title: ' Ud
description: ' Ud The ' ud ( OOD ) was a stringed Zakharan instrument similar to both the lute or guitar . Because of its rich tone , the " ' ud " was often referred to as " amir al - tarab " which translated as " prince of enchantment " in Midani . Description .

title: ' Ud of the marids
description: ' Ud of the marids The ' ud of the marids was a beautiful magical " ' ud " created by marid luthiers to be presented to the new high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , therefore multiple " ' uds of the marids " existed throughout Zakhara . Description .

title: A - Ling Shan
description: A - Ling Shan The A - Ling Shan was a mountain range located in the Hordelands . Geography . An extension of the great Yehimal , this mountain range divided the southern portion of Raurin from the Katakoro Plateau .

title: A Discovery of the World
description: A Discovery of the World A Discovery of the World , also called A Description of the World , was a book written by Vilhiard of Procampur , a renowned scholar and monk of Deneir . It told of his travels into the Hordelands and other lands of the East , and described all the lands he explored and the customs of the peoples he met , such as the Tuigan . The book was written with the Thorass script in a corresponding archaic language and older spellings for Tuigan terms , such as naming them " Taangan " .

title: A History of the Tuigan
description: A History of the Tuigan Observations of the Tuigan Historian , Recording the Life of Yamun Khahan from his Rise to his Death in the Lands of the West , from Notes made for King Azoun of Cormyr , with the tentatively shortened title of A History of the Tuigan , was a book written by the lama Koja of Khazari in the early 1360s DR . Following his " Life among the Tuigan " , Koja expanded his notes into his new book , aiming to give a complete account of Yamun Khahan , the Tuigan people , and their history . He wrote much of the book while staying at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast , and was close to finishing it in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR .

title: A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt
description: A Reader ' s Guide to R . A . Salvatore ' s the Legend of Drizzt A Reader ' s Guide to R .

title: AD & D Trading Cards
description: AD & D Trading Cards AD & D Trading Cards or Collector Cards were a series of trading cards published by TSR , Inc . between 1991 and 1993 . The cards adhere to 2nd - edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules , and were released in three separate yearly series .

title: Aalangama Gulderhorn
description: Aalangama Gulderhorn Lady Aalangama Gulderhorn was Countess of Morninggold , Title Chancellor of Tethyr , Marquise Scion of Siamorphe , and commander and one of the founders of the Order of the Silver Chalice . She was also the unofficial Crown Ecclesiastic of Tethyr . Description .

title: Aarakocra
description: Aarakocra Aarakocras ( æ - ra - KO - kras ) were a race of avian monstrous humanoid s . Appearance . Aarakocras resembled humanoid birds .

title: Aarin Gend
description: Aarin Gend Aarin Gend was Lord Nasher ' s personal spymaster and played a part in protecting Neverwinter through the Wailing Death , the Cult of the Eye ' s plots and attack from Luskan . Description . A large human man with dark skin and hair .

title: Aaronarra
description: Aaronarra Aaronarra was an old copper dragon living on the western side of the High Moor , near the Misty Forest . He was around 700 years old in 1368 DR and had a bad attitude . For food , he selected creatures whose populations could reasonably be reduced , such as goblin s .

title: Aarun
description: Aarun Aarun was a Harper in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Aarun was a member of the Harpers based in Ten Towns .

title: Aasim
description: Aasim Aasim was an elven sha ' ir living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Aasim was responsible for inspecting all of the cargo at the wharf in Bandar al - Sa ' adat .

title: Aasim al - Nazi
description: Aasim al - Nazi Aasim al - Nazi was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Aasim was an honest man who was completely devoted to his work .

title: Aasimar
description: Aasimar Aasimar , derived from the Mulhorand i word " aasimon " , were human - based planetouched , native outsider s that had in their blood some good , otherworldly characteristics . They were often , but not always , descended from angel s and other creatures of pure good alignment , but while predisposed to good alignments , aasimar were by no means always good . Description .

title: Ab ' i
description: Ab ' i Ab ' i was a plant that grew in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . Viewed from the surface , ab ' i looked like tall brown grass .

title: Aba
description: Aba An aba ( pronounced AH - bah ) was a sleeveless , light fabric robe or cloak worn by men and women to protect against the elements , common to peoples from desert climes , such as Calishite s , Zakharan s , or the Bedine . Variants . A heavier , more expensive type of aba , called a " jellaba " was worn in winter .

title: Aba of the desert
description: Aba of the desert The aba of the desert was a magical garment that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Aba s " were light robes or cloaks in Zakhara .

title: Aba of the elements
description: Aba of the elements An aba of the elements was a magic robe found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The coloration of an " aba of the elements " depended on the element it represented with flame being red , wind being blue , sand being white , and sea being green .

title: Aballister Bonaduce
description: Aballister Bonaduce Aballister Bonaduce was a wizard and head of the Triumvirate of Castle Trinity . Aballister Bonaduce was the nemesis of his son Cadderly Bonaduce . Calculating , cold , and merciless , Aballister did everything to see his quest for the Chaos Curse completed .

title: Aban al - Hadhar
description: Aban al - Hadhar Aban al - Hadhar was a gnome barber who lived in Hawa . Description . Aban possessed a loud voice and could usually be heard at any time in the cities ' Free Market .

title: Abarax
description: Abarax Abarax was a pit fiend that managed to depose and assume the identity of Lord Orgauth until he was slain by Scyllua Darkhope . Description . Abarax in his true form stood 12ft ( 3 .

title: Abas for All
description: Abas for All Abas for All was a shop located in the Clothiers ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Abas for All sold a wide variety of hand - crafted aba s .

title: Abazigal
description: Abazigal Abazigal was one of The Five , the loosely allied group of powerful Bhaalspawn who rose to prominence during the time of the fulfillment of Alaundo ' s prophecy about the children of Bhaal . Apparently the offspring of Bhaal and a blue dragon , he could assume the form of either a humanoid hybrid with reptilian features , or a powerful blue dragon . He had his lair in a cavern complex somewhere in Tethyr and may have been amassing an " army " of dragons , though this was only implied .

title: Abbalaya
description: Abbalaya The Abbalayar ( singular Abbalaya ) were a tribe of human s in Calimshan known and feared for their divinatory powers . They were so unique both magically and physically that they were often considered a distinct subrace of human . Etymology .

title: Abbathor
description: Abbathor Abbathor ( ÆB - ba - thor ) , also known as the Great Master of Greed , was the neutral evil dwarven god of greed before becoming an exarch of Bane . He was an intensely greedy deity and was both desirous and envious of others ' riches . Abbathor and his followers believed in the acquisition of all forms of wealth by any and all means necessary .

title: Abbey of St . Sollars
description: Abbey of St . Sollars The Abbey of Saint Sollars was the temple of Ilmater in Bloodstone Village , Damara . Structure .

title: Abbey of the Just Hammer
description: Abbey of the Just Hammer The Abbey of the Just Hammer was an abbey in Tasseldale , in the Dalelands , dedicated to Tyr . It was positioned close to the River Ashaba . The abbey ' s focus was upon the justice element of Tyr ' s portfolio and provided legal education for free .

title: Abbey of the Rose
description: Abbey of the Rose The Abbey of the Rose was a secret temple in shadovar - dominated Sembia . It was located near the river Draal before it joined the river Arkhen , east of the Thunder Peaks . Once it was a temple to Mask .

title: Abbey of the Sword
description: Abbey of the Sword The Abbey of the Sword was a large temple to Tempus in Battledale , which was built atop a network of caverns leading to " portals " to the Underdark . Leadership . The abbey ' s founder , Eldan Ambrose led the abbey until his death during a battle with drow .

title: Abdel Adrian
description: Abdel Adrian Abdel Adrian was a male human Bhaalspawn and a mercenary warrior . He became tangled in the sinister plans of a number of other Bhaalspawn , as well as of Jon Irenicus , but emerged victorious . Appearance .

title: Abeir
description: Abeir Abeir was the twin planet of Toril , located in the same material plane of its sibling world , but within a " pocket dimension " that was out of synchrony with Toril . Abeir revolved around the same sun of Realmspace , although from Abeir the sun was seen as blue colored . Abeir shared the lunar satellite Selûne and its Tears with Toril .

title: Abeir - Toril
description: Abeir - Toril Abeir - Toril ( Ai - BEER - toh - RILL ) was the name of a prehistoric planet that existed before - 31000 DR when Ao sundered the world into two worlds : Abeir and Toril . The name was archaic , meaning " cradle of life " . Geography .

title: Abeiran Underdark
description: Abeiran Underdark The Abeiran Underdark was the equivalent of Toril ' s Underdark on the world of Abeir . Other than it was inhabited by drow and mysterious monsters , nothing more was known about this region . A portion of the Abeiran Underdark was transported to Toril alongside Laerakond during the Blue Breath of Change .

title: Aberration
description: Aberration Aberrations were creatures from or touched by the Far Realm , thereby making them utterly alien to the Prime Material Plane , the fundamental plane s , the parallel plane s , or any other regions of the local cosmology . Aberrations generally all had bizarre anatomies , strange abilities , alien mindsets , or any combination thereof . Most aberrations had darkvision out to 60 feet .

title: Abishai
description: Abishai Abishai ( ÆB - i - shy ) were medium - sized baatezu devil s from the first two circles of the Nine Hells , who were servants of Tiamat . They were guards and torturers . Description .

title: Abjuration
description: Abjuration The abjuration school of magic encompassed protective spells . They created physical or magical barriers , negated magical or physical abilities , harmed trespassers , or even banished the subject of the spell to another plane of existence . The abjuration school had no subschools .

title: Abjure undead
description: Abjure undead Abjure undead was a " channel divinity " prayer cast by avenger s . When an avenger cast " abjure undead " he or she pulled any undead within a 5 foot ( 1 . 5 m ) radius at least10 feet ( 3m ) toward themselves .

title: Aboleth
description: Aboleth Aboleths ( ÆB - o - leths ) were a race of malevolent , eel - like aberration s with potent psionic abilities . Description . Aboleths were fish - like amphibians of immense size , often reaching 20 feet ( 6 .

title: Abolethic Sovereignty
description: Abolethic Sovereignty The Abolethic Sovereignty were the original aboleth s of the Realms , who dwelt in the flying , obelisk - shaped city of Xxiphu , that has existed since prehistoric times . The Abolethic Sovereignty originally came to Abeir - Toril when the world was young , when Xxiphu plummeted to the world and settled deep below what is now the Sea of Fallen Stars . The oldest - known aboleth and possibly the progenitor of the entire species , the Eldest , was an enormous creature that rested atop the city like a throne .

title: Abolethic Sovereignty ( series )
description: Abolethic Sovereignty ( series ) Abolethic Sovereignty is a trilogy of novels written by Bruce R . Cordell . Summary .

title: Abomination
description: Abomination Abominations were a loosely organized group of creatures of varying origin left over from the Dawn War between the god s and their primordial adversaries . Many abominations were either weapons forged for the purpose of destruction or creatures created out of the ashes of the war . Some were created purposefully by gods , others by primordials , and others were complete accidents , created inadvertently .

title: Abon Duum
description: Abon Duum Abon Duum was a human man and a pasha of Manshaka in Calimshan in the 14th century DR . History . For over half a century , Abon Duum ruled the city of Manshaka and its Arenas of Blood as a ruthless despot and crime - lord holding absolute power .

title: Aborana Startoucher
description: Aborana Startoucher Aborana Startoucher was a famous oracle and fortune teller in Memnon , before having to relocate to the Calling Horn in Beliard . History . Famous for her accuracy as a seer , Aborana would often give advice to those whose fortunes were less than pleasant .

title: Abordabe
description: Abordabe Abordabe was the chieftain of the largest tribe in Narfell in 1359 DR , the Adordabe . Activities . Abordabe supervised the massive Trade Fair each summer .

title: Abraxus
description: Abraxus An abraxus was a magical creation similar to a golem or automaton . History . The abraxus were created by Chondath an mages to serve Sembia ' s Chondathan borders .

title: Abraxus affair
description: Abraxus affair The abraxus affair referred to the attack on King Azoun IV by an abraxus , a magical golden bull - like creature in 1369 DR . Beginning . The king was hunting in the forest with his cousins Baron Thomdor and Duke Bhereu , and Aunadar Bleth , when the creature sprung unexpectedly from an abandoned ruined elven watch tower , giving off poisonous gas as it attacked .

title: Abu Bakr
description: Abu Bakr Abu Bakr was the Caliph of Semphar during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Abu Bakr ruled Semphar from the capital of Dhaztanar .

title: Abul Fiydah
description: Abul Fiydah Abul Fiydah was the Amir of Estanil during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As the ultimate commander of the forces stationed in Estanil , Abul was faced with the difficult task of defending the border city of Semphar .

title: Abutsu
description: Abutsu Abutsu was a villager of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Abutsu was a widow of Seinin village .

title: Abysmal Creed
description: Abysmal Creed The Abysmal Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They focused on instilling fear into thrall populations . They were highly efficient at torturing thrall races .

title: Abyss
description: Abyss The Abyss ( a - BIS ) was the birth place of the demon s , a chaotic evil universe unto itself with uncountable layers of infinite variety connected haphazardly . The Abyss ' s place in the cosmology of the Forgotten Realms shifted over time , but the nature of the plane remained fairly constant : a violent , malevolent place where the strong survived on the backs of the weak , the weak conspired to overthrow the strong , alliances only lasted while convenient , and the landscape itself tortured the mind and body of all who dared to pass . Cosmology .

title: Abyssal Plague
description: Abyssal Plague The Abyssal Plague is a multiverse - spanning series of seven novels and one novella , published by Wizards of the Coast between 2010 and 2012 . The event revolves around the Voidharrow , an entity from a dead universe that is unleashed across multiple worlds . Two of the novels in the " Abyssal Plague " series are set in the Forgotten Realms .

title: Abyssal Plague ( disease )
description: Abyssal Plague ( disease ) The Abyssal Plague was a condition inflicted upon victims who came into contact with the Voidharrow . This disease and its malevolence was divine in nature , and its victims ' used symbols and scripts associated with the worship of Tharizdun , an interloper deity from another world . It was usually fatal unless cured or until the victim was transformed into a plague demon .

title: Abyssal drake
description: Abyssal drake Abyssal drakes were a mixing of demon s , red dragon s , and wyvern s , created to serve as mounts for demon rulers . Description . An abyssal drake appeared similar to a wyvern , but it had red scales and bat - like wings .

title: Abyssal ghoul
description: Abyssal ghoul Abyssal ghouls were extraplanar undead creatures that served the drow goddess Kiaransalee . Description . Appearing much like an ordinary ghoul with a twisted and bestial humanoid form , an abyssal ghoul differed in a few ways .

title: Abyssal language
description: Abyssal language The abyssal language was the language of demons . History . It was a form of the Primordial language warped and twisted by the evil of the Abyss .

title: Academy of Shapers and Binders
description: Academy of Shapers and Binders The Academy of Shapers and Binders was a magic academy for the Red Wizards of Thay , located on Thaymount in Thay . The school specialized in transmutation magic . Its motto was " Nothing is immutable .

title: Acamar
description: Acamar Acamar was an elder evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Acamar didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description .

title: Accalia
description: Accalia Accalia was a female human priest from the Temple of Tempus in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . As a follower of Tempus , the priestess wore armor even while completing her temple duties .

title: Achaierai
description: Achaierai Achaierais ( a - CHY - ur - ys ) were large , flightless , birdlike creatures that could be found in the Barrens of Doom and Despair and in Acheron . Description . These creatures resembled 15 - ft - tall ( 4 .

title: Acham el Jhotos
description: Acham el Jhotos Acham el Jhotos , whose full name was Acham yn Aban el Jhotos , yi Almraiven and who was commonly referred to as the Weavepasha , was a mighty wizard and the ruler of Almraiven in Calimshan . He was considered to be one of the most powerful mortals alive in 1479 . His entire life was dedicated to defending the city of Almraiven from djinn , efreet , and other menaces .

title: Achazar ' s Throne
description: Achazar ' s Throne Achazar ' s Throne was a mountain located in the Nightmare ' s Hoof mountain range , near the the city of Sambral , one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Background . The mountain had a depression in its southern face beneath its peak .

title: Acheron
description: Acheron Acheron ( ÆTCH - ur - un ) was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between lawful evil and lawful neutral with emphasis on law . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Clangor , Nishrek , and Warrior ' s Rest when that cosmology became popular . Nishrek and Warrior ' s Rest survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology model .

title: Achmed al - Assad
description: Achmed al - Assad Achmed al - Assad was the father of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir — the Grand Caliph of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Achmed served as the Grand Caliph until his death .

title: Achreny Ulyeltin
description: Achreny Ulyeltin Achreny Ulyeltin was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Achreny was a boorish man without trace of civilization about him .

title: Acid
description: Acid Acid was a grisly liquid that could cause major and permanent scarring , and possible death . Spell Use . Acid was a component in the following spells : A number of spells produced effects with acid : Magic items .

title: Acid Aerie
description: Acid Aerie The Acid Aerie was gorge located several days walk west of Blingdenstone . Description . The Acid Aerie was several hundred - foot - wide and filled with foul - smelling acid , the result of a wizard ' s experiment long ago .

title: Acid arrow
description: Acid arrow Acid arrow , sometimes called more completely Melf ' s acid arrow is a somewhat complex wizard spell learned very early on in a mage ' s training . When cast , " acid arrow " conjure s an arrow of acid that speeds from the caster ' s hand towards a single creature within 100 feet . The " acid arrow " , upon hitting , not only deals immediate damage but leaves a festering wound of acid .

title: Acid dart
description: Acid dart An acid dart was a hollow dart that contained acid . When striking something , the dart broke and released the acid in a splashing fashion , as well as the usual piercing action associated with darts . Acid darts cost 20 gp each and weighed around 1 lb ( 450 g ) .

title: Acid fog
description: Acid fog Acid fog , also known as death fog , was an conjuration spell that created acid ic vapors . Users . " Acid fog " could be cast by sorcerer s and wizard s , as well as cleric s who commanded the Water domain .

title: Acid splash
description: Acid splash Acid splash , also known as acid orb , was a conjuration spell used by sorcerer s and wizard s . Effect . When " acid splash " was cast , the sorcerer or wizard conjured a sphere of liquid acid which , when thrust at a target , collided and exploded , burning one creature with its contents .

title: Acid storm
description: Acid storm Acid storm was a spell that caused acid to rain down in an area 20 feet ( 6 meters ) in diameter . Components . The material component of this spell was a flask of acid .

title: Acidic burst
description: Acidic burst Acidic burst is a quality that can be applied to weapons , making them corrosive to the touch , and causing them to spew a burst of acid on a critical strike . If ranged weapons are given this quality , the effects apply to any ammunition loaded into them .

title: Ackyn Selebon
description: Ackyn Selebon Ackyn Selebon was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ackyn was one of the contacts of Leosin Erlanthar and provided support for the adventuring party recruited to fight the Cult of the Dragon when they passed through his city .

title: Acrobat
description: Acrobat Acrobats were agile individuals . Background . Those who studied the art of acrobatics seldom wore armor and attacked with very light weapons or simply their bare hands .

title: Ad ' non Kareese
description: Ad ' non Kareese Ad ' non Kareese was a male drow and a member of a band of four renegades including Donnia Soldou , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett , and Tos ' un Armgo . History . Ad ' non belonged to House Khareese of Ched Nasad .

title: Adaerglast
description: Adaerglast Adaerglast , also known as the Land of Mages , was a coastal region in the west of the Border Kingdoms . Its coastline was sometimes known as the Garden Coast because it was one of the most fertile areas of farmland in Faerûn . " Adaernen " was the word used to describe inhabitants of Adaerglast .

title: Adalon
description: Adalon Adalon was a silver dragon living in the Underdark near the city of Ust Natha . Her task was to guard the drow city and maintain peace and the balance between the drow and the elves of Suldanessellar . History .

title: Adalwulf Longfang
description: Adalwulf Longfang Adalwulf Longfang was the honorable of the Red Tiger Tribe Uthgardt barbarian tribe located primarily in the Cold Wood . Personality . Under Adalwulf ' s rule , the Red Tigers were strictly a wild and solitary tribe .

title: Adam Gillespie
description: Adam Gillespie Adam Gillespie is an illustrator who works with numerous clients including Wizards of the Coast . Adam ' s art is usually cover art as he works in full color . His most recent work for Wizards was several images in " A Reader ' s Guide to R .

title: Adama
description: Adama The Adama was a spiritual belief held by almost all Durpar ians . After Mulhorand invaded Durpar and wiped out the barbarian clans , a simple trader emerged to lead the remnants of his people . His name was Satama and he claimed to have experienced a divine revelation , which he turned into the philosophy of the Adama .

title: Adama ' s Wrath
description: Adama ' s Wrath Adama ' s Wrath was the highest peak of the mighty Dustwall Mountains in the Shining South . Description . Though the Dustwall Mountains averaged 15 , 000 ft .

title: Adama Miiralin
description: Adama Miiralin Adama Miiralin was a young and naive cleric of Tymora in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Adama was a young and enthusiastic man .

title: Adamantine
description: Adamantine Adamantine was a jet - black alloy of adamantium and other metals . Usually black in colour , adamantine had a green sheen when viewed by candlelight or a purple - white sheen when viewed by magical light . It was found only in veins of ore near earth node s and areas of " faerzress " in the Underdark .

title: Adan Longstride
description: Adan Longstride Adan Longstride was an ambassador to the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the midst of council , Adan Longstride maligned the good will of the commander of the Legendary Campaign , who had been appointed emissary to Nix with the task of negotiating peace terms with the king of the goblins . In accordance with goblin custom , they had to resolve their disagreement in trial by combat , which they did through bloodforge battle .

title: Adanac Harpell
description: Adanac Harpell Adanac Harpell was the elder of the Harpell family and spokesman for the town of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier . Relationships . The magic - user was the father of Ardanac Harpell .

title: Addazahr
description: Addazahr Addazahr , or Backbiters , were tiny flying insects that lived in Zakhara ’ s deserts , hills , and plains . Description . These tiny creatures were only 2 inches ( 5 .

title: Addemios Three - Dawn
description: Addemios Three - Dawn Addemios Three - Dawn was one of the lieutenants of Merrisara Winterwhite , the leader of the returned Iliyanbruen eladrin in Neverwinter Wood . However , Addemios ' s true goal was more nefarious than rebuilding the ancient elven empire . He wanted to start a war between the Iliyanbruen elves and the human s of Neverwinter , under orders of his god Asmodeus .

title: Adder River
description: Adder River The Adder River ran south to north from the Adder Peaks to empty into the Bay of Chessenta through the Adder Swamp . Geography . The Adder River was described as being a wide , slow flowing river with muddy water .

title: Adder Swamp
description: Adder Swamp The Adder Swamp was a dangerous expanse of lycanthrope - infested marshland that surrounded the Adder River delta in Chessenta . History . The native werecrocodile s had a half - sunken settlement somewhere on the seaward edge of the swamp , but when a community of wererat s migrated to the area , the werecrocodiles ' territorial nature caused the two races to immediately come to blows .

title: Addition
description: Addition Addition was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to create one or more simple , ordinary , identical objects or even a single , small , natural creature . This was accomplished by " adding a term to the equation of the moment . " Effects .

title: Adera ( intellect devourer )
description: Adera ( intellect devourer ) " Adera Moonfist " was a disguised intellect devourer in the Moonsea region . Personality . Like its master , the mind flayer Vanquo , its main goal was to acquire an artifact from the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Adera Moonfist
description: Adera Moonfist Adera Moonfist was a famed thief in Ravens Bluff . History . She descended from Satcheera Moonfist , a member of the Turning Key , a famed Mulmaster adventuring party that had hidden a treasure in Flooded Forest .

title: Adhal
description: Adhal Adhal was a small town in North Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Adhal was located along several caravan routes in between Qudra and the Sea of Caravans .

title: Adhan el Ilmater
description: Adhan el Ilmater Adhan el Ilmater was a human man and a priest of Ilmater . He was the leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , " circa " 1370 DR . Adhan was a kind and wise man , who often worked directly with his patients .

title: Adhe Wood
description: Adhe Wood Adhe Wood was a forest located in the Vast , lying south of the Earthfast Mountains , between the North Road and the Tsurlar Forest , north - east of the hamlet of Sevenecho . It was infested with arachnid monsters . Description .

title: Adimond Kroskas
description: Adimond Kroskas Adimond Kroskas was the leader of a Cult of the Dragon cell in Neverwinter circa 1480 DR . He was enslaved by Valindra Shadowmantle , who also gained his " ring of dragons " . However , he agreed to her project of resurrecting the legendary dragon Lorragauth as a dracolich .

title: Adisha Brombottle
description: Adisha Brombottle Adisha Brombottle was a halfling merchant at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Adisha was depressed , bored , and very often drunk .

title: Adjudicators
description: Adjudicators The Adjudicators ( " Schatjamaetrish " in Tymantheran ) < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p146 " > < / ref > were an organization of dragonborn soldiers gathered from every clan , who served as the police force of Djerad Thymar under the direct command of the Vanquisher . When there was a crime a dragonborn clan could not handle on their own , it was the duty of the Adjudicators to take care of it . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p61 , 145 " > < / ref > Members of the Adjudicators used golden beads beneath their eyes as piercings , mimicking the same kind of piercings used by the Vanquisher .

title: Administrator genie
description: Administrator genie Administrator genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who served the bureaucracies of humans as well as other genie s . They served as diplomats , advisers , and general bureaucrats . They often worked under warmonger genie s .

title: Adnan al - Raqi
description: Adnan al - Raqi Adnan al - Raqi , also called the Pillar of Wisdom , Master of the Invisible , and the Whisper that Thunders , was a powerful sha ' ir who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Adnan ' s desire for protection left his body ailing after having permanently cast " detect invisibility " , " protection from normal missiles " , and " avert evil eye " upon himself .

title: Adolican Rhand
description: Adolican Rhand Adolican Rhand was a Waterdeep noble wizard who worked for the Shadovar . History . Adolican twice crossed paths with the warlock Farideh , first in search of the secret of the Netherese arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding and the second when Farideh was coerced to work for him in a secret Shadovar fortress that housed many captured Chosen ; he was killed during the escape of the chosen from the camp .

title: Adon
description: Adon Adon was a human man and a cleric of Sune and later Mystra . He was a prominent personality of the Time of Troubles . History .

title: Adordabe
description: Adordabe The Adordabe were a tribe of Nar found in Narfell . Organization . Roughly 4 , 000 Nar comprised the Adordabe , making them the largest tribe found within Narfell .

title: Adras Ashatiel
description: Adras Ashatiel Adras Ashatiel was the heir of the Ashatiel noble family of Waterdeep around 1368 DR . She joined the armed forces of Waterdeep while her brother Arran Ashatiel studied as a businessman . However , Arran was killed in 1368 DR under the orders of Sarevok Anchev .

title: Adreen
description: Adreen Adreen was a human merchant in Mantol - Derith in 1479 DR . Activities . Adreen usually sold exotic pets .

title: Adresin
description: Adresin Adresin was a knight of the Golden Star who had joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade . In 1374 DR , during the Cormanthor War , he acted as Seiveril ' s herald and adjutant on the field of battle . Later , he died fighting alone at the Semberholme border .

title: Adrianna
description: Adrianna Adrianna was a female elf and sorceress . She helped topple the Dark Alliance alongside fellow adventurer s Kromlech and Vahn . Description .

title: Adrienne Stillwater
description: Adrienne Stillwater Adrienne Stillwater was a female half - elf ranger and cleric of Mielikki operating in the Hullack Forest and the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Basing herself in Thunderstone on occasion , Adrienne roamed northeastern Cormyr around the Hullack Forest .

title: Adris Colebriar
description: Adris Colebriar Adris Colebriar was a male human fighter and a merchant of the Six Coffers Trading Coster . He managed a branch office in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Adris was a shrewd trader , and through him the Six Coffers dominated trade in the town .

title: Adun Abd al - Amin
description: Adun Abd al - Amin Adun Abd al - Amin was the general and commander of the Faithful Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Adun viewed Hatit Abd al - Wajib and Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib as personal enemies .

title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons ( comic series )
description: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons ( comic series ) Advanced Dungeons & Dragons is a series of comic books originally published by and set in the " Forgotten Realms " . Summary . The series told the adventures of a motley band of heroes : Vajra Valmeyjar , a former champion gladiator of Manshaka ; Timoth Eyesbright , a good - hearted centaur warrior ; Onyx the Invincible , an irascible dwarf fighter and thief ; and Kyriani Agrivar , a mischievous half - elf wizard .

title: Adventurer
description: Adventurer An adventurer was one who took risks in the pursuit of a goal . Some did it for fame , others for money . Some sought revenge , while others laid down their lives in defense of their kings , their families , or the land itself .

title: Adventurers League
description: Adventurers League The Adventurers League ( also termed the D & D Adventurers League ) is Wizards of the Coast ' s flagship organized play program for the fifth edition of Dungeons & Dragons . The Adventurers League is a continuation of the D & D Encounters program that was part of the fourth edition experience . Stores that are members of the Wizards Play Network can submit reports on the results of adventures , just like they could during the Encounters program , but are no longer beholden to a weekly schedule .

title: Advespa
description: Advespa An advespa was a devil resembling a black wasp . Appearance . The advespa was the size of a bear .

title: Aearee
description: Aearee The aearee were the avian creator race of Faerûn . The aearee prospered during the Days of Thunder . History .

title: Aec ' Letec
description: Aec ' Letec Aec ' Letec was a powerful tanar ' ri who was killed by Durlag Trollkiller , who then trapped the demon ' s soul in an enchanted dagger . Eventually after the madness and death of Durlag , Aec ' Letec broke free from the dagger but remained trapped in Durlag ' s Tower . At last , Gorion ' s Ward entered the tower and , on the highest floor , fought and killed the demon .

title: Aegis - fang
description: Aegis - fang Aegis - fang was the weapon of Wulfgar , son of Beornegar , of the Elk tribe . Description . The head of this beautiful weapon was made from mithral , and the shaft was made from adamantite .

title: Aegis of assault
description: Aegis of assault Aegis of assault is among the most basic spell s known to swordmage s , used primarily by assault swordmages . A spell of the conjuration school , " aegis of assault " allows a swordmage to form an arcane bond with a creature within an area of ten feet in diameter nearby . The creature so ensnared becomes intently tied to its disadvantage .

title: Aegis of shielding
description: Aegis of shielding Aegis of shielding is a very basic spell of the abjuration school used by shielding swordmage s . When a swordmage casts " aegis of shielding " they forge a magic al link between themselves and a foe within a nearby area of ten feet in diameter . When the foe attacks an ally of the swordmage , the link hampers their efforts , making their strikes less effectual .

title: Aekyl Dafyre
description: Aekyl Dafyre Aekyl Dafyre was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 . History . Circa 1340 DR , Aekyl was a cartographer and guide for Undermountain until a day when he was guiding three nobles and , thanks to one of Halaster ' s " gate s " , they were ambushed by two owlbear s .

title: Aelia
description: Aelia Goodwoman Aelia was a healer and herbalist in the Moonsea . History . At one point Aelia settled in the small Moonsea village of Hillpicket .

title: Aelinthaldaar
description: Aelinthaldaar Aelinthaldaar was the capital of Illefarn , an ancient elven civilization in northwest Faerûn . The city was located where Waterdeep would later stand . History .

title: Aelorothi
description: Aelorothi House Aelorothi was a sun elf house whose traditional role was to provide cleric s of Corellon Larethian or the Seldarine to work in Evermeet ' s temples or on the battlefield . The house estate was located in Leuthilspar and consisted of a tall , thin blue and green tower . The house possessed two " rods of resurrection " and the " Staff of Rumathil " .

title: Aelric the Avenger
description: Aelric the Avenger Aelric the Avenger was a warrior - mage who tried to liberate the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Aelric was a man of Doegan who became heir to a legacy of great mages .

title: Aencar Burlisk
description: Aencar Burlisk Aencar Burlisk ( " ay - AN - kar " ) was a Dalesfolk hero who united all of the Dales ( with the exception of Archendale and High Dale ) , in 1038 DR . History . Childhood .

title: Aerdrie Faenya
description: Aerdrie Faenya Aerdrie Faenya , also known as Queen of the Avariel , was an elven goddess of the Seldarine . She was free , chaotic and impulsive , and didn ' t like to stay in any one place for too long . While she delighted in creating unpredictable weather , including some fairly severe thunderstorms , her primary joy was simply to feel the air around her as she flew high above the ground .

title: Aerego Bethendur
description: Aerego Bethendur Aerego Bethendur was a businessman in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Personality . Aerego never asked about goods placed in his storage , even if they contained cadavers .

title: Aerel Hassammar
description: Aerel Hassammar Aerel Hassammar was the owner and operator of the Swords Meet inn and tavern located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Aerel was a fair man , but relentlessly drove his staff to be fast , efficient , silent , and unseen .

title: Aerie
description: Aerie Aerie was a female avariel , a race of winged elves , who was crippled by her wings being cut off , forcing her to remain earthbound for the rest of her life . History . Aerie ' s earliest life was spent apparently happily in Faenya - Dail , one of the few remaining cities of her people .

title: Aerie of the Snow Eagles
description: Aerie of the Snow Eagles The Aerie of the Snow Eagles was the only known large settlement of the avariel left on Toril . Located on the eastern edge of the Great Glacier , the Aerie was a palace made of crystal built atop the sheared peak of Mount Sundabar . History .

title: Aerilaya
description: Aerilaya Aerilaya was a female green elf druid who came to live on Evermeet after wandering Faerûn for some time , spreading the faith of Rillifane Rallathil . She was tall with long dark hair in a single braid bound with a copper headband engraved with oak leaves . She came to Evermeet after an " unfortunate incident " involving an oak tree , great quantities of ale , and a Chauntea n monk whose identity was not made known .

title: Aerilpar Forest
description: Aerilpar Forest The Aerilpar Forest , also known as the Wood of Dark Trees , both for its animated jungle and the dangerous beasts that prowled it , was located in Veldorn in 1367 DR . Geography . The Wood of Dark Trees was found between the Giant ' s Belt Mountains to the north and the Liontongue River to the south .

title: Aerisi Kalinoth
description: Aerisi Kalinoth Aerisi Kalinoth was the Prophet of Air and leader of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . Activities . Obsessed with the legends of the avariel , she used constant illusion magic and flying spells to appear as one .

title: Aeron Morieth
description: Aeron Morieth Aeron Morieth was a half - elven wizard and shadow adept who lived in Chessenta . History . In 1367 DR , Aeron Morieth became the Stormwalker of Maerchwood .

title: Aerosclughpalar
description: Aerosclughpalar Aerosclughpalar , also called " Gildenfire " , Vaeros Fireshield , The Druid Dragon and the Wyrm of Golden Hue , was a neutral gold dragon who , as of 1368 DR , inhabited Tall Trees , in human form , as a druid of Mielikki . Relations . Aerosclughpalar had assumed human form and become a druid of Mielikki , which put him at some odds with his peers , although he still acknowledged Lareth .

title: Aesgareth
description: Aesgareth Aesgareth was a cambion who was once trapped inside Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . Eventually , he met Gorion ' s Ward and tried to bargain . However , Gorion ' s Ward killed him in order to collect the items needed to exit the keep .

title: Aesperus
description: Aesperus Aesperus was a lich wizard dwelling in the city of Hulburg near the Moonsea . History . Some time in the 9th century DR , Aesperus was a wizard fighting in defense of Hulburg .

title: Afafrenfere
description: Afafrenfere Afafrenfere was a human monk of the Brothers of the Gray Mists and a former member of Cavus Dun . He was saved from death by fellow Cavus Dun member Ambergris ; the two then traveled with Drizzt Do ' Urden and his companions until Drizzt ' s apparent demise at Kelvin ' s Cairn . At the splintering of the group , Afafrenfere sought penance at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , with Ambergris as his companion , before he was assigned to journey with the drow Jarlaxle .

title: Afanc
description: Afanc Afanc ( AY - fænk ) , or gawwar samakat , were a dangerous breed of fish found in the oceans around Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These creatures were initially named because they were confused with a similar creature found in the distant Moonshae Isles . Within the Land of Fate , " gawwar samakat " was the proper name to use when discussing these fish .

title: Affluent District
description: Affluent District The Affluent District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Nestled in the southeast corner of Huzuz against the city walls , the Affluent District was found in the Palace Quarter and was one of the smaller city districts .

title: Afrafa
description: Afrafa Afrafa was a female human monk and a member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the mid – 14th century DR . Description .

title: Afyal
description: Afyal Afyal , also called the Isle of the Elephant , was a large island kingdom at the eastern edge of Zakhara , north of Sahu . Geography . The kingdom ' s capital , Medina al - Afyal , was also its only real city .

title: Aga
description: Aga Aga was an evil wu jen in Kozakura . History . In 505 DR , Aga settled in Kurojo castle in Kuroi - joshima and from there terrorized the inhabitants of Miyama Province , not wanting to rule but only to gain special privileges .

title: Agada Vane
description: Agada Vane Agada Vane was a shopkeeper in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Agada was a regular customer at the Yawning Portal inn .

title: Agal
description: Agal In Zakhara n culture , an agal was a cord ( or group of cords ) used to secure a keffiyeh ( headcloth ) to one ' s head . Agal were available in a wide variety , ranging everywhere from simple hemp to gold or jeweled thread . Prices .

title: Aganazzar ' s scorcher
description: Aganazzar ' s scorcher Aganazzar ' s scorcher was an arcane evocation spell that created a destructive jet of flame . History . " Aganazzar ' s scorcher " was created by the wizard Aganazzar .

title: Aganis
description: Aganis Aganis was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a barkeep of the local inn . Personality .

title: Agaricus
description: Agaricus Agaricus was one of the myconid rulers in Sporedome . History . During the Rage of Demons , many myconid sprouts disappeared from Agaricus ' s colony and from many others .

title: Agate
description: Agate Agate , the gemstone , came in many forms and colors , most of which were considered ornamental stones or hardstones in the " Realms " . Description . Agates were a form of chalcedony , which made them part of a large family of gems and minerals .

title: Agate Anchor
description: Agate Anchor The Agate Anchor was a curio shop in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Location . The shop lay on Dragonleather Street , in the southern part of the city .

title: Agatha
description: Agatha Agatha was a banshee who haunted the Neverwinter Wood near Conyberry . Description . The banshee looked like she did in life : an elven maiden clad in a flowing gown .

title: Agatha ' s Grove
description: Agatha ' s Grove Agatha ' s Grove was the lair of the " Ghost of Neverwinter Wood " , Agatha . Geography . The grove was northwest of the Conyberry area at the end of a path whose entrance was marked by a group of birch trees in the Neverwinter Wood in northwest Faerûn .

title: Agatha ' s mask
description: Agatha ' s mask Agatha ' s mask was a magical item of illusion . Description . Agatha ' s mask was a plain white stage mask with a simple cord to hold it in place .

title: Age of Humanity
description: Age of Humanity The Age of Humanity was the period from about −3000 to 1358 DR . Description . This period began with the decline of the elven and dwarven empires and the flourishing and expansion of the human empires .

title: Agency
description: Agency The Agency was both a mercenary company and an adventuring party around 1358 DR . Membership . The Agency had a very unusual roster of members : three elves : a blade bard , a bladesinger , and a wilderness ranger , one tabaxi , one aarakocra , and one hengeyokai cat plus a gnomish priest with mechanical parts and a human militant wizard .

title: Agents of the Eye
description: Agents of the Eye The Agents of the Eye was a slaving ring in Skullport run by a paranoid elder beholder . History . The Agents of the Eye was a slaving ring created by The Eye after his arrival in Skullport in 1205 DR .

title: Aghazstamn
description: Aghazstamn Aghazstamm was a blue dragon dracolich . He was a member of the Cult of the Dragon and an acquaintance of Symgharyl Maruel . History .

title: Aghul Balai
description: Aghul Balai Aghul Balai was a member of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the mid – 14th century DR . He was a follower and Chung Tao of the Way . History .

title: Agin Lamarck
description: Agin Lamarck Agin Lamarck was a noble and historian in Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Agin was a very cynical individual , wielding sarcasm like a warrior wielded a good blade .

title: Aglaraerose
description: Aglaraerose Aglaraerose was an ancient green dragon who lived in a mountain known as the Fang in the Forest in the Earthfast Mountains . Powers . She swallowed a Thayan wizard who was a master of life draining magic and absorbed his abilities .

title: Aglarel Tanthul
description: Aglarel Tanthul Prince Aglarel Tanthul took over as commander of the High Prince ' s personal bodyguard when the City of Shade returned to Faerûn . He knows that it is only matter of time before the High Prince is the target of an assassination attempt - but whether that attempt is directed by an enemy government , a secret organization such as the Harper s , or one of his own brothers , he doesn ' t know . He doesn ' t really care , either , because Aglarel has no interest in what he sees as pointless political and power squabbles .

title: Aglarond
description: Aglarond Aglarond was a magocratic state in the southwestern - most part of the Unapproachable East with its capital at Veltalar . Most of its land was covered by the Yuirwood . Filled with magic and mystery , it was ruled by one of the most potent spellcasters of the Realms : the Simbul , until 1425 DR , the Year of Seven Sisters , and as of 1475 DR was ruled by fifteen Simbarch of Aglarond — arcane spellcaster s trained in the Simbul ' s arts .

title: Aglarondan griffonrider
description: Aglarondan griffonrider Aglarondan griffonriders were elite aerial knights who served the Simbul in Aglarond . They often acted as guards and commanders within the army of the nation . Griffonrider code .

title: Aglarondan language
description: Aglarondan language Aglarondan was a regional tongue of East Faerûn and the official language of Aglarond . Speakers . Aglarondan was spoken from Dahst in the north to the Yuirwood in the south , and from Ingdal ' s Arm in the west to Glarendar in the east .

title: Aglarra Galdekund
description: Aglarra Galdekund Aglarra Galdekund is the wife of the merchant Flammos Galdekund of Waterdeep . In 1369 DR , Queen Filfaeril Obarskyr assumed her appearance in order to hide in Waterdeep during the abraxus affair . The change in mannerisms and voice was blamed on an illness , that the couple had to travel to Iritue ' s Firesprings in southern Amn in order to address .

title: Aglast Thimm
description: Aglast Thimm Aglast Thimm was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Previously , Aglast acted as a poisoner for the Zhent s in various Sea of Fallen Stars cities until his face became too known .

title: Aglonell
description: Aglonell Aglonell was a hunter in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Aglonell was a trapper and hunter living near Bryn Shander in the Ten Towns .

title: Agni mani
description: Agni mani Agni Mani was the " Realms " name given to certain ; pieces of glass formed when celestial objects strike the ground . Description . These ornamental stones were usually found in desert regions such as Anauroch .

title: Agrak
description: Agrak Lord Agrak was a goblin lord and chieftain servant of Graz ' zt in the Moonsea . History . Many years before Agrak was banished from Lowerdark and settled among a goblin clan living in a Upperdark tunnel very near of surface city of Hillsfar .

title: Agrathan Hardhammer
description: Agrathan Hardhammer Agrathan Hardhammer is a dwarven councilor of Mirabar in 1370 DR and is also the only dwarven member of the Council of Sparkling Stones , as well as a cleric of Dumathoin . He has soft features for a dwarf , and a long white beard . As the highest ranking dwarf in Mirabar among the humans , he is also the voice of the dwarven population not only to the council but to the Marchion as well .

title: Agricultural Promenade
description: Agricultural Promenade The Agricultural Promenade , or Farmers ' Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Farmers ' Road separated the Clothiers ' District and Peasants ' District , branching off from the Road to Enlightenment near the Gulf Gate to run north roughly parallel to Clothiers ' Way before terminating at the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .

title: Agrivar
description: Agrivar The Agrivars were a prominent noble family of the North in the 1350s DR , producing the renowned wizard Ostus Agrivar and his children the famed adventurers Kyriani and Priam Agrivar . Base . The family seat was the Agrivar estate on Mount Sar , east of the High Road out of Waterdeep along the Sword Coast North .

title: Aguul
description: Aguul Aguul was a ogre man who lived in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . Oddly for an ogre , Aguul served as an apprentice printer to Forgemaster Inkstain , a dwarf , in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . Description .

title: Ahazu
description: Ahazu Ahazu the Seizer is a demon lord that now functions as a vestige as a result of his self - imposed imprisonment in the Abyssal layer known as the Wells of Darkness . Description . Ahazu appears as a dark - skinned naked humanoid with bat - like wings , long thin arms , and an elongated head dominated with a mouth filled with needle - sharp teeth .

title: Ahbhaer Mhilshoun
description: Ahbhaer Mhilshoun Ahbhaer Mhilshoun was a Calishite human inhabitant of Beliard around 1368 DR who owned Milshoun ' s Stronghouses . History . Originally from Calimshan , Ahbhaer gained his magical items by killing a sleeping wizard and stealing them .

title: Ahghairon
description: Ahghairon Ahghairon was a human mage from northwest Faerûn and the first Open Lord of Waterdeep . He created the Lords of Waterdeep , the system by which Waterdeep had been ruled ever since , except for a six - year period immediately following his death . Background .

title: Ahghairon ' s dragonward
description: Ahghairon ' s dragonward Ahghairon ' s dragonward was a powerful mythal cast by the famous mage Ahghairon over the city of Waterdeep . Centuries before the 14th century DR , Ranressa Shiard returned as a hero from her journeys to Waterdeep atop a mighty dragon . Although she was welcomed home , the appearance of her mount flying over the city unsettled the majority of the populace .

title: Ahja
description: Ahja Ahja the Azure was a male human magician of Luskan on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Ahja was a mage of Luskan , who was trained by the Host Tower wizards .

title: Ahlarkhem
description: Ahlarkhem Ahlarkhem was a barony of Erlkazar encompassing the High Peaks and their evirons . Description . Ahlarkhem Barony was the center of trade for the kingdom of Erlkazar .

title: Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen
description: Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen Ahlysaaria Yrl ' Lysaen was a female drow cleric of Lolth and a member of the mercantile House Lysaen of the city of Karsoluthiyl in 1370 DR . She was chosen to lead a group of three other priestesses and a 32 - strong hunting party of her house to establish a hold on Level Two of Undermountain , with the goal of rebuilding an ancient slave - trading route to the surface , in order to bypass the route used by House Tanor ' Thal , the ruling house of Karsoluthiyl .

title: Ahmaergo
description: Ahmaergo Ahmaergo was a member of the Iron Ring and the most competent slaver of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Ahmaergo was in charge of buying and selling the slaves acquired by the Guild .

title: Ahmahd abd al - Iffa
description: Ahmahd abd al - Iffa General Ahmahd abd al - Iffa directed the mamluk s of the Honored Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Ahmahd was a burly eunuch .

title: Ahryn Firefinger
description: Ahryn Firefinger Ahryn Firefinger was the leader of a dozen or so Red Wizard s within their enclave in Mulmaster . Relationships . Ahryn ' s responsibilities were to ensure that their magical item trade remained profitable .

title: Ahs Trango Shan
description: Ahs Trango Shan Ahs Trango Shan , or the South Guardian Peak , was a mountain located in Khazari . Geography . The South Guardian Peak formed part of the natural border of eastern Khazari , along with the Nas Trango Shan , providing a rocky barrier against Kara - Tur and the outside world .

title: Ahtahqugotak Sea
description: Ahtahqugotak Sea The Ahtahqugotak Sea was a body of water in Ibelgrak Valley in Angalpuk on the Great Glacier . Geography . The Ahtahqugotak Sea was the largest sea in Angalpuk , at almost 70 miles ( 112 kilometers ) across at its widest point , but also quite shallow , being only 75 feet ( 23 meters ) deep .

title: Ahtayir
description: Ahtayir Ahtayir was a djinn i in service to the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In the past , Torhild Flametongue , king of the Besilmer dwarves , found a horn capable of summoning Ahtayir .

title: Aid
description: Aid Aid was a spell that belonged to many schools because it gave the recipient a temporary boost in health and improved both morale in the face of fear and combat skill . Effects . The abjuration version of this spell could be cast on a target up to 30 ft ( 9 .

title: Aida al - Irrahman
description: Aida al - Irrahman Aida al - Irrahman was a the true leader of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Personality . Aida ' s cunning knew no bounds .

title: Aihonen
description: Aihonen Aihonen was a great hero who killed the white dragon Icasaracht . Description . When in battle , Aihonen used his sword the Blade of Aihonen and equipped a shield which bore the symbol of Tempus .

title: Aileen
description: Aileen Aileen was one of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . When she went on scouting missions , Aileen covered her shining armor with a woolen tunic of green , earthen tones and changed her lance for a bow , along with a slim sword .

title: Ailoth
description: Ailoth Ailoth was an diviner and an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay for the Sembia and Hillsfar , part of the network of Alzegund . Description . Ailoth was a white - haired magic - user .

title: Aingst
description: Aingst The Aingst were a tribe of Nar found in western Narfell . Activities . Generally speaking , the Aingst did not mind dealing with others , particularly farmers from Damara , so long as they did not tread within the borders of Narfell .

title: Air
description: Air The element of air was one of the four fundamental building blocks of matter , and the origin of everything that was gaseous . It represented change , flexibility , and freedom . Cosmology .

title: Air elemental
description: Air elemental An air elemental was a being made up of wind and living air . It appeared as a cyclone of air that moved in any direction , even against the wind when enraged . Air elementals were always flying , an expression of freedom that they enjoyed to its fullest .

title: Air mephit
description: Air mephit An air mephit was a mephit from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . An air mephit was about four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall and weighed only a pound ( half a kilogram ) .

title: Air walk
description: Air walk Air walk was a transmutation spell that allowed a single creature to walk on air as though it were solid ground . Effects . Through the use of this spell , a creature or being could ambulate normally with no solid support .

title: Airspur
description: Airspur Airspur was the capital of Akanûl . The city was located on two cliffs facing a narrow bay . Many buildings were located on earthmotes that floated over the bay and were connected to each other and the cliffs by bridges .

title: Airsteppers Guild
description: Airsteppers Guild The Airsteppers Guild was a messenger guild of windsoul genasi located in Airspur . Due to the vertical nature of Airspur , travel throughout the city was challenging . However , windsoul genasi could levitate over short distances and float and thus made excellent couriers .

title: Aizel Treemaine
description: Aizel Treemaine Aizel Treemaine was an elf wizard in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Aizel was hired by the Red Wizard of Thay Varriel to explore on her behalf a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain .

title: Ajami
description: Ajami Ajami were alien wizard s in Zakhara . Requirements . Ajamis had no special requirements .

title: Ajantis Ilvastarr
description: Ajantis Ilvastarr Ajantis Ilvastarr is a human paladin in the Baldur ' s Gate computer game . Personality . He is a righteous and somewhat naive young paladin found in the farmlands just north of the Friendly Arm Inn .

title: Ajax Firestorm
description: Ajax Firestorm Ajax Firestorm was a red dragon who lived disguised as an elven merchant of Huzuz named Aja Pelima . Description . Aja Pelima , also called Mad Aja , was the eccentric owner of Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons , a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz .

title: Ajayib
description: Ajayib Ajayib , also called the " City of Wonders " , was the youngest of Zakhara ' s Pearl Cities , and its most westerly . Beyond it lay the wilderness of al - Suqut Mountains . Trade .

title: Ajhuu
description: Ajhuu Ajhuu was a powerful marid leader during the time of the Calim Empire . He was one of Calim ' s most powerful allies but grew frustrated when Calim capitulated to the elves of Keltormir and the dwarves of Shanatar to fix his borders at the edges of their realms . Ajhuu was one of several powerful genies who broke from Calim ' s alliance to establish their own realms .

title: Ajimo Heikaru
description: Ajimo Heikaru Ajimo Heikaru was a Wererat samurai in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Heikaru was the first son of the warlord of ito family but against his family ' s wishes he fall in love with Emi Towiki a kitchen worker .

title: Ajmer Forest
description: Ajmer Forest The Ajmer Forest was located in northeast Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . This tropical rainforest was stiflingly hot and humid .

title: Ak ' chazar
description: Ak ' chazar Ak ' chazar are rakshasa with the heads of white tiger s . Abilities . They are powerful spellcasters and specialize in necromantic magic .

title: Ak ' hafta
description: Ak ' hafta Ak ' hafta was a drow soldier hunting Drizzt Do ' Urden in Mithral Hall for Vierna Do ' Urden . History . In 1357 DR , Artemis Entreri disguised himself as Regis and infiltrated Mithral Hall for Jarlaxle and his Bregan D ' aerthe .

title: Akabar Bel Akash
description: Akabar Bel Akash Akabar Bel Akash is the name of the male Turmish wizard who is a sometimes companion to Alias of Westgate . His first appearance is in the novel " Azure Bonds " , written by Jeff Grubb and Kate Novak . Appearance .

title: Akachi
description: Akachi Akachi was a priest of the former god of the dead , Myrkul , who lived in Mulsantir . He along with his brother Araman was offered as a " sacrifice , " and they were given the names " Akachi " and " Eveshi . " He became a favored priest , seemingly immune to poison and disease , and was unaffected when a plague called the " Black Whisper " spread throughout Mulsantir .

title: Akadi
description: Akadi Akadi ( pronounced " ah - KAH - dee " ) , the Queen of Air , was the embodiment of the element of air and goddess of elemental air , speed , and flying creatures . As an immortal being of freedom and travel , she instructed her followers to move as much as possible from place to place and from activity to activity . History .

title: Akalan
description: Akalan Akalan was the original tongue of the Arkaiun s . Speakers . By 1367 DR , Akalan was a language used by most of the population of Dambrath .

title: Akana Kiku
description: Akana Kiku Akana Kiku was a wu jen adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . and 1358 History . Kiku studied wu jen arts under the Grey Master of Okazara .

title: Akanûl
description: Akanûl Akanûl was a land that once belonged to the world of Abeir as part of the realm of Shyr , but was transposed onto the plane of Toril during the ravages of the Spellplague . The land carried with it a large population of Abeir genasi who , as of 1479 DR , controlled the region that used to be Chondath and western Chessenta . Geography .

title: Akar Kessell
description: Akar Kessell Akar Kessel was an unskilled mage who lived in Luskan ' s Host Tower of the Arcane under the tutelage of Morkai the Red . History . During a trip to Icewind Dale in 1351 DR , Dendybar the Mottled persuaded Kessel to kill Morkai in return for a place of power in the Host Tower .

title: Akashnu Mountains
description: Akashnu Mountains The Akashnu Mountains lay in the land of Malatra in Kara - Tur . Geography . The Akanshu Mountains rose 6000 – 7000 feet ( 1 .

title: Akbara Abd al - Yahruq
description: Akbara Abd al - Yahruq Akbara Abd al - Yahruq was a mamluk inhabiting Talab in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Akbara was the leader of the Parched Mamluk Society and held the title of Most Respected Warrior .

title: Akbet - Khrul
description: Akbet - Khrul Akbet - Khrul was a pirate lord of the Pirate Isles . History . In 1361 DR , Akbet - Khrul ' s fleet plagued the seas near Amn until the Council of six hired the Golden Legion to defeat the pirates .

title: Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook
description: Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook Akdam ' s Traveling Spellbook was a spellbook written by Akdam . It was a thin , traveling spellbook containing several simple spells . The title was printed on the cover in an old , rare script .

title: Akh ' Faer
description: Akh ' Faer The Akh ' Faer ( elven for Army of the Art ) was the arcane branch of the Akh ' Velahr military in the elven empire of Cormanthyr that existed up until the fall of Myth Drannor at the close of the Weeping War . Headquartered in the Art Tower of Castle Cormanthor , they numbered over four hundred " akf ' faern " ( members ) during the empire ' s peak ( circa 650 DR ) . Heirarchy .

title: Akhlaur
description: Akhlaur Akhlaur was a powerful conjurer who lived in Halruaa during the mid – 12th century DR . Activities . Akhlaur was only interested in increasing his power by researching dangerous magic .

title: Akhlaur Swamp
description: Akhlaur Swamp The Swamp of Akhlaur was a marshland located west of Lake Halruaa and Halagard . Description . The swamp covered an oblong area roughly 95 miles ( 152 .

title: Akil Festir
description: Akil Festir Akil Festir was a powerful and ambitious wind mage who resided in Huzuz , the City of Delights . Personality . His delusions of grandeur often exceeded his abilities to bring them to fruition .

title: Akila Abd al - Amin
description: Akila Abd al - Amin Akila Abd al - Amin was a caravan guard captain from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Akila was a small , wiry woman .

title: Akim al - Kalaas
description: Akim al - Kalaas Akim al - Kalaas was a sha ' ir and leader of the Unclean in 1367 DR . He had many nicknames , including the Sage , the Undaunted , Opener of Wisdom , and He Whom the Stars Obey . Personality .

title: Akima Abd al - Garib
description: Akima Abd al - Garib Akima Abd al - Garib was a mamluk inhabiting the island of Afyal in east Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Akima served as the leader of the Wondrous Mamluk Society , an organization dedicated to protecting the Padisha of Afyal .

title: Akir Abd al - Himaya
description: Akir Abd al - Himaya Akir Abd al - Himaya was the commander of the Defenders Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Akir and his Defenders were responsible for the security and defense of Qudra .

title: Akirakeiko
description: Akirakeiko Akirakeiko was a sohei adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Akirakeiko lived in a Konjo temple in Shizume Province , always busy in skirmishes with rival sohei of Kanchai temple .

title: Akkabar ' s battleblade ring
description: Akkabar ' s battleblade ring Akkabar ' s battleblade ring was the first of the " Qysari Rings " and could form a " blade barrier " when a command word was spoken . Description . Like other " shoonring " s , this ring was made from strands of metal woven like twisted vines , but each vine was made of swords touching point to pommel .

title: Akkabar Shoon the Elder
description: Akkabar Shoon the Elder Akkabar Shoon was a mighty wizard , the Pasha of Calimshan and the man ultimately behind the rise of the Shoon Imperium . Description . By all accounts , Akkabar was considered a " prodigy " in regards to the use of magic .

title: Akkabar Shoon the Younger
description: Akkabar Shoon the Younger Akkabar Shoon the Younger was the less - famous grandson of Akkabar Shoon the Elder , the mastermind behind the rise of the Shoon Imperium . Relationships . Akkabar the Younger was the son of Akkabar the Elder ' s first son .

title: Akkabar el Souvlak
description: Akkabar el Souvlak Revered Father Akkabar el Souvlak was the head abbot of the House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing , an Ilmatari monastery on the western coast of Calimshan . Akkabar was a fat man who loved food and believed that his god , Ilmater , wanted to end the suffering of hunger .

title: Akla
description: Akla Akla was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Akla was one of the monks kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a plot to access an elemental node .

title: Aklar Delkash
description: Aklar Delkash Aklar Delkash was a human man and merchant operating in the Vast in the late 1360s DR . History . Aklar was a trader in quality fur s and woven rug s .

title: Akota
description: Akota Akota was a mysterious country somewhere beyond the western shores of Zakhara . It exported gold , slave s , wood , and exotic goods to the Land of Fate through an overland trade route crossing the Southern High Desert to the city of Tajar . It had its own language called Akotan .

title: Akura al - Hiyali
description: Akura al - Hiyali Akura al - Hiyali was a member of the Corsair Council of Hawa and remained an active corsair captain despite his responsibilities in the city . Description . Akura possessed medium height and had a trim build .

title: Akyar al - Awasif
description: Akyar al - Awasif Akyar al - Awasif was a noble djinni who lived in Rog ' osto in East Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Unique among noble genie s , Akyar served the Khedive of Rog ' osto by choice .

title: Akyid al - Neti
description: Akyid al - Neti Akyid al - Neti was the Headmaster of Al - Bidir Sallah , or the " Home of the Seekers of Knowledge " , which was located in Huzuz , in 1367 DR . Description . Akyid was a half - elven male sorcerer .

title: Al - Adib River
description: Al - Adib River Al - Adib River , also known as the " River of Courtesy , " wound itself through southwestern Zakhara for more than 100 miles ( 161 km ) across the plains of the High Desert to the coast of the Golden Gulf . Description . Al - Adib was filled with rancid water , courtesy of centuries of local humans using it as their dumping ground .

title: Al - Asaf
description: Al - Asaf al - Asaf , or the Sorrowful , served as the cavalry of the efreet army in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . This part of the army of the efreet had around 25 , 000 lancers and their mounts .

title: Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace
description: Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace Al - Azid ' s Ghostly Palace was a magical building connected to the Ethereal plane . Description . This huge palace was made from fine white marble and was decorated with minarets .

title: Al - Azra ' Wadi
description: Al - Azra ' Wadi Al - Azra ' Wadi , or the Blue Valley , was a village located on the Island of Gardens within the Genie ' s Turban off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Description . The village sat between two natural coves , providing beautiful scenery for the natives .

title: Al - Badia
description: Al - Badia The term Al - Badia referred to the nomads comprising the wandering tribes of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Activities . These people were driven by the constant need for food , water , and suitable land for their livestock .

title: Al - Bakbuk
description: Al - Bakbuk Al - Bakbuk , or the Babbler , was a gibbering mouther living in the Pit of a Thousand Voices within Sarahin in 1367 DR . Description . The Babbler was formed from the carcasses of holy slayer s and saluqi greyhounds , giving it a distinct voice that was a combination of both .

title: Al - Barq bin Mawli
description: Al - Barq bin Mawli Al - Barq bin Mawli , or the Lightning , was a member of the House of Mawli in 1367 DR . Activities . Al - Barq was infamous for her lightning - quick attacks on caravans traveling through the southeast regions of the Haunted Lands .

title: Al - Bidir Sallah
description: Al - Bidir Sallah Al - Bidir Sallah , also known as the Home of the Seekers of Knowledge , was a massive university located in Huzuz in 1367 DR that housed 20 , 000 students and hundreds of instructors . Easily the largest of its kind in all of Zakhara , the university included colleges for Alchemy , Barbering , Combat , Fine Arts , Magic , and Science . Each college had its own dean who met with the other deans on a monthly basis to discuss university issues .

title: Al - Fatir River
description: Al - Fatir River Al - Fatir River , also called the Tepid River , was a slow - flowing river found in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Originating in Al - Yabki Mountains north of Gogal Pass , the Tepid River flowed eastward from the mountain range to the city of Jumlat on the coast of the Golden Gulf .

title: Al - Hadhar
description: Al - Hadhar The term Al - Hadhar referred to the sedentary inhabitants of the towns and cities of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Activities . " Al - Hadhar " had easy lives compared to their desert nomad kin .

title: Al - Haul River
description: Al - Haul River Al - Haul River was a small river found in the Free Cities of North Zakhara . Geography . The river flowed down from the Furrowed Mountains on a northwestern course before reaching the Great Sea .

title: Al - Hyam Dhazid
description: Al - Hyam Dhazid Al - Hyam Dhazid was a magic - user in Phlan in 1340 DR . Activities . Al - Hyam acted as an advisor for Tyranthraxus , trying to learn his secrets .

title: Al - Iltifat River
description: Al - Iltifat River Al - Iltifat River was one of the mightiest rivers in the Cities of the Ancients in East Zakhara . Geography . Al - Iltifat wound for hundreds of miles from the fringes of the barren Haunted Lands , through the jungles of the Ruined Kingdoms before finally emptying into the Crowded Sea where it met the Salt Jungle .

title: Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement
description: Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement The Al - Itimad Traveling Revival Movement was a group of wandering ethoist priests in the coastal towns of Zakhara . Activities . This group differed from most ethoists organizations in that they chose to wander around the Land of Fate and spread the word of their god .

title: Al - Kufr River
description: Al - Kufr River Al - Kufr River was a small river found in the Free Cities of Zakhara . Geography . Al - Kufr originated in the northern expanse of the Furrowed Mountains .

title: Al - Malih River
description: Al - Malih River Al - Malih River , also called the Dry River , was located in Zakhara near Halwa in 1367 DR . Geography . This river originated northeast of Halwa somewhere in the Great Anvil and flowed past the city for hundreds of miles toward the southwest .

title: Al - Malja River
description: Al - Malja River Al - Malja River was found in the far southern corner of west Zakhara . Geography . Al - Malja River flowed east down from Al - Suqut Mountains through the Pearl Cities region .

title: Al - Mauqida
description: Al - Mauqida Al - Mauqida , or the Hearth , was the bazaar in the city of Liham in north Zakhara . Description . The Hearth was named for the multitude of red clothing worn by the roaming citizens of Liham .

title: Al - Nuhas River
description: Al - Nuhas River Al - Nuhas River , also called the River of Copper , was a small river found in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Al - Nuhas flowed east from the center of Al - Yabki Mountains for 75 miles ( 120 km ) before reaching the city of Sikak on the coast of the Golden Gulf .

title: Al - Qadim
description: Al - Qadim Al - Qadim ( literally , " The Old " in Arabic ) is an " " - themed campaign setting for the " Dungeons & Dragons " role - playing game . The setting was developed by Jeff Grubb for TSR , Inc . , and was first released in 1992 .

title: Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse
description: Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse Al - Qadim : The Genie ' s Curse is a game for MS Dos and was published in 1994 by Strategic Simulations Inc . ( SSI ) . It followed the rules of the 2nd Edition of AD & D .

title: Al - Sabiya River
description: Al - Sabiya River Al - Sabiya River , also called the River of Maidens , flowed through the central region of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Al - Sabiya flowed south from Al - Yabki Mountains for 120 miles ( 190 km ) before emptying into Gana Bay on the Crowded Sea .

title: Al - Sari River
description: Al - Sari River Al - Sari River divided the city of Liham in North Zakhara . Geography . Al - Sari originated in the foothills of the southwest tail of the Furrowed Mountains .

title: Al - Sarif River
description: Al - Sarif River Al - Sarif River , also called the River of Nobility , was located in Zakhara . Description . Al - Sarif River originated in Al - Akara Mountains located several hundred miles inland east from Suq Bay .

title: Al - Suqut Mountains
description: Al - Suqut Mountains Al - Suqut Mountains , or the Tumbling Mountains , were found in west Zakhara . Geography . Al - Suqut Mountains separated the western " border " of the Pearl Cities from the Great Sea .

title: Al - Tariq Channel
description: Al - Tariq Channel Al - Tariq Channel , also called the Passage , was a strait found in North Zakhara connecting the Sea of Caravans and the North Quarter of Suq Bay . Geography . The Passage stretched for over a hundred miles between the two larger bodies of water .

title: Al - Wahl River
description: Al - Wahl River Al - Wahl River was an important river found within Interior Zakhara that fed the industry of Hiyal . Geography . Al - Wahl originated in the peaks of the southern tip of the Furrowed Mountains .

title: Al - Warrakh
description: Al - Warrakh Al - Warrakh was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As a wizard , Al - Warrakh would use his magical powers to assist Sheik Ar - Rabi on raids in southern Murghôm and on the various tribes of the Plains of Purple Dust .

title: Al - Yabki Mountains
description: Al - Yabki Mountains Al - Yabki Mountains , also called the Mountains of the Tears or simply the Mountains of Tears , were located in the Pearl Cities region of west Zakhara . Geography . The mountain range ran for several hundred miles from the northwest near Tajar to the southeast near Jumlat and Gana .

title: Al - Zabdiyat
description: Al - Zabdiyat Al - Zabdiyat , or the Bowl , was a group of mountainous islands located near Masud Jazayir in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago in the Crowded Sea . Geography . The islands of Al - Zabdiyat were crescent shaped laying at the mouth of the Strait of Woe .
