title: Al - Zalim River
description: Al - Zalim River Al - Zalim River was the lifeblood of Muluk , the City of Kings , in the Free Cities of North Zakhara . Geography . The river began its short trek to the Great Sea in the peaks of the Furrowed Mountains found southeast of Muluk .

title: Al - Zira
description: Al - Zira Al - Zira , or the Arm , formed the large islands of the Djinni ' s Claws in the Crowded Sea southwest of mainland Zakhara . Inhabitants . All kinds of genie s could be found on the islands of Al - Zira .

title: Al - Zulma River
description: Al - Zulma River Al - Zulma River was a small river found in North Zakhara . Geography . Al - Zulma orginated in the northern reaches of the Furrowed Mountains .

title: Al - jahar
description: Al - jahar Al - jahar , or dazzles , were sinister creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , who masqueraded as beautiful humanoids . Description . The true form of a dazzle was that of a winged humanoid - shaped mass of sparkling light and waves of heat .

title: Al Dimeneira
description: Al Dimeneira Al Dimeneira was a powerful angelic deva which tried to defeat the power of Crenshinibon without success . What is known of this being is that at some time it tried to put an end to the evil power of the relic called Crenshinibon . Also the demon Errtu was looking for the relic , but for a different aim : it craved its power .

title: Al Qahara
description: Al Qahara Al Qahara was a hidden elven town located in a cavern in the southern Raurin desert . The settlement was isolated but did some trade with oasis settlements in the desert . Description .

title: Ala ' i Kalin
description: Ala ' i Kalin Ala ' i Kalin was a member of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . History . Originally from Huzuz , Ala ' i ' s father was accused as being a traitor to the Grand Caliph and beheaded .

title: Ala ' i ibn - Hasim
description: Ala ' i ibn - Hasim Ala ' i ibn - Hasim was a dwarven sha ' ir within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Ala ' i was in charge of the Hall of the Treasury .

title: Alaeros Margaster
description: Alaeros Margaster Alaeros Margaster was a red haired fighter and agent of the Lords ' Alliance . He was a very kind man with many talents . He had a moral belief that meant he would never cut down a live tree .

title: Alagh Rorncaurak
description: Alagh Rorncaurak Alagh Rorncaurak , or the Battlecavern of Unquenched Valor , was both a chasm and a temple of Clangeddin Silverbeard , the Father of Battle , in the dwarven city of Earthfast , deep below the Earthfast Mountains between the Vast and Impiltur , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . Description . Alagh Rorncaurak was a huge natural chasm that served as a natural cathedral to Clangeddin .

title: Alaghôn
description: Alaghôn Alaghôn , the capital of Turmish , was an ancient city that saw its share of trials and tribulations over the years , ranging from terrible fires to occupation by the blue dragon Anaglathos during the Reign of the Wyrm . Throughout all of this , Alaghôn survived as a trade center known as the " throne of Turmish . " Architecture .

title: Alahar Khaumfros
description: Alahar Khaumfros Alahar Khaumfros was the Waterbaron of Yartar . History . Around 1366 DR , four illithids walked into the Baron ' s Hall and murdered Alahar .

title: Alaia Serrat
description: Alaia Serrat Alaia Serrat was a powerful human shaman and one of the three leaders of the merchant family House Serrat . She was the adopted mother of the yuan - ti pureblood Zaltys Serrat . Description .

title: Alaine
description: Alaine Alaine was a female human villager of Ember on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Alaine was a minor inhabitant of village of Ember , located near Luskan .

title: Alak Abaeir
description: Alak Abaeir Alak Abaeir was a drow assassin under the employment of the church of Vhaeraun with membership in the same . History . It wasn ' t clear when or where , but Alak Abaeir was born in a traditional drow city ruled by Lolth ' s clergy .

title: Alak Faerzhind
description: Alak Faerzhind Alak Faerzhind was the Master of Apportation of the school of Alteration in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . Activities . Alak was a senior member of the school of Alteration who served directly the Master of Alteration and member of the Conclave of Sshamath , Shurdriira Helviiryn .

title: Alamber Sea
description: Alamber Sea The Alamber Sea was the primary trade avenue between the nations of Mulhorand , Unther , Thay , and Tymanther ( and for a time , High Imaskar as well ) . As a result , its waters were considered neutral territory . Geography .

title: Alambit
description: Alambit Alambit was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the peninsula of Altumbel and the lands along the coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars towards the Alamber Sea , from Spandeliyon in the northwest to Thasselen in the southeast . Alambit was considered a Chessentic language , being related to Chessentan , and was divided into two dialects , Altumbelan and Coastal ( or Reach ) Alambit .

title: Alamontyr
description: Alamontyr Alamontyr was a large fishing and agricultural town in the far northeast of the Border Kingdoms . It was the easternmost notable settlement within the Border Kingdoms . Alamontyr lay on Zarcel ' s Run , a river that flowed from the Duskwood in the south to the shores of the Lake of Steam in the north .

title: Alandor River
description: Alandor River The Alandor River was a major river in Amn . Description . The Alandor was a slow - moving and wide river .

title: Alandra
description: Alandra Alandra was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . Alandra was a Cult member who joined the reformed faction under Severin Silrajin .

title: Alansyn Ambrilar
description: Alansyn Ambrilar Alansyn Ambrilar was a male human cleric of Lathander , the Morninglord , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Ambrilar was High Morninglord of the Morning Halls temple to Lathander at the time . He led fourteen priests and twenty - one lay - followers .

title: Alanza DaNosta
description: Alanza DaNosta Alanza DaNosta was a member of the Golden Legion . Personality . DaNosta was well known for his greed .

title: Alaor
description: Alaor Alaor ( or sometimes The Alaor ) was an island on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was under the control of Thay and housed Thayan shipyards until it was wiped out by a huge wave caused by a volcanic eruption . The House of Holy Tides , a temple to Istishia on the southern shore of the island , survived intact , and went on to take power , turning the island into a free state .

title: Alaphondar
description: Alaphondar Lord Alaphondar was one of the leading sages in service to the royalty of Cormyr in Suzail . Background . Flammos Galdekund .

title: Alarashan Tlor
description: Alarashan Tlor Alarashan Tlor was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was one of the more rationally minded magelords and agreed with his master Ithboltar to fight together but died in the spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower .

title: Alaric Hembreon
description: Alaric Hembreon Alaric Hembreon was a Tethyrian noble and member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Alaric spent all his life in Tethyr ian politics , being the heir of the Draknor duchy and a member of the Knights of the Shield by family connections .

title: Alarm
description: Alarm Alarm was an abjuration spell designed to alert its caster . Effects . The caster picked an area of no more than 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Alaron
description: Alaron Alaron was an island in the Moonshae Isles . Although not the largest of the Moonshae Isles , it was considered the most powerful prior to the Spellplague . In the 14th century DR , the isles were collectively ruled from the capital city of Caer Callidyrr by High Queen Alicia Kendrick .

title: Alascartha Vyperwood
description: Alascartha Vyperwood Alascartha Vyperwood was a human woman and a fighter . She was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History .

title: Alashan
description: Alashan Alashan was a city located in the kingdom of Khazari within the Hordelands . Geography . This important city sat along the banks of the Kuruk Muren river where the Silk Road passed through the western border of the country .

title: Alasklerbanbastos
description: Alasklerbanbastos Alasklerbanbastos was an ancient blue dracolich who ruled Threskel from his lair on Mount Thulbane . He held the distinction of being the only dracolich to have his physical form destroyed twice in the same year . History .

title: Alastra Hathwinter
description: Alastra Hathwinter Alastra Hathwinter was a wizard in Longsaddle . History . In her youth , Alastra was a wide - wandering adventurer : she went from Nimbral to Malatra in Kara - Tur and from Zakhara in the distant south to the castles of the cloud giant s above the endless ice of the North .

title: Alasturan Malatheer
description: Alasturan Malatheer Alasturan Malatheer was a shopkeeper in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . He was also the local representative of the female adventuring company , the Galadran Company , and collaborated often with the Soft Claws .

title: Alasz Ironwood
description: Alasz Ironwood Alasz Ironwood was a sarcastic horse breeder and trader in High Dale . History . Alasz was once a high - ranking Zhentilar warrior before he settled in High Dale .

title: Alathene Moonstar
description: Alathene Moonstar Alathene Moonstar was the archlich matriarch of House Moonstar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . She was for a long time involved in the faith of Selûne in the city . Alathene was obsessed with hunting down her evil brother Vanrak Moonstar and bringing him to justice .

title: Alatorin
description: Alatorin Alatorin was the ancient dwarven settlement formed when Taark Shanat ' s dwarves defeated the inhabitants of Rringlor Noroth in the Cloaker Wars , including four blue dragon s slain by Taark himself . It was the first settlement established in Shanatar and contained Brightaxe Hall and the famous Wyrmskull Throne . History .

title: Alatos Thuibuld
description: Alatos Thuibuld Alatos Thuibuld , known as " Ravenscar " , was the leader of a thieves ' guild in Baldur ' s Gate . History . In the years prior to the return of Eldrith the Betrayer , Ravenscar was the guildmaster of the thieves until she created her own thieves guild led by the beholder Xantam , it was aptly named the Guild of Xantam .

title: Alaundo
description: Alaundo Alaundo the Seer was the singular sage whose prophecies proved to be true over the years . Citing a seer from past ages that Alaundo called “ the T Source ” , the prophecies he made included The Creation of the Bhaalspawn and The Creation of the Seven Scourges . Upon his death , Candlekeep became a haven for the veneration of his prophecies and knowledge .

title: Alauthshaee
description: Alauthshaee Lady Alauthshaee was a female elf notorious for her wealth and the manner of her death . History . Over her life - time , Lady Alauthshaee married six wealthy husbands , and outlived each one .

title: Albaeri Mellikho
description: Albaeri Mellikho Albaeri Mellikho was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Personality . Albaeri was a pot - bellied and jovial woman .

title: Albaeron Thalion
description: Albaeron Thalion Albaeron Thalion was a high - ranking monk of Candlekeep . History . Thalion hailed from Athkatla , where he was a great calligrapher and artist until Oghma appeared in his dreams to call him .

title: Alban
description: Alban Alban was a wight ruler in Maztica . History . Alban was the ruler of the city of Mictlatepec , an administrative center of the old Zateca people .

title: Albarrana
description: Albarrana Albarranas were the fortresses used by efreet for defensive purposes that were scattered across their vast empire . Location . Each efreet thurgur could have up to four albarranas within its borders .

title: Albert
description: Albert Albert seemed to be a young boy in Nashkel , looking for his dog Rufie . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward offered to help him but when Gorion ' s Ward delivered the dog to Albert , he revealed his true form , a pit fiend . Albert and his dog then " plane shift ed " back to the Nine Hells .

title: Albhaera Haerldoun
description: Albhaera Haerldoun Albhaera Haerldoun was a Vaasan human woman . She was an adventurer and wizard , and owner of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description .

title: Albie Grizlow
description: Albie Grizlow Albie Grizlow was a teenager cattle rancher in Uluvin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Albie and his friend Leshonna Daar escaped after their village was invaded by a group of hill giant s and goblin s .

title: Alchemist
description: Alchemist An alchemist was a craft profession . At the most basic level , anyone who mixed substances together in a liquid form to create a wanted effect could be considered an alchemist . Alchemy required a fair amount of intelligence , as well as time and materials .

title: Alcheringa
description: Alcheringa Alcheringa was a philosophy followed by the Osslander s of Osse . They revered ancestral heroes as totems and believed that the stars were the spirits of their ancestors . One of these was Tumbarum , revered as the spirit of music .

title: Aldamair Galashar
description: Aldamair Galashar Aldamair Galashar was a rogue hired by Gormstadd the Rerisen of Voonlar to be the steward of Twilight Gate Farm , a hunting lodge , and the surrounding land until Gormstadd retired and was able to take possession himself . Description . In his younger days , Aldamair was a good - looking charmer , but as he aged his comeliness faded a bit .

title: Aldanon
description: Aldanon Aldanon is an important NPC in the Neverwinter Nights 2 official campaign . Abilities . An accomplished wizard , Aldanon had specialised in the art of divination .

title: Aldeth Sashenstar
description: Aldeth Sashenstar Aldeth Sashenstar was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate and a head of the Merchant ' s League . Relationships . Aldeth had a nephew , Dabron Sashenstar .

title: Aldimer
description: Aldimer The Aldimer family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Aldimers were allied with the Mathlin and Uruthkurt families .

title: Aldor Urnpoleshurst
description: Aldor Urnpoleshurst Aldor Urnpoleshurst was a lawyer just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Aldor was very suspicious of others and made accusations over nothing .

title: Aldorn Thuragar
description: Aldorn Thuragar Baron Aldorn " Foesmasher " Thuragar is the cautious , yet committed ruler of Sespech . While he holds his court in the capital of Ormpetarr , Thuragar also frequents Mimph and Elbulder with appearances . The three - day long celebration known as the Feast of Purple Majesty , is held annually in the last few days of Alturiak to celebrate the baron ' s rise to power .

title: Aldreth
description: Aldreth Aldreth was the largest of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Aldreth was considered to be the most sophisticated of the Sword Lands towns , and the most snooty by envious people of other towns .

title: Aldric
description: Aldric Aldric was the abbot of the Abbey of St . Sollars of the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Aldrur Hariburt
description: Aldrur Hariburt Aldrur Hariburt was a local herald based in Myratma , Tethyr , in 1372 DR . Personality . Aldrur was a pompous bureaucrat with an inflated sense of importance .

title: Alduvar Snowbrand
description: Alduvar Snowbrand Alduvar Snowbrand was one of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR . Activities . Alduvar as Blue Sword was a strenue supporter of major ties with Sembia , believing the Dales need a new powerful ally .

title: Alea Dahast
description: Alea Dahast Alea Dahast was a female elf who led a raiding party on a human camp in Cormanthor in - 75 DR . The purpose of the raid was to kill the camp ' s inhabitants and destroy the settlement , but Alea and her party rescued the Netherese wizard Baerauble Etharr in the process . The two would later become lovers .

title: Aleaxtis
description: Aleaxtis Aleaxtis , the Kingdom of the Sahuagin , was a dangerous neighbor of the Old Empires . Description . Though the exact location of this kingdom remained unknown , it was believed to lay somewhere north of a volcanic island called the Ship of the Gods .

title: Aleena Paladinstar
description: Aleena Paladinstar Aleena Paladinstar was the daughter of Open Lord Piergeiron the Paladinson . Description . Aleena was tall and serious .

title: Aleina Brightlance
description: Aleina Brightlance Aleina Brightlance was a knight - commander of Silverymoon ' s Knights in Silver in the late 15th century . Relationships . She established a sexual relationship with Wulfgar History .

title: Alek Lenter
description: Alek Lenter Alek Lenter was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Alek was a fence in Waterdeep before he was recruited by the Xanathar for his operations in Skullport .

title: Aleksei
description: Aleksei Aleksei was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Aleksei was the rotten son of a minor noble .

title: Aleksi Drejkov
description: Aleksi Drejkov Aleksi Drejkov was a noble member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Aleksi saw his allegiance to the Howling Hatred only as another method by which he could damage his rivals .

title: Alemander I
description: Alemander I King Alemander I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the seventh king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Called Alemander the Spellbinder , he was regarded as one of the Hero - Kings of Tethyr . Abilities .

title: Alemander II
description: Alemander II King Alemander II of House Tethyr was the ninth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Alemander was the grandson of King Coram III , whom he would eventually succeed .

title: Alemander III
description: Alemander III King Alemander III of House Tethyr was a king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Alemander was the nephew of King Errilam I .

title: Alemander IV
description: Alemander IV King Alemander IV of House Tethyr was the last king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He was slain during the Ten Black Days of Eleint . Personality .

title: Alemander V
description: Alemander V Crown Prince Alemander V of House Tethyr was the last member of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He never ruled , having been slain during the Ten Black Days of Eleint . Relationships .

title: Alenuath
description: Alenuath House Alenuath was a sun elf house on Evermeet . Unusually for sun elves , its members were typically ranger s , hunters , or others who spent a great deal of time alone . Although the house had a small manse in Leuthilspar , it was often unoccupied for extended periods .

title: Aleratha Ilnatar
description: Aleratha Ilnatar Aleratha " Rubytresses " Ilnatar was an elf woman of the city of Ylraphon in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . In the early 7th century , Aleratha assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the human mage Beldossan the Short in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .

title: Alestone
description: Alestone Alestone , also known as , was named for its brown to yellowish brown color , the hues of old s . Description . This semi - precious stone was found in crystals and cut into gems of handsome appearance .

title: Alex
description: Alex Alex was a child of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Alex ' s father , Zachan , told Alex about the story that thounsands of duergar fought a battle .

title: Alexa
description: Alexa Alexa was a drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Alexa was one of the most promising apprentices in the College of Conjuration and the wife of Eldrinn Elpragh of the College of Divination .

title: Alexandrite
description: Alexandrite Alexandrite was a greenish variety of that appeared reddish under non - natural light , such as " light " spells . This transparent gem was usually faceted and used in pendants and earrings . Alexandrites were used as a magic focus for items that provided good luck , favorable reactions , protection , or other good omens .

title: Aleyd Burral
description: Aleyd Burral Aleyd Burral was a knight in Phlan and a member of the Knights of the Black Fists during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Aleyd was always concerned with corruption inside the Black Fists and wanted to do something to unveil it .

title: Alfrendo Galona
description: Alfrendo Galona Alfrendo Galona was a businessman in Shining Plains in 1358 DR . Activities . Alfrendo managed the Alfrendo ' s Mythical Menagerie , a circus of mythical creatures , all made inoffensive .

title: Alfun Deeprock
description: Alfun Deeprock Alfun Deeprock was a deep gnome cultist of Ogrémoch and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Underdark beneath the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , he and his fellow Lorn Tauth discovered that the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch , was located inside a mine near Mulmaster ' s Underdark trading post of Fort Iron .

title: Algashon Nathaire
description: Algashon Nathaire Algashon Nathaire was a wizard and a priest of Bane who was the one responsible of the madness of Sammaster . History . The first time Algashon met Sammaster was near Baldur ' s Gate in 865 DR and soon the two became friends , traveling together for many years .

title: Algorind
description: Algorind Algorind was a paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Algorind was a man who ' d lost his way .

title: Alhoon
description: Alhoon Alhoons were magic - using outcasts from mind flayer societies who had defied the ruling elder brain s to achieve a limited form of lich dom . Only the most powerful mind flayer mages could achieve true lichdom and were known as illithiliches ; however , many in the Realms did not make this distinction . Alhoons combined powerful wizardry and sorcery with their innate skill at psionics to become a new threat to the established order of the Underdark and beyond .

title: Ali - bin - Jafar
description: Ali - bin - Jafar Bertrem Thinwick , also known as Ali - bin - Jafar , was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Bertrem was a cunning Skullport native who understood that having an exotic name would help increase his business .

title: Ali Abdal Akim
description: Ali Abdal Akim Ali Abdal Akim was a daolani who lived in the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Driven by a wicked and sadistic nature , Ali would harass anyone if he believed he could get away with it .

title: Ali Mirza Ahmak
description: Ali Mirza Ahmak Ali Mirza Ahmak was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Ali was a djinni spy who masqueraded as a smoke merchant within the city .

title: Ali al - Lazan
description: Ali al - Lazan Ali al - Lazan was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . History . Ali attempted to incinerate the royal palace of Sultana Alurah bint Asrah of Hiyal .

title: Ali al - Mustasib
description: Ali al - Mustasib Ali al - Mustasib lived in Iris Well Spring in the Hordelands during the mid 14h century DR . History . Atabeg Ali al - Mustasib was an exiled ruler of Semphar who was forced to live in the small community of Iris Well Spring located to the east of Semphar .

title: Ali ben Ali
description: Ali ben Ali Ali ben Ali was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Ali was just as famous for his somber demeanor as he was for his magical prowess .

title: Aliah
description: Aliah Aliah was a Payit princess of history . History . During the Payit golden age , Aliah was a princess , promised to her half - brother Xetl .

title: Alias
description: Alias Alias was a created construct that had been given true life . She was not a natural human being , but instead the construct of an alliance between several powerful groups . She became a sell - sword who fought for good causes .

title: Alice Tinker
description: Alice Tinker Alice Tinker worked at the Curious Past in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep as an assistant to Bronwyn Caradoon . Activities . Alice was a skilled drawer and appraiser .

title: Alicia
description: Alicia Lady Alicia was the head of the Zhentarim wizards at the Citadel of the Raven in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Alicia grew up in Zhentil Keep and soon she joined the Zhentarim .

title: Alicia Kendrick
description: Alicia Kendrick Alicia Kendrick was the High Queen of the Moonshae Isles . History . Born in 1346 DR , Princess Alicia was the eldest daughter of High King Tristan Kendrick and the druid Robyn Kendrick .

title: Alignment
description: Alignment The alignment system is a two - dimensional grid , one axis of which measures a " moral " continuum between good and evil , and the other " ethical " between law and chaos . Those characters that fall on one of the extremes are " good " or " evil " , " lawful " or " chaotic " ; in addition , there is a middle ground of " neutrality " on both axes , describing characters that are indifferent , committed to balance , or conflicted about the struggle between good and evil ( or law and chaos ) . By combining the two axes , any given character has one of nine possible alignments .

title: Aliisza
description: Aliisza Aliisza was an alu - fiend ( child of a succubus and human ) servant and consort of the half - demon Kaanyr Vhok . She was also friend of the fallen astral deva Tauran and mother of Kael , a knight of Torm . Description .

title: Alik Aksama
description: Alik Aksama Alik Aksama was a merchant and the proprietor of Fine Rugs in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Alik was always busy .

title: Alim Baybars
description: Alim Baybars Alim Baybars lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Appearance . Alim ' s face and body were ruined from constant exposure to humid air , dark magic , and his own obsessive pursuit of power .

title: Alim Zangi
description: Alim Zangi Alim Zangi was a powerful sha ' ir living on Jazirat al - Sayyad in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Alim was the sha ' ir responsible for binding a group of herdsman genie s to watch over the fabulous Sayyad bloodline of horses on the island of Jazirat al - Sayyad .

title: Alima bint Khayri
description: Alima bint Khayri Alima bint Khayri was a halfling corsair living in the Al - Azra ' Wadi in 1367 DR . Personality . Alima ' s cheerful personality led many to underestimate her .

title: Alimir Mountains
description: Alimir Mountains The Alimir Mountains served as the eastern border of Calimshan and were once the home of a great horde of beholder s . Geography . The Alimir Mountains composed the southern end of the Iltkazar Range , the same chain of mountains containing the Omlarandin Mountains , the Kuldin Peaks , the Snowflake Mountains , and the Giant ' s Run Mountains .

title: Alin Cateln
description: Alin Cateln Alin Cateln is a human bard and a brief member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Alin wears a light tunic , an indigo - dyed vest and leather breeches .

title: Alisannara Morcane
description: Alisannara Morcane Alisannara Morcane was a female drow and the High Priestess of Lolth in Szith Morcane . History . She was consumed by a " destruction " spell when followers of Kiaransalee from Maerimydra overthrew House Morcane .

title: Alix
description: Alix Alix was a merchant living in Bandar al - Sa ' adat in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR , but originally came from outside of Zakhara . Description . Alix had blonde hair that was showing more gray with each passing year .

title: Aljanor Keenblade
description: Aljanor Keenblade Aljanor Keeblade was a knight member of the Order of the Gauntlet in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . At the start of Rage of Demons , Ajanor was captured by the drow of Menzoberranzan during one of their surface raids , but all believed him to have been killed in the fighting .

title: Alkilith
description: Alkilith Society . The alkilith is among the demon s that disgust and terrify . These shapeless horrors are used by demon lord s for assignments in areas that most demons would hesitate to travel to , for alkiliths can survive and even thrive in the most chaotic and hellish and unlivable areas of the Abyss .

title: All sphere
description: All sphere The All sphere was a group of spells that were granted to cleric s and druid s of any mythos . These spells were utilitarian in nature and were not associated with particular deities . Spells in normal text are listed in the " Tome of Magic " 2 edition .

title: Allafel
description: Allafel Allafel was an elf during the late 15th century DR . History . Allafel was the younger brother of Tarathiel .

title: Allamon Sorn
description: Allamon Sorn Allamon Sorn was a Calishite human man of the mid – 14th century DR . History . He was an acquaintance of Pasha Abon Duum and sat with him in the stands at the Arena of Blood in Manshaka , Calimshan , in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR .

title: Allan Redhand
description: Allan Redhand Allan Redhand was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Allan was not bright , and had little patience for social interaction and intrigues .

title: Allathast
description: Allathast Allathast was a male human fighter and the commander of the guards of the city of Daerlun in 1369 DR . He was secretly a thrall of the Cult of the Dragon , controlled by magic and Cultist friends . History .

title: Allesian
description: Allesian Allesian was a language spoken by the inhabitants of Thesk and Ashanath , the region southwest of Lake Ashane , from Kront in the north to the River Umber in the south and from Telflamm in the west to the Plateaus of Thay in the east . It was a Raumtheran language , just as Rashemi , which was spoken to the northeast . It had two dialects , Ashane and Golden Allesian .

title: Allessia Faithhammer
description: Allessia Faithhammer Allessia Faithhammer is a Cleric of Helm and one the five starting playable characters in . She is a human from Secomber and employs the abilities and spells typical of her character class . Adventuring Career .

title: Alleviators
description: Alleviators The alleviators were a cleric al order devoted to the god Ilmater . History . The alleviator order was developed by the priests of Ilmater themselves , rather than commanded or inspired by their god .

title: Allian
description: Allian Allian was a young halfling from Lowhill within the Moonshae Isles . Description . The female halfling had a high squeaky voice .

title: Alliance of Belt Watchers
description: Alliance of Belt Watchers The Alliance of Belt Watchers was a military organization in Damara in the Bloodstone Lands in 1359 DR . It was a group of three races who formed an interesting pact . Organization .

title: Alliance of Seventon
description: Alliance of Seventon The Alliance of Seventon began as a confederation of seven villages . At first , it was a paradise of rivers , forests , lakes , and plains . Seventon ' s history began in - 3859 DR , or 1 NY ( Nether Years ) .

title: Allip
description: Allip Allips were the incorporeal remnants of persons driven to insanity who then killed themselves . They were a type of undead creature commonly conjured by evil spellcasters using the more advanced versions of the " summon undead " spell . Description .

title: Allyn ' s Anvil
description: Allyn ' s Anvil Allyn ' s Anvil was an ancient stone circle situated high in the northern Alimir Mountains between Calimshan and the Lake of Steam . It lay east of St . Wityn ' s Hospice .

title: Almaestaddamir Auldcastle
description: Almaestaddamir Auldcastle Almaestaddamir Auldcastle , commonly called Almaes , is an alchemist who lives in Ashabenford . He is known for crafting and selling such items as tanglefoot bag s , sunrod s , various acids and antitoxins and smokepowder . Almaes once offered to build a smokepowder - keg - throwing device to combat the drow for Haresk Malorn , but he politely ( and likely wisely ) declined the offer .

title: Almari bint - Kafira
description: Almari bint - Kafira Almari bint - Kafira , or the Shark of Suq Bay , was a notorious Zakharan pirate in 1367 DR . She flew under a flag depicting a black hammerhead shark on a sea - green background . The sight of this flag was enough for most ships to strike their colors because of a unique deal that Almari offered .

title: Almorel
description: Almorel Almorel was a cosmoplitan yet primarily human trade city on the Golden Way . Geography . Almorel was located on the southeastern shores of the Lake of Mists where the Golden Way ran alongside it .

title: Almraiven
description: Almraiven Almraiven sat on the shore of the Shining Sea and was the only remaining human city in Calimshan around 1479 DR . History . Founded around - 5521 DR , the city weathered countless natural and man - made disasters and was rebuilt many times .

title: Alokkair
description: Alokkair Alokkair also known as Alokkair the Wizard - King was once the ruler of the lost kingdom of Hlontar who lives on as a Lich within Shadowdale . Appearance . Alokkair was very tall , standing at 6 ' 8 " , and had a long flowing white beard with long , wispy white hair .

title: Alonmarch
description: Alonmarch Alonmarch was a county in Suretmarch in eastern Tethyr . Geography . Alonmarch was located just where the lowlands and the highlands of Tethyr met .

title: Alonso de Bartuella
description: Alonso de Bartuella Alonso de Bartuella was a sea captain in 1357 DR . Personality . His biggest flaw was being very vulgar at dinner .

title: Alora
description: Alora Alora was a halfling thief . Alora was a cheerful and sweet halfling girl whose curiosity prompted her to frequently investigate forbidden and dangerous territory ( usually other people ' s property ) . She could be caught by adventurers while breaking into the High House of Wonders in Baldur ' s Gate at night , and offered to join them if they helped her case the joint .

title: Alphar
description: Alphar Alphar was an island in the Pirate Isles . Geography . There were several harbours on the island and the westernmost harbour was neutral , allowing any ships to dock .

title: Alpuk
description: Alpuk Alpuk , also called the Central Basin , was the largest of the three regions of the Great Glacier and the home of the Iulutiun people . Geography . The Great Glacier was naturally divided into three regions .

title: Alro Randulkyn
description: Alro Randulkyn Alro " Five Flames " Randulkyn was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . His specialty was evocation spells . Personality .

title: Altar of the Air
description: Altar of the Air The Altar of the Air was a shrine to the goddess Akadi built over a crypt in the center of the ruins of the city of Dashadjen . Inhabitants . The mummified priestess of Akadi , El Sadhara , resided there .

title: Alter normal winds
description: Alter normal winds Alter normal winds was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Alter self
description: Alter self Alter self , originally known as Quantoul ' s alterer , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to change his or her body to a new form . Effects . This spell only worked on the caster , and transformations were limited to the same general body type , " i .

title: Althea
description: Althea Althea the Abased was a priestess of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR . History . Around 1267 DR , Althea the Abased succeeded Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn as leader of the House of the Broken God , after Waelarn had been expelled from office for triggering a holy war over the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater .

title: Altho Farambler
description: Altho Farambler Altho Farambler was a halfling merchant who lived at the Chang - liu - shui oasis in the Hordelands . Activities . Altho setup a small shop in his home , catering to clients travelling from the west .

title: Alton DeVir
description: Alton DeVir Alton DeVir was a drow wizard of House DeVir who posed as a master of Sorcere in the city of Menzoberranzan . Description . In 1297 DR , Alton marred his face with acid , making his features appear unrecognizable .

title: Alton Mertlin
description: Alton Mertlin Alton Mertlin was the commander of the militia of Teziir in 1359 DR . Activities . Alton lead a force of 500 leather - armored individuals .

title: Alton Vandree
description: Alton Vandree Alton Vandree was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Alton joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt .

title: Alton the Cobbler
description: Alton the Cobbler Alton the Cobbler was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Alton was a cobbler in Menzoberranzan .

title: Altraloth
description: Altraloth An altraloth is a yugoloth of any type ( from lesser yugoloths such as mezzoloth s to greater yugoloths such as ultroloth s ) that has been transformed into a unique being by a ritual known only to the night hag s . Altraloths are changed little , mentally , but their physical forms often change dramatically and they gain powers far in excess of the rest of their kind . After they have paid off their debt to the hags , they often rise to become the rulers of their kind .

title: Altumbel
description: Altumbel Altumbel was a peninsula on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It neighbored Aglarond and includes the Archipelago of Altumbel . Altumbel was a harsh and unforgiving land , which included the maze - like archipelago of the Thousand Swords .

title: Alu - fiend
description: Alu - fiend Alu - fiends ( ÆL - oo - feend ) are the product of successful procreation between a succubus and a male mortal ( mostly humans ) . Females are , generally , attractive or beautiful , going to great lengths at times to conceal their needle - like teeth and diminutive wings . They often possess a high degree of sexual proclivity .

title: Aluar Zendos
description: Aluar Zendos Aluar Zendos was a ranger of Mielikki in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Aluar was a quiet man with an uncompromising hatred of evil creature .

title: Aluarim
description: Aluarim Aluarim was a small city located in the center of Halruaa . History . Much of the electrum mined in Maeruhal was sent to Aluarim where it was turned into coinage called skie .

title: Alukk Dannath
description: Alukk Dannath Alukk Dannath was a human man of the city of Yartar on the Savage Frontier in northwest Faerûn . Dannath was a proprietor of Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods , which sold foods for travellers in the North . He ran the store with the aid of this three strong , quiet daughters .

title: Alurah bint Asrah
description: Alurah bint Asrah Alurah bint Asrah was the Sultana of Hiyal in 1367 DR . Personality . She was considered a wise a fair ruler by some , while others thought of her as a dark - hearted schemer .

title: Alusair Obarskyr
description: Alusair Obarskyr Alusair Nacacia Obarskyr , the Steel Regent , was the princess and regent of the kingdom of Cormyr , and the youngest child of King Azoun IV and Queen Filfaeril . Alusair led Cormyr as its regent for her infant nephew , Azoun V . Some of the major concerns of her reign were rebuilding Cormyr and reclaiming the realm ' s status as the leading power in the region .

title: Alustriel Silverhand
description: Alustriel Silverhand Lady Alustriel Silverhand ( known as Elué Dualen to the elves ) was a human wizard who served for many years as the ruler of the open city of Silverymoon , and later as the High Lady of the League of the Silver Marches , a confederation of various states in the areas around Silverymoon ( Mithral Hall , Everlund , and Citadel Adbar , to name a few ) . She was a powerful mage , being one of the Chosen of Mystra and one of the Seven Sisters . She was known for her love and devotion to her people , something especially unusual for many people who hold political power .

title: Aluvauna Thornym
description: Aluvauna Thornym Aluvauna Thornym was the founder and one of the leaders of the Guardians of the Weave in 1374 DR . History . Aluvauna was just an adventuring wizard from Waterdeep until 1371 DR when a Zhent shadow adept put her in great danger .

title: Alvaerele Tasundrym
description: Alvaerele Tasundrym Alvaerele Tasundrym , also known as the Silent Chosen , is a half - elven Chosen of Mystra and former Magister . History . Alvaerele was a sage who specialized in healing , good food & beneficial herbs for human s & demihumans .

title: Alvarro
description: Alvarro Alvarro was an officer in the Golden Legion and captain of the Legion ' s cavalry . He was known for his brutality and lack of courage . History .

title: Alven Gissen
description: Alven Gissen Alven Gissen was a sculptor in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Alven was a sculptor working mostly for the Morninglow Tower .

title: Alvund
description: Alvund Alvund was a merchant from the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech in the 14th century DR . Alvund partnered with six other merchants — Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .

title: Alyana al - Azzazi
description: Alyana al - Azzazi Alyana al - Azzazi was Grand Vizier for the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . The title of Grand Vizier was one of the highest ranks one could achieve in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description .

title: Alyn Telarson
description: Alyn Telarson Alyn Telarson was an half - elf living in Myth Nantar and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the Sea of Fallen Stars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Alyn was born in Essembra and was a member of the Harpers that fought in the Iakhovas Invasion ; for his exploits he was offered to live in Myth Nantar and he accepted ; at one point he joined the Moonstars .

title: Alysae
description: Alysae Alysae was a businesswoman and priest of Shar in Skullport . Personality . In her festhall , she was the unquestioned authority .

title: Alysir Ursequarra
description: Alysir Ursequarra Alysir Ursequarra was a female fey ' ri and a member of the daemonfey . History . As lady of the Ursequarra house in 1374 DR , she attended the meeting the daemonfey gathered by their leader Sarya Dlardrageth .

title: Alyssim
description: Alyssim Alyssim was a tiny elven village located about fifty miles to the east of Essemore on the banks of the Elvenflow . Society . The people of Alyssim frowned upon half - elves and punished any elves who procreated with other species .

title: Alyth Elendara
description: Alyth Elendara " Lady " Alyth Elendara was the Elfsong Tavern bartender and owner . Personality . Lady Alyth was charming and charismatic ; she was widely praised for her stew and patrons of the Elfsong , who would gladly aid her if she was threatened .

title: Alzegund
description: Alzegund Alzegund the Trader was an evoker and an agent of the Red Wizards of Thay who posed as a friendly merchant on his travels . Description . Alzegund appeared as an old , battle - scarred wizard who proudly displayed his nation ' s distinctive wizard garb .

title: Alzhedo
description: Alzhedo Calishite Alzhedo was a regional tongue of Southwest Faerûn , and the main language of Calimshan . Other regions where it was commonly spoken included : Amn , Chult , the Lake of Steam , Lapaliiya , Lantan , the Nelanther Isles , the Shaar , Tashalar , Tethyr , Waterdeep ( among dwarves , elves , and gnome s ) , the Western Heartlands ( among halfling s and planetouched ) , the Wealdath , Tharsult , and the Old Shanatar region of the Underdark . Alzhedo , like most primarily human tongues , used the Thorass alphabet .

title: Ama Basin
description: Ama Basin The Ama Basin was the southern part of the land called the Northern Wastes in Kara - Tur . This land was called the Ama Basin in honor of the great river Ama that originated here and ended in the Celestial Sea . Also in these lands were the Koryaz Mountains , which were home to many tribes .

title: Amaese languages
description: Amaese languages The Amaese languages were a group of languages spoken by the tribes of the Ama Basin in northern Kara - Tur , and were the primary languages there . It comprised the Issacortae , Pazruki , and Wu - haltai languages , named for the nations that spoke them : Issacortae , Pazruki , and Wu - haltai . Each of these languages was a family of dialects descending from a common ancestral tongue .

title: Amahl ' s Mastering
description: Amahl ' s Mastering Ahahl ' s Mastering represented the pinnacle of the artificer ' s craft among all the " Qysari Rings " . Commissioned with great secrecy by the paranoid Qysar Amahl Shoon IV , this ring ' s most well - known power was to summon djinn , but it had other devious uses only known to a few . When the " Mastering " was coupled with his " silver scimitar " , the blade could be commanded to perform amazing feats .

title: Amahl Abd al - Muhlis
description: Amahl Abd al - Muhlis Amahl Abd al - Muhlis was a mamluk who lived in the Pantheist city of I ' tiraf in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Commander Amahl was the leader of the Devoted Mamluk Society , and led them against conflicts with the Exalted for dominance as the region ' s finest mamluk organization .

title: Amahl Shoon I
description: Amahl Shoon I King Amahl el Shoon I was the first ruler of the Shoon Dynasty of Tethyr and the period of time known as the Shoon Traitorum . Description . It was the intent of Akkabar Shoon the Elder that Amahl I be only a puppet king ; however , Amahl refused to follow his grandfather ' s wishes .

title: Amahl Shoon II
description: Amahl Shoon II King Amahl el Shoon II was the second ruler of the Shoon Dynasty of Tethyr and the period of time known as the Shoon Traitorum . Description . Amahl II was a wizard who was corrupt and completely loyal to his grandfather , the Pasha of Calimshan .

title: Amahl Shoon III
description: Amahl Shoon III Amahl Shoon III was a king of Tethyr and the first emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . Amahl III was noted as being the official founder of the Shoon Imperium , although the Imperium was in actuality the result of the result of the machinations of Akkabar Shoon the Elder over many decades .

title: Amahl Shoon IV
description: Amahl Shoon IV Qysar Amahl Shoon IV , known as Amahl the Mad , was the fifth emperor of the Shoon Imperium . He went insane in the final years of his reign . Activities .

title: Amahl Shoon V
description: Amahl Shoon V Qysar Amahl Shoon V , the Artist Qysar , was the sixth emperor of the Shoon Imperium . He was considered a near saint by the Ilmatari . Reputation .

title: Amahl Shoon VI
description: Amahl Shoon VI Qysar Amahl Shoon VI was the seventh emperor of the Shoon Imperium . He was remembered for quenching the Harakhti Uprisings . Personality .

title: Amahl Shoon VII
description: Amahl Shoon VII Qysar Amahl Shoon VII was the last emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Personality . Amahl VII was a man remembered for his treacherousness and double - dealing .

title: Amak
description: Amak Amak was an efreeti guard in the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Amak was a guard at a mine run by Hafiz al - Milhab in the Elemental Plane of Fire , where efreet put enslaved azer s to work .

title: Amanuensis
description: Amanuensis Amanuensis was an arcane and divine transmutation spell or a creation ritual that copied ordinary , non - magical text . Effect . The " amanuensis " spell read non - magical text from a book , parchment , or piece of paper , and made a perfect copy on a supplied surface , copying at a rate of 250 words per minute .

title: Amarath
description: Amarath Amarath was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Amarath and his fellow N ' von led a contingent of cultists on giant vulture s in search of a cloud giant willing to ally with their cult .

title: Amaratha
description: Amaratha Amaratha is also known as shieldstone and is unique to the Realms . Found as small lumps or nodules in deep rock strata , amaratha is soft and yields greenish white to pale green gemstones that can be set into body jewelry or any setting where it is protected from damage or wear . Shieldstone attracts and absorbs electricity in a ten foot ( three meter ) radius , protecting all within this area until it vaporizes .

title: Amarillis
description: Amarillis House Amarillis is a moon elf house descended from Kethryllia Amarillis , whose body is now in the Hall of the Ancients in Leuthilspar . The house has no leader and its members tend not to specialise in any particular vocation . The house is known for its members ' tendency to leave Evermeet to explore Faerûn .

title: Amarith Coopervein
description: Amarith Coopervein Amarith Coopervein was a dwarf in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Amarith was a member of the Emerald Enclave and one of the students of Morista Malkin in Gauntlgrym .

title: Amaront
description: Amaront Amaront of Selgaunt was a young mage of Selgaunt in Sembia . His primary area of research was creating spell s that used gem s as foci . Using a gem as the focus for the magic made it difficult to trace a spell back to the caster .

title: Amarsa Bleth
description: Amarsa Bleth Lady Amarsa Bleth was a human woman and a member of the Bleth noble family of Cormyr in the 14th century DR . History . In the late 1360s , Lady Amarsa and Lord Gruen Bleth were guests of Lord Partic Thistle at his manor , Thistleflame , on the occasion of King Azoun IV ' s birthday .

title: Amarune
description: Amarune Amarune was a rogue female malaugrym who posed as Nael Irlingstar , a noble heiress in Waterdeep for over three decades . She first eschewed the plots of her kin and lived quietly among Waterdeep ' s nobility , in accordance with the Dark Decree of the Great Shadowmaster Dhalgrave but soon she turned rogue , never returning to the Plane of Shadow or communicating with her brethren . She even spawned children without authorization .

title: Amarune Whitewave
description: Amarune Whitewave Amarune Whitewave , whose full name is Amarune Lyone Armala Whitewave , is a human rogue living in Suzail . She is Elminster ' s great - great granddaughter through Narnra Shalace . Although she had grown up hearing family stories about their relationship to Elminster , she never really believed the tales .

title: Amaunator
description: Amaunator Amaunator ( pronounced " ah - MAWN - ah - tor " ) was the Netherese solar deity of order , the sun , law , and time . He was viewed as a harsh but fair deity , revered by many rulers , soldiers , and powerful wizards . It was eventually claimed , following the Spellplague , that Lathander , the Faerûn ian god of the sun , was an aspect of the long - dormant Amaunator .

title: Amaunator ' s belt
description: Amaunator ' s belt " Amaunator ' s belt " was a name given to an ancient constellation associated with the Netherese god Amaunator . Observation . The constellation appeared over the Spine of the World mountains in summer , during the time of the ancient empire of Netheril .

title: Amaunthur Sardron
description: Amaunthur Sardron Amaunthur Sardron was a human noble from Eskorn , Returned Abeir , and the main oppositor of the Roaryl dynasty as of 1479 DR . Background . In 1479 DR , Amaunthur was secretly working to depose the Roaryl dynasty from the throne , and to elevate his son to king of Eskorn .

title: Amazandar
description: Amazandar Capital of the old kingdom of Anauria , Amazandar was known as the City of Gems . Geography . Amazandar lied west of the Desertsmouth Mountains .

title: Amber
description: Amber Amber was fossilized tree resin and was usually tumbled into smooth stones or polished and cut cabochon . Description . This fancy stone was soft and brittle and easily worked into strings of beads and used for trade by barbarians of the north .

title: Amber amulet of vermin
description: Amber amulet of vermin An amber amulet of vermin was a magic item that conjured a giant insect to serve its owner . Description . The amulet consisted of an irregular nugget of natural amber on a gold chain , with an insect caught inside the amber .

title: Ambergris
description: Ambergris Ambergris ( full name Amber Gristle O ' Maul ) was a dwarf cleric of Dumathoin and formerly a member of Cavus Dun . Description . Ambergris was a female dwarf convert to the Shadowfell , part shade but not wholly one .

title: Ambratha Suren
description: Ambratha Suren Ambratha Suren was a farmer and goose - breeder from Aunkspear in Cormyr . Personality . Gruff and crude , Ambratha did not have time for fools or insolence .

title: Ambuchar ' s Amulet
description: Ambuchar ' s Amulet Ambuchar ' s Amulet was a unique magic item that could be found within the Hordelands . History . It was assumed that this item was made by Ambuchar Devayam and spoke on his behalf .

title: Ambuchar Devayam
description: Ambuchar Devayam Ambuchar Devayam was once known as Tan Chin , a powerful necromancer and the emperor of what would become the nation of Shou Lung in Kara - Tur . Biography . Tan Chin is first noted in history as a young man who discovered several artefact s from the fallen empire of Anok - Imaskar .

title: Amedahast
description: Amedahast Amedahast was a female human wizard , and a descendant of Baerauble Etharr and Alea Dahast . She was the successor of Baerauble in the position of High Wizard of Cormyr . Description .

title: Amelior Amanitas
description: Amelior Amanitas Amelior Amanitas ( pronounced Ah - ME - lee - or Ah - mah - NEE - tass ) was a male human wizard and the Sage of Secomber . Description . Amelior was a 6 - ft ( 1 .

title: Amelyssan
description: Amelyssan Amelyssan the Blackhearted was a priestess and Deathstalker of Bhaal whom that deity entrusted with the task of resurrecting him . Having foreseen his death during the Time of Troubles , Bhaal came to Toril years before the event and mated with mortal females of different races , producing offspring called Bhaalspawn , who were to slaughter each other and fuel his rebirth . Amelyssan ' s task was to perform rituals that would complete Bhaal ' s return .

title: Amet ' ned - thoth
description: Amet ' ned - thoth Amet ' ned - thoth was a wizard - priest of Thoth in Skullport . Personality . Amet ' ned - thoth always dressed in the typical " kalasiris " of his home country .

title: Amethyst
description: Amethyst Amethyst was a fancy stone related to agate s and other varieties of but held a higher value . Description . Gem quality amethysts could be a light to deep purple , but the deep " royal " hues were the most highly valued .

title: Amethyst dragon
description: Amethyst dragon Amethyst dragons were considered wise even by dragon standards . They tended to be poor flyers but could burrow underground . Most Amethyst dragons lived in the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Amie Fern
description: Amie Fern Amie Fern was a female human wizard of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Relationships . Amie was a long - time friend of the one known as the Kalach - Cha , and both had been orphaned during the battle with the King of Shadows .

title: Amiq rasol
description: Amiq rasol Amiq rasol , also called Deep men or Dark men , were corsair s from Zakhara who rose from the dead after being lost at sea , marooned , or murdered . Amiq rasol could also be corsairs who rejected the Enlightened gods and died at sea . Description .

title: Amkethran
description: Amkethran Amkethran was a town located somewhere in Tethyr . In 1368 DR , it was under the unofficial leadership of Balthazar , the leader of the local monastery and a Bhaalspawn . The town was in very bad shape , as its inhabitants lived in poverty and had to contend with Balthazar ' s mercenaries , who also lived there and did basically whatever they liked .

title: Amlakkar
description: Amlakkar Amlakkar were the city watch or police force for Calishite towns and cities . Organization . The amlakkar ( singular , amlak ) were composed of indentured servants .

title: Amlaruil Moonflower
description: Amlaruil Moonflower Amlaruil Moonflower ( sometimes known as the Sad Queen after the death of King Zaor Moonflower ) was a moon elf and queen of the elven island of Evermeet . History . Born on Evermeet in 611 DR , Amlaruil eventually married Zaor Moonflower , King of Evermeet However Zaor was assassinated on Ches 2 , 1321 DR , by an agent of Kymil Nimesin .

title: Ammakyl Flowers and Foods
description: Ammakyl Flowers and Foods Ammakyl Flowers and Foods was a shop in the village of Amphail , selling fruits , vegetables , and trail baskets . It was run by the Ammakyl family of Waterdeep . During the summer and autumn months , an awning was erected outside the shop to provide extra space for the wares .

title: Ammanadas Silversword
description: Ammanadas Silversword Ammanadas Silversword was a member of the Silversword noble house of Cormyr . In 1369 DR , he stabbed Ensibal Threen , a War Wizard , in the throat for believing him to be a supporter of Vangerdahast ' s proposed regency . He was quickly subdued by Lareth Gulur , a passing Purple Dragon .

title: Ammaratha Cyndusk
description: Ammaratha Cyndusk Ammaratha Cyndusk was a song dragon , and the mother of Narnra Shalace by Elminster . History . Early life .

title: Ammarindar
description: Ammarindar Ammarindar was a ruined city in the Northdark inhabited by tanarukk s . Geography . Ammarindar was located primarily in the Northdark between the drow cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad .

title: Ammatha Braceryn
description: Ammatha Braceryn Ammatha Braceryn was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was pleasantly plump , but light on her feet .

title: Ammathluir
description: Ammathluir Ammathluir was an important trading hub in Luiren in the Shining South . Geography . Ammathluir was situated south of the Long Forest in western Luiren .

title: Ammathtar
description: Ammathtar Ammathtar was a city located in northeastern Dambrath . Geography . Ammathtar was located between the Granuin forest on the east and the Trader ' s Way on the west .

title: Ammisyll Veldann
description: Ammisyll Veldann Lady Ammisyll Veldann was the sun elven governor of Nimlith on the island of Evermeet and a member of the Council of Evermeet . Personality . Ammisyll had extremely conservative views and opposed the monarchy on Evermeet .

title: Ammon Jerro
description: Ammon Jerro Ammon Jerro is a powerful warlock of the Sword Coast . Ammon is best known for his position as the chief enemy of the King of Shadows prior to the rise of the Kalach - Cha . Description .

title: Ammut
description: Ammut The ammut was a horrifying creature which inhabited Zakhara and performed judgments over sinners . Description . These creatures were a cross between a crocodile , a lioness , and a hippopotamus in mannish form .

title: Amn
description: Amn Amn , also known as the Merchant ' s Domain , was a tremendously wealthy nation in West Faerûn . Prior to the Spellplague and the continent ' s disappearance , Amn held colonies far away in Maztica . Post - Spellplague it still controlled important trade routes to Calimshan and Baldur ' s Gate as well as colonial ports in the Moonshaes and Chult .

title: Amnemis
description: Amnemis Amnemis was a black dragon member of the Cult of the Dragon . Relationships . She was the familiar of the half - dragon Vargo Kent but when she became too big , Vargo choose a new familiar and Amnemis became his cohort .

title: Amnestria
description: Amnestria Amnestria Moonflower ( later known as Z ' beryl ) was the daughter of Amlaruil Moonflower and Zaor Moonflower and therefore a princess of Evermeet . She was also mother to Arilyn Moonblade . Description .

title: Amnian phrases
description: Amnian phrases Amnian phrases are those with specific meaning in Amn . There are a number of these in common usage . B .

title: Amnic Basult
description: Amnic Basult Amnic Basult was a male Chondathan human in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . He was the proprietor of Basult ' s Books , and was the only bookseller in town . Relationships .

title: Amnizu
description: Amnizu Amnizu were powerful baatezu found mostly on the layer of the Nine Hells called Stygia . Description . Amnizu were usually around 4 ft ( 1 .

title: Amnurflow
description: Amnurflow The Amnurflow was a river in Amn that flowed into Lake Weng . Geography . The river was the northernmost of the tributaries of Lake Weng .

title: Amnwater
description: Amnwater Amnwater was a small city on the Eshpurta Road between Crimmor and Keczulla , in Amn . Until 1107 DR , Amnwater was simply a tavern . After this time , it became a village of farmers and caravan drovers .

title: Amori De ' Spri
description: Amori De ' Spri Amori De ' Spri was a resurrected noble in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In her past , Amori was a noble in Waterdeep .

title: Amphail ( village )
description: Amphail ( village ) Amphail was a village on the Long Road . Population . It had a population of 600 , supporting 250 more in outlying farms .

title: Amphail the Just
description: Amphail the Just Amphail the Just was a human War Lord of Waterdeep . He reigned during the second Trollwar , but his reign lasted only one year because he was killed during a battle against the troll s . His rule followed on from that of Gharl , successor to Nimoar , and he was succeeded by another five War Lords before the end of that twelve - year period .

title: Ampherd Holt
description: Ampherd Holt Ampherd Holt was a Zhentarim cleric of Tempus at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . Personality . Ampherd had an unbalanced mind , being in permanent state of battle madness .

title: Amphisbaena
description: Amphisbaena An amphisbaena ( æm - fis - BAY - na ) resembles a pit viper with instead of one head two of them at each end of its body . Alu - fiend Physical description . An amphisbaena ' s skin molts just like other snakes , and little horns above each eye helps it to shed its skin .

title: Amplify
description: Amplify Amplify was a simple alteration spell used to alter the volume of sound . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .

title: Amra
description: Amra Amra was an ancient human kingdom of Returned Abeir . History . According to old legends , one of the kings that ruled Amra centuries before the Spellplague was a dragonheir .

title: Amrath Mulnobar
description: Amrath Mulnobar Amrath Mulnobar was the castellan of Noanar ' s Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Amrath was the castellan of the Hunt Lords keep for more than two centuries serving them from before they entered in a pact with Orcus becoming wight .

title: Amratha Shuldeiroun
description: Amratha Shuldeiroun Amratha Shuldeiroun was the senior chatelaine of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Amratha was a petite woman with beautiful , angular features and red hair .

title: Amree
description: Amree Amree was a human ship ' s wizard whose home port is Westgate . In 1479 DR she sailed on a ship owned by the Nine Golden Swords and successfully defended the ship from attack by Sahuagin and the boat was able to limp back into port in Westgate . Unfortunately , the ship had taken too much damage and sank in Westgate harbor after all the cargo had been unloaded .

title: Amrelle Mistwind
description: Amrelle Mistwind Lady Amrelle Mistwind was a human female . Description . Amrelle was stunningly beautiful and had dark swirling hair that matched her eyes .

title: Amreth Gaunt
description: Amreth Gaunt Armreth Gaunt was a master merchant who resided in Scornubel . He was sly and had a glib tongue . He was willing to deal with anyone with the exception of eladrin whom he considered out of his league .

title: Amryyr Yauntyrr
description: Amryyr Yauntyrr Amryyr Yauntyrr was a courier in Skullport for the Dark Dagger . History . Amryrr was born to House Druu ’ giir , a noble house in Menzoberranzan .

title: Amsha al - Lanim
description: Amsha al - Lanim Amsha al - Lanim was in charge of the Gate of the Ghost in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Amsha was harsh and strict , relentlessly driving her employees to strive for perfection in their duties .

title: Amstel River
description: Amstel River The Amstel River was a river in eastern Amn that began with the merging of Trifin Creek and the River Rimril at Eshpurta . Geography . The river flowed safely southward for about 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) until it was joined by the Khalleshyr at Trollford , then it turned west and became impossible to ford for 75 miles ( 120 kilometers ) .

title: Amulet of Dreams
description: Amulet of Dreams The Amulet of Dreams was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . While wearing an Amulet of Dreams , the owner could summon up to three sandmen .

title: Amulet of Laeral ' s Tears
description: Amulet of Laeral ' s Tears Amulets of Laeral ' s tears were named after the famed sorceress , Laeral Silverhand . They temporarily bestowed greater health upon those who wore the amulet against their skin . A variant of these amulets , known as an Amulet of Dark Blessing , were found among the drow of the Underdark and besides their appearance they functioned identically .

title: An Army of One Thousand
description: An Army of One Thousand The spider katanga are massing again and the rivers flowing from Fire Mountain are poisoning the lands they flow through . Two groups of heroes are required - one group to cause a distraction and rescue the scouting party who were captured when they were sent to investigate , and another to venture into the spider katanga lair to kill their Mother of a Thousand Young before she can birth an army .

title: Ana - Mashhal
description: Ana - Mashhal Ana - Mashhal was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Ana - Mashhal was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Anabraxis
description: Anabraxis Anabraxis the Black Talon was a runescribed dracolich revered by the Cult of the Dragon as their ultimate authority around the Year of the Ageless One . Activities . She had various lairs in Lorosfyr in the Underdark , from were she could travel to the Shadowfell at will through its bottomless abyss , and she commanded a tribe of Death giant s that lived in the deepest regions of the chasm .

title: Anaconda
description: Anaconda Anaconda were a mercenary company based in Elven Wood near Elmwood and operating in Dalelands and Stonelands around 1358 DR . Organization . Membership .

title: Anagakok
description: Anagakok An anagakok was a special type of wizard unique to the Great Glacier who had been magically adapted to the cold . Description . An anagakok was immediately recognizable , because the secret ceremony of his or her initiation magically and permanently changed his or her physiology — an anagakok had fur like an animal .

title: Anagrys Brightbrass
description: Anagrys Brightbrass Anagrys Brightbrass was a gold dwarf wizard who grew up in the Great Rift . History . She showed a remarkable aptitude for magic from an early age .

title: Analyze device
description: Analyze device Analyze device was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was used primarily by mechanician s . Effects .

title: Analyze opponent
description: Analyze opponent Analyze opponent was a divine magic divination spell available to priests , holy strategists , and holy warriors of the Red Knight , the Lady of Strategy . It let the caster gauge the strengths and weaknesses of one or more creatures for tactical intelligence . Effects .

title: Analyze portal
description: Analyze portal Analyze portal was a divinatory spell used by arcane spellcasters in the Realms . Cleric s of Eilistraee or Shaundakul who mastered the portal domain could also cast this spell . Effects .

title: Ananta
description: Ananta Ananta was a dragonborn who served as the Guardian of Dracowyr in 1479 DR . Abilities . Ananta was able to breathe acid .

title: Anarch of Shyr
description: Anarch of Shyr The anarchs of Shyr are one of the oldest orders of swordmage s on either Abeir or Toril , having originated long ago amongst genasi arcane spellcaster s on the continent of Shyr . In contrast to some of the more esoteric or abjuration based swordmages , anarchs of Shyr concentrate on focusing the arcane magic that flows through the Elemental Chaos into powerful blasts of energy . This has served the anarchs of Shyr well for centuries , making them ideal enemies of the dragon s of Abeir and Returned Abeir .

title: Anarchic
description: Anarchic Anarchic is a weapon quality that can be added to any weapon . The weapon becomes chaotically aligned and inflicts more damage to creatures of lawful alignment . Any lawful creature welding an " anarchic " will be weakened .

title: Anariel
description: Anariel Anariel was an individual who gave the elven longbow " Taulmaril " and a quiver of Anariel to Clan Battlehammer . She had the title " Sister of Faerûn " . History .

title: Anastes
description: Anastes Anastes was the paramount of the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain in 1369 DR . Description . Anastes had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .

title: Anastra Syluné Silverhand
description: Anastra Syluné Silverhand Anastra Syluné Silverhand , more commonly known as Syluné and also known as the Witch of Shadowdale , was the eldest of the Seven Sisters . After her death at the hands of a dragon cult , she remained in Shadowdale as a spectral harpist . History .

title: Anathar ' s Dell
description: Anathar ' s Dell Anathar ' s Dell was an inn located in southern Daggerdale . Geography . The establishment was nestled between Serpentsbridge to the north and the Spiderhaunt Wood s to the south .

title: Anauria
description: Anauria Anauria was one of a small number of cities of Netheril that survived Karsus ' s Folly . Afterwards , it grew into a kingdom . Nevertheless , it was eventually swallowed up by the growing Anauroch desert .

title: Anauroch
description: Anauroch Anauroch ( either Ah - " NOR " - ach or An - OAR - ock - hh ' ) , or The Great Sand Sea , was a magical desert in northern Faerûn . It held the remnants of the once - powerful Netherese Empire , their flying enclaves having crashed to the ground when their greatest mage Karsus , in a desperate bid to end the war against the phaerimm , challenged the goddess Mystryl for her divine mantle , causing the Weave to falter and all magic to fail . For generations since , Anauroch , the greatest desert in Faerûn , encroached relentlessly on border nations , burying them beneath the sands .

title: Anauroch : The Empire of Shade
description: Anauroch : The Empire of Shade Anauroch : The Empire of Shade is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the 3 . 5 - edition ruleset of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Summary .

title: Anaxim
description: Anaxim An anaxim , also called a sheen , was a golem - like metallic elemental native to the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The anaxims did not had a definite form .

title: Anaya
description: Anaya Anaya was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Anaya and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Ancestral mound
description: Ancestral mound ORIGINS When Uthgar conquered the beast Gods and ascended on his sky pony to join his father Beorunna he left his people with a path and totem animals to lead them on the path outlined by Tempus . By assigning the totem spirits to the tribes the shamans were gifted with the power to invoke the strength and characteristics of the deity , either upon themselves or others of the tribe . The ancestor mound was a pivitol socio / religious focus point of the tribes , with each tribe generally regarding at least one mound as their traditional veneration site , of which the history of the people would be remembered in oral tradition .

title: Anchin
description: Anchin Anchin was a Tsuyoi - no - kami acolyte in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . As a new monk , Anchin was assigned to do all the most menial works no one else wished to perform .

title: Anchorome
description: Anchorome Anchorome ( " Ang - kor - OH - may " ) is the far western continent of Toril . It lies roughy 3 , 000 miles ( 4800 km ) west across the Trackless Sea of the Sword Coast , or about 1 , 000 miles ( 1600 km ) west of Evermeet . Anchorome is directly north of Maztica .

title: Ancient Ones
description: Ancient Ones The Ancient Ones were believed to be supernatural beings of great power by the Nexalan s , but they were actually drow . History . The Ancients lived in the Highcave at the summit of Zaltec ' s sacred volcano , Mount Zatal .

title: Andahar
description: Andahar Andahar was a unicorn that could be summoned by Drizzt Do ' Urden . Description . Drizzt possessed a horn charm on a silver chain .

title: Andannas Dalkur
description: Andannas Dalkur Andannas Dalkur was a monk of Candlekeep . History . Dalkur hailed from Secomber , later moved to Tharsult , and finally settled in Candlekeep .

title: Andar
description: Andar Andar was the " Realms " name for , a durable gemstone that could be facet - cut by a skilled to produce translucent " andars " with a green - red or brown - red flash . Description . This semi - precious stones could be found as small crystals , averaging 0 .

title: Andar ( sunmaster )
description: Andar ( sunmaster ) Andar was a cleric and sunmaster of Amaunator . He organized a torchbearer service , employing orphans , to light the ways of citizens moving about in the dark . His torchbearers often brought him news of unlawful things occurring in the darkness , which he sought to deal with .

title: Andar Obarskyr
description: Andar Obarskyr Andar Obarskyr was brother to Ondeth and uncle to Faerlthann , first king of Cormyr . He was part of the first human settlement in what was then known as the Wolf Woods . In an argument between the humans and an elf hunter by the name of Thatoryl Elian , Andar slew the elf .

title: Andareunarthex
description: Andareunarthex Andareunarthex , aka Dareun , is a young Green dragon and a player of the game of Xorvintaal . In 1479 DR he made the audacious move of entering Waterdeep and establishing a lair in an antiquaries shop the Trades Ward , outside the range of the Ahghairon ' s dragonward . His ultimate goal appears to have been domination of Waterdeep .

title: Andarphisk Hawkspike
description: Andarphisk Hawkspike Andarphisk Hawkspike was a businessman in Suzail . Activities . Andarsphisk was one of the two surviving leaders of Thurbrand and Arley , Wendra of the Willing Whips , and Splendors of the Shining Sea Importations , which was situated in the poor quarters of Suzail .

title: Anders Aricssen
description: Anders Aricssen Anders Aricssen was a Northman rogue living in the city of Ravens Bluff . History . Along with Jack Ravenwild , Anders broke into House Kuldath in order to steal a set of five perfect rubies purchased by the Brothers Kuldath from jeweler Shorlock Revahl .

title: Andorra
description: Andorra Andorra of the Many Veils , or the Gazelle , was a wildly popular dancer living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Combined with her impressive dancing skills , Andorra ' s beauty , genuine smile , and friendly demeanor ensured she always had a captive audience of amorous nobles .

title: Andranth Glarvreth
description: Andranth Glarvreth Andrath Glarvreth was a very successful merchant in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Glarvreth was plotting against King Foril Obarskyr I in order to become a noble .

title: Andreas Vanderslyke
description: Andreas Vanderslyke Andreas Vanderslyke was a monster hunter . Personality . The hunter traveled far and wide in search of evil creatures to stalk .

title: Andrew
description: Andrew Andrew was a child of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Andrew ' s father , Zachan , told Andrew about the story that thounsands of duergar fought a battle .

title: Andrew Goldhawk
description: Andrew Goldhawk Andrew Goldhawk is a fantasy illustrator who was born in 1966 in Buffalo , New York . He graduated from the Colorado Institute of Art and from the early 1990s he has worked with RPG companies such as TSR , White Wolf , and Wizards of the Coast . He considers himself to be a science fiction and horror artist , and prefers to use traditional methods such as oil , pencil , and brush .

title: Andrik Gos
description: Andrik Gos Andrik Gos was a mad artist in Mulmaster . Relationship . Andrik was the nephew of Zor Faltyn Gos , one of the Blades of Mulmaster .

title: Androsphinx
description: Androsphinx Androsphinxes ( ÆN - dro - sfink - ses ) were the males of the sphinx species . They were physically powerful creatures with inherent magical powers and a terrifying roar . While they tended to be short - tempered and terse , androsphinxes possessed good - natured ideals and always attempted to do the right thing .

title: Andrus Kriivor
description: Andrus Kriivor Andrus Kriivor was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Andy Collins
description: Andy Collins Andy Collins is a game designer for Wizards of the Coast . Education . Collins received his bachelors degree in English from in 1994 .

title: Andzrel Baenre
