description: Andzrel Baenre Andzrel Baenre was the weapons master of House Baenre and a commander of the Army of the Black Spider . Description . Andzrel wore black mithral plate and a dark cloak .

title: Angah Lalla
description: Angah Lalla Angah Lalla was a curios dealer and fence for stolen goods in the city of Scornubel . Appearance . Angah dressed in flowing off - white robes with a black veil .

title: Angel
description: Angel Angels , also known as the aasimon , were celestial immortal s of varying humanoid form that hailed from any of the celestial plane s or the Astral Sea . In the Dawn War , angels served deities as soldiers , though they are not necessarily in the service of the gods anymore . Angels were ancient enemies of elemental archon s as well as all manner of fiend s .

title: Angel McCoy
description: Angel McCoy Angel Leigh McCoy grew up delving into fantasy and horror novels to escape the doldrums of long , hot summers . She won her first essay contest in 6th grade and has been writing ever since . As time passed , she studied French Literature at the University of Illinois in Champaign - Urbana and rediscovered the attractions of myth and magic .

title: Angel of decay
description: Angel of decay The Angel of Decay was an undead monstrosity — an avatar , the very essence of rot . Appearance . Standing 9 - feet tall and weighing 500 – 700 lbs with wings and claws , their putrid bodies constantly decomposed , and pools of filth dribbled around their feet .

title: Angel of vengeance
description: Angel of vengeance An angel of vengeance was an angel sent to punish those who defied or angered the gods , or to test a mortal who was in danger of falling from the path a deity set for them . Combat . When in battle , these immortal s wore plate mail and fought with dual longsword s .

title: Angelar ' s skin
description: Angelar ' s skin Angelar ' s skin , also called angel ' s skin , was not a mineral but a delicate pink coral found on reefs in shallow tropical waters . Description . Proper preparation of these fancy stones included baking in the sun for many days to dry them out and to eliminate the odor of dead sea life .

title: Angelic avenger
description: Angelic avenger An angelic avenger is a paragon path available to cleric s . This particular path places one in high accord with one ' s deity to the point where in battle one may begin to look like an angel , a servant of the gods . One ' s face becomes unrecognizable , wings sprout from one ' s back and legs dissipate and one looks as if to float .

title: Angelo Dosan
description: Angelo Dosan Angelo Dosan was a corrupt Flaming Fist officer who worked for Sarevok , briefly becoming the head of the Fist when Scar was assassinated and Duke Eltan incapacitated . He fell along with Sarevok in his final stand in the Undercity . He was also the father of the female warrior called Shar - Teel .

title: Angels of Death
description: Angels of Death The Angels of Death were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Fully 35 , 000 efreet armed with composite short bows made up the Angels of Death .

title: Anghara Hettix
description: Anghara Hettix Anghara Hettix was a gnome merchant in the Moonsea region . Personality . Anghara was an experienced and well - traveled merchant .

title: Angharradh
description: Angharradh Angharradh , also referred to as the Queen of Arvandor , who was sometimes considered the personification of three separate elven goddesses , Aerdrie Faenya , Hanali Celanil , and Sehanine Moonbow , as well as a single goddess who extended beyond these three separate aspects before the Spellplague , was the chief goddess of the Seldarine . As such , her nature reflected traits of each of these deities . Due to the nature of her creation , Angharradh exhibited a fierce protectiveness and strong resolve .

title: Angharradh ' s favor
description: Angharradh ' s favor Angharradh ' s favor was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , granted to worshipers of Angharradh that granted one ally a burst of skill or luck against various types of attacks . This power could only be invoked after the caster or an ally demonstrated skill or luck on their own .

title: Anglathammaroth
description: Anglathammaroth Anglathammaroth was a male black dragon who served as the mount of Undarl , the malaugrym magelord of Athalantar . History . In 240 DR , during Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection against the magelords , Undarl rode Anglathammaroth in his battle with Elminster .

title: Angrath Woodwise
description: Angrath Woodwise Angrath Woodwise was one of servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Angrath was the chief hunter for Lord Marsten until his master was killed some time before the Tyranny of Dragons and the lodge was occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel .

title: Angruin Myrvult
description: Angruin Myrvult Angruin Myrvult was a powerful Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR Angruin was the commander - in - chief of a secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale ; however Elminster Aumar and Sharantyr discovered the Zhent plot about the dale and started an insurrection against the Zhent and thanks also to the coming of the Time of Troubles the Zhent were defeated and Angruin died by a spell going crazy .

title: Angsaas Chain
description: Angsaas Chain The Angsaas , or " Eastern Shield " , was a chain of mountains in the east of the Great Glacier . Geography . The Angsaas Chain overlooked the plains of Sossal and formed the border between that land and Angalpuk .

title: Angulutiun
description: Angulutiun The Angulutiuns were a human ethnic group living in the Angalpuk region of the Great Glacier . They were a nomadic race of caribou - herders , and were one of the peoples collectively known as the Ulutiun s . Description .

title: Angus
description: Angus Angus was an old moorhound owned by Tristan Kendrick , Prince of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles . Description . Deep in his years , Angus had a worn brown face and a shaggy neck .

title: Angus Materi
description: Angus Materi Angus Materi was an important member of the Zhentarim and the leader of the Outriders of Darkhold , an elite cavalry troop of vanguard raiders based in Darkhold . Personality . Angus was among the most easily encountered of the Zhent secondary leaders .

title: Anhur
description: Anhur Anhur ( pronounced " an " - hur ) , also known as Rumathep , Ramathant in Thay , and Ramatep in Unther , is a wise and peace - loving deity . He remains ever vigilant in his role of protecting Mulhorand from evil , but still finds the time to appreciate those he defends . History .

title: Animal companion
description: Animal companion Animal companions were the bonded creatures of ranger s and druid s . They helped in fighting , scouting , and friendship . They most commonly were wolves or badger s , but sometimes were boar s , bear s or even snake s , as was the case with the dwarven druid Pikel Bouldershoulder .

title: Animal friendship
description: Animal friendship Animal friendship was an enchantment spell that allowed a druid to befriend one or more natural animals and eventually train them to do tricks or perform tasks . If the creature would be harmed by any allies of the caster the spell would end . Components .

title: Animal growth
description: Animal growth Animal growth was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to double the size of one or more animals . The reverse of this spell , shrink animal , caused animals to shrink to half their size . Effects .

title: Animal messenger
description: Animal messenger Animal messenger , also known as Messenger , was an enchantment spell that recruited a tiny - sized creature to carry a message , following simple directions . Components . The spell required verbal and somatic components and a small morsel of food as a material component .

title: Animal shapes
description: Animal shapes Animal shapes is a transmutation spell that causes one ally per level to polymorph into a chosen animal . Effect . As " polymorph other " , except you polymorph up to one willing creature per level into an animal of your choice ; the spell has no effect on unwilling creature .

title: Animal sphere
description: Animal sphere The Animal sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and druid s that allowed influence , summoning , communication , control , alteration , or friendship with animals and insects . Spells in normal text are listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Animal Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Animal summoning II
description: Animal summoning II Animal summoning II was an improved version of " animal summoning I " , which operated in the same way but could summon up to twelve animals of the same size as " animal summoning I " or up to six animals approximately twice that size .

title: Animal summoning III
description: Animal summoning III Animal summoning III was an improved version of " animal summoning II " . It operated in the same way as " animal summoning I " but could summon up to sixteen animals of the same size as " animal summoning I " , or up to eight animals of the larger size from " animal summoning II " , or up to four animals approximately twice the size of the larger ones from " animal summoning II " .

title: Animal trance
description: Animal trance Animal trance is an enchantment spell that fascinates animals . Effect . Your swaying motions and music ( or singing , or chanting ) compel animal s , beast s , and magical beast s to do nothing but watch you .

title: Animate
description: Animate An animate was a creature artificially vested with life or intelligence . Animates were generally under the control of their creators and were devoid of most qualities typical of life , such as breathing , consumption , or sleep . Animates differed little by planar origin and none arose naturally under normal circumstances .

title: Animate blood
description: Animate blood Animate blood was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created tiny beings from the caster ' s blood .

title: Animate dead
description: Animate dead Animate dead was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to raise one or more mostly intact skeletons or corpses as undead skeleton s or zombie s under his or her control . Effects . This spell was a staple of the necromantic arts and saw many incarnations as magic evolved over time .

title: Animate objects
description: Animate objects Animate objects ( also seen as animate object ) was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to temporarily bring to life one or more inanimate objects to attack a designated target . Effects . This spell could animate objects made of any non - magical material such as ceramic , fabric , glass , leather , metal , or wood .

title: Animate rope
description: Animate rope Animate rope , originally known as Vilate ' s restriction and later bind , was an arcane alteration / enchantment or transmutation spell that could animate a rope - like object to move or loop , coil , or tie knots as directed by the caster . Casters . In the time of Netheril , " Vilate ' s restriction " could be cast by arcanist s of the Variation specialization .

title: Aniseed
description: Aniseed Aniseed was an effective items used by some rogue s to thwart a dog ' s sense of smell . Uses . When dropped on the ground behind them , a fleeing thief could usually successfully cover - up their scent with aniseed , effectively blocking dog ' s from picking up their trail for several minutes or several hours depending on the dog ' s training .

title: Anithlynn
description: Anithlynn Anithlynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Anithlynn was born with Briglynn and Kaitlynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth .

title: Anival Dyrr
description: Anival Dyrr Anival Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan from 1373 DR . History . Anival was the first daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr in 1373 DR when , during the Silence of Lolth , House Agrach Dyrr entered into a secret alliance with the Jaezred Chaulssin and betrayed Menzoberranzan ' s Army of the Black Spider to the armies of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok .

title: Ankaram
description: Ankaram Duchy Ankaram , formerly Ankramir , was the territory of Tethyr bordering Calimshan in the south . Geography . Ankaram was located between the River Ith and the River Memnon .

title: Ankhapur
description: Ankhapur Ankhapur was a city located in the Lake of Steam region on the southern edge of interior Faerûn . Trade . The city was primarily known for its pearl industry , which involved many of its citizens .

title: Ankheg
description: Ankheg The ankheg ( ÆNK - eg ) was a huge insectoid monster with many slender limbs and large antennae . It burrowed underground and hunted from below . Environment .

title: Ankhwood
description: Ankhwood Ankhwood ( once part of the Winterwood ) was a forest whose insect , animal and plant populations become mutated . There were once wild magic and dead magic areas orbiting one another in the forest , but by 1374 DR this effect had subsided and the elves living in the area were investigating the cause of the mutations .

title: Anklet
description: Anklet Anklets were decorative jewelry worn around the ankles of women in Zakhara . Description . Anklets could be rather common or incredibly ornate .

title: Ankramir
description: Ankramir The Principality of Ankramir was the southwestern of Tethyr . Geography . Ankramir included the of Kamlann , the Purple Marches , and Ankaram , and was the location of Tethyr ' s former capital and largest city , Zazesspur .

title: Annaeus
description: Annaeus Annaeus was a dwarven priest in the Illefarn empire , and was responsible for the creation of the King of Shadows . History . When the Knight Captain of Crossroad Keep encountered his spirit in the Gem Mines in the ruins of Arvahn , Annaeus stated that he did not regret his creation , before helping the Captain to unlock one of the statues of the Ritual of Purification designed by Annaeus himself to weaken the King of Shadows .

title: Annah
description: Annah Annah of the Shadows is a tiefling female thief from the computer game . She is described as the daughter of the Collector Pharod , but not as a natural issue . Most likely , she was found as an orphan on the streets of Sigil , and raised by Pharod .

title: Annam All - Father
description: Annam All - Father Annam All - Father was a giant deity and creator of the giant race . Background . Annam came across the planet of Abeir - Toril at a time before the existence of dwarves , elves , and human s .

title: Anne Gray McCready
description: Anne Gray McCready Anne Gray McCready is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . Education . McCready earned her B .

title: Annen
description: Annen Annen was a shukenja adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Annen lived most of his life in the Konjo temple of Miyama until , in 1357 DR , his master said that to achieve enlightenment he needed to see the world .

title: Annihilation
description: Annihilation Annihilation by Philip Athans is the fifth book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The novel opens in Menzoberranzan , still besieged by the duergar army of Gracklstugh and tanarukk warriors of Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion .

title: Annis
description: Annis An annis ( ÆN - nis ) was the most physically powerful of the hag s . Appearance . An annis was a giant crone with blackened skin , stringy , black hair , fingers that ended in long talons , and sharpened teeth that looked like iron nails .

title: Annulus Conflagros
description: Annulus Conflagros Annulus Conflagros was the second " Qysari Ring " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It gave the wearer both protection from fire and access to arcane fire spells . There were other " shoonring s " made during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) with similar properties , but only one imperial ring .

title: Annulus Qysarus Major
description: Annulus Qysarus Major Annulus Qysarus Major was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It randomly reflected some or all of each spell cast directly at the wearer . When worn with the " Annulus Qysarus Minor " ring , it transformed incoming spells into healing for the wearer .

title: Annulus Qysarus Minor
description: Annulus Qysarus Minor Annulus Qysarus Minor was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It had the power to store a small number of spells and allow the wearer to cast them as desired . When worn with the " Annulus Qysarus Major " ring , it allowed the wearer to sacrifice some health to achieve greater effectiveness when casting a stored spell .

title: Annunaki
description: Annunaki Annunaki was the ruler of Messemprar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Annunaki was busy with survive from the rebel siege to the royal palace .

title: Annuv
description: Annuv An annuv was either a written symbol or a hand motion that was used among Calishite s to indicate that one ' s proper titles had been left unwritten or unsaid for the sake of brevity . Because the nobility of Calimshan often had a long list of titles before their names , it became a common practice for members of the same or higher class to dispense with naming the titles , instead offering proper respect by using the " annuv " . The " annuv " was correctly performed using only the left hand .

title: Anointed knight
description: Anointed knight Anointed knights were holy warriors who used alchemical secrets to become formidable combatants . Powers . Wielding an ancestral weapon , they searched for obscure lore , consulted historians and alchemists , and communed with the powers of good .

title: Anok - Imaskar
description: Anok - Imaskar Anok - Imaskar was one of the three successor states of Imaskar after the Empire ' s fall , the others being Deep Imaskar and Solon . Geography . At its height , Anok - Imaskar stretched from the Celestial Sea to the Segara Sea ( a large portion of what was later Shou Lung and T ' u Lung ) .

title: Anomen Delryn
description: Anomen Delryn Anomen Delryn was a human fighter and cleric , and a squire in the Most Noble Order of the Radiant Heart . Personality . Anomen ' s first impression was of someone insufferably vain who constantly bragged about battles he ' d most likely never fought .

title: Ansel Burwyth
description: Ansel Burwyth Ansel Burwyth , also called the Master of Gems , was a skilled wizard who lived during the 4th century DR in Mulhorand . History . Ansel was hired in 326 DR , along with many other mages , by the ruling bodies of Tashalar to rid them of Magister Onsilur Maerdrathom who had become quite a nuisance to their way of life .

title: Ansi
description: Ansi Ansi , meaning West Protecting Fortress , was a small town located in the northern regions of the Quoya Desert within the Hordelands around 1359 DR . Description . The small town of Ansi was little more than a fortified inn built near an oasis of bitter water .

title: Ansilber Klauthaudra
description: Ansilber Klauthaudra Ansilber Klauthaudra was once the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar until his untimely and premeditated death just after winter had arrived in the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR . Description . Ansilber was a corpulent man with droopy features that made it look like he was half asleep most of the time .

title: Ansong
description: Ansong Ansong was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Ansong lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo .

title: Ansrivarr
description: Ansrivarr Ansrivarr was a large heavy - hafted greatsword , one of the six Cormyrean Swords of State , that originally belonged to Mondar Bleth . Its name is the elvish word for " memory " . After Mondar ' s death , the sword was taken by Faerlthann Obarskyr .

title: Anstruth harp
description: Anstruth harp An Anstruth harp was a masterwork magical harp and an Instrument of the Bards . Description . An " Anstruth harp " was slender and graceful of design , small and light enough to be played in one ' s lap .

title: Antatlab of the Shaking Stones
description: Antatlab of the Shaking Stones Antatlab of the Shaking Stones was the head of the College of Elemental Magic , the College that gathered all wizards with the most exotic specializations , and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . Rumors said Antatlab was a secret worshiper of Vhaeraun .

title: Antethriss
description: Antethriss Antethriss was a female Netherese shadovar and an assassin and duchess in 1480 DR . History . Antethriss was once a personal assassin of the Prince of Shade Clariburnus Tanthul .

title: Anth - Malar
description: Anth - Malar Anth - Malar was the Chosen of Malar and leader of the Furious Hunt lycanthrope cult . Appearance . Though a pure - blooded human , anth - Malar had the aspect of a furry humanoid beast with hooked claws .

title: Anthan Narlgold
description: Anthan Narlgold Anthan Narlgold was a half - dwarven warrior of Clan Narlgold . Personality . Anthan was a heroic and fearless warrior .

title: Anthara Shalymarr
description: Anthara Shalymarr Anthara " Softangles " Shalymarr was a Mulhorand i woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a former thief and later a tavern keeper and proprietress of the Scarlet Sheath tavern . Description & Personality .

title: Anthilar
description: Anthilar Anthilar was a lich of Tashalar . History . Antilar was one of the main leaders of Untisczer in Lapaliiya in 285 DR but managed to survive his city ' s destruction at the hands of the Shoon Imperium by relocating to a secret lair in the mountains west of the Tashan Gap .

title: Anthraxus
description: Anthraxus Master of Khin - Oin and nominal ruler of the Blood Rift , Anthraxus the Decayed ( æn - THRAK - sus ) commands considerable power and authority . To the demon s of the rift and the Wasting Tower , he is the Lord of Misery and Despair , worshiped in fear and revered as a god . Anthraxus appears as a gaunt , ghoulish creature draped in moldering gray robes .

title: Anthrus Strongarms
description: Anthrus Strongarms King Anthrus Strongarms was the ruler of the dwarves of Ironfang Keep in Turmish , and had been so for over half a century by 1370 DR . A veteran of the Campaign of Darkness , King Strongarms was as a result very untrusting of the duergar , even more so than he was of human s .

title: Antilife shell
description: Antilife shell Antilife shell , also known as anti - animal shell , was an abjuration spell that produced a hemispherical barrier that was impermeable to most types of living creatures . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius hemisphere centered on the caster and lasted almost two hours at a minimum ( longer for higher level casters ) .

title: Antimagic field
description: Antimagic field Antimagic field , also known as anti - magic shell , was an abjuration spell that nullified all magic within a sphere . Effect . The caster created a 10 - foot - wide ( 3 meters ) sphere around them that removed all magical forces inside .

title: Antimineral shell
description: Antimineral shell Antimineral shell was an abjuration spell that created a barrier of force that prevented all manner of elemental creatures and animated elements from entering the zone of effect . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius hemisphere centered on the caster .

title: Antipathy
description: Antipathy Antipathy is an enchantment spell repels certain creatures from an object or location . Effect . You cause an object or location to emanate magical vibrations that repel either a specific type of intelligent creature or creatures of a particular alignment , as defined by you .

title: Antiplant shell
description: Antiplant shell Antiplant shell was an abjuration spell that protected the caster and all creatures within a short distance from animated plants and plant creatures . Effects . This spell created an invisible barrier at a radius from the caster than moved as the caster moved .

title: Antivermin barrier
description: Antivermin barrier Antivermin barrier was an abjuration spell that warded a large area against small , non - magical creatures . Effects . This spell created a protected area and prevented entry by all manner of small vermin , i .

title: Anton Marivaldi
description: Anton Marivaldi Anton Marivaldi was a male pirate from Turmish in the Sea of Fallen Stars during the Second Sundering . History . Anton originated from Sapra in Turmish but after some crime he went into exile and became a pirate captain .

title: Antrysn Barriath
description: Antrysn Barriath Antrysn Barriath was a " zekyl " ( " half - shadow - dragon drow " ) and the Anointed Blade of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Personality . Antrysn had a nasty temper and a penchant for sadism .

title: Anusha Marhana
description: Anusha Marhana Anusha Marhana was the spoiled daughter of the Marhana merchant family . History . In 1396 DR , she was lost within the dreams of the Eldest in her dream form , where she met Yeva .

title: Anwae Mavin
description: Anwae Mavin Anwae Mavin was a half – song dragon half – moon elf monk sorcerer , and the leader of the Sisterhood of Essembra in 1374 DR . Background . She was the granddaughter of the song dragon Essembramaerytha .

title: Anwar Tulam
description: Anwar Tulam Anwar Tulam was an elven corsair and captain of the pirate vessel the " Reaver " in 1367 DR . His banner was a flying pair of crossed cutlass es . Personality .

title: Anwar al - Makruh
description: Anwar al - Makruh Anwar al - Makruh was a sha ' ir who lived in Medina al - Afyal on the island of Afyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Anwar ran an impressive spy network within Afyal and beyond .

title: Anwar al - Sifr
description: Anwar al - Sifr Anwar al - Sifr was the Cipher of Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Anwar al - Sifr was secretly a holy slayer who protected their interests in Liham , sometimes through the use of well - planned attacks where he would plant messages before making his escape .

title: Anyo
description: Anyo Anyo was a very old chiang lung in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Anyo was the ultimate loremaster of the Fochu Peninsula : all seekers of knowledge tried to find her lair to gain the rarest information .

title: Anyspell
description: Anyspell Anyspell was a transmutation spell that allowed a spell domain cleric to cast an arcane spell of up to . Effect . Anyspell allowed the caster to read and prepare any arcane spell of up to 2nd level .

title: Ao
description: Ao Lord Ao ( " AY " - oh ) was the Overgod of the worlds of Abeir - Toril . As Overgod , all deities and primordial s of Toril , even those who also operated in other spheres and planes such as Lolth , were subject to him . To be more precise , only aspects of gods directly connected with Abeir - Toril were under Ao ' s power .

title: Aosinin Truesilver
description: Aosinin Truesilver Aosinin Truesilver was a member of the Truesilver noble house of Cormyr and the cousin of King Galaghard III . Background . Aosinin fought in the Battle with the Witch Lords in 900 DR alongside King Galaghard III and Thanderahast .

title: Aoth Fezim
description: Aoth Fezim Aoth Fezim is a warmage and leader of the Brotherhood of the Griffon . He was formerly captain of the Griffon Legion of Pyarados . Aoth is spell - touched and hasn ' t aged since the Spellplague .

title: Aphras Tirin
description: Aphras Tirin Aphras Tirin was a drow merchant in Mantol - Derith . Relationship . the drow tried to approach Zarell Tahaladar numerous times in order to buy her spellbooks , but she would not collaborate .

title: Aphrunn Mountains
description: Aphrunn Mountains The Aphrunn Mountains were a mountain range forming the southern border of the republic of Turmish in the Vilhon Reach . The range was famous for Mount Kolimnis , a volcano that destroyed the city of Gildenglade in 1423 DR . The gold dragon Frizzerfraz made his home in these mountains .

title: Apostle of peace
description: Apostle of peace Apostles of peace are an unusual breed , forswearing violence and material possessions in favor of using their life to promote peace and nonviolent resolutions to conflict . An apostle possesses powerful access to divine magic , but his spells are aimed at healing , calming hostilities , and aiding allies . Background .

title: Applebane
description: Applebane A small steel dagger with a shadowtop handle , Applebane was once owned by the halfling thief Peliwen Redgrass . Peliwen was a kind but morose individual who spent most of his time sitting in a large rocking chair that he took with him on adventures . Before important adventures , he would just sit in his rocking chair and eat apples with the aid of his dagger Peliwen ' s blade was so rarely used for combat that his comrades starting calling it " Applebane " .

title: Appointments with the Mighty
description: Appointments with the Mighty Appointments with the Mighty was a shop located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Appointments with the Mighty could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Apsel
description: Apsel Apsel was a scrimshawer in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The older man dressed in dull grey clothing .

title: Aquatic elf
description: Aquatic elf Aquatic elves ( also called sea elves and Alu ' Tel ' Quessir in their own tongue ) , are water - breathing cousins to land - dwelling elves . They live amid the waves and the ocean depths with allies such as dolphins and whales . Aquatic elves fight underwater with trident s , spears , and nets .

title: Aquatic longbow
description: Aquatic longbow An aquatic longbow is an underwater version of a longbow that is favored by aquatic elves . It typically weighs 3 lb ( 1 . 4 kg ) and costs 400 gp , with a kelp string to dampen vibration .

title: Aquessir
description: Aquessir Aquessir , also known as Shadowtop Borough , was a floating city of Netheril . Noted for its inhabitants ' friendly disposition towards outsiders , as well as being the original home of the malevolent " Crown of Horns " , Aquessir was destroyed in −342 DR when the city ' s " mythallar " failed . Geography .

title: Ar - Rabi
description: Ar - Rabi Sheik Ar - Rabi was a bandit leader during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ar - Rabi was the leader of the bandit group known as the Desert Wind .

title: Ara bint Cala
description: Ara bint Cala Ara bint Cala was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Ara was a pilot who helped safely guide incoming ships through the treacherous coral maze of Chaos Bay .

title: Araag Dyrr
description: Araag Dyrr Araag Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Araag graduated from Sorcere at an unknown time .

title: Araband Tymin
description: Araband Tymin Araband Tymin was a commander in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Araband was the commander of the military forces of the city of Timindar , which was ruled by his father , Reland Tymin .

title: Arabel
description: Arabel Arabel was a fortified city in northern Cormyr . The city stood at an important crossroads and was a major trade center . Etymology .

title: Arabellan Cheddar
description: Arabellan Cheddar Arabellan Cheddar was a cheese crafted in Arabel . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Arabellan Dry
description: Arabellan Dry Arabellan Dry was a wine exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This fine red wine was best served at cellar temperature .

title: Arabeth Raurym
description: Arabeth Raurym Arabeth Raurym was a female human sorcerer , an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the South Tower . She was responsible for the Brotherhood ' s operations in the southern quadrant of Faerûn . She was also the eldest daughter of Elastul Raurym , Marchion of Mirabar .

title: Arach - Tinilith
description: Arach - Tinilith Arach - Tinilith was the clerical school in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Like the rest of the Academy , it was located in Tier Breche . Structure .

title: Arachhar Sevenstar
description: Arachhar Sevenstar Arachhar Sevenstar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Arachhar was a genius boy from Yhaunn , known for his talent in creating new spells and his frequent episodes of insanity .

title: Arachnomancer
description: Arachnomancer The Arachnomancer is a prestige class of the Underdark that focuses on the strength and power of spider s . Relations . Because of the worship of Lolth among the Drow , an Arachnomancer can expect good reception within the majority of drow society .

title: Araevin Teshurr
description: Araevin Teshurr Araevin Teshurr is a sun elf . His home has been Tower Reilloch for the last eighty years . Relatives .

title: Aragath Taltar
description: Aragath Taltar Aragath Taltar was a evil lich - like undead in Turmish in 1370 DR . History . Aragath was a priest of Talos in the smugglers ' city of Jathrin ' s Jump .

title: Arahnar
description: Arahnar Arahnar is a female human werewolf . She was found injured in human form by Kharran Fel , who nursed her back to health and they began a relationship . She does not remember who caused these injuries , how she got separated from her pack , or much about her pack , but she is determined to find them again .

title: Arakon
description: Arakon Arakon was an archmage who attacked the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale with a band of mercenaries . History . The archmage fought the tribes of the Uthgardt and Reghedmen , but when his army appeared to have been beaten , Arakon opened a portal to the Lower Planes .

title: Araldyk
description: Araldyk Araldyk was a helmed horror directly under the control of the mage , Yather Indaglol . Personality . Being a mindless helmed horror under control of a wizard , Araldyk was silent , attentive , and menacing .

title: Aralent
description: Aralent Aralent was a settlement in the Deepwing Mountains in the Vilhon Reach . It was the site of the House of the Harmed temple of Ilmater , and home to the well - respected priest Master Sufferer Olbedan . History .

title: Araman
description: Araman Araman ( also known as Eveshi and Ahrraman ) was a priest of the former god of the dead , Myrkul , who lived in Mulsantir and was later a Red Wizard of Thay . History . He , along with his brother Akachi , was offered as a " sacrifice " and he was given the name " Eveshi " .

title: Arambar
description: Arambar Arambar was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s before the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Appareance . Arambar was a gigantic primordial with the size of a mountain and a vaguely humanoid form .

title: Arambar ( energy )
description: Arambar ( energy ) Arambar was a kind of ambient energy that enveloped the atmosphere of the world of Abeir , changing the color of the sky from blue to steel - colored . Abeirans called this phenomenon the " Steelsky " . Uses .

title: Arambarium
description: Arambarium Arambarium was an extremely rare metal that resembled polished silver . It was tuned to primordial and elemental energy and could amplify magic al effects . It also had mundane uses such as in armor .

title: Aran Linvail
description: Aran Linvail Aran Linvail is the name of two distinctly different characters that play a very broadly similar role in the and versions of " Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn " . The novel . Aran Linvail was an assassin who was killed by Abdel Adrian .

title: Aranea
description: Aranea The araneas ( sometimes called " werespiders " ) were a magical race of sentient , shape - changing spider - like creatures inhabiting the Spider Swamp in Calimshan . Description . While they were not true lycanthropes , aranea could transform between the appearance of a humanoid and a giant monstrous spider .

title: Araneth Idogyr
description: Araneth Idogyr Araneth Idogyr was a half - elven former adventurer who later ran the Hills ' Cheer Distillery & Brewery in the Shalanar Barony of Erlkazar . He was the half - brother of the famous Tethyr ian mage Gamalon Idogyr . Activities .

title: Aranghthal
description: Aranghthal Aranghthal was a dragonborn settlement in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Aranghthal was one of the two " mobile " settlements the Relmorn dragonborn always maintained near the city of Rokthorl .

title: Arangor Obarskyr
description: Arangor Obarskyr Arangor Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr and the father of Azoun II . He was on the throne in 1018 DR . Relatives .

title: Arash bint Sanjar
description: Arash bint Sanjar Arash bint Sanjar was a Grand Caliph of Zakhara , ruling from the Enlightened Throne in the mid – 7th century DR . He was the daughter of Sanjar . History .

title: Arashta Tharbrow
description: Arashta Tharbrow Arashta Tharbrow was a Zhentarim sorceress in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , just after the start of the Time of Troubles , Arashta was in Daggerdale with the mission to kill Randal Morn .

title: Arathane
description: Arathane Queen Arathane was a stormsoul genasi and the ruler of Akanûl in 1479 DR . Appearance . Arathane was a stunningly beautiful genasi with lavender skin .

title: Arathluth
description: Arathluth Arathluth was a male malaugrym . Unable to fly in air , he disliked winged shapes ; having no magic power of his own , he collected magic item s to empower him . He was believed to reside in Amn impersonating a human merchant ; known aliases included " Ulstult " and " Imbar " .

title: Araugauthos
description: Araugauthos Araugauthos ( The Bluetalon ) is an old blue dragon that was imprisoned in the ruins of Undermountain by Halaster Blackcloak . She later escaped from imprisonment . Background .

title: Araumycos
description: Araumycos Araumycos ( Dwarvish for “ Great Fungus ” ) was an enormous fungal growth that lived in the Upper Northdark and lay beneath the High Forest between the cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad . Description . Araumycos a huge life form , a single organism that covered almost all the parts of the Underdark beneath the High Forest , beginning at a depth of one mile ( 1 .

title: Araundor
description: Araundor Araundor was a wizard from Mulhorand , who became a lich and went to live in a small refuge in the Underdark . History . A long time before 1372 DR , Araundor was once a wizard in Mulhorand .

title: Araundras Othaun
description: Araundras Othaun Araundras Othaun was a Chosen of Mystryl in ancient Netheril . History . In the time of Netheril , Araundras was a Chosen of Mystryl .

title: Arauntan of Selgaunt
description: Arauntan of Selgaunt Arauntan of Selgaunt ( the Wandering Wizard ) was a wizard from Selgaunt . He is notable because in 1351 DR , he recalled that three brothers in Harrowdale had dramatically changed their appearance . History .

title: Arauthator
description: Arauthator Arauthator was a white dragon who lived under Lonefang Mountain in the Spine of the World in the Endless Ice Sea . History . Arauthator was among the dozen or so dragons that attacked the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan because of Sammaster ' s Rage of Dragons in 1373 DR .

title: Aravilar Moondown
description: Aravilar Moondown Aravilar Moondown was a new Knight of the Weave from Halruaa in 1374 DR . He was tasked with the mission of finding and stopping a potion - peddler who sold magic items corrupted by the Shadow Weave . Aravilar was confident in himself to the point of being arrogance .

title: Arcadia
description: Arcadia Arcadia ( ar - KAY - dee - a ) was the Outer Plane representing alignments between lawful neutral and lawful good in the Great Wheel cosmology model . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Dwarfhome , House of the Triad , and even Dweomerheart when that cosmology became popular . Dwarfhome and the House of the Triad ( which became known as Celestia ) survived the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology .

title: Arcana domain
description: Arcana domain The arcana domain , or magic domain as it is sometimes called , ( not to be confused with the spell domain ) is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters prayer s connected to the power of the arcane . They may , as part of their training , gain the ability to use wizard ly implement s such as scrolls , wand s , and rod s . Deities with the Arcana domain .

title: Arcanabula
description: Arcanabula An Arcanabula , sometimes known as an " orizon " , is the term used for a wizard ’ s working spellbook ; often a hodgepodge of spells ( including some that were unusable by the author ) and research notes for both the completed spells therein and for spell concepts still in progress . An arcanabula differs in concept from a " travelling spellbook " in that the latter is generally a distilled copy of one or more arcanabulae , lacking the research notes for the sake of compactness , though most travelling spellbooks with blank pages remaining almost inevitably become aracanabulae . Appearance .

title: Arcanaloth
description: Arcanaloth The arcanaloths were the record keepers of yugoloths . All transactions for services rendered in the Blood War went through them . As yugoloths go , they were a civilized breed .

title: Arcanamach
description: Arcanamach Known as the Suel arcanamachs on Oerth , the arcanamachs of Toril can be associated with the elite warrior - mage traditions of Netheril , Imaskar , or even Jhaamdath or Mulhorand . These empires were known for the great and terrible power wielded by their archmages ( technically , Jhaamdath was known for psionicist s instead ) , and so elite schools of combat training were necessary to fight the dangerous magic of an archmage ' s rivals . The arcanamach , then , is an elite guard serving archmage masters , serving the greatest wizards of their empire with both sword and spell .

title: Arcane Brotherhood
description: Arcane Brotherhood The Arcane Brotherhood is a mercantile company and wizard s ' guild that operated out of the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan . The organization was shrouded in mystery , as even its most high - ranking members were unknown . It is known however that their primary goal was the political and economic control of the North .

title: Arcane Power
description: Arcane Power Contents . " Arcane Power " is a 4th edition " Dungeons & Dragons " sourcebook intended as supplementary rules for players playing as characters using the arcane power source , such as wizards or warlocks . It covers all of the officially released classes of the arcane power source , including swordmages , to that point but not later released ones , such as the artificer class .

title: Arcane archer
description: Arcane archer The arcane archer is a prestige class whose members mix archery with magic , making them fearsome combatants . Abilities . Enhance Arrow Upon firing a mundane arrow it becomes enhanced .

title: Arcane devotee
description: Arcane devotee Arcane devotee is a prestige class on Faerûn comprised of arcane spellcaster s dedicated to the deity they worship . Usually they expand their studies into divine magic and acquire lesser divine - related abilities . Arcane devotees often work for the respective church of their deity and are among their most respected members .

title: Arcane eye
description: Arcane eye Arcane eye was an arcane divination spell that allowed its caster to spy on things from a distance . Effects . The spell would create an invisible floating eye , which would give a mental image to the caster whenever it was dark and within 30 feet .

title: Arcane gate
description: Arcane gate Arcane gate was an arcane conjuration spell that created a portal between two points . Effects . The caster picked two spots that they could see , the first within 10 feet ( 3 meters ) and the other within 500 feet ( 152 meters ) , and a portal would be created between the two .

title: Arcane lock
description: Arcane lock Arcane lock , also known as wizard lock , was an arcane abjuration ( formerly alteration ) spell that allowed the caster to lock closed entryways . Effect . By touching a closed door , window , gate or other entryway , the caster would lock it .

title: Arcane magic
description: Arcane magic Arcane magic ( the Art ) is the direct manipulation of energy . Arcane magic is created out of manipulation of the Weave . Anyone who can fully duplicate the gestures and sounds required of each spell can use arcane magic .

title: Arcane scholar of Candlekeep
description: Arcane scholar of Candlekeep Arcane scholars of Candlekeep seek to raise the study of magic to the level of an academic discipline . Their interest is not in researching new spells or finding more specialized uses for their craft , but in understanding the fundamental processes of magic and the inner workings of the Weave , which is the fabric that underlies all magic . The arcane scholar class was created in - house by Obsidian Entertainment for " " .

title: Arcane trickster
description: Arcane trickster Arcane trickster was a prestige class that combined arcane spellcasting ability with stealth . Culture . Arcane tricksters tended to prepare for any eventuality and then winged it , relying on their stealthiness to sneak in and use their spells to maximum advantage , then get away quickly .

title: Arcane wellspring
description: Arcane wellspring An arcane wellspring is a sorcerer for whom the wielding of arcane magic comes even more easily , almost instinctively than it does for even other sorcerers . When an arcane wellspring unleashes its power , it does not flow , but rather erupts , bellowing forth from them like an arcane geyser . To an arcane wellspring , magic is less a stream of power they let flow through them than a part of their very being , as much as their flesh or blood .

title: Arcanist
description: Arcanist Arcanists were Netherese individuals who wielded arcane magic in the days of the first Netherese Empire . The title " arcanist " was synonymous with the more modern word " wizard . " Culture .

title: Arcata
description: Arcata The duchy of Arcata was found in Damara . History . The start of the Bloodstone Wars was marked by a conflict between Arcata and the neighbouring Barony of Bloodstone , in which Duke William Horgath attempted to seize bloodstone mines in the barony ' s territory .

title: Arch Wood
description: Arch Wood Arch Wood was a forest on the northern border of Archendale . Geography . Throughout history , the majority of the forest was never been logged .

title: Arch of Goolgog
description: Arch of Goolgog The Arch of Goolgog was an orc - made monumental arch in the Vast . It held a " portal " to the Battle of Bones in the Western Heartlands . History .

title: Archdevil
description: Archdevil The archdevils are the rulers of the Nine Hells . They are also called the Lords of the Nine , the Archdukes of Hell , and the Lords of Hell . They each control one of the plane ' s nine layers and are the most powerful and highest - ranking devil s .

title: Archfey
description: Archfey Archfey were fey beings who gained great power and established a position of preeminence among fey - kind . Each archfey had a unique appearance and set of abilities . Most controlled a portion of the Feywild and had self - proclaimed titles .

title: Archfey patron
description: Archfey patron An archfey patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and one of the archfey , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots .

title: Archfiend
description: Archfiend An Archfiend is a particularly powerful fiend , usually a creature that rules over one of the fiendish planes or has a fiendish army at their disposal . There are 10 Archdukes of Hell , an unknown number of Baernoloths and possibly an infinite number of Abyssal Lords , though only 10 really worth noting . Abyssal Lords .

title: Archipelago of Altumbel
description: Archipelago of Altumbel The Archipelago of Altumbel was a collection of islands off the coast of Altumbel , on the Sea of Fallen Stars . The islands were composed of coral and rock , and primarily contained fishing villages . There were numerous wizard towers on the islands , some of which were disused and some of which were still in use .

title: Architect genie
description: Architect genie Architect genies , also called builder genies , were special tasked genie s who were common in the Great Dismal Delve . They were also bound by sha ’ ir s in Zakhara to serve princes and lords . These genies were once dao but changed over time to suit their tasks .

title: Archive of Curiosities
description: Archive of Curiosities The Archive of Curiosities was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Unique gifts presented to the Grand Caliph and other treasures were displayed here for the public to see .

title: Archivist
description: Archivist The Archivist is a powerful divine spellcaster class . However , its method of spellcasting is more akin to that of a wizard than a cleric . It is a class representing the academic profession of collecting divine lore .

title: Archlich
description: Archlich Archliches were a type of lich that were good beings during their life . They can be of any type of spellcaster and devote their existence to whatever noble purpose motivated their transformation into lichdom . Basics .

title: Archmage
description: Archmage Archmage is a prestige class in Faerûn whose members are arcane magic users who have become experts at manipulating and altering their spell s often in strange ways . Most archmages are pure wizard s or sorcerer s , rarely multiclassing , so they may become masters in their study of magic . More generally , the term " archmage " may refer to any extremely powerful spellcaster such as Elminster Aumar or Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun .

title: Archmage ( novel )
description: Archmage ( novel ) Archmage by R . A . Salvatore is the first book of the Homecoming series , which follows the Companions Codex series .

title: Archmage of Menzoberranzan
description: Archmage of Menzoberranzan The Archmage of Menzoberranzan was a title for the head of Sorcere in the fabled drow city . Activities . His role was to advise and serve the ruling Council , especially in devising magics for the defense of the city , and to help the inhabitants of the city keep track of time in the lightless Underdark by casting a lingering heat enchantment on Narbondel .

title: Archtassel
description: Archtassel Archtassel was an unwalled " tassel " ( outsiders would call it a village ) of Tasseldale . Trade . Woodcutting and trapping were the usual trades in Archtassel .

title: Archwizard
description: Archwizard An archwizard was an arcane spellcaster . The first archwizard was Ioulaum of Netheril , who achieved this status when he created the first flying city in Faerûn , Xinlenal , through the use of a mythallar , another of Ioulaum ' s creations . The moment Xinlenal was afloat , every Netherese arcanist of sufficient power strove to make their own .

title: Arclath Delcastle
description: Arclath Delcastle Arclath Delcastle was a noble in Suzail and the heir of House Delcastle . He was sometimes referred to derisively as the " Fragrant Flower of House Delcastle " , owing to his family ' s penchant for floral designs in their mansion . History .

title: Arcorar
description: Arcorar Arcorar , also known as the Great King Forest , was a large forest region that at one time included the realms / domains of Rystall Wood , Cormanthyr , Elven Court , Jhyrennstar , Semberholme and Uvaeren . Geography . At its largest extent , Arcorar stretched from west of Cormyr to east of the Moonsea .

title: Arctic circle
description: Arctic circle The arctic circle was a druid circle associated with the cold climate where glaciers formed and winters were harsh . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a climate had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Arctic dwarf
description: Arctic dwarf Arctic dwarves , also known as Inugaakalikurit ( EE - nu - GA - ka - LEE - ku - rit ) , are a race of dwarves located in the isolated reaches of the Great Glacier in Faerûn ' s northernmost reaches . Arctic dwarves have a different origin than most of the other dwarves in Faerûn as well as the duergar , and are significantly different physiologically and culturally from other members of the Stout Folk , so much that they might be considered their own race . Arctic dwarves were almost entirely unheard of until relatively recent , when a group of them began settling the edges of Luruar a century ago .

title: Arctigis
description: Arctigis Arctigis was a white dragon servant of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR . History . Zhengyi subdued Arctigis centuries ago when the wizard was still a living being .

title: Arcturia
description: Arcturia Arcturia was a female half - fey human worm that walks and one of Halaster Blackcloak ' s apprentices , who were collectively known as the Seven . She resided in Arcturiadoom , deep in Undermountain . Description .

title: Ardanac Harpell
description: Ardanac Harpell Ardanac Harpell was the chief family elder of the Harpell family and spokesman for the town of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Personality . The son of Adanac Harpell , Ardanac was the only Harpell who could deal with the stress and headaches of the local politics or the doings of the world around them .

title: Ardeep ( realm )
description: Ardeep ( realm ) Ardeep was a realm of moon elves , founded during the First Flowering around - 23600 DR . Geography . The realm of Ardeep encompassed the area later known as the Ardeep Forest as well as lands north of the River Delimbiyr .

title: Ardeep Forest
description: Ardeep Forest The Ardeep Forest , also known as the Realm of the Deepening Moon and Faraway Forest , was a relatively small but thick woodland of blueleaf , duskwood and weirwood trees a few miles east of Waterdeep , on the south bank of the River Dessarin . Geography . Ardeep Forest contained a lot of ridges and steep gullies that were hidden beneath thick vines , dense shrubbery and cloaked in mists which could present a danger .

title: Ardeep River
description: Ardeep River The Ardeep River was a river in the Sword Coast North region , a few miles southeast of Waterdeep , between the River Dessarin and the River Delimbiyr . Geography . The river originated in the Ardeep Forest and flowed westward to the Sea of Swords , where it forked into three branches forming a small delta .

title: Ardenor Crush
description: Ardenor Crush Ardenor Crush was a reincarnated evil human fighter who appeared in the body of a hobgoblin . History . Crush was the founder of the Chill , a military organization for the purposes of gaining revenge on those who originally slew Ardenor .

title: Ardet Peytir
description: Ardet Peytir Ardet Peytir was a young socialite in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Ardet was one of the main opponents of the Liberators led by Aleyd Burral , saying that Mulmaster did not need a war against Phlan and could use those men in better ways .

title: Ardred Briferhew
description: Ardred Briferhew Ardred Briferhew was a veteran caravan master just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Activities . Ardred worked for the High Road Charter Company with the role of managing the caravan traffic to points north of the city .

title: Ardreyth Mizzrym
description: Ardreyth Mizzrym Ardreyth Mizzrym was a drow woman and a former Matron Mother of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . One day during a hunt , she happened to swat a wingless wonder out of her way when it suddenly snarled and created a " meteor swarm " , obliterating her and most of her family in the area . As the dust cleared , the merely blackened wonder sighed and waddled away , as the remaining drow looked on in shock .

title: Ardulace Despana
description: Ardulace Despana Matron Mother Ardulace was a powerful drow cleric and the head of the Ust Natha branch of house Despana . She formed an alliance with Jon Irenicus with the intent of attacking the elves of Suldanessellar . Using the eggs of the silver dragon Adalon given to her by Irenicus , she was to buy the services of a powerful demon to lead the attack .

title: Ardulrae Melarn
description: Ardulrae Melarn Ardulrae Melarn was a member of House Melarn and Matron of Scriptures of Arach - Tinilith in 1479 DR . History . Ardulrae was the third daughter of Kyrnill Melarn and thanks to the strength of the new House Melarn she rose through the ranks of the Arach - Tinilith instructors .

title: Arellaxerrontoal
description: Arellaxerrontoal Arellaxerrontoal was an bronze dragon living in Forest of Tethir and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Amn and Tethyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Arellaxerrontoal was a bronze dragon living in Forest of Tethir in her mate in the past ; at one point the blue dragon great wyrm Iryklathagra killed her mate .

title: Arena of Blood
description: Arena of Blood The infamous Arenas of Blood , also known as the Blood Arenas , were a pair of identical gladiatorial arenas located in the city of Manshaka in Calimshan . Location . One of the Arenas was located in the northeastern drudach of the northwestern sabban of the city ; the other was found in the southern drudach ( south of Drudach Street ) of the northeastern sabban .

title: Arena of War ( game )
description: Arena of War ( game ) Dungeons & Dragons : Arena of War is a video game , an application for various pad and tablet devices . It is a supplement to the Second Sundering event and you take on the part of a “ Chosen ” of a non specific good deity and struggles to rid the realms of the blight of evil that spreads its influence . The Plot .

title: Arganth Snarrl
description: Arganth Snarrl Arganth Snarrl was an orc shaman for the orc king Obould Many - Arrows . He was kidnapped and then killed by Innovindil in 1370 DR . Appearances .

title: Argath
description: Argath Argath was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . History . Argath was originally a scoundrel from a settlement near Silverymoon .

title: Argent Legion
description: Argent Legion The Argent Legion was the state army of Luruar . Activities . Formed in an attempt to ensure the safety of the smaller settlements of Luruar , the Argent Legion ' s forces were drawn from the various armies maintained by the more powerful city - states of that nation .

title: Argent Palace
description: Argent Palace The Argent Palace was Graz ' zt ' s personal home in the city of Zelatar . Structure . The palace was composed of sixty - six ivory towers and scores and scores of mirrored hallways .

title: Argentor
description: Argentor Argentor was a village of earthsoul genasi located in southern Tethyr within the Mir Spires . Description . The village ' s dwellings were hollowed out from the spires by the genasi using their innate ability to shape rock .

title: Arglander River
description: Arglander River The Arglander River was one of the major sources of the Deepwash . Geography . The river was located within Ahlarkhem Barony in Erlkazar .

title: Arglath
description: Arglath Arglath was a massive elder orb beholder from Ooltul , presumed to be alive in 1370 DR . History . Arglath was a beholder of monstrous size from Ooltul , and one of the mightiest beholders to escape the city ' s destruction .

title: Argrum Blackspear
description: Argrum Blackspear Argrum Blackspear was a bandit leader in Tethyr in 1358 DR who preyed upon the Trade Way . He once clashed with the Company of Eight . He tried to gather all bandit leaders of the area to form an alliance , hoping to also attract the Company of Eight so that he could eliminate them .

title: Argul
description: Argul Argul was a ruined castle located in northern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Argul was built by dragonborn slaves to serve as a lair for the dragon lord Argularragh .

title: Argul Marammas
description: Argul Marammas Argul Marammas was a wizard who lived in Suzail in 1367 DR . Personality . Most people , warriors especially , were little more than lumbering fools who destroyed everything they could get their hands on .

title: Argularragh
description: Argularragh Argularragh was a dragon who lived in the realm of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Argularragh was a massive dragon , even by dragon standards .

title: Argus Treader
description: Argus Treader The Argus Treader was a Gontese merchant ship owned by Captain Madwave of Szant . Background . The " Argus Treader " was one of the few Gontese ships that didn ' t belong to the Twelvefold .

title: Argust Coppernight
description: Argust Coppernight Argust Coppernight was a dwarf in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he went into Undermountain in search of locations for mining .

title: Arhymeria Ithal
description: Arhymeria Ithal Queen Arhymeria Ithal was the wife of King Nishan Ithal II of Tethyr . Description . Arhymeria was an exquisitely beautiful Calishite woman and also a loving and compassionate one .

title: Aria of peace
description: Aria of peace Aria of peace was a powerful enchantment spell used to stop hostile interactions . Effects . This spell created soothing melodies of different instruments within the area of effect around the caster .

title: Ariana
description: Ariana Ariana was a deep gnome merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Ariana was a gem merchant in Gracklstugh .

title: Ariana Riverlost
description: Ariana Riverlost Ariana Riverlost was a wizard member of the Harpers in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Ariana and her two half - elven scout companions Elifar and Lorendil were sent to the Halls of the Hunting Axe in order to stop Gargosh Blusterhelm from reclaiming the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " .

title: Aribeth ' s ring
description: Aribeth ' s ring Aribeth ' s ring was a magical ring that provided its wearer with resistance to spells . It was worth around 50 , 000 gold piece s . This ring was the family heirloom of Aribeth de Tylmarande , an elven paladin of Tyr , but it was lost when she was defeated in combat in Neverwinter in 1372 DR .

title: Aribeth de Tylmarande
description: Aribeth de Tylmarande Lady Aribeth de Tylmarande was a half - elf paladin of Tyr , the Blind God of Justice . Biography . She is said to have been born in Thundertree , a town in the Neverwinter Woods , of uncertain parentage ; some say a union between half - elves , others a moon elf and a human .

title: Ariella Kulmina
description: Ariella Kulmina Ariella Kulmina was a Windsoul genasi swordmage from Airspur . In 1479 DR she travelled with a delegation from Akanûl to Almraiven . While in Almraiven she became friends with the Earthsoul genasi Cephas and taught him how to manifest as a Windsoul .

title: Arietta Seasilver
description: Arietta Seasilver Arietta Seasilver was the daughter of Farninger Seasilver , grand duke of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . She believed herself to be a Chosen of Siamorphe , the goddess of nobility and the patron deity of her family . Activities .

title: Arik Stillmarsh
description: Arik Stillmarsh Arik Stillmarsh was a vampire hid in the Bargewright Inn sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Arik hid in the inn thank of the protection of Nalaskur Thaelond of the Zhentarim .

title: Arilyn ' s moonblade
description: Arilyn ' s moonblade Arilyn ' s moonblade was the hereditary moonblade wielded by Arilyn Moonblade , having been passed to her by her mother , Princess Amnestria of Evermeet . Description . The sword and its hilt appeared antique .

title: Arilyn Moonblade
description: Arilyn Moonblade Arilyn Moonblade was a half - elf assassin and Harper originally from Evereska . Description . Like most half - elves , her ears were pointed and she retained her youthful appearance and vitality even into middle age .

title: Arin el Sujil
description: Arin el Sujil Sultan Arin yn Kahar el Sujil was the official ruler of Memnon in Calimshan in 1370 DR . In truth , the real power lay with his advisers and the pasha s . Personality .

title: Arina
description: Arina Arina was a merfolk princess in Myth Nantar . History . Arina was a member od the merfolk Homurr clan and seven in line of succession to the throne of Eadraal .

title: Ariser Creed
description: Ariser Creed The Ariser Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They sought to dominate the surface world . They believed that the best way to obtain exclusive knowledge was by attacking knowledge storehouses on the surface .

title: Aristocrat
description: Aristocrat " Aristocrat " was a general term for a member of the wealthy and educated upper class . The rulers of most nations , or those holding some other form of political power , were often aristocrats . Training and Education .

title: Ariton Delmis
description: Ariton Delmis Ariton Delmis was a male human paladin and second - in - command of the Freedom Riders in 1369 DR . History . Ariton was a longtime member of the Riders , fighting the Zhentarim together with Randal Morn for a very long time .

title: Arkaiun
description: Arkaiun The Arkaiun were a human ethnic group residing primarily in Dambrath but also in Halruaa and the Shaar . Arkaiun culture was formed through the interbreeding of Nar refugees from Shandaular and Illuskan tribes . As of 1374 DR , the Dambrathan Arkaiuns lived as servitors of the half - drow Crinti .

title: Arkaneus Silvermane
description: Arkaneus Silvermane Arkaneus Silvermane was Archdruid of Mosstone and a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Abilities . Arkaneus knew how to fight with hammer , dagger , and staff .

title: Arkaras
description: Arkaras Arkaras is a very tall bearded man who maintains a fierce expression . He is a shipwright operating out of the eastern side of the harbour at Scornubel , and he maintains the ships that operate in the area , including owning the ferry that crosses from Scornubel to the south bank of the River Chionthar .

title: Arkas
description: Arkas Arkas was a grass found on the fields of the ranchos in Dambrath . Uses . This hearty grass was used as feed for local livestock .

title: Arkhelthingril
description: Arkhelthingril Arkhelthingril ( also known as Ice ) was an old female white dragon who was transformed into a dracolich by the archmage of Maerimydra , Duneth Wharreil . Description . About 20 - ft - long ( 6 m ) , Ice ' s form had not fared well since its transformation into a dracolich and her flesh had rotted to the point where her bones were visible .

title: Arkhen ' s Invocatorium
description: Arkhen ' s Invocatorium Arkhen ' s Invocatorium was a college of magic in Silverymoon that specialized in sorcery . The school was run by Arkhen the Icy , and was part of the Conclave of Silverymoon . The Invocatorium was once situated in a stone fortress on the east side of Silverymoon , but later moved into an entirely new building , filled with animated construct s .

title: Arklem Greeth
description: Arklem Greeth Arklem Greeth was a powerful lich and Archmage Arcane of the Arcane Brotherhood . History . After spending many years attempting to extend his lifespan through the aid of " Wish " spells and other powerful magics his body was eventually wracked with age .

title: Arktash
description: Arktash Arktash was an orc chieftain of the Il - Khan tribe that made its home in the Spine of the World , around the 14th century DR . Personality . While a mighty warrior in their own right , Arktash obtained their position as leader of the Il - Khan tribe through guile , not strength .

title: Arkuel
description: Arkuel Arkuel was a member of the Cult of the Dragon . History . In 1357 , Arkuel was one of the servants of the the Cult ' s archmage , Malark Himbruel , helping his master to enter the Twisted Tower of Ashaba in Shadowdale in order to capture Shandril Shessair .

title: Arlaenga
description: Arlaenga Arlaenga was one of the servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Arlaenga was the head maid for Lord Marsten until , some time before the Tyranny of Dragons , her master was killed and the lodge occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel .

title: Arlen
description: Arlen Arlen was the captain of the guard at Caer Corwell and the teacher of Prince Tristan Kendrick . Description . Arlen was a gruff old war veteran .

title: Arleon
description: Arleon Arleon , also known as Arleon the Unforgiven , was a powerful ogre warlord living in Neverwinter in ancient times . History . Arleon was a powerful warrior who in life killed many strong opponents .

title: Arleosa Starhenge
description: Arleosa Starhenge Arleosa Starhenge was a tavern owner in Amphail sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Born in a wild magic area , Arleosa received the innate power to cast the " alter self " spell three times a day .

title: Arlho ' s Fine Flasks
description: Arlho ' s Fine Flasks Arlho ' s Fine Flasks was an exceptional brewery and winery located in Ashabenford . Location . Situated on the north of the Moonsea Ride as it passed through Ashabenford , Arlho ' s Fine Flasks was one of many shops dotting the route .

title: Arlith
description: Arlith Arlith was a halfling rogue living in Ravens Bluff in 1479 DR . She was a member of an adventuring group known as the Blue Wyvern Company . In a fight , she preferred to use ranged weapons rather than melee attacks and was proficient in the use of the crossbow .

title: Armas
description: Armas Armas was a half - elf sorcerer and a Chosen . Activities . In a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , Armas was one of the associates of Oota .

title: Armor of Agathys
description: Armor of Agathys Armor of Agathys was a complex spell learned and used by young or inexperienced warlock s . Effect . When " Armor of Agathys " is cast , it creates a layer of thick , black ice around the body of its caster , adding to their vitality for several minutes and injuring enemies who draw too near with its frigid power , the deadliness of the ice depending upon the durability of the warlock .

title: Armor of concealed wizardry
description: Armor of concealed wizardry Armors of concealed wizardry were special suits of armor whose enchantments were hidden from magical detection . Shields also fell into this group . These items originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate .

title: Armor of darkness
description: Armor of darkness Armor of darkness was an abjuration spell exclusive to cleric s with the Darkness domain . It armored the subject with shadow . Effect .

title: Armor of swimming
description: Armor of swimming Armor of swimming was a magical armor that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This armor looked like regular lamellar armor .

title: Armor of the desert evening
description: Armor of the desert evening Armor of the desert evening was a magical suit of armor that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magical armor was made using lamellar armor .

title: Armories ( Oryndoll )
description: Armories ( Oryndoll ) The Armories of the illithid city of Oryndoll were located all throughout the city . They stored weapons and armor that were needed to equip an army of thralls . They were heavily guarded in the event of another thrall uprising .

title: Arms of Hadar
description: Arms of Hadar Arms of Hadar was a conjuration spell for warlock s that used the power of Hadar , the Dark Hunger . Effect . At the caster ' s behest , the ground would sprout tendrils of dark energy in a 10 - foot ( 3 meter ) radius .

title: Army of Darkness
description: Army of Darkness The Army of Darkness was a massive force of nearly 60 , 000 yugoloth s , ogre s , gnoll s , goblinoid s and several giant s . They were led by the Trio Nefarious who organized the monsters into tightly regimented battalions , which made it the biggest army ( seeing as a horde , some examples of which rival the Army ' s numbers , has very little structure ) that Faerûn has ever seen . It took twenty - nine months for the army ' s forces to be gathered .

title: Army of Gold
description: Army of Gold The Army of Gold was the name of the expedition of gold dwarves that set out from the Great Rift to reclaim the glory of Deep Shanatar , the lost kingdom of the shield dwarves . History . In the caves of Taark Shanat , the Army of Gold entered into the War of Gold and Gloom with the gray dwarves of the Underspires around 1369 DR .

title: Army of Steel
description: Army of Steel Army of Steel was the name for the duergar army from Underspires that clashed with the Army of Gold in the caverns of Deep Shanatar , the lost kingdom of the shield dwarves . History . In the caves of Taark Shanat , the Army of Steel fought the gold dwarves from the Deep Realm around 1369 DR in the War of Gold and Gloom .

title: Army of the Black Spider
description: Army of the Black Spider The Army of the Black Spider was an army put together by the noble houses of Menzoberranzan to defeat the approaching armies of Gracklstugh ( joined by Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scourged Legion ) in 1372 DR during the Silence of Lolth . Description . The Army of the Black Spider was composed of soldiers from all great houses , as well as sixteen minor ones .

title: Army of the Lion
description: Army of the Lion The Army of the Lion was a subsection of the Aglarond an army stationed at the fortress Emmech ( later Undumor ) and tasked with the defence of the nation against the threat from Thay through the Tannath Gap . In 1374 DR it was led by Lord Gante Demelin . Its battle wizards were led by Canton Karlesad , while the Aglarondan griffonrider s were led by Captain Araevil Darkeye .

title: Arn Forest
description: Arn Forest The Arn Forest was a forest on the edge of the Silver Marches . Description . The Arn Forest was an area of pine forests and swamps , which did not see many visitors .

title: Arnagus
description: Arnagus Arnagus the Shipwright was the wealthiest shipbuilder in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Arnagus was a strong and vital man .

title: Arnglar
description: Arnglar Arnglar is a sleepy hill village in the west of the Border Kingdoms , situated not far from where the River Rith and Tumblestone River originate . It is a windswept site suited to pastoral grazing and the location was once the elven realm of Glorfindral . Arnglarren is the name given to an inhabitant of Arnglar .

title: Arno and Julian
description: Arno and Julian Arno and Julian were the two heads of a single being , the origin of the ettin race . Relatives . Arno and Julian were the two heads of one of Annam All - Father ' s sons .

title: Arphoind Bleth I
description: Arphoind Bleth I Arphoind Bleth was the child of Mondar Bleth and his wife , born in 8 DR or 10 DR . Arphoind was the first man knighted by Faerlthann . Relatives .

title: Arquiuius
description: Arquiuius Arquiuius was a wizard in Thay . History . Arquiuius was a reclusive wizard who took as apprentice the young orphan Halloran .

title: Arrabar
description: Arrabar Arrabar was the capital city of Chondath in the Vilhon Reach . History . By 1372 DR , the empire of Chondath was much shrunken .

title: Arrath Vir
description: Arrath Vir Rath is a dwarven monk who lived in Waterdeep in the late 1470 ' s DR . Rath ' s true name is Arrath Vir but he is known to nearly everyone simply as Rath . He despises dwarven culture and has turned his back on his people and his gods .

title: Arrayan Faylin
description: Arrayan Faylin Arrayan Faylin is a female half - orc wizard living in Palischuk in the northeastern region of Vaasa . Her full name being Arrayan Faylin Maggotsweeper . Appearance .

title: Arren
description: Arren Arren was a male human butler of Lord Temar on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Arren was Lord Temar ' s butler , who assisted him .

title: Arrizz
description: Arrizz Arrizz was a drow elf in the Moonsea . History . Arrizz lived as a member of a drow noble house very far from the Moonsea until he betrayed his house and struck out on his own .

title: Arrk
description: Arrk Arrk was a well - known troll mercenary who operated in the Lake of Steam region in 1372 DR . Personality . While he was smaller than normal trolls , Arrk was a bit more intelligent ( though still possessing a quite short attention span ) and dependable .

title: Arrow
description: Arrow Arrows were a type of projectile , fired by bows . A normal arrow consisted of a shaft with an arrowhead attached to the front end , with fletchings and a nock at the other . Some arrows were enchanted in some way so they could deal larger damage , dispel , blind or silence their target .

title: Arrow catching
description: Arrow catching Arrow catching shield s are useful defensive items , as they provide an added level of protection against ranged weaponry to the wielder and his or her allies . Creation . To enchant a shield with the " arrow catching " property , the enchanter must have the spell " entropic shield " available .

title: Arrow demon
description: Arrow demon Arrow demons were valued tanar ' ri made specifically to fight in the armies of the Abyss . Description . Emaciated but possessing unnatural strength for its frame , an arrow demon ' s body is also completely hairless .

title: Arrowhawk
description: Arrowhawk An arrowhawk was a creature from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Arrowhawks had four wings and four eyes ( one pair on either side of its beak ) .

title: Arsekaslyx
description: Arsekaslyx Arsekaslyx was a red dragon member of the Cult of the Dragon . She was called to the Well of Dragons to reinforce the defense of the Cult ' s stronghold there . Relationship .

title: Artblade
description: Artblade The Artblade ( also known as the Noble Sorcerer ' s Sword , or Ary ' Faern ' Kerym in Elven ) , is one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . This particular blade is used to name the Spell - Major , the Defender by Art , as he is called . The wielder of the Artblade is responsible for the upkeep of magical defenses of the realm , and command of the Akh ' Faer , the arcane arm of the military .

title: Artemis Entreri
description: Artemis Entreri Artemis Entreri ( once known as Barrabus the Gray ) was a ruthless assassin and the former arch - nemesis of Drizzt Do ' Urden . A cunning and tactical assassin , Entreri lived an empty life , devoid of any kind of pleasure , existing only to kill .
