The passage of time caused him to soften his sentiments , but never his fighting edge .

title: Arthagus
description: Arthagus Arthagus , called " Arthagus of the Miracles " , was a mage living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . Arthagus was a skilled invoker who spent much of his time tutoring young spellcasters to fund his extensive research projects .

title: Arthindol
description: Arthindol The Terraseer was originally a powerful ancient sarrukh lord who eventually became a lich and thereby survived the downfall of the ancient progenitor race . He dwelt , ever since , in the ruins of ancient Oreme , rarely interacting with the outside world . Most notably he served as a source of ancient arcane knowledge for the Netherese Empire .

title: Arthus Cavilos
description: Arthus Cavilos Arthus Cavilos was the Lord of Hawk ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Cavilos , a veteran of War of the Silver Marches , raised hippogriff s .

title: Arthylmas
description: Arthylmas Arthylmas was a sage of the city of Saerloon in Sembia of the 13th century DR . History . In the late 13th century DR , Kesten Orthalin of the Grimblades adventuring company had Arthylmas identify a short sword that had come into his possession .

title: Artifact
description: Artifact An artifact was a type of magic item of exceptional power that could not be reproduced using normal magical means . Artifacts created through spiritual means were sometimes called relics . This diverse category included the works of the great civilizations of old , such as Netheril , as well as the many magical creations of deities .

title: Artificer
description: Artificer Artificers are a rare kind of arcane spellcaster who treat magic in the same manner as a mason might see a chisel - as a tool for the creation of marvels . An artificer learns to wield his or her magic through the mastering of sigils and diagrams that they etch into that which they enchant , as well as magical ingredients . Artificers infuse objects of the world , be they inanimate or alive , with the power of the arcane , making them both powerful crafters and healers .

title: Artist genie
description: Artist genie Artist genies were special tasked genie s who were brilliant craftsman and artists capable of creating masterpieces so long as their masters treated them well . Enslaved , charmed , or mistreated artist genies always produced inferior work . Artist genies were once dao and djinn but were reshaped over time .

title: Arton Githsberry
description: Arton Githsberry Arton Githsberry was the ruler of Turmish in 522 DR , whose seat of power was the city of Alaghôn . Activities . When petitioned by a joint delegation of Gulthmere druid s and Xorhun ian elves to cease Turmish ' s logging operations , Githsberry made a show of inviting all his lords to discuss the issue .

title: Artor Morlin
description: Artor Morlin Artor Morlin , also known as the The Baron of Blood , was a vampire Lord who saw Waterdeep as his own personal hunting grounds and brooked no challenges from rival vampires to his domain . Personality . As an immortal creature who had been living in the same place for well over four centuries , Artor had to create several personalities for himself to remain incognito .

title: Artur Grossman
description: Artur Grossman Artus Grossman was the leader of the Rogues of Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . Artus was fighting a cell of Fire Knives installed in Tilverton that had killed his father , the former Guildmaster .

title: Artus Cimber
description: Artus Cimber Artus Cimber was the youngest son of the highwayman known as Shadowhawk . Description . As a young child , Artus was scrawny with dark brown eyes .

title: Aru
description: Aru Aru was a town on the island of Tsukishima , part of the state of Wa in Kara - Tur . By 1357 DR , it was a center of worship of Bishamon , and pilgrims from all over Wa traveled here . Geography .

title: Arun Maerdrym
description: Arun Maerdrym Arun Maerdrym was a half - elf of House Maerdrym from Myth Drannor . He was the father of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Relatives .

title: Arundel
description: Arundel Arundel was the Archdruid of Kuldahar . Physical description . Arundel was an old human male and a druid of unknown power capable of using the Heartstone Gem which only someone with great natural or supernatural power could do .

title: Arunika
description: Arunika The devil Arunika was a succubus and , one of the major players in the struggle to claim Neverwinter from the ashes of the cataclysm which tore the city apart and plunged several factions into contention . History . Working indirectly , Arunika planned to weaken the warring factions of Thay and the Shadovar by playing them off one another until such a time as they were easy picking for the Abolethic Sovereignty .

title: Aruph Thunderfist
description: Aruph Thunderfist Aruph " Red " Thunderfist is a red - haired , burly fence from Luskan . A man who can always get the best deal on just about any item a person could want , Red is well - like and respected all over the city . He can often be found conducting business in a corner booth in the Cutlass , where he ' ll down an endless number of drinks with a near immunity to the effects of intoxication .

title: Arush Ashuak
description: Arush Ashuak Arush Ashuak was a village located on the southern lands of Tymanther , in the green lands near Ash Lake . History . For most of its story , Arush Ashuak was one of the agricultural trade hubs for the dragonborn .

title: Arush Vayem
description: Arush Vayem Arush Vayem was a small , isolated walled village located on the frontier of Tymanther , in an unmapped region of the Smoking Mountains . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p185 " > < / ref > History . Arush Vayem was a remote village unknown to the most people .

title: Arval
description: Arval Arval was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Arval was a servant of the King of Shadows .

title: Arvandor
description: Arvandor Arvandor , sometimes rarely called Arborea , is the second root of the World Tree . It is covered in lush forests , massive mountains , perfectly clear streams , placid lakes , and an ocean called the Sparkling Sea , as befitting of the home of the Seldarine . Each one of the elven patron deities maintains a realm on this plane .

title: Arveiaturace
description: Arveiaturace Arveiaturace was an ancient white dragon who served the wizard Meltharond , who also rode her into battle . Description . The white dragon had scales of powder blue and faded alabaster .

title: Arvik Zaltos
description: Arvik Zaltos Arvik Zaltos was a Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford circa 1485 DR . History . In 1485 DR , Arvik paid the Clotskull orc s to attack the Floshin Estates in order to gain access to an ancient altar to Yan - C - Bin in the family crypts .

title: Arvin
description: Arvin Description . An unremarkable man , Arvin uses his easily forgettable appearance to his advantage , slipping between the cracks of society . He has short , dark hair and wears a clay cat ' s eye bead around his neck .

title: Arvin Kothonos
description: Arvin Kothonos Arvin Kothonos was the Guildmaster of the Merchants ' Guild of Ravens Bluff around 1356 DR . Appearance . Arvin was 5 feet 9 inches ( 1 .

title: Arvoreen
description: Arvoreen Arvoreen , also known as The Defender or The Wary Sword was the closest the halfling s had to a war god , but he was actually the halfling pantheon ' s deity of defense , guardians , and watchers . . Personality .

title: Arxhadk
description: Arxhadk Arxhadk was the morkoth ambassador of Olleth in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . Arxhadk hailed from the Arcanum of Olleth , the morkoth magocracy in the Sea of Fallen Stars . He survived out of the water thanks to a golem - like construct that resembled and had the powers of a massive water elemental , which he dwelt inside .

title: Aryselmalyn calendar
description: Aryselmalyn calendar The Aryselmalyn calendar is an example of how all elven nations marked the passage of time ( and still do in Evereska and Evermeet ) . It was used by the ancient and fallen Aquatic elf nation of Aryselmalyr . Four years marked one " aeloulaev " ( " when peaces meet " in elven ) which ended during the celebration of " Cinnaelos ' Cor " ( " The Day of Corellon ' s Peace " ) and started a new one .

title: Aryvandaar
description: Aryvandaar Known also as the Vyshaantar Empire , Aryvandaar was a sun elf kingdom that fell during the Fifth Crown War . History . First Flowering .

title: Arzastra
description: Arzastra Arzastra was a half - ogre innkeeper and tavern owner in Xantharl ' s Keep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Arzastra managed the Falling Orc inn and tavern .

title: As Seconds Slip Away
description: As Seconds Slip Away Intelligence suggests that the Zhentarim are planning a direct attack on Loudwater in a bid to take control of the Delimbiyr Vale . Scouts are needed to travel into Zhent territory to determine the truth of this report . The second part of the Tides of War mini series .

title: Asabi
description: Asabi Asabis , also known as laerti , were reptilian humanoid s that dwelt in the desert . Nomenclature . " Asabi " was the Bedine word for this creature .

title: Asahi
description: Asahi Asahi was a member of the ninja Kata clan in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Asahi was an expect tactician , always taking the fewest risks .

title: Asala
description: Asala Asala was a priestess of Kiaransalee in Szith Morcane . History . Asala was a young priestess of Kiaransalee under Velasta T ' sarran .

title: Asanta
description: Asanta Asanta was a human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was one of the proprietors of the Wyvern Watch Inn . Relationships .

title: Asbarode
description: Asbarode Asbarode , also known as Nith the Entertainer , was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She was unquestionably loyal to Ashemmi .

title: Asbeel
description: Asbeel Asbeel was a moon elf who was at once blessed and cursed by Tymora and Beshaba to become a sentinel for Tymora that was charged with watching over the Stone of Tymora . Asbeel was to watch the bearers of the stone without interfering , only acting to ensure that upon the death of the current bearer , the stone found its way to the next bearer . At some point during the centuries of watching over the bearers , Asbeel became disenchanted with his role and began interfering , even slaying more than a few of the bearers .

title: Asbravn
description: Asbravn To the travelers eye Asbravn looks like lush farms with wood lots , well - kept barns , drainage ditches and ponds and tranquility Asbravn is the market center of the southern Vale farmers . Rather here they do their trading with each other and traveling merchants then in the cities where others will make a profit from their food . Buyers from Berdusk and Iriaebor come to the market each day .

title: Ascalan
description: Ascalan Ascalan was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a wizard and fishmonger , and owner of The Fish House . Once a wizard , Ascalan retired to become a fishmonger at The Fish House .

title: Ascarle
description: Ascarle Ascarle , the " Sunken City , " was an underwater elven city located off the northern shores of Trisk in the Purple Rocks . Description . The somewhat - ruined buildings and walkways were formed from crystal and red coral .

title: Ascendancy of the Last
description: Ascendancy of the Last Ascendancy of the Last is the third and final novel in The Lady Penitent trilogy by Lisa Smedman . Summary . The end to the Lady Penitent trilogy reveals the epic climax and aftermath of the sava match between Lolth and Eilistraee .

title: Ascension Hall
description: Ascension Hall The Ascension Hall , or the Golden Road , was located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Ivory and alabaster statues flanked the main hallway which was lined with solid gold .

title: Ascore
description: Ascore Ascore in 1374 DR is lonely , windswept ruin on the edge of the Anauroch . In its heyday , in the time of the Netherese Empire , Ascore was a bustling dwarven port city of the nation of Delzoun on the northern shores of the Narrow Sea . Tradegoods from Netheril flowed into Delzoun either via the docks of Ascore or via the Lowroad which connected to Ascore .

title: Asdag
description: Asdag Ruinlord Asdag was the head of internal security and head torturer of the Zhentarim in 1370 DR . Personality . Asdag was a cold and cruel person .

title: Asdefk ' s Inn
description: Asdefk ' s Inn Asdefk ' s Inn was a popular inn and tavern in the capital city of Darromar in Tethyr . It was known for its extremely spicy Calishite and Tashalar an dishes , but was overpriced . The building was located on the west side of Star Street in the Temple Quarter of the city , directly across from the Wheel Market .

title: Asgar Tellendar
description: Asgar Tellendar Asgar Tellendar was a human man and the chief priest of Ilmater of the House of the Suffering God in Asbravn in the late 1360s DR . Personality . Asgar was a devout follower of Ilmater , usually quite serene , and very wise .

title: Asgetrion
description: Asgetrion Asgetrion the Learned was a local sage who lived in Arabel in Cormyr . Activities . He was perhaps the most accomplished expert on the study of gorgon s in all of Cormyr .

title: Asgorath
description: Asgorath Asgorath ( pronounced " AZ - gore - ath " ) , was the dragon god of creation . He ( or she , as some traditions suggested ) was regarded as the creator of the multiverse and of dragonkind , and he manipulated the destinies of all dragons by operating in a way that nobody suspected his involvement . Asgorath was supposed to encompass all alignments , but was often regarded as neutral .

title: Ash ' ala Melarn
description: Ash ' ala Melarn Ash ' ala Melarn was a drow priestess of Menzoberranzan and third daughter of the First Priestess of House Melarn in 1479 DR . Description . Ash ' ala always dressed the robes of her office .

title: Asha Vandree
description: Asha Vandree Asha Vandree was a drow priestess of Lolth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Asha was ambitious enough to dream of ruling the outpost , but not so courageous as to openly challenge Ilvara Mizzrym , also knowing that for a permanent assignment she needed to also impress her superiors in Menzoberranzan .

title: Ashaba
description: Ashaba Ashaba was a water wizard and the first Lord of Shadowdale after driving the drow out of the Twisted Tower in 906 DR . Ashaba ruled Shadowdale for thirty four years until 940 DR . Ashaba created the " Pendant of Ashaba " , to be used to determine the rightful lord of Shadowdale .

title: Ashabenford
description: Ashabenford Ashabenford was the capital and largest settlement of Mistledale . Geography . Composed of rustic homes and collections of cottages , Ashabenford sat on the eastern side of the River Ashaba , though some of its notable buildings were found also on the west bank .

title: Ashaerond
description: Ashaerond Ashaerond was a merchant who lived in Westgate on the Dragon Coast and lived prior to 1369 DR . Ashaerond gave generously to the Church of Ilmater , in case of needing the Ilmatari ' s help one day . Ashaerond explained " If I pay for one extra potion today , it may be the last one tomorrow — but the one needed then to heal me .

title: Ashala
description: Ashala Ashala was a lizardfolk of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp in 1374 DR . History . Ashala was the mate of Kessessek and also a cleric of the forgotten god Essylliss .

title: Ashanath
description: Ashanath Ashanath was an unsettled region of Thesk with rich soil . Description . It was primarily covered with grassland inhabited by ankheg s , bulette s , wild ox en and ponies .

title: Ashdra
description: Ashdra Ashdra was a drow in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Ashdra was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .

title: Ashemmi
description: Ashemmi Ashemmi ( originally Shemmithil Maraphiir ) was a moon elf wizard and the lover and consort of the wizard Sememmon . Appearance . Ashemmi had flaxen hair and gold eyes , which went some way to explain the regular confusion over her true race , since these traits are rare in moon elves ( she had claimed to be a moon elf around 1372 DR ) .

title: Ashemmon
description: Ashemmon Ashemmon , also called Ashemmon of Rhymanthiin , was a half - elf sorcerer of Rhymanthiin and the fifth Blackstaff of Waterdeep . Description . Ashemmon wore no beard and had blond hair nearly to the ground .

title: Ashenford Torinbow
description: Ashenford Torinbow Ashenford Torinbow was a druid and a member of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave and a follower of Silvanus during the Second Sundering . History . Early in his life he was a Harper in Dalelands until 1328 DR when was captured and tortured by the Zhentarim .

title: Ashenwood
description: Ashenwood The Ashenwood was a wild evergreen forest in Rashemen known for its large number of fey inhabitants . The Rashemi considered the Ashenwood sacred and would not settle within its borders . Geography .

title: Asheyron
description: Asheyron Asheyron the Learned was a sage and the owner of the Elfskull Inn in Arabel in 1367 DR . Activities . Asheyron possessed a wealth of knowledge about monsters , particularly gorgon s .

title: Ashhold
description: Ashhold Ashhold was an ash giant citadel in the Black Ash Plain . The citadel ' s fortifications were entirely natural and consisted of huge basalt pillars with lava pits and flows . History .

title: Ashigi Desugaki
description: Ashigi Desugaki Ashigi Desugaki was a provincial governor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ashigi , a follower of the emperor , was nominated governor of the Fukudo Province , a territory traditionally ruled by the family of Takenaka Okawa , in a very clever placement by retired emperor Gokammu .

title: Ashira
description: Ashira Ashira were spirits of trees that lived mainly in palm trees , plum trees , banana trees , etc . These creatures were a subspecies of the fairies that lived on the open spaces of Zakhara . They led joyful and carefree lives and often were close friends of people who looked after their trees .

title: Ashkabbar
description: Ashkabbar Ashkabbar was an orc leader in Blingdenstone . History . In 1478 DR , Ashkabbar led a group of orcs into a section of Blingdenstone .

title: Ashmadai
description: Ashmadai The Ashmadai were a secretive devil worshiping cult based in Neverwinter dedicated to the god Asmodeus . The cult was well connected in Neverwinter prior to the cataclysm in 1451 DR and was even better connected as of 1479 DR . In the years prior to Neverwinter ' s destruction , the Ashmadai worked as agents of Thay although since the cataclysm , the Ashmadai are no longer allied with Szass Tam .

title: Ashni
description: Ashni Ashni was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Ashni was a student of Neverwinter Academy .

title: Ashok
description: Ashok Ashok was a shadar - kai from the Shadowfell . Formerly a member of a small shadar - kai enclave , he later resided in Ikemmu , where was a considered a champion of the god Tempus . History .

title: Ashroot
description: Ashroot Ashroot was a succubus agent of Graz ' zt in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . In the late 1480s DR , the demon lord Graz ' zt sent Ashroot disguised as a deep gnome to spread his madness in Zortagra .

title: Asilther Graelor
description: Asilther Graelor Asilther Graelor was an Harper . Personality . Asilther followed always Mintiper , as she saw it , she owed her life to him .

title: Askalan Larcloaks
description: Askalan Larcloaks Askalan Larcloaks was a gnome wheelwright in Immerford in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Askalan and other wealthy citizens went to protest to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn about an unseen thief and murderer .

title: Askar
description: Askar Askar ( askara for females ) were the most common kind of warrior found in Zakhara . They served as the backbone of any defense . Requirements .

title: Askavar
description: Askavar Askavar was an ancient elven settlement in the Glimmerwood . History . The evil wizard Uldoon used to send fiend s from his small realm of Torsil north of the Cloud Peaks to prey upon the elves of Askavar .

title: Askoro Imo
description: Askoro Imo Askoro Imo was a hengeyokai bushi adventurer in Kozakura . History . Imo was always a traveler , never remaining for too long in a place , even if was a good one .

title: Asmodeus
description: Asmodeus Asmodeus ( æz - mo - DAY - us or æz - MO - dee - us ) , an archdevil before the Spellplague , Supreme of the Nine Hells ( or Baator ) , was the god of sin . An ever ambitious and careful creature , Asmodeus retained his position all through the Reckoning of Hell , unlike many of the other archdevils . Asmodeus was lord of Nessus , the Ninth Layer of Hell , though he was generally recognized as lord of all of his divine dominion of Baator , which lay within the Astral Sea .

title: Aspect
description: Aspect An aspect was a lesser incarnation of a powerful creature , often a deity , though sometimes a demon lord or similar creature . An aspect was similar to an avatar , but unlike an avatar it was not a mortal incarnation but rather a powerful supernatural being in its own right . Aspects sometimes appeared to even have a distinct personality or differing abilities from the original personality , though in fact , an aspect was merely another face of that creature .

title: Asper
description: Asper Asper was an inhabitant of Waterdeep and the wife of Mirt . Appearance . Asper was a lithe , petite beauty .

title: Aspergillum
description: Aspergillum An aspergillum , also called an aspergill , was an implement used for spraying holy water . Description . Aspergillums came in various designs , but often took the form of a small metal club or light mace , sometimes hanging on the end of a chain .

title: Asperii
description: Asperii Asperii , also known as wind steeds , were magical horse s that possessed keen minds and telepathic powers and the ability to fly . Description . Asperii appeared as normal horses , averaging around eight feet ( 2 .

title: Asraf el Kahaman
description: Asraf el Kahaman Asraf yn Malik el Kahaman yi Manshaka was one of the most prominent members of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . For unknown reason he remain loyal to Khelben Arunsun even after his transformation .

title: Asram
description: Asram Asram was originally one of the flying cities in ancient Netheril . It was one of only three cities ( the others being Anauria and Hlondath ) high enough above the ground that the reborn Mystra was able to save them before they tumbled to the ground and shattered . Instead , Mystra ensured they landed safely , although never again would they be able to fly .

title: Assad Bazaar
description: Assad Bazaar The Assad Bazaar , or Lion Bazaar , was a marketplace found within the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This bazaar derived its name because it faced a monument of an old hero of Huzuz named Assad al - Assad .

title: Assad Head
description: Assad Head The Assad Head was a sculpture found in the Assad Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This 20 ft .

title: Assam
description: Assam Assam was a small city on the northern side of the Shining Plains . Geography . While Assam was the northernmost city in the Shining Plains , it was still several leagues south of the northern edge of the plain .

title: Assassin
description: Assassin Assassins are deadly and ruthless killers and spies that draw upon the power of shadow magic . Abilities . The abilities of an assassin are skilled at being able to kill or incapacitate a target while avoiding confrontation .

title: Assassin ' s spear
description: Assassin ' s spear An Assassin ' s Spear is a + 1 magical shortspear that conveys this magical enhancement bonus when used in melee combat , but if thrown , grants the thrower " invisibility " . The enhancement bonus does not function for the duration of the invisibility spell , so it strikes as a normal shortspear . But once the invisibility spell is broken or wears off , the Assassin ' s Spear regains its magical bonus until the next time it is thrown .

title: Assassin vine
description: Assassin vine An assassin vine was a type of carnivorous plant found in varieties both above and below the surface . Description . A single specimen usually consisted of a 20 - foot - long ( six meters ) main branch as thick as a human ' s forearm .

title: Assassins Guild of the Galenas
description: Assassins Guild of the Galenas The Assassins Guild of the Galenas , also called the Citadel of Assassins , was an assassin s guild based in the Galena Mountains in Damara . History . The Guild was once loyal to Zhengyi the Witch - King .

title: Assault on Maerimydra
description: Assault on Maerimydra Assault on Maerimydra , designed by Greg Marks , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the cavern of Sporedome , drow , fire giant s , and Maerimydra . Summary .

title: Assembly
description: Assembly The Assembly was a meeting hall in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . It was a huge , barn - like building . The Assembly was used to hold a variety of gatherings , including civic , private , and religious events .

title: Astanalan
description: Astanalan Astanalan was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Astanalan was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Astilabor
description: Astilabor Astilabor ( pronounced " As - TIL - uh - bore " ) was the neutral dragon goddess of acquisitiveness and wealth . She represented the draconic desire to acquire and treasure wealth and by doing so gain status , and so she was , in a way , the archetype of dragonkind . Description .

title: Astral Plane
description: Astral Plane The Astral plane ( sometimes Astral Plane ) was one of the planes of existence in various models of cosmology . Astral Plane in the Great Wheel Model . In 1st and 2nd edition D & D , as explained by the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Astral plane connected the Prime Material Plane s to the first layers of the Outer planes .

title: Astral Sea
description: Astral Sea The Astral Sea , formerly known also as Astral Plane , was the home of the gods in the World Axis cosmology model of the planes of existence for the Forgotten Realms . The Astral Sea was described as being " above " the Prime Material Plane and its two reflections , the Feywild and the Shadowfell . The Spellplague destroyed the World Tree and set the dominion s of the gods adrift to wander about in the silvery void .

title: Astral dominion
description: Astral dominion Astral dominions , sometimes simply called dominions or more archaically the Outer Planes , were distinct plane s connected by the Astral Sea which were inhabited and maintained often , but not always , by one or more god s . In many ways an astral dominion was a plane in and of itself , and sometimes contained its own demiplane s . Nonetheless , each dominion was a part of the greater Astral Sea as described by the World Axis cosmology model .

title: Astral dragon
description: Astral dragon An astral dragon was a type of dragon that was able to inhabit the Astral Sea . They were chromatic dragon s , but they bore only a slight resemblance to others in their subtype . Abilities .

title: Astral projection
description: Astral projection Astral projection was a necromancy spell that projected the caster and his / her companions into the Astral Plane . Formerly , this spell was called the astral spell and was a member of the alteration school . Effects .

title: Astral sphere
description: Astral sphere The Astral sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s that allowed access to other planes of existence via the Astral Plane . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Astral Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Astral stalker
description: Astral stalker Astral stalkers are abomination s created by the gods as weapons for use in the Dawn War . Devious and bloodthirsty killers , astral stalkers have served since the Dawn War primarily as bounty hunters and assassins , though often they hunt simply for the sake of the challenge in cornering dangerous prey . Originally , astral stalkers were created by the gods in order to fight the primordial s and their servants .

title: Astrid Saj
description: Astrid Saj Astrid Saj was a wealthy merchant in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Astrid was part of a merchant house that hoped to enter into the city ' s Blade elite .

title: Astrolabe of entrapment
description: Astrolabe of entrapment Astrolabes of entrapment were rare magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These spherical were usually made of metal .

title: Astrologer
description: Astrologer Astrologers were unique wizard s in Zakhara who used the constellation s to enhance their spells and other powers . Requirements . Due to the strict nature of their unique way of practicing magic , astrologers tended to be very ordered and lawful individuals .

title: Astrosphinx
description: Astrosphinx Malevolent sphinx es whose heads resemble goat skulls . Combat . An astrosphinx uses its two great horns to attack with a head - butt first , striking with each horn separately .

title: Asuras
description: Asuras Asuras were good messenger spirits in service to deities , and as such were the main competitors to the deva s . They were a symbol of goodness and light , kindness and tenderness , and often appeared on the Material Plane helping mystic s and faithful . Description .

title: Aswidorg
description: Aswidorg Aswidorg was a juvenile black dragon whose lair was in the Serpent Hills and the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . He was the great - grandson of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the son of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the brother of the black dragons Woklef , Cheleen and Kasidikal .

title: Aswiyah al - Muftahir
description: Aswiyah al - Muftahir Aswiyah al - Muftahir was the caliph of Muluk in 1367 DR . Personality . Aswiyah was a crafty and cunning individual , just like her ancestors .

title: Aszundar Zel
description: Aszundar Zel Aszundar Zel was a diplomat of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1350s DR . Around 1354 DR , Aszundar Zel paid a visit to the royal court of Cormyr and met Princess Alusair Obarskyr , later describing her as " impish " and " winsomely beautiful " .

title: Atabeg al - Mazdaghani
description: Atabeg al - Mazdaghani Atabeg al - Mazdaghani was a noble marid who lived under the waters of the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Activities . The noble marid aggressively confronted any ship daring to drop anchor in his waters .

title: Ataman al - Hajar
description: Ataman al - Hajar Ataman al - Hajar was a noble dao who lived deep within an intricate cave system on the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Ataman was short for a noble dao , but still possessed a truly massive frame .

title: Athalantar
description: Athalantar Athalantar ( also known as the Realm of the Stag ) whose capital , Hastarl , stood on the site of the settlement of Secomber , was a small human kingdom in the North . Geography . The Unicorn Run made its path through the middle of Athalantar , creating rich farmlands on its way to the Delimbiyr in the south where , the capital , Hastarl stood .

title: Athalee
description: Athalee Athalee was an elf living in Kryptgarden Forest in past ages . History . Athalee was in a forgotten past a scholar who lived and died in Kryptgarden .

title: Atherton Cooper
description: Atherton Cooper Atherton Cooper was an unusually tall , hawk - nosed halfling thief who often wore leathers and wielded the magic sword " Godsbane " before it was stolen from his village by the Zhent army led by Cyric . Personality . Atherton often responded to Sneakabout , and liked to show off his tracking skills .

title: Athkatla
description: Athkatla Athkatla was the capital city of Amn . Considered a pilgrimage site for followers of Waukeen , the City of Coin was rumoured to have streets paved with gold . This was , of course , untrue , especially in the slums and the notorious Docks districts , where people were poor and crime was rife .

title: Athorton
description: Athorton Athorton was a sage from Nleeth on Vilhon Reach , living in the 13th century DR . History . Athorton was a young sage in the early 1200s DR .

title: Athrogate
description: Athrogate Athrogate was a dwarven warrior of some reputation in the Bloodstone Lands and later in the North . He later became a companion of Jarlaxle and an agent of Bregan D ' aerthe . Description .

title: Atia Scorvo
description: Atia Scorvo Atia Scorvo was a medusa member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Earthspur Mountains in 1491 DR . Personality . Atia was a cruel and vain individual .

title: Atiq el Catahras
description: Atiq el Catahras Atiq el Catahras was the owner of The Roving Rune , a popular inn in Teshburl , in 1370 DR . Relationships . Atiq was the nephew of former wizard who used to occupy the minaret tower in which The Roving Rune resided .

title: Atl - Ollin
description: Atl - Ollin Atl - Ollin was a high priest of Calor in Nexal . History . Around 1351 DR , after a series of portents , Naltecona gathered all the high priests to ask them what the gods wished .

title: Atonement
description: Atonement Atonement was an abjuration spell that could restore status , alignment , or abilities to a being who suffered a loss due to misdeeds against their deity or alignment . Effects . This spell could be used to alleviate a variety of moral and ethical ailments caused by acts contrary to the ethos of their class , religion , or profession , either good versus evil , law versus chaos , or both .

title: Atorrnash
description: Atorrnash Atorrnash was an ancient city of dark elves in the southern parts of Faerûn . It existed in the Dawn Age and was ruled by an Iythiiri - archmage . The City was on a peninsula surrounded by the sea on three sides .

title: Atreus Eleint
description: Atreus Eleint Atreus Eleint was a wealthy human noble and the descendant of an unknown noble family living in Erlkazar . A spell used on him in his youth had distorted his growth and caused him to become severely deformed , not detracting much from his physical abilities but ruining his appearance . This virtual handicap prevented him from living a normal life and caused him to become obsessed with trying to become handsome .

title: Atropal
description: Atropal Atropals are a race of unfinished immortal s modeled after the god s , who have since become undead abomination s . Existing solely to spread death and destruction , atropals roam across the planes , hunting down any prey that comes their way . Others are sealed away in forgotten delves .

title: Atropus
description: Atropus Atropus , known as the World Born Dead , was an undead primordial whose coming was a harbinger of death and destruction . Description . Once a great power , little remained of Atropus but a decaying , disembodied head the size of a small moon , apparently made of black stone , heavily cratered , and covered with foul amniotic fluid .

title: Atsuko
description: Atsuko Atsuko was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Atsuko was a very paranoid individual .

title: Aubaudameira Dree
description: Aubaudameira Dree Aubaudameira Dree , usually known as Alais , was a female elf who was the herald of the Coronal Eltargrim of Cormanthyr . History . Alais was a prominent member of Dree House .

title: Aubrin Crownsilver
description: Aubrin Crownsilver Aubrin Crownsilver , who usually went by his nickname " Brin " , was a young acolyte of Torm and the scion of the Crownsilver family of Cormyr . Due to his grandmother ' s dalliance with a prince of Cormyr , his father was a bastard Obarskyr , which , under Cormyrean law , placed him in the line of succession for the throne . According to Cormyrean succession rules , Brin was currently fourth in line for the throne as of 1479 DR .

title: Auckney
description: Auckney Auckney was a small fiefdom near the Spine of the World . It was ruled by the noble Auck family . Because its cold location was somewhat removed from busy trade routes , it was not often visited .

title: Audara Imryth
description: Audara Imryth Audara Imryth was a cleric of Mystra and a potion - seller in Westgate in 1370 DR . Secretly , she was a member of the Harpers , watching over the city . Audara was affiliated with the Harper branch based in Shadowdale and had a strained relationship with fellow local Harper Jamal , whom she did not trust .

title: Audra Maskyr
description: Audra Maskyr Audra Maskyr was a sergeant of the Mulmaster City Watch . Personality . The sergeant was one of the more ambitious and competent members of the City Watch .

title: Audrec SeTourne
description: Audrec SeTourne Audrec SeTourne was a duelist from Lantan who was in Mulmaster . Personality . The gladiator was known for his evil nature .

title: Augathra the Mad
description: Augathra the Mad Augathra the Mad was a Netherese magic user , scholar , and seer . She received visions and wrote them down into a chronology that would become known as the Roll of Years . To her chagrin , she received dark and disturbing visions during her sleep .

title: Augelite
description: Augelite Augelite was a clear , colorless crystal . Description . These ornamental stones were soft but fragile and therefore easily worked without special skill or tools but cannot hold fine detail without splitting .

title: Aughisky
description: Aughisky An aughisky is an exceedingly rare creature that takes the form of a beautiful - looking horse . Ecology . It wanders dry land looking for humanoid prey .

title: Augrek Brighthelm
description: Augrek Brighthelm Augrek Brighthelm was a deputy in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Usually , Augrek was found at the southwest gate of the city , where she welcomed all visitors with a well - rehearsed speech about the wonders of Bryn Shander .

title: Augury
description: Augury Augury ( AG - ur - ee ) was a divination spell that learned whether a given action will be good or bad . Effect . An " augury " spell could tell you whether a particular action will bring good or bad results for you in the immediate future .

title: Aulagol
description: Aulagol Aulagol was an illithilich wizard and a member of the Concord of Elders that governed the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the mid – 13th century DR , during a visit to the Astral Plane , Aulagol allowed a raiding party of githyanki to discover his " astral projection " and to pursue him to the astral portion of the city ' s elder brain .

title: Auldus Breeklar
description: Auldus Breeklar Auldus Breeklar was a lord in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Storm Silverhand asked for the collaboration of Lord Breeklar and Lord Hamnlaer in helping King Foril Obarskyr I but Bleeklar did not believe her .

title: Aulruick Thoster
description: Aulruick Thoster Aulruick Thoster was the captain of the ship the " Green Siren " . Appearance . While on board ship he wore a prodigious hat , a gold - trimmed coat , and a slender , straight sword in a silver sheath .

title: Aulumpiter
description: Aulumpiter Aulmpiter was a nycaloth and a member of the Trio Nefarious and leader of the Army of Darkness . History . Aulmpiter was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese .

title: Aumark Lithyl
description: Aumark Lithyl Aumark Lithyl was the ruler of Ruathym . History . Before becoming the ruler of Ruathym , Aumark Lithyl was a member of the adventuring band known as the Knights of Myth Drannor .

title: Aumrauth
description: Aumrauth Aumrauth is a sea elf realm located in the Shining Sea between Tharsult and the mouth of the River Scelptar . Aumrauthans seem to spend most of their time farming various underwater flora and fauna , occasionally trading secretly with specially selected fishermen from the surface . History .

title: Aumry ' s cloak
description: Aumry ' s cloak Aumry ' s cloak was the cloak of Aumry , lord of Shadowdale . Powers . The cloak had the powers of a " cloak of charisma " .

title: Aumry Obarskyr
description: Aumry Obarskyr Aumry Obarskyr was the Lord of Shadowdale from 1300 DR to 1339 DR . His last name , Obarskyr , was known only to a few individuals . He was the husband of Syluné Silverhand .

title: Aumvor
description: Aumvor Aumvor the Undying was an ancient Netherese lich , infamous since Netheril ' s Age of Discovery for his unmatched mastery over necromancy . He was named " the Undying " because , instead of seeking lichdom , he lived for centuries by leeching the living energy of his " living zombie " servitors , many of them members of his own family . The casting of " Karsus ' s Avatar " in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR , an event that nearly tore the Weave apart and caused the fall of Netheril , caused the activation of his contingency magics : Aumvor was teleported into his hidden lair inside the Endless Caverns , far below the High Forest and transformed into a lich .

title: Aunadar Bleth
description: Aunadar Bleth Aunadar Bleth was a human from Cormyr . History . Since he was sighted in the royal library with the crown princess Tanalasta Obarskyr , it was rumored that they were sharing a romance .

title: Aundra Blacklock
description: Aundra Blacklock Aundra Blacklock was a powerful Raptoran Sorceress who was the owner of a tenement building known as the God Catcher . She lived in a magical sphere that hovered above the building . Clytemorrenestrix , a Blue dragon changed into a human by the Spellplague , came to Aundra and asked her to reverse the effects of the Spellplague , something that Aundra claimed was within her power .

title: Aunglass Roaryl
description: Aunglass Roaryl Aunglass Roaryl was a legendary hero of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , and the founder of the Roaryl dynasty . History . Several centuries before the Spellplague , Aunglass Roaryl led a rebellion against the dragon emperor Eskornamundyr .

title: Aunrae Dhuurniv
description: Aunrae Dhuurniv Aunrae Dhuurniv was the eldest of the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Aunrae was always the most diplomatic and administrative of the Matron sisters .

title: Aunrae Nasadra
description: Aunrae Nasadra Aunrae Nasadra was the matron mother of House Nasadra and the uncrowned queen of Ched Nasad until its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . In 689 DR , Aunrae succeeded her grandmother as head of House Nasadra and informally as queen of Ched Nasad .

title: Auppenser
description: Auppenser Auppenser was a stoic god , and the precepts of his worship included moderation , inner balance , self - reflection , and reason . Relationships . His church reached its heights in Jhaamdath - primarily in the Twelve Cities of Swords - before its imperial expansion .

title: Aura against flame
description: Aura against flame Aura against flame was a divine abjuration spell that protected against and extinguished natural and magical fires . Effects . This spell created an aura of blue mist that surrounded the cleric .

title: Aura of comfort
description: Aura of comfort Aura of comfort was an evocation spell that allowed the recipient to ignore normal extremes of non - magical heat or cold , and be protected from rain , snow , and hail . Effects . This spell lasted for a few hours ; longer for more experienced casters , and created a faint aura that shimmered around the subject .

title: Aura of life
description: Aura of life Aura of life was a divine abjuration spell that generated an aura of life preservation . Effects . The caster created an aura with a 30 - foot ( 9 .

title: Aura of purity
description: Aura of purity Aura of purity was an abjuration spell that created an aura of purifying energies . Effects . The aura extended to 30 feet ( 9 .

title: Aura of vitality
description: Aura of vitality Aura of vitality was an evocation spell for paladin s that created an aura that could heal creatures close by . Effects . The caster created an aura with a 30 - foot radius ( 9 .

title: Auran
description: Auran Auran was the language of the Elemental Plane of Air . It was also known as Old Alzhedo , as the modern Alzhedo language spoken in Calimshan derived from it . Description .

title: Aurbangras
description: Aurbangras Aurbangras was a young white dragon . History . In 1484 DR , during the Darkening in Luruar , Aurbangras and his father Arauthator were allied with the drow Quenthel Baenre and Gromph Baenre .

title: Aurgloroasa
description: Aurgloroasa Aurgloroasa ( pronounced ore - " GLOR " - oh - " ASS " - ah ) , also known as Sibilant Shade , was a venerable shadow dragon responsible for the fall of the dwarven city of Thunderholme in the Thunder Peaks . Personality . Aurgloroasa was obsessed with research into death , undeath , necromancy , and shadow magic .

title: Auril
description: Auril Auril ( pronounced " AW - rill " ) , also known as The Cold Goddess , The Frostmaiden , Icedawn , and the Goddess of Winter , was a fickle , vain , and evil deity , who was primarily venerated out of fear . The few among the Iulutiun s of the Great Glacier who worshiped her called her Saukuruk . Relationships .

title: Auril ' s flowers
description: Auril ' s flowers Auril ' s flowers was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused an explosion of sharp ice and small stones to burst from the ground in an area designated by the caster . Effects .

title: Aurin
description: Aurin Aurin was a businessman and conjurer in Skullport . History . Aurin hailed from a country on the Sea of Fallen Stars near the Earthspur Mountains .

title: Auro ' pol Dyrr
description: Auro ' pol Dyrr ' Auro ' pol Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan during the Time of Troubles . History . During the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR , House Agrach Dyrr was one of the several to take part in the Battle of Mithral Hall and its Matron Auro ' pol Dyrr went personally to the battle together with the mastermind of the attack : Matron Baenre .

title: Aurochs
description: Aurochs Aurochs were powerful wild beasts sometimes revered and used as war mounts by some orc tribes , in particular those that worshiped Bahgtru . Notable aurochs . It was told in legends that Bahgtru tamed an aurochs with his bare hands and brought it to Nishrek under Gruumsh ' s rule .

title: Aurora
description: Aurora Aurora was the owner of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Aurora was an adventurer sorceress who traveled most of Faerûn , from Icewind Dale to Chult , from the Sword Coast to the fringes of Kara - Tur .

title: Aurora ' s Emporium
description: Aurora ' s Emporium Aurora ' s Emporium was a curio shop located in Westgate . The shop sold exotic items from all over Faerûn . The Emporium was but one of a number of similar outlets located throughout Faerûn , connected through a network of teleportation spells and devices , with outlets in most major cities in western Faerûn , including at least six in the city of Waterdeep .

title: Aurumvorax
description: Aurumvorax The aurumvorax ( a - rum - VOR - æks ; see plural for the plural form ) , sometimes known as the golden gorger , is a small , shaggy hole - dwelling creature with eight legs that is able to eat gold . It is sometimes used to locate gold , able to detect and find its veins in the ground . It is not fearful and can become vicious , able to defend itself against formidable creatures like chimera e .

title: Auseriel
description: Auseriel Auseriel was the secret elven haven established by Lamruil Moonflower , Prince of Evermeet , the late Zaor ' s youngest son . History . After the nearly successful conquest of Evermeet , by Kymil Nimesin was thwarted , Queen Amlaruil gave the " Tree of Souls " to Lamruil and , at her urging , agreed to take the tree and establish an elven haven on the mainland .

title: Auspician
description: Auspician The auspician was a prestige class of for those who sought powers of luck . Entry . The auspician was often a worshiper of a deity of luck .

title: Austrus Flambrant
description: Austrus Flambrant Austrus Flambrant was a noble in Cormyr and the lord of Flambrant House . Relationships . Flambrant was close to Lady Jalassra Dawningdown .

title: Ausuriel
description: Ausuriel Ausuriel , mostly known as the blind goat , was an angel and the Herald of Shiallia , exarch of Mielikki , in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Ausuriel lived in a small village on an isle not too far from Phlan .

title: Autton Shadowshroud
description: Autton Shadowshroud Autton Shadowshroud was a male elven assassin and a member of the Shadowkind assassin guild based in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Description . Autton was 5 feet and 2 inches ( 1 .

title: Auvandell
description: Auvandell Auvandell , named after the human hero Auvan Arlandspyr , was a village located on the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar , where the road descended out of Silverymoon Pass . The town clustered around an old , dwarf - built , Delzoun watchtower . Description .

title: Ava Moonflower
description: Ava Moonflower Ava Moonflower was a Moon elf of House Moonflower long before the Crown Wars of the ancient realm Aryvandaar . She was also a mighty High Mage and served as a center for the high magic rituals . She was married to the sun elf Rolim Durothil shortly before both travelled the ocean with many elves to the island of Evermeet .

title: Avaereene
description: Avaereene Avaereene was one of the most trusted agents of the Xanathar , the leader of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Personality . Avaereene was a cruel and efficient person ; she enjoyed creating darkenbeast s to serve her deadly whims , and she intended to supplant the Blackstaff as the most powerful mage of Waterdeep .

title: Avaerl
description: Avaerl Avaerl of Sembresh was a Zhentarim wizard . History . In 1358 DR , after Elminster Aumar had foiled a Zhentarim plot to conquer High Dale , Manshoon sent Avaerl to track and kill the Old Mage .

title: Avalanche hurler
description: Avalanche hurler Avalanche hurlers are ranger s who excel at flexibility in combat , focusing on neither melee nor ranged combat like most rangers but instead emphasizing both . Ever resourceful avalanche hurlers are equally effective in a melee or from a short distance . For this purpose avalanche hurlers specialize in the use of two smaller melee weapons that can be thrown effectively , such as dagger s or small hammer s .

title: Avan Vatsisen
description: Avan Vatsisen Avan Vatsisen is a Thay an wizard who was originally based in Eltabbar . He was sent by his Red Wizard master to Scornubel to oversee the transportation of rare spell components , available only in the Western Heartlands , back to Thay . He is accompanied by two flesh golem s .

title: Avariel
description: Avariel The Avariel ( " Aril - tel - quessir " in elven or " winged folk " ) were amongst the first of the elven races to migrate to Faerûn . However , conflict with Dragon s almost wiped them out before the First Flowering and while they have survived since that time , they are considered by most to be myths or legends . Physical Description .

title: Avatar
description: Avatar An avatar was a physical manifestation of a deity on Toril . It was usually significantly less powerful than the deity it represented . The deity Tiamat had her avatar slain twice , implying the loss of an avatar did not result in any permanent damage to the deity .

title: Avatar series
description: Avatar series The Avatar series , originally the Avatar trilogy , is a series of novels detailing the events of the Time of Troubles . The original three books were set from Kythorn 1 to Marpenoth 15 . The books are : The artwork for the covers of the books were provided by Brom .

title: Avelyere
description: Avelyere Avelyere , most often referred to as Lady Avelyere , was a diviner who ran a school ( Coven ) for young sorceresses in the Shade Enclave in 1469 DR . Description . Lady Avelyere had light gray eyes and brown hair .

title: Avenger
description: Avenger An avenger was an agent of one or more god s who sought to bring divine wrath unto the enemies of their divine patron . Invested with traditions both ancient and quite often secret , avengers served as a well - crafted weapon of their deity , finding the enemies of their faith and striking them down . Of all a god ' s agents they were the most deadly , marked and empowered by rituals of investiture similar , but not identical to , those that which marked the training of a cleric or paladin .

title: Avenging slayer
description: Avenging slayer Avenging slayers are fighter s who see it as their duty to deal justice in a cruel and unforgiving world plagued by monsters and villains . These would - be heroes seek out the seeds of future destruction to prevent new further suffering and to quench the thirst for vengeance that many feel . Many avenging slayers begin as survivors left behind after some violent disaster , such as the pillaging of a village .

title: Aventine
description: Aventine Aventine was a svirfneblin city located in the Underdark near Dambrath . History . The deep gnomes inhabiting Aventine , and much of the city , was destroyed by drow aided by crinti and arkaiun .

title: Aventurine
description: Aventurine Aventurine , also known as a love stone , was a variety of that glitters when viewed from certain angles due to inclusions . Description . This semi - precious stone could be medium to light green , dark to pale blue , or a beautiful sparkling shade of gold .

title: Avenue of Wealth
description: Avenue of Wealth The Avenue of Wealth was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This street entered Huzuz through the Gate of Wealth .

title: Avenue of the Sea
description: Avenue of the Sea The Avenue of the Sea , or the Fishers ' Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Avenue of the Sea entered Huzuz through a gate in the northwest corner of the city where it branched from the River Road , travelling southeast between the Merchants ' District and Northwest District before terminating at the Grand Bazaar .

title: Avernus
description: Avernus Avernus was the first layer of Baator and was a vast charred wasteland of rubble over which the iron towers of the Dukes of Hell stood . Legions of devil s marched across its plains in continual readiness for the next battle of the Blood War . A red light suffused the sky and huge fireballs flew across the layer , randomly exploding wherever they hit .

title: Avert evil eye
description: Avert evil eye Avert evil eye was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This popular spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Avery Schell
description: Avery Schell Avery Schell is a cleric of Deneir and the substitute father of Cadderly Bonaduce . History . Avery was one of the headmasters of the Edificant Library .

title: Avgar Filroy
description: Avgar Filroy Avgar Filroy was the only innkeeper in Noanar ' s Hold until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Courageously , Avgar managed the White Hart Inn with the help of some " unseen servant s " for the cleaning .

title: Avid
description: Avid Avid was a merchant in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Avid hailed from Durpar .

title: Avimmuck Wanderfoot
description: Avimmuck Wanderfoot Avimmuck Wanderfoot was the Cloakmaster of the Caravan Sect of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Location . Avimmuck owned a house in Riatavin .

title: Aviss
description: Aviss Aviss was a once - human woman magically transformed into a bird - like being , who sought the destruction of Waterdeep . History . The lover and partner of Fellandar , Aviss lived in Waterdeep in the mid – 10th century DR .

title: Avner
description: Avner Avner of Hartsvale was a thief and scout in Hartsvale in the 14th century DR . History . Avner was an orphan living in Hartwick in Hartsvale .

title: Avnos Des
description: Avnos Des Avnos Des was the head of the spirit s that protected the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . Avnos Des was once a human living in Elgrin Fau in the Plane of Shadow until Kesson Rel killed all the inhabitants .

title: Avolakia
description: Avolakia Avolakia were aberrations who lived deep underground in small tribal units . Description . In their natural form avolakias resembled a disgusting cross between an octopus , worm and insect .

title: Avos
description: Avos Avos the Fisher was a gang leader in Selgaunt . History . Avos was born among the city ' s fishermen but at an early age ran away and joined Selgaunt ' s underground .

title: Awaken
description: Awaken Awaken was a transmutation spell that awakened intelligence and ability in a creature or plant of little or no intelligence . Effects . After eight hours of casting and touching a creature of little or no intelligence , the creature would gain average intelligence ( compared to humanoids ) and learn the language of the caster .

title: Awang Sophir
description: Awang Sophir Awang Sophir was a monk participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Possessions . Awang possessed a " ring of teleportation " .

title: Awen
description: Awen Awen was a doomguide in Neverwinter . History . During an inspection to the city graveyard , Awen died at the hands of Red Wizard minions but rose as ghost , not acknowledging her death .

title: Axar Xyrl
description: Axar Xyrl Axar Xyrl was one of the morkoth arcount member of the Arcanium of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Axar Xyrl was a calculating and scheming individual that spoke what he thought in very rare occasions .

title: Axe
description: Axe An axe is a single - or double - bladed weapon made from a metal or stone head mounted on a haft of varying length . The haft is usually made of wood to reduce the overall weight . The term " axe " is used here as an archetype of hand - held slashing weapons that fit this description and where the blade length is considerably less then the overall weapon length .

title: Axe Grinders
description: Axe Grinders The Axe Grinders was a bodyguard business in Skullport . Geography . The business was located off in the Central Port district of Skullport , north of the Crossed Swords tavern and the Bane ' s Mistress festhall .

title: Axe Kingdoms
description: Axe Kingdoms The Axe Kingdoms were a pair of merrow kingdoms , Khuur and Nmalk , in Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . They represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History .

title: Axe of Mirabar
description: Axe of Mirabar The Axe of Mirabar is the two thousand strong militia of Mirabar , consisting of humans and five hundred dwarves . Its members wear the crest of Mirabar ( a deep red double - bladed axe with a pointed haft and a flaring , flat base on a black field ) on their shield or armour . They fight with crossbow s , lance s and hammer s , riding mountain ponies , and rothé in the winter .

title: Axiomatic creature
description: Axiomatic creature Axiomatic creature was a transmutation spell that transfigured the subject into a perfect version of itself . This could only be cast by those with the archon subtype . Effects .

title: Axithar
description: Axithar Axithar was a balor lord whose armies invaded the House of the Triad after the fall of Mystra . History . Not long after the death of Mystra ( in 1385 DR ) , the cambion Kaanyr Vhok and his companions were captured by the marilith Vhissilka , who served Lord Axithar .

title: Aya Glenmiir
description: Aya Glenmiir Aya Glenmiir was an elven wizard in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Aya was a brilliant individual , well versed in the Weave .

title: Ayala
description: Ayala Ayala was an elven Harper and saved Drogan Droganson ' s life after the kobold attack on Hilltop . Description . Ayala was a slim elf , with long dirty - blonde hair , often put into a pony tail .

title: Ayana No - Shui
description: Ayana No - Shui Ayana No - Shui was a wu jen in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . History . Born with the mark of the maraloi , Ayana was always destined to become a wu jen .

title: Ayesha al - Rumi
description: Ayesha al - Rumi Ayesha al - Rumi was a holy slayer inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Ayesha wore bright white robes that covered her entire body save for her intense dark eyes .

title: Ayre Affapanov
description: Ayre Affapanov Zora Ayre Affapanov was a girl in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Rekationships . Ayre was the daughter of Lord Serge Affapanov , a noble predicted to become one of the Blade s allied with the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Ayrorch
description: Ayrorch The Ayrorch was the ruling council of the island - nation of Lantan , based in Sambar . Activities . The council consisted of twelve members serving for life , chosen by the council itself .

title: Azad the Free
description: Azad the Free Azad the Free was a former champion gladiator from Calimport who led a slave revolt and escaped into eastern Tethyr where he founded the Island of the Free on an earthmote . Azad was tricked by the Pasha of Calimport , Marod el Arhapan , into killing the Pasha ' s wife in the arena . After this , the Pasha made Azad a household slave whose primary job was to read bedtime stories to the Pasha ' s son Cephas .

title: Azak Throm
description: Azak Throm Azak Throm was a Red Wizard of Thay diplomat in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Azak was a cunning and calculating individual .

title: Azalar Falconhand
description: Azalar Falconhand Azalar Falconhand , was a ranger of Mielikki and the son of Dove and Florin Falconhand . Azalar was the direct result of Mielikki ordering his parents to marry and beget a child . .

title: Azanza Mizzrym
description: Azanza Mizzrym Azanza Mizzrym was the leader of the House Mizzrym contingent that controlled the ruins of Sulasspryn in 1367 DR . Personality . Azanza was cunning and had good diplomatic skills , which helped in her dealings with other creatures that roamed the ruins .

title: Azariah Craulnober
description: Azariah Craulnober Azariah Craulnober ( pronounced " ah - ZAH - ree - ah " ) was the daughter of Elaith Craulnober , a moon elf crime lord of Waterdeep . Description . Azariah had silvery hair .

title: Azbara Jos
description: Azbara Jos Azbara Jos was a Red Wizard of Thay and a member of the faction loyal to Rath Modar . History . Azbara acted as Modar ' s envoy to the raiding armies of the reformed Cult of the Dragon .

title: Azer
description: Azer Azers ( AY - zurz ) were elemental creature s native to the Elemental Plane of Fire and Elemental Chaos . Azers were created by fire titan s and fire giant s , whom they often served . Others , however , lived free and worked for their own benefit .

title: Azhakar
description: Azhakar Azhakar was a talking bird who lived in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . History . Azhakar was found living with a singing tree during the time of Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s great - grandfather .

title: Azhaq
description: Azhaq Azhaq was a silver dragon paladin of Bahamut and was the " barb " of the Talons of Justice after the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Azhaq and his fellow Moonwing tried to capture the rebellious song dragon Karasendrieth , but were defeated by Dorn Graybrook ' s team .

title: Azharul
description: Azharul Azharul was a dragon god who lived in Dragon Eyrie , reputed for his mastery of magic . Description . His natural form was that of a fearsome , bad - tempered old dragon with many long , sharp projecting body - barbs .

title: Azharzel
description: Azharzel Azharzel was a blue dragon dracolich . At one point , a former high - ranking member of the Waterclock Guild and secret member of the Cult of the Dragon secreted Azharzel in the Waterclock Guild Crypts . Circa 1484 DR , both the Dragon Cultist and the Thayan minions of Valindra Shadowmantle searched for the dracolich .

title: Azhir Kren
description: Azhir Kren Azhri Kren was a human fighter and tharchion of Gauros . Physical description . During a war expedition , she was usually armored in blue - enameled plate .

title: Aziz - Tagem
description: Aziz - Tagem Aziz - Tagem was a crime lord on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Aziz - Tagem , a man of mixed Bavanese and Bawani ancestry , ruled over the still small yakuza of Bawa .

title: Aziz Jomini
description: Aziz Jomini Aziz Jomini was an elven associate of the Mosque of Free Haku in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziz traveled far from Huzuz to a strange land called Maztica .

title: Aziz min Hajama
description: Aziz min Hajama Aziz min Hajama was a dwarven moralist who served as the commander of the Gate of Revelations within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziz was serious about his duties , often taking the time to personally interview individuals who aroused his suspicion .

title: Aziza
description: Aziza Aziza was a seer who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Aziza was follower of Zann and an active member of the Readers .

title: Azla
description: Azla Azla was a female pirate in 1359 DR . History . Azla was an officer in the Cormyrean army and member of a prominent family .

title: Azmaer Dhuurniv
description: Azmaer Dhuurniv The last powerful drow leader of the Twisted Tower was the Marshall Azmaer Dhuurniv in its last drow - held days . Azmaer oversaw the last retreat of the drow holdings in the face of a human uprising , and held the citadel against a year - long siege . History .

title: Azmyth
description: Azmyth An Azmyth is a small four foot long bat , with a three foot wingspan . They have crested heads , bearded chins and whitepupilless eyes . Skin color ranges from leathery gray , mauve or emerald green .

title: Aznar Thrul
description: Aznar Thrul Aznar Thrul , Zulkir of Evocation , Tharchion of Priador , was one of the eight rulers of Thay and its Red Wizards . Personality . An exceedingly cruel and evil man , he was the greatest rival of the lich Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy .

title: Azoun Obarskyr I
description: Azoun Obarskyr I Azoun I ( full name Azoun Obarskyr ) was the 51st king of Cormyr , reigning from 391 – 425 DR . He was the son of King Anglond of the Obarskyr dynasty , and was titled " the Crown Prince of Battles " for his campaigns as a prince . Description .

title: Azoun Obarskyr II
description: Azoun Obarskyr II Azoun Obarskyr II was the king of Cormyr . He was thin and lean in appearance . Relatives .

title: Azoun Obarskyr IV
description: Azoun Obarskyr IV King Azoun Obarskyr IV of Cormyr was the king of Cormyr from 1336 DR to 1371 DR and a member of the Purple Dragon Knights . During his reign , the kingdom experienced unprecedented economic growth . He was killed in the Goblin War by Nalavarauthatoryl .

title: Azoun Obarskyr V
description: Azoun Obarskyr V Azoun Obarskyr V became the 72nd king of Cormyr , having inherited the throne after the death of his grandfather , the legendary Azoun IV , as well as a mythic sovereign . He is the son of former Crown Princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and Rowen Cormaeril , a scout in the army of Cormyr . History .

title: Azuposi
description: Azuposi The Azuposi were a race of human s living in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Their existence was built upon agriculture and cultivating the harsh land of the basin , but they revered sophisticated culture . Society .

title: Azure Bonds
description: Azure Bonds Azure Bonds is the first book of The Finder ' s Stone trilogy by Jeff Grubb and Kate Novak . It was later made into an adventure module , " Curse of the Azure Bonds " , and a computer game of the same name released by . Characters .

title: Azure Legion
description: Azure Legion The Azure Legion , or the Thunderbolts , was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 10 , 001 jann comprised the Azure Legion .

title: Azuredge
description: Azuredge Azuredge was a magical , intelligent battleaxe forged by Ahghairon the mage . Its wielder was considered the greatest protector of Waterdeep . Description .

title: Azurite
description: Azurite Azurite was a bluish form of malachite that is a little more scarce . Description . An azurite was a rich blue stone with mottling darker shades of blue , tumbled or cut and polished for use in decorating belts and rings .

title: Azuth
description: Azuth Azuth ( pronounced " ah - ZOOTH " ) , also known as the Lord of Spells and the God of Wizards , was a lesser deity who concerned himself with the advancement and preservation of the magical arts . Worshiped by all manner of spellcasters ( and wizards in particular ) , the crafty deity acted as an adviser to the sitting deity of raw magic ; he and Mystra shared an amicable relationship akin to that of tutor and favorite student . Other deities found him crotchety , not understanding his dry wit or ceaseless dedication to collecting magical knowledge .

title: Azzagrat
description: Azzagrat Azzagrat was a realm in the Abyss ruled by the demon lord Graz ' zt . Geography . Azzagrat spanned the 45th , 46th and 47th layers of the Abyss .

title: Ba Salnang
description: Ba Salnang Ba Salnang was the owner of the Fountain of Happiness Inn in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Given the high flow of wealthy caravan traffic through his inn , and the number of local thieves that this traffic attracted , Ba offered free meals to all of the city guards on duty near his establishment with the hopes of gaining their prompt service should any illegal activities occur under his roof .

title: Baalbisan
description: Baalbisan Baalbisan was a balor who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . He was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demon s and devil s , but broke free when he convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the demons to the haven . Baalbisan ' s matron was named Bethshiva .

title: Baalzebul
description: Baalzebul Baalzebul was the lord of Maladomini , the seventh layer of the Nine Hells , and one of the most powerful archdevil s . Formerly a celestial archon known as Triel , he bore the titles Fallen One , Lord of the Flies , Lord of the Lies , and the Slug Archduke . The last refers to the form he was cursed with after the Reckoning of Hell ; Asmodeus has made his natural form that of a filth - covered giant slug with tiny arms .

title: Baar Tworgeir
description: Baar Tworgeir Baar Tworgeir was a carpenter living in Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , Baar was hired by Deirk Erlich to repair the vacant Tinfellow Farm .

title: Baatezu
description: Baatezu Baatezu were a category of devils inhabiting the Nine Hells of Baator . Like all other devils , they were ruled by the Archdevil s , or " Lords of the Nine " . Baatezu on the Fugue Plane .

title: Baatral
description: Baatral Baatral was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Baatral and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Baazka
description: Baazka Baazka was a pit fiend allied with the Red Wizards of Thay in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . History . Baazka was a powerful pit fiend from the Nine Hells .

title: Babau
description: Babau Babaus usually serve as a spy or assassin to more powerful demons of the Abyss or sometimes to spellcasters on the material plane . Babaus strike with sudden ferocity after forming careful , devious plans . Most demon lords have at least several babaus as minions .

title: Bacao Foo
description: Bacao Foo Bacao Foo was a merchant in Suijeng in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Bacao Foo was a friendly merchant who sat in restaurants waiting for the start of the Komite .

title: Bacar
description: Bacar Bacar are intelligent , ant - like creatures living in the jungle in Far Payit in Maztica . As far as is known the only colony that exists lives in the ruined city of Ixtzul . The Bacar were created by the last ruler of Ixtzul ( Greyst ) using Hishna magic .

title: Baccira
description: Baccira Baccira was a soultaker ghul - kin living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Like all ghul - kin , Baccira used illusions to mask her true appearance , preferring to appear as an attractive dark - haired woman .

title: Backblast
description: Backblast Backblast was an abjuration spell that caused fire - based spells to be turned back and granted some fire resistance . History . The " backblast " spell was first developed by the phaerimm s .

title: Backlands
description: Backlands The Backlands were a large lawless , monster - haunted frontier in the Western Heartlands . The Backlands are all the land between the east of Serpent ' s Tail Stream , the Forest of Wyrms and the Trielta Hills ; north of the River Reaching ; west of Anauroch ; and south of the Greypeak Mountains . History .

title: Badger
description: Badger A badger was a squat , furry with a distinctive white stripe from the tip of its long nose to the back of its head and white cheeks . Expert diggers , badgers were also notorious for their fury when threatened ; despite their small size , when angered their strong bite and sharp claws could be highly dangerous . Badgers were admired by the gnome race and could often be seen serving as " watchdogs " for rock gnome homes .

title: Badger mouse
description: Badger mouse A badger mouse is a mouse - like rodent roughly the size of a badger . They are native to the Duskwood and are most abundant during the Spring , when the ash wheat is in good supply . The badger mice are preyed upon by puff adder s .

title: Badiat al - Farif
description: Badiat al - Farif Badiat al - Farif was a member of the court of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Concerned because the Grand Caliph was unable to produce a male heir , she inquired about the issue at the Mosque of Zann the Wise , tasking them to try to find a solution to the problem .

title: Badiat bint Malin
description: Badiat bint Malin Badiat bint Malin was an influential sha ' ir who lived in Kadarasto in 1367 DR . Activities . Badiat may have been an ally of the Yikarian Empire , working to further the goals of the yak - folk in the Cities of the Ancients .

title: Badrazel
description: Badrazel Badrazel was a male balor and the chief lieutenant of Kurgoth Hellspawn during the Silence of Lolth . Description . He stood roughly 12 ft ( 3 .

title: Bae ' qeshel
description: Bae ' qeshel Bae ' qeshel was a bardic art known to very few drow . Wielders of " bae ' qeshel " were known as the " dark minstrels . " The song was keening and magical .

title: Bael An Ashock
description: Bael An Ashock Bael An Ashok was the tiefling shopkeeper of the Grand Emporium in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . Personality . He usually gave advice to adventurers new to the city .

title: Baelnorn lich
description: Baelnorn lich Baelnorn liches , sometimes simply called baelnorns , were elves who chose a path of Prime - bound duty beyond death . These undead defenders unswervingly protected their clan and its holdings for centuries . The majority of baelnorn were spellcasters , and they maintained their mental and magical abilities in this state , though exceptions occurred .

title: Baeloth Barrityl
description: Baeloth Barrityl Baeloth Barrityl , also known as Baeloth the Entertainer , was a powerful drow sorcerer and the master of The Black Pits , a famous Underdark fighting pit . After being tricked by his servant djinni , Baeloth found himself banished to the topside of the Sword Coast , eventually joining Gorion ' s Ward during the iron crisis of 1368 DR .

title: Baen Chalgash
description: Baen Chalgash Baen Chalgash was a wererat and a high - ranking member of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter . Relationships . The wererat was the brother and lieutenant of Varin Chalgash .

title: Baeniff Tor
description: Baeniff Tor Baeniff Tor was a hill in the marshland of the Evermoors , in Luruar . It was located about 15 miles ( 24 kilometers ) northeast of the town of Nesmé , and 2 miles ( 3 . 2 kilometers ) north of Morach Tor .

title: Baerauble Etharr
description: Baerauble Etharr Baerauble Etharr ( - 116 - 429 DR , later Baerauble the Venerable and Baerauble the Wise ) was a Netherese wizard who lived for many years in the company of the elves inhabiting the Forest Country , and later became the first Royal Magician of Cormyr . Appearance . Baerauble was tall and lean with a ratty reddish beard .

title: Baerdeth Malagar
description: Baerdeth Malagar Baerdeth Malagar was the High Priest or Huntmaster of the High House of the Hunt , a temple devoted to the worship of Malar in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . As Huntmaster , Baerdeth supervised 11 other priests of Malar .

title: Baerelus
description: Baerelus Baerelus the Bold was a satyr and local expert on the lore , flora , and fauna of the King ' s Forest of Cormyr around 1367 DR . Beloved by the people , he enjoyed serving as a guide and source of wise advice to many young Cormyrean s within the area . He was kept informed of what was going on within Cormyr by the confessions of the young folk he spoke to in his daily travels .

title: Baergil
description: Baergil Baergil was a former member of the Riders of Mistledale in 1358 DR . History . Baergil led the Riders of Mistledale until he devoted himself to Tempus and left the Riders to join the church of Tempus .

title: Baergon Bluesword
description: Baergon Bluesword Baergon Bluesword was a cleric of Tempus in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Baergon went to Daggerford with the City Guard of Waterdeep to fight against the evil of Dragonspear Castle .

title: Baerick Hammerstone
description: Baerick Hammerstone Baerick Hammerstone was a dwarf master of the black ice in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . Possessions . Wearing splint mail in battle , Baerick fought with a black ice maul and light hammer .

title: Baerill
description: Baerill Baerill was a human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was one of the proprietors of the Wyvern Watch Inn . Relationships .

title: Baerithryn
