description: Baerithryn Baerithryn , also known as Braer , was an elf wizard who tutored the young Elminster Aumar . History . Baerithryn was an elf living in the High Forest and a powerful wizard , one of the last to know the secret of the magic of weredragon ing .

title: Baerlatha Luruin
description: Baerlatha Luruin Baerlatha Luruin was the soft - spoken wife of the healer of Bargewright Inn , Chanczlatha Luruin , around 1365 DR . Description . Baerlatha was a thin woman with steel - gray eyes and blonde hair .

title: Baern Harbrow
description: Baern Harbrow Baern Harbrow was a War Wizard of Cormyr from Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Glathra Barcantle ordered Harbrow to check a palace gate when Elminster Aumar , Storm Silverhand , Amarune Whitewave , and the ghost of Alusair Obarskyr arrived .

title: Baernaloth
description: Baernaloth Baernoloths are one of the biggest mysteries of the multiverse . They wander in solitude , they scheme and discard them for something even more terrible . According to the rumors , they created the yugoloth s and demodand s .

title: Baeron
description: Baeron Baeron was a human and one of the original Lords of Waterdeep . Along with Shilarn , he overthrew the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh to restore the government of Waterdeep . Relatives .

title: Baert Ghalhunt
description: Baert Ghalhunt Baert Ghalhunt was the personal huntsman of Marlin Stormserpent . History . Around 1479 DR , Marlin sent Ghalhunt to kill all the people that knew his hiding spot .

title: Baervan Wildwanderer
description: Baervan Wildwanderer Baervan Wildwanderer , also known as The Forest Gnome , was the neutral good gnome deity of forests , travel and nature . He lived in the gnomish realm of the Golden Hills . His sacred animal was the raccoon and his holy days were on the full moon .

title: Baerzlus Anagathiir
description: Baerzlus Anagathiir Baerzlus Anagathiir was the only Red Wizards of Thay magister knew for one of the shortest reign ever . Personality . The young Baerzlus believed that becoming Magister will grant him power among his peers .

title: Baffenburg
description: Baffenburg Baffenburg was a large town in what is now the Fell Pass circa approximately - 335 DR . Baffenburg ' s residents were both orc s and dwarves and they had lived together in peace for many years , even merging their languages . It seems as if Baffenburg was originally a surface outpost of Delzoun , much like Citadel Felbarr , Citadel Sundabar and Citadel Adbar .

title: Bag of holding
description: Bag of holding A Bag of holding was a small sack that acted as an opening to a nondimensional space . The space inside the bag could hold a huge amount of materials and it not increase the weight of the bag . History .

title: Baga Choki
description: Baga Choki Baga Choki was a Tuigan warrior and member of the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Description . Baga was tall for a Tuigan and possessed a sinister countenance .

title: Bagatur Jokai
description: Bagatur Jokai Bagatur Jokai was a commander within the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Bagatur commanded an " arban " — a military unit of ten men — within the army .

title: Bagpipes
description: Bagpipes Bagpipes were a type of wind instrument that used a bag filled with the help of a mouthpiece to provide the necessary flow , while the sound came from the attached reed or reeds with different holes to vary the tone . Dwarves held bagpipes in high regard . Mizwid .

title: Bahamut
description: Bahamut Bahamut ( pronounced " bah - HAHM - ut " ) was the dragon god of justice and a subservient deity to Torm , god of law . Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon , he was a member of the Draconic pantheon , as a deity of good dragons , metallic dragons , wisdom , and enlightened justice ( justice tempered with mercy and punishment with forgiveness ) known by the name of Xymor ( pronounced " ZIE - more " ) . For some time he was also a member of the Untheric pantheon , under the alias of Marduk .

title: Bahgtru
description: Bahgtru Bahgtru was a rather stupid god of pure physical strength who scorned both weapons and magic alike . He was the son of Gruumsh . Worshipers .

title: Bahija Jalin
description: Bahija Jalin Bahija Jalin was a potion vendor who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Due to skillful application of make - up , Bahija appeared to be in her 90 ' s .

title: Bahija al - Kesir
description: Bahija al - Kesir Bahija al - Kesir was a human pragmatist within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Bahija led a contingent of priests who operated the palace hospital .

title: Bahramiyah al - Musafir
description: Bahramiyah al - Musafir Bahramiyah al - Musafir was a caravan master from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . For over 40 years Bahramiyah oversaw the great caravans that transported fine weapons crafted by the House of Bulad from Hiyal to Qudra .

title: Bai Kabor
description: Bai Kabor The Bai Kabor were one of the over 100 Bedine tribes . Honor was prime among the Bedine ' s beliefs . The Bai Kabor had a harsh existence , but their death and hardship made them resilient to the many obstacles they faced .

title: Baishiria
description: Baishiria Baishiria was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Baishiria was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Baiyosho Degi
description: Baiyosho Degi Baiyosho Degi was a monk member of the Tairo in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Baiyosho was a monk from a family that had always provided generations of faithful servitors to the shogunate .

title: Bakar
description: Bakar Bakar , a survivor state of the Imaskar Empire , disappeared in approximately 357 DR when the River Athis dried up due to the curse of Bakar ' s last pharoah , Amun - Re . Bakar was located in Raurin , and it was the most recent of Imaskar ' s survivor states to rule there . Notable locations .

title: Bakhara Spires
description: Bakhara Spires The Bukhara Spires were circles of massive bronze spires , each etched with an intricate runic design said to be Batrachi in origin . These spires were created in the Early Dynastic period ( - 7975 to - 6422 DR ) , by the Imaskari who , around this time , had mastered transdimensional magic . These permanant , two - way portals allowed the rapid transportation of whole legions over vast distances in the blink of an eye .

title: Bakshi
description: Bakshi The Bakshi were a yakuza clan who dominated the city of Ojy - do in Koryo around 1357 DR . Organization . At that time , the Bakshi were headed by So Golin - po , nicknamed " the Hojyko Yada " , of " the mountain badger " .

title: Bala
description: Bala Bala was a goddess of music of Zakhara and emphasized the importance of music to lift the spirit and mitigate suffering . She was a local goddess who was worshipped in the city of Mahabba , but her faith was outlawed and driven underground by the Pantheists . In this persecution her followers spread to other cities .

title: Balacer Macefist
description: Balacer Macefist Balacer Macefist was a human male and the Commander of the Golden Fortress Military Academy in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . The Golden Fortress was the primary garrison of the Amnian Army and Balacer Macefist commanded a total of 25 , 000 troops , officers , instructors , and trainees . Commander Macefist took orders from General Labak Craumerdaun but could act independently to aid the city if needed .

title: Balagos
description: Balagos Balagos , known as the Flying Flame , was one of the most famous red dragon s . Personality . Balagos was a megalomaniac .

title: Balanzia
description: Balanzia Balanzia was a dead city in T ' u Lung . Founded in 422 DR , Balanzia was once one of the largest cities in all Kara - Tur , thanks to its easy access to Zastrasai Bay and the Straits of Va ' shung , as well as its great sea wall and its magnificent towers . However , in 1118 DR , a wandering wise man named Loarru the Just came to Balanzia , advising that the city would fall , but nobody listened .

title: Baldur ' s Gate
description: Baldur ' s Gate Baldur ' s Gate , also called simply the Gate , was a metropolis and city - state on the Sword Coast and Western Heartlands border , on the north bank of the River Chionthar about 20 miles ( 32 km ) east from its mouth on the Sea of Swords . It was located to the south of the great city - state of Waterdeep and to the north of the country of Amn , and was located along the well - traveled Coast Way road . This wealthy port metropolis , whose population , according to many accounts , exceeded that of Waterdeep , was an important merchant city on the Sword Coast .

title: Baldur ' s Gate ( game )
description: Baldur ' s Gate ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate is a computer role - playing game developed by and released in 1998 by . It is the first game in the " Baldur ' s Gate " series , and is set in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn . The gameplay is adapted from 2nd edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules , featuring a mixture of turn - based and pausable real - time combat .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance is the first in a series of role - playing games developed exclusively for game consoles . It was developed by Snowblind Studios and released for the PlayStation 2 in 2001 , with versions for the Xbox and Nintendo GameCube releasing in 2002 . A Game Boy Advance version of " Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance " was also released in 2004 , by Magic Pockets .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II Baldur ' s Gate : Dark Alliance II is a computer role - playing game developed by Black Isle Studios for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox , released in 2004 . " Dark Alliance II " returned to Baldur ' s Gate with a new story and new characters . The story begins when the player ' s previous three heroes are taken prisoner by an evil vampire king , Mordoc SeLanmere .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Enhanced Edition
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Enhanced Edition Baldur ' s Gate : Enhanced Edition is a remake of the 1998 video game " Baldur ' s Gate " and its expansion , " " . Released in 2012 , the " Enhanced Edition " adds several hours worth of new content , along with numerous technological improvements . New features .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Siege of Dragonspear
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Siege of Dragonspear Baldur ' s Gate : Siege of Dragonspear is an expansion to " " that takes place between " Baldur ' s Gate " and " " . Features . " Siege of Dragonspear " features new areas along the Sword Coast , more than 100 new items , four new NPCs , a new class ( shaman ) , and new difficulty modes .

title: Baldur ' s Gate : Tales of the Sword Coast
description: Baldur ' s Gate : Tales of the Sword Coast Baldur ' s Gate : Tales of the Sword Coast is an expansion pack for the video game " Baldur ' s Gate " . Released in 1999 , " Tales of the Sword Coast " adds 20 – 30 hours worth of content to the " Baldur ' s Gate " campaign .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Enhanced Edition
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Enhanced Edition " Baldur ' s Gate II : Enhanced Edition " is a remake of the 2000 video game " " and its expansion , " " . Released in 2013 , the " Enhanced Edition " adds several hours worth of new content , along with numerous technological improvements . New features .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( game )
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn is the second computer role - playing game in the Baldur ' s Gate series and takes place just a few months after the events of " Baldur ' s Gate " . It is based on the outdated Advanced Dungeons and Dragons 2nd Edition system . Features .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( novel )
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn ( novel ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Shadows of Amn is the second book in the Baldur ' s Gate trilogy by Philip Athans and Drew Karpyshyn . Characters . Main characters .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( game )
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( game ) Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal is an expansion pack for the computer role - playing game , and is the final chapter in the Baldur ' s Gate series . It adds one large optional bonus area to the Baldur ' s Gate II game : Watcher ' s Keep , a multi - level dungeon of sorts . Plot .

title: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( novel )
description: Baldur ' s Gate II : Throne of Bhaal ( novel ) Summary . In " Throne of Bhaal " , Abdel Adrian has gained a superstrength , so it seems he is invincible . But he is no match when it comes to the other five Bhaalspawn , which include Illasera , who has cursed arrows that can pierce even his flesh , and many others .

title: Baldur ' s Gate series
description: Baldur ' s Gate series The " Baldur ' s Gate " series of computer games by BioWare Corp and the now - defunct Black Isle Studios have become some of the most respected computer roleplaying games to date . Followed by a trilogy of novels that weren ' t received nearly as well , the games are still played by a large , devoted group . The modding community is also still fairly vibrant as are the official ( and several unofficial ) forums .

title: Baldur ' s Gate trilogy ( novels )
description: Baldur ' s Gate trilogy ( novels ) The Baldur ' s Gate trilogy are the novelizations of the " Baldur ' s Gate " computer game series . The first two novels are written by Philip Athans , editor of the " Forgotten Realms " novel line , and the third by Drew Karpyshyn . The novels are based on the storylines of the computer game series .

title: Balduran
description: Balduran Balduran is a legendary seafaring explorer . He was the first native of Faerûn to set foot on the lands known as Anchorome and made the trek up to Sossal . He returned full of tales and vast wealth .

title: Balduran ' s Log Book
description: Balduran ' s Log Book Balduran ' s Log Book was the incomplete logbook of Captain Balduran , detailing his journey to Anchorome . It lay in the wreck of his ship , the " Wandering Eye " , on Werewolf Island . It was damaged by time and the elements .

title: Balhiir
description: Balhiir Balhiir are energy creatures that feed off of magic , any form of magic , from thrown spells to s up to dragon magic . While they cannot be harmed with mundane objects , they can be drained or ' prisoned with telekinesis . A balhiir can only be destroyed by its releaser .

title: Balian ' s yellow ioun stone
description: Balian ' s yellow ioun stone Balian ' s yellow ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " that boosted a random physical or mental trait of the bearer . Powers . When attuned , this seemingly faulty " ioun stone " gave an enhancement to one physical or mental trait of the bearer , as with " ioun stones " , but this was decided randomly each day .

title: Balian Rocksmith
description: Balian Rocksmith Balian Rocksmith was a guard . Whilst serving as a guard at a convention of wizard s , Balian discovered a seemingly faulty " ioun stone " on the floor , apparently lost after it stopped functioning . It became known as " Balian ' s yellow ioun stone " .

title: Balismo Dey Canna
description: Balismo Dey Canna Balismo Dey Canna was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Balismo was a noble of Calimport who , at the Amn ian court , decided to join the expedition to Maztica .

title: Baliver ' s House of Horses
description: Baliver ' s House of Horses Baliver ' s House of Horses was a rental stable in Luskan . History . The stables consisted of a series of walled paddocks and sheds located at the south end of the Upstream Span .

title: Balix
description: Balix Balix was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The drow was a wizard and a historian .

title: Ball lightning
description: Ball lightning Ball lightning , also known as nautical ball lightning , was an arcane conjuration spell that produced one or more spheres of coruscating electricity that skimmed along surfaces , possibly catching them on fire . Effects . This spell had a range of 180 ft ( 55 m ) and lasted a number of minutes equal to the caster ' s level .

title: Balor
description: Balor Balors , also known as type VI demon s , were one of the most powerful types of tanar ' ri . They were found serving as generals under demon lord s or even as minor princelings . Description .

title: Balor ( individual )
description: Balor ( individual ) Balor was the greatest of the balor tanar ' ri demon s and the reason that his race was known as balors . History . Balor served all of the demon lord s at one point or another in his life .

title: Balrik Daershun
description: Balrik Daershun Balrik Daershun was a male bandit in the Dalelands . History . Balrik fought for Lashan Aumersair in his war of conquest of the Dalelands .

title: Baltak
description: Baltak Baltak was a drow wizard from Sshamath . Activities . Baltak was a talented transmogrifist , always busy isculpting his body in an effort to attain the perfect form .

title: Balthazar
description: Balthazar Balthazar was a human Bhaalspawn and a monk , and one of the Five . He was perhaps the most powerful of them , and the only one whose goal was not to achieve power for himself . The game .

title: Balthorr Olaskos
description: Balthorr Olaskos Balthorr " the Bold " Olaskos was a fence and trader in Waterdeep who specialized primarily in currency , coins , and various rare trinkets . Personality . Olaskos was often able to relate a story about any particular item on the spot .

title: Baltir Merivolst
description: Baltir Merivolst Baltir Merivolst was the most famous commander of the Knights of the Flying Hunt in 1374 DR . Personality . Baltir took personal care of the teaching of some of the Knights ' recruits , knowing that it was vital to have a high level of training , like he had had .

title: Baltor
description: Baltor Baltor was a druid who lived in Dambrath . Activities . While in the shape of a dolphin , Baltor studied the enigmatic creatures who clustered off of the shores of southern Dambrath .

title: Bambryn
description: Bambryn Bambryn was a village in the Vast , lying on the crossroads of the Hlintar Ride , between Hlintar and Dark Hollow , and the Long Reach , between Sendrin and Orlimmin . History . During the early Time of Glorious Fools , after human s first settled the central Vast in the mid – 7th century DR , the vengeful bandit Iljack of the Black Blade plagued the central Vast .

title: Bamsmack
description: Bamsmack Bamsmacks were diversion tools used by some rogue s . Uses . Imported from exotic Shou Lung , bamsmacks were made from bamboo reed and stuffed with salt .

title: Banak
description: Banak Banak was once the top ranked evil priest in all the Bloodstone lands . He was 24th level until Gareth Dragonsbane and party banished Banak ' s demon patron Orcus , from Faerûn . Since his patron ' s fall , Banak can cast 1st through 3rd level spells and occasionally casts a higher level .

title: Banak Brawnanvil
description: Banak Brawnanvil Banak Brawnanvil was one of the dwarves of Mithral Hall who defended against the orc s led by Urlgen Threefist . He was the High Commander . In 1370 DR , during the battle with army of orcs commanded by King Obould Many - Arrows , he was hurt by a goblin spear .

title: Bandaerl
description: Bandaerl Bandaerl , son of Rykos , blood of Melair , High Old One of Dumathoin , and protector of Melairbode ' s essence was a dwarven archlich of the Melairkyn clan who protected the tomb of King Melair I in the depths of Undermountain , formerly home to this ancient clan .

title: Bandagh
description: Bandagh Bandagh was a orc in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Bandagh was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .

title: Bandar al - Sa ' adat
description: Bandar al - Sa ' adat Bandar al - Sa ' adat was a town located on the isle of Masud Jazayir in the Nada al - Hazan archipelago within the Crowded Sea south of mainland Zakhara . Organization . The town could field a militia of 100 soldiers who were adept at defending against pirate raids .

title: Banded agate
description: Banded agate Banded agate was a form of opaque agate with striations of brown , red , blue , and / or white . Description . These ornamental stones were polished smooth and had a waxy feel making it ideal for " worry stones " or " soothe stones " that some merchants would rub or fondle to relieve stress during negotiations .

title: Banderhobb
description: Banderhobb Banderhobbs were creatures resembling bipedal toads . They were hybrids of shadow and flesh created by magical means . Creation .

title: Bandit camp ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Bandit camp ( Mere of Dead Men ) This unnamed bandit camp was a camp located at the southern end of the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast . Location . The bandit camp was located near Fort Locke .

title: Bando
description: Bando Bando the Lame was an old halfling priest of Tymora in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Bando was once injured in a battle with three lizardfolk , which gave him an injured leg and a deep hatred for the scaly fiends .

title: Bandore
description: Bandore Bandores were bass - range musical instruments similar to cittern s . Description . The sound of the bandore was rich and mellow , and it was capable of reaching lower notes than usual citterns which made them good accompanying instruments for quieter voices .

title: Bane
description: Bane Bane ( pronounced " BAIN " ) was the evil and malicious greater deity of fear , hatred and tyranny and ruler of Banehold . Preferring to plot and scheme , Bane rarely appeared to act in a direct manner ; instead acting through his worshipers and other various agents . His ultimate goal was to eventually control all of Faerûn .

title: Bane ( spell )
description: Bane ( spell ) Bane was an enchantment spell that sapped enemy morale and reduced their combat effectiveness . A conjuration version was known by the name curse and was the reverse of " bless " . Effects .

title: Baneblades of Demron
description: Baneblades of Demron The Baneblades of Demron were six powerful magic sword s forged for the defenders of Myth Drannor before its fall . The archmage Demron was credited with their creation over some three centuries , but they were cooperative efforts among all the races that dwelled in Myth Drannor . Each was designed for a member of a particular race or profession , and their magic ceased to function for anyone else , leaving only a nonmagical weapon of otherwise fine quality .

title: Baneguard
description: Baneguard Baneguards were animated skeleton s with magical abilities originally created by cleric s of Bane . The spell " create baneguard " eventually propagated to other evil - and neutral - aligned faiths that found these capable guardians acceptable . Description .

title: Banehold
description: Banehold Banehold , sometimes called the Barrens of Doom and Despair , or Gehenna , particularly in the past , is an evil - aligned plane of existence . It is one of a number of Outer Planes , one of inhospitable locales , including vast deserts of black sand and huge plains of dark granite . There is no water to be found anywhere on the plane , and no sunlight fills the blood - red sky .

title: Banelar naga
description: Banelar naga Banelar nagas ( also simply called banelars ) were evil , spell - wielding naga s with large , humanoid heads . Description . Their eyes had a green tint to them , and their scales were a greenish purple , but they had brown tails tipped with stingers .

title: Banelich
description: Banelich A banelich was a lich who was a cleric of Bane during his or her mortal life . Baneliches acted and looked the same as others of their kind , but they continued to worship Bane as an undead . They had the same immunities as regular liches , and gained the rest of the undeads ' powers , such as " paralytic touch " .

title: Bangor Battlehammer
description: Bangor Battlehammer Bangor Battlehammer was the father of the more famous Bruenor Battlehammer , king of Mithral Hall . Appendix . Notes .

title: Bani Matruj al - Haddar
description: Bani Matruj al - Haddar Bani Matruj al - Haddar , or the Silent Sheikh , was a goblin barber living in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Bani was talkative to the point where he would continue to talk until gagged .

title: Banish dazzle
description: Banish dazzle Banish dazzle was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Banishing smite
description: Banishing smite Banishing smite was an abjuration spell for paladin s that made a weapon crackle with power and cause more damage . Effects . The spell caused the chosen weapon to crackle with power and cause serious damage .

title: Banishment
description: Banishment Banishment was an abjuration spell that banished outsider s to their home plane . Effects . A " banishment " spell was a more powerful version of the " dismissal " spell .

title: Baniya Dolester
description: Baniya Dolester Baniya Dolester was a human female priest ess of Lliira in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , she served as High Priest of the Hall of Success temple in the Temple District of Procampur .

title: Bankenfuere
description: Bankenfuere Bankenfuere was Berkthgar the Bold ' s large flamberge sword . Description . The sword had a wavy 4 - ft - long ( 1 .

title: Banner of renown
description: Banner of renown The Banner of renown was a magical flag that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This flag displayed the moon and trailing stars symbol of the Land of Fate .

title: Banshee
description: Banshee A Banshee is a female phantom , embodying the essence of hideousness . Banshees are the spirits of strongwilled , selfish humanoids . They are undead creatures who delight in bringing death to any living creature .

title: Bapar Ghalmrin
description: Bapar Ghalmrin Bapar Ghalmrin was a member of Clan Ghalmrin in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Bapar , as the fourth son , was always considered redundant and expendable , so he dreamed of finding the Wyrmskull Throne and gaining the respect of his distant father and his oldest brothers .

title: Baphomet
description: Baphomet Baphomet was a demon lord who ruled a layer of the Abyss called the Endless Maze . He was the Prince of Beasts and the Demon Lord of Minotaur s . Description .

title: Bar - lgura
description: Bar - lgura Bar - lguras or barlguras , also known as leaping demons , were ape - like tanar ' ri demon s . Description . Bar - lguras were covered in reddish - brown hair and stood between 5 and 6 feet tall .

title: Bara Minora
description: Bara Minora Bara Minora was a halfling who worked and cared for Hama Sayif within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Bara played her drums while Hama performed his mystical dances .

title: Baraedin
description: Baraedin The Baraedin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Baraedins were allied with the Mithertul , Onsil , and Naskurl families .

title: Baragustas Harbuckler
description: Baragustas Harbuckler Baragustas Harbuckler was a retired carpenter in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationships . Baragustas was an old member of Believers .

title: Barakuir
description: Barakuir Barakuir ( the Iron Kingdom ) was a kingdom of the dwarven realm of Shanatar , dominated by the shield dwarf Clan Duergar , whose inhabitants would eventually be transformed into the gray dwarves . The kingdom venerated Laduguer and was ruled by a priest - king who was known as the Iron Shield . History .

title: Baralea Braceryn
description: Baralea Braceryn Baralea Braceryn was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was rotund , but with bird - like quickness .

title: Baran al - Amin al - Jinn
description: Baran al - Amin al - Jinn Baran al - Amin al - Jinn was a janni who lived in Al - Yabki Mountains in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . As a priest of Kor , Baran donned the robes of a " qadi " and began acting as a judge at a sacred site in the mountains near Turab and Sikak .

title: Barandos Hawklin
description: Barandos Hawklin Barandos Hawklin was the popular head of the Hawklin noble family in Suzail in 1368 DR . Description . He had urbane good looks .

title: Baraskur
description: Baraskur Baraskur was the main settlement of the Ripped Gut orc tribe . Description . The cavernous fortress of Baraskur was built in memory of a great orc hero .

title: Barasta Cleeith
description: Barasta Cleeith Barasta Cleeith was a high - ranking member of the Church of Waukeen and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Barasta was the daughter of the Amn ian noble Lord Lurraxol and the wife of fellow noble Lord Cleeith .

title: Baravar Cloakshadow
description: Baravar Cloakshadow Baravar Cloakshadow , known as the Sly One , was the neutral good gnome deity of illusion and deception . His dogma primarily concerned the protection of the gnome race through the art of illusion . Worshipers .

title: Barbarian
description: Barbarian Barbarians were mighty warrior s who rely on their strength and incredible toughness , characterized by a bestial rage empowered either by ancestral totem s and nature spirit s or an inner passion for violence . Barbarians were less versatile than fighter s but were tougher and capable of dealing heavy damage to their foes much more quickly . The most famous barbarian of Toril was likely Wulfgar , friend and companion to Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Barbarian lands ( Utter East )
description: Barbarian lands ( Utter East ) East of the kingdom of Ulgarth , in the northern Utter East of the far southeast Faerûn lay barbarian - inhabited lands . Geography . The land was a vast plain , uncharted by the neighboring civilizations .

title: Barbarians ' Road
description: Barbarians ' Road Barbarians ' Road was a road in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It ran north – south , joining the settlements of Dralpur and Kellesar . It formed the well - patrolled border with the barbarian lands to the east .

title: Barbazu
description: Barbazu Barbazus , also called bearded devils , were the shock troops of the Nine Hells . They led armies of lemure s . Physical description .

title: Barbed dart
description: Barbed dart A barbed dart was a very large dart that is both fletched and barbed . They measured 2 – 3 ft ( 60 – 90 cm ) in length and weighed around 5 lb ( 2 . 5 kg ) .

title: Barber
description: Barber Barbers were rogue s inhabiting the bazaars of Zakhara . Requirements . All types of rogues could be barbers .

title: Barber Shop of Gorar al - Aksar
description: Barber Shop of Gorar al - Aksar The Barber Shop of Gorar al - Aksar was a prominent fixture of the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The walls of the barber shop were festooned with astrological charts and graphs .

title: Bard
description: Bard Bards were versatile arcane spellcaster s , capable in combat , art , and magic alike . Bards practiced magic as they would art or song , using their artistic talents to induce magical effects that either bolstered their allies or hindered their enemies , typically through charms and illusions . In addition to their magical skills , bards were artistically talented and extraordinarily well - learned , possessing knowledge in a wide range of fields .

title: Bardan ruqad
description: Bardan ruqad Bardan ruqad , which translated in Midani as " cold sleep " , was a rare poison . Properties . " Bardan ruqad " was a strong poison capable of instantly paralyzing the victim .

title: Bardran Thulmaer
description: Bardran Thulmaer Shield Duke Bardran Thulmaer was the well - loved leader of the town of Alamontyr . Description . He was an aging but large man with a huge white moustache .

title: Bardshyr
description: Bardshyr County Bardshyr was a wide stretch of cattle fields and ranches in the Purple Marches of Tethyr and the site of Castle Tethyr before its destruction . Geography . Bardshyr was the northeastern county of the Purple Marches , located south of the Sulduskoon River .

title: Bareris Anskuld
description: Bareris Anskuld Bareris Anskuld was a human bard . . As a bard he worshipped Oghma and Milil .

title: Barge House
description: Barge House The Barge House was a large tavern found in Daleport in 1357 DR . Description . Converted from an old warehouse , the Barge House was massive , easily holding 500 occupants at one time .

title: Bargewright Inn
description: Bargewright Inn The Bargewright Inn was an important wayside hub for travelers of all sorts located on Jundar ' s Hill overlooking Ironford on the River Dessarin . Geography . To the south of the Bargewright Inn was Goldenfields .

title: Barghest
description: Barghest Barghests are evil fiendish shapechanger lupines . Physical description . In its normal form , it resembles a goblin - wolf hybrid with monstrous jaws and razor sharp claws .

title: Barglun Blackbutter
description: Barglun Blackbutter Barglun Blackbutter was the founder of the Blackbutter Inn in Red Larch . Personality . Barglun was a fat and jovial individual who was fondly remembered as a local legend in the village .

title: Baric Nylef
description: Baric Nylef Baric Nylef was a knight of Tyr in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Baric was a member of the Order of the Gauntlet .

title: Barimus Whitehand
description: Barimus Whitehand Barimus Whitehand was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Barjin
description: Barjin Barjin was a powerful cleric of Talona . Background . Not much is known of Barjin ' s past .

title: Barkskin
description: Barkskin Barkskin was a druid evocation and a transmutation or alteration spell that toughened the skin to a bark - like consistency . Effects . " Barkskin " toughened the skin of the creature touched , giving it natural armor .

title: Barlowe
description: Barlowe Barlowe was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Barlowe was the runner of the smuggler ' s warehouse .

title: Barrelstalk
description: Barrelstalk Barrelstalk was a fungus that grew in the Underdark , named for its barrel - like shape . It had a hard , woody outer surface , but the inside was hollow and could contain about 5 to 8 gallons ( 19 to 30 liters ) of potable water . The inner rings of the barrelstalk were made from an edible pulp .

title: Barrelstone Inn
description: Barrelstone Inn The Barrelstone Inn was a low - quality inn run by around twenty jovial gnome s in Marsember , Cormyr in 1367 DR . Location . The inn was situated on the island immediately south of Starwater Keep in the Cormyrian area .

title: Barrier of retention
description: Barrier of retention Barrier of retention was an abjuration spell that created a temporary containment trap for all creatures in an area . Effects . The area of effect for this spell was a 10 ft ( 3 .

title: Barriltar Bhandraddon
description: Barriltar Bhandraddon High Priest Barriltar Bhandraddon served as Torm ' s pontiff and ruled from the magnificent Temple of Torm ' s Coming in Tantras . From this place , the pontiff extended Torm ' s reach and worship by sponsoring continent - wide knightly orders , including the prestigious Order of the Golden Lion .

title: Barroch
description: Barroch Barroch was said to be the first great bandit lord of the Inner Sea lands . He made his lair at Barroch ' s Hold , a fabled citadel in the Glacier of the White Worm . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , a band of adventurers rediscovered Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm .

title: Barroch ' s Hold
description: Barroch ' s Hold Barroch ' s Hold was a citadel located on the Glacier of the White Worm in the Earthspur Mountains , and once the fabled lair of Barroch , the first great bandit lord of the Inner Sea . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , a band of adventurers rediscovered Barroch ' s Hold but soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed . Two of them survived — Yostur Ulhmond and Feenoch the Five - Fingered — and made it to Orm to tell their story , though they would not be drawn on the matter of treasure .

title: Barrowin Undurr
description: Barrowin Undurr Barrowin Undurr was a devoted dwarf cleric of Gorm Gulthyn . She had a dour outlook on life but would always stand against evil , especially when it moved against dwarvenkind . History .

title: Barthelby
description: Barthelby Barthelby was a high - ranking priest of Jergal in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , an omen reveled that some tombs holy to Jergal inside Undermountain had been forgotten and needed to be tended .

title: Bartholomew Blackdagger
description: Bartholomew Blackdagger Bartholomew Blackdagger was an undead pirate in service to Garrundar in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . Bartholomew led a very powerful band of sky pirates .

title: Barthus
description: Barthus Barthus was a vampire priest of Bane that somewhere after the Spellplague established himself in the catacombs under the ruins of Spellgard . Using his divine powers , he cowed several undead already there into his service and created more from captured victims . Appearance .

title: Barundar mac Idrin
description: Barundar mac Idrin Barundar mac Idrin was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord of Earthfast in the 8th century DR . History . Barundar was the son of Idrin .

title: Barunga Foestone
description: Barunga Foestone Barunga Foestone was a frost giant in the late 15th century DR . History . Barunga was part of the frost giant tribe that allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening .

title: Barze
description: Barze Barze was an ancient , now - fallen kingdom neighboring what is now Vaasa . It was located between what would eventually be known as the West Galena Mountains and the Vercy Wood . History .

title: Basad el Ostak
description: Basad el Ostak Basad yn Malik el Ostak was the leader of el Kahmir clan in Memnon in 1370 DR , chosen by that family to oversee the assassins ' , thieves ' , smugglers ' , and slavers ' guilds there . He was young at the time and loyal to the syl - pasha . Relationships .

title: Basadoni
description: Basadoni Pasha Basadoni was the leader of House Basadoni , the most powerful Thieves ' guild in Calimport and so one of the masters of Calimport ' s underworld . Basadoni tutored the young Artemis Entreri , who worked for Basadoni in his early years before entering the service of Pasha Pook . When Enteri returned to Calimport in 1364 DR , Pasha Basadoni invited him to join again , but Entreri refused .

title: Basel Indoulur
description: Basel Indoulur Basel Indoulur was the governor of Halagard in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Activities . Basel was an accomplished Conjurer .

title: Basem bin Rumi
description: Basem bin Rumi Basem bin Rumi was a gnome alchemist and researcher living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Basem was a friendly fellow who was easily distracted by fantasies .

title: Bashal ' s Tendrilight
description: Bashal ' s Tendrilight Bashal ' s Tendrilight was a magical lantern that could emit a dark tendril , which could attack an opponent . Description . The lantern was rectangular with a half - foot - by - half - foot base .

title: Bashenee
description: Bashenee Bashenee was a githzerai craftsman . In a past age , in a realm beyond the Astral Plane , Bashenee created an " incandescent blue ioun stone " for a great githzerai monk , who later fell in battle with githyanki . The githyanki took the stone for their own .

title: Basidia
description: Basidia Basidia was the new myconid leader of the Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Two years before , Basidia undertook a migration of its colony through the Underdark until they arrived in the Neverlight Grove , where fellow sovereign Phylo welcomed it , happy to have someone to share the burdens of leadership with .

title: Basil
description: Basil Basil of Lyndusfarne was an unusual verbeeg in the service of the Kingdom of Hartsvale in the 1370s DR . He was a runecaster , a rarity among his people . He met and befriended Tavis Burdun , just moments before the princess Brianna was kidnapped .

title: Basil Arness
description: Basil Arness Basil Arness was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Basil was a member of the Champions of Muktar .

title: Basil Willowbrook
description: Basil Willowbrook Basil Willowbrook was a halfling innkeeper in Skullport . History . Once an adventurer in the Shining South , Basil settled in the Lower Heart district of Skullport , where he opened the Bindle ' s Blade inn .

title: Basilisk
description: Basilisk Basilisks were large , eight - legged reptile s with the terrifying ability to poison or petrify their prey . Though not malicious , basilisks were indisputably dangerous . They could be found all over Faerûn .

title: Basket trick
description: Basket trick Basket trick was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable only by wizard s . Effects .

title: Baskor Tranth
description: Baskor Tranth Baskor Tranth was a surly wizard who dwelt in Suzail , frequenting its bars and taverns . Activities . He was haunted by the horrific memories he had of escaping the fall of Myth Drannor alone .

title: Bassana
description: Bassana Bassana was a spy of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Bassana was one of the agents of Boubakar of Golconda .

title: Bassorah
description: Bassorah Bassorah was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Bassorah was a shrew of a woman .

title: Bastabar Yulgont
description: Bastabar Yulgont Bastabar Yulgont was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Bastabar was on the high side of middle age and his once - toned body had become rotund and flabby .

title: Bastard sword
description: Bastard sword A bastard sword , also called a hand - and - a - half sword , is a weapon that is in between a longsword and a greatsword . Description . A bastard sword can be used in either one or two hands , thus giving it its name .

title: Bastian Thermandar
description: Bastian Thermandar Bastian Thermandar was the second - in - command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bastian was a very paranoid individual , not trusting anyone .

title: Bastion of good
description: Bastion of good Bastion of good is an abjuration spell that conjures a mighty barrier against evil attacks . Effect . A nimbus of light surrounds you , protecting you and those around you from spell effects and the attacks of evil creatures .

title: Bastun
description: Bastun Bastun was a Vremyonni wizard of Rashemen . Appearance . Bastun wore a dark mask of wood inlaid with silver whorls and tiny designs resembling thorny vines that covered his face from forehead to jawline .

title: Basult ' s Books
description: Basult ' s Books Basult ' s Books was a bookshop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , on the western end of the city . " Circa " 1374 DR , it was the only bookseller in town , and was run by Amnic and Mela Basult . History .

title: Bat
description: Bat Bats were a group of wild , flying mammal s of generally small size that fed on other small mammals , insect s , reptile s , or fruit . Although the majority of bats were small , a few larger varieties existed . Bats were almost all nocturnal .

title: Bat ' s Roost
description: Bat ' s Roost The Bat ' s Roost was a tavern in the Central Port of Skullport . Geography . The tavern was located in the northwest corner of the Central Port near the Pierced Navel and Gentleman ' s Groggery .

title: Bathaerel
description: Bathaerel Bathaerel was a purplish powder made from rocks found in the Abyssal layers of Rauwend and Voorz ' zt . When mixed with water , potato es and green plants and placed in a bag with rusty metal items , it will remove the rust from the iron .

title: Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods
description: Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods The Bathhouses of Jisan of the Floods were located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Bathhouses of Jisan were located south of the Caravan District .

title: Batihat al - Saji
description: Batihat al - Saji Batihat al - Saji , also known as the Lagoon of the Brave , was a bay on Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The blue waters of this lagoon were calm , concealing the terror that lay on the bottom .

title: Batina al - Shaat
description: Batina al - Shaat Batina al - Shaat was a moralist priest of Hajama and the leader of the Preachers in 1367 DR . Personality . Batina was a rogue compared to other moralist priests in Zakhara .

title: Batiri
description: Batiri The Batiri were a collection of clans and tribes of goblin s in Chult known and feared for their tracking skills . Description . Most Batiri had green skin , which blended well with the jungle surroundings .

title: Batrachi
description: Batrachi Batrachi were an amphibious race that are counted as one of the Creator Races . Geographical Region . It was discovered by illithids in 1370 DR that the batrachi ruled at least as far north as the Black Sea and as far south as Lopango .

title: Battering Wave
description: Battering Wave The Battering Wave was a temple of Umberlee in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , the temple was led by Thogonia Grim , who was still in charge by 1370 DR . She was served by six priests of fanatical beliefs .

title: Battle at the Bar
description: Battle at the Bar The Battle at the Bar was a fight that broke out in the common room of the Whistling Wizard inn sometime around the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . It involved two independent and uncoordinated Harper groups , members of a slavery and smuggling ring known as the Tarntar , an illithid , an ogre mage , at least two doppelganger s , various bodyguards , and eventually the local law enforcers . Location .

title: Battle captain
description: Battle captain Battle captains are frontline commanders and officers , warlord s who feel most confident leading their troops into battle personally . A battle captain is good for morale in a company of warrior s , obtaining a hard - earned devotion through their own accomplishments rather than merely titles or tactical brilliance . Few can inspire devotion in those following them as can a well - trained and courageous battle captain .

title: Battle mage
description: Battle mage Battle mages are wizard s trained in the heat of combat , developing their abilities for the purpose of offensive use . Battle mages are dangerous to behold , deadly and capable of long - term combat survival . Battle mages can be as useful as a fighter in a melee or as deadly as a ranger from afar , depending on the wizard ’ s individual preference .

title: Battle of Bloody Reeds
description: Battle of Bloody Reeds The Battle of Bloody Reeds was a battle fought in Impiltur against an orc horde from Vastar in the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR . Events . Lead up .

title: Battle of Bones
description: Battle of Bones The Battle of Bones was the name given to an old battlefield in the Western Heartlands . History . The Battle was named after a huge battle between human s and various goblinoid races in the year 1090 DR .

title: Battle of Bryn Shander
description: Battle of Bryn Shander Took place in 1351 The Year of the Crown . The barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale often raided the villages of the Ten Towns , but as autumn of 1351 DR came and the herds moved south , the tribes chose to make one massive thrust in an attempt to occupy the communities and live off slave labor . A traitor from one of the communities revealed his plan of attack .

title: Battle of Caer Moray
description: Battle of Caer Moray The Battle of Caer Moray was a brief assault on the lycanthrope - held castle at Caer Moray on the Isle of Moray in the Moonshae Isles . Lycanthropes loyal to the god Malar attacked the settlement at night . They attempted to use rough - cut logs as ladders to scale the castle walls but were initially repelled .

title: Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger
description: Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger The Battle of Daelyth ' s Dagger took place on Tarsakh 11 , 1374 DR , between the daemonfey and their minions , and the Argent Legion and the elves . It occurred in the valley known as Daelyth ' s Dagger . The battle was an easy victory for the Argent Legion thanks to their superior tactics .

title: Battle of Deepfires
description: Battle of Deepfires The Battle of Deepfires was a battle fought beneath Mount Grimmerfang between the shield dwarves of Roldilar and the orcs of the Vast in north Faerûn in the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR . It marked the fall of the kingdom of the Roldilar . Events .

title: Battle of Demarch ' s Fall
description: Battle of Demarch ' s Fall The Battle of Demarch ' s Fall was a battle fought in the Halls of Demarch beneath the city of Tantras in the Vast in north Faerûn , between rival factions of Demarch ' s Alliance . Events . Demarch ' s Alliance was an alliance between beguiler s who served Leira and those who served Mask .

title: Battle of Fell Pass
description: Battle of Fell Pass The Battle of Fell Pass took place centuries ago in Fell Pass between Delzoun dwarves and orc s . As of 1370 DR their ghost s still occupy the pass . Battle .

title: Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm
description: Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm The Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm was a battle between Indrila ' s human army and the half - elves that took place in what would become Aglarond in 1065 DR . The battle was won by Brindor ' s half - elves , and Brindor went on to become king of the newly created nation of Aglarond . Motivations .

title: Battle of Keeper ' s Dale
description: Battle of Keeper ' s Dale The Battle of Keeper ' s Dale , known as Yvonnel ' s Folly by the drow , was a short war fought by Clan Battlehammer and their allies against the drow of Menzoberranzan and their slave army of humanoids . Location . The environs of Mithral Hall .

title: Battle of Lendon ' s Dike
description: Battle of Lendon ' s Dike In Ches of 1479 DR , Kardhel Terov of the Warlock Knights approached warchief Mhurren of the Bloody Skulls orc tribe . He offered the warlord complete control over Thar and its various tribes in return for an oath of fealty . After sacking Glister with the promised troops and armaments , the army - now consisting of the orcs of the Bloody Skulls and Burning Daggers , the ogre s of the Skullsmashers , the hobgoblin s of the Red Claws , and a contingent of Warlock Knights and their controlled beasts - marched on Hulburg .

title: Battle of Luthcheq
description: Battle of Luthcheq The Battle of Luthcheq was a conflict between the nations of Chessenta , Akanûl , and Tymanther against the dragon players of Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " that took place in the Year of the Ageless One . History . When Alasklerbanbastos warned Brimstone about Aoth Fezim and the Brotherhood of the Griffon attempts to foil the " xorvintaal " , the smoke drake allowed the dracolich to reach other dragon allies , including Tchazzar and a few dragon Princes of Murghôm , among them Astanalan , Chelnadatilar , Ferzath , and Llemgradac , to attack and destroy the Brotherhood , who at the time were in the city of Luthcheq .

title: Battle of Marak ' s Stile
description: Battle of Marak ' s Stile The Battle of Marak ' s Stile was a battle for control of Harrowdale that took place around 1180 - 1185 DR ( no source has a precise date ) . The forces of Halvan the Dark invaded Harrowdale , and fought against the defending forces of Lord Elmaer Oraun , leader of Harrowdale . Battle .

title: Battle of Mount Bogdo
description: Battle of Mount Bogdo The Battle of Mount Bogdo occurred on Tarsakh 1 , 1338 DR at the foot of Mount Bogdo in the Hordelands . Events . Lead up .

title: Battle of Nightflames
description: Battle of Nightflames The Battle of Nightflames occurred in 1334 DR between the armies of Mulsparkh and Tethyr . The Tethyrian forces were led by Crown Prince Rythan who was killed in the battle . The armies of Calimshan destroyed Mulsparkh itself soon after the battle .

title: Battle of Shallows
description: Battle of Shallows The Battle of Shallows occurred in 1370 DR between a huge force of orc s and frost giant s and the human and dwarf defenders of Shallows , a small settlement in the Spine of the World . Participants . Orcs and giants .

title: Battle of Tanglefork
description: Battle of Tanglefork The Battle of Tanglefork was the final battle in the War of the Returned Regent . Battle . Outmatched by the force assembled before him , Nanathlor Greysword called upon aid from Mielikki , who " awaken ed " the trees surrounding the battlefield , thereby granting Nanathlor an army of treant s .

title: Battle of the Crippled Mountain
description: Battle of the Crippled Mountain The Battle of the Crippled Mountain was the last battle the dragonborn slaves of Skelkor fought before they gained their freedom . History . After a decisive victory in a previous battle , the rebel dragonborn leaders Iskara and Shurideh had gained a powerful artifact known as the Eye of Blazing Rorn , after felling its previous owner , the silver dragon Asativarainuth .

title: Battle of the Cwm
description: Battle of the Cwm The Battle of the Cwm took place in the early hours of 27 Ches 1374 DR between the daemonfey army and an elven coalition from Evereska and Evermeet , on the West Cwm on the outskirts of Evereska . The battle was won by the elves , but at great cost . Participants .

title: Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon
description: Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon The Battle of the Fortress of the Half - Demon was fought in late 1479 DR between undead Durthan s and their humanoid allies and Rashemi berserkers and fey commanded by Aoth Fezim . The Rashemi lead the attack and forced their way past the ruined gates of the fortress . Fey loyal to the Stag King , a dark fey with features of a deer , followed the Rashemi .

title: Battle of the Gods
description: Battle of the Gods The Battle of the Gods was a conflict between the Untheric and Mulhorandi pantheon s against the Orc pantheon , as well of one of the major battles in the ongoing Dragonfall War , that took place in - 1071 DR as part of the Orcgate Wars . History . During the Orcgate Wars , the gray orc s and their cleric s had developed amazingly powerful and deadly spell s ; the most potent of magic s being their ability to directly call down avatar s of their deities .

title: Battle of the Gods ' Theater
description: Battle of the Gods ' Theater The Battle of the Gods ' Theater was a costly conflict during the Crown Wars . Circa - 10700 DR , after peace failed , the elves of Shantel Othreier fought to defend their lands from the acquisitive and corrupt Vyshaan of Aryvandaar . Into this already - bloody conflict , located in what is now the Tunlands , poured an enormous horde of orcs .

title: Battle of the Haunted Plains
description: Battle of the Haunted Plains The Battle of the Haunted Plains was a battle fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk . It took place in the Haunted Plains in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History .

title: Battle of the Lonely Moor
description: Battle of the Lonely Moor The Battle of the Lonely Moor began at sunset on 11 Tarsakh , 1374 DR . It was fought between the daemonfey armies and the armies of Evermeet and Evereska on the boggy terrain of the Lonely Moor , which was to have an impact on the battle ' s outcome . Participants .

title: Battle with the Witch Lords
description: Battle with the Witch Lords The last battle with the Witch Lords took place in 900 DR between the armies of Cormyr and the armies of the Witch Lords who had invaded . This was the final decisive battle of a war that had lasted several months . It took place about 40 miles from the edge of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr , at dawn .

title: Battleaxe
description: Battleaxe A battleaxe ( also battle axe ) is a martial melee weapon of the axe family . They are usually crafted with a wooden handle and metal head . Description .

title: Battledale
description: Battledale Battledale was one of the dales in the Dalelands . Despite its name earned long ago , it was one of the more peaceful vales in the 14th & 15th centuries DR . Even though Battledale was one of the largest dales , it was also one of the least populated .

title: Battlefield archer
description: Battlefield archer Battlefield archers are ranger s trained to become the pinnacles of archery and are typically imagined as unrivaled in the use of ranged weapons . Calm in the heart of battle , battlefield archers rarely miss and are a valuable addition to any adventuring party . Abilities .

title: Battlepriest of Cormyr
description: Battlepriest of Cormyr A Battlepriest of Cormyr was a prestige class of members of the Purple Dragons . Activities . The priests provided healing to their fellows while aiding in planning tactics and speeding their comrade ' s marching .

title: Battlerager
description: Battlerager Battleragers are a type of dwarven fighter whose combat style relies on raw instinct , anger and physical strength . The individuals who practice this type of fighting are usually mentally unstable with a low life expectancy . Despite this simple attitude , battleragers are a key element of dwarven warfare .

title: Batu Min Ho
description: Batu Min Ho Batu Min Ho was a general first in the army of Shou Lung and later in the Grand Army of the Tuigan . History . Batu was the son of a lowlander of Tuigan ancestry in Chukei .

title: Bauhei
description: Bauhei Bauhei , colloquially known as the Black Leopard , was a greater spirit in T ' u Lung . History . Bauhei was a very ancient spirit , ruling lands around Fenghsintsu province long before the rising of the Celestial Empire .

title: Baule diviner
description: Baule diviner Baule diviners were a type of wizard found in Zakhara , who venerated Fate . They were diviner s who got their knowledge from studying the four elements of air , earth , fire , and water . Thus they also had access to spells from the priestly elemental sphere , while their specialization precluded them from using conjuration / summoning magic .

title: Bautha z ' hin
description: Bautha z ' hin Bautha Z ' hin , meaning " dodge and walk " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that made use of their natural agility and their favored kind of armor , the light armor . Description . As the name " dodge and walk " suggested , the fighting style was about dodging defenses and mobility .

title: Bay Town
description: Bay Town Bay Town was a small settlement found along Trader ' s Bay near the center of Impiltur . Bay Town ' s population in 1357 DR was 1 , 750 . Inhabitants .

title: Bay of Azuth
description: Bay of Azuth The Bay of Azuth was a bay located in southeast Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Azuth offered a natural barrier to towns a cities located in southeast Halruaa , protecting them from pirates and harsh weather rolling in from the Great Sea .

title: Bay of Chessenta
description: Bay of Chessenta The Bay of Chessenta was a large bay in the southern Sea of Fallen Stars . It was the preferred means of travel in Chessenta as the Chessentan roads were poorly maintained in the late 15th century DR . Oar - powered Chessentan triremes plied the waters of the often windless bay and there were many small harbors for ships to pull into .

title: Bay of Halruaa
description: Bay of Halruaa The Bay of Halruaa was a bay located in south central Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Halruaa opened up the central portion of southern Halruaa to the Great Sea .

title: Bay of Kings
description: Bay of Kings The Bay of Kings was located on the coast of Estagund in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . The Bay of Kings offered natural protection for the city of Klionna , sheltering many of their warships and fishing boats from the fierce winter storms that blew in from the Great Sea and wracked the region .

title: Bay of Taertal
description: Bay of Taertal The Bay of Taertal was a bay located in southwest Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . The Bay of Taertal offered natural protection for cities and towns dotting the southwest coast of Halruaa .

title: Bayel Droust
description: Bayel Droust Bayel Droust was a scholar and scribe from Impiltur . He was sent by the Grand Council in 1399 DR on an expedition to map the post - spellplague coastline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . The ship he was travelling on , the Grayling , was attacked and sunk by Cealynna near the island of Prespur .

title: Bazaar ( Menzoberranzan )
description: Bazaar ( Menzoberranzan ) The Bazaar was the permanent market of Menzoberranzan located in the district of Duthcloim ( also known as " Manyfolk " ) . Some considered the Bazaar the heart of Menzoberranzan . Description .

title: Bazidan
description: Bazidan Barzidan , also called Barzidan of the Flames was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Barzidan served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .

title: Bazim - Gorag
description: Bazim - Gorag Bazim - Gorag the Firebringer was an ascended primordial and one of the five elemental lords of Toril , and formerly a batrachi and a slaad lord . Description . Bazim - Gorag was a frog - like humanoid with red - gold skin and two froglike heads .

title: Bea Farbough
description: Bea Farbough Bea Farbough was a farmer in the Moonsea . History . Bea and her husband Ebenz Farbough managed a farmhouse near Hillsfar .

title: Beacon Cairn
description: Beacon Cairn Beacon Cairn was the easternmost town of Rashemen , and sat astride the Golden Way . History . The name came from a pinnacle of rock that rose above the plain to roughly 500 ft ( 152 m ) .

title: Beacon of hope
description: Beacon of hope Beacon of hope was an abjuration spell that granted health and feelings of hope . Effects . Any targeted person or creature within 30 feet ( 9 .

title: Bear
description: Bear Bears were mammal s , typically of a predatorial nature , that were found throughout Toril . Although lacking in particularly supernatural abilities , larger bears were still dangerous creatures to enrage and could prove a match for the ill - prepared adventurer . Bears could be most often found in forested regions or caverns .

title: Beartrid Winters
description: Beartrid Winters Beartrid Winters was the wife of Kalas Winters , who owned the Wolf ' s Pelt Inn in the Icewind Dale community of Targos . Description . The hostess of the Wolf ' s Pelt was an attractive human with black hair and brown eyes .

title: Beast
description: Beast A beast was any creature that behaved in a manner similar to that expected of common animal s dwelling in the Prime Material Plane . However , while animals were generally beasts , many beasts were not animals and could have highly abnormal origins or features . Physically , beasts tended to resemble animals or at the very least , other natural wildlife .

title: Beast Lord
description: Beast Lord The Beast Lord was an alhoon mage ally of the Zhentarim in the North . Personality . Incredibly secretive , the Beast Lord planned to conquer the North and parts of the Deepearth .

title: Beast sense
description: Beast sense Beast sense was a divination spell that allowed a caster to use the senses of a willing creature . Effect . The caster gained any special senses possessed by the target creature .

title: Beast stalker
description: Beast stalker Beast stalkers are expert archer ranger s who specialize in the hunting and slaying of magical beast s . Beast stalkers track their prey through the dangerous wilds and through skill and training fell them with remarkable ease . Beast stalkers also , when required , can turn their methods against other creatures .

title: Beastlands
description: Beastlands The Beastlands were a region of plains at the eastern end of the Shaar . It was home to various non - human monstrous tribes who were allied in a loose confederation for self - defense . The eastern edge of this region was formed by the Giant ' s Belt Mountains , a range which separated the plains from the desert to the east .

title: Beaugrat
description: Beaugrat Beaugrat was a barbarian and a member of the Peacekeepers and the Order of Blue Flame . Appearance . He was of heavy build , although he wasn ' t much taller than an average human .

title: Beaumaris River
description: Beaumaris River The Beaumaris River flows south from the Great Glacier , turns east and cuts Vaasa in half , flows through the Galena Mountains at Bloodstone Pass , and heads to the south into Damara . It is a meltwater river and is completely frozen during the winter . At other times it flows very slowly and is shallow to such an extend that even small boats cannot navigate its fords without being carried .

title: Bebilith
description: Bebilith A bebilith was a massive demonic spider the size of a plow horse . They delighted in causing suffering and pain in others , but especially so in demon s whom they hunted for food . The bebilith seemed to be some form of supernatural demon predator .

title: Bedeviling burst
description: Bedeviling burst Bedeviling burst is an evocation spell used by sorcerer s , most frequently chaos sorcerers . When a sorcerer casts " bedeviling burst " they literally assault the mind of their foe , causing them so much pain that they literally stagger back from the psychic attack . Chaos sorcerers sometimes do this through actual telekinesis rather than simple effect .

title: Bedine
description: Bedine The Bedine were a proud warlike race that inhabited the southern Anauroch regions but were concentrated in the region known as the Sword . Description . They had brown - hued skin , brown eyes , and black or brown hair and were of average height and weight for a humanoid creature of Faerun .

title: Bedon
description: Bedon Bedon was a human cleric and monk of Ilmater and the leader of the Monastery of St . Fanal in the Alimir Mountains " circa " 1374 DR . Brother Bedon instated a policy that no one who came to the monastery seeking knowledge could be denied .

title: Bedorn
description: Bedorn Bedorn is a coastal realm of the Border Kingdoms . The Shining Sea lies off its coastline to the west and the Scelptarmouth ( the mouth of the River Scelptar ) is to the north . The main centre of activity in Bedorn is the town of Oparl .

title: Beetle
description: Beetle The beetle was an insect found in many places and variations in the " Forgotten Realms " , often in giant sizes . Species . Giant bombardier beetle .

title: Beggar - thief
description: Beggar - thief Beggar - thieves were among the lowest individuals of Zakharan society . Requirements . As the name implied , beggar - thieves were thieves .

title: Beguiling tongue
description: Beguiling tongue Beguiling tongue , sometimes called " beguiling influence " , was a spell used by warlock s to enhance their own charm and capacity for persuasion by making the very voice of a warlock powerful with great magic . " Beguiling tongue " was particularly attractive to those who specialized in pacts with powerful archfey , since its power drew heavily on the magical energies of the Feywild . " Beguiling tongue " was relatively easy to cast and though a warlock could only use it intermittently , a short rest of a few minutes was enough to regain its power .

title: Beguld Thormon
description: Beguld Thormon Beguld Thormon was a merchant who lived in Crimmor in Amn in the 14th century DR . History . Beguld was well respected over a long career , but was murdered by doppelganger sometime in the summer of Year of the Behir , 1342 DR .

title: Behemoth
description: Behemoth Behemoths ( also known as dinosaurs or thunderers ) were a group of ancient reptilian creatures found on Toril . Description . Behemoths came in many shapes and sizes though , as their name implied , the best known were typically very large .

title: Behir
description: Behir A behir ( pronounced be - HEER ) was a great serpentine monster with twelve legs and an electrical breath . Description . A behir was often mistaken for a wingless blue dragon .

title: Beholder
description: Beholder A beholder , sometimes called a sphere of many eyes or an eye tyrant , was a large aberration normally found in the Underdark . These large , orb - shaped beings had ten eyestalks and one central eye , each containing powerful magic . Powerful and intelligent , beholders were among the greatest threats to the world .

title: Behroun Marhana
description: Behroun Marhana Behroun Marhana was a lord of the Marhana merchant family . Personality . Behroun was quite charming , when he wanted to be .

title: Bejung
description: Bejung Bejung was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay on the western side of Kang Bay . History .

title: Bel Leos
description: Bel Leos Bel Leos was a hengeyokai in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Bel Leos was a hengeyokai working with the Black Leopard Cult in the town of Lenachi in T ' u Lung .

title: Belagon
description: Belagon Belagon was one of the best generals of Mephistopheles . History . In 1484 DR , when Drasek Riven invaded Cania with an army of undead from the Shadowfell , Belagon was one of the generals that led the devil legions to oppose them .

title: Belamy Lightfingers
description: Belamy Lightfingers Belamy Lightfingers was a halfling fighter from a strongheart clan in Red larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . History . Belamy and his sister Bryn came from a family of bakers , known for their crumblecake .

title: Belargh Thulin
description: Belargh Thulin Belargh Thulin was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar early in his insurrection . Personality . He was a minor magelord , known for devoting his time to romancing all women who came within range of his eye ( and his magical compulsions ) in rural Ambletrees .

title: Belaur Aumar
description: Belaur Aumar Belaur Aumar was the nominal king of Athalantar , but in truth he was under the power of the magelord s . Finally , he was killed by his nephew , Elminster Aumar . History .

title: Beldabar Yarryn
description: Beldabar Yarryn Beldabar Yarryn was an innkeeper in Yartar in 1370 DR . history . Once Beldabar was an adventurer , a member of the Hawks of the North .

title: Beldara Laerune
description: Beldara Laerune Beldara Laerune was a wayward Harper . Activities . Beldara was quite famous for her travels , like the one from Icewind Dale to Halruaa and the one from Nimbral to Sossal .

title: Beldora
description: Beldora Beldora was a secret Harper agent in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Beldora , posing as a homeless waif , gained coins by helping to tend other folk ' s campfires .

title: Beldossan
description: Beldossan Beldossan the Short was a human of the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . Beldossan was rumored to have dwarven blood , thus the nickname . In the early 7th century , Beldossan assisted the dwarven priest Turbaern and the elf sorceress Aleratha Ilnatar in enchanting over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar .

title: Beldred Truesilver
description: Beldred Truesilver Beldred Truesilver was a knight and a member of the Truesilver noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .

title: Beldryn Klynrin
description: Beldryn Klynrin Hammer of the God Beldryn Klynrin was a priest of Tempus from Sembia who traveled often to Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Belhifet
description: Belhifet Belhifet is a Baatezu with twisted horns similar to a kudu . He is the main enemy in the computer role - playing game Icewind Dale as well as , and dual wields falchions in battle against the player . In the events of the Icewind Dale story , Belhifet sought to conquer the home plane from which he was banished .

title: Belhuar Thantarth
description: Belhuar Thantarth Belhuar Thantarth was a Harper and the master of Twilight Hall in Berdusk . Activities . Belhuar spent much of his time residing in Twilight Hall writing letters to fellow Harpers , studying maps , receiving reports , and managed Harper personnel in their operations against evil forces .

title: Belial
description: Belial In name , Fierna rules Phlegethos , commanding the fiery layer from her palace of rock and magma . In truth , her father , Belial , is the power behind the throne . Sequestered away in the central Hall of One Thousand Sighs and Screams , he advises his daughter in the arts of love and pain , taking a personal hand in ensuring she learns all there is to know .

title: Beliard
description: Beliard Beliard was a small tree - cloaked village , east of the Stone Bridge . Geography . The village sat at the intersection of the Dessarin Road , Jundar ' s Pass , and the road toward Ironford .

title: Believers
description: Believers The Believers was a secret society in Red Larch active until the end of the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Believers wasn ' t exactly a cult , although it had special ceremonies and rites had been passed down for generations , but it also wasn ' t a civic organization , despite the fact that some of the wealthiest and most powerful people in Red Larch were members .

title: Belim
description: Belim Belim was a count and later king in Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . History . In 1355 DR the self - styled king of Muktar started a war against Golconda .

title: Belinda Heavensbow
description: Belinda Heavensbow Belinda Heavensbow was a former member of Silverymoon ' s Knights in Silver in the late 15th century DR . Relationships . She was the best friend of Aleina Brightlance .

title: Beliot Sevenecho
description: Beliot Sevenecho Beliot Sevenecho , or Beliost Sevenecho , was a human man of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . He was patriarch of the Sevenecho family and innkeeper of The Worried Wyvern inn in the late 1360s DR . History .

title: Belisarius
description: Belisarius Belisarius is a powerful mage , who resides in Carradoon , at the foot of the Snowflake Mountains . Description . The mage has bushy brows and a similarly bushy , graying beard and wears a floppy , woolen cap atop his wiry stature .

title: Beljuril
description: Beljuril Beljurils , also known as fireflashils , were gemstones unique to the Realms . They were a deep seawater green and all known specimens were roughly the size of a human fist and not quite spherical . About once every hour ( rates vary from stone to stone ) a beljuril would absorb an undetectable amount of energy from within a thirty foot ( ten meter ) radius and re - emit that energy as a " flash " of sparkling light without heat , sound , or electrical discharge .

title: Bell Market
description: Bell Market The Bell Market was , as of 1374 DR , a market at the center of Everlund , with broad streets leading from it to the various city gates . It took its name from its huge bell , hanging in an open space next to the city barracks , used to warn of incoming attacks . The market ' s opening hours were between one hour after dawn and one hour prior to dusk .

title: Bell Tower
description: Bell Tower The Bell Tower served as an alarm system for the city of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The tower stood in the southwest corner of the city .

title: Bell in the Depths
description: Bell in the Depths The Bell in the Depths was one of the great mysterious sites in the Moonsea area . It was connected with legendary Northkeep , an island kingdom that was the first human citadel on the Moonsea . Northkeep was a great and magical city , and it was while under the protection of those magics that humanity began to press back the orc hordes and take command of the sea .

title: Bella don Delroy Harpell
description: Bella don Delroy Harpell Bella don Delroy Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and daughter of spokesman Delroy Harpell of Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Description . Beautiful Bella was short ( barely five feet ) with one bright green eye and one dull green eye that looked in different directions .

title: Bellany Tundash
description: Bellany Tundash Bellany is a wizard who worked for the famous pirate Sheila Kree . She was one of her more trusted lieutenants . She is Morik the Rogue ' s lover .

title: Bellas ' s Band
description: Bellas ' s Band Bellas ' s Band was an adventuring company led by Bellas Thanatar that operated in the Vast in the 1330s DR . They later ruled the city of Calaunt as Supreme Scepter and Merchant Duke s . History .

title: Bellas Thanatar
description: Bellas Thanatar Bellas Thanatar was a human man and Supreme Scepter of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History . Bellas was formerly an adventurer and leader of Bellas ' s Band .

title: Belleethe Kheldorna
description: Belleethe Kheldorna Belleethe Kheldorna was the Waterbaron of the city of Yartar . Activities . With justice and fairness , Belleethe oversaw the trade within her city .

title: Belmourn
description: Belmourn Belmoun was a cook in Yulash . Activities . Belmoun , together with Jamrry and Otiben , managed the chickens at the Red Plumes camp in Yulash .

title: Belmuth Obarskyr
description: Belmuth Obarskyr Belmuth " the Bastard " was a king of Cormyr . He took the throne after his stepnephew Baerildo Obarskyr , who was only an infant , was slain by Gorauna .
