Belmuth ' s reign likewise ended because of his death in Gorauna ' s Purplethroat Plague , and his son Sargrannon succeeded him .

title: Belorgan
description: Belorgan Belorgan is a noble house of Cormyr . family head is the Earl of Wyvernshores , the farmland along the southeastern coast of the Wyvernwater . The Belorgan estates are called Mossfarms .

title: Beloved of Lurue
description: Beloved of Lurue The beloved of Lurue are forest - living maidens who forever forswear mortal love to follow the unicorn deity Lurue , forming a close bond with unicorn s . Background . The beloved of Lurue come from all walks of life , but share two major characteristics : all are champions of good , and all are mortal women who have forsworn mortal men .

title: Belpheron
description: Belpheron Belpheron was an ancient and powerful lich who once tried to destroy Faerûn , and the mentor of Heurodis . Belpheron ' s mummified hand somehow ended up in the posession of the Harpers , who gave it to Drogan Droganson for safekeeping . The hand was stolen from Droganson by a band of kobold s for the dragon Tymofarrar .

title: Belprin ' s Hold
description: Belprin ' s Hold Belprin ' s Hold was an abandoned keep of human origin located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Inhabitants . As of 1479 DR , Belprin ' s Hold was home to fearsome monsters that preyed upon the outlaws who sought the keep as a haven , or the treasure - seekers who went to Belprin ' s Hold in search of its fabled hoards .

title: Belshazu
description: Belshazu Belshazu was a glabrezu and the father of the draegloth Jeggred Baenre . Description . Belshazu was a glabrezu , so he had four arms ( two with pincers ) and a dog - like head .

title: Belt
description: Belt Belt was one of the Grand Duke s during the years immediately following the Time of Troubles and a member of the Council of Four , the rulers of the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Baldurs Gate 2 Tutorial . Belt appears as the instructor for the tutorial for Baldurs gate 2 with a host of other characters that don ' t appear in the main story like Xan and Branwen .

title: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
description: Belt of Storm Giant Strength The Belt of Storm Giant Strength is a great and decorated girdle with a silver buckle set with crossed lightning bolts . It imbues its wearer with the strength of a giant , the greatest of which were the Storm giant s that throw lightning bolts across mountain peaks . The belt enacts its magic when being tightened notch by notch .

title: Belt of priestly might
description: Belt of priestly might Belts of priestly might were defensive magical items , created by servants of a given deity , that boosted the wearer ' s strength and natural defenses . They were normally named for their faith of origin ( e . g .

title: Beltyn ' s burning blood
description: Beltyn ' s burning blood Beltyn ' s burning blood was a necromancy spell that ignited blood flowing out of open wounds , causing additional damage due to fire . Effects . The target of this spell was one creature that had open , bleeding wounds caused by an edged weapon or similar means ( wounds from blunt weapons or those that had been dressed or healed did not produce enough blood ) .

title: Beluar
description: Beluar Beluar was an elven man and a heroic warrior of the Vast in the 7th century DR . He won a famous victory against an orc army to help save the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar . History .

title: Beluar ' s Hunt
description: Beluar ' s Hunt Beluar ' s Hunt , or simply the Hunt , was a series of hills found in the north of the Vast , lying west of the North Road between Kurth and Maskyr ' s Eye , and extending southwest of Kurth . Geography . Beluar ' s Hunt was a series of rolling , drumlin hills .

title: Beluir
description: Beluir Beluir was the largest city ( usually considered the capital ) of the halfling realm of Luiren it also housed foreign dignitaries . Its was also known for having the largest Yondalla temple in Luiren , and so also the home of the Devout Voice of Yondalla . Geography .

title: Belwar Dissengulp
description: Belwar Dissengulp Belwar Dissengulp was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone and was known in the city of Blingdenstone as the " Most Honorable Burrow Warden " . Description . Belwar Dissengulp was a stout barrel - chested gnome with a deep voice .

title: Belween
description: Belween Belween was the second bastard son of Berellip Xorlarrin . History . In 1484 DR , in preparation for the drow war against the Silver Marches , Belween , under the orders of Tiago Baenre and Ravel Xorlarrin , disguised himself as the orc prince Lorgru , who had been kidnapped previously .

title: Ben
description: Ben Ben , or Ben the Brewer was a herbalist living on the outskirts of Luskan . History . While working as healer for the farmers of Luskan , Ben was called by Meg to heal the poisoned Dahlia Sin ' felle , injured by a poisoned attack from Beniago of Ship Kurth .

title: Benchi
description: Benchi Benchi was a boatman on the Fenghsintzu river in T ' u Lung . History . Benchi was orphaned at very young age and sold to No Koni Wa , a old kensai uncle of the famous kensai master To Jano .

title: Bendekik
description: Bendekik Bendekik was a deep gnome priest in Blingdenstone . History . Bendekik was the high priest of the city until 1371 DR , the year of a drow attack .

title: Beniago
description: Beniago Beniago was a lieutenant and later the captain of Ship Kurth in Luskan . In reality he was a drow under the guise of a human who was a high - ranking lieutenant for Bregan D ' aerthe . Description .

title: Benitus
description: Benitus Brother Benitus was a male human and a Cleric of Helm . He was a prelate of the Golden Fortress in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard He , along with younger priests of each faith , oversaw the chapels to Helm , Tempus , Torm , and Tyr that existed within the Golden Fortress .

title: Benji Sadira
description: Benji Sadira Benji Sadira was a simple innkeeper living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Benji ' s inn , the House of Safe Rest , lived up to its name since it was one of the safest places to stay within the often treacherous Harbor District .

title: Benju Matsumoto
description: Benju Matsumoto Benju Matsumoto was the daimyo of the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Benju cared very much about his family , although in his youth he liked to take the most dangerous missions .

title: Bennesey
description: Bennesey Bennesey ( known as Old Bennesey ) was a Sembia n who was alive around 1188 DR . He participated in the discussions with King Pryntaler Obarskyr in an attempt to acquire the city of Marsember . The others in his group were Kodlos Homfast , Lady Threnka and Jollitha Par .

title: Benson Delmo
description: Benson Delmo Benson Delmo was the mayor of Maldobar in 1340 DR . Description . Delmo was " obese " and cheerful .

title: Bent Mermaid Inn
description: Bent Mermaid Inn The Bent Mermaid Inn was an inn at the edge of Tidetown in Westgate which was a hangout for pirates and other assorted trash . Structure . The inn was best known for a figurehead of a bent - over mermaid out the front of the establishment .

title: Bentley Mirrorshade
description: Bentley Mirrorshade Bentey Mirrorshade was an industrious gnome illusionist who ran the Friendly Arm Inn . Description . Bentley had curly hair and a very large nose .

title: Beorg
description: Beorg Beorg was the king of the Tribe of the Wolf . History . Beorg was the strongest Reghedman warrior and the most powerful king alongside Heafstaag .

title: Beornegar
description: Beornegar Beornegar was a well - respected member of the Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) but was killed in a battle with another Reghedman barbarian tribe . Relationships . Beornegar was the son of Beorne .

title: Beorunna ' s Well
description: Beorunna ' s Well Beorunna ' s Well was a large settlement of the barbarian s of the Black Lion Tribe . Description . Members of the tribe lived in modest houses around the deep pit that once contained the ancestral mound .

title: Beorunna ' s cure - all
description: Beorunna ' s cure - all Beorunna ' s cure - all was the name of a highly - prized plant found in the Savage Frontier . When its stem was boiled in a tea , drinking the resulting concoction would result in a general restorative effect that , when combined with an attempt to relieve a malady , be it wound or disease , it would benefit the result . The plant would enhance the effect of any treatment , munadane or magical , to make cuts heal better and defeat illnesses faster .

title: Beralt
description: Beralt Beralt was a boy member of the Emerald Enclave in the Moonsea . History . Beralt studied as a druid under a master and was a member of the Emerald Enclave .

title: Berdusk
description: Berdusk Berdusk was known as the Jewel of the Vale as it sat on both the Uldoon Trail and the River Chionthar in Sunset Vale . Twilight Hall was located here , making the city the base of many operations for Harpers in the west and the north . A person from Berdusk was known as a Berduskan .

title: Berduskan Dark
description: Berduskan Dark Berduskan Dark was a wine exported from Berdusk and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy wine was dark and sweet with a slight burning aftertaste .

title: Beregost
description: Beregost Beregost is a town on the Coast Way , halfway between Baldur ' s Gate and Amn . The town receives many visiting merchant caravans and , as of 1368 DR , has one tavern and three inns . History .

title: Berellip Xorlarrin
description: Berellip Xorlarrin Berellip Xorlarrin was a priestess of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan . Description . Berellip wore black robes with elaborate designs and spider - shaped charms .

title: Berent Thallowood
description: Berent Thallowood Berent Thallowood was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Tallowood and other five Dragons acted as escort to War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .

title: Berg ' inyon Baenre
description: Berg ' inyon Baenre Berg ' inyon Baenre ( alternately spelt Bergynion ) , the youngest son to Yvonnel , and interestingly the fifth Baenre son after Gromph , a second unknown son , Jarlaxle , and Dantrag , is a fighter of great prowess . He is Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s rival in the academy , but never once beats him . Later , when Drizzt comes back to the Underdark , Berg ' inyon helps his brother Dantrag in fighting Drizzt .

title: Berkin Rould
description: Berkin Rould Berkin Rould was a barkeep in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . In his life at sea , Berkin had seen and heard all kinds of things .

title: Berkthgar
description: Berkthgar Berkthgar was a Reghedman barbarian from the Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) who for a time was the chieftain of Settlestone before returning to become king of his tribe . Description . The barbarian chieftain had wild brown hair , which fell across his strong shoulders .

title: Beromchess Ilthyn
description: Beromchess Ilthyn Beromchess Ilthyn was a priestess of Ilmater in the 13th century DR . History . Beromchess lived locally to the elderly sage Athorton of Nleeth , and became friends with him .

title: Berranzo
description: Berranzo Berranzo was a failed colony on the western side of the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . History . It was originally built by Calishite human s " circa " 1330 DR for the purposes of mining and refining , and was home to some 2000 people .

title: Berronar Truesilver
description: Berronar Truesilver Berronar Truesilver ( " bair " - oh - nahr " troo " - sill - vur ) was an intermediate deity in the dwarven pantheon . She was also known as The Revered Mother or the Mother of Safety . Activities .

title: Bertold
description: Bertold Bertold the Seeker was a paladin of Torm , god of duty . History . According to legend , Bertold embarked on the traditional quest to rediscover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr , the realm of the once - mortal Torm .

title: Bertram Nettlebee
description: Bertram Nettlebee Bertram Nettlebee was the son of Wiggan Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bertram was a very fanatical believer of the cult , and full of bluster .

title: Berun ' s Hill
description: Berun ' s Hill Berun ' s Hill was a bare - topped , conical hill that commanded a splendid view of the valley of the Dessarin River to the east . History . The hill was used as a lookout for advancing barbarian s and orc hordes from north and east .

title: Bese al - Sedni
description: Bese al - Sedni Bese al - Sedni was a marid who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Bese was tasked with helping incoming ships to the Trade Harbor find their docks .

title: Beshaba
description: Beshaba Beshaba ( pronounced " be - SHAH - ba " ) , or Lady Doom as she was also known , was the chaotic evil intermediate deity of accidents , bad luck , misfortune , and random mischief and a member of Tempus ' pantheon . She demanded worship to keep her bad luck at bay . Her aim in life was to destroy her sister Tymora , or Lady Luck .

title: Besilmer
description: Besilmer Besilmer was a dwarven realm in the hills of the valley of the River Dessarin . Its sign was a wheel over a plow . The realm extended from the Westwood , through Ironford , and as far east as the High Forest , although in Besilmer ' s time , the High Forest extended further westward than in 1368 DR .

title: Besnell
description: Besnell Besnell was a high - ranking elven Knight in Silver who hailed from Silverymoon in the Silver Marches . He led the Knights in Silver against the drow during the battle for Mithral Hall . Description .

title: Bestow curse
description: Bestow curse Bestow curse was a necromancy or abjuration spell that handicapped a creature . The reverse of this spell was " remove curse " . Effects .

title: Bethshiva
description: Bethshiva Zaxis was an hezrou who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . Speaking with Blooden , a Succubus , was discovered that Zaxis was in truth Bethshiva , a marilith demoted as a lower fiend , and also the mother of Baalbisan

title: Bevemar
description: Bevemar Bevemar was a cleric and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Bevemar tolerated no backtalk from those she worked with , let alone those who worked for her .

title: Bevil Starling
description: Bevil Starling Bevil Starling is a non - player character and companion in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . Activity . Bevil , after he was recruited into the Greycloack army at Crossroad Keep , could ' ve been trained to become a sergeant .

title: Bexron
description: Bexron Bexron was a glabrezu in Maerimydra . History . As of 1491 DR Bexron and two bar - lgura surveyed the entrance to the Undying Temple buth in truth they relaxed with a good smoke and boasted to each other .

title: Beyab al - Rashid
description: Beyab al - Rashid Beyab al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Beyab and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham .

title: Beyd Sechepol
description: Beyd Sechepol Beyd Sechepol was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Beyd was a very diplomatic individual , always evading arguments that divided public opinion , with exception of the topics of horse and gear , about which he was careless .

title: Bezantur
description: Bezantur Bezantur was a port city located at the southern coast of Tyraturos , a region of Thay . She was also called Thay ' s City of a Thousand Temples and was famous for it ' s great harbour . Hexcidon , which was the only Hexblade college in Faerûn , was located in Bezantur .

title: Bezoldur Thornhand
description: Bezoldur Thornhand Bezoldur Thronhand was an elderly dwarven cook that worked in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . He was one of the very few non - humans that resided in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description .

title: Bhaal
description: Bhaal Bhaal ( pronounced " Beh - HAHL " ) , the Lord of Murder , was originally a mortal and one of the Dead Three . Along with Bane and Myrkul , Bhaal took the portfolios of the ancient deity Jergal . Despite his most common title , Bhaal was the god of death , but he especially favoured violent or ritual deaths .

title: Bhaalspawn
description: Bhaalspawn Bhaalspawn is the name given to the mortal offspring of the now dead god Bhaal . It is said that Bhaal foresaw his death during the Time of Troubles and came to Toril before the climactic event , mating with females of almost any species , not all of them humanoid . Like Bane , he would attempt to use these offspring to bring himself back to life .

title: Bhaem Shumokh
description: Bhaem Shumokh Bhaem Shumokh was a human male and the head of the Shumokh mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . The Shumokh family made their fortune in the blacksmithing and armor business , but kind - hearted Bhaem chose to become a musician and lute - maker , which turned out to be quite lucrative .

title: Bhaerynden
description: Bhaerynden Bhaerynden was the first great kingdom of the dwarves of Faerûn , centered in the great cavern deep beneath the Shaar . Bhaerynden fell to the drow after the Crown Wars and the descent of the Drow . " See also : " The section on Bhaerynden tied to the Great Rift article as part of the Deep Realm , and the Great Bhaerynden article as part of the Underdark .

title: Bhaeryta Chassendora
description: Bhaeryta Chassendora Bhaeryta Chassendora was a human woman and a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast . Bhaeryta ' s specialty was to trade in rare and otherwise hard - to - find material components and substances required for magic , such as dragon blood , manticore spikes , and wyvern scales . She often acquired these from adventurers who won them in their exploits , and sold them onto mages .

title: Bhaluin
description: Bhaluin Bhaluin , or the Drowned City , was a ruin located in the middle of Gbor Nor in Semphar . Geography . The ruins of Bhaluin sat upon an island within Gbor Nor located 10 miles ( 16 km ) from the coast .

title: Bhamm ' s Herbs
description: Bhamm ' s Herbs Bhamm ' s Herbs was a shop in Eshpurta run by Eudhis Bhamm . The arcane arts were frowned upon in Amn and Eudhis would deny he had anything in stock ( other than herbs ) that could be considered a spell component . Inquiries were often met with ridicule and scorn .

title: Bharash
description: Bharash Bharash was a dragonborn who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . He was beside Sabine the general in charge of the Dagult Neverember army in the city .

title: Bharavan Bhaerkantos
description: Bharavan Bhaerkantos Bharavan Bhaerkantos was a merchant and member of the Thousandheads Trading Coster . Activities . Bharavan was the founder and leader of the Thousandheads Trading Coster .

title: Bheloris
description: Bheloris Bheloris was an elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . Once Bheloris was a member of the elder ' s council that advised the Shadowmaster High before Dhalgrave decided to stoup down it .

title: Bhereu Ammaeth
description: Bhereu Ammaeth Duke Bhereu Ammaeth was the Lord High Marshal of Cormyr . He is bald . He resided in High Horn .

title: Bheur
description: Bheur Bheurs , also known as winter hags or blue hag , were found commonly in Auril ' s realm within the Deep Wilds as well as within the nation of Rashemen on the Prime Material Plane . They lived for the pleasure of bringing icy doom to as many people as they could . A common legend in Rashemen and surrounding lands suggested that there was only one bheur alive , because no more than one was ever seen at a time , but it was far more likely that they were solitary wanderers .

title: Bhevek Grimshackle
description: Bhevek Grimshackle Bhevek Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bhevek and his brother were only interested in money .

title: Bhokaran
description: Bhokaran Bhokaran was a priest of Haku in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Bhokaran was an athletic young man .

title: Bhylqex
description: Bhylqex Bhylqex was a mutant ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Bhylqex was known for her violent temperament , larger - than - normal size , and unique mutant ability to shoot barbed spikes from her tail like a manticore .

title: Bhyrindar Tellynnan
description: Bhyrindar Tellynnan Bhyrindar " Silverhart " Tellynnan was a moon elf werewolf and , as of 1374 DR , was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma and leader of a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra operating in the north of the High Forest . The Eldreth Veluuthra failed to ally with Turlang and Lossarwyn , and this was attributed to Bhyrindar ' s impatience .

title: Bhùn Ludwakazar
description: Bhùn Ludwakazar Bhùn Ludwakazar was a dwarf gladiator of the Ludwakazar clan in Mulmaster . Personality . Having been exiled , Bhùn felt he had lost his honor and only wanted a death would win him glory in the afterlife .

title: Bichan Rarkat
description: Bichan Rarkat Bichan Rarkat was one of the Cloakmasters of Esmeltaran for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Bichan ' s parents were killed when he was ten and soon he become a thug for the Shadow Thieves .

title: Bidderdoo Harpell
description: Bidderdoo Harpell Bidderdoo Harpell was a wizard from the Harpell family , an eccentric clan of mages from Longsaddle that lived in the Ivy Mansion . History . For seven years , Bidderdoo was trapped in the form of a dog due to a backfired spell .

title: Bifely Lyeelm
description: Bifely Lyeelm Bifely Lyeelm was the high priestess of Cyric at the temple dedicated to his worship in Mulmaster . She was half - crazed from her incessant scheming , though it had worked out somewhat as she managed to ingratiate herself to High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . History .

title: Biff the Understudy
description: Biff the Understudy Biff the Understudy was a human male fighter and an actor in Raelis Shai ' s theater performance at the Five Flagons Inn in Athkatla in 1369 DR . He served as an understudy for Haer ' Dalis , who was absent . Biff messed up his lines , prompting booing and causing the play to be abandoned .

title: Big Head
description: Big Head The Big Head gang was a yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Big Head ' s main business was selling goods and fake medicines between the local villages and in the city and towns they controlled the business of the small street stalls . The stall owners payed protection money to the Big Head and normally the Big Head yakuza protected common people from the outrages of the samurai .

title: Big Tiger Pagoda
description: Big Tiger Pagoda The Big Tiger Pagoda was a large structure found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Structure . The pagoda was composed entirely of brick and stood seven stories tall , making it an impressive landmark in the city .

title: Bigby ' s clenched fist
description: Bigby ' s clenched fist Bigby ' s clenched fist was an evocation spell that conjured a hand of force to attack one ' s foes . Clerics who cast this spell named it for their deities — " Torm ' s clenched fist " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as clenched fist , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Bigby ' s crushing hand
description: Bigby ' s crushing hand Bigby ' s crushing hand was an evocation spell that created a hand of force to grapple , block , push , or squeeze an opponent . Cleric s who cast this spell named it for their deity — " Loviatar ' s crushing hand " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as crushing hand , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Bigby ' s grasping hand
description: Bigby ' s grasping hand Bigby ' s grasping hand was an evocation spell that created a hand of force to grapple with an opponent . Cleric s who cast this spell named it for their deity — " Lathander ' s grasping hand " , for example . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as grasping hand , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Bigby ' s hand
description: Bigby ' s hand Bigby ' s hand might refer to any of a family of spells created by the fabled wizard Bigby . It is the name of the 5th edition spell that has many varieties , each of which appeared as a separate spell in previous editions :

title: Biggrin
description: Biggrin Description . The massive giant had his upper lip torn off by a , which left him permanently scarred . This wound help gave him his name : " Big - Grin " .

title: Bija tree
description: Bija tree A bija tree was a type of tree found in Koryo in Kara - Tur . It grew in the Quang Muku Forest . Green sleeping dust could be made from the bija tree .

title: Bildoobaris
description: Bildoobaris Bildoobaris , the unofficial capital of Narfell , was little more than an open plain that rested in the towering shadow of Mount Nar . For one tenday every summer , this plain turned into a bustling city consisting of over 30 , 000 Nars . Also called Bildoobaris , this festival was the largest and most important holiday in all of Narfell ; even the cruelest and most fierce Nar tribes came to drink , feast , and trade together .

title: Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal
description: Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal Bilskromminet Yakanderosstenfal was the only gnome Proven Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Bilskromminet loved pranks like all gnomes , but he always targeted people he disliked , and his pranks were usually very humiliating .

title: Bimaru
description: Bimaru Bimaru was the ambassador of the kingdom of Bertan on the isle of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Bimaru was a mysterious woman .

title: Bimasara
description: Bimasara Bimasara was the Padhrasattva of Barter within the Padhran religion . History . Before the city was destroyed , Kushk held a strong collection of Bimasara ' s followers at their temple called the Holy Mountain of Kus .

title: Bineera Ethar
description: Bineera Ethar Skull Servant Bineera Ethar was a female human cleric of Cyric . She led the Cyricists ' s activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History .

title: Binnacy Kron
description: Binnacy Kron Binnacy Kron was a woman in Mulmaster . History . As result of the Brotherhood of the Cloak ' s actions , Binnacy ' s sister Maude Kron was killed .

title: Bint al - Jawzi
description: Bint al - Jawzi Bint al - Jawzi was a dwarf merchant - rogue living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Jawzi was a formidable rubban in a profession dominated by men , human s , and elves .

title: BioWare
description: BioWare BioWare Corp is a Canadian entertainment software company best known for its roleplaying games , including a number of Forgotten Realms computer game titles . BioWare was founded in , in 1995 by medical students Ray Muzyka and Greg Zeschuk . After initially developing " " in 1996 , BioWare went on to develop " Baldur ' s Gate " for Black Isle Studios in 1998 , their first out of many contributions to the Forgotten Realms license .

title: Birdpipes
description: Birdpipes Birdpipes , also known as shalm , were a type of pan pipes . Sacred to Lliira and the satyr s , birdpipes were quite popular among the wood elves and wild elves . Description .

title: Birthing Furnace
description: Birthing Furnace The Birthing Furnace was a powerful artifact created by the primordial Nehushta . Abilities . The Birthing Furnace had the ability to create living genasi babies .

title: Bishop
description: Bishop Bishop was a skilled and deadly ranger from the Sword Coast North . During the Shadow War , he notably traveled with the Kalach - Cha and aided them in their quest before eventually betraying them at the Siege of Crossroad Keep . Description .

title: Bismalla bin Ala ' i
description: Bismalla bin Ala ' i Bismalla bin Ala ' i was a member of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Personality . Bismalla was a polite individual who deferred to those in charge for any decision .

title: Bison - gourd
description: Bison - gourd Bison - gourd was a flowering plant common on Pelleor ' s Prairie surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls . Uses . The oils harvested from this plant ' s seeds were hard to smell but could be used as a natural insect repellent .

title: Bistro Battenrooj
description: Bistro Battenrooj Bistro Battenrooj was the traveling companion of Bahooha Shortsleeves in Impiltur in 1359 DR . Activities . Bistro proclaimed himself a monk despite having no training as one .

title: Bitter Black
description: Bitter Black Bitter Black was a stout beer exported from Arabel and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This heavy beer tasted best when served at cellar temperatures .

title: Bitter Well Oasis
description: Bitter Well Oasis Bitter Well Oasis was a small resting stop located in the southern regions of the Quoya Desert within the Hordelands . Description . Set on a plateau , this nearly abandoned oasis was small and pitiful .

title: Bjami Tengervaald
description: Bjami Tengervaald Bjami Tengervaald was an old shaman in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Bjami was born into the Tribe of the Bear .

title: Black Altar
description: Black Altar The Black Altar was the temple complex devoted to the god Bane in the ruined city of Zhentil Keep . History . In 1263 DR , Fzoul Chembryl broke with the Black Lord ' s Altar , the orthodox banite church run by the High Imperceptor of Bane in Mulmaster and declared the Black Altar the new centre of the Black Lord ' s church .

title: Black Ash Plain
description: Black Ash Plain Black Ash Plain was located west of Unther in East Faerûn . History . In 1373 DR , many refugees from the Untheric - Mulhorandi conflict ran through the plain .

title: Black Blood Tribe
description: Black Blood Tribe The Black Blood Tribe was a tribe of lycanthropes dedicated to summoning Kazgoroth , an aspect of the beastlord Malar , to Faerûn . The tribe was made up of both Faerûnian born lycanthropes as well as were - beasts from the Feywild . As of 1479 DR the tribe controlled most of Moray Isle in the Moonshae Isles .

title: Black Blood cultist
description: Black Blood cultist The Black Blood Cultist is a prestige class of Faerûn . The evil barbarian hordes of The North and other uncivilized , wild regions of the Realms came to idolize the shapeshifting worshipers of Malar , the People of the Black Blood . These Cultists of the Black Blood draw power from this idolization , becoming increasingly bestial and imitating the corrupt nature of their masters .

title: Black Chronology
description: Black Chronology " In the years before the Spellplague , word spread of a new Roll of Years , a Black Chronology fashioned by the goddess Shar , the Lady of Loss and her faithful . The purpose of this Shadow Roll was to mark the events that would lead to the ultimate ascendancy of Shar over all of Toril , but instead , the goddess of darkness ’ plans went all awry and brought on the Spellplague . " These are the years as dictated by the Black Chronology : 1352 the Year of the Lost King 1353 the Year of Masks 1354 the Year of Great Reaping 1355 the Year of Retreat 1356 the Year of the Drow 1357 the Year of Spell Flames 1358 the Year of Ascension 1359 the Year of the Carnival 1360 the Year of Armies 1361 the Year of the Golden Discovery 1362 the Year of the Sun 1363 the Year of Winter 1364 the Year of Lords 1365 the Year of Joyous Elves 1366 the Year of Icy Waters 1367 the Year of Unmasking 1368 the Year of Sons 1369 the Year of the City ' s Sorrows 1370 the Year of the Deep War 1371 the Year of the Toppling Towers 1372 the Year of the Dark Returns 1373 the Year of Madness 1374 the Year of Unraveling 1375 the Year of Harsh Goals 1376 the Year of False Hopes 1377 the Year of Black Banner 1378 the Year of Broken Hearts 1379 the Year of Lost Wisdom 1380 the Year of the Dull Blade 1381 the Year of the Fool 1382 the Year of Unwelcome Guests 1383 the Year of Unjust Rewards 1384 the Year of Stolen Thrones 1385 the Year of Revelation

title: Black Claw
description: Black Claw Black Claw was an orc tribe formed by the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . History . In 1026 DR , the Black Claw tribe was formed with the intention of destroying Waterdeep after the Brotherhood ' s previous attempt , the Broken Bone , succumbed to Lhammaruntosz .

title: Black Claw Mercantile Company
description: Black Claw Mercantile Company The Black Claw Mercantile Company was a fellowship run mainly by House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Organization . The fellowship was one of two competing merchant houses in Menzoberranzan .

title: Black Darts
description: Black Darts The Black Darts were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Black Darts was comprised of 2 , 000 manscorpion slaves who wielded javelin s effectively .

title: Black Eagles
description: Black Eagles The Black Eagles , also called the Ashes , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Black Eagles were the only unit of jann among the armies of the efreet .

title: Black Flame Zealots
description: Black Flame Zealots The Black Flame Zealots , also known as the Order of The Black Flame , was a secret society of assassins who drew their power from the passions of anger and rage . They were originally only disciples of Kossuth , but their ardent practices have since inspired devotees of other worships to follow in their footsteps of the Black Flame Zealot . They served as the eyes , ears , and hands of Kossuth in Thay .

title: Black Garius
description: Black Garius Black Garius was a powerful Luskan archmage , a member of the city ' s sinister ruling cabal , " Arcane Brotherhood . " Description . Garius wore regal - looking black robes and regarded others with a deep , intimidating stare .

title: Black Helm Tower
description: Black Helm Tower Black Helm Tower was the home of Black Vizor , one of the High Herald s of the organization known as the Heralds of Faerûn . Location . Black Helm Tower was located about a day ' s ride ( approximately 30 mi or 48 km ) to the north and east of Daggerford in west Faerûn , just north of the Delimbiyr river .

title: Black Horde
description: Black Horde The Black Horde was the largest orc horde in the history of Faerûn . It compromised primarily of orcs and goblins . The Black Horde besieged countless settlements in the North and threatened kingdoms far south of it as well .

title: Black Horn Regiment
description: Black Horn Regiment The Black Horn Regiment was a yugoloth mercenary company led by the ultroloth Inthracis . They were based in Corpsehaven within the Blood Rift . Description .

title: Black Isle Studios
description: Black Isle Studios Black Isle Studios was a division of the PC and video game developer and publisher Interplay Entertainment , created specifically for the development of PC role - playing games . The division was formed during 1996 , adopting the name " Black Isle Studios " during 1998 . The idea for the division ' s name came from the Black Isle in Scotland - founder Feargus Urquhart ' s native country .

title: Black Kumade
description: Black Kumade The Black Kumade was a magical javelin wielded by Lin Goh , clanmaster of the Panthers of Xi . It became a symbol of that ninja clan . It was an obsidian " + 2 javelin " that would return to its wielder when hurled .

title: Black Leopard Cult
description: Black Leopard Cult The Black Leopard Cult , later the Black Leopard Society was a very ancient and much - talked - about organization in T ' u Lung . Description . The Black Leopard Cult worshiped the Black Leopard Bauhei , an ancient greater spirit who preceded the Celestial Empire .

title: Black Lion ( tribe )
description: Black Lion ( tribe ) The Black Lion Tribe of the Uthgardt barbarian s were centered around the village of Beorunna ' s Well . History . In 1372 DR , the Black Lion ancestral mound was Beorunna ' s Well .

title: Black Mist
description: Black Mist The Black Mist gang was a recently formed yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Black Mist tried to control all illegal business in the city , entering in feud with both Big Head and Worthless Flower gang . The Black Mist in Nakamaru was not so powerful but elsewhere in Wa they were truly powerful and so the two other yakuza gang were cautious in trying to destroy the Black Mist .

title: Black Pearl
description: Black Pearl Black Pearl was a half - elf descended from a human and a sea elf . Description . Black Peal had white skin , dark eyes , and long black hair .

title: Black Raven Monastery
description: Black Raven Monastery Black Raven Monastery was founded in 1181 DR by Valas Belaem del Pharm . Geography . The monastery was located in the Spine of the World and connected Valas ' Tomb to the Underdark .

title: Black Raven Tribe
description: Black Raven Tribe The Black Raven Tribe was a particularly conservative band of the Uthgardt barbarian s who resided at Raven Rock . History . In 1372 DR , the Black Ravens ' ancestral mound was the Raven Rock .

title: Black Vizor
description: Black Vizor In the Heralds of Faerûn , the office of Black Vizor was one of the High Heralds . This office was charged with keeping a finger on the pulse of society , particularly political society in various states of conflict . The job required crisscrossing Faerûn to visit courts of nobles and governing bodies as well as regularly communicating with local Heralds and agents , keeping track of attitudes , mores , court dynamics , and intrigues , to declarations of war , peace treaties , trade agreements , and the balance of power .

title: Black Watch
description: Black Watch The Black Watch was a dark group of mercenaries who operated in the Moonsea area . Equipment . Members of the Black Watch dressed in black clothing and wore chain mail with their demon ' s eye sigil .

title: Black Wizards
description: Black Wizards Black Wizards , by Douglas Niles , is the second book in the Moonshae trilogy . Characters . Alexei • Allisynn • Annuwyn • Avalon • Bhaal • Vaughn Burne • Canthus • Reginald Carrathal • Cassidy • Chauntea • Cowan • Cyndre • Dai - Dak • Daryth • Gadrric Deepglen • Devin • Doric • Dornthwait • Dynnatt • Earthmother • Eileen • Evan ( bandit ) • Fergus • Finellen • Fiona • Glynnis • Ryder Greenleaf • Grunt • Hobarth • Isolde • Kamerynn • Karianow • Kazgoroth • Bryon Kendrick • Tristan Kendrick • Koart • Kryphon • Larrell • Macshea • Genna Moonsinger • Robyn Moonsinger • Newt • Nolan • Hugh O ' Roarke • Pawldo • Randolph • Rasper • Razfallow • Rodger • Sean • Sythissall • Talraw • Tavish • Trahern • Trevor • Waine • Wertam • Yazilliclick • Ysalla Locations .

title: Black bear
description: Black bear The black bear was a forest - dwelling animal . Description . These creatures had black , blond , or cinnamon fur .

title: Black blade of disaster
description: Black blade of disaster Black blade of disaster was a drow arcane spell used to cut through anything in its path . Effect . This spell created a crack between the planes that looked like a dark blade .

title: Black cloud of vengeance
description: Black cloud of vengeance The Black cloud of vengeance was a creation of those who violated the Laws of the Loregiver in the early days of the world . Although these were rare creations , they were mentioned in almost all cultures in Zakhara . Many people believed that only one cloud existed , but some wise men believed otherwise .

title: Black dragon
description: Black dragon Black dragons , also known as skull dragons , are far and away the most vile tempered and cruel of all chromatic dragon s . Physical description . Black dragons appear abnormally slender in comparison to other chromatic dragons — wiry , but not gaunt .

title: Black kumade ( Neverwinter Nights )
description: Black kumade ( Neverwinter Nights ) A black kumade was one of a number of magical spears once wielded by Guul Shatterneck and his bandits in the North of Faerûn . Description . These spears had three - pronged heads , hence their name as " kumades " , a type of weaponized rake of Kara - Tur .

title: Black opal
description: Black opal Black Opal is a greenish type of with black mottling and gold flecks . Usually found in ancient hot springs , the gem is usually tumbled smooth and cut cabochon . The phrase in the North " Black as a black opal " means , effectively , not very black ( or evil ) at all , and is used to describe good - hearted rogues and similar individuals who would be embarrassed by praise .

title: Black pudding
description: Black pudding A black pudding was an ooze resembling a bubbling , heaping pile of thick black goo . Description . The average black pudding measured 15 ft ( 4 .

title: Black sapphire
description: Black sapphire Black Sapphire was a rare variety of sapphire that was a deep , rich black with yellow or white highlights . They were found mostly in the South with the greatest concentration in the Great Rift . These stones were highly valued by dwarves .

title: Black talon
description: Black talon Black talon was a divine magic spell available to priests of Cyric , the Prince of Madness . It turned the caster ' s arm into a claw - tipped , stretchable appendage for a short time . Effects .

title: Black unicorn
description: Black unicorn Black unicorns are fiendish versions of their good unicorn brethren , magically created by the Red Wizards of Thay . They have become prominent in the armies of Thay , serving as elite cavalry . Black unicorns will only allow human or drow females of an evil alignment to ride them .

title: Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop
description: Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop is a store and a trading post run by none othere than the Harper Ulblyn Blackalbuck . With a large outdoor terrace for adventurers and traders to display their wares , the Swap Shop is a great place to trade equipment or information to others .

title: Blackbread
description: Blackbread Blackbread was a type of bread made from flour and Amn ish molasses . Description . Molasses gave blackbread its dark color .

title: Blackbutter Inn
description: Blackbutter Inn Blackbutter Inn was an inn owned by Dhelosk Quelbeard in the town of Red Larch . Structure . The inn was a two - story building of stone and timber with a covered porch that ran parallel to the Long Road .

title: Blackdagger Bandits
description: Blackdagger Bandits The Blackdagger Bandits were a powerful bandit group operated on the High Road led by the brothers Malus and Traven Blackdagger . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan .

title: Blackfeather Bridge
description: Blackfeather Bridge Blackfeather Bridge was the name of a village surrounding the bridge of the same name across the River Ashaba in Featherdale on Raauthauvyr ' s Road . History . The village of Blackfeather Bridge was founded in 1358 DR The Blackfeather Bridge itself was once a wooden bridge painted black , but by 1368 DR , it was made of stone .

title: Blackguard
description: Blackguard Blackguard , also referred to by some as the antipaladin , is a specialized prestige class on Faerûn that epitomizes pure evil . Nothing short of a mortal fiend , they are quintessential black knights , carrying a reputation of the foulest sort . Consorting with demon s and devil s while serving dark deities , blackguards are hated and feared by all .

title: Blackhold
description: Blackhold Blackhold was a trademoot located in a cavern of the nation of Fimbrul , on Returned Abeir . It was inhabited only by humanoid s . Background .

title: Blackjackal
description: Blackjackal Blackjackal was the lieutenant and later the leader of a small tribe of elves living in the eastern starwood of Cormanthor . The elven tribe once used a large area of blueberries as their primary food source , which they shared amiably with shambling mound s . When a couatl covered in strange markings fell out of the sky into the blueberry field , the elves and mounds did not think much of it , but its decomposing corpse infected the blueberries with a form of vine blight .

title: Blacklight
description: Blacklight Blacklight was an evocation or alteration spell that created an area of magical darkness that only the caster could see through . Effects . " Blacklight " was very similar to " darkness " with the exception that the caster could act and see normally while within the area of effect .

title: Blackrazor
description: Blackrazor Blackrazor , also known as the Sword of Souls , is a greatsword that appears to be forged from an unknown alloy of steel . It is sheathed in a black scabbard decorated with pieces of cut obsidian . When held , it shines like the night sky filled with stars .

title: Blackscale
description: Blackscale The Blackscales were a tribe and subrace of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . Description . A blackscale was a humanoid reptilian , resembling other lizardfolk but much larger , standing 8 .

title: Blackstaff
description: Blackstaff Blackstaff is the title and name given to the master of the eponymous staff and Blackstaff Tower and the Archmage of Waterdeep . “ Blackstaff ” was originally a nickname given to Khelben Arunsun because of his powerful staff of the same name , but after his death it became the title used by his successors . Blackstaffs .

title: Blackstaff ( spell )
description: Blackstaff ( spell ) Blackstaff was a spell applied to a staff or quarterstaff that enhanced its combat effectiveness , and gave it the ability to dispel magic or cause a spellcaster it struck to lose a prepared spell . History . This spell was created by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and was part of the reason why his common appellation was " Blackstaff " , as he carried a staff of power that had this spell cast on it with permanency .

title: Blackstaff ( staff )
description: Blackstaff ( staff ) The Blackstaff was the name for a series of powerful magical staves , created and used by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and / or his successor . It was believed that Khelben Arunsun , who carried the first Blackstaff title , selected a new Blackstaff every time he left Blackstaff Tower . However , it always appeared as a long wooden staff .

title: Blackstaff Tower
description: Blackstaff Tower Blackstaff Tower ( previously Arunsun Tower ; renamed by Khelben in 1322 DR ) was the home of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . The forbidding structure is one of the most recognizable landmarks in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . It was also the home of his apprentices and his consort Laeral Silverhand .

title: Blackstaff Tower ( novel )
description: Blackstaff Tower ( novel ) Blackstaff Tower by Steven E . Schend is the first novel in the Waterdeep series . Summary .

title: Blackstone
description: Blackstone Earl Blackstone of Fairheight was an earl who lived in the Moonshaes . He kept a pack of moorhound s , one of whom was called Warlock . Relations .

title: Blacktalons
description: Blacktalons The Blacktalons were a mercenary group based out of Iriaebor who predominantly took contracts guarding and raiding caravans . Led by Taurgosz Khosann , they were an unscrupulous company known for their autonomy , vengeance ( when they were cheated out of money ) , and for never reneging on a contract . As a testament to the bandits who preceded them , the Blacktalons were known for raiding unguarded caravans in order to encourage their owners to seek their protection .

title: Blackthorn
description: Blackthorn Blackthorn was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Blackthorn was a half - elf living in the Gulthmere Forest until human expansion in the area consumed him with bitterness .

title: Blackwash Fens
description: Blackwash Fens The Blackwash Fens was a boggy lowland area found along the coast of the Great Sea in the far northern reaches of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The fens were located in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Yikarian Empire on the banks of the River Ruin at the edge of Pearl Bay near the city of Lipo .

title: Blade
description: Blade A blade is a term meaning an edge that is sharp and used to cut . It is used here as an archetype of hand - held slashing weapons made of metal or other rigid material where the cutting edge makes up most of the length of the weapon , unlike axe s and pole arm s where the cutting edge is much shorter than the overall length . See Blade ( disambiguation ) for other uses of this name .

title: Blade ( individual )
description: Blade ( individual ) Blade was a wood elf fighter and assassin who ultimately abandoned his party of evildoers . Description . Long , brown hair framed Blade ' s stern face , which was adorned with green eyes , full lips , and a prominent nose .

title: Blade - rite
description: Blade - rite The ritual of Blade - rite was an elven ritual that involved the drawing of a magical sword to determine the worthiness of its wielder for a given assignment or position among the hierarchy of the elves . It was most closely associated with the drawing of the famous Elfblade s , used to determine the Coronal of Cormanthyr , and his two Defenders , the Arms - Major and the Spell - Major . Nature of the Rite .

title: Blade and Stars
description: Blade and Stars The Blade and Stars was an inn in Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast of Faerûn . Structure . The long building was four stories high with an attached stable .

title: Blade banshee
description: Blade banshee Blade banshees are eladrin ranger s trained in the art of wielding enchanted longsword s with another melee weapon . The rangers channel their innately magic al nature into the blade s they wield , making them deadly foes with a terrifying bond with their very weapons . The enchanted sword they wield sings in a ghostly voice , shrieking with each blow the blade banshee delivers and striking fear into the eladrin ' s foes .

title: Blade barrier
description: Blade barrier Blade barrier was an evocation spell that summoned a wall of spinning , razor - sharp blades of force . Effects . Older versions of this spell created a deadly curtain that could be as small as 5 ft ( 1 .

title: Blade dancer
description: Blade dancer Blade dancers are ranger s , typically of the two - blade , though not necessarily , whose combat style mimics dance in its grace and its refinement . To a blade dancer , their dual weapons , often blade s of some sort , are as two dance partners with whom they train and choreograph constantly . Masters of footwork as well as fencing , blade dancers are as deadly as they are elegant .

title: Blade of Aihonen
description: Blade of Aihonen Blade of Aihonen was the sword of the hero Aihonen . Description . Even broken , the blade was extremely sharp .

title: Blade of banishing
description: Blade of banishing A blade of banishing was a magical dagger that was able to destroy magical barriers , illusions , or protections upon coming in contact with them . The dagger was always active , it could not be " switched off " , and would have this effect whether or not it was being wielded , or if it was drawn . It simply needed to come into contact with the magic against which it was acting .

title: Blade of doom
description: Blade of doom Blade of doom , also known as Shaeroon ' s scimitar , was an evocation spell that threatened one creature with injury from an invisible sword of force that was triggered by a condition chosen by the caster . Effects . This spell was a curse that followed its target , hovering over the creature ' s head , waiting to strike if the trigger condition occurred .

title: Blade of forgetfulness
description: Blade of forgetfulness Blades of forgetfulness were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special weapons were only used by Holy slayer s . Description .

title: Blade of mastery
description: Blade of mastery The Blade of mastery was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This weapon appeared as a small jambiya with an ethereal blade .

title: Blade thirst
description: Blade thirst Blade thirst was a spell that allowed a slashing weapon being wielded by a ranger to gain a + 3 bonus and glow with a blue flame . The earlier version of this spell was an alteration spell called bladethirst . It was usable by wizards and worked on any single - edge blade .

title: Bladebane
description: Bladebane Bladebane was a transmutation spell that caused a bladed weapon to temporarily do extra damage to a creature type . Effect . The caster imparted a deadly quality to a single bladed weapon for a short time .

title: Bladeboots
description: Bladeboots Bladeboots were nasty footwear worn by some rogue s and adventurers . Uses . Bladeboots were most effective when used in a surprise attack , typically after the wearer was apprehended and stripped of their weapons .

title: Bladeling
description: Bladeling Bladelings were a race of humanoid outsider s from the Barrens of Doom and Despair . Their skin was covered with sharp , metallic spines , and they were known for their xenophobia . Description .

title: Bladen ' Kerst Baenre
description: Bladen ' Kerst Baenre Bladen ' Kerst Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a high priestess of Lolth . Personality . Bladen ' Kerst was known for her sadism and cruelty , as well as her lack of recognition for the protocols of drow society .

title: Blades ( Mulmaster )
description: Blades ( Mulmaster ) The Blades were the governing council that ruled the grand city of Mulmaster . The Blades were ten to sixteen of the most preeminent citizens , normally from the noble houses of the city . It was not clear how someone could become one of the Blades .

title: Blades for Daggerdale
description: Blades for Daggerdale Blades for Daggerdale , designed by Matthias Schäfer , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 4th edition ruleset . It focuses on Daggerdale , the gnoll s , and the zhent s . Summary .

title: Blades of the Moonsea
description: Blades of the Moonsea The Blades of the Moonsea series by Richard Baker is a trilogy of novels that follow a few years of the life of Geran Hulmaster , a thirty - something swordmage who returns from a decade of adventuring to find his home of Hulburg being taken over by those not native to the town . The novels take place primarily between mid - Eleint of 1479 DR to mid - Ches of 1480 DR , though there are occasional flashbacks to Geran ' s earlier history . The epilogue takes place a little less than a month after the events of the final novel .

title: Bladesinger
description: Bladesinger The Bladesinger prestige class is comprised of Tel ' Quessir ( " " The People " " in the elven language ) who have blended art , swordplay , and arcane magic into a seamless whole . They use very discrete tactics and precise movement in battle to maintain a highly effective combat defense . Using a mixture of arcane and martial abilities , Bladesingers act as roving guardians of surface Tel ' Quessir culture , seeking to promote Tel ' Quessir ideals , and as protectors and champions of the eladrin and elven communities .

title: Blaermon
description: Blaermon Blaermon the Blessed was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Holy Warriors of Suffering in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Blaermon the Blessed was known for surviving a string of hopeless battles , for which he earned his name .

title: Blaern ' s Trail
description: Blaern ' s Trail Blaern ' s Trail , also called the Wandering Trail , ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Calaunt and the village of Dead Tree Hollow . From west to east , it began at Calaunt , ran through Thindilar , Sendrin , and Fallentree , and ended at Dead Tree Hollow . On the way , it linked with the Hlintar Ride , the Cross Road , the Long Reach , Feldar ' s Trail , and ended at the North Road .

title: Blagothkus
description: Blagothkus Blagothkus was the cloud giant ruler of Skyreach Castle . Personality . Blagothkus was a survivor of the giant empires of the past , and his main dream was somehow to go back to those glorious times .

title: Blaine
description: Blaine Blaine was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Blaine was one of Fort Locke ' s best soldiers ( who spent decades in the Neverwinter army ) that went with Tann and his men to patrol .

title: Blaizette
description: Blaizette Blaizette was a halfling waitress in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Blaizette worked as waitress for her mother at the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle .

title: Blakkal Mord
description: Blakkal Mord Blakkal Mord was a leather - worker in High Dale . History . Jatham was a very able warrior in High Dale and a secret agent of the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Blakrho Phull
description: Blakrho Phull Lord Blakrho Phull was a former scion of the noble House Phull of Waterdeep who turned on his family and pursued a life of banditry along the southern Sword Coast . Description . In spite of his age , Blakrho was described as youthful and handsome looking in 1479 DR .

title: Blanaer
description: Blanaer Blanaer was a village in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the Cross Road between Kurth and Thindilar . The Pass Trail led to Tavilar . History .

title: Blas Iwan
description: Blas Iwan Blas Iwan was a young red dragon that sought transformation in dracolich around 1370 DR . Relationships . Blas was a fanatical worshiper of the Sammaster ' s theories and entered in the Cult of the Dragon thinking was his destiny .

title: Blaskar Lauthom
description: Blaskar Lauthom Blaskar Lauthlon was a male human wizard , and the Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the West Tower . He was responsible for the Arcane Brotherhood ' s operations in the western quadrant of Faerûn . Description .

title: Blasko Halamar
description: Blasko Halamar Blasko Halamar was a stout ex - warrior and stable owner who owned Halamar ' s Horses in Beliard around 1370 DR . Description . The stable master was stout with a long white beard .

title: Blasphemy
description: Blasphemy Blasphemy was an evocation spell that could incapacitate or even kill nonevil creatures and banish those of extraplanar origin . The counterpart to this spell for casters of good alignments was " holy word " . Effects .

title: Blast of pain
description: Blast of pain Blast of pain was a divine spell that bolstered the health , strength , and endurance of a protected creature . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s who commanded the combat and necromantic spheres .

title: Blastback swipe
description: Blastback swipe Blastback swipe is a spell of the evocation school used by some swordmage s of relatively low experience and power , particularly those of the assault style . When cast " blastback swipe " causes debilitating sound to emanate from the swordmage ' s weapon as he or she swings it about a target with melee range . The sonic energy not only causes the creature injury , but if successfully used , pushes the target back up to ten feet .

title: Blazen Stoe
description: Blazen Stoe Blazen Stoe was one of the Blade s in Mulmaster . Personality . Stoe took great pride in his family ' s position and his role as a Blade .

title: Blazevale
description: Blazevale The Blazevale is a broad , sand - scoured valley near Evereska that separates the Sharaedim from the Greycloak Hills to the north . It is made up of scrubby pine s , thorn bush of cacti and wolf root , where only the hardiest of rabbit s , moon fox es , mice , lizard s , and meadow quail survive .

title: Blazidon One - Eye
description: Blazidon One - Eye Blazidon One - Eye was the secret owner of the Bowels of the Earth tavern in the city of Waterdeep . Despite this , Blazidon spent most of his time as a hiring agent for sellswords at the Dock Ward or at the city ' s various inns and taverns . He was a business rival of Filiare , as the two compete over clients looking for work .

title: Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking
description: Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking The Blazing Banner of Ologh the Overking was the famous battle standard of Ologh , the Overking of the orc ish kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . History . Ologh carried the Blazing Banner into battle , before being slain by the black dragon Iyrauroth in the Year of Writhing Darkness , 572 DR .

title: Bledryn Scoril
description: Bledryn Scoril Bledryn Scoril was a member of the Scoril noble house of Cormyr , as well as the Crown ' s representative to , and Lord of , Marsember , having taken over the role from Ildool . He was the local Herald , Grand Marsember , and acted as the registrar of births , deaths , and marriages , as well as the Crown ' s witness to sentencing , contracts , treaties , and the like .

title: Bleeder
description: Bleeder Bleeder was an enchanted axe . Description . The axe was heavy but finely crafted .

title: Blentra Whaelbuckler
description: Blentra Whaelbuckler Blentra Whaelbuckler was an inhabitant of Marsember in 1367 DR . Description . A giant of a woman , Blentra ' s immense strength aided her well when fighting pirates .

title: Bless
description: Bless Bless was an enchantment or conjuration spell that temporarily increased the morale and combat skill of allies . The conjuration version of this spell was reversible and was called curse , also known as " bane " , and temporarily lowered the morale and combat skill of enemies . Effects .

title: Bless weapon
description: Bless weapon Bless weapon is a transmutation spell that grants a weapon a temporary holy aura . Effect . This transmutation makes a weapon strike true against evil foes .

title: Blessed abundance
description: Blessed abundance Blessed abundance was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster to multiply a quantity of animal or vegetable matter . Effects . This spell worked on raw or prepared food and live or harvested plants , not on live creatures , metals , minerals , or magical items .

title: Blessing of Vhaeraun
description: Blessing of Vhaeraun Blessing of Vhaeraun was a spell used by priests of Vhaeraun , the drow god of thievery , to augment their abilities . Effects . The caster ' s abilities were temporarily augmented , but only for a very short time and only for one use .

title: Bleth
description: Bleth Bleth was a noble family of Cormyr . History . In the 1360s DR , the Bleth family was one of the more powerful and wealthier noble families of Cormyr , thanks to its control of the Seven Suns Trading Coster , one of the largest merchant groups in the kingdom .

title: Bleucorundum
description: Bleucorundum Bluecorundum was a sapphire dragon living under the Omlarandin Mountains near Iltkazar in the Underdark in 1370 DR , who was the self - appointed Sapphire Sentinel of the Sleeping Legion of the Knights of the Crescent Moon . Personality . Bleucorundum was not aggressive by nature but was highly territorial and distrustful of strangers .

title: Bleys Orltusk
description: Bleys Orltusk Bleys Orltusk , also known as The Blade or as Old Tusk , was a dwarf shopkeeper in Blackhold , Fimbrul . Appareance . Bleys had lost one of his eyes .

title: Bleyshar
description: Bleyshar Bleyshar was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In the year 1479 DR , there were only two surviving Bleyshars : Shalice Bleyshar and her nephew Tantram .

title: Blibdoolpoolp
description: Blibdoolpoolp Blibdoolpoolp ( also known as the Sea Mother ) was the deity worshipped by the kuo - toa n race . Her symbol was a lobster head and black pearl . Blibdoolpoolp usually took the form of a 20 foot ( 6 .

title: Blight ( spell )
description: Blight ( spell ) Blight was a necromancy spell that bathed a creature or plant with necromantic energy . Effects . The spell would effectively drain water and vitality from a creature , which would suffer serious necrotic damage .

title: Blind
description: Blind The Blind was an old beholder who lived in Skullport beneath Waterdeep in the 15th century DR . Personality . As his name implied , he was blind .

title: Blinding beauty
description: Blinding beauty Blinding beauty was a transmutation spell that made the caster as beautiful as a nymph , allowing her to blind humanoids that looked at her . Effect . The caster gained the physical beauty of a nymph , with some of the supernatural accompaniments .

title: Blinding glory
description: Blinding glory Blinding glory is a conjuration spell that brightly illuminates an area . Effects . A brilliant radiance spreads from you , brightly illuminating the area .

title: Blinding smite
description: Blinding smite Blinding smite was an evocation spell that made the next hit with a melee weapon create a explosion of light and radiant damage against the target . Effects . For the duration of the spell , a struck target could be blinded and would have to try and resist the magical brightness that struck their eyes .

title: Blindness or deafness
description: Blindness or deafness Blindness or deafness was a necromancy - or , in a variant , illusion - spell that rendered a target blind or deaf as chosen by the caster . Effects . There were several versions of this spell .

title: Blindsight
description: Blindsight " Blindsight " was a general term for the natural ability of certain creatures to perceive their surroundings as well as a sighted creature yet without using visual senses . Senses that could contribute to a creature ' s overall blindsight included enhanced hearing , an acute sense of smell , sensitivity to vibrations , or such specialized senses as echolocation . Because the sense of sight was not involved , a creature with blindsight was not hindered by such spell effects as " invisibility " or " darkness " .

title: Blingdenstone
description: Blingdenstone Blingdenstone was a svirfneblin city - state founded in - 690 DR by svirfnebli fleeing the phaerimm . In 1371 DR , the city was destroyed and abandoned . However , beginning around 1440 DR the svirfneblin began to resettle the town with support from Mithral Hall and Silverymoon .

title: Blink
description: Blink Blink was a transmutation spell caused the caster to " blink " randomly between the Prime Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane , similar to a blink dog . Effect . This made the caster harder to attack , since there was a chance an attack or spell would miss due to the caster not being on the Prime Material Plane at the time .

title: Blink dog
description: Blink dog A blink dog was a mysterious , intelligent canine creature . Most blink dogs had yellow - brown fur and large ears . They were well known for their ability to " blink " — a supernatural teleportation ability .

title: Bliss
description: Bliss Bliss was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lliira , the Joybringer . It caused one creature to fall into a trance of intense joy , ignoring other beings or dangerous situations and feeling no pain . Effects .

title: Blister
description: Blister Blister was a Netherese military outpost established in - 1286 DR in the mountains of southeast Netheril . Defenses . The outpost was so well defended that it survived beyond the fall of the Empire .

title: Bloated Gargoyle Inn
description: Bloated Gargoyle Inn The Bloated Gargoyle Inn was an inn in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . In the early 7th century DR , the infamous pirate Urthag the Knife boldly caroused for several hours at the Bloated Gargoyle Inn . Finally , the Royal Constabulary discovered him and tried to arrest him and Urthag fled across the rooftops of the city .

title: Bloirt Waelarn
description: Bloirt Waelarn Bloirt Waelarn was a human male priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , in the late 13th and 14th centuries DR . He was infamous for launching a holy war against the rival House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , and for his descent into murderous madness in an effort to possess the holy relic the " Tome of Torment " . History .

title: Blood & Magic
description: Blood & Magic Blood & Magic is a computer game released by Interplay in 1996 which uses the " Dungeons & Dragons " license . Gameplay . " Blood & Magic " is a real - time strategy game , where players take on the role of wizards , using blood magic to create monsters .

title: Blood Above , Blood Below
description: Blood Above , Blood Below Blood Above , Blood Below , designed by Will Doyle , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It was designed to be played by three different parties of adventurers at the same time , each with their own objectives but with the success of all of them together determining the final outcome . Summary .

title: Blood Rift
description: Blood Rift The Blood Rift was named for the rift that the River of Blood created crossing the planes . It served as the main connection between the Nine Hells and the Abyss , so it was the main battlefield for the Blood War . In addition , it sometimes connected to other lower planes , bringing the eternal struggle there , until it floated away or a deity took action to stop the carnage .

title: Blood War
description: Blood War The Blood War is an ancient conflict that once raged between the Fiends of the Lower Planes . The Tanar ' ri are the demonic forces of the Abyss , an evil plane of chaos . Representing the equally evil but lawful realm of Baator are the Baatezu , the dominant caste of devilkin .

title: Blood Wine
description: Blood Wine Blood Wine was a wine exported from Aglarond . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Blood fiend
description: Blood fiend Blood fiends are abomination s who feed on the blood of living creatures . Initially created in the Elemental Chaos , they are just as prevalent in other planes , wherever there are creatures to provide food for them . Blood fiends are often mistaken for demon s .

title: Blood mage
description: Blood mage Blood mages are powerful wizard s who have learned to turn their very blood into a weapon of arcane power . The way of a blood mage is undoubtedly painful but its rewards are enormous to those strong enough to survive it . With the proper training , a blood mage makes their own body the fuel to empower their spell s .

title: Blood of Lathander
description: Blood of Lathander The Blood of Lathander was a minor artifact unknown to or forgotten by most of the Realms . A relic of a long - ago battle between an avatar of the Morninglord Lathander and one of Mystra ' s Chosen , it resided in a shrine in the Dalelands thorp of Hap . Description .

title: Blood of Morueme
description: Blood of Morueme The collective term Blood of Morueme originally was given to a subservient race of half – blue dragon hobgoblin s and their descendants but later was also used to describe a clan of blue dragons that lived beneath Dragondoom Mountain in the easternmost peaks of the Nether Mountains " circa " the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . The hobgoblins selected for breeding came from the Red Flayers tribe , which , at the time , occupied Doomspire castle on the slopes of Dragondoom . Organization .

title: Blood of the martyr
description: Blood of the martyr Blood of the martyr is a necromancy spell that transfers the caster ' s life force to heal others . Effect . The cleric may transfer his own life force directly to a target creature within range .

title: Bloodaxe Mercenary Company
description: Bloodaxe Mercenary Company Bloodaxe Mercenary Company was a mercenary company based in Sundabar around 1358 DR . Organization . The Bloodaxe were very skilled and versatile , they adapted their tactics depending of the kind of job they would do .

title: Bloodberry bush
description: Bloodberry bush Bloodberry bushes grew on the plains surrounding the Battle of Bones . Description . Red berries and heart - shaped reddish - green leaves characterized this small bush .

title: Bloodbriars
description: Bloodbriars Bloodbriars was an evocation spell that entangled a foe in unseen briars . Effects . The spell created unseen but very sharp briars from magical energy , ensnaring the foe .

title: Blooden
description: Blooden Blooden was a succubus and mistress of the Deep Crest , the breeding grounds of the Abyss . She was one of the demon s and devil s bound to Ammon Jerro in order to increase his warlock power . She appeared to have an infatuation with Koraboros , despite the fact he was devil and she was a demon .

title: Blooding
description: Blooding The Blooding was a drow coming - of - age ritual in which a maturing drow must hunt down and kill an intelligent or dangerous creature from the surface . Much of the time the ritual was fulfilled during a surface raid , the preferred target being surface elves , but captives may sometimes be placed in the Underdark for the purposes of slaughter .

title: Bloodpurge
description: Bloodpurge Bloodpurge was an herb that could be found in the deeper parts of polluted freshwater marshes in Faerûn . Usage . Bloodpurge could be dried and used as an herb to neutralize minor poisons .

title: Bloodring worm
description: Bloodring worm Bloodring worms were small parasites found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These small worms had metallic skin and four red eyes that looked like small gems .

title: Bloodroot
description: Bloodroot Bloodroot was a plant root that grew only in the Mhair Jungles . Uses . It heightened the taste of blood and was therefore highly addictive to vampires , but not particularly to anyone else .

title: Bloodsong
description: Bloodsong The Bloodsong was a special ceremony performed on the Feast of the Moon each year by the Heralds of Faerûn . Heralds had a number of duties on the Feast of the Moon , a day when the dead were traditionally honored . Prime among these was to perform the Bloodsong ceremony , at which a Herald publically recited the genealogies of each noble family in the area .

title: Bloodstaunch
description: Bloodstaunch Bloodstaunch was an herb used to stop or slow the bleeding of an open wound . Location . The herb could typically be found in gullies located in relatively arid , temperate regions .

title: Bloodstone
description: Bloodstone Bloodstone was the " Realms " name for the mineral , a deep green - gray chalcedony with inclusions of red jasper . Description . This semi - precious stone were usually cut with beveled edges , in smooth ovals which tended to resemble drops of blood .

title: Bloodstone Barony
description: Bloodstone Barony Bloodstone was the name for the barony of Damara that lay within Bloodstone Pass , a narrow valley that crossed the Galena Mountains between Vaasa and Damara . History . The barony of Bloodstone was ruled by the king of Vaasa and Damara , Gareth Dragonsbane .

title: Bloodstone Lands
description: Bloodstone Lands The Bloodstone Lands were a part of the Cold Lands and referred to a cold region in northeast Faerûn , found nestled between the Great Glacier to the north , the nation of Impiltur to the south , and Thar , the Moonsea and Mulmaster to the west . It was roughly triangular in shape and primarily encompassed Damara and Vaasa . It had an area of around 150 , 000 square miles ( 388 , 500 km ) .

title: Bloodstone Pass
description: Bloodstone Pass Bloodstone Pass was the only reasonable crossing point through the Galena Mountains in Northeast Faerûn . History . The pass acted as a trade route between Damara and Vaasa .

title: Bloodstone Pass ( adventure )
description: Bloodstone Pass ( adventure ) Bloodstone Pass is a adventure that was later into the " Forgotten Realms " . It was the first module to feature the tabletop rules . The storyline of " Bloodstone Pass " introduced the character of Gareth Dragonsbane and the Order of the Golden Cup , and was later expanded on in the H series of adventure modules .

title: Bloodstone Village
description: Bloodstone Village Bloodstone Village was the second largest settlement in Bloodstone Pass , the only real accessible link between the lands of Vaasa and Damara . It was within the Barony of Bloodstone before 1357 DR , but the baron of the time , Baron Tranth , had little power over the dominion . In 1359 DR , it became the home of the King of Damara , Gareth Dragonsbane .

title: Bloodwind
description: Bloodwind Bloodwind was a high - member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , after his fellow cultists infiltrated the monastery , Bloodwind went there to commence an elemental ritual .

title: Bloody Keel
description: Bloody Keel The Bloody Keel was the ship of the fiery red haired rogue Sheila Kree . It received its name from the punishment its captain exacted upon those who did not obey , keelhauling . Cattie - Brie sank the Bloody Keel by shooting the helmsman as Sheila Kree and her band was making a hasty escape from her cove .

title: Bloody Skull
description: Bloody Skull The Bloody Skull was an orc clan in the Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn . History . In the mid - 12th century DR , the Bloody Skull were among an alliance of goblin s and orcs that were determined to annihilate the dwarves of Earthfast .

title: Bloom
description: Bloom Bloom was a minor arcane spell that allowed a magic - user to conjure flowers in bloom . Effect . The " bloom " spell simply conjured a cut flower , typically a rose , in full bloom and floating in the air where directed .

title: Bloppblippoodd
description: Bloppblippoodd Bloppblippoodd was a kuo - toa cultist living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . Personality . Bloppblippoodd was a bloodthirsty sadist absolutely assured that her divine vision would raise her in glory to rule her people .

title: Blowpipe
description: Blowpipe Blowpipes come in varying sizes , depending on philosophy of use . When the user needs a medium ranged weapon , for hunting or fighting , the blowpipe is longer , about 2 to 4 feet long , and heavier and uses larger dart s . When they need a small , concealable short range weapon they are 8 inches to 2 feet .

title: Blue Age
description: Blue Age The Blue Age was a time in the ancient history of Abeir - Toril when life on the planet resided in a single , vast ocean . The Dawn War between the god s and the primordial s raged mostly over this unfortunate planet at the time and one of the primordials , Dendar the Night Serpent , devoured one of Selûne ' s most favored creations , the sun ( a feat her sister Shar had been attempting since its creation ) . The temperatures on Abeir - Toril subsequently dropped markedly and not long afterward , most life on the planet became extinct .

title: Blue Bear Tribe
