description: Blue Bear Tribe The Blue Bear Tribe were a tribe of the Uthgardt . History . In 1313 DR , the Tree Ghost tribe separated from the Blue Bears .

title: Blue Dragons
description: Blue Dragons The Blue Dragons was the name of Cormyr ' s navy . They were based in the Citadel of the Purple Dragons in Suzail and patrolled the waters of the Dragonmere . Organization .

title: Blue Kumi Bandits
description: Blue Kumi Bandits The Blue Kumi Bandits were a group of bandits who plagued the Fochu Peninsula around 1358 DR . They were originally a group of disaffected bushi of the city of Fochu . Without work , they turned to banditry , using a distinctive blue kumi ( braid ) dangling down their backs .

title: Blue Lady
description: Blue Lady The Blue Lady was a spellplague - changed sirine worshiped by the Choir cult . History . The Blue Lady was a sirine that was transmuted by the Spellplague .

title: Blue Sigil
description: Blue Sigil The Blue Sigil was a mercenary company comprised of ogre s that was based in Mog ' s Keep , near Longsaddle and operated throughout the North . Around 1358 DR , they were led by an ogre named Mog the Fist , whose keep bore his name . History .

title: Blue Wyvern Company
description: Blue Wyvern Company The Blue Wyvern Company was an adventuring group based in Ravens Bluff . The group was best known for helping Jack Ravenwild recover the shadow magic tome known as the Sarkenaegal in 1479 DR . History .

title: Blue dragon
description: Blue dragon Blue dragons , also known as storm dragons , are orderly creatures and are unusual for chromatics in that they keep fairly well - ordered , hierarchical societies . They are more likely to be mocking and manipulative than outrightly cruel or murderous to ' lesser ' creatures , aided greatly by their natural talents for hallucination . They are infamous for tricking desert travelers into drinking sand or going miles out of their way to avoid nonexistent dust basins .

title: Blue ice
description: Blue ice Blue ice was a mysterious magical substance found in the Yellow Sea of Kara - Tur . Blue ice was so cold it burned flesh , yet it sizzled and smoked when immersed in water . Appendix .

title: Blue quartz
description: Blue quartz Blue quartz was a transparent , pale blue crystal . Description . These large , single crystallized ornamental stones were the preferred ingredient to produce gems of seeing , especially in ancient versions of this magic item .

title: Blue slaad
description: Blue slaad Blue slaadi were a type of slaad . Description . Blue slaadi had bone hooks protruding from the backs of their hands .

title: Bluecap
description: Bluecap Bluecap fungus was the main staple grain of the Underdark . Description . Bluecaps were tall ( up to 6 inches ) , slender white mushrooms with pale blue caps .

title: Blueflame ghost
description: Blueflame ghost Blueflame ghosts are spirits which are imprisoned within blueflame magic items . Some members of the adventuring group The Nine are among the blueflame ghosts . The term comes from the magical blue flames that surround the ghosts .

title: Blueleaf
description: Blueleaf A blueleaf was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Bluewood was the name of the wood taken from this tree . Description .

title: Bluestone
description: Bluestone Bluestone was the " Realms " name for , or " ditroite " , which was a rich blue but soft and brittle mineral . Sometimes bluestone had veins of pink , white , cream , and yellow . Description .

title: Blugdub
description: Blugdub Blugdub was an orog leader in Blingdenstone . History . In 1478 DR , Blugdub , like Ashkabbar , led a group of orc s into a section of Blingdenstone .

title: Blur
description: Blur Blur was an illusion spell that made the contours of a caster " blurry " . Effects . When under this spell , the caster would become harder to hit as they did not appear to have a solid form any more .

title: Blushing Mermaid
description: Blushing Mermaid The Blushing Mermaid was a famous lower - class tavern in the city of Baldur ' s Gate , located in the northeast part of the upper city on the Sword Coast . Structure . The tavern was long , low building which looked like it would collapse at any minute .

title: Blustich
description: Blustich Blustich was a small hamlet on the edge of the Hermit ' s Wood and the west bank of the Wyvernflow . Inhabitants . The villagers of Blustich spent most of their time hunting , fishing , and farming .

title: Bly Ruldegost
description: Bly Ruldegost Bly Ruldegost was a proud and honorable member of the Knights of the Shield and the regent of House Ruldegost . Personality . While Ruldegost attempted to recruit other Waterdhavian nobles to his order , he did not believe in instituting a Knight of the Shield within the ranks of the Lords of Waterdeep .

title: Boakhar
description: Boakhar Boakhar was what folk of the " Realms " called . Description . This semi - precious stone was extremely soft and fragile , but its tabular red or orange crystals yielded small transparent gem s for use in ornamental gem - work , such as inlays on furniture and royal displays .

title: Boar
description: Boar Boars are wild relatives of the domestic pig . Physical description . Boars are covered in thick fur , often brown or grayish in color .

title: Boareskyr Bridge
description: Boareskyr Bridge Boareskyr Bridge was the crossing over the Winding Water connecting Soubar , Triel , and Scornubel to Waterdeep and the Trade Way . History . The bridge was built by the traveler Boareskyr .

title: Bodak
description: Bodak Bodaks were what was left of a humanoid that had been destroyed by the touch of pure evil , such as that of a nightwalker . Undead creatures devoid of personality or a soul , bodaks were cruel and relentless hunters , either of their own volition or at the behest of some greater power , such as the nightwalker that created them . Ecology .

title: Boddyknock Glinckle
description: Boddyknock Glinckle Boddyknock Glinckle was a male gnome sorcerer from Lantan who was present in Neverwinter during the Wailing Death . Description . A henchman to the Hero of Neverwinter , Boddyknock was skilled in arcane magic but also used a crossbow and dagger when needed .

title: Bodhi
description: Bodhi Bodhi was a vampire who was expelled from Suldanessellar , which would lead to her becoming an undead . She , with Jon Irenicus , was a plotter who wanted to drain the Tree of Life and become immortal . She was also once in love with Abdel Adrian , Hero of Baldur ' s Gate , as he was with her .

title: Body link
description: Body link Body link was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable by wizard s and priest s ( cleric s ) . Effects .

title: Boesild Aerasumé
description: Boesild Aerasumé Boesild Aerasumé was Alustriel Silverhand ' s eighth son . He was known for being the most pragmatic of her sons . Boesild was also the Moonstars ' regional agent for Luruar and the Evermoors regions and the only one of Alustriel ' s children who got on well with Khelben Arunsun .

title: Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II
description: Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II was a male gnome fighter and owner of the tavern called The Furniture ' s Fate in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Boffo , being an eccentric prankster , was usually at the center of brawls in the aptly named Furniture ' s Fate .

title: Bog Luck
description: Bog Luck Bog Luck was a half - orc member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin , and the owner of the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North . History . Bog Luck owned a roadhouse north of Waterdeep on a highly trafficked caravan road - the High Road .

title: Bogclaw
description: Bogclaw Bogclaw was a lizardfolk in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bogclaw was a young and strong leader for his tribe .

title: Boggle
description: Boggle Boggles were creatures born out of feelings of loneliness , materializing where the Feywild touched the world in proximity to an intelligent being that felt isolated or abandoned . Boggles were not murderous , and preferred to do simple tricks such as breaking dishes , and so on .

title: Bogo Rath
description: Bogo Rath Bogo Rath was an evil wizard who was affiliated with the Night Masks and Castle Trinity . History . Bogo was a minor wizard in the Night Masks but later quit the thieves ' guild and entered into the service of the powerful wizard Aballister Bonaduce , leader of Castle Trinity .

title: Bok
description: Bok Bok was a powerful flesh golem manufactured by Dendybar the Mottled , a wizard and the guardian of the northern spire in the Hosttower of the Arcane in the seaport city of Luskan . In 1356 DR , Dendybar sent Bok alongside the wizard Sydney and the soldier Jierdan in search of Drizzt Do ' Urden with the hopes of acquiring Crenshinibon . Bok was destroyed by Drizzt during a vicious fight near Mithral Hall .

title: Bokika Hokio
description: Bokika Hokio Bokika Hokio was a disgraced daimyo in Wa around 1357 DR and 1358 DR . Personality . Hokio was a bitter man , living only for revenge against the shogun .

title: Bol
description: Bol Bol was a tiefling warrior and a member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . Bol was one of the members of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Bolas
description: Bolas A bolas is an exotic ranged weapon . Description . A set of bolas consists of two or three spheres connected by long cords to a central point .

title: Bold Jhyak ' s
description: Bold Jhyak ' s Bold Jhyak ' s was a tavern and smokehouse in Teshburl that stood out in that naval town for appearing like a Northern roadhouse . Description . The tavern was a rustic building made of flagstone with low beams on its ceiling .

title: Boldovar Obarskyr
description: Boldovar Obarskyr Boldovar Obarskyr ( Boldovar the Mad ) was the king of Cormyr until his believed death in 242 DR . Although Boldovar was the second eldest male child , he was crowned after his father , Tharyann , outlived his older siblings . Relatives .

title: Bolhur the Clanless
description: Bolhur the Clanless Bolhur the Clanless was the father of Durlag Trollkiller and lived in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn . He was a great warrior in his time , earning him the name Thunderaxe . He roamed Faerûn , much like his son one day would .

title: Bollus
description: Bollus Bollus was a caravaneer in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Bollus was a caravaneer who originated from Calimport and owned a caravan business in Westgate , who traveled up and down between the two cities .

title: Bolothamogg
description: Bolothamogg Bolothamogg , " " Him Who Watches from Beyond the Stars " " , was a primal force or entity ( Elder Evil ) that sought to protect the Far Realm from the " taint " of the other dimensions . " " The Darkness between the Stars " " was honored by the Aboleth s by leaving large gaps and empty spaces in their architecture and by constructing large open buildings . Bolothamogg had made some sort of alliance with the demon lord Areex , whom he ordered to venture " Beyond the Stars " to pay the price of their deal .

title: Bolt of glory
description: Bolt of glory Bolt of glory was an evocation spell that struck a target with a blast of positive energy . Effect . By casting this spell , one projected a bolt of energy from the Positive Energy Plane against one creature .

title: Bolton Brimwell
description: Bolton Brimwell Bolton Brimwell was an innkeeper of the Guts and Garters in the Lower Heart of Skullport . Personality . The innkeeper would show patrons a secret passage to the alley near the Feathered Rat for an extra gold piece .

title: Bone Dance
description: Bone Dance The Bone Dance was a religious hunting festival dedicated to Malar the Beastlord and practiced in the Vast . It was held on the night of Highsun 9th and hosted by cleric s of Malar . The Malarites animated the skeletons of great stag s and other beasts , and the oldest and youngest members of the community played hunters .

title: Bone naga
description: Bone naga Bone nagas were an undead form of naga s . They resulted from a naga ' s resurrection process being interrupted by a necromantic ritual developed by the yuan - ti that transformed them into servants with a fraction of the abilities that the original nagas possessed .

title: Bone ring
description: Bone ring A bone ring is a magic ring that will protect its wearer from ability drain or energy drain . Despite its name , it can be made from bone , stone or ivory , but will never be made from any . Each time it protects the wearer , a charge is used up , and when all charges are gone , it crumbles to dust .

title: Bone rot
description: Bone rot Bone rot was a disease that could cause bones to become brittle and rot away . It was prevalent in swamp areas containing the dead , particularly graveyards and battlefields . The disease was contracted through contact and had an incubation time of between one and three days .

title: Bonfire of insanity
description: Bonfire of insanity A Bonfire of insanity is a vile ritual performed during rainstorms by powerful necromancers . They build a pyre of human bones and burn it as the rain pours . As the smoke from the fire rises to the clouds , the rain itself is tainted for a mile around the ritual site .

title: Bonnalurie
description: Bonnalurie Bonnalurie was a sun elf and priestess of Angharradh in Tintageer . When her home was destroyed in a war , she was the last surviving priestess with enough power to control High Magic . On behalf of Durothil , she began to dance and sing to create a magical gate through the boundaries of the realms .

title: Bonnerbas Ironcap
description: Bonnerbas Ironcap Bonnerbas Ironcap was the dwarven soldier from Mithral Hall . He was killed by Proffit during the battle with troll s in 1370 DR . He was a member of the General Dagna Waybeard ' s squad , which was sent from Mithral Hall to protect the refugees from Nesme .

title: Boo
description: Boo Boo was the pet and companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc , having joined him shortly after he sustained an injury to his head . While there was skepticism regarding the claim , Minsc insisted that Boo was , in fact , a miniature giant space hamster who was intelligent and could converse coherently with him . However , as Minsc was quite addled , it was unclear whether or not his claims were true .

title: Boobrie
description: Boobrie The boobrie is a magical beast and a giant relative of the stork at 12 ' ( 3 . 7m ) tall , that lives in swamps and marshes . It attacks by finding a tall patch of grass , hiding in it , and waiting for prey to come .

title: Book Knowledge
description: Book Knowledge Adventurers out of Undermountain recently sold a local sage a book detailing the history of the first three Green Regent s . Bizarrely , it seems as though everyone who has come into contact with the book has vanished . The adventurers and the sage have all disappeared and the Sage ' s wife wants him back .

title: Book of Bats
description: Book of Bats The Book of Bats was a spellbook of unknown origin found in the Realms . Description . This tome was tall and narrow , measuring approximately three handwidths wide and nine handwidths tall .

title: Book of Change
description: Book of Change The Book of Change was a book presenting a system of divination using trigrams . It was written by the sage Hsin Fu Chan . History .

title: Book of Lore
description: Book of Lore The Book of Lore was a magical tome that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The binding of this book was red leather from an unknown creature .

title: Book of St . Sollars
description: Book of St . Sollars The Book of St . Sollars was a religious tome dedicated to St .

title: Book of Tarchamus
description: Book of Tarchamus The Book of Tarchamus was a sentient book that was actually the consciousness of the ancient Netherese arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding . After Tarchamus built his library , he turned his physical form into a powerful mummy with the help of his apprentices . He placed most of his intelligence into a magical tome with the remainder staying with his physical body .

title: Book of the Holy Scourge
description: Book of the Holy Scourge The Book of the Holy Scourge was a sacred book of the Church of Ilmater . Though not the holiest book of the faith ( that honor went to the " Tome of Torment " ) , it was probably the most well - known and useful . Abilities .

title: Book of the World
description: Book of the World The Book of the World was an enigmatic tome discovered in Asram in approximately 1254 DR ; from the oxidation of the pages , the book was probably created some 400 years before that . The book consisted of some 300 sheets of a thin , flexible metal upon which a simplified runic script in an extremely ancient form of Thorass had been scribed . Only a single copy of the book was ever found , but it was evidently once the center of a body of religious beliefs .

title: Books and Scrolls
description: Books and Scrolls Books and Scolls was a small shop located in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Books and Scrolls was jammed with all kinds of books , scrolls , and maps .

title: Booming blade
description: Booming blade Booming blade is a basic spell of the evocation school often used by shielding swordmages , as well as swordmage s of other styles . When a swordmage attacks a creature with their blade , they have the option to add the sonic energy to their attack , using a field of thunderous noise to injure their retreating foe . Like most swordmage spells , the spell is charged primarily by the swordmage ' s intellect , though their durability adds to the effectiveness of their sonic attack and more experienced swordmages cast " booming blade " with more power .

title: Boots of elvenkind
description: Boots of elvenkind Boots of elvenkind were a magical item that allowed the wearer to step across any surface quietly . They were also known as Elven boots , Elvish boots , or Elven sneaking boots . Description .

title: Boots of the winterlands
description: Boots of the winterlands Boots of the winterlands were common magical boots that allowed the wearer to stride atop snow and ice and protected from the effects of bitter cold . Description . " Boots of the winterlands " weighed about a pound ( half a kilogram ) and gave off a faint aura of both abjuration and transmutation magic .

title: Borador Goldhand
description: Borador Goldhand Borador ' Goldhand ' ( a moniker picked up for his legendary avarice ) is a dwarven treasure - hunter and one of the five starting playable characters in . He is classed as a rogue and uses numerous thief abilities . Background .

title: Boraksaghegirak
description: Boraksaghegirak Boraksaghegirak , commonly called Borak , was an ancient blue dragon residing in the ruins of the city of Imer in the Calim Desert . History . Hundreds of years before the 14th century DR , Borak allied with an eager and able wizard .

title: Border Forest
description: Border Forest The Border Forest was a large forest that connected four different regions of Faerûn : the Dalelands to the south , Anauroch to the west , the Tortured Land to the north and the Moonsea to the east . Geography . The Border Forest was a mixture of pines , oak s and other deciduous trees ; the forest undergrowth was relatively thick , making the walk difficult .

title: Border Kingdoms
description: Border Kingdoms The Border Kingdoms occupy an area of lush grasslands between the Lake of Steam and the Shaar . This area is divided politically into many smaller principalities and kingdoms . Because of the instability of the Border Kingdoms , no accurate maps exist and the borders move around as rulers and boundaries change — this is the ideal place for adventurers wanting to start a kingdom of their own .

title: Borem
description: Borem Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud was one of the Seven Lost Gods , possibly a primordial who remained on Toril after the split between Abeir and its twin . History . In - 359 DR , Borem became active after long years of appearing as a simple muddy river .

title: Borem ' s Quagheart
description: Borem ' s Quagheart Borem ' s Quagheart was a potent magical artifact . Description . The " Quagheart " was a malodorous lump of brown skin and muscle , covered in slime and mud — the final remains of the god Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud .

title: Borgan Selgard
description: Borgan Selgard Borgan Selgard was a mercenary in the year 1375 DR . Description . Borgan was a grizzled man with gray hair and a short beard .

title: Borigon Hillsafar
description: Borigon Hillsafar Borigon Hillsafar was the king of Hillsafar Hall in Vaasa in 1479 DR . History . In 1470 DR , the Warlock Knights of Vaasa invaded Hillsafar Hall .

title: Boris Elberwelter
description: Boris Elberwelter Boris Elberwelter was a male human and the proprietor of the inn called The Sign of Thunder in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . His wife was Tasha . He heard the Wolfmasters adventuring company discussing rumors of a large ruin in the Vast Swamp .

title: Borlann
description: Borlann Borlann was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1450 DR . History . He was the last lover of the Thayan elf Dahlia Sin ' felle but in that year Dahlia decided to terminate their relationship , and as always , she killed Borlann after the separation .

title: Borlin
description: Borlin Borlin , blood of Ghellin , titled Axe of the Iron House , was a male dwarf of the Iron House , the exiled royal court of the Mines of Tethyamar . He was a descendent of Ghellin , King - in - Exile of the Iron House . He was also a leader of dwarven armies , such as the Mithril Legion .

title: Bormton
description: Bormton Bormton was a village in Amn , lying between Trademeet and the Small Teeth mountains . History . Revered Brother Filithan of the Church of Ilmater originally hailed from Bormton .

title: Born
description: Born Born was a creature that claimed dominion over Dragonspear Castle in the Western Heartlands around 1479 DR . Born led the undead forces that emerged from the Nepenthe River under the castle . They slaughtered the living inhabitants and destroyed the shrine to Tempus , before shrouding the castle in a constant fog and repelling efforts to retake the castle .

title: Boronuil Ironfist
description: Boronuil Ironfist Boronuil Ironfist was a dwarven craftsman living in Galdel in 1367 DR . Activities . Boronuil was renowned for being one of the best electrum craftsmen in all of Halruaa .

title: Borri mac Rogni
description: Borri mac Rogni Borri mac Rogni was a dwarf priest of Moradin in the Moonsea . Activities . Borri was a priest and a member of the Hammer of Moradin in Earthfast .

title: Borsipa
description: Borsipa Borsipa was an apprentice member of the Northern Wizards in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . In truth , Borsipa was a spy for Gilgeam , sending constant reports to the king ' s army .

title: Borstag Duncastle
description: Borstag Duncastle Borstag Duncastle was a merchant prince and an official of Sembia in the 1370s DR . Activities . Borstag represented Sembian interests concerned with trade , settlement , and industry in the Dales and the Moonsea .

title: Borth Jhandelspar
description: Borth Jhandelspar Borth Jhandelspar was a barbarian who worked as a guide in Triboar in the Savage Frontier . History . He was cast out of his tribe as a youth and adopted by a Triboar family .

title: Boruse Temlor
description: Boruse Temlor Boruse Temlor was the head cleric of Cyric at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . Personality . Boruse was a cold and remote individual .

title: Borwald Firehammer
description: Borwald Firehammer Borwald Firehammer was the chief advisor of Horgar Steelshadow in Gracklstugh during the Silence of Lolth . History . Borwald was one of the most loyal followers of Horgar and was his chief advisor and marshal of the army .

title: Bosturo
description: Bosturo Bosturo was a noted sage and keeper of the Muradi Lighthouse in Koryo around 1357 DR . History . Bosturo grew up in the Quang Muku Forest , but came to be the Master of the Muradi Lighthouse in 1308 DR .

title: Bottom Feeder ( ship )
description: Bottom Feeder ( ship ) Bottom Feeder was a riverboat run by a crew of dwarves . Description . " Bottom Feeder " was as 20 - foot - long ( 6 .

title: Boubakar
description: Boubakar Boubakar was the spymaster of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Boubakar directed the spies of the small kingdom of Golconda .

title: Bouladin al - Mutajalli
description: Bouladin al - Mutajalli Bouladin al - Mutajalli was the Amir of the jann of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Bouladin was an honest and noble janni , but did not hesitate to strike against those who opposed him or threatened the House of Sihr .

title: Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun
description: Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun ( often known simply as Cavus Dun ) were renowned mercenaries from Netheril . Organization . Members of the mercenary group were not considered Netherese nobles , but were considered above commoners .

title: Bounty hunter
description: Bounty hunter A Bounty hunter is someone who hunts for someone or something for a price . It is an occupation on Faerûn . The Bounty hunter will track , hunt , capture , kill or seize the thing or person for the right price , no matter the cost to him ( unless the cost is more than the gain ) .

title: Bounty of the Goddess
description: Bounty of the Goddess The Bounty of the Goddess was a temple and garden complex dedicated to Chauntea in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn .

title: Bounty seekers
description: Bounty seekers The bounty seekers were a trio of bounty hunters sent by Baron Abon Duum of Manshaka in Calimshan to recapture Vajra Valmeyjar , the famous veteran slave - gladiator of the Arena of Blood who had escaped the baron ' s service . History . Baron Abon Duum wanted Vajra back in his service , as she ' d been very profitable to him as a gladiator , and so sent the bounty seekers after her .

title: Bouqthi
description: Bouqthi Bouqthi was a type of pastry made in Luiren . Despite its popularity , " bouqthi " was rarely exported since pastries did not fare well under the rigors of travelling over long distances . Description .

title: Bow
description: Bow A bow was a two - handed muscle - powered projectile weapon used to shoot arrow s at a distant target . Bows came in a variety of different sizes and could be made of wood , horn , or bone . Composite bows were made of thin layers of these materials laminated together for extra strength .

title: Bow of the Black Archer
description: Bow of the Black Archer The Bow of the Black Archer was the weapon of the elven deity Shevarash until he was captured and slain by the drow . Description . Apart from the fact that the bow was as black as pitch , it was completely unremarkable in terms of looks .

title: Bowgentle
description: Bowgentle Bowgentle of Silverymoon was a legendary wizard . Personality . Bowgentle was noted for his calm demeanour , politeness and generosity , but also for his reckless adventuring .

title: Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey
description: Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey Bowgentle ' s fleeting journey was an arcane alteration spell that briefly teleported another person or creature to a nearby location and then back to the point of origin . Effects . This spell only worked on a single live creature ( not undead or an inanimate object ) that was successfully touched while casting the spell .

title: Bowshot
description: Bowshot Bowshot sits aside the Trade Way north of the Way Inn and south of Liam ' s Hold . It was name for its location , being a " bowshot " from the Misty Forest when the village was founded . The woods are now considerably farther away as the years of logging have taken their toll .

title: Boyla ' s Court
description: Boyla ' s Court The Boyla ' s Court was a large outdoor courtyard found near the center of Manass in Khazari . Uses . The courtyard served as a prime location for a variety of events such as public announcements , executions , torturing criminals , and public festivals .

title: Brace Lenalice
description: Brace Lenalice Brace Lenalice , who usually went by Brace the Bold , was a gnome bard who lived in Westgate Description . Brace had a huge nose and large ears . Abilities .

title: Brace Skatterhawk
description: Brace Skatterhawk Brace Skatterhawk was a knight and a member of the Skatterhawk noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .

title: Brace Ulmemur
description: Brace Ulmemur Brace Ulmemur was a City Watch fighter in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Brace was very loyal to friends but was liable to hunt a betrayer to the end of the world .

title: Bracers of armor
description: Bracers of armor Bracers of armor were magical armor pieces for the forearms that protected the wearer with an invisible field of force that acted as a source of armor for his or her whole body . Description . Most bracers of armor appeared to be a pair of normal .

title: Bracers of the blinding strike
description: Bracers of the blinding strike Bracers of the blinding strike were a pair of magical bracers worn on the wrists . Description . This pair of magical ringlets could be worn over any appendage , size permitting , to magically increase the speed of , in most cases , the limb that the ringlets adorned .

title: Brack ' thal Xorlarrin
description: Brack ' thal Xorlarrin Brack ' thal Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan . History . Prior to the Spellplague , Brack ' thal was a powerful wizard favored by Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin .

title: Braden Yil
description: Braden Yil Braden Yil was a merchant retainer of House Cadorna of Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Braden was a nervous but meticulous individual .

title: Braelen Hatherhand
description: Braelen Hatherhand Braelen Hatherhand was a boy in Red Larch and a son of a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , his father put him in the Tomb of Moving Stones as punishment for failed to deliver a message to Ilmeth Waelvur .

title: Braelin Janquay
description: Braelin Janquay Braelin Janquay was a drow scout within Jarlaxle ' s Bregan D ' aerthe . History . In 1483 DR , Bregan D ' aerthe leader Jarlaxle met the reincarnated Regis and , despite not recognizing him , sent spies to report on him .

title: Braerindra Calauth
description: Braerindra Calauth Braerindra Calauth was an elven woman who was the last of Calauth House in Cormanthyr . After her death , she rose as a specter and was entrusted by the Coronal to act as guardian of his quarters . History .

title: Braeryn
description: Braeryn The Braeryn , nicknamed Stenchstreets , was the lowest , poorest , and most crowded district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Inhabitants . The Braeryn ' s houses were full of escaped or disposed of slaves of many races especially orc s and goblinoid s .

title: Brain golem
description: Brain golem A brain golem was an eight - foot - tall humanoid - shaped construct made entirely of brain tissue with a bud of an elder brain for a head . These creations existed only to serve an elder brain and its illithid community . They did not communicate in any way and only reacted to the telepathic orders of mind flayers , and could not attack any mind flayer .

title: Brainstealer dragon
description: Brainstealer dragon A brainstealer dragon was a mix of illithid and dragon . They sometimes ruled illithid settlements that did not have an elder brain . Appendix .

title: Brakar ( weasel )
description: Brakar ( weasel ) Brakar was a weasel and the familiar of Chaid al Farid al Fuqani . Chaid first bonded with Brakar on 28 Uktar 1374 DR . Chaid had wanted to name the creature " Brakar " , but on advice from Tsarra Chaadren , asked the weasel if it already had a name , and , on learning that it did not , asked if it minded being called " Brakar " , to which it agreed .

title: Bralani
description: Bralani Bralani are noble eladrin who hold dominance over the autumn winds . They usher in winter in the great cycle of life , death , and rebirth . They are considered to be the fiercest and wildest of all the celestial s , living from moment to moment .

title: Bramas Thorntree
description: Bramas Thorntree Bramas Thorntree was a thief and smuggler in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Bramas worked for Kiros Tamadan , a spice merchant in Athkatla , that through various agents and blind contacts worked for Inselm Hhune .

title: Brambleberry
description: Brambleberry Lord Brambleberry was a noble of Waterdeep . He held a great hatred for Luskan ' s pirate activity . In 1376 DR , he agreed with Captain Deudermont of the " Sea Sprite " to reform Luskan by eliminating the High Captains of Luskan and the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Bran Skorlsun
description: Bran Skorlsun Bran Skorlsun was a well - respected High Harper , who dared to love an elven princess and was also the indirect cause for the creation of the Tel ' Teukiira . Description . Bran was a tall man beginning to visibly age at the time of Khelben ' s trial .

title: Branch of Linden
description: Branch of Linden The Branch of Linden was an organization operating out of Tethyr in the mid 1400 ' s DR . Activities . Comprised of supporters of Evonne Linden and her revolt against her sister Anais Linden as queen of Tethyr , the Branch of Linden attempted to overthrow the current queen and her supporters .

title: Brand
description: Brand Brand was a sadistic wizard spell created by a " shig ' harak " of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . " Brand " was similar to the " wizard mark " spell save that it could be placed on any surface , including flesh .

title: Branded
description: Branded The Branded , or abd Wusum , were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . The efreet mamluk s of the Branded guarded the Sultan ' s personal harim .

title: Brandeen
description: Brandeen Brandeen is the common name in the Realms for stibiotantalite , a rare mineral which sometimes contains clear areas of reddish brown to honey - yellow hue which can be cut to yield small , hard , faceted gems . A typical specimen has a base value of 100gp .

title: Brandiar
description: Brandiar The Duchy of Brandiar was a small region of Damara in 1357 DR . Description . Farming settlements dominated the landscape for most of Brandiar .

title: Brandilar
description: Brandilar Brandilar was the guard captain of the Merchant ' s League headquarters in Baldur ' s Gate . History . During the iron crisis , Brandilar was aware of abnormalities in his organization ' s leaders .

title: Branding smite
description: Branding smite Branding smite was an evocation spell that produced an astral radiant glow on a target when struck . Effects . If the enchanted weapon struck an invisible target , then it would give off a soft glow to a distance of about 5 feet ( 1 .

title: Brandobaris
description: Brandobaris Brandobaris was the halfling deity of thievery and an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl . He was the misapprehensions of halflings held by most races in divine form . He was constantly scheming and meddling , as he was curious and with a short attention span .

title: Brandyr
description: Brandyr Brandyr was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn , who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Brandyr was in charge of the Six - Fingered Courtyard , where inhabitants paid homage to the demon lord Graz ' zt with four cambion assistants until an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect samples of fiendish fire giant bloods confronted and defeated her and her minions .

title: Branislav Semyon
description: Branislav Semyon Branislav Semyon serves as a bodyguard within the Tower of the Blades in Mulmaster and often carries out assassin work for High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin . He often disguises himself as Draazu , one of the region ' s earliest hired killers . Branislav is not the only person to have taken this name , only furthering the legend and mystery surrounding Draazu ' s whereabouts .

title: Brant Rethalshield
description: Brant Rethalshield Brant Rethalshield was a human aspirant to the Order of the Aster . He was the squire of Grayth Holmfast . Appearances .

title: Branwen
description: Branwen Branwen was a human female cleric of Tempus who lived in the late 13th century DR . Born in the village of Seawolf in the Norheim Isles , Branwen was reviled by her fellow villagers for pursuing the traditionally male - oriented profession of priest . She wandered the Sword Coast , eventually falling in with a malicious adventuring troupe .

title: Brass dragon
description: Brass dragon Brass dragons were the weakest of the metallic dragon s , and also one of the most benign of all species of dragon . They loved to talk , to the exclusion of most else . They loved to engage friends and foes alike in hours of long - winded conversation .

title: Brathes
description: Brathes Brathes was the bodyguard of the new pharaoh of Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Brathes was trying to act as bridge between the new pharaoh and the clergy of Anhur .

title: Braundlae ' s Best
description: Braundlae ' s Best Braundlae ' s Best was a restaurant and tavern on the promenade below the Roving Dragon in Suzail , Cormyr and staffed by Braundlae . Food and drink . The restaurant served live eel s in mint - and - lime hot sauce and sausage rolls with Silver dragon sauce .

title: Braxow
description: Braxow Braxow was a stone giant thane sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Braxow was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Brazier
description: Brazier Braziers were simple devices that could be used to burn materials or to house burner s to provide a low but constant source of heat . Description . Braziers were essential in a wizard ' s laboratory .

title: Breachgnome
description: Breachgnome Breachgnomes were a type of gnomish fighter that were trained to single - handedly hold off enemies for as long as possible . Most breachgnomes were fighter s , ranger s , paladin s , or barbarians . They were generally found only in gnomish villages , although occasionally they could be found traveling alone .

title: Breastplate
description: Breastplate A breastplate was one of the better forms of medium armor . Description . The armor covered the wearer ' s front and back with a metal cuirass , and included a helmet and greaves .

title: Breath of Petron
description: Breath of Petron The Breath of Petron was a powerful dragonborn artifact . Description . The Breath of Petron was a flute that looked like a root made of red stone , branching in at least six different directions into finer tubes .

title: Breath of life
description: Breath of life Breath of life was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to cure nonmagical diseases in many people over a wide area . The reverse of this spell , breath of death could infect people in a large area with a fatal disease . Effects .

title: Breath of the Sultan
description: Breath of the Sultan The Breath of the Sultan was a special fountain found within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . The fountain was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Breath of the Yellow Rose
description: Breath of the Yellow Rose Breath of the Yellow Rose , designed by Greg Marks , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Mulmaster , its noble families and the Chapter House of the Yellow Breath . Summary .

title: Bredisker
description: Bredisker Bredisker was a thief of the 12th century DR . In the Year of the Majesty , 1177 DR , in the southern Sword Coast lands , Bredisker successfully stole the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . Bredisker fled east to the Thornwood , but was continually harassed and stalked by the Ilmatari .

title: Breek
description: Breek Breek was a soup served at the Flying Stag inn , in Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . Breek was prepared by boiling beef from all parts of a cow ( including hooves ) into a broth and then straining out the solid bits .

title: Breex Vandermast
description: Breex Vandermast Breex Vandermast was an evil half - orc sorcerer living in Hillsfar . Personality . Breex was an intelligent and annoyingly confident individual .

title: Bregan D ' aerthe
description: Bregan D ' aerthe Bregan D ' aerthe was an elite drow mercenary and later mercantile group founded and led by Jarlaxle , primarily based in Menzoberranzan in the Underdark . History . Founding .

title: Brelaina
description: Brelaina Brelaina was the captain of the Watch of Neverwinter . Description . Brelaina was typically dressed as a soldier .

title: Bremen
description: Bremen Bremen is the westernmost of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . Bremen is located is located on the southwestern shore of Maer Dualdon where the Shaengarne River meets the lake .

title: Bren Tallsword
description: Bren Tallsword Bren Tallsword was a male human fighter and the commander of the forces stationed at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Tallsword was a rigid and strict disciplinarian .

title: Brenna Graycloak
description: Brenna Graycloak Brenna Graycloak was a wizard and councilor of Aglarond . Personality . Brenna was once a city - dweller ignorant of life in the larger world , but after a mission to Thay , her mind was opened .

title: Brennus Tanthul
description: Brennus Tanthul Prince Brennus Tanthul was the youngest brother among the princes , and many would say that Telamont Tanthul has a special fondness for him . Identified early as an intellectual prodigy , the boy was placed in the hands of the city ' s finest tutors and educators . Although Brennus displayed the royal family ' s expected facility with arcane magic , his teachers noted that he showed an equally strong aptitude for history .

title: Bresnos Huantilar
description: Bresnos Huantilar Bresnos Huantilar was a human male from Sembia and a member of the Saerloon chapter of the Cult of the Dragon . Description . Standing 5 ' 3 " ( 1 .

title: Brian
description: Brian Brian , known as Brian the Swordmaster , was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Brian was bald with a black beard and a permanent scowl .

title: Brian Fargo
description: Brian Fargo Brian Fargo is a computer game producer and designer who founded both and . Career . Fargo began work in the video game industry in 1982 .

title: Brian R . James
description: Brian R . James Brian R . James is a senior software developer by day .

title: Brian Thomsen
description: Brian Thomsen Brian Michael Thomsen was a writer and editor who worked for TSR , Inc . Career . Thomsen worked as the managing editor for fiction for TSR .

title: Brianna Burdun
description: Brianna Burdun Brianna Burdun was a priestess of the giant goddess Hiatea and the queen of Hartsvale in 1366 DR . Description . Because of the giant - blood running in her veins , Brianna was nearly seven feet tall , with a body a rugged as most human males without sacrificing her femininity .

title: Brianne Byndraeth
description: Brianne Byndraeth Brianne Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and the widow of fellow Lord and crime lord Carril Byndraeth . Brianne ' s marriage to a fellow Lord caused many troubles . The rift that was opened between the two just before Carril ' s death nearly caused the split of the Lords into two factions .

title: Briarbones
description: Briarbones Briarbones is an Avolakia wizard who lives in the Waterdeep sewers beneath Seawind Alley where he studies the phenomenom of the ghostly whispering voices . His lair is guarded by zombies he created . Briarbones was a tutor to the elven warlock Quessahn Uthraebor and she came to him for advice on stopping the First Flensing .

title: Briarsting
description: Briarsting Briarsting was a thorn who was tasked with guarding the tomb of a long dead druid in Waterdeep ' s City of the Dead . Relationships . The thorn was friends with and often rode a semi - sentient Topiary dragon with whom he guarded the druid ' s tomb .

title: Brickers
description: Brickers Brickers was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone in 1370 DR . History . For a long time , Brickers was a friend and admirer of Belwar Dissengulp .

title: Bridge of the Ancients
description: Bridge of the Ancients The Bridge of the Ancients was a stone bridge over the Pasocada River in Maztica . It stood near the ruins of Esh Alakar in the Long Canyon . It offered a useful crossing point over the Pasocada River .

title: Bridget
description: Bridget Bridget was a Ffolk human woman and a princess of Callidyrr on the island of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , Princess Bridget of Callidyrr was to marry the Northlander prince Scothgar of Rogarsheim , but she and her whole royal entourage vanished on the voyage to Norland . Ffolk and Northmen each blamed the other for the disappearance , which worsened relations between them .

title: Bright Banner Brandished
description: Bright Banner Brandished The Bright Banner Brandished was an adventuring company in Neverwinter . In 1261 DR , the wizard Ashemmi joined , having left her home in the Neverwinter Woods . In 1266 DR , the company were trapped in subterranean crypts north of Mirabar by the lich Orvanath .

title: Bright Beacon Springs
description: Bright Beacon Springs Bright Beacon Springs was a popular stopping point for both the nomads of the Endless Wastes and caravans traveling along the Spice Road . Geography . The city was located near the Kora Shan mountain range , not too far off the path of the Golden Way trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur .

title: Bright Blade Brandished
description: Bright Blade Brandished The Bright Blade Brandished was a favorite tavern of adventurers in Silverymoon . Geography . The building was located in Northbank , on Sunset Lane in the westernmost angle of the Wallrun in the " Gem of the North " .

title: Brightaxe Hall
description: Brightaxe Hall Brightaxe Hall was created from the lair of the four blue dragons slain by Taark Shanat at end the Cloaker Wars . It formed the royal chamber for Alatorin and was the site of the Wyrmskull Throne from its creation around - 12 , 000 DR to its removal by the dwarves during the Third Spider War around - 6150 DR .

title: Brightleaf
description: Brightleaf Brightleaf was a treant in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Brightleaf regularly reported forest news to Serinia of Elventree .

title: Brightstar Risingsun
description: Brightstar Risingsun Brightstar Risingsun was a foreigner living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . Brightstar was the consort of the Duchess of the North , Tralia Falrith .

title: Brightwater
description: Brightwater Brightwater was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the goddesses Lliira , Sharess , Sune , Tymora , and Waukeen until the Spellplague upset the cosmos . At least a portion of Brightwater survived the Spellplague and became Sune ' s realm in the Gates of the Moon .

title: Brightwing
description: Brightwing Brightwing was a female griffon , linked to the warmage Aoth Fezim . Description . Brightwing is 9 feet ( 2 .

title: Brigit
description: Brigit Brigit was the captain of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . Brigit ' s face was exceptionally slender and fine - boned , accented by a pair of huge , luminous brown eyes .

title: Briglynn
description: Briglynn Briglynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Briglynn was born with Anithlynn and Kaitlynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth .

title: Briiathor Alougarr
description: Briiathor Alougarr Briiathor Alougarr was the Lord Warder of Amphail and an unofficial member of Waterdeep ' s City Guard , though he was officially retired from that post . Personality . Briiathor was completely loyal to Piergeiron the Paladinson .

title: Brimskarda
description: Brimskarda Brimskarda was a fire giant and the nagging wife of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Brimskarda was in the kitchen supervising a personnel composed of five smoke mephit s , two ogre s and twenty goblin s .

title: Brindani
description: Brindani Brindani was a half - elf fighter and former mercenary . History . Brin fought alongside Uthalion in Caidris when the village was attacked by the Abolethic Sovereignty .

title: Brindell
description: Brindell Brindell was a halfling priestess of Eilistraee . Brindell was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History .

title: Brindlor Zidorion
description: Brindlor Zidorion Brindlor Zidorion was a deathsinger from Ched Nasad . Description . Brindlor wore fine clothes and gems .

title: Brindol
description: Brindol Brindol the Burned was a firesoul genasi and the leader of the genasi faction that lived in the Dominion of the Burned in Glaur as of 1479 DR . Description . Brindol was a fiery genasi armored in a carapace of burn - blackened iron , that had trophies of Brindol ' s past victories bolted across all the armor .

title: Brindor Olóssyne
description: Brindor Olóssyne King Brindor Olósynne ( born 998 DR , died 1128 DR ) was a half - elf and the king of Aglarond between 1065 DR and 1128 DR as the beginning of the Olósynne Dynasty . History . Brindor defeated the human army of Velprin in the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm in 1065 DR , creating Aglarond and becoming its first ruler .

title: Brinna Alcott
description: Brinna Alcott Brinna Alcott was a merchant living in Bryn Shander in 1485 DR . History . Brinna was a merchant living in the Ten Towns , but in 1484 DR she became one of the cultists of Auril led by Davrick Fain .

title: Briost Elthauryn
description: Briost Elthauryn Briost Elthauryn was a male wizard who was one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar . History . Briost was one of the most talented members of the magelords .

title: Brister Fendlestick
description: Brister Fendlestick Brister Fendlestick was a human wizard who traveled the Underdark in his magical iron tower , which he carried with him wherever he traveled . Fendlestick polymorph ed a pech into the hook horror known as " Clacker . " Clacker was then returned to Brister by Drizzt Do ' Urden and Belwar Dissengulp in order to reverse the spell , but before the transformation could be completed , Clacker lashed out and killed Fendlestick .

title: Briza Do ' Urden
description: Briza Do ' Urden Briza Do ' Urden was the eldest and most powerful of the daughters of Matron Mother Malice Do ' Urden of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . Description . Briza was large by drow standards and had a round figure .

title: Broadsheet
description: Broadsheet A broadsheet , also known as a short scroll , was a short , printed document which usually contained tabloid - style news or political rants . They were common in Waterdeep . " The Vigilant Citizen " , " The Blue Unicorn " , " Daily Luck " and " Northwind " were popular Waterdavian broadsheets .

title: Broadshield
description: Broadshield Broadshield was a outlaw in Cormyr . Activities . He led the notorious outlaw group known as Broadshield ' s Beasts , a gang notorious for kidnapping nobles .

title: Broadsword
description: Broadsword Broadsword is the name given to a style of sword that has extra protection around the hilt . For game purposes , treat it the same as a longsword . Description .

title: Broken Bone
description: Broken Bone The Broken Bone was a horde of orc s formed by the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . History . In 1024 DR , the Broken Bone tribe attacked Waterdeep after the crypt of their leader , Uruth Ukrypt , was plundered by the human adventuring company , the Dawnbringer Company .

title: Broken Dagger
description: Broken Dagger The Broken Dagger was a stinking watering hole in the southern part of Dagger Falls in Daggerdale . Structure . The main building of the Dagger was a burnt - out shell .

title: Broken Ones
description: Broken Ones The Broken Ones were a monastic order devoted to the god Ilmater . Organization . The Broken Ones numbered both monk s and swordsage s among their ranks .

title: Broken Pike
description: Broken Pike The Broken Pike was a tavern in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain . It was owned and run by Marks in 1370 DR . A one - story tavern of shabby quality yet average prices , the Broken Pike ' s patron were a motley crew of fences , pirates , and smugglers .

title: Bromdurr Tathen
description: Bromdurr Tathen Bromdurr Tathen was a mercenary recruiter in Amn . Activities . Bromdurr was a leading member ( Boar ' s Head ) of the Order of the Blue Boar .

title: Bromm
description: Bromm Bromm was , together with his twin Harnoth , one of the Twin Kings of Citadel Adbar in the Silver Marches in 1484 DR . He was the son of the famous Harbromm . History .

title: Bronn Selgard
description: Bronn Selgard Bronn Selgard is a blacksmith in Shadowdale . Bronn is known for his great strength . Family .

title: Bronsheir ' s Charge
description: Bronsheir ' s Charge The Bronsheir ' s Charge was a battle fought between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater in the Year of the Groaning Hart , 1267 DR . Events . Holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith .

title: Bronwyn Caradoon
description: Bronwyn Caradoon Bronwyn Caradoon was a proprietor of an antiquities shop called the Curious Past , a part - time adventurer , and a member of the Harpers . Activities . Bronwyn was always one to share her knowledge of ancient texts and lore while making sure to pick up little gems of information — typically regarding lost or stolen items — in the process .

title: Bronwyn Daggerford
description: Bronwyn Daggerford Bronwyn Daggerford was a wizard in Daggerford . History . Bronwyn was the sister of Pwyll Greatshout .

title: Bronze
description: Bronze Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin . Uses . " Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts " could manifest an urn of bronze that was capable of transporting users to Khalas on the plane of Gehenna .

title: Bronze Falcon
description: Bronze Falcon The Bronze Falcon was a province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . The Bronze Falcon was the southern most province of the empire , covering the southern tip of the World Pillar Mountains where they bordered the Jungle of Monsters in northeast Zakhara .

title: Bronze Phalanx
description: Bronze Phalanx The Bronze Phalanx , also called the Nutcrackers , was part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The 1 , 200 azer of the Bronze Phalanx were the siege engineers for the Sultan ' s army .

title: Bronze dragon
description: Bronze dragon Bronze dragons were the third most powerful of the metallic dragon s . Physical description . Physically , the bronze dragon was quite fierce in appearance , despite its good nature .

title: Bronzefume
description: Bronzefume Bronzefume was a weak dragon turtle in service to the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Bronzefume agreed to help the Cult in exchange for riches .

title: Brooch of lingering heat
description: Brooch of lingering heat The brooch of lingering heat was one of the artifacts reserved for the archmage of Menzoberranzan . It was in the possession of Gromph Baenre . It granted the wearer the ability to fill Narbondel with twenty - four hours of heat , allowing the city ' s inhabitants to tell time even in the Underdark .

title: Brooch of perpetual youth
description: Brooch of perpetual youth A brooch of perpetual youth was a talisman that when worn made the wearer appear young and have a youthful appearance , similar to a Phylactery of long years In human years one wearing the brooch might appear 28 years old . In other races the apparent age would be different . One well known wearer of such a brooch was Gromph Baenre , Archmage of Menzoberranzan .

title: Brooch of shielding
description: Brooch of shielding A brooch of shielding was a magical protective device . A full - capacity brooch had a base value of 1 , 500 gp . Appearance .

title: Broog - Norb
description: Broog - Norb Broog - Norb was an ettin found into the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Broog - Norb was a particularly large and grumpy ettin .

title: Broryn Windstag
description: Broryn Windstag Broryn Windstag was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of the Windstag noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Broryn gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war .

title: Brotha
description: Brotha Brotha was a small agricultural village found within the Barony of Ostel in Damara southwest of Heliogabalus . Activities . The farmland surrounding Brotha was quite productive , helping Ostel maintain their independence from the larger baronies of Damara .

title: Brotherhood of the Cloak
description: Brotherhood of the Cloak The Brotherhood of the Cloak was a group of all the non - novice wizard s and sorcerer s within the city of Mulmaster . Created for the near - singular purpose to control the power of magic within the city , all arcane spellcasters with any signifigant experience were required to join the Brotherhood under penalty of exile . Regardless of this consolidation of power , the Brotherhood was tasked with the protection of the High Blade ( currently Rassendyll Uoumdolphin ) .

title: Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun
description: Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun The Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun was a sect of the church of Lathander that believed he was the reincarnation of the supposedly dead deity Amaunator . History . The Brotherhood was a recognized cleric and knightly order within the Church of Lathander .

title: Brotherhood of the Griffon
description: Brotherhood of the Griffon The Brotherhood of the Griffon was a mercenary company led by Aoth Fezim . The organization took its name from its griffon riders . Although the Brotherhood was best known for its griffon riders , they had companies of archers and spearmen as well .

title: Brotherhood of the True Flame
description: Brotherhood of the True Flame The Brotherhood of the True Flame was a notorious sorcerous society in Zakhara . Members . Most members of this society were pure flame elementalists .

title: Brown Maeve
description: Brown Maeve Brown Maeve was the Royal Magister of Ankhapur and the former wizard of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Maeve really loved drinking too much , to the point that her sanity was in decline .

title: Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company
description: Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company The Brown Mushroom Mercantile Company of Menzoberranzan was a fellowship created to counter House Baenre ' s profits from trade in the city . Organization . The fellowship was one of two competing merchant houses in Menzoberranzan .

title: Brown bear
description: Brown bear The brown bear was a forest - dwelling animal . Description . These creatures had brown fur .

title: Brown dragon
description: Brown dragon Brown dragons , also known as great desert dragons , were ferocious dragons that lived under the desert sands . Physical description . They had sand colored scales , though unlike other types of dragon their scales were leathery .

title: Brown mold
description: Brown mold Brown mold was a fungus that grew in response to warm . So extremely did it absorb heat that it produced an area of cold around it . Description .

title: Brownie
description: Brownie A brownie is sometimes said to be distant relative of the halfling ( perhaps half halfling , half pixie ) , but are smaller and far less common . Description . Brownies appear as small elves roughly one and a half feet tall .

title: Bruce R . Cordell
description: Bruce R . Cordell Bruce Robert Cordell is an American author of role playing games and fantasy novels . Born in South Dakota in 1968 , he graduated from the University of Colorado at Boulder in 1992 .

title: Bruenor Battlehammer
description: Bruenor Battlehammer < / ref > Bruenor Battlehammer was the eighth and tenth king of Mithral Hall from 1356 DR - 1362 DR and 1370 DR - 1409 DR . He was the dwarven adoptive father of Catti - brie and Wulfgar , friend to Drizzt Do ' Urden and Regis , crafter of Aegis - fang , and a member of the Companions of the Hall . He was reincarnated in 1463 DR as Reginald Roundshield of Citadel Felbarr .

title: Bruenor Battlehammer I
description: Bruenor Battlehammer I Bruenor Battlehammer I was the 2nd King of Mithral Hall , and the namesake of the more widely known 8th and 10th king of Mithral Hall . He was the youngest of Gandalug Battlehammer ' s three sons , and inherited the throne despite not being the oldest . It is his personal battle armor that became the official royal armor of all future Battlehammer kings .

title: Bruherd
description: Bruherd Bruherd was an outcast member of House Duskryn in Menzoberranzan . History . In 1372 DR , Bruherd was one of the many males who escaped from their House during the Silence of Lolth .

title: Bruithyn Ammacaster
description: Bruithyn Ammacaster Bruithyn Ammacster was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch in 1358 DR . Bruithyn was famous for carrying an " iron bands of Bilarro " sphere , to deal with those who threatened him . When he traveled in Anauroch , he always had with him a bodyguard of Sembian mercenaries and a priest of Lathander from Eveningstar for healing .

title: Bruldenthar
description: Bruldenthar Bruldenthar was a dwarven sage in Mirabar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Bruldenthar was chosen among many others as part of a diplomatic delegation , but at Beliard in the Dessarin Valley they were ambushed by the Cult of the Black Earth .

title: Bruneil
description: Bruneil Bruneil was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Bruneil was one of Fort Locke ' s newest soldiers ( who did not want to become a merchant ) that went with Tann and his men to patrol .

title: Brunos Costak
description: Brunos Costak Brunos Costak was one of the western divisional leaders of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis . History . Costak accompanied Rieltar Anchev to Candlekeep to negotiate a treaty with the Knights of the Shield and was murdered there along with the others present in the negotiations .

title: Brusha
description: Brusha Brusha was a bandit who lived in the Hordelands near Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Brusha was the leader of a secret bandit base located somewhere within the valleys southwest of Ahs Trango Shan beneath Katakoro Shan near Khazari .

title: Brymoel
description: Brymoel Brymoel was a male orc cleric and one of the son ' s of King Obould Many - Arrows . Personality . A fantacial devotee of Gruumsh , Brymoel envisioned all the orc s of the Spine of the World being ruled over by his deity ' s cleric s .

title: Bryn Lightfingers
description: Bryn Lightfingers Bryn Lightfingers was a halfling ranger from a strongheart clan in Red Larch and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . Personality . She had the family tendency of a quick temper but also an open mind and curiosity .

title: Bryn Shander
description: Bryn Shander Bryn Shander was the biggest of the Ten Towns and was known for being a trading center in Icewind Dale . Geography . The city was the only one of the Ten Towns not located on the shores of either Maer Dualdon , Redwaters , or Lac Dinneshere .

title: Bryndar
description: Bryndar The Bryndar were a group rumored to dwell within Brynwood in the Vast . Stories about them varied , but agreed that they were a clan of evil , magic - using female shapeshifters . The most common of these claimed that they were evil magical creatures who could change their shape into that of a female human .

title: Bryndar Obarskyr
description: Bryndar Obarskyr Bryndar Obarskyr was the third king of Cormyr , of the Obarskyr dynasty . He was born in the Year of the Vow Manifest , 44 DR , and was the only son of Imlon Obarskyr , the second king of Cormyr . Bryndar reigned as king himself from the Year of Lamplit Nights , 57 DR , aged only 13 , and ended his reign in the Year of Gleaming Frost , 64 DR , at age 20 .

title: Brynnlaw
description: Brynnlaw Brynnlaw was an island located on the Sea of Swords . History . It was home to a pirate lord as well as Spellhold , an asylum belonging to the Cowled Wizards that was attacked by Jon Irenicus in 1369 DR .

title: Brynwood
description: Brynwood Brynwood was a forest located in the Vast , covering a large area between the Earthfast Mountains and the North Road , lying north of the towns of Maerstar and Sevenecho . It was infamous for holding a number of monsters and legends . Description .

title: Bryon Kendrick
description: Bryon Kendrick Bryon Kendrick was a member of the Kendrick family , the king of Corwell and father to Tristan Kendrick . Description . King Bryon was a strong man with dark hair and long black beard streaked gray .

title: Bryseis Kakistos
description: Bryseis Kakistos Very little is known about Bryseis Kakistos other than she was the leader of the Toril thirteen , the original thirteen tiefling warlock s who made pacts with Asmodeus . She was said by the cambion Lorcan to have been a thoroughly wicked person who was partially responsible for Asmodeus ' ascension to godhood . She lived near Vaasa and was alive in the 14th century .

title: Brysis
description: Brysis Brysis of Khaem was a wraith sorcerer in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . History . In life , Brysis was a great sorcerer in Netheril .

title: Bryth Moonaxe
description: Bryth Moonaxe Bryth Moonaxe was a half - dwarf commander of the Knights of the Crescent Moon who arrived in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR . History . Bryth was a rare half - dwarf born from the Lady of the Seven Silver Stars , Elhanna Moonhawk , and First Axe Therlarn Axesong .

title: Bubble Net
description: Bubble Net The Bubble Net , or Waterspout , was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Bubble Net was what the marid s called a large column of air that connected the Elemental Plane of Water to the Elemental Plane of Air , allowing passage to clouds of the Elemental Plane of Air .

title: Buckler
description: Buckler A buckler was a small shield useful as a defense in melee combat . Due to its small size , a buckler was of limited use in defending against missiles . Use .

title: Buckweather
description: Buckweather Sprite - Heels was Lord of the Watch of Ankhapur and a former halfling member of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Sprite - Heels loved ale and cheese , and he liked his comforts .

title: Bugbear
description: Bugbear A bugbear is a massive humanoid distantly related to , but larger and stronger than , goblin s and hobgoblin s . Like many goblinoid s , bugbears speak the Goblin language . They are one of the only goblinoids to be covered in fur .

title: Buhrell Caah
description: Buhrell Caah Buhrell Caah was an agent of the Emerald Enclave in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Buhrell was an agent of the Emerald Enclave sent to Phlan .

title: Builders ' Hall
description: Builders ' Hall Builders ' Hall was the guildhall of the Guild of Stonecutters , Masons , Potters , & Tile - makers in the South Ward of Waterdeep . Location . The guildhall was located at the intersection of Coach Street and Carter ' s Way in the South Ward .

title: Buirin Thalshond
description: Buirin Thalshond Buirin Thalshond was a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast . Speaking of treasure tales in the Vast in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Buirin remarked " Treasure ? Aye , lots of it in the Vast , lad ; why didn ' t ye ask earlier ?

title: Buiyrandyn
description: Buiyrandyn Buiyrandyn was a tiny drow settlement in the northern Underdark , beneath the northern Sword Mountains . It was also famous for rejecting Lolth and other evil drow deities . Besides that it was the birhtplace of Qilué Veladorn , one of the Seven Sisters .

title: Buldegas Mhaerkoon
description: Buldegas Mhaerkoon Buldegas Mhaerkoon was a human man living in the cities of Wheloon and Arabel in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Wyvern Watch Inn and another inn . History .

title: Bulette
description: Bulette The bulette ( pronounced boo - lay ) , also known as a landshark , is a particularly loathsome creature that lives in the Starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Feared and hated by most living creatures , bulettes are extremely dangerous , burrowing unseen beneath the soil before erupting up at an unexpected moment to seize their prey . Dwarves called the bulette a ghohlbrorn .

title: Bull ' s strength
description: Bull ' s strength Bull ' s strength , also known simply as strength , was an arcane or divine spell that caused the recipient to become stronger . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell , " bull ' s strength " that could be cast by both arcane and divine spellcasters , and " strength " which was only used by wizards .

title: Bullywug
description: Bullywug Bullywugs are froglike humanoid creatures . Description . Bullywugs are described as humanoids with the head of frogs .

title: Bundrigo Dalastarra
description: Bundrigo Dalastarra Bundrigo Dalastarra was a halfling man of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . In the mid – 14th century DR , he held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat , but proved rampantly corrupt . Personality .

title: Bungalow Thump
description: Bungalow Thump Bungalow Thump was the leader of the Gutbuster Brigade , the battlerager brigade of Mithril Hall in 1484 DR . History . In addition to his duties as a Gutbuster , Bungalow was a personal bodyguard of King Connerad Brawnanvil .

title: Buntaro Ostato
description: Buntaro Ostato Buntaro Ostato was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Buntaro had the personality ( and the look ) of a dyspeptic bear : he rarely smiled and always seemed arrogant .

title: Buorstag Hlammythyl
description: Buorstag Hlammythyl Buorstag Hlammythyl is the elected bron of the town of Voonlar , in 1372 DR . The burly ex - mercenary is known to be a worshiper of Bane and is in fact a puppet ruler from the Zhentarim . Buorstag is assisted by six deputies and can call the militia in Voonlar to arms if needed .

title: Buppido
description: Buppido Buppido was a cunning derro murderer who lived in the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Buppido was crazy at heart .

title: Bupposo
description: Bupposo Bupposo was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Bupposo was a good teacher at the monastery .

title: Burak
description: Burak Burak the Mongrel was a half - orc pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Personality . Burak had no strategy in his attacks and was not loved nor admired by his crew ; they followed him for money , and showed no mercy to their victims .

title: Buraq
description: Buraq Buraqs , or horses of heaven , were companions of princes and sultans , and helpers for many holy warriors . These free creatures had no master . Description .

title: Burgher Xarod
description: Burgher Xarod Burgher Xarod was the original boss of the land that later became the Xiousing district in Marsember . History . Xarod controlled some of the neighborhoods around Xiousing and when the Sea of Fallen Stars retreated , he assumed control of the newly exposed land .

title: Buried Realms
description: Buried Realms The Buried Realms , called the Phaerlin by the phaerimm , lie underneath the desert of Anauroch . This domain of the Underdark is home to the phaerimm , who are confined to the Buried Realms by the Sharnwall . This magical artifice that functions as a barrier for the phaerimm between their realm and the rest of Faerûn was created thousands of years ago by the Sharn to imprison the phaerimm .

title: Burnbones
description: Burnbones Burnbones appear similar to the blazing bones found in Myth Drannor , but are selected high level members of the church of Cyric who have been transformed with a portion of his power by Cyric himself . Physical description . Usually proudly wearing a holy symbol of Cyric these undead monstrosities can call upon all the clerical powers they commanded when they were still alive and now do so with even more efficiency while their mere presence burns with the power of Cyric ' s dark fires .

title: Burning Daggers
description: Burning Daggers The Burning Daggers were a fanatical Kossuth - worshiping group of orc s in Thar . Description . Each of them was branded in the center of the face with a dagger symbol as a sign of devotion .

title: Burning Pool of Natifa
description: Burning Pool of Natifa The Burning Pool of Natifa was a small wonderous body of water located in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Geography . The Burning Pool of Natifa was located near a cluster of crescent - shaped " barchan " dunes west of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams .

title: Burning Rift
description: Burning Rift The Burning Rift was an underground volcanic rift in Chult . Geography . The Burning Rift was located in the Firelands directly beneath the Peaks of Flame .

title: Burning blade
description: Burning blade Burning blade is among the most complex spell s learned by swordmage initiates and is used most commonly by those who invoke the assault style of arcane swordplay . When a swordmage casts " burning blade " he or she transmutes their sword ' s surface into flames , making it more deadly upon contact with the flesh of a swordmage ' s foe . The initial power of the spell is largely determined by a swordmage ' s intellect but the effect of the spell can continue for up to several minutes , during which time the intensity of the flames is dependent instead upon the swordmage ' s physical strength .

title: Burning hands
description: Burning hands Burning hands was a spell of the alteration or evocation school of magic . Effects . Learned by some wizard s of relatively low experience , " burning hands " momentarily engulfed the wizard ' s hands in a burst of magical flames and then expelled them rapidly into an adjacent area of roughly twenty - five feet in diameter .

title: Burning sands
description: Burning sands Burning sands was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused regular sand to become combustible .

title: Burning spray
description: Burning spray Burning spray is an evocation spell used by sorcerer s , particularly those of a draconic heritage . When cast , " burning spray " allows a sorcerer to fling burning liquid from their arm as they sweep it and their implement through the air . The liquid , which sprays into a nearby area of roughly fifteen feet in diameter , causes any creatures it lands upon to be caught on fire , taking damage proportional to the strength of personality exhibited by the sorcerer casting the spell as well as that sorcerer ' s level of power .

title: Burnt Ridge
description: Burnt Ridge Burnt Ridge was an area of burnt woodland outside the city of Myth Drannor that was used by its wizard s to practice hurling their spells . History . In 714 DR , it served as a last stand for the city ' s wizards who were overcome by the invading Army of Darkness , that would later bring about the fall of Myth Drannor .

title: Burrath
description: Burrath Burrath was the bodyguard of Lord Olgarth Oldbridle in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon used the body of Burrath to infiltrate the mansion of Andranth Glarvreth , who had invited Lord Olgarth .

title: Burrowing owl
description: Burrowing owl Burrowing owls inhabited the High Desert of Zakhara on the plains north of the Range of the Marching Camels . Description . These owls possessed golden feathers and talons twice the size of normal owls .

title: Burto Milibuck
description: Burto Milibuck Burto Milibuck was an insane halfling thief in Yûlash in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Burto was scavenging in the ruins of the city when he saw the avatar of Moander that escaped from Yûlash .

title: Burtrar Malith
description: Burtrar Malith Burtrar Malith was a veteran bodyguard and caravan guard as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak . Personality . Burtar was particularly quiet and grim .

title: Bushi
description: Bushi A bushi was a class of fighter common in Kara - Tur . In Shou Lung , the bushi was known as a chanshi or warrior . Culture .

title: Bushido ( organization )
description: Bushido ( organization ) Bushido were a mercenary company based in Chessenta around 1358 DR . Organization . Membership .

title: Buster Bracer
description: Buster Bracer Buster Bracer was one of the finer armorsmiths of Clan Battlehammer in Mithral Hall . Description . Buster had a blue beard .

title: Butt
description: Butt A butt was a container used to store beverages in Faerûn . Description . Butts were basically large barrels that stood 6 or 7 ft .

title: Butter tea
description: Butter tea Butter tea was a beverage from Khazari , made from yak butter , salt , and tea . In 1362 DR , the lama Koja thought of yak - butter tea when he remembered his homeland . He was later presented with a magical feast that included it .

title: Buzuq
description: Buzuq A buzuq ( buh - ZOOQ ) was a stringed Zakharan instrument that was comparable to an elongated lute . Description . The " buzuq ' s " metallic strings were stretched over a long fretted neck connected to a wider , nearly circular body .

title: Buzzard Beak Harbor
description: Buzzard Beak Harbor Buzzard Beak Harbor was a small bay found off the Easting Reach in northeast Faerûn . Geography . Part of the harbor was in Damara and the other part was in Impiltur .

title: Bwimb
