description: Bwimb Bwimb , called the " Baron of Ooze " , was the evil archomental of ooze . History . Bwimb was considered a great general of the planes in ages past .

title: Byronae Trilluach
description: Byronae Trilluach The self - styled Lord Byronae Trilluach was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Byronae still dressed in the typical Ardeep dress .

title: Byrtyn Fey
description: Byrtyn Fey Byrtyn Fey was the matron mother of House Fey - Branche in Menzoberranzan . Description . Byrtyn had a well - rounded , sensual figure .

title: Bythnara Shobalar
description: Bythnara Shobalar Bythnara Shobalar was a drow and the twenty - eight - year - old ( in 1348 DR ) daughter of Xandra Shobalar . Personality . She was envious of Liriel Baenre , feeling that Xandra gave her too much affection and that male drow preferred her .

title: Byubo
description: Byubo Byubo was the Padhrasattva of " nyum " within the Padhran religion . " Nyum " was a Ra - Khatian word for boldness or guts . History .

title: Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity
description: Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity Byubo ' s Lamp of Audacity was a unique magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . Description . This magic item looked like a normal butter lamp .

title: Byuchyuch
description: Byuchyuch Byuchyuch was a goblin slave of House Do ' Urden in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History . Byuchyuch became an " indentured servant " to House Do ' Urden circa 1307 DR .

title: Cabrath Nelinderra
description: Cabrath Nelinderra Cabrath Nelinderra was a female drow keening spirit and a cleric of Kiaransalee . She was considered Irae T ' sarran ' s top lieutenant in life . Description .

title: Cachiko
description: Cachiko Cachiko was a waitress in the town of Aru in Wa . Relationships . Cachiko was the granddaughter of Fusae and her translator , being very good in sign language .

title: Cadderly Bonaduce
description: Cadderly Bonaduce Cadderly Bonaduce is a priest and Chosen of Deneir . Appearance . Standing 6 feet tall and weighing a bit under 200 pounds , Cadderly is a handsome man in his late 20s with striking gray eyes , curly brown hair and a sincere , warm smile .

title: Cadogan
description: Cadogan Cadogan was an adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Cadogan was once an adventurer and a member of the large adventuring party called Her Majesty ' s Reconnaissance Team .

title: Caelar Argent
description: Caelar Argent Caelar Argent , most commonly known as the Shining Lady , led a crusade against Dragonspear Castle around 1368 DR . She hailed from Waterdeep , where her family had ties with the Order of the Aster . Her uncle Aun Argent was a noted paladin in the Order and Caelar was also a member .

title: Caelynna
description: Caelynna Caelynna , often referred to as The Blue Lady , was a powerful Eladrin wizard who was banished to Toril around the same time the spellplague struck . She was bound to a small piece of the Feywild that was transported to the bottom of the Sea of Fallen Stars between Pirate Isle and Prespur . She was either spellscarred by the spellplague or was able to develop her own innate powers to make herself much more powerful than she had been on Abeir .

title: Caemon
description: Caemon Caemon was a priest of Amaunator in Hillsfar . History . During a pilgrimage , he came across the Cult of the Dragon ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains and was captured by Talis Kasterel .

title: Caer - Dineval
description: Caer - Dineval Caer - Dineval was one of the towns of Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . Caer - Dineval was located on the northwestern bank of Lac Dinneshere , not far south of Caer - Konig .

title: Caer - Konig
description: Caer - Konig Caer - Konig was one of the towns of Ten Towns in Icewind Dale . Geography . Caer - Konig was located on the northern shore of Lac Dinneshere , not far from Caer - Dineval .

title: Caer Callidyrr
description: Caer Callidyrr Caer Callidyrr was the capital city of the Ffolk people on the Moonshaes island of Alaron , overlooking Whitefish Bay . Its castle was constructed from alabaster and it was the tallest man - made structure in the Moonshaes . It was inhabited by the monarchy of the Ffolk .

title: Caer Corwell
description: Caer Corwell Caer Corwell was a small city and a mile outside of Lowhill on the isle of Gwynneth . Geography . The keep was located on a rocky cliff overlooking the common fields of Corwell and the waters of Corwell Firth .

title: Caftan
description: Caftan A caftan was a long ankle - length garment worn in Zakhara . Description . The robe was usually made with cotton , but finer versions could be crafted from silk or brocade .

title: Cage
description: Cage The Cage was a special prison located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Cage was completely enclosed by " walls of force " .

title: Cailek Balathorp
description: Cailek Balathorp Cailek Balathorp was a noble of Ravens Bluff who made his living by capturing surface dwellers and delivering them to the drow who lived in the Underdark beneath the city . He went by the nickname Fetterfists while operating as a slaver . Description .

title: Cain
description: Cain Cain was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Cain was a performer in the Blacklake District .

title: Caiphon
description: Caiphon Caiphon was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Caiphon did not have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description .

title: Cairn
description: Cairn Cairn was a divine conjuration spell that created a pile of rocks . Effect . The spell gathered rocks and stones from all around ( not including any organic or other materials ) and dropped them on a given location from a height of 20 feet ( 6 meters ) .

title: Cakl
description: Cakl Cakl was a Payit in Maztica in 1362 DR . History . In 1362 DR , he was one of the Payit recruited by the rogue priestess of Helm Mirandos .

title: Caknol
description: Caknol Caknol was a priest of Qotal in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing .

title: Caladnei
description: Caladnei Caladnei ( kah - " lad " - nay ) was the Royal Mage of the Cormyr ian court , replacing Vangerdahast after his retirement . She was renowned for her feisty and opinionated personality and was often seen as hard to deal with in the Court . Caladnei was also the leader of the famed War Wizards .

title: Caladorn Cassalanter
description: Caladorn Cassalanter Caladorn Cassalanter was a young and gallant secret Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Caladorn was a fighter : broad - shouldered , tall ( six feet ) , and he acted with purpose .

title: Caladorn the Wise
description: Caladorn the Wise King Caladorn the Wise was a ruler of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn before the 14th century DR . King Caladorn decreed that priests could not judge a person ' s worldly behavior . As a result , priests could not serve as either king ' s justices or baron ' s justices in the kingdom .

title: Calantar ' s Way
description: Calantar ' s Way Calantar ' s Way was a long road running north to south in the nation of Cormyr . The northernmost point of Calantar ' s Way was the city of Arabel . The southernmost point of Calantar ' s Way was the city of Suzail .

title: Calanti Snowdrop
description: Calanti Snowdrop Fatima Asad was a language teacher at the Grand University of Huzuz in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Description . Fatima was an albino with white hair , pale skin , and red eyes .

title: Calathanorgoth
description: Calathanorgoth Calathanorgoth , also known as The Old One , was a powerful black dragon dracolich in High Moor in 1370 DR . Relationships . The dracolich lived in the ruins of Orogoth with her offspring : the venerable mated pair Wastirek and Vilholin , their son the adult Woklef and the young Aswidorg , and the mature adult female Cheleen .

title: Calathlarra
description: Calathlarra Calathlarra was a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune around late 1487 DR . History . Calthlarra was one of the most cold and emotionless leaders of the Twisted Rune .

title: Calaunt
description: Calaunt Calaunt was a city - state in the Vast , and formerly the village of Vespermouth . It sat on the mouth of the mouth of the River Vesper on the eastern side of the Dragon Reach , at the end of Blaern ' s Trail from Thindilar and at the end of the Hlintar Ride from Hlintar . Language .

title: Calcitro Burrow
description: Calcitro Burrow Calcitro Burrow was the mayor of Beluir in 1367 DR . Description . Due to his love of food and drink , Calcitro was a portly fellow .

title: Caldor Fuldren
description: Caldor Fuldren Caldor Fuldren was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Caldor Raventree
description: Caldor Raventree Caldor Raventree was a young War Wizard of Cormyr from Arabel . History . Around 1479 DR , Caldor was among the many War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail .

title: Caldreth ' s Cobbling
description: Caldreth ' s Cobbling Caldreth ' s Cobbling was a shop in the town of Mornbryn ' s Shield as of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Services . Caldreth Wyvernlyng repaired shoes , boots , and cloaks .

title: Caleb
description: Caleb Caleb was a male human bandit of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Caleb was one of the local Docks ' thugs , who was acting under Moire ' s employ .

title: Caledan Caldorien
description: Caledan Caldorien Caledan Caldorien was once a member of the Harpers and the adventuring group known as the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon . Relationships . While working with the Harper Mari Al ' maren , his comrades from the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon and his son Kellen , Caledan found meaning in his life .

title: Calendar of Harptos
description: Calendar of Harptos The Calendar of Harptos was the calendar used across most of Faerûn . It was created by the wizard Harptos of Kaalinth , although most people associate the word " Harptos " with the calendar . It was split into twelve months , each lasting three tenday s ( or thirty days ) .

title: Calesaer
description: Calesaer Calesaer was a large wood elf in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Calesaer was traveling through the Moonsea in order to look for his sister in the Border Forest .

title: Calhyar
description: Calhyar Calhyar , or Calhyar of the Winds , was the third senior Witches of Rashemen in Mulsantir and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . Personality . Khelben himself did not understand the motivations of Calhyar but preferred to have her close in order to unveil her secret .

title: Caligarde ' s claw
description: Caligarde ' s claw Caligarde ' s claw was an arcane conjuration spell that created an invisible claw made of pure force , similar to the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells . Effects . This spell could be cast at a target up to 60 yd ( 55 m ) away .

title: Caligrosto
description: Caligrosto Caligrostos are perhaps the most sadistic of the known types of loumara , and considering the other three include the nature - razing wrath of the manitou s , the corpse - haunting decadence of the dybbuk s , and the murder - happy malevolence of the guecubu s , this indicates a level of cruelty that some demon s might even be shocked at . Spawned in the Dreaming Gulf of the Abyss from the nightmares of a long - forgotten dead god of healing and craftsmanship , the caligrosto come into the world with a red lust for the edge of a blade . Although incorporeal ( and remaining so once they have created a fiend ish shade ) , a caligrosto ’ s weapon remains a physical object and is thus subject to armor .

title: Calihye
description: Calihye Calihye was a female half - elf bounty hunter of some reputation in Vaasa . Description . Calihye had light blue , almost gray eyes , thin lips in an angular beautiful face were it not for a nasty scar on her right cheek .

title: Calim
description: Calim Calim was the noble djinni lord who founded the Calim Empire in what is now Calimshan . For millennia his body and mind were split and imprisoned in the Calim Desert . Description .

title: Calim Desert
description: Calim Desert The Calim Desert was a rocky desert on the coast in the country of Calimshan . It was not formed by natural means , instead being the result of an epic magical war between two genie s , the djinn i Calim and efreet i Memnon . The sands hid the ruins of ancient cities , which were said to hold many treasures .

title: Calim Empire
description: Calim Empire The Calim Caliphates , more commonly referred to as the Calim Empire , was the great kingdom founded by the noble djinn i Calim and his people , the Djen . Geography . At its peak , the empire stretched from the southern Sword Coast to the River Agis and along the Marching Mountains to the Alimir Mountains and south to the Shining Sea .

title: Calim River
description: Calim River The Calim River was the largest river in Calimshan . It formed the eastern border of the Calim Desert . Geography .

title: Calim cactus
description: Calim cactus Calim cacti were small , sharp - thorned cacti native to the Calim Desert that grew to between three and four inches tall . However , they had vast root systems that spread out over nearly a dozen square feet under the surface . These roots often poked through the surface and absorbed moisture from the air .

title: Calimar Arkhenneld
description: Calimar Arkhenneld Calimar Arkhenneld was a drow lich enchanter of the city of Sshamath in the 14th century DR . He was the Master Emeritus of the School of Enchantment and Charm , as well as a former member of the ruling Conclave of Sshamath . History .

title: Calimban Knoll
description: Calimban Knoll Calimban Knoll , formerly called Calim ' s Bane , was a stone circle marking where a battle was fought in the Calim Desert at the end of the Fourth Age of Calimshan . Geography . Located near the northern border of the Calim Desert , 25 miles south of Memnon just off the Trade Way , Calimban Knoll was a circle of 21 s 700 yards in diameter with a tiny , rocky mound in the center .

title: Calimemnon Crystal
description: Calimemnon Crystal The Calimemnon Crystal was the magically created crystal that entrapped the essence of the genie s Calim and Memnon and hundreds of their servants . It was one of the most powerful magical artifact s ever to exist in Faerûn and the greatest magical achievement of the elves of Tethir and Mir . Description .

title: Calimite
description: Calimite Calimite was a famous breed of light warhorse known for its speed and endurance . Originating in the Calim Desert , legends told that Calimites were granted their speed by the djinni Calim himself . A Calimite was considered a beautiful horse .

title: Calimmon
description: Calimmon Calimmon was the county bordering Calimshan in the southwestern portion of Ankaram Duchy in Tethyr . Calimmon County was ruled by Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter immediately after the Reclamation Wars . She ruled from the county seat at the keep of Daraqadim .

title: Calimport
description: Calimport Calimport was the sprawling capital city of the country of Calimshan . For most of its existence , it was by far the largest city in all of Faerûn . It was the long - time home of the assassin Artemis Entreri , known for his longstanding feud with Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Calimport / Shackles Ward
description: Calimport / Shackles Ward Shackles Ward was one of the wards of the city of Calimport . Description . Shackles Ward was the poorest ward of the city , inhabited primarily by slaves and slavers .

title: Calimshan
description: Calimshan Calimshan was a nation which covered the southern corner of West Faerûn , including the Calim Desert and the Spider Swamp . Calishite was the name given to an inhabitant of Calimshan . The term " Calimite " was a severe insult .

title: Calindra
description: Calindra Calindra was a female human of Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Calindra was a miner , who came from Amn in search for work .

title: Caliph ' s Harbor
description: Caliph ' s Harbor The Caliph ' s Harbor was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Activities . This harbor housed the personal barge of the Grand Caliph as well as the admirality of Huzuz .

title: Calishite
description: Calishite Calishite was the name given to the majority of human s who came from Calimshan . " Calimite " was a deeply insulting name for these people . Regions .

title: Calishite naming conventions
description: Calishite naming conventions Names and titles were a matter of pride and honor to a typical Calishite . This article describes the conventions and traditions of Calishite naming . General Format .

title: Calispar Delgorth
description: Calispar Delgorth Calispar Delgorth was a human man and a priest of Talona in the late 1360s DR . He was a member of first the Red Brigade mercenaries and later the Vipers bandits . History .

title: Calkontor
description: Calkontor Calkontor was a mage in Zhentil Keep . He became envious of the appointment of Harlshoon as first Lord of Zhentil Keep , and died in an attempt to poison him . Relatives .

title: Call faithful servants
description: Call faithful servants Call faithful servants is a conjuration spell that summons up to four celestials to your side . Effect . You call up to four lawful good lantern archon s from Celestia , up to four chaotic good coure eladrin s from Arborea , or up to four neutral good musteval guardinal s from Elysium to your location .

title: Call lightning
description: Call lightning Call lightning was a druid encounter evocation , or an evocation spell , or an alteration spell or even a Conjuration spell that directed lightning bolts to strike targets . Effects . Early versions of this spell required a storm of some sort in the vicinity of the casting in order to produce lightning .

title: Call society
description: Call society Call society was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell members of sorcerous societies could call upon other members for assistance .

title: Call woodland beings
description: Call woodland beings Call woodland beings was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster three chances to name a type of forest - dwelling creature , such as brownie s , centaur s , dryad s , pixies , satyr s , sprites , treant s , unicorn s , etc . , and summon one or more of them to aid the caster .

title: Callabus
description: Callabus Callabus was a goblin wizard who attacked the Ten Towns for the Legion of the Chimera . Personality . The goblin loved to weaken his enemies with powerful spells like " fireball " .

title: Callarduran Smoothhands
description: Callarduran Smoothhands Callarduran Smoothhands , also known as the Deep Brother , was a neutral gnome deity . He was primarily venerated as the patron of the Underdark - dwelling gnome subrace , the svirfneblin . Worshipers .

title: Callatl
description: Callatl Cattatl was an inhabitant of Kultaka . History . Cattatl was the son of the Eagle Knight Huakal .

title: Caller in darkness
description: Caller in darkness A caller in darkness was a ghostly collection of the minds of a large group of victims who died in terror at the same time . Description . Callers in darkness appeared as large , incorporeal masses of cloud , fog , or mist within which one could observe the faces of victims screaming silently in fear .

title: Callidyrr mead
description: Callidyrr mead Callidyrr mead was a brewed on the island of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles . Geography . The mead was served in the tent of Geoffrey the aleman during the Festival of the Spring Equinox in 1345 DR .

title: Calling Horns
description: Calling Horns The Calling Horns was an inn south of the Evermoors where Jundar ' s Pass met the Evermoor Way . History . It was named after the legendary battle where an army of humans and dwarves united to defeat the last army of trolls .

title: Calm animals
description: Calm animals Calm animals was a divine enchantment ( compulsion ) spell that calmed animal s , beast s , and magical beast s . Effects . The spell was used to calm aggressive animals , quieting them and making them docile and harmless to those nearby .

title: Calm emotions
description: Calm emotions Calm emotions was an enchantment spell that attempted to negate strong emotions in a group of creatures . Effects . The creatures affected by this spell in a 20 ft ( 6 m ) radius area were brought to a emotionally neutral state .

title: Calm water
description: Calm water Calm water was an arcane abjuration spell that could turn an area of choppy or violent waves into calm seas . The reverse of this spell , churn water , could create an area of high waves in relatively calm conditions . Effects .

title: Calm wind
description: Calm wind Calm wind was an arcane abjuration spell that could reduce strong winds to a light breeze in a localized area . Effects . This spell could be cast out to a distance of 360 yd ( 330 m ) and affect a circular area at least 180 ft ( 55 m ) in radius ( larger for more experienced casters ) .

title: Calm winds
description: Calm winds Calm winds was a divine magic spell given to priests of Akadi , the Queen of Air , and Aerdrie Faenya , the Winged Mother . It created a sphere of still air around the caster . Effects .

title: Caltrop
description: Caltrop Caltrops were effective items used by some rogue s and adventurers to dissuade pursuit . Uses . Caltrops were tiny metal creations lined with spikes .

title: Calum
description: Calum Calum was a male dwarf and a member of the Neverwinter Nine on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Calum was one of the members of the Neverwinter Nine .

title: Calvin Longbottle
description: Calvin Longbottle Calvin Longbottle was the Regent of the Harbor of Ravens Bluff from 1350 DR - - ? Appearance . Lord Calvin is 5 ' 10 " tall and weighs 175 pounds .

title: Calwern
description: Calwern Brother Calwern was an old cleric of Deneir in Silverymoon . History . Calwern was one of the clerics that took care of the Vault of the Sages archive in Silverymoon .

title: Cambion
description: Cambion Cambions are considered to be the result of breeding a devil with mortals . The offspring of a mortal male and a succubus is a different creature known as an alu - fiend . In general , a cambion is described as any humanoid creature that is half - fiend .

title: Camden
description: Camden King Camden was a ruler of Hartsvale . Description . Camden had thick sturdy legs , hulking shoulders , and a solid build .

title: Camel
description: Camel Camels were desert herd animals renowned for their ability to endure great stretches of time without water or food . Description . Camels were easily recognizable for the hump or humps upon their backs .

title: Camel of the Pearl
description: Camel of the Pearl Camels of the Pearl appeared in Zakhara during prehistoric times , having been carved from a single great pearl by Jisan . They still served the people faithfully . Description .

title: Caminus
description: Caminus Caminus was a red dragon . History . The dragon took part in the orc attack on the Gemspark mine but obeyed Ygorl ' s orders after he was released from the " Demon Stone " .

title: Canaith mandolin
description: Canaith mandolin A Canaith mandolin was a masterwork magic mandolin and one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Canaith mandolins " were 8 - string mandolins .

title: Canary
description: Canary The canary was a bird found in Faerûn . It was bright yellow in color and sang . Species .

title: Cancer mage
description: Cancer mage The cancer mage is the back alley rat and corpse feaster of society . He hides in the shadows of abandoned buildings where no one cares to look into and digs through long forgotten trash . A cancer mage is one of the worst and most disgusting " people " a person is most likely to meet .

title: Candle magic
description: Candle magic Candle magic was a manifestation of the Power developed by mystic s in the Realms . When these priests reached a certain level of proficiency with herbalism , they could begin to create infused candles that , when burned , had an effect much like a magic spell on all those nearby . As their skill and experience grew , they learned how to make additional types of candles .

title: Candle of calm
description: Candle of calm Candle of calm was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lliira , the Joybringer , and others who followed deities whose areas of influence were charms or protection . Effects . This spell could be cast at a point up to 270 ft ( 82 m ) away ( even farther for more experienced casters ) .

title: Candle of truth
description: Candle of truth A candle of truth was a common magical item that created a zone of truth around it when lit . Description . " Candles of truth " were white , half - pound ( quarter - kilogram ) candles made of tallow and enchanted with a " zone of truth " spell .

title: Candlekeep
description: Candlekeep Candlekeep is a towered fortress library that stands on a crag , looking down upon the Sea of Swords . The library is filled with books and scrolls of knowledge , and it was the home of the great seer Alaundo , who foresaw the coming of the Bhaalspawn . To gain entry to the halls of wisdom , a visitor must gift the library collection with a new tome of immense value .

title: Candlemas
description: Candlemas Candlemas was Lady Polaris ' of Delia in the Netherese Empire . Description . The bearded wizard was short , fat , and balding .

title: Candoria
description: Candoria Candoria was a gang leader in Nexal . History . Candoria was one of the renegades living in the human quarter of Nexal in 1362 DR .

title: Canisphinx
description: Canisphinx Vicious hunters , canisphinxes often chase their prey across the desert sands for hours , waiting for the victim to drop from exhaustion . Combat . Canisphinxes prefer prey that is too weak to fight back , and they usually flee in the face of stronger opposition .

title: Canoloth
description: Canoloth Canoloths are specialized yugoloth s who serve as scouts , skirmishers and trackers . They are not common but a few is always a great plus to any yugoloth mercenary company . Description .

title: Canthan Doolittle
description: Canthan Doolittle Canthan Doolittle was a human wizard and associated with the Citadel of Assassins . Description . Canthan was a slim , studious looking man , with beady brown eyes and a long straight nose .

title: Canthraxis
description: Canthraxis Canthraxis was a blue dragon dracolich living in the Moonshae Isles around 1370 DR . Relationships . The dracolich worked with the Cult of the Dragon cell operating on the Isles .

title: Canthus
description: Canthus Canthus was a large moorhound which belonged to Tristan Kendrick , Prince of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles . Description . The large moorhound was strong with thick brown fur and powerful legs .

title: Canticle
description: Canticle Canticle is the first book of the The Cleric Quintet by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Cantoule
description: Cantoule Cantoule was a male human monk and a member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the 14th century DR . He was the head of the monastery , holding the rank of Grand Master of Flowers .

title: Cantrip
description: Cantrip " Cantrip " was the common name for the weakest spells an arcane spellcaster could cast . The divine magic equivalents were known as orison s , but " cantrip " was often used to describe all beginner apprentice / acolyte spells . Cantrips were the first spells that a wizard learned during their apprenticeship .

title: Cantrip ( spell )
description: Cantrip ( spell ) Cantrip was a universal spell that all wizards learned to cast during their apprenticeship . By means of this spell , all manner of very limited magical effects could be manifested at the will of the caster . Effects .

title: Canumbrax
description: Canumbrax Canumbrax was a shadurakul ( shadow canomorph ) bounty hunter in 1374 . History . Circa 1374 DR , Canumbrax was hired by Lord Hulraven Irlingstar to help an adventuring party rescue his wife Nael , who ' d been kidnapped by some agents of the Jaezred Chaulssin for unknown reasons .

title: Cape Velen
description: Cape Velen Cape Velen was a lightly - populated duchy in Tethyr ruled in 1369 DR by Duke Llachior Blackthorn . Geography . Cape Velen encompassed the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula , which was also called the Velen Peninsula or the Tethyr Peninsula .

title: Capnolithyl
description: Capnolithyl Capnolithyl , also known as Brimstone , was a vampiric smoke drake and a hero of the last Rage of Dragons . Description . Capnolithyl appeared to be a normal , adult smoke drake with reddish black scales .

title: Carac
description: Carac Carac was one of the Eagle Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , during the march of the column of survivors of the Night of Wailing , Chical sent many of his knights , among them Carac , to scout the surrounding land .

title: Caracatl
description: Caracatl Caracatl was the high priest of Tezca in Nexal . History . Around 1351 DR , after a series of portents , Naltecona gathered all the high priests of Nexal , asking for the gods ' wishes .

title: Carathryn
description: Carathryn Carathryn , known as Holy High Carathryn and the Lost Home , was a town that once stood on the seaward coast of the Dragonstail peninsula of the Purple Hills of Tethyr in west Faerûn . Its people were dedicated to Ilmater , the Crying God . History .

title: Caravan Boulevard
description: Caravan Boulevard The Caravan Boulevard , also known as the Ghost ' s Route or the East Gate Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Caravan Boulevard was actually the beginning or end of the Dihl al - Taif trade route , depending on which way a caravan was headed .

title: Caravan District
description: Caravan District Though not technically a single district , the Caravan District referred to the area surrounding each of the gates of Huzuz . Description . The Caravan District was crowded with inns , taverns , hostels , animal stalls , and caravanserais .

title: Caravel
description: Caravel A caravel was a medium - sized sailing ship used in Amn , and on the Inner Sea by Cormyr , Sembia , and Impiltur . They were less popular in Turmish and Chondath . Description .

title: Cargunn
description: Cargunn Major Cargunn was the proprietor of the well - stocked Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . He was a retired officer of the local Shield Militia but rumors said he had certain " expertise " that kept him involved with Militia operations .

title: Carina
description: Carina Carina was a lieutenant of the Sisters of Synnoria , warriors of the Llewyrr . Description . Carina had a high , almost musical voice .

title: Carl Sargent
description: Carl Sargent Carl Sargent ( born December 11 , 1952 , in Caerleon , Monmouthshire ) is a British author of several role - playing game - based products and novels . Most of his role - playing works were published between 1987 and 1996 . He has authored many products for both the " Dungeons & Dragons " ( particularly for the " World of Greyhawk " campaign setting ) , " Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay " and " Shadowrun " role - playing games .

title: Carmenere
description: Carmenere Carmenere was an earthsoul genasi and a priestess of Selûne . She was the niece of Queen Arathane and was formerly a close friend of the rogue Riltana . Carmenere aided Demascus in destroying the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye .

title: Carnelian
description: Carnelian Carnelian , also known as , was a clear , reddish , or red - brown chalcedony . Description . This semi - precious stone was tumbled smooth and cut , and used as decoration on devices that offered protection from evil or from bodily harm .

title: Carnelian ( spirit )
description: Carnelian ( spirit ) Carnelian was a ghost who lived in Wandering Stones as of 1479 DR . Background . Carnelian was one of the few self - aware ghosts who lived in Wandering Stones , and he had lived there for many decades , as of 1479 DR .

title: Carolyas Idogyr
description: Carolyas Idogyr Carolyas Idogyr was a half - elf sorcerer from Waterdeep . Description . Idogyr had wild curly red hair and flashing green eyes .

title: Carp
description: Carp A carp was a type of fish found on Toril . Species . Giant golden carp .

title: Carpet of diving
description: Carpet of diving Carpets of diving were cursed magic item s that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . A " carpet of diving " measured 5 ft .

title: Carpet of fighting
description: Carpet of fighting A carpet of fighting was a magic item originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Carpets of fighting " were available in many beautiful or mundane variations .

title: Carpet of flying
description: Carpet of flying A carpet of flying was a wondrous item that had the power of flight . It was a rug that could fly through the air as if affected by a permanent " overland flight " spell . Description .

title: Carrack
description: Carrack A carrack was a large , multi - masted sailing ship used in Amn and elsewhere on the Sword Coast . It could carry many soilders and was capable of deep sea voyages . Carracks had both fore and aft castles on the main deck .

title: Carrackus
description: Carrackus Carrackus was a male scrag and a pirate on the Sword Coast under the command of Pinochet . History . Carrackus was present in 1356 DR when the " Sea Sprite " , sailed by Captain Deudermont and the Companions of the Hall , defeated Pinochet ' s fleet , but Carrackus managed to escape .

title: Carradoon
description: Carradoon Carradoon was a shipwrights ' town on the southern shore of Impresk Lake , southeast of the Snowflake Mountains . Cadderly Bonaduce ' s Spirit Soaring cathedral lay north of the town . Layout .

title: Carrague
description: Carrague Ambassador Carrague was the honorary building inspector in Ravens Bluff for decades . He had been in the city for so long that no one remembered that his appointment was supposed to be honorary . Appearance .

title: Carrelath
description: Carrelath Carrelath Barony was a part of the monarchy of Erlkazar encompassing the territory of the Kuldin Peaks . Description . The Kuldin Peaks contained garrisons for Erlkazar ' s army .

title: Carril Byndraeth
description: Carril Byndraeth Carril Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and crime lord . He was also the husband of fellow Lord Brianne Byndraeth . Having Carril married to a fellow Lord caused many troubles .

title: Carrion Fleet
description: Carrion Fleet The Carrion Fleet was a fleet of ships sailed by fallen pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars . A legend told that these were pirates who were strung up on their own ships and had returned as undead . The fleet was spotted many times off the coast of Thesk between the River Eth and Cape Dragonfang .

title: Carrion crawler
description: Carrion crawler A carrion crawler was a burrowing aberration that scavenged the dead and occasionally preyed on living creatures . Similar to a giant , toothed centipede in appearance , carrion crawlers were often accompanied by a foul odor of death , which warned others of their approach . Although their nature ultimately rested in the Far Realm , it was thought by many , and indeed was possible , that carrion crawlers were created through a mad wizard ' s experiments .

title: Carsomyr
description: Carsomyr Carsomyr was a powerful two - handed Holy Avenger sword found in Firkraag ' s " hoard " in " " . Physical description . Described as one of the most powerful weapons existing on Faerûn , the blade was technically a + 5 two - handed sword ( greatsword ) that granted magic resistance when wielded .

title: Carthoun Misintle
description: Carthoun Misintle Carthoun Misintle , also known as Alamondh , was a human male and the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Abilities . Misintle was a powerful evil mage , but used amulets and spells to conceal both his power and his evil nature , presenting himself as a good mage of half his actual power .

title: Carzakh Halandir
description: Carzakh Halandir Carzakh Halandir was the leader of the reformed Shadow thieves guild in Athkatla on Amn . History . Carzakh was one of the five charismatic thieves and assassin that in 1255 DR founded the Shadow Thieves guild and remain one of the leader of the guild for the years after until the 1298 DR when the Masked Lady Lhestyn unveiled the guild .

title: Casavir
description: Casavir Casavir , also known as Katalmach was a paladin of Tyr who participated in the Shadow War as a companion to the Kalach - Cha . Description . Middle - aged , Casavir was a well - built and dignified human with a handsome physique and sophisticated aura .

title: Casildar
description: Casildar Ruinlord Casildar was a leader of the Zhentarim , the second - in - command of Iyachtu Xvim ' s Heart of the Hand and Tor Blackflame in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Casildar was a long time supporter of Fzoul Chembryl .

title: Casin Cu Calas
description: Casin Cu Calas Casin Cu Calas or the Triple C are a group of vigilantes made up of human s , elves and dwarves from the Silver Marches who attack small orc settlements in and around the Kingdom of Many - Arrows around 1470 DR . The organization ' s name comes from an elven saying that means " honour in battle " . Non - affiliated elves have become upset at the use of this name and have taken to calling the group the Night Riders .

title: Cassana
description: Cassana Cassana was an evil wizard who masterminded the creation of Alias for her own ends . Description . Like Alias , Cassana was 5 ft 10 in ( 1 .

title: Cassandra Thann
description: Cassandra Thann Cassandra Thann was the daughter of Zelphar Arunsun , wife of Rhammas Thann , and mother of Danilo Thann . She was the powerful matriarch of the Thann clan Personality . Cassandra was intellectual and well - versed in politics and history of Waterdeep .

title: Cassiar
description: Cassiar Cassiar was the undead master who turned Jander Sunstar into an elven vampire . Description . The master vampire was young looking with coppery red hair , pale skin , and large doe - like eyes .

title: Cassius
description: Cassius Cassius was the leader of and spokesman for the town of Bryn Shander , and principle spokesman ( " Elderman " ) on the Ten Towns Ruling Council . Description . Clean - shaven Cassius had short gray hair , bright blue eyes , and was slender .

title: Cassra Brandywine
description: Cassra Brandywine Cassra Brandywine was the head scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Cassra was a young but very smart woman .

title: Cassyt
description: Cassyt Cassyt was a cleric of Kelemvor in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Cassyt ' s principal character trait was a sense of humor that was dry and a little warped .

title: Castings
description: Castings Castings was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Situated beneath the Furnace , Castings served as the barracks for the efreeti army .

title: Castle Al - Amo
description: Castle Al - Amo Castle Al - Amo , also called the Fortress of Love and the Castle of St . Sollars , was the abode of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred on the plane of Mercuria in the Seven Heavens .

title: Castle Crag
description: Castle Crag Castle Crag was a castle in northern Cormyr designed to protect it from the threats of the Stonelands in the mid – 14th century DR . Location . Castle Crag lay in the central north of Cormyr , at the base of the Storm Horns mountains .

title: Castle Dasaajk
description: Castle Dasaajk Castle Dasaajk was a castle situated on the eastern edge of the Purple Hills in Tethyr . History . In the 3rd and 4th centuries DR , the location was the site of a fortress and the base of the Holy Warriors of Suffering , a paladin order devoted to Ilmater .

title: Castle Grimstead
description: Castle Grimstead Castle Grimstead ( formerly known as Castle Greatstead ) was a castle in Shadowdale , in the Dalelands . It was constructed in 834 DR by the Glittering Band with the aim of driving back the drow who inhabited the nearby Twisted Tower . The castle survived until 864 DR , when it was overrun and destroyed by a combination of drow forces above and below the ground .

title: Castle Hartwick
description: Castle Hartwick Castle Hartwick was the home of the royal family of Hartsvale and the seat of its throne . Location . Castle Hartwick was located on an island in the center of the Clear Whirl River east of the town of Hartwick and west of the village of Stagwick .

title: Castle Irlingstar
description: Castle Irlingstar Castle Irlingstar was a remote and secret prison stronghold in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate . History . It was established after 1369 DR by Royal Mage Vangerdahast Aeiulvana , who erected the magical wall , and survived the Spellplague .

title: Castle Krag
description: Castle Krag Castle Krag was a castle built by the drow and was located in Shadowdale in the Dalelands . At the time when Jyordhan came to power in Shadowdale in 1339 DR , the castle was in a state of ruin , and he had intended for it to be reconstructed to rival Darkhold , but due to a lack of resources and a rebellion , the castle was rebuilt on a much smaller scale . The fortification was eventually set alight and razed by followers of Mane ' s Band , and , as of 1367 DR , lay in ruins , except for a single tower , with the surrounding area having become overgrown by briar and other undergrowth .

title: Castle Maerimydra
description: Castle Maerimydra Castle Maerimydra was a fortification at the heart of Maerimydra and the seat of the ruling house . Physical Description . Standing atop a 100 - ft - high ( 30 m ) plateau , the elegant curves and fluted battlements of this castle represented the epitome of drow aesthetics .

title: Castle Obarskyr
description: Castle Obarskyr Castle Obarskyr , also known as the King ' s Castle , was the royal palace located in Suzail , Cormyr . Geography . The castle was located on a dominating hillock , separated from the rest of the city by Lake Azoun , the Royal Gardens , and several castles of lesser nobility .

title: Castle Perilous
description: Castle Perilous On a single night in 1347 DR the dark stone and iron fortress called Castle Perilous was raised by the work of demons of the Abyss . It was located on a rocky crag on the shore of the Lake of Tears in Vaasa . It was the seat of power for the lich Zhengyi , the Witch - King of Vaasa .

title: Castle Spulzeer
description: Castle Spulzeer Castle Spulzeer was a castle , finished in 795 DR for the Spellseer family . It was located a few miles south of Tethir Road , en route to Riatavin . Construction of the castle began in 755 DR .

title: Castle Trinity
description: Castle Trinity Castle Trinity was the headquarters of a sect worshiping the goddess Talona . It was located in the Snowflake Mountains . Architecture .

title: Castle Ward of Waterdeep
description: Castle Ward of Waterdeep The Castle Ward of Waterdeep lies at the center of the city . It encompasses Mount Waterdeep , its castle , and much of the government of the city . This includes the Palace of Waterdeep , occupied by Piergeiron the Paladinson , and the homes of many prosperous Waterdhavians .

title: Castle Waterdeep
description: Castle Waterdeep Castle Waterdeep was a castle located in the city of Waterdeep . Description . Its walls were 60 - ft - thick ( 18 m ) on average , and high enough that when banners were displayed in honor of visiting parties , they were visible from many areas of the southern city .

title: Castle of Illusion
description: Castle of Illusion The Castle of Illusion was once the home of the gnome illusionist Fhzmilliyun Sparkledrim , whose illusions lingered for years , even driving away an orc horde that settled in the ruined citadel . Geography . The castle was located near the eastern side of the Fell Pass .

title: Castles ( boxed set )
description: Castles ( boxed set ) Castles is a 2nd edition Advanced Dungeons and Dragons accessory for the Battlesystem tabletop game . The box set includes three paperback booklets , each covering an imposing castle in a different gaming world . The first booklet , by Jeff Grubb , is about the Zhentarim fortress , Darkhold .

title: Cat & Mouse
description: Cat & Mouse " Cat & Mouse " is the 15th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .

title: Cat ' s Eye circlet
description: Cat ' s Eye circlet This magical circlet was given to Cattie - Brie before she went to chase Drizzt Do ' Urden back in to the Underdark to his home city of Menzoberranzan . The Cat ' s Eye circlet allows the wearer to see in complete darkness as if under a sky filled with stars . The Cats Eye circlet was enchanted by Alustriel of Silverymoon .

title: Cat ' s Gate
description: Cat ' s Gate The Cat ' s Gate was a Netherese extra - planar portal located in Anauroch . Description . Most of this gate was buried by the shifting sands .

title: Cat ' s grace
description: Cat ' s grace Cat ' s grace was a transmutation spell that increased the chance of performing any skill requiring dexterity . Effect . The caster had to touch the target of this spell in order to cast it .

title: Cat ( person )
description: Cat ( person ) Cat of Ordulin ( Lady Wyvernspur ) was the wife of Giogioni Wyvernspur of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . Description . Cat was pretty with copper - coloured hair and green eyes .

title: Cat One - eye
description: Cat One - eye Cat One - eye was a thief in Damara and a member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1359 DR . Activities . Cat , as a contract murderer , wandered Damara searching for the most difficult targets for assassinations .

title: Cat burglar
description: Cat burglar A cat burglar was a rogue trained in advanced acrobatic and athletic techniques . Masters of evasion and daring athletes , and capable of remarkable feats of skill and agility , cat burglars could surprise their opponents with their feats . Abilities .

title: Cat lord
description: Cat lord The cat lord ( also rendered as Cat Lord ) , also known as master cat , was one of the Animal Lords . The cat lord was the ruler of all felines , from the common house cat to the huge smilodon ( sabre - toothed tiger ) . Personality .

title: Catacombs ( Djerad Thymar )
description: Catacombs ( Djerad Thymar ) The Catacombs were a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The lowest level of the city , the Catacombs were located in a tunnel network under the foundation of the city .

title: Catapult ( spell )
description: Catapult ( spell ) Catapult was an arcane alteration spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused a loose item roughly the weight of a double - fist sized stone to move in the direction indicated by the spell caster .

title: Cathakay Shintar
description: Cathakay Shintar Cathakay Shintar was a half - elven priestess and Queen of Dambrath during the 11th century DR . Relationships . Cathakay died without bearing a child , so the rulership of Dambrath passed to her niece , Melanith .

title: Catharyn
description: Catharyn Catharyn was a crinti pirate who lived in Dambrath . Personality . Much to her mother ' s pride , Catharyn was cruel and ruthless .

title: Cathedral of Emerald Scales
description: Cathedral of Emerald Scales The Cathedral of Emerald Scales was an opulent temple dedicated to Varae located in the city - state of Hlondeth . Varae was the goddess of a beast cult that worshiped the power of snakes and the Cathedral of Emerald Scales was literally surrounded by and wrapped in snake sculpture . Its domed structure dominated the Hlondeth skyline and influenced the architecture of the entire city .

title: Cathtyr
description: Cathtyr Cathtyr was a metropolis and the capital city of Dambrath . It was formerly known as Shantil . Cathtyr sat in a small bay on the far eastern end of Dambrath .

title: Cathtyr Shintar
description: Cathtyr Shintar Cathtyr Shintar was a half - elven priestess and eventually the first Queen of Dambrath during the 9th century DR . Relationships . Cathtyr ' s daughter was named Filina .

title: Catlord ( old )
description: Catlord ( old ) The Catlord was a werecat who was the current catlord in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Sensing his end was near and great change coming to the Realms , the Catlord decided to choose an heir , a young werecat boy who would someday become a new catlord .

title: Catoblepas
description: Catoblepas A catoblepas was a mix of buffalo , dinosaur , warthog and hippopotamus that lived in swamps and wastelands . Legends said that hag s raised catoblepases like cattle and fed on their milk . Its most feared ability was its deadly gaze .

title: Catti - brie
description: Catti - brie Catti - brie was a female human and a friend and later wife to Drizzt Do ' Urden . She was a member of the Companions of the Hall and , later , a chosen of the goddess Mielikki . She was reincarnated as a Bedine girl named Ruqiah in 1463 DR .

title: Cauln Aumar
description: Cauln Aumar Cauln Aumar was the third of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and secretly a wizard . History . Cauln was a sour , suspicious , and secretive man with a natural affinity for magecraft .

title: Cause fear
description: Cause fear Cause fear was a cleric prayer or a necromancy or abjuration spell used by both divine and arcane spellcasters . It could cause a creature to flee in panic from the caster . Older versions of this spell were reversible , known as " remove fear " , and bolstered the morale and courage of the recipients .

title: Cavatina Xarann
description: Cavatina Xarann Cavatina Xarann was a female drow Darksong Knight in service of Eilistraee . She was the fourth - generation devotee of the Lady of the Dance , born on the surface . .

title: Cave fisher
description: Cave fisher A cave fisher was a lobster - like monster which inhabited subterranean locations and ambushed its prey using a sticky filament similar to a strand of giant spider silk . Description . Cave fishers grew to about seven feet ( 2 .

title: Cave moss
description: Cave moss Cave moss was a moss found in the Underdark . Ecology . Although many creatures creatures , such as rothé and giant vermin , fed on cave moss , it was inedible to humanoid s .

title: Cave of the Monkey
description: Cave of the Monkey The Cave of the Monkey was a cave located in the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range . Description . Located deep in the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range , itself part of the larger Yehimal mountain range , stood the Cave of the Monkey , home to the greater spirit Monkey .

title: Cavelord
description: Cavelord The Cavelord is a prestige class of the Underdark that calls to those who have a love for the secret places of their home . Those who have a powerful wanderlust often take this class in order to better know everything they can of their surroundings , much like the rangers and druids of the surface races . Their connection to the rock beneath their feet and over their heads is such that it gives them the power to move quickly and accomplish impressive feats of strength .

title: Cavern of the Everlasting
description: Cavern of the Everlasting The Cavern of the Everlasting was located beneath the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . The Cavern of the Everlasting was a natural cavern .

title: Caves of Ghazz
description: Caves of Ghazz The Caves of Ghazz were a series of caves on the island of Saishu , off the coast of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . They were a legendary site but their exact location was unknown . It was said the " mirror of perfection " had been hidden there since around 607 DR .

title: Caves of a Thousand Gods
description: Caves of a Thousand Gods The Caves of a Thousand Gods were an important religious site located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located at the eastern end of the Kora Shan mountain range in the Endless Wastes , the Caves of a Thousand Gods were one of the largest and most important religious sites of followers of the Path of Enlightenment , the major religion of most in Kara - Tur .

title: Cavil
description: Cavil Cavil was an assassin member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Gareth Dragonsbane and his party somehow captured Cavil and Cavil gave precious information about the guild to Gareth .

title: Cavil Zaltobar
description: Cavil Zaltobar Cavil Zaltobar was a mercenary wizard in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , hired by Drannin Splitshield , Cavil and some minions ambushed some adventurers and Gargosh Blusterhelm ( in truth a doppelganger posing as him ) at the Stone Bridge .

title: Caxal
description: Caxal Caxal was the ruler of Payit . History . Caxal was a cautious ruler , who wanted no intrusion from the temples .

title: Cedar
description: Cedar The cedar tree could be found in various places in Faerûn , as well as on Abeir - Toril ' s other continents . It was used by the Azuposi of Maztica to form prayer sticks , which were burned for protection , healing , and purification . Variations .

title: Cedarleaf
description: Cedarleaf Cedarleaf is a wood elf settlement in the lands of Damara / Vaasa near the Gemspark mine . It is the home village of Zhai , the half - drow daughter of a drow female and a wood elf male . The village ( as it appears in " Demon Stone " ) is a sprawling elven tree settlement .

title: Cedarsproke
description: Cedarsproke Cedarsproke was a small , independent city in the middle of the Gulthmere Forest inhabited and ruled by druid s . Geography . The Cedar River divided the city in two .

title: Cedric Ravajar
description: Cedric Ravajar Cedric Ravajar was a human man , once a leader of the Red Brigade mercenaries and later a leader of the Vipers bandit s . History . Cedric Ravajar was a mercenary for much of his adult life .

title: Cedric deLancie
description: Cedric deLancie Cedric deLancie was a noble from Waterdeep . He was a commander in the City Guard ( Waterdeep ) , despite he had never saw a true battle . He however was an expert in military history and strategies .

title: Cel
description: Cel Cel was a fishermen in the Kabel ' s Hill community in Quivering Forest in 1489 DR . Personality . The fisherman was a taciturn but not rude person .

title: Cela Jardi
description: Cela Jardi Cela Jardi was a prominent camel - dealer within the Caravan District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Cela ' s time in the desert gave her a keen eye for selecting quality camels .

title: Celadrin
description: Celadrin Celadrin were a planetouched race that resulted from the union of elves and eladrins ( usually firre ) . Many of the celadrins encountered outside of their homes were warriors , though they were also known for their skill as bard s . Description .

title: Celedon Kierney
description: Celedon Kierney Celedon Kierney was a half - elf mage . Appearance . Celedon appeared as a charming rogue with more than a bit of elven blood in him .

title: Celestia
description: Celestia Celestia , commonly called in the past Mount Celestia , or more fully , the Seven Mounting Heavens of Celestia or even the Seven Heavens is a lawful good - aligned astral dominion that is currently ruled over by Torm as it drifts through the Astral Sea . Description . Celestia is the ultimate in law and good .

title: Celestial Emperor
description: Celestial Emperor The Celestial Emperor , also called the Celestial One and the Master of Heaven , was a deity who ruled the Celestial Empire and oversaw the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant pantheon of the continent of Kara - Tur , especially the empire of Shou Lung , and the overarching spiritual state managing its gods , spirits , dragons , and other creatures . Description . The Celestial Emperor was depicted as a tall man of aristocratic aspect , with a face at once both stern and compassionate , with eyes that blazed white with the inner fire of karma .

title: Celestial Empire
description: Celestial Empire The Celestial Empire , also known as the Celestial Heaven or the Empire of Heaven , was the dominant pantheon of the continent of Kara - Tur , especially the empire of Shou Lung , and the overarching spiritual state managing its gods , spirits , dragons , and other creatures , all through the Celestial Bureaucracy . The Spirit World . The Celestial Empire stood within the Spirit World , a plane that lay coexistent and coterminous with the land of Kara - Tur .

title: Celestial Fury
description: Celestial Fury The Celestial Fury was a powerful katana designed to slay a dragon but ended up housing its spirit . History . The province of a wa an daimyo , Hoshi Katahiroi , was suffering under unnatural and destructive weather .

title: Celestial Heavens
description: Celestial Heavens The Celestial Heavens , or simply Heaven , was a realm in the Spirit World , the domain of the Celestial Empire of Kara - Tur . " Heaven " was often a byword for the Celestial Empire itself , or for the Celestial Emperor . Inhabitants .

title: Celestial Stairway
description: Celestial Stairway A Celestial Stairway was a type of pathway linking the Realms with the plane s . A stairway led to a nexus , which led to the homes of all the gods . They were used by god s to traverse from the Realms to their home planes .

title: Celestial archon
description: Celestial archon Archons , not to be confused with the similarly named elementals , are an elite group of celestial s in the service of all that is lawful and good . Archons are wholly good and lawful and are consistently at odds with fiend s of any kind , though they particularly despise demon s . Types of Archons .

title: Celestial blood
description: Celestial blood Celestial blood was an abjuration spell that granted the subject divine defenses . Effect . The caster channeled holy power to grant the subject some of the protection enjoyed by celestial creatures .

title: Celestial brilliance
description: Celestial brilliance Celestial brilliance was an evocation spell that conjured a blaze of celestial light from an object . Effect . The object touched shed light brighter than bright sunlight , channeled directly from the celestial realms .

title: Celestial domain
description: Celestial domain The Celestial domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters celestial spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Celestial Domain Powers .

title: Celestial language
description: Celestial language Celestial was the language of celestial s . It was brought to Toril through contact with good folk from other planes . It was described as beautiful , yet alien in nature , since it developed among beings with thought patterns very unlike those of human ity .

title: Celestial mystic
description: Celestial mystic Celestial mystics are spellcasters who seek to better their very souls by contemplating and studying the mysteries of Celestia . Background . Though they come from all walks of life , celestial mystics share a few features .

title: Celestial paragon
description: Celestial paragon A celestial paragon is the antithesis of an archfiend . There are currently 16 paragons . 7 of them each rule one of the seven heavens of Mount Celestia on the House of the Triad .

title: Celestial planes
description: Celestial planes Celestial planes is a collective term used to describe a subset of the Outer Planes in the World Tree cosmology model . The celestial planes were generally associated with the good deities whereas the fiendish planes were generally associated with the evil ones . The celestial planes were : All of these planes were connected to the World Tree which could be used to travel directly between planes without having to pass through the Prime Material Plane , but this mode of travel was often dangerous .

title: Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild
description: Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild The Cellarers ' and Plumbers ' Guild was a guild in Waterdeep that dug building foundations and maintained Waterdeep ' s sewer system . Base of operations . The Old Guildhall was located on Gaustus Street in the Trades Ward .

title: Cellica
description: Cellica Cellica was a halfling rogue who lived in Waterdeep with her adoptive brother Kalen Dren . History . As a youth in Luskan , Cellica worked as a thief for the same organization as Kalen .

title: Centaur
description: Centaur The centaur was a large creature that lived in temperate forests . Physical Description . A centaur had the upper body of a humanoid , and the lower body of a large horse .

title: Centaur ( constellation )
description: Centaur ( constellation ) The Centaur was a constellation resembling a centaur with a sword . Observation . It could be observed over the Sword Coast North in summer .

title: Centaur Bridge
description: Centaur Bridge Centaur Bridge was a small town in Turmish , just off the Halondar . Geography . Centaur Bridge was located in the Dancing Forest .

title: Centiv Naomal
description: Centiv Naomal Centiv Naomal was a human wizard specializing in illusion s . He was the one who slew Samark Dhanzscul , the sixth Blackstaff . Description .

title: Central District
description: Central District The Central District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Central District was found in the North Quarter in the central portion of Huzuz just north of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne and the great mosques .

title: Central Thorass languages
description: Central Thorass languages The Central Thorass language subgroup included Chondathan and Common and a large number of their lesser - known derivative languages and dialects . Languages . Despite the name , the parent language of the languages in this group was Jhaamdathan , or " Old Chondathan " .

title: Cephalopolop
description: Cephalopolop The Cephalopolop was a renegade kraken who was the secret ruler of Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . and 1372 DR Personality . Despite its small size as a kraken , the Cephalopolop compensated with cunning , secrecy and ambition .

title: Cephalossk
description: Cephalossk Cephalossk was the ulitharid Creedmaster of the Venerators Creed in Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Its position and its powers made Cephalossk the second more powerful individual in the city . History .

title: Cephas
description: Cephas Cephas was a genasi and a skilled fighter . He was the long - lost heir to Pasha Marod el Arhapan , the leader of Calimport . Description .

title: Cera Eurthos
description: Cera Eurthos Cera was the head priestess of Amaunator in the Chessentan town of Soolabax . She aided Aoth Fezim in uncovering Alasklerbanbastos ' plans to attack Chessenta although she believed that Amaunator wanted her to uncover an even bigger plot . She and Aoth later fell in love .

title: Ceratosaur
description: Ceratosaur Ceratosaurs were viscous bipedal carnivorous dinosaur s from the jungles of Chult . Description . These dinosaurs could reach 30 feet ( nine meters ) in length and walked on two thick , muscular legs .

title: Cerebrilith
description: Cerebrilith A cerebrilith was a type of tanar ' ri demon native to the Abyss . It was notable for possessing psionic powers . Physical description .

title: Ceremorphosis
description: Ceremorphosis Ceremorphosis was a bodily change that occurred when an illithid tadpole reached maturity and was inserted into the brain of another humanoid being , usually a human . The tadpole ate away the victim ' s brain matter and essentially replaced the brain , erasing all of the subject ' s personality and memory , but leaving the physical body alive and under the tadpole ' s control . After this , " morphological transformations " occurred and a new illithid was created .

title: Cereon
description: Cereon Cereon was a sun elf . Activities . In a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , Cereon was a leader of his fellow elves .

title: Cerest Elenithil
description: Cerest Elenithil Cerest Elenithil was a gold elf originally from Myth Drannor . He was the offspring of an illicit liaison between his mother and another elf . Because of his illegitimate birth , he was never fully accepted by his family and left Myth Drannor at an early age .

title: Cerion Haldoreth
description: Cerion Haldoreth Cerion Haldoreth was a wood elf who lived in the Tower District of Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He helped elven adventurer s new to the city by telling them about Evermeet and recruiting them for missions benefiting the elven race .

title: Cernd
description: Cernd Cernd is a party NPC in the " " computer game and its expansion " " , and can be recruited into the player ' s party from his prison cell beneath the Mayor of Trademeet ' s home . He plays a vital role in the quest to resolve the disturbance at the druid grove , and also gives the player access to another subquest involving his son . In the game , Cernd comes equipped with two personal items ; a Cloak of the High Forest and a Staff of the High Forest .

title: Cernd Shattermind
description: Cernd Shattermind Cernd Shattermind was a hybrid illithid dwarf living in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR . History . Cernd was a member of Clan Arnskull .

title: Cespenar
description: Cespenar Cespenar was an imp who used to serve Bhaal as a " butler " . He appeared to have vanished from existence with that deity ' s death , but reappeared in the Pocket Plane , which Gorion ' s Ward and party unconsciously created to protect themselves within Bhaal ' s domain . Cespenar was able to upgrade and create various enchanted items from the right ingredients .

title: Ch ' Chitl
description: Ch ' Chitl Ch ' Chitl was a city of mind flayers located 18 mi ( 28 . 97 km ) beneath the Sword Mountains . History .

title: Ch ' ou Chu Lan
description: Ch ' ou Chu Lan Ch ' ou Chu Lan was the Chamberlain of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Rumors said that Ch ' ou Chu Lan was originally a monk student of the Dragonfly school of kung fu and that he so impressed the young Kai Tsao Shou Chin with his clear thinking that the Emperor immediately appointed him to the Imperial household .

title: Chaab
description: Chaab Chaab was a Zhent agent during the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 DR . History . Chaab was an agent of the Zhentarim .

title: Chac
description: Chac Chacs looked like slender jaguar s when on all fours and werejaguar s when they assumed a bipedal stance . They were spirits who helped control the rains in Maztica and lived in caves high in the mountains . From their caves they sent out rain to the surrounding countryside .

title: Chachim
description: Chachim Chachim was an assassin of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Chachim was born in Amn and he trained at the School of Stealth in Zazesspur .

title: Chad Dulac
description: Chad Dulac Chad A . Dulac is a serviceman in the U . S .

title: Chadal
description: Chadal Chadal was a young thief in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . Activities . Chadal was one the Little Rats , a gang of children affiliated with Dead Rats gang , acting as spies and messengers .

title: Chador
description: Chador A chador ( pronounced " SHAH - dor " ) was a type of robe worn by some women of Zakhara . and Calimshan . Description .

title: Chaggrin
description: Chaggrin Chaggrins , or soil beasts , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Because of their destruction of valuable minerals , chaggrins were considered to be elemental vermin on their native plane . Description .

title: Chahir
description: Chahir Chahir was a vampire sorcerer that resided in the crypts of Dordrien . Description . Chahir sported thick black hair and and carefully trimmed beard and mustache .

title: Chaid al Farid al Fuqani
description: Chaid al Farid al Fuqani Chaid al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyrian human from Myratma . Description . Chaid had dusky skin , jet black curly hair , and bronze - colored eyes .

title: Chain lightning
description: Chain lightning Chain lightning was an evocation spell that blasted a target with lightning then jumped on to more targets . Effect . This spell created a lightning bolt that traveled from target to target doing successively less and less damage .

title: Chainmail
description: Chainmail Chainmail ( also knowns as chain mail or simply chain ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chainmail was a common form of armor made of interlocking metal rings .

title: Chaka
description: Chaka A chaka was the term given to the core social unit of the Shining Lands . Organization . A basic chaka was comprised of a single extended family .

title: Chakas of 31
description: Chakas of 31 The Chakas of 31 were a group of prominent chaka s in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . Chakas of this group were usually the most successful merchant organizations within the Shining Lands .

title: Chakram
description: Chakram A chakram was a small throwing disk . Description . A typical chakram was a metal ( often steel ) disk from five inches ( 13 centimeters ) to a foot ( 30 centimeters ) in radius with a sharpened outer edge and a rounded inner edge .

title: Chaks
description: Chaks Chaks was the Cloakmaster of Zazesspur for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Chaks was originally a slave in Calimshan until he escaped when a teenager .

title: Chalannos Firehawk
description: Chalannos Firehawk Chalannos " the Masked " Firehawk was a male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a retired adventurer . Chalannos was a former adventurer who retired to a cottage on a lane on the northeastern edge of Wheloon by 1358 DR .

title: Chalarstaukh
description: Chalarstaukh Chalarstaukh was the largest goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Chalarstaukh was located in the Chalarstaukh caverns in the western foothills of the Rauvin Mountains , not far from Citadel Felbarr .

title: Chalaska Muruin
description: Chalaska Muruin Chalaska Muruin was the unofficial ruler of Bargewright Inn during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Muruin was the master of the gate guards of the Inn and acted as unofficial ruler under orders of a cabal of plutocratic business owners , most of whom were in the pockets of the Zhentarim .

title: Chalcedony
description: Chalcedony Chalcedony was a mixture of and , usually white , but rare variations included gray or black . Description . This semi - precious stone was the base mineral in many gem - quality stones such as carnelians , chrysoprase , and agate s .

title: Chalco
description: Chalco Chalco was one of the greatest Nexal an rulers of history . History . After the rule of the warmonger Pakli , Chalco was chosen as the new ruler because he was the most powerful warrior of his time and a cousin of Pakli .

title: Chalsembyr ' s Heart
description: Chalsembyr ' s Heart Chalsembyr ' s Heart was a magic al greatsword central to the church of Torm the True , forged to guide paladin s who sought Chalsembyr . Description . " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " was a finely crafted greatsword forged of cold iron and gold , with a lion motif .

title: Chalthos Immer
description: Chalthos Immer Chalthos Immer was a man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Immerhand Inn . Chalthos Immer was once a mercenary warrior .

title: Chamal Avenue
description: Chamal Avenue Chamal Avenue was a road in Myth Nantar leading east from the Fire Fountain at the city ' s center , to the Mermaid ' s Gate at its edge . It was named after Chamal , the only mermaid Dukar , and was paved with aqua - colored mosaics .

title: Chamber of Judges
description: Chamber of Judges The Chamber of Judges was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Chamber of Judges was a three - chambered structure .

title: Chameleon leather
description: Chameleon leather Chameleon leather armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chameleon leather was made from the treated hide of an ophidian .

title: Champion of Gwynharwyf
description: Champion of Gwynharwyf Champions of Gwynharwyf strive to emulate their celestial patron ' s balance of fury and reserve , proving that rage and righteousness can coexist in one being . Background . No matter what their background , every champion of Gwynharwyf needs at least one level of barbarian to gain access to the class ' s battle - frenzy requirement .

title: Champions Vigilant
description: Champions Vigilant The Champions Vigilant was a Tethyr ian knightly order of Helm . It was prestigious and popular and saved thousands of lives during the Tethyrian Interregnum . They had fortified bases dotting the countryside .

title: Champions of Muktar
description: Champions of Muktar The Champions of Muktar were an evil adventuring company in Muktar in Turmish in 1358 DR . Organization . They acted as high - ranking officers in the army of the self - styled king of Muktar , Hetep , during the war between Muktar and Golconda .

title: Chan Cheng
description: Chan Cheng Chan Cheng ( pronounced " chan ching " ) , called the Mighty Lord of Heroes , was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire , the dominant religion of Kara - Tur , particularly Shou Lung . He was a god of battle , bravery , and martial arts , and represented the virtue of courage in the Path of Enlightenment . As one of the Nine Immortals , Chan Cheng also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers .

title: Chan Chiong
description: Chan Chiong Chan Chiong was a skeleton in Kuning Valley in Shou Lung . History . In ancient times , Chan Chiong led the Segara Sea Lords , a large pirate fleet that preyed upon ships from their harbors in Muara Bay and Ahn Bay .

title: Chancil Crystalheart
description: Chancil Crystalheart Chancil Crystalheart was a human mage of Memnon in Calimshan in the 1350s DR . Relations . Chancil was a subordinate of Pasha Abon Duum of Manshaka .

title: Chanczlatha Luruin
description: Chanczlatha Luruin Chanczlatha Luruin was a cleric of Lathander who lived at the Bargewright Inn in the Dessarin Valley around 1365 DR . Activities . He was a revered healer within his community who dedicated his life to tending the sick .

title: Chaney
description: Chaney Chaney was the name assigned to a doppelganger who was Howard Holiday ' s chief spy in Ravens Bluff around 1356 – 1357 DR . No one knew its real name , or if it even had one . History .

title: Chang - liu - shui
description: Chang - liu - shui Chang - liu - shui , or Inexhaustible Spring Halt , was a small town located on the Spice Road on the Plain of Horses . Description . This oasis could be found between the Merket Depression and the Ni - Ko Oasis .

title: Changchub Zangpo
description: Changchub Zangpo Changchub Zangpo was the Sergeant of the Guard for Saikhoi in Ra - Khati during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . As with all of his fellow sohei , Changchub was a fanatic while within the walls of Saikhoi , willing to give his life in defense of the city and its rulers .

title: Change domain
description: Change domain The goddesses Selûne and Tymora both are part of the change domain but both have a different view upon change . In the eyes goddess of the tides and the cycles of the moon Selûne everything that changes will some day change back . She looks upon change as a natural , continual , process essential to life and the world .

title: Changestaff
description: Changestaff Changestaff was a transmutation or evocation and enchantment spell that made a specially prepared staff become a treant - like creature on command . Effects . This spell required a staff that was specifically prepared for use with this spell .

title: Chanii
description: Chanii Chanii was a ch ' i - lin member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Chanii was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .

title: Channath
description: Channath The Channath family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Channaths were allied with the Elovear , Laranadda , Tithlin , and Vandover families .

title: Chanoch
description: Chanoch Chanoch was a young Shadar - kai warrior from Ikemmu . History . Chanoch was born into a small Shadar - kai enclave .

title: Chansobal Dreen
description: Chansobal Dreen High Morninglord Chansobal Dreen ( known by locals as the Chanter ) was a High Morninglord of Lathander and led the Morningmist Hall in Marsember , Cormyr . Activities . He oversaw sixteen priests and twelve other staff , and was strongly opposed to piracy , often sending out ships against them .

title: Chansrin Aluar
description: Chansrin Aluar Chansrin Aluar was a female human wizard who lived in Scornubel in the 14th century DR . Personality . Chansrin was generous to her friends , but had a sharp tongue and was easily distracted and soon bored .

title: Chant
description: Chant Chant was a conjuration spell that provided a " bless " on the caster ' s allies and a " curse " on the caster ' s enemies for as long as the chant could be maintained without interruption . Effects . Allies were filled with hope , boosting their morale and improving their combat ability , giving them a slightly better chance to strike a blow or aim true .

title: Chant Masters
description: Chant Masters The Chant Masters were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Jisan , the Zakharan goddess of bounty . The Chant Masters did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities .

title: Chant Morven
description: Chant Morven Chant Morven was a portly human pawnbroker with a shop in one of Airspur ' s seedier districts . In spite of his large size , he was unusually nimble and quick on his feet . Chant owed a large gambling debt to Raneger , a local crime lord .

title: Chantlarn Iyrmerr
