description: Chantlarn Iyrmerr Chantlarn Iyrmerr was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . In 240 DR , he was forcibly summoned to a spell - battle in Ithboltar ' s tower in Athalgard and died there .

title: Chantos Graybeard
description: Chantos Graybeard Chantos Graybeard was a businessman and wizard in Skullport . Personality . Chantos was a gentleman mage known for his quick wit and complex , but deft , hand gestures during spell casting .

title: Chaos Bay
description: Chaos Bay Chaos Bay was an inlet of water on the Great Sea named for its often impassable coral reefs and sandbars , which offered natural protection for the corsairs ' main base of Hawa . Description . The coral reefs and sandbars guarding Chaos Bay were shifted regularly through the use of unknown magic .

title: Chaos Curse
description: Chaos Curse The Chaos Curse or Tuanta Quiro Miancay ( Most Fatal Horror ) was a potion discovered by the imp Druzil and brewed by Aballister Bonaduce that made the afflicted being ' s desires paramount over all other things . Difficulty . Both gathering the ingredients and preparing the potion successfully was extremely difficult .

title: Chaos bolt
description: Chaos bolt Chaos bolt is a spell used by sorcerer s , most often chaos sorcerers . When cast , " chaos bolt " shoots a blast of multicolored light out from a sorcerer ' s implement towards the head of an enemy within fifty feet , filling their mind with wracking pain in a telepathic attack . Enhanced and fueled by a sorcerer ' s charisma like virtually all sorcerer spells , " chaos bolt " grows in potency as the sorcerer casting it grows more powerful .

title: Chaos hammer
description: Chaos hammer Chaos hammer was an evocation spell exclusive to cleric s with the Chaos domain . It damaged and staggered lawful enemies . Effect .

title: Chaos sphere
description: Chaos sphere The Chaos sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s that followed deities of bad luck and trickery and to chaotic crusader s . These spells increased entropy , mischief , and confusion in the world . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Chaotic evil
description: Chaotic evil Chaotic evil is power without control - selfishness unfettered by any law . A chaotic evil character does whatever his greed , hatred , and lust for destruction drive him to do . If he is simply out for whatever he can get , he is ruthless and brutal .

title: Chaotic good
description: Chaotic good Chaotic good combines a good heart with a free spirit . In 4th edition mechanics for " " chaotic good is found under the umbrella of the good alignment . A chaotic good character acts as his or her conscience directs with little regard for what others expect .

title: Chaotic neutral
description: Chaotic neutral Chaotic neutral is freedom from both society ' s restrictions and a do - gooder ' s zeal . In 4th edition mechanics for " " chaotic neutral is found under the umbrella of the unaligned alignment . A chaotic neutral character follows his whims .

title: Char
description: Char The Char was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This walled section held the slave barracks .

title: Charcoal Palace
description: Charcoal Palace The Charcoal Palace was a massive structure located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Palace was found within the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Chard languages
description: Chard languages The Chard language subgroup included Damaran and related Ulou languages . Languages . Damaran was considered by some to be some scholars to simply be a dialect of the Chardic language .

title: Chardalyn
description: Chardalyn A chardalyn was a rare black stone which could naturally absorb and release magic , with larger stones able to hold more potent spells . Found only in the northern Sword Coast , they required no magical preparation to function . History .

title: Chardansearavitriol
description: Chardansearavitriol Chardansearavitriol , known as Ebondeath , was a black dragon who became a dracolich . History . in 631 DR , Ebondeath was the first dragon to settle in the Mere of Dead Men in the Sword Coast North , making his home in Uthtower and ruling all of the surrounding area .

title: Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV
description: Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV Lord Charles was the Lord Speaker of the Advisory Council of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? .

title: Charles Oliver O ' Kane
description: Charles Oliver O ' Kane Charles Oliver O ' Kane was the Lord Mayor of Ravens Bluff from 1337 DR to 1370 DR . Description . At 5 ′ 11 ″ ( 1 .

title: Charles Stross
description: Charles Stross Charles David George " Charlie " Stross ( born Leeds , October 18 , 1964 ) is a writer based in Edinburgh , Scotland . His works range from science fiction and Lovecraftian horror to fantasy . In the 1970s and 80s , Stross published some role - playing game articles for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons in the " White Dwarf " magazine , and some of his creatures , such as the death knight , githyanki , githzerai , and slaad ( a chaotic race notable for their rigid caste system ) were later published in the " Fiend Folio " monster compendium .

title: Charm lycanthrope
description: Charm lycanthrope Charm lycanthrope was a sorcerer / wizard spell that could be used to charm natural lycanthropes , although it would not work with infected lycanthropes . In order to cast the spell , the caster had to use the blood of a natural lycanthrope as the material component . This spell did not end if the lycanthrope changed form .

title: Charm monster
description: Charm monster Charm monster , formerly known as Pockall ' s monster hex , was an enchantment ( compulsion ) spell that turned a monster into an ally of the caster . Effect . This spell worked in the same fashion as " charm person " , except that it was not restricted to humanoid creatures or by their size .

title: Charm person
description: Charm person Charm person was an enchantment spell that made the subject a friend of the caster . Charm Person was a common spell in the Realms . Effect .

title: Charm sphere
description: Charm sphere The Charm sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and druid s that influenced people or creatures with some intelligence . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Charm Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Charon
description: Charon A major altraloth is Charon ( also known as Cerlic ) , the boatman of the River of Blood , who ferries souls down the River for a steep price . The River of Blood links the topmost layers of the Fiendish Planes , and it branches can be found anywhere from the Nine Hells to the Abyss . When encountered , the River is a deep , swift , and unfordable torrent .

title: Charon ' s Claw ( novel )
description: Charon ' s Claw ( novel ) Charon ' s Claw is third novel of The Neverwinter Saga by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Charon ' s Claw ( sword )
description: Charon ' s Claw ( sword ) Charon ' s Claw ( later known simply as Claw ) was a magical sword and gauntlet designed to battle wizard s . It was once wielded by the highly skilled assassin Artemis Entreri . It was assumed destroyed in 1463 DR .

title: Charsultketh
description: Charsultketh Charsultketh , also known as Helanna Darkstorm , was the newest member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Charsultketh was for a long time , the enforcer of Gargauth as well as his consort .

title: Chartilifax
description: Chartilifax Chartilifax was a young green dragon living in Neverwinter Wood circa 1479 DR . Chartilifax was however seduced and later twisted by the succubus Rohini under orders from the Abolethic Sovereignty . She opened her mind to the dragon , driving him mad .

title: Chasme
description: Chasme A chasme ( pronounced KAZ - mee or CHAZ - mee ) , sometimes called a fly demon , was a type of tanar ' ri demon found in the Abyss . Chasmes were horrid and disgusting hybrids of flies and humans who sucked blood and enjoyed tormenting and torturing their victims . The droning of their wings could lull an unwary being to sleep , who might awake to find themselves being fed upon and tortured .

title: Chastise
description: Chastise Chastise was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell on those who offended them .

title: Chastus Beldrorn
description: Chastus Beldrorn Chastus Beldrorn was a local herald based in Darromar , Tethyr , in 1372 DR . Personality . Chastus was known to be enamored with his own importance and imperious to those who challenged his authority .

title: Chathi Oandem
description: Chathi Oandem Chathi Oandem was a priestess of Kossuth . Appearance . Chathi was of willowy built .

title: Chatkcha
description: Chatkcha A chatkcha was a type of exotic throwing weapon invented by the thri - kreen and unique to them . The chatkcha was a kind of triangular throwing wedge with three piercing points . The thri - kreen carved it from a crystalline material .

title: Chatulio
description: Chatulio Chatulio was a copper dragon who helped Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon king Lareth ordered all metallic dragon s to hide in order to avoid the Rage , Chatulio was among those who disagreed , instead believing in searching for a cure .

title: Chaul
description: Chaul Chaul is a hag who lives in and rules the village of Citadel Rashemar in Rashemen . She lives in the lower levels of the ruined keep in the former fortress and has a hatred for the hathran , having killed two of them who attacked her . She trains her ogre and goblin followers to use magic like she does .

title: Chaul ' mur ' ssin
description: Chaul ' mur ' ssin Chaul ' mur ' ssin was a drow city in the Plane of Shadow . History . It was founded by the former inhabitants of Chaulssin , a city in the Underdark of Toril .

title: Chaulssin
description: Chaulssin Chaulssin is a drow city in the Underdark . To some people it is also known as the City of Wyrmshadows . Chaulssin lies beneath the northern Rauvin Mountains .

title: Chaumyk Vorn
description: Chaumyk Vorn Chaumyk Vorn was a male human Red Wizard and khazark of the Thayan enclave in Hillsfar . Abilities . As a high - ranking Red Wizard and skilled evoker , Chaumyk was talented in the use of evocation spell s that could be highly destructive in battle .

title: Chauntea
description: Chauntea Chauntea ( pronounced " Chawn - TEE - ah " ) , the Grain Goddess or the Great Mother was the god dess of life and a parallel deity to Silvanus , who was considered the god of wild nature , whilst Chauntea herself was seen as being the embodiment of all things agrarian or agriculture . She was a goddess of agriculture , plants cultivated by humans , farmers , gardeners , and summer . Some of her worshipers claimed that her divine glimmer gave life to the natural world , and some contended that she was the creator and source of all mortal races .

title: Chaunticleer
description: Chaunticleer Brother Chaunticleer was a brother at the Edificant Library who sung the Canticle of Deneir at mid - day every day . During the Chaos Curse , he momentarily forgot the words while thinking of fishing , and that proved to Cadderly Bonaduce that something was terribly wrong with the library . When Cadderly finally returned to a doomed and desecrated library , he eventually found Chaunticleer in his room , which he had warded against vampire s so Kierkan Rufo and his zombie and vampire lackeys could not enter .

title: Chaver Tegarech
description: Chaver Tegarech Chaver Tegarech was an aide to First Speaker Tessarin Alaurun in Nesmé . In 1374 DR he rode from Nesmé to check upon a watchpost at Morach Tor and was kidnapped by the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk , who had been hired to protect the town against attack from giant s and troll s . The lizardfolk betrayed Alaurun and Nesmé .

title: Chavyondat
description: Chavyondat Chavyondat was a port city and the capital of Estagund . It was the largest city in that realm . Chavyondat was formerly known as Klionna .

title: Chayne Mulish
description: Chayne Mulish Chayne Mulish was a dwarf commander of Citadel Adbar . History . Chayne was a commander in 1484 DR .

title: Chazdan
description: Chazdan " Lord " Chazdan was a man from the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a former noble of Procampur , but later turned pirate . He was among the great pirate lord Immurk ' s fleet of 100 pirate ships at Dragonisle .

title: Chazlauth Yarghorn
description: Chazlauth Yarghorn Chazlauth Yarghorn was a wizard in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Chazlauth was a kind of dragon expert .

title: Chechu al Khish
description: Chechu al Khish Chechu al Khish was an exiled dao genie member of the Shadow Thieves in Westgate around 1370 DR . Personality . Chechu ' s objective was to overthrow his father ' s rival and his work for the Shadow Thieves gained him the money he needed to buy magic items needed for his plan .

title: Ched Nasad
description: Ched Nasad Ched Nasad , or the " City of Shimmering Webs " or " City of Webs " , was a drow city in the Middle Northdark that was destroyed on Uktar 3 , 1372 DR . Geography . Ched Nasad was located in the Middle Northdark beneath the High Cap in the northern Graypeak Mountains .

title: Ched Nasad portal
description: Ched Nasad portal The so - called Ched Nasad " portal " was a portal that connected the drow city of Ched Nasad with the Dalelands . Geography . The Ched Nasad " portal " , like any other gate consisted of two gates : an Underdark one in Ched Nasad and a surface one in the Dalelands , namely Deepingdale .

title: Cheddah al - Assad
description: Cheddah al - Assad Prince Cheddah al - Assad was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Cheddah was extremely obese .

title: Cheese
description: Cheese Cheese was widely available in Faerûn . Terminology . Cheese was most often found in 1 - lb circular or elliptic wheels , or in rectangular loaves , which could then be divided further in wedges , or hunks .

title: Cheg
description: Cheg Cheg was a doppelganger member of the Unseen who disguised itself as the human Nool , a Hand Leader and a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport in 1370 DR . As Nool , he guided a squad of ten slavers in search of victims in Waterdeep ' s slums and using his peculiar talents they usually had a good hunt . As Cheg , his mission was to get near the Xanathar and discover his lair , in order for the Unseen to control him from afar and possibly assassinate the Xanathar at need .

title: Cheju
description: Cheju Cheju was a settlement on the island of Saishu in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Cheju stood at the end of a narrow bay that cut deep into the island .

title: Cheleen
description: Cheleen Cheleen was a mature adult black dragon whose lair was in the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . She was the great - granddaughter of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the daughter of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the daughter of the black dragons Woklef , Aswidorg and Kasidikal .

title: Chelnadatilar
description: Chelnadatilar Chelnadatilar was a gold dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Chelnadatilar was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Chelryn Sarynnryllar
description: Chelryn Sarynnryllar Chelryn Sarynnryllar was a sun elf and the mother of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Chelryn had two children with the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir : Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) and Malphys Maraphiir .

title: Chen
description: Chen Chen was a general of Shou Lung who earned the disfavor of the Emperor . History . General Chen attempted to overthrow the Emperor of Shou Lung and seize the throne for himself during the 1330s DR .

title: Cheng Han
description: Cheng Han Cheng Han was a noble officer in the army of Shou Lung . History . Cheng Han was a noble and an officer in the personal armies of the nobles , the Twenty - Five Armies .

title: Chenowyn
description: Chenowyn Chenowyn was a ruby dragon companion of queen Zaranda Star . Description . Chenowyn had spent most of her life in the form of a human orphan girl in the city of Zazesspur .

title: Chenraya Xorlarrin
description: Chenraya Xorlarrin Chenraya Xorlarrin was a dark elf priestess of Lolth who conspired to steal arambarium ore from Akanûl in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , the goddess Lolth ordered her minions to collect as many blue fire items and relics of Mystra as possible so that Lolth could become the new goddess of magic .

title: Cherlrigo ' s Darkness
description: Cherlrigo ' s Darkness Cherlrigo ' s Darkness was supposedly the translation ( by Cherlrigo ) of a sonnet that could be found within " The Leaves of One Grass " , a work of prophetic yet cryptic messages penned by the Dark Diviners of Windsong Tower in Myth Drannor . This particular passage was thought to have originally been written two thousand years before the mid - fifteenth century Dale Reckoning and was heralded by many Shadovar nobles and sages , including Draygo Quick , Parise Ulfbinder and Rolan of Gloomwrought to directly relate to the power of the Shadowfell and have something to do with the Chosen . Notes .

title: Cherra
description: Cherra Sister Cherra was one of the monks of the Monastery of the Precipice . History . Cherra went from Waterdeep to the the Monastery in 1473 DR in search of answers to the disappearance of her brother .

title: Cherrapunni Nor
description: Cherrapunni Nor Cherrapunni Nor , or the Bottomless Lake , was a lake located in western Ra - Khati . Geography . Glacial run - off formed this large lake that formed part of the border of Ra - Khati .

title: Chess
description: Chess Lord Chess was the ineffectual overlord of Zhentil Keep from at least the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR until his death around the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Personality . Chess was a gluttonous , corpulent man who was vainly fastidious in manner and dress .

title: Chess ( game )
description: Chess ( game ) Chess was a board game and " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with draughts , dice , and Talis . Description . In Faerûn , chess was played on a checkered board with six types of pieces : pawns , rooks , knights - errant , priests , queens , and kings .

title: Chessan languages
description: Chessan languages The Chessan language group was a part of the Faerûnian language family and included the language of Chessenta . Subgroups . The Chessan group contained two diverse subgroups , the Chessentic group — which included languages spoken around the Sea of Fallen Stars near Chessenta — and Akalaic — including languages spoken in the Shaar , the Shining South , and the Chultan Peninsula .

title: Chessenta
description: Chessenta Chessenta took its name from the first Grand Viceroy Iphram Chess when the region was a province of Unther Prior to the Spellplague , Chessenta was a country of individual city - states that were often at war with one another . The city of Cimbar was the theoretical capital of Chessenta as it was the definitive capital of Tchazzar ' s brief Chessentan Empire . After Chessenta defeated Threskel in 1479 DR , Threskel became a vassal state .

title: Chessentan Lotus Cheese
description: Chessentan Lotus Cheese Chessentan Lotus Cheese was a popular cheese crafted in Chessenta . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Chessentan language
description: Chessentan language Chessentan , also called Chessic , was the regional language of the confederation of Chessenta , located in the Old Empires region of southern Faerûn . Speakers . It was spoken primarily by both Chessenta ns and Ixinos ians but included speakers in Aglarond , Altumbel , the Chondalwood , the Dragon Coast , Impiltur , the Moonsea region , Mulhorand , Sembia , Thay , Turmish , Unther , and the Vilhon and Wizards ' Reaches .

title: Chestnut
description: Chestnut The chestnut tree can be found in various places in Faerûn , including the midwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . In the colder parts of its range , as at Cormanthor , it grows with beech , maple and oak . In the warmest areas , its companions include the fig , mulberry and olive .

title: Cheth Moonviper
description: Cheth Moonviper Cheth Moonviper was a balding alchemist in High Dale . History . Cheth was a priest of Bane and a scion of one of the most noble families of Zhentil Keep .

title: Chethel
description: Chethel Chethel was a coastal city in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Chethel was located on the coast of Luirenstrand ( the Great Sea ) .

title: Chevesh
description: Chevesh Chevesh was a powerful human wizard who liveed in a marble tower in Airspur . He was widely regarded by the citizens of Airspur to be crazy and most people avoided his tower . Chevesh was suspected of summoning demons and was investigated by Demascus .

title: Chezzara
description: Chezzara Chezzara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR . Activities . Chezzara was one of the priestesses of the Misty Forest .

title: Chical
description: Chical Chical was the old leader of the Eagle Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , Chical tried to convince Poshtli , a fellow Eagle Knight and nephew of Naltecona , to abandon his fellows Halloran and Erixitl to their fates .

title: Chiguo Ihario
description: Chiguo Ihario Chiguo Ihario was a wakadoshiyori sohei in Wa . Personality . At heart , Chiguo was a bureaucrat and also a devotee of the Path of Enlightenment .

title: Chil ' triss Kilsek
description: Chil ' triss Kilsek Chil ' triss Kilsek was the leader of a group of drider s . History . Chil ' triss was once a priestess of Lolth of House Kilsek before she was cursed to become a drider .

title: Children of the Starry Quill
description: Children of the Starry Quill The Children of the Starry Quill was an order of bard s that served the Church of Mystra as a news - gathering network and sometimes put to use as a propaganda machine spreading rumors that improved the church ' s position on some issue .

title: Chilis
description: Chilis Chilis were strong spices from Maztica . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Chill
description: Chill The Chill was a military band of goblinoid s and others , led by Ardenor Crush ( a reincarnation in a hobgoblin body ) and formed from the survivors of the Second Battle of Urml . Its base was Chill Tower in the Lurkwood and its symbol , worn on the upper arm , was a fist surrounded by a white nimbus . Its members headed into the North to slay the adventurers who had killed Ardenor .

title: Chill blade
description: Chill blade A chill blade is a magic dagger that glows white . It grants its wielder the ability to activate it , upon which it can confer extra damage upon a target , and imposes a magical effect on the target such that the target ' s own attacks are reduced in effectiveness for around an hour . The blade does a reduced amount of extra damage against the undead , but has a probability of turning them , causing them to flee temporarily .

title: Chill metal
description: Chill metal Chill metal was a transmutation spell that made metal cold as ice . Effect . Chill metal made metal extremely cold .

title: Chill strike
description: Chill strike Chill strike is a wizard spell of relatively low complexity . When cast , " chill strike " creates a bolt of icy cold energy that is purplish in color . The bolt then flies towards its target , which must be somewhere within a range of fifty feet , dazing them if they are animated .

title: Chill touch
description: Chill touch Chill touch , formerly known as Veridon ' s chiller , was a necromancy spell that disrupted the life force of the living . Users . " Chill touch " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold domain In the time of Netheril , it could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive and Variation specializations .

title: Chilling blow
description: Chilling blow Chilling blow was a swordmage spell of the transmutation school , most commonly used by those of the shielding style . When cast , " chilling blow " instilled the swordmage ' s weapon with magic al cold , so that the wound they left froze instantly , causing the target a level of pain proportional to the swordmage ' s intellect . This frozen flesh continued to injure its owner for a short while afterward ; precisely how much dependent upon the vitality of the swordmage in question .

title: Chimera
description: Chimera A chimera is a large magical beast that appears to be an amalgam of several different creatures , namely a dragon , a goat , and a lion . Although typically unintelligent , chimeras are self - aware creatures , with a limited capacity for language , often Draconic . Physical description .

title: Chioptl
description: Chioptl Chioptl was a Tabaxi in Nexal . History . Chioptl was a Tabaxi living in southern Maztica .

title: Chipgrin Goldwhisker
description: Chipgrin Goldwhisker Chipgrin Goldwhisker was the leader of the wererat s in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Chipgrin was a smart and reasonable leader .

title: Chiquong
description: Chiquong Chiquong was a shukenja and holy man in the land of Koryo . Seeking a suitable locale for his hermitage , Chiquong had journeyed to the southern tip of the island of Saishu , but had still found nothing to his liking . So instead he raised an island from the depths of the sea , a desolate rock that came to be called Su ' un .

title: Chitikas
description: Chitikas Chitikas was a couatl servant of Qotal . History . Chitikas was the main agent of Qotal in preparation for his god ' s return .

title: Chitin armor
description: Chitin armor Chitin armor was made from the shells of chitinous creatures such as ankheg , giant crab s , or remorhaz . It was flexible and could be comfortable , and was known to be used by aquatic elves and some savage cultures . The armor was valued around 75 gp and weighed 20 lb ( 10 kg ) .

title: Chitine
description: Chitine Chitines were humanoid s that resembled spiders and were found in the Underdark . Description . Chitines were about 4 feet tall and had four arms , each of which had an extra joint .

title: Chitine web armor
description: Chitine web armor Chitine web armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Chitin web armor was a rare type of armor made from the hardened web of chitine s .

title: Chizra
description: Chizra Chizra was a priestess of Eilistraee and one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . . History .

title: Cho Lu - k ' u
description: Cho Lu - k ' u Cho Lu - k ' u was a wizard who once lived in Koryo . Cho Lu - k ' u died in the Dang Caverns and cursed its tunnels . This may have led to the evil monsters that lurked there .

title: Chog
description: Chog Chog the Yellow was one of the two Cloakmasters of Keczulla for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Previously , Chog was the guildmaster of fences for the Shadow Thieves in the city .

title: Choi Tan Sai
description: Choi Tan Sai Choi Tan Sai was a yakuza adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Choi was a shrewd and cunning individual who never showed his true feelings .

title: Choin
description: Choin Choin , or Choin the Blue - Nosed , was the bakemono ruler of Panjuis in 1359 DR . Description . As his name implied , Choin possessed a large blue nose centered on a bulbous head .

title: Choldrith
description: Choldrith Choldriths were the priest race of the chitine s in the Underdark . Description . Choldriths had eight legs ( though the front two served as arms ) and resembled bloated white spiders .

title: Chond
description: Chond Chond was a merchant from the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Chond partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .

title: Chondalwood
description: Chondalwood Chondalwood is a large forest located in Chondath in the Vilhon Reach , stretching from the Nunwood to the Nagaflow River . It is also known as Satyrwood . The village of Elbulder is to the south of the forest .

title: Chondath
description: Chondath Chondath was a country located in the Vilhon Reach . It had a long history . It was located on what once was the psiocracy of Jhaamdath on the shore of the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Chondathan
description: Chondathan Chondathans were one of the more common human ethnicities . Regions . Chondathans made up the bulk of the population in the following areas : Chondathan culture had a major influence on Damaran , Vaasan , and Tethyrian heritage .

title: Chondathan language
description: Chondathan language Chondathan was a popular human language spoken mainly in the western regions of Faerûn . Description . Chondathan was similar to Common , but it was far more expressive and complex in its grammar .

title: Chondathan steelsword
description: Chondathan steelsword A Chondathan steelsword , named after Chondath in the Vilhon Reach , is a broad - bladed one - handed sword that behaves like a masterwork longsword and is particularly good at breaking other weapons . As of 1372 DR they were available in Cormyr , the Dalelands and Sembia . They were valued around 315 gp and weighed 5 lb ( 2 .

title: Chonis
description: Chonis Chonis was an unknown being named in two ruins found in Cormyr : the ruins of Chonis ' Temple in the Stormhorns in the west and the Tomb of Chonis in the plains in the east . The word " Chonis " was written in the Thorass alphabet in prominent places in both structures . For example , it appeared on the stone lintel over the door in the tomb .

title: Chonis ' Temple
description: Chonis ' Temple Chonis ' Temple was the name given to a ruined structure in western Cormyr . It lay east of Eagle Peak , in the foothills of the Stormhorns . The ruins were thought to have once been a temple , and prominently bore the name " Chonis " , written in the Thorass alphabet , a feature it shared with the Tomb of Chonis .

title: Choren Lendoren
description: Choren Lendoren Choren Lendoren was a tavern owner of the Dizzy Drake in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Choren started to drink with his customers .

title: Chosen
description: Chosen The Chosen are individuals imbued with divine power by one of the deities of the Realms , which grants them various abilities and boons , such as stopping the process of aging . It is believed that all deities are capable of " choosing " mortals , though it is impossible to say whether all of them take advantage of this power . It is possible for one being to be the chosen of more than one deity .

title: Chosen of Bane
description: Chosen of Bane The chosen of Bane was a position granted by Bane to powerful members of his faith . Typically , there was only one Chosen of Bane at a time . Around 1372 DR , this position was held by Fzoul Chembryl .

title: Chosen of Lolth
description: Chosen of Lolth The Chosen of Lolth were , like other Chosen , mortals who were favored or otherwise " blessed " by a god or goddess , in this case Lolth . There were two apparent types of Chosen of Lolth : zedrinset and Yor ' thae . Zedrinset .

title: Chosen of Mystra
description: Chosen of Mystra The Chosen of Mystra are , similarly to the Chosen of other deities , mortals who have been specifically blessed by Mystra . Due to this blessing they gain access to unprecedented magical power . Mystra ' s Chosen are all concerned with fighting evil and imbalances in the Weave .

title: Choshein
description: Choshein Choshein was one of the seats of the Satraps of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography & Layout . The city of Choshein was a subterranean one , with smooth , crystal walls and spired buildings .

title: Chou Lin Shi
description: Chou Lin Shi Chou Lin Shi was the Minister of Sea of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Chou Lin Shi gained fame by defeating the pirates of Akari .

title: Chourm Mristar
description: Chourm Mristar Chourm Mristar was a monk from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in Damara in the late 15th century DR . Relationship . Chourm was a good friend of Lana , and was one of the people that Lana trusted most .

title: Chourst
description: Chourst Chourst is the slaad Lord of Randomness . Description . Chourst appears as a gangly , 20 ' tall chalk - white slaad ; his other forms are unknown .

title: Chris Avellone
description: Chris Avellone Chris Avellone is a video game designer who has worked for the video game companies and Obsidian Entertainment . He was one of the co - founders of the latter company . He also writes comic books .

title: Chris Sims
description: Chris Sims Chris Sims is a game designer and associate editor working at Wizards of the Coast , Inc . . Biography .

title: Chris Tulach
description: Chris Tulach Chris Tulach is an RPGA Content Desginer and Program Manager at WOTC who ' s worked on several Dungeons & Dragons . Chris is best know for his RPGA or D & D Play reports which have been a regular feature in Dragon since April 2008 . Bibliography .

title: Chris Youngs
description: Chris Youngs Chris Youngs is a magazine editor at Wizards of the Coast . Career . Youngs first joined Wizards of the Coast in 1998 as an editing intern .

title: Christie Golden
description: Christie Golden Christie Golden ( born 1963 ) is a Colorado based American fantasy author . Her first novel " Vampire of the Mists " ( 1991 ) marked the beginning of TSR ' s Ravenloft novel line . Her trips to the Forgotten Realms have thus far been limited to three short stories published in the anthologies series in which she further explores the character of the elven vampire Jander Sunstar , whom she established in " Vampire of the Mists " .

title: Christine Dragonsbane
description: Christine Dragonsbane Lady Christine was the wife of King Gareth Dragonsbane and the daughter of Baron Tranth , the former ruler of the Barony of Bloodstone in Damara . History . Christine had been raised as a noblewoman , being the daughter of Baron Tranth .

title: Christopher Perkins
description: Christopher Perkins Christopher Perkins has written many supplements for Wizards of the Coast , first as a freelance contributor in Dungeon magazine , then as that magazine ' s editor before becoming editor - in chief for all Wizards of the Coast periodicals . He was also the design manager for the Eberron campaign setting before becoming the Story Design and Development Manager for all of Dungeons and Dragons in 2007 , acting as senior producer for the game .

title: Chromatic Demon
description: Chromatic Demon The Chromatic Demon was a tanar ' ri imprisoned in Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . He was forced into Helm ' s service to secure the Imprisoned One in the keep . He guarded a level of the dungeon imprisoned in a magical cage , and only he had the key for the next level .

title: Chromatic dragon
description: Chromatic dragon Chromatic dragons were a type of dragon distinguished typically by a solid , non - reflective coloring of their scales , hence the name . They were generally evil , greedy , and predatory , and usually worshiped Tiamat , whom they regarded as their queen . It was believed by scholars from Candlekeep that all species of chromatic dragons evolved from the proto - dragon species of the inficedraco genus .

title: Chromatic orb
description: Chromatic orb Chromatic orb was an evocation spell used by several sorcerer s and wizard s . When cast , " chromatic orb " shoot a dazzling , multicoloured globe towards a creature of the casters choice within fifty feet , which upon impact burst into a ray of whatever colour was currently dominant . Though this often resulted in debilitating effects , " chromatic orb " always dealt some degree of injury to its target , regardless of how well they defend themselves .

title: Chronomancy
description: Chronomancy Chronomancy was a school of magic dealing with movement through time , or the manipulation of time . It was a secretive and rare school of magic , and most wizard s had difficulty comprehending the possibility of altering the natural course of events . Those wielding power in this school were known as chronomancers .

title: Chronos
description: Chronos Chronos was an ancient deity , the god of time , ironically , lost to the ages . Religious texts and ancient histories speak of him in passing . He was known to be worshiped by the nation of Orva but it was unknown how he died .

title: Chroomeg
description: Chroomeg Chroomeg was a tavern owner in Mulmaster . Personality . The tavern owner was a gregarious and affable man with hints of orc blood in his veins .

title: Chrysoberyl
description: Chrysoberyl Chrysoberyl , also known as a cat ' s eye , was a hard , transparent , green gem , usually facet - cut . Description . This fancy stones were used in producing devices which provide protection against " magic jar " spells or other forms of possession , and in weapons designed to affect ghost and similar creatures .

title: Chrysocolla
description: Chrysocolla Chrysocolla was a translucent variety of chalcedony , its blue - green to green color due to traces of copper . Description . These valuable ornamental stones had uniform color and no inclusions ( flaws caused by impurities ) .

title: Chrysoprase
description: Chrysoprase Chrysoprase , also known as stormrock , was a translucent chalcedony with an apple - green color . Description . This semi - precious stone was found throughout the " Realms " but its greatest concentration was in the Stormhorn Mountains of Cormyr .

title: Chuchian
description: Chuchian Chuchian was a language spoken by the tribes of the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands , those that dwelt along the border with Shou Lung and north of the Kora Shan . Related languages . Chuchian was of the Eastern Imaskari languages subgroup , which was in turn of the Imaskari languages family .

title: Chuhotl
description: Chuhotl Chuhotl was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Chuhotl was the son of Kichemel , a great Nexalan Eagle Knight .

title: Chult
description: Chult Chult is located on an island in the southern part of the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Calimshan . Formerly , the land was located at the westernmost end of the Chultan peninsula . It is a mountainous jungle of savage beast s , hulking dinosaur s , and disease - ridden swamps .

title: Chultan ( ethnicity )
description: Chultan ( ethnicity ) The term Chultan referred broadly to humans from the Chultan Peninsula , consisting primarily of members of the Tabaxi tribe . Description . Chultans were tall and had dark , ebony skin .

title: Chultan Peninsula
description: Chultan Peninsula The Chultan Peninsula is the dominant area of Southwest Faerûn . It has an undeserved reputation of being a backward place with a complete lack of civilisation populated by savages . In fact , it boasts several large cities with stable governments that are all rife with culture .

title: Chultan dwarf
description: Chultan dwarf Chultan dwarves were shield dwarves living in the vast mines of Chult . Description . The shield dwarves of Chult were albinos ; their hair and skin were white , and they had pink eyes .

title: Chultan language
description: Chultan language Chultan was a language group of south Faerûn and the main language of Chult and Samarach . Other regions where it was commonly spoken include Calimshan , Lapaliiya , Nimbral , Tashalar , Tharsult , and Thindol . Tabaxi was the primary language of the Chultan language group .

title: Chuqali Shilai
description: Chuqali Shilai Chuqali Shilai was a barbarian chieftain inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Chuqali was the chieftain of the Fankiang tribe and the ruler of Li - Raz , the greatest city of the Plains .

title: Church of Cyric
description: Church of Cyric The Church of Cyric was the organization dedicated to worshiping , as well as furthering the influence of , the deity Cyric . Regions . Waterdeep .

title: Church of Dionysus
description: Church of Dionysus The Church of Dionysus was a temple of Ilmater dedicated to St . Dionysus . History .

title: Church of Eilistraee
description: Church of Eilistraee The Church of Eilistraee was an organization composed of the followers of the goddess Eilistraee , the Dark Maiden . Worshipers of Eilistraee mostly consisted of those drow who hoped to escape the danger and darkness of Underdark and Lolth ' s evil , taking back their place in the surface world and living in peace with all other races . However , in line with her ideals , Eilistraee would welcome and accept beings of all races who shared the desire of seeing all races living in harmony , without pointless discrimination or wars , and worked towards that goal .

title: Church of Ilmater
description: Church of Ilmater The Church of Ilmater ( pronounced " Ihl - MAY - ter " or " ill - " may " - ter " ) was the primary religious organization dedicated to the worship and service of Ilmater , the Crying God . The clergy dedicated themselves to providing healing and succor to all in need , whatever the cost to themselves , as they believed life was sacred and that suffering to preserve it was holy . Misunderstood and scorned by those hard of heart , the Ilmatari were yet loved and relied upon by multitudes of ordinary folk , and so the church had the widest and most faithful following in all Faerûn .

title: Church of Mystra
description: Church of Mystra The Church of Mystra , also known as the Church of Mysteries and by other names , was the primary religious organization dedicated to the worship and service of the goddess of magic , Mystra , or her successor , Mystra . Dogma . The church of Mystra typically did not employ idols like statues of the goddess , but had no commandments against it .

title: Church of Mystryl
description: Church of Mystryl The church of Mystryl was the main organization that followed the tenets of the goddess Mystryl , predominately during the time of the ancient Netheril empire , because the Fall of Netheril corresponded with the death of the goddess and her reincarnation as Mystra . Organization . The hierarchy of the Mystrylan church was loosely organized with an order dedicated to each type of magical energy led by a head priest .

title: Church of Shar
description: Church of Shar The Church of Shar is an organization dedicated to spreading the dogma and carrying out the wishes of the deity Shar . Although the estimated one hundred thousand worshippers of Shar can loosely be deemed members , its true membership consists of the clergy of the church , who number around three and a half thousand . The faith is forbidden in many areas of Faerûn and this leads the church underground , practising in hiding much of the time .

title: Church of Tyr
description: Church of Tyr The Church of Tyr was an institution to further the worship and tenets of the god of justice , Tyr . History . The church swiftly spread to the majority of civilized lands on the surface of Faerûn after the end of the Procession of Justice .

title: Church of Umberlee
description: Church of Umberlee The Church of Umberlee is disorganized , and different locales vary significantly in the way they practice faith in the Bitch Queen . Following Umberlee ' s nature inner disputes are usually resolved through dueling , and the strongest Umberlant prevails , while the other is thrown aboard the next ship to leave port . Clergy .

title: Church of Vhaeraun
description: Church of Vhaeraun The Church of Vhaeraun was an organization composed of the followers of the Vhaeraun , the drow god of thievery . They mostly consisted of drow and half - drow who wanted to see their people freed from Lolth ’ s oppression , united while having at the same time place in power on the surface world . Many males wishing for better opportunities than the absolute subservience reserved to them among the followers of Lolth , were also drawn to Vhaeraun .

title: Church of the Red Knight
description: Church of the Red Knight The church of the Red Knight was a small organization based primarily in the west of Faerûn , devoted to the Red Knight . History . The church of the Red Knight was not a distinct entity from the church of Tempus until the end of the Time of Troubles .

title: Churin
description: Churin Churin was the warehouse manager of Gaspar the fishmonger in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The manager dressed in yellowish clothing .

title: Chuth
description: Chuth Chuth was an adult green dragon that lived in the Misty Forest during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Chuth at one point joined the Cult of the Dragon and became the companion of the exiled elf prince Neronvain .

title: Chuul
description: Chuul Chuuls were large lobster - like aberration s with a hatred for surface - dwelling humanoid s . The many tentacles that surrounded their mouths were capable of causing paralysis with a single touch , thus leaving their unfortunate victim at the mercy of the chuul ' s powerful claws . Description .

title: Chvar Eldenbow
description: Chvar Eldenbow Chvar Eldenbow was the field agent of the Moonstars for the Western Heartlands in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Chvar was always a knowledge seeker , gaining the informal title of " Loreseeker " .

title: Chwidencha
description: Chwidencha Chwidencha , also known as spider leg horrors by surface dwellers , were horrific spider - like creatures created by Lolth from drow that failed her tests , or otherwise displeased the Spider Queen . Description . A chwidencha seemingly consisted of nothing but a writhing mass of long , hairy , flexible spider legs .

title: Chyndrie Stormwind
description: Chyndrie Stormwind Chyndrie Stormwind was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , and Noelin Tlestlin .

title: Cierre
description: Cierre Cierre was a female drow ranger who wandered the Silver Marches around 1372 DR . Description . The ranger was 5 ft 9 in ( 1 .

title: Cimarine Isles
description: Cimarine Isles The Cimarine Isles were populated by genasi and trade settlements from Amn , and were located between the Moonshae Isles and the Sword Coast . The western city of Branestria , inhabited by water genasi and partially submerged , traded with Baldur ' s Gate and some smaller settlements .

title: Cimbar
description: Cimbar Cimbar was a city - state in the Old Empires and a sometimes - capital of the empire of Chessenta . Geography . Cimbar was a port city on the eastern side of the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Cindarm mac Faern
description: Cindarm mac Faern Cindarm mac Faern was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark History . Cindarm was the son of Faern , and the grandnephew of Torg mac Cei , the ironlord of Earthfast . In the late 1360s DR , Cindarm led veteran Clangeddite warriors in defense of Alagh Rorncaurak , the temple - cavern of Clangeddin Silverbeard , against overwhelming numbers of orc s .

title: Cinderhild
description: Cinderhild Cinderhild was a fire giant and the belligerent daughter of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Cinderhild lived in her and her brother ' s room with two hobgoblin handmaidens .

title: Cindermoon
description: Cindermoon Cindermoon , formerly Shadowmoon Crystalembers , was a druid and leader of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave during the 14th and 15th centuries DR . History . In her early life she was a human druid living in Chondalwood where fall in love with the elf Freiwin Crystalembers .

title: Cindersweeps
description: Cindersweeps Cindersweeps was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . A steep trail called the Chimney led down to Cindersweeps .

title: Circle dance
description: Circle dance Circle dance was a divine divination spell that revealed the direction and status of a specific person through the act of dance . Components . This spell required one minute of a spinning dance in a circle while completing the words of the spell and mentally focusing on the individual in question .

title: Circle of Darkness
description: Circle of Darkness The Circle of Darkness was a small temple dedicated to Cyric , the Dark Sun , in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Inhabitants . The temple was led by High Priest Maskul Mirrorbane and his cadre of clergymen .

title: Circle of Rust and the Worm
description: Circle of Rust and the Worm The Circle of Rust and the Worm was rumored organization that served the god Talos . Known only in fearful rumor , the Circle of Rust and the Worm was a mysterious group . It was said to consist of insane sage s and spell casting mystics of a variety of religious and secular disciplines .

title: Circle of Skulls
description: Circle of Skulls The Circle of Skulls are a haunt in the city of Waterdeep bound to Pharra ' s Alley in Sea Ward . History . All nine of the Circle were originally wizards and clerics of Mystra .

title: Circle of Vehlarr
description: Circle of Vehlarr The Circle of Vehlarr is a magical portal that was constructed to allow transportation from the city of Vehlarr to the city of Myth Lharast . Myth Lharast had been protected with a magical lure by Syri Mhaal , and the werewolf Vehlarr , with the aid of the deity Sehanine , began construction on the portal in 712 DR , so that an attack on the city could be launched . It took eight years to complete and the attack was launched in 720 DR .

title: Circle of death
description: Circle of death Circle of death was a necromancy spell that extinguished the life force of several living creatures in all directions . Originally , this spell was simply called death spell , but by 1372 DR it was widely known as " circle of death " . Effects .

title: Circle of power
description: Circle of power Circle of power was an abjuration spell for paladin s that created a sphere of divine radiance centered on the caster . Effects . The 30 - foot - wide ( 9 .

title: Circle of privacy
description: Circle of privacy Circle of privacy was an alteration spell that masked scent and muffled sound within the area of effect to better hide from predators or trespassers . Effects . An area up to 50 ft ( 15 m ) in diameter could be protected by this spell .

title: Circled Serpent
description: Circled Serpent The Circled Serpent was an artifact which could be used to open two " portals " . Both were located on the Chultan Peninsula . One " portal " lead to Smaragd , Sseth ' s layer in the Abyss , the other to the lair of Dendar the Night Serpent on the Fugue Plane .

title: Circus of Doctor Trundles
description: Circus of Doctor Trundles The Circus of Doctor Trundles was a circus , run by Dr . Trundles and Tanaroo Quinson , which traveled Impiltur and Damara with a collection of monsters . Whenever the circus went through the town of Valls , there was always excitement ( which became rare in the time of 1357 DR ) .

title: Circus of Wonders
description: Circus of Wonders The Circus of Wonders was a travelling circus run by the Kenku Corvus Nightfeather . The circus traveled throughout Tethyr and other regions in southern Faerûn and was used by Corvus as a cover for his activities as a spy for various factions . Acts included clowns , historical reinactments , a strongman and aerial performances .

title: Cirotralech
description: Cirotralech Cirotralech was an obscure primordial who slept in the caves beneath the section of Howling Mountains located in Fimbrul , Returned Abeir . Appearance . It was believed that Cirotralech had multiple heads .

title: Citadel Adbar
description: Citadel Adbar Citadel Adbar was a fortress named for King Adbar , the ancient dwarf who began its construction in - 370 DR and completed it in - 272 DR during the waning years of ancient Delzoun , making this the last shard of that once mighty dwarven kingdom . The Citadel consisted of a massive fortified fortress that provided surface access to miles and miles of defensive granite corridors , tunnels , and hallways that wind their way under the Ice Mountains . The city can house up to 60 , 000 dwarves in relative comfort , though less then a third of that number were usually present .

title: Citadel Felbarr
description: Citadel Felbarr Citadel Felbarr was originally a dwarven citadel of over 25 , 000 dwarves that at different times in history belonged to dwarves , human s , orc s , and since 1367 DR once again the dwarves . The badge of office for the King of Citadel Felbarr was a a simple golden crown adorned with three large sapphires . Geography .

title: Citadel Rashemar
description: Citadel Rashemar Citadel Rashemar was a ruined village in the Sunrise Mountains in east Rashemen . It began as a ring - shaped fortress until it was besieged by the Tuigan Horde and although the horde was conquered , the village was never rebuilt . Present day .

title: Citadel of Black Ash
description: Citadel of Black Ash The Citadel of Black Ash was an underground temple to Gilgeam located in the eastern Smoking Mountains in the land of Unther , East Faerûn . Its entrance was a pair of large blackened steel doors shielded by an overhang of rock , all carved to resemble a fiend ish visage . Geography .

title: Citadel of Ice and Steel
description: Citadel of Ice and Steel The Citadel of Ice and Steel was the center of all major djinni activity within the Elemental Plane of Air . Geography . This citadel was actually a gigantic chunk of elemental ice and earth , smoothed over time by the winds into a nearly perfect oval .

title: Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls
description: Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls The Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls was the seat of rulership for the Great Padisha of the Marids . Geography . Located within the warm waters of the Elemental Plane of Water , this large circular coral reef sported bubbling air fountains , carpets of kelp , copper doorways , giant clams , and schools of fish .

title: Citadel of White Exile
description: Citadel of White Exile The Citadel of White Exile was a place located on the border between the Positive Energy Plane and the Plane of Gems . Description . The Citadel itself was a tall white tower , with the top not more than fifty feet ( 15 .

title: Citadel of the Mists
description: Citadel of the Mists The Citadel of the Mists was a castle located in the north - east area of the High Forest . Description . This castle was the mysterious dwelling of the enigmatic lord known as Mistmaster .

title: Citadel of the Raven
description: Citadel of the Raven The Citadel of the Raven was a fortress of the Zhentarim that was situated within the Dragonspine Mountains in the western portion of the Moonsea region . The citadel itself was the main feature of the stronghold , which rested in the center of 10 miles ( 16 km ) of interconnected fortresses on the western end of the Dragonspines . It was a well - fortified and well - protected fortress .

title: Citadel of the Respected
description: Citadel of the Respected The Citadel of the Respected was a fortress located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . The Citadel stood at the mouth of the Al - Zalim River upon an artificial mount , providing easy access to any threats to Muluk approaching from the Great Sea .

title: Cities of the Ancients
description: Cities of the Ancients The so - called Cities of the Ancients covered jungle - filled East Zakhara , an area left vacant by the ruin of former empires . Influence of Huzuz , Afyal and the League of the Pantheon on the local rulers was strong , but so was that of their savage history . Geography .

title: Cities of the Heart
description: Cities of the Heart Cities of the Heart was the name of a group of metropolises surrounding Suq Bay . They lay at the center of the continent of Zakhara geographically , but even more so in importance . They contained the largest population of any Zakharan region , and while Wasat ' s and Halwa ' s role was mainly to connect the cities to each other and with the wild hinterland of the Haunted Lands , respectively , Hiyal was the continent ' s largest industrial center , and Golden Huzuz not only functioned as the capital from which the Grand Caliph ruled all of Zakhara , but was its historical , religious , and cultural center as well .

title: Cities of the Pantheon
description: Cities of the Pantheon Several cities along the east coast of the Golden Gulf and the adjacent coast of the Crowded Sea formed the loose political organization of the League of the Pantheon , also called the Pantheist League . What bound them together was a similar outlook on religious and social matters : They restricted their belief to five gods : the Great Gods Hajama , Kor , Najm , Selan as well as Jauhar , which only the Pantheists considered equal to the others . Faiths of other gods were forbitten and often persecuted .

title: Citrine
description: Citrine Citrine , also known as false topaz was a variety of whose color ranged from pale yellow to brown . Description . This semi - precious stone cleaved nicely and was usually in brilliant or marquise styles .

title: Cittern
description: Cittern Citterns were pear - shaped musical instruments , similar to yarting s . Description . Citterns had four sets of paired strings that produced a rich array of tones and were said to " add spice to peasant music " by the Patriarch of Song in Waterdeep .

title: City - state
description: City - state A city - state is a self - governing political entity that consists solely or chiefly of a single metropolitan area . City - states are not precluded from possessing colonies or dependencies but are defined instead by the fact that the chief city or capital also functions as the primary government of the entire state , with no distinction between local government or the one that rules the entirety of the state . Several states along both the Sword Coast and Dragon Coast are city - states .

title: City Bastion ( Djerad Thymar )
description: City Bastion ( Djerad Thymar ) The City Bastion was a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The City Bastion was the upper level of Djerad Thymar , a giant pyramid whose summit had a flat end .

title: City Guard ( Waterdeep )
description: City Guard ( Waterdeep ) The City Guard was a militia organization made up of soldiers responsible for defending and patrolling the great city of Waterdeep . Organization . A City Guard patrol was typically led by a captain or sergeant .

title: City Watch ( Waterdeep )
description: City Watch ( Waterdeep ) The City Watch of Waterdeep served as the police force within the city . Organization . Members of the City Watch held the following ranks : Activities .

title: City of Brass
description: City of Brass Floating amid the Elemental Plane of Fire , the City of Brass was the epicenter of efreet culture and was the place from where the Sultan of the Efreet ruled . Geography . Hovering in the hottest areas of the Plane of Fire , the City of Brass sat in an enormous hemisphere of brass some 40 miles ( 64 kilometers ) across .

title: City of Judgment
description: City of Judgment The City of Judgement was a tightly packed metropolis located on the Fugue Plane . It was a colorless and purposefully bland city . Geography .

title: City of the Dead ( Waterdeep )
description: City of the Dead ( Waterdeep ) The City of the Dead was a large cemetery and ward in Waterdeep . Most of the city ' s dead were buried here . Structure .

title: City of the Spider Queen
description: City of the Spider Queen City of the Spider Queen , designed by James Wyatt , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 3rd edition ruleset . It focuses on drow , the Silence of Lolth , and the cult of Kiaransalee . Summary .

title: Civilization domain
description: Civilization domain The domain of civilization falls under the auspices of four deities . Amaunator supports the growth of cities so that they can develop and enforce regimented laws . The predictability of orderly cities appeals to the him .

title: Clacker
description: Clacker Clacker was a hook horror who lived in the Underdark . Background . Clacker was originally a pech , a member of a species that has a special bond with the earth .

title: Clairaudience / clairvoyance
description: Clairaudience / clairvoyance Clairaudience / clairvoyance was a divination spell that allowed the caster to put an invisible magical ear or eye in a well known place , and then hear or see what the magical organ detects from far away . Effects . The caster had to choose an aural or visual sensor at the time of casting and choose a place in which to put it .

title: Clan Auzkovyn
description: Clan Auzkovyn Clan Auzkovyn was the second biggest faction of drow living in Cormanthor in 1372 DR , They numbered about 3500 , and accounted for about 5 % of the entire drow population in Cormanthor . History . The clan was named after the founder of the clan .

title: Clan Battlehammer
description: Clan Battlehammer Clan Battlehammer was a clan of shield dwarves based in Mithral Hall who were ruled by a king of Battlehammer blood , at least until the bloodline was lost with the apparent death of Bruenor Battlehammer and Banak Brawnanvil became king . History . Mithral Hall .

title: Clan Brightblade
description: Clan Brightblade Clan Brightblade was a dwarven clan that had resided in Daggerdale since before the founding of the human settlement of Dagger Falls . Organization . The clan was led by its chieftain in most matters but the chief priest of Dumathoin also carried a great deal of authority in the clan .

title: Clan Bukbukken
description: Clan Bukbukken Clan Bukbukken was the name of the clan of Duergar that worshiped Shimmergloom the shadow dragon . Physical description . Like most Duergar , the clan had grey skin and stocky features .

title: Clan Delzimmer
description: Clan Delzimmer Clan Delzimmer was a dwarven clan from Delzimmer . The Delzimmer clan ' s Waterdeep townhouse , as of 1374 DR , was an opulent four - storey building on Swords Street , adjacent to Sapphire House . Adjoining to the north was Sablehearth , the Irlingstar mansion .

title: Clan Duergar
description: Clan Duergar Clan Duergar was a shield dwarf clan of Shanatar whose members were eventually enslaved by the illithid s and became the duergar , a race of gray dwarves . History . The Clan was one of many who splintered off to form a new kingdom in the early days of Shanatar , venerating Laduguer in a strict theocracy , naming it Barakuir .

title: Clan Forgebar
description: Clan Forgebar Clan Forgebar was a savage dwarven family of around seventy hill dwarves who lived in caves in Mount Galardrym in the Sword Mountains . History . Around 1372 DR , the clan launched three attacks on the nearby gnome settlement of Ieirithymbul , but each time they came close to total elimination due to the gold dragon Palarandusk , the " Unseen Protector " .

title: Clan Hammerhand
description: Clan Hammerhand Clan Hammerhand was a shield dwarf clan of both Ravens Bluff in the Vast , and of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn and the Earthroot region of the Underdark . History . The Hammerhands wee a clan with a long history , being well established in Earthfast of old and in Sarbreen before it fell in the Year of the Bloody Crown , 649 DR .

title: Clan Herlinga
description: Clan Herlinga Clan Herlinga was a dwarven clan who occupied Hagga Shan in the Hordelands . Activities . These red - bearded dwarves lived in caves on the west side of Hagga Shan , which they referred to as the " Glittering Spires .

title: Clan Ironeater
description: Clan Ironeater Clan Ironeater was a dwarven clan who spent centuries guarding some of the otherwise empty holds of Illefarn from intruders . History . With the demise of Phalorm in 615 DR the demihuman defenders of that realm were no more .

title: Clan Ironstar
description: Clan Ironstar Clan Ironstar was a dwarven clan whose realm was founded in - 2919 DR beneath Firstpeak , Secondpeak and Thirdpeak , also known as " Ironstar Mountain " , " Northlook " and " Wyrmtongue " . Organization . The clan sign was a white four - pointed star on top of a black anvil .

title: Clan Karuck
description: Clan Karuck Clan Karuck was a small group of ogrillon s that resided in the Underdark beneath the Spine of the World . History . In 1372 DR , Toogwik Tuk communicated with the clan leader , Grguch , and brought the tribe to the surface .

title: Clan Melairkyn
description: Clan Melairkyn Clan Melairkyn was an ancient dwarven clan of artisans , explorers , and traders . When King Melair I discovered deposits of mithral in the rock beneath Mount Waterdeep in - 1288 DR , the area was rapidly expanded into Melairbode , later known as Undermountain . Their home was under increasing threat from the drow over the course of the centuries , until a huge attack in 34 DR killed King Melair IV , who was their ruler at the time , and forced them deeper into the mountain .

title: Clan Nornglast
description: Clan Nornglast Clan Nornglast was an extinct noble house of Eskorn . History . Clan Nornglast was one of the most prominent clans of Eskorn , and its members were the founders of the " Royal Keep " of the same name .

title: Clan Roaryl
description: Clan Roaryl Clan Roaryl was a noble house of Eskorn , and the ruling dynasty of the kingdom as of 1479 DR . History . Clan Roaryl was founded by the legendary hero Aunglass Roaryl after he defeated the dragon Eskornamundyr .

title: Clan Wilddragon
description: Clan Wilddragon Clan Wilddragon was an extinct noble house of Eskorn . History . Clan Wilddragon was one of the dynasties that ruled Eskorn centuries before the Spellplague .

title: Clan Xornbane
description: Clan Xornbane Clan Xornbane was a duergar mercenary band in the Underdark that was led by Khorrl Xornbane . Description . Clan Xornbane consisted of several thousand duergar .

title: Clangeddin Silverbeard
description: Clangeddin Silverbeard Clangeddin Silverbeard , pronounced ( " clan " - gedh - din " sihl " - vur - beard ) , was the dwarven deity of battle and honour in warfare . He was known as the the Father of Battle and the Lord of the Twin Axes . His holy symbol was two crossed battleaxes .

title: Clangor
description: Clangor Clangor , also known as Acheron , is a plane of eternal battle . Armies of goblin and kobold petitioners , often led by barghests , clash in struggle , only to be resurrected the following dawn and start the battle again , over and over . It is the home plane of Hruggek , Kurtulmak and Maglubiyet .

title: Clargannuth ( family )
description: Clargannuth ( family ) The Clargannuth family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , where common folk believed the Twelvefold families held uncountable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Clariburnus Tanthul
description: Clariburnus Tanthul Clariburnus Tanthul was one of the Twelve Princes of Shade who led Netheril . In charge of Shadovar operations in New Neverwinter , Clariburnus led the Netherese in an attempt to restore Xinlenal , and the first Mythallar , to Toril . Personality .

title: Clarion
description: Clarion Clarion was a male adult silver dragon . History . He helped Queen Dagnabbet of Mithral Hall transport an elite strike team of six dwarven warriors , who were charged with carrying out a mission on behalf of the Lords ' Alliance , to disable the strongholds of cloud giant s that floated throughout the North .

title: Clarity of mind
description: Clarity of mind Clarity of mind was an abjuration spell that warded against spells affecting perception . Effect . The caster granted the subject the insight to defend against spells from the charm ( " charm monster " ) , compulsion ( " dominate animal " ) , or glamer ( " change self " ) subschools of magic .

title: Clarry
description: Clarry Clarry was a blended wine crafted in Faerûn . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Claugiyliamatar
description: Claugiyliamatar Claugiyliamatar was a green dragon who tried to influence the politics of Waterdeep and Neverwinter through her own criminal gang . Personality . Claugiyliamatar was always fascinated by powerful elven and human females and the spells that transformed dragon s into humans .

title: Claw ( kuo - toa )
description: Claw ( kuo - toa ) The Claw was a male half - fiend kuo - toa and the leader of a small sect of kuo - toa in the Shrine of the Claw on the Lake of Shadows . Description . Unlike others of his kind , the Claw ' s teeth protruded from his mouth and his eyes glowed with an unearthly radiance .

title: Claw ( organization )
description: Claw ( organization ) The Claw were a mercenary company based in Evermoors . Tactics . Usually , the Claw had no true organization , with basic tactics but their regenerative abilities proved to be very effective .

title: Claw Hollow
description: Claw Hollow Claw Hollow was one of the People of the Black Blood hideouts in the Silver Marches . Geography . Claw Hollow was located in the northern reach of the Moonwood .

title: Claw bracer
description: Claw bracer An orc ish claw bracer is the signature weapon of Luthic . She fights bare - handed with her claws because only the males of the community are allowed to wield a weapon . In passive respect to the Cave Mother , males ignore the use of a claw bracer .

title: Claw of Malar
description: Claw of Malar The Claw of Malar was a potent artifact associated with the god Malar the Beastlord . Description . The Claw of Malar was an actual humanoid right hand , with gray skin and long , pointed fingernails .

title: Claw of the revenancer
description: Claw of the revenancer The claw of the revenancer was an enchanted silver gauntlet that had the distinction of being an artifact of the drow goddess Kiaransalee . It was famously wielded by the high priestess , Irae T ' sarran during the the Silence of Lolth . Description .

title: Clawrift
description: Clawrift The Clawrift was a deep , dark chasm in the center of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . . Description .

title: Claws of Malar
description: Claws of Malar Claws of Malar were unique claw bracer s that belonged to followers of Malar and were used in ritualistic hunts , ceremonies , and as personal weapons . Description . Typically created by the carrier , they were fashioned to mimic clawed beast paws , such as lion , tiger , or bear .

title: Claws of the savage
description: Claws of the savage Claws of the savage is a transmutation spell that replaces the touched creature ' s hands with sickle - like claws . Effect . The caster grants one creature two long claws that replace its hands , tentacle tips , or whatever else is appropriate .

title: Clay golem
description: Clay golem Clay golems were human - shaped construct s modeled out of clay that were usually divinely infused with a spirit from the Elemental Plane of Earth by priests . Since clay was a weak vessel for life , damaged clay golems tended to release the spirit bound to them and would go berserk until completely destroyed or repaired .

title: Clayton Emery
description: Clayton Emery Clayton Emery has been a blacksmith , a dishwasher , a schoolteacher in Australia , a carpenter , a zookeeper , a farmhand , a land surveyor , and a volunteer firefighter , among other things . He was an award - winning technical writer for ten years . His novels include " Tales of Robin Hood " ; " Shadow World # 1 : The Burning Goddess " and " Shadow World # 3 : City of Assassins " ; the Whispering Woods trilogy for " Magic : The Gathering " ; the Robin & Marian stories in Ellery Queen ' s " Mystery Magazine " , and other works .

title: Cleanse water
description: Cleanse water Cleanse water was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell purified a body of water , removing all poisons , toxins , salt , or any other unpleasant or armful effects .

title: Clear Whirl River
description: Clear Whirl River The Clear Whirl River was the major river of the kingdom of Hartsvale . Description . The river was cold and often full of ice .

title: Clear path
description: Clear path Clear path was an alteration spell that cleared a corridor in front of the caster as he or she traveled through rough terrain . The reverse of this spell , called clutter path , obfuscated the terrain behind the caster , covering any tracks . Effects .

title: Clearflow River
description: Clearflow River The Clearflow River was located in the Hordelands near the Lake of Mists . Geography . The Clearflow River flowed south from the Lake of Mists across the Great Amber Steppes until it connected with the River Murghol .

title: Clearlight
description: Clearlight The Clearlight temple was a run - down temple of Tymora in Luskan . The temple took its name from the large stained glass window in the roof which , as of 1480 DR , was the only know glass window remaining in Luskan . The temple was used as the headquarters of the Coin Spinners gang and was heavily reinforced so that it resembled a fortress and the complex was heavily guarded .

title: Cleiophane
description: Cleiophane Cleiophane ( sometimes misspelled as " clelophane " ) was a variety of ( also known as or ) that often yielded large specimens of gemstone quality . Description . Sphalerite was a mineral that occurred in crystals of yellow , orange , red , and brown .

title: Cleric
description: Cleric A cleric was a divine servant of one or more gods , serving them with martial might and divine magic fueled by their own strength of faith . As agents of a divine authority , clerics were empowered both by ritual training and their god ' s particular favor . Relatively rare , clerics inspired both reverence and terror , depending on their aims and who they serve .

title: Cli lyre
description: Cli lyre A Cli lyre was a masterwork magic lyre and one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Cli lyres " were superior in every way to ordinary lyres .

title: Clicking Heels
description: Clicking Heels Clicking Heels was a hamlet on the southern slopes of the Spine of the World , northeast of Mithral Hall . Description . It consisted of a cluster of houses surrounded by a piled stone wall .

title: Cliffs of Leaping Horses
description: Cliffs of Leaping Horses The Cliffs of Leaping Horses were a series of plains and hills located in northern Mulhorand . The region was known for its large equine population . Geography .

title: Cliffs of Tanghai
description: Cliffs of Tanghai The Cliffs of Tanghai were a series of cliffs or bluffs beside the Hungtse River in Shou Lung . Inscribed with the teachings of the Path of Enlightenment by the Celestial Emperor himself , they were a holy site of the faith and the surest evidence of the existence of the Celestial Heaven . Geography .

title: Cliffside Cranny
description: Cliffside Cranny The Cliffside Cranny was a hole in Luskan ' s wall created by an earthquake that occurred around 1460 DR . The cranny was assessable by foot or boat and served as an unofficial city gate . In 1480 DR the cranny was guarded by Waterdavian guardsmen assigned to keep plague victims from leaving Luskan .

title: Climbing irons
description: Climbing irons Climbing irons were leg attachments used to make climbing wooden surfaces easier . Uses . Climbing irons were metal rods that attached to the lower leg .

title: Cloak Wood
description: Cloak Wood Cloak Wood , also stylized as Cloakwood , was an ancient , thickly grown forest in the Western Heartlands region on the south end of the Sword Coast . Description . Cloak Wood was a thickly overgrown ancient forest .

title: Cloak from undead
description: Cloak from undead Cloak from undead was an alteration spell that made one individual invisible to the undead . Effects . Similar to the priest spell " invisibility to undead " , the affected person or creature could move and operate with impunity near undead , as long as they took no hostile action , including attempts to turn them .

title: Cloak of Gathering Shadows
description: Cloak of Gathering Shadows The Cloak of Gathering Shadows was a ritual used by sha ' ir s to grant their gen the ability to hide within shadows with ease . Preparation . This ritual required a spider web found beneath the shadow of a rock .

title: Cloak of bravery
description: Cloak of bravery Cloak of bravery was a divine conjuration spell that protected up to four creatures from all forms of fear . The reverse of this spell , known as cloak of fear , gave one creature an aura of fear . Effects .

title: Cloak of chaos
description: Cloak of chaos Cloak of chaos was an abjuration spell that granted magical armor and magical resistance . Effect . A random pattern of color surrounded the subjects , protecting them from attacks , granting them resistance to spells cast by lawful creatures , and confusing lawful creatures when they struck the subjects .

title: Cloak of dark power
description: Cloak of dark power Cloak of dark power was an abjuration spell unique to cleric s with the Drow domain . It created a haze around the subject to counteract the effects of sunlight on the drow . Effect .

title: Cloak of elvenkind
description: Cloak of elvenkind A cloak of elvenkind was a magical item that granted increased powers of stealth . The " jellaba of concealment " functioned in the same manner as a " cloak of elvenkind " . This magical robe originated in Zakhara .

title: Cloak of the crow
description: Cloak of the crow The cloak of the crow was an enchanted cloak worn by Dahlia Sin ' felle . Physcial description . The " cloak of the crow " was a high - collared black cape that could transform its wear into a giant crow .

title: Cloak undead
description: Cloak undead Cloak undead was a necromancy or divination spell that made all undead within a certain radius invisible . The earliest version of this spell could be cast in reverse as " detect undead " . Effects .

title: Cloaked sniper
description: Cloaked sniper Cloaked snipers are a variety of rogue s who specialize in making highly accurate , long - ranged strikes . Prized by kings and kingpins alike , cloaked snipers are adept at slaying their enemies with little risk of retaliation .
