Through stealth and deadly accuracy , cloaked snipers , wielding their favored crossbow s , are sometimes as valuable as a company of lesser archers .

title: Cloaker
description: Cloaker Cloakers were intelligent creatures that dwelt underground and resembled large flying manta rays when active . At rest , they looked like a black cloak , hence their name . Although they were usually found in a flock of twelve or fewer individuals , they were thought to have built the Underdark city Ikemmu Cloakers often waited in ambush for their prey and generally attempted to engulf an opponent with their wings .

title: Cloaker Wars
description: Cloaker Wars The Cloaker Wars occurred around - 10800 DR when Taark Shanat ' s dwarves ( migrating west from Bhaerynden ) engaged the inhabitants of Rringlor Noroth . This included four blue dragons occupying the Rift of Dhalnadar who were all slain by Taark , bringing a victory for the dwarves . Alatorin and its famous Brightaxe Hall was established on this site .

title: Clockwork mage
description: Clockwork mage Clockwork mages , or mechanicians were unique wizard s in Zakhara who focused on building magical constructs instead of practicing traditional spellcraft . Requirements . Clockwork mages not only had to possess high intelligence , but they also needed to be gifted with dextrous fingers to manipulate the fine workings of their machines .

title: Cloister of St . Uzurr
description: Cloister of St . Uzurr The Cloister of St . Uzurr was a temple of Ilmater that lay at the heart of city of Uzurr in Lapaliiya and was home to the Order of St .

title: Clone
description: Clone Clone was a necromancy spell that created a clone of a creature . Effect . The " clone " spell effectively made a dormant clone from a 1 cubic inch of flesh in 120 days within an appropriately sized container .

title: Clothes for the Enlightened
description: Clothes for the Enlightened Clothes for the Enlightened was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This shop was actually a pair of large red - striped pavilion tents .

title: Clothiers ' District
description: Clothiers ' District The Clothiers ' District was the center for all industry revolving around cloth in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Located within the Clothiers ' Quarter , this district was by far the most aromatic part of Huzuz .

title: Clothiers ' Quarter
description: Clothiers ' Quarter The Clothiers ' Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Clothiers ' Quarter encompassed the Clothiers ' District , Merchants ' District , and the seedy Northwest District , forming the west and northwest portion of the city .

title: Clothiers ' Way
description: Clothiers ' Way Clothiers ' Way was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Clothiers ' Way branched off of the South Road at the Gulf Gate , entering Huzuz from the south and passing northeast between the Peasants ' District , Northwest District and Clothiers ' District before terminating at the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .

title: Cloud Crown Palace
description: Cloud Crown Palace Cloud Crown Palace was the finest example of Evereska ' s natural architecture . The palace resembled a stand of bluetop s packed so closely together that the huge boles grew into each other . The scaling on the bark was so expertly done that even a practiced sculptor ' s eye would not have known it was stone , it was a place of mighty defensive magics and ancient towers .

title: Cloud Peaks
description: Cloud Peaks The Cloud Peaks were a range of mountains in West Faerûn , and they marked the northern border of Amn . Sportsmen and - women who could afford the cost would use the cliffs of the range for rock climbing . Geography .

title: Cloud Wizard
description: Cloud Wizard Cloud Wizard was a powerful wizard among the vile yak - folk of the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being one of the most powerful wizards among the yikarians , Cloud Wizard was also a member of the Seven Sages and the appointed governor of the Fiend ' s Wing province within the Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Cloud giant
description: Cloud giant Cloud giants were a race of giant s who preferred living among the clouds . Description . Cloud giants ' skin ranged in color from milky white to light sky blue .

title: Cloud of daggers
description: Cloud of daggers Cloud of daggers was a simple spell learned by some wizard s . Upon casting the wizards " cloud of daggers " conjured a cloud of small , flying daggers of force within an area of roughly five feet in diameter , within fifty feet of the caster . These daggers cut to shreds anything in their path , though they were weak enough that more powerful foes may be lightly harmed .

title: Cloud palace
description: Cloud palace A cloud palace or cloud castle was an abode of cloud giant s kept floating on a single large cloud by magic . Description . A cloud palace was like any other cloud giant castle , only it was constructed upon a magical , solid cloud .

title: Cloudkill
description: Cloudkill Cloudkill was a conjuration or evocation spell that filled an area with a extremely lethal cloud . Effect . " Cloudkill " would release a yellowish green cloud that was heavier than air so it would always sink to the ground or into holes .

title: Cloudtop Tower
description: Cloudtop Tower Cloudtop Tower is the second highest spire within the city of Evereska . It is built from white marble and made to resemble a stand of blueleaf trees . It is home to the High Magi of the Cloudtop Circle , advisers to the Council of Hill Elders and commanders of the Spell Guard .

title: Cloven Mountains
description: Cloven Mountains The Cloven Mountains were a wide and barren mountain range rising from the waters of the Deepwash . Geography . The range ran from east to west and was split in two by the Wintercloak River , which was how the mountains received their name .

title: Cloven Shield
description: Cloven Shield The Cloven Shield was a loud inn and tavern in Marsember , Cormyr . Geography . The tavern was situated on the island immediately south of Morningmist Hall in the Cormyrian area .

title: Club
description: Club The club is one of the oldest weapons known . Any blunt object that can be swung with force enough to cause damage can be considered a club . They are considered simple , one - handed melee weapons .

title: Clusterfang
description: Clusterfang Clusterfang was a poor translation into Common of a particular deepspawn ' s given name . It operated in the southern Sword Coast and Vilhon Reach regions in concert with the Twisted Rune . No one who knew of its existence could guess at why Clusterfang had allied itself with this organization of evil magic - users , but it obviously saw some benefit of doing so .

title: Clyde Caldwell
description: Clyde Caldwell Clyde Caldwell is an American artist and self - described fantasy illustrator . Originally a commercial illustrator for ad agencies , he gained fame working for TSR , Inc . from 1982 to 1992 , illustrating many products at a time the game was at the peak of its popularity .

title: Clytemorrenestrix
description: Clytemorrenestrix Clytemorrenestrix , or Nestrix to her human companions , was a mature blue dragon who was changed by the Spellplague into a human woman . History . Pre - Spellplague .

title: Coast Road
description: Coast Road The Coast Road ran along the west coast of the Vast , connecting the cities of Ravens Bluff and Tantras . From south to north , it started at Ravens Bluff , passed over the Fire River via the great multi - span bridge at Mossbridges , and ended at Tantras . On the way , it linked with the High Trail , Feldar ' s Trail , the Tantras Trail , and the Cross Road .

title: Coast Trail
description: Coast Trail The Coast Trail was a alternative to the Trade Way as a means to travel from Calimport to Memnon , avoiding the Calim Desert . As the name suggests , the trail followed the windy coast along the southern and western edges of Calimshan . The path was only wide enough for a single cart and covered rocky terrain , but it was far enough from the effects of Memnon ' s Crackle .

title: Coast Way
description: Coast Way The Coast Way was a long , well - traveled trade road along the west coast of Faerûn . The Coast Way was just a part of the much larger Trade Way that started at Calimport in the south and went along the coastline all the way north to Waterdeep . The section of road between Baldur ' s Gate and Tethyr was generally known as the Coast Way .

title: Coast circle
description: Coast circle The coast circle was a druid circle associated with the transitional region between sea and land , teeming with life of infinite variety , beating with the pulse of waves crashing ashore . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Coaster
description: Coaster A coaster , also known as a round ship , was a medium - sized sailing ship used on the Inner Sea . They were favored by Aglarond , Chessenta , Chondath , and Turmish . Description .

title: Cobble
description: Cobble Cobble was a dwarven cleric in Mithral Hall . Description . He was a squat and round dwarf with a short yellow beard .

title: Cockatrice
description: Cockatrice The cockatrice was a small avian magical beast . It was notorious for its petrification ability . It was closely related to the pyrolisk .

title: Cocoa
description: Cocoa Cocoa was a powdered product from Maztica that was used to prepare a bitter beverage . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Code Helm
description: Code Helm The Code Helm was an organization based on the planet of Glyth around 1359 DR . Activities . Code Helm was focused on destroying the mind flayer s .

title: Codex of Araunt
description: Codex of Araunt The Codex of Araunt was a tract originally recorded on stone tablets by Lod , a bone naga and founder of the Eminence of Araunt . History . More than five - hundred years before the Year of the Ageless One , the codex prophesied the slow expansion of the Eminence in the centuries that followed .

title: Coelenite
description: Coelenite Coelenites were colony creatures that began life as single - celled organisms that grew a hardened shell similar to coral . Rudimentary intelligence was achieved when groups of coelenites lived together as a colony , eventually becoming sentient when enough coelenites gathered . Description .

title: Coffee House of Buri
description: Coffee House of Buri The Coffee House of Buri was a small shop in Bandar al - Sa ' adat in 1367 DR . Location . The establishment was located near Usamah the Carpet Dealer in the Bandar al - Sa ' adat marketplace .

title: Coffee ceremony
description: Coffee ceremony The coffee ceremony was a crucial social interaction among Zakharans . All Zakharans , from a wealthy Al - Hadhar all the way to a free - roaming Al - Badia , were appraised by their peers for their coffee - making . Unless a woman was the master of the house or tent , this was typically a man ' s responsibility .

title: Cog
description: Cog A cog was a small , one masted sailing ship used on the Sea of Fallen Stars . Another ship , also called a cog , had two masts and was a larger version of the coaster . Description .

title: Coggin ' s Rise
description: Coggin ' s Rise Coggin ' s Rise was a trail that ran through the hills from Stagwick to Castle Hartwick . The hills in the region were covered with white - barked aspen trees . It took between a half hour and an hour to travel the full distance by horse .

title: Cognition thief
description: Cognition thief A cognition thief was a psionicist who specialized in espionage via psionics and was a member of the Hall of Mental Splendor . Culture . Cognition thieves were psychic spies who specialized in raiding the minds of their targets to rob them of their secret thoughts and even their wits .

title: Coiled Cabal
description: Coiled Cabal The Coiled Cabal is a secret society of arcane spellcasters dominated by the Hss ' tafin , but draws members from all the great houses of the yuan - ti . Though the " vrael olo " do not consider it an independent tribe in its own right , it is often treated like one in intertribal politics , especially since membership requires that loyalty to the society take precedence over tribal allegiances . Symbol .

title: Coiled dragon
description: Coiled dragon The coiled dragon was a magical chalice . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description .

title: Coin Spinners
description: Coin Spinners The Coin Spinners were a Luskan street gang that was based in the old Clearlight temple of Tymora . The Coin Spinners were active at least as early as 1475 DR . The gang took its name from the coin that symbolized the goddess and its symbol was a coin that incorporated both Tymora ' s and Beshaba ' s symbols .

title: Cold Field
description: Cold Field The Cold Field was a flat , treeless moor located south of Cormanthor and Velarswood between Harrowdale and Scardale . Description . The Cold Field was a battlefield haunted by ghosts of soldiers .

title: Cold Heart
description: Cold Heart Cold Heart was the favored weapon of Kiaransalee , the drow goddess of undeath . Description . It was a curved dagger that constantly dripped acid .

title: Cold Vale
description: Cold Vale The Cold Vale was a wild and desolate region between the southern edge of the Cold Wood and the northern spur of the Rauvin Mountains . Geography . The Cold Vale was located between the Cold Wood ( later the Glimmerwood ) to the north and the Rauvin Mountains to the south .

title: Cold Wood
description: Cold Wood The Cold Wood was a forest on the edge of the Silver Marches . By about 1460 DR , the Moonwood had grown together with the Cold Wood and the larger forest was known as the Glimmerwood . Geography .

title: Cold domain
description: Cold domain The Cold domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters cold - themed spell s and powers . The spellcaster gained the abilities to rebuke and command cold creatures and to turn and destroy fire creatures . Deities with the Cold domain .

title: Cold fire
description: Cold fire Cold fire was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It could temporarily change hot flames into cold , or damage a cold - sensitive creature . Effects .

title: Cold iron
description: Cold iron Cold iron is forged at a lower temperature than normal iron or steel , in order to preserve its properties . It is mined deep underground , and famed for its efficacy against fey creatures . Cold iron weapons cost twice as much as their standard counterparts .

title: Cold snap
description: Cold snap Cold snap was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused a dramatic drop in temperature over a wide area that lasted for hours . Effects .

title: Colderan Morn
description: Colderan Morn Colderan Morn was a male human wizard and once a tyrannical Mage - lord of Daggerdale . He was also the great - grandfather of the famous Randal Morn . Description .

title: Colin McComb
description: Colin McComb Colin McComb is an author and game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . and . Education .

title: Coliseum ( Maerimydra )
description: Coliseum ( Maerimydra ) The Coliseum was an enormous structure built by the drow of Maerimydra to entertain the masses with battles between slaves , prisoners , and exotic beasts . Location . Located in the southern end of Maerimydra , the coliseum was more than half a mile from northern entrance to the city .

title: Collector
description: Collector Collectors are a special type of scavenger found in the city of Sigil . They and their group focus on the recovery of bodies on the streets and understreets of Sigil . Their leader was Pharod until his slaying by the shades that chased the Nameless One .

title: College of the Eclipse
description: College of the Eclipse The College of the Eclipse was a society of psionicist s dedicated to the teaching of psionics , based in the city of Riatavin in Tethyr and active in the mid - 1370s DR . Base of Operations . The College ' s headquarters in Riatavin were described as like a fortress .

title: Color spray
description: Color spray Color spray was a spell used by wizard s that , when cast , created a vivid cone or fan shape of clashing colors which sprang forth from the caster ' s hand or implement . Enemies hit were not only injured lightly by the sheer power of the magical light , but are also dazed into a momentary stupor . Prior to the Spellplague , the spell was more versatile and could cause creatures to become stunned , blinded , or possibly knock them unconscious .

title: Colson
description: Colson Colson was the adopted daughter of Wulfgar and Delly Curtie who Wulfgar saved from the small town of Auckney . She was originally the daughter of Meralda Ganderlay , Lady of Auckney , and Jaka Sculi . History .

title: Colstan Rhuul
description: Colstan Rhuul Colstan Rhuul was an Illuskan human cleric of Bane and one of the most trusted agents of the Xanathar , the leader of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . History . Colstan was a cleric of Bane , but he briefly turned to Cyric , before coming back to Bane when his god returned in 1372 DR .

title: Combat readiness
description: Combat readiness Combat readiness enables the subject to act more rapidly in combat . Effect . When the spell is cast , the subject ' s eyes widen and briefly shine white .

title: Combat sphere
description: Combat sphere The Combat sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , crusader s , and monk s that could be used to smite their foes . Appendix . Notes .

title: Combat veteran
description: Combat veteran Combat veterans are experienced and battle - hardened warlord s who have been through perils that should have killed them and lived to tell the tale . As a result , combat veterans have a measure of training earned not through study or practice , but actual experience on the battlefield , giving them an unusually improvised methodology that has proven very effective at keeping them alive . While combat veterans might not be as inspirational in a purely charismatic way as some warlords , they exude confidence in their men just by the very fact that , no matter what the world has thrown at them , the combat veteran still stands ready for battle .

title: Combine
description: Combine Combine was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to temporarily increase his or her effective level with respect to turning undead and casting spells . This required the help of two to four additional priests . Effects .

title: Comet K ' Thoutek
description: Comet K ' Thoutek K ' Thoutek is a large comet in Realmspace that circumnavigates the sun in an extremely elliptical orbit . Its only remaining inhabitant of a once large group of oortling s is their greatest wizard , now an undead haunt bent on revenge against the illithid s who destroyed the colony . The appearance of comet K ' Thoutek is seen as a sign for the birth of a powerful person by astronomers on Toril .

title: Command
description: Command Command was an enchantment spell that forced one subject to briefly obey a one - word command . Effects . The command word had to be given in a language the subject could understand and the effect lasted for only one minute .

title: Command element
description: Command element Command element was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . There were four versions of this spell , one for each of the elements .

title: Command monster
description: Command monster Command monster was a divine enchantment spell , similar to " command " , that forced one creature to obey a one - word order . Effects . This spell was similar to the beginning level " command " spell but it did not require the caster to know a language understood by the target , was harder to resist , and it had greater range ( 60 yd / 55 m ) and duration .

title: Command water spirits
description: Command water spirits Command water spirits was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell did not actually allow the caster to command water spirits , instead it allowed them to manipulate the currents of large bodies of water to move objects on or under the surface .

title: Command word
description: Command word A command word , or a trigger word is a word that needs to be spoken aloud to activate a magical effect . A command word or words can be any word . Though common words are often avoided as to avoid activating a magical effect accidentally .

title: Commander ' s ring
description: Commander ' s ring A commander ' s ring was a magic + 2 ring that was made by the War Wizards of Cormyr for their military commanders . Three times a day each , the ring could produce the effects of " daylight " , " feather fall " , " knock " , and " wall of force " , but only when the correct command word was uttered . If a purple dragon ring was worn on the same hand as this ring , they were treated as one ring .

title: Commani
description: Commani The Commani were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Commani lived in the southwestern region of the Endless Waste .

title: Commani language
description: Commani language Commani was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the western Hordelands . Description . Like other languages in the same region , Commani had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds .

title: Commarth
description: Commarth Commarth was the commander of the border armies of Sembia but he was also one of the Wearers of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon . History . As leader of the Cult he was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR , and was in his position in 1369 DR .

title: Common
description: Common Common was the trade language of Faerûn . Almost every sentient , civilized being spoke a smattering of it , and most were fluent . While most could not read or write the language , generally , the people of Faerûn were able to converse with each other in this language .

title: Common bloodrose
description: Common bloodrose The common bloodrose was a flowering plant that could be found growing in the Rose Garden of the Battle of Bones . Description . This plant produced medium sized flowers that were the color of blood .

title: Common dictionary
description: Common dictionary Most players in our world simply use Common as a direct translation from whatever language they speak . However , certain words are different , as demonstrated by the following list . A .

title: Commune
description: Commune Commune was a divination spell that allowed a priest to ask yes or no questions of his or her deity . Effects . By means of this spell , the caster was put in contact with his or her deity , either directly or through a proxy , agent , or servant .

title: Commune with nature
description: Commune with nature Commune with nature was a divination spell that allowed the caster to learn about the surrounding terrain for a few miles / kilometers . The more advanced the caster , the further the effect . Effects .

title: Community domain
description: Community domain The Community domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters community spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Community Domain Powers .

title: Community of the high brows
description: Community of the high brows The " community of the high brows " was a mountain giant tribe dwelling in the Orbrekh in the Orsraun Mountains of Turmish . Organization . The community of the high brows was led by Oogle , its shaman , in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR .

title: Companions Codex
description: Companions Codex The Companions Codex is a series of novels by R . A . Salvatore featuring Drizzt Do ' Urden and the reborn Companions of the Hall .

title: Companions of the Hall
description: Companions of the Hall The Companions of the Hall was the unofficial name for the adventurers who retook and subsequently defended Mithral Hall . The members consisted of King Bruenor Battlehammer , Drizzt Do ' Urden and his companion Guenhwyvar , and Catti - brie , Wulfgar and Regis . Ivan and Pikel Bouldershoulder were also usually included as members due to their extensive help in defending Mithral Hall from Obould Many - Arrows , as was Thibbledorf Pwent , Bruenor ' s bodygard .

title: Companions of the Noble Heart
description: Companions of the Noble Heart The Companions of the Noble Heart were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to the faith of Ilmater , the One Who Endures . Activities . The Companions of the Noble Heart had the duty of seeking out destroying the cruel , those people who tortured and enjoyed the suffering of others .

title: Companions of the Pallid Mask
description: Companions of the Pallid Mask The Companions of the Pallid Mask were a group of Jergal ' s priests who specialized in combating and commanding the undead . They eliminated the undead creatures whose existance was not sanctioned by the church or who had proven to be troublesome . They also were the supervisors of the skeleton and zombie work crews that the church sometimes ran to profit itself .

title: Company of Crazed Venturers
description: Company of Crazed Venturers The Company of Crazed Venturers was one of Waterdeep ' s most famous adventuring groups . Exploits . The Company of Crazed Venturers was involved in many activities in and around Waterdeep .

title: Company of Eight
description: Company of Eight The Company of Eight was a band of adventurers based out of Tethyr during the time of the Tethyrian Interregnum . They were dedicated to freedom , justice , and peace . Organization .

title: Company of Hunnar
description: Company of Hunnar The Company of Hunnar were a mercenary company based in Riatavin in Amn around 1358 DR , specialized in siege warfare , usually in concert with other mercenary units . Organization . Membership .

title: Company of the Anvil
description: Company of the Anvil The Company of the Anvil were a one - time adventuring company around Tethyr in 1370 DR . Organization . The Company of the Anvil was composed by Bramas Thorntree , gathering old allies specifically in order to recover the " Sondarr Scepter " .

title: Company of the Bright Spear
description: Company of the Bright Spear The Company of the Bright Spear was a band of mercenaries . History . The group was decimated in a battle with a large party of cult members .

title: Company of the Red Dawn
description: Company of the Red Dawn The Company of the Red Dawn was an adventuring company responsible for an attack on the vampire Noreyth Harpell and his associates in 1315 DR . They were recruited and sent by Artor Morlin , the Baron of Blood , to kill Noreyth . Noreyth , his servant Dhusarra yr Fadila el Abhuk , and two other Malar ites were ambushed on the Storeroom Level of Undermountain .

title: Company of the Scorpions
description: Company of the Scorpions The Company of the Scorpions was a military unit in the Zhentilar army before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . The first commander was Tyzack , a paranoid man living in fear of people discovering that in his youth he had briefly rebelled against the Zhentarim .

title: Company of the Singing Dawn
description: Company of the Singing Dawn The Company of the Singing Dawn were a mercenary company based in Chondath around 1358 DR . Organization . The Company was divided into five units : Solara ' s Elite , fighters from the Fields of Nun ; the Spears of Dawn , fighters ; the Forester Guards of Nun , charismatic and chivalrous warriors from the Chondalwood ; the Lightblades , paladins mounted on pegasi ; and the Sunshafts , pegasus - riding elven archers .

title: Company of the White Star
description: Company of the White Star The Company of the White Star was an adventuring company started by Araevin Teshurr to explore the ruins of ancient elven sites . When its members disbanded in 1356 DR , Araevin gave them all a star - shaped pendant that would act as a conduit in case he needed to call them together again . The company was reformed in Ches 1374 DR and consisted of Araevin , his partner Ilsevele Miritar , former member Grayth Holmfast , Grayth ' s squire , Brant Rethalshield , and Maresa Rost , daughter of the former member Theleda .

title: Company of the Wolf ( mercenary group )
description: Company of the Wolf ( mercenary group ) The Company of the Wolf were a disbanded mercenary company . History . Around 1358 DR , the Company of the Wolf worked well protecting merchants from the Sword Coast to the Sea of Fallen Stars for two decades until their leaders went with a crazy idea : to assault and destroy Zhentil Keep .

title: Compass rose
description: Compass rose Compass roses were magical compasses that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These small tracking devices had a piece shaped like a rose and a clear medallion with the cardinal directions clearly marked .

title: Compelled duel
description: Compelled duel Compelled duel was an enchantment spell that by divine command compelled a duel with a target . Effect . The caster would compel a duel with a target within 30 feet ( 9 .

title: Complete Champion
description: Complete Champion New options for heroes with a divine cause . Complete Champion focuses on the divine champion archetype and provides new rules options for characters who enjoy battling for a cause , defeating foes using divine power , and going on quests that mean more than simply defeating the bad guy and grabbing the treasure . This book also helps Dungeon Masters run quest - themed campaigns and adventures .

title: Comprehend languages
description: Comprehend languages Comprehend languages was a divination spell that let one temporarily understand all written and spoken languages . Effects . With this spell the caster could understand a text that was otherwise incomprehensible to him or her .

title: Compulsion
description: Compulsion Compulsion was an enchantment spell that charmed a target and by will of the caster would move in a direction . Effect . The caster attempted to charm targets that she could see or that could hear her .

title: Conaluil range
description: Conaluil range The Conaluil range was a strip of land located in central Dambrath . Geography . Nestled between the Great Swamp of Rethild to the west and the Bay of Dancing Dolphins to the east , the Conaluil range ran north to south .

title: Conbert
description: Conbert Conbert was a Red Plumes mercenary in the Moonsea . Activities . Conbert was one of the soldiers assigned to the garrison in the Waydown .

title: Concettina Delcasio
description: Concettina Delcasio Concettina was the seventh wife of King Yarin Frostmantle and queen of the Bloodstone Lands . Description . In 1484 DR , Concettina was in her early 20s , three decades younger than her husband the king .

title: Concordant Opposition
description: Concordant Opposition The plane of Concordant Opposition was the center of the Great Wheel of Outer Planes . It connected to all other Outer Planes and was truly neutral in alignment . Other names for this plane were the Outlands , Godsland and Friendly Opposition .

title: Condemnation
description: Condemnation Condemnation by Richard Baker is the third book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The group of drow adventurers - - Quenthel Baenre , Pharaun Mizzrym , Jeggred Baenre , Halisstra Melarn , Danifae Yauntyrr , Ryld Argith , and Valas Hune - - are continuing to seek answers for Silence of Lolth .

title: Cone of cold
description: Cone of cold Cone of cold , formerly known as Veridon ' s cone , was an evocation spell that froze all enemies in front of the caster . Users . " Cone of cold " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold or ocean domain s .

title: Conflagration
description: Conflagration Conflagration was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell set a living target ablaze , burning at least the first layer of flesh from its body .

title: Confluence
description: Confluence The Confluence were a loose , secret association of half – steel dragon s based in Waterdeep with the purpose of eliminating all shapechanger s that tried to enter the City of Splendors . Its primary enemy in 1374 DR was the Unseen . Relationships .

title: Confrontation at Candlekeep
description: Confrontation at Candlekeep Confrontation at Candlekeep is a Dungeons & Dragons 5th edition playtest module that was released to RPGA Dungeon Masters at " Gen Con Indy 2013 " . It was released publicly over two years later as a PDF download for a modest fee . Acting as a prequel to Ed Greenwood ' s " The Herald " novel , Ed was consulted in the module ' s creation .

title: Confusion
description: Confusion Confusion was an enchantment spell that made the subject behave oddly for a while . Effect . The spell could cause a creature or more to do nothing at all , attack the nearest creature , gibber to it self , wander away , the affect was random and so was the number of targets .

title: Congenio Ioun
description: Congenio Ioun Congenio Ioun was a human arcanist and inventor of the ancient empire of Netheril . He was considered the first great arcanist of Netheril , famed for creating the popular magical items known as " ioun stone s " after him , in 397 NY ( −3462 DR ) . Congenio is known to have created at least thirty different types of " ioun stones " .

title: Conjuration
description: Conjuration The conjuration school of arcane magic calls materials , creatures or energy to the caster and can also be reversed to send creatures to other places , either over long distances or even to a whole different plane of existence . A wizard who specialized in conjurations spells is called a conjurer .

title: Conjure air elemental
description: Conjure air elemental Conjure air elemental was a divine magic spell that brought a native from the Elemental Plane of Air to assist the caster . The reverse of this spell , dismiss air elemental , sent the summoned creature back home . Realmslore .

title: Conjure animals
description: Conjure animals Conjure animals was a conjuration spell that summoned fey spirits that took the shape of animals . Effect . The beast or beasts that were formed were considered fey and the caster could decide how the fey spirits ' power would be divided .

title: Conjure barrage
description: Conjure barrage Conjure barrage was a conjuration spell that turned a single non - magical missile into a swarm of them . Effect . The caster fired or throw a single non - magical missile into the air and the spell created a 60 - foot - wide ( 18 .

title: Conjure celestial
description: Conjure celestial Conjure celestial was a conjuration spell that summoned a celestial . Effect . The summoned celestial followed the caster ' s orders as long as they didn ' t go against the creature ' s beliefs .

title: Conjure elemental
description: Conjure elemental Conjure elemental was a conjuration / summoning spell that allowed a wizard to call and control either an air , earth , fire or water elemental . The type of elemental needed to be fixed during memorization and each required a different material component and a certain amount of the respective element . The spell always carried a certain risk that the conjured elemental would break free .

title: Conjure fey
description: Conjure fey Conjure fey was a conjuration spell that summoned a fey . Effect . This spell summoned a fey creature of some power ; the creature considered the caster and its allies friendly .

title: Conjure jungle minions
description: Conjure jungle minions Conjure jungle minions was a divine magic spell available to priest s of the Zakhara n savage goddess Ragarra , and some specialized kahin s . It temporally transformed very young crocodile s into lesser segarran s . Effects .

title: Conjure minor elementals
description: Conjure minor elementals Conjure minor elementals was a conjuration spell that summoned one or multiple minor elemental s . Effect . In casting this spell , the caster could choose to summon up to four minor elementals .

title: Conjure nature elemental
description: Conjure nature elemental Conjure nature elemental was a divine magic spell available to druid s of Chauntea and other priests of nature deities with both the Elemental and Plant sphere s . The spell summoned a nature elemental that removed all traces of civilization in the area of effect . It was an extremely destructive spell with the potential to cause tremendous loss of life and was only granted after careful consideration of the justification and consequences of its use .

title: Conjure sand lion
description: Conjure sand lion Conjure sand lion was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell conjured a female spotted lion that was faithful to the caster .

title: Conjure volley
description: Conjure volley Conjure volley was a conjuration spell that transformed a singe missile into a volley of hundreds of missiles . Effect . After the caster threw or fired a single nonmagical missile weapon into the air and picked an area within 150 feet ( 46 meters ) , the area would be pelted with a volley of hundreds of the same missiles .

title: Conjure woodland beings
description: Conjure woodland beings Conjure woodland beings was a conjuration spell that summoned fey creatures . Effect . Casting this spell , the caster could choose to summon up to four fey creatures .

title: Conner
description: Conner Conner was a human thief and conman in the mid – 14th century DR . He was the mentor of a young Vajra Valmeyjar and guardian of the kittenlord , and his cons embroiled him in the machinations of the gods . History .

title: Connerad Brawnanvil
description: Connerad Brawnanvil Connerad Brawnanvil , son of Banak Brawnanvil , was the 12th King of Mithral Hall and leader of Clan Battlehammer around 1440 DR . Although his name was Brawnanvil , he was of Battlehammer blood and used the name in formal events . History .

title: Conoptora Billon
description: Conoptora Billon Conoptora Billon was a human man of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . Conoptora was a mage and member of the Council , a governing body consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords .

title: Consecrate
description: Consecrate Consecrate blesses an area with positive energy , weakening undead . Effect . Within the area of a " consecrate " effect , a cleric ' s ability to turn undead is boosted .

title: Constable ' s Tower
description: Constable ' s Tower Constable ' s Tower was an imposing keep with a tall tower , standing high over the town of Dagger Falls . Location . The tower stood at the highest point in town within the walls , on the north side , opposite the Forest Gate .

title: Constance Goodroot
description: Constance Goodroot Constance Goodroot was a young farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Constance helped her parents run their beet factory .

title: Constancia Crownsilver
description: Constancia Crownsilver Constancia Crownsilver was a knight of Torm and a member of the noble Crownsilver family of Cormyr . After Brin Crownsilver ' s father was assassinated , she was assigned to look after him . Constancia and Brin were placed in the same Tormite monastery where Constancia apparently flourished although Brin was unhappy .

title: Constellation
description: Constellation A constellation was an arrangement of stars in Realmspace as viewed in the night sky . Significance . Clergy of Mystra , goddess of magic , held a regular ceremony in which they observed various stars and constellations , named them , and gave them reverence .

title: Construct
description: Construct Constructs are either animated objects or any type of artificially constructed creatures . Most constructs are non - intelligent automotons with neither a soul nor a purpose beyond the service of their creator . Because few constructs are truly alive , usually operated only by a " spark " of life , most constructs are immune to attacks that target the living .

title: Construct undead
description: Construct undead Construct undead was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was used by ghul lord s . Effects .

title: Constulgrael
description: Constulgrael Constulgrael was a great wyrm black dragon and the only true dragon to become Magister . He reigned from 983 DR to 986 DR . History .

title: Contact other plane
description: Contact other plane Contact other plane was a divination ritual or spell that mentally connected the caster to a another powerful mind . Effect . Functioning similarly to the " commune " spell , this allowed the caster to contact another powerful mind .

title: Contagion
description: Contagion Contagion was a necromancy spell that inflicted a horrendous disease on a target . Effect . Older versions of the " contagion " spell infected a touched target with a vicious infestation , like boils , lesions , seeping abscesses , blotches , or worse .

title: Contagion ( invocation )
description: Contagion ( invocation ) Contagion is a necrotic spell wielded by warlock s , most commonly of the dark pact . When a warlock casts " contagion " they infect the flesh of one unfortunate creature within fifty feet with a vile poison that mimics the effect of a disease , causing skin lesions , boils , and a fever of the blood that causes deadly injury for several minutes , though a strong or lucky victim might stave it off more quickly . Any immediately nearby enemies are sometimes also infected , though with reduced symptoms .

title: Contingency
description: Contingency Contingency was an evocation spell that allowed a caster to set a trigger for another stored spell . Effect . " Contingency " stored a spell for a long time , ranging from days in older versions to ten days in newer versions .

title: Continual darkness
description: Continual darkness Continual darkness was an alteration spell that created an area of perpetual darkness impermeable to normal light . The reverse of this spell , continual light , created a permanently sun - bright area . Effects .

title: Continual flame
description: Continual flame Continual flame was an evocation spell that created a magical flame . Effect . The flame did not cause any damage or heat and could not be quenched or smothered as it did not need oxygen .

title: Continual light
description: Continual light Continual light was an alteration spell used by both arcane and divine spellcasters to create a permanent area of sun - bright illumination . The reverse of this spell , continual darkness , created the absence of light . Effects .

title: Control undead
description: Control undead Control undead , originally known as Sadebreth ' s undead control , was a necromancy spell that enabled the caster to command one or more undead creatures for a short period of time . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell that were similar but with important differences .

title: Control vapor
description: Control vapor Control vapor was a divine magic spell available to druid s and specialty priests of Eldath , the Mother of the Waters . It gave the caster command of the movement rate and direction of magical and non - magical smokes , vapors , clouds , and mists , including creatures in gaseous form . A less powerful arcane version was known but rare among the wizarding community .

title: Control water
description: Control water Control water , also known as lower water and its reverse , raise water , was a transmutation / alteration spell that allowed the caster to gain some control over a body of water . Effects . The older versions of this spell reduced or increased the water level of a cistern , stream , river , pond , lake , or other body of water .

title: Control weather
description: Control weather Control weather was a transmutation or alteration spell that changed the weather in the local area . Effects . After ten minutes of casting , the weather in a two - mile ( 3 .

title: Control winds
description: Control winds Control winds was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to increase or decrease the speed ( but not direction ) of the prevailing winds , from a zephyr to a hurricane . Later versions of this spell could even produce tornado - level winds . Effect .

title: Converse with sea creatures
description: Converse with sea creatures Converse with sea creatures was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to speak with any creature of the sea that had at least animal intelligence .

title: Convert wand
description: Convert wand Convert wand is a transmutation spell that temporarily transforms a magic wand into a healing one . Effect . This spell temporarily transforms a magic wand of any type into a healing wand with the same number of charges remaining .

title: Conyberry
description: Conyberry Conyberry was a small farming village on the eastern edge of the Neverwinter Wood . Geography . This small village was sheltered within the forest edges and nestled in hills on the edge of the Dessarin .

title: Conyberry Arms
description: Conyberry Arms Conyberry Arms was a smithy run by ex - adventurer , Martin von Mensch . Geography . The weaponshop was located in Conyberry west of the town of Triboar in the Northwest Faerûn .

title: Coobert Draftworth
description: Coobert Draftworth Coobert Draftworth was a human rogue and a smuggler in Cormyr in the early 1370s DR . He was partner to Norry Waywocket . Activities .

title: Cool strength
description: Cool strength Cool strength was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Copper
description: Copper Copper was a precious metal used in Faerûn as the baseline of most currency . When used as currency , it was usually cast into copper pieces ( cp ) of a standard weight . Worth .

title: Copper Bay
description: Copper Bay Copper Bay was a bay in the eastern side of the Golden Water in southeast Faerûn . Description . In the bay , the famous yellow hue of the Golden Water was diminished , and at sunset the water took on a coppery color , hence its name .

title: Copper automaton
description: Copper automaton Copper automatons were magical statues made of copper and bronze that move using concealed levers and clockwork gears . This whole mechanism was controlled by magic that made them move or perform their tasks . Usually , copper automatons were made by skilled magicians .

title: Copper dragon
description: Copper dragon Copper dragons are the second weakest of the metallic dragon s . They are born tricksters and jokesters . They are quite devious and clever , but their intent is purely benign .

title: Cora Peytir
description: Cora Peytir Cora Peytir was one of the Blades of Mulmaster . Activities . In addition to her duties as a Blade , Cora managed her family business of lumberyards and mills .

title: Coral
description: Coral Coral was formed by very tiny animals in the warm seas of the " Realms " ( including the Sea of Fallen Stars ) . It was not a gemstone in the traditional sense of having been mined from underground , but after being treated , cut , and polished , it was considered a fancy gemstone . Description .

title: Coral ( saurial )
description: Coral ( saurial ) Coral was a saurial priestess who was possessed by Moander and transformed into the god ' s chosen servant , the Mouth of Moander . Personality . Coral ' s personality was twisted by Moander .

title: Coral Princess
description: Coral Princess The Coral Princess was a yikarian member of the Seven Sages and governor of the Sun ' s Eye province of the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Description . The Coral Princess was an albino , a rarity among the yak - folk .

title: Coralynn Winsail
description: Coralynn Winsail Coralynn Winsail was an inhabitant of Yulash . Activities . Coralynn cared for her four mastiff s at the Red Plumes camp in Yulash .

title: Coram I
description: Coram I King Coram I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the fifth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Coram was the fifth son of King Haedrak I .

title: Coram II
description: Coram II King Coram II of House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the sixth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Coram II was the second - oldest grandson of King Coram I .

title: Coram III
description: Coram III King Coram III of House Tethyr was the eighth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Coram III was the third - oldest great - grandson of King Alemander I .

title: Coram IV
description: Coram IV King Coram IV of House Tethyr was the tenth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Coram IV was the first legitimate son of Alemander II .

title: Coram Rhindaun
description: Coram Rhindaun His Highness Coram Haedrak Errilam Vander Silvam Rhindaun was the first son and second child of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III and Prince of the Iltkazar Highlands of Tethyr . Relationships . Prince Coram was the middle child of the triplets born to Zaranda .

title: Coran
description: Coran Coran was a wandering adventurer and womanizing archer of dubious virtue . History . He met Gorion ' s Ward while hunting wyverns in Cloakwood forest .

title: Cordallar
description: Cordallar Cordallar was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In Alturiak of 1365 DR , Baerune Cordallar and other members of the Cordallar family were discovered scheming against the Cormyrean royal family .

title: Cordell
description: Cordell Cordell was a great general who conquered much of Maztica for Amn . He formed the Golden Legion as a consolidation of his previous adventuring companies . He slowly trained these remnants into a single military unit .

title: Cordio Muffinhead
description: Cordio Muffinhead Cordio Muffinhead is a dwarven cleric from Mithral Hall . He treated King Bruenor Battlehammer when he was struck by magic and put into a coma . Notes .

title: Cordon of arrows
description: Cordon of arrows Cordon of arrows was a transmutation spell that made a number of missiles lie in wait for a triggering target . Effect . The caster placed four non - magical bolts or arrows in the ground .

title: Corellon
description: Corellon Corellon or more fully Corellon Larethian , whose titles included Creator of the Elves and the Protector , was the patron god of all elves . He was the creator and preserver of the Tel ' Quessir , governing those things held in the highest esteem among elves , such as magic , music , arts , crafts , poetry , and warfare . Corellon lived in the realm of Arvandor .

title: Coril
description: Coril Coril of Baldur ' s Gate was a human wizard and Harper in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Coril was the illegitimate daughter of the mercenary lord Sarraver of Baldur ' s Gate .

title: Corinna Lathankin
description: Corinna Lathankin Corinna Lathankin was a half – moon elf vampire slayer in the Order of the Aster . Description . Corinna was short and skinny with a soft face that easily concealed the fact that she was a powerful spellcaster .

title: Corleth Fentable
description: Corleth Fentable Corleth Fentable was an official in Suzail . Activities . Corleth was an understeward in Cormyr ' s government .

title: Corm Orp
description: Corm Orp Corm Orp was a small town on the Dusk Road dominated by halfling s and led by a human mayor . It was the fastest growing settlement of halflings north of Luiren . It was situated in screaming distance of Darkhold to the east .

title: Cormanda
description: Cormanda Cormanda was a plaguechanged demon lord who , as of 1479 DR , was trapped in Mount Cormanda , a volcano located in Skelkor , Returned Abeir . Description . Cormanda ' s lower body was fused with the stone of Mount Cormanda ' s lava tube .

title: Cormanthor
description: Cormanthor The forest of Cormanthor was long the place of the elven empire of Cormanthyr . It is a large , dense forest made up of a variety of species of plants , including some trees that can grow over 100 ' ( 30m ) high deep in the woods . It is largely abandoned today because of the Retreat , when over 90 % of the elven inhabitants left for Evereska and Evermeet or other places in the west .

title: Cormanthor War
description: Cormanthor War The Cormanthor War was a very complex war that ended with the restoration of an elven kingdom in Myth Drannor . History . The war started in 1374 DR , after the failed fey ' ri invasion of Evereska , when the daemonfey , under suggestion of the fallen solar and yugoloth lord Malkizid , relocated to the fallen Myth Drannor .

title: Cormanthyr
description: Cormanthyr Cormanthyr is one of many Tel ' Quessir ( elven and eladrin ) empires that have graced Faerûn . For much of recent history it has been in ruin , though recently it has risen again under a new Coronal . Its capital , Cormanthor , was the first of any city to have a mythal created by wizardry , whereas previously , all mythals were created by elven High Magic .

title: Cormanthyr : Empire of the Elves
description: Cormanthyr : Empire of the Elves Cormanthyr : Empire of the Elves is an Arcane Age sourcebook about the lost elven kingdom of Cormanthyr . It was published in 1998 by TSR after it became a subsidiary of Wizards of the Coast . Written by Steven E .

title: Cormick
description: Cormick Cormick was a marshal in Neverwinter ' s City Watch in the 1370s DR . History . Cormick was something of a local legend in the village of West Harbor .

title: Cormyr
description: Cormyr Cormyr ( pronounced " core - MEER " ) , also known as the Forest Country and the Land of the Purple Dragon was an independent nation in interior Faerûn . It was historically one of the most prosperous countries of Faerûn . As of 1372 DR , the country was under threat from all sides and struggling to hold onto order .

title: Cormyr : A Novel
description: Cormyr : A Novel Cormyr : A Novel , by Ed Greenwood and Jeff Grubb , was originally written as a stand - alone book . It later became the first book in The Cormyr Saga , which chronicles the end of King Azoun IV ' s rule of Cormyr .

title: Cormyr : The Tearing of the Weave
description: Cormyr : The Tearing of the Weave Cormyr : The Tearing of the Weave is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 . 5 edition ruleset . It was designed by Richard Baker , David Noonan , Bruce R .

title: Cormyrean Coins Coster
description: Cormyrean Coins Coster The Cormyrean Coins Coster , known as the " Coiners " , was a business located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It was a coster involved in shipping and warehousing . Description .

title: Cormyrian goblinthrasher
description: Cormyrian goblinthrasher A Cormyrian goblinthrasher is a magic + 1 longsword that enables its wielder to fight better against goblinoid s . They are decorated with the purple dragon symbol , and many have been made for the Purple Dragon Knights by the War Wizards , on the order of Caladnei . These swords are often personalised to the original recipient and are worth in the region of 18 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Cormyrian greatshield
description: Cormyrian greatshield The Cormyrian greatshield was a large magic steel shield with the image of a Purple Dragon standing on a broken arrow . They were popular among those who hunted evil humanoid s in the Storm Horns , and magically improved the shield ' s ability to deflect projectiles such as arrows . The shield was a " + 1 arrow deflecting large steel shield " .

title: Cornaith Moonflower
description: Cornaith Moonflower Cornaith Moonflower was the son of Sharlario Moonflower . He travelled with his father across Faerûn . On one of these trips both encountered the godess Eilistraee .

title: Cornugon
description: Cornugon Cornugons , also known as horned devils or malebranche — not to be confused with another type of devil with the same name — were greater baatezu that served as elite defense troops in the Nine Hells . Description . Cornugons were about as tall as an ogre , reaching nine feet ( three meters ) high and weighing some 600 pounds ( 270 kilograms ) .

title: Corona of cold
description: Corona of cold Corona of cold was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It surrounded the caster with an aura of cold that protected the caster from heat and fire , and chilled others within the area . Effects .

title: Coronal
description: Coronal Coronal is the title of a Faerûnian elven monarch who rules over a singular elven realm such as ancient Jhyrennstar or Aryvandaar , or an empire such as Cormanthyr . The reign of a Coronal is called a Rysar , which begins and ends with the rule of a single elf . A Coronal ' s reign is monarchial and rules over all .

title: Coronal Guard
description: Coronal Guard The Coronal Guard , whose members are known as armathors in Elven , is an ancient tradition of swordmage s in Faerûn , built upon the foundations of eladrin culture . Skilled warriors armed with a graceful and cultured twinning of arcane magic and sword play , Coronal Guards are among the greatest of swordmages and among the first to defend the ancient city of Myth Drannor , from which their style initially originated . Culture .

title: Corpse - Tearers
description: Corpse - Tearers The Corpse - Tearers , or the Four - Eyed Giants , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Corpse - Tearers were made up of 1 , 200 umber hulk s and dao commanders .

title: Corpsehaven
description: Corpsehaven Corpsehaven was a settlement in the Blood Rift . It was ruled over by the ultroloth Inthracis in 1373 DR . It may have been home to the Black Horn Regiment .

title: Corpselight
description: Corpselight Corpselight was a necromantic spell with an alteration component that was generally known in Faerûn . Effects . This spell caused a body , either dead or undead , to give off a faint radiance , from a thin nimbus outline to a full torch - like aura .

title: Correlian
description: Correlian Correlian was a constellation in the elven tradition . It consisted of thirteen stars . Observation .

title: Corrosive ( weapon quality )
description: Corrosive ( weapon quality ) Corrosive is a quality that can be applied to weapons . Upon command from its wielder , the weapon will become covered in acid ic liquid . The wielder is immune to this liquid .

title: Corrosive ruin
description: Corrosive ruin Corrosive ruin was an evocation spell used by some swordmage s of relatively low experience and power . When cast " corrosive ruin " shot a spinning spray of deadly acid out from a swordmage ' s blade into a nearby area of fifteen feet in diameter , searing any creatures caught within the blast zone . The spell was relatively easy to cast and could be recharged with a rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Corruption domain
description: Corruption domain The Corruption domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters corrupt spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Vile Darkness " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Corruption Domain Powers .

title: Corsair ( kit )
description: Corsair ( kit ) Corsairs were the warrior s of the sea in Zakhara . Requirements . Corsairs had no special requirements , but ranger s could not become corsairs .

title: Corsair Council
description: Corsair Council The Corsair Council was the main governing body of Hawa . They were lenient on crime so long as the city was not threatened , and many vices forbidden in mainland Zakhara were practiced openly and tolerated by the Council . Organization .

title: Corsair Domains
description: Corsair Domains The Corsair Domains consisted of a number of small islands in the Great Sea off the northern coast of Zakhara . They were the holdouts of the pirate s in this region , and the different areas , villages , and hiding - places in the Corsair Domains were ruled by whichever brigand or former captain could grab power . The only real city here , Hawa , was no exception .

title: Corsairs ' Sea
description: Corsairs ' Sea The Principality of the Corsairs ' Sea was the northwestern of Tethyr , the official domain of the heir to the throne , and the original homeland of the Tethyrian tribes . Geography . Located north of the Starspire Mountains , the principality encompassed the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula and the Forest of Tethir .

title: Corstal
description: Corstal Corstal , also infrequently known as , was a rare mineral and especially hard to find without impurities . They were worn by nomadic tribes and those that could not afford better jewelry . Description .

title: Corth
description: Corth Corth was a settlement in the area that would become Aglarond . It was founded by colonists from Chessenta in 756 DR . The fishing village lay in a cove with nearby beaches of white sand .

title: Corthala Family Armor
description: Corthala Family Armor The Corthala Family Armor is a suit or armor specifically made for the Corthala family and its last heir , Valygar . Though a powerful , with a + 2 enhancement bonus , it ' s still light enough not to impede his ranger / stalker abilities . It also grants immunity to Charm spells and a resistance to fire , acid and magic damage .

title: Corthas Muhleer
description: Corthas Muhleer Corthas Muhleer was an infamous mage who was perhaps the person known for holding the title of Magister for the shortest period of time in history . Corthas held the tile for less than a full day in 246 DR , perhaps not even long enough for his soul to be treated as a Magister by Mystra in the afterlife . Personality .

title: Corvus Nightfeather
description: Corvus Nightfeather Corvus Nightfeather was a kenku assassin and spy and the owner of Nightfeather ' s Circus of Wonders . He seemed to have a soft spot for outcasts such as the goliath Tobin . In addition to his circus , Corvus earned his coin by acting as a spy for various factions in southern Faerûn .

title: Corwyn Jaffe
description: Corwyn Jaffe Corwyn Jaffe is an ex - pirate who runs the Devil ' s Fire Tavern in Melvaunt , an establishment he purchased from a merchant in 1372 DR . Corwyn has not completely left his old life behind however , continuing to serve as the first mate on a pirate ship .

title: Cosalla Huin To
description: Cosalla Huin To The Cosalla Huin To were two powerful spirits , appearing as twin children , who dwelt in the northern glades of the Quang Muku Forest in Koryo , Kara - Tur . They lived and moved among the upper branches of the trees much like monkeys did , but often followed travelers in the forest . They merely played pranks on those who meant no harm to the wood , but punished those who invaded or despoiled the forest they watched over .

title: Cosmology
description: Cosmology Cosmology is the study of the cosmos — the structure , organization and composition of all that there is . What most people would call the " known universe " is labeled the Prime Material Plane . It holds the world of Toril , the moon , the sun , and extends out into space to the stars .

title: Coton
description: Coton Coton was the high priest of Qotal in Nexal until 1361 DR . History . Coton was the leader of the Qotal ' s faith in all Maztica and like all high priests of his god he had made vow of silence .

title: Cottie Cooperson
description: Cottie Cooperson Cottie Cooperson was a refugee from Nesmé after the two - headed troll Proffit allied his forces with the orc king Obould Many - Arrows to overrun the small town . In the original battle over Nesmé , Cottie Cooperson lost her child and husband and was forced to flee the town alone with only a small group of survivors . They fled to the safety of Mithril Hall , where she met Delly Curtie .

title: Couatl
description: Couatl The couatl was a large , winged serpentine creature , and considered a native outsider . History . The couatl were originally sarrukh from Okoth who , when they realized that their empire was failing , fled to the other planes of existence .

title: Council ( Tsurlagol )
description: Council ( Tsurlagol ) The Council was the governing body of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . It consisted of the city ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords . From among their number , by means of a secret ballot they chose their leader , called the Ven , and the Ven ' s Voice .

title: Council Hall
description: Council Hall Council Hall was the monthly meeting place of the Royal Council of Aglarond , advisers to the Simbul , around 1368 DR . It was located in an elevated position in Velprintalar , Aglarond , and overlooked the rest of the city . It was built in a typical Aglarondan style : constructed from weathered wood with steep roofs , chimneys and cupolas .

title: Council House
description: Council House The Council House was an old and unremarkable fortress - like building in Athkatla in Amn . It was the base of operations for the Council of Six , the government of the nation of Amn . The building was constructed during the days of Shoon and it had extensive tunnel systems and dungeons beneath it .

title: Council Mage of Cormyr
description: Council Mage of Cormyr Council Mage of Cormyr is a Prestige class whose members belong to Cormyr ' s Council of Mages . While the War Wizards mostly honed their powers on the battlefield , the Council Mages would serve and protect the Royal Family directly . They craft the magical items used by the royals and place any magical defenses the crown deems necessary .

title: Council of Elders ( Everlund )
description: Council of Elders ( Everlund ) The Council of Elders in Everlund was a council of individuals in prominent positions , charged with running the city . It was led by the First Elder , who was able to hold the position until challenged by another member . History .

title: Council of Elders ( Halruaa )
description: Council of Elders ( Halruaa ) The Council of Elders was the prime governing body in Halruaa . Members . Ruled by Zalathorm Kirkson , the Council of Elders had 400 members , all of whom were proven wizard s .

title: Council of Five
description: Council of Five 1479 DR . Members of the formerly anonymous council now rule openly . The five council positions are held by : House Selemchant who sponsors the Cowled Wizards of Athkatla , House Dannihyr which belongs to the Shadow Thieves , House Alibakkar , House Ophal and House Nashivaar which is closely allied with the Church of Cyric .

title: Council of Four
description: Council of Four The Council of Four was the governing body of the city of Baldur ' s Gate consisting of four powerful individuals elected for life . The council was part of the Lords ' Alliance , which includes Waterdeep , Neverwinter and Silverymoon , among others . < ref name = FRCS / CotRp27 > < / ref > The council is now replaced by a parliament .

title: Council of Guilds
description: Council of Guilds The Council of Guilds ran the daily affairs of Daggerford . Activities . Imitating the masked Lords of Waterdeep , the council members wore masks and shrouded themselves in robes to hide their identities at council meetings , but everyone in Daggerford knew who the council members were .

title: Council of Loggers
description: Council of Loggers The Council of Loggers was a trade guild located in Estanil in the Hordelands . Activities . Comprised of mill owners and representatives from companies who harvested lumber from the Shalhoond , the Council of Loggers used their considerable economical leverage to control Abul Fiydah , the Amir of Estanil .

title: Council of Mages
description: Council of Mages The Council of Mages was a primarily advisory group of arcane spellcasters who served the Forest Kingdom and its king directly . Activities . While the War Wizards would focus purely on military matters , it was the Council ' s job to advise the king on all matters magical ( thereby helping to craft the laws governing magic ) , create magic items for the royal family , and battle the most dire of magical threats to Cormyr .

title: Council of Merchants
description: Council of Merchants The Council of Merchants were the rulers of the Shining Lands . Organization . The eleven wealthiest merchants within the Shining Lands comprised the Council of Merchants .

title: Council of Savants
description: Council of Savants The Council of Savants were an advisory body to the duergar Deepking of Gracklstugh , and was made up of derro savants . Organization . Only the thirty - six best derro savants were admitted into the council , and succession almost always included an incumbent member ' s demise .

title: Council of Sparkling Stones
description: Council of Sparkling Stones The Council of Sparkling Stones is an elected council in Mirabar . Members must swear an oath of loyalty to Mirabar and its marchion . It meets each fall to plan the year ahead and organise trade agreements .

title: Council of Spiders
description: Council of Spiders The Council of Spiders was an organization of drow wizard s who sought representation on the Ruling Council of Menzoberranzan . History . In the late 15th century DR , minor wizards of various noble houses of Menzoberranzan ( most prominently House Xorlarrin and House Barrison Del ' Armgo ) formed the Council of Spiders to gain seats on the Ruling Council alongside the priestesses of Lolth .

title: Council of the Marches
description: Council of the Marches The Council of the Marches was the ruling body of the League of the Silver Marches consisting of the High Lady , representatives of the six signatory states ( known as Peers ) , the commander of the Ardent Legion , the Lady Protector and a rotating Member - at - Large appointed by the Lady .

title: Counterspell
description: Counterspell Counterspell was an abjuration spell that attempted to stop another spell from being cast . Effect . If a creature within 60 feet ( 18 .

title: Courage
description: Courage Courage was an enchantment spell that crusader s and battle clerics could use to boost the morale of up to 200 individuals organized in a fighting unit . Effects . This spell lasted until sundown or until the unit was faced with a situation that challenged their morale , whichever came first .

title: Courageous
description: Courageous The Courageous , or Abd al - Jari , was a group of farisan who fought for the Preachers in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Courageous were based in the fortress of Sarahin located deep within the Haunted Lands .

title: Couralitai
description: Couralitai A couralitai was a scheduled meeting of the khans or princes of the people inhabiting the Hordelands . History . These meetings occurred every fall at the vale of Ejen Horo , located between the Khopet Dag Mountains and the Mountains of Copper .

title: Courdh Mizzrym
description: Courdh Mizzrym Courdh Mizzrym was the Archmage Emeritus of Menzoberranzan and house wizard of the House Mizzrym in 1370 DR . Courdh was the aged Past Master who oversaw all teaching at the Academy . He was in charge of experimenting with and guarding the most powerful magical items held by Sorcere .

title: Court District
description: Court District The Court District was one of the wards of Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The Court District was the wealthiest section of Huzuz .

title: Court herald
description: Court herald Court herald was a prestige class in Faerûn that was closely related to that of the Loremaster . Heralds focused primarily on gaining knowledge . Becoming a herald .

title: Court of Enlightenment
description: Court of Enlightenment The Court of Enlightenment , or the first court , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This large court faced the Golden Mosque .

title: Court of Grandeur
description: Court of Grandeur The Court of Grandeur , or the third court , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This large court was decorated with a bounty of flowers and climbing vines .

title: Court of Proclamations
description: Court of Proclamations The Court of Proclamations , or the second court , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This large court was capable of holding 2 , 000 visitors at one time .

title: Court of Rhythm
description: Court of Rhythm The Court of Rhythm was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Hajama , the Zakharan god of courage . The Court of Rhythm favored the short sword . Activities .

title: Court of Rorn
description: Court of Rorn The Court of Rorn was a religious cult dedicated to the primordial Rorn , that operated in Fimbrul , Returned Abeir . Activities . The Court of Rorn goal was to prepare the world for the awakening of Rorn .

title: Courtyard of Lolth
description: Courtyard of Lolth The Courtyard of Lolth was a temple dedicated to Lolth in Maerimydra and was destroyed during the Silence of Lolth . Location . Located on the noble plateau above the rest of Maerimydra , the Courtyard of Lolth was reached from the city proper by ascending a great sweeping staircase at the end of the Grand Boulevard .

title: Cowled Wizards
description: Cowled Wizards The Cowled Wizards are a secret organization of wizard s in Amn . They were originally created by Alisar of Esmeltaran in the 13th century . Alisar and the mages wanted to preserve magical lore and they saw themselves as saviors of the Art and as agents of Azuth and Deneir .

title: Coyo
description: Coyo Coyo was a Nexal an general of history . History . Under the rule of Zomoc , Coyo was the chief general of the Revered Councilor .

title: Cracker and Whacker
description: Cracker and Whacker Cracker and Whacker were twin morning star s that were the chief weapons of the dwarf Athrogate . Description . " Cracker " and " Whacker " were both gray glassteel morning star s , with spiked metal heads attached to the ends of adamantine chains .

title: Crackers
description: Crackers Crackers were crispy tidbits of bread . A selection with herbs from the Dalelands was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Crackletongue
description: Crackletongue Crackletongue was the magical saber of Zaranda Star . It was a saber of sharpness + 5 , with a basket hilt . When drawn , blue flames ran along the blade .

title: Craft District
description: Craft District The Craft District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Craft District was found in the North Quarter and covered a large portion of the northeast corner of Huzuz .

title: Craggnor
description: Craggnor Craggnor was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Craggnor was a cultist and a great friend of White Wyrmspeaker Varramzord .

title: Cragmaw tribe
description: Cragmaw tribe The Cragmaw were a tribe of goblin s , bugbear s , and hobgoblin s operating in Neverwinter Wood and the Triboar Trail . The members of the tribe sharpened their teeth , which led to the name of the tribe . King Grol ruled the tribe as a whole from Cragmaw Castle , while Klarg lead a smaller group from the Cragmaw Hideout .

title: Crags
description: Crags The Crags were a series of hills and broken mounds south of Mirabar . History . In the past many mines were located in this area .

title: Cranium rat
description: Cranium rat Cranium rats were psionically enhanced rat s , transformed by mind flayer s through bombardment with psionic energy . Behavior . When isolated , cranium rats behaved like ordinary rats , using their telepathy to communicate basic feelings .

title: Crannak Smoulderburn
description: Crannak Smoulderburn Crannak Smoulderburn ( pronounced KRAN - uck SMOL - der - burn ) was a derro smith and a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in the Moonsea region . Description . Crannak was bald - his hair frequently burned off in fires of his own creation .

title: Crawler
description: Crawler Crawlers were small elemental vermin native to the Elemental Plane of Earth that could also be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Crawlers had a crested dog - like head with feelers located near the snout .

title: Crawling claw
description: Crawling claw A swarm of crawling claws was made from the hands of some 300 small - and medium - sized humanoids . This construct acted like a swarm of insects , but perhaps with even less intelligence . Nevertheless , it was quite disturbing when viewed first hand .

title: Create baneguard
description: Create baneguard Create baneguard was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Bane , the Black Hand . It animated a baneguard out of an intact skeleton . Other ways of creating a baneguard were discovered , but this spell was specific to Bane and did not spread to other faiths until after his " death " in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR .

title: Create campsite
description: Create campsite Create campsite was a conjuration spell that summoned many invisible servants to set up a comfortable campsite . The reverse of this spell , break camp , could pack and clean up a campsite , leaving no trace . Effects .

title: Create crypt servant
description: Create crypt servant Create crypt servant was a necromancy spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable by wizard s and priest s ( cleric s ) . Effects .

title: Create direguard
description: Create direguard Create direguard was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Cyric , Prince of Madness . It animated a direguard out of an intact skeleton . Other ways of creating a direguard were discovered , but this spell was specific to Cyric and a jealously guarded secret .

title: Create food and water
description: Create food and water Create food and water was a conjuration or alteration spell that caused food and water to appear . Effects . The food was simple and bland , but very nourishing .

title: Create frenzy dog
description: Create frenzy dog Create frenzy dog was an evil druid spell used by certain druids in the forest of Chondalwood to transform almost any animal into a frenzy dog , a magically enhanced creature . Although the spell caused a corruption in nature to create the frenzy dog , druids justified this by their use of these creatures in the protection of their forest environment . The spell was barely known outside the Chondalwood and the druids used it sparingly because they were aware of the potential damage large numbers of frenzy dogs would cause .

title: Create greater undead
description: Create greater undead ' Create greater undead " was a necromancy spell that created more powerful undead than the lesser " create undead " spell . Effect .
