This spell functioned in the same manner as " create undead " , except that it allowed the caster to create more powerful and intelligent sorts of undead .

title: Create jungle minions
description: Create jungle minions Create jungle minions was a divine magic spell available to priest s of the Zakhara n savage goddess Ragarra , and some specialized kahin s . It transformed certain creatures into lesser segarran s . Effects .

title: Create or destroy water
description: Create or destroy water Create or destroy water , also known simply as create water or destroy water , was a transmutation / alteration or conjuration spell that could create a quantity of drinkable water or remove a like quantity of standing water . Effects . This spell had two functions with opposite effects .

title: Create shade
description: Create shade Create shade was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a patch of shaded ground .

title: Create soundstaff
description: Create soundstaff Create soundstaff was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell diminished noise by gathering it into a special staff .

title: Create undead
description: Create undead Create undead was a necromancy spell that created one or several undead under the casters service . Effect . A older version of the spell allowed the caster to bring into being a ghoul , ghast , mummy or mohrg depending on the caster ' s ability .

title: Creation
description: Creation Creation was a illusion spell that took threads of the Shadowfell to form a inanimate object of plant stuffs . Effect . The object could be no larger then a 5 foot ( 1 , 5 meters ) cube and be of a material and form of something the caster have seen before .

title: Creative Creed
description: Creative Creed The Creative Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They advocated that the best way to expand their knowledge base was to create , invent , or discover new psionic disciplines , technology , and psionic items . They successfully built flying craft , living troop transports and weaponry , and other unique psionic items .

title: Creator race
description: Creator race The five creator race s ( or " Iquar ' Tel ' Quessir " in the language of the elves ) dominated Faerûn during the Days of Thunder . All are considered native to Abeir - Toril , as are their descendants and creations . Most historians agree that the creator races were the sarrukh ( creators of the yuan - ti , naga , lizardfolk , and scalykind ) , the batrachi ( known as amphibioids , and the creators of the bullywug s , doppelganger s , kopru , kuo - toa , locathah , siv s , tako and other shapeshifting , amphibious , or piscine races ) , the aearee ( known as avians , and creators of the aarakocra , kenku , and other birdlike humanoids ) , the fey ( known as sylvans , and creators of korreds , sprite s , and pixie s ) and humans .

title: Cree
description: Cree Cree was a shadar - kai warrior living in the city of Ikemmu on the Shadowfell side . Relationships . He was a brother of Skagi and a close friend of Ashok .

title: Creel
description: Creel The Creel were one of the smallest tribes of Nar found in Narfell . There were 750 Creel in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Creeper rose
description: Creeper rose Creeper roses were common in the Rose Garden of the Battle of Bones . Description . Creeper roses were vigorous plants with pink flowers .

title: Creeping doom
description: Creeping doom Creeping doom was a conjuration spell that called into being a carpet of insects that attacked selected targets . Effects . Early versions of this spell summoned 500 to 1 , 000 poisonous spider s , scorpions , beetle s , and centipede s that swarmed over a 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Crenshinibon
description: Crenshinibon Crenshinibon , also called " The Crystal Shard " , was a unique , magical artifact . Powers and personality . Crenshinibon was a vile relic of immense power , a crystal shard that drew its magical energy from the light of the sun .

title: Crescent Blade
description: Crescent Blade The Crescent Blade was a magical sword created by the goddess Eilistraee . Description . The blade was curved , resembling a crescent moon attached to a leather hilt .

title: Crescentcoat
description: Crescentcoat In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Crescentcoat was one of the High Heralds . This office was primarily responsible for training the local Heralds and was also given the difficult task of presenting all sides of issues brought up for debate among the High Heralds . Crescentcoat traditionally played the role of " devil ' s advocate " to ensure the council came to their conclusions honestly after considering the ramifications of each aspect .

title: Cressaro
description: Cressaro Cressaro was the cloud giant castellan of Lyn Armaal sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Cressaro was a young giant in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR .

title: Cressyl Blackbones
description: Cressyl Blackbones Cressyl Blackbones was a male orc and a red half - dragon from the Thunder Peaks . He led a small army of orcs near the eastern edge of the Hullack Forest . Description .

title: Cricket
description: Cricket A cricket is a type of insect . Species . Horse .

title: Crimdrac
description: Crimdrac Crimdrac was a dracolich ally of Dracandros in Battledale in 1357 DR . History . Crimdrac was a red dragon dracolich created by the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Crimel
description: Crimel Crimel was a small city in Luiren in the Shining South . Geography . Crimel was found along the edge of the Long Forest .

title: Crimmor
description: Crimmor Crimmor was the Caravan Capital of Amn . Many caravan s were sponsored and arranged in Athkatla , but the goods were loaded onto barges there and towed up the Alandor River by horses and mules on River Road until they reached their mustering point at Crimmor . Some folk said nearly every caravan in Faerûn passed through Crimmor in time .

title: Crinti
description: Crinti The Crinti ( drowic for " noble ones " ) , also referred to as Shadow - Amazons by the Halruaa ns , were the half - drow and half - elf aristocracy and ruling class of Dambrath . History . In 831 DR the Arkaiun people were defeated at the Battle of Crimtar by the combined efforts of the drow of T ' lindhet and one hundred and twelve priestesses of Loviatar who became later known as The First .

title: Cripakolus
description: Cripakolus Cripakolus was an azer lord on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Cripakolus was the leader of the azer Everash Tribe in the Elemental Plane of Fire .

title: Crippled Mountain
description: Crippled Mountain The Crippled Mountain , originally known as the Celestial Mountain , was a volcano located in Skelkor , Returned Abeir . History . The Celestial Mountain was the lair of the red dragon Rhodrolytharnestrix , the most powerful of the dragon tyrants of Abeir .

title: Crommower Pwent
description: Crommower Pwent Crommower Pwent was a dwarven battlerager and a dear friend and traveling companion of Gandalug Battlehammer , the First King of Mithril Hall . Description . Crommower was a dirty dwarf with a black beard and a clean - shaven head to secure the spiked helmet on his head .

title: Cron Bolver
description: Cron Bolver Cron Bolver was a member of the Knights of Black Fist in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Bolver had a lot of power in the city and made sure that all knew this .

title: Crookspar Parlor
description: Crookspar Parlor Crookspar Parlor was a gambling den located in the Crown , the highest section of Skullport . The lower floor was open to anyone with coin while the upper floor was divided into private rooms in which high stake games of chance were played . The establishment was considered neutral turf by Skullport ' s gangs and leaders of the town ' s gangs often gambled in the private rooms .

title: Cross Road
description: Cross Road The Cross Road ran through the Vast from the city of Tantras at its most southern point to Kurth at its northern point . From south to north it ran through : Tantras , Hlintar , Thindilar , Viperstongue Ford over the River Vesper , through the Viperstongue pass in the Troll Mountains , Blanaer , and ended at Kurth . On the way , it connected with the Coast Road , the Tantras Trail , the Hlintar Ride , Blaern ' s Trail , the Pass Trail , the Hunt Trail , and the North Road .

title: Cross Wheeler
description: Cross Wheeler Cross Wheeler was the innkeeper of The Way Inn sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Cross retired from his work as ranger and became the innkeeper of The Way Inn .

title: Crossbow
description: Crossbow A crossbow is a weapon consisting of a bow mounted on a stock that shoots bolt s . A mechanism in the stock holds the bow in its fully - drawn position , without human effort or intervention , until it is shot by releasing a trigger . Due to the short travel of the bow section in firing the weapon , significant force is needed to prime it for firing .

title: Crossroad Keep
description: Crossroad Keep Crossroad Keep is an old fortress within Neverwinter ' s sphere of influence , located along the High Road south of Neverwinter . It was best known as the Kalach - Cha ' s base during Neverwinter ' s campaign against the King of Shadows , and later , the headquarters of Lady Sa ' Sani ' s merchant company . Geography .

title: Crow Dz Pong
description: Crow Dz Pong Crow Dz Pong , also known as " the Wha ' kai Choun " ( meaning " the Lord of High Water " ) and " the wu jen of mo ' Ki Bay " , was a human wu jen and a notorious pirate active in Koryo around 1357 DR . Abilities . The wu jen had a mastery over water .

title: Crowded Sea
description: Crowded Sea To the South , the continent of Zakhara was enclosed by the Crowded Sea , or Bahr Al - Izdiham in Midani . Geography . The eastern half of the Crowded Sea was dominated by four major islands : Afyal and Sahu in the North ( both were also counted as part of the Ruined Kingdoms region ) , Harab and Bariya to the South .

title: Crown ( constellation )
description: Crown ( constellation ) A constellation appearing in the North consisted of six stars and resembled a crown . Observation . The constellation could be observed in the North in autumn and winter , looking to the south .

title: Crown Council
description: Crown Council The Crown Council was the ruling council of Relmaur , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . The Crown Council was established by High Crown Harangor Urlingscar to allow all the prominent Relmorn dragonborn clans , Clans Urlingscar , Belarrak , and Garandorn , to participate in the government of the kingdom .

title: Crown Lands
description: Crown Lands The Protectorate of the Crown Lands was composed of the four central - most counties of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Geography . The counties Ithmonn , Rivershire , Varyth , and Spellshire make up the Crown Lands .

title: Crown Wars
description: Crown Wars The Crown Wars were a series of elven wars fought early in the history of Faerûn . Over a period of 3 , 000 years , the great elven kingdoms participated in five primary conflicts , leading to the near destruction of the elven race . First Crown War .

title: Crown Wars timeline
description: Crown Wars timeline The Crown Wars were a series of elven wars spanning a period of 3 , 000 years . The great elven civilizations participated in five primary conflicts , leading to the decline of elven power in Faerûn . Some of the Crown Wars overlap each other .

title: Crown of Horns
description: Crown of Horns The Crown of Horns was an evil , intelligent artifact of great power . Forged by Trebbe , a Netherese arcanist , and later enhanced by Myrkul , the former god of Death , it carried with it a long history of corruption and tragedy . Description .

title: Crown of glory
description: Crown of glory Crown of glory is an evocation spell unique to divine spellcasters with the Glory domain , Herald domain , and / or Glory prestige domain . It inspires awe in its subjects . Effect .

title: Crown of madness
description: Crown of madness Crown of madness was a evocation spell that assaulted the mind of a target and summoned a jagged crown above the targets head . Effect . After the Spellplague version of the spell made the target attack a adjacent ally of the casters choice , the post Second Sundering of the spell worked the same way making the target attack characters of the casters choice but it lasted longer .

title: Crown of silver
description: Crown of silver Crown of silver was the Realms name for , a variety of chalcedony containing many fine bands of black . Description . The black bands of these ornamental stones took on a brilliant polish alongside the silver chalcedony , so crown of silver was usually sliced for , tumbled smooth , or cut .

title: Crown of stars
description: Crown of stars Crown of stars is a spell used most frequently by warlock s of the star pact , though other warlocks may learn its power . " Crown of stars " , when cast , conjures a circle of small , star - like orbs that circle the head of the caster . At the warlock ' s command , the glowing spheres fire a beam of burning , radiant energy powered largely by the warlock ' s charisma at a target within fifty feet or , with a little more concentration on the warlock ' s part , two targets .

title: Crunch
description: Crunch Crunch was the leader of the Wilddwarf Brigade , the battlerager brigade of Citadel Adbar . He was not known by any other name . History .

title: Crusader
description: Crusader A crusader is a warrior in the service of a deity who acts according to a certain code . Culture . Crusaders are rare warriors who are in the highest favors of their chosen deities .

title: Crusader ' s mantle
description: Crusader ' s mantle Crusader ' s mantle was an evocation spell that created a 30 foot ( 9 . 1 meter ) aura that radiated holy energies . Effects .

title: Crusader the Holy Avenger
description: Crusader the Holy Avenger Gareth ' s magical longsword . The sword is blessed by Ilmater and Gareth aquired it while he was still an adventuring knight . Gareth used it throughout his time in the Cold Lands and held onto if for the rest of his days .

title: Crushing sphere
description: Crushing sphere Crushing sphere was an evocation spell that trapped and crushed a victim . Casting " crushing Sphere " caused a sphere of force ( like " Otiluke ' s resilient sphere " ) to appear around the target , and begin to shrink , crushing the victim .

title: Crushing walls
description: Crushing walls Crushing walls was an enchantment spell that turned a room surface into a death trap . Effects . A wall , ceiling , or floor of a room could be enchanted to slowly move toward the opposite side whenever someone other than the caster entered the room .

title: Cry of Joy
description: Cry of Joy The Cry of Joy was a temple of Lliira in Hill ' s Edge . Inhabitants . The leader of the temple was the young priestess named Joybringer Jhanadra Caseldown .

title: Crying To My Harp
description: Crying To My Harp Crying To My Harp was a collection of satirical ballads by the traveling minstrel Nymbrar Shatterslee . It began by making fun of the stereotypes of people in general but then transformed into a scathing attack on certain Waterdhavian nobility . This had generated many complaints from the nobility in question and demands that the composer be arrested and punished , but these died down after Mirt the Moneylender suggested that such requests were effectively an admission of guilt .

title: Cryovain
description: Cryovain Cryovain was a white dragon enslaved by the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Cryovain lived with her mate Isendraug in Svarborg .

title: Crypt of Augathra the Mad
description: Crypt of Augathra the Mad The crypt of Augathra the Mad was located in the ruins of the Netherese floating citadel of Synod . History . Augathra the Mad found the ruins around - 390 DR and , discovering a unique interaction between the Weave and the Sharn Wall , stayed to research a way to end her dark torment as the chronicler of the Black Chronology .

title: Crypt of the Six
description: Crypt of the Six The Crypt of the Six was one of many Anauria n tombs littered throughout the Serpent Hills . It housed the bodies of multiple counselors and their families and contained a number of magical guardians , along with a path forcing travelers to wander the Abyss before delving deeper . Because of these defenses , it was one of the few tombs in the area to never be looted .

title: Crypt servant
description: Crypt servant Crypt servants were a special kind of guardian undead that could be found in Zakhara . The creation of these creatures originated in the Ruined Kingdoms of Nog and Kadar . These creatures were made via the " create crypt servant " spell .

title: Crysmal
description: Crysmal Crysmals were psionic crystalline elemental creature s native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Crysmals were composed of a mixture of stone and crystal .

title: Crystal ball
description: Crystal ball Crystal balls were the most common of magical scrying devices . Description . These orbs of crystal weighed about seven pounds ( 3 .

title: Crystal dragon
description: Crystal dragon Crystal dragons were among the friendliest of the gem dragon s and enjoyed conversing with other creatures . Dragons of this type who dwelt on the Prime Material Plane preferred to live atop high mountains . They sometimes came into conflict with White dragon s and had been known to steal white dragon wyrmlings in order to raise them in a friendlier environment .

title: Crystal orb
description: Crystal orb Crystal Orbs were magical items that could be found in Halruaa . History . The first of these items were believed to be created by the legendary archmage Halruaa himself .

title: Crystal sand
description: Crystal sand Crystal sand was a magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , used to create crystalline objects of virtually any shape . Powers . Items created with " crystal sand " could weigh up to five lbs .

title: Crystal sphere
description: Crystal sphere A crystal sphere was a gigantic spherical shell that contained an entire planetary system . Each sphere varied in size but typically they were twice the diameter of the orbit of the planet that was furthest from the sun or planet at the center of the sphere ( the system ' s primary ) . The surface of the sphere was called the " sphere wall " and separated the void of wildspace ( within the sphere ) from the phlogiston ( which surrounded and flowed outside the sphere ) .

title: Cullen Kordamant
description: Cullen Kordamant Cullen Kordamant was a priest of Oghma from the city of Procampur in the Vast , at the Domes of Reason temple , and the Grand Patriarch of the Oghmyte church , a pontiff widely recognized as the " Voice of Oghma " on Toril . Worshipers of Oghma swore by Kordamant ' s word , and the entire church hierarchy , well - organized and established , was dedicated to his service and spirit . However , this all changed during the Time of Troubles , in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , when Kordamant vanished without a trace from his home in Procampur , as did much of his immediate clergy .

title: Cullen Salgoud
description: Cullen Salgoud Cullen Salgoud was a one of the Boar ' s Head s , the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruitment company in Amn . Description . Cullen had a neat goatee and mustache .

title: Cult of Istishia
description: Cult of Istishia The Cult of Istishia was a small cult in Hawa who worshiped Istishia in 1367 DR . Activities . Members of the cult , through their own choices or by magical coercion , were involved in kidnapping inhabitants of Hawa in an attempt to make converts out of them .

title: Cult of Shared Suffering
description: Cult of Shared Suffering The Cult of Shared Suffering was a heretical religious organization dedicated to the worship and service of Ilmater , the Crying God . Dogma . The cult held the view that all mortal beings should help share part of the burden carried by Ilmater , so that they might understand the sacrifice he made .

title: Cult of the Black Earth
description: Cult of the Black Earth The Cult of the Black Earth was a cult devoted to Ogrémoch and one of the four cults responsible for the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The earth cultists were fascinated by the implacable strength and unyielding resistance of elemental earth .

title: Cult of the Crushing Wave
description: Cult of the Crushing Wave The Cult of the Crushing Wave was a cult devoted to Olhydra and one of the four cults responsible for the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The water cultists were fascinated by the crushing force of the sea and the raging torrents of rivers in flood and the rock - crushing power of ice and glaciers .

title: Cult of the Dragon
description: Cult of the Dragon The Cult of the Dragon , also known as Keepers of the Secret Hoard or , more recently , Wearers of Purple , was a semi - religious evil organization venerating undead dragons , or dracoliches , founded by Sammaster , a powerful wizard . Sammaster possessed great power , in a manner similar to Elminster and Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . In Sammaster ' s case however , the additional power brought delusions of godhood and madness , and he came to believe in time that " dead dragons shall rule the world entirely " and began to work toward that goal , fighting the several Chosen of Mystra and even the god Lathander along the way .

title: Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye
description: Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye The Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye was dedicated to bringing the evil god Tharizdun , an interloper god from the Oerth universe who was imprisoned in the Abyss , into Faerûn . The cult was related to the Church of All Tomorrows , an Oghman heresy that believed its followers should be able to foresee the future . History .

title: Cult of the Eternal Flame
description: Cult of the Eternal Flame The Cult of the Eternal Flame was a cult devoted to Imix and one of the four cults responsible for the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The followers of the Eternal Flame cult were fascinated by the destructive power of fire in all its manifestations .

title: Cult of the Eyeless
description: Cult of the Eyeless The Cult of the Eyeless was a beholder cult active in Athkatla in around 1369 DR . Outwardly , its blind priests preached that all the gods were fakes , and that the only true one was the Unseeing Eye , whom the cult served . This helped it gain some followers among ordinary people who were disillusioned with the gods .

title: Cult of the Howling Hatred
description: Cult of the Howling Hatred The Cult of the Howling Hatred was a cult devoted to Yan - C - Bin and one of the four cults responsible for the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Cult of the Howling Hatred gathered all air cultists .

title: Cult of the Shadow
description: Cult of the Shadow The Cult of the Shadow , or Cult of the Shadows , was a temple of Shar in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast in the 1360s DR . The temple doubled as a thieves guild , acting as the headquarters of the Sharwomen . The identity of its high priestess was unknown , but she was also head of the Sharwomen .

title: Cult of the Shattered Peak
description: Cult of the Shattered Peak The Cult of the Shattered Peak were Netherese descendents who watched constantly for those seeking what they believed should not be sought . They strove to keep the secrets of ancient Netheril out of the hands of others . History .

title: Culthar
description: Culthar Culthar was a male warrior who was one of the guards of the Twisted Tower in Shadowdale ; secretly , he was also a member of the Cult of the Dragon . History . In 1357 , Culthar was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair , helping the Cult ' s archmage Malark Himbruel to enter the Twisted Tower .

title: Cultist of the Shattered Peak
description: Cultist of the Shattered Peak A Cultist of the Shattered Peak was a member of the Cult of the Shattered Peak , a secret society whose members were all of Netherese descent . History . Cultists were always human s of Netherese descent .

title: Cure light wounds
description: Cure light wounds Cure light wounds was a conjuration or evocation spell that healed minor injuries . After the Second Sundering it was simply called cure wounds . Effects .

title: Cure minor wounds
description: Cure minor wounds Cure minor wounds was a conjuration spell that clerics and druids learned as an orison . It provided the minimum noticeable amount of healing . Effects .

title: Cure moderate wounds
description: Cure moderate wounds Cure moderate wounds was a conjuration or necromancy spell that healed slightly more severe injuries than " cure light wounds " . Effects . When laying hands upon a living creature , the caster channeled positive energy that healed a medium amount of damage .

title: Cure serious wounds
description: Cure serious wounds Cure serious wounds was a conjuration spell that healed major injuries . Effect . This spell worked the same as Cure Light Wounds , except that it healed a significant amount of damage .

title: Curkon Gheldieg
description: Curkon Gheldieg Curkon Gheldieg was Namarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1345 DR until his death in 1362 DR . He was the Lord of House Gheldieg from 1317 DR and before Namarch , he was the Iltarch from 1333 - 1345 . He had been a fighter by trade , but his success led him to become overindulgent and obese .

title: Curna Mountains
description: Curna Mountains The Curna Mountains were a short mountain range that lay in the Shining Lands . Geography . The Curna Mountians were bordered by Durpar , Estagund , Veldorn , and Var the Golden .

title: Curna emerald
description: Curna emerald Curna emeralds were rare gemstones found in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . These beautiful clear emerald s held turquoise light in their center .

title: Curnil Thordrim
description: Curnil Thordrim Curnil Thordrim was captain of the guard in Elventree in Cormanthor . History . In 1372 DR , Curnil introduced the drow outcast Ryld Argith and Halisstra Melarn to his lord Dessaer .

title: Currach
description: Currach A currach was a boat used mainly for fishing in Aglarond and Turmish . Description . The hull of a currach was built using thick animal hides stretched over a frame made from wood and wicker .

title: Currag Blackstone
description: Currag Blackstone Currag Blackstone was the son and heir to Earl Blackstone on the Moonshae Isles . He died suddenly in mysterious circumstances in 1365 DR . Death .

title: Curran Corvalin
description: Curran Corvalin Curran Corvalin was a halfling in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Curran never considered himself a chosen since he had no powers .

title: Currency
description: Currency When bartering for goods and services no longer meets the needs of commerce , the sentient beings of the Realms turn to using items with a more universal value , namely precious metals , gem s , and some minerals . Metals are rarely found in their pure form in nature and require significant energy and effort to refine and purify them . In general , the rarity and the amount of effort it takes to produce a given metal determines its worth .

title: Curse
description: Curse A Curse is a powerful , negative magical effect . A curse is hard to remove . Only a handful of specialized spells can hope to remove even a weak curse .

title: Curse candle
description: Curse candle A curse candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It could bestow one or more severely handicapping curses on victims . Description .

title: Curse of Yondalla
description: Curse of Yondalla The Curse of Yondalla is an especially powerful cleric spell , granted only to followers of the halfling deity Yondalla and reserved only for use against creatures guilty of destroying a halfling community or slaying innocent and defenseless halflings . When cast , anything affected by the spell is stunned so that it cannot make any offensive actions and then over the next minute , the affected person or creature will revert to infancy , first slowly and then faster . Undead creatures without any sort of divinity are immediately destroyed while extraplanar creatures are banished to their home plane and unable to return for up to 100 years .

title: Curse of the Azure Bonds
description: Curse of the Azure Bonds Curse of the Azure Bonds is a " Forgotten Realms " adventure published in 1989 by TSR , Inc . " " Curse of the Azure Bonds " is an adventure set in the " FORGOTTEN REALMS " game world for the AD & D 2nd Edition game . It is based on the best - selling novel , " Azure Bonds " , by Jeff Grubb and Kate Novak .

title: Curse of the Azure Bonds ( game )
description: Curse of the Azure Bonds ( game ) Curse of the Azure Bonds is the second title in the four - game " Forgotten Realms " series of computer role - playing games developed and published by Strategic Simulations , Inc . It is the sequel to " Pool of Radiance " . The game was based on the novel " Azure Bonds " and the module " Curse of the Azure Bonds " .

title: Curse of the dark dream
description: Curse of the dark dream The curse of the dark dream was a warlock invocation of moderate complexity , which could only be cast once per day . Effects . When a warlock cast " curse of the dark dream " , he or she struck into the mind of a creature within fifty feet , filling their thoughts with nightmarish visions as though they were asleep .

title: Cursebite
description: Cursebite Cursebite was a necrotic invocation used by warlock s , particularly those of the dark pact . Effect . " Cursebite " took advantage of a warlock ' s ability to curse their foes and each creature so cursed within an area of fifty feet in radius could become affected with " cursebite " , which struck deep into their life force .

title: Cursed javelin
description: Cursed javelin Cursed javelins were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons looked exactly like regular javelin s .

title: Curtis Scott
description: Curtis Scott Curtis Scott was a game designer who had worked for TSR , Inc . He was also one of the organizers of the gaming convention . Education .

title: Curuvar
description: Curuvar Curuvar the Brazen was a wizard from Loudwater . Description . Curuvar had a long black beard , wore a robe , and had a raven - topped staff .

title: Cuth Swift
description: Cuth Swift Cuth Swift was a human man in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . History . Around 1489 DR during a battle with the Cult of the Dragon , Cuth , his wife Linan Swift , and their children were pursued by some kobold s until they were saved by some adventurers .

title: Cutlass
description: Cutlass A cutlass is a short and heavy sword with a slightly curved blade that can either be used in a stabbing or slashing manner . With a heavy basket hilt , it is more difficult for the wielder of a cutlass to be disarmed . Cutlasses are especially popular with pirates .

title: Cutlass ( inn )
description: Cutlass ( inn ) The Cutlass was one of the busiest taverns in the city of Luskan . Location . The inn was located on the southern bank in Luskan on Half Moon Street , the last road before the piers themselves .

title: Cutlass of the Golden Gulf
description: Cutlass of the Golden Gulf The Cutlass of the Golden Gulf was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . It was favored by corsairs and other sailors . Powers .

title: Cutter ( comic )
description: Cutter ( comic ) Cutter ( full name : Dungeons & Dragons : Cutter ) is a collection of five comic issues centering on Tos ' un and Doum ' wielle Armgo and the sentient sword " Khazid ' hea " ; it takes place just prior to " Night of the Hunter " . The story was written by R . A .

title: Cutter ( person )
description: Cutter ( person ) Lord Cutter , previously known as Ravendas , was a ruthless and power hungry agent of the Zhentarim and briefly the puppet tyrant of Iriaebor . History . After traveling to Baldur ' s Gate in order to learn martial skills , Ravendas ' s lust for power led her to Darkhold , where she sought membership in the Zhentarim .

title: Cutter ( ship )
description: Cutter ( ship ) The Cutter was a seal - hunting ship based near the Sea of Moving Ice . Crew . It was captained by Farlow , a black - bearded mercenary .

title: Cvaal Daoran
description: Cvaal Daoran Cvaal Daoran was an important member of the Zhentarim and a leader of the Brothers of the Black Fist who became the lord of Phlan and started the Shadowbane War . History . Cvaal was a member of the Zhentarim , from before the Time of Troubles .

title: Cybriana
description: Cybriana Cybriana was a female half - elf magic - user from Shadowdale in the Dalelands . Personality . Cybriana had great goodness in her soul , enough to reject any evil in her makeup .

title: Cyclops
description: Cyclops Cyclopes were evil , one - eyed giant s that originally came from the Feywild . Description . Cyclopes were one of the smallest types of giants , standing only twelve feet ( four meters ) and weighing 1 , 200 pounds ( 540 kilograms ) , but they were as strong as the average stone giant .

title: Cyclopskin
description: Cyclopskin A cyclopskin is smaller version of a cyclops . Physical description . Typical cyclopskin stands 7 .

title: Cylyria Dragonbreast
description: Cylyria Dragonbreast High Lady Cylyria Dragonbreast was a member of the Harpers and the ruler of the city of Berdusk . Activities . Cylyria encouraged the city in a manner to maintain it as a peaceful haven for trade and negotiation , while keeping it firmly rooted in the Lords ' Alliance and maintaining the Harpers ' strength within .

title: Cymbals
description: Cymbals Cymbals were a percussion instrument played in the continent of Zakhara . They were also used by rock gnome s and in certain Khazari monasteries . Description .

title: Cymmarraa
description: Cymmarraa Cymmarraa was a young wizard who was once Manshoon ' s apprentice and lover , as were her sisters and her mother . Elminster used her to spy on Manshoon while he was lord of Westgate . He placed a powerful spell on Cymmarraa which prevented her from dying .

title: Cynda
description: Cynda Cynda was a halfling ranger and the twin sister of Shan . She was also an accomplished aerialist in the Circus of Wonders . Her voice was damaged in a fight with an undead creature and she lost her ability to speak .

title: Cynosure
description: Cynosure Cynosure , also known as the Outlands , is a small plane located very close - cosmologically speaking - to Toril . It is a plane only accessible to deities , and they can only access it from within their own domains . The plane is considered neutral ground by all the powers of Faerûn , and the plane is used as a meeting ground to settle disputes and decide upon punishments for those deities who upset the Balance ( as defined by the guidelines Ao left ) .

title: Cyrag Hammerbone
description: Cyrag Hammerbone Cyrag Hammerbone was a dwarf of Illefarn circa 1363 DR . History . Cyrag was a veteran warrior in the High Moor before joining the reconstruction effort in Illefarn .

title: Cyriana Rhindaun
description: Cyriana Rhindaun Her Highness Princess Cyriana Raisa Marela Vajra Eralea Rhindaun was the second daughter and third child of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III of Tethyr . Officially , she was the Princess of Ankramir and the third heir to the throne . Description .

title: Cyriana Rhindaun II
description: Cyriana Rhindaun II Cyriana Rhindaun II was the fourth queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty and the third queen of Tethyr by that name . Relationships . Cyriana was the daughter of Prince Nishan and the niece of Queen Zaranda II .

title: Cyric
description: Cyric Cyric ( pronounced " SEER - ick " ) , whose titles included The Lord of Three Crowns , The Mad God , and The Prince of Lies , was the monomaniacal deity of strife and lies with an immense following , though after he murdered Mystra and caused the Spellplague , his faith diminished somewhat . He was petty and self - centered , and enjoyed misleading individuals of all inclinations so that they performed acts that ruined their lives or so that they made fatal mistakes . Cyric was closely associated with the essence of murder , conflict , lies , intrigue , and illusions .

title: Cyrinishad
description: Cyrinishad The Cyrinishad is an unholy tome created by Rinda the Scribe under the forced divine guidance of Cyric . Creation . The tome was made for the sole purpose to increase Cyric ' s power in Faerûn .

title: Cyrrollalee
description: Cyrrollalee Cyrrollalee ( seer - oh - lah - lee ) is the halfling deity of Friendship , trust and hospitality as well as an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl . Her symbol ( an open door ) shows the two way path that halflings should take : leave the door open to welcome friends and have a look outdoor to discover new places in Faerûn . Worshipers .

title: Cyrvisnea
description: Cyrvisnea Cyrvisnea was an ogre mage who attacked the southern cities of Amn in West Faerûn . History . In 1370 DR , Cyrvisnea along with Sythillis , her mate , led a goblinoid army with hill giant s and worshipers of Cyric on an assault on southern Amn as a part of the Sothillisian War .

title: Cythandria
description: Cythandria Cythandria was a female half - elf wizard and a member of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis . History . After the death of Tamoko , Cythandria became the lover of Sarevok Anchev in order to rise through the ranks .

title: D ' tarig
description: D ' tarig D ' tarig were a race of human s inhabiting the Anauroch desert . Description . The average D ' tarig stood little more than four feet ( 122 cm ) tall .

title: Daardendrien Balasar
description: Daardendrien Balasar Daardendrien Balasar was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Daardendrien . He was a close friend of the paladin Medrash and Khouryn Skulldark of the Brotherhood of the Griffon , and the lover of Biri . He was a high - ranking member of the Lance Defenders .

title: Daardendrien Medrash
description: Daardendrien Medrash Daardendrien Medrash was a dragonborn member of Clan Daardendrien . He was a paladin of Torm , and later a follower of Bahamut . He was a good friend of the warrior Balasar .

title: Dabron Sashenstar
description: Dabron Sashenstar Dabron Sashenstar was a male human fighter , ranger , and merchant prince of the city of Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast in the mid – 14th century DR . He was an aristocrat and leader of House Sashenstar and he also owned and led the Merchant ’ s League based in the city . He was a renowned explorer , who journeyed across the Great Glacier and mapped a trade route to the fabled realm of Sossal .

title: Dabus
description: Dabus The dabus are a race unique to Sigil and are the personal entourage of the Lady of Pain . Dabus are humanoids with white hair , goatlike horns and yellow - tan skin . They float inches above the ground , their feet never touching the earth .

title: Dace Sontan
description: Dace Sontan Dace Sontan was the coordinator of the Spellhold prison in Amn , and the architect of the maze below it , where the sanity of the inmates of that asylum was tested . History . In 1369 DR , when Jon Irenicus and Bodhi took over Spellhold , the latter turned Dace into a vampire and ordered him to wait for Gorion ' s Ward in the dungeon under the prison .

title: Dackto
description: Dackto Dackto was a Maztican drider . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History .

title: Daeghun Farlong
description: Daeghun Farlong Daeghun Farlong was a male elven inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Personality . Following his wife ' s death , Daeghun was grim and harsh , especially to his foster child , the Kalach - Cha .

title: Daelan Red Tiger
description: Daelan Red Tiger Daelan Red Tiger is a male half - orc barbarian raised by the Uthgardt tribe of the Red Tiger . He is an honorable warrior out to prove himself in the world , hoping to amend for his father ' s orc blood , and to end the exile by his tribe . He carries a spectacular double - axe and also has a longbow for a ranged weapon , and makes a powerful tank for the player .

title: Daelegoth Orndeir
description: Daelegoth Orndeir Daelegoth Orndeir was a leader of the Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun as well as major proponent behind recent growth of belief in the Risen Sun heresy . Background . Born the only son of Morninglord Hatthala Orndeir , Daelegoth quickly embraced the ideologies of Lathander and rose quickly in the ranks of the church .

title: Daelyth ' s Dagger
description: Daelyth ' s Dagger Daelyth ' s Dagger was a deep dell in the Lost Peaks with old fortifications . Its lower entrance was a narrow path alongside a stream that was only wide enough for one humanoid to walk along , with steep rock sides . Its upper entrance was a steep trail leading higher up into the mountains .

title: Daemonfey
description: Daemonfey The Daemonfey are a clan of half - fiend s and fey ' ri who were imprisoned for over five thousand years and were freed in recent times . Although the term actually describes the organization , it is sometimes also used to mean the descendants of House Dlardrageth , who have royal demonic blood , and conversely the term " fey ' ri " is sometimes used to describe the descendants of the other corrupted houses of Siluvanede . History .

title: Daerlun
description: Daerlun Daerlun was a city in Sembia . Its most prominent feature was a huge 500 - foot - tall curtain wall erected by the Netherese Empire . Government .

title: Daern
description: Daern Daern of Hawksroost was a warrior from the village of Hawksroost in the Ride in the late 13th and early 14th centuries DR . History . Daern became a devoted companion of Flaergon of Glister , a priest of Ilmater who dedicated himself to assisting miners and caravan - workers in the frozen north of the Moonsea lands .

title: Daffir
description: Daffir Daffir the Prescient was a human member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath . History . Daffir was a human wizard diviner hailing from south Faerûn .

title: Daffyd
description: Daffyd Daffyd was a stonemason who lived in Gracklstugh . He believed he was a Morndin of Clan Ironstar . Description .

title: Daftar
description: Daftar A daftar was a Zakharan captain ' s most treasured item . Uses . Daftar comprised instructions , tables , charts , etc .

title: Dag Nost
description: Dag Nost The Dag Nost were a fairly large tribe of Nar found in Narfell that measured 3 , 200 strong in 1357 DR . Activities . Many travelers in and around Narfell considered the Dag Nost to be the most civilized of the Nar tribes .

title: Dag Zoreth
description: Dag Zoreth Dag Zoreth , born Brandon Caradoon , is a priest of Cyric and the estranged brother of Bronwyn Caradoon . Dag was captured by the Zhentarim when he was a young boy and raised into the ways of evil . This was despite the fact that he was the son of a paladin .

title: Dagagoorg
description: Dagagoorg Dagagoorg was a kuo - toa who was both the king of Sloopdilmonpolop and the high priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR . and 1372 DR Personality . Dagagoorg was totally crazy : he believed he ruled over a vast empire in Underdark and the seas above .

title: Dagan
description: Dagan Dagan , son of Belgin , blood of Jangarak was the last High Old One or high priest of Dumathoin in the lost dwarven kingdom of Thunderholme . He betrayed his people when the shadow dragon Aurgloroasa manipulated him into dedicating his newly anointed temple in the name of Null , the dragon god of death and undeath , and not his or his city ' s patron , Dumathoin . The priest then summoned Aurgloroasa , believing her to be an avatar of his deity .

title: Dagger
description: Dagger A dagger is a short , two - sided blade used for stabbing and thrusting . They are not as long as a short sword , but are larger than a common knife . Daggers are also easily thrown as improvised ranged weapons and are excellent for use in an off - hand for those who prefer dual - wielding melee weapons .

title: Dagger Falls
description: Dagger Falls Daggers Falls was a large , stone - walled town in the Daggerdale region of the Dalelands . The town was situated near a steep waterfall of the same name . Defenses .

title: Dagger Hills
description: Dagger Hills The Dagger Hills were located south - east of Daggerdale . Description . In the mid – 14th century DR , the sparse human settlements , mostly small farms , dwindled during the Zhent occupation of Daggerdale and the hills became covered with dense thickets and thorn fields , resistant to fire and human intrusion .

title: Dagger of chaos
description: Dagger of chaos A dagger of chaos was a magic blade carrying a strange curse that transformed the wielder into many different forms . History . In the time of Netheril , the " dagger of chaos " was given to Serreg of Neverwinter by the god of war , Targus .

title: Dagger of defiance
description: Dagger of defiance A dagger of defiance is a magical dagger , first created in Myth Drannor , that grants the wielder an immunity to fear and repulsion , and enables the wielder to more easily resist the effects of enchantments , charms , polymorphs and petrification . Such a weapon requires a standard dagger , doppleganger blood , distilled essence of xorn flesh , and the casting of " fear " and " repulsion " spells . As of 1368 DR , the value of such a dagger was around 1 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Dagger of fiery demise
description: Dagger of fiery demise The dagger of fiery demise was a wicked magic weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . These daggers appeared to be slightly curved " jambiya s " .

title: Dagger of quickness
description: Dagger of quickness Daggers of quickness were wonderful magic weapons found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magic weapons could be found in many forms including common daggers , dirk s , " jambiya s " , knives , razors , and " katar s " .

title: Dagger of the Evil Eye
description: Dagger of the Evil Eye Daggers of the Evil Eye were magical weapons that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons could be found in any dagger form including jambiya s , dirk s , stiletto s , etc .

title: Dagger of truth
description: Dagger of truth Daggers of truth were cursed weapons that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . As with non - magical dagger s , these weapons were available in a wide variety of shapes and sizes .

title: Daggerdale
description: Daggerdale Daggerdale ( originally named Merrydale ) is a remote region of the Dalelands located between the Desertsmouth Mountains and the Dagger Hills . It is a region of dark forests and rocky hills with a single large settlement named Dagger Falls . Geography .

title: Daggerford
description: Daggerford Daggerford was a town that lay along the Shining River on the Sword Coast in the Western Heartlands . It was a walled town with a population of approximately 900 , with a number of outlying hamlets , farms , and estates bringing the population to over 2 , 000 . The town was strategically placed along the Trade Way and fortified by the local duke ' s dwarven - built castle .

title: Daggermaster
description: Daggermaster Daggermasters , also sometimes called invisible blades , are deadly rogue s who prefer to use light blade s , particularly dagger s , in combat . Their training and techniques with these weapons make them just as lethal as most well - armed fighter s . As a result , daggermasters have a frightful reputation , one they enjoy cultivating through exaggeration .

title: Dagh Illance
description: Dagh Illance Dagh Illance was a knight and a member of the Illance noble family in Cormyr who rode with Alusair Obarskyr . Personality . He was hot tempered and battle - hungry , but Alusair thought him a fool like Martin Illance and the rest of their family .

title: Dagna Waybeard
description: Dagna Waybeard Dagna Waybeard was the dwarven general and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall ' s armed forces . Description . The general was broad shouldered and huge by dwarf standards .

title: Dagnabbet
description: Dagnabbet Dagnabbet was the general of Mithral Hall in Luruar . History . Dagnabbet served as general under King Connerad Brawnanvil in 1484 DR during the Darkening , a time when Mithral Hall was under threat from the orc s of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows .

title: Dagnabbit
description: Dagnabbit Dagnabbit was the son of dwarven general Dagna and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall ' s armed forces , as well as a companion of Bruenor Battlehammer , although not considered part of the Companions of the Hall . History . Dagnabbit ' s primary role was to protect King Bruenor , a role given to him by Gandalug Battlehammer .

title: Dagon
description: Dagon Dagon is a demon lord , also called Prince of the Depths . His realm is the 89th layer of the Abyss , and is known as Shadowsea . Dagon is an obyrith .

title: Dagsumm
description: Dagsumm Dagsumm was a wizard in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Dagsumm was friendly and could be relied onto honor an agreement , but he had a hunger for new magic and was fastidious with regard to details .

title: Dagult Neverember
description: Dagult Neverember Dagult Neverember was the Open Lord of Waterdeep and the Lord Protector of New Neverwinter around 1479 DR . In 1489 DR , he focused entirely in his role as Lord Protector of Neverwinter . He also was a member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Dahl Peredur
description: Dahl Peredur Dahl Peredur was an antiquarian and Harper apprentice . He was formerly a novice Oghman paladin but he fell from grace for reasons he didn ' t understand . History .

title: Dahlia Sin ' felle
description: Dahlia Sin ' felle Dahlia Sin ' felle , originally known as Dahlia Syn ' dalay , was a young elf originally in the service of Szass Tam . She later traveled for a time with Drizzt Do ' Urden and became his lover . After her apparent death , she was rescued by Quenthel Baenre to serve as the figurehead matron mother of the restored House Do ' Urden .

title: Dahlia Vhammos
description: Dahlia Vhammos Dahlia Vhammos was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Lady Dahlia was a medium - height slender woman .

title: Dai - Oni ( tengu )
description: Dai - Oni ( tengu ) The " Dai - Oni " was a disguised tengu master of the Black Temple in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . A tengu in 1357 DR had an idea for a great joke : he disguised himself as a dai - oni ( or " great oni " ) and became a leader of some raiders .

title: Daidoji Rakan
description: Daidoji Rakan Daidoji Rakan was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and also a jito in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . He controlled affairs in Takeo village in the center of a very beautiful Niwa shoen .

title: Daidoji Tadako
description: Daidoji Tadako Daidoji Tadako was a samurai that run a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . in a post house very near to Tamanokuni he led three bushi .

title: Daile Redfletching
description: Daile Redfletching Appearance . She has short red - gold hair and blue eyes . Daile is the daughter of Ren O ' The Blade and Druid Priestess who died when Daile was young .

title: Daisake Mayazato
description: Daisake Mayazato Daisake Mayazato was a wu jen in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . As an effect of his old age , Daisake had become senile and obsessed with some ideas for no real reason .

title: Daitya
description: Daitya Daitya was the stone giant ruler of the Lodge of Faces . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Daitya and all her fellows succumbed to the " faerzress " - infected madness caused by the Purple Statue .

title: Dak Zarre
description: Dak Zarre Dak Zarre was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Dak led the Blood Hawks mercenary company , composed of many Turmish warriors .

title: Dakhim el Yndhar
description: Dakhim el Yndhar Dakhim el Yndhar was a former caleph arcane of Almraiven . While one of the most powerful wizards alive in Calimshan in 1370 DR , the elderly wizard chose to live as a hermit in one of the minarets in northern Memnon . From his simple - looking tower , he spent his time making specialty magic carpet s and other magic item variants .

title: Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi
description: Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi Dakim ibn Mu ' izzi was a goblin employee of the House of Al - Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The success of the Al - Kamari silk ventures was largely due to Dakim ' s skill and ingenuity .

title: Dala Silmerhelve
description: Dala Silmerhelve Dala Silmerhelve was a member of House Silmerhelve in 1489 DR . Personality . Dala deeply believed that evil must be defeated all time .

title: Dalabrac Bramblefoot
description: Dalabrac Bramblefoot Dalabrac Bramblefoot was a male halfling member of the Fire Knives during the Second Sundering . History . Dalabrac was an important leader of the Fire Knives in Westgate and he had many dealings with the pirate Anton Marivaldi .

title: Dalagar ' s Dagger
description: Dalagar ' s Dagger Dalagar ' s Dagger was the highest peak in the northeast section of the Nether Mountains . History . The Dagger was named after Dalagar the dwarf who tried to climb the mountain around 372 DR and fell to his death .

title: Dalagor
description: Dalagor Dalagor the Cold was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Dalagor earned his nickname for his approach to his business , without emotion but with calculation and cruelty .

title: Dalai Lama
description: Dalai Lama The Dalai Lama was the spiritual leader and ruler for the nation of Ra - Khati in the Hordelands . Etymology . The phrase meant " ocean spirit father " .

title: Dalat
description: Dalat The Dalat were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Dalat lived in the southern region of the Endless Waste .

title: Dalat language
description: Dalat language Dalat was a language of the Hordelands . Description . Dalat had harsh consonant sounds , especially its Ks , and the sound of L was aspirated .

title: Dalath ' s Span
description: Dalath ' s Span Dalath ' s Span was a bridge across the River Mirar in the city of Luskan . History . As of 1370 DR , at the south end of the bridge , there was a Harper symbol under a high window , and those in search of a Harper could make a seal noise during the night to summon one .

title: Dale Donovan
description: Dale Donovan Dale A . Donovan is a freelance author , editor , and game designer . He was an editor for " Dragon " magazine for over five years .

title: Daleen Duerna
description: Daleen Duerna Daleen Duerna was the duergar Laird of Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . Daleen became the reigning Laird fifty years before when she murdered her father .

title: Dalekeva
description: Dalekeva Dalekeva , also known as Oberon ' s Hold , was a Low City near Tinnainen in Netheril . History . During the Shadowed Age , members of the Beneficent Traders ' Guild of Dalekeva requested an audience with Lady Polaris ' High Steward Candlemas to beg the Netherese to protect their city from the orc and human army of the One King , who destroyed their neighboring city of Tinnainen .

title: Dalelands
description: Dalelands The Dalelands is a region neighbored by the kingdom of Cormyr to the southwest , the nation of Sembia to the south , the forest of Cormanthor to the northeast and the Anauroch desert ( over the Desertsmouth Mountains ) to the northwest . It is most famous for being the home of the wizard Elminster . Some say Dalelanders originally came from the Great Dale .

title: Daleport
description: Daleport Daleport was a tiny village situated in the Barony of Polten on the border with the Barony of Morov where the Icelace River met Lake Mogador . History . Daleport existed because its clever founders realized that caravans needed a safer way to cross between the two baronies .

title: Dales Council
description: Dales Council The Dales Council meets once a year at Midwinter to decide on important matters that affect multiple members of the Dalelands . Each dale sends a delegate to the council to agree upon matter such as trade routes , foreign relations , common defense and various objections against other dales . Lately many meetings have concerned the growing threat of Drow in Cormanthor and the Zhents .

title: Dalfred Noakes
description: Dalfred Noakes Dalfred Noakes was a halfling innkeeper in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Dalfred ran the Narbondel ' s Shadow , an inn and the " finest rooming house in Menzoberranzan " in Eastmyr district .

title: Dalia bint Khalil
description: Dalia bint Khalil Dalia bint Khalil was a the youngest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Like her older sister Janya , Dalis lived in the Royal Harim for the first few years of her life before being moved to a secure location within Al - Akara Mountains .

title: Dalilah al - Nakar
description: Dalilah al - Nakar Dalilah al - Nakar was Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s first wife . Description . Dalilah was a mature beauty in her mid 40s in 1367 DR .

title: Dalmar
description: Dalmar Dalmar was a human abbot and cleric of Chauntea who led the monk s of the Green Lady ' s Keep , a temple to Chauntea in Velprintalar , Aglarond , around 1368 DR . Personality . The abbot enjoyed making and drinking the strong ale brewed in the abbey .

title: Dalren
description: Dalren Lord Dalren was a noble of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . During the war against Luskan , Lord Dalren supplied Lord Nasher with troops and resources to fight the Luskan forces .

title: Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth
description: Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth was a male moon elf wilder and a younger member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . Around 1374 DR , Dalthoeneir Delthoenoth had emerged as the leader of an expansionist contingent within the Kaliesh ' erai , younger members who desired contact with non - elven psionicists , and perhaps even allow them to join the Kaliesh ' erai .

title: Daltim ' s Tome of Fire
description: Daltim ' s Tome of Fire Daltim ' s Tome of Fire was a spellbook written by the wizard and psionicist Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . It contained a number of rare and unique fire - based spell s , details on several light - and fire - themed magical items , and brief treatises on fire magic , psionics , and the creation of psionically empowered items . It was lost , presumed stolen , in Tethyr in the 1360s DR .

title: Daltim ' s fiery protector
description: Daltim ' s fiery protector Daltim ' s fiery protector was an arcane conjuration / enchantment spell that summoned and bound a minor fire elemental to defend a certain item . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .

title: Daltim ' s fiery tentacles
description: Daltim ' s fiery tentacles Daltim ' s fiery tentacles was an arcane conjuration spell that caused flaming tentacles to emerge from the ground and grapple and burn creatures within reach . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .

title: Daltim ' s flaming fist
description: Daltim ' s flaming fist Daltim ' s flaming fist was an arcane evocation spell that created a fiery fist to strike one ' s foes . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa and was his signature spell . Effects .

title: Daltim ' s proof against fire
description: Daltim ' s proof against fire Daltim ' s proof against fire was an arcane abjuration spell that bestowed a permanent immunity to fire upon an object . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .

title: Daltim Flamefist
description: Daltim Flamefist Daltim Flamefist was a male Halruaan human wizard and psionicist from the realm of Halruaa in south Faerûn . He was well known as a powerful noble of Halruaa ; as the commander of the Destroyers , a mercenary company of mages and psionicists ; and for his groundbreaking research into fire magic , psionics , and the creation and reproduction of magical and psionic items . Description .

title: Dalvar Corzon
description: Dalvar Corzon Dalvar Corzon was a captain of the Cormyrean Freesails in 1359 DR . History . Dalvar was trained by the clerics of Mielikki .

title: Dalzhel
description: Dalzhel History . Dalzhel was a skilled warrior of Zhentil Keep and during the Time of Troubles he was in the Zhentilar army stationed in Scardale . Dalzhel was promoted to lieutenant of the Company of the Scorpions under Cyric .

title: Dama
description: Dama Dama was a rebel leader in the Unther in 1357 DR . History . Once Dama was a gladiator in Chessenta but was captured to Thayan slavers and sold to a Unther ' s freeholder .

title: Damara
description: Damara Damara was a sparsely populated kingdom in the Cold Lands of Northeast Faerûn . In 1357 DR it was ruled by King Virdin . Later ruled by King Gareth Dragonsbane as of 1371 DR , and , with Vaasa , formed the Bloodstone Lands .

title: Damaran language
description: Damaran language Damaran was a regional language of Northeast Faerûn and the official language of the kingdom of Damara . Damaran was the major dialect of Chardic . Speakers .

title: Damarite Red
description: Damarite Red Damarite Red was a cheese crafted in Damara within the Bloodstone Lands . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Dambrath
description: Dambrath Dambrath was a nation on the southern coast of Faerûn . It was notable as it was formerly ruled by a race of human , drow and elves collectively known as the Crinti , who comprised the upper class . Dambrath was a predominantly isolationist nation , though they did allow some limited trade with outsiders .

title: Dambrathan language
description: Dambrathan language Dambrathan was a regional tongue of south Faerûn and the nation of Dambrath . Speakers . Dambrathan was spoken primarily by the people of Dambrath , including the Arkaiun s .

title: Damian Krale
description: Damian Krale Damian Krale is a worshiper of Shar who has been tasked by the Mistress of the Night to unite cells dedicated to her worship throughout the Western Heartlands . The ultimate goal of his endeavours is mostly a secret and only a few of the leaders of the cells know what it is . Physical appearance .

title: Damien
description: Damien Damien was the son of Gaspar the Fishmonger in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The young boy dressed in brown clothing .

title: Damien Oneknife
description: Damien Oneknife Damien Oneknife was a deadly assassin living in Faerûn during the decades following the Time of Troubles ( 1358 DR ) . He was known for being opportunistic in battle , and he always tried to benefit from the assets of his enemies . One such battle saw him barely survive against a group of ghouls .

title: Damlath
description: Damlath Damlath ( nicknamed the Laughing Mage ) was a wizard . Appearance . Damlath was dark - skinned .

title: Damos
description: Damos The Damos is a powerful artifact of Imaskari origin . It appears as a round , silver disk with a reservoir holding black fluid in the center . Anyone drinking the liquid is able to see the future with certainty .

title: Dan Mishkin
description: Dan Mishkin Dan Mishkin is a comic book writer for . Collaborations . Since his teenage years , Mishkin has collaborated with writer , and they entered the comics industry together .

title: Dan Zor
description: Dan Zor Dan Zor was a male human samurai and the hereditary leader of the island kingdom of Saishu in Koryo , before becoming its governor , with the title " Master of Cheju " . He was also a noted sage . History .

title: Danactar the High Artificer
description: Danactar the High Artificer The heart of Gond ' s church is the High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration in the city of Illul in Lantan . This monastery is run by Danactar the High Artificer , Most Holy Servant of Gond . Danactar is the highest ranking mortal cleric of Gond ; he is the supreme voice in ecclesiastical matters and he serves in Lantan ' s ruling council , the Ayrorch .

title: Dance of ruin
description: Dance of ruin Dance of ruin is a necromancy spell that seriously damages non - demon s . To cast this spell , the caster dances wildly and chants . After they finish their dance , a wave of crackling energy flashes outward up to the extent of the range .

title: Dance of the Dolphins
description: Dance of the Dolphins The Dance of the Dolphins was a spectacle that occurred in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath . It was the synchronized movement of thousands of dolphin s that gave the appearance of a dance . History .

title: Dancing Dell
description: Dancing Dell The Dancing Dell was a dell containing the Ladystone , a sacred stone touched by Eilistraee . The stone was very old , possibly dating back as far as the early settlements of Ardeep . Description .

title: Dancing Dwarves
description: Dancing Dwarves The Dancing Dwarves was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Kor , the Zakharan god of wisdom . The symbol and favored weapon of the Dancing Dwarves was a battle - axe . Activities .

title: Dancing hart
description: Dancing hart The dancing hart was a magical chalice that was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a deer that held a cup in its antlers .

title: Dancing lightning
description: Dancing lightning Dancing lightning is an evocation spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training that is similar to " lightning bolt " . When a sorcerer casts " dancing lightning " , he or she causes lightning to strike from the sky into a target at some fifty feet or less . Thunder subsequently booms around the target as well , dealing further damage .

title: Dancing lights
description: Dancing lights Dancing lights was an evocation or alteration spell that produced levitating lights that could move at the caster ' s direction . Effects . All versions of this spell produced up to four floating lights that could be made to appear as torches , lanterns , or as orbs vaguely resembling will - o ' - wisp s .

title: Dang Caverns
description: Dang Caverns The Dang Caverns were a series of caves lying beneath the northeastern Ziyero Ridge in Koryo . Description . The caverns were vast and extensive with hundreds of levels .

title: Danica Maupoissant
description: Danica Maupoissant Danica Bonaduce , formerly known as Danica Maupoissant , was a human monk . She was the wife of Cadderly Bonaduce and mother of their three children . Description .

title: Danifae Yauntyrr
description: Danifae Yauntyrr Danifae Yauntyrr was a stunningly beautiful drow cleric who eventually would became the " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen of Lolth ) , a part of Lolth herself . Description . Danifae was described as very beautiful .

title: Danilo Thann
description: Danilo Thann Danilo Thann was a young Waterdhavian nobleman of House Thann , the sixth son of Rhammas and Cassandra . He was also an ex - Harper as well as a former Lord of Waterdeep . While first and foremost married to Arilyn Moonblade , Danilo counted many other great Faerûnians among the ranks of those to whom he was close .

title: Dannal Harftevor
description: Dannal Harftevor Dannal Harftevor was a half - elf male cavalry officer in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Originally from Tethyr , Dannal joined the Council Army Cavalry and rose to the rank of lieutenant . Due to the treatment of arcane spellcaster s in Amn , Dannal kept his wizard ly skills a closely guarded secret .

title: Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods
description: Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods Dannath ' s Pickles , Nuts , & Foods was a shop located in the city of Yartar on the Savage Frontier in northwest Faerûn . Operation . It was owned and run by Alukk Dannath and his three daughters .

title: Danthra
description: Danthra Danthra ( often called Danthra the Dreamer , a name chosen by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ) was a companion to Tsarra Chaadren , and considered Tsarra her best friend . Description . Danthra was very thin with a delicate build , long dark straight hair , and a wan complexion .

title: Dantrag Baenre
description: Dantrag Baenre Dantrag Baenre was a drow fighter , and the weapons master of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Description . A talented swordsman , Dantrag was unusually tall for a drow , closer to 6 ft ( 1 .

title: Danyig
description: Danyig Danyig was a skilled blacksmith who lived in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Danyig was easily the most skilled blacksmith within the entire city .

title: Dao
description: Dao The dao were a variation of genie from the Elemental Plane of Earth . Dao often ran gem - mining operations there or on the Material Plane . They could especially be found in the wild regions of Zakhara .

title: Dao Khanate
description: Dao Khanate The Dao Khanate was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the dao . Organization . The Great Khan , Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil , ruled over all of the noble dao comprising the Dao Khanate .

title: Dao mazework
description: Dao mazework Dao mazeworks were the homes of noble dao who lived far from the vast Sevenfold Mazework . Location . These structures were typically located somewhere on the Elemental Plane of Earth , but could be found on other planes as well .

title: Daoine Teague Feer
description: Daoine Teague Feer Daoine Teague Feer also called The Star Enchantment was an ancient ritual performed by the forest elves of Shilmista in the Snowflake Mountains . History . The ritual was usually attended only by elves .

title: Daolani
description: Daolani Daolani , or sand gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Sand gen had tanned skin and dark black hair .

title: Dar al - Kalif
description: Dar al - Kalif Dar al - Kalif , or the Crystal Palace , was the royal palace of Abu Bakr , Caliph of Semphar . Location . Dar al - Kalif was located in the heart of Dhaztanar .

title: Daraq
description: Daraq Daraq were the Zakhara n counterpart to the common buckler . Description . Small , and light , these shields were favored by the desert warriors of Zakhara .

title: Daraqadim
description: Daraqadim El Daraqadim was a former Calishite manor located in Calimmon County in Tethyr and was one of the keeps of the duke of Ankramir before the Interregnum period . After the Reclamation Wars , the keep became the county seat of Calimmon and the home of Her Excellency Kyrin Hawkwinter . Countess Hawkwinter prefered to call the manor The Cliff , instead of its old Alzhedo name .

title: Darastriverthicha
description: Darastriverthicha Darastriverthicha was an ancient dragon kingdom ruled by Caesinsjach , a mighty green dragon . Its name means " Dragon Mountain " . Among its vassal states was Darastrixhurthi , a nation of kobold s ruled by her spawn , Kurtulmak , located in what is now the Shoal of Thirst .

title: Darathra Shendrel
description: Darathra Shendrel Darathra Shendrel was the ruler of Triboar and a member of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Darathra was an adventurer from Waterdeep in her youth , during which time she joined the Harpers .

title: Darbukkah
description: Darbukkah The darbukkah ( dar - BOOK - kah ) was a medium - sized Zakharan drum . Description . The " darbukkah " was a vase - shaped drum that was wider at the top .

title: Darcassan
description: Darcassan Darcassan the Farseer was a male sun elf diviner of Windsong Tower . History . During his tenure as an elder of Windsong Tower , Darcassan came close to perfecting a method of using illusion s to create simulacra of himself that were telepathically linked and could be used to better defend the Tower from unruly students or outside forces .

title: Dardren
description: Dardren Dardren was a wizard from Memnon in Calimshan , of the 13th century DR . Dardren was slain by Glaragama Dunrohiyr , a rogue archmage who ' d disguised herself as a man . When she killed Dardren , she revealed her true form , then stole all his magic .

title: Daren Timbide
description: Daren Timbide Daren Timbide was a general of the Banite army stationed at Mintar in 1372 DR . Activities . A fervent worshiper of Bane , Daren was known for the speed with which he rose through the ranks of that evil army .

title: Darfin Floshin
description: Darfin Floshin Sir Darfin Floshin was a sun elf advisor in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . History . Darfin was the son of Elorfindar Floshin , who acted as guardian of a portal nexus connecting the Ardeep Forest to Evermeet .

title: Dargoth
description: Dargoth Dargoth was a merchant who was a member of the Peldar Merchant Fleet , but he was also one of the Wearers of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in Sembia . History . As a leader of the Cult , he was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR .

title: Daria
description: Daria Daria the Hammer was a mercenary recruiter in Waterdeep . Activities . Daria was a talented merchant but was also the best - known mercenary recruiter in the City of Splendors .

title: Darien
description: Darien Darien was a Szarkai before Lolth turned her into a albino - drider during the Night of Wailing . Once she had been sent by the drow of Maztica to Faerûn where she should find a tool for their plans of getting full control over the cult of Zaltec in her home . She found the young soldier Cordell and helped him to survive a lost battle .

title: Daring acrobat
description: Daring acrobat A daring acrobat is a rogue who has learned to master acrobat ic techniques . Wondrous to behold these daring acrobats might be professional performers , religious devotees of Tempus or Tymora , or expert thieves . Some obtain their skills from a school and others from a family tradition , while most of the remainder are self - taught , learning their skills as a matter of self - preservation .

title: Darius Bormul VI
description: Darius Bormul VI Darius Bormul VI was a Council of Six ' s envoy in Maztica in 1370 DR . Activities . Lord Darius was concerned about the apparent disinterest of Governor Cordell to maintain the Council ' s hold over Maztica after the settling of New Waterdeep .

title: Dark - Eyed One
description: Dark - Eyed One The Dark - Eyed One was an adventurer and mage in the ruin of Spellgard . History . The Dark - Eyed One was an evil adventurer member of the Free Company of the Crescent .

title: Dark Army of the Night
description: Dark Army of the Night The Dark Army of Night was formed by Lord Vanrak Moonstar , a minor Waterdeep noble , after his father was killed by a mysterious , uncurable wasting disease that was possibly brought back with him after Vanrak returned from an expedition to the Black Jungles of Tashalar . Vanrak , his body and mind weakened by his arduous travels , was overcome with grief and blamed the priests of Selûne from the High House of Stars for his father ' s death . So engrossed in his grief , Vanrak was an easy convert to Shar ' s worship .

title: Dark Arrow Keep
description: Dark Arrow Keep King Obould XVII ruled the Kingdom of Many - Arrows from the central chamber in this trapped fortress . Known for its slit - covered , confounding corridors and blind alleys , Dark Arrow Keep also housed the Pit ; an arena used by the King to judge his chieftains and mete out brutal punishments . Description .

title: Dark Dagger
description: Dark Dagger The Dark Dagger was a widespread group of Vhaeraun - worshiping drow . Their goal was to increase the influence of the drow on the surface and to gain power to fight against the church of Lolth . Headquarters .

title: Dark Disaster
description: Dark Disaster The Dark Disaster , or the Killing Storms , was a tragedy in - 10 , 500 DR that totally turned the territory of the elven kingdom of Miyeritar into a barren wasteland . History . In - 11800 DR , the elven nation of Miyeritar was annexed by another elven nation called Aryvandaar and pacified by - 11300 DR .

title: Dark Diviners
description: Dark Diviners A cadre of wizard ' s based in Myth Drannor ' s Windsong Tower , the Dark Diviners discovered the tome the Book of the Black . Written ( in part ) by the Netherese seer Augathra the Mad , the book revealed many of the goddess Shar ' s dark secrets . The Dark Diviners wrote of their findings and insights in the Leaves of One Night .

title: Dark Dominion
description: Dark Dominion All of the tunnels within a 5 mile radius of Menzoberranzan are known as the Dark Dominion . Drow patrols are a constant presence of the region . They search for banned creatures , monsters and surface elves and challenge them once spotted .

title: Dark Eight
description: Dark Eight The Dark Eight were a coven of pit fiend generals who resided on the Ninth Layer of Hell , Nessus . They plotted and strategized the movements of Hell ' s armies . Bel , Lord of the First Layer , was once a mighty leader on the battlefields of the War , and used his influence with the Dark Eight to retain control of Avernus .

title: Dark Exodus
description: Dark Exodus The mystery of the Gray migrations remains a puzzle to all folk in the Delimbiyr Vale save the High Forest orc s themselves , and none of them are willing to talk about it . The party ventures into the tusker ' s former home to find out why , only to be attacked by drow ! A treant then tasks them with saving a large number of fey who are being held hostage by the drow .

title: Dark God Reformed
description: Dark God Reformed The Dark God Reformed was a temple and walled compound dedicated to Cyric in Voonlar . In the days before the supposed death of Bane , the Black Hand , it was a Banite temple named The Dark Lord ' s Hand , and it had other names under previous leaders . Location .

title: Dark Hollow
description: Dark Hollow Dark Hollow was a village in the Vast , lying on the crossroads of the Hlintar Ride and Feldar ' s Trail , between Bambryn , Fallentree , Dragon Falls and Highbank Forest , in the Fire River uplands . Description . Dark Hollow was a small village and named for the valley it sat in , which was shaded by many trees .

title: Dark House
description: Dark House The Dark House was the name taken by a group of exiled Waterdavian lordlings who took to banditry along the Southern Sword Coast beginning around 1440 DR and was still active as of 1479 DR . The gang was led by the notorious Blakrho " Blackthroat " Phull .

title: Dark Linsa
description: Dark Linsa Dark Linsa was a Welcomers thief during the late 1480s DR . History . Linsa was a thief in Phlan working for the Welcomers thieves guild .

title: Dark Moon heresy
