description: Dark Moon heresy The Dark Moon heresy was the belief that Selûne and Shar were two aspects of the same deity . Believers of this doctrine could be found teaching it to others . Origin .

title: Dark Seldarine
description: Dark Seldarine The Dark Seldarine was the drow pantheon of gods . Overview . The Dark Seldarine , the pantheon of the drow , was led by Lolth , the Spider Queen .

title: Dark Shrine
description: Dark Shrine The Dark Shrine was a temple which was the seat of orthodox worship of Bane in Zhentil Keep . History . In 1268 DR , Fzoul Chembryl took control of the Dark Shrine of Bane and the Black Altar .

title: Dark Speech
description: Dark Speech Dark Speech is the secret language of evil god s , a language of such evil that demon s and devil s avoid speaking it , for fear it might consume them . It is extremely difficult for mortals to learn even a single word of it , but each word is full of dread power that can be used to provoke emotions , empower magic , or corrupt physical objects . Fiend s find the language easier to learn than mortals do .

title: Dark Watch
description: Dark Watch The Dark Watch was a mercenary company based in the Orsraun Mountains and active in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Organization . The company was a group of archers mounted on hippogriff s .

title: Dark Wave
description: Dark Wave The Dark Wave was a small group of holy slayer s that were operating out of Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . The Dark Wave served the Cult of Istishia , against their will .

title: Dark Weavings Bazaar
description: Dark Weavings Bazaar The Dark Weavings Bazaar is the marketplace of the city of Sshamath , at the bottom of the cave . In hundreds of tents and small shops in stalagmites the visitor can buy almost everything . If he does not find what he is looking for , he can hire someone to find it for him , even humans to go search for the item in the world above .

title: Dark Wind Stables
description: Dark Wind Stables The Dark Wind Stables were located within the great fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Basalt floors and white - washed stone walls adorned the stables .

title: Dark aura
description: Dark aura Dark aura was a divine magic spell available to priests of Cyric , the Mad God . It surrounded the caster with a gloomy atmosphere that greatly improved the caster ' s combat ability and , to a lesser extent , that of all evil - aligned creatures within the vicinity . At the same time , it hindered the combat ability of good - aligned creatures .

title: Dark creature
description: Dark creature A dark creature was a type of creature that had a strong connection to the Plane of Shadow , possessing a supernatural ability to hide in shadows and other powers . Description . Dark creatures resembled their counterparts on the Material Plane , though they were strange and distorted reflections .

title: Dark creeper
description: Dark creeper The dark creepers were a race of humanoid s dwelling in the Underdark . They were natural rogue s with powers of stealth and shadow . They were one of the two subraces of the dark one s .

title: Dark elf
description: Dark elf Dark elves , were elves , known as Ssri - tel - quessir in the elven tongue , and were the ancestors of the drow . The two terms were oftentimes used interchangeably , even by elves ( Tel - quessir ) themselves . Dark elves had dark brown skin , as opposed to the ebony skin that drow presently have .

title: Dark embrace
description: Dark embrace Dark embrace was a spell used by priests of Vhaeraun to store a spell for rapid use at a later time . Effects . On casting , a dark mask was created around the face , in which a second spell could be stored .

title: Dark mirror
description: Dark mirror Dark mirror was a combination abjuration and alteration spell that could counter , reflect , or penetrate " darkness " spells . Effects . This spell had three variants , one of which had to be chosen at the time of casting .

title: Dark naga
description: Dark naga A dark naga was a naga subspecies that looked like a large purple snake or eel with a barbed stinger at the end of its tail and a human face . Dark nagas could speak Common and Infernal . They liked to plot with other creatures of evil alignment so that they could gather wealth more easily .

title: Dark one
description: Dark one The dark ones were a race of humanoid s dwelling in the Underdark . They were natural rogue s with powers of stealth and shadow . They were divided into two subraces : the short , gnome - like dark creeper s and the human - like dark stalker s .

title: Dark promise
description: Dark promise Dark promise was a divine magic spell available to priests of Bane , the Black Lord . It put the victim under a type of " geas " that adversely affected his or her health each time the " promise " was broken . After Bane ' s supposed death in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , Cyric granted spells to Banite priests for a decade , so it was possible this spell could be found within the church of Cyric .

title: Dark stalker
description: Dark stalker The dark stalkers were a race of humanoid s dwelling in the Underdark . They were natural rogue s with powers of stealth and shadow . They were one of the two subraces of the dark one s .

title: Dark tree
description: Dark tree A dark tree was an evil intelligent tree that looked like a cypress tree , but slightly darker and devoid of moss . It was known to grapple and bite . It lived on drinking blood from human s and other intelligent creatures that wandered into its native jungle .

title: Darkas
description: Darkas Darkas the Storyteller was a half - elven woman who dwelled in Memnon in Calimshan through the 13th and 14th centuries DR . At over a century old by 1370 DR , she was gray - haired and had only one eye , but it remained keenly observant . She had a very good memory of her long life in Memnon , and clearly knew all the rumors and happenings about the city .

title: Darkberry
description: Darkberry Darkberry was a type of berry bush found in forests around the Sea of Fallen Stars . They grew in clumps hidden deep in the forests . Darkberry bushes produced small purple berries , only a few of which ripened each fall , and they were growing rarer every year by 1372 DR .

title: Darkbolt
description: Darkbolt Darkbolt was an evocation spell unique to cleric s with the Darkness domain . It released bolts of darkness that damaged and dazed the target . Effect .

title: Darkdance Manor
description: Darkdance Manor Darkdance Manor was a large decrepit manor located in the west end of Westgate near Tidetown . Structure . The manor had been maintained for years by the family ' s loyal dwarf servant Elevar .

title: Darkening
description: Darkening The Darkening was the name given to a spell that cast shadows over the Silver Marches in preparation for the drow and orc invasion of that land starting in 1484 DR . The spell was given to the drow wizard Tsabrak Xorlarrin by the illithid Methil El - Viddenvelp by the order of Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre . While casting the spell , Tsabrak was said to have served as a conduit of Lolth , the first such occurrence since Yvonnel Baenre channeled Lolth in when destroying House Oblodra in 1358 / 1359 DR .

title: Darkflow River
description: Darkflow River The Darkflow River , or simply the Darkflow , was a short river in the Vast Swamp that formed part of the border between Cormyr and Sembia in the east . Geography . The source of the Darkflow lay in the heart of the Vast Swamp , being fed by the marsh - water itself , and it flowed south into the Lake of Dragons .

title: Darkhold
description: Darkhold Darkhold , originally called The Keep of the Fallen Hills , was the western stronghold of the Zhentarim , located near the Sunset Mountains in the Western Heartlands . Government . In 1372 DR , Darkhold was led by the Pereghost , who commanded its 800 warriors , and Dhamir Ercals , who led the resident clerics of Cyric .

title: Darklake
description: Darklake The Darklake was a series of connected bodies of water in the Underdark . They were formerly linked by waterfalls but later governed by locks created by dwarven engineers . Geography .

title: Darklands
description: Darklands The Darklands were located underneath the heart of Faerûn and formed an important domain of the Underdark . Geography . Located above the Darklands was the Dragon Coast , portions of the Orsraun Mountains , Turmish , and Chessenta .

title: Darkling
description: Darkling Darklings were a lineage of fey that suffered a curse from the Summer Queen , forever doomed to absorb light and to suffer rapid aging from exposure to it . The absorbed light over the lifetime of a darkling was explosively released at the time of its death , destroying its body and much of its surroundings . Society .

title: Darkmaiden ' s Leap
description: Darkmaiden ' s Leap Darkmaiden ' s Leap was a shrine sacred to the goddess Eilistraee and her followers , found in the northern High Forest , southeast of Everlund . Description . Darkmaiden ' s Leap was a small clearing with a large flat - top gray rock about six feet tall and five feet in diamater .

title: Darkmask
description: Darkmask The Darkmask was a special divine caster of Vhaeraun . They were considered the elite among the clerics . Becoming a Darkmask .

title: Darkness
description: Darkness Darkness was an evocation or alteration spell that created an area impenetrable to normal light . Effects . The area shrouded by this spell was 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Darkness , 15 ' radius
description: Darkness , 15 ' radius Darkness , 15 ' radius ( originally , Fahren ' s darkness ) was an alteration spell that made an area impervious to normal light . Effects . This spell was similar to " darkness " except for the smaller radius of effect ( 15 ft / 4 .

title: Darkness domain
description: Darkness domain The Darkness domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters darkness spell powers . There are two versions of this domain : one from the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting " ( 3rd Edition ) , and the other from the " Book of Vile Darkness " . Cleric s can select their spells from either list at the DM ' s discretion .

title: Darksong Knight
description: Darksong Knight Darksong Knights were the elite warriors of Eilistraee , famed for their tireless hunting of the demonic agents of Lolth . They were mostly active in the lands of ancient Ilythiir . As of the 1490s DR , post Second Sundering , the Darksong Knights were very much active , but existed only in small numbers .

title: Darkstalker Wars
description: Darkstalker Wars The Darkstalker Wars were a series of battles between the various guild thieves and assassin s of Calimshan in the wake of the death of Bhaal . They were the first major event of the Tenth Age of Calimshan . All Bhaal - worshiping assassins were killed by Bane just before the end of the Time of Troubles .

title: Darkturret
description: Darkturret Darkturret was a ruined castle located on the banks of the River Orlaphar in Gontal . Because it was exposed to the Spellplague , the ruins of Darkturret existed outside time and space . Background .

title: Darkvision
description: Darkvision Darkvision referred to the ability to see in the dark by allowing a creature to discern forms , as in normal daylight vision , only in shades of greys . It was similar to low - light vision , a trait more commonly found among surface races . Underground creatures often had darkvision , including drow , illithid s , and minotaur s .

title: Darkvision ( spell )
description: Darkvision ( spell ) Darkvision was an transmutation spell that gave vision in total darkness . Effect . The older version of the spell made the caster see within 60 feet ( 18 meters ) of total darkness , everything in total darkness would appear black and white .

title: Darkwalker
description: Darkwalker Darkwalkers were a group of warlock s bound by the dark pact to an exceptional degree . Attitudes . Opening themselves up to the full power of the darkness , darkwalkers cared little for the fate of their own soul s , which others might try and protect from the corrupting powers that darkwalkers dealt with on a regular basis .

title: Darkwalker on Moonshae
description: Darkwalker on Moonshae Darkwalker on Moonshae , by Douglas Niles , is the first book in the Moonshae trilogy . It was the first novel set in the " Forgotten Realms " , followed in published order by " The Crystal Shard " by R . A .

title: Darkwoods Massacre
description: Darkwoods Massacre The Darkwoods Massacre was a battle fought in the Darkwoods of Cormanthor between an orc horde from Vastar and combined elven and human forces of the Akh ' Velahr of Cormanthyr in the Year of Seven Stones , 335 DR . Events . Lead up .

title: Darla
description: Darla Darla was a young thief in Neverwinter . Activities . Darla was one the leaders of the Little Rats , a gang of children affiliated with Dead Rats gang , acting as spies and messengers .

title: Darlan Mortem
description: Darlan Mortem Darlan Morten was a male half - elf shadow adept who was one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Darlan was an obscure manipulator of the Shadow Weave who used his position to increase his collection of magic items . His duty was to control the guild ' s operations between Baldur ' s Gate and Amn .

title: Darlisan
description: Darlisan Darlisan the Rover was one of the best hunters in Vaasa in 1479 DR . Activities . Darlisan was a superb hunter and an infallible tracker .

title: Darlutheene Ambershields
description: Darlutheene Ambershields Darlutheene Ambershields is the daughter of a family of servants in Suzail , Cormyr . Appearance . Darlutheene has blonde hair and violet eyes .

title: Darmon
description: Darmon Sir Darmon was a male human and member of the Nine of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . If the Kalach - Cha and the companions sided with the Watch and raided the Smuggler ' s warehouse , Darmon would appear before them giving orders to his men , since this problem worried Lord Nasher himself .

title: Darmshall
description: Darmshall Darmshall was a small city in the hostile lands of Vaasa in the Bloodstone Lands . Structure . It was as much a fortress as it was a city surrounded by capable walls lined with siege weaponry and grizzled soldiers .

title: Darni House
description: Darni House The Darni House was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . A small mosque dedicated to Jisan decorated the center of the Darni House .

title: Daroush
description: Daroush Daroush was a small mining village located in the Aphrunn Mountains . Geography . Daroush lay at the eastern end of Lilit Pass in the Aphrunn Mountains .

title: Darrawn
description: Darrawn Darrawn was the capital and only proper city of the nation of Fimbrul , on Returned Abeir . It was inhabited only by earth giant s and their galeb duhr servants . Background .

title: Darreth
description: Darreth Darreth was a prisoner at the Temple of Elemental Evil under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Darreth lived in Womford in the Dessarin Valley .

title: Darrin Drader
description: Darrin Drader Darrin Drader is a novelist and game designer who co - authored several Forgotten Realms and core D & D sourcebooks . He was employed as a writer at 38 Studios , a computer gaming company owned by Curt Shilling and R . A .

title: Darromar
description: Darromar Darromar , formerly known as Ithmong , was a metropolis and the capital of Tethyr . Geography . It lay on the River Ith .

title: Darrow Nettlebee
description: Darrow Nettlebee Darrow Nettlebee was the second son of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Darrow was a good - natured individual but his grandfather ' s words about inheritance made him worried about his future .

title: Darsson ' s cooling breeze
description: Darsson ' s cooling breeze Darsson ' s cooling breeze was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . Similar to , but less powerful than , the " gust of wind " spell , Darsson ' s cooling breeze was used to create peaceful air currents centered on a object .

title: Darsson ' s eye in the sky
description: Darsson ' s eye in the sky Darsson ' s eye in the sky was a sort of mass - " levitation " spell created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to " levitate " all people and loose objects found within a 10 ft .

title: Darsson ' s fiery cube
description: Darsson ' s fiery cube Darsson ' s fiery cube was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created a burst of flame that engulfed a cubical area no greater than 10 ft .

title: Darsson ' s music box
description: Darsson ' s music box Darsson ' s music box was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . With this spell the caster could enchant some kind of container so that it would play music or recorded messages .

title: Darsson ' s potion
description: Darsson ' s potion Darsson ' s potion was an enchantment spell used to literally create an instant potion . This spell was created by Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .

title: Darsson Spellmaker
description: Darsson Spellmaker Darsson Spellmaker , known commonly as Darsson , was a renowned Halruaan wizard who specialized in researching new and wondrous spell s . Personality . Darsson was a quiet individual who preferred to spend his time researching new spells as opposed to associating with others .

title: Darts of force
description: Darts of force Darts of force is a version of the magic missile spell commonly known to all mage s . As with most variants up to five missiles of pure magical energy can be projected at a target or targets , in most cases rendering them insensible or outright killing them from a combination of physical kinetic impact and system shock . Use and Practitioners .

title: Dartwell
description: Dartwell Dartwell was a half - elf market grifter in Waterdeep in the 1470s DR . History . In 1476 DR , Dartwell entered into Undermountain after fleeing from the City Watch after swindling some merchants .

title: Daruk
description: Daruk Daruk was a human bard and a friend of the Ikemmu merchant Tatigan Carrlock . He was said to be beloved by Shar . History .

title: Daryth
description: Daryth Daryth was a thief from Calimshan . Description . Like most Calishite s , Daryth was deeply tan with dark eyes .

title: Darz Helgar
description: Darz Helgar Darz Helgar was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Darz was a male human of Illuskan stock .

title: Dashadjen
description: Dashadjen Dashadjen was an ancient city of the Calim Empire , which fell into ruins . The fortified military city was the major garrison for the armies of Calim before and during the Era of Skyfire . Geography .

title: Dashard Devlin
description: Dashard Devlin Duke Dashard Devlin was the twentieth duke of Carmathan in Damara in 1357 DR . History . After Zhengyi the Witch - King seized control of Damara , one of his first actions was to kill the current duke of Carmathan and all his family .

title: Dasharra Keldabar
description: Dasharra Keldabar Dasharra Keldabar was a Shield dwarf living in Fireshear sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Dasharra lived in a most underground hovel where she raised griffon s , training them and explaining to people how mount them .

title: Dasin
description: Dasin Dasin was a aquatic elf Dukar of the Order of Kupavi in Myth Nantar . History . Dasin was a younf wizard - in - training in Faenasuor when she had a dream where was summoned to Myth Nantar .

title: Datchas
description: Datchas Datchas was the common name for in the " Realms " . The pink variety was also known as sugar stone . Description .

title: Datharian Mistwatcher
description: Datharian Mistwatcher Datharian Mistwatcher was an elf who , thousands of years ago , was responsible for creating One Thousand Broken Dreams , a powerful magic longsword . He created this item after his home city was destroyed by the drow , but he was slain soon after by drider s . Datharian worshipped Sehanine Moonbow .

title: Dathlil
description: Dathlil Dathlil was a common ground flower that was used by herbal lore to combat poison . Description . The petals of the dathlil were tiny and white .

title: Dathlue Mistwinter
description: Dathlue Mistwinter Dathlue Mistwinter , who most knew as Lady Steel , was the founder of the Harpers at Twilight . History . Dathlue was the heiress of the noble Mistwinter House in Myth Drannor .

title: Daudon el Yakan
description: Daudon el Yakan Daudon yn Saibh el Yakan was the Nirdey of Memnon for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Daudon worked for many years as a bandit , bodyguard , and enforcer for the Rundeen until his age made it difficult to do these jobs , so he asked for a more sedentary job and was appointed as Nirdey of Memnon .

title: Daughter of the Drow
description: Daughter of the Drow Daughter of the Drow is the first book in the Starlight & Shadows trilogy by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . Liriel Baenre is the prized daughter of Gromph Baenre and therefore a princess of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan .

title: Daumar Gudenny
description: Daumar Gudenny Daumar Gudenny is an ex - assassin and spy for the Bruil family of Melvaunt . Though he currently lives within the city , he often operated within the land of Thar . A self - exiled spirit folk from Rashemen , he is obsessed with the legends of Vorbyx , the First King of Thar , as some theories surrounding him suggest the ancient king shared his lineage .

title: Dauna Lorastur
description: Dauna Lorastur Dauna Lorastur was the High Lord of Marrauk in 1479 DR . Background . Dauna was a calm person , well - liked by her subjects .

title: Dauneth Marliir
description: Dauneth Marliir Dauneth Marliir was a member of the Marliir noble house of Arabel , Cormyr . He became the father - in - law of King Azoun V in 1396 DR . Dauneth Marliir was a nobleman and warrior , loyal throughout the Abraxus Affair , and was appointed to be Warden of the Eastern Marches by Azoun IV .

title: Dauntinghorn
description: Dauntinghorn House Dauntinghorn was a noble family of Cormyr . Their seat was Dauntinghorn House in Suzail in Cormyr . The family was distantly related to the Truesilver s .

title: Dauntless Mamluk Society
description: Dauntless Mamluk Society The Dauntless Mamluk Society , also known as the Dauntless , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization specialized in exploration and the recovery of powerful magical items and artifacts .

title: Dauravyn Redbeard
description: Dauravyn Redbeard Dauravyn Rebdeard was an innkeeper circa 1363 DR . History . Dauravyn was an adventurer until he retired to manage The Way Inn , an inn near Dragonspear Castle .

title: Daurgothoth
description: Daurgothoth Daurgothoth ( pronounced " DOUR " - goh - thoth ) , also known as Creeping Doom , was an archmage , dracolich , and one of the most powerful beings in all of Faerûn . Two near - impossible goals consumed him : to become the most powerful creature in the world , and to breed his own race of " living " dracoliches . History .

title: Daurvos Frostbeard
description: Daurvos Frostbeard Daurvos Frostbeard was a dwarf and king of the Ironstar clan . Relationships . Daurvos had several sons , all of whom perished while fighting orc s fleeing south to Ironford .

title: Davaeorn
description: Davaeorn Davaeorn was a mage in the employment of the Iron Throne . Activities . Davaeorn was responsible for controlling the iron production in the Cloakwood mines .

title: Dave Gross
description: Dave Gross Dave Gross is a game designer and the author of several fantasy novels . He also was the lead writer for the Enhanced Edition of Baldur ' s Gate . Background .

title: David C . Sutherland III
description: David C . Sutherland III David C . Sutherland III was a fantasy artist famous for illustrating early editions of Dungeons & Dragons .

title: Davon Malaeda
description: Davon Malaeda Davon Malaeda was an official in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Davon was the closest advisor of the First Lord Torin Nomerthal .

title: Davra Jassur
description: Davra Jassur Davra Jassur was an assassin and a member of the Zhentarim during the Rage of Demons . History . Davra ' s job for the Zhentarim was to recruit promising valuable assets , but she also silenced those who were possible weaknesses to the organization .

title: Davrick Fain
description: Davrick Fain Davrick Fain was the lead cultist of Auril in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . History . Davrick was a common merchant of Bremen until the winter of 1483 DR when the power of Auril truly manifested to him .

title: Dawn Age
description: Dawn Age The Dawn Age , or the Age of Dawn , was a period lasting from −30 , 000 DR to −24 , 000 DR , when the powerful empires of the creator race s disappeared from the face of the earth and their land was occupied by dragons and giants . Constant war for land in Faerûn led to the creation of great kingdoms and empires . It was a time on Toril when dragon s took an interest in the lesser races ' squabbling and taught them the basic concepts of organization and civilization , leading to the construction of cities and armies .

title: Dawn Cataclysm
description: Dawn Cataclysm The Dawn Cataclysm was an attempt by the god Lathander to reshape the pantheon of deities more in his own image . It is unknown when this event occured but Lathander failed , only succeeding in killing Murdane , the goddess of pragmatism , who was opposed to Lathander ' s idealism . It has been theorised , though not confirmed , that the Dawn Cataclysm had knock - on effects that affected the Realms .

title: Dawn Pass Trail
description: Dawn Pass Trail The Dawn Pass Trail ran across northwest Faerûn marking the border between north Faerûn and the Western Heartlands . Geography . The westernmost point of the Dawn Pass Trail was the town of Secomber and the easternmost point was the edge of the desert of Anauroch .

title: Dawn Titan ' s Spire
description: Dawn Titan ' s Spire The Dawn Titan ' s Spire was a monolithic structure located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . The Dawn Titan ' s Spire was a monolith of about two miles ( 3200 mts .

title: Dawn War
description: Dawn War The Dawn War was the war between the primordial s and the god s . The war encompassed the eras known on Abeir - Toril as the Blue Age and the Shadow Epoch . The Dawn War began when the mad god Tharizdun marshaled the primordials against the gods in a bid for universal domination after becoming corrupted by the obyrith s .

title: Dawn of Night
description: Dawn of Night Dawn of Night is the second book in the Erevis Cale trilogy by Paul S . Kemp featuring Erevis Cale and Drasek Riven . Summary .

title: Dawnbringer Company
description: Dawnbringer Company The Dawnbringer Company was a band of adventurers from Waterdeep . History . In 1024 DR , they plundered the crypt of Uruth Ukrypt ' s orcs .

title: Dawnstone
description: Dawnstone The Dawnstone was a beautiful and powerful artifact of Lathander , gifted to aid in the defense and eventual rebirth of the city of Myth Drannor . It resided in the temple known as the Dawnspire in the city ' s ruins . Description .

title: Dawson
description: Dawson Dawson was a servant in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Dawson had always served House Culkin .

title: Day of the Darkening
description: Day of the Darkening " Day of the Darkening " is the 18th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .

title: Dayan
description: Dayan Dayan was a vampire necromancer in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , Dayan found a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain with many strange necromantic machines .

title: Daylight
description: Daylight Daylight was an evocation spell that caused an object to give off light , making the illuminated area as bright as a clear day . Effects . The area of effect of " daylight " was full daylight within a radius of 60 ft ( 18 .

title: Days of Terror
description: Days of Terror The Days of Terror was a period of four days during the Tethyrian Interregnum between the end of Tarsakh and beginning of Kythorn in 1367 DR and refers to the events that happened in Zazesspur during this period . Firstly , child slavers were discovered in the caves beneath the city and they were removed . Secondly , the Darkling armies were released onto the streets by fell forces .

title: Days of Thunder
description: Days of Thunder The Age of Thunder began when the majority of the glaciers left by the cooling of Abeir - Toril ' s ocean during the Shadow Epoch finally melted under the new sun and the sea levels lowered enough to reveal a supercontinent that would eventually be called Merrouroboros . Life bloomed on this landmass in the form of the creator races and the ancient apelike ancestors of human s . This was the time of the fabled creator races , or Iqua - Tel ' Quessir in the elven tongue , when many gods came to the consciousness of mortals , and many races still hid in caves .

title: Daze
description: Daze Daze was a simple cantrip that temporarily clouded the mind of a targeted humanoid creature . It was considered an enchantment of the compulsion sub - school of magic . An eyeball , a minuscule relative of the beholder could daze opponents with one of its four tiny eyestalks .

title: Dazzling ray
description: Dazzling ray Dazzling ray , also known as flare , is a spell used by many sorcerer s , particularly those who wield the power of wild magic . When it is cast , " dazzling ray " shoots a stunningly bright beam of light at a creature within fifty feet of the sorcerer , injuring them from the intensity of its light . Chaos sorcerers also gain the benefit of dazzling their target , making them less effective in their attacks .

title: DeBernezan
description: DeBernezan DeBernezan betrayed the fighting people of Ten - Towns for his own good . He ended up with Heafstaag and the rest of the barbarian s , giving them ways to defeat the Ten Towns that only one from the Ten Towns would know . He is described in The Crystal Shard as a short man with black hair .

title: Dead - magic zone
description: Dead - magic zone A dead - magic zone was an area of space in which magic ceased to function . They were one of the lasting effects of the Time of Troubles . Creation .

title: Dead Dwarf Bridge
description: Dead Dwarf Bridge Dead Dwarf Bridge , or Clearflow Bridge , was located near the Lake of Mists next to the small city of Drubiev . This site had an evil reputation among locals since it marked the final stand of Theodo Greataxe and his seven loyal companions . Description .

title: Dead Horse Ford
description: Dead Horse Ford Dead Horse Ford was a crossing on the Dessarin River south of Calling Horns . The ford was a part of Jundar ' s Pass , the trail from Beliard to Calling Horns . It drew its name from the battle fought here where the hero Destril Longtracker had three horses slain from underneath him .

title: Dead Orc Pass
description: Dead Orc Pass Dead Orc Pass was a narrow pass in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Dead Orc Pass was a narrow cleft between two mountains on the west ( Mount Jaws and Mount Gaeram ) and two mountains on the east ( Faerang ' s Doom and Mount Tolzrin ) .

title: Dead Rats
description: Dead Rats The Dead Rats were a street gang operating in Luskan on the northern Sword Coast . The gang was most notable for having a large number of wererat s within their ranks . The gang was based in the Drowned Rat tavern and was notorious throughout northern Faerûn .

title: Dead Three
description: Dead Three The Dead Three was the collective name given to Bane , Bhaal & Myrkul . Originally , they were powerful mortal adventurers who sought the path to godhood , known at first as the Dark Three . They found it in the form of Jergal , who acquiesced to their demands as he was tiring of his life as god of the dead .

title: Dead Tree Hollow
description: Dead Tree Hollow Dead Tree Hollow was a village in the Vast , lying on the North Road between Dragon Falls and Swords Pool , where Blaern ' s Trail from Fallentree met the North Road . History . Long ago ( but still within elven memory in 1370 DR ) , the flying carriage of Lady Alauthshaee was attacked by the spell s of Ilthuryn , her scorned suitor .

title: Dead in Thay
description: Dead in Thay Dead in Thay is an adventure module for the D & D Next / 5th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " , as part of the " Dreams of the Red Wizards " campaign . It was released in April 2014 . Summary .

title: Dead power
description: Dead power Dead power is the residual essence of a god or goddess that lingers in the vicinity where that deity perished . It may be contained in an item or linger in in the air . Perhaps it seeped into the dirt or walls .

title: Deadly dance
description: Deadly dance Deadly dance was a divine magic spell available to specialty priest s of Lliira , the Joybringer , and other priests that followed a more martial faith with emphasis on combat . It granted perfect balance and enhanced dexterity to the recipient , but with an impetus to move . Effects .

title: Deadsnows
description: Deadsnows Deadsnows was a large village located on the northen edge of the Nether Mountains . It was the smallest member of the confederacy of the Silver Marches and would not have normally been accepted as a signatory unless as a vassal to a larger city , but due to the request of Lady Arletha Icespear it was allowed to join , though did not have a seat on the council . Deadsnows was connected via a trail to Fork Road which eventually lead to Sundabar .

title: Deara
description: Deara Deara was a priest ess of Deneir at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . Deara desired to create the perfect scribe , and so in the temple ' s vaults she sculpted and animated a clay golem . In one particular test , " circa " 1362 DR , the golem drove a quill through a wooden writing desk , smashing it in the process .

title: Death ' s door
description: Death ' s door Death ' s door was a necromancy spell that had an arcane and a divine magic version . It could be used to stop a creature from bleeding to death after they had fallen unconscious . Effects .

title: Death Cheese
description: Death Cheese Death Cheese was a unique cheese that came from the swamps bordering both Cormyr and Sembia . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Death Moon Orb
description: Death Moon Orb The Death Moon Orb was a magical artifact of domination . Originally created by the Netherese lich - king Larloch to control his court , it was famously employed by Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy , to gain power over Thay and attempt to enslave the demon prince Eltab . It had the power to charm and dominate the minds of others , to spy on faraway points , to raise the dead , and to summon and compel fiends , but had a corrupting influence .

title: Death bump
description: Death bump Death bump was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was used primarily by ghul lord s . Effects .

title: Death dealer
description: Death dealer Death dealers are deadly rogue s who have made killing into their living . Experts at their job , death dealers are rightly feared and experienced adherents to the path are extremely difficult to defeat in combat . Though death dealers aren ' t necessarily evil , they skirt the path of sadism , making it difficult for any to truly be " good " .

title: Death domain
description: Death domain The Death domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters death spell powers . They gain the ability to kill a target instantly once per day , though the odds of success depend on both the strength of the cleric and the target . Death Domain Spells .

title: Death knell
description: Death knell Death knell was a necromancy spell that finished off a dying subject and sapped his energy to strengthen the caster . Effect . The caster drew forth the ebbing life force of a badly wounded creature and used it to fuel his own power .

title: Death knight
description: Death knight A death knight was a mighty undead warrior created by gods of death or other malevolent forces . They were most commonly created from evil humanoid s who in life had been blackguards , fighters , rangers , barbarians , and even paladin s fallen from grace . Description .

title: Death link
description: Death link Death link , also known as body sympathy , was an arcane necromantic spell that connected the caster with a target creature in such a way that damage or healing to one also affected the other . Effects . When cast , the target had to be within 240 yd ( 220 m ) of the caster , but for the duration of the spell , the distance between caster and target did not matter as long as they were both on the same plane of existence .

title: Death slaad
description: Death slaad Death slaadi were very powerful evil slaad shapechangers and spellcasters . Description . Death slaadi emerged as the result of a gray slaad having devoured the corpse of a dead death slaad .

title: Death smoke
description: Death smoke Death smoke was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a cloud of dark noxious gas that could not be blown or burned away .

title: Death spear
description: Death spear A death spear or death lance was a longspear infused with negative energy and used by elite drow warriors . Description . These longspears were 10 feet ( 3 meters ) long and made of a dull - gray metal with mottled and sparkling patterns along its length .

title: Death talisman
description: Death talisman Death talisman was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was usable by wizard s and priest s ( cleric s ) . Effects .

title: Death tyrant
description: Death tyrant Death tyrants were an undead form of beholder , similar to zombie s , that retained some innate magical abilities . They were often used by powerful wizard s as guardians . They were almost never encountered near other beholders , who found them abhorrent .

title: Death ward ( spell )
description: Death ward ( spell ) Death ward was a necromancy spell that granted immunity to and effects or simply prevented death . Effects . The older version made the subject immune to all death spells and magical death effects .

title: Deathcalm
description: Deathcalm Deathcalm the Loved helped to run Galvendo ' s Lodge with her companion and business partner Galvendo , of whom the lodge was named . She assisted in such ways as raising clients who had met their end on hunting trips with Galvendo . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities & Civilization - p27 " > < / ref >

title: Deathwatch
description: Deathwatch Deathwatch was a necromancy spell that , within an area of thirty feet , informed the caster how badly wounded subjects were . Effects . Using the foul sight granted by the powers of unlife , the caster could determine the condition of creatures near death within the spell ' s range .

title: Deathway
description: Deathway The deathways were a network of portal s linking crypts , catacombs , graveyards and other places related to the Eminence of Araunt . Description . The deathways were located in tombs , crypts , catacombs , graveyards and such other places , that were marked with the sign of the Eminence , three vertical slashes above .

title: Debbi
description: Debbi The debbi was a mammal native to the warm deserts of Zakhara . Description . This 2 ft ( 0 .

title: Decastave
description: Decastave Decastave was an evocation spell that converted a small piece of wood into a 10 - ft - long ( just over 3 m ) force - staff that could be used as a magic weapon . Effects . The magical pole was of fixed length , 2 in ( 5 cm ) in diameter , and rigidly inflexible .

title: Deceive prying
description: Deceive prying Deceive prying was a spell used by priests of Vhaeraun to pass mental examination . Effects . Upon casting , the caster determined some criteria , such as religious and moral standards ; these standards didn ' t need to match up with the caster ' s actual mental state .

title: Deceiver genie
description: Deceiver genie Deceiver genies were tasked djinn whose lives revolved around deception and illusion . Oddly enough , deceiver genies were more susceptible to believing illusions than most creatures . Description .

title: Deekin Scalesinger
description: Deekin Scalesinger Deekin Scalesinger was a male kobold bard adventurer in the North in the 1370s DR . Description . He was a gray - scaled kobold who was often seen with pen and paper in hand as well as his lute .

title: Deep Duerra
description: Deep Duerra Deep Duerra ( " dwair " - uh ) , also known as Queen of the Invisible Art or the Axe Princess of Conquest , was the duergar demigod of psionics , conquest and expansion . Worshipers . Deep Duerra and her cleric s were known below the surface as " Norothor " ( " those who seized enemy lands " ) .

title: Deep Imaskar
description: Deep Imaskar Deep Imaskar , also known as The City of the Great Seal , was created during the fall of the Imaskar Empire in −2481 by the wizard lord Ilphemon as a safe haven for his followers and family . The fled carrying an artifact of immense power , the Third Imaskarcana . The city was located in the lower Underdark , somewhere below the Endless Waste .

title: Deep Imaskari
description: Deep Imaskari Deep Imaskari are heirs to the lost empire of Imaskar . Few have survived when their slaves , having been abducted from other worlds and magical monsters ( phaerimm ) created by the war wizards of the Imaskari , were turned against them . Their empire crumbled leaving only ancient cities becoming ruins .

title: Deep King
description: Deep King Deep King was a title used by a dwarven ruler , equivalent to a king . History . The dwarven kingdom of Roldilar , founded in 610 DR , was ruled by Deep King Tuir Stonebeard .

title: Deep Kingdom
description: Deep Kingdom The Deep Kingdom , also known as the Deep Realm , was the name of a kingdom of gold dwarves that was found in the caverns of the Great Rift and the surface lands surrounding it . Geography . When first established , the Deep Kingdom occupied lesser caverns and tunnels under the Eastern Shaar .

title: Deep Sashelas
description: Deep Sashelas Deep Sashelas was an elven deity who made his home on Arvandor , although he was rumored to maintain a demesne off the coast of the Moonshae Isles known as " Tír faoi Thoinn " . He was heavily involved with the lives of the sea peoples and spent most of his time with deities from that realm . He gave one group of Corellon ' s creations the ability to breathe and live underwater , wishing to see the wisdom and goodness of the elves prevail in the deeper and wilder realms of the sea .

title: Deep Speech
description: Deep Speech Deep Speech was the language of aberration s , an alien form of communication originating in the Far Realm . When written by mortals it used the Espruar script , as it was first transcribed by the drow due to frequent contact between the two groups stemming from living in relatively close proximity within the Underdark .

title: Deep Wastes
description: Deep Wastes The Deep Wastes formed a small domain part of the vast Underdark hidden away underneath the surface of the Dalelands and the Moonsea . Geography . Stretching from the Earthspur Mountains with few entrances from the surface , a large portion of the Deep Wastes remained unexplored by travelers of the more adventurous type .

title: Deep Wilds
description: Deep Wilds The Deep Wilds was a plane in the Astral Sea that was home to nature deities including Silvanus , Mielikki , Auril , Malar and Umberlee . Silvanus ruled the plane and the other deities who dwelled in the Deep Wilds served him . Every type of environment found on Toril was also found in the Deep Wilds although the version found in the Deep Wilds was much more extreme than that on Toril .

title: Deep diviner
description: Deep diviner The Deep Diviner is a prestige class of the Underdark that uses the mystical energies of the deep places of the world to accomplish feats of magic . They are particularly impressive because of their use of Node Magic , which involves manipulating deposits of magic within the Underdark , called Earth Node s . Deep Diviners use Earth Nodes to enhance and refuel their own magic , which focuses primarily on communicating with the stone that surrounds them and the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Deep dragon
description: Deep dragon Deep dragons , also called purple dragons , were a type of chromatic dragon that lived in the Underdark . Description . Despite their large size , deep dragons were slender and agile , allowing them to crawl through the tunnels of the Underdark .

title: Deep gnome
description: Deep gnome Deep gnomes , called svirfneblin in their own language , are a gnome subrace that live in the Underdark . While their surface cousins are known for their boundless optimism and cheerful mischief , the " svirfneblin " are serious and suspicious creatures . They survive in the Underdark by maintaining wariness of others and working hard to keep their underground society secret .

title: Deep rothé
description: Deep rothé Deep rothé were a variety of rothé that lived in the Underdark . Description . Deep rothé were smaller than surface rothé , standing only 4 feet tall at the shoulder .

title: Deep scion
description: Deep scion Deep scions were people who surrendered their bodies and souls to an evil aquatic power ( usually a kraken ) in exchange for their lives . Upon surrendering , they were transformed by a ritual into amphibious shapechanger s , in service to their masters . Description .

title: Deep slumber
description: Deep slumber Deep slumber was an improved version of " sleep " that affected more creatures and / or tougher creatures . Effects . This spell could only be cast a close range ( unlike " sleep " which had a medium range ) but it could affect more creatures caught in the 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius burst and potentially tougher creatures as well .

title: Deepearth
description: Deepearth Deepearth was a city and the surroundings areas in the Underdark under the Galena Mountains in the Bloodstone Lands . History . Deepearth was settled by deep gnome s .

title: Deeping
description: Deeping The Deeping was a stream in the Cormanthor forest . Wildlife . The waters of the Deeping ran clear and was home to a large number of and .

title: Deepspawn
description: Deepspawn Deepspawn were monstrous aberration s that could spawn many other varieties of monsters . Description . Deepspawn looked like large , rubbery spheres of mottled grey and brown .

title: Deepwash
description: Deepwash The Deepwash was a freshwater lake and , as of 1370 – 1372 DR , the largest lake in the Vilhon Reach . The northwestern stretch was known as Shalane Lake in Erlkazar . Geography .

title: Deepwing Mountains
description: Deepwing Mountains The Deepwing Mountains were a small , east – west mountain range southeast of the Shining Plains in the Vilhon Reach . They were located between the Orsraun Mountains and the Cloven Mountains and north of the Deepwash . The mountains were populated with a number of large , flying monsters , including manticore s , griffon s and hippogriff s , red dragon s , and wyvern s .

title: Defender of Sealtiel
description: Defender of Sealtiel Defenders of Sealtiel are the earthly servants of the celestial paragon Sealtiel , the patron of defenders - those who protect the weak , fight off the forces of evil , and defend the ideals of truth and goodness from evil deception . The Defenders of Sealtiel are a knightly order sworn to uphold said ideals , and where the fists of Raziel take an offensive role in the eternal struggle against evil , the defenders remain at home and fight back against counterassault . Background .

title: Defenders Mamluk Society
description: Defenders Mamluk Society The Defenders Mamluk Society , also known as the Defenders , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Defenders were charged with the protection and defense of mighty Qudra .

title: Defiance in Phlan
description: Defiance in Phlan Defiance in Phlan , designed by Shawn Merwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Phlan , the Cult of the Dragon , and the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle . Summary .

title: Degasus Tarensun
description: Degasus Tarensun Degasus Tarensun was a minor assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Degasus was born in the Caravan Cities but grew up in Westgate after being abandoned at the city ' s docks at the age of six .

title: Degrodel
description: Degrodel Degrodel was an abjurer wizard living in Baldur ' s Gate . He had a collection of construct s , doomguard s , and helmed horror s . Degrodel employed Gorion ' s Ward to recover the helm of Balduran , recently resurfaced .

title: Dehydration
description: Dehydration Dehydration was a powerful wizard spell that combined the schools of alteration and necromancy to devastating effect . It was used commonly by the members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects .

title: Deinyn Fembrys
description: Deinyn Fembrys Deinyn Fembrys was a male Chondathan human cleric of Shar . He was one of a group of clerics Shar posing as clerics of Mystra at a false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History .

title: Deirdre Kendrick
description: Deirdre Kendrick Deidre Kendrick was the firstborn daughter of Robyn Kendrick and Tristan Kendrick . Relationships . As a gifted magic - user , she was trained first by wizard Keane and later by Sinioth an aspect of Talos .

title: Deirk Erlich
description: Deirk Erlich Deirk Erlich was a man living in Hillsfar . History . Deirk lived with his family in the slums of Hillsfar until , during the Rage of Demons , his brother Haakon Erlich , a officer of the Red Plumes , told him that the Tinfellow Farm was now vacant and he could take him there .

title: Deity
description: Deity A deity is a being of great power that controls some aspect of mortal affairs , referred to as the god ' s portfolio . True gods are called Estelar and differ from the Dawn Titans ( primordial s ) . All deities were either elevated to their positions by Ao ( the overseer ) or were approved by Ao to be worshiped in the Realms , in the case of interloper deities .

title: Dejor Rasthavin
description: Dejor Rasthavin Dejor Rasthavin was a sage and historian of Selgaunt and a regional agent of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Dejor was a quiet and soft - spoken man , with a great interest in history and politic of the Sea of Fallen Stars History .

title: Del Geery
description: Del Geery Del Geery was a human farmer in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . He was notably prosperous and enterprising , particularly in the hydra trade . History .

title: Dela Alder
description: Dela Alder Dela Alder was the proprietor of the Traveler ' s Cloak Inn within the city of Mulmaster . History . In 1374 DR , Alder ran the inn with her husband Vesvur Alder .

title: Delaan Winterhound
description: Delaan Winterhound Delaan Winterhound was a ranger of the Emerald Enclave and their main delegate at the Council of Waterdeep . Personality . Delaan preferred the wild spaces of the North and felt uncomfortable in Waterdeep .

title: Delacrae Gentleblossom
description: Delacrae Gentleblossom Delacrae Gentleblossom was a sage and shopkeeper in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Delacrae ran a shop in Phlan called All Questions Answered , where she used her sage knowledge to answer customers ' questions .

title: Delayed blast fireball
description: Delayed blast fireball Delayed blast fireball , or delayed blast fire ball was an evocation spell that was like " fireball " but could be given a timed detonation . Effect . Other than being similar to " fireball " , the damage of the spell was increased and the spell would detonate with a timed trigger .

title: Delban
description: Delban Delban was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Delban didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description .

title: Delbyl
description: Delbyl Delbyl was a town located in southern Murghôm . Description . Delbyl sat at the point where the Road of the Dawn split into its northern and southern branches .

title: Deleira Truesilver
description: Deleira Truesilver Deleira Truesilver was a noble from Suzail and a lady of the Truesilver noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , the beholder - kin Talane was suddenly awoken by Manshoon in the private room of Lady Deleira .

title: Delethyrsos
description: Delethyrsos Delethyrsos was a shadow dragon and the personal mount of Hadrhune in 1375 DR . History . Delethyrsos was at his master ' s side during Hadrhune ' s secret plot to obtain the " Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar " , and was slain together with Hadrhune by an adventuring party recruited to stop him .

title: Delf
description: Delf Brother Delf was a priest of the god Deneir the Scribe , who lived at a monastery near Verdusk . Brother Delf once wrote a document recounting the origins of various magical creatures . In it , he gave one of the few known accounts of the creation of the peryton s , though he may simply have been retelling an ancient legend .

title: Delfen Ondabarl
description: Delfen Ondabarl Delfen Ondabarl was the greatest wizard of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Delfen was an adventuring wizard from Iriaebor who retired to Daggerford around 1355 DR .

title: Delg Ironstar
description: Delg Ironstar Delg Ironstar , also called Delg Hammerhand , was a dwarven fighter and part of the Company of the Bright Spear . He was also a member of the Harpers and was one of the last members of the legendary noble clan of dwarves , Clan Ironstar . Equipment .

title: Delgar Munsch
description: Delgar Munsch Delgar Munsch was a hunter at Bridgefort in Boareskyr Bridge around 1368 DR . He owned a cabin in the area , where Delgar and his company of hunters took their prey , including goblin s and orc s , which they later sold at Baldur ' s Gate . Around 1367 DR , he retired after a very good season but when the crusade of the Shining Lady arrived nearby he joined the crusaders , even becoming an officer .

title: Delhumide
description: Delhumide Delhumide is the name of the central tharch or region of Thay and its local capital . History . 2300 years ago , when Thay had been a Mulhorand i colony , Delhumide was one of its greatest cities and bastions of power .

title: Delia
description: Delia The city of Delia was elevated in - 1401 DR ( 2458 NY ) by Lady Polaris . Geography . Originally Delia was an island crafted carefully by the druids and was altered once it became an enclave under the care of Lady Polaris .

title: Delimbiyr
description: Delimbiyr The Delimbiyr , also know as the River Shining , was a river that ran through the Savage Frontier and the Western Heartlands . Geography . Starting deep in the Nether Mountains , flowing south through Delimbiyr Vale , it was joined near Loudwater by the combined flow of the River Loagrann and the River Greyflow .

title: Delimbiyr Vale
description: Delimbiyr Vale Delimbiyr Vale was an area in the North , encompassing the upper reaches of the Delimbiyr River . Geography . The Vale was bound on the north by the Nether Mountains and to the south by the South Wood .

title: Delimbiyran
description: Delimbiyran The city of Delimbiyran was one of the ' three crowns ' of Phalorm , representing the human s of that kingdom . Near the end of Phalorm ' s existence , Delimbiyran had grown beyond the need for allies and , indeed their elven peers from Ardeep had left the kingdom to travel to Evermeet and their severely depopulated dwarven allies had retreated from the area , effectively putting an end to the realm . The humans allowed any of the gnomes and halflings of Phalorm who wanted to stay in the alliance to do so as long as they swore fealty to king Javilarhh II , who founded the Kingdom of Man , officially called Delimbiyran after his capital city .

title: Delina
description: Delina Delina was a moon elf wild mage sorcerer who decided to travel to Baldur ' s Gate in order to find her twin brother , Deniak , whom she sensed was in trouble via their mystic bond . Personality . Inquisitive and fearless , she may have looked vulnerable but she carried a great strength within .

title: Delisle
description: Delisle Delisle was a gnome in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Hailing from Ice Peak , Delisle always lamented about the heat and the humidity of Daggerford .

title: Delitar
description: Delitar Delitar the Slow was considered by many to be the greatest human historian in the Realms in 1358 DR . Activities . Delitar was one of the most respected historians of the Realms , and was quoted by many sages .

title: Dell McCourt
description: Dell McCourt Dell McCourt was a dwarf soldier of the Dagult Neverember army in Neverwinter . History . Dell recruited an adventurer just arrived in the city to collect arrows from the dead in a skirmish with the undead of Valindra Shadowmantle and delivered them to the archers commanded by private Hawthidon .

title: Dellanil Quil ' quien
description: Dellanil Quil ' quien Dellanil Quil ' quien was once an elven king of Shilmista and one of the forests legendary heroes . It is also the title of an ancient tome containing writings of King Dellanil Quil ' quien . The Book .

title: Delly Curtie
description: Delly Curtie Delly Curtie , born Delenia Curtie , was the wife of Wulfgar and before that , a wench at Arumn ' s tavern in Luskan . She sold herself to men almost every night , including people such as Morik the Rogue . Description .

title: Delmarin Island
description: Delmarin Island Delmarin Island was a small , remote , and desolate island located in the Sea of Swords west of Orlumbor , somewhat north of Mintarn , and east of the Korinn Archipelago . It was surrounded by perilous reefs . It was inhabited by fog giant s .

title: Delmuth Echorn
description: Delmuth Echorn Delmuth Echorn was the young elven heir of House Echorn in Cormanthyr at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor . History . Delmuth was the heir of the Echorn , one of the most noble of elven houses .

title: Delphe
description: Delphe Delphe was a star elf abjurer and a Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . Equipment . Delphe once possessed a Cerulean Sign , an amulet with potent magical powers against elder aberration s though it was destroyed in 1375 DR by Telarian using the sword Angul - Nis .

title: Delras
description: Delras The Delras was the spelljamming ship of the lich Demchungchumrub . Description . The " Delras " was a great galley that had been specially outfitted to travel beyond Toril .

title: Delsephine
description: Delsephine Delsephine was a member of the Cult of the Dragon sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , the great red dragon Klauth had discovered that the ordning of the giant s was broken by Annam .

title: Delthrin Everet
description: Delthrin Everet Delthrin Everet , also known as Delthrin the Deadmaster was a human man of the city of Marsember in Cormyr . He was a necromancer and local hero . History .

title: Delthuntle
description: Delthuntle Delthuntle was a commercial center and port in Aglarond . Trade . The city primarily made a profit through trade with the genasi nation of Akanûl , especially its capital , Airpur .

title: Delzimmer
description: Delzimmer Delzimmer was a port city located on the Gulf of Luiren in southern Faerûn . The city was known as the gateway to the East Rift because of the large amount of dwarven goods that flowed through the city . History .

title: Delzoun
description: Delzoun Delzoun was the great Northkingdom of the dwarves from - 3900 DR to - 100 DR . Geography . The kingdom extended from the Ice Mountains south to the Rauvin and Nether Mountains at its height .

title: Demand
description: Demand Demand was an enchantment spell that functioned in the same manner as " sending " , with the addition of the ability to send " suggestion s " . Effects . As " sending " , but the message could also contain a suggestion ( see the " suggestion " spell ) , which the subject did her best to carry out .

title: Demarch ' s Alliance
description: Demarch ' s Alliance Demarch ' s Alliance was a spellcasting organization based in the Halls of Demarch in the city of Tantras in the Vast in north Faerûn . It comprised a number of beguiler s devoted to Leira and Mask . Activities .

title: Demarch ' s Folly
description: Demarch ' s Folly Demarch ' s Folly was a spellcasting organization based in the Halls of Demarch in the city of Tantras in the Vast in north Faerûn . Its members were dedicated to learning shadow magic and other shadow - based magic s , such as the Shadow Weave . History .

title: Demascus
description: Demascus Demascus was a deva from the world of Nerath who operated in multiple realities , including the universe Toril was located in . He was called upon by the gods to set straight things that should never have occurred . Demascus was often killed on his missions but was always resurrected with little memory of his past incarnation .

title: Demigod
description: Demigod Demigods , were considered the first rung on the ladder of the gods . Demigods were true immortal deities and capable of granting spells A demigod typically had only a handful of clerics and roughly 300 to 3 , 000 worshipers that typically prayed to a deity of such power . A demipower was a god that either had just risen to godhood , just returned from the dead , suffered a loss of divine power or shared a part of their portfolio with a god of greater power .

title: Demihuman
description: Demihuman " Demihuman " was a collective name for races that were not human but had a similar appearance . Among them were peoples of the dwarves , elves ( including drow ) , halfling s , and gnome s . Half - elf s and half - orc s held a special position , as they were indeed half human .

title: Demilich
description: Demilich Despite the name , a demilich was not a lesser lich , but rather a lich who had evolved beyond a need for its undead body . Personality . Great wizard s and sorcerer s usually became liches in order to continue their pursuit of magic and power beyond death .

title: Demiplane ( spell )
description: Demiplane ( spell ) Demiplane was a conjuration spell that created or reconnected with a demiplane , Effect . The caster created a shady door fit for medium creatures that would lead to or create a demiplane of about 30 cubic feet with wood or stone surfaces . The shady door would last for an hour , and after that time , the door would disappear and whatever was inside would be stuck there until the plane was reconnected .

title: Demiplane of Dread
description: Demiplane of Dread The Demiplane of Dread , commonly known as Ravenloft , was unique , similar to the plane that contained the city of Union in that many worlds and planes connected to it but it was still independent of them all . It was technically part of the Ethereal Plane but was markedly different from the vast majority of that place . Someone on the demiplane would be forgiven for thinking that it was made out of some supernatural mist as the stuff bordered every domain and entering the mists could transport one to another location on the demiplane .

title: Demiplane of Nightmares
description: Demiplane of Nightmares The Demiplane of Nightmares is a demiplane coterminous with both the Ethereal Plane and the Region of Dreams . The boundary between the Demiplane of Nightmares and the Far Realm is very thin , and Far Realm taint continually leaks into the demiplane , corrupting all it touches . Description .

title: Demodand
description: Demodand Also known as gehreleths , demodands were said to have been fashioned by one of the baernoloth s , primal creations of Evil and exiled because of their chaotic taint . Habitat . Demodands were encountered in 1357 DR on the plane of Tarterus by the Companions of the Hall .

title: Demogorgon
description: Demogorgon Demogorgon , also known as the Prince of Demons , was a powerful demon lord and lesser deity . The self - proclaimed title " Prince of Demons " was won by virtue of power and influence ; many demons challenged it but none could defeat Demogorgon and claim it . Description .

title: Demon
description: Demon Demons are the most widespread race of fiend s . They are usually , with the exception of yugoloth s , chaotic evil by nature , and are native to the Abyss . Demons have no true rulers , though powerful demon lords and deities are able to gain enough power and influence to gain control over sizeable armies of demonic creatures .

title: Demon Weave
description: Demon Weave The Demon Weave was a magical fabric that the goddess Lolth attempted to create in order to make herself the new goddess of arcane magic after the demise of Mystra . Nature of the Demon Weave . The Demon Weave coexisted with the torn remains of Mystra ' s Weave that Mystra and her servants were trying to restore once she herself had been restored by Elminster in 1479 DR .

title: Demon lord
description: Demon lord Demon lords , also known as Abyssal lords , were archfiend s who gained great power and established a position of preeminence among demon kind . Each demon lord had a unique appearance and set of abilities . Most controlled at least one layer of the Abyss .

title: Demonflesh golem
description: Demonflesh golem Demonflesh golems are similar to flesh golem s , but are created from the remains of demons . Many of them are found in the Nine Hells , built with the remains of fiends slain during the Blood War . History .

title: Demonic domain
description: Demonic domain The Demonic domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters demonic spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Vile Darkness " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Demonic Domain Powers .

title: Demonologist
description: Demonologist A demonologist was a mortal who devoted his or her life to the study of demon s . He or she was practiced in dealing with them , fighting them , and using them for their own gain . They even gained some demon abilities due to their studies and devotion to the fiends of the Abyss .

title: Demonskin adept
description: Demonskin adept Demonskin adepts are sorcerer s who , for their spell s and other abilities , rip away the power of the Abyss , stealing it from the skins of the demon s to whom it belongs . This gives them access to powerful abilities but comes at a cost , for such power is indelibly tainted with the evil of the plane from which it comes , corrupting the heart of those who wield it . More to the point , the demons from whom the power is stolen rarely take kindly to the sorcerer ' s possession of it .

title: Demonweb Pits
description: Demonweb Pits The Demonweb Pits was originally the 66th layer of the Abyss . By the end of the Silence of Lolth , Lolth had moved her domain in the Demonweb Pits to its own planar space . The realm is ruled over by Lolth , the primary drow deity , who resides in a huge iron fortress that moves under its mistress ' s will on spider - like legs .

title: Denak
description: Denak Denak was an abjurer and a member of the Red Wizards of Thay . Relationships . The Red Wizard worked with Edwin Odesseiron and Zulkir Nevron .

title: Dendar
description: Dendar Dendar the Night Serpent is an elder evil and a primordial who , according to legend , came into existence shortly after the first being slept and had a nightmare . She has an uncountable horde of horrible dreams and foul visions in her gullet that she has been devouring since the dawn of time . She relishes the taste of particularly choice nightmares and savors the dreams of kings and deities alike .

title: Dendritic crystal armor
description: Dendritic crystal armor Dendritic crystal armor is heavy armor made from dendritic seed crystals grown deep underground . It is not forged in fire and must be tailored specifically to each wearer , leaving almost no gaps , but is heavier and more cumbersome than plate mail . The armor will grow back to its original shape if damaged , provided there is at least 5 lb ( 2 .

title: Deneir
description: Deneir Deneir ( pronounced " deh - NEER " ) , often called the Scribe of Oghma , was the neutral good lesser deity of art , cartography , glyphs , images , knowledge , literature and scholars . Worshippers . Followers of Deneir always remained in close contact with those of Oghma as he was Deneir ' s brother god .

title: Deng Tse Chin
description: Deng Tse Chin Deng Tse Chin was a shukenja adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Growing up as an abandoned child in the Sheng - Ti monastery , known as " The Sanctuary " , in the city of Hsi - Feng , Deng learned all about the Path of Enlightenment and the Immortal Fa Kuan , patron of the monastery .

title: Dengor Bloodheart
description: Dengor Bloodheart Dengor Bloodheart was a forgepriest of Surtr in Szith Morcane in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , after the fire giant s occupied the outpost Dengor was choose as the leader of the place .

title: Denia Vesdar
description: Denia Vesdar Denia Vesdar was a spy for the Zhentarim , who worked in the Tower of the Blades in the city of Mulmaster . She had attained her rank after proving herself time and again , beginning her career as a mere soldier within Zhentil Keep . Appearance .

title: Deniak
description: Deniak Deniak was a splinter Cult of the Dragon leader and spellcaster and the brother of Delina . Personality . As a child , he seemed normal and playful , but jealousy and ambition turned him somewhat crazy .

title: Denial of Resource
description: Denial of Resource A young red dragon with a lair in the Graypeak Mountains has grown more bold and has attacked the village of Shining Falls . Evidence gathered from Zhentarim emissaries shows that the evil organization is also planning on using it to threaten Loudwater . Kalahar Twohands therefore orders a dragon hunt to curb the potential threat .

title: Denver Gilliam
description: Denver Gilliam Denver Gilliam was a businessman in Skullport . Personality . Denver liked written contracts .

title: Depth warning
description: Depth warning Depth warning was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . The caster of this spell could tell sudden changes in depth , including obstacles such as reefs , while at sea .

title: Derdek Deepingdell
description: Derdek Deepingdell Derdek Deepingdell was a male dwarf fighter and the proprietor of the inn called The Bear ' s Den in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Derdek was short and wide and bore a very bushy bear . All in all , he resembled a small bear himself .

title: Derendil
description: Derendil Derendil was a quaggoth who inhabited the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Under the influence of the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu , Derendil believed himself to be an elven prince from the kingdom of Nelrindenvane in the High Forest who was polymorphed into a quaggoth by an evil wizard .

title: Derid Kendrick
description: Derid Kendrick King Derid Kendrick was an heir of Alicia Kendrick and , as of 1479 DR , was the nominal King of all the Moonshae Isles although he only directly controlled Alaron . Even though his power was limited he still commanded the respect of most Ffolk and Northlander s in the isles and hoped to reassert his authority over the entire archipelago .

title: Deriel Rethslane
description: Deriel Rethslane Deriel Rethslane was a moon elf scout living in Cormanthor . History . Deriel lived in the woods of Cormanthor for a century until she met the drow merchant Arrizz and the two fell in love .

title: Derlaunt
description: Derlaunt Derlaunt was the ruler of Gheldaneth in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Being bored , Derlaunt was trying to animate one of the many Statues - That - Walk surrounding Gheldaneth .

title: Derlusk
description: Derlusk Derlusk is a city of music that grew up around one of the busiest harbors in the Border Kingdoms , southeast of the Dragonsmoke Ridge . Wealth is everywhere in the city , with many of the stout stone buildings appearing as a beautiful vista of slate roofs and shimmering lanterns at night . The city ' s port has several rival shipyards , best known for building swift , sleek ' wave runner ' coastboats ( those which are often preferred by smugglers and pirates for their speed and low silhouettes ) .

title: Dermont
description: Dermont Dermont was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Dermonts contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .

title: Dernovia
description: Dernovia Dernovia was a village in Rashemen . Geography . Dernovia was located not far from the shores of Lake Ashane .

title: Derreg
description: Derreg Derreg was a paladin of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1450 DR , Derreg welcomed Varra and called the priest Erdan to help her to give birth to Vasen Cale .

title: Derrick Gaffner
description: Derrick Gaffner Derrick Gaffner was a sailor in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Derrick was a fisherman in Lac Dinneshere and captain of the fishing boat " Howling Fiend " until he found some black ice .

title: Derro
description: Derro Derro were a species of monstrous humanoids that inhabited the Underdark . Physical description . Derro appeared to be some degenerate hybrid of dwarves and humans .

title: Derval Ironeater
description: Derval Ironeater Derval Ironeater was the last King of Clan Ironeater who went on to become a blacksmith in Daggerford . History . Derval traveled to Daggerford with his brothers Derwin and Korin and their families around 1270 DR .

title: Desai
description: Desai The Desai were a Bedine tribe located in Anauroch . By 1468 DR , they were nominally under the rule of Netheril . History .

title: Descent to Undermountain
description: Descent to Undermountain Descent to Undermountain ( also known simply as Undermountain ) is a role - playing game created and distributed by in 1997 . It was developed by , , , , . The game partially derives its title from the use of the 3D graphical engine .

title: Desecrate
description: Desecrate Desecrate was an evocation spell used by cleric s . Effect . This spell strengthened the undead by filling them with negative energy .

title: Desert ' s Virtues
description: Desert ' s Virtues The Desert ' s Virtues was a group of islands in the Great Sea west of the Genie ' s Turban . Description . The Desert ' s Virtues consisted of three small main islands : the Camel ' s Hump , the Chador and the Dune .

title: Desert Mosque
description: Desert Mosque The Desert Mosque was a religious structure in Zakhara where Haku , the Zakharan god of freedom , was worshipped . Location . The Desert Mosque was located about halfway between the Pit of the Ghuls and the Sea of Caravans in the northern reaches of the High Desert .

title: Desert Wind
description: Desert Wind The Desert Wind was a bandit organization located in the Plains of Purple Dust during the mid – 14th century DR . Organization . The Desert Wind had roughly 350 members , most of whom were warriors equipped with leather armor or chain mail .

title: Desert centaur
description: Desert centaur Desert centaurs were nomads inhabiting the vast deserts of Zakhara - They often executed raids on bandits camps , using their speed and savage skills to their advantage . Desert centaurs zealously protect theirs lands . Description .

title: Desert circle
description: Desert circle The desert circle was a druid circle associated with the seemingly barren wastes that held surprising varieties of life . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Desert dwarf
description: Desert dwarf The desert dwarves were dwarven clans living in the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . The dwarves were known as the " Hairy Men of the Desert " to human s living in Maztica . History .

title: Desert fist
description: Desert fist Desert fist was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . When cast , this spell caused a parcel of sand to rise up and strike a target .

title: Desert giant
description: Desert giant In the past desert giants were numerous and lived in the deserts of Zakhara , but their number was decreased by a curse of the gods , which slowly but steadily turns them to stone . Being they are shepherds , they often travel with their herds . In the past they had built a great civilization but it has since succumbed to the ravages of time .

title: Desert of Desolation
description: Desert of Desolation Desert of Desolation is a compilation adventure module published by TSR in 1987 for the " Dungeons & Dragons " fantasy roleplaying game . It combines the three previously published individual modules " Pharaoh " , " Oasis of the White Palm " , and " Lost Tomb of Martek " , which were produced for use with the 1st edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " rules . " Pharaoh " was created by Tracy and Laura Hickman soon after they were wed in 1977 , and published by TSR in 1982 .

title: Desert rider
description: Desert rider Desert Riders were elite mounted warrior s who lived in Zakhara . Requirements . Only humans , elves , and half - elves were desert riders .

title: Desertsmouth Mountains
description: Desertsmouth Mountains The Desertsmouth Mountains were a range of mountains that separated the Dalelands region , to the east , from the great desert of Anauroch , to the west . History . This area was inhabited by dwarves , humans and various monsters as well .

title: Deseyna Norvael
description: Deseyna Norvael Deseyna Norvael was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Deseyna was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation to Mirabar .

title: Deskyr Thanterim
description: Deskyr Thanterim Deskyr Thanterim was the son of Hersir Thanterim and was the only member of the Thanterim family still alive by 1479 . One item Deskyr did have in his possession was the key to the family vaults . Appearance .

title: Desmonda
description: Desmonda Desmonda was the mistress of no less than seven different nobles of Zhentil Keep . A noble herself , she was still overtly flirtatious even though she also managed to keep to herself .
