When Zhentil Keep was under siege in 1368 DR Desmonda was one of many who fell and whose bodies were never found .

title: Despayr
description: Despayr Despayr was a black dragon that was unusual in a number of ways . He was born covered in glowing purple runes , could not breathe acid and lacked the ability to cast spells like others of his kind . Relationships .

title: Dessa sik - Morcane
description: Dessa sik - Morcane Dessa sik - Morcane was a female drow cleric of Lolth in Szith Morcane who , during the Silence of Lolth , turned to barbarism . Description . Dessa had particularly deep black skin for a drow and a shock of wild , white hair .

title: Dessandra
description: Dessandra Dessandra was a member of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes in the Moonsea . History . During the Rage of Demons , Dessandra led a Red Plume patrol to the Goodroot factory to retrieve the red dye that the Goodroots produced from the beet juice harvested on their farm .

title: Dessarin Valley
description: Dessarin Valley The Dessarin Valley was situated between the Sword Mountains and the High Forest . It was home to a diverse range of folk , although most inhabitants were either human s or halfling s . The main industry of the Dessarin Valley was agriculture , and Goldenfields played a large part in the agricultural economy of the North .

title: Desther Indelayne
description: Desther Indelayne Desther Indelayne is an antagonist in the original campaign of " Neverwinter Nights . " After the plague breaks out in Neverwinter , Desther and followers of his arrive , claiming to be priests of Helm sent to help cure the plague with their blessings . Upon the successful creation of a cure for the plague , Desther takes this potion and retreats through a portal to Helm ' s Hold .

title: Destroyer
description: Destroyer The Destroyer , or He Who Learns to Destroy , was a yak - man who lived beneath Huzuz in the Lair of the Unspeakable in 1367 DR . Activities . The Destroyer learned to speak Midani from a slave in the World Pillar Mountains .

title: Destroyers
description: Destroyers The Destroyers were a mercenary company based in Halabar in Halruaa . They specialized in providing artillery support , both mundane and magical , to regular armies . They were commanded by Daltim Flamefist , a noted mage , psionicist , scholar , and noble of Halruaa .

title: Destruction
description: Destruction Destruction was a necromancy spell that could kill a creature and obliterate its body . Earlier versions of this spell were the " resurrection " spell cast in reverse , which turned a creature to dust . Effects .

title: Destruction wave
description: Destruction wave Destruction wave was an evocation spell that had the caster strike the ground to throw divine energies at surrounding targets . Effects . When the caster uttered this spell and struck the ground for emphasis , a wave of energy emanated explosively from the caster and hit any number of chosen targets within 30 ft ( 9 .

title: Detect chaos
description: Detect chaos Detect chaos was a divination spell that provided information about objects or creatures with a chaotic aura . Effects . This spell functioned exactly like " detect evil " except it detected chaotic auras from demon s , chaotic clerics , spells , magic items , etc .

title: Detect evil
description: Detect evil Detect evil was a divination spell that provided information about objects or creatures with an evil aura . Some versions of this spell were reversible , becoming " detect good " , and operated in the same manner but for good auras instead . Effects .

title: Detect evil and good
description: Detect evil and good Detect evil and good was a divination spell that detected outsider s of different types and other types of creatures within 30 feet ( 9 meters ) . Effect . The caster could sense desecrated or consecrated ground as well as aberration s , celestial s , elemental s , fey , fiend s , or undead .

title: Detect good
description: Detect good Detect good was a divination spell that provided information about objects or creatures with a good aura . Some versions of this spell were reversible , becoming " detect evil " , and operated in the same manner but for evil auras instead . Effects .

title: Detect law
description: Detect law Detect law was a divination spell that provided information about objects or creatures with a lawful aura . Effects . This spell functioned exactly like " detect evil " except it detected lawful auras from paladin s , lawful clerics , spells , magic items , etc .

title: Detect lycanthrope
description: Detect lycanthrope Detect lycanthrope allowed the caster to sense the presence of all lycanthropes within its area , which could be a few miles in radius . Infected lycanthropes were more likely to evade the effects of this spell than natural lycanthropes . The caster was unable to tell which kind of lycanthropes were out there , or any information about them other than their location .

title: Detect magic
description: Detect magic Detect magic was a divination spell that was sometimes categorized as a universal spell . It allowed the caster to become aware of magical emanations in the direction the caster was facing , within range of the spell . After the Spellplague , it became a trained skill for those with affinity for magic .

title: Detect metals and minerals
description: Detect metals and minerals Detect metals and minerals was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . However , by 1372 DR , it was known to cleric s and mages in Faerûn .

title: Detect poison
description: Detect poison Detect poison was a divination spell that allowed the caster to sense if a creature or an object was poisonous or had been poisoned . Effect . Upon casting this spell , the caster could examine one creature , object , or a 5 ft ( 3 .

title: Detect poison and disease
description: Detect poison and disease Detect poison and disease was a divination spell that detected diseases , poisons , or poisonous creatures . Effect . Upon casting this spell , the caster could sense disease , poisons , and poisonous creatures within a 30 ft ( 9 .

title: Detect psionics ( spell )
description: Detect psionics ( spell ) Detect psionics was an arcane divination spell that served as a magical counterpart to " psionic sense " , allowing a mage to detect psionic creatures and activity . Effects . The " detect psionics " spell functioned as a magical version of the psionic devotion " psionic sense " , enabling its user to sense all psionic activity within a distance from themselves .

title: Detect scrying
description: Detect scrying Detect scrying was a divination spell that alerted one to magical eavesdropping . Effect . The caster immediately became aware of any attempt at observation by means of " clairaudience / clairvoyance " or " scrying " .

title: Detect secret doors
description: Detect secret doors Detect secret doors is a divination spell that reveals hidden doors within 60 feet of the caster . Effect . When cast , this spell allows the caster to detect secret doors , compartments , caches , and so forth .

title: Detect snares and pits
description: Detect snares and pits Detect snares and pits was a divination spell that made the caster aware of pits , deadfalls , and snares in a chosen direction . Effects . This spell could detect terrain hazards , creature hazards , and even magical hazards as long as they were not mechanically complex and resembled pits , deadfalls , or snares .

title: Detect thoughts
description: Detect thoughts Detect thoughts , also known as ESP , is a divination spell that allows one to " listen " to surface thoughts . Effect . The amount of information revealed depends on how long the caster studies a particular area or subject .

title: Detect undead
description: Detect undead Detect undead was a divination or necromancy spell that revealed undead creatures within a certain distance from the caster . The earliest version of this spell could be cast in reverse as " cloak undead " . Effects .

title: Dethek
description: Dethek Dethek was the name of a runic script used by the Dwarvish language , as well as some , and by the giant , ogre , orc , gnome , goblin , and terran languages . It consisted of letters , numerals and symbols for common words or phrases . " Dethek " was also sometimes used to refer to the Dwarvish language as a whole .

title: Dethud Tanthul
description: Dethud Tanthul Prince Dethud Tanthul was perhaps the most reserved of the twelve princes of Netheril . His reputation for silence was famous throughout the City of Shade ; he rarely spoke directly to anyone , and when he did , it was usually with the voice of wisdom . Among the royal family , Dethud was the closest thing to a peacemaker .

title: Detrinius Wands
description: Detrinius Wands Detrinius Wands was a Faerun ian lich in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Detrinius Wands was a lich from Faerun who decided to go to Kara - Tur , believing it was a land without cleric s .

title: Deudermont
description: Deudermont Captain Deudermont was a friend of Drizzt and the Companions of the Hall . He was the captain of the famous " Sea Sprite " , a large pirate - hunting vessel commissioned to him by the Lords of Waterdeep . Deudermont was recognized as perhaps the most successful pirate hunters of all time , and not even the elves knew of one better .

title: Deularla Ithruen
description: Deularla Ithruen Deularla " Hightower " Ithruen was a gold elf wizard and adventurer from Evermeet who resided in Cormyr in 1367 DR . Activities . Deularla used her spellcasting abilities as an adventurer in the Six Splendid Swords band .

title: Deva
description: Deva Devas are a specific type of aasimar that , unlike typical examples of the race , are all in fact angel ic souls contained within mortal bodies . These souls are reborn again and again , meaning that devas have access to the experiences of several lifetimes in their subconscious and sometimes waking mind as well . These souls are obliged to fight in the cosmic war against evil , though some stray from this path and are reincarnated in their next life as rakshasa s .

title: Deva ( angel )
description: Deva ( angel ) A deva is a category of angel , part of those known as " celestial stewards " . Celestial stewards are those angels who directly serve the gods of the Celestial Planes , and include devas , light s , planetar s , and solar s . There are three types of devas : astral devas , monadic devas , and movanic devas .

title: Devamari
description: Devamari Devamari was a doppelganger criminal in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Activities . The doppelganger acted as the right hand of crime lord Gethmedra Darmov at the Black Blade and Bloody Boar tavern / gladiator arena .

title: Devane
description: Devane Devane was the Helm ite Bishop of Maztica in 1362 DR . History . He was a protégée of the late Bishop Domincus of Amn and communicated with the bishop through magical means until Domincus was sacrificed to Zaltec by the Viperhands .

title: Devastate undead
description: Devastate undead Devastate undead , also known as disrupt undead , was an arcane necromancy spell that sapped undead of their negative energy and destroyed them . Effects . The spellcaster fired a beam at a number of undead targets and destroyed them in a manner similar to the power of a " disruption " weapon .

title: Devic
description: Devic Devic was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the city of Solon and the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It was found in the region between Solon and the Dustwall in the north , Xontuil Bay and the Great Sea in the west , and the Yehimal Mountains in the east . It was categorized as part of the Imaskari languages group , in the Durpari language s subgroup .

title: Devil
description: Devil Devils were a lawful evil race of fiend s who hailed from the Nine Hells of Baator , a dominion of the Astral Sea ruled over by the god Asmodeus . True to their alignment , devils were locked into a strict hierarchy which culminated with the Lords of the Nine , the powerful rulers of the Hells . Types of devils .

title: Devlin
description: Devlin Devlin was an adventurer in the ruins of Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Devlin was an evil adventurer leading the Free Company of the Crescent .

title: Devoted Mamluk Society
description: Devoted Mamluk Society The Devoted Mamluk Society , also known as the Devoted , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Devoted and Exalted were bitter rivals , leading to frequent conflicts in the region of the Cities of the Pantheon .

title: Devourer
description: Devourer Devourers were fiends who acted in the service of Orcus . They were used to create armies of undead by consuming the bodies and souls of humanoid s . Lesser demon s could be promoted to devourers by proving themselves to Orcus .

title: Devout Mamluk Society
description: Devout Mamluk Society The Devout Mamluk Society , also known as the Devout , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization was tasked with protecting the prince of Kadarasto , Nari ibn Aman .

title: Dhaerhaera Nanatar
description: Dhaerhaera Nanatar Dhaerhaera Nanatar was a female human wizard and adventurer who made her home in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . She was one of the more notable mages of the city at the time . In the late 1350s DR , Dhaerhaera captured a griffon and successfully tamed it and taught it to carry her as a rider .

title: Dhaerivus
description: Dhaerivus Dhaerivus was a human wizard with dark eyes and a thin white face . Description . The mage wore a dark with glowing mystic signs , and carried a staff adorned with gem s and a crystal sphere at one end .

title: Dhafiyand
description: Dhafiyand Dhafiyand was a Red Wizard of Thay in Neverwinter in 1478 DR . History . Dhafiyand was a Red Wizard that concealed his true allegiance and managed to become the spymaster of the Protector of Neverwinter , Dagult Neverember .

title: Dhairn
description: Dhairn Dhairn was a judicator of Selvetarm . History . Dhairn was part of a group of drow exiled from Eryndlyn for focusing too much to Selvetarm instead of Lolth In 1375 DR , Dhairn went to recruit a large group of drider s living in the Underdark under the Misty Forest for membership in the Selvetargtlin .

title: Dhalgrave
description: Dhalgrave Dhalgrave was the leader of the malaugrym in 1358 DR . Activities . As Shadowmaster , Dhalgrave had mastery over the Shadowcrown and the Doomstars , two powerful artifact s given by Malaug himself to the leader of his kin .

title: Dhamir Ercals
description: Dhamir Ercals Dhamir Ercals was the high priest of Cyric in Darkhold and one of the Zhentarim leaders of the fortress in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Dhamir led the Second Banedeath in Darkhold , purging all non - Cyric followers .

title: Dhampyr
description: Dhampyr Dhampyrs , also known as " daywalkers , " are living creatures who have inherited some of the tainted blood of vampire s . Some are the descendants of male vampires and mortal females , but many others have dhampyrs for parents and some result from a vampire of either sex biting a pregnant female . A dhampyr ' s powers may lie dormant for years before being quickened ; dhampyrs may also have children who are normal in every respect .

title: Dharbang River
description: Dharbang River The Dharbang River was located in Ra - Khati . Geography . The Dharbang River was the smaller of Ra - Khati ' s two major rivers ; the larger being the Gogrus River .

title: Dharjamyn Thauntle
description: Dharjamyn Thauntle Dharjamyn Thauntle was a cobbler who operated Thauntle ' s Good Heels and Soles in the South Ward of Waterdeep . Personality . The cobbler had a personal collection of gemstones , but claimed that due to his age , he was unable to search for rare stones in the areas surrounding the city .

title: Dharva Scatterheart
description: Dharva Scatterheart Dharva Scatterheart was the would - be - queen of Greenfields in 1372 DR . She enjoyed the open space , freedom from taxation , and the caravans that regularly pass through . Allied with the Shadow Thieves , Dharva had established a small town called Greenest on the trail that led to Berdusk .

title: Dhast
description: Dhast Dhast was a coastal hamlet on the east coast of The Fang in east Faerûn . As of 1368 DR , the population was split between a clifftop community and a smaller number of fishermen living on the beach . The two portions of the hamlet were linked via a trail , and a rivalry existed between them , each side considering the other to be stupid and wicked .

title: Dhaztanar
description: Dhaztanar Dhaztanar , or the Crystal - towered , was the capital of Semphar and the kingdom ' s largest city . Location . Dhaztanar marked one end of the Silk Road , making it a bustling epicenter of trade and commerce .

title: Dhedluk ( town )
description: Dhedluk ( town ) Dhedluk ( pronounced " dead - LUKE " ) was a small town surrounded by a stockade in the King ' s Forest in Cormyr . It had a population of 936 as of 1372 DR . It was a farming and woodcarving community led by Lord Thiombar .

title: Dhelt
description: Dhelt Dhelt was a human man of Elturel in the Chionthar Valley . He was a paladin of Helm , the High Rider of the Hellriders and Lord of Elturel . Under his reign , Elturel became one of the safest and best - defended communities within the region , despite his competitive nature .

title: Dhenna Shavres
description: Dhenna Shavres Dhenna Shavres was a Red Wizard and leader of the Rose Keep enclave in Aglarond . Relationships . She managed to keep running the enclave even after the War of the Zulkirs , when all Red Wizards outside Thay were recalled home by Szass Tam or faced exile .

title: Dheolur
description: Dheolur Dheolur was a former noble house of Cormyr . One of its houses was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr , and another in the King ' s Forest , protected by a 20 foot high ( 6 . 1m ) wall , built on top of the ruins of a temple of Moander .

title: Dheubpurcwenpyl
description: Dheubpurcwenpyl Dheubpurcwenpyl was one of the most powerful deep dragon s in the Underdark in 1370 DR . Reputation . She was so powerful that nobody challenged her authority and even the neighboring drow of Guallidurth had to go around her domain and even revered her as " Malla Harl Valsharess " , or " Honored Queen of the Depths " .

title: Dhinnilith
description: Dhinnilith Dhinnilith was a phantom city rumored to appear on moonless nights every few years , hovering over the waters of the Vilhon Reach , just north of the Chondalwood . History . Dhinnilith was the first of the twelve Cities of the Sword of Jhaamdath , founded in - 5750 DR by that empire ' s psionic rulers .

title: Dhoelath
description: Dhoelath Dhoelath was a high mage who lived in his tower , Dhoelath ' s Tower , in Leuthilspar on Evermeet . Personality . The wizard was reclusive , but had been known to take on an apprentice .

title: Dhoelath ' s Tower
description: Dhoelath ' s Tower Dhoelath ' s Tower was a green marble tower in Leuthilspar , Evermeet . Description . The black and white striped tower had balconies and a reflective black marble roof .

title: Dhow
description: Dhow A dhow was a small sailing ship with a single , triangular sail . Dhows are generally too small to be used as military vessels . In Calimshan .

title: Dhusarra el Abhuk
description: Dhusarra el Abhuk Huntmistress Dhusarra yr Fadila el Abhuk was a Calishite human vampire ( formerly an adventurer ) who lived in Undermountain and worshiped Malar . She famously conducted a High Hunt in the city of Waterdeep . Dhusarra ' s former master was Noreyth Harpell .

title: Diabolic domain
description: Diabolic domain The Diabolic domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters diabolic spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Vile Darkness " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Diabolic Domain Powers .

title: Diabolic grasp
description: Diabolic grasp Diabolic grasp was a moderately complex spell known to warlock s , particularly those of the infernal pact . When cast , " diabolic grasp " allowed a warlock to lift a creature of an ogre ' s size or smaller within fifty feet of him or her with a summoned talon from the Hells and move them telekinetically a distance of at least five feet . The creature could be tossed as far as ten feet , or possibly further , if the caster was an infernal warlock of considerable intelligence .

title: Diamond
description: Diamond Diamond was an extremely hard gemstone found primarily in the cold , mountainous region of Faerûn and anywhere on Toril that had seen volcanic activity , either active or dormant . Nearly all probable diamond locations were deep underground , making them accessible only to dwarves and the other subterranean races . Description .

title: Diancastra
description: Diancastra Diancastra was a deity in the giant pantheon , the Ordning . She was a minor trickster goddess , unlike her older sisters Hiatea and Iallanis . History .

title: Diatryma
description: Diatryma The diatryma was a large , flightless bird native to the Underdark . Description . The gigantic bird was about 8 ft ( 2 .

title: Dice
description: Dice Dice was " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with chess , draughts , and Talis . It was played on multiple plane s of existence . Description .

title: Dictum
description: Dictum Dictum is an evocation spell that kills , paralyzes , weakens , or dazes nonlawful subjects . It is the lawful counterpart to the chaotic spell " word of chaos " . Effect .

title: Dier Ashlin
description: Dier Ashlin Dier Ashlin was a male human Zhentilar soldier during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR He was guarding the Temple of Bane in Zhentil Keep when the god Bane himself , in the corpse of Fzoul Chembryl , arrived in the city after the disastrous Battle of Shadowdale . Ashlin , believing he was speaking to Fzoul , explained the change in the city ' s government after the defeat .

title: Diesel
description: Diesel Diesel , whose real name was David S . LaForce , is an artist who designed the maps for many TSR , Inc . products .

title: Dietr
description: Dietr Dietr was a halfling soul residing in the halfling sphere of heaven , the Green Fields in 1372 . During his second confrontation with the lichdrow Lord Dyrr , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , Gromph Baenre , was physically sent by his enemy to the Green Fields . Here , Gromph met Dietr , who was enjoying his afterlife .

title: Digitalogist
description: Digitalogist Digitalogists were wizard s in Zakhara who used the unique connection between mathematics and magic to create powerful formulas when they cast spells . Requirements . Due to the immense amount of time spent studying complex mathematical equations , digitalogists were always logical and reasonable individuals .

title: Dihl al - Suq
description: Dihl al - Suq Dihl al - Suq , or the Northern Sea Route , was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . The Northern Sea Route was preferred by merchants shipping goods to Hiyal , Wasat , and beyond through the Sea of Caravans . Description .

title: Dihl al - Taif
description: Dihl al - Taif Dihl al - Taif , or the Ghost ' s Route , was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . The portion of Dihl al - Taif found within mighty Huzuz was called the Caravan Boulevard . Description .

title: Dihliz
description: Dihliz Dihliz was located on the edges of Zakhara n civilization about 50 miles north from the mouth of the Nogaro River . It served as a starting point for expeditions to the ruins and jungles of the lost kingdoms of Nog and Kadar , gaining it the title of the " Gateway City " . Between the distant influences of the Grand Caliph in Huzuz and the Padishah of Afyal , corruption grew rampant , compromising the existing regulations about the export of treasures and antiquities .

title: Diinakvil Rylafyrn
description: Diinakvil Rylafyrn Diinakvil Rylafyrn was the leader of the derro Council of Savants of Gracklstugh in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Personality . Diinakvil was a firm supporter of the status quo and spent most of his efforts in ruining the more outrageous plots of his fellow derro savants .

title: Diirinka
description: Diirinka Diirinka was the god of the derro , monstrous hybrids of dwarves and humans that inhabited the Underdark . His symbol was a spiral of gray , black , and white . He was a deity of magic and knowledge , as well as cruelty .

title: Dikanie
description: Dikanie A dikanie was a type of gigantic crab found in the Straits of Koryo between the island of Saishu and the mainland Koryo Peninsula in Kara - Tur . These orange - hued crustaceans grew to 30 – 40 feet ( 9 . 1 – 12 .

title: Dileen Shurlef
description: Dileen Shurlef Dileen Shurlef was an assassin during the Time of Troubles . History . Shurlef was an assassin and a devoted worshiper of Bhaal who helped his god when he was cast out into the Realms in 1358 DR .

title: Diligent Mamluk Society
description: Diligent Mamluk Society The Diligent Mamluk Society , also known as the Diligent , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . Within the Warehouse District of Huzuz , the Diligent Mamluk Society acted as a security force .

title: Dillard Portyr
description: Dillard Portyr Dillard Portyr was the leading Grand Duke of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Dillard disliked conflict , mostly for not being able to manage the stress .

title: Dimension
description: Dimension The dimension school of magic was a " school of effect " rather than one of the traditional schools of magic , which were based on philosophy . Studying dimensionalism was a " specialist " track that exploited space , time , and other dimensions to achieve success .

title: Dimension door
description: Dimension door Dimension door was a conjuration or alteration spell that unerringly teleported the caster and possibly other objects or creatures to a nearby location . Effects . When using " dimension door " , the caster chose a destination that the caster could see , visualize , or describe precisely in distance and / or direction , and was instantly teleported there without error .

title: Dimensional anchor
description: Dimensional anchor Dimensional anchor was an abjuration or alteration spell that barred extradimensional movement . Effects . When cast , an emerald - green beam of light emitted from the caster ' s hand .

title: Dimensional thunder
description: Dimensional thunder Dimensional thunder was a teleportation spell used by swordmage s , most often those of the raging storm path , who preferred to use the forces of thunder and lightning together . With " dimensional thunder " a swordmage could cut a hole in the fabric of the Prime , slipping through into to another location , how far away depending on the swordmage ' s constitution . In the process , the swordmage brought with him or her a wake of thunderous sound , which could be deadly to nearby enemies and which boomed outward from the swordmage ' s weapon .

title: Dimensional warp
description: Dimensional warp Dimensional warp is a teleportation spell used by some swordmage s early on in their training . When cast , " dimensional warp " teleports up to two friendly creatures , including the caster if he or she so wishes . When the teleportation is complete the two creatures will have swapped locations , with the each standing where the other was a moment before .

title: Dimian Ree
description: Dimian Ree Dimian Ree was the baron of Morov in Damara in 1359 DR . History . In 1357 DR Dimian refused to support the army of the Barony of Bloodstone against Zhengyi , believing a suicide effort .

title: Dimon
description: Dimon Dimon was the tharchion of Tyraturos in the realm of Thay and also a priest of Bane . Appearance . Dimon had fairer skin than most Mulan .

title: Dimswart
description: Dimswart Lord Dimswart was one of the leading sages in service to the royalty of Cormyr in Suzail . Appearance . Dimswart was short and stout , with gray hair and sparkling blue eyes .

title: Dimwold
description: Dimwold Dimwold was a fire mephit in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Dimwold acted as a messenger between the balor commander Ter - soth and the palace of Orcus but often he was very lazy .

title: Dinam
description: Dinam Dinam was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Dinam , on the surface , was a polite , well - mannered , individual but with people he trusted he showed his ribald sense of humor and total trust in his companions .

title: Dinin Do ' Urden
description: Dinin Do ' Urden Dinin Do ' Urden was a drow fighter of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . He later became a drider . History .

title: Dinnom Baraizal
description: Dinnom Baraizal Dinnom Baraizal was one of the ten Cloakmasters of Athkatla for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Dinnom was only a passable assassin , but in 1368 DR he was promoted by Rheax Bormul to the position of Cloakmaster of the Bridge district of Athkatla and proved a good choice .

title: Dioptase
description: Dioptase Dioptase , also known as diopside , was a small semi - precious stone that had unusual healing properties . Description . These deep emerald - green stones were typically found in small crystals that were riddled with flaws and only yielded tiny faceted gems .

title: Dirana
description: Dirana Dirana was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Dirana lived at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil .

title: Dire Whiner
description: Dire Whiner The Dire Whiner was a female demon in Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . The Dire Whiner lived in a swamp in the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus .

title: Dire Wood
description: Dire Wood The Dire Wood was a part of the High Forest . Geography . It was defined by a ring of completely albino oak trees surrounding the hills in the eastern High Forest .

title: Dire bat
description: Dire bat Dire bats were giant bats the size of horses . Description . Dire bats averaged 200 pounds ( 90 kilograms ) and had leathery wings that stretched fifteen feet ( 4 .

title: Dire bear
description: Dire bear A dire bear was a huge version of the typical bear . Description . Most dire bears were 12 ft ( 3 .

title: Dire boar
description: Dire boar Dire boars were omnivores and spent much of their time searching for food . Unlike ordinary pigs , dire boars were vicious and would attack any creature that approached . Combat .

title: Dire charm
description: Dire charm Dire charm was an enchantment spell that caused one person to go on a murderous rampage . Effects . Similar to " charm person " , this spell worked on humanoid creatures of medium size or smaller .

title: Dire corby
description: Dire corby Dire corbies were a mutated semi - humanoid horrors that were once flightless birds . They were common to the southern reaches of the Underdark . Description .

title: Dire flail
description: Dire flail The dire flail was a two - handed , exotic melee weapon that could be used as a double weapon . Description . A dire flail was essentially two flail s mounted on either end of a stout haft shorter than a quarterstaff .

title: Dire lion
description: Dire lion A dire lion was a larger cousins of the lion . Description . Dire lions could grow as large as fifteen feet long and weigh as much as 3 , 500 pounds .

title: Dire radiance
description: Dire radiance Dire radiance is among the most basic spell s known to warlock s of the star pact . " Dire radiance " , when cast , allows the warlock to call forth a shaft of brilliant , chilling light from the heavens , using it to cause excruciating pain to a creature within fifty feet . If the creature attempts to approach the warlock , the beam intensifies , causing even greater pain .

title: Dire rat
description: Dire rat Dire rats were dangerous creatures . They were much larger than the common rat and were found in dungeons and city sewers . The bite of these creatures carried a potentially lethal disease known as filth fever .

title: Dire tiger
description: Dire tiger Dire tigers , also called smilodons , were giant cats with a pair of huge fangs jutting from their powerful jaws . Due to these teeth , they were often referred to as saber - toothed tigers . Dire tigers preyed on just about anything that moved .

title: Dire weasel
description: Dire weasel Dire weasels were larger , more - aggressive versions of normal weasels . Physical description . Dire weasels had sleek , long bodies up to ten feet long and could reach a weight of 700 pounds .

title: Dire wolf
description: Dire wolf A dire wolf was a dire version of a grey wolf , being a larger and more primitive or feral breed of wolf . Description . Dire wolves grew to about 9 feet ( 2 .

title: Director
description: Director Directors were beholder abominations that served as hive shock troops . Activities . A director ' s primary function was as a cavalry fighter .

title: Direguard
description: Direguard A direguard was a more powerful version of a baneguard created by cleric s of Cyric ( and later , Iyachtu Xvim , Velsharoon , and others ) , lich es , and death knight s . After the Spellplague , there were two known varieties : the direguard deathbringer and the direguard assassin . Description .

title: Dirs
description: Dirs Dirs , or the Jaw - Tooth , was a rocky island located in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Geography . This island was covered with rocky outcroppings and dried grasses , making in rather inhospitable to humans .

title: Disc of secrets
description: Disc of secrets A disc of secrets was an un holy symbol of Shar that bore an illusion to conceal its appearance , allowing a Sharran cleric to hide their true allegiance . Description . The " disc of secrets " normally appeared to be a blank silver disc on an ordinary silver chain .

title: Discern lies
description: Discern lies Discern lies , also known as detect lie , was a divination spell that reveals deliberate falsehoods . Effect . Each round , you concentrate on one subject , who must be in range .

title: Discern location
description: Discern location Discern location is a divination spell that determines the exact location of a creature or object . Effects . A " discern location " spell is among the most powerful means of locating creatures or objects .

title: Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred
description: Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred The Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred , also known as the Order of the Yellow Rose or the Monks of the Yellow Rose , was a monastic order devoted to St .

title: Disciples of the White Rod
description: Disciples of the White Rod The Disciples of the White Rod were a monastic order of the faith of Loviatar . All monk s of the faith were members of the order . They were based out of an abbey near Calimport .

title: Disguise self
description: Disguise self Disguise self , also known as change self , was an illusion spell that changed one ' s appearance . This spell was originally called Quantoul ' s changer in the days of the first Netherese empire . Effects .

title: Disguise undead
description: Disguise undead Disguise undead was an arcane spell that crossed multiple schools of magic including alteration , illusion , and necromancy . It altered the appearance of one or more undead creatures so they could pass for live , healthy creatures . A less effective but easier to learn illusion - only spell by the same name was later developed .

title: Dishdashah
description: Dishdashah A dishdashah was a type of clothing worn in Zakhara . Description . Dishdashahs were simple tunics that were often worn by farmers or poor merchants .

title: Disintegrate
description: Disintegrate Disintegrate , originally called Aksa ' s disintegrate , was an alteration or transmutation spell that created a thin green ray that made a creature or a object of a certain size vanish , or be reduced to ash or dust . Effect . Older versions of " disintegrate " made the target disappear no matter if it was a creature , or magical matter , or a 1 " cubic volume of other material .

title: Dismal Caverns
description: Dismal Caverns Dismal Caverns was an Astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to the Spellplague it was known as Deep Caverns in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the Great Mother , Ilsensine , Laogzed , and Ghaunadaur .

title: Dismind
description: Dismind Dismind was an arcane enchantment spell that disassociated an individual ' s mind from their body , leaving the body in an invulnerable state of suspended animation , usually as a final escape from a deadly situation . The reverse of this spell , known as restore mind , reunited the body with the absent mind and had other beneficial uses . Effects .

title: Dismissal
description: Dismissal Dismissal , also known as abjure , was an abjuration spell that could send an extraplanar creature back to its plane of origin . Effects . If the caster overcame the target ' s magic resistance ( if any ) , then a momentary battle of wills ensued where the outcome was influenced by the relative difference in experience levels between the caster and the target .

title: Dispater
description: Dispater Dispater was an archdevil of the Nine Hells , and the Lord of the Iron City of Dis . Paranoid and reclusive , he never leaves his inner sanctum . He was always stoic , emotionless , and expressionless .

title: Dispel chaos
description: Dispel chaos Dispel chaos was an abjuration spell that worked exactly like " dispel evil " except it affected chaotic spells and creatures instead of evil ones . Effects . The effects of this spell were the same as " dispel evil " except the aura surrounding the spellcaster was a solid , unwavering blue and made of lawful energy .

title: Dispel evil
description: Dispel evil Dispel evil was an abjuration spell that protected the caster from evil attacks , could banish summoned evil creatures , or dispel enchantments cast by evil spellcasters . The reverse of this spell , dispel good , had the same effects on good attacks , creatures , and enchantments . Effects .

title: Dispel evil and good
description: Dispel evil and good Dispel evil and good was an abjuration spell that granted protection from fey , undead , and monsters from beyond the Prime Material Plane . Effects . For a minute , the caster was covered in shimmering light that created a disadvantage for attacking celestial , elemental , fey , and fiend creatures targeting the caster .

title: Dispel fatigue
description: Dispel fatigue Dispel fatigue was a necromancy spell that alleviated weariness and exhaustion in the recipient . Effects . One creature within a range of 90 ft ( 27 .

title: Dispel fog
description: Dispel fog Dispel fog was an arcane abjuration spell that removed mist and fog from an area around the caster . Effects . This spell took one minute to cast and cleared a circular area with a radius of at least 50 ft ( 15 m ) .

title: Dispel good
description: Dispel good Dispel good was an abjuration spell that worked exactly like " dispel evil " except it affected good spells and creatures instead of evil ones . Effects . The effects of this spell were the same as " dispel evil " except the aura surrounding the spellcaster was dark and made of quivering unholy energy .

title: Dispel law
description: Dispel law Dispel law was an abjuration spell that worked exactly like " dispel evil " except it affected lawful spells and creatures instead of evil ones . Effects . The effects of this spell were the same as " dispel evil " except the aura surrounding the spellcaster was yellow , flickered like a candle , and made of chaotic energy .

title: Dispel magic
description: Dispel magic Dispel magic was a abjuration spell that could negate magic on a creature or object ( including potions ) , or interfere with casting spells and the use of spell - like abilities . Effects . When a magic effect is dispelled it ceases to function as if the spell duration had expired .

title: Dispel mirage
description: Dispel mirage Dispel mirage was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a magical field capable of destroying false images including mirages , illusions , etc .

title: Dispel silence
description: Dispel silence Dispel silence was an abjuration and alteration spell that counteracted the effects of magical silence . Effects . For the duration of the spell , the area of effect was protected against " silence " spells .

title: Dispelling
description: Dispelling Dispelling is a quality that can be applied to weapons . Once per day , the wielder can use the weapon to " dispel " magic on whatever the weapon next touches . Creation .

title: Displacer beast
description: Displacer beast A displacer beast , also known as a dirlagraun , was a monstrous magical creature . History . The beast appears to have originated in the Feywild .

title: Displacer serpent
description: Displacer serpent A displacer serpent was a magical beast , a snake - like with a " displacement " - like ability . Description . A displacer serpent resembled a snake some 8 feet ( 2 .

title: Disruption
description: Disruption Disruption is a weapon property . Weapons with this property are often wielded by paladin s and Kelemvor ites , and are specifically designed to fight undead . Creation .

title: Dissolution
description: Dissolution Dissolution by Richard Lee Byers is the first book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary . The city of Menzoberranzan is being subject to the Silence of Lolth : priestesses no longer have access to their clerical magic .

title: Dissonant whispers
description: Dissonant whispers Dissonant whispers was an enchantment spell that created a cacophonous whisper that damaged a target and could make it run away . Effect . The caster would whisper a cacophonous sound that only the target could hear .

title: Disthene
description: Disthene Disthene , also known as , was a plentiful ornamental stone found across the " Realms " . Description . Disthene cleaved easily but was difficult to facet - cut because it was prone to splitting in unwanted directions .

title: Distort
description: Distort Distort was a simple alteration spell used to alter sound . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .

title: Ditriv Starkdale
description: Ditriv Starkdale Ditriv Starkdale was a sage at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Ditriv was focused only on his research .

title: Divination
description: Divination The divination school of magic contains spells that enable the caster to learn secrets long forgotten , interpret dreams , predict the future , to find hidden things or foil deceptive spells . Among them are included detect magic and scry . A wizard who specializes in divination is known as a diviner .

title: Divination ( spell )
description: Divination ( spell ) Divination was a divination spell that was similar to " augury " but it foretold the outcome should the caster choose to enter a certain area . Effect . The oldest version of the spell told of the strength of monsters and the value of treasure in a known area and if the caster would invoke forces of supernatural evil or good if they attempted to enter .

title: Divination sphere
description: Divination sphere The Divination sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and monk s that could be used to find lost objects or information , or assist in making choices by giving glimpses of possible futures . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Divination Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Divine champion
description: Divine champion Divine champions are powerful individuals in the service of a specific deity . Divine champions come from all sorts of backgrounds and are united solely by their dedication and a loose set of shared skills , though all are considered holy warriors of their various churches , dedicated to the protection of holy sites , priests , and pilgrims , as well as leaders in any crusades . Culture .

title: Divine disciple
description: Divine disciple Divine disciples are those members of the church that have a devotion to their deity far superior to the norm , and who are chosen by their deity to act as intermediaries in the Prime Material Plane . Disciples seek to become the living embodiment of their patron and at the end of their path they ascend to become something more than mere mortals , taking on qualities of the divine . Culture .

title: Divine domain
description: Divine domain A divine domain is a specific area of interest for deities . A cleric of a particular deity must choose two of the deity ' s domains to focus upon , and gains access to extra spells within those domains . A deity can have as many or as few domains as it pleases , although it is usual to have at least four .

title: Divine favor
description: Divine favor Divine favor is a evocation spell that asks the favor of a deity in combat . Effects . The first version of the spell granted the caster a higher ability to successfully strike a enemy as well as increasing the damage of said hit .

title: Divine magic
description: Divine magic Divine magic ( the Power ) was magic granted from prayer with the gods . While divine magic could not function without the Weave , spellcasters who used divine magic had no ability to manipulate the Weave directly . Cleric s , druid s , ranger s , paladin s , and blackguard s predominantly used this type of magic .

title: Divine power
description: Divine power Divine power is an evocation spell that channels holy or unholy power to strengthen the caster ' s combat abilities . Effect . Calling upon the divine power of your patron , you imbue yourself with strength and skill in combat .

title: Divine rank
description: Divine rank Divine Rank . Each deity has a divine rank . A deity ’ s divine rank determines how much power the entity has .

title: Divine sacrifice
description: Divine sacrifice Divine Sacrifice was a necromancy spell that traded the caster ' s life force for increased damage to opponents . Effects . The caster could sacrifice life force to increase the damage dealt to opponents .

title: Divine seeker
description: Divine seeker Divine seeker is a special prestige class on Faerûn . Divine seekers are stealthy characters dedicated to the service of their patron deity and church . They are called to perform different missions , like spying on enemy churches , retrieving holy relics or even assassination of heretics .

title: Divine word
description: Divine word Divine word was an evocation spell where the caster spoke a word imbued with the power of the first creation . Effect . Casting this spell the caster would chose creatures within 30 feet whom had to attempt to resist the spellpower of the caster .

title: Diviner
description: Diviner A diviner was a type of mage who specialized in divination magics . They were typically worshipers of the god Savras and fortune tellers . Notable diviners .

title: Diviner ' s staff
description: Diviner ' s staff A diviner ' s staff is usually made from gnarled hazel and magically enhances the wielder ' s knowledge . It also contains the " identify " , " locate creature " and " locate object " spells , and two each of the " analyze dweomer " and " vision " spells . It is worth around 137 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Divisav Irithyl
description: Divisav Irithyl Divisav Irithyl was the first son of Kahvoerm Irithyl and the second of the family line to attempt to draw the Rulers ' Blade and become the Coronal of Cormanthyr in - 2900 DR . Unlike his father and all of his line to follow , Divisav failed on account of his greed and was consumed by the elfblade . He died instantly in a bout of arcane green fire .

title: Diyah al - Wasil
description: Diyah al - Wasil Diyah al - Wasil was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Diyah had oily skin that marred his complexion .

title: Djaffar
description: Djaffar Djaffar is the leader of the Hammers , the Marchion of Mirabar ' s personal defence . He wears a plumed open - faced helmet . On more than one occasion , some mention is made of Djaffar ' s eyeing of Shoudra Stargleam , as if to suggest he has feelings for her , and that these feelings are not returned .

title: Djalfi
description: Djalfi Master Djalfi was a Red Wizard of Thay and an instructor of the Academy of Shapers and Binders . History . Djalfi was one of the most notorious teachers at the Academy of Shapers and Binders .

title: Djen
description: Djen The Djen was a large group of djinn and their slaves and servants led by the powerful djinni Calim . They came to Faerûn from an unknown place around - 7800 DR and settled the areas immediately surrounding present - day Calimport . This event was known as " The Great Arrival " and within mere months , they had built a large city , whose spires quickly rose above the trees .

title: Djerad Kethendi
description: Djerad Kethendi Djerad Kethendi ( the " Fortress of Gems " in Draconic < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p248 " > < / ref > ) was a Tymanther an port city in the Alamber Sea . Description . Djerad Kethendi was composed of three white pyramids constructed on the southern shore of the Alamber Sea ' s estuary .

title: Djerad Kusold
description: Djerad Kusold Djerad Kusold ( the " Fortress of Kusold " in Draconic ) was a ruined dragonborn city in Melabrauth . History . Before the Blue Breath of Change , Djerad Kusold was a city that served as home for the slave dragonborn population of Melabrauth .

title: Djerad Thymar
description: Djerad Thymar Djerad Thymar ( the " Fortress of Thymara " < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 " > < / ref > , in Draconic ) was the capital city of Tymanther . It served as the cultural nexus for the dragonborn on Faerûn . Description .

title: Djinn freehold
description: Djinn freehold Djinn freeholds were the homes of noble djinni who did not reside in the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Description . Freeholds were made from large chunks of earth or stone that floated around in the Elemental Plane of Air .

title: Djinni
description: Djinni Djinn ( singular : djinni ) were creatures born from the Elemental Chaos . Having aided the primordials in their ancient battle with the gods over control of Faerûn , most were imprisoned in common objects and scattered . The few who were free sought to reclaim their power .

title: Djinni ' s Claws
description: Djinni ' s Claws The Djinni ' s Claws were a group of islands in the Crowded Sea south of Zakhara , located to the west of the Steaming Isles and to the south of Jazayir al - Sartan . Little was known about these islands and no enlightened Zakharans settled there . These mountainous islands of dense jungle were dreaded as the home of pirates , genie s , and monsters .

title: Djinni ' s Flower
description: Djinni ' s Flower The Djinni ' s Flower , or the Floating Rose , was the sailing vessel of the corsair and pirate Ghunayya . Activities . Active in the waters of the Crowded Sea , the " Djinni ' s Flower " targeted Zakharan merchant vessels so it could return their goods to Masud Jazayir .

title: Djinni Caliphate
description: Djinni Caliphate The Djinni Caliphate was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the djinn . Organization . The Great Caliph , Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim , ruled over all of the noble djinni comprising the Djinni Caliphate .

title: Djinnling
description: Djinnling Djinnlings , or wind gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Wind gen usually had bluish skin and white hair .

title: Dlara
description: Dlara Dlara was a wizard in the village of Amphail . History . Dlara was a wizard from Chult who ended up working as the second - in - command of Mother Gothal ' s festhall in Amphail .

title: Dlorna Roaryl
description: Dlorna Roaryl Dlorna Roaryl was the princess of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . She was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Personality .

title: Dlusk
description: Dlusk Dlusk was a small town in Aglarond , near the mouth of the River Umber . It was a fishing town of narrow streets and weathered wooden buildings in the typical Aglarondan style . As of 1368 DR , its population was around one thousand and its harbor was filled with over a hundred vessels .

title: Dmetrio Extaminos
description: Dmetrio Extaminos Dmetrio Extaminos was a male yuan - ti sorcerer and the son of Dediana Extaminos of Hlondeth in Turmish . He was involved in a relationship with Glisena Foesmasher , the daughter of Baron Thuragar Foesmasher of Sespech , making the relationship between Hlondeth and Sespech somewhat tense . Dmetrio was also the leader of the Cult of the Dragon in the city .

title: Dmitra Flass
description: Dmitra Flass Dmitra Flass was the tharchion of Eltabbar within the realm of Thay and a Red Wizard of Illusion . She often tried to settle disputes between the Zulkir s and promote foreign trade of magic items within the Red Wizards of Thay . During the war of Thay in the years 1375 DR - 1385 DR , Dmitra was elected Zulkir of Illusion , following the demise of her predecessor Mythrellan .

title: Do Jang of Won Kwang
description: Do Jang of Won Kwang The Do Jang of Won Kwang was a military academy and " " in the city of Pyong Do in Koryo . It was one of ten respected schools in the land for the teaching of martial arts , particularly tae kwon do , and techniques of honorable behavior and warfare . History .

title: Dock Ward of Waterdeep
description: Dock Ward of Waterdeep The Dock Ward of Waterdeep is situated on the " Great Harbor " of Waterdeep . It contains the docks , shipbuilding yards , and warehouses for the sea trade . Compared to the rest of the city it is exceptionally dirty , smelly , and particularly dangerous .

title: Dodkong
description: Dodkong The Dodkong ( meaning " Deathking " in Giant ) was the stone giant ruler of Cairnheim , and also a powerful lich . History . Grugaran was an old and frail stone giant when he recovered the artifact known as the " Crown of Obadai " from human tomb robbers .

title: Doegan
description: Doegan Doegan ( pronounced " durgan " ) was a realm in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It was one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East . Geography .

title: Dog
description: Dog Dogs were canines prevalent throughout Toril . Description . Dogs were a race of both wild and domesticated animals that were found all over the world .

title: Dog People
description: Dog People The Dog People , also called the " North Ones " , were primitive , savage , nomadic tribesmen who lived in the deserts of northern Maztica . Traits . Dog People tended to act emotionless and did not seem bothered by poverty or pain .

title: Dog Perry
description: Dog Perry Dog Perry was the assassin in the employ of the thieves guild of Quentin Bodeau in 1364 . He was a brutal and savage man . When Artemis Entreri came back to Calimport , Perry against all reasons thought to gain great glory by killing the elder assassin .

title: Doi No Fugu
description: Doi No Fugu Doi No Fugu , or Inn of the Globefish , was a famous inn in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . The story of the Doi no Fugu started in the famous inn , Nami No Hana , where after the battle of Kyoki the founder of the Akimatsu Dynasty , the semi - legendary Akimatsu Mori decided to go there for dinner .

title: Doin Sanehiro
description: Doin Sanehiro Doin Sanehiro , known also as the Monkey , was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Doin was a samurai of Tomobiki in the service of the Shimamura Clan in Kanazaki Province .

title: Dolblunde
description: Dolblunde Dolblunde was founded in 232 DR by several rock and deep gnome clans led by Olbrent Handstone . It was located in the Upper Northdark under the hills northeast of what was to become Waterdeep . Dolblunde joined the kingdom of Phalorm when it was formed in 523 DR but was sacked and pillaged by the Everhorde in 614 DR .

title: Dolerphus Thongolir IV
description: Dolerphus Thongolir IV Dolerphus Thongolir IV was the Thongolir heir . He lived in Waterdeep . He was notable for putting out a public call for a wife after becoming disgusted with the predatory nature of the daughters of wealthy nobility and merchants who sought him .

title: Dolman
description: Dolman A dolman was a type of clothing worn in Zakhara . Description . These garments were floor - length robes that had sleeves .

title: Dolphin
description: Dolphin Dolphins were plentiful in the waters of Abeir - Toril . They could be found in the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath where they could be seen performing the Dance of the Dolphins . They were the allies of the aquatic elves and particularly old and intelligent dolphins could be found living with them in Myth Nantar .

title: Dolphin ' s Climb
description: Dolphin ' s Climb The Dolphin ' s Climb was a river located in Dambrath . Description . The Dolphin ' s Climb flowed from the southwestern range of the Gnollwatch Mountains into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins .

title: Domborcojh
description: Domborcojh Domborcojh was a sapphire dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Domborcojh was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Dome Dancers
description: Dome Dancers The Dome Dancers were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Haku , the Zakharan god of freedom . The Dome Dancers wielded scimitar s in both hands . Activities .

title: Dome of the Rose
description: Dome of the Rose The Dome of the Rose was a monastery and temple to Lathander in Athkatla . The impressive building lay in the Gem District . Description .

title: Domes of Reason
description: Domes of Reason The Domes of Reason was a temple of Oghma in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . It was formerly the seat of Grand Patriarch Cullen Kordamant , the head of the Oghmyte church and widely recognized as the " Voice of Oghma " on Toril .

title: Domgarten
description: Domgarten Domgarten was a young elf scout during the late 15th century DR . History . Domgarten was one of the elf scouts of the Moonwood during the War of the Silver Marches of 1484 DR – 1485 DR .

title: Dominate animal
description: Dominate animal Dominate animal or Dominate beast was an enchantment spell that forced an animal to obey mental commands . Effect . A dominated animal could be commanded with basic orders like " attack " , " fetch " or " run " , though it wouldn ' t obey obviously suicidal instructions or attack creatures much bigger than it .

title: Dominate monster
description: Dominate monster Dominate monster was a enchantment spell that allowed the caster to telepathically control any creature . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " dominate person " , except that it was not restricted by creature type or size .

title: Dominate person
description: Dominate person Dominate person , also simply known as domination , granted the caster control over the actions of a humanoid creature . Effect . Casting " dominate person " on a person could give complete control of that person while on the same plane .

title: Domincus
description: Domincus Domincus was an Amn ian bishop of Helm and a member of Cordell ' s Maztica n expedition . He took his daughter , Martine , on the voyage and when she was sacrificed by the natives of Payit he demanded retribution . Domincus ' thirst for vengeance led to a short war between the Golden Legion and Payit .

title: Domineering
description: Domineering Domineering was a magical quality that could be applied to weapons . The wielder ' s opponent would be forced to fight defensively against a weapon with this quality . Creation .

title: Dominion of Bone
description: Dominion of Bone The Dominion of Bone was a small organization of undead who lived in the ruined fortress of Glaur . History . In 1385 DR , the Blue Breath of Change happened and destroyed the old fortress of Glaur , transporting Laerakond from the world of Abeir to the world of Toril .

title: Dominion of the Burned
description: Dominion of the Burned The Dominion of the Burned was a small and isolated tribe of savage firesoul genasi who lived in the ruined fortress of Glaur . History . Genasi members of the Burned believed themselves the original strain of their race , created by the primordial Nehushta long ago to serve as her slaves .

title: Dominion of the Green King
description: Dominion of the Green King Dominion of the Green King ( or XGR - 5 ) was supposed to be the final module for the Legacy of the Green Regent RPGA campaign but it was never released to Dungeon Masters . Dominion of the Green King was supposed to have been played at the Winter Fantasy convention during February 23 - 26 of 2006 .

title: Domo
description: Domo Domo was a wizard living near Phlan in 1340 DR . History . In order to recover a magic bottle that he believed was in the possession of a hobgoblin tribe , he polymorph ed into the form of a boy and asked the help of an adventuring party to defeat the hobgoblins , telling them a tragic story about the death of his parents at the hands of the monsters .

title: Don Turnbull
description: Don Turnbull Don Turnbull was an editor and game designer who worked for TSR , Inc . Career . Turnbill began his career as a high - school math teacher , but eventually began working in the game design industry .

title: Don Vaez
description: Don Vaez Don Vaez was an adventurer who led Amn ' s second Maztica n expedition . Vaez was from Calimshan and apprenticed with a thieves guild but was not a very good rogue . He later moved to Amn and became a mercenary .

title: Dondon Tiggerwillies
description: Dondon Tiggerwillies Dondon was an afflicted wererat halfling in Calimport with many underworld dealings . Personality . Dondon had the confidence of Artemis Entreri and Regis , but always sided with the strongest .

title: Dongzhei Nangpo
description: Dongzhei Nangpo Dongzhei Nangpo was the leader of the Yellow Mountain Sect in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Dongzhei was the master of the Temple of the Yellow Mountain .

title: Donigarten
description: Donigarten Donigarten was the name for the district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan that surrounded Lake Donigarten . Geography . The district of Donigarten was located at the easternmost side of the cavern housing the city .

title: Donnia Soldou
description: Donnia Soldou Donnia Soldou was a drow assassin and a member of a band of four , including Ad ' non Kareese , Kaer ' lic Suun Wett and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Donnia had long silver hair which she wore across the right half of her face covering her right eye .

title: Donnola Topolino
description: Donnola Topolino Donnola Topolino was the granddaughter of Pericolo Topolino , the Grandfather of Assassins in Delthuntle , Aglarond . She served as one of the captains of Morada Topolino ( the house of Topolino ) , along with the mage Wigglefingers . Skills .

title: Donnor Kerth
description: Donnor Kerth Donnor Kerth was a knight of Lathander . History . Donnor was trained in the ways of Lathander by Grayth Holmfast as a member of the Order of the Aster .

title: Doom
description: Doom Doom was a necromancy spell that reduced the subject ' s combat abilities . Effect . This curse caused a single being to become consumed with dread , which caused them to weaken and lose confidence .

title: Doomguard
description: Doomguard The Doomguard ( nicknamed Sinkers ) was one of the " official " philosophical and political factions of Sigil . Their belief was that the decay and entropy of everything was not only inevitable but a good thing , and what was " supposed " to happen . Though they did not generally act only to destroy everything they came across , they were in favour of the ideas of entropy and chaos and may well have been disposed to help them along in ways they saw as suitable .

title: Doomguide
description: Doomguide Doomguides are devoted cleric s and paladin s of Kelemvor , god of the dead , whom they serve , along with the people of Faerûn , by helping mortals deal with their fears of death and existence after the fact . In order to help combat these fears , many of which are tied to the works of necromancer s , doomguides also serve as elite divine spellcasters who seek out necromancers and their undead servitors to destroy them and bring a measure of peace to the world . To doomguides and their god there is no greater abomination than the undead and doomguides train throughout their careers to free these souls and send them on their way to the City of Judgment .

title: Doomsayer
description: Doomsayer Doomsayers are specialized warlock s of the star pact , who delve into the maddening knowledge of the Far Realm willingly . With this eldritch lore , doomsayers can enhance their powers and affect the fate of others , issuing dark proclamations of doom that all too often prove to true . Doomsayers are not necessarily evil , but they are all dangerous .

title: Doomvault
description: Doomvault The Doomvault of Thay was a massive dungeon containing laboratories used by Szass Tam to fuel his ascension to godhood . Geography . The Doomvault was located deep beneath Thaymount .

title: Doomwarding
description: Doomwarding Doomwarding is a quality that can be applied to weapons , usually those wielded by followers of Tymora . The quality usually gives the weapon seven charges , one of which can be used by the wielder to give a very brief burst of speed or to improve one attack . Creation .

title: Doppelganger
description: Doppelganger Doppelgangers were monstrous humanoids , infamous for their shapeshifting abilities that allowed them to mimic almost any humanoid creature . They were lazy but cunning creatures , who killed or disposed of people then assumed their place . While not actually evil , doppelgangers were extremely self - centered and liable to look down on their victims .

title: Doquaio Baenre
description: Doquaio Baenre Doquaio Baenre was the second - boy of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre at the time of Jarlaxle Baenre ' s birth . History . When Doquaio ' s younger brother Jarlaxle was born , he was set to be killed in a ritual because he was the third - born son .

title: Dorban Smokestone
description: Dorban Smokestone Dorban Smokestone was a dwarf cleric of Mammon . He lived in a dwarf community , and , as a follower of Mammon , used his vast wealth to pay thieves and assassins to kill his enemies . Equipment .

title: Dorbo Diggermattock
description: Dorbo Diggermattock Dorbo Diggermattock and his wife Senni Diggermattock were the informal rulers of the settlers in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Dorbo oversaw the rebuilding of palaces and the reopening of mines , plus organizing patrols to explore as - yet - unexplored parts of the city and to defend the new citizens .

title: Dordrien
description: Dordrien The hold of Dordrien was founded in the shadow of the Desertsmouth Mountains by a Jhaamdathan noble , who the settlement was named after . History . Dordrien led the survivors north from the Twelve Cities of the Sword in - 251 DR after the destruction of Jhaamdath in - 255 DR .

title: Dorgar Adarbrent
description: Dorgar Adarbrent Dorgar Adarbrent is an old Waterdavian noble with a strong interest in preserving Waterdeep ' s traditions . He gives monetary support to old nobles who are down on their luck . Dorgar is often seen wandering the paths in the City of the Dead .

title: Dorhun
description: Dorhun Dorhun was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Dorhun was one of the apprentices of Stonespeaker Hgraam , leader of Clan Cairngorm .

title: Dorigen Kel Lamond
description: Dorigen Kel Lamond Dorigen Kel Lamond was an evil wizard in service to Castle Trinity . After Cadderly spared her in Shilmista , she gradually underwent a change of heart , ultimately sacrificing herself at the Edificant Library in an attempt to save her new - found friends from vampires . Description .

title: Doril Cire
description: Doril Cire Doril Cire was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Doril hatched a subtle plot to destroy the city .

title: Dorina T ' sarran
description: Dorina T ' sarran Dorina T ' sarran was the daughter of Irae T ' sarran and a priestess of Kiaransalee . Description . Dorina is a gaunt drow vampire with deep black skin and yellowish - white hair .

title: Dormythyrr
description: Dormythyrr Dormythyrr was the acting - steward of the Duchy of Brandiar in Damara in 1359 DR . History . Dormythyrr was a simple farmer when the armies of Vaasa devastated his land , killing all the local nobles .

title: Dorn Graybrook
description: Dorn Graybrook Dorn Graybrook was a human half – iron golem adventure who became involved in the events of the Rage of Dragons of Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . History . When Dorn was nine , he and his parents were part of a merchant caravan traveling in the Moonsea region .

title: Dorn Il - Khan
description: Dorn Il - Khan Dorn Il - Khan was a half - orc blackguard and a companion of the Bhaalspawn known as Gorion ' s Ward , in the late 1300s DR . Hailing from the Spine of the World , Dorn spent many years operating as a bandit in Luskan , before being double crossed by his colleagues and left for dead . His anger at this betrayal attracted the attention of the demon Ur - Gothoz , who restored and empowered Dorn with demonic abilities , in return for his service .

title: Dorn Redbear
description: Dorn Redbear Dorn Redbear was a male human barbarian . Description . Typical of his kind , he was physically powerful and could enter a berserk state .

title: Dorna Trapspringer
description: Dorna Trapspringer Dorna Trapspringer was a female dwarven cleric and rogue . She was one of Drogan Droganson ' s first apprentices . Description .

title: Dornal Whitebeard
description: Dornal Whitebeard Dornal Whitebeard was an agent of the Lords ' Alliance in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Dornal was a gregarious old dwarf with a hedonistic demeanor .

title: Dornavver
description: Dornavver Dornavver , also known as Demonbane , was a legendary weapon of Faerûn ian history . It was a sword wielded by heroic paladins and the kings of Impiltur , and it was famous in the fight against the fiend s . Description .

title: Dornavver ( smith )
description: Dornavver ( smith ) Dornavver was a master sword - smith of the 3rd century DR , who forged the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History . To counter the growing spread of evil under the Shoon Imperium and a plethora of evil artifacts fashioned at the time , the Church of Ilmater sought a weapon to combat such evil .

title: Dorothea Linkletter
description: Dorothea Linkletter Dorothea Linkletter , born Dorothea Nacht , was a female human living in Neverwinter in 1479 DR , serving as one of the architects of Lord Dagult Neverember before she became involved in the plots of Rhazzad . History . Dorothea was a renowned architect who came to the city at Lord Dagult Neverember ' s behest to help in the rebuilding .

title: Dorrin Brightaxe
description: Dorrin Brightaxe Dorrin Brightaxe was a dwarf fighter in Daggerdale around 1479 DR . History . Dorrin was a dwarf born from the Brightaxe clan living in Daggerdale .

title: Doryn
description: Doryn Doryn No - Mouth was a male human and one of the four staff of The Rapids inn in Teshwave in 1367 DR , working as a stableboy and handyman . He was a young , fair - faced lad of around 17 years , but he was mute . Doryn was frequently harassed by the Zhentilar because of his particular condition , and they called him " Doryn No - Mouth " .

title: Dosemen
description: Dosemen Dosemen , sometimes called Dosemen of Sundabar , was a competent wizard from Sundabar . In 1364 , he was involved in a contest with the fellow mages of his guild and invoked the aid of a demon . Dosemen was tricked into calling the help of a powerful demon lord , Errtu .

title: Doss lute
description: Doss lute A Doss lute was a magical masterwork lute with multiple magical abilities . It was one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description .

title: Dottee
description: Dottee Dottee was a teamster ' s wife in Hillsfar in the Moonsea . History . During the Rage of Demons , Dottee announced to Wittel that she was pregnant and they decided to go for a trip in the Cormanthor forest .

title: Double Dragon Gambling Hall
description: Double Dragon Gambling Hall The Double Dragon Gambling Hall was a secret , invitation only , gambling den located in the Shou district of Xiousing in Marsember . The entrance to the Double Dragon was through a curtain in the Shrine of Tymora . The ground floor was reserved for common patrons while wealthy patrons were invited to game at the high stakes games on the top floor .

title: Doubloon
description: Doubloon Originally a ground - based bandit hideout , the city of Doubloon was transplanted onto a flying citadel by the archwizard Tempera of Fenwick in - 1645 DR ( 2214 NY ) . Tempera was impressed with the bandits ' ability to counterfeit money from the various Netherese cities , and she strived to make quasi - magical devices to aid the bandits in their counterfeiting operations . Of course , this made Doubloon less than popular with the other enclaves .

title: Dougan ' s Hole
description: Dougan ' s Hole Dougan ' s Hole is the smallest of the Ten Towns in Icewind Dale , with a population of around 100 some time around the 1360s DR , most of them fishermen Geography . The town is located on the western shore of Redwaters , southwest of Good Mead . Two piers jut out into the lake : the Short Pier and the Long Pier .

title: Doughty
description: Doughty Doughty was a knight of the Knights in Silver in the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during an assault by orc and drow on the Silver Marches , Doughty and Plenerond Silverbell were part of a contingent of Knights under Aleina Brightlance who helped in the defense of Sundabar .

title: Douglas Niles
description: Douglas Niles Douglas Niles wrote the very first Forgotten Realms novel , " Darkwalker on Moonshae " , as well as the subsequent titles in the Moonshae trilogy and two further trilogies in the Forgotten Realms . Until 1982 he was a high school teacher in Clinton , . Heidi Gygax , daughter of D & D co - creator Gary Gygax , was in his class , and introduced him to the game around 1979 .

title: Doum ' wielle Armgo
description: Doum ' wielle Armgo Doum ' wielle Armgo was the daughter of Sinnafain , an elf in the Moonwood , and Tos ' un Armgo , a renegade drow . Description . Doum ' wielle had silvery skin .

title: Dounalis Guff
description: Dounalis Guff Dounalis Guff was the High Priest of Tempus at the Vault of Swords in Hillsfar . He also served as the chaplain for the city ' s military force , the Red Plumes . A gruff and loud man in his mid - forties by 1374 DR , Dounalis believed that salvation from cowardice could only be found through death on the battlefield .

title: Doust Sulwood
description: Doust Sulwood Doust Sulwood was a human cleric of Tymora and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He became the Lord of Shadowdale after Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun offered this title to his companion Florin Falconhand but Florin declined it . Background .

title: Dove Falconhand
description: Dove Falconhand Dove Falconhand , born Ambara Dove Silverhand was a ranger , Chosen of Mystra , and one of the Seven Sisters , known for her skill at arms . Most folk in the Realms knew her as a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor who was skilled with bow and sword , but who said little . Fellow Harpers knew her as an accomplished singer and harpist , and also knew she had been raising her son , Azalar Falconhand , in Evermeet .

title: Dowell Harpell
description: Dowell Harpell Dowell Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their spokesman in the late 15th century DR . History . Dowell was the husband of Penelope Harpell and the family spokesman in 1479 DR .

title: Downshadow
description: Downshadow Downshadow was the name commonly used to refer to the upper levels of Undermountain in Waterdeep . As of 1479 DR , the top levels of Undermountain were mostly cleared of monsters although some creatures still roamed the halls and many magical traps remained active . In the years after the Spellplague , the southernmost cavern in the upper levels turned into a sort of village inhabited by outcasts , criminals , and down - on - their - luck adventurers exploring the lower levels .

title: Doxon
description: Doxon Doxon was a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Doxon was an intelligent and charismatic individual .

title: Draa velve
description: Draa velve Draa Velve , meaning " two swords " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that made use of two bladed weapons . Description . As the name " two swords " suggested , the fighting style was about fighting with two swords , one in each hand .

title: Draac Xorlarrin
description: Draac Xorlarrin Draac Xorlarrin was a member of House Xorlarrin and an ally of the fire giant Duke Zalto sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Once Draac lived in Q ' Xorlarrin .

title: Dracandros
description: Dracandros Dracandros of the Crimson was an exiled Red Wizard of Thay in Battledale in 1357 DR . History . Dracandros was a promising but megalomaniac Red Wizard .

title: Drace
description: Drace Drace was an herb produced from the leafs of the bittergar bush , a small thistle - like shrub which grew all over Faerûn with the exception of mountainous or desert regions . Raw drace was too bitter to consume but when cooked it lost its bitterness and , when added to a pot , could enhance the flavor of other foods . This herb was one of the ingredients of Spellslayer wine .

title: Dracil
description: Dracil Dracil was a dwarf who lived within the Forest of Amtar in Dambrath . Activities . Dracil was the leader of the nefarious adventuring group known as Dracil ' s Raiders .

title: Dracil ' s Raiders
description: Dracil ' s Raiders Dracil ' s Raiders was an adventuring group inhabiting the Forest of Amtar in Dambrath . Activities . Though small with only ten members , this group was comprised entirely of wicked individuals who enjoyed attacking small caravans that traveled the roads located to the east of the forest .

title: Dracohorn
description: Dracohorn House Dracohorn was a small noble house of Cormyr . The family had a bad reputation among the other noble houses of Cormyr . The family wanted to shift power from the king to the nobles .

title: Dracolich
description: Dracolich More than a powerful form of undead , a dracolich is a dragon who has voluntarily tied its soul to a phylactery , freeing itself from death .
