A type of lich , the creature ' s spirit can possess any dead serpentine body , usually their original form , and retain all the powers and abilities of the former body . That means a dracolich has the supernatural fear aura , spells , and breath weapon it had in life , plus the terrible might of the undead .

title: Dracolisk ' s Head
description: Dracolisk ' s Head The Dracolisk ' s Head was an inn in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . It was a low - quality and dilapidated place , but cheap . Despite this , it had a stuck - up air of tired old glories .

title: Draconic creature ( template )
description: Draconic creature ( template ) A draconic creature was the second - generation or later offspring of a dragon . Description . Draconic creatures bore subtle indications of their draconic heritage .

title: Draconic language
description: Draconic language Draconic was the language of dragons . It used its own distinct alphabet , called Iokharic . Other native speakers included members of draconic - related races , such as kobolds and dragonborn , and members of reptilian races such as lizardfolk and troglodyte s .

title: Draconic pantheon
description: Draconic pantheon The draconic pantheon was the dragon pantheon of god s . Members . The pantheon consisted of the gods worshiped mostly by dragons , though some of these deities also had among their worshipers half - dragon s , kobold s , lizardfolk , troglodyte s , spellscale s , and even human s and dragonborn .

title: Draconis
description: Draconis Draconis was a brown dragon and the son of Abazigal . Curiously enough , Draconis seemed to be a brown dragon even though Abazigal was a blue . Like Abazigal , Draconis was a dragon capable of taking humanoid form .

title: Dracorage mythal
description: Dracorage mythal Created during the Time of Dragons by High mage s of the Fair Folk , this High Magic effect tied a Faerûn - wide " mythal to the King - Killer Star . The Dracorage mythal encompasses roughly a 250 , 000 square mile area where the King - Killer Star is visible over Faerûn and causes all dragon and dragon - blooded creatures to slowly become more agitated and reckless , eventually becoming little more than raging beasts . This effect lasts for ten days .

title: Dracosphinx
description: Dracosphinx The dracosphinx is a desert - dwelling creature related to red dragon s . This sphinx is a sly predator , roaming the desert highlands in search of all sorts of prey . They prefer to lair in bleak cliff sides , where they have an excellent vantage point of their hunting territory .

title: Dracowyr
description: Dracowyr Dracowyr was an earth mote that floated five miles above the Great Wild Wood in Murghôm . Near the center of the mote was a castle - like building carved into the landscape . Dracowyr was used as a neutral ground where the Princes of Murghôm and other foreigner dragon s celebrated meetings and other events relevant to dragon kind .

title: Dradeel
description: Dradeel Dradeel was an elven wizard and the only surviving member of Balduran ' s last crew . History . Dradeel was on board Balduran ' s ship when it arrived at Balduran ' s Isle in the Trackless Sea .

title: Drado Weny
description: Drado Weny Drado Weny was a magic - user in Hades in 1358 DR . History . In 1357 DR Drado went in Hades offering his service as ally to the arcanaloth Yrkhetep but for his pride Yrkhetep enslaved him and cursed him to remain in the conduits that permitted the access to the Infinity Train until Drado had killed a thousand enemies of Yrkhetep .

title: Draegan Guldar
description: Draegan Guldar Draegan Guldar was a daywalker vampire and a low - ranking member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Draegan was a beautiful man who possessed a physique like a cleric of Sune .

title: Draegloth
description: Draegloth Draegloths were half - demon , half - drow monstrosities . They are created by the " unholy union " of a glabrezu and a newly - ordained high priestess of the drow goddess Lolth . Description .

title: Draethren Tanthul
description: Draethren Tanthul Draethren Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade and the best sorcerer of Thultanthar . History . Draethren usually worked at the warded tomb of Anlathgrus .

title: Draevyn Thornbolt
description: Draevyn Thornbolt Draevyn Thornbolt was an albino wizard in Neverwinter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Draevyn was a captain on the employ of Dagult Neverember , captaining the " Seabreaker " .

title: Dragathil
description: Dragathil Dragathil was a slightly curved rapier sized for medium creatures . It had a row of small rubies down the center of the blade and a large basket hilt in the form of rose s twined around three harps . The rapier glowed with a fierce red light when drawn , but despite its fearsome appearance , it was designed to subdue opponents peacefully .

title: Dragon
description: Dragon Dragons ( or wyrms ) were very powerful and magical creatures . There were several types of dragons , the most common of which were chromatic and metallic which were evil and good respectively . They were an ancient race .

title: Dragon ' s Breath Beer
description: Dragon ' s Breath Beer Dragon ' s Breath Beer was a strong beer exported from Sembia and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This beer had a strong and harsh flavor .

title: Dragon ' s Hoard
description: Dragon ' s Hoard The Dragon ' s Hoard was an independent trade organization that operated throughout the Underdark . The majority ( if not all ) of its members were worshipers of Vhaeraun . Activities .

title: Dragon ' s Teeth
description: Dragon ' s Teeth The Dragon ' s Teeth , or Lui Do - pah were the straits lying between the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo and the island of Ryuten in Kozakura , in Kara - Tur . It linked the Sea of Kozakura and the ganra ye - do . They lay south of Paektu - san .

title: Dragon ' s breath
description: Dragon ' s breath Dragon ' s breath is one of the spells available in " " . Like similar spells , it can only be learned by a powerful mage or sorcerer , and no scrolls exist of it . " Dragon ' s breath creates a disembodied dragon head that breathes forth an enormously damaging fireball that only affects enemies and may throw them backwards .

title: Dragon ( magazine )
description: Dragon ( magazine ) Dragon is one of the two official magazines for source material for the " Forgotten Realms " , first published in 1976 . History . In 1975 , TSR .

title: Dragon ( ship )
description: Dragon ( ship ) The Dragon was the sailing vessel of the corsair Shing Jaw - long . This ship was a dragonship of shou design . Shing stole the spelljammer from Kara - Tur and settled in Zakhara with the hopes of avoiding the emperor ' s wrath .

title: Dragon +
description: Dragon + Dragon + is a mobile application developed by marketing agency Dialect Inc . in collaboration with Wizards of the Coast for Apple and Android products . After the " Dungeon " and " Dragon " magazines were placed on hiatus in December 2013 , Wizards of the Coast concentrated on the release of the 5th edition of the Dungeons & Dragons game .

title: Dragon Beach
description: Dragon Beach Dragon Beach was the original harbor in Luskan , and was an extremely lawless place . Structure . The harbor was usually crammed with small boats , cog s and caravel s , and also pirate and merchant shipping .

title: Dragon Eyrie
description: Dragon Eyrie The Dragon Eyrie was the home of the Draconic pantheon , manifesting as a vast mountain with its peak eternally covered in frost and surrounded by wispy clouds . While the Dragon Eyrie was the home of all draconic deities , only Hlal , Null , Task , and Tiamat had permanent lairs on the plane . Dragon Eyrie links .

title: Dragon Falls ( village )
description: Dragon Falls ( village ) Dragon Falls was a small village in the Vast , lying between Dead Tree Hollow and Glorming Pass , where the Hlintar Ride met the North Road . It was located on the north side of the Fire River and was named for the nearby Dragon Falls . History .

title: Dragon Falls ( waterfall )
description: Dragon Falls ( waterfall ) Dragon Falls was a waterfall in the Vast , lying on the Fire River . It gave its name to the nearby village of Dragon Falls . Description .

title: Dragon Reach
description: Dragon Reach The Dragon Reach was a northwestern fjord of the Sea of Fallen Stars that stretched between the Vast and the Dalelands . History . The name likely derived from the days , circa - 700 DR , when elves ruled the forested western shore , orc s were teeming to the east , and dragon s laired about the Moonsea and held sway over the northern part of the Reach .

title: Dragon Sea ( Abeir )
description: Dragon Sea ( Abeir ) The Dragon Sea was the largest inland body of water in Returned Abeir . Geography . The sea stretched from the coastline of Relmaur all the way south to the Great Sea .

title: Dragon Wars
description: Dragon Wars The Dragon Wars were between the Calim Empire and the dragons in the Marching Mountains . It started when a flight of dragon s destroyed the city of Calimport in " circa " - 7790 DR . This event initiated a century of war pitting Calim and the genie s against the dragons .

title: Dragon aging
description: Dragon aging True dragons go through twelve stages of growth during their enormously long life cycle . While size depends on the subspecies of dragon , great wyrms are often more than 100 feet in length . Unlike Human s , age does not seem to diminish their strength , intelligence , or power , and often has the opposite effect , and so the oldest wyrms are among the most formidable and impressive creatures in all of Faerûn .

title: Dragon ascendant
description: Dragon ascendant Easily the most powerful creatures native to the Material Plane , dragons hold a unique position in relation to the powers beyond that plane . Those who become dragon ascendants , such as Tchazzar , quest to transcend the limitations of material existence , rising above all other dragons to become nothing less than deities themselves . Their progress through the levels of this class represents their advancement toward their ultimate goal , and they become increasingly godlike as they advance .

title: Dragonback Inn
description: Dragonback Inn The Dragonback Inn was a large building with fieldstone walls to chest height and wooden walls above , supported by thick timbers . The windows were made from dark - green , leaded glass , and above the door there hung a wooden sign . A dragon skull hanged over the fireplace in the main room , and the walls were decorated with banners and shields .

title: Dragonbait
description: Dragonbait Dragonbait ( also referred to as Champion ) is the finhead saurial companion of the adventurer Alias . Dragonbait is a paladin of the God of Law from his world , with his spells currently provided by the god Tyr . He was brought over into this world by a cruel trick of Moander ( prior to the Rotting God ' s death at the hand of Finder Wyvernspur during the Godswar ) along with a small portion of his people .

title: Dragonbane
description: Dragonbane Dragonbane was an abjuration spell that warded an area against intrusion by dragon s . Effects . Any dragon that failed to resist " dragonbane " was physically unable to enter the protected area for the duration of the spell .

title: Dragonbane amber
description: Dragonbane amber Dragonbane amber was a type of magic al amber crystal usually found underground in Returned Abeir . Powers . The dragonbane amber had the quality to greatly weaken any nearby dragon s to the point of killing them if exposed to the crystal during prolonged periods of time , hence the name .

title: Dragonbloods
description: Dragonbloods The Dragonbloods were a Luskan gang whose members were predominately Shou . The gang ' s headquarters was the Dragon ' s Lair , a reconstructed watch barracks . Their leader , Umbra , was rumored to be a dragon although in reality he was some sort of doppelganger .

title: Dragonbones
description: Dragonbones The Dragonbones was seemingly bottomless gulf located in Fimbrul , where all dragon s in Returned Abeir went to die . Background . It was believed that dying dragons when to Dragonbones and killed themselves by crashing against the gulf , mingling their bones with those of long dead dragons .

title: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn Dragonborn ( also known as Strixiki in Draconic ; or Vayemniri , " Ash - Marked Ones " , in Tymantheran Draconic ) were a race of native to Abeir , Toril ' s long - sundered twin . During the Spellplague the dragonborn nation of Tymanchebar was placed where Unther had once been , creating the nation of Tymanther , where most dragonborn of Faerûn dwelt in the 15th century DR . Dragonborn had a strong hatred of dragon s , who had enslaved them on Abeir .

title: Dragonborn of Bahamut
description: Dragonborn of Bahamut Dragonborn of Bahamut ( also known as Ux Bahamuti in Draconic ) were a race of created by the deity Bahamut during the Time of Dragons to act as his emissaries in the mortal realm . Unlike normal creatures , dragonborn of Bahamut weren ' t born naturally , but instead were creatures reborn from good - aligned non - draconic humanoids who , to show their devotion to Bahamut , willingly took on draconic traits in place of their original biology . Dragonborn of Bahamut were powerful creatures who resembled their adoptive father .

title: Dragoneye Dealing Coster
description: Dragoneye Dealing Coster The Dragoneye Dealing Coster was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This merchant company was originally founded by two brothers who did not want to ship overland to avoid pirates only to loose their goods to roadside bandits .

title: Dragonfall War
description: Dragonfall War The Dragonfall War was a conflict between the draconic followers of Bahamut and Tiamat . In some respects the conflict never ended . It began in the Time of Dragons , a period that lasted about six millennia from c .

title: Dragonfang bolt
description: Dragonfang bolt Dragonfang bolt was a spell used by many sorcerer s who were inexperienced or had not yet obtained a vast amount of power . " Dragonfang bolt " , when cast , caused several venomous dragon fangs to appear in mid - air , which the sorcerer could then hurl towards one or two creatures within fifty feet of the caster , inevitably striking them and quite possibly poisoning them . The spell was not one that comes easily and " dragonfang bolt " could only be cast once per day .

title: Dragonfrost
description: Dragonfrost Dragonfrost is a spell similar to " ray of frost " used by sorcerer s , particularly dragon sorcerers . When it is cast , " dragonfrost " slams an icy gust into a creature of the sorcerer ' s choice within fifty feet , pushing them back up to five feet and causing them injury from its frigid power , which is fueled by the sorcerer ' s charisma like virtually all sorcerer spells . " Dragonfrost " is instantly recastable and its power grows as the sorcerer using it does .

title: Dragonheir
description: Dragonheir The Dragonheirs , formerly known as Dragonmasters , were an Abeir an human bloodline who had been granted the power to control dragon s by the primordials . Abilities . Dragonheirs had the ability to control dragons by gaze , voice , or touch .

title: Dragonheir Clans
description: Dragonheir Clans Dragonheir Clans was an Abeir an book that chronicled the story of the Dragonheir s of the Sword Lands , and recorded the genealogy of every Dragonheir clan that had existed . History . In 1479 DR , the book came into possession of the adventuress Jada Marlserpent , the last survivor of Clan Marlserpent .

title: Dragonisle
description: Dragonisle Dragonisle ( sometimes The Dragonisle ) is the largest island in the Pirate Isles . It is populated by around 4 , 000 pirates and is geographically dominated by the Earthspur , an 8 , 000ft ( 2 , 438m ) mountain at the southern end of the island . The island has historically been the seat of power for anyone controlling the islands as a whole .

title: Dragonjaw Mountains
description: Dragonjaw Mountains The Dragonjaw Mountains were mountains in Thesk inhabited by gnome s and copper dragon s . The gnomes were frequent visitors to the human city of Milvarune where they traded their crafts . The dragons were known to enter annual joke - telling competitions with the gnomes .

title: Dragonmere
description: Dragonmere The Dragonmere ( also known as the Lake of Dragons ) was a lake on the Dragon Coast at the western edge of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Cormyr and Sembia were on the northern part of this lake , with the Dragon Coast along the south . The Dragonmere was almost 100 miles from north to south at its widest point .

title: Dragonne
description: Dragonne Dragonnes are dangerous monsters that possess the ferocity of a lion and the cunning of a dragon . They appear to be lions covered in brass - colored scales with massive wings like those of a dragon . Dragonnes are highly territorial and will attack any invading creatures in their home .

title: Dragonriders Club
description: Dragonriders Club The Dragonriders Club is a private club in Suzail , owned by Tress , that is the favorite nightime hangout of many nobles and wealthy merchants . The club ' s primary attraction is its beautiful Mask Dancers who dance on stages wearing nothing but a mask . During the daytime hours the club offers meals and services such as haircuts and baths to its members .

title: Dragonslayer ( tribe )
description: Dragonslayer ( tribe ) The Dragonslayer tribe was a tribe of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . As their name told , they claimed to have slain a number of dragon s . Base of Operations .

title: Dragonsoul heir
description: Dragonsoul heir Dragonsoul heirs , also known as dragon disciples , are an elite form of dragon sorcerer s . These spellcasters tap into the lingering residue of dragon blood within their bodies , unleashing it in the form of draconic abilities . As a dragonsoul heir progresses along the path they began , their physical appearance begins to change , becoming more and more dragon like as they realize the power within their blood .

title: Dragonspawn
description: Dragonspawn Dragonspawn , also known as the spawn of Tiamat , were a type of creatures descended from true dragon s . They were the antithesis of the dragonborn of Bahamut . Description .

title: Dragonspear Castle
description: Dragonspear Castle Dragonspear Castle was a fortress , built across three low hills on the southwestern edge of the High Moor , east of Trollbark Forest and just north of where the Coast Way joins the Trade Way . Extensive tunnels were dug under the keep , connecting with an underground river , the already - abandoned city of Kanaglym , and hence the larger Underdark . The Castle became most notable for its interplanar portals , through which come baatezu and other fiends .

title: Dragonspine Mountains
description: Dragonspine Mountains The Dragonspine Mountains was a range of peaks to the west of the region of the Moonsea . History . Around 1372 DR , Zhentil Keep had mines in the western half of the range , while Melvaunt and Hillsfar had mines in the eastern half .

title: Dragonstaff of Ahghairon
description: Dragonstaff of Ahghairon The Dragonstaff of Ahghairon was a powerful magic staff . Powers . Any dragon touched by the staff became immune to the effects of Ahghairon ' s dragonward for a duration of time specified by the mage who controlled the staff .

title: Dragonstail
description: Dragonstail The Dragonstail was a peninsula protruding from the Purple Hills in Tethyr in west Faerûn . Geography . The Dragonstail was low in elevation and described as serpentine , snaking out into the Sea of Swords .

title: Dragonstooth
description: Dragonstooth Dragonstooth was a magical longsword containing the spirit of the red dragon dracolich Greshrukk , known as Red Eye . Powers . Dragonstooth was a " + 4 defending longsword " .

title: Dragonsword Mountains
description: Dragonsword Mountains The Dragonsword Mountains , located in central Mulhorand , served as a barrier between the Plains of Purple Dust and the rest of the nation . Geography . The Dragonsword Mountains were considered impassable by the people of Mulhorand , and as a result remained largely unexplored .

title: Dragonwall
description: Dragonwall The Dragonwall was a giant wall located on the eastern edge of the Quoya Desert along the border with Shou Lung in Kara - Tur . Description . Thousands of miles long , the wall was built with brick and stone .

title: Dragonwrought kobold
description: Dragonwrought kobold Dragonwrought kobolds were rare kobold s who were considered a blessing by normal kobolds . History . Kobold myths maintained that the race was descended from true dragon s .

title: Draguth Endroun
description: Draguth Endroun Draguth Endroun is the elderly and reclusive leader of the druid ic circle known as the Knightswood Nine . A stubborn and short - tempered man , Draguth is often found fighting with the other members of the group . He retains his leadership over the others by acting more powerful than he is along with possessing a brilliant store of knowledge about the King ' s Forest .

title: Drakar
description: Drakar Drakar was a human man . He served as a cook to both the Red Brigade mercenaries and later the Vipers bandit s . History .

title: Drake
description: Drake Drakes were draconic creatures that were distantly related to wyvern s . They were smaller and not as powerful as dragon s but were much easier to train , so they were commonly used as mounts . They were often used as guards by metallic dragon s , or they were given to the dragons ' humanoid servants .

title: Drakkar
description: Drakkar A drakkar , also known as a dragonship , was the largest vessel used by the Northmen of the Moonshae Isles . Description . Typically 100 ft ( 30 m ) long at the keel and 20 ft ( 6 m ) wide , drakkars were primarily rowed , but could raise a single mast and sail if desired .

title: Drakosa
description: Drakosa Drakosa owned a plantation near Helmsport . History . Drakosa was a petty noble from Memnon who decided to go to Maztica .

title: Dral Thelev
description: Dral Thelev Dral Thelev was an one - eyed half - orc innkeeper in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Dral managed the Danivarr ' s House inn under the Zoar family .

title: Dralmorrer Borngray
description: Dralmorrer Borngray Dralmorrer Borngray was an elf who served as caretaker of Castle Naerytar for the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker Rezmir of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . He was also member of the Eldreth Veluuthra . Personality .

title: Dralpur
description: Dralpur Dralpur was a mining city of 8000 people in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . It was located on the eastern slopes of the Galuil Mountains , known locally as the Mountains of Gold .

title: Dram Kallen
description: Dram Kallen Dram Kallen is an alchemist and inventor of the Silver Stake gas bomb , a device used by the Silver Stake to subdue and capture lycanthropes . He is also a founding member of the Silver Stake organization itself . He was born in Baldur ' s Gate and has lived there his entire life .

title: Dramar Lornen
description: Dramar Lornen Dramar Lornen was a collector from the " Royal Keep " of Ironhar in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . Dramar was obsessed with the Dawn Titan ' s Spire , and , as of 1479 DR , she had hired many adventurers and agents in all of Returned Abeir to investigate any clues that would allow Dramar to gain entry to the Spire .

title: Drann Barrow
description: Drann Barrow Drann Barrow was a member of the Zhentarim who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . During the Tyranny of Dragons , Drann was in the Whispering Carverns and directed many adventurers to disrupt the actives of the Cult of the Dragon , including in the fight with Vilithrax .

title: Drannin Splitshield
description: Drannin Splitshield Drannin Splitshield was an evil dwarf of Mithral Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Drannin was a self - serving individual who believed that , due to his heritage , he was owed better than he received .

title: Drasek Riven
description: Drasek Riven Drasek Riven was a one - eyed former Zhentarim assassin and longtime rival of Erevis Cale . Background . After he and Erevis were pulled into a near - death experience at the hands of a shadow adept and his slaad i partners , they grudgingly joined forces to oppose them .

title: Drashk
description: Drashk Captain Drashk was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Drashk was a member of the Zhentarim who sometimes acted as captain of the " Lost Cause " .

title: Drasna Bluemantle
description: Drasna Bluemantle King Drasna Bluemantle , also known as Drasna the Fortunate was a human paladin of Torm and the ruler of the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn in the mid - to - late 14th century DR . He ruled from the city of Orvyltar . History .

title: Draughts
description: Draughts Darughts , also known as checkers , was a board game and " one of the four universal games " of Faerûn along with chess , dice , and Talis . Description . Draughts was played on the same 8×8 checkered board as chess , but draughts was a much simpler game to learn and faster to play .

title: Drava T ' syrr
description: Drava T ' syrr Drava T ' syrr was a drow warrior in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . History . Drava lived in Szith Morcane until it fell to fiendish fire giant s .

title: Draven Millovyr
description: Draven Millovyr Draven Millovyr was an innkeeper of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Draven tried to join the Arcane Brotherhood but was refused .

title: Drawmij ' s instant summons
description: Drawmij ' s instant summons Drawmij ' s instant summons was a conjuration spell that summoned a prepared item in an instant . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as instant summons , and counted among the spells of the universal province . Effects .

title: Draygo Quick
description: Draygo Quick Draygo Quick was a powerful Netherese warlock . History . Draygo Quick was a noble in the Nethril Empire .

title: Drayson Fivestars
description: Drayson Fivestars Drayson Fivestars was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Drayson joined the Cloak at an early age .

title: Dread blast
description: Dread blast Dread blast was a divine necromancy spell only available to cleric s serving Cyric , the Prince of Lies . It fired a beam of negative energy at a target . Effects .

title: Dread fang
description: Dread fang Dread fangs , sometimes called dread fangs of Lolth are elite warriors of drow society , trained as rogue s , typically in the service of a noble house or the Spider Queen . Cunning and deceptive , dread fangs embody the treacherous perils of drow society , though a few leave the terrors of their homeland for something better , becoming forces for good or at the very least opposed to Lolth ' s machinations . Masters of death , dread fangs excel at lowering their enemy ' s guard , and then , while they ' re defenseless , striking them down .

title: Dread ring
description: Dread ring A dread ring was an enchanted area created by necromancer s with the intention of stealing the souls of the living in order to feed necromantic powers such as animating the dead or creating structures such as fortresses . People that died there fed the power of the necromancer casting the spell with their souls and would likely be raised as undead . Dread rings were most notably affiliated with the Red Wizard s of Thay under the rule of Szass Tam .

title: Dread star
description: Dread star Dread star is a warlock invocation of some complexity learned early in some warlocks ' training . When a warlock casts " dread star " he or she conjures a fist - sized sphere of brilliant blue - white light , which then proceeds to whirl around a creature of the warlock ' s choosing within fifty feet , searing them with painful blasts of light that discourage movement of any kind . The intensity of the beams is largely determined by the warlock ' s charisma .

title: Dread whisper
description: Dread whisper Dread whisper was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell on a target and spoke of a terrible outcome that would happen if the target did not ignore the caster .

title: Dreadful word
description: Dreadful word Dreadful word , also known less commonly as frightful blast , is a relatively simple spell used by several warlock s , particularly those of the star pact . When a warlock casts " dreadful word " they can use its deadly power to fill the mind of one creature within twenty - five feet of them with petrifying pain and terror . Creatures who fall victim to this attack suffer a damage to their morale , making them less likely ro resist similar attacks later on .

title: Dreadmaster
description: Dreadmaster The Dreadmaster is a special prestige class for clerics of Bane . Much like the god whom they worship , Dreadmasters seek to control everyone around them , using the tools offered by Bane to inspire fear and loyalty in equal measure . Dreadmasters seek to reach the heights of any government or organization they are part of , believing that only they are capable of the control required to keep order .

title: Dream
description: Dream Dream was an illusion spell that would shape the dreams of a target . Effect . Choosing a known target within the same plane and casting the dream spell allows the caster or someone else to become a messenger and effect the chosen ' s dreams .

title: Dream Brigade
description: Dream Brigade The Dream Brigade was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 4 , 000 sandmen comprised the Dream Brigade .

title: Dream vestige
description: Dream vestige A dream vestige was an intangible entity , more like a huge mass of fog with anguished faces appearing in it , stretching , twisting , and dissolving back into the vapor . It was accompanied by a chorus of faint voices , some moaning , some gibbering , and others laughing . The souls that made up the cloud were in constant torment , trapped in a nightmare , and they hated one another even more than they hated the world .

title: Dreamheart
description: Dreamheart The Dreamheart was an ancient aboleth magical artifact . History . The Dreamheart was first found in modern times by the kuo - toa Nogah in 1395 DR , in a drowned and destroyed illithid city deep under the Sea of Fallen Stars in Serôs .

title: Dreaming Dragon
description: Dreaming Dragon The Dreaming Dragon was located near the Downriver Gate within Everlund . Inhabitants . Elves and halfling s loved the establishment because every night a great story and ballad would be heard .

title: Dreena Dellmon
description: Dreena Dellmon Dreena Dellmon was a druid during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Dreena was a druid and an agent of the Emerald Enclave .

title: Drelagara
description: Drelagara Drelagara is a small city on Evermeet that makes up in symmetry and quiet beauty what it lacks in grandeur . The buildings are all made from white marble , magically raised from the depths of Evermeet , and the whole city is located in the center of an expanse of gently rolling meadows that measures more than sixty miles ( 97km ) wide . This meadowland is surrounded on all sides by forests , and within a day ' s ride of the white - sand beaches of Siiluth .

title: Dresimil Chûmavh
description: Dresimil Chûmavh Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh was the matriarch of House Chûmavh , a drow clan that lived in a huge cavern beneath Ravens Bluff . Relationships . Dresimil had two brothers , Jezzryd and Jaeren , whom she seemed to at least tolerate , a rarity for dark elf matriarchs .

title: Dretch
description: Dretch Dretches were the least powerful of tanar ' ri demon kind . Description . Dretches were ape - like creatures with arms ending in clawed hands .

title: Dretchroyaster
description: Dretchroyaster Dretchroyaster , also known as Dretch , was a venerable green dragon that agreed to become dracolich in 1365 DR . Personality . Dretch was primarily a hunter of all kinds of living being .

title: Dreveth
description: Dreveth Dreveth the Gray was a male human diviner who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers . Abilities . As a highly experienced wizard who specialised in divination magic , Dreveth could cast some of very powerful divination spell s , if needed .

title: Drew Karpyshyn
description: Drew Karpyshyn Drew Karpyshyn has written two novels for Wizards of the Coast . Though his main works lie outside of the Faerûn setting , he carved out the time to write these two novels in 2001 . Before 2001 , however , he would not have dreamed of writing a novel , as he was a loan officer .

title: Drexa
description: Drexa Drexa was the chieftain of the Blackmaw lizardfolk tribe at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil and a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The lizard king believed that he should be one of the leaders of the Crushing Wave .

title: Dreyon
description: Dreyon Dreyon was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , possibly taking advantage of an eruption of elemental power , Dreyon and his cell of Black Earth cultists took control of Westbridge .

title: Drider
description: Drider Driders are drow that have been transformed from the waist down so they have the body of a spider . The transformation is typically a punishment for offending their goddess , or failing a test of Lolth . Ecology .

title: Drider vampire
description: Drider vampire Drider Vampires were undead drider s that had been infected with vampirism . Physical Characteristics . Appearing similar to their once - living selves , drider vampires had clawed hands and venomous fangs that protruded from their mouths .

title: Driftdisc
description: Driftdisc A Driftdisc is a form of transport used by drow noble houses to convey Matron Mother s from place to place , usually within cities . They are especially used during special occasions , such as a visit to another noble household . Driftdiscs usually operate as an enchanted platform that magically hovers above ground , and serves as a portable throne ; Matron Mothers use them to signify their station in drow society .

title: Driftglobe
description: Driftglobe A driftglobe was a small glass orb that magically floated in the air and emitted light . Description . A " driftglobe " was a small sphere of thick glass , that weighed about one pound ( 0 .

title: Drik Hargunen
description: Drik Hargunen Drik Hargunen was a duergar city in the Underdark region of Faerûn . Geography . The city was built around a natural rock chimney and iron stairways connected the various levels .

title: Drisinil Armgo
description: Drisinil Armgo Drisinil Armgo was member of House Barrison Del ' Armgo and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Description . Drisinil was described as tall .

title: Drisinil Melarn
description: Drisinil Melarn Drisinil Melarn was the matron mother of House Melarn until her death and its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Ssipriina led House Zauvirr in an attempt to defeat House Melarn .

title: Drizfryn Oblodra
description: Drizfryn Oblodra Drizfryn Oblodra was the weapon master of House Oblodra circa 1358 DR . Personality . Drizfryn was a violent psychopath , kept in check only by his mother .

title: Drizzt ' s mithral chainmail
description: Drizzt ' s mithral chainmail This piece of fabled armor belongs to Drizzt Do ' Urden and was crafted for him by Buster Bracer . The armor itself is chainmail , made from mithral . It is extremely lightweight without compromising it ' s protection .

title: Drizzt Do ' Urden
description: Drizzt Do ' Urden Drizzt Do ' Urden , also called Drizzt Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon , was a male drow ranger . He was an atypical drow who had forsaken both the evil ways of his people and their home in the Underdark , to become the legendary hero of the North . Description .

title: Drogan Droganson
description: Drogan Droganson Drogan Droganson was a renowned dwarven wizard , cleric of Mystra , and secret member of the Harpers , who opened a school for adventurers after retiring from the his own adventuring life . His students included Xanos Messarmos , Mischa Waymeet and Dorna Trapspringer . Description .

title: Droki
description: Droki Droki was a derro criminal in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Droki hated everyone in general and surfacers in particular .

title: Drom
description: Drom Drom was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Drom was one of the goblins who inhabited the caves near Duskwood .

title: Drom ( dwarf )
description: Drom ( dwarf ) Drom was a dwarf fighter worshiper of Helm and a member of Order of the Gauntlet in 1489 DR . Personality . Drom believed that you could fix problems with a big hammer .

title: Dromond
description: Dromond A dromond was a large warship related to a galley used for both war and commerce on the Sea of Fallen Stars . They were originally of Chessentan design but were also used by Mulhorand due to a long tradition of raiding and capturing ships from each other . The Alaor in Thay boasted a dozen deadly dromonds as part of its navy .

title: Drone Wyvernspur
description: Drone Wyvernspur Drone Wyvernspur , called affectionately Uncle Drone by most of his younger kinfolk , was the archmage of Redstone Castle , the ancestral home of the Wyvernspur family . Description . Drone had all the typical male Wyvernspur features : blue eyes , beak - nosed , and black hair .

title: Drool
description: Drool Drool was an ogre at the Sacred Stone Monastery during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Drool acted as a subterranean guard and jailer of the monastery , under the orders of Jurth .

title: Drosnin
description: Drosnin Drosnin was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Drosnin was the priest responsible for Yan - C - Bin ' s chapel inside Rivergard Keep .

title: Droth
description: Droth Droth , also known as Demon ' s blood , was a magic al substance made in the Abyss from the blood of mane s and the chitin of derghodemon s . Its primary use was to cure blindness when rubbed on the eyes or cure disease when swallowed . It could also be used to reverse the effects of acid .

title: Droth ( individual )
description: Droth ( individual ) Droth was a mercenary formerly in service to the Cult of the Howling Hatred at Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Droth was hired by the Howling Hatred .

title: Drounan Harbrand
description: Drounan Harbrand Drounan Harbrand was a businessman in Suzail . Activities . Drounan was one of the two surviving leaders of Thurbrand and Arley , Wendra of the Willing Whips , and Splendors of the Shining Sea Importations , which was situated in poor quarters of Suzail .

title: Drow
description: Drow Drow , also known as dark elves , were a dark - skinned sub - race of elves that predominantly lived in the Underdark . They earned their reputation as evil people , with all justification , though some members with more neutral disposition did exist , as did an even smaller number of actually good members . On the surface , the drow were sometimes referred to as " The Ones Who Went Below " .

title: Drow - dragon
description: Drow - dragon Drow - dragons ( or " Draa ' zekyl " ) were an offshoot of both the drow and the shadow dragon , more precisely of the " zekyl " . Abilities . They were shadow dragon s but at the same time also drow .

title: Drow Merchant Houses
description: Drow Merchant Houses Drow Merchant Houses were an important part of drow society alongside independent traders . They were run mostly by male drow , though a few merchants , such as Nal Xalyth , contradicted this standard . The trade was a dangerous one , even more so for non - drow , and many died quickly due to " accidents " from Houses that disliked them or from rival traders .

title: Drow dictionary
description: Drow dictionary A list of words in the Drow language . A . abban - " ally " , " not - enemy " .

title: Drow judicator
description: Drow judicator The Drow Judicator is a special prestige class of the drow . Servants of demigod Selvetarm , to whom they must make an unholy pledge , judicators are spellcasters that have survived the vicious rites necessary to work with demons and Lolth - warped spiders . They often serve , albeit grudgingly , high - ranking priestesses of Lolth as defenders and assassins .

title: Drow language
description: Drow language The Drow language is the most common native language of the drow . Deep Drow . Deep Drow , also known as Low Drow or Drowic , is the normal language of the drow .

title: Drow wanderer
description: Drow wanderer Drow wanderers are skilled drow who have eschewed their race ' s traditions to wander the depths of the Underdark . These unusual drow may be either good or evil but cast aside the way of their people to seek freedom in the darkness . Solitary and alone , these individuals must hone themselves to excellence in order to survive the many terrors that are common below the surface world .

title: Drowcraft
description: Drowcraft A drowcraft armor or weapon was one of a unique style of drow manufacture . Benefits . In an area of " faerzress " or inside an earth node , a " drowcraft " item became energized — a wielder of a " drowcraft " weapon would enjoy more fortune in making attacks and inflicting injuries , while a wearer of " drowcraft " armor would find attacks against them deflected .

title: Drowned Lady
description: Drowned Lady " The Drowned Lady " was the name given to a ghost that haunted the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast around 1367 – 1370 DR . Locals regularly sighted her on or beside a pool named for her , Ghost Pond , just north of the hamlet . They described her as a beautiful woman .

title: Drowning Flagon
description: Drowning Flagon The Drowning Flagon was an inn in Marsember , Cormyr owned by Polinar Kirin and was originally established by a noble . Structure . It was situated on its own island and comprised of several buildings including kitchens , stables , and a central hall featuring luxurious dancing chambers .

title: Droze
description: Droze Droze was a fisherman who became the keeper of The Mermaid ' s Purse in Corth , Aglarond , after becoming injured in an accident . He would entertain guests at the inn , telling the story of rescuing a mermaid and being rewarded with three wishes from her king .

title: Druarwood
description: Druarwood Druarwood was a forest west of Cold Wood and northeast of the Moonwood in the Silver Marches . Description . The forest was sparse and narrow , full of pine , spruce firs and conifers .

title: Drudach
description: Drudach A drudach was the smallest subdivision of a Calishite town or city , roughly equivalent to a precinct or neighborhood . Description . In cities , each drudach was surrounded by a short wall .

title: Drudach Street
description: Drudach Street Drudach Street was the major road of the Calishite city of Manshaka . It ran west to east and effectively divided the city in half with four sabban s on each side . It ran from the gate of the city to its port region at the coast of the Shining Sea .

title: Drufi
description: Drufi Drufi was a frost giant who led an attack on Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Drufi always traveled with her two winter wolves .

title: Druid
description: Druid Druids were primal spellcaster s of considerable power and versatility , who gained their power through being at one with nature or through a connection to a powerful deity or nature spirit . Guardians of the wilderness , druids saw themselves less as masters of the natural order and more as an extension of its will . Culture .

title: Druid ' s Grove
description: Druid ' s Grove Druid ' s Grove was a large clearing filled with standing stones in a rough circle located to the northwest just outside of the village limits of Shadowdale . Flora . Oak trees surrounded the area around the Grove .

title: Druidcraft
description: Druidcraft Druidcraft was a transmutation cantrip spell that allowed the caster to commune with spirits to cause minor effects . Effect . The spell could have one of four effects chosen by the caster : Components .

title: Druidhome trilogy
description: Druidhome trilogy The Druidhome trilogy is the follow - up series to the Moonshae trilogy . The books were written by Douglas Niles . Douglas Niles also wrote a short story about the early days of the Moonshae Isles called " The First Moonwell " .

title: Druidic language
description: Druidic language Druidic was the secret language of druid s . Speakers . All druids were taught Druidic , and they were forbidden to teach the language to anyone who was not a druid .

title: Druids of Tall Trees
description: Druids of Tall Trees The Druids of Tall Trees were a secretive order of druid s who let few others into their woods and groves . Their main goal was to combat expansion and protect the Tall Trees within the High Forest . The organization was lead by the Great Druid Uthgang Jyarl .

title: Drullister
description: Drullister Drullister was a phaerimm and the leader of a small hive in Synod in 1375 DR . History . Drullister and its hive gathered in Synod to study the strange sharn formed from Augathra the Mad , a fellow phaerimm , and Shar Cormrael .

title: Drum Tower
description: Drum Tower The Drum Tower was the main alarm system for the city of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . Found in the center of the city near the Boyla ' s Court , the Drum Tower sported red beams , a black - tiled roof , and shining brass fittings .

title: Drums
description: Drums Drums were a group of percussion instruments dating back a very long way and used by many races . They were all characterized by a membrane , usually made of skin , which was spanned tightly over some kind of hollow resonating body to create sound . Varieties .

title: Drunk sailor
description: Drunk sailor Drunk sailor was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Found near Flinn , this sailor was drinking ale and mistook the Kalach - Cha to be his friend and asked how was the Kalach - Cha ' s mother .

title: Drusilla
description: Drusilla Drusilla was a young woman in Waterdeep in the late 1350s DR . One night in a tavern in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , she and a friend flattered and flirted with the dwarf adventurer Onyx the Invincible . However , this was a distraction so an old woman could get his autograph — on a marriage contract .

title: Druxus Rhym
description: Druxus Rhym Druxus Rhym was the Zulkir of transmutation within the Red Wizards of Thay . Physical description . Druxus was a skinny , stork - legged man , with a weak chin and a bulge of flab at the waist - line .

title: Druzil
description: Druzil Druzil was an imp from the Lower Planes . Description . Druzil was two feet tall , had a canine face with floppy ears , his mouth was equipped with a set of pointed , yellow teeth , and he often moved his forked tongue in a lizard - like fashion .

title: Dryad
description: Dryad Dryads are fey - maidens who act as the protectors of forests and trees . They appear to be beautiful women with delicate features seemingly made of soft wood . Their hair appears to be made of leaves and foliage that changes color as the seasons change .

title: Drygully Tunnel
description: Drygully Tunnel The Drygully Tunnel was an entrance to the Underdark at the edge of the High Forest , less than two - days ' marches away from the small village Trollbridge . While the humans in the area did not know much about the tunnel , the drow used it regularly for raiding attacks upon the inhabitants of the World Above . The human berserker Fyodor used it to escape the Underdark after he learned from Liriel Baenre of its existence .

title: Drystan
description: Drystan Drystan was an escaped slave in the Deep Wastes . History . Drystan and his sister Tegan were two farmers in the Dalelands until , five years before the Rage of Demons , they were captured in a orc raid .

title: Du - yang
description: Du - yang Du - yang was a prince of the kingdom of Silla in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Under the influence of a love potion from the Quang Muku Forest , Prince Du - yang of Silla fell in love with a plotting woman and was slain by her jealous husband .

title: Dual Ring of Velsharoon ' s Bindings
description: Dual Ring of Velsharoon ' s Bindings The Dual Ring of Velsharoon ' s Bindings was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It gave the wearer protection against the undead and increased resistance to necromantic spells . Copies of this magical jewelry were known to exist but the shortened name ring of Velsharoon ' s Binding was commonly used to describe them .

title: Dualah
description: Dualah Dualah was a female human cleric of Umberlee in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . She tended to the shrine of Umberlee there . Lord Maalthiir seemed interested in her — according to a rumour , they were romantically involved .

title: Duar Obarskyr
description: Duar Obarskyr King Duar Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . He took an army to the King ' s Forest to battle the orc invaders but while he was gone , his father - in - law , Melineth Turcasson , sold the city of Suzail to pirates for the price of 500 sacks of gold . Duar destroyed the orcs , but when he returned to Suzail in 429 DR , he was barred from entering , and the betrayal of Melineth almost broke him .

title: Duara
description: Duara Duara was a mage and a good friend of Elminster . Description . She had dark eyes and flowing black hair .

title: Duathamper
description: Duathamper The Duathamper or Elvenflow is one of two major rivers running through Cormanthor . ( The other is the River Ashaba . ) It runs along the southeastern border of the forest .

title: Dubilitop
description: Dubilitop Dubilitop was the leader of a group of brownie s that were originally nomadic within the Pasocada Basin in Maztica , but settled in Kin Elbhaz . Unknown to the settlement ' s inhabitants , the brownies took care of the crops and ensured that the area was kept as disease - free as possible , in exchange for taking grain from the store via a secret passage . Equipment .

title: Duc - Sum Li
description: Duc - Sum Li Duc - Sum Li was a Shou knight and healer who was the Regent of the Xiousing District in Marsember . He was a descendent of Emperor Li of the Shou Dynasty of Might . He was still active in his extreme old age in 1479 DR , exercising and meditating daily .

title: Dueling Globes
description: Dueling Globes Dueling Globes was popular game played among children and adolescents in Halruaa . Description . Halruaan children capable of casting basic spells would attempt to mimic each other when casting the " dancing lights " spell .

title: Duelist
description: Duelist The duelist is a prestige class that focuses on quick , nimble feet and a good eye at striking with a light , one handed weapon . Often referred to as " swashbucklers " , duelists use their speed and coordination in a deadly blend with their intelligence to become capable fighters who prefer to avoid getting hit instead of drawing upon their resilience to take the blows and keep on standing . Duelists prefer to wander the Realms alone , though the odd duelist enjoys joining the adventuring party and forming long lasting friendships .

title: Duergar
description: Duergar Duergar ( pronounced DEW - ur - gar ) , also known as gray dwarves , were a subterranean race . They were close kin to dwarves , but with a diabolic taint to their blood . They carved out an existence in the Underdark , often near volcanoes .

title: Dugald
description: Dugald Dugald was a human man of Damara and a cleric of Ilmater and St . Dionysus . He was a famous adventuring cleric of the Bloodstone Lands and one of its saviors .

title: Dugmaren Brightmantle
description: Dugmaren Brightmantle Dugmaren Brightmantle , also known as the Errant Explorer , was the dwarven deity of scholarship , discovery and invention and an exarch of Moradin . Just as Marthammor Duin exemplified the urge to explore the world beyond the mountain , Dugmaren Brightmantle signified the exploratory striving to blaze the trails of creativity by using accumulated knowledge to create that which was new and good . Brightmantle represented the progressive elements of a naturally conservative race that nonetheless prided itself on its infrequent innovations .

title: Duhlark Kolat
description: Duhlark Kolat Duhlark Kolat was a powerful mage who lived in Waterdeep . Description . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , Duhlark was a middle - aged but vital man with russet - colored eyes , braided long blonde hair , and a similarly braided beard .

title: Duhuls
description: Duhuls Duhuls were small fissures in the ground that led to natural pools of water . Most of these fissures were located along the hillsides of the Pit of the Ghuls near the western tip of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams , in the High Desert of Zakhara . Water was always scarce within the High Desert , so local nomads fiercely guarded duhuls that they claimed .

title: Duir leather
description: Duir leather Duir leather referred to any leather , or leather item , crafted in Duirtanal . Description . The unique processes required to produce duir leather were known only to the guild masters of Duirtanal .

title: Duirsar
description: Duirsar High Elder Erlan Duirsar , also called Lord Duirsar , was the leader of the Hill Council , the rulers of Evereska . Description . He was short and thin and his face showed signs of age .

title: Duirtanal
description: Duirtanal Duirtanal was a small town located in the middle of Semphar . Description . This small town appeared sad and ugly .

title: Dukar
description: Dukar The Dukars were a kind of unique Serôs ian specialist wizard who used coral implants to channel their magic . Their goal was the protection of Serôs from all kinds of menaces and to promote peace and harmony between all races . Organizations .

title: Dukars ' Academy
description: Dukars ' Academy Dukars ' Academy was an academy of magic in the underwater city of Myth Nantar , comparable to a bards ' college . It comprised four college buildings , one for each order , and a fifth octagonal building known as the Paragon ' s College . The buildings appeared disconnected on the surface , but underneath the city they were connected with tunnels to allow easy access .

title: Duke
description: Duke A duke ( male ) or duchess ( female ) was a title for a member of a nobility , typically ranking just below a ruling monarch or reigning as a monarch in their own right . The traditional territory controlled by a duke or duchess was called a " duchy " .

title: Dulahey
description: Dulahey Dulahey was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Par asked of Kalach - Cha to investigate the trouble in his house .

title: Dulcimer
description: Dulcimer A dulcimer was a stringed instrument known in the Realms . The Zakharan version was known as a santur . Description .

title: Dulfan
description: Dulfan Dulfan was a seawolf living in Serôs . History . Born in 1329 DR , Dulfan was a fishermen of Uthmerg in the Easting Reach until 1348 DR when a seawolf injured him .

title: Dulwar
description: Dulwar Dulwar the Leatherworker was a male human who ran his own leatherwork business in Dagger Falls . He was a friend to and spy for Randal Morn . Description .

title: Dumathoin
description: Dumathoin Dumathoin , pronounced ( " doo " - muh - " thoe " - in ) , was the patron of Shield dwarves , and the dwarven deity of mining and underground exploration and was known as the Keeper of Secrets Under the Mountain . He was also the protector of the dwarven dead . His holy symbol was a cut , faceted gem inside a mountain .

title: Dumathoin ' s Wrath
description: Dumathoin ' s Wrath Dumathoin ' s Wrath was a powerful magic warhammer created by the Thorsamsonn Bandaerl . Description . Sized to be wielded most efficiently by a dwarf , " Dumathoin ' s Wrath " had a solid mithral head engraved with runes that read " Rukkoth Dumathoin " and , in heavy mithral settings , was embedded with two diamond spikes on the top and the back of it .

title: Dun Hills
description: Dun Hills The Dun Hills were a series of hills in Tasseldale in the Dalelands . They separated Tasseldale from Deepingdale to the west and Battledale to the north . As of 1372 DR , the hills were generally considered to be safe , containing wild ponies .

title: Duncan
description: Duncan Duncan was a merchant visiting the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Duncan visited the new Temple of Mystra and was among a group of people who partook in the three - day - long ritual of Mystra ' s Sacred Trust that the priests there were pushing , alongside eleven others : Durgen Glintstone , Kareem Hastith , Smote , Tholwick Styles , Dava , Mendios , Zephan , Veera Wavecrest , Halish , Kenniwick , and Amnic Basult .

title: Duncan ( sage )
description: Duncan ( sage ) Duncan was a sage in Arabel in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was goblinoid s . When he was young , Duncan lost his family to a goblin attack , so he started studying them , becoming the greatest expert in goblin lore .

title: Duncan Farlong
description: Duncan Farlong Duncan was a male wood elf of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Appearance . Duncan was a wood elf , who wore simple clothes with an apron .

title: Duncan el Ashnarti
description: Duncan el Ashnarti Sultan Duncan el Ashnarti was the ruler of the city of Keltar in Calimshan as late as 1370 DR . Wealth . Duncan Ashnarti ( who often dropped the article in his name to sound more like a northerner ) , was one of the richest men in Keltar , having made his money through connections in the horse - breeding , meat - packing , and shipping industries .

title: Duneth Wharreil
description: Duneth Wharreil Duneth Wharreil was a drow and the former archmage of Maerimydra until his coup during Lolth ' s Silence and his subsequent death at the hands of Irae T ' sarran . As of 1372 DR he persisted as a silverwraith under Irae T ' sarran ' s control . Description .

title: Dunfee
description: Dunfee Dunfee was a small but vital mining town found in Impiltur near the border of Damara nestled within the Earthspur Mountains . Activities . The inhabitants of Dunfee maintained quality relationships with all of their neighbors including fellow miners from Sudrav , nobles from Ravensburg , and the farmers of Zarach .

title: Dungeon Master
description: Dungeon Master Dungeon Master or DM is the title used for the individual who is directing the overall story and action within a game of Dungeons & Dragons . The DM controls the actions of all the Non - Player Characters ( NPC s ) in opposition ( though not always hostile ) to the Player Characters ( PC s ) .

title: Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3rd edition
description: Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3rd edition The Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3rd edition is the original Dungeon Master ' s Guide for the 3rd edition of the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons game . It was replaced in 2003 by the " Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3 . 5 " , when the rules were advanced from 3rd edition to 3 .

title: Dungeon Master ' s Guide 4th edition
description: Dungeon Master ' s Guide 4th edition Contents . The 4th edition variant of the " Dungeon Master ' s Guide " , like previous variants , is aimed at providing " dungeon masters " - the rules referees and storytellers of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game , with guidelines and rules for running their own games . This includes such basic details as to how to interact with players , how to balance player wishes with game rules , details on how to construct NPCs , and how to build encounters in a way that is balanced and rewarding for players .

title: Dungeon Master Guide 2nd edition ( revised )
description: Dungeon Master Guide 2nd edition ( revised ) The Dungeon Master Guide 2nd edition ( revised ) was the final Dungeon Master Guide released under the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd edition rules . Note that while other books have tended towards being called " Dungeon Master ' s Guide " ( " Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3rd edition " or " Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3 . 5 " ) , this edition uses " Dungeon Master " instead .

title: Dungeon Masters Guide 1st edition
description: Dungeon Masters Guide 1st edition The Dungeon Masters Guide 1st edition was the original Dungeon Master ' s Guide for the AD & D game , authored by Gary Gygax and first published in August 1979 . Note that unlike other publications from future editions which were entitled " Dungeon Master ' s Guide " ( such as " Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3rd edition " or " Dungeon Master ' s Guide 3 . 5 " ) , this book ' s title lacks the apostrophe .

title: Dungeon magazine
description: Dungeon magazine Dungeon magazine , or simply Dungeon , is a " Dungeons & Dragons " - based magazine . It was first published by TSR , Inc . in 1986 , as a bi - monthly magazine .

title: Dungeon magazine 144
description: Dungeon magazine 144 " Dungeon " issue 144 was released in March of 2007 . It contained the following article related to the Forgotten Realms : The Muster of Morach Tor . This adventure is set in the Evermoors and involves a failed attempt by the town of Nesmé to hire lizardfolk mercenaries to push back attacks from troll s and giant s .

title: Dungeon magazine 170
description: Dungeon magazine 170 " Dungeon " issue 170 was released in January of 2009 in online format only . It contained the following article related to the Forgotten Realms : Monument of the Ancients . This adventure involves a barbarian attack on the region of Moonsea North , which sent survivors into the city of Phlan .

title: Dungeon magazine 192
description: Dungeon magazine 192 " Dungeon " issue 192 was released in July of 2011 in online format only . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Eye on the Realms : Masks of Living Flesh . This article provides an overview of the strange parasitic creature called a jaod .

title: Dungeon magazine 198
description: Dungeon magazine 198 " Dungeon " issue 198 was released in January of 2012 in online format only . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Cormyr Royale : The Royal Court of the Forest Kingdom . This article describes the Royal Court of Cormyr over the 100 years from 1379 and 1479 DR .

title: Dungeon magazine 208
description: Dungeon magazine 208 " Dungeon " issue 208 was released in November 2012 in online format only . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Elves with Demonic Designs : The Fey ' ri , Faerûn ' s Hidden Threat . An article on the daemonfey , including Sarya Dlardrageth and her minions .

title: Dungeon magazine 217
description: Dungeon magazine 217 " Dungeon " issue 217 was released in August of 2013 in online format only . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Rats in the Undercellar . An adventure for characters of levels 1 - 2 .

title: Dungeon magazine 69
description: Dungeon magazine 69 " Dungeon " issue 69 was released in July / August of 1998 . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Mere of Dead Men : Slave Vats of the Yuan - ti . This adventure is part 1 of the " Mere of Dead Men " series and involves an exploration of the Wolfhill House overlooking the Mere and encounters with the yuan - ti .

title: Dungeon magazine 70
description: Dungeon magazine 70 " Dungeon " issue 70 was released in September / October of 1998 . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Ssscaly Thingsss . This adventure is part 2 of the " Mere of Dead Men " series and involves an exploration of the Mornhaven Towers and encounters with lizardfolk .

title: Dungeon magazine 71
description: Dungeon magazine 71 " Dungeon " issue 71 was released in November / December of 1998 . It contained the following articles related to the Forgotten Realms : Dreadful Vestiges . This adventure is part 3 of the " Mere of Dead Men " series and involves an exploration of the Holk House and encounters with reviler s .

title: Dungeon magazine 73
description: Dungeon magazine 73 " Dungeon " issue 73 was released in March / April of 1999 . It contained the following article related to the Forgotten Realms : Mere of Dead Men : Eye of Myrkul . This adventure is the final part of the " Mere of Dead Men " series started in " Dungeon " # 69 and involves retrieving the bones of a dracolich to save a paladin .

title: Dungeon magazine 75
description: Dungeon magazine 75 Dungeon magazine 75 was the 75th issue of " Dungeon " magazine . It was released in July 1999 . = Contents = Non - Prophet Organization .

title: Dungeon magazine 79
description: Dungeon magazine 79 Dungeon magazine 79 was published in March / April 2000 . Contents . The Akriloth .

title: Dungeon magazine 87
description: Dungeon magazine 87 Dungeon magazine 87 was the 87th issue of " Dungeon " magazine . It was released in July / August 2001 . = Contents = The Raiders of Galath ' s Roost .

title: Dungeon magazine 88
description: Dungeon magazine 88 Dungeon magazine 88 was the 88th issue of " Dungeon " magazine . It was released in September / October 2001 . = Contents = The Door From Everywhere .

title: Dungeon magazine 94
description: Dungeon magazine 94 Dungeon magazine 94 was the 94th issue of " Dungeon " magazine . It was released in September / October 2002 . = Contents = Spiral of Manzessine .

title: Dungeon of Death
description: Dungeon of Death The Dungeon of Death is a subterranean structure located under a grassy hill just within the southern edge of the Lurkwood near the headwaters of Shining Creek , one of the tributaries of the River Surbrin . Its story is one of the darkest of any dungeon in Faerûn . History .

title: Dungeon of the Hark
description: Dungeon of the Hark The Dungeon of the Hark is located beneath the ruined village of Moorsedge , so named for its location on the northern edge of the High Moor . Very little is left of the village save a few stones , bits of masonry and what is left of an iron statue of some grand king or lord that has , over time , lost its head and arms . Several holes and pits lead into various warrens and vast network of interconnecting tunnels that house most of The Hark ' s lycanthropic brood and his bandit subordinates .

title: Dungeon of the Hark ( module )
description: Dungeon of the Hark ( module ) Stedd Rein , leader of the Red Fellowship has declared war on the bandit lord known as The Hark . He , his Red Fellows and the party march on The Hark ' s lair in the High Moor . On the way , they are waylaid by a pack of worg s and Stedd asks the party to clear out their den so his army ' s flank is protected .

title: Dungeon of the Ruins
description: Dungeon of the Ruins The Dungeon of the Ruins was an abandoned dwarf hold located about halfway between Mithral Hall and Nesme . Rumors and legends . The local barbarian s avoid the subterranean tunnels because of tales of " strange froglike humanoid s ( [ possibly slaad ] ) dancing around bonfires in the ruins .

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Dungeons & Dragons Dungeons & Dragons ( abbreviated as D & D ) is a paper - and - pencil role - playing game ( RPG ) . Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson created Dungeons & Dragons in the year 1974 . It was first published by Tactical Studies Rules , Inc .

title: Dungeons & Dragons : Daggerdale
description: Dungeons & Dragons : Daggerdale Dungeons & Dragons : Daggerdale is an video game developed by and published by . The game includes both single and cooperative multiplayer modes and is set in a Forgotten Realms environment . " Dungeons & Dragons : Daggerdale " was the second Dungeons & Dragons video game to be announced in 2010 and was released in May 2011 on , , and .

title: Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 1
description: Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 1 Dungeons & Dragons Classics , Vol . 1 is the first collection of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " , published by .

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online
description: Dungeons & Dragons Online Dungeons and Dragons Online - more commonly referred to as DDO is an MMORPG , released on February 28th 2006 that is primarily set in the Eberron Campaign Setting . In June of 2012 , DDO released a major " Menace of the Underdark " expansion that allowed players to travel to the kingdom of Cormyr in the Forgotten Realms . Players were able to travel from Xen ' drik in Eberron to Cormyr where they could explore and adventure in Eveningstar , Wheloon , the Stormhorns , the Thunder Peaks , along the High Road and in Sschindylryn , even getting the chance to travel to the Demonweb Pits and meet Elminster .

title: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set
description: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set The Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set is a boxed set for the 5th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Intended to serve as a basic introduction to tabletop " D & D " , it contains a set of basic rules , an adventure , several pre - made character sheets , and a set of dice .

title: Dungeons and Dragons : Attack Wing ( game )
description: Dungeons and Dragons : Attack Wing ( game ) Dungeons and Dragons : Attack Wing is a strategy - based tabletop game . It can be played in three different forms . The first form is free play , where the players build their legion according to the basic rules of the game .

title: Dunkin Tallmast
description: Dunkin Tallmast Dunkin Tallmast was an emissary of Tarnheel Embuirhan , the tyrant of Mintarn . History . When the " Sea Sprite " of Captain Deudermont arrived in Mintarn in search of information about the mythical isle of Caerwich , Dunkin ' s master Tarnheel was intrigued because he knew that on board was Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Dunman Kiriag
description: Dunman Kiriag Dunman Kiriag was a fighter in the village of Eveningstar in the kingdom of Cormyr , and a secret member of the Harpers . He owned and operated The Lonesome Tankard Inn and Tavern . Personality .

title: Dunn Tenwealth
description: Dunn Tenwealth High Priest Dunn Tenwealth served as Torm ' s pontiff in Tantras before and during the Time of Troubles and was member of the city ' s High Council . Right after the starting of the Avatar Crisis in the Realms Dunn discovered one of the Tablets of Fate in the basement of his temple ; meantime the god Torm incarnated in an avatar in Tantras and tell to his devotes that his arrive was caused by the theft of the Tablets . Dunn not tell to Torm that he had one of the Tablet but instead with the other senior members of the church decided that the arrive of their god was the signal that Tantras was the Torm ' s chosen city and they need convert or eliminate the other churches .

title: Dunobo Springs
description: Dunobo Springs The Dunobo Springs are a collection of small pools and streams that transform in the spring into the Danozi Wash due to the meltwater flowing from the surrounding mountains . The springs are located in the forested foothills of the mountains of the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . The resulting floodwater that annually forms the Danozi Wash is responsible for carving the Sun Canyon which leads southwest to the Pasocada River .

title: Dunspeirrin
description: Dunspeirrin Dunspeirrin , also known as the City of Sunken Spires and Underspires , was a duergar city below the Orsraun Mountains in the Darklands of the Middledark and was known as the City of Blades . History . Around 1369 DR , the duergar sent the Army of Steel into the caverns of Taark Shanat to stop the Army of Gold regaining the shield dwarf kingdom of Deep Shanatar and started the War of Gold and Gloom .

title: Dunstanny
description: Dunstanny Dunstanny was a halfling personal assistant to the wizard Parwyyd Hanifar in the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Owing to his great absentmindedness and poor memory , Parwyyd hired Dunstanny to assist him in his work .

title: Dura ' s Vale
description: Dura ' s Vale Dura ' s Vale was a vale located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . It laid approximately 26 miles ( 41 kilometers ) from Sevenecho and a league ( 5 . 5 kilometers ) southeast of the Misty Vale .

title: Dura Gerathu
description: Dura Gerathu Dura Gerathu was a male ranger who lived in the Brynwood forest in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , Gerathu met Cedric Ravajar , leader of the Red Brigade mercenaries , while they conducted a scouting expedition in Brynwood .

title: Dura al - Mustasib
description: Dura al - Mustasib Dura al - Mustasib lived in Iris Well Spring in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships . Dura was the daughter of Atabeg Ali al - Mustasib , an exiled regent of Semphar .

title: Durgo Silvermane
description: Durgo Silvermane Durgo Silvermane is the eldest son of Jhaele Silvermane . History . As of 1375 DR , Durgo has taken over most of the day to day administrative duties of running The Old Skull Inn from his mother , Jhaele .

title: Durissa Thornion
description: Durissa Thornion Durissa Thornion was an illusionist in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Durissa , like her sister Morissa Thornion , was daughter of the town mage but being more interested in the arts of deception she decided to become an illusionist .

title: Durlag ' s Tower
description: Durlag ' s Tower Durlag ' s Tower was a large tower south of the Wood of Sharp Teeth , situated on top of a rough patch of hard rock . History . This local landmark was the isolated keep of Durlag Trollkiller , son of Bolbur , a dwarven hero said to have amassed a large quantity of treasure and stored it here and in a few other locations .

title: Durlag Trollkiller
description: Durlag Trollkiller Durlag Trollkiller was the son of Bolhur the Clanless and one of the most powerful dwarves of his time , and undoubtedly one of the richest . As his name suggests , he earned his fame slaying trolls and other ferocious beasts , alongside a small band of adventurers . After retiring from adventuring , Durlag set about building a great tower in which to begin his own clan , to prevent him from dying alone as his father did .

title: Durmista
description: Durmista Durmista was a of Tethyr only in name . It was the eastern half of the elven territory of the great Wealdath forest . Etymology .

title: Durnan
description: Durnan Durnan " the Wanderer " ( occasionally known as " Durham " ) was the gruff , burly yet close - mouthed Masked Lord of Waterdeep who ran the Yawning Portal Inn and considered himself the self - appointed gatekeeper to Undermountain . He was known for having explored Undermountain . Personality .

title: Duromil
description: Duromil Duromil the Fearless was a rogue in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Duromil was very good at hiding his true nature as thief and no one in the city suspected him , a sign of his great ability .

title: Durothil
description: Durothil House Durothil was an elven house . It claimed to be one of the founding houses of the gold elves . It had a reputation for producing excellent warriors and wizards , many of whom joined Evermeet ' s army .

title: Durothil ( prince )
description: Durothil ( prince ) Durothil was the prince of the elven realm Tintageer . He fled with the last survivors of his people , when Tintageer was destroyed by a tremendous flood . With all sun elves of Tintageer and the moon elf Sharlario Moonflower Durothil came to the north of Faerûn .

title: Durpar
description: Durpar Durpar was a merchant kingdom of the Shining Lands in Southeast Faerûn that rested to the southeast of Veldorn , separated from Estagund by the Curna Mountains . The capital port - city of Vaelan was located near the western shores of the Golden Water . Verdant farms surrounded the Golden Water and the shoreline was given to the mansions of the luxury - loving ruling merchant elite of the kingdom .

title: Durpari
description: Durpari The Durpari , or Durparians , were a human ethnicity populating the coast of the Golden Water , including Durpar , Estagund , and Var the Golden . They also comprised significant minorities in Mulhorand , Murghôm , Semphar , and the Shaar as late as the 14th century DR . They were somewhat short and swarthy and followed the Adama .

title: Durpari - Shaartan Patois
description: Durpari - Shaartan Patois Durpari - Shaartan Patois was a creole of Durpari and Shaaran spoken by the inhabitants of the eastern Shaar , from the Council Hills in the north to the Toadsquat Mountains in the south , and from Landrise in the west to Giant ' s Belt in the east .

title: Durpari language
description: Durpari language Durpari was a regional tongue of Southeast Faerûn and the official language of the Durpar i Kingdoms . Speakers . Durpari was spoken in Durpar , Estagund , Var the Golden , and Veldorn , and was the primary language in those kingdoms .

title: Durth
description: Durth Durth was a deep gnome . History . In 1377 DR , Durth was one of the deep gnomes hired by Cavatina Xarann to act as a guide for the the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .

title: Durthan
description: Durthan The Durthans were a secretive group of women who operated in Rashemen . They called upon the darker spirits of the country . They were the antithesis of the Witches of Rashemen and worked against them for the rulership of the realm .

title: Durzagon
description: Durzagon A durzagon was the offspring of a devil and duergar . History . Sometimes , a devil would secretly breed with a duergar .

title: Dus Abd al - Dawwar
description: Dus Abd al - Dawwar Dus Abd al - Dawwar was the admiral and commander of the Wanderers Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Dus spent most of his time trying to bring at least half of Qudra ' s fleet of ships up to working order through constant repairs .

title: Dusk Ports
description: Dusk Ports The Dusk Ports were a collection of seemingly free trade cities on the western shores of the Dragon Sea . In reality , they were vassal states to the green dragon Orlarrakh . Geography .

title: Dusk Road
description: Dusk Road The Dusk Road was a short , moderately traveled trade road in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn . The Dusk Road started at Iriaebor in the south and went northwest , crossing the River Reaching at Hill ' s Edge and continuing along the coastline all the way north to Waterdeep .

title: Dusklan
