description: Dusklan Dusklan was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports on Returned Abeir . Background . Dusklan was the most racially diverse of the Dusk Ports , having citizens of a variety of races , even orc s .

title: Duskwood
description: Duskwood The Duskwood was a forest in the Border Kingdoms . It covered the eastern side of the Border Kingdoms area , between the Realm of the Smoking Star and the Realm of the Ready Sword . Description .

title: Duskwood ( tree )
description: Duskwood ( tree ) Duskwood was a type of tree found growing all over Faerûn . Description . Duskwoods grew in densely packed groves , blocked the light and appeared rather eerie , giving them their name .

title: Dust curtain
description: Dust curtain Dust curtain was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a controlled gale that lifted dust from the surrounding area .

title: Dust genasi
description: Dust genasi A dust genasi , or dust para - genasi , was a sub - race of the genasi . It was a para - genasi , meaning that it was descended from two different elemental outsider s , namely an outsider of elemental air and an outsider of elemental earth , forming para - elemental dust . Personality .

title: Dust mephit
description: Dust mephit A dust mephit was a mephit from the Elemental Plane of Air or Quasi - Elemental Plane of Dust . Description . A dust mephit was about four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall and weighed a couple pounds ( about one kilogram ) .

title: Dustclaws
description: Dustclaws The Dustclaws were a Luskan gang lead by a half - orc named Duulgrin . The gang ' s symbol was a dripping claw inside a circle . In 1480 DR , the gang had sixty members and operated out of a tavern .

title: Dustdigger
description: Dustdigger A dustdigger was a huge monster that lurked underground and projected illusions to lure prey into its maw . Description . A dustdigger resembled a huge five - pointed upside - down starfish with flexible arms and a many - fanged mouth in the center , which faced upwards .

title: Duster
description: Duster Dusters were small elemental vermin native to the Elemental Plane of Air that could also be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were weaker relatives of dust devil s . Description .

title: Dusts of death
description: Dusts of death Dusts of death was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spelled turned dust or sand into a deadly poison .

title: Dustwall Mountains
description: Dustwall Mountains The Dustwall Mountains ( also called simply the Dustwalls or just the Dustwall ) separated southern Raurin from northern Durpar in the Shining South . They were so named because they protected Durpar from the turbulent sandstorms that ravaged the Raurin desert . It had many names , being also known as the Mountains of War and the Mountains of Adama .

title: Dusty Hoof
description: Dusty Hoof The Dusty Hoof was an inn and tavern located on the east side of Northstorm Street at the six - way intersection of the Walk in Scornubel . Structure . The building was long and narrow with high ceilings .

title: Duth Gulkanun
description: Duth Gulkanun Duth Gulkanun was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Gulkanun went to Castle Irlingstar with Nostyn Vandur .

title: Duthcloim
description: Duthcloim Duthcloim , also known as Manyfolk , was a district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Description . The district of Duthcloim surrounded the Bazaar and the Clawrift , a huge chasm in the center of the city .

title: Dutiful Mamluk Society
description: Dutiful Mamluk Society The Dutiful Mamluk Society , also known as the Dutiful , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Dutiful represented the largest and most powerful mamluk organization in the entire Land of Fate .

title: Duupox
description: Duupox Duupox was a morkoth member of the Arcanum of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . History . Thanks to his skills , Duupox rose through the Arcanum ' s ranks until he became one of the apprentices of Arcount Axar Xyrl .

title: Duvan
description: Duvan Duvan is a human rogue and adventurer - for - hire of about twenty years of age who works for the copper dragon Tyrangal in Ormpetarr . History . Early Life .

title: Duvessa Shane
description: Duvessa Shane Duvessa Shane was the speaker of Bryn Shander in 1485 DR and sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Duvessa was the daughter of a Waterdhavian trader and a woman of Icewind Dale .

title: Dwahvel Tiggerwillies
description: Dwahvel Tiggerwillies Dwahvel Tiggerwillies was a halfling woman and a cousin of Dondon Tiggerwillies . She was the guildmistress of a halfling guild based in Calimport , and the proprietor of the Copper Ante . She did not entertain many who were not halflings .

title: Dwalimar Omen
description: Dwalimar Omen Dwalimar Omen was the captain of the Halruaan caravel " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Dwalimar hailed from Halruaa .

title: Dwarf
description: Dwarf Dwarves , sometimes called the Stout Folk , were a natural humanoid race common throughout parts of Toril as well as Abeir . Dwarves were a tough , tradition - abiding folk known for their strong martial traditions and beautiful craftsmanship . Description .

title: Dwarfbane
description: Dwarfbane Dwarfbane was a poison that was especially effective against dwarves . Description . Dwarfbane was gummy in its consistency .

title: Dwarfhome
description: Dwarfhome Dwarfhome is a lawful good - aligned astral dominion , home to the god Moradin and his wife , the goddess Berronar . Formerly located on Mount Celestia , on its forth layer Solania , it was the home of the dwarven pantheon . Since the Spellplague it has floated freely in the Astral Sea like all dominions .

title: Dwarnid Inkpeddler
description: Dwarnid Inkpeddler Dwarnid Inkpeddler was a dwarf tattooer in Skullport . History . In his youth , Dwarnid was the personal slave of Zulkir Druxus Rhym .

title: Dwarven defender
description: Dwarven defender The path of the dwarven defender or dwarven hero is a highly trained and specialized fighter tradition that is available to the dwarven race . These individuals take pride from the noble history of their race and its constant vigilance against exterior threats such as giant s or goblinoid s , which they hope to match in spirit as well as form . Culture .

title: Dwarven waraxe
description: Dwarven waraxe A dwarven waraxe is an exotic one - handed ( or martial two - handed ) melee weapon . Description . The dwarven waraxe is a single - bladed axe larger and heavier than a battleaxe but less so than the double - bladed greataxe .

title: Dwarves ' Deep ( settlement )
description: Dwarves ' Deep ( settlement ) Dwarves ' Deep , or simply " the Deep " , was a subterranean dwarven settlement somewhere in Faerûn . History . It was once home to Forgemaster Inkstain and his kin , before he left for the city of Procampur in the Vast .

title: Dwarvish
description: Dwarvish Dwarvish or Dwarven was the name for a family of languages used by dwarves . The dwarves called their own language Dethek , but most other races used that term to refer to the runic alphabet in which the language was written . Although a verbally dying language by 1400 DR , Dwarvish was still found all over Faerûn inscribed into weapons , buildings and mystical items .

title: Dweomerheart
description: Dweomerheart Dweomerheart was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model and was also the name of the scintillating city that was the realm of Mystra here in the World Tree model and on the plane of Elysium in the Great Wheel model . The other deities of magic , Azuth , Savras , and Velsharoon , also made their homes on this plane not far from Mystra ' s domain . Dweomerheart was destroyed in a cataclysmic explosion in the Year of Blue Fire , 1385 DR , after Cyric assassinated Mystra causing the Spellplague .

title: Dweomerkeeper
description: Dweomerkeeper The Dweomerkeeper is a special prestige class for worshipers of Mystra . They serve the Lady of Mysteries by tending to the Weave and help aid Mystra and her clergy in increasing the use of magic across the Realms . Dweomerkeepers form a powerful connection with the Weave , losing their ability to ever call upon the power of the Shadow Weave .

title: Dwiergus
description: Dwiergus Dwiergus was a truly ancient demon lord , at least as old as Pale Night . He held dominion over the shaping of demonic races , and was once a tutor of Baphomet . Dwiergus ' realm was known as Fleshforges , and was the 558th layer of the Abyss .

title: Dying gray dwarf
description: Dying gray dwarf This dying gray dwarf was a male duergar who attacked the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in 1374 DR . History . This dwarf was one of the attackers of West Harbor .

title: Dylohra
description: Dylohra Dylohra was a half - elf waitress in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Dylohra was the oldest of her sisters and felt responsible for them .

title: Dyltharra
description: Dyltharra Dyltharra was a half - elf high priestess of the temple of Selûne in Velprintalar , Aglarond , around 1368 DR . She led six other priestesses at the temple and helped to maintain contact between the Simbul , the Royal Council of Aglarond , and the Harpers .

title: Dynaheir
description: Dynaheir Dynaheir was a young wizard specialized in invocation magic , and a wychlaran of Rashemen . Her speech was somewhat archaic and she was very demanding of her companions . She had come to the Sword Coast along with her bodyguard Minsc as part of a rite of passage .

title: Dynarth Bloodcowl
description: Dynarth Bloodcowl Dynarth Bloodcowl was the most lethal assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Although nearly totally lacking in stealth and discretion , Dynarth remained one of the top assassins of Westgate .

title: Dyon G ' ennivalz
description: Dyon G ' ennivalz Dyon G ' ennivalz was the name of a drow city known by the illithid Yharaskrik when it was young . In 1366 DR , Yharaskrik mentioned it when questioning Kimmuriel Oblodra as to where he hailed from , though he actually came from Menzoberranzan .

title: Dyrr
description: Dyrr Lord Dyrr , commonly known as Lichdrow Dyrr or simply the Lichdrow and also called " Old Dyrr " or " Master Dyrr , " was the de facto ruler of House Agrach Dyrr in Menzoberranzan and the power behind Yasraena Dyrr ' s throne . In addition to his large magical and political power , the Lichdrow had lived for at least two millennia , and he was once shown to contemplate his possible ascension to divinity in the future . Thus , before his death , he was probably one of the most powerful magic users in the Underdark .

title: Dzunn
description: Dzunn Dzunn was a merchant from the city of Sheirtalar in Lapaliiya in the 14th century DR . Dzunn partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .

title: E ' Tyon Bay
description: E ' Tyon Bay E ' Tyon Bay was a bay to the north of the city of Singye in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying beside the Quang Muku Forest . By 1357 DR , E ' Tyon Bay had become infested by tigerworm s , which sunk four fishing boats and a merchant ship . Singye authorities offered a reward to any who could eliminate the menace .

title: Eadro
description: Eadro Eadro ( " ee - AD - ro " ) was the creator of the locathah and merfolk and was worshiped exclusively by those two races , though each worshiped him differently . Worshipers . Merfolk .

title: Eadyan Falconmoon
description: Eadyan Falconmoon Eadyan Falconmoon was the priest of Chauntea of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personality . Eadyan remained calm even during the chaos of the attack .

title: Eaerlann
description: Eaerlann Eaerlann was a powerful elven kingdom of wood and moon elves in the valley of the Delimbiyr River and a portion of the eastern High Forest that was founded by Sharrven nobles in - 4700 DR and lasted for around six thousand years . Together with Sharrven it suppressed the spread of evil in Siluvanede and maintained the peace . Their land was bound by the eastern part of the High Forest from Turnstone Pass in the north to the Shining Falls in the south .

title: Eaerlraun Shadowlyn
description: Eaerlraun Shadowlyn Eaerlraun Shadowlyn was the Harper master of Moongleam Tower in Everlund . History . In 1372 DR , Eaerlraun held the title of Moonlord and was simpathetic to the Moonstar cause .

title: Eagle
description: Eagle Eagles were large , majestic birds of prey that were often seen as symbols of nobility or as divine messengers . Description . They were generally larger than other birds , with a powerful build and heavier head and beak .

title: Eagle ' s splendor
description: Eagle ' s splendor Eagle ' s splendor is a transmutation spell that makes the subject more charismatic . Effect . The transmuted creature becomes more poised , articulate , and personally forceful .

title: Eagle ( spirit )
description: Eagle ( spirit ) Eagle was a deity and animal spirit worshiped by the green elves of Evermeet . Description . His role was to bestow good fortune but also to bring omens of impending catastrophes .

title: Eagle Knights ( Maztica )
description: Eagle Knights ( Maztica ) The Eagle Knights were elite warrior s in Maztica . Organization . The lower echelon soldiers were known as Eagle Warriors and the leaders were called Eagle Knights .

title: Eagles
description: Eagles The Eagles were a group of hobgoblin soldiers , who served the Preachers in the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Eagles were based in the fortress of Sarahin , located deep within the Haunted Lands .

title: Eagles ' Eyrie
description: Eagles ' Eyrie Eagles ' Eyrie was a rocky knoll just outside the town of Dagger Falls ; it was noted as a site sacred to the Brightblade clan of dwarves . Geography . A bare rocky hill , this natural lookout point gave a view high over the nearby town of Dagger Falls .

title: Eagus
description: Eagus Eagus was a mercenary who was killed by Abdel Adrian in 1368 DR . Appearance . Eagus had a messy greying brown beard and yellow teeth .

title: Ear seeker
description: Ear seeker Ear seekers were small parasitic insects found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Ear seekers were small insects measuring about 6 inches ( 15 cm ) in length .

title: Earblade
description: Earblade Earblades were a rogue ' s last chance to beat the noose . Uses . By far , hanging was the most popular method for the execution of criminals .

title: Eardon
description: Eardon Brother Eardon was a wandering priest of Lathander during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Eardon wandered northwest Faerûn , using his powers to help villagers as a messenger or priest .

title: Earring of Prince Mamoon
description: Earring of Prince Mamoon The Earring of Prince Mamoon was an item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These pieces of jewelry were hoops of jet coral covered with intricate calligraphy .

title: Earth
description: Earth Earth was a world on an alternate Material Plane . People . A number of human peoples of Faerûn originally came from another world , which is widely believed to have been Earth .

title: Earth ' s End
description: Earth ' s End Earth ' s End was an isolated Underdark town located 20 miles ( 32 km ) beneath northeastern Halruaa . The town contained a number of portals and a passageway that led to the Underchasm . Some of the portals did nothing other than let in light from aboveground and some let in water and fresh air from the Elemental Chaos .

title: Earth ( element )
description: Earth ( element ) The element of earth was one of the four fundamental building blocks of matter : solid , stable , and unyielding in character . It encompassed all kinds of stone and rock , but also soil , metal ores and sand . Cosmology .

title: Earth Node
description: Earth Node An Earth Node was a geological anomaly beneath the surface of Faerûn . They usually existed only at points were the invisible streams of arcane magic that permeated Faerûn intersected . Those creatures in tune with arcane magic could sometimes sense the presence of a node .

title: Earth Spider
description: Earth Spider The Earth Spider was a terrible monster in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Once the Earth Spider ruled over Shou Lung but he and his legion were banished by the Celestial Emperor in the Realms of Mirrors .

title: Earth giant
description: Earth giant Earth giants were the most brutish of giant s , that lived in mountains , rocky barrens , canyons , and other such regions . Physical description . Earth giants were creatures whose bodies were made of rock and stone .

title: Eartheart
description: Eartheart Eartheart is the principal settlement for the Gold Dwarves in East Rift and it is still the cultural and spiritual center for its people . Dwarves take on pilgrimages to behold the great holy city and take their trips from other countries and the deeps to reach their goal , it use to house great temples and shrines to all the Dwarven pantheon and dwarf heroes but after the great collapse much was lost . Leadership .

title: Eartheart defender
description: Eartheart defender Eartheart defenders , not to be confused with dwarven defender s , are an elite organization of dwarven divine spellcasters whose role it is to defend and serve the interests of East Rift , for whose capital the Eartheart defenders are named . With an unmovable spirit like the stones that make up dwarven cities , Eartheart defenders stand against the enemies of their race . Culture .

title: Earthfast
description: Earthfast Earthfast was a shield dwarven city located in the Earthfast Mountains near Impiltur , from a high mountain valley to deep beneath in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . Though it was a war - torn city under constant siege from orcs and goblins , Earthfast was a capable ally of Cormyr and an able defender of Faerûn against the Tuigan Horde . History .

title: Earthfast Mountains
description: Earthfast Mountains The Earthfast Mountains , or simply the Earthfasts , were a small mountain range in north Faerûn , running from the Dragon Reach in the west , through the Vast and into Impiltur in the east . It was an arm of the greater Earthspur Mountains to the north . Geographical features .

title: Earthfast plate
description: Earthfast plate Earthfast plate was a type of full plate armor forged by the shield dwarves of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn . It was famous for its non - magical strength . Construction .

title: Earthmother
description: Earthmother The Earthmother was believed to be an aspect of the deity Chauntea , but in truth she was a primal spirit representing the power of nature on Toril . The Earthmother was venerated as a goddess by the Ffolk , the native human inhabitants of the Moonshae islands . The Earthmother had three " mortal " servants : The Leviathan , the Unicorn , and the Pack ( an enormous pack of well - coordinated wolves ) , each with powers beyond the usual for their kind due to the Earthmother ' s favor .

title: Earthquake
description: Earthquake Earthquake was an evocation or alteration spell that unleashed a powerful but localized tremor . Effect . The effect of the tremor depended on the type of terrain it was cast in , so a cavern would collapse and damage those caught in the collapse where heavily damaged .

title: Earthroot
description: Earthroot The Earthroot was a vast domain in the Underdark . Since it lay beneath the Unapproachable East - buried deep below Thay and the Sunrise Mountains few people knew of its existence and even fewer explorers mapped its tunnels and caves . In its northern reaches , it was a frigid area containing numerous ice formations and caves .

title: Earthsoul genasi
description: Earthsoul genasi An earthsoul genasi , also known as an earth genasi , was a type of genasi that was able to harness the power of the earth . Description . Earthsoul genasi came in many physical shapes and appearances .

title: Earthspur
description: Earthspur The Earthspur was an 8 , 000 ft ( 2 , 438 m ) mountain at the southern end of the island of Dragonisle in the Pirate Isles . It was the main geographic feature of the island and acted as a navigational aid to seafarers in the area .

title: Earthspur Mountains
description: Earthspur Mountains The Earthspur Mountains , or simply the Earthspurs , and sometimes named the Giantspike Mountains or the Dragonspike Mountains , was a great mountain range in north Faerûn . It ran roughly from northwest to southeast , from the Moonsea and the Galena Mountains in the north to the Sea of Fallen Stars in the south . It had two arms : the smaller Troll Mountains and the Earthfast Mountains .

title: Earthwood
description: Earthwood The Earthwood was a thick forest in the Earthspur Mountains within Damara , which consisted mainly of birch and evergreen trees . Geography . Despite the poor appearance of the stony , hilly soil , the fertility of the land was such that it allowed trees to grow quickly .

title: Earynspieir Ongluth
description: Earynspieir Ongluth Earynspieir Ongluth was a male elf of Cormanthyr and the Royal Archmage at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor in 241 DR . History . Earynspieir was one of the two Supreme Court Wizards in service to Coronal Eltargrim .

title: East District
description: East District The East District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The East District was found in the Palace Quarter and made - up most of the eastern section of the city along the city walls .

title: East Faerûn
description: East Faerûn East Faerûn bordered the eastern expanses of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Here the sea formed a long arm that traveled to the east before turning south to become the Alamber Sea . The northern nations of this mysterious area were termed by some people as the " Unapproachable East " and the southern nations the " Old Empires " , and , for a time , the " Empires of the Alamber Sea " .

title: East Gate
description: East Gate The East Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Description . The East was located on the eastern side of Huzuz at the juncture of the River Road and the South Road .

title: Eastern Imaskari languages
description: Eastern Imaskari languages The Eastern Imaskari languages was a collection of languages derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the eastern parts of the Hordelands . Description . The Eastern Imaskari languages were nasal languages and spoken in the back of the throat .

title: Eastern Plains
description: Eastern Plains The Eastern Plains were a region of deforested plains and rolling hills in the east of the kingdom of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . Geography . The Eastern Plains were bordered on the west by the Wyvernflow and Wyvernwater and on the north by the Thunder River .

title: Eastern Shaar
description: Eastern Shaar The Eastern Shaar was the eastern extension of the Shaar . Its major feature was the Council Hills . As of 1479 DR , Okoth , a reawakened realm of the sarrukh , lay directly south of Azulduth ( the Lake of Salt ) , and the Gulf of Luiren , which was a realm named Luiren before the Spellplague , lay to the south of Okoth .

title: Easthaven
description: Easthaven Easthaven was one of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The town was located on the southern shore of Lac Dinneshere on the east end of the Eastway that led to Bryn Shander .

title: Easting ( town )
description: Easting ( town ) Easting was a small town east of Iriaebor , hence its name . Description . Easting was typical of such small communities .

title: Easting Reach
description: Easting Reach The Easting Reach was a wide expanse of water at the northeast edge of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was calm and predictable , and was therefore well suited to trade . The city of Sarshel lay at its mouth .

title: Easting language
description: Easting language Easting was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the Vast and Impiltur , from Mulmaster and the Icemelt Mountains in the north to Lyrabar in the south , and from Tantras in the west to Easting Reach in the east . Many of the speakers of Easting also spoke Damaran , a closely related Chard language . There were several dialects of Easting , including Impilturian ( spoken in Impiltur ) , Mulman ( from Mulmaster ) , Procampan ( from Procampur ) , and Tantran ( from Tantras ) .

title: Eastmyr
description: Eastmyr Eastmyr was a district of Menzoberranzan that was primarily home to commoners . Inhabitants . Most commoners , including mercenaries and lesser merchants , lived in this neighborhood .

title: Eastway
description: Eastway The Eastway was a road from Bryn Shander to Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The gravel road began in Bryn Shander traveling east toward the community of Easthaven and the banks of Lac Dinneshere .

title: Eastways
description: Eastways The Eastways were three tunnels and roads that lead east from the drow city of Menzoberranzan to Fardrimm and Delzoun . Menzoberranzan . The Eastways were three tunnels that opened up in to the cavern of Menzoberranzan at the district of Donigarten .

title: Easy Blades Adventuring Band
description: Easy Blades Adventuring Band The Easy Blades Adventuring Band was an adventuring company that operated in Cormyr and Sembia in the mid - 14th century DR . The Easy Blades were chartered in Suzail . They were often suspect of conducting extensively smuggling operations along the coast of Sembia .

title: Easy march
description: Easy march Easy march was an evocation spell that allowed a number of creatures to march quickly for days without fatigue . Effects . The number of creatures that could be affected by this spell and the number of days of duration was related to the caster ' s level of experience .

title: Easy trail
description: Easy trail Easy trail was an abjuration spell used by travelers of the wilderness in the Forgotten Realms . It created a path for the caster and any followers behind him by magically forcing aside any underbrush gently . Effects .

title: Eather Heilean
description: Eather Heilean Eather Heilean is a High Harper , who was recruited by the organization at a young age . She has recruited many members to the Harpers that are loyal to Twilight Hall first and foremost . Eather has been also been an agent who has dealt with members who have defected to the Moonstars .

title: Ebenz Farbough
description: Ebenz Farbough Ebenz Farbough was a farmer in the Moonsea . History . Ebenz and his wife Bea Farbough managed a farmhouse near Hillsfar .

title: Ebi
description: Ebi Ebi was one of the most powerful yakuza crime lords in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ebi ' s gang operated in the Miyama capital of Tamanokuni , especially in the Bridge District .

title: Eboanaflimoth
description: Eboanaflimoth Eboanaflimoth , also known as Ebonflame , was a red dragon working with Cult of the Dragon . History . Hating Lathander with a passion , the dragon sent her cultists to attack the Morninglord ' s temple in Tilverton around 1370 DR .

title: Ebon Lefash
description: Ebon Lefash Ebon Lefash was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Ebon Lefash led a a mob of looters and scavengers who moved into the deserted Old Stone Keep . The commander of the Legendary Campaign , which sought to unify the wartorn Utter East through conquest , seeking to take back something they believed to be rightfully theirs , came to the ruins to defeat Lefash in a bloodforge battle .

title: Ebonsoul
description: Ebonsoul Ebonsoul was a lich whose ship , " Thepurl ' s Diamond " , was attacked and sunk by pirates in the Sea of Fallen Stars around the time of the Spellplague ( 1385 DR ) . History . In 1481 DR , agents working for the halfling assassin guild master Pericolo Topolino discovered a shard of a Mirror of Opposition in Ebonsoul ' s wrecked ship in a 200 - foot - deep ( 61 meters ) trench in the Sea of Fallen Stars some 12 leagues southwest off Aglarond ' s southwesternmost point .

title: Ebony Queen
description: Ebony Queen The Ebony Queen was a special sailing vessel capable of travelling between all of the genie realms on the Elemental planes . Description . The entire ship was made from ebony wood and was set with an orrery of the inner planes .

title: Ebusado
description: Ebusado Ebusado was one of the most talented kensai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ebusado ran the Light - Sparkling Water School in Yoemura on Mikedono Island .

title: Eckert
description: Eckert Eckert used to be the valet of Talbot Uskevren until he betrayed him and the other Uskevren s in exchange for the life of his daughter , Maelin , who was being kept by Radu and Stannis Malveen . When he outlived his usefulness , Radu nearly slew Eckert , but the man was saved by Feena Archwood , who managed to heal him in time . He was later dismissed by Talbot , who showed Eckert sympathy by not having him jailed .

title: Ecology
description: Ecology Ecology is a long - running series of articles in " Dragon magazine " , focusing on detailed information on various monsters and creatures . This table lists all of the articles , but not all articles are within , and therefore some don ' t contain links or citation templates .

title: Ector Brahms
description: Ector Brahms Ector Brahms ( pronounced ECK - turr BRAMM ) was the ruler of Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Ector was a stubbornly honorable and stoic man .

title: Ed Bonny
description: Ed Bonny Ed Bonny is a freelance game designer . Ed recalled becoming hooked on the " Forgotten Realms " in the 1980s when he read the Time of Troubles trilogy . Ed considers himself obsessed with maintaining consistent lore for the Realms .

title: Ed Gentry
description: Ed Gentry Ed Gentry is the author of the novel " Neversfall " , part of The Citadels series . He began writing with an entry to the open call for " Maiden of Pain " . His short story " Freedom ' s Promise " appears in the Realms of the Dragons II compilation .

title: Ed Greenwood
description: Ed Greenwood Ed Greenwood ( born 1959 ) is the creator of the Forgotten Realms . He first began in 1967 , writing fiction set in his imagined world . He created the Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting for his own D & D games in 1975 , and its popularity with other gamers through Dragon Magazine led to TSR ' s purchase of the setting in 1986 .

title: Edario
description: Edario Edario was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Edario was Highcliff ' s blacksmith , who specialized in crafting armor .

title: Eden of the Clearlight
description: Eden of the Clearlight Eden of the Clearlight claimed to be a high priestess of Tymora but in reality she was a self - serving , greedy person with few , if any divine powers . Eden lived in the Clearlight , Tymora ' s run - down temple in Luskan and was the leader of the Coin Spinners gang . History .

title: Edherli Lewel
description: Edherli Lewel Edherli Lewel was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The merchant was an impatient individual but took great care with her wagon and horse .

title: Edificant Library
description: Edificant Library The Edificant Library was a library located in the south of the Snowflake Mountains . It stood for over 600 years . Architecture .

title: Edik Brey
description: Edik Brey Edik Brey ( pronounced " ED - ick BRAY " ) was a foreman in Mulmaster . History . Edik was a foreman retainer of House Peytir .

title: Edrae Obarskyr
description: Edrae Obarskyr Edrae " the Doomed Babe " was officially a king of Cormyr , but he was only an infant , and he did not live to see his fourth birthday . He was killed by his own mother as an act of mercy to end his suffering caused by the Purplethroat Plague .

title: Edwin Odesseiron
description: Edwin Odesseiron Edwin Odesseiron ( possibly related to Tharchion Homen Odesseiron of Surthay ) is a character in the " Baldur ' s Gate " and " " computer games . He is a member of the Red Wizards of Thay specialised in conjuration magic who as a novice was sent to the Sword Coast near Baldur ' s Gate on an unknown mission . He got into conflict with Dynaheir of Rashemen but failed to have her killed .

title: Eel
description: Eel Eels were aquatic creatures . Species . Vilhon .

title: Efficacious monster ward
description: Efficacious monster ward Efficacious monster ward was an abjuration spell that could keep some undesirable creatures out of a large area for a few minutes . Effects . This spell was a stronger version of " antivermin barrier " that operated exactly like that spell except that it prevented entry of creatures roughly twice the size and / or toughness .

title: Effran Redspur
description: Effran Redspur Effran Redspur was a duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Effran started her merchant career in order to travel throughout the Underdark , but Mantol - Derith was her first stop .

title: Effron
description: Effron Effron , also known as " the Twisted " , was a tiefling warlock under the tutelage of the Netherese lord Draygo Quick . He was the son of Herzgo Alegni and Alegni ' s rape victim , Dahlia Sin ' felle . Description .

title: Efreeti
description: Efreeti Efreet ( singular : efreeti ) , or efreeta for females , were unpredictable creatures with fiery forms and spectacular magical powers . They were a type of genie native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . The efreet were genie s from the Plane of Fire .

title: Efreeti bottle
description: Efreeti bottle An efreeti bottle was a powerful magical item in which an efreeti was entrapped . It was thus a variety of genie prison . Description .

title: Efreeti palazzo
description: Efreeti palazzo Efreeti palazzos were the homes of noble efreeti and their slaves . These buildings served as both a palace and stronghold . Location .

title: Efreeti pashas
description: Efreeti pashas The efreet pashas represented the Sultan of the Efreet on the Prime Material Plane . Organization . Six elite noble efreeti were efreet pashas .

title: Efreeti tyrants
description: Efreeti tyrants The efreeti tyrants were the ruthless leaders of the efreet . Organization . The Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan , ruled over all of the noble efreeti tyrants .

title: Efreetikin
description: Efreetikin Efreetikin , or flame gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Flame gen had jet black skin and fiery red hair .

title: Ehjax
description: Ehjax Ehjax was an ixilthetocal ruler of Seros . History . Born in 885 DR , Ehjax founded the modern ixilthetocal society of the Xedran Reefs , adjusting rules normally used only by ixilthetocal vampire s .

title: Eichiro Tanaka
description: Eichiro Tanaka Eichiro Tanaka was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Eichiro was the son of Eiji Tanaka , a fellow general of Benju Matsumoto .

title: Eiellûr
description: Eiellûr Eiellûr was an ancient kingdom of green elves created during the First Flowering in - 21000 DR . History . Eiellûr was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Thearnytaar and Syòrpiir by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR .

title: Eigeron
description: Eigeron Eigeron was a ghost cloud giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Eigeron was the son of the cloud giant ruler Blagothkus .

title: Eight Million Gods
description: Eight Million Gods The Eight Million Gods is an ancient religion practiced in Wa and Kozakura , and it is a collection of beliefs and practices that has evolved over human history since humans arrived in those island kingdoms . The rituals of the practice relate to a variety of nature spirits who are believed to inhabit the land itself . In Kozakura , the worship is open and accepted , but in Wa it is not encouraged by the Shogunate government .

title: Eilistraee
description: Eilistraee Eilistraee was the chaotic good drow goddess of song , dance , swordwork , hunting , moonlight , goodness , and beauty , within the drow pantheon known as the Dark Seldarine . She was the patroness and protector of the few dark elves who longed to return to the surface and live there , at peace with other races , and to abandon the endless conflicts and intrigues that dominated the lives of most drow . She was often referred to as the The Dark Maiden , the Lady of the Dance , or Lady Silverhair , and sometimes The Dark Dancer , among other titles Briefly , she was known as The Masked Lady , while her faith subsumed that of the Masked Lord Vhaeraun , her divine brother .

title: Eilistraee ' s Spellsong
description: Eilistraee ' s Spellsong The Spellsong was an evocation spell granted by Eilistraee to her speciality priestesses , the Sword Dancers . It was a form of Spellsong , a type of magic that used song and sometimes dance to draw power from the Weave Casters . The Sword Dancers could sing and dance to channel the power of Eilistraee .

title: Eilistraee ' s moonfire
description: Eilistraee ' s moonfire Eilistraee ' s moonfire was an alteration spell granted by the goddess Eilistraee to her priestesses and , at her will , worshipers . Effects . This spell generated " moonfire " , a beacon of light , whose intensity and color could be controlled by the creator at will , ranging from a faint glow to a clear , bright — though not blinding nor strong enough to harm — light ) , though " moonfire " generally had the same intensity as moonlight .

title: Eira
description: Eira Eira was a wood elf in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Eira was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .

title: Eiruk Weskur
description: Eiruk Weskur Eiruk Weskur was a young human wizard of Waterdeep . Description . Eiruk had black hair that he often worn shorn short in a skullcap .

title: Eirwyn
description: Eirwyn Eirwyn was an astral deva follower of Helm until the god ' s death . She was a skilled diviner . Description .

title: Eiverbreen Parrafin
description: Eiverbreen Parrafin Eiverbreen Parrafin was the father of Spider Parrafin ( the reborn Regis ) . Personality . Eiverbreen was a drunkard .

title: Ejen Horo
description: Ejen Horo Ejen Horo , or the Valley of the God , was a vale located between the Mountains of Copper and the Khopet Dag within the Hordelands . Description . Blessed with good weather , Ejen Horo was a lush garden - like valley that offered plentiful hunting as many animals were drawn to the bountiful vegetation .

title: Ekandor
description: Ekandor Ekandor was the leader of a team of Red Wizard s who hunted the half - elf wild mage Neera . History . Ekandor and his fellows hunted Neera for a long time for her unique magical ability .

title: Ekur
description: Ekur Ekur was the ruler of Shussel in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Ekur was bargaining with the clergy of Isis for them to give their support to god - king Gilgeam .

title: Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib
description: Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib Ekuriyah Abd al - Wajib was the general of the Dutiful Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . She served as the active voice for the Dutiful on the Mamluk Council because Hatit Abd al - Wajib ' s duties as emir prevented him from having a say on council matters .

title: El Ahimar
description: El Ahimar The Ahimar clan was the least well known and most secretive of the four major crime families operating in Calimshan in 1370 DR . They rose to power during the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR . Believed to have been a lost house , they were aided by Ralan el Pesarkhal , and as such were indebted to him and under his indirect control .

title: El Ashnarti
description: El Ashnarti The Ashnarti family of crime lords was one of the smaller crime families in Calimshan , with its base in Keltar , and was known for its brutes and thugs . The headquarters of the Guild of Enforcers and Thugs of Calimshan was located in Keltar and was the only rogues ' guild of note in the city . In 1370 DR , this guild was in the control of the sultan of Keltar , Duncan el Ashnarti , allowing him to control both illegal and legal activity there .

title: El Kahmir
description: El Kahmir The Kahmirs were one of four major crime families operating in Calimshan in 1370 DR . Until the Darkstalker Wars in 1359 DR , they were the most powerful of all Calishite underworld groups since the Seventh Age of Calimshan . See also .

title: El Pesarkhal
description: El Pesarkhal The Pesarkhals were the post powerful crime family in Calimshan in 1370 DR , controlling each of the remaining three houses , because Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal sat on the throne . Ralan el Pesarkhal also intentionally married off his daughters to the other families to control them , and while the seat of control for el Pesarkhal was technically in Calimport , there was at least one Pesarkhal family member in a position of power in every city throughout Calimshan .

title: El Sadhara
description: El Sadhara High Whirlwind Fida ' iya yr Iamar , commonly known as el Sadhara , " the Desert Rose " , was an exceptionally powerful priestess of Akadi who had been mummified . She resided at the Altar of the Air and was said to possess many treasures . She was also reported to believe that she was the lover of the djinni lord Calim .

title: El Vyndahla
description: El Vyndahla The Vyndahla clan was the third - largest family in the criminal underworld of Calimshan . In truth , it was simply a puppet group of the Rundeen . The Darkstalker Wars robbed them of much of their power , but in 1370 DR they still controlled criminal activities in Almraiven and Volothamp .

title: El Zarud
description: El Zarud El Zarud was the Zhent spokesman among the Bedine in Anauroch . Description . El Zarud had a silky mustache and bore many scars .

title: Eladrin form
description: Eladrin form Eladrin form was a transmutation spell that transfigured the caster into an incorporeal globe . Effects . The caster assumed the form of an incorporeal globe of eldritch colors , 5 feet in diameter .

title: Elaerue Estspirit
description: Elaerue Estspirit Elaerue Estspirit was a half - elf woman and an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Elaerue was a local member of the Heralds of Faerûn , holding the office and title of " Wheloon " . In addition to her heraldry and other duties , she served Lord Sarp Redbeard as his assistant , clerk , and record - keeper .

title: Elaine Cunningham
description: Elaine Cunningham Elaine Cunningham is an American fantasy and science fiction author , especially known for her almost poetic literary style . Her contributions to the Forgotten Realms campaign world include the realms of Evermeet , Halruaa , Rashemen , Ruathym and Waterdeep . Amongst Elaine ' s most popular characters are the half - elf Arilyn Moonblade , the bard Danilo Thann , the quirky drow wizard Liriel Baenre , her companion the Rashemi berserker Fyodor , and Elaith " The Serpent " Craulnober ( created by Ed Greenwood ) .

title: Elaith Craulnober
description: Elaith Craulnober Elaith Craulnober was a moon elf adventurer and crime lord living in the city of Waterdeep . He was a cunning and opportunistic elven rogue with an infamous reputation . Description .

title: Elak Dornen
description: Elak Dornen Elak Dornen was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and the informal leader of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . He was a stern and inflexible man , and he enjoyed the power he gained from bending others to his side .

title: Elan
description: Elan Elans were psionic humanoids They were extremely long - lived , occasionally managing to live for 2 , 000 years or more . History . The elan came about during the the time of Jhaamdath but the method used to create them is long lost to mortals .

title: Elanee
description: Elanee Elanee was an elven druid from the Mere of Dead Men . Elanee is best known for her aid to the Kalach - Cha during the latter ' s quest to destroy the King of Shadows . Description .

title: Elanil Elassidil
description: Elanil Elassidil Elanil Elassidil was a famous bard and the Herald of Elventree , holding the office of " Moonsilver " around 1367 DR . Personality . She had a ready wit but a quick temper , and kept abreast of all goings - on in Elventree .

title: Elanna Huntsilver
description: Elanna Huntsilver Elanna Huntsilver was Maestoon Huntsilver ' s wife . She was much younger than Maestoon and was a Dauntinghorn by birth . Description .

title: Elassuara Narithan
description: Elassuara Narithan Elassuara Narithan was a female human cleric of Milil , Lord of Song , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Elassuara was high priestess of the Happy House of Splendor and Song temple to Milil at the time . She led six priests and eleven lay - followers .

title: Elastul Raurym
description: Elastul Raurym Elastul Raurym is the marchion of Mirabar . The Hammers are his personal bodyguard . , fighters named Djassar , Hulmm , Kriiador , and Turvon who command the marchion ' s 64 platinum mail wearing bodyguards .

title: Elbereth
description: Elbereth Elbereth was an elf and the king of Shilmista . He was the son of Galladel , grandson of Dellanil Quil ' quien . Description .

title: Elbulder
description: Elbulder Elbulder was once a logging town on the River Arran , south of the Chondalwood . It was used to send logs downstream to the Vilhon Reach and onwards to the Sea of Fallen Stars . During the Rotting War , the disapproval of the Emerald Enclave meant that the logging operation could not continue .

title: Elbus Tinfellow
description: Elbus Tinfellow Elbus Tinfellow was a halfling living in the Moonsea . History . Elbus was the patriarch of the Tinfellow s , a large family of farmers in a valley near Hillsfar .

title: Eldaerneth Spellstalker
description: Eldaerneth Spellstalker Eldaerneth Spellstalker was a sun elf rogue and enchanter . History . Around 1374 DR , Eldaerneth was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma .

title: Eldan Ambrose
description: Eldan Ambrose Eldan Ambrose was an Amnian priest of Tempus who came to Battledale during the Time of Troubles . History . Pilgrimage to Battledale .

title: Eldargh
description: Eldargh Eldargh was a malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Eldargh was among the many malaugrym that suddenly attacked El en masse .

title: Eldath
description: Eldath Eldath ( pronounced " " el " - dath " ) , also known as The Green Goddess or Mother Guardian of Groves , was a lake spirit who acted as the guardian of groves and watersheds , her presence was felt wherever there was calm . She was a pacifist who avoided hostile action , even if threatened . Although shy , quiet and enigmatic , Eldath was possessed of unknown depths of character and unexpressed resolve that could not be broken .

title: Eldath ' s Mount
description: Eldath ' s Mount Eldath ' s Mount was a peak in the Troll Mountains of Amn at which the great Green Goddess Falls was located . The falls were a part of the River Rimril , and the Duskwood Dell into which the waters flowed was a sacred site to the goddess Eldath .

title: Eldeluc
description: Eldeluc Eldeluc was a male human wizard and a member of the Host Tower of the Arcane . He tried to usurp the position of the Archmaster Arcane Arklem Greeth . History .

title: Elden Corrinthal
description: Elden Corrinthal Elden Corrinthal , usually know as the Oracle , was the head priest of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1484 DR , the Oracle encouraged Vasen Cale to follow the destiny that Amaunator would show him .

title: Elden Mymn
description: Elden Mymn Elden Mymn was a priest of Kelemvor in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Elden was a patient and quiet individual .

title: Elden Vargas
description: Elden Vargas Elden Vargas was a businessman in Neverwinter . History . Elden was , before the Spellplague a War Wizard of Cormyr .

title: Eldenser
description: Eldenser Eldenser , called " The Lurker " or " The Worm Who Hides in Blades " , was a male amethyst great wyrm known for his magical ability to " jump " his sentience from blade to blade . Description . By the 1370s DR , in his true dragon form , Eldenser appeared ancient and decrepit .

title: Elder
description: Elder The Elder was a respected priest of the Faceless God and the governor of the Enlightened Ring province in the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . As with the other members of the Seven Sages , the Elder was an appointed governor of one of the provinces of the Yikarian Empire .

title: Elder Evils
description: Elder Evils " Elder Evils provides DMs with 160 pages of truly wicked threats to challenge high - level heroes . Each " elder evil " described in this nightmarish tome comes with a detailed description , stat blocks for the elder evil and its minions , tips for how to incorporate the elder evil into any D & D campaign , adventure seeds , and maps of the elder evil ' s lair ( complete with encounters and room descriptions ) . The book also provides guidelines to help DMs create their own unique elder evils as worthy campaign villains and endgame encounters .

title: Elder brain
description: Elder brain An elder brain was the final stage of the mind flayer life cycle . The elder brain lived in a brine - filled pool in the center of a mind flayer city , where it guided its community by filling them with dark dreams of illithid domination . Although its intellect was of godlike proportions , its only physical attack was by using its tendrils to lash out at or grapple an opponent .

title: Elder evil
description: Elder evil Elder evils were ancient , powerful , and generally evil beings or entities . Their power could rival , or even surpass , that of demigod s to such that they could destroy an entire world . Elder evils .

title: Elder orb
description: Elder orb An elder orb was a very old and powerful beholder . Description . Elder orbs were between 4 and 6 feet ( 1 .

title: Eldest
description: Eldest The Eldest was an aboleth of massive size , incalculable age and inconceivable malignancy . It ruled the city of Xxiphu and the Abolethic Sovereignty . It was the most powerful and oldest aboleth in the city of Xxiphu and was believed to be the only " living " being that could use the Key of Stars to unlock the Far Manifold beyond Forever ' s Reach .

title: Eldeth Feldrun
description: Eldeth Feldrun Eldeth Feldrun was a shield dwarf scout who was made a prisoner of the drow during the late 1480s DR . History . Eldeth lived with her family in Gauntlgrym , where she worked as a scout .

title: Eldkin Agetul
description: Eldkin Agetul Eldkin Agetul was a guard just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Eldkin was a perfectionist and wanted all to know this .

title: Eldorn Mindalar
description: Eldorn Mindalar Eldorn Mindalar was a male human cleric of Gond , the Lord of All Smiths , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Eldorn was high priest of the House of Skilled Hands temple to Gond at the time . He led nine priests and eighteen lay - followers .

title: Eldoth Kron
description: Eldoth Kron Found in the Cloakwood forest , Eldoth Kron is a sleazy , thrill - seeking dilettante who makes a living seducing rich women and living off their money . His latest scheme is to elope with his current lover , Skie Silvershield , then blackmail her father by claiming to have " kidnapped " her and threatening to harm her if he is not paid on a regular basis . A male chauvinist , Eldoth treats Skie quite badly , which earns him the hatred of both Garrick and Shar - Teel .

title: Eldras Tantur
description: Eldras Tantur Eldras Tantur was the blacksmith of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Activities . Eldras managed the village ' s smithy with his son and daughters over a decade and half .

title: Eldreth Veluuthra
description: Eldreth Veluuthra The Eldreth Veluuthra ( " Victorious Blade of the People " , also sometimes Eldreth Veluuthara ) , formed in 262 DR and still active as of 1374 DR , was a group of elves dedicated to the removal of all human s from Faerûn . Its main areas of activity were ancient elven forests , including the Ardeep Forest , the Border Forest , the Chondalwood , Cormanthor , the High Forest , the Moonwood , Neverwinter Woods and the Winterwood . History .

title: Eldrinn Elpragh
description: Eldrinn Elpragh Eldrinn Elpragh was a boy drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Eldrinn was a member in the College of Divination of his city and the son of Seldszar Elpragh .

title: Eldrinpar
description: Eldrinpar Eldrinpar , also known as the Doegan Capital , was the capital city of the realm of Doegan , one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East in southeast Faerûn . Geography . The land around the Doegan Capital was open and clear , with pleasant green fields and palm trees , but harsh times saw it become dry and rocky , or as rippled brown earth like dried mud with patches of broken , rougher land .

title: Eldritch blast
description: Eldritch blast Eldritch blast was the most basic of all spell s known to a warlock . Effect . When a warlock cast " eldritch blast " he created and fired from his hands or implement a purple bolt or beam of crackling destructive energy .

title: Eldritch giant
description: Eldritch giant Eldritch giants were ancient and powerful scions of arcane lore , spending their years seeking out fragments of knowledge . Physical Appearance . Eldritch giants have purple skin that was usually covered with tattoos and runes .

title: Eldritch rain
description: Eldritch rain Eldritch rain is an evocation spell used most often by fey pact warlock s , though other warlocks sometimes learn to use it . Similar in some ways to the more basic " eldritch blast " , " eldritch rain " creates a series of deadly purple rays of arcane power , hurling them at a creature within fifty feet or two within the same range , as well as within ten feet of one another . While a warlock ' s strength of personality is the key attribute powering " eldritch rain " , fey pact warlocks also use their intellect to increase the lethality of each ray .

title: Eldritch speed
description: Eldritch speed Eldritch speed is a transmutation spell used by several inexperienced swordmage s . When it is cast , " eldritch speed " allows a swordmage to infuse their body with magic al power , quickening both their mental and physical reactive capability . Swordmages enhanced by the " eldritch speed " react to danger more quickly and can run twice as fast .

title: Eldrith
description: Eldrith Eldrith the Betrayer , commonly known as the Betrayer , was a powerful warrior who served as general of the Company of the Crescent Blade in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . So masterful were her tactics , so well trained were her soldiers and such was her individual combat prowess that she never lost a battle . Her undefeated status fed her pride and she came to view Baldur ' s Gate as under her rulership , though she never actually staged a coup against the Grand Dukes .

title: Eldroon
description: Eldroon Eldroon was a minor noble house of Cormyr . History . They were a minor noble family of Marsember while it was an independent city .

title: Eldrus Wands
description: Eldrus Wands Eldrus Wands was the Magister and the patriarch of the infamous Wands House . He reigned from 409 DR to 516 DR . History .

title: Electric jolt
description: Electric jolt Electric jolt was a simple arcane evocation cantrip used by spellcasters in the Forgotten Realms to create a small jolt of electricity from their fingertips . Effects . The jolt could be aimed at a target up to 25 feet away ( or further , depending on the skill of the caster ) , but it did not produce a very powerful shock .

title: Electrum
description: Electrum Electrum was a naturally occurring silver – gold alloy , with half the value of pure gold , such that one electrum piece ( ep ) is worth ½ gold piece ( gp ) . which makes electrum worth 25 gp per pound as a trade good . Value and terminology .

title: Eledric Omanrys
description: Eledric Omanrys Eledric Omanrys was the mayor of Halagard in Halruaa in 1373 DR . Activities . Eledric was an accomplished evoker .

title: Eleedra Nathchant
description: Eleedra Nathchant Eleedra Nathchant held the title of Magister between 407 DR and 409 DR . History . Eleedra ' s ultimate goal was to seduce key rulers along the Sword Coast and make them slaves to her wiles , ruling through their utter devotion to her whims .

title: Elemental
description: Elemental Elementals were the purest living forms of the four basic elements — air , earth , fire , and water — as well as several other , less common elements . They were intelligent , self - aware entities that were made up of the matter of their home plane . They could be summoned to any plane of existence , except the plane of concordance to their element .

title: Elemental Chaos
description: Elemental Chaos The Elemental Chaos is the fundamental plane within which are contained all of the former elemental plane s and energy plane s as well as the planes of Limbo and the Abyss . A tempestuous sea of ever - changing terrain and clashing elements , with stability only enforced in isolated locations , the Elemental Chaos is ruled over , at least in name if not fact , by the primordial s and is the equal and opposite of its divine counterpart , the Astral Sea , as the primordials are the opposites of the god s as demon s are to devil s . In spite of its chaotic and dangerous landscape most parts of the Chaos are relatively easy to travel through , or at least so much as most other planes .

title: Elemental Evil
description: Elemental Evil Elemental Evil was a Dungeons & Dragons storyline that began in March 2015 and ran through August 2015 . It was followed by the Rage of Demons storyline . Description .

title: Elemental Evil Player ' s Companion
description: Elemental Evil Player ' s Companion Elemental Evil Player ' s Companion is a supplement for " Princes of the Apocalypse " . It was designed for the 5th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " , set in the " Forgotten Realms " , and released in 2015 .

title: Elemental Plane of Air
description: Elemental Plane of Air The Elemental Plane of Air was an Inner Plane or Elemental Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Elemental Plane of Air collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . Air is one of the four elements and two energies that make up the known universe and therefore of keen interest to cosmologists as well as spell casters that wish to harness and wield the raw power of the elements .

title: Elemental Plane of Earth
description: Elemental Plane of Earth The Elemental Plane of Earth was an Inner Plane or Elemental Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Elemental Plane of Earth collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . Earth is one of the four elements and two energies that make up the known universe and therefore of keen interest to cosmologists .

title: Elemental Plane of Fire
description: Elemental Plane of Fire The Elemental Plane of Fire was an Inner Plane or Elemental Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Elemental Plane of Fire collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . Fire is one of the four elements and two energies that make up the known universe and more than any other element has fascinated sentient beings since the beginning of time .

title: Elemental Plane of Water
description: Elemental Plane of Water The Elemental Plane of Water was an Inner Plane or Elemental Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Elemental Plane of Water collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . Water is one of the four elements and two energies that make up the known universe and therefore of great interest to cosmologists .

title: Elemental aegis
description: Elemental aegis Elemental aegis is a spell of the abjuration school used by some swordmage s , particularly those with an elemental focus . When a swordmage casts " elemental aegis " they extend their mythal to protect another within a nearby burst of roughly twenty - five feet in radius against the strikes of a creature affected by an " aegis " spell . The swordmage then infuses this magic al shield with elemental energy , protecting the creature within it from either acidic , electrical , fiery , freezing , or sonic damage .

title: Elemental air sphere
description: Elemental air sphere The Elemental Air sphere was a group of spells that manipulated the element of air . Originally , druid s were granted unlimited access and clerics were granted minor access to these spells . Optionally , cleric s were denied these spells .

title: Elemental archon
description: Elemental archon Archons are an elite group of elementals that can be found in either the Elemental Chaos serving primordial s or other elementals . Built in vaguely humanoid shapes , archons are among the most dangerous soldiers of the planes . Physical characteristics .

title: Elemental archon ( prestige class )
description: Elemental archon ( prestige class ) The elemental archon is a prestige class of Faerûn . Elemental archons go beyond simple mastery of their chosen element ( earth , air , water , or fire ) , believing it a necessary part of their existence to extol the superiority of their element over all others . Elemental archons often wander the lands to preach to the common folk and attempt to direct them to worship of the god representing their own element .

title: Elemental aura
description: Elemental aura Elemental aura ( also known as energy aura ) is a quality that can be applied to weapons , and can add acidic , cold , electricity , fire or sonic damage to its normal attack . If this quality is applied to a ranged weapon , its effects apply to any ammunition the weapon uses . Creation .

title: Elemental aura ( spell )
description: Elemental aura ( spell ) Elemental aura was a powerful abjuration and evocation spell that protected the caster against one specific element designated during casting and provided certain powers related to the element . This aura moved with the caster . Effect .

title: Elemental creature
description: Elemental creature Elemental creatures were beings who originated from the Inner Plane s or , since the Spellplague , the Elemental Chaos . Nearly all had powers from the plane ( s ) of air , land , fire and / or water . Though elemental beings hailed from the elemental and energy plane s , many were able to exist in other environments , sometimes easily .

title: Elemental earth sphere
description: Elemental earth sphere The Elemental Earth sphere was a group of spells that manipulated the element of earth . Druid s were granted unlimited access and clerics were granted minor access to these spells . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Elemental fire sphere
description: Elemental fire sphere The Elemental Fire sphere was a group of spells that manipulated the element of fire . Originally , druid s were granted unlimited access and clerics were granted minor access to these spells . Optionally , cleric s were denied these spells .

title: Elemental forbiddance
description: Elemental forbiddance Elemental forbiddance was an abjuration spell that created a zone that was proof against entrance by or attack from elemental s . Effects . This spell protected an area from elementals of all kinds ; they absolutely could not enter or physically attack through the barrier for the duration of the spell .

title: Elemental form
description: Elemental form Elemental form was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Elemental guide
description: Elemental guide Elemental guide was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Elemental mage
description: Elemental mage Elemental mages were wizard s in Zakhara who specialized in one of the four primary elements — sand , wind , sea , and flame . Requirements . These mages did not have any special requirements , though elemental mages following the path of flame tended to be sinister individuals .

title: Elemental realm
description: Elemental realm Elemental realms , sometimes called just realms , are domains located in the Elemental Chaos that , through sheer willpower of their creators , are made into planes in of themselves . Many of these realms are ruled over by primordial s but far from all and more than a handful exist created by other denizens of the Chaos . Although realms are distinct unlike other parts of the Elemental Chaos , sometimes even possessing their own demiplane s , each realm is still subject to the endless entropy of the Chaos and doomed to eventual absorption by its surrounding , though it may simply , like the ancient Abyss , change form or size .

title: Elemental shift
description: Elemental shift Elemental shift was a transmutation spell used by sorcerer s similar to the " resistance " spell cast by wizard s . When sorcerers used " elemental shift " they changed their own bodies , realigning the elemental energies that flowed through them . As a result , the sorcerers lost their resistances to certain types of energy prior to the spell ' s casting temporarily and replaced them with a resistance to a different kind of energy dependent upon whether they were dragon sorcerers or chaos sorcerers , an effect which could last for several minutes .

title: Elemental sphere
description: Elemental sphere The Elemental sphere was a large group of spells encompassing divine magic that manipulated the four elements — air , earth , fire , and water . Originally , druid s were granted major access and cleric s were granted minor access to these spells . Optionally , clerics got only minor access to the Elemental Earth and Elemental Water spheres .

title: Elemental swarm
description: Elemental swarm Elemental Swarm was a conjuration spell that summoned between two and eight large elemental s , one to four huge elementals , and one greater elemental , whose element depended on the plane from which they were summoned . Effects . This spell opened a portal to an Elemental Plane and summoned creatures from that plane .

title: Elemental tempest
description: Elemental tempest Elemental tempests , also sometimes called tempests or genasi tempests , are genasi capable of manifesting two elemental forms simultaneously , an unusual talent amongst their race . Unlike most genasi , who typically have a single , dominant elemental manifestation , elemental tempests embrace the chaos that fuels their physical nature . As a result , elemental tempests are inconstant and passionate individuals capable of both vast power and an unusual amount of versatility .

title: Elemental transmogrification
description: Elemental transmogrification Elemental transmogrification was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell affected any item with ties to one of the four elements .

title: Elemental vermin
description: Elemental vermin Elemental vermin were small natives of the elemental planes but could also be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were simple pests on their native elemental planes , but carried the potential for wreaking havoc in Zakhara . Description .

title: Elemental vortices
description: Elemental vortices Elemental vortices were permanent pathways that existed between the four elemental planes or an elemental plane and the Prime Material Plane . History . Genie s used these passageways to travel between the courts of other genies located on the elemental planes .

title: Elemental weapon
description: Elemental weapon Elemental weapon was a transmutation spell that infused a temporary elemental magic effect into a weapon . Effect . The caster would touch the weapon while picking an elemental magical force — acid , cold , fire , lightning , or thunder — that would infuse the weapon .

title: Elemetar
description: Elemetar Elemetar was a and later the smallest county of Tethyr , but contained Tethyr ' s second - largest city , Myratma . Geography . Elemetar was located in the Purple Marches .

title: Elender Stormfall
description: Elender Stormfall Elender Stormfall was a bard from Suzail in Cormyr in the mid - 14th century DR . As a young bard , Elender wrote a chapbook titled " The Dream of the Dragon " , discussing the spirit and mood of Cormyr around the death of King Azoun IV and the rise of the Regent Alusair in 1371 DR . The book was published in late 1374 DR .

title: Elephant
description: Elephant Elephants were enormous plant - eating animals known for their prehensile trunks . In some lands , they were used as beasts of burden or mounts . Varieties .

title: Elephant bird
description: Elephant bird The elephant bird was a huge bird with green plumage and a yellowish beak . Their screams could often be heard when traveling in the jungles of Zakhara . Usually these birds traveled in groups of two or three , but they were rarely separated from their flock .

title: Elephant drum
description: Elephant drum The elephant drum was a large instrument that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Elephant drums resembled " darbukkah s " but measured up to 6 feet in height .

title: Eles Wianar
description: Eles Wianar Lord Eles Wianar was the ruler of Chondath around 1372 DR . Activities . He was very protective of his treasury , and had spies in the powerful noble houses in nearby cities of Sespech and Arrabar .

title: Elestra Blaebur
description: Elestra Blaebur Elestra Blaebur was a popular singer , dancer and all - around performer at the Masked Merfolk in Marsember . Description . Blaebur had an extremely sultry voice .

title: Elf
description: Elf Elves , much like their living ancestors , the eladrin , who are also commonly called elves , are a long lived race of the Tel - quessir found most commonly in forests , shrublands , and other wildernesses . From time to time the elves have organized strong nations , though with far less frequency than eladrin , in some cases adopting even a nomadic lifestyle . Almost all elves worship the Seldarine , otherwise known as the elven pantheon , and the elves are generally , though not always , good in nature .

title: Elf Leap
description: Elf Leap Elf Leap was a hillock to the north and slightly west of Castle Grimstead in Shadowdale . It had steep cliffs on its south and east sides . History .

title: Elf disguise
description: Elf disguise Elf disguise was an illusion spell contained in the " Obsul Ssussun " . It was also called " golhydarthiir " , meaning " surface - elf disguise " , but included also the option to disguise the caster as a drow . Description .

title: Elfblade
description: Elfblade The Elfblades ( not to be confused with the Cormanthyrian elfblade , a lesser magical item ) refers to three specific magical swords created by Elven High Magic by spellcasters from the Elven Court in - 4000 DR . The three swords , the Rulers ' Blade ( the Ar ' Cor ' Kerym ) , and the two Defenders ' Blades , the Warblade ( the Ary ' Velahr ' Kerym ) , and the Artblade ( the Ary ' Faern ' Kerym ) are wielded by the rulers of Cormanthyr and used to determine who is worthy of such responsibility by the ancient ritual of Blade - rite . History .

title: Elfharrow
description: Elfharrow Elfharrow was a desert land populated by scattered tribes of xenophobic elves . The natives also patrolled the North Wall mountains south of their lands , recording occasional sightings of monstrous entities in the high clouds along the ridgeline of desolated Halruaa . The region was also known as the Elfharrow badlands .

title: Elfhold
description: Elfhold The Elfhold was an ancient crypt hidden under the Wyvernstones of Hullack in the Hullack Forest . It was once used as a burial vault by the elves of House Amaratharr , where their remains were interred in small crypts carved into the walls of the grotto . The legendary human druid Hullack of Eldath , whose name lived on in that of the forest , was also buried here .

title: Elfinster
description: Elfinster Elfinster , also known as El , operated the small establishment known as the School of the Mage of Shadowdale in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in Zakhara . Description . El was a human ajami mage who called himself the " Mage of Shadowdale .

title: Elfmaid ( ship )
description: Elfmaid ( ship ) The Elfmaid was a Ruathen pirate ship captained by Hrolf the Unruly that plied the Sea of Swords . Description . The " Elfmaid " was long and graceful , clinker - built of strong , light wood .

title: Elfmeet
description: Elfmeet Elfmeet was a small community of Poscadar elves situated on the southern side of the Long Canyon in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Geography . The hamlet was right on the edge of the canyon and had a spring at its center .

title: Elfshadow
description: Elfshadow Elfshadow is the first book in the Songs and Swords series by Elaine Cunningham and the second book in The Harpers series . " Elfshadow " introduced the popular characters of Arilyn Moonblade , Danilo Thann , and Elaith Craulnober . Summary .

title: Elfskull Inn
description: Elfskull Inn The Elfskull Inn was an inn in the city of Arabel owned by Asheyron . History . The inn was named because of the mysterious glowing floating skull of an elf which appeared occasionally at night in the entry foyer .

title: Elfsong
description: Elfsong Elfsong is the second book in the Songs and Swords series by Elaine Cunningham . It was originally released as the eighth book in The Harpers series . Summary .

title: Elfsong Tavern
description: Elfsong Tavern The Elfsong Tavern was a well - known tavern in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Geography . The tavern was located just inside the gate to Wyrm ' s Crossing on the eastern side of the lower city .

title: Elfstone Tavern
description: Elfstone Tavern The Elfstone Tavern was a tavern in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep , on the Street of the Sword . It was aimed at elves and half - elves in the city , and run by Yaereene Ilbaereth . Structure .

title: Elgath
description: Elgath Elgath was a man from the city of Archenbridge in Archendale , in the Dalelands . He was the proprietor of Elgath ' s Provisions . History .

title: Elgath ' s Provisions
description: Elgath ' s Provisions Elgath ' s Provisions was a shop located in the city of Archenbridge in Archendale in the Dalelands . It sold overland travelling supplies and was found on Urserpent Street , in the eastern part of the city . History .

title: Elgrin Fau
description: Elgrin Fau Elgrin Fau was a city built by humans , and later sent to the Shadow Deep , in the Plane of Shadow by Kesson Rel . History . The city was built on a world now forgotten , nearly 9000 years previous to the events of Dawn of Night .

title: Elgun
description: Elgun Elgun was a male human of Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Elgun was a citizen of Port Llast .

title: Eliah Coastoar
description: Eliah Coastoar Eliah Coastoar was a seller in the Moonsea . Activities . Eliah worked at the Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities as seller of wine and pies .

title: Elikarashae
description: Elikarashae Elikarashae was a female Yuir elf warrior who became a deity and ascended to Arvandor . As a mortal , she used the spear " Shama " which was able to speak to a pure - hearted and noble elf ; the club " Maelat " , which could only be used in anger if it was to defend the Yuirwood ; and the sling " Ukava " , which was said to never miss .

title: Elion
description: Elion Elion was a northern fishing town on the island of Evermeet within the Trackless Sea . Government . It was governed by a council elected to settle disputes and maintain order .

title: Elisa Nettlebee
description: Elisa Nettlebee Elisa Nettlebee was the only daughter of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Elisa had inherited her mother ' s personality .

title: Elisande
description: Elisande Elisande was a young girl in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Elisande lived in a small village on a isle not too far from Phlan .

title: Elisia
description: Elisia Elisia was a sea spirit who lived in Lac Dinneshere within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The elven - like water spirit had blue skin and light green hair .

title: Elisker Hagathan
description: Elisker Hagathan Elisker Hagathan was a priest of Ilmater the Broken God in the 14th century DR , holding the title of " Enduring Servant " . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , Ilmatari investigators discovered the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — in the possession of a group of Thayan agents based in Athkatla , Amn . An Ilmatari strike force assaulted their house one night in the autumn of that year .

title: Elister Noggins
description: Elister Noggins Elister Noggins was a rock gnome priest of Gond from Loudwater . History . Elister lived in Loudwater as a clockmaker with his friend the clockwork construct Tick Tock .

title: Elizar Dryflagon
description: Elizar Dryflagon Elizar Dryflagon was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Elemental Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall . History . Elizar was once a druid until he turned to the worship of Imix .

title: Elizzaria Whitehand
description: Elizzaria Whitehand Elizzaria Whitehand was the lord of Tasseldale in 1368 DR . Activities . As Grand Mairshar , Elizzaria had powers only over the defense of the dale .

title: Elk Tribe
description: Elk Tribe The Elk tribe was one of the Uthgardt barbarian tribes whose realm of influence includes the Evermoors , the Dessarin and the lower Surbrin valleys . Under the leadership of chieftain Zokan Thunderer , ( as of year 1359 . ) They have also gained loose ties with Luskan .

title: Elkannath ( family )
description: Elkannath ( family ) The Elkannath family was a dwarven noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Elkannath Mountains
description: Elkannath Mountains The Elkannath Mountains were a range of mountains located in the southwestern region of Returned Abeir . It totally separated the kingdom of Gontal from the rest of Returned Abeir , as the only known way to traverse the mountains was through Gontal Pass , the eastern gate of Gontal City .
