title: Elkantar Iluim
description: Elkantar Iluim Elkantar Iluim was the drow companion of Qilué Veladorn . History . Elkantar was a drow noble who had been sold into slavery by his matron mother because of his rebellious tendencies .

title: Ellaniath
description: Ellaniath Ellaniath was the name of Vhaeraun ’ s realm , the drow deity of thievery . It served as his base of operation and as the place of his followers ’ afterlife . Location .

title: Ellard Gauntur
description: Ellard Gauntur Ellard Gauntur was a War Wizard of Cormyr in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Lady Glathra Barcantle sent Ellard with five Purple Dragons to arrest Rorskryn Mreldrake for treason but found he had escaped through a " gate " to Marsember .

title: Ellardin Darovik
description: Ellardin Darovik Ellardin Darovik was the priest of Goldenfields and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . The priest managed the largest walled temple - farm to Chauntea in the Dessarin Valley .

title: Ellery Dragonsbane
description: Ellery Dragonsbane Ellery Dragonsbane , her full name Ellery Tranth Dopray Kierney Dragonsbane Peidopare , was a famous commander of the Army of Bloodstone . Appearance . Ellery was tall and quite slender .

title: Ellesime
description: Ellesime Ellesime was the elven queen of Suldanessellar . History . She was said to be of divine heritage ; indeed , her beauty was often compared to that of a goddess .

title: Ellhimar
description: Ellhimar Ellhimar was a human wizard living in Iltkazar . History . Ellhimar hailed from Erlkazar but in 1366 DR he relocated to Iltkazakar , although he still considered himself a visitor .

title: Ellifain Tuuserail
description: Ellifain Tuuserail Ellifain Tuuserail ( male alias Le ' lorinel Tel ' e ' brenequiette ) was a moon elf in the Moonwood . Her mother was killed by a drow raiding party containing Drizzt Do ' Urden when she was a young child . Physical description .

title: Elliot Graves
description: Elliot Graves Elliot Graves was a Harper and the servant and close confident of Loene in Waterdeep . Description . Graves was a skilled soldier and chef .

title: Ellis Adarbrent
description: Ellis Adarbrent Ellis Adarbrent was a member of the noble house of Adarbrent and a cartographer in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ellis was a quiet man and he stuttered when nervous .

title: Ellison Berenger
description: Ellison Berenger Ellison Berenger was a sorcerer member of the Cult of the Dragon and a scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Ellison was sent by his masters to infiltrated Mantor ' s Library , together with fellow cultists Tibeem and Spernik , who had another mission .

title: Ellym Thourin
description: Ellym Thourin Ellym " Catsjaw " Thourin was a priest of Helm in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . Ellym once earned a reputation as an adventurer , but later retired . Subsequently , Ellym rose through the clergy of Helm to become High Watchful Weaponmaster of the Noble Hand temple by 1368 DR .

title: Elmaer Oraun
description: Elmaer Oraun Elmaer Oraun was a former Sembia n war captain who became Lord of Harrowdale in the 1170s or 1180s DR . He vanished during the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , presumed dead , in which Harrowdale was lost to Halvan the Dark . Relationships .

title: Elmanesse
description: Elmanesse The Elmanesse was an elven tribe in the Forest of Tethir . History . The tribe was formed when elves fled the fall of Myth Drannor and settled in Tethir .

title: Elmariel Emmarask
description: Elmariel Emmarask Elmariel Emmarask was a member of the Emmarask noble house of Cormyr and a war wizard . He was a trusted friend of Luthax . Background .

title: Elminster ' s Choice
description: Elminster ' s Choice Elminster ' s Choice was a popular beer exported from Immersea and sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This dark beer had a thick head and was clouded with yeast .

title: Elminster ' s Ecologies
description: Elminster ' s Ecologies Elminster ' s Ecologies is a 2nd Edition boxed set containing several 32 - page books detailing the ecology of the Forgotten Realms . It is written in - character as Elminster and other characters . In addition to the credited authors , Monte Cook is also credited as a designer .

title: Elminster ' s effulgent epuration
description: Elminster ' s effulgent epuration Elminster ' s effulgent epuration was an arcane abjuration spell that created a number of floating spheres that protected an individual from targeted hostile magic . Effects . This spell had a few distinct variations , but all versions produced intangible spheres that floated about the caster or another creature as chosen by the caster , and did not require concentration to maintain .

title: Elminster ' s evasion
description: Elminster ' s evasion Elminster ' s evasion was an arcane evocation spell that transported the mind , soul , and body of the caster to a chosen location in the event of any of six predetermined trigger conditions . Upon arrival , one or two other stored spells were allowed to take effect . Effects .

title: Elminster ' s tower
description: Elminster ' s tower Elminster ' s tower was the abode of perhaps the most famous , or infamous , spellcaster throughout Toril — Elminster Aumar . Location . Elminster ' s tower was found in the village of Shadowdale .

title: Elminster : The Making of a Mage
description: Elminster : The Making of a Mage Elminster : The Making of a Mage is the first book in the open - ended Elminster series . Appendix . Notes .

title: Elminster Aumar
description: Elminster Aumar Elminster Aumar , also known as the " Sage of Shadowdale " and the " Old Mage " , was one of the most famous and powerful wizards in all of Faerûn , as well as a fair fighter and thief . Description . As a high - level wizard , Elminster was capable of taking on almost any appearance imaginable .

title: Elminster Must Die
description: Elminster Must Die Elminster Must Die by Ed Greenwood is the debut fourth - edition appearance of Elminster . It is the first novel in the Sage of Shadowdale series . Appendix .

title: Elminster hunting
description: Elminster hunting Elminster hunting is a name for the practice of the Zhentarim sending their members to seek Elminster , with predictable results . This used as a way to weed out those who are seen as too ambitious . Older members use this as a way to " die " out of the Brotherhood .

title: Elminster series
description: Elminster series The Elminster series is the signature work of Ed Greenwood , the founder of the Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting . An open - ended series , all the novels center on Elminster , the Sage of Shadowdale , Chosen of Mystra , and general narrator of the Realms .

title: Elmwood
description: Elmwood Elmwood was a small farming community located on the southern shores of the Moonsea . Government . This tranquil place was loosely ruled by its constable , Thoyana Jorgadaul , a shield dwarf adventurer who retired here due to a respiratory disease .

title: Elorfindar Floshin
description: Elorfindar Floshin Lord Elorfindar Floshin was a sun elf who guarded the " portal s " of the Ardeep Forest . He lived in a manor close to the House of Long Silences . He was a distant relative of Araevin Teshurr .

title: Elovear
description: Elovear The Elovear family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Elovears were allied with the Channath , Laranadda , Tithlin , and Vandover families .

title: Elrem the wise
description: Elrem the wise Elrem the Wise was the powerful shaman of the Great Worm Tribe of Uthgardt barbarians and resided permenatly at the Great Worm ancestor mound . Once human , Elrem had acquired the shape of a great Worm through some magical means . Either through pious devotion or the prays of his followers Elrem had became an embodiment of the totem spirit of his tribe .

title: Elsura Dauniir
description: Elsura Dauniir Elsura Dauniir was the field agent of the Moonstars for the north Faerûn in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Powers . She had the unique ability to transform herself in a black cat at will .

title: Eltab
description: Eltab Eltab is a demon lord known as the " Lord of the Hidden Layer . " Description . Eltab appears as a fifteen - foot - tall humanoid with the head of a canine - like creature .

title: Eltan
description: Eltan Eltan was the founder and leader of the Flaming Fists mercenary company , as well as a Grand Duke of the city of Baldur ' s Gate in the late 1300s DR . During the iron crisis of 1368 DR , Eltan was nearly assassinated by members of the Iron Throne , but he survived the attempt . Description .

title: Eltargrim Irithyl
description: Eltargrim Irithyl Eltargrim Irithyl was sixth Coronal of Cormanthyr , seventh son of Coronal Tannivh Irithyl , ruling from - 223 DR to his death in 661 DR . He was of the unpopular opinion that the outside races ( such as human s , gnome s , halfling s and dwarves ) could not be held back by the elves due of their sheer numbers , so he allowed them entry to the forest of Cormanthor and to inhabit the city of Cormanthor , renaming it Myth Drannor in 261 DR . Description .

title: Elthaun Aumar
description: Elthaun Aumar Elthaun Aumar was the second of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Elthaun was the second son of the Stag King of Athalantar , Uthgrael Aumar .

title: Elthia
description: Elthia Elthia was a princess of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast , and later princess and queen of Impiltur in the 7th century DR . History . Around the early 7th century DR , Chessagol recently came under the rule of King Lamoth and his newly royal family , though they were not considered legitimate .

title: Elthryn Aumar
description: Elthryn Aumar Elthryn Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and the father of Elminster Aumar . History . Elthryn was a calm , peaceful , just man .

title: Elturel
description: Elturel Once an independent city , Elturel later served as the capital of Elturgard . Geography . The city was situated atop a cliff , dominating the River Chionthar .

title: Elturgard
description: Elturgard Elturgard was a theocracy in the Western Heartlands ruled by paladin s of Torm in the 15th century DR . History . Elturgard was first formed by the paladins and cleric s of the city of Elturel after the Spellplague in 1385 DR .

title: Elturian Grey
description: Elturian Grey Elturian Grey was a cheese crafted in Elturel . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Eluraunt Malabrak
description: Eluraunt Malabrak Eluraunt Malabrak was a shadovar arcanist . History . Eluraunt was one of the few shadovar surviving the fall of Thultanthar in 1487 DR .

title: Elvar the Grainlord
description: Elvar the Grainlord Elvar the Grainlord was the ruler of the small village of Triel . Personality . Elvar was generally a reasonable lord when it came to trade , though he had two mild obsessions .

title: Elvath Muirreste
description: Elvath Muirreste Lord Elvath Muirreste was a tall moon elf who served in the Silver Guard as the leader of the Elion legion until he followed Seiveril Miritar to Faerûn to combat the daemonfey invasion . Description . The strongly built elven lord had pale skin and very dark hair .

title: Elven Court
description: Elven Court The Elven Court ( sometimes called " Old Elven Court " after its destruction by the drow ) is one of four old elven communities in the forest of Cormanthor ( the others being Myth Drannor , Semberholme and the Tangled Trees ) , part of the newly refounded realm of Cormanthyr . It is a holy site for the elves , a Seldarine - blessed place of pilgrimage , where the elves first convened to serve justice and decide the outcome of the Crown Wars and the fate of elves . History .

title: Elven Port
description: Elven Port Elven Port was a flourishing elven city that stood at the edges of the High Forest . Description . Its piers were wetted by the river Delimbiyr .

title: Elven bow
description: Elven bow An Elven bow was a ranged weapon which could be used in melee as a club or staff . Description . A wondrous piece of art , elven bows were crafted mostly from wood , and beautifully designed .

title: Elven bread
description: Elven bread Elven bread was a highly nutritional bread produced in Evermeet . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Elven dualist
description: Elven dualist Dualists , commonly known as " elven dualists " despite the fact that in the time of Myth Drannor a few gnomes became " nelluonkkar " , were specialist wizard s who hailed from the ancient elven nations . History . In the time of Myth Drannor , the theory of magic revolved around fixed circular relationships between the eight schools of magic ; arcane wizardly specialists would sacrifice the school or schools that opposed their own and focus primarily on their specialty school with minor interest in the other , non - opposed , schools .

title: Elven high mage
description: Elven high mage Elves study magic with a matchless passion . But even among the elves , the high mages are regarded as obsessed with the accumulation of arcane power . Elven high mages are the masters of creating their own epic spells — " mythals " that can grow to engulf entire cities .

title: Elven high magic
description: Elven high magic Elven High Magic ( Arselu ' Tel ' Quess in elven or the Great Art of the People ) is the term used to describe one of the most powerful forms of magic practiced in Faerûn . Casters of this magic are called Selu ' taar , also known as the " Art ' s Disciples " or simply as " High Mages " . High Magic spells are powerful enough to affect deities or to create world - changing spell effects .

title: Elven language
description: Elven language Elven ( commonly called Elvish and sometimes referred to as the True Tongue ) was the language ( or language family ) of the " Tel ’ Quessir " ( " e . g . " , eladrin , elves , and drow ) .

title: Elvenblood Pass
description: Elvenblood Pass Elvenblood Pass was a major pass through Earthfast Mountains in the Vast , linking the northern and southern halves . The High Trail ran through it to connect Procampur and Ravens Bluff . Description .

title: Elventree
description: Elventree Elventree was a sylvan community in the West Branch of the Moonsea in the forest of Cormanthor . Structure . Elventree had been built up with wood on ruins of stone buildings .

title: Elverquisst
description: Elverquisst Elverquisst was a variety of elven spirit . Description . Elverquisst was ruby colored , " distilled from sunshine and rare summer fruits .

title: Elveswatch
description: Elveswatch Elveswatch was a small city located in the Forests of Amtar in Dambrath . Geopgraphy . The city was located along the southeastern fringes of the great forest .

title: Elvran Torchtower
description: Elvran Torchtower Elvran Torchtower was a human noble from Cormyr . Relationships . He was from the noble house of Torchtower .

title: Elysium
description: Elysium Elysium was the Great Wheel cosmology plane embodying the concept of pure good without being overly restricted by law nor dissipated by the randomness of chaos . Some characteristics of this plane where ascribed to Heliopolis and the House of Nature in the World Tree cosmology model when that cosmology became popular . Heliopolis was essentially destroyed in the Spellplague and the House of Nature split in at least two parts , one of which became the Deep Wilds and the other merged with the Green Fields as described by the World Axis cosmology model .

title: Elytharra Dinnesmore
description: Elytharra Dinnesmore Elytharra Dinnesmore was a half - elf woman and an enchantress from Neverwinter . History . Elytharra met Ulbrec Dinnesmore , who was in the guard at the time .

title: Embassy of Procampur
description: Embassy of Procampur The Embassy of Procampur was an embassy of the city of Procampur located in the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . Description . The embassy was found at the south end of the Foreign District in Ravens Bluff , where a looping side - lane provided access .

title: Embattlement
description: Embattlement Embattlement was a divine abjuration spell that made it more difficult to successfully attack the caster . History . The " embattlement " spell appeared within the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the church of Ilmater , which first appeared in the Realms in 848 DR .

title: Embrae Aloevan
description: Embrae Aloevan Queen Embrae Aloevan was a moon elf Chosen of both Mystra and Sehanine . History . In the Year of Frostfires ( 292 DR ) , Aloevan became a chosen of Mystra and Sehanine .

title: Embrus Obarskyr
description: Embrus Obarskyr Embrus " the Old " was so named because even though he was only the second son of Faerlthann Obarskyr , he was the sixth king of Cormyr after his father for some reason declared him to be last in the line of succession , and was a ripe 49 years old when he took the throne in 79 DR after his younger brother Rhiiman died without an heir . Relationships . Embrus had two sons , both born before his coronation , Kaspler and Imbre to ensure the continuation of his line in the wake of three consecutive heirless kings .

title: Embryn Crownsilver
description: Embryn Crownsilver Embryn Crownsilver was a member of the Crownsilver noble house of Cormyr . History . In 1369 DR , Embryn pledged allegiance to Vangerdahast as the Regent of Cormyr .

title: Emelyn
description: Emelyn Emelyn , called the Gray , was a human wizard around 1368 DR . Appearance . Emelyn wore satin gray robes .

title: Emerald
description: Emerald Emerald was a brilliant green variety of found in the Realms . Description . Emerald cleaved easily along orthogonal lines , making rectangular cuts ( the " emerald " cut , known as a modified step cut in lapidary parlance ) the most common form for this jewel .

title: Emerald Brotherhood
description: Emerald Brotherhood The Emerald Brotherhood was a mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Emerald Brotherhood was originally an adventuring party operating in Amn , Tethyr , the Thornwood , and the Snowflake Mountains until they were taken into wildspace by mind flayer slavers .

title: Emerald Enclave
description: Emerald Enclave The Emerald Enclave was an organization of druid s and other nature worshipers on the island of Ilighôn . The actions of the Enclave influenced the lives of the high and low , its members avoiding good and evil to focus on the needs of the natural world and resist the growing influence of humankind . Despite their primary goal of preserving nature , members were not direct opponents of progress ; they preferred instead to work with civilized folk to promote the health of the natural world without resorting to acts of violence .

title: Emerald burst
description: Emerald burst Emerald burst is an evocation spell that turns an emerald into a grenadelike weapon . Effect . You infuse an emerald with magical power and it flies toward your enemies .

title: Emerald dragon
description: Emerald dragon Emerald dragons were gem dragon s who were inquisitive and often more knowledgeable than most sages . Personality . They tended to be paranoid and distrustful of visitors , and their lairs often had many traps .

title: Emerus
description: Emerus King Emerus Warcrown of Citadel Felbarr was one of the Members of the Council of 12 Peers . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Since 1367 DR he sought to rebuild the " once - glorious city of Felbarr " ; despite this , the Citadel was still very vulnerable . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p61 " > < / ref > In the second month of 1486 DR , King Emerus abdicated his throne and title to Parson Glaive to join on the march to reclaim Gauntlgrym .

title: Emi Towiki
description: Emi Towiki Emi Towiki was a maiden butterfly in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Towiki was a kitchen worker at the Ito family ' s castle .

title: Emilo Haversack
description: Emilo Haversack Emilo Haversack was a kender from the world of Krynn . History . In 1368 DR , Emilo met Joel the Rebel Bard and Jasmine of Westgate , a former Krynn Spelljammer , after being gated to Sigil .

title: Eminence of Araunt
description: Eminence of Araunt The Eminence of Araunt was a relatively new power in Toril . Brought to the world on the planeshifted continent of Returned Abeir , The Eminence viewed itself as the de facto ruler of all undead across Toril . Organization .

title: Emlar Goldsword
description: Emlar Goldsword Emlar Goldsword was a rogue fighter and a member of House Goldsword of Cormyr . Elmar was a bald man . He was loyal to Cormyr but not to the Obarskyr s .

title: Emmer Jundhyl
description: Emmer Jundhyl Emmer Jundhyl was an Illuskan human and a member of the City Watch of Waterdeep , holding the position of watch civilar for the North Ward . Personality . The watch captain was hefty and outgoing .

title: Emmergluth
description: Emmergluth Emmergluth was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a .

title: Emotion
description: Emotion Emotion , also known as emotion control , was an alteration and / or enchantment / charm spell that aroused strong emotions in one or more creatures . There were divine and arcane versions of this spell . Effects .

title: Emperel Ruousk
description: Emperel Ruousk Emperel Ruousk was a member of the Purple Dragons and the guardian of the Lords Who Sleep . He was killed by the ghazneth Xanthon Cormaeril while investigating a series of murders . Possessions .

title: Emperor ' s Quarters
description: Emperor ' s Quarters The Emperor ' s Quarters served as the palace of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne in the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Location . The Emperor ' s Quarters made - up a a full quarter of the size of the capital city of Nathong .

title: Emperor of the Lotus Throne
description: Emperor of the Lotus Throne The Emperor of the Lotus Throne , also called the Lotus Emperor , was the traditional head of the Lotus Court and ruler of the Yikarian Empire . Activities . The Emperor not only ruled the vast Empire , but also served as the High Priest of the Faceless God — the only deity worshiped by the yak - folk .

title: Empires of the Alamber Sea
description: Empires of the Alamber Sea The Empires of the Alamber Sea was a collective term used in the late 14th century and through most of the 15th century DR to describe the empires of High Imaskar and Okoth . Although not technically an empire , people also usually associated the nation of Tymanther with this term as well .

title: Empowerment candle
description: Empowerment candle An empowerment candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It increased spellcasting and weapon effectiveness to their greatest potential . Description .

title: Empty - Scabbard Killers
description: Empty - Scabbard Killers The Empty - Scabbard Killers , or Forak - Erach - Naek in an obscure dwarvish dialect , were a legendary order of duergar psionic assassins in Gracklstugh , whom common people believed to be mythical . They were one of the most feared groups in the Underdark . They practiced disciplines unknown to even the savviest derro or the wisest priest .

title: Empyreal ecstasy
description: Empyreal ecstasy Empyreal ecstasy is an abjuration spell that immunizes targets to pain and , and halves damage taken . Unfortunately , it also reduces skill modifiers . Effect .

title: Emryn Dawe
description: Emryn Dawe Emryn Dawe was a Harper based in Luskan in 1485 DR . History . She was contacted by a fellow Harper named Aarun from the Ten Towns .

title: Emrys
description: Emrys Emrys was a Netherese arcanist and a friend of Tarchamus the Unyielding . Approximately 5 , 000 years before the present ( 1479 DR ) , Tarchamus destroyed the Netherese floating city of Tenish using his volcano spell . After the destruction of Tenish , Emrys convinced the most powerful Netherese arcanists to block Tarchamus ' access to the Weave , which must have required the intercession of Mystryl .

title: Emthrara Undril
description: Emthrara Undril Emthrara Undril was a female human Harper who worked as a dancer at The Laughing Lass tavern in Suzail to maintain her cover . Appearance . Emthrara was beautiful with long blonde hair .

title: Encephalithid
description: Encephalithid The Encephalithid was the elder brain of Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Personality . The Encephalithid did not have absolute authority over the community ; instead , it led the Elder Concord and had an active role in the governing of the community .

title: Encrypt
description: Encrypt Encrypt was an arcane illusion spell that permanently obscured a short written message from all eyes except a chosen few . Effects . The message was limited to 66 letters or characters ( spaces were not counted ) but could appear on any non - liquid surface such as paper , wood , stone , glass , sand , soot , or snow up to 80 ft ( 24 m ) away , and even farther for more experienced casters .

title: End ' s Rest
description: End ' s Rest End ' s Rest was a college for healer s located in the city of Heliogabalus in Damara around 1374 DR . The college was managed by a group of worshipers of Ilmater . These healers tended to the city ' s defenders , including paladin s and recruits , as well as the sick and injured of the community and pregnant women .

title: End to strife
description: End to strife End to strife is an enchantment spell that causes anyone who attacks in the spell ' s area of effect to take damage . Effect . This spell creates an invisible aura of divine power around the caster .

title: Enda Yate
description: Enda Yate Enda Yate was a halfling rogue in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , having heard about a ruby - eyed - statue somewhere inside Undermountain , Enda agreed to join the doomed Rutherford Urmbrusk ' s party .

title: Endarthar
description: Endarthar Endarthar was in wizard who lived in the Wildwoods mansion near Waymoot in 1367 DR . Personality . Endarthar was a brilliant spellcaster possessed of a fierce temper .

title: Endless Caverns
description: Endless Caverns The Endless Caverns were a series of deep - reaching cavern and tunnel complexes located to the south of the Star Mounts . Inside the Endless Caverns lived many powerful and dangerous creatures , such as Grimnoshtasdrano , the Riddling Dragon , and the lich Aumvor The Undying .

title: Endless Ice Sea
description: Endless Ice Sea The Endless Ice Sea was an enormous glacier north of the Spine of the World believed to house hidden treasure troves and magic . Geography . The Endless Ice Sea was located to the east of Reghed Glacier and a frozen wasteland .

title: Endless Revels of Life
description: Endless Revels of Life The Endless Revels of Life are holy days for the followers of Sharess . These revelries are celebrated on Midwinter , Midsummer , the vernal equinox , Highharvestide , the Feast of the Moon , the winter solstice , and every full moon . The most important of these events is the Midsummer revelry .

title: Endra Mathlyn
description: Endra Mathlyn Endra " Watchever " Mathlyn was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a priest ess of Helm and was High Guardian of the Tower of the Eye temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1367 DR . She had 18 subordinate priests and 24 lay - followers .

title: Endrith Vallivoe
description: Endrith Vallivoe Endrith Vallivoe was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a contact of the Harpers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The shopkeeper was a shy and scuttling little man .

title: Endroth Knag
description: Endroth Knag Endroth Knag was an old member of the City Watch in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Every night after he finished his work in the Watch , Knag went to drink at the Yawning Portal tavern , pondering on unresolved cases .

title: Endurance domain
description: Endurance domain The Endurance domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters endurance spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Endurance Domain Powers .

title: Endurance of Ilmater
description: Endurance of Ilmater Endurance of Ilmater was a divine spell that bolstered the health , strength , and endurance of a protected creature . Users . The spell could be cast by cleric s who commanded the necromantic and protection spheres , and by painbearer s , the specialty priests of Ilmater .

title: Endure cold or heat
description: Endure cold or heat Endure cold / endure heat was an alteration spell that allowed a creature to withstand extremes of non - magical heat or cold . Effects . This spell was an improved version of the " resist cold " spell that allowed the caster to choose " endure cold " or " endure heat " at the time of casting .

title: Endure elements
description: Endure elements Endure elements was an abjuration spell that allowed the recipient to ignore normal extremes of non - magical heat or cold . Effects . This spell lasted for 24 hours .

title: Energetic healing
description: Energetic healing Energetic healing is an conjuration spell that immunizes the target against a particular type of energy , and lets him regain 10 % of the would - be damage as healing . Effect . This spell converts magical energy damage into healing power .

title: Energy drain
description: Energy drain Energy drain was a necromancy spell that could temporarily or permanently drain life energy levels from a creature . The older versions of this spell were the reverse of the necromantic " restoration " . Effects .

title: Enervation
description: Enervation Enervation was a necromancy spell that severely weakened the subject . Effect . The caster pointed his finger and uttered the incantation , releasing a black bolt of crackling negative energy that suppressed the life force of any living creature it struck .

title: Enhance ability
description: Enhance ability Enhance ability was a transmutation spell that would enhance a targets abilities for up to a hour . Effect . The caster would pick an effect that would grant improvements to the target in a predetermined way : For every spell level higher then the normal spell level used , another target could gain a benefit of this spell .

title: Enhance fire creature
description: Enhance fire creature Enhance fire creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell toughened fire creatures .

title: Enhanen
description: Enhanen Enhanen was a mercenary recruiter in Arrabar . Activities . Enhanen usually recruited from his trusted veterans team , but newcomers were also welcome .

title: Enixtryx
description: Enixtryx Enitryx was a black dragon and a member of the Cult of the Dragon . Relationships . He was the familiar of the half - dragon Vargo Kent after Amnemis became too big and became Vargo ' s cohort instead .

title: Enki
description: Enki Enki was a god with several connections to the gods of Toril , although he was never worshiped on that world . He was god of rivers and oceans among the ancestors of the Mulan , and also the patron of jewelers , goldsmiths , and stonecutters . Description .

title: Enlarge desert creature
description: Enlarge desert creature Enlarge desert creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell let the caster increase the size of a desert creature .

title: Enlarge or reduce person
description: Enlarge or reduce person Enlarge person was a transmutation spell that doubled the height of one humanoid with a corresponding increase in mass . Earlier versions of this spell were called Aksa ' s growth or simply enlarge and worked on both humanoids and objects , but to different degrees . " Enlarge " was reversible , and the shrinking spell was called reduce .

title: Enlightened Ring
description: Enlightened Ring The Enlightened Ring was part of the core of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This central province in the Land of the Yak - Men was located high in the World Pillar Mountains of northeast Zakhara .

title: Enlil
description: Enlil Enlil was the patriarch of the Untheric pantheon . He abdicated in favor of his son Gilgeam and left Toril in - 734 DR . His symbol was a pickaxe .

title: Enom Tobun
description: Enom Tobun Enom Tobun was a teamster just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Enom loved telling stories , not caring for the truthfulness of them .

title: Enserric the Sword
description: Enserric the Sword “ " this blade is almost as nasty as the personality that permanently resides within " ” – Description of blade Enserric is a magical + 4 sentient sword that was discovered in Undermountain among the hall of sleeping kings during Hordes of the Underdark Appearance . It was not known what Enserric looked like in his mortal life , though one could assume through his initial title , that he was generally attired in grey clothing , or that he was aged enough to have grey hair , or possibly both instances . As for the sword , the weapon is described to be a black with a red glittering effect , with the intensity increasing whenever Enserric speaks .

title: Ensnaring strike
description: Ensnaring strike Ensnaring strike was a conjuration spell that gave a strike the chance of ensnaring a target with vines . Effect . The target was covered with vines .

title: Entangle
description: Entangle Entangle was a transmutation or alteration spell that caused plants to hinder and ensnare all creatures in the area of effect . Effects . The transmutation version of this spell affected a circle of 40 ft ( 12 .

title: Entar Silvershield
description: Entar Silvershield Entar Silvershield was one of the Grand Dukes of the Council of Four that ruled the city of Baldur ' s Gate before the Spellplague . In the Baldur ' s Gate computer game , Entar is the father of the NPC Skie Silvershield . He lives in an estate in north - western Baldur ' s Gate with his wife Brilla .

title: Entemoch
description: Entemoch Entemoch , the Prince of Earth Elementals , was the twin of Ogrémoch , but unlike his evil brother , Entemoch was good . Description . Like his brother , he resembled a gigantic earth elemental , like a living mountain .

title: Enthrall
description: Enthrall Enthrall was an enchantment spell that captivated any number of creatures in a wide area for up to an hour . Effects . The caster had to acquire the attention of the group first by making a loud noise , shouting , performing , casting " calm chaos " , or some other means .

title: Entillis Fulsom
description: Entillis Fulsom Entillis Fulsom was an elf and a member of the Harpers living in Baldur ' s Gate . Relationships . Entillis was a friend of Gorion , Jaheira , and Khalid .

title: Entomb
description: Entomb Entomb was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Entropic shield
description: Entropic shield Entropic shield is an abjuration spell makes it harder to hit the caster with ranged attacks . Effect . A magical field appears around you , glowing with a chaotic blast of multicolored hues .

title: Entropic warding
description: Entropic warding Entropic warding was a defensive warlock invocation designed to deflect ranged attacks . Effect . " Entropic warding " appeared to be a combination of the spells " entropic shield " and " pass without trace " .

title: Entropomancer
description: Entropomancer Entropomancers are spellcasters that plumbed the depths of divine power , to the point of gaining a most advanced attunement to the great nothingness they say lies at the center of the universe . These students use this connection to develop strange powers , sacrificing some of their normal studies which retards their progress as spellcasters . Any entropomancer would say their new abilities are well worth the cost .

title: Entropy
description: Entropy Entropy was a primordial , who was for a time an aspect of Tiamat . History . When Ao banished the primordial s to Abeir he imprisoned Entropy in the form of a " sphere of annihilation " and placed him on Toril as a warning to the gods that they faced annihilation if they did not behave .

title: Eodraco
description: Eodraco The eodraco ( or " dawn dragon " , in a ) was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . Many scholars believed " eodracos " were the first proto - dragon genus . Description .

title: Eodraco orientalis
description: Eodraco orientalis The Eodraco orientalis was a supposed proto - dragon species of the " Eodraco " genus that eventually evolved into the lung dragon s . History . There was no conclusive evidence of the existence of " E .

title: Ephram Darano
description: Ephram Darano Ephram Darano was a halfling wererat wizard near Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Ephram was the patriarch of the Darano , a halfling clan cursed with lycanthropy .

title: Epic magic
description: Epic magic Epic magic is magic of " astonishing power " . Usually associated with ancient magical kingdoms , due to Mystra ' s Ban , items and places of epic magic can still be found . In D & D epic magic is usually considered to be spells of 10th level or higher .

title: Epidemic
description: Epidemic All over Loudwater , orc s are exploding ! The cause is a disease that is spreading quickly through the city ' s populace . There isn ' t enough cleric al magic to go around and an epidemic will soon strike if a cure is not found quickly .

title: Epidote
description: Epidote Epidote was a plentiful ornamental stone within the Realms . Description . This stone ' s color ranged from clear ( in the smallest crystals ) to dark red ( in larger crystal deposits ) .

title: Epricante
description: Epricante Epricante was a drow warrior of House Xorlarrin living in Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . During the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , he along his old associate Maffizo Vailentarne was part of a Xorlarrin reinforcement army sent to help the orc warlord Hartusk after an orc defeat near Mithril Hall .

title: Equarz
description: Equarz Equarz was an elf and a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster . History . Around 1491 DR , Equarz was based just outside of Mulmaster .

title: Equinis
description: Equinis Equinis was an eladrin ritualist in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Equinis went into Undermountain in search of magical knowledge .

title: Era of Skyfire
description: Era of Skyfire The First Era of Skyfire . The Era of Skyfire was a time in Faerûn ian history when the efreeti Memnon and the djinni Calim brought their forces together against each other in twenty - two cataclysmic battles from - 6500 DR to - 6100 DR . Elven High Magic forcibly bound the two leaders and bound their elemental essences to the sky and earth respectively .

title: Era of Upheaval
description: Era of Upheaval Era of Upheaval The Era of Upheaval was the time period between the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and the Spellplague in 1385 DR . 1358 DR Time of Troubles : After the Tablets of Fate were stolen , the Overgod , Ao , forced all of the gods of Faerûn to walk on Toril in their mortal avatar forms . However , unlike when a god usually sent an avatar to Toril and his or her true form resided typically on one of the Outer Planes , the deities were all demoted and this was the only form that they had at the time , making them vulnerable , though still very powerful .

title: Eragyn
description: Eragyn Eragyn was a female cleric of Cyric living in Zhent - occupied Daggerdale in 1367 DR . Activities . Circa 1359 DR , she started an eight - year - long plan to resurrect the evil wizard and ruler of the dale Colderan Morn after discovering his crypt .

title: Erakic
description: Erakic Erakic was a language spoken by the Eraka , the barbarians of The Ride , from Frozen Forest in the north to the Dragonspine Mountains in the south , and from Desert ' s Edge in the west to the Galena Mountains in the east . It was one of the Low Ulutim languages .

title: Eralynn Thunsonn
description: Eralynn Thunsonn Eralynn Thunsonn was a dwarven adventurer and member of the Order of Delvers . She was a good friend and sometimes delving companion of Torrin Ironstar . History .

title: Erammon Oraun
description: Erammon Oraun Erammon Oraun was son of Lord Elmaer Oraun , former Lord of Harrowdale . He fought in the Battle of Marak ' s Stile , defending Harrowdale against the forces of Halvan the Dark , but vanished during the battle , and the battle was won by the invading forces . History .

title: Erase
description: Erase Erase is a transmutation spell that causes mundane and magical writing to vanish . Effect . " Erase " removes writings of either magical or mundane nature from a scroll or from up to two pages of paper , parchment , or similar surfaces .

title: Erathaol
description: Erathaol Erathaol was a Seer and the ruler of Venya , the third layer of Mount Celestia . He dwelt in the library fortress of Xiranthador . Description .

title: Eravien Haund
description: Eravien Haund Eravien Haund was a half - elf and a noble member of the Lords ' Alliance during the Rage of Demons . History . Eravien was of both wood elf and Tethyrian descent , but lived in Waterdeep .

title: Erdan
description: Erdan Erdan was a priest of Amaunator in the Abbey of the Rose in Sembia . History . In 1450 DR , Erdan and Derreg welcomed Varra and helped her to give birth to Vasen Cale , despite being suspicious about the child ' s heritage .

title: Eregul
description: Eregul Eregul ( pronounced ERE - eh - GULL ) , usually known as the Freestave ( meaning that he was a wizard out for his own interests , while working for an organization ) , was a high - ranking Zhentarim wizard in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . He died in 1375 DR in Shadowdale . Description .

title: Erek - Hus
description: Erek - Hus Erek - Hus , also known as The King of Terror , was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . History . According to the few dragonborn of Abeir who believed in gods , the dragon god Asgorath ( known in Abeir by the name of Io ) fought alone against Erek - Hus during the Dawn War , and the primordial killed him by cutting Asgorath in twain with his giant adamantine axe .

title: Erelda
description: Erelda Erelda was the second - in - command of battlemistress Rylla of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1379 DR , during an attack by Ghaunadaur ' s followers on the Promenade , Erelda remained to control the seals that trapped the god ' s avatar .

title: Erelda H ' tithet
description: Erelda H ' tithet Erelda H ' tithet was the main drow representative in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Ereda was very good at concealing her scorn for others .

title: Erelhei - Cinlu
description: Erelhei - Cinlu Erelhei - Cinlu is a drow city located in the Underdark of Oerth . Its importance in the Forgotten Realms is based on the fact that the names of several of the drow noble houses of this city , which is detailed in the AD & D module D3 Vault of the Drow , republished and expanded in the Queen of the Spiders campaign adventure , are mentioned in the 1991 Forgotten Realms publication " FOR2 The Drow of the Underdark " . The Drow Houses mentioned in both publications are : Aleval , Despana , Eilservs , Everhate , Godeep , Kilsek , Noquar and Tormtor .

title: Eressea Ambergyles
description: Eressea Ambergyles Preceptress Eressea Ambergyles was the ranking religious official at the The House of the Lady in Shadowdale . History . When Erressea was younger , she was a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor .

title: Erethun Rivenstave
description: Erethun Rivenstave Erethun Rivenstave was a member of the Council of Seven Burghers in 1368 DR . History . Around 1359 DR , Erethun ' s predecessor suddenly died and Erethun was elected to the Council thanks to his wealth , despite nobody liking or trusting him .

title: Erevain Blacksheaf
description: Erevain Blacksheaf Erevain Blacksheaf was an elven adventurer from Evereska who journeyed to the Icewind Dale town of Easthaven . Description . The gold - haired elf was of slender build and dressed in hunting leathers .

title: Erevan Ilesere
description: Erevan Ilesere Erevan Ilesere ( air - eh - van illeh - seer ) was the elven god of mischief and rogue s . Having lost power in the Spellplague , he became an exarch of Corellon . His titles included the Trickster and the Chameleon .

title: Erevis Cale
description: Erevis Cale Erevis Cale is a shade and a chosen of Mask alongside Drasek Riven . He changed his name from Vasen Coriver upon his departure from the city of Westgate and the Night Masks thieves ' guild . Biography .

title: Erevon Sunter
description: Erevon Sunter Erevon Sunter was a lord in Cormyr . Activities . Sunter commanded High Horn ' s garrison .

title: Ergol Mrauksoun
description: Ergol Mrauksoun Ergol Mrauksoun was a moneylender and landlord in Immerford in Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Ergol and other wealthy citizens went to protest to Lord Lothan Durncaskyn about an unseen thief and murderer but the lord explained he was busy with two other troubles : a group of outlaws preying upon caravans and a possible crazy wizard in Hullack Forest .

title: Erhu
description: Erhu The erhu was a stringed instrument constructed with a long stick - like neck and a sound box at the bottom . The instrument had two strings and was played with a horse hair bow . The renowned erhuist Ping Chiang played the erhu at the Lily Pad Inn in Marsember .

title: Erian
description: Erian Erian was a soldier in Caer Corwell . Description . Erian was a huge man with strong corded muscles .

title: Eric Haddock
description: Eric Haddock Rich Redman is an author and game designer who has written for " Dragon " and " Dungeon " magazines . He is the author of the " Cormyr " sourcebook , and has also produced work for . Background .

title: Eric L . Boyd
description: Eric L . Boyd Eric L . Boyd has co - authored a number of " Forgotten Realms " campaign supplements , most recently the " Forgotten Realms Player ' s Guide " for 4th edition D & D .

title: Erik Mona
description: Erik Mona Erik Mona was the editor - in - chief of Dragon magazine from 2004 to 2007 and Dungeon magazine from 2004 to 2006 ; both magazines were published by Paizo Publishing until 2007 . He has edited , authored , and co - authored several products for the Dungeons & Dragons role - playing game , including the " Living Greyhawk Gazetteer " , " Faiths and Pantheons " , " Armies of the Abyss " , and " " . He is also the former editor of the " Oerth Journal " , an online publication devoted to the World of Greyhawk campaign setting .

title: Erik Scott de Bie
description: Erik Scott de Bie Erik Scott de Bie ( born July 18 , 1983 ) is an American fantasy author and technical writer . He has a degree in English Composition and Literature from in . His wife is named Shelley and he has several cats and a dog .

title: Erin M . Evans
description: Erin M . Evans Erin M . Evans is a fantasy author currently living in Seattle with her husband .

title: Erinyes
description: Erinyes Erinyes were baatezu devil s of the Nine Hells . Physical description . Erinyes originally appeared as beautiful women and men , with large feathered wings and glowing red eyes .

title: Erione
description: Erione Erione was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Erione resented the fact that a few priests were in the cult ' s command structure and wanted to demonstrate that worship could bring even greater power .

title: Erixitl
description: Erixitl Erixitl was a young Maztican priestess of Qotal and the wife of the former Golden Legion officer Halloran . History . At the age of 10 , Erixitl was taken captive and held as a slave in the city of Kultaka .

title: Erliza Daressin
description: Erliza Daressin Lady Erliz Daressin was a human woman and vampire and the Amnian ruler of Snowdown Isle in the Moonshae Isles in 1479 DR . When she was turned into a vampire in Amn , she had a vision of being reborn as a queen of the Feywild . Through research that mostly consisted of consulting sages and then drinking their blood , she found information that led her to believe the city of Karador contained a portal to the Feywild and she worked to obtain a position of power in Amn ' s colony of Snowdown .

title: Erlkazar
description: Erlkazar Erlkazar was a small kingdom located due east of Tethyr . History . The land now known as Erlkazar was , until the last millennium , untamed wilderness .

title: Erlranther Alibakkar
description: Erlranther Alibakkar Erlranther Alibakkar is the current Meisarch , the highest ranking member of the Council of Six , the government of Amn . He is noted as being in his late fifties as of 1362 DR ( see Age below ) and he has a slightly large belly . He was originally a caravan organizer and a fighter , but in 1333 DR he entered the Council of Six as the lower - ranked Namarch , moving his way up gradually .

title: Erned Stoutblade
description: Erned Stoutblade Erned Stoutblade was a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , having heard that the Iceshield orc s had attacked many farms in the Dessarin Valley , he decided to go to the Dellmon farm to help Kerbin Dellmon to fight them off .

title: Erngar Narrowlea
description: Erngar Narrowlea Gentle Father Erngar Narrowlea was a priest of Lathander in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Erqynak
description: Erqynak Erqynak was an elderly ixzan who was a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR . Activities . Erqynak ' s primary concern was with spell research .

title: Errde Blackskull
description: Errde Blackskull Errde Blackskull was the duergar commander of the Stone Guard s in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Errde ' s main concern was the growing corruption in the city ' s governments .

title: Errtu
description: Errtu Errtu was a powerful balor . He commanded his own layer of the Abyss and the tanar ' ri inhabitants that resided there . Description .

title: Eruption
description: Eruption Eruption was a powerful conjuration and flame spell that was used by high - ranking members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell had two very different effects depending on where it was cast .

title: Erve
description: Erve Erve was a priest of Jergal in the Moonsea . History . During the Rage of Demons , Erve went to an abandoned temple of Waukeen to take an inventory of the dead buried in the church ' s graveyard and crypt .

title: Eryndlyn
description: Eryndlyn Eryndlyn was a drow city of more than sixty thousand in the Upper Underdark . Geography . Eryndlyn was located in caves beneath the High Moor in the Upperdark .

title: Esalor Harumaar
description: Esalor Harumaar Esalor Harumaar was the field agent of the Moonstars for Cormanthyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Esalor was a half - elf ranger of wild elf descent from Semberholme .

title: Esarhaddon
description: Esarhaddon Esarhaddon was the youngest of the leaders of the Enclave in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Esarhaddon planned to transform the Enclave into a political entity and attempt the conquest of the land .

title: Esbresh
description: Esbresh Esbresh was a settlement near the Utter East and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn , lying on the shore of the Great Sea . There was a certain slaving ring based out of Luskan in far northwest Faerûn , fronted by one Inther Blackfeather , that reached all the way to Esbresh and Kelazzan . Appendix .

title: Escalant
description: Escalant Escalant was a coastal city in Thay , in East Faerûn . As of 1357 DR , the city was independent of Thayan rule , but had been under Thayan control in the past . It was situated on the mouth of the River Lapendrar .

title: Esclarotta
description: Esclarotta Esclarotta was a cloud giant and the deceased wife of Blagothkus . Personality . Esclarotta greatly disliked all those cultists , dragon s , and kobold s inside her castle , but love her husband too much to act .

title: Escobert
description: Escobert Escobert the Red was a shield dwarf and the castellan of keep of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personailty . As master of the keep , Escobert knew all about the city ' s defenses and tunnels and sally port under it .

title: Eseldra Yeth
description: Eseldra Yeth Eseldra Yethwas a Red Wizard and the tharchion of Lapendrar from around the Year of the Emerald Ermine , 1387 DR , until the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Eseldra was a vampire and a follower of Szass Tam that was appointed tharchion of Lapendrar " circa " 1387 DR and remained in that position until the Tyranny of Dragons a century later .

title: Esh Alakar
description: Esh Alakar Esh Alakar was a site of ruins on the Pasocada River , in Long Canyon , Maztica . Nearby was the Bridge of the Ancients . Reputation .

title: Esham - Ana
description: Esham - Ana Esham - Ana was a dragonborn of Abeir , and the founder of Clan Yrjixtilex . History . Esham - Ana was a slave of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal .

title: Eshebala
description: Eshebala Eshebala is the Foxwoman deity of vanity , charm , greed and cunning . Her symbol is a female fox . Description Eshebala appears as a foxwoman , a shapely fur covered female with a fox ' s head or as a young elf maiden .

title: Eshowe
description: Eshowe The Eshowe were a Chult an tribe that was nearly extinct by 1370 DR . History . The Eshowe were one of the tribes that couatl s led from the Dark Continent to meet the god Ubtao on the Peaks of Flame in −2809 DR .

title: Eshpurta
description: Eshpurta Eshpurta , the " Shield City " of Amn , was a bustling military trade town in eastern Amn . Before the Sothillisian War in 1370 DR , Eshpurta contained about 70 , 000 townsfolk with another 10 , 000 in the surrounding ranches and farms . Additionally , there were 25 , 000 Amnian troops garrisoned in the city , bringing the approximate population to 105 , 000 .

title: Esklindrar Iol
description: Esklindrar Iol Esklindrar Iol was a sharp - tongued sage whose knowledge and memory of human lore along the Sword Coast surpassed that of anyone outside of Candlekeep . Description . Esklindrar had a white beard and appeared old , feeble , and a bit unsteady on his feet .

title: Eskorn
description: Eskorn Eskorn , also known as the Wild Dragon Realm , was a human kingdom located in eastern Returned Abeir . Background . The realm was known as the Wild Dragon Realm not for its draconic past but for the Wilddragons , one of its former ruling families .

title: Eskornamundyr
description: Eskornamundyr Eskornamundyr was the dragon emperor of the realm of Eskorn , Laerakond , in the world of Abeir . History . Eskornamundyr was killed by rebel forces led by the legendary hero Aunglass Roaryl centuries before the Spellplague happened .

title: Eskrel Starbridge
description: Eskrel Starbridge Eskrel Starbridge was a highknight of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , during the Council of the Dragon Eskrel was busy with a secret mission out of Suzail .

title: Esmelflow
description: Esmelflow The Esmelflow was a collective term for a number of rivers in the northeast of Amn . Description . All of the rivers and streams within the Esmelflow ultimately fed Lake Esmel and were located north of that lake and the Amstel River , flowing south from the Ridge of the Cloud Peaks , the Snakewood , and the Qadim Hills of the Troll Mountains .

title: Esmeltaran
description: Esmeltaran Esmeltaran was a halfling - dominated city in eastern Amn and lay to the northwest near Lake Esmel . The River Esmel , along with the lake , were both named after this city . Few halflings lived west of Esmeltaran , preferring to live in segregation in this city or in Riatavin , because these settlements were near the lost halfling realm of Meiritin .

title: Espar
description: Espar Espar was a hamlet in Cormyr , located north of Waymoot . As of 1368 DR , it consisted of about 120 stone buildings . It was ruled at that time by Lord Hezom .

title: Esparin
description: Esparin Esparin was a kingdom until it was annexed into Cormyr in 1162 DR after the wedding of Queen Enchara and Cormyr ' s crown prince , Palaghard . Geography . The kingdom occupied most of the Stonelands .

title: Essafah al - Jamila
description: Essafah al - Jamila Essafah al - Jamila was a sha ' ir and shopkeeper who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Essahah ' s shop , called Items for the Immortals , catered to genie s and other sha ' irs .

title: Essafah al - Qadibi
description: Essafah al - Qadibi Essafah al - Qadibi was a sorcerer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Essafah ' s vanity was only matched by his cowardice .

title: Essembra
description: Essembra Before it was abandoned in 1422 DR , Essembra was the largest town and centre of trade in Battledale . History . Essembra was settled when the Ordulin - Hillsfar road was cut through the Elven Court .

title: Essembramaerytha
description: Essembramaerytha Essembramaerytha was a song dragon who was known to non - dragon s as the legendary adventuress Essembra , for whom the town in Battledale was named . Description . In her human form , Essembra had red eyes and red hair .

title: Essylliss
description: Essylliss Essylliss was a demigod of the lizardfolk with dominion over their race , but he was nearly forgotten by them . Essylliss was considered an aspect of the World Serpent . History .

title: Estagund
description: Estagund Estagund was , alongside Durpar and Var the Golden , a part of the Shining Lands . As with all the Shining Lands , it was largely centered around trading . History .

title: Estanil
description: Estanil Estanil was a small burg located in northern Semphar on the banks of the River Estan near the Shalhoond forest . Description . The town of Estanil was considered a rarity in Semphar , for the fact that its buildings were made mostly out of wood , a rare resource in that land .

title: Estelar Sunweaver
description: Estelar Sunweaver Estelar Sunweaver was an elf suprematist in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Estelar worked for the Serôs Aquatic elf tyrant Gantar Kraok , acting as one of his agents on the surface .

title: Estele Greymantle
description: Estele Greymantle Estele Greymantle was a human woman and a priestess of Eldath . She was a noble lady in the village of Highbank Forest in the Vast around 1370 DR . She was a retired adventurer and one of the wealthiest of the petty lords in the area .

title: Estellia Vizen
description: Estellia Vizen Estellia Vizen was a potter of Crack ' d Pots in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Estellia managed a clay laboratory , known to produce unattractive but very durable ceramics .

title: Estelner Ebonhawk
description: Estelner Ebonhawk Baron Estelner Ebonhawk was the head of Ebonhawk noble family of Cormyr in 1371 DR . He was young and unsure of him , and widely thought to be a dunderhead trying to look good to the Crown . He led a troop of lancers , but had no skill with the weapon himself .

title: Estemal Talltankard
description: Estemal Talltankard Estemal Talltankard was a paladin of Arvoreen who around 1359 DR founded the military order of Arvoreen ' s Marchers , composed mostly of halfling s and some gnome s , to defend Tethyr . Personality . Estemal had strong determination , which helped him keep the Purple Hills region safer than most other areas during the Tethyrian Interregnum .

title: Estember Orntalar
description: Estember Orntalar Estember Orntalar was a priest of Oghma of Domes of Reason temple in the city of Procampur in the Vast . " Circa " 1369 DR , Orntalar held the position of High Loremaster Librarian at the Domes , but was engaged in an aggressive power struggle with fellow priests to succeed the missing Patriarch , Cullen Kordamant , and become leader of the Orthodox Church of Oghma . Orntalar was apparently set to win this position .

title: Esvele Graycastle
description: Esvele Graycastle Esvele Greycastle was a human cleric of Shar and shadow adept . She was determined to fulfill her role as an exemplary worshiper of Shar . She was assigned to a secret temple in Urmlaspyr where she attempted to recruit new members to the church from the merchants of Sembia .

title: Esvena Dyrr
description: Esvena Dyrr Esvena Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1373 DR . Relationships . Esvena was the fourth daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr .

title: Eternal Crimson
description: Eternal Crimson The Eternal Crimson served as the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The army of the efreet had around 100 , 000 soliders .

title: Eternal Flame Pavilion
description: Eternal Flame Pavilion The Eternal Flame Pavilion was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Eternal Flame Pavilion was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Eternal Sun
description: Eternal Sun Eternal Sun was a plane of existence thought to be lost long ago but was found again after the Spellplague and became part of the World Axis cosmology model . It was the astral dominion of Amaunator , who dwelt in the Palace of the Four Suns with his exarch , Siamorphe . The Palace was surrounded by Waukeen ' s Marketplace Eternal .

title: Eth Junster
description: Eth Junster Eth Junster was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Eth was a young promising magelord .

title: Ethereal banishment
description: Ethereal banishment Ethereal banishment was an alteration spell that transported one creature to the Ethereal plane and kept it there for a limited time . It was often used on opponents , who had a chance to resist the magic . Components .

title: Ethereal barrier
description: Ethereal barrier Ethereal barrier was an abjuration spell that prevented encroachment by creatures moving through the Ethereal Plane . Effects . The wall ( s ) created by this spell were proof against creatures traveling through the Ethereal Plane by " phasing " , " dimension door " , " shadow walk " , or any other method of travel through the Border Ethereal adjacent to the plane of the caster ( usually the Prime Material Plane ) .

title: Ethereal marauder
description: Ethereal marauder An ethereal marauder was a predatory monster from the Ethereal Plane . Nilshai , sorcerers of that plane , were said to keep ethereal marauders as guardians . Description .

title: Ethereal plane
description: Ethereal plane The Ethereal plane was one of the planes of existence in various models of cosmology . Ethereal Plane in the Great Wheel Model . In the 1st and 2nd edition D & D , as explained by the Great Wheel cosmology model , the Ethereal plane existed adjacent to the Prime Material Plane and connected it to the Inner plane s ( the Elemental planes plus the Energy planes ) .

title: Ethereal stride
description: Ethereal stride Ethereal stride is a spell used by warlock s to enable them to fade out of the world for a split second , crossing into the Ethereal Plane or some equivalent thereof . When a warlock finishes the use of " ethereal stride " he or she finds themselves transplanted a distance of fifteen feet . The effects of the movement stick with the warlock a moment longer , however , making them slightly more difficult to attack due to their temporarily insubstantial nature .

title: Etherealness
description: Etherealness Etherealness was a transmutation spell made the caster travel to the Border ethereal . Effect . The older version of this spell functioned like ethereal jaunt except more targets could join the caster .

title: Ethoist
description: Ethoist Ethoists or Clerics of the Faith Ethical , were priests who primarily maintained the temples and mosques of Zakhara . They called for prayer , delivered sermons , and performed daily tasks required by their god . Requirements .

title: Ethur Anszim
description: Ethur Anszim Ambassador Ethur Anszim was the representative of the Red Wizards of Thay at their enclave within the city of Waterdeep . Personality . A witty yet unforgiving man , Ethur was often invited to the parties of Waterdhavian nobles who wish edto appear " daring " .

title: Etsi Hashoto
description: Etsi Hashoto Etsi Hashoto was an inhabitant of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Yusuke lived in the village of Esan in Fochu Peninsula and was a collector of butterflies .

title: Etsu - no - kami Makoto
description: Etsu - no - kami Makoto Etsu - no - kami Makoto was a spirit folk samurai adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Makoto was born in Miyama to the samurai Etsu - no - kami Yasutoki and the spirit lady of a great willow .

title: Ettercap
description: Ettercap An ettercap is one of a race of bestial spider - men aberration s located throughout Faerûn . Ettercaps are primitive , hunting Aberration s that have an affinity with spiders . Like spiders , they use webs as traps to capture prey , which is then injected with paralytic venom from the ettercap ’ s bite .

title: Ettin
description: Ettin Ettin were giant s with two heads that were capable of independent thought and can each control one arm for attacking . Abilities . Typically , an ettin fought with two weapons , such as a morningstar and javelin .

title: Euclase
description: Euclase Euclase was a rare precious stone found in the form of small crystals . Description . Euclase was easily cut into faceted gems and came in various colors ranging from colorless to pale yellow , vivid yellow , pale green , and blue .

title: Eudhis Bhamm
description: Eudhis Bhamm Eudhis Bhamm was a human male herbalist and the proprietor of Bhamm ' s Herbs in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . He had a surly disposition and was quick on the rejoinder . He was usually nervous and with good reason : he was a wizard in a land that had nearly outlawed wizardry .

title: Eulagad
description: Eulagad Eulagad the Maul was an innkeeper in Skullport . Personality . Eulagad lived in the past , remembering the times where he fought evil with his dead companions .

title: Euripanee Thundershield
description: Euripanee Thundershield Euripanee Thundershield was a female dwarf mercenary in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Euripanee left Citadel Adbar for a life as a mercenary .

title: Eusebius
description: Eusebius Eusebius was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Eusebius had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .

title: Evaelathil
description: Evaelathil Evaelathil is a Baneblade of Demron in the shape of a short sword , sized for small wielders and usable only by halfling s . It glows with a soft green light when drawn . In addition to the standard baneblade abilities , Evaelathil grants its wielder resistance to fire and allows him or her to use " charm person " and " locate creature " each once per day .

title: Evaine
description: Evaine Evaine was a wizard in Phlan . Relationships . Evaine was an acquaintance of Shal Desanea .

title: Evanara
description: Evanara House Evanara was an insular sun elf house . As of 1368 DR , it was led by the fighter - wizard Nylaathria Evanara . It was notable for producing war wizard s .

title: Evard ' s black tentacles
description: Evard ' s black tentacles Evard ' s black tentacles , or simply black tentacles , was a conjuration spell that conjured tentacles to grapple and restrain opponents . It was presumably developed by Evard . Effect .

title: Evelina Plaksina
description: Evelina Plaksina Evelina Plaksina was an earthsoul genasi and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , Evelina was part of the cell led by Yegor that pursued the dwarf Furgis Boltsmelter to take the elemental codex .

title: Evendur Highcastle
description: Evendur Highcastle Evendur Highcastle was an infamous pirate in the Sea of Fallen Stars who rose as an undead Chosen of Umberlee during the Second Sundering . History . Before his death , Evendur was a notorious pirate lord .

title: Evenhand
description: Evenhand Evenhand was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Evenhands contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .

title: Eveningstar
description: Eveningstar Eveningstar is a small unwalled farming town of about fifty buildings located roughly 30 miles west of Arabel , in Cormyr . Eveningstar is located where the High Road crosses the Starwater River , Geography . Eveningstar is a pastoral village surrounded by fields and orchards situated in an elbow of the Starwater River just north of the King ' s Forest in Cormyr .

title: Everard
description: Everard Everard was the head cleric of Tempus from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . Even within his temple , the war priest dressed in heavy armor , such as plate mail .

title: Everbright
description: Everbright Everbright was a quality that could be applied to metal armor or weapons . The technique was well known by the sun elves of Evermeet . It made the item incredibly shiny and untarnishable , immune to rust and corrosion .

title: Everburning oil
description: Everburning oil Everburning oil , also called Greek fire by knowledgable wizards , was a mixture of oil and other substances designed for use in combat . It was easy to ignite but difficult to extinguish , and had a tendency to stick to anything it hit . Use .

title: Everdusk Hall
description: Everdusk Hall Everdusk Hall , before being burnt to the ground , was one of the oldest and most revered temples within Silverymoon . Interior . The lower levels of this temple were decorated with many marble statues of the elven gods .

title: Evereska
description: Evereska Evereska ( " Eh - ver - Eh - ska " , elvish : " fortress home " ) was a fabled valley in the Western Heartlands , one of the last realms of the elves in the north . Founded in secret in - 8600 DR , Evereska became a haven for the remaining Fair Folk in Faerûn . Description .

title: Evereskan tomb guardian
description: Evereskan tomb guardian An Evereskan tomb guardian was a special prestige class for the elves of Evereska . Culture . To the elves of Evereska , nothing was more sacred than the bodies of the deceased and the countless tombs of great ancestors and heroes scattered around the region .

title: Everlasting
description: Everlasting The Everlasting , or the Brotherhood of the Everlasting , was perhaps the largest group of holy slayer s in Zakhara in 1367 DR . The symbol of the Everlasting was a golden scimitar . Activities .

title: Everlasting fire
description: Everlasting fire Everlasting fire was an arcane evocation spell that conjured an always - burning flame . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .

title: Everlund
description: Everlund Everlund ( formerly Besander ' s Blockhouse ) was a city of merchant traders and caravan teams and was one of the greatest supporters of the league of the Silver Marches . Located southeast of Silverymoon and situated on the north bank of the River Rauvin , Everlund was the second largest city in the Silver Marches and one of its most active mercantile communities . History .

title: Everlund Pass
description: Everlund Pass The Everlund Pass was the road from Everlund to Silverymoon , which crossed the eastern end of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The rough trail ran roughly on the eastern side of the River Rauvin , sometimes hundreds of feet above the river , and it snaked far away from the rushing waters into dangerous hills .

title: Evermead
description: Evermead Evermead was a liquor crafted by the elves of Evermeet . Outside of the elven homeland , it was only sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Evermeet
description: Evermeet Evermeet , sometimes known as the Green Isle , is the final destination for all non - drow Tel ' Quessir ( meaning elves and eladrin ) from Faerûn . As of 1368 DR it is under the reign of Amlaruil Moonflower , a moon elf and a widow of Zaor Moonflower , a moonblade wielder who was killed by a sun elf . She rules from its capital city of Leuthilspar , and is home to many prominent Tel ' Quessir houses , including the Durothil s .

title: Evermeet : Island of Elves
description: Evermeet : Island of Elves Evermeet : Island of Elves is a stand - alone novel by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The book is shaped as an elven history opera written by Danilo Thann .

title: Evermoor Way
description: Evermoor Way The Evermoor Way is the road from Triboar to Bridge Gate in Everlund , although " The Savage Frontier " states that it extends to Silverymoon . Everlund has taken on the responsibility of keeping the road clear of danger from Everlund to Calling Horns , however has been hard pressed to do so in recent times .

title: Evermoors
description: Evermoors The Evermoors , or Trollmoors , was a region of bog - pocketed hills , long rolling vistas , rocky ridges , and small peaks hiding deposits of valuable ore . It was located along the western edge of the Silver Marches . Geography .

title: Evernight
description: Evernight Evernight was the dismal echo of Neverwinter located in the Shadowfell . It was a city of the undead and those that trafficked with them — unhinged necromancer s , slave traders , and followers of dark deities . Description .

title: Evil
description: Evil In 4th edition , evil individuals were people who , using rules and order to give them power , took advantage of their position for personal gain , disregarding the well - being of others . They didn ' t go out of their way to cause harm , but didn ' t care if they did . They supported rigid caste structures and slavery , as long as it benefited them .

title: Evil eye
description: Evil eye The evil eye was a unique power present in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . It was widely believed that every genie had the innate ability to cause misfortune to befall another simply by looking at them in a distasteful manner .

title: Evlyn
description: Evlyn Evlyn was a Moonstone Mask employee in Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . If the Kalach - Cha and the companions entered the establishment , she would scold them if they did not spend any money at the establishment .

title: Evocation
description: Evocation The evocation school of magic included spells that manipulated energy or tapped an unseen source of power in order to produce a desired end . In effect , they created something out of nothing . Many of these spells produced spectacular effects , and evocation spells could deal large amounts of damage .

title: Exaction
description: Exaction Exaction was a divine evocation and alteration spell that summoned a planar being to strike a bargain for a service . Effects . Possible creatures that could be summoned from another plane of existence included devas , devil s , and demon s , but nothing as powerful as a demigod .

title: Exalted Mamluk Society
description: Exalted Mamluk Society The Exalted Mamluk Society , also known as the Exalted , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Exalted were bitter rivals with the Devoted , leading to frequent conflicts in the region of the Cities of the Pantheon .

title: Exarch
description: Exarch Exarchs are beings of extraordinary power . Exarchs are often called demigods ( but note that exarchs are not gods ( as in Demigod s ) of demipower status ( despite the name ) ) or heroes . Many are ascended mortal servants of greater gods , brought up from the world to serve as agents of their divine masters .

title: Exile
description: Exile Exile is the second book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Exorcessum
description: Exorcessum Exorcessum was a greatsword created by gods outside of Toril wielded by the deva Demascus . It had magic runes on each side which allowed Demascus to call magical abilities . The runes on one side were red and contained martial abilities while the runes on the other side were white and cast beneficial magic .

title: Expedition to Undermountain
description: Expedition to Undermountain Expedition to Undermountain is a combination sourcebook / campaign adventure for adventurer levels 1 - 10 . This is the D & D 3rd edition supplement for Undermountain . The book is split into an Introduction , briefly describing Halaster ' s death and a synopsis of the adventure , the first chapter , which briefly describes Undermountain , with maps of most levels and sublevels , chapters 2 - 5 , which are the campaign adventure , and an appendix of new creatures , such as the Eyeball Swarm , and new items , such as the Crown Adamant .

title: Expeditious retreat
description: Expeditious retreat Expeditious retreat was an evocation spell that made the caster faster . Effect . The caster became allot quicker being able to walk , run or shift doubly as fast as normal .

title: Exploit
description: Exploit An exploit was a unique ability granted to a specific character class or role . Examples included exploits that allowed a fighter to better attack enemies or defend allies ; enabled a ranger to become preternaturally skillful and deadly with weapons ; gave a rogue an edge in strength , agility , or cunning ; and granted a warlord the ability to lead and inspire .

title: Explosive pyre
description: Explosive pyre Explosive pyre is a conjuration spell used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When a sorcerer casts " explosive pyre " he or she places a storm of flames around a target of his or her choice within fifty feet of themselves . Any creature caught within this small storm , roughly five feet in diameter , during the next moment is scorched by its flames .

title: Explosive runes
description: Explosive runes Explosive runes was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that booby - trapped written or drawn information to prevent unauthorized viewing . Effects . This spell could be applied to written information in the form of a map , book , scroll , or a similar item containing written information .

title: Exterminators
description: Exterminators Founded by a wind mage named Akil Festir , the Exterminators were an adventuring company whose main purpose was to rid Huzuz of elemental vermin , particularly the warehouses . Organization . Rather lax by most adventuring company standards , the Exterminators did not have strict requirements for membership .

title: Extinction
description: Extinction Extinction by Lisa Smedman is the fourth book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary .
