The group of drow adventurers — Quenthel Baenre , Pharaun Mizzrym , Jeggred Baenre , Valas Hune , Ryld Argith , Halisstra Melarn , and Danifae Yauntyrr - - continue to seek answers about the Silence of Lolth after fleeing House Jaelre .

title: Extract water elemental
description: Extract water elemental Extract water elemental is a brutal and efficient way to summon an ally in a waterless region . History . The mage Akhlaur used a much stronger version of this spell when he was brought back to Faerûn by the elf Kiva .

title: Eye agate
description: Eye agate Eye agate was a special form of banded agate found in the Realms . Description . Eye agate was similar to banded agate but with the layers within the stone arranged in rings .

title: Eye of Blazing Rorn
description: Eye of Blazing Rorn The Eye of Blazing Rorn was a powerful dragon artifact . Description . The Eye of Blazing Rorn was literally the eye of the primordial Rorn .

title: Eye of Horus - Re
description: Eye of Horus - Re The Eye of Horus - Re was a special class of cleric s faithful to the chief deity of the Mulhorandi pantheon , Horus - Re . Among their ranks were those who crusaded against servants of Set and their undead minions . Unlike other organizations of Mulhorand , they were not tied to the pharaoh and followed their own hierarchical structure .

title: Eye of Justice
description: Eye of Justice The Eye of Justice was a religious sect that believed in the Heresy of the Threefold God , a belief that held the gods Torm , Helm and Tyr were one and the same . Although the church was regarded as a heresy by Torm ' s followers , Torm apparently granted power to some of its members . The order was governed by the Council of Vigilent Seers and had few female members .

title: Eye of the All - Father
description: Eye of the All - Father The Eye of the All - Father was a secret underground temple to Annam built in the time of ancient Ostoria in the Spine of the World . Inside , an oracle may have once made predictions . Only a handful of giants — among them Harshnag — knew the location .

title: Eye of the Tempest
description: Eye of the Tempest Eye of the Tempest is a 5 edition adventure module set in the Forgotten Realms . It is part of the Elemental Evil series of adventures published for the D & D Adventurers League . It was authored by Pieter Sleijpen and designed for characters of levels 5 – 10 .

title: Eye of the deep
description: Eye of the deep The eye of the deep was a water - dwelling relative of the beholder , covered with reddish lobster - like chitin . The eye of the deep possessed two antennae with eyes on their ends and two arms ending in lobster - like claws ; these features replaced the usual beholder eyestalks .

title: Eye of truth
description: Eye of truth The eye of truth was a special ritual used by sha ' ir s to enhance their gen ' s vision . Preparation . The sha ' ir needed to provide a pair of rubies worth at least 300 dinar s each .

title: Eyebite
description: Eyebite Eyebite was a spell that made the caster gaze cause negative effects . Effect . In most of the versions of the spell it was quite powerful , needing a caster of skill to be cast .

title: Eyes of Silvanus
description: Eyes of Silvanus The Eyes of Silvanus were two islands , Ilighôn and Wavecrest , near to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach on the Sea of Fallen Stars . The islands were formed from mountains when Jhaamdath fell . After the Spellplague hit and the waters from the Sea of Fallen Stars receded , the islands no longer exist .

title: Eyes of the eagle
description: Eyes of the eagle The eyes of the eagle was a special ritual that allowed sha ' ir s to enhance the acuity of their gen ' s vision . Preparation . A pair of rubies worth at least 300 dinar s each was needed to perform the eyes of the eagle .

title: Eyes of the spider
description: Eyes of the spider The eyes of the spider was a device that fitted over an individual ' s head and covered the wearer ' s left eye . It granted the wearer great visual prowess and protection . Description .

title: Eyon
description: Eyon Eyon was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Eyon was a callous mercenary who joined the Cult of the Crushing Wave .

title: Eytan Bernstein
description: Eytan Bernstein Eytan Bernstein hails from exotic Long Island and spends his days writing and editing projects for numerous game companies . In addition to his work on Dragons of Faerûn , the Magic Item Compendium , and numerous other projects , Eytan serves as a partner and PR & Marketing Manager for Silven Publishing . Eytan enjoys hunting for gems and minerals in rock quarries , studying religion and theology , composing music , and playing with his many pets .

title: Ezira Gloomdelve
description: Ezira Gloomdelve Ezira Gloomdelve was a vampire and a top advisor to the mercenary lord Dalagor in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Ezira was once an adventurer until she was bitten by a vampire while relaxing in Skullport .

title: Ezril Treewarder
description: Ezril Treewarder Ezril Treewarder was a druid of Elmwood during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , a Zhentarim contingent conquered Elmwood and Ezril lodged a number of townspeople in the sacred grove .

title: Fabada
description: Fabada Fabada , which lay along the northern border of the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams , was one of the most durable communities of Zakhara ' s High Desert . Inhabitants . The settlement of Fabada comprised members from three tribes : the al - Shazzi , al - Waughiwan , and al - Zab .

title: Fabricate
description: Fabricate Fabricate ( originally called Aksa ' s contrivance ) was a transmutation spell that transformed raw materials into finished items or forms . Effect . With this spell the caster would use a amount of material equal to the resulted product within a set amount of space .

title: Faceless Guard
description: Faceless Guard The Faceless Guards were the guardians of the Gate of Heaven within the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Activities . The elite yak - folk warriors of the Faceless Guard were tasked with protecting the Gate of Heaven , the provincial heart of the Empire that housed the capital city of Nathong as well as the Emperor of the Lotus Throne and his court .

title: Fadime Zatar
description: Fadime Zatar Fadime Zatar was a former Red Wizard in Neverwinter . History . Fadime was a red wizard in Thay until she decided to defect and join the forces of Neverwinter ; she acted in all means to undermine the lich zulkir s .

title: Fadiya al - Farid
description: Fadiya al - Farid Fadiya al - Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Fadiya held grudges for years at a time , but she was pleasant to anyone from whom she required help .

title: Faelfaril ' s Inn
description: Faelfaril ' s Inn Faelfaril ' s Inn was one of the oldest and least suitable houses in Bryn Shander . Location . This inn was located in Bryn Shander near the southwest gate near the stables .

title: Faerang ' s Doom
description: Faerang ' s Doom Faerang ' s Doom was a peak located in the Rauvin Mountains . Description . The peak had a shape similar to a knife and a waterfall flowed through it .

title: Faerie dragon
description: Faerie dragon A faerie dragon is a mischievous branch of the dragon family tree . Physical description . Faerie dragons are extremely small in comparison to their large metallic dragon , or chromatic dragon cousins , only about one to two feet long .

title: Faerie fire
description: Faerie fire Faerie fire was a evocation or alteration spell that outlined a target . Effect . " Faerie fire " caused a glowing lining around targets in a selected area .

title: Faerie pool
description: Faerie pool The Faerie pools were small pools of water tainted with an odd mineral in the rocks , located across the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Description . The pools produced gases that cause an " air frost " ( snowflakes ) that , if inhaled , caused brief but vivid hallucinations .

title: Faerinaal ' s hymn
description: Faerinaal ' s hymn Named for the consort to the eladrin queen Morwel , Faerinaal ' s hymn is an enchantment spell that prevents attacks of opportunity by evil creatures . Effect . This gentle hymn clouds the minds of evil creatures , causing targets of the spell to forgo attacks of opportunity for the spell ' s duration .

title: Faerlthann Obarskyr
description: Faerlthann Obarskyr King Faerlthann Obarskyr was the first king of Cormyr . Appearance . Faerlthann was tall with tanned skin .

title: Faerntarn
description: Faerntarn The Royal Palace of Faertarn ( formerly Gallowglass Hall ) was the royal palace of Tethyr after the Reclamation Wars . Location . The palace was built upon the Ithal Crag within the Royal Quarter of the capital city of Darromar .

title: Faersynd Floshin
description: Faersynd Floshin Faersynd Floshin was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Faersynd ' s consort was Talya Floshin .

title: Faervian
description: Faervian Faervian is a Baneblade of Demron , the fourth in that series , and is in the shape of a longsword . It was originally created for the Spell - Major of Cormanthyr as a replacement for the lost " Ary ' Faern ' Kerym " elfblade ( the Artblade ) . It is known to humans as " Battlebane " , and more colloquially as the " Sword of Art " or the " Mage ' s Blade " .

title: Faeryl Zauvirr
description: Faeryl Zauvirr Faeryl Zauvirr was the Ched Nasad an ambassador to Menzoberranzan from ca . 1358 DR to 1372 DR . Description .

title: Faerzress
description: Faerzress Faerzress was a magic al radiation only found in the Underdark . It was said to be a remnant of the forces that shaped the Underdark terrain and it interfered with the casting of some spells . Faerzress and drow culture .

title: Faerûn
description: Faerûn Faerûn was a major continent on the planet of Toril . Geography . The continent included terrain that was as varied as any other .

title: Faerûnian languages
description: Faerûnian languages The Faerûnian languages were a family of languages spoken by the majority of human s on the continent of Faerûn . The Faerûnian language family encompassed roughly 50 distinct human languages , including Common . Language Groups .

title: Fagara
description: Fagara Fagara was a spice from T ' u Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Fahhas
description: Fahhas Fahhas was a city that lay between I ' tiraf and Hilm , where Al - Naqus River flowed into the Golden Gulf , in Zakhara . It was one of Cities of the Pantheon . Though blessed with fertile grazing areas and fruit orchards around it , and rich clays for pottery in its river valley , the city was characterized by the brooding mood of its ruler and citizens .

title: Failed Shadow Gate
description: Failed Shadow Gate A failed Shadow Gate was the result when an attempt to create a gate leading to the Plane of Shadow failed in some way . Rather than take a being to that plane , it risked subsuming their flesh with shadow , either killing them or transforming them into a dark creature . Effect .

title: Fairin Icemantle
description: Fairin Icemantle Fairin Icemantle was a male sage of the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Fairin was the author of the " Treatise Against Blood - Metal " , in which he expressed his reservations about orcslayer blades whose steel was poisonous to orc s . He feared that they would lead to the development of other alloys toxic to many races , and spread death and destruction .

title: Faith of the Nine Travelers
description: Faith of the Nine Travelers The Faith of the Nine Travelers , or simply " the Nine Travelers " , was a faith common in Shou Lung and Wa in Kara - Tur . Dogma . The Faith of the Nine Travelers was less a faith or religion and more a set of customs and a philosophy .

title: Faithful Mamluk Society
description: Faithful Mamluk Society The Faithful Mamluk Society , also known as the Faithful , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Faithful represented one of the more powerful mamluk societies in Qudra .

title: Faithless
description: Faithless The Faithless are mortals who do not have a divine patron . This could be because the mortal never worshiped a deity ( or rejected outright the worship of any deity ) , the mortal ' s divine patron has died , or that their divine patron rejected them for whatever reason . A soul who does worship a deity but did not sufficiently uphold their patron ' s dogma is instead judged False .

title: Falchion
description: Falchion A Falchion is a large , single - edged , two - handed sword . Description . The falchion looks much like a big scimitar with a wide blade curved toward the tip .

title: Falcon
description: Falcon Falcons were small birds of prey , often used in hunting . Reputation . Falcons were a favored animal of the Mulhorandi god Anhur and the [ [ halfling ] god [ [ Arvoreen ] ] .

title: Falcon ' s Wings
description: Falcon ' s Wings The Falcon ' s Wings was a ritual used by sha ' ir s to grant the permanent ability of flight to their gen s . Preparation . The sha ' ir needed to collect the feathers of a falcon taken directly from the falcon ' s aerie .

title: Falconsrise
description: Falconsrise Falconsrise was an island that lay west of the Singing Rocks in the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Calimshan in west Faerûn . Geography & Description . Falconsrise emerged alone from the sea , and it was too small to appear on many charts of the area .

title: Falconstar Wayshipping
description: Falconstar Wayshipping Falconstar Wayshipping was a business located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It rented out storage space for cargo . It was owned by Mhaernos Falconstar .

title: Faldorn
description: Faldorn Faldorn is a member of the Shadow Druids , a militant sect of druid s that believes in the violent struggle of nature against man . She disagrees vehemently with Jaheira and her mainstream druidic views of man co - existing peacefully alongside nature . However , despite her militant beliefs ( and extremely aggressive character portrait ) , Faldorn ' s speech and behavior in " Baldur ' s Gate " is surprisingly mellow and laid - back .

title: Falgor
description: Falgor Falgor was a male human living in Port Llast on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Falgor was the innkeeper of Alliance Arms Inn in Port Llast .

title: Fall of Frostsilver
description: Fall of Frostsilver Fall of Frostsilver was an RPGA module set in Icewind Dale that was released at the 2007 Worldwide Dungeons & Dragons Game Day . It was written by Forgotten Realms Continuity Editor Matthew Sernett in honor of the 20th anniversary of the creation of Drizzt Do ' Urden . Summary .

title: Fall of Zhentil Keep
description: Fall of Zhentil Keep The Fall of Zhentil Keep started on Nightal 27 1368 DR and lasted until Kythorn 13 1369 DR . Background . The attack was but one part of Cyric ' s plan to consolidate and increase his divine powers since the rules of divinity had been changed by Ao in the wake of the Time of Troubles .

title: Fallen Giant Rift
description: Fallen Giant Rift Fallen Giant Rift was a crack in the earth within the Plain of Standing Stones in Anauroch . Description . Fallen Giant Rift was located east of the Tagorlar mountain range within the Plain of Standing Stones .

title: Fallen Lands
description: Fallen Lands The Fallen Lands are an rocky , barren area just west of Anauroch . This is the present - day ( circa 1479 DR ) name for the strip of habitable land west of Anauroch , stretching between the Far Forest ( now overrun by evil things out of Hellgate Keep ) and Weathercote Wood . The Fallen Lands are now home only to monsters , it seems , although rumors persist of powerful mages inhabiting the southern end , and hurling back the evil creatures of Hellgate Keep with their art .

title: Fallentree
description: Fallentree Fallentree was a village in the Vast , lying where Feldar ' s Trail from Dark Hollow met Blaern ' s Trail between Sendrin and Dead Tree Hollow . History . The area was once plagued by bandits , who lurked in the pine woods and ambushed travelers on the road .

title: Falrinn Greathorm
description: Falrinn Greathorm Fulrinn Greathorm was a strange gnome smuggler incidentally involved in the Second Sundering in 1486 DR . History . In 1486 DR , Falrinn transported the reaver Anton Marivaldi out of the city of Westgate in order to meet with the boy Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .

title: False life
description: False life False life was a necromancy spell that granted the caster a temporary boost of health above his or her normal healthy state . Effects . This spell only affected the caster and lasted a number of hours per the power of the caster , or until the extra health was lost ( due to injury or disease , for example ) , whichever came first .

title: False vision
description: False vision False vision is an illusion spell that fools scrying with an illusion . Effect . You and all you desire within the area of the spell become undetectable to scrying ( whether by spell or magic device ) .

title: Falstaff
description: Falstaff Falstaff was one of the many Doomguide s who were part of the contingent in Neverdeath Graveyard in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . He and some of his fellows were lost in the graveyard after an assault by undead . Falstaff was killed when pierced by arrows .

title: Faltyn Gos
description: Faltyn Gos Zor Faltyn Gos was a noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Faltyn indulged in self - appreciation , always reminding everyone of his contributions to the city .

title: Falwan Underbough
description: Falwan Underbough Falwan Underbough was a community leader in Cormanthor . History . Falwan was a famous baker in Hillsfar , known among nobility for his " half cakes " until the reintroduction of the First Great Law of Humanity by Torin Nomerthal forced Falwan and his family to escape the city .

title: Falzo Hawklin
description: Falzo Hawklin Lord Falzo Hawklin was a noble of the Hawklin family and a commander among Alusair Obarskyr ' s Blades . Lord Falzo Hawklin resided in a modestly sized manor on the northern side of Suzail ' s great Promenade with extensive gardens . Description .

title: Familiar
description: Familiar A familiar is a normal creature that has been summoned to service by a sorcerer or wizard , after which it becomes a magical beast and gains new powers . They are magically linked to their masters , in some sense , practically existing as one being . All familiars have special abilities along with granting special abilities to its master .

title: Fandour
description: Fandour Fandour is an entity of unkown nature imprisoned in a pocket plane . The reasons for his imprionment are unclear , although the Githyanki may have been responsible . A Gith on a merchant vessel that was sunk by Moonsea pirates in 1460 DR possessed a bracelet known as the Rythanko that was tied to Fandour .

title: Fane of Lolth
description: Fane of Lolth The Fane of Lolth was a temple dedicated to Lolth in Szith Morcane that was open for the denizens of the settlement to come and worship . Location . Located above the seat of House Morcane in Szith Morcane , the Fane of Lolth was reached only by ascending one of its eight spiderweb ladders .

title: Fane of Quarvelsharess
description: Fane of Quarvelsharess The Fane of Quarvelsharess , also called the Fane of the Goddess , was a public cathedral dedicated to Lolth in the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan . History . The Fane of the Quarvelsharess was a " gift " of House Baenre , providing , for the first time , a place for the general public to worship .

title: Fane of Shadows
description: Fane of Shadows The Fane of Shadows was a that journeyed the worlds on the currents of the secret Weave . The place had many names in many tongues , and was also known as the Temple of Night or the Umbral Shrine . Location .

title: Fane of the Eye
description: Fane of the Eye The Fane of the Eye was a large cavern complex deep under the Dessarin Valley . It was centered around a black ziggurat temple built by renegade drow and dedicated to the Elder Elemental Eye . The cult that built it eventually died out or were hunted by drow loyal to Lolth .

title: Fanedown
description: Fanedown Fanedown was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . Fanedown was known for its many minstrels , jesters , and because , as of 1479 DR , was one of the few places in Returned Abeir where books were published .

title: Faneuil Hardisty
description: Faneuil Hardisty Baron Faneuil Hardisty was a warrior of Tethyr who attempted to bring an end to the anarchy within the region by any means available to him . Background . Along with Zaranda Star , Faneuil was a captain in King Azoun ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde .

title: Fang
description: Fang The Fang was a large promontory extending north into the Sea of Fallen Stars from Aglarond . Geography . It was a mostly barren and rocky piece of land that jutted out from the northern coast of Aglarond , marking the beginning of the Sea of Dlurg .

title: Fang dragon
description: Fang dragon A fang dragon , also known as a gray dragon , was type of dragon found in Faerûn . Description . Fang dragons were poor flyers , with small muscled wings .

title: Fang in the Forest
description: Fang in the Forest The Fang in the Forest , formerly known as Daerlo ' s Rest , was a conical - shaped peak and the southernmost of the Earthfast Mountains . It was thought to have been an extinct volcano and was said to be partially hollow . Inhabitants .

title: Fang scarab
description: Fang scarab A fang scarab was a medallion that gave any spider that wore it the ability to hear the dark whispers of Lolth and guide it in battle . However , any non - spider who wore the medallion found it would fuse to their neck and slowly transform them into a half - spider creature . Description .

title: Fangjaws Hold
description: Fangjaws Hold Fangjaws Hold was a collection of palisade stone lodges in Thar . Inhabitants . The hold was home to the Skullsmashers ogre tribe lead by Zar - Umak .

title: Fangs of Night shuriken
description: Fangs of Night shuriken The Fangs of Night ninja clan of the city of Ojy - do in Koryo were known for a set of five magical stone shuriken , each carried by the five top warriors of the clan . Description . Strangely , these shuriken were carved of stone .

title: Fangs of retribution
description: Fangs of retribution Fangs of retribution was a divine evocation spell that dealt back all the injuries the caster had suffered . Effect . The spell created the ghostly jaws and fangs of a viper in front of the caster ' s face , who could then direct it to fly at and bite a foe of their choice .

title: Fangshields
description: Fangshields The Fangshields are a group of talking animals and good - aligned monsters who operate all over the wild areas of Faerûn . They seek out and stop evil monsters and organizations from carrying out their plans . Until very recently the group was not organized at all , simply a few monsters doing good deeds whenever they could but recently there has been an increase in the number of worshipers of Lurue and Nobanion , whom most of the group ' s members consider their patron deities .

title: Fankiang
description: Fankiang The Fankiang were a tribe of nomadic human s living on the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . Territory . The Fankiang lived in the eastern regions of the Endless Waste .

title: Fansa Windblossom
description: Fansa Windblossom Fansa Windblossom was one of the four Cloakmasters of Eshpurta for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Fansa was abandoned by her elven mother and grew up with a pair of married rangers .

title: Fantastic machine
description: Fantastic machine Fantastic machine is an illusion spell that creates an illusory and very noisy mechanical contraption . It is solely available to cleric s who worship deities of the craft or gnome domain s . Effect .

title: Fanya bint Parigar
description: Fanya bint Parigar Fanya bint Parigar was in charge of the Grand University of Huzuz located in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Activities . Fanya was a priest of Zann .

title: Far Anchor
description: Far Anchor Far Anchor was a large inn on the north side of Far Rider Street in Scornubel . It was built in around 1365 DR by a retired sea captain and its name referred to the distance by river barge to the Sword Coast . Description .

title: Far Forest
description: Far Forest The Far Forest was one of a group of three forests named the Triangle of Trees . Description . The Far Forest was full of small lakes , some of which had become stinking marshes infested by will - o ' - wisp s and a few chuul .

title: Far Hills
description: Far Hills The Far Hills were a group of high landrises located in the Western Heartlands . Geography . The area was a region of rocky hills , hidden valleys and thick strands of trees .

title: Far Outpost
description: Far Outpost The Far Outpost was a large village and trading hub found on the very tip of the entrance to the Bay of Dancing Dolphins in Dambrath . Activities . The garrison of the Far Outpost was charged with defending the Bay of Dancing Dolphins from any attackers .

title: Far Payit
description: Far Payit The Far Payit Lands were a heavily forested jungle region of Maztica , occupying the peninsula east of the Sea of Azul . The region consisted of some arable land , disease - ridden swamps , and mountain crests that jutted just above the treetops . Otherwise , most of Far Payit was made up of vast miles of steaming , leaf - shrouded jungle in semi - darkness .

title: Far Quey
description: Far Quey The Far Quey were a martial tribe of Nar found in Narfell who were renowned for their toughness . There were 2 , 300 Far Quey in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Far Realm
description: Far Realm The Far Realm was a plane of madness situated very far from the planes of the standard cosmology . This maddening realm was feared for its power to twist unfortunate visitors into gruesome monsters , and it was from here that aberration s came . According to Malyanna , a servant of the Abolethic Sovereignty , all cosmologies are threatened by the same Far Realm .

title: Farad al - Meisal
description: Farad al - Meisal Farad al - Meisal was a janni inhabiting the Lost City of Ubar within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Farad served as Vizier to the Amir of Ubar .

title: Fargas Rumblefoot
description: Fargas Rumblefoot Fargas Rumblefoot was a lightfoot halfling adventurer in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . History . The halfling went to the Underdark with his adventuring party in search of the Lost Tombs of Khaem , but they were attacked by mad gnoll s .

title: Farid al - Nisr
description: Farid al - Nisr Farid al - Nisr was a Harper wizard in 1372 DR . History . Around 1369 DR , Farid was sent to New Waterdeep in Maztica by High Harper Khelben Arunsun together with his Harper fiancee Lady Syllia Adarbrent and fellow Harper Orist Moonbow .

title: Faridah bint Halah
description: Faridah bint Halah Faridah bint Halah was a person of note in Hawa . Description . She was tall and trim and had deep brown eyes that matched her sun - streaked brown hair .

title: Farideh
description: Farideh Farideh ( pronounced " far - ee - duh " ) was a warlock who accidentally made a pact with the cambion Lorcan . She is the adopted daughter of a dragonborn warrior named Mehen and the twin sister of Havilar . Description .

title: Faril Laheralson
description: Faril Laheralson Faril Laheralson was a male human fighter and ranger and the Oversword of a 100 - strong contingent of Purple Dragons based in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s and early 1370s DR . Activities . Laheralson cared deeply for his men but was concerned more with their morale and spirit than their discipline .

title: Farim
description: Farim Farim was a human mamluk who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Farim was a handsome man .

title: Farim al - Kanafi
description: Farim al - Kanafi Farim al - Kanafi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Farim complained about his job to anyone who would listen .

title: Faris
description: Faris A faris ( plural farisan ; farisa for females ) was a holy warrior of Zakhara . Requirements . Farisan had no special requirements , though the vast majority of these warriors were good - natured .

title: Farl
description: Farl Farl was a thief in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar and the best friend of the young Elminster Aumar . History . Farl was the illegitimate son of the Royal Mage Neldryn Hawklyn , leader of the magelord s , but for his poor birth he lived on the fringes of society and became a thief .

title: Farlong house
description: Farlong house The Farlong house was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Daeghun Farlong . Location .

title: Farmer ' s Cheese
description: Farmer ' s Cheese Farmer ' s Cheese was a simple cheese produced by small farming communities across the Realms . It was available for sale through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Farninger Seasilver
description: Farninger Seasilver Farninger Seasilver was the grand duke of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . Activities . When the Shadovar armies attacked Cormyr , Marsember was easily sacked .

title: Farnvik
description: Farnvik Farnvik the Venemous was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Farnvik was a cultist cleric of Tiamat .

title: Farouk Abd al - Bazan
description: Farouk Abd al - Bazan Farouk Abd al - Bazan was an efreeti and leader of the Sword Dancers sect of the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Personality . Contrary to most of his kind , Farouk was extremely charismatic .

title: Farrak
description: Farrak Farrak was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Farrak and Harrak did everything together .

title: Farsann
description: Farsann " Farsann " was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr . A farsann was responsible for managing the domestic staff of a noble house as well as for seeing to the planning and transpiring of feasts and ceremonies . A farsann was an inferior position to a sammafar .

title: Farsea Marshes
description: Farsea Marshes The Farsea Marshes was a wetland located in interior Faerûn west of Cormyr . Geography . The Farsea Marshes were located south of the Anauroch desert , west of the Stonelands , north of the Storm Horns mountain range , and east of Sunset Mountains .

title: Farsea Swamp
description: Farsea Swamp The Farsea Swamp was a wetland located on the western fringes of the nation of Cormyr . It formed when the Farsea Marshes joined with the Marsh of Tun some time after the Era of Upheaval . To the south was what remained of the dry Tunlands , east was the Storm Horns , and west were the Sunset Mountains and Far Hills .

title: Fasim Kaldur
description: Fasim Kaldur Fasim Kaldur was the leader of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . Activities . As the leader of the Riders of Blood , Fasim coordinated attacks upon caravans traveling between Halwa and Huzuz .

title: Fasruil
description: Fasruil Fasruil was the northernmost city in Luiren . It was famous for the tasty red rhubarb that was traded across all of Luiren and other countries of the Shining South . Geography .

title: Fastrin the Delver
description: Fastrin the Delver Fastrin the Delver was a powerful and good wizard and ruler of an ancient kingdom in the Sunrise Mountains in Thay . That kingdom came to existence not long after the fall of the Netheril . One day though , Fastrin went mad and started to slaughter his people .

title: Fated Depths
description: Fated Depths Fated Depths was a Fiendish Plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home of Blibdoolpoolp , Sekolah , and many other evil aquatic creatures . After the Spellplague , this plane disappeared , perhaps becoming part of the Elemental Chaos .

title: Fatell
description: Fatell Fatell was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster . History . Fatell was a lumber merchant and a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak and also a fire cultist in Mulmaster .

title: Father of Spiders
description: Father of Spiders " The Father of Spiders " was a deepspawn speculated to exist within Adhe Wood in the Vast . The sage Alither studied the legends of Adhe Wood and believed that the many mutant spider s there were produced by a diseased or magically altered deepspawn , which was named " the Father of Spiders " .

title: Fatik al - Amin
description: Fatik al - Amin Fatik al - Amin was the falconer of the Dark Wind Stables in Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Fatik was a quiet man who loved his work .

title: Fatima Kossi
description: Fatima Kossi Fatima Kossi was a halfling who lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fatima owned the Wanderer ' s Rest , catering to pilgrims visiting Huzuz .

title: Fatima bint Fayiz
description: Fatima bint Fayiz Fatima bint Fayiz was a tailor who lived Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fatima made clothes for people based on personal orders , as well as bulk orders for larger merchant houses .

title: Fatula Chupa
description: Fatula Chupa Fatula Chupa , or the City of Monasteries , was a city located in the mountains of what was once the Kingdom of Guge . Location . Located deep within the mountains on the Katakoro Plateau , this city was almost hidden to those who were not looking for it .

title: Faurael Blackhammer
description: Faurael Blackhammer Faurael Blackhammer was the lord protector of the town of Triboar . Description . The Lord Protector had gray hair and a number of old wounds that caused him pain but he still continued to train the town ' s militia .

title: Favor of Ilmater
description: Favor of Ilmater Favor of Ilmater was a divine spell that could have two possible benefits : one to grant a recipient peace of mind in the most terrible circumstances , and the other to sacrifice one ' s life - force to aid another . Although created by Ilmater , the Crying God , and used by his faithful , the spell spread to priests of other faiths who named it after their own gods , such as favor of Torm for followers of Torm . A generic version was known as favor of the martyr .

title: Favor of the goddess
description: Favor of the goddess Favor of the goddess was a divine magic spell available to druid s , mystic s , ranger s , and shaman s of Chauntea . At the choice of the caster , it doubled the yield of either mature plants or picked fruit and vegetables . It also removed any taint , disease , or poison from plants or produce unless it was naturally harmful to humans .

title: Favria
description: Favria Favria was the leader of the Ashmadai faction that remained loyal to Valindra Shadowmantle in Neverwinter circa 1480 DR . History . Favria born as a slave of a duergar clan that followed Asmodeus .

title: Fayaniz al - Nokar
description: Fayaniz al - Nokar Fayaniz al - Nokar was an employee of the House of Wo in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Fayaniz handled the daily workings of the , leaving Wo free to deal with food preparation .

title: Fayiz Mikali
description: Fayiz Mikali Fayiz Mikali was a crewman on the pirate vessel " Leap for the Throat " in 1367 DR . Activities . As a sea mage , Fayiz made good use of his powers while raiding merchant vessels sailing on Suq Bay .

title: Fayne
description: Fayne Fayne was a fey ' ri rogue who lived in Waterdeep . She was the product of a relationship between a Gold elf and a demoness . Fayne earned her coin through petty theft and by writing stories for a scandalous broadsheet known as the " Mocking Minstrel " .

title: Fear
description: Fear Fear was a necromancy spell that caused subjects to flee . Effect . An invisible cone of terror caused living creatures to become panicked .

title: Fear no elements
description: Fear no elements Fear no elements was a spell used by swordmage s very similar to , but weaker than , the " resistance " spell used by wizard s . When " fear no elements " was cast , it transmuted its caster ' s body , making him or her less vulnerable to either acidic , electricity , fiery , freezing , or sonic attacks , to a degree dependent upon the swordmage ' s natural vitality . " Fear no elements " was a difficult spell to cast for its relative ease in learning and could only be cast once per day .

title: Feast of the Moon
description: Feast of the Moon The Feast of the Moon , or Moonfest , was an annual festival in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring between the final night of Uktar and the first day of Nightal . It was the last great festival of the calendar year . The day traditionally marked the onset of winter .

title: Feast of the Moon ( module )
description: Feast of the Moon ( module ) It is the Feast of the Moon and Waterdeep is full of happy revelers . In a house at the end of Dretch Lane , the partygoers find themselves being killed off , but the deaths appear to be due to drowning .

title: Feather fall
description: Feather fall Feather fall was a spell that caused creatures or objects to fall slowly , like a feather . Effects . An early form of the spell had a duration and weight limit set by the experience and the power of the caster .

title: Feather turban
description: Feather turban Feather turbans were wondrously decorative magical apparel that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These turbans were woven with colorful peacock feathers .

title: Feathergale Knights
description: Feathergale Knights The Feathergale Knights , or Feathergale Society , was a sub - branch of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The Feathergale Knights usually acted as elite forces of the Howling Hatred cult or they surveyed the land around Feathergale Spire , guarding the entrance to the air cult ' s hidden temple .

title: Featherlung
description: Featherlung Featherlung was a respiratory disease . It was one of The Three Plagues of the more well - known contagious diseases of Faerûn . Effects .

title: Fedosia Peytir
description: Fedosia Peytir Fedosia Peytir was a noble in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Fedosia and her husband were working on establishing an advantageous business alliance for House Peytir .

title: Feeblemind
description: Feeblemind Feeblemind was a powerful enchantment spell that reduced a person ' s intelligence and personality to almost nothing . Effects . Arcane spellcaster s were quite vulnerable to the effects of this spell , which were hard to remove .

title: Feena Archwood
description: Feena Archwood Feena Archwood was a natural werewolf and cleric of Selûne . Appearance . She often chose to dress simply in light sandals , a blue skirt of homespun wool , and a blouse of linen dyed yellow with yarrow .

title: Feenoch
description: Feenoch Feenoch the Five - Fingered was an infamous rogue and adventurer of the 1350s DR . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Feenoch was a member of a band of adventurers that rediscovered the fabled Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm . However , they soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed .

title: Feign death
description: Feign death Feign death was a necromancy spell that allowed one creature touched by the caster to temporarily fall into a state indistinguishable from death . Effects . There was an arcane and a divine version of this spell and both had the effect of putting the recipient into a cataleptic state with rigid muscles and posture , unresponsive pupils , and lack of respiration and vital signs .

title: Feint of Honor
description: Feint of Honor A Feint of Honor was an ancient rite that allowed two dragon s ( or two parties of dragons each represented by a leading figure ) to settle a dispute without the need for mortal combat . All dragonkind followed the code that allows for this kind of ritual combat , regardless of their alignment . Description .

title: Feisal Abd al - Jari
description: Feisal Abd al - Jari Feisal Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Feisal rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan .

title: Felarathael
description: Felarathael Felarathael was a solar in the service of Corellon living in Arvandor . History . In 1379 DR , Felarathael and his fellow Lashrael went to the Fugue Plane under the orders of Corellon Larethian to retrieve the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann .

title: Feldar ' s Trail
description: Feldar ' s Trail Feldar ' s Trail , also called the Mosstree Trail , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the town of Mossbridges and the village of Fallentree . From west to east , it began at Mossbridges , ran through Highbank Forest and Dark Hollow , and ended at Fallentree . On the way , it linked with the Tantras Trail , the Hlintar Ride , and Blaern ' s Trail .

title: Feldon Strongbeard
description: Feldon Strongbeard Feldon Strongbeard was a dwarf who lived in the Protector ' s Enclave within Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He was a merchant member of the Harpers during the Tyranny of Dragons and helped equipped the adventurer s sent to fight the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Felgolos
description: Felgolos Felgolos was a very imprudent bronze dragon . Activities . Felgolos wandered all North Faerûn , always crashing into things , causing mayhem , and appearing in the midst of draconic battles , clashes of armies , archmages ' spell - duels , and other spectacular events .

title: Feliane
description: Feliane Feliane was an elven priestess of Eilistraee in Cormanthor and Velarswood . Description . Feliane was short , smaller than the average drow , and had dark brown hair .

title: Felix
description: Felix Felix was chief lieutenant in King Virdin ' s Damara n army when they fought the army of Zhengyi the Witch - King . It is widely believed that Felix betrayed Virdin by making him believe that a magic wand would enable the Damaran army to cross the Goliad River at the Ford of Goliad . Zhengyi was waiting for them to fall into this trap and defeated them .

title: Feljack
description: Feljack Feljack was an adventurer of the Vast . History . With treasure won from adventuring , Feljack built a mansion called Feljack ' s Hall in the Tweenwalls area of Kurth , sometime around 1347 DR .

title: Fell Pass
description: Fell Pass Fell Pass is a large rocky east - to - west vale in the Spine of the World where ghost s from an old battle roam . The Dreadmont and Skyfire mountains are to the north and south . The east of the pass is within sight of the River Surbrin .

title: Fellandar
description: Fellandar Fellandar was a once - human man magically transformed into a cat - like being , who sought the destruction of Waterdeep . History . The lover and partner of Aviss , Fellandar lived in Waterdeep in the mid – 10th century DR .

title: Fellows of Free Fate
description: Fellows of Free Fate This is a special fellowship of clergy within the church of Tymora who have dedicated themselves to countering the efforts of Beshaba , and especially of the Black Fingers , her assassins . Any clergy member may join who shows experience , dedication to the cause and is vouched for by a senior Fellow .

title: Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon
description: Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon The Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon is a now retired adventuring group that consisted of Caledan Caldorien , Kera , the mage Morhion , Ferret the thief , Tyveris and the halfling Estah . After the events involving the rule of the Zhentarim under Ravendas over Iriaebor the Harper Mari Al ' maren joined the ranks of the fellowship .

title: Fellowship of the Mithral Mountain
description: Fellowship of the Mithral Mountain The Fellowship of the Mithral Mountain was an order of priest s dedicated to the god Geb of the Mulhorandi pantheon . The majority of adventuring priests of Geb were members of this order . The fellows were charged with discovering the location of a legendary mountain supposed to contain large mithral deposits .

title: Fellowship of the Purple Staff
description: Fellowship of the Purple Staff The Fellowship of the Purple Staff is a group of like - minded priest s and other faithful who have united to settle the area of the Gulthmere Forest and the other lands north of Turmish into a more civilized land they call the " Holy Realm " . Striking from the forest and the western settlement of Cedarspoke the Fellowship has successfully sought out to slay evil creatures and generally bring settlements of civilization to an uncivilized land . Membership .

title: Felodar Aumar
description: Felodar Aumar Felodar Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar and the most successful after his brother Belaur Aumar . History . Felodar never loved his country or his family , his only interest was amassing wealth .

title: Felratha
description: Felratha Felratha was a priestess of Lliira in the Moonsea . Activities . Felratha lead a minstrel band , the Felratha ' s Merry Minstrels .

title: Felsul
description: Felsul Felsul was a type of deciduous tree that thrived in harsh conditions . Description . Felsul trees had flaky brown bark , from the hue of cinnamon to deep brown .

title: Feluna Moonstar
description: Feluna Moonstar Feluna Moonstar was a female human werecat cleric of Selûne in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Feluna had many of the traits of felines , like a strong sense of independence , nocturnal habits , and a hunter ' s mentality .

title: Felyndiira T ' orgh
description: Felyndiira T ' orgh Felyndiira T ' orgh was the head of the College of Illusion and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that Felyndiira was a slippery and oily individual .

title: Fender Stouthammer
description: Fender Stouthammer Fender Stouthammer is a young dwarf of the Stouthammer clan . He was among those that followed Torgar when he left Mirabar for Mithral Hall . He was captured by Tos ' un Armgo in a sneak attack with a poisoned blade .

title: Feng Ironhead
description: Feng Ironhead Feng Ironhead was a half - orc shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Feng was a genius in his field : he could pick what looked to be an ordinary weapon or piece of armor that in truth was extremely durable .

title: Fenkenkabradon Dokaan
description: Fenkenkabradon Dokaan Fenkenkabradon Dokaan was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Fenkenkabradon . He was also the commander of the Lance Defenders in 1486 DR . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p256 " > < / ref > Description .

title: Fenmarel Mestarine
description: Fenmarel Mestarine Fenmarel Mestarine is a member of the Seldarine , though he refuses to have any contact with them unless absolutely necessary . He is sullen and withdrawn , offering cynicism and distrust to almost any non - elf who he comes across . Worshipers .

title: Fenn
description: Fenn Fenn was a young man of Waterdeep who was Kyriani Agrivar ' s current beau in the summer of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . Fenn was with Kyriani on the hottest day of summer , 1357 DR , in the Selûne ' s Smile tavern as Vajra Valmeyjar arm - wrestled Timoth Eyesbright while Onyx the Invincible collected bets . Fenn asked Kyriani which one to bet on , but Kyriani suggested he try his arm on the winner .

title: Fennor
description: Fennor Fennor was a berserker and warlord of the Uthgardt Tribe of the Elk during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Fennor led a small raiding band of the Elk tribe .

title: Fenris Aghatonn
description: Fenris Aghatonn Fenris Aghatonn was the Lady of Hawk ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Fenris was the wife of Arthus Cavilos .

title: Fenthick Moss
description: Fenthick Moss Fenthick Moss was an elf who was Lady Aribeth ' s lover . Fenthick was working to help find the cure to the Wailing Death , supposedly along with Desther , when Desther stole the cure shortly after its creation . Fenthick followed Desther in the hope of making him recant and ended up hanged for his " collaboration " with the false Helm ite traitor .

title: Feral spirit
description: Feral spirit Feral spirits are beastmaster s trained to an unusual degree , even amongst other beastmasters , in fostering a bond between themselves and their animal companion that transcends normal communication . Such rangers know on an instinctive level the goals , desires , fears , and actions of their feral partner as intimately as the animal itself and the same is true in reverse . In the heat of the moment , feral spirits and the beasts with whom they travel are , for all practical purposes , one being .

title: Fergana Pass
description: Fergana Pass Fergana Pass was a well - used route through the northern reaches of Teyla Shan in the Hordelands . Geography . Caravans heading north from Semphar into the vast steppes often chose this route since Iris Well Spring was found within a short distance where the pass exited the mountains .

title: Feringal Auck
description: Feringal Auck Feringal Auck was the lord of Auckney . Description . Feringal was not considered a very effective leader , although considering Auckney ' s status that was not such a terrible thing .

title: Ferla Treeclimber
description: Ferla Treeclimber Ferla Treeclimber was a wild elf who lived in the Forest of Amtar in northern Dambrath . Activities . Ferla ruled the Trunalor tribe for nearly 300 years through the mid 14th century DR .

title: Fern
description: Fern The fern was a common type of plant in Faerûn . Variations . Softwood .

title: Fern - frond soup
description: Fern - frond soup Fern - frond soup was a dish made in Faerûn , using the fronds of a fern . Geography . The village of Dead Tree Hollow in the Vast was famous for its fern - frond soup .

title: Ferremo Magli
description: Ferremo Magli Ferremo Magli was an assassin and the chief servant of the green dragon , Andareunarthex . Description . The blonde haired Ferremo liked to wear nice clothes because he found it made him less noticeable than clothing favored by most assassins .

title: Ferret
description: Ferret The ferret was a common animal in the Realms . Description . Like weasel s , these animals were small and furry creatures .

title: Ferrodraco
description: Ferrodraco Ferrodraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed that ferrodracos were an evolved and more intelligent species of the " Ignidraco " genus .

title: Ferryl Nimersyl
description: Ferryl Nimersyl Ferryl Nimersyl was the commander of the Moon Knights . He was known to have fought well in Nimesin ' s War in 1371 DR . In 1374 he joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade .

title: Ferzath
description: Ferzath Ferzath was a black dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Ferzath was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Fesric
description: Fesric Fesric was a Zhent soldier at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR . In the wake of the disaster that had destroyed Zhentil Keep , Fesric became the leader of a group of like - minded Zhents who wanted to break away and transform the Citadel of the Raven into the base of a separate power . Kandar Milinal considered him a possible problem for the future , and he considered arranging an " accident " to befall Fesric .

title: Festival of the Founding
description: Festival of the Founding The Festival of the Founding was a celebration held in Menzoberranzan on Ches 20 every year to commemorate the anniversary of Menzoberranzan ' s founding by Menzoberra the Kinless . Unallied houses were to dine together as a display of unity . Sometimes Lolth appeared in the form of an avatar .

title: Fetlock Court
description: Fetlock Court Fetlock Court was a large paved courtyard in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep , adjoining the stables of the Palace . It was used as the staging area for mounted guards before their departure on patrols , and was unofficially a concert area for bard s to practice . It was also possible to purchase horse s here .

title: Fevered certainty of Caiphon
description: Fevered certainty of Caiphon Fevered certainty of Caiphon is spell used by warlock s , most often those of the star pact . When cast , " fevered certainty of Caiphon " bestows upon its caster with dark and forbidden knowledge , giving them an advantage over others in various mundane or heroic tasks alike . However , the knowledge is intoxicating and flushes the warlock with a small touch of the madness of the Far Realm , which like the benefits gained , lasts only for a moment .

title: Fey
description: Fey Fey were creatures from the Feywild , a parallel plane to the Prime . Many were typified as having supernatural abilities and a connection to nature or to some other force or place . The language of the fey was called Sylvan .

title: Fey ' ri
description: Fey ' ri Fey ' ri , or demonfey , were not a true elven subrace . They were to elves as tiefling s were to human s and tanarukk s were to orc s . The fey ' ri were the result of interbreeding between sun elves and tanar ' ri in an attempt to strengthen the sun elf bloodline .

title: Fey ' ri invasion of Evereska
description: Fey ' ri invasion of Evereska The hellspawn race of elves known as the fey ' ri were effectively entombed underneath Myth Drannor for 5000 years until some of the magical warding had eroded and they were able to escape to the surface . The fiendish race of elves were tainted and had acquired a great deal of power through the dark arts . High Fey ' ri mages had summoned 3500 demons and other minions of darkness to fortify their troops and begun a march south along the River Delimbiyr valley and into a narrow pass in the foothills to Evereska , the last elven stronghold .

title: Fey beguiler
description: Fey beguiler Fey beguilers are some of the greatest heroes in the folklore of gnome s . While most races would have powerful and fearless warriors as their heroes , in gnome legends the heroes outwit huge monsters , play great pranks without getting caught , and sneak past great magical guardians to get the treasures . Fey Beguilers bring these stories to a reality , using agility , stealth , and a little well - placed magic to achieve their goals .

title: Fey crossroad
description: Fey crossroad Fey crossroads were magical portals , many of which led to the Feywild . They could be found all over Toril , but most were hidden from casual view . They often required the use of a ritual to operate , and after the Spellplague , many malfunctioned .

title: Fey domain
description: Fey domain The Fey domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters fey spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Fey Domain Powers .

title: Fey mound
description: Fey mound Fey mounds were hidden burial barrows of wild fey which often contained treasures buried with the fey . The soil from fey mounds was thought to be magical and was used in some ritual s to increase the fertility of fields . Individuals highly attuned to magic could sometimes sense a mound ' s presence .

title: Feytouched
description: Feytouched The feytouched are warlock s bound to pacts with powerful archfey , who have absorbed so much of the Feywild ’ s power so quickly as to have gone literally mad . However , the madness is only temporary for most who successfully take on the path , who learn to control their sanity , almost as if insanity itself were another weapon . With the power of the Feywild itself at their command , feytouched are not hindered by their temporary bouts of insanity .

title: Feywild
description: Feywild The Feywild , also known as the plane of Faerie , existed as an " echo " of the Prime Material Plane . It was from here that the fey originated , giving the Feywild its name , and it was also a place of unusually potent magic . Traits .

title: Fflar Starbrow Melruth
description: Fflar Starbrow Melruth Fflar Starbrow Melruth is the former Captain of Myth Drannor in the Akh ' Velahr ( army of Cormanthor ) . He is around a hundred and fifty years old . Description .

title: Ffolk
description: Ffolk The Ffolk were a race of human s that inhabited the Moonshae Isles alongside the Northlanders . The Ffolk inhabited the southern parts of the Moonshaes , including Flamsterd , Moray , Snowdown and Sunset , and the southern parts of Alaron and Gwynneth . Their society was mainly agricultural and was ruled by a High King or Queen who resided in Caer Callidyrr , the capital of the Ffolk .

title: Fhaornik
description: Fhaornik Fhaornik was a sun elf apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , he was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush . He threw a " rod of absorption " into Kemarn ' s summoned nishruu , but it did not destroy the creature as he had hoped .

title: Fhazail
description: Fhazail Fhazail was a human bandit . Description . Fhazail was a fat man .

title: Fiddlehead soup
description: Fiddlehead soup Fiddlehead soup was a dish made in Faerûn , using the fiddlehead of a fern . Locations . Around 1370 DR , the village of Dead Tree Hollow in the Vast was famous for its fiddlehead soup when the fiddleheads were in season .

title: Field glass
description: Field glass A field glass was a popular export from the the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . History .

title: Field of Triumph
description: Field of Triumph The Field of Triumph was a large outdoor stadium located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep at the southern end of the Street of the Singing Dolphin , adjacent to the House of Heroes , and bordered by Julthoon Street , Jelzar ' s Stride , and Seaeye ' s March . The main entrance was at the end of Gulzindar Street , known as the Lion Gate because it was carved to give visitors the impression they were walking into the maw of a gigantic lion . The Field of Triumph was the venue for many public spectacles from late spring until late autumn , weather permitting .

title: Fields of Mythal
description: Fields of Mythal The three Fields of Mythal were the way the powerful arcanist s of Netheril grouped their spells , similar to the nine schools of magic known to the wizard s of later ages . Each arcanist was a specialist in one Field , had minor insight into a second and could not cast spells from the third Field . Inventive .

title: Fields of Slaughter
description: Fields of Slaughter The Fields of Slaughter was a large plot of land running between the Spine of the World and the Severed Hand . History . The fields were named after a great battle that took place between elven and orc ish forces .

title: Fields of the Dead
description: Fields of the Dead The Fields of the Dead are the rolling hills east of Baldur ' s Gate between the Winding Water and the River Chionthar on the Sword Coast . Kings Strohm IV and Samyte of Tethyr were buried here . History .

title: Fiella Markin
description: Fiella Markin Warchief Fiella Markin was the ruler of Hethar in Dambrath . Personality . Due to her lack of priestly skills , Fiella was a fiercely determined individual who was not afraid to take risks in order to accomplish her goals .

title: Fiend
description: Fiend A fiend is an evil creature from one of the Fiendish Planes . They are not just evil , but " born " of Evil ; primal malevolence is one of the roots of their nature , and the evil essence of the fiendish planes permeates every part of their bodies . Types of Fiends .

title: Fiend ' s Wing
description: Fiend ' s Wing The Fiend ' s Wing was a large province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This section of the Empire was found at a narrow section of the World Pillar Mountains that separated the jungles of the east from the barbarian lands of the west .

title: Fiend of corruption
description: Fiend of corruption A fiend of corruption is an evil Outsider who specializes in tricking people into embracing the darker aspects of themselves . They do so out of the spitefulness of their nature . Known Fiends of Corruption .

title: Fiend patron
description: Fiend patron A fiend patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and an archdevil , a demon lord , or some other member of the fiendish royalty , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots .

title: Fiendish planes
description: Fiendish planes Fiendish planes was a collective term used to describe a subset of the Outer Planes in the World Tree cosmology model . The fiendish planes were generally associated with the evil deities whereas the celestial planes were generally associated with the good ones . The fiendish planes were : The River of Blood connected all of these planes except for the Demonweb Pits and the Supreme Throne .

title: Fiendish resilience
description: Fiendish resilience Fiendish resilience is a spell used by many warlock s , both before and after the Spellplague , to enhance their durability . When a warlock , most typically one bound to the devil s of the Nine Hells , casts " fiendish resilience " , he or she imbues her flesh with the power of the Hells themselves , increasing his or her vitality substantially . This effect is not permanent , but nor does it wear down with time , and until this magical protection is stripped away from the warlock they retain it .

title: Fiertallin
description: Fiertallin Fiertallin was a cosmetic commonly used in Ulgarth . It was a white , chalky substance gathered from the river Xon and exported from the city of Suormpar to the rest of the realm . Around 1367 DR , women of Ulgarth used fiertallin to add artistic streaks of white to their typically dark hair , as hair was a prime area of fashion .

title: Fiery bolt
description: Fiery bolt Fiery bolt was a spell of the evocation school used most often by infernal pact warlock s , though other warlocks sometimes learned to use it . " Fiery bolt " , when cast , created a fiery ray of golden colored flame , which the warlock casting it shot toward a creature of their choosing within fifty feet . The spell , the potency of which was influenced by the caster ' s durability , if it hit , burned the target , as well as other creatures unfortunate enough to be nearby , with deadly ( but easily extinguished ) flames .

title: Fiery fists
description: Fiery fists Fiery fists was a flame spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Fighter
description: Fighter Fighter was a descriptive term for a warrior skilled with a variety of weapons and trained in the arts of war . A skilled fighter defined the front line of any battle , breaking through enemy ranks and holding the line while their allies maneuvered . All fighters were trained to use virtually any armor or weapon the situation required ; a fighter could use an axe , a rapier , or a greatsword with roughly equivalent skill .

title: Figurine of wondrous power
description: Figurine of wondrous power A figurine of wondrous power is a small statuette ranging in size from a grown man ' s hand to the size of a little finger , that is similar in shape to the extra - planar creature that it turns into . These rare items transform into many types of bestial planar creatures that understand common and follow the orders of the wielder of the statuette . These creatures are called by the name given to the creature upon the item ' s creation .

title: Fihelis
description: Fihelis Fihelis was a half - elf of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Fihelis was a citizen of Neverwinter , whose daughter died during the Neverwinter plague .

title: Fiirnel ' ther Vandree
description: Fiirnel ' ther Vandree Fiinel ' ther Vandree was the matron mother of House Vandree in Menzoberranzan in 1480 DR and after . Personality . During the Rage of Demons , she and her house were considered vicious , vindictive , and determined to rise to the top .

title: Filani
description: Filani Filani of Tantras was a female human wizard and sage from the city of Tantras in the Vast who settled in Tilverton in Cormyr . History . Hailing from the city of Tantras in the Vast , Filani made her home in Tilverton before 1358 DR .

title: Filarion Filvendorson
description: Filarion Filvendorson Filarion Filvendorson was a grandson of Elorfindar Floshin in Daggerford around 1370 DR and 1485 DR . History . Filarion was the son of Filvendor Floshin .

title: Filfaeril Obarskyr
description: Filfaeril Obarskyr Queen Filfaeril Selzair Obarskyr ( the Dragon Queen ) was the queen of Cormyr and wife of King Azoun IV . Azoun was drawn to her more for her extremely sharp mind rather than her beautiful appearance . She was skilled at chess .

title: Filfaeril Stormbillow
description: Filfaeril Stormbillow Filfaeril Stormbillow was a wizard and ex - adventurer . History . She was born in Marsember , Cormyr , and retired there around 1338 DR .

title: Filiare
description: Filiare Filiare was a retired fighter who ran the Inn of the Dripping Dagger in Trades Ward of Waterdeep . Description . The middle - aged human was quite jovial and Filiare had greying dark hair and a moustache .

title: Filina Shintar
description: Filina Shintar Filina Shintar was a half - elven priestess and Queen of Dambrath during the 11th century DR . Relationships . Filina was the daughter of Dambrath ' s first queen , Cathtyr Shintar .

title: Filithan
description: Filithan Filithan was a male priest of Ilmater from Bormton , Amn , in the 3rd century DR , who held the title " Revered Brother " and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History . To counter the growing spread of evil under the Shoon Imperium and a plethora of evil artifacts fashioned at the time , the Church of Ilmater sought a weapon to combat such evil .

title: Fillistrom Wunderkundoodle
description: Fillistrom Wunderkundoodle Fillistrom Wunderkundoodle was a healer in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Fillistrom liked taking his time to do things but was a very competent healer .

title: Filsaelene Merwyst
description: Filsaelene Merwyst Filsaelene Merwyst was a sun elf cleric of Corellon Larethian rescued from captivity by the daemonfey in the ruins beneath Myth Glaurach by Araevin Teshurr and his party . Possessions . Filsaelene carried a longsword and wore a breastplate bearing the symbol of Corellon Larethian .

title: Filvendor Floshin
description: Filvendor Floshin Filvendor Floshin was the youngest son of Elorfindar Floshin in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Filvendor was the father of Kelson Darktreader and Filarion .

title: Filzaur
description: Filzaur Filzaur was a male drow wizard and a student of the Inverted Tower in Szith Morcane . Description . An average - looking male drow , Filzaur distinguished himself by his atypical attire among drow society .

title: Fimbrul
description: Fimbrul Fimbrul , also known as the Land of Giant s , was a small nation of giants located amid the northern Howling Mountains in Returned Abeir . Fimbrul was known for its few landmarks and the small communities hidden in the snowy mountains . Government .

title: Final Chord
description: Final Chord The Final Chord was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara dedicated to the teachings of Bala , the Zakharan goddess of music . The symbol of the Final Chord was a silver jambiya adorned with silver bells . Activities .

title: Finch
description: Finch Finch is described as a notorious bard , though perhaps infamous is a better word . Preferring his dulcet singing voice over instruments , Finch was at the very least also a fine lute and mandolin player , having taught Cain Lethellon , the popular Neverwintran lute player , as much as he could . However , despite his international fame as a musician , it would of course be Finch ' s many romantic liasons which made his name more widely known .

title: Find familiar
description: Find familiar Find familiar was a conjuration ritual that bound a spirit to a warlock or wizard in the form of a familiar . Effects . Familiars summoned in this way were spirits of either celestial , fey or fiend ish nature , depending on the caster ' s choice , that took the form of an animal , also of the caster ' s choice .

title: Find steed
description: Find steed Find steed was a conjuration spell for paladins s to call a spirit to take the form of a steed . Effects . The summoned steed could take any form , but most commonly it would take on the common forms of steeds ( warhorse , camel , or mastiff , for example ) .

title: Find the path
description: Find the path Find the path was a divination spell that found the most direct way from point A to point B . The reverse of this spell , lose the path , could completely confuse a creature and prevent it from finding any intended destination . Effects .

title: Find traps
description: Find traps Find traps was a divination spell that allowed the caster to detect traps . Effect . The oldest version of this spell functioned across an area and revealed all traps in a specific area around the caster .

title: Find water
description: Find water Find water was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could literally smell a supply of water within a broad expanse of territory depending on their level of power .

title: Findar
description: Findar Findar was a human settlement in The Fang , containing the descendants of refugees from the conflict between the humans and the half - elves of the Yuirwood . It was situated on the coast on the west side of The Fang , beneath the cliffs , and the sandy ground made it difficult to grow crops . Findar ' s occupants made their living from the sea instead .

title: Finder Wyvernspur
description: Finder Wyvernspur Finder Wyvernspur ( pronounced " FIND - er " ) was a relatively new deity raised to divinity by acquiring the divine spark of the deceased god Moander . Originally he was a powerful bard named Finder Wyvernspur , though history would recall him as The Nameless Bard . Finder was the chaotic neutral demi - power of the cycles of life and transformation of art .

title: Fine Rugs
description: Fine Rugs Fine Rugs was a collection of three tents in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . It was operated by the shrewd merchant Alik Aksama . Description .

title: Finellen
description: Finellen Finellen came from one of the dwarven groups who lived in Myrloch Vale . Description . As was the case of dwarven females , Finellen had a bristling beard that dropped past the beltline .

title: Finger of death
description: Finger of death Finger of death was a spell where the caster would attempt to cause instant death to a target . Effects . The oldest version of the spell would just attempt to kill the target .

title: Finguld Felloki
description: Finguld Felloki Finguld Boomer Felloki was a frost giant warrior in the late 15th century DR . History . Finguld was one of the most trusted warriors of Jarl Fimmel Orelson .

title: Fini ' they Tlabbar
description: Fini ' they Tlabbar Fini ' they Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Like her matron mother , Fini ' they was a devoted follower of Lolth and faithfully loyal .

title: Fior Botpur
description: Fior Botpur Fior Botpur was one of the elected Three Lords of Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lord Botpur ruled the city together with Lord Warkas and Lord Nybahn .

title: Firble
description: Firble Firble was a svirfneblin councilor of King Schnicktick in Blingdenstone , and had a secret relationship with Jarlaxle , who traded information . Description . The deep gnome had stubby fingers and was going bald .

title: Firbolg
description: Firbolg The firbolg is a reclusive type of giant - kin that prefers to avoid contact with other sentient races . They are the most intelligent of the giant - kin . Amongst their own kind , they live in colonies , which are usually found in forests or caverns and watched by guard towers .

title: Fire
description: Fire The element of fire was one of the four fundamental building blocks of matter , both useful and dreadful , warming and consuming , changing and purifying . Despite elements generally playing a neutral role in the cosmos , fire was seen as aggressive and evil by many . Cosmology .

title: Fire Fountain
description: Fire Fountain The Fire Fountain was a fountain of flame at the center of the city of Myth Nantar , in Serôs . The mythal of the city allowed for surface - only effects , such as the fountain ' s ability to shoot flames , which would otherwise have been impossible underwater . The fountain also warmed the water inside the city .

title: Fire Knives
description: Fire Knives The Fire Knives were a band of assassins that operated out of the city of Westgate , under the approval of the thieves guild known as the Night Masks . The group was led by Lord Tagreth Cormaeril , also referred to as the Grandfather of Assassins . Agents of the guild operated within all the major cities in Cormyr , as well as Chessenta , the Dalelands and Sembia .

title: Fire River
description: Fire River The Fire River was a river in the Vast that ran from the Earthspur Mountains to the Dragon Reach . Description . The Fire River was a wide and mostly placid river that flowed west across the southern Vast , north of the Earthfast Mountains , and into the Dragon Reach and ultimately the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Fire Wine
description: Fire Wine Fire Wine was a wine exported from the Old Empires . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Fire agate
description: Fire agate Fire agate was a form of chalcedony which contained arranged in thin lines , giving this stone an iridescent quality . Description . These ornamental stones came in red , brown , gold , and green varieties and in the finest specimens the chalcedony was partially translucent , allowing the color to come through .

title: Fire arrows
description: Fire arrows Fire arrows was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused a regular campfire to spray flaming arrow s .

title: Fire elemental
description: Fire elemental Fire elementals were elemental s formed from the element of fire . Description . They were fast and agile creatures whose touch could set objects aflame .

title: Fire falcon
description: Fire falcon Fire falcons were small raptors that could be found around the Battle of Bones . Description . These falcons were small birds .

title: Fire gate
description: Fire gate Fire gate was an arcane alteration spell that allowed the caster to step into a large fire and teleport to another such fire . Effects . In order for this spell to work , there had to be at least two large fires ( a minimum of 2 to 4 ft ( 60 to 120 cm in diameter ) within range of each other .

title: Fire giant
description: Fire giant Fire giants were a type of giant . Description . Fire giants stood around eighteen feet ( five meters ) tall and were dwarf - like in appearance .

title: Fire lichen
description: Fire lichen Fire lichen was a type of lichen that grew in the Underdark near sources of geothermal heat . It was recognizable by its stalks of pale orange - white . When ground to powder and fermented , it formed a paste that was very spicy but edible , added to soups and stews or spread on sporebread for flavor .

title: Fire opal
description: Fire opal Fire opal was a rare gem stone usually found near hot springs and geysers . Description . Fire opal was a brilliant orange - red form of opal that was usually solid in color but could have golden or greenish flashes .

title: Fire purge
description: Fire purge Fire purge was an abjuration spell that prevented normal fires and dampened magical fires in an area . Effects . Within the protected area , normal fires refused to burn and magical fires were reduced to half intensity .

title: Fire sand
description: Fire sand Fire sand was a dangerous magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that created intense sheets of flame . Powers . " Fire sand " could be used in two ways : as a burning wall , or as an area spell .

title: Fire shield
description: Fire shield Fire shield , also known as Dragonflame mantle during the Spellplague , was an evocation spell used to immolate the caster in protective and offensive flames . Effects . When " fire shield " was cast , it enveloped the caster in a fiery shield that made it more difficult for enemies to attack the caster and burned any who came in contact .

title: Fire shroud
description: Fire shroud Fire shroud , originally named flame shroud and also published under the name shroud of flame , was an arcane evocation spell that caused one creature to be engulfed in flames and endanger those around it . Post - Spellplague , this spell attacked all enemies close to the caster , but with less intensity . Colloquially , it was called the " trollkiller " spell .

title: Fire spiral
description: Fire spiral Fire spiral was a flame and abjuration spell utilized by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell created a spiral thread of flame that originated at the caster ' s feet and wound around their body before terminating above their head .

title: Fire storm
description: Fire storm Fire storm was an evocation spell that permeated a area of effect with sheets of flame . Effect . The target area would be drench all creatures within the area in flame similar to a " wall of fire " causing damage but usually not for a very long time but .

title: Fire track
description: Fire track Fire track was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a spark that followed a target just like a hound on the scent .

title: Fire trap
description: Fire trap Fire trap was both an abjuration and evocation spell that could be used on any closeable item , causing a small fiery explosion upon unauthorized entry . History . This spell was invented by the arcanist and Fire Warden of Netheril Noanar in −2319 DR .

title: Fire truth
description: Fire truth Fire truth was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Fireball
description: Fireball Fireball was an arcane spell that created a tiny ball of fire that flew forward from the caster , exploding in a huge fireball at a point designated by the caster . While an extremely potent spell , the caster had to take care to avoid catching allies in the explosion , or to accidentally strike an obstruction and detonate the spell early . Effects .

title: Firebead Elvenhair
