description: Firebead Elvenhair Firebead Elvenhair was a mage who traveled the Sword Coast in search of books for the sages at Candlekeep , such as Gorion . That he made purchases for the monastery was a badly kept secret among the book dealers of Baldur ' s Gate and Beregost . Appearances .

title: Firecam full - plate armor
description: Firecam full - plate armor The Firecam full - plate armor was the personal suit of armor of Sir Keldorn Firecam . It was designed specifically for him , so very few others could wear it . It was a " + 1 full plate armor " that granted the wearer to ability to move freely through hindrances such as webs , as well as boosted resistances to effects that assailed them .

title: Firedrake ( county )
description: Firedrake ( county ) County Firedrake was both the most populated and the most dangerous county on the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula in Tethyr . Description . The waters around the peninsula were constantly full of pirates , which made life on this county risk for its citizens .

title: Firedrake Bay
description: Firedrake Bay Firedrake Bay was the bay located between the Tethyr Peninsula and the Starspire Peninsula . Port Kir was located at its southeastern corner . Geography .

title: Firedrinker ' s Inn
description: Firedrinker ' s Inn Firedrinker ' s Inn was an inn found in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . This famous establishment had a pristine reputation among the traveling folk of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Description .

title: Firefeed
description: Firefeed Firefeed was a strange wizard spell that combined the element of fire with healing . Effects . The caster of this spell could heal himself by physically touching a flame .

title: Firefiend
description: Firefiend Firefiend was a unique magic weapon wielded by a tasked slayer genie called the Head Taker . " Firefiend " was one of two dangerous swords wielded by the Head Taker , with the other being " Widowmaker . " Description .

title: Fireflow
description: Fireflow The Fireflow , also called Gaping Stream , was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Description . The water in this stream was icy cold .

title: Firefoam
description: Firefoam Firefoam was the famous war steed of the Knights of Myth Drannor leader , Florin Falconhand . Description . Florin ' s horse was a very intellectual white charger or heavy war horse .

title: Firelands
description: Firelands The Firelands was a region of the Underdark located beneath the jungles of Chult . Geography . The Firelands were located beneath the jungles of Chult .

title: Firenewt
description: Firenewt Firenewts were reptilian humanoids native to volcanic regions , who evolved from lizardfolk and gained the ability to breathe fire . Description . Firenewts were about the size of a slim human .

title: Firepeaks
description: Firepeaks The Firepeaks were a series of mountains located in the Endless Wastes . Description . The Firepeaks , which received their name from the reddish glow seen at night , were located several hundred miles east of Almorel and were considered one of the most famous landmarks in the Endless Wastes .

title: Fireseed
description: Fireseed Fireseed was an alcohol ic beverage made by dwarves . It was a non - magic al liquor that had negligible effects on dwarves and gnome s . Fireseed was more potent to other races , however , either increasing natural resistances or debilitating drunkenness .

title: Fireshear
description: Fireshear Fireshear was a mining city in the Frozenfar in Northwest Faerûn , on the coast west of the Iceflow river . Geography . The city ' s location was chosen because of the rich copper and silver veins in the area , exposed by a violent event such as a volcano or something falling from the sky .

title: Firesoul genasi
description: Firesoul genasi A firesoul genasi , also known as an fire genasi , was a type of genasi that was able to harness the power of fire . Description . Many firesoul genasi carried obvious traits from the Elemental Plane of Fire , such as coal - colored skin , flame - like hair , and fiery eyes .

title: Firespiders
description: Firespiders Firespiders creates 240 tiny fire elemental s in form of small burning spiders . History . Thousands of years ago drow used this spell to set afire large parts of what is now the Border Forest and separated it from Cormanthor .

title: Firesteap Mountains
description: Firesteap Mountains The Firesteap Mountains stretched from the edge of the Lake of Steam to the forest of Chondalwood , then go on to the northern border of the Shaar , meeting the land beyond . The mountains do not have many monsters but the Shaaryan tribes claimed there were ancient tombs and killed or captured anyone that did not have traditional rights . The northern mountains had a couple of thieves and monsters that struck at caravans .

title: Firestorm Cabal
description: Firestorm Cabal The Firestorm Cabal was a loosely organized organization of genasi with chapters in Airspur , Calimport and Memnon . The Airspur chapter was dedicated to protecting Akanûl and the chapter often did Queen Arathane ' s dirty work for her . The organization was disliked by many of the lower classes in Airspur but was viewed favorably by the upper classes .

title: Firethorn
description: Firethorn Firethorn , or Sea Rose , was a naturally occurring plant on the Island of the Firethorns within the Genie ' s Turban off the coast of mainland Zakhara . Description . The presence of firethorn gave the Island of the Firethorns a lovely red coloration .

title: Firetrees
description: Firetrees Firetrees was a small town located in the Greenfields of Unther , East Faerûn , as of 1357 DR . Background . The town was named after its red - colored trees , that shone in the night with unnatural phosphorescence .

title: Firetrees ( Returned Abeir )
description: Firetrees ( Returned Abeir ) Firetrees , originally named Durlyndbold and later Raurokh , was a ruined fortress located in eastern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . The fortress was located in a scorched land of tumbled stones , amid a forest of burned tree trunks and fire - blackened rocks where no new plants could grow , hence its name .

title: Firewine Bridge
description: Firewine Bridge Firewine Bridge was once an elven trading town , but it was destroyed around 1168 DR in a sorcerous battle . By 1368 DR , " Firewine Bridge " was a fallow field of overgrown rubble dominated by a large area of wild magic . The sorcerous battle was so mighty that it not only leveled the elven town , it also altered the course of the stream over which the bridge crossed .

title: Firkraag
description: Firkraag Firkraag , also known as Lord Jierdan Firkraag , was a red dragon living in the Windspear Hills in Amn and masquerading as a human noble . He took over the area after financially ruining the rightful owner of the lands , Garren Windspear , and made his lair in an old temple / tomb complex nearby . Firkraag surrounded himself with such minions as orc s , hobgoblin s , ogrillon s , wolfwere s and golems s .

title: First Age
description: First Age The First Age of Netheril began in - 3859 DR when the human communities of Fenwick , Gers , Gilan , Gustaf , Moran , Nauseef , and Janick all banded together to protect themselves . Description . At first , the community was known as Seventon , but Nether the Elder renamed the alliance " Netheril " .

title: First Crown War
description: First Crown War - 12 , 000 . Aryvandaar , lead by the Vyshaan clan , invades Miyeritar and pressures Shantel Othreier to accept occupation or suffer the same fate . - 11 , 800 .

title: First Flowering
description: First Flowering The First Flowering was a period in Faerûn ' s history between - 24000 DR and - 12000 DR . At the start of this period , the elves had split into five major realms : Aryvandaar , Illefarn , Keltormir , Miyeritar and Shantel Othreier , as well as several smaller ones such as Eiellûr , Ilythiir , Orishaar , Syòrpiir and Thearnytaar . During the First Flowering , the last of the winged elven race Avariel are believed to have left Faerûn .

title: First Lancers
description: First Lancers The First Lancers , also called the Blazes , was part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Noble efreet led these medium cavalry who numbered 1 , 000 strong .

title: First Sundering
description: First Sundering The First Sundering ( sometimes simply The Sundering ) or Ever ' Sakkatien ( as called by the Tel - quessir ) , was a High Magic ritual cast by the greatest High Mage s of the Tel - quessir during the period of The First Flowering , around – 17600 DR . The ritual resulted in the creation of the Isle of Evermeet , but also resulted in widespread disaster which destroyed or altered much of Faerûn and may even be the cause of much of the non - uniformity of the Weave throughout the continent . Ever ' Sakkatien is somehow connected to the more recent Second Sundering , an event that takes place in the 1480s DR .

title: First Tymanther - Unther War
description: First Tymanther - Unther War The First Tymanther – Unther War was a conflict between the nations of Tymanther and Unther that took place in the Year of the Rune Lords Triumphant , 1487 DR . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p109 - 115 " > < / ref > History . At some point in 1486 DR , while on the world of Abeir , the god - king Gilgeam contacted the demon lord Graz ' zt and asked him to aid Unther in their war against the genasi forces of Shyr .

title: First flensing
description: First flensing The First Flensing was a powerful ritual that , if completed , would allow the evil god Asmodeus to enter Waterdeep . Wizards and clerics at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep first attempted the ritual around 1180 DR in exchange for immortality . However , they reneged on the deal and were cursed into lich form and became the Circle of Skulls .

title: First inter - dale war
description: First inter - dale war The first inter - dale war occurred in 1232 DR between Archendale and Sessrendale , and lasted three weeks . It ended in victory for Archendale , and the annihilation of Sessrendale . The forces of Archendale led an invasion of Sessrendale after the " mysterious " Dusk Lord , ruler of Sessrendale , was judged to be using necromancy and that " evil raiders " were being harbored there .

title: Firstpeak
description: Firstpeak Firstpeak was a mountain in the Spine of the World mountain range . History . It was formerly known as Ironstar Mountain since it was once home to the Ironstar clan of shield dwarves .

title: Fish - spice paste
description: Fish - spice paste Fish - spice paste was a condiment applied to in Faerûn . It was made of fish with spice and also had a salty flavor , and came in several varieties . Elgath ' s Provisions in Archenbridge in Archendale , in the Dalelands , sold fish - spice pastes to add flavor to their traveling rations , in addition to their hot sauces .

title: Fist
description: Fist The Fist was the best assassin member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , the Grandfather of Assassins sent the Fist and a squad of assassins to kill Gareth Dragonsbane and his party .

title: Fist of the adder
description: Fist of the adder Fist of the adder was a potent offensive spell used in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was favored by the Red Eyes sorcerous society . Effects .

title: Fistandantilus ' s firequench
description: Fistandantilus ' s firequench Fistandantilus ' s firequench , also shortened to just firequench , was an abjuration and alteration spell that extinguished fires and prevented flammable materials from igniting . Effects . This spell protected a spherical volume with a radius of 40 ft ( 12 m ) for a duration of four minutes .

title: Five Great Terraces
description: Five Great Terraces The Five Great Terraces was a large enclosure found in Manass in Khazari . Description . A graveled square surrounded the Five Great Terraces , which were stacked upon one another .

title: Fives Council
description: Fives Council The Fives Council served as the ruling body of government of Yhaunn in 1358 DR . This organization derived its name because each table of a council session seated five people . Activities .

title: Fizmorayen Fitzmoran
description: Fizmorayen Fitzmoran Fizmorayen Fitzmoran was an exiled high artificer and a cleric of Gond who lived in the fortress known as Throne Rock . Relationships . Living with Fizmorayen within his sanctuary was a few dwarves , tinkerers , and an alchemist .

title: Flaergon
description: Flaergon Flaergon was a follower of Ilmater who lived in Glister in Thar , in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Flaergon devoted his efforts to assisting and ensuring the safety of miners and caravan - workers in the frozen north of the Moonsea .

title: Flagon Held High
description: Flagon Held High The Flagon Held High was the only tavern in Tilverton . History . In 1372 DR , the town of Tilverton was completely destroyed during an attack by Thultanthar forces .

title: Flail
description: Flail A flail is a one - handed , martial melee weapon . Description . A flail consists of a haft about two feet ( 60cm ) long with a heavy metal ball or rod attached by chain to the end of the haft .

title: Flail of Ages
description: Flail of Ages The Flail of Ages was a powerful multi - headed flail , each of whose heads did different kinds of damage . It also grew in power according to the number of heads currently on it . History .

title: Flail snail
description: Flail snail Flail snails were earth - based creatures that produced a number of valuable resources . The residue they left behind as they moved could be harvested to produce glass , and their colorful shells could be used to produce protective magical items , such as spellguard shield s and robes of scintillating colors .

title: Flamberge
description: Flamberge A flamberge sword was a two - handed weapon with an undulating blade . The name literally meant " flame blade " . Used during medieval times , this two - handed sword could be used in such ways that it would send vibrations down an opponent ' s weapon , much to their discomfort .

title: Flame ( province )
description: Flame ( province ) The province of flame in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of fire . Use . The four elemental provinces played a very similar role for Zakharan magic - users as the eight ( or nine ) schools of magic did for Faerûn ian ones .

title: Flame blade
description: Flame blade Flame blade was an evocation spell that created a sword - like beam of fire that extended from the caster ' s hand and performed similar to a scimitar . Effects . The blade inflicted fire damage , could ignite items , and gave off light .

title: Flame cyclone
description: Flame cyclone Flame cyclone is an evocation spell used by inexperienced swordmage s , particularly those of the assault style . When " flame cyclone " is cast a tempest of magical flame shoots from the swordmage ' s blade , towards a nearby location , exploding into a flaming storm of fifteen feet in diameter . Creatures caught within are scorched by this blast , which dissipates within a few seconds and which is powered primarily by the strength and intelligence of the swordmage casting it .

title: Flame knife
description: Flame knife Flame knives were special weapons used by holy slayer assassin s in Zakhara . Description . These knives had a wavy blade .

title: Flame of justice
description: Flame of justice Flame of justice was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was a more powerful version of the " fire truth " spell and was cast in the same manner using a special lit candle .

title: Flame shield
description: Flame shield Flame shield was a divine magic spell available to druid s of Eldath , the Goddess of Singing Waters . It created an intangible barrier attached to the caster ' s hand that extinguished normal and magical fires . The " shield " could be passed to others .

title: Flame spiral
description: Flame spiral Flame spiral , also known as fireburst , is an evocation spell used by many sorcerer s early on in their careers . When a sorcerer casts " flame spiral " , they create a vortex of flame that spins around them , shooting outwards into a burst of ten feet in diameter . Any three creatures caught within are scorched , the degree depending largely on how quick their reflexes are , as well as the sorcerer ' s charisma .

title: Flame strike
description: Flame strike Flame strike was an evocation spell that blasted a target with divine fire . Effects . A vertical column of fire was called down by the caster on the exact spot indicated when the spell was cast .

title: Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy
description: Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy was a fiery liquor and the signature drink from Kelvin ' s Comfort in Bryn Shander . Description . A few warm shots of Firebeard ' s Firebrandy were advertised by Augrek Brighthelm to help in keeping the cold at bay .

title: Flamedance
description: Flamedance Flamedance was the name in the Realms for . Description . This precious stone was translucent and ranged in color from pale yellow to green .

title: Flamedeath Fellowship
description: Flamedeath Fellowship The Flamedeath Fellowship was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara dedicated to the teachings of Najm , the Zakharan god of adventure , or Kossuth , the Lord of Flames . Activities . This group of holy slayers was closely involved with the Brotherhood of the True Flame .

title: Flameling
description: Flameling Flamelings were small elemental vermin native to the Elemental Plane of Fire that could also be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These creatures resembled small alligators .

title: Flameproof
description: Flameproof Flameproof was an abjuration spell that granted a subject immunity to fire . Effects . When cast , this spell fully protected the recipient from normal fires and offered limited protection from magical ones .

title: Flameran Verminbane
description: Flameran Verminbane Flameran Verminbane was a halfling during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Flameran worked in the great Dellmon farm in the Dessarin Valley .

title: Flames of Phlegethos
description: Flames of Phlegethos Flames of Phlegethos , sometimes known as brimstone blast , is a moderately powerful warlock invocation learned by young or inexperienced warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with the powers of the Nine Hells . When " flames of Phlegethos " is cast , the warlock casting it summons from the plane of Phlegethos burning streams of liquid fire , which he bathes a target of his or her choice within fifty feet , causing them immense pain and burning at their flesh . Even if the creature survives the initial onslaught , the flames continue to burn , causing continuous pain to the warlock ' s victim .

title: Flamesight Mosque
description: Flamesight Mosque The Flamesight Mosque was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Flaming
description: Flaming Flaming is a enchantment that causes flames to sheathe a weapon . This enchantment is command - word activated and does not harm the wielder . This enchantment adds fire damage upon a successful hit .

title: Flaming Brazier
description: Flaming Brazier Located in Eltabbar , the Flaming Brazier was the largest temple of Kossuth , the Firelord . Description . The Flaming Brazier was an immense basalt building .

title: Flaming Fist
description: Flaming Fist The Flaming Fist , or Flaming Fists , was a mercenary company based in the city of Baldur ' s Gate on the Sword Coast , where its members served as city guards . They also worked outside the city ; their sphere of influence extending just south of Beregost but stopping before Nashkel . The Flaming Fist Mercenary Company , as it was then called , was founded around 1345 DR by Eltan , a formidable fighter and Grand Duke of Baldur ' s Gate .

title: Flaming Griffon
description: Flaming Griffon The Flaming Griffon was an inn in the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta in the early 1370s DR . Its proprietor was Rueldarr . Description .

title: Flaming Tower
description: Flaming Tower The Flaming Tower , also known as the Tower of Flame , was a massive ruined tower in Daggerdale . Location . The tower was built on the southern edge of the Border Forest less than fifteen miles north west of Dagger Falls .

title: Flaming sphere
description: Flaming sphere Flaming sphere ( or burning sphere ) is a spell that summons a globe of hot flames , which the caster can then move at a speed roughly equivalent to that of a human . The sphere ' s flames are volatile and any creature caught nearby that is unable to get out of the way is scorched . Editions .

title: Flandal Steelskin
description: Flandal Steelskin Flandal Steelskin was the gnomish god of mining and smithing , an excellent craftsman with an unerring nose for finding metals in the earth . He was physically strong , and no stranger to battle . He helped forge Arumdina , and so often had the ear of Garl Glittergold .

title: Flandarr Roaryl
description: Flandarr Roaryl Flandarr Roaryl was one of the princes of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Background .

title: Flattery Wyvernspur
description: Flattery Wyvernspur Flattery Wyvernspur was the first artificial human created by Finder Wyvernspur as a living repository of his songs in an effort to keep them unchanged and alive . Abilities . Aside from being a very powerful archmage , Flattery also had perfect knowledge of Finder Wyvernspur ' s repertoire of songs and the ability to sing them ( if not quite at his creator ' s level of perfection ) .

title: Flenser
description: Flenser Flenser was a female draegloth cleric of Kiaransalee and a torturer for Irae T ' sarran in the Undying Temple . Description . Flenser had a bestial and elongated face with a mouth full of dangerously sharp teeth .

title: Flesh golem
description: Flesh golem A flesh golem is a ghoulish collection of humanoid body parts , stitched together into a single composite form . Description . Flesh golems are constructed using the physical body parts of once - living creatures .

title: Flesh mirage
description: Flesh mirage Flesh mirage was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could switch faces with another creature , living or dead .

title: Flesh ripper
description: Flesh ripper Flesh ripper was an evocation spell that attacked opponents with a black claw . Effect . The caster evoked pure evil power in the form of a black claw that flew at and slashed the target .

title: Flesh to stone
description: Flesh to stone Flesh to stone was a spell that caused the target , to be turned into a mindless , inert , stone statue . The reverse form , stone to flesh , could restore a body thus afflicted back to life , though there was a chance that it might not survive the shock of this transition . If applied to ordinary stone , the spell created the corresponding amout of dead flesh .

title: Fleshwort
description: Fleshwort Fleshwort was a plant that could be used to aid in the healing of injuries . Description . The stalks of fleshwort were gray and resembled .

title: Flickering venom
description: Flickering venom Flickering venom is an invocation used by some warlock s , which can be used to infect an enemy with deadly poison . When a warlock casts " flickering venom " he or she conjures a dagger - like weapon of venomous poison , which they then shoot into a creature within twenty - five feet of him or her . The deadliness of the dagger is largely determined by the warlock ' s charisma but dark pact warlocks also gain a benefit from their intellect , which allows them to stretch the reach of their attack from twenty - five to fifty feet .

title: Flight of Remnis
description: Flight of Remnis Flight of Remnis was a divine magic spell given to priests of Aerdrie Faenya . It called many birds of prey to the aid of the caster . Effects .

title: Flind
description: Flind Flinds were humanoid creatures related to gnoll s . A flind was a particularly strong and viscous gnoll that commanded the war band it was part of . They led their war bands into battle wielding flails imbued with magic by Yeenoghu himself .

title: Flinderspeld
description: Flinderspeld Flinderspeld was a deep gnome who was forced into slavery by the drow . History . Flinderspeld hailed from Blingdenstone .

title: Flink Thunderbonk
description: Flink Thunderbonk Flink Thunderbonk was a deep gnome apprentice wizard in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Flink was an apprentice wizard of Yantha Coaxrock , leader of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone .

title: Flinn
description: Flinn Captain Flinn was a sailor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Before he became a sailor , Flinn adventured with Daeghun Farlong , exploring dungeons .

title: Fll ' Yissetat
description: Fll ' Yissetat Fll ' Yissetat was a fairly powerful female green dragon who acted as an unwilling guardian for Abazigal ' s lair , having been geased into service . The key to unlocking the geas was a specific scroll kept elsewhere in Abazigal ' s lair . In order to reach Abazigal , the player character in " " will have to either release Fll ' Yissetat , in which case she will simply leave , or fight her .

title: Float
description: Float Float was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Flooded Forest
description: Flooded Forest The Flooded Forest was a swamp lying between Cormanthor , the Dragon Reach , and the Earthspur Mountains , between the lands of the Moonsea and the Vast in north Faerûn . Geography . The Flooded Forest was a section of the great forest of Cormanthor that lay beyond the River Lis .

title: Florfindyn
description: Florfindyn Florfindyn was an elf prince of Misty Forest circa 1363 DR . History . Florfindyn lived in peace with his people in the Misty Forest until 1363 DR , when , at the start of the Second Dragonspear War , the Hordes of Dragonspear attacked the forest .

title: Florin Falconhand
description: Florin Falconhand Florin Falconhand was a human ranger and senior member of the Knights of Myth Drannor and the husband of Dove Falconhand . Physical description . Florin was tall with curly hair .

title: Florio
description: Florio Florio was a Turami human adventurer in Mulmaster . Personality . Florio was a charismatic , natural - born leader .

title: Floshin Estates
description: Floshin Estates The Floshin Estates were a parcel of lightly wooded land located roughly halfway between Ardeep Forest and Daggerford . History . House Floshin had owned the land for longer than human history had been recorded in the area and they eventually built a manor house on it .

title: Floshwa
description: Floshwa Floshwa was a female loxo wizard and a member of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . In the 1360s DR , Floshwa went with the company to the Eastern Shaar , where they took an extended contract with the gold dwarves of the Great Rift . Their purpose was to study the chances of war in the local Underdark .

title: Flowery Pond Well
description: Flowery Pond Well Flowery Pond Well was a small oasis situated on the eastern half of the Kora Shan mountain range . Description . The oasis received its name from the water lilies that cover the surface of it .

title: Flubnak
description: Flubnak Flubnak was a gnoll chieftain and trapper around 1485 DR . History . Flubnak led a gnoll tribe near Daggerford .

title: Flumph
description: Flumph Flumphs were mysterious and benevolent creatures that drifted through the Underdark . Description . Flumphs floated by means of an innate anti - gravity field , and moved by using air jets as propulsion .

title: Fluorspar
description: Fluorspar Fluorspar , also called , was a soft , easily workable stone found in many colors . The pink and red varieties were sometimes called cabra stones . I Description .

title: Fluvenilstra
description: Fluvenilstra Fluvenilstra was an Underdark city located 11 miles ( 18 km . ) beneath the Shaar Desolation in southern Faerûn . The city was known primarily for its fungus forest and as a training ground for genasi who wished to mix their earth and water natures .

title: Fly
description: Fly Fly was a transmutation spell or supernatural ability that allowed the caster to fly for a time by simply concentrating . Cleric s of Baervan Wildwanderer , Brandobaris , Gwaeron Windstrom , Herne , Hoar , Ibrandul , Kelemvor , Lliira , Marthammor Duin , Mielikki , Myrkul , Oghma , Sehanine Moonbow , Selûne , Sharess , Shaundakul , Tyche , Tymora , Vhaeraun , and Waukeen were also sometimes granted this spell . Effects .

title: Flying ( property )
description: Flying ( property ) Flying was a quality that could be applied to melee weapons . The weapon could be commanded to follow very simple orders , and it could fly like an animated object . " Flying " weapons could also be used to guard a location , just like an animated skeleton could .

title: Flying Blade
description: Flying Blade The Flying Blade is one of the artifacts of The Nine . The spirit of Relve Langral is bound to the sword and may be called forth by the sword ' s owner and will unquestionably follow the owner ' s commands . His mind was twisted by Myrkul and he enjoys killing .

title: Flying Stag
description: Flying Stag The Flying Stag was an inn in Voonlar that offered peace and privacy to travelers able to afford some extra amenities . Location . The inn was on Blarun ' s Lane north of the intersection with Runstal ' s Ride , west of the bakery .

title: Flying dagger
description: Flying dagger A flying dagger is a magical dagger that is typically around 23cm ( 9in ) in length and can be given a trigger that will cause it to activate and attack a particular individual or type of creature . Due to the methods behind their creation , " flying daggers " are not brittle and will not rust . Some daggers might reflect or be immune to certain magic , or cause metal items to rust instantly upon contact , or potentially other properties .

title: Flying fist
description: Flying fist Alcimer ' s flying fist was an evocation spell that formed a small , invisible hand which could perform tasks which required little strength or dexterity . Effect . A ball of magical force took the shape of a gloved hand and could only be seen by the caster or those with the ability to see invisible objects .

title: Flying jambiya
description: Flying jambiya Flying jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could send a small blade flying after a target like a hawk chasing a rat .

title: Flyndagol
description: Flyndagol Flyndagol was an isolated city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Located in the far northwest corner of Durpar , Flyndagol sat on the west bank of the River Xon .

title: Fochlucan bandore
description: Fochlucan bandore A Fochlucan bandore was a masterwork magic bandore and one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Fochlucan bandores " were 3 - string instruments similar to lute s .

title: Fochu
description: Fochu Fochu was the main city of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . It was a violent and corrupt city . Usually the shogun assigned his least skilled administrators there .

title: Focran Samina
description: Focran Samina Focran Samina was the owner of Ropes for All Uses within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Focran was a sleight man .

title: Focus
description: Focus Focus was a faith magic spell that gathered devotional energy to power a semi - permanent divine effect . Effects . With this spell , the small amount of power generated by individual believers in a faith could be concentrated and used to augment and maintain a beneficial divine spell for a year .

title: Foesnare
description: Foesnare Foesnare is a basic evocation spell used by some swordmage s early in their training . When " foesnare " is cast it causes bolts of solid , eldritch energy to burst from the body of a creature struck with the swordmage ' s weapon . These bolts , grasping to the body of their victim , tie into the ground beneath , holding the creature still for a brief moment , in addition to wounding the victim with power proportionate to the swordmage ' s mental processing power .

title: Fog cloud
description: Fog cloud Fog cloud , formerly known as Veridon ' s cloud , was a conjuration spell that created a fog . Users . " Fog cloud " could be cast by druid s , sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the water domain .

title: Fog giant
description: Fog giant Fog giants are cousins of cloud giants with surprising stealth and cunning for their size . They lack their kindred ’ s magical aptitude but are adept hunters with the ability to slip unseen through the mist . A fog giant stands about 18 feet tall and is heavily muscled 8500 pounds , though not quite as strong as a cloud giant .

title: Fomorian
description: Fomorian The godless Fomorians are the " most hideous and wicked of all giantkind . " They are hideously deformed and misshapen , but the random positioning of their sense organs gives them keen perception . Fomorians have no loyalty beyond those they fear and seek the enslavement of all creatures , particularly other fey .

title: Foo Nakar
description: Foo Nakar Foo Nakar was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Foo Nakar lay at the mouth of the Malu River , within the great Quang Muku Forest .

title: Footmen
description: Footmen The Footmen served as the city watch of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . The footmen had 10 , 000 members broken into four watches of 2 , 500 men .

title: Forbiddance
description: Forbiddance Forbiddance was an abjuration spell that blocked all extraplanar travel within an area and warded the area against creatures of alignment s different from that of the caster . Effects . This spell had two major effects that operated on a volume up to one 60 ft ( 18 .

title: Forbidden
description: Forbidden The Forbidden was a group of people cursed by the True Gods to live in isolation on Jazirat al - Gawwar in deep southern Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . The Forbidden lived in isolation for 400 years on Jazirat al - Gawwar .

title: Forbidden Plateau
description: Forbidden Plateau The Forbidden Plateau was a high plateau lying beside a glacier in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It was the site of the Kingdom of Nix . The only way to reach it was through the elusive Phantom Pass , but even then , Nix only appeared once a year , around harvest - time .

title: Force
description: Force Force was a magical effect that could be added to any weapon , even ammunition such as arrow s . Use . It allowed the wielder to make destructive blasts of magical force with each attack .

title: Force orb
description: Force orb Force orb is an evocation spell learned by inexperienced wizard s . A wizard who casts " force orb " creates an invisible sphere of force energy , which he or she then throws a distance of 100 feet or less at a designated target . Once the orb collides with its target , it shatters and bursts into a series of invisible daggers that cut through both the target and adjacent objects .

title: Forcecage
description: Forcecage Forcecage , formerly known as Valdick ' s forcecage , was an evocation spell that fashioned a cube of force to imprison all within it . Effects . A " forcecage " spell created an immovable , invisible prison composed of pure force , similar to a " wall of force " .

title: Foresight
description: Foresight The spell foresight grants the caster powerful warnings about the future . History . The Netherese arcanist Smolyn is credited with the creation of this spell in - 1964 DR .

title: Forest Country
description: Forest Country The Forest Country ( also known as the Forest Kingdom ) was a forest basin southeast of the Stormhorns in the area now known as Cormyr . Mountains lie on the north , west and east sides of the forest , with an inlet of the Inner Sea to the south . This area was part of Cormanthor to the elves and would later become the nation of Cormyr .

title: Forest circle
description: Forest circle The forest circle was a druid circle associated with the great communities of trees that covered a great part of Faerûn . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Forest gnome
description: Forest gnome Forest gnomes are among the least commonly seen gnome s on Toril , far shier than even their deep gnome cousins . Small and reclusive , forest gnomes are so unknown to most non - gnomes that they have repeatedly been " discovered " by wandering outsiders who happen into their villages . Timid to an extreme , forest gnomes almost never leave their hidden homes .

title: Forest leaf
description: Forest leaf Forest leaf was a soup served at the Flying Stag inn , in Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description . Forest leaf was a thin broth , almost tea - like , made from a secret combination of boiled roots and leaves , served with berries floating in it .

title: Forest of Amtar
description: Forest of Amtar The Forest of Amtar was a large forest that formed the northern border of the nation of Dambrath . It comprise nearly half of the land area of Dambrath . Description .

title: Forest of Lethyr
description: Forest of Lethyr The Forest of Lethyr was one of the two forests that comprised the borders of the Great Dale , the other being Rawlinswood . Lethyr was the southern border and separated it from Thesk ( which claimed the trees south of the River Flam ) . The forest was guarded by druid s and ranger s as well as a few treant s .

title: Forest of Mir
description: Forest of Mir Prior to the Spellplague , the Forest of Mir was a dense forest that covered the southern highlands of Tethyr and continued south over the Marching Mountains and into Calimshan . Names . The Forest of Mir was named after the lost elven kingdom of Keltomir and the later human First Kingdom of Mir .

title: Forest of Tethir
description: Forest of Tethir The Forest of Tethir , also known as Wealdath , was the largest forest in the Lands of Intrigue and on the Sword Coast and one of the largest in all of Faerûn . Some scholars were of the opinion that the forest was the " single most important thing " that set the culture of Tethyr . Etymology .

title: Forest of Wyrms
description: Forest of Wyrms The Forest of Wyrms ( known as Ss ' kowlyn ' raa by the yuan - ti ) is a forest in the Western Heartlands . The air in the forest is cool and damp , and mists cover some areas of the ground . Inhabitants .

title: Forest troll
description: Forest troll Forest trolls were a subspecies of troll s usually residing in the woods . Description . Forest trolls had a long and thin frame and were usually between six and six and a half feet tall ( between 1 .

title: Foresters
description: Foresters The Foresters were elite members of the Aglarond an army . These troops were ranger s and patrolled the Yuirwood . They were skilled at using coastboat s for transportation and raids , particularly against invading forces .

title: Foresters ' Hall
description: Foresters ' Hall Foresters ' Hall was a long , low meeting hall used by the Foresters : an elite part of the Aglarond an army . The hall was decorated in the style of the Yuir elves , with runes and artifacts . It is used for long celebrations , feasting and drinking .

title: Forgefires
description: Forgefires Forgefires was a small dwarven stronghold located in Fimbrul , Returned Abeir . Background . The dwarves of Forgefires were xenophobic and only allowed other dwarves to enter in their domain .

title: Forgotten Forest
description: Forgotten Forest The Forgotten Forest lies in a vale between Evereska ' s Shaeradim to the east , and the Graypeak Mountains forty miles to the west . The Marsh of Chelimber is south of the forest , and to the north are the Lonely Vale and the Graycloak Hills .

title: Forgotten God
description: Forgotten God The Forgotten God was a mysterious deity worshiped at a temple in the Spine of the World mountains . Worshipers . Nothing was known about the Forgotten God except that his priests , referred to as acolytes , gained priestly powers from someone .

title: Forgotten Realms
description: Forgotten Realms The Forgotten Realms is a fictional alternate world that has been published as a campaign setting for " Advanced Dungeon & Dragons " ( " AD & D " ) , " Dungeons & Dragons " ( D & D ) , 3 Edition " Dungeons & Dragons " ( 3e ) , and 4 Edition " Dungeons and Dragons " ( 4e ) , by TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast ( WotC ) . The setting is also referenced in the 5 edition " Dungeons and Dragons " core books , though it has not yet been published as its own separate setting .

title: Forgotten Realms : Demon Stone
description: Forgotten Realms : Demon Stone Forgotten Realms : Demon Stone is a game with a story written by R . A . Salvatore about three adventurers who get involved in an inter - planar war .

title: Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide
description: Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide Contents . The " Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide " is the first portion , followed by the " Forgotten Realms Player ' s Guide " of the 4th edition release of the " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting for the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game . Unlike previous releases , like the 3rd edition variant , the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide " , or FRCG , focuses solely on proving information for rules referees and storytellers known as DMs , rather than for players .

title: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition
description: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition The Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition was the " original " second edition campaign setting , published in 1993 . This version features an image of a horse on a plain background on the box . This campaign setting was revised and re - released in 1996 .

title: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition ( revised )
description: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition ( revised ) The Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 2nd edition is the " revised " version of the original boxed second edition campaign setting , which was originally released in 1993 . This boxed set depicts Elminster Aumar on top of a rock on the cover .

title: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition
description: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition The Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting was published in 2001 by Wizards of the Coast , Inc . It is a Forgotten Realms campaign sourcebook for use with the 3rd edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " role - playing game . The book was written by Ed Greenwood , Sean K .

title: Forgotten Realms Interactive Atlas
description: Forgotten Realms Interactive Atlas The Forgotten Realms Interactive Atlas was developed by ProFantasy Software , the creators of for Wizards of the Coast . The developers created vector versions of the published maps for the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting " and included many new maps , including a globe of Abeir - Toril . There have been three updates published for the application that deliver over 800 maps .

title: Forgotten Realms Player ' s Guide
description: Forgotten Realms Player ' s Guide Contents . This is , along with the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Guide " , the most recent release of the " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting for " Dungeons & Dragons " . Unlike the " Campaign Guide " , which focuses on lore ( commonly refered as " fluff " ) and background information for so - called " dungeon masters " game referees and storytellers to use , the " Player ' s Guide " , or FRPG , focuses on " crunch , " that is to say , information immediately relevant to the game such as new player races , a new class , new paragon paths , and a number of other materials for players to make use of in their game .

title: Foril Obarskyr I
description: Foril Obarskyr I King Foril Obarskyr was a member of the Obarskyr s , the ruling family of Cormyr . He was born in the Year of True Omens , 1409 DR to King Azoun V and Nalara Marliir and named after his great - grandfather ' s only son who perished at the hands of a Fire Knives assassin at the age of two . He married Jemra Rhindaun , niece to Queen Sybille of Tethyr , in the Year of the Stalking Horses , 1430 DR and she gave birth to Irvel Obarskyr in the Year of the Lashing Tail , 1431 DR .

title: Forjia Chase
description: Forjia Chase Forjia Chase was a rogue and operative of the Zhentarim in 1375 working within the city of Melvaunt . Background . In 1361 DR , at the young age of seven , Forija fled Zhentil Keep as it was assaulted by the armies of Cyric .

title: Fork
description: Fork The Fork was located where the trail east from Sundabar split to go north along the Adbar Road toward Citadel Adbar , and east along the Fork Road toward Ascore . Geography . The lonely and wild spot seemed like the end of Faerûn , splitting toward the dwarfholds of the Ice Mountains , and the nameless track heading east to the ruins of Ascore .

title: Fork Road
description: Fork Road Fork Road was an east - to - west road joining Sundabar at the western end to Ascore at the eastern end . Starting at Sundabar , Fork Road passed by Newfort just before the road entered the gap between the Nether Mountains and the Rauvin Mountains . Just before the Fork , where Fork Road met Adbar Road , down a narrow cart track was the village of Deadsnows .

title: Formian
description: Formian Formians were an ant - like race of outsider s . Description . Formians were brown and resembled a cross between an ant and a centaur .

title: Forsyl Filarfar
description: Forsyl Filarfar Forsyl Filarfar was an accomplished abjurer living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Personality . Forsyl was a gentle , quiet man .

title: Fort Agis
description: Fort Agis Fort Agis , also known as Memnonnar Citadel , was one of the border keeps of Tethyr , collectively known as the Calimmon Garrisons . Location . This fort was located two miles north of Memnon on the edge of the ruins of Memnonnar .

title: Fort Arran
description: Fort Arran Fort Arran is an outpost that guards the Golden Road between Sespech and Arrabar , the capital of Chondath . The fort serves as a warning of sorts for the people of Sespech should a war break out with their neighbors . As such , messengers are ready to be dispatched to Mimph , Elbulder and Ormpetarr with warning for the rest of the country .

title: Fort Beluarian
description: Fort Beluarian Fort Beluarian was a trade outpost in northern Chult that was run by the Flaming Fist and later belonged to the city - state of Baldur ' s Gate . Geography . Fort Beluarian was located on the northern tip of Chult , northeast of Port Nyanzaru and near the eastern shore of the Bay of Chult .

title: Fort Ilbratha
description: Fort Ilbratha " Fort Ilbratha " was the name given to an abandoned fort in the eastern foothills of the Troll Mountains , Amn . Location . The fort once controlled the quickest east – west pass through the Troll Mountains .

title: Fort Locke
description: Fort Locke Fort Locke was a garrison southern end of the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast . Geography . Located between Highcliff and West Harbor , Fort Locke was built as a garrison .

title: Fort Morninglord
description: Fort Morninglord Fort Morninglord was an Elturgardian fortress located a day ' s ride from Elturel . In 1476 DR the entire garrison of paladin s disappeared overnight and every stone in the fort was blackened and fused . The High Overseer of Torm feared the fort was contaminated by some evil and ordered all entrances sealed and declared that anyone entering the fort would be outlawed .

title: Forthar Helvenstron
description: Forthar Helvenstron Forthar Helvenstron was a Zhentilar commander involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Forthar was a Zhentilar commander who was part of the Zhentarim Occupation Army in Shadowdale in 1375 DR .

title: Fortify
description: Fortify Fortify was a cooperative magic spell allowing one priest to enhance the healing powers of another . Effects . The priest casting " fortify " had to touch another priest casting " cure light wounds " , " cure serious wounds " , or " cure critical wounds " on a subject , and both spells had to be cast simultaneously .

title: Fortress of Jorhat
description: Fortress of Jorhat The Fortress of Jorhat , or Jorhat Citadel , was a fortification located in the Hordelands . Location . The ruins of this fortress sat halfway up the mountain of Jorhat Shan .

title: Fortress of the Five Vultures
description: Fortress of the Five Vultures The Fortress of the Five Vultures was a castle in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Calauntans jokingly called it " the Sevensroost " . Description .

title: Fortress of the Half - Demon
description: Fortress of the Half - Demon The Fortress of the Half - Demon is a ruined stone fort located north of Rashemen . It was built thousands of years ago by the Nar and has a huge iron gate fashioned into the face of a leering demon . One of the gates is ajar which is the source of the name " Half - Demon " The fortress is square in shape and has a huge stone keep in the center of the courtyard .

title: Fortune candle
description: Fortune candle A fortune candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It granted the subject ( s ) a modicum of luck ( similar to a " luckstone " ) when the vagaries of life could not be avoided . Description .

title: Fossil
description: Fossil Fossil was a remnant of an angel in service to the god Cyric . In 1479 DR , he existed in the form of a sentient mask . He recalled the spirit of Madri from the dead and manipulated her into plotting against the deva Demascus .

title: Foulwing
description: Foulwing Foulwings were huge , monstrous aberration s . Description . They were very large with black , leathery wings , toad - like bodies , and horse - like heads .

title: Founder
description: Founder The Founder was a female Red Wizard of Thay . History . She was the lover of the Chosen of Myrkul , Akachi .

title: Foundry
description: Foundry The Foundry was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This area of the City of Brass had many plazas , wide streets , and opulent homes .

title: Fountain of Happiness Inn
description: Fountain of Happiness Inn The Fountain of Happiness Inn was the largest inn found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Structure . Located near the Jade Gate , the inn was complete with a full courtyard , stable and additional guest houses located around a Shou - style garden .

title: Fountain of Stars
description: Fountain of Stars The Fountain of Stars was a white fountain in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description . The white fountain depicted birds , flowers , trees and other icons of nature .

title: Fountains of Memory
description: Fountains of Memory The Fountains of Memory were a mysterious source of water that permitted one to see inside pieces of the history selected by the observer . Description . Originally , they were a series of pools located somewhere in the Northdark .

title: Four
description: Four The Four were adventurers from Waterdeep . Activities . The organization was banned from working in Cormyr and Amn , but did business in the North and Tethyr .

title: Fourteenth Skull
description: Fourteenth Skull The Fourteenth Skull was the legendary " extra " skull in Skullport . Personality . Although he was similar in nature to the Skulls of Skullport , he operated independently unlike the Skulls who seemed to behave collectively .

title: Fourthpeak
description: Fourthpeak Fourthpeak was one of the many mountains which rested along the huge range known as the Spine of the World . Geography . Fourthpeak was one of four mountains whose peaks , when standing in the correct place , aligned perfectly .

title: Fox ' s cunning
description: Fox ' s cunning Fox ' s cunning was a transmutation spell that increased the chance to perform any skill requiring intelligence . Effects . The caster had to touch the target of this spell in order to cast it .

title: Fox - at - Twilight
description: Fox - at - Twilight The Fox - at - Twilight ( real name : Ilira ) was a swashbuckler and con artist , the moon elf called " Light " by her friends was an enigma at best . Description . Twilight was often described as having an athletic build , slight and lithe ( sensual ) with a kind of allure not entirely like that of an elf .

title: Fox Ridge
description: Fox Ridge Fox Ridge was a rise of ground on the east side of the Ashaba in Shadowdale . Geography . The ridge was north of the temple of Chauntea and south of Storm ' s Farm .

title: Foxberry
description: Foxberry Foxberry was a snaky vine that grew in the midwood area of the forest of Cormanthor , often near beech trees . It had yellow , greasy , grape - like berries that smelled like meat . These berries could even be eaten by the meat - eaters in the forest .

title: Foxe
description: Foxe Foxe was a priest of Deneir at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . Foxe was the eldest in his family . The lama Koja of Khazari could not pronounce his family name , and so called him " Firstborn Foxe " in honor of this position .

title: Foxilon Cardluck
description: Foxilon Cardluck Foxilon Cardluck , better known as Foxy , was a crew - member of the Halruaan caravel " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Foxy was born in Luiren but soon left in search of adventures with some halfling companions .

title: Foxmantle
description: Foxmantle The Foxmantles were one of the merchant - noble families of Sembia . Their businesses included farming , pressing wine , growing dyestuffs , salting meat , and tanning hides and furs . Their family crest was three vigilant eyes in purple set on a slant .

title: Fraasz
description: Fraasz Fraasz was a duergar city located deep under the Sunrise Mountains in eastern Rashemen . History . The city was originally located in a vault beneath Thay but earthquakes caused by the Spellplague nearly destroyed the old city and the duergar relocated .

title: Fracto - Nimbuli
description: Fracto - Nimbuli Fracto - Nimbuli was a cloud giant ally of Yrkhetep in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Usually Fracto - Nimbuli was in his main room with three spotted lion s as pets .

title: Fraeyer Illance
description: Fraeyer Illance Fraeyer Illance , tall thin darkly handsome and soft - spoken cold heart , one of the younger and better - traveled members of his family , now most energetic in promoting family interests , unscrupulous and follows the motto " Freedom from all laws , and a spur to all profits , daggers for our foes , and a pox on all lawmakers and keepers . " ( hinted to be a family motto )

title: Franko Olbert
description: Franko Olbert Franko Olbert was a man from Nesme in the late 15th century DR . History . Franko born in Nesmè from an Uthgardt mother and a Nesmè man .

title: Fraternity of Tharos
description: Fraternity of Tharos The Fraternity of Tharos was a demon - worshiping cult based in New Sarshel in Impiltur . The group took its name from the ancient Nar capital of Dun - Tharos . The group conducted bloody rituals that required members to kidnap innocent victims and then sacrifice them on the Demonstone which lay in a tower in New Sarshel .

title: Fray
description: Fray The Fray were thirteen mage s who helped the Fourteenth Skull maintain the weakened mythal around Skullport known as the Mantle in the 15th century DR . Members of the Fray were given great power by the Fourteenth Skull but it drove them mad . They were promised that once the mythal was restored to its former power they would become the new Skulls of Skullport .

title: Fraz - Urb ' luu
description: Fraz - Urb ' luu Fraz - Urb ' luu , styled the Prince of Deception , was a demon lord . Abilities . His vision was excellent and piercing with both darkvision and " true seeing " .

title: Fredegar Rockcrusher
description: Fredegar Rockcrusher Fredegar Rockcrusher , also known as Fret , was a dwarf sage under the charge of Alustriel in Silverymoon . He was a trusted advisor to both Alustriel and her sister Dove Falconhand . Description .

title: Fredegast
description: Fredegast Fredegast was the young sheriff of the halfling town of Waukeshire in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Fredegast and his people met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .

title: Free Cities of Zakhara
description: Free Cities of Zakhara The Free Cities of Zakhara were a group of city - states along the north coast of that continent . Geography . Each of these city - states was located at the mouth of a river .

title: Free Cities of the Vilhon Reach
description: Free Cities of the Vilhon Reach The Free Cities of the Vilhon Reach were a collection of independent city - states that separated themselves from Chondath . Hlondeth , Lachom , Nimpeth , Reth , and Surkh were considered the five key free cities but the villages of Elupar and Nun were often grouped with them as well . History .

title: Free action
description: Free action Free action was a divine abjuration and enchantment spell that allowed an individual to move normally while under water or against magic that impeded movement . Effects . The caster was required to touch the target of this spell and it lasted for over an hour , with even longer duration for more experienced casters .

title: Freedale
description: Freedale Though far from other towns , Freedale remains a busy place . Elves traveling west often stop in Freedale for supplies , as do other travelers from the east . Freedale is also a stop for those traveling up or down the River Ashaba , docking their boats or barges at the wharfs south of town .

title: Freedom
description: Freedom Freedom is an abjuration spell that releases a creature from imprisonment . Effects . The subject is freed from spells and effects that restrict his movement , including " entangle " , " hold " , " imprisonment " , " paralysis " , " petrification " , " sleep " , " slow " , stunning , " temporal stasis " , and " web " .

title: Freedom Riders
description: Freedom Riders The Freedom Riders were the military forces organized by Randal Morn to expel the Zhentarim from Daggerdale . After victory in 1369 DR , they became the official army of the dale . History .

title: Freedom domain
description: Freedom domain The two deities who hold influence over the freedom domain are Ilmater and Mielikki . Ilmater ' s primary mission is to keep others from feeling the weight of hardship , pain and being controlled against ones wish . The freedom the crying god grants comes from his own suffering .

title: Freedom of movement
description: Freedom of movement Freedom of movement is a common abjuration spell that allows the subject to move normally despite impediments . Effect . This spell enables you or the creature you touch to move and attack normally for the duration of the spell , even under the influence of magic that usually impedes movement , such as " hold person " , " paralysis " , " solid fog " , " slow " , and " web " spells .

title: Freeze
description: Freeze Freeze was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It could attack a creature with biting cold and possibly encase the target in ice . Effects .

title: Freezing cloud
description: Freezing cloud Freezing cloud is a spell of the evocation school used by wizard s early in their studies . When cast , " freezing cloud " creates a tiny pellet of ice , which shoots from the hand of its caster to a spot within fifty feet of him or her . There , the pellet explodes into a cloud of freezing mist over an area of ten feet in radius .

title: Frenzy dog
description: Frenzy dog The frenzy dog is a magical transformation of almost any other animal , created by the special " create frenzy dog " spell , used by the druid s of Chondalwood to protect their environment . The spell that creates these creatures is barely known outside this forest , and the druids use it sparingly , creating a pack of only around a dozen frenzy dogs at one time , wary of their ability to ruin forest environments if left unchecked . A frenzy dog gains a certain amount of magical intelligence , but only enough for hunting .

title: Freona
description: Freona madame Freona was an halfling businesswoman in Phlan . Personality . Freona has a keen taste for finer things in life .

title: Friary of St . Amahl
description: Friary of St . Amahl The Friary of St . Amahl was an Ilmatari monastery in the middle of the Calim Desert .

title: Fried Rat
description: Fried Rat The Fried Rat was a restaurant on Rat Alley in Luskan established by two retired shiphands who had developed a taste for rat after long periods at sea , and wanted to serve it . History . The restaurant burned down long before 1370 DR .

title: Friendly Arm Inn
description: Friendly Arm Inn The Friendly Arm Inn was a walled hamlet on the Coast Way between Baldur ' s Gate and the town of Beregost . Interior . The most prominent building around the hamlet was the stone keep which housed the titular inn , which was run by Bentley Mirrorshade .

title: Friendly Word
description: Friendly Word The Friendly Word was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teaching of Zann , the Zakharan god of learning and intelligence . Symbol . Though they did not use unique weapons , members of the Friendly Word left a pen - shaped dagger in the pillow of their target as a calling card and warning .

title: Friends
description: Friends Friends was an arcane enchantment spell that could influence the mood of a creature in favor of the caster . Effects . While the caster concentrated , for up to one minute , the target creature became more inclined to believe , be persuaded or otherwise influenced by the caster .

title: Frigid blade
description: Frigid blade Frigid blade is a transmutation spell used by swordmage s , particularly those who prefer to use fire and ice together in their spells . When a swordmage casts " frigid blade " they fill their weapon with icy power , freezing the flesh of its target and the air around it . When used on a creature , this causes the said creature to slow down substantially , the exact percentage dependent upon how durable the swordmage ' s own flesh is .

title: Frigid darkness
description: Frigid darkness Frigid darkness , is an invocation of the evocation school used by many warlock s , particularly those of the star pact . When a warlock casts " frigid darkness " he or she summons to a spot within fifty feet of him or herself a pool of freezing shadow . These shadows cling to any creature unfortunate enough to be within their grasp , bestowing them with a sample of the dark cold of the night sky .

title: Frisky chest
description: Frisky chest Frisky chest was an enchantment spell that enabled an object to avoid being approached by anyone other than the caster . Effects . The caster had to touch the object to cast this spell , and the object had to be movable , non - living , and fit inside a 10 ft ( 3 m ) cube .

title: Frizzerfraz
description: Frizzerfraz Frizzerfrazz was a young gold dragon living in the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish in 1358 DR and 1374 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Frizzerfrazz was attacked by a group of wyvern s controlled by Muktar ' s army .

title: Froghemoth
description: Froghemoth Froghemoths were elephant - sized amphibious predators with four tentacles and three eyes . They were revered by bullywug s , who treated them as gods . Relations .

title: Frost ( property )
description: Frost ( property ) Frost is a property that can be magically added to a masterwork weapon . Upon command , a " frost " weapon is sheathed in icy cold . The cold does not harm the wielder .

title: Frost Giant ' s Fury
description: Frost Giant ' s Fury Frost Giant ' s Fury is a series of " Forgotten Realms " comic books published by . It is a direct continuation of the previous series " Shadows of the Vampire " and " Legends of Baldur ' s Gate " . Summary .

title: Frost Hills
description: Frost Hills The Frost Hills were a barren region in the southern reaches of the Spine of the World . Geography . Located in the southernmost tip of the Spine of the World , the Frost Hills were bordered by the Evermoors to the south and the Silver Marches to the west .

title: Frost agate
description: Frost agate Frost agate , also called frost stone , was a beautiful member of the agate family found in the Realms . Description . These rare ornamental stones were had white markings that resembled frost over the base color of the stone .

title: Frost backlash
description: Frost backlash Frost backlash is a fairly complex spell learned by swordmage initiates , particularly those of the shielding style of arcane swordplay . Unlike most spells , " frost backlash " can be cast instantaneously , and is used to transform the magic al warding projected by all swordmages into frigid ice , which explodes out from the swordmage ' s weapon when they are injured by a nearby enemy . Even if the spell misses its target , the wave of cold energy still injures the attacker , making " frost backlash " an effective form of retaliation .

title: Frost breath
description: Frost breath Frost breath was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused a blast of frigid air to emit from the caster ' s mouth . Effects .

title: Frost fingers
description: Frost fingers Frost fingers was a divine spell given to specialty priest s of Auril . This spell produced a fan of freezing cold and ice analogous to the " burning hands " spell . There was an arcane version of this spell that had a narrower field but greater range than the divine version .

title: Frost folk
description: Frost folk The frost folk were a race of human s that long ago struck a bargain with a cold power . Physical characteristics . Frost folk had the height and weight of typical humans .

title: Frost giant
description: Frost giant Frost giants , called isejotunen in their own language , are large giant s that live in caverns or castles in cold , mountainous environments . Description . Almost always evil creatures , these giants stand 15 ' ( 4 .

title: Frost whip
description: Frost whip Frost whip was a divine magic spell given to specialty priest s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It produced an insubstantial , flexible beam of cold that could be used as a weapon . Effects .

title: Frostbind
description: Frostbind Frostbind is an transmutation spell used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When a sorcerer casts " frostbind " he or she causes chilling ice to envelop the flesh of a creature within fifty feet , slowing their reactions and injuring them . " Frostbind " is relatively difficult to use for its level of complexity and as such a sorcerer is required to rest at least a few minutes before casting it again .

title: Frostbite
description: Frostbite Frostbite was a cyricist winter wolf involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Frostbite was recruited by Cyric in 1368 DR when he was part of the monster ' s army that assaulted Zhentil Keep at the god ' s will ; he continued to work with the Church of Cyric even after ; in 1375 DR the high members of the church of Cyric send Frostbite to Shadowdale to observe and eventually gained power by the Zhent occupation of the dale .

title: Frostbite ( spell )
description: Frostbite ( spell ) Frostbite was a divine magic spell available to priests of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It inflicted bone - chilling cold on one creature , causing freezing damage and fatigue from hypothermia . Effects .

title: Frostbrand
description: Frostbrand Frostbrand , or frost brand , weapons were designed to fight creatures with an affinity for fire . Powers . These weapons were particularly effective against creatures with a tie to the Elemental Plane of Fire .

title: Frostfell
description: Frostfell Frostfell by Mark Sehestedt is the last book of The Wizards series of standalone novels . The story is continued in the Chosen of Nendawen trilogy . Summary .

title: Frosthelm
description: Frosthelm Frosthelm was king of Sundabar during the early 15th century DR . Relationships . He was the son of Helm Dwarf - Friend and become the king of Sundabar after his father ' s death .

title: Frostrill
description: Frostrill Frostrill was a small thorp located in the Druarwood , north of the Moonwood and the Cold Wood , in the Silver Marches . Inhabitants . The thorp ' s inhabitants were exclusively arctic dwarves and were led by Unimak Giantskull around 1372 DR .

title: Frozenfar
description: Frozenfar The Frozenfar was a barren region north of the Spine of the World . Usage . The Frozenfar did not have definable boundaries .

title: Fruitcake
description: Fruitcake Fruitcake was a sweet bread studded with dried fruits and nuts and flavored with rum or brandy made on the Pirate Isles . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Frulam Mondath
description: Frulam Mondath Frulam Mondath was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin , holding the rank of Wearer of the Purple . Relationships . Mondath considered Langdedrosa Cyanwrath , her right - hand and often kept the half - dragon at her side .

title: Fu - shora
description: Fu - shora Fu - shora was a geisha in Semmishi on Wa around 1357 DR . History . Fu - shora , born as Ido Fushora , was the youngest daughter of Ido Kunarakuai , chief justice of the executive court .

title: Fual al Barasth
description: Fual al Barasth Fual yn Senaor al Barasth was a Calishite sage and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Fual was a minor druzir in the Defenders ' Drudach of Memnon , so his position did not permit him the command of many soldiers , and he let the administrative decisions be made by the qayadin .

title: Fuantze Wah
description: Fuantze Wah Fuantze Wah was a yakuza participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . Relationships . Fuantze Wah was a member of a small yakuza gang .

title: Fugue Plane
description: Fugue Plane The Fugue Plane is a neutral plane within the Astral Sea where the souls of mortals are drawn when they die . The vast majority of this plane is flat , gray , bland and nondescript , with no notable topographical features . The sky overhead is also gray .

title: Fukada Shiro
description: Fukada Shiro Fukada Shiro was a samurai lord and ally of the Hiro clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Fukada owned the shoen surrounding the Gobo village .

title: Fukawa
description: Fukawa Fukawa was a mysterious sage in Shou Lung . Personality . Fukawa spoke all the time , about all kinds of subjects .

title: Fulbar Hardcheese
description: Fulbar Hardcheese Fulbar Hardcheese was a halfling tavern owner in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Fulbar was an adventurer in his youth .

title: Fulgath
description: Fulgath Fulgath was a male human merchant from Dagger Falls that owned Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies . He was well known for both his high prices and wide range of equipment . Description .

title: Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies
description: Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies Fulgath ' s Caravan Supplies was a large shop in Dagger Falls . Structure . The barnlike shop was a thick stone building with large twin doors .

title: Fulminorax
description: Fulminorax Fulminorax was a blue dragon allied with Valindra Shadowmantle in 1484 DR . History . To fulfill the terms of their alliance , Valindra agreed to send Fulminorax into the Feywild to help King Malabog to destroy New Sharandar .

title: Fulta
description: Fulta Fulta was a halfling criminal in Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . Fulta was a freelance criminal in Phlan with a group of her fellows acting as her guards .

title: Funada Genzo
description: Funada Genzo Funada Genzo was the harbormaster of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Genzo was an efficient harbormaster , commander of the shipyard garrison and supervisor of the shipping in the port .

title: Funada Hashiba
description: Funada Hashiba Funada Hashiba was an abbott in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hashiba led the Nakamaru temple of the Shining Mountain Sect , a very popular temple leading most ceremonies at the local court , which was a prestigious honor .

title: Funada Mitsuhide
description: Funada Mitsuhide Funada Mitsuhide was the daimyo of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Often Mitsuhide was in Uwaji in attendance to the shogun ( where his wife and young children lived ) .

title: Funada Toragi
description: Funada Toragi Funada Toragi was a kuei in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . In life , Toragi was the brother of Funada Kazuo , the father of Funada Mitsuhide and Funada Toyoo .

title: Funada Toyoo
description: Funada Toyoo Funada Toyoo was the administrator of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Often his brother the daimyo Funada Mitsuhide was in Uwaji in attendance to the shogun and during these times was Toyoo that run the city .

title: Funada clan
description: Funada clan The Funada clan were the ruling family in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Funada hold the position of daimyo and of many key city officers , plus some members hold important positions in local temples . They kept a close eye over their vassals house thank to their allegiance with the ninja of Hijo clan and to many lesser samurai families , who wanted improve their own position .

title: Furdah Rustauk
description: Furdah Rustauk Furdah Rustauk was the name of the harbor in Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . The walls surrounding Furdah Rustauk were the oldest in the city , sitting in a state of disrepair .

title: Furgis Boltsmelter
description: Furgis Boltsmelter Furgis Boltsmelter was a dwarf criminal in Moonsea . Activities . Furgis was a criminal who could be hired to procure information or objects from people with a skill that was uncanny .

title: Furifax
description: Furifax Furifax was the most powerful bandit leader in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Furifax was traveling with his parents in the Eastern Shaar when they were killed by bandits .

title: Furlinastis
description: Furlinastis Furlinastis was a shadow dragon who lived in a swamp on the Plane of Shadow . His body was covered in moving shadows which twisted into the faces of the souls that were trapped within it . These souls once kept a shard of Mask ' s divinity which was stolen by Kesson Rel and then trapped within the shadow dragon ' s body .

title: Furo
description: Furo Furo was the Padhrasattva of Knowledge within the Path of Enlightenment . Furo ' s teachings took the form of a number of sutra s . Followers of Furo were taught to refrain from strong alcohol ic drinks and eating meat .

title: Furrowed Mountains
description: Furrowed Mountains The Furrowed Mountains , or Jibal al - Hutut , were a prominent mountain range found in North Zakhara . Geography . The Furrowed Mountains ran inland in a northeast diagonal line roughly parallel to the coast of the Great Sea , effectively separating the Free Cities of Zakhara from the harsh desert of the Haunted Lands , before terminating near the World Pillar Mountains and the Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Furthinghome
description: Furthinghome Furthinghome was a trading port city in Aglarond and one of the oldest cities in the nation . Description . Around 1368 DR , it was made up of some buildings in the traditional Aglarondan weathered wood style and others made from stone .

title: Fury
description: Fury The Fury was a plague caused by the demon Scour . Victims were infected through the bite of an infected creature and developed oozing sores and strange crimson cystaline growths . Those infected became increasingly aggressive and , if they didn ' t die in a fight , eventually lost their minds .

title: Fury ' s Heart
description: Fury ' s Heart Fury ' s Heart was a Fiendish plane in the World Tree cosmology model . It was the home plane of the Gods of Fury , Auril , Malar , Talos , and Umberlee until the Spellplague scrambled the cosmos . In the wake of that world - shaping event , it merged with the House of Nature to form the Deep Wilds , except for Talos ' s portion , which the aspect of Gruumsh took with him to Nishrek .

title: Fusae
description: Fusae Fusae was a mute businesswoman in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Fusae was the daughter of a famous samurai general but when she was young her father was involved in a plot against the daimyo and in punishment her parents were both executed and Fusae and other members of the family were demoted to the eta caste .

title: Fydor
description: Fydor Fydor was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Fydor was one of the commanders of the fire giant army in the attack on Szith Morcane .

title: Fylo Nelgorn
description: Fylo Nelgorn Fylo Nelgorn was a Zhent diplomat in Nesmé sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Fylo was a priest of Bane who led the Zhentarim delegation in the reconstruction of Nesmé in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR .

title: Fyndrick Dellmon
description: Fyndrick Dellmon Fyndrick Dellmon was the youngest son of Kerbin Dellmon during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , the Iceshield orc s attacked many farms around the Dellmon farm .

title: Fyodor
description: Fyodor Fyodor was a berserker from Rashemen . He was a companion and lover to Liriel Baenre . He was a member of the Black Bear Lodge " fang " in Dernovia .

title: Fyraven
description: Fyraven Fyraven was the oldest human - settled area of Tethyr . Geography . Fyraven was a county of Cape Velen .

title: Fyrefly
description: Fyrefly A fyrefly is a 2 " ( 5cm ) - long flying insect that flickers with flame at night . Diet . The fyrefly eats vegetation .

title: Fyrentennimarr
description: Fyrentennimarr Fyrentennimarr was a powerful red dragon who had her lair in the Snowflake Mountains . Fyrentennimarr was a very powerful and famous red dragon living in the region . History .

title: Fyrfar Smokebeard
description: Fyrfar Smokebeard Fyrfar Smokebeard was a dwarf and a Master Smith of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . In the early 7th century , Fyrfar forged over a thousand weapons from orcslayer metal over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard . Among these was the short sword " Sarghathuld " in the Year of the Many Serpents , 605 DR .

title: Fyrillicus
description: Fyrillicus Fyrillius was a red dragon in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Fyrillicus patrolled the lands around the gate of the castle of Orcus .
