title: Fzoul Chembryl
description: Fzoul Chembryl Fzoul Chembryl was the Faerûnian god of service to evil as well as an exarch of Bane . Formerly the mortal Chosen tyrant of his dark overlord , Fzoul was killed while fighting the Shadovar and was granted the status of an exarch as his reward for dying in Bane ' s service . History .

title: Ga Nomes
description: Ga Nomes Ga Nomes is a gnomish drinking song apparently written by Mintiper Moonsilver as a ' thank you ' to the gnomes of the High Forest who helped him to speed through the area via the Trail of Mists . The song has inspired many bar brawls since its first reported performance in 1344 DR and other gnomes have added their own verses in order to insult every audience . The original goes as follows :

title: Gabble Dripskillet
description: Gabble Dripskillet Gabble Dripskillet was the main deep gnome representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Gabble was a merchant and shopkeeper selling salt , gemstones , and rare minerals .

title: Gabriel
description: Gabriel Gabriel was a solar in the service of Bahamut . History . In 1357 DR , Gabriel was captured by a group of balor s in the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus .

title: Gabrielle
description: Gabrielle Gabrielle was a wizard - in - training of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . History . Gabrielle grew up in Bloodstone Village dreaming of becoming a wizard .

title: Gabulla
description: Gabulla Gabulla was a goblin shaman living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . History . Around 1486 DR , Gabulla was possessed by the pit fiend Baazka and , under his manipulation , convinced her leader Shorg to invade the village of Julkoun , following the suggestion of one of the Red Wizards of Thay .

title: Gacholoth
description: Gacholoth Gacholoths serve as the infiltrators and terrorists of the Blood War , causing havoc and spreading panic to all sides . These master betrayers have a fondness for deceit and terror that makes them well - favored by yugoloth commanders . They may spend even centuries serving and ingratiating themselves to a baatezu or tanar ' ri master , serving with the utmost loyalty , all the while planning for the best moment to torture and slaughter their supposed allies .

title: Gaedynn Ulraes
description: Gaedynn Ulraes Gaedynn Ulraes was a warrior and an officer in the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . He was primarily known for his superb markmanship as an archer . History .

title: Gaerdal Ironhand
description: Gaerdal Ironhand Gaerdal Ironhand ( " GAIR - dul EYE - urn - hand " ) , was a lawful good deity of the gnome pantheon , led by the Greater deity Garl Glittergold . The sternest and most serious of gnome deities , Gaerdal was the patron of warriors and protectors of gnomish communities . As such , he was honored in some manner by nearly all good - aligned gnomes , and one or two crusaders would be found in most sizable settlements .

title: Gaerradh
description: Gaerradh Gaerradh was an elf ranger and scout in the High Forest and also a member of the Harpers . Description . Gaerradh had long russet hair tied back in a single braid .

title: Gahlaerd Mossmere
description: Gahlaerd Mossmere Gahlaerd Mossmere was a sarcastic yet witty wizard from Tilverton who spent his time primarily developing , experimenting with , and selling spells of his own creation . He made a comfortable living as his spells were worth tens of thousands of gold . Rumours .

title: Gai
description: Gai Gai was a Shou Harper agent near Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gai was watching a puppet show in a tavern near Hillsfar , while his superior Olisara Lightsong hired an adventuring party to investigate some cases of kidnapped farmers in the area , possibly related to the Red Plumes .

title: Gailan
description: Gailan Gailan was the commander of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Gailan always saw a military solution to all kind of problems .

title: Gaitiyah al - Aranib
description: Gaitiyah al - Aranib Gaitiyah al - Aranib was an employee of the Merchant ' s Home in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Tun Hayal , the owner of the Merchant ' s Home , trusted Gaitiyah with managing the affairs of the lavish .

title: Gaius Varro
description: Gaius Varro Gaius Varro was the Lord Marshal of Ravens Bluff from about 1355 DR - - ? Appearance . Gaius is 6 ' 4 " tall and 310 pounds and easily the most recognizable man in the city .

title: Gak Fixen
description: Gak Fixen Gak Fixen was a surface gnome merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Gak was bloodthirsty and evil , as his appearance showed .

title: Gaki
description: Gaki Gaki , also called nin - chu - ju - gaki were rumored to be the reincarnated spirits of wicked people . Description . Gaki were horrible humanoid monsters with several different forms .

title: Gal - ralan
description: Gal - ralan A gal - ralan was a cold iron armband with long needles on the interior . It was worn by shadar - kai to negate the effects of their shadow curse . It did this by nailing together the shadar - kai ' s body and soul ; however , it also caused constant pain to its wearer .

title: Galaeron Nihmedu
description: Galaeron Nihmedu Galaeron Nihmedu was an elf shadow adept and a minor noble of Evereska , Lasthaven to the elves of Faerûn . Description . Galaeron was tall and solidly built for a moon elf and had the pale skin and regal features common to his race ; two decades of serving as a Tomb Guard along the Desert Border South have left his face mildly rugged and weather - beaten .

title: Galaghard Obarskyr I
description: Galaghard Obarskyr I Galaghard Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . It is said that a particular moonstone chess set in the royal palace has a good likeness of him . He is Duar Obarskyr ' s only son and heir from his second wife .

title: Galaghard Obarskyr III
description: Galaghard Obarskyr III Galaghard Obarskyr III was the king of Cormyr from 897 DR to 953 DR and fought against the invading Witchlords of Wyvernwater . History . Born in 873 DR , Galaghard was the first son of Bryntarth I .

title: Galauntar Hawkhelm
description: Galauntar Hawkhelm Galauntar Hawkhelm was the commander of the forces at the Citadel of the Raven prior to and during the invasion of the Zhentarim . He died from wounds he recieved in a battle with a horde of orc s ; his final act was successfully leading the remainder of his forces to safety from these dual dangers . the group would later form the organization known as the Knights of the North .

title: Galbi
description: Galbi Galbi was the owner of the House of Galbi in Manass in 1367 DR . Activities . Galbi ' s business practices and his willingness to cater to illicit ventures forced him to flee his native home in Semphar .

title: Galdel
description: Galdel Galdel was a small city located in central Halruaa . Description . Galdel was a quiet town nestled on the southern banks of Lake Halruaa .

title: Galeb duhr
description: Galeb duhr Galeb duhr ( gay - leb DOR ) were magical creatures of stone that appeared almost like animated boulders , with the power to control the rocks around them . Description . When galeb duhr were not moving , they could choose to appear exactly like a boulder , but when they opened their eyes or moved , one could see that they had dark , foreboding eyes , a wide mouth , and two appendages that acted as both hands and feet .

title: Galeerie Mulurkrath
description: Galeerie Mulurkrath Galeerie Mulurkrath was a wizard who lived during the 3rd century DR . He held the title of Magister from 246 DR until 249 DR . Personality .

title: Galen
description: Galen Galen was a male human who visited the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Galen was a traveling merchant who bought and sold things along the Sword Coast .

title: Galena Mountains
description: Galena Mountains The Galena Mountains or simply the Galenas ) was a range of mountains that formed a natural border around Vaasa and Damara in Northeast Faerûn . Geography . The range was about 250 mi ( 402 km ) long and not more than about 25 mi ( 40 km ) wide , forming a ring around Vaasa from the west to the east in an anti - clockwise direction .

title: Galena Snake
description: Galena Snake The Galena Snake was a winding river that flowed down the Galena Mountains in Northeast Faerûn . Geograpy . Its origin was near to the eastern edge of the range , close to Justin ' s Mine , and it flowed south through Kinbrace before turning southeast and joining the Icelace River .

title: Galgadayle
description: Galgadayle Galgadayle oin Meadowhome was a firbolg seer of Hartsvale , who prophesied about the birth of Queen Brianna ' s child . Description . Galgadayle was lanky for a firbolg , looking more like a verbeeg .

title: Galgast
description: Galgast Galgast was the ulitharid leader of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact in 1479 DR . History . Galgast originated from a drow host of House Oblodra in 1358 DR and the psionic powers of his host permitted the birth of an ulitharid .

title: Galladel
description: Galladel Galladel was once the king of Shilmista , but was killed by the ogrillon king Ragnor . He once believed the magic of the forest , but lost his beliefs once he tried the ritual and failed his fellow elves . Over the many years of his age , he has became almost human like in thinking and planning during the war of Shilmista .

title: Gallard
description: Gallard Gallard was the westernmost of the Border Kingdoms settlements that guarded the Shaar trails . Description . Gallard was a crowded place of winding cobbled streets and gravel alleys .

title: Galleon
description: Galleon A galleon was an advanced sailing vessel , the largest used by Cormyr , Impiltur , and Sembia as of the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR . Even in these relatively wealthy countries , the galleon was not a common sight on the Inner Sea . Description .

title: Galley
description: Galley A galley was a large ship used by Sword Coast and Moonsea pirates and other sailors . Although galleys had at least one mast , most relied on oarsmen to propel the ship . Because galleys required a large crew , they usually put into shore to camp at night and rarely ventured far into the ocean .

title: Gallowshawk
description: Gallowshawk Gallowshawk , known by all as Slop , was an innkeeper in Skullport . History . Gallowshawk was , in 1355 DR , a lowly scullery cook on board a ship that had arrived in Skullport when the boat was shipwrecked and he was miraculously the only survivor .

title: Gallus
description: Gallus Gallus was a pech in Blingdenstone . History . In 1479 DR , Gallus was the leader of a group of pech miners established in a section of Blingdenstone .

title: Galuil Mountains
description: Galuil Mountains The Galuil Mountains were a small isolated mountain range in the north of the realm of Ulgarth , standing beside the Golden Water , in southeast Faerûn . They were commonly called the Mountains of Gold for their appearance , but might be better termed the Iron Mountains for their primary resource . Description .

title: Galuum
description: Galuum Galuum was a mind flayer in the Northdark during the late 1480s DR . History . Galuum lived in Ryxyg .

title: Galvan
description: Galvan Galvan was the Blue Dragon Wyrmspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin . Personality . Galvan thought very much like a scheming blue dragon .

title: Galvendo
description: Galvendo Galvendo is a hunter within the city of Mirabar who operates a hunting lodge named after himself . Along with utilizing very aggressive advertising for his lodge , Galvendo claims that no one has ever died on one of his expeditions . The truth however , is that three clients have met a grizzly demise while hunting with Galvendo ( typically by a bear or winter wolf ) .

title: Galvin
description: Galvin Galvin was a druid and an agent of the Harpers . Personality . Galvin loved open spaces and was uncomfortable in urban environments .

title: Gamalon Idogyr
description: Gamalon Idogyr Lord Gamalon Idogyr was the Count of Spellshire and the Court Sage of Tethyr . Formerly , he had been the most powerful wizard living on the Rock of Bral , as well as a famous traveler , explorer , and merchant of magical goods . Description .

title: Gamo Hidenobu
description: Gamo Hidenobu Gamo Hidenobu was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hidenobu was often involved in questionable duels and vendettas History .

title: Gamo Mitsutoshi
description: Gamo Mitsutoshi Gamo Mitsutoshi was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Mitsutoshi regularly spitting in public .

title: Gamo Mochikuni
description: Gamo Mochikuni Gamo Mochikuni was a retainer of Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Mochikuni wandered looking like a gaudy tough , wearing loud clothing and swaggering History .

title: Gamogan
description: Gamogan Gamogan was a kindly and wise star elf advisor to the nobility of Yuireshanyaar . He was popular among the people as a voice of moderation . In the early days of the construction of Sildëyuir , Gamogan was an outspoken opponent of the plan , claiming that it would strain those relations that had already been made with the human s and the existing allies of Yuireshanyaar .

title: Gana
description: Gana Gana , the " City of Riches , " ( together with Jumlat ) gave the group of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara their name because pearl diving was one major source of wealth . Trade . Another source of wealth was from the nearby wasteland to the west called the Realm of Bleeding Trees where and aromatic gum s could be collected .

title: Gana Bay
description: Gana Bay Gana Bay was nestled in the southeast corner of west Zakhara in the Pearl Cities in 1367 DR . Description . Gana Bay measured approximately 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide by 60 miles ( 96 km ) in length , forming a roughly rectangular shape .

title: Gandalug Battlehammer
description: Gandalug Battlehammer Gandalug Battlehammer was the first and ninth king of Mithral Hall . He was imprisoned by Yvonnel Baenre before he was freed after Yvonnel ' s death in the Battle of Mithral Hall . History .

title: Ganilon
description: Ganilon Ganilon was one of the many Doomguide s who were part of the contingent in the Neverdeath Graveyard in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He and some of his fellows became lost in the graveyard after an assault by undead .

title: Gannayev - of - Dreams
description: Gannayev - of - Dreams Gannayev , or Gann - of - Dreams , is a hagspawn spirit shaman from Mulsantir who aids the Kalach - Cha during the events of . Personality . As a constant wanderer who had never felt attachment to anyone , Gann can be charming and acerbic all at once .

title: Ganrahast Aeiulvana
description: Ganrahast Aeiulvana Ganrahast Aeiulvana was the Royal Mage of Cormyr in 1479 DR . Abilities . Although his magical abilities did not appear to come close to those of his predecessors , he was a competent and level headed spellcaster .

title: Gantar Kraok
description: Gantar Kraok Gantar Kraok was an aquatic elf tyrant in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Gantar was one of the most ruthless , manipulative person on Toril .

title: Gantharla Obarskyr
description: Gantharla Obarskyr Gantharla Obarskyr was the older sister of Iltharl Obarskyr and , from 245 DR , the first queen of Cormyr . Appearance . Gantharla had brilliant red hair , worn short .

title: Gaping Maw
description: Gaping Maw The Gaping Maw is the 88th level of the Abyss and the home of Demogorgon , Prince of Demons . It is a vast and savage wilderness filled with those that serve the Prince of Demons , various fiends , and dinosaurs . Reflecting the dual personality of its master , the Gaping Maw is a vast continent covered in a jungle and surrounded an endless ocean and brine flats .

title: Gapolploorg
description: Gapolploorg Gapolploorg was a powerful kuo - toa whip of Sloopdilmonpolop and priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR . Personality . Gapolploorg was one of the few relatively sane members of the ruling kuo - toa elite .

title: Gar Shatterkeel
description: Gar Shatterkeel Gar Shatterkeel was the Prophet of Water and the leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave . Description . His skin was covered in barnacles , and his left arm was replaced by a large mechanical crab claw .

title: Garadoc ' s Camp
description: Garadoc ' s Camp Garadoc ' s Camp was a small settlement of the barbarian s of the Black Raven Tribe in the Frost Hills . Activities . A band of Black Raven Uthgardt had established a camp on the top of Dhaemang ' s head , the most southern peak of the Frost Hills .

title: Garagos
description: Garagos Garagos ( pronounced " GAH - rah - gohs " ) , the Lord of War , was a god of war and exarch of Tempus , though he focused more on destruction than war itself . Followers . Clerics of Garagos , known as " Bloodreavers " , spent their days fomenting strife throughout the continent , knowing that each conflict contributed to Garagos ' s continuing rebirth .

title: Garbul
description: Garbul Garbul was a hobgoblin warlord in 1489 DR . Garbul was the leader of the Zartruss hobgoblin tribe living in Kryptgarden Forest and the primary agent of the great dragon Claugiyliamatar . History .

title: Garda Greenleaf
description: Garda Greenleaf Garda Greenleaf was a scribe of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Description . The librarian was a middle - aged man .

title: Garden of Delights
description: Garden of Delights The Garden of Delights was a special domed building located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Garden of Delights was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .

title: Garden of Rhinda
description: Garden of Rhinda The Garden of Rhinda was a luscious flower garden in Darromar at the base of and surrounding the Ithal Crag , the large hill upon which the queen ' s royal palace of Faerntarn was built . The garden added color to the otherwise dull granite of the palace walls . To reach the palace , one had to pass along the winding road up the hill and through the garden .

title: Gareth Cormaeril
description: Gareth Cormaeril Sir Gareth Cormaeril is a fallen paladin of Tyr and retired member of the Knights of Samular who currently resides at the Halls of Justice in Waterdeep serving as Exchequer of the organization . He is distantly related to the Cormaeril noble family of Cormyr . Appearance .

title: Gareth Dragonsbane
description: Gareth Dragonsbane Gareth Dragonsbane is the paladin king of Damara and a mythic sovereign . History . He was once an adventurer working as a knight of the Order of the Golden Cup and tithed 50 % of his gains to the organization .

title: Gareth Jadaren
description: Gareth Jadaren Gareth Jadaren was a pirate serving aboard the Orcsblood . In 1460 DR , the Orcsblood attacked a merchant ship and Gareth took a magic bracelet known as the Rythanko from a Githyanki passenger . Unkown to Gareth , the bracelet was linked to an entity named Fandour who was imprisoned in a pocket plane .

title: Gargauth
description: Gargauth Gargauth ( pronounced " GAR - goth " ) , or The Lord Who Watches , was the lawful evil demigod of betrayal , cruelty , political corruption and powerbrokers . He embodied the inevitable decay and corruption that accompanied all self - serving , greedy , and power - hungry leaders and groups . Gargauth held to the letter of any agreement , not the spirit , and relished betraying anyone with whom he forged a pact by twisting the contract to serve his own ends .

title: Gargosh Blusterhelm
description: Gargosh Blusterhelm Gargosh Blusterhelm was a dwarf of Mithral Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Gargosh devoted his life to finding the legendary axe " Orcsplitter " , property of King Torhild Flametongue of Besilmer , and presenting it to the elders of Clan Blusterhelm in the hopes of restoring his family ' s lackluster reputation .

title: Gargoyle
description: Gargoyle Gargoyles were vicious predators imbued with magic . Behavior . Their original nature aided them in that they are adept at appearing perfectly still , as if they are still made of stone , and their hides were rough and thick , similar to stone as well .

title: Garick Honestone
description: Garick Honestone Garick Honestone was a cleric of Garl Glittergold in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . When Garick first arrived in the town , he started a undertaker ' s service but with little success .

title: Gariena
description: Gariena Gariena was a druid at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Gariena was one of the many druids deceived by the Cult of the Elemental Flame in order to unwittingly help the Rite of the Wicker Giant .

title: Garin
description: Garin Garin was an angel in service to Tyr in 1384 – 1385 DR . History . In 1384 DR , Garin was assigned by his friend and superior Micus to act as the jailor of Kaanyr Vhok , who had infiltrated the House of the Triad .

title: Garl Glittergold
description: Garl Glittergold Garl Glittergold , also known as The Watchful Protector , was a Lawful good Greater deity . He was said to have discovered the first gnomes while exploring a cavern before telling them a joke and leading them into the world . Garl led the Gnomish pantheon as the deity of luck , protection and trickery .

title: Garlen Harlathurl
description: Garlen Harlathurl Garlen Harlathurl was one of the owners of the Helm at Highsun tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Garlen was a jovial but grasping individual .

title: Garlena
description: Garlena Garlena , or Sister Garlena , was a cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . The god Helm gave Garlena and her fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . Knowing it was a difficult mission , her leader , Odren , recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him .

title: Garlokantha
description: Garlokantha Garlokantha was a gold dragon living in the Forest of Tethir as late as 1370 DR . She was saved by the Company of Eight in 1354 DR from the hand of some evil adventurers , including the drow Tleobar . Garlokantha preferred isolation and lived alone in her cave in the northeastern region of the forest , but about once every four years , she would take a humanoid form and travel through Tethyr and Amn to observe other races .

title: Garnet ( gem )
description: Garnet ( gem ) Garnet was the generic name for a variety of crystals that had the same properties but came in a wide range of colors . Description . Garnets came in many colors ( see gallery ) but , as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR , the violet hue was the most valuable while the other varieties and fallen out of favor and were valued in the fancy stone price range .

title: Garney
description: Garney Garney was a member of the Golden Legion . History . Garney took part in the Maztica n expedition .

title: Garos Daunger
description: Garos Daunger Garos Daunger was the chancellor of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . He liked hunting . History .

title: Garotte
description: Garotte Garottes were vile weapons that were used to strangle an unsuspecting victim . Uses . Made from a metal wire strung between two wooden handles , a garotte was a brutally efficient weapon when attacking someone from behind .

title: Garrandar ( family )
description: Garrandar ( family ) The Garrandar family was an noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Garrant
description: Garrant Garrant was an officer in the Golden Legion and captain of the Legion ' s swordsmen . Despite being one of the main officers Cordell never consulted him in strategic decision . History .

title: Garrathmaw
description: Garrathmaw Garrathmaw , also known as Incisor and Insyzor , was a fang dragon dracolich in the Greypeak Mountains and the River Loagrann . Activities . The Incisor ' s hoard was very wealthy with many dwarven treasures from Ammarindar and countless Netherese magic items .

title: Garret
description: Garret Garret was a human soldier of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Garret was one of Fort Locke ' s soldiers that went with Tann and his men to patrol .

title: Garrick
description: Garrick Garrick was a free - spirited bard living in Beregost with a lively outlook on life and love . He could be found in Beregost working for Silke , an employer of dubious nature . Appendix .

title: Garron Ersemm
description: Garron Ersemm Master Garron Ersemm was a skilled horseman and horse breaker and captain of the cavalry under the control of the Countess of Calimmon , Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter . He was also her fiancé , having come with her from Waterdeep during the Reclamation Wars . < ref name = " LoI / Tethyr - 79 " > < / ref > Garron was almost perpetually happy and was well - loved by the young horse soldiers of Tethyr ' s cavalry .

title: Garrundar
description: Garrundar Garrundar the Vile was an old black dragon who made its home in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . At one time , the sky pirates of Bartholomew Blackdagger tried to capture Garrundar but they failed spectacularly and the black dragon pursued them back to their hideout .

title: Gartokkar Xundorn
description: Gartokkar Xundorn Gartokkar Xundorn was the leader of the Keepers of the Flame in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Just before the Rage of Demons , Gartokkar found himself in deep trouble because the Gray Ghosts thieves guild stole the red dragon egg that the Keepers of the Flame needed in order to kill and replace Themberchaud in the near future , since Themberchaud had grown too strong .

title: Gartos
description: Gartos Gartos was a male mercenary warrior in service to Prince Belaur Aumar of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Gartos was one of the most trusted men of Belaur , which elevated him to the prince ' s status and permitted him to be ranked above a minor magelord .

title: Garumbelly Hillsafar
description: Garumbelly Hillsafar Garumbelly Hillsafar was the leader of Clan Hillsafar in Vaasa in 1359 DR . Activities . Garumbelly gained his nickname , " Grumble " , for his habit of murmuring to himself .

title: Garumn ' s Gorge
description: Garumn ' s Gorge Garumn ' s Gorge was a wide chasm located in Mithral Hall . Description . There was a small waterfall that spouted from the wall of the chasm , called Bruenor ' s Falls .

title: Garumn Battlehammer
description: Garumn Battlehammer Garumn Battlehammer was the sixth King of Mithral Hall , and grandfather to the legendary Bruenor Battlehammer . History . Garumn was killed fighting duergar in Mithral Hall when his kin mined too deep and released the dragon known as Shimmerglooom .

title: Garwyl Gos
description: Garwyl Gos Zor Garwyl Gos was a noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Garwyl was a realistic but ruthless person .

title: Gary Gygax
description: Gary Gygax Ernest Gary Gygax ( born July 27 , 1938 , in Chicago , Illinois ; died March 4 , 2008 , Lake Geneva , Wisconsin , aged 69 years ) was best known as the author of " Dungeons & Dragons " ( " D & D " ) , co - created with Dave Arneson and co - published with Don Kaye in 1974 under the company TSR , Inc . . Although not alone in contributing to the origins of the industry , Gygax is generally considered to be the " father " of the modern role - playing hobby .

title: Garyx
description: Garyx Garyx ( pronounced " GAIR - iks " ) was the chaotic evil dragon god of fire , destruction , and renewal . He symbolized the sheer power and destructive force of dragonkind , as well as the destructive and cleansing influence of fire . Some believed Garyx was insane as a result of his long residence in the plane of Pandemonium .

title: Gasbide
description: Gasbide Gasbide was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . A loyal follower of Phylo , Gasbide was corrupted by Zuggtmoy , dreaming of bizarre , elaborate structures no myconids would ever need , inspired by visions of Abyssal palaces .

title: Gaseous form
description: Gaseous form Gaseous form or wraithform ( originally called Quantoul ' s wraithmorph ) was an arcane transmutation spell that mimicked the supernatural ability of some creatures , ( " e . g . " , oni mage s , several types of genie , and vampire s ) to take on an insubstantial , misty form .

title: Gash
description: Gash Gash was a gnoll in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gash was with his fellow gnolls in the Labyrinth until a pack of minotaur s ambushed and killed them .

title: Gaspar
description: Gaspar Gaspar was a fishmonger who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The fishmonger was of normal build and dressed grey clothing .

title: Gaspar Cormaeril
description: Gaspar Cormaeril Gaspar Cormaeril was a young member of the Cormaeril noble house of Cormyr . Background . In 1369 DR Gaspar met with High Wizard Vangerdahast to discuss the appointment of Vangerdahast as regent .

title: Gasteban
description: Gasteban Gasteban was a pirate in 1359 DR . History . Gasteban was a noble of Chessenta who around 1349 DR was deposed and fled to the Pirate Isles with three ships .

title: Gastyn
description: Gastyn Gastyn was head of the servants in Lord Marsten ' s hunting lodge . History . Gastyn was head butler for Lord Marsten until , some time before the Tyranny of Dragons , his master was killed and the lodge occupied by Cult of the Dragon agents under Talis Kasterel .

title: Gate
description: Gate Gate was a conjuration spell that connected two plane s for two - way travel or the summoning and control of creatures or beings of great power to aid the caster . Older versions of this spell allowed one - way travel for a named entity and requested their help rather than commanding it . Effects .

title: Gate of Glory
description: Gate of Glory The Gate of Glory was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . This gate was found in the Foundry ward of the city . Description .

title: Gate of Heaven
description: Gate of Heaven The Gate of Heaven was the central province and heart of the Yikarian Empire in the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Geography . The Gate of Heaven sat high atop the southern arm of the mighty World Pillar Mountains in northeast Zakhara .

title: Gate of Iron
description: Gate of Iron The Gate of Iron was a magical gateway between the Raurin desert and northern Durpar in southeast Faerûn . Geography . It was located in the Dustwall Mountains , at the very top of a narrow mountain pass at a neck in the range .

title: Gate of Iron Fangs
description: Gate of Iron Fangs The Gate of Iron Fangs was a ruined city in the southwestern tip of the Forest of Amtar . No one really knew who inhabitated and built it since it was already a ruin when the Arkaiun s migrated into this region . The few who explored this ancient site speculated that it might have been a serpent - like race since the ruins showed resemblance to the architecture of Ilimar .

title: Gate of Revelations
description: Gate of Revelations The Gate of Revelations was the real entrance into the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Made from marble streaked with pink and red , the Gate of Revelations was even more beautiful than the Grand Gate of Delights .

title: Gate of Wealth
description: Gate of Wealth The Gate of Wealth was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The Gate of Wealth was located within the Affluent District of Huzuz .

title: Gate of the Bulls
description: Gate of the Bulls The Gate of the Bulls was the inner gate leading to the great fortress of Sarahin . Description . Beautiful mosaics depicting winged bulls , sword - bearing lions , and snakes climbing toward to sun adorned this gate .

title: Gate of the Fallen
description: Gate of the Fallen The Gate of the Fallen was a large monument located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Gate of the Fallen was found within the ward of Castings . Description .

title: Gate of the Ghost
description: Gate of the Ghost The Gate of the Ghost was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Activities . The Gate of the Ghost was the most heavily used entrance to the city .

title: Gate of the Mamluks
description: Gate of the Mamluks The Gate of the Mamluks was an entrance for the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This gate served as the main entrance and exit to and from the Palace for all of the mamluk s and other guards .

title: Gate of the People
description: Gate of the People The Gate of the People was the main entrance for the Public Gardens in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Commoners used this gate the enter the beautiful gardens .

title: Gate of the Wind
description: Gate of the Wind The Gate of the Wind , or Bab il - Hawa , was the first gate of the great fortress of Sarahin . Description . The Gate of the Wind appeared as an archway framed by two large carvings of desert giant s holding the central portion of the gate aloft .

title: Gatekeeper ' s Crystal
description: Gatekeeper ' s Crystal The Gatekeeper ' s Crystal was a powerful magical device , which , according to legend , had been created by a powerful lich . The truth , however , is that it originated from the Outlands , having been carried by a mysterious being called the Gatekeeper , whose sole duty was apparently to guard a crossroads of " gate " s across the planes and spheres , preventing anyone who wished to restrict access to it from blocking the travel of others . It was stolen ( with the assistance of a deity , it was said ) by Iyraclea , a lich and ice - priestess of Auril of the Great Glacier known as the Ice Queen , as part of her attempt to conquer Myth Ondath .

title: Gates of Doom
description: Gates of Doom The Gates of Doom is the name give to two pillars of rock , with a path between them . They mark the entrance to Oversember Vale in the Thunder Peaks Inhabitants . The Cult of the Dragon inhabits the area , and guards the Gates of Doom .

title: Gates of the Moon
description: Gates of the Moon Gates of the Moon was a Celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model and later an astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to its attachment to the World Tree , it was Selûne ' s realm in Gladsheim / Ysgard as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Description .

title: Gateway
description: Gateway Gateway was an arcane alteration spell that opened a two - way portal to a location the caster had previously visited . Effects . This spell only worked on the Prime Material Plane of the caster , and only provided passage to locations at which he or she had been physically present at some previous time .

title: Gathan
description: Gathan Gathan was a lizardfolk chieftain in the Vast Swamp until 1374 DR . History . Gathan was the chieftain of the Sharptooth tribe .

title: Gatherer Creed
description: Gatherer Creed The Gatherer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . This Creed was different from the other Creeds as it dealt with immigration . They believed that the best way to gather knowledge was to reunite the widely scattered illithid hives .

title: Gathgaer Milomynt
description: Gathgaer Milomynt Gathgaer Milomynt was a cleric of Shar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Gathgaer , on the surface , pretended to be a healer in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep , but in fact he was a slaver , kidnapping people of little influence or profile .

title: Gathkatra
description: Gathkatra Gathkatra was an ogre mage that masqueraded as a human female and worked as the chatelaine of the Whistling Wizard inn on the outskirts of Voonlar " circa " the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . History . In the late 1350s DR , the Whistling Wizard had become a haven and meeting place for many of the more evilly - inclined religious , mercantile , and political groups in the Moonsea region .

title: Gattash
description: Gattash Gattash was a cambion servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt exiled Gattash and Rashara for some failures , sending them to the Waydown area .

title: Gaucelm Gonfrey
description: Gaucelm Gonfrey Lord Gaucelm Gonfrey was once the ruler of the kingdom of Grimmantle after usurping the throne from its aged king . Personality . Gonfrey had a penchant for the finer things in life , even in undeath he would spare no expense on outfitting his chambers or wardrobe with finery .

title: Gaulguth
description: Gaulguth Gaulguth was a berserker nycaloth and member of the Trio Nefarious and field commander of the Army of Darkness . History . Gaulguth was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese .

title: Gaumahavi
description: Gaumahavi Gaumahavi , also called the Purple Dragon , was a unique greater purple dragon from the Hordelands . Description . Outwardly , Gaumahavi looked very similar to an oriental dragon , possessing a long sinuous body that measured well over a hundred feet long .

title: Gauntlet
description: Gauntlet A gauntlet was a metal glove worn to protect the hand . They were a standard part of medium and heavy suits of armor . Reputation .

title: Gauntlet ( Herald )
description: Gauntlet ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Gauntlet was one of two unique positions ( Green Shield being the other one ) that were temporary . While most Herald offices were a lifetime appointment , Gauntlet was given a four - year term that began just before a Shieldmeet and ended just prior to the next Shieldmeet . Gauntlet was charged with gathering intelligence related to non - state militias , mercenary companies , and adventuring groups , reporting to the High Heralds their strength and effectiveness , the character of their leadership , their clientele , what loyalties they held , what areas they operated in , and how to contact their agents .

title: Gauntlet ( organization )
description: Gauntlet ( organization ) The Gauntlet was a law - enforcement company based in the Tears of Selûne around 1358 DR . History . Around 1358 DR , the Gauntlet were the self - proclaimed law - enforcement agency of the Tears of Selûne .

title: Gauntlets of ogre power
description: Gauntlets of ogre power The Gauntlets of ogre power were found among other objects upon the rescue of the drow / wood elf Zhai , when she had been subdued and captured in the troll mines , among the powerful beads of force and the ring of jumping . These powerful gauntlets give the wearer ( in this case ) the strength of a powerful ogre and furthermore allow him or her to smash the ground with great force , causing great damage to enemies and for the smashing of walls and the removal of obstacles . They where wield by Rannek and used to progress the advance of the party on there journey .

title: Gauntlets of swimming and climbing
description: Gauntlets of swimming and climbing Gauntlets of swimming and climbing were magical gauntlets that bestowed the wearer with the ability to swim as fast as a triton underwater ( or as fast as a merman on the surface ) and to scale vertical surfaces whether climbing upward or downward . Description . These gauntlets appeared normal but would radiate magic if detected .

title: Gauntlets of the valorous
description: Gauntlets of the valorous Gauntlets of the valorous were magic al gauntlet s that were created for the heroes of Myth Drannor . Description . These gauntlets were made in a wide variety of appearances , ranging from huge silvery gauntlets that extended to the elbows to five rings for fingers and thumb chain linked by chains to a bracelet .

title: Gauntlgrym
description: Gauntlgrym Gauntlgrym was an ancient dwarven city that fell into ruin . The city was the capital of the Delzoun . Geography .

title: Gauntlgrym ( novel )
description: Gauntlgrym ( novel ) Gauntlgrym is a book in the " Legend of Drizzt " saga by R . A . Salvatore and the first book in the " The Neverwinter Saga " series .

title: Gaussra Kenafin
description: Gaussra Kenafin Gaussra Kenafin was a member of House Kenafin and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Description . Gaussra had black teeth .

title: Gauth
description: Gauth A gauth , sometimes referred to as a lesser beholder , was a four - foot ( 1 . 42 m ) wide beholderkin that fed on magic as well as flesh . They had six eyestalks , one of which was used to drain magic from items , along with four feeding tendrils that sprouted from the top of its body .

title: Gauth Grottoes
description: Gauth Grottoes The Gauth Grottoes formed an area of the Underdark distinct from its main regions . The grottoes were located 30 miles south and 7 miles down from Darkhold . They were close to the Northdark , the Buried Realms and the Darklands but had no direct connections to any of these areas .

title: Gauwervyndhal
description: Gauwervyndhal Gauwervyndhal , also known as Gauwer or The Empress Dragon , was the dragon ruler of Skelkor in 1479 DR . Personality . Gauwervyndhal was known for being a brutal mother .

title: Gavilon Jostins
description: Gavilon Jostins Gavilon Jostins was the ex - adventurer mayor of the city of Elbulder as of 1372 DR . Background . Gavilon Jostins became the mayor soon after Aldorn Thuragar became the ruler of Sespech .

title: Gavin
description: Gavin Gavin was smith from Cantrev Myrrdale who used to travel selling his wares . He was married to Shareen and had two little girls . Description .

title: Gayar
description: Gayar Gayar was the leader of the dukar Order of Kupavi in Myth Nantar . Personality . A very ancient being Gayar was one of the most soft - spoken individual of the city , surprising people that had had bad meeting with morkoth .

title: Gayrlana
description: Gayrlana Gayrlana , also called " Lady Bloodsword " , was a human fighter and rogue , and the leader of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . Description . Gayrlana was a beautiful woman with white hair and dusky skin .

title: Gazer
description: Gazer Gazers ( also known as eyeballs ) were tiny ( eight - inch wide ) , four - stalked , wild beholderkin . They often served as familiars for evil spellcasters . A gazer was " born " out of a beholder ' s feverish dreams , in which its perception of scale and perspective was warped by its delirium .

title: Geas / Quest
description: Geas / Quest Geas / Quest was an enchantment spell that commanded any subject to undertake a task or suffer possibly fatal pain and sickness . Arcane spellcasters and bards usually called this spell " geas " while divine spellcasters referred to it as " quest " . Effects .

title: Geb
description: Geb Slow to display emotion but appreciative of humor of all varieties , Geb ( pronounced " gheb " ) is the eldest member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Also known as Gebthant in Thay and Gebakotep in Unther , he is a cautious and even tempered deity . History .

title: Gedrin Thalavar
description: Gedrin Thalavar - - Gedrin Thalavar Gedrin Thalavar , sometimes called Shadowbane , was a paladin and the founder of the Eye of Justice , a sect that believed in the Heresy of the Threefold God . History . In 1384 DR , as a child member of the Night Masks , Gedrin had a vision in which the god Helm was slain in a duel with Tyr .

title: Geeraugh
description: Geeraugh Geeraugh was a half - ogre bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Geeraugh and his companion Mougra were hidden in the Haunted Tomb of Red Larch waiting for a bandit raid .

title: Gehenna
description: Gehenna Gehenna was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between neutral evil and lawful evil . Description . The four layers of Gehenna were infinite planes with gravity at a forty - five degree angle to the ground , making travelers feel as if they were on the side of a mountain with no base or peak .

title: Geildarr Ithym
description: Geildarr Ithym Geildarr Ithym is the Lord Mayor of Llorkh and a member of the Zhentarim . He assumed the title after the Zhents invaded the city and installed him as it ' s new ruler . He commands both the Zhent soldiers that frequent the town and an army of three hundred , purple cloaked , Lord ' s Men that " protects " the city from those who do not appreciate the rule of the Black Network .

title: Geildirion of Cimbar
description: Geildirion of Cimbar The Geildirion of Cimbar was a book of secret lore from Myth Drannor . History . The book was held in a tower in Myth Drannor and guarded by a beholder mage until the party of Quenthel Baenre , with the help of Jezz the Lame , retrieved it in 1372 DR for Tzirik of House Jaelre in exchange for more information about the Silence of Lolth .

title: Geirildin Sethomiir
description: Geirildin Sethomiir Geirildin Sethomiir was the coronal of the illythiiri house Sethomiir . He was a dark elf and powerful mage during the time of the Crown Wars . He summoned the balor Wendonai in - 11500 DR to help him against the Aryvandaar i and to help him achieving a leading position among the other dark elven clans .

title: Geiron Hawkwinter
description: Geiron Hawkwinter Lord Geiron Hawkwinter was a Royal Corlann of Faerntarn , the royal palace of Queen Zaranda and King Haedrak III . In this role , he maintained the royal quarters . He was the favorite nephew of Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter , the Countess of Calimmon .

title: Gelatinous cube
description: Gelatinous cube A gelatinous cube was a transparent ooze composed of mindless , gelatinous matter in the shape of a cube . They slid through dungeon corridors , absorbing everything in their path , digesting everything organic and secreting non - digestible matter in their wake . Contact with their exterior could result in a paralyzing electric shock , after which cubes would proceed to slowly digest their stunned and helpless prey .

title: Geldenstag ' s Rest
description: Geldenstag ' s Rest Geldenstag ' s Rest was one of the oldest inn s in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located close to Bryn Shander ' s East Gate .

title: Geldirth ( lord )
description: Geldirth ( lord ) Lord Geldirth was head of the Geldirth house of Waterdeep , whose main trade was traditionally caravan mustering . Relationships . Geldirth ' s second son and heir was Lord Harthar .

title: Geldrin Fey
description: Geldrin Fey Geldrin Fey was the weapon master of House Fey - Branche in Menzoberranzan . History . At Melee - Magthere , Geldrin was in the same class as Andzrel Baenre .

title: Geletha
description: Geletha Geletha was a female frost giant and part of a group of four of her kin who , along with around a hundred orc s , destroyed Clicking Heels in 1370 DR . She was killed by the Companions of the Hall and Tred McKnuckles along with two of her comrades .

title: Gelnur Farland
description: Gelnur Farland Gelnur Farland was a constable of Cormyr . Activities . Gelnur took care of the prisoners of the remote and secret prison stronghold of Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate .

title: Gelroos Hun ' ett
description: Gelroos Hun ' ett Gelroos Hun ' ett , also known Faceless One , was one of the masters at the Sorcere in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Description . When wandering the city , Faceless dressed in a dark cloak to hide his grotesque deformity .

title: Gelugon
description: Gelugon Gelugons , also called ice devils , were the strategists and masterminds of Hell ' s armies . They made their decisions based on cold , calculated logic , with no thought of the losses of troops . As long as success were possible with their plans , they were willing to sacrifice any number of infernal soldiers .

title: Gem dragon
description: Gem dragon Gem dragons were a type of dragon with crystalline scales . They were aloof , solitary , and self - centered . They spent most of their time on the Inner Planes .

title: Gembomb
description: Gembomb Gembomb is a conjuration spell unique to cleric s with the Gnome and / or Trade domain s . It transforms gems into explosives . Effect .

title: Gemburst
description: Gemburst Gemburst was a powerful alteration and flame spell that was used by skilled members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to literally store a " fireball " within a valuable fire opal .

title: Gemjump
description: Gemjump Gemjump was an arcane alteration or transmutation spell that used a rogue stone as a base for safe teleport ation from anywhere to the location of the gem . Effects . This spell had two parts : attuning oneself to the rogue stone and activating the teleport .

title: Gen
description: Gen Gen were small elemental genie s who often served as special familiar s to sha ' ir s in Zakhara . All sha ’ irs needed them to work their magic . As powerful as an individual sha ' ir may be , they were utterly helpless without their loyal gen .

title: Genasi
description: Genasi Genasi were human - derived planetouched infused with the power of the Elemental Chaos , most often as the result of crossbreeding between humans and the powerful genie races or other elementals that dwell in such planes . Physically powerful and cunning , genasi were a varied race with abilities that varied depending on their lineage and individual experience . Ecology .

title: Genbudo
description: Genbudo Genbudo was one of the most powerful wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Genbudo was a very troubling wu jen residing in Chimotoge .

title: General Tiger
description: General Tiger General Tiger was a high - ranking member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . History . General Tiger was a member of the Animal Kings ' Court , of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy , overseeing the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula .

title: Generic City Guard private ( Waterdeep )
description: Generic City Guard private ( Waterdeep ) A Guardsman or Guardswoman was a junior member of the City Guard of Waterdeep , serving as a private . One was also called a " Trusty " . Activities .

title: Generic City Guard sergeant ( Waterdeep )
description: Generic City Guard sergeant ( Waterdeep ) An armar or vigilant was a junior member of the City Guard of Waterdeep , serving as a sergeant . Activities . They typically patrolled the environs of Waterdeep in groups of twelve , with ten privates , one sergeant , and one captain or lieutenant .

title: Generic City Watch captain ( Waterdeep )
description: Generic City Watch captain ( Waterdeep ) A civilar was a member of the City Watch of Waterdeep , holding a rank equivalent to a lieutenant or captain . Activities . They typically patrolled inside the walls of Waterdeep in groups of four , with two patrolpersons , one sergeant , and one captain or lieutenant .

title: Generic City Watch patrolperson ( Waterdeep )
description: Generic City Watch patrolperson ( Waterdeep ) A watchman or watchwoman was a junior member of the City Watch of Waterdeep , serving as a patrolperson . Activities . They typically patrolled inside the walls of Waterdeep in groups of four , with two patrolpersons , one sergeant , and one captain .

title: Generic City Watch sergeant ( Waterdeep )
description: Generic City Watch sergeant ( Waterdeep ) An armar or amlar was a low - ranking member of the City Watch of Waterdeep , holding a rank equivalent to a sergeant . Activities . They typically patrolled inside the walls of Waterdeep in groups of four , with two patrolpersons , one sergeant , and one captain .

title: Generic Guard man - at - arms ( Tantras )
description: Generic Guard man - at - arms ( Tantras ) A low - ranking member of the Guard of the city of Tantras in the Vast was a man - at - arms . Possessions . Regular soldiers of the Guard were outfitted in blue oiled plate mail armor emblazoned with the coat of arms of Tantras : three silver stars over a silver breaking wave on a field of royal blue , called the " blue and silver " .

title: Generic Guard officer ( Tantras )
description: Generic Guard officer ( Tantras ) A high - ranking member of the Guard of the city of Tantras in the Vast was an officer . Possessions . Officers of the Guard were outfitted in blue oiled plate mail armor emblazoned with the coat of arms of Tantras : three silver stars over a silver breaking wave on a field of royal blue , called the " blue and silver " .

title: Generic Guard sergeant ( Tantras )
description: Generic Guard sergeant ( Tantras ) A member of the Guard of the city of Tantras in the Vast was a sergeant , also called a " longsword " . Possessions . Sergeants of the Guard were outfitted in blue oiled plate mail armor emblazoned with the coat of arms of Tantras : three silver stars over a silver breaking wave on a field of royal blue , called the " blue and silver " .

title: Generic shadow guard
description: Generic shadow guard A shadow guard was one of the temple guards hired to defend the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Corrupted by the false priests , they had been transformed into dark creature s . Induction .

title: Generic temple guard
description: Generic temple guard A temple guard was one of those hired to defend the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Activities . The temple guards patrolled the walls around the temple and stood watch in the outer courtyard and middle temple areas .

title: Genie
description: Genie Genies were outsider s native to the elemental planes . Genie magic . Genies had a number of inherent magical abilities , but a few among them also trained to gain spellcasting abilities of a sorcerer of its specific element .

title: Genie ' s Turban
description: Genie ' s Turban The Genie ' s Turban was a group of islands off the coast from Muluk in Zakhara . Description . The " turban " of this group of islands comprised two large islands called the Island of Firethorns and the Island of Gardens , or " al - Hada ' iq " .

title: Genie contract
description: Genie contract Genie contract was a spell used by genie s to seal a contract that was magically binding to the two parties involved . Both sides had to agree willingly to the terms , and a punishment was defined for anyone transgressing them . Genies employed this spell to all kinds of formal agreements between them and mortals , or between two mortals with the genie as a witness .

title: Genie prison
description: Genie prison Genie prisons were items that could be crafted and used by skilled sha ' ir s to entrap genie s . Uses . These special cells were designed to ensnare a genie against its will .

title: Genie slayer sword
description: Genie slayer sword Genie slayer swords were magic weapons found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that specialized in harming genie s . Description . Though most commonly found as scimitar s , any type of sword could be enchanted with " genie slaying " properties .

title: Genie wish
description: Genie wish A genie wish was , in many ways , the same as the powerful " wish " spell . The notable difference between the two wishes was that genie s often interpreted the words of the person making the wish into creative , and often dangerous , results . Rules Governing Genie Wishes .

title: Genies ' Anvil
description: Genies ' Anvil The Genies ' Anvil was a barren stretch of land in the High Desert of Zakhara laying between the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams and the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue . Geography / Ecology . Many dangerous obstacles threatened would - be travelers in this land .

title: Genies ' Caravan
description: Genies ' Caravan The Genies ' Caravan was a small road found within the High Desert of West Zakhara . Description . The road connected the heart of the Genies ' Anvil with the Aman Oasis near the Spine of the Dog .

title: Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon
description: Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon The Gentle Ghost of Silverymoon was a flying ghostly , sentient apparition which first appeared in Silverymoon around 1459 DR . The identity of the ghost in life was unknown but many wild theories abounded . The ghost occasionally swooped down and passed through observers who often collapsed but were unharmed other than reporting an intense chill .

title: Genzo Taira
description: Genzo Taira Genzo Taira was a samurai adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Genzo was a natural leader , instinctively taking charge of any situation , even despite protests from his companions .

title: Geoffrey
description: Geoffrey Geoffrey was a brewer in Caer Corwell . Description . Geoffrey was a huge fat man .

title: Georg Redfell
description: Georg Redfell Georg Redfell was a male human and mayor of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Georg was the mayor of West Harbor and the leader of its militia .

title: George MacDonald
description: George MacDonald George MacDonald is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . Career . MacDonald began designing role - playing games while in college .

title: Gera
description: Gera Gera was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Gera was first found in Weeping Willow Inn , where asked of Kalach - Cha to rescue her husband , Zachan .

title: Gerak
description: Gerak Gerak was a hunter in Sembia . History . Gerak lived in the small village of Fairelm in shadovar - dominated Sembia with his wife Elle .

title: Gerald Brom
description: Gerald Brom Gerald Brom ( born March 9 1965 in Albany , Georgia ) is a gothic fantasy artist and illustrator . He spent much of his early years on the move , living in many countries such as Japan and Germany . Among others , he has contributed illustrations for the War of the Spider Queen series and reprints of The Avatar Series , and was a key illustrator of the Dark Sun campaign setting .

title: Geran Hulmaster
description: Geran Hulmaster Geran Hulmaster is a powerful human swordmage who was born into the ruling family of Hulburg on the coast of the Moonsea . Geran was formerly a member of the adventuring group The Company of the Dragon Shield . After retiring from adventuring , Geran partnered with a Ghostwise halfling named Hamil to form the Red Sail trading coster in Tantras .

title: Geremis Dyrr
description: Geremis Dyrr Geremis Dyrr was an old member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Geremis graduated from Sorcere at an unknown time and became an apprentice of the Lichdrow Dyrr .

title: Gerrin I Wyvernspur
description: Gerrin I Wyvernspur Lord Gerrin I Wyvernspur was a member of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . Background . Gerrin fought against the red dragon s in the attack on Suzail in 1018 DR , and subsequently pursued Thauglor , who badly burned him , although Thauglor was defeated .

title: Gerti Orelsdottr
description: Gerti Orelsdottr Gerti Orelsdottr was a female frost giant who lived in an ice and rock cavern in the Spine of the World called Shining White . History . She was the sole daughter and heir to Jarl Orel , the frost giant patriarch who united the various families and clans around the Spine of the World to form a unified frost giant populace .

title: Gervor
description: Gervor Gervor was an adventurer prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Gervor and his adventuring party were exploring the Sumber Hills when they were attacked by Black Earth cultists .

title: Gestal
description: Gestal Gestal , also known as Lord Divergence , is a demon thrall , or priest , of the demon lord Demogorgon . As the lord of Divergence , he is the first servant of the Prince of Demons and is the self - proclaimed ruler of the area of the Underdark known as the Depths of Madness . Personality .

title: Gestaniius
description: Gestaniius Gestaniius was a blue dragon and one of Tiamat ' s chosen . History . He was invested with a third of Tiamat ' s divine power during the Time of Troubles but was devoured , along with Skuthosiin by the bearer of another third , Tchazzar .

title: Gethmedra Darmov
description: Gethmedra Darmov Gethmedra Darmov was a crime lord in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Her arena made Gethmedra popular among the city ' s elite , but she knew that , for her poor birth , she would never move among them .

title: Gethshemeth
description: Gethshemeth Gethshemeth was an ancient Kraken . Description . Gethshemeth was roughly one hundred feet in length , a massive and ancient kraken with a dun - colored hide and large red eyes .

title: Getsu
description: Getsu Getsu was an unusually intelligent tigbanua buso in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Somehow , a tigbanua buso gained intelligence and named himself Getsu , plotting to destroy the city of Nakamaru .

title: Ghaark Ironseth
description: Ghaark Ironseth Lord Ghaark Ironseth was a human of Amnwater , Amn , around 1368 DR , where he led the Ironseth family , owners of about half of the land around Amnwater . Personality . Lord Ironseth was known as a noisy and insensitive man .

title: Ghaele
description: Ghaele The ghaeles are a type of noble eladrin who are the embodiment of winter . As such , they are native to the Feywild , but many also live in the celestial planes such as Arvandor and Celestia , where they are the knights - errant of the celestials . They are powerful warriors that delight in the hunting and slaying of evil in all its forms , especially fiend s , dragon s , and undead .

title: Ghaelya
description: Ghaelya Ghaelya is a watersoul genasi from Airspur . She was born into a wealthy family and had a twin sister . Unlike the other members of her family who manifested fire , she manifested the element of water .

title: Ghald
description: Ghald Ghald was a four - armed sahuagin and a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Ghald and his partner Unferth were the Kraken Society ' s top operatives in this part of the North , specialized in advancing the agenda of the society through theft , intimidation , and assassination .

title: Ghaliver Longstocking
description: Ghaliver Longstocking Ghaliver Longstocking was the ruler of Westbridge in 1370 DR . Activities . Ghaliver was a very able businessman : he possessed a farmer ' s market , a stockyard , a walled grain warehouse complex and an inn in Westbridge , and a few houses in Waterdeep .

title: Ghaliyah
description: Ghaliyah Ghaliyah was a nereid living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Enslaved by the Cult of Istishia , Ghaliyah was forced to guard the entrance to the cult ' s lair in Hawa .

title: Ghallar Knoll
description: Ghallar Knoll Ghallar Knoll was a small hill said to contain red - colored grass with magical properties . Description . Ghallar Knoll supposedly was found in the western Small Teeth mountains .

title: Ghalvin Dragonmoor
description: Ghalvin Dragonmoor Ghalvik Dragonmoor was a half - elf member of the Emerald Enclave in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Ghalvik was captured by the minions of Chief Guh and taken to Grudd Haug .

title: Ghalyi Shan
description: Ghalyi Shan Ghalyi Shan was the easternmost mountain within the A - Ling Shan range in the Hordelands . Geography . This impressive mountain was part of the A - Ling Shan range .

title: Ghardumn Greenaxe
description: Ghardumn Greenaxe Ghardumn Greenaxe was a swordsman from Cormyr . Relationships . Ghardumn was the captain of the adventuring company known as the Dragonclaw Clan .

title: Gharnell
description: Gharnell Gharnell was a bard and adventurer in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he went with his party into Undermountain .

title: Gharreil
description: Gharreil Gharreil was one of the seats of the Satraps of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography & Layout . The ruins of Gharreil were located under the Great Glacier , in the region of Alpuk , near the Lugsaas Chain and the border of Vaasa , about 100 miles from Castle Perilous .

title: Gharri Delark
description: Gharri Delark Gharri Delark was a member of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Gharri had won the grudging respect of Baron Xhalth .

title: Ghartii Nung
description: Ghartii Nung Ghartii Nung was a monstrous eel that dwelt in the Yellow Sea off the coast of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was reported to be 100 feet ( 30 meters ) long . The mighty eel was caught by the famous Koryoan fishermen of In ' ani and Ansong .

title: Ghassis
description: Ghassis King Ghassis was a lizard king who inhabited the Great Swamp of Rethild in western Dambrath . Activities . Ghassis was the leader of the Servants of the Royal Egg mercenary company .

title: Ghast
description: Ghast Ghasts were a subtype of ghouls . Description . They resembled very closely their undead cousin , except perhaps being just a bit more slender and ghost - like .

title: Ghaulantatra
description: Ghaulantatra Ghaulantatra was a white dragon ghost who fought for ownership of her home lair against the Cult of the Dragon and Thaluul , a beholder ghost . Description . The ghost looked to have the general shape of an enormous white dragon , but made of pale white mist .

title: Ghaulathator
description: Ghaulathator Ghaulathator , also known as Wintercloak , was an ancient white dragon slain in the time of Netheril . History . In 3426 NY ( −433 DR ) , Wintercloak flew under the floating city of Lathery , over the Narrow Sea in Netheril , and was teleport ed into one of the city ' s cold storage chambers , as part of its fishing system .

title: Ghaunadaur
description: Ghaunadaur Ghaunadaur ( " gone " - ah - dowr ) was a greater deity and the god of abominations . Originally , Ghaunadaur was a member of the drow pantheon but following the War of the Spider Queen he left the pantheon to break off on his own . His portfolio included slimy creatures , outcasts , and rebels .

title: Ghauntz
description: Ghauntz Ghauntz , also known as Ghauntz the Cloaked , was a male human cleric of Gargauth who went on to become the vice chairman of the Knights of the Shield . Description . Ghauntz was an old man with a scarred face who always dressed in black with a cape .

title: Ghaurann Rhee
description: Ghaurann Rhee Ghaurann Rhee was a merchant with some understanding of the the Art and a member of the smuggling and slavery ring known as the Tarntar . He sold spell s that enhanced beauty , provided adornment , or embellished the face and figure along with his line of skin - care products and cosmetics . Personality .

title: Ghazneth
description: Ghazneth The seven ghazneths were fell demon s created by Nalavarauthatoryl from prominent members of Cormyr ean royalty and nobility who had betrayed Cormyr in some way . Powers . Even a single ghazneth was incredibly deadly , displaying phenomenal power and lighting - fast speed .

title: Ghazrim DuLoc
description: Ghazrim DuLoc Ghazrim DuLoc was the Zhentarim ' s main representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Ghazrim was born to a wealthy family in Amn .

title: Ghearufu
description: Ghearufu The Ghearufu was a set of magic items , consisting of a golden - edged mirror on a gold chain that could be hung around the neck and a pair of mismatched gloves , one white and one black . History . Not much was known about the Ghearufu ' s history .

title: Gheldaneth
description: Gheldaneth Gehldaneth was the only Mulhorandi city to survive the Spellplague although its population was greatly reduced . As of 1479 DR it swore fealty to High Imaskar and the Imaskarians stationed troops in the city to ensure its loyalty . Inhabitants .

title: Gheldieg
description: Gheldieg House Gheldieg is an Amn ian house originating from the Gildeggh family of Lord - Magister Ehlemm Gildeggh of Waterdeep . The family was exiled and came to Amn , marrying into its families and gradually transforming into the Gheldieg family . Its power is now controlled by House Tanislove .

title: Ghelryn Foehammer
description: Ghelryn Foehammer Ghelryn Foehammer was a shield dwarf blacksmith of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Ghelryn managed the Foehammer ' s Forge .

title: Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar
description: Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar Ghenni ' tiroth Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar the fourth house of Menzoberranzan . Description . Unlike most drow , Ghenni was a tall and very slim .

title: Ghenni Tlabbar
description: Ghenni Tlabbar Ghenni Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Ghenni ascended to the position of matron mother before 1372 .

title: Ghevel Coalhewer
description: Ghevel Coalhewer Ghevel Coalwhever was a duergar boatman in Gracklstugh during the Silence of Lolth . History . In 1372 DR , Ghevel was hired by the drow party of Quenthel Baenre and Pharaun Mizzrym to travel the Darklake .

title: Ghiirvox
description: Ghiirvox Ghiirvox was the leader of the Scoured Legion in 1479 DR . Personality . Ghiirvox was very reserved and calculating for a tanarukk .

title: Ghilanna Tlabbar
description: Ghilanna Tlabbar Ghilanna Tlabbar was the matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar of Menzoberranzan until her death in 1361 DR . History . Ghilllana won this position due to bloody fights with her seven sisters after her mother and the former heir to the throne were slain in the battle of Mithral Hall in 1358 DR .

title: Ghileeda
description: Ghileeda Ghileeda was a maid in the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Ghileeda worked at the Swinging Sword tavern .

title: Ghindul
description: Ghindul Ghindul was a male kir - lanan and the leader of the Howling Wing in the Wailing Cliff . Description . His scales were a deep ebony and his eyes were of a notably rich amethyst color .

title: Gholam ibn Jubair
description: Gholam ibn Jubair Imam Gholam ibn Jubair was the High Priest of the Mosque of Free Haku in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . As with most priests of Haku , Gholom wore outlandish aba s composed of loud colors .

title: Ghont Tavvas
description: Ghont Tavvas Ghont Tavvas was one of the Boar ' s Head s of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruitment organization in Amn . Description . Lord Tavvas was a distinguished man who was rarely seen out of his blue uniform .

title: Ghost
description: Ghost A ghost was the spirit of a deceased sentient creature . This type of undead was incorporeal in nature and only vulnerable to conventional weapons on the Ethereal Plane . A Ghost Brute was a ghost of an animal , plant , or magical beast that was stuck to the material plane .

title: Ghost ( assassin )
description: Ghost ( assassin ) Ghost was an assassin who belonged to the Night Masks . He spent at least three lifetimes perfecting his mastery of the dreaded " Ghearufu " . Appearance .

title: Ghost Holds
description: Ghost Holds The Ghost Holds consisted of some forty ruined castles and mansions spread through the forest in Battledale . Description . It was an outlaw town ruled unofficially by a long - dead past ruler referred to by some as the King of Ghosts .

title: Ghost Knight of Galardoun
description: Ghost Knight of Galardoun The Ghost Knight of Galardoun was a wandering apparition that appeared in various locations throughout the heartlands of Faerûn . Several cults sprang up to venerate the apparition including the True Ghost Knight Faithful in Waterdeep . Description .

title: Ghost Leopard
description: Ghost Leopard The Ghost Leopard province was found in the northwest region of the Land of the Yak - Men in 1367 DR . Geography . This province of the Yikarian Empire was dominated by the World Pillar Mountains on its eastern side and foothills and rugged terrain along the River Ruin in the west and north .

title: Ghost Mountains
description: Ghost Mountains The Ghost Mountains , or Jibal al - Taif , were a small group of mountains found within Interior Zakhara . Geography . The Ghost Mountains were situated between the North Quarter of Suq Bay and the burning expanse of the Haunted Lands .

title: Ghost Pond
description: Ghost Pond Ghost Pond was a body of water located near the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . It was a large but shallow pool situated beside of the North Road , just north of Sevenecho . It was named for the ghost regularly sighted on or beside its waters by 1367 DR .

title: Ghost armor
description: Ghost armor Ghost armor was a conjuration spell that improved on the " armor " spell by creating an aura of protection around the recipient . Effects . This spell could be cast by touch on one creature of any size up to Huge .

title: Ghost mount
description: Ghost mount Ghost mounts were horrifying creatures who wander in the desert and has help lost travelers but for a special fee : those who agree to go with this creatures , themselves become ghosts . These ghosts have two forms their true form and illusory . Their real form is a transparent outline , of what they were in life ( horse , camel , or antelope ) They often look very badly rotting skeletons with big wounds .

title: Ghost of eventide
description: Ghost of eventide A ghost of eventide was a rogue who had chosen to fight the forces of the revived Netherese Empire around 1479 DR . Learning to use the very shadows that protected and enshrouded Netheril , ghosts of eventide were members of a loosely bound organization whose aim was , above all else , the defeat of Netheril . Silent and deadly killers , " ghosts of death " were often motivated by a sense of vengeance or righteous rage , choosing to fight evil with death and dealing little mercy against their most hated enemies .

title: Ghost pipes
description: Ghost pipes Ghost pipes was a bard spell that caused an instrument to rise into the air and hover , playing itself with no visible musician . Wizard s could cast this spell also , but it was more difficult for them . Effect .

title: Ghost rigging
description: Ghost rigging Ghost rigging was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a ghostly rigging on a sailing vessel that functioned just as normal rigging did .

title: Ghost rothé
description: Ghost rothé Ghost rothé , also known as snow rothé or white rothé , were a variety of white rothé . Description . Like other rothé , ghost rothé had shaggy fur , but their coat was a striking white .

title: Ghost sound
description: Ghost sound Ghost sound , also known as audible glamer , is a cantrip , or very simple to use spell , learned by all wizard s . " Ghost sound " allows its caster to create the impression of a quiet , whispery sound within fifty feet . However , the sound is not real , but an illusion created by the wizard .

title: Ghosts of Dragonspear Castle
description: Ghosts of Dragonspear Castle Summary . A group of Red Wizards of Thay have constructed a base that contains a quartet of netherese " portal s " that each lead to powerful elemental nodes . In order to access the power of those nodes , they need the portal keys .

title: Ghostwalk
description: Ghostwalk Ghostwalk is a sourcebook for " Dungeons & Dragons " using the 3rd - edition ruleset published in 2003 . It covers a heavily ghost - themed campaign setting , " Ghostwalk " . Although unrelated to the " Forgotten Realms " campaign setting , the book includes suggestions for adapting and placing the " Ghostwalk " setting on Toril .

title: Ghostwise halfling
description: Ghostwise halfling Ghostwise halflings were the most uncommon of the three halfling subraces . Description . Ghostwise halflings have the ability to communicate telepathically with any creature within 20 feet that speaks the same language .

title: Ghoul
description: Ghoul Ghouls were monstrous , undead humanoids who reeked of carrion . Culture . A ghoul was said to be created on the death of a man or woman who savored the taste of the flesh of people ; this was probably derived from the popular connection of the word " ghoul " with persons who delighted in the unsavory .

title: Ghour
description: Ghour The ghours are a race of demon s in the service of ( and possibly / probably created by ) the demon lord Baphomet ; whom is best known as the patron of minotaur s . They are an uncategorized species of demon ; not belonging to either the tanar ' ri , obyrith or loumara demonic subcategories . These monstrosities work their master ' s will among the minotaurs , ogre s and renegade giant s that serve him .

title: Ghul - kin
description: Ghul - kin Ghul - kin were creatures related to the great ghuls . They were undead jann that lived in Zakhara . Description .

title: Ghul Lord
description: Ghul Lord Ghul Lords were strange wizard s from Zakhara who used the Negative Energy plane to fuel their spells . Requirements . Their close association with the Negative Energy plane attracted wild and ruthless individuals to become ghul lords .

title: Ghuldur Flagonfist
description: Ghuldur Flagonfist Ghuldur Flagonfist was the duergar ' s main representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Ghuldur was a merchant from Gracklstugh selling armor , arrowheads , locks , mining and smithing equipment , and smoked Darklake fish .

title: Ghunayya
description: Ghunayya Ghunayya of the Rose Petal was a human pirate living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Ghunayya captained a ship known as either the " Djinni ' s Flower " or the " Floating Rose " .

title: Ghunayya min Hakiyuh
description: Ghunayya min Hakiyuh Ghunayya min Hakiyuh was a high priestess of Hakiyah of the Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest in 1367 DR . Activities . Ghunayya was a member of the holy slayer organization called the Soft Whisper .

title: Ghunda
description: Ghunda Ghunda was one of the elders , along with her husband Thurrak , of a stone giant tribe on the eastern shore of the Lake of Shadows . Personality . Ghunda did not share the same reticence as others of her kind when dealing with others .

title: Ghunnis
description: Ghunnis Ghunnis was a locathah of Tiger Coral tribe in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Ghunnis was very hard - nosed and unforgiving in her outlook .

title: Giant
description: Giant Giants are humanoid creatures , usually of great strength and size . Most giants have vision equivalent to that of a human , though some have the capacity to see well in low light or total darkness as well . As a group , they have no other special abilities .

title: Giant ' s Belt Mountains
