description: Giant ' s Belt Mountains The Giant ' s Belt Mountains marked the northeastern border of the Beastlands and Durpar . The Aerilpar Forest lay at the foot of this mountain range , as well . The monsters who destroyed Veldorn came from the Giant ' s Belt Mountains , making them the origin point of the Beastlands themselves .

title: Giant ' s Folly
description: Giant ' s Folly The Giant ' s Folly is a festhall in the village of Reddansyr , southwest of Westgate on the road to Starmantle . It has become known in the Dragon Coast as an information clearing - house , which rather annoys the local chapel of Oghma . The Giant ' s Folly is located inside an overturned boat that was pulled inland by a fire giant to win a bet .

title: Giant ' s Plain
description: Giant ' s Plain The name of these plains has changed at least twice . The first after the impressive rout of the resident giants by the dwarves of High Shanatar which slaughtered over 5000 of the creatures in - 5350 DR . The general of that successful army was named Karlyn and the area was dubbed Karlyn ' s Vale in his honor .

title: Giant ' s Run Mountains
description: Giant ' s Run Mountains The Giant ' s Run Mountains were a range of mountains west of the Vilhon Reach in the Shining Plains . They were an outpost for the gold dwarves as of 1372 DR . Geography .

title: Giant - kin
description: Giant - kin Giant - kin were large humanoid s related to the true giant s . Any race that could trace its lineage back to Othea ' s relationship with Ulutiu could be considered giant - kin . The mother of all giants , Othea , cheated on her husband Annam All - Father , the father of giants , with Ulutiu , producing the firbolg s , fomorian s , verbeeg s , and the voadkyn .

title: Giant Wars
description: Giant Wars The Giant Wars were fought between the giant s of Nedeheim and the dwarves of High Shanatar from −5360 to −5350 DR . The dwarves were led by Karlyn of House Kuldever . By the end of the war , more than five thousand giants of Nedeheim had fallen to the dwarves and half of the entire giant population south of the Cloud Peaks was exterminated .

title: Giant bombardier beetle
description: Giant bombardier beetle The giant bombardier beetle was a variety of giant beetle . Description . Bombardier beetles were generally about 4 feet ( 1 .

title: Giant cobra
description: Giant cobra Giant cobras were large venomous snakes that inhabited the lands of Zakhara . These dangerous snakes were incredibly long - lived , sometimes surviving for as long as a century . All giant cobras gained intelligence as they aged .

title: Giant eagle
description: Giant eagle Giant eagles were large - sized magical beasts that resembled massive eagles . Decription . Eagles were intelligent creatures that stood about 15 feet tall and possessed a wingspan of 30 feet .

title: Giant fire beetle
description: Giant fire beetle Giant fire beetles were nocturnal giant beetle s . Description . Giant fire beetles were the smallest of all the giant beetles known to scholars .

title: Giant insect
description: Giant insect Giant insect , also known as giant vermin , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to grow centipede s , scorpions , spider s , beetle s , flies , wasp s or similar creatures to much larger than their original size . The reverse of the spell , shrink insect , could reduce giant insects down to normal size . Effects .

title: Giant language
description: Giant language The giant language , called Jotun by those who speak it , was the ancient language of most giant s . It was one of the oldest active languages . It was believed that the language shared some of its roots with Common and Thorass .

title: Giant mason wasp
description: Giant mason wasp Giant mason wasps were huge versions of a common mason - wasp . They could be found in Zakhara and were viewed as messengers of the gods . Description .

title: Giant owl
description: Giant owl Giant owls were magical creatures that appeared to be abnormally large owl s . Description . In addition to their great size ( 9 feet tall with a wingspan of 20 feet ) , these creatures were intelligent and capable of speech .

title: Giant pantheon
description: Giant pantheon The giant pantheon ( or Ordning when used with an initial capital ) is the group of titan s worshiped by giant s and giant - kin as deities . While the specifics of worship and religious views vary from species to species and even from tribe to tribe , most giants accept that Annam All - Father , the creator of giants , is the supreme deity . It is believed that the taller the giant , the closer he is to the throne of Annam , and therefore the more superior he is .

title: Giant spider
description: Giant spider Giant spiders were quite simply enormous versions of regular spiders . Existing in various types , there was no way to singularly describe their appearance ; with various types ranging in size from that of a dog to a house . Giant versions of tarantulas existed , as did black widows , spitters , spinners , and all manner of others .

title: Giant wasp
description: Giant wasp A giant wasp is a monstrous version of the common wasp . They attack when hungry or threatened , usually taking the dead bodies of their victims to the hive where it can be consumed by young wasps . Usage .

title: Giants in Grey
description: Giants in Grey The Giants in Grey , or Chu Jen Yin , were a group of legendary creatures of Shou Lung . Description . The Giants were said to be of great height , standing 4 meters ( 13 .

title: Giantspire Mountains
description: Giantspire Mountains The Giantspire Mountains were located on the snowy and rugged borders of Damara and Narfell . Geography . The mountains were north of the Rawlinswood in northeastern Faerûn .

title: Giarrok
description: Giarrok Giarrok , commonly known as Fire - Tongue , was a gnoll sorcerer who was chieftain of the Fire Claws , a small tribe of his kin who lived in the Umar Hills in Amn . Description . As mentioned , Giarrok was almost 8 feet tall , had almost mahogany colored fur and a long black stripe down his left side .

title: Gibbering mouther
description: Gibbering mouther Gibbering mouthers were unnatural aberrations , nightmarish blobs of mouths and eyes . Description . These bizarre creatures appeared as large blobs composed entirely of mouths and eyes .

title: Gibberling
description: Gibberling Gibberlings are small , nocturnal humanoid creatures that inhabit many regions in Faerûn . Their species originates in the Far Realm , a place of madness beyond the known planes . Appearance .

title: Gideon Holke
description: Gideon Holke Gideon Holke was a military captain in Mulmaster . Personality . Gideon had recently grown in influence , especially with some of Mulmaster ' s wealthiest and most beautiful women .

title: Gideona
description: Gideona Lochlord Gideona was the leader of the Keepers in Skullport in 1370 DR . Personality . Gideona ' s ambition was that , within the next decade , all overland routes and gates along the River Sargauth would fall under the Keepers ' control , permitting her to control all trade in and around the city .

title: Gifu
description: Gifu Gifu was the shogun capital of Kozakura from 1046 DR . Gifu was in Tairayama Province near the Moro Province border . It was selected because was at center of lands controlled by Hojo clan .

title: Gilded Gown of Selussa
description: Gilded Gown of Selussa The Gilded Gown of Selussa was a tight gauzy dress made of mithral . Abilities . The garment was protected the wearer from wounds and reflected " magic missile " spells back to the casters .

title: Gilded Palm
description: Gilded Palm The Gilded Palm was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Jisan , the Zakharan goddess of fruitfulness . The symbol and favored weapon of the Gilded Palm was a dagger that had a coin - encrusted hilt . Activities .

title: Gilded Spur
description: Gilded Spur The Gilded Spur was an inn in Amnwater , Amn . Services . The establishment offered gambling facilities aimed at the passing caravan trade , but this made it less popular with locals .

title: Gildenglade
description: Gildenglade Gildenglade was a settlement in the forest area at the foot of the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish . This city was the second - largest within Turmish , composed of dwarves , elves , and half - elves living together in harmony . Its economy was based primarily upon woodcutting and mining .

title: Gildmak Sholapur
description: Gildmak Sholapur Gildmak Sholapur was a prominent halfling businessman in Luiren in 1367 DR . He was the leader of a group of brewers . Activities .

title: Giles Wormack
description: Giles Wormack Giles Wormack was a human boy during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow assault on the Silver Marches , Giles lived with his sister Karolina Wormack in Sundabar .

title: Gilfron Milon
description: Gilfron Milon Gilfron Milon was a merchant in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Gilfron was a friendly and pleasant individual .

title: Gilgeam
description: Gilgeam Gilgeam , the God - king of Unther , was a demigod and the former leader of the Untheric pantheon . He was known for his jealousy , cruelty and pride . A former intermediate deity , he was reduced to the state of demigod after the Time of Troubles due to his centuries - long abuse of his followers .

title: Gilkriz
description: Gilkriz Gilkriz was a senior member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , Gilkriz was chosen by Master Urlryn Khalazza to help teleport the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .

title: Gillian ' s Hill
description: Gillian ' s Hill Gillian ' s Hill was a hamlet about a half - day ' s ride south of Daggerford on the Trade Way and about the same distance north of Liam ' s Hold . The hamlet was named for Gillian Cantilar . There was an ancient and dangerous tomb in Gillian ' s Hill that led to the Underdark .

title: Gim Blacktongue
description: Gim Blacktongue Gim Blacktongue was a mage and ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Gim Blacktongue was a cunning mage who used treachery to usurp the throne of Doegan . Although the kingdom prospered , it did so under an air of suspicion , and Doegan folk called for a new and trustworthy rule .

title: Gina bint Kemala
description: Gina bint Kemala Gina bint Kemala was a human mystic and member of the Readers in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Her long black hair began to streak with grey as she approached middle age .

title: Ginafae DeVir
description: Ginafae DeVir Ginafae DeVir was the matron mother of House DeVir in Menzoberranzan until its destruction in 1297 DR . History . In 1297 DR , Ginafae DeVir was the matron mother of the fourth house and thus the youngest matron in the Ruling Council .

title: Ginali
description: Ginali Ginali was a servant of the High Imperceptor of Bane , known himself as the High Inquisitor of Bane , and an orthodox Banite . History . In 1357 DR , he was charged with conducting an investigation into the fitness of Fzoul Chembryl to be head of the church in the West Moonsea region .

title: Gindrol
description: Gindrol Gindrol was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Gindrol was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee .

title: Ginella
description: Ginella Ginella was the chief of the staff of Helm Dwarf - Friend in Sundabar in 1373 DR . Description . Ginella was a burly and severe elder woman .

title: Gingerbread
description: Gingerbread Gingerbread was a cake - like bread made with ginger from Shou Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Gingrid
description: Gingrid Gingrid was a strange follower of Myrkul who lived in the Underchasm in 1486 DR . History . Gingrid resided in a castle in Underchasm , just above the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple , waiting for a sign from her presumed - lost god .

title: Giogioni Wyvernspur
description: Giogioni Wyvernspur Giogioni Wyvernspur ( Giogi for short ) is the head of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr . He is capable of transforming into a wyvern when he is in possession of the mummified wyvern ' s claw that is an heirloom in his family . Only one in every generation is capable of this transformation .

title: Girallon
description: Girallon Girallons were aggressive , carnivorous apes with four arms . They were incredibly strong and territorial . These beasts lived in groups dominated by the strongest male .

title: Girdle of priestly might
description: Girdle of priestly might Girdles of Priestly Might were magical items that could be found in Halruaa . History . These items only appeared after the Time of Troubles .

title: Girru
description: Girru Girru was the Untheric god of fire . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was an axe wrapped in flame .

title: Gisbertus
description: Gisbertus Gisbertus was the bugbear steward and chamberlain of queen Zaranda Star . Personality . Gisbertus fretted over the other servants and often took it upon himself to cook for the queen , being an expert cook .

title: Giselle Malcomb
description: Giselle Malcomb Giselle Malcomb was a Rider of Nesmé . Description . Giselle was strong and solidly built .

title: Gisen
description: Gisen Gisen , known in Kozakura as Kuang , was an exiled prince of T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Gisen was born in the royal court of T ' u Lung as the third son of the emperor , tutored by the great sword master Tong Fu Mei .

title: Gith
description: Gith Gith was one of the leaders of the thrall rebellion that toppled the illithid empire thousands of years in the past and the first leader of the githyanki . History . Gith was a native of the planet Pharagos , which was part of the vast illithid empire , although she later led her followers to the Astral Plane after defeating their illithid masters .

title: Gith ( race )
description: Gith ( race ) The gith ( they referred to themselves as “ the People ” ) are a group of natural outsider s , descended from human s enslaved by the illithid s . The gith are divided into two different races , the githzerai and githyanki . Additionally , there are gith who went their own ways after the gith split .

title: Githyanki
description: Githyanki The githyanki were a once - human race of Astral Sea - dwellers . Ecology . All githyanki children possessed minor telekinetic abilities , but only a few worked to develop them .

title: Githyanki hideout
description: Githyanki hideout Githyanki hideout was a house in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The hideout was located in the Merchant Quarter in Neverwinter , near the Smuggler ' s warehouse .

title: Githyanki silver sword
description: Githyanki silver sword Githyanki " silver swords " were weapons given to the knights and leaders of the githyanki race . They were powerful magic al greatsword s that came in two varieties , depending on the wielder ' s rank . Their most notable property was the ability to sever an individual ' s silver cord .

title: Githzerai
description: Githzerai The githzerai are a once - human race that dwells primarily on the plane of Limbo . Description . Githzerai are naturally possessed of psionics and some magic resistance .

title: Glabbagool
description: Glabbagool Glabbagool was an unusual sentient gelatinous cube in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The arrive of the demon lord Juiblex somehow granted Glabbagool intelligence .

title: Glabrezu
description: Glabrezu A glabrezu , also known as a type IV demon , was powerful type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . A glabrezu ' s broad , muscular body was as large as a giant .

title: Glacier of the Dragon
description: Glacier of the Dragon The Glacier of the Dragon was a large glacier located within A - Ling Shan and Katakoro Shan of the Yehimal . Geography . This glacier had the shape of a serpent if viewed from above , making many believed that this was where its name orginated .

title: Glacier of the Lost King
description: Glacier of the Lost King The Glacier of the Lost King was located in the western reaches of what was once known as the kingdom of Guge . Description . The glacier rested upon the southwestern rim of the Hollow Crown Mountains .

title: Glacier of the White Worm
description: Glacier of the White Worm The Glacier of the White Worm was a glacier situated high in the Earthspur Mountains in north Faerûn , lying between the Moonsea , Damara , Impiltur , and the Vast . Geography . The glacier was a great river of ice that weaved between the tallest mountains of the Earthspurs .

title: Glade
description: Glade The Glade was an area of trees in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . The location contained a small stream and a lake , and was where sylvan races like centaur s and faun s often chose to stay while visiting .

title: Gladiator
description: Gladiator A gladiator was an occupation and prestige class . Summary . Gladiators were creatures , often humanoid , who fought other creatures for the amusement of others .

title: Gladsheim
description: Gladsheim Gladsheim , also referred to as Ysgard , was the Great Wheel plane straddling the alignments of chaotic good and chaotic neutral . Like the Greek influence on Olympus / Arvandor , much of this plane was heavily dominated by the gods of the Norse pantheon who had little interaction with the people of Toril . The primary exception was Tyr , the Norse god of war and law who became known and widely worshiped as the God of Justice in the Forgotten Realms .

title: Glaedorn
description: Glaedorn Glaedorn was a cave located somewhere in the Howling Mountains section of Fimbrul , Returned Abeir . The cave was full of rich veins of metal ores and huge gem stones . Background .

title: Glaemril
description: Glaemril The Glaemril , also known as the Deeping Stream , was a small river that ran through the Dalelands . The river started in the southern spur of the woods of Cormanthor and flowed into the River Ashaba , just before the Pool of Yeven . Uses .

title: Glaive
description: Glaive A glaive was a reach weapon in the pole arm family . Description . The glaive was a pole arm that , in its basic form , was a large knife mounted on a long pole .

title: Glamered
description: Glamered Glamered armor is quite useful for intrusion , as it can transform itself upon command to take the form of ordinary clothing . Creation . He who would craft " glamered " armor must know the spell " disguise self " .

title: Glamered ( armor property )
description: Glamered ( armor property ) Glamered is a quality that can be applied to masterwork armor , granting the wearer the ability to hide his or her armor from sight . If the wearer gives a predetermined command , the armor transmutes itself into outwardly normal clothing . It retains all other properties , including weight , hardness , and so on .

title: Glamerie Windbough
description: Glamerie Windbough The current leader of the Chauntea ns in Shadowdale is High Harvestmistress Glamerie Windbough , a calm introspective woman who sees all things as passing in cycles , like the seasons of the year , including the Zhentarim occupation . She spends a lot of time hearing the complaints of the Dalesfolk and attempting to soothe their anger and fears . She also meets regularly with the commanders of the Zhentarim army , who tolerate the Temple of Chauntea , called the House of Plenty , as long as it can encourage bumper harvests .

title: Glaragama Dunrohiyr
description: Glaragama Dunrohiyr Glaragama Dunrohiyr was a female wizard and archmage from Calaunt in the Vast , of the 13th century DR . History . Glaragama originally came from Calaunt in the Vast .

title: Glass - breakers
description: Glass - breakers The Glass - breakers were a group of fanatical gnomes who lived on an uncharted island in the middle of Yal Tengri . Activities . The sole purpose of the Glass - breakers was to thwart the construction of the Great Spire of the Ice Sea that was being built by a cult of Gond .

title: Glass cutter
description: Glass cutter A glass cutter was a tool used by some rogue s to by - pass locked windows . Uses . Glass cutters were a viable option for thieves wishing to ignore the time - consuming task of getting through a locked window .

title: Glassteel
description: Glassteel Glassteel was a material that was as strong as steel and as transparent as glass . Properties . Glassteel lacked the normal greenish tint of glass , instead gleaming a dullish and almost translucent gray .

title: Glasya
description: Glasya Lord of the Sixth , Glasya is a Princess of the Nine Hells . She is noted as one of the most powerful and influential of the female devil s and for being the daughter of Asmodeus . Appearance .

title: Glathra Barcantle
description: Glathra Barcantle Glathra Barcantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr and the " de facto " third - in - command . During King Foril ' s Dragon Council in 1479 DR , when Royal Mage Ganrahast and his second - in - command Vainrence were imprisoned by Manshoon in the palace crypts , Glathra assumed command of the War Wizards and helped to prevent an uprising by disgruntled nobles . Personality .

title: Glaur
description: Glaur Glaur , known to its inhabitants as the Dominions of Nehu , was an ancient fortress built by the primordial Nehushta during the Dawn War . It was located in northern Gontal , in the center of the Glaur Barrens . Description .

title: Glaur ( instrument )
description: Glaur ( instrument ) A glaur was a short curved valved horn , popular among bard s in the Realms . It was similar to a cornucopia and sounded like a trumpet . Description .

title: Glaur Barrens
description: Glaur Barrens The Glaur Barrens were the plagueland s that composed most of the northern region of Gontal . Geography . The Glaur Barrens were a mixture of earthmote s and plaguelands filled with strangely regular metallic ruins and areas of rusted iron and sparse vegetation .

title: Glaurachyndaar
description: Glaurachyndaar Glaurachyndaar ( formerly Myth Glaurach , the City of Scrolls ) is a ruined Eaerlann i city situated on the river Starsilver , a tributary of the river Delimbiyr , in the Nether Mountains . It was a garden city with ornate buildings and white domes , built on the ruins of an Aryvandaar an city . History .

title: Glavel
description: Glavel Glavel was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Glavel was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Chisel in the Disciples of St .

title: Gleamtail jack
description: Gleamtail jack A gleamtail jack is a type of fish known to live in the Elemental Chaos . Physical description . Gleamtail jacks are albino colored .

title: Glei Yuindo
description: Glei Yuindo Glei Yuindo was an adventurer active in Koryo in the 1350s DR . In 1357 DR , a band of adventurers headed by Glei Yuindo returned to Pan and it was rumored they had discovered the famous lost fortress of Toranu Ganppo . However , before they could tell their story , they died of a mysterious sickness .

title: Glek
description: Glek " ? Glek " ' was a male goblin of Duskwood on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History .

title: Glendar
description: Glendar Glendar was an adventuring wizard who hated medusas and basilisks to such an extent that he was compelled to invent the rod of mirrors . Eventually , Glendar turned evil and became a lich , but he was destroyed by the adventurers he had originally aimed to protect .

title: Glenn Whitmore
description: Glenn Whitmore Glenn Whitmore is a comic book artist who has worked for , , and Comics . His primary role was as colorist . Career .

title: Glenna Moonsmith
description: Glenna Moonsmith Glenna Moonsmith was a dwarf innkeeper and tavern owner in the Moonsea . Activities . Glenna managed the inn and tavern called the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop .

title: Glevith
description: Glevith Glevith was a criminal in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Glevith did not like the established powers and always fought for the good of the lower class .

title: Glibness
description: Glibness Glibness was a transmutation spell that altered the caster ' s speech , making his or her elocution much more convincing and believable . Effects . The caster of this spell was blessed with an agility of speech that greatly increased the chance that a bluff would succeed .

title: Glimmersea
description: Glimmersea The Glimmersea , sometimes called the Sea of the Starry Night , was a vast underground ocean lying in the Underdark of Toril . Geography . The Glimmersea laid some 20 miles ( 32 kilometers ) beneath the floor of another large body of water , the Sea of Fallen Stars in central Faerûn .

title: Glina
description: Glina Glina was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Glina was a wizard of Neverwinter Academy , who entertained herself with gossips .

title: Glinda Scatterstar
description: Glinda Scatterstar Glinda Scatterstar was the master of the Mage ' s Guild of Hillsfar and secretly an active rebel against Lord Maalthiir in 1367 DR . Personality . Glinda saw Maalthiir as a ruining influence in her city and she changed the objective of the Guild to actively remove him from power .

title: Glister
description: Glister Glister was the only human settlement in Thar . Due to its remote location in an otherwise desolate land , food and timber were its main imports , which were often traded for raw ores including iron , silver and copper . History .

title: Glitterdust
description: Glitterdust Glitterdust ( originally called Fahren ' s glitterdust ) was a conjuration spell from the that created a burst of golden particles that stuck to everything in an area . Effects . Upon completing this spell , the caster created a cloud of glittering dust with a twenty - foot diameter within a medium distance .

title: Glittergold ' s gambit
description: Glittergold ' s gambit Glittergold ' s gambit was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Garl Glittergold that granted a nearby ally another chance at performing a skill or attack in order to improve the outcome . Better or worse , the second outcome was final .

title: Glizn
description: Glizn Glizn was a quasit in Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , Glizn was the quasit that Piri , an apprentice in the College of Mages and acolyte of the skin , bonded to himself using an ancient Ritual of Bonding rediscovered by Q ' arlynd Melarn .

title: Gloaming
description: Gloaming Gloamings were planetouched creatures with heritage from both Toril and the Plane of Shadow . Description . Gloamings were humanoid s typically with pale skin and dark , furry wings , with which they were able to fly .

title: Globe of invulnerability
description: Globe of invulnerability Globe of invulnerability was an arcane abjuration spell that created a protective barrier around the caster . Effects . For up to one minute , as long as the caster kept concentrating , the spell created a shimmering fixed spherical barrier centered on the caster that canceled the effects of any spell that was originally less powerful than " globe of invulnerability " .

title: Glooglugogg
description: Glooglugogg Glooglugogg was a kuo - toa whip living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . Personality . Glooglugogg was very loyal to his goddess and his father .

title: Gloomwrought
description: Gloomwrought Gloomwrought was a city in the Shadowfell . Government . The ruler of Gloomwrought was Prince Rolan , a human nobleman .

title: Glorghakt
description: Glorghakt Glorghakt was a mind flayer envoy from Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR the illithid of Ryxyg discovered that the fire giant s of Maerimydra had built devastating arcane siege engines that planning to use against Hillsfar and Elventree but the mind flayer discovered also a mean to disable those engine in secret from far .

title: Glorious raiment
description: Glorious raiment Glorious raiment is an abjuration spell that imbues clothing with divine power . Effect . You imbue a robe , priestly garment , or outfit of regular clothing with divine power .

title: Glorious servitor
description: Glorious servitor Abilities . Similar in some respects to the divine champion , glorious servitors gained no additional spells , but did gain several useful powers and spell - like abilities , including being able to transform into their deity ' s favored animal . They could even communicate while in this animal form .

title: Glorlo
description: Glorlo Glorlo was the cleric of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Instead of speak Glorlo chanted and for him a - week - ago ' s events were like legends of ancient times .

title: Glorming
description: Glorming Glorming was a male orc chieftain of the tribes that dwelled in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast . He was a hero to the local orcs , and died fighting in the pass that was named for him — Glorming Pass — some time before 1370 DR .

title: Glorming Pass
description: Glorming Pass Glorming Pass was a major pass through Earthfast Mountains in the Vast , linking the northern and southern halves . The North Road ran through it to connect Sevenecho and Dragon Falls . It was a wild and dangerous place , prone to orc ambushes and haunted by The Phantom Knights .

title: Glormorglulla
description: Glormorglulla Glormorglulla was a beholder . History . Once Glormorglulla was defeated and frozen by Elminster and Dove Falconhand .

title: Glorst
description: Glorst Glorst was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Glorst was one of the former priests who joined the church of Eilistraee in Shilmista .

title: Glory
description: Glory Glory was a tiefling psionicist who was employed by the merchant clan House Serrat for security . Her primary duty was to erase the memories of the clan ' s terazul harvesters so that the family ' s rivals could not learn the location of the plants . Description .

title: Glory Mines
description: Glory Mines The Glory Mines were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . The Glory Mines were located within the very bedrock upon which the City of Brass was located .

title: Glory domain
description: Glory domain The Glory domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters glorious spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Glory Domain Powers .

title: Glory of the martyr
description: Glory of the martyr Glory of the martyr was a divine abjuration spell for paladin s that granted a protective ward to multiple subjects , transferring some of their wounds to the spellcaster and healing them if the caster should die . Although created by Ilmater , the Crying God , and used by his faithful , the spell spread to paladins of other faiths . Users .

title: Glouroth
description: Glouroth Glouroth was a mature adult Shadow dragon that resided in the Deep Wastes between the Lake of Shadows and Maerimydra . He made his lair in the Wailing Cliff , an odd place where the Plane of Shadow bled into the Material Plane . Description .

title: Glow fever
description: Glow fever Glow fever was a deadly wasting disease that could be contracted by being bitten by the firefly - like insects that lived in the fortress of Glaur in Gontal . In the initial stages , the bodies of those afflicted glowed with a yellow - green bioluminescence similar to that of the of the swarming insects . Victims who died of this disease had their bodies mutated into a new swarm , which usually abandoned the place of their deaths to seek for its fellows in Glaur .

title: Glow of Ulban
description: Glow of Ulban Glow of Ulban is a powerful invocation bestowed upon warlock s , particularly those who specialize in pacts with aberrant powers , that flows from the power of the ancient , Far Realm - touched star of Ulban . When a " glow of Ulban " spell is cast , the warlock summons forth burning , blue - white light from Ulban , scorching one creature of the warlock ' s choosing within twenty - five feet . If the warlock specializes in such aberrant power likely also cause the creature ' s instincts for self - preservation to fade away , making them more vulnerable to later attacks .

title: Glow ring
description: Glow ring A glow ring was a magical ring that gave off a soft glow , useful in nighttime thieving and other illicit activities . Description . It was a silver ring set with an opal .

title: Glowrod
description: Glowrod A glowrod was a small metal rod that glowed with bright light . Description . Most glowrods were made of and had a cover to block their light when not in use .

title: Glycamerax
description: Glycamerax Glycamerax was a white dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Glycamerax was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Glyph of warding
description: Glyph of warding Glyph of warding was an abjuration spell that stored an evocation effect in a magical inscription to prevent intrusion . Effects . A " glyph " could be set on a object or on a suitable area .

title: Glyphic Shroomlight
description: Glyphic Shroomlight Glyphic Shroomlight was a young deep gnome acolyte of Segojan Earthcaller in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Glyphic was very nervous because he knew his position needed an older and more experienced priest .

title: Glyphimhor
description: Glyphimhor Glyphimhor was one of the most powerful lieutenants in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Glyphimhor ruled the metropolis of Orcusgate on the Layers of the Abyss ruled by Orcus .

title: Glyth
description: Glyth Glyth was the 6th planet in the Realms ' solar system and had long been a bastion of the Illithid s . A ringed planet approximately 1 , 000 , 000 , 000 miles from the sun . It had 3 satellites and is one of the Five Wanderers , planets that ( from the perspective of Toril ) seemed to defy the normal paths of the stars .

title: Gnoll
description: Gnoll Gnolls are a humanoid race that most closely resemble hyenas that dwell in the eastern parts of Faerûn and are known for their savage culture and warlike ways . Ecology . Physical description .

title: Gnollwatch Mountains
description: Gnollwatch Mountains The Gnollwatch Mountains are a medium small mountain range that runs east to west through Dambrath for approximately 700 miles . The range eventually declines and becomes the Hills of Dead Kings in the east . The Gnollwatch are not impressive peaks because of the Muaraghal Mountains to the west but have several moderate peaks over 9000 feet and Mount Hazail is the tallest peak at 11 , 500 feet .

title: Gnome
description: Gnome Gnomes , or the Forgotten Folk as they were sometimes known , were small humanoid s known for their eccentric sense of humor , inquisitiveness , and engineering prowess . Having had few overt influences on the world ' s history but many small and unseen ones , gnomes were often overlooked by the powers that be , despite their craftiness and affinity for illusion magic . Description .

title: Gnome artificer
description: Gnome artificer Gnome artificer is a prestige class whose members are artisans and craftspeople who explore what technologies are available to the people of Faerûn , specifically by creating devices that attempt to reproduce the effects of various arcane spells . While often being competitive with one another , artificers also tend to share information and work with one another on various projects . If not working on their own or in small teams , artificers can often be found as advisors to massive engineering endeavours such as in the construction of bridges and the like .

title: Gnome hooked hammer
description: Gnome hooked hammer The gnome hooked hammer was a two - handed exotic melee weapon . Description . The gnome hooked hammer had a relatively short haft with a hammer on one end and a sharp - pointed hook ( curved only slightly more than a pick ) on the other .

title: Gnome language
description: Gnome language The gnomish language , also known as Gnim , was spoken by the gnome s of the Great Spire of Yal Tengri . Gnim has a simple structure and fluid tones . Most gnomes have a truly daunting vocabulary , however , with extremely fine degrees of distinction in , for example , kinds of love or shades of green .

title: Gnomish cloak
description: Gnomish cloak Gnomish cloaks were special cloaks worn by some rogue s . Uses . These wonderful cloaks were expertly crafted with grey fabrics that created a textured look , allowing a prowling thief to blend into the shadows with more conviction .

title: Gobidamu
description: Gobidamu Gobidamu was a monk and the retired emperor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Gobidamu was emperor from 1326 DR until 1333 DR when he retired in favor of his son , Gokammu .

title: Goblin
description: Goblin Goblins are a race of small and numerous goblinoid s common throughout Toril , often living in underground caverns near the surface known as lairs . The race is often , though not always , dominated by other goblinoids , most commonly hobgoblin s . Goblins may have , in fact , been initially created by this related race to serve as scouts and infiltrators .

title: Goblin War
description: Goblin War The Goblin War occurred from 1370 DR to 1371 DR . The war started when Nalavarauthatoryl , ( an elf - dragon ) massed an army of Orc s , Grodd goblin s , the seven Ghazneths and other monsters to attack the country of Cormyr . Interestingly , although the war is refered to as the Goblin Wars , goblin s only made up a fraction of the army , most of the fighting being done by the Orc s .

title: Goblin language
description: Goblin language The goblin language , also known as Ghukliak , was the language spoken by goblin s , hobgoblin s , and bugbear s . It originally used the Dethek script , but by the late 15 century , goblinoid s had begun using the Thorass alphabet instead .

title: Goblinberry bush
description: Goblinberry bush Goblinberry bushes grew on the plains surrounding the Battle of Bones . Description . These small bushes had reddish - purple berries and dark green leaves that almost appeared black but had a silver underside .

title: Goblinoid
description: Goblinoid Goblinoids are a race of closely related humanoid s also known as goblins , not to be confused with the particular variety of the same name . It is believed by some scholars that some of the goblinoid races were purposefully bred by the hobgoblin race , who often dominate goblinoid communities . Notable examples of the goblinoid include , but are not limited to , the goblin , bugbear , and hobgoblin .

title: Gobo
description: Gobo Gobo was the myoshu of a very small village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Gobo ' s village was visited by sohei of the Black Temple , who asked for a payment of rent .

title: Gobo ( hengeyokai )
description: Gobo ( hengeyokai ) Gobo was a myoshu in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Gobo led the village of Ibara ; most people suspected he was a cat hengeyokai .

title: Gobo the Hermit
description: Gobo the Hermit Gobo the Hermit was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Gobo meditated all time in a cave searching for illumination .

title: Goburu Ichi
description: Goburu Ichi Goburu Ichi was a shukenja kuei in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ichi was a shukenja of the Sun Temple who one day decided to go to Ito - jo to cleanse it of evil .

title: God ' s Grove
description: God ' s Grove The God ' s Grove was a shrine to Silvanus in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description . The God ' s Grove was a stand of duskwood trees that lay just north of the Way of the Manticore , and marked the eastern edge of Wheloon .

title: God Catcher
description: God Catcher The God Catcher was a tenement building in Waterdeep located near the market . The building was originally one of the colossal guardian statues but in 1385 DR the Spellplague animated all the guardians of the city and they walked around Waterdeep wreaking havoc . The Blackstaff turned the ground to mud underneath the statue and it sank partway into the ground .

title: God of the warren
description: God of the warren The god of the warren was a title given to a deity associated with rabbit s and hares . This god was followed by hare hengeyokai . One was the hero Xax Chung of Koryo , who wore around his neck a brass chain bearing the symbol of the god of the warren , but its meaning was unknown or obscure to those who saw it .

title: Gods of Fury
description: Gods of Fury Gods of Fury was a collective term for a group of evil and destructive deities led by Talos , the Destroyer . The Gods of Fury were Talos , plus Auril , the Frostmaiden , Malar , the Beastlord , and Umberlee , the Bitch Queen .

title: Gods of the Pantheon
description: Gods of the Pantheon The Gods of the Pantheon , sometimes just called Pantheon for short , were a group of five deities who were worshiped within the Zakhara n Cities of the Pantheon to the exclusion of all other faiths . The deities were Hajama , Jauhar , Kor , Najm , and Selan , and they were considered the only enlightened and Great Gods ( including Jauhar , who was considered a local deity by the rest of Zakhara ) . In addition to the tenets of these gods , unity — especially internal unity against outsiders — was the main ideal of this combined faith .

title: Godsbane
description: Godsbane Godsbane was the sword form acquired by Mask during the Time of Troubles . He would eventually come to be wielded by the then - mortal Cyric . Cyric acquired the sword by murdering a halfling named Atherton Cooper , also called Sneakabout , who in turn killed the former wielder of the sword .

title: Gogal
description: Gogal Imam Gogal was the High Priest of the Mosque of Kor the Old in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Gogal was a bit forgetful at times because of his age , but his mind remained sharp for important issues .

title: Gogal Pass
description: Gogal Pass Gogal Pass offered a viable land route through Al - Yabki Mountains , connecting two of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara — Gana in the west and Jumlat in the east . Description . The pass cut through the southern third of the mountain range for 30 miles ( 48 km ) , opening in the west to a splendid view of Al - Sabiya River in the distance .

title: Gogal al - Misal
description: Gogal al - Misal Gogal al - Misal was a nefarious slave trader within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . In reality , he was actually a skilled flame mage of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description .

title: Gogrus River
description: Gogrus River The Gogrus River was located in northwestern Ra - Khati . Geography . Due to the steep mountainous terrain , the Gogrus River was the only known route that reached the interior of Ra - Khati .

title: Goisho
description: Goisho Goisho was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay at the edge of the foothills of the Vorkani Mountains , beside the Quang Muku Forest , on the Hoparatu River . For many years , the Hu ' i Wing , a massive magical brazier that revealed the future and was one of the most valued relics of Koryo , was the centerpiece of a shrine near Goisho .

title: Gok ' llak
description: Gok ' llak Gok ' llak was a male grimlock barbarian who served the mind flayer , Quthnorak , in Vournoth ' s Mire during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Considered a fine example of his kind , Gok ' llak was an enormously muscular grimlock .

title: Gokammu
description: Gokammu Gokammu was the retired emperor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Gokammu was emperor until 1352 DR when he retired in favor of his son , Gonijo .

title: Gol ' fanin
description: Gol ' fanin Gol ' fanin was a former wizard and warrior who later became one of Menzoberranzan ' s accomplished weaponsmiths . History . Gol ' fanin traveled with the Xorlarrin expedition to Gauntlgrym in the year 1463 DR , alongside Tiago Baenre .

title: Gold
description: Gold Gold is a precious metal that is used in Faerûn as the baseline of most currency . Worth . Most coins in Faerûn work off of the silver and gold standard , with copper pieces ( cp ) being worth 1 / 100th of a gold piece ( gp ) and silver pieces ( sp ) being worth 1 / 10 of a gp .

title: Gold dragon
description: Gold dragon Gold dragons are the most powerful of the metallic dragon s , and the most dedicated to defeating evil . They spend the bulk of their lives in human form , seeking out evil and punishing wrongdoers to the best of its considerable abilities . Its typical mode of operation runs roughly along the lines of a sting operation : the dragon will listen for stories of dangerous or evil creatures or people , then reveals its true form and metes out punishment .

title: Gold dwarf
description: Gold dwarf Gold dwarves , also known as hill dwarves , are the aloof , confident and sometimes proud subrace of dwarves that predominantly come from the Great Rift . They are known to be particularly stalwart warriors and shrewd traders . Gold dwarves are often trained specifically to battle the horrendous aberration s that are known to come from the Underdark .

title: Gold sheen
description: Gold sheen Gold sheen was a rare variety of obsidian that was considered a semi - precious stone . Description . This stone had tiny golden speckles in a glassy black substrate , giving it a unique appearance .

title: Goldbug
description: Goldbug Goldbugs were parasitic beetles found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The body of a goldbug was circular and flat .

title: Golden
description: Golden Golden was a village in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . History . Long before the 14th century DR , the village of Golden was once besieged by bandits and the villagers were forced to defend themselves .

title: Golden Axe of the Great Rift
description: Golden Axe of the Great Rift A Golden Axe of the Great Rift was a " magic aberration bane battleaxe " that was created by the gold dwarves of the Great Rift . Physical description . The axe s were decorated with dwarven rune s on both sides of the blade , and were popular in areas that had corridors to the Underdark .

title: Golden Blade
description: Golden Blade The Golden Blades were sword s crafted during the Shou Dynasty of Might . History . The first emperor of the Li Dynasty ordered nine magical swords crafted for each of his generals and ordered them to conquer the world .

title: Golden Creek
description: Golden Creek The Golden Creek was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Description . The waters in this stream were good for fishing .

title: Golden Crown
description: Golden Crown The Golden Crown was a galleon from Calimshan used to transport treasure . In the early 1330s DR , the " Golden Crown " was carrying a cargo of gold and silver ingots , electrum bars , and a valuable quantity of gem s from the Calishite mining colony of Berranzo on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . Also on board was the wizard Hoch Miraz of Calimshan .

title: Golden Flow
description: Golden Flow The Golden Flow , ( sometimes spelled Goldenflow , ) or the Tail of Semphar , was a river located in southern Semphar . Geography . The Golden Flow originated high in the Raurin Alta and flowed down into Semphar and Gbor Nor , serving as a green belt marking the border between Semphar and the Raurin desert .

title: Golden Grove
description: Golden Grove The Golden Grove was an unlikely druid grove dedicated to Silvanus within the city of Memnon . The grove was located in the southeastern sabban of the city . Unlike the rest of Calimshan , the tiny grove had oak trees and shadowtop trees and a tree with golden - colored leaves .

title: Golden Gulf
description: Golden Gulf The Golden Gulf was a large body of water in southern central Zakhara between the High Desert and the Cities of the Pearl in the west and the League of the Pantheon in the east . To the north it contracted to form Suq Bay , to the south it first narrowed to then open into the Crowded Sea . Huzuz , the City of Delights , was also called the jewel of Suq Bay and the Golden Gulf , sitting at the conjuction of the two .

title: Golden Hills
description: Golden Hills Golden Hills was a celestial plane in the World Tree cosmology model , and home to most of the gnome pantheon . During the Spellplague , it was set adrift in the Astral Sea and eventually merged with Arvandor . Before becoming its own plane , Golden Hills was a region in the Dothion half of Twin Paradises / Bytopia , according to the Great Wheel cosmology model .

title: Golden Legion
description: Golden Legion The Golden Legion was formed by Cordell as a consolidation of his previous adventuring companies , slowly training these remnants into a single military unit . History . After defeating Akbet - Khrul in a great battle in Amn , Cordell ' s legion won the gratitude of the Council of Six and sponsorship for their legendary expedition to Maztica .

title: Golden Marches
description: Golden Marches The Golden Marches was a border in the northeastern highlands of Tethyr . The region was also known as the Upper Highlands . Geography .

title: Golden Mosque
description: Golden Mosque The Golden Mosque was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . This temple was the most spectacular house of worship on the entire continent of Zakhara . Location .

title: Golden Plains
description: Golden Plains The Golden Plains was the name for the area of land between the Nagaflow and Arran rivers . The land was named for its tall , golden grasses . After the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , the Golden Plains became an area of magical chaos known as the Plaguewrought Land .

title: Golden Road
description: Golden Road The Golden Road was a trade road running from Sespech in the Vilhon Reach to Innarlith on the Lake of Steam and beyond . In 1385 DR the spellplague created an area of extreme magical chaos known as the Plaguewrought Land over the area formerly occupied by the road .

title: Golden Ruins
description: Golden Ruins The Golden Ruins were a series of ruins in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . They lay hidden in a valley situated some 10 miles ( 16 km ) off the Hullack Trail , and 10 miles ( 16 km ) from the village of Ghars . They were named for the yellow stone they were built from , much to the disappointment of would - be treasure hunters who sometimes visited here .

title: Golden Sands Brews
description: Golden Sands Brews Golden Sands Brews encompassed several different lagers from Calimshan . They were only available from vendors in Waterdeep and Baldur ' s Gate and were also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Golden Sword of Ammatok
description: Golden Sword of Ammatok The Golden Sword of Ammatok was an important sword in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Each year after he took the throne in the 1350s DR , a ceremony held on Wei Do Peak to honor King Wanang Sun culminated with the king himself ritually beheading the most infamous criminal in the kingdom ' s prisons . This act symbolized his power to defeat evil in the kingdom .

title: Golden Voyages
description: Golden Voyages Contents . Home Port : Wherein the Tale Begins . A 32 - page book .

title: Golden Water
description: Golden Water The Golden Water was a bay located in the center of the Shining Lands . Geography . The Golden Water was connected to the Great Sea through a narrow channel on its southern side .

title: Golden Way
description: Golden Way The Golden Way was a road starting in Telflamm , a city in the nation of Thesk along the coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It extended eastward , through Phsant , Tammar , and other cities until it reached the shore between Lake Ashane and Lake Mulsantir . Travelers crossed via ferries to Mulsantir in Rashemen .

title: Golden lion ( coin )
description: Golden lion ( coin ) The golden lion was a gold coin that served as the standard currency of Cormyr and was equivalent in value to a gold piece . History . Prior to 1357 DR , the " lion " was divided into 20 silver falcon s .

title: Golden mirror
description: Golden mirror Golden mirrors were magic items that adorned each major stronghold of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . These mirrors were the same size as a large circular shield .

title: Golden wand
description: Golden wand The golden wand was a wondrous plant found only in the remote World Pillar Mountains within the Land of the Yak - Men . Description . The reeds of this strange plant were made of solid gold .

title: Golden water
description: Golden water Golden water was a special liquid that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Golden water was only found in springs that were connected to the Elemental Plane of Water and was often guarded by marid s .

title: Goldenfields
description: Goldenfields Goldenfields was a walled abbey to Chauntea of spectacular size covering over 20 square miles and housing over 5 , 000 people . The settlement was founded as an abbey around 1359 DR by Tolgar Anuvien , but in a few years Goldenfields grew into a fortified farmland .

title: Goldeye
description: Goldeye A goldeye is a special prestige class for worshipers of Waukeen . Goldeyes are interested in increasing the wealth of their countries and church , either through trade or adventuring into ancient dungeons or ruins . Some goldeyes focus on keeping the treasures of church and country away from the hands of thieves and other goldeyes .

title: Goldfeather
description: Goldfeather House Goldfeather was a Cormyr ian noble house whose last living noble was executed for treason by King Dhalmass in 1191 DR . All of their property , including the hunting lodge called Stag Steads was forfeited to the crown . In 1442 DR , the house was ennobled again by King Azoun V .

title: Goldline
description: Goldline Goldline , also called , was the name given to varieties of with lines of gold - colored ( an impurity similar to iron oxide ) embedded in the matrix . Description . These quartz ornamental stones could be amethyst , citrine , or smoky quartz with bright yellow strands or tufts of goethite running through it in parallel lines .

title: Golem
description: Golem Golems are an amalgam of several types of magically created construct s . They are tough , fearsome combatants with incredible defenses . Although they move like living creatures , they are merely animated objects , giving them several advantages and disadvantages in battle .

title: Goliad
description: Goliad Goliad was a small high - walled city and the seat of power for the Duchy of Brandiar . Geography . The city was located north of Morovar and south of Ironspur along the Goliad River near the Ford of Goliad .

title: Goliath
description: Goliath Goliaths were a nomadic race of humanoid s native to the mountainous regions of Toril . Description . Goliaths were massive .

title: Golothaer
description: Golothaer Golothaer was a city of the drow in the Great Bhaerynden more than 5000 years ago . History . The city was part of the first drow realm in the Underdark but like most of them had two main fractions .

title: Golotl
description: Golotl Golotl the Merchant was a merchant and thief in Nexal . History . Golotl was one of the renegades living in the human quarter of Nexal in 1362 DR .

title: Gombdalla
description: Gombdalla Gombdalla was a powerful Red Wizards of Thay researcher in 1357 DR . Personality . Gombdalla had a fascination for wild exotic semi - humans as centaur s , troll s and satyr s .

title: Gomir al - Kasir
description: Gomir al - Kasir Gomir al - Kasir ran a barber shop from the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Gomir was popular barber among the tourists visiting Huzuz .

title: Gommoth
description: Gommoth Gommoth the Twisted was the leader of a cult of fire - worshiping creatures on Mount Hotenow in 1484 DR . History . Gommoth was exiled by his people for his size , which made him look more like a dwarf than a fire giant .

title: Gond
description: Gond Gond ( pronounced " GAHND " ) , the Lord of All Smiths , was the intermediate deity of craft and smithwork , whose faith was the state religion of Lantan . The church of Gond was tolerated across Faerûn and members were found in both good and evil aligned human populations . He had an increasing following in rock gnome communities .

title: Gondegal
description: Gondegal Gondegal ( also known as the Usurper King and the Lost King ) was a king who , in 1352 DR ( the Year of the Dragon ) , attempted to establish a kingdom centered in the city of Arabel in northern Cormyr . He was overthrown after only eight days in power by the standing army of Cormyr , the Purple Dragons , led by king Azoun IV . Appearance .

title: Gondyl Ilitheeum
description: Gondyl Ilitheeum Gondyl Illitheeum was a doppelganger in Triboar in 1370 DR . Activities . Gondyl appeared to be a snobbish , urbane , and slim human male proprietor of Everwyvern House .

title: Gonehl
description: Gonehl Gonehl was a senior member of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Gonehl , under his alias as " Aquila Gerallin " , led the Masquerade , a mercenary information network based outside of Waterdeep . The Masquerade , to all outside Gonehl and Hlaavin , looked like a honourable group without a hidden agenda , but in truth they had infiltrated the governments of Amn , Sembia , and Westgate , plus several mercenaries companies .

title: Gonijo
description: Gonijo Gonijo was the emperor of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Gonijo became emperor in 1352 DR when his father Gokammu retired .

title: Gontal
description: Gontal Gontal was an isolated kingdom in southwestern Returned Abeir that had only been settled for less than one hundred years by 1479 DR . It was separated from the rest of the continent by the Elkannath Mountains and the inhabitants of other lands of Returned Abeir were largely uninformed about the region . Government .

title: Gontal City
description: Gontal City Gontal City was a port city and the capital of the kingdom of Gontal , Returned Abeir . Government . As of 1479 DR , Gontal City was ruled by Queen Imreera Hethkantan , who was a hands - off ruler who appeared to be more interested in sending expeditions to the Glaur Barrens than in actively ruling the land .

title: Gontal Pass
description: Gontal Pass Gontal Pass was the name of a narrow chasm in the Elkannath Mountains . It was the only land route that connected the kingdom of Gontal with the Dusk Ports and the rest of Laerakond . Background .

title: Gontonia
description: Gontonia Gontonia of Helm was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Gontonia was one of the Godseyes , or Watchers of Helm , and went to Maztica in order to research the ways of this new world and convert the natives .

title: Good
description: Good In 4th edition , good characters are those who believe that protecting and helping those in need , or those who are too weak to act for themselves , is the right thing to do , without special regard for the law or authority . The good alignment includes tenets from the neutral good and chaotic good alignment s from previous editions . The good alignment is distinct from the lawful good alignment in that good characters are not bound to sacrifice themselves or ignore completely their own needs for the sake of some ethos or code of conduct , although they probably have a strong inclination to do so .

title: Good Mead
description: Good Mead Good Mead was a small town in Icewind Dale . Good Mead receives little fishing profit , so they turned to exporting their iconic brew . Geography .

title: Goodberry
description: Goodberry Goodberry was a transmutation or alteration / evocation spell that turned a few berries into a magical food that could " cure minor wounds " and / or provide a healthy creature with the equivalent of a full meal . The reverse of this spell , badberry , created a poisonous food that had the same effect as " inflict minor wounds " . Effects .

title: Goodmorning Starshine
description: Goodmorning Starshine Goodmorning Starshine was a businesswoman in Skullport . History . Goodmorning was a festhall entertainer who managed to make enough money to open her own festhall .

title: Goolgog Elvenbane
description: Goolgog Elvenbane Goolgog Elvenbane was a male orc of the Vast . Goolgog was a great leader of orcs who commanded armies . Once , in ancient times , he won a great victory against elves and human s , and to celebrate he ordered the construction of the Arch of Goolgog , a triumphal monument .

title: Goran
description: Goran Goran of Tethyr was a mercenary recruiter in Tethyr . Activities . Goran was the best - known recruiter of Tethyr with a staff of six fighters and thieves to help him .

title: Gorar al - Aksar
description: Gorar al - Aksar Gorar al - Aksar was a famous barber and owner of the Barber Shop of Gorar al - Aksar in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . Personality . To say Gorar was popular was an understatement .

title: Gorath
description: Gorath The Gorath was the hidden leader of the Royal Vagabonds of Shou Lung around 1357 DR . Activities . The Gorath secretly assisted the Old Man in managing the activities of the Royal Vagabonds against enemies of Shou Lung .

title: Gord Roundshield
description: Gord Roundshield Gord Roundshield was a dwarf living in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . History . Gord hailed from Citadel Felbarr but at some point he decided to travel to Neverwinter .

title: Gordon Stakaria
description: Gordon Stakaria Battle - Chaplain Gordon Stakaria was the jaded veteran warrior - priest of the temple fortress of Swordpoint in the city of Archenbridge . He was the Swordmaster of the Shrine of Swords . Personality .

title: Gordroun Obarskyr
description: Gordroun Obarskyr Gordroun Obarskyr was listed among the kings of Cormyr although he never actually reigned . He was crowned posthumously by his younger brother King Keldroun Obarskyr . Gordroun was known for killing his traitorous stepbrother and stepfather , who had murdered his older brother and then king Torst .

title: Gorge of the Silver Wyrm
description: Gorge of the Silver Wyrm The Gorge of the Silver Wyrm was a canyon in Hartsvale through which the Wyrm River flowed . Description . The gorge was deep and dark .

title: Gorglak
description: Gorglak Gorglak was a duergar guard in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Gorglak was well - known as one of the most corrupt members of the Stone Guard s .

title: Gorgon
description: Gorgon A gorgon is a large magical beast that resembles a bull , covered in dusky metallic scales . Ecology . Behavior .

title: Gorion
description: Gorion Gorion was a monk , a skilled spellcaster , a learned sage and a respected Harper . He lived in the library - fortress of Candlekeep during the times when he wasn ' t adventuring . His perhaps most notable impact on history was his raising two Bhaalspawn children , one of whom especially played a crucial part in the fulfilling of Alaundo ' s prophecy of the Bhaalspawn ( detailed in the Baldur ' s Gate series ) as an adult , being the main protagonist of the stories .

title: Gorion ' s Ward
description: Gorion ' s Ward Gorion ' s Ward was the last Bhaalspawn left alive at the end of the Throne of Bhaal conflict . While his or her true name is disputed , it is known that they were raised as the foster child of the sage Gorion and thusly received this nickname . Early History .

title: Goristro
description: Goristro Goristros were a powerful type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . Goristros resembled huge fiendish minotaurs and had horns like a bull .

title: Gorlist
description: Gorlist Gorlist was the son of Nisstyre and leader of a drow band pursuing Liriel Baenre . Description . Gorlist had short white hair and a dragon tattoo on his left cheek that glowed if a dragon was in the vicinity .

title: Gorloun
description: Gorloun Gorloun was a dragon of immense size , might , and age , who founded the first draconic empire of Abeir . History . Gorloun founded its nation some time after the War of Fang and Talon , in the continent of Laerakond .

title: Gorloun Hethel
description: Gorloun Hethel Gorloun Hethel was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Hethel and other five Dragons acted as escorts for the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .

title: Gorm Gulthyn
description: Gorm Gulthyn Gorm Gulthyn ( " gorm " " gull " - thin ) , also known as Fire Eyes , Lord of the Bronze Mask and the Eternally Vigilant , was a dwarven lesser deity who held the portfolios of defense and watchfulness and was the guardian of all dwarves . Overview . Most dwarven enclaves stand in the path of aggressive Underdark enemies as they are built below the surface .

title: Gormauthator
description: Gormauthator Gormauthator was a skeleton red dragon in 1375 DR . History . Gormauthator was one of the dragon s that assaulted Shadowdale in 1375 DR during a flight of dragons ; Syluné Silverhand fought the three more powerful dragons , among those Gormauthator , at the Tower of Ashaba and destroyed the dragons at the price of her own life .

title: Gormstadd
description: Gormstadd Gormstadd the Rerisen was the head of a temple in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Gorrunk
description: Gorrunk Gorrunk was a bugbear raider during the Tyranny of Dragons . Possessions . Dressed in hide armor , Gorrunk fought with a morning star and shield in battle .

title: Gorstag
description: Gorstag Gorstag was the innkeeper of the Rising Moon inn in Deepingdale and the foster father of Shandril Shessair . History . Gorstag was a battle - axe wielding warrior and one of the best friends of Garthond , a wizard who had often fought the Cult of the Dragon , and Dammasae , an adventurer whom Garthond had rescued from the Cult .

title: Gorstag Helder
description: Gorstag Helder Gorstag Helder was one of Brimstone ' s agents during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Under orders from his draconic master , Gorstag joined a Cult of the Dragon cell in Lyrabar in 1373 DR .

title: Gort
description: Gort Gort was a thief of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . Activities . He was a professional thief , and known to operate as a " retriever of lost items " for a hefty fee .

title: Gorvan Ironheart
description: Gorvan Ironheart Gorvan Ironheart was a dwarven priest of Grumbar in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Gorvan was interested only in money .

title: Gorx
description: Gorx Gorx was a xorn at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , while in his home plane , Gorx saw a gate to Toril .

title: Gorym Harndrekker
description: Gorym Harndrekker Gorym Harndrekker was a battle priest of Tempus and the acting Priest - General of the Abbey of the Sword as of 1372 DR . Formerly a skilled fighter , his advancing age and an encounter with wraith s greatly diminished his physical prowess . He was best known as a master military strategist .

title: Goryu
description: Goryu Goryu was a shukenja priest in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Goryu was head priest at the Kanchai Temple of Miyama .

title: Goshukara Akinari
description: Goshukara Akinari Goshukara Akinari was the head of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Akinari was plotting to somehow removed Funada Mitsuhide from power and replaced him with a Goshukara .

title: Goshukara Sadamoto
description: Goshukara Sadamoto Goshukara Sadamoto was a member of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sadamoto supported his brother Goshukara Akinari in his plots , acting as wild card .

title: Goshukara clan
description: Goshukara clan The Goshukara clan , mostly known as Northern Goshukara , were one of the most powerful families in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Goshukara was a very ancient family , able to trace their ancestry directly to the emperor . Their members had ceremonial offices in the Emperor ' s court .

title: Gotha
description: Gotha Gotha was a dracolich who was formerly an ancient red dragon and was transformed by Talos . History . Talos , the god of destruction , had approached Gotha to make a proposal .

title: Gothal
description: Gothal Mother Gothal owned a festhall in Amphail . History . Once Gothal was a famed dancer in Baldur ' s Gate until she retired in Waterdeep .

title: Gothwan Cooper
description: Gothwan Cooper Gothwan Cooper was a male thief member of the Nasher in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , taking advantage of the chaos resulting from the undead assault on Neverwinter , led by Valindra Shadowmantle , Gothwan and his friend Honor Reigh , under orders from the Nasher leader Karzov , sneaked inside the Hall of Justice and stole the Crown of Neverwinter .

title: Gothyl
description: Gothyl Gothyl was an ancient wizard who resurfaced in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Gothyl lived in Daggerdale in Spiderhaunt Wood long ago with a court of apprentices .

title: Gotokok
description: Gotokok Gotokok was an Iulutiun village known for its annual weapons trade fair . Geography . Gotokok was in Alpuk , alongside the stream linking the Lugalpgotak Sea to Risuak Lake .

title: Govinda
description: Govinda Govinda lived in the fortress of Luntse Dzong in Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Govinda commanded the forces of Luntse Dzong within Ahs Trango Shan .

title: Gower
description: Gower Gower was a male dwarf scout living in Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was an acquaintance of Durnan and Khelben and guided them , plus Elminster Aumar and the mortal Kelemvor , to a passage to the Fugue Plane located in Undermountain .

title: Goyat Nagumo
description: Goyat Nagumo Goyat Nagumo was a general in Shou Lung . History . Goyat Nagumo was a young promising general , always promoted by the Minister of War Kwan Chan Sen .

title: Grabber Forth
description: Grabber Forth Grabber Forth was a deep gnome archmage in service to the yugoloth Maram il Vass in the Deep Wastes during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Grabber worked for Maram il Vass .

title: Grabert
description: Grabert Grabert was a soldier in the Golden Legion around 1361 DR . History . Grabert was a veteran swordsman of the Legion .

title: Grace of the Masked Lord
description: Grace of the Masked Lord Grace of the Masked Lord was an ability , a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun used " grace of the Masked Lord " when they needed to deal with traps .

title: Gracklstugh
description: Gracklstugh Gracklstugh , the " City of Blades " , was a duergar city on the shores of the Darklake in the Northdark . Geography . The city was located five miles beneath the Evermoors , as well as beneath the Dessarin River valley and the Uthgardt ancestor mound Flintrock .

title: Grady Moll
description: Grady Moll Grady Moll was a officer of the Soldiery of Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Grady was investigating the lumber merchant Fatell , suspected to be part of the Cult of the Eternal Flame when a fire destroyed Fatell ' s shop .

title: Graevelwood
description: Graevelwood Graevelwood was an isolated gnomish clanhold located underneath a rocky crag in the eastern reaches of the Arn Forest in the Silver Marches . Government . Clanlord Mavheran Haerlskeel believed a war with orc s was not something she wanted to get her clan involved with so she kept her community ' s location a secret .

title: Grand Army of the Tuigan
description: Grand Army of the Tuigan The Grand Army of the Tuigan , also simply called the Horde , was a formidable fighting force that was assembled by Yamun Khahan and rose to prominence in the Hordelands during the 14th century DR . Organization . Formed mostly of horsemen , Yamun Khahan ' s army was fast , efficient , and lethal .

title: Grand Bazaar
description: Grand Bazaar The Grand Bazaar was a market in the city of Huzuz . Easily the largest open - air market in Zakhara , the Grand Bazaar even surpassed the great markets of Calimport and the Durpar ian markets at Heldapan . Constant change to the layout of the Grand Bazaar made it a confusing place to shop for those unaccustomed to its methods .

title: Grand Bazaar Boulevard
description: Grand Bazaar Boulevard The Grand Bazaar Boulevard was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This road ran from the heart of Huzuz near the mosques in the Pilgrims ' District northwest to the Grand Bazaar in the Merchants ' District .

title: Grand Boulevard
description: Grand Boulevard The Grand Boulevard was a large street in Maerimydra . Geography . Situated in the center of Maerimydra , the Grand Boulevard neatly bisected the city into its northern and southern sections .

title: Grand Caliph
description: Grand Caliph Grand Caliph was the Midani title for the ruler of all of enlightened Zakhara . The Grand Caliph led the Land of Fate in matters of state as well as faith from his seat , the grand palace in the capital city of Huzuz . The extent of his influence on the more distant parts of his realm , however , often remained in doubt .

title: Grand Gate of Delights
description: Grand Gate of Delights The Grand Gate of Delights was the main entrance for the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This gate complex consisted of two gates and a pair of towers that stood 90 ft .

title: Grand Grelpin
description: Grand Grelpin Grand Grelpin was a kobold wyrmpriest in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR he was leading his tribe in search of a rumored dragon into Undermountain when the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr appeared and killed their chieftain .

title: Grand Hoist
description: Grand Hoist The Grand Hoist was an unfinished lift designed to ferry goods back and forth between Waterdeep and Skullport . The hoist was designed to bypass the dangers of Undermountain and the Lapel Sea . History .

title: Grand University of Huzuz
description: Grand University of Huzuz The Grand University of Huzuz was a school located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Grand University could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Grandfather Tree
description: Grandfather Tree The Grandfather Tree was an arakhor , an elder form of treant , which appeared as a monstrously large , gnarled oak tree located deep in the heart of the High Forest . Four smaller oak trees marked the corners of the tree ' s roots , along with a few rotted tree stumps , elven works , and totems of the Blue Bear tribe . This arakhor was summoned in −12 , 500 DR by the Elves of Aryvandaar to guard the site , after they discovered the Hall of Mists , which now lay under its roots .

title: Grandfather of Assassins
description: Grandfather of Assassins Grandfather of Assassins is the title of the ruling leader of the Citadel of Assassins , based in the Galena Mountains in Damara . History . The Grandfather always conceals his face with a mask and is said to be immortal .

title: Grankhul
description: Grankhul Grankhul is the bugbear deity of hunting , senses , stealth , and surprise . His symbol is ever - open eyes in darkness . Description .

title: Grappling hook
description: Grappling hook A grappling hook was a three pronged hook that was attachable to a rope . Uses . Its intended use was to make climbing easier and safer but thieves took advantage of the tool and it has since become a crucial tool for a thief .

title: Grash Crackbacker
description: Grash Crackbacker Grash Crackbacker was a slow - witted priest of Bhaal . Description . A pale - skinned half - orc , Grash dressed in an intricate red - and - black robe .

title: Grask
description: Grask Grask was the dusk beast companion of Sithierel on the " Necreme " in 1374 DR . History . Around 1374 DR , Grask loyally served Sithirel , during the Despayr ' s plot , guarding the boat , Necreme .

title: Grasping shadows
description: Grasping shadows Grasping shadows is an illusion spell learned by newly trained wizard , particularly those that hope to specialize as illusionists . With " grasping shadows " a wizard is able to summon forth magical darkness that reaches out ensnares nearby foes . These shadows effect an area of roughly five feet in diameter , within fifty feet of the wizard .

title: Grasping vine
description: Grasping vine Grasping vine was a conjuration spell that summoned a vine capable of pulling creatures toward it . Effects . The spell caused a vine to sprout from the ground that could pull another creature directly towards it .

title: Grass
description: Grass Grass is plentiful in many varieties in the " Forgotten Realms " . Varieties . Bluegrass .

title: Grassland circle
description: Grassland circle The grassland circle was a druid circle associated with the wide open plains and prairies . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Gratus
description: Gratus Gratus was a male human living in Scardale before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Gratus was originally the Minister of Propaganda in the regime of Lord Lashan Aumersair .

title: Graul
description: Graul Graul was an orc leader in Dead Orc Pass in the Silver Marches . Description . Graul was a large orc .

title: Graven Larvoldson
description: Graven Larvoldson Graven Larvoldson was a dwarf blacksmith in Undermountain in 1479 DR . Activities . Graven had a workshop in Waterdeep .

title: Gravenhollow
description: Gravenhollow Gravenhollow was a mystic library in the Underdark . Description . The library was a peculiar building for many reasons : it was outside the normal time of Toril , everybody inside it understood all languages , it was bigger on the inside , it prevented works of magic except divination , and nobody could find it without its keeper ' s will .

title: Graveyard ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Graveyard ( Mere of Dead Men ) This unnamed graveyard was a graveyard in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . This graveyard was located near Fort Locke .

title: Graxxygak
description: Graxxygak Graxxygak was a half - dragon troll berserker in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Graxxygak was the half - dragon son of Throstulgrael in the Twilight Marsh .

title: Gray Doom
description: Gray Doom The Gray Doom were a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Gray Doom earned a reputation in the Sword Coast for their skill and swiftness in skirmishes .

title: Gray Forest
