description: Gray Forest The Grey Forest , also spelled the Gray Forest and also called the Tsurlar Forest , was a forest located between the Vast and the nation of Impiltur , lying south of the Earthfast Mountains . History . Moon elves once lived in the Gray Forest several centuries before the 14th century DR .

title: Gray Ghosts
description: Gray Ghosts The Gray Ghosts were the only true thieves ' guild of Gracklstugh . They were filled with derro and duergar outcasts and a few escaped slaves . The Gray Ghosts had a special interest in a ruined obelisk they had found that they believed contained " unimaginable power " , so they tried to recollect all the fragments of the obelisk and rebuild it .

title: Gray Goose Provisioners
description: Gray Goose Provisioners Gray Goose Provisioners was a store in Eshpurta run by Carn Wittsome and his mistress , Nethris Perndle . The Gray Goose carried good trail rations and other small supplies for those that needed or wanted to travel . Prices were very reasonable but sometimes it was awkward interrupting an argument between the two proprietors to make a purchase — the elderly couple bickered constantly on just about every topic .

title: Gray Hand enforcer
description: Gray Hand enforcer Gray Hand Enforcers were highly trained elite members of the Gray Hands , the elite fighting force of Waterdeep , serving directly under the employ of the city ' s Lords . Enforcers were known for their loyalty to Waterdeep , their disregard for any formalities and most of all for not fearing death .

title: Gray Hands
description: Gray Hands The Gray Hands were a group of adventurers whose duty it was to defend the city of Waterdeep from immense dangers . Organization . The elite band was small in number but were still quite capable of felling the most dangerous of foes .

title: Gray Hunt
description: Gray Hunt The party must violate a treaty between Loudwater and the Zhentarim in order to prevent the possibility of a greater conflict . Orc migrants from the Loudwater side of the territorial border are raiding Zhent land and Loudwater needs to stop them . .

title: Gray Vale
description: Gray Vale Gray Vale , also seen as Grayvale , was the area centered around Loudwater in 1479 DR . During the 14th century DR the Grayvale was merely a part of the region known locally as the Delimbiyr Crescent but after the Spellplague and the reduction in the region ' s population , the nomenclature appears to have been simplified and the entire valley south of the High Forest as well as the surrounding lands became known as the Grey Vale . It was presumably named after the Graypeak Mountains , which sheltered the area in the east ; the Grey Highlands and the Greyflow river , which joins the Delimbiyr as a major tributary - all of which were local geographical features .

title: Gray Wolf Tribe
description: Gray Wolf Tribe The Gray Wolf Tribe were Uthgardt barbarian s who had a characteristic every single member shared : under the light of the full moon , they all turned into savage werewolves . History . The legacy of the Gray Wolf Tribe was thought to have begun when they accepted refugees from fallen Gauntlgrym into their fold .

title: Gray guard
description: Gray guard Among the ranks of paladin s there are some who have seen too much . The archetype of the noble - spirited paladin , resplendent in blessed armor and wielding a holy blade to smite the enemies of goodness , has gotten countless good men and women killed by their enemies ' underhanded tactics . Taking a cue from their foes , certain churches have formed semi - secret groups from their most experienced and hard - hearted paladins and cleric s , and trained them in the shadowy tactics favored by such worthies as the Church of Shar .

title: Gray ooze
description: Gray ooze A gray ooze resembles a thick puddle of gray sludge , roughly 8 " ( 20 cm ) and up to 14 ' ( 4 . 27 m ) across , that closely resembles wet stone or an amorphous rock formation . They consume any organic matter they encounter .

title: Gray portrait
description: Gray portrait The gray portrait is an artifact that halts the natural ageing process . History . The most common myth regarding this artifact tells of Belarian the Beautiful , a follower of Sune who supposedly lived in the seventh century before Dalereckoning .

title: Gray render
description: Gray render A gray render is a magical beast born from various terrain substances present in swamps and marshes . History . Although many scholars have come to believe that roots of gray renders can be traced back to the Elemental Chaos , the truth of the matter is that gray renders were created thousands of years ago by a small conclave of silver dragon wizards who spent most of their time in elven form and developed gray renders primarily as bodyguards for their loyal minions .

title: Gray slaad
description: Gray slaad Gray slaadi were powerful slaad shapechangers and spellcasters . Description . Gray slaadi were the result of a green slaad having learned a magical procedure to transform permanently into a stronger form , while retaining all their memories from their previous forms .

title: Gray wolf
description: Gray wolf The gray wolf was the most common variety of wolf to be found . Combat . While wolves were often blamed for attacks on stray wanderers and children , they were actually quite afraid of humans .

title: Grayclaws
description: Grayclaws The Grayclaws were a thieves ' guild located in the city of Tantras in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Organization . The Grayclaws were composed of thieves and smugglers .

title: Grayclaws ( weapon )
description: Grayclaws ( weapon ) Grayclaws were a set of claw - like weapons favored by the Grayclaws thieves ' guild of Tantras , who took their name from these blades . Description . Grayclaws consisted of a set of leather gauntlets that strapped to the hand fitted with brass knuckles , from which projected razor - sharp blades .

title: Graycloak ' s Wolves
description: Graycloak ' s Wolves Graycloak ' s Wolves was an adventuring company active in 1343 DR , and led by Irmar Graycloak . Activities . Graycloak ' s Wolves were active in the city of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach in the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , when they were requested to deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the most holy book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent .

title: Grayling
description: Grayling The Grayling was a ship that sailed its last voyage in 1399 DR . The Grand Council of Impiltur chartered the ship to carry Bayel Droust on a mission to map the post - spellplague shoreline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Droust carried two rare books that the eladrin Caelynna wanted and she sunk the ship in order to get the books and to capture Droust .

title: Graystaff
description: Graystaff A graystaff , or a staff of frost , was a mundane staff used by bheur s as a magical focus for powerful spells . Description . A graystaff was a gnarled wooden staff taller than a bheur .

title: Grayth Holmfast
description: Grayth Holmfast Grayth Holmfast was a human priest of Lathander and a member of the Company of the White Star . His squire was Brant Rethalshield . He lived in Waterdeep .

title: Graz ' zt
description: Graz ' zt Graz ' zt , called The Dark Prince , is a demon lord and one of the most powerful fiends in the Abyss . Description . Standing nine feet tall , Graz ' zt appears as a lithe , muscular humanoid .

title: Grazilaxx
description: Grazilaxx Grazilaxx was a mind flayer member of the Society of Brilliance during the Rage of Demons . History . Grazilaxx and all the other members of the society went on a pilgrimage to Gravenhollow some years before the Rage of Demons .

title: Grease
description: Grease Grease ( originally called Shan ' s tallow ) was a low - powered conjuration spell of the creation subschool used by arcane casters to cover a solid surface in an oily film . Some cleric s of Ghaunadaur , Ilsensine , Laogzed , and Moander were granted the power of " grease " by their deities , and ooze genasi could create a similar effect . Effects .

title: Great Bhaerynden
description: Great Bhaerynden Great Bhaerynden was a domain located in the south - central region of Faerûn beneath the vast plains of Shaar . History . This Underdark region was the first homeland of the dwarves , but was conquered by the drow when they first ventured in the Underdark in search of a realm of their own .

title: Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati
description: Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati The Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati was the only known crossing of the Jumpa River . Location . Located in Ra - Khati , the bridge crossed the Jumpa River and the Jumpa River Gorge into the city of Kushk .

title: Great Codex
description: Great Codex The Great Codex was a compendium of all the laws of the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was compiled in the 13th century DR , as a grand project to copy all of Procampur ' s existing laws into a single tome , which would be installed in a grand library . Scribes and legal scholars accompanied the city ' s ruling Thultyrl everywhere to continue the work .

title: Great Dale
description: Great Dale The Great Dale is governed by a druid ic hierarchy , under rule of Nentyarch . It is a human land , of 200 , 000 inhabitants . According to rumours , The Great Dale is the place from which Dalelanders come .

title: Great Dismal Delve
description: Great Dismal Delve The Great Dismal Delve was the home of all dao living on the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . The Great Dismal Delve was actually a massive labyrinth located deep underground .

title: Great Door
description: Great Door The Great Door was a massive door hidden on the outskirts of Waterdeep on the Sword Coast North . It served as a " gate " to the planes . Defenses .

title: Great Garden
description: Great Garden The Great Garden was a wonder found within the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in the Great Anvil of the Haunted Lands in 1367 DR . Descriptions . The garden was found deep underground beneath the fortress .

title: Great Glacier
description: Great Glacier The Great Glacier , also called Pelvuria was a large mass of frozen land in northeast Faerûn . History . It was created in - 2550 DR when the god Ulutiu laid himself to rest in his ice barge in the Cold Ocean , a favourite inland sea of his .

title: Great Library of Perpustakaan
description: Great Library of Perpustakaan The Great Library of Perpustakaan , or simply Perpustakaan , was a library in Perpustakaan in Kesasar Valley in Shou Lung . It was one of the most magnificent depositories of knowledge in all of Kara - Tur . Unfortunately , most of the people outside the Shao Mountains had forgotten the existence of Perpustakaan History .

title: Great Mother
description: Great Mother The Great Mother was the monstrous goddess of beholder s and a chaotic evil greater deity . Her symbol was an egg with an eye . Her areas of influence included magic , fertility , and tyranny .

title: Great Old One patron
description: Great Old One patron A Great Old One patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and a being from the Far Realm , an elder evil , or some other ancient and mysterious being , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots .

title: Great Padishate of the Marid
description: Great Padishate of the Marid The Great Padishate of the Marid , or the Marid Padishate , was the collective term referring to the ruling body of government of the marid s . Marids were less organized as an official government when compared to the djinn , but their greater power ensured that they held greater control over the Elemental Plane of Water than the djinn did on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization .

title: Great Raven Pueblo
description: Great Raven Pueblo Great Raven Pueblo was a settlement of 900 Azuposi nestled between the north bank of the Pasocada River above Raven Falls and Mesa Bovara . It marked the boundary between the Azuposi territory to the north and the Metahel territory to the south , and a large staircase carved from the rock descended from the settlement to the lands below . The Metahel settlement of Lomaraj was just a few miles down the river .

title: Great Reflecting Pool
description: Great Reflecting Pool The Great Reflecting Pool was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Rumors and Legends . Accessible only from the Public Gardens , the reflecting pool was believed to have mystical properties .

title: Great Rift
description: Great Rift The Great Rift is the traditional home of Faerûn ' s gold dwarves , though there is also a human city nearby , called Khôltar . The country of 1 , 300 , 000 dwarves , gnome s , halfling s and humans is ruled by a monarchy from the capital of Eartheart . Geography .

title: Great Spire of the Ice Sea
description: Great Spire of the Ice Sea The Great Spire of the Ice Sea was a giant structure found on an uncharted island located near the middle of Yal Tengri . Geography . This cold , desolate place was windy around the year .

title: Great Swamp of Rethild
description: Great Swamp of Rethild The Great Swamp of Rethild , also known simply as the Great Swamp or Rethild , was a swamp in Dambrath . Geography . The Great Swamp was located on the western border of Dambrath .

title: Great Vale
description: Great Vale The Great Vale , also known as Asanibis , was considered the breadbasket of Mulhorand , and included the lands that lie between the Dragonsword Mountains and the Alamber Sea . Geography . The area that made up the Great Vale accounted for the majority of Mulhorand ' s farmland .

title: Great Wheel cosmology
description: Great Wheel cosmology Great Wheel is the cosmology model in which the world of Toril was said to exist during the first and second editions of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " game , although the actual term " Great Wheel " didn ' t mean the cosmology as a whole until the 3rd edition of the " D & D " game and its " Manual of the Planes 3rd edition " . In second edition , " Great Wheel " or " Great Ring " meant the Outer planes only . The cosmology as a whole didn ' t require a name other than " the Planes " or " the Multiverse , " as there weren ' t any formally named alternatives in the " AD & D " game .

title: Great Worm Cavern
description: Great Worm Cavern Great Worm cavern , the traditional ancestor mound of the Great Worm tribe , was said to reside at the base of a mountain in the Spine of the World range , part of a vast underground complex . Given great reference by the tribes through the lineage of Uthgar ' s still living son , Elrem the Wise . Little is known of the inside of the caves but stories abound of a large altar depicting stylised represntations of a great spiralling winged snake .

title: Great galley
description: Great galley A great galley was a large ship used for both war and commerce on the Sea of Fallen Stars , primarily by the nations of Chessenta and Mulhorand . Description . The great galley was an improvement on the design of the dromond , having more sails and fewer oars and rowers .

title: Great ghul
description: Great ghul Great ghuls were undead cousins of genie s who occupied the lowest rung in the hierarchy of the jann . Description . Great ghuls had one interesting feature — their feet were always donkey hooves , although they often tried to hide this shortcoming by wearing long robes or boots .

title: Great revenance
description: Great revenance Great revenance was a spell researched by Irae T ' sarran that could raise an army of revenant s slaved to the caster ' s will . Effects . The magic of this spell could potentially animate thousands of creatures as revenant s under the command of the caster .

title: Great shout
description: Great shout Great shout was an arcane evocation spell that produced a tremendous sonic force similar to a " horn of blasting " from the mouth of the caster . Effects . There were at least two distinct versions of this spell .

title: Great shout ( evocation )
description: Great shout ( evocation ) Great shout was a barbarian evocation that briefly hindered the attacking ability of foes . Effects . Upon a successful hit , a barbarian could tap into the rage of his or her ancestors and give a furious battle cry .

title: Greataxe
description: Greataxe A greataxe is a double - bladed , two - handed melee weapon in the axe family . Description . The greataxe is a large , heavy battleaxe with a double - bladed head .

title: Greatclub
description: Greatclub The greatclub , a two - handed version of the club , is a martial melee weapon . Description . A greatclub is bigger and heavier than a regular club and usually augmented with spikes , nails and / or bands of iron .

title: Greater command
description: Greater command Greater command was an arcane evocation spell that compelled multiple subjects to follow a single order as long as they were given in a language they understood . Effect . This spell functioned in the same manner as " command " , except that more creatures could be affected and the effects lasted longer .

title: Greater dispelling
description: Greater dispelling Greater dispelling was an abjuration spell that dispelled magic . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " dispel magic " , except that the maximum bonus on the dispel check was + 20 instead of + 10 .

title: Greater fantastic machine
description: Greater fantastic machine Greater fantastic machine was an illusion spell exclusive to cleric s with the Craft domain . It called into being a large illusory mechanical contraption that was controlled by the caster to perform simple tasks . Effect .

title: Greater glyph of warding
description: Greater glyph of warding Greater glyph of warding is an abjuration spell that creates a glyph that causes damage when triggered . Effect . This spell functions in the same manner as " glyph of warding " , except that the blast deals up to 10d8 damage , and the " greater glyph " can store a harmful spell of up to 6th level .

title: Greater invisibility
description: Greater invisibility Greater invisibility or improved invisibility was an illusion spell that functioned exactly like " invisibility " except the recipient could attack and not break the spell . History . The spell was attributed to the Netherese arcanist Pockall in - 1478 DR and was known then as " Pockall ' s invisibility plus " .

title: Greater ironguard
description: Greater ironguard Greater ironguard was an arcane abjuration spell that temporarily granted one creature immunity from all non - magical metals and some enchanted metals . It was an improved version of " ironguard " . Effects .

title: Greater planar ally
description: Greater planar ally Greater planar ally was a conjuration spell that called up to three outsider s or elemental s from their home plane to aid the caster in exchange for payment . Effect . This spell functioned in the same manner as " lesser planar ally " , except that the caster could call three such creatures , or two somewhat larger creatures , or one very large creature .

title: Greater restoration
description: Greater restoration Greater restoration is a necromancy spell that completely heals the subject . Effect . This spell functions in the same manner as " lesser restoration " , except the spell dispels all negative levels afflicting the healed creature , restoring the creature to the highest level it had previously achieved .

title: Greater scrying
description: Greater scrying Greater scrying is a divination spell that spies on a subject from a distance . Effects . This spell functions in the same manner as " scrying " , except as noted above .

title: Greater spell immunity
description: Greater spell immunity Greater spell immunity , also known as Serten ' s spell immunity , was an abjuration spell that was identical to " spell immunity " except that it bestowed complete resistance against one or more particular spells , spell - like effects of magic items , or spell - like abilities of creatures of 8th level or below .

title: Greater touchsickle
description: Greater touchsickle Greater touchsickle was a divine magic spell available to druid s , cleric s , and crusader s of Eldath , the Mother Guardian of Groves . It was a more potent version of " touchsickle " . Effects .

title: Greatsword
description: Greatsword A greatsword is a two - handed , martial , melee weapon . Description . The greatsword is the largest member of the sword family requiring two hands to wield .

title: Greed domain
description: Greed domain The Greed domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters greed spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Greed Domain Powers .

title: Green Calishite cheese
description: Green Calishite cheese Green Calishite was a spicy cheese crafted in Calimshan . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Green Fields
description: Green Fields Green Fields was the celestial home of the halfling pantheon . It was also the home of the souls of deceased good halflings . Description .

title: Green Folk
description: Green Folk The Green Folk were one of the four basic people groups of Maztica , living in the low jungles south of the desert known as the House of Tezca . Description . The Green Folk were short like the Payit .

title: Green Goddess Falls
description: Green Goddess Falls The Green Goddess Falls were a series of waterfalls in Amn . Description . The Falls were part of the River Rimril , as its waters flowed out of the Troll Mountains .

title: Green Imsa
description: Green Imsa Green Imsa was a traveler just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Imsa was a quiet and friendly individual .

title: Green Lady
description: Green Lady " The Lady " or " The Green Lady " was a female human druid and follower of Eldath who lived in the Brynwood forest in the Vast in the 1350s and 1360s DR . History . Going by her age , the Lady was born around 1289 DR .

title: Green Lady ' s Keep
description: Green Lady ' s Keep The Green Lady ' s Keep was a long , low temple to Chauntea in Velprintalar , Aglarond . History . In 1368 DR , the abbey included a granary where twelve monks were led by Abbot Dalmar .

title: Green Regent
description: Green Regent The Green Regent enjoyed many of the abilities of a Chosen of Mielikki . Their powers however , were limited to a period of four years — from Shieldmeet to Shieldmeet ( unless of course the Regent was killed in the meantime ) . The Green Regent was tasked with the protection of Mielikki ' s Dream : the perfect balance between civilization and nature that was found in the Delimbiyr Crescent .

title: Green Shield
description: Green Shield In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Green Shield was one of two unique positions ( Gauntlet being the other one ) that were temporary . While most Herald offices were a lifetime appointment , Green Shield was given a four - year term that began and ended just before consecutive Shieldmeet s . Green Shield presided over the particular quadrennial festival at which was convened the Heralds ' Round — an open court wherein the High Heralds publicly spoke and voted on various aspects of Herald business .

title: Green Sirene
description: Green Sirene The Green Sirene was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The Green Sirene lay on Whistleturn War , close to the Market in the center of the city .

title: Green Sword
description: Green Sword The Green Sword was a tavern in Leuthilspar , Evermeet . Description . The establishment took its name from an extremely heavy green metal sword mounted behind the counter , which supposedly belonged to a green dragon .

title: Green dragon
description: Green dragon Green dragons are master manipulators who revel in corrupting lesser creatures and hoarding them like possessions . Physical description . Green dragons are most notable for the large , waving crest or fin that starts at the dragon ' s nose and runs the entire length of the dragon ' s body .

title: Green hag
description: Green hag Green hags , also known as swamp hags and river hags , use their magical powers to lure innocents into their traps . They will assume the form of beautiful women and enter a populated area to find a young man or woman to corrupt with vices . They will use their ability to mimic animal noises to lure children into the swamp , where they are captured and devoured .

title: Green slaad
description: Green slaad Green slaadi were unusually intelligent slaad shapechangers and spellcasters . Description . Green slaadi appeared as the result of an infection of a humanoid spellcaster by a red slaad egg or a blue slaad ' s chaos phage .

title: Green sleeping dust
description: Green sleeping dust Green sleeping dust was a drug that caused a creature to fall asleep . It was made from parts of the bija tree , which was found in the Quang Muku Forest in Koryo , Kara - Tur . It was incredibly potent — a person who inhaled the dust could not resist falling asleep .

title: Green warder
description: Green warder Green warders were plant creature s programmed by elves to guard their woodland secrets . Description . Green warders were humanoid - shaped topiary bushes pruned to look like tall elves , but if untended , they grew bushy and scraggly .

title: Greenest
description: Greenest Greenest was the only sizable town along the Uldoon Trail in the Greenfields area of the Western Heartlands . Ravenforge . A respected group of mercenaries whose ideals and aims are unknown to many .

title: Greenfields ( Unther )
description: Greenfields ( Unther ) Greenfields or the Green Lands was a region of Unther , and later Tymanther , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p248 " > < / ref > south of the River Alamber and including the River Angol . It was considered the breadbasket of Unther , and later Tymanther , with many productive farms .

title: Greenflame blade
description: Greenflame blade Greenflame blade is a transmutation spell most often used by assault swordmages , though swordmage s of other styles are also known to cast it . When cast " greenflame blade " ignites the swordmage ' s weapon with viridian flames , which add to the deadliness of the swordmage ' s attacks for an instant . " Greenflame blade " , which can be cast at will uses the swordmage ' s intellect and physical strength as the basis for its power , though a swordmage of greater experience will cast a significantly more powerful version of the spell .

title: Greengrass
description: Greengrass Greengrass was a festival to welcome in the first day of spring in the Calendar of Harptos . It occured annually on a special day between Tarsakh 30 and Mirtul 1 . Traditionally , the wealthier people brought out flowers to give to the less wealthy , who either wore them or spread them on the ground to encourage the deities to usher in the summer .

title: Greenmeadow
description: Greenmeadow Greenmeadow was a grassy meadow north of Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . The meadow was separated from the city by the River Ardulith .

title: Greenshores
description: Greenshores County Greenshores was at the base of the Dragon ' s Neck Peninsula in Tethyr . Geography . Greenshores was the eastern most of the three counties of the of Cape Velen .

title: Greenstone
description: Greenstone Greenstone was the Faerûnian name for , a gray - green variety of . Description . These ornamental stones were soft and usually cut or tumbled and polished .

title: Greenwood
description: Greenwood Greenwood was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Quiet One . It temporarily turned a dead or dying tree or a wooden object into a green , leafy plant , vibrant with life . Effects .

title: Gregor
description: Gregor Brother Gregor was an alchemist dedicated to Oghma who lived in the city of Ormpetarr around 1479 DR . Gregor was touched by wild magic and had a spellscar that allowed him to know the effects that any ingredients would have on a potion . History .

title: Greigor Kundknoddick
description: Greigor Kundknoddick Greigor Kundknoddick was a frost giant jarl in the late 15th century DR . History . Greigor was the leader of a frost giant tribe that allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening .

title: Greila Sontoin
description: Greila Sontoin Greila Sontoin was a High Priestess of Mystra in the temple on Mount Talath in Halruaa . Personality . Greila was granted supernatural wisdom by Mystra .

title: Grek
description: Grek Grek was an imperfect galeb duhr in Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Grek , while only half - finished , was exiled from the stone giant Lodge of Faces by the elder Daitya .

title: Grell
description: Grell Grell were sightless aberrations that resembled giant floating brains with tentacles and a beak . Anatomy . Much like other aberrant creatures , the anatomy of a grell was truly bizarre .

title: Grenai Markin
description: Grenai Markin Grenai Markin lived in Luenath in central Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Activities . Herald served as Warchief of Luenath .

title: Grendan Baenre
description: Grendan Baenre Grendan Baenre was a member of House Baenre who was a tenth - year apprentice at Sorcere " circa " 1373 DR . He was considered handsome and had a flair for illusion . History .

title: Grengoral Whelshire
description: Grengoral Whelshire Grengoral Whelshire was the leader of Perfectone Mercantile in the north Faerûn . History . Grengoral was an adventurer who became a merchant .

title: Greshlyrr
description: Greshlyrr Greshlyrr was a kobold chief of the Scything Claw tribe in the Turmish in 1358 DR . History . Greshlyrr gained his fame among his tribe from an episode : he found in a abandoned den a masterfully crafted figurine of Kurtulmak and only second later he had exit the den collapsed in a earthquake .

title: Greshrukk
description: Greshrukk Greshrukk , or Red Eye , was an old red dragon turned into a disembodied dracolich . History . Greshrukk was to be the nascent Berdusk an Dragon Cult ' s second attempt at creating a dracolich , at the request of Shhuusshuru .

title: Grewe
description: Grewe Grewe was a male Northman human and the king of Konigheim in the Utter East in the mid – 7th century DR . In the Year of the Dancing Daggers , 648 DR , King Grewe was the first to discover the ancient bloodforge s of the Utter East . These ancient devices of war could mass - produce entire armies of golems , eliminating overnight the cost of mustering and maintaining armed forces .

title: Grey Blossom Regiment
description: Grey Blossom Regiment The Grey Blossom Regiment was a mercenary company based in Nakamaru in Wa . Description . The company was composed of 500 bushi led by officers who were all no - caste Wanese or natives of Wa .

title: Grey Fire
description: Grey Fire The Grey Fire was a group of holy slayer s who operated within Zakhara in 1367 DR . The symbol of the Grey Fire was a javelin that had a grey shaft and red feathers . Activities .

title: Grey Riders
description: Grey Riders The Grey Riders ( also Gray Riders ) were a group of around twenty ranger s on horseback who were protectors of Harrowdale in the Dalelands . Their primary purpose as of 1368 DR was to guard against monsters and bandits in the forests and woods of the dale . Activities .

title: Greyanna Dhuurniv
description: Greyanna Dhuurniv Greyanna Dhuurniv was the middle Matron Sister of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Although Greyanna and her sisters allied with the Zhentarim , the Matron Sisters had plots in minds different from the objective of the Zhentilar and the Shar rans .

title: Greyanna Mizzrym
description: Greyanna Mizzrym Greyanna Mizzrym was a priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan and sister of Pharaun Mizzrym . Description . Greyanna Mizzrym was described as handsome except for a scar on the left side of her face .

title: Greycloaks of Evereska
description: Greycloaks of Evereska The Greycloaks of Evereska is an organization of investigators and law enforcers based in the hidden elven settlement of Evereska . Named after the Greycloak hills to the north , they are respected by people all over the Western Heartlands and are one of the main reasons why Evereska has never fallen against an enemy . Recently , in 1372 DR the Greycloaks helped defend Evereska against the onslaught of the phaerimm and their mind slaves , after the sharn wall was broken by the Evereskan elf Galaeron Nihmedu and the human and shade Melengaunt Tanthul , a Prince of Shade Enclave .

title: Greypeak Mountains
description: Greypeak Mountains The Greypeak Mountains were a mountain range in northwest Faerûn . Geography . The mountains separated the Fallen Lands from the Delimbiyr River .

title: Greyst Seven Cloud
description: Greyst Seven Cloud Greyst Seven Cloud was the last ruler of Ixtzul . History . Greyst was the ruler of Ixtzul in 562 DR and knew that the vale was dying because there were too many people living in it .

title: Greywolf
description: Greywolf Greywolf was a famous bounty hunter in Baldur ' s Gate . History . Greywolf was a fallen ranger who succumbed to the desire of money and celebrity .

title: Grguch
description: Grguch Grguch was the powerful ogrillon chieftain of the much feared Clan Karuck . Equipment . Grguch was highly adept at throwing huge javelin s from an atlatl .

title: Grick
description: Grick An adult grick was about eight - feet long from the tips of its tentacles to the end of its body and weighed some 200 lbs . Its body coloration was uniformly dark , with a pale underbelly . This creature had no legs , so it slithered around .

title: Griffin ' s Claw
description: Griffin ' s Claw The Griffin ' s Claw was a tavern found in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the bard Talamic could be found entertaining here , singing such songs as the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " .

title: Griffon
description: Griffon A griffon was an intelligent beast with the body of a lion and the wings , forelegs , and head of an eagle . Griffons were majestic magical beasts that combine the features of eagles and lions . These creatures were often used as heraldry symbols and mounts by skilled knights .

title: Griffon ' s Grog
description: Griffon ' s Grog The Griffon ' s Grog was a tavern in Waterdeep . As of 1374 DR , its taproom was smoky , and outside , its sign was moldy , showing a carved griffon volant holding a foaming mug in its claws . The owner in 1374 DR was a fat man with a peg leg and only a thumb and forefinger on his right hand .

title: Griffon ' s Nest
description: Griffon ' s Nest Griffon ' s Nest is a village in an area of grass - cloaked hills west of the Shining Creek . The village is one of the few permanent Uthgardt settlements . The village itself is made up of about 20 thatched log huts that are sealed with baked earth .

title: Griffon Knights
description: Griffon Knights The forty Griffon Knights are a group of fighter s who are responsible for the safety and security of the town of Alamontyr in the Border Kingdoms . They serve Alamontyr ' s ruler , Shield Duke Bardran Thulmaer . They are known for bearing lances to which they sometimes attach magic wands .

title: Griffon Mountains
description: Griffon Mountains The Griffon Mountains were a small mountain range located in the Durpar . Geography . This mountain range rested between the Scarlet Jungle and the River Hiedar .

title: Griffon Tribe
description: Griffon Tribe The Griffon Tribe was led by the charismatic chief Kralgar Bonesnapper . Under his leadership , the tribe has strived toward many greater accomplishments , making them among the most powerful of the Uthgardt barbarian s . History .

title: Griffonheight Keep
description: Griffonheight Keep Griffonheight Keep was a keep and barracks in Velprintalar , Aglarond , situated on a hill . As of 1368 DR , it housed 250 foot soldiers and 50 cavalry , under the command of Sir Tyman . By 1374 DR , the number of foot soldiers had increased to 400 , and the cavalry had been replaced by aerial cavalry .

title: Griffonwatch Keep
description: Griffonwatch Keep Built by Angar Hulmaster , Griffonwatch glowers over the town of Hulburg , a mile from the harbor , perched atop a rocky spur of the eastern ridge . It is the home of the ruling Hulmaster family , the training and barracks of the Shieldsworn , and a place of refuge when the town is in danger of attack . While it is not very well situated to guard the city against attacks by sea , it faces north , inland , a defense against the savage orc s , ogre s , and other monsters who dwell in the desolate hills and moorlands of Thar .

title: Grig
description: Grig Grigs were sprites who loved mischief and light - hearted pranks . They loved playing tricks on larger creatures . Description .

title: Griggen Ekmiran
description: Griggen Ekmiran Griggen Ekmiran was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Griggen managed a shop for carpentry and woodworking .

title: Grigor Hulmaster
description: Grigor Hulmaster Grigor Hulmaster was once the Harmach ( lord ) of Hulburg . Grigor was forced into exile in Thentia by the shadowmage Rhovann and the merchant council of Hulburg . He was assassinated by Cyric ists in 1480 DR .

title: Grim Jaws
description: Grim Jaws The Grim Jaws were a collection of four peaks over a mile high in the western Starspire Mountains in Tethyr . They were the tallest mountains in the Starspires . Geography .

title: Grim Thornbuck
description: Grim Thornbuck Grim Thornbuck was a member of the Knights of the Black Fist in Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . He usually became indebted to the wrong people and did all he had to to repay the debts .

title: Grima al - Auni
description: Grima al - Auni Grima al - Auni min Kor was an ethoist ( conservative ) priest of Kor and member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Grima had black hair and black eyes but appeared stately even though he was a hill giant .

title: Grimblades
description: Grimblades The Grimblades were an adventuring company that operated around the Inner Sea lands in the late 13th century DR . The Grimblades were led by Kesten " Steelglance " Orthalin . History .

title: Grimes
description: Grimes Sergeant - Major Grimes was an officer in the Golden Legion and replaced the captain of the Legion ' s cavalry . He was not too smart but loyal to orders . History .

title: Grimgnaw
description: Grimgnaw Grimgnaw was a dwarven monk and member of the Monks of the Long Death , an evil monastic order that worshiped the very essence of death , which was personified as the " Silent Lord , " and sought to bring as many living beings to death as possible . History . He was from Clan Battlehammer but left Mithral Hall to pursue initiation into the Order of the Long Death .

title: Grimham
description: Grimham Grimham was a svirfneblin who was captured by the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk and prevented from returning to the Underdark . He was tasked with preparing the Khoroshen ' s food , and took the prisoner Chaver Tegarech to the nearby Baeniff Tor on his raft . Grimham possessed a magically enhanced kukri .

title: Grimlight
description: Grimlight Grimlight was a behir who lived in a cave near a gorge situated near to the Cold Vale . He was a large , clever and vicious behir , well known for his tastes for dwarf flesh and gold . It was defeated on 6 Tarsakh , 1374 DR by the reformed Company of the White Star when they entered the cave looking for a telkiira .

title: Grimlock
description: Grimlock Grimlocks are a race of monstrous humanoid s that live in the Underdark . Grimlocks are savage humanoids that have dwelt within the depths of the world for thousands of years . As such , they have lost their sight in the lightless depths and have replaced their ability to sense the world around them with an acute sense of smell and echolocation .

title: Grimmantle
description: Grimmantle Grimmantle was a kingdom in the eastern Crags in northwest Faerûn . History . The northern kingdom was founded by human s in 272 DR to guard against orc attacks .

title: Grimmbold
description: Grimmbold Grimmbold the Gith was a Zhentarim githzerai agent in Skullport . History . Grimmbold lived in Sigil on Concordant Opposition , but the explosion of a portal sent him to Faerûn , near the Citadel of the Raven .

title: Grimmerfang
description: Grimmerfang Grimmerfang was a male orc and Orc - King of the orcish kingdom of Vastar in the late 6th and early 7th centuries DR . History . After Vastar suffered eight bloody years of civil war following the death of Ologh the Overking , Grimmerfang won the war when he defeated his last rival for the throne , then ceremonially spitted , cooked and devoured them .

title: Grimnoshtadrano
description: Grimnoshtadrano Grimnoshtadrano ( called Grimnosh for short ) was a riddle - loving green dragon dwelling in the High Forest . Description . Grimnosh had golden green eyes and was eighty feet long from snout to tail .

title: Grimoires
description: Grimoires Grimoires , sometimes called greatbooks , are formal , ordered collections of spell s . Description . Greatbooks tend to be locked , guarded , and hidden , either in a secure cache or in a wizard ' s abode .

title: Grimslaak
description: Grimslaak Grimslaak was an ultroloth agent of Yrkhetep in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Grimslaak killed and replaced the innkeeper of the Inn of the Five Crown in Arrabar in order to spy on the meeting of the Sisterhood of the Oaks , the Lightblades , the Sunshafts , and the Windriders , where they organized their battle plans against the troops of one of the Yrkhetep ' s minions .

title: Grimwald ' s greymantle
description: Grimwald ' s greymantle Grimwald ' s greymantle was an arcane necromancy spell that prevented healing or regeneration effects from working on a single creature for a short time . Description . The caster imbued the material component of this spell ( a bone , small skull , or small animal skeleton ) with a silver - gray glow which immediately had to come in contact with the target .

title: Grin Ousstyl
description: Grin Ousstyl Grin Ousstyl was a drow wizard and apprentice of archmage Vizeran DeVir during the Rage of Demons . History . Grin hailed from House Ousstyl of Menzoberranzan .

title: Grinding Gulf
description: Grinding Gulf The Grinding Gulf was a large cavern underneath Fox Ridge in Shadowdale . The Grinding Gulf was a great chasm where flying boulders cascaded in a magical vertical dance . Elminster and Florin Falconhand once investigated the Grinding Gulf , but decided that it did not present an immediate threat .

title: Grinna Brightbell
description: Grinna Brightbell Grinna Brightbell was a halfling innkeeper and cook in Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Grinna was spunky , opinionated , and spoke her mind .

title: Grinning Lion
description: Grinning Lion The Grinning Lion was a tavern in the North Ward of the city of Waterdeep . Structure . It was a noisy raucous tavern with tattered shield s on its walls and a variety of other weapons and armor on display .

title: Grinning Ponies
description: Grinning Ponies The Grinning Ponies was a band of halfling adventurers who traveled along the Trade Way and beyond . Activities . The Grinning Ponies was a halfling band that traveled along the Trade Way from Memnon to Waterdeep and east and back the length of Elturgard .

title: Grinning Skull
description: Grinning Skull The Grinning Skull was one of two oases found in the Plains of Purple Dust . This oasis was so named because it was shielded from the harsh wind by the skull of a long - dead great dragon . Inhabitants .

title: Grintalalch
description: Grintalalch Grintalalch the Red was an inscrutable spriggan merchant in Deepearth in 1479 DR . Activities . Gintalalch managed a merchant company in Deepearth .

title: Grintharke
description: Grintharke Grintharke was a balor who ruled over Hellgate Keep . History . He and his followers were exiles from the Abyss .

title: Grisella
description: Grisella Grisella was the owner of the Winter ' s Cradle Tavern in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The bartender was a large woman who wore dull gray outfits .

title: Grisha
description: Grisha Grisha was a cultist of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Grisha believed himself to be correct in sensing the power of Yeenoghu in all things — and particularly in the way in which cultists had begun to rise as undead ghoul s after death .

title: Grissen
description: Grissen Grissen was a halfling member of the Emerald Enclave in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Grissen was possibly involved in the case of the disappearance of Halvin Graingle and six other villagers of the Kabel ' s Hill community inside the forest .

title: Gristle Pete
description: Gristle Pete Gristle Pete was a cook working in the Carnath Roadhouse on the Sword Coast North just before the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Around 1489 DR , Pete worked as a cook for Bog Luck , an agent of the Cult of the Dragon , but did not know his real allegiance .

title: Gritchet
description: Gritchet Gritchet was a halfling trickster in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Gritchet went to Waterdeep from Amn in search of a job .

title: Grobnar ' s camp
description: Grobnar ' s camp Grobnar ' s camp was a house in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The hideout was located in the Neverwinter Wood .

title: Grobnar Gnomehands
description: Grobnar Gnomehands Grobnar Gnomehands was a gnomish bard of the Sword Coast North best known for his travels with the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . A fun - loving and inquistive soul , he was also known for getting into trouble . Description .

title: Grodd
description: Grodd Grodd was a demiplane located in close proximity to the Plane of Shadow . The Grodd goblin s who inhabited this plane believed that the entire plane was underground and consisted of subterranean tunnels and caverns . The Hoard and Grodd demiplanes were linked via a " gate " .

title: Grodd goblin
description: Grodd goblin Grodd goblin s are a sub - race of goblin s that were trapped in the Grodd demiplane with Nalavarauthatoryl . Due to the demiplane s close proximity to the Plane of Shadow , the Grodd goblin s developed abilities that allowed them to not be harmed by the touch of shadow s . Grodd goblins speak a corrupt form of " Ancient Elven " .

title: Grolantor
description: Grolantor Grolantor is a giant deity , and patron of Hill giant s and ettin s as well as some Frost giant s and ogre s . Grolantor looks like a 25 - foot tall hill giant , wearing several belts of woven dwarf beards . He wields an oversized club named Dwarfcrusher .

title: Gromnir Il - Khan
description: Gromnir Il - Khan Gromnir Il - Khan was a half - orc Bhaalspawn who briefly ruled Saradush while the city was under siege by Yaga - Shura . He and his garrison of soldiers had been brought into the city by Melissan along with other Bhaalspawn , ostensibly to keep them safe . When Yaga - Shura besieged the city in an effort to destroy all the Bhaalspawn within , Gromnir locked himself up in the palace with his closest followers , and while the local militia fought against the invaders , his men were content to bully and exploit the town ' s populace .

title: Gromph Baenre
description: Gromph Baenre Gromph Baenre was a drow and the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , as well as a very capable diviner . He was also the Master of Sorcere , the arcane school , and the eldest son of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre , which made him the most powerful male in the city . Description .

title: Grond Peaksmasher
description: Grond Peaksmasher Grond Peaksmasher was a little - known son of Hiatea and a true demigod - unlike the rest of the giant - kin progenitors - who was worshiped by the firbolg s of the Moonshae Isles . The Moonshae firbolgs believe that Grond carved the Moonshae Isles out of a single piece of rock and that the leftovers became the firbolg , while the rubble became the dwarves . They claim that the dwarves slipped him up and he fell into a crevasse that he ' d cut with his axe and then a sheared - off mountaintop fell on him , trapping him there .

title: Groshin Lor
description: Groshin Lor Groshin Lor was the leader of the Hawks secret police in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Groshin was tortured by Thayan s as a young man .

title: Grounding
description: Grounding Grounding was an abjuration spell that prevented damage from normal electrical discharges and helped insulate against magical electrical attacks , within the area of effect . Effects . This spell operated similarly to " fire purge " but did not prevent electrical discharges as " fire purge " prevented ignition of fires ; instead the electricity was prevented from damaging anything in the protected area .

title: Grove of Corellon
description: Grove of Corellon The Grove of Corellon ( also Corellon ' s Grove ) was a place containing the greatest of Evermeet ' s temples to the deity Corellon Larethian , as well as shrines to many of the other Seldarine . Geography . The grove was located south of the village of Elion , in the middle northern part of the island .

title: Growing Mountains
description: Growing Mountains The Growing Mountains were a small isolated mountain range found in the northern regions of the Katakoro Plateau in the Hordelands . Geography . The mountains sat between Nor Tso to the south and the peak of Shan Pi and the eastern arm of Katakoro Shan to the north .

title: Growling Falls
description: Growling Falls Growling Falls is a 200 - foot ( 61 - meter ) waterfall in the Pasocada Basin . Its noise is said to be the roar of an evil bear who could not be defeated because it was sired by a god in animal form . It was eventually defeated by a hero that the Azuposi call Hinchapa but the Dog People call Incholcpa .

title: Grrothgrrowl
description: Grrothgrrowl Grrothgrrowl was the most powerful wemic king of the Shining Plains . Activities . Grrothgrrowl ruled the Tenpaw tribe , which comprised more than 12 , 000 members .

title: Grubkern
description: Grubkern Grubkern was a criminal and grave - robber in the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the months after Rathgar the Raider and his invaders seized control of Doegan , Grubkern was arrested and imprisoned in the castle in the Doegan Capital . He whispered of a gathering army of undead coming to rid Doegan of the invaders .

title: Gruen Bleth
description: Gruen Bleth Lord Gruen Bleth was a human man and a member of the Bleth noble family of Cormyr in the 14th century DR . History . Around 1367 DR , Gruen was the leading member of the Bleth family and he controlled the Seven Suns Trading Coster in Cormyr .

title: Grumbar
description: Grumbar Grumbar ( pronounced " GRUM - bar " ) , or the Earthlord , was the elemental embodiment of earth . He was one of the four elemental deities worshiped in Faerûn . Grumbar , like the other elemental deities ( except Kossuth ) had a minimum of followers in Faerûn , and he cared little indeed for most of those worshipers , as his power came from the many elemental devotees in both the Underdark and the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Grumble
description: Grumble Grumble was a quaggoth thonot in Maerimydra . Activities . Grumble was a slave overseer in Maerimydra .

title: Grumink
description: Grumink Grumink the Renegade was a dwarf at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Grumink was a bloodthirsty and callous individual .

title: Grund
description: Grund Grund was simpleton in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Grund was a happy dim - witted sort .

title: Grung
description: Grung Grungs were poisonous frog - like amphibious humanoid s that lived in trees . Their society was organized in castes determined by each grung ' s color . Description .

title: Grunnarch
description: Grunnarch Grunnarch was a northmen king of Norland in the Moonshae Isles . Personality . Grunnarch was a fierce and proud man .

title: Grunwald
description: Grunwald Grunwald was a tiny village in the North . It was the headquarters of the Thunderbeast tribe of Uthgardt barbarians . Geography .

title: Grushakk
description: Grushakk Grushakk was a powerful glabrezu under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth in 1374 DR . History . During the Battle of the Cwm , Grushakk was the leader of the demon s allied with the fey ' ri .

title: Gruumsh
description: Gruumsh Gruumsh ( pronounced " " groomsh " " ) was an orc god and a greater deity . He was envisioned with one eye by all who named him a god and was a deity mainly worshipped by orcs and orogs . Worshipers .

title: Guallidurth
description: Guallidurth Guallidurth was one of the oldest drow city in the southern Underdark . It was situated beneath the Calim Desert in the Middledark of Old Shanatar . Government .

title: Guard ( Tantras )
description: Guard ( Tantras ) The Guard was the police and defense force of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Base of operations . The Guard were based in the Sea Tower in the city of Tantras , standing on the coast at the southern side of the bay opening .

title: Guardgoyle
description: Guardgoyle Guardgoyles were construct s created by Zhentarim wizard s to protect their treasures . They resembled baby gargoyle s , hence their moniker , and their small stature ( 2 feet tall / long ) allowed them to hide in the wizard ' s posessions , ready to fly out and strike if they sensed a presence in the room it was guarding that wasn ' t it ' s creator or one of the 5 people it could be programmed to not attack . If not destroyed , the magic animating them would last as long as their creator lived .

title: Guardian
description: Guardian The Guardian , or He Who Guards Those That Sleep , was a yak - man inhabiting a secret complex beneath Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Guardian was tasked with watching over the helpless bodies of both the Watcher and the Unspeakable while they remained in possession of their victims .

title: Guardian ' s Tear
description: Guardian ' s Tear The Guardian ' s Tear was a major artifact created , quite by accident , during the Time of Troubles by Helm , the god of guardians . Unsurprisingly , the tragic circumstances behind its creation and the sheer amount of power released during it made this relic extremely desirable . .

title: Guardian daemon
description: Guardian daemon A guardian daemon , also known as a guardian yugoloth , was a type of daemon from the plane of Gehenna . Description . A guardian daemon was a gigantic fiendish creature that spoke with a booming voice .

title: Guardian genie
description: Guardian genie Guardian genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who were sworn to defend specific items or locations . Most of these genies were once efreet who were reshaped over time , but a few were once dao . History .

title: Guardian naga
description: Guardian naga Guardian nagas were immortal beings that often protected treasure , magical secrets , items , and lore that would be destructive should they ever fall into the wrong hands . Description . Like all naga s , guardian nagas had snake - like bodies and human - like faces .

title: Guardian of faith
description: Guardian of faith Guardian of faith was a divine conjuration spell that summoned a spectral guardian that prevented hostile creatures from approaching it . Effects . The spell created a large indistinct guardian that could be identified only by the presence of the symbol of its caster ' s deity on its shield .

title: Guardian sphere
description: Guardian sphere The Guardian sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , crusader s , and monk s that produced zones of protection , often reactive to threats or by way of a semi - sentient creature . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Guardian Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Guardian trees
description: Guardian trees The Guardian trees were 500 ft ( 152 . 4 m ) tall trees that surrounded the Moonstone Palace in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description .

title: Guardians of the Three Fires
description: Guardians of the Three Fires The Guardians of the Three Fires were an elite group of soldiers in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . Activities . The Guardians of the Three Fires served to protect the Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam and the temples under his control .

title: Guards and wards
description: Guards and wards Guards and wards was an arcane abjuration spell that could be used to protect an area or structure with a variety of magical effects and wards . Effects . This spell had numerous effects that operated on an area up to 200 ft ( 18 .

title: Gudea
description: Gudea Gudea was the ruler of Ssintar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Gudea was a supporter of Gilgeam .

title: Guecubu
description: Guecubu A guecubu resembles a mass of vapor , and is born from dreamstuff tainted by evil . Guecubus can possess and control the body of sleeping humanoids . Once they are in control , they ' ride ' silently , letting their victim go about his or her business .

title: Guenhwyvar
description: Guenhwyvar Guenhwyvar was a 600 - lb . ( 272 - kg ) black panther who resided on the Astral Plane . She was summoned to the Prime Material Plane by the use of an onyx " Figurine of Wondrous Power " .

title: Guge
description: Guge Guge was an ancient kingdom situated on the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . At the height of its power , the kingdom of Guge encompassed the entirety of the Katakoro Plateau , stretching as far north as the Hollow Crown Mountains .

title: Guh
description: Guh Chief Guh was the ruler of the hill giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Guh was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Guidance
description: Guidance Guidance , also known as divine fortune , was a cantrip , or a " channel divinity " prayer cast by all cleric s . When the prayer version of " divine fortune " was cast , the cleric using it became , for a moment , more resistant to ill effects while simultaneously gaining additional combat proficiency . After the effects had worn off , " divine fortune " could not be recast , nor could any other " channel divinity " prayer be cast , until the cleric rested for at least a few minutes , in order to regain the concentration needed for the casting .

title: Guiding bolt
description: Guiding bolt Guiding bolt was a light - based divine evocation spell . Effects . The spell caused a beam of light to hit a creature , damaging it and making it glow for a short period of time , temporarily making it an easier target .

title: Guiji Yui
description: Guiji Yui Guiji Yui was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Guiji was honest and humorless , believing in strict enforcement of the law .

title: Guild
description: Guild A guild was an organization composed of like - minded individuals to further and protect their interests . Guilds appeared in many different forms but typically offered benefits such as camaraderie and even financial support to members . Large , powerful guilds could even control an aspect of a city , such as trade in certain goods .

title: Guild Arcane
description: Guild Arcane A Guild Arcane was a mages ' guild , local to a Calishite city , that totally controlled and regulated the use of magic within that city . Organization . Each of the five Guilds Arcane was led by a caleph arcane , who was the most influential wizard in his or her respective city .

title: Guild thief
description: Guild thief The guild thief is a prestige class of Faerûn . Simply put , a guild thief is just a member of a city ' s thieves ' guild , as opposed to those lone con men and cat burglars who operate solo or perhaps with a few others . The result of their membership in the thieves ' guild is that a guild thief has access to assets and training that other thieves simply lack , making a Guild Thief considerably more dangerous and resourceful to those his guild may target .

title: Guildwars
description: Guildwars The Guildwars took place in Waterdeep between 1256 DR and 1262 DR . They were initiated when the death of Open Lord Ahghairon died and the Council of Guildmasters took power . The guildmasters had killed all of the Lords of Waterdeep whose identities they could discover , and afterwards , they turned on one another .

title: Guilmarl
description: Guilmarl Guilmarl was a city located in southern Dambrath . Geography . Guilmarl was the southernmost city in Dambrath located along the coast on the Great Sea .

title: Guisarme
description: Guisarme A guisarme is a two - handed , martial , melee weapon of the pole arm family . Description . The basic guisarme is a weaponized pruning hook mounted on a long pole .

title: Guise of the Yak - Man
description: Guise of the Yak - Man Guise of the Yak - Man was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . The spell made the target appear as a vile yak - man as far as all of the physical senses were concerned .

title: Guise of the faithful
description: Guise of the faithful Guise of the Faithful was an ability a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun usually tried to avoid notice , owing to the illegality of their own existence in drow society , but also to do their work .

title: Guk
description: Guk Guk was a female goblin rogue and member of the Hidden in Maerimydra during the Silence of Lolth . Description . She had deep red skin and yellow eyes .

title: Guldaeth Grimshield
description: Guldaeth Grimshield Guldaeth Grimshield was an old dwarf adventurer who lived in the village of Highbank Forest in the Vast around 1370 DR . Speaking of dangers and rumors to be found in the Vast , Guldaeth once joked dryly , " Come one , come all , here to the Vast . All the killing ' s happening here , and the next handful of dooms to befall us all are a - hatching here — why wait for them to crawl to you ?

title: Guldagh Ironfist
description: Guldagh Ironfist Guldagh Ironfist was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch . Activities . Guldagh was a notorious thug .

title: Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn
description: Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn The Gulder ' s Good Grub Inn ( previously Gulder ' s Good Grubb Inn ) , was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located on the eastern edge of the city , just near the city wall . Around 1358 DR , it was known as a cozy establishment , typically full of regular patrons year - round , except in the worst of winter .

title: Guldor Zauviir
description: Guldor Zauviir Guldor Zauviir was the head of the College of Mages , the College that gathered all non - specialized wizards , and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . Relations . Guldor had strong ties with the local church of Lolth , headed by a female of House Zauvirr .

title: Guldred
description: Guldred Guldred was a lizardfolk in Cormanthor ' s Underdark . History . In 1479 DR , Guldred was an outcast of his tribe living in an Underdark lake under the lair of Dretchroyaster .

title: Gulf Gate
description: Gulf Gate The Gulf Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR . Activities . Located south of the Clothiers ' District , this gate was largely used by traders and suppliers .

title: Gulf of Luiren
description: Gulf of Luiren The Gulf of Luiren was created in 1385 DR when the Spellplague completely inundated Luiren , submerging the land beneath the waves . In addition to the creatures one would normally find in a large body of salt water , the gulf was home to Sahuagin , aquatic ogres and trolls and the ghost s of the former halfling residents of Luiren .

title: Gulkin Hammarlin
description: Gulkin Hammarlin Gulkin Hammerlin was a surly carpenter in High Dale . History . Gulkin was for a brief time a mercenary hailing from Daerlun before he settled in High Dale .

title: Gullykin
description: Gullykin Gullykin was a small settlement located a couple of miles from Durlag ' s Tower , south of the Wood of Sharp Teeth in the Western Heartlands . In Gullykin information about the on - goings in Durlag ' s Tower could be purchased for a small price . Gullykin laid hard up against the overgrown , fallow , rubble field that was once the elven town of Firewine Bridge .

title: Gultec
description: Gultec Gultec was the leader of the Jaguar Knights in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Gultec was one of the most powerful men in Ulatos , always close to the ruler Caxal in time of wars .

title: Gulthmere Forest
description: Gulthmere Forest The Gulthmere Forest marked the boundary between the Dragon Coast and the Vilhon Reach . It was an overgrown forest of pine and cedar that was sacred to the god Nobanion . Geography .

title: Gumushtekin
description: Gumushtekin Gumushtekin was a noble efreeti who occasionally visited the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . He favored dark black and silver clothing .

title: Gundar Brontoskin
description: Gundar Brontoskin Gundar Brontoskin was the King of Grunwald and the Thunderbeast Tribe . Description . The king was a good looking man who ruled Grunwald with a light touch .

title: Gundar Silvershine
description: Gundar Silvershine Gundar Silvershine was an outlander living in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Gundar owned and operated Abas for All .

title: Gundarlun
description: Gundarlun Gundarlun ( pronounced " GOON - der - len " ) was an island in the Frozenfar in the Trackless Sea , off the coast of Icewind Dale in the North . Climate . Although classed as a subarctic climate like the nearby mainland , Gundarlun , like other islands in the area , experienced somewhat different weather , owing to the seas .

title: Gundbarg
description: Gundbarg Gundbarg , called the " Gateway Port " , was a city on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea . It was the biggest settlement on the island — indeed , all the islands of the northern Trackless Sea — with a population of 12 , 000 . Economy .

title: Gunder
description: Gunder The Gunders were the historical ruling family of Estagund in the Shining Lands . History . The Gunders ruled Estagund through turbulent times .

title: Gunderman Brewmaster
description: Gunderman Brewmaster Gunderman Brewmaster was a member of the Council of Seven Burghers in 1368 DR . Activities . Gunderman was a very able brewer , known for the Old Smoke , a beer much appreciated in the Moonsea area .

title: Gundren Rockseeker
description: Gundren Rockseeker Gundren Rockseeker was one of the three dwarf brothers who rediscovered Wave Echo Cave . He was the brother of Tharden Rockseeker , and the older brother of Nundro Rockseeker . He was also a friend to Sildar Hallwinter , a member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Gur
description: Gur The Gurs , also known as Selûne ' s Children or the people of the highway , were a nomadic human people . Description . Like their Rashemi kin , Gurs were typically a stout , strong , and sturdy people , with thick black hair , dark eyes , and dusky skin .

title: Gurdren Myrinn
description: Gurdren Myrinn Gurdren Myrinn was a female keening spirit and a divine champion of Kiaransalee . She resided in V ' elddrinnsshar in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth alongside Larynda Telenna . Description .

title: Gurnik Tapfinger
description: Gurnik Tapfinger Gurnik Tapfinger was a priest of Callarduran Smoothhands and a member of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Gurnik was at the Speaking Stone sanctuary .

title: Gurrash
description: Gurrash Gurrash was the war chief of the Ear Seekers tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Gurrash led his orcs against the elves of the Ardeep Forest , but they were defeated .

title: Gurri
description: Gurri Gurri was the language spoken by the nomadic Gur people . Description . Gurri was an nasal language , with long E and I vowels drawn out .

title: Gurum
description: Gurum The Gurum were a tribe of Ogre s and ogre magi who inhabited an area of Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea of southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Gurum lived in dwellings or caves scattered all over the island .

title: Gust of wind
description: Gust of wind Gust of wind was an evocation or alteration spell that blew away or knocked down smaller creatures . Effect . This spell created a strong blast of air that originated from the caster and moved in the direction he or she was facing .

title: Gustin Bone
description: Gustin Bone Gustin Bone was a young wizard of moderate power who specialized in Illusion and Transmutation magic . His combat spells were quite weak . Gustin ' s primary source of income was through scams .

title: Gustofsen Eller
description: Gustofsen Eller Gustofsen Eller was the most renowned planar expert in the Realms in 1357 DR . History . In his youth , Gustofsen witnessed his entire family slaughtered by cultists of Kali , a goddess of another plane .

title: Gustyl
description: Gustyl Loremaster Gustyl " the Curious " was a priest of Oghma . He took on Raegar Stoneblade to unofficially work for him , spying on wizard s in Waterdeep , although he forbade Raegar from spying on Maaril the Dragonmage , or anyone from the Wands clan or Blackstaff Tower . Gustly ' s assistant was Phanar Manthar .

title: Gutbuster ( drink )
description: Gutbuster ( drink ) Gutbuster was a strong dwarven brew consumed by the dwarves of northwest Faerûn . Description . Gutbuster was a strong drink that only the toughest dwarves and foolhardiest non - dwarves would ever attempt to drink .

title: Gutbuster Brigade
description: Gutbuster Brigade The Gutbuster Brigade was a famous battlerager squad founded by Thibbledorf Pwent in Mithral Hall . They had their own brand of gung - ho tactics and often disregarded the typical order and discipline in favor of a more direct approach . History .

title: Guth
description: Guth Sir Guth of Ormpetarr was a knight of Ilmater and a member of the Order of the Golden Cup from the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech . History . " Circa " 1342 DR , the mad Ilmatari priest Bloirt Waelarn returned and committed murder and stole the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church — from the House of the Broken God in Keltar , Calimshan .

title: Guthbert Golthammer
description: Guthbert Golthammer Guthbert Golthammer was the last Zhent - appointed constable of Dagger Falls from c . 1368 DR until the dale ' s liberation in 1369 DR . History .

title: Guts and Garters
description: Guts and Garters The Guts and Garters was an inn in Skullport . Geography . The inn was located off Illithid Way in the Lower Heart district of Skullport near the Feathered Rat , the Thrown Gauntlet , and the Bindle ' s Blade inn .

title: Guul Shatterneck
description: Guul Shatterneck Guul Shatterneck was a bandit once active in northwest Faerûn . Guul and his kin were bandits . They used the magical spear s called " black kumades " to overwhelm their victims .

title: Guylian Stundter
description: Guylian Stundter Guylian Stundter was a halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Guylian regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned .

title: Gwaeron Windstrom
description: Gwaeron Windstrom Gwaeron Windstrom ( pronounced " GWAIR - on WIND - strahm " ) is a neutral good demigod of rangers and tracking . History . Gwaeron roamed the North as a mortal ranger many centuries ago .

title: Gwelt
description: Gwelt Gwelt was a very ambitious arcanist of Thultanthar . History . In 1487 DR , Manarlume Tanthul and her sister Lelavdra Tanthul found that Gwelt was a highly dangerous individual who was plotting to kill all the Princes of Shade .

title: Gwen
description: Gwen Gwen was a willowy female soldier who traveled with Salen and Jensena . Description . Gwen was a short slender brunette .

title: Gwydion pen Dafwyd
description: Gwydion pen Dafwyd Gwydion pen Dafwyd was the court wizard of Daggerford . History . Once Gwydion was the court wizard of duke Pryden Daggerford but at 1370 DR the court magician was Bronwyn Daggerford in all save the name .

title: Gwynneth
description: Gwynneth Gwynneth was an island in the Moonshae Isles and was the largest of the southern islands . The island was called Sarifal , mainly by its fey inhabitants , and they controlled most of the island . Notable Locations .

title: Gwynneth ( person )
description: Gwynneth ( person ) Gwynneth was the second daughter of the Archduke of Ebenfar , Markus Randol . " Circa " 140 DR , she led refugees across the Sea of Swords to the Moonshae Isles , where they established the first human settlement there . She died a year later of consumption .

title: Gyawa Zangpo
description: Gyawa Zangpo Gyawa Zangpo was a me - zu oni who lived in Takshang on the slopes of Ghalyi Shan in the Hordelands . Personality . Like many oni , Gyawa had a short temper , flying into fits of rage at the slightest provocation .

title: Gynosphinx
description: Gynosphinx A gynosphinx was a female sphinx . While not as physically powerful as an androsphinx , the gynosphinx was still a capable combatant and possessed a number of magical powers . The gynosphinx was the sole female sphinx subrace .

title: Gyrlond
description: Gyrlond Gyrlond was a noble house of Cormyr . History . In the year 1479 DR , the Gyrlonds concerned themselves with methods of farming capable of producing riches relatively quickly .

title: Gythka
description: Gythka A gythka was a type of exotic weapon invented by the thri - kreen and unique to them . It was a long , two - handed polearm with a crescent - shaped blade mounted on each end . These dealt deep slashing wounds .

title: Gyudd
description: Gyudd Gyudd was a master brewer in Skullport . Personality . Gyudd had been haunted by the Melairkyn ghosts in his dreams for most of his life .

title: H ' Catha
description: H ' Catha H ' Catha was one of the planets in Toril ' s solar system , also known as Realmspace . It appeared as an emerald green star in Toril ' s sky . The last of Toril ' s Five Wanderers , H ' Catha , appeared as a crystalline glimmer of white .

title: H ' hoort
description: H ' hoort H ' hoort was a troglodyte consort during the Rage of Demons . History . H ' hoort was the mate of chieftain S ' slaar in the Wormwrithings area .

title: H ' slaat
description: H ' slaat H ' slaat was a troglodyte warrior during the Rage of Demons . History . H ' slaat was the war chief and champion of Laogzed in the tribe led by S ' slaar in the Wormwrithings area .

title: Haakon Erlich
description: Haakon Erlich Haakon Erlich was a corrupt officer of the Red Plumes in Hillsfar . History . During the Rage of Demons , he was approached by the sorcerer Breex Vandermast with an idea to become rich : kidnap non - human farmers from around the city and sell them to the Hillsfar Arena .

title: Haask , Voice of Hargut
description: Haask , Voice of Hargut Haask , Voice of Hargut is said to be one of the Seven Lost Gods who bowed before Bane long ago . History . Haask , a monstrous greathorn minotaur , conquered Ironfang Keep in - 981 DR , declaring himself priest - king of the land of Grong - Haap .

title: Haayon
description: Haayon Haayon the Punisher was a cloud giant member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Haayon was called along with his fellow cultists to the Dessarin Valley .

title: Hada Forgebreath
description: Hada Forgebreath Hada Forgebreath was a dwarf smith in Mulmaster . Activities . Hada was a metalsmith of some renown and one of the few dwarves in Mulmaster .

title: Hadar
description: Hadar Hadar , also known as the Dark Hunger , was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Hadar didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace . Description .

title: Hadarr Karayaka
description: Hadarr Karayaka Hadarr Karayaka was a Calishite explorer in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . Personality . Hadarr was an impulsive individual .

title: Haddenbils
description: Haddenbils The Haddenbils brothers of Deepingdale are known for being the first to use dams to solve the local irrigation problems and provide water for their oat fields . The dams were made from giant granite blocks and sealed with clay and giant spider s ' webs . The brothers gained the use of a spade of colossal excavation which they borrowed from a warrior whose identity is not known .

title: Haden Stonehand
description: Haden Stonehand Haden Stonehand was a bloodforge mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Haden Stonehand was a hardy soul who made a home in the harsh Serpent Valley . The commander of the Legendary Campaign , who aimed to unify the Utter East through conquest , came to challenge Haden in a contest of bloodforge warfare .

title: Hadencourt
description: Hadencourt Hadencourt was a malebranche devil in the service of Szass Tam . Tam sent him to Neverwinter to kill Tam ' s traitorous minion Dahlia Sin ' felle . Dahlia traveled with Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Hades
description: Hades Hades , also known as the Gray Waste , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model , home of the daemon s . Located at the midpoint of the Lower Planes , it was a plane of evil balanced between Law and Chaos . Description .

title: Hadley Erridge
description: Hadley Erridge Hadley Erridge was a human explorer living in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the late 1340s DR , Hadley Erridge was a neighbor of the prosperous and enterprising farmer Del Geery .

title: Hadra bint Aswiyah
description: Hadra bint Aswiyah Hadra bint Aswiyah was a princess of of Muluk in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the royal heir of Muluk , Hadra was an accomplished sha ' ir who held the rank of Sorcerer - General in Muluk ' s army .

title: Hadrhune
description: Hadrhune Hadrhune was an ambitious elven shade who served as the right hand of High Prince Telamont Tanthul , ruler of Thultanthar . Hadrhune fought his way through the ranks of his peers , proving himself to be a capable manipulator as well as a determined and talented mage . With his skills ( and the elimination of his rivals ) , he soon became Telamont ' s top agent and personal emissary .

title: Hadrogh Prohl
description: Hadrogh Prohl Hadrogh Prohl was an elderly cane - wielding half - drow merchant of Mantol - Derith dealing in slaves . History . Hadrogh was approached by Xandra Shobalar to purchase prey for the Blooding .

title: Haedrak I
