description: Haedrak I King Haedrak I of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the fourth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Haedrak was a first cousin to Kortal , the previous king .

title: Haedrak II
description: Haedrak II King Haedrak II , known as the " Corsair Prince " , was the twelfth king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . He was considered one of the Hero - Kings of Tethyr . Relationships .

title: Haedrak Rhindaun III
description: Haedrak Rhindaun III His Royal Highness , King Haedrak Errilam Alemander Olosar Lhorik Rhindaun III was the husband of Queen Zaranda of Tethyr and as such was the Monarch ' s Consort . He was also the Duke - Protector of the Crown Lands and Crown Regent for the heir to the throne . He was the first king of the Rhindaun Dynasty .

title: Haedraline
description: Haedraline Haedraline was a sarrukh who was made a Word Slave bound to the Words of Power . History . The Hero of Neverwinter first met her while searching for the Words of Power , and she offered help in finding them and eventually defeating Morag .

title: Hael Darandar
description: Hael Darandar Hael Darandar was a human from Skelkor , Returned Abeir , and the main diplomat of that empire as of 1479 DR . Background . As of 1479 DR , the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal had tasked Darandar to improve the diplomatic and commercial relationships of Skelkor with the other countries of Returned Abeir .

title: Haela Brightaxe
description: Haela Brightaxe Haela Brightaxe ( " hay " - la " brite " - axe ) , also called the Lady of the Fray or the Luckmaiden , was a dwarven demigod of battle and luck . Overview . Haela Brightaxe was one in spirit with good - aligned dwarves who loved battle and who lived to cleanse Toril of evil monsters .

title: Haeleeya Hanadroum
description: Haeleeya Hanadroum Haeleeya Hanadroum was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and an Emerald Enclave supporter during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Relationship . Since they saved her life , Haeleeya always supported the Enclave , and she shared with them whatever interesting secret talk she heard in the bathhouse .

title: Haeler Thommadur
description: Haeler Thommadur Haeler Thommadur was a warrior during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Haeler organized a caravan under the orders of Ascaleld Marurryn , who acted as negotiator for the Sembia n Rolling Wheel .

title: Haelimbrar
description: Haelimbrar Haelimbrar was a Triadic knight and one of the Knights of Imphras II in 1374 DR . Activities . Haelimbrar was one of the Council of Lords , based in Laviguer .

title: Haelond
description: Haelond Haelond was an abandoned mining outpost located in the Elkannath Mountains , in Gontal . History . Haelond was a mining outpost run by the Elkannath family of the Twelvefold .

title: Haemir Waelvor
description: Haemir Waelvor Haemir Waelvor was a male elf wizard who was a prominent member of the Waelvor House of Cormanthyr . History . Haemir was part of the Waelvor House , one of the old families fierily against the Opening promised by the Coronal Eltargrim .

title: Haer ' Dalis
description: Haer ' Dalis Haer ' Dalis is a tiefling actor and planewalker , and a member of the planar faction known as the Doomguard . He doesn ' t live anywhere permanently , but most frequently returns to Sigil . He belonged to Raelis Shai ' s theatre troupe at one point , and at least at that time , in 1369 DR , stayed on Toril for some time .

title: Haerinvureem
description: Haerinvureem Shimmergloom is the nickname of Haerinvureem . He was a shadow dragon who arose from the depths of the Underdark after the Battlehammer dwarves of Mithral Hall delved too deep in their mithral mines . History .

title: Haerldoun
description: Haerldoun Haerldoun , also called " Hawkmaster " , was a human man and a professional mercenary and adventurer . He was once the owner of Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . History .

title: Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields
description: Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields Haerldoun ' s Helms and Shields was a shop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , near the center of the city . It sold armor , shields , and some weapons . History .

title: Haeromos Dothwintyl
description: Haeromos Dothwintyl Haeromos Dothwintyl was the ruler of Port Llast . Description . A retired stonemason , Haeromos carried himself in a proud manner and wore the finest clothing , armor , and weaponry money could buy .

title: Haeshkarr
description: Haeshkarr Haeshkarr was a demon , more than twenty - thousand years ago . Biography . He was a servant of the demon Lolth , who was at that time still a Tanar ' ri and ruled only the Demonweb Pits in the abyss .

title: Hafayah
description: Hafayah The Free City of Hafayah , located along Al - Kufr River , was characterized by the dark colors of its buildings and the dress of its citizens , who were somber , secretive and suspicious toward strangers . Politically the City of Secrets suffered from the underhanded dealings following the poisoning of the former sultan and most of his family in 1364 DR .

title: Haffa
description: Haffa Haffa was a half - ogre businessman in Skullport . Personality . Haffa was a clever , intuitive , and soft - spoken individual .

title: Hafiz al - Milhab
description: Hafiz al - Milhab Hafiz al - Milhab was an efreeti overseer on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Hafiz was the overseer of a mine in the Elemental Plane of Fire , where efreet put enslaved azer s to work .

title: Hafiz bin Watat
description: Hafiz bin Watat Hafiz bin Watat was a dwarven wizard living in the area east of the Nashkel mine . He was also a seer and an astrologer , and when he met Gorion ' s Ward he said that they had met previously in dreams . He also gave some cryptic advice about a future menace .

title: Hag Countess
description: Hag Countess The Hag Countess was a night hag and once the Lord of the Sixth of the Nine Hells . Personality . As a night hag rather than a devil , she enjoyed no support from any other Lord of the Nine .

title: Hagar Hlutwigsson
description: Hagar Hlutwigsson Hagar Hlutwigsson was a hagspawn in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Hagar was the son of Hlutwig Long - throw , last chieftain of the Blue Bear Tribe , and the annis Tanta Hagara , at that time shaman of the tribe .

title: Hagarl
description: Hagarl Hagarl was a doppelganger who assumed the form of a human boy in order to feast on the inhabitants of Beliard . Personality . Preying on the weak , Hagarl killed horse s , dog s , and the weakest travelers journeying through Beliard .

title: Hagen
description: Hagen Hagen was a merchant of Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Since bandits and thugs threatened him to give away gold for them , Hagen lost his trust with the Neverwinter Watch .

title: Hagga Shan
description: Hagga Shan Hagga Shan , or the Glittering Spires , was a mountain range located in the northern region of the Hordelands along Yal Tengri . Geography . Hagga Shan sat along the southeastern edge of Yal Tengri .

title: Hagspawn
description: Hagspawn Hagspawn were male hag s produced by human s and hags mating . Society . Though male or female offspring may result from such a coupling , female children inevitably became hags rather than hagspawn .

title: Hah Li
description: Hah Li Hah Li was a coombe giant inhabiting the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Hah Li helped lead a band of Tuigan deserters to the Rainbow Monastery which they took as their own .

title: Haifami
description: Haifami The Haifami were a tribe of human s who inhabited an area of Jazayir al - Sartan in southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Chief only assembled a " court " when major decisions needed to be made .

title: Hailcone
description: Hailcone Hailcone was an evocation spell used to create dangerous shards of hail . This spell was created by the wizard Aubayreer . Effects .

title: Hair shirt of Ilmater
description: Hair shirt of Ilmater A hair shirt of Ilmater , also known as a hair shirt of suffering , was a magical horsehair shirt associated with the faith of the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures . Description . It was , as the name suggested , a thick shirt fashioned of several layers of coarse , brown woven horse hair , making quite a stiff fabric .

title: Hairy spider
description: Hairy spider Hairy spiders were a variety of subterranean spider . Description . Hairy spiders were about the size of a human hand .

title: Haither Stonehand
description: Haither Stonehand Haither Stonehand was the general of Daggerford ' s militia . The Stonehand clan had lived in the town for generations and Haither ' s mother died in the Second Dragonspear War . Haither considered all her soldiers to be more friends and family than subordinates , gaining their absolute loyalty .

title: Hajama
description: Hajama Hajama was the Zakhara n god of bravery . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and encouraged his followers to never shy away from any opposition — be it in battle or other circumstances . His followers believed that it is better to try and fail than not to try at all , as even living through a defeat strengthens the spirit .

title: Hajjaj
description: Hajjaj Hajjaj , also called Hajjaj the Intemperate was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Hajjaj served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .

title: Haka Kinnori
description: Haka Kinnori Haka Kinnori was a disguised samurai of Doi No Fugu in 1360 DR . History . Kinnori was a samurai retainer of the Emperor .

title: Hakim
description: Hakim Hakim was an efreetikin who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Perhaps because of his master ' s numerous negative dealings with genies , Hakim was quite sullen most of the time .

title: Hakim Sayad
description: Hakim Sayad Hakim Sayad was the owner of Clothes for the Enlightened within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Hakim was portly , even for an ogre .

title: Hakim al - Nasri
description: Hakim al - Nasri Hakim al - Nasri was a priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Hakim was the chief supporter of Imam Jomhur , believing he should be allowed to die in office without retiring .

title: Hakima
description: Hakima Hakima , or Wise Women , were insightful cleric s in Zakhara . Requirements . All Hakima were female and possessed great wisdom .

title: Hakiyah
description: Hakiyah Hakiyah was worshiped as the goddess of truth in the lands of Zakhara . She was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of honesty and calm examination of the truth . Hakiyah ' s symbol was a cresting wave .

title: Haku
description: Haku Haku was the god of freedom of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of personal independence and self - reliance . Haku ' s symbol was a stylized gust of wind .

title: Haku ( yakuza )
description: Haku ( yakuza ) Haku was a yakuza assassin in the town of Aru in Wa . Possessions . In battle , Haku used a chain and knife .

title: Hala Myrt
description: Hala Myrt Hala Myrt was a Tethyrian human who frequented the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward of Waterdeep , working for Orlpar Husteem . She found customers for Orlpar and ses up meetings . She was arrested by the City Watch on many occasions but was never charged due to the actions of Orlpar ' s agents , who were responsible for watching her movements while she was carrying Orlpar ' s money or illegal substances .

title: Halabankh Ormsarr
description: Halabankh Ormsarr Halabankh Ormsarr was a human man and an illusionist . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History .

title: Halagard
description: Halagard Halagard was a city located in central Halruaa . Description . At 7 , 500 inhabitants , Halagard sported a large population when compared to other Halruaan cities .

title: Halagard Channel
description: Halagard Channel The Halagard Channel was a waterway located in Halruaa . Geography . The Halagard Channel connected Lake Halruaa with the Great Sea .

title: Halamar
description: Halamar Halamar was a competent mage specializing in fire magic and a member of the Blue Wyvern Company . In 1479 DR , Halamar and the Blue Wyverns helped Jack Ravenwild recover the Sarkenaegal tome from the ancient dwarven city of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff . Description .

title: Halamar ' s Horses
description: Halamar ' s Horses Halamar ' s Horses was a stable run by Blasko Halamar . Geography . The stables were located on the eastern side of Beliard , east of the Stone Bridge in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn .

title: Halana Shauluth
description: Halana Shauluth Halana Shauluth was a baker in the village of Amphail on the Sword Coast North around 1370 DR . She baked hard loaves of wheat and meat - filled buns . Biography .

title: Halanaestra
description: Halanaestra Halanaestra was an elf of mixed wild elf and moon elf heritage ( and possibly aquatic elf , too ) . History . Around 1368 DR , she was the proprietor of the Green Sword tavern in Leuthilspar , Evermeet .

title: Halander Hardingdale
description: Halander Hardingdale Halander Hardingdale , also known as Ratshadow , was a young halfling from Baldur ' s Gate . Due to some trouble with certain associates , he and is family had to flee to Waterdeep . While there he joined the Zhentarim , who relocated him to Ten Towns .

title: Halani Meliamne
description: Halani Meliamne Halani Meliamne was a slave of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Halani was a princess of the Moonwood elves until , in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , one night several yak folks possessing some moon elf hunters killed her brothers and took her as a slave .

title: Halarahh
description: Halarahh Halarahh was the capital of Halruaa prior to the Spellplague . Description . The city consisted was made of pink coral houses ; towers of white , blue , or green marble ; and streets cobbled in semiprecious stone and fanciful fountains filled the air with fresh splash and bubble .

title: Halardrim
description: Halardrim Halardrim was a dead language in the Raumtheran languages group by the 14th century DR . History . It was once spoken in the northlands of Rashemen , and some of its words were still present in the Rashemi language .

title: Halarglautha
description: Halarglautha Halarglautha , also called " Firewings " , was a female great wyrm red dragon that once laired in Dragon Falls , the Vast . She was slain by adventurers . History .

title: Halaster ' s Higharvestide
description: Halaster ' s Higharvestide Abduction . At dawn on Higharvestide of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , two members of the Twisted Rune managed to kidnap Halaster Blackcloak from inside Undermountain . The lich Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk and the alhoon Ralayan the Ocultacle used a ring of multiple wishes to bind and summon the Mad Mage to Stardock where they intended to probe the great archmages mind for his intricate knowledge of portals and magical gates .

title: Halaster ( Zhentil Keep )
description: Halaster ( Zhentil Keep ) Halaster was a puppet member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . History . Halaster in the young was a able Zhentilar commander and fought many battles against bandits and goblinoid of Thar ; now he owned many building in the Foreign Quarter and had interest near Tesh .

title: Halaster Blackcloak
description: Halaster Blackcloak Halastar Blackcloak ( formerly Hilather ) was a very old and insane wizard who resided within his lair : Undermountain . History . In his youth more than a thousand years ago , Halaster Blackcloak was known as Hilather , though where he spent his youth is the source of great speculation .

title: Halav
description: Halav Halav was a priestess of Eilistraee . Halav was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History .

title: Halavar
description: Halavar Halavar was an archwizard of Palter who spent most of his time entertaining the youth of Netheril . He created a magical item , " Halavar ' s universal pantograph " that allowed him to reproduce his puppets and marionettes . Through a strange twist of fate , the device could also copy just about anything that could fit in the box , even living beings .

title: Halavin Symryvvin
description: Halavin Symryvvin Halavin Symryvvin was member of House Symryvvin and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith . History . In 1372 DR , Halavin was a novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith , known for being fond of wearing jewelry .

title: Halbasho
description: Halbasho Halbasho the Smart was an oni inhabiting Horseshoe Temple Oasis during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Halbasho supervised other oni and goblin s as they attempted to convert a temple for the worship of Li Pei , the lord of the underworld .

title: Halbdol
description: Halbdol Halbdol was a special paste used in the Cold Lands , specifically in Narfell . Description . " Halbdol " was a thick black paste that gave off a flowery smell with a hint of mint .

title: Halberd
description: Halberd A halberd is a two - handed , martial melee weapon of the pole arm family . Description . The business end of a halberd has three main parts : the axe head , the back spike and the spear tip .

title: Halcaunt
description: Halcaunt Halcaunt was the paladin leader of the Brotherhood of Skuld in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Halcaunt was the most formidable opponent of the faith of Set .

title: Haldan
description: Haldan Haldan was a thief in Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Haldan was the main source of gossip in the village ( often inaccurate ) .

title: Haldos
description: Haldos Haldos was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a butcher and owner of Haldos ' s Fine Butchery . Around 1369 DR , Haldos kept his business in the center of Wheloon , to the irritation of his neighbors , though few dared to complain to him about the noise of slaughter .

title: Haldos ' s Fine Butchery
description: Haldos ' s Fine Butchery Haldos ' s Fine Butchery was a shop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , near the center of the city . It was a butchery and was owned by Haldos . History .

title: Haldyn Stormkin
description: Haldyn Stormkin Haldyn Stormkin was a human man and a fighter . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Description .

title: Halemar
description: Halemar Halemar was a weaponsmith and armorer , and proprietor of Halemar ' s Fine Blades in the city of Tantras in the Vast . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , when Tantras expected war with the forces of Zhentil Keep , Halemar was kept busy crafting war materiel for the city ' s army .

title: Halemar ' s Fine Blades
description: Halemar ' s Fine Blades Halemar ' s Fine Blades was a business in the city of Tantras in the Vast , located in the northeastern part of the city , owned by Halemar . Halemar was a weaponsmith and armorer . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , when Tantras expected war with the forces of Zhentil Keep , Halemar was kept busy crafting materiel for the city ' s army .

title: Half - Elven Renegades
description: Half - Elven Renegades The Half - Elven Renegades was the name given to a group of bandits who raided along the Delimbiyr during the Era of Upheaval . Leadership . " Princess " Tianna Skyflower lead the Renegades , who had been shaped by her to believe that they were the rightful descendants of Earlann .

title: Half - dragon
description: Half - dragon A half - dragon was a cross between a dragon and another unrelated creature . Description . Most half - dragons were slightly bigger than their non - dragon parent and displayed features of their dragon parent .

title: Half - drow
description: Half - drow A half - drow was the offspring of one human parent and one drow parent . A half - drow generally had dusky skin , silver or white hair , and human eye colors . They could see around 60 feet ( 18 m ) with darkvision but otherwise had no other drow traits or abilities .

title: Half - dwarf
description: Half - dwarf Half - dwarves ( also known as dwelves or halfbloods ) were humanoid s born through the union of a dwarf and another humanoid race . Ecology . Half - dwarves were usually the result of a dwarf mating with a human , gnome , elf , or halfling .

title: Half - eladrin
description: Half - eladrin Half - eladrin are generally considered to be the progeny of unions between human s and eladrin , though technically all half - breeds with eladrin ancestry are half - eladrin . Most half - eladrin are descended from moon elves and face the same prejudices and cultural alienation that half - elves do . Ecology .

title: Half - elf
description: Half - elf Half - elves , as usually defined , are humanoid s born through the union of an elf and a human . Whether a half - elf is raised by their human parent or their elven parent , they feel isolated and alone . Because they take around twenty years to reach adulthood , they mature quickly when raised by elves ( who think they look like humans ) , making them feel like an outsider in either place .

title: Half - fiend
description: Half - fiend Half - fiends are the offspring of fiend s who have mated with a creature that is not a fiend , such as a human or dragon . Description . A fiend ' s magical nature allows it to breed with virtually any creature .

title: Half - gnoll
description: Half - gnoll Half - gnolls were humanoids with both human and gnoll ancestry . Description . Most half - gnolls were large muscular beastmen with wild fur and yellowed teeth .

title: Half - goblin
description: Half - goblin Half - goblins were humanoids born from a pairing of goblin s with another race , such as human s . They could be found wherever such a pairing took place , notably in Icewind Dale and the Dustwall Mountains . Description .

title: Half - ogre
description: Half - ogre Half - ogres were the offspring of a human and an ogre . Description . Half - ogres had a height somewhere between that of a human and an ogre and taller than a half - orc , often between seven and eight feet ( 210 and 240 centimeters ) .

title: Half - orc
description: Half - orc Half - orcs are humanoids born of both human and orc ancestry by a multitude of means . Combining the physical power of their orcish ancestors with the agility of their humans ones , half - orcs can be formidable individuals . Though often shunned in both human and orcish society , though for different reasons , half - orcs have proven themselves from time to time as worthy heroes and dangerous villains .

title: Halfana al - Yamini
description: Halfana al - Yamini Halfana al - Yamini was an oathbinder genie who worked for the Everlasting in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Halfana was summoned when eight rafiq s prayed to Hajama , and the " lamp of devotion " was filled with rich , and possibly magical , incense and lit .

title: Halfaxe Trail
description: Halfaxe Trail The Halfaxe Trail was a footpath through the forest of Cormanthor , began around the 1180s DR . It was built by Durl Halfaxe and a force of human workers , under the command of Halvan the Dark , who was the ruler of Harrowdale at the time . Its construction was an attempt by Halvan the Dark to prevent losing trade from the west of Harrowdale and from the Moonsea Ride , as it would have connected Harrowdale Town with this major road .

title: Halfling
description: Halfling Halflings , also known as Hin amongst themselves or the " good folk " amongst other races , or the " quick folk " and " sly folk " were humanoid creatures similar in shape to human s , who halflings called the " Big Folk , " , " Manyhanded " or " Hurbryn " but around half their size . Halflings got along well with most of the other races and were known for their curiosity and tendency to collect things . The term " halfling " was derived from the fact that a halfling was around half of the size of a human , but otherwise very similar in appearance .

title: Halfling bounder
description: Halfling bounder Halfling bounders are expert fighter s of the halfling race who use their own unique physical qualities to form a particular fighting style unique to the " hin " . Unlike most fighters , halflings use their natural nimbleness and quick wit as their primary methods of survival , making halfling bounders unusually daring warriors . Halfling bounders are the elite soldiers of halfling society , protecting the nomadic caravans or halfling towns and villages from external harm .

title: Halfling domain
description: Halfling domain The Halfling domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters halfling spell powers . They gain the ability to boost their climbing , jumping , and stealth once per day for 10 minutes . Deities with the Halfling domain .

title: Halfling language
description: Halfling language The Halfling language , which was properly called Luiric , was a language spoken by the halfling s of Luiren . Since halflings were so adaptive by nature , the vast majority of halflings outside of Luiren had abandoned their native tongue and spoke Common or other human languages instead .

title: Halfling outrider
description: Halfling outrider The halfling outrider was a champion of defense and scouting of halfling communities . Culture . The outrider worked as an elite scout and rider for their community and they were naturally skilled in those areas .

title: Halfole
description: Halfole Halfoles were a style of building prevalent in Luiren that were used by halfling s . Structure . Halfoles were located underground .

title: Halfway Inn
description: Halfway Inn The Halfway Inn was a tavern and inn located in the mountains near Evereska that was constructed for the elves to trade with the other races . Description . The Halfway Inn was located on the northwestern border of Evereska , a ride of an hour or two away from the city of Evereska .

title: Halidae ' s Height
description: Halidae ' s Height Halidae ' s Height was a forest - covered hill top south and a little west of the city of Myth Drannor . Magic . In 760 DR , Halidae ' s Height was warded against all types of fiend s by the god Azuth , for " as long as Azuth ' s power endures " .

title: Haliduth Orspriir
description: Haliduth Orspriir Haliduth Orspriir was a priest of Deneir and the Librarian Supreme of the Master ' s Library temple of Deneir on Iron Dragon Mountain in the Earthfast Mountains . . History .

title: Halima min Kor
description: Halima min Kor Halima min Kor was a human ethoist within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . As the High Priest of the Palace , Halima led the religious services of the entire palace .

title: Halinaxus
description: Halinaxus Halinaxus was a red dragon at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Halinaxus toyed with the idea of allying with the Cult of the Eternal Flame .

title: Halish
description: Halish Halish was a male Calishite human cleric of Mystra in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Halish among a group of people who visited the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr .

title: Halisstra Melarn
description: Halisstra Melarn Halisstra Melarn was a drow priestess of House Melarn in Ched Nasad . At her " death , " she was turned into a demonic servant of Lolth known as the Lady Penitent . Description .

title: Haliyra Ravenfast
description: Haliyra Ravenfast Haliyra Ravenfast was an assassin member of the Hand of Yartar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , a patrol of the Twelve near Triboar had defeated some cultists of the Cult of the Eternal Flame and recovered a " devastation orb " .

title: Haljal Throndor
description: Haljal Throndor Haljal Throndor was a blacksmith who ran the Cracked Anvil in Port Llast . Background . Haljal was once a miner north of Mirabar until a terrible cave - in crushed his right leg and arm and his chest , forcing him to retire .

title: Hall of Ashes
description: Hall of Ashes The Hall of Ashes was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The Hall of Ashes held the interred remains of the Grand Caliph s of Huzuz .

title: Hall of Audience
description: Hall of Audience The Halls of Audience was located within the great fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Thousands of candles kept this chamber lit during all hours of the day or night .

title: Hall of Commanders
description: Hall of Commanders The Hall of Commanders was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The Hall of Commanders was a large area dedicated to the housing of various leaders of the mamluk s , guards , and admirality .

title: Hall of Earth
description: Hall of Earth The Hall of Earth was located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Hall of Earth was kept extremely dry .

title: Hall of Justice
description: Hall of Justice The Hall of Justice was the temple of Tyr in the city of Neverwinter . Location . It was located on a cliff overlooking the Sea of Swords on the south bank of the Neverwinter River near its mouth .

title: Hall of Mental Splendor
description: Hall of Mental Splendor The Hall of Mental Splendor was a small keep in the city of Skullport in Undermountain that was the headquarters of an organization of psionic mercenary spies led by Vhondryl active in the 1370s DR . Services . The psychic spies of the Hall of Mental Splendor conducted espionage for those who hired them , promising discretion .

title: Hall of Mists
description: Hall of Mists The Hall of Mists , located deep inside the High Forest , was an ancient stronghold of the Ba ' etith , an organization of sages and lorekeepers that began in the ancient sarrukh empire of Isstosseffifil . The Hall of Mists was guarded by a powerful arakhor , known as the Grandfather Tree , summoned here by the elves in - 12500 DR . In - 2436 DR , an unknown thief stole seven of the Nether Scrolls , and three of them were hidden away in the Halls of Mists .

title: Hall of Success
description: Hall of Success The Hall of Success was a temple of Waukeen in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . It later became a temple of Lliira . History .

title: Hall of Winds
description: Hall of Winds The Hall of Winds was a tower located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Aptly named , the Hall of Winds was literally filled with raging winds that circled constantly within the tower structure .

title: Hall of the Ancients
description: Hall of the Ancients The Hall of the Ancients was a large hall in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet that was used to contain the remains of elven heroes . It contained the bodies of Lafarallinn and Kethryllia Amarillis . A rumor existed that the hall also contained elven magical items , but Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun believed this to be false .

title: Hall of the Courtiers
description: Hall of the Courtiers The Hall of the Courtiers was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This area served as both the living quarters and workplace of the hundreds of scribes , courtiers , and bureaucrats who ran the daily operations of the Palace .

title: Hall of the Fountain
description: Hall of the Fountain The Hall of the Fountain was located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Hall of the Fountain was filled with enchanted water that remained within the room when any door was opened .

title: Hall of the Hearth
description: Hall of the Hearth The Hall of the Hearth was located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . An extremely high temperature was maintained within this hall , hot enough to cause clothing to smolder and paper to burst into flame .

title: Hall of the High Hunt
description: Hall of the High Hunt The Hall of the High Hunt is a temple built into the steep western slope of Moondark Hill . It is a great open air pavilion encircled by a tightly packed colonnade of ancient shadowtop s . A pure mountain spring rises in the heart of the hill and winds through a series of natural caverns before exiting at the heart of the Shadowtop Glade .

title: Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai
description: Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai The Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai was a building in the elven city of Evereska in the Western Heartlands that was the headquarters of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of elven psionicist s . Activities . A subbasement area of the Hall contained a number of laboratories and vaults holding the group ' s collection of psionic item s , ranging from ordinary power stone s to crystal capacitor s to potent psicrown s .

title: Hall of the Treasury
description: Hall of the Treasury The Hall of the Treasury was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Since the wealth of the Grand Caliph was stored here , it was heavily guarded .

title: Hallong
description: Hallong The Hallong was a rite of passage for young male yikarian s of the World Pillar Mountains . Hallong translated literally as " begging bowl " in the yikarian language . History .

title: Halloran
description: Halloran Halloran was a young cavalry officer in the service of Cordell ' s Golden Legion who participated in the Maztica n expedition . History . Youth .

title: Hallorfan Teshdale
description: Hallorfan Teshdale Hallorfan Teshdale was a male human and one of the four innkeepers of The Rapids inn in Teshwave in 1367 DR . He was the original proprietor before the arrival of the Zhentilar . Hallorfan was resigned to living under Zhent rule ; he had no place to escape to and , in his late 60s , he was too old to fight .

title: Hallowed Redeemer
description: Hallowed Redeemer The Hallowed Redeemer was a special two - handed sword owned by the paladin Keldorn Firecam . History . He received it as a gift from Torm himself early on in his career , and no - one else could use it .

title: Halls of Demarch
description: Halls of Demarch The Halls of Demarch was a guildhall in the city of Tantras in the Vast in north Faerûn . It served as headquarters to Demarch ' s Alliance and later Demarch ' s Folly . Location .

title: Halls of Justice ( Muluk )
description: Halls of Justice ( Muluk ) The Halls of Justice was a government building located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . The Halls of Justice were found near the center of Muluk .

title: Halls of Memory
description: Halls of Memory The Halls of Memory were part of the complex of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This building could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Halls of the Faithful
description: Halls of the Faithful The Halls of the Faithful were located within the great fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . This building served as the barracks for the holy slayer s of the Everlasting .

title: Halls of the Hunting Axe
description: Halls of the Hunting Axe The Halls of the Hunting Axe were halls that were part of the dwarven realm of Besilmer before falling into ruin when the realm fell . They were located 48km ( 30 miles ) southeast of the Stone Bridge and were used as a dwarven city , occupied by the Delzoun . The halls were constructed of stone with arched walls , and once contained windows consisting of coloured mosaics .

title: Hallucinatory forest
description: Hallucinatory forest Hallucinatory forest was an illusion spell that made a large area appear to be a real forest permanently . The reverse of this spell , revealed wood , removed this illusion . Effects .

title: Hallucinatory terrain
description: Hallucinatory terrain Hallucinatory terrain was an illusion spell that made one type of terrain look like another for a few hours . Effects . This spell worked on natural terrain and areas with roads .

title: Halondar
description: Halondar The Halondar , originally called the Turmway , was a road in the Vilhon Reach that stretched from Alaghôn to Hlondeth . Geography . The Halondar ran through the Halondar Valley between the Orsraun Mountains and the Aphrunn Mountains before nearly bisecting Turmish .

title: Halonya
description: Halonya Halonya was the teenaged prophetess of Tchazzar and his high priestess . Although she was Tchazzar ' s proclaimed high priestess , she was incapable of casting divine magic . Halonya was jealous of Jhesrhi Coldcreek and often whispered derogatory comments to Tchazzar behind Jhesrhi ' s back .

title: Halric Bonesnapper
description: Halric Bonesnapper Halric Bonesnapper was the ruler of Griffon ' s Nest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Halric was the grandson of the great Kralgar Bonesnapper Activities .

title: Halruaa
description: Halruaa Halruaa , as of 1372 DR , was a land of magic , renowned for its electrum mines . Ruled by Netyarch ( wizard - king ) Zalathorm Kirkson in the capital city of Halarahh , the fabled , quiet and wealthy magocracy was justly depicted as full of wonder . Created by archwizard s foreseeing the fall of Netheril , Halruaa combined the peace and harmony of Cormyr with the magic powers of Thay .

title: Halruaan ( ethnicity )
description: Halruaan ( ethnicity ) The Halruaans were an ethnic group of human s who made up the vast majority of the population of Halruaa and Nimbral . They also composed a tiny percentage of the population of Lapaliiya and the Shaar . Description .

title: Halruaan Consumption
description: Halruaan Consumption Halruaan Consumption was a deadly wasting disease that could be contracted by non - spellscared creatures who ventured into the wastelands of Halruaa . In the initial stages of the disease any magical healing spell s cast on the afflicted creature would be less effective . However , arcane attack spells cast by the creature would be more powerful .

title: Halruaan elder
description: Halruaan elder Being just an arcane spellcaster is not enough in Halruaa . One must be able to prove his / her mastery of the Art with unique displays of arcane force and knowledge ; enough to make them famous all across the land . Such individuals that earn this title are granted permission to participate in the revered and prestigious Halruaan Counsil of Elders , the court of Netyarch , the " wizard - king " , where they discuss the official policies and important matters of the country with the head of state .

title: Halruaan language
description: Halruaan language Halruaan ( sometimes spelled Halruan ) was a regional language of South Faerûn and the official language of the magocracy of Halruaa and the island of Nimbral . Speakers . Descendants of the Netheril Empire , the people of Halruaa spoke a language that evolved from ancient Netherese .

title: Halruaan skyship
description: Halruaan skyship A Halruaan skyship was a sailing vessel that flew through the air . Physical description . The flying vessel looked much like a normal seagoing sailing ship .

title: Halthara Summergarth
description: Halthara Summergarth Halthara Summergarth was a halfling woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Around 1368 DR , Summergarth was a ship - owner and a maker of barrels and crates , and conducted her trade from Summergarth Facilitations in Procampur .

title: Halueth Never
description: Halueth Never Halueth Never was the sun elf founder of the city of Neverwinter . History . In the Year of Burning Glades , - 10 DR , he led the elves of Iliyanbruen to defeat Illuskan expansion .

title: Halvan ' s Keep
description: Halvan ' s Keep Halvan ' s Keep was a keep in Harrowdale , once occupied by then lord of Harrowdale ( Halvan ' s Dale ) , Halvan the Dark . It was described as an old , rambling manor house enclosed by newer walls , and the origin of the manor house is therefore not known . History .

title: Halvan the Dark
description: Halvan the Dark Halvan the Dark was an individual who became lord of Harrowdale at some point in the 1180s DR , and renamed it " Halvan ' s Dale " . He also created the Halfaxe Trail , a route through deep woodland to Harrowdale . Character .

title: Halvin Graingle
description: Halvin Graingle Halvin Graingle was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Under the orders of his masters , Halvin went to the Quivering Forest posing as a woodworker .

title: Halwa
description: Halwa Halwa , the City of Solitude , was one of Zakhara ' s " Cities of the Heart " . Geography . Halwa was located about 200 miles ( 320 km ) east of Wasat within the desert of the Haunted Lands along Al - Malih River .

title: Hama
description: Hama Hama this birds spirits who remained on the material plane instead of going to the afterlife . Usually they can not go to the afterlife for the same reasons that other spirits , it ' s either not finished deal that holds the spirit of this world , or revenge . Hama can not speak but their songs and croakings can often guess what they mean .

title: Hama Sayif
description: Hama Sayif Hama Sayif was a dwarven mystic who ran a small stand within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . For a fee , Hama would give his customers advice or even dance for them .

title: Hamadh
description: Hamadh Hamadh the Unseen was a male drow shadowdancer from Maerimydra . He led a small group of resistance fighters , known as the Hidden , that formed in the wake of Kurgoth Hellspawn ' s invasion . Description .

title: Hamatula
description: Hamatula Hamatulas — also called barbed devils — were the guardians of the Nine Hells , entrusted with important duties such as defending infernal fortresses and prisons , guarding vaults , and serving as bodyguards to the most powerful denizens of the Nine Hells . Description . As their name implies , a barbed devil was covered in a mass of sharp barbs .

title: Hamayarch
description: Hamayarch A Hamayarch was the title of a mage - advisor and assistant to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast , and leader of the city ' s mage s . Duties . The Hamayarch served as a mage - advisor and assistant to their Thultyrl , and was meant to be very loyal to their ruler and operated with their blessing .

title: Hambergyle
description: Hambergyle Hambergyle , also known as hambergite , was a somewhat rare semi - precious stone . Description . Hambergyle was found in crystal or fragmentary form .

title: Hambone Bay
description: Hambone Bay Hambone Bay was a small body of water located on the western end of Luirenstrand in Luiren . Geography . Hambone Bay abutted the central coastline of Luiren .

title: Hames
description: Hames Hames was an undead pirate in service to Garrundar in the Pirate Skyhold north of Neverwinter . History . Hames was a commander of the very powerful band of sky pirates led by Bartholomew Blackdagger .

title: Hamid al - Bashshar
description: Hamid al - Bashshar Hamid al - Bashshar was one of the newest members of the Corsair Council of Hawa by 1367 DR . History . Hamid was once a member of the Dutiful Mamluk Society .

title: Hamlar Hills
description: Hamlar Hills The Hamlar Hills were a cluster of foothills of the Cloud Peaks in Amn . Description . People often used the term " Hamlar Hills " to refer to any of the foothills of the Cloud Peaks .

title: Hammer
description: Hammer A hammer is an implement ranging in size from tiny jewelery hammers to massive warhammer s . Certain races prefer to wield hammers , especially dwarves who make extensive use of these tools in mining their great caverns . The light hammer may be thrown at a target and is thus considered a ranged weapon as well as a melee weapon .

title: Hammer Hall
description: Hammer Hall Hammer Hall was a log house and stables , surrounded by a wooden palisade . Built by the Men of Hammer Hall , an adventuring group , to explore the nearby Halls of the Hammer , it became a viable place of refuge in the rugged wilderness of the North .

title: Hammer of Moradin
description: Hammer of Moradin Hammer of Moradin were a special prestige class on Faerûn for the dwarven worshipers of Moradin . Hammers of Moradin were members of an order of holy warriors , defending Citadel Adbar against the enemies of dwarves : goblinoid s , giant s and drow . Rather than simply defend the city walls , they left that work to the regular army of the Iron Guard and actively sought their enemies to destroy them and their homes .

title: Hammer of Thunderbolts
description: Hammer of Thunderbolts The Hammer of Thunderbolts is a powerful dwarven warhammer . History . This mighty weapon is said to have been wielded in the " Battle of the Drowning of Lornak " .

title: Hammer of Tyr
description: Hammer of Tyr The Hammer of Tyr is a holy relic of the church of Tyr , god of justice . A powerful weapon against evil and the undead , it can cast extraordinarily powerful " turn undead " and " sunray " spells , as well as " heal " allies . The Hammer can be also be used as a + 5 weapon and when thrown returns to the wielder ' s hand .

title: Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork
description: Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork Hammerhand ' s Wagons and Woodwork was a wainwright and carpentry business owned by Hammerhand Bucko in Shadowdale . History . In 1374 DR , Hammerhand sold and repaired wheeled vehicles .

title: Hammers
description: Hammers The Hammers were the personal guard and advisors of Marchion Elastul Raurym of Mirabar around 1370 DR . Organization . They were four in number and were led by Djaffar .

title: Hammers of Grimjaws
description: Hammers of Grimjaws The Hammers of Grimjaws are the highest ranking and most elite order of paladin s who dedicate their lives and services to Tyr . Membership . Members of the Grimjaws are sponsored by existing members from the ranks of only two orders of Tyr , the Knights of Holy Judgment and the Knights of the Merciful Sword .

title: Hamsetis
description: Hamsetis Hamsetis was the most powerful fighter in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hamsetis was a member of The Fangs of Set .

title: Hamstrung Giant
description: Hamstrung Giant The Hamstrung Giant was an inn and tavern in Eshpurta . It was located in the southern part of the city where many of the artists , musicians , and sculptors lived , but the clientele was an equal mix of artists , soldiers , and merchants . The Hamstrung Giant had a friendly atmosphere and good food and ale , moderately priced .

title: Han language
description: Han language Han was a language spoken by the ancient Han people of Kara - Tur . History . Legend told that after the creation of the land of Kara - Tur , the gods themselves handed down the Han language to the Han people .

title: Han languages
description: Han languages The Han languages were a group of languages spoken in Kara - Tur . It comprised a number of languages descended from the root Han language , including Koryo , Kozakuran , and Wa - an , and possibly others . Kozakuran and Wa - an remained closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language .

title: Han people
description: Han people The Han were an ethnicity of human s who lived in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur in prehistoric times . They were the ancestors of the Koryoan people , and presumably also the Kozakuran and Wanese peoples , owing to a shared linguistic roots . The Han language was the basis for the Koryo , Kozakuran , Wa - an , and other languages , and continued to be used by scholars and philosophers for ages afterward .

title: Hanali Celanil
description: Hanali Celanil Hanali Celanil is the fey aspect of the goddess Sune , serving as the deity of romantic love and beauty within the Seldarine . She lives in the realm of Arvandor . A being of timeless beauty and benign nature , she always forgives minor transgressions and delights in rewarding her followers with the bliss of unexpected love and affection .

title: Hanamoto Genji
description: Hanamoto Genji Hanamoto Genji was an evil shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hanamoto managed the Red Fog cult , a heretical branch of the Konjo school based in Daidake on Tenmei island .

title: Hand crossbow
description: Hand crossbow Drow hand crossbows are feared weapons , they are small enough to fit inside of a pocket . They usually contain a knock - out poison . Drizzt Do ' Urden pretended to have one in his pocket and made a duergar give him information , threatening to shoot him with a hand crossbow .

title: Hand of Bane
description: Hand of Bane The Hand of Bane was an artifact created by the priesthood of Bane to enable Bane to be resurrected , should the need arise . Location . The hand was hidden in the city of Sigil , in a former temple to Bane .

title: Hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory
description: Hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory A hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory was an item with properties similar to a " hand of glory " except it had five silver rings upon it that each produced a different magic al power . Description . Each " hand of Kiaransalee ' s glory " was a mummified drow hand that wore a silver ring on each finger .

title: Hand of Makti
description: Hand of Makti The Hand of Makti was a standing stone found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate in 1367 DR . Geography . This stone was located deep within the Genies ' Anvil of the High Desert .

title: Handaxe
description: Handaxe A handaxe is a light , martial melee weapon of the axe family . Description . The handaxe is similar to a hatchet in size and shape .

title: Handfang
description: Handfang Handfang is a necromancy spell that conjures a mouth in one ' s hand . Effect . You create a fanged , biting mouth in the palm of your hand .

title: Handful of Coins
description: Handful of Coins The Handful of Coins regrouped the Zhentil Keep ' s merchants not affiliated with the Zhentarim . They were an informal mutual assistance group , with the objective of protect their members from abuse by the lords and / or the Zhentarim . They also protect themselves from the magistrate and tried to improve foreign trade in the Keep .

title: Hands of Ihbar
description: Hands of Ihbar Hands of Ihbar , also known , particularly in the past , as chilling tentacles , is a spell used by warlock s , most often those who specialize in pacts with aberration s . When " hands of Ihbar " , which draws on the dark power of the star Ihbar , is cast , its caster summons frigid tentacles to a spot occupied by a creature within fifty feet . These tentacles seem to peel out of the creature themselves , causing them vast amounts of pain and slowing their movement with their chilling power , which reduces the blood flow of any living creature within the spell ' s grasps .

title: Hanging Tree of Ravencourt
description: Hanging Tree of Ravencourt The Hanging Tree of Ravencourt or the Magistree , was a spectral phenomenon that was localized in the area of Ravencourt , Waterdeep . Description . In appearance it resembled a typical Hangman tree , but it would only react to those who were unpunished for capital crimes , known or unknown .

title: Hangman ' s Knoll
description: Hangman ' s Knoll Hangman ' s Knoll is a small rise where the road from Mirrorman ' s Mill connects to the North Ride in Shadowdale . History . Hangman ' s Knoll takes its name from the days of Lord Joadath , who commissioned gallows here to execute " thieves , highwaymen , and petty followers of all gods .

title: Hangman tree
description: Hangman tree The hangman tree is so named for its rope - like appendages . These sinewy vines resemble nooses at their ends and when dropped down appear much as if they were hanging ropes . Hangman trees are deciduous and are found in temperate to subtropical climes .

title: Haniah Dales
description: Haniah Dales Haniah Dales was a half - elf who arrived in the village of Hilltop in the Silver Marches in 1372 DR . When kobold s attacked the village , she was forced to handle the aftermath of the attack because the mayor , Veraunt Shuttlescomb , was beyond drunk .

title: Hank
description: Hank Hank the Double - Bitted was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Hank was the leader of the Champions of Muktar .

title: Hanne Hallen
description: Hanne Hallen Hanne Hallen was a young drow wizard during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Hanne was very close to her mother , Zhora Hallen .

title: Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines
description: Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines The Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines was an apothecary located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Hanno Minstrelsong . History .

title: Hanno Minstrelsong
description: Hanno Minstrelsong Hanno Minstrelsong , not his original name , was a half - elf man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of Hanno ' s Herbs and Medicines tavern . Personality .

title: Hanovar
description: Hanovar Hanovar of Ruathym was a barkeep in Nexal . History . Hanovar was one of the renegades living in the human quarter of Nexal in 1362 DR .

title: Hantanus Tarm
description: Hantanus Tarm Hantarus Tarm was the castellan of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , like all castellans of Goldenfields , Tarm was appointed by the Lords of Waterdeep to lead the defense of the place , despite having no military experience .

title: Hapdash
description: Hapdash Hapdash was a kobold slinger in Undermountain in 1479 DR . Activities . Hapdash was in charge of create the alchemic products for the army of the mad half - elf mercenary Zarr .

title: Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenings
description: Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenings The Happy Hall of Fortuitous Happenstance was a temple to Tymora . Geography . The temple was located on a small hilltop in Yartar , and was built like a huge windowed keep with dark and dreary stone walls .

title: Happy Hippocampus
description: Happy Hippocampus The Happy Hippocampus was an inn and tavern found in the port district of the city of Procampur in the Vast around 1358 DR . It was frequented by adventurers visiting the city . It was a noisy place compared to the Silent Sword , but was good quality with cheap prices .

title: Happy House of Splendor and Song
description: Happy House of Splendor and Song The Happy House of Splendor and Song was a temple to Milil , Lord of Song , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was the biggest temple to Milil on the eastern side of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Location .

title: Happy Hunting Grounds
description: Happy Hunting Grounds The Happy Hunting Grounds , also known as the Beastlands , was the Outer plane representing alignments between neutral good and chaotic good in the Great Wheel cosmology model . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Arvandor and the House of Nature when that cosmology became popular . Arvandor survived the Spellplague while the House of Nature split in at least two parts , one of which became the Deep Wilds and the other merged with the Green Fields as described by the World Axis cosmology model .

title: Harab
description: Harab Harab , also known as the Isle of War , was a large island of the Crowded Sea region south of the Pantheist League . It did not possess any unified government . Trade .

title: Haradan
description: Haradan Haradan the Hermit was a human mage of the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Haradan was a recluse who had remained apart from the world for many years .

title: Harae
description: Harae Harae was a ghost in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Harae was frustrated with the limits of her condition as one of the undead .

title: Haragh Mnistlyn
description: Haragh Mnistlyn Haragh Mnistlyn was an apprentice Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Haragh was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .

title: Harajin
description: Harajin Harajin was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Harajin and seven other fallen angels to remained as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Haramara ' s bow
description: Haramara ' s bow Haramara ' s bow was a non - magical , masterfully crafted bow , originally belonging to Haramara Alenuath but by 1368 DR in the possession of Thalanil Alenuath . It was an item of great significance to House Alenuath . It was said that Haramara slew the red dragon Skarra with a single arrow from the bow .

title: Haramara Alenuath
description: Haramara Alenuath Haramara Alenuath was the founder of the gold elf House Alenuath . Possessions . Haramara was said to have slain the red dragon Skarra with just one arrow from her non - magical bow ( " Haramara ' s bow " ) , which become an item of great significance to the house .

title: Harammamyl H ' tithet
description: Harammamyl H ' tithet Harammamyl H ' tithet was the main drow delegate in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Harammamyl hid well her disgust for other races and even understood that a little false compassion helped in business .

title: Harandil Thundersword
description: Harandil Thundersword Harandil Thundersword was a knight and a member of the Thundersword noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He was softly spoken . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .

title: Harangor Urlingscar
description: Harangor Urlingscar High Crown Harangor Urlingscar was a dragonborn member of Clan Urlingscar and the king of Relmaur as of 1479 DR . Background . Harangor was considered a stern man by most , but he also was a benevolent ruler .

title: Harauna Beltzund
description: Harauna Beltzund Harauna Beltzund was the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Harauna was of short stature and her features suggested she may have had some dwarven blood in her ancestry .

title: Harazos Thelbrimm
description: Harazos Thelbrimm Gauntlet Harazos Thelbrimm was the leader of the Loudwater town guard . History . Harazos Thelbrimm and Kalahar Twohands were the leaders of the Loudwater Guard .

title: Harbinger
description: Harbinger The Harbinger was a colossal wight in the service of Valindra Shadowmantle in 1484 DR . The Harbinger guided a host of undead in trying to break the wall of Neverwinter , but was defeated by an adventurer newly arrived in the city . Appendix .

title: Harbor District
description: Harbor District The Harbor District was an unofficial designation for a region of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Harbor District included the Trade Harbor and Caliph ' s Harbor , and the surrounding buildings located outside the walls of Huzuz along the south bank of Al - Sarif River north of the city .

title: Harbor master
description: Harbor master This human was the harbor master of the village of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The harbor master tried to convince a ship captain to remain in the village , but failed , and the ship sailed off .

title: Harbor moon
description: Harbor moon A harbor moon was a Waterdhavian coin worth fifty gold pieces inside the city , but only thirty gold pieces elsewhere . Description . The coin was shaped like a crescent moon and made of platinum with an electrum inlay .

title: Harbromm
description: Harbromm King Harbromm was the ruler of Citadel Adbar and was a member of the Council of 12 Peers < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > during the formative stages of the Silver Marches and was currently a Peer on the League of the Silver Marches ' council . Relationships . He had two sons , Bromm and Harnoth , twins born in the wake of the Thunder Blessing .

title: Harburk Tuthmarillar
description: Harburk Tuthmarillar Harburk Tuthmarillar was the constable of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis on 1491 DR . Activities . Harburk directed his duties from a shop in the village , where he lived together with the town ' s butcher Jalessa Ornra .

title: Hard - Tack
description: Hard - Tack Hard - Tack was a dry unseasoned water - and - flour biscuit . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Hardbuckler
description: Hardbuckler Hardbuckler was a small town of gnome s on the Dusk Road , south of Northdark Wood and the Trielta Hills , and just north of the Reaching Woods . Economy . It was a favorite location for traders along the Dusk Road owing the gnomes ' industriousness .

title: Hardcastle ( city )
description: Hardcastle ( city ) Hardcastle was a small city strategically built at the crossroads of three major caravan routes . Geography . Little more then a fortified trading camp , Hardcastle sat on the roads between the Great Rift , Unther , and the Vilhon Reach .

title: Hardstones
description: Hardstones Hardstone was a general term for natural substances that can usually be found in large quantities and are valued for their appearance and usefulness in artistic carvings , metallurgy , jewelry , and architecture . The prices listed were for one pound ( a little under a half kilogram ) of the material . Notable hardstones .

title: Harem Palace
description: Harem Palace The Harem Palace of Calim in the city of Teshyll was a massive palace of the djinn i Calim said to have housed nearly 2 , 000 human and jann slaves and concubines at the height of the Calim Empire . It was known for its extraordinary architecture . After Teshyll ' s destruction in the Era of Skyfire , the " Jhasinnadah " became home to an assortment of bandits and monsters over the centuries .

title: Haresk Malorn
description: Haresk Malorn Haresk Malorn is the current High Councilor and Mistran of the council that rules over Mistledale . He also commands the Riders , Mistledale ' s mounted defenders . Despite this , Haresk is known as more of a wise and compassionate merchant rather than a true warrior .

title: Harginn
description: Harginn Harginns , or flame horrors , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . All harginns could assume several different forms including a regular bonfire , a pillar of flame , or a bronze d humanoid .

title: Harglast
description: Harglast Harglast was a spartan stone city and one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Government . Harglast was ruled by a Lord Merchant .

title: Hargleth Forest
description: Hargleth Forest The Hargleth Forest was a large forest located in eastern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . This forest was dotted with countless ancient ruins that dated back to the time when Eskorn was ruled by dragon s .

title: Hargrid Tenslayer
description: Hargrid Tenslayer Hargrid Tenslayer was the Tharchion of Laprendar in Thay in 1357 DR . History . Hargrid was a merchant from Phsant in Thesk but after killing the child of the local ruler he fled to Thay .

title: Hariah Highkin
description: Hariah Highkin Hariah Highkin was a ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . After previous turmoil , Doegan fell into the safe and steady hands of Hariah Highkin . The capital prospered , the borders held firm , and people were happy .

title: Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul
description: Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul Harijo Ten Rasid Nahdatul was the military commander of the kingdom of Bawa in 1357 DR . History . In his youth , Harijo was a valiant adventurer , defeating many monsters .

title: Harim Gate
description: Harim Gate The Harim Gate was supposedly the only entrance into the Royal Harim within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This gate was constantly guarded by a contingent of the Honored Mamluk Society .

title: Harim servant genie
description: Harim servant genie Harim servant genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who guarded harims and entertained the brides and concubines of elite citizenry . These genie s preferred to work for mortals , where they could feel superior and important , but they also worked for other genies performing more menial tasks . Harim servant genies originated as servants of the jann , working in their harims for so long that they lost the drive to perform any other functions .

title: Harimmon
description: Harimmon Harimmon was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Description . Harimmon was built around an old , semi - ruined castle .

title: Harjad
description: Harjad Harjad was an half - elven " saka " , or water - bearer , inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Harjad was a crafty and clever matrud .

title: Hark
description: Hark Hark was the leader of a group of goblin s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hark and his fellow goblins lived in the Ardeep Forest .

title: Hark ' s Finger
description: Hark ' s Finger Hark ' s Finger , or Mount Jiksidur to the Nar , was the most prominent landmark found in the flatlands of central Narfell . Description . The peak jutted from the surrounding flat landscape , serving as a useful beacon to anyone traveling within eyesight .

title: Harkas Kormallis
description: Harkas Kormallis Harkas Kormallis was the senior paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Harkas was a zealot , interested only in the glory of Tyr and caring nothing about his duties as a member of the Kormallis family .

title: Harkle Harpell
description: Harkle Harpell Harkle Harpell was a wizard who belonged to the Harpell family and lived in the small town of Longsaddle . Description . He was a little shorter than average , with long , brown hair that stuck out from his head at odd angles .

title: Harkon Lukas
description: Harkon Lukas Harkon Lukas was the wolfwere Darklord of Kartakass in the Demiplane of Dread who formerly lived in Cormyr . Description . As a shapechanger , Harkon assumed a variety of forms .

title: Harl
description: Harl Harl was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , after the Night of Wailing , he was one of the chieftains gathered by Luskag to discuss the matter of the goblinoid armies from Nexal .

title: Harlakh Doroaver
description: Harlakh Doroaver Harlakh Doroaver was a venerated mercenary and " ruler " of the region known as the Realm of the Ready Sword . Personality . Never one to be caught off his guard , Harlakh was always planning in terms of battle .

title: Harlesk Knowin
description: Harlesk Knowin Harlesk Knowin was the Silhouette of Assassins in the Caravan Sect of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Abilities . Harlesk was a master of disguise .

title: Harlotharaur
description: Harlotharaur Harlotharaur was a black dragon wyrm in Amn . History . Once Harlotharaur waged a campaign of destruction against humanity so Elminster defeated and bound Harlotharaur to a deep mountain cavern on the northern edge of Amn .

title: Harlshoon
description: Harlshoon Lord Harlshoon was a warrior and former commander of Zhentil troops who ascended to become the first Lord of Zhentil Keep . Relatives . Harlshoon had two sons : Asmuth and Manshoon .

title: Harm
description: Harm Harm was a necromancy spell that delivered a charge of negative energy , bringing a creature to near unconsciousness and death . Some versions also inflicted a disease on the victim . The reverse of this spell , heal , cured most ailments and greatly restored lost health .

title: Harmun Rapids
description: Harmun Rapids The Harmun Rapids was a section of rapids on the River Rauvin just south of Sundabar . Geography . The Harmun Rapids was located just downriver ( south ) out of sight of Sundabar , just before the River Icespear joined with the River Rauvin .

title: Harndarr Oryn
description: Harndarr Oryn Harndarr Oryn was the High Mornmaster of the temple of Lathander ' s Light . Description . Harndarr had a short and stocky build such that some believed he might have dwarven blood in his veins .

title: Harnoth
description: Harnoth Harnoth was , together with his twin brother Bromm , one of the Twin Kings of Citadel Adbar in the Silver Marches in 1484 DR . He was son of the famous Harbromm . History .

title: Harnrim Starangh
description: Harnrim Starangh Harnrim Starangh was a Red Wizard of Thay usually disguised as a mercenary wizard of Westgate . He manipulated the Rightful Conspiracy of treacherous Cormyr ean nobles with the secret objective of stealing the new spell that Vangerdahast Aeiulvana was creating . In the end , when the Rightful Conspiracy launched its revolt , Harnrim led a small army of fellow Red Wizards to attack Vangerdahast ' s secret hideout .

title: Haroistem
description: Haroistem Haroistem was a scholarly priest of Lathander . Description . Bespectacled and clad in blue robes , Haroistem sported a thin mane of white hair .

title: Harone Thar
description: Harone Thar Harone Thar was a dragonborn settlement in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Harone Thar was one of the two " mobile " settlements the Relmorn dragonborn always maintained near the city of Rokthorl .

title: Haronstin Garulth
description: Haronstin Garulth Haronstin " Leatherjaws " Garulth was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Close One that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Personality . Haronstin was calm , casual , and carefree .

title: Harooga
description: Harooga Harooga was the greater spirit of Akari . History . Harooga was the greater spirit of the island of Akari and the most powerful spirit of all the Prioto islands .

title: Haroun Abd al - Jari
description: Haroun Abd al - Jari Haroun Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Haroun rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan .

title: Haroun ibn Abbak
description: Haroun ibn Abbak Haroun ibn Abbak served as Grand Admiral of Huzuz ' s navy in 1367 DR . Personality . Haroun was flamboyant and extremely well - liked by his crews .

title: Harp
description: Harp Harps could be found in several varieties across the Realms . Description . Impiltur was known for making high quality wood harps , and Selgaunt produced silver - made harps .

title: Harpell
description: Harpell The Harpell family was an eccentric clan of wizard s who , for the most part , lived in the Ivy Mansion in Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier of northwest Faerûn . Despite their eccentricity and their strange experiments , they were well known for collectively having a vast knowledge of the history and geography of the North . Organization .

title: Harper agent
description: Harper agent A Harper agent ( also known as a Harper scout ) is a member of the semi - secret organization known as the Harpers , and members are scattered all across Faerûn . These individuals are dedicated to battling evil , discovering and preserving forgotten lore , and maintaining the balance between nature and civilization . Harper agents are the " field agents " of the Harper organization , acting directly to gather intelligence and eliminate threats to the greater good .

title: Harper pin ( greater )
description: Harper pin ( greater ) The greater Harper pin was a heavily enchanted version of the " lesser Harper pin " . The upgrade usually happened after an agent had been in the ranks for a few months or after an especially significant mission . Powers .

title: Harper pin ( lesser )
description: Harper pin ( lesser ) Lesser Harper pins were silver brooches that were given to new members of the Harpers . They granted the same abilities as a " ring of mind shielding " . The market price for a lesser pin was 8 , 000 gp .

title: Harper schism
description: Harper schism The Harper schism is an event that occurred in 1370 DR in which the Harpers uncovered apparent dealings between the Zhentarim and one of their highest members , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . This accusation caused a political division to form within the Harpers and heightened paranoia and mistrust , forcing many of its members to choose their loyalties . Council meeting .

title: Harper token
description: Harper token A Harper token is a small brooch , ring , belt buckle or other such item that is typically made of silver or , less frequently , gold . It is often embossed with the symbol of the Harpers , or more simply the image of a tree or musical note . Regardless of it ' s form , Harper tokens are used to identify members of " Those who Harp " .

title: Harpers
description: Harpers The Harpers were a semi - secret organization dedicated to promoting good , preserving history ( including art and music of old ) and maintaining a balance between civilization and nature by keeping kingdoms small and the destruction of plant life to a minimum . They considered the elven empire of Myth Drannor shortly before its fall to be the pinnacle of civilized history and strove to recreate the world in that image . Those Who Harp were led by a council of seven High Harpers , who were responsible for most of the group ' s long - term plans and goals .

title: Harpers ' Hill
description: Harpers ' Hill Harpers ' Hill was a large , bare hill just east of the village of Shadowdale . History . Throughout history , the hill was used as a meeting place for Harpers and elves from the Elven Court .

title: Harpsichord
description: Harpsichord A harpsichord was a large keyboard instrument . Description . Harpsichords were popular in manors and castles alike .

title: Harpy
description: Harpy A harpy was a malign humanoid creature with an avian lower body and a pair of wings . It subdued its prey with its ability to magically sing , inducing a trance in those that heard , drawing them closer , and then tormenting them . Description .

title: Harrak
description: Harrak Harrak was an adventurer in the ruin of Spellgard . Personality . Farrak and Harrak did everything together .

title: Harrandave Donohar
description: Harrandave Donohar Harrandave Donohar ( or Harandave Donohar ) was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a priest of Chauntea . By 1358 DR , Harandave was the high priest of the Harvest Hall temple in Wheloon , and he still held the position in 1369 DR .

title: Harried in Hillsfar
description: Harried in Hillsfar Harried in Hillsfar , designed by Shawn Merwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on Hillsfar , the village of Elventree s , and the Cormanthor forest . Summary .

title: Harrow Ride
description: Harrow Ride Harrow Ride was the name given to two separate roads leading through Harrowdale , in the Dalelands , one on either side of the dried river bed . At the south east end of the route lay New Velar , and the north west part of the route went through Velarsburg before becoming the Halfaxe Trail at Velartree .

title: Harrowdale
description: Harrowdale Harrowdale ( formerly Velarsdale and Halvan ' s Dale ) was the oldest of the surviving Dalelands . It mainly consisted of human inhabitants , as well as some elven and half - elven people . Its main town was also known as Harrowdale .

title: Harshnag
description: Harshnag Harshnag the Grim was a frost giant and member of the Gray Hands . Waterdhavians tended to use Harshnag as an indicator that that their neighborhood was about to become a war zone , and to get out of the area as fast as possible . He was also a key player in the conflict between the storm giant Hekaton and the blue dragon Iymrith .

title: Harthos Zymorven
description: Harthos Zymorven Harthos Zymorven was the commander of Zymorven Hall in Rauvin Vale . Activities . Harthos was the lord of the Zymorven family of Silverymoon .

title: Hartkiller
description: Hartkiller Hartkiller was the last son of Annam All - Father and Othea . History . His mother deliberately delayed his birth because she had made a deal with Annam that he could only return once his son called his name , but she was then poisoned by another of her sons , Lanaxis , and died .

title: Hartsvale
description: Hartsvale Hartsvale was a small human kingdom lying in the Ice Spires in north Faerûn . Geography . The realm lay in a remote valley in the Ice Spires , a range of ever - frozen peaks lying north of the Ice Mountains , west of the High Ice of Anauroch , and south of the Endless Ice Sea .

title: Hartusk
description: Hartusk Hartusk was an orc warlord in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . Hartusk was always a warmonger among the Many - Arrows orcs so it was easy for the drow under Tiago Baenre to manipulate him into ousting the moderate Obould dynasty and started a new war against the Silver Marches .

title: Hartwick
description: Hartwick Hartwick was a small town on the west bank of the Clear Whirl River in Hartsvale . Description . The town was populated by craftsmen , fishermen , and gatherers , as well as by rich traders and merchants , who lived in large manor houses .

title: Harug Shieldsunder
description: Harug Shieldsunder Harug Shieldsunder was a dwarf and member of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild of Waterdeep . Personality . Harug was called " most cantankerous dwarf in the city , " but was considered one of the guild ' s best tunnel workers .

title: Harun al - Rashid
description: Harun al - Rashid Harun al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Harun and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham .

title: Harvas Peltsen
description: Harvas Peltsen Harvas Peltsen was one of the leader of Teziir in 1359 DR . History . Harvas was one of te founders of Teziir and sit on the Teziir City Council .

title: Harvest Hall
description: Harvest Hall The Harvest Hall was a temple of Chauntea in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Description . The Harvest Hall was the largest temple in Wheloon , but a modest one .

title: Harvest Inn
description: Harvest Inn The Harvest Inn was located in Westbridge . Geography . The inn was the favorite gathering spot for travelers on the Long Road , which traveled between the northern cities of Waterdeep and Mirabar .

title: Harvest of Horrors
description: Harvest of Horrors The Harvest of Horrors was a conflict fought in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , waged between the Kingdom of Nix and the folk of Vanesci Hamlet . Notably , it was fought with basal golem s mass - produced by bloodforge s . Location .

title: Harvester
description: Harvester The Harvester , or He Who Harvests for Hunger , was a sinister yak - man who lived beneath Huzuz in the Lair of the Unspeakable in 1367 DR . Activities . The Harvester hunted human prey on the streets of Golden Huzuz .
