title: Harvester of Blood
description: Harvester of Blood Harvester of Blood was Sunbright Steelshanks ' longsword . Description . The sword had a blade the length of a human arm and ended with a sharp hook .

title: Hasan
description: Hasan Hasan was a Grandfather of the Everlasting in Zakhara . History . After the destruction of their base by mamluk s from Qudra , Hasan discovered the existence of the fortress of Sarahin from one of his loyal followers .

title: Hasan ibn al - Din
description: Hasan ibn al - Din Hasan ibn al - Din was a human corsair living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Hasan was a young and inexperienced rubban whom Fate deemed worthy of elevating .

title: Hasheth Balik
description: Hasheth Balik Hasheth Balik was a rising noble and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Hasheth was a minor son of the late Pasha Balik of Zazesspur born in 1349 DR .

title: Hasicor Danali
description: Hasicor Danali Hasicor Danali was a male human cleric of Oghma who ran the Leaves of Learning in Highmoon . Description . Balding , tall , and given to a rather severe appearance , Hasicor Danali rarely appeared outside the Leaves of Learning ; his black " robe of many sigils " woven with mithral threads in the shape of many runes was ever - flapping in the wind .

title: Hasoctl
description: Hasoctl Hasoctl was a human fighter in Maztica . History . Hasoctl gained everything in life thanks to his connection with his great - uncle , the Revered Counselor Caxal .

title: Hasos Thora
description: Hasos Thora Hasos Thora was the Baron of Soolabax in 1479 DR . Description . Hasos was tall , muscular and long - nosed .

title: Hassan
description: Hassan Hassan was a powerful efreeti who patrolled the halls of the Royal Harim of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Possessions . Hassan wielded a massive fiery scimitar .

title: Hastammer Orlim
description: Hastammer Orlim Hastammer Orlim was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . He had a carefully cultivated reputation of being so powerful that he conversed with deities and gave them advice . Personality .

title: Haste
description: Haste Haste was a spell that caused the affected target ( s ) to move and act more quickly than normal . Effects . A creature under the effects of a " haste " spell could make quicker attacks and dodge attacks with their enhanced speed .

title: Hastor el Khafar
description: Hastor el Khafar Shieldlord Hastor el Khafar ran a fighting school at one of the shrines to Tempus in Memnon . In 1370 DR , Hastor took on a sea elf student named Vyaalis , whom he trained in secret , teaching him how to fight on land in exchange for the latter teaching him how to fight below the waves .

title: Hat of difference
description: Hat of difference When worn , the wearer is able to assume the role of a first level character of any profession different from that he or she actually follows . Experience gained in this new role is cumulative as long as the owner retains possession of the hat .

title: Hatch ' net
description: Hatch ' net Hatch ' net was the master of Lore and a trainer at the Academy within the hall of instruction at the Melee Magthere in Menzoberranzan . Personality . All drow warrior s had to go through fifty days learning the heritage of the drow culture , and Hatch taught hate and distrust , helping to create some of the Underdark ' s most vicious killers .

title: Hathor
description: Hathor Hathor ( pronounced " haa " - thor ) was a kind and compassionate member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known by the name Hatharia in Thay and that of Hathelya in Unther , she was seen as a caring mother figure to those that followed her . Relationships .

title: Hathran
description: Hathran Hathran is a special prestige class of Rashemen . Members of the Wychlaran , also called the Witches of Rashemen , hathrans are an elite class of female spellcasters who rule over Rashemen and protect their people against the invasions of greedy wizards of Thay . They develop a bond with their land that gives them exceptional power , as long as they don ' t leave their homeland .

title: Hatim
description: Hatim Hatim the Righteous was a paladin inhabiting Phannaskul during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Hatim ' s outspoken rants against the corruption of Phannaskul ' s nobles gained momentum with the commoners of the city .

title: Hatim Sumika
description: Hatim Sumika Hatim Sumika was a gnome scribe who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Hatim stood 2 and a half feet tall .

title: Hatim al - Rakal
description: Hatim al - Rakal Hatim al - Rakal was an inhabitant of the Elemental Plane of Water in 1367 DR . Activities . As a skilled sea mage , Hatim used his powers to take control of the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls whenever the Great Padishate of the Marid abandoned it in favor of other activities .

title: Hatred domain
description: Hatred domain The Hatred domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters hatred spell powers . They gain a brief boost to their combat skills versus a single foe . Hatred Domain Spells .

title: Haundrae Duir
description: Haundrae Duir Haundrae Duir was part - owner , cook , brewer , and host at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . A former warrior , tall and strong , but some of his muscle had turned to fat .

title: Haunted Halls
description: Haunted Halls The Haunted Halls is a legendary dungeon located in Starwater Gorge , north of the Cormyrean town of Eveningstar . The entrance to the Halls is located on the east side of the gorge . History .

title: Haunted Lands
description: Haunted Lands The Haunted Lands were the eastern and greater of the two large deserts that dominated the elevated interior of Zakhara . History . After a distant history of opposing kingdoms , the Haunted Lands were only thinly populated by several enlightened tribes of nomadic herders ( called Al - Badia in Midani ) and a number of small groups of savage nomads with more sinister trades .

title: Havarlan
description: Havarlan Havarlan was a silver dragon who devoted herself to Xymor and led the Talons of Justice as its " Barb " . History . In 1373 DR , she send two of her Talons , Azhaq and Moonwing to capture the song dragon Karasendrieth under orders of the King of Justice Lareth for defiance of council ' s decisions about the abnormal Rage of Dragons of that year .

title: Havell
description: Havell Havell was a merchant in Shussel in 1357 DR . History . Havell was unveiled as a fraud by a foreign merchant ( probably from Durpar ) .

title: Havilar
description: Havilar Havilar was a tiefling fighter who grew up in the small village of Arush Vayem on the frontier of Tymanther . As an infant , Havilar and her twin sister Farideh were left in a basket at the village gate and were adopted by a clanless dragonborn warrior named Mehen . In 1477 DR Havilar was in a barn attempting to summon an imp when she accidentally summoned a cambion from Malbolge named Lorcan .

title: Hawa
description: Hawa Hawa , also known as City of Chaos and the City of Stilts , was the only important settlement within the Genie ' s Turban in the Corsair Domains . History . Circa 1357 DR a fleet of the mamluk s of Qudra tries to take control of the city .

title: Hawk
description: Hawk A hawk was a bird with excellent vision and a long tail . Ecology . Hawks were predatory birds that were native to the natural world .

title: Hawk ' s Isle
description: Hawk ' s Isle Hawk ' s Isle is a forest - covered island in the Pirate Isles . Its inhabitants are horribly deformed after a plague struck the island at some point in the past . The island has the remains of more than twelve harbours , but the inhabitants only have the ability to use canoes .

title: Hawk ' s Nest
description: Hawk ' s Nest Hawk ' s Nest was a small watchtower near the top of the Silverymoon Pass . Geography . Travelers on the road from Silverymoon to Sundabar were often pressed hard to reach the shelter of the watchtower before nightfall .

title: Hawklin
description: Hawklin Hawklin was a noble house of Cormyr active in the 14th and 15th centuries DR . History . Generations of Hawklins served in the Purple Dragons or adventured in service to the Crown of Cormyr .

title: Hawksroost
description: Hawksroost Hawksroost was a village that lay south of Ilinvur in the Ride in north Faerûn . It was once the home of Daern , a warrior who fought alongside the Ilmatari priest Flaergon of Glister and figured highly in the tale of the " Tome of Torment " . After 1299 DR , Hawkroost was destroyed in a series of ogre attacks .

title: Hawkwing ' s Brook
description: Hawkwing ' s Brook Hawkwing ' s Brook was a tributary of the Sulduskoon River in Tethyr . Geography . The brook began in the Starspire Mountains and flowed down through County Uluran to join the great Sulduskoon .

title: Hawthidon Faalwun
description: Hawthidon Faalwun Hawthidon Faalwun was a private in Dagult Neverember ' s army in Neverwinter . History . Hawthidon fought the undead minions of Valindra Shadowmantle ; for this task he recruited an adventurer new to the city .

title: Hayfa al - Simbaya
description: Hayfa al - Simbaya Hayfa al - Simbaya was a the Sultana of Simbaya in north Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Hayfa was a beautiful woman who possessed long black hair .

title: Haz
description: Haz Haz was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla , Amn . He was involved in the covert war between the thieves and Bodhi ' s vampires . Appendix .

title: Hazamarch
description: Hazamarch Hazamarch was one of the Golden Marches of Tethyr . It was an agriculturally focused county and struggled with competing monster populations . Description .

title: Hazamir al Aktorral
description: Hazamir al Aktorral Hazamir al Aktorral ( also spelled al - Aktorral and el Aktorral ) was a wizard and the Caleph of Calimshan during the Shoon Imperium . Unexpectedly , he became " riqysar " ( regent ) of the empire after Shoon II died in 107 DR , charged with taking care of the realm until Shoon III came of age . Personality .

title: Hazaufein Oblodra
description: Hazaufein Oblodra Hazaufein Oblodra was the House Wizard of House Oblodra and Elderboy of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Hazaufein was often mocked by his brother Drizfryn Oblodra , who said that his ability to craft was the result of being part - dwarf , but Hazaufein always accepted these jests with a wan smile .

title: Hazirawn
description: Hazirawn Hazirawn was an enchanted and sentient greatsword of Netherese manufacture . It was infamously wielded by the wyrmspeaker , Rezmir , during the the Tyranny of Dragons . Description .

title: Hazlik
description: Hazlik Hazlik was a Red Wizard who formerly lived in Thay and later became the Lord of Hazlan in the Demiplane of Dread . History . Hazlik was a rising Red Wizard of Thay of the Evocation school .

title: Hazuth
description: Hazuth Hazuth was a city located in eastern Dambrath . Geography . Located north of Melanith Bay where the River Ammath terminated , Hazuth served as a convenient place for depositing bluewood harvested from inland forests .

title: Hcarla Bellwind
description: Hcarla Bellwind Hcarla Bellwind was a Zhentarim wizard of power in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Hcarla was a member of the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .

title: Hea - Rem
description: Hea - Rem Hea - Rem was the chieftain of the White Worm barbarian tribe in Vaasa in north Faerûn around 1359 DR . Hea - Rem was a big and tough veteran warrior of 50 years old at the time . The chieftain was oft - accompanied by a five - strong bodyguard called the " Kura - winther " , meaning " Worm - Victors " , the elite warriors of the tribe .

title: Head Taker
description: Head Taker The Head Taker was a particularly deadly tasked slayer genie inhabiting the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in 1367 DR . Description . Foes who proved to be worthy adversaries were rewarded by becoming trophies of the Head Taker .

title: Headband of the Binder
description: Headband of the Binder A headband of the Binder was a magic item created by bards of Oghma , the Binder of What is Known . It could also be known as a headband of the lorebinder . Description .

title: Heafstaag
description: Heafstaag Heafstaag was the hereditary king of the Tribe of the Elk of Icewind Dale . His standard bearer was Wulfgar . Description .

title: Heal
description: Heal Heal was a conjuration , evocation , or necromancy spell that cured many ailments and restored health . The reverse of this spell , harm , could drain health away , bringing a creature to near unconsciousness and death . Effects .

title: Healing candle
description: Healing candle A healing candle was a special magic item made my mystic s in the Realms . It healed the wounds of one individual . The longer the candle was allowed to burn , the more healing it could provide .

title: Healing hand
description: Healing hand Healing hand was a divine necromancy spell that boosted the healing provided by a previously cast healing spell . Effect . The " healing hand " spell supplied additional healing to a creature that had already been healed within the previous 24 hours .

title: Healing sphere
description: Healing sphere The Healing sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , crusader s , and druid s without limitations , and to monk s and shaman s with minor access only . Spells in this sphere could cure or cause damage to health , but not bring beings back to life . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Healing word
description: Healing word Healing word was a healing spell or prayer cast by bard s , cleric s , and druid s . Among the most basic forms of magic al healing , " healing word " uses some of one creature ' s life force to heal said creature a small amount . This creature must be within a nearby area of twenty - five feet in diameter or the caster themselves .

title: Heart of All Mountains
description: Heart of All Mountains The Heart of All Mountains comprised the bulk of the armed forces of the dao within the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . Nine thousand dao heavy infantry made up the Heart of All Mountains .

title: Heart of Wine
description: Heart of Wine Heart of Wine was a special alcoholic beverage found in Zakhara . It was made by aging wine in the desert heat or mountain snows until all of the water evaporated or froze , leaving behind a potent substance . As with all alcoholic drinks , Heart of Wine was forbidden in any area controlled by moralist s .

title: Heart of ice
description: Heart of ice Heart of ice was a divine magic spell available to cleric s and crusader s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It caused massive internal damage to the creature touched , often fatally shattering the heart . Effects .

title: Heart of the Eagle
description: Heart of the Eagle The Heart of the Eagle was located within the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Carved from the rock of the ridge upon which Sarahin stood , the Heart of the Eagle was a tight chamber decorated with several tapestries .

title: Heart of the Lion
description: Heart of the Lion The Heart of the Lion was a holy relic that could be found in the fortress of Sarahin in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The Heart of the Lion was actually a carnelian of bright red coloration .

title: Heartblood River
description: Heartblood River The Heartblood River was a tributary of the Delimbiyr in the Savage Frontier . It found its source on the north face of the Star Mounts and wound its way east and south through the Dire Wood . There it gained its name from the red tinge its waters took on as they passed the ruined city of Karse .

title: Heartstone Gem
description: Heartstone Gem The Heartstone Gem was a powerful artifact kept in the village of Kuldahar . Description . The Heartstone Gem was a red stone , appearing like a gemstone .

title: Heartwarder
description: Heartwarder Heartwarders are devoted spellcasters devoted to the worship of the god dess Sune . Heartwarders follow the teachings of their patron goddess and seek to encourage love and enjoyment of all things in life . Heartwarders often serve wealthy patrons and in turn are served by others to help bring together men and women seeking love and intimacy , as well as to bring pure pleasure through art , music , and other enjoyable pursuits .

title: Heat leech
description: Heat leech Heat leech was a necromantic divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It drained vitality from all creatures in a small area and transferred that vitality to the caster , even to the point of gaining temporary health beyond normal limits . Effects .

title: Heat metal
description: Heat metal Heat metal is a transmutation spell that heats metal to damage those who touch it . Effect . This spell is identical to " chill metal " except that it makes metal warm , hot , and searing instead of cold , icy , and freezing .

title: Heat mirage
description: Heat mirage Heat mirage was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell enhanced the desert ' s natural abilities to create mirages .

title: Heatwave
description: Heatwave Heatwave was a flame spell that combined the schools of alteration and evocation . It was used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects .

title: Heaven ' s trumpet
description: Heaven ' s trumpet Heaven ' s trumpet is an evocation spell that sounds a blast of music to paralyze foes . Only casters with the archon subtype can use this spell . Effect .

title: Heavenly lightning
description: Heavenly lightning Heavenly lightning is an evocation spell that electrocutes targets with divine lightning . Effect . You create a leaping bolt of radiant lightning that arcs from one target to the next , avoiding other creatures in its path .

title: Heavy aspergillum
description: Heavy aspergillum A heavy aspergillum was a weapon that combined the features of an aspergillum and a heavy mace . It was only used by the Ilmaterans of the kingdom of Impiltur . Description .

title: Heavy flail
description: Heavy flail A heavy flail is a two - handed , martial melee weapon , a larger version of the flail . Description . A heavy flail is a flail with a longer haft ( about four feet or 1 .

title: Heavy mace
description: Heavy mace A heavy mace is a simple , one - handed melee weapon , much like a club made from metal . Description . The heavy mace is the larger brother of the light mace .

title: Heavy pick
description: Heavy pick A heavy pick is a one - handed , martial melee weapon . Description . The heavy pick is similar to a miner ' s pick but specifically designed for war .

title: Hebopbe
description: Hebopbe Hebopbe was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Hebopbe had no interest in the feud between sovereigns Basidia and Phylo .

title: Hector
description: Hector Hector was an oni night hunter in the ruin of Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Thanks to a partial array of alabaster pillar s , Thoran managed to summon and bind an oni , who often disguised himself as a human prisoner called Hector .

title: Hedrun Arnsfirth
description: Hedrun Arnsfirth Hedrun Arnsfirth was the Chosen of Auril in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . History . Hedrun was born into the Tribe of the Elk as the daughter of Soren Arnsfirth .

title: Hedweck
description: Hedweck Hedweck was a male human barbarian of the White Worm tribe in Vaasa in north Faerûn in the mid – 14th century DR . He was the tribe ' s spirit hunter around 1359 DR . History .

title: Heidar Qan
description: Heidar Qan Heidar Qan was an Amir of the Jann of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Heidar Qan was credited with constructing the great fortress of Sarahin within the Haunted Lands .

title: Hekaton
description: Hekaton Hekaton was the storm giant king until sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hekaton ruled the storm giants but asserted his authority over all races of giants .

title: Heladar Longspear
description: Heladar Longspear Heladar Longspear was a male warrior member of the Zhentilar in High Dale . History . Heladar fought for Zhentil Keep in Daggerdale and in the conquest of the Citadel of the Raven .

title: Helbareim Alanasker
description: Helbareim Alanasker Helbareim Alanasker was in 1373 DR the king of Ormpur , the Lapaliiyan town holy to Tiamat . He came to power by overthrowing Queen Maerildarraine who , in 1306 DR , had rebelled against Tiamat and killed her father . Helbareim defeated the heretic queen with the help of the church of Tiamat but at the price of falling under the power of the Overking of Lapaliiya .

title: Helda Silverstream
description: Helda Silverstream Helda Silverstream was a dwarf just returned to Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Helda was born in Kelvin ' s Cairn in the union of Clan Silverstream and Clan Battlehammer and was the niece of Stokely Silverstream .

title: Heldapan
description: Heldapan Heldapan was the capital of Durpar located toward the center of the country . Description . Heldapan was situated on the eastern coast of the River Heldar near the Golden Water .

title: Heldatha Dhussta
description: Heldatha Dhussta Heldatha Dhussta was a female human and a Painbearer of Ilmater . She was the Revered Mother of the House at the Towers of Willful Suffering in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard

title: Helder Mornstone
description: Helder Mornstone Helder Mornstone was the commander of Xantharl ' s Keep in 1370 DR . Activities . Helder was the leader of the garrison of Xantharl ' s Keep .

title: Heldorm
description: Heldorm Heldorm was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Heldorm was an unbalanced individual .

title: Heldorn Thaerntyl
description: Heldorn Thaerntyl Heldorn " Goldsun " Thaerntyl was a human fighter , wizard , thief and a member of the Council of Sparkling Stones in Mirabar . Description . The adventurer gained his nickname because he had long curly blond hair , and he used two sun blade s in combat .

title: Helgabal
description: Helgabal Helgabal , formerly known as Heliogabalus , was the largest city in Damara , and was once the seat of government until King Gareth moved the capital to Bloodstone Village . Government . 14th Century DR .

title: Helgar Hoaraxe
description: Helgar Hoaraxe Helgar Hoaraxe was the head carpenter in Skullport . Once a sailor , Helgar settled in Skullport around 1340 DR , starting a new career in repairing and refitting damaged ships that arrived in the port . In times of slow work , he and his squad could be hired by captains as on - board carpenters or sailmasters .

title: Helgre
description: Helgre Helgre served as the first mate on the " Orcsblood " , a pirate ship that terrorized the Moonsea in the mid – 15th century DR . She managed to escape when the " Orcsblood " was attacked and destroyed by deva s in 1460 DR . Helgre correctly reasoned that two shipmates , Gareth Jadaren and Ivor Beguine , who had recently jumped ship , were the ones responsible for betraying the " Orcsblood " ' s location to the devas .

title: Heliodor
description: Heliodor Heliodor was a variety of and considered a precious stone for jewelry and ornamentation . It has some magical uses as well . Description .

title: Heliopolis
description: Heliopolis Heliopolis was a plane where the deities of the Mulhorandi pantheon resided . Great Wheel cosmology . In the Great Wheel cosmology , Heliopolis was more specifically the name of a joint realm of three Mulhorandi deities in Arcadia ' s second layer of Buxenus .

title: Helisa Ithcanter
description: Helisa Ithcanter Helisa Ithcanter was a cleric of Azuth in Westbridge in 1370 DR . Activities . Helisa can ' t stay still , she always need did something .

title: Hell hound
description: Hell hound A hell hound was a big , powerfully built dog with short , rust - red fur ; its markings , teeth , and tongue were sooty black . Description . Hell hounds were the dogs of the Nine Hells .

title: Hellborn shadow
description: Hellborn shadow A hellborn shadow is a tiefling ranger who has learned to tap into his or her fiend ish heritage as a way to enhance their natural abilities . Instead of turning away from their ancestry , hellborn shadows embrace it , for good or evil , and use it to battle the supernatural threats they face , becoming dark and often feared monster slayers . The brings hellborn shadows dangerously close to the evil taint that haunts them , sometimes blurring the line between good and evil .

title: Hellcat
description: Hellcat Hellcats , also called " bezekira " , are quiet hunters of the Nine Hells . Physical description . In total darkness , hellcats appear to be a massive feline monsters with hot , ethereal wisps coming from their bodies .

title: Hellenhild
description: Hellenhild Hellenhild was a frost giant jarl sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hellenhild was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Hellenrae
description: Hellenrae Hellenrae was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Hellenrae simply hated everyone , even her fellow cultists , so she tried to avoid contact with others .

title: Hellfire warlock
description: Hellfire warlock A Hellfire Warlock is able to enhance the power of their eldritch blasts by harnessing hellfire , a mysterious magical energy found in the Nine Hells . They often gain this power by interacting with the Baatezu , summoning them in order to make infernal contracts or forcibly capturing and interrogating them . Abilities .

title: Hellfire wyrm
description: Hellfire wyrm Hellfire wyrms were dragons sponsored by the hells to influence events on the Material Plane . Description . Large bone spikes jutted from the head and shoulders of these dragons , while smoke was continually emitted from their scales , seeming to flow like molten lava across their massive bodies .

title: Hellgate Dell
description: Hellgate Dell Hellgate Dell was the area where Hellgate Keep once stood . All that remained of Hellgate Keep was a craggy and mishapen hill covered with small bushes and moss . A ring of twenty - five huge oak trees , of which five were treant s , surrounded and guarded the hill from strangers .

title: Hellgate Keep
description: Hellgate Keep Hellgate Keep , formerly Ascalhorn , was a city of evil on the northeast edge of the High Forest . It was destroyed in 1369 DR when the Harpers used the Gatekeeper ' s Crystal , and is now overseen by the treant Turlang and his fellows . History .

title: Hellish rebuke
description: Hellish rebuke Hellish rebuke was a basic spell known to all warlock s of the infernal pact , and available to all warlocks after the Second Sundering . Effects . When cast , " hellish rebuke " caused a creature of the warlock ' s choosing within fifty feet of him or her to burst into flames channeled straight from the Nine Hells by the warlock ' s pain and rage .

title: Hellriders
description: Hellriders The Hellriders were a group of skilled horsemen who acted as the primary armed force of the city of Elturel . Skilled soldiers who fought from horseback , they were typically proficient with spears , composite bows , and a curved saber similar to a scimitar . Activities .

title: Hellwasp devil
description: Hellwasp devil Hellwasp devils are members of a huge colony that makes its home in the Garden of Delight s in Malbolge . Ruthless and logical , with an alien intelligence and the unquestioning instincts of a colony insect , these devil s live to serve the whims of their queen . Hellwasp devils were once demons akin to mezzodemon s .

title: Helm
description: Helm Helm ( pronounced " HELM " ) , also known as the Vigilant One and The Watcher , was the god of guardians , protection , and protectors . He was worshiped by guards and paladin s both , long being seen as a cold and focused deity who impartially took the role of defender and sometimes also enforcer . His activities in the Time of Troubles caused the folk of Faerûn to look differently on the Watcher .

title: Helm ' s Hold
description: Helm ' s Hold Helm ' s Hold was a fortified city and cathedral located near Neverwinter . Location . Helm ' s Hold was located around twenty miles ( less than a day ' s travel ) south east of the the city of Neverwinter , not far from the edge of Neverwinter Wood , in fact , a section of the Wood , known as the Watcher ' s Forest , was cared for by the Hold ' s residents , historically because of a wild magic area within .

title: Helm Dwarf - Friend
description: Helm Dwarf - Friend Helm Dwarf - Friend was the ruler of Sundabar < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p56 " > < / ref > and a member of the Council of the Marches . Personality . Helm was known as a wise and fair leader .

title: Helm Stoneblade
description: Helm Stoneblade Helm Stoneblade was a knight serving the Stag King of Athalantar , Uthgrael Aumar , and the new king of the kingdom after 240 DR . History . Helm was a knight serving the kingdom of Athalantar and his king Uthgrael .

title: Helm and Cloak
description: Helm and Cloak The Helm and Cloak is a high - end inn and feasting hall in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . It is highly popular both with travelers and with local residents , who enjoy its dining room . It is also home to the majority of the Knights of the Unicorn , who currently rent the majority of an upper floor .

title: Helm at Highsun
description: Helm at Highsun The Helm at Highsun was a tavern in the town of Red Larch owned by a mage named Yather Indaglol . Interior . The tavern was shadowy and quiet .

title: Helm of reflection
description: Helm of reflection The helm of reflection was a magic item that could be found within the Hordelands . Description . This item was available in a variety of helmet types .

title: Helmed horror
description: Helmed horror A helmed horror is an animated construct often found as a guardian . Physical description . A helmed horror as an empty suit of armor , with purple magical light flickering between the joints .

title: Helmgrove
description: Helmgrove Helmgrove was a wooded area north of the city of Myth Drannor . It is most notable for its use as a watchpost by the Shield of Myth Drannor , in the events leading up to the Fall of Myth Drannor . It no longer exists and its exact location has been lost .

title: Helmsdale
description: Helmsdale Helmsdale was a small farming town found in Soravia on the border with Brandiar . Description . Helmsdale rested on the banks of the Goliad River south of Ironspur .

title: Helmsport
description: Helmsport Helmsport was an Amn ian fort on the shore of Payit established by Captain - General Cordell in 1361 DR . It had an anchorage for ships and served as the Golden Legion ' s main base in Maztica . The fort was located on the ocean several miles from the native city of Ulatos .

title: Helmthorn
description: Helmthorn Helmthorn was a hardy , vine - like shrub . Description . The helmthorn got its name from large , imposing black thorns .

title: Helping hand
description: Helping hand Helping hand was an evocation spell that called a spectral hand to lead the subject to the caster . Effects . This spell could be used to summon help or to direct a person within five miles ( 8 km ) to the caster ' s location .

title: Heltharn Dynasty
description: Heltharn Dynasty The Heltharn Dynasty was the fourth of the ruling dynasties of Impiltur . Overview . House Heltharn was the family of paladin war - captain Imphras Heltharn the Great , who united what were four independent cities against a hobgoblin horde in 1095 DR .

title: Helve ' s Trail
description: Helve ' s Trail Helve ' s Trail was a road in the southern Vast . It ran from Maerstar in the south , where it met the North Road , then into the Earthfast Mountains , where it ended at High Haspur and connected with the High Trail .

title: Helve Moonstar
description: Helve Moonstar Helve Moonstar was a member of House Moonstar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Helve was rebellious in his past , but matured over time .

title: Helve Urtrace
description: Helve Urtrace Helve Urtrace was a City Watch officer in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Helve was a old , bald , and quiet man .

title: Helvur Tharnlar
description: Helvur Tharnlar Helvur Tharnlar was a shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis , who once provided a favor for the Lords ' Alliance . Personality . Helvur was a snob .

title: Helyos
description: Helyos Helyos was a mercenary in Chessenta . History . Helyos was one of the best fighters in Chessenta .

title: Hematite
description: Hematite Hematite was an ornamental stone that was favored by fighters . Description . When polished , hematite was a shiny gray - black stone .

title: Hemeth
description: Hemeth Hemeth was a duergar arms dealer in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . History . Hemeth was originally from Gracklstugh .

title: Hendle
description: Hendle Hendle was a druid from Rashemen and an old member of the Emerald Enclave in 1489 DR . Personality . Hendle was saddened by the loss of treant s in forests .

title: Hengar Aesnvaard
description: Hengar Aesnvaard Hengar Aesnvaard was a young barbarian in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Hengar was born into the Tribe of the Elk .

title: Hengeyokai
description: Hengeyokai The hengeyokai ( also known as katanga in Malatra ) were an incredibly varied species of shapechanger s . They believed themselves descended from human s and shapeshifting animal spirits or fey versions of primal animals , though some scholars of Faerie instead believed them to be either " awaken ed " animals infused with the magic of that plane or creations of the fomorian s . Physical characteristics .

title: Hengorot ( Settlestone )
description: Hengorot ( Settlestone ) Hengorot , or Mead Hall , was a meeting place in Settlestone for barbarian s of the Elk tribe . Structure . The stone building was huge and could house over 800 inhabitants .

title: Henkala Shadowsong
description: Henkala Shadowsong Henkala Shadowsong was a deep gnome shopkeeper in Blingdenstone . History . Henkala escaped from Blingdenstone in 1371 DR .

title: Hephaestus
description: Hephaestus Hephaestus was a red dragon who laired in Erlkazar . A fluke of the Spellplague would turn him into an undead creature with powers over the denizens of the Shadowfell . Appendix .

title: Hepson
description: Hepson Hepson was a human male and general of the Zhentilar army during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was with the god Bane when he planned the invasion of Tantras . Hepson , fearing for the lives of his soldiers , tried to argue with Bane , but was silenced by the god .

title: Heptios
description: Heptios Heptios was the most powerful wizard in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Heptios wandered the streets of Cimbar trying to spread his philosophy .

title: Herald ' s Hall
description: Herald ' s Hall Herald ' s Hall ( also seen as Heralds ' Hall ) was an opulent manor on an island on a subterranean lake , and was the secret headquarters of the Heralds of Faerûn . Location . Herald ' s Hall was located in Swordsmere , a cave complex deep beneath Mount Sklagarra in the Troll Mountains in western Amn .

title: Herald ' s Holdfast
description: Herald ' s Holdfast Herald ' s Holdfast was a spellguarded library complex that belonged to the Heralds of Faerûn and was their primary repository of heraldic lore , history , genealogy , and artifacts from nearly all the humanoid races native to Faerûn . It was the greatest library in the North , surpassing even the Vault of the Sages in Silverymoon , and was also the residence of the High Herald Old Night . Location .

title: Herald ' s Rest
description: Herald ' s Rest Herald ' s Rest was an opulent and exclusive inn , festhall , and brothel frequented by members of the Heralds and the Harpers . Location . Herald ' s Rest was located in the city of Berdusk in the Western Heartlands .

title: Herald Markin
description: Herald Markin Herald Markin lived in Prastuil in central Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Activities . Herald served as Warchief of Prastuil , and was the leader of the city by most standards since the city did not have its own Duchess .

title: Herald domain
description: Herald domain The Herald domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters heraldic spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Herald Domain Powers .

title: Heralds ( local )
description: Heralds ( local ) The Heralds of Faerûn had members in most cities of significant size or in locations where their services were in demand . Each local Herald was responsible for their city and usually the surrounding countryside as well . Each office had a unique name which the Herald used on official business , rather than their real name .

title: Heralds Pursuivant
description: Heralds Pursuivant The Heralds Pursuivant were a group of talented and senior Heralds that served the High Heralds as apprentices , personal assistants , messengers , and itinerant representatives . They were trusted envoys that carried out sensitive missions , sometimes requiring secrecy and disguises . In the Herald organization , the Heralds Pursuivant were second only to the High Heralds and were under the tutelage of Old Night .

title: Heralds of Faerûn
description: Heralds of Faerûn The Heralds of Faerûn , or simply the Heralds , were a quasi - independent group of historians and heraldists that took on the responsibility of recording , preserving , and policing the coats of arms , flags , standards , shields , badges , mottoes , symbols , and sigils of the nobility of Faerûn . Over the years , they also became the foremost authority on courtly courtesy , inheritance , precedence , genealogy , correct armature , and general history . Their impartiality and neutrality earned them the respect of nearly every nation , kingdom , city - state , mercenary company , clan , and tribe in civilized Faerûn .

title: Herath
description: Herath Herath was a city located in central Dambrath . Geography . Located along the Dolphin ' s Climb ' river just south of the Gnollwatch Mountains , Herath was a bustling city .

title: Hercubes Jedea
description: Hercubes Jedea King Hercubes Jedea was a human wizard , a member of the Jedea family , and the ruler of the city - state of Mordulkin in Chessenta in the mid - to late 14th century DR . History . He was the most powerful mage of the Jedea family and , as per custom , became the ruler of the city , a position he held before the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR .

title: Herdsman genie
description: Herdsman genie Herdsman genies were special tasked genie s in Zakhara who tended animals . Herdsmen were descendants of the jann . Description .

title: Heresy of the Threefold God
description: Heresy of the Threefold God The Heresy of the Threefold God was a belief that Helm , Tyr , and Torm were the same god . The Eye of Justice was the only known organization that held this belief . In 1384 DR , Gedrin Shadowbane had a vision in which Helm was slain by Tyr and Helm ' s godhood merged with Tyr ' s .

title: Hergatha
description: Hergatha Hergatha , commonly known as the Storm Maiden , was a young woman who led most of the Northlander s on the Ilse of Norland in the late 15th century DR . She believed herself to be the reincarnation of Viledel , an ancient Northlander warrior , although her belief was false . Abilities .

title: Hermit ' s Wood
description: Hermit ' s Wood Hermit ' s Wood was a large forest in southern Cormyr , lying southwest of Wheloon and east of the Wyvernflow . History . During the life of King Azoun II ( 1001 – 1056 DR ) , a hermit was the first person to dwell in the forest , giving it its name .

title: Hermit ' s Wood toad
description: Hermit ' s Wood toad The Hermit ' s Wood toad was a breed of frog or toad found near Hermit ' s Wood in Cormyr . It was green with reddish striations and had eyes that were unusually large . Incredibly , these animals had the ability to see invisible creatures , even invisible creatures from other plane s .

title: Hermuk ' s Allgoods
description: Hermuk ' s Allgoods Hermuk ' s Allgoods was an excellent merchant ' s shop located in Melvaunt . While the store provided regular goods , along with some more exotic items from the region ' s black market , its proprietor Hermuk offered to fence goods brought to him by rogue s and adventurers .

title: Hern
description: Hern Hern was a high - ranking monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Relationship . Hern was a friend of Mival .

title: Herne
description: Herne Herne The Huntmaster was a hunter power worshiped by the orc s of the High Forest instead of the Orc pantheon . Herne was a corrupted version of the Master of the Hunt , one of the avatar s of Malar , who came to Faerûn with a wave of other interloper deities , one of whom was Oghma . It was Malar fighting and defeating Herne on Faerûn that convinced Lolth to recruit the Beastlord to join her anti - Seldarine .

title: Hero
description: Hero Hero by R . A . Salvatore is the third and final book of the Homecoming trilogy .

title: Hero of Neverwinter
description: Hero of Neverwinter The Hero of Neverwinter was an adventurer who was instrumental in curing the Wailing Death and putting an end to the war between Neverwinter and Luskan . History . The Hero was one of the first to join the Neverwinter Academy after the call was put out for those of adventurous spirit to aid the city in its time of need after the Wailing Death plague began decimating the population .

title: Heroes ' feast
description: Heroes ' feast Heroes ' feast was a conjuration spell that called forth a great banquet to feed , heal , cure , protect , and " bless " those who partook of the repast . Effects . " Heroes ' feast " conjured a full banquet , replete with a table fit for a king , chairs , dishes , utensils , food , and a special nectar - like beverage for as many revelers as the caster was able to provide for .

title: Heroes of Horror
description: Heroes of Horror Designed to bring all the horrors of your Dungeons and Dragons adventure to life , or unlife , as realistically or fantastically as possible . Ways to make any adventure a Dread Adventure , making Dread Creatures and Dread Characters . How to manipulate fear , tension , and mood to make a scary story into a horror story .

title: Herzgo Alegni
description: Herzgo Alegni Herzgo Alegni ( pronunced " HAIR - zz - go uh - LEG - knee " ) was a Shadovar tiefling in charge of the Netherese search for Xinlenal in the Neverwinter Wood . Description . Alegni was very large in stature .

title: Hesken - P ' aj Symryvvin
description: Hesken - P ' aj Symryvvin Hesken - P ' aj Symryvvin was the matron of the 18th house of Menzoberranzan and the most powerful priestess of Lolth in the city . Personality . The matron and her family was sometimes referred to as " the eyes of Lolth " .

title: Hespal Nicort
description: Hespal Nicort Hespal Nicort was a half - orc commander of the city guard of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR , leading 500 footmen and 200 archers . Although half orc , Hespal vehemently hated orc s . By 1367 DR , warnings circulated that the gray orc s of the Dustwall Mountains were gathering in preparation for a major assault or raids into Ulgarth .

title: Hesperdan
description: Hesperdan Hesperdan was an archmage in the Zhentarim . He was considered by some to be perhaps the greatest tyrant mage in all of Faerûn . He also went by the alias Gelvar Thordrunn , a dealer of magical curios and esoterica in Ordulin , Sembia .

title: Hessar
description: Hessar Hessar was a Calishite Shade and member of the Eye of Justice . History . Hessar kept his true nature hidden from most members of the Eye .

title: Hetha
description: Hetha Hetha was the student of Neverwinter Academy . Biography . Hetha was a wizard of Neverwinter Academy , who was Qara ' s enemy .

title: Hethar
description: Hethar Hethar was a city in Dambrath . Geography . Located on the Hethar Peninsula near the southern coast of the Bay of Dancing Dolphins , Hethar sat in a prime position to defend the southern portion of Dambrath from attack .

title: Hethar Peninsula
description: Hethar Peninsula The Hethar Peninsula was a stretch of land located in southern Dambrath . Geography . Located between the Great Sea to the south and the Bay of Dancing Dolphins to the north , the Hethar Peninsula formed a good portion of Dambrath ' s southern border .

title: Hethcypressarvil
description: Hethcypressarvil Hethcypressarvil , usually known as Cypress , was the leader of a Cult of the Dragon cell in Elversult . He ended his mortal life when he was killed by Lady Yanseldara and he returned as a dracolich . His spirit resided in a giant topaz inset into a staff Yanseldara had inherited from her father .

title: Hethhab
description: Hethhab Hethhab was the current incarnation of Anhur in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hethhab was the protector of the eastern sections of Mulhorand .

title: Hethmeir ' s Highboots
description: Hethmeir ' s Highboots Hethmeir ' s Highboots was a shop located in Everlund . Services . Around 1370 DR , the store sold the finest custom - tailored boot s in all of Faerûn ( though the corvisors of Waterdeep might have taken exception to this ) .

title: Heurodis
description: Heurodis Heurodis was a powerful medusa sorceress who sought to revive the Netherese flying city of Undrentide and use it to gain great power for herself . History . She managed to reawaken and bind to herself the power of the mythallar powering the city , turning into a lich from its power and managed to make the city take flight again .

title: Heway
description: Heway The heway is a huge snake with cold eyes who loves to poison oases and wells with its deadly venom . This animal hates all the inhabitants and nomadic tribes of the desert . Unlike the scales of ordinary snakes , Heway scales are covered with a slimy fatal poison .

title: Hexblade
description: Hexblade Hex magic is a form of sorcery that manifests at a young age . It tends to occur in poorer areas where magical training and education are unavailable , though this is not always the case . Some embrace this ability , becoming evil or neutral hexblades bent on vengeance and retribution .

title: Hezass Nymar
description: Hezass Nymar Hezass Nymar was the tharchion of Lapendrar of Thay and Eternal Flame of the temple of Kossuth in Escalant . His favorite guards were four golem s carved of deep brown Thayan oak to resemble men - at - arms with longbow s as part of their bodies . He had the habit of plundering the offerings faithful gave to Kossuth .

title: Hezebel
description: Hezebel Hezebel was an erinyes who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . She was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demon s and devil s , but broke free when Baalbisan convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the fiends to the haven .

title: Hezom
description: Hezom Lord Hezom was a human cleric of Helm and lord of the settlement of Espar in Cormyr as of 1368 DR . He maintained a shrine to Helm in the settlement and treated the sick and wounded there . Prior to this , he was a full - time priest of Helm .

title: Hezrou
description: Hezrou A hezrou , also known as a type II demon , was a type of tanar ' ri demon . Description . A hezrou was a large demonic monstrosity that bore a superficial resemblance to a toad in humanoid form , with arms and hands instead of forelegs .

title: Hgraam
description: Hgraam Hgraam was the leader of the stone giant s of Gracklstugh and a cleric of Skoraeus Stonebones in 1370 DR . and 1372 Personality . Hgraam was a capable leader for his people , known for his intelligence , diplomatic skills , and martial prowess .

title: Hiatea
description: Hiatea Hiatea is the giant deity of nature , agriculture , hunting , females , and children . Her symbol is a flaming spear . She takes the form of a tanned , lithe giantess with long legs , wearing leather armor and carrying a spear that flames on her command , a bow , and a quiver of arrows .

title: Hichikung nio
description: Hichikung nio The hichikung nio was a secret society in Koryo sponsored by King Wanang Sun in the mid – 14th century DR . Tactics . The king installed members of the hichikung nio in key posts in the local and regional bureaucracies of the realm .

title: Hidden
description: Hidden The Hidden were a band of various drow rogues , shadowdancer s , and shapechanger s who operated as a small resistance force in Maerimydra . They worked against the forces of Kurgoth Hellspawn and the undead of Irae T ' sarran after Maerimydra ' s fall in 1372 DR . Organization .

title: Hidden Fulcrum
description: Hidden Fulcrum The Hidden Fulcrum was the audience chamber of the Great Khan of the Dao , Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil . Location . This secret chamber was hidden within the Sevenfold Mazework on the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Hidden Lake
description: Hidden Lake Hidden Lake was a body of water in ancient Netheril , west of the Lodestar Mountains . After Netheril fell , it dried up and became known as the Shoal of Thirst . In 1479 DR , the lake is filled with water again and known as the Shadow Sea .

title: Hide armor
description: Hide armor Hide armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Hide armor was made from animal skins , pelts and furs .

title: Hide from undead
description: Hide from undead Hide from undead was an abjuration spell that was an improved version of the necromancy spell invisibility to undead . Both spells made the recipient undetectable to common undead creatures and could sometimes fool even highly intelligent undead . The earliest divine version of this spell worked more like " sanctuary " and was only effective against low level undead .

title: Hide heart
description: Hide heart Hide heart was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Hieracosphinx
description: Hieracosphinx The hieracosphinx was one variation of a sphinx . They were an evil , savage and animal - intelligent hawk - headed sphinx . Sphinxes were enigmatic creatures with great , feathery wings and leonine bodies .

title: Hierophant
description: Hierophant The hierophant is a prestige class of clerics and druids . Hierophants are higher members of clergy and druidic circles who decide to temporarily forgo gaining the highest levels of divine magic in order to concentrate on the mastery of what they already possess . This has the chief consequence of having spells that are much more potent than normal , allowing hierophants to heal and damage much more efficiently and powerfully through understanding rather than calling on more involved prayers .

title: Hiexel
description: Hiexel Hiexel was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Description . Hiexel trees usually grew about 30 feet tall .

title: High Captains of Luskan
description: High Captains of Luskan The High Captains of Luskan were the leaders of the city of Luskan . Each of them ruled over one of the five factions ruling the city of Luskan , which were Ship Kurth , Ship Baram , Ship Rethnor , Ship Taerl and Ship Suljack . When a High Captain died , a long - standing tradition caused the new High Captain to become known by their predecessor ' s name .

title: High Council
description: High Council The High Council was the governing body of the city of Tantras in the Vast by the 14th century DR . Organization . The High Council comprised the heads of sixteen of the local noble merchant families as well as the high priest of the temple of Torm , as it was the most influential church in the city .

title: High Country
description: High Country The High Country was an area of land located on the eastern side of the Vast . Description . The High Country was a large area of rocky moors and grassy plains and hills , bordered by the North Road on the west and the Earthspur Mountains , or Giantspike Mountains .

title: High Desert
description: High Desert The High Desert was the more westerly of the two great deserts that dominated the elevated interior of Zakhara . Inhabitants . A number of mostly enlightened desert nomads , called Al - Badia in Midani , roamed the High Desert organized into major and minor tribes .

title: High Forest
description: High Forest The High Forest is a remnant of the days of old , when all of Faerûn was covered in green and elves , giant s and dragon s ruled the world . The forest is a vast region of old forest growth bounded by the Nether Mountains in the north and the High Moor to the south . To the west is found the Evermoors and to the east the vast desert of Anauroch .

title: High Forest scout
description: High Forest scout High Forest scouts are guardians of the High Forest and the bane of the wood ' s enemies . Roaming the confines of the enchanted forest that they call home High Forest make common cause with the many fantastical creatures that inhabit it while combating the threats that would do them harm , such as the yuan - ti of Najara to the south or the demon ic servitors of revived Netheril . To those who would do the forest harm , High Forest scouts are as deadly ghosts , haunting would - be foes from the trees and driving them off .

title: High Hallowed Festival Hall
description: High Hallowed Festival Hall The High Hallowed Festival Hall was a temple and hall dedicated to the worship of Lliira in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Inhabitants . Endress Joybringer Halatar was the High Mistress of Revels for the temple .

title: High Harpers
description: High Harpers The High Harpers are a council of powerful individuals who plan the long - term goals of the semi - secret Harper organization . As of 1375 DR the council consists of : Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and his wife Laeral Silverhand were also members of this council before Khelben split off to form the Moonstars . Alustriel Silverhand was also a High Harper before she resigned from the Harpers ( shortly before Khelben & Laeral did ) .

title: High Haspur
description: High Haspur High Haspur was a village in the Vast , lying high in the western Earthfast Mountains , where Helve ' s Trail from Maerstar met the High Trail between Sarbreenar and Procampur . Government . High Haspur was ruled for a number of generations by the Morninglight family , a gnome clan who also ran The Elf in Armor inn there .

title: High Hedge
description: High Hedge High Hedge was the home of the wizard Thalantyr , which was situated northwest of Beregost . Structure . Thalantyr the Conjurer ' s estate was a dark , turreted stone building overgrown with pines .

title: High Heralds
description: High Heralds The High Heralds were the leadership council of the Heralds of Faerûn . Each High Herald used the traditional name of his or her office instead of their real name when conducting Herald business . As of the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR , there were six High Heralds : The High Heralds were ranked by seniority in office but a popular Herald usually had more influence than his or her seniors because the main tool of the Heralds of Faerûn was peer pressure .

title: High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration
description: High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration The heart of Gond ' s church is the High Holy Crafthouse of Inspiration in the city of Illul in Lantan . This monastery is run by Danactar the High Artificer , Most Holy Servant of Gond . Danactar is the highest ranking mortal cleric of Gond ; he is the supreme voice in ecclesiastical matters and he serves in Lantan ' s ruling council , the Ayrorch .

title: High Horn ( hold )
description: High Horn ( hold ) High Horn was a huge Cormyte military stronghold at the top of High Horn mountain in the Storm Horns , at an elevation of around 1000 ft ( 305 m ) . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was led by Lord Commander Thursk Dembarron and was garrisoned by approximately a hundred archers and three hundred other soldiers . In the winter , it was home to half of the entire army of Cormyr .

title: High Horn ( mountain )
description: High Horn ( mountain ) High Horn was a mountain 1000 feet high ( 310 m ) situated in the Storm Horns mountain range , north - west of Cormyr . It was the site of the stronghold also named High Horn and the High Horn Pass leading to the west and providing one of only two easy crossings through the mountain range .

title: High Horn Pass
description: High Horn Pass High Horn Pass was a pass leading east to west through the Storm Horns mountain range into Cormyr , passing close to the mountain High Horn and to the stronghold of the same name , High Horn . It was frequented by lizardmen who used it to try to pass into Cormyr .

title: High House of Magic
description: High House of Magic The High House of Magic , which belonged to the mage guild of the same name , was a large castle like structure on MacIntyre Path in Ravens Bluff . The building hosted a large library and had enchanted busts of former archmages in the entryway .

title: High House of Wonders
description: High House of Wonders The High House of Wonders was a temple to Gond in Baldur ' s Gate . Structure . As the largest temple in Baldur ' s Gate .

title: High House of the Hunt
description: High House of the Hunt The High House of the Hunt was a small temple dedicated to Malar , the Beastlord , in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Inhabitants . This temple was led by Huntmaster Baerdeth Malagar .

title: High Hunt
description: High Hunt A High Hunt was a religious celebration in tribute to the Beast Lord Malar . High Hunts were required to be held four times per year , one for each season . They were organized and run by a Huntmaster or Huntmistress .

title: High Ice
description: High Ice The High Ice is a monster - infested region of ice and snow found directly north of the Anauroch desert . A glacier , extended from its original size by the magic of the phaerimm . Its inhabitants are the harmless icejack s , the bizarre snow snake s and a few mammal and bird species adapted to the cold .

title: High Imaskar
description: High Imaskar High Imaskar stood on the shattered ruins of Mulhorand on the eastern shore of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It represented one of two nations of Imaskari survivors in the 15th century DR . History .

title: High Imperceptor of Bane
description: High Imperceptor of Bane The High Imperceptor of Bane was a title held by the head of the Black Lord ' s Altar , the seat of the orthodox branch of the Banite faith based in Mulmaster . History . During the 1340s DR , the position was held by Szchulan Darkoon , who was in open conflict with the transformed branch of the faith based in Zhentil Keep , headed by Fzoul Chembryl .

title: High Moor
description: High Moor The High Moor is a large , monster - infested , open moorland in western Faerûn , and is bordered on the east by the Serpent Hills and on the west by the Misty Forest . It was created in about - 10500 DR when the fallen kingdom of Miyeritar was destroyed by the Vyshaantar Empire ' s magics during the Crown Wars . The High Moor contains numerous ancient ruins and structures , but the most familiar include Dragonspear Castle on the western edge , Hammer Hall , a log house and stables surrounded by a wooden palisade near the banks of Highstar Lake , and Orzogoth , a large ancestral hall near the Serpent Hills .

title: High Old One
description: High Old One The High Old One was the title of the ranking priest of Dumathoin in a dwarven church or kingdom . In Thunderholme , it was last held by Dagan . Another who held this rank was the dwarven archlich Bandaerl , who guarded the tome of King Melair I in Undermountain .

title: High Peaks
description: High Peaks The High Peaks were the western spur of the Cloven Mountains . Geography . With the Deepwash to the north and the Thorn Wood to the south , the High Peaks were located in the middle of the barony of Ahlarkhem in Erlkazar .

title: High Road
description: High Road The High Road was the inland trade route that stretched from Waterdeep in the south to Luskan in the north . It skirted Thornhold and the eastern edge of the Mere of Dead Men where it passed beneath Iniarv ' s Tower before going through Leilon . Shortly afterward it intersected with the western Triboar Cutoff then went through Neverwinter and Port Llast before coming to Luskan .

title: High Shou
description: High Shou The Shou language , also called High Shou or Kao te Shou , was the language spoken by the Shou people inhabiting Shou Lung . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , and came from the same root tongue as the T ' u Lung language . Speakers .

title: High Temple of Mystra
description: High Temple of Mystra The High Temple of Mystra on Mount Talath was said by some to be the center of all magic in Halruaa . It contained one of the largest storehouses and libraries of magic in all Faerûn . Location .

title: High Tide
description: High Tide The High Tide was the largest tavern in Skullport and was built atop a brewery . Inhabitants . Only invited guests were allowed to enter the tavern and the exclusiveness made the business a favorite with Skullport ' s leaders .

title: High Trail
description: High Trail The High Trail was a trail through the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast . It ran from Procampur at its most southern point to Ravens Bluff in the north . The High Trail ran through Procampur , High Haspur , Sarbreenar , the Earthfast Mountains at Elvenblood Pass , Mossbridges , and ended at Ravens Bluff .

title: High Ulutim languages
description: High Ulutim languages The descriptive term " High Ulutim " referred to two closely related Ulou languages spoken in the northernmost ( " high " ) reaches of Faerûn by the Ulutiun people . Languages . The High Ulutim languages were Uluik and Ulutiun .

title: High elf
description: High elf High elves , also known as eladrin , are graceful warrior s and wizards that originated from the realm of Faerie , also known as the Feywild . In addition to living in the Feywild , they are at home in Arvandor and Gates of the Moon as well as the forests of the world . They are magical in nature and share an interest in the arcane arts .

title: Highbank Forest
description: Highbank Forest Highbank Forest was a village in the Vast , sitting at the end of the Tantras Trail from Orlimmin , at the intersection with Feldar ' s Trail between Dark Hollow and Mossbridges . Geography . The village of Highbank Forest was named for a steeply sloped and wooded hill that lay just to the north .

title: Highcliff
description: Highcliff Highcliff was a village near the Mere of Dead Men . It was the closest village to Crossroad Keep and Neverwinter . Geography .

title: Highcliff Castle
description: Highcliff Castle Highcliff Castle was a ruin in Highcliff on the Sword Coast . Geography . Located on a hill near Highcliff , Highcliff Castle was a strategic point .

title: Highfire Crown
description: Highfire Crown The Highfire Crown was a priceless elven artifact created during an Elven High Magic ritual that cleansed and constructed the mythal over the Elven Court in 714 DR . Description . The crown was a ring of thirteen " selu ' kiira " seemingly held together by silver - and amber - colored arcane fire which extended up to seven points .

title: Highharvestide
description: Highharvestide Highharvestide was an annual festival in the Calendar of Harptos , taking place between 30 Eleint and 1 Marpenoth . It was traditionally a feast to celebrate the harvest and the abundance of food , but also the time when those wishing to travel left on their journeys before winter set in . Preparations for the feast started as early as a tenday before , while preparing , cooking , and preserving the harvest for the cold winter months .

title: Highmoon
description: Highmoon Highmoon was a large town and the capital of Deepingdale . History . Highmoon was attacked on Tarsakh 17 , 1373 DR , by the black dragon Zarlandris , who destroyed the Tower of the Rising Moon before being killed .

title: Highmoon Trading Coster
description: Highmoon Trading Coster The Highmoon Trading Coster was a dominant trading organization that controled much of the overland trade in the Sword Coast . It was led by Duldelph Maremmon . The Highmoon Coster had exclusive rights to kaorph ( a blue wine ) and certain spices such as arispeg , marka and delph .

title: Highsummer
description: Highsummer Highsummer was a special day in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring on the night after Midsummer — this was Eleasis 1 , the 1st of the month of Highsun , in most years ; or Shieldmeet , every four years . The night of Highsummer was traditionally the time for the Feast of the Moon or the " Festival of Lovers " in Turmish and across the Vilhon Reach . Curiously , on the day before Highsummer each year , every tressym in the city of Ankhapur mysteriously disappeared .

title: Hijo clan
description: Hijo clan The Hijo clan was the Ninja clan ally of Funada clan in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Hijo were tie to the Funada not only by loyalty or greed bust mostly by ancient tradition and by giri — a sense of obligation and duty . However normally they pursued their personal goals and only if their plans can damaged the Funada the giri obligated them to stop .

title: Hildeth Highhammer
description: Hildeth Highhammer Hildeth Highhammer was a dwarven adventurer from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The dark - haired dwarf woman dressed in a blue and brown leathers .

title: Hilithiimm Turnstone
description: Hilithiimm Turnstone Hilithiimm Turnstone was the master of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Reputation . He had the trust of the Lords of Waterdeep , of the City Watch , and of the nobility of Waterdeep .

title: Hill ' s Edge
description: Hill ' s Edge Hill ' s Edge was a small city on the Dusk Road , south of Anauroch on the River Reaching , south - east of Skull Gorge , east of Hardbuckler and west of the Sunset Mountains . Notable buildings . Official buildings .

title: Hill giant
description: Hill giant Hill giants were giant s of low intelligence that lived in hilly areas . They spoke Jotunhaug and Jotun . Physical description .

title: Hills of the Dead Kings
description: Hills of the Dead Kings The Hills of the Dead Kings was a hilly region in central Dambrath . Geography . Connected to the Gnollwatch Mountains , this area helped bisect the central portion of the country .

title: Hills of the Seven Lost Gods
description: Hills of the Seven Lost Gods The Hills of the Seven Lost Gods were seven hillocks located just west of the city of Westgate . Upon each hillock lay a ring of standing stones , each ring dedicated as a shrine to a particular god . These gods were Moander , Garagos , Ghaunadaur , Jergal , Savras , Silvanus , and one whose name was lost .

title: Hillsfar
description: Hillsfar Hillsfar was a powerful city - state located on the southern coast of the Moonsea . The city was heavily involved in trade in the region , acting as a hub for cities and settlements in the surrounding area . A person from Hillsfar was known as a Hillfarian .

title: Hillsfar ( game )
description: Hillsfar ( game ) Hillsfar was developed by Westwood Studios in 1989 and published by SSI . The player chooses a character and started in Hillsfar . It was one of the first RPGs who tried to combine simple hack and slay with puzzles .

title: Hilltop
description: Hilltop Hilltop was a tiny community nestled in the southern foothills of the Nether Mountains . Geography . Hilltop was located in the Silver Marches .

title: Hilm
description: Hilm Hilm , or the " City of Kindness , " was the northernmost city in the Pantheist League within Zakhara . Geography . The metropolis , located near Huzuz , was a caravan stop for missionaries traveling toward the Court of Enlightenment .

title: Himeji
description: Himeji Himeji was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . Himeji was a lieutenant of Ogaki , the second - in - command of Lord Korimori . History .

title: Hin Ghostwar
description: Hin Ghostwar The Hin Ghostwar ( also known as the Hin Ghostwars and the Ghost War ) was a long conflict between the ghostwise halfling s and the allied strongheart and lightfoot halfling s in the Lluirwood in Luiren . Background . The three halfling subraces ( lightfoot halfling s , strongheart halfling s , and ghostwise halfling s ) were originally nomadic tribes of the Lluirwood in Luiren who shared their resources among each other .

title: Hindhorn Hills
description: Hindhorn Hills The Hindhorn Hills was a rolling area of scrub woodlands , small cliffs and deep ravines northwest of Secomber . It was not marked on many maps . The area contained many deer , hare s and hawk s , but also dangerous wolves , gnoll s and orc s .

title: Hinny
description: Hinny The hinny was a giant flower that resembled a bright blue buttercup with petals 10 feet ( 3 m ) in diameter that remained closed in a ball - like shape for most of the year . The petals only opened for one day in the first week of spring , and there was a small pool of nectar inside . The nectar could be absorbed into the body , usually — but not always — with beneficial effects .

title: Hino Sadamoto
description: Hino Sadamoto Hino Sadamoto was the head of Hino clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sadamoto was often drunk , sleeping until late in morning .

title: Hippartes
description: Hippartes Hippartes was the king of Akanax in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Hippartes first distinguished himself as warrior in the war against Maerduuth .

title: Hippogriff
description: Hippogriff Hippogriffs are chimeric magical beasts related to griffon s . They are distinctly different from griffons , in that they also possess the physical characteristics of horses , rather than lions . In addition , hippogriffs possess the minds of animals , whereas griffons are intelligent .

title: Hippogriff cavalry
description: Hippogriff cavalry The hippogriff cavalry served as an elite military unit for Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . The hippogriff cavalry consisted of well - trained soldiers who specialized in riding hippogriff s in combat scenarios .

title: Hiro Ieyuki
description: Hiro Ieyuki Hiro Ieyuki was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and overseer of Hiro castle in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ieyuki led the garrison of 200 samurai and 800 bushi , mostly of the Hiro clan .

title: Hiro Koji
description: Hiro Koji Hiro Koji was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Hiwasa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In the fishing village of Hiwasa , he led a company of ten samurai and ninety bushi , plus an armorer and many servants .

title: Hiro Masaru
description: Hiro Masaru Hiro Masaru was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and shugo - matadai of Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hiro lived in Kuda where he had his office .

title: Hiro Matsu
description: Hiro Matsu Hiro Matsu was a samurai lord in Wa . Personality . Hiro preferred to listen than to talk .

title: Hiro Yoshitoki
description: Hiro Yoshitoki Hiro Yoshitoki was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and shugodai of Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yoshitoki lived in Okahira , where he had his office .

title: Hisan bin Hanif
description: Hisan bin Hanif Hisan bin Hanif was the kennel - master of the Dark Wind Stables in Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Hisan took care of the horse s , ponies , and lone pegasus of the Everlasting .

title: Hishna
description: Hishna Hishna or Talonmagic was a form of divine magic practiced by Maztica n priests of Zaltec . Hishna could be used over long distances and powerful practitioners could dominate the will of another being hundreds of miles away . Hishna could also be used to create a sending to deliver messages over long distances and could be used to animate objects such as snake skins .

title: Hissing sand
description: Hissing sand Hissing sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could cause sand or loose earth to flow in a direction of their choosing .

title: History of Aglarond
description: History of Aglarond The nation of Aglarond was created in 1065 DR when the half - elf army of Brindor Olósynne defeated the human army of Queen Indrila Demaz at the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm . The half - elves negotiated for the creation of a new nation with Brindor as its king . Early history .

title: History of Cormanthyr
description: History of Cormanthyr The history of Cormanthyr dates back nearly six millennia ago to the forest realm of Arcorar , where a number of previously existing elven communities were found . Pre - History . The beginnings of Cormanthyr trace back to the Crown Wars , when the greatest of elven kingdoms lie in ruin and the elven people were in strife .

title: History of Cormyr ( timeline )
description: History of Cormyr ( timeline ) The Obarskyr Family . The Obarskyr family ' s fate and Cormyr ' s were intertwined . Founded in 26 DR , the Kingdom of Cormyr was the Kingdom of the Obarskyr family .

title: History of Myth Drannor
description: History of Myth Drannor The history of Myth Drannor is long and tumultuous , fraught with rises to power and falls to ruin . Early History . Many believe that the city began as an elven encampment consisting of tree dwellings near some fresh water pools that gradually grew and incorporated rope bridges , though in truth the city was founded in - 3983 DR by the Coronal Kahvoerm Irithyl as he summoned the Rule Tower with the elfblade , the Rulers ' Blade .

title: History of Netheril
description: History of Netheril All dates are in Netherese followed by dates in Dale Reckoning . Age of Discovery ( 2654 - 3162 ) ( - 1205 DR to - 697 DR ) . The Age of Discovery lasts from - 1205 DR to - 697 DR The Shadowed Age ( 3163 - 3519 ) ( - 696 DR to - 340 DR ) .

title: History of Shadowdale
description: History of Shadowdale This article covers the history of Shadowdale . Originally Shadowdale ( then known as the " Land Under Shadow " ) was controlled by the drow , who constructed the original Twisted Tower to protect their underground routes in the area . The drow maintained a population of human s and other races on the surface , used as slaves .

title: History of Waterdeep
description: History of Waterdeep Waterdeep is on the site of an elven settlement called Aelinthaldaar , which was the capital of Illefarn at the time , and dates from around - 8500 DR . Early history . In - 1288 DR , Melairbode was created in the mountain beside and underneath Aelinthaldaar by the dwarven King Melair I , who began mining mithral there .

title: History of Zhentil Keep
description: History of Zhentil Keep Founded in 640 DR , Zhentil Keep was located on the western edge of the Moonsea at the connection point of the River Tesh . Along with the Citadel of the Raven , Zhentil Keep was destroyed by the Shadovar in 1383 DR . The Founding .

title: History of magic
description: History of magic The birth of Mystryl . Lord Ao created the universe . At first it was nothing but energy , with neither light nor dark , heat nor cold .

title: History of the Crusade
description: History of the Crusade History of the Crusade was a book written by Thom Reaverson in the early 1360s DR . It gave a complete , accurate , and unbiased account of King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . By 1362 DR , the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast had a copy , bound together with Koja ' s " Life among the Tuigan " .

title: History of the Nether Scrolls
description: History of the Nether Scrolls History of the Nether Scrolls was a tome on the subject of the Nether Scrolls . Description . Gorion ' s Ward found it indecipherable , both by normal and magical means .

title: Histra
description: Histra Histra was a human woman and a priestess of Sune studying at the Edificant Library in the Snowflake Mountains around 1362 DR . History . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , Cadderly , a young priest of Deneir , paid Histra 200 gold piece s to enchant a disk with a permanent " light " spell .

title: Hittok
description: Hittok Hittok was a Maztican drider . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History .

title: Hiwa Itzusune
description: Hiwa Itzusune Hiwa Itzusune was the admiral of Kozakura ' s Imperial Navy in 1357 DR . History . Itzusune was a member of the Niwa clan of Miyama Province .

title: Hiyal
description: Hiyal The soot - covered , industrious city of Hiyal was one of Zakhara ' s Cities of the Heart . Geography . Hiyal lay in the valley of Al - Wahl River , at the opposite , inner end of Suq Bay from its rival Huzuz .

title: Hjerik Broadkin
description: Hjerik Broadkin Hjerik Broadkin was an inhabitant of Vanesci Hamlet in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Hjerik was an upstart bloodforge commander . When the leader of the Legendary Campaign passed through the streets of Vanesci , Hjerik provoked them and publically challenged them to a bloodforge duel — it was common for such upstarts to challenge renowned bloodforge commanders .

title: Hjurgen
description: Hjurgen Hjurgen was one of the second generation of frost giant s on Toril . Relationships . Hjurgen was a son of Ottar , the father of all frost giants .

title: Hlaavin
description: Hlaavin Hlaavin was the leader of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1372 . History . Hlaavin born in the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in Underdark as one of the mind flayer ' s experiment ; it was considered a successful experiment and the Ulitharid Thalynsar in 1349 DR send Hlaavin in Waterdeep as leader of a druuth , a band of Doppelganger send by illithid to infiltrate enemy cities ; soon after however Ch ' Chitl suffer a crisis caused by the killing of the Elder brain by a githyanki party in 1362 .

title: Hlal
description: Hlal Hlal ( pronounced " Huh - LAL " ) was the chaotic good dragon goddess of humor , inventiveness , and pleasure . Of all the dragon gods , she was the most friendly to non - dragons , and her symbol , a single white flame , represented the light of wit . In the Outer Planes she was more commonly known by the name of Aasterinian and was often regarded as chaotic neutral in alignment .

title: Hlam
description: Hlam Prior Hlam was a human priest of Tyr in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . Prior Hlam assisted Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar as he presided over the Hall of Justice in Neverwinter .

title: Hlang
description: Hlang A hlang was a Chult an oval - shaped , hide shield , most common in the city of Mezro . Description . An oval hlang was two feet wide and between four and six feet tall .
