title: Hlarkus Baltreyo
description: Hlarkus Baltreyo Hlarkus Baltreyo was a lich and the Zulkir of Illusion in Thay in the late 15th century DR . Baltreyo dwelt within the Phantasmal Fortress . Relationships .

title: Hlartenth
description: Hlartenth Hlartenth was a human wizard from the city of Procampur in the Vast in the mid – 14th century DR . Hlartenth was a member of the Zhentarim . Around 1358 DR , he served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh .

title: Hlath
description: Hlath Hlath was a city of Chondath . Economy . Hlath was a busy port city .

title: Hlaungadath
description: Hlaungadath Hlaungadath was one of the three cities that survived " normally " the destruction of Netheril . Geography . Hlaungadath was the remnants of a formerly great Netherese city in the desert of northwestern Anauroch .

title: Hledh Hellspawn
description: Hledh Hellspawn Queen Hledh Hellspawn was a female fiend ish fire giant ess who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . Description . She was an enormous demon ic fire giantess with six fingers on each hand .

title: Hlethvagi Anteos
description: Hlethvagi Anteos Hlethvagi Anteos was the leading cleric of Loviatar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Only two things made Hlethvagi happy : inflicting pain and being filthy rich .

title: Hlintar
description: Hlintar Hlintar ( pronounced " Heh - LIN - tar " ) was a town in the Vast , lying on the crossroads of the Hlintar Ride , between Calaunt and Bambryn , and the Cross Road , between Tantras and Thindilar . It was a located a good day ' s ride from Calaunt and from Tantras . History .

title: Hlintar Ride
description: Hlintar Ride The Hlintar Ride was a road that ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Calaunt and the village of Dragon Falls . From west to east , it began at Calaunt , ran through Hlintar , Bambryn , and Dark Hollow and ended at Dragon Falls . On the way , it linked with Blaern ' s Trail , the Cross Road , Long Reach , Feldar ' s Trail , and the North Road .

title: Hlondeth
description: Hlondeth Hlondeth was an independent city - state at the end of the Vilhon Reach which controlled a region of mountainous territory to the southwest of Turmish . The city had a longtime association with serpents , and was ruled by the Extaminos family , with mixed blood that was not quite human . The matriarch of the Extaminos family was Dediana Extaminos who had a snake ' s tail instead of legs .

title: Hlontar
description: Hlontar Hlontar was a lost realm situated around the river Tesh and reaching as far south as Shadowdale . History . Hlontar was founded by the wizard Alokkair , who came from one of the survivor states of Netheril after they had been swallowed by Anauroch .

title: Hm - boye
description: Hm - boye Hm - boye was a Kara - Tur an man who lived in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . History . Though his mother apparently came from somewhere in Kara - Tur , Hm - boye only ever remembered living in Procampur .

title: Hoar
description: Hoar Hoar ( pronounced " HORE " ) , also known as The Doombringer , was the vengeful deity of retribution invoked by those who sought to repay an eye for an eye . He was also an exarch of Bane . He was a bitter deity , prone to mood swings and fits of violence .

title: Hoard ( demiplane )
description: Hoard ( demiplane ) The Hoard was a demiplane created in 116 DR when five wizards of Cormyr trapped Nalavarauthatoryl in the Grodd demiplane . Unlike the Grodd demiplane in which Nalavarauthatoryl was imprisoned , the Hoard demiplane was far more " vivid " . The Hoard demiplane and the Grodd demiplane were linked via a " gate " .

title: Hoard of the Dragon Queen
description: Hoard of the Dragon Queen Hoard of the Dragon Queen is a 2014 " Forgotten Realms " adventure module for the 5th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " , designed by Kobold Press and the Wizards RPG Team . The module revolves around the Cult of the Dragon ' s plans to free Tiamat , the goddess of chromatic dragon s , from the Nine Hells . " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " is part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline , and received a direct continuation in the adventure module " The Rise of Tiamat " .

title: Hobart Bracegirdle
description: Hobart Bracegirdle Hobart Bracegirdle was the leader of the Kneebreakers in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Hobart wandered with his companions in search of wrongs needing righting .

title: Hobarth
description: Hobarth Hobarth was a cleric of Bhaal living in the Moonshae Isles . Personality . Hobarth was a petty , vicious , mean , and cruel individual .

title: Hobgoblin
description: Hobgoblin Hobgoblins are a larger , stronger , smarter , and more menacing form of goblinoid s than goblins , but not as powerful as bugbears . It is believed they may have created the latter two races . Psychology .

title: Hoch Miraz
description: Hoch Miraz Hoch Miraz was a wizard from Calimshan in west Faerûn . History . " Circa " 1330 DR , Hoch Miraz was aboard the " Golden Crown " , a treasure galleon leaving the Calishite mining colony of Berranzo on the island of Gundarlun in the Trackless Sea .

title: Hochtl
description: Hochtl Hochtl was a scribe in Far Payit in the 13th century DR . History . Hochtl was a scribe of renown , writing many scrolls .

title: Hodkamset
description: Hodkamset Hodkamset was the most powerful wizard in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Hodkamset was a member of The Fangs of Set .

title: Hohengroth
description: Hohengroth Hohengroth was a red dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Hohengroth was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Hojo Haru
description: Hojo Haru Hojo Haru was the mother of shogun Hojo Kawakubo of Kozakura in 1357 DR . < History . Haru was the daughter of Takenaka Okawa and was married at age of twelve with Hojo Todahiro .

title: Hojo Kamuri
description: Hojo Kamuri Hojo Kamuri was a former shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kamuri ruled as shogun until retired in favor of his son and become a monk at Namikami Temple under the name of Bentori .

title: Hojo Kawakubo
description: Hojo Kawakubo Hojo Kawakubo was the shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kawakubo , grandson of Hojo Kikutake , ascended to the position of shogun in 1349 DR after the conclusion of the Hojo War , where the Takenaka clan gained supremacy over the Hojo clan .

title: Hojo Todahiro
description: Hojo Todahiro Hojo Todahiro was the exiled former shogun of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Todahiro was the son of shogun Hojo Kikutake .

title: Hol Halstrom
description: Hol Halstrom Hol Halstrom was a farmer and an inhabitant of the village Hilltop in the Silver Marches . In 1372 DR , he called Piper a fool for his rantings on the " coming death . " Piper proclaimed Halstrom would be dead within a week .

title: Holang
description: Holang Lady Holang was a consort in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Holang was kidnapped from T ' u lung when she was a child and sold as a wife in Motra .

title: Hold animal
description: Hold animal Hold animal was an enchantment spell that held one animal helpless for a few minutes . Older versions of this spell could paralyze up to four animals for a longer duration . Effects .

title: Hold monster
description: Hold monster Hold monster was an enchantment spell that held a targeted creature helpless . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " hold person " , except that it colud be used against any creature who failed to resist to its effect .

title: Hold person
description: Hold person Hold person was an enchantment spell that could rigidly immobilize one or a few humanoid creatures for a short time . Effects . This spell worked on humanoid creatures only .

title: Hold plant
description: Hold plant Hold plant was an enchantment spell that allowed the caster to prevent dangerous plants from moving or making noise . Effects . All forms of vegetation , including fungi and those magically enhanced , could be affected by this spell ( shrieker s , treant s , shambling mound s , " plant growth " , " spike growth " , etc .

title: Hold poison
description: Hold poison Hold poison was an improved version of " slow poison " that prolonged the onset time of poison in a victim for days . Effects . The recipient of this spell was prevented from any further harm from a poison in their system for the duration of the spell .

title: Hold vapor
description: Hold vapor Hold vapor was an abjuration spell that allowed the caster to surround and capture any vapor or cloud that was visible and within the range and capacity of the spell . Effects . This spell created a spherical barrier with a radius of 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Holfast Harpenshield
description: Holfast Harpenshield Holfast Harpenshield was a retired adventurer who ran the White Hart Inn in Ashabenford , Mistledale , around 1372 DR . He gladly served all good folk who came to the inn . As he enjoyed the company of adventurers , Holfast freely shared information and advice with those passing through his inn .

title: Holger
description: Holger Holger was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Holger commanded the gatehouse of Rivergard Keep .

title: Holivanter
description: Holivanter Holivanter was a wizard who was quite merry . He taught summoned creatures all sorts of songs and chants . He was known to have talking frog s , and even a couple of winged frogs .

title: Hollow Crown Mountains
description: Hollow Crown Mountains The Hollow Crown Mountains were a mountain range that sat south of the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs , just outside the Shou Lung Empire . Description . The Hollow Crown Mountains were a mountain range that abutted Kara - Tur and the Hordelands , just outside the borders of the Shou Lung Empire , and marked what was the northernmost border of the ancient kingdom of Guge .

title: Hollowbold
description: Hollowbold Hollowbold was a ruined dwarven realm located under much of the dragon empire of Skelkor . Background . Hollowbold was composed of several underground dwarf settlements linked by a series of cave networks .

title: Holly Harrowslough
description: Holly Harrowslough Holly Harrowslough was a paladin of Lathander and a member of the Order of the Aster . Description . She had dark brown skin and bushy brown hair that she cut short .

title: Holman Frostfeather
description: Holman Frostfeather Holman Frostfeather was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Holt Burukhan
description: Holt Burukhan Holt Burukhan was the high priest of Bane in Sundabar in 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Burukhan was approached by Kaanyr Vhok , leader of the Scoured Legion , who asked for the help of the local Church of Bane to overthrow Helm Dwarf - Friend .

title: Holy Hill Farm
description: Holy Hill Farm Holy Hill Farm was a farm related to the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . In the Year of the Leaping Frog , 1266 DR , Holy Hill Farm was the site of a bloody battle between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater . The holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith .

title: Holy Mountain of Kus
description: Holy Mountain of Kus The Holy Mountain of Kus was located in the Hordelands on and within Mount Kus and near Kushk . Description . Along with the Tower of Harmony atop the summit , a vast network of twelve tunnels within Mount Kus comprised this temple to Bimasara .

title: Holy Warriors of Suffering
description: Holy Warriors of Suffering The Holy Warriors of Suffering were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to Ilmater , the Broken God , and affiliated with the Church of Ilmater . Base . The Holy Warriors of Suffering were based out of a fortress located on the site of what was later Castle Dasaajk , east of the Purple Hills in Tethyr .

title: Holy aura
description: Holy aura Holy aura was an abjuration spell that granted protection against evil . It was the counterpart to the evil spell " unholy aura " . Effect .

title: Holy avenger
description: Holy avenger The Holy avengers are rare blades well - suited to battling evil in all its myriad forms . They are greatly prized by paladin s . Creation .

title: Holy slayer
description: Holy slayer Holy slayers were elite assassin s within Zakhara who meted out justice based on a specific set of principles and beliefs . Often , just the knowledge that a holy slayer was operating nearby was enough to dissuade those who opposed their goals or beliefs . Requirements .

title: Holy symbol
description: Holy symbol Holy symbols were divinely powered implements used by cleric s and paladin s alike to enhance their prayers or unleash the fury of their god . Holy symbols came in a wide variety of designs , though all shared the common quality of being directly blessed by a god , godlike being , or the servants of the former two for the purpose of aiding agents of the divine . In many ways , holy symbols were to clerics and paladins what sword s were to fighter s or wand s were to some wizard s .

title: Holy water
description: Holy water Holy water was water blessed by a good deity that could damage undead and evil outsider s . Evil clerics could create a similar substance called unholy water . The priests of Helm called holy water the " Tears of Helm " .

title: Holy word
description: Holy word Holy word was an evocation or conjuration spell that could incapacitate or even kill nongood creatures and banish those of extraplanar origin . The reverse of this spell , which applied to nonevil creatures , was called unholy word and became better known as " blasphemy " . Effects .

title: Home of the Happy Dolphin
description: Home of the Happy Dolphin The Home of the Happy Dolphin was an inn located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . Located in the Trade Harbor district , this typical inn had twenty tables filling the common room .

title: Homeland
description: Homeland Homeland is the first book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Homen Odesseiron
description: Homen Odesseiron Homen Odesseiron is a warmage and tharchion of Surthay . His standard shows axe - and - boar . Appearance .

title: Hommet Shaw
description: Hommet Shaw Hommet Shaw was a human necromancer from Longsaddle . Personality . Hommet was a young , talented , and eager necromancer , but he was not a very detail - oriented person .

title: Homunculus
description: Homunculus Homunculi were tiny constructs created by spellcasters to act as spies and servants . They were created through mysticism and alchemy , using the spellcaster ' s own blood in the procedure . This blood - link provided a special bond between the homunculus and its creator .

title: Honlinar Tempest
description: Honlinar Tempest Honlinar Tempest was the mayor of Assam in the Shining Plains in 1370 DR . Activities . Honlinar was a master politician choose as mayor by both Ormath and Lheshayl .

title: Honor Reagh
description: Honor Reagh " Honor " Reagh was a female soldier and member of the Nasher in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , taking advantage of the chaos resulting from the undead assault on Neverwinter , led by Valindra Shadowmantle , Reagh and her friend Gothwan Cooper , under the orders from the Nasher leader Karzov , sneaked inside the Hall of Justice and stole the Crown of Neverwinter .

title: Honor mark
description: Honor mark Honor mark was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell to mark targets whom they witnessed performing dishonorable actions .

title: Honored Mamluk Society
description: Honored Mamluk Society The Honored Mamluk Society , also known as the Honored , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization was tasked with protecting the Grand Caliph and his harim .

title: Hood of servitude
description: Hood of servitude The hood of servitude was a magical animal hood that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item looked like a regular falcon hood .

title: Hooded One
description: Hooded One The Hooded One was a mind flayer merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . The Hooded One was curious and quite congenial for an inhuman monster .

title: Hook horror
description: Hook horror A hook horror ( also known as a vulture beak , hacker , cave dweller ) is a large bipedal subterranean aberration that looks like a vulture - like humanoid with bony hooks in place of hands . It is an invertebrate arthropod . Description .

title: Hooked Knucklehead
description: Hooked Knucklehead The Hooked Knucklehead was a longstanding inn in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located near the marketplace in the center of town .

title: Hoondarrh
description: Hoondarrh Hoondarrh , known as the Red Rage of Mintarn , was one of the most famous red dragon s . Personality . Hoondarrh was a cruel and efficient dragon .

title: Hoparatu River
description: Hoparatu River The Hoparatu River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Found on the eastern edge of Koryo , the Hoparatu River began in the Quang Muku Forest then ran through the southern foothills of the Vorkani Mountains .

title: Hope Kellar
description: Hope Kellar Hope Kellar was a mayor in the Moonsea . History . Hope was once a sailor until she retired and opened an inn in the village of Hillpicket .

title: Hope domain
description: Hope domain The Hope domain was a divine domain that granted hope - themed powers to a divine caster . Theme . The hopes of people took many different forms , like the hope that a current problem would be smoothly resolved for the best ; the hope that the efforts of the current generation would bear fruit for the future ; or the hope that a child would grow up and demonstrate wisdom and kindness .

title: Horac
description: Horac Horac was a warrior in Hillsfar . Activities . Horac was the chief enforcer for Margery Thrier of the Hillsfar Arena .

title: Horaldin
description: Horaldin Horaldin was a druid in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . In 1375 DR , Qilué Veladorn asked his help in investigating a gem found in the possession of a Selvetargtlin aranea and thanks to his power he able to explain some of the history of the gem .

title: Hordelands
description: Hordelands The Hordelands , also known as The Endless Wastes and as Taan by the natives , was once part of the territory of the mighty empire of Imaskar and was populated by horsemen tribes , most notably the Tuigan s . People . The Endless Wastes were occupied by many tribes who controlled loosely defined geographical locations throughout the region .

title: Horgar Steelshadow IV
description: Horgar Steelshadow IV Horgar Steelshadow IV was the Crown Prince ( sometimes labeled as King ) and ruler of Gracklstugh . Description . Horgar was bald .

title: Horgar Steelshadow V
description: Horgar Steelshadow V Horgar Steelshadow V was the duergar king of Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . He was a ruthless and canny ruler .

title: Hori Chomin
description: Hori Chomin Hori Chomin was a samurai commander of Atarashijo castle in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Chomin was tasked with the mission of building Atarashijo at the southern entrance to the pass between the plain and Nora - ko .

title: Hori Gutsu
description: Hori Gutsu Hori Gutsu was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan , who ran a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a very tranquil posthouse inside a Niwa shoen , located at an equal distance between Tamanokuni and Kuda , he led a company of ten samurai and thirty bushi , plus twenty servants , mostly from the Hori clan .

title: Horizikaul ' s cough
description: Horizikaul ' s cough Horizikaul ' s cough was a simple cantrip from the evocation school that created a short , loud noise . Effects . By completing this spell , the caster could cause a quick , loud sound to originate nearby a target person or object within close range .

title: Horizon Syndicate
description: Horizon Syndicate The Horizon Syndicate was a drow mercantile organization , formed after the Spellplague . History . In the century following the Spellplague , a growing faction of drow divorced themselves from the old ways of their people to follow a new path .

title: Horizon walker
description: Horizon walker The path of the horizon walker was one taken by adventurers whose goals were to explore and map out the plethora of environments within and even beyond the Prime . Those explorers who had an irresistible sense of curiosity and wanderlust to travel took on the path in order to gain an innate connection to their surroundings , whatever those surroundings might be . As horizon walkers became more experienced , they treated their surroundings as part of themselves , which gave them special abilities and senses to protect them from the dangers of incessant travel .

title: Horlo Aumrabbar
description: Horlo Aumrabbar Horlo Aumrabbar was a member of the adventuring band known as the Company of the Cloak . Activities . He was the soft - spoken deceiver within the band .

title: Horn
description: Horn Horns were a type of wind musical instrument . Description . Several variants of horns existed , such as fanfare horn s , hunting horn s , and glaur s .

title: Horn coral
description: Horn coral Horn coral was not a mineral but a highly prized variety of . It was also known as night coral . Description .

title: Horn of Shasphur
description: Horn of Shasphur The Horn of Shasphur , also known as the Shield of Shasphur , was a tavern located in the Market Floor of Djerad Thymar . It was owned by Clan Kepeshkmolik , and it was one of the few taverns in Djerad Thymar were non - dragonborn where allowed to enter . The tavern was named after Shasphur , the founder of Clan Kepeshkmolik .

title: Horn of Valhalla
description: Horn of Valhalla Horn of Valhalla is a wondrous item that has the power to summon forth the spirits of barbarian s from their afterlife to fight for the summoner . The horns come in four different types which appear to be normal horns until the command word is spoken . In the Forgotten Realms Campaign setting this magic item could correctly be named Horn of Warrior ' s Rest .

title: Hornbill ivory
description: Hornbill ivory Hornbill ivory was not really ivory , it was material from the beak of the hornbill bird . Description . The hornbill bird in the realms was a large bird with gray plumage and a heavy beak .

title: Horned harbinger
description: Horned harbinger The horned harbinger is a special prestige class for worshipers of the dead god Myrkul . All horned harbingers since the Time of Troubles have had contact with an artifact called the Crown of Horns and turned their worship from their previous deity to that of Myrkul , whose personality possesses the Crown of Horns . All horned harbingers are essentially tools of Myrkul , dedicated to aid the personality inhabiting the Crown of Horns in some fashion unknown to outsiders .

title: Hornmoot
description: Hornmoot Hornmoot was the traditional trading festival between the dwarves and human s of the Vast . It took place on the 14th of Kythorn each year , with lesser hornmoots on the 14th of each month until Eleint . At the end of winter , when the dwarves emerged from their subterranean homes , they blew horns from the mountains to alert the humans in the lands below that they coming to trade .

title: Horns of the Earth
description: Horns of the Earth The Horns of the Earth , or the Darkwings , was a large group of gargoyle s within the Sevenfold Mazework and the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The exact numbers of gargoyles within the Horns of the Earth remained unknown .

title: Hornung ' s surge selector
description: Hornung ' s surge selector Hornung ' s surge selector was a wild magic spell that gave the caster a limited ability to shape wild surge s their spells produced , either as a side effect or by way of " Nahal ' s reckless dweomer " . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as surge selector . Components .

title: Horquine
description: Horquine Horquine is an elven mage known for his attempts to breed a variety of azmyth that would eat the fyreflies in Cormanthor . The fyreflies were causing problems by igniting large parts of the forest , and although the azmyth Horquine bred were able to eat them , they could not digest the abdomens , the source of the flames , and so they were forced to spit them out , causing a fireball .

title: Horreb
description: Horreb Horreb was an ancient fallen civilization south of Barze . It was known for its potent magical artificers . History .

title: Horrid wilting
description: Horrid wilting Horrid wilting , also known as Abi - Dalzim ' s horrid wilting , is a necromancy spell that damages a creature via dehydration . Effect . This spell evaporates moisture from the bodies of all the subject living creatures , causing damage .

title: Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin
description: Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin Horroodissomoth Xorlarrin was the house wizard and patron ( to Matron Mother Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin ) of House Xorlarrin in 1372 DR . He was killed during the Spellplague . Description .

title: Horse
description: Horse Horses on Abeir - Toril were used for riding and pulling . Ponies . Ponies were often used as mounts by smaller humanoids like halfling s or small human s .

title: Horse ( individual )
description: Horse ( individual ) Horse was a hunter in Narfell in 1359 DR . History . Horse was cast out of his tribe because his unbridled savagery .

title: Horse Pond
description: Horse Pond Horse Pond was a pond in Amphail on the Sword Coast . Description . It was a muddy pond containing frog s and water lilies , and it was used for drinking and washing water for horses .

title: Horse Prairie
description: Horse Prairie The Horse Prairie is a land area in the Dragon Coast . The Horse Prairie runs from the Castaway Coast on the Dragonmere in the north , to the Giant ' s Run mountains to the south . And from Elversult to the east and Teziir to the west .

title: Horselords
description: Horselords Horselords , by David Cook , is the first book in The Empires trilogy . Summary . For centuries , the civilized people of the eastern and western realms have dismissed the nomadic inhabitants of the vast middle land as barbarians , but now these nomads are rising with the might to challenge the world .

title: Horseshoe Temple Oasis
description: Horseshoe Temple Oasis Horseshoe Temple Oasis was a large and important oasis located deep inside the Quoya Desert of the Endless Wastes . Description . Located in a box canyon , the Horseshoe Temple Oasis was known to have an ample supply of fresh water that bubbled up from underground .

title: Horus - Re
description: Horus - Re Horus - Re ( pronounced " hore " - us " ray " ) was the leader of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known by the name Helcaliant in Thay and that of Hokatep in Unther , he was an honorable deity that opposed change . History .

title: Horustep III
description: Horustep III Horustep III was a pharaoh , or king , of Mulhorand . He ascended to the throne in the summer of 1357 DR at the age of 11 after the assassination of his father , Akonhorus II . He approved the Mulhorandi invasion of Unther following the Time of Troubles and the Untheric god - king Gilgeam ' s death at the hand of Tiamat .

title: Hosan Khalid
description: Hosan Khalid Hosan Khalid was in charge of the West Center district of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Hosan was an extremely diligent individual .

title: Hoseki
description: Hoseki Hoseki was a disguised sohei follower of the dai - oni in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Hoseki was a sohei of the Black Temple .

title: Hoshin
description: Hoshin Hoshin was a shukenja adventurer in Kozakura . History . Hoshin ' s early history was shrouded in mystery : some said he was a samurai fleeing his household after a love affair with a clan rival ' s daughter ; he was a pirate and the only survivor after a shipwreck ; he was an impostor searching for a good hiding spot for illegal activities as a yakuza or ninja ; or he might be an illegitimate son of the shogun .

title: Hoshtar Xorlarrin
description: Hoshtar Xorlarrin Hoshtar Xorlarrin was a drow ] wizard of Menzoberranzan and cousin to House Wizard Ravel of House Xorlarrin . Description . By the tradition of his house , Hoshtar wore a red veil over his face .

title: Host Tower of the Arcane
description: Host Tower of the Arcane The Host Tower of the Arcane was both an academy of magic al training for the Arcane Brotherhood and a political and economic power in the city of Luskan . Description . The tower resembled a tree with four " limbs " ( spires ) .

title: Hotun - Shûl
description: Hotun - Shûl Hotun - Shûl is a large underground temple beneath the Ice Spires . It was razed by unknown intruders over 400 years ago . Skrom Jek of Thay wrote a book on the temple before its destruction , named " The Meanderings Upon the Friezes of Hotun - Shûl " .

title: Hound archon
description: Hound archon Hound archons are celestial beings that live primarily on the slopes of Celestia . Hound archons are the well - disciplined soldiers and sentinels of their heavenly realm . They are well - trained in the fight against evil and show no mercy to fiends .

title: Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl
description: Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl was a drow and former member of House Tuin ' Tarl in Menzoberranzan . He learned about the Silence of Lolth and conspired with Syrzan to use the weakness of the priestesses to take over Menzoberranzan . Description .

title: Hourm
description: Hourm Hourm was a friendly galeb duhr living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Hourm assisted an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , at Gravenhollow , explaining to them the functions and rules of the library .

title: Hours of the day
description: Hours of the day Most inhabitants of Faerûn divided the day into ten segments . Common names for these divisions of the day are given below : Other divisions in common use included : None of these divisions were precise . Different folk ' s usages might overlap with others .

title: House Agrach Dyrr
description: House Agrach Dyrr House Agrach Dyrr was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Structure . House Agrach Dyrr was the fifth house in 1372 DR .

title: House Ahmaquissar
description: House Ahmaquissar House Ahmaquissar was an elven house . Activities . It is known for accommodating minstrels , thieves and con artists .

title: House Alsevir
description: House Alsevir House Alsevir was a very old Cormyrean noble house which rose to the nobility around 200 DR . The family was thought to have died out but a distant branch of the family returned to Cormyr in 1420 DR and took up residence in the old Bleth estate . The family had built a considerable fortune as merchants before returning to Cormyr and , when they arrived in Suzail , began buying their way into high society .

title: House Auvryndar ( Ched Nasad )
description: House Auvryndar ( Ched Nasad ) House Auvryndar was a powerful drow house of Ched Nasad . Headquarters . House Auvryndar was located on the second level from the top of the city .

title: House Baenre
description: House Baenre House Baenre was the first drow house of Menzoberranzan , and had been for centuries - - as long as anyone in the city could remember . It was the oldest ( around 5 , 000 years old ) , strongest , and most prestigious house in the city . History .

title: House Barrison Del ' Armgo
description: House Barrison Del ' Armgo House Barrison Del ' Armgo was a high - ranking noble drow house of Menzoberranzan . Activities . The house was known for its wizards and warriors ; its might was not based in the clergy .

title: House Basadoni
description: House Basadoni Greatest guild of the many in Calimport , a desert port city that is the chosen home of Artemis Entreri . Lead for many years by Basadoni , mentor of the infamous assassin Artemis Entreri , House Basadoni was later controlled for a brief period by the opportunistic mercenary Jarlaxle . It became the front for Jarlaxle ' s attempts to widen his band of rogue drow ' s influence to the surface world .

title: House Chûmavh
description: House Chûmavh House Chûmavh was the ruling drow house of Maerimydra , and held the position as ruling house . Base of Operations . Until 1372 DR , House Chûmavh , resided within the impressive Castle Maerimydra which overlooked the city of Maerimydra .

title: House Cormaeril
description: House Cormaeril House Cormaeril was a noble house of Cormyr . Their estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . It was an enemy of the Illance house .

title: House Crownsilver
description: House Crownsilver House Crownsilver was a royal noble house of Cormyr whose estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . As of 1479 DR , the family was one of two remaining royal houses in Cormyr . The Crownsilvers disliked the younger noble houses ' mercantile activities and held House Alsevir , House Goldfeather , and House Marliir in particular disdain .

title: House DeVir
description: House DeVir House DeVir was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Headquarters . House DeVir was constructed among five floor - to - ceiling , hollow stalagmites in the midst of a mushroom grove on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl .

title: House Despana
description: House Despana House Despana is a drow noble house with two major sects . One is located in the Vhaeraun - dominated Rilauven in the north , the other is based in the devoutly Lolth - worshiping Ust Natha further to the south . A third section of the family would be a minor house of Menzoberranzan as said on p .

title: House Dhuurniv
description: House Dhuurniv House Dhuurniv is the only house to survive the fall of Maerimydra in 1372 DR . This was due in part to the fact that they had holdings outside the city . Following their escape from the city , they fell in with the Zhentarim ' s conquest of Shadowdale .

title: House Dlardrageth
description: House Dlardrageth House Dlardrageth was originally a sun elf house of Cormanthor and a proud and powerful family in ancient Arcorar until they chose to give themselves to demon s , courting incubi and succubi , in an attempt to strengthen their line to gain the power necessary to seize the throne and rebuild the ruin of Aryvandaar . They were discovered by the Coronal and their house was destroyed , most of the members being imprisoned magically inside Arcorar ' s keep , but some escaped to ancient Siluvanede , where they turned some other houses to evil . The emblem of the House is a dracophoenix .

title: House Do ' Urden
description: House Do ' Urden House Do ' Urden , also known by its ancient and formal name , Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon , was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Upon its destruction in 1339 DR , it was the eighth house . The house was reformed as the eighth house in 1484 DR by Matron Mother Quenthel Baenre .

title: House Druu ' giir
description: House Druu ' giir House Druu ' giir was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . It was the seventeenth house in 1328 DR , but by 1480 DR , it had risen to become the tenth house . Headquarters .

title: House Duskryn
description: House Duskryn House Duskryn was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . They won the charter from House Baenre that allowed them to loot the city of Blingdenstone . Activities .

title: House Eroth
description: House Eroth House Eroth was a silver elf house . History . As of 1367 DR , House Eroth was led by the elders and siblings Tanithil Eroth and Anaharae Eroth .

title: House Faen Tlabbar
description: House Faen Tlabbar House Faen Tlabbar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Description . House Faen Tlabbar was based in a large castle of dark stone .

title: House Fajirik Military Camp
description: House Fajirik Military Camp The House Fajirik Military Camp was a relatively permanent outpost of House Fajirik , located west of the Jamal Oasis in the High Desert of Zakhara . Inhabitants . Soldiers stationed here were often bored , which many traders took advantage of by bringing goods and services for them to spend their money on .

title: House Fey - Branche
description: House Fey - Branche House Fey - Branche was the fifth house of the drow city of Menzoberranzan in 1484 DR . Activities . House Fey - Branche served as a lackey to a number of houses , most notably House Baenre , hoping to curry favor with them .

title: House Freth
description: House Freth House Freth was a decease drow house of Menzoberranzan . Activities . Before their destruction they started to breed venom ooze s .

title: House Greatgaunt
description: House Greatgaunt House Greatgaunt was a noble house of Cormyr that was elevated to the nobility in the 13th century DR . The family was a voice of moderation among the nobles and disliked the newer noble houses , such as House Alsevir . The Greatgaunts ' wealth came from their extensive land holdings and they were known for their livestock herds .

title: House Hawksong
description: House Hawksong House Hawksong was a moon elf house known for its members ' service to Evermeet as riders of eagle s and pegasi . Base of operations . The Hawksong manse was located in the city of Leuthilspar on Evermeet .

title: House Hawkwinter
description: House Hawkwinter The Hawkwinters ( HAWK - win - ter ) were one of the Noble Families of Waterdeep . Trade & Interests . House Hawkwinter was most often associated with soldiering , garrisons , and guardianship .

title: House Horlbar
description: House Horlbar House Horlbar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . History . Before the Time of Troubles , House Horlbar was the twelfth ruling house in Menzoberranzan , and Jerlys and Ker Horlbar were co - matron mothers .

title: House Hunzrin
description: House Hunzrin House Hunzrin was a drow house of Menzoberranzan that controlled much of the agriculture within the city . For that reason , the pitchfork was the weapon of choice for the family . Headquarters .

title: House Illance
description: House Illance House Illance was a noble house of Cormyr based in Suzail . Holdings . Although the family was based in Suzail it had deep roots in Marsember and owned many properties through a complicated web of small companies bearing the names of others .

title: House Jaelre
description: House Jaelre House Jaelre was the biggest drow faction in Cormanthor . In 1372 DR , they accounted for about 11 % of the drow population in the forest . Objectives .

title: House Jysstev
description: House Jysstev House Jysstev was an Amnian house . History . The house backed the Jhannivvar pretender for the throne of Tethyr and subsequently lost its riches , living in near poverty .

title: House Karanok
description: House Karanok House Karanok were the insane ruling family of the city of Luthcheq in Chessenta . Organization . They believed that wizard s ( including also sorcerer s , dwarves , and elves ) were evil and must be burned .

title: House Kenafin
description: House Kenafin House Kenafin was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . It was ranked the tenth house of the city in the year 1361 DR . The females of the house reigned supreme and were famous for taking immense delight in subjugating and terrorizing the house males .

title: House Korianthil
description: House Korianthil House Korianthil was an elven house on Evermeet . History . In 1367 DR , it was led by the experienced war wizard Hatharal Korianthil .

title: House Mallyth
description: House Mallyth House Mallyth was a former noble house of Tethyr that rose to prominence several centuries before 1479 DR . Due to their questionable activities , which included blackmail and influence peddling , they were soon stripped of their noble status . After losing their nobility , they left Tethyr for Scornubel , Sembia , Westgate and other cities .

title: House Masq ' il ' yr
description: House Masq ' il ' yr House Masq ' il ' yr is a deceased drow house of Menzoberranzan . It fell during the wars with House Nasadra when Menzoberranzan was still young . Priest s and priestesses survive as ghauroper s in an underwater temple beneath Donigarten .

title: House Melarn ( Ched Nasad )
description: House Melarn ( Ched Nasad ) House Melarn was a drow house in Ched Nasad , which fell during the destruction of Ched Nasad during the Silence of Lolth ( 1372 DR ) . House . House Melarn ' s compound was a huge cyst - like bulge on the second - highest level of the city .

title: House Melarn ( Menzoberranzan )
description: House Melarn ( Menzoberranzan ) House Melarn was the sixth house of Menzoberranzan by the end of 1484 DR . Headquarters . The House Melarn compound was located in Lolth ' s Web — webs strung hundreds of feet off the cavern floor — in West Wall in Menzoberranzan .

title: House Miritar
description: House Miritar House Miritar was an elven clan on the island of Evermeet . Since the 9th century DR , they looked after the northern fishing town of Elion and its surrounding area . Around 1374 DR , the house occupied by the clan was called Seamist .

title: House Mizzrym
description: House Mizzrym House Mizzrym was the fifth drow house of Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . Headquarters . House Mizzrym was located on the plateau of Qu ' ellarz ' orl .

title: House Naerhand
description: House Naerhand House Naerhand was a merchant house operating from the Sword Coast to the western Sea of Fallen Stars as of 1479 DR . Although the clan was fabulously wealthy , they avoided joining the ranks of nobles , preferring to work behind the scenes . The family dominated the harness making trade and controlled key rest stops and watering holes along trade routes .

title: House Nasadra
description: House Nasadra House Nasadra , formerly of Menzoberranzan , was the most powerful drow house of Ched Nasad . The matron mother of the house was the informal ruler of Ched Nasad until the city ' s destruction in 1372 DR . House .

title: House Nierdre
description: House Nierdre House Nierdre was a sun elf house orgionally founded in Myth Drannor . Base of Operations . The house ' s estate in Leuthilspar was constructed from a rare and unusual shiny black stone .

title: House Nightstar
description: House Nightstar House Nightstar was a moon elf house led in 1367 DR by the twin sisters Halaema Nightstar and Saelihn Nightstar . History . The family moved to Evermeet after the fall of Myth Drannor .

title: House Norjah
description: House Norjah House Norjah was a noble house in the city of Airspur whose mansion was located in Airspur ' s south - facing cliffs . The house was most notable for being almost entirely composed of vampires . House Norjah managed to acquire seven of the twenty - two Whispering Children artifacts .

title: House Oblodra
description: House Oblodra House Oblodra was a deceased drow house of Menzoberranzan . Base . House Oblodra ' s compound was located in the district of Duthcloim ( often referred to as Manyfolk ) , where it clung to a cliff face between the two " fingers " of the Clawrift .

title: House Phull
description: House Phull House Phull was a noble house of Waterdeep and one of the older noble families in the city . Around 1440 DR Mhairdren Phull purchased the original Phull ' s title of nobility from the impoverished family . Shortly after the new Phulls moved into the family mansion , Mhairdren ' s second son , Blakrho Phull , murdered his elder brother and blamed the crime on his younger brother .

title: House Serrat
description: House Serrat House Serrat was a large merchant clan from Delzimmer that was best known for controlling trade in the drug terazul . Strictly speaking , the family wasn ' t noble as Delzimmer had no nobility . The family was considered a second - tier merchant house , below the Four Families who ruled Delzimmer .

title: House Shaelara
description: House Shaelara House Shaelara was a sun elf house on Evermeet . History . As of 1369 DR , the house was led by Uthorim Shaelara ; most of its members were under a hundred years old .

title: House Shobalar
description: House Shobalar House Shobalar was a drow house of Menzoberranzan . Description . The house was uncharacteristically reclusive , even by Menzoberranzan standards .

title: House Srune ' Lett
description: House Srune ' Lett House Srune ' Lett was a drow house of Menzoberranzan that was destroyed in the War of the Spider Queen . Description . House Srune ' Lett had a compound in the district of Narbondellyn .

title: House T ' sarran
description: House T ' sarran House T ' sarran was a drow house from Maerimydra that worshiped the goddess Kiaransalee . Organization . The house was led by Irae T ' sarran and by her immediate family .

title: House Tanor ' Thal
description: House Tanor ' Thal House Tanor ' Thal was the dominant house in the drow city of Karsoluthiyl . This was in no small part due to the large number of slaves the house sold in Skullport . Using a " portal " to their outpost of Kyorlamshin , led by Matron Tanor ' Thal ' s niece of Kesra , they captured any potential slaves that they could and sold them in the bazaars of Skullport .

title: House Teken ' duis
description: House Teken ' duis House Teken ' duis was formerly a noble drow house in the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan . Headquarters . House Teken ' duis resided in a two - stalagmite compound in the northwest part of the city in West Wall .

title: House Teyachumet
description: House Teyachumet House Teyachumet was a deceased drow house of Ched Nasad . History . House Teyachumet was destroyed more than a century before 1366 DR ( that is , sometime before 1266 DR ) .

title: House Thann
description: House Thann Thann was a noble Waterdhavian house that were known as a leading vintner in the Waterdeep region . Activities . The Thann family owned large plots of land to both the north and south of Waterdeep .

title: House Vandree
description: House Vandree House Vandree was the 17th drow house of Menzoberranzan in 1358 DR and therefore one of the minor drow houses in the city . By 1480 DR , it had become the eighth house and thus a member of the Ruling Council . Headquarters .

title: House Veruna
description: House Veruna House Veruna is a very large trading company based in Mulmaster , with several enterprising bases in Moonsea cities . History . In the mid 1470s DR , House Veruna commissioned a compound in the frontier town of Hulburg , with large help from Sergen Hulmaster .

title: House Vyshaan
description: House Vyshaan House Vyshaan were a clan of extremely power hungry sun elves who came to power in ancient Aryvandaar . History . After a time they became corrupt and learned malignant forms of magic from devil s which gave them supreme arcane might .

title: House Xorlarrin
description: House Xorlarrin House Xorlarrin was a drow house formerly of Menzoberranzan . It had been considered the " most magical " house of that city . The entire house relocated to Q ' Xorlarrin in Gauntlgrym in 1484 DR .

title: House Yauntyrr
description: House Yauntyrr House Yauntyrr was a noble house of Eryndlyn until its destruction circa 1362 DR . History . Circa 1362 DR , House Yauntyrr was attacked and defeated .

title: House Zauvirr
description: House Zauvirr House Zauvirr was a minor drow house in Ched Nasad . Description . House Zauvirr was a minor merchant house of Ched Nasad .

title: House of Al - Birar
description: House of Al - Birar The House of Al - Birar was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Through a stroke of cleverness , the House of Al - Birar employed several sha ' ir s and their marid to keep their warehouses cool enough to prevent food spoilage .

title: House of Al - Cinel
description: House of Al - Cinel The House of Al - Cinel was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Cinel was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz .

title: House of Al - Danafi
description: House of Al - Danafi The House of Al - Danafi was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Khwaja al - Danaf and his wife Perijan were the original founders of their house .

title: House of Al - Dinak
description: House of Al - Dinak The House of Al - Dinak was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . After experiencing a slew of devastating caravan attacks , the House of Al - Dinak began hiring adventurers to guard their caravans .

title: House of Al - Farif
description: House of Al - Farif The House of Al - Farif was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Mamluk s of the Diligent Mamluk Society and several sha ' ir s and wind mages were employed to protect their warehouse .

title: House of Al - Kamari
description: House of Al - Kamari The House of Al - Kamari was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . They claimed to make the finest silks in all of Al - Toril . Organization .

title: House of Al - Klemari
description: House of Al - Klemari The House of Al - Klemari was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The House of Al - Klemari was based out of the Warehouse District of Huzuz .

title: House of Al - Thuria
description: House of Al - Thuria The House of Al - Thuria was one of the richest merchant families in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Organization . Each of their three large factories specialized in making leather goods including leather armor , saddles and tack , and sandals and other common items .

title: House of Bhalla
description: House of Bhalla The House of Bhalla was a temple to Chauntea in Immilmar , Rashemen . Structure . The House was a old medium sized stone building near the Iron Lord ' s citadel .

title: House of Firehair
description: House of Firehair The House of Firehair was an enormous fortified cathedral dedicated to Sune that sat atop a pastoral hill in the middle of Daerlun . Structure . Walls surrounded the entire hill that The House of Firehair stood upon , separating it from the rest of Daerlun .

title: House of Galbi
description: House of Galbi The House of Galbi was a notorious establishment found in the city of Manass in Khazari . Activities . Many illicit activities such as gambling and excessive drinking occurred within the House of Galbi .

title: House of Glory
description: House of Glory The House of Glory was a temple to Tempus , the Lord of Battles , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Glory lay on the northeastern edge of the city .

title: House of Heroes
description: House of Heroes The temple of Tempus the lord of battles was located in the Sea ward of Waterdeep . Rebuilt in 1346 DR . after the night of temple - fall in 1345 DR .

title: House of Holy Light
description: House of Holy Light The House of Holy Light was a shrine dedicated to Lathander in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn .

title: House of Holy Suffering
description: House of Holy Suffering The House of Holy Suffering was a temple of Ilmater found in Mussum in the Vilhon Reach . History . The House of Holy Suffering was a major temple in the mid – 13th century DR .

title: House of Hope
description: House of Hope The House of Hope was a temple to Tymora the Luckbringer found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Hope lay on the north side of the Market in the center of Tantras .

title: House of Knowledge ( Neverwinter )
description: House of Knowledge ( Neverwinter ) The House of Knowledge is a temple to Oghma in Neverwinter . It is located at one end of the Dolphin Bridge and is run by Chief Priest Watger Brighthair and Elder Reader Salyndra Shaern , who offer their teachings for free . It is a tall building with many windows and an arched roof .

title: House of Mawli
description: House of Mawli The House of Mawli was an unenlightened tribe inhabiting the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in the 1367 DR . Activities . This tribe was primarily involved in raiding weaker tribes or anyone foolish enough to enter the Haunted Lands without a proper escort .

title: House of Moander
description: House of Moander The House of Moander was a temple of Moander near the town of Ylraphon and the Flooded Forest in the Vast . Location . The House of Moander lay north of Ylraphon , amidst the boggy woodlands beside the Flooded Forest , which encroached on the ruined city ' s northeast .

title: House of Moonlight
description: House of Moonlight The House of Moonlight was a temple to Selûne the Moonmaiden found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Moonlight lay on the far east side of the city .

title: House of Plenty
description: House of Plenty The House of Plenty is a temple of Chauntea in Shadowdale . This is known by the locals as The Garden for its encircling structure of ordered vegetable patches and orchards . The Temple of Chauntea was founded in Shadowdale immediately following the Time of Troubles .

title: House of R ' maga
description: House of R ' maga The House of R ' maga was a renowned porter business found in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Founded by seven ogre brothers in 1357 DR , the House of R ' maga quickly established a well - earned reputation within the Grand Bazaar .

title: House of Safe Rest
description: House of Safe Rest The House of Safe Rest was an inn located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , within the Harbor District on Al - Sarif River . Activities . Though the Harbor District often held a negative reputation , the House of Safe Rest was known to be an affordable place run by a trustworthy individual .

title: House of Scarlet Hooks
description: House of Scarlet Hooks House of the Scarlet Hooks was a temple of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain , in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The temple was managed by Whipmistress Shaleen " Talonkiss " Oomreen . She led twenty - four priests and priestesses , as well as 114 lay worshipers through the mid – 14th century DR .

title: House of Serpents
description: House of Serpents House of Serpents is a trilogy by Lisa Smedman that tells the story of Arvin , a psionically gifted ropemaker from Hlondeth , who gets caught up in the intrigues of the ruling yuan - ti . House of Serpents . The trilogy was republished as an omnibus edition in 2009 .

title: House of Sihr
description: House of Sihr The House of Sihr , also known as the jann of the High Desert , was one of the largest and most powerful groups of jann in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Organization . All jann of the House of Sihr were enlightened .

title: House of Skilled Hands
description: House of Skilled Hands The House of Skilled Hands was a temple to Gond , the Lord of All Smiths , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The House of Skilled Hands sat almost at the end of Whistleturn Way , near the city ' s waterfront .

title: House of Song
description: House of Song The House of Song was the guildhall of the Council of Musicians , Instrument - Makers , and Choristers in Waterdeep . It was located in the city ' s Trade Ward , on the corner of Coach Lamp Lane and Carter ' s Way . Inside , two adjacent columns were paler blue than the others , and there was an old elven song etched near the ceiling here .

title: House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing
description: House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing The House of St . Liwan ' s Blessing was a monastery of Ilmater on the western coast of Calimshan .

title: House of Stone
description: House of Stone The House of Stone , also known as Stoneturn , was an immense square tower on the eastern edge of the Ardeep Forest . Structure . The keep contained hundreds of rooms , halls , temples and towers locked together in a single huge maze .

title: House of Tezca
description: House of Tezca The House of Tezca was a large desert found south of Nexal on the continent of Maztica . History . The desert was named after the Matizcan sun god Tezca .

title: House of Thorne
description: House of Thorne The House of Thorne was a dilapidated old mansion in Waterdeep ' s Sea Ward . Structure . The home was named for the thorn vines that grew on its walls .

title: House of Wo
description: House of Wo The House of Wo was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This four - story structure was capable of lodging hundreds of occupants at the same time , though typically only the cafe was full .

title: House of Wonder
description: House of Wonder The House of Wonder was a mage academy and former temple of Mystra located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Geography . The temple dedicated to Mystra was located on Flint Street and Pharra ' s Alley , which was named after the first mistress of the temple , Pharra .

title: House of the Bright Blade
description: House of the Bright Blade The House of the Bright Blade , run by Zespara Alather , is perhaps the most famous shop in Mirabar among human s . It is widely renowned as the best shop to get a sword that seems as if it were custom - forged for it ' s wielder . The main room of the shop glitters in the steel of hundreds of swords and dagger s of all sizes , finishes and prices .

title: House of the Broken God
description: House of the Broken God The House of the Broken God was a temple , monastery , and hospital dedicated to Ilmater , located in Keltar in Calimshan . It was the largest temple complex of the Broken God , and the center of his faith in southern Faerûn . Location .

title: House of the Four Moons
description: House of the Four Moons The House of the Four Moons was a white - domed temple to Selûne in Velprintalar ( now Old Velprintalar ) , Aglarond . In 1368 DR it was led by High Priestess Dyltharra and served by six other priestesses , who kept contact between the Simbul , the Royal Council of Aglarond and the Harpers .

title: House of the Hand
description: House of the Hand The House of the Hand was a temple of Torm in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Clerics of the House of the Hand forged the sword " Chalsembyr ' s Heart " for the paladin Bertold the Seeker , to aid him in his quest to discover the lost kingdom of Chalsembyr .

title: House of the Harmed
description: House of the Harmed The House of the Harmed was a temple of Ilmater found in Aralent , home to the well - respected priest Master Sufferer Olbedan . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan at the House of the Harmed in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers and never made it to Olbedan .

title: House of the Helm
description: House of the Helm The House of the Helm was a shrine dedicated to Tempus in Voonlar . Location . Voonlar was a trading town and farming community located in the southwest corner of the Moonsea region of north Faerûn .

title: House of the Iron Rose
description: House of the Iron Rose The House of the Iron Rose was a sumptuous boarding house in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Typically , only ranking officers and wealthy adventurers stayed there . The House of the Iron Rose offered the finest quality accommodations to those willing to pay for excellence .

title: House of the Loregiver
description: House of the Loregiver The House of the Loregiver was a sacred site to Enlightened Zakharans found within the Golden Mosque in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This building could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: House of the Master ' s Shadow ( Telflamm )
description: House of the Master ' s Shadow ( Telflamm ) The House of the Master ' s Shadow is a temple of Mask in Telflamm . The House serves as the headquarters of the local thieves guild , led by the Shadowmasters of Telflamm . The House looks like any other temple in Telflamm , except that it has no locks .

title: House of the Triad
description: House of the Triad The House of the Triad exemplifies the rule of law upholding the principles of good . It is a resplendent plane of majestic marble halls , gleaming palaces , and heavenly radiance . Inhabitants .

title: House of the Wise Unicorn
description: House of the Wise Unicorn The House of the Wise Unicorn is a rental club in Nesmé run by Nistlor Lothlyn , who is assisted by sixteen guards . No spellcasting is allowed within the premises . Services .

title: Hovering road
description: Hovering road Hovering road was a conjuration spell that temporarily created a smooth stone road that hovered above any terrain . Effects . Similar to " clear path " , this spell operated on the 10 ft by 10 ft ( 3 m by 3 m ) area directly in front of the caster and extended outward as the caster moved forward .

title: Howard Baker
description: Howard Baker Howard Baker was a halfling who owned and operated a fabulous pastry shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Howard exemplified the ethics of Durparian merchants by never overcharging for a pastry he deemed less than perfect .

title: Howard Holiday
description: Howard Holiday Howard Holiday was the Deputy Mayor of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? .

title: Howl of Vengeance
description: Howl of Vengeance The Howl of Vengeance was a conflict fought in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) , waged between those who ' d conquered the kingdom of Doegan and those who sought to liberate it . Notably , it was fought with basal golem s mass - produced by bloodforge s . Location .

title: Howling Gap
description: Howling Gap The Howling Gap was a passage between the Teyla Shan and the Raurin Alta mountains , and was the primary trade passage between Semphar and the east . Description . Created by the space between the Teyla Shan and the Raurin Alta mountain ranges , too broad to be considered a pass , the Howling Gap sat along the the Silk Road that connected Semphar to the lands of Shou Lung , and served as the primary route of travel between the two nations .

title: Howling Mountains
description: Howling Mountains The Howling Mountains were a vast range of mountains located in northern Returned Abeir . The nations of Fimbrul and Relmaur were located within its mountains . Most of the forbidden primordial cults of Returned Abeir operated out in the Howling Mountains .

title: Howling Wing
description: Howling Wing The Howling Wing was a small band of kir - lanan that laired at the Wailing Cliff , in the Deep Wastes . They were led by a powerful kir - lanan called Ghindul . Organization .

title: Hoxitl
description: Hoxitl Hoxitl was the high priest of Zaltec in Nexal . Activities . Hoxitl was the leader of the faith of Zaltec over all Maztica .

title: Hrar
description: Hrar Hrar was a bugbear chieftain . History . Hrar was a bugbear chieftain .

title: Hrarnok Sharkchum
description: Hrarnok Sharkchum Hrarnok Sharkchum was a lesser seawolf member of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Hrarnok was for many years the bosun of the Sembian vessel " Harbor Moon " in the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Hrimnir
description: Hrimnir Hrimnir was a frost giant living in the Icespire Peak in 1480 DR . History . When the Icehammer dwarves of Icespire Peak discovered the Winterforge artifact and the frozen body of Lakkar , Hriminir dreamed of recreating Lakkar ' s exploits .

title: Hrolf
description: Hrolf Hrolf the Unruly was a human captain of the Ruathen pirate ship " Elfmaid " . Description . The captain was a large , broad - shouldered man with skin tanned by the sun and wind .

title: Hrothgar
description: Hrothgar Hrothgar was a human adventurer from Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The soldier was a powerfully built man who wore heavy armor , like plate mail .

title: Hrotun
description: Hrotun Hrotun was the very first frost giant skald . Relationships . Hrotun was the son of Ottar , making him one of the second generation of giants to live on Toril .

title: Hruggek
description: Hruggek Hruggek was the chief deity of bugbear s , and was the god of violence and combat , as well as an exarch of the greater god Bane . Other gods worshiped by the bugbears included Grankhul , the god of hunting , senses , and surprise ; and Skiggaret , the god of fear . Prior to relocating to Banehold , Hruggek lived in a large cave in Pandemonium called Hruggekolohk .

title: Hruk
description: Hruk Hruk was a hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Chief Guh took Hruk from his wife Moog as her own husband , like many others .

title: Hrusse
description: Hrusse Hrusse , usually known as Hrusse of Assuran , was cleric member of the Gray Hands in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Hrusse was a vengeful , intense , and driven man .

title: Hsao Chronicles
description: Hsao Chronicles Hsao Chronicles was an influential text of the Way written by Hu Ling Do of T ' u Lung in Shou Year 935 ( −315 DR ) . In prompted a strong following of the Way in southern Shou Lung . In its pages , " Hsao Chronicles " examined various " Images " of nature , finding within them metaphors and drawing conclusions for the " superior man " who followed the Way .

title: Hsi Yog
description: Hsi Yog Hsi Yog was a Tuigan shugenja and member of the Grand Army of the Tuigan during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Hsi used his clerical powers to aid the soldiers of the army under Prince Hubadai Khahan ' s command .

title: Hsin Fu Chan
description: Hsin Fu Chan Hsin Fu Chan was a sage of Shou Lung who wrote the " Book of Change " , which detailed a system of divination through the use of trigrams . Legend told that Hsin Fu Chan discerned the trigrams from patterns in the back of a great lizard as it slept .

title: Hsiung chi Kang
description: Hsiung chi Kang Hsiung chi Kang was a samurai in Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Hsiung was a young noble indulging in flirtation , strutting , drinking , and gossiping .

title: Hsskala
description: Hsskala Hsskala ( " nearkill " in the Common tongue ) was a positoxin that would render an undead creature unconscious . It was created by the half - fiend yuan - ti Kharantes , who used to in 1375 DR to render the sarrukh lord , King Oreme , incapacitated . Kharantes plan was foiled shortly thereafter by a group of adventurers seeking King Oreme for his council .

title: Hssthak
description: Hssthak Hssthak ( Eeesss - TAK ) was a sarrukh mummy and believed himself to be the last survivor of the empire of Isstosseffifil . Description . At first glance , Hssthak appeared human under his loose wrappings , but the bony tail and dry , snake - like skin drawn taut over his skeleton quickly dispelled that impression .

title: Hsuan Yu Po
description: Hsuan Yu Po Hsuan Yu Po was a noble of Shou Lung . History . Hsuan was a noble and a general in the province of Chukei .

title: Hu
description: Hu Hu was a sea captain in 1358 DR . Activities . Hu was a Wanese captain in service to the mercantile Ko clan , commanding the " Victorious Morning " ship .

title: Hu ' i Wing
description: Hu ' i Wing The Hu ' i Wing was an old artifact from Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was said to reveal the future , and was the most valuable relic of the kingdom of Koryo . Description .

title: Hu Chien
description: Hu Chien Hu Chien was a Shou wu jen in Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Hu Chien arrived in Okahira and so impressed the shugo - matadai Kadokawa Shigetada that he became his principal counselor .

title: Hu Don
description: Hu Don Hu Don was a bushi in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Hu Don was a bushi in the town of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung .

title: Hu Ling Do
description: Hu Ling Do Hu Ling Do was a writer of T ' u Lung and a follower of the Way . In Shou Year 935 ( −315 DR ) , Hu Ling Do wrote " Hsao Chronicles " , an influential text of the Way that prompted a strong following of the Way in southern Shou Lung .

title: Huacli
description: Huacli Huacli was a nation in Maztica . It was composed of six city - states , five of which were former vassals of Nexal . With the demise of Nexal as a power , all of the Huacli cities banded together again under the leadership of the Otomis , the people of the only city state never to have been conquered .

title: Huakal
description: Huakal Huakal was a former Eagle Knight at Kultaka . History . Huakal was a valorous Eagle Knight until he retired because of old age .

title: Huang Ch ' ung
description: Huang Ch ' ung Huang Ch ' ung was a sohei in Shou Lung in 1357 DR . History . Ch ' ung born in a year of great famine so his clan decided to consecrate him to the Dragon Monastery in Kuo Te ' Lung .

title: Huat Rhu
description: Huat Rhu Huat Rhu was a famed general of the kingdom of Koguryo in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Huat Rhu once led his soldiers on an expedition into the Naktong Moors . They never returned .

title: Hubadai Khahan
description: Hubadai Khahan Prince Hubadai Khahan was a Tuigan warrior and the son of Yamun Khahan during the mid 14th century DR . Personality . Hubadai was a strict commander , making him a challenging enemy .

title: Hudid
description: Hudid Hudid , also called the " City of Humility " , was one of the Cities of the Pantheon . It was famous for its trade in exotic goods and for featuring the most important university in all of Zakhara . Geography .

title: Hudkin Moadi
description: Hudkin Moadi Hudkin Moadi was the halfling mayor of the city of Krenadir in Luiren in 1367 DR . Activities . Hudkin hated adventurer s of all types , and sent many to their deaths on foolhardy quests within the Mortick Swamp .

title: Huerbara
description: Huerbara Huerbara was a young able malaugrym with a bad temper in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , during the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Huerbara was speaking with Neleyd when the elder Bheloris approached them , proposing to hatch a plan together to increase the chance of their success in the hunt .

title: Hukdon
description: Hukdon Hukdon was a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Hukdon was very ill - mannered but he thought of himself as funny and likeable .

title: Hulburg
description: Hulburg Hulburg was a small city on the northeastern shore of the Moonsea of north Faerûn . Description . Griffonwatch Keep , the ancestral home of the Hulmasters , sat on a rocky outcrop on the eastern edge of the city .

title: Hulda
description: Hulda Hulda was a stone giant who helped Blagothkus in managing the flying Skyreach Castle . Personality . Hulda was very concerned about Blagothkus ' plan to ally with dragon s and the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Hulgen Proudfist
description: Hulgen Proudfist Hulgen Proudfist was the leader of a large group of half - orc s in the Tower District of Neverwinter , the so - called Proudfist Tribe . Personality . Hulgen led his " tribe " in order to increase the importance of the half - orcs in the city .

title: Hullack Forest
description: Hullack Forest The Hullack Forest was once a part of the huge forest of Cormanthor and marks the northeastern border of Cormyr and the Dales . It was the most primeval forest in all of Cormyr , with numerous dark valleys and hidden vales that went unseen for decades and was likely among the most dangerous regions of Cormyr . Legends stated that it was full of ghosts and monsters .

title: Hullack Trail
description: Hullack Trail The Hullack Trail was a trail running through southeastern Cormyr . Locations . Following the shores of the Thunder River , Wyvernwater , and the Wyvernflow , it linked Thunderstone , Hultail , Juniril , and Wheloon , as well as the Unknown Shrine , via short connecting trails .

title: Hulmaster
description: Hulmaster The Hulmaster family is the ruling family of the town of Hulburg , on the northeast shores of the Moonsea . The line began with Ivar Nanthon , who changed his surname to Hulmaster after the lich Aesperus ( who was also his uncle ) " granted " him the right to rule in the Year of the Keening Gale .

title: Hulraven Irlingstar
description: Hulraven Irlingstar Hulraven Irlingstar was the patriarch of House Irlingstar in Waterdeep in 1374 . Personality . Hulraven was still a very cunning individual , though the years were starting to tell on him .

title: Hulzimmer Atharn
description: Hulzimmer Atharn Hulzimmer Atharn was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . Powers . He specialized in magic that transformed men into monsters , or at least gained for mages a semblance of beast - powers .

title: Human
description: Human Humans in Toril are widespread , can be found in most regions and , in general , are fierce and disagreeable , which can sometimes lead certain other races to view them with contempt . They are renowned for their diversity and ambition , and although they lack specialization , they can excel in many areas . History .

title: Humanoid
description: Humanoid A humanoid was a type of creature shaped generally like a human ; with two arms , two legs , one head , or a human - like torso , arms and head . Humanoids were often roughly - human sized though some were enormous , such as titan s , or miniscule like fairies . Most humanoids were capable of speech and had well - developed societies .

title: Humility
description: Humility Bodies are being found in the city of Loudwater with their brains extracted . Considering the trouble with Mind flayer s that has been experienced lately , it is fairly clear what is responsible . High lord Kalahar Twohands also has a spy in the Zhentarim who has suddenly stopped feeding him information .

title: Hun - kho
description: Hun - kho Hun - kho was a legendary war chief of the Kalmyr tribe in the Hordelands . History . Hun - kho was a great conqueror of the steppe nomads , reaching as far as the Dragonwall to the east .

title: Hundelstone
description: Hundelstone Hundelstone was a trade town of 1 , 200 gnome s , dwarves , and human s located at the western edge of the Spine of the World along the Ten Trail . Description . The town ' s buildings were built low to the ground , with the majority of living space consisting of cellar rooms cut into the rock .

title: Hundred lotus
description: Hundred lotus Hundred Lotus was a sutra that would cause pain to an evil spirit . Realmslore . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , the lama Koja of Khazari chanted the Hundred Lotus sutra when confronted by a mysterious woman with a magical feast , to test if she was an evil spirit .

title: Hunger of Hadar
description: Hunger of Hadar Hunger of Hadar was a conjuration spell for warlock s that used the power of Hadar , the Dark Hunger . Effect . The spell caused a 20 - foot ( 6 - meter ) radius spherical gateway of utter darkness to appear and stay open for one minute , or for as longer as the caster concentrated .

title: Hungry Man
description: Hungry Man < / ref > Inn The Hungry Man , also known as the Hungry Man Inn , was a restaurant located in the city of Arabel . Inhabitants . The proprietor was the elderly woman Zehla .

title: Hungtse River
description: Hungtse River The Hungtse River was one of the largest rivers on Toril , spanning over a thousand miles across both the Hordelands and Kara - Tur . As it neared the territories of the Hordelands , the river was often called the Upper Hungtse River . Geography .

title: Hunt Trail
description: Hunt Trail The Hunt Trail ran through the Vast , connecting the towns of Ylraphon and Kurth . From west to east , it began at Ylraphon , passed the Flooded Forest , ran through the Tavilar and Beluar ' s Hunt and ended at Kurth . On the way , it joined the Pass Trail and the North Road .

title: Huntcrown
description: Huntcrown Huntcrown was a noble house of Cormyr whose seat was in Suzail . The Huntcrowns were enobled during reign of King Duar in 429 DR . During the Abraxus affair , the family was apparently among those that favored a ruling council for Cormyr rather than any regency or rule by a female .

title: Hunter ' s mercy
description: Hunter ' s mercy Hunter ' s mercy was a transmutation spell granted uniquely to ranger s by their deities . Effects . After a prayer for mercy , a ranger ' s next shot with a bow , if taken quickly , would not miss and had a good chance of inflicting critical damage to its target .

title: Huntsilver
description: Huntsilver Huntsilver was a noble house of Cormyr . An " old blood " family , it was considered one of the Royal Houses , owing to its close ties to the Obarskyr royal line . Base .

title: Hupe Brightbell
description: Hupe Brightbell Hupe Brightbell was a halfling innkeeper in Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Hupe was a painfully meek little man .

title: Hurashum
description: Hurashum Hurashum was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Hurashum was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Hurbold Duethkatha
description: Hurbold Duethkatha Hurbold Duethkatha , or Scar , was a commander of the Flaming Fist mercenary company . Relationships . He was a close friend of Duke Eltan .

title: Hurc
description: Hurc Hurc was a confident kobold who participated in the attack on Hilltop in 1372 DR . Hurc and a small band of his fellow kobolds got separated from the main group , and barricaded themselves in the kitchen of the Bubbling Cauldron tavern , taking the chef Mara as hostage .

title: Hurgan Stoneblade
description: Hurgan Stoneblade Hurgan Stoneblade was a dwarf living in Ulgoth ' s Beard . History . Hurgan recruited Gorion ' s Ward to retrieve the Soultaker dagger from the Durlag ' s Tower .

title: Hurm Thiodor
description: Hurm Thiodor Hurm Thiodor was a male human fighter in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr . He was the local clerk and official of the crown and the unofficial Herald in the late 1360s DR . Activities .

title: Hurn
description: Hurn Hurn was a dwarf knight in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Hurn was an old and unfriendly individual , only wanting to reach his retirement day .

title: Husam Alin
description: Husam Alin Husam Alin ran a large tour guide business from the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Husam employed over 50 youths to guide pilgrims around the popular spots of the City of Delights .

title: Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim
description: Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim Great Caliph Husam al - Balil ben Nafhat al - Yugayyim was the brilliant but flighty ruler of the djinn . Activities .
