The Great Caliph spent most of his time in the center of his fortress , the Citadel of Ice and Steel , ruling upon legal , political , and strategic issues of the djinn .

title: Husam al - Jana
description: Husam al - Jana Husam al - Jana was a winged cat who lived in the Royal Harim of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Husam prowled the halls of the harem searching for intruders .

title: Husijo
description: Husijo Husijo was a villager of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Husijo managed a small shop in the Zuke village .

title: Hustil Benzur
description: Hustil Benzur Hustil Benzur was a Zhentarim agent in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Hustil usually resided at the River Shining Tavern , posing as an agent working for Amn ian investors .

title: Husuf el Halid
description: Husuf el Halid Husuf yn Harun el Halid was the Nirdey of the Emerald Ward in Calimport for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Husuf was the handsome son of a renowned moneylender of Calimport .

title: Huum
description: Huum Huum was a male mind flayer who resided in Sporedome . Description . Purple - skinned and hairless , Huum ' s tentacles writhed around his mouth .

title: Huzuz
description: Huzuz Located at the narrow straits between the Golden Gulf and Suq Bay , Huzuz was Zakhara ' s greatest city . The spectacular view of its gleaming spires could be seen for miles across the water . It was the place where the first Grand Caliph had the vision of the Loregiver , gaining Fate ' s wisdom and the Law .

title: Huzza
description: Huzza Huzza was a hill giant pirate in the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . History . Huzza originally hailed from the Earthspur Mountains , where he lorded over a tribe of goblin s .

title: Hyaline
description: Hyaline Hyaline was a milky or white form of and was usually cut as plates for inlays or cut and mounted in a silver setting . Description . The milkiness of these ornamental stones was caused by tiny droplets of water or carbon dioxide trapped in the crystals .

title: Hybsil
description: Hybsil Hybsils were small fey creatures native to numerous forests in Faerûn . Description . Hybsils appeared as a cross between a small antelope and a pixie , like a centaur but with the bodies of small deer instead of horses .

title: Hydee
description: Hydee Hydee was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport around 1370 DR . Activities . Hydee was a cleric of Loviatar and acted in a supportive role to a Hand ' s team .

title: Hydel Pontifax
description: Hydel Pontifax Sir Hydel Pontifax was a deceased adventurer . Personality . He was a devoted follower of Mystra .

title: Hydia Moonmusk
description: Hydia Moonmusk Hidya Moonmusk was the leader of Blue Bear Tribe allied with the stone giant s . Personality . Hidya , like most of her tribe , agreed with the stone giant thane Kayalithica that civilization must be destroyed .

title: Hydra
description: Hydra Hydras were a breed of reptilian magical beast that had anywhere from five to twelve heads . Ecology . Hydras typically lived alone in fetid swamps and waterways and were generally always the most dangerous predator in whatever area they inhabited .

title: Hydrophane
description: Hydrophane Hydrophane was a variety of opal that was highly prized by sailors and the aquatic races of Faerûn because its true beauty was only visible when wet . Description . This semi - precious stone was typically used for inlay work or cut cabochon for jewelry .

title: Hyena
description: Hyena A hyena was a type of pack animal known for its shrewdness and hunting skills and for its disturbing laugh - like call . Description . Hyenas came in different varieties but commonly had stripes on their fur , weighing about 120 pounds ( 55 kilograms ) and measuring a about a yard ( meter ) in length .

title: Hykopgruk
description: Hykopgruk Hykopgruk was an Iulutiun village known for the quality of its kayaks . Geography . Hykopgrukwas located in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier , on the southwestern shore of the Lugalpgotak Sea and north of the Surykyk Range .

title: Hykros Allumen
description: Hykros Allumen Hykros Allumen was the high priest of the Hall of Justice of Tyr in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Hykros was a devoted follower of Tyr and a bastion of law in Waterdeep .

title: Hypersthene
description: Hypersthene Hypersthene , also known as , was a gemstone usually cut . Description . This semi - precious stone was brown and opaque ( sometimes reddish or greenish ) and contained silvery spangles .

title: Hypnotic pattern
description: Hypnotic pattern Hypnptic pattern was an illusion spell that could incapacitate multiple creatures . Effects . The spellcaster created a pattern of twisting colors that lasted for just a moment .

title: Hyraken ( lord )
description: Hyraken ( lord ) Lord Hyraken of Hilp was one of the leaders of the Freedom Warriors in the political aftermath of the Goblin War . According to Lady Kestrel Vaylan , he was a cruel man who worked his servants to death and consorted with priestesses of Loviatar . Rumors said that his hatred of Regent Alusair Obarskyr was due to her rejection of a proposal of marriage in the 1360s DR .

title: Hyuth Kolstaag
description: Hyuth Kolstaag Hyuth Kolstaag was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Hyuth was an adventurer until in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR rich he retired and settled in Triboar .

title: I ' m Quite the Red - Roof Girl
description: I ' m Quite the Red - Roof Girl " I ' m Quite The Red - Roof Girl " was a bawdy song favored in the more disreputable parts of the city of Procampur in the Vast and sung by the mid - 13th century DR . It described the red - roof girls of the city ' s Adventurers ' District . In the Year of Burning Steel , 1246 DR , Ivy of the Siegebreakers learned it from a minstrel in a Procampan military camp .

title: I ' tiraf
description: I ' tiraf The large city of I ' tiraf served as the capital of the federation of Pantheist cities , with the League Conclave located here . Geography . It lay at the banks of Al - Hadi River , directly across the Golden Gulf from the Pearl City of Jumlat .

title: Iados
description: Iados Iados was a tiefling warrior and a companion of the dragonborn paladin Thava . He was an old friend of the monk Kwan Shang - Li and joined forces with him to defeat Caelynna and recover several rare tomes belonging to the Standing Tree Monastery . Appearance .

title: Iakhovas
description: Iakhovas Iakhovas was an ancient megalodon . Not much was truly known of his long history but it is known that he was responsible for devastating attacks on coastal cities and was also the instigator of the Twelfth Serôs War . Biography .

title: Iallanis
description: Iallanis Iallanis was the giant goddess of love and mercy . She always sought to reunite the giant races under a single banner , with the hopes that they could live in harmony forevermore . Her holy symbol was a garland of flowers .

title: Ian Harman
description: Ian Harman Ian Harman was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Ian was a member of the militia of West Harbor .

title: Iarno Albrek
description: Iarno Albrek Iarno Albrek , also known as " Glasstaff " , was a human wizard and the direct leader of the Redbrands bandit gang . He was a short , dark - bearded human wizard that was simply known to most as " Glasstaff " for his weapon of choice , a magic staff made of glass . Iarno was initially a member of the Lords ' Alliance , who was sent to the town of Phandalin to establish constabulary ( as the town did not have a powerful authority ) .

title: Ibin Stormrider
description: Ibin Stormrider Ibin Stormrider was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . When the king of the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix was slain , Ibin Stormrider was the most dangerous of the opportunists who gathered around the dead king ' s throne . In order that a goblin might claim the throne , the commander of the Legendary Campaign returned to Nix to drive away Ibin and the rest in bloodforge battle .

title: Ibn
description: Ibn Ibn was first mate under Captain Hrolf on the Ruathen pirate ship " Elfmaid " . Description . Ibn had fair ruddy skin , blue eyes , and a red beard .

title: Ibrandul
description: Ibrandul Ibrandul ( " Ih - BRAN - duhl " ) was a chaotic neutral lesser deity of the Underdark , worshiped in Calimshan and other parts of the Shining South . Worshipers . Ibrandul was worshipped as a deity with power over the underground , darkness and stealth in the Shining South and by the Calishite s .

title: Ibtisam bint Latifa
description: Ibtisam bint Latifa Ibtisam bint Latifa was a clothing designer who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Ibtisam ' s real skill revolved around her ability to pick specific clothing to suit each customer and their particular body shape .

title: Icasaracht
description: Icasaracht Icasaracht was a white dragon who lived in the northern region of Icewind Dale . She was said to be the matron mother of the white wyrms . History .

title: Ice Run
description: Ice Run The Ice Run was a network of tunnels and sunken trails in the Great Glacier , beside Vaasa in north Faerûn . Geography . The Ice Run was a network of ice - walled pathways stretching all along the face of the Great Glacier .

title: Ice Spire ogre
description: Ice Spire ogre Ice Spire ogres were bigger , smarter , and more dangerous than their more numerous cousins . History . Much of the history of the Ice Spire ogres was unknown to human chroniclers , but some relatively later events were common knowledge .

title: Ice axe ( spell )
description: Ice axe ( spell ) Ice axe was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It created a whirling cloud of ice slivers shaped like a battleaxe that the caster could wield with proficiency . Effects .

title: Ice blade
description: Ice blade Ice blade was a divine magic spell given to specialty priest s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It produced whirling formation of ice crystals in the shape of a sword that the caster could wield with great skill . Effects .

title: Ice box
description: Ice box An ice box was a quasimagical item invented in Netheril to allow people to preserve food by keeping it cool . Description . An " ice box " was roughly the shape of a coffin and was constructed from a material with about the same thickness and strength as hardened clay .

title: Ice dagger
description: Ice dagger Ice dagger was an evocation spell used by arcane spellcaster in the Forgotten Realms . Effects . Using a few drops of water , the spellcaster would shape a dagger - shaped shard of ice , which would then launch itself inerrantly at a target within close range and explode upon impact , causing cold damage to the target and an area within a five - foot ( one - and - a - half - meter ) radius .

title: Ice dragon ' s teeth
description: Ice dragon ' s teeth Ice dragon ' s teeth is conjuration spell used by several young or inexperienced sorcerer s . When " ice dragon ' s teeth " is cast , the dragon causes tooth - like daggers of ice to surge outwards from the body of any creature within a zone of five feet in diameter that is no more than fifty feet from the sorcerer . As a result of this attack , any affected are not only injured , but find their movements slowed slightly for a brief moment .

title: Ice gauntlet
description: Ice gauntlet Ice gauntlet was a divine magic spell available to cleric s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It encased one of the caster ' s fists in a spike - covered ball of ice that was an effective melee weapon . Effects .

title: Ice genasi
description: Ice genasi An ice genasi , or ice para - genasi , was a sub - race of the genasi . It was a para - genasi , meaning that it was descended from two different elemental outsider s , namely an outsider of elemental air and an outsider of elemental water , forming para - elemental ice . Personality .

title: Ice storm
description: Ice storm Ice storm , formerly known as Veridon ' s storm , was an evocation spell that blasted an area with hail . Effect . The spell caused large hailstones to pound down over an area , dealing both impact and cold damage to creatures in their path .

title: Ice troll
description: Ice troll Ice trolls were a type of troll that inhabited the cold north . Society . Like all troll s , they were meat eaters and would gladly consume anything , even humanoid s .

title: Icelace Lake
description: Icelace Lake Icelace Lake was a frigid lake in Narfell that was created from runoff from the Great Glacier . Description . The body of Icelace Lake was long and thin , almost resembling a bloated river .

title: Icelace River
description: Icelace River The Icelace River flowed southwest down from the Great Glacier , through the far western part of Narfell and into central Damara . It flowed fast enough so that it never froze over , even in the harshest of winters and was deadly cold if someone fell in , making it useful for protecting the northeastern border of Damara from aggressive Nar tribes . If the river was needed to repel the tribesmen and blightlords , king Gareth Dragonsbane of Damara would have expanded his borders to better defend the river .

title: Icelance
description: Icelance Icelance was an alteration spell that created a magical lance from an existing supply of ice which then flew off to strike a chosen target . Effects . This spell required a supply of approximately 10 lbs ( 4 .

title: Icelin Tearn
description: Icelin Tearn Icelin Tearn is a human wizard from Waterdeep . She has a spellscar which makes her magic much more powerful than it would otherwise be . However , her magic often runs wild and she has a difficult time controlling the effects of her spells .

title: Icerim Mountains
description: Icerim Mountains The Icerim Mountains were located in the far northern expanses of the Hordelands bordering Narfell and Rashemen . Geography . These mountains were once part of the Great Glacier , but a recession of the ice over the centuries had separated the Icerim .

title: Icewind Dale
description: Icewind Dale Icewind Dale was an arctic region , along the northernmost part of the Sword Coast . History . The region was first populated when Northlander longships reached the region during the last centuries of the Illefarn empire .

title: Icewind Dale ( game )
description: Icewind Dale ( game ) Icewind Dale is a computer role - playing game developed by Black Isle Studios , released in June 2000 . The first game in the " Icewind Dale " series , it features tactical , party - based combat based on 2nd edition " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " . The game ' s story is set in the Icewind Dale region on the northern Sword Coast , several decades prior to the events of the popular Icewind Dale trilogy of novels " Icewind Dale " received two expansion packs : " " and " " , and was followed by the sequel " Icewind Dale II " in 2002 .

title: Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter
description: Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter Icewind Dale : Heart of Winter was the expansion pack for the year 2000 game Icewind Dale . Summary . The expansion to Icewind Dale involves stopping the white dragon Icasaracht from causing the possessed barbarian chieftain , Wylfdene to attack the Ten Towns .

title: Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster
description: Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster Icewind Dale : Trials of the Luremaster was a downloadable expansion pack for set in the Anauroch desert , rather than the standard locale of the games namesake , Icewind Dale . Summary . Heart of Winter was deemed too short ( especially in comparison to other Black Isle expansions like ) so a free downloadable addition was made called Trials of the Luremaster .

title: Icewind Dale II
description: Icewind Dale II Icewind Dale II is the sequel to " Icewind Dale . " It is set around 30 years after the events of the original game . Its plot revolves around a goblin uprising in the North , known as the Legion of the Chimera which threatens to overrun the Ten Towns if not stopped .

title: Ichi ( korobokuru )
description: Ichi ( korobokuru ) Ichi was a korobokuru yakuza in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Ichi was a kobun of the Big Head gang .

title: Ichi Krijiku
description: Ichi Krijiku Ichi Krijiku was a bushi of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Ichi Krijiku led the Soldiers of Iron kabukimono of the village of Seinin in Fochu Peninsula .

title: Icingdeath
description: Icingdeath Icingdeath was the nickname for Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s main right - hand scimitar . Description . The hilt of this scimitar was black adamantite and the blade was made of silver with a diamond edge .

title: Icy - White
description: Icy - White Ice - White was an ice mephit in the Samek Valley . History . In 1366 DR , Icy - White acted as assistant to the gelugon Vreesar in his plan to conquer the Samek Valley .

title: Icy Claws
description: Icy Claws The Icy Claws of Iyraclea were a group of gelugon s who served the self - proclaimed Ice Queen Iyraclea on the Great Glacier . Description . Each of the Icy Claws was more powerful and better trained then the typical ice devil from Cania would be .

title: Icy rays
description: Icy rays Icy rays is a spell used by some young or inexperienced wizard s . When cast , " icy rays " causes two bolts of bright , frigid energy to shoot out from the wizard ' s location and towards a spot somewhere within fifty feet of him or her . Bluish - white in color , these rays can strike one or two targets , though only one ray can be used on any one target .

title: Icy terrain
description: Icy terrain Icy terrain is an evocation spell learned by some wizard ly initiates that uses cold terrain to impede the wizard ' s foes . When a wizard casts " icy terrain " he or she fills a small area within fifty feet with a thick layer of ice , which causes any creatures within the area ' s five foot diameter without fast enough reflexes to slip and fall to the ground . For the next few moments the affected terrain provides a small impedement to enemy movement .

title: Idalia ' s flute
description: Idalia ' s flute Idalia ' s flute was a magical flute that affected a person ' s emotions . Description . Idalia ' s flute was a small and rather ordinary - looking flute carved from a piece of gray driftwood .

title: Idea
description: Idea Idea was a divination spell that monk s could use to gain a burst of inspiration toward solving a problem . Effects . This spell induced a clarity of thought in the caster that could be used to prompt a memory of a forgotten detail or overlooked clue that was relevant to solving a conundrum .

title: Identify
description: Identify Identify is a divination spell that determines a single feature of a magic item . Identify is an uncommon spell in the Realms , though not a popular one . Effect .

title: Ido Kunarakuai
description: Ido Kunarakuai Ido Kunarakuai was a judge in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Ido Kunarakuai was the chief justice of the executive hyojosho court in Uwaji .

title: Idolflow
description: Idolflow The Idolflow was a river in eastern Tethyr that fed into the Gorge of the Fallen Idol . Geography . The river was fed by the longer Levast River .

title: Idriane Nethis
description: Idriane Nethis Idriane Nethis was a female human rogue who was an operative for the Shadow Thieves in Beregost . Description . Idriane was tall and thin with shiny black hair and beady dark eyes .

title: Idris
description: Idris Idris was a Netherese necromancer who lived in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . In the village of Ebon Downs on the High Road , she found a powerful artifact known as the Deathknell and with it Idris made pacts with the Barrow Lords of Ebon Downs , seeking to build an army of undead to strike at their Thayan foes . However , the appearance of this undead army alarmed Lord Dagult Neverember , who sent a contingent of his army to stop them , accompanied by Doomguide Vesper Soulhearth .

title: Ieirithymbul
description: Ieirithymbul Ieirithymbul was a gnome mining village in the western Sword Mountains . Trade . There were rich coal , copper and iron deposits in the area .

title: If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair
description: If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair R . A . Salvatore along with Ed Greenwood , Margaret Weis , and Tracy Hickman had the idea of doing a book together .

title: Iftuu
description: Iftuu Iftuu was a drow soldier involved in Vierna Do ' Urden ' s scheme to capture her brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in Mithral Hall . History . In 1357 DR , Jarlaxle and his Bregan D ' aerthe helped Vierna Do ' Urden track down Drizzt with the aid of Artemis Entreri .

title: Igan Sokol
description: Igan Sokol Igan Sokol was the quartermaster of Sokol Keep in Phlan until 1489 DR . History . Igan was a scion of the mercantile House Sokol .

title: Igi Saturo
description: Igi Saturo Igi Saturo was a monk and former samurai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Saturo was the head of the Igi clan until he retired to become a monk at the Konjo Provincial Monastery .

title: Igi Tajima
description: Igi Tajima Igi Tajima was the deputy governor of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Tajima hailed from Igi clan , originally a samurai clan that thanks to good marriage became a branch of the Tsu family .

title: Igi clan
description: Igi clan The Igi clan was a samurai clan that became a noble house thanks to a marriage with the Tsu family in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . They controlled the mokudai position and tried to acquire as many zussho positions as possible . They cared almost nothing about the shogun and shikken , and concentrated their efforts only in Miyama .

title: Ignace Dethingeller
description: Ignace Dethingeller Ignace Dethingeller was a Loremaster that is known through his communications to Tethtoril , the First Reader of Candlekeep . In one letter he had journeyed north of Fort Flame to an unnamed island where a the wreckage of a flying ship was discovered . Due to a journal that Dethingeller was able to recover he learned that the ship had been captained by Eartharran Neirdre from Evermeet and that it had crashed after battle with a wing of wyrms .

title: Ignar Turc Abolin
description: Ignar Turc Abolin Ignar Turc Abolin was a mage from Kara - Tur who inhabited the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Description . Ignar was gaunt and always garbed in dark robes that shielded his face .

title: Ignatia
description: Ignatia Ignatia was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Ignatia led the warriors at the temple and commanded the hobgoblin s of the south barracks .

title: Ignidraco
description: Ignidraco The Ignidraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . Ecology . Scholars from Candlekeep theorized that " ignidracos " had an evolved digestive tract that enabled them to regurgitate intestinal gas and ignite it with an enzymatic , hypergolic reaction in the back of their throats , making them capable of breathe out blasts of fire .

title: Ihtafeer
description: Ihtafeer Ihtafeer was a female rakshasa who posed as Adratha , the potion seller at Druid Grove , after killing the original . She was an enemy of the dao of Khan Zahraa . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward became involved with the dao , who asked him to find and kill Ihtafeer .

title: Ihundyl
description: Ihundyl Ihundyl was a powerful male wizard who named himself ruler of the Calishar Emirates and was considered one of the most powerful wizards of his age . History . In 223 DR , Ihundyl , the Mad Mage , was exiled from the Calishite city of Volothamp for his monstrous experiments and his inability to control creatures he summoned from the Abyss .

title: Ikemmu
description: Ikemmu Ikemmu was a city located in the Underdark deep under Aglarond . It was unique in that it existed in both the Underdark and the Shadowfell at the same time . There was a portal known as the veil between the Shadowfell and the Prime Material Plane .

title: Ikitipsa
description: Ikitipsa Ikitipsa was an evil bent priest ess in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . In 1359 DR , Ikitipsa sent a farastu onto the Sun Trail to stop the Gilded Priest Koyisqatapi , in order to bring down the Azuposi nation .

title: Ilandra Wavemistress
description: Ilandra Wavemistress Ilandra Wavemistress was a half – aquatic elf pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Description . Ilandra was a woman with deeply tanned skin and long , greenish - black hair .

title: Ilbaereth
description: Ilbaereth Ilbaereth was an elven house in Neverwinter Woods . Its seal was a pegasus rearing over six wand s . This seal is a combination of the seals of Houses Ealoeth and Ildacer which might suggest a union of these houses created the Ilbaereth line .

title: Ilbratha
description: Ilbratha Ilbratha , also known as the " Mistress of Battles " , Haalorth , the Heir ' s Blade , and " the Warrior ' s Fang " , was an enchanted bronze short sword that had the distinction of being a part of the royal regalia of two kingdoms , to be carried by the heirs of two royal lines : the Forest Kingdom of Cormyr on land and the merfolk kingdom of Eadraal under the sea . It was one of the Cormyrean Swords of State , commissioned by Azoun I and seen as a symbol of his victory over the armies of Shoon . It was also famously wielded by the merfolk princes and princesses of Eadraal for some seven centuries .

title: Ilbrost Mythyl
description: Ilbrost Mythyl Ilbrost Mythyl was one of the leading cleric s of Mystra at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ilbrost ' s lack of personal ambition stopped him from rebelling openly against the high priest , Meleghost Starseer .

title: Ilcanorr
description: Ilcanorr Ilcanorr of Luthcheq was a male Turami human and a powerful wizard of Luthcheq who came to reside in the Border Kingdoms realm of Bedorn . Description . He was raven - haired with a handsome appearance and a chin - spike beard .

title: Ildar Orsabbas
description: Ildar Orsabbas Ildar Orsabbas was a famous fence in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ildar was a stout , fun - loving and somewhat pompous individual .

title: Ildibane Nasadra
description: Ildibane Nasadra Ildibane Nasadra was the archmage of Ched Nasad until its fall in the year 1372 DR . History . Ildibane was the twin brother of Aunrae Nasadra .

title: Ildilyntra Starym
description: Ildilyntra Starym Ildilyntra Starym was the former matriarch of the Starym clan of elves , an old noble house of Cormanthyr . She was a chief opponent of the Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl ' s plan to open Cormanthor to non - elves , and took her own life to form a blood dragon in an attempt to slay the elven ruler . Appearance .

title: Ildomyl
description: Ildomyl Ildomyl was an apprentice Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . He was a friend of Nordryn Spellbinder . History .

title: Ildool
description: Ildool Lord Ildool was the Crown ' s representative in Marsember , Cormyr . He was widely distrusted because of his alleged dishonesty about taxes , and the Harpers were keeping him in check . Ildool lived at the King ' s Tower .

title: Ildriss
description: Ildriss Ildriss , or wind terrors , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Ildriss were either completely invisible , or they resembled a cloud - like mass with vaporous tentacles and red gleaming eyes .

title: Ildryn Thallin
description: Ildryn Thallin Ildryn Thallin was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was a sly and manipulative magelord .

title: Ileuthra
description: Ileuthra Ileuthra was a brass dragon who heeded the call to Protanther ' s council to discuss the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ileuthra was a very ancient dragon , always in search for knowledge and more challenging games .

title: Ilighôn
description: Ilighôn Ilighôn was one of two islands that made up the Eyes of Silvanus on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was situated close to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . It benefited from the protection of reefs and also the magic of the Emerald Enclave .

title: Ilimitar
description: Ilimitar Ilimitar was an elven Royal Archmage in Cormanthyr at the time that Elminster Aumar was nominated Armathor . History . When he was young , Ilimitar was an apprentice of the Srinshee .

title: Iliph Thraun
description: Iliph Thraun Illiph Thraun was a lichnee and a lich lord of the Zhentarim involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair . History . Illiph Thraun was a Zhentarim wizard and wielder of the power of " spellfire " .

title: Iliphanar
description: Iliphanar Iliphanar was a trade city in Semphar . Geography . Located at the mouth of the Golden Flow river , this small town drew many who sought their fortune within the Raurin Alta .

title: Iliphar Nelnueve
description: Iliphar Nelnueve Iliphar Nelnueve ( Lord of the Scepters ) was an elven warrior - mage . Appearance . Iliphar had long silver - blond hair , constrained by a circlet with three spikes and an inset amethyst .

title: Iliyanbruen
description: Iliyanbruen Iliyanbruen was an elven survivor - state of Illefarn that encompassed most of Neverwinter Wood . Originally a colony of Illefarn that replaced the vanished Llewyrr colony , it constituted elves who refused to follow their coronal ' s plan to retreat to Evermeet in the face of human ity ' s encroachment on the North . It was known for its help in repelling The Orc Marches from High Vale in - 111 DR and its repelling of Illusk an expansion in - 12 DR before finally falling in 175 DR after spending itself protecting the North against orc s .

title: Iljack
description: Iljack Iljack of the Black Blade was a highwayman of the village of Bambryn in the Vast after the 7th century DR . History . During the early Time of Glorious Fools , after human s first settled the central Vast in the mid – 7th century DR , Iljack of the Black Blade arose to plague the area .

title: Iljrene Ahbruyn
description: Iljrene Ahbruyn Iljrene Ahbruyn was a drow follower of Qilué Veladorn . Description . Iljrene was described as a " tiny , kitten - soft doll of a priestess " .

title: Ill - Mater
description: Ill - Mater Ill - Mater was a fictional character commonly used by traveling entertainers . Ill - Mater was a clown dressed in a gray costume who was always being whacked , beaten , and pushed over for slapstick entertainment . The Ill - Mater character mocked members of the Church of Ilmater .

title: Illasera
description: Illasera Illasera was one of the group of Bhaalspawn known as the Five . She was the first of them to die by the game ' s protagonist ' s hand after she had been sent to kill them . The game .

title: Illefarn
description: Illefarn Illefarn was an elven city - state that was founded during the First Flowering in - 22900 DR , survived the Crown Wars , grew into an expansive nation and later fragmented into smaller realms . Geography . Illefarn as a nation at its height , stretched along the Sword Coast , from just south of the settlement of Illusk , itself not far south of the Spine of the World , to the River Delimbiyr .

title: Illistyl Elventree
description: Illistyl Elventree Illistyl Elventree was one of the Knights of Myth Drannor from Shadowdale in 1358 DR . History . Illistyl was born in Shadowdale .

title: Illithid body tamer
description: Illithid body tamer The Illithid Body Tamer was a special prestige class of the illithids that focused on martial skill over psionic prowess . Illithid Body Tamers followed a discipline called the " Tamer Creed " which said that only a potent military force would ensure Illithid society ' s future existence . They maintained that only by abstaining from psionics will they strengthen their considerably frail bodies sufficiently enough to become accomplished fighters .

title: Illithocyte
description: Illithocyte Illithocyte were illithid tadpoles that survived the fall of a mind flayer empire , and evolved into a new life form . They crawled about in groups seeking psychic radiation on which to feed . Following the demise of the city of Ch ' Chitl , illithocytes appeared in the surrounding areas of the Underdark as a consequence of the death of the city ' s elder brain .

title: Illitran Starym
description: Illitran Starym Lord Illitran Starym was Lord Speaker of the Starym clan . He infamously forged a pact with Moander in order to fool his Moonblade and retain power over the house . In 523 DR , a branch of moon elven ex - patriate members of the Starym Clan returned to Myth Drannor to reclaim the house and return it to glory .

title: Illius
description: Illius Illius was a sorcerer during the 14th century DR . He used a staff and a formidable array of magical powers , as well as a set of force beads he used in combat . Illius was born into a line of knight s , but when he discovered that he had sorcerous powers he pursued that path instead .

title: Illul
description: Illul Illul is a city in the island - kingdom of Lantan . It is situated on the southern shore of the main island . Overview .

title: Illuminated
description: Illuminated The Illuminated were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . Umar al - Hadra al - Bazan led the 50 , 000 soldiers of the Illuminated .

title: Illumor Sendever
description: Illumor Sendever Illumor Sendever was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He owned and worked at Sendever ' s Stables . In this capacity , he bought and sold horse s , provided veterinary care to them , and rented out stables for them .

title: Illusion
description: Illusion The Illusion school includes spells that deceive the senses or minds of others . They cause people to see things that are not there , not see things that are there , hear phantom noises , or remember things that never happened . Among these spells are included " invisibility " and " disguise self " .

title: Illusionist
description: Illusionist An illusionist is a wizard specializing in illusion magic . Illusion spells create false images and other sensory tricks . Illusionists can make ghostly sounds to distract opponents , conjure visionary beasts , or create a wall that does not actually exist .

title: Illuskan
description: Illuskan Illuskan was the name usually given to human s who lived in the Sword Coast North . They were also known as Northlanders . Illuskans made up the bulk of the population in the following areas : Physical description .

title: Illuskan language
description: Illuskan language Illuskan was an ethnic human language spoken in northwest Faerûn , largely by Illuskan s . Speakers . Illuskan was commonly used as a " lingua franca " along the Sword Coast North , in addition to the ubiquitous Common .

title: Illuski languages
description: Illuski languages The Illuski language group was a linguistic group that included the languages of the Northmen . Illuski languages were spoken in Ruathym and Luskan and from the islands as far north as the Uttersea south to the Moonshae Isles and Mintarn . Languages .

title: Illusory ambush
description: Illusory ambush Illusory ambush is an illusion spell similar to a simplified and easier to master version of the " phanstasmal killer " spell . " Illusory ambush " is learned by wizard s , particularly those who wish to become illusionists . When cast , " illusory ambush " manifests a small number of illusory assailants at a location within fifty feet of the wizard , who seem to attack an intended target , distracting him or her from their own assault against the wizard .

title: Illusory script
description: Illusory script Illusory script , or illusionary script , was an illusion spell that disguised a written message and compelled non - authorized viewers with a brief " suggestion " for a short time . Components . In addition to verbal and somatic components , the message had to be written with a lead - based ink costing no less than 50 gp .

title: Illusory wall
description: Illusory wall Illusory wall or illusionary wall ( originally , Toscudlo ' s illusionary wall ) was a mid - power illusionist spell , that created the false figment of a wall for persons to hide behind . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create a visual illusion of a wall or similar surface , such as a ceiling or floor .

title: Illydia Maethellyn
description: Illydia Maethellyn Illydia Maethellyn was a moon elf cleric of Sehanine Moonbow . Description . She had the markings of lightning damage on her arms .

title: Illyth Fleetwood
description: Illyth Fleetwood Illyth Fleetwood is a noblewoman living outside the city of Ravens Bluff at Woodenhall manor , the home of the Fleetwood family . Despite her noble status , Illyth is an accomplished scholar and has an extensive personal library . She is not currently married and delights in activities such as the Game of Masks .

title: Ilmara
description: Ilmara Ilmara was a queen of Impiltur and the third ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Ilmara was the only daughter of King Imphras I and Queen Sambral .

title: Ilmater
description: Ilmater Ilmater ( pronounced " Ihl - MAY - ter " or " ill - " may " - ter " ) was an intermediate deity of the Faerûnian pantheon whose portfolio included endurance , martyrdom , perseverance , and suffering . He was the god of those who suffered , the oppressed , and the persecuted , who offered them relief and support , encouraged them to endure , and who encouraged others to help them , to take their burdens or take their places . He was called the Crying God , the Broken God , the Lord on the Rack , and the One Who Endures .

title: Ilmater ' s fist
description: Ilmater ' s fist Ilmater ' s fist was a divine evocation spell that conjured an ethereal fist to strike a foe . Effect . The spell produced a spectral fist that flew through the air to strike a chosen foe , delivering as much injury as the caster had suffered in the last minute or so , before disappearing .

title: Ilmeth
description: Ilmeth Ilmeth was the grim , yet fair Lord of Essembra . He was somewhat obsessed with commanding Battledale ' s army known as the Lord ' s Men . Lord Ilmeth barely tolerated adventurers in his presence , so long as they remained out of his way .

title: Ilmeth Waelvur
description: Ilmeth Waelvur Ilmeth Waelvur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Ilmeth was a hard - drinking and sullen man .

title: Ilmra
description: Ilmra Ilmra was a drow apprentice wizard in Ched Nasad . History . Ilmra was one of the few female drow who decided to study as a wizard in the Arcane Conservatory .

title: Ilmurk Jongrath
description: Ilmurk Jongrath Ilmurk Jongrath was a miller and rancher in the county of Bardshyr in southwestern Tethyr , owner of Jongrath ' s Mill . Personality . Ilmurk was an honest entrepreneur with a roguish streak .

title: Ilmwatch
description: Ilmwatch Ilmwatch was a large fortress that protected the infamous Buzzard Beak Harbor found on the northern end of the Easting Reach . Activities . Ilmwatch was large enough to easily support several hundred troops .

title: Ilneval
description: Ilneval Ilneval ( pronounced " ill " - nev - all ) is a lesser deity of the Orc pantheon . A cunning war leader inspiring great loyalty in his followers , he is very diligent in planning his strategies for victory . He is considered the patron of orc crossbreeds , such as orogs and tanarukks .

title: Ilnezhara
description: Ilnezhara Ilnezhara was a copper dragon who lived in the Bloodstone Lands . Description . Her human form was that of an attractive woman with a shock of thick , copper - colored hair and huge blue eyes .

title: Ilnger Obskoth
description: Ilnger Obskoth Ilnger Obskoth was a male priest of Ilmater in the 9th century DR . He was the high priest of the Ilmatari town of Carathryn in the Purple Hills of Tethyr . One morning in the Year of the Vigilant Familiar , 848 DR , the " Tome of Torment " appeared on the altar of Ilmater in Carathryn .

title: Ilsensine
description: Ilsensine Ilsensine was the patron deity of the illithid s , though not their creator . It was also the patron of evil mage s and psionic ists who dominated the minds of others . Its true appearance was as a disembodied brain of emerald color that trailed countless ganglion - like tentacles .

title: Ilserv
description: Ilserv Ilserv , also known as Ilserv of the Illithids , was a mind flayer sage in Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . History . Ilserv originally acted as an emissary and ambassador of Ch ' Chitl to the surface until , by accident , the beholder crime lord Xanathar petrified him .

title: Ilsevele Miritar
description: Ilsevele Miritar Lady Ilsevele Miritar is a sun elf spellarcher from the Queen ' s Guard in Evermeet and was the partner and betrothed of Araevin Teshurr until the couple parted ways when Ilsevele fell in love with the resurrected Fflar Starbrow Melruth whom she eventually wed . She has a fine gray destrier named Swiftwind . She worked with her father on the Elven Crusade to Myth Drannor , and after his death took up leadership of the Army of Myth Drannor .

title: Ilshara Naerthskul
description: Ilshara Naerthskul Ilshara Naerthskul was a thief in the Ten Towns in 1370 DR . Activities . Ilshara was an infamous thief who specialized in working on rooftops , minarets , and chimneys and in the theft of diamond s , coins , magical item s , and any kind of weapon .

title: Ilstan Narbrace
description: Ilstan Narbrace Ilstan Narbrace was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Narbrace and other five Dragons acted as escort to the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .

title: Ilthan
description: Ilthan Ilthan was an island in the Pirate Isles in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Its natives were cyclops es who herded sheep . Its main feature was a large ruined city at the center of the island .

title: Iltharagh
description: Iltharagh Iltharagh , also known as Golden Night , was a unique topaz dragon dracolich living near Luskan who worked with the Cult of the Dragon in 1370 DR . History . Iltharagh was a very old topaz dragon who laired near the City of the Sails .

title: Iltharl Obarskyr
description: Iltharl Obarskyr King Iltharl Obarskyr was crowned King of Cormyr in 242 DR . Appearance . Iltharl usually dressed in immaculate robes .

title: Ilthond
description: Ilthond Ilthond was a Zhentarim wizard who was one of the leaders of the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History . Ilthond was a wizard in the Zhentarim and an apprentice and loyal follower of Manshoon .

title: Ilthor
description: Ilthor Ilthor was a sea captain of Aglarond . Activities . Ilthor sailed with her ship , the " Windsinger " , around the Sea of Fallen Stars , in particular from Sembia to Aglarond .

title: Ilthuryn
description: Ilthuryn Ilthuryn was a male elf mage who murdered Lady Alauthshaee . History . Ilthuryn attempted to court the famously wealthy and haughty Lady Alauthshaee , but she rejected him harshly .

title: Iltkazar
description: Iltkazar Iltkazar ( the Mithral Kingdom ) was a subterranean dwarven realm , originally one of the eight sub - kingdoms of Shanatar , and known for its stone carving and engineering . The term " Iltkazar " came to describe more than just the original sub - kingdom , and by - 1900 DR it was used to describe a sub - kingdom of Calimshan . The Shanataran sub - kingdoms of Barakuir , Drakkalor , Holorarar and Ultoksamrin were located in Iltkazar , as well as Zokir , City of Orbs .

title: Iltkazar Highlands
description: Iltkazar Highlands The Iltkazar Highlands were the eastern of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Geography . The eastern Highlands sloped upwards to the chain of mountains that included the Snowflake , Omlarandin , and Alimir Mountains .

title: Iltkazar Range
description: Iltkazar Range The Iltkazar Range was a long chain of five distinct mountain ranges that ran vertically from the Vilhon Reach in the north down to the the Shining Sea in the south and roughly divided west Faerûn from interior Faerûn . The range included , from north to south , the Giant ' s Run Mountains , the Snowflake Mountains , the Kuldin Peaks , the Omlarandin Mountains , and the Alimir Mountains .

title: Iltztran Melarn
description: Iltztran Melarn Iltztran Melarn was the house wizard of House Melarn in 1479 DR . History . Iltztran was a wizard from Ched Nasad and an arachnomancer .

title: Ilva
description: Ilva Ilva was a maid in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Ilva hailed from Phlan but like many others fled her hometown after Vorgansharax began to rule the city .

title: Ilvani
description: Ilvani Ilvani is the witch of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell and is the twin sister of Natan , the former high priest of Ikemmu . In 1479 DR , Ilvani was sent on an expedition to scout an area of the Shadowfell north of Ikemmu . Her party was captured by a Shadar - kai enclave and most of the members were tortured to death .

title: Ilvara Mizzrym
description: Ilvara Mizzrym Ilvara Mizzrym was a drow priestess of Lolth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The priestess was a very ambitious and cruel individual , wanting to rise in Lolth ' s esteem .

title: Ilvarthaele Everstone
description: Ilvarthaele Everstone Ilvarthaele Everstone was a Damaran human woman and a High Herald , as which she was known as the Silver Stag . History . Ilvarthaele Everstone was once a scribe and loremaster in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast .

title: Ilyana Wyrmmruff
description: Ilyana Wyrmmruff Ilyana Wyrmmruff was an innkeeper in Skullport . Personality . Ilyana was the driving force behind the success of the inn : her organizational skills kept the building running efficiently .

title: Ilyich
description: Ilyich Ilyich was a duergar soldier employed by Irenicus in his dungeon . History . Ilych was the chief of the duergar soldier in the Irenicus ' dungeon .

title: Ilythiir
description: Ilythiir Ilythiir was a realm of the dark elves during the Dawn Ages and First Flowering ( founded roughly - 27000 DR ) before being destroyed after the Descent of the Drow following the Fourth Crown War . Geography . Ilythiir was an expansionist country , that started in the southern jungles and spread throughout southern Faerûn during the Dawn Age .

title: Ilyyela Miritar
description: Ilyyela Miritar Ilyyela Miritar was the wife of Seiveril Miritar , leader of the Miritar clan of elves on the island of Evermeet . She was killed in 1371 DR during the war launched by Kymil Nimesin when the Tower of the Sun was destroyed . Seiveril attempted to resurrect her , but she refused to return from Arvandor , telling him that he would fulfill his role in the mortal world before joining her .

title: Ilyykur ' s mantle
description: Ilyykur ' s mantle Ilyykur ' s mantle was an arcane abjuration spell that gave the caster some protection against various types of magical attacks . Effects . This spell gave the caster a protective aura that covered the body in a soft , form - fitting glow .

title: Ilztoj A ' Qaran
description: Ilztoj A ' Qaran Ilztoj A ' Qaran was a drow mage in Cormanthor during the Rage of Demons . History . Ilztoj lived in Szith Morcane until it fell to fiendish fire giant s .

title: Imaerphil Clovenshield
description: Imaerphil Clovenshield Imaerphil Clovenshield was a female human who led Maalthiir ' s guard in Hillsfar . Abilities . As an experienced fighter , Imaerphil could hold her own in most battles .

title: Imani
description: Imani Imani was a wizard and sage in Turmish . History . Imani was a former adventuring wizard from Turmish .

title: Imaskar
description: Imaskar The Imaskar Empire ( also known as the Raurin Empire ) was an ancient human nation that ruled lands in the east that came to comprise of the nations of Mulhorand , Thay , and Unther . Its citizens were the Imaskari . Early History .

title: Imaskari
description: Imaskari The Imaskari were the citizens of Imaskar , the ancient empire later swallowed by the Raurin Desert and the Plains of Purple Dust . They were vilified by the Mulan , who were the descendants of the slaves the Imaskari artificer s abducted from other worlds using the mighty portal s they crafted . Distribution .

title: Imaskari languages
description: Imaskari languages The Imaskari languages were a small family of languages that shared a history in the ancient empire of Imaskar . Language Groups . According to scholars , the following languages and language groups belonged to the Imaskari language family : Appendix .

title: Imaskari vengeance taker
description: Imaskari vengeance taker The Imaskari vengeance taker is a special prestige class of the deep Imaskari , a race of humans that live in the Underdark . Devoted to law , justice , and revenge , the vengeance takers use a combination of techniques involving magic and investigative skills to track down targets . Few beings are as cold and emotionless as these men and women , all of whom may challenge an assassin in terms of downright deadliness and mercilessness .

title: Imbralym Skoond
description: Imbralym Skoond Imbralym Skoond was a wizard in Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Imbralym dreamed about the immense wealth he could amass with his magic power .

title: Imbrar I
description: Imbrar I Imbrar Heltharn I , known as Imbrar the Lost , was the ninth Paladin - King of Impiltur and the second ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Through his father , Imphras I , he was a descendant of a line of paladin s related to the Durlarven Dynasty by marriage , through one of the sisters of King Bellodar III .

title: Imbrar II
description: Imbrar II Imbrar II was the last king of Impiltur . Relationships . He was the second nephew of Soarimbrar the Younger ( who was a descendant of Imphras II ' s fourth son ) , through his older sister .

title: Imbrult Longclaws
description: Imbrult Longclaws Imbrult Longclaws was a curse - ridden War Wizard of Cormyr . History . During a mission against some outlaws he was cursed by Manshoon riding a black dragon .

title: Imbrus Obarskyr I
description: Imbrus Obarskyr I Imbrus I was a king of Cormyr . Like so many of his relatives , he was murdered by Gorauna . A common - born man named Rathdar Orlenthar next ruled Cormyr until Imbrus ' cousins or son would come of age .

title: Imbrus Obarskyr II
description: Imbrus Obarskyr II Imbrus II , son of Imbrus I , was one of the three " boy kings " of Cormyr while Rathdar Orlenthar ruled as regent . He died in the Purplethroat Plague as did the other boy kings and was succeeded by the granddaughter of Gorauna , " Mad Meurthe " .

title: Imbryl ' s Cloaks
description: Imbryl ' s Cloaks Imbryl ' s Cloaks is a cloak and garment shop in Amphail , run by Imbryl , a broad - shouldered woman . A group of women from the village gather here to make cloaks , breeches and rainspouts , which are hats with a large brim . The shop provides alterations to garments with a three - day waiting period .

title: Imbue undead with spell ability
description: Imbue undead with spell ability Imbue undead with spell ability was an arcane necromancy spell that transferred one spell from the caster to one undead creature . Effects . This spell took ten minutes to cast and the caster had to touch the undead creature in order to transfer a spell .

title: Imbue with spell ability
description: Imbue with spell ability Imbue with spell ability was a divine evocation or enchantment spell that allowed the caster to bequeath a small number of spells to another creature . Effects . A divine spellcaster with this spell ( or ability , in the case of the divine disciple ) had to touch another creature that had sufficient wisdom and intelligence to hold the divine energies and to cast them effectively .

title: Imdarr Relvaunder
description: Imdarr Relvaunder Imdarr Relvaunder was a priest of Tempus in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Imdarr was a stern man , and keenly interested in news , rumors , and visitors .

title: Imgig Zu
description: Imgig Zu Imgig Zu was an extraplanar monster and the ruler of his people . History . The Song of Selûne .

title: Imix
description: Imix Imix was the evil archomental of fire . He was a primordial older than the world itself . He was known as the Fire Lord Imix , Lord of Hellfire and the Eternal Flame .

title: Imizael
description: Imizael Imizael was a tavern owner in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Imizael was an efficient tavern - keeper , always attentive to patrons ' needs .

title: Imlon Obarskyr
description: Imlon Obarskyr Imlon " the Touched " was the second king of Cormyr and was crowned in 55 DR . Relatives . Imlon ' s father was the legendary Faerlthann Obarskyr .

title: Immaero Sraunter
description: Immaero Sraunter Immaero Sraunter was an alchemist in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon managed to discover his hidden secrets and enslaved Sraunter to do his bidding .

title: Immerdusk
description: Immerdusk Immerdusk was a noble house of Cormyr . It was based in Arabel . History .

title: Immerhand Inn
description: Immerhand Inn The Immerhand Inn was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Chalthos Immer . History .

title: Immil Vale
description: Immil Vale Immil Vale was a deep valley in Rashemen north of the Running Rocks . It was the site of the Battle of Immil Vale in 1360 DR . Description .

title: Immilmar
description: Immilmar Immilmar was the capital city of Rashemen and seat of the Iron Lord . At the center of Immilmar was the Lord ' s citadel , built with the help of the mighty Wychlaran . Around the keep was the central part of Immilmar , with farther - out homes built more like regular Rashemi homes .

title: Immithra Shrae
description: Immithra Shrae Immithra Shrae was the head of the Bounty of the Goddess temple of Chauntea in Voonlar during the time period roughly corresponding to the term of Bron ( sheriff ) Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1367 DR .

title: Immolith
description: Immolith An immolith is an undead demon ic creature that is sometimes created when the spirits of deceased demons have fallen back into the Abyss . Immoliths greatly despise living creatures , and they are often found accompanying other undead such as lich es and vampire s , although they can also be found with other demons such as horde ghoul s , mezzodemon s , and vrock s . Immunity .

title: Immortal
description: Immortal Immortals are outsider s native to the Astral Sea and the many plane s that lie within it whose essence is primarily composed from that same fundamental plane . In spite of their name , they are not the only beings capable of immortality , many elemental s and even natural creature s also being capable of something along such lines . However , agelessness and the incapablity of dying a natural death is something that defines all immortals , which is not true of elemental , fey , natural , or shadow creatures .

title: Immurk
description: Immurk Immurk the Invincible was the legendary first great pirate lord of the Sea of Fallen Stars , who lived during the 12th century DR . As he began his piratical career , he recruited the disaffected sailors of various nations around the Inner Sea , promising them plunder for their loyalty . According to legend , Immurk ' s first great crime was when he stole the new crown for the coronation of King Palaghard I of Cormyr in the Year of Long Shadows , 1164 DR .

title: Immurk ' s distraction
description: Immurk ' s distraction Immurk ' s distraction was an arcane enchantment spell that prevented people finding concealed objects by causing them to be distracted . It was useful for hiding buried treasure chests and smuggled goods . Effect .

title: Imnescourse Trail
description: Imnescourse Trail Imnescourse Trail was a roadway that ran across central Amn . The western most point of the trail was at the town of Immescar where it met with the Trade Way , then it ran east , through the Umar Hills through the city of Esmeltaran , before turning north and ending at the town of Gambiton at the South Road . Realmslore .

title: Imoen
description: Imoen Imoen was a young female human who was raised in Candlekeep . She was also a Bhaalspawn , though this remained unrevealed for some time even after it was revealed that the other ward of Gorion living in Candlekeep was one . Imoen travelled with them for a time before the prophecy of the Bhaalspawn was fulfilled .

title: Imp
description: Imp Imps are vicious , manipulative fiends that make up the least powerful ranks of the infernal legions . An imp is a minor non - Baatezu devil . They serve as tempters and lackeys to mortals whom devils want groomed to the side of evil .

title: Imperial Cavalry
description: Imperial Cavalry The Imperial Cavalry served within Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Prince Cheddah al - Assad favored applicants who could perform interesting tricks on horseback .

title: Imperishable
description: Imperishable The Imperishable was an elite mamluk order who dedicated their lives to serving the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Activities . The primary goal of the Imperishable was defending the great fortress of Krak al - Mazhar from all enemies of the Brotherhood .

title: Impervious sanctity of mind
description: Impervious sanctity of mind Impervious sanctity of mind was an abjuration spell that granted the caster complete immunity from mind - affecting spells , spell - like effects , and psionic s . Effects . This spell lasted for at least two hours ( longer for higher level casters ) .

title: Imphras I
description: Imphras I Imphras Heltharn I , known as Imphras the Great , was the eighth Paladin - King of Impiltur and the first ruler of the Heltharn Dynasty . Relationships . Imphras Heltharn was a descendant of a line of paladin s who were related to the Durlarven Dynasty by marriage , through one of the sisters of King Bellodar III .

title: Imphras II
description: Imphras II Imphras Heltharn II was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Imphras was the only heir of Queen Ilmara , and he was crowned as king at birth in 1169 DR .

title: Imphras III
description: Imphras III Imphras Heltharn III was a crown prince of Impiltur . Relationships . Imphras was the eldest son of King Lashilmbrar the Sly .

title: Imphras IV
description: Imphras IV Prince Imphras IV was a prince of Impiltur and the husband of Queen Sambryl . Relationships . Imphras was the only son of traitorous Thaum of Telflamm and the great - grandson of Imphras II .

title: Imphras V
description: Imphras V Imphras V was a boy king of Impiltur who never ruled . Relationships . Imphras was the oldest nephew of King Soarimbrar .

title: Impil Street
description: Impil Street Impil Street was an alley in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr , located near the waterfront on the eastern shore of the Wyvernflow River . Services . Impil Street was the site of a number of warehouses , all owned by the Cormyrean Coins Coster .

title: Impiltur
description: Impiltur Impiltur was a former kingdom and current confederacy of feudal lords in Northeast Faerûn of around 1 . 2 million inhabitants , comprising mainly human s , but also dwarves and halfling s . Geography .

title: Impilturan demonslayer
description: Impilturan demonslayer Impilturan demonslayers are heroes of Impiltur and hunters of the demon ic forces that haunt it . Wielding dual weapons , most often two blades , Impilturan demonslayers fearlessly hunt the enemies of Impiltur ' s people , be they demons or horrific plaguechanged monsters . To these bold adventurers , demons are little more than more powerful versions of the more common beast s most ranger s hunt .

title: Implosion
description: Implosion Implosion is an evocation spell that kills one subject per round . Effect . You create a destructive resonance in a corporeal creature ' s body .

title: Impregnable mind
description: Impregnable mind Impregnable mind was an enchantment spell that greatly improved the recipient ' s chances of resisting magical or psionic attacks on the mind . Effects . For ten minutes , more depending on the level of the caster , the recipient of this spell was much less likely to be " beguile d " , " charmed " , " dominated " , " feeblemind ed " , " held " or succumb to similar mind - affecting spells and psionics .

title: Impresk
description: Impresk Impresk was a barony of the monarchy of Erlkazar , which encompassed the territory of the Snowflake Mountains . Description . Impresk was the barony responsible for ensuring that the monster population of the Snowflake Mountains remained low and defending the trade road to Riatavin .

title: Impresk Lake
description: Impresk Lake Impresk Lake was a lake in Erlkazar . Geography . The water of Impresk Lake was ice cold .

title: Imprisoners
description: Imprisoners The Imprisoners were a group of powerful mages working before the Spellplague for Larloch who imprisoned spirits in magic items . The ultimate goal was apparently to preserve some of Larloch ' s power so he could access it later . The items created were known as Blueflame items and had powerful magic contained within .

title: Imprisonment
description: Imprisonment Imprisonment was an abjuration spell that entombs subjects beneath the earth . Effects . When you cast " imprisonment " and touch an opponent , he is entombed in a state of suspended animation ( see the " temporal stasis " spell ) in a small sphere far beneath the surface of the earth .

title: Improved skull watch
description: Improved skull watch Improved skull watch was a permanent - until - triggered version of the " skull watch " spell . Effects . This spell improved on " skull watch " in a number of ways .

title: Imrar Roaryl
description: Imrar Roaryl Imrar Roaryl was the Crown Prince of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Personality .

title: Imreera Hethkantan
description: Imreera Hethkantan Queen Imreera Hethkantan was the queen of Gontal as of 1479 DR . By popular account , she seemed more interested in the ruins of the Glaur Barrens than in ruling her own kingdom , and many believed the families of the Twelvefold to be the real power of Gontal . However , that was a facade created by Queen Imreera to mislead her enemies .

title: Imrilsar ( family )
description: Imrilsar ( family ) The Imrilsar family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , where common folk believed the Twelvefold families held uncountable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Imvaernarhro
description: Imvaernarhro Imvaernarho , or Inferno , is an ancient red dragon who has mastered fire magic whose lair rests in the Star Mounts . Legends surrouding the great wyrm have been spread all throughout the Western Heartlands and the Sword Coast North . Although he has typically kept himself isolated from other , Inferno has taken a recent interest in the Silver Marches .

title: In ' ani
description: In ' ani In ' ani was a city on the island of Saishu in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . In ' ani stood on the northern tip of Saishu , facing the Yellow Sea .

title: In Sylvan Shadows
description: In Sylvan Shadows In Sylvan Shadows is the second book of The Cleric Quintet by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Inanna
description: Inanna Inanna was one of two Untheric goddesses of love and war ( the other was her " daughter " , Ishtar ) . Her manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . Her symbol was a shepherd ' s staff .

title: Inata Eller
description: Inata Eller Inata Eller was a wizard sage specialized in Outer Planes in the Vilhon Reach in 1358 DR . History . Inata studied under her second cousin , Gustofsen Eller , probably the most renowned planar expert in the Realms .

title: Inayah bint In ' am
description: Inayah bint In ' am Inayah bint In ' am was an elven sha ' ir and resident of note in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Through magic Inayah was able to disguise herself to appear as a bent old woman .

title: Incandescent Eye
description: Incandescent Eye The Incandescent Eye was a powerful magic gem originating from the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This crimson - colored gem was the size of a cherry .

title: Incandescent blue ioun stone ( githzerai )
description: Incandescent blue ioun stone ( githzerai ) This incandescent blue ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " created by the githzerai that boosted the wisdom of the bearer . Description . It was a spherical blue stone , weighing 1 lb ( 453 g ) .

title: Incantation
description: Incantation The school of incantation contained spells that targeted magic itself and the way of casting it . Like other schools of effect , it thus grouped spells not like the traditional nine schools of magic based on their philosophy , but on what they affected . The schools of conjuration / summoning , illusion / phantasm , invocation / evocation and necromancy were considered opposed to incantation .

title: Incantatrix
description: Incantatrix Incantatrix , whose male equivalent is the Incantatar , is a special prestige class whose members are the most skilled practitioners of metamagic . They study and shape spells in their raw effects and can modify the spells of allies , magic items and even active spells cast by another . They dislike extraplanar intrusions of Faerûn , having a particular fondness for magic that thwarts extraplanar beings while seeking out and destroying planar portal s and gates .

title: Incendiary cloud
description: Incendiary cloud Incendiary cloud was a conjuration spell that summoned a cloud of smoke and embers . Effects . Prior to the Time of Troubles , for Parwyyd Hanifar at least , an " incendiary cloud " spell evoked a cloud around 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Incendiary sword
description: Incendiary sword Incendiary sword is a spell used by several swordmage s , particularly those who follow the astral fire path . When it is cast , " incendiary sword " causes the blade of the swordmage casting the spell to erupt into flames , which the swordmage then hurls to a location within twenty - five feet of him or herself . When the blade strikes the ground it erupts again , creating a fiery blast zone of roughly twenty - five feet in diameter , burning any creatures unfortunate enough to be caught within , burning them repeatedly for several minutes even after the fire has dissipated .

title: Indeema
description: Indeema Indeema was a halfling cleric living on Jazayir al - Alfar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . She was the ruler of a tribe of halfings called the Tarangu . Description .

title: Indesm
description: Indesm Indesm was a noble house of Cormyr . Bases . They were situated in Arabel .

title: Indrila Demaz
description: Indrila Demaz Indrila Demaz was the Queen of Velprin and leader of the human army that invaded the Yuirwood in response to attacks from the half - elves living there . She became queen in 1058 DR . A year later , in 1059 DR , she drove the half - elves further back into the forest .

title: Indrizil
description: Indrizil Indrizil was a female drow priestess of Lolth from Cormanthor . Abilities . As a priestess of Lolth , Indrizil once had the favor of Lolth .

title: Ineddra
description: Ineddra Ineddra was a high elf member of the Lords ' Alliance in Cormanthor . Activities . Ineddra was a scholar .

title: Infernal death
description: Infernal death Infernal death was a rare magical poison sometimes used by Holy slayer assassin s of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Zakhara . Description . This liquid was derived from the of fire elemental s .

title: Infernal language
description: Infernal language Infernal is the language of the baatezu , a subtype of devil s . Infernal was brought to Toril through contact with evil beings from other planes . It is described as beautiful , yet alien in nature , since it developed among beings with thought patterns very unlike those of human ity .

title: Inferno ( spell )
description: Inferno ( spell ) The spell Inferno sets a creature aflame . When a druid casts this spell , the clothing , hair , flesh and items of the target burn with ferocity until the spell ends or the target manages to extinguish the flames . To cast the spell he needs a glob of beeswax .

title: Infestation of maggots
description: Infestation of maggots Infestation of maggots was a necromancy spell used by druid s in the realms . Effects . By touching an opponent , a druid casting this spell would cause an infestation of maggot - like creatures to cover the target creature .

title: Inficedraco
description: Inficedraco The Inficedraco was a genus of prehistoric proto - dragon s . History . Scholars from Candlekeep believed that " inficedracos " were an evolved and more intelligent species of the " ignidraco " genus .

title: Inflict critical wounds
description: Inflict critical wounds Inflict critical wounds , also known as cause critical wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused extreme damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Inflict light wounds
description: Inflict light wounds Inflict light wounds , also known as cause light wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused light damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Inflict minor wounds
description: Inflict minor wounds Inflict minor wounds was a necromancy spell that generally evil clerics learned as an orison . It delivered the minimum noticeable amount of damage to a living creature . Effects .

title: Inflict moderate wounds
description: Inflict moderate wounds Inflict moderate wounds , also known as cause moderate wounds was a necromancy spell that harmed the living and healed the undead . Effects . On a successful touch , this spell revitalized undead creatures or had a withering effect on the living .

title: Inflict serious wounds
description: Inflict serious wounds Inflict serious wounds , also known as cause serious wounds , was a necromancy spell that caused heavy damage to a creature touched by the caster . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Influencer Creed
description: Influencer Creed The Influencer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They believed that the best way to obtain knowledge was through indirect means . The Influencers wished to transform the societies of other races by removing important sources of lore .

title: Infravision
description: Infravision Infravision was a type of vision that many non - human species had , in addition to " normal sight " , in Dungeons & Dragons and Advanced Dungeons & Dragons prior to version 3 . 0 of the game . In 3 .

title: Ingdal ' s Arm
description: Ingdal ' s Arm Ingdal ' s Arm was a human settlement in the area that would become known as Aglarond . It was settled in 756 DR . The settlement was the site of the Battle of Ingdal ' s Arm in 1065 DR .

title: Ingeloakastimizilian
description: Ingeloakastimizilian Ingeloakastimizilian was a white dragon that lived in a region of the Reghed glacier known as Evermelt . Personality . He spent most of his time sleeping on a bed of ice that covered his hoard .

title: Inglor Brathren
description: Inglor Brathren Inglor Brathren was a member of the Zhentarim at Bargewright Inn during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personailty . Inglor believed that Nalaskur Thaelond was lining his pockets at the expense of the Zhentarim .

title: Inhil Lauthdryn
description: Inhil Lauthdryn Inhil Lauthdryn , nicknamed " Hurler - of - Stars " , was a mage of the 13th century DR and held the position of Magister from 1282 to 1294 DR . Description & Personality . Inhil was a tall man , grim of mood and little spoken .

title: Iniarv
description: Iniarv Iniarv was the Mage Royal of Uthtower and the lich who created the Mere of Dead Men . History . In the early years of the Uthtower realm , Iniarv served as the Mage Royal of Uthtower .

title: Iniarv ' s Tower
description: Iniarv ' s Tower Iniarv ' s Tower was a ruined tower near the Mere of Dead Men that belonged to the lich Iniarv . Geography . Iniarv ' s Tower was on the eastern side of the High Road , but it was often considered part of the Mere of Dead Men .

title: Inkstain
description: Inkstain Forgemaster Inkstain was a male dwarf and a printer . History . He originally came from Dwarves ' Deep , but later moved to the city of Procampur in the Vast .

title: Inkwing
description: Inkwing Inkwing was a pixie in the Quivering Forest . Activities . Inkwing was one of the pixies living in the secret village of Thornbud .

title: Inn of the Clowns
description: Inn of the Clowns The Inn of the Clowns was a weak establishment that was once a fine place , located in the village of Bloodstone . The symbol of the inn was a battered sign of a clown juggling bottles of wine . The Inn of the Clowns was once renowned all throughout the Kingdom of Damara .

title: Inn of the Dragon
description: Inn of the Dragon The Inn of the Dragon was a inn found in the village of Dragon Falls in the Vast . History . After human adventurer s slew the red dragon Halarglautha Firewings , who ' d laired at the nearby Dragon Falls waterfall , the survivors took possession of the dragon ' s hoard of coins .

title: Inn of the Dripping Dagger
description: Inn of the Dripping Dagger The Inn of the Dripping Dagger was the favored bar and home to many adventurers , mercenaries , misfits and soldiers in the city of Waterdeep . the Dripping Dagger ' s prices always seemed to be a bit lower for those who were down on their luck . The inn was best known for its seemingly haunted front door which would utter cryptic and seemingly menacing phrases such as ' His head will be found in a basket on Ship Street .

title: Inn of the Glowing Gem
description: Inn of the Glowing Gem The Inn of the Glowing Gem was an establishment in Yartar . History . Around 1356 DR , a group of adventurers , later known as the Heroes of Ascore , awoke in the morning to find thieves from the Kraken Society had stolen all their possessions .

title: Inn of the Nine Swords
description: Inn of the Nine Swords The Nine Swords , also known as the Inn of the Nine Swords was a high - quality inn found in the village of Swords Pool in the Vast . It stood on the western side of the road , between the North Road and the pond of Swords Pool . History .

title: Inn of the Sea Bass
description: Inn of the Sea Bass The Inn of the Sea Bass was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . This was a small inn that afforded its inhabitants a splendid view of the Caliph ' s Harbor .

title: Innanig
description: Innanig Innanig was an orc shaman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orcs and drow on Silver Marches , Innanig led a contingent of troops against Nesme with his fellow goblin shaman Kllug .

title: Innarlith
description: Innarlith Innarlith occupied the eastern tip of the Lake of Steam . It was a city where anything could be purchased , though how legal the acquisition might be was another story . History .

title: Inner Planes
description: Inner Planes Inner Planes is the collective term for a subset of the known planes of existence in the Great Wheel cosmology model and the World Tree cosmology model . The term refers to the placement of the planes at the center of the concentric spheres that made up the Great Wheel model . The Inner Planes were also called the elemental planes because each one was primarily made up of one type of matter .

title: Inner dragon
description: Inner dragon Inner dragons are specialized dragonborn fighter s who train themselves to unleash their draconic heritage as martial power . These individuals nurture the raw fury of their ancestry into an impressive fighting style , manifesting draconic attributes as they grow in experience and power . Whether acquiring these powers through training by others or personal discovery , inner dragons are a fearsome foe to behold .

title: Innesdav
description: Innesdav Innesdav was an elderly monk living in Candlekeep . Description . Physically , he was tall and thin .

title: Innovindil
description: Innovindil Innovindil is a moon elf from the Moonvines in the Moonwood and friend and lover of Tarathiel . Physical description . Innovindil is fairly short with yellow hair and strikingly blue eyes .

title: Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess
description: Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess The Inquisitor of the Drowning Goddess is a special prestige class of the kuo - toa . The majority of the kuo - toa who pick up this prestige class are monitors ( monk s ) who have been charged with the duty to protect their communities from internal dangers such as insurgence and betrayal to outside forces . They do this with great ability , using their skills at intimidation , detection of falsehoods , and martial skill to end any danger to the lawful authorities .

title: Inri
description: Inri Inri is an elven sorcerer and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Inri has hair like gold and a golden complexion .

title: Insanity
description: Insanity Insanity , also known as descent into madness , was an enchantment spell that drove a subject permanently insane . Effects . The enchanted creature was under the constant effect of a " confusion " , causing them to act and erratically .

title: Insect plague
description: Insect plague Insect plague was a conjuration spell that could summon swarms of locust s to attack all creatures in an area . Effects . The summoned insects blanketed the area of effect , biting and stinging every creature relentlessly , reducing visibility down to 10 ft ( 3 m ) , and preventing all spellcasting .

title: Inselm Hhune
description: Inselm Hhune Duke Inselm Hhune was a male human merchant who rose to become the leader of the Knights of the Shield but was under the influence of Gargauth , the Hidden Lord . He was also duke of Kamlann Duchy and Lord Watch Chancellor of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Description .

title: Inspired aim
description: Inspired aim Inspired aim is an enchantment spell that makes it easier for allies to hit targets with ranged attacks . Effect . You inspire allies within 40 feet to focus their minds on hitting their intended targets .

title: Inspiring reaction
description: Inspiring reaction Inspiring reaction was a warlord exploit that brought immediate aid to a wounded ally . Effects . Any wound received by the warlord or an ally could initiate this exploit .

title: Instruments of the Bards
