description: Instruments of the Bards The Instruments of the Bards were magical masterwork musical instruments that were extremely effective in the hands of bard s . Description . They were in every way superior to their ordinary counterparts .

title: Instruments of the jann
description: Instruments of the jann The instruments of the jann referred to a legendary collection of extraordinary magical musical instruments created by members of the major genie races . History . The various instruments were created to honor the ascension of each new jann chieftain of the High Desert .

title: Insulation
description: Insulation Insulation was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . " Insulation " provided temporary resistance to electrical damage to the caster .

title: Insurrection
description: Insurrection Insurrection by Thomas M . Reid is the second book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Plot .

title: Intellect devourer
description: Intellect devourer Intellect devourers resembled walking brains on a set of bestial legs . They were servants of the mind flayer s and took over their victims ' minds on their behalf . Ecology .

title: Intelligent item
description: Intelligent item Intelligent items or sentient items were magical item s that possessed a degree of intelligence and sentience . A tiny fraction ( less than one percent ) of the magical items created throughout history had actual intelligence . They had alignment s , could bestow additional powers on their user , and could even have enough of an ego ( a key quality of these creations ) to choose who was worthy to use them .

title: Interior Faerûn
description: Interior Faerûn With the exception of the Shining Plains , the interior lands of Faerûn lie along the irregular western coastline of the Sea of Fallen Stars . In the north the Dragonmere arm of the sea extends far to the west , ending close to the Western Heartlands . To the south , the Vilhon Reach forms a second arm leading to the southwest .

title: Interior Zakhara
description: Interior Zakhara Vast interior Zakhara , like its Zakharan population , was divided into two distinct parts : the dry and barren landlocked elevation of the Haunted Lands took up its north and east and were the dwelling place of hardy desert nomads , genie s , and the remnants of more bountiful days . Its south and west , at the shores of Suq Bay and the Golden Gulf , contained great centers of civilization in the incomparable Cities of the Heart and the devout Cities of the Pantheon . Geographic limits .

title: Intermediate deity
description: Intermediate deity An intermediate deity was a type of deity who was less powerful than a greater deity . They were , however , above lesser deities , demigod s , and dead power s in the ranking of powers . Intermediate deities had hundreds of thousands of worshipers .

title: Inthracis
description: Inthracis Inthracis was an ultroloth necromancer who lived in Corpsehaven in the Blood Rift . He was the commander of the Black Horn Regiment , an elite army 500 strong . Description .

title: Introduction to Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
description: Introduction to Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " Imagine you have entered a fantasy realm with monsters , treasures and daring deeds to be done ! Play a heroic fighter or cunning wizard . Explore old castles and chart the depths of mysterious dungeons .

title: Inum
description: Inum Inum was a famous Iulutiun philosopher . Description . Inum was one of the " kiam " ( elders ) of the " iquemelum " ( village council ) of the village of Gronne in Alpuk on the Great Glacier .

title: Invadiah
description: Invadiah Invadiah was the most powerful erinyes in the Nine Hells and was the leader of Glasya ' s elite Erinyes guard , the Pradixikai . She had fifty - eight erinyes daughters , one cambion daughter and a cambion son named Lorcan whom she regarded as worthless . In 1478 DR , Invadiah sought to carry out Glasya ' s plot to trick Asmodeus into fighting the Abolethic Sovereignty .

title: Inverted Tower
description: Inverted Tower The Inverted Tower was the center for the study of arcane magic in Szith Morcane . Structure . The stronghold was so named because of its unusual construction of rooms branching off from a tall , octagonal cavern .

title: Invisibility purge
description: Invisibility purge Invisibility purge was an abjuration spell that disabled invisibility effects within a small area . Effects . Invisible objects and creatures that entered the protected area immediately became visible .

title: Invisible College
description: Invisible College The Invisible College was a place of study for djinni sorcerers within the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Defenses . Layer upon layer of illusions were constantly changing within and around the College , leading most sages to agree that it did not really exist .

title: Invisible stalker
description: Invisible stalker Invisible stalkers were solitary creatures native to the Elemental Plane of Air . Uses . They were sometimes summoned by mage s to perform tasks .

title: Invoker
description: Invoker Invokers , are divine spellcasters who gain their power through the direct touch of a deity , carrying with them a fragment of the god ' s divine power . This is unlike avenger s , cleric s , or paladin s , who channel their prayer s carefully through holy symbol s . Invokers have no need for such tools , however , and their prayers come directly from their god and none of their power is lost through transition .

title: Iokharic
description: Iokharic Iokharic was the name of a script used by the Draconic language , as well as by the Auran , Ignan , and some . It consisted of runic characters equivalent to letters and numbers in human scripts . Alphabet and punctuation .

title: Iol
description: Iol Iol , also known as violet stone , was the name by which ( ) was commonly known in the Realms . Description . This semi - precious stone was predominately blue in hue , but the stone ' s color changed with viewing angle , from dark blue to straw - yellow .

title: Ioma
description: Ioma Ioma was a small island in the Nelanther Isles to the west of Amn . The island had only one town , Ioma Town , with a population of 800 in 1479 DR . Most of the island was occupied by a mountain of the same name , which contained a large vein of Iomic crystal at its peak .

title: Iomic crystal
description: Iomic crystal Iomic crystal was a purple crystal found on the island of Ioma in the Nelanther Isles . After the Spellplague , the mineral was believed to have anti - magic properties and the Amnish mined it and turned it into amulets to ward off wild magic . It was later found that the crystal had no special properties but the Amnish continued to mine and sell the stones as amethyst .

title: Iorg Brokenjaw
description: Iorg Brokenjaw Iorg Brokenjaw was a dwarf jailer at Grimshackle Jail in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Despite what he did , Iorg was a man of his word , and he always respected his words .

title: Iorn Ludwakazar
description: Iorn Ludwakazar Iorn Ludwakazar was a dwarf king of the Ludwakazar clan in the Earthspur Mountains . Personality . Iorn was a shrewd but stubborn ruler .

title: Ioulaum
description: Ioulaum Ioulaum was a great archwizard of Netheril , a beloved champion of his people and the inventor of both the mythallar and the flying enclaves of his empire . When Ioulaum abandoned Netheril to escape the " life drain " dweomers of the phaerimm in - 339 DR , panic spread at the news of his disappearance , leading to Karsus casting his spell " Karsus ' s avatar " . < ref name = " N : EoM / WoN - p11 - 12 " > < / ref > Since the fall of Netheril , Ioulaum has survived as an elder brain ( the central brain of an illithid community ) lich .

title: Ioulaum ' s longevity
description: Ioulaum ' s longevity This spell was developed by the powerful archwizard Ioulaum of Netheril " circa " the Year of Dwarves Besieged , – 674 DR ( 3185 NR , during Netheril ' s Shadowed Age ) to extend his lifespan over the centuries . Effects . " Ioulaum ' s longevity " dealt massive damage to every creature within its area of effect .

title: Ioun stone
description: Ioun stone Ioun stones , originally called Congenio ' s pebbles and Ioun ' s stones , were magical stones that floated around a bearer ' s head and granted a range of enhancements or powers to a creature . Description . They were small , crystalline stones , coming in a wide range of colors and shapes that determined their powers .

title: Iphegor Nath
description: Iphegor Nath Iphegor Nath was the High Flamelord of the church of Kossuth , residing in the Flaming Brazier . Appearance . Iphegor was tall and craggy and burly of build .

title: Irae T ' sarran
description: Irae T ' sarran Irae T ' sarran was a female drow high priestess of Kiaransalee who attempted to exact her goddess ' s vengeance upon the surface lands by raising an army of undead beneath the Dalelands . Description . Irae was striking for a drow , as she was an albino , a seldom seen variant known as a szarkai .

title: Iraska
description: Iraska Iraska , who was known to her derro subjects as the Slime King was a yuan - ti pureblood who ruled a clan of derro in the Underdark . Description . With the exception of canine teeth which looked like fangs , Iraska appeared as an elderly human female .

title: Iraun
description: Iraun Iraun was a mage , and along with Srivven , they were the self - proclaimed kings of Adaerglast . They originally came from easternmost Murghôm after a battle broke out in their school of magic between students and their masters . Before arriving in Adaerglast , Iraun and Srivven traveled Faerûn , plundering mages ' tombs and seizing spells from living wizards .

title: Iraun Thelder
description: Iraun Thelder Iraun Thelder was a one - eyed mercenary at the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Iraun worked as a guard , and stayed at the Swinging Sword tavern when he had no work .

title: Iriador Wintermist
description: Iriador Wintermist Iriador Wintermist , known as Garnet , was a half - elven spellsinger and former Harper . Description . Iriador had red hair and was over 300 years of age , although she was able to use magic to make herself appear somewhat younger .

title: Iriaebor
description: Iriaebor Iriaebor , also known as the Overland City and the City of a Thousand Spires , was a large city in Sunset Vale in the Western Heartlands region of west Faerûn . Geography . The city stood on a sprawling ridge above the north fork of the river Chionthar .

title: Iriaeboran North Brew
description: Iriaeboran North Brew Iriaeboran North Brew was a local brew from Iriaebor and was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description . This beer was appreciated by the commoners more than those with more refined palettes .

title: Iridescent Peacock Society
description: Iridescent Peacock Society The Iridescent Peacock Society was a secret society in Kozakura . Description . The Iridescent Peacock Society was the only society composed by normally solitary evil wu jen .

title: Iris Well Spring
description: Iris Well Spring Iris Well Spring was a small oasis and village located just east of Semphar in the Hordelands . Description . This area was a dreary place for much of the year , but each spring the dormant dwarf irises bloomed , surrounding the area with beautiful blue flowers .

title: Iris agate
description: Iris agate Iris Agate was a low - grade agate that came in large pieces , usually sold by the pound ( kilogram ) as a building material . Description . Iris agate looked white in normal lighting conditions , but when cut into thin slabs and illuminated from behind , its swirling mix of colors was strikingly visible .

title: Irisroth
description: Irisroth Irisroth was a half - elf in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Irisroth was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .

title: Iritar
description: Iritar Iritar " the Dark " was a human man and a wizard . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . He was also the " Night Hood " of the Shadowcloaks thieves guild .

title: Irithyl
description: Irithyl Irithyl was a royal gold elven family that ruled over the Empire of Cormanthyr , a great kingdom of elves in the forest of Cormanthor , from the nation ' s founding in - 4000 DR onward through 661 DR . The Irithyl clan was an old founding family of Arcorar and among the first Twelve Houses of Cormanthyr . History .

title: Irixis
description: Irixis Irixis the Sorcerorb was a powerful elder orb beholder spellcaster of Ooltul in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Activities . Irixis officially acted as an assistant to Scalmarael the Sage , a phaerimm and member of Triumvirate that ruled Ooltul .

title: Irl
description: Irl Irl was a village that lay just west of the River Rith , due north of The Realm of the Mount . The village ' s main claim to fame was in the form of jewlers and their gem s . Governmental rulings were made by the Eight - sided Stone , a covert council whose members were the elders of the most powerful Irlian families .

title: Irlin Stonestable
description: Irlin Stonestable Irlin Stonestable was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Stonestable noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Irlin gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war .

title: Irmakul
description: Irmakul Irmakul " Bloodthews " was a priest of Ilmater from Memnon , Calimshan , of the 3rd century DR . Irmakul was an Archsufferer in the Church of Ilmater and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History .

title: Irmar Graycloak
description: Irmar Graycloak Irmar Graycloak was an adventurer and leader of the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company in the early 1340s DR . Irmar Graycloak and Graycloak ' s Wolves were in the city of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach in the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , when they were requested to deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the most holy book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent . However , during the harsh winter , Graycloak ' s Wolves fell prey to doppelganger s and leucrotta preying on travellers .

title: Iron
description: Iron Iron was a non - precious metal mined widely on Toril . Mining . The Galena Mountains in northeast Faerûn were rich in iron ore and human s and dwarves established mining communities there .

title: Iron Crucible
description: Iron Crucible The Iron Crucible was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Iron Crucible was a large fountain of liquid metal located near the Sevenfold Mazework .

title: Iron Dragon Mountain
description: Iron Dragon Mountain Iron Dragon Mountain was a mountain in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , between Impiltur and the Vast . It was a legendary hidden peak and home to greatest temple of Deneir in the Realms . History .

title: Iron Helm of Heroes
description: Iron Helm of Heroes The Iron Helm of Heroes was an artifact and minor relic of Ilmater the Broken God and his church . Description . The " Iron Helm of Heroes " was unremarkable in appearance .

title: Iron Legion
description: Iron Legion The Iron Legion was a disbanded mercenary company by 1358 DR . History . The Iron Legion was the combined army that fought the arcanaloth Yrkhetep in his home plane of Hades .

title: Iron Lord
description: Iron Lord The Iron Lord , or Huhrong , was the highest - ranking male ruler of Rashemen . He was expected to rule wisely in the best interests of the people of Rashemen . His duties included keeping travel between settlements relatively safe , securing the frontier lands , controlling raiding monsters from the wilder parts of Rashemen , and serving as supreme warlord during times of war .

title: Iron Ring
description: Iron Ring The Iron Ring was a consortium of the most powerful slavers in Skullport . Activities . The Iron Ring ' s primary interest was slaving and protecting the slave trade in Skullport and Undermountain .

title: Iron Throne
description: Iron Throne The Iron Throne was a mysterious merchant organization . Little was known of its history or the identity of its backers . It apparently operated independently of any government .

title: Iron Tower
description: Iron Tower The Iron Tower was the massive tower - fortress located in the hellish Iron City of Dis . The Tower served as the headquarters of the Archdevil of the 2nd realm of hell , where the city was located , Dispater . The tower was heavily guarded and crawled with deadly and wicked traps , all set in place to protect Dispater , who was extremely , and perhaps wisely , paranoid .

title: Iron Wastes
description: Iron Wastes The frigid Iron Wastes are home to the dullard lord Kostchtchie , the malformed demon - giant who claims all frost giants as his protected kin . A place of unrelenting blizzards and icy rifts , the inhospitable layer might have been avoided by most Abyssal inhabitants if not for the presence of one of the most coveted gates in the Abyss , a rime - encrusted stone monolith arch leading to Jotunheim on Ysgard , near the frost giant town of Utgardt . More importantly , the gate opens near the roots of the Great Wheel - spanning Yggdrasil Tree , a major transplanar thoroughfare leading to locales throughout the Upper Planes .

title: Iron Worm
description: Iron Worm The Iron Worm was a unique anaxim that roamed the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The Iron Worm was a gargantuan worm - like anaxim with an articulated metallic body that stretched over a hundred feet ( 300 meters ) in length .

title: Iron body
description: Iron body Iron body was a transmutation spell that turned the subject ' s body to living iron which , in turn , granted powerful resistances and new abilities . Effects . While under the effects of this spell , the target experienced the following effects : Material components .

title: Iron circlet
description: Iron circlet The iron circlet was a unique magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . History . The iron circlet worn by the grinning statue of Byubo , the Padhrasattva of " nyum " , found within the Rainbow Monastery .

title: Iron crisis
description: Iron crisis The Iron Crisis was an event occurring in 1368 DR in which the Iron Throne plotted to destroy the iron supply of the Sword Coast by poisoning the iron from the mines of Nashkel with alchemy , having groups of bandits steal all of the untainted iron all along the coast and infiltrating rival trading companies with doppelganger s so as to drive them into financial ruin . This was so they would have a monopoly on iron in the region using a secret iron mine they had found in the Cloakwood , fueled by slave labour . Rumours were put around that it was the nation of Amn that was causing the iron shortage , helped by several important figures in Baldur ' s Gate being assassinated and having the insignias of the Shadow Thieves dropped at the murder sites .

title: Iron golem
description: Iron golem Whereas most other golems are created as guards , iron golems are usually created as mindless soldiers of war . These behemoths are unstoppable engines of destruction . They wade into melee with powerful blows from their fists and expel a corrosive poisonous gas onto the battlefield .

title: Iron vanguard
description: Iron vanguard Iron vanguards are mighty warriors trained to prime physical condition and who are ruthless in obtaining victory . Few , if any , defend their allies as well as an iron vanguard . Abilities .

title: Iron vigil
description: Iron vigil Iron vigil was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to forgo food , drink and sleep , and be immune to the effects of normal environmental conditions for a week or even longer . Effects . While under the effects of this spell , the caster required no food or water and felt no ill effects from hunger , thirst , fatigue , dehydration , or the discomforts of exposure to normal climate conditions .

title: Ironbark
description: Ironbark Ironbark was a treant in Cormanthor . History . In 1459 DR , Ironbark and two other treants were captured by the dracolich Dretchroyaster , who considered them a delicacy .

title: Ironcloak
description: Ironcloak Ironcloak was a ruined town in central Turmish , near the Alaoreum River . It was a brutal example of how the Emerald Enclave dealt with those who damaged the environment . History .

title: Ironcloak ( lord )
description: Ironcloak ( lord ) Lord Ironcloak was a man of Turmish in the 13th century DR . He was the ruler of the town of Ironcloak . History .

title: Ironfang Keep
description: Ironfang Keep Ironfang Keep was an ancient keep in northern Faerûn . Geography . The stronghold lay in the northernmost parts of the Earthspur Mountains at the cascades where the White River fell into the Moonsea .

title: Ironfell
description: Ironfell Ironfell was a magical ore mined from the constantly regenerating body of the fallen primordial Telos . It had a crystalline structure but was as hard as steel after being worked by skilled hands . It was used to make weapons , magic items , armor , and golem - like constructs called shardsoul s .

title: Ironford
description: Ironford Ironford was a bridge which crossed the river Dessarin . It was a part of the Iron Road . History .

title: Ironhar
description: Ironhar Ironhar was the biggest of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Ironhar was home to several wealthy collectors , who often hired adventurers to explore old ruins in eastern Eskorn , and to retrieve old relics for them .

title: Ironlord
description: Ironlord Ironlord was the title of the ruler of Earthfast , a dwarven city in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark Powers . The ironlord was the sole leader of Earthfast , and it was a hereditary position . The ironlord led the army and maintained law and order .

title: Ironmaster
description: Ironmaster Ironmaster was an isolated towered city built into the rocky walls of a valley in the Frozenfar . Ironmaster was inhabited by mountain dwarves . The coat of arms for Ironmaster was a red anvil on a diamond - shaped field of gray .

title: Ironseth
description: Ironseth The Ironseth family was a human family of horse and mercenary trainers in Amnwater , Amn around 1368 DR . Members . The family was led by [ Ghaark Ironseth | Lord Ghaark Ironseth ] ] and around 1368 DR it owned about half the land around Amnwater .

title: Ironstar mace
description: Ironstar mace The Ironstar mace was the signature weapon of Clan Ironstar constructed from their secret alloy , darksteel . Description . The mace s were the size of a footman ' s mace yet weighed less than 1 lb ( 0 .

title: Irooukudel
description: Irooukudel The Irooukudel were a group of Tuigan priests who lived within the vale of Ejen Horo in the Hordelands . Activities . The main responsibility of the Irooukudel was to watch over the bodies of the honored dead of the Tuigan who were buried in Ejen Horo .

title: Irphiina
description: Irphiina Irphiina was a shade human who worked for Lord Telamont of the Shadovar . Description . Appearing human , Irphiina had dusky gray skin , a dour expression , and shadows that seemed to cling to her skin .

title: Irreph Mulmar
description: Irreph Mulmar Irreph Mulmar was the high constable of High Dale in 1368 DR . History . In youth Irreph was a hero and an adventurer that in senior years was choose as high constable of his dale .

title: Irtios
description: Irtios Irtios was the common name for in the Realms . It was found as natural crystals when mined from deep formations , or as tumbled stones in streambeds and among deposits of water - born gravel . Description .

title: Iruladoon
description: Iruladoon Iruladoon was a quasi - extraplanar forest that was located on the eastern bank of Lac Dinneshere in Icewind Dale . It was created by Mielikki specifically for her apparent Chosen , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in order to house and instruct his friends , the Companions of the Hall , prior to their reincarnations . Catti - brie and Regis were the first to arrive here after their deaths in 1385 DR .

title: Iryklathagra
description: Iryklathagra Irklathagra was a blue great wyrm who had long plagued the lands of Amn , Calimshan , and Tethyr and was the long - standing nemesis of Shoon VII . Description . Irklathagra was the perfect example of a blue dragon in her prime , sporting impressive frilled ears and an enormous horn typical of her kind .

title: Isabeau Thione
description: Isabeau Thione Isabeau Thione was a female human thief in Waterdeep and the daughter of Lady Lucia Thione - Hhune of Tethyr . Appearance . Isabeau was 5 feet 3 inches ( 1 .

title: Isair and Madae
description: Isair and Madae Description . Being half - elf and half - devil , Isair and Madae have elfin and devilish characteristics . They both stand at around six and a half feet tall and are bipedal .

title: Isakkhu
description: Isakkhu Isakkhu was a male deity worshiped by barbarian s dwelling in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast in north Faerûn . Description . The deity took the form of a mountain .

title: Isendraug
description: Isendraug Isendraug was a white dragon enslaved by the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Isendraug lived with her mate Cryovain in Svarborg .

title: Isfizari ibn - Atash
description: Isfizari ibn - Atash Isfizari ibn - Atash was an outland priest and fanatic of Kossuth inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Frequent violent communes with his god left Isfizari ' s body horribly burned and disfigured .

title: Ishal Karanok
description: Ishal Karanok Ishal Karanok was a member of House Karanok who came to control all of Chessenta in the years following the Spellplague in 1385 DR . History . He gained the trust of the people after he repelled the armies of aberration s sent by the Abolethic Sovereignty in 1399 DR .

title: Ishaldra
description: Ishaldra Ishaldra was a dryad princess and a powerful fey of Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . Activities . She advised her companion prince Whitchthorn , balancing his evil inclinations with her good nature .

title: Ishenalyr
description: Ishenalyr Ishenalyr was an ancient green dragon who was one of the agents of Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . Abilities . Ishenalyr was a type of draconic mystic called hidecarved .

title: Ishi Barasume
description: Ishi Barasume Ishi Barasume was a crew - member of the Halruaa n caravel ship " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Ishi hailed from Kozakura in Kara - Tur .

title: Ishtar
description: Ishtar Ishtar was one of two Untheric goddesses of love and war ( the other was her progenitor , Inanna ) . She departed the world of Toril soon after Enlil did . In her place , she left her portfolio and the right to use her name and appearance to the Mulhorandi goddess Isis .

title: Ishtiyam
description: Ishtiyam Ishtiyam was the term used to describe a pilot or navigator of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Not every ship in Zakhara had an " ishtiyam " on board at all times , but it was common practice to hire one when departing for a long voyage or as a backup when sailing through particularly dangerous waters .

title: Isimud
description: Isimud Isimud was the wizard leader of the Enclave in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Isimud was a very old wizard , relying on magical means to move .

title: Isis
description: Isis Isis ( pronounced " eye " - sys ) is a kind deity that takes joy in revealing new discoveries to her followers . She is known as Isharia in Thay , and by the name Ishtar in Unther . History .

title: Iskander
description: Iskander Iskander was a wizard member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons second - in - command of the Xonthal ' s Tower , History . Iskander was a wizard long time member of the Cult , being a strong dracolich traditionalist he did not like the new direction of the Cult under Severin . At one point just before Tyranny of Dragons Iskander was nominated second - in - command of the just conquered Xonthal ' s Tower , a bastion full of Cult ' s traditionalists .

title: Iskh Lammarask
description: Iskh Lammarask Iskh Lammarask , known as Motherlass Longfingers to her patrons , was an old human inn owner in Blackhold , Fimbrul . Appareance . Iskh had gold eyes under fierce black brows .

title: Iskor
description: Iskor Iskor was a water wraith from Elemental Plane of Water . Activities . Iskor acted as a broker of information acting on the behalf of a water god worshiped in the Inner Planes and by sea creatures of Faerûn .

title: Island giant
description: Island giant Island giants were malevolent giant s found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Island giants communicated via a broken form of Midani that was mostly unintelligible by others who spoke Midani . Description .

title: Island of Gardens
description: Island of Gardens The Island of Gardens , or al - Haba ' iq , was located within the Genie ' s Turban of the Corsair Domains off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Geography . The coast of this island was covered with lush foliage , giving the island its name .

title: Island of the Free
description: Island of the Free The Island of the Free was a small settlement located on an earthmote in eastern Tethyr near the Omlarandin Mountains . History . It was founded in approximately 1462 DR by the escaped slave and former gladiator Azad the Free .

title: Islands of the Utter South
description: Islands of the Utter South The Islands of the Utter South , also simply called the Utter South , was a series of unexplored islands found south of the known regions of the Crowded Sea . Geography . Situated south of the Djinni ' s Claws , the Steaming Isles , and Bariya , the Islands of the Utter South sprawled east to west for over a thousand miles across waters that most sailing vessels wisely avoided .

title: Isle of Devils
description: Isle of Devils The Isle of Devils was the largest of the Outer Isles of Wa . Devil s that had once wandered the mainland were banished here by the Spirit of Wa . A man had to agree to take the place of a devil before it could leave .

title: Isle of Gargantuas
description: Isle of Gargantuas The Isle of Gargantuas was one of the Outer Isles of Wa in Kara - Tur , and home to gigantic monsters , called gargantua s . Description . The island was often rent by volcanic eruptions and earthquakes , which devastated the landscape .

title: Isle of One Thousand Pines
description: Isle of One Thousand Pines The Isle of One Thousand Pines was one of the Outer Isles of Wa in Kara - Tur . It was considered part of Jasuga Province . It was a densely forested place , hence its name .

title: Isle of Quelthiir
description: Isle of Quelthiir The Isle of Quelthiir , also known simply as Quelthiir or Passion Island , was an island that separated the Luirenstrand bay from the open waters of the Great Sea off the coast of Luiren . Geography . The Isle of Quelthiir was located off the southern coast of Luiren , a straight shot southeast from Shoun .

title: Islif Lurelake
description: Islif Lurelake Islif Lurelake was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Islif was born in the village of Espar to the trader Buckman Lurelake .

title: Islik Herlingson
description: Islik Herlingson Islik Herlingson was a dwarf and leader of the Herlinga Clan in the Hordelands . Description . Like all Herlinga dwarves , Islik was red - bearded .

title: Issacortae
description: Issacortae The Issacortae people inhabited the western part of the wild lands of Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Description . The barbaric Issacortae were medium build and muscular with black curly hair .

title: Issacortae language
description: Issacortae language Issacortae , also spelled Isacorte , was a language spoken by the Issacortae people of the northwestern Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Issacortae was related to Pazruki and Wu - haltai , other languages in the Amaese languages group .

title: Issani
description: Issani Issani was a messanger of Waterdeep . Biography . Issani was sent from Waterdeep to negotiate with Neverwinter .

title: Issayk
description: Issayk Issayk was the most infamous forger in Skullport . Activities . Issayk could forge the most perfect false documents in the Realms .

title: Issem
description: Issem Issem was a vampire in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Issem was a vampire who , in ancient times , was cursed to be bound to the Red Wizards of Thay and specifically to the Doomvault dungeon .

title: Isteval
description: Isteval Sir Isteval was a paladin from Cormyr . Personality . A noble , retired paladin who gathers adventurers to his cause .

title: Isthana Ro
description: Isthana Ro Isthana Ro was the guild master of the Rogue ' s Guild in Hillsfar . Activities . Isthana managed the Rogue ' s Guild , the official thieves ' guild of Hillsfar .

title: Istishia
description: Istishia Istishia ( pronounced " is - TISH - ee - ah " ) , also known as King of Water Elementals , is the neutral primordial deity of elemental water and purification . Worshipers . Istishia is worshiped by Sailors , Pirates , Water Elementals , Water Genasi , some Aquatic Elves , and others who feel a bond with the Ocean ' s destructive power .

title: Isyio
description: Isyio Isyio was a wizard in Teziir in 1359 DR . History . Once Isyio was an apprentice of the Simbul but after he embarrassed her the Simbul sent him away in order to mature .

title: It ' s All in the Blood
description: It ' s All in the Blood It ' s All in the Blood , designed by Dave Olson , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on the village of Elventree , drow , and the Maerimydra . Summary .

title: Item of cloaked wizardry
description: Item of cloaked wizardry An item of cloaked wizardry was any magic item that , in addition to possessing a regular enchantment , was also undetectable as a magic item from spells . These items originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers .

title: Items for the Immortals
description: Items for the Immortals Items for the Immortals was a shop located in the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Items for the Immortals was located within the Court District since only the residents of that lavish section of Huzuz could afford the price of most of the items sold by the shop .

title: Ithal Bridge
description: Ithal Bridge The Ithal Bridge was a large and ancient bridge over the River Ith at the exact center of the city of Darromar on the Ithal Road ( or Star Street ) . It was constructed by dwarves during the kingdom of Shanatar . The bridge was four wagons wide and was the only safe means of crossing the River Ith for hundreds of miles .

title: Ithal Crag
description: Ithal Crag The Ithal Crag was a large hill in the Royal Quarter of Darromar where the queen ' s royal palace of Faerntarn was built . Geography . The Ithal Crag was a rocky headland overlooking the River Ith to the south .

title: Ithal Road
description: Ithal Road The Ithal Road was a major trade road from Zazesspur to Saradush and Ithal Pass . It also passed through the center of Darromar , the capital of Tethyr , within which it was called Star Street . In Darromar , the road divided the city north to south , while the River Ith , which was crossed at the Ithal Bridge , divided the city east to west .

title: Ithana Redstave
description: Ithana Redstave Ithana Redstave was an ambitious Zhentarim wizard in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Ithana lead the Zhent garrison in the city .

title: Ithboltar
description: Ithboltar Ithboltar was a male wizard who was the leader of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . Ithboltar was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , most of the magelords began as apprentices of him : first Neldryn Hawklyn , later Kadeln Olothstar and Seldinor Stormcloak .

title: Ithimir Isle
description: Ithimir Isle Ithimir Isle was a small island off the coast of Akanûl . The island was originally in Abeir and fell into the Sea of Fallen Stars at the time of the Spellplague . The island was notable for being the only source of arambarium ore in Faerûn .

title: Ithmonn
description: Ithmonn County Ithmonn was an agricultural region in central Tethyr . Geography . Ithmonn was located in the Crown Lands north of the River Ith and bordering the Purple Marches in the west .

title: Ithraides
description: Ithraides High Spellstar Ithraides was a moon elf wizard and the High Spellstar of Arcorar who inscribed three telkiira , the first of which came into the possession of Araevin Teshurr . His subjects Kaeledhin , Morthil and Sanathar each took one of the telkiira . After his death and journey to Arvandor he left most of his tomes and treasures to the star elf Morthil .

title: Ithvar Wordkiller
description: Ithvar Wordkiller Lord Ithvar Wordkiller was a wizard and businessman in Skullport . Personality . Ithvar ' s ruin was his temper , he was too ready to fight without thinking for a second .

title: Ito - Jo
description: Ito - Jo Ito - Jo was a cursed castle in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Ito - Jo was the ancestral home of the Ito family in Maeshi , build on a small island near the coastline .

title: Ito Chomei
description: Ito Chomei Ito Chomei was a cursed shukenja in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Chomei was a retainer of the Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Ito Gohei
description: Ito Gohei Ito Gohei was a cursed wu jen in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Gohei was a dwarf retainer of the Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Ito Kiku
description: Ito Kiku Ito Kiku was a cursed maiden in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Kiku was the daughter of Ito Tadahiro who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Ito Murasame
description: Ito Murasame Ito Murasame was an undead shikki - gaki in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Murasame was the lady of the castle who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Ito Tadahiro
description: Ito Tadahiro Ito Tadahiro was a cursed samurai ronin in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Tadahiro was a samurai general of the Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Ito Yoichi
description: Ito Yoichi Ito Yoichi was a cursed bushi / ninja in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Ito Yoichi was a retainer of the Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Ityak - Ortheel
description: Ityak - Ortheel Ityak - Ortheel , commonly called the Elf Eater , is a monstrous creature that dwells in the Abyss , waiting for the god Malar , the Beastlord , to summon it to Faerûn to destroy life . Physical description . The Elf Eater is a thirty - foot - tall monstrosity that stands on three enormous , trunk - like legs .

title: Itza
description: Itza The Itzas were a human people of Far Payit in the southeast of Maztica . They were a sub - grouping of the Payit race . Description .

title: Iuak
description: Iuak An iuak was a blade made of bone or stone that resembled a machete , common in the Great Glacier . Description . An iuak was about two - feet - long and six - inches - wide .

title: Iulutiun
description: Iulutiun The Iulutiuns ( EE - oo - LOO - shee - uns ) were a human people living in the Alpuk region of the Great Glacier . They were one of the ethnicities collectively known as the Ulutiun s and the most numerous of all human tribes living on the Glacier . Description .

title: Iurnan Chall
description: Iurnan Chall Iurnan Chall was a mercenary in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lhrek was a high - ranking member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company and the company ' s magic - user .

title: Ivan Bouldershoulder
description: Ivan Bouldershoulder Ivan Bouldershoulder was a dwarf , brother to Pikel Bouldershoulder . Description . Ivan had a long yellow beard , square shoulders , and dark eyes .

title: Ivold Nakarof
description: Ivold Nakarof Ivold Nakarof was a priest of Bane , serving in Zhentil Keep . Ivold ' s older brother died in the Battle of Falling Wasps at the hands of the Red Plumes and in 1373 DR he decided to enact his vengeance upon them . After traveling to a cemetery near the road between Hillsfar and Yulash , Ivold started casting " animate dead " to raise an army of fallen soldiers with the intention to unleash them on the Red Plume forces .

title: Ivor Beguine
description: Ivor Beguine Ivor Beguine served as a sailor on the pirate ship " Orcsblood " . History . In 1460 DR , Ivor and his friend Gareth Jadaren became disgusted with the brutality of their captain and abandoned ship near Mulmaster .

title: Ivory
description: Ivory Ivory , also known as , was the primary substance that makes up the teeth or tusks of all mammals and some other creatures . It was carved for artistic ornaments and also many practical uses . Description .

title: Ivory Plague
description: Ivory Plague The Ivory Plague was a disease that was prevalent in Kara - Tur . Outbreaks . Shou Lung .

title: Ixan
description: Ixan Ixan was a Weaver of the Purple wizard and a traditionalist leader of the Cult of the Dragon in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . He remained loyal to the old traditions of the Cult , in opposition to the majority of the Cult that had shifted to Severin Silrajin ' s vision .

title: Ixilthetocal
description: Ixilthetocal Ixilthetocal was a mad sahuagin king in the Sea of Swords . History . Ixilthetocal ruled the City of Caverns .

title: Ixtzul
description: Ixtzul Ixtzul is a lost city deep within the jungles of Far Payit on the continent of Maztica . Although the city was abandoned hundreds of years ago , it remains in very good condition because of the caretakers created by the city ' s last ruler , Greyst . Before he died , Greyst used Hishna magic to create a colony of giant , intelligent ants .

title: Ixusaxa Terrorsong
description: Ixusaxa Terrorsong Ixusaxa Terronsong was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Ixusaxa ' s main objective was the power to command true dragons , if someone can offer to her something related to it , she can betray her current masters , otherwise she followed loyally her duty , hoping to rise the rank .

title: Ixzan
description: Ixzan The ixzan were a semi - amphibious race , closely related to the ixitxachitl . Habitats . Like ixitxachitl , they resembled manta rays , but unlike their cousins they lived only in Underdark .

title: Iyachtu Xvim
description: Iyachtu Xvim Iyachtu Xvim , also known as Godson , was the half - demonic son of Bane and for a time , the lawful evil lesser deity of Fear , Hatred , and Tyranny . Iyachtu Xvim was consumed in 1372 DR when his father used his body to re - emerge from death , taking Xvim ' s portfolios as his own . Description .

title: Iyawaei
description: Iyawaei Iyawaei of Konghani was a sea captain in 1357 DR . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . He ruled his ship with an iron fist and his crew feared him .

title: Iyelle Tlabbar
description: Iyelle Tlabbar Iyelle Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Iyelle like many others priestesses strongly believed that the Demon Weave was a bad idea , fearing that male would challenge their power .

title: Iymrith
description: Iymrith Iymrith was a very powerful sorcerer blue dragon . Activities . Iymrith tirelessly explored all ancient Netherese ruins in the Ascore area in search of magic .

title: Iyraclea
description: Iyraclea Iyraclea , or simply the Ice Queen , was a female human cleric , divine disciple , and hierophant of Auril the Frostmaiden living within the Great Glacier . Ancient and mighty , she was the self - proclaimed Ice Queen of the glacier . She was the Chosen of Auril by 1373 DR .

title: Iyrauroth
description: Iyrauroth Iyrauroth , also called " the Wyrm of the Peaks " , was a male great wyrm black dragon that laired in the steppes of Thar and in Mount Grimmerfang in the Vast . History . In fear of his older sister , Embrurshaile , Iyrauroth spent centuries of his life hiding on other continents .

title: Iyvdanya
description: Iyvdanya Madame Iyvdanya was a diviner in Skullport . Activities . Iyvdanya predicted destinies for the notoriously superstitious outlaws and pirates passing for the Port of Shadow .

title: Izac Uthor
description: Izac Uthor Izac Uthor was a goblin commander who rose to power during the turmoil that wracked goblinkind near the lands bordering western Anauroch before the Battle of Bones occurred . Personality . Izac was brutish and ambitious .

title: Izhkin
description: Izhkin Izhkin was a derro rogue also known as " Lord of the Dark " . Personality . He seemed incomprehensible and was content with great acts of violence to keep ruling his realm .

title: J ' Nah
description: J ' Nah J ' Nah is a half - fiend elf who appears in the first chapter of " " as an antagonist . She had made a deal with the white dragon Tymofarrar to acquire the four relics in the keeping of Drogan Droganson . In her betrayal , she sent a group of gnoll s under her control to attack Tymofarrar ' s kobold s ( who were sent in ahead of time because Tymofarrar wished to see the artifacts for himself first ) who were returning from Hilltop with the artifacts .

title: J . E . Sawyer
description: J . E . Sawyer Joshua " J .

title: J . Robert King
description: J . Robert King J . Robert King is a novelist and game designer who has contributed to a variety of sourcebooks from TSR , Inc .

title: Jaal
description: Jaal Jaal was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Stonespeaker Hgraam could possibly have sent Jaal to guide an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , to the mystic library of Gravenhollow .

title: Jabal Turab
description: Jabal Turab Jabal Turab , or the Mount of Dust , was a mountain that housed an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . Located 80 miles ( 128 .

title: Jabal al Gaunrahl
description: Jabal al Gaunrahl Jabal al Gaunrahl was a jewel thief in Calimport and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Jabal was the son of an elven slave and a struggling gem cutter in the Mjôm Sabban of the Jewel Ward of Calimport .

title: Jabbrawuk
description: Jabbrawuk A jabbrawuk was a type of dragon of fantastical appearance and a long neck . The name " jabbrawuk " was used by some sage s . Statues of jabbrawuks were among the statues of gargoyle s , gremlin s , satyr s , and wyvern s that adorned Oldstone Hall and its walls , in Wheloon in Cormyr .

title: Jacinth
description: Jacinth Unique to the Realms , jacinth , also known as hyacinth and flamegem , was a gemstone similar to sapphire . Description . This rare jewel had a fiery orange hue and was as hard and durable as sapphire and ruby .

title: Jack Ravenwild
description: Jack Ravenwild Jack Ravenwild was a rogue who was born in and resided in Ravens Bluff . He was most noted for recovering the shadow magic tome known as the Sarkenaegal from Sarbreen and for his one hundred year imprisonment in the mythal below Ravens Bluff . Description .

title: Jack the Gnome
description: Jack the Gnome Jack the Gnome was a moderately powerful spellcaster who appeared in the novel " The Orc King " . History . Jack lived in the Underdark for centuries and was at one time a student of illithid s and demon s in his search for greater magical knowledge .

title: Jackal ( kit )
description: Jackal ( kit ) Jackals were wizard s in Zakhara who venerated their namesake , preferring to steal spells from others instead of going through the hard work of studying them and learning like other wizards . Requirements . Because their nature involved stealing spells from others , Jackals were never lawful individuals .

title: Jackal ward
description: Jackal ward Jackal ward was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell protected a wizard from a jackal wizard attempting to steal their spells .

title: Jackals
description: Jackals The Jackals were a vicious organized force found in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . The wicked salamander s of the Jackals were used to violently quell unrest or riots among the poor citizens of the city .

title: Jaculi
description: Jaculi Jaculis was a tree - dwelling creature that resembled a snake . Description . Jaculis looked like snakes with mauve to dark purple scales and an arrow - shaped head topped with sharp , forward - pointing horns .

title: Jada Marlserpent
description: Jada Marlserpent Jada Marlserpent , also known as Jada Harimdor , was one of the fabled dragonheir s , and the last surviving member of Clan Marlserpent as of 1479 DR . History . Jada was born in 1459 DR in the village of Wandering Stones , and as her mother died in childbirth , Jada became the last survivor of her bloodline .

title: Jadaren Hold
description: Jadaren Hold Jadaren Hold was a stronghold built into an extinct volcano near Erlkazar . Before it was claimed by Gareth Jadaren , it was known as Giant ' s Fist and was home to a clan of dwarves who carved an extensive series of tunnels and chambers under the mountain . Gareth claimed Giant ' s Fist in 1461 DR and had his friend Jandi M ' baren use the Rythanko to place powerful wards on the stronghold .

title: Jadd Ala ' i
description: Jadd Ala ' i Jadd Ala ' i was a human sha ' ir living in Madinat al - Mumin in the Steaming Isles in 1367 DR . Activities . Jadd was the closest advisor to his wife and leader of Madinat al - Mumin , Jaddat Jamila .

title: Jaddat Jamila
description: Jaddat Jamila Jaddat Jamila was the human ruler of Madinat al - Mumin in the Steaming Isles in 1367 DR . Appearance . Jaddat Jamila was an aged woman .

title: Jade
description: Jade Jade was the generally accepted name for a class of stones found in the Realms that included and . Description . When jade was freshly mined , it was found in shades of light to dark green , and white .

title: Jade Gate Spring
description: Jade Gate Spring Jade Gate Spring was a small town located along the Dragonwall bordering the Hordelands and Kara - Tur . Description . The gate through the Dragonwall in this town led to the Horseshoe Temple Oasis and Merket Oasis .

title: Jade spider
description: Jade spider Jade spiders were construct s of the drow . Description . The spiders got their name because of the sharp - tipped mandibles and saw - edged legs which were made of a particular sort of magically - treated jade .

title: Jadethread
description: Jadethread Jadethread was a human thief who specialized in procuring difficult treasure . Description . Jadethread was a tan - skinned man with shoulder - length brown hair and blue eyes .

title: Jadger
description: Jadger Jadger was a deep gnome ghost burrow warden in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Secretly , some young deep gnomes gathered around the ghostly Jadger to learn the ways of the burrow warden .

title: Jaemas Xorlarrin
description: Jaemas Xorlarrin Jaemas Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin in 1373 DR . History . Jaemas was a competent Xorlarrin wizard .

title: Jaerathindryl
description: Jaerathindryl Jaerathindryl , or " Malachite " , was a wyrm - aged female green dragon who laired in the forests south of Mulmaster in the lands of the Moonsea in north Faerûn . History . By 1369 DR , Malachite was waging a feud with the much younger black dragon Velvet , who lived in the Flooded Forest to the south .

title: Jaezred Chaulssin
description: Jaezred Chaulssin The Jaezred Chaulssin was a secret patriarchal organization based in Chaulssin primarily consisting of skilled shadow dragon - blooded drow assassin s bent on ending the drow race ’ s slavery to Lolth . Objectives . The Jaezred Chaulssin ’ s objective was to free the drow from Lolth ’ s and her priestesses ’ oppression .

title: Jafar el Uabar
description: Jafar el Uabar Jafar el Uabar was the Nirdey of Volothamp for the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Jafar grew up in Volothamp with his uncle Tulmon , a wealthy pearl diver .

title: Jagged Dagger
description: Jagged Dagger The Jagged Dagger was a tavern built in 1372 DR . It was a frequent place of interest of the Red Dragon Trading Post . Inhabitants .

title: Jagre
description: Jagre Jagres are extremely powerful humanoids who were created by Zaltec during the Night of Wailing . High ranking Jaguar Knights were transformed into ogre s and a few were later turned into jagres . Jagres are leaders of the orc s and ogres who now live in the Valley of Nexal .

title: Jaguar Guard
description: Jaguar Guard The Jaguar Guard was a mercenary company based in Tethyr . History . The Jaguar Guard were composed of Jaguar Knights from Kultaka in Maztica .

title: Jaguar lord
description: Jaguar lord Jaguar lords were huge , evil , intelligent jaguar s living in the jungles of Maztica . Jaguar lords hated couatl s and would attack one on sight . Combat .

title: Jahed
description: Jahed Jahed is a weretiger who now serves his god in the Demiplane of Dread . Biography . Jahed began life as part of a group of gypsies in the Dalelands .

title: Jaheira
description: Jaheira Jaheira was a half - elf , druid , warrior , a member of the Harpers , and a friend of Gorion . She and her husband Khalid , who was later killed , were sent to investigate the iron crisis , and she traveled with Gorion ' s ward during that time and for some time after . The games .

title: Jaheira ( genie )
description: Jaheira ( genie ) Jaheira was a tasked artist genie serving the House of Al - Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Jaheira dressed herself in the latest fashions of Huzuz , usually before they become popular with others .

title: Jahlah
description: Jahlah The jahlah ( jah - LAH ) was a small simplistic Zakharan drum . Description . A " jahlah " was a basic clay pot that was played by beating it with both hands .

title: Jaipur chaka
description: Jaipur chaka The Jaipur chaka was a successful chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . The Jaipurs owned thousands of acres of farmland in Var the Golden .

title: Jak Errins
description: Jak Errins Jak Errins was a male human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Trusted Sword . He was the seneschal of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard Jak was getting on in years and two underpriests , Battlelady Peris Whallnsor and Lance of the Lord Niskam Tresdaap , were contending for his position .

title: Jak Fleet
description: Jak Fleet Jak Fleet was a halfling cleric / thief who was an adventuring companion and the best friend of Erevis Cale . Relationships . Jak was thought by Cale to be his conscience personified as he was always a shoulder to lean on , and a true friend who always managed to pull Cale from the brink of darkness when he needed it .

title: Jak Timberline
description: Jak Timberline Jak Timberline was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description & Personality .

title: Jaka Sculi
description: Jaka Sculi Jaka Sculi was a rash young man in the town of Auckney , nestled in the Spine of the World . Description . Jaka was rather self - centered and felt he was better than everyone else .

title: Jalandyl o ' Stars
description: Jalandyl o ' Stars Jalandyl o ' Stars was an agent of the Harpers who posed as a dancer at the Drunken Lion alehouse in Archenbridge . Description . While scarred somewhat by her travels and adventures , she was easily the most attractive of the Lion ' s ladies .

title: Jalanthar
description: Jalanthar Jalanthar was a hamlet located on the trail between Everlund and Sundabar and was once a stop on the Rauvin River situated between the Moon Pass and Everlund . Description . The buildings were half - buried in the ground and looked like as green hills .

title: Jalanvaloss
description: Jalanvaloss Jalanvaloss was a steel dragon in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Jalanvaloss was a vigilant observer of even the smallest details and this helped her in the many intrigues and deception she was a part of .

title: Jalap
description: Jalap Jalap was a plant found in the deserts of Maztica . Uses . Wild jalap was used by the Azuposi people of Maztica in order to protect against rattlesnake bites .

title: Jalarkh Ohngate
description: Jalarkh Ohngate Jalarkh Ohngate was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Jalassra Dawningdown
description: Jalassra Dawningdown Jalassra Dawningdown was a noble in Suzail . History . Around 1480 DR , she hired Drounan Harbrand and his partner Andarphisk Hawkspike to go to Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr to free her son Jeresson Dawningdown , a traitor and murderer .

title: Jalaunther Ithbreeiur
description: Jalaunther Ithbreeiur Jalaunther Ithbreeiur was the unofficial but true leader of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 . Personality . Jalaunther was a very ambitious man with a network of agents in all major cities in the " Realms " .

title: Jalavaerra Ishtra
description: Jalavaerra Ishtra Jalavaerra Ishtra was a retired fighter and adventuress from Westgate who owned and managed the adventurers ' club The Fine Gold Chain in Memnon . Description . Jalavaerra was tall and willowy and " famously beautiful " , with long blonde hair and large , dark , purple eyes .

title: Jalboun of the Two Blades
description: Jalboun of the Two Blades Jalboun of the Two Blades is a mercenary and a fence who operates out of the Cutlass in Luskan . Very skilled with both axe - throwing and in the use of dagger s , Jalboun will often belt out drinking songs and will always join in a fight that erupts within his favorite watering hole . Possessions .

title: Jaleigh Johnson
description: Jaleigh Johnson Jaleigh Johnson lives at the edge of a corn field in the Midwest , in a yellow house with a lot of windows . On the long road to publication , she ' s written ad copy ; gaming material ; Gen Con diaries ; horror fiction ; science fiction ; fiction for children ; fiction for adults ; fiction for small , furry animals and gnomes ; etc . She tries very hard to be serious at all times ; unfortunately the world is too absurd and thwarts almost every attempt she makes to take it seriously .

title: Jalessa Ornra
description: Jalessa Ornra Jalessa Ornra was the butcher of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Jalessa managed a shop in the village , where she lived together with her husband , the town ' s constable Harburk Tuthmarillar .

title: Jalessa Windstone
description: Jalessa Windstone Jalessa Windstone was a high - ranking member of the court of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Jalessa took care of the protocol of the Royal Palace .

title: Jalia Mossgreen
description: Jalia Mossgreen Jalia Mossgreen was the most prominent of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR . Activities . Jalia as Black Sword supervised the Archendale militia .

title: Jalless
description: Jalless Jalless was a deep gnome healer in Blingdenstone . History . Jalless in 1479 DR was one of the healers and the most outspoken critic of Kargien Dissengulp .

title: Jalma
description: Jalma Jalma was a female elf in the 1350s DR who lived near Waterdeep . Jalma lived in a small house with two other elven women . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , they provided lodging for the night to Cybriana of Shadowdale , who was journeying to Waterdeep .

title: Jalynfein
description: Jalynfein Jalynfein was a male drow wizard from Menzoberranzan , and was perhaps the most powerful spellcaster in the city . He carefully cultivated a reputation of insanity and zealous devotion to Lolth , but truly hated the tyranny of the Spider Queen and opposed all forms of slavery . However , he was far too intelligent and skilled in the magical arts to ever betray these inner thoughts .

title: Jamad
description: Jamad Father Jamad was the head priest of St . Faelar ' s Cloisters in 1370 DR . Under Jamad ' s leadeship , the monks and ranger s of the Cloisters traded many escaped slaves in survival skills in the foothills of the Marching Mountains .

title: Jamal
description: Jamal Jamal the Thespian was a bard in Westgate in . History . Around 1370 DR , Jamal was secretly a member of the Harpers , watching over the city .

title: Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid
description: Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid Jamal Elijiwan al - Iwlid was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamal ran a thieves guild in the Rookery ward of the city .

title: Jamal Oasis
description: Jamal Oasis The Jamal Oasis was one of the most hospitable and well known oases in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . The presence of a mud - brick large enough for a small army made this oasis extremely convenient .

title: Jamala Abd al - Raffa
description: Jamala Abd al - Raffa Jamala Abd al - Raffa was a mamluk inhabiting the League of the Pantheon in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamala was the leader of the Exalted Mamluk Society and named Most Respected Warrior .

title: Jamala al - Mutajalli
description: Jamala al - Mutajalli Jamala al - Mutajalli was a janni of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Jamala ' s blood ran hot , urging her to seek adventure whenever possible .

title: Jambiya
description: Jambiya Jambiyas were sharply curved daggers common to Calimshan and Zakhara . Etymology . The word for " dagger " in Alzhedo was " jambiya " , yet when most people used the term " jambiya " , they were referring specifically to the style of curved dagger found among Calishite s and Zakharan s .

title: James Lowder
description: James Lowder James Lowder is an award - winning editor and author of the fantasy and horror genres . Education . Lowder grew up in .

title: James Ward
description: James Ward James Ward is a fantasy author and game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . He was one of Gary Gygax ' s original players . He introduced deities into Dungeons & Dragons and created the first ever science fiction role - playing game , .

title: Jamid abd - Balduro
description: Jamid abd - Balduro Jamid abd - Balduro was an elven warrior who traveled across the deserts of Zakhara with her father ' s caravan around 1367 DR . Description . Jamid was a muscular woman with very long , black hair .

title: Jamila al - Thuri
description: Jamila al - Thuri Jamila al - Thuri was the dwarven matriarch of the House of Al - Thuria in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though elderly , Jamila ruled her family with iron resolve .

title: Jamila al - Zahab
description: Jamila al - Zahab Jamila al - Zahab was a mercenary who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Strong and exotic , Jamila ' s demeanor transcended the norm of Zakhara n society .

title: Jamina al - Mubarak
description: Jamina al - Mubarak Jamina al - Mubarak was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . Jamila served as the ambassador Extraordinary of the Brotherhood of the True Flame within the efreeti city .

title: Jamison
description: Jamison Jamison was the fletcher of the Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Jamison was very popular with the ladies and always friendly .

title: Jamna Gleamsilver
description: Jamna Gleamsilver Jamna Gleamsilver was a gnome assassin and a member of the Zhentarim . History . At the start of the Tyranny of Dragons , in 1489 DR Jamna was tasked with a mission to investigate the recent uprising of the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Jan Duursema
description: Jan Duursema Jan Duursema is a comic book artist know for her work on comics . Education . Duursema was trained as an artist at in New Jersey .

title: Jan Jansen
description: Jan Jansen Jan Jansen was a gnome inventor , illusionist , and dishonest businessman in Athkatla . Activities . Jan could be found in the Government District Athkatla , peddling his wares , which in actuality were dangerous weapons in their own right .

title: Jana - nimr
description: Jana - nimr Jana - nimr , also called greater winged cats , were mysterious felines that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were prized by zookeepers or as pets . The " jana - nimr " were intelligent felines that used their own unique language .

title: Jana - qitat
description: Jana - qitat The jana - qitat , also called lesser winged cats or fluttercats , were smaller cousins of the " jana - nimr " . They were usually found within cities . Description .

title: Janath Rendaer
description: Janath Rendaer Janath Rendaer was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . Janath was a sarcastic individual who was one of the first magelords to join Belaur Aumar .

title: Janci al - Kriman
description: Janci al - Kriman Janci al - Kriman was a camel trader within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Janci procured livestock for many of the animal dealers in the City of Delights .

title: Jandather
description: Jandather Jandather was a human evoker of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Personality . The wizard was a dashing wannabe adventurer looking to earn himself a reputation .

title: Jander Sunstar
description: Jander Sunstar Appearance . Jander was 5 ' 9 " and weighed 130 pounds . He had angular features but retained the noble countenance of an elf .

title: Jandi M ' baren
description: Jandi M ' baren Jandi M ' baren was an apprentice mage from Mulmaster whose primary skill was in setting and defeating magical wards . In 1460 DR , she met Gareth Jadaren and Ivor Beguine when they hired her master to determine the nature of a magic bracelet known as the Rythanko . She fell in love with Ivor and left her master ' s employment to travel with Gareth and Ivor to Turmish .

title: Janessar
description: Janessar The Janessar were a group of warriors and priests throughout Calimshan , all worshiping The Triad of Torm , Tyr , and Ilmater , who opposed the slave trade and protected travelers from bandits . Organization . The Janessar were active in loose collections of small groups of between four and twelve .

title: Jang
description: Jang Jang was a watchman of Marsember in Cormyr in 1486 DR . History . Jang was part of a contingent of Marsember Watch and House Seasilver guards who accompanied Arietta Seasilver ; Kleef Kenric , a paladin follower of the dead god Helm ; and two Chosen , Malik el Sami , follower of Cyric , and Joelle Emmeline , follower of Sune , out of Marsember in order to fulfill their mission .

title: Janik Darni
description: Janik Darni Janik Darni was the proprietor of the Darni House in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Janik catered to wealthy merchants and caravan - masters by offering an assortment of fine food and skilled services .

title: Jann of the Haunted Lands
description: Jann of the Haunted Lands The Jann of the Haunted Lands was one of the largest and most powerful groups of jann in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Compared to jann found elsewhere in the Land of Fate , many of the Jann of the Haunted Lands were impulsive and vindictive genie s .

title: Janni
description: Janni Jann , singular janni , were the weakest of all genie s . Unlike other genies , jann were not intimately bonded to one particular element or native of a singular elemental plane , instead they were natives of the Prime Material Plane . The jann of Toril resided in great numbers within Zakhara , the Land of Fate .

title: Jannti
description: Jannti Jannti was the language of the genie s , including the djinn , efreet , marid , dao , and jann . Whether Jannti was a single tongue with several dialects or four different elemental tongues was a matter of some debate , though it was effectively a single language . Jannti was one of the roots of the Midani language .

title: Janol Famisso
description: Janol Famisso Janol Famisso , commonly known as Pinch , was the king of Ankhapur and a former crime lord . Personality . Despite his warm feelings for his closest companions , he would not hesitate to sacrifice one of them if it served his goals .

title: Janos
description: Janos Janos the Lichbreaker was most veteran Knight of the Weave in 1374 DR . He had trained three other Knights by this time . His main concern was the plots of the Shadovar and he patrolled the Anauroch near Thultanthar , hoping to stop all possible Shadovar plots before they could disturb the Weave , especially those involved the Shadow Weave .

title: Janszeene Naerhand
description: Janszeene Naerhand Janszeene Naerhand was the leader of House Naerhand , a powerful merchant family that was active from the Sword Coast to Cormyr as of 1479 DR . Relationships . Janszeene didn ' t trust her sister Malarrla who was considered unfit to ever lead the family .

title: Jantoo
description: Jantoo Jantoo was the greatest philosopher alive in 1358 DR . Activities . Two of her most famous pamphlets told about free will .

title: Janxar Dhoarn
description: Janxar Dhoarn Janxar Dhoarn was a male half - elf fighter of Alaghôn in Turmish . He was the richest mercenary captain in the city and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . Description .

title: Janya bint Khalil
description: Janya bint Khalil Janya bint Khalil was a the eldest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Janya spent the first three years of her life within the Royal Harim but was moved to a secret location deep within Al - Akara Mountains for her own protection .

title: Janzobur
description: Janzobur Janzobur of the Snow Cats was a barbarian in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Janzobur was a member of the Uthgardt Red Tiger Tribe .

title: Jaod
description: Jaod A jaod was an unintelligent , parasitic creature that could be molded into the shape of a humanoid face or body part . The creature got its name from a sage from Cimbar known as Rinthrin Jaod . Ecology .

title: Japheth Donard
description: Japheth Donard Japheth Donard is a warlock of a fey pact with the archfey Neifion . Appearance . Japheth has black hair and black eyes .

title: Jaqon
description: Jaqon Jaqon was a devil who lived on Avernus , the first hell of Baator , where he was exiled by Asmodeus for a great betrayal . Asmodeus changed Jaqon ' s name to Dagon , so that if someone tried to summon him , they would instead summon the powerful demon lord ' s aspect . Activities .

title: Jarda
description: Jarda Jarda was a halfling sa ' luk inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Jarda was a shrewd professional who distrusted others until they proved otherwise .

title: Jardwim
description: Jardwim Jardwim was the leader of the Gray Hands adventuring company who helped guard the city of Waterdeep . Appearance . He had a stocky , muscular build and shoulder length black hair .

title: Jarekos
description: Jarekos Jarekos was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Jarekos was among the first to see the arrive of Cordell and his forces in 1361 DR .

title: Jareth Grim
description: Jareth Grim Jareth Grim was the apparent leader of the Blackdagger Bandits on the High Road . History . Jareth Grim was a prominent member of the Blackdagger Bandits .

title: Jargoon
description: Jargoon Jargoon was a rare variety of zircon found in the Realms . Description . Jargoons were valued for their resemblance to deep red rubies in color and luster .

title: Jargus Holenhond
description: Jargus Holenhond Jargus Holenhond was a paladin of Ilmater and a member of the Order of the Golden Cup in the mid – 13th century DR . History . Jargus Holenhond rose to a position of leadership in the Order of the Golden Cup by the 1260s DR .

title: Jarhild Stoneforge
description: Jarhild Stoneforge Jarhild Stoneforge was a shield dwarf fighter and a member of the Order of the Burning Dawn . History . Jarhild was a trained soldier who was always ready for a fight .

title: Jarlaxle Baenre
description: Jarlaxle Baenre Jarlaxle ( born Jarlaxle Baenre ) was a drow mercenary and leader of the Bregan D ' aerthe mercenary company . He was one of a small number of male drow who actually had significant power in a Lolth - worshiping city , although he increasingly spent little time in the city itself as he adventured on the Surface . Description .

title: Jarlin Flamtarge
description: Jarlin Flamtarge Jarlin Flamtarge was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Flamtarge was on patrol on the Orondstars Road with fellow War Wizards and some Purple Dragons when Manshoon appeared .

title: Jarmik
description: Jarmik Jarmik , the Thirsty Jann , was a local god of Zakhara . The symbol of Jarmik was a jann sitting on his knees near a well . Personality .

title: Jarthon Drael
description: Jarthon Drael Jarthon Drael was a male half - elf werebadger from the Moonwood and was the Bloodmaster for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Personality . Clear of thought and adaptable , Jarthon takes great relish in battle and stealth and out - witting his foes alike .

title: Jaseen Drakehorn
description: Jaseen Drakehorn Jaseen Drakehorn was the High Blade of Mulmaster . History . Jaseen quietly ruled Mulmaster , supported by the Church of Bane , until 1491 DR .

title: Jashnil Zolond
description: Jashnil Zolond Streea ' Valsharess Jashnil Zolond was the high priestess of Lolth in the city of Sshamath in the year 1379 DR . History . In 1379 DR Jashnil Zolond was choose as the new Streea ' Valsharess after the demise of Ilharess Laele Zauviir .

title: Jasmal
description: Jasmal Jasmal was a gemstone found in the Thunder Peaks and the Spine of the World mountains . Description . Jasmals were usually found in small veins of ore .

title: Jasmar ' n Shadewidow
description: Jasmar ' n Shadewidow Jasmar ' n Shadewidow was a small - time crime lord in Skullport . Personality . Jasmar ' n was cold and emotionless .

title: Jasmine
description: Jasmine Jasmine was both a spelljamming and planewalking adventurer . She was a member of Finder ' s Band . She was notable for her wings .

title: Jasper
description: Jasper Jasper was a semi - precious form of or chalcedony found in the Realms . Description . Mostly found in opaque shades of red , brown , or solid black , very rare specimens of these semi - precious stones were blue or had bands of blue superimposed over the other colors .

title: Jasper Dimmerchasm
description: Jasper Dimmerchasm Jasper Dimmerchasm was a shield dwarf member of the Zhentarim and prisoner of the fire giant s in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Jasper went to negotiate with Duke Zalto .

title: Jasrya Aelorothi
description: Jasrya Aelorothi Jasrya Aelorothi was a high - ranking daemonfey bladesinger . In 1374 DR , she was one of the captains of Sarya Dlardrageth in the Cormanthor War . She died during the battle at the Vale of Lost Voices , killed by multiple arrows fired by Dalesfolk archers .

title: Jasrya Ilviiri
description: Jasrya Ilviiri Jasrya Ilviiri was a tall female fey ' ri who served Sarya Dlardrageth . Her skin was covered with diamond - shaped scales and she had marilith heritage . She was given control of the houses of Ilviiri , Aelorothi and Dhaorothi against the wood elves of the High Forest , along with Sarya ' s son , Xhalph .

title: Jatham Villore
description: Jatham Villore Jatham Villore was a wheezing weaver in High Dale and secretly a Red Wizard of Thay . History . Jatham was a very able weaver in High Dale .

title: Jathrin ' s Jump
description: Jathrin ' s Jump Jathrin ' s Jump ( also known as the Jump ) was a virtually lawless town in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . Somewhere in or near to the town , were some high cliffs .

title: Jaufan
description: Jaufan Jaufan was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Since 1348 DR , Jaufan had worked as an enforcer for a criminal yakuza gang .

title: Jauhar
description: Jauhar Jauhar was the goddess of wealth of Zakhara . She was technically only a local goddess , but probably the most influential of those , as she was worshiped in a number of cities . In the Cities of the Pantheon , she was seen as a Great Goddess and took the place of Jisan there .

title: Javelin
description: Javelin A javelin is a simple , thrown , ranged weapon , similar to a shortspear . Description . A javelin is a light , flexible spear designed primarily as a throwing weapon .

title: Javor
description: Javor Javor was an old chieftain of the Uthgardt Tribe of the Elk during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In life , Javor was a great Uthgardt chieftain .

title: Jawali
description: Jawali Jawali was a dwarf faris living on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Personality . Jawali was fierce and rarely socialized with others .

title: Jawzah
description: Jawzah A jawzah ( jauh - ZAH ) was a stringed fiddle - like Zakharan instrument . Description . A " jawzah " resembled a thin spiked fiddle with four strings connected to a small soundbox made from a hollowed - out coconut shell .

title: Jaxanaedegor
description: Jaxanaedegor Jaxanaedegor was an ancient green vampiric dragon who lived on Mount Thulbane in Threskel . Appearance . Jaxanaedegor was described as having scales of alternating light and dark green and yellow eyes .

title: Jay Batista
description: Jay Batista Jay Batista is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . He is known primarily for his work on the Kara - Tur setting . Education and Career .

title: Jayani al - Jasir
description: Jayani al - Jasir Jayani al - Jasir was a ranking member of the Corsair Council of Hawa and a legend among corsair s . Description . Jayani had an angular face and trim but muscular physique .

title: Jaylee Clammath
description: Jaylee Clammath Jaylee Clammath was part - owner , cook , and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . She was tall and quite overweight .

title: Jayne Nettlebee
description: Jayne Nettlebee Jayne Nettlebee was the wife of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Jayne was a no - nonsense lady who knew how to handle Wiggan , Bertram , and other loudmouths .

title: Jazayir al - Sartan
description: Jazayir al - Sartan Jazayir al - Sartan , the Isles of the Crab , formed a crab - shaped archipelago in the eastern part of the Crowded Sea of Zakhara , south of Ajayib . Poorly explored and marginally settled by enlightened Zakharans , it was the home to a large number of monsters as well as savage tribes of halfling s , human s , ogre s and ogre magi .
