Even the waters were avoided due the strange crab - like monsters .

title: Jazirat al - Sadaf
description: Jazirat al - Sadaf Jazirat al - Sadaf , also known as the Island of the Shell , was an island in Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The island was surrounded on all sides by imposing cliffs made from volcanic rock , proving especially treacherous to approaching vessels .

title: Jazirat al - Sayyad
description: Jazirat al - Sayyad Jazirat al - Sayyad , or the Hunter , was an elongated island located in the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Geography . Jazirat al - Sayyad had extremely rocky shores , marking it as dangerous sailing territory for mariners .

title: Jazirian
description: Jazirian Jazirian is the couatl deity of community , peace , learning , and parenthood . The couatls believe Jazirian to be the embodiment of supreme purpose and fate , the invisible force that moves the strings upon which all other gods move . They think themselves uniquely fortunate to be able to apprehend Jazirian where other races cannot , and give humble thanks for this gift .

title: Jazzomyn Gheldieg
description: Jazzomyn Gheldieg Jazzomyn Gheldieg was a member of the Gheldieg family and head of the Eshpurta Gheldiegs , which gave her a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . She was the niece of Curkon Gheldieg ( a former Namarch of the Council of Six ) and the cousin of Lady Vyma ( Gheldieg ) Tanislove , both of Athkatla .

title: Jazzt Dyrr
description: Jazzt Dyrr Jazzt Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . Description . Jazzt was small and scarred .

title: Jearth Xorlarrin
description: Jearth Xorlarrin Jearth Xorlarrin was the weaponsmaster of House Xorlarrin . He was one of the most powerful weaponsmasters in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History .

title: Jed
description: Jed Jed , also known as Old Jed , was a fisherman who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The aged fisherman was of normal build and dressed in a yellow tunic and dark breeches .

title: Jedea
description: Jedea House Jedea was the royal family of the city - state of Mordulkin in Chessenta . The city was a family enclave and traditionally the most powerful mage of the family became king or queen . History .

title: Jedea Academy
description: Jedea Academy The Jedea Academy was a school for magic located in the residential district of city of Mordulkin in Chessenta . Description . The Jedea Academy was a two - story complex , built of white stone that shone brilliant in the sun , but was otherwise austere and unornamented .

title: Jeff Easley
description: Jeff Easley Jeff Easley is a fantasy artist who was born in Nicholasville , Kentucky and studied at Murray State University , graduating in 1976 . He was hired by TSR , Inc . in 1982 and did much of the artwork during the 1980s .

title: Jeff Grubb
description: Jeff Grubb Jeff Grubb is the author of several Forgotten Realms novels with his wife Kate Novak . Among these are The Finder ' s Stone trilogy which features the popular character Alias . Works .

title: Jeggred Baenre
description: Jeggred Baenre Jeggred Baenre was a draegloth - - the offspring of a drow and a demon - - and the son of Matron Mother Triel Baenre . He followed her every command , and served as her personal bodyguard . He was viewed by the drow as a sign of Lolth ' s favor upon Triel .

title: Jehokim
description: Jehokim Jehokim was a businessman in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Jehokim was an adventurer in his youth but after finding a great treasure he retired and opened several inns across Unther .

title: Jekk Ironfist
description: Jekk Ironfist Jekk Ironfist was a shield dwarf acquaintance of Sir Isteval in Daggerford circa 1486 DR . History . Jekk was born to Kellack Ironfist , a slave - gladiator in the Hillsfar arenas , and in time he followed in his father ' s stead .

title: Jelde Asturian
description: Jelde Asturian Jelde Asturian was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Jelde was born as Semoor Wolftooth in Espar village .

title: Jelvus Grinch
description: Jelvus Grinch Jelvus Grinch was a merchant from Neverwinter . History . He was selling his goods in Waterdeep when Mount Hotenow exploded in 1451 DR , destroying his native city .

title: Jenila
description: Jenila Jenila was a noble marid who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Jenila spent a good deal of time within the White Agate ' s Tower , associating with the White Agate and helping him guard his possessions .

title: Jensena
description: Jensena Jensena was a strong female soldier who drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn . Description . Jensena was tall , attractive , and had powerful muscles .

title: Jeny Greenteeth
description: Jeny Greenteeth Jeny Greenteeth was a green hag in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Jeny was a personification of malice and hate .

title: Jeordros
description: Jeordros Jeordros was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Jeordros ruled over the largest territory .

title: Jeorug Khalaga
description: Jeorug Khalaga Jeorug Khalaga was a high lama on the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . Jeorug was born to a family that had provided eighteen consecutive generations of lama s .

title: Jera al - Farif
description: Jera al - Farif Jera al - Farif was the owner of Sculptures for the Elite within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Jera was one of the most skilled sculpturers in all of Huzuz .

title: Jeradeem
description: Jeradeem Jeradeem was a wealthy merchant from Durpar during the 11th century DR . History . Since he was the most successful merchant throughout Durpar , Jeradeem was selected by the Council of Merchants to travel to Estagund with the task of settling a dispute with that nation so that trade would no longer get interrupted .

title: Jeralla
description: Jeralla Jeralla was a dragonborn sorcerer of red dragon ancestry who was a bandit leader in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Jeralla believed herself to be a Chosen of Tiamat but this was a false claim .

title: Jerbollah
description: Jerbollah Jerbollah was a dwarven cleric of Moradin in Mithral Hall . Personality . Bruenor Battlehammer awarded Jerbollah a seven out of ten for his brewing of mead dwarven holy water .

title: Jeremi Laski
description: Jeremi Laski Jeremi Laski was a wine and spirits vendor who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Jeremi was a large man , standing 6 and a half feet tall .

title: Jergal
description: Jergal Jergal ( pronounced " JER - gull " ) , also referred to as The Lord of the End of Everything , is the seneschal of the Lord of the Dead who keeps records on the final disposition of all the spirits of the dead . Jergal is unfeeling and excessively formal , he never angers and always speaks in a disembodied , chilling voice . He cares little for anything besides an orderly accounting of the fate of the world as it slowly sinks into death , and he now serves Kelemvor as he previously served Cyric and Myrkul before him .

title: Jeriah Chronos
description: Jeriah Chronos Jeriah Chronos was born in - 2207 DR in Netheril . He was known to the Netherese as Chronomancer after creating his first time - oriented spell in - 2158 DR . He was a haughty and determined young man who was constantly concerned about appearances .

title: Jerlys Horlbar
description: Jerlys Horlbar Jerlys Horlbar was the drow matron mother of House Horlbar in Menzoberranzan . Description . Jerlys was a beautiful female elf with smooth long legs and she would use her feminine wiles to seduce and manipulate her victims .

title: Jermander
description: Jermander Jermander was a tiefling swordsman and a member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . Jermander was a swordsman and the leader of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Jerold Keegan
description: Jerold Keegan Sir Jerold Keegan was a paladin of Selûne , a dragonslayer , and a knight of Cormyr in 236 DR . History . Sir Keegan was a renowned dragonslayer .

title: Jerrod
description: Jerrod Jerrod was a barbarian shaman who fought against the archmage Arakon and united the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes after the battle . History . The wizard Arakon attacked Icewind Dale with a army of mercenaries .

title: Jerrod ' s stone
description: Jerrod ' s stone Jerrod ' s stone was a stone disc created by the barbarian shaman Jerrod when he sacrificed himself to seal a gate to the Lower Planes . History . When the forces of the archmage Arakon attacked Icewind Dale , the Reghedmen and the Uthgardt tribes banded together to defeat the common foe .

title: Jesper
description: Jesper Jesper was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . As one of the more prominent families , the Jespers contributed a member to the council of elders that governed Sevenecho , around 1369 DR .

title: Jess Lebow
description: Jess Lebow Jess Lebow ( pen name T . H . Lain ) is a fantasy author and storyteller who has written Forgotten Realms novels including " Master of Chains " from The Fighters series and " Obsidian Ridge " from The Citadels series .

title: Jesse Decker
description: Jesse Decker Jesse Decker is a game designer who has worked for Wizards of the Coast . He also served as editorial assistant for " Dragon " and " Dungeon " magazines and later chief editor for " Dragon " . He was one of the main developers for the fourth edition of Dungeons & Dragons .

title: Jesse Hearthe
description: Jesse Hearthe Jesse Hearthe was a mage who lived in Vanesci Hamlet in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Jesse Hearthe was a popular mage who commanded great political influence at all levels in the Utter East . Although she had retired to Vanesci Hamlet for a number of years , she still manipulated matters behind the scenes .

title: Jester ' s Green
description: Jester ' s Green Jester ' s Green ( formerly Soldier ' s Green ) is a piece of land northwest of Suzail , Cormyr . It had originally been a settlement in the time before Cormyr existed , but it was wiped out by goblin s . It is used to drill the palace guards and marshal the militia .

title: Jestra
description: Jestra Jestra was a human woman of Arabel in Cormyr and an independent wizard specializing in the transmutation school of magic . Around 1369 DR , she resided in Arabel , Cormyr , owned properties in Arabel and utilized her magic to increase the attractiveness of her clients as well as to improve various objects brought to her by enhancing the object ' s appearance and usefulness .

title: Jestry Rallevin
description: Jestry Rallevin Jestry was a skilled zealot of Asmodeus in the service of Sylora Salm . He was in his twenties when he was turned to Lady Sylora´s closes advisor and laiter her champion . He has large shoulders , dark hair and brooding dark eyes .

title: Jet
description: Jet Jet was a variant of bituminous coal that could be cut into fancy stones . Description . Jet was a deep black gemstone that was hard enough to take facets and was often used in simple pendants or as part of a larger setting .

title: Jewel Box
description: Jewel Box The Jewel Box was a drow tavern in Menzoberranzan . Geography . The building was located just outside the accepted border of the main marketplace , the Bazaar ( so as not to be subject to the rules that require its places of business to move at least once every 66 years ) , and was owned and run by Nym , an old retired battle wizard with only one leg .

title: Jewelfish
description: Jewelfish Jewelfish were a tiny , silvery fish found in the oceans and rivers of Faerûn . Ecology . Jewelfish were inedible by humanoid s .

title: Jezgar Skentzin
description: Jezgar Skentzin Jezgar Skentzin was a seawolf pirate in the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . Activities . Jezgar was an audacious pirate with a very bloody approach .

title: Jezz the Lame
description: Jezz the Lame Jezz the Lame was one of the leaders of the Vhaeraun - worshipping House Jaelre , commanding the drow of his house who warred with the elves of Myth Drannor . Description . Jezz had smooth , black skin and pale white hair .

title: Jhaam
description: Jhaam Jhaam was the warrior - king of an ancient human folk living around - 5800 DR . He led his people in a series of minor wars against neighbouring villages . Through this , he wanted to secure his realm from attack .

title: Jhaamdath
description: Jhaamdath Jhaamdath was the first and only psiocracy in the history of the human nations of Toril . Made up of the Twelve Cities of the Sword - Naarkolyth ( the capital and First City ) , Porrenath , Jhouram , Gharrent , Golmuth , Lirremar , Tuoxent , Hollinth , Jhirrent , Inixrien , Corrant , and Mirrindith - this ancestor of present - day Chondath was founded circa – 5800 DR and destroyed in – 255 DR by elven high mages of Nikerymath . History .

title: Jhaamdathan language
description: Jhaamdathan language Jhaamdathan was the language of the old Jhaamdath an Empire . Jhaamdathan was also known as " Old Chondathan " , and as this name suggests , it was the direct precursor of the Chondathan language . The original " Common " tongue , Thorass ( " Old Common " ) , came about as a mixture of Jhaamdathan and Alzhedo , and thus , Jhaamdathan was a progenitor of modern Common as well .

title: Jhaartael Ealoeth
description: Jhaartael Ealoeth Jhaartael Ealoeth was a male fey ' ri fighter / sorcerer bladesinger , and one of the daemonfey around the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . In 1370 DR , while posing as a moon elf from Evermeet , Jhaartael wandered the North in order to lure adventurers into the High Forest , where his fellow fey ' ri ambushed and killed them .

title: Jhachalkhyn
description: Jhachalkhyn Jhachalkhyn was a drow city in the Underdark . Geography . It wasn ' t very clear where exactly Jhachalkhyn lay but it was far in the south from Menzoberranzan but not as far from the City of Spiders as Maeralyn was , in fact it was so near that it was considered reasonable to assume that refugees from the city would flee to Menzoberranzan , once it was destroyed .

title: Jhaele Silvermane
description: Jhaele Silvermane Jhaele Silvermane is the proprietor of The Old Skull Inn in Shadowdale . As of 1375 DR Jhaele ' s husband died decades ago , and her her eldest son , Durgo now performs most of the day to day administration of the Inn . Jhaele ' s other children , daughters Belestar and Raith and sons Purn and Braun , have left Shadowdale as adventurers and merchants .

title: Jhalanessa Brithlar
description: Jhalanessa Brithlar Jhalanessa Brithlar was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Watchful that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Personality . She had a bit of a wild spirit that led to mischievousness and deep , passionate feelings about many things .

title: Jhamanthra Tsathree
description: Jhamanthra Tsathree Jhamanthra Tsathree was the proprietor of Tsathree ' s Comforts , a shop on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep . Activities . Sometime around the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Jhamanthra invented a new scented facial wash she named Waterfall Kiss and began selling it in her shop .

title: Jhandlatha Taskloath
description: Jhandlatha Taskloath Jhandlatha Taskloath is the co - owner of The Swinging Sword inn in Red Larch with her sister , Peieyrie Taskaloath . History . Jhandlatha is originally from Luskan , where her father was a wizard who opposed , and was eventually killed by , The Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Jhaniloth Puiral
description: Jhaniloth Puiral Jhaniloth Puiral was a lich and member of the Twisted Rune . Before that , she was a wizardess of Silverymoon . Background .

title: Jhannas Errlyk
description: Jhannas Errlyk Jhannas Errlyk was a merchant of Amn and a disgraced member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Jhannas was the head of a family mercantile business in Myratma and a member of the Shadow Thieves , smuggling poisons and other goods for the guild .

title: Jhanos Yhliivast
description: Jhanos Yhliivast Lord Jhanos Yhliivast was a male human who , as of 1368 DR , was the head of the Yhliivast family and the most powerful man in Amnwater , Amn . He was the proprietor of The Gilded Spur inn and his lover ( and hostess at the inn ) was Krigar .

title: Jhanra Merlistar
description: Jhanra Merlistar Jhanra Merlistar was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Jhanra was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Talor Vurtalis and Keryth Adofaer .

title: Jhartos Illance
description: Jhartos Illance Jhartos Illance was a young nobleman who lived in the Cormyrean Embassy in Calimport . Relationships . Jhartos was the fourth son of the Illance noble family and the younger cousin of Mallik , third in line to his father ' s position .

title: Jharvex Krimmevol
description: Jharvex Krimmevol Jharvex Krimmevol was a human male and the head of the Krimmevol mercantile family in Eshpurta , and held a seat on the Shield Council from before the Year of the Lion ( 1340 DR ) to at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Lord Aernos Krimmevol of Crimmor was his nephew . Jharvex got rid of his youngest brother Cahorl and acquired his share of land by framing him for the murder of a young girl from the Zoar family .

title: Jhassalan
description: Jhassalan Jhassalan was an arcane devotee of Tyr in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Jhassalan hailed from Silverymoon in Luruar but departed to become an adventurer .

title: Jhasso
description: Jhasso Jhasso was a merchant from the city of Baldur ' s Gate in Silver Marches in the 14th century DR . He originally owned Jhasso ' s Wagons , a fast - haul transport company . However , Jhasso partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Nammna of Milvarune , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster .

title: Jhastar Belnold
description: Jhastar Belnold Jhastar Belnold was a ranger from Secomber and an active Harper . Description . Jhastar stood 6 ft 2 in ( 188 cm ) and weighed 211 lb ( 96 .

title: Jhatli
description: Jhatli Jhatli was a boy in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing .

title: Jhegaan
description: Jhegaan Jhegaan the Maestro was an employee of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Jhegaan adventured with Aurora across much of Faerûn , from Icewind Dale to Chult , from the Sword Coast to the fringes of Kara - Tur .

title: Jhembryn Durrock
description: Jhembryn Durrock Jhembryn Durrock , or simply Durrock , was a male human assassin and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Durrock was an elite assassin in service to the church of Bane based in Scardale during the Time of Troubles .

title: Jherek
description: Jherek Jherek was an agent for the Harpers who helped in stopping Eldrith the Betrayer , Mordoc SeLanmere and the Zhentarim ( under leadership of Karne ) from gaining control of the Onyx Tower . Activites . Jherek was in charge of the Harper activity in Baldur ' s Gate , the Western Heartlands , and along the Sword Coast .

title: Jherek Wolf ' s - get
description: Jherek Wolf ' s - get Jherek Wolf ' s - get was the young man famous for playing a major role in defeating Iakhovas during the Twelfth Serôs War . Description . As a young man , Jherek was leanly built with deeply tanned skin .

title: Jherremor
description: Jherremor Jherremor was a ghirrash living in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Jherremor was a ghirrash living in Plane of Shadow near the Dusk Lord ' s Passage ; in 1374 DR he was recruited by the Church of Shar to guard the passage to the Lost Refuge in exchange for not useful prisoners .

title: Jhesiyra Kestellharp
description: Jhesiyra Kestellharp Jhesiyra Kestellharp was one of Halaster ' s seven apprentices who accompanied him to Undermountain as one of the Seven . She is noted as the primary source of information on Halaster as she was the only one of the seven ever recorded leaving those halls . History .

title: Jhesrhi Coldcreek
description: Jhesrhi Coldcreek Jhesrhi Coldcreek was a powerful mage and a member of the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . Although Jhesrhi was capable of casting spells in other schools of magic most of her magic was elemental in nature . She had a special affinity with the wind and was able to command air spirits to aid her .

title: Jhessail Greycastle
description: Jhessail Greycastle Jhessail Greycastle was the commander of the exiled Knights of the Black Fist . Personality . Jhessail was despite all loyal to her city and was totally shocked by the Vorgansharax ' s coup and the betrayal of her fellows .

title: Jhessail Silventree
description: Jhessail Silventree Jhessail Silventree was one of the original Knights of Myth Drannor in 1358 DR . History . Jhessail was born in Espar in Cormyr to two foresters who were friends of elves .

title: Jhingleshod
description: Jhingleshod Jhingleshod was the former man - at - arms to the wizard Wulgreth of Ascalhorn , and became an undead knight . Also known as The Iron Axeman , Jhingleshod once had another name , but no longer remembered it . Description .

title: Jhonen
description: Jhonen Jhonen was a fisherman who lived in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The young fisherman dressed in faded and worn clothing .

title: Jhorganni
description: Jhorganni Jhorganni was a female drider vampire and a cleric of Kiaransalee who resided in Maerimydra . Description . Her legs knotted in sticky strands of web , Jhorganni appeared as a drider with glowing red eyes .

title: Jhothûn
description: Jhothûn Jhothûn was an ancient empire of giant s located in the far northern cold regions of Faerûn . Description . While not large , Jhothûn was a powerful empire of giantkind .

title: Jhothûn ( city )
description: Jhothûn ( city ) Jhothûn was the capital of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Description . Jhothûn was once an impressive city full of towers of crystal .

title: Jhuild
description: Jhuild Jhuild ( also known as Rashemi firewine , Rashemaar firewine , or thrallwine ) was considered to be the national drink of Rashemen . Description . " Jhuild " was a thick , dark reddish - brown alcoholic beverage that created the sensation of fire in the imbiber ' s belly , thus earning its name .

title: Jhuvik
description: Jhuvik Jhuvik , usually known as Jhuvik of the Seven Gems , was an elven thief and cleric of Mystra in Milvarune , and a senior member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Jhuvik venerated Khelben Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand for their status as Chosen of Mystra but he rarely spoke about this .

title: Jhyak
description: Jhyak " Bold Jhyak " was a very old , retired adventurer who owned a bar by the same name in Teshburl in 1370 DR . Jhyak hired a couple mercenaries to tell stories of their battle scars to patrons , which increased his business in an otherwise sea - focused town .

title: Jhyndara Thiolstar
description: Jhyndara Thiolstar Jhyndara Thiolstar was a High Priestess , or High Luck Priestess , of Tymora in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . Jhyndara was the ranking priestess in the Ladysluck Tower .

title: Jierdan
description: Jierdan Jierdan was a soldier of Luskan . History . He assisted Dendybar ' s apprentice Sydney along with Artemis Entreri in their quest to find both Regis and the crystal shard Crenshinibon .

title: Jierta
description: Jierta Jierta was a female frost giant warrior in the late 15th century DR . History . Jierta was one of the warriors in Jarl Greigor Kundknoddick ' s tribe , who allied with drow and orc s during the Darkening .

title: Jiksidur
description: Jiksidur Jiksidur was a Netherese enclave of Netheril ruled by the Sorcerer - King Larloch . History . Larloch rose to become Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Jiksidur in Netheril .

title: Jimjar
description: Jimjar Jimjar was a deep gnome gambler during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was a reckless rogue with a devil - may - care attitude , a fondness for coin , and an obsession with betting on virtually anything and everything .

title: Jinchin
description: Jinchin Jinchin was an evil shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Jinchin was originally Ieyasu Sabanada , the eldest son of a samurai family that became counselors to the Imperial Court .

title: Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn
description: Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn ( Jinn ) was a 4 , 000 year old deva who originally served the Mulhorandi pantheon . He resided in Waterdeep in 1480 DR . History .

title: Jinutt
description: Jinutt Only few people lived on the island of Sahu . Some of them formed the small village of Jinutt , which was located on the northern coast below the plateau dominating the island ' s interior . Inhabitants .

title: Jiraad
description: Jiraad Jiraad was the most well - known genie throughout all of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . As a noble marid , Jiraad stood as tall as a giant at 22 feet ( 6 .

title: Jirozu no Nakamaru
description: Jirozu no Nakamaru Jirozu no Nakamaru was the oyabun of Big Head yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Jirozu collected odd and unusual weapons and will payed honest prices for such things ( particularly gaijin items ) .

title: Jisan
description: Jisan Jisan is the goddess of fruitfulness of Zakhara , who stands for fertility and productivity . She is one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and encourages hard work and diligent planning in order to harvest the riches of the world . Jisan ' s symbol is a rain cloud , a relic of her long - gone origins as a storm - goddess who provides the monsoon rains necessary for the fertility of the land .

title: Jivex
description: Jivex Jivex was a faerie dragon from the Gray Forest and a member of the mixed human and draconic group that defeated Sammaster . Abilities . Jivex was skilled in the arts of illusion , preferring to deceive and trick his opponents rather than blast them into little bits and pieces .

title: Jivvin golhyrr
description: Jivvin golhyrr Jivvin Golhyrr , meaning " amusing trick " , was a fighting style used by sadistic drow who found their purpose in humiliating their enemies . Description . The name " amusing trick " wasn ' t given because it was amusing to look at but because it was " amusing to the sadist who happened to be the practitioner " .

title: Jo Stick of the White Tree
description: Jo Stick of the White Tree The Jo Stick of the White Tree was a pure white jo stick , carried by Grandmaster Kane . It was formed from a branch of the white tree that grew in the courtyard of Gareth Dragonsbane ' s Castle in Bloodstone Village on the shore of Lake Midai . This tree was called the Tree - Gem of Bloodstone .

title: Joadath
description: Joadath Joadath was Lord of Shadowdale between 1273 DR and his death in 1300 DR . He was an agnostic who believed that the deities held no power . This was a belief that led , in 1297 DR , to the massacre of Tyr ists on Watcher ' s Knoll .

title: Joatra Stelmar
description: Joatra Stelmar Joatra Stelmar was a druid and an agent of the Knights of the North in 1374 DR . Personality . Joatra first and foremost loved all kinds of birds and nobody could harm one of them in her presence , especially her knights .

title: Jochris
description: Jochris Jochris was the headmaster of the Neverwinter Academy around 1374 DR . History . After Qara ' s fight with Ashni , with the Kalach - Cha and companions , Jochris would approach Qara .

title: Joei
description: Joei Joei the Aged was a wu jen merchant in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In the city of Kuda , Joei managed a very lucrative business of importing exotic items under licenses by both the emperor and the shogun .

title: Joelle Emmeline
description: Joelle Emmeline Joelle Emmeline was a jewel thief from Berdusk and a Chosen of Sune in 1486 DR . Activities . In 1486 DR , Joelle was tasked by her goddess with the mission of taking the Eye of Gruumsh to the earth primordial Grumbar ' s temple in the Underchasm .

title: Jogaoh
description: Jogaoh Jogaoh was a fire elemental who was trapped in the form of a dwarf and bound to Toril . Jogaoh was well known as a magical smith on the Sword Coast . History .

title: John Nephew
description: John Nephew John Nephew is an author for roleplaying games . Biography . John Nephew started his career as an author for RPGs with writing articles for the RPG - magazine " Dragon " .

title: Joiifericus
description: Joiifericus Joiifericus was a succubus nursemaid in Maerimydra during the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR . Activities . Joiifericus ' duty was to take care of the many children of demon lord Graz ' zt .

title: Jolen Firth
description: Jolen Firth Jolen Firth was the First Speaker of Nesmé in the late 15th century . Description . Jolen was a sturdy man .

title: Jolliver Grimjaw
description: Jolliver Grimjaw Jolliver Grimjaw was a wereboar member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Jolliver Grimjaw was a sullen , suspicious , and humorless individual .

title: Jomhur
description: Jomhur Imam Jomhur was the High Priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Imam Jomhur supervised around 200 priests and other laymen within the mosque .

title: Jomo Shanbaeren
description: Jomo Shanbaeren Jomo " the Cutlass " Shanbaeren was a retired pirate who owned a tavern . Background . Jomo stowed away on the Dragon ' s Claw when he was seventeen years old but was discovered by its female captain , who offered him passage .

title: Jon Irenicus
description: Jon Irenicus Joneleth Irenicus , commonly referred to as Jon Irenicus or simply Irenicus , is the primary antagonist in " " , a role - playing game set in Amn . Personality . At first , Irenicus appears to be a simple , if surreal , villain with a keen interest in torturing the protagonist with unusual magic at the very beginning of " Shadows of Amn " .

title: Jon Pickens
description: Jon Pickens Jon Pickens is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . Background .

title: Jonathan Tweet
description: Jonathan Tweet Jonathan Tweet is a game designer who has been involved in the development of the role - playing games " " , " " , " " , " " and the third edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . He currently works at Wizards of the Coast . He has many short cultural and political essays on his website with a particular focus on religion and atheism .

title: Jongrath ' s Mill
description: Jongrath ' s Mill Jongrath ' s Mill was a " waterless " grain mill in Tethyr , known locally as Stump Hill , owned and operated by Ilmurk Jongrath . On the property was the working mill , a cottage that could be rented , livestock , and a large horse stable . It was in operation around the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR Location .

title: Joon Tsao Choo
description: Joon Tsao Choo Joon Tsao Choo was an emperor of Shou Lung of ancient times History . Joon Tsao Choo was a great emperor that strongly ruled for many years , expanding the Empire . Many nobles feared the Empire ' s expansion over the Shao Mountains , a land outside their control , and the most rebellious of them formed the Black Maut Cult in order to ruin Joon Tsao and regained their power .

title: Jordy Gallum
description: Jordy Gallum Lord Jordy Gallum was the Count of Greenshores in Tethyr and that kingdom ' s Sheriffs ' Chancellor . Personality . Jordy Gallum had been described as " the epitome of a Greenshores man " .

title: Jorgen Pawl
description: Jorgen Pawl Jorgen Pawl was a member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons commander of the Xonthal ' s Tower , History . Like most people at Xonthal ' s Tower , Jorgen was a strong dracolich traditionalist . Just before the Tyranny of Dragons , he was nominated as commander of the recently conquered Xonthal ' s Tower , a bastion full of Cult ' s traditionalists .

title: Jorhat Shan
description: Jorhat Shan The Jorhat Shan were a pair of tall mountains located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located between Solon in the Raurin Desert , and Ra - Khati in the Katakoro Shan mountain range , sat the twin mountains of Jorhat Shan .

title: Jorid
description: Jorid Jorid was a barkeep in in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Jorid owned the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth in northeastern Tethyr .

title: Jorik
description: Jorik Jorik was a human who owned the Weeping Willow Inn near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Jorik came to the Mere of Dead Men and found a lone building .

title: Joril
description: Joril Joril was a mighty frost giant , who lived in the Spine of the World with his clan . His magical dagger was lost , when he was killed by a group of adventurers . Some time later the dagger reapeared in Kuldahar and was reforged there , so that it can now be used by human s and human - sized creatures as a two - handed sword .

title: Jorildyn
description: Jorildyn Jorildyn was a half - elf battlemage and a member of the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . Description . The half - elf had a grey - streaked beard .

title: Jorin Kell Harthan
description: Jorin Kell Harthan Jorin Kell Harthan was a captain of the Simbul ' s Guard in the 1370s DR History . In 1374 DR , Jorin went to Araevin Teshurr explaining that he must go to the royal palace escorted by Jorin . Later the regent Phaeldara ordered to Jorin to help the Araevin ' s party to arrive in Sildeyuir .

title: Jorlan Duskryn
description: Jorlan Duskryn Jorlan Duskryn was a drow warrior of House Duskryn during the Rage of Demons . History . Jorlan was a drow of Menzoberranzan living in the Velkynvelve outpost .

title: Jorunhast
description: Jorunhast Jorunhast was High Wizard of Cormyr . He was broad - shouldered and muscular . He was the pupil of Thanderahast .

title: Jorus Azuremantle
description: Jorus Azuremantle Jorus Azuremantle was a half - elven wizard and the leader of the Spellguard , assuming the title after Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade . He was also a member of the Council of 12 Peers . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Personality .

title: Josef Linkletter
description: Josef Linkletter Josef Linkletter was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1479 DR , serving as soldier in Lord Dagult Neverember ' s army before became involved in the plots of Rhazzad . History . Josef was a native - born of Neverwinter who had been born in the grim years after the Spellplague .

title: Joser Minstrelwish
description: Joser Minstrelwish Joser Minstrelwish was an halfling from Arabel and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Cormyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Joser owned the Minstrelwish Chains , Belts , and Scabbards shop in Arabel .

title: Josidiah Starym
description: Josidiah Starym Josidiah Starym was an honorable and noble - born elf born in the elven empire of Cormanthyr . A bladesinger and adventurer , he was known for finding the " Artblade " and returning it to Myth Drannor , where he later served on the Council of Twelve and as Spell - Major . He was also known for being the first owner of Guenhwyvar , a magical figurine of power .

title: Jott
description: Jott Jott was an agent of Thylius Caramitru in Mulmaster . Activities . In 1491 DR , Jott and his brother Rolo were the main agents of Thylius , running for him the Yellow Breath Chapter House .

title: Jouka
description: Jouka Jouka was a gnome inhabiting the Samek Valley who helped defeat the ice devil Vreesar in 1366 DR . Possessions . Jouka wore a strange " badger - fighting suit " , which was a sort of spiked body armor .

title: Joy
description: Joy Joy is a non - player character in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . History . Joy was brought up by priests of Lathander together with her twin sister , Light of Heavens .

title: Joyella
description: Joyella Joyella was a gnome and active member of the Zhentarim in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Joyella was a member of a Zhent party in the Underdark .

title: Jozul Piniago
description: Jozul Piniago Duke Jozul Piniago was a human man and a noble of the city of Procampur in the Vast in the early 1360s DR . History . He held the title of " Duke " among Procampan nobility .

title: Ju - Hai Chou
description: Ju - Hai Chou Ju - Hai Chou was the Minister of State of Shou Lung around 1358 DR . Personality . Ju - Hai Chou was the model of a perfect career mandarin : subtle , clever and learned .

title: Jub
description: Jub Jub was a half - drow half - orc fisherman in Skullport . History . Jub was originally a slave saved from his slavers by Elkantar Iluim and his men .

title: Jubal
description: Jubal Doctor Jubal was a businessman in the Moonsea . Activities . Doctor Jubal managed the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities .

title: Judarin
description: Judarin Judarin , also called the Sot , was an elven bard / sa ' luk inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Judarin was rude and lacked respect for authority and any organized religion .

title: Judgment of Abd Hikmat
description: Judgment of Abd Hikmat The Judgment of Abd Hikmat was an item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item was a simple scroll with nonmagical script .

title: Jugicha
description: Jugicha Jugicha was a city in the Plain of Horses in Kara - Tur . It lay at the foot of the Chigidi Mountains , beside the Chukei Plains . It was the home and capital of the Tsu - tsu tribe .

title: Jui - jung Nu Nam
description: Jui - jung Nu Nam Jui - jung Nu Nam was a traveling cook in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Jui - jung Nu Nam sold his noodle soup to visitors , claiming that his was the best soup in all Shou Lung .

title: Juiblex
description: Juiblex Juiblex ( pronounced " JOO - ee - blex " ) , known as the Faceless Lord , was a demon lord and lord of ooze s and shapeless things . He was a lesser deity and one of the triumvirate of the Lost Gods of the Underdark ( the other two being the Elder Elemental God and the Dark God . Description .

title: Juju zombie
description: Juju zombie A juju zombie was an exceptionally powerful type of zombie . Created by potent magics , they were stronger , faster , and more cunning than the basic shambling corpse . Unlike a normal zombie , juju zombies retained their consciousness and the awareness of their undead state made them horribly vicious and cruel .

title: Jukum
description: Jukum Jukum was the second - largest Iulutiun settlement . Geography . Jukum was located on southeastern shore of the Lugalpgotak Sea , west of the Cuccu Stream .

title: Julain De ' Spri
description: Julain De ' Spri Julain De ' Spri was a ghost noble in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In his past , Julain was a magistrate in Waterdeep .

title: Julani Baenre
description: Julani Baenre Julani Baenre was a drow wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan and the Master of Evocation at Sorcere . History . Along with the other mages of House Baenre , Julani aided Gromph Baenre in attacking Nimor Imphraezl through a scrying crystal during the Siege of Menzoberranzan .

title: Julen Serrat
description: Julen Serrat Julen Serrat was a young rogue and member of the Guardians branch of House Serrat of Delzimmer . As the youngest son of his branch of the Serrats , Julen stood to inherit very little . His father Ramul intended to apprentice him to one of his brothers who traded with drow and dwarves in the Underdark .

title: Julia Ravensblood
description: Julia Ravensblood Julia Ravensblood was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Julia was a research wizard in Murann .

title: Julnar bint Bahija
description: Julnar bint Bahija Julnar bint Bahija was a holy slayer and member of the Gilded Palm in 1367 DR . Activities . Julnar was selected for a special mission and agreed to have her body permanently polymorphed to appear as a beautiful elf .

title: Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi
description: Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi Julnar bint Julnar al - Huzuzi supervised Huzuz ' s Foreign Bureau in 1367 DR . Activities . Julnar reported to Ambassador Jiraad , but she directly managed the bureaus of local relations , Zakhara n relations , and distant relations .

title: Julthoon Street
description: Julthoon Street Julthoon Street was a street in Waterdeep that ran east to west . The Sea Ward was north of the street and the Castle Ward was south . Prior to 1255 DR , the city walls were outside this street .

title: Jumlat
description: Jumlat The large city of Jumlat , the " City of Multitudes , " ( together with Gana ) gave the group of the Pearl Cities of Zakhara their name : It ' s most important source of income was the harvest and trade of pearl s . Outside harvest time , many inhabitants of this unprepossessing and crowded city turned to begging .

title: Jump
description: Jump Jump is a transmutation spell used by young or inexperienced wizard s that enhances the capacity of its target to jump . When " jump " is cast on a creature , they became half again as likely to succeed in any jump . The spell is not particularly complex , but drains the mental faculties of a wizard enough that it cannot be cast again until the wizard has rested briefly , perhaps a few minutes , to refocus himself .

title: Jumpa River
description: Jumpa River The Jumpa River , or Jumpa Muren , was one of the largest rivers in all of Toril . Geography . Located in the Hordelands and northeast Faerûn , the Jumpa River originated within Katakoro Shan in Khazari , flowing past A - Ling Shan , where it joined the Gaya at the Great Pass within the southern region of the majestic Yehimal mountains .

title: Jumpa River Gorge
description: Jumpa River Gorge The Jumpa River Gorge was one of the largest canyons in all of Toril . Geography . Formed from the churning waters of the mighty Jumpa River , the gorge stretched along Katakoro Shan passed the countries of Khazari and Ra - Khati before entering the lands of East Faerûn .

title: Jumping
description: Jumping Jumping is a quality that can be applied to weapons . It gives the wielder abilities like a ring of feather falling , and once every twelve seconds , the wielder can gain the ability to make an extremely accurate jump . Creation .

title: Jungle avatar
description: Jungle avatar Jungle avatar was a potent divine magic spell available to priest s of the Zakhara n savage goddess Ragarra , and some specialized kahin s . It temporally changed the caster into a greater segarran . Effects .

title: Jungle giant
description: Jungle giant Jungle giants subsist on a diet composed entirely of meat . Jungle giants roam the jungles of Zakhara quickly hunting all the prey in an area before quickly moving on to the next stretch of jungle . Jungle giants stand 18 ’ tall and can weigh up to 3 , 000 pounds .

title: Juni
description: Juni Juni was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Juni ' s husband disappeared and Juni thought that the lizardlings have captured him .

title: Junyu
description: Junyu Junyu was one of the greatest swordsmen in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Junyu was once one of the most talented duelists in Kozakura , tutoring many students , but sensing a void in his life he decided to become a priest in a Konjo temple .

title: Jurina Plem
description: Jurina Plem Jurina Plem was an art seller in Mulmaster . Personality . She considered Andrik Gos a genius and a true artist , not caring for the monetary value of his paintings .

title: Jurisk Ulhammond
description: Jurisk Ulhammond Jurisk Ulhammond was a human man of Waterdeep . He was a moneylender as well as the leader of the Trades Ward cell of the Red Sashes in Waterdeep . He was one of only two members of the Sashes , along with Naneatha Lharilstar , that knew the true identity of their secretive leader , known only as " The One " .

title: Jurth
description: Jurth Jurth was an orog member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Jurth was at the Sacred Stone Monastery .

title: Just chancellor
description: Just chancellor A just chancellor , or the Lord Just Chancellor , of Tethyr was the primary legal authority of the kingdom . Hierarchy . The Lord Just Chancellor was superior to four sub - chancellors : The Just Chancellor also directed a group of judges known as High Justicars and Justicars .

title: Justicar ( sword )
description: Justicar ( sword ) Justicar is the powerful longsword wielded by the former god of justice , Tyr . It was gifted to him either by Ao or Tyr ' s predecessor . Mystra aided in its creation .

title: Justice blade
description: Justice blade A justice blade was a magic sword made by the church of Tyr . Many of them had been forged . Description .

title: Justice domain
description: Justice domain Justice can come as the fight for what is just ' until the right has been wronged or the halls of law and order reaching a conclusion . All the deities that claim the justice domain have different views on how justice is best served . The keeper of law , Amaunator looks upon justice as law followed to the very letter and that there are extremely rare times when one can stray from the path of law .

title: Justice of weald and woe
description: Justice of weald and woe Justice of Weald and Woe is a prestige class that originated within the ranks of elven nationalist group called Eldreth Veluuthra , though there are no known members who have expanded from that organization . Justices are the agents of elven lords hired to slay men . They do so by becoming skilled hunters who wield their bow s with expertise .

title: Justiciar of Tyr
description: Justiciar of Tyr A Justiciar of Tyr was a member of a special prestige class of law - enforcers , magistrates , and judges . The Justiciars acted as the elite servants of Tyr , the living embodiment of their patron god ' s portfolio . To become a Justiciar , one was required to show combat prowess , spellcasting abilities , skill at diplomacy , and great knowledge about laws and religions .

title: Justran Daehl
description: Justran Daehl Justran Daehl was one of the owners of the Helm at Highsun tavern in Red Larch and secretly a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Justran managed the Helm at Highsun tavern along with Garlen Harlathurl .

title: Juz ' la
description: Juz ' la Juz ' la was an independent spy on Waterdeep in c . 1372 . Juz ' la born on Skullport and in her youth , she survived as a spy , selling secrets to the highest bidder .

title: Juzimura rebellion
description: Juzimura rebellion The Juzimura rebellion was the revolt and subsequent slaughter of thousands of " radical " worshipers of Chantea and their displaced ronin mercenaries by the government forces of Wa around 1337 DR . The followers of the oft - distrusted western goddess Chantea had gathered at Juzimura Castle in the south of Tsukishima , presumably to protest the xenophobic rule of the new Shogun , Matasuuri Nagahide , who had come to power the year before . The shogun sent his troops to purge the castle of its inhabitants and thousands were slaughtered .

title: Jymahna
description: Jymahna Overview . Jymahna is a female human Lich and member of the Twisted Rune . She was once a concubine of Shangalar before he made her into a lich .

title: Jyordhan
description: Jyordhan Jyordhan was a Zhentarim agent and Lord of Shadowdale between 1339 DR and his death in 1345 DR . Background . When Aumry was assassinated by Zhentarim agents in 1339 DR , Jyordhan captured and killed these assassins , claiming the " Pendant of Ashaba " and presenting himself as the new lord , to which the people of Shadowdale agreed .

title: Jyzrill
description: Jyzrill Jyzrill was a member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , alongside Gilkriz , Jyzrill was one of the conjurers sent to help teleport the combined force of wizards of Sshamath and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .

title: K ' yorl Odran
description: K ' yorl Odran K ' yorl Odran was the matron mother of House Oblodra in the drow city of Menzoberranzan from 961 DR until the house ' s destruction in 1358 DR . Description . K ' yorl was a small and physically weak drow .

title: Ka ' Narlist
description: Ka ' Narlist Ka ' Narlist was a dark elf and ilythiiri . He was also the archmage and ruler of Atorrnash . His home was known as Ka ' Narlists Keep and dominated the city .

title: Ka ' ioa ' Tara
description: Ka ' ioa ' Tara Ka ' ioa ' Tara was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Ka ' ioa ' Tara was a free spirit , rejecting all conventions of her people .

title: Kaanyr Vhok
description: Kaanyr Vhok Kaanyr Vhok was a cambion , leader of the Scoured Legion ( sometimes seen as Scourged Legion ) , and Master of Hellgate Keep . Description . As the son of a marilith and a human father , Vhok appeared mostly humanoid , but with light olive - colored skin and silver hair .

title: Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil
description: Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil Kabril Ali al - Sara al - Zalazil was the powerful ruler of the dao . < br > Activities . Much less athletic than the usual noble dao , he had shrewd mind for schemes and business of all sorts , and was always open to new ideas and technologies to improve the empire of the dao , called the Great Dismal Delve , and his personal wealth .

title: Kachin
description: Kachin Kachin was the high priest of Qotal in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Kachin led the most powerful temple in Ulatos .

title: Kadar
description: Kadar Kadar was a fallen empire of Zakhara , that lay in the jungles of the Nogaro and the adjacent river valleys , southeast of the Haunted Lands and south of World Pillar Mountains and Jungle of Monsters . Some sages believed that Kadarasto was once its capital . Its language was Kadari .

title: Kadar al Ilmater
description: Kadar al Ilmater Kadar al Ilmater was a Calishite human monk of Ilmater , a member of the Order of St . Uzurr , the Abbot of the Cloister of St . Uzurr , and leader of the city of Uzurr in Lapaliiya " circa " 1372 DR .

title: Kadarasto
description: Kadarasto The city of Kadarasto sat atop a bluff above the Nogaro River , about 100 mi ( 160 . 93 km ) up the flow from Dihliz . Structure .

title: Kadeln Olothstar
description: Kadeln Olothstar Kadeln Olothstar was a male wizard who was one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . Kadeln was a powerful member of the magelords from the start of their power , second only to Neldryn Hawklyn , together with Seldinor Stormcloak .

title: Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi
description: Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi Kadin al - Zor al - Faddi , or Kadin of the Silver Throat , was a half - elf rawun living in the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Possessions . Kadin owned a magical short sword , a lap zither , and his spellbook .

title: Kadokawa Shigetada
description: Kadokawa Shigetada Kadokawa Shigetada was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and shugo - matadai of Okahira in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Kadokawa lived in Okahira , where he had his office .

title: Kadokawa Yori
description: Kadokawa Yori Kadokawa Yori was a samurai who assisted in running a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a very tranquil posthouse inside a Niwa shoen , located at an equal distance between Tamanokuni and Kuda , Kadokawa assisted Hori Gutsu as his second - in - command .

title: Kadorr
description: Kadorr Kadorr was a Zhentarim wizard apprentice of Ashemmi in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Kadorr was a devious individual with great ambition .

title: Kadran Gordeon
description: Kadran Gordeon Kadran Gordeon was a lieutenant of House Basadoni , the most powerful Thieves ' guild in Calimport in 1364 . He was the leader of the guild ' s army and a good fighter . Kadran was insanely jealous of Artemis Entreri , whom all considered the best fighter of Calimport , a title Kadran wanted for himself .

title: Kae Deverell
description: Kae Deverell Kae Deverell was a male human Purple Dragon commander of the Cormyrean stronghold of High Horn during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . He was possessed by Bhaal . History .

title: Kaedlaw Burdun
description: Kaedlaw Burdun Prince Kaedlaw Burdun was the son of Queen Brianna Burdun of Hartsvale . Description . In his natural form , Kaedlaw was a rather normal - looking child , although he was extremely large for his age .

title: Kael
description: Kael Kael was the half - drow son of the alu - fiend Aliisza and drow wizard Pharaun Mizzrym . He was a paladin of Torm . Description .

title: Kaeledhin
description: Kaeledhin Kaeledhin was the recipient of one of Ithraides ' s " telkiira " . It was taken by Sarya Dlardrageth who , over five thousand years later , concealed it on the body of Philaerin after he was killed , and was subsequently taken up by Araevin Teshurr .

title: Kaelen Sarssir
description: Kaelen Sarssir Kaelen Sarssir was a inhabitants of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Kaelen was an actor that casually inherited the Talking Troll tavern but he had no interest in managing it well .

title: Kaelyn
description: Kaelyn Kaelyn the Dove was a half - celestial cleric of Ilmater . She fought alongside the Kalach - Cha during his / her adventures in the Unapproachable East . Behind the scenes .

title: Kaer ' lic Suun Wett
description: Kaer ' lic Suun Wett Kaer ' lic Suun Wett was a drow priestess of Lolth and part of a band of four along with Ad ' non Kareese , Donnia Soldou and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Kaer ' lic lost her right eye in a battle almost a hundred years ago before 1371 DR , and she replaced it with a black eye from a giant spider .

title: Kaeth
description: Kaeth Kaeth , also known as coffee , was a brewed beverage made from ground beans . Considered a rare delicacy in areas north of Calimshan , kaeth was relatively common in more southerly lands , as well as in larger cities such as Athkatla , Waterdeep , and Westgate . Production .

title: Kaff
description: Kaff Kaff , or the Palm , was the northernmost island of the Djinni ' s Claws southwest of mainland Zakhara . Mariners considered Kaff to be the safest island to sail near . Inhabitants .

title: Kaggen Entreri
description: Kaggen Entreri Kaggen Entreri was a young Warlock Knight in Vaasa in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Kaggen was sent with his platoon to investigate a relic from the Witch - King Zhengyi .

title: Kahin
description: Kahin Kahins ( females were sometimes called kahinas ) were the practitioners of an unusual and ancient faith in the burning land of Zakhara . Also called idol priests , they saw divinity not only in the gods but in all things , and saw a divine force at work in the universe as a whole . They did not , however , necessarily believe that this force worked toward a discernible goal .

title: Kahvoerm Irithyl
description: Kahvoerm Irithyl Kahvoerm Irithyl was the first Coronal of Cormanthyr , ruling from - 4000 DR to his death in - 2900 DR , having been the first elf clan leader to draw the Rulers ' Blade . At the wish of the dying Coronal Oacenth of Jhyrennstar , and with the support of the nobles and the Council of Trees he united the realms of Semberholme , Jhyrennstar , and Elven Court into the empire of Cormanthyr . Kahvoerm spent the first part of his rysar seeking a spot for the new empire ' s capital .

title: Kai Chiang Lung
description: Kai Chiang Lung Kai Chiang Lung was a chiang lung dragon in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Kai was a chiang lung dragon residing at the bottom of Lake Sari .

title: Kai Tsao Shou Chin
description: Kai Tsao Shou Chin Kai Tsao Shou Chin was the emperor of Shou Lung in 1357 DR and 1358 DR History . Kai Tsao was born as the eight son of emperor Hsiao Chin , the Seventh Emperor of the Chin Dynasty . However , early in his life , his mother fell into a disagreement with the emperor and she fled with him from the Great Court , starting a new life in far Kao Shan .

title: Kai Tyran Uviel
description: Kai Tyran Uviel Kai Tyran Uviel was a bandit in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Kai was a member of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek .

title: Kaia
description: Kaia Kaia were aberration s that lived in the Spur Forest near the Akanamere . Description . These horrid creatures used darkvision and tremorsense to hunt prey .

title: Kaian
description: Kaian Kaian was a old Tsuyoi - no - kami monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kaian commonly strode through the temple on one errand after another .

title: Kaitlin ' s weed
description: Kaitlin ' s weed Kaitlin ' s weed was a plant found growing within the prairie lands surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls , located slightly southwest of the southern border of the great desert Anauroch . Uses . Often confused with another weed called dragon ' s breath , which was poisonous , Kaitlin ' s weed was used as a natural balm treatment for common sunburn .

title: Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk
description: Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk Lady Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk was the leader of the group of Red Knight faithful known as the Order of the Red Falcon . History . During the Time of Troubles , Lady Bloodhawk became the avatar for the Red Knight and led an adventuring band to Tethyr and routed an invading horde of monsters from the region .

title: Kaitlynn
description: Kaitlynn Kaitlynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Kaitlynn was born with Anithlynn and Briglynn on board a Moonshae Isles ship to a mystic of the Earthmother , Celya , who lost most of her energy in childbirth .

title: Kal Clewsoro
description: Kal Clewsoro Kal Clewsoro ran a camp near Spellgard in 1479 DR . History . Clewsoro started as a soldier , later becoming a teamster and rising to become a merchant prince .

title: Kalach - Cha
description: Kalach - Cha The Kalach - Cha , also known as the Knight - Captain , was an adventurer who , among other major feats , battled the King of Shadows . The name Kalach - Cha , which is a " nom de guerre " , was coined by the Kalach - Cha ’ s githyanki enemies , in whose language the words " Kalach - Cha " mean " shard bearer , " referring to the close connection between the hero and the " Silver Sword of Gith " . Biography .

title: Kalach - Cha ' s construct
description: Kalach - Cha ' s construct The Kalach - Cha ' s construct , often called simply the Construct by the hero and their companions , was a blade golem manufactured by the Illefarn ese several centuries in the past . Reactivated by agents of the King of Shadows the blade golem would eventually be neutralized and salvaged by the Kalach - Cha and their companions and used against its former owners . Physical description .

title: Kalah
description: Kalah Kalah was a gnome illusionist who worked in a circus that toured at least Amn and Tethyr . He grew bitter at being made fun of and , when the circus stopped at Waukeen ' s Promenade in Athkatla , used powers he had gained from an unknown source to turn the inside of the circus tent into an unreasonably large world of illusions in the middle of his act . Some people trapped within were killed , others seemingly turned into various monsters .

title: Kalahar Twohands
description: Kalahar Twohands Kalahar Twohands was a half - elf and the well - respected High Lord of Loudwater , formerly the " Gauntlet of the Western Marches " . Background . In 1347 DR Kalahar was the current Green Regent and led his Scions against a Tempest summoned by Talassan priests which had been terrorizing Llorkh and Orlbar .

title: Kalam Bloodsword
description: Kalam Bloodsword Kalam Bloodsword was a veteran Zhentilar warrior in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Kalam was one of the Zhentilar lieutenants in the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .

title: Kalassyn
description: Kalassyn Kalassyn was a minor Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . Kalassyn and his fellow Mrinden had fought in Daggerdale .

title: Kalb Bahriy Sahr
description: Kalb Bahriy Sahr Kalb Bahriy Sahr , or the Shark Reef , was a island chain formed from coral reefs . This reef was located in the Djinni ' s Claws in the Crowded Sea southwest of mainland Zakhara . Geography .

title: Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari
description: Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari Kalbari al - Durrat al - Amwaj ibn Jari was a noble marid and the Great Padishah of the Marid in 1367 DR , who ruled her subjects from her court in the Citadel of Ten Thousand Pearls on the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . Different descriptions gave Kalbari two alternate appearances , either with skin of darkest black and hair of corraline red piled up in the shape of a turban , or skin of shimmering white with black hair .

title: Kalda Purefist
description: Kalda Purefist Kalda Purefist was a dwarf paladin in the Moonsea . Activities . Kalda was a paladin and an officer of the Hammer of Moradin in Earthfast .

title: Kaled bin Zafir
description: Kaled bin Zafir Kaled bin Zafir was a Zakharan inventor in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Kaled was an eccentric man , and a genius in his field .

title: Kaleil
description: Kaleil Kaleil was a druid of Maiden ' s Glade near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . In 1374 DR , Kaleil transformed himself into a bear , but was not able to change back .

title: Kalen Dren
description: Kalen Dren - - Kalen Dren Kalen Dren was a human Paladin who believed in the Threefold God and was the primary crusader of the Eye of Justice . He lead a dual life as a member of an elite Waterdeep guard unit and vigilante crime fighter . Kalen suffered from a spellscar which numbed his body .

title: Kalia
description: Kalia Kalia was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Kalia was a member of the Champions of Muktar .

title: Kalian
description: Kalian The Kalian , which literally meant the Pipe or the smoking pipe , was a market located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Kalian was found in the Rookery ward of the city . Activities .

title: Kaliesh ' erai
description: Kaliesh ' erai The Kaliesh ' erai was an organization of psionic elves based in the city of Evereska in the Western Heartlands . Activities . The majority of the members spent their time in serene mediation and contemplation of their powers , but there were some who ' d grown fascinated by psionic items .

title: Kalil yi Tulmon
description: Kalil yi Tulmon Kalil yi Tulmon was a pirate in service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Kalil usually acted as first mate on pirate ships of the Rundeen fleet out of Almraiven , Suldophor , and Theymarsh .

title: Kalin Abd al - Bas
description: Kalin Abd al - Bas Kalin Abd al - Bas was the general and commander of the Valiant Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Description . Kalin had a streak of white running through her hair ; a trait that was identical to a hero of the Valiant .

title: Kalkan Swordbreaker
description: Kalkan Swordbreaker Kalkan was a fallen deva who was transformed into a rakshasa and was the arch - nemesis of the deva Demascus . History . Like Demascus , Kalkan died many times only to be resurrected .

title: Kallicl
description: Kallicl Kallicl was a priest of Zaltec in Nexal , Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , he was the right - hand man of high priest Hoxitl .

title: Kallos Tam
description: Kallos Tam Kallos Tam was a Red Wizard of Thay , a necromancer , and the true menace behind the Blackdagger Bandits that raided the High Road . History . Kallos Tam was an ambitious Red Wizard , one of the many agents of Thay sent to the Neverwinter region in 1479 DR .

title: Kalnak
description: Kalnak Kalnak was the leader of the Jaguar Knights of Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , Kalnak was chosen by Naltecona to lead an ambush against the Golden Legion at Palul .

title: Kalon Doring
description: Kalon Doring Kalon Doring was the last King of Guge in the Hordelands . Rumors and Legends . It was widely rumored that the gods drove Kalon mad because he dared to challenge the might of the Celestial Emperor .

title: Kalugin
description: Kalugin Kalugin was an officer of the City Watch of Mulmaster . Personality . Kalugin was a rigid applier of the law .

title: Kalzareinad
description: Kalzareinad Kalzareinad was the dragon demigod of dragon magic , in particular the selfish , uncaring , or evil application of it . Relationships . Before his death , Kalzareinad was on somewhat friendly terms with Null .

title: Kama
description: Kama A kama is a light , exotic melee weapon typically used by monk s . Description . The kama is similar to the sickle or a small scythe and bears a strong resemblance to a heavy pick but without the backside peen .

title: Kamal
description: Kamal A kamal was a nautical tool used by Zakharan sailors . Uses . This device was used in navigation .

title: Kame - Renn
description: Kame - Renn Kame - Renn was a sea dragon member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Kame - Renn was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .

title: Kamlann
description: Kamlann Duchy Kamlann was the small , mountainous duchy north of the Sulduskoon River in the central western part of Tethyr . It was mostly hill country and pipeweed plantations , but it also contained Zazesspur , the largest and richest city of Tethyr . Geography .

title: Kammarth
description: Kammarth Kammarth was a magical drug concocted from a rare surfrace root and a subterranean fungus . Description . It was taken as a powder or as a beige jelly and was either eaten or taken through skin contact , the former was a more effective way to experience its effects .

title: Kamo Ti
description: Kamo Ti Kamo Ti was a shopkeeper in Shou Lung . Activities . Kamo Ti lived in the city of Pasar , the largest city in the Shao Mountains .

title: Kamon
description: Kamon Kamon was a short and stocky human mercenary who was killed in a fight with Abdel Adrian in 1368 DR . Kamon had previously worked with Abdel in 1367 DR , guarding a warehouse in Athkatla . Kamon had blue eyes and liked to wield two axe s simultaneously .

title: Kamoth Kastelmar
description: Kamoth Kastelmar Kamoth Kastelmar was a member of a minor noble family of Hillsfar . Possessions . The " Kraken Queen " was equipped with a magical device created by Red Wizards known as a starry compass that allowed it to sail high into the air , even as high as Selûne .

title: Kamus el Tarshaj
description: Kamus el Tarshaj Kamus yn Tasyn el Tarshaj was one of the many pashas of Calimport and rulers of Calimshan during its Fifth Age . Kamus el Tarshaj was remembered in history for his gift of the territory later known as Ankaram to King Silvam of Tethyr for his assistance in the Eye Tyrant Wars . This occurred in the Year of Recompense , - 150 DR .

title: Kanaglym
description: Kanaglym Kanaglym was an abandoned dwarven town . Located entirely underground and reachable by a series of caves located under Dragonspear Castle , the town was the site of the Fountain of Nepenthe , a watery portal to the Fugue Plane . History .

title: Kanari Taro
description: Kanari Taro Kanari Taro was a korobokuru yakuza adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Taro lived on the streets from when he was child , never knowing about his family .

title: Kane
description: Kane Kane was a male human monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains south of Damara in the Bloodstone Lands . He was a high - ranking member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred , following Ilmater the Broken God and St .

title: Kang Bay
description: Kang Bay Kang Bay was a bay between the two branches of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . Locations . It held a number of islands , large and small , the greatest of which were Quelpart and Kanko , it was actually a volcano that emerged from the sea .

title: Kangaxx
description: Kangaxx Kangaxx was a powerful demilich residing in Athkatla . Personality . Kangaxx was an intensely evil man even prior to undeath .

title: Kani
description: Kani Kani was a hengeyokai bushi adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kani lived in a barren seashore with his friends Rabbit and Tanuki .

title: Kanishta
description: Kanishta Kanishta was a root found in the Cold Lands , specifically Narfell . Description . " Kanishta " was a dark - colored root .

title: Kanjentellequor Biri
description: Kanjentellequor Biri Kanjentellequor Biri was one of the few dragonborn wizard s of Tymanther and a member of Clan Kanjentellequor . She was also a member of the Lance Defenders and the lover of Balasar . Description .

title: Kanko
description: Kanko Kanko was a volcano island in Kang Bay at the end of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . History . In ancient times , the Kanko volcano rose up out of Kang Bay and erupted ; it was said that the very skies over Koryo caught fire .

title: Kao Dynasty
description: Kao Dynasty The Kao Dynasty ( meaning " the High Dynasty " ) was a dynasty of the empire of Shou Lung that lasted from Shou Year 1025 ( – 225 DR ) to Shou Year 2050 ( 800 DR ) . " Kao Dynasty " was also a byword for this period of Shou Lung ' s history . History .

title: Kao Shan Ten
description: Kao Shan Ten Kao Shan Ten was the Imperial Wu Jen of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Kao Shan Ten had assisted and protected Emperor Kai Tsao Shou Chin since he was very young .

title: Kaorti
description: Kaorti The kaorti were an alien , emaciated people from the Far Realm who wished to transform the Prime Material Plane into a place more to their liking . History . During the Dawn Ages , elves created the " Vast Gate " in an attempt to make travel anywhere instantaneous and to see what lay beyond the works of the gods .

title: Kappiyan Flurmastyr
description: Kappiyan Flurmastyr Kappiyan Flurmastyr was a wizard and loremaster in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Together with his wife , Kappiyan sold potions in order to fund his Mystra - blessed magic research .

title: Kar ' r ' rga
description: Kar ' r ' rga Kar ' r ' rga was a savage god worshipped by the non - Enlightened natives of Jazayir al - Sartan in Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea - human and non - human alike . Its special servants , also called its children , were the monstrous sartani , which appeared just like their god : a giant humanoid with the head of a crab . < br > The lagoon called Batihat al - Saji in the center of the island group was sacred to Kar ' r ' rga .

title: Kara - Tur
description: Kara - Tur The large landmass of Kara - Tur lies east of Faerûn on Toril . Between Kara - Tur and Faerûn stretches the Hordelands for hundreds of miles . At the far South East of it lies the mysterious continent of Osse .

title: Kara - Tur calendar
description: Kara - Tur calendar The Kara - Tur calendar was the calendar by which the civilized lands of Kara - Tur measured the months of the year . It was devised by one of the emperors of Shou Lung . Appendix .

title: Kara - Turan languages
description: Kara - Turan languages The Kara - Turan languages were a family of languages spoken by the majority of human s on the continent of Kara - Tur . Languages . The following language groups belonged to the Kara - Turan language family : In addition , the following languages were also among this family : The Chuchian language from the Imaskari languages family was also found among the languages of Kara - Tur .

title: Kara Chermosk
description: Kara Chermosk Kara Chermosk was the commander for the Zhentarim forces of the Tethyamar Fortress , nestled in the western Dalelands amid the Desertsmouth Mountains . Personality . Kara earned much respect from her soldiers for her iron - handed rule and severe manner , which brooked no dissent .

title: Kara Hulmaster
description: Kara Hulmaster The ranger Kara Hulmaster is the cousin of Geran Hulmaster and was the current , as of 1480 DR , regent of Hulburg . In addition to her skills as an excellent warrior , Kara was a competent strategist and battle master . Appearance .

title: Karador
description: Karador Karador was a small city located in the middle of Lake Myrloch on Gwynneth Isle in the Moonshaes . As of 1479 DR the city was ruled by the fey queen High Lady Ordalf as the capital of Sarifal although her son Prince Araithe handled the day - to - day running of the government . Inhabitants .

title: Karak
description: Karak Karak was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay at the edge of the great Quang Muku Forest , by the sea . History .

title: Karakil chaka
description: Karakil chaka The Karakil chaka was a prominent chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . This chaka focused on foresting and the milling of harvested timber .

title: Karasendrieth
description: Karasendrieth Karasendrieth was a female adult song dragon who lived in Impiltur around 1374 DR . Description . As a song dragon , Kara was able to take the form of a beautiful , willowy , silver - haired human .

title: Karatin
description: Karatin Karatin was a seaport city at the mouth of the Hungtse River . It was built on a swamp , but partly settled on a cleared - out jungle . History .

title: Karazikar
description: Karazikar Karazikar was a beholder living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Like all of its kind , Karazikar was arrogant , hateful , and paranoid .

title: Kardann
description: Kardann Kardann was an official of the government of Amn in 1361 DR . History . In 1361 DR , Kardann was assigned to the Golden Legion for their Maztica n expedition .

title: Kardhel Terov
description: Kardhel Terov Kardhel Terov is a fellthane among the Warlock Knights and an ambitious merchant . Background . In the Year of the Ageless One , Terov approached Mhurren of the Bloody Skulls orc tribe , offering the warchief his own kingdom of Thar in exchange for an oath of fealty and an agreement not to endanger cities under Kardhel ' s protection .

title: Karel Mahorne
description: Karel Mahorne Karel Mahorne was a human cleric of Mielikki who dedicated her life to the curing of lycanthrope s and who was the leader of the Silver Stake , an organization with this goal . Activities . Because of her by then considerable age , during the years following the Time of Troubles , she worked exclusively from the company ' s compound near Baldur ' s Gate .

title: Karen Wynn Fonstad
description: Karen Wynn Fonstad Karen Wynn Fonstad was a geographer and cartographer know for designing the atlases of a number of fictional settings , including and D & D ' s and Forgotten Realms setting . Education . Fonstad earned her B .

title: Karffbadh
description: Karffbadh Karffbadh was the capital of one of the satrapies of the ancient Jhothûn Empire of giant s . Geography . The city of Karffbadh once sat on the tip of a penisula extending west from what would later be called Icewind Dale .

title: Kargien Dissengulp
description: Kargien Dissengulp Kargien Dissengulp was a deep gnome burrow warden in Blingdenstone . History . Kargien was a burrow warden who had escaped from Blingdenstone in 1371 DR .

title: Karigulzu
description: Karigulzu Karigulzu was the nominal ruler of Red Haven in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Karigulzu was sent as a sacrificial lamb to the most dangerous town of Unther .

title: Karim Ben Aziz
description: Karim Ben Aziz Karim Ben Aziz was a half - elf living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Karim served as the captain of the marketplace guards in Bandar al - Sa ' adat .

title: Karis
description: Karis Karis was the mad wife of Elden Vargas in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . History . Karis was a storm sorceress of Rashemen .

title: Karl
description: Karl Karl , commonly known as Dumb Karl , was a dwarf farmer in the Moonsea . Personality . Karl was a homely individual but despite his appearance and nickname he was actually quite bright .

title: Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen
description: Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen Karl Gustavis Gearwizzen was the head priest of Gond in Skullport . History . Karl was the main proponent of building a water clock with his clergy and the gnome twins Tykkyl Burrwarden and Tohkkal Burrwarden .

title: Karl Waller
description: Karl Waller Karl Waller is a comic book and fantasy artist . Education . Waller graduated from the in 1987 .

title: Karma curse
description: Karma curse Karma curse was a powerful clerical spell from the charm sphere . Users . Only clerics and priests without evil in their hearts could use this spell .

title: Karne
description: Karne Karne , also called Kharne was an agent for the Zhentarim . He was formerly a sellsword operating in Nashkel and the mortal enemy of the vampire king of the Battle of the Bones , Mordoc SeLanmere . Karne was quick to ascend through the ranks of the Black Network and was likely a direct advisor to Fzoul Chembryl .

title: Karolina Wormack
description: Karolina Wormack Karolina Wormack was a woman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow next assault on the Silver Marches , Karolina lived with her brother Giles Wormack in Sundabar .

title: Karontor
description: Karontor Karontor was one of the sons of Annam All - Father , the Father of all true giant s . His brothers were Grolantor , Stronmaus , Skoraeus , Memnor , Surtr , and Thrym . His sisters were Hiatea , Iallanis , and Diancastra .

title: Karr
description: Karr Karr was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Karr had a bald head and sported a curly brown beard .

title: Karrlon
description: Karrlon Karrlon was a male wemic ranger and paladin of Nobanion . He was a scout in the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company , based in Mindulgulph Castle just south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast , and the founder of the Legion of Lions , a militant religious order devoted to Nobanion the Lion King . History .

title: Karrundax
description: Karrundax Karrundax the Red was a young red dragon living in the Caverns of Karrundax within Mount Hotenow in Neverwinter Wood . History . Karrundax made his lair in Mount Hotenow in a cave near the river of pure elemental fire at some point before 1479 DR .

title: Karse
description: Karse Karse was a city built at the base of a " tall butte of red stone " . History . Like many other settlements in the High Forest , Karse was abandonded after the fall of Ascalhorn .

title: Karselridrith
