description: Karselridrith Karselridrith , also known as Brightstrike , was a blue wyrm whose lair was near Wreathe in Netheril . History . During the Shadowed Age and around - 1859 DR , Karselridrith was slain in her lair by more than fifteen adventurers .

title: Karsev
description: Karsev Karsev ( pronounced KAR - seff ) was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea . Possessions . In battle , Karsev wore a suit of scalemail and fought with a hand fork and shield .

title: Karsoluthiyl
description: Karsoluthiyl Karsoluthiyl was a drow city located beneath the Trackless Sea , west of the mouth of the River Chionthar . Two prominant houses were House Tanor ' Thal and House Lysaen . Both houses were big players in the slave trade of Skullport .

title: Karsus
description: Karsus Lord Karsus was the Netherese creator and caster of the " Karsus ' s avatar " spell that triggered the Fall of Netheril . History . Early life .

title: Karsus ' s Folly
description: Karsus ' s Folly Karsus ' s Folly was a climactic event which caused the end of the Netherese empire in - 339 DR . History . After decades of war with the Phaerimm , the homeland of Netheril was quickly becoming a wasteland , partly due to the strange help the Netheril got from the Sharn .

title: Karsus ' s avatar
description: Karsus ' s avatar Karsus ' s avatar was a very powerful spell which altered the very disposition of reality . Effects . The spell was even capable of allowing its user to become a god of their choosing , replacing a current god with themselves the moment the spell was completed .

title: Kartak Spellseer
description: Kartak Spellseer Kartak Spellseer is a lich , member of the Twisted Rune and bane of his mortal family . Description . Kartak looks as if he is still mortal , and young - looking for the age he died at ( 54 years old ) too .

title: Kartha - Kaya
description: Kartha - Kaya Kartha - Kaya was the chief of a yak folk village near Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Kartha - Kaya lived with his fellow and his two wives Imberu and Nahala near Ironslag forge .

title: Karzon Kul
description: Karzon Kul Karzon Kul was a ruffian dwarf from Loudwater in 1479 DR . Description . Karzon ' s head was shaved , and he had tattoos across his body .

title: Karzov
description: Karzov Karzov was the deputy leader of the Nasher in Neverwinter and an Uthgardt fighter . History . In 1484 DR , Karzov had become the the second - in - command of the Nasher rebel group , answering only to Arlon Bladeshaper .

title: Kasad
description: Kasad Kasad , or One - Eye Kasad , was a disfigured human sergeant of the watch in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . A bar fight during his youth left Kasad with a ghastly facial injury and the loss of an eye .

title: Kashada
description: Kashada Kashada the Nightwraith was a shadow mystic ( probably a shadow adept ) and an aspect of Shar . Description . Kashada was tall .

title: Kashghun
description: Kashghun The Kashghun were a tribe of nomadic human s living on the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . Territory . The Kashghun lived in the eastern regions of the Endless Waste .

title: Kashik
description: Kashik The Kashik were an elite organization from the Hordelands during the 14th century DR . Organization . 10 , 000 men comprised the Kashik .

title: Kasidikal
description: Kasidikal Kasidikal was a mature adult black dragon and a member of House Orogoth . Her lair was in the ruins of Orogoth on the High Moor of the Western Heartlands , just north of the Serpent Hills . Relationships .

title: Kasnchil
description: Kasnchil Kasnchil was the baron of the city of Surbar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Kasnchil was the most corrupt and greedy of Ulgarth ' s barons , and this affected his legal judgments . He permitted all kinds of trade through Surbar , which made it a popular port and a prosperous city , but this knew no limits : even Dambrath an pirates could dock there to resupply and refit .

title: Kaspar
description: Kaspar Kaspar was a city lying on the eastern side of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Description . Kaspar was a thriving city of 10 , 000 people , called " Kasparians " .

title: Kassawar Plickenstint
description: Kassawar Plickenstint Kassawar Plickenstint was the main deep gnome delegate in Mantol - Derith in 1372 DR . History . Kassawar was the representative of Blingdenstone in the merchant outpost of Mantol - Derith .

title: Kastighur
description: Kastighur A kastighur was a type of tanar ' ri demon found in the Abyss or the Barrens of Doom and Despair . Wicked and sadistic , kastighurs acted as prison wardens and hunters among demonkind . They teleported around the field of battle and used their devastating charges to stun and horrify their enemies .

title: Kata Brizik
description: Kata Brizik Kata Brizik was a businesswoman and dancer in Mulmaster . History . Kata was a very talented dancer who opened the festhall the Wave and Wink with her husband Urdun Brizik .

title: Katakoro Glacier
description: Katakoro Glacier The Katakoro Glacier was a large glacier located within Katakoro Shan , bordering both Ra - Khati and Khazari . Geography . This large glacier covered hundreds of square miles .

title: Katakoro Plateau
description: Katakoro Plateau The Katakoro Plateau was the only large plateau in the entire Hordelands . Geography . The roughly triangular Katakoro Plateau was enclosed by the Kun - Yen Shan range to the south , the A - Ling Shan range to the west , and the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs to the east .

title: Katakoro Shan
description: Katakoro Shan Katakoro Shan was an enormous mountain range located in the Hordelands . It was part of the larger Yehimal mountains . Geography .

title: Katana
description: Katana Description . The katana is an eastern - style sword with a slightly curved , single - edge blade on the outside edge of the curve and a tanto tip . Typical designs carry blade lengths anywhere from 24 to 29 inches ( 60 .

title: Katar
description: Katar A katar was a punching dagger common to Calimshan and Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Etymology . The word for " knife " in Alzhedo was " katar " , yet when most people used the term " katar " , they were referring specifically to the punching dagger used by Calishite s .

title: Katashaka
description: Katashaka Katashaka was a distant continent southwest of Faerûn and was the original home of several human tribes , including the Eshowe , Tabaxi , and Thinguth . Inhabitants . A being known as Olurobo — and its children , the " nyama - nummo " — was worshiped by the Tabaxi tribes before they converted to the worship of Ubtao and their subsequent migration to the Jungles of Chult .

title: Kate Kenkichi
description: Kate Kenkichi Kate Kenkichi was a samurai retainer of the Tsu family who run a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse in a cool and shaded hollow inside a Niwa shoen , he led a company of one samurai ( his brother Kate Akiie ) and ten bushi .

title: Katharine Marie Moorland
description: Katharine Marie Moorland Katharine Marie Moorland was the Lord Speaker of the Council of Lords of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance .

title: Katheera Urdo
description: Katheera Urdo Katheera Urdo was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Katheera was the scion of the noble House Urdo of Westgate and joined the Night Masks only to indulge in her depraved interests .

title: Katl
description: Katl Katl was an Eagle Knight in Maztica . History . In late 1361 DR , Katl was one of the many officers in the assorted column of refugee led by Cordell .

title: Katriana Donohar
description: Katriana Donohar Katriana Donohar was a Tethyrian human woman living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a priest of Chauntea . History .

title: Katsuhara Omitsu
description: Katsuhara Omitsu Katsuhara Omitsu was a spirit folk shugo - daimyo in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Katsuhara was the daimyo of Dosaki Province and the main overseer of the construction of the imperial shipyards at Renkyu and the controlled exploitation of the Waturi Forest .

title: Kavayah II
description: Kavayah II Kavayah II was the novice - prince of the Kuong Kingdom in Malatra . History . Around 1357 DR , Kavayah was totally absorbed with his training to become the next king - priest .

title: Kaverin Ebonhand
description: Kaverin Ebonhand Kaverin Ebonhand was the leader of the Cult of Frost . Personality . Kaverin was a ruthless , vindictive , and obsessive individual .

title: Kawabi
description: Kawabi Kawabi was a governor in Shou Lung . Relationship . Kawabi was the sixth cousin of the Emperor .

title: Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id
description: Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id Kawthar bint Husn umm Ra ' id was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Kawthar ruled the sea elves inhabiting Chaos Bay with her husband .

title: Kayalithica
description: Kayalithica Thane Kayalithica was the ruler of the stone giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Kayalithica was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Kayl Moorwalker
description: Kayl Moorwalker Captain Kayl Moorwalker is both the First Elder of the Council of Elders and the High Captain of Everlund , in 1372 DR . Kayl was an intelligent military commander who preferred to look after the interests of the nobility rather than commoners and merchants . As a result of this , he was looked upon favourably by the elves of the Council of Elders .

title: Kaylessa Irkell
description: Kaylessa Irkell Kaylessa Irkell was the owner of the Swinging Sword tavern in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Kaylessa was the fortyish matriarch of her family and a pleasant , sturdy woman .

title: Kaylinn
description: Kaylinn Kaylinn was a cleric of Kelemvor in the city of Ormpetarr in Sespech . Description . Kaylinn was short , with wide hips and full breasts .

title: Kaz Hanar
description: Kaz Hanar Kaz Hanar was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Kaz Hanar patrolled the plaza outside of the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil with his wyvern mount .

title: Kazgaroth
description: Kazgaroth Kazgaroth ( sometimes Kazgoroth ) was an aspect of Malar , who was a powerful , intelligent , evil beast opposed to the balance and the influence of the Earthmother on the Moonshae Isles . It would periodically ravage the land until it was defeated , only to return several years later . Kazgaroth ' s natural form was of a huge " Tyrannosaurus rex " , but it could shape - change to other forms , including those of people whom it might kill and devour before impersonating .

title: Kazit Gul
description: Kazit Gul Kazit Gul was the Red Wizard of Thay demilich master of the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Centuries before , Kazit Gul was a Red Wizard necromancer obsessed with dungeons .

title: Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian
description: Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian Kazmil - urshula - kelloakizilian or Urshula was a former Black dragon . Circa 1368 DR , he was a Dracolich spirit found in a phylactery concealed in a Book of Creation , a relic of the Witch - King Zhengyi . History .

title: Kazook Pickshine
description: Kazook Pickshine Kazook Pickshine was a notorious deep gnome alchemist in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Kazook helped create the " spell gem s " used in the city ' s defense .

title: Kazra
description: Kazra Kazra was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Kazra happened to spy the Cult of the Howling Hatred .

title: Kazrith
description: Kazrith A Kazrith was an aquatic demon that could be found prowling murky lakes , underground waterways , and flooded tunnels . Abilities . A kazrith used tremorsense to detect enemies ; after locating a target , it surfaced and attacked , poisoning its victim .

title: Keane
description: Keane Keane was a wizard in the Moonshae Isles . History . Keane was the royal tutor of the two young princesses Alicia Kendrick and Deirdre Kendrick , posing as a failed wizard as ordered by King Tristan Kendrick .

title: Keefe
description: Keefe Keefe was a priest of Kelemvor in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Keefe was a young priest of Kelemvor who with his fellows guarded the Valhingen Graveyard in the city .

title: Keen
description: Keen Keen is a magical effect that can be added to any bladed weapon . It allows the wielder of the weapon to make wounding , critical cuts . A weapon with this effect has the same power granted by the " keen edge " spell .

title: Keening spirit
description: Keening spirit A keening spirit was a type of ghost , created specifically from the spirit of an evil female elf . Known for its constant weeping and groaning , the creature was sometimes referred to as a " groaning spirit " . A drow keening spirit was known as a " kiaranshee " , after the drow goddess of the undead , Kiaransalee .

title: Keep of the Lizard King
description: Keep of the Lizard King King Amiskal rules the lizardfolk and muckdwellers of the Serpent Hills from an ancient Anaurian tomb that , once plundered , was converted into living quarters . The former crypt is carved into a hillside in the northern reaches of the Serpent Hills , and Amiskal ’ s throne rests atop the dais where the sepulcher once lay . A secret portal somewhere in the crypt connects with the portal network centered on the Dungeon of Swords .

title: Keep on the Shadowfell
description: Keep on the Shadowfell Behind the scenes . While " Keep on the Shadowfell " was designed initially for the " points of light " core setting for 4th edition D & D , alterations to the adventure made in an article of Dungeon magazine made it possible to use it as a dungeon for characters in the " Forgotten Realms " . These changes included changing the focus on Orcus to that of Shar and relocating Winterhaven to a geographical location in Faerûn between Cormyr and Sembia .

title: Keeper of the Key ( Ito - Jo )
description: Keeper of the Key ( Ito - Jo ) Keeper of the Key was a cursed sohei in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . The Keeper was a retainer of Ito family who died in the castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Keeper of the Old Faith
description: Keeper of the Old Faith The " Keeper of the Old Faith " was the title of the senior Sage - Priest , the official historian , of the Church of Ilmater in the late 13th century DR . The Keeper of the Old Faith succeeded the previous senior Sage - Priest , the Spontaer , after his sacrifice " circa " 1265 DR .

title: Keepers of the Flame
description: Keepers of the Flame The Keepers of the Flame were an order of psionic cleric s of Laduguer in Gracklstugh with the duty of keeping quiet the existence of the Wyrmsmith of Gracklstugh , the red dragon who used his fire breath to temper the legendary steel blades of the city in exchange for contributions to his hoard . They also had the responsibility of slaying the current Wyrmsmith before he grew too strong , and replacing him with a new red hatchling . Later , the Keepers gained the duty of protecting the Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V from the plots of the derro Council of Savants .

title: Keesha
description: Keesha Keesha was one of the finest archers of Tulom - Itzi . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the lieutenants of Gultec in trying to delay the Darien ' s army of giant ant s in order to protect the column of the refugee .

title: Keevosen Nihili
description: Keevosen Nihili Keevosen Nihili was a shadovar spy in restored Myth Drannor in 1375 DR . History . Keevosen established herself near the restored Myth Drannor in the old house of the Blackthorn family with a group of People of the Black Blood werewolves at her service .

title: Keffiyeh
description: Keffiyeh Keffiyeh were the traditional headcloths worn by inhabitants of Zakhara , Calimshan , and the Arnaden region . Description . A keffiyeh covered the head and hung down the neck .

title: Kei Bot Li
description: Kei Bot Li Kei Bot Li was a general in the army of Shou Lung . History . Kei Bot Li was the competent general of the provincial Army of Hungtze .

title: Keinen
description: Keinen Keinen was a paladin in the service of Waterdeep ' s temple of Torm . Description . Keinen was an elderly man with long locks of white hair , sporting a significant beard that nearly reached his waist .

title: Kelazzan
description: Kelazzan Kelazzan was a coastal city located in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Kelazzan had the distinction of being both the westernmost and southernmost settlement of Ulgarth .

title: Keld
description: Keld Keld was a stone giant carver at the Lodge of Faces . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Keld and all his fellows succumbed to the " faerzress " - infected madness caused by the Purple Statue .

title: Keldar of the Forest
description: Keldar of the Forest Keldar of the Forest was a Human male priest of Silvanus who lived in the village of Dragon Falls in the Vast . History . Keldar was a member of the band of adventurer s that slew the red dragon Halarglautha Firewings , who once rampaged across the Vast .

title: Kelddath Ormlyr
description: Kelddath Ormlyr In 1368 DR , Kelddath Ormlyr was the Most Radiant of Lathander and high priest of the temple of Lathander known as the Song of the Morning , located in Beregost . Before becoming high priest Kelddath had once been a merchant . He was typically regarded as the governor of Beregost , though he left the day - to - day activities to the town council .

title: Keldith Oericel
description: Keldith Oericel Keldith Oericel was one of the captains of Leuthilspar ' s infantry who had joined Seiveril Miritar ' s crusade . In 1374 DR , he replaced the dead Celeilol Fireheart as leader of the Leuthilspar contingent and was one of the captains summoned by Seiveril to plan the Cormanthor War .

title: Keldor Hannith
description: Keldor Hannith Keldor Hannith was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He was a wizard who sold scroll s and potion s , and performed spellcasting services for a fee . Hannith was described as a quiet and careful man , but was one of the more notable Procampan mages of his day .

title: Keldorn ( family )
description: Keldorn ( family ) The Keldorn family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , where common folk believed the Twelvefold families held uncountable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Keldorn Firecam
description: Keldorn Firecam Sir Keldorn Firecam is a human paladin of Torm and a respected senior member of the Order of the Radiant Heart living in Athkatla . Dedicated to his work and cause , he was often absent from his family even near retirement , at least temporarily alienating them . In 1369 DR , he was sent to investigate the Cult of the Eyeless .

title: Keledon
description: Keledon Keledon was a ghost revealed to be the husband of the elven songstress of the Elfsong Tavern . Appearance . Keledon was located though a door in the onyx tower and could be seen as a ghostly apparition .

title: Kelemvor
description: Kelemvor Kelemvor ( pronounced " KELL - em - vor " ) , formerly Kelemvor Lyonsbane , also known as the Lord of the Dead and Judge of the Damned , was the god of death and the dead , and master of the Crystal Spire in the Fugue Plane . In his mortal days , Kelemvor was a skilled mercenary , with the heart of a noble paladin , concealed under rude manners and thwarted by his mysterious family curse . Fair yet cold , Kelemvor was the god of death and the dead — the most recent deity to hold this position , following in the footsteps of Jergal , Myrkul , and Cyric .

title: Kelemvor ' s Garden
description: Kelemvor ' s Garden Kelemvor ' s Garden , previously known as the Thunderstone Cemetery , was a graveyard in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . History . The graveyard was originally known as the Thunderstone Cemetery , but Lorelei Gravesower renamed it when she became caretaker in the 1360s DR .

title: Kella Darkhope
description: Kella Darkhope Kella Darkhope was a Zhentarim agent in Nightstone sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Kella went to Nightsone posing as an itinerant monk .

title: Kellesar
description: Kellesar Kellesar was a settlement near the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It lay at the southern end of Barbarians ' Road , which formed the border between Ulgarth and the barbarian lands of the east , amidst the Stony Waste . Appendix .

title: Kellindil
description: Kellindil Kellindil was an elven archer and a member of Dove Falconhand ' s traveling party . Kellindil tied Roddy McGristle up to have him tried for his crimes in Sundabar , mainly against Montolio Debrouchee and Drizzt Do ' Urden , as he was the one who lead an army of orc s and winter wolves against them in Mooshie ' s Grove . Tephanis cut Roddy ' s bindings and Roddy strangled the elf with his bare hands .

title: Kelnozz
description: Kelnozz Kelnozz was a commoner drow warrior of House Kenafin of Menzoberranzan . History . Kelnozz was classmates with Drizzt Do ' Urden at Melee - Magthere , the fighters ' academy .

title: Kelpie
description: Kelpie A kelpie was a creature that resembled a mass of seaweed . It could alter its form to appear as a woman , a hippocampus , or a green horse , then charm a person into thinking it was in trouble and needed rescuing . Upon the person attempting to rescue the person , the kelpie grappled the victim and held it in the water until it drowned .

title: Kelson Darktreader
description: Kelson Darktreader Kelson Darktreader was a half - elf hunter in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . Personality . Kelson was a man of very few words .

title: Keltar
description: Keltar Keltar , one of the oldest cities in Faerûn , was located in Calimshan and was famous for being the site of the House of the Broken God . Geography and Layout . Keltar was located at the eastern edge of the Calim Desert along the deepest point of the Calim River .

title: Keltar ( individual )
description: Keltar ( individual ) Keltar was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Keltar believed Gorx was an emissary of Ogrémoch . History .

title: Kelthann
description: Kelthann Kelthann was an island in the Pirate Isles . It had few true pirates , owing to its close proximity to Sembia , but it acted as a smuggling port , where goods could be transferred freely between parties without regulation or taxation . The human and halfling natives here worshiped Grumbar .

title: Keltormir
description: Keltormir Keltormir was a moon and green elf realm established circa - 17800 DR to avoid the strife of the other elven nations . . Geography .

title: Kelvhan Olortynnal
description: Kelvhan Olortynnal Kelvahn Olortynnal was Arms - Major of the Akh ' Velahr in the years of the Weeping War . The Arms Major and his friend , Hachaam Selorn , died defending Myth Drannor on Kythorn 26 , 714 D . R .

title: Kelvin ' s Cairn
description: Kelvin ' s Cairn Kelvin ' s Cairn was a mountain in Icewind Dale . Description . Kelvin ' s Cairn was a free - standing 1 , 000 - foot - tall mountain fronted by a river valley about as deep as the mount was high .

title: Kelvin ' s Comfort
description: Kelvin ' s Comfort Kelvin ' s Comfort was a tavern in Bryn Shander . Location . The tavern was located next to Bryn Shander ' s market square .

title: Kemarn Darkthrush
description: Kemarn Darkthrush Kemarn Darkthrush was a wizard from Nesmé who , in 1374 DR , attempted to kill Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun . Background . Raegar Stoneblade inadvertently exploded the side of Blackstaff Tower on 28 Uktar 1374 DR , causing Khelben to be wounded .

title: Kemil Abd al - Jasir
description: Kemil Abd al - Jasir Kemil Abd al - Jasir was a general and commander of the Dauntless Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Kemil usually followed the lead of senior members of the military council since he was only a minor member .

title: Kempfana
description: Kempfana Kempfana was a barghest whelp from the plains of Gehenna . Description . Kempana was a huge , scarlet - skinned goblinlike creature .

title: Kenai al - Afriz
description: Kenai al - Afriz Kenai al - Afriz was a dao inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Kenai ' s real dao name was Shahraman . Personality .

title: Kendar Morn
description: Kendar Morn Kendar Morn was the constable of Daggerdale . Personality . Kendar loved his work .

title: Kendrin Feldarr
description: Kendrin Feldarr Kendrin Feldarr was a merchant during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Kendrin usually sold exotic animals all around the Sword Coast North .

title: Kenku
description: Kenku Kenkus were a race of flightless avian humanoid s . They tended to be selfish and secretive in nature and were often engaged in plots to acquire wealth and power . They operated in small gangs and often lived in large human cities , especially in southern Faerûn , where they worked as spies , assassins , or thieves .

title: Kenku ( winged )
description: Kenku ( winged ) Kenku were a race of winged avian humanoid s . Description . The kenku had a human - like frame , standing 5 – 7 feet ( 1 .

title: Kenniwick
description: Kenniwick Kenniwick was a merchant visiting the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . History . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Kenniwick visited the new Temple of Mystra and was among a group of people who partook in the three - day - long ritual of Mystra ' s Sacred Trust that the priests there were pushing , alongside eleven others : Durgen Glintstone , Kareem Hastith , Smote , Tholwick Styles , Dava , Mendios , Zephan , Veera Wavecrest , Halish , Duncan , and Amnic Basult .

title: Kensei
description: Kensei Kensei , sometimes called kensai , were fighter s trained in an ancient school of martial fighting that refined the skills of an individual warrior in their weapon of choice . These fighters , as a result , often became unrivaled amongst all other warriors as the master of their chosen weapon , whatever it may be . In Shou Lung , these fighters were called chujen ( " master " ) .

title: Kensidan
description: Kensidan Kensidan was the son of Rethnor , the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . History . Kensidan came to prominence in 1377 DR when Captain Deudermont tried to free Luskan from the rule of the High Captains and the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Keolan Dracohorn
description: Keolan Dracohorn Keolan Dracohorn was the founder of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr . History . He found a dead young blue dragon on the site that would become known as Soldier ' s Green , and claimed to have killed it , which was the origin of the family name .

title: Kepeshkmolik Ashoka
description: Kepeshkmolik Ashoka Kepeshkmolik Ashoka was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik . She was the last living daughter of Kepeshkmolik Thymara in 1486 DR . Description .

title: Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi
description: Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik and was a direct descendant of Shasphur . He was also the Chosen of Enlil . Description .

title: Kepeshkmolik Narghon
description: Kepeshkmolik Narghon Kepeshkmolik Narghon was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Kepeshkmolik in 1486 DR . He was the father of Kepeshkmolik Uadjit . Description .

title: Kepeshkmolik Tarhun
description: Kepeshkmolik Tarhun Kepeshkmolik Tarhun was a dragonborn warlord member of Clan Kepeshkmolik , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p301 " > < / ref > and the Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1479 DR , who maintained the dragonborn ' s hardline agenda of dragon hatred . Description . Tarhun was a hulking dragonborn , bulkier than any common dragonborn .

title: Kepeshkmolik Thymara
description: Kepeshkmolik Thymara Kepeshkmolik Thymara was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik , and a direct descendant of Shasphur . She was the founder of Djerad Thymar . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p291 - 294 " > < / ref > History .

title: Kepeshkmolik Uadjit
description: Kepeshkmolik Uadjit Kepeshkmolik Uadjit was a dragonborn member of Clan Kepeshkmolik who served as the ambassador of Tymanther . She was a direct descendant of Shasphur . and the mother of Kepeshkmolik Dumuzi .

title: Kerbin Dellmon
description: Kerbin Dellmon Kerbin Dellmon was the patriarch of the Dellmon family and a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Kerbin managed a great farm in the valley .

title: Keren Donnell
description: Keren Donnell Keren Donnell was the most famous bard in the Ffolk - inhabited Moonshae Isles . Possessions . Keren used a longbow as tall as a man made of black Callidyrr yew .

title: Kereska
description: Kereska Kereska ( pronounced " Kuh - RES - kah " ) was the chaotic neutral dragon goddess of magic , specifically dragon magic and magical creativity . Description . Kereska always manifested in the form of a dragon , although she was able to take on many draconic forms as she wanted to , and specific details about her natural form were unknown .

title: Kerim Najar
description: Kerim Najar Kerim Najar was a powerful dwarven sha ' ir who lived in the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Kerim was famous in the Court District for building his tower in a single night , an event that sparked many bets on exactly how many genie s were used to construct the tower so quickly .

title: Kerima al - Zahir
description: Kerima al - Zahir Kerima al - Zahir was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Personality . Kerima ' s short temper matched her passion for her torrid magical specialization , leading her to challenge many lesser wizard s to personal combat , usually to the death .

title: Kerinda Lynnrenno
description: Kerinda Lynnrenno Kerinda Lynnrenno was a member of the Shadow Council of Shadow Thieves and the Shade of Baldur ' s Gate around 1370 DR . History . Kerinda was a former sellsword before joining the Shadow Thieves , where she made a career until ascending to the Shadow Council .

title: Kern Desanea
description: Kern Desanea Kern Miltiades Desanea was born in 1352 DR and was named the Hammerseeker before his birth on the day the Hammer of Tyr was lost to the evil god Bane and his dark servant , the Hammerwarder . Abilities . Due to his mother Shal Bal casting many powerful spells while pregnant with Kern , Kern became " anti - magic " , meaning that most magic would have no effect on him unless he concentrated on having his anti - magic barrier lowered .

title: Keros
description: Keros Keros the Wanderer was an outcast triton hero . History . Born in 1354 DR , Keros joined the clergy of Persana .

title: Kerrenderit
description: Kerrenderit Kerrenderit were coin - sized ice crystals of exceeding sharpness that could be magically enhanced to form deadly arrowheads . Kerrenderit were nurtured by the arctic dwarves in caves carved into the Great Glacier and they took a long time to form . The word " Kerrenderit " came from the Kurit dialect of Dwarvish .

title: Kerrie
description: Kerrie A kerrie was a shaped club weighted for throwing , used primarily in Chult . Description . These throwing clubs were usually crafted out of a hard wood , such as iron wood .

title: Kerrigan
description: Kerrigan Kerrigan was a human Masked Lord of Waterdeep . He was the only Lord known to have betrayed Waterdeep . After murdering three other Lords in an attempt to gain sole power in the city , his betrayal was discovered by Open Lord Ahghairon , and a spell battle ensued .

title: Kerrilla Gemstar
description: Kerrilla Gemstar Kerrilla Gemstar was a female shield dwarf and a cleric of Marthammor Duin , the Finder - of - Trails , from Deadsnows in the Silver Marches . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Activities . Around 1370 DR , she was a member of the Council of 12 Peers , and the Observer of the Hospice of Marthammor .

title: Keryjek Wars
description: Keryjek Wars The Keryjek Wars were the only serious conflict to occur on the Great Glacier among the Ulutiun peoples . Location . Most of the fighting occurred in the vicinity of the Keryjek Ridge of mountains , which gave the fifty - year conflict its name .

title: Keryth Adofaer
description: Keryth Adofaer Keryth Adofaer was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Keryth was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Talor Vurtalis and Jhanra Merlistar .

title: Keryvian
description: Keryvian Keryvian ( also known as Foebane or Demron ' s Bane ) is a Baneblade of Demron and a mighty hand - and - a - half broadsword , or one - handed bastard sword . It was once carried by Fflar Starbrow Melruth . As of 1368 DR it was in the ruins of Myth Drannor , but Seiveril Miritar recovered it some time after this and it was residing at Seamist in northern Evermeet where it decorated a wall for a time , until Fflar was resurrected and took up the sword once more .

title: Keshna Finlothleer
description: Keshna Finlothleer Keshna Finlothleer was the Guildmaster of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Keshna was a small , driven woman .

title: Kesra Tanor ' Thal
description: Kesra Tanor ' Thal Kesra Tanor ' Thal was House Tanor ' Thal ' s representative in Skullport . Personality . Kesra was a free spirit ready to show her skill in arms and priest magic .

title: Kessessek
description: Kessessek Kessessek was a lizardfolk cleric of the forgotten god Essylliss who became the chieftain of the Sharptooth tribe in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr in 1374 DR . Abilities . Kessessek wielded the divine magic of a cleric , commanding the Animal and Scalykind domain s .

title: Kesson Rel
description: Kesson Rel Kesson Rel is a former Chosen of Mask . Given a sliver of divinity from his patron deity , he was driven insane , eventually driving him away from Mask and into the arms of Shar . Separated from that same spark of divinity by a group of priests serving Mask , who bound it into the shadow dragon Furlinastis and then hid it from him , Kesson spent millennia searching for it .

title: Kessynna
description: Kessynna Princess Kessynna was remembered in Tethyr ian history for how her five daughters were horribly murdered , serving as a common example for why the number five was cursed in Tethyr . History . Kessynna was one of the daughters of King Haedrak II , known as the " Corsair Prince " , of the Lions ' Dynasty .

title: Kesten Orthalin
description: Kesten Orthalin Kesten " Steelglance " Orthalin was a warrior and adventurer of the 13th century DR . He was the leader of the Grimblades adventuring company . History .

title: Kestin
description: Kestin Kestin was the best tailor in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Kestin ran Buttons , Boots , and Rags , a shop repairing and selling used clothing .

title: Kestor
description: Kestor Kestor was a half - elf merchant of Baldur ' s Gate and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Kestor was an able merchant in Baldur ' s Gate , and also a prominent member of the Merchant ' s League .

title: Kesymys
description: Kesymys Kesymys was a ghost in Cormanthor . Personality . The elven ghost was curious about the world in this new era .

title: Kethryllia Amarillis
description: Kethryllia Amarillis Kethryllia Amarillis also known as Flame - Flower was a moon elf who founded House Amarillis . Her body resides in the Hall of the Ancients in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . She lived long before the Crown Wars as the archmage of Sharlarion .

title: Ketjap
description: Ketjap Ketjap was an exotic food found in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Ketsarra Shadowscale
description: Ketsarra Shadowscale Ketsarra Shadowascale was a half - black dragon commander in the Lost Refuge in 1374 DR . History . Ketsarra was a lizardfolk half - dragon of black dragon descent and also a cleric of Shar , transformed in a shadowslain , a Shar kind of undead .

title: Kevin Olwynson
description: Kevin Olwynson Kevin Olwynson was the baron of the city of Dralpur in Ulgarth around 1367 DR , known as a crafty leader . He was a former ranger who once wandered the realm of Ulgarth , the Utter East , and the Dustwall Mountains , before he became baron . He secured the loyalty and skills of the 500 warriors who defended the town by paying them well with gold .

title: Kevrin
description: Kevrin Kevrin was a male Chondathan human sorcerer who dwelled at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Activities . Kevrin whiled away his days in his quarters , which he shared with Shan Thar , idly reading books on outdated magical theory and nursing strong liquor .

title: Key to Phantoms ' Cloister
description: Key to Phantoms ' Cloister The annual haunting of a ghost in the streets of Loudwater is interrupted by a groundling attack . Their burrowing reveals a previously undiscovered reliquary containing a tangible shard of pure light . Following clues , the party makes their way to the ruin of Phantom ' s Cloister where they find Zhentarim battling creatures under the control of a vicious quasit .

title: Keyfa al - Parid
description: Keyfa al - Parid Keyfa al - Parid was an elven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Keyfa was extremely honest and had a deep love of the sea .

title: Keymaking set
description: Keymaking set Keymaking sets were used by some rogue s to replicate keys . Uses . In lieu of picking a lock , a skillful thief could make an exact copy of a borrowed key after taking a wax imprint of the key .

title: Kezef
description: Kezef Kezef the Chaos Hound is a powerful primordial , feared by gods and mortals alike . He is a unique being who roams the Outer Planes constantly hunting the Faithful , which are the souls of those who have chosen to venerate one god above all others . He has no taste for the Faithless or the False and is sickened by the taste of the unripened spirits of the still - living .

title: Khadiga
description: Khadiga Khadiga was a human sha ' ir living on Al - Zabdiyat in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Khadiga and her giant sea snake pet , Shipwrecker , were the only known inhabitants of the entire island .

title: Khaerbaal
description: Khaerbaal Khaerbaal was a city located in Halruaa along the Great Sea . Description . Located on the southern coast of Halruaa , Khaerbaal was sheltered from pirates and rough ocean currents by the Bay of Taertal .

title: Khafaz ibn Dahz
description: Khafaz ibn Dahz Khafaz ibn Dahz was a trader and caravan master in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Khafaz had handsome features and appeared well groomed .

title: Khai Khmun
description: Khai Khmun Khai Khmun was a Red Wizard of Thay loyal to Araman . History . After Araman led a coup against Nefris , the headmistress of the Academy of Shapers and Binders , he sent his loyal mage Khai Khmun to kill Lienna and Safiya .

title: Khala
description: Khala The Khala were a race of human s said to have inhabited Imaskar in east Faerûn in ancient times . Legend . Brother Delf , a priest of Deneir from Verdusk , put to paper a tale concerning the Khala , apparently relating an ancient legend .

title: Khalab
description: Khalab Khalab was a small fishing village located in Murghôm . Location . Khalab sat on the western banks of Gbor Nor .

title: Khaless
description: Khaless Khaless was a game played by the drow of House Oblodra in Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1358 DR , the members of House Oblodra used this game to test courage .

title: Khalia
description: Khalia Khalia is a diplomat for the Red Wizards of Thay who posesses a calm , yet passionate demeanor . Extremely cautious in how she conducts her work , she visits foreign nations of behalf of the Red Wizards to further the expansion of their power base through the construction of their enclaves . Along with negotiating profits and establishing cordial relationsips , she is often used in the presentation of gifts to various heads of state .

title: Khalid
description: Khalid Khalid was a half - elf from Calimshan and a Harper . He was married to Jaheira , another half - elf and Harper . He was a friend of Gorion , and was investigating the iron crisis with his wife at the time of Gorion ' s death ( in 1368 DR ) .

title: Khalil
description: Khalil Khalil was a half - elf sha ' ir living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Khalil owned a ship that was in a poor state of repair .

title: Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir
description: Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir was the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , the City of Delights in 1367 DR , and the eighteenth of his line . Description . Khalil was still strong and lean into middle age thanks to his time spent adventuring .

title: Khalleshyr
description: Khalleshyr The Khalleshyr was one of the rivers of the Esmelflow in Amn . Geography . The Khalleshyr was a major tributary of the Amstel River .

title: Khamsin
description: Khamsin Khamsin was a potent magical poison sometimes used by Holy slayer assassin s of the Wind of Fate in Zakhara . Description . Khamsin smelled like honey .

title: Khamtar Raofal
description: Khamtar Raofal Khamtar Raofal was a ship captain from Caer Callidyrr and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the Moonshae Isles , Lantan and Ruathym in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Originally from Callidyrr , Khamtar was captain of the " Raven ' s Eye " , a ship that sailed the Sword Coast from Lantan to Luskan .

title: Khanduq
description: Khanduq A khanduq was a walled enclosure found within many Calishite towns and cities . It served as a central trade center for the marketplaces that sprung up around it . Khanduqs often included bars , inns , warehouses , guild halls , guard houses , moneychangers , or other such amenities .

title: Kharal
description: Kharal Kharal was a locathah of Tiger Coral tribe in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Kharal no spoke much but remained always calm .

title: Kharantes
description: Kharantes Kharantes was a yuan - ti half - fiend who usurped control of Oreme in 1375 DR . Personality . A child of the Abyss , Kharantes was the offspring of a female yuan - ti abomination and a male demon .

title: Khareesa H ' kar
description: Khareesa H ' kar Khareesa H ' kar was a drow elf slaver of House H ' kar in Menzoberranzan . Description . The drow female was very beautiful with fine facial features , shapely legs , and thick white hair .

title: Kharran Fel
description: Kharran Fel Kharran Fel was a large muscly human fighter . He was the child of druids from the Forgotten Forest and although he loved the wilderness , he lacked the inclination to learn to become either a ranger or a druid . He did , however , pick up some healing and herbalism skills and also the tracking abilities of a ranger .

title: Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin
description: Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin Kharza - kzad Xorlarrin was a drow and a master of Sorcere before he turned himself into a lich . Description . In life , Kharza - kzad was described as thin with protruding eyes .

title: Khaspere Drylund
description: Khaspere Drylund Khaspere Drylund was a noble in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Khaspere was the proprietor of the " Golden Goose " , a riverboat housing a gambling hall .

title: Khass
description: Khass Khass was a male deity worshiped by barbarian s of the Eastern Shaar . Description . The deity was a cloud god with multiple limbs and palm trees were said to be his fingers .

title: Khassidi
description: Khassidi The Khassidi were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Khassidi lived in the northwestern regions of the Endless Waste .

title: Khassidi language
description: Khassidi language Khassidi was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the western Hordelands . Description . Khassidi , like other languages in the same region , had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds .

title: Khault
description: Khault Lord Khault was the leader of The Choir , a cult in Tohrepur that worshipped a spellplague changed Sirine . Prior to 1473 DR , Khault was a farmer in the village of Caidris in Akanûl . When the mercenaries fighting for the Keepers of the Cerulean Sign made a stand against the Abolethic Sovereignty in his village , he allowed a group of soldiers led by the mercenary Uthalion to take shelter in his home .

title: Khayar Ironfist
description: Khayar Ironfist Khayar Ironfist was a member of Ironfist clan on the Sword Coast North in the 1374 DR . History . Khayar was an older dwarf , who went to explore the Ironfist stronghold .

title: Khazari
description: Khazari Khazari was a country in the Hordelands . Environment . Khazari was a small mountain valley nation , formed by the encircling arms of the Katakoro Shan .

title: Khazari language
description: Khazari language Khazari was the language spoken by the people of Khazari in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , being related to the Kao te Shou and Ra - Khati language s . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages .

title: Khazid ' hea
description: Khazid ' hea Khazid ' hea was a sentient and magical sword . " Khazid ' hea " meant " Cutter " in the Drow language , and it was often referred to as such . Description .

title: Khelben ' s warding whip
description: Khelben ' s warding whip Khelben ' s warding whip was an arcane abjuration spell that directly countered movable magical force spells , particularly the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells . Effects . The spell created a whip of magical force that had a range of 10 yd ( 9 .

title: Khelben Arunsun
description: Khelben Arunsun Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun ( 414 DR – 1374 DR , aged 960 years , although rumors are he may still be alive being a Chosen of Mystra ) was the Lord Mage of Waterdeep , a masked Lord of Waterdeep , and powerful archmage . He resided in Blackstaff Tower until his death . One of the few spellcasters to become one of Mystra ' s Chosen , and the last survivor of House Maerdrym , Khelben was a serious , imposing wizard , and a grim proponent of law and order whose methods of achieving the ultimate good were often highly questionable in the eyes of the righteous .

title: Khelben Arunsun the Younger
description: Khelben Arunsun the Younger Khelben Arunsun the Younger is a human born to Zelphar Arunsun and Lhestyn in Waterdeep in 1302 DR . Although most people know him as the " Blackstaff , " he actually left Faerûn to travel the planes , and was replaced by his grandfather , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun the Elder .

title: Kheldell
description: Kheldell Kheldell was a thorp on the northern brim of the Westwood in the foothills of the Sword Coast Spires . The only way into the village was on trail to Red Larch . The village itself was a small cluster of log homes .

title: Kheldrivver
description: Kheldrivver Kheldrivver was small hamlet at the southeastern edge of the Troll Hills . History . Founded as monastic community worshiping Oghma , the village was destroyed several times until abandoned around 1166 DR .

title: Khelessa Draga
description: Khelessa Draga Khelessa Draga was a spy of the Lords ' Alliance in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . Khelessa was a high elf from Silverymoon .

title: Khelgar Ironfist
description: Khelgar Ironfist Khelgar Ironfist was a dwarven fighter of Clan Ironfist who teamed up with the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War and who afterwards took up temporary stewardship of Crossroad Keep . Description . Standing just under five feet tall , Khelgar Ironfist was immediately identifiable by his manners or , quite often , lack thereof .

title: Khemal Serist
description: Khemal Serist Khemal Serist was a member of the Cult of the Shattered Peak . Personality . Khemal preferred distracting seekers of Netherese lore rather than killing them outright .

title: Khirad
description: Khirad Khirad was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Khirad didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description .

title: Khnarek
description: Khnarek Khnarek was a senior member of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1370 DR . Personality . The doppelganger was a reluctant ally of Hlaavin , often acting autonomously , such as when it forged an alliance with Priamon Rakesk of the Twisted Rune .

title: Khochen
description: Khochen Khochen was a young Tuigan Harper thief agent . Activities . Khochen posed as an itinerant merchant .

title: Kholzourl
description: Kholzourl Fire - Speaker Kholzourl was the leader of a group of duergar followers of Asmodeus who mined hellthorn in the depths of Gauntlgrym " circa " 1480 DR . He was an unholy warrior of Asmodeus who interpreted the signs and omens sent by the god of Nine Hells . Only Kholzourl knew the reason why his god ordered his mission .

title: Khondar Naomal
description: Khondar Naomal Khondar " Ten Rings " Naomal was a human wizard and the guildmaster of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Waterdeep . His nickname referred to the ten rings he wore at all times , only two of which were magical at any given time . Description .

title: Khopesh
description: Khopesh A khopesh was a one - handed slashing weapon wielded like a sword or an axe . Physical description . The khopesh typically had a handle like a knife rather than a hilt like a sword .

title: Khopet - Dag
description: Khopet - Dag The Khopet - Dag , also known as the Spiderhaunt Peaks , was a mountain range located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located north of the Shalhoond sat the Khopet - Dag mountain range , most famous for its large number of giant spider s , which gave it its nickname " Spiderhaunt Peaks " .

title: Khorl Krissellian
description: Khorl Krissellian Khorl Krissellian was a sun elf sorcerer and farseer , and a member of the College of Divination in the city of Sshamath in the year 1377 DR . History . Khorl was four centuries old by the late 14th century DR , and had lived for a long time in the Underdark .

title: Khoroshen
description: Khoroshen The Khoroshen was a tribe of lizardfolk who inhabited the low marshes of the Evermoors . In 1372 DR , First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin of the city of Nesmé recruited the tribe to help defend the city against troll and giant attacks . The tribe was led by Uhndek , and most only spoke Draconic .

title: Khorrl Xornbane
description: Khorrl Xornbane Khorrl Xornbane was a duergar who was the head of Clan Xornbane , a mercenary band in the Northdark . Description . Khorrl was bald and wielded an orc double axe .

title: Khouryn Skulldark
description: Khouryn Skulldark Khouryn Skulldark is a dwarven fighter and an officer in the Brotherhood of the Griffon mercenary company . Khouryn fought in the Brotherhood ' s war against Szass Tam ' s forces in Thay and participated in the Brotherhood ' s foray into Impiltur . He travelled with the Brotherhood to Chessenta when they were hired by a noble to investigate a series of supernatural murders in Luthcheq .

title: Khrulis
description: Khrulis Khrulis was the ruler of Airspur in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Khrulis led his half - orc fellows in a revolt against the previous theocracy of the priests of Bhaelros and became the leader of the military council that thereafter ruled the city .

title: Khulmar Ironfist
description: Khulmar Ironfist Khulmar Ironfist was a male dwarf and a member of Ironfist Clan on the Sword Coast North in the 1374 DR . History . Khulmar was a scout of the Ironfist Clan .

title: Khumarr
description: Khumarr Khumarr was a male drow blackguard and divine champion of Kiaransalee who served as an important lieutenant of Irae T ' sarran in Castle Maerimydra . Description . A tall male drow , he was rather handsome and seemed to wear a constant smile on his face .

title: Khuralosothantar
description: Khuralosothantar Khuralosothantar , or in short Khuralos , was a bronze dragon in Seros . History . Born in 612 DR Khuralos laired within the slopes of Mount Halaath .

title: Khuur
description: Khuur Khuur was a merrow kingdom of Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Alongside Nmalk , it was one of the two Axe Kingdoms that represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History .

title: Khuur ( instrument )
description: Khuur ( instrument ) The khuur was a stringed musical instrument used by the nomads of the vast steppes of the Hordelands . Description . A typical " khuur " was made from wood with horsehide stretched tightly over the front .

title: Khwaja
description: Khwaja Khwaja , called the Mad , was a demented dwarven beggar living on the streets of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he appeared to be nothing more than a pathetic beggar , Khwaja was actually one of the most useful informants for Sa ' id Firdawsi , the spymaster for Prince Tannous al - Assad .

title: Khwaja al - Danaf
description: Khwaja al - Danaf Khwaja al - Danaf was the head of the House of Al - Danafi merchant family in Huzuz in 1367 DR , though he was more of a figurehead because his wife , Perijan was the real reason for their success . Description . Khwaja was a middle - aged man who dressed in fine cloth often sewn with pearls .

title: Ki
description: Ki Ki was the Untheric goddess of nature . Her manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . Her symbol was the .

title: Ki - rin
description: Ki - rin Ki - rins were noble creatures native to the celestial planes who either worked for good - aligned deities in direct opposition to the forces of evil or served as protectors of large areas of the mortal world . They were regarded as harbingers of good fortune , and days when a ki - rin was sighted were considered blessed . Description .

title: Ki Bohr
description: Ki Bohr Ki Bohr was the head priest of Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ki Bohr took care of the shrine to the Path of Enlightenment in the town of Tai Ko .

title: Ki Hiar
description: Ki Hiar Ki Hiar was a queen of the kingdom of Saishu in the land of Choson ( later known as Koryo ) before the mid – 14th century DR . Queen Ki Hiar was once affected by a love potion from the Quang Muku Forest and fell in love with a pirate from Wa .

title: Ki Mor Sha
description: Ki Mor Sha Ki Mor Sha was a shou mayor in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ki Mor Sha was mayor of Tai He town and governor Ko Lei Kho ' s brother - in - law .

title: Kiaransalee
description: Kiaransalee Kiaransalee ( " kee " - uh - " ran " - sa - lee ) was a drow lesser deity , also known as the Lady of the Dead , The Revenancer or The Vengeful Banshee . Her portfolio included vengeance and the undead . Kiaransalee was a cruel , twisted and vengeful deity .

title: Kidera Takeshi
description: Kidera Takeshi Kidera Takeshi was the head of the Kidera clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Takeshi really want lived according to the “ old ways .

title: Kidera Ujisato
description: Kidera Ujisato Kidera Ujisato was the commander of the sohei of the Winter Sect in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Ujisato always tried to maintain the neutrality of the temple in the conflicts between the city ' s clans .

title: Kier Thunsonn
description: Kier Thunsonn Kier Thunsonn was a male dwarf who lived in Eartheart near the East Rift . He was Torrin Ironstar ' s adopted nephew and was very close to Torrin . History .

title: Kieren
description: Kieren Kieren was a Chosen in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Kieren was one of the many Chosen captured by the Red Wizards of Thay and transported to the Doomvault dungeon for experiments .

title: Kierkan Rufo
description: Kierkan Rufo Kierkan Rufo was originally a cleric at the Edificant Library , a colleague and rival of Cadderly Bonaduce . Outward Appearance . Rufo is 6 ft tall , bone - skinny and always standing at an angle tilting to the side .

title: Kierstaad
description: Kierstaad Kierstaad , or Kierstaad the Swift , was a barbarian king of the Tribe of the Elk in Icewind Dale . Personality . Like his father , Kierstaad had a secret desire to experience " civilized life " in the cities of the Sword Coast .

title: Kiira
description: Kiira Lore gems ( " Kiira " ) were elven magic items that could only be worn by elves . They were semi - intelligent and acted as repositories of knowledge gathered by its wearer . This knowledge could be accessed by future wearers of the gem .

title: Kiirma Blackmane
description: Kiirma Blackmane Kiirma Blackmane was the cloakmaster of Riatavin for the Shadow Thieves . She was also a senior agent of the Moonstars ( Tel ' Teukiira ) in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Description .

title: Kila Odani
description: Kila Odani Kila Odani was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Kila was in charge of the spice warehouse of the House of Al - Farif within the Warehouse District of Huzuz .

title: Kili bint Farud
description: Kili bint Farud Kili bint Farud was a dao who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Kili was an enslaved genie who worked on the docks of the Trade Harbor .

title: Kilij
description: Kilij Kilij was a male halfling holy slayer who lived on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Kilij was a member of the Gilded Palm .

title: Kilili
description: Kilili Kilili was a female drow magic - user . She was in fact the embodiment of a dark spirit extracted from the body of Cybriana , and was her dark , other self . She plotted with the extraplanar monster Imgig Zu to release his people from the " Selûne ' s Eye " gem to overrun and conquer the Realms .

title: Killian Kreel
description: Killian Kreel Killian Kreel was the self - exiled son of the Nanther family within Melvaunt and cleric of Loviatar . Description . Killian ' s face and body was covered in self - inflicted scars , a practice that began long before his induction into the church .

title: Killoren
description: Killoren Killoren were a relatively new and uncommon race of fey . It was unknown whether they were created by a deity or were spontaneously created by nature itself . Society .

title: Kilmaruu Swamp
description: Kilmaruu Swamp The Kilmaruu Swamp was a stretch of swamp and marshland located in southeast Halruaa . Description . The swamp was the site of a ruined city .

title: Kiltzi
description: Kiltzi Kiltzi was the Maztica n goddess of love , both romantic and lustfull , and fertility . Kiltzi did not require material sacrifices , rather the act of love between a man and woman was considered a form of devotion to the goddess . Appearance .

title: Kim - un - guru
description: Kim - un - guru Kim - un - guru was a korobokuru wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Kim - un - guru took care of the Korobokuru Shrine , dedicated to Raven the spirit god .

title: Kim Mohan
description: Kim Mohan Kim Mohan is an author , editor , and game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . He was a long - time editor of " Dragon " magazine .

title: Kimmuriel Oblodra
description: Kimmuriel Oblodra Kimmuriel Oblodra was a powerful psionicist of Menzoberranzan and one of the few survivors of the destruction House Oblodra . A He often served as the de facto leader of Bregan D ' aerthe while Jarlaxle romped around the surface world . Description .

title: Kin Elbhaz
description: Kin Elbhaz Kin Elbhaz is a pueblo settlement of 500 in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . It always receives above average yields from its crops and rarely suffers from diseases or pestilence because nearby brownie s ensure it , in exchange for unlimited grain from the pueblo ' s store , via a secret passage . There are rumours that the villagers have made a pact with evil forces in order to ensure their own prosperity .

title: King ' s Forest
description: King ' s Forest The King ' s Forest was located in western Cormyr . It was once home to elves , as the westernmost fragment of Cormanthor , but they abandoned the forest to humankind . The King ' s Forest was so named because it was the property of the crown .

title: King ' s Reach
description: King ' s Reach King ' s Reach , also called the High Reach , was a town in the Vast , lying by the River Vesper on North Road between Swords Pool and Three Trees Pass , at the intersection with the Long Reach trail from Sendrin . History . There were various explanations for the name of King ' s Reach , but sages agreed that the oldest and most likely story was that this was the spot where Deep King Tuir Stonebeard of Roldilar declared that human s would reach this far and no further into dwarven lands .

title: King ' s Tower
description: King ' s Tower The King ' s Tower was a smooth - sided fortified construction on the west side of Marsember . Structure . The building ' s cobbled terrace was the largest open public space in the city .

title: King - Killer Star
description: King - Killer Star The King - Killer Star was a reddish cometary body , visible from Toril , once linked to the Dracorage mythal . Its periodic appearance in the skies of Abeir - Toril caused dragon s to go mad with rage , destroying and killing without reason . History .

title: King Oreme
description: King Oreme King Oreme was the name given to the ruling sarrukh lich of Oreme . Organization . Sixty sarrukh liches rotated as the leader of the city .

title: King of Doegan
description: King of Doegan The king of the realm of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) saw his kingdom fall . History . Doegan was overrun by invaders led by Rathgar the Raider , who plundered the realm and laid siege to the capital .

title: King of Justice
description: King of Justice His ( or Her ) Resplendence , the King of Justice ( or the Queen of Justice ) was a title used by the ruler of gold dragon society . The title was created because the gold dragons , the most lawful of the dragon species , felt the necessity to create the most orderly of societies . The King of Justice was usually the oldest and most powerful gold dragon of a given region .

title: King of Shadows
description: King of Shadows The King of Shadows ( originally known only as the Guardian ) was a dark creature who was both born of the Illefarn empire , as well as the reason for its destruction . History . Not much is known about the King ' s early days , save that he was a talented human magic user who was trained for twenty years by the elf Master Isym in the arcane arts .

title: Kingdom of Nix
description: Kingdom of Nix The Kingdom of Nix was a goblin realm lying in the western Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . Geography . The Kingdom of Nix lay upon the high Forbidden Plateau , beside a glacier in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal .

title: Kings ' tears
description: Kings ' tears Kings ' tears ( also seen as king ' s tears ) were extremely rare jewels unique to the Realms . They were sometimes called frozen tears or lich weepings . Description .

title: Kinterly
description: Kinterly Kinterly ran a magic shop in Zhentil Keep in 1357 DR . Activities . Kinterly ran Kinterly ' s Magics , one of the few recognized magic shops in the Realms .

title: Kinyel Druu ' giir
description: Kinyel Druu ' giir Kinyel Druu ' giir was a drow assassin in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Kinyel was an assassin of House Druu ' giir in Menzoberranzan but she was exiled to Mantol - Derith after failing to kill a house rival There , during the Rage of Demons , she became smitten with a gargoyle who had given her a madness - causing gem created by the demon lord Fraz - Urb ' luu Affected by the madness , Kinyel decided she must kill the Zhentarim beholder Lorthuun .

title: Kipp
description: Kipp Kipp is a non - player character and companion in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . Background . Not much is known about him , except that he is reported to sometimes steal things and throw acorns at militiamen on drill ( Bevil Starling in particular ) .

title: Kipper Harpell
description: Kipper Harpell Kipper Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their oldest member in the late 15th century , and he was known to be well versed in transportation magic . History . In 1479 DR , Kipper was the oldest sage of the clan .

title: Kiputytto
description: Kiputytto Kiputytto was a demigoddess of disease slain by Talona . In - 33 DR Kiputytto attacked Talona , a deity who shared a portfolio with hers . Their chosen battleground was city of Asram , one of the four remaining cities of Netheril .

title: Kir - lanan
description: Kir - lanan Kir - lanan were gargoyle - like creatures that appeared on Faerûn during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Ecology . Physical Characteristics .

title: Kira
description: Kira Kira was an elven wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Kira was the great - granddaughter of Elorfindar Floshin and had both sun elf and wood elf blood in her veins .

title: Kirenkirsalai
description: Kirenkirsalai Kirenkirsalai , also known as Kire , was a vampire lord who lived in an abandoned temple of Garagos in Westgate . History . He was obsessed with the young mage Myrin Darkdance and was the person behind the bounty for her capture in Luskan .

title: Kiril Duskmourn
description: Kiril Duskmourn Kiril Duskmourn was a star elf warrior and a Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . Personality . The star elf was known for her foul mouth , purposeful baiting of others , and derision .

title: Kirioshi
description: Kirioshi Kirioshi was a Shoya in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kirioshi was shoya of a quarter of a unnamed city of Kozakura .

title: Kiros
description: Kiros Kiros was the leader of the centaur s in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Kiros was a kind of sage about history , warfare , and nature .

title: Kirsoph Vinson
description: Kirsoph Vinson Kirsoph Vinson was the first Dahaunarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1333 DR to 1342 DR , and the Lord of House Vinson from 1299 DR . Always impatient , in 1342 DR , Kirsoph ordered his agent to kill the Pommarch in order to rise through the ranks but the Pommarch bribed Kirsoph ' s agents to betray and kill their master . He was known as the " Kobold Lord " for his stinginess .

title: Kiser Jhaeri
description: Kiser Jhaeri Kiser Jhaeri was an infamous thief and assassin in Saradush . History . During The Five ' s siege of Saradush , Kiser was ready to open the gates to the enemy .

title: Kisha Yunoko
description: Kisha Yunoko Kisha Yunoko was the concubine of the emperor of Wa around 1357 DR . History . Yunoko was the adopted daughter of daimyo Matasuuri Ieysuna and granddaughter of the shogun .

title: Kishimoto Endai
description: Kishimoto Endai Kishimoto Endai was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Kan - oji in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Kan - oji , he led a company of three samurai and ten bushi .

title: Kishiria
description: Kishiria Kishiria was a human warrior who worked for the Red Wizards of Thay in the southern part of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Description . She had sharp facial features dotted with freckles , and curly , orange hair , cropped short .

title: Kishkoman
description: Kishkoman A kishkoman , or whistle - knife was a unique weapon found in the Cold Lands . Description . A " kishkoman " looked like a small animal horn only slightly longer than a child ' s hand .

title: Kisonraathiisar
description: Kisonraathiisar Kisonraathiisar was a topaz dragon and the first king of Westgate . He founded Westgate in an effort to build a kingdom that would survive the effects of the King - Killer Star . History .

title: Kissikit ' a
description: Kissikit ' a Kissikit ' a was a thri - kreen of the Krakk ' t tribe dwelling in the Rushing Hills on the Shining Plains . In Tarsakh in 1370 DR , Kissikit ' a was the representative of the Krakk ' t to the annual meeting with representatives of the human cities of Assam , Lheshayl , and Ormath ; the Emerald Enclave ; and the centaur and wemic tribes of the Shining Plains , held on the Hill of Memories . There were reportedly tense moments between Kissikit ' a and the ruler of Lheshayl , Entawanata , but they and the other rulers mostly discussed trade routes , local monsters , and so on .

title: Kit
description: Kit A character kit or simply kit was an optional additional layer in character creation used in 2nd edition , allowing for a variety of subtypes within the usual character classes . Each kit provided a specific role and a set of requirements , limitations and benefits to give a character its own twist . Usually , these kits where specific to a character class .

title: Kitashi
description: Kitashi Kitashi was a yakuza in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kitashi was a yakuza spy in a town in Kozakura , where resided Ko Mei Kho .

title: Kittenlord
description: Kittenlord The " kittenlord " , also called the " cat child " , was a werecat boy and the heir to the role of catlord in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Sensing his end was near and great change coming to the Realms , the existing Catlord decided to choose an heir , a young werecat boy who would someday become a new catlord .

title: Kixa To ' u
description: Kixa To ' u Kixa To ' u was a great wu jen who lived in Koryo several centuries before 1357 DR . Kixa To ' u fashioned a magical staff of eldritch power , the " Ky Trencha Ukang " . But he came to fear what he had wrought and split the staff apart , transforming it into five magical scroll reels .

title: Kixitiloc
description: Kixitiloc Kixitiloc was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Kixitiloc lived in a small Payit village that was destroyed during a battle against another village .

title: Kiyosu Kuroda
description: Kiyosu Kuroda Kiyosu Kuroda was a samurai retainer of Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Kuroda was sent to lead a patrol of bushi near Ito - Jo in order to stop an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to took the Seven Swords to Uemon .

title: Kizzlok
description: Kizzlok Kizzlok was a Maztican drow . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History .

title: Klaire Gatewood
description: Klaire Gatewood Klaire Gatewood was a famed artist of Cormyr . A book of sketches by Klaire Gatewood was in the possession of Lady of Mystery Naedaenya Arthas at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . It was worth 200 gp to the right buyer .

title: Klarz
description: Klarz Klarz was a hobgoblin sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Klarz was the captain of the " Koalith " .

title: Klauth
description: Klauth Klauth , also known as Old Snarl , was supposedly one of the eldest dragons alive who had not been turned into a dracolich . Personality . He was thoroughly evil , especially to his own kind , though he did have a few redeeming factors such as granting boons to creatures he considered no threat , crushing the odd orc horde on a whim and the fact that he has avoided the advances of the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Klavikus
description: Klavikus Klavikus was a glabrezu in service of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR . History . Klavikus was a powerful and ambitious demon at the court of demon lord Orcus .

title: Kleve
description: Kleve Kleve was a slaad in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Kleve acted as the loyal bodyguard of archmage Vizeran DeVir , thanks to a control gem the drow possessed .

title: Klibdoloogut
description: Klibdoloogut Klibdoloogut was a kuo - toa whip cultist living in Sloobludop until the Rage of Demons . History . Klibdoloogut was a whip and , during the Rage of Demons , quickly become one of the first followers of the new god Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father , ( in truth , demon lord Demogorgon .

title: Kllug
description: Kllug Kllug was a goblin shaman in the late 15th century . History . In 1484 DR , during a new assault by orc and drow on the Silver Marches , Kllug and his fellow orc shaman Innanig led troops to an assault of Nesmè .

title: Klonalogh Umesker
description: Klonalogh Umesker Klonalogh Umesker was an inhabitant of the town of Mossbridges in the Vast around 1370 DR . Klonalogh was the foreman of a corps of engineers and stonemasons paid by the civic authorities of both Ravens Bluff and Tantras to maintain the massive multi - span bridge over the Fire River in Mossbridges . They could never be persuaded to risk or sabotage the bridge .

title: Klurichir
description: Klurichir A klurichir is a variant of guardian tanar ' ri , one of the most powerful and respected demons of the Abyss . It is said that even a mighty balor will give a klurichir a wide berth . They often serve and act as a right hand to a demon lord , usually as generals just as balor are .

title: Knarr
description: Knarr A knarr was a small ship used mainly in the North for transporting cargo . Description . A typical knarr was 60 ft ( 18 m ) long at the keel and 15 ft ( 4 .

title: Knee - Cracker
description: Knee - Cracker Knee - Cracker was a cider crafted in Faerûn . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Kneebreakers
description: Kneebreakers The Kneebreakers were a vigilante organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Kneebreakers were a group of young halfling s riding war - pigs in search of a thrill in their peaceful existence .

title: Knellict
description: Knellict Knellict the archmage of the Citadel of Assassins . History . Knellict is of great , but unknown age , generally assumed to be in his second or third century .

title: Knesha
description: Knesha Knesha was a bard in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Knesha was the greatest non - divine expert in lost relics and artifact s in south Mulhorand .

title: Knight
description: Knight A knight was an armored , mounted warrior serving a lord in feudal societies . In the Realms , the term could also refer to , among other things : It could also refer to a specific type of character in various editions of the Dungeons & Dragons rules :

title: Knight ' s Detente
description: Knight ' s Detente The Knight ' s Detente was a boisterous festhall with rooms for rent in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . It was a place for soldiers to carouse , flirt , gamble , laugh , and spend their pay on poor quality but overpriced food and drink . Non - military were not welcome , although it was said that a person could gain entrance if they could last more than five seconds arm - wrestling the burly half - orc bouncer , Xom .

title: Knight ' s move
description: Knight ' s move Knight ' s move was a divine transmutation or alteration spell similar to " blink " that teleported the caster diagonally for a surprise attack or a surprise escape , making it a favorite of Red Knight ist cleric s . Effects . When cast , this spell caused the caster to instantaneously transit the Astral Plane and reappear a short distance away , in the manner of a knight - errant chess move — in a spot two - thirds the total distance in one direction and the remaining third in a perpendicular direction .

title: Knight commander
description: Knight commander A knight commander is a specific variety of warlord that has learned to command by example and forceful authority and who specialize in the use of heavy armor . Like battle captain s , knight commanders tend to lead from the front , protected by their cuirass and shield . Many knight commanders are , as the name implies , sworn to honor and chivalry , though they are not required to be knight s .

title: Knight of Iron
description: Knight of Iron The Knight of Iron advances in his , Gaerdal Ironhand ' s , service through prayer , fasting , and meditation . When a knight commits a serious transgression , he ( or she ) must seek out the nearest higher - level Knight of Iron , and atone with a quest of that knight ' s ( and Gaerdal ' s ) choice . Gaerdal ' s knights are expected to defend their people against any threat , even at cost of their lives .

title: Knight of the Blue Moon
description: Knight of the Blue Moon The Knight of the Blue Moon is a special prestige class of Waterdeep . Knights of the Blue Moon draw upon the influence that the moon has over the Weave , their offensive and defensive skills changing in response to the waxing and waning of Selûne . The Knights of the Blue Moon call upon both arcane and divine magic .

title: Knight of the Flying Hunt
description: Knight of the Flying Hunt Knight of the Flying Hunt is a prestige class of Faerûn whose members act as the defenders of Nimbral . While protecting Nimbral , these noble soldiers answer to the mysterious Nimbral Lords . They dedicate themselves to the inhabitants of Nimbral while enforcing the lands local laws .

title: Knight of the Weave
description: Knight of the Weave The Knight of the Weave is a prestige class of Faerûn . Whereas most individuals worship Mystra , Azuth , or Savras , Knights of the Weave worship the Weave itself , believing it to serve every living creature and give life a depth and experience that it would lack otherwise . Knights of the Weave believe themselves to be the protectors of the Weave and therefor go to great lengths to defend the Weave against any who would wish to abuse or destroy what the Knights of the Weave believe to be a gift to be used equally by all .

title: Knights in Silver
description: Knights in Silver The Knights in Silver were the army of Silverymoon and it was their duty to patrol and defend the city against orc s and other dangers . History . The Knights in Silver were led by Besnell of Silverymoon , an elven fighter up until his death in the war between Mithral Hall and Menzoberranzan .

title: Knights of Holy Judgment
description: Knights of Holy Judgment The Knights of Holy Judgment were an order of paladin s that faithfully focused on the lawful tenets of their patron deity Tyr . The Knights were very close to the Knights of the Merciful Sword , both of whose members were the only faithful of Tyr who were eligible to join the ranks of the Hammers of Grimjaws .

title: Knights of Ilmater
description: Knights of Ilmater The Knights of Ilmater were a knightly order of paladin s devoted to Ilmater , the Broken God Description . The order comprised fifty paladins who fought together under a red - and - grey banner bearing a holy symbol of Ilmater .
