An ultra - heavy cavalry unit , they were an incredibly dangerous force on the battlefield .

title: Knights of Myth Drannor
description: Knights of Myth Drannor The Knights of Myth Drannor adventuring company came to prominence as the rulers of Shadowdale with their successful defiance of Zhentil Keep . They were also instrumental in the defeat of Lashan of Scardale . History .

title: Knights of Samular
description: Knights of Samular The Knights of Samular are an order of paladins in the service of Tyr who tend to focus on the supremacy of law . They are a well respected order in the Northlands with their base of operations in the Summit Hall while also maintaining a base in Waterdeep . History .

title: Knights of the Black Gauntlet
description: Knights of the Black Gauntlet The Knights of the Black Gauntlet were a group of over 7000 banite crusaders who kept their faith , even after Bane ' s death at the hands of Torm during the Time of Troubles . The Knights were led by Teldorn Darkhope , a mad priest of Bane who led the group of warriors and helmed horror s . Followers of Iachtu Xvim were also accepted within the ranks .

title: Knights of the Bleeding Shield
description: Knights of the Bleeding Shield The Knights of the Bleeding Shield were a knightly order devoted to the Ilmater , the Broken God , and affiliated with the Church of Ilmater . History . Around 1265 DR , Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced the Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith , and declared them degenerate , mentally ill heretics .

title: Knights of the Merciful Sword
description: Knights of the Merciful Sword The Knights of the Merciful Sword were an order of paladin s that faithfully focused on the " good " tenets of their patron deity Tyr . The Knights were very close to the Knights of Holy Judgment , both of whose members were the only faithful of Tyr who were eligible to join the ranks of the Hammers of Grimjaws .

title: Knights of the Mystic Fire
description: Knights of the Mystic Fire The Knights of the Mystic Fire was an order of paladin s dedicated to Mystra , goddess of magic . A member of the order was known as a Mystic Fire Knight . Organization .

title: Knights of the North
description: Knights of the North The Knights of the North are a semi - secret group of adventurers and soldiers from the Moonsea who are dedicated to the destruction of the Zhentarim . Through various hit - and - run tactics and relative secrecy of their identities , the Knights disrupt Zhent trade and attempts to foil their plots and machinations at every turn . History .

title: Knights of the Shield
description: Knights of the Shield The Knights of the Shield are expert wielders and manipulators of information who pose as a group of merchants and nobles interested in mercantile activities . Though they are based primarily in Baldur ' s Gate , Amn and Tethyr , the realm of influence of the Knights reach from Calimshan to Waterdeep , though they have little influence in the latter anymore thanks to a failed coup against the Lords of Waterdeep . The Knights of the Shield were a secret society , said to have worked for the archdevil - turned - deity , Gargauth .

title: Knights of the Unicorn
description: Knights of the Unicorn The Knights of the Unicorn was both a mercenary company and an adventuring party around 1358 DR . History . The Knights originated as an adventuring party in the Sword Coast .

title: Knock
description: Knock Knock was a transmutation spell that could open locked , barred , or stuck doors with only the spoken word . Cleric s who had access to the greed domain could also cast this spell as a divine power . " Knock " was one of the spells granted to the wearer of the commander ' s ring s worn by the leaders of the War Wizards of Cormyr .

title: Know bloodline
description: Know bloodline Know bloodline is a divination spell available to cleric s . By casting this spell a cleric was able to determine the ancestry and racial type of the target . History .

title: Know customs
description: Know customs Know customs was a divination spell that allowed the caster to acquire knowledge about local laws and customs from a local resident . Effects . The caster had to be within 30 yd ( 27 m ) of a person who had the knowledge being sought .

title: Know direction
description: Know direction Know direction was a divination spell that allowed the caster to immediately know which direction was north . Effects . This spell worked in any environment ( underground , underwater , in " darkness " , etc .

title: Know school
description: Know school Know School was a divination spell known to the magic - using community in Faerûn . Effects . By means of this spell , a curious mage could find out the school another wizard specialized in , if any .

title: Knower of Names
description: Knower of Names The Knower of Names , has knowledge of all . After seducing her , Mephistopheles used her to expose the treacherous nature of the devil generals who served him . He then bound each of them beneath the ice of Cania and imprisoned the Knower to protect himself from the power of his true name .

title: Knowledge domain
description: Knowledge domain The Knowledge domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the field of knowledge . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . Knowledge Domain Spells .

title: Knox
description: Knox Sergeant Knox was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR , serving as officer in the army of Lord Dagult Neverember . He together with warlock Makos and a female cleric defeated a dracolich near Neverwinter . He was one of the first to meet a new adventurer arriving in the city .

title: Ko Dun Kin
description: Ko Dun Kin Ko Dun Kin was a Shou merchant in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . Ko Dun Kin was a merchant , representative of the mercantile Ko clan in the town of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung .

title: Ko Ho San
description: Ko Ho San Ko Ho San was a powerful Wu jen in 1358 DR . History . Ko Ho San was a member of mercantile Ko clan and a powerful wu jen .

title: Ko La Ko
description: Ko La Ko Ko La Ko was a promising Wu jen in 1358 DR . History . Ko La Ko was a young member of mercantile Ko clan ; sensing his talent his grandfather the great wu jen Ko Ho San took him as apprentice .

title: Ko Lei Kho
description: Ko Lei Kho Ko Lei Kho was the shou governor of Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ko Lei Kho was a member of mercantile Ko clan that led the first colony in Akari .

title: Ko Mei Kho
description: Ko Mei Kho Ko Mei Kho was a shou merchant in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ko Mei Kho was a merchant , rappresentative of mercantile Ko clan in a town of Kozakura .

title: Ko Mihn Gi
description: Ko Mihn Gi Ko Mihn Gi was a Shou mayor in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Ko Mihn Gi was a member of the mercantile Ko clan , the younger brother of Ko Lei Kho .

title: Kobold
description: Kobold Kobolds are aggressive , inward , yet industrious small humanoid creatures . They are noted for their skill at building traps and preparing ambushes , and mining . Kobolds are distantly related to dragons and urd s and are often found serving the former as minions .

title: Koda Yoshiuji
description: Koda Yoshiuji Koda Yoshiuji was a samurai who ran a posthouse or waystation in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . It was a very unhealthy posthouse .

title: Kogi
description: Kogi Kogi was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kogi was a good instructor at the monastery .

title: Koguryo
description: Koguryo Koguryo was a kingdom in the land of Choson and later a province of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Koguryo lay in the south - western " toe " of the boot - like shape of the Koryo Peninsula , centered around the Ziyero Ridge .

title: Koh Nur
description: Koh Nur Koh Nur , or the Mountain of Light , was a giant opal kept in the heart of the Great Khan ' s palace in the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Description . The light emitted from Koh Nur was the method of timekeeping with the Sevenfold Mazework and the entire expanse of the Great Dismal Delve .

title: Koja
description: Koja Koja was a human man and a lama of Khazari . He became advisor to Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde . History .

title: Koje
description: Koje Koje was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay on the eastern side of Kang Bay . History .

title: Kola bint Fayala
description: Kola bint Fayala Kola bint Fayala was a retired thief and locksmith who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Kola was a young gnome who had a harassed look about her .

title: Kolbaz
description: Kolbaz Kolbaz was an old and cantankerous mage and a member of the Harpers in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Kolbaz lived in a villa owned by the Harpers in Yartar .

title: Komar al - Anni
description: Komar al - Anni Komar al - Anni was a historical inhabitant of Zakhara . History . Komar bravely sacrificed his life to save a group of pilgrim ' s from a group of bloodthirsty jann .

title: Komite
description: Komite The Komite , or Imperial Tournament was a martial arts tournament held in Shou Lung . Reputation . For many martial artists , the Komite was the supreme contest , allowing them to confront the greatest fighters in all styles from across the empire and abroad .

title: Konang Pen
description: Konang Pen Konang Pen was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It stood west of the Tumen River and east of the Naktong Moors . Industry .

title: Konigheim
description: Konigheim Konigheim , one of the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East , was a country located between Doegan , the Kingdom of Nix , and the Land of the Yak - Men . The town of Vanesci Hamlet lay in eastern Konigheim , lying upriver of the main part of the kingdom . Beyond it , the Phantom Pass led to the Kingdom of Nix .

title: Konishi Ieyasu
description: Konishi Ieyasu Konishi Ieyasu was the head of the ninja Konishi clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Ieyasu lived in Dojyu as a bushi named Kumorigawa Ieyasu who had retired from service to a korobokuru lord in distant Haso Province , but in truth he led the deathliest ninja clan in Kozakura .

title: Konishi Seichi
description: Konishi Seichi Konishi Seichi was a member of the ninja Konishi clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Seichi lived in Dojyu as a wu jen named Kumorigawa Seichi with her father Konishi Ieyasu .

title: Kor
description: Kor Kor was the god of wisdom of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached that wisdom stemmed from age , and wisdom brought strength . Kor ' s symbol was a sunburst .

title: Kora Shan
description: Kora Shan The Kora Shan was a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Starting at the edge of the Quoya Desert , and ending just before reaching the Hagga Shan , the Kora Shan was a narrow range of mountains that cut the central Hordelands in two .

title: Koraboros
description: Koraboros Koraboros is a pit fiend who was trapped within Ammon Jerro ' s haven in the Sword Mountains , for the purpose of empowering the warlock . He was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demon s and devil s , but broke free when Baalbisan convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the demons to the haven . Once he returned to Baator , Koraboros began to plot revenge upon Jerro for imprisoning him .

title: Korai Anteki
description: Korai Anteki Korai Anteki was a machi - yakko leader in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Anteki was the son of Korai Urushi , a modest rice merchant in Iiso .

title: Korak
description: Korak Korak was a marginally intelligent and curiously friendly ghoul , who instead of attacking people to devour them , wanted to join Abdel Adrian ' s party and actually helped him on occasion . Appendix . Notes .

title: Korat Minial
description: Korat Minial Korat Minial owned Lights in the Dark within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Korat ' s shop specialized in offering lamps and lanterns that gave off different colors of light .

title: Korax ( shukenja )
description: Korax ( shukenja ) Korax of Manchar was a human male shukenja and follower of the Way from the town of Manchar in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was a holy man who wandered northern Koryo , and was famous for his kindness . Activities .

title: Korbus Brightjewel
description: Korbus Brightjewel Korbus Brightjewel is the owner and proprieter of Korbus ' s Jewelry and Fine Ornaments in Daggerford . An expert jeweler , Korbus could easily have found work at the higher - class venue of Waterdeep but prefers the life that can only be found in a small town . He is also an expert at identifying all , magical or otherwise .

title: Koresh
description: Koresh Koresh was the leader of a criminal band of mercenaries operating in a desert . Description . Koresh was a tan , dark - haired and dark - bearded man with a prominent nose .

title: Korgan Bloodaxe
description: Korgan Bloodaxe Korgan Bloodaxe was an evil dwarf companion of the Bhaalspawn . Gameplay . Korgan is considered one of the best fighters in the game for an evil party , probably even better than Minsc , save for the low intelligence attribute that makes Korgan very susceptible to mind flayers .

title: Kori
description: Kori Kori was a barmaid in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Kori had black hair and walked with a limp .

title: Korial Quintara
description: Korial Quintara Korial Quintara was a captain in Maztica . Personality . Quintara was a quiet old man .

title: Korienna Redarm
description: Korienna Redarm Korienna Redarm was a human female bandit leader in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . She was originally an officer , as indicated by her full plate armor and shield , but deserted the Army and chose a lawless life . She led a small band of about a dozen other deserters and they marauded up and down the South Road between Eshpurta and Hillfort Keshla , and perhaps beyond , attacking travelers and stealing their horses and other valuables .

title: Koril Benshay
description: Koril Benshay Koril Benshay was a captain of the Freedom Riders of Daggerdale in 1369 DR . He was a good friend of fellow captain Ariton Delmis and when Koril was captured just before the decisive battle in Dagger Falls , Ariton tasked adventurers he had recruited to free Randal Morn to also enter Zhent headquarters and liberate Koril .

title: Korinn Archipelago
description: Korinn Archipelago The Korinn Archipelago was a chain of islands at the northernmost region of the Moonshae Isles and home primarily to humanoids such as orcs and goblins . Travel amongst the islets of the area wasn ' t easy due to rough water and reefs . Notable Locations .

title: Korkan
description: Korkan Korkan was a hobgoblin slave in Szith Morcane . History . Korkan was the head slave in the noble house led by Rilira .

title: Kormoroth
description: Kormoroth Kormoroth of Westgate was a very successful merchant in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Kormoroth was plotting against King Foril Obarskyr I .

title: Kornah
description: Kornah Kornah " The Crazy " is a member of the Harpers who poses as a crazed guide of Zhentil Keep . Home . Kornah ' s house , in keeping with her disguise , is a disheveled mess .

title: Kornerupine
description: Kornerupine Kornerupine was a rare fancy stone usually found in stream beds , eskers , or ridge - pit gravel . Description . Kornerupine came in green or brown translucent crystals that were hard and yielded solid faceted gems up to medium size .

title: Korobokuru
description: Korobokuru Korobokuru were dwarf - like humanoids who lived in the barren lands of Kara - Tur , away from people and civilization . Society . They lived in small villages and engaged in hunting and farming .

title: Korock
description: Korock Korock was an orc warrior during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during the orc and drow assault on the Silver Marches , Korock was guiding a contingent of troops .

title: Korona Caramitru
description: Korona Caramitru Korona Caramitru was a minor noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Korona was a dour person to the point of being puritanical .

title: Korr
description: Korr Korr of Ilmater was a knight of Ilmater circa 1363 DR . History . Korr led a company of fifty fellow knights devoted to Ilmater , called simply the Knights of Ilmater .

title: Korr Odahn
description: Korr Odahn Korr Odahn was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Whilst crossing the high mountains of the Utter East , Legendary Campaign forces found themselves enveloped in a mysterious fog . As it lifted , they found themselves in Phantom Pass and being threatened with a grisly fate by an angry Korr Odahn , whom they faced in bloodforge battle .

title: Korred
description: Korred Korreds were fey that resembled small satyrs , and were said to be descended from warped gnome s . They were fun - loving forest - dwellers who valued hair and items that most would consider too mundane to warrant interest . Korreds took great offense about people cutting their hair .

title: Kortal
description: Kortal King Kortal of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the third king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Kortal was the second son of King Nearel .

title: Kortolt Rushtyn
description: Kortolt Rushtyn Kortolt Rushtyn was a priest of Ilmater from the city of Mussum in the Vilhon Reach , who preached near Hlondeth in the early 1340s DR . History . Kortolt Rushtyn was a young underpriest at the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum , " circa " 1342 DR , when he received visions from the god Ilmater directing him to the hidden " Tome of Torment " , the most holy book of the faith .

title: Kortyl Rowanmantle
description: Kortyl Rowanmantle Kortyl Rowanmantle was a knight and a member of the Rowanmantle noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . He was a brash youth . History .

title: Koryo
description: Koryo Koryo , formerly known as Choson , was a loose association of three kingdoms all descended from the Han people . The kingdom was ruled by a strong king , the warlord , Wanang Sun . Names & Etymology .

title: Koryo Peninsula
description: Koryo Peninsula The Koryo Peninsula was a large stretch of land in the northeast Kara - Tur . The realm of Koryo lay at its southern end . Geography .

title: Koryo language
description: Koryo language Koryo was a language spoken by the Koryoan people , inhabitants of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Koryo descended from the ancient Han language , as did Kozakuran and Wa - an , and possibly others . Its vocabulary comprised many words evolved from the old Han tongue , as well as loanwords from Wa - an and Kao te Shou that had been borrowed over centuries .

title: Kossaandar
description: Kossaandar Kossaandar was the lizardfolk war chief of Shadowscale tribe in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Kossaandar war the war leader of the lizardfolk gathered by Ketsarra Shadowscale called Shadowscale tribe .

title: Kossuth
description: Kossuth Kossuth ( pronounced " koh - SOOTH " ) , or the Lord of Flames is the primordial of elemental fire . Kossuth is symbolized by the holy symbol of a twining red flame and his portfolio covers elemental fire and purification through fire . He is , however , not a true god but actually an elemental primordial , a being whose power rivals that of a true deity .

title: Kossuth ' s Eyes
description: Kossuth ' s Eyes Kossuth ' s Eyes were a pair of dormant volcanoes in the Small Teeth mountains . Description . These two volcanoes were located on the far eastern end of the mountain range .

title: Kostchtchie
description: Kostchtchie Kostchtchie , known as the Prince of Wrath , was a demon lord and a patron of frost giant s and rage . Relationships . By establishing himself as a deity of frost giants , Kostchtchie directly encroached upon the domain of Thrym , though that titan did not take direct action against the demon lord .

title: Kostil
description: Kostil Kostil was an elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , regarding the hunt for Elminster Aumar , Kostil joked to the younger malaugrym , provoking them to attack the human wizard without preparation .

title: Kotaro Taro
description: Kotaro Taro Kotaro Taro was a kensai adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Taro born in Kotaro clan as first son and scion .

title: Koumiss
description: Koumiss Koumiss ( pronounced KOO - miss ) was an extremely potent drink in Zakhara made from fermented mare ' s milk . It was forbidden in areas controlled by moralist s . Prices .

title: Koyisqatapi
description: Koyisqatapi Koyisqatapi was the Azuposi ruler in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . In 1359 DR , Koyisqatabi was elected as the new Gilded Priest and like all his predecessors he went to Dunobo Springs and ventured onto the Sun Trail in order to meet Masauwu and have his blessing .

title: Koyoss
description: Koyoss Koyoss was an Iulutiun village known for the quality of its sled dogs . Geography . Koyoss was located in the Alpuk region of the Great Glacier , alongside a stream flowing between the Uppuk River and the Lugalpgotak Sea .

title: Kozah ' s Needle
description: Kozah ' s Needle Kozah ' s Needle was a retractable magic staff that could turn into a triple bar with chains ( a dire threshing flail ) . It was the primary weapon used by Dahlia Sin ' felle , one of many users of the staff and seemingly the most proficient . Kozah ' s Needle built up an electric charge as it was used , and it could unleash electricity , even channeling it through an opponent ' s metal weapon .

title: Kozakura
description: Kozakura Kozakura is an archipelago nation composed of four large islands and dozens of smaller ones , the largest of which stretches fourteen hundred miles from tip to tip . It is a land where constant political power struggles are fought , and the central government in the Imperial Capital only has power within its immediate reach . Political intrigue is common as the great families of Kozakura seek to outmanoeuvre each other in their bid for power and wealth .

title: Kozakuran language
description: Kozakuran language Kozakuran was a language spoken by the Kozakuran people , inhabitants of the realm of Kozakura in Kara - Tur . Kozakuran descended from the ancient Han language , as did Koryo and Wa - an , and possibly others . Kozakuran and Wa - an were closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language .

title: Kraanfhaor ' s Door
description: Kraanfhaor ' s Door Kraanfhaor ' s Door was an ancient elven magic college in Talthalaran in the High Moor . It was one of the most ancient colleges , dating to millennia before the Descent of the drow . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn found a clue to its location inside a " kiira " found in the High Moor .

title: Kradazuur
description: Kradazuur Kradazuur was a blue dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Kradazuur was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Krailash
description: Krailash Krailash , sometimes known as Krai was a dragonborn fighter who served as guard captain and chief of security for the Travelers of the merchant House Serrat . Description . Krailash was huge , standing nearly seven feet ( 2 meters ) tall and weighing 300 lbs .

title: Krak al - Mazhar
description: Krak al - Mazhar Krak al - Mazhar was the secretive base of operation for the Brotherhood of the True Flame in 1367 DR . Description . Krak al - Mazhar was found within an ancient volcano deep within the Great Anvil of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara .

title: Krak al - Nayyiran
description: Krak al - Nayyiran Krak al - Nayyiran , or the Castle of Sun and Moon , was a castle located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This keep was found in the Plume district of the city . Activities .

title: Krak al - Tawil
description: Krak al - Tawil Krak al - Tawil , or the Long Castle , was a keep located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The castle was found in the Ashlarks ward of the city . Activities .

title: Krak al - Yinangi
description: Krak al - Yinangi Krak al - Yinangi , also called the Castle of Conveyance , was a fortress located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . This beautiful but stout bridge - like fortress was designed to appear to float upon the lagoon where it sat .

title: Krak al - Zinad
description: Krak al - Zinad Krak al - Zinad , or the Keep of Fire Striking Steel , was a castle located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Keep was located in the Cindersweeps ward of the city . Activities .

title: Kraken
description: Kraken Krakens , called lopok by the locathah , were large , ocean - dwelling magical beast s . They are akin to squids except larger in size , almost 80 ' ( 24 m ) long ; they have a similar body , with a ring of tentacles surrounding a mouth connected to a conical central body . Two of its ten tentacles are longer than the rest and have deadly barbs .

title: Kraken Society
description: Kraken Society The Kraken Society was a secret society of thieves , assassin s and mage s in the Savage Frontier . Its purpose was to maintain an information network throughout the North , and it was secretly led by the the kraken , Slarkrethel . It had its headquarters in the Purple Rocks , and their main fortress in the ruins of Ascarle .

title: Krakentua ( Isle of Gargantuas )
description: Krakentua ( Isle of Gargantuas ) " The krakentua " was the krakentua ruler of the Isle of Gargantuas in the Outer Isles of Wa in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Around Wa Year 1765 ( 1347 DR ) , the krakentua had a titanic battle with more powerful spirits of the ocean .

title: Krakentua ( Ito - Jo )
description: Krakentua ( Ito - Jo ) " The krakentua " was a krakentua lairing beneath Ito - Jo in Kozakura in 1359 DR . History . The krakentua lived in the deep oceans until it fled the more powerful guardian spirits of the deep .

title: Krakentua ( Shinkintin )
description: Krakentua ( Shinkintin ) " The krakentua " was a krakentua who posed as the goddess of the village of Shinkintin on the Fochu Peninsula of Wa in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Several centuries before , she was attacked and defeated by Za - Jikku , a pan lung dragon and rogue officer of the Celestial Bureaucracy who caused much destruction in Kara - Tur .

title: Krakk ' t
description: Krakk ' t The Krakk ' t was a tribe of thri - kreen who dwelled in the Rushing Hills on the Shining Plains . Their territory extended into the plains themselves and southwest to outside the city of Surkh . Organization .

title: Kral
description: Kral Kral was a bard and Harpers agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . The bard was little paranoid and preferred to be underestimated by his enemies .

title: Kralgar Bonesnapper
description: Kralgar Bonesnapper Kralgar Bonesnapper was the chieftain of the Uthgardt Griffon tribe who ruled Griffon ' s Nest . Activities . He endlessly struggled to fulfill his goal of conquering and ruling one of the great cities of the North .

title: Kraljaom Distillery
description: Kraljaom Distillery The Kraljaom Distillery was a famous producer of ales , beers , ciders , wines , and other alcohol , located in the western half of the city of Myratma . Notable Products . Many of the distillery ' s wares were known throughout Faerûn , as they were sold both locally and through Aurora ' s Emporium .

title: Kranum
description: Kranum Kranum was a stone giant shaman in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Kranum was exiled by his tribe for being too kind to lesser races .

title: Krashos Morueme
description: Krashos Morueme Krashos Morueme was a blue dragon of the legendary Morueme dragon clan . He resided in Ched Nasad under the alias of Quevven Jusztiirn , professing to be a venerable drow mage . Abilities .

title: Krehlan Arunsun
description: Krehlan Arunsun Krehlan Arunsun was the son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand and the fourth Blackstaff . Description . Krehlan was silver - haired from birth .

title: Krenadir
description: Krenadir Krenadir ( also seen as Krenalir ) was a coastal city in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Krenadir was located on the coast of Luirenstrand in the Great Sea .

title: Kreodo
description: Kreodo Kreodo was the leader of the Wraith of the Inner Sea mercenary company in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . Kreodo initially was a slave of the Flaming Spike orc s but escaped and arrived in Reth .

title: Kresselack
description: Kresselack Kresselack the black wolf was a Barbarian King who conquered a vast kingdom during his youth . He described himself after his death as evil itself . Spirit of Kresselack , 1281 DR , the Vale of Shadows Everard , 1281 DR Once he grew old and realized that he would die and be dead forever , he knew fear for the first time of his life .

title: Krestung
description: Krestung The Krestung was a breed of monstrous flying creature that lurked in the depths of the Vorkani Mountains in Koryo in Kara - Tur . It resembled a great vulture with a long neck like a snake and the head of a wolf of hideous and evil aspect . Packs of these creatures raided even the best - guarded caravans , snatching away horse s and human s alike .

title: Krieger
description: Krieger Krieger was a deep gnome councilor of the city of Blingdenstone in 1370 DR . Before becoming a councilor , he was a burrow warden . Personality .

title: Kriknar
description: Kriknar Kriknar was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Kriknar usually traveled around the city heavily cloaked and painted , in order to pass as an ugly half - orc .

title: Krilelyn H ' Kar
description: Krilelyn H ' Kar Krilelyn H ' Kar was an elite warrior of Bregan D ' aerthe in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , an expedition led by some adventurers , hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to stop the threat of the demon lord s , arrived in Menzoberranzan .

title: Krimgol Muzgardt
description: Krimgol Muzgardt Krimgol Muzgardt was a duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Krimgol was an ale merchant from Gracklstugh .

title: Krimmon Amethystall
description: Krimmon Amethystall Count Krimmon Amethystall was the Fleet Chancellor of Tethyr and the ruler of County Vintor in the Purple Marches in 1370 DR . Description . Count Amethystall was short , even for a halfling .

title: Krinth
description: Krinth Krinth were humanoid s native to the Plane of Shadow . They composed the bulk of the armies of the returned Netherese city of Thultanthar . Description .

title: Kriv
description: Kriv Kriv was one of the few dragonborn wizard s of Tymanther . Description . Kriv had yellow eyes and bronze scales flecked with black .

title: Krivvin Shamblestar
description: Krivvin Shamblestar Krivvin Shamblestar was the stocky yet soft - spoken tavernmaster of the Stag - Horned Flagon in Amphail . Along with being an exceptional knife - thrower , Krivvin had an extensive memory for the faces of his clientele and the favored drinks that go with them . He also made sure that he knew most of the business that went on within his bar , whether the patrons realized it or not .

title: Kromlech Bruenghor
description: Kromlech Bruenghor Kromlech was a shield dwarf of the Sunset Mountains , who sought adventure and glory in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . Having been waylaid and robbed by thieves almost immediately , his first instinct was to track down the ones who robbed him and seek vengeance . Little did he know that this would mean becoming involved in some of the greatest events to shape the future of Baldur ' s Gate for years to come .

title: Kromm Kadar
description: Kromm Kadar Kromm Kadar was a silent blacksmith in High Dale . History . Kromm was once a Zhentilar warrior before he settled in High Dale as blacksmith but always collaborated with the Zhent s .

title: Krondac
description: Krondac Krondac was a baron in Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Krondac was called to a meeting of prominent citizens gathered by Lord Fior Botpur to discuss the menace of a barbarian army from Kara - Tur .

title: Krondorl Waeglossz
description: Krondorl Waeglossz Krondorl Waeglossz was the head of the College of Invocation and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1379 DR , he participated in the debate about elevating the College of Ancient Arcana or the College of Bae ' qeshel Magic as the new eleventh official college of the city .

title: Krote Word - Maker
description: Krote Word - Maker Krote Word - Maker was a gnoll cleric of the Burnt Fur tribe . Description . Compared to other gnolls , Krote was very thin , with a sunken snout and eyes .

title: Krowen Valharrow
description: Krowen Valharrow Krowen Valharrow was an archmage member of the Harpers in Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Krowen lived in Moongleam Tower with the company of dozens of tressym and a handful of apprentices .

title: Krydle
description: Krydle Krydle ( " Cry dull " with a quick L ) was a half - elf thief and poet who lived in Baldur ' s Gate , estranged from his father Coran . He hated the politics of the city and the schism between upper and lower cities . He joined Minsc and Delina ' s quest .

title: Kryll
description: Kryll Kryll was a female necromancer who was a one - time companion of Dorn Il - Khan until she betrayed him to Luskan ' s guards . Eventually , with the help of Gorion ' s Ward , Dorn found Kryll near Nashkel and killed her in revenge .

title: Kryptgarden Forest
description: Kryptgarden Forest Kryptgarden Forest was located east of the Sword Mountains . It lay just west of the Long Road , and north of Waterdeep . In 1489 DR , the Green Dragon Mask was recovered from the lair of Claugiyliamatar in Kryptgarden Forest .

title: Kuda
description: Kuda Kuda was the second - largest city and the former capital of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . In that year , there lived in the city around 7 , 000 people divided into two wards . Kuda was the provincial capital under the emperor ' s rule but the shogun moved the capital to Tamanokuni .

title: Kuda no Nito
description: Kuda no Nito Kuda no Nito was a weapons merchant in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , while traveling to sell his goods with his two assistants , Nito was attacked by some evil sohei who killed his assistants and robbed him .

title: Kueh - Ku
description: Kueh - Ku Kueh - Ku was an assassin and a member of the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . The assassin was a very vicious and evil person .

title: Kukri
description: Kukri A kukri is a light , martial , melee weapon . Description . The kukri looks like a short machete with a bent blade .

title: Kukul
description: Kukul Kukul was the father of all Maztica n gods and the husband of the deity Maztica . The Maztican creation myth holds that Kukul created humans by cutting off his fingers and dropping them to the earth . Kukul died of grief after Maztica was killed by their son Zaltec .

title: Kuldahar
description: Kuldahar Kuldahar was a settlement in the northern reaches of the Spine of the World mountains . History . In the early days of the world of Toril , the god of nature Silvanus planted a simple acorn in the northern foothills of the freezing Spine of the World mountain chain .

title: Kuldahar Pass
description: Kuldahar Pass Kuldahar Pass was a vale between Easthaven and Kuldahar in the Spine of the World . Geography . On the outskirts of the pass was a small mill , which was often used as a base for marauding goblin s .

title: Kuldin Peaks
description: Kuldin Peaks The Kuldin Peaks were a small cluster of mountains in the country of Erlkazar at the border with Tethyr . Geography . The Kuldin Peaks fell within the borders of the barony of Carrelath in Erlkazar .

title: Kuldus Droum
description: Kuldus Droum Kuldus Droum was a male human werebear from the Moonwood and was a cleric for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Description . Kuldus was a strong , large , and quiet man .

title: Kultaka
description: Kultaka The nation of Kultaka occupies a fertile coastal plain and its surrounding mountains . Despite being a coastal nation , large salt marshes that stretch along the coast separate the people from the sea . Kultaka is populated by humans .

title: Kulwarth
description: Kulwarth Marshal Kulwarth was a scarred barbarian Zhentilar officer in the 1370s DR . History . In 1374 DR , during the Cormanthor War , Kulwarth was the aide - de - camp of the castellan Scyllua Darkhope .

title: Kumade
description: Kumade A kumade was a type of multi - purpose tool and weapon used in Kara - Tur , and was favored by ninja . Description . It was 6 ft ( 1 .

title: Kumed Hahpret
description: Kumed Hahpret Kumed Hahpret replaced the murdered Aznar Thrul by 1385 DR as zulkir of Evocation . Importance . Kumed supported the council of zulkirs in their war against the lich Szass Tam , who proclaimed himself regent of all Thay .

title: Kumen
description: Kumen The Kumen , or Ancient Gate , was a gateway on the Dragonwall . Geography . This particular gateway was located at the southern end of the wall near Khazari .

title: Kumiss
description: Kumiss Kumiss was alcohol ic beverage made from soured or fermented horse milk . It could be stored in leather bags . Geography .

title: Kun - Yen Shan
description: Kun - Yen Shan The Kun - Yen Shan was a mountain range located in the Hordelands . Geography . The Kun - Yen Shan formed the northern rim of the sprawling Yehimal mountains , stretching from the A - Ling Shan in the west all the way to the province of Tabot and Kao Shan in Shou Lung to the east .

title: Kung Pu Mok
description: Kung Pu Mok Kung Pu Mok was the High Priest of Shou Lung in 1357 DR and 1358 DR Activities . Kung Pu Mok plotted to replace the Emperor with a theocracy . He also sought to marry Kai Tsao Shou Chin ' s third daughter , Princess Pai .

title: Kuo - toa
description: Kuo - toa Kuo - toa were a debased monstrous humanoid fish - like race that dwelt in the Underdark . They had human - like bodies and fish - like heads . Religion .

title: Kuong Kingdom
description: Kuong Kingdom Kuong Kingdom is the southernmost state in Malatra and almost all his territory are huge wild jungle . It is thanks to this jungle Kueng always ensured by a tree . As in Laothan main terrain consists of rolling hills and steep ridges mixed with jungle .

title: Kuong language
description: Kuong language Kuong was a language spoken by the people of Kuong in Malatra . Coming from a different linguistic stock to the Laothan and Purang languages also spoken in Malatra , Kuong was distinctly unlike all other languages spoken in Kara - Tur . Because it was so unique , the Kuong people believed it to be specially blessed .

title: Kupuk
description: Kupuk Kupuk , also known as walrus dogs , were creatures native to the Great Glacier and domesticated by the Ulutiun s to serve as sled - pullers . Description . At first glance , a kupuk appeared to be a cross between a walrus and a dog .

title: Kura
description: Kura Kura was a kobun of the Big Head yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . After an attack by Black Mist yakuza on a shrine protected by Big Heads , Kura gathered around thirty like - minded yakuza to attack the Black Mist headquarters in revenge ( an attack that would probably end in tragedy ) .

title: Kuraulyek
description: Kuraulyek Kuraulyek was the patron deity of urd s . Description . Kuraulyek appeared as a blue - skinned dragonwrought kobold or as a blue - skinned urd with feathered wings .

title: Kurgoth Hellspawn
description: Kurgoth Hellspawn Kurgoth Hellspawn was a half - fiend fire giant who led the assault upon the drow city of Maerimydra and with the aid of Duneth Wharreil managed to sack the entire city . Although the drow of Maerimydra suffered from Lolth ' s Silence , leading his army of ogre s , fire giants and demon s to victory is an impressive feat nonetheless . Description .

title: Kuri Ironspike
description: Kuri Ironspike Kuri Ironspike was a human fighter in Maztica . History . Ironspike was originally a warrior from Amn who ' d fought wyvern s and gnoll s in the Snowflake Mountains .

title: Kurken Garshorn
description: Kurken Garshorn Kurken Garshorn was an exiled duergar merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Kurken ' s status as an exile caused him serious trouble with other duergar .

title: Kurkle
description: Kurkle Kurkle was a haraknin ( hell hound canomorph ) who served as a guide and scout in the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Kurkle ' s natural form was a hell hound , but as a canomorph he could change into humanoid form .

title: Kuroda Saga
description: Kuroda Saga Nogami Sado was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan who commanded Awa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . He led ten samurai and thirty bushi at Awa village , controlling the shoen , despite the fact that the land was administrated directly from nearby Tamanokuni .

title: Kurplarhagoon
description: Kurplarhagoon Kurplarhagoon was the kuo - toa leader of the Blib - sanvu in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . and 1372 Personality . Unfortunately , Kurplarhagoon had succumbed to the madness that affected most of the kuo - toa of Sloopdilmonpolop .

title: Kurr
description: Kurr Kurr was a fang of Yeenoghu in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Kurr suffered from a peculiar form of demon lord – spread madness : he felt guilty for all the people he had killed .

title: Kurth
description: Kurth Kurth ' was the leader of Ship Kurth and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan in 1367 DR . Due to the traditions of the High Captains , his real name was rarely used but it is highly likely that he is not the first High Captain Kurth . Along with his peers he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate .

title: Kurth ( adventurer )
description: Kurth ( adventurer ) Kurth " Banditslayer " was an adventurer of the Vast . History . Kurth was an adventurer who earned a reputation of killing bandits , hence the nickname , and founded the town of the same name .

title: Kurth ( town )
description: Kurth ( town ) Kurth , known as " Pirates ' Rest " , was a town in the Vast , located at the intersection of the Cross Road and the North Road , between Maskyr ' s Eye , Blanaer , and King ' s Reach , and at the end of the Hunt Trail from Tavilar . It sat at the northern entrance to Three Trees Pass , and east of the Beluar ' s Hunt hills . History .

title: Kurtulmak
description: Kurtulmak Kurtulmak was the patron deity of the kobolds , and they claimed he gave them life . After Kurtulmak created the kobolds and taught them the skills of thieving and pillaging , the gnome s entered into an eternal conflict with his creations , angering him . According to other myths , he stole the gift of sorcery from a dragon deity to give to his people .

title: Kurush el Nayet
description: Kurush el Nayet Archdruid Kurush yn Arib el Nayet was the son of a Calishite naval captain who became a follower of Silvanus and founded the Golden Grove in Memnon with Silvanus ' miraculous blessing . History . Kurush was the son of Rysal Arib el Nayet , but not wanting to follow in his father ' s footsteps as a man of the sea , he fled as a youth to the north and became an adventurer .

title: Kurzen Brewhammer
description: Kurzen Brewhammer Kurzen Brewhammer was a dwarven fighter and member of the Blue Wyvern Company . When not adventuring , Kurzen helped his father , Tharzon Brewhammer , run the Smoke Wyrm tavern . Kurzen was knowledgeable about the ancient dwarven ruins of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff , knowledge that proved invaluable during the Blue Wyvern ' s quest to retrieve the Sarkenaegal .

title: Kushk
description: Kushk Kushk , also called the Deserted City of Kushk or Purple Kushk , was located on the west bank of the mighty Jumpa River in the Hordelands . Geography . The ruins of Kushk sat in the shadow of Mount Kus where the Old Iron Road crossed the Jumpa River through the Katakoro Shan range .

title: Kuskur
description: Kuskur Crown Prince Kuskur Heltharn was a regent ruler of Impiltur . Relationships . Kuskur was the third son of King Imphras II through the king ' s second wife , Rebaera Osterhown .

title: Kusphia
description: Kusphia Kusphia was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . In battle , Kusphia wore leather armor and fought with a scimitar .

title: Kuthe
description: Kuthe Kuthe was one of the Riders of Mistledale in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Kuthe led a patrol of the Riders .

title: Kwachow
description: Kwachow Kwachow , known as the City of Melons , was the largest settlement of the Merket Depression in the Hordelands . Description . The settlement of Kwachow sat where several streams met in the otherwise dry Quoya Desert , and was famous for the large , sweet melons grown there .

title: Kwalu
description: Kwalu " Negus " ( Prince ) Kwalu was the son of King Osaw I and a member of the " bara e " , the seven " super - paladins " sworn to protect the holy city of Mezro in Chult before its destruction during the Spellplague . Description . Kwalu was a handsome man .

title: Kwan Chan Sen
description: Kwan Chan Sen Kwan Chan Sen was the Minister of War of Shou Lung . History . Kwan Chan Sen served as the head of Shou Lung ' s military , being the second most powerful man of the Empire .

title: Kwan Ching Lo
description: Kwan Ching Lo Kwan Ching Lo was the Minister of Public Works of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Kwan Ching Lo was appointed Minister of Public Works around 1328 DR .

title: Kwan Shang - Li
description: Kwan Shang - Li Kwan Shang - Li was a young Shou monk belonging to the Standing Tree monastic order . Kwan ' s mother was an elven ranger whom his father married against his family ' s wishes . Kwan learned woodcraft and his devotion to the goddess Mielikki from his mother .

title: Kwan Wan Lo
description: Kwan Wan Lo Kwan Wan Lo was a kensai participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Kwan Wan Lo was an aged and revered kensai who had devoted all his life to martial arts .

title: Kwan Yung
description: Kwan Yung Kwan Yung was a Shou monk from the Standing Tree Monastery and the father of Kwan Shang - Li . He was considered to be a great scholar . Description .

title: Ky Trencha Ukang
description: Ky Trencha Ukang The Ky Trencha Ukang was a magical staff of eldritch power from Koryo in Kara - Tur , separated into five enchanted scroll cases . History . The " Ky Trencha Ukang " was fashioned by the great wu jen Kixa To ' u several centuries before 1357 DR .

title: Kybor
description: Kybor Kybor was a sorcerer member of the Fire Knives in Tilverton in 1357 DR . Activities . Kybor was a member of the Fire Knives cell refuge in Tilverton and a lieutenant of Radatha .

title: Kyjal Stardancer
description: Kyjal Stardancer Kyjal Stardancer was a Star elf who became the most promising apprentice of Mourel Duskwalker . Kyjal was the only survivor of the defeat of his master . He fell into the sea below Tir ' in ' tiral and was presumed dead .

title: Kymas Nahpret
description: Kymas Nahpret Kymas Nahpret was a vampire Red Wizard of Thay and a necromancer . History . In 1486 DR , together with Umara Ankhlab , Kymas was tasked by Szass Tam with the mission of finding the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .

title: Kymil Nimesin
description: Kymil Nimesin Kymil Nimesin is a sun elf who has earned a spotless reputation as one of the finest teachers of swordsmanship and as an eminent person at the Elven Court . History . Kymil is over 600 years old and has borne witness to the fall of Myth Drannor and the rise of the House Moonflower rulers of Evermeet .

title: Kyone veldrin
description: Kyone veldrin Kyone Veldrin , meaning " alert in the shadows " , was a fighting style taught among drow , that was about drawing maximum advantage out of their ability to cast " darkness " . Description . As the name " alert in the shadows " suggested , the fighting style was keeping one ' s senses in shadows , in this case a drow ' s natural ability to cast " darkness " .

title: Kyorli
description: Kyorli Kyorli was the female rat familiar of Gromph Baenre , the Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Personality . Gromph and Kyorli were relatively close and affectionate with one another .

title: Kyorlin plynn
description: Kyorlin plynn Kyorlin plynn , meaning " watch and take " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It was used to defeat enemies without killing them . Description .

title: Kyra
description: Kyra Kyra was an adventurer who had just arrived in Mulmaster . Personality . Kyra was a laconic individual with great combat and survival skills .

title: Kyriani Agrivar
description: Kyriani Agrivar Kyriani Agrivar was a half - drow wizard of Waterdeep . She was a member of the Moonstars , a Lord of Waterdeep , and the third Blackstaff . < ref name = " Cite book / BT - p ?

title: Kyrill Nederlok
description: Kyrill Nederlok Kyrill Nederlok was an officer of the Flaming Fist . He first joined the group as a mercenary at the group ' s founding in 1345 DR . In time , he rose through the ranks and was promoted to marshal around 1362 DR .

title: Kyrin Hawkwinter
description: Kyrin Hawkwinter Her Excellency , Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter was the Countess of Calimmon in Tethyr and Horselady of Her Majesty ' s Cavalry . She was known as a superb rider , horse breeder , and military strategist , with a strong will . History .

title: Kyriusho
description: Kyriusho Kyriusho was a greater spirit of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Kyriusho was an aloof and arrogant individual but fair - minded in truth .

title: Kyrlraun
description: Kyrlraun Kyrlraun was a paladin of Ilmater and the leading member of the Council of Lords of Impiltur in 1359 DR . Activities . He was in effect the true ruler of Impiltur because the Queen - Regent Sambryl always sought Kyrlraun ' s advice in state affairs .

title: Kyrnill Melarn
description: Kyrnill Melarn Kyrnill Melarn ( formerly known as Kyrnill Kenafin ) was formerly the matron mother of House Kenafin in Menzoberranzan and later the First Priestess of House Melarn . History . Starting before 1361 DR and lasting until 1383 DR , Kyrnill Kenafin served as the matron mother of House Kenafin .

title: Kysaer Whitemantle
description: Kysaer Whitemantle Kysaer Whitemantle , also known as the Rider in White , was the most famous assassin in the Sea of Fallen Stars and secretly a member of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . Possessions . Kysaer was known to use " Elquillar " , the famed " Sword of Many Faces " .

title: Kyuss
description: Kyuss Kyuss , also known as the Worm that Walks , was an Elder evil prophesied to usher in the " Age of Worms " , a time when the undead will rise and destroy the world . Description . The Worm that Walks was a 30 feet ( 9 meters ) tall giant composed of a shifting mass of maggots and worms filled with the psychic imprint of a former demigod named Kyuss .

title: Kâras
description: Kâras Kâras was a drow divine seeker and priest of Vhaeraun and a member of the Hidden from Maerimydra . After Vhaeraun ' s death , he switched his allegiance to Eilistraee . He died while under her employment , but somehow revived at some point around the Second Sundering .

title: LaValle
description: LaValle LaValle was a competent wizard who was one of the lieutenants of Pasha Pook in Calimport . Personality . LaValle explained to both Drizzt Do ' Urden and Artemis Entreri that his loyalty was first and foremost to the organization itself , not to a particular leader , so he served loyally someone that cared about the guild .

title: Laal
description: Laal Laal was a flumph living in the Underdark beneathe Mulmaster . Personality . Laal was a polite and truthful creature .

title: Laaqueel
description: Laaqueel Laaqueel was the malenti priestess of Sekolah who freed Iakhovas . History . Laaqueel was a malenti born with a very unusual pink skin , resembling a surface elf rather than a sea elf .

title: Lab
description: Lab Lab was a she - mule and the constant companion of Saleem the architect in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Relationships . Lab and Saleem were inseparable .

title: Labak Craumerdaun
description: Labak Craumerdaun Labak Craumerdaun was the commander of the Amnian Council Army garrison in Eshpurta , and because of this he also held an advisory position with the ruling body of Eshpurta , the Shield Council . With his forceful personality and desire for what was best for his troops , he often got what he wanted out of the Shield Council , most of whom did not want to lose favor with the commander - in - chief of 18 , 000 troops within the city walls .

title: Labelas Enoreth
description: Labelas Enoreth Labelas Enoreth , or the Lord of the Continuum , was the chaotic good elven deity who governed the orderly passage of time and guarded against those who would alter the path of history . Together with Sehanine Moonbow , he oversaw the long life span of the elves and their lives after they had left the mortal realms . His symbol was the setting sun .

title: Labyrinth
description: Labyrinth The Labyrinth was an ancient maze of tunnels in the Northdark . Geography . The Labyrinth covered a large area of the Upperdark and Middledark beneath the Dessarin River and beyond .

title: Lac Dinneshere
description: Lac Dinneshere Lac Dinneshere was one of the three lakes of Icewind Dale in the Frozenfar of the Sword Coast North that the Ten Towns clustered around . Geography . Most of the shoreline of Lac Dinneshere was rocky bluffs and barren tundra .

title: Ladies of the Green Shield
description: Ladies of the Green Shield The Ladies of the Green Shield was an adventuring company that operated in the Vast in the 1360s DR . The Ladies of the Green Shield were all slain outside the city of Calaunt in Mirtul of the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Some believed they ' d happened upon a band of drow one evening , perhaps the same drow spotted lurking on the streets of Calaunt at nights .

title: Ladok
description: Ladok Ladok was an efreetikin who worked within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Ladok assisted his master , the sha ' ir Wadi ' a bint Sali , in her duties to the Grand Vizier .

title: Laduguer
description: Laduguer Laduguer , also known as The Exile , the Gray Protector and Master of Crafts was the lawful evil dwarven deity of the duergar . Ever since he was cast out from the rest of the Mordinsamman , Laduguer has harboured a bitter resentment , viewing the rest of the pantheon as layabouts more concerned with outdated tradition than with progress . However , his doctrine taught obedience to one ' s leader , empowerment through the exploitation of slaves , enrichment through the creation of magical weapons and protection through an unforgiving military program .

title: Lady ' s Hall
description: Lady ' s Hall The Lady ' s Hall was a temple of Tymora in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . The temple of Lady Luck was run by the human cleric , Chanthalas Ulbright and the congregation consisted of twenty - four clerics and sixty - nine followers .

title: Lady ' s Hand Monastery
description: Lady ' s Hand Monastery The Lady ' s Hand Monastery was a temple dedicated to Loviatar on Ladypeak . History . In the Year of the Unstrung Harp , 1371 DR , the tower of Lady ' s Hand collapsed under the attacks of a Morueme dragon , which was later torn asunder mid - flight by the monks ' Netherese magic .

title: Lady ' s Happy Hall
description: Lady ' s Happy Hall The Lady ' s Happy Hall was a temple of Tymora in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Organization . By 1357 DR until 1367 DR and after , it was led by High Priest Orn Thavil , with 24 subordinate priests and 16 lay - followers .

title: Lady Quallem
description: Lady Quallem Lady Quallem was a female human and once the head of the Quallem family before she arose as a ghost in the Dordrien crypts . Description . Lady Quallem had a regal look about her and dressed in gowns both elegant and long .

title: Laele Dhuurniv
description: Laele Dhuurniv Laele Dhuurniv was a female drow and the Matron mother of House Dhuurniv of Maerimydra . History . Prior to the Weeping War , matron mother Laele Dhuurniv led the Maerimyra n forces who wished to reclaim the Land Under Shadow .

title: Laele Zauviir
description: Laele Zauviir Laele Zauviir , most knew as Streea ' Valsharess Zauviir , was the high priestess of Lolth in the city of Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . History . In 1379 DR Streea ' Valsharess together with her nephew Guldor Zauviir and T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl devised a scheme to gain more power in the Conclave of Sshamath but failed .

title: Laelran Aelorothi
description: Laelran Aelorothi Laelran Aelorothi was a member of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Laelran had a quasit familiar , Noxit , who helped him in his deception .

title: Laeral ' s dancing dweomer
description: Laeral ' s dancing dweomer Laeral ' s dancing dweomer was an illusion / phantasm that obfuscated magic auras , confusing any attempt to use " detect magic " spells or abilities . Effects . This spell created twenty false magic auras that flickered from object to object within the effected area , creating or masking auras on items as they went .

title: Laeral ' s spell shield
description: Laeral ' s spell shield Laeral ' s spell shield was a magical shield named after the creator of the first item of this type , Laeral Silverhand . It was a " + 1 large steel shield " that gave its bearer a moderate resistance against force - based spells . It costed 9170 gold piece s .

title: Laeral ' s storm armor
description: Laeral ' s storm armor Laeral ' s storm armor is a magic full plate armor made from an unknown non - metallic material , rumoured to be from another plane . It gives its wearer resistance to electricity and fire , and an immunity to the movement effects caused by strong winds . It can sell for in excess of 60 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Laeral ' s tears
description: Laeral ' s tears Laeral ' s tears was the Realms name for , named after the famous sorceress Laeral Silverhand . Description . This gemstone was soft and brittle but deposits often produced large crystals which could be facet cut into impressive colorless gems that held a glossy , lustrous shine .

title: Laeral Silverhand
description: Laeral Silverhand Laeral Silverhand was known as the Lady Mage of Waterdeep . Together with her partner Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun they lead the Moonstars , a dissident faction of the Harpers , which sought to arrange the destiny of the cities and nation of the North . Appearance .

title: Laerekh
description: Laerekh Laerekh was a male drow sorcerer and the Chief Necromancer of the cult of Kiaransalee in Maerimydra . Description . Taller than most male drow , Laerekh was almost as tall as a surface elf .

title: Lagiluri
description: Lagiluri Lagiluri was a small village located in Ra - Khati . Geography . Lagiluri was located near the mighty Jumpa River in the foothills of the Katakoro Shan range in northwestern Ra - Khati .

title: Lahnis
description: Lahnis Lahnis was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Lahnis ' s faith in Szass Tam had begun to flag ; he was no longer certain that Tam ' s plot was the best for Thay .

title: Lai Angesstun
description: Lai Angesstun Lai Angesstun was a merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Lai was fixated with money .

title: Lailuu Gyrrite
description: Lailuu Gyrrite Lailuu Gyrrite was the governor of Zalasuu in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Activities . Lailuu spent less time governing her city and more time making preparations for Halruaa ' s defense .

title: Lair of the Hidden
description: Lair of the Hidden The Lair of the Hidden was once an inn in Maerimydra until it was turned into a hidden base for the Hidden during the Silence of Lolth . Location . Located in the north - eastern end of Maerimydra , the Lair of the Hidden was about 200 ft ( 60 .

title: Lair of the Night Masters
description: Lair of the Night Masters The Lair of the Night Masters was the secret lair of Manshoon and his vampire associates during the time he led the Night Masks in the guise of Orbakh . Geography . The lair was located in Westgate ' s sewers and could only be entered through the secret back entrance in a trapped tunnel .

title: Lair of the Unspeakable
description: Lair of the Unspeakable The Lair of the Unspeakable was a secret yikarian location nestled deep beneath the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The lair was actually a large artificially - made cavern located underground .

title: Lakataki
description: Lakataki Lakataki was an azer on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1373 DR . History . Lakataki was the seneschal of the azer Everash Tribe in the Elemental Plane of Fire , acting as an advisor to Lord Cripakolus .

title: Lake Ashane
description: Lake Ashane Lake Ashane , also known as the Lake of Tears , was a large , glacial lake that formed the western border of Rashemen . Geography . Lake Ashane was located on the eastern borders of Narfell and Ashanath , and it was the western border of Rashemen .

title: Lake Donigarten
description: Lake Donigarten Lake Donigarten was a lake in Menzoberranzan . The lake and its island , the Isle of Rothe , were managed by House Hunzrin , which provided rothé cheese and meat to the city . Geography .

title: Lake Esmel
description: Lake Esmel Located on the eastern half of Amn and southeast of the city Esmeltaran for which the lake and the River Esmel are named after , Lake Esmel was a way - point that connected the Sea of Swords to the Snakewood and the Troll Mountains . Description . The lake was unusually deep .

title: Lake Halruaa
description: Lake Halruaa Lake Halruaa was located toward the center of Halruaa . Geography . Filled by the Rivers Halar , Maeru and Aluar , Lake Halruaa dominated the center of the Halruaan landscape .

title: Lake Lhespen
description: Lake Lhespen Lake Lhespen was a medium - sized lake found amid the sprawling plains of the Shaar . Geography . The lake sat several hundred miles inland from the Shining Sea , marking the rough midpoint between Sheirtalar and the Great Rift .

title: Lake Maeru
description: Lake Maeru Lake Maeru was a small body of water found in eastern Halruaa . Geography . Lake Maeru was nestled at the foot of the Muaraghal Mountains .

title: Lake Midai
description: Lake Midai Lake Midai was a small but vital freshwater lake found in Bloodstone Barony . Geography . Lake Midai sat at the foot of the Galena Mountains on the western end of the barony .

title: Lake Mogador
description: Lake Mogador Lake Mogador was a crucial central location in Damara for both commercial and political reasons . Geography . Lake Mogador was literally situated in the center of Damara bordering several major baronies or duchies .

title: Lake Mulsantir
description: Lake Mulsantir Lake Mulsantir was a lake that made up the border of Thesk , Rashemen , and Thay . Geography . Lake Mulsantir was connected to Lake Ashane via the wide River Mulsantir ; together the two lakes made up the western and southern borders of Rashemen .

title: Lake Sember
description: Lake Sember Lake Sember was a medium sized freshwater lake in the southwest of Cormanthyr . It was drained by the Semberflow to the east . The elven community of Semberholme was the on the northern shore of the lake .

title: Lake Weng
description: Lake Weng Lake Weng ( originally called the Lake of Amin ) was a lake in the Cloud Peaks region of Amn . Geography . Lake Weng was a freshwater lake formed by a rocky ridge of the Cloud Peaks stretching from near the city of Crimmor to the city of Amnwater .

title: Lake Woe
description: Lake Woe Lake Woe was a large lake in the North . Description . The lake was full of ice and covered in a thick mist that drifted down from the massive mountain at its center .

title: Lake Woe mountain
description: Lake Woe mountain Lake Woe mountain was one of the tallest mountains in northern Faerûn and the home to a steading of storm giant s . Description . The peak rose high above most cloud cover yet was constantly bombarded by lightning storms .

title: Lake of Blood
description: Lake of Blood The Lake of Blood was a red - tinged lake in Maerimydra . Geography . The Lake of Blood was located in the south - eastern section of Maerimydra , between the slave district and the southern gates .

title: Lake of Mists
description: Lake of Mists The Lake of Mists was the second largest freshwater lake in the Endless Waste . The lake was fed by the heated waters from the Firepeaks and underground thermal springs . Environment .

title: Lake of Shadows
description: Lake of Shadows The Lake of Shadows was a large body of fresh water located in the Middledark beneath the Dagger Hills in the extreme northwest of Cormanthor . Geography . The Lake of Shadows was a tenday from Lake Thoroot , to which it was connected by a river which flowered towards Lake Thoroot .

title: Lake of Steam
description: Lake of Steam The Lake of Steam , also known as Arnaden , was a region in south Faerûn . Despite its name , the Lake of Steam was in fact an inland sea connected to the Shining Sea . Geography .

title: Lake of the Emerald Eye
description: Lake of the Emerald Eye The Lake of the Emerald Eye was located in the Land of the Yak - Men within the dominating heights of the World Pillar Mountains in northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The lake was found within the Red Goat province near the heart of the Yikarian Empire .

title: Lake of the Ghuls
description: Lake of the Ghuls The Lake of the Ghuls was a small body of water found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Geography . This lake was located in the High Desert , specifically in the northern section of the notorious valley known as the Pit of the Ghuls .

title: Lake of the Snake
description: Lake of the Snake The Lake of the Snake is a small lake in the Dragon Coast . The lake is south of the Horse Prairie and east of the Giant ' s Run mountains . The river Reddan feeds the lake .

title: Lakkar
description: Lakkar Lakkar was a frost giant living in the Sword Mountains in the past . He was a loyal follower of the god Thrym and Thrym gifted to Lakkar an artifact known as the Winterforge , which channeled the power of the icy realms within the Elemental Chaos . With this power , Lakkar started a unstoppable war of conquest until he fought the Icehammer dwarves of Icespire Peak .

title: Laksi al - Afyid
description: Laksi al - Afyid Laksi al - Afyid was was a merchant - rogue and business woman in Huzuz . Abilities . She possessed a natural talent for catering to the rich and powerful .

title: Lalaskra
description: Lalaskra Lalaskra of Ormpetarr , also known as " Leatherskin " , was a priestess of Loviatar from Ormpetarr in Sespech , living in the 12th century DR . History . Soon after Bredisker stole the " Tome of Torment " in the Year of the Majesty , 1177 DR , he sold the holiest book of the faith of Ilmater to Lalaskra , an enemy of the church .

title: Lalibela
description: Lalibela Lalibela was a demigoddess of the nixie s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Lalibela lived in a small lake inside The Mines of Bloodstone .

title: Lallara Mediocros
description: Lallara Mediocros Lallara Mediocros was the zulkir of abjuration within the ranks of the Red Wizards of Thay . Description . Lallara was seemingly pale and vital but her age showed in the lines at the corners of her eyes , mouth , and soft flesh beneath her chin .

title: Lalondra Worul
description: Lalondra Worul Lalondra Worul reigned for decades as Shar ' s high priestess . Biography . Lalondra was a young Sharran when she began receiving visions in her dreams from her goddess of the location of a sacred relic , " Gorothir ' s Girdle " .

title: Lamellar
description: Lamellar Lamellar was a type of armor used in Zakhara . Description . Lamellar was similiar to scale armor .

title: Lamet
description: Lamet Lamet was an inhabitant of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Lamet once lived in Port Llast but one day was arrested for the theft of a bottle of wine .

title: Lamia
description: Lamia Lamias were dangerous monstrosities that lived to bring strife and suffering into the world . They were cruel and seductive beings who lured their victims closer to doom with illusions of beauty . Description .

title: Lammasu
description: Lammasu A lammasu is a noble and stern magical beast that looks like a cross between a lion and an eagle . Lammasus seek to promote goodness throughout the world , living in isolated ruins and abandoned temples . They speak Celestial , Common and Draconic .

title: Lamorak Tanthul
description: Lamorak Tanthul Prince Lamorak Tanthul was appointed by his father to oversee the Determinists ' Guild in 1362 DR . It was Lamorak and his fellow Determinist s who administered the tests to each shadovar in order to determine how they may have best served the City of Shade . Lamorak was also in charge of the closely guarded process of selecting and transforming deserving shadovars into shade s .

title: Lamoth
description: Lamoth King Lamoth was the ruler of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast in the 7th century DR . History . Around the early 7th century DR , Chessagol recently came under the rule of King Lamoth and his newly royal family , though they were not considered legitimate .

title: Lamp of Devotion
description: Lamp of Devotion The Lamp of Devotion was a sacred flame for the holy slayer s of the Everlasting within the fortress of Sarahin . History . Located within the Tower of the Dawn , the flame was tended so it burned brightly during all hours of the day , signifying the Everlasting ' s honor of Hajama .

title: Lamp of the four winds
description: Lamp of the four winds Lamps of the four winds were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special lamps were only used by Holy slayer s . Powers .

title: Lamris Kholl
description: Lamris Kholl Lamris Kholl was a cleric of Tymora in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Lamris had a vivacious and unpredictable personality .

title: Lamruil Moonflower
description: Lamruil Moonflower Prince Lamruil Moonflower was the youngest son of the late King Zaor Moonflower and Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . He was the current bearer of the " King ' s Blade " , the most powerful elven moonblade and heir apparent to the throne of Evermeet . Description .

title: Lana
description: Lana Lana was monk , serving as a scribe at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in 1491 DR . Personality . Lana was an honest and stubborn but somewhat shy woman , preferring to observe others .

title: Lana Mara
description: Lana Mara Lana Mara was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Lana was a member of the Champions of Muktar .

title: Lanaxis
description: Lanaxis Lanaxis was a titan of great size and strength and the origin of the titan race . He and Othea claimed the vast cold plains of Faerûn , where Lanaxis constructed the citadel of Voninheim . Relationships .

title: Lance Defenders
description: Lance Defenders The Lance Defenders were the core of Tymanther military forces , a highly trained army of dragonborn soldiers gathered from every clan , who were specialized in fighting with lances and other weapons , both on foot and in aerial combat , mounted on giant bats . Their primary task was to defend Djerad Thymar from dragon attacks , and , because of that , the Lance Barracks , their headquarters , was located in the highest place of the City - Bastion along with the Lance Roost that served as the giant bat stables . Although few thymari dragonborn had a knack for spellcasting , the Lance Defenders maintained a number of spellcaster s among their ranks .

title: Lance of Faerûn
description: Lance of Faerûn A lance of Faerûn is a magic + 2 holy lance . They are mostly heavy lance s but one in ten is a light lance . The lances are made from hardwood with a steel tip and they are created for followers of Torm who use mounts .

title: Lance of faith
description: Lance of faith Lance of faith , also known as searing light , is a sun domain prayer used by many cleric s , particularly devoted clerics . Focusing holy power like a ray of the sun , a cleric casting " lance of faith " projects a blast of light from their implement or open palm towards a target within twenty - five feet , searing them with painful rays of divine brilliance . Additionally , one ally of the cleric visible becomes more likely to strike true in their next attack .

title: Lances of Leilon
description: Lances of Leilon The Lances of Leilon was a group of soldiers that defended the town of Leilon . Organization . This force of about 200 men was always on patrol trying to minimize orc s and goblin s in the area .

title: Lancilon Seenabuck
description: Lancilon Seenabuck Lancilon Seenabuck was an adventurer in Maztica . History . Lancilon was a thief until he tried to steal arquebuse s from the temple of Gond in Lantan but was discovered .

title: Land Under Eternal Ice
description: Land Under Eternal Ice The Land Under Eternal Ice was the goddess Auril ' s domain within the Deep Wilds . It was an eternally frozen land , possibly even the coldest place on any plane . Auril dwelt in the Winter Hall , which floated slowly above the landscape .

title: Land of Fate
description: Land of Fate The boxed set contains a 128 - page book entitled Adventurer ' s Guide to Zakhara which is for players and DMs alike and gives a general overview of the continent , its cities , inhabitants and customs . The second book is 64 pages and is entitled Fortunes and Fates and contains information on running an Al - Qadim campaign , intended for the DM .

title: Land of stability
description: Land of stability Land of stability was an abjuration spell that protected an area from natural disasters . Effects . The area that could be protected was a cube whose sides were no bigger than the caster ' s level times 10 ft ( 3 m ) .

title: Land of the Yak - Men
description: Land of the Yak - Men The Land of the Yak - Men was the term for the geographical region controlled by the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . The southwestern arm of the World Pillar Mountains extended south into Zakhara from the junction of the continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur with the Land of Fate .

title: Lander
description: Lander Lander was a Harper ranger . Personality . Lander was a practical man with a strong focus on his mission .

title: Landon Bhentyl
description: Landon Bhentyl Landon Bhentyl was a male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a former member of the War Wizards and proprietor of Wheloon Tack & Leather . History .

title: Landrise
description: Landrise The Landrise was a large , sprawling cliff that speared through the middle of the Shaar , effectively cutting the region into two halves . Geography . The Landrise originated in the north on the eastern edge of the Firesteap Mountains .

title: Landswith Meilin
description: Landswith Meilin Landswith Meilin was a female half - elf warrior - priest of Tyr the Just and an adventuring knight of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn around 1367 DR . Activities . Landswith Meilin was the quintessential knight in shining armor — she wandered the kingdom in search of noble quests she could undertake , good deeds to do , and wrongs to right .

title: Langdarma
description: Langdarma Langdarma was a very isolated and mysterious country hidden deep within the Yehimal Mountains . Geography . Langdarma was a valley located in the heart of the Yehimal range , surrounded on all sides by high mountain peaks and covered above by thick glacial ice .

title: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath
description: Langdedrosa Cyanwrath Langdedrosa Cyanwrath was a half – blue dragon member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Description . Cyanwrath was seven feet tall with bright blue scales .

title: Lanniver Strayl
description: Lanniver Strayl Lanniver Strayl was a fighter member of the Order of the Gauntlet during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Lanniver was a very respected fighter for the army of good in Faerûn .

title: Lannon siblings
description: Lannon siblings Lannon siblings were villagers of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . These teenagers were contestants of the Harvest Fair brawl .

title: Lanseril Snowmantle
description: Lanseril Snowmantle Lanseril Snowmantle was a druid and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . Description . Lanseril was six feet , two inches tall .

title: Lantan
description: Lantan Lantan was an island - nation in the Trackless Sea north of the Chultan peninsula , known for its advanced technology and the population ' s devout worship of Gond . Geography . It consisted of three separate islands : Lantan proper , which the Sambar Run separates from the southern Suj , and the eastern most and almost uninhabited Orlil .

title: Lantanese language
description: Lantanese language Lantanese , also known as Lantanna , was the official language of Lantan . Speakers . Other regions where Lantanese was commonly spoken included the Nelanther Isles and Tethyr .

title: Lantanna
description: Lantanna The Lantanna were the native human race of the islands of the nation of Lantan . Description . The Lantanna were one of the more recognizable human ethnic groups with their copper - red hair , large , green eyes , and pale , parchment - hued skin tones .

title: Lantern Inn and Boathouse
description: Lantern Inn and Boathouse The Lantern Inn and Boathouse , previously the Lanthorn Inn and the Lantern Inn and Boat Rental , was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Staephon Gylesman , who also rented small boats and barges to guests . History .

title: Lantern archon
description: Lantern archon Lantern archons were celestial beings that appeared as floating balls of light glowing about as brightly as a torch . Only their destruction could extinguish the glow , though they could try to hide it . Lantern archons were friendly beings who were curious about mortals and the mortal world .

title: Lantern light
description: Lantern light Lantern light is an evocation spell that fires divine light from the caster ' s eyes , dealing damage . Effect . Rays of holy light flash from the caster ' s eyes .

title: Lanther Maerown
