description: Lanther Maerown Lanther Maerown , also known as " Smokethroat " for his raspy voice , was the stablemaster of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Lanther had thinning gray hair and a gray mustache .

title: Lao Chin - Mao
description: Lao Chin - Mao Lao Chin - Mao was the most influential scholar in all Shou history . History . Born in 531 Shou Years ( −719 DR ) , Lao spent all his life studying how to improve the behavior and morals of his fellow Shou .

title: Laothan language
description: Laothan language Laothan was a language spoken by the people of Laothan in Malatra . When the Laothan tribes came into contact with neighboring civilizations , they borrowed words and phrases for concepts and things they as yet had no words for . Most of these came from the T ' u Lung language , but as the Laothan pronunciation deviated significantly from the form , it was almost impossible for T ' u Lung speakers to recognize them .

title: Lapaliiya
description: Lapaliiya Lapaliiya ( also known as the Lapal League ) consisted of the land between the Delphin Mountains and the Sheir Peninsula , bounded by the Mhair Jungles , the North Wall of Halruaa , the Bandit Wastes and the Dun Hills . The Cities of the Seabreeze were sometimes misunderstood to describe Lapaliiya , but this phrase also included other cities , such as Narubel , Tashluta , Ormpur , and Procalith . The city of Sheirtalar hosted a Shou Town ( source ) Lapaliiya in 1478 : The confederacy of Lapaliiya crumbled during the Spellplague due to spellfire spreading through a newly formed gap in Halruaa ' s north wall .

title: Lapis lazuli
description: Lapis lazuli Lapis lazuli , incorrectly called in the South , was an ornamental stone found in the Realms . Description . Lapis lazuli was an opaque gem ranging in color from sky blue to dark blue , usually bespeckled with gold .

title: Laraelra Harsard
description: Laraelra Harsard Laraelra Harsard was a human sorceress with minor magic al powers . As of 1479 DR , she was the Blackstaff ' s Heir under Vajra Safahr . Description .

title: Laragunt
description: Laragunt Laragunt of Threskel was an archmage . History . Laragunt was a wizard from Threskel .

title: Larajin
description: Larajin Larajin was the unacknowledged half - elf daughter of Thamalon Uskevren and the wild elf Trisdea of the Tangled Trees . She was also the twin sister of Leifander . Religion .

title: Larak Dardulkyn
description: Larak Dardulkyn Larak Dardulkyn was considered the most powerful independent wizard in Suzail . He was also the richest , acquiring his wealth by working as a freelance mage for noble houses . During King Foril ' s Dragon Council in 1479 DR , the young noble Arclath Delcastle went to Larak ' s mansion and attempted to hire him to find the noble who controlled the blueflame ghost s .

title: Laral Kroul
description: Laral Kroul Laral Kroul was the main delegate for surface - dwellers in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Laral was a cunning and mean individual .

title: Larala Dumian
description: Larala Dumian Larala Dumian was a female half - drow fang of Lolth who degenerated into insanity during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Before Larala underwent her transformation as a fang of Lolth , she had dusty grey skin , but after adopting the " fang scarab " her skin became inky black with numerous tufts of hair covering it .

title: Laranadda
description: Laranadda The Laranadda family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Laranaddas were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Tithlin , and Vandover families .

title: Larch deJuan
description: Larch deJuan Larch deJuan was a young stable hand in Mulmaster . Personality . Larch was a boy with a good heart and happy with his life .

title: Larendrammagar
description: Larendrammagar Larendrammagar , more commonly known as Nexus , was a great wyrm gold dragon that had a role in the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Larendrammagar was one of the oldest gold dragons and reputed to be the most talented spellcaster among the metallic dragon s .

title: Lareth
description: Lareth His Resplendence , Lareth , the King of Justice , was once the ruler of gold dragon s He was killed in 1373 DR . Death . In 1373 DR , Lareth was slain in battle by the gold dragon , Tamarand .

title: Larethar Gulgrin
description: Larethar Gulgrin Larethar Gulgrin was a gold dwarf rogue from Luskan . Relationships . His closest ally was Illydia Maethellyn .

title: Larga Bloodhand
description: Larga Bloodhand Larga Bloodhand was a orog warlord in Thar near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , she went with her bodyguards to meet the black dragon Throstulgrael , who had recently settled near Twilight Marsh .

title: Laric
description: Laric Laric was the Captain of the Bloodriders , the personal guard of Grunnarch the Red . History . In 1345 DR , Laric accompanied Grunnarch the Red to Oman ' s Isle to the council before attacking the Ffolk cities in the southern cities of the Moonshae Isles .

title: Larid Herokimal
description: Larid Herokimal Larid Herokimal was a human paladin , a war hero , and the baron of the city of Kelazzan in Ulgarth around 1367 DR and 1373 DR . Personality . Herokimal was a devoutly religious paladin .

title: Larikal Dyrr
description: Larikal Dyrr Larikal Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Larikal was the third daughter of matron mother Yasraena Dyrr .

title: Larion Keenblade
description: Larion Keenblade Larion Keenblade was a member of Severin ' s reformed Cult of the Dragon . History . He was forcibly conscripted into the Cult and not very happy about his situation .

title: Larissa Neathal
description: Larissa Neathal Larissa Neathal was a courtesan and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Larissa had red hair .

title: Larloch
description: Larloch Larloch , called the Shadow King , was a Netherese male human and a lich . He was the former Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Jiksidur in ancient Netheril and later the master of the Warlock ' s Crypt and Shadow King of its undead inhabitants . He was one of the oldest non - draconic beings in Faerûn and one of the most powerful mages .

title: Larloch ' s minor drain
description: Larloch ' s minor drain Larloch ' s minor drain was an arcane necromancy spell that drained the life of a target creature . Effects . The spell drained a small portion of life from a target creature and transferred it to the caster , healing them of any injuries they add .

title: Larmon Greenboot
description: Larmon Greenboot Larmon Greenboot was a shepherd in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Larmon led his sheep to graze in the Sumber Hills .

title: Laroun
description: Laroun Laroun or Lauroun was a human Warlord of the " Free City of Waterdeep " ( later known simply as Waterdeep ) and the city ' s first female Warlord . Description . Laroun had cerulean eyes , a hawklike nose , and a strong brow .

title: Larrakh
description: Larrakh Larrakh was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Red Larch who was in contact with the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . The priest hoped to redeem himself in the eyes of his cultist masters by conquering Red Larch .

title: Larrana Vestel
description: Larrana Vestel Larrana Vestel was a human explorer and guide who operated throughout Gontal , mainly in the Glaur Barrens . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Larrana was renowned in Gontal for her skills as an adventuress and for being brave enough to explore the Glaur Barrens .

title: Larry Elmore
description: Larry Elmore Larry Elmore is a prolific fantasy illustrator , who has produced work for many settings . He was the author of " SnarfQuest Tales " , a comic series of " Dragon " magazine . Education .

title: Larva
description: Larva Abyssal larvae , also called soul larvae , are not unlike grubs or rot grubs . When people are corrupted by chaos and evil , these chaotic evil mortal souls flow to the Abyss . Larvae can , if given enough time become demon lords .

title: Larynda Telenna
description: Larynda Telenna Larynda Telenna was the high priestess of Kiaransalee in the Vault of Gnashing Teeth beneath Vaasa . She was also the leader of Kiaransalee ' s cult across the entirety of Faerûn . History .

title: Lasaonar
description: Lasaonar Lasaonar was a drow swordmaster living in Ust Natha . Activities . He was known to participate in duels in the local tavern ' s fighting pit .

title: Lasfelro
description: Lasfelro Lasfelro the Silent was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Lasfelro usually remained silent , hence his moniker , but sometimes he broke into merry song or short bouts of joke - telling .

title: Lashan Aumersair
description: Lashan Aumersair Lashan Aumersair was the ruler of Scardale until he attempted a war of conquest in the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , to unite the Dalelands under his rule . History . A direct descendant of Elminster ( the Aumersair name was a corruption of " Aumar ' s heir " ) , Lashan was descended from a long line of Purple Dragons and Harpers .

title: Lashilmbrar
description: Lashilmbrar Lashilmbrar the Sly was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Lashilmbrar was the second son of King Imphras II and Lasheela of Dilpur .

title: Lashrael
description: Lashrael Lashrael was a solar in the service of Corellon living in Arvandor . History . In 1379 DR , Lashrael and his fellow Felarathael went to the Fugue Plane under the orders of Corellon Larethian to retrieve the Darksong Knight Cavatina Xarann .

title: Lashyrr Maerdrymm
description: Lashyrr Maerdrymm Lashyrr Maerdrymm was the leader of the dukar Order of Numos in Myth Nantar . Activiities . Lashyrr was the most visible of the dukar paragons , despite her status .

title: Lasishal Ama
description: Lasishal Ama Lasishal Ama was the greatest spirit in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . She was the most powerful river spirit , famous for assisting many legendary heroes , and punishing those who had sought to despoil the land . She was presumed to live inside the Ama River .

title: Laspar
description: Laspar Laspar was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Description . Laspars appeared similar to " squat cedar s " .

title: Laspeera Inthré
description: Laspeera Inthré Laspeera Inthré ( sometimes informally called Speera , Mother , and Mother Laspeera ) was a human female and warden of the War Wizards of Cormyr . Biography . Born Laspeera Naerinth , she was married to Aundable Inthré , a fellow War Wizard of Cormyr , and was second - in - command of that group under the leadership of Caladnei .

title: Lassalar Ormitar
description: Lassalar Ormitar Lassalar Ormitar was a male human fighter in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , he was head of the Ormitar noble house , a member of the High Council that governed Tantras , and commanded the Guard , the military force that defended and policed the city . Although the Guard was directly responsible to the Council , its loyalties lay with Lassalar , who was more serious about restricting merchant freedoms in favour of law and order .

title: Last judgment
description: Last judgment Last judgment is a necromancy spell that strikes evil creatures dead and banishes their souls to the Lower Planes . Effects . Reciting a list of the targets ’ evil deeds , you call down the judgment of the heavens upon their heads .

title: Lastraeya Indomurr
description: Lastraeya Indomurr Lastraeya Indomurr was a human woman of Chessenta who moved to the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . In the mid – 14th century DR , she held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat . History .

title: Latar
description: Latar Latar was a male troglodyte cleric who roamed the Deep Wastes leading raids for his tribe . Description . Latar wore breastplate armor and wielded an oversized morningstar .

title: Lateu ' quor
description: Lateu ' quor Lateu ' quor , the Forest Communion of the Crescent Moon , was a religious ceremony in which the elven deity Corellon was praised by his followers and his gift of creativity honored . It was held once per lunar month , when the moon was in its quarter phase , a crescent , and softly illuminating the night sky . Followers of the elven deity Corellon gathered in moonlit glades , where they praised their Creator through music , song , and dance and offerings of beautiful artwork .

title: Lathander
description: Lathander Lathander ( pronounced " lah - THAN - der " ) , whose title was The Morninglord , was a deity of creativity , dawn , renewal , birth , athletics , spring , self - perfection , vitality and youth . He favored those who dispelled the undead and blessed those who planted new life . Lathander was also the god called upon to bless birth and fertility related ceremonies .

title: Lathander ' s Light
description: Lathander ' s Light Lathander ' s Light was the local temple to the Morninglord in Dagger Falls . Location . Situated within the walls on the east side of town this solid stone building faced the rising sun .

title: Lathander ' s red
description: Lathander ' s red Lathander ' s Red was a variety of wine brewed by the priest s of Lathander in Dagger Falls . Description . A valuable red wine , it was typically kept in small casks below Lathander ' s Light .

title: Lathery
description: Lathery Lathery , also written Lachery , was a Netherese enclave of Netheril that specialized in fishing , using its " mythallar " to do so . It was found hovering over the Narrow Sea , moving along its shoreline . Economy .

title: Lathtarl ' s Lantern
description: Lathtarl ' s Lantern Latherl ' s Lantern is a small fishing village on the Sword Coast at the mouth of the Winding Water . It is close to the Warlock ' s Crypt . History .

title: Latifa ibn Morim
description: Latifa ibn Morim Latifa ibn Morim was a half - elf sand mage within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Latifa served as one of the Grand Vizier ' s assistants .

title: Latovenomer
description: Latovenomer Latovenomer was a green dragon who lived within the Great Swamp of Rethild in western Dambrath . Activities . Latovenomer had a lair hidden deep beneath the waters of the swamp .

title: Laughing Goblin Inn
description: Laughing Goblin Inn The Laughing Goblin Inn was not necessarily Phlan ' s fanciest inn , but the inn was definitely Phlan ' s busiest . History . One busy night in 1340 DR , Ren o ' the Blade challenged three female human fighter s to lift and carry a serving tray from their table to the bar , but the tray turned out to be an old heavy shield and the ranger tricked Salen , Jensena , and Gwen out of a bagful of gold .

title: Laughing hare
description: Laughing hare The laughing hare was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a hare . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .

title: Laughingflow
description: Laughingflow The Laughingflow , also known as the Trollflow in Nesmé , was a river located in the Evermoors . Description . The clear , fast - flowing river had a gravel bottom and banks lined with felsul , laspar , and a few blueleaf trees .

title: Lauratha Delrym
description: Lauratha Delrym Lauratha Delrym was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Trueseed that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Description . Lauratha had dark hair and plain features .

title: Lauren DeVillars
description: Lauren DeVillars Lady Lauren DeVillars was an influential noble in Ravens Bluff , and a retired member of the Cleric Circle from ? – ? Appearance .

title: Lauryn Shavvyrstar
description: Lauryn Shavvyrstar Lauryn Shavvyrstar was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Chyndrie Stormwind , Noelin Tlestlin .

title: Lauzoril
description: Lauzoril Lauzoril was the Zulkir of Enchantment and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . Personality . Laurozil was a relatively young man for his level and was always very charming to anyone he talks to .

title: Lava missile
description: Lava missile Overview . The Lava Missile spell shoots forth a missile of lava , striking unerringly a designated target that has less than total cover . When the target is unable to thwart the missile , the scorching hot lava will ignite whatever clothing or armor the spellcaster ' s opponent wears .

title: Lava splash
description: Lava splash Lava splash was a divine conjuration spell that created a wave of lava . Effect . The lava wave splashed over a designated area some 40 feet ( 12 .

title: Laviguer
description: Laviguer Laviguer was a mining town in the kingdom of Impiltur in northeast Faerûn . Geography . It lay in the Uplands of northwestern Impiltur , at the foot of the Earthspur Mountains , at the end of the Prince ' s Road .

title: Lavok Corthala
description: Lavok Corthala < / ref > Lavok Corthala was a powerful human wizard living in Athkatla , Amn , in the 1360s DR . History . Lavok was a mighty wizard , with an interest in necromancy .

title: Law of the Loregiver
description: Law of the Loregiver The Law of the Loregiver was a set of universal beliefs based on the teachings of the Loregiver that united a continent , literally transforming the burning land of Zakhara into the " Land of Fate . " History & Legend . Legend stated that the Loregiver transcribed the Law for the benefit of all Zakharans .

title: Law sphere
description: Law sphere The Law sphere was a group of spells granted to lawful crusader s . This sphere is the counterbalance to the sphere of chaos , promoting obedience , order , and the power of cooperation . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Lawantha Silendia
description: Lawantha Silendia Dutchess - Consort Lawantha Silendia Blackthorn was a Calishite sorceress and member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Personality . Lawantha had no interest in the politics of Tethyr but was deeply loyal to the Company of Eight ; however , in typical Calishite fashion , she did not hide her disinterest well .

title: Lawful evil
description: Lawful evil Lawful evil is the methodical , intentional , and frequently successful devotion to a cruel organized system . In 4th edition mechanics for " " lawful evil is found under the umbrella of the evil alignment . A lawful evil character methodically takes what he wants within the limits of his personal code of conduct without regard for whom it hurts .

title: Lawful good
description: Lawful good A lawful good character upholds society and its laws , believing that these laws are created to work for the good and prosperity of all . He is both honest and benevolent . He will work within the established system to change it for the better , and strives to bring order to goodness that other good - aligned characters might pool their resources to better the world .

title: Lawful neutral
description: Lawful neutral A lawful neutral character is directed by law , logic , tradition , or a personal code . Order and organization are paramount to him . He may believe in personal order and live by a code or standard , or he may believe in order for all and favor a strong , organized government .

title: Laws of Cormyr
description: Laws of Cormyr In 1368 DR , the following laws are posted at all major entry points to Cormyr . When this started or was / if discontinued is unknown Laws of Cormyr Regal Rules . Only someone with Obarskyr blood may assume the crown .

title: Lawyers !
description: Lawyers ! " Lawyers ! " is the 23rd issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by .

title: Lawyers ( Waterdeep )
description: Lawyers ( Waterdeep ) Commonly called the lawyers , a band of legal professionals briefly tried to establish themselves in Waterdeep in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR . Membership . The lawyers wore dark robes and strange hats .

title: Lay of the Purple Dragons
description: Lay of the Purple Dragons The Lay of the Purple Dragons was a ballad about King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . The " Lay " embellished the historical account for added heroism , adding extra dragon s , knight s , and magic . At one point , even the god s appear before King Azoun to bless his crusade .

title: Layers of the Abyss
description: Layers of the Abyss Each layer of the Abyss is different from all the others , the only apparent similarity being that the plane seems to try and inflict as much harm on travelers with each layer as possible . It might even be said that the plane is as varied and evil as the demons who inhabit it . Even deities dwell in the Abyss , like Umberlee and Merrshaulk , as well as Demon Lords that are mostly worshiped by one kind of species , such as Sess ' innek , the lord of lizardfolk who makes his home on the seventh layer , " Phantom Plane , " and Vaprak , patron of ogre s , ogre mage s and troll s .

title: Lazlo Buckman
description: Lazlo Buckman Lazlo Buckman was a male human and mayor of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . After Georg Redfell died , Laszlo became the new mayor of West Harbor .

title: Lazlo Lunk
description: Lazlo Lunk Lazlo Lunk was a high - ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Lazlo was a member of the Champions of Muktar .

title: Lazy Moon Inn
description: Lazy Moon Inn The Lazy Moon Inn was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast , owned by Faress . It was well located in the city , lying on Shendle Street . Around 1358 DR , it was always busy , a good quality establishment with only middling prices .

title: Le ' Quella
description: Le ' Quella House Le ' Quella is a moon elf house known for its unconventional dress sense and the contentious ( but friendly ) relations between its members . As of 1368 DR it is led by Huquethae Le ' Quella . Its estate is in Leuthilspar , on Evermeet , and consists of a magically grown building of wood and leaves .

title: LeShay
description: LeShay A leShay was an immortal , albino , elf - like fey creature of extraordinary magical power . Some scholars believe that the leShay were one of the creator race s . Description .

title: Leahon Woumar
description: Leahon Woumar Leahon Woumar was a man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a miller and proprietor of Woumar ' s Wheloon Mill . History .

title: Leap for the Throat
description: Leap for the Throat The Leap for the Throat was a pirate vessel active in Suq Bay along Dihl al - Suq in 1367 DR . Activities . Almari bint - Kafira was the captain of the " Leap for the Throat " .

title: Leaping Hart Tavern
description: Leaping Hart Tavern The Leaping Hart Tavern was the most popular tavern in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . It also served as an inn and a gambling hall , and was the center of gossip in the city . Services .

title: Leaping fish
description: Leaping fish The leaping fish was a magical chalice that was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description . It was carved in the shape of a fish with its open mouth serving as the cup .

title: Leather Market
description: Leather Market The Leather Market was a semi - annual fair held in the spring and fall seasons in Duirtanal , Semphar . Activities . Each Leather Market was held for one week at a time .

title: Leather armor
description: Leather armor Leather armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Leather armor was made from leather .

title: Leaves of Green
description: Leaves of Green The Leaves of Green was a divine spellbook and a holy book of Silvanus . Description . It appeared to be a flat oval - shaped piece of fissured dark gray bark with a triangle of three circles scratched on its inner surface .

title: Leaves of Learning
description: Leaves of Learning The Leaves of Learning was a temple dedicated to Oghma in Highmoon in the Dalelands and contained one of best libraries in Faerûn . Location . Situated at the southern end of Highmoon Hill , the Leaves of Learning towered over the streets of Highmoon in Deepingdale .

title: Leda Widris
description: Leda Widris Leda Widris was a mercenary just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Leda was an honest and courageous woman .

title: Leech
description: Leech Leech was a healer in Skullport . History . During his youth , Leech studied under a crackpot Calishite chirurgeon .

title: Leevoth
description: Leevoth Leevoth was the captain of the guard of the city of Thultanthar and a powerful Shadovar . History . At first , Leevoth studied to be a wizard , but soon realized his love for war and fighting and decided to train as warrior .

title: Lefeber ' s mark
description: Lefeber ' s mark Lefeber ' s mark was an inventive arcanist spell of small power . It was developed by inventor Lefeber in 1725 NY ( - 2134 DR ) during Netheril ' s Golden Age . Knowledge of its effect was lost in later ages , but given its name and comparable power it is possible that " Lefeber ' s mark " was the Netherese name for the spell " wizard mark " .

title: Legacy of the Drow
description: Legacy of the Drow The Legacy of the Drow is the third series of novels about Drizzt Do ' Urden written by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition
description: Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition Legacy of the Drow Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the four novels in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Legacy of the Green Regent
description: Legacy of the Green Regent Legacy of the Green Regent was an RPGA campaign based mostly in the Delimbiyr Vale . 28 modules were supposedly written over 3 years to be distributed to registered Dungeon Masters and played at events such as GenCon and Winter Fantasy . These modules were then supposed to be made commercially available .

title: Legend of Drizzt
description: Legend of Drizzt The Legend of Drizzt series reissued the many novels about Drizzt Do ' Urden , re - numbered in chronological order . All the novels are by R . A .

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate Legends of Baldur ' s Gate is a series of " Forgotten Realms " comic books published by as part of the " Tyranny of Dragons " storyline . It is continued in the series " Shadows of the Vampire " and " Frost Giant ' s Fury " . Summary .

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 1
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 1 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 2
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 2 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 2 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 3
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 3 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 3 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 4
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 4 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 4 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .

title: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 5
description: Legends of Baldur ' s Gate 5 Legends of Baldur ' s Gate # 5 is a comic published by set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is a part of the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . It is written by Jim Zub , drawn by Max Dunbar , and edited by John Barber .

title: Legion of the Chimera
description: Legion of the Chimera The Legion of the Chimera was an evil organization which operated in the Severed Hand , an elven citadel within the Spine of the World . History . Founding .

title: Lehtinan
description: Lehtinan Lehtinan was the owner of the Copper Coronet tavern in the city of Athkatla , Amn . Personality . He was involved in many criminal dealings , primarily prostitution and gambling on slave pit - fights .

title: Leilon
description: Leilon Leilon was a small mining town that served as a convenient resting place for weary travelers on the High Road between Neverwinter and Waterdeep . Politics . The town was a member in good standing with the Lords ' Alliance , thanks to the efforts of its leader Lord Pelindar Filmarya .

title: Leira
description: Leira Leira ( LAIR - ah or LAIR - uh ) , also known as The Lady of Deception or The Lady of the Mists , was the goddess of deception and illusion s and patroness of illusionists and liars . Personality . She was an enigma , never telling the truth when falsehood would do .

title: Lelavdra Tanthul
description: Lelavdra Tanthul Lelavdra Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade . History . In 1487 DR , Lelavdra and her sister Manarlume Tanthul were summoned by the High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who ordered them to gather in a kind of club all the young ambitious arcanist s , and seduce the most suspicious in order to uncover all plots against Telamont .

title: Leldon
description: Leldon Leldon was a male human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Leldon was one of the thieves in Neverwinter .

title: Leleanor
description: Leleanor Leleanor was a descendant of Aurora of Aurora ' s Emporium . History . Leleanor was a businesswoman who wanted to regrow the business of her ancestor , which was at that time limited to a few outlets in major cities like Waterdeep , Baldur ' s Gate , and Westgate .

title: Lelia
description: Lelia Imam Lelia , also known as the Voice of the Beautiful Moon , was the High Priest of the Mosque of Beauteous Selan in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . As of 1367 Lelia ' s blue eyes sparkled with the vigor of youth .

title: Leliana Vrinn
description: Leliana Vrinn Leliana Vrinn was a drow priestess of Eilistraee , a protector of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden and the mother of Rowaan Vrinn , the head priestess of the Misty Forest shrine . Together with Qilué Veladorn and Cavatina Xarann she is one of the main characters among the priestesses of Eilistraee in The Lady Penitent Trilogy . Along with the other followers of Eilistraee and drow of Miyeritari descent without Wendonai ´s taint , she was transformed into a dark elf during Flamerule 1379 DR by Q ' arlynd Melarn ´s High Magic and the grace of Eilistraee .

title: Lemure
description: Lemure Lemures were among the weakest devils . Lemures are the shock troops and laborers of the devils . The most selfish , cruel , and evil mortals that die and come to Hell become lemures .

title: Lendarn
description: Lendarn Lendarn was an evil wizard who , together with an ogre , led a group of kobold s in attacking the halfling village of Gullykin . Eventually , Gorion ' s Ward chose to help the halflings kill the kobolds and in the end , Gorion ' s Ward defeated Lendarn .

title: Lendys
description: Lendys Lendys ( pronounced " LEN - dis " ) was the lawful neutral dragon god of justice and the judge of dragons in life instead of after death . He was the consort of Tamara , and was commonly worshiped alongside her and Bahamut , who in some traditions was considered to be their son . Description .

title: Leneka Jheth
description: Leneka Jheth Leneka Jheth was a Zhent lich . Biography . Leneka was a powerful lich .

title: Lennithon
description: Lennithon Lennithon was a adult blue dragon allied with the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Lennithon helped the cultists in the assault on Greenest but with little enthusiasm . He was last seen attacking a traitor to the Cult of the Dragon at Xonthal ' s Tower .

title: Lenta Moore
description: Lenta Moore Lenta Moore was a member of the Watch of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . History . Lenta was the daughter of an Upper City rich merchant member of the Parliament of Peers .

title: Leomund ' s secure shelter
description: Leomund ' s secure shelter Leomund ' s secure shelter is a conjuration spell that creates a sturdy cottage . It was presumably developed by Leomund . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as secure shelter , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Leonal ' s roar
description: Leonal ' s roar Named for leonal guardinal s , leonal ' s roar is an evocation spell that kills , paralyzes , or weakens non - good subjects , and deals sonic damage . Effect . This spell has the effect of a " holy word " , and it additionally deals moderate sonic damage to nongood creatures in the area .

title: Leopard
description: Leopard Leopards were big cats . They dwelt in forested mountains , hills , and plains . They had rosettes similar to those of the jaguar , but the leopard ' s rosettes were smaller and more densely packed , and did not usually have central spots .

title: Leopard Shan
description: Leopard Shan The Leopard Shan , or the Mountain of the Leopard , was a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Howling Gap , the lone peak of the Leopard Shan stood as a prominent landmark in the Hordelands .

title: Leosin Erlanthar
description: Leosin Erlanthar Leosin Erlanthar was a monk from Berdusk and a member of the Harpers who researched the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Leosin noted the unusual actions of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons and decided to investigate the matter .

title: Lerek
description: Lerek Lerek was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . History . Lerek was one of the cultists that dealt with Red Wizard of Thay necromancer Zaralda .

title: Lernaean hydra
description: Lernaean hydra The hydra of legend was extremely deadly . The creature was poisonous in every way . Its bite was poisonous ; as was its blood .

title: Lessa Amyselnar
description: Lessa Amyselnar Lessa Amyselnar was a human female priest ess of Tymora at The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . Lessa ' s father was a priest of Tymora , instilling his faith into daughter since she was young .

title: Lessen gravity
description: Lessen gravity Lessen gravity was an alteration spell used to weaken gravity ' s pull within a targeted area . This spell was created by Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .

title: Lesser deity
description: Lesser deity A lesser deity was a type of deity ranked below an intermediate deity or a greater deity . They were , however , above demigod s in the ranking of powers . Follower Base .

title: Lesser ironguard
description: Lesser ironguard Ironguard was an arcane spell that used the opposing schools of abjuration and alteration to temporarily render one creature immune and intangible to non - magical metal . After an improved version was developed , this spell became known as lesser ironguard . Effects .

title: Lesser planar binding
description: Lesser planar binding Lesser planar binding is a conjuration spell that traps an outsider until it performs a task . Effect . Casting this spell attempts a dangerous act : to lure a creature from another plane to a specifically prepared trap , which must lie within the spell ' s range .

title: Lesser restoration
description: Lesser restoration Lesser restoration , and a more limited version known as restore strength , were conjuration and necromancy spells ( respectively ) that removed a temporary handicap caused by certain creature attacks , poisons , and magical effects . Effects . The necromantic version of this spell , " restore strength " , could only alleviate temporary losses of strength , whereas the conjuration version returned lost strength , constitution , dexterity , intelligence , wisdom , or charisma ( only one of these characteristics per casting of " lesser restoration " ) .

title: Lesser shadow tentacle
description: Lesser shadow tentacle Lesser shadow tentacle is an abjuration spell that transmutes a nearby shadow into a ropelike tentacle . Effect . You can animate any nearby shadow into a ropelike tentacle .

title: Lestra Urmbrusk
description: Lestra Urmbrusk Lestra Urmbrusk was the master of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1476 DR Quarren Urmbrusk , the lord of the House , abandoned his duty in order to went to adventure .

title: Leucrotta
description: Leucrotta The leucrotta is a magical beast ; a ugly mix of a stag ' s body and legs , a lion ' s tail and a wedge shapped head much like a giant badger ' s . They constantly emit a noxious stench and their oily skin appears , and smells , rancid . They do not actually have teeth , but rather a jagged bony ridge as strong as adamantine .

title: Leuthilspar
description: Leuthilspar Leuthilspar was the capital of the island of Evermeet and lay on the east coast , situated at the mouth of the River Ardulith . An area of grassland known as the Greenmeadow lay north of the city , across the river . The elves believed that if Leuthilspar were to fall , it would bring an end to elves on Toril .

title: Levast River
description: Levast River Levast River was a river in eastern Tethyr that was a tributary of the Idolflow . Etymology . The river was believed to have been named after a dwarven clansman .

title: Levia Shadewalker
description: Levia Shadewalker Levia Shadewalker was the half - elven spymistress of the Eye of Justice in Westgate . Levia was Gedrin Thalavar ' s apprentice and she considered herself his adopted daughter . Description .

title: Leviathan
description: Leviathan The leviathan was a huge whale and child proxy of the Earthmother of the Moonshae Isles . Description . A great black - skinned whale , the leviathan was larger than any whale naturally found on Toril .

title: Levitate
description: Levitate Levitate was a transmutation spell or supernatural ability that allowed the caster to move a creature or object vertically as desired . Some races native to Faerûn , such as the air genasi , had the innate ability to levitate . During the religious ceremony of the Dance of the Swirling Winds , the elven goddess Aerdrie Faenya would sometimes grant her worshipers who could not fly the power to levitate .

title: Lewy Jons
description: Lewy Jons Lewy Jons was a male human inhabitant of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Lewy was a farmer of the West Harbor .

title: Lewy Jons ' hog
description: Lewy Jons ' hog Lewy Jons ' hog was a pig of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Lewy Jons was a farmer of the West Harbor .

title: Lhaaril
description: Lhaaril Lhaaril was the shadovar seneschal to Prince Brennus Tanthul . History . In 1484 DR , Lhaaril announced to Brennus that his father Telamont Tanthul had just arrived in Sakkors to speak with Brennus .

title: Lhargloroth
description: Lhargloroth Lhargloroth was a dragon who lived in Oroth , in the realm of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . As of 1479 DR , Lhargloroth was experimenting in Oroth , using living creatures to create strange monsters , most of them gibbering mouther s or rare sterile beasts , although a few of those were able to breed true .

title: Lherzona Ludwakazar
description: Lherzona Ludwakazar Lherzona Ludwakazar was a dwarf of the Ludwakazar clan in the Earthspur Mountains in 1491 DR . History . Lherzona lived with her father King Iorn Ludwakazar and the rest of her clan in the Earthspur Mountains , acting as custodians of the mystical Chamber of Falling Stones .

title: Lheshayl
description: Lheshayl Lheshayl was a small city in the Shining Plains . Geography . The city sat on the southwestern side of the Shining Plains and was the only city on the west side .

title: Lhestyn
description: Lhestyn Lhestyn ( the Masked Lady ) was a human and one of the Open Lords of Waterdeep . Relatives . Lhestyn was the child of Baeron and Shilarn , two other Lords of Waterdeep .

title: Lhoris
description: Lhoris Lhoris was a fiery - tempered boy from Fireshear . Appearance . Lhoris had flaming red hair .

title: Lhrek Jarsyn
description: Lhrek Jarsyn Lhrek Jarsyn was a mercenary in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Lhrek was a high - ranking member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea mercenary company .

title: Lhuvenhead
description: Lhuvenhead Lhuvenhead was a village in the Rauvin Vale within Luruar . Geography . Lhuvenhead was located along the River Rauvin , forty miles upriver from Everlund along the trail between Everlund and Sundabar .

title: Li Kao - teh
description: Li Kao - teh Li Kao - teh was a shou who lived within the town of Ansi within the Quoya Desert during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Li owned a caravansary where an assortment of regular goods could be acquired .

title: Li Kit Su
description: Li Kit Su Li Kit Su was an old shen lung living near the town of Aru in Wa . Lair . Li Kit Su lived for more than a millennium in the Yama - san river , spending most of time sleeping .

title: Li Koi
description: Li Koi Li Koi was a librarian in Kesasar Valley in Shou Lung . Activities . Li Koi was the head librarian of the legendary Great Library of Perpustakaan .

title: Liam Lenter
description: Liam Lenter Liam Lenter was a human bard and the " High Wheel " ( town leader ) of Amnwater , Amn as of 1368 DR . Activities . His official job was to maintain the welfare and defense of the town , but the position was largely powerless being easily influenced by the three most powerful families in the town .

title: Liam Sunmist
description: Liam Sunmist Liam Sunmist was a cleric of Lathander in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Liam managed the biggest religious center of the duchy , the Moonglow Tower , and was directly supported by the duke .

title: Liar ' s Dice
description: Liar ' s Dice Liar ' s Dice was a popular gambling game in Harglast , one of the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Background . Liar ' s Dice was a very random game .

title: Library of Tarchamus
description: Library of Tarchamus The Library of Tarchamus was a secret library hidden deep inside a mountain in ancient Netheril in a location a few days journey from present day Everlund . The library was built by the legendary arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding both as a repository for his knowledge and as a trap for his Netherese rivals . Many Netherese arcanists fell victim to traps or Tarchamus ' mummy while searching the library for his secrets .

title: Lich
description: Lich Liches were an almost universally evil form of undead spellcaster of great power , usually wizards , but they could also be sorcerers or clerics . They were feared by mortal beings for their malign magic , their intelligence and their willingness to embrace undeath for a chance to live forever ( or rather , " exist " forever ) . Physical description .

title: Lich touch
description: Lich touch Lich touch was an arcane necromancy spell that temporarily granted the caster the power of a lich ' s chilling touch as well as immunity from most lich - like abilities and effects . Effects . By means of this spell , a necromancer gained the painful paralyzing touch of a lich .

title: Lichen
description: Lichen Lichen can be found in various places in the " Forgotten Realms " , including the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Types of lichen . Medquat .

title: Lichling
description: Lichling A lichling was a creature spawned from a demilich . Description . It resembled a cockroach with a pair of insect - like wings , two pairs of human - like arms , a pair of human - like legs , and a human skull for a head , containing razor - sharp fangs .

title: Lidahan
description: Lidahan Lidahan was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the jungles and valleys of the Shao Mountains of southwestern Kara - Tur . The nine largest valleys each had their own dialect , the most sophisticated and developed of which was that of the Mahasiswa people of the Kesasar Valley . Appendix .

title: Lieko
description: Lieko A lieko was a gold coin minted and used as currency in the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn around 1367 DR . Very much like the standard gold piece , liekos bore images of King Caladorn the Wise ( the front ) and a mounted knight ( the back ) .

title: Liela
description: Liela Liela was a bureaucrat in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Liela ' s heart beat only for business .

title: Lieshann
description: Lieshann Lieshann was a female minstrel from Ordulin in Sembia . History . Lieshann once journeyed through the Vast , travelling from Tavilar to Kurth .

title: Life - stealer
description: Life - stealer Life - stealers are among the most terrifying of those warlock s who parlay with devil s . From their literally infernal dealings these powerful arcane spellcaster s obtain the ability to become vampire s of a sort , though not literally so , for life - stealers have learned to harness the power of life itself . Sapping away at the animus or “ life force ” of their enemies , life - stealers are deadly predators .

title: Life among the Tuigan
description: Life among the Tuigan Life among the Tuigan was a book written by the lama Koja of Khazari in the early 1360s DR . Following King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Koja was a guest of Azoun , living in Suzail in Cormyr for over a year . While there , on the king ' s request , he wrote up an account of his experiences with the Tuigan and their culture .

title: Life domain
description: Life domain Berronar Truesilver , Chauntea and Silvanus were the deities most attuned to the life domain . To the revered mother of dwarfs , kinship was the most essential part of life , and a new life was an extension of the family . The Forest Father and The Great Mother both strongly encouraged the birthing of new life , though Silvanus cared foremost about life in the wilderness and was known to unleash his wrath if someone attempted to harm the lush beauty of nature , while Chauntea had respect and love for all living things .

title: Life of Rebrum
description: Life of Rebrum The Life of Rebrum was a bawdy autobiography of the life of the travelling merchant Rebrum of Sheirtalar . It was written around 1210 DR and was frequently copied . In it , among other things , Rebrum wrote of the " Aleave " trade - fair in Vaerndoun in the Underdark .

title: Life water
description: Life water Life water was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This wondrous spell transformed any liquid into a magical serum capable of healing wounds , curing blindness , disease , poison , rot , feeblemindedness , etc .

title: Lifeproof
description: Lifeproof Lifeproof was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Lifeproof safely removed a vital portion of the target ' s life , even through solid objects .

title: Lifesurge
description: Lifesurge Lifesurge was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was primarily used by ghul lord s . Effects .

title: Lifferlas
description: Lifferlas Lifferlas was was an awakened tree in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . A druid of the Emerald Enclave gave life to Lifferlas .

title: Light
description: Light Light was a very common spell learned by most spellcasters . Depending on how the caster was trained , " light " was either a cantrip or a first - level spell . In some spellcasting traditions this spell was reversible and called darkness when reversed .

title: Light Tube
description: Light Tube The Light Tube was an invention by Cadderly Bonaduce . Design . The tube itself was a foot - long cylinder two inches in diameter .

title: Light burst
description: Light burst Light burst weapons produced a blinding flash of light on a severe hit to the target . Creation . A spellcaster who wished to enchant a weapon with the " light burst " property had to have the " daylight " spell available .

title: Light domain
description: Light domain The Light domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the aspect of light . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Light hammer
description: Light hammer A light hammer is a light , martial melee weapon of the hammer family that can be used as a ranged weapon . Description . The light hammer is a small sledge hammer , usually with a haft made of wood about one and a half feet long ( 45cm ) .

title: Light mace
description: Light mace A light mace is a simple melee weapon , much like a small club made from metal . Description . A light mace is little more than a metal club with flanges , knobs , or ridges of metal placed symmetrically around the head .

title: Light of Heavens
description: Light of Heavens Light of Heavens is a non - player character in " Neverwinter Nights 2 " . History . During the evacuation of Neverwinter in Act III , the Kalach - Cha encountered the Light of Heavens in the Merchant ' s District , where the deva tried to get a feel for now - Knight - Captain of Crossroad Keep .

title: Light pick
description: Light pick A light pick is a smaller version of the heavy pick , classified as a light , martial melee weapon . Description . Similar to a modern day geologist ' s hammer , a light pick has a metal head with a thick , slightly curved spike backed by either a smaller spike or a hammer head .

title: Lighten load
description: Lighten load Lighten load was an alteration spell that reduced the weight of burdens by half . Effects . This spell could be cast on a pile of non - magical objects — organic , inorganic , alive , or dead — and it temporarily reduced the weight of those objects by half .

title: Lightfoot halfling
description: Lightfoot halfling Lightfoot halflings are the most common type of halfling s seen in the world , in large part due to their famous wanderlust , which sets them apart from the relatively sedentary ghostwise and strongheart halfling s . Lightfoots are most comfortable living alongside other cultures , even adopting their cultural practices , right down to their deities . Physical characteristics .

title: Lightning Dragon Dojo
description: Lightning Dragon Dojo The Lightning Dragon Dojo was a martial arts academy founded by the Shou Duc - Sum Li . The school was located in the Shou district of Xiousing in Marsember and was named after Master Li ' s fighting style . When Li became too old to spar , his son Chang Li took over operation of the dojo .

title: Lightning bolt
description: Lightning bolt Lightning bolt was an evocation spell that caused arcs of lightning to emanate from the caster ' s fingertips . Effects . The searing bolt of electricity traveled in a straight line emanating from the caster .

title: Lightning breath
description: Lightning breath Lightning breath is a spell used by many sorcerer s , most often dragon sorcerer s . When a sorcerer casts " lightning breath " they exhale a blast of electrically charged air , injuring nearby foes , more so if the sorcerer is a dragon sorcerer . Regardless of whether or not the attack succeeds , " lightning breath " forces back any foes caught within its blast zone , which is roughly fifteen feet in diameter , a distance of five feet .

title: Lightning clash
description: Lightning clash Lightning clash is a somewhat basic spell of the evocation school used by several inexperienced swordmage s . When a swordmage casts " lightning clash " a bolt of rippling electrical energy sprouts from a creature struck by their sword , leaping through the air to strike another creature within twenty - five feet of the original target . Like most swordmage spells the precise power of the lightning ' s charge depends upon the swordmage ' s mental processing power .

title: Lightning lure
description: Lightning lure Lightning lure is among the most basic swordmage spell s , used most commonly by shielding swordmage s . When cast " lightning lure " lashes a creature of the swordmage ' s choosing within fifteen feet with a whip - like bolt of painful lightning , which the swordmage can use to pull the target towards them . " Lightning lure " does not work , however , if there is no clear path between the swordmage and his or her target .

title: Lights in the Dark
description: Lights in the Dark Lights in the Dark was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Located on the edge of the bazaar , this shop was easily noticed due to the variety of colored lanterns that were lit every day at dusk .

title: Liham
description: Liham Liham , located at the mouth of the Al - Sari River , was the most southerly of Zakhara ' s Free Cities " circa " 1367 DR . It also lay nearest to powerful Qudra , which , together with the presence of several mamluk units , gave the larger city enormous influence on Liham ' s politics . The large military led to the title " City of Soldiers " , but it was also called Liham the Red , because the citizens enjoyed wearing clothing in various shades of crimson .

title: Lilarcor
description: Lilarcor Lilarcor was a sword in the " " computer role - playing game . As an enchanted talking sword , it serves as a , with its various wisecracking comments , as well as its insatible thirst for blood , battle , and glory . History .

title: Lilianviaten Dlardrageth
description: Lilianviaten Dlardrageth Lilianviaten Dlardrageth , who usually went by Lilten , was a gold elf , Beshaba ' s high priest and chosen , a Masked Lord of Waterdeep , and last prince of House Dlardrageth . He resided in Waterdeep . He took a fiend ( possibly a fey ' ri ) as a mate and she bore him a daughter named Fayne .

title: Lilinuk
description: Lilinuk Lilinuk was the largest settlement on the Great Glacier . Geography . Lilinuk was located on a plateau south of the Nakalpgotak Sea , about 150 feet ( 46 meters ) above the shore , and west of the Novularond mountains .

title: Lilit Pass
description: Lilit Pass Lilit Pass was the name of a narrow chasm in the Aphrunn Mountains . It led from the Halondar to Daroush . History .

title: Lilith
description: Lilith Lilith was a member of the Zhentarim in 1489 DR . Personality . Lilith was a quick - witted individual who used humor to disarm others ' mistrust .

title: Lily Pad Inn
description: Lily Pad Inn The Lily Pad Inn was a three - story floating inn in the Xiousing district of Marsember , owned by the Shou known as Shiau Chen . The inn was built on a floating platform on the large pond known as the Zhao . Chen ran a rickshaw service out of the inn .

title: Limbo
description: Limbo Limbo was an Outer plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model that embodied the chaotic neutral alignment . The plane of Warrior ' s Rest in the World Tree cosmology was similar to Limbo in many ways but not quite as morphic . The batrachi formed a realm in Limbo called the Supreme Throne which became its own plane in the World Tree cosmology model .

title: Limited wish
description: Limited wish Limited wish is a universal spell that alters reality , within limits . Effect . With the restriction that the effects listed must be of decreasing power than the one listed before it , the possible effects the caster can create with a " limited wish " spell are to : duplicate a moderately - powerful sorcerer or wizard spell , provided they have experience casting spells from that school of magic ; duplicate any non - sorcerer or - wizard spell , with the same restriction ; duplicate any sorcerer or wizard spell from any school of magic ; or duplicate the effects of any type of spell .

title: Lin Kwan Shu
description: Lin Kwan Shu Lin Kwan Shu was a famous female martial artist of Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Lin Kwan Shu was a woman living in the city of Ping Chow in Wang Kuo province .

title: Linal Alprin
description: Linal Alprin Linal Alprin was the harbormaster of the city of Tantras in the Vast during the Time of Troubles . History . Alprin was a good man and an efficient city worker , married to Moira .

title: Linan Swift
description: Linan Swift Linan Swift was a human female commoner in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . Personality . As a mother , Linan would fight to the death to save her children and her husband .

title: Line of protection
description: Line of protection Line of protection was a cooperative abjuration spell that formed a field of force between two or more priests , or two or more stationary objects , that harmed all creatures passing through it , particularly evil and undead creatures . The reverse of this spell , line of destruction , was particularly painful to paladin s and good - aligned creatures . Effects .

title: Ling Li Te Hsin
description: Ling Li Te Hsin Ling Li Te Hsin was a famous martial artist of Shou Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Ling Li worked as a cartographer for the Ministry of Public Works in Kuo Te ' Shou .

title: Linu La ' neral
description: Linu La ' neral Linu La ' neral was a female moon elf cleric of the elven goddess Sehanine Moonbow . She hailed from the city of Evereska . Linu was clumsy ( some said unfortunate ) , often causing accidents in her wake .

title: Lion
description: Lion Lions were powerful feline predators that traveled and hunted in large groups , known as prides . Male lions had large manes of golden fur . They were responsible for defending the pride against any attackers .

title: Lion ' s Mouth
description: Lion ' s Mouth The Lion ' s Mouth was a secret ritual held in the Lion ' s Shrine of the fortress of Sarahin . History . Holy slayer s of the Everlasting undertook this ritual to prove their courage to their superiors .

title: Lion ' s Shrine
description: Lion ' s Shrine The Lion ' s Shrine was a mosque dedicated to Hajama that was located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Lion ' s Shrine was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .

title: Liongirt Tower
description: Liongirt Tower Liongirt Tower was the home of Onsilur Maerdrathom , a Magister during the 4th century DR . Location . The tower was located in the capital of Lapaliiya , Sheirtalar .

title: Lions ' Dynasty
description: Lions ' Dynasty The Lions ' Dynasty was one of the ruling dynasties of Tethyr . It was largely to blame for the political instability and chaos leading up to the Tethyrian Interregnum period . Dynastic Seal .

title: Lionshields
description: Lionshields The Lionshields were a merchant company based in the fortified city of Yartar in the Savage Frontier . The Lionshields ' symbol was a blue lion painted on a wooden shield . The merchant company were able to ship finished goods , such as supplies of armor and weapons , to small settlements and towns all throughout the northwestern region of Faerûn .

title: Lipo
description: Lipo Lipo was a yikarian city located along the coast of Pearl Bay near the edge of Zakhara ' s northern border in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . Lipo was the seat of power for the Coral Princess , the yikarian governor of the Sun ' s Eye province .

title: Liquid earth
description: Liquid earth Liquid earth was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Lirela Drumsinger
description: Lirela Drumsinger Lirela Drumsinger was a human woman from the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a bard and a member of the Harper s . History .

title: Liriel Baenre
description: Liriel Baenre Liriel Baenre ( born Liriel Vandree ) was a rogue drow mage , fighter , and magic user trained by Gromph Baenre the Archmage of Menzoberranzan who was a noble of House Baenre , the first house of Menzoberranzan . She was forced to flee Menzoberranzan when she obtained the Windwalker amulet and began traveling with Fyodor . Description .

title: Lisa Smedman
description: Lisa Smedman Lisa Smedman is the author of several novels and co - author of many sourcebooks . She has had a number of short science fiction and fantasy stories published in various magazines and anthologies , and has had two of her plays produced . In 1993 she was a finalist in the Writers of the Future contest .

title: Lissa
description: Lissa Lissa was a cleric of Lathander at the temples to Lathander in both Elturel and Ankhapur . She became an ally of Pinch . Personality .

title: Lissa ( Red Plumes )
description: Lissa ( Red Plumes ) Lissa was a member of the Red Plumes in the Moonsea . Activities . Lissa was one of the soldiers assigned to the garrison in the Waydown .

title: List of armor
description: List of armor This is a list of armors that were non - magical and common in the realms . For a collection of unique sets of armor and magical armors see . List of armors .

title: List of creatures from Monstrous Compendium Kara - Tur Appendix
description: List of creatures from Monstrous Compendium Kara - Tur Appendix The Monstrous Compendium Kara - Tur Appendix consisted of 64 5 - hole punched loose - leaf pages , unnumbered , and included a " How To Use This Book " page with an alphabetical index and 4 pages of random encounter charts , with the remainder consisting of the descriptions of the fictional monsters . Also included were 4 full - page illustrations on heavier card stock .

title: List of minor Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide characters
description: List of minor Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide characters A list of minor characters appearing in " " . Belpheron . Belpheron was a fearsome lich .

title: List of novel series
description: List of novel series Abolethic Sovereignty . By Bruce R . Cordell .

title: Litchi fruit
description: Litchi fruit Litchi was an exotic fruit from Shou Lung . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " Description . The unusual fruit was very sweet and tender and was usually served in the courts of Shou Lung .

title: Lithocentric pendulum
description: Lithocentric pendulum Lithocentric pendulums were simple magic item s used to navigate on the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . This device was a simple string with a stone attached to one end .

title: Liticia Gos
description: Liticia Gos Liticia Gos was a girl in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Liticia was a very naive girl .

title: Little Erik
description: Little Erik Little Erik was a bandit thug in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Erik believed that a hag had cursed him and he would die when he heard a screeching cry .

title: Little Fox
description: Little Fox The Little Fox was the youngest member of the Seven Sages inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Little Fox was appointed to govern the Ghost Leopard province in the northwest region of the Yikarian Empire .

title: Little Stone Bridge
description: Little Stone Bridge The Little Stone Bridge was found just outside of the city of Manass in Khazari . Description . The bridge straddled a small river that flowed by Manass on the south and west sides of the city , allowing road access to Manass from the west .

title: Little Wing
description: Little Wing Little Wing was an assassin member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in the Moonsea . Personality . Little Wing was a merciless servant of the Prince of Evil Aerial Creatures .

title: Liveoak
description: Liveoak Liveoak was a transmutation or enchantment spell that turned one nearby oak tree into a treant guardian . Effects . The tree to be transformed had to be alive and healthy and preferably of Huge size .

title: Living Gate
description: Living Gate The Living Gate was a portal that connected reality with the Far Realm . It was located in the Feydark , beneath the ruined city of Cendriane . Description .

title: Living construct
description: Living construct Living constructs were beings who were exactly the same as other construct s in form and origin but who were otherwise alive in a manner much like that of magical beast s or humanoid s . Living constructs had a soul , and while they did not require organic sustenance they did require rest equivalent , though not identical , to that of sleep and were not immune to magic that targeted the living . Warforged were examples of living constructs .

title: Living idol
description: Living idol Living idols were animated , semi - intelligent statues of stone , presumably created to serve as foci of ancient religions in Zakhara . As of 1367 DR , they were sometimes worshiped by small cults , who empowered the idols with sacrifices appropriate to the type of living idol . All living idols were considered opposed to Zakhara ' s predominant culture of Enlightenment .

title: Liza
description: Liza Liza was a female human refugee in Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Liza was one of a group of people that traveled around the Mere of Dead Men in 1374 DR .

title: Lizard
description: Lizard Lizards are reptilian animals that range all over the world ( except in arctic climates ) . Unlike snakes , lizards have legs and ears . They otherwise have no distinguishing characteristics .

title: Lizardfolk
description: Lizardfolk Lizardfolk , also known as lizard men , were a race of reptilian humanoid s native to Toril . Description . Lizardfolk were semi - aquatic reptilian humanoids .

title: Lizel
description: Lizel Lizel was a vendor employed by Master Velsin in Sundabar in 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Aliisza , while in disguise , saw Lizel treated rudely by Yrudis Gregan and somehow sensed that her father , a city guard , was killed some nights before by some tanarukk .

title: Llandrydd ' s Steel
description: Llandrydd ' s Steel Llandrydd ' s Steel was a mercenary company based in Vilhon Reach and active also in the Sea of Fallen Stars around 1358 DR . Organization . They were divided into two units : the Steel , 150 fighters led by Llandrydd ; and the Auxiliary , 80 pike wielders .

title: Llandrydd Wyvernheart
description: Llandrydd Wyvernheart Llandrydd Wyvernheart was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Llandrydd led the Llandrydd ' s Steel company .

title: Lleddew of Selûne
description: Lleddew of Selûne Lleddew of Selûne is a high priestess of Selûne and a former adventurer , currently known as Mother Lleddew . History . Originally , she was an adventurer , a companion of Cole Wyvernspur .

title: Llemgradac
description: Llemgradac Llemgradac was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR . History . Llemgradac was one of the princes of Murghôm who participated in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Llewan Aspenwold
description: Llewan Aspenwold Llewan Aspenwold was a priestess of Mystra in 1368 DR . History . In 1368 Llewan opened a temple of Mystra in the dale .

title: Llewellyn Longhand
description: Llewellyn Longhand Llewellyn Longhand was the military commander of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Llewellyn in 1363 DR hired some adventurers to led the Daggerford army against the Hordes of Dragonspear Activities .

title: Llewyrr
description: Llewyrr The Llewyrr were a race of elves that once held sway over the isle of Gwynneth and perhaps others of the Moonshaes but as human s began to colonize the islands the Llewyrr decided to retreat to Synnoria and isolate themselves . The Llewyrr are very similar to those called the high elves and it is suspected the they were the descendants of the survivors of a shipwrecked elven vessel that was on a pilgrimage to Evermeet , but only the Llewyrr can know for sure . Long before the humans arrived in the Moonshaes , dwarves began to immigrate and lived in peace with the Llewyrr mostly due to the fact that they did not compete for resources .

title: Lliira
description: Lliira Lliira ( pronounced " LEER - ah " ) , also known as Our Lady of Joy , was a good exarch ( formerly a lesser deity ) of Sune responsible for the sphere of joy , and for the domain s of chaos , charm , family , good and travel . Worshipers . Priests and priestesses of Lliira , called " Joydancers " , were the apple of her eye .

title: Lliira ' s laugh
description: Lliira ' s laugh Lliira ' s laugh was an enchantment spell that heartened good creatures and demoralized evil ones . Effects . The caster released a joyous , boisterous laugh that strengthened the resolve of good creatures and weakened the resolve of evil creatures .

title: Llimark
description: Llimark Llimark was a gold dragon during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , when the gold dragon king Lareth ordered all metallic dragon s to hide in order to avoid the Rage , the song dragon Karasendrieth and others disagreed , instead proposing to search for a cure .

title: Llombaerth Starym
description: Llombaerth Starym Llombaerth Starym , sometimes known as the Masked , was a male elf wizard and the Lord Speaker of the Starym House of Cormanthyr . History . Llombaerth was one of the most prominent members of Starym House and was fierily against the Opening promised by the Coronal Eltargrim .

title: Llorkh
description: Llorkh Llorkh was a human town to the northeast of Loudwater in the Gray Vale . History . Establishment & Expansion .

title: Lluirwood
description: Lluirwood The Lluirwood , or the Long Forest , was a forest in Luiren . Geography . Lluirwood made up the northern border of Luiren .

title: Llurth Dreir
description: Llurth Dreir Llurth Dreier was a drow city located about 10 miles under Shaar and to the west of the Great Rift . It wasn ' t clear what but its denizens did something to offend Lolth in ways that caused her to completely forsake it . Religion .

title: Loaradden Derviir
description: Loaradden Derviir Loaradden Deviir was a sinister Magister who held the title for two years from 319 DR to 321 DR before his actions finally earned the wrath of Mystra . Personality . Loaradden was cold and calculating , caring for nothing but the pursuit of magical power .

title: Lob
description: Lob Lob was a hill giant who , together with Ogg , led an attack on Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Lob and Ogg always traveled together .

title: Locate animals or plants
description: Locate animals or plants Locate animals or plants , also known as detect animals or plants , was a divination spell that allowed the caster to discover the direction , distance , and approximate number of one type of animal or plant desired . Effects . The caster picked a direction and one type of animal or plant , and then concentrated for a short time to discover if the desired plant or animal was within the range of the spell .

title: Locate creature
description: Locate creature Locate creature was a divination spell that allowed the caster to sense the location and movement of a well - visualized creature . Effects . Similar to " locate object " , this spell could find a creature familiar to the caster within a radius of at least 560 ft ( 171 m ) — the range increased with the experience level of the caster but would not cross running water .

title: Locate object
description: Locate object Locate object was a divination spell that let one sense the direction to an object . Effect . The caster sensed the direction to a well - known or clearly visualized object .

title: Locathah
description: Locathah The locathah were a fish - like humanoid race also known as fish - men , gill - men or kaparl ( " slave " in the kuo - toa n language ) . Description . In Serôs , they have fine scales covering their bodies that range from olive green to ocre in colour although their stomach scales instead range from sea green to pale yellow .

title: Lockpicks
description: Lockpicks Lockpicks , or thieves ' picks were one of the most indispensible tools for a rogue . Uses . A complete set of lockpicks included wires , angled wrenches , rods , oil , a small hammer , a magnifying glass , chisels , and acid .

title: Lockstone
description: Lockstone A Lockstone was a magical gem that triggered a few set spells when certain conditions were met . They were commonly used as wards and traps . Reputation .

title: Lod
description: Lod Lod was a bone naga from the world of Abeir , and the founder of the Eminence of Araunt . Activities . Although the Eminence of Araunt believed that all members were equal , Lod was an exception , as he served as the leader of the Eminence .

title: Lodar
description: Lodar Lodar is the cheerful tavernmaster of the Bubbling Cauldron in the village of Hilltop . In 1372 DR , after a kobold attack on Hilltop , Lodar ' s chef Mara was taken hostage in the tavern ' s kitchen by a band of kobolds , led by Hurc , who had been separated from the main group .

title: Loene
description: Loene Loene was a former member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . Description . Loene had dark blond hair and hazel eyes .

title: Log of everburning
description: Log of everburning Log of everburning was an enchantment spell that could keep a wood fire burning brightly for many hours without consuming the fuel . Effects . This spell had to be cast on a wooden object no larger than 1 ft ( 0 .

title: Logala Thenduk
description: Logala Thenduk Logala Thenduk was a female drow wererat rogue and a member of the Hidden during the Silence of Lolth . Description . Although a drow , Logala spent much of her time in her dire rat form to avoid detection .

title: Logram Eyegouger
description: Logram Eyegouger Logram Eyegouger was a barbarian orc and chieftain of the Eyegouger clan , the dominant clan under which all other orc clans surrounding the Old Owl Well served . At one point , Logram allied with Black Garius and razed Neverwinter ' s caravans . In the end , Logram ' s orcs captured a Waterdhavian emissary and the Kalach - Cha was sent to retrieve him .

title: Lok
description: Lok Lok was the leader of the Eagle Knights in Payit in 1361 DR . History . Lok was one of the most powerful men in Ulatos .

title: Lokoshin
description: Lokoshin Lokoshin was the female Azuposi human spokesperson for the settlement of Kin Elbhaz in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica in the 1360s DR . Personality . She had led the community for a decade and was strong - minded .

title: Lolth
description: Lolth Lolth ( pronounced " LOALTH " ) , or Lloth in Menzoberranzan , was the major goddess the Queen of Spiders or Queen of the Demonweb Pits was the major goddess of the drow and the leader of the Dark Seldarine . She drove the drow under the pretense of culling the weak into heavy infighting . All for the sake of having fun , while at the same time limiting the growth of drow power and influence to ensure that she remained the only accessible power source to them .

title: Lolth ' s Web
description: Lolth ' s Web Lolth ' s Web was a neighborhood of the district of West Wall in Menzoberranzan that was suspended from the ceiling and walls by calcified spider silk . Description . Lolth ' s Web was located in West Wall next to the district of Narbondellyn .

title: Lomaraj
description: Lomaraj Lomaraj was a Metahel human settlement on the Pasocada River , home to around 1 , 000 individuals . Geography . The town was located a few miles from Great Raven Pueblo , an Azuposi settlement , and acted as the main point of trade between the two peoples .

title: Londal Fen
description: Londal Fen Londal Fen was a male Chondathan human fighter in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . In 1374 DR , Londal and his partner , Smile , were employed by Lady Arthas of the Temple of Mystra .

title: Lonely Tower
description: Lonely Tower The Lonely Tower was a tower located somewhere in the Moonlands near the eastern border of the Moonwood forest in the Silver Marches . Description . This mysterious tower , made of white stone , had an incredibly light and frail structure compared to where it stood .

title: Lonelywood
description: Lonelywood Lonelywood was a town in Ten Towns within the cold region of Icewind Dale . It was known as being the " first choice " for rogues seeking a refuge in Icewind Dale . Geography .

title: Long Canyon
description: Long Canyon The Long Canyon was a ninety - mile - long ( 145 km ) canyon in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica , through which the Pasocada River ran . It was between a mile ( 1 . 6 km ) and ten miles ( 16 km ) wide .

title: Long Jing
description: Long Jing Long Jing , also known as West Lake Dragon Tea , was a green tea found around the Sea of Fallen Stars . Geography . The tea was grown only in the mythical Zhejiang province in only a couple of tea gardens .

title: Long Reach
description: Long Reach The Long Reach , also called the Centaur Trail , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the village of Orlimmin and the town of King ' s Reach . From west to east , it began at Orlimmin , ran through Bambryn and Sendrin and ended at King ' s Reach . On the way , it linked with the Tantras Trail , the Hlintar Ride , Blaern ' s Trail , and the North Road .

title: Longbow
description: Longbow A longbow is a two - handed , martial ranged weapon of the bow family . Description . The longbow is a flexible shaft of wood ( or horn or bone ) about 4 to 6 feet ( 1 .

title: Longhorn
description: Longhorn A longhorn was a type of Faerûn ian flute that was commonly found in civilized regions , or in elven communities . Description . Longhorns were considered to be amongst the most lyric of musical instruments .

title: Longsaddle
description: Longsaddle Longsaddle was a hamlet on the Long Road in the Savage Frontier of Faerûn . Geography . Situated east of the Crags and west of the Evermoors , Longsaddle surrounded the magical home of the Harpell family .

title: Longship
description: Longship A longship was a square - sailed , oared ship with a single mast that could be removed . Description . The longship was similar to the drakkar but much smaller — typically 70 to 80 ft .

title: Longspear
description: Longspear The longspear is a simple , two - handed melee reach weapon of the pole arm family . Description . Just as the name implies , a longspear is a longer version of the spear .

title: Longsword
description: Longsword The longsword is an extremely common and very versitle weapon . It is typically of western design , though all Faerûn ian cultures exhibit weapons of similar design and intent . The classic , straight blade is a favorite of many paladin s .

title: Loobamub
description: Loobamub Loobamub was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Loobamub was the leader of the Circle of Hunters in Neverlight Grove .

title: Lopango
