description: Lopango Lopango , also known as the Land of Fire , was a land on the southern end of Maztica . It was covered in forest or jungle and high mountains . Some maps depicted archers with longbow s there .

title: Lorabelios
description: Lorabelios Lorabelios was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Lorabelios and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Loranse
description: Loranse Loranse was the manor home of Count and Countess Malcor and Shyrr Grannox and the county seat of Ithmonn in Tethyr . Location . Loranse was located just west of the capital , along the northern banks of the River Ith and south of Ithal Road .

title: Loravyre Impkith
description: Loravyre Impkith Loravyre Impkith was a tiefling wizard who inhabited Fort Precipice in the Chasm within the Ebon Downs in 1484 DR . History . She recruited a tiefling adventurer to recover some strange items in possession of some Ashmadai - related devils in the Chasm .

title: Lorcan
description: Lorcan Lorcan was a cambion and the sole son of the succubus ( formerly erinyes ) Invadiah . Personality . To amuse himself , and possibly to gain bargaining power with higher - ranking devils , Lorcan collected warlock s and had a complete set of the Toril thirteen warlocks .

title: Lord Dheolur
description: Lord Dheolur Lord Dheolur was the head of the Dheolur noble house of Cormyr . He married Threena Cormaeril . His sister was Pella Dheolur .

title: Lord Helmstone
description: Lord Helmstone Lord Helmstone was the lord of the Helmstone noble family of Cormyr around 1372 DR . He believed Laspeera should be Royal Mage and that the still - living members of the Obarskyr royal family to be decadent . He may have been plotting against the Obarskyrs or the current Royal Mage .

title: Lord Sage of Phlan
description: Lord Sage of Phlan The Lord Sage of Phlan was a sage in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . The Lord was a taciturn and reserved individual .

title: Lord Wolf
description: Lord Wolf " Lord Wolf " was the title adopted by a brigand who once ruled over the area of Highbank Forest in the Vast . History . Styling himself as " Lord Wolf " , he laid claim to the area and the ruined keep atop the local hill and set himself up as its ruler .

title: Lords ' Alliance
description: Lords ' Alliance The Lords ' Alliance , also known as the Council of Lords , is a partnership of merchant cities , founded in 1325 DR . Its members are from the North and Western Heartlands , Waterdeep , Silverymoon , and Neverwinter , as well as other free cities and towns in the region , which make up the bulk of the organization . It was formed to oppose the growing influence of the Black Network in the North , as well as the Shadow Thieves of Amn who have clawed out a foothold for themselves in Waterdeep once more .

title: Lords of Waterdeep
description: Lords of Waterdeep The Lords of Waterdeep are the ruling council who have ruled the city of Waterdeep for the most of the last 300 years . Throughout that time , there have been between 50 and 80 lords , four of whom have reigned as Open Lord . The Lords come from all walks of life and while predominantly comprised of human s , has had members of various races throughout the Realms .

title: Lords of the Golden Hills
description: Lords of the Golden Hills The Lords of the Golden Hills was the collective name given to the gnome pantheon . It consisted of the gnomish god s that resided on the plane of the Golden Hills , and Urdlen . The pantheon , led by Garl Glittergold , consisted of : Legends speak of the existence of several goddesses in the gnomish pantheon , but their stories are long lost to history .

title: Lords of the Nine Heavens
description: Lords of the Nine Heavens The Lords of the Nine Heavens were members of the Lotus Court , the ruling body of government for the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Activities . In reality , only two members of the Lords of the Nine Heavens amounted to anything more than lackeys of the Emperor of the Lotus Throne .

title: Lords of the Tempest
description: Lords of the Tempest The Lords of the Tempest were an rumored organization of wizard s that served the god Talos . Known only in rumor , the Lords of the Tempest were a mysterious group . They were said to be wizard s who specialized in elemental magic in exotic combinations .

title: Loregiver
description: Loregiver The Loregiver , also called the Handmaiden of Fate or the Maiden of Beauty , was one of the most prominent figures in Zakharan history , though some believed her to be nothing more than a myth . History . Fate chose a beautiful young girl upon whom to bestow her knowledge .

title: Lorelei Gravesower
description: Lorelei Gravesower Lorelei Gravesower was a female half - elf cleric of Kelemvor who tended the Kelemvor ' s Garden cemetery in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . History . Lorelei became caretaker of the graveyard in the 1360s DR , renaming it from the " Thunderstone Cemetery " .

title: Loremaster
description: Loremaster The loremaster is a prestige class . Spellcasters who have a love for uncovering lost knowledge and gathering huge amounts of eclectic information choose to become loremasters in order to enhance their ability to use this knowledge to its maximum effect . As a loremaster becomes experienced in gathering and using the knowledge he has obtained , he gains the ability to speak additional languages , remember tiny tidbits of helpful information , and enhance his own abilities .

title: Loretaker Creed
description: Loretaker Creed The Loretaker Creed was not one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They advocated a long - term strategy of gathering all forms of information and slowly depleting information held by other races . They did not care about how useful the information was .

title: Lorgru
description: Lorgru Lorgru was an orc and a prince of the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . In 1484 DR , Lorgru was the eldest son and heir of the king of Many - Arrows and , like all his dynasty , a moderate who favored peace with human s .

title: Lorhanna
description: Lorhanna Lorhanna was a priest of Tempus of Yulash . Activities . Lorhanna took care of the shrine to Tempus in the Red Plumes accampanent in Yulash .

title: Lorien Dawnbringer
description: Lorien Dawnbringer Lorien Dawnbringer was a priestess of Sune in Waterdeep . She was a very good friend of Ilira Nathalan and the two were rumored to be lovers although it ' s doubtful they had a physical relationship because Ilira ' s spellscar prevented her from touching another person . Lorien spent time skulking around Downshadow , healing adventurers who had taken on more than they could handle .

title: Lorn Tauth
description: Lorn Tauth Lorn Tauth was a cultist of Ogrémoch and a member of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Underdark beneath the Moonsea . History . In 1491 DR , he and his fellow Alfun Deeprock discovered the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch , was located inside a mine near Mulmaster ' s Underdark trading post of Fort Iron .

title: Lorne Starling
description: Lorne Starling Lorne Starling was a fighter and an agent of Black Garius during the Shadow War and the older brother of Bevil Starling . History . Lorne was the older brother of Bevil Starling and son of Retta Starling .

title: Loross
description: Loross Loross was the Netherese noble tongue and one of the languages of the people of the City of Shade . Speakers . During the empire of Netheril , the Netherese people were divided by class .

title: Lorragauth
description: Lorragauth Lorragauth , the Chained Wyrm , was a gargantuan black dragon who lived in Neverwinter Wood centuries prior to 1479 DR . He lived a long life as a dragon , amassing a great hoard . However , when Lorragauth sensed the coming of the end of his days , he tried to destroy all the lands in his domain in malice and spite .

title: Lorthio Bukbukken
description: Lorthio Bukbukken Lorthio Bukbukken was a duergar alchemist in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Until the Rage of Demons , Lorthio had dealings with the corrupt Gorglak .

title: Lorthuun
description: Lorthuun Lorthuun was a beholder Zhentarim in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . History . Lorthuun joined the Zhentarim and was appointed to the crucial garrison of Mantol - Derith .

title: Losifan Urdo
description: Losifan Urdo Losifan Urdo was a mercenary in Westgate . Activities . Losifan was one of the field officers of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .

title: Lost Dragon of Waterdeep
description: Lost Dragon of Waterdeep The Lost Dragon of Waterdeep was a painting owned by Lord Narrovan Eagleshield of Waterdeep . The painting was tied to the Legend of the Lost Dragon which claimed a blue or white dragon was trapped in some object inside the city . Description .

title: Lost Lovers ' Pool
description: Lost Lovers ' Pool Lost Lovers ' Pool was a pool hidden within a cave in Shalanar Barony in Erlkazar . Description . The pool was located hidden within a coastal cave along Shalane Lake , north of the city of Llorbauth .

title: Lost Messenger
description: Lost Messenger The Lost Messenger was a ghost that could be found wandering the Battle of Bones . Description . The Lost Messenger appeared as a transparent young boy .

title: Lost Peaks
description: Lost Peaks The Lost Peaks were two mountains located in the High Forest . Description . These mountains full of forests dominated the north - western area of the High Forest .

title: Lost Refuge
description: Lost Refuge The Lost Refuge was a Cormyr ean keep placed near the border of the Vast Swamp . It was built in 1227 DR . It supported a town as well but in the mid – 13th century DR , the combination of the expanding swamp and an orc attack killed the garrison and Cormyreans subsequently forgot all about the place .

title: Lost Temple of the Fey Gods
description: Lost Temple of the Fey Gods Lost Temple of the Fey Gods , designed by Bill W . Baldwin , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 4th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the Yuirwood , fey , and the Cult of Voldini .

title: Lostmauth
description: Lostmauth Lostmauth was a red dragon living on the isle of Tuern in the Trackless Sea . History . The Cult of the Dragon sent their leader , Severin himself , to bargain with Lostmauth for the red dragon mask .

title: Losvius Longnose
description: Losvius Longnose Losvius Longnose was a teamster on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Losvius ' s surname derived not from his big nose but from his overpowering thirst for gossip about other people .

title: Lothan Durncaskyn
description: Lothan Durncaskyn Lothan Durncaskyn was a lord of Cormyr . Activities . Lothan was the lord of Immerford in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr .

title: Lothan Maergh
description: Lothan Maergh Lothan Maergh was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Watchful that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Abilities . Watchful Brother Lothan was a horticulturist that specialized in the production and storage of bulbs and seeds as well as grafting techniques .

title: Lothen of the Silver Spires
description: Lothen of the Silver Spires Lothen of the Silver Spires was a set of ruins of an ancient elven city located in the western side of the High Forest . Description . The ancient city once marked the southern boundary of Siluvanede , which was a sun elven kingdom .

title: Lotil
description: Lotil Lotil was a blind featherworker in Palul . History . Lotil was the father of both Erixitl and Shatil and a featherworker of renown .

title: Lotus Court
description: Lotus Court The Lotus Court was the ruling body of government for the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . History . The Lotus Court was comprised of nobles from among the population of yak - folk inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in the Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Loudwater
description: Loudwater Loudwater was a city that sat on the confluence of the Delimbiyr and Greyflow rivers . Much reduced since its heyday , it still offered a well - defended rest stop for caravans and riverboats despite the ruination of its neighbours after the Spellplague . History .

title: Loumara
description: Loumara The loumaras are a relatively new demon ic race , much younger than the tanar ' ri . They are still centuries old , but this is still recent in a place like the Abyss , where time doesn ' t mean the same thing it does on the Material Plane . As a result , few loumaras have yet become powerful enough to be recognized as demon lord s ; Sifkhu , who has been captured by the succubus queen Malcanthet , is perhaps the only one .

title: Love candle
description: Love candle A love candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It caused individuals to be " charmed " by and possibly enamored with the first creature they saw after the candle was extinguished . Description .

title: Love domain
description: Love domain There are three deities whom after the Spellplague lay claim to the love domain . One of them was Sheela Peryroyl who represents romantic love and courtship , especially among halfling s of whom she was the prominent deity . She was more connected to natural beauty rather than to the aesthetics of art .

title: Loviatar
description: Loviatar Loviatar ( pronounced " loh - VEE - a - tar " ) , also known as The Maiden of Pain and The Willing Whip , was the evil goddess of agony and was both queen and servant to the greater god Bane . Loviatar was a cold - hearted bully , calculating and despotic ; she was the master of inflicting physical and psychological suffering and her portfolio included Pain , Hurt and Torture . Her symbol was a nine - stranded whip , with barbed strands .

title: Low - light vision
description: Low - light vision Low - light vision extends the distance a creature can see in conditions of low light , rather than allowing vision in no light like darkvision . In previous editions , low - light and dark visions were known as infravision and was used to describe the ability to detect infrared signatures .

title: Low Ulutim languages
description: Low Ulutim languages The term " Low Ulutim " described a grouping of closely related Ulou languages spoken by small populations of people in various Faerûn ian locales . Languages . The Low Ulutim languages were spoken at lower latitudes than the High Ulutim languages .

title: Lower planes
description: Lower planes The lower planes ( sometimes Lower Planes ) is a collective term used in the Great Wheel cosmology model to represent the Outer planes of Evil alignment , located across the bottom of the Great Wheel . These are Acheron , the Nine Hells , Gehenna , Hades , Tarterus , the Abyss , and Pandemonium . The only other thing these planes have in common is the river Styx which flows through at least one level of each Evil plane .

title: Loxo
description: Loxo Loxos appear as large humanoid elephants with two trunks and bluish - gray skin . They roam the Shaar in hunter - gatherer groups . Peaceful in nature , Loxos prefer to be left alone and have little contact with other sentient races .

title: Loy Ho - dun
description: Loy Ho - dun Loy Ho - dun was a kensai adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Loy Ho - dun had a great natural talent for swordsmanship .

title: Loyalists
description: Loyalists The Loyalists were a faction of the holy slayer organization known as the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Activities . The Loyalists were the only faction within the Everlasting to truly remain faithful to the Shadow Caliph , hence their name .

title: Lu - che
description: Lu - che Lu - che , also known as Sensei Lu - che , was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . Activities . Lu - che , training under Master Taembak Duahl in Shou Tu ' lung , earned a 6th - degree black belt in the Four Keys style of kung fu .

title: Luc Sunbright
description: Luc Sunbright Luc Sunbright was a priest of Amaunator in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Luc led the worship of Amaunator at the Morninglow Tower .

title: Lucan Greenharrow
description: Lucan Greenharrow Lucan Greenharrow was an elf wizard who resided at the Hosttower of the Arcane in Luskan , before stealing lore from the tower and relocating to Neverwinter to begin a new life , where he co - founded the Waterclock Guild . Background . Lucan discovered tendrils of magic beneath the tower , and found that they appeared to pull elemental power from the sea itself , and channel it to the south .

title: Lucia Thione - Hhune
description: Lucia Thione - Hhune Lady Lucia Thione - Hhune was a female human who went on to become a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield , due in part to her being the wife of Inselm Hhune , the Duke of Kamlann and the First Lord of the Shield . Description . Lucia was a pretty , chestnut - haired lady , though cold .

title: Luenath
description: Luenath Luenath was the second - largest city in Dambrath . Geography . Situated on the west bank of the River Caraguir where it emptied into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins , Luenath was a prime port city that easily supported the bulk of Dambrath ' s navy .

title: Lufala
description: Lufala Lufala was a tasked harim servant genie working within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Lufala was described as being matronly .

title: Lugalpgotak Sea
description: Lugalpgotak Sea The Lugalpgotak Sea was the largest body of water on the Great Glacier and the resting place of the slumbering god Ulutiu . Geography . The Lugalpgotak Sea was located in the center of Alpuk .

title: Lugh
description: Lugh Lugh was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark History . Lugh was among the 2000 dwarves that accompanied Ironlord Torg mac Cei to join the Army of the Alliance to crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . Following the First Battle of the Golden Way on the 3rd of Flamerule , Princess Alusair Obarskyr of Cormyr detailed Lugh and three other dwarves to escorted the captured commander Batu Min Ho .

title: Lugsaas Chain
description: Lugsaas Chain The Lugsaas , or " Southern Shield " , was a chain of mountains in the south of the Great Glacier , which formed the border with the Cold Lands to the south . Geography . The Lugsaas Chain formed the border between Damara and Vaasa in the south and the Alpuk region in the north .

title: Lui - hsia Chih
description: Lui - hsia Chih Lui - hsia Chin was a wu jen leader of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . He led the sixteen members of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru .

title: Luiren
description: Luiren Luiren was known as the land of the halfling s since its population was almost completely comprised of their race . It was a small kingdom with a population of about 840 , 000 inhabitants in 1372 DR ruled by the halfling theocrat Faran Ferromar . Travelers to Luiren were often surprised to find the locals adventurous and bold as opposed to the fat and quiet halflings one could find elsewhere .

title: Luiren ' s Best
description: Luiren ' s Best Luiren ' s Best was a beer brewed in Luiren by the Smokardin clan . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Luiren spring cheese
description: Luiren spring cheese Luiren spring cheese or cheeeese was a type of cheese that acted as a drug to halfling s . Effect . Foxilon Cardluck described cheeeese as " special , like black opium or booze " .

title: Lumachella
description: Lumachella Lumachella , also known as fire marble , was a hardsone found in the Realms . Description . Lumachella was a rare type of dark brown marble that contained tiny fossilized snails with iridescent shells .

title: Lumalia
description: Lumalia Lumalia was an astral deva prisoner in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Lumalia ' s long imprisonment deeply affected her ( she also changed from neutral good to chaotic good ) .

title: Luna
description: Luna Luna was a female human who managed the Selûne ' s Smile tavern in Waterdeep in the 1350s DR . Luna was in truth an avatar of the goddess Selûne , the Moonmaiden , who dwelled among mortals occasionally . History .

title: Lung Jua
description: Lung Jua Lung Jua , colloquially known as the Dragon Claw , was a petty demon of the Celestial Bureaucracy in T ' u Lung . History . In 1358 DR , he approached the Celestial Emperor , saying he had seen in T ' u Lung too many martial arts schools led by poor teachers and the Emperor agreed .

title: Luntse Dzong
description: Luntse Dzong Luntse Dzong was a fortress located in eastern Khazari . Location . Nestled within the rocky confines of Ahs Trango Shan , Luntse Dzong was the larger of two fortresses that guarded the entrance into Khazari from the east .

title: Lupe Berrypip
description: Lupe Berrypip Lupe Berrypip was a halfling girl in the Earthspur Mountains . History . In 1491 DR , Lupe lived with her father , Ombul Berrypip , who was sent to the mine in the Earthspurs as a cook .

title: Lupinaxe
description: Lupinaxe The Lupinaxe was an enchanted axe whose head resembled a wolf . Powers . It could summon a dire wolf .

title: Luposphinx
description: Luposphinx Luposhinxes were sphinx es with the heads of wolves , found in wooded areas . Description . The luposphinx ' s body was about 7 ft ( 2 .

title: Lurdas Jasperstone
description: Lurdas Jasperstone Lurdas Jasperstone was a member of the Glass - breakers on the Great Spire of the Ice Sea during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Lurdas believed that all of Toril would be immersed in fire , and the greater glory of Gond , if the tower on the island being constructed by a cult of Gond was completed .

title: Lure of Jaws
description: Lure of Jaws Created for the ancient green dragon Aglaraerose , The Lure of Jaws was a lair built by a band of dwarves that were forced to construct it for the she dragon . The lair itself was filled with numerous traps and after its construction rumors were spread by the dwarven builders that a great treasure lied deep within its halls . Leading to the death of countless adventurers .

title: Lureene Dundragon
description: Lureene Dundragon Lureene Dundragon was a Zhentarim agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Lureene was possibly involved in an expedition to Throstulgrael ' s lair .

title: Luriyl
description: Luriyl Luriyl , also known as , was a semi - precious stone widespread and popular in the Realms . Description . Found in crystals , luriyl often yielded attractive gem s of vivid yellow , green , yellow - green , and ( rarely ) blue and purple .

title: Lurker cloak
description: Lurker cloak A lurker cloak was a mottled gray cloak that almost looked like it was made out of stone . Upon speaking the cloak ' s command word , the wearer could turn themselves into a lurker for seven minutes . This ability could be used twice a day .

title: Lurking regard
description: Lurking regard The lurking regard was a theory supported by a few spellcaster s and scholars . According to this theory , some spell s were self - aware , with consciousness granted by unknown entities . This theory was used to " explain " why some spells sometimes seemed to either aid or thwart certain spellcasters or other creatures that used those spells .

title: Lurkwood
description: Lurkwood Lurkwood was a great forest located south of the Spine of the World . Geography . The forest was located north of Grunwald , where the Thunderbeast tribe dwelled within the wood .

title: Luros
description: Luros Luros was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Luros and his fellow cultists observed a plot by the Cult of the Howling Hatred to kidnap monks from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , in order to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .

title: Luruar
description: Luruar Luruar , also commonly known as the Silver Marches , was a confederation of cities in the north of Faerûn , under the leadership of Alustriel Silverhand , former ruler of Silverymoon . It consisted of Silverymoon , Citadel Adbar , Deadsnows , Jalanthar , Quaervarr , Citadel Felbarr , Everlund , Mithral Hall , and Sundabar , and its goal was to protect the North against the growing horde of orc s in the mountains . The nation was also a member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Lurue
description: Lurue Lurue ( pronounced " luh - RUE " ) , also known as the Unicorn Queen or the Queen of Talking Beasts , is a chaotic good archfey who is often worshiped as a goddess of intelligent and talking beasts . Lurue teaches that life is there to be lived , and one should live it with zest and flair . Adventures and quests should be taken on a whim and life should be filled with good times and laughter .

title: Luskag
description: Luskag Luskag was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . In 1361 DR , Luskag saved the life of Poshtli in the House of Tezca and accompanied him to Sunhome .

title: Luskan
description: Luskan Luskan , also known as the City of Sails , was a port city at the mouth of the River Mirar on the Sword Coast North . Luskan , despite the presence of the Ten Towns is considered by many to be civilization ' s farthest reach . Although once a bustling city , in the days prior to the Spellplague , the city would suffer greatly at the hands of Arklem Greeth .

title: Luspeel
description: Luspeel Luspeel was the Realms name for a hardstone known as or lodestone . Description . Luspeel was naturally magnetic and was occasionally used in the floors of temples to subtly encourage piety - - a kneeling worshiper felt his or her weapons and armor being gently stuck to the floor .

title: Lustrum
description: Lustrum The Lustrum was a mithral mine outside of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The Lustrum was located 20 miles from the Pillars of Woe .

title: Lute
description: Lute A lute was a stringed instrument with a neck and a wooden soundboard which was often oval or shaped as a teardrop . Lutes were often used by bard s of the Realms . Description .

title: Luth alur
description: Luth alur Luth Alur , meaning " superior shooting " , was a fighting style taught among drow and was shooting enemies with ranged weapons . Description . As the name " superior shooting " suggested , the idea behind this fighting style was to shoot down the enemy in an ambush , before they had the chance to strike back .

title: Lutha
description: Lutha Lutha was an ogre around 1485 DR . Possessions . The ogre wore hide armor and wielded a greatclub .

title: Luthax
description: Luthax Luthax was a war wizard of Cormyr and senior officer to Thanderahast . Elmariel Emmarask was a trusted friend . Appearance .

title: Luthcheq
description: Luthcheq Luthcheq was the capital city of Chessenta . Formerly a port city located on the Bay of Chessenta , as of 1479 DR the city was miles from what remained of the bay . Because it was only a few miles from the River Adder , Luthcheq maintained its status as a maritime city .

title: Luthic
description: Luthic Luthic ( " looth " - ick ) is the orc goddess of caves and the mate of Gruumsh . She is often referred to as the Cave Mother . Appendix .

title: Luthvaerynn
description: Luthvaerynn Luthvaerynn was a possibly female malaugrym in 1479 DR in Telflamm . It was involved in both licit and illicit businesses in that city using trade and the black market . All its identities were female and it liked the humanoid form more than its original form , and maintained it even when threatened .

title: Luvon Greencloak
description: Luvon Greencloak Luvon Greencloak was the former emissary of the Elven Court in Cormanthyr and the regional agent of the Moonstars for the region in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . He was an old associate of Khelben Arunsun . He was in 1374 among the many powerful mages Arunsun brought together in order to restore the denizens of the lost city of Miyeritaar ' s High Mages and cleanse part of the High Moor .

title: Lycanthropy
description: Lycanthropy Lycanthropy was a disease ( for afflicted lycanthropes ) and a hereditary condition ( for natural lycanthropes ) that caused humanoid s and giant s to change form , usually into a hybrid humanoid - animal state . A lycanthrope was an individual who possessed this condition . They were called " nightwalkers " by some .

title: Lylorn
description: Lylorn Lylorn was a port city and the largest , wealthiest , and most dominant of the confederation of the Dusk Ports on Returned Abeir . Background . The Lylar were proud people reputed as the boldest of Abeir an sailors and for easily drawing their swords for insults , imagined or real .

title: Lymmura Auldarhk
description: Lymmura Auldarhk Lymmura Auldarhk was a priestess of Sune in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Lymmura was a sympathetic ear and guide to all the citizens .

title: Lynn Abbey
description: Lynn Abbey Lynn Abbey ( born September 8 , 1948 ) is an American author born in Peekskill , New York . Lynn began publishing in 1979 with novels and short stories . She began writing for TSR around 1994 while continuing to write novels and editing anthologies .

title: Lynx eye
description: Lynx eye Lynx eye was the Realms name for a variety of known as that exhibited a green flash . Description . These ornamental stones were pale to dark gray with large flakes of colored reflections .

title: Lyra Sunrose
description: Lyra Sunrose Lyra Sunrose ( also known as " Little Miss Lemon " ) was a female half - elf ranger who lived in the forest of Cormanthor . History . Childhood .

title: Lyrabar
description: Lyrabar Lyrabar was a port city in Impiltur . When the Spellplague struck in 1385 DR and the Sea of Fallen Stars receded , the city ' s port was left dry , disrupting trade until the port was rebuilt closer to the water . Lyrabar was known for its criminal organizations , which made secret arrangements with the city guard .

title: Lyran Nanther
description: Lyran Nanther Lyran Nanther was an inhabitant of Melvaunt who was nominated by the Zhentarim agent and Lord of Shadowdale , Jyordhan , to succeed him . Because Jyordhan was killed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and was dispossessed of the " Pendant of Ashaba " , Lyran was left with no claim to the lordship and did not become the new lord . Biography .

title: Lyrene
description: Lyrene Lyrene was a half - elf in Mulmaster . Personality . The half - elf dreamed of joining the Zhentarim like her ancestors .

title: Lysalis
description: Lysalis Lysalis was a female fey ' ri wizard in service to Kaanyr Vhok , the leader of the Scoured Legion at the time of the Legion ' s assault on Sundabar . History . During the attack in 1385 DR , Lysalis helped Vhok to enter unseen into the town but was later killed fighting some dwarven guards .

title: Lysan
description: Lysan Lysan was a manipulative cleric of Auril in Icewind Dale . History . Her primary mission was to open the tomb of the barbarian king Kresselack to the cold winds and cleanse out the light and sources of warmth within that tomb .

title: Lysander Il ' Argad
description: Lysander Il ' Argad Lysander Il ' Argad was an individual at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Lysander was bored and inquisitive .

title: Lythari
description: Lythari Lythari ( originally Ly - tel - quessir ) are good - aligned elven lycanthropic wolves , similar in appearance to werewolves and often mistaken as such . Lythari differ from werewolves in that they have no hybrid form and are friendly and companionable when in lupine form . Although much less numerous than werewolves , a lot of Lythari are sponsored by the church of Selûne .

title: Lytin
description: Lytin Lytin was a member of the Cult of the Elemental Flame at the Scarlet Moon Hall during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . History . Lytin was one of the many Eternal Flame cultists disguised as druid s who waited to take part in the Rite of the Wicker Giant .

title: Lyzandra Calderos
description: Lyzandra Calderos Lyzandra Calderos , or Lyzzie , was the third - in - command of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Temple of the Eternal Flame in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Lyzzie was with four magmin s until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and confronted and defeated her .

title: M ' tarl
description: M ' tarl History . In 1358 DR , while traveling through the deadly streets of Menzoberranzan seeking valuable information to help the organization ' s cause , Jarlaxle and M ' tarl encountered Gromph Baenre . To have a private conversation with Jarlaxle , Gromph transported M ' tarl to an extra - dimensional realm .

title: Ma
description: Ma Ma was a barkeep in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Ma was loyal to her customers and staff but for some gold she agreed to talk .

title: Ma Chung - ying
description: Ma Chung - ying Ma Chung - ying was a shou inhabiting the Bitter Well Oasis within the Quoya Desert during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ma was the only permanent resident of Bitter Well Oasis .

title: Maalirn ' s Walk
description: Maalirn ' s Walk Maalirn ' s Walk was a north – south road bordering the eastern side of the Dukar Quarter of Myth Nantar . Geography . The road arched in places with links to the Dukars ' Academy , and was popular with younger merfolk who enjoyed racing along it , despite the hazards .

title: Maalthiir
description: Maalthiir Maalthiir was a merchant and a wizard who came to rule the city of Hillsfar . Biography . Maalthiir was an unknown quantity in the Moonsea .

title: Maarika
description: Maarika Maarika was a unusual frost giant druid in the Great Glacier in 1491 DR . Description . Maarika was a relatively small giant , compared to others in Great Glacier .

title: Maaril
description: Maaril Known chiefly as the mage who owned the Dragon Tower in the 14th century DR , Maaril possessed the Dragonstaff of Ahghairon , a powerful magic item that allowed any dragon who touched it to avoid the negative effects of Waterdeep ' s dragonward . As owner of the Dragonstaff , Maaril was able to control which dragons entered Waterdeep , a power he used to his advantage . Relationship .

title: Maas
description: Maas Maas was a male drow vampire and the leader of Maerimydra ' s force of assassins . Description . He was a handsome male who typically wore only dark trousers , gloves , and bracers of elaborate design .

title: Maastik
description: Maastik Maastik was a drow priestess of Ghaunadaur who lived in the Underdark . Description . Maastik had a mane of white hair that contrasted with her night - black skin .

title: Maatsuki
description: Maatsuki Maatsuki was a hengeyokai wu jen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Maatsuki was an evil and scheming wu jen member of the Iridescent Peacock Society in Dojyu .

title: Mabad
description: Mabad Mabad was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Mabad served as one of Sheik Ar - Rabi ' s lieutenants .

title: Mac - Fuirmidh cittern
description: Mac - Fuirmidh cittern A Mac - Fuirmidh cittern was a masterwork magic cittern and one of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Mac - Fuirmidh citterns " were pear - shaped citterns similar to lute s , superior in every way to ordinary citterns .

title: MacBec Maclyon
description: MacBec Maclyon MacBec Maclyon was an evil wizard in the Savage Frontier . Activities . MacBec had occupied the Castle of Illusion with his orc retinue .

title: Maccath
description: Maccath Maccath , also known as Maccath the Crimson , was a tiefling member of the reformed Arcane Brotherhood . Description . Maccath had very conspicuous tiefling traits , especially extremely red skin .

title: Mace
description: Mace A mace is a simple bludgeoning weapon resembling a metal club . The haft can be of varying lengths and thicknesses , but for game purposes maces come in two sizes , the light mace and the heavy mace . Both are intended to be used in one hand .

title: Mace ( half - orc )
description: Mace ( half - orc ) Mace was a half - orc cleric of Bane in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Mace led a group of orc s that had occupied the temple of II - Mater until an adventuring party hired by Dirtan killed him and his minions .

title: Mace of the Darkchildren
description: Mace of the Darkchildren A mace of the darkchildren was a heavy mace that gave its wielder power over undead . Description . A mace of the darkchildren had a haft of blackened metal resembling a human femur bone .

title: Mackester Claypipe
description: Mackester Claypipe Mackester Claypipe was a halfling assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . Mackester on the surface was the houndsmaster of House Thalavar and the most skilled canine expert of Westgate , loved both by her masters and the city ' s halfling community . However , she was secretly also a Night Mask assassin .

title: Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons
description: Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons Mad Aja ' s Magic for Fools & Simpletons was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz . Services / Merchandise . This shop offered rare and magical items for purchase to those who " looked like they needed to be able to do anything .

title: Madame Darkness
description: Madame Darkness Madame Darkness was a fortune teller in the Moonsea . Activities . Madame Darkness was the fortune teller in the Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities .

title: Madeiron Sunderstone
description: Madeiron Sunderstone Madeiron Sunderstone was the bodyguard of Open Lord Piergeiron the Paladinson in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Madeiron was near fearless but not very smart .

title: Madinat
description: Madinat Madinat , or the Round City , was the name of the main sector of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . Madinat sat next to the harbor of Furdah Rustauk .

title: Madinat al - Mumin
description: Madinat al - Mumin Madinat al - Mumin , or The City of the Faithful , was a small settlement located on the Steaming Isles within the Crowded Sea of southern Zakhara . Inhabitants . Each and every one of the inhabitants of this town lived for the Law of the Loregiver , firmly believing that as long as the Law was practiced within Madinat al - Mumin , that it would never cease to exist regardless of what happened to the rest of the Land of Fate Defenses .

title: Madislak Pemsk
description: Madislak Pemsk Madislak Pemsk was one of the druid rulers of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Madislak was a leader in the druid council that ruled Sossal .

title: Madness domain
description: Madness domain The Madness domain was a deity domain that granted madness - related spells to a cleric or certain divine spellcasters devoted to a god of madness . Once the gods Cyric , Ghaunadaur , and Tharizdun laid claim , the madness domain began spreading their blessing to their followers . Cyric " The mad god " was an ever lasting void of madness .

title: Madri
description: Madri Madri was a human woman and an important official in Halruaa . History . Prior to the Spellplague , she became lovers with the deva Demascus .

title: Madwave
description: Madwave Captain Madwave was the human captain and owner of the Gontese merchant ship " Argus Treader " . Background . Captain Madwave was one of the few gontese ship owners who didn ' t worked for the Twelvefold .

title: Mae ' Var
description: Mae ' Var Mae ' Var was the leader of a guildhall of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla in Amn . He employed Gorion ' s Ward in some missions until he ordered him to kill his superior Renal Bloodscalp in order to ascend in the thieves ' ranks . Eventually , Renal sent Gorion ' s Ward back to kill him .

title: Maea Dulgussir
description: Maea Dulgussir Maea Dulgussir was a wizard in the village of Eveningstar in the kingdom of Cormyr . She owned and operated The Low Lantern , a tavern , dance hall and theater . She kept her magical skills concealed , and few if any knew that she could work magic .

title: Maegera
description: Maegera Maegera the Inferno was a fiery primordial , whose immense heat was harnessed to power the Great Forge of the dwarven city of Gauntlgrym . Description . Similar to other fire elemental s , Maegera ' s 50 - ft ( 15 .

title: Maelephant
description: Maelephant The maelephant is a denizen of the Nine Hells and a powerful guardian used to protect the treasures of greater fiend s and evil archmage s . It is humanoid in shape , standing nine feet tall and weighing eight hundred pounds . Its oversized hands are tipped with vicious claws , and its head is just like that of a small elephant .

title: Maelestor Rex
description: Maelestor Rex Maelestor Rex was an ancient black dragon in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . In the past , Maelestor Rex made a bargain with the cornugon Vesarius in order to learn some unique spell s .

title: Maelgot
description: Maelgot Maelgot was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . While working as a guard , Maelgot usually kept around 20 gp on his person .

title: Maelin
description: Maelin Maelin was the fiery daughter of Talbot Uskevren ' s valet , Eckert . Sometime in the winter between 1370 and 1371 DR , she was kidnapped by Radu Malveen , who held her in the Malveen s ' former home . Guarded by Radu ' s vampire brother , Stannis , she was kept for months while Radu ransomed Eckert ' s knowledge of the Uskevren s for his daughter ' s life .

title: Maelin Rascalin
description: Maelin Rascalin Maelin Rascalin was a former bandit who became a general and the baron of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth . History . Maelin Rascalin was once one of the most notorious and dangerous bandits in the kingdom of Ulgarth , until at last he was captured with great effort .

title: Maelos Karanok
description: Maelos Karanok Maelos Karanok was the figurehead ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR and 1372 DR . Activities . Maelos saw magic in every corner and knew only one way to deal with it : destruction .

title: Maelstrom
description: Maelstrom Maelstrom was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Sea Queen , and to others that followed a deity associated with the ocean . It created a whirlpool in a body of water that sucked in creatures and objects . Effects .

title: Maelstrom ( Zakharan version )
description: Maelstrom ( Zakharan version ) Maelstrom was a spell used by powerful wizard s in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . When cast upon a large body of water , this spell created a hole through the Prime Material Plane into the Elemental Plane of Water , creating a huge whirlpool for the duration of the spell .

title: Maelstrom ( storm giants )
description: Maelstrom ( storm giants ) The Maelstrom was the main stronghold of the storm giant s , where lived their kings . Location . The Maelstrom lay on the floor of the Trackless Sea , 3 , 000 feet beneath the surface at a point between Ruathym , the Whalebones , and the Korinn Archipelago .

title: Maeluth
description: Maeluth Maeluths were planetouched , native outsider s descended from the breeding of dwarves and devil s . Description . Maeluths descended from fiends and dwarves , so they could have some fiend ish features , including red eyes , abnormally long fingers , or almost hairless bodies .

title: Maenoth Silversword
description: Maenoth Silversword Maenoth Silversword was a member of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was a fighter and thief of the cult and a member of the ruling council . In truth , Maenoth was also a mage and a member of the Harper s .

title: Maer Dualdon
description: Maer Dualdon Maer Dualdon was a cold lake in Icewind Dale . Geography . The lake was located in the western Ten Towns region .

title: Maera
description: Maera Maera was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Maera was a lithe half - elven woman .

title: Maeragra Duskwinter
description: Maeragra Duskwinter Maeragra Duskwinter was the junior chatelaine of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Maeragra had red hair that framed a beautiful , sharply defined face atop a slight , wiry frame .

title: Maerdrym
description: Maerdrym Maerdrym was a powerful moon elven house of Myth Drannor . Headquarters . House Maerdrym was based in a four - story villa in Myth Drannor .

title: Maerhult
description: Maerhult Maerhult was a male bard . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , he visited The Drunken Dragon tavern in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . There he met the adventurer Shaless , who was displaying a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s that she ' d apparently looted from devil s in Myth Drannor .

title: Maerimydra
description: Maerimydra Maerimydra was a large drow city located below the Dalelands in the Deep Wastes . Geography . Maerimydra was situated in the Middledark , roughly ten miles below the southern border of Mistledale .

title: Maernos
description: Maernos The Maernos ( MAY - er - noz ) family was a human noble family in Waterdeep . It concerned itself with financial activities such as banking and moneylending . Its coat of arms consisted of a pair of hands with green sleeves and three silver spear heads on a blue field .

title: Maerstar
description: Maerstar Maerstar was a town in the Vast , situated at the point where Helve ' s Trail from High Haspur ended at the North Road between Procampur and Sevenecho . It lay near the Earthfast Mountains and south of the Brynwood . History .

title: Maeruhal
description: Maeruhal Maeruhal was a small city located in eastern Halruaa . Description . Maeruhal was a small settlement located within close proximity to the famed electrum mines of Halruaa .

title: Maerun Stoutbold
description: Maerun Stoutbold Maerun Stoutbold was a merchant in Suzail , Cormyr around 1367 DR . He ran a shipbuilding company out of both Suzail and Marsember that dealt in the repair and sale of ships , nets , and masts . He had not been found to have broken the law but he was well known to be the person to speak to for silent passage on a ship .

title: Maeryln
description: Maeryln An apprentice who was lost to time and history , all that is known of Maeryln is that she was a human who specialized in absorption of arcane powers , memories , and souls . It is rumored that Halaster took her on due to her resistance to the Spellplague that he somehow knew was coming . She was consumed by her own experiments when she summoned a lifedrinker specter that slowly drained away her memories and life - force .

title: Maeshi Province
description: Maeshi Province The Maeshi Province was a small and isolated province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Geography . Maeshi was on a small northern peninsula on the west coast of Shinkoku and was bordered by several of the highest peaks in Kozakura , among them including Two Peak Mountain .

title: Maestro
description: Maestro Maestro by R . A . Salvatore is the second book of the Homecoming series .

title: Maffizo Vailentarne
description: Maffizo Vailentarne Maffizo Vailentarne was a drow wizard of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Maffizo was a minor wizard living in Q ' xorlarrin .

title: Maforie Chûmavh
description: Maforie Chûmavh Maforie Chûmavh was a drow slave in Maerimydra . History . Maforie lived all her life in slavery of the fire giant s rulers of her city .

title: Magadon Kest
description: Magadon Kest Magadon Kest was a tiefling psionicist ( or " mind mage " ) who was sired by Mephistopheles , Archduke of Cania , and a human woman . Close friend of the late Erevis Cale and the exarch Drasek Riven , he was instrumental in the struggle against the returned Netherese who were led by Shar - worshiper Rivalen Tanthul . History .

title: Mage ' s Tower
description: Mage ' s Tower The Mage ' s Tower was a mysterious tower standing on the edge of the Flooded Forest between the lands of the Vast and the Moonsea in north Faerûn , lying west of Kurth and at the end of a trail north from Tavilar . Structure . The Mage ' s Tower was a lone tower some 70 feet ( 21 meters ) high with a spired top .

title: Mage ' s disjunction
description: Mage ' s disjunction Mage ' s disjunction is a magical spell that radiates outward in a 40 by 40 ft . radius and all magical effects and magic items within the radius , except the items that you are carrying or presently touching are taken away / dispelled . Thus " disjoining " the spell with items , things , etc .

title: Mage Who Never Dies
description: Mage Who Never Dies The Mage Who Never Dies was the mysterious master of the Flooded Forest in the Vast and the Moonsea regions of north Faerûn . The title was given by folk around Ylraphon , but whoever or whatever this being was remained unknown . The Mage Who Never Dies was said to have claimed the southern part of the Flooded Forest as his domain .

title: Mage armor
description: Mage armor Mage armor ( originally called General Matick ' s armor and later simply armor ) was a common conjuration spell used by arcane casters to create an armor for themselves out of magical force . Deities of magic , such as Azuth , Mystra , Savras , and Thoth , also granted some of their cleric s this power . Effects .

title: Mage hand
description: Mage hand Mage hand is a cantrip , or low complexity spell , learned by all wizard s . When a wizard uses " mage hand " he or she conjure s a magical , ghost - like hand within twenty - five feet , which they can use to interact with objects weighing twenty pounds or less . The hand has the equivalent speed of a dwarf and can easily drop items or , given a moment , pick up new ones .

title: Magebane
description: Magebane Magebane was an intelligent + 2 bastard sword made of one piece of an unusual and unidentified black metal . It allowed its wielder to " detect magic " at will . History .

title: Magefair
description: Magefair A magefair , or the Magefair , was a private gathering of wizard s for the purposes of demonstrating magical powers and general enjoyment . Magefairs could be useful for learning new spells . History .

title: Magelord
description: Magelord Magelord was a special prestige class on Faerûn whose members were arcane spellcasters who studied an ancient magical practice known for its distinctive style : extremely fast and versatile . Magelords typically believed they had the right to get respect , wealth and power through the use and threat of arcane strength . In reality though , they used their power to dominate and intimidate less talented individuals .

title: Magemask
description: Magemask Magemasks were leather halfmasks with crystal lenses fitted within the eye openings . Powers . Anyone wearing a " magemask " viewed their surroundings as if under the active effects of a " detect magic " spell , allowing them to easily spot magic items , hidden runes , and other wizardly writings .

title: Mages of Saruun
description: Mages of Saruun The Mages of Saruun was a merchant wizard s ' guild that operated out of the Seven - Pillared Hall in Cormyr . The organization was shrouded in mystery , as even its most high - ranking members were unknown . Their operations were considered illegal , as they weren ' t officially sanctioned by the Forest Kingdom .

title: Mageweaver
description: Mageweaver Mageweavers were wizard s in Zakhara who imbued artistic creations , such as tapestries and silk scarves , with magical power . Requirements . Mageweavers did not have any special requirements other than possessing the skill needed to craft the artistic vessel where they intended to store their magic .

title: Maggarl Helck
description: Maggarl Helck Maggarl Helck was a Red Plumes commander in the Moonsea . Activities . Maggarl managed the Waydown garrison .

title: Magic
description: Magic Magic was the ability possessed by some individuals to manipulate the ambient energies of the world to produce desired results . In the Realms , arcane magic was commonly referred to as " the Art " , while divine magic was referred to as " the Power " . The goddess Mystra controlled the Weave which was the main medium for channeling the arcane energies of Abeir - Toril .

title: Magic aura
description: Magic aura A magic aura or magical aura was a type of aura , an invisible property that indicated the strength and nature of the magic possessed by a magical item or a spell , and by certain mages . The " detect magic " spell allowed a spellcaster to examine magical auras in their vicinity . Arcane spellcasters could also possess a magic aura , and this revealed their nature and make - up to other mages .

title: Magic circle against chaos
description: Magic circle against chaos Magic Circle against Chaos was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from chaotic creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from chaos " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonlawful summoned creature .

title: Magic circle against evil
description: Magic circle against evil Magic Circle against Evil , also known as Protection from Evil , 10 ' Radius , was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from evil creatures . The older version of this spell was reversible , called Protection from Good , 10 ' Radius , and had identical effects on good creatures . Effects .

title: Magic circle against good
description: Magic circle against good Magic Circle against Good , also known as Protection from Good , 10 ' Radius , was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from good creatures . The older version of this spell was reversible , called Protection from Evil , 10 ' Radius , and had identical effects on evil creatures . Effects .

title: Magic circle against law
description: Magic circle against law Magic Circle against Law was an abjuration spell that created a sphere of warding against mental and physical attacks from lawful creatures . Effects . This spell operated just like " magic circle against evil " except that it extended the area of effect for " protection from law " rather than " protection from evil " , and it could trap a nonchaotic summoned creature .

title: Magic fang
description: Magic fang Magic fang is a transmutation spell that improves a creature ' s natural weapons ( teeth , claws , etc . ) . Effect .

title: Magic jar
description: Magic jar Magic jar , which was originally called Jarm ' s magic jar , was a necromancy spell used to trap one ' s soul in a gem or crystal . Effects . Upon completing this powerful spell , the caster ' s soul leaves his or her body and enters a selected gemstone , the " magic jar " , somewhere within medium range .

title: Magic match
description: Magic match A magic match was a one - use magic item that produced a small flame on demand . Description . It was an ordinary copper rod some 3 inches ( 7 .

title: Magic missile
description: Magic missile A magic missile was a spell that cast bolts of pure force from its caster ' s fingertips . Effect . Originally , " magic missile " grew in power as its spellcaster did , so that more experienced wizards or sorcerers cast more bolts with a single spell than those with less training .

title: Magic mouth
description: Magic mouth Magic mouth , originally known as Carbury ' s mouth , was an illusion spell , that created the glamer of a mouth upon a creature or object that would deliver a message when a trigger event occurred . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to create an illusion of a speaking mouth upon a chosen object or creature within close proximity .

title: Magic stone
description: Magic stone Magic stone , also called magical stone , was a transmutation or enchantment spell that turned some nearby stones into projectiles . Effects . Up to three small stones no larger than sling bullets could be enchanted to become magical projectiles that could be used in a ranged attack .

title: Magic tinderbox
description: Magic tinderbox A magic tinderbox was a tinderbox enchanted for better reliability . It was invented by the Halruaa n mage Daltim Flamefist . Description .

title: Magic vestment
description: Magic vestment Magic vestment , and an older version called magical vestment , were transmutation or enchantment spells respectively , that improved the armor value of clothing , a shield , or a suit of armor . Effects . Though similar in effect , the two versions of this spell were different in practice .

title: Magic weapon
description: Magic weapon Magic weapon is a widespread transmutation spell that boosts a given weapon ' s usefulness in combat . Effects . " Magic weapon " gives a weapon a + 1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

title: Magical Legion
description: Magical Legion The Magical Legion was an elite unit of specialized aerial soldiers found in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . Grand Vizier Alyana al - Azzazi ran the Magical Legion , though since she detested dealing with Prince Cheddah al - Assad ' s orders , she often deferred the guidance of the Magical Legion to the White Agate who proved more than capable of handling the demands .

title: Magical sand
description: Magical sand Magical sand referred to the various types of magical sandy substances found throughout Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Similar to magical dusts , magical sand was often found in a sack or jar .

title: Magister
description: Magister The Magister was the personal champion of Mystra , existing to promote the Art in her name . The role of Magister was created in the wake of the Dawn Cataclysm . A man named Azuth gained the office , but passed it on once he himself gained divinity .

title: Maglubiyet
description: Maglubiyet Maglubiyet , known as The Mighty One or The High Chieftain was the chief deity of goblin s and hobgoblin s as well as an exarch of Bane . He was a god of war and leadership who ruled over the goblin pantheon with an iron fist . As a god of war and a great general he was also known as The Battle Lord .

title: Magnar
description: Magnar Magnar the Bear was a primal spirit of the Yuirwood . History . An ancient spirit of Yuirwood , Magnar was revered by the primitive human inhabitants of the forest .

title: Magocracy
description: Magocracy A magocracy is a form of government where only those with ability in arcane magic have a voice in government . Power is often limited to the few who have the wealth and education , or magical heritage . Magocracies are commonly , but not always , where wizard s share power in government .

title: Magrath the Minotaur
description: Magrath the Minotaur Magrath the Minotaur was a pirate lord who briefly ruled over the city of Suzail . Biography . Fleeing from a Chondathan mercenary army that had invaded the pirate city of Westgate , Magrath landed in Cormyr and purchased the city of Suzail from Melineth Turcassan for 500 sacks of gold in 429 DR .

title: Magros
description: Magros Magros was a misfortune devil in the service of Levistus . History . In 1486 DR , Magros was plotting with Sairché to use Farideh to acquire some divine sparks from the Chosen s captured by the shadovar in the Lost Peaks .

title: Magurk
description: Magurk Magurk was a male human fighter in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . A former soldier of the Purple Dragons , Magurk was proprietor of the store called One - Armed Magurk ' s . History .

title: Magusta
description: Magusta Magusta was a powerful female malaugrym that was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair in 1357 DR . At the end , she managed to get close to the girl posing as her dwarf friend Delg Hammerhand but was killed by Torm of the Knights of Myth Drannor that Elminster had sent to find and stop the malaugrym .

title: Mahabba
description: Mahabba The city of Mahabba on the banks of Al - Musammas River lay in the south - east of the League of the Pantheon at the edge of the Al - Sayaj Mountains bordering the area of the Ruined Kingdoms . It was also the latest to join the Pantheist Cities , and though centuries passed , military forces kept occuping the city against the rebellions of the pre - Pantheon cult of the goddess Bala . Because of the resulting oppressive atmosphere , Mahabba recently has been called City of Silence more often than its former title , City of Charity .

title: Mahamsaratsu Shan
description: Mahamsaratsu Shan Mahamsaratsu Shan , meaning Mountain of the Sweet - Voiced Goddess , was a peak located in the A - Ling Shan mountain range . Geography . Mahamsaratsu Shan was the most recognizable peak of the A - Ling Shan range with an elevation approaching 24 , 000 ft .

title: Maharishi
description: Maharishi Maharishi , mostly known simply as the Seer of Procalith , was a sage in serpentfolk matters in 1372 DR . Activities . Maharishi made her life ' s goal to study all about sarrukh and yuan - ti , particularly their history and magic .

title: Mahatnartorian
description: Mahatnartorian Mahatnartorian was a great red wyrm . He was killed by Prince Durothil . Background .

title: Mahavidi
description: Mahavidi Mahavidi was the Padhrasattva of Erudition within the Padhran religion . History . Historically , Mahavidi was the personal Padhrasattva of the Dalai Lama .

title: Mahmud
description: Mahmud Mahmud was a carpet merchant living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Mahmud spent much of his time at a local tavern when he was not selling carpets in the market .

title: Mahmud Ben Aziz
description: Mahmud Ben Aziz Mahmud Ben Aziz was a half - elf living on Masud Jazayir in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He ruled a small town called Bandar al - Sa ' adat . Activities .

title: Mahmud Biinazol
description: Mahmud Biinazol Lord Mahmud Biinazol was one of the four Cloakmasters of Myratma for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Mahmud had a fantastic intellect and a knack for acting , and he was uninterested in the dirty work of his trade .

title: Mai Lan
description: Mai Lan Mai Lan was a Shou human woman and the wife of Merquam Pang , one of the most prosperous merchants of Koryo around 1357 DR . She was beautiful and he was intensely jealous of her , and kept her cloistered in his mansion in Xi Hulang .

title: Maiden ' s Glade
description: Maiden ' s Glade Maiden ' s Glade , also known as Eridis in the language of Illefarn , was a glade near the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast North . Geography . Located between Fort Locke and Highcliff , Maiden ' s Glade was a clearing and a retreat for druid s , ranger s , animal s , or any traveler .

title: Maiden ' s Tongue
description: Maiden ' s Tongue " Maiden ' s Tongue " was a secret language used in ceremonies by Crinti priestesses of Loviatar . It was a language in the Central Thorass subgrouping , being related to Thorass . However , the tongue was unique enough that someone fluent in other Central Thorass languages could still not understand " Maiden ' s Tongue " .

title: Maignith Baenre
description: Maignith Baenre Maignith Baenre was a member of House Baenre circa 1373 DR . She was a captain in the guard of the Baenre Compound . History .

title: Maimun
description: Maimun Maimun was a bard and reknowned pirate who sailed up and down the entirety of the Sword Coast . As a baby , Maimun ' s village was destroyed by agents of the cambion named Asbeel who was obsessed with finding both the Stone of Tymora and the mortal whom the stone had chosen as it ' s wielder . Maimun was that mortal .

title: Majnun
description: Majnun Majnun was a janni of the Haunted Lands in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Majnun ' s whereabouts remained unknown .

title: Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe
description: Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe Major Cargunn ' s Military and Equipment Shoppe was a general store in the southern quarter of Eshpurta run by Cargunn , a retired member of the Shield Militia . The Shoppe carried all manner of adventuring gear , weapons , armor , and supplies up to a top price of 500 gp ; from sturdy clothing to bronze plate mail , from knives to greatsword s , bow s and pole arm s of all varieties , camping equipment , tack and harnesses , and even a few musical instruments . The Shoppe was located two doors north of the Hamstrung Giant .

title: Major image
description: Major image Major image , also known as spectral force or , originally , Carbury ' s spectral force , was an illusion spell , that created the visual figment of an object , creature , or force . Some creatures with innate powers of illusion , such as deceiver genie s , could also duplicate the effects of this spell . Effects .

title: Majuvix
description: Majuvix Majuvix was a Maztican native and one of the leaders of New Waterdeep in 1370 DR . History . Majuvix agreed to go to Faerûn and lived two years in Waterdeep .

title: Makbulla bint Dalmar
description: Makbulla bint Dalmar Makbulla bint Dalmar was a dwarf trader who frequented Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though she posed as a trader , Makbulla was in fact a dangerous pirate who sailed the Golden Gulf in search of prey on her sambuk , " The North Wind ' s Fury " .

title: Makin al - Mutrattab
description: Makin al - Mutrattab Chancellor Makin al - Mutrattab was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR , and a member of the royal family . Personallity . Chancellor Makin possessed a strong sense of right and wrong .

title: Makk Fireseed
description: Makk Fireseed Makk Fireseed was an elven priest of Rillifane Rallathil . Activities . He convinced his followers that the deity ' s favorite creature was the Duathamper canary , a type of canary that nested in the butternut trees on the River Duathamper .

title: Maklin Mucklar
description: Maklin Mucklar Maklin Mucklar was a gnome alchemist in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Maklin sold his alchemical products inside the Yawning Portal inn with the permission of Durnan .

title: Makos
description: Makos Makos was a tiefling warlock who lived in Neverwinter in 1479 DR . He , together with Sergeant Knox and a female cleric , defeated a dracolich near Neverwinter . Makos performed the magic that bound the dracolich ' s soul and prevented its return .

title: Malabog
description: Malabog Malabog was the king of the fomorian giants in the Feywild in 1484 DR . History . Malabog was a powerful fomorian giant in the Feywild who at some point became the king of his race .

title: Malachite
description: Malachite Malachite was an ornamental stone related to azurite and often used in inexpensive jewelry . Description . Malachite was distinguished by its green stripes of many shades .

title: Malacon
description: Malacon Malacon was a variety of zircon found in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones could produce large brown faceted gems that were hard but fragile , so they were not generally used in jewelry that was frequently subject to impact , like rings , but they were often used in room decorations .

title: Malaeragoth
description: Malaeragoth Malaeragoth was a sapphire dragon living under the Greypeak Mountains in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1370 DR . Personality . Malaeragoth enjoyed solitude , usually walking slowly in the tunnels of his home and murmuring to himself his thoughts , comments , and unfolding schemes .

title: Malaerigo Harsard
description: Malaerigo Harsard Malaerigo Harsard was the guildmaster of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild of Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Description . Malaerigo had unkempt black hair and a line of moles down his right cheek .

title: Malagdorl Armgo
description: Malagdorl Armgo Malagdorl Armgo was the weapon master of House Barrison Del ' Armgo . Personality . Malagdorl was greatly fascinated by the most powerful warrior of his House , Uthegentel Del ' Armgo , and dreamed of surpassing his ancestor ' s exploits .

title: Malaggar Tlabbar
description: Malaggar Tlabbar Malaggar Tlabbar was a drow of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan and head instructor of Melee - Magthere . History . Malaggar was the First Sword of Melee - Magthere in 1372 DR and so the nominal head of the martial school .

title: Malaggar Xarann
description: Malaggar Xarann Malaggar Xarann was the head of the College of Enchantment and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that the College of Enchantment ruled the city ' s slave market .

title: Malakuth Tabuirr
description: Malakuth Tabuirr Malakuth Tabuirr was one of the leaders of the Iron Ring as well as the leader of the Dark Dagger cell in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Malakuth was originally a caravan leader and first born of a merchant house in Karsoluthiyl .

title: Malanthor Drymm
description: Malanthor Drymm Malanthor Drymm was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed in Elminster Aumar ' s insurrection . History . He was an arrogant and very self - confident magelord .

title: Malanthus Stormstaern
description: Malanthus Stormstaern Malanthus Stormstaern was a mage of the 2nd century DR and held the position of Magister from 154 to 177 DR . History . In the Year of the Jealous Hag , 154 DR , Malanthus Stormstaern was one of a number of mages who banded together against Flaerivus Grevauldyn , the current Magister , in an effort to stop him acquiring yet more power .

title: Malar
description: Malar Malar ( pronounced " MAHL - arr " ) , The Beastlord , was the lesser deity of the hunt , evil lycanthropes , bestial savagery and bloodlust . His dogma concerned savage hunts , the spreading of the curse of lycanthropy , and general contempt for civilization . After the events of the Spellplague , he was an exarch of Silvanus .

title: Malark Himbruel
description: Malark Himbruel Malark Himbruel was a wizard and a Weaver of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon in 1357 DR , during the hunt for Shandril Shessair . Malark was the last remaining Cult ' s archmage who tried to capture Shandril , after she destroyed Shargrailar . Malark also wanted vengeance for the death of Symgharyl Maruel , his underling , but Shandril defeated him also .

title: Malark Springhill
description: Malark Springhill Malark Springhill was a monk of the long death and for sometime a servant of Szass Tam . Appearance . Originating from the Moonsea area , Malark is not of Mulan descent but since he moved to Eltabbar he started to shave his head and put on tattoos like a Mulan born .

title: Malathon
description: Malathon Malathon was a half - orc cleric of Bane who helped in the attack on Shadowdale . Powers . His cleric domains were Destruction and Evil .

title: Malatra
description: Malatra Malatra was a jungle land in the south of Kara - Tur . In these lands there existed political states which were quite different in their culture and inhabitants from the rest of Kara - Tur . There were three states Purang , Laothan and the Kuong Kingdom .

title: Malatran Plateau
description: Malatran Plateau Created and protected by ancient alien magic , the Malatran Plateau rose thousands of feet above the rest of Malatra . Geography . Like the rest of Malatra , the Malatran Plateau was covered mostly by jungle .

title: Malaug
description: Malaug Malaug , before knew as Maulagadorn , was a male warrior and wizard who created the malaugrym . History . In the early days of the North , Maulaugadorn was a great warrior who created for himself a kingdom in these lands , worshiping Tempus .

title: Malaugrym
description: Malaugrym Malaugryms , also known as Shadowmasters , were evil shapeshifter s . Combat . These shapeshifters were , both physically and mentally , superior to many , if not most other races .

title: Malauth
description: Malauth Malauth was the " most sinister " goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Malauth was located in the central southern foothills of the Rauvin Mountains .

title: Malavon Despana
description: Malavon Despana Malavon Despana is a drow wizard of some power , who currently serves as the Archmage of the Underdark city of Rilauven . He led a group of anti - Lolth ite revolutionaries to a successful coup in the city , changing the Lolth venerating , matriarchal society into a relatively egalitarian oligarchy , led by a council of representatives from the cities acadamies . The coup was relatively bloodless .

title: Malavos Drunn
description: Malavos Drunn Malavos Drunn is a retired warrior and the current barkeep of the Horn and Hoof tavern in Longsaddle . He fences stolen goods , with enough skill so as to not draw any uneccessary attention . Possessions .

title: Malazan
description: Malazan Malazan was an old colossal red dragon who was one of the primary agents of Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , under Sammaster ' s orders , Malazan led a horde of goblinoid s to conquer the fortress at the Vaasan Gate .

title: Malcanthet
description: Malcanthet Malcanthet was a demon lord . She was also called Queen of Succubi . Description .

title: Malchior
description: Malchior Malchior , usually know as Malchior of Darkhold , was a cleric of Cyric and a member of the Zhentarim in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Malchior ' s first and foremost loyalty was to himself , his god a distant second .

title: Malchor Harpell
description: Malchor Harpell Malchor Harpell was a human wizard of the Harpell family who dwelt in the Tower of Twilight , which rested east of the Neverwinter Wood . Personality . Even though Malchor was Khelben ' s second most powerful follower , other than Laeral Silverhand , he was also the most skeptical of the Moonstars .

title: Malco
description: Malco Malco was the personal servant of Sozarro in 1362 DR . History . Malco was a Payit who believed Maztica conquered by the Amn ians in 1361 DR and offered his services to them .

title: Maldobar
description: Maldobar Maldobar was a small village north of Sundabar . Geography . Maldobar was located 50 miles north up the Dead Orc River from Sundabar .

title: Maldridge House
description: Maldridge House Maldridge House was a stately old mansion located on Macintyre Path in Ravens Bluff . The mansion was best known as Jack Ravenwild ' s temporary residence after he rescued Seila Norwood from enslavement by dark elves . The mansion burned to the ground in 1479 DR during a drow attempt to recapture Jack .

title: Maldrithor
description: Maldrithor Maldrithor , known to history as " the Sarbreenar Wyrm " , was a male wyrm green dragon that once laired at Sarbreenar in the Vast . History . Maldrithor grew to be a dragon of tremendous size .

title: Malduir
description: Malduir Malduir was a city located in Dambrath . History . Reinhar IX and his attempted expansion of Dambrath was repelled by drow forces during a brutal war that lasted three decades .

title: Maldwyn Daggerford
description: Maldwyn Daggerford Maldwyn Daggerford was the duke of Daggerford . Personality . Maldwyn was more interested in being admired and respected than truly ruling his duchy .

title: Malebranche
description: Malebranche Malebranches , or war devils , were the champions of the Nine Hells . Activities . Malebranches only obey pit fiend s and archdevil s .

title: Maliantor
description: Maliantor Maliantor , also known as Blackstaff ' s Eyes and Maliantor of Waterdeep , was a member of the Gray Hands adventuring company . Description . Maliantor had long , braided brown hair , sea - green eyes , and an impish smile .

title: Malice Do ' Urden
description: Malice Do ' Urden Malice Do ' Urden was matron mother of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan until her death . She was a strong high priestess of Lolth , although her fall was in losing the favor of Lolth . Description .

title: Maligor
description: Maligor Maligor was the Zulkir of Alteration in Thay until 1362 DR . Description . The Zulkir was a bald , pale , thin man with a tattoo atop his skull demonstrating his devotion to Myrkul .

title: Malik al - Samawat
description: Malik al - Samawat Malik al - Samawat was a noble djinni who lived atop the highest peak on the island of Al - Zira in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Personality . Malik was incredibly haughty and easily distracted .

title: Malik el Sami
description: Malik el Sami Malik el Sami yn Nasser was a human former merchant from Calimshan and the Seraph of Lies and Chosen of Cyric . History . Malik lived as a merchant in Calimport until the first prince of the local caliph took a liking to his wife , and frequently visited Malik ' s household .

title: Malimshaer
description: Malimshaer Malimshaer was a scout nycaloth and member of the Trio Nefarious and strategist of the Army of Darkness . History . Malimshaer was first summoned to the Realms by the Netherse archwizard Aldlas Sodhese .

title: Malkarion
description: Malkarion Malkarion was a male Damaran human paladin turned blackguard , formerly devoted to Tyr before turning to Shar . He led the Sharran cultists ' activities at the Black Rift on the Plane of Shadow , serving the black dragon Despayr . Description .

title: Malkizid
description: Malkizid Malkizid was a powerful fallen solar and former archdevil who resided in the Blood Rift . He was also called " The Branded King " , because of the constantly bleeding wound on his forehead given to him by Corellon Larethian . History .

title: Malkyn Grenefeld
description: Malkyn Grenefeld Malkyn Grenefeld was the chamberlain of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Malkyn was the city ' s chamberlain and the court ' s mage .

title: Malla ' s soul stone
description: Malla ' s soul stone Malla ' s soul stone was a unique " ioun stone " imprisoning the soul of Malla , daughter of Marlowe . Description . It was a small tear - shaped star sapphire , weighing 1 lb ( 907 g ) .

title: Mallag
description: Mallag Mallag was a derro from Ravagestone . History . During the Rage of Demons , Mallag was exiled from his town for being too insane even for derro standards .

title: Mallik Illance
description: Mallik Illance Captain Mallik Illance of the Illance family , elder cousin of Jhartos , was seventh in line for the clan ' s lordship and was one of the clan ' s few ship owners . He lived in the Cormyrean Embassy in Calimport but hated the city and remained only because it was his duty . He established trade ties with honest merchants .

title: Mallin
description: Mallin Mallin was a lich and one of the lovers — and skulls — of Tashara of the Seven Skulls . After Azuth defeated Tashara , her seven skulls split apart , and went in many directions . The skull of Mallin that took residence in a shattered tower in Myth Rhynn , where he collected and studied magic .

title: Malphys Maraphiir
