description: Malphys Maraphiir Rhyem Maraphiir was an elf and the brother of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Malphys ' s mother was the sun elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar and his father was the moon elf Rhyem Maraphiir .

title: Malruthiia Chaadren
description: Malruthiia Chaadren Malruthiia Chaadren was a female sylvan elf and the half - sister of Yaereene Ilbaereth . She was born out of wedlock to a high - ranking clan in the Neverwinter Woods , and was exiled upon reaching adulthood . Relatives .

title: Malu River
description: Malu River The Malu River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Found on the eastern edge of Koryo , the Malu River began high in the Sillan Mountains , then ran south alongside the Vorkani Mountains .

title: Malus Blackdagger
description: Malus Blackdagger Malus Blackdagger was an infamous bandit leader on the High Road , together with his brother Traven Blackdagger . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan .

title: Malus Blackiron
description: Malus Blackiron Malus Blackiron was a duergar specter priest of Deep Duerra and a member of Clan Blackiron at the small duergar settlement of Fort Iron in the Underdark under Mulmaster in the Moonsea . History . Over time , most of Malus ' s fellow duergar went mad as a result of the influence of the Seed of Fel Earth , a sentient stone part of Ogrémoch .

title: Malvag
description: Malvag Malvag was a powerful drow priest of Vhaeraun in Cormanthor in 1375 DR . History . Malvag gathered some of the most loyal followers of Vhaeraun , among them Jezz the Lame , from both House Jaelre and Clan Auzkovyn in order to cast a spell he had found in the ruins of ancient Ilythiir in order to summon their god undetected .

title: Malver Tulbard
description: Malver Tulbard Malver Tulbard was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Malver was investigating Sraunter , so Manshoon sent his mind - controlled War Wizard Ondrath Everwood to kill him .

title: Malvin Draga
description: Malvin Draga Malvin Draga was on the Council of Elders in the city of Everlund , appointed as the " Keeper of the Bridges " , as of 1374 DR . He was a human rogue and fighter . He had a scheming personality and aimed to gain wealth by controlling customs in the city through corruption of the city watch .

title: Malyanna
description: Malyanna Malyanna was a noble eladrin and follower of the Abolethic Sovereignty . She wished to open a portal to the Far Realm in order to unleash god - like elder evil s upon Toril . Description .

title: Malydren
description: Malydren Malydren was a city in the Underdark and the main capital of the race of the ixzan , the subterranean cousins of the ixitxachitl and the center of the worship of their god Ilxendren . History . It was founded in the year 602 DR .

title: Malygris
description: Malygris Malygris was a powerful dracolich on Toril . Description . He was originally a very old Blue dragon that lived in Anauroch .

title: Malyk
description: Malyk Malyk was allegedly from a far - distant branch of the House of Morn , the historic rulers of Daggerdale . His loyalty to the Black Network of the Zhentarim prompted them to instill rebellion , eliminate the House of Morn and install Malyk as the Lord of Daggerdale . The surviving heir to the house was the adventurer Randal Morn who fled into the hills to raise a resistance force .

title: Malyk ( demipower )
description: Malyk ( demipower ) Malyk was an aspect of Talos created in the wake of the Time of Troubles to take advantage of areas of wild magic , created after Mystra ' s death at the hands of Helm . Due to the nature of his followers though , these were usually restricted to areas in the Underdark . History .

title: Mamaod
description: Mamaod Mamaod was a djinni and inhabitant of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Gifted to the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , by Jiraad , Mamaod guarded her within her personal quarters .

title: Mamblat
description: Mamblat Mamblat , nicknamed " Happy " , was a minstrel from the city of Hillsfar by the Moonsea . Around 1370 DR , Happy Mamblat was one of the more well - known itinerant minstrels wandering the Vast . Mamblat was a friendly and good - humored figure , loved by many .

title: Mameluks
description: Mameluks The mameluks , also known as the slave - kings , were a group of slave - soldiers in the Seventh Age of Calimshan who rose to power after the fall of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . During the reign of the mameluks , slavery was ( naturally ) outlawed in Calimshan .

title: Mamluk
description: Mamluk Taken from unenlightened tribes as children , mamluks were individuals who grew up as slaves in Zakhara . Activities . These children were brought to enlightenment and schooled in various areas including warfare , discipline and administration .

title: Mamluk Council
description: Mamluk Council Several mamluk organizations in Qudra had seats on the cities ' military council and were called the Mamluk Council . Mamluk Council . The Dauntless .

title: Mamluk sword of obedience
description: Mamluk sword of obedience The Mamluk swords of obedience were magical swords that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These swords were available in a wide variety of sword types .

title: Mammon
description: Mammon Mammon is the archduke of Minauros , the third layer of the Nine Hells , and the patron of greed and lust . He is a baatezu . Despised by his peers , no one trusts Mammon thanks to his record for duplicity .

title: Mamood
description: Mamood Mamood lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Mamood owned a large tent in the Pilgrims ' District which he rented out to travelers and pilgrim ' s , providing them with a safe place to sleep for only one bit per night .

title: Mamood ' s
description: Mamood ' s Mamood ' s was a large tent located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . Mamood ' s could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mamood Kalin
description: Mamood Kalin Mamood Kalin was a member of the Riders of Blood in 1367 DR . History . Originally from Huzuz , Mamood ' s father was accused as being a traitor to the Grand Caliph and beheaded .

title: Mamoud ibn Asra
description: Mamoud ibn Asra Mamoud ibn Asra was a dwarven faris who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Mamoud was a a confidant of Batina al - Shaat , the leader of the Preachers .

title: Mana Forge
description: Mana Forge The Mana Forge was a small realm within Bhaal ' s realm in the Lower Planes , created for the purpose of focusing his scattered essence from his Bhaalspawn children after his death . It consisted of only a few relatively small , circular platforms that floated in nothingness , although gravity operated normally on top of them . Four smaller platforms existed just to feed energy into the larger central one , where it was focused on a column of green light .

title: Manarech Eskwuin
description: Manarech Eskwuin High Priest Manarech Eskwuin is a priest of Tymora in the services of the royalty of Cormyr . In 1369 DR he was attempting to treat the stricken Duke Bhereu Obarskyr when the Duke vomited black viscous bile on him , causing him to flee in terror .

title: Manarlume Tanthul
description: Manarlume Tanthul Manarlume Tanthul was one of the Princes of Shade . History . In 1487 DR , Manarlume and her sister Lelavdra Tanthul were summoned by High Prince Telamont Tanthul , who ordered them to gather in a kind of club all the young ambitious arcanist s , and seduce the most suspicious in order to uncover all plots against Telamont .

title: Manasowar
description: Manasowar Manasowar was a large lake found in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . Located deep within the Katakoro Shan range , Manasowar sat just north of the capital city of Saikhoi .

title: Manass
description: Manass Manass , or the City of White Walls , was one of the Five Great Cities of Khazari , though it was the smallest of them . Geography . Manass was located in northern Khazari along a pass found halfway up the Katakoro Shan mountains .

title: Manchar
description: Manchar Manchar was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying in the eastern arm of the Vorkani Mountains . Around 1357 DR , the town was the home of the wandering holy man Korax of Manchar . It was also the base of the Vi ' oontu ninja clan .

title: Mandible
description: Mandible The Mandible was the most powerful gang operating in Skullport in the late 15th century DR . Next to the Skulls of Skullport The Mandible was the closest thing to a government the town had . The gang took its name from a sword known as " Dragon ' s Tooth " which was found in the ruins of the old town .

title: Mandolin
description: Mandolin Mandolins were small pear - shaped string instruments . Description . When played as accompanying instruments , mandolins provided a delicate fluttering sound .

title: Mandrake Deepwise
description: Mandrake Deepwise Mandrake Deepwise was a human explorer of the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Mandrake was a legendary member of the Guild of Underdark Guides , having performed some difficult explorations .

title: Mandrake Trollbane
description: Mandrake Trollbane Mandrake Trollbane was a skilled within the Caravan District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Mandrake specialized in making custom wagons for his customers .

title: Mandron Saldar
description: Mandron Saldar Mandron Saldar was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Saldar and other five Dragons acted as escort to War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .

title: Mane
description: Mane A mane was a tanar ' ri demon formed when a chaotic evil soul died and was sent to the Abyss . Manes were considered the " fodder " of the Abyss . Description .

title: Mane ' s Band
description: Mane ' s Band Mane ' s Band was a group of ten adventures , led by the warrior Mane . History . In 1344 DR the band almost met their death ' s in the Yuirwood and disbanded for a time .

title: Mane ' s Manor
description: Mane ' s Manor Mane ' s Manor was a house in the town of Shadowdale belonging to Mother Tara . Structure . The manor was a two - story house located just west of the festhall .

title: Maneira
description: Maneira Maneira was a female halfling holy slayer who lived on Nada al - Hazan in the Crowded Sea . Activities . Maneira was a member of the Gilded Palm .

title: Manferic III
description: Manferic III Manferic III was the king of Ankhapur . Personality . Manferic ' s goal was immortality but for his vanity he also wanted to maintain a good appearance and continue ruling his city .

title: Manfred Arbustle
description: Manfred Arbustle Manfred " Manny " Arbustle was a druid member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Description . With noticeable freckles , Manfred appeared very boyish and younger than his actual age .

title: Manggus
description: Manggus A manggus was an evil spirit that lived on the steppes of the Hordelands . They used their power to frighten others and demand sacrifices . Description .

title: Mangobarl Lorren
description: Mangobarl Lorren Mangobarl Lorren was the baker of Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . He ran his shop in that village . Relationship .

title: Manitou
description: Manitou A manitou manifests , in its true form , as a tangle of ghostly vines , each tipped with a fanged maw . Manitous can possess any animal , plant , or fey . In their incorporeal form , they can literally tear apart the natural world with the invisible forces at their command .

title: Mannin
description: Mannin Mannin the Stout was a mercenary in Westgate . Activities . Mannin was one of the field officers of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .

title: Manshaka
description: Manshaka Manshaka was a city ( a town by Calishite standards ) in Calimshan , most well - known for its Blood Arenas and slavery . A home for gamblers and smugglers , such was its disrepute that more euphemistic aliases existed for this city than any other in Calimshan . It was the second - largest gambling center in all Faerûn , next to Calimport .

title: Manshoon
description: Manshoon Manshoon was the founder of the Zhentarim , also known as the Black Network , until he was " slain " by Fzoul Chembryl , his ally , and Lord Orgauth in 1370 DR . However , it transpired that Manshoon had created a dozen or more clone s that the murderous duo then found themselves facing . Only one of these clones survived into the late 1370s DR and once more headed the evil organization known as the Zhentarim .

title: Manticore
description: Manticore A manticore was a large , magical beast with the body of a lion , dragon - like wings , and a somewhat humanoid head . Its long tail had a cluster of deadly spikes , which the creature could launch at its foes as weapons . It had dagger - like claws and fangs .

title: Mantle
description: Mantle The Mantle were a serie of passages and side - caverns in the Dark Dominion of Menzoberranzan . The Eastways : These tunnels lead to Driders ' Chasm , east to the Fardrimm and the dwarf - claimed tunnels of fallen Delzoun . In this tunnels were the caves Ablonsheir ' s Cave , named for Ablonsheir U lu ' ar , one - time Arch mage of Menzoberranzan , Cavern of the Severed Tentacles , named for a fail invation of I llithids from Phanlinksal , Pit - Warrens a jail for violators .

title: Mantle stone of Vhyridaan
description: Mantle stone of Vhyridaan The mantle stone of Vhyridaan was an " ioun stone " that held and protected against magical spells . It held the soul of Vhyridaan the Mad . History .

title: Mantol - Derith
description: Mantol - Derith Mantol - Derith was a trading city situated in an underground cavern three miles below the surface . Geography . Its exact location was not known by many .

title: Manual of the Planes 4th edition
description: Manual of the Planes 4th edition Contents . The " Manual of the Planes " is the authoritative guide to the new cosmology presented in the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game . Like previous versions of the book the 4th edition of the " Manual of the Planes " ( MotP ) is primarily a lore book , focusing on background information on each plane it covers rather than introducing new rules .

title: Manxam
description: Manxam Manxam was the oldest and most powerful beholder living in the Western Heartlands . He was a member of the Zhentarim , and also acted also as the ruler of Teshwave . He was the most prominent of the exiled beholder of Ootlul Activities .

title: Many - Arrows
description: Many - Arrows The Kingdom of Many - Arrows was an orc kingdom founded by Obould Many - Arrows in 1371 DR and recognized as a sovereign realm by several of the Silver Marches signatories the following year . It stretched from Mithral Hall in the west to the Moonwood in the east and to the Evermoors in the south . A glimpse into the future made it known that the kingdom would last at least 100 years to the reign of King Obould VI , but even then , renegade shamans of Gruumsh attempted to return to the old orc ways and wished to attack their neighbors instead of continuing to foster peaceful relations with them .

title: Many - Hued Peacock Society
description: Many - Hued Peacock Society The Many - Hued Peacock Society was a secret society plotting the ruin of Shou Lung . Description . The Many - Hued Peacock Society was known for their centuries - long plots .

title: Many - Windowed Tower
description: Many - Windowed Tower The Many - Windowed Tower was a slender tower , 6 or 7 stories tall , on the southwestern shores of the Yal Tengri in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . The tower was the abode of a lich named Demchungchumrub who kidnapped and killed sailors along Yal Tengri to crew his spelljammer ship , a great galley known as " Delras " .

title: Manyfins
description: Manyfins Manyfins was a name given to a type of found in north Faerûn in the Vast . Description . It was very small in size , characterized by its number of fins , and had a sharp taste .

title: Map House
description: Map House The Map House , also known as the Heralds ' House because it was owned by the Heralds of Faerûn , was a library and repository for geographical maps and genealogies of noble houses . In 1371 DR it became part of the Conclave of Silverymoon . Location .

title: Mar ( ethnicity )
description: Mar ( ethnicity ) The Mar were a race of human s dwelling in the Utter East . History . The Mar were the indigenous inhabitants of the Utter East ; they had settled along the coastline in past ages .

title: Mara
description: Mara Mara was the chef of the Bubbling Cauldron tavern in the village of Hilltop . History . In 1372 DR after a kobold attack on Hilltop , Mara was taken hostage in the tavern ' s kitchen by a small group of kobolds led by Hurc , who had been separated from the main attack force .

title: Mara al - Gurab Sakir
description: Mara al - Gurab Sakir Mara al - Gurab Sakir was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Mara was demure and loyally obeyed every command of her master .

title: Marakus Beindold
description: Marakus Beindold Marakus Beindold was a Master Merchant of the village of Hlintar in the Vast in the 13th century DR . History . Around the mid – 13th century DR , Marakus Beindold was Master Merchant of the village of Hlintar when he sought to annex the hills east of the town , and thereby expand Hlintar ' s farmland and enrich himself .

title: Maraloi
description: Maraloi The Maraloi , or Ancient Lords , were a mysterious race inhabiting northern Kara - Tur . Name . The word ' " maraloi " meant " ancient lords " in the Pazruki language .

title: Maram il Vass
description: Maram il Vass Maram il Vass was a powerful ultroloth yugoloth in the Deep Wastes . Activities . Maram had found a better approach than warmongering .

title: Maram il Vass ' s servant
description: Maram il Vass ' s servant Maram il Vass ' s servant attended the yugoloth in the Deep Wastes . Personality . The long years of servitude had completely conditioned him into unquestioningly serving the yugoloth .

title: Maram of the Great Spear
description: Maram of the Great Spear Maram of the Great Spear was a primordial , confined to the Elemental Chaos by the Monuments of the Ancients . . It was also one of the " Seven Lost Gods " .

title: Maran
description: Maran Maran or Mari was a language spoken by the Mar people of the Utter East . It was categorized in the Midani subgroup of the Untheric group of the Rauric languages family , and was most closely related to the languages of Zakhara . Sounding strange yet melodious to Atreus Eleint ' s ears , Maran was composed of many short syllables and employed throaty or guttural clicks .

title: Marance Talendar
description: Marance Talendar Marance Talendar was a wizard in Nine Hells . Relationships . Marance in Selgaunt was always in company of his brother Nuldrevyn Talendar .

title: Marangor
description: Marangor Marangor , also known as the City of Dragon s , was a fortress - city and the capital of the empire of Skelkor on Returned Abeir . Government . Marangor was ruled by the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal since many centuries before the Spellplague .

title: Marantha
description: Marantha Marantha was a mute cleric in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Marantha was the cleric of a unidentified nature goodness .

title: Marantine Delcastle
description: Marantine Delcastle Marantine Delcastle was a noble in Suzail and the lady of House Delcastle . History . In 1479 DR , following the request of her son Arclath Delcastle , Marantine agreed to house Amarune Whitewave and Elminster Aumar ' s party in her house for a time .

title: Maranyuss
description: Maranyuss Maranyuss was a night hag who was personally kicked out of the Nine Hells by Asmodeus himself . She found herself in Waterdeep and set up a bookshop called Curious Pages that specialized in esoteric books . At some point , she met the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn and since they both hated Asmodeus , they entered into an uneasy alliance .

title: Marash Rashi
description: Marash Rashi Marash Rashi was a barbarian merchant in the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . As a member of the Kashghun tribe , Rashi was the best trader of Chegoyui .

title: Maratimmir
description: Maratimmir Maratimmir was the seat of Ankaram and the official home of Duchess Vajra Valmeyjar of Tethyr , though she spent most of her time at the royal palace of Faerntarn . Location . Maratimmir was located about 30 miles east of the city of Myratma along the southern bank of the River Ith within the confines of County Calimmon .

title: Maraunth Torr
description: Maraunth Torr Maraunth Torr was an evil archmage in 1487 DR . Personality . Maraunth Torr was a young and ambitious archmage .

title: Marble
description: Marble Marble was a hardstone widely used in the Realms as a building material . Marble was sometimes called because that was its primary ingredient . Description .

title: Marcabruk
description: Marcabruk Marcabruk was the leader of the hybsil Autnak Tribe in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Marcabruk and his tribe in 1358 joined the Company of the Singing Dawn , the Llandrydd ' s Steel group and Enhanen ' s men in fighting the undead army led by the mad cleric of Tempus Theodoric .

title: Marchas
description: Marchas Vanguard Marchas was a leader of a steading of cloud giant s . History . In the late 1200s DR , during Marchas ' time as vanguard of the his tribe , he chose to ban the high priest of Memnor , Abram , from the contests at which cloud giants often compete , because Abram had shown himself to be cruel and careless with the lives of innocent persons involved .

title: Marching Mountains
description: Marching Mountains The Marching Mountains were a heavily forested mountain range on the northern border of Calimshan . Geography . The Marching Mountains ran east to west and , together with the River Agis , which flowed west from its peaks , formed the Calishite border with Tethyr .

title: Marco Volo
description: Marco Volo Marcus Wands , better known as Marco Volo was a Waterdhavian noble nuisance and a minor thief who adopted this moniker after stealing an artifact and blaming the real Volo . Personality . Marco comes off as an annoying , persistent and brazen fellow .

title: Marco Wildfeet
description: Marco Wildfeet Marco Wildfeet was the unofficial leader of Soravia in Damara in 1359 DR . History . Marco led his people in the opposition to Zhengyi .

title: Marcos Craumerdaun
description: Marcos Craumerdaun Marcos Craumerdaun was a human male and the head of the Craumerdaun mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . Marcos was a cavalry trainer and had a good eye for quality horses , but did not deal as well with people in competitive business dealings .

title: Marcus
description: Marcus Marcus was a potter in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Marcus was a priest of Chauntea in Secomber but an argument with the high priest stripped him of his powers and rank .

title: Marcus Vinlander
description: Marcus Vinlander Marcus Vinlander was a shopkeeper of Tuns and Tubs in Skullport . History . The Vinlander family had always been in the vine business and Marcus at first wanted to manage a distillery .

title: Marcus of Shadowdale
description: Marcus of Shadowdale Marcus of Shadowdale was killed and then reincarnated as a dog . He made his way to Ravens Bluff and has endeared himself to the local population who named him King . Appearance .

title: Mardeiym Reithel
description: Mardeiym Reithel Lord Mardeiym Reithel was a fey ' ri under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth . He was a veteran of the Seven Citadels ' War and was given control of the houses of Reithel , Floshin , Ulvaerren , Ursequarra and Almyrrtel against the city of Evereska . Later Sarya chosen him as the general of her army .

title: Marden Norwood
description: Marden Norwood Marden Norwood , aka Lord Norwood , was the patriarch of House Norwood in Ravens Bluff . Description . Norwood had silver hair .

title: Mardikan
description: Mardikan Mardikan was a human priest of House Helcaliant who worshiped Horus - Re in Mulhorand within the Old Empires . Description . The cleric was a strong and tall man with powerful religious and political ties .

title: Mardivec Gentlecut
description: Mardivec Gentlecut Mardivec Gentlecut was an incubus servant of Graz ' zt in the Moonsea . Relationships . Mardivec was an old friend of the goblin cambion Agrak .

title: Marduk
description: Marduk Marduk was an aspect of the lesser dragon god Bahamut , worshiped in Unther as the greater god of cities , wind , thunder , storms , and rain . Description . Marduk was one of the few members of the Untheric pantheon who had an inhuman appearance .

title: Marek
description: Marek Marek was a male human thief active before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Marek was a high - ranking member of the thieves ' guild of Zhentil Keep and was a mentor to the young human Cyric .

title: Marek the Shank
description: Marek the Shank Marek the Shank was a hobgoblin of Ship Rethnor in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . Possessions . Dressed in studded leather , Marek used a longsword and shield , or wielded a shortbow in battle .

title: Marel
description: Marel Marels were a distinct evil aquatic elven race worshiping Umberlee . Description . These pale skin elves had blackish green hair and green eyes which had an phosphorescent glow .

title: Maresa Rost
description: Maresa Rost Maresa Rost was a tall genasi - human crossbreed . Appearance . Maresa had very pale skin , large violet eyes , a pointed chin , and a heart - shaped face .

title: Margery Thrier
description: Margery Thrier Margery Thrier , also known as Mags , was a businesswoman in Hillsfar . History . Mags managed the finances of the Hillsfar Arena .

title: Mari Agneh
description: Mari Agneh Mari Agneh was the former tharchion of Priador , a region and town of Thay . History . Mari was deposed by the zulkir Aznar Thrul , who then proclaimed himself tharchion of Priador .

title: Mari Al ' maren
description: Mari Al ' maren Mari Al ' maren was a Harper bard . Personality . Mari was quick to laugh and to anger but also sarcastic like Caledan Caldorien .

title: Mari bint Sadita
description: Mari bint Sadita Mari bint Sadita ran a small stall within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Mari was quiet and her pleasant attitude made customers feel at ease .

title: Mariabronne
description: Mariabronne Mariabronne the Rover was a human ranger , famous throughout the lands of Damara , often called The Tamer of Vaasa . Description . At about 40 years of age , Mariabronne ' s face showed the hardship that came with more than 20 years of battles .

title: Maribar Island
description: Maribar Island Maribar Island was located off of the eastern coast of the Pearl Cities region of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Maribar Island covered roughly 900 sq .

title: Marid
description: Marid Marids ( sometimes pluralized as " marid " ) were powerful genie s native to the Elemental Plane of Water . They were also prevalent throughout Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Most Zakharans revered marids as the most wondrous and powerful of all geniekind .

title: Marid ' s Mouth
description: Marid ' s Mouth The Marid ' s Mouth , also known as al - Gawwar , al - Hazan , or Maut Ahmar , was a large whirlpool located in the waters of the southern region of the Nada al - Hazan achipelago within the Crowded Sea . Description . The mouth of Maut Ahmar spanned several leagues , striking fear into the heart of any sailor within sight because the whirlpool moved around in random patterns , making it nearly impossible to safely navigate around .

title: Maridan
description: Maridan Maridans , or sea gen , were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . Sea gen resembled their element with greenish skin and blue hair and eyes .

title: Marilith
description: Marilith Mariliths , also known as type V demon s , were a type of powerful tanar ' ri demon . Mariliths were the tacticians of Abyssal hordes and queens of the Abyssal realms . They served as the generals and advisors to the demon lords of the Abyss .

title: Marilyn Haresdown
description: Marilyn Haresdown The Lady High Ambassador Duchess Marilyn Haresdown was the duchess of the Purple Marches in Tethyr and a former member of the adventuring band the Company of Eight . Description . Duchess Haresdown had relatively short , blonde hair .

title: Marim Tem
description: Marim Tem Marim Tem was a half - elf entertainer and musician in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . His growing fame had a bad effect on Marim .

title: Marimmar
description: Marimmar Marimmar , also known as Marimmar the Magnificent , was the wizard master of the young Narm Tamaraith . History . Marimmar was a good but slow magic teacher who over - estimated his powers .

title: Marion Hexbane
description: Marion Hexbane Marion Hexbane was a high - ranking member of the Blackdagger Bandits in Neverwinter . Personality . Marion resented her spellscar , despite the fact that it increased her power .

title: Marius
description: Marius Marius the Valiant was a mercenary recruiter in Turmish . Activities . Marius was a recruiter based in Alaghôn .

title: Mark Anthony
description: Mark Anthony Mark Anthony ( born 1966 ) is an American fantasy author known beyond the Realms for his " The Last Rune " series . His first novel was " Crypt of the Shadowking " in The Harpers series . His works include novels for the Forgotten Realms , the Dragonlance and the Ravenloft settings , as well as several short stories .

title: Mark Nelson
description: Mark Nelson Mark Nelson is a professor and artist who has illustrated role - playing games and comic books . Education . Nelson received his Master of Arts degree from the .

title: Markao Jaitzen
description: Markao Jaitzen Markao Jaitzen was a sohei participant at the Komite in Shou Lung . History . Markao Jaitzen was a sohei at the Temple of True Enlightenment in Suijeng , training under sensei Lu - che .

title: Markeen
description: Markeen Markeen , or “ genie doubles , ” were a lesser form of genie that were isolated from most of their kind . At birth , these creatures were cursed to resemble exactly a human from Zakhara . Other than their looks , markeen did not share any kind of bond with their human counterpart other than both were born at the exact same moment .

title: Market Floor ( Djerad Thymar )
description: Market Floor ( Djerad Thymar ) The Market Floor was a district of the dragonborn city of Djerad Thymar . Description . The Market Floor was an open bazaar where the city ' s commerce was held , located above the foundation of the city .

title: Markguth
description: Markguth Markguth was a human guard and the sergeant of the guards in the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands in west Faerûn . History . During the battle with the Cult of the Dragon , Markguth was among the defenders of the keep .

title: Markham Southwell
description: Markham Southwell Markham Southwell was the sheriff of Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Markham was at the town hall when giant s attacked the city .

title: Marking the Years
description: Marking the Years Years ( winters ) are referred to by names , each name consistent across the Realms . Each kingdom or city - state numbers years differently , usually to measure the reign of a dynasty or the current monarch , or since the founding of the country . The result is a hodgepodge of overlapping numbers that serve to confuse the ordinary person and frustrate the sage .

title: Markoth Hasselpond
description: Markoth Hasselpond Markoth Hasselpond , usually known as Fat Mar , was a waiter in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Description . Markoth was a rotund man who sweated profusely .

title: Marks
description: Marks Marks was a male human thief who was the proprietor of the Broken Pike tavern in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR . Description . He was short and mousy .

title: Marlandro Gaelkur
description: Marlandro Gaelkur Marlandro Gaelkur was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . Marlandro ran a barber shop and a shop of used tools .

title: Marlgate
description: Marlgate Marlgate was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This warehouse district of the City of Brass was largely abandoned .

title: Marliir
description: Marliir House Marliir was a noble house of Cormyr , based in Suzail . The family were always outsiders at the Royal Court and had extensive landholdings and businesses in the Arabel area . The Marliirs and the Huntcrown s hated each other and were close to open conflict in the late 15th century DR .

title: Marlin Stormserpent
description: Marlin Stormserpent Marlin Stormserpent was a young noble from Suzail and the only surviving male member of his family . History . In 1479 DR , Marlin schemed with Manshoon , whom he thought was a palace courtier named Lothrae , to acquire as many of the artifacts of The Nine as possible .

title: Marlos Urnrayle
description: Marlos Urnrayle Marlos Urnrayle was the Prophet of Earth and the leader of the Cult of the Black Earth . Personality . He was genteel and well - spoken , but took pleasure in mocking others and could be driven to fits of blind , unreasoning jealousy .

title: Marlowe
description: Marlowe Marlowe was a man living in the desolate town of Amkethran in Tethyr . He was once a merchant of Calimshan who desired wealth . He sought out the lich Vongoethe and struck a bargain with him : if Marlowe was given wealth and fortune , Marlowe would give Vongoethe his soul after a designated time .

title: Marlspire of Najara
description: Marlspire of Najara The Marlspire of Najara , a crown given to the Najara n naga by the yuan - ti of the Hss ' tafi tribe in - 320 DR as a symbol of loyalty , was worn by Terpenzi and all successive kings through the reign of Jarant . Abilities . Far from being a mere symbol of office , the Marlspire had powerful magical capabilities ( some of which only functioned when it was worn by a reptile .

title: Marlyn Lurraxol
description: Marlyn Lurraxol Marlyn " Luxor " Lurraxol was a human female and a barmaid at the Fierce Flumph tavern in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . She was the niece of a member of the Lurraxol family of Athkatla , but was an outcast for some reason ( perhaps related to her arcane talent ) . She relocated to Eshpurta and was known to the locals as Luxor .

title: Marni Sobor
description: Marni Sobor Marni Sobor was a shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Marni was studying as a wizard when in 1370 DR her mother was killed in a robbery and she inherited the shop .

title: Marod el Arhapan
description: Marod el Arhapan Marod el Arhapan was the Pasha of Calimport in 1479 DR . His favorite pastime was staging gladiatorial games in his arena , an activity he preferred to actually ruling Calimport . The Pasha had a lavish floating palace that floated high above the arena .

title: Maroon Prince
description: Maroon Prince The Maroon Prince was a unique red dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Description . The Maroon Prince was a rare three headed dragon .

title: Maroth Marstel
description: Maroth Marstel Leader of the Marstel trading house , Maroth was the Harmach of Hulburg in 1479 DR . The shadowmage Rhovann dominated Maroth ' s will and turned him into his puppet . When Maroth ' s mind became too enfeebled for him to function as the Harmach , Rhovann killed Maroth and replaced him with a construct .

title: Marquen
description: Marquen Marquen of Silverymoon was a warrior living in Luruar in the late 15th century DR . History . Marquen lived in Silverymoon until " circa " 1474 DR when he relocated to Nesme .

title: Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan
description: Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan was a noble efreeti and the Sultan of the Efreet who ruled his subjects from the City of Brass in the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . Marrake sported a small goatee , eyes of sparking flame , and sharp elongated claws .

title: Marrashi
description: Marrashi Marrashi ( plural marrash ) , or winged archers , were evil spirits used by sha ' ir s or genie s on occasion . In return for their service , a marrashi demanded treasure or the freedom to spread contagion . Description .

title: Marrauk
description: Marrauk Marrauk was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . Geography . Marrauk was surrounded by five high valleys filled with deep deposits of very fine , pure salt .

title: Marren
description: Marren Marren was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Marren and some other monks were kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .

title: Marsara Storntil
description: Marsara Storntil Marsara Storntil was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl , " i . e . " , from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR .

title: Marsember
description: Marsember Marsember , also known as the City of Spices , was a metropolis and the busiest port in Cormyr , situated on the west bank of the mouth of the Starwater River . Geography . The city was based upon trade and lay on sandy islands in swampy terrain , making use of canals that doubled as open sewers , often causing a stench problem in warm periods , but preventing the water from freezing during the cold periods .

title: Marsember Marsh
description: Marsember Marsh The Marsember Marsh was an area of marshland that stretched along the northern shore of the Dragonmere for several miles , occupying the mouth of the Starwater River . It was inhabited by lizardfolk , but when a war broke out , most were slain , and the area was taken over by will - o ' - wisp s and other creatures . It eventually became the site of the city of Marsember in Cormyr .

title: Marsh Belwintle
description: Marsh Belwintle Marsh Belwintle was the Slave Lord of Zhentil Keep in 1357 DR and an important member of the Zhentarim . He was little involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair when she attack Zhentil Keep . He was a member of the Zhentil ' s city council and supported Manshoon ; he died during the Cyric assault on the city .

title: Marsh of Chelimber
description: Marsh of Chelimber The Marsh of Chelimber is a swamp located in the Western Heartlands near Evereska . Geography . The swamp is bordered on the north by the Greypeak Mountains , and on the east by the Greycloak Hills .

title: Marten Foss
description: Marten Foss Marten Foss was a dwarf and a retired trainer in Phlan in 1489 DR . Marten was also secretly a member of the Order of the Gauntlet . Personality .

title: Marthammor Duin
description: Marthammor Duin Marthammor Duin ( Mar - " tham " - more " doo " - ihn ) , is the young , neutral good dwarven god of wanderers and patron of dwarves who have left the clanholds to explore the world . He is also known as Finder - of - Trails , Watcher over Wanderers and the Watchful Eye . He is also an exarch of Moradin .

title: Marthin Avathnar
description: Marthin Avathnar Marthin Avathnar was a seneschal in Cormyr . Activities . Marthin ruled the remote and secret prison stronghold of Castle Irlingstar in the Thunder Peaks on the eastern border of Cormyr , where the king put traitor nobles , murderers , and agents of Sembia and Westgate .

title: Martin Illance
description: Martin Illance Martin Freyault Illance is head of the Illance noble house of Cormyr . He is one of the most handsome young men at court but has been spurned by both princesses , considered most untrustworthy noble in realm by Thomdor & Bhereu , involved with Gaspar Cormaeril and Aunadar Bleth in the Abraxus affair , a darkly handsome young womanizer of charm , wit , and the ability to become a self - effacing " listener in the background , " his name Martin derived from his grandmother ' s name to distinguish him from his uncle Freyault History . Martin attempted to seduce the crown princess Tanalasta Obarskyr but she saw though his attempts and rejected him .

title: Martin von Mensch
description: Martin von Mensch Martin von Mensch was the ex - adventurer owner of Conyberry Arms within the village of Conyberry . Personality . Never content with just ripping off his customers , Martin enjoyed creating items which would break and selling them at market prices .

title: Martine
description: Martine Martine was a Harper ranger famous for defeating the gelugon Vreesar . Description . Martine was a short and petite woman ( only five feet tall ) with short black hair and long bangs across her forehead .

title: Martyr ' s Progeny
description: Martyr ' s Progeny The Martyr ' s Progeny is the collective term used to describe children ( aged from birth to 14 years ) who were spared from death by the deity Torm when he absorbed the souls of his followers in Tantras during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Torm required the absorption of these souls in order to defeat Bane ' s avatar , knowing that those whose souls had been taken would die instantly . At the risk of not gaining enough power from the available souls , Torm chose to spare the children , who subsequently became known as the Martyr ' s Progeny , and as of 1372 DR are aged between 14 and 28 .

title: Martyrdom
description: Martyrdom Martyrdom , also known as Martyrdomain , was the realm of the deity Ilmater , the Broken God . Location . Under the Great Wheel cosmology , Martyrdomain was located on the layer of Shurrock in the Twin Paradises of Bytopia .

title: Martyred champion of Ilmater
description: Martyred champion of Ilmater The martyred champion of Ilmater was an exalted prestige class in Faerûn for followers of the god Ilmater , the Crying God . Culture . A martyred champion was a person who had heroically sacrificed themselves in accordance with Ilmater ' s teachings and returned to life to continue along the same path , ready to sacrifice themselves again if need be .

title: Marune
description: Marune Marune , usually known as the Masked , was a necromancer and the oldest living member of the Shadow thieves and also the leading agent to their comeback in Waterdeep . History . Marune was born in 1226 DR ; Marune achieved longevity through magic without resorting to lichdom , thanks to the artifact known as " Andrathath ’ s mask " , which he acquired early in his career while plundering a long - forgotten ruined tower in the Lost Peaks .

title: Marwan al - Jabal al - Hiyali
description: Marwan al - Jabal al - Hiyali Marwan al - Jabal al - Hiyali served as Grandfather of the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Personality . The Grandfather of the Everlasting was both wise and wicked , going so far as to kill his own son because he displayed cowardice .

title: Mary H . Herbert
description: Mary H . Herbert Mary H . Herbert ( born 1966 ) is an American author who wrote several novels for TSR ' s Dragonlance setting and five books in her " Hunnuli " series .

title: Masakado
description: Masakado Masakado was a tiger hengeyokai in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Masakado was always fascinated by human s and lived among them .

title: Masauwu
description: Masauwu Masauwu is the Skeleton Man , a spirit in the culture of the Azuposi , a human civilization of Maztica . Shrines . Across the Azuposi landscape , shrines to Masauwu are constructed by travellers who believe that he will offer them protection during their travels .

title: Masgar Lam
description: Masgar Lam Masgar Lam was a general and the governor of the city of Foo Nakar in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Masgar Lam was once a general under the command of Wanang Sun , and an old friend and battle companion of the man who would one day be king of Koryo .

title: Mashida Kowa
description: Mashida Kowa Mashida Kowa was a Korobokuru retainer of Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Many that despite Kowa ' s heritage and skills considered him an ill - begotten upstart .

title: Mask
description: Mask Mask ( pronounced " MASK " ) , the Lord of Shadows , is a loner god , most often associated with thieves or those of otherwise ill - repute . He is a Chaotic Neutral Intermediate deity , from the Shadow Keep in the Plane of Shadow , whose portfolio includes shadows , thievery and thieves ; although it previously also included intrigue . Mask ' s symbol is a black velvet mask tinged with red .

title: Mask Dance
description: Mask Dance The Mask Dance was a Cormyran dance performed by a paid performer , usually in a private club . The dancer wore nothing but a mask while gyrating about on a stage . The Mask Dance first became popular in 1476 DR and remained popular as of 1479 DR .

title: Maskar Wands
description: Maskar Wands Maskar Wands was the patriarch of the Wands family in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Maskar was a conservative and traditionally minded individual .

title: Masked Merfolk
description: Masked Merfolk The Masked Merfolk was a club in Marsember , Cormyr near to Starwater Keep . Structure . The door of the establishment had a carving of a mermaid and a merman embracing one another .

title: Masked Minstrel
description: Masked Minstrel The Masked Minstrel was a famed but mysterious bard in Waterdeep . Description . The Masked Minstrel , as her name implied , only appeared in public while wearing a mask to conceal her identity .

title: Masked One
description: Masked One The Masked One was a Red Wizard of Thay and a necromancer in 1358 DR . History . The Masked One was a powerful wizard who tried to change the interests of the School of Necromancy from the destruction of Rashemen to other goals .

title: Masked traitor
description: Masked traitor Masked Traitors were a special type of traitor priestesses serving Vhaeraun as spies in his enemy ’ s church . Traitor Priestess - Description . Traitor priestess was a general term for clerics double spies , who publicly showed loyalty to one deity but in truth serving another .

title: Maskhi
description: Maskhi Maskhi were unique humanoid s in Zakhara that were able to transform into animals , trees , and even stone . Description . Maskhi were lean , wiry humanoids in their natural form .

title: Maskul Mirrormane
description: Maskul Mirrormane Maskul Mirrormane was the High Priest of the Circle of Darkness , a temple devoted to the worship of Cyric in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . Maskul oversaw a staff of 11 other priests of Cyric .

title: Maskyr ' s Eye
description: Maskyr ' s Eye Maskyr ' s Eye ( pronounced " MAH - skeer " ) was the name given to a village and vale in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the North Road between Mulmaster and Kurth . History . In the 7th century DR , the powerful archmage Maskyr came to explore the newly opened Vast , seeking a place to live in solitude .

title: Maskyr One - Eye
description: Maskyr One - Eye Maskyr ( pronounced " MAH - skeer " ) , later known as Maskyr the One - Eyed , Maskyr One - Eyed , or simply Maskyr One - Eye , was a human archmage who settled in the Vast in the 7th century DR . History . Maskyr was a powerful archmage when he came to explore the newly opened Vast in the 7th century DR , seeking a place well beyond human affairs where he could build himself a tower .

title: Masoj Dhuunyl
description: Masoj Dhuunyl Masoj Dhuunyl was the head of the College of Abjuration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told Miverra , a priestess of Eilistraee , that Masoj enjoyed entombing his rivals deep in earth .

title: Masoj Hun ' ett
description: Masoj Hun ' ett Masoj Hun ' ett was drow wizard of House Hun ' ett who studied at Sorcere in Menzoberranzan . Description . One of Masoj ' s eyebrows was missing , as it had never grown back after a " fireball " cast at his feet .

title: Masquerade ( mercenary group )
description: Masquerade ( mercenary group ) The Masquerade were a mercenary company based in Waterdeep around 1358 DR . They were a company of professional spies and infiltrators . History .

title: Mass cure critical wounds
description: Mass cure critical wounds Mass cure critical wounds was a conjuration spell that applied an enhanced " cure critical wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . Like other " cure " spells , the caster channeled positive energy that healed the living or harmed the undead .

title: Mass cure light wounds
description: Mass cure light wounds Mass cure light wounds , also known as healing circle , was a prayer or conjuration spell that applied an enhanced " cure light wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . Like other " cure " spells , the caster channeled positive energy that healed the living or harmed the undead .

title: Mass cure moderate wounds
description: Mass cure moderate wounds Mass cure moderate wounds was a conjuration spell that applied an enhanced " cure moderate wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . Like other " cure " spells , the caster channeled positive energy that healed the living or harmed the undead .

title: Mass cure serious wounds
description: Mass cure serious wounds Mass cure serious wounds was a conjuration spell that applied an enhanced " cure serious wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . Like other " cure " spells , the caster channeled positive energy that healed the living or harmed the undead .

title: Mass heal
description: Mass heal Mass heal was a conjuration spell that applied an enhanced " heal " spell to a small group of creatures . Effect . This spell works the same as " heal " , except it affects all creatures within range of the caster and within 30 ft .

title: Mass inflict critical wounds
description: Mass inflict critical wounds Mass inflict serious wounds was a necromancy spell that applied an enhanced " inflict serious wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Mass inflict light wounds
description: Mass inflict light wounds Mass inflict light wounds was a necromancy spell that applied an enhanced " inflict light wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Mass inflict moderate wounds
description: Mass inflict moderate wounds Mass inflict moderate wounds was a necromancy spell that applied an enhanced " inflict moderate wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Mass inflict serious wounds
description: Mass inflict serious wounds Mass inflict serious wounds was a necromancy spell that applied an enhanced " inflict serious wounds " to a small group of creatures . Effects . When this spell was cast , the caster channeled negative energy which did harm to living beings .

title: Mass jump
description: Mass jump Mass jump was an arcane alteration spell that gave a group of creatures the ability to leap great distances for a short time . Effects . All creatures within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of the caster received this ability when " mass jump " was cast .

title: Mass sanctuary
description: Mass sanctuary Mass sanctuary ( alternately , " sancturary , mass " ) is an abjuration spell that prevents multiple subjects from attacking and from being attacked . It functions in the same manner as " sanctuary " . Only cleric s with the Balance domain can use this spell .

title: Mass snowshoes
description: Mass snowshoes Mass snowshoes was a divine magic spell available to priests and ranger s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It cast the " snowshoes " spell on a group of creatures . Effects .

title: Master ' s Library
description: Master ' s Library The Master ' s Library was a temple of Deneir on Iron Dragon Mountain in the Earthfast Mountains between Impiltur and the Vast in north Faerûn . It was the greatest depository of books on Abeir - Toril and the site where the Metatext was pieced together . History .

title: Master Harper
description: Master Harper Master Harper is a specialized prestige class on Faerûn , whose members are elite agents of the Harpers . They study spells and develop many skills to help them in their duties of preserving lore by imparting it to others , raising morale and aiding other members of the Harpers as well as others who promote similar aims . Many master Harpers are bard s , but by no means all are .

title: Master Tactician
description: Master Tactician Master Tactician : Spells from the Church of the Red Knight is a web enhancement for the Forgotten Realms about a tactics manual cum spellbook that adds three new cleric and paladin spells . Description of " Master Tactician " . " Master Tactician " is considered a holy text by the Red Fellowship ( the official name of the Red Knight ' s church ) .

title: Master Wraith
description: Master Wraith The Master Wraith was a powerful undead wraith that lived in the Forest of Mir and fed on the souls of the living . Though it was a formidable opponent in combat and commanded a number of lesser undead , it could also use its shapechanging and telepathic abilities to psychologically weaken its prey , to persuade them to surrender . The Master Wraith was destroyed in 1369 DR when it confronted Gorion ' s Ward in front of an old temple of Bhaal in the forest .

title: Master infiltrator
description: Master infiltrator Master infiltrators are rogue s highly trained at , as their name implies , sneaking into and out of locations or situations . Master infiltrators might serves as spies , assassin s , scout s , or sniper s , moving silently through and out of peril unnoticed . In order to assist them in this , master infiltrators take on a variety of abilities that make them elusive prey and deadly predators .

title: Master undead
description: Master undead Master undead was an arcane necromancy spell that took precise control over one or more undead creatures , allowing them to perform complex tasks . This spell was once known by the name control undead but that name has come to belong to another spell , similar to but less powerful than " master undead " . Effects .

title: Mastering of Amahl V
description: Mastering of Amahl V Mastering of Amahl V was the name given to a " shoonring " that was part of the treasure hoard of the great blue wyrm Iryklathagra . It may have been one of the " Qysari Rings " made for members of the Shoon Dynasty . Description .

title: Mastraero
description: Mastraero Mastraero was a mage from the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Mastraero once played chess with an unwashed sailor in The Salty Dog tavern in Ravens Bluff — and lost . In his rage , he turned every witness into a snail , but missed his opponent , who turned out to be Ambassador Carrague of Ravens Bluff .

title: Masud Jazayir
description: Masud Jazayir Masud Jazayir , or the Fortunate Isles , was a group of islands located along the northern tip of the Nada al - Hazan achipelago in the Crowded Sea . This group of islands represented the farthest outpost of Zakhara ns into the Crowded Sea . Geography .

title: Masudi
description: Masudi Masudi was a Semphari caravan master traveling the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Personality . Because of his belief in the set of laws known as muhjari , Masudi was a strict individual .

title: Masulk ' s Tomb
description: Masulk ' s Tomb Masulk ' s Tomb was the burial place of Masulk the Magnificent located in the Far Forest in the Savage Frontier . Description . The tomb was hidden by trees , shrubs and climbing plants , so it was hard to locate .

title: Masyr
description: Masyr Masyr was a wizard and businessman of Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . Though he owned both the Green Sash Tavern & Pleasure House and the Green Rings Trading Company , Masyr was always short on coin .

title: Matasuuri Nagahide
description: Matasuuri Nagahide Matasuuri Nagahide was the ruling shogun of Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Nagahide was the most successful shogun of Wa .

title: Matasuuri Unteki
description: Matasuuri Unteki Matasuuri Unteki was the younger brother of the shogun of Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Unteki was the daimyo of Iiso and one of the Three House daimyos , being so one of the most powerful man in Wa .

title: Mather Ukkhemn
description: Mather Ukkhemn Mather Ukkhemn was a merchant and a member of the Knights of the Shield in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Mather was an egoistical individual .

title: Matherly Harpell
description: Matherly Harpell Matherly Harpell was a wizard who belonged to the Harpell family and lived in the small town of Longsaddle . He made a mistake in a magical experiment and ended up becoming petrified . By 1356 DR , Matherly was one of the statues of the Ivy Mansion .

title: Mathira Melarn
description: Mathira Melarn Mathira Melarn was an Eilistraee an sword dancer from Ched Nasad who wielded the Crescent Blade . History . Mathira Melarn was a member of the Ched Nasadan House Melarn .

title: Mathlin
description: Mathlin The Mathlin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Mathlins were allied with the Aldimer and Uruthkurt families .

title: Matliedun
description: Matliedun Matliedun was a cambion priest in Maerimydra . Activities . Matliedun was responsible for the temple security but was usually busy gambling .

title: Matrud
description: Matrud Matruds were outcast thieves of the desert in Zakhara . They lived for revenge and survival . Requirements .

title: Matruda al - Muhif
description: Matruda al - Muhif Matruda al - Muhif was a holy slayer and member of the Flamedeath Fellowship in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Matruda separated herself from the other members of the Fellowship , gaining well - earned infamy throughout the Land of Fate .

title: Matsue Fusu
description: Matsue Fusu Matsue Fusu was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and overseer of Gomen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Gomen , the largest fishing village of the Tara - gawa Basin area , he led a company of five samurai and fifteen bushi .

title: Matt James
description: Matt James Matt James is an award - winning game designer and current freelancer for Wizards of the Coast , producing articles , content , and game design for the Forgotten Realms . He has been a contributing author to many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks and has done work for Open Design ( Kobold Quarterly ) as well as Pathfinder RPG ( Paizo ) . Matt is the younger brother of Brian R .

title: Mattias Farseer
description: Mattias Farseer Mattias Farseer was a ranger and long - time companion of the wyvern Trill . He travelled for many years with the Kenku assassin Corvus Nightfeather and his Circus of Wonders . Corvus considers Mattias to be one of the best archers who ever lived .

title: Mattick Tanthul
description: Mattick Tanthul Prince Mattick Tanthul of Thultanthar , the City of Shade , was the twin brother of Prince Vattick Tanthul . Relationships . He was two minutes elder than his brother .

title: Maugrim Korothir
description: Maugrim Korothir Servant of Morag ( second in command ) , Maugrim unleashed the Wailing Death upon Neverwinter and , being one of Morag ' s elites , plays a large role in the masterminding of the attack on Neverwinter . The main character defeats him in " Neverwinter Nights " shortly after he performs a ritual to bring his mistress Morag out of her magical stasis . This results in his banishment to Cania .

title: Mauj
description: Mauj Mauj was a reef giant living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Mauj was short for his race standing 15 ft .

title: Maul
description: Maul A maul ( or mall ) is a heavy , long - handled hammer used for splitting a piece of wood along its grain , or as a two - handed , martial , melee weapon . Description . One side of it is similar to a warhammer and the other side is much like an axe .

title: Maulygh
description: Maulygh Maulygh was one of the magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . Biography . Maulygh was a master wizard from Unther who was hired by the prince Felodar Aumar in Calimshan to fight the magelords of Athalantar .

title: Maurezhi
description: Maurezhi The maurezhi are horrifying demon s that consume the souls of mortal creatures and have the ability to take the forms of those they ' ve consumed . Thus , they make perfect spies and assassins , usually . Unfortunately ( or fortunately ) , most maurezhi never make it out of the Abyss and never get a chance to feed on any hapless mortal creatures , thus most of them never get a chance to become the perfect spy or assassin before the babau or the molydeus ship them off to the Blood War frontlines .

title: Mauzzkyl Jaezred
description: Mauzzkyl Jaezred Mauzzkyl Jaezred was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) and the patron grandfather of the Jaezred Chaulssin as well as its founder . Description . Mauzzkyl preferred use the drow form , appearing as hale old man with broad shoulders , a wide chest , and thinning hair forming a widow ' s peak .

title: Mavin ' s create volcano
description: Mavin ' s create volcano Mavin ' s create volcano was a 10th - level Arcanist spell created in the days of Netheril . Effects . Casting " Mavin ' s create volcano " caused a minor earthquake to erupt in the desired area .

title: Mavin ' s earthfast
description: Mavin ' s earthfast Mavin ' s earthfast was a 10th - level Arcanist spell used in the days of Netheril . Effects . The spell was originally created to allow continued mining of areas that would otherwise be too dangerous to mine .

title: Maw of stone
description: Maw of stone Maw of stone is a transmutation spell unique to cleric s with the Cavern domain . It animates a natural opening or chamber . Effect .

title: Maw of the God Swallower
description: Maw of the God Swallower The Maw of the God Swallower was an oblong - shaped region of utter annihilation in southern Chessenta in the late 15th century DR . Along the edges , the ground crumbled away and the sky was dark . In the interior of the region , the land fell away into a void and the primordial Entropy hung in the exact center of the void .

title: Maxer Hlarr
description: Maxer Hlarr Maxer Hlarr , the Defender of Suzail , was a wizard who lived in Cormyr ' s captial in 1367 DR . Personality . Maxer was a recluse who enjoyed peace and quiet .

title: Maximanus Tholl
description: Maximanus Tholl Maximanus Tholl was a Chondathan human male inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a captain of the Purple Dragons contingent there . History . Maximanus Tholl was a warrior of the Purple Dragons of Cormyr .

title: May T ' ang Lien
description: May T ' ang Lien May T ' ang Lien was a hengeyokai wu jen adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Lien ' s goal was knowledge , she wanted to know all .

title: Maya Do ' Urden
description: Maya Do ' Urden Maya Do ' Urden was the youngest daughter of Malice Do ' Urden and a priestess of Lolth in House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan . Description . Maya was slender but strong , stronger than her brother Drizzt .

title: Mayne
description: Mayne Elder Mayne was the mayor of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Elder Mayne was the mayor of Highcliff when the lizardmen attacked the boats .

title: Maze
description: Maze Maze is a conjuration spell that traps the subject in an extradimensional maze . Effects . You conjure up an extradimensional labyrinth of force planes , and the subject vanishes into it .

title: Maze Engine
description: Maze Engine The Maze Engine was a powerful artifact capable of reshaping reality itself . Modron s called it The Orderer , as its function was to bring order to chaos . It resembled an enormous working model of the Great Wheel .

title: Maze of mirrors
description: Maze of mirrors Maze of mirrors is a spell of the illusion school learned by some wizard s , particularly those interested in illusions as a speciality . When cast , " maze of mirrors " appears to create a tiny labyrinth of mirrors over an area five feet in diameter , somewhere within 100 feet of the wizard . Any creatures caught within might be fooled by the illusion and left unable to escape until the illusion dissipates a moment later , enough time for a wizard or their allies to take advantage of the situation .

title: Mazeer
description: Mazeer Mazeer was a member of the College of Conjuration in the city of Sshamath . History . In 1377 DR , alongside Gilkriz , Mazeer was one of the conjurers sent to help teleport the combined force of Sshamath wizards and priests of Eilistraee to the main temple of Kiaransalee , which they planned to attack .

title: Mazrol
description: Mazrol Mazrol was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Mazrol was one of the many priests of Vhaeraun who joined the Church of Eilistraee after 1375 DR .

title: Maztica
description: Maztica Maztica , referred to by its inhabitants as The True World , was a large continent west of Faerûn . Maztica was a land of jungles and mystery . During the Spellplague , the continent of Mazitca was replaced by a continent that came to be known as Returned Abeir .

title: Maztica ( goddess )
description: Maztica ( goddess ) Maztica was the ancient mother of the maztican pantheon before she was killed by her son Zaltec . Description . She was the epitome of fertile womanhood and therefore she was shown as a lush and full woman with a round and always smiling face .

title: Maztica trilogy
description: Maztica trilogy The Maztica trilogy is a series of books set in the " Forgotten Realms " on the continent of Maztica at the time of its " discovery " by Cordell of Amn . The trilogy was written by Douglas Niles . The main character is Erixitl , a priestess of Qotal and former slave .

title: Maztican
description: Maztican " Maztican " was a collective term used by Faerûn ians for any of the inhabitants of Maztica . When most folk in Faerûn used the term , they were most likely referring to Nexalan s , as that was the only people group of Maztica for which individuals had traveled to the east . In truth , there were seven separate ethnicities of humans in Maztica :

title: Maztican Dragon
description: Maztican Dragon The Maztican dragon , also known as the Rain serpent or Tlalocoatl is a dragon unique to the continent of Maztica . The feature that most distinguishes Maztican dragons from their kin in Faerûn is the fact that these dragons have two heads and no tail . One head is the head of a serpent and the other is a jaguar head .

title: Mazzy Fentan
description: Mazzy Fentan Mazzy Fentan was a halfling warrior and servant of Arvoreen . She was the closest thing to a halfling paladin of Arvoreen at a time when such a thing was unheard of , possessing divine - granted abilities similar to those of a paladin . Appendix .

title: Mead
description: Mead Mead was a slightly sweet alcoholic beverage made of fermented honey . It was commonly brewed in the Northlands . Mead from the gardens of Neverwinter was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " .

title: Mechanical disruption
description: Mechanical disruption Mechanical disruption was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell served as a paralysis spell when cast at mechanical creations , keeping them from moving or performing any function until the spell ended .

title: Mechezarin
description: Mechezarin Mechezarin was a great wyrm dragon . The dragon lived in a large room carved out underneath Durlag ' s Tower , along with other magical beasts that Durlag kept in his bestiary . The massive beast eventually died , but its vast skeleton continued to rest deep underneath Durlag ' s Tower .

title: Mechnik
description: Mechnik Mechnik was the title given to the leader of the Gospoda in the city of Almorel in the Hordelands . Activities . The Mechnik served as the head of the ruling council of Almorel .

title: Medallion of elemental summoning
description: Medallion of elemental summoning Medallions of elemental summoning were magical items that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were golden medallions with a stone inset depending on the type of elemental it could summon : blue for water , brown for earth , red for fire , and clear for air .

title: Medina al - Afyal
description: Medina al - Afyal Medina al - Afyal , the capital and only real city on Afyal , was beyond compare . While lacking the blue tilework of most Zakharan cities , it featureed polished marble and gleaming hardwoods in magnificient style . Perhaps due to strong influence from Bharata and southeast Kara - Tur , a rigid caste system prevailed on this island .

title: Medium spider venom
description: Medium spider venom Medium spider venom was a poison extracted from a medium - sized monstrous spider . Effect . Inflicted via wounding , medium spider venom sapped the strength of a victim , but they could recover from it with time .

title: Medusa
description: Medusa Medusae were monstrous beings with bodies that are covered in scales and rather than hair , they had a writhing mass of serpents growing from their scalp . Abilities . The eyes of a medusa were feared , because to look in their eyes was to invite death .

title: Medusanna Mhairdaul
description: Medusanna Mhairdaul Medusanna Mhairdaul was the high priestess of the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Medusanna was a female yuan - ti abomination with a snake - like body and a human head with a mass of poisonous snake s instead of hair on her head .

title: Meenlock
description: Meenlock Meenlocks were deformed fey that originated from intense fear . They had no purpose other than to destroy good and beauty , and resorted to telepathic torture in order to terrify and corrupt other creatures . Someone who succumbed to this torture would then magically transform into a meenlock as well .

title: Meera
description: Meera Meera was an unusual cleric of Cyric and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Velen around 1370 DR . Personality . Meera worshiped Cyric in his nonviolent aspects .

title: Meerschaum
description: Meerschaum Meerschaum , also known as , was a hardstone found in the Realms used for carving . Description . Meerschaum was a white , compact , porous , clay - like stone used for pipes and small carvings .

title: Mefraset
description: Mefraset Mefraset was a wizard member of the cult of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Hodkamset ordered Mefraset and some of her fellows to infiltrate a city in west Faerûn .

title: Mehen
description: Mehen Thrikominaki ( clanless ) Mehen , formerly a member of Clan Verthisathurgiesh , < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p18 " > < / ref > was a clanless dragonborn warrior who at one point found a home in the small village of Arush Vayem on the frontier of Tymanther . Description . Mehen was a tall and powerfully built dragonborn , with dull - ocher scales and scars where he once had his clan piercings .

title: Mehmet al - Nassar
description: Mehmet al - Nassar Mehmet al - Nassar was an elven theologian who lived in Hilm , the City of Kindness . History . Mehmet was an outspoken lecturer who condemned the actions of holy slayer s .

title: Mei Li Mao
description: Mei Li Mao Mei Li Mao was a yakuza in Shou Lung . Activities . Around 1357 DR , Mei Li Mao owned the Imperial Phoenix restaurant in Kuo Te ' Lung , a very popular meeting point for secret societies .

title: Meira Faerenduil
description: Meira Faerenduil Meira Faerenduil was a ghost knight of Myth Drannor . History . Meira was a knight in Cormanthor and a follower of Labelas Enoreth .

title: Meirgin Windtalon
description: Meirgin Windtalon Meirgin " Daggers " Windtalon was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Meirgin was tall and thin , with smouldering good looks .

title: Mekrath
description: Mekrath Mekrath was a powerful elven wizard in Athkatla , Amn . History . Mekrath was not very tolerant of visitors , especially thieves , and when he found Haer ' Dalis thieving in his lair , he enslaved him .

title: Mel Odom
description: Mel Odom Mel Odom ( born 1957 ) wrote several novels in the Forgotten Realms series , including the The Threat from the Sea trilogy , and two short stories as yet . He has gained renown beyond the Realms with his The Rover and Left Behind Apocalypse series , and two novels for the NCIS franchise . He lives in Oklahoma and is the father of five children .

title: Mela Basult
description: Mela Basult Mela Basult was a female Chondathan human in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . Relationships . Mela was the wife of Amnic Basult , the proprietor of Basult ' s Books .

title: Melabrauth
description: Melabrauth Melabrauth , also known as the Jungle Empire , was the oldest dragon empire of Returned Abeir . Description . There were no known settlements or roads in Melabrauth .

title: Melair I
description: Melair I King Melair I ( then known only as Melair ) first discovered mithral ore beneath Mount Waterdeep in - 1288 DR and set about rallying together shield dwarves who would eventually create Melairbode and form Clan Melairkyn on that site . Although he passed away at an unknown time in the distant past , his ghost still occupies the royal crypt deep within the Undermountain and he firmly believes Clan Melairkyn is still a living clan .

title: Melairbode
description: Melairbode Melairbode was the home of the Melairkyn , an ancient dwarven clan that was later wiped out . Their vast network of caverns and chambers was later known as Undermountain . Melairbode was frequently raided by drow .

title: Melandrach
description: Melandrach King Melandrach was the king of the wild elves of the Misty Forest and the elves leading the delegation to the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Melandrach was the king of the Misty Forest long before 1344 DR .

title: Melanith
description: Melanith Melanith ( also spelled Melinith ) was a Queen of Dambrath during the mid 11th century DR . Relationships . Queen Melanith took a crinti named Sadalar as her consort .

title: Melann Brandish
description: Melann Brandish Melann Brandish was one of the cleric s of Chauntea at the Bounty of the Goddess in Archendale . Description . She had long dark hair , tied away from her face .

title: Melauthaur
description: Melauthaur Melauthaur , also known as The Undying One , was the emperor of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . He was a very old and powerful dracolich , and formerly a black dragon . Activities .

title: Meld
description: Meld Meld was a cooperative enchantment spell that allowed a priest to temporarily transfer his or her persona to another priest of the same faith who was willing to be a host for the caster ' s essence . Effects . This spell could only be cast on a willing priest of the same religion as the caster .

title: Meld into stone
description: Meld into stone Meld into stone is a transmutation spell that causes the caster and his gear to merge with stone . Effect . " Meld into stone " enables you to meld your body and possessions into a single block of stone .

title: Melder Crownrood
description: Melder Crownrood Melder Crownrood was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Crownrood noble house . Activities . Melder was the chancellor of King Foril Obarskyr I .

title: Melder Rythtin
description: Melder Rythtin Melder Rythtin of the Healing Hand was a priest of Ilmater and leader of the House of the Broken God temple in Keltar , Calimshan , " circa " 1369 DR . Melder was renowned for his accurate diagnoses and miraculous treatments of those afflicted with suffering .

title: Melee - Magthere
description: Melee - Magthere Melee - Magthere was the warrior school for the drow of Menzoberranzan . It was part of the Tier Breche academy . Notably , Drizzt Do ' Urden spent time here in training .

title: Melegaunt Tanthul
description: Melegaunt Tanthul Prince Melegaunt Tanthul was one of the youngest Princes of Shade . Personality . He had a knack for deception , combined with a talent of false empathy , that made him a formidable manipulator .

title: Meleghost Starseer
description: Meleghost Starseer Meleghost Starseer was the high priest of the House of Wonder , the temple to Mystra in Waterdeep , in 1372 DR . Personality . Meleghost was a cruel but polite individual .

title: Melf ' s minute meteors
description: Melf ' s minute meteors Melf ' s minute meteors was a fire - based evocation spell . Effects . The spell created six tiny meteors that orbited the caster for up to 10 minutes , until released upon a target or until the caster stopped concentrating .

title: Melia Ceralle
description: Melia Ceralle Melia Ceralle was a female human operating on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Melia was a member of the Neverwinter Nine .

title: Melicent Mellicot
description: Melicent Mellicot Melicent Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Melicent was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Meliors and Melusine . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment .

title: Melineth Turcasson
description: Melineth Turcasson Melineth Turcassan was the father - in - law of King Duar Obarskyr of Cormyr . History . When Duar took an army north to battle the orc invaders in the King ' s Forest , Melineth sold the city of Suzail to pirates for 500 sacks of gold .

title: Melino Richtoes
description: Melino Richtoes Melino Richtoes was the mayor of Shoun in 1367 DR . Personality . Melino was an exceedingly greedy person before he found religion .

title: Meliors Mellicot
description: Meliors Mellicot Meliors Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Meliors was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Melicent and Melusine . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment .

title: Melisende Baybars
description: Melisende Baybars Melisende Baybars lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Appearance . Melisende was as near to physical perfection as most mortals could come .

title: Melkar
description: Melkar Melkar of Mirabar was a mage who tried to breach the protections around Ahghairon ' s Tower in 1271 DR ( although his identity was not public knowledge ) .
