He failed , having misjudged the number of keys needed by half . His skeleton remained hanging inside the protections as a warning .

title: Melkatka
description: Melkatka Melkatka was a drow commoner who served House Xorlarrin as slavemaster and torturer . He was part of the first expedition to establish Q ' Xorlarrin . When , in 1484 DR , the drow captured the Companions of the Hall and put them into slavery , it was Melkatka who supervised them .

title: Melkhor Goldseeker
description: Melkhor Goldseeker Melkhor Goldseeker was a dwarf businessman in the Blackdagger Ruins in 1484 DR . Relationships . He had a niece to whom was very attached .

title: Mellast Ormblade
description: Mellast Ormblade Mellast Ormblade was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of the Ormblade noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Mellast gathered with some friends to discuss if it was true that the kingdom was on the verge of a civil war .

title: Mellochrysos
description: Mellochrysos Mellochrysos was a variety of zircon found in large crystals in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones were an intense yellow hue and very resistant to chipping in natural form .

title: Mellomir
description: Mellomir Mellomir was a wizard who lived in Arabel in Cormyr in 1367 DR . Personality . Mellomir was dry and dapper , but widely respected across Faerûn .

title: Mellyth Echorn
description: Mellyth Echorn Elder star Mellyth Echorn was a cleric of Corellon Larethian and the highest ranking priest of the deity in Evermeet after Seiveril Miritar . Personality . Political views .

title: Melody Mount Walk
description: Melody Mount Walk Melody Mount Walk was a magically lit tunnel in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep that ran west up to the cliffs on which the New Olamn barding college was situated . The tunnel contained a little - known portal between Waterdeep and the keep in Rassalantar .

title: Meloon Wardragon
description: Meloon Wardragon Meloon Wardragon was a human sellsword who hailed from northern Faerûn . Description . Meloon was a very tall young man with broad shoulders , blond hair , and pale blond scruff on his face .

title: Melori Ostur
description: Melori Ostur Melori Ostur ( pronounced MEH - lore - ee OH - stir ) was a sergeant of the City Watch . History . Around 1491 DR , Melori led a City Watch patrol that arrived at the Wave and Wink dance hall after an arson attack on Zora Tiega Gos .

title: Melusine Mellicot
description: Melusine Mellicot Melusine Mellicot was a woman of the village of Swords Pool in the Vast in 1370 DR . Melusine was a member of the Mellicot family , and sister to Melicent and Meliors . Together , the three sisters owned the Inn of the Nine Swords , a high - quality establishment .

title: Melvaunt
description: Melvaunt Melvaunt ( pronounced " MELL - vont " ) was a city that sat on the northern coast of the Moonsea , adjacent to Thar . It was a city of smithing and mercantile services , serving as the port of entry to many travelers coming to the region . The city itself was cold and gray , with a mist that rose from the Moonsea seeming to cover it entirely .

title: Memnon
description: Memnon Memnon , a key port of trade for Calimshan , was the former capital of the efreet i kingdom of Memnonnar and the birthplace of the infamous assassin Artemis Entreri . Geography and Layout . Memnon was situated on the northern border of the Calim Desert , at the mouth of the River Agis , and along the Trade Way .

title: Memnon ( efreeti )
description: Memnon ( efreeti ) The Great Pasha Memnon was a noble efreeti lord who founded the country of Memnonnar and fought a great war against the djinni Calim . His spirit was trapped for millennia in the Calim Desert , where it still warred against Calim , being the legendary cause of the desert ' s very existence . Description .

title: Memnonnar
description: Memnonnar Memnonnar was the remains of the city center of Memnon from the time when it was the capital city of the kingdom of Memnonnar under the Great Pasha Memnon . A portal to the Elemental Plane of Fire still existed deep below the ruins as late as 1374 DR .

title: Men of the Basilisk
description: Men of the Basilisk The Men of the Basilisk was a society of wealthy merchants and nobles with a thirst for adventure . History . The society was rigorously all - male , and the name of the group came from the admission ritual that consisted in looking in the eyes of a basilisk .

title: Menes Azludde
description: Menes Azludde Menes Azludde was the lead priest of Cyric in Skullport . Personality . Menes was a charismatic but very ambitious individual .

title: Mennek Ariz
description: Mennek Ariz Mennek Ariz was a traitorous Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford . Personality . Mennek , as an enchanter , greatly despised the preeminence of the necromancers over his land and secretly aligned with rebels who sought to overthrow Szass Tam and the necromancers from control of Thay .

title: Mentalism domain
description: Mentalism domain The Mentalism domain ( not to be confused with the Mind domain of Ilsensine ) is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters mentalism spell powers . They can temporarily ward their minds against external effects . Deities with the Mentalism domain .

title: Mentor
description: Mentor The Mentor was a mysterious human archmage who lived for some time in Cormanthyr . He lived for many years in the elf city perfectly disguised as an elf . He only revealed himself in 261 DR for the creation of the " mythal " of Myth Drannor , offering his help in the creation .

title: Menzoberra
description: Menzoberra Menzoberra was a drow high priestess of Lolth , who founded the city of Menzoberranzan . History . After decades of infighting among the drow of Golothaer , and at the behest of the Spider Queen , who gave her the title " Yor ' thae " ( Chosen one ) , Menzoberra the Kinless led seven drow families from their southern holdings of Great Bhaerynden into the Northdark .

title: Menzoberranzan
description: Menzoberranzan Menzoberranzan , the City of Spiders , was a large underground drow city - state in the Upper Northdark . Menzoberranzan was possibly the most well known drow city in Faerûn . It was the home of Drizzt Do ' Urden , and many of his early adventures dealt with the political intrigue and characters of the city .

title: Menzoberranzan ( game )
description: Menzoberranzan ( game ) Menzoberranzan was developed by DreamForge Internainment , Inc . in 1994 and published by SSI , who also published other titles of the Forgotten Realms Setting , like Al - Qadim - The Genies Curse . It was a first person role - playing game in a similiar style like Ultima Underworld or the Might and Magic games of that time .

title: Meo
description: Meo The Meo family was a noble family based in the city of Xai Chung in Koryo . They had an ancestral mansion there . Around 1350 DR , the king of Silla ordered the children of Meo Yungdo — Meo Cha and Meo Li — be kidnapped and sold into slavery .

title: Meo Cha
description: Meo Cha Meo Cha was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . Relations . Meo Cha was the son of Meo Yungdo and brother of Meo Li .

title: Meo Li
description: Meo Li Meo Li was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . Relations . Meo Li was the daughter of Meo Yungdo and sister of Meo Cha .

title: Meo Yungdo
description: Meo Yungdo Meo Yungdo was a noble of the Meo family of Xai Chung in Koryo . He was governor of Xai Chung and advisor to King Wanang Sun around 1357 DR . Relations .

title: Mephasm
description: Mephasm Mephasm was an pit fiend polymorph ed into the form of an elderly half - elf , who was in the service of Ammon Jerro . History . Mephasm was probably the most powerful of devil s and demon s in service to Jerro .

title: Mephistopheles
description: Mephistopheles Mephistopheles , also known as the Lord of No Mercy and the Cold Lord , is the lord of Cania , the eighth of the Nine Hells . He was the main opponent of Baalzebul during the Reckoning of Hell , and still holds a claim to his own layer . He seeks to take Baalzebul ' s layer away from him , that he may gain enough power to one day challenge Asmodeus for rulership of all the Nine Hells .

title: Mephit
description: Mephit Mephits were extraplanar , outsider creatures similar to imps . They were not native to the material plane as they are somewhat linked to various elemental or quasi - elemental planes of existence . Mephits were roughly humanoid in appearance and somewhat small ; approximately 4 feet ( 1 .

title: Merah
description: Merah Merah was a chiang lung dragon in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Activities . Merah resided at the bottom of the lake .

title: Meralaine
description: Meralaine Meralaine was a young human necromancer from Luthcheq . After Tchazzar lifted restrictions on mage s , Meralaine joined the Chessenta n army during the war with Threskel . She angered Tchazzar , who had a strong dislike for the undead , when she raised the dead during a battle .

title: Meralda Ganderlay
description: Meralda Ganderlay Meralda Ganderlay , also known as Meralda Auck , was a human woman from the fiefdom of Auckney near the Spine of the World . Relationships . She was the daughter of Dohmi and Biaste Ganderlay , who were farmers on the side of Maerlon Mountain .

title: Merap
description: Merap Merap " Dead - eyed " was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Merap received his nickname " Dead - eyes " from his ugly appearance .

title: Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate
description: Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate The Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate was a mercenary recruitment organization based in Westgate around 1358 DR . Membership . The Guild was proud to recruit only from the best merchant families of Westgate .

title: Mercenary barbarian
description: Mercenary barbarian Mercenary barbarians were a special type of warrior found in Zakhara . In some ways they were the counterparts to mamluk s . Requirements .

title: Merchant ' s Home
description: Merchant ' s Home The Merchant ' s Home was a located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . The Merchant ' s Home was regarded by many as being the finest caravanserai in all of Golden Huzuz . Description .

title: Merchant ' s League
description: Merchant ' s League The Merchant ' s League was an organization based in Baldur ' s Gate that promoted safety among the caravan routes throughout the region surrounding the city . The League began to decline in the mid - fourteenth century Dalereckoning due to many other local costers being formed . Under the leadership of Dabron Sashenstar and with the backing of the Dukes of Baldur ' s Gate , the Merchant ' s League began to challenge the Iron Throne for the weapons trade in the Western Heartlands .

title: Merchant - rogue
description: Merchant - rogue Merchant - rogues were businessmen and - women in Zakhara who also stole from their clients from time to time . Requirements . Only thieves could be merchant - rogues .

title: Merchant prince
description: Merchant prince Merchant Prince , or Merchant Princess , is a prestige class whose members either acquired their business through inheritence or earned their coin on their own . Merchant princes affect much of the economies throughout Faerûn and their mercantile holdings are often quite vast . Becoming a merchant prince .

title: Merchants ' Avenue
description: Merchants ' Avenue Merchants ' Avenue was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Merchants ' Avenue branched off of the Road to Enlightenment near the juncture of the South District , Peasants ' District , and Pilgrims ' District .

title: Merchants ' District
description: Merchants ' District The Merchants ' District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Clothiers ' Quarter in northwest Huzuz , this district served as the prime location for trade and business transactions between vendors , or large - scale merchant families , and their customers .

title: Merdrith
description: Merdrith Merdrith the Mad was a former zulkir of the Red Wizards until his self - imposed exile to the High Forest . Description . Merdrith had head tattoos marking him as a Red Wizard and his beard was dyed red .

title: Mere of Dead Men
description: Mere of Dead Men The Mere of Dead Men ( or Merdelain , meaning " Slow Marching Court " in Elvish ) was a swampy area located along the Sword Coast North . Etymology . The name " Mere of Dead Men " referred to the thousands of dwarves , elves , and human s of the Fallen Kingdom who were slain here during the invasion of an orc army .

title: Merfolk
description: Merfolk Merfolk are aquatic humanoids that have the upper body , arms , and head of a fair - featured human from the waist up and instead of legs it has a fish - like tail from the hips down . Males are called " Mermen " , while females are called " Mermaids " . Their humanoid features are fey - like , more similar to elves than humans .

title: Mergandevinasander
description: Mergandevinasander Mergandevinasander was a black dragon that resided in Chult . Description . Mergandevinasander had purple eyes .

title: Merial Luenath
description: Merial Luenath Duchess Merial Luenath was the ruler of Luenath in Dambrath and the head of Clan Luenath . Activities . Merial was one of the most powerful figures in Dambrath , second only to Queen Yenandra .

title: Merinid Dalael
description: Merinid Dalael Merinid Dalael was a drow assassin member of Jaezred Chaulssin in Menzoberranzan in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 Merinid penetrated in the abandoned House Srune ' Lett compound , , one of the lairs used by members of the Council of Spiders .

title: Merith Baenre
description: Merith Baenre Merith Baenre was a drow priestess of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . History . Merith once was the daughter of a street sweeper but her considerable clerical powers convinced Yvonnel Baenre to adopt Merith as her daughter .

title: Merith Strongbow
description: Merith Strongbow Merith Strongbow was an elven fighter mage and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . His familiar was a black cat named Shadowclaw . Appearance .

title: Meritid Archneie
description: Meritid Archneie Meritid Archneie was the Dread High Trident of Umberlee living in the Queenspire within Waterdeep . Personality . While Meritid was a faithful follower of Umberlee , he was also an agent of the Kraken Society , who operated out of the city .

title: Merket Oasis
description: Merket Oasis The Merket Oasis , also known as the Merket Depression , was a large valley located in the Quoya desert in the Hordelands . Description . Unlike a typical oasis , the Merket Oasis was not green or very rich in plant life .

title: Merle Pariso
description: Merle Pariso Merle Pariso was a battle - mage in Calimport in 1364 . He was considered one of the most lethal killers of the city and often worked for House Basadoni . In 1364 DR , Kadran Gordeon secretly hired him to kill Artemis Entreri .

title: Merothrax
description: Merothrax Merothrax the Greedy was a white dragon living on the slopes of Icespire Peak . Personality . Described as being " as stupid as he is greedy , " the Cult of the Dragon acquired his aid by giving him some of the mithral they were stealing from the local Icehammer dwarves .

title: Merquam Pang
description: Merquam Pang Merquam Pang was a human male fighter and a merchant based in the city of Xi Hulang in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was one of the most prosperous merchants in the kingdom . Description .

title: Merring
description: Merring Brother Merring was a villager of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North around 1374 DR . History . Originally from Neverwinter , Merring came to the village of West Harbor .

title: Merrow
description: Merrow Merrow were undersea merfolk - like monsters from the Abyss who terrorized the waters . Demogorgon often sent his merrow to the Material Plane to bully life there . Society .

title: Merrow ( ogre )
description: Merrow ( ogre ) Merrow , also known as sea ogres or aquatic ogres , were a breed of ogre adapted to aquatic environments . Description . Merrow living in freshwater environs were more violent and quicker than land ogres .

title: Meryl
description: Meryl Meryl was the halfling cook of Qilué Veladorn at the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . Meryl had been Qilué ' s cook for decades and knew well all the inhabitants of the Promenade .

title: Message
description: Message Message is a transmutation spell that lets one converse in whispers at a distance . The spell is language - dependent . Effect .

title: Message plate
description: Message plate A message plate was a magic item that could be used to send a message . Description . One message plate resembled a gold - hued disc , wide enough to rest on one ' s hand , with studs around the side .

title: Message ring
description: Message ring Message rings were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These rings were used to record and send messages .

title: Messanth
description: Messanth Messanth was a bronze shadow dragon in Szith Morcane . History . The Archmage of Szith Morcane , Solom Ned ' razak , at one point captured the bronze dragon Messanth and imprisoned him inside a pocket of Shadowfell .

title: Messenger genie
description: Messenger genie Messenger genies were tasked genie s who were once djinn . These genie s served all of geniekind equally , traveling between the planes delivering a wide assortment of messages and gifts as required by their masters . Description .

title: Mester Rauvaraudo
description: Mester Rauvaraudo Mester Rauvaraudo was the majordomo of the Sign of the Shield inn located in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . He was known as Master Mester to everyone that knew him . Description .

title: Mestin Durmark
description: Mestin Durmark Mestin " Troll " Durmark was a ranger and a high - ranking member of the Freedom Riders in 1369 DR . Description . As her nickname suggested , Mestin was not a dainty female .

title: Mestrel Hawkmantle
description: Mestrel Hawkmantle Mestrel Hawkmantle was an Harper bard . History . Mestrel in 1357 DR was very busy : he worked as guard for a caravan carrying Harpers messages from Baldur ' s Gate to Iriaebor , found a Thay spy in Iriaebor and foiling his salving operation following the spy until Westgate , where Mestrel identified the spy ' s master and with help of a fellow Harper wizard from Suzail read the mind of the superior before killing him .

title: Metahel
description: Metahel The Metahel were a group of people who lived along the lower banks of the Pasocada River in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . Society .

title: Metal domain
description: Metal domain The Metal domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters metal - related spell powers . They also gained proficiency with a chosen kind of hammer weapon . Deities with the Metal domain .

title: Metallic dragon
description: Metallic dragon Metallic dragons were a type of dragon distinguished typically by the color and composition of their scales , that was like that of various metals , hence the name . They were generally good , altruistic , and righteous creatures . Despite their relatively benign nature , metallic dragons were also aggressive when threatened or challenged .

title: Metalmaster
description: Metalmaster Also known as a sword slug , the metalmaster was a carnivore that could magnetically attract , repulse and crudely manipulate metal objects . Description . The metalmaster was an amorphous creature with slimy purple skin , four eyes on stalks , and a round mouth of sharp teeth .

title: Metamagic
description: Metamagic Metamagic was a group of skills used by spellcasters , including wizard s , sorcerer s , illusionist s and other casters focusing exclusively on arcane magic for their survival and livelihood . Metamagic allowed casters to transcend the normal rules of magic and create effects that could be devastatingly powerful . The term metamagic was also used for a that affected the workings of other spells to the same purpose .

title: Metatext
description: Metatext In 1385 DR , Mystra was assassinated by Cyric , with the aid of Shar . With the death of the Goddess of Magic , the Weave began to collapse . Deneir , in an attempt to stabilize the Weave , somehow wrote himself and the Metatext into the Weave and were presumably destroyed .

title: Meteor swarm
description: Meteor swarm Meteor swarm was a spell that caused four meteors to fly forward and explode like " fireball s " . It had a range of over 400 ' ( 120 m ) . History .

title: Meth
description: Meth The Meth was a breed of light warhorse known for its short legs and sturdy disposition . Meths were first bred in Unther near the border to Chessenta around 1000 DR . They were used for pulling chariots in the Old Empires .

title: Methegrist
description: Methegrist Methegrist was home to a small group of paladin s centuries before the Spellplague , known as the Moonwatchers . They were dedicated to Helm , and were appointed as protectors of the Moonlands . Methegrist was destroyed by a devil infiltrating the ranks of the Moonwatchers , and tricking Jahar to be the first to strike a fellow knight .

title: Methil El - Viddenvelp
description: Methil El - Viddenvelp Methil El - Viddenvelp was an illithid from Phanlinksal who served Yvonnel Baenre , and later Quenthel Baenre , as a secret advisor in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . He was also the founder of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact . Descriptions .

title: Methrammar Aerasumé
description: Methrammar Aerasumé High Lord Methrammar Aerasumé was a half - elf fighter and wizard and the High Lord of the Silver Marches as well as the ruler of Silverymoon . High Marshal of the Argent Legion , the army of the League of the Silver Marches . He lead 400 soldiers at Rauvinwatch Keep , about 15 miles west of Silverymoon , where a lot of time was spent training .

title: Methwood
description: Methwood The Methwood was , as of 1372 DR , a dense forest in Unther inhabited by chimera s , druid s and the green dragon Skuthosiin . It was rumoured that a potentially ancient city of the Turami was lost in the forest . As of 1374 DR , a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra , led by Talindra Amalith of the Vel ' Nikeryma , operated in the forest .

title: Mev Flintknapper
description: Mev Flintknapper Mev Flintknapper was a deep gnome fighter in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Mev was attacked by two gelatinous cube s in one of Blingdestone ' s grottoes , but was saved by a party of adventurers escaping from drow slavers of Velkynvelve .

title: Mez ' Barris Armgo
description: Mez ' Barris Armgo Mez ' Barris Armgo was the matron mother of House Barrison Del ' Armgo , second house of Menzoberranzan . Description . Mez ' Barris Armgo was unusually tall and powerful .

title: Mezro
description: Mezro Before its destruction in the Spellplague , Mezro was the largest civilized population center in Chult . It was a holy place to the Tabaxi people , being founded by their god Ubtao . Geography and Layout .

title: Mezzoloth
description: Mezzoloth Mezzoloths were the most common type of yugoloth encountered in the lower planes . Description . They looked like humanoid insects covered in great chitinous plates .

title: Mhaernos Falconstar
description: Mhaernos Falconstar Mhaernos Falconstar was a human man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the owner of Falconstar Wayshipping . He was in this position by 1358 DR , and still held it in 1369 DR .

title: Mhair
description: Mhair Mhair was a Tethyrian human fighter who worked as a boatman at the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . History . By Eleint of 1374 DR , Mhair was working at the temple , having a key role in transporting kidnapped petitioners and followers of Mystra out of the city .

title: Mhair Gulzrabban
description: Mhair Gulzrabban Mhair Gulzrabban was the founder and leader of the adventuring band known as the Company of the Cloak . Description . Mhair was a stout small man with tiny dark eyes .

title: Mhair Szeltune
description: Mhair Szeltune Mhair Szeltune was the leader of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Mhair was a serene yet persistent and efficient lady with an iron will .

title: Mhairdren Phull
description: Mhairdren Phull Mhairdren Phull was the patriarch of House Phull of Waterdeep . Around 1440 DR , Lord Phull purchased a title of nobility from the impoverished original Phulls . Shortly after the new Phulls moved into the family mansion , Mhairdren ' s second son Blakrho murdered his older brother and blamed the crime on a younger brother .

title: Mhairshaulk
description: Mhairshaulk Mhairshaulk was the second sarrukh realm . It was contained on the Chultan Peninsula . History .

title: Mhandyvver ' s Poultry
description: Mhandyvver ' s Poultry Mhandyvver ' s Poultry is a poultry shop owned by Oskler Mhandyvver , in the town of Red Larch . Mhandyvver ' s Poultry produces fowl , fresh eggs , and chicks for raising . The fowl include turkeys , chickens , and clip - wing ducks .

title: Mhaorathil
description: Mhaorathil Mhaorathil was a Baneblade of Demron . History . It was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , being the second of his series of Baneblades , designed to be used by the dwarven defenders of the city .

title: Mhaug
description: Mhaug Mhaug was an annis hag shopkeeper in Skullport . Personality . For a hag , Mhaug was cordial but her mind was focused on business .

title: Mhaumask
description: Mhaumask Mhaumask of Mordulkin was a human wizard from the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta in the mid – 14th century DR , and a member of the Zhentarim . Around 1358 DR , he served as the most powerful mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh .

title: Mhezenter Mirilar
description: Mhezenter Mirilar Mhezenter Mirilar was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was worked at Rallogar Hardware but was also a thief . Description .

title: Mhiilamniir
description: Mhiilamniir Mhiilamniir was a ruined Eaerlann i settlement on the Old Road in the High Forest . History . It was formerly the seat of power for the priests of the Seldarine in the kingdom of Eaerlann .

title: Mhoaran
description: Mhoaran King Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the first king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Description . Mhoaran was a thick and tall man and a powerful warrior .

title: Mhodi Shan
description: Mhodi Shan Mhodi Shan was a prominent peak of the Katakoro Shan mountain range . Geography . The peak was found in the southeast corner of Khazari in the branch of Katakoro Shan that formed the southern border of the country .

title: Miba sitt Lelia
description: Miba sitt Lelia Miba sitt Lelia was in charge of the Gulf Gate of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Relationships . Miba was the mother of the current imam of the mosque of Selan .

title: Mica Foebreaker
description: Mica Foebreaker Mica Foebreaker was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth . History . In 1491 DR , Mica led a cell of her fellow cultists on a mission to observe a plot by the Cult of the Howling Hatred to kidnap monks from the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , in order to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .

title: Michaca
description: Michaca Michaca , also known as the City of Gold , was a city of Azuposi situated in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . The concept of Michaca was conceived by Chief Tapeyzin when he saw that men had been corrupted by personal greed caused by the abundance of gold in the area , and he set about using the excess wealth to create a fitting tribute to the gods in the shape of a city , rather than for personal gain .

title: Michael Fleisher
description: Michael Fleisher Michael Fleisher was a comics writer who worked for DC Comics during the 1970s and 1980s . In 1988 , Fleisher wrote the first four issues of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics , with artist Jan Duursema as co - plotter . Together they introduced all the heroes of the series : Cybriana of Shadowdale , Onyx the Invincible , Timoth Eyesbright , Vajra Valmeyjar , as well as Priam Agrivar .

title: Michal Bluestar
description: Michal Bluestar Michal Bluestar was an elven ajami crewman on the pirate vessel " Leap for the Throat " in 1367 DR . Activities . Michal added his magical power to the raids committed by Almari bint - Kafira and her pirate fleet .

title: Michitl
description: Michitl Michitl was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Michitl ruled over a territory of Azatl .

title: Microcline
description: Microcline Microcline , sometimes referred to as amazonstone ( ) in the " Realms " , was a variety of . Description . These ornamental stones were found in deep green to blue - green hues and cleaved easily so it took a skilled to handle properly .

title: Micus
description: Micus Micus was an astral deva servant of Tyr . He was a high - ranking member of the Court of Tyr and one of Tauran ' s closest friends . Description .

title: Midani language
description: Midani language Midani was the common tongue of Zakhara . It was spoken by all " enlightened " citizens of that region as well as by most unenlightened savages of that land . A version of Midani , known as Uloushinn by some scholars , was also spoken by the Bedine .

title: Midnight ' s Mask
description: Midnight ' s Mask Midnight ' s Mask is the third book in the Erevis Cale trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Summary .

title: Midnight Men
description: Midnight Men The Midnight Men were a mercenary company in the Stonelands . History . The Midnight Men earned some notoriety from Waterdeep to Thay .

title: Midnight Mosque
description: Midnight Mosque The Midnight Mosque was a mosque dedicated to Hajama in Liham , in 1367 DR . Location . The Midnight Mosque had a splendid view over Al - Sari River .

title: Midsummer
description: Midsummer Midsummer was a festival that celebrated love and music through feast . It occurred between 30 Flamerule and 1 Eleasis on the Calendar of Harptos . It was a time when love advanced , and it was said the deities themselves took a hand to ensure good weather .

title: Midwinter
description: Midwinter Midwinter ( also known as Deadwinter Day ) was a festival to mark the midpoint of winter in the Calendar of Harptos . It occured on a special day between Hammer 30 and Alturiak 1 . Amongst nobles and monarchs it was known as " Midwinter " and was traditionally used to make or renew alliances , although the common people called it Deadwinter Day , a reference to the cold and hard times that remained before the spring .

title: Mielikki
description: Mielikki Mielikki ( pronounced " my - LEE - kee " ) , also referred to as the Forest Queen , was the neutral good goddess of autumn , druids , dryads , forests , forest creatures and rangers . Her symbol was a gold - horned , blue - eyed , unicorn ' s head facing left and she resides in the Grove of the Unicorns , located within the House of Nature . Worshippers .

title: Mifru
description: Mifru Mifru was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Mifru was the right - hand of Stormgale in their second plan to access the elemental node under the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .

title: Mighty cleaving
description: Mighty cleaving Mighty cleaving was a magical enchantment that could be added to a weapon . It allowed a trained warrior to make another attack after knocking out one foe . Creation .

title: Miglin Crackedquartz
description: Miglin Crackedquartz Miglin Crackedquartz was a deep gnome in Blingdenstone . Activities . When not acting as a guide , Miglin wandered the city making , notes about the caverns and passages .

title: Miilal Hydcont
description: Miilal Hydcont Miilal Hydcont was a noble of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Miilal was the eldest sister of Lord Toben Rosznar and widow of the late Lord Hydcont , meaning that she controlled all the fortunes of House Hydcont , the Amnian branch of House Rosznar .

title: Miirphys Irithyl
description: Miirphys Irithyl Miirphys Irithyl was fourth Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 1338 DR to - 791 DR after Sinaht Irithyl , and a priest of Sehanine Moonbow and the only moon elf Coronal to rule that empire . He did lots of work sending ships into Realmspace to prevent the incursions of Netherese spelljammers from expanding into his domain . He was also known for having imprisoned the Trio Nefarious , a band of nycaloths that one day returned and caused the downfall of his empire , and for raising the Crescent Court , a temple of his deity ( which he was rumoured to haunt after his death ) .

title: Miirym
description: Miirym Miirym , known as the Sentinel Wyrm , was the most peculiar guardian of Candlekeep . Personality . Miirym was a very lonely being and her main aspiration was to finally fly again in the blue sky .

title: Mijayrah
description: Mijayrah The mijayrah ( mih - JAY - rah ) was a basic recorder from Zakhara . Description . These simple instruments were made from reeds .

title: Mikaal Dannihyr
description: Mikaal Dannihyr Mikaal Dannihyr was a human male and the head of the Dannihyr mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . Mikaal was the aging grandson of Rhinnom Dannihyr , the Iltarch ( chief intelligence officer ) of Amn , whom most of the family believed to be dead .

title: Mikal Canos
description: Mikal Canos Mikal Canos was the Tharchion of Delhumide in Thay in 1357 DR and brother of fellow tharchion Thessaloni Canos . History . Mikal commanded one of the most largest thayan army in order to keep control of the ruins of the ancient Delhumide and mean time suppress the many slave uprising in the slave - farms in his Tharch and the sometime raids from Rashemen warriors .

title: Mike Breault
description: Mike Breault Mike Breault is a game designer and editor who has worked for TSR , Inc . Education . Breault was trained as a physicist from in 1980 .

title: Mike Pondsmith
description: Mike Pondsmith Mike Pondsmith is a prolific game designer — including role - playing , video , and board games — who has written sourcebooks for both the Forgotten Realms and Oriental Adventures settings . Background . Pondsmith graduated from with a Bachelor of Arts degree in graphic design and a Bachelor of Science degree in behavioral psychology .

title: Miki - san
description: Miki - san Miki - san was the leader of the yakuza gang of Miki in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Miki , a large fishing village that had recently grown significantly , Miki - san ' s men acted as a peacekeeping force , while the bushi of the jito Mushakoji Nariakira were busy managing the adjacent central Niwa clan shoen .

title: Mikkaalgensis
description: Mikkaalgensis Mikkaalgensis , also known as the Harper Dragon , was an male adult silver dragon living in Myth Drannor during the time of the Weeping War . History . The Harper Dragon was slain in the war ' s twelfth campaign known as the Dragons ' Last Dive while destroying a gate in Aglarond ' s Yuirwood , which was being used by the invading Army of Darkness

title: Miklos Selkirk
description: Miklos Selkirk Miklos Selkirk was an ex - adventurer and the founder and commander of the Silver Ravens . Abilities . Miklos was known as a skilled negotiator , diplomat , and exceptional sword fighter .

title: Milhvar
description: Milhvar Milhvar was an audacious elder malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In Acheron in 1358 DR , just before the start of the Time of Troubles , Milhvar took from the mind of the god Bane some secret information .

title: Milil
description: Milil Milil ( pronounced " mil - LILL " ) , also known as the One Who Watches While Music is Alive and the Guardian of Singers and Troubadours , is a good exarch of Oghma . He is depicted in religious art and song as a handsome male human or elf with a charismatic manner and a haunting , melodic voice . He is venerated by human , elf , and half - elf , bards .

title: Millek
description: Millek Millek the Thrush was a halfling in the Monastery of the Precipice . Activities . Millek was a thief who , in 1479 DR , traveled to Spellgard , seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel to answer a simple question : where she could find a lost treasure ?

title: Millivent Moss
description: Millivent Moss Millivent Moss was a farmer of Twilight Marsh near Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Millivent ran a peat farm from a bog near Phlan with her husband Haldred Moss , her daughters Alleena Moss and Kithian Moss and her sons Quayle Moss and Vollian Moss .

title: Millston
description: Millston Millston was a mercenary . History . Millston served under Cordell of the Golden Legion in the war against the pirates of Akbet - Khrul .

title: Milsantos Daramos
description: Milsantos Daramos Milsantos Daramos was the tharchion of Thazalhar in Thay . Abilities . He was a seasoned warrior and had a reputation for being the canniest commander in Thay .

title: Milshoun ' s Stronghouses
description: Milshoun ' s Stronghouses Milshoun ' s Stronghouses was a collection of three stone warehouses in Beliard around 1368 DR . Inhabitants . The warehouses were owned by Ahbhaer Mhilshoun , who provided storage facilities per day , tenday , or month .

title: Miltiades
description: Miltiades Miltiades , although not specifically referred to as a death knight , was a skeletal undead paladin . Miltiades grew up in the city of Turell . He was its steward and champion .

title: Mimic
description: Mimic Mimics were strange aberrations that assumed the form of mundane furnishings and household objects . Description . Most mimics were the relative size of a human , assuming the form of small beds , chests , and wardrobes .

title: Mimph
description: Mimph Mimph was a coastal city of Sespech . It could only be reached by sea or overland travel as no road led to this city . Despite this limitation , it still saw a fair amount of overland trade .

title: Mina Neyman
description: Mina Neyman Mina Neyman was an acolyte of Kelemvor in Neverdeath Graveyard within Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Description . The priest had blond hair and a scar on the right side of her face .

title: Minak al - Zafyi
description: Minak al - Zafyi Minak al - Zafyi ran a small shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Minak was a tall and handsome elf .

title: Minauthkeep
description: Minauthkeep Minauthkeep was the ruins of a former elven stronghold and base of operations for the drow House Jaelre in Cormanthor . Geography . Minauthkeep was located in the forest of Cormanthor .

title: Mind blank
description: Mind blank Mind blank is an abjuration spell that renders the subject immune to mental / emotional magic and scrying . Effects . The subject is protected from all devices and spells that detect , influence , or read emotions or thoughts .

title: Mind bond
description: Mind bond Mind bond was a divination spell that allowed a paladin and her mount to communicate telepathically and coordinate their attacks . Effect . The paladin temporarily strengthened the mental bond with her special mount , allowing them to predict each other ' s movements and gain a significant edge in combat .

title: Mind domain
description: Mind domain Not to be confused with the Mentalism domain , the Mind domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters Mind spell powers . In terms of game mechanics , a cleric with this domain gains a + 2 bonus on Bluff , Diplomacy , and Sense Motive checks , along with a + 2 bonus on Will saves against enchantment spells and effects . Deities with the Mind domain .

title: Mind flayer
description: Mind flayer An illithid , also called a mind flayer , was an evil and sadistic being , humanoid in appearance , but with a four - tentacled octopus - like head . These beings were feared throughout the Underdark for their telepathic abilities and usually were not without two or more slaves , mentally bound to each individual mind flayer . Although they cooperated to achieve a goal , they would back away at the first sign that something was not profitable to themselves .

title: Mind fog
description: Mind fog Mind fog is an enchantment spell that summons a magical fog to muddle the subject ( s ) mind ( s ) . Effect . " Mind fog " produces a bank of fog that weakens the mental resistance of those caught in it .

title: Mind ream
description: Mind ream Mind Ream is a spell unique to the War Wizards of Cormyr that allows the mage to extract information from a person ' s mind . The spell often leaves the victim ' s mind in ruins . With the changes to the magical weave after the Spellplague , the spell often destroys the mind of the caster as well as the victim .

title: Minda Obarskyr
description: Minda Obarskyr Minda Obarskyr ( born Minda Bleth ) was the sister of Mondar Bleth and settled on the land that would become known as Suzail in 15 DR . She had a secret relationship with Ondeth Obarskyr after his wife had left him that was eventually exposed . Appearance .

title: Minder
description: Minder Minder was an iron golem crew - member of the Halruaa n caravel ship " Realms Master " in 1370 DR . History . Minder was a dwarf who joined Dwalimar Omen in his mission to acquire the Astrolabe of Nimbral .

title: Mindstalker Wars
description: Mindstalker Wars The Mindstalker Wars , also known as the War of Cloven Thoughts , were a series of wars fought between the illithid s of Oryndoll and the dwarves of Shanatar . They began when the illithids attacked the eastern subkingdoms of Shanatar in - 8100 DR . The war lasted until - 8080 DR .

title: Mindulgulph Castle
description: Mindulgulph Castle Mindulgulph Castle was a large keep or castle in the hills south of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast . It sat atop a pinnacle that overlooked the town . It became the base of the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company .

title: Mindulgulph Mercenary Company
description: Mindulgulph Mercenary Company The Mindulgulph Mercenary Company was a mercenary company based in Mindulgulph Castle outside Priapurl on the Dragon Coast , and operated throughout the Heartlands and the southern lands of Faerûn . It was famous for its many monstrous and otherwise non - humanoid members , and was commanded by Gayrlana , nicknamed " Lady Bloodsword " . History .

title: Mindwitness
description: Mindwitness Mindwitnesses were flying nightmares of eyes and tentacles created by mind flayers by inserting one of their tadpoles into a beholder . Description . A mindwitness greatly resembled its beholder " parent " ; an orb - shaped being 6 ft ( 1 .

title: Miner genie
description: Miner genie Miner genies were one of the newest kinds of tasked genie . Though employed by the dao extensively , miner genies were originally created by the yak - folk from dao slaves . Compelled to work and toil within mine shafts , miner genies were hulking creatures driven not only by their need to dig and move stones , but by their burning shame and hatred as well .

title: Mingari
description: Mingari Mingari was a rare and exotic spice exported from Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Description & Uses . This strong spice was similar to cinnamon in flavor .

title: Mini - blade
description: Mini - blade The mini - blade was a tiny blade that was easily concealed between the knuckles . Uses . Mini - blades practically gave the cutpurse their name , allowing a brash thief to slice the strings of an unwary victim ' s coin purse with ease .

title: Miniature giant space hamster
description: Miniature giant space hamster A miniature giant space hamster was , according to Minsc , a that had been miniaturized . These creatures were apparently quite intelligent and had the ability to talk in whispers , though most of the time they just made normal hamster squeaks . The only known miniature giant space hamster in Realmspace was named Boo and was the animal companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc ever since his first head wound .

title: Minnitha
description: Minnitha Minnitha was a dragonborn of white dragon heritage in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Minnitha planned to search for treasure in the mountains near the city , but in fear of bandits she used a disguise and the name Halda in town to visit her family .

title: Minolin Fey
description: Minolin Fey Minolin Fey , also known as Minolin Fey - Branche and Minolin Fey - Baenre , was a Mistress of Arach - Tinilith in Menzoberranzan and wife of Gromph Baenre , Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Personality . Minolin had an inner strength and independence that was belied by her servitude to Quenthel Baenre .

title: Minotaur
description: Minotaur Minotaurs were a strong and combative race of monstrous humanoids resembling bull – human hybrids that were rare in Faerun . Description . Minotaurs were evil giant muscular humanoids with fur - covered bodies and bull - like heads .

title: Minroe
description: Minroe Minroe was a town in Cormyr located west of the King ' s Forest . History . It was a mining town for many years but by 1370 DR the mines were no longer profitable and the population dwindled to about 100 souls .

title: Minsc
description: Minsc Minsc is a kind - hearted , but rather addled warrior known for his habit of talking to a hamster . He believes that the animal , called Boo , is a Miniature Giant Space Hamster , but no - one else ever sees any evidence of this . The Novel .

title: Minser
description: Minser Minser was a peddler in Sembia . History . Minser lived in the small village of Fairelm in shadovar - dominated Sembia .

title: Minsker Halbar
description: Minsker Halbar Minsker Halbar was a human male wizard from Calaunt in the Vast . He was the proprietor of Halbar ' s Bookshop around 1358 DR . He was an old and quiet man , but one of the most accomplished wizards among Calaunt ' s oppressed mages .

title: Mintar
description: Mintar Mintar was a large city located on the Lake of Steam . History . In 1362 DR , Mintar was conquered by an army of the church of Bane led by Teldorn Darkhope and aided by a beholder named Vaxall .

title: Mintarn
description: Mintarn The island of Mintarn lay 400 miles ( 640km ) southwest of Waterdeep , in the Sea of Swords . Mintarn was a popular safe haven for those fleeing the authorities as well as neutral ground for conflicting parties to come to accord . This beautiful island asked no questions and turned no one away .

title: Mintassan the Magnificent
description: Mintassan the Magnificent Mintassan the Magnificent ( also known as the Sage or the Mad ) is a planewalker and sage of the planes that lives in the city of Westgate . His sigil is a stylized sideview of a four - legged beast that vaguely resembles the letter ' M ' . Personality .

title: Minthra Mhandyvver
description: Minthra Mhandyvver Minthra Mhandyvver , usually known as Minny , was a shopkeeper in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis of 1491 DR . Personality . Minny had the demeanor of a kindly , old dodderer , but she was very sharp .

title: Mintiper Moonsilver
description: Mintiper Moonsilver Mintiper Moonsilver was a bard whose works were collected in Silverymoon and compiled into " Mintiper ' s Chapbook " . Appearance . Mintiper ' s eyes were usually blue but whose brightness fluctuated with his mood , growing darker when angered or shining when excited .

title: Mir - Jhaamdath War
description: Mir - Jhaamdath War The Mir - Jhaamdath War broke out in - 5032 DR when Jhaamdath got into contact with the realm of Mir . Mir lost some battles and had to made an alliance with Coramshan in - 5007 DR . The war ended in - 5005 DR and both sides had to give up their intentions to get hold on the land around the Lake of Steam .

title: Mira Roper
description: Mira Roper Mira Roper was a guard in the Moonsea . Activities . Mira was one of the few guards on the payroll of the Red Plumes in the village of Hillpicket .

title: Mira Satra
description: Mira Satra Mira Satra owned some boarding houses in Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Mira managed the Blue Roan , a complex of four boarding houses in Cormyr ean style with well - kept stables .

title: Mira Zawad
description: Mira Zawad Mira Zawad was a scholar , antiquarian , and relic hunter in league with the Zhentarim . She was the only child of the Harper Tam Zawad . History .

title: Mira al - Mikam
description: Mira al - Mikam Mira al - Mikam ran a barber shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Young and beautiful , Mira exemplified elven grace .

title: Mirabar
description: Mirabar Mirabar was a mining city of great wealth located on the Sword Coast . As of 1368 DR it was the richest city north of Waterdeep . In 1370 DR , the city was occupied by 1600 shield dwarves who lived underground near to their workshops , which produced metal goods for export in the region and beyond .

title: Mirabar District
description: Mirabar District The Mirabar District ( also known as the Mirabar Shield ) was a district on the north bank of the city of Luskan , and was dedicated to the warehouses used by Mirabarran merchants operating in the city . As of 1370 DR , companies such as Anvilfist Banner , the Golden Hand , and Thalorin ' s Manymetals traded in this district . These companies operated up to 90 guards to prevent " accidental " injuries from the Luskan militia , who were known to fire into the district for " blood money " .

title: Mirage wall
description: Mirage wall Mirage wall was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an illusionary wall wherever the caster could see .

title: Miraj Vizann
description: Miraj Vizann Miraj Vizann was the second - in - command of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Miraj was a very rational and deliberate individual .

title: Mirandos
description: Mirandos Mirandos was a priest of Helm who was sent to Maztica to convert the native population of Payit and Far Payit . Until she went rogue , Mirandos was considered an excellent missionary . One of Mirandos ' s duties was to burn heretical native texts and while engaged in this activity she stumbled upon books that referenced the ruined city of Ixtzul and its guardian the Star Worm .

title: Miraun
description: Miraun Miraun was a male human enchanter and the " diplomat at large " for Zhentil Keep and the Zhentarim in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . As required in his job , Miraun was an intelligent and charming person .

title: Miresella
description: Miresella Miresella was a scout from Baldur ' s Gate . History . Miresella was following a caravan when she happened to discover the secret Cult of the Dragon village of Parnast .

title: Mirg Isle
description: Mirg Isle Mirg Isle was an island and a pirate stronghold in the Pirate Isles . It had two ports . History .

title: Mirkazar
description: Mirkazar Mirkazar was a protectorate of the Kingdom of Tethyr that contained most of the Forest of Mir . Geography . The Mir Protectorate was located in the of Suretmarch , south of counties Alonmarch and Surkazar .

title: Mirol
description: Mirol Mirol was the merfolk prince of Eadraal in Myth Nantar . History . Born in 1345 DR as Prince Mirol III he was a bookish cleric of Eadro until after the Twelfth Serôs War with the king Vhaemas ' s injury Mirol was choose as temporary regent .

title: Miros Xelbrin
description: Miros Xelbrin Miros Xelbrin was was an innkeeper ins Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Miros managed the Northfurrow ' s End inn .

title: Mirran
description: Mirran Mirran was a storm giant princess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Mirran was the eldest daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Mirror
description: Mirror Mirror was a ghost that manifested in the Sunrise Mountains in Thay . Appearance . Mirror was usually perceived as a phosphorescence floating through the air , which sometimes assumed a manlike shape and could momentarily take on the semblance of a nearby person or sculpture .

title: Mirror image
description: Mirror image Mirror image allows the caster to bring several illusions of him or herself into being in the caster ' s immediate surroundings . The images behave and look exactly like the caster , and the caster is able to merge with , or split from , any of the images at will . If an image is struck , such as with a weapon , it disappears for good .

title: Mirror of perfection
description: Mirror of perfection The mirror of perfection was a magic item in Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . Around 607 DR , the " mirror of perfection " was hidden in the Caves of Ghazz on the island of Saishu off the coast of Koryo . It was thought to still be there by 1357 DR , but the exact location of the caves was unknown .

title: Mirrorman ' s Mill
description: Mirrorman ' s Mill Mirrorman ' s Mill was an old millhouse in Shadowdale . Geography . The mill was located south of the village at the confluence of the Duckrace and the Millpond .

title: Mirt
description: Mirt Mirt " the Moneylender " was a fat , wheezing old rogue , and retired adventurer . He made his fortune as an adventurer in Undermountain after a colorful career as a mercenary general . During this time Mirt , then known as Mirt the Merciless or the Old Wolf or Lord Walrus .

title: Mirthal Aendryr
description: Mirthal Aendryr Mirthal Aendryr was Duke of Durmista and the Suldusk elves , Scoutlord of Tethyr , and a former member of the Company of Eight . Description . Mirthal was a wild elf ( green elf ) of the Suldusk tribe of the eastern Forest of Tethir , known as Durmista .

title: Misbahd
description: Misbahd Only few people lived on the island of Sahu . Some of them formed the village of Misbahd , which was located on the northern coast below the plateau dominating the island ' s interior . Inhabitants .

title: Mischa Waymeet
description: Mischa Waymeet Mischa Waymeet was one of Drogan Droganson students in Hilltop . Description . Mischa had shoulder length blonde hair , fair skin and green eyes .

title: Misdirection
description: Misdirection Misdirection was an illusion spell that could confuse divination spells trying to read the auras of a person or an object . Components . Only verbal and somatic components were required to cast this spell .

title: Mishtan
description: Mishtan Mishtan was just one of many villages within the Great Vale of Mulhorand , but stood out from others because it was the gateway to the Land of the Dead — the resting place for pharaohs and their families . Description . Tombs and other construction projects were a never - ending occurrence in Mishtan .

title: Misikin
description: Misikin Misikin was a feng - huang member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Misikin was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .

title: Miska the Wolf - Spider
description: Miska the Wolf - Spider Miska , the Wolf - Spider , is a demon lord who was once the Prince of Demons . He was imprisoned in Pandemonium by the Wind Dukes of Aaqa . The Queen of Chaos utterly destroyed the prince of demons , Obox - ob , and gave the title to Miska .

title: Misker
description: Misker Misker the Pirate Tyrant was a beholder smuggler king in Skullport . Personality . Misker was known to have a very creative mind in developing his smuggling routes .

title: Mislead
description: Mislead Mislead is an illusion spell that turns the caster invisible and creates an illusory double . Effect . An illusory double of the caster ( a figment ) appears , and at the same time , the caster becomes invisible ( as improved invisibility , a glamer ) .

title: Missile mastery
description: Missile mastery Missile mastery was an arcane alteration spell that allowed the caster to alter the trajectory of a missile . Effects . This spell had a duration of 4 minutes , and during that time the caster could stop or reflect a single mundane or enchanted physical missile , such as a rock , a crossbow bolt , a javelin , a throwing axe , an " arrow + 1 " , a vial of " holy water " , or a flask of oil .

title: Misstyre
description: Misstyre Misstyre was a drow wizard and merchant who lead a tribe of a hundred or so of his brethren in the western region of the High Forest . Personality . The drow ' s group would capture female elves from the nearby area under Misstyre ' s leadership .

title: Mist cheese
description: Mist cheese Mist cheese was a rich cheese crafted in Loudwater Vale within the Savage Frontier . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Mist of the goddess
description: Mist of the goddess Mist of the goddess was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Quiet One . It created a holy mist that could return one unfortunate soul to full health , blessed vitality , and mental acuity , or it could be used to reincarnate one or more beings . Effects .

title: Mistdown Marauders
description: Mistdown Marauders The Mistdown Marauders were a famed adventuring company that operated in the Vast . They were based out of The Stag and Viper inn at Viperstongue Ford . History .

title: Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco
description: Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco Mistinarperadnacles Hai Draco , or Mist for short , was a red dragon famous for killing an abomination of the god Moander . Personality . Though she ate living creatures and kept a hoard of a treasure that she coveted like any other red dragon , she didn ' t enjoy killing just for the sake of killing or the joy of inspiring terror .

title: Mistledale
description: Mistledale Mistledale was one of the regions that made up the Dalelands . It consisted mainly of a grassy vale in the midst of the elven forest , allegedly created by a falling star . This was among the more peaceful of the Dales , although as of 1372 DR , drow incursions from the forest began causing serious problems .

title: Mistledale Mount
description: Mistledale Mount Mistledale Mount was a large hill southwest of the village of Shadowdale . The mountain received its name from the local legend that on a clear day you could see the smoke from fires in distant Mistledale . Features .

title: Mistmaster
description: Mistmaster The Mistmaster was a very powerful illusionist and cleric of Leira living in the Citadel of the Mists in the High Forest and a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR . History . Almost nothing was known about the Mistmaster and his dealings with Khelben Arunsun ; some speculated that it was under Khelben ' s orders that the Mistmaster destroyed Hellgate Keep with the " Gatekeeper ' s Crystal " .

title: Mistmyr Iroan
description: Mistmyr Iroan Mistmyr Iroan was a sorcerer and tavern keeper in Waterdeep in 1374 DR . Personality . Mistmyr talked very loudly , especially when he was very excited or nervous .

title: Mistshaws
description: Mistshaws Mistshaws was one of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . Located near Hargleth Forest , Mistshaws was renowned for its talented singers , minstrels , and instrument - makers .

title: Mistshore
description: Mistshore Mistshore was the name given to the dilapidated north shore of Waterdeep ' s harbor . After the Spellplague , Waterdeep went into a decline and maintenance of the harbor was neglected . Many ships sank or were scuttled in the northern harbor and eventually Waterdeep ' s outcasts created a small community on the wrecked ship hulls .

title: Misty Forest
description: Misty Forest The Misty Forest was located just west of the High Moor , just south of the river Delimbiyr . Flora . The Misty Forest was full of pine trees and other types of evergreen trees .

title: Misty Vale
description: Misty Vale The Misty Vale was a valley and temple to Eldath located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . It laid a league ( 5 . 5 kilometers ) northeast of Dura ' s Vale .

title: Mita
description: Mita Mita was the raccoon familiar of No Ziar , a notorious wu jen who dwelled in the Vorkani Mountains and in the settlement of Pan in Koryo around 1357 DR . Mita could swell to twice its natural size in a fight . It enjoyed eating fresh fish , namely the people that No Ziar transformed into fish .

title: Mitbiq
description: Mitbiq The mitbiq ( miht - BEEQ ) was an interesting Zakharan wind instrument that appeared to be two instruments in one . Description . " Mitbiqs " were double clarinets made from reed tubes .

title: Mithann
description: Mithann Mithann was a cleric of Amaunator in Icewind Dale in 1484 DR . History . Mithann was a cleric of Amaunator and an adventurer from Cormyr .

title: Mithbarakaz
description: Mithbarakaz Mithbarakaz , usually known as Mith Barak , was the king of Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR and 1479 DR . History . Mithbarakaz was a silver dragon who disguised itself as a dwarf with silvery blue skin and a silver beard called " Mith Barak the Clanless " in 66 DR .

title: Mithertul
description: Mithertul The Mithertul family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Mithertuls were allied with the Baraedin , Onsil , and Naskurl families .

title: Mithral
description: Mithral Mithral , also known as mithril , was a precious metal produced from ore found in mountain ranges in certain areas of Faerûn and in the Underdark . Description . Mithral was produced through a process similar to that of steel - smelting .

title: Mithral Hall
description: Mithral Hall Mithral Hall ( sometimes spelled " Mithril Hall " ) was a dwarven stronghold beneath Fourthpeak Mountain in the Frost Hills , part of the Spine of the World . It was one of the best known dwarven strongholds in Faerûn . Originally a mithral mine belonging to Clan Battlehammer , this underground town became a safe haven for various dwarf families and even some persons of other races .

title: Mithral bells
description: Mithral bells Mithral bells were a small chain of eleven mithral bells , each of which could be thrown as a grenade weapon to detonate with a " sound burst " effect . The bell would explode after 40 feet if it did not strike something first . While worn as a bracelet , the wearer would find greater success at attempted artistic performances , provided at least three bells remained on the mithral chain .

title: Mithril Legion
description: Mithril Legion The Mithril Legion , or Mithral Legion , was a dwarven army that quested to recover the lost Mines of Tethyamar in the 1360s DR . History . Borlin inspired a large number of dwarven warriors to form the Mithril Legion and embark on a quest to reclaim the Mines of Tethyamar .

title: Mithril Mountain
description: Mithril Mountain The Mithril Mountain , or the Crescent , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . Three thousand light infantry archers made up the Mithril Mountain .

title: Mival
description: Mival Mavil was a hermit monk in the Great Glacier in 1491 DR . Personality . Mavil was a very typical hermit , disliking others and having trouble interacting with them .

title: Miverra
description: Miverra Miverra was a drow priestess of Eilistraee . History . Miverra was a priestess of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden .

title: Mixi
description: Mixi Mixi ( pronounced " MIX - ee " ) was a half - elf waitress in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Mixi was usually very gentle and professional .

title: Mixtal
description: Mixtal Mixtal was the high priest of Zaltec in Payit . History . In 1361 DR , Mixtal and the Jaguar Knight Gultec were tasked by Nexal high priest Hoxitl with the mission to capture and to kill Erixitl from the local temple of Qotal , despite Mixtal ' s fear of reprisal .

title: Miyagi - ko
description: Miyagi - ko Miyagi - ko was the concubine of Funada Toyoo in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Miyagi - ko was the mother of Toyoo ’ s favorite son , having so a great amount of power inside Toyoo ' s household , more than Toyoo ’ s First Wife .

title: Miyama Province
description: Miyama Province The Miyama Province was one of the most wealthy and populated provinces in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Miyama was at the exact center of the isle of Shinkoku . It was composed of two very fertile plains divided by woods and the mountains of Kurisammyaku .

title: Miyeritar
description: Miyeritar Miyeritar was an ancient dark elven empire in the north western parts of Faerûn . History . The realm of Miyeritar was founded by green and dark elves around - 18000 DR in the area later known as the High Moor and Misty Forest .

title: Miyoshi
description: Miyoshi Miyoshi was a spirit folk kensai in Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Miyoshi was the current pupil of the great swordsman Junyu .

title: Miz ' ri Mizzrym
description: Miz ' ri Mizzrym Miz ' ri Mizzrym was the matron mother of House Mizzrym in 1372 DR . Description . She was considered comely but perpetually wore an ugly scowl .

title: Mizferac
description: Mizferac Mizferac is a glabrezu who was summoned by Cadderly to determine the whereabouts of Jarlaxle . Appearance and Personality . Mizferac was described as stupid by the imp who provided his name to Cadderly .

title: Mlarraun
description: Mlarraun The mlarraun , also known as a " spitting snake " or a " stone snake " , was a snake - like magical creature , classified as both a Scaled One and a , native to Faerûn south of the Inner Sea . They were notorious for spitting poison and assuming a pliable stone - like torpor . Physical description .

title: Mlorgathyn
description: Mlorgathyn Mlorgathyn of Selgaunt was a merchant around 1479 DR . History . Mlorgathyn was a dealer in fine wines , scents , and sauces based in Selgaunt .

title: Mo ' ki
description: Mo ' ki Mo ' ki , also written as mo ' Ki , was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Mo ' ki lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo .

title: Mo ' ki Bay
description: Mo ' ki Bay Mo ' ki Bay or mo ' Ki Bay was a bay in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Mo ' ki Bay lay on the eastern coast , facing the Straits of Koryo .

title: Mo Kin
description: Mo Kin Mo Kin was the abbot of Pokarr in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Mo Kin ruled over the Pokarr monastery and was a member of the Lon Chen , the chief ministers who advised the High Lama .

title: Moander
description: Moander Moander ( pronounced " moe - AN - der " ) was an ancient deity of rot , corruption , and decay . The " Darkbringer " never had a large following , but various cults had venerated Moander since before the rise of Netheril . Moander was alternately referred to as he , she , or it in the ancient texts and the deity ' s gender remains unknown to this day .

title: Mocking Maiden
description: Mocking Maiden The Mocking Maiden was an inn and tavern in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . It was a merry and busy place , but of excellent quality for only moderate prices . The staff focused on good food and on keeping adventuring patrons happy .

title: Mod ' Vensis Tlabbar
description: Mod ' Vensis Tlabbar Mod ' vensis Tlabbar was a drow priestess of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1361 DR , Mod ' Vensis was a Faen Tlabbar priestess and an instructor at Arach - Tinilith .

title: Modron
description: Modron Modrons were a race of immortal s known for their zealous adherence to the principles of law and order above all else . Just as fiend s were considered the embodiment of evil and celestial s the embodiment of good , so were modrons the embodiment of the universal principle of order . Ecology .

title: Mogion
description: Mogion Mogion was the leader of the Survivors of Moander cult in Yûlash in 1357 DR . History . The daughter of a Sembia n noble , Mogion joined the cult of Moander and rose to the position of high priestess .

title: Mohrg
description: Mohrg Mohrgs were undead that were the risen forms of mass - murderers that died before they could atone for their crimes . Mohrgs existed to bring more death and destruction to the world , delighting in the screams of the dying . Description .

title: Moirah
description: Moirah Moirah was a worker at the Jewel tavern in Ormpetarr . Appearance . Moirah was a slight woman with a small build and dark , raven - colored hair .

title: Moire
description: Moire Moire was a female half - elf who was a high - ranking member of the Shadow Thieves chapter in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Moire was a notorious gang leader in Neverwinter ' s Docks district , part of the Shadow Thieves chapter under Axle Devrie .

title: Moktessa
description: Moktessa Moktessa was a wine that could only be found within the kingdom of Dambrath . Description . Made from rich white grapes , Moktessa was enjoyed by humans and drow .

title: Mold touch
description: Mold touch Mold touch was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath and cleric s of Mielikki and Silvanus . It gave the caster a handful of brown mold spores that could be transferred to a target by touch . Effects .

title: Molnir
description: Molnir Molnir the Mighty was a dwarf and part of a valiant group who defended Dead Dwarf Bridge against forces from Narfell who hoped to invade Almorel . History . Molnir fell to his death from the bridge into the Clearflow River far below , but not before killing many enemies .

title: Moloch
description: Moloch Moloch is a Lord of the Nine Hells and arch - devil of Hell ( Baator in later editions of the game ) , and once served as the viceroy of Baalzebul . Description . Moloch is a great , square - bodied creature with red - orange skin .

title: Molten Throne
description: Molten Throne The Molten Throne was a magic throne used by Nar - Aidiya within Krak al - Mazhar — the secret fortress of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Description . The Throne sat upon a stone column in the Infernal Hall that measured 10 feet in diameter and usually sat 10 feet above the ground .

title: Molvayas Armgo
description: Molvayas Armgo Molvayas Armgo was a member of House Barrison Del ' Armgo in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Molvayas was an instructor at Arach - Tinilith .

title: Molvayas Philiom
description: Molvayas Philiom Molvayas Philiom was a fanatic high priest of Ghaunadaur in Llurth Dreir . History . Malvayas was a member of House Philiom in Llurth Dreir .

title: Molydeus
description: Molydeus When Tharizdun discovered the shard of utter evil and buried it in the elemental chaos , he charged seven angels with the protection of his treasure . The celestial beings were naturally , obedient , to the wishes of the god , but were unsure if they were doing what they should in listening to the scheming Deity . This left them frustrated and angry .

title: Moment of clarity
description: Moment of clarity Moment of clarity is an abjuration spell that lets a paladin help the subject clear or effects from his mind . Effect . When the paladin casts this spell and touch a creature that is under the influence of a mind - affecting spell or effect , that creature immediately attempts to break free of the effect .

title: Monastery of St . Fanal
description: Monastery of St . Fanal The Monastery of St . Fanal was a monastery , school , and library dedicated to Ilmater the Broken God .

title: Monastery of the Yellow Rose
description: Monastery of the Yellow Rose The Monastery of the Yellow Rose , also known as the Citadel of the White Worm , was a monastery dedicated to St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred and Ilmater , the Broken God . It was situated high in the Earthspur Mountains in Damara , overlooking the Glacier of the White Worm .

title: Monastic Servants of Auppenser
description: Monastic Servants of Auppenser Note . No lore was ever officially established on the monastic servants , but Ed Bonny , creator of the psionic deity Auppenser , and co - author of Lost Empires of Faerûn , posted a full write up of the unofficial prestige class here .

title: Mondar Bleth
description: Mondar Bleth Mondar Bleth was the owner of a small farmstead about a mile from Suzail , which he and his family had settled shortly after Ondeth Obarskyr settled in the area . He was killed along with most of his family by elves in 16 DR and his farmstead was razed . Mondar wielded a large heavy - hafted sword that would later become known as Ansrivarr .

title: Mongrelfolk
description: Mongrelfolk Mongrelfolk , or mongrelmen , were the result of an experiment by an accomplished wizard . The wizard had wanted to find a good replacement for dopplegangers , one that could be controlled easily . His experiment succeeded , and the mongrelmen infiltrator s were born .

title: Monica Langin
description: Monica Langin Monica Langin was a concubine in Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s Royal Harim in Huzuz . Description . Monica had fiery red hair and was so beautiful that she caught Khalil ' s eye and was asked to join the harem .

title: Monk
description: Monk Monks were spiritual ascetics and practitioners of a mystical energy known as " ki " , the magical essence which flows through all living things . Monks utilized this energy to augment their own physical abilities , granting them extraordinary speed and strength . Monks could also use their own ki to alter the energy flow in other living creatures , for both defensive and offensive purposes .

title: Monk of the long death
description: Monk of the long death Monks of the long death belong to the Order of the Long Death monastic order . These monks study the nature of death , and are particularly interested by the moment of passing . They don ' t bother about the afterlife or nature of the soul .

title: Monkberry
description: Monkberry Monkberry was the Rengarth mother of Sunbright Steelshanks . Description . The Rengarth woman used her hair to make bowstrings .

title: Monkey
description: Monkey Monkeys were tree - dwelling primates . Unlike other primates , some monkeys had tails . They were mostly found in warm forests and jungles but a few species could also live in tundras .

title: Monkey ( Hu Sen )
description: Monkey ( Hu Sen ) Monkey , also known as Mad Monkey and Hu Sen , was a unique being from the Outer Planes who was banished to Toril . Description . Though capable of shapechanging , Monkey ’ s natural form was that of a man with the face of a monkey .

title: Monksblade
description: Monksblade Monksblade was a village in Cormyr known for its fine food and accommodation , making it a popular stop for people traveling to Sembia . Location . Monksblade was located along the Way of the Manticore between Dreamer ' s Rock and Battlerise .

title: Monocle of Bagthalos
description: Monocle of Bagthalos The monocle of Bagthalos was a holy artifact of Helm . Worn over one eye , it gave its user magically enhanced eyesight . The " monocle " was crafted by Bagthalos Deszhummer , Archpriest of Helm , in the 1100s DR , and was imbued with his spirit , which could also curse any who wore the " monocle " .

title: Monrativi Teshy Mir
description: Monrativi Teshy Mir Monrativi Teshy Mir was Alzhedo for the " First Kingdom of Mir " . It was the term used by the Calishites to refer to a piece of land in Monteshi that was contested between Calimshan and the kingdom of Tethyr . Shoonach , the capital of the Shoon Imperium was located there .

title: Monsoon Legion
description: Monsoon Legion The Monsoon Legion was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 1 , 000 heavily armed elite djinni bodyguards served in the Monsoon Legion .

title: Monster Manual 2 4th edition
description: Monster Manual 2 4th edition Contents . Monster Manual 2 is an expansion upon the first , including many new monsters , as well as new versions of older ones . Like the first , Monster Manual 2 consists of only four chapters , though the first chapter composes most of the book .

title: Monster Manual 3 4th edition
description: Monster Manual 3 4th edition Contents . Monster Manual 3 is an expansion upon the first and second monster sources , including many new monsters , as well as new versions of older ones . Unlike its predecessors , this book contains no information on playable monster races .

title: Monster Manual 4th edition
description: Monster Manual 4th edition Contents . The 4th edition " Dungeons & Dragons " ruleset revamps the mechanics of monsters substantially and it is this subject that the " Monster Manual " covers . Like previous iterations of the book , the " Monster Manual " is a compendium of basic lore , game mechanics , and imagery on the various monsters which make up the core bestiary of the D & D game .

title: Monster mount
description: Monster mount Monster mount was an enchantment spell that could charm creatures into being mounts or pack animals for a few hours . Effects . This spell worked on a limited number of live ( not undead ) creatures of low intelligence .

title: Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix
description: Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix Contents . The Monstrous Compendium Al - Qadim Appendix consisted of 64 5 - hole punched loose - leaf pages , unnumbered , and included a " How To Use This Book " page with an alphabetical index , a one - page index of appropriate monsters for the Al - Qadim setting from other books of the " Monstrous Compendium " - series , 2 pages of random encounter charts , and a sheet with the compiled game statistics , with the remainder consisting of the descriptions of the fictional monsters . Also included were 4 full - page illustrations on heavier card stock .

title: Monstrous humanoid
description: Monstrous humanoid Monstrous humanoids are differentiated from humanoid s by their monstrous or animalistic features . Not all of them are technically " humanoid " in body form . They often have different types of supernatural or extraordinary abilities .

title: Monstrous scorpion
description: Monstrous scorpion Monstrous scorpions or giant scorpions were a breed of arachnids known for their poisonous stingers . They were found in a variety of climates , but are most numerous in deserts . Description .

title: Montar Kaspar
description: Montar Kaspar Montar Kaspar was a half - elf cavalier and the baron of the city of Kaspar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . He chose the name " Montar Kaspar " for himself , it meant " defender of Kaspar " . Activities .

title: Montaron
