description: Montaron Montaron was a halfling member of the Zhentarim who was sent with Xzar to the Sword Coast during the iron crisis . He appears in both the game and novel versions of the Baldur ' s Gate series , of which only the latter is considered canonical . The Novel .

title: Monte Cook
description: Monte Cook Monte Cook has been a professional game designer since 1988 , working primarily on role - playing games . Much of his early work was for . During this period , he attracted fan and critical attention with the popular multi - genre setting .

title: Monteshi
description: Monteshi County Monteshi was a county in Tethyr . The ruined and haunted city of Shoonach resided there . Geography .

title: Montolio Debrouchee
description: Montolio Debrouchee Montolio Debrouchee ( also spelled DeBrouchee ) , better known as " Mooshie , " was a ranger of great renown , having dedicated himself to the defense of all living things not evil in nature , and total dedication to the goddess of the forest , Mielikki , at an early age . Description . In his last year of life , Montolio was tall , straight , and frail - looking .

title: Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne
description: Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne The Monument of the Achievements of the Enlightened Throne was a tower located within the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . This splendid tower housed halls honoring the Grand Caliph s of Zakhara ' s past .

title: Moo Kalai
description: Moo Kalai Moo Kalai was a hengeyokai carp man in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Moo lived with his family in a deep lake in Nam Tso .

title: Moog
description: Moog Moog was a lonely hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Moog lived in a decrepit old tower somewhere near the Dessarin Valley where she wallowed in self - pity .

title: Mook
description: Mook Mook was a thief and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla in Amn . She was involved in the covert war between the thieves and Bodhi ' s vampires . Appendix .

title: Moon ' s Twelve
description: Moon ' s Twelve The Moon ' s Twelve were an adventuring company operating in Cormyr in the 1350s DR . History . " Circa " 1357 DR , the Moon ' s Twelve embarked on an expedition into the notorious Vast Swamp of eastern Cormyr .

title: Moon ( coin )
description: Moon ( coin ) " The moon " ( or a " moon " ) refers to crescent shaped coins minted by the city of Silverymoon . A " moon " was originally a shining blue crescent - shaped electrum coin , valued at 2 ep ( 1 gp ) in the city of Silverymoon . and 1 ep elsewhere .

title: Moon - horse
description: Moon - horse Moon - horses , also called teu ' kelytha in Elvish , were intelligent , magic - using horse s found on Evermeet . Description . Moon - horses had coats that ranged from white to silvery gray .

title: Moon - spinners
description: Moon - spinners The Moon - spinners were a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Selan , the Zakharan goddess of beauty . The symbol of the Moon - spinners was a long white scarf , which they used to whip or strangle their victims . Activities .

title: Moon Daggers
description: Moon Daggers The Moon Daggers were a gang organized by Myrkyssa Jelan in 1479 DR shortly after she escaped her imprisonment in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff . The gang attempted to recover the Sarkenaegal tome in the ruined dwarven city of Sarbreen beneath Ravens Bluff but were slightly slower than Jack Ravenwild and his hirelings , the Blue Wyvern Company , who beat the Moon Daggers to the book . Later , Myrkyssa and the Moon Daggers helped to defeat an attack by the slaver Fetterfists and his drow allies on a noble revel .

title: Moon Knights
description: Moon Knights The Moon Knights are a military order of the temple of Sehanine Moonbow . Description . They number around eighty and consist of cleric s of Sehanine Moonbow , all of whom are trained swordsmen .

title: Moon Pass
description: Moon Pass The Moon Pass was an ancient gorge through which the River Rauvin flowed , splitting the eastern and western section of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The trail between Everlund and Sundabar passed through the Moon Pass .

title: Moon domain
description: Moon domain The Moon domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters spell powers related to the Moon , perception and lycanthrope s . The spellcaster gains the ability to turn and destroy such shapechanger s as a good cleric turns undead . Moon Domain Spells .

title: Moon elf
description: Moon elf Moon elves , also known as Teu - tel - quessir in their own language , or as silver elves are the most common of all the eladrin subraces . More tolerant of human s than other eladrin , moon elves are the ancestors of most half - eladrin . Ecology .

title: Moonbar
description: Moonbar Moonbars were rare gemstone unique to the Realms that were found in desert and tropical regions on Toril . Description . Moonbars were usually found in large crystals , typically 1 ft ( 30 cm ) long by 4 in ( 10 cm ) wide , which were rectangular with rounded corners .

title: Moonbeam
description: Moonbeam Moonbeam was an evocation spell that fired a movable beam of light that penetrated darkness and forced lycanthropes to change shape . Effects . The " moonbeam " was cone - shaped and originated from the caster ' s hand .

title: Moonblade
description: Moonblade A moonblade was a hereditary magical longsword passed down in elf lineages . Description . Moonblades were named in part because of the moonstone s found in the of each sword but also for the moon elves that wielded them , with the only exception of the half - elf assassin , Arilyn Moonblade .

title: Moonclaw
description: Moonclaw The Moonclaw were a thieves ' guild in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar . They were secretly financed by King Belaur Aumar . History .

title: Moondeep Sea
description: Moondeep Sea The Moondeep Sea was a subterranean lake approximately 240 miles ( 386 km ) wide found in the Underdark beneath the Galena Mountains . Geography . The cavern which contained it was known as the Vault of Gnashing Teeth , so named for the countless animated skulls stuck to the cavern ' s ceiling .

title: Moonfire ( person )
description: Moonfire ( person ) Lady Moonfire was a light - hearted half - elf and leader of Loudwater as of 1479 DR . Physical Appearance . Lady Moonfire tended to wear a black gown , decorated with patterns threaded in silver .

title: Moongleam Tower
description: Moongleam Tower Moongleam Tower was the base of operations for the Harpers in Everlund . Structure . Built around 1172 DR , the hard black stone keep was visible from almost every part of Everlund .

title: Moonhoney
description: Moonhoney Moonhoney was made from the feces of ground - dwelling worms that dwelled in the Abyss . Its color and consistency resembled that of honey and when exposed to moonlight it developed a sweet flavor that was highly prized by human s and many demihuman s . Moonhoney didn ' t spoil so it was ideal travel food .

title: Moonlands
description: Moonlands Moonlands was a region that was located east of the River Surbrin and north of River Rauvin in the Silver Marches . Description . The southern part of this region was densely populated , but away from the river , the landscape soon turned into a real wild land .

title: Moonlight
description: Moonlight Moonlight was one of three ninja in the service of Daisake Mayazato in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Moonlight trained in the ninja arts in the Warazama clan together with Smoke and Snake , until that clan was destroyed by internal dissent .

title: Moonlight ' s Triumph
description: Moonlight ' s Triumph Moonlight ' s Triumph was a battle that occurred when the Nethertide Horde of the Nether Mountains threatened both Everlund and Silverymoon in Year of the Boot , 1343 DR . Preparation . The Moonlight Men mercenaries had reached Turnstone Pass before the orc s , who were approaching from the north .

title: Moonlight Men
description: Moonlight Men The Moonlight Men were a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Moonlight Men were a mercenary company of ten years ' experience that gained a great reputation .

title: Moonlit Tower
description: Moonlit Tower The Moonlit Tower was a mysterious tower situated on a crag northwest of the town of Maerstar in the Vast in north Faerûn . Structure . It only appeared when the moon was full and its rays illuminated the crag .

title: Moonsea
description: Moonsea The Moonsea was a region in north Faerûn . The region was dominated by the large titular sea that was connected to the Sea of Fallen Stars to the south by the River Lis . The shoreline was a wild , frontier area that was home to several city states dominated by despots .

title: Moonsea ( lake )
description: Moonsea ( lake ) The Moonsea , originally known as the Dragon Sea , was a deep natural lake just north of the Dalelands . The Moonsea gave its name to the whole Moonsea region , as the name Moonsea applied to both the lake and the lands around the lake .

title: Moonsea Ride
description: Moonsea Ride The Moonsea Ride was a road that ran from Arabel , through Tilverton north of Cormyr , in a northeasterly direction , cutting through the Rimwood and Midwood areas of the forest of Cormanthor , until it reached Hillsfar on the southern shores of the Moonsea . In Cormyr , it was called the Mountain Ride . From Arabel , it ran past Castle Crag ( near where it joined Dragon Trail ) and through Gnoll Pass in the Storm Horns .

title: Moonsea skysentinel
description: Moonsea skysentinel The Moonsea Skysentinel is a prestige class of the Moonsea region of Faerûn . Moonsea Skysentinels serve as the lookouts , spies , and scouts for the Knights of the North , a small organization of individuals who wish to see the destruction of the Zhentarim . Moonsea Skysentinels ride their dire hawk mounts in search of enemy movement , communication between cells of their organization , and a variety of other tasks they are uniquely suited to .

title: Moonshadow Hall
description: Moonshadow Hall Moonshadow Hall is the temple of Selûne located in the city of Yhaunn in the nation of Sembia . Layout . The high priestess ' s rooms are located on the second floor of the temple , furthest from the ram that leads down to the ground floor .

title: Moonshae Isles
description: Moonshae Isles The Moonshae Isles were a group of islands that formed a roughly circular archipelago with the Sea of Moonshae in the center . They lay roughly 400 miles ( 644 km ) west of the region of Amn and to the southwest of the Sword Coast . As of 1371 DR , the majority of the Moonshae Isles were ruled by High Queen Alicia Kendrick , who ruled from the capital city of Caer Callidyrr on Alaron .

title: Moonshae trilogy
description: Moonshae trilogy The Moonshae trilogy was the first series of books set in the Forgotten Realms . The trilogy was written by Douglas Niles . The series is followed by the Druidhome trilogy .

title: Moonsilver House
description: Moonsilver House Moonsilver House was a temple of Selûne in the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The temple was managed by High Priestess Wyndra Syrylstone , who was known as " Moon Mistress " . She led twenty - two priestesses , as well as 229 lay worshipers through the mid – 14th century DR .

title: Moonstalker
description: Moonstalker Moonstalkers are shifter s who have a closer bond with their lycanthropic ancestors . They assault their enemies using bone - chilling howls and feral instincts . Also , they have the ability to take the form of a wolf or a tiger , depending on what kind of shifter they are .

title: Moonstar agent
description: Moonstar agent Moonstar agents , also referred to as Teukiir , was a special prestige class on Faerûn . They were all members of the organization known as the Moonstars which was founded by Khelben Arunsun . Ex - Moonstar Agents .

title: Moonstars
description: Moonstars The Moonstars ( also known as the Tel ' Teukiira , the Silverstars or the Twelvestars ) were a highly secretive group of individuals formed by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun with the aim of unifying the human s and other races ( especially elves ) against the forces of evil . Outlook . The Moonstars sought to preserve life and knowledge .

title: Moonstone
description: Moonstone Moonstone was an opaque white form of found in the Realms . Description . Moonstones took on a milky bluish sheen when polished and were usually cut cabochon for jewelry and ornamentation .

title: Moonstone Palace
description: Moonstone Palace The Moonstone Palace ( also Moonflower Palace ) is the home of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower on the island of Evermeet . It is a huge white structure made from marble , alabaster and crystal , surrounded by the Guardian trees , and situated above the city of Leuthilspar . Its features are slender towers , flying buttresses and sky bridges .

title: Moonveil
description: Moonveil Moonveil was a divine magic spell available to certain priests of Bhaal , and later , Bane , that corrupted and blocked a moonwell — sacred pools scattered around the Moonshae Isles and dedicated to the Earthmother , with magical properties and possibly a " portal " — from operating . It was a ritual that took nine minutes to cast and could be assisted by up to seven additional followers . Effects .

title: Moonwater
description: Moonwater The Moonwater was a temple of Selûne in the town of Ylraphon in the Vast . Organization . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was quite a small temple , tended to by only five cleric s , including their leader , Catalan Bree .

title: Moonwing
description: Moonwing Moonwing was a silver dragon and a leader of the Talons of Justice during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Azhaq and his fellow Moonwing tried to capture the rebellious song dragon Karasendrieth , but they were defeated after Dorn Graybrook ' s team helped Kara in the battle .

title: Moonwood
description: Moonwood The Moonwood was a large forest north of Silverymoon in the Silver Marches . By about 1460 DR , the Moonwood had grown together with the Cold Wood and the larger forest was known as the Glimmerwood , although the elves still referred to it as the Moonwood . Geography .

title: Mooshie ' s Grove
description: Mooshie ' s Grove Mooshie ' s Grove was the home of Montolio Debrouchee ( " Mooshie " ) and was a diamond - shaped grove of trees and piled stone walls in the Rauvin Mountains near the Coldwood . Structure . The grove featured elevated walkways and beautifully designed huts .

title: Mooshie ' s Longbow
description: Mooshie ' s Longbow Mooshie ' s longbow was a finely crafted longbow . It was given to Drizzt Do ' Urden by Montolio Debrouchee at the end of Drizzt ' s ranger training . Appearances .

title: Morada Topolino
description: Morada Topolino Morada Topolino was a mansion and assassin / thieves ' guild located in Delthuntle , Aglarond . Business . Morada Topolino was involved in much of the crime of Delthuntle .

title: Moradin
description: Moradin Moradin , pronounced ( " mor " - uh - din ) , was the lawful good god of the dwarves and the chief deity in their pantheon . A harsh but fair judge , he was strength and force of will embodied . Moradin inspired dwarven inventions and constantly sought to improve that race , encouraging their good nature , intelligence , and harmonious existence with other good races while battling their pride and isolationist tendencies .

title: Moradin ' s Vein
description: Moradin ' s Vein The Moradin ' s Vein , also called River of Gold , was a magical river of molten gold that flowed wherever the dwarven god Moradin willed it . The river was actually Moradin ' s lifeblood and could be used for magical travel . In 1480 DR , duergar from Drik Hargunen used rune magic to contaminate the river with the Stoneplague disease .

title: Morag
description: Morag Morag is the main antagonist in the original " Neverwinter Nights " campaign . Ten thousand years before the events of the campaign , Morag was a queen of the sarrukh , a powerful and cruel reptilian race from whom the present lizardfolk and yuan - ti are descended . At that time , the continent of Faerûn was a jungle , but after an ice age dawned upon Faerûn , the sarrukh were all but wiped out .

title: Morak Ur ' gray
description: Morak Ur ' gray Morak Ur ' gray was a innkeeper in Nightstone sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Morak managed an inn in the Nightstone village .

title: Moral
description: Moral Imam Moral was the High Priest of the Mosque of Bountiful Jisan in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Imam Moral oversaw over 200 priests of Jisan , clerical brethren , and laymen .

title: Moralist
description: Moralist Moralists or Clerics of the Faith Moral , were militant priests in Zakhara who served as the heart and fire of their church . Requirements . Moralists priests could be male or female of any race .

title: Moray
description: Moray Moray was the western most settlement of the Ffolk and the most wild of the southern Moonshae Isles . By 1479 DR the Black Blood Tribe of lycanthropes controlled most of the island . Notable Locations .

title: Morbeoth
description: Morbeoth Morbeoth was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Morbeoth was a proud and prickly individual .

title: Mordai Vell
description: Mordai Vell Mordai Vell was a tiefling and the leader of the Ashmadai cult in New Neverwinter . Personality . He was charming and manipulative and had a hand in many of the goings - on in Neverwinter .

title: Mordak Brelliar
description: Mordak Brelliar Mordak Brelliar is the current apprentice of First Lord Maalthiir , often serving the role as his most prolific agent . Mordak believes that the powers of Hillsfar should align with the Zhentarim , believing their combined power capable of reigning over the entire Moonsea . Appearance .

title: Mordenkainen
description: Mordenkainen Mordenkainen was a prolific archmage from the world of Oerth who was responsible for many powerful and useful spells . Description . His hair and beard were both long , black and peppered with grey streaks .

title: Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound
description: Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound Mordenkainen ' s faithful hound is a conjuration spell that summons a phantom dog for defense and attack . It was presumably developed by the mage Mordenkainen . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as faithful hound , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion
description: Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion Mordenkainen ' s magnificent mansion is a conjuration spell that creates a door leading to an extradimensional mansion . It is one of many spells presumably developed by the prolific Mordenkainen . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as magnificient mansion , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Mordoc SeLanmere
description: Mordoc SeLanmere Mordoc SeLanmere , also known as the Pale Knight or the White Prince , was the self - proclaimed first and utmost powerful vampire king in all of Toril . Mordoc was the disciple of Eldrith the Betrayer , he , however , was not a loyal servant to her . He did provide to her slaves and members for her army .

title: Mordoc Torsilley
description: Mordoc Torsilley Mordoc Torsilley was the captain of the elite Company of the White Dragon of the City Guard of Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . When the hordes of Myrkul invaded the city , he was ordered by Piergeiron to enlist the help of Khelben Arunsun and fight the undead .

title: Mordulkin
description: Mordulkin Mordulkin was a wealthy mage - ruled city - state on the Bay of Chessenta in Chessenta in the Old Empires . Geography . Mordulkin stood upon the eastern shore of the Bay of Chessenta , a short distance north of the polluted Jade River that flowed down out of the Riders to the Sky Mountains .

title: Morgalla
description: Morgalla Morgalla , known as Morgalla the Mirthful , was a dwarven entertainer from Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains . She was an artist specializing in satirical cartoons . Description .

title: Morgan Ildacer
description: Morgan Ildacer Morgan Ildacer was the aquatic elf captain of the High Mages ' guard in Sylkiir and a member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Morgan was an ill - tempered and over - arrogant elf .

title: Morganis Andropoea
description: Morganis Andropoea Morganis Andropoea was a medusa shopkeeper in Skullport . History . Morganis lived with her husband Holmyrr until , in 1340 DR , an adventuring party ambushed them and killed Holmyrr .

title: Morglon - Daar
description: Morglon - Daar Morglon - Daar was a city near the Blood Rift in the Abyss . History . For years , a human merchant Oroch controlled a portal which linked Scornubel to Morglon - Daar , but after disappearing on an adventure , Tarnrose , a drow wizard and her gang took up residence over the gateway .

title: Morgur ' s Mound
description: Morgur ' s Mound Morgur ' s Mound was the ancestor mound of the Thunderbeast tribe of the Uthgardt . It was believed to be the burial site of Morgur , Uthgar ' s mortal brother . Atop the mound was the skeleton of a long - dead dinosaur , known as a " thunderbeast " by the Uthgardt .

title: Morhion Gen ' dahar
description: Morhion Gen ' dahar Morhion Gen ' dahar was known to many as the greatest wizard in the city of Iriaebor . Appearance . Morhion was tall , regal and handsome , with a long mane of golden hair .

title: Moria Chantel
description: Moria Chantel Moria Chantel was an evil mage in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Moria Chantel had a practice of kidnapping travellers near Phantom Pass , for use in a ceremony that bestowed immortality on the mage . After hearing a haunting tale of this , the commander of the Legendary Campaign decided to deal with Moria .

title: Moriann Obarskyr
description: Moriann Obarskyr King Moriann Obarskyr was king of Cormyr before Tharyann Obarskyr . Moriann took the throne in 147 DR after the death of his father Irbruin and older brother Faerlthind . He and all of his heirs perished in a battle with goblin s from Hlundadim in 201 DR .

title: Morik the Rogue
description: Morik the Rogue Morik the Rogue is a friend of Wulfgar , living in the town of Luskan . He is nearly executed by the Luskan authorities for a crime not committed , the murder of Deudermont . Despite his small stature , Morik rose through the ranks of criminals on the streets of Luskan , eventually becoming feared and respected as both a thief and a fighter .

title: Morissa Thornion
description: Morissa Thornion Morissa Thornion was an archivist in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Morissa managed the Thornion archives in the city of Timindar .

title: Morista Malkin
description: Morista Malkin Morista Malkin was a scout and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Rage of Demons . History . Morista hailed from Luruar but responded to Bruenor ' s call to liberate Gauntlgrym from evil in 1485 DR .

title: Morkai the Red
description: Morkai the Red Morkai the Red was a powerful wizard and the guardian of the North Tower of the Host Tower of the Arcane in the seaport city of Luskan . He was murdered by his apprentice Akar Kessel on the command of Dendybar the Mottled and his associates in the Host Tower . Morkai the Red now dwells on the spirit plane .

title: Morkoth
description: Morkoth Morkoths were known as wraiths of the deep , a cruel and evil race of aquatic predators with hypnotic powers . Description . Early descriptions of morkoths were vague and suggested they were humanoid , but as these mysterious creatures got involved in the affairs of other races , a more accurate picture emerged .

title: Morligul Downdagger
description: Morligul Downdagger Morligul Downdagger was a wizard - for - hire in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Morligul together with his partner Scarmar Heldeth was searching around Lord Helderstone ' s rooms .

title: Morlith ( family )
description: Morlith ( family ) The Morlith family was a noble house of Gontal , and part of the Twelvefold . They held great political influence in Gontal , specially in Gontal City , were common folk believed the Twelvefold families held incontable treasures in their manors and vaults , and were the true power behind the throne . They controlled most of the commerce in Gontal , as well as many illegal activities .

title: Mornbryn ' s Shield
description: Mornbryn ' s Shield Mornbryn ' s Shield was a hamlet on the north bank of the River Surbrin and the Laughingflow . The hamlet was named for the ranger Mornbryn and its location — the village sat on a natural rampart enclosing the west and south sides of the settlement .

title: Morndin
description: Morndin The Morndin ( Son of Moradin , in Dwarvish ) were dwarves that , according to tradition , were reincarnated in members of other humanoid races after they died , in order to fulfill specific tasks Moradin could not entrust to a member of the dwarven races . Notable Members . The only known Morndin were members of Clan Ironstar .

title: Morndin Gloomstorm
description: Morndin Gloomstorm Morndin Gloomstorm was the high cleric of Laduguer in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR and 1372 DR History . Morndin was born to Clan Bukbukken , as the son of Kildor and blood of Balgor , in Shimmergloom ' s Run in Mithral Hall . Morndin lived under the shadow dragon Shimmergloom ' s rule until the shield dwarves of Clan Battlehammer reclaimed their ancestral home .

title: Morndinsamman
description: Morndinsamman Morndinsamman ( dwarven : " shield brothers on high " or " high dwarves " ) was the collective name of the fourteen deities that formed the dwarven pantheon . The members were : The majority of the Morndinsamman resided in Dwarfhome ( when it was still located on Mount Celestia ) under the leadership of Moradin , creator of the dwarves . Duerra and Laduguer lived in Hammergrim , having been exiled by Moradin .

title: Morning Halls
description: Morning Halls The Morning Halls was a temple to Lathander , the Morninglord , found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The Morning Halls lay in the northern part of the city , on Ember Lane .

title: Morning star
description: Morning star A morning star ( also " morningstar " ) is a simple , one - handed melee weapon , essentially a large , spiked club . Description . The morning star is very similar to a spiked club but with refinements .

title: Morningdawn Hall
description: Morningdawn Hall Even Lathander might blush at the ostentation of his temple in the town of Shadowdale . The building is a miracle of unbreakable rose - tinted glass blown into the shape of a giant phoenix facing west with outstretched wings greeting the dawn . Its wings become two great turrets which command a view of the surrounding area .

title: Morninggold
description: Morninggold Morninggold was the easternmost county of Tethyr , located within the Golden Marches . Geography . County Morninggold was located in the western foothills of the Kuldin Peaks and was bordered in the north and west by the Shining Stream and in the south by the Idolflow and its tributary , the Levast River .

title: Morninglark
description: Morninglark The Morninglark was a magical elven harp that could only be operated through spellsong . Description . The Morninglark a 20 - stringed harp was made of dark wood marked with carvings of elven origin .

title: Morninglord
description: Morninglord Morninglords , formerly known as morninglords of Lathander , are a priestly order of Faerûn . The morninglords of Amaunator and his aspect Lathander are among the Sun Lord ' s most elite priest s . They are dedicated to heal , advise , protect people and destroy the undead .

title: Morningmist Hall
description: Morningmist Hall Morningmist Hall was a temple to Lathander in Marsember , Cormyr . Inhabitants . It was led by High Morninglord Chansobal Dreen and was served by 16 priests and 12 other staff members .

title: Morningstar Hollows
description: Morningstar Hollows Morningstar Hollows used to be a quiet village until the continual flooding of the Alaoreum River caused its inhabitants to abandon it and move to nearby Velorn ' s Valor . The land where the village is situated is now very boggy and it is believed to be inhabited by around three dozen lizardfolk .

title: Morntel
description: Morntel Morntel was a merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Morntel was named after his father in Athkatla and inherited both his fortune and his membership of the Knights in 1356 DR .

title: Morntel the Elder
description: Morntel the Elder Morntel the Elder was a merchant of Amn and an ex - member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Morntel was a wealthy merchant in Athkatla , working for House Redolo .

title: Morok Ulgren
description: Morok Ulgren Morok Ulgren was an orc blacksmith in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . Activities . Morok was the most highly skilled orcish blacksmith in the entirety of Many - Arrows , making him the most prominent trade figure in the kingdom .

title: Mortal Consequences
description: Mortal Consequences Mortal Consequences is the third book in the Netheril trilogy by Clayton Emery . Summary . Sunbright has been banished long enough .

title: Morthil
description: Morthil Morthil was the recipient of one of Ithraides ' s telkiira . Later he become the Grand Mage of Yuireshanyaar becoming a key player in that kingdom for several centuries . He also founded a long - standing society of wizards known as the Seneirril Tathyrr , or the Mooncrescent Order

title: Mortick Swamp
description: Mortick Swamp The Mortick Swamp ( also spelled Mortik Swamp ) was the only swamp in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . The Mortick Swamp was located in southern Luiren , just to the southeast of Chethel .

title: Mortuth Baldreth
description: Mortuth Baldreth Mortuth Baldreth was a traveling merchant that dealt in wagons , wagon wheels , cart wheels , lanterns , and large tools such as pick s , woodcutting axe s , and shovels . Abilities . Mortuth was extremely strong and a specialist with the longsword .

title: Morueme ' s Cave
description: Morueme ' s Cave Morueme ' s Cave was the home of the blue dragon clan the Blood of Morueme located in the Nether Mountains . Geography . The cave was located on the edge of the Anauroch Desert on the mountain known as Dragondoom .

title: Morus Brokengulf II
description: Morus Brokengulf II Morus Brokengulf II was a paladin of the Knights of Samular in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Morus II was , from the age of 16 , a devoted paladin and Tyrran zealot , even cutting off his right hand in sacrifice to Tyr and soon joining the Knights of Samular .

title: Morvar
description: Morvar Morvar was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Morvar was located along the west bank of the River Lesh where it emptied into the Golden Water in eastern Durpar near the base of the Gryphon Mountains .

title: Morvian
description: Morvian Morvian was a magic al greatsword and one of the Baneblades of Demron . History . It was crafted by the archmage Demron before the fall of Myth Drannor , and was the third of his series of Baneblades .

title: Morwen Daggerford
description: Morwen Daggerford Morwen Daggerford was the sister of the duke of Daggerford around 1485 DR and later duke herself the following year . Activities . Morwen usually trained with the militia and paid regular visits to the shrine of Tempus .

title: Mosque of Beauteous Selan
description: Mosque of Beauteous Selan The Mosque of Beauteous Selan was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Blistering Atonement
description: Mosque of Blistering Atonement The Mosque of Blistering Atonement was located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Mosque of Blood
description: Mosque of Blood The Mosque of Blood was the second - most - noticeable feature of the Zakhara n city of Qudra . Location . This crimson - covered mosque was the largest temple in the entire Land of Fate used to worship the warrior - god Vataqatal .

title: Mosque of Bountiful Jisan
description: Mosque of Bountiful Jisan The Mosque of Bountiful Jisan was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Brave Hajama
description: Mosque of Brave Hajama The Mosque of Brave Hajama was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Free Haku
description: Mosque of Free Haku The Mosque of Free Haku was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest
description: Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest The Mosque of Hakiyah the Honest was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Kor the Old
description: Mosque of Kor the Old The Mosque of Kor the Old was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Kossuth
description: Mosque of Kossuth The Mosque of Kossuth was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Mosque of Najm the Adventurous
description: Mosque of Najm the Adventurous The Mosque of Najm the Adventurous was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of Zann the Wise
description: Mosque of Zann the Wise The Mosque of Zann the Wise was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . This temple could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Mosque of a Thousand Fountains
description: Mosque of a Thousand Fountains The Mosque of a Thousand Fountains was a temple dedicated to Zann found in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . The mosque actually straddled a large section of the city walls .

title: Mosque of the Irreducible
description: Mosque of the Irreducible The Mosque of the Irreducible was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . This mosque was found in the Furnace ward of the city . Description .

title: Mosque of the Revealed
description: Mosque of the Revealed The Mosque of the Revealed was a mosque dedicated to Najm in Liham , in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . Many citizens from Liham came to the mosque to blow off steam , verbally venting their frustration with any number of issues .

title: Mosque of the Thirsty Jann
description: Mosque of the Thirsty Jann The Mosque of the Thirsty Jann was a religious structure dedicated to the worship of Jarmik , a local god . Description . This small mosque was located along the Pilgrims ' Route between Zayir and Hilm .

title: Moss agate
description: Moss agate Moss agate was one of many forms of agate found in the " Realms " . Description . Impurities of formed grayish green fern - like patterns that resembled moss embedded in these pink to yellow - white semi - transparent or translucent ornamental stones .

title: Mossbridges
description: Mossbridges Mossbridges was a town in the Vast , lying where the Coast Road between Ravens Bluff and Tantras crossed the Fire River , over the bridge of the same name . Feldar ' s Trail began at Mossbridges and joined to Highbank Forest . History .

title: Mosstone
description: Mosstone Mosstone was a walled town in Tethyr on the Trade Way near the Wealdath forest that was known primarily as a caravan stop . The town was self - governing and residents reached decisions through consensus . History .

title: Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud
description: Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud The Most Solemn Order of the Silent Shroud was an organization of embalmers , gravediggers , and other cemetery workers and craftsfolk in service to the church of Kelemvor , Lord of the Dead . Membership in the Order was kept secret by the church . Those in the order identified each other with a number of secret signs .

title: Mother
description: Mother Mother was a monstrous spawn of Graz ' zt in Maerimydra . History . In 1491 DR Graz ' zt entrusted Mother to the derro of Ravagestone .

title: Mother Mauler
description: Mother Mauler The Mother Mauler was a unique infamous anaxim that roamed the Glaur Barrens of Gontal , in Returned Abeir . Description . The Mother Mauler was squat , squarish " mauler " - type anaxim , as big as a large shack .

title: Mother Millstone
description: Mother Millstone Mother Millstone was the highest - ranking priest of the Faceless God among the vile yak - folk of the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Mother Millstone oversaw the largest temple dedicated to the Faceless God .

title: Mother Tara
description: Mother Tara Mother Tara was a cheery halfling from the Vilhon Reach , who owned Mother Tara ' s Festhall in Shadowdale . Description . Tara had dark curly hair which was graying .

title: Mother Tara ' s Festhall
description: Mother Tara ' s Festhall Mother Tara ' s Festhall was a banquet hall in the town of Shadowdale . Geography . Located on the western side of the Shadowdale Trail , Mother Tara ' s Festhall was situated between Mane ' s Manor and Hammerhand Bucko ' s house .

title: Mother of pearl
description: Mother of pearl Mother of Pearl was the name in the Realms for small , cut and polished , trochus and turbo shells . Description . They were used for making buttons etc .

title: Motoharu Kaijitsu
description: Motoharu Kaijitsu Motoharu Kaijitsu was a ninja / yakuza adventurer in Kozakura in 1357 DR . and 1358 History . Kaijitsu was always able to balance his ninja life under the name Ito with his yakuza one , using the one to have an alibi for the other and vice versa .

title: Motsegai
description: Motsegai Motsegai was a shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Motsegai was the abbot at the Kanchai school monastery of Mount Ichi , where the former emperor Gobidamu retired to .

title: Mougra
description: Mougra Mougra was a goblin bandit in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Mougra and his companion Geeraugh were hidden in the Haunted Tomb of Red Larch waiting for a bandit raid .

title: Mount
description: Mount A mount is an creature that is used to transport another creature . Typically , mounts used by humanoids are large and can move much faster then the humanoid could on foot . The vast majority of mounts have only low , animal level intelligence , though some creatures of greater intelligence willing serve as mounts .

title: Mount ( spell )
description: Mount ( spell ) Mount , which was originally called Jarm ' s mount , was a summoning spell to conjure an equine to carry a rider . Effects . To within close range of the caster , this spell summoned a pony or light horse , which was willing an able to carry a rider .

title: Mount Abbalayat
description: Mount Abbalayat Mount Abbalayat was an isolated peak in the western Marching Mountains famous for being the home of the race of oracles called the Abbalaya r . Description . Abbalayat was an extremely steep mountain , with cliffs for lower slopes .

title: Mount Cormanda
description: Mount Cormanda Mount Cormanda was an active volcano located in southern Skelkor , Returned Abeir . History . When the Spellplague transported Returned Abeir to Toril , the demon lord Cormanda went to explore the new continent .

title: Mount Gommat
description: Mount Gommat Mount Gommat was the tallest peak in the Marching Mountains . It was the site of the famous Axemarch Stone . Description .

title: Mount Grimmerfang
description: Mount Grimmerfang The Hollow Mountain , later called Mount Grimmerfang was a mountain in the Vast in north Faerûn . It was the capital of both the orc kingdom of Vastar and the dwarf kingdom of Roldilar . History .

title: Mount Hazail
description: Mount Hazail Mount Hazail was the highest peak of the Gnollwatch Mountains in Dambrath . Description . Mount Hazail had an elevation of 11 , 500 ft .

title: Mount Hotenow
description: Mount Hotenow Mount Hotenow ( pronounced " HOE - teh - NOW " ) , was a volcano amid the Crags mountain range , situated to the northeast of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North , deep in Neverwinter Wood . It was home to a large population of fire elemental s , warming the Neverwinter River to the point where it never froze over , even in the heart of winter ( hence the city ' s name ) . The volcano also had a tendency to attract creatures like fire giant s and red dragon s to make their homes near it .

title: Mount Ieldroun
description: Mount Ieldroun Mount Ieldroun was one of the two tallest mountains east from the Moon Pass . History . The mountain peak was named for a long dead orc chieftain .

title: Mount Kahdas
description: Mount Kahdas Mount Kahdas was the second tallest peak in the Alimir Mountains . Description . Kahdas was one of the central Alimirs .

title: Mount Kus
description: Mount Kus Mount Kus was located in the Hordelands near the Katakoro Shan range . Geography . Situated on the western bank of the Jumpa River , Mount Kus stood above the city of Kushk where the Great Chain Bridge of Ra - Khati met the Old Iron Road .

title: Mount Phevos
description: Mount Phevos Mount Phevos was the tallest peak in the Alimir Mountains . Description . Mt .

title: Mount Sarengard
description: Mount Sarengard Mount Sarengard was one of the tallest peaks in the eastern Marching Mountains . It was the location of the holiest site to Vhaeraun . Description .

title: Mount Sklagarra
description: Mount Sklagarra Mount Sklagarra was a peak in the Troll Mountains of Amn where the Heralds maintained their secret headquarters . It was east of the Smokespire volcano in the far west of the mountain range . The mountain contained a vast underground lake with an island in the center surrounded by a large complex of caverns known as the Swordmere .

title: Mount Speartop
description: Mount Speartop Mount Speartop was the tallest mountain of the Cloud Peaks . Description . Mount Speartop was located near the coast on the southwestern corner of the Cloud Peaks .

title: Mount Talath ( town )
description: Mount Talath ( town ) Mount Talath was a small town located near the summit of the mountain with the same name in Halruaa . It was little more than a collection of homes for the staff and priests who worked within the High Temple of Mystra built into the mountains slopes .

title: Mount Thalagbror
description: Mount Thalagbror Mount Thalagbror was a mountain in Archendale . Geography . The mountain was the starting point for the River Arkhen in the Thunder Peaks .

title: Mount Thargill
description: Mount Thargill Mount Thargill was an extinct volcano and the easternmost peak of the Starspire Mountains in Tethyr . The ancient lava tube of Mt . Thargill was known as the Wyrmwell .

title: Mount Thorog
description: Mount Thorog Mount Thorog was one of the two tallest mountains east from the Moon Pass . History . The mountain peak was named after a deceased orc chieftain .

title: Mount Tolzrin
description: Mount Tolzrin Mount Tolzrin was a mountain located in the Rauvin Mountains . Geography . The mountian was located near Mount Jaws , just west of Faerang ' s Doom .

title: Mount Turbold
description: Mount Turbold Mount Turbold was a mountain in the Kuldin Peaks of Erlkazar . History . Long before the kingdom of Erlkazar came into existence , an ancient battle between giant s and dwarves from Shanatar took place on this mountain and in the valley to the north .

title: Mount Ulaarn
description: Mount Ulaarn Mount Ulaarn was a peak in the central Alimir Mountains . Description . This mountain was located in the central Alimirs between Mounts Kahdas and Phevos .

title: Mount Waterdeep
description: Mount Waterdeep Mount Waterdeep was the name of the mountain on and around which the city of Waterdeep was built . It was a rough , rocky mountain and stood some 1 , 500 feet ( 457m ) above the sea level , to the west of the city . Beneath the mountain was the notorious Undermountain .

title: Mount Wolf
description: Mount Wolf Mount Wolf was a mountain in the Vast in north Faerûn . It lay in the Giantspike Mountains , by the Earthspur Mountains , and towered over the North Road , south of Maskyr ' s Eye . It marked the proper border of the lands of the Vast .

title: Mount Zatal
description: Mount Zatal Mount Zatal was Zaltec ' s sacred mountain in Maztica . A volcanic mountain , it overlooked the now ruined city of Nexal . The Ancient Ones manipulated the priests of Zaltec from the sacred Highcave on top of the mountain .

title: Mount of Forgiveness
description: Mount of Forgiveness The Mount of Forgiveness was a necropolis located in Muluk , the City of Kings , in 1367 DR . Description . Located just outside of the walls on the southeast side of the city , this artificial mount was covered with artistic tombs and sepulchers .

title: Mountain Crusher
description: Mountain Crusher Mountain Crusher was a + 5 composite longbow belonging to Tavis Burdun , the First Defender of Hartsvale . Tavis was a firbolg and his weapon was reinforced with the rune - etched ribs of a glacier bear , allowing him to use his incredible strength to best effect without risking snapping the weapon .

title: Mountain Prince
description: Mountain Prince The Mountain Prince was a skilled yikarian warrior inhabiting the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Description . The Mountain Prince carried scars from his many battles .

title: Mountain circle
description: Mountain circle The mountain circle was a druid circle associated with grand terrain that reached for the sky . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Mountain giant
description: Mountain giant Mountain giants were a breed of brutish giant s given to acts of cruelty . Description . Often living to be 100 years old , mountain giants resembled hill giants , standing over fourteen feet ( four meters ) tall , and weighing over 1 , 000 pounds ( 500 kilograms ) .

title: Mountain of Iron
description: Mountain of Iron The Mountain of Iron was located in the far northern reaches of the Hordelands near the western fringes of the Ama Basin . Geography . The Mountain of Iron was part of the Ulhai Shan range .

title: Mountain orc
description: Mountain orc The mountain orcs of the North and the Spine of the World comprise the oldest and most numerous of the various orc subraces active on Faerûn . In fact , many people assume that all orcs are like the savage warmongers found in these regions , and do not identify gray orcs or even half - orcs as separate races . Physical description .

title: Mountains of Copper
description: Mountains of Copper The Mountains of Copper were a mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . The Mountains of Copper were a small mountain rage that formed the northern border of Murghôm , and were known for the large amount of copper ore found within .

title: Mountains of Forgotten Dreams
description: Mountains of Forgotten Dreams The Mountains of Forgotten Dreams were located southeast of the Genies ' Anvil within the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . This mountain range boasted peaks as high as 5 , 000 ft .

title: Mountains of the Alaoreum
description: Mountains of the Alaoreum The Alaoreum were a collection of northern peaks in the Orsraun Mountains set apart from the rest of the range by Treefall Pass . The peaks overlooked the Gulthmere Forest . The Mountains of the Alaoreum were notable for containing the volcano Mount Andrus , which was sacred to the god Talos , and the dwarven mine of Ironfang Deep .

title: Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue
description: Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue The Mountains of Lizard ' s Tongue was a prominent geographical feature of West Zakhara , fully dominating the landscape in the northwest region of the High Desert . Geography . The mountain range stretched for hundreds of miles across this region of the Land of Fate , running northeast to southwest .

title: Mountainside
description: Mountainside Mountainside was a district in Waterdeep located on the eastern and southeastern slope of Mount Waterdeep . History . Mountainside was settled in the 15th century DR by the rich and up - and - coming , who were attempting to avoid the Second Pestilars by rising above the masses and seeking cleaner air .

title: Mourel Duskwalker
description: Mourel Duskwalker Mourel Duskwalker was a Star elf wizard who was corrupt and hungry for power . From his citadel of glass Tir ' in ' tiral in the demi - plane of Sildëyuir , Mourel marshalled evil forces to conquer the Star elves but was eventually defeated . He was interred in Tir ' in ' tiral and it , plus all of the towers connecting it were cut off from Sildëyuir to become a separate Demi - Plane known as the Night Realm and eventually relegated tales of " The Duskwalker " to stories for frightening children .

title: Mourmyd Jacerryl
description: Mourmyd Jacerryl Mourmyd Jacerryl was a pirate in the Sea of Fallen Stars loyal to Evendur Highcastle during the Second Sundering . History . In 1486 DR , under orders from Evendur , Mourmyd took his ship , the " Octopus " , out in search of the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .

title: Mourner ' s armor
description: Mourner ' s armor Mourner ' s armor was a form of magical lamellar armor that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , and was created by a great ghul sha ' ir . Description . The black plates of this armor were often decorated with bright colors .

title: Mourngrym Amcathra
description: Mourngrym Amcathra Mourngrym Amcathra was the lord of Shadowdale from 1353 DR until 1375 DR . Appearance . Mourngrym was a 6 ' 4 " ( 1 .

title: Mouth of Song
description: Mouth of Song The Mouth of Song was a small shrine to Eilistraee located in the south central portion of the Moonwood , approximately a day ' s travel north of Quaervarr . Geography . The shrine was located in a cave mouth beneath a treeless hill , atop which the dark elven worshipers and a few half - elven and elven faithful from Silverymoon danced in a great ring on moonlit nights .

title: Move dune
description: Move dune Move dune was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to lift and move a large heap of sand , dust , or gravel .

title: Move earth
description: Move earth Move earth is a transmutation spell that digs trenches and builds hills . Effects . " Move earth " moves dirt ( clay , loam , sand ) , possibly collapsing embankments , moving hillocks , shifting dunes , etc .

title: Move sand
description: Move sand Move sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Mozah
description: Mozah Mozah was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Mozah was a villager who tasked an adventurer to get him some money .

title: Mozgriken
description: Mozgriken A mozgriken was the result of an illithid tadpole being inserted into a svirfneblin gnome and then subjected to a dangerous psionic ritual . The ritual involved channeling energy straight from the Plane of Shadow into the ceremorph , as svirfneblin implantation normally means both the svirfneblin and the larvae die . These three - tentacled ceremorphs were despised by the svirfneblin , owing to the hatred they had for the brain - eating illithids , and also by the illithids , because of their imperfections .

title: Mreeiel Klintar
description: Mreeiel Klintar Mreeiel Klintar was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , Chyndrie Stormwind , and Noelin Tlestlin .

title: Mreskan Haundle
description: Mreskan Haundle Mreskan Haundle was the seneschal of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Description . Mreskan was an old but kind man .

title: Mreyelundar
description: Mreyelundar Mreyelundar was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . It was the most decadent of all the Dusk Ports . Background .

title: Mrinabnahor
description: Mrinabnahor Mrinabnahor was a black dragon who laired in the mountains west of the Moonsea . In 590 DR , he battled and killed Arms - Major Pirphal of Myth Drannor , along with most of his patrol . Pirphal ' s sword , " Dragathil " , was added to Mrinabnahor ' s hoard and remained lost for the next four centuries .

title: Mrinden
description: Mrinden Mrinden was a minor Zhentarim wizard in High Dale . History . Mrinden fought with his companion Kalassyn in Daggerdale .

title: Mu ' izzi al - Kamar
description: Mu ' izzi al - Kamar Mu ' izzi al - Kamar was the head of the House of Al - Kamari in 1367 DR . Activities . As of 1367 , Mu ' izzi had been the head of the family for two decades .

title: Mu Tong
description: Mu Tong Mu Tong was a village in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay near the headwaters of the Malu River , high in the Sillan Mountains . Jade was discovered near Mu Tong in 1357 DR .

title: Muaraghal Mountains
description: Muaraghal Mountains The Muaraghal Mountains were a range of mountains in the Shining South that formed the eastern border of Halruaa . Geography . This mountain ranged formed the eastern border of Halruaa , offering natural protection .

title: Mucknuggle
description: Mucknuggle Mucknuggle was an elderly duergar who worked in Mithral Hall , during the reign of Haerinvureem . Description . The dwarf had a long gray beard .

title: Mud armor
description: Mud armor Mud armor armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Mud armor is a crude form of armor made from drying mud on the skin of the wearer .

title: Mudflow
description: Mudflow The Mudflows were strange rivers of warm mud that were more common in the eastern and southern regions of the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . The mudflows released dangerous gases that caused dizziness or , with prolonged exposure , even death .

title: Muhjari
description: Muhjari Muhjari was a set of faith - based laws followed by many in Semphar and surrounding lands . These laws promoted the idea that activities such as drinking , gambling , sexual proclivity and other vices were sinful and should be avoided . Adherence to these laws was most common among the poor but enforcement varied from place to place .

title: Mujibur
description: Mujibur Mujibur was tasked slayer genie who lived within the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar in 1367 DR . Activities . Muhibur served Nar - Aidiya and the Brotherhood of the True Flame guarding and tending the Great Garden of the fortress .

title: Muki Nobi
description: Muki Nobi Muki Nobi was the daimyo of Chozawa around 1357 DR . History . Muki was the son of Toyo Nobi , a key military advisor and the close personal friend of shogun Matasuuri Nagahide ' s father .

title: Mukteff
description: Mukteff A mukteff was a rare breed of sled dog native to Nakvaligach , in the Great Glacier . Description . Like all sled dogs , mukteff had short snouts and bright eyes .

title: Mulahey
description: Mulahey Mulahey was a half - orc cleric of Cyric who was sent by Tazok to sabotage the Nashkel mines on behalf of Sarevok and the Iron Throne . He set up his headquarters below the third level of the mine , and started sending kobold minions up to poison the iron from the mine with mineral poison provided by his superiors , helping to orchestrate an iron shortage the Iron Throne would take advantage of . Against orders given to Tazok , the kobolds took to attacking and killing the miners , though Mulahey still remained undetected for a time , hidden so deep down few dared to venture there .

title: Mulahid
description: Mulahid Mulahid was an efreeti of Zakharan folklore . History . Mulahid fell in love with the Grandmother of the Everlasting — a woman said to be so fierce that even lion s would get out of her way .

title: Mulan
description: Mulan The Mulan were a human ethnic group non - native to Toril . Appearance . Mulan were typically tall and thin with a sallow skin tone and brown or hazel eyes .

title: Mulani languages
description: Mulani languages The Mulani languages group was one of the two major branches of the Rauric languages family and included languages spoken in East Faerûn by the Mulan people . Subgroups . The Mulani languages were further subdivided into the Mulhorandi and Muhjuri branches .

title: Mulcaster Emmarask
description: Mulcaster Emmarask Mulcaster Emmarask was a noble in Cormyr and a lord of Emmarask noble family . History . Around 1479 DR , at the start of the Council of the Dragon , Mulcaster proposed a plan for an eleven - person council , comprised entirely of members of old families like the Illance s and the Emmarasks .

title: Muldiver
description: Muldiver Muldiver was a master shipwright of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Muldiver worked out of a shipyard in Tantras ' s harbor . During the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR , Muldiver was kept very busy with the city ' s preparations for war against Zhentil Keep .

title: Mule
description: Mule Mules were pack animals specifically bred for labor . They were a cross between horse s and donkey s , intended to share the best traits of both animals . They were more sure - footed , hardy , and longer - lived than horses , and faster and more intelligent than donkeys .

title: Mulgor
description: Mulgor Mulgor of Tyr was a diligent yet patient tax collector within the city of Waterdeep as well as a member of the City Watch . He also served in ceremonies at the temple of Tyr known as the Halls of Justice and could occasionally be found at the Elfstone Tavern .

title: Mulhorand
description: Mulhorand Mulhorand ( muhl - HOH - rand ) was one of the Old Empires in eastern Faerûn . The Mulhorandi were brought to Toril from Earth by the Imaskar Empire looking for some manpower . After countless praises , Ao contacted Ptah who led a part of the Mulhorandi pantheon to Toril .

title: Mulhorandi language
description: Mulhorandi language Mulhorandi was a regional tongue of East Faerûn , and the official language of Mulhorand and Thay . Other regions where it was commonly spoken include Murghôm , Semphar , and Chessenta . In most areas where Mulhorandi was spoken , it used the Celestial alphabet ; however , Thay used the Infernal alphabet instead .

title: Mulhorandi languages
description: Mulhorandi languages The Mulhorandi languages were a sub - grouping of the Mulani languages and members of the Rauric languages family . Languages . This sub - grouping included the tightly related languages Mulhorandi and Thayan .

title: Mulhorandi pantheon
description: Mulhorandi pantheon The Mulhorandi pantheon consisted of the deities worshiped in Mulhorand . Their domain was Heliopolis . When the Imaskar i captured the Mulan people and brought them to Toril , the slaves also brought the worship of their deities .

title: Mullivan
description: Mullivan Mullivan was a former adventurer and mind - thrall in Oryndoll in 1370 DR . History . Mullivan was a ranger and leader of an adventuring party from Almraiven .

title: Mulmaster
description: Mulmaster Mulmaster was a city located in the rugged area west of the Earthspur and Galena Mountains in the eastern part of the Moonsea region . After years of opposition , the city finally joined the Zhentarim , becoming a decadent sprawl riddled with crime and corruption . The buildings nearest the docks were the most dilapidated and dangerous , full of poverty and rife with crime .

title: Mulmaster Beholder Corps
description: Mulmaster Beholder Corps The Mulmaster Beholder Corps were a group of beholder s in Mulmaster . History . All started circa 1384 DR when an eye tyrant clan ship crash - landed into a deep ravine in the Dragonspine Mountains .

title: Muln Horan
description: Muln Horan Muln Horan was a dwarf soldier in Neverwinter . Activities . Muln was a top advisor to General Sabine , and remained in control of a part of the city when the general was busy in other places .

title: Mulnis Lenz
description: Mulnis Lenz Mulnis Lenz was a caravan leader and warehouse owner in 1359 DR . History . In 1359 Mulnis led a caravan from Waterdeep to Cormyr with a stop in Teziir .

title: Mulsantir
description: Mulsantir Mulsantir was a large city in southwest Rashemen . It was located on the northern shore of the River Mulsantir , just west of Lake Mulsantir . History .

title: Mulser
description: Mulser Mulser was a male warrior and a member of the Zhentilar in High Dale . History . In 1358 DR , Mulser was part of a secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .

title: Multon Weny
description: Multon Weny Multon Weny was a magic - user in Hades in 1358 DR . History . Around 1358 Multon went in Hades in search of his brother Drado Weny but like his brother was enslaved by the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .

title: Muluk
description: Muluk Muluk , located on the mouth of Al - Zalim River , was one of the Free Cities of Zakhara . Renowned as a trading city , Muluk specialized in many goods including regal purple dye . Its established unbroken line of rulers gave it the name " City of Kings " .

title: Mummy
description: Mummy A mummy is an undead creature , usually of lawful evil alignment , created from a preserved corpse that have been animated by the dark gods of the desert . These horrid creatures are often marked with symbols of the dire gods they serve . While other undead often stink of carrion , the herbs and powders used to create a mummy give off a sharp , pungent odor like that of a spice cabinet .

title: Mummy rot
description: Mummy rot Mummy rot was a condition inflicted upon victims by the touch of a mummy . It was usually fatal unless cured . Mummy rot was a disease that occurred in various strains and could be natural or magical ( like a curse ) in nature , which required different methods to cure .

title: Mummy touch
description: Mummy touch Mummy touch was a necromancy spell that gave the caster temporary immunity to mummy rot and imbued him or her with a mummy ' s ability to inflict the disease on others by touch . Effects . " Mummy touch " lasted one minute per experience level of the caster .

title: Munaa el Tarshaj
description: Munaa el Tarshaj Munaa yr Shunnari el Tarshaj was the fifth daughter of Syl - Pasha Kadar el Tarshaj of Calimport . She became the second wife of Akkabar Shoon the Elder on Midsummer of −78 DR . As a wedding gift , her father made Akkabar the Elder the Syl - Vizar and ruler of Memnon .

title: Muni - Ku
description: Muni - Ku Muni - Ku was a elder storyteller in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Once Muni - Ku was a cook in service of of the daimyo of Tifuido like her mother and her grandmother .

title: Mur ' i bint Fatima
description: Mur ' i bint Fatima Mur ' i bint Fatima was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Mur ' i was responsible for collecting taxes from caravans and merchants passing through the Gate of Wealth .

title: Mur - zhagul
description: Mur - zhagul The Mur - zhagul ( or demon trolls ) are planetouched creatures descended from the cross - breeding of trolls and demon s . Description . Mur - zhagul appear as normal trolls in posture and shape .

title: Muradi Lighthouse
description: Muradi Lighthouse The Muradi Lighthouse was a lighthouse standing at the very southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo in the 14th century DR . History . In 1308 DR , Bosturo came to be the Master of the Muradi Lighthouse .

title: Muragh Brilstagg
description: Muragh Brilstagg Muragh Brilstagg was a former cleric of Lathander in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . Muragh in life was a very pretentious and critical person so a wizard , exasperated by him , curse d him : his soul never went to the Fugue Plane after his death but remained in his body .

title: Murann
description: Murann Murann , known as the Sailors ' City , was a port city and the second - largest city of Amn . Geography . Murann was located in Tarseth Bay along the Sea of Swords .

title: Muranndin
description: Muranndin Muranndin was a kingdom in the Lands of Intrigue in western Faerûn . Geography . The monster kingdom of Muranndin bordered Amn in the north via the Small Teeth Mountains , Tethyr ' s northern Wealdath forest in the east , and west with the Dragon ' s Head peninsula .

title: Murdane
description: Murdane Murdane was a lesser deity of pragmatism and reason . Relationships . She was the lover of Helm the Watcher , god of guardians .

title: Muren Khi
description: Muren Khi The Muren Khi , meaning River of Earth , was a river in the Hordelands . Description . Beginning at the Nor Yudol lake in the Katakoro Plateau , and flowing east into Shou Lung , the Muren Khi formed the lower half of the Muren Tso river .

title: Muren Tso
description: Muren Tso The Muren Tso , or the River of the Sky , was a river in the Hordelands . Description . Fed by glaciers in the Katakoro Shan and A - Ling Shan mountain ranges , the Muren Tso river flowed across the Katakoro Plateau until it reached the Nor Yudol lake , continuing on as the Muren Khi .

title: Murghôm
description: Murghôm Prior to the spellplague , Murghôm was an inland nation of farmers and horsemen in East Faerûn north of Brightstar Lake . It was theoretically a subjugated territory of Mulhorand . Inhabitants are referred to as Murghômi ; their second largest city is Phannaskul with another major town being the heavily militarized Port Ghaast .

title: Murial
description: Murial Murial " the Misshapen " was an apprentice of Halaster Blackcloak , the Mad Mage of Undermountain . A capable fighter in his youth , Murial was recruited by Halaster as bodyguard but soon he started studied under Halaster and learned to magically graft materials together . When Halaster broke off all contact he descended into madness , grafting his torso unto the body of a giant scorpion to better engage in combat .

title: Muriel
description: Muriel Muriel was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Muriel and some other monks were kidnapped by cultists of the Cult of the Howling Hatred , who planned to use them in a new plot to access an elemental node .

title: Murkolk Szolt
description: Murkolk Szolt Murkolk Szolt was the main duergar delegate in Mantol - Derith in 1372 DR . History . Murkolk become the representative of Gracklstugh in 1371 DR after his predecessor Gradoc Rockhand was thrown into the Darklake for his use of a " thought medallion " .

title: Murmur
description: Murmur Murmur was a demon who was leader of the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye . He was able to turn nightmares into flesh and blood and was also capable of possessing people when they slept . He possessed one of the officers of the Firestorm Cabal and use her to recruit members of the cabal into the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye .

title: Murssvayas Dhuurniv
description: Murssvayas Dhuurniv Murssvayas Dhuurniv was a drow wizard and a former member of House Dhuurniv in Szith Morcane . History . In 1491 DR , his home was besieged by demon s and their fire giant minions from Maerimydra .

title: Mus
description: Mus Mus was an ogre mage living on Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He was the head of a family of ogre mages . Activities .

title: Musanna
description: Musanna Musanna was an aquatic elf warrior - priestess in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . In 1491 DR , Musanna led a patrol of her fellows in order to rescue her prince , Ulatha Mesavir , who had been kidnapped by the Cult of the Crushing Wave .

title: Mushakoji Nariakira
description: Mushakoji Nariakira Mushakoji Nariakira was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and the jito of Miki in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Miki , a large fishing village that had recently grown significantly , he led a company of ten samurai and thirty bushi .

title: Mushigoto Tada
description: Mushigoto Tada Mushigoto Tada was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Mushigoto Tada was the shoya of the village of Sokijan in Fochu Peninsula .

title: Music of the spheres
description: Music of the spheres Music of the spheres was an enchantment spell that could prevent creatures from attacking the caster and make them more susceptible to other charms . Effects . Using a set of small silver bows , the magic of this spell produced heavenly music with such intricate harmonies and complex textures that the listeners were entranced with respect to the caster .

title: Musil al - Samik
description: Musil al - Samik Musil al - Samik was a broker who lived in the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Musil acquired fabulous manors for wealthy pilgrims who traveled to Huzuz .

title: Mussum
description: Mussum Mussum was an abandoned city in Chondath , lying on the southeast shore of the Vilhon Reach . It was a plague - ridden ruin , but also home to the House of Holy Suffering , a major temple to Ilmater . History .

title: Mustapha
description: Mustapha Mustapha was human physician inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Mustapha was a secretive individual .

title: Musukosan no Hashi
description: Musukosan no Hashi Musukosan no Hashi was one of the most powerful yakuza crime lords in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Hashi ' s gang operated in the Miyama capital of Tamanokuni , especially in the Bridge District .

title: Mutamin
description: Mutamin Mutamin was a gnome mage , possibly mad , who resided in an area known as Mutamin ' s Garden north of the halfling village of Gullykin . Activities . The gnome had trained the local basilisk population to attack and petrify wandering humanoids , but not to eat them , as Mutamin wanted to keep the statues of their victims as " art " .

title: Mutamin ( NWN )
description: Mutamin ( NWN ) Mutamin was a retired adventurer who , using his funds left over from adventuring , built the Green Griffon Inn on the road just south of Luskan . Mutamin kept some unusual clientelle , but kept something even stranger underneath his tavern . He had gathered several monsters , extraplanar creatures and undead and placed them in a dungeon of his own devising , built underneath the inn and charged adventurers 500 gold pieces to try and overcome what was known as ' Mutamin ' s Challenge ' in an effort to earn themselves a full half of all the gold Mutamin earned during his adventuring career .

title: Muthoth
description: Muthoth Muthoth is a Red Wizard of Necromancy and follower of the lich Szass Tam . Appearance . Muthoth has sharp , haughty features .

title: My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars
description: My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars was a book written by Nelve Harssad of Tsurlagol . It detailed the author ' s experiences while traveling on the Sea of Fallen Stars , and provided a great deal of lore about the area . It was written in the Year of the Sword and Stars , 1332 DR .

title: Myconid
description: Myconid Myconids , or " Fungus men , " are insidious fungal menaces from the Feywild caverns polluted by the fomorian s . Myconids strive only to spread across their territories , contaminating those places with its presence . The Oasis of the Stone King , where Drizzt Do ' Urden once dwelt , was home to a small community of myconids .

title: Mycontil
description: Mycontil Mycontil was an archmage who lived in Halruaa during ages past . Activities . Mycontil oversaw the destruction of a large group of barbarian invaders from Dambrath , valiantly giving his life to defend Halruaa against the enemy .

title: Mycontil ' s last resort
description: Mycontil ' s last resort Mycontil ' s last resort was a spell unique to Halruaa . History . This spell was rumored to by used by Mycontil himself during his final stand against the Dambraii invaders .

title: Mydianchlarus
description: Mydianchlarus Mydianchlarus was briefly the Oinoloth , ruler of the Wasting Tower of Khin - Oin . History . Mydianchlarus overthrew its predecessor , Anthraxus , at some point between 1357 DR and 1369 DR not through violence , but by Mydianchlarus whispering a secret in Anthraxus ' s ear so profound and disturbing that he was compelled to leave Khin - Oin and move on .

title: Myir
description: Myir The Myir were a tribe of people living in the town of Nathoud between Rashemen and the Hordelands . Activities . Famed for their prized Nathoudi stallion s , the Myir were not known for anything other than horse - breeding .

title: Mykaro
description: Mykaro Mykaro , also known as , was a massive gemstone found in many hues as crystals or as crusts up to 2 in ( 5 cm ) thick in rock cavities . Description . These semi - precious stones were soft and durable when found as a crust , but brittle in crystal form .

title: Mykros
description: Mykros Mykros was the commander of the army of Arcata in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Mykros was the right - hand man of Duke William Horgath .

title: Mynda Idogyr
description: Mynda Idogyr Lady Mynda Idogyr was the wife of Lord Gamalon Idogyr , the Count of Spellshire in Tethyr . Activities . Because Gamalon was often busy at Faerntarn , the royal palace of Tethyr , Mynda controlled much of the administration of Spellshire .

title: Myndlar
description: Myndlar Myndlar was a monk of Candlekeep . History . Myndlar hailed from Athkatla but settled in Candlekeep .

title: Mynteer
description: Mynteer Mynteer , also known as , was a hard , clear , and rare gemstone found in the Realms . Description . These semi - precious stones occurred in crystals , usually with inclusions so that it yielded only small gems .

title: Myratma
description: Myratma Myratma was one of the most important cities in Tethyr , known around Faerûn for the quality of its textiles , owing to the output from the Tethyr Mills outside its walls . It was once called Artrimmar . Geography and Layout .

title: Myrddin Viligoth
description: Myrddin Viligoth Myrddin Viligoth was a former Red Wizards of Thay , now fighting for the good of Damara at the behest of god Ilmater History . Myrddin born in Thay with attitude to magic ; like all similar gifted children of that land he was enrolled in the tower of a Red Wizard to learn all about magic . He was a good student and become a powerful wizard in time ; but his heart was not filled with evil like all his fellow red wizards .

title: Myrian Beechwood
description: Myrian Beechwood Myrian Beechwood was the provisional lord of Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Myrian needed to subject most of his actions to the Parliament of Advisors , composed of representatives of the occupying powers .

title: Myrin Darkdance
description: Myrin Darkdance Myrin Darkdance , whose birth name was Maerlyn , was a young spellscar red human wizard originally from Westgate . Myrin ' s father was a half - drow and her mother was of Mulhorandi descent . Abilities .

title: Myrineyl Baenre
description: Myrineyl Baenre Myrineyl Baenre was the First Priestess of House Baenre circa 1484 DR . Personality . Myrineyl had been groomed from infancy to rule .

title: Myrkul
description: Myrkul Myrkul , also known as the Lord of Bones , was one of the Dead Three and " the god of the dead " , as opposed to " the god of murder " , which was the province of Bhaal or " the god of death " which was Kelemvor . His portfolio , and his home , the Bone Castle , were both usurped by Cyric after the Lord of Bones was destroyed atop Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles by Midnight . Later Myrkul ' s portfolio passed to Kelemvor when Cyric was driven from the City of Strife by an alliance of deities and denizens .

title: Myrkul ' s Wrath
description: Myrkul ' s Wrath Myrkul ' s Wrath was a powerful scythe with various magic properties . Crafting . To craft " Myrkul ' s Wrath " , one had to have a broken scythe from Myrkul ' s vault and the essence of the dead god ' s soul .

title: Myrkyssa Jelan
description: Myrkyssa Jelan Myrkyssa Jelan was a regional warlord and not much was known about her except that she was female , extremely ambitious , had multiple identities , and threatened the city of Ravens Bluff twice between the years of 1337 and 1347 DR . Her first attempt , using diverse forces such as orc s , ogre s , and giant s , as well as mercenary companies , failed largely because of the caliber of citizens inhabiting Ravens Bluff . Her army went down in defeat at the Battle of Fire River , and she disappeared , not appearing again until two years later .

title: Myrlochar
description: Myrlochar The Myrlochar , also known as a soul spider , was a demon creature of Lolth . Description . The monstrous myrlochars resembled giant brown - green spiders with a round body with eight legs and a fiendish head with eight red eyes .

title: Myrmeen Lhal
description: Myrmeen Lhal Myrmeen Lhal was the Lady Lord of the Cormyrean city of Arabel , a skilled ranger , and revered member of the Moonstars . History . Myrmeen was born in a poor section of Calimport into a life of obscurity .

title: Myrmith Splendon
description: Myrmith Splendon Myrmith Splendon was a fighter in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Activities . Myrmith acted as a " captain - at - arms " , a kind of tutor to fighters , teaching bladed weapons and polearms .

title: Myrmyr
description: Myrmyr Myrmyr was a small city in Var the Golden in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Myrmyr was located near the western coast of the " mouth " of the Golden Water .

title: Myrra
description: Myrra Myrra was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Myrra was extremely cruel and liked to toy with her opponents even when she was losing .

title: Myrthos Shyllantham
description: Myrthos Shyllantham Myrthos Shyllantham was a member of the Harpers who petitioned High Lady Alustriel Silverhand to restore the Foclucan bard college . History . Around 1370 DR , Shyllantham saw the rise in influence of the New Olamn bards ' college in Waterdeep and wanted to spread the knowledge to Silverymoon .

title: Myshik Morueme
description: Myshik Morueme Myshik Morueme was half – blue dragon half - hobgoblin and a member of Clan Morueme . Description . Myshik had blue leathery wings with which he could glide but not fly .

title: Mystic
