description: Mystic Mystics were a special kind of priest found mainly in the rural and wilder areas of the Realms . Typically , only human s , halfling s , elves , and half - elves chose to become mystics . These clergy had great personal charisma and above average wisdom and intelligence with a strong individualistic streak that caused them to shun structure and order in favor of finding their own path to enlightenment , and helping others find theirs .

title: Mystic ( Zakhara )
description: Mystic ( Zakhara ) Mystics were bizarre priests in Zakhara whose powers were rumored to move both men and mountains . Mystics often gained spiritual awareness or revelations through dance , meditation , or other eccentric means . Requirements .

title: Mystic of Nog
description: Mystic of Nog Mystics of Nog , or Nogian mystics , were special wizard s in Zakhara who learned to master the art of storing magical energy within their bodies . History . The art these wizards practiced was perfected in the ancient empire of Nog .

title: Mystic theurge
description: Mystic theurge Mystic theurges blurred the line between divine and arcane , drawing power from divine sources and ancient tomes alike . While most spellcasters chose one path to magical power , mystic theurges were able to simultaneously master spells common to clerics and wizards . Mystic theurges tended to be fascinated with magic in whatever form it took .

title: Mystic transfer
description: Mystic transfer Mystic transfer was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to receive the effect of a cast spell from another priest of the same religion and redirect it , thus greatly extending the range of the transferred spell . Effects . " Mystic transfer " took one minute to cast and for the next nine minutes the caster could be the target of spells from one or more priests of the same religion .

title: Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam
description: Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam The Mystical Legate of the Hidden Imam was the title given to the efreeti priest who oversaw the temples to Agni , Imix , Kossuth , Freyal , Surtr , and Hastsezini . All of these temples were located near the Charcoal Palace within the City of Brass . The Legate was protected by his own contingent of elite soldiers called the Guardians of the Three Fires .

title: Mystra
description: Mystra Mystra ( pronounced " MISS - trah " ) , the Mother of all Magic , was a greater deity and the second incarnation of the goddess of magic after her predecessor Mystryl sacrificed herself to protect the Weave from Karsus ' s Folly . Mystra was destroyed by Helm when she defied the will of Ao the overgod and attempted to leave the Prime Material Plane during the Time of Troubles . At the conclusion of the Godswar , Ao offered the position of Goddess of Magic to the wizard Midnight , who reluctantly accepted and took Mystra ' s name in order to smooth the transition after so much chaos .

title: Mystra ' s Ban
description: Mystra ' s Ban Mystra ' s Ban is a decree that the goddess Mystra made about the mortal use of powerful magic . Magic before the Ban . Before Mystra ' s Ban , there was no practical limit to the ways magic could be used .

title: Mystra ( Midnight )
description: Mystra ( Midnight ) Mystra ( pronounced " MISS - trah " ) , the Mother of all Magic , formerly known as Midnight , was once a greater goddess who guided the magic that enveloped Toril and its surrounding space . Mystra tended to the Weave constantly , making possible all the miracles and mysteries wrought by magic and users of magic . She was believed to be the embodiment of the Weave and of magic itself ( though this was known to be false in the wake of the Spellplague ) .

title: Mystryl
description: Mystryl Mystryl ( MISS - trihl ) , the Lady of Mysteries , was a greater deity and the first incarnation of the goddess of magic . Later incarnations of the goddess were named " Mystra " . Mystryl was most notably known as the being who embodied the Weave , the primary source of magic in the cosmos .

title: Mytela Halvasyn
description: Mytela Halvasyn Lady Mytela Halvasyn was a half - elf noble with considerable influence in the city of Velprintalar . Her house , a palace - like structure , Mytela Halvasyn ' s house , later became the base of operations for her descendants , who operated the Society of the Verdant Arrow , an anti - human organization .

title: Mytela Halvasyn ' s house
description: Mytela Halvasyn ' s house Lady Mytela Halvasyn ' s house was a palace - like house in Velprintalar , Aglarond , once occupied by Lady Mytela Halvasyn , but , as of 1368 DR , was occupied by her descendants , who formed an anti - human organization called the Society of the Verdant arrow .

title: Myth Adofhaer
description: Myth Adofhaer Myth Adofhaer was a mythal - cloaked Silvuanede nn city . It was sent away from Faerûn around - 5300 DR by the Eaerlann i , but shortly prior to 1374 DR , information was found in a ruined Eaerlanni library that revealed how to bring it back . This information was of particular interest to Eldreth Veluuthra , the organisation that sought the removal of all human s from Faerûn .

title: Myth Drannor
description: Myth Drannor Myth Drannor , formerly known as ( the city of ) Cormanthor , the City of Song , or the City of Love , as well as many other names , was an elven city of around 10 , 000 ( as of 1479 DR ) in Cormanthor , which had been rebuilt after the original had laid in ruins since it fell in 714 DR . It was one of four old communities and capital of Cormanthyr ( the others being the Elven Court , Semberholme , and the Tangled Trees ) . At its height , it represented the peak of eladrin civilization and craftsmanship .

title: Myth Nantar
description: Myth Nantar Myth Nantar ( the City of Destinies ) was an underwater city about 56 - 64km ( 35 - 40 miles ) west of the Whamite Isles , and about 64km northwest of Voalidru . The city contained a mythal , a magical protective barrier . After the Spellplague the Sea of Fallen Stars receded and part of the city was exposed to air .

title: Myth Ondath
description: Myth Ondath Myth Ondath , formerly known as Yrlaancel and Ondathel , was a ruined city located in the Tortured Land of north Faerûn . Geography . Myth Ondath was located at the western end of the White Peaks that spanned the northern border of the Ride .

title: Myth Rhynn
description: Myth Rhynn Myth Rhynn is an ancient elven tomb city deep in the forest of Wealdath . Even the elves themselves are unsure of when it was built , but it was some time during the height of the realm of Keltormir . It ' s mythal has long since been corrupted .

title: Mythal
description: Mythal A mythal was a powerful magical effect , created by a group of spellcasters to protect and ward a large area with numerous powerful enchantments . The earliest mythals were created by a circle of elven High Mages . Mythals could permanently alter The Weave to create an area wherein the normal rules of magic no longer applied .

title: Mythal recovery
description: Mythal recovery Mythal recovery is an abjuration spell used by some swordmage s to rid themselves of negative effects placed upon them by enemies . When a swordmage casts " mythal recovery " he or she turns their magic al wardings inward , giving them a chance to cast off a hindering effect left upon them by some enemy or other obstacle . The spell is not terribly complex and can be used again after a short rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Mythallar
description: Mythallar A mythallar was a Netherese device that allowed access to vast amounts of raw magic . Description . This magical device looked much like a crystal ball but was about 150 feet in diameter .

title: Mythrellan
description: Mythrellan Mythrellan was the Zulkir of Illusion and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . She lived in the Serpent Tower , in the city of Bezantur . She was known to have only mindless servants .

title: Mythrien Sarath
description: Mythrien Sarath Mythrien Sarath was one of several elven god s of magic in danger of losing their deific status due to lack of worshipers . As Mystra once delegated certain aspects of magic to other , lesser deities , so too did Corellon Larethian before her . Mythrien held dominion over protective magic and aided High mage s in the erection of mythal s .

title: Myudo Ichiro
description: Myudo Ichiro Myudo Ichiro was an old man living in Myudo village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Ichiro lived with his aged wife , his daughter , and the husband of the daughter .

title: N ' Safa
description: N ' Safa N ' Safa was the leader of the yuan - ti Se ' Sehen tribe around 1374 DR . History . Around 1374 DR , N ' Safa led her tribe in betraying Sseth , instead pleading their allegiance to the new god Zehir .

title: NPC
description: NPC NPC stands for a non - player character in a role - playing game . The term can mean two different things , though both meanings stand in opposition to the meaning of " player character " . Firstly , in role - playing games in general , it can refer to any character who is not controlled by a player ( but rather the computer or the DM ) .

title: Naahal
description: Naahal Naahal was a whale bard until 1369 DR . History . Born in 613 DR , Naahal become the leader of the largest pod of humpback whale s .

title: Naaman al - Rima
description: Naaman al - Rima Naaman al - Rima was a halfling and the chief cook who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Naaman directed the actions of dozens of other cooks .

title: Naaren Dhest
description: Naaren Dhest Naaren Dhest was a thief and a member of the Hand of Yartar during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , a patrol of the Twelve near Triboar had defeated some cultists of the Cult of the Eternal Flame and recovered a " devastation orb " .

title: Nabeirion
description: Nabeirion Nabeirion was a high - ranking monk of Candlekeep . Activities . Nabeirion ' s duty was to always recite the Endless Chant of Alaundo .

title: Nabil al - Rashad
description: Nabil al - Rashad Nabil al - Rashad was a horse trader who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he did not own a stall or stable , Nabil could be found nearly everywhere within Huzuz selling horses .

title: Nacacia
description: Nacacia Nacacia was a female half - elf slave in Myth Drannor , in service to the Masked of Cormanthyr in years between c . 238 and 261 . History .

title: Nacre
description: Nacre Nacre is the substance that pearls are made of and is also found in turbo and trochus shells . Similar to mother of pearl , the smaller specimens of these shells that exhibit a fiery luster are cut and polished and sold as " nacre " at a base value of 1gp per pound ( 0 . 45kg ) .

title: Nada
description: Nada Nada , also known as Juto , was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Possessions . In battle , Nada used a ninja - to .

title: Nada al - Hazan
description: Nada al - Hazan Nada al - Hazan was an island chain in the Crowded Sea south of Zakhara . Among the wild archipelagos of the sea , it was the island chain best explored and most settled by enlightened Zakharans . Located south of the Golden Gulf , between Jazayir al - Sartan , the island of Harab , and the Steaming Isles , Nada al - Hazan was a convenient entryway into the Crowded Sea , giving it the title the " Silver Road " .

title: Nadlok Bormul
description: Nadlok Bormul Nadlok Bormul was a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Nadlok grew up in Crimmor in Amn but sold all his holdings to the Crytrappers and moved to Athkatla in 1366 DR .

title: Nado Tori
description: Nado Tori Nado Tori was a samurai ronin in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Nado lived at the Shrine of the Spring , despite being a follower of the Konjo school .

title: Nadrathen
description: Nadrathen Nadrathen , usually know as The Rebel Chosen , was a powerful male wizard . He was once one of the Chosen of Mystra but he decided to follow only his will against his goddess and for this he was destroyed by Elminster Aumar . History .

title: Nadul DaRoni
description: Nadul DaRoni Nadul DaRoni was a gnomish artist and inventor who lived as a hermit near High Horn . He was undoubtedly a genius , but also quite possibly a madman ( which may be one of the factors involved in his natural ingenuity ) . Some of these inventions were not always foolproof and some were quite risky to use .

title: Nadyra ' s Glory
description: Nadyra ' s Glory Nadyra ' s Glory ( also known as the Lost Princess ) was the bridal ship of Princess Aliia of Impiltur , which sank in mysterious circumstances on the Sea of Fallen Stars in 926 DR after leaving Hlammach . Aliia was on the way to marry Crown Prince Rhiigard I of Cormyr . The ship was loaded with treasure and displayed purple sails in honour of Cormyr , and its aim ( and the aim of the marriage ) was to unite Cormyr and Impiltur .

title: Naedaenya Arthas
description: Naedaenya Arthas Naedaenya Arthas was a female Chondathan human cleric of Shar . She was the leader of a group of clerics of Shar posing as clerics of Mystra at a false temple to Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr in 1374 DR . History .

title: Naer Tlarra
description: Naer Tlarra Naer Tlarra was a human man and a wizard of the lands that became Chessenta , who lived around the 4th or 5th century DR . His tomb was a subject of treasure tales . After he died , Naer ' s tomb was built in Elvenblood Pass in the Earthfast Mountains of the Vast , and either buried or heavily overgrown somewhere there .

title: Naergoth Bladelord
description: Naergoth Bladelord Naergoth Bladelord was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was the warrior lord of the cult and the leader of the ruling council . He usually resided in Saerloon .

title: Naerlus
description: Naerlus Naerlus was a shadovar spy inside Candlekeep . History . Naerlus went to infiltrate Candlekeep .

title: Naeros Karanok
description: Naeros Karanok Naeros Karanok was the son of the ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Naeros usually wandered with his retinue watching people run away .

title: Naeryndroth
description: Naeryndroth Naeryndroth was an adult black dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Personality . Naeryndroth was cunning and able to deceive many foes with his acting skills .

title: Nafay Mizz ' rynturl
description: Nafay Mizz ' rynturl Nafay Mizz ' rynturl was a drow traitor priestess of Guallidurth in 1378 DR . Activities . Nafay was a noble of House Mizz ' rynturl of the city of Guallidurth but secretly also a traitor priestess of Vhaeraun .

title: Nafir
description: Nafir The nafir ( nah - FEER ) was a Zakharan wind instrument similar to a trumpet . Description . " Nafirs " resembled long , thin trumpets and were made from metal .

title: Nafyrra Dyrr
description: Nafyrra Dyrr Nafyrra Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1372 . History . Nafyrra commanded a contingent of 80 warriors , mostly of her house , at the Rhazzt ' s Dilemma outpost in order to detect enemies arriving during the Silence of Lolth .

title: Naga
description: Naga Nagas are a race of intelligent snake - like immortal s with widely differing abilities and alignments . They resemble giant snakes , some with humanoid heads and some with more snake - like heads , both of which have a certain amount of spell casting power . They have also been known to eat the flesh of humans , orcs , and other races .

title: Naga ( yakuza )
description: Naga ( yakuza ) Naga was a yakuza in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Naga recently became known for his many unorthodox ideas , which were not really appreciated by his fellows .

title: Naga Crawls
description: Naga Crawls The Naga Crawls were a series of caverns in the Deep Wastes noted as the lair of a trio of spirit naga . Geography . The Naga Crawls were located 52 .

title: Naga Plains
description: Naga Plains The Naga Plains are a grouping of tall grasslands located between the Golden Road and the Nagawater , in the nation of Sespech . Recent History . There are persistant rumors that naga s live among the grasses .

title: Nagaflow
description: Nagaflow The Nagaflow was a river in the country of Sespech in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The source of the Nagaflow lay in the depths of of the Chondalwood .

title: Nagamat
description: Nagamat Nagamat was a dragon general of Tiamat during the Time of Dragons . History . In −30000 DR , Nagamat was in charge of the siege of the aearee kingdom of Shara , destroying its hatcheries and claiming the realm as his own .

title: Nagawater
description: Nagawater The Nagawater was formerly a large , deep lake located in Sespech . It was named for the large number of water naga s that lived in the southern region of the lake . A line of buoys lit with continual flame spells marked the boundry between the north half of the lake that human s inhabited and the southern part left for the naga s .

title: Naglatha
description: Naglatha Naglatha , alias the Black Flame , was Red Wizard of Thay residing in Selgaunt in Sembia . Description . Naglatha in 1357 DR was a young , black - haired woman with a grim face .

title: Nagoya Hatano
description: Nagoya Hatano Nagoya Hatano was the head of Nagoya clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Hatano withdrawn into his own family to avoid people ' s suspects .

title: Nagoya Kenko
description: Nagoya Kenko Nagoya Kenko was the heir of Nagoya clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Kenko usually spend more than he can afford on clothes .

title: Nahal ' s reckless dweomer
description: Nahal ' s reckless dweomer Nahal ' s reckless dweomer was an arcane spell that used wild magic on a most basic level . The caster invoked a surge of magical energy in order to create the effect of any one spell known to him . Often however , the release of energy created a completely unpredictable result .

title: Nahopaca
description: Nahopaca The Nahopaca were a group of people living in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . Society .

title: Naib ibn - Sodar
description: Naib ibn - Sodar Naib ibn - Sodar was an elven sorcerer who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Naid was in charge of the wizard s who guarded the Grand Gate of Delights leading into the Palace .

title: Naican
description: Naican The Naican were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Khassidi lived in the southwestern region of the Endless Waste .

title: Naican language
description: Naican language Naican was a language in the Imaskari languages group , spoken in the Hordelands . Description . Naican had round and broad vowel sounds with rolled R sounds .

title: Nain Keenwhistler
description: Nain Keenwhistler Nain Keenwhistler is a human wizard from Waterdeep . He has been resurrected more times than anyone else in the city . He lives at Naingate in the Sea Ward , his own personal tower .

title: Naingate
description: Naingate Naingate is the wizard tower of Nain Keenwhistler , wizard and former member of the Company of Crazed Venturers . It is located in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep , at the intersection of Grimwald ' s Way and Seawatch Street . It is used by Nain as a home , as well as a base for his research .

title: Najara
description: Najara Najara , a large kingdom in the Western Heartlands , was inhabited by a wide variety of serpentfolk . It comprised parts of the High Moor , the Forest of Wyrms , and the Marsh of Chelimber , with the Serpent Hills existing in the center . It not functioning as a typical government , its status as a kingdom is a disputed subject .

title: Najeeya
description: Najeeya Najeeya was a student inhabiting the White Agate ' s Tower in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to her studies , Najeeya met with callers who came seeking answers from her master .

title: Najib al - Dhi ' b
description: Najib al - Dhi ' b Najib al - Dhi ' b was the leader of the Dauntless Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . His duties kept Najib at court for much of his time , where he took orders directly from the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir .

title: Najib al - Samsi
description: Najib al - Samsi Najib al - Samsi was the ruler of Sams Bandar on Jazirat al - Qraidis in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Najib was a skinny , balding man who had heavily weathered skin from time spent outdoors .

title: Najit ' aqalat
description: Najit ' aqalat Najit ' aqalat was a bound marid who served as harbormaster of Hawa within the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Abilities . Najit ' aqalat possesed all of the impressive abilities common to marids .

title: Najm
description: Najm Najm was the dashing god or goddess of adventure and curiosity of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and wanted his followers to venture forth an make the unknown known . Najm ' s symbol was a single arrow pointed upward .

title: Nakamaru
description: Nakamaru Nakamaru was a city in Wa known to maintain the largest quarter for the residences of foreign merchants and dignitaries , through special dispensation of the Empress Bishkammon . Nakamaru was the original home province of the Marasuuri family . Geography .

title: Nakata
description: Nakata Nakata was an ancient spirit of Rashemen , a wolf - telthor friend of Okku . She lived in Okku ' s barrow and served the God of Bears . There is little known about her .

title: Nakhuda
description: Nakhuda Nakhuda ( pl . nawakhid ) was the term used to describe someone who owned a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities .

title: Nako Nang
description: Nako Nang Nako Nang was a merchant in Tabot in 1357 DR . Activities . Nako owned a shop in Talung but was often out with caravans .

title: Naktong Moors
description: Naktong Moors The Naktong Moors were a tract of moorland in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . They lay west of the settlement of Konang Pen . Trade .

title: Nakulutiun
description: Nakulutiun The Nakulutiuns were a reclusive people residing in the Nakvaligach region of the Great Glacier , the most inhospitable area of that frozen wilderness . They were the smallest ( only 5 % ) of the tribes collectively called the Ulutiun s . Description .

title: Nakvaligach
description: Nakvaligach Nakvaligach , also called the " Northern Barrens " , was the most dangerous region of the Great Glacier . Geography . Nakvaligach , the smallest of the three regions of the Glacier , was located north of Alpuk , across the Uppuk River .

title: Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn
description: Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn Nal ' dorltyrr Melarn was the unusual drider weapon master of House Melarn in 1479 DR . History . Nal ' dorltyrr was appointed as weapon master in 1469 DR after the elder boy and previous weapon master was killed at a party .

title: Nala
description: Nala Nala , formerly a member of Clan Yrjixtilex , was a dragonborn priest ess of Tiamat and a servant of Skuthosiin , who posed as a cleric of Bahamut in order to infiltrate and corrupt the Platinum Cadre . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Nala was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description .

title: Nalaskur Thaelond
description: Nalaskur Thaelond Nalaskur Thaelond was an innkeeper of the Bargewright Inn and a member of the Zhentarim during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Activities . From his inn , Nalaskur was able to keep tabs on all travelers .

title: Nalavarauthatoryl
description: Nalavarauthatoryl Nalavarauthatoryl or Nalavara , formerly the elven wizard Lorelei Alavara , was an elf - dragon . History . She swore vengeance on the Obarskyr name and all humans in Cormyr after a member of the Obarskyr family slew her lover .

title: Nalfein Do ' Urden
description: Nalfein Do ' Urden Nalfein Do ' Urden was the elderboy and house wizard of House Do ' Urden of Menzoberranzan until his death . History . Nalfein studied wizardry at Sorcere , the drow academy for wizards in Menzoberranzan .

title: Nalfeshnee
description: Nalfeshnee Nalfeshnees , also known as Type IV demon s , were a powerful type of demon . They were the judges of the Abyss . Description .

title: Nalia de ' Arnise
description: Nalia de ' Arnise Nalia de ' Arnise is a young Amnian noblewoman of a particularly charitable bent . She has learnt some rogue skills in the process of sneaking out of her home to help out those less well off , something her guardians did not much approve of , especially as her mother had died of an illness contracted during such charity . Besides of this , she is a capable mage .

title: Nalifarn
description: Nalifarn Nalifarn was an durzagon alchemist and chieftain around 1485 DR . History . Nalifarn led a clan of duergar .

title: Naloc
description: Naloc Naloc was the high priest of Zaltec at Kultaka and one of the closest advisors of the Kultakan ' s ruler Takamal . History . In 1361 DR , he was with Takamal during the battle against the Golden Legion , when , in order to turn the destiny of the conflict , the mage Darien levitate d to them and killed first Naloc and then Takamal .

title: Nalos
description: Nalos Nalos of Pumanath was the triton centurion of the sixth squad of Abydos and a member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Initially during the Twelfth Serôs War , Nalos was skeptical about his mission and his position but , by 1370 DR , he had come to appreciated the shallow waters .

title: Naltecona
description: Naltecona Naltecona was the last ruler of Nexal in 1361 DR . He was governed by superstition , as were most Nexalans , and the High Priest of Zaltec , Hoxitl , had a strong influence over his actions . He was the most brilliant general during the rule of his father Axalt .

title: Nalynaul
description: Nalynaul Nalynaul the Shriveled was an alhoon who commanded a small clan of wererat s in Yartar in 1372 DR . History . Nalynaul was originally based in the depths of Gauntlgtym , where it commanded a " druuth " , a community of doppelganger servants .

title: Namarra
description: Namarra Namarra , also known as The Sword That Never Sleeps , is a unique magic + 2 keen longsword that glows light purple and can be commanded by its owner to cast " silence " at any time . It floats on water , and white sparks fly from it when it strikes metal . Both sides of the blade are engraved , one with " Namarra " and the other with " Never sleeps .

title: Namaxil
description: Namaxil Namaxil was a Jaguar Knight in Maztica . History . Naxamil was born in Qoral .

title: Namble Swiftleg
description: Namble Swiftleg Namble Swiftleg was a human male and Squad Leader in the Second Battalion of the Amnwater Blues Regiment , in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . Namble was a robust , active , honest , and sociable man who commanded the complete loyalty of his squad of soldiers , two men and two women . Possessions .

title: Nameless ( tressym )
description: Nameless ( tressym ) Nameless was the tressym familiar of Tsarra Chaadren . Description . Nameless was jet black , with one blue eye and one green .

title: Nameless Haunt
description: Nameless Haunt The Nameless Haunt was a legendary cat - man creature that inhabited and guarded the Pellamcopse Woods north of Waterdeep . Description . The Nameless Haunt ' s body was shaped as a man , but he had huge black wings , a cat ' s head , and white sigils on his torso .

title: Nameless One
description: Nameless One The main character of is a nameless human with a unique form of immortality . Rather than being protected from injury , his specific brand of unending life allows him to raise from the dead due to regeneration abilities , like a troll . However , with each rising , he loses large chunks of his memory , leaving him little clue as to what he was doing or even where he is .

title: Nameless One ( Shar )
description: Nameless One ( Shar ) The Nameless One was a shadovar girl and a high - ranking priestess and Chosen of Shar . History . She resided in Sakkors with her parents until it was destroyed around 1484 DR and her parents died in the fall .

title: Nameless Swamp
description: Nameless Swamp The Nameless Swamp is a small marsh located in the Dragon Coast . Geography . Located south of Elversult , the Nameless Swamp is west of the Giant ' s Run mountains .

title: Nammna
description: Nammna Nammna was a merchant from the city of Milvarune in Thesk in the 14th century DR . Nammna partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Pomphur of Almraiven , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .

title: Nan - kuo
description: Nan - kuo Nan - kuo was a monk member of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Nan - kuo was forced to abandon his monastery in T ' u Lung due to war .

title: Nanathlor Greysword
description: Nanathlor Greysword Nanthalor Greysword was a fighter and the High Lord of Loudwater . Description . In 1358 DR , Nanathlor had a gray beard and long flowing gray hair .

title: Nandrel Gostur
description: Nandrel Gostur Nandrel Gostur was one of the richest inhabitants of the city of Lylorn , in the Dusk Ports . Activities . Unknown for most people , Nandrel was a head member of the criminal organization " Shadowkiss " .

title: Naneatha Lharilstar
description: Naneatha Lharilstar Naneatha Lharilstar is a courtesan at Piergeiron ' s Palace as well as the leader of the Castle Ward cell of the Red Sashes . She is one of the two members of the Sashes who knows the true identity of the " One . " Appearance .

title: Nanfoodle Buswilligan
description: Nanfoodle Buswilligan Nanfoodle Buswilligan is a gnome alchemist around three and a half feet ( 1 . 1m ) tall . He has a little knowledge of illusion ism .

title: Nanhu Oasis
description: Nanhu Oasis Nanhu Oasis , meaning South Lake Oasis in the language of the horsemen , was an oasis in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Teyla Shan mountain range , Nanhu Oasis was a small , shallow , lake covered in reeds .

title: Nanna - Sin
description: Nanna - Sin Nanna - Sin was the Untheric god of the moon . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a black axe over a moon .

title: Nanteuil
description: Nanteuil Nanteuil was a dwarf cleric in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Once Nanteuil was always drunk until he accidentally killed a young half - elf woman .

title: Naoki Katasube
description: Naoki Katasube Naoki Katasube was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Bingo village in a Niwa shoen , he controlled affairs from a beautiful house served by 20 servants .

title: Naomi ( Wa )
description: Naomi ( Wa ) Naomi was a consort in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Naomi on the surface looked like a mild and introverted woman but deep down she was strong - willed and intelligent .

title: Naqqarah
description: Naqqarah The naqqarah ( nah - KAR - rah ) was a small Zakharan drum often worn at the side . Description . The " naqqarah " was fixed with a leather thong worn over the shoulder .

title: Nar ' ysr
description: Nar ' ysr El Nar ' ysr , which means " The Phoenix " in Alzhedo , was one of the most prolific prophets ever to live on Toril , with greater divinatory power than even Alaundo the Seer , famous for many thousands of predictions later recorded in a multi - volume work entitled " The Phoenix Prophecies " . Description . The Nar ' ysr , whose real name was lost to history , was one of the Abbalayar , a group of human s so unique to be considered a different race altogether .

title: Nar - Aidiya
description: Nar - Aidiya Nar - Aidiya , or The Bonfire , was a human flame mage and member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Though he kept his true physical appearance hidden from nearly everyone , including members of the Brotherhood , Nar - Aidiya appeared to be a man in his mid - 40s with piercing black eyes , shining black hair , and a trimmed goatee .

title: Nar Kerymhoarth
description: Nar Kerymhoarth Nar Kerymhoarth ( the Sleeping Citadel ) was an underground fortress known by most as the Nameless Dungeon . Description . The Eaerlann knew its true name but refused to speak it .

title: Nar demonbinder
description: Nar demonbinder Nar Demonbinder is a special prestige class on Faerûn . Master of the black art of demon summoning , keeping alive the old , sinister traditions of the Empire of Narfell . Though it was thousands of years ago that the empire grew mighty on the strength of unholy wizard s and cruel priest - lords , this conjuring of demons contributed to its eventual downfall .

title: Nar fiendbond
description: Nar fiendbond Nar fiendbond was a transmutation spell that transformed a person into a half - fiend . It was presumably developed by the Nars . Effects .

title: Naralis Analor
description: Naralis Analor Naralis Analor ( sometimes seen as Naris Analor ) was a lesser member of the Seldarine and took the role of the elvish god of suffering , healing , and death . Unlike other gods with death in their portfolio , Naralis was caring and benevolent which made him a popular deity among those who risked death . Description .

title: Nararoot
description: Nararoot Nararoot was a tuber that was used as birth control throughout Faerûn . Much cheaper than cassil herbs , nararoot shavings were taken by women . Nararoot could be diluted and steeped into tea for a more pleasant flavor .

title: Narbeck Horn
description: Narbeck Horn Narbcek Horn was the shield dwarf commander of Xantharl ' s Keep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Narbeck commanded the local garrison of 150 veterans and responded directly to the marchion of Mirabar using a sending stone in order to inform the city of any menace .

title: Narbondel
description: Narbondel The Narbondel was a huge stalagmite in the city of Menzoberranzan and served as a clock for its inhabitants . History . At one time , the drow Zaknafein Do ' Urden found Menzoberra ' s tomb within Narbondel and took the " Dagger of Menzoberra " back to the city .

title: Narbondellyn
description: Narbondellyn Narbondellyn was a district of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . The district of Narbondellyn was located next to Narbondel , the city ' s enchanted clock pillar .

title: Narder Ulthub
description: Narder Ulthub Narder Ulthub was a halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Narder regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned .

title: Naren Dafyre
description: Naren Dafyre Naren Dafyre was a merchant residing in Skullport in the late 15th century DR . He was a lesser lord of the Mandible gang , a position he believed was too low for him . History .

title: Narfell
description: Narfell Narfell is a country in the eastern part of Faerûn . It lies in the Cold Lands region but was once the heart of a vast empire that stretched from the Giantspire Mountains to Lake Ashane which included the Great Dale , much of Thesk , part of the Plateau of Thay , what would become Impiltur , and other lands . History .

title: Narfelli language
description: Narfelli language Narfelli was the original language of the Nar people of the ancient Narfell i Empire . It was strongly influenced by the Abyssal language , as much of that empire ' s history was influenced by devil s and demon s . By 1372 DR , Narfelli was a dead language , and the survivors of the Narfelli Empire , the Nars , spoke Damaran and Naric .

title: Nari al - Farif
description: Nari al - Farif Nari al - Farif was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Nari was the Dean of the College of Fine Arts .

title: Naric
description: Naric Naric was a language spoken by the Nars , from Icelace Lake in the north to Rawlinswood in the south , and from the Giantspire Mountains in the west to the Icerim Mountains in the east . It was one of the Low Ulutim languages . It was presumably derived from the ancient language of Narfelli .

title: Narim Sandir
description: Narim Sandir Narim Sandir was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Narim was the dean of the College of Combat Technique .

title: Narla Gulmaern
description: Narla Gulmaern Narla Gulmaern was a spellscar red tiefling tavern owner in Gontal City . Abilities . Narla ' s spellscar gave her the ability to disrupt arcane magic and ritual s with her mere presence .

title: Narle Shieldbiter
description: Narle Shieldbiter Narle Shieldbiter was an orog chieftain of the Burning Banner tribe in Thar and a mercenary in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Narle was persuaded by Sharrak ' s words to help the Cult of the Dragon and believed that his tribe was chosen to serve the soon - to - be dragon kings .

title: Narm
description: Narm Narm was a large half - orc fighter and the leader of the Blue Wyvern Company of Ravens Bluff . In 1479 DR , Narm agreed that the Blue Wyverns would help Jack Ravenwild recover a tome of shadow magic from Sarbreen in exchange for 500 gold pieces per member of the company .

title: Narm Tamaraith
description: Narm Tamaraith Narm Tamaraith was a young apprentice mage who become the lover and later the husband of the wielder of " spellfire " , Shandril Shessair . History . Narm decided to become a mage after he saw a battle between two wizard s that killed his parents .

title: Narmitra Stormserpent
description: Narmitra Stormserpent Narmitra Stormserpent was a noble in Cormyr and a lady of the Stormserpent noble house . Relationships . Narmitra was the mother of Marlin Stormserpent .

title: Narnorn
description: Narnorn Narnorn was mysterious thief who ruled Mreyelundar in 1479 DR . Background . Narnorn was a thief of legendary status in Returned Abeir , and its true identity was unknown .

title: Narnra Shalace
description: Narnra Shalace Narnra Shalace was a rogue who called Waterdeep her home . History . She was the daughter of the song dragon Maerjanthra Shalace and Elminster .

title: Narrak
description: Narrak Narrak was a derro savant cultist of Demogorgon in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Narrak ' s area of expertise was demonology .

title: Narrow Sea
description: Narrow Sea The Narrow Sea was the main body of water in the old Netherese Empire . The Narrow sea once stretched across nearly the whole northern edge of Netheril . Inhabitants .

title: Narth Tezrin
description: Narth Tezrin Narth Tezrin was an inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Narth managed the Lion ' s Share shop together with Alaestra Ulgar .

title: Nartham
description: Nartham Nartham was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Nartham was a violent and short - tempered fellow , always looking for an excuse to kill .

title: Nas Trango Shan
description: Nas Trango Shan Nas Trango Shan , or North Guardian Peak , was a mountain in Khazari . Description . Nas Trango Shan was one of two mountains in Khazari , the other being Ahs Trango Shan , that formed the nation ' s eastern border .

title: Nasaqh
description: Nasaqh Lord Nasaqh was the lord of the Nasaqh Estates on Mount Sar north of Waterdeep on the Sword Coast North in the 14th century DR . History . Lord Nasaqh was the fourth generation of Nasaqhs to rule the valley encompassed by the Nasaqh Estates .

title: Nasaqh Estates
description: Nasaqh Estates The Nasaqh Estates were a plot of land ruled by Lord Nasaqh and his ancestors . They lay between Mount Helimbrar and Mount Sar , east of the High Road out of Waterdeep along the Sword Coast North . History .

title: Nasher Alagondar
description: Nasher Alagondar Lord Nasher Alagondar was the fearless former adventurer and ruler of Neverwinter who held his city firmly in the Lords ' Alliance . Nasher was responsible for laying many plots and magical contingencies against assaults from the city ' s warlike rival , Luskan , even going so far as banning maps of the city being made in order to throw off the spies of Luskan and their potential invasion plans . Description .

title: Nashkel
description: Nashkel Nashkel was a small town on the northern slopes of the Cloud Peaks . Geography . Although formally a part of Amn , Nashkel was separated from the rest of the kingdom by the mountain passes and so was relatively autonomous .

title: Nasim el Pesarkhal
description: Nasim el Pesarkhal Nasim yn Feroz el Pesarkhal and known as the " Dark Caleph " was the younger brother of Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal and the leader of el Pesarkhal clan in Memnon . In this position , he directly controlled the black marketeers , and began buying and selling with sources in the Underdark , which boosted earnings for the family by 50 % over only a few years . He also controlled the enforcers and thugs in the city .

title: Nasir al - Nasr
description: Nasir al - Nasr Nasir al - Nasr , the Great Eagle , was the second Grand Caliph of Zakhara and an important historical figure of the Land of Fate . History . After the death of his father , the first Grand Caliph , Nasir was faced with the onslaught of various factions vying for the rule of the new Zakhara .

title: Nasir el - Mamadin
description: Nasir el - Mamadin Nasir el - Mamadin was the mamluk leader of the Diligent Mamluk Society in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The mamluk took orders directly from Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir or Preani Qin .

title: Naskurl
description: Naskurl The Naskurl family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Naskurls were allied with the Baraedin , Mithertul , and Onsil families .

title: Nasnas
description: Nasnas Nasnas were humanoid creatures created by evil priests or wizards in Zakhara . They were fanatically loyal to their creator and would defend them to the death . Description .

title: Nasr - uddin
description: Nasr - uddin Nasr - uddin , called the Lame , was a prophet who traveled the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Description . Nasr had a long white beard that fit the physical appearance of a wandering prophet .

title: Nastasia
description: Nastasia Nastasia was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in Lake Sember in 1375 DR . History . Nastasia was at the shrine to Eilistraee in Lake Sember when she was attacked by a Nightshadow of Vhaeraun , who killed her and stole her soul .

title: Natak Hornswallow
description: Natak Hornswallow Natak Hornswallow was a merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Natak was a rug merchant with few contact outside his hometown of Athkatla , so his invitation to join the Knights was a surprise to many .

title: Natali
description: Natali Natali was a monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Natali was not sure about her vocation as a monk ; her dreams shifted from being a great warrior , a devoted priest , or a powerful wizard .

title: Natali Dormetsk
description: Natali Dormetsk Natali Dormetsk was a warrior of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Natali was a commander in the contingent led by Madislak Pemsk during the war against the Ice Witch Iyraclea and the white dragon dracolich Zethrindor .

title: Natan
description: Natan Natan was a Shadar - kai high priest of Tempus in the city of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell . He was a close friend and advisor to Uwan , Ikemmu ' s leader . Natan regularly received visons that he believed to be from Tempus himself .

title: Nath
description: Nath The Nath was a region in northeastern Halruaa . Geography . Located at the junction of the Nathaghal Mountains and Muaraghal Mountains , the Nath was a large basin used by Halruaans to herd livestock .

title: Nathaghal Mountains
description: Nathaghal Mountains The Nathaghal Mountains , also known as the North Wall , were a range of mountains in South Faerûn that formed the northern edge of Halruaa . Geography . The North Wall surrounded the region of the Nath .

title: Nathchan Belemmor
description: Nathchan Belemmor Nathchan Belemmor was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . For a human , Belemmor was a gem - cutter of unequaled talent , so great he worked only on regalia for the nobility and even for royalty . However , he was notorious for his fits of rage .

title: Nathgarl
description: Nathgarl Nathgarl was a minor magelord of the kingdom of Athalantar . Biography . Nathgarl was a minor wizard from Unther and an apprentice of Maulygh .

title: Nathlekh
description: Nathlekh Nathlekh ( the City of Cats ) was the capital of the Shou nation of Nathlan . Located at the western edge of the Gulthmere Forest on the shores of the Lake of the Long Arm , Nathlekh was built around a granite plug , atop which The Pride of Nobanion stood , seemingly as an extension of the rock . Originally populated by feline lycanthrope s worshiping Nobanion and Sharess .

title: Nathong
description: Nathong Nathong was the mysterious capital city of the Yikarian Empire in northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Found high in the peaks of the daunting World Pillar Mountains , Nathong was nestled safely near the central core of the Land of the Yak - Men within the Gate of Heaven province .

title: Nathoud
description: Nathoud Nathoud was a fortified town located in the northern region of the Hordelands bordering Rashemen . Description . Nathoud sat in the hill country at the feet of the southern slopes of the Icerim Mountains .

title: Nathoudi stallion
description: Nathoudi stallion Nathoudi stallions were a special breed of horse found in the city of Nathoud where the northern reaches of the Hordelands bordered Rashemen . History . Nathoudi stallions were breed and prized for their endurance and stamina .

title: Nathur Hethkantan
description: Nathur Hethkantan Prince Nathur Hethkantan , also known as the Prince of Bone , was a plaguechanged spellscar red dracolich and the ruler of the Dominion of Bone in Glaur as of 1479 DR , and formerly a human merchant prince of Szant . He was also the granduncle of Queen Imreera Hethkantan of Gontal . Description .

title: Nathyrra
description: Nathyrra Nathyrra was a former member of the Red Sisters order of drow assassins and is now a devout follower of Eilistraee . She is first met in the bowels of Undermountain , offering assistance in freeing Halaster Blackcloak . She is later available as a henchman in Chapter 2 and is one of the romance options for male characters throughout the expansion .

title: Natifa
description: Natifa Natifa was a ghost who inhabited the Burning Pool of Natifa in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Appearance . Natifa appeared as an elderly woman .

title: Native Intelligence
description: Native Intelligence Nothing is known of this module as it seems to have never seen play . However , considering the plotlines of previous and future modules that were released , it is likely it has something to do with the book " Legacy of the Green Regent " and discovering that the current Green Regent , Otar , is rumoured to have been seen in Waterdeep .

title: Natrisse
description: Natrisse Natrisse was a female human of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Natrisse was a priestess of Lathander , who worked along Brother Merring , before he went to West Harbor .

title: Natural creature
description: Natural creature Natural creatures are those creatures which occur naturally within the Prime ' s landscape and which are neither from the Feywild like eladrin , the Shadowfell like shadar - kai , the Elemental Chaos like fire giant s , nor the Astral Sea like devil s . This includes such creatures as deer but also larger or more powerful creatures like dire wolves or dinosaur s . Many of Toril ' s humanoid inhabitants are also natural creatures .

title: Nature domain
description: Nature domain The Nature domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the natural world . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Nature elemental
description: Nature elemental A nature elemental was a creature summoned by a special priest spell for a single purpose : to return an area of land or water to its natural state , " i . e . " , before it was touched by any form of humanoid civilization .

title: Naug - adar
description: Naug - adar The Naug - adar , also known as devil dogs , were a sub organization of the Zhentarim composed by minor wizard s in Zhentil Keep that acted as law enforcement agents and patrol troops in the Keep . The individual naug - adar were usually assigned by the Zhent to spying and eavesdroppings missions . They performed also missions in order to advantage the Black Network killing enemies , manipulate people and events or discovered important secrets .

title: Naug - orls
description: Naug - orls The Naug - orls , also known as devil worms or simply the Worms , were Zhentil Keep ' s thieves ' guild in 1368 DR . However the ties between criminal and official interests in Zhentil were so strong that they usually acted more like a scout ' s company than thieves . Feared and shunned by the Zhent s , the Worms secretly frequented all taverns and inns within the city , spying for their master who served the Council of Lords .

title: Nauloene Tharantra
description: Nauloene Tharantra Nauloene Tharantra was a notorious hedonist and businesswoman living in Waterdeep in the latter half of the . Description . Judging by her nickname and her profession , she was probably a redhead who honored Sune , but this is uncertain .

title: Naupau
description: Naupau Naupau was a small city in Sossal . Description . Located north of the Great Glacier , along the coast of the Yal Tengri , Naupau was the only known trade city of the nation of Sossal .

title: Nauzhror Baenre
description: Nauzhror Baenre Nauzhror Baenre was a high - ranking drow abjurer and house wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . He was a master of Sorcere and for a time in 1372 – 1373 DR he served as acting Archmage of Menzoberranzan . Description .

title: Nawab
description: Nawab A Nawab was the title of the leading , or most wealthy , merchant in a city or town within the Shining Lands . Activities . Nawabs served as a mayor of sorts .

title: Naxene Drathkala
description: Naxene Drathkala Naxene Drathkala was was an member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Naxene was usually at the Northfurrow ' s End inn .

title: Naxil
description: Naxil Naxil was a former priest of Vhaeraun . History . Naxil trained as a sorcerer and alchemist under his father before joining the Church of Vhaeraun .

title: Nay
description: Nay The nay ( NAY ) was a Zakharan wind instrument that resembled a flute . Description . " Nays " were made from dried , shellacked reeds or similar thin flora .

title: Nay of the djinn
description: Nay of the djinn The nay of the djinn was a magical musical instrument created by skilled djinn craftsmen to honor the chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " nays of the djinn " scattered throughout Zakhara . Description .

title: Nazari
description: Nazari Nazari was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Nazari was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Nazra Mrays
description: Nazra Mrays Nazra Mrays is a noblewoman , socialite and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Although she appears to be a typical frivolous Waterdavian noble , she is actually an extremely shrewd gatherer of information . Dagult Neverember entrusted the safekeeping of the dragonstaff to Nazra .

title: Naztharune
description: Naztharune Naztharune were black - furred rakshasa s with black tiger heads . Abilities . Many naztharune had few magical powers but were strong fighter s who specialized in assassination .

title: Nchaser
description: Nchaser Nchaser was a powerful mage who is famous for creating glowing globe s and the spell Nchaser ' s glowing orb . He was known for actively exploring the world , seeking out new magic and twice acting as an advisor for a local ruler , the second time being for the High Captains of Luskan . His tutor in the Art was Nulathoe .

title: Nchaser ' s glowing orb
description: Nchaser ' s glowing orb Nchaser ' s glowing orb , also known as Nchaser ' s glowing globe , was a rare spell that created a permanent mobile magical light source . Effect . This spell fills a fist - sized glass sphere with a " continual light " that the caster can mentally control , changing the brightness from nothing to full daylight .

title: Neachal Fountain
description: Neachal Fountain Neachal Fountain was a large gyser located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located along the Old Iron Road , Neachal Fountain served as the edge marker of a thermal basin that lay south of the road .

title: Nearel
description: Nearel King Nearel of the House of Ithal - Strohm - Bormul was the second king of the Lions ' Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Nearel was the seventeenth son and 32 child of King Mhoaran the Tusk - Bearded , the first ruler of the dynasty .

title: Neb
description: Neb Neb was a crazy serial killer in Baldur ' s Gate who fled to Athkatla in Amn . History . Neb was an assassin in Baldur ' s Gate until he was caught by the Flaming Fist .

title: Nebuseddar
description: Nebuseddar Nebuseddar was a fighter in Unther and one of the best champions in the service of Gilgeam in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , under the orders of his god - king , Nebuseddar went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose the new king .

title: Necklace of fireballs
description: Necklace of fireballs Necklaces of fireballs were magical items that provided the possessor with the ability to throw explosive beads . Description . A " necklaces of fireballs " was created with an illusory effect that made it appear like a series of beads on a string , sometimes tied into a necklace .

title: Necromancy
description: Necromancy Necromancy is the school of magic whose spells manipulate the power of death , unlife , and the life force . Spells involving the undead make up a large portion of this school , including " animate dead " and " finger of death " . Highly focused on the Negative Energy Plane , most spells from this school drain abilities .

title: Necromantic singularity
description: Necromantic singularity When cast , necromantic singularity created a temporary link between the Prime Material Plane , the Weave , and the Negative Energy Plane . The negative energy passed from the Negative to the Prime was strong enough to slay dozens , if not hundreds , of victims near the point of opening . With the collapse of the Weave , no reports of the spell being cast have been made .

title: Necromantic sphere
description: Necromantic sphere The Necromantic sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s and , to a lesser degree , monk s and crusader s . These powerful spells could restore life force , limbs , or even forgotten experiences . Wielded by an evil priest , they were extremely deadly .

title: Ned Dameron
description: Ned Dameron Ned Dameron is a prolific science fiction and fantasy illustrator whose art fills many 1 and 2 edition Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks . He has also illustrated the covers of authors such as . Background and Education .

title: Needle
description: Needle The Needle was a water tower in Luskan situated on the north side of Setting Sun Street , and was used during weekly flushes of the sewer system . Structure . The tower could also be used as a water supply in case fires broke out in the city .

title: Neera
description: Neera Neera was a half - elf wild mage . History . For her unique magical ability , she was chased for months by a team of Red Wizard s guided by Ekandor .

title: Neerg
description: Neerg Neerg was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Esmeltaran around 1370 DR . Personality . Neerg was easily frustrated by people who could not understood his instructions or who were condescending to him .

title: Neeshka
description: Neeshka Neeshka was a devil - descended tiefling rogue who journeyed with the Kalach - Cha during the hero ' s quest to defeat the King of Shadows . Description . Neeshka , like many tieflings , was vaguely human in appearance , though her fiendish ancestry was also immediately obvious .

title: Nefris
description: Nefris Nefris was a female Red Wizard of Thay and the headmistress of the Academy of Shapers and Binders . She was the one who first drew the Kalach - Cha to Rashemen by manipulating her daughters Lienna and Safiya . However , it was discovered that she was acting under the hidden orders of the Founder and she was a partial reincarnation of her .

title: Negative Energy plane
description: Negative Energy plane The Negative Energy plane , sometimes called the Plane of Death or the Negative Material plane , was an Inner Plane or Energy Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Negative Energy plane collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . The goddess Shar managed to channel some of this death energy into the Plane of Shadow and create the Shadowfell .

title: Negative energy
description: Negative energy Negative energy was a type of energy originating on the Negative Energy Plane . It manifested as a black , crackling surge of power . It was the antithesis of positive energy , being the " lifeforce " of undead creatures , healing them while causing harm to the living .

title: Negative plane protection
description: Negative plane protection Negative plane protection was an abjuration spell that gave the recipient one chance to completely avoid the draining effects of a negative energy attack . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient in order to cast this spell .

title: Neheedra Duskryn
description: Neheedra Duskryn Neheedra Duskryn was a medusa ally of Ogremoch ' s Bane in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . As a drow , she was full of greed and vanity , obsessed by spell gems for their power and beauty .

title: Nehushta
description: Nehushta Nehushta was a primordial artificer who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . Description . Nehushta was a massive being made of different metallic alloys who shined star - white when roused to fury .

title: Neifion
description: Neifion Neifion is an archfey of the Feywild . His title is the " Lord of Bats " . Neifion has been known to enter into a fey pact with warlock s .

title: Nekiset
description: Nekiset Nekiset was the most powerful cleric in service to Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . Born in Sampranasz as a slave , Nekiset became the leader of her slave group as a youth , impressing her masters .

title: Nelanther Isles
description: Nelanther Isles The Nelanther Isles were a widely scattered chain of nearly one thousand islands west of Amn and Tethyr in the Trackless Sea . More than half the islands lacked potable water and were an unfit place to live . The hundreds of islands that could support life were fought over by ruthless pirates who tended to prey upon the shipping lines of Amn , Tethyr , Calimshan , the Sword Coast and the Moonshae Isles .

title: Neldorild
description: Neldorild Neldorild was a the fourth largest city in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Description . Neldorild was located on the coast on the Alamber Sea .

title: Neldryn Hawklyn
description: Neldryn Hawklyn Neldryn Hawklyn was a male wizard who was one the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar but was killed by the magister Dorgon Heamilolothtar . History . Neldryn was the Royal Mage and the leader of the magelord s that ruled the kingdom of Athalantar .

title: Nelkin Danniker
description: Nelkin Danniker Nelkin Danniker , better known as the Snail , was a member of the Zhentarim in Daggerford sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Nelkin was the primary Zhent contact of the succubus Pencheska .

title: Nellis Saradexma
description: Nellis Saradexma Nellis Saradexma was an Imaskari human wizard who served as the ambassador of High Imaskar . Description . Nellis was tall and thin , and had gray lines , like those of genasi , adorning his skin in intricate patterns .

title: Nelnfaen Sauntarae
description: Nelnfaen Sauntarae Nelnfaen Sauntarae was the only drow Magister . He hailed from Sshamath and reigned from 1104 DR to 1126 DR . History .

title: Nelve Harssad
description: Nelve Harssad Nelve Harssad was an inhabitant of Tsurlagol , a traveler and an author . Nelve was the author of " My Journeys Around the Sea of Fallen Stars " , a book detailing their travels on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was written in the Year of the Sword and Stars , 1332 DR .

title: Nelvik
description: Nelvik Nelvik was the pseudodragon companion of Severin Silrajin the Red Dragon Wyrmspeaker and the main leader of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . He was always at his master ' s side during all the Tyranny of Dragons Appendix . Appearances .

title: Nelvine
description: Nelvine Nelvine , also known as pigeon stone , was the Realms name for a variety of called which was found in large quantities in older rock formations . Description . The gem quality version of these ornamental stones had a blue iridescent flash known as " peristerism " .

title: Nelvon deJuan
description: Nelvon deJuan Nelvon deJuan was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster . Personality . Nelvon truly believed in the righteousness of the Cloaks .

title: Nemesis ( property )
description: Nemesis ( property ) Nemesis weapons are quite similar to " bane " weapons in that they grant a given weapon a bonus to accuracy and damage . However , unlike " bane " weapons , wherein the bonus is against a particular creature type , " nemesis " weapons function against creatures which have a particular kind of knowledge or ability . Notable nemesis weapons .

title: Nemevon
description: Nemevon Nemevon was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Nemevon and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Nentyarch
description: Nentyarch Nentyarch is an archaic title given to the rulers of the ancient empire of Narfell . The first Nentyarch , Thargaun Crell , created Dun - Tharos in the Rawlinswood in - 970 DR and forged the Crown of Narfell before uniting the various Nar realms under his rule . The empire of Narfell lasted 794 years until Narfell and the neighboring empire of Raumathar destroyed each other .

title: Neogi
description: Neogi The neogi were a race of spider - like creatures that were usually accompanied by umber hulk s , their large ape / beetle crossover monsters . Description . A neogi appeared to be a small eight - legged creature , no bigger than a small child and they had a head with reflective eyes that sat upon a long eel - like neck .

title: Neothelid
description: Neothelid Neothelids were extremely rare creatures in mind flayer society . To create a neothelid , not only must an illithid tadpole not undergo ceremorphosis , but the elder brain of the colony must have died , as the elder brain would normally eat all tadpoles that failed to undergo ceremorphosis . With the elder brain dead , chaos would erupt in the spawning pools , as the society around them collapsed as well .

title: Nephthys
description: Nephthys Nephthys ( pronounced " nef " - thiss ) was a vain but caring member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . She was known as Nesharia in Thay , and as Neselthia in the nation of Unther . History .

title: Nerath
description: Nerath The world of Nerath was a world on an alternate Material Plane . People . The deva Demascus was originally from this world .

title: Nereid
description: Nereid Nereids were a race of aquatic fey related to the triton s . Like the nymph s who lived in the coves and streams , the dryad s who lived in the trees , and the oread s who dwelt in the mountains , nereids were fey who were bound to the seas and oceans . They physically resembled tritons except that their bodies displaced light , making them nearly transparent and hard to see , especially when they were in the water .

title: Nergal ( archdevil )
description: Nergal ( archdevil ) Nergal was an outcast archdevil exiled by Asmodeus to Avernus . In an attempt to learn the secrets of silver fire , he captured Elminster whilst the wizard was in Avernus and exhausted from sealing a planar rift between Avernus and Shadowdale . Nergal subjected Elminster to horrific suffering , all the while stealing his memories using a mental link , until Nergal ' s body was destroyed by the Simbul ( his life - force seemingly escaped ) .

title: Nergal ( deity )
description: Nergal ( deity ) Nergal was the Untheric deity of the underworld and the dead . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a dark man holding a black shield .

title: Neri
description: Neri Queen Neri was a storm giant queen sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Neri was the queen of the storm giants , married to King Hekaton .

title: Nerise Gladham
description: Nerise Gladham Nerise Gladham was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Nerise was captured by air cultists , who took her to a jail at the Fane until some adventurers infiltrated the temple and freed her .

title: Neronvain
description: Neronvain Neronvain was the Green Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon that attacked the Misty Forest during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Neronvain was the elven prince of the Misty Forest , son of the king Melandrach ; he had a terrible relationship with his father for the cautious mood of the king .

title: Nerrol Hamastyl
description: Nerrol Hamastyl High Steward Nerrol Hamastyl was a half - elf ranger and paladin , and was the High Steward of the Royal Council of Aglarond as of 1374 DR . The council ' s duty was to appoint representatives of the cities and provinces of Aglarond , and Hamastyl was representative of the Simbul at the council , except at times when the Simbul appeared herself .

title: Nerve dance
description: Nerve dance Nerve dance was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created 1 to 3 red streamers to strike forth from the casters hand .

title: Nerve swimmer
description: Nerve swimmer Nerve swimmer derived from immature illithid tadpoles and were used as living instruments of torture and interrogation . In the illithid city of Oryndoll , members of the Abysmal Creed were known to experiment with nerve swimmers to spread terror among other creatures . These experiments with illithid tadpoles were considered distasteful even by other illithids .

title: Nesmé
description: Nesmé Nesmé ( pronounced NEZ - may ) was a small frontier city located in the Savage Frontier of northwest Faerûn , lying by the River Surbrin . Geography . Nesmé sat beside the River Subrin .

title: Nester
description: Nester Nester was one of Halaster Blackcloak ' s apprentices . Description . After achieving lichdom , Nester appeared as a green - glowing , floating skull and skeletal arms .

title: Nesterin Deirr
description: Nesterin Deirr Nesterin Deirr was a star elf bard in the 1370s DR in Sildëyuir . History . In 1374 DR , Nesterin found House Aerilpe abandoned and infested by nilshai .

title: Nestor Podgin
description: Nestor Podgin Nestor Podgin was a shopkeeper and transmuter in Skullport . Personality . Nestor ' s main objective was to discover all that he could about the creation of life .

title: Nestra Ruthiol
description: Nestra Ruthiol Nestra Ruthiol was the ruler of Yartar and a member of the Lords ' Alliance during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Personality . Nestra considered her allegiance to the Lords ' Alliance vital for the survival and prosperity of her city .

title: Nestrun Damond
description: Nestrun Damond Nestrun Damond , formerly Nestrun Farclutch , was a former member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr in 1358 DR . History . Nestrun was one of the original members of the Company in 1344 DR .

title: Net of plenty
description: Net of plenty The net of plenty was a magic item that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , and was prized by fishermen . Description . This item looked like a regular fisherman ' s net .

title: Neth Stand
description: Neth Stand The Neth Stand is a dark , thick forest on the Lake of Steam . It contains underground volcanic vents that emit a sulphurous mist . The wood here is valuable , despite the need to treat it to get rid of the sulphur smell .

title: Nether Mountains
description: Nether Mountains The Nether Mountains were a chain of dark peaks that once marked the boundary between the ancient empires of Netheril and Delzoun . History . Many travelers avoided these peaks , because several orc tribes laired in the region , such as the Thousand Fists and the Ripped Gut tribes who fought ferociously over the Moon Pass , a large gorge that split the mountains into its eastern and western ranges .

title: Nether Scrolls
description: Nether Scrolls Nether Scrolls was the name for a certain set of 50 scrolls that dealt with fundamental magic theory . Description . Nether scrolls were a set of small scrolls that described fundamental magical theory .

title: Nether the Elder
description: Nether the Elder Nether the Elder , also known as King Nether , was the shaman king of Gers , one of the seven towns whose coalition formed Netheril . Personality . The shaman king was tyrannical and egotistical in his rule .

title: Netherese
description: Netherese Netherese are an ethnic group of human s residing in Netheril . Many cultures are either descendant or have been absorbed as Netherese , such as the Shadovar , the Halruaans , the Bedine , and the Illuskans , etc . Society .

title: Netherese arcanist
description: Netherese arcanist In the long past days of Netheril , practitioners of the Art once were able to bend arcane powers in ways few today can match . A small number of people from the time of Netheril , a few lich es ( Larloch being the most well known ) and some of the Princes of Shade from Thultanthar , are direct survivors of that fallen empire . Some few others have researched the past thoroughly enough that they have uncovered the secrets of the ancient Netherese .

title: Netherese language
description: Netherese language Netherese was a language spoken in Netheril both before and after Karsus ' s Folly in - 339 DR . Though it was considered a dead language by 1372 DR , scholars believed that it evolved into the Halruaan and Ruathlek languages . Speakers .

title: Netherese pantheon
description: Netherese pantheon Ancient Netherese Pantheon . Ten deities made up the Netherese pantheon : Amaunator . Amaunator was the deity of order , law , time , and the sun .

title: Netheril
description: Netheril The magocracy of Netheril was one of the ancient human empires of Faerûn . Netheril was also the home of the most powerful wizard who ever walked on Faerûn , Karsus . The Netherese also created powerful artifacts known as mythallar s , which allowed mundane objects to become magical , dramatically changing the face of the Netherese Empire ( or better said , the face of the upper side of the empire , as Netheril eventually became twofold : the " have " , High Netherese , and the " have not " , the low Netherese ) .

title: Netheril ( region )
description: Netheril ( region ) The land of Netheril was the land largely occupied by the nation of Netheril . In the beginning of the Age of Humanity , Netheril was a verdant land , until the coming of the phaerimm . Starting in - 461 DR , the phaerimm started casting spells that caused the lush land to change into desert .

title: Netheril trilogy
description: Netheril trilogy The Netheril trilogy was a series of books set in the " Forgotten Realms " during the age of the Netheril empire ( circa - 700 DR ) . The trilogy was written by Clayton Emery . The main character is the barbarian Sunbright Steelshanks of the northern Rengarth tribe .

title: Netheris Ket
description: Netheris Ket Netheris Ket a human woman of Mulhorand and a glorious servitor of Sebek . She fought hard to gain her exalted position within the cult of Sebek . Once she had access to her deity ' s giant crocodile form , she used it frequently to inspire loyalty in her followers .

title: Nethmoun Aln
description: Nethmoun Aln Nethmoun Aln was a reclusive wizard who lived in a ramshackle hut on the east side of Scornubel . He protected his home with flying daggers , margoyles , and modified " Evard ' s black tentacles " spells . Nethmoun was a collector of rare spells .

title: Nethmurta
description: Nethmurta Nethmurta was the proprietary of the Blinking Owl tavern in Ashabenford and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Dalelands in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Nethmurta owned the the Blinking Owl tavern in Ashabenford and also owned four warehouse in the city .

title: Neutral
description: Neutral The neutral alignment ( sometimes known as true neutral ) is without prejudice or compulsion . In 4th edition mechanics for " " neutral is found under the umbrella of the unaligned alignment . A neutral character does what seems to be a good idea .

title: Neutral evil
description: Neutral evil Neutral evil is pure pragmatism without honor and without variation — survival of the ruthless . In 4th edition mechanics for " " neutral evil is found under the umbrella of the evil alignment . A neutral evil character does whatever he can get away with .

title: Neutral good
description: Neutral good Neutral good characters desire good without bias for or against order . In 4th edition mechanics for " " neutral good is found under the umbrella of the good alignment . A neutral good character does good for goodness ' sake , not because she or he is directed to by law or by whim .

title: Neutralize poison
description: Neutralize poison Neutralize Poison was a spell claimed by various schools that could detoxify one poisonous weapon , poisonous object , a venom - carrying creature , or a victim of poisoning . The reverse of this spell was simply called poison and inflicted a possibly deadly toxin into a target creature . Effects .

title: Nevalle
description: Nevalle Nevalle was a male human fighter , and a member of the Neverwinter Nine in 1374 DR . Description . Nevalle was a very handsome man , with a chiseled physique to match .

title: Neveren Darkdance
description: Neveren Darkdance Neveren Darkdance was a half - drow noble and the father of Myrin Darkdance . He was a member of the Night Masks and trained Ilira Nathalan . Neveren was married to Shalis Ptolexis , a Mulhorand i priestess of Sharess .

title: Neverlight Grove
description: Neverlight Grove The Neverlight Grove was a myconid community in the Northdark . Its isolation permitted the myconids to live in peace until the Rage of Demons . History .

title: Neversfall ( fortress )
description: Neversfall ( fortress ) Neversfall is a fortress in the wilds of Veldorn . Description . Neversfall is comprised of several buildings , most notably three towers , surrounded by a very skillfully made wall of large dark stones and strong mortar .

title: Neverwinter
description: Neverwinter Neverwinter , also known as the City of Skilled Hands or the Jewel of the North , was a metropolis sitting on the northwestern Sword Coast of Faerûn . Neverwinter was regarded by many , including the erudite travel writer Volo , as the most cosmopolitan and the most civilized city in all of Faerûn , quite a reputation , considering the breadth and variety of the continent . The city was a member in good standing of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Neverwinter ( game )
description: Neverwinter ( game ) Dungeons & Dragons : Neverwinter is a free - to - play massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Cryptic Studios and published by Perfect World Entertainment . It was released on the 20th of June 2013 , with additional content updates ( called Modules ) releasing every few months thereafter . The game deals with the aftereffects of an attack on the city of Neverwinter by Valindra Shadowmantle and a dracolich .

title: Neverwinter ( novel )
description: Neverwinter ( novel ) Neverwinter is the second novel in the " The Neverwinter Saga " series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Neverwinter Academy
description: Neverwinter Academy The Neverwinter Academy was a school for magic and combat in the district of the Beggar ' s Nest in the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North . Description . The Neverwinter Academy taught numerous skills , including melee and distance combat , arcane and divine magic , and rogue skills .

title: Neverwinter Nights
description: Neverwinter Nights Neverwinter Nights ( NWN ) , produced by BioWare and published by Infogrames ( now Atari ) , is a third - person perspective computer role - playing game that is based on third edition Dungeons & Dragons rules , set in the Sword Coast , centering around the City of Skilled Hands , Neverwinter . An expansion pack , , was released in June 2003 , and a subsequent expansion pack , was released in December 2003 . In October 2005 , , an expansion pack that includes three new modules was released .

title: Neverwinter Nights 2
description: Neverwinter Nights 2 Neverwinter Nights 2 ( NWN2 ) is a computer role - playing game developed by Obsidian Entertainment and published by . It is the sequel to ' s " Neverwinter Nights " ( NWN ) . Where NWN was based on the " Dungeons & Dragons " 3rd edition rules , NWN2 is based on " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 .

title: Neverwinter Nights 2 : Mask of the Betrayer
description: Neverwinter Nights 2 : Mask of the Betrayer Neverwinter Nights 2 : Mask of the Betrayer ( NWN2 : MotB ) is an expansion to Neverwinter Nights 2 developed by and published by . Players are transported back to the Forgotten Realms shortly after the events detailed in the original Neverwinter Nights 2 . Following the climactic battle against the King of Shadows , the player awakens alone and stranded deep beneath the earth .

title: Neverwinter Nights 2 : Storm of Zehir
description: Neverwinter Nights 2 : Storm of Zehir Neverwinter Nights 2 : Storm of Zehir is an expansion pack for the role - playing video game " Neverwinter Nights 2 " , developed by Obsidian Entertainment and published by Atari . It was first released November 18th 2008 . This was the second and final retail expansion pack for NWN2 .

title: Neverwinter Nights : Hordes of the Underdark
