description: Neverwinter Nights : Hordes of the Underdark Neverwinter Nights : Hordes of the Underdark is the second expansion pack for Neverwinter Nights . New features included new prestige classes , tilesets , monsters and the ability to craft items . The key new feature of the expansion , though , was the introduction of epic levels , which allowed players to theoretically achieve level 40 .

title: Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide
description: Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide Neverwinter Nights : Shadows of Undrentide is an expansion pack for " Neverwinter Nights " produced by Floodgate Entertainment and published by ( now ) . It was released in June 2003 . The expansion scenario pack adds a new campaign and new features including five prestige class es : arcane archer , assassin , blackguard , Harper scout , and shadowdancer ; new creatures , feats , and spells , and other nuances such as allowing the player to access and modify their henchman ' s inventory .

title: Neverwinter Nine
description: Neverwinter Nine The Neverwinter Nine are the personal bodyguards of Lord Nasher Alagondar , the leader of Neverwinter . It was named after the nine guards of the founder of Neverwinter , Lord Halueth Never . History .

title: Neverwinter River
description: Neverwinter River Neverwinter River was a major river that flowed through the Sword Coast North in northwest Faerûn . Description . Neverwinter River ' s bright waters ran warm throughout the year , and many believed this feature was thanks to the heat produced by Mount Hotenow .

title: Neverwinter Tales
description: Neverwinter Tales Neverwinter Tales ( full name : Dungeons & Dragons : The Legend of Drizzt : Neverwinter Tales ) is a collection of five comic issues centering on Thibbledorf Pwent , Drizzt Do ' Urden , and Dahlia Sin ' felle during the events of the Neverwinter Saga . The story was written by R . A .

title: Neverwinter Wood
description: Neverwinter Wood Neverwinter Wood was located in the North , and possessed a sense of magic within it . Geography . Coming from Mount Hotenow , the Neverwinter River flowed through the woods of Neverwinter .

title: Nevik ' Dethig
description: Nevik ' Dethig Nevik ' Dethig was an aboleth in the Lake of Blood . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , having heard the whispers of the demon lord Graz ' zt , Nevik ' Dethig settled inside the Lake of Blood , quickly gaining some orc minions from Maerimydra .

title: Nevron
description: Nevron Nevron was the Zulkir of Conjuration and one of the eight leaders of the Red Wizards of Thay . Appearance . Nevron had several tattoos on his face and body .

title: New Dawn
description: New Dawn New Dawn was the name chosen for a proposed village , farming community , and temple of Lathander in the Hindhorn Hills , northwest of Secomber in the early 1370s DR . Due to the roaming wolves , gnoll s , and orc s in the area , an offer of two dragon s per day was made for anyone defending the project when it began . Its spokesperson was Harammas Malark .

title: New Neverwinter
description: New Neverwinter New Neverwinter was a " movement " based around the rebuilding Neverwinter , but in reality it was a simple propaganda movement by Lord Dagult Neverember to annex the city on behalf of Waterdeep . The movement to create New Neverwinter is being headed by Neverember , whose titles include the Open Lord of Waterdeep , the Lord Protector of Neverwinter , and the heir of Nasher . The propaganda has gone on from 1462 DR to 1480 DR .

title: New Sarshel
description: New Sarshel New Sarshel was a busy trade city of Impiltur . After the Spellplague the city captured some of Lyrabar ' s trade . Several members of Impiltur ' s ruling council lived in New Sarshel , which increased the city ' s influence .

title: New Velar
description: New Velar New Velar ( formerly Harrowdale Town or Harrowdale ) was the capital and largest settlement of Harrowdale in the Dalelands . Names . The town began as Harrowdale Town ( or simply Harrowdale ) , but , in 1428 DR , the town was renamed New Velar , to mark the formal alliance between the Council of Seven Burghers and Myth Drannor .

title: Newander
description: Newander Newander was a druid who worshipped the deity Silvanus . Description . Newander had sandy brown hair and was just under six feet tall .

title: Newsbearer
description: Newsbearer A newsbearer was a small device made out of glass , used by the inhabitants of Ten Towns in Icewind Dale to communicate across large distances . Description . The glasspiece would be used to reflect sunlight in a series of signaling codes .

title: Newt ( faerie dragon )
description: Newt ( faerie dragon ) Newt was a faerie dragon who lived in Myrloch Vale . History . Newt made the acquaintance of Tristan Kendrick when the prince and his companions were on a mission to rescue Keren Donnell .

title: Newt Longscar
description: Newt Longscar Newt Longscar was a bloodforge mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Newt Longscar mustered and trained a bloodforge army in the Serpent Valley to fight against the advancing commander of the Legendary Campaign , who aimed to unify the Utter East through conquest . The commander tried to strike first before Newt was fully prepared and established .

title: Nexal
description: Nexal Nexal was once the capital of the greatest empire in Maztica and the center of the cult of Zaltec . It was destroyed in the Night of Wailing and is now a monster infested ruin . Once hundreds of thousands humans lived within Nexal .

title: Nexalan
description: Nexalan The Nexalans ( or Nexala ) were the largest ethnicity living in Maztica . They were one of the seven major tribes of Maztican s . When most folk in Faerûn used the term " Maztican " , they were most likely referring to Nexalans , as Nexalans were the only people of Maztica who had traveled to the east as of 1372 DR .

title: Nezram
description: Nezram Nezram , known as the World - Walker , was a powerful Mulhorand i wizard who traveled the planes extensively . Activities . Nezram was a wizard with a passion for gemstones and he specialized in planar and transportation magics .

title: Nezram ' s amethyst aura
description: Nezram ' s amethyst aura Nezram ' s amethyst aura was an abjuration spell shielding the subject from poison and disease . It was presumably developed by Nezram . Effect .

title: Nezram ' s emerald energy shield
description: Nezram ' s emerald energy shield Nezram ' s emerald energy shield was an abjuration spell that caused the target to be covered by an emerald green hued layer of protective energy . Effects . This shield protected against effects causing deafness and sonic type attacks .

title: Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding
description: Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding Nezram ' s sapphire screen of shielding was an abjuration spell that had the dubious distinction of having one of the longest names in the school of Abjuration . Effects . It created a floating , square shaped shield of sapphire blue colored force that protected the target from physical and magical attacks .

title: Nezrebe
description: Nezrebe Nezrebe , the White Knight , was a mortal servant of Yeenoghu often proclaimed as his " exarch " , though this was in fact a misnomer since exarchs were divine in nature . Nezrebe stood about nine feet tall and was covered in whitish fur that blackened near the armpits and groin . He wielded a powerful bastard sword , " Winnower " as his weapon of choice .

title: Nezznar
description: Nezznar Nezznar , also known as the " Black Spider " , was a drow who was in search of the Forge of Spells in Wave Echo Cave . The drow promised a share to Iarno Albrek in exchange for his loyalty and aid . Nezznar was the true leader of the Redbrands , controlling them ( as well as the Cragmaw tribe of goblin s and bugbear s ) in the hopes of finding Wave Echo Cave and unlocking its secrets ( while also keeping it a secret for himself ) .

title: Nhar - del
description: Nhar - del Nhar - del the Black was a necromancer agent of the Zhentarim in the Dalelands . Description . A pale man dressed in black , Nhar - del had blue eyes , a bald head , and a full brown goatee .

title: Nhyris D ' Hothek
description: Nhyris D ' Hothek Nhyris D ' Hothek was a yuan - ti slaver who possessed the Crown of Horns prior to the Spellplague . History . Nhyris was a slaver living lived in Skullport working under his uncle Zstulkk Ssarmn of the Iron Ring .

title: Ni - Ko Oasis
description: Ni - Ko Oasis The Ni - Ko Oasis , also known as Mud Pit Hollow , was traditionally consider the endpoint of the Golden Way and the Spice Road and the boundary between Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Geography . Located in the Plain of Horses , the oasis was a boggy forest bordering on a swamp .

title: Nicomantis
description: Nicomantis Nicomantis was a cleric with strange powers in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Nicomantis had a strange power over all predacious six - legged insects .

title: Nicos Corynian
description: Nicos Corynian Nicos Corynian was an influential chessenta n noble in 1479 DR . He was also a secret servant of the green dragon Skuthosiin . Description .

title: Nigel Findley
description: Nigel Findley Nigel D . Findley was the author of a number of books for roleplaying games . He is known chiefly for his work on the Dungeons & Dragons and Shadowrun roleplaying games .

title: Nigel Thunderstorm
description: Nigel Thunderstorm Nigel Thunderstorm was a dwarf chef of Citadel Adbar in the late 15th century DR . History . Nigel was the personal chef of King Harbromm .

title: Night ' s jambiya
description: Night ' s jambiya Night ' s jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell cloaked a jambiya , or any other form of dagger , in a shroud of impenetrable shadow .

title: Night Helm
description: Night Helm The Night Helm is a magical helmet supposedly created centuries ago by Elminster himself for the King of Cormyr . The helm protects the wearer from any mind affecting spell and from scrying . The helm was kept in the Kings Tower in Marsember to be used by an Obarskyr on the run .

title: Night Kiss
description: Night Kiss The Night Kiss was the most notorious tavern in Gontal City . Its owner was a spellscar red tiefling named Narla Gulmaern , who had the ability to disrupt arcane magic and ritual s with her mere presence , making the tavern a safe and popular place for important meetings and illegal activities alike .

title: Night Knives
description: Night Knives The Night Knives was a small thieves ' guild that operated out of Selgaunt , Sembia . Organization . The guild numbered forty or so members with a mix of thieves , smugglers , fences and a couple wizard s and priests of Mask .

title: Night Mask deathbringer
description: Night Mask deathbringer The Night Mask Deathbringer is a special prestige class of the Night Masks in Faerûn . The Night Mask Deathbringers serve the leadership of the Night Masks as their most elite assassins and lieutenants , feared by the natives of Westgate , and hungry for power in their own right . The vampiric leadership of the Night Masks created the Deathbringers as unique intermediaries between themselves and those outside of the guild .

title: Night Masks ( guild )
description: Night Masks ( guild ) The Night Masks were a criminal organization based in the city of Westgate . They controlled the criminal underworld of the city and performed assassinations , kidnappings , extortion , smuggling , and blackmail . Organization .

title: Night Parade
description: Night Parade The Night Parade were a group of Netherese arcanist s who emigrated from the Prime Material Plane to the Demiplane of Nightmares in the Year of Nightmares ( - 681 DR ) . Over time their descendants begin to be born , twisted by the magic of the realm , into nightmarish creatures , the Night Parade that is known today . At an unconfirmed date relatively recently , those of the Night Parade created " gates " back into the Prime Material Plane because their homeplane was becoming overpopulated .

title: Night Trees
description: Night Trees The Night Trees were two small forests located between Moonwood and Cold Wood . Description . These dark and silent forests were shunned by dwarves , elves , humans and orcs , as an ancient evil power lurked in the dark under the foliage .

title: Night ale
description: Night ale Night ale was an ale brewed in Voonlar specifically for the Swords Meet inn " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . This strong ale was very dark in color and thus the name .

title: Night hag
description: Night hag Night hags are incredibly evil creatures hailing from the Fiendish Planes . They are known for their mercilessness and ability to walk in the dreams of others . In the fiendish planes they are powerful creatures , being the creators of the process that creates altraloth s , powerful unique yugoloth s , but much more commonly known for being able to harvest soul larvae which are used as currency in the Abyss , Blood Rift and Nine Hells .

title: Night of Crystal & Iron
description: Night of Crystal & Iron The Night of Crystal and Iron was a decisive battle during the Fall of Zhentil Keep . One night , in Alturiak , the forces belonging to the delicate alliance between the white dragon s and frost giant s in Cyric ' s siege army came together in an all - out offensive against the Keep . Amazingly , the tired and starving Zhentilar defenders managed to hold their line against the onslaught .

title: Night of Fourteen Magisters
description: Night of Fourteen Magisters The Night of the Fourteen Magisters was an event involving the position of Magister on Eleasis 4 of 709 DR . It all started with a plot by the archmage Zunroun Iber of Calimport to kill the reigning Magister , Almer Galarthund . With the help of his three assistants ( two of whom died in the process ) , Zunroun clone d himself a dozen times .

title: Night of Pirates
description: Night of Pirates The Night of Pirates was an event that took place in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep late in the month of Uktar in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . A pirate - lord hailing from the Nelanther Isles , Elro Starankh , led ninety - six crewmen from three ships into the Heartflame festhall on Snail Street . He proceeded to offer the proprietress , famed madam Nauloene Tharantra , a commission of twenty dragons for each girl who agreed to marry one of the seadogs .

title: Night of Temple Fires
description: Night of Temple Fires The Night of Temple Fires occurred in Waterdeep in 1345 DR . Following a period of unrest between followers of the churches of Lathander , Selûne , Shar and Tempus , one night of violence and looting resulted in the destruction of the Spires of the Morning and the House of Heroes , and the sacking of a subterrenean temple of Shar near Shadows Alley . The Dark Army of the Night tried , but failed to set fire to the House of the Moon .

title: Night of Wailing
description: Night of Wailing The Night of Wailing was the name given to the night during which Nexal was destroyed and many of the inhabitants turned into monsters . Several prophets of Qotal foresaw the events before they occurred and the priestess Erixitl attempted to prevent the calamity . Events were set into motion when Cordell ' s lover and mage Darien killed the Nexalan ruler Naltecona .

title: Night of the Hunter
description: Night of the Hunter Night of the Hunter is the first novel in the Companions Codex by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Nightcloak
description: Nightcloak The nightcloak is a special prestige class for clerics and rangers who worship Shar . Nightcloaks serve Shar in a variety of capacities such as helping her hide knowledge , search for her enemies , and using the Shadow Weave to increase her power . Most nightcloaks possess great charisma and intelligence , a powerful combination to manipulate ignorant nobles and commoners alike to bring about events pleasing to Shar ' s vision of the end of all existence .

title: Nighthaunt
description: Nighthaunt A nighthaunt is a type of nightshade ; a sentient undead monster from the Plane of Shadow . Thoroughly unnatural and malicious , they take delight in the corruption and suffering of others . As creatures of both death and shadow , they have tremendous powers over darkness .

title: Nighthunt
description: Nighthunt The Nighthunt was a quite quiet and rather comfortable inn to the east of Loudwater . Location . The inn was located one ' s day ride east of Loudwater on the south part of the road to Llorkh .

title: Nightlight
description: Nightlight Nightlight was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It glowed with bioluminescence and was sensitive to being touched by creatures or objects . Description .

title: Nightmare ' s Hoof
description: Nightmare ' s Hoof The Nightmare ' s Hoof was a mountain range located in southeastern Returned Abeir , near the Dragon Sea . It separated the city of Sambral from the rest of the Windrise Ports . Geographical features .

title: Nightmare ( creature )
description: Nightmare ( creature ) A nightmare was a neutral evil outsider from the Lower Planes . They were a type of fiend that existed in the dimensions beyond the natural world . Description .

title: Nightscale
description: Nightscale Nightscale armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Nightscale was similar to leather armor , but it was made from dark snakeskin .

title: Nightscar
description: Nightscar Nightscar was an illusion spell that put a mark on a creature or object that only the caster and those chosen by the caster could see . Effects . If this spell was cast upon a person or creature , they had a chance to resist being marked even if they were unaware that they were targeted .

title: Nightshade
description: Nightshade Nightshades were large undead creatures from the Plane of Shadow . They were a horrifying mixture of death and darkness , made more frightening by their alien intelligence and spellcasting powers . All nightshades were surrounded by an aura of " desecration " that could draw life from the living .

title: Nightshade ( nightclub )
description: Nightshade ( nightclub ) The Nightshade was a nightclub in Scornubel in the late 1360s DR It was dim and usually crowded , and a home to music , passion , and shady dealings . It served as a festhall and gambling house . It lay on top of the crypt of the Wondermen , although the club ' s staff denied its existence or claimed that the secret panel that granted access to the crypt moved regularly .

title: Nightstar ( selukiira )
description: Nightstar ( selukiira ) The Nightstar was the " selu ' kiira " of Saelethil Dlardrageth in which the old secrets of Aryvandaar were recorded . Description . The Nightstar was a dagger - shaped deep purple crystal about 3 in ( 0 .

title: Nightstone
description: Nightstone Nightsone was a fortified settlement located near the Ardeep Forest , in the hills between Waterdeep and Daggerford . It was connected to the High Road via a side trail . Geography .

title: Nightwalker
description: Nightwalker A nightwalker was a type of nightshade ; a sentient undead monster from the Plane of Shadow . It was unnatural and malicious , and it took delight in the corruption and suffering of others . It was a creature of both death and shadows , and had enormous powers over darkness .

title: Nihal
description: Nihal Nihal , sometimes called the Serpent Star , was an Elder Evil from the Far Realm who had taken possession of one of the stars of Realmspace . Unlike normal stars , Nihal didn ' t have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across the Realmspace . Description .

title: Nikitsky
description: Nikitsky Nikitsky lived within the city of Almorel in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Nikitsky served as the Mechnik , or leader , of the governing body of Almorel called the Gospoda .

title: Niko
description: Niko Niko was an woman in Chu ' Yuan province in Shou Lung . History . Niko lived in village of Tangan in Keluh Valley with her mother Shanshu .

title: Niko Sevek
description: Niko Sevek Niko Sevek was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Niko was the steward of Zor Aleksi Drejkov .

title: Nikol
description: Nikol Nikol was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Nikol had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .

title: Nikolai Nikopolis
description: Nikolai Nikopolis Nikolai Nikopolis was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Nikolai was a repugnant pig .

title: Nilbog
description: Nilbog Nilbogs were goblin s afflicted with a strange space - time reversal disease known as Nilbogism . The disease appeared to occur when heavy use of magic strained the fabric of the space - time continuum , leading to some very strange localized events . The disease only affected goblins and was not transmitted by them .

title: Nilhogg ' s nose
description: Nilhogg ' s nose Nilhogg ' s nose was a small fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was edible , but provided no nutrition . When consumed , it enhanced the sense of smell for one to four hours , improving the chance of detecting and / or identifying odors .

title: Nilraun Dhaerlost
description: Nilraun Dhaerlost Nilraun Dhaerlost was a wizard member of the Zhentarim and an ally of the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Nilraun was always obsessed with find the Ring of Winter .

title: Nilsa
description: Nilsa Nilsa was an astral deva in service to Tyr in 1384 – 1385 DR . History . When the Spellplague hit , Nilsa and Garin were commanders of the celestial armies that tried to repel the evil outsiders who arrived in Celestia .

title: Nilshai
description: Nilshai Nilshai are sorcerer s native to the Ethereal Plane and are sometimes referred to as ethereal theurges by star elves . These malevolent alien sorcerers spend most of their time on the Ethereal Plane , but they sometimes mount expeditions to the Material Plane to obtain lore and magic . They are servants of the Abolethic Sovereignty and have been invading Sildëyuir , the extraplanar home of the star elves , for several centuries , making portal s to the demiplane that alter the plane ’ s essence , and have recently begun to assault the stars elves ’ citadels .

title: Nimbaud
description: Nimbaud Nimbaud was the highest - ranking member of the Zhentarim left in Zhentil Keep during late 1368 DR . History . Nimbaud chose to remain in Zhentil Keep in 1368 DR when Manshoon , sensing Cyric ' s plan , decided to relocated most of the Zhentarim , himself included , to the Citadel of the Raven .

title: Nimbral
description: Nimbral Nimbral was an island nation that was probably the most mysterious land in all of Abeir - Toril . Pegasi - mounted warriors attacked a lot of foreign merchants ( though almost always because they were slavers or pirates ) and large fleets that headed in the supposed direction of the island had a history of being turned away . Nimbral was self - sufficient and only traded with Samarach , Halruaa ( both of these only infrequently though ) and Zakhara , all mysterious and nigh - unknown lands themselves .

title: Nimlith
description: Nimlith Nimlith was a small fishing community on the island of Evermeet , consisting of around 200 non - magical wooden structures and inhabited mainly by moon elves ( silver elves ) . Fishing . The fisherfolk of the town caught hake , salmon , and whitefish from the waters west of the island .

title: Nimoar
description: Nimoar Nimoar , " the Reaver " , was the leader of a human tribe of barbarians in Northwest Faerûn . The tribe was one of many to attack a small settlement on the Sword Coast North , but this tribe was the one that succeeded , leading to Nimoar ' s tribe taking over the settlement and naming it Nimoar ' s Hold , but this would soon be changed to Waterdeep , the name used by sea captains docking at the harbor . Background .

title: Nimor Imphraezl
description: Nimor Imphraezl Nimor Imphraezl was a talented and deadly zekyl assassin of the Jaezred Chaulssin . In the post - Spellplague era , Nimor became the patron of a Jaezred Chaulssin fosterage in Menzoberranzan under the guise of Nagyon Nurindyn , a member of House Nurindyn . Description .

title: Nimor Ironvice
description: Nimor Ironvice Nimor Ironvice was a member of a group of duergar followers of Asmodeus under Fire - Speaker Kholzourl who mined hellthorn in the depths of Gauntlgrym around 1480 DR . He scouted the surface and there Nimor met and befriend Mordai Vell , leader of the Ashmadai . Vell also wanted hellthorn , so Nimor started smuggling the mineral to the ashmadai for a very high price .

title: Nimpeth
description: Nimpeth Nimpeth is a city - state on the southern shore of the Vilhon Reach , near to Sespech . Its inhabitants are fiercely proud and paranoid about their trades and produce , and any visitors who question or doubt this are likely to be attacked . Economy .

title: Nindil Jalbuck
description: Nindil Jalbuck Nindil Jalbuck , a deceased lightfoot halfling and Masked Lord of Waterdeep , was killed and replaced by a doppelganger in 1372 . Nindil was originally from Secomber but went to Waterdeep in search of fortune . Initially Nindil worked as thief but later became a spy and information broker .

title: Nine Bells
description: Nine Bells The Nine Bells was a huge warehouse built over the hulks of nine sunken ships in the Sargauth river in Skullport . The warehouse functioned as the primary market for the town . A wide variety of goods were available for purchase although availabilities varied day - to - day .

title: Nine Golden Swords
description: Nine Golden Swords When Shou immigrants first began traveling west from the lands of Kara - Tur to settle in Thesk and other lands of the west , they brought with them the secret society of yakuza known as the Nine Golden Swords . Their leader was known as the Golden Master , headquartered in the city of Phsant . Marsember .

title: Nine Hells
description: Nine Hells The Nine Hells , sometimes Hell or Hells , also known as Baator in Infernal , was the home of the devil s . It was a plane of sinister evil and institutional cruelty organized in a strict caste system with a very rigid chain of command . Unlike the demon s of the Abyss , the devils were highly organized in their quest for power and status — scheming and plotting power plays , coups , and assassinations .

title: Nine Swords Company
description: Nine Swords Company The Nine Swords Company was an adventuring company that operated in the early days of the Vast , in the 6th century DR . It consisted entirely of practitioners of the Sublime Way . History .

title: Nine jewels of Neverwinter
description: Nine jewels of Neverwinter The nine jewels of Neverwinter were enchanted gem s created long ago that gave the bearer many useful powers . Description . Each " jewel " was a unique item made from a different type of gem .

title: Ning D ' Ahn
description: Ning D ' Ahn Ning D ' Ahn was the seventh High Lama of Tabot in 1357 DR . History . The sixth high lama chose Ning D ' Ahn as his successor when Ning was only eight years old .

title: Ninja
description: Ninja Ninjas used deception , " ki " powers , and martial arts to defeat their enemies , gather information , and steal secrets . Though they lacked the outright combat prowess of fighter s and barbarian s , they were adept at bringing foes to battle on their own terms , seeming to appear and disappear at will . In Faerûn , the ninja arts , or ninjutsu , were believed to have originated on the eastern continent of Kara - Tur .

title: Ninth Serôs War
description: Ninth Serôs War The Ninth Serôs War was a conflict fought between the merfolk realm of Hmurrath and the merrow Axe Kingdoms of Khuur and Nmalk , in the undersea land of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . Background .

title: Niofu Sangto
description: Niofu Sangto Niofu Sangto was a hero of Koryo . Niofu Sangto defeated the Kozakura n navy in the Battle of Wui Eyong in the year Koryo 812 and possessed the " sitting dog " , a magical chalice of uncertain powers , and was the last known have to used it . Niofu Sangto also owned a fortress that stood on the coast somewhere to the east of the city of Tu Pe .

title: Niro Longtooth
description: Niro Longtooth Niro Longtooth was a brigand in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . The oppressive Niro Longtooth extorted the folk of Vanesci Hamlet into giving up their food supplies , else the town would be raided . When the commander of the Legendary Campaign returned , with followers starving for food , the villagers had none to spare .

title: Nirva
description: Nirva Nirva was a cloud giant on a quest sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , after the disappearance of King Hekaton , Nirva and sibling Jaral went on a quest in order to place the cloud giant stripe ( and themselves ) at the top of the renewed ordning .

title: Nirvana
description: Nirvana Nirvana , sometimes called Mechanus , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology representing the alignment of lawful neutral and home of the modron s . Description . This plane was filled with an infinite number of country - sized circular interlocking gears which were habitable on one or both sides .

title: Nishaadhri
description: Nishaadhri Nishaadhri , or the Bound Ones , were mages of Vaasa who swore lifelong fealty to the Warlock Knights . Description . All nishaadhri wore a dark veil over their eyes .

title: Nishan Rhindaun
description: Nishan Rhindaun Prince Nishan Rhindaun was the father of Queen Cyriana III of Tethyr . Relationships . Nishan was a grandson of Zaranda Star , the famous adventuress and first queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty , through his mother Queen Sybille II .

title: Nishrek
description: Nishrek Nishrek was a fiendish plane in the World Tree cosmology model and later an astral dominion in the World Axis cosmology model . Prior to the discovery of the World Tree , it was Gruumsh ' s realm in Acheron , occupying one face of a gigantic cube ( and then later , the whole cube ) as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Nishrek was the last known home of the orc pantheon , which tended to wander or be forced out of various previous homes .

title: Niskam Tresdaap
description: Niskam Tresdaap Niskam Tresdaap was a male human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Lance of the Lord . The aging seneschal , Trusted Sword Jak Errins was soon to retire and Niskam was maneuvering to take over the leadership of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard His chief rival was Battlelady Peris Whallnsor . Niskam was under the sway of Sapphiraktar , an undead blue dracolich and a Runemaster of the Twisted Rune .

title: Nisstyre
description: Nisstyre Nisstyre was a drow wizard and leader of the merchant band Dragon ' s Hoard . Description . Nisstyre was thin , with a sharp - featured face , elegantly pointed ears and a mane of unusual copper - colored hair that he normally put up in a ponytail .

title: Nistlor Lothlyn
description: Nistlor Lothlyn Nistlor " The Undying " Lothlyn is a smoothspoken wizard and proprietor of the House of the Wise Unicorn who has recently been turning to necromancy and even lichdom . Having already mastered the summoning of lesser undead he now hoards potions of longevity , purchasing them at every opportunity . Nistlor has three apprentices who help run the Unicorn and assist with his acquiring of spell components .

title: Nisviim
description: Nisviim Nisviim was an arcanaloth enchanter who lived in Corpsehaven in the Blood Rift . He was the chief assistant of Inthracis and the vice - commander of the Black Horn Regiment , an elite army 500 strong . Relationships .

title: Nivlin Goskull
description: Nivlin Goskull Nivlin Goskull was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Nivlin was a prankster and was known to leave the severed heads of animals on a pillow in some guests ' rooms .

title: Niwa Hirotada
description: Niwa Hirotada Niwa Hirotada was the samurai leader of the Niwa clan and shugo - daimyo of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Hirotada was always a supporter of Takenaka Okawa and after the Hojo War he was nominated shugo - daimyo of Miyama by the shikken .

title: Niwa Onshi
description: Niwa Onshi Niwa Onshi was a samurai member of the Niwa clan and shugodai of Kuda in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Onshi lived in Kuda where he had his office .

title: Niwa Sutai
description: Niwa Sutai Niwa Sutai was a samurai member of the Niwa clan and overseer of Kabe in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Kabe , he led a company of four samurai and ten bushi .

title: Niwa clan
description: Niwa clan The Niwa clan was the most powerful samurai family in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . The Niwa possessed most of the land and thanks to their allegiance with the Takenaka clan , their members were granted the position of shugo - daimyo , several shugodai positions , and many other jito positions on the largest shoen in Miyama .

title: Nixie
description: Nixie Nixies are an aquatic race of sprite . They dwell in ponds , streams , rivers , and even lakes . They are generally playful and sometimes invite passerbys to come swim and play with them .

title: Nizidramanii ' yt
description: Nizidramanii ' yt Nizidramanii ' yt was a black dragon who allied with Jon Irenicus , attacking Suldanessellar and once there guarding the Goblet of Life to prevent anyone from following Irenicus to the Tree of Life . Gorion ' s Ward and companions had to face Nizidramanii ' yt and acquire the Goblet . They could fight or bargain for the Goblet , but the dragon would only give it for all of their treasure ( gold and magic items ) , lying that he had no other treasure himself .

title: Njal
description: Njal Njal was a dwarf and part of a valiant group who defended Dead Dwarf Bridge against forces from Narfell who hoped to invade Almorel . History . A wizard from Narfell cast a spell upon Njal , forcing him to attack his fellow dwarves .

title: Nmalk
description: Nmalk Nmalk was a merrow kingdom of Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR . Alongside Khuur , it was one of the two Axe Kingdoms that represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs . History .

title: No - Nose
description: No - Nose No - Nose was a goblin leader of history in the Orsraun Mountains . History . Around 1258 DR , No - Nose led the Bloodier Teeth goblin band .

title: No Foolish Matter
description: No Foolish Matter No Foolish Matter , designed by Ash Law , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the hamlet of Hillpicket , and a travelling carnival . Summary .

title: No Ziar
description: No Ziar No Ziar , called the Mole , was a male human wu jen who dwelled in the Vorkani Mountains and in the settlement of Pan in Koryo around 1357 DR . Description . Short - statured and hunch - backed , with a shaved head and such bad myopia that he was always squinting , his nickname was very fitting .

title: Noanar ' s Hold
description: Noanar ' s Hold Noanar ' s Hold was a village , just off the Evermoor Way just on the edge of the High Forest , that grew up around one of the most famous hunting lodges in the North . Cottages and well - kept stables rambled between the trees . The village could be reached from Calling Horns .

title: Nobanion
description: Nobanion Nobanion ( pronounced " no - BAN - yun " ) , also known as the King of Beasts , Lord Firemane or the Lion King , is a primal spirit sometimes worshiped as a deity of royalty , lion s , and other felines , as well as good beasts . Nobanion was considered to have originally been an interloper deity on Toril , but since his arrival he has firmly established himself within the Faerûnian pantheon . His worship is especially strong in Gulthmere Forest and among the wemic s of the Shining Plains .

title: Noble Adventurer of Cormyr
description: Noble Adventurer of Cormyr Noble Adventurer of Cormyr is a Prestige class whose name is a bit of a misnomer . Nobles can come from any civilised land , though Cormyr is one of the better known producers of those who take this class . Entrants to this class don ' t even have to be nobles , they could just be educated and wealthy merchants or adventurers who have bought themselves political clout .

title: Noble Hand
description: Noble Hand The Noble Hand was a temple of Helm in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . It was the most prominent temple of Helm in the Realms . It also operated as a school for training professional guards .

title: Noble dao
description: Noble dao Noble dao ruled the genie s living on the Elemental Plane of Earth . They used earth elemental s , dao , xorn , and other slaves to mine precious gems , which they craved . Description .

title: Noble djinni
description: Noble djinni Noble djinn ruled the genie s living on the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Noble djinn were taller and more fair than regular djinn , who had darker complexions .

title: Noble efreeti
description: Noble efreeti Noble efreet were the warlords of the efreet though they still reported to the Sultan of the City of Brass . These creatures plotted against one another with cunning similar to creatures found on the lower planes . They would try to corrupt any sha ’ ir who summoned them .

title: Noble eladrin
description: Noble eladrin Noble eladrin , sometimes simply called eladrin , are powerful beings who have become so infused with the power of the Feywild that they have become entirely new creatures , taking on aspects of the seasons and other natural phenomena . Noble eladrin are powerful archfey of comparative strength to demon prince s or archdevil s , and who are most commonly found in the Feywild or celestial plane s , particularly Arvandor and Gates of the Moon . Like most eladrin , noble eladrin are almost always free - spirited and noble individuals , whose power often reflects the seasons and other natural phenomena .

title: Noble marid
description: Noble marid Noble marids were powerful masters of the oceans . Description . Noble marids had pearls for teeth and currents for muscles , making them the strongest and handsomest of all genie kind .

title: Noble tombs
description: Noble tombs Noble tombs were the final resting places of the khans of the Hordelands . Description . The appearance of a noble tomb could vary greatly depending on the wealth and status of the khan in question , ranging anywhere from a simple grave to an elaborate burial mound .

title: Nobruzzal
description: Nobruzzal Nobruzzal was a male drow wizard and a student of Solom Ned ' razak at the Inverted Tower in Szith Morcane . Description . A tall and gaunt male drow , Nobruzzal distinguished himself by dressing entirely in black .

title: Nobu Chuya
description: Nobu Chuya Nobu Chuya was a wakadoshiyori inspector in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Chuya was an administrator of the Karo in Jasuga but his math skills so impressed the shogun that he was promoted to the wakadoshiyori council despite his young age .

title: Noelin Tlestlin
description: Noelin Tlestlin Noelin Tlestlin was a woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . She worked as a chambermaid at the The Worried Wyvern inn " circa " 1370 DR . She was also in a romantic relationship with proprietor and innkeeper Beliost Sevenecho — as were three fellow chambermaids , Mreeiel Klintar , Lauryn Shavvyrstar , and Chyndrie Stormwind .

title: Nog
description: Nog Nog was a fallen kingdom of Zakhara , that lay in the jungles of the Nogaro and adjacent river valleys , Southeast of the Haunted Lands and South of the World Pillar Mountains and Jungle of Monsters . It was believed to be younger than the other known lost empire in the region , Kadar . Its language was Noga .

title: Nogah
description: Nogah Nogah was a kuo - toa senior whip and a cleric . Appearance . Nogah had scaled skin and webbed hands and feet , and was quite bloated .

title: Nogami Sado
description: Nogami Sado Nogami Sado was a samurai retainer of Niwa clan that command the Niiashima - jo garrison in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a castle on a small isle strategic for control eastern Miyama he led one hundred samurai and three hundred bushi .

title: Nojheim
description: Nojheim Nojheim was a male goblin from the Silver Marches who was kept as a slave in the human village of Pengallen . Description . Nojheim was a typical - looking goblin .

title: Nok
description: Nok Nok was a goblin who lived in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR , and twin to Nyk . Nok and Nyk were a pair of enterprising goblin s who swept up the dung left by the Raging Bull , a long - imprisoned minotaur suspended from the ceiling by The Deepfires inn . They used the dung as manure to grow mushrooms .

title: Nola Treestump
description: Nola Treestump Nola Treestump was a halfling priestess of Sheela Peryroyl inhabiting the Long Forest in 1367 DR . Activities . Nola spent much of her time protecting the western region of the forest against bandits and other foul creatures who tried to push their way into her domain .

title: Nolaloth
description: Nolaloth Nolaloth , more completely known as Nolalothcaragascint , was a crystal great wyrm that was asked by the Illefarn Empire to destroy their great Guardian following the fall of Netheril . War with the King of Shadows . The Guardian had been created from one of Illefarn ' s greatest champions , his soul tied to the ancient Weave to become a construct of power great enough to deter Netherese attack .

title: Nolan
description: Nolan Nolan was a priest from Caer Corwell . Description . The friar was a short fat man with a bald head .

title: Nomadic centaur
description: Nomadic centaur Nomadic centaurs were more rugged versions of the common sylvan centaur . They could be found roaming the vast steppes and plains of the Hordelands . Compared to common centaurs , they were more introverted , preferring the company of their own kind .

title: Nomi Pathshutter
description: Nomi Pathshutter Nomi Pathshutter was the second - in - command of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Nomi concentrated her efforts on eradicating Ogremoch ' s Bane .

title: Nomog - Geaya
description: Nomog - Geaya Nomog - Geaya was the hobgoblin deity of war and authority . Physical description . The god appeared as a huge , powerful goblin with rough , ash - gray skin , cold orange eyes , and teeth like a shark ' s .

title: Non Lu Non
description: Non Lu Non Non Lu Non was the Minister of Agriculture of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Non Lu Non hailed from a farming family of Wang Ku and this granted him direct knowledge about agriculture .

title: Nondetection
description: Nondetection Nondetection ( or non - detection ) was an abjuration spell that hid the subject from divination and scrying . Effects . The warded creature or object became difficult to detect by divination spells such as " clairaudience / clairvoyance " , " locate object " , and detection spells .

title: Nonthal
description: Nonthal Nonthal was a city located in Turmish . It was known for its industry based on animals and , more notably , the smell that industry produced , which pervaded the entire city . The city contained an unusually high number of gnome s , many of whom were illusionist s .

title: Noodles
description: Noodles Noodles were produced in several shapes and sizes across Kara - tur , and some countries made their own specific varieties . A selection was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Noohar Serelim
description: Noohar Serelim Noohar Serelim was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Noohar was one of the most articulate persons in Faerun .

title: Noori
description: Noori Noori was a member of the Great Worm Tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Noori somehow managed to enter inside the Eye of the All - Father temple .

title: Noori Baenre
description: Noori Baenre Noori Baenre was a female high - born cousin to Triel Baenre . She was one of the few exceptions to the rule of only males at Sorcere circa 1373 DR . She was permitted to study magic at Sorcere rather than become a cleric of Lolth at Arach - Tinilith .

title: Nor Takt
description: Nor Takt Nor Takt was a lake in the Hordelands near Khazari and Ra - Khati . Geography . This lake was found nestled within the foothills of Katakoro Shan .

title: Nor Tso
description: Nor Tso Nor Tso , or the Sky Lake , was a lake in the Hordelands found near the center of the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . The lake sat north of the mighty Hungtse River , forming part of the boundary of the Wild Yak Meadows to the west .

title: Nor Yudol
description: Nor Yudol The Nor Yudol , also known as The Churned One or the Evening Lake , was a lake in the Hordelands . Description . Located in the Katakoro Plateau , the Nor Yudol was named after the mud on the bottom of the lake that rose to the surface , giving it a brown color , and cleansing the poisoned waters of the Muren Tso river into the clean water of the Muren Khi river .

title: Nor Zanskra
description: Nor Zanskra Nor Zanskra was a large lake found in the Hordelands at the northern end of the Katakoro Plateau . Geopgraphy . Nor Zanskra located at the eastern base of a portion the Katakoro Shan range that formed the southern border of Khazari .

title: Noreia
description: Noreia Noreia was an erinyes in the service of Glasya . Description . Noreia had woolly black dreadlocks .

title: Noreyth Harpell
description: Noreyth Harpell Noreyth Harpell was the master vampire of Dhusarra yr Fadila el Abhuk . History . He was attacked in 1315 DR by the Company of the Red Dawn , who were sent by the undead vampire Artor Morlin because Noreyth encroached upon his territory .

title: Norland
description: Norland Norland was an island in the Moonshae Isles that was inhabited primarily by Northlander s . At one time House Kendrick exerted nominal control over the island but as of 1479 DR the isle was ruled by the warrior maiden known as the Storm Maiden . Locations .

title: Nornglast
description: Nornglast Nornglast was the smallest of the " Royal Keeps " of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Nornglast was a place haunted by spirits .

title: Noro Amoto
description: Noro Amoto Noro Amoto was a samurai mercenary in Chessenta . History . Noro Amoto founded the Bushido army to fight the Tuigan during the Horde Wars .

title: Noromath
description: Noromath Noromath was a in name only , being the western half of the elven territory of the great Wealdath forest of Tethyr . Etymology . The name " Noromath " is Elvish for " Legacy of the North " .

title: Norry Waywocket
description: Norry Waywocket Norry Waywocket was a rock gnome sorcerer and a smuggler in Cormyr in the early 1370s DR . He was partner to Coobert Draftworth . Activities .

title: North Center
description: North Center The North Center was a ward of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Northwest District , this ward controlled all trade passing through the River Gate and the Gate of the Ghost .

title: North Faerûn
description: North Faerûn North Faerûn stretches from the wide Anauroch desert in the west to the eastern edge of the inland Moonsea , in the northern region of Faerûn . It is a region of contrasts , with the forested Dalelands , the wastes of Anauroch , the coastline of the Moonsea , and the bitterly cold steppes of The Ride . Regions .

title: North Gate ( Luskan )
description: North Gate ( Luskan ) The North Gate in the city of Luskan was a guarded iron gate at the north end of the Upstream Span bridge . Structure . The north side of the gate was outside the city walls , and one would enter south through the gate , across the Upstream Span bridge and into the city on the southern bank .

title: North Quarter
description: North Quarter The North Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The North Quarter encompassed the Craft District , Central District , and the Warehouse District , forming most of the northern portion of the city .

title: North Ride
description: North Ride The North Ride was a road in the Dalelands that ran from Tilverton in the Shadow Gap in the south , leading to Cormyr , to Voonlar in the north , leading to the Moonsea . Where the road crossed the River Ashaba , the town of Shadowdale is situated .

title: North Road
description: North Road The North Road ran through the Vast from the city of Procampur at its most southern point all the way to Mulmaster on the Moonsea at its most northern point . Description . From north to south it ran through : Mulmaster , Maskyr ' s Eye , Kurth , Three Trees Pass between the Troll Mountains and the Giantspike Mountains , over the River Vesper , through King ' s Reach , Swords Pool , Dead Tree Hollow , Dragon Falls , across the Fire River , through the Earthfast Mountains at Glorming Pass , between the Adhe Wood and Brynwood , Sevenecho where it bent west , Maerstar , and ended at Procampur .

title: North Wind ' s Fury
description: North Wind ' s Fury The North Wind ' s Fury was the pirate vessel of the corsair Makbulla bint Dalmar in 1367 DR . Description . " North Wind ' s Fury " was a 70 ft .

title: North Zakhara
description: North Zakhara The area of north Zakhara was dominated by the conflicting world - views of the independent - minded Free Cities of Zakhara on the one hand and the Mamluk s of Qudra with their fierce loyalty towards the Grand Caliph and belief in order on the other . It was framed by the shores of the Great Sea in the west and north , where it touched Faerûn at the border to Konigheim , and the Land of the Yak - Men in the east . The Furrowed Mountains separated north Zakhara to the south and east from the Haunted Lands in the continent ' s interior .

title: Northdark
description: Northdark The Northdark was a underground domain of the Underdark north and east of the city of Waterdeep . Geography . The area was home to some of the most renowned subterranean realms of Faerûn like the svirfneblin ruins of Blingdenstone , the duergar deepkingdom of Gracklstugh and the drow cities of Menzoberranzan and Ched Nasad .

title: Northeast Faerûn
description: Northeast Faerûn Northeast Faerûn is a remote area that begins in the cold , forbidding lands along the great ice sheets and continues south toward the northeastern shores of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It is bordered on the west by the mountain - hemmed land of Vaasa and stretches east to the vast steppes of the Hordelands . Regions .

title: Northeast Zakhara
description: Northeast Zakhara Northeast Zakhara was in many ways the antithesis to the civilization of the rest of the continent . It comprised the Land of the Yak - Men with their evil empire within the World Pillar Mountains ( the Zakharan part of the Yehimal ) and the untamed expanse of the Jungle of Monsters towards the Foreigners ' Sea . Together they effectively cut off land travel towards Kara - Tur in the northeast and east .

title: Northern Four
description: Northern Four This adventuring group made their names along the Sword Coast North and all eventually came to positions of prominence in that region . The group consisted of Nasher Alagondar , Dumal Erard and the lovers Ophala Cheldarstorn and Kurth . Nasher led the group to many victories in the northlands .

title: Northern Imaskari languages
description: Northern Imaskari languages The Northern Imaskari languages were languages derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the northern parts of the Hordelands . Description . These languages rolled their rs and had broad , rounded vowels .

title: Northern Wastes
description: Northern Wastes The Northern Wastes was an area in the north of Kara - Tur . Geography . Though used by many peoples , the name " Northern Wastes " was misleading , as it was in fact a very diverse and interesting part of Kara - Tur , not to be confused with the Land of the Snow Demons and permafrost further north .

title: Northern Wizards
description: Northern Wizards The Northern Wizards were one of the two spellcasting organizations in Unther . Organizations . They were a group of wizards that considered themselves the protectors of the common people of Messemprar .

title: Northkeep
description: Northkeep Northkeep was the first settlement built on the Moonsea by humans . History . The city was founded in 348 DR ( Year of the Dagger ) on an island near the lake ' s southern shore , about midway between the present towns of Elventree and Elmwood .

title: Northlander
description: Northlander The Northlanders , or sometimes Northmen , were seafaring people who inhabited the northern parts of the Moonshae Isles . Society . Descendants of raiders from the island of Ruathym , the Northlanders were a sturdy , war - ready people who worshiped the god Tempus .

title: Northlook ( inn )
description: Northlook ( inn ) The Northlook was an inn in Bryn Shander . Location . The inn was located next to Bryn Shander ' s North Gate .

title: Northwest District
description: Northwest District The Northwest District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . The Northwest District was found in the Clothiers ' Quarter in the western portion of Huzuz .

title: Northwest Faerûn
description: Northwest Faerûn Northwest Faerûn , generally referred to as The North , is a region of wilderness , difficult winter weather , orc hordes , and barbarian tribes . It is a mostly untamed region that lies west of Anauroch and north of the High Moor . The inhabitants of areas further south , in West Faerûn , describe this area in condescension as " the Savage North , " which is a reference to the Savage Frontier and a time when its inhabitants were less civilized .

title: Northwest Zakhara
description: Northwest Zakhara Northwest Zakhara consisted of a number of islands on a beautiful shallow part of the Great Sea off the northern coast of the continent . The two larger archipelagos of the Genie ' s Turban and the Desert ' s Virtues made up the Corsair Domains , with the one major settlement , Hawa . Closer toward the coast of the Free Cities , authority over the Wizard ' s Reach toward the north and the group of three islands — the Bird , the Dancer and the Fortress — to the south , were disputed between the corsairs and the mainland cities .

title: Norun Chethil
description: Norun Chethil Norun Chethil was a monk cook of Candlekeep . History . Chethil was the most able cook of the monastery .

title: Nostilax
description: Nostilax Nostilax was a half - dragon druid in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Nostilax had an unusual relationship with her father .

title: Nostyn Vandur
description: Nostyn Vandur Nostyn Vandur was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Nostyn arrived with two ironlord bodyguards at Castle Irlingstar , just after Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave .

title: Nothic
description: Nothic Nothics were one - eyed creeping monsters that lurked in places with great magical knowledge , which they themselves craved . Description . Nothics were the result of a curse befalling wizard s who delved too deep into arcane knowledge .

title: Nourisher Creed
description: Nourisher Creed The Nourisher Creed was one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They were highly focused on the thralls and were the Creed that took care of them , organized them , kept them docile , and ceremorphed them . Oryndoll .

title: Novularond
description: Novularond Novularond was the name of a region of the Great Glacier in Faerûn . History . One branch of the first dwarven migration into Faerûn settled in the Novularond mountains and later became known as arctic dwarves .

title: Noxious step
description: Noxious step Noxious step was an ability a skulker of Vhaeraun could learn . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun usually tried to avoid notice but when a skulker ' s cover was blown , " noxious step " was the ability to be used .

title: Noyerghu
description: Noyerghu Noyerghu was a Thay an gnoll around 1485 DR . History . Noyerghu was a gnoll from Thay who accompanied the Red Wizard of Thay Thegger Grynn in 1485 DR in taking control of the Phylund Lodge .

title: Nozumi Takahasho
description: Nozumi Takahasho Nozumi Takahasho was a broken soldier in Shou Lung . History . Nozumi Takahasho was a soldier of the army of General Goyat Nagumo .

title: Nrymm Aumar
description: Nrymm Aumar Nrymm Aumar was the youngest of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Nrymm was very young when his father , and king , died and he was raised by the women of the court .

title: Nualion Galanodel
description: Nualion Galanodel Nualion Galanodel was an adventurer who had recently arrived in Mulmaster . Personality . Nualion was not certain that he wanted to remain an adventurer and considered returning to Cormanthor , after having developed a crippling case of claustrophobia while in the sewers .

title: Nubari
description: Nubari The Nubari were the human s of the Malatran Plateau of southern Kara - Tur . Description . The Nubari people were tall , ranging from five feet to well over six feet in height .

title: Nubari ( ancient )
description: Nubari ( ancient ) The Nubari ( often called the " Ancient Nubari ' " , or simply " the Ancients " , to distinguish them from the race of humans who descended from them ) were a starfaring race that settled on Toril in Malatra . Description . The Ancient Nubari were an exceptionally tall ( reaching seven feet in height ) and willowy race of humanoid s with large , elongated skulls .

title: Nudar Abd al - Amin
description: Nudar Abd al - Amin Nudar Abd al - Amin was a platoon commander from Hiyal in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . Nudar was easy going and well - liked .

title: Nulara Haphet
description: Nulara Haphet Nulara Haphet , also known as Silversong , was a female human bard who was one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . History . Nulara hailed from distant Mulhorand , a place she never spoke of , and was considered to have the soul of a dark poet and the mind of a criminal genius .

title: Nulathoe ' s ninemen
description: Nulathoe ' s ninemen Nulathoe ' s ninemen ( pronounced " nin " - em - en ) , was a rare necromancy spell that preserved a dead body from decay . Effects . This spell halted the decay and rot of corpses for burial preservation or for a possible candidate of " raise dead " or " resurrection " spells .

title: Nuldrevyn Talendar
description: Nuldrevyn Talendar Nuldrevyn Talendar was the patriarch of the Talendar family in Selgaunt . Relationships . In youth , Nuldrevyn was always in the company of his brother Marance Talendar .

title: Null
description: Null Null ( pronounced " NUL " ) was the dragon god of death and undeath with two aspects , The Reaver and the Guardian of the Lost . As the Reaver , he was worshiped by evil dragons and took lives , blessing those who served him in this capacity . As the Guardian , he ferried the souls of dead dragons to Dragon Eyrie and ensured they were no longer troubled by the enemies they may have had in life .

title: Numbers sphere
description: Numbers sphere The Numbers sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s . These spells revealed the mathematical underpinnings to many aspects of reality and allowed understanding and manipulation of events in unexpected ways . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Nun
description: Nun Nun was a small village on the Vilhon Reach filled with priests . History . Nun rested on the site of the Battle of Nun ( part of the Rotting War conflict of 902 DR .

title: Nunchaku
description: Nunchaku The nunchaku is a light , exotic melee weapon typically used by monk s . Description . The nunchaku is made of two hardwood wands or dowels connected at one end by a leather thong or short length of chain .

title: Nune
description: Nune Nune was the common name for ( sometimes called " cross stone " or " fairy stone " ) in the Realms . Description . These ornamental stones were translucent brown or nearly clear and occurred in small cross - shaped crystals up to one inch ( two and a half centimeters ) across either arm .

title: Nung Chiang
description: Nung Chiang Nung Chiang ( pronounced " nung chee - ang " ) , called the Teacher of the Plow or the Master of the Red Earth , was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire , the dominant religion of Kara - Tur , particularly Shou Lung . He was a god of agriculture and fertility . As one of the Nine Immortals , Nung Chiang also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers .

title: Nunwood
description: Nunwood The Nunwood was a forest on the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . The nearby cities of Reth and Hlath used the Nunwood as their main source of lumber . In 1372 DR , Hlath ' s main export was Nunwood lumber .

title: Nur al - Zahir
description: Nur al - Zahir Calipha Nur al - Zahir was a member of the prominent House of Zahir in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Relationships . Nur was the mother of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir and married to his father Achmed Al - Assad .

title: Nura al - Hamiir
description: Nura al - Hamiir Nura al - Hamiir was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Nura possessed a sharp wit and keen eye , earning her a notorious reputation for being able to single - out smugglers among the throngs of people who passed through the Pilgrims ' Gate .

title: Nura al - Kosiri
description: Nura al - Kosiri Nura al - Kosiri was a priest of the Mosque of Brave Hajama in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Nura led a group of followers who believed that Imam Jomhur needed to step down from his duties as High Priest .

title: Nureh el Pesarkhal
description: Nureh el Pesarkhal Nureh yr Catahra el Pesarkhal , an exceptional spymaster of the Memnon underworld , was the wife of the crime lord Nasim yn Feroz el Pesarkhal and sister - in - law to the syl - pasha in 1370 DR . Description . She was a beautiful half - elven woman with jet black hair .

title: Nuri al - Zaratani
description: Nuri al - Zaratani Nuri al - Zaratani was an amiq rasol living on a zaratan in the waters of the Great Sea near the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Description . Nuri was 6 ft .

title: Nurih al Suhal
description: Nurih al Suhal Nurih yr Catahra al Suhal was a moneylender in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Nurih was married to Fahid yn Nur al Suhal , a cowardly moneylender .

title: Nurissa Vyllshan
description: Nurissa Vyllshan Nurissa Vyllshan was a female drow illusionist and shadow adept and the leader of the School of the Shadow Weave in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . She petitioned the Conclave of Sshamath to have a position on the conclave as leader of the shadow adepts . However , the Conclave denied them for fear of losing political influence by adding another member to the conclave , and because they distrusted the shadow adepts , many of whom worshiped Shar .

title: Nurr ' Korzahg
description: Nurr ' Korzahg Nurr ' Korzahg was an illithid of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1372 DR . Personality . A close meeting with death shook Nurr ' Korzahg deeply .

title: Nurthel Floshin
description: Nurthel Floshin Nurthel Floshin was a fey ' ri who served the daemonfey leader Sarya Dlardrageth as her spymaster . Description . Nurthel had only one eye , and it was green .

title: Nurvureem
description: Nurvureem Nurvureem was a " draa ' zekyl " shadow dragon with a fell reputation among the inhabitants of the Dessarin River Valley . She maintained several different lairs , though she favored Rundreth Manor . Biography .

title: Nushala Le ' Quella
description: Nushala Le ' Quella Nushala Le ' Quella was an elf jeweler who lived in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . She created jewellery and works of art , and once spent 18 months on a single piece for Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . As of 1368 DR , she was over 600 years old and was held in much respect in the elven community .

title: Nuska Ohm Wy
description: Nuska Ohm Wy Nuska Ohm Wy was the a Hengeyokai in Henai River in T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Nuska was well known in area from Henai river to Zun Hi for his small thefts and his pranks .

title: Nusrah bin Kerim
description: Nusrah bin Kerim Nusrah bin Kerim was a the leader of the Winged Bulls in 1367 DR . Decription . Nusrah ' s skin was dark brown .

title: Nut cheese
description: Nut cheese Nut cheese was a type of cheese mixed with nuts produced in many cities of the Savage Frontier , including Silverymoon , Mirabar , and Sundabar . A selection was available from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Nuth Harandal
description: Nuth Harandal Nuth Harandal was the leader of the Storm Rune , a guild of merchants and landlords in Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Personality . Nuth was considered a wily and calculating person .

title: Nuyen Phi
description: Nuyen Phi Nuyen Phi was the prince of Sayan in Malatra . Personality . Phi believed himself a great general .

title: Nycaloth
description: Nycaloth Nycaloths , later known as nycademons , are the elite cavalry in yugoloth armies , swooping down onto enemy flanks and tearing up unsuspecting troops . These arrogant , green - skinned creatures are eight feet ( 240 centimeters ) tall and possess four muscular arms , a doglike head and a pair of vast , bat - like wings . Nycaloth commanders are larger than their fellows , and lead entire battalions into war .

title: Nydyaa Ealoeth
description: Nydyaa Ealoeth Nydyaa Ealoeth was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Nydyaa ' s consort was Myrlaer Ealoeth .

title: Nyerhite Verther
description: Nyerhite Verther Nyerhite Verther was a Calishite silk merchant just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The merchant was not a scrupulous individual .

title: Nyh Ilmichh
description: Nyh Ilmichh Nyh Ilmichh was an envoy of the Red Wizards of Thay sent by Szass Tam to propose an alliance between Thay and the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . One day , Nyh Illichh , under orders from his master , approached the Council of Lords of Waterdeep with the purpose of setting up a meeting between Thay and the Council in the hope they could help each other against the rising menace of Tiamat and the Cult of the dragon .

title: Nyk
description: Nyk Nyk was a goblin who lived in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR , and twin to Nok . Nyk and Nok were a pair of enterprising goblin s who swept up the dung left by the Raging Bull , a long - imprisoned minotaur suspended from the ceiling by The Deepfires inn . They used the dung as manure to grow mushrooms .

title: Nylaersyn Floshin
description: Nylaersyn Floshin Nylaersyn Floshin was a member of House Dlardrageth that infiltrated the Unseen in Waterdeep by the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . History . Nylaersyn was a fey ' ri member of House Dlardrageth .

title: Nym
description: Nym Nym was the aged proprietor of The Jewel Box in Menzoberranzan . Activities . He was a retired battle wizard and at some point in his past lost one of his legs and didn ' t get it magically replaced .

title: Nym ( Icewind Dale )
description: Nym ( Icewind Dale ) Nym is an unscrupulous drow trader who appears in both Icewind Dale and Icewind Dale II . He often sells some of the best items in both games . Nym indirectly caused the fall of both the Fortress of the Severed Hand and Dorn ' s Deep by stealing the elven and dwarven magical items from Dorn ' s Deep and then selling them to the goblinoid armies that proceeded to sack them both .

title: Nym ( monk )
description: Nym ( monk ) Nym was a monk of Ilmater at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Nym was born and raised at the monastery .

title: Nym ( storm giant )
description: Nym ( storm giant ) Nym was a storm giant princess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Nym was the middle daughters of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Nym Mlezziir
description: Nym Mlezziir Nym Mlezziir was the Battlemaster of the Eastern Marches in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Nym was one of the primary military commanders of the city , assigned to supervising the patrols in the tunnels and the caverns that included the Gauth Grottoes and the ruins of Oghrann . He was renowned for fighting with dwarves and nighteyes and it was said that he had slain at least two gauth alone .

title: Nym Nindar
description: Nym Nindar Nym Nindar , nicknamed " Slowtooth " , was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He owned and operated Slowtooth Weaponry . History .

title: Nymara Scheiron
description: Nymara Scheiron Nymara Scheiron , more commonly known as Kitten , was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Few people knew her full name . Description .

title: Nymarrath
description: Nymarrath Nymarrath was an aged druid living in Elventree . Activities . Nymarrath took care of the Silver Shadow Cave in Elventree .

title: Nymbrar Shatterslee
description: Nymbrar Shatterslee Nymbrar " Nighteye " Shatterslee was a traveling minstrel responsible for the composition and performance of " Crying To My Harp " , a collection of satirical ballads criticizing the Waterdhavian nobility that proved to be extremely successful when performed in Waterdeep . After enraging the targets of the criticism and attracting the attention of thugs , Nymbrar left the city .

title: Nymia Focar
description: Nymia Focar Nymia Focar was a fighter and tharchion of Pyarados of Thay . Description . Nymia was handsome with a wide , sensuous mouth .

title: Nymmestra Durothil
description: Nymmestra Durothil Nymmestra Durothil , or Nym , was a gold elf born of House Durothil of Evermeet . Her affinity for magic led her to study at the Tower of the Sun and the Tower of the Moon . However , she had mischievous and a wild side that got her into a great deal of trouble .

title: Nymmurh
description: Nymmurh Nymmurh was a bronze dragon summoned to the metallic dragon ' s council to discuss of the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Nymmurh was granitic in his beliefs that humanity were better than metallic dragons .

title: Nymph
description: Nymph Nymphs were fey that typically resembled Tel - quessir women , not just physically beautiful , but literally blindingly so . They usually dwelt in forests , streams , waterfalls , or coves . They were the guardians and protectors of these and the portals to the faerie realm .

title: Nyo - ko
description: Nyo - ko Nyo - ko was the third wife of Funada Mitsuhide , daimyo of Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Nyo - ko born as daughter of a daimyo and her parents had gone to great trouble to teach her refined graces .

title: Nyphithys
description: Nyphithys Nyphithys was an erinyes servant of the lich Arklem Greeth . History . Meeting Arklem Greeth .

title: Nyraala golem
description: Nyraala golem A nyraala golem was a type of golem created by illithid s . It was a flailing , slimy , tentacled construct capable of launching surprise attacks . They often served as guards , and were prized because their creation did not involve petitioning the elder brain to surrender part of its mass .

title: Nyssa Seebenstern
description: Nyssa Seebenstern Nyssa Seebenstern was a caravan leader in the Dalelands . Personality . Nyssa was full of enthusiasm and idealism .

title: Nyth
description: Nyth Nyth is a small city of 11 , 501 inhabitants ( as of 1372 DR ) in Thesk that relies on trade with its neighbouring settlements . It was once controlled by the independent city - state of Telflamm . History .

title: Nyth ( creature )
description: Nyth ( creature ) Nyths are creatures very similar to will - o ' - wisp s and the two species can communicate and have been known to ally with each other . Nyths are often mistaken for wisps but some northern barbarian s can supposedly tell the two apart , naming nyths " wildfire " and thinking them to be evil spirits . Nyths have a slightly wider range of colouration than wisps .

title: Nytus the Shipwright
description: Nytus the Shipwright Nytus the Shipwright was a sailor who retired to become a shipwright in Velprintalar ( later Veltalar ) , Aglarond . He made a reputation for creating quality fishing vessels and large merchant ships that extended across the Sea of Fallen Stars . Other shipbuilders would approach him for advice or commissions .

title: O - Cho
description: O - Cho O - Cho was the handmaiden of Sumi - ko in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . O - Cho started working for the Funada clan in 1347 DR .

title: O - Kaze
description: O - Kaze O - Kaze was a Phoenix clan ninja in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . During the plot of Goshukara Sadamoto to ruin peace talks between Funada Mitsuhide and the Big Head yakuza gang , O - Kaze was assigned by the Phoenix ninja to kill Jirozu no Nakamaru , framing Funada clan retainers in the process .

title: O - Shino
description: O - Shino O - Shino was a young maiden in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . O - Shino was an independent - minded young woman of modest means .

title: OA series
description: OA series The OA series was a series of seven 1st and 2nd edition Kara - Tur - based adventures published between 1986 and 1990 . OA1 to OA4 were not branded with the Forgotten Realms logo , but the wiki accepts them to be part of Forgotten Realms canon .

title: Oak
description: Oak The oak tree could be found in various places in Faerûn , including the starwood area of the forest of Cormanthor , where they could grow up to 400 ' ( 122 m ) . Varieties . Chime .

title: Oars to snakes
description: Oars to snakes Oars to snakes was a divine magic spell that could be used offensively or defensively , turning a ship ' s oars into large sea snake s . Effects . This spell was similar to " sticks to snakes " except it was specifically for use on oars , and created a few very large and tough sea serpents that remained in their oarlocks for the duration of the spell .

title: Oasis of Solitude
description: Oasis of Solitude The Oasis of Solitude was located on Dihl al - Taif in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Sitting between Zarif and the Al - Malih River , the Oasis of Solitude was one of the last sources of fresh water on the Ghost ' s Route to Halwa .

title: Oasis of Vipers
description: Oasis of Vipers The Oasis of Vipers was an old , well - watered set of three pools in Anauroch that was mostly ignored by the Bedine . Geography . This oasis was located near the northernmost border of the Sword .

title: Oath of Devotion
description: Oath of Devotion The Oath of Devotion was one of the sacred vows that paladin s could choose to take when they reached a milestone in their journey of faith . When they dedicated themselves to the tenets of this oath , they also were granted access to a set of spells at no cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Oath of Vengeance
description: Oath of Vengeance The Oath of Vengeance was one of the sacred vows that paladin s could choose to take when they reached a milestone in their journey of faith . When they dedicated themselves to the tenets of this oath , they also were granted access to a set of spells at no cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Oath of the Ancients
description: Oath of the Ancients The Oath of the Ancients was one of the sacred vows that paladin s could choose to take when they reached a milestone in their journey of faith . When they dedicated themselves to the tenets of this oath , they also were granted access to a set of spells at no cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Oath of the Crown
description: Oath of the Crown The Oath of the Crown was one of the sacred vows that paladin s could choose to take when they reached a milestone in their journey of faith . When they dedicated themselves to the tenets of this oath , they also were granted access to a set of spells at no cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Oathbinder genie
description: Oathbinder genie Oathbinder genies were tasked genie s who were believed to be the descendants of a single efreeti . Their sole purpose was to maintain oaths sworn between their master and other beings . They punished any oathbreaker based on the terms of their vow .

title: Oathbinding
description: Oathbinding Oathbinding was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Obaleth
description: Obaleth Obaleth was a cheese with a strong flavor and sharp taste made locally to the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s and 70s DR . Locations . The Worried Wyvern inn in Sevenecho had Obaleth cheese for sale on its excellent menu .

title: Obarskyr
description: Obarskyr Obarskyr was the royal house of Cormyr . History . The Obarskyr family originally rose to prominence in Impiltur as a mercenary company .

title: Obedient avalanche
description: Obedient avalanche Obedient avalanche , also known by many as Zajimarn ' s avalanche , was a conjuration spell of the creation subschool that called down an avalanche to bury one ' s foes . Effect . The spell opened a rift in midair , from which poured an avalanche of snow that engulfed everyone and everything beneath it and swept outwards from that location .

title: Oberon
description: Oberon Oberon was a wizard living in a tower in Baldur ' s Gate . Relationships . The wizard had many dealing with Pasha Pook of Calimport .

title: Oboo
description: Oboo An oboo " ( pl . oboos ) " was an altar to the gods of sky and earth that could be found on the steppes of the Hordelands . Description .

title: Oboth Thornsteel
description: Oboth Thornsteel Oboth Thornsteel was a Zhent mercenary leader in Mornbryn ' s Shield sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Oboth was a Zhentarim mercenary in Yartar in the late 1480s or early 1490s DR .

title: Obould
description: Obould Obould , also known as King Obould I Many - Arrows , was an exarch of Gruumsh and the mortal orc king of the Broken Arrow tribe . Description . Obould was a large orc who was intelligent even by human standards .

title: Obould XVII
