description: Obould XVII King Obould XVII is the seventeenth king in a line of unbroken Oboulds , ruling over the kingdom of Many - Arrows . Obould XVII reunited the tribes in 1460 DR after a series of civil wars split the kingdom . He was the first of his line to attempt the expansion of his power base , sending forces to secure territory in the city of Neverwinter , however , the lieutenant he sent to achieve this , a power - hungry orc female named Vansi , has allied herself with the Abolethic Sovereignty and rather than reporting back to her king , risks turning herself and her warriors into pawns .

title: Obraerl Fowlweather
description: Obraerl Fowlweather Obraerl Fowlweather was a noble in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , at the start of the Council of the Dragon , Obraerl asked the king for equal participation in the council by old and new noble families .

title: Obratu
description: Obratu Obratu was an oni at the Shrine of the Tender Oath in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationship . Obratu had a partnership of convenience with a duergar called Reulek .

title: Obscuring mist
description: Obscuring mist Obscuring mist was a conjuration spell that caused fog to form around the caster . The druid evocation could be used at a range from the caster . The alteration spell obscurement was another variant of this spell .

title: Observer
description: Observer The observer was a larger - than - average beholder - kin ( 6 ' diameter ) with a hard , chitinous skin mottled in shades of pink and purple . It possessed six eye - stalks , three central eyes ( evenly spaced around the equator ) , and three small mouths ( one below each central eye ) . The observer ' s mouths were not what they appeared to be ; each one was actually a sucker attached to the end of a 5 ' tentacle .

title: Obsidian
description: Obsidian Obsidian , also known as natural glass or volcanic glass , came in different grades and varieties , some more prized than others . Low grade obsidian , called pitchstone , was not as shiny or smooth as gem quality obsidian but was useful for grinding and abrading . A variety called blacksmoke obsidian was primarily found in Tashalar , sold in the local bazaars .

title: Obslin Minstrelwish
description: Obslin Minstrelwish Obslin Minstrelwish was Seneschal of Twilight Hall in Berdusk and one of the High Harpers . History . In Tarsakh of 1370 DR , he was running the Harper stronghold during the absence of the severely ill Cylyria Dragonbreast when , under the urging of Bran Skorlsun , Obslin agreed to discuss the evidence that showed Khelben Arunsun was a traitor .

title: Obsul Ssussun
description: Obsul Ssussun Obsul Ssussun , or " The Door to Light " , was a spellbook containing some spell s designed for followers of Vhaeraun . Description . The black book was small , about as wide as an elf ' s hand , and written in Undercommon in small Elven script .

title: Obyrith
description: Obyrith An obyrith was a type of demon . It was so ancient it predated mortal life , and even the gods . They rarely had a humanoid shape , and some said that just looking at an obyrith could drive a mortal insane .

title: Ocarina
description: Ocarina The ocarina was a tiny glass flute - like instrument with an oval or round - shaped enclosed body , several finger holes and a mouth piece projecting from the body . Geography . Among other products , ocarinas were produced in Galandor ' s Glassworks , a small shop in Kirinwood , a village in southern Cormyr .

title: Occidian
description: Occidian Occidian was an elven city before the Crown Wars and a center of elven music and dance in the northern parts of Faerûn . History . The city was destroyed in the Year of Singing Sirens when a huge orc horde rushed over many parts of the northern continent .

title: Ocean domain
description: Ocean domain The Ocean domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters oceanic - themed spell s and powers . They gained the ability to breathe underwater for several minutes to several hours . Deities with the Ocean domain .

title: Ochio
description: Ochio Ochio was the myoshu of Myudo village in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Myudo was under the control of evil sohei of the Black Temple who terrorized Ochio and other villagers with stories of the dai - oni who led them .

title: Ochre jelly
description: Ochre jelly Ochre jellies resemble giant amoebas , consisting of a thick , golden sludge . Description . The ooze ’ s body is made up of yellow - orange colored acid capable of dissolving any organic material .

title: Octagon
description: Octagon The Octagon was a huge magical prison located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Octagon was found within Iskalat , or the fiery dock ward of the City of Brass . Description .

title: Octel
description: Octel Octel was the common name for in the Realms . Jewelers sometimes marketed them as savage fire . Description .

title: Octopus
description: Octopus Octopi are a breed of multi - tentacles that live within the ocean . Combat . Generally regular octopi are not dangerous unless provoked , and in this case , will usually try to escape .

title: Ocular adept
description: Ocular adept The ocular adept was a prestige class of Faerûn . By giving themselves to beholders , they gained special abilities that went with their worship of the beholder goddess , the Great Mother . Description .

title: Odak Truesteel
description: Odak Truesteel Odak Truesteel was a fat cleric of Dumathoin in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Odak was a cheerful dwarf , friendly with no - dwarves with a very sarcastic humor .

title: Odren
description: Odren Odren was a knight and cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . Helm gave Odren and his fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . However , knowing this was a too difficult mission for them alone , Odren recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him .

title: Oe - Ura
description: Oe - Ura Oe - Ura , mostly known as the Peachling Girl , was a heroine in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . Oe - Ura preferred the company of animals to people .

title: Oe Shodayu
description: Oe Shodayu Oe Shodayu was a retainer of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Shodayu was an old warrior tired of fighting .

title: Oebelar
description: Oebelar The Oebelar was formerly a mage in the city of Scornubel . One night around 1338 DR , his tower was struck by blue - white cold fire and destroyed , but the next night , one of his eyeballs and a blackened forearm appeared . Thereafter , they wandered the city either together or independently .

title: Oedachlo
description: Oedachlo Oedachlo was a powerful mind flayer wizard until a human wizard magically imprisoned him under the sands of Anauroch . However , in 1358 DR , a Zhentarim expedition freed him . Oedachlo remained deeply hidden while exploring the modern Realms .

title: Oel ' yvia Reefglider
description: Oel ' yvia Reefglider Oel ' yvia Reefglider was an aquatic elf barmaid in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Oel ' yvia was hired as a barmaid for Basil Willowbrook ' s inn , the Bindle ' s Blade in the Lower Heart district , where she would delight customers with her songs .

title: Oenath
description: Oenath Oenath , also known as Dreamers , are intelligent , wolf - like creatures living in the wilds of Akanûl . They were originally a pack of wolves changed by the Spellplague into their current form . Combat .

title: Oerth
description: Oerth Oerth , the world of the " Greyhawk " campaign setting , is an alternate Material Plane world parallel to Toril . Inhabitants . Oerth is home to prominent wizards such as Bigby , Drawmij , Tenser , and Mordenkainen whose spells have spread even to the Forgotten Realms .

title: Oey Sambal Pedas
description: Oey Sambal Pedas Oey Sambal Pedas was the sultan of Kilap Valley in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . He ruled over the Laska people . Personality .

title: Of the Fall of Netheril
description: Of the Fall of Netheril Of the Fall of Netheril was a book written by Rhaugilath the Ageless , an archlich of Netheril dwelling at Warlock ' s Crypt . The book detailed Netheril ' s complete history . However , Rhaugilath considered the Netherese Diaspora after Netheril ' s fall to be an integral part of the history , as well as the expected restoration of Netheril , thought to be only beginning in 1374 DR .

title: Ogaki
description: Ogaki Ogaki was a samurai retainer of Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Ogaki was the second - in - command of Lord Korimori .

title: Ogandi Tsipiang
description: Ogandi Tsipiang Ogandi Tsipiang was Prince of Khazari during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Ogandi was the Prince and ruler of Khazari and lived within the city of Skarou .

title: Ogawa Besar
description: Ogawa Besar Ogawa Besar was a barbarian participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Nobody knew Ogawa Besar ' s origins .

title: Ogden Fastrunner
description: Ogden Fastrunner History . Ogden was the captain of a Cormyr ean patrol that was patrolling the near the city of Marsember during the Time of Troubles when a strange poisonous fog killed him and his men . He later rose as an undead creation under the order of the god of the dead , Myrkul .

title: Ogden Flamebeard
description: Ogden Flamebeard Ogden Flamebeard was a tavern owner in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Ogden managed the Kelvin ' s Comfrort tavern , the most known drinking place of the city , famous for his Flamebeard ' s Firebrandy drink .

title: Ogg
description: Ogg Ogg was a hill giant who , together with Lob , led an attack on Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Lob and Ogg always traveled together .

title: Oghma
description: Oghma Oghma ( pronounced " OGG - mah " ) , also known as The Lord of Knowledge , was the neutral greater power of bards , inspiration , invention , and knowledge in Faerûn . Oghma was the leader of the Deities of Knowledge and Invention and his home plane was the House of Knowledge . His symbol was a blank scroll .

title: Oghrann
description: Oghrann Oghrann was a dwarven realm founded on and under the Plain of Tun . Geography . At its height , Oghrann surrounded the valley of the River Tun , extended into the Sunset Mountains in the west and underneath the Storm Horns in the east .

title: Ogre
description: Ogre Ogres were a race of giant - kin . Description . Ogres appeared as giant humanoids with very muscular bodies and large heads .

title: Ogre giant
description: Ogre giant Ogre giants were imposing giant s found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that seemed to have more in common with ogre s than giants . These creatures spoke the tongue of ogres , but some who lived near humans could speak Midani as well . A rare few even attained enlightenment , serving as missionaries for their kind , though the vast majority were savage brutes .

title: Ogremoch ' s Bane
description: Ogremoch ' s Bane Ogremoch ' s Bane was a drifting cloud of sentient , invisible magical dust that lived in the city of Blingdenstone since 1358 DR . Named after the lord of evil earth elemental s to contrast the presence of Entemoch ' s Boon , it moved around the city and any creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth not of a good alignment that it came into contact with were driven into a mindless destructive rage . These creatures could also not be " banished " back home , so they must be destroyed in order to get rid of them .

title: Ogrillon
description: Ogrillon Ogrillons were the result of orc s and ogre s breeding . Description . Ogrillons looked very similar to orcs , but were often a little taller .

title: Ogrima
description: Ogrima Ogrima were the result of inter - breeding between ogre s and ogre mage s . Over time they became a separate race of ogres entirely . Description .

title: Ogrémoch
description: Ogrémoch Ogrémoch , also known as the Prince of Evil Earth , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Earth . Description . Ogrémoch was described as a ten - foot - tall ( 3 meters ) humanoid made of rock and crystal .

title: Ohlmer Cormaeril
description: Ohlmer Cormaeril Ohlmer Cormaeril was the head of the Cormaeril noble house in Cormyr . Although he appeared to be a respectable nobleman , he was not above kidnapping for slavery , smuggling and trade with pirates . He had been known to mistreat female slaves .

title: Oigur
description: Oigur The Oigur were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Oigur lived in the southern wastes of the Hordelands .

title: Oigur language
description: Oigur language Oigur was a language spoken in the Hordelands . Description . Oigur was a nasal language .

title: Oil of animate dead
description: Oil of animate dead Oil of animate dead was a potion that could be rubbed onto a corpse or bones to create either a zombie or a skeleton . The first creature that it saw was regarded as its master and it would obey commands as if it were under the influence of the spell " animate dead " . It could only be used on a medium - sized or smaller creature .

title: Oil of attractiveness
description: Oil of attractiveness Oil of attractiveness was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of cloaking
description: Oil of cloaking Oil of cloaking was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of great devotion
description: Oil of great devotion Oil of great devotion was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of horridness
description: Oil of horridness Oil of horridness was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of impact
description: Oil of impact Oil of impact was a very explosive magical substance . The priest Cadderly Bonaduce was known to use this oil in his youth . A typical vial of this oil had a base value of 5 , 000gp .

title: Oil of invisibility
description: Oil of invisibility Oil of invisibility was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of invulnerability
description: Oil of invulnerability Oil of invulnerability was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of obedience
description: Oil of obedience Oil of obedience was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of romance
description: Oil of romance Oil of romance was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oil of sulphur
description: Oil of sulphur Oil of sulphur was a magic potion that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This item was often used by genie s who sought revenge against their masters . Description .

title: Oil of the pickpocket
description: Oil of the pickpocket Oil of the pickpocket was a magical substance that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Oilskin
description: Oilskin Oilskin was an arcane abjuration spell that protected an individual or an object from precipitation and being doused by waves . Effects . This spell set up a nearly waterproof barrier around one touched creature or small object .

title: Oinker - Boinker
description: Oinker - Boinker Oinker - Boinker was an ettin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Oinker - Boinker was one of the minions of the hill giant Chief Guh in Grudd Haug .

title: Ojy
description: Ojy Ojy was the spiritual guide of the village of Golden in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur long before the 14th century DR . He was known for forging the magical shuriken called the " stars of Ojy - do " . History .

title: Ojy - do
description: Ojy - do Ojy - do was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was one of the few troublespots of the kingdom around 1357 DR . Geography .

title: Oka Sanai
description: Oka Sanai Oka Sanai was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Sanai was a noted satirist , writing some pamphlets against the Funada clan .

title: Oka Yoshinaka
description: Oka Yoshinaka Oka Yoshinaka was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Yoshinaka and Mashida Kowa clashed with the Gamo brothers , Hidenobu , Mitsutoshi and Mochikuni .

title: Okahira
description: Okahira Okahira was a large city in the northern region of the Miyama Province . As of 1357 DR , it was the third largest city in all the provinces of Kozakura and dominated the northern coast . In that year , around 6 , 000 people populated the city .

title: Okasha
description: Okasha Okasha was a Wanese captain temporary in Akari in 1357 DR . History . Okasha was a sea captain merchant from Wa .

title: Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm
description: Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm Okin Abd al - Talib ' ilm was the general and commander of the Studious Mamluk Society in Qudra in 1367 DR . Activities . Okin ' s strengths catered to research and tactics for the Studious .

title: Okku
description: Okku Okku is a God of Bears , an ancient spirit of Rashemen . Personality . In life , Okku was a paragon bear - one of an ancient race of intelligent beasts who ruled the wild places .

title: Okotampe
description: Okotampe Okotampe was a korobokuru wu jen in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Okotampe was a shaman among his tribe but left his home to found a new totem for the tribe .

title: Oksakex
description: Oksakex Oksakex was a vampiric ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , in 1370 DR . Personality . Oksakex hoped to become a greater vampiric ixzan and approached Phiaqiv on more than one occasion asking for a transformation .

title: Okssort
description: Okssort Okssort was a fire giant who , together with his wife Ildmane , led an attack on Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , under the orders of Duke Zalto , Okssort and Ildmane went in search of pieces of the Vonindod .

title: Olam Chistlesmith
description: Olam Chistlesmith Olam Chistlesmith was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn in the 14th century DR and a member of Clan Chistlesmith . Olam was the mate of Thendara Spearsinger and the father of the bard Morgalla the Mirthful .

title: Olara
description: Olara Olara was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Olara was a monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose and a member of the Order of the Scroll of the Disciples of St .

title: Olbedan
description: Olbedan Master Sufferer Olbedan was a priest of Ilmater the Broken God , dwelling at the House of the Harmed in Aralent in the Vilhon Reach . Olbedan was widely regarded as a saintly and trustworthy soul . In the Year of the Boot , 1343 DR , the people of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach requested that the Graycloak ' s Wolves adventuring company deliver the " Tome of Torment " — the holiest book of the church of Ilmater — to Master Sufferer Olbedan in Aralent .

title: Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks
description: Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks was a tannery and leatherworking shop just outside Dagger Falls in Daggerdale . Location . Situated outside of the River Gate on the eastern side of Dagger Falls , Old Dulwar ' s Leatherworks stood at the junction of the Tethyamar Trail and the Tesh Trail .

title: Old Gebe
description: Old Gebe Old Gebe was , in 1368 DR , an old man living in Dlusk , Aglarond . During the spring festival there , he would give free hayrides to children and tell stories about mules , including his own mules Sara and Corey . He knew many of the local legends and was knowledgeable on the subject of the Unapproachable East in general .

title: Old Goatbeard
description: Old Goatbeard Old Goatbeard was the skilled yak - folk governor of the Red Goat province in the World Pillar Mountains in 1367 DR . Activities . Old Goatbeard was a member of the Seven Sages and the appointed governor of the Red Goat province within the Yikarian Empire .

title: Old Illuskan
description: Old Illuskan Old Illuskan was the language of Old Illusk and the parent language of modern Illuskan , Bothii , and Reghedjic . It also influenced the modern language of Dambrathan . Script .

title: Old Men ' s Bones
description: Old Men ' s Bones Old Men ' s Bones was a classic game played in Faerûn . Description . An Old Men ' s Bones set consisted of tiny bones that were poured into a pile .

title: Old Night
description: Old Night In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , Old Night was one of the High Heralds . The sign of Old Night was an ancient , broken bronze shield hung on the wide trunk of an oak tree , surrounded by oak leaves . This office was in charge of training the Heralds Pursuivant , including the " everchanging offices " of Green Shield and Gauntlet .

title: Old One Eye
description: Old One Eye Old One Eye was a beer brewed in Llorbauth from the Hills ' Cheer Distillery & Brewery . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Old Owl Well
description: Old Owl Well Old Owl Well , located in the hills north of the Sword Mountains , was a popular watering hole and rest stop for caravan traffic , especially between Yartar and Neverwinter . History . In - 2368 DR , at the adamant insistence of the Terraseer , the Empire of Netheril began earnestly colonizing the Savage Frontier .

title: Old Road ( High Forest )
description: Old Road ( High Forest ) The Old Road is a cracked cobblestone road that has partly fallen into disrepair and become overgrown . It links Elven Port , the Nameless Dungeon and Mhiilamniir . Where the Old Road splits off and leads to the Nameless Dungeon there is a guardpost with no less than 25 moon and gold elves from Silverymoon and Evereska .

title: Old Road ( Vilhon Reach )
description: Old Road ( Vilhon Reach ) The Old Road was a road in the Vilhon Reach area that runs from Shamph in Chondath , south through the Chondalwood , through Elbulder in Sespech , where it crosses the River Arran , and then further south across the Golden Plains .

title: Old Shanatar
description: Old Shanatar Once Old Shanatar was home to the powerful dwarven realm of Deep Shanatar . Nowadays only one of Deep Shanatar ' s eight kindoms stand , the rest have been overrun , conquered or simply been destroyed at the hands of drow , mind flayers or duergar . Ranking among the major Underdark domains , Old Shanatar has the most artificial delvings , halls and passages , including works of amazingly huge scale .

title: Old Skull Inn
description: Old Skull Inn The Old Skull Inn was a popular inn in Shadowdale . Ownership . The Old Skull Inn was owned by Jhaele Silvermane .

title: Old Skull Tor
description: Old Skull Tor The Old Skull Tor was a large , bare hill shaped like a massive dome just north of the village of Shadowdale . The tor was a spur of gnarled volcanic rock . Lichen and thick tufts of grass grew out of the many cracks and fissures .

title: Old Staff
description: Old Staff The Old Staff was Azuth ' s favored weapon . Description . Both ends of the wooden , rune - scribed staff were shod in iron .

title: Old Stone Keep
description: Old Stone Keep Old Stone Keep was a ruined keep and city found in the Utter East in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Old Stone Keep stood atop the high mountains east of Doegan .

title: Oldstone Hall
description: Oldstone Hall Oldstone Hall was a manor house located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and home of the town ' s lords . Location . The manor house lay in the center of town , on Wheloon Way , opposite the Wheloon Moothouse .

title: Oleff Uskar
description: Oleff Uskar Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar was a priest of Tyr who presided over the civil court of Neverwinter known as the Hall of Justice . While practicing what was considered " low justice " , Oleff was assisted by Prior Hlam . Appendix .

title: Oleg
description: Oleg Oleg was a half - orc smith in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Oleg was a very able weaponsmith but few in the town trusted a half - orc enough to enter his shop .

title: Oleg One - Ear
description: Oleg One - Ear Oleg One - Ear was a male human and the proprietor of the tavern called The Dragons ' Den in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Although Oleg didn ' t plan it , the tavern was taken over by the rowdy Purple Dragons garrison in town . However , he was a practical man who knew to mind his own business .

title: Olgarth Oldbridle
description: Olgarth Oldbridle Olgarth Oldbridle was a noble in Cormyr and a lord . History . Around 1479 DR , Lord Olgarth was invited to the mansion of Andranth Glarvreth .

title: Olgerkhan
description: Olgerkhan Olgerkhan was a half - orc warrior living in Palischuk in Vaasa . Appearance . Olgerkhan ' s features favored his orcish half with wide eyes in a tusky face ; his lip twisted as a result of his huge , uneven canines ; anbd his thick forehead being adorned with a singular bushy brow over bloodshot eyes .

title: Olhydra
description: Olhydra Olhydra , the Princess of Evil Water , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . In her natural state , she appeared as a huge cresting wave with two eyes like large pearl s or as a shapeless watery mass about 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Olin
description: Olin Olin was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Olin was an adventurer with bad luck .

title: Olin Gisir
description: Olin Gisir Olin Gisir means " secret keeper " in Elven , which is precisely what these scholar - mages were . Elven lifespans were many times those of humans , and this brought along with it secrets that were best left secret . Background .

title: Olisara Lightsong
description: Olisara Lightsong Olisara Lightsong was a Harper agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Olisara was possibly involved in an expedition to Throstulgrael ' s lair .

title: Olive Ruskettle
description: Olive Ruskettle Olive Ruskettle was a halfling thief who always aspired to a life of entertaining people and the easy living that profession could bring . History . Her true name was unknown .

title: Ollamh harp
description: Ollamh harp An Ollamh harp was a masterwork magic harp and the most powerful of the Instruments of the Bards . Description . " Ollamh harps " were superior in every way to ordinary harps .

title: Ollarent Hillgreen
description: Ollarent Hillgreen Ollarent Hillgreen was the assistant to Old Night Shalara Swordshigh at the main library of the Heralds of Faerûn , known as Herald ' s Holdfast , around the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . As an assistant to one of the High Heralds , Ollarent also belonged to the Heralds Pursuivant . He was the senior sage in charge of the Library of Man .

title: Olleth
description: Olleth Through out the Age of Humanity the Arcanum of Olleth was the major morkoth country in Serôs . Early into the Era of Upheaval and after the Spellplague , Olleth is now ruled by the Kuo - toa . History .

title: Olmaer Naxrin
description: Olmaer Naxrin Olmaer Naxrin was a traveling merchant that traded in Sembia . He occasionally traveled to Voonlar to oversee investments for the Zhentarim . Description .

title: Ologh
description: Ologh Ologh was a male orc and Overking of the orc kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . History . At some point , Ologh rose to the position of Overking of Vastar .

title: Ologhyn
description: Ologhyn Ologhyn of Voonlar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Ologhyn was known for his collection of rare and strange wands .

title: Olostin ' s Hold
description: Olostin ' s Hold Olostin ' s Hold was a fortified keep , between Everlund and Yartar just off the Evermoor Way located in the northwest edges of the High Forest . Description . Olostin ' s Hold was home to about 200 people and provided security for about 600 farmers and ranchers in the surrounding area .

title: Olothon
description: Olothon Olothon was an elder dragonborn shaman , and the leader of Wandering Stones as of 1479 DR . Description . Olothon had turquoise scales .

title: Olway Lezard
description: Olway Lezard Olway Lezard was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Olway led the Gray Doom mercenary company .

title: Olwen Forest - Friend
description: Olwen Forest - Friend Olwen Forest - Friend was a human ranger . Appearance . Olwen was a bear of a man with a muscular chest and his arms bulging with muscles who often spoke with a booming voice .

title: Olympus
description: Olympus Olympus , also called Arborea on the planes , and later known better by its elvish name Arvandor , was the Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model embodying the disorganized but well - intentioned motives of the chaotic good alignment . Although the gods of Olympus and Toril occasionally interacted , the people of Toril rarely concerned themselves with the affairs of the Olympians and vice versa . Memories of Olympus eventually faded and by the time the World Tree cosmology was introduced Arvandor was the accepted name for this plane .

title: Oma el Catahras
description: Oma el Catahras Oma yr Raisa el Catahras was the daughter of the innkeeper of The Roving Rune in Teshburl and an aspiring spellcaster and adventuress . In 1370 DR , Oma was being trained by her mother in the magical arts in the hidden basement of her father ' s inn . Oma kept her arcane talents secret , but she longed to finish her schooling so she could explore the world as an adventuress .

title: Oman
description: Oman Oman Island was an isle near the center of the Moonshae archipelago . Prior to the Spellplague the island was a center of Northlander culture and was under control of the Kendrick dynasty . After the Spellplague , a group of Fomorian giants entered through a gate from the Feywild and conquered the island .

title: Omar al - Farid
description: Omar al - Farid Omar al - Farid was a holy slayer and member of the Grey Fire in 1367 DR . Personality . Omar was more a follower than a leader , trusting in his sister ' s judgement in most matters .

title: Omar bin Omar
description: Omar bin Omar Omar bin Omar was a member of the Dancing Dwarves who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Omar tied his long hair and beard into braids that spun around during his dances .

title: Ombedor Steen
description: Ombedor Steen Ombedor Steen was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He was a wizard and a former adventurer who been elevated to the city ' s nobility . As an old man , he studied history , researched esoteric details of magical theory , and developed new spell s .

title: Ombul Berrypip
description: Ombul Berrypip Ombul Berrypip was a halfling cook in the Earthspur Mountains . History . In 1491 DR , Ombul lived with his daughter , Lupe Berrypip .

title: Omlar gem
description: Omlar gem Omlar gems were exceptionally rare gems mined from the Omlarandin Mountains in Tethyr . Description . Omlars were rock crystals with about the same hardness and color as aquamarine s and could also be mistaken for emerald s of a lighter shade .

title: Omlarandin Mountains
description: Omlarandin Mountains The Omlarandin Mountains were a mountain range in Tethyr and Erlkazar , known for its richness in omlar gem s , which had a variety of magical uses . Etymology . The name " omlarandin " is a corruption of Dwarvish " olaramorndin " , which means " magical peaks " .

title: Ommlur Hills
description: Ommlur Hills The Ommlur Hills were the foothills of the Small Teeth located on the west side of the Trade Way . Description . The hills were noted for their pristine beauty .

title: Omskilar Rethwood
description: Omskilar Rethwood Omskilar Rethwood was an outlaw as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak . Activities . He loved to kill , often slaying specific individuals with a single crossbow bolt .

title: Onan
description: Onan Onan of Tyr was a priest of Neverwinter . Biography . Onan went to investigate disturbances at the Tomb of the Betrayers , though he got trapped by the undead .

title: Ondal
description: Ondal Ondal was a wizard who lived in the heartlands prior to the spellplague . He was best known as a vintner who made very good wine . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , Ondal ' s manor was destroyed and the mage disappeared and was thought to have perished .

title: Ondal ' s wine
description: Ondal ' s wine Ondal ' s wine were white or golden wine s made by the mage and vintner Ondal prior to the spellplague . When the spellplague struck in 1385 DR , Ondal ' s manor and most of his wine cellar was destroyed . A few wagonloads of wine escaped destruction and these were soon recovered and disbursed throughout the Realms .

title: Ondar
description: Ondar Ondar was a farmer in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . History . In 1370 DR , he lost six head of cattle to some gnoll s .

title: Ondeth Obarskyr
description: Ondeth Obarskyr Ondeth Obarskyr was responsible for creating the settlement in the area known as the Forest Country that would later become known as Suzail , the capital of the nation of Cormyr . Relatives . Ondeth ' s wife was Suzara Obarskyr .

title: Ondonti
description: Ondonti Ondontis are a rare race closely related to orc s , brought up to be pacifists . The members of the race known as the ondontis are close cousins to orcs . However , the ondontis live as peaceful farmers and gatherers , taking only what they need from the land to survive .

title: Ondrath Everwood
description: Ondrath Everwood Ondrath Everwood was a best " tracker " among the War Wizards of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Manshoon decided he needed him in order to uncover the killer inside Castle Irlingstar .

title: Ondrin Dracohorn
description: Ondrin Dracohorn Ondrin Dracohorn was a member of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr . Appearance . Ondrin was short with ordinary looks and pale blue eyes .

title: One - Armed Magurk ' s
description: One - Armed Magurk ' s One - Armed Magurk ' s was a shop in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR run by Magurk . Magurk purchased — no questions asked — goods looted by adventurers from ruins and dungeons found within the untamed wildernesses around Thunderstone : the Hullack Forest , the Thunder Peaks , and the Vast Swamp . He sold it on in his store , and thus his selection varied greatly over time , but generally included a varied collection of artworks , gems , and jewelry ; weapons and armor ; books ; and used equipment .

title: One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs
description: One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs One - Hundred of the Dalai Lama ' s Best Proverbs was a book listing the proverbs of a Dalai Lama of the Padhran religion in Ra - Khati . A copy was located at the Blue Grotto of the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati around 1359 DR .

title: One - way lantern
description: One - way lantern A one - way lantern was a magical lantern that projected a light only the bearer could see . Description . It was small lantern fashioned of fine copper , set with a dark ruby in its center .

title: One Stone
description: One Stone One Stone was an ancestor mound for the Golden Eagle and Sky Pony tribes in the Moonwood in the Silver Marches . Description . Instead of an altar mound at the center of the cairn rings , there was a single massive boulder 20 ft ( 6 .

title: One Thousand Broken Dreams
description: One Thousand Broken Dreams One Thousand Broken Dreams is a unique magic + 3 mithral holy drow bane elven longsword . History . It is thousands of years old and was made by the elf Datharian Mistwatcher when his home city was destroyed by the drow .

title: One who waits
description: One who waits A nameless creature described as the one who waits lingered in an unknown planar location thought to be somewhere in the Nine Hells . Description . The creature was a gargantuan slug - or worm - like monstrosity , grotesquely fat and sickly green .

title: Oni mage
description: Oni mage Oni mages , often mistakenly called ogre mages , are powerful , intelligent and cunning oni that possess several potent abilities . Physical description . They often stand 10 ft ( 3 m ) tall and can weigh 700 lb ( 320 kg ) .

title: Onoshi
description: Onoshi Onoshi was an inhabitant of the town of Aru in Wa . Relationships . Onoshi was the son of an Aru fishmonger .

title: Onoye
description: Onoye Onoye was a demigod kami in Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . Onoye was a lesser nature spirit , an earthbound minor deity more goddess than human , of the Wood Spirit people .

title: Onsil
description: Onsil The Onsil family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Onsils were allied with the Baraedin , Mithertul , and Naskurl families .

title: Onsilur Maerdrathom
description: Onsilur Maerdrathom Onsilur Maerdrathom , also called the Ruling Magister , was a wizard inhabiting Sheirtalar during the 4th century DR . He served as Magister from 321 DR to 326 DR . History .

title: Onthaer
description: Onthaer Onthaer was a priest of Ilmater from the city of Athkatla in Amn . History . Described as " saintly " , Onthaer became a hermit on the lonely , windswept isle of Falconsrise in the Trackless Sea .

title: Ontharr Frume
description: Ontharr Frume Ontharr Frume was a paladin of the Order of the Gauntlet and their main delegate at the Council of Waterdeep . Personality . Ontharr was boisterous and gregarious to a fault .

title: Onthrilaenthor
description: Onthrilaenthor Onthrilaenthor was a ruined Eaerlann i settlement in the eastern Star Mounts . It was created for the elves by the Ammarindar dwarves and consisted of miles of tunnels and chambers cut into the rock , including vertical shafts to an area near the summit of the southern Star Mounts . The presence of stables near this shaft led to the belief that it was used by the Eaerlanni elves for aerial mounts .

title: Onyx
description: Onyx Onyx was part of the agate family of ornamental stones but was considered a semi - precious stone when found in pure black , pure white , or in straight bands of both colors . Description . This semi - precious stone was carved for jewelry and decorative housewares and was hard enough to wear well .

title: Onyx Tower
description: Onyx Tower The Onyx Tower was the most powerful creation on the face of Toril , it was ruled by the spirit of hatred , Eldrith the Betrayer . The Onyx Tower was created out of the Elemental Foundations and laid out on the Material Plane , it controlled all of the elements which is what made it so powerful . It was erected in the Marsh of Chelimber .

title: Onyx the Invincible
description: Onyx the Invincible Onyx the Invincible , or Onyx , Blood of Placidor , was a male dwarf fighter , thief , and adventurer who hailed from Eartheart in the Great Rift and lived in Waterdeep in the late 1350s DR . Personality . He was a wild exception to the classic image of a dour dwarf looking to the past .

title: Oolite
description: Oolite Oolite , also known as ool stones in the lands around the Sea of Fallen Stars , was a variety of which occurred in tiny egg - shaped . Description . These ornamental stones were usually solid brown in color and were very similar to algae .

title: Oolitikana
description: Oolitikana Oolitikana was an inhabitant of Mitzlato in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Abilities . Oolitikana knew many languages : those of the Dog People , desert dwarves , Poscadar elves , Metahel , Nahopaca , and the Short Ones .

title: Ooraen
description: Ooraen Ooraen was a young member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Ooraen graduated from Sorcere in 1372 DR .

title: Oota
description: Oota Oota was a self - styled mayor within the Lost Peaks . Activities . Oota managed a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen , despite being herself a captive .

title: Ooumraun
description: Ooumraun Ooumraun was the second ruler of the phaerimm . History . He was a colleague of Phaerl and developed many new spells .

title: Ooze
description: Ooze Oozes were mindless , amorphous blobs that mostly dwelt underground . Abilites . They were essentially blind , but more than made up for that with an ability called blindsight , allowing them to discern nearby objects and creatures without needing to see them .

title: Ooze Master
description: Ooze Master The Ooze Master was a monstrous intelligent ooze in the Doomvault dungeon . Personailty . The Ooze Master believed that all Red Wizards needed to be fused with oozes in order to achieve immortality and it welcomed all that arrived in its presence as new apprentices that needed its gift .

title: Ooze genasi
description: Ooze genasi The ooze genasi were para - genasi , meaning they where a mix of two elemental outsiders — water and earth . Ecology . The ooze genasi where known to have a disgusting outward appearance and also known for their repulsive personalities .

title: Opal
description: Opal Opal was a milky gem stone related to black and fire opal s , but occurred slightly more frequently . Description . The substrate of opal was usually an opaque pale blue , while the inclusions flashed green to gold .

title: Opanrael
description: Opanrael Opanrael was the head curator of Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Opanrael was a tidy man , almost obsessively such .

title: Opara Rendril
description: Opara Rendril Opara Rendril was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . Around 1358 DR , Rendril was a well - known Procampan master metal - smith who crafted high - quality longsword s and helms , while her bracelets and belt - dagger s were famous around the Inner Sea .

title: Oparl
description: Oparl Oparl was a town consisting of sixty large Calishite mansions , walled off with each having a good view of the rest of Bedorn , being situated on four high knolls . Strangers were not welcome here . Injured persons were occasionally given some supplies but were otherwise forced off to the nearest source of water by the private security of the nearest mansion .

title: Opawang
description: Opawang The Opawang was an evil sorcerer in Akari . History . The Opawang was originally the Black Leopard Priest , leader of the Black Leopard Cult in Durkon .

title: Open Feast
description: Open Feast Open Feast was a revelry held on the 26th of Mirtul each year by the King of Cormyr . It was known as the " open " feast because by tradition no members of the royal family attended the festival and the nobles were able to speak openly .

title: Open Grave
description: Open Grave Contents . " Open Grave " is a supplement meant for use in the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game , regardless of setting , which lists lore and gameplay information on undead . This ranges from a listing of new monsters to ecological details on undead of any type , as well as statistics for non - player characters ( NPCs ) of undead origin .

title: Ophala Cheldarstorn
description: Ophala Cheldarstorn Ophala Cheldarstorn is the covert owner of the Moonstone Mask as well as a respected member of the Many - Starred Cloak . Regarding the Harpers ( as well as Elminster of Shadowdale ) as allies , she counts the Arcane Brotherhood of Luskan among her list of foes . Ophala ' s apprentices spend most of their time spying on the Brotherhood through magical means so its agents can be stopped .

title: Ophealine
description: Ophealine Ophealine , or more commonly glass stone , was the name in the Realms for . The purple or violet variety was called yanolite . Description .

title: Ophidian
description: Ophidian Ophidians ( also pluralized as ophidia and also known as snakemen ) were a cruel race of serpentfolk that often served as slaves to the yuan - ti or spirit naga s . With the pterafolk , they were counted among the " Hidden Folk " . Description .

title: Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia
description: Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia Ophinshtalajiir Kaijia was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the matriarch of Clan Ophinshtalajiir in 1486 DR . Description . Kaijia had patina - green scales .

title: Ophinshtalajiir Perra
description: Ophinshtalajiir Perra Ophinshtalajiir Perra was a dragonborn member of Clan Ophinshtalajiir who served as the ambassador of Tymanther . Description . Perra was tall and gaunt .

title: Ophinshtalajiir Sepideh
description: Ophinshtalajiir Sepideh Ophinshtalajiir Sepideh was a dragonborn member of Clan Ophinshtalajiir , and a field commander of the Lance Defenders in 1486 DR . Description . Sepideh had silver scales .

title: Opinicus
description: Opinicus Opinicus , a name used when referring to both one or many , were strange good - hearted creatures found in the deserts and ruins of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Opinicus appeared to be a blend of several animals .

title: Orauna Speldarnshar
description: Orauna Speldarnshar Orauna Speldarnshar was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . She served as a mageling to Ruatheene and was based in a Zhentilar camp in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . Orauna was a former Calishite dancing girl .

title: Oraundas Haeltower
description: Oraundas Haeltower Oraundas Haeltower was a vintner from Tethyr . He who was best known for producing drinkable but rather unexceptional table wine s sold throughout the Sword Coast . His wines kept well and were a favorite among innkeepers and shopkeepers .

title: Oraxes
description: Oraxes Oraxes was a human wizard from Luthcheq . History . In his youth , he was forced to live in the arcane ghetto with other magic - users .

title: Orb
description: Orb Orbs are a type of arcane implement used by wizard s . Orbs all share their spherical shape , though many are constructed from different materials or are different colors . The powers of orbs also vary wildly , though they are typically psychic in nature , allowing the wizard to attack the mind of their foe or see into places beyond sight .

title: Orb alur
description: Orb alur Orb alur , meaning " superior spider " , was a fighting style taught among drow . Its purpose was to enable a single person to strike many enemies at once . Description .

title: Orb wraith
description: Orb wraith Orb wraiths were incorporeal undead formed when half a dozen or more wraith s merged together at a location of powerful negative energy . Description . Appearing somewhat like an enormous mass of darkness comprised of various humanoid features , an orb wraith was a constantly shifting amalgam of insubstantial limbs , faces , and shining red eyes .

title: Orbaline
description: Orbaline Orbaline was the common name in the Realms for . Description . Orbaline crystals were relatively soft and usually found in fragments rather than whole crystals .

title: Orbbcress
description: Orbbcress Orbbcress ( or Spiderweb ) was a shield belonging to Tiago Baenre . Description . The shield had grips formed like black spiders with blue sapphire eyes .

title: Orblen
description: Orblen Orblen was a rare gemstone unique to the Realms and highly prized along the Sword Coast North . Due to its rich color , it was sometimes called honeystone . The largest known Orblen was 6 in ( 15 cm ) across and was held by King Azoun IV of Cormyr .

title: Orbos Husteem
description: Orbos Husteem Orbos Husteem was a Chondathan human and the patriarch of the Husteem noble house of Waterdeep . Personality . He was well aware of his brother Orlpar ' s illegal activity and attempted to keep him in check .

title: Orbrekh
description: Orbrekh The Orbrekh was a slim branch of the Orsraun Mountains in Turmish in interior Faerûn . Inhabitants . The Orbrekh was inhabited by a mountain giant clan called the " community of the high brows " .

title: Orbyn
description: Orbyn Orbyn ( the Edge of Justice ) was a longsword crafted for Duar Obarskyr by Amedahast , and one of the Cormyrean Swords of State . It had a soft glow , similar in intensity to the full moon , and was covered in faint runes that , to the wielder , seem to move . The sword was used to slay both the dragon Thauglorimorgorus and Magrath the Minotaur .

title: Orc
description: Orc Orcs are a race of humanoids that have been a threat to the civilized cultures of Toril , particularly Faerûn for as long as any can remember . This changed somewhat in the years preceding and immediately after the Spellplague , when a horde of mountain orc s under the command of King Obould Many - Arrows unified into a single kingdom , one that is remarkably civilized . History .

title: Orc - King
description: Orc - King Orc - King was a title used by an orc ruler , equivalent to a king . History . In 580 DR , after fighting a civil war , Grimmerfang won the throne of Vastar .

title: Orc domain
description: Orc domain The Orc domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters Orc spell powers . They gain the ability to smite foes , particularly elves and dwarves . Deities with the Orc domain .

title: Orc double axe
description: Orc double axe An orc double axe was a two - handed , exotic melee weapon that could be used as a double weapon . Description . This weapon was two double - bladed axes mounted on either end of a stout haft .

title: Orc language
description: Orc language Orc , also known as Orcish or Daraktan , was the common language written and spoken by most orc s . Daraktan used the Dethek script . History .

title: Orcfastings War
description: Orcfastings War The Orcfastings War was a war between orc s and human s that took place in 936 DR in and around Nimoar ' s Hold , which would later become Waterdeep . It took place in a number of individual battles and eventually it was won by the humans . Battles .

title: Orcgate Wars
description: Orcgate Wars The Orcgate Wars , which began in - 1076 DR , were originally a magical experiment that quickly escalated into a war of devastating proportions across the Old Empires . History . In - 1081 DR , the theurgist adept Thayd , last apprentice of the Imaskari wizard s , opened a fateful portal to a brutal world dominated by empires of fanatically religious orc s .

title: Orcolla
description: Orcolla Orcolla was the duergar high priest of Orcus in Deepearth in the Underdark in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Orcolla had always at his side a marilith .

title: Orcsblood
description: Orcsblood The Orcsblood was a pirate ship captained by Ping that sailed the Moonsea in the mid – 15th century DR . History . The " Orcsblood ' s " captain and crew were known for their brutality , often slaughtering the entire crews of captured ships .

title: Orcslayer
description: Orcslayer Orcslayer , or blood - metal , was an alloy of steel that was poisonous to orc s . Description . Orcslayer was a dull gray metal .

title: Orcus
description: Orcus Orcus was a demon lord and master of the undead . Description . Orcus was typically described as having the head and legs of a goat , although with ram - like horns , a bloated body , bat - like wings , and a long tail .

title: Ordalf
description: Ordalf High Lady Ordalf was the ruler of the fey kingdom of Sarifal on the isle of Gwynneth in the Moonshae Isles , a rule that lasted over 11 , 000 years . History . Long ago , Lady Ordalf received a prophecy from a satyr seer that she could only die in the mortal realm but that she must die to save both worlds from a disease spread by a beast lord .

title: Order ' s wrath
description: Order ' s wrath Order ' s wrath is an evocation spell unique to cleric s with the law domain . It damages and dazes chaotic creatures . Effect .

title: Order of Blue Flame
description: Order of Blue Flame The Order of Blue Flame , sometimes referred to as the Order of Blue Fire , was an organization whose members often sought out plagueland s in what were referred to as Scar Pilgrimage s . The Order also operated many hospices whose mission was to aid those infected by the Spellplague . Because of the Order ' s good works , they were usually welcomed within cities .

title: Order of Delvers
description: Order of Delvers The Order of Delvers was a dwarven guild of delvers , those dwarves dedicated to exploration and discovery with chapters in many dwarven settlements . Organization . The leader of each chapter was known as a Delvemaster .

title: Order of Rainbow Monks
description: Order of Rainbow Monks The Order of Rainbow Monks were a religious organization found in the Hordelands . Activities . The rainbow monks worshiped Byubo .

title: Order of Saint Dionysus
description: Order of Saint Dionysus The Order of Saint Dionysus was a monastic order that was devoted to Ilmater and followed Saint Dionysus , the patron saint of wine and other alcohol ic spirits . History . The Order of Saint Dionysus was formed around St .

title: Order of St . Uzurr
description: Order of St . Uzurr The Order of St . Uzurr was a monastic order that was devoted to Ilmater and followed Saint Uzurr .

title: Order of the Aster
description: Order of the Aster The Order of the Aster is a militaristic organization that serves Lathander . Paladins of the Morninglord are among the best - loved heroes of Faerûn . They are loosely organized ( along with other fighters devoted to the god ) into a holy order called the Order of the Aster .

title: Order of the Bladewright
description: Order of the Bladewright The Order of the Bladewright was a psionic unit of the Knights of Imphras II made up of soulknives , based in the kingdom of Impiltur . Activities . The soulknives of the Order of the Bladewright dedicated their minds and bodies to the protection of the Boy King , Imbrar II .

title: Order of the Blue Boar
description: Order of the Blue Boar The Order of the Blue Boar was the most - prestigious mercenary recruitment organization in Amn , based near Riatavin around 1358 DR . They were active in Amn , Calimshan , Tethyr , and the Sword Coast . Membership .

title: Order of the Chalice
description: Order of the Chalice The Order of the Chalice is the organization to which all Knights of the Chalice , along with those whom are aspiring to that prestige class , belong . Members of the order devote themselves entirely to the organization ' s primary mission : the complete eradication of demon s in the multiverse . To this end , they seek out and destroy demons wherever they exist on the Material Plane , while also carry out well - planned excursions against targets within the Abyss itself .

title: Order of the Dark Moon
description: Order of the Dark Moon Shar ' s secretive monastic order was referred to as the Order of the Dark Moon . Activities . The Dark Moon acted openly in lands friendly to the worship of Shar .

title: Order of the Dawn
description: Order of the Dawn The Order of the Dawn was a secretive religious cult that venerated the slumbering Primordial s of Returned Abeir . Dogma . The Order of Dawn preached that before dragon s Laerakond was a peaceful land inhabited by humanoids who lived in harmony with the Dawn Titans , and that , in their slumber , the Dawn Titans were aware of all that had befell to the good people of Laerakond .

title: Order of the Fiery Heart
description: Order of the Fiery Heart The Order of the Fiery Heart was part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . This elite unit numbered 500 griffon - riding troops .

title: Order of the Gauntlet
description: Order of the Gauntlet The Order of the Gauntlet was formed to destroy evil in the world at large . Its core members were cleric s and paladin s . These religious paragons were united in ideals from the faiths of Tyr , Helm , Torm , and Hoar .

title: Order of the Golden Coin
description: Order of the Golden Coin The Order of the Golden Coin was an all - female martial order of priestesses dedicated to the goddess Nephthys of the Mulhorandi pantheon . They protected temples , caravans , and individual people , and were quite skilled at dissuading criminals , although their fee was considerable .

title: Order of the Golden Cup
description: Order of the Golden Cup The Order of the Golden Cup was a knightly order of paladins within the faith of Ilmater , the Crying God . Activities . The Order devoted itself to the healing and defense of the innocent , the weak , the sick , and others who could not protect themselves .

title: Order of the Golden Lion
description: Order of the Golden Lion The Order of the Golden Lion was a paladin order of Torm . Activities . Members of the the Order , known as Golden Lions , guarded temples of deities whose worshipers Torm ' s church had persecuted during the Time of Troubles .

title: Order of the Jade Blade
description: Order of the Jade Blade The Order of the Jade Blade were the personal agents of the High Lord of Loudwater . Two adventuring parties who had earned the respect of the Gauntlets of Loudwater were brought before High Lord Kalahar Twohands whose son , Velvred had been kidnapped and was being held in one of the Rensha tombs beneath the High Lord ' s Hall . Kalahar himself had been warned by divinations that if he were to enter the tombs he would surely be killed so he sent the two groups into the tombs in his stead .

title: Order of the Long Death
description: Order of the Long Death The order of the Long Death is a monastic order devoted to death . History . Formed after the people of Calimshan freed themselves from the Djen , the order ' s original purpose was to teach people how they could attack and kill their former masters .

title: Order of the Many - Starred Cloak
description: Order of the Many - Starred Cloak The Order of the Many - Starred Cloak was a guild of arcane magic users in the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North . Headquarters . The guild ' s headquarters were found at the Cloaktower in the Castle District of Neverwinter .

title: Order of the Radiant Heart
description: Order of the Radiant Heart The Order of the Radiant Heart is a fraternity of lawful good paladins and clerics that operates throughout Faerûn . Members of the order devote themselves to fighting evil and injustice , maintaining peace and upholding the law . The Order has followers of many goodly deities in its ranks , but the knights of the Order mainly venerate the gods Torm , Tyr and Helm .

title: Order of the Red Falcon
description: Order of the Red Falcon The Order of the Red Falcon was a group of fighter s and paladin s dedicated to the service of the Red Knight . From their base just north of Baldur ' s Gate , the Citadel of Strategic Militancy , they taught tactics , strategy and military history to aspiring officers who sought their teachings .

title: Order of the Risen Scepter
description: Order of the Risen Scepter Drawn exclusively from those who have died in combat with servants of Set and been raised from the dead ( sometimes spontaneously by the power of Osiris ) , they are primarily hunters ( multiclass Paladins / Rangers of Set ’ s minions ) . They are casual towards death as they are granted the power to return from death unaided if killed by Set ' s minions with unjust or dishonorable means .

title: Order of the Shooting Star
description: Order of the Shooting Star The Order of the Shooting Star was an order of ranger s dedicated to Mystra , goddess of magic . A member of the order was known as a Shooting Star . Organization .

title: Order of the Silver Chalice
description: Order of the Silver Chalice The Order of the Silver Chalice was a knightly order dedicated to Siamorphe the Noble . Activities . This group was primarily made up of Tethyrian nobles dedicated to locating lost members of noble families and restoring to power those who would govern with the interests of the common people at heart .

title: Order of the Silver Lance
description: Order of the Silver Lance The Order of the Silver Lance was a mercenary company based in Ormath in the Shining Plains and active in the Sea of Fallen Stars around 1358 DR . They were a corp of medium cavalry . Membership .

title: Order of the Steel Fang
description: Order of the Steel Fang The Order of the Steel Fang is an elite fighting order within the church of Tempus , whose members are often assigned to the most dangerous duties and led by battle - hardened clergymen . Many mercenary companies and knightly fighting orders of crusaders also avail themselves of a connection to the church . One badge of the god seen among his affiliated mercenaries is a rusty brown dagger , shown diagonally with its point to the upper right , dripping four drops of blood .

title: Order of the Sun Soul
description: Order of the Sun Soul The Order of the Sun Soul was a monastic order that , during the time of Netheril , worshipped the god Amaunator as the " Brotherhood of the Sun " . History . When Netheril fell , the order survived , though their god seemed not to have .

title: Order of the Verdant Grove
description: Order of the Verdant Grove The Order of the Verdant Grove was an association of druid s and verdant lord s who shared information about nature with each other , reporting on the discovery of standing stones , druidic circles , new plants or animals , and other lands . Members were identified by a hoop earring adorned with a small green pearl . In order to be accepted , a druid must be sponsored by an existing member and voted in during one of the organization ' s occasional meetings .

title: Order of the Watchful Lion
description: Order of the Watchful Lion The Order of the Watchful Lion was an order of crusader s dedicated to Anhur . This organization served as Mulhorand ' s first line of defense . Its members often scout neighboring regions and report important events , areas , and people to their superiors .

title: Ordning ( social structure )
description: Ordning ( social structure ) The ordning is the social structure to which all giant s adhere , dating back to the ancient empire of Ostoria . It is similar to a class - based society , but is much more specific , assigning a social rank to each individual . Therefore , each individual giant knows which others giants are inferior and superior to himself , and no giants are equal to other giants .

title: Ordulin
description: Ordulin Ordulin was the former capital of Sembia but was destroyed in a planar rift summoned by Elyril , one of Shar ' s followers . There was a constant ominous cloud above the city , along with a lone earthmote with a Shadovar citadel resting atop it . History .

title: Oreioth
description: Oreioth Oreioth was a necromancer hiding in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Oreioth had always been cruel , but after his self - exile to Red Larch with only the company of his undead servitors , he became a true megalomaniac .

title: Oreme
description: Oreme Oreme was the capital of the Sarrukh empire of Isstosseffifil ( the Land of the Lost Sea ) , remaining after the collapse of the empire in – 33 , 800 DR . By 1374 DR , mainly ruins and the circular rubble of its great towers remained on the surface , but many of its subterranean structures were intact .

title: Oren Yogilvy
description: Oren Yogilvy Oren Yogilvy was was a halfling musician in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Oren resided permanently at the Northfurrow ' s End inn .

title: Oretheo Spikes
description: Oretheo Spikes Oretheo Spikes was a member of , and later the leader of , the Wilddwarf Brigade ; a battlerager brigade from Citadel Adbar . History . Oretheo was a member of the Wilddwarf Brigade in 1484 DR .

title: Orgauth
description: Orgauth Orgauth was a veteran of fifteen years of service to the Zhentilar and later became a Lord of Zhentil Keep . Description . Dark - haired and generously mustached with hints of grey revealing his age , Orgauth kept his hair tightly pulled back in a ponytail .

title: Orglash
description: Orglash An orglash , or ice spirit , was a rare elemental native to the Prime Material Plane and found in the land of Rashemen . Description . Similar to air elemental s , orglash had insubstantial bodies made of wind and snow .

title: Orglym
description: Orglym Orglym was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a .

title: Oric Cimber
description: Oric Cimber Oric Cimber was the eldest son of the highwayman known as Shadowhawk . Description . As the son of a bandit , Oric was strong and quick .

title: Oriental Adventures
description: Oriental Adventures Oriental Adventures was written by Gary Gygax , David " Zeb " Cook , and Francois Marcela - Froideval , and published in 1985 by TSR for use with the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 1st Edition rules . The book ' s early chapters introduce ten character classes and three races that Oriental campaigns use in place of D & D ' s original classes and races . Further chapters provide spells , monsters , magic items , and other rules used in Oriental campaigns .

title: Oriphaun McMaren
description: Oriphaun McMaren Oriphaun McMaren was a Chondathan human swordsage in the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a practitioner of blade magic and led an order of crusader s based at a sword - temple in Procampur . They were usually engaged in providing security at major events and noble galas , as well as guarding visiting dignitaries .

title: Orishaar
description: Orishaar Orishaar was an ancient kingdom of moon elves created during the First Flowering . History . The kingdom was a trade partner of Aryvandaar , and this link was a good excuse for the Ilythiiri dark elves to attack the moon elves and take their land .

title: Orison
description: Orison An orison was the divine spellcasting equivalent to a " cantrip " . Priests of all mythoi learned various " orisons " as acolytes . Effects .

title: Orist Moonbow
description: Orist Moonbow Orist Moonbow was an impetuous Harper in Maztica in 1370 DR . Activities . Orist was sent to Maztica by High Harper Khelben Arunsun together with fellow Harpers Lady Syllia Adarbrent and Farid al - Nisr .

title: Orjalun
description: Orjalun Orjalun was the kind and just High Mage of Silverymoon , during the city ' s early days . He was one of the most polite and cultured wizard s ever known . Prior to being High Mage , he was Keeper of the Vault of Sages .

title: Orl
description: Orl Orl crystals were only found in very soft rock inside " blue caves " such as those near Wheloon , and were believed to be exclusive to the northern half of Faerûn . Description . Orls occurred as long , symmetric , sharp - edged crystals and ranged in color from a dark , tawny yellow to orange to red .

title: Orlak
description: Orlak Orlak was a powerful vampire who once ruled Westgate . History . Before the Dale Reckoning , Orlak was a powerful vampire .

title: Orlarrakh
description: Orlarrakh Orlarrakh , also known as The Green Duchess , was the ruler of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . She was a vassal of Melauthaur , the ruler of Melabrauth . Personality .

title: Orlath
description: Orlath " This horrific serpentine demon shares two humanoid atop a single coiling body . Each torso weaves a set of six humanoid arms , all clutching cruel scimitars . The monster ' s two baboon - like heads glower menacingly , their eyes beady and bright with hate .

title: Orlathon Lunemast
description: Orlathon Lunemast Orlathon Lunemast was a human man and a priest of Selûne in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , Orlathan was High Priest of The Rising Moon temple of Selûne in Tsurlagol , in charge of 9 subpriests . He was still in charge by 1370 DR .

title: Orlbar
description: Orlbar Orlbar was a sleepy village on the junction of the Loagrann and Greyflow rivers , supporting about 450 shepherds History . Known as a simple , sleepy town unwilling to grow any larger than it already was . In the summer of 1369 DR a Zhentarim caravan rolled into town and set up a new government .

title: Orlen
description: Orlen Orlen was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Orlen was a respected old farmer who kept his crops in good health .

title: Orlenstar Thirlthorn
description: Orlenstar Thirlthorn Orlenstar Thirlthorn was a Chondathan human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a druid of Silvanus who tended to the God ' s Grove shrine . History .

title: Orlex
description: Orlex Orlex was a baatezu devil lord who ruled the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia , which was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . His reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked . A band of rebellious wizard s arose to depose Orlex .

title: Orlgaun
description: Orlgaun Orlgaun was a black dragon allied with the Zhentarim and usually ridden by Manshoon . Manshoon rode him in his first tentative abduction of Shandril Shessair , but thanks to her power of " spellfire " and her friends she defeated Manshoon and greatly injured the dragon . Despite Manshoon ' s efforts , the dying Orlgaun lost all his strength and crashed into the ruins of Myth Drannor .

title: Orlil
description: Orlil Orlil is an island in the country of Lantan . Not much is really known about Lantan , other than that it consists of 3 separate islands located in the Trackless Sea , north of Chultan peninsula : Lantan proper , which the Sambar Run separates from the southern Suj , and the eastern most and almost uninhabited Orlil . After Captain Cordell from Amn discovered Maztica , Lantaneses , being the westernmost extension of Faerûn along with the reclusive Evermeet and the enigmatic Nimbral , also claimed some lands .

title: Orlimmin
description: Orlimmin Orlimmin was a village in the Vast , lying where the Long Reach from Bambryn met the Tantras Trail between Tantras and Highbank Forest . Description . Orlimmin was a quiet agricultural center .

title: Orlpar Husteem
description: Orlpar Husteem Lord Orlpar Husteem was a human living on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep and a member of the Husteem noble house . Personality . Orlpar was a trader of drugs , perfumes , spices and wine s , although some of his wares were illicit , such as bloodroot .

title: Orlumbor
description: Orlumbor Orlumbor , pronounced ( Or - LUM - bore ) , was a small rocky barren island city - state in the Sea of Swords . Geography . The settlement was located due west of the Trollbark Forest between Daggerford and Baldur ' s Gate and 300 miles south of the free city of Waterdeep , on the Sword Coast .

title: Ormath
description: Ormath Ormath was a small city on the south - eastern edge of the Shining Plains . Relations . Of the three cities it shared the Shining Plains with , Ormath was the most prone to conflict over the slightest transgression .

title: Ormion Bowbreaker
description: Ormion Bowbreaker Ormion Bowbreaker was a male Chondathan human psion ( seer ) and a soldier based at Castle Crag in Cormyr in the 1370s DR . A young man , Ormion was one of the psionicist s hired by Commander Bren Tallsword to instantly transmit secure messages via telepathy to Arabel in the event the castle was attacked . However , Ormion ' s powers went a step further — he successfully foresaw a vicious raid by gnoll s .

title: Ormitar
description: Ormitar The Ormitar family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the family was headed by Lassalar Ormitar , who also commanded the Guard , the military force that defended and policed the city .

title: Ormpetarr
description: Ormpetarr Prior to the Spellplague , Ormpetarr was the capital city of Sespech . After the Spellplague struck , the city became a center for scar pilgrimage s . Features .

title: Ormu
description: Ormu Ormu was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It favored warm , moist areas such as steam tunnels and steam vents . Ormu gave off a soft green glow that provided dim illumination in a five foot ( 1 .

title: Orn Thavil
description: Orn Thavil Orn Thavil was a human male priest of Tymora who dwelt in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . By 1357 DR , Orn Thavil served as High Priest of the Lady ' s Happy Hall temple of Tymora in the Temple District of Procampur .

title: Orna
description: Orna Orna was a former member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Orna was a greedy and brutal individual .

title: Ornan Roaryl
description: Ornan Roaryl Ornan Roaryl was the king of Eskorn , Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . He was a member of the Roaryl dynasty . Description .

title: Orniiv Fanderfall
description: Orniiv Fanderfall Orniiv Fandarfall , also called the Eclipse , was a male human cleric of Mask . He was a member of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Orniiv was responsible for the guild ' s operation in Baldur ' s Gate .

title: Ornoth I
description: Ornoth I King Ornoth I ( full name Ornoth Myrmoran ) was the king of Myrmoran from 168 DR . He became king after the death of his father , Uth I . Ornoth granted nobility to seven of his closest allies , who had long been his counselors .

title: Oroch ' s Stride
description: Oroch ' s Stride Oroch ' s Stride was a portal to the Abyss located in Scornubel . History . For years , a human merchant Oroch controlled the portal which linked Scornubel to Morglon - Daar .

title: Orog
description: Orog Orogs were orc s who lived and thrived in the Underdark . They looked like normal mountain orc s but were slightly taller , with larger ears and huge pale eyes . History .

title: Orok
description: Orok Orok was a runaway boy of Blue Bear Tribe in Zelbross . History . Orok abandoned his tribe because his siblings bullied him .

title: Orold Archemusk
description: Orold Archemusk Orold Archemusk was a wizard of the 12th and 13th centuries DR . History . Around 1100 DR , he wrote " Trends in Approaches to the Art " .

title: Ororonymilith
description: Ororonymilith Ororonymilith , also known as The Vizier of Broken Thorns , was a bronze dragon vassal of the Empress Dragon Gauwervyndhal in Skelkor , Abeir . History . Ororonymilith was one of the vassals of Gauwervyndhal who were tasked with finding the thief who was hunting in the Dragon Empress ' s forest .

title: Oroth
description: Oroth Oroth , also known as the Hollow Mountain , was a volcano located in southern Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Oroth was a large but low , collapsed volcanic peak overgrown with thick forest .

title: Orox
description: Orox Orox was a beholder ally of the Orthodox Church of Bane in 1357 DR . History . Orox was a beholder supporting the High lmperceptor of Bane of Mulmaster .

title: Orprase
description: Orprase Orprase was another name for , a gemstone especially favored by followers of Tymora . Description . Orprase was a medium - hard , brittle stone that was either colorless or faintly straw - yellow and found as transparent areas in otherwise uninteresting opaque rock samples .

title: Orran
description: Orran Orran was a senior Doomguide and priest of Kelemvor in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . As a member of the Eternal Order of Kelemvor , his mission was to clear the city ' s graveyard of undead .

title: Orrery
description: Orrery An orrery was complex device used by astrologer s in Zakhara to view and chart the constellation s . Description . An orrery consisted of a silver ball that was surrounded by twelve rings .

title: Orrery of the Inner Planes
description: Orrery of the Inner Planes The Orrery of the Inner Planes was an enchanted mechanical object , the origin of which was up for debate . Some scholars believed it to be a marid device , while others thought it to be a creation of the cooperative efforts of both the marid and dao , which seemed highly unlikely . Description .

title: Orrik
description: Orrik Orrik was a wizard who dwelt at the Severed Hand . Physical description . Orrik wore all gray robes , and had gray hair .

title: Orsin
description: Orsin Orsin was a deva shadowalker from Telflamm . History . Orsin lived many lives , always as deva , aasimar , or similar celestial being .

title: Orsraun Mountains
description: Orsraun Mountains The Orsraun Mountains were the largest range of mountains south of the Spine of the World . Geography . The Orsrauns made up the majority of Turmish ' s western border .

title: Orthaerus Manycloaks
description: Orthaerus Manycloaks Orthaerus Manycloaks was a wizard who lived in the Wildwoods mansion near Waymoot in 1367 DR . History . Orthaerus was slain during a spell - duel by the wizard Endarthar .

title: Orva
description: Orva Orva was a kingdom located in what was later south - east Cormyr . Orva was destroyed around - 700 DR , in " one horrific night of blood and slime " and was " long gone and forgotten " by 26 DR when the kingdom of Cormyr was founded . Locations .

title: Orvanath
description: Orvanath Orvanath was a lich and a necromancer . In 1266 DR , he trapped the Bright Banner Brandished adventuring company , including the wizard Ashemmi , in a subterranean crypt north of Mirabar , where he killed them in their entirety , except for Ashemmi who escaped by using a " teleport " scroll . Orvanath joined the Arcane Brotherhood in Luskan .

title: Orvustia Esseren
description: Orvustia Esseren Orvustia Esseren was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . The guard was smart , tough , and talented with her bow and spear but knew nothing of the " Realms " outside her homeland .

title: Orvyltar
description: Orvyltar Orvyltar was the capital city of the kingdom of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . The city stood at the innermost end of Copper Bay , a protected bay that it the kingdom ' s biggest and safest port .

title: Oryal Forestal
