description: Oryal Forestal Oryal Forestal was the Silhouette of Spies of the Shadow Thieves chapter in Athkatla around 1370 DR . Personality . Oryal was very loyal to his friend Renal .

title: Oryndoll
description: Oryndoll Oryndoll , the City of Loretakers , was a large underground mind flayer citystate in the Lowerdark of the Darklands . Oryndoll was one of the earliest illithid cities on Toril and was highly famed for its inhabitants rampant collection of exclusive knowledge . Its wealth of knowledge rivaled even Candlekeep ' s great library .

title: Osamu Muraoka
description: Osamu Muraoka Osamu Muraoka was a samurai who ran a posthouse in Kozakura and also a jito in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse at the strategic entrance to the pass through the Kurisammyaku , he led a company of thirty samurai and four hundred bushi .

title: Osari Daizan
description: Osari Daizan Osari Daizan was the daimyo of Tifuido in Wa . Personality . Daizan was a good - natured and cheerful individual .

title: Osari Minhiro
description: Osari Minhiro Osari Minhiro was an old samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Personality . After the death of his daughters , Minhiro became cynical .

title: Osaw I
description: Osaw I The undying " negus negusti " ( " Prince of Princes " ) , King Osaw I the Wise was the ruler of the holy city of Mezro and one of the seven " bara e " , the Chosen of Ubtao . Description . King Osaw appeared to be a Tabaxi man of 80 years of age , with hunched shoulders and wrinkled skin , though he was over a millennium - and - a - half old .

title: Osbrun
description: Osbrun King Osbrun was the king of the city of Chessagol ( later called Tsurlagol ) in the Vast in the early 1350s DR . History . King Osbrun once bought the shield called " Thurbrand ' s Protector " from the warrior Thurbrand .

title: Osbur
description: Osbur Osbur was a servant of House Oldbridle in Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , after the death of Olgarth Oldbridle , his son and heir Elbert Olbridle sent Osbur to Broryn Windstag in order to inform him about the news and to not trust Kormoroth and Yestrel and the Lhendreth s of Saerloon .

title: Osco Salibuck
description: Osco Salibuck Osco Salibuck was a halfling rogue from Waterdeep . Description . Osco had chestnut - brown curly hair with sideburns .

title: Osco Salibuck the Elder
description: Osco Salibuck the Elder Osco Salibuck the Elder was a male halfling and an associate of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , and the ancestor of Osco Salibuck . History . He had a statue honoring his service to Khelben in Blackstaff Tower .

title: Osconivon
description: Osconivon Osconivon was the Lord Magistrate of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Osconivon was a drunken fool in service of Manshoon ; deep he was a coward but not stupid .

title: Osctl Sleeping Turtle
description: Osctl Sleeping Turtle Osctl Sleeping Turtle was a chieftain in Far Payit in the 4th century DR . History . Osctl was one of the chieftains in the Ixtzul Vale when in 362 DR the Star Worm ' s egg fell from the sky .

title: Oshiga
description: Oshiga Oshiga was an trumpet archon in service to Erathaol in 1385 DR . History . Oshiga was an archon who was in service to Erathaol in Mount Celestia for long time .

title: Osiris
description: Osiris Osiris ( pronounced oh - " sigh " - ris ) is a stern member of the Mulhorandi pantheon who enjoys watching children play . He is known as Osirant in Thay , and by the name Ozrikotep in Unther . History .

title: Osk Thunderhale
description: Osk Thunderhale Osk Thunderhale was a sea captain sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Relationship . Osk was at the employ of Lord Dagult Neverember .

title: Osse
description: Osse Osse was a continent on Toril , located between Kara - Tur and Maztica . It lay between the Eastern Sea of Kara - Tur and the Western Ocean before Maztica , and north of the Southern Ocean . It was mysterious and little - known to Faerûn .

title: Ossian Talendar
description: Ossian Talendar Ossian Talendar was the heir of the Talendar family in Selgaunt . History . Early in his life , his father Nuldrevyn noticed Ossian ' s great intelligence and energy and so Ossian was chosen as the family ' s heir and trained for this role .

title: Ostoria
description: Ostoria Ostoria ( meaning " father ' s seat " in Jotun ) was the original kingdom of the giant s , founded by Annam All - Father to celebrate the last of his sons coming of age . At the peak of its power , it was dubbed " The Colossal Kingdom " because it occupied an area of Faerûn from the Vilhon Reach to the Cold Lands . As it grew , Annam split it up so that each of his favored sons could acquire part of it .

title: Ostrav
description: Ostrav Ostrav was a small farming village found in the grasslands of the Duchy of Arcata in Damara along the Beaumaris River . Activities . Despite their relatively small size , the politically neutral community managed to survive and thrive during desperate times such as the rise of Zhengyi .

title: Ostus Agrivar
description: Ostus Agrivar Ostus Agrivar was a male human wizard of the North . He was one of the most renowned wizards of the region and lord of the Agrivar estate . Relationships .

title: Osyluth
description: Osyluth Osyluths — sometimes called bone devils — serve as taskmasters and interrogators of the devils . They act as law - enforcement throughout Hell , leading many devils to fear their presence . Bone devils delight in torturing mortals and devils alike , causing physical and mental suffering wherever they go .

title: Otaaryliakkarnos
description: Otaaryliakkarnos Otaaryliakkarnos was a wyrm silver dragon follower of Bahamut who lived in Cormanthor . History . In 650 DR Otaaryliakkarnos served as the companion of the moon elf Avourel Omberdawn .

title: Othea
description: Othea Othea ( known as Deronain in Auld Dwarvish and Sonnhild in ancient Thorass ) was a goddess who married Annam All - Father and bore his children , who would become the origin of the giant race . She would later claim the cold vast plains with Annam ' s son Lanaxis . Relatives .

title: Othea Tor
description: Othea Tor Othea Tor was an isolated mountain far to the north of Faerûn , the physical manifestation of Othea in her death . Description . The ice - covered mountain was only about 200 feet high .

title: Othelstan
description: Othelstan Captain Othelstan was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who supervised the Cult - controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains . Description . The captain was a strong man with unusual black skin .

title: Otherwind stride
description: Otherwind stride Otherwind stride is a spell of the conjuration school used by some warlock s , particularly those of the fey pact . When cast " otherwind stride " , he or she creates a maelstrom resembling in many ways of a fey crossroad . Any creatures caught in the effect , which is roughly five feet in diameter and must be cast near the warlock , are injured by its energy .

title: Othglas Aumar
description: Othglas Aumar Othglas Aumar was one of the Warring Princes of Athalantar . History . Othglas was a fat , jolly , and food - loving man , with a penchant for poisoning his enemies .

title: Othiiyr Velthrann
description: Othiiyr Velthrann Othiiyr Velthrann was a sage of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . His life ' s work was his study of the magic sword s of the Royal Guard of King Imphras I and King Imbrar of Impiltur .

title: Othimturac
description: Othimturac Othimturac was a shadow white dragon bred by the Jaezred Chaulssin of Karsoluthiyl . History . As part of an experiment , the Jaezred Chaulssin of Karsoluthiyl crossbred various kinds of chromatic dragon s with shadow dragon s in order to create a more suitable race .

title: Othla Multar
description: Othla Multar Othla Multar was a sage from the city of Spandeliyon in Altumbel . Othla Multar studied the legends of Adhe Wood in the Vast and theorized that the many mutant spiders there were bred by drow , who released them to guard their passage to the local Underdark , from which they occasionally emerged and crossed into the Tsurlar Forest to trade with pirate vessels that anchored in hidden coves .

title: Othmar bin Jaqal
description: Othmar bin Jaqal Othmar bin Jaqal was a sha ' ir who lived in Mahabba of the Pantheist League in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Othmar bound an efreeti named Zet into his service .

title: Othmar bin Kaloth
description: Othmar bin Kaloth Othmar bin Kalath was a sha ' ir who lived in Rog ' osto of the Cities of the Ancients in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Othmar was served by a loyal efreeti named Xamus .

title: Othorion Keove
description: Othorion Keove Othorion Keove was an elven warrior . Description . Othorion wore full elven mail armor .

title: Othovir
description: Othovir Othovir was a shopkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Othovir was a handsome and charismatic male human of Illuskan stock .

title: Othur Roonsundyr
description: Othur Roonsundyr Othur Roonsundyr was a reclusive wizard in Skullport . Personality . Othur was the most militant recluse in the North .

title: Otiluke ' s resilient sphere
description: Otiluke ' s resilient sphere When Otiluke ' s resilient sphere is cast , the result is a globe of shimmering force that encloses the subject creature if it fails to successfully save vs . Spells . The " resilient sphere " ' will contain its subject for the duration of the spell .

title: Otleo Ressmon
description: Otleo Ressmon Otleo Ressmon , usually known as The Fat , was a male thief who was a member of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Otleo was a career man , rising through the ranks of the guild step by hard step , starting as a common thief . His duty was to control the guild ' s operations in Tethyr , where he posed as a prospering merchant .

title: Otomo Tahiro
description: Otomo Tahiro Otomo Tahiro was a prisoner shukenja in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Tahiro in 1360 went to Ito - Jo to destroy the evil inside but for his weak power he was captured and tortured by magic by an evil Wu jen in the caves deep the castle .

title: Otsabe Kanchi
description: Otsabe Kanchi Otsabe Kanchi was a samurai retainer of the Tsu family and the zussho of Iyo in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In Iyo , he led a company of two samurai and ten bushi , all loyal only to him .

title: Ott Steeltoes
description: Ott Steeltoes Ott Steeltoes was the most competent smuggler of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Ott was a renegade of the Ironmaster clan . He first worked as pirate but later was offered a place in the Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild .

title: Ottad el Ostak
description: Ottad el Ostak Ottad yn Malik el Ostak was the younger brother of Basad el Ostak and the head of the thieves ' guild in Memnon for el Kahmir family in 1370 DR . Personality . Ottad was young and power - hungry , which spymaster Nureh el Pesarkhal used to her advantage .

title: Ottar
description: Ottar Ottar was a frost giant and the origin of the frost giant race . His father , Annam All - Father , granted him the cold lands of the north of Faerûn . Relatives .

title: Otto ' s irresistible dance
description: Otto ' s irresistible dance Otto ' s irresistible dance was an enchantment spell that forced the subject to dance . It was presumably developed by Otto . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as irresistible dance , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Otyugh
description: Otyugh Otyughs were strange aberration s that dwelt underground and delighted in the eating of filth and offal . Description . Otyughs were strange - looking creatures , with bloated , oval - shaped bodies around 8 feet ( 2 .

title: Ouranalathra
description: Ouranalathra Ouranalathra , also called " the Mistmaiden " , was a female great wyrm mist dragon who once laired at Iron Dragon Mountain , in Earthfast Mountains in north Faerûn , but by 1374 DR resided at the Lake of Mists in the Endless Wastes . History . In the spring of 231 DR , the Year of the Mist Dragon — a year named for her — Ouranalathra was sighted in lands all around the Inner Sea , challenging , fighting , and publicly slaying any other dragon she could find .

title: Ourqax
description: Ourqax Ourqax was a ixilthetocal ruler during the Twelfth Serôs War . History . Born in 1212 DR Ourqax started in ascension in 1355 DR at Ilkanar and Ageadren and in ashort time became vitanar .

title: Oussa
description: Oussa Oussa was a yuan - ti in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Oussa was a devotee of Zehir .

title: Outer Planes
description: Outer Planes Outer Planes is a collective term used to describe a subset of the known planes of existence in various cosmology models . The term refers to the placement of the planes being the outermost concentric sphere that made up the multiverse in the Great Wheel cosmology model . The term continued to be used in the World Tree cosmology model but referred to a different set of planes .

title: Outland priest
description: Outland priest Outland priests were cleric s , priests , and druid s who came to Zakhara from distant lands to practice their beliefs . Requirements . Members of both sexes and all races could be considered an outland priest , though no Zakharan could ever be considered an outland priest .

title: Outland warrior
description: Outland warrior Outland warriors were special warrior s found in Zakhara who traveled there from some other location . Requirements . These warriors had no special requirements .

title: Outsider
description: Outsider Outsiders were any non - elemental creatures that originated on a plane other than the Prime Material Plane . Abilities . Most outsiders had darkvision to a range of 60 feet .

title: Overking
description: Overking Overking was a title used by a ruler , equivalent to a king . History . The orc kingdom of Vastar was ruled by an overking .

title: Overland flight
description: Overland flight Overland flight was a transmutation spell that functioned like the spell " fly " , except that it only affected the caster and was slightly slower , but lasted much longer . Over an eight - hour period , the caster of overland flight could travel up to 64 miles .

title: Overseer
description: Overseer Overseers were the most dangerous of the beholderkin . Rivaling the power of a hive mother , an overseer resembled nothing more than a large mass of flesh or a tree with mouths on its trunk and eyes on its branches . Overseers possessed powers similar to that of a hive mother and could control the actions of five to ten standard beholder s or five to twenty beholderkin .

title: Oversember Vale
description: Oversember Vale Oversember Vale was a small valley located in the Thunder Peaks . Description . Small pools of water lay at the northern end of the vale .

title: Ovith
description: Ovith Ovith was a shadovar scout for Prince Brennus Tanthul . History . In 1484 DR , Ovith and his fellow Cronil went under the orders of Brennus to search for the Abbey of the Rose .

title: Ovon
description: Ovon Ovon was a monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Earthspur Mountains . Personality . Ovon was always calm and naive .

title: Ovros Thilymm
description: Ovros Thilymm Ovros Thilymm was a man of Mordulkin in Chessenta and Head Librarian of the Jedea Academy in the early 1370s DR . History . In the winter of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Ovros led Ythnel Duumin , Kestus Aentius , Muctos Dapritus , and Kohtakah to a secret meeting with a contact — in truth , King Hercubes Jedea .

title: Owl
description: Owl Owls are nocturnal birds of prey that are known to silently fly through the night in search of food . They feed on small animals , lizards , and other birds . Owls come in a variety of names and appearances .

title: Owlbear
description: Owlbear An owlbear is a large magical beast that looks like a cross between an owl and a bear . Species . Cormanthor .

title: Oxsal Keeneyes
description: Oxsal Keeneyes Count Oxsal Keeneyes was a Count of Monteshi and Guild Chancellor of Tethyr . He was a halfling man . Personality .

title: Oyfanen
description: Oyfanen Oyfanen was a dryad living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . Oyfanen was the spirit of an oak tree . History .

title: Oyn Evenmoor
description: Oyn Evenmoor Oyn Evenmoor was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Oyn was a stubborn , argumentative man with an opinion about everything .

title: Ozomar Do ' Urden
description: Ozomar Do ' Urden Ozomar Do ' Urden , formerly Ozomar Druu ' giir , was the house wizard of House Do ' Urden . History . Ozomar was formerly a member of House Druu ' giir .

title: PC
description: PC A PC ( player character ) is the opposite of an NPC . A PC is the character that you make in a computer roleplaying game , or the character that the player makes in a game of . The term in the plural is frequently used to refer to the group of players .

title: Pachipol
description: Pachipol Pachipol was the mayor of Amah in the Vilhon Reach in 1358 DR . Activities . Pachipol ruled Amah , one of the Free Cities of the Vilhon Reach .

title: Pack runner
description: Pack runner A pack runner is a beastmaster ranger who has chosen to focus his or her connection with the wild through their bond with a canine such as a wolf or jackal . These pack runners form bonds solely with companions of the canine variety , building upon the long history of friendship between canines and humanoid s . So connected is the pack runner and his or her canine friend , that their minds can often seem as one , as the ranger takes on doglike characteristics while their feral friend becomes more and more like a sentient creature .

title: Pact of the Iron Ring
description: Pact of the Iron Ring The Pact of the Iron Ring was a brief ritual designed to strengthen the bond between the Warlock Knights of Vaasa . The ritual required each knight to display his ring and swear an oath to all the other knights present . Knights who participated in the ritual were bound to their peers for all time .

title: Pacys
description: Pacys Pacys was an old wandering bard in 1370 DR . History . Pacys hailed from Maskyr ' s Eye in the Vast but abandoned his home to follow the bard Ardynn , whom he loved .

title: Padded armor
description: Padded armor Padded armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Padded armor was made up of several quilted layers of cloth and .

title: Paddy Stoutfellow
description: Paddy Stoutfellow Paddy Stoutfellow was a member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr . Description . Paddy was a halfling with black , bushy hair and sideburns .

title: Padhra
description: Padhra The Padhra was the founder and deity of the Padhran religion practiced in the Hordelands . In life , the Padhra was known as Surtava , an ancient Ulgarian prince who abandoned his privileged existence to become a beggar and seek enlightenment . He found it and dedicated the remainder of his life to teaching others his observations .

title: Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom
description: Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom The Padhra ' s Seven Baskets of Wisdom was a religious text discussing the Padhran religion . A copy was located at the Blue Grotto of the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati around 1359 DR . Appendix .

title: Padhran religion
description: Padhran religion The Padhran religion was a faith practiced in the Hordelands and by almost all of those living in the hidden realm of Ra - Khati . History . As written in the religious books of the Padhran faith , around −1700 DR , an Ulgarian prince named Surtava gave up his crown , his power , and his wealth and voluntarily became a beggar to seek enlightenment and wisdom .

title: Paektu - san
description: Paektu - san Paektu - san was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Paektu - san lay on the southern coast of the western peninsula , north of the Dragon ' s Teeth , a series of straits that were impossible to navigate .

title: Paelinn
description: Paelinn Paelinn was a female drow and a divine seeker of Kiaransalee who resided in the Undying Temple in Maerimydra . Description . Attractive , tall , and slim , Paelinn was a young drow with striking emerald eyes and a delicate but angled face .

title: Paerestus
description: Paerestus Paerestus , also called " Smokebeard " , was a man from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast in the 12th century DR . He was a famous bard . History .

title: Pag Hou Ling
description: Pag Hou Ling Pag Hou Ling was a steward in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Pag ' s mother hailed from T ' u lung .

title: Page prince
description: Page prince Being a page prince is a stage in every noble - born drow male ' s life whereupon he must personally cater to the Matron Mother ' s every whim ( more so than usual ) . Page princes are not deemed nobles until they have completed the training required of them . It is the task of the house elderboy to train the page prince in manners .

title: Pahari
description: Pahari Pahari were shapeshifting nymph s who inhabited the seas and oceans of Zakhara . Description . Pahari resembled mermaid s in their natural form , but they also appeared as small fish or beautiful women .

title: Pain domain
description: Pain domain The Pain domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters spell s and powers themed around pain . Pain Domain Powers . A cleric with the Pain domain could convert an injury dealt from one blow into healing for him or herself , once a day .

title: Painbearer
description: Painbearer The painbearer was a specialty priest of Ilmater , the Crying God . History . Specialty priests of Ilmater were simply called " clerics " , like other cleric s , around 1358 DR .

title: Paine
description: Paine Paine was an inhabitant of Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Once Paine was a Zhent executioner until she escaped to the North .

title: Paitza
description: Paitza A paitza was a warrant of safe passage through Tuigan lands in the Hordelands . It served as a symbol of the " khahans " favor , leaving anyone who carried one free to roam the vast steppe unmolested . Description .

title: Paizo Publishing
description: Paizo Publishing Paizo Publishing , LLC is a publisher of fantasy roleplaying games , accessories , and board games . For many years Paizo was the publisher of the Dragon and the Dungeon magazine s . Founded in 2002 by Lisa Stevens , a former Wizards of the Coast employee who left after Hasbro bought the company in 2000 .

title: Palace Guard of Huzuz
description: Palace Guard of Huzuz The Palace Guard of Huzuz served as within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Organization . All members of the palace guard were large individuals who possessed not only intimidating physical strength and presence , but enough intelligence and eloquence to resort to politely addressing visitors .

title: Palace Lane
description: Palace Lane The Palace Lane was a street located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This was a small street that branched off of the Street of the Inns ; leading travelers northeast toward the Palace of the Enlightened Throne , the Court of Enlightenment , and the beautiful Public Gardens of Huzuz .

title: Palace Quarter
description: Palace Quarter The Palace Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Palace Quarter encompassed the Affluent District , Court District , and the East District , forming most of the central and southeast portions of the city .

title: Palace of Loss
description: Palace of Loss The Palace of Loss was the abode of the goddess Shar , located on the Plane of Shadow , before the Spellplague . Description . The Palace of Loss was a tower with neither windows nor doors .

title: Palace of Sly Ravens
description: Palace of Sly Ravens The Palace of Sly Ravens was the seat for the Caliph of Liham , Harin al - Hayif , in 1367 DR . Location . Located in Liham , the palace did not stand out from the buildings surrounding it .

title: Palace of the Enlightened Throne
description: Palace of the Enlightened Throne The Palace of the Enlightened Throne , also known as the Palace of the Grand Caliph and the Seat of the Great Lion , was the seat of the Grand Caliph of all of Zakhara . Description . The Palace appeared as a small city when viewed from the court , covering several acres of land .

title: Palace of the Simbul
description: Palace of the Simbul The Palace of the Simbul ( or Simbul ' s Palace ) was a palace in Velprintalar ( now called Old Velprintalar ) and the home of the Simbul , queen of Aglarond from 1320 DR to 1425 DR . The palace is constructed from green stone from Mulhorand and is situated on a hill that overlooked Velprintalar . It was protected by a host of magical maeasures .

title: Paladin
description: Paladin A paladin was a holy crusader , sworn to an oath to promote and fight for their beliefs and values . As paragons of their beliefs , paladins were granted the ability to wield divine magic by deities or similar powers . So long as a paladin stayed true to their oath , they retained the ability to wield these powers .

title: Palaghard Obarskyr I
description: Palaghard Obarskyr I Palaghard I was king of Cormyr from 1164 DR to 1187 DR . Appearance . Palaghard had broad shoulders and blue eyes .

title: Palaghard Obarskyr II
description: Palaghard Obarskyr II Background . Palaghard was born the second son of King Dhalmass Obarskyr and Jhalass Huntsilver in 1214 DR . Family .

title: Palarandusk
description: Palarandusk Palarandusk ( the Unseen Protector , previously the Sun Dragon ) is a male gold dragon who lives in the Sword Mountains on the Sword Coast North . He is a great wyrm . Each time he kills , he weeps .

title: Pale Night
description: Pale Night Pale Night , also known as the Mother of Demons , is an Abyssal Lord , both enigmatic and unbelievably ancient . In " " , it was revealed that she is a member of the demonic race called the obyrith s . Description .

title: Pale River
description: Pale River The Pale River was an elemental vortex connecting two elemental plane s . Location . The Pale River originated in the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth , flowing to the marid oyster beds in a particularly filthy area of the Elemental Plane of Water .

title: Pale green ioun stone
description: Pale green ioun stone The pale green ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " giving greater combat skill and fortitude . Description . It was a pale - green ovoid stone .

title: Palevash
description: Palevash Palevash was an ancient and isolated monastery founded centuries before the 14th century DR by the monks of Shou Lung . Many monks of the monastery came to it from the native tribes across the Northern Wastes . However , these tribes and local races sometimes launched raids against the monastery for its wealth .

title: Palischuk
description: Palischuk Palischuk was a settlement in the northeastern corner of Vaasa . Geography . The city was located just south of the banks of the towering ice river known as the Great Glacier and east of the ruins of Castle Perilous .

title: Palla
description: Palla Palla the Light was a mercenary recruiter in Turmish around 1358 DR . Activities . Palla was the leader of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .

title: Pallar the Obedient
description: Pallar the Obedient Pallar the Obedient was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a priest of Torm and was High Priest of the House of the Hand temple by 1358 DR , a position which he still held by 1367 DR . He had 26 subpriests and 48 lay - worshipers .

title: Pallidor
description: Pallidor Pallidor was a wizard in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Pallidor was the apprentice of Vaelish Gant ] and a fellow member of reformed Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Palm
description: Palm The palm tree was a type of tree found various places in Faerûn . Varieties . Beetle .

title: Palonya
description: Palonya Sister Palonya was a priest of Jergal in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Sister Palonya arrived at the Yawning Portal inn with Brother Sepulcher .

title: Palron Kaeth
description: Palron Kaeth Palron Kaeth was a vampire . Appearance . Palron Kaeth was bald with black sigil tattoos adorning his cheek and neck .

title: Palter
description: Palter Palter was a Netherese floating city . It was established in 1217 NY . As the archwizard who controlled this enclave , Halavar established the laws guided the city .

title: Pan
description: Pan Pan was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying on the shore of the Yellow Sea at the western end of the Vorkani Mountains . Organizations . Based in Pan was a yakuza family .

title: Pan Chu
description: Pan Chu Pan Chu was the best wako admiral of Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Pan Chu , a Kozakuran of Shou ancestry , was the most feared of the wako pirate admirals .

title: Pandemonium
description: Pandemonium Pandemonium was the Great Wheel cosmology plane of chaotic neutral and chaotic evil alignment . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the Deep Caverns in the World Tree cosmology model which was later renamed the Dismal Caverns by the World Axis cosmology model . Description .

title: Pandemonium Stone
description: Pandemonium Stone The Pandemonium Stone was an ancient and extremely powerful artifact that existed in the Elemental Chaos . Description . The Pandemonium Stone was a spire more than five hundred feet ( 152 meters ) tall and more than one hundred feet ( 30 meters ) in diameter .

title: Pandorym
description: Pandorym Pandorym was an Elder Evil from a distant dimension beyond the Faerûnian cosmology . It was lured to Faerûn and imprisoned by the ancient Imaskari because they wanted it as a deterrent , a doomsday weapon to deter the vengeful deities of the Mulan from destroying Imaskar . Since Pandorym was very dangerous to the Imaskari themselves , they kept its body and mind separated .

title: Panicked Plague
description: Panicked Plague The Panicked Plague was a disease that afflicted the city of Mussum in the Vilhon Reach . Effects . The disease affected a victim ' s skin , turning it light green and covering it with welts and abscesses .

title: Panjuis
description: Panjuis Panjuis , the Pixie Fortress , was a located deep within the Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Most believed the location to simply be a myth . Structure .

title: Pankin Yegorovna
description: Pankin Yegorovna Pankin Yegorovna ( pronounced PAN - kin YAY - gore - OVE - nuh ) was one of the Blade s of Mulmaster . Relationship . Pankin had a daughter , Riasa Yegorovna .

title: Pantheist Temple of Tyr
description: Pantheist Temple of Tyr The Pantheist Temple of Tyr was a temple of Tyr the Just God on the Rock of Bral , an asteroid in the Tears of Selûne , which orbited the planet Toril behind its moon Selûne . Notably , it was the only temple to Tyr in Realmspace that did not lie on the planet of Toril , and its priests held a number of non - standard religious views . Although the clergy and their practices followed the rules of mainstream Tyrran faith on Toril , the priests here saw Tyr as a patron deity of good warriors in addition to his role as a god of justice .

title: Panther
description: Panther Panthers were black - furred jungle wildcats similar to , leopard s , and . Description . Like all cats in the leopard family , panthers typically weighed 120 pounds ( 55 kilograms ) and were around four feet ( 120 centimeters ) in length .

title: Panthers of Xi
description: Panthers of Xi The Panthers of Xi were a ninja clan based in the town of Xi in Koryo . They controlled the Vorkani Mountains between Xi and the Malu River in the east . Their clanmaster was Lin Goh , the wielder of the Black Kumade .

title: Par
description: Par Par was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Par was a wealthy villager of Highcliff .

title: Par ' s house
description: Par ' s house Par ' s house was a house in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . Par ' s house was located near Edario ' s forge .

title: Parallel plane
description: Parallel plane Parallel planes were plane s of existence which existed in parallel with the Prime Material Plane . They were defined by a shared geography , bestiary , and were more easily reached than other planes by inhabitants of the Prime . The parallel planes were created in the days of creation when the Primordial s , mighty beings on par with the gods , split the Prime into three parts , finding some parts " too bright " or " too dark .

title: Paralyze
description: Paralyze Paralyze was a necromancy spell that allowed the caster to immobilize creatures with a successful touch attack . Effects . This spell gave the caster a paralyzing touch for a number of minutes equal to his or her experience level .

title: Paramount
description: Paramount A paramount was the ruler of a tribe of storm giant s . In most storm giant tribes , the paramount was the most powerful giant and stood atop the " ordning " ; however , a paramount did not become such by offering a challenge , as in other giant societies . Instead , a paramount was selected after the observing of a sign or omen .

title: Paramyr Bladerunner
description: Paramyr Bladerunner Paramyr Bladerunner was a male human fighter and an agent of Zhentil Keep based in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities . Paramyr led a contingent of six Zhentish soldiers quartered in Thunderstone at the time , though he tried to keep this fact hidden from others .

title: Parbid
description: Parbid Parbid was a tiefling Shadovar monk . History . He was a member of Cavus Dun and the Brothers of the Gray Mists .

title: Parched Mamluk Society
description: Parched Mamluk Society The Parched Mamluk Society , also known as the Parched , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Parched was one of the smallest mamluk organizations in Zakhara .

title: Parg
description: Parg Parg was a goblin in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Parg was a goblin of Frostfur tribe , who lived under the protection of the stone giant shaman Kranum .

title: Parise Ulfbinder
description: Parise Ulfbinder Parise Ulfbinder was a lord of Netheril . Relationships . Parise Ulfbinder was friends with Draygo Quick , another Netherese noble .

title: Parissus
description: Parissus Parissus was a mercenary and bounty hunter in the region of the Bloodstone Lands from Impiltur . Description . Parissus had a large - boned and round face and short , light - colored hair .

title: Parlek Lateriff
description: Parlek Lateriff Parlek Lateriff was a sage , sorcerer , and smith in the Mountainside ward of Waterdeep . He made replica and counterfeit jewelry for nobles , who paid him quite handsomely . History .

title: Parman
description: Parman Parman was a merchant in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Parman was a member the Ardjo family , one of the richest merchant families of Bawa .

title: Parnak
description: Parnak Parnak was a dragon turtle living in the Golden Gulf in Zakhara 1367 DR . Activities . Parnak accosted a pair of merchant vessels sailing the Pearl Way and demanded tribute .

title: Parok Mirami
description: Parok Mirami Parok Mirami was a well known askar guide for the Grand Bazaar in Huzuz . Activities . Parok charged 1 dirham per hour for his guide services .

title: Paronder ( philosophy )
description: Paronder ( philosophy ) Paronder was a belief that Mystra or some other entity or force of the multiverse promoted a law of cosmic balance , so that those who did something would be rewarded in the same way . For instance , if someone did something good , the cosmos would do something good for them , but if they did something evil , they would be repaid with evil , and so on . Background .

title: Parrot - man
description: Parrot - man The parrot - man was a legendary creature in South Saishu , an island of Koryo in Kara - Tur . The parrot - man was one of the local legends that Dan Zor , the former king and governor of Saishu , wished to investigate . By 1357 DR , he sought adventurers who would seek out the parrot - man of South Saishu for him .

title: Parson Glaive
description: Parson Glaive Parson Glaive was a dwarf priest of Citadel Felbarr in the late 15th century DR . History . Parson was a priest of Moradin and steward - in - waiting in Citadel Felbarr in 1463 DR .

title: Part sand
description: Part sand Part sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could create a 20 foot ( 6 .

title: Parthar
description: Parthar Parthar the Valiant , most known as Rhymallos , meaning " Hidden Eye " , was an unsung hero of the Weeping War . History . Parthar was a gnome member of the N ' Vaelahr , the shadow army of Myth Drannor .

title: Parwiccan Cycle
description: Parwiccan Cycle The Parwiccan Cycle was a compilation of ancient elven myths regarding the origins of dragon kind and the first interactions of elves and dragons . The myths compiled in the " Parwiccan Cycle " told of the Tearfall , the felling of the red dragon Mahatnartorian at the hands of elves from Tintageer , and the crusades of the first dragonborn against the dragonspawn , among other events . Many respected scholars , such as most of the sages of Candlekeep , dismissed the " Parwiccan Cycle " as just a compilation of fancy elven mythology with no relationship with actual historical facts .

title: Parwyyd Hanifar
description: Parwyyd Hanifar Parwyyd Hanifar was a human male wizard in the mid – 14th century DR . Description . Parwyyd was tall , elderly , with long white hair , moustache , and blue eyes .

title: Pasari - niml
description: Pasari - niml Pasari - niml , or mants , were vicious insect - like creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These creatures appeared to be large ants measuring 4 – 6 inches ( 10 – 15 cm ) in length .

title: Pasha
description: Pasha " Pasha " was an Alzhedo word and Calishite title for a guildmaster or clan leader of Calimshan . A pasha could belong to the upper or lower classes , depending on the amount of power held and the importance of the guild or house over which the pasha had leadership . The least important pashas were still treated as belonging to the upper end of the merchant middle class and given the respect of the upper class .

title: Pasocada Basin
description: Pasocada Basin The Pasocada Basin was a tough unyielding land in Maztica , north of the deserts where the Dog People resided . It was home to numerous human groups , most notably the Azuposi , and the Poscadar elves . Geography .

title: Pass without trace
description: Pass without trace Pass without trace was a transmutation or enchantment spell that allowed the recipients to move through an area leaving no footprints or scent . Effects . The caster had to touch the creature ( s ) to cast this spell .

title: Passage to Dawn
description: Passage to Dawn Passage to Dawn is the fourth book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Passepout
description: Passepout Passepout was one of Volothamp Geddarm ' s companions during his adventures . Description . Slightly rotund , the only thing larger than Passespout ' s appetite was his belief that women were enamored with him .

title: Passwall
description: Passwall Passwall was a transmutation spell that breached walls . The maximum thickness of the wall depended on the magical power of the caster . Effect .

title: Path of Enlightenment
description: Path of Enlightenment The Path of Enlightenment , or the True Path , and known in Kozakura as the Way of Enlightenment , was the state religion of both Shou Lung and Wa and a popular one in Kozakura and other Kara - Tur an countries . It was a major religion of much of Kara - Tur and the Hordelands . Dogma .

title: Pathfinder
description: Pathfinder Pathfinders are bold scouts of the unknown , ranger s whose job it is to find pathways for others to follow . Pathfinders do this through their skills for perception but also through their battle prowess , which allows them to carve a path if none is available . For this purpose , pathfinders look to their weapons , typically two blade s .

title: Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition
description: Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition Paths of Darkness Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the four novels in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Paths of power
description: Paths of power The paths of power were an alternative way for wizard s to view magic and acquire spells in comparison to the conventional system of schools of magic . Magic system . While a school comprised a large number of spells based on one philosophical principle like alteration , each path of power consisted of a much smaller selection of spells of increasing power tied together by one topic .

title: Patma
description: Patma Patma was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Patma had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .

title: Patric Fulgirth
description: Patric Fulgirth Patric Fulgirth was a ruler of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . He was an idle ruler who cared not for the needs of the people . Formerly a powerful nation , Doegan fell into decline under his dereliction of duty .

title: Patrin
description: Patrin Patrin , formerly a member of Clan Shestandeliath , was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut and the leader of the Platinum Cadre in 1479 DR . Due to his faith in a dragon god , Patrin was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description .

title: Paul S . Kemp
description: Paul S . Kemp Paul S . Kemp is a New York Times best - selling author most known for his Forgotten Realms novels .

title: Paulina Claiborne
description: Paulina Claiborne Paulina Claiborne is a pseudonym of Paul Park . According to her fictional biography , Paulina was born in Kansas and educated at home by Chinese missionaries . She has spent several stints in prison .

title: Pavel Shemov
description: Pavel Shemov Pavel Shemov was a cleric of Lathander who traveled with Dorn Graybrook , the song dragon Karasendrieth , and the vampiric smoke drake Brimstone during the Year of Rogue Dragons , 1373 DR . He fought against Sammaster and died freeing the " Dracorage mythal " from the lich ' s influence . Equipment .

title: Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne
description: Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne The Pavilion of the Enlightened Throne was found within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The pavilion stood 10 ft .

title: Pawldo
description: Pawldo Pawldo was a halfling adventurer who ostensibly lived in Lowhill . Description . Pawldo was a clean shaven , short and hardy individual around 3 ft ( 0 .

title: Paxas
description: Paxas Paxas was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Paxas was a standoffish and focused individual .

title: Payit
description: Payit Payit was an empire in north Maztica . What is now known as Payit is only half of the ancient empire . Much of Payit is open savannahs of brush and grass , or copses of thin woods .

title: Payit ( ethnicity )
description: Payit ( ethnicity ) The Payits were one of the seven major ethnicities of Maztica , inhabiting the lands of Payit and Far Payit in the east . Description . A Payit individual tended to be short but muscular .

title: Payr ' adar
description: Payr ' adar Payr ' adar was a puppet member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . History . Payr ' adar hailed from Chessenta and arrived in Zhentil Keep with a caravan full of exotic women at his service .

title: Pazruki
description: Pazruki The Pazruki composed several tribes of human s inhabiting the northern part of the Koryaz Mountains . Territory . The territory of the Pazruki bordered the lands of the Fankiang and the Issacortae .

title: Pazruki language
description: Pazruki language Pazruki , also called Pazruk , was a language spoken by the Pazruki of the Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Related languages .

title: Pazuzu
description: Pazuzu Pazuzu is a powerful demon lord , called the Prince of the Lower Aerial Kingdoms . He rules the skies above all layers of the Abyss and is also known as Pazrael or Pazuzeus . One of the oldest and most reprehensible demon lords , Pazuzu is a master manipulator and corruptor of mortal souls .

title: Pe Nii - Qwoh
description: Pe Nii - Qwoh Pe Nii - Qwoh was an officer in the army of Shou Lung . History . Pe was the adjutant of General Batu Min Ho in the provincial Army of Chukei .

title: Peaks of Flame
description: Peaks of Flame The Peaks of Flame were a range of volcanic mountains in the center of Chult , said to be the point of entry of Dendar the Night Serpent when she will enter Toril at the end of the world . Geography . Geographical Features .

title: Pearl
description: Pearl Pearls were not mined , they were the product of oysters or other mollusks , but they were treated like gemstones . Description . Pearls were formed of layers of tchazar ( ) around a bit of grit or other irritant , growing inside a mollusk over the span of a few years .

title: Pearl ( Hamayarch )
description: Pearl ( Hamayarch ) The Pearl was the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur in the Vast in the mid - 13th century DR . Her true name , age and race were all unknown , though she appeared mostly human . Appearance .

title: Pearl Bay
description: Pearl Bay Pearl Bay was found in the extreme northern reaches of the continent of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . Pearl Bay was located in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Pearl Cities
description: Pearl Cities The Pearl Cities were a group of wealthy Zakhara n seaports along the coast of the Crowded Sea and the western shores of the Golden Gulf next to the High Desert . Activities . These cities - Ajayib , Gana , Jumlat , Sikak , and Tajar - focused on a lucrative trade mainly in luxury goods , with Jumlat ' s and Gana ' s production of pearl s providing the name for the whole group .

title: Pearl Way
description: Pearl Way The Pearl Way , or the Southwestern Sea Route , was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Cargo departing Huzuz for the Pearl Cities traveled by ship across the southern portion of Suq Bay , sailing west through the northern reaches of the Golden Gulf , usually directly toward Tajar , before continuing south to the rest of the Pearl Cities .

title: Peasants ' District
description: Peasants ' District The Peasants ' District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Peasants ' District was found in the People ' s Quarter and near the center of Huzuz .

title: Pech
description: Pech Pech were earth - aligned fey . Description . They looked like gnome s with dark brown or dull grey skin , pupilless eyes that reflected light like an owl or cat , and thin , gangly arms ending in abnormally large and powerful hands .

title: Peebles
description: Peebles Peebles was a deep gnome servant of Xazax during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Peebles claimed to have always been fascinated by aberration s , and beholder s in particular .

title: Peerless archer
description: Peerless archer A peerless archer was one devoted to the perfection of archery , bowyery , and fletching . Outlook . Such an archer dedicated his or her life to the perfection of the bow , being both an expert in its craft and its usage .

title: Pegasus
description: Pegasus Pegasi are a breed of magical beast s that , at first glance , resemble mere horse s with large bird - like wings . Despite this , they have other avian features as well , their lower legs are feathered instead of furred and their manes and tails are also of feathers . They most commonly live in temperate forests and are incapable of speaking common .

title: Pehllus Tanislove
description: Pehllus Tanislove Pehllus Tanislove was a rising noble and merchant of Amn and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Pehllus was the lord of House Tanislove and the lord - consort of House Gheldieg .

title: Peieyrie Taskaloath
description: Peieyrie Taskaloath Peieyrie Taskaloath was the co - owner of The Swinging Sword inn in Red Larch with her sister , Jhandlatha Taskloath . History . Peieyrie is originally from Luskan , where her father was a wizard who opposed , and was eventually killed by , the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Pekaonit
description: Pekaonit Pekaonit was a korobokuru chieftain in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . History . Pekaonit inherited his position as chieftain of the village of Karoah but thanks to his violent nature he defeated or drove off all challengers .

title: Peldar Armsmith
description: Peldar Armsmith Peldar Armsmith was the Cloakmaster of Karlaggar , one of the eight districts of Zazesspur , for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . History . Peldar was a blacksmith before becoming a well - known arms and armors merchant .

title: Pelek
description: Pelek Pelek was a deep gnome ghost in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Pelek lived in Blingdenstone until he met Buppido .

title: Pelendralaar
description: Pelendralaar Pelendralaar was a dracolich in league with the Cult of the Dragon sought to gain control of all of Faerûn by corrupting the Mythal of Myth Drannor . Description . In life , Pelendralaar was a red dragon .

title: Pelindar Filmarya
description: Pelindar Filmarya Lord Pelindar Filmarya was a paladin of Tyr and the ruler of Leilon following the Time of Troubles . Of mixed Waterdhavian and Tethyrian noble blood , his father ' s side of the family was once renowned in Tethyr for the prowess of its battle knights . His wise justice and pragmatic battle mastery have won him wide respect in the North .

title: Pella Dheolur
description: Pella Dheolur Pella Dheolur was a member of the Dheolur noble house of Cormyr . She was the sister of Lord Dheolur . She was of slight build .

title: Pellamcopse Woods
description: Pellamcopse Woods Pellamcopse Woods , also known simply as Pellamcopse , was a forest located east - northeast of Waterdeep ' s Northgate . After the Spellplague , the woods were nickname " Pellamcorpse " due to their sinister reputation . Description .

title: Peltarch
description: Peltarch Peltarch was the only permanent settlement of any size in Narfell as of 1479 DR . The town was located on the southern shore of Icelace Lake and was constructed from the masonry of Old Peltarch to the north of the current settlement . The Nar s of Peltarch were wealthier than their kinsmen who considered them outlanders .

title: Penanggalan
description: Penanggalan A penanggalan was a variety of female vampiric undead creature . Description . A penanggalan had two forms .

title: Pencheska
description: Pencheska Pencheska was a succubus in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Pencheska was a succubus summoned by a lich named Tarul Var of the Red Wizards of Thay , who quickly enslaved her .

title: Pendant of Ashaba
description: Pendant of Ashaba The Pendant of Ashaba was a magical pendant that was created by Ashaba , the first lord of Shadowdale , and was used to determine the rightful lord of the dale . It is a silver crescent moon with horns that point upwards . Originally the pendant hung from a plain string , but this was replaced by a silver chain that was made by Syluné Silverhand .

title: Penelope Harpell
description: Penelope Harpell Penelope Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their most powerful member during the late 15th century DR . History . Penelope was the wife of Dowell Harpell , the family spokesman in 1479 DR .

title: Pengallen
description: Pengallen Pengallen was a village in the Silver Marches in northwest Faerûn , located fifteen miles south - east of River Surbrin and not far from Mithril Hall . History . One of the villagers , Rico Pengallen , enjoyed hunting down , capturing and forcing others , common enemies of humankind , to work for him , in the full knowledge of all in Pengallen .

title: Penny Williams
description: Penny Williams Penny Williams was " Game Questions Expert " for TSR , Inc . in the 1980s . She served as RPGA Network Coordinator , Polyhedron Newszine editor , and Senior Editor and Coordinating Editor for the RPG R & D Department at Wizards of the Coast .

title: Penri
description: Penri Penri was a korobokuru forest barbarian adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Penri born in the Bear Clan in northern Kozakura .

title: People ' s Quarter
description: People ' s Quarter The People ' s Quarter was one of the four quarters of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The People ' s Quarter encompassed the Peasants ' District , Pilgrims ' District , and South District .

title: People of the Black Blood
description: People of the Black Blood The People of the Black Blood were Malar - worshiping lycanthropes from the the many scattered forests throughout Faerûn . They were more of a loose group of small tribes than a formal organization . Organisation .

title: Pepin Pollo
description: Pepin Pollo Pepin Pollo was a male gnome of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Pepin was a gnome who came from Waterdeep to Neverwinter to paint pictures for money .

title: Pepper cheese
description: Pepper cheese Pepper cheese was a spicy cheese from Tethyr . It was available for purchase from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Percival Gallard Woodehouse
description: Percival Gallard Woodehouse Percival Gallard Woodehouse , also known as Pig , was a famous chef in Skullport . History . Percival was a famous chef in Waterdeep until Denver Gilliam hired him to work at the Traitor Picks .

title: Perd Dellmon
description: Perd Dellmon Perd Dellmon was a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Perd helped his father Kerbin Dellmon manage a great farm in the valley .

title: Pereghost
description: Pereghost The Pereghost was one of the great mysteries of the Zhentarim ' s fortress of Darkhold . The warrior appeared out of nowhere in 1356 DR , offering his services to the Black Network . He gave no name other than " The Pereghost " and refused to speak of his history .

title: Peren Voranwell
description: Peren Voranwell Lord Peren Voranwell of Lyllburg was a self - appointed landholder in Tethyr . Description . Peren was originally a handsome man , until he was facially disfigured in combat with a troll .

title: Perendra Raslemtar
description: Perendra Raslemtar Lady Perendra Raslemtar ( Per - EN - drah ) was Countess of Elemetar and also served as Court Vizera of Tethyr . Description . Perendra had a large forehead and chin , dark skin , very short black hair , and brown , almond - shaped eyes .

title: Perestrom
description: Perestrom Perestrom was a Zhentarim adventurer wizard in Yûlash . History . Perestrom was the master of the Lords of the Ebon Wyrm , a small adventuring party loyal to the Zhent .

title: Perfect summons
description: Perfect summons Perfect summons was a transmutation spell that created a summoning area for good creatures only . Effect . The caster created an area in which only good creatures could be magically summoned .

title: Periapt of health
description: Periapt of health Periapts of health were common magical item s worn about the neck that prevented the wearer from contracting diseases . Description . These items were crafted with a gem , which hung on a necklace of silver chain .

title: Pericolo Topolino
description: Pericolo Topolino " Grandfather " Pericolo Topolino was a halfling assassin guildmaster of the Morada Topolino in Delthuntle . He appeared to have controlled much of the organized criminal world in Dethuntle and was treated with respect ( and fear ) by almost everyone . Descriptions .

title: Peridot
description: Peridot Peridot was the gem - quality version of which occurred in volcanic basalts or with other deposits . Description . These gemstones were found in shades of light to dark olive green and were usually facet cut .

title: Perigrog Scrapedust
description: Perigrog Scrapedust Perigrog Scrapedust was a deep gnome businessman in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Perigrog believed that the more the mine produced , the more he could export , and that this would restore the city to its former glory quicker .

title: Perijan al - Danaf
description: Perijan al - Danaf Perijan al - Danaf was the driving force behind the wealthy House of Al - Danafi merchant family in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Personality . Perijan was shy and soft - spoken around others .

title: Perinsa Falmarya
description: Perinsa Falmarya Perinsa Falmarya was a ghostwise halfling who grew up in the Chondalwood . Activities . Ger tribe lived closer to the outside world than others .

title: Peris Whallnsor
description: Peris Whallnsor Peris Whallnsor was a female human and a Battleguard of Tempus with the title of Battlelady . With Trusted Sword Jak Errins soon to retire , she was contending to take over the leadership of the Towers of the Vengeful Hand in Eshpurta , Amn , in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Her chief competitor for the position was Lance of the Lord Niskam Tresdaap .

title: Permanency
description: Permanency Permanency was a universal spell that made certain spells permanent . Effect . The caster could make the following spells permanent when cast on him - or herself : " arcane sight " , " comprehend languages " , " darkvision " , " detect magic " , " protection from arrows " , " read magic " , " see invisibility " , and " tongues " .

title: Permanent image
description: Permanent image Permanent image , also known as permanent illusion , is an arcane spell that conjures an illusion more convincing than its lesser " image " cousins . Effects . This spell functions in the same manner as " silent image " , except the figment includes visual , auditory , olfactory , and thermal elements , and the spell is permanent .

title: Pern
description: Pern Pern was a male human of Waterdeep in the 1350s DR . He was a member of Waterdeep ' s City Guard . One day in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , a huntsman informed the City Guard of a magical tower erected within a single day , a full day ' s hard ride north of Waterdeep ' s Trollwall .

title: Perrywinkle Shin
description: Perrywinkle Shin Perrywinkle Shin was the highest - ranking active monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Bloodstone Lands in 1484 DR . Personality . Perrywinkle was at his core a man who was at peace with himself and he retained a sense of humor .

title: Persana
description: Persana Persana was unknown to many outside of the triton race and those that did know of him believed that he was nothing more than a god of construction and guardianship . This was due to the silence and mystery that Persana , like his triton followers , surrounded himself with . The tritons themselves however , were like the ixitxachitl , a completely theocratic society .

title: Persistent image
description: Persistent image Persistent image is an illusion spell that creates a complex image that does not require concentration . Effect . This spell works the same as " silent image " , except the figment includes visual , auditory , olfactory , and thermal components , and the figment follows a script determined by you .

title: Pertelope
description: Pertelope Pertelope was one of the Chosen of the god Deneir and undoubtedly one of the most powerful headmistresses at the Edificant Library . Appearance . Pertelope always appeared as a neatly groomed , graying woman .

title: Peryton
description: Peryton Perytons were twisted and depraved magical creatures that appeared to be a cross between a giant eagle and a demonic - looking , fang - toothed stag . They were known and feared for tearing the beating hearts from their victims ' chests . Description .

title: Petitioner
description: Petitioner Petitioner is the term applied to dead people ’ s souls , which made it in some way or another into another plane of existence than the Material Plane . Becoming a petitioner . Upon dying , a mortal ’ s soul was transported to the Fugue Plane .

title: Petralisks
description: Petralisks The Petralisks , or the Gazers , was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 1 , 500 dao cavalry using greater basilisks for mounts made up the Petralisks .

title: Petron
description: Petron Merciless Petron was a primordial who fought against the god s during the Dawn War . History . After the primordials were defeated in the Dawn War and Ao split Abeir - Toril into the twin worlds , Abeir and Toril , Petron founded a great kingdom in the continent of Shyr .

title: Petrylloc ' s gambit
description: Petrylloc ' s gambit Petrylloc ' s Gambit is a spell that creates a wall of ice and two walls of stone above a target , which then fall upon it . It was cast in a group casting in 1374 DR by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and the wizards Sememmon and Ashemmi in order to defeat a sharn at the Sleeping Dragon inn .

title: Phaan Colwyvv
description: Phaan Colwyvv Phaan Colwyvv was a Tessarch of Amn . He was one of only two surviving members of the original Council of Six set up in 1333 DR . At this time , he entered the council as a Pommarch , but rose to Iltarch in 1345 DR and Tessarch in 1362 DR .

title: Phaen of Rags
description: Phaen of Rags Phaen was a lowly wizard of the Hosttower . He committed some fatal mistake , which he never shared with anyone , and was immediately cast out of the Brotherhood . He lost his robe and he began wearing a " Robe of Rags " , which showed his lowly rank in the Hosttower .

title: Phaere Despana
description: Phaere Despana Phaere Despana was the daughter of Matron Mother Ardulace , the head of the Ust Natha branch of the Despana house . She was unsurprisingly plotting to overthrow her mother . Earlier in her life , she ' d had actual feelings for the male called Solaufein , but all such genuine feeling had been chased away from her by relentless torture administered for that purpose .

title: Phaerimm
description: Phaerimm Phaerimms were aberrations of a wholly evil and sadistic bent . Their desire to erase all other living beings from existence was held in check by their desire to have other beings as slaves and to torture for sport . Phaerimms communicated with one another in a non - verbal way by varying the wind speed around their bodies .

title: Phaerl Hawksong
description: Phaerl Hawksong Phaerl Hawksong was a senior priestess of Sehanine Moonbow at the Tower of the Moon ' s Magic in Evereska and a member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She shared the dream of Khelben Arunsun of bringing the elves and humans together .

title: Phaia
description: Phaia Phaia was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Phaia was a true believer of Szass Tam .

title: Phaikkul
description: Phaikkul Phaikkul was a female half - dragon kir - lanan and the leader of the Screeching Wing in the Wailing Cliff . Description . Her dark grey scales were large and thick , especially on her back and chest .

title: Phalantar Orivan
description: Phalantar Orivan Phalantar Orivan was a fence in Waterdeep in 1372 DR who originated from Hlondeth . Personality . Phalantar always smiled gently and moved quietly .

title: Phalorm
description: Phalorm Phalorm ( known as the Realm of Three Crowns ) was a kingdom in Northwest Faerûn made up of dwarves , elves , gnome s , halfling s and human s . History . The kingdom was formed in 523 DR at the Council of Axe and Arrow , a council to deal with the growing orc problem in the area .

title: Phalse
description: Phalse Phalse was a being with beholder - like characteristics , except that his tentacles ended in mouths . Other beholders found this disgusting . Phalse was one of the six involved in creating the human construct Alias .

title: Phanar Manthar
description: Phanar Manthar Phanar Manthar was a devout priest of Oghma and the disowned son of a Waterdhavian noble house . Background . When Phanar ' s master , Loremaster Gustyl " the Curious " , died in 1371 DR , Phanar took on his responsibilities .

title: Phandalin
description: Phandalin Phandalin was a human village located northeast of Leilon , where the road that ran from the High Road to Triboar Trail faded into a trail . It was raided by orcs in 951 DR and subsequently abandoned . Phandalin had three deep wells .

title: Phandar
description: Phandar Phandar was a type of tree found across Faerûn . Description . Phandar trees had numerous curving branches sprouting from a knobby trunk .

title: Phandymm
description: Phandymm Phandymm was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR and secretly a cleric of Bane . History . Phandymm was a cleric of Bane loyal to the High Imperceptor of Bane until he met Fzoul Chembryl ; Fzoul gained Phandymm ' s loyalty and used him as spy in the Orthodox faction of the Church of Bane and also thank to him in 1263 DR Fzoul gained control over all the Zhentil Banites .

title: Phane
description: Phane Phanes were a race of immortal magical beast s with the ability to manipulate time itself . Chaotic and destructive , phanes were nonetheless non - evil in nature . Occasionally , phanes formed pacts with powerful mortals who shared their goals .

title: Phanlinksal
description: Phanlinksal Phanlinksal was a ruined illithid settlement located in the Northdark . Geography . Phanlinksal was located in the Upper Northdark beneath the Lurkwood , a few weeks ' march west of Menzoberranzan .

title: Phantasmal killer
description: Phantasmal killer Phantasmal killer , originally known as Carbury ' s killer , was an illusion spell that created a phantasm of an attack by the most fearful creature the victim could imagine . Effects . This spell reached into the victim ' s subconscious , pulled out the most horrifying creature he or she could imagine , and attacked with it using an illusion only the victim could see clearly ( the caster saw only an indistinct shape ) .

title: Phantasmal terrain
description: Phantasmal terrain Phantasmal terrain is a spell of the illusion school illusion used by wizard ly initiates to hinder their enemies . When cast , " phantasmal terrain " creates the illusion of forbidding and difficult to cross terrain within an area of five feet in radius within 100 feet of the wizard . This effect can last for several minutes , slowing the movements of creatures within by as much as half , who become so distracted that they become vulnerable to far more mundane traps and hazards .

title: Phantom Pass
description: Phantom Pass The Phantom Pass was a pass in the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains of the Yehimal , in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It connected the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau with Vanesci Hamlet in Konigheim . Reputation .

title: Phantom chasm
description: Phantom chasm Phantom chasm is an illusion spell learned by some wizard s early in their training . " Phantom chasm " , when cast , creates the image of a bottomless pit five feet in diameter within 100 feet of the wizard . Though it is only an illusion , creatures standing over the chasm find it so realistic that they may suffer actual mental trauma , convinced that they are plummeting to their deaths .

title: Phantom plow
description: Phantom plow Phantom plow was a divine magic spell available to cleric s and druid s of Chauntea . It caused a deep , straight groove to form in the earth , possibly causing creatures in its path to fall . It also revealed any dweomers cast on the ground .

title: Phantom steed
description: Phantom steed Phantom steed was a conjuration spell that conjured a magical horse ( or spider in the case of spider domain cleric s ) for the caster to ride . Effect . This spell conjure a quasi - real , horse - like creature .

title: Pharaun Mizzrym
description: Pharaun Mizzrym Pharaun Mizzrym was a talented wizard and and Master of Sorcere from House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . Description . He was charismatic , well dressed , eloquent , and never left standing on one foot .

title: Pharblex Spattergoo
description: Pharblex Spattergoo Pharblex Spattergoo was the chief and shaman of the bullywug tribe in the Mere of Dead Men during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons in 1489 . Personality . Pharblex greatly enjoyed tormenting the lizardfolk , thanks to Dralmorrer Borngray putting them under his control , and he killed the lizardfolk chief Suncaller .

title: Pharnth Aelorothi
description: Pharnth Aelorothi Pharnth Aelorothi was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Pharnth ' s consort was Saesaan Aelorothi .

title: Pharom Ildacer
description: Pharom Ildacer Pharom Ildacer was the elder surviving aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar and a member of the Nantarn Council . History . Pharom was promoted to High Mage in 1341 DR after his masters the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark accepted new students .

title: Pharos
description: Pharos Pharos was the most powerful elven high mage among the elves of Tethir , Darthiir Wood , and Shilmista and the one who trapped the genie s Calim and Memnon in the " Calimemnon Crystal " and ended the Era of Skyfire . He became a baelnorn and guarded over the " Crystal " for nearly 9 , 000 years . As of 1374 DR , Pharos still resided in the Spinning Keep of Siri ' wadjen .

title: Pharra ' s Alley
description: Pharra ' s Alley Pharra ' s Alley was an alley in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep near the House of Wonder . History . The alley was named for Pharra , the first Magistress of the House of Wonder who died in 1247 DR .

title: Pharran Nicostas
description: Pharran Nicostas Pharran Nicostas was a drow wight in Blingdenstone . History . Pharran was a drow warrior who went to Blingdestone .

title: Pharx
description: Pharx Pharx was a deep dragon ally of the Dragon ' s Hoard . History . In 1361 DR , Pharx was the strongest ally of the Dragon ' s Hoard group in Skullport .

title: Pharyssolnyth
description: Pharyssolnyth Pharyssolnyth was a female wyrm silver dragon of the 16th century before Dalereckoning . She was the author of the Tablets of Pharyssolnyth . History .

title: Phase door
description: Phase door Phase door was a conjuration or spell that opened passages , where there were none . Effects . While the spell was called " phase " " " door " " , what appeared on casting was an ethereal , and thus invisible , tunnel .

title: Phase spider
description: Phase spider A phase spider was a magical beast akin to a predacious version of the ethereal filcher . Phase spiders were monstrous arachnid - kin that dwelt within the Ethereal Plane . They made quick forays into the natural world to snatch an unlucky creature to feed upon .

title: Phase trap
description: Phase trap Phase trap was an arcane alteration spell that could temporarily anchor a plane - hopping creature to the Prime Material Plane . Effects . The caster of " phase trap " was required to be within 20 yd ( 18 .

title: Phelansheene
description: Phelansheene Phelansheene was a sorceress under a curse in Amphail in 1370 DR . History . Phelansheene was a sorceress with a spellbook full of ancient and powerful Netherese spell s .

title: Phelas Urm
description: Phelas Urm Phelas Urm was a merchant from Thentia by the Moonsea . Some time after the sinking of " Valashar ' s Bane " in 389 DR , he purchased the recovered Cormyr ean state sword , " Ilbratha " , from a fellow merchant , Sevan of Amnwater , while in Scornubel , not realizing the blade ' s significance . Phelas took the sword with him as he traveled overland , passing through Cormyr , and the sword was recognized in Arabel .

title: Phelzel
description: Phelzel Phelzel was a city in Semphar . Description . The city of Phelzel was the second - largest in Semphar , about half the size of Dhaztanar , and a major trading city for that nation , primarily focusing on lumber from the Shalhoond .

title: Phen Do
description: Phen Do Phen Do was a rebellious noble in Tabot in 1357 DR . History . Wanting to return the rule of nobles over Tabot , Phen Do bribed the Chi - Kyap Khempo and influenced the Nafeen Gompa and Zotung Gompa , starting a revolt .

title: Phenalope
description: Phenalope Phenalope , also known as , was related to the less valuable rhodochrosite . Description . These pink to rose - red semi - precious stones could be or tumbled smooth .

title: Phent
description: Phent Phent is large fortress city in Thesk along the Golden Way . Phent is a sprawling fortress that carries with it a heavy feeling of duty , many people here are retired knights and derelict guards , many of Faerûn ' s best human made weapons and armors can be found here . Recently there has been an influx of Gnomish engineers bringing in their expertise to expand the value and variety of the master craftsmen here .

title: Phezult ' s sleep of ages
description: Phezult ' s sleep of ages Phezult ' s sleep of ages was a spell which created a protective sphere of suspended animation . Effects . After casting , a spherical stasis field would slowly expand out from the " spell focus " until it reached it ' s maximum spherical volume .

title: Phiaqiv
description: Phiaqiv Phiaqiv was one of the leading ixzan members of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , in 1370 DR as well as the city ' s archmage . History . Phiaqiv was born in the year of Malydren ' s founding , 602 DR , and together with Zekaqux was transformed into a greater vampire by an avatar of Ilxendren .

title: Philaerin
description: Philaerin Philaerin was a moon elf and the Eldest of the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . He resided in Tower Reilloch on the island of Evermeet . Description .

title: Philip Athans
description: Philip Athans Philip Athans was born in 1964 in Rochester , New York , but was raised in Chicago . He is Managing Editor for Wizards of the Coast Book Publishing , and wrote some of the first " Forgotten Realms " books , as well as many others like " Lies of Light " in 2006 and " Realms of War " coming up in 2008 . He is well - known for writing the novelizations of the computer games , Baldur ' s Gate and .

title: Philter of drunkenness
description: Philter of drunkenness A philter of drunkenness was a magical potion that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Phindar streeaka
description: Phindar streeaka Phindar streeaka , meaning " mindless recklessness " , was counted among the drow fighting styles but wasn ' t truly a technique . It was a catch - all phrase to describe berserker - like combat , and it lacked any kind of underlying order in its approach to combat . Description .

title: Phlan
description: Phlan Phlan was a large town located on the northern shoreline of the Moonsea at the mouth of the Stojanow river . Founded over 1 , 000 years ago , a series of destruction and rebuilding led to the city being walled off into a destroyed , ruined Old Phlan and a rebuilt , shining Civilized Phlan . Phlan was noteworthy not only for its stubbornness but also as the location of the fabled Pool of Radiance , which was the source of power for the otherworldy Tyranthraxus .

title: Phlogiston
description: Phlogiston Phlogiston is the name given to the space between the crystal sphere s of the Prime Material Plane . Bizarre creatures inhabit it and prey on spelljammer s traveling between spheres . In the Spelljammer setting , there is a celestial configuration known as the Triad , which consists of Realmspace , in which the world Toril is located ; Greyspace , where the world of Oerth is found ; and Krynnspace , home of the world of Krynn and the " Dragonlance " campaign setting .

title: Phoenix clan
description: Phoenix clan The Phoenix clan was a ninja clan and an ally of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . Despite not being as efficiently as the Hijo clan , the Phoenix were more obscure and secretive , not telling anyone the true name of their clan or the location of their headquarters . Their leader was a mysterious woman called the Serpent ; all other members of the clan had met at least once but could not identify her .

title: Phourkyn One - Eye
description: Phourkyn One - Eye Phourkyn One - Eye was a sunwyrm posing as a human wizard in Thentia during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . The wizard Firefingers believed that there had once been a real Phourkyn One - Eye until the sunwyrm killed him and took his place . History .

title: Phsant
description: Phsant Phsant was a large city of 30 , 000 inhabitants ( as of 1479 DR ) in Thesk . Phsant sat along the Golden Way . It was the site of the defeat of the Tuigan Horde and had a large orc population .

title: Phthta Thak
description: Phthta Thak Phthta Thak ( pronounced " fith - ta thak " ) was a necromancer and inhabitant of the Battle of Bones . Personality . Phthta was a loner and a recluse , wishing nothing more than to be left alone to her work .

title: Phulir
description: Phulir Phulir was a member of the Company of the Anvil adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Phulir was a rather normal - looking individual .

title: Phultan Hammerwand
description: Phultan Hammerwand Phultan Hammerwand was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Quite peculiar for a vampire lord , Phultan ' s diet of blood had changed his previously corpulent physique to one of sagging flesh .

title: Phylactery
description: Phylactery A phylactery was a term for a charm or amulet , or repository used to store small parchments bearing holy scripture or arcane writings . Lich ' s phylactery . A magic phylactery was used to store the souls and life force of lich es .

title: Phylactery of bravery
description: Phylactery of bravery The phylactery of bravery was a magic item of Najm , the Zakharan goddess of adventure . Description . The phylactery was actually a gold - trimmed armband made from parchment inscribed with arcane metallic runes .

title: Phylactery of faithfulness
description: Phylactery of faithfulness A phylactery of faithfulness was a useful item for divine spellcaster s , in that it enabled the wearer to foresee how their actions would affect their connection to their deity . Appearance . A " phylactery of faithfulness " was a small black box containing religious scripture , tied around the forehead by a leather cord .

title: Phylactery of righteousness
description: Phylactery of righteousness Phylacteries of righteousness were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .

title: Phylo
