description: Phylo Phylo was the original myconid leader of the Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Phylo " ruled " the Neverlight Grove alone for a long time .

title: Phyvvak
description: Phyvvak Phyvvak was an ixilthetocal ruler of history in Seros . History . Born in 1107 DR , Phyvvak ascended to the position of vitanar in 1185 DR .

title: Pick
description: Pick A pick , also known as a pickax or pickaxe is a hand tool for digging and breaking up hard or rocky ground . They range in size from about one to four feet ( 30cm to 120cm ) long with a perpendicularly mounted striking head . The head has a sharp spike on one side and the other side may be a chisel , hammer , or another spike .

title: Pick and Lantern
description: Pick and Lantern The Pick and Lantern was a successful tavern in the Venter section of Skullport . The proprietor was a dwarf known as Wilgold Gunderbradt who also owned a flophouse behind the tavern . The tavern welcomed sailors and miners and was known for the collection of maps of Undermountain that adorned its walls .

title: Pick and Shovel Corps
description: Pick and Shovel Corps The Pick and Shovel Corps was a military organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . 3 , 500 slaves and gladiators made - up this organization .

title: Pien - Hung
description: Pien - Hung Pien - Hung was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Pien - Hung was a traveling shukenja who fell sick and asked for hospitality at the Shrine of the Setting Sun and remained there for a while .

title: Piergeiron the Paladinson
description: Piergeiron the Paladinson Piergeiron the Paladinson was the Open Lord of Waterdeep throughout most of the 1300s DR and leader of the Lords ' Alliance . He lived in Piergeiron ' s Palace in Waterdeep . Usually , the identities of the Lords of Waterdeep are concealed from the people , but Piergeiron was one of only four whose identities were known , the others being Ahghairon , Baeron , and Lhestyn .

title: Pieron Ramdon
description: Pieron Ramdon Pieron Ramdon was a Lords ' Alliance ' s agent in Mulmaster . History . Pieron was a soldier in Cormyr until he decided to go to the Moonsea in search of a better fortune .

title: Pierson
description: Pierson Pierson was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Pierson was one of the members of West Harbor militia .

title: Pierson ' s home
description: Pierson ' s home Pierson ' s home was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Pierson . Location .

title: Pigeon Rock Oasis
description: Pigeon Rock Oasis Pigeon Rock Oasis was located in the Hordelands . Description . Located just west of the northern Quoya Desert , this small oasis got its name from the nearby outcropping of rock used to identify it .

title: Pikar Salibuck
description: Pikar Salibuck Pikar Salibuck was a halfling apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , he was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush . History .

title: Pike
description: Pike Pike was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Pike was the personal servant of Shoalar Quanderil .

title: Pikel Bouldershoulder
description: Pikel Bouldershoulder Pikel Bouldershoulder is a dwarven druid of Mielikki and brother of Ivan Bouldershoulder . Description . Pikel has a dyed green beard with a middle parting that is drawn back over his ears to join his long hair at his back in a braid .

title: Pil ' it ' ith
description: Pil ' it ' ith Pil ' it ' ith was the sarrukh former Chosen of Sseth . History . Pil ' it ' ith was a very unusual albino sarrukh that was the last emperor of Okoth .

title: Pilgrims ' District
description: Pilgrims ' District The Pilgrims ' District was one of the wards of Huzuz , the City of Delights . , in 1367 DR . Description .

title: Pilgrims ' Gate
description: Pilgrims ' Gate The Pilgrims ' Gate was one of the entrances into Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . The gate was located along the edge of the south central region of the city .

title: Pilgrims ' Route
description: Pilgrims ' Route The Pilgrims ' Route was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Travelers departing Huzuz along the Pilgrims ' Route exited the golden city through the Pilgrims ' Gate before heading south .

title: Pillar of Skulls
description: Pillar of Skulls The Pillar of Skulls was a landmark in the plane of Avernus , the first layer of the Nine Hells . It contained the skulls of victims of the Blood War , taken as trophies by the devil s . The Pillar towered over a mile ( over 1 .

title: Pillar of sand
description: Pillar of sand Pillar of sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a pillar of sand that rose into the air , carrying any target into the sky .

title: Pillars of Woe
description: Pillars of Woe The Pillars of Woe was a cavern and gorge located between Gracklstugh and Menzoberranzan . Geography . The Pillars of Woe was located not far south of Menzoberranzan .

title: Pilot Demitrick
description: Pilot Demitrick Pilot Demitrick was a warrior from Targos who traveled the North , finding work as a guide , hunter , sage and all - round mercenary . He became a renowned guide within the northern territories , leading adventurers and the like into the more dangerous regions of the Savage Frontier . Background .

title: Pine
description: Pine The pine is common in Faerûn , especially in the north , but also exists on other parts of Abeir - Toril . It grows in places such as the southern slopes of the Spine of the World and in the Vordrorn Forest . Variations .

title: Pingtu
description: Pingtu Pingtu was a deep gnome priest in Blingdenstone . History . Pingtu was briefly an acolyte priest under high priest Bendekik before 1371 DR .

title: Pinochet
description: Pinochet Pinochet was a powerful male human pirate on the Sword Coast . In 1356 DR , he and his fleet , acting on the orders of Pasha Pook , attacked the " Sea Sprite " belonging to Captain Deudermont to stop the Companions of the Hall from arriving in Calimport . Thanks to Drizzt Do ' Urden and his friends , Pinochet ' s pirates were defeated and Pinochet was captured .

title: Piper
description: Piper Piper was a self - proclaimed prophet residing in Hilltop . He would constantly rant about prophecies that never seemed to come true — causing a great deal of stress to Mayor Veraunt Shuttlescomb and the village guards . In 1372 DR , when Hol Halstrom called Piper a fool for claiming that death was coming to Hilltop , Piper was angered by this and proclaimed that Hol would die within the week .

title: Pipestone
description: Pipestone Pipestone , was also known as . Description . Pipestone was a soft stone , easily carved .

title: Pirate Isles
description: Pirate Isles The Pirate Isles were a collection of rocky islands that dotted the Sea of Fallen Stars and were inhabited by pirates . There were fifteen named islands but around sixty in total . The islands that comprised Prespur were not included in the Pirate Isles , despite their proximity .

title: Piri
description: Piri Piri was a drow wizard from Sshamath . History . Piri was an apprentice in the College of Mages of his city , known for his skill in piecing together arcane texts .

title: Pirithin Alagost
description: Pirithin Alagost Pirithin Alagost was a halfling man and a thief . He was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . Activities .

title: Piscaethces
description: Piscaethces Piscaethces , The Blood Queen , is the creator of the aboleth s . From her blood the Eldest was spawned . Aboleths depict her as a vast aboleth with no tentacles and with mucus the color of blood .

title: Pit fiend
description: Pit fiend Scholars pertain that there are sixteen standard ranks of baatezu and pit fiends are right at the top of this hierarchy . Physical description . Pit fiends are the generals of baatezu armies , the orchestrators of mass corruption and the bullies of their lesser devils .

title: Pit fighter
description: Pit fighter Pit fighters were expert warriors who had learned to fight in closed spaces , such as dungeons or gladiator pits . To survive these dangerous battles , pit fighters picked up unorthodox survival methods that might be considered dishonorable or " dirty . " However , while the pit fighter ' s style might not have been elegant or dignified , it did what it needed to do .

title: Pit of a Thousand Voices
description: Pit of a Thousand Voices The Pit of a Thousand Voices was located within the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Winding tunnels and caves were scattered throughout the pit .

title: Pit of the Ghuls
description: Pit of the Ghuls The Pit of the Ghuls was a dangerous valley in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . The Pit of the Ghuls was a deep valley surrounded by ring of granite cliffs .

title: Pitalla
description: Pitalla Pitalla was a shukenja in the land of Koryo . Pitalla used a " wish " from the " leaping fish " to cure the settlement of Mo ' ki of the ivory plague . He was believed to have then taken the " leaping fish " to the island of Su ' un and left it there , where it remained long lost by the mid – 14th century DR .

title: Pitney Lannon
description: Pitney Lannon Pitney Lannon was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Neverwinter Nights 2 .

title: Piwafwi
description: Piwafwi A piwafwi was a drow cloak that granted increased powers of stealth and hiding . It came in two varieties , lesser and greater . Description .

title: Pixie
description: Pixie Pixies were a race of sprites native to Faerie that were created by the fey creator race . Description . Many pixies enjoyed wearing bright colored clothing .

title: Piyrathur
description: Piyrathur Piyrathur was a caravan master from Iriaebor and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Piyrathur was one of the few Knights operating in the Caravan Cities .

title: Placidor
description: Placidor Placidor was a dwarf and the hero of the Battle of Twelvesuns . Descendants of Placidor could call themselves " Blood of Placidor " under the traditional dwarven naming system . However , in the mid – 14th century DR , one such descendent declined as an act of rebellion , naming himself " Onyx the Invincible " instead .

title: Plague ( spell )
description: Plague ( spell ) Plague was an arcane illusion spell that caused the recipient to appear as if he or she were suffering from a disfiguring and probably contagious disease . Effects . This powerful illusion mimicked a noxious disease , giving the victim the look , feel , and smell of a true plague - carrier that was obviously apparent to any observer other than the victim .

title: Plague demon
description: Plague demon Plague demons were fiends that were created when creatures succumbed to the abyssal plague . Creation . Similar to ghoul fever , a victim infected by the abyssal plague , either through the ingestion of or contact with Voidharrow , exposure to the blood of another infected creature , or the attacks / death throes of a plague demon , could develop symptoms of the disease and transform upon their death .

title: Plague gnat
description: Plague gnat A plague gnat was a small green gnat that infested swampy terrain . Their bite could cause plague gnat boils , a disease that caused large red sores that themselves could contain plague gnats , which , if left untreated , burst into a cloud around the victim .

title: Plague of Spells
description: Plague of Spells Plague of Spells is the first novel in the Abolethic Sovereignty trilogy by Bruce R . Cordell . Summary .

title: Plaguegrass
description: Plaguegrass Plaguegrass is grass that has been touched by the spellplague and grows only within the borders of the Plaguewrought Land . The grass was used as the key ingredient in Gregor ' s elixir that blocked the effects of the spellplague . Plaguegrass has blue crystals growing on the stalks .

title: Plagueland
description: Plagueland Plaguelands is a term used to refer to areas or regions where spellplague exists . Creatures that venture close to plaguelands can gain spellscar s . The Order of Blue Flame often seek out plaguelands in what are referred to as Scar Pilgrimage s .

title: Plaguewrought Land
description: Plaguewrought Land The Plaguewrought Land ( also called the Plaguewrought Lands ) is the name given to what was once the state of Halruaa and a large area south of Chondalwood that continues , as of 1479 DR , to be wracked by the effects of the Spellplague . Inside this plagueland the ground heaves like waves on the ocean and pieces of land levitate randomly to form earthmote s . The vegetation that grows here is strange and twisted and may sprout , mature and then die in a matter of minutes .

title: Plain of Horses
description: Plain of Horses The barbarians of the Horse - Plain have tried countless times to invade their neighbors , the Shou and T ' u Lung , and have been successful on a few accounts , but their victories were often short lived . Recently though , Tuigan tribes successfully breeched the Dragonwall and devastated many of the northwestern provinces of the Shou Empire . During this invasion , many Shou refugees fled to Faerûn and settled in the Thesk region of the Unapproachable East .

title: Plain of Standing Stones
description: Plain of Standing Stones The Plain of Standing Stones was one of the three major subdivisions of the Anauroch desert . The northern dwarves called it " Turlaghh " , the " Field of Broken Dreams " . Geography .

title: Plains of Purple Dust
description: Plains of Purple Dust The Plains of Purple Dust , was a vast windy desert located east of the Dragonsword Mountains on the edge of the region formerly occupied by Mulhorand and the northern region of the Raurin desert . The desert expanded in the century following the Spellplague . Geographic Features .

title: Planar Sphere
description: Planar Sphere The Planar Sphere was created by the wizard Lavok Corthala , putting many resources and much wealth into its creation . Near the time it was finished , it and Lavok disappeared for 500 years until it suddenly returned , re - appearing in the Slums District of Athkatla , vaporizing whatever matter existed where it appeared . A massive sphere , it was conceived and used as a vessel for planar travel .

title: Planar binding
description: Planar binding Planar binding ( originally called Valdick ' s snare and later ensnarement ) was a powerful and dangerous conjuration spell used by arcane casters to call a being from another plane and bind it . Effects . The spell took a full ten minutes to cast and could call forth up to three elemental creatures or outsider s .

title: Planar rift device
description: Planar rift device The planar rift device was an artifact of great power , sealed beneath Athkatla . It would later be found by the Bhaalspawn Abdel Adrian and potentially destroyed by a vestige of Amaunator . History .

title: Planar traits
description: Planar traits The many planes in the cosmology of Toril had traits that greatly differentiated them from the Prime Material Plane with which most adventurers were familiar . Depending on your abilities , race , and even faith the different planes could be warm , welcoming places , or manifestations of pure horror . In 1st and 2nd edition D & D , planes were not categorized by specific traits but instead were described in terms of survival : breathing , time , food and drink , gravity , direction , vision and senses , and movement .

title: Plane of Shadow
description: Plane of Shadow The Plane of Shadow was one of the planes of existence in various cosmological models . Its purpose and characteristics evolved as new cosmologies were formulated . Other names for this plane included Shadowland , the Demiplane of Shadow , the Shadowfell , and simply Shadow .

title: Plane shift
description: Plane shift Plane shift was an alteration or conjuration spell that transported the caster and a few others to a different plane of existence . Effects . By means of this spell , the caster and up to seven other beings could be transported to a chosen plane or alternate dimension , including specific layers of multilayer planes .

title: Planetar
description: Planetar Planetars were a race of angel s inhabiting the celestial plane s . They were the mighty generals of celestial armies that had also been known to help powerful mortals on missions of good , particularly those that involved battles with fiends . Appearance .

title: Planetouched
description: Planetouched Planetouched are mortal creatures whose lineages trace back to outsiders , including celestial s , fiend s and elemental s . Outsiders who can reproduce tend to be inter - fertile , therefore being able to mate with just about any other creature they desire . If the offspring of these unusual unions proves to be itself fertile , within a few generations planetouched will be born .

title: Planewalker
description: Planewalker A planewalker was one who had significantly traveled the planes . Typically , but not always , they were powerful wizard s . It was quite common for powerful wizards such as Elminster and Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun to have spent some time planewalking .

title: Plant door
description: Plant door Plant door was an alteration spell that created a passageway through thick vegetation , allowing easy passage or concealment . Effects . This spell opened a magical corridor 4 ft ( 1 .

title: Plant growth
description: Plant growth Plant growth was a transmutation or alteration spell that caused plants to grow . Effects . This spell could be cast in two different ways : as a means of creating a barrier ( nicknamed " overgrowth " ) or as a means of promoting better crop yields ( " enrichment " ) .

title: Plant lance
description: Plant lance Plant lance was a divine magic spell available to druid s of Chauntea . It converted living plants into animated spear s that flew at a target and attacked . Effects .

title: Plant sphere
description: Plant sphere The Plant sphere was a group of spells granted to druid s and shaman s . Ranger s also had minor access to this sphere . These spells could be used to aid agriculture or bring aspects of plant life to bear on problems of attack , defense , and survival .

title: Plate mail
description: Plate mail Plate mail ( also known field plate or simply plate ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Plate mail consisted of shaped , interlocking plates .

title: Platinum
description: Platinum Platinum is a rare silvery - white metal sometimes used as a currency in the Realms . It ' s value is generally greater than gold and , like gold , it ' s resistant to oxidation . Worth .

title: Platinum Cadre
description: Platinum Cadre The Platinum Cadre was an order of dragonborn knights from Tymanther sworn to the service of Bahamut . Because they worshiped a dragon god they were outcasts in thymari society and wasn ' t uncommon that its members were expelled from their clans because of their beliefs . The headquarters of the Platinum Cadre were located in an abandoned section of the Catacombs of Djerad Thymar .

title: Platinum dragon
description: Platinum dragon Platinum dragons were the rarest of metallic dragon s ; in fact , most believed that there was only one platinum dragon . They represented the archetype of good - aligned metallic dragons . Description .

title: Platter of Plenty
description: Platter of Plenty The Platter of Plenty was a restaurant in Marsember , Cormyr owned by Bientra Whaelbuckler . Atmosphere . It was a busy , alcohol - free establishment that opened around dusk and remained open until dawn .

title: Player ' s Handbook 2
description: Player ' s Handbook 2 Contents . The fourth core rulebook in the 4th edition ruleset for the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game , the " Player ' s Handbook 2 " , or PHB2 , is meant to be used alongside the original 4th edition " Player ' s Handbook " by players for building their characters . The PHB2 includes , among other things , races and classes that were considered " core " in previous editions but were excluded in the initial release of 4th edition .

title: Player ' s Handbook 3rd edition
description: Player ' s Handbook 3rd edition For other uses , see Player ' s Handbook ( disambiguation ) . The " Player ' s Handbook " 3rd edition was the original Player ' s Handbook for the 3rd edition of the Advanced Dungeons & Dragons game . It was replaced in 2003 by the " Player ' s Handbook " v .

title: Player ' s Handbook 4th edition
description: Player ' s Handbook 4th edition Contents . The " Player ' s Handbook " is the first core rulebook for the 4th edition of the " Dungeons & Dragons " roleplaying game . Within , as in previous editions of the " Player ' s Handbook " , are contained all that any player needs to know before playing for their first time , including available classes and races from which to build their character , as well as an introduction to combat rules and a listing of magical equipment that player characters can acquire .

title: Players Handbook 1st edition
description: Players Handbook 1st edition The Player ' s Handbook , also known as Players Handbook in 1st edition Advanced Dungeons & Dragons ( AD & D ) , is a book of rules for the fantasy role - playing game Dungeons & Dragons ( D & D ) . It does not contain the complete set of rules , but only those for use by players of the game . Additional rules , for use by Dungeon Masters ( DMs ) , who referee the game , can be found in the Dungeon Master ' s Guide .

title: Pleasant Valley Gateway Oasis
description: Pleasant Valley Gateway Oasis Pleasant Valley Gateway Oasis was located at the southern end of the Glittering Spires mountains in the Hordelands . Description . This green valley was fed by glacial run - off that formed a small lake that slowly drained the excess water deep underground .

title: Pleasure domain
description: Pleasure domain The Pleasure domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters pleasurable spell powers . It originated in the " Book of Exalted Deeds " , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " . Pleasure Domain Powers .

title: Plenerond Silverbell
description: Plenerond Silverbell Plenerond Silverbell was a knight of the Knights in Silver during the late 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , during an assault by orc and drow on the Silver Marches , Plenerond and Doughty were part of a contingent of Knights under Aleina Brightlance and helped in the defense of Sundabar .

title: Pliinki
description: Pliinki Pliinki was a mad derro savant member of the Gray Ghosts in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Pliinki believed that the Gray Ghosts ' obelisk was hidden in its location by Diirinka herself and that rebuilding it would grant " unimaginable power " that she could use to conquer the city .

title: Plod Graveltoe
description: Plod Graveltoe Plod Graveltoe was a deep gnome in Mulmaster . History . Plod led a svirfneblin expedition into the Mulmaster sewers .

title: Ploopploopeen
description: Ploopploopeen Ploopploopeen was a kuo - toa n archpriest and ruler of Sloobludop until the events of the Rage of Demons . Personality . Ploopploopeen was a good leader for his people , even tolerating occasional dissidents like Shuushar , but he was not forgiving of any who would destroy the peace of his community , even his daughter .

title: Pluma
description: Pluma Pluma or feathermagic was a form of divine magic practiced by priests of Qotal in Maztica . Feathermagic took its name from the colorful feathers required to work the magic . Feathermagic was used primarily to enchant objects such as feather armor and to create useful magical items such as elevator - like lifts or floating litters to carry a person .

title: Plume
description: Plume The Plume was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . This section of the City of Brass was jammed with coffee houses , shops , and stalls .

title: Po ' ioa ' nam
description: Po ' ioa ' nam Po ' ioa ' nam was a shalarin innkeeper in Myth Nantar . History . Po ' ioa ' nam was a rogue warrior who , around 1349 DR , managed to penetrate the Great Barrier with his wife Tu ' ara ' thal after fleeing a group of merrow who had killed all his companions .

title: Po Yul Dzayul Range
description: Po Yul Dzayul Range The Po Yul Dzayul Range was a mountain range in Tabot in Kara - Tur . Geography . The Po Yul Dzayul Range was the middle of the three arms of the Yehimal that extended east into Kara - Tur .

title: Pocket Plane ( Baldur ' s Gate )
description: Pocket Plane ( Baldur ' s Gate ) The Pocket Plane in the game " " and its expansion " " is a plane within a plane unconsciously created through the power of their Bhaalspawn blood by the player character to shield themselves within Bhaal ' s realm . Nature . The Pocket Plane first appears at the end of " Shadows of Amn " when the player character is dragged into " hell " together with Irenicus who has stolen most of their divine soul .

title: Poh Nih
description: Poh Nih Poh Nih was a sage in T ' u Lung . History . Poh Nih was a sage and a member of the Black Leopard Cult .

title: Pohidge Plam
description: Pohidge Plam Pohidge Plam was the son of the mason of Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . For fifteen years Pohidge chased fortunes as fighter .

title: Poison
description: Poison A poison was a substance that damaged or affected the abilities of a creature , either instantly or over time . A poison could be administered by contact , inhalation , ingestion , or through a wound . The effects of poisons varied widely but some common effects include paralysis , sleep , loss of ability , injury , or death .

title: Poison ( spell )
description: Poison ( spell ) Poison was a necromancy or alteration spell that inflicted a debilitating and possibly fatal poison into a living target creature . The reverse of this spell was known as neutralize poison . Effect .

title: Poison Dusk
description: Poison Dusk The Poison Dusks were a tribe and small subrace of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . Description . A poison dusk was a humanoid reptilian , resembling other lizardfolk but much smaller , standing 3 – 4 feet ( 0 .

title: Poison domain
description: Poison domain The Poison domain is not only that of the deadly toxins that are within deadly creatures , it ' s also in the form words , and there are three deities to whom have a liking to the poison domain . To Talona , poison and disease are of the same purpose : To create misery and pain . To her the mother of all plagues , the best poisons are the ones that cause extended torment and agony fore killing the afflicted victims .

title: Poisonous exhalation
description: Poisonous exhalation Poisonous exhalation is a spell of the conjuration school used by sorcerer s , particularly dragon sorcerers . When it is cast , " poisonous exhalation " causes the sorcerer casting it to breath out a billowing mist of poisonous gas that saps the endurance of creatures caught within . Dragon sorcerers off sap their enemies still further , to a degree dependent on their own physical strength .

title: Poke
description: Poke Poke was a monk and a member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the mid – 14th century DR . Poke was the head of the monastery at the time , holding the rank of Grand Master of Flowers .

title: Pokoso
description: Pokoso Pokoso was an intelligent Azuposi human sunwatcher who lived in Kin Elbhaz in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . Personality . The cleric was under - confident and felt he was not worthy of his position , and this affected his ability to pray for spells .

title: Pol
description: Pol Pol , or Brother Pol , was a knight , wizard , and cleric of Helm at Watcher ' s Keep in Amn . The god Helm gave Pol and his fellow knights the task of sealing Demogorgon inside the keep . Knowing it was a difficult mission , his leader , Odren , recruited Gorion ' s Ward to work for him .

title: Polaris
description: Polaris Lady Polaris was the archwizard leader of Delia in the Netherese Empire . Description . The Netherese female was attractive with golden skin and snow white hair .

title: Pole arm
description: Pole arm Pole arms were invented to increase the effectiveness of infantry against cavalry and they can be devastating in disciplined formations of well - trained soldiers . Over the centuries , pole arms developed from the basic forms to more sophisticated and specialized ones as the art of war progressed . Naming , describing and classifying the myriad types of pole arms is not standardized , and indeed seems to vary greatly even among authoritative sources .

title: Polearm master
description: Polearm master Polearm masters are fighter s who have trained to become specialists in the use of polearm s such as spear s or halberd s . These individuals gain a combat advantage through the reach of their weapons and the ease of use , though at the cost of learning to use other melee weapons effectively . However , the benefits of polearms are impressive and polearm masters are effective guardians as well as deadly adversaries .

title: Political map of Faerûn
description: Political map of Faerûn Official political map of Faerûn ( a geography map with political borders ) was first published in the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting " for " Dungeons & Dragons " 3rd edition . It is relative to the year 1372 DR . The map was updated to year 1373 DR in the " Player ' s Guide to Faerûn " .

title: Polyhedron magazine 103
description: Polyhedron magazine 103 Polyhedron magazine # 103 was released in January 1994 . Forgotten Deities : Amaunator . The first of eighteen articles on lesser - known gods that hadn ' t yet received a full write - up in other supplements .

title: Polymorph
description: Polymorph Polymorphing was a magical effect in which the subject creature assumed a new physical form while retaining its essential identity and abilities . These effects included the Alter self spell , polymorph spells ( " polymorph " , " baleful polymorph " , and " polymorph any object " ) , the " shapechange " spell , the wildshape class feature , and the alternate form special quality . Magic could cause creatures and characters to change their shapes — sometimes against their will but usually to gain an advantage .

title: Polymorph any object
description: Polymorph any object Polymorph any object ( originally called Aksa ' s morphing ) was a powerful transmutation spell that let one change someone or something into anything else . Effects . Upon completion of the spell , the subject — which could be any nearby creature or a nonmagical item — was changed into a creature or object of the caster ' s desire .

title: Pomab Ak ' azmjir
description: Pomab Ak ' azmjir Pomab Ak ' azmjir was the Calishite owner of Pomab ' s Emporium in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . The merchant was a slender man who dressed in red robes .

title: Pomphur
description: Pomphur Pomphur was a merchant from the city of Almraiven in Calimshan in the 14th century DR . Pomphur partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , and Shield of Everlund — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .

title: Pond of Tears
description: Pond of Tears The Pond of Tears was a small pond that could be found near the middle of the plains around the Battle of Bones . Geography . The Pond of Tears was a naturally occurring body of water that filled with runoff from the region ' s brief spring rains .

title: Ponton
description: Ponton Ponton was a cleric of Tyr in Urml in the Shining Plains in 1358 DR . Activities . Ponton took care of the temple of Tyr in Urml , where was kept the Hand of Tyr artifact gauntlet .

title: Pook
description: Pook Pasha Pook was the leader of the Pook guild in Calimport , the capital of Calimshan . He was the one who had originally hired Artemis Entreri , " Pasha Pook ' s prime assassin " , in an attempt to get an enchanted ruby back from the halfling Regis . Pook was given Drizzt ' s magic panther , Guenhwyvar , as a token from Artemis Entreri .

title: Pool of Radiance ( game )
description: Pool of Radiance ( game ) Pool of Radiance was the first of a long series of computer role - playing games that shared a common engine that came to be known as the " Gold Box Engine " after the gold boxes in which most games of the series were sold . Summary . The game takes place in the " Forgotten Realms " setting , in and around the Moonsea region and the city of Phlan , which has been overrun by forces of evil .

title: Pool of Radiance ( novel )
description: Pool of Radiance ( novel ) Pool of Radiance , by James Ward and Jane Cooper Hong , is the first book of The Pools trilogy . The novel is based on the very first Forgotten Realms computer game , Pool of Radiance . Summary .

title: Pool of Radiance : Ruins of Myth Drannor
description: Pool of Radiance : Ruins of Myth Drannor Pool of Radiance : Ruins of Myth Drannor is a " Forgotten Realms " Dungeons & Dragons role - playing game released in 2001 by . It is the sequel to the 1980s gold box game " Pool of Radiance " . " Ruins of Myth Drannor " is based on the " AD & D " module of the same name , but with rules updated for the third edition of " AD & D " .

title: Pool of Radiance : Ruins of Myth Drannor ( novel )
description: Pool of Radiance : Ruins of Myth Drannor ( novel ) Pool of Radiance : The Ruins of Myth Drannor by Carrie Bebris is a novel based on the of the same name by SSI . Summary . The novel is about a group of four adventurers — Kestrel , a thief ; Corran D ' Arcey , a paladin of Tyr , Durwyn , a fighter ; and Ghleanna Stormlake , moon elf wizard — as they explore the ruins of Myth Drannor and face the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Pools of Darkness ( game )
description: Pools of Darkness ( game ) Pools of Darkness is the final title in the four - game " Forgotten Realms " series of computer role - playing games developed and published by Strategic Simulations , Inc . It is the sequel to " Secret of the Silver Blades " . The novel " Pools of Darkness " by James Ward and Anne K .

title: Porphyrys Cadorna
description: Porphyrys Cadorna Porphyrys Cadorna was briefly the head of the Council of Ten in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Porphyrys was born as the son of Eugenia Cadorna , once master of the Cadorna cloth merchants .

title: Port Ghaast
description: Port Ghaast Port Ghaast was a large city in Murghôm . Geography . Situated along the western bank of the River Ghaast and the coast of Brightstar Lake , Port Ghaast was a prime military location for incursions into neighboring Semphar .

title: Port Llast
description: Port Llast Port Llast ( formerly Grath ' s Hold ) stood on the High Road some thirty - five miles north of Neverwinter . It was a small town of 700 folk mainly known for its skilled stonecutters and excellent harbor – a small bay sheltered by a high , rocky spit , with a fine beach and inlet . The port was overlooked by cliffs on which boulder - hurling siege engines were placed .

title: Port Nyranzaru
description: Port Nyranzaru Port Nyranzaru ( alternate spelling , Port Nyanzaru ) was a port in northern Chult that was an Amn ish colony in 1479 DR . It was the major trading center for all of Chult . Geography .

title: Portable hole
description: Portable hole A portable hole was a magic item worth 20 , 000 gp consisting of a circle of black cloth about 6 ft ( 1 . 8 m ) in diameter that , when spread on any surface , opened an extradimensional hole to a non - dimensional space that was 10 ft ( 3 m ) deep . When not in use , the hole could easily be folded to the size of a handkerchief .

title: Portable spring
description: Portable spring The portable spring was a magic item that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Portable springs " appeared as blue pieces of cloth .

title: Portal
description: Portal Portals were permanent teleporation effects that linked many places in and outside Toril , including other planes . The devices riddled Toril , easily numbering in the thousands , though by the 14th century DR no one was ever able to determine the exact number of active " portals " , even in Faerûn alone . A freestanding archway of some kind usually identified the location of a portal , so those who could not detect magical auras did not stumble into them accidentally .

title: Portal drake
description: Portal drake Portal drakes were a type of drake that dwelled in the Underdark and spent their time looking for magical items . Description . Portal drakes were the size of a " large housecat .

title: Portfolio
description: Portfolio A portfolio was a list of things that all true deities possessed . The portfolio of a deity determined the area of interest that it both represented and had power over . Ideas , emotions , races of creatures , schools of magic , and other topics related to mortal existence could all become part of a deity ' s portfolio .

title: Portith
description: Portith Portith was a medium - sized town found in the Barony of Ostel in Damara . Portith ' s population in 1357 DR was 1 , 200 . Activities .

title: Portrait
description: Portrait Portrait was a basic alteration spell used to capture a scene perfectly within another item . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .

title: Poscadar elf
description: Poscadar elf The Poscadar elves , or Poscadari , were a group of nomadic elves who lived along the Pasocada River and Long Canyon . They were taller than an average elf and had bronze - colored skin . They subsisted by skilfully hunting the bison and other large creatures that inhabit the grasslands .

title: Poseidon
description: Poseidon Poseidon was a god of waters worshiped by some in Impiltur in northeast Faerûn . However , like the sea , he was fickle in nature . In the late 1350s DR , twelve cleric s of Poseidon served aboard " Rilaunyr ' s Warship " , which was based in Sarshel .

title: Poshtli
description: Poshtli Poshtli was one of the Eagle Knights of Nexal . History . Poshtli was the nephew of Naltecona and one of his wisest advisors .

title: Positive Energy plane
description: Positive Energy plane The Positive Energy plane , sometimes called the Plane of Life or the Positive Material plane , was an Inner Plane or Energy Plane of the Great Wheel cosmology and the World Tree cosmology models . After the Spellplague , the Positive Energy plane collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , mixing with all the other Inner Planes . Cosmologists believe that positive energy and its opposite negative energy , combined with the four elements , make up the known universe .

title: Positive energy
description: Positive energy Positive energy was the energy empowering living beings with life . It originated on the Positive Energy Plane and manifested as a white , glowing surge of power . Positive energy healed living beings .

title: Positoxin
description: Positoxin Laced with positive energy , positoxins are special alchemical mixtures that can effect undead . Positoxins effect corporeal undead as poison s effect the living . Positoxins are able to effect an undead ' s physical abilities ( strength and dexterity ) .

title: Potala
description: Potala The Potala was the palace of the Dalai Lama in Saikhoi . Description . The Potala appeared as a red citadel .

title: Potion
description: Potion Potion was a catch - all term for a liquid brewed by an alchemist or spellcaster with an intended magical or extraordinary effect . Probably most common were the various potions of healing wherein those with the ability to do so channeled positive energy into a mixture that could heal the wounds of the imbiber . Many temples used such potions to generate revenue for the upkeep of the building and any other expenses .

title: Potion of dreaming
description: Potion of dreaming Potions of dreaming were magical liquids that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . The vast majority of magical potions and oils in Zakhara were found in durable flasks sealed with crystal and wax .

title: Pouri Lam
description: Pouri Lam Pouri Lam was a female human bushi and the unofficial mistress of the city of Foo Nakar in Koryo , as well as the most powerful woman in the kingdom , in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Pouri Lam was the daughter of Masgar Lam , the governor of Foo Nakar .

title: Povros Karanok
description: Povros Karanok Povros Karanok was a member of House Karanok in 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Povros was the leader of one of the new Karanok holdings built outside of Luthcheq after , in 1370 DR , Entropy ( secretly manipulated by Tiamat ) spawned some smaller spheres .

title: Pow Ming
description: Pow Ming Pow Ming was a wizard in Yartar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Pow Ming acted as security chief of the Golden Goose , a riverboat housing a gambling hall .

title: Power word , banishment
description: Power word , banishment Power word , banishment was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to banish a single extra - planar creature , forcing it back to its native plane .

title: Power word , kill
description: Power word , kill Power word , kill is a conjuration spell that kills one tough subject or many weak ones . Effects . When " power word , kill " is uttered , you can either target a single creature or let the spell affect a group .

title: Power word , silence
description: Power word , silence Power word , silence was an arcane alteration or conjuration spell that surrounded a target creature with a field that sound could not penetrate . Effects . When the caster pointed at a creature and uttered the power word , an aura of silence instantly surrounded the creature out to a distance of 1 ft ( 30 cm ) .

title: Power word , stun
description: Power word , stun Power word , stun was a conjuration spell that stunned strong creatures . Effects . When a " power word , stun " spell was uttered , one creature of the caster ' s choice was stunned , whether the creature could hear the word or not .

title: Pox
description: Pox Pox was a female lich and a leader of the Cult of the Dragon cell in Yartar in 1369 DR . Personality . Pox hated everyone from Zhentil Keep and the Zhentarim .

title: Pragmatist
description: Pragmatist Pragmatists or Clerics of the Faith Pragmatic , were the most liberal and most common of all priests in Zakhara . A pragmatist ' s belief system was based upon taking the ethos of the gods and fitting it to face the problems of the contemporary world . Pragmatists often wandered far from their temples in order to help spread their teachings .

title: Prastuil
description: Prastuil Prastuil was the oldest city in Dambrath . Geography . The city was situated at the mouth of the Dolphin ' s Climb , where it emptied into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins .

title: Pratcus
description: Pratcus Pratcus was a dwarven priest . Appearance . Pratcus had the typical sturdy build of a dwarf with muscular arms .

title: Prath Baenre
description: Prath Baenre Prath Baenre was a young drow wizard of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Description . Prath was described as very stocky .

title: Praven
description: Praven Praven was a student of Neverwinter Academy in 1374 DR . Biography . Praven was a student of Neverwinter Academy , and he liked to amuse ladies .

title: Praxasalandos
description: Praxasalandos Praxasalandos , also known as Prax , was a mercury dragon who lived in the Dragonsword Mountains in High Imaskar . History . In 1479 DR , Praxasalandos was one of the dragons who received an invitation to participate in Brimstone ' s " xorvintaal " .

title: Prayer ( spell )
description: Prayer ( spell ) Prayer was a enchantment or conjuration spell that brought divine favor to a battle ; encouraging allies and discouraging foes . Effects . The caster and all allies within the area of effect were granted better luck in striking their enemies and gave a small boost in skill or strength so the blows that landed were more damaging .

title: Prayer Stone
description: Prayer Stone The Prayer Stone was a large granite slab in the western part of the town of Amnwater , in Amn , as of 1368 DR . It was once part of a full stone circle , and acted as the only permanent temple in Amnwater . It was a multi - faith temple , and praying to any deity was permitted , provided it did not disrupt others .

title: Prayer of Anger
description: Prayer of Anger Prayer of Anger was an enchanted greatsword . Description . The sword was inscribed with the holy symbol of Tempus , god of battle .

title: Preachers
description: Preachers The Preachers were a faction of the holy slayer organization known as the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Activities . The Preachers served the Everlasting by being a direct representative to the moralist mosques of Hajama and their imams .

title: Preani Qin
description: Preani Qin Preani Qin was the ultimate leader of the Diligent Mamluk Society and commander of all mamluk s in Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description . Preani was attractive , so much so that she caught the eye of the Grand Caliph and earned the enmity of his wife , Tanya bint Perijan .

title: Prellyn Teh ' Kinrellz
description: Prellyn Teh ' Kinrellz Prellyn Teh ' Kinrellz was a female drow priestess of House Teh ' Kinrellz in Ched Nasad in 1375 DR . Activities . Prellyn was the weapon mistress of House Teh ' Kinrellz and the main enforcer of Matron Teh ' Kinrellz in the ruined Ched Nasad .

title: Preparing for the Sacred Trust
description: Preparing for the Sacred Trust Preparing for the Sacred Trust was a book written by Starweaver Deinyn Fembrys , a priest of the Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . He read from the book for his sermons in the so - called Mystra ' s Sacred Trust rite held at the temple . Essentially , in it , he claimed that , as shown on Mystra ' s holy symbol , magic was born between the stars , with the stars themselves being the known points or schools of magic , and that the space between contained far more secret magical knowledge that Mystra would only reveal to the most promising .

title: Preserve wood
description: Preserve wood Preserve wood was an arcane abjuration spell that permanently protected a quantity of wood from magical alteration . Effects . This spell could be cast on a wooden structure , such as a ship , to prevent the wood from being magically deformed by " warp wood " and similar spells .

title: Presper ' s moonbow
description: Presper ' s moonbow Presper ' s moonbow was an evocation spell that brought forth a few small glowing orbs that could be sent to shock one or more targets . Effects . This spell could be found in different versions as it evolved over the years .

title: Prespur
description: Prespur Prespur ( or the Isles of Prespur ) consisted of two islands in the Sea of Fallen Stars , in the same chain of islands as the Pirate Isles . Geography . On the larger of the two islands , the town of Palaggar was a garrison town and shipyard under the control of Cormyr .

title: Prestidigitation
description: Prestidigitation Prestidigitation is a minor cantrip learned by wizard s with varying effects . When a wizard casts " prestidigitation " he can choose any number of effects to occur , any of which must be within ten feet of the caster . " Prestidigitation " might allow a wizard to move an object of less than one pound , create a small sensory effect , clean or soil items withn one cubic foot , light or snuff out a small light source , chill or warm a pound of non - living material , make a small mark or symbol appear on a surface for an hour or less , produce a small item or image out of nothingness , or make a small , handheld item invisible for a short moment .

title: Prestige class
description: Prestige class Prestige classes are a group of advanced routes Faerûnian characters may take in their professional advancement which have nearly limitless options for their gaining in power and prestige . From secret societies such as the Harpers and the Shadow Thieves to military orders such as the Purple Dragons and the Aglarondan Griffonrider s , there are many paths for characters of every class to follow . Fighters and other combat - focused characters can continue advancing in their basic training or sign up with a mercenary guild or national army .

title: Prexijandilin Jhiri
description: Prexijandilin Jhiri Prexijandilin Jhiri was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Prexijandilin . Description . Jhiri had crimson eyes and umber scales .

title: Priador
description: Priador Priador is the coastal region of Thay east of Escalant . History . During the Salamander War ( 1357 DR - 1358 DR ) that ravaged the coastal cities of the Priador , the forces of Thay found themselves sorely beleaguered by former salamander allies .

title: Priam Agrivar
description: Priam Agrivar Priam Agrivar was a male human paladin of Tyr of the North . He was a famous adventurer and a crewmember of the " Realms Master " . Personality .

title: Priamon Rakesk
description: Priamon Rakesk Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk was a member of the Twisted Rune and formerly from Waterdeep . He was exiled for research into dark magic . Priamon stole portal - building secrets from Halaster Blackcloak and became the primary portal - builder for the Twisted Rune .

title: Priapurl
description: Priapurl Priapurl was a small town located on the Trader ' s Road . Government . As of 1372 DR , the ruler of Priapurl was Tar Hurara , who had descended from bandits but was often away from the town spending her time in the court of Cormyr .

title: Priatl
description: Priatl Priatl was one of the three leaders of the Azatl settlement in Nexal in 1362 DR . Activities . Priatl ruled over the territory alongside the human quarter and the human market .

title: Pride of Zhentil Keep
description: Pride of Zhentil Keep The Pride of Zhentil Keep was an infamous tavern and inn found in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Description . The Pride of Zhentil Keep was rumored to be so dirty that even the chamberpots leaked .

title: Priest ' s Spell Compendium Volume One
description: Priest ' s Spell Compendium Volume One Priest ' s Spell Compendium Volume One is the first in a series of three 2nd - edition books containing a vast collection of priest spells . It was published in 1999 . It contains alphabetically sorted spells from " a day in life " to " frost whip " .

title: Priest ' s Spell Compendium Volume Two
description: Priest ' s Spell Compendium Volume Two Priest ' s Spell Compendium Volume Two is the second in a series of three 2nd - edition books containing a vast collection of priest spells . It was published in 1999 . It contains alphabetically sorted spells from " garments of elvenkind " to " spiderform " .

title: Priest ' s shield
description: Priest ' s shield Priest ' s shield was a prayer cast by several cleric s , most often battle cleric s . When a cleric casted " priest ' s shield " he or she struck a foe with their melee weapon while simultaneously enhancing their , and one nearby ally ' s , ability to avoid injury for a brief moment . The strength of the prayer iwas consistent and proportional to that of the cleric ' s physical power as well as the cleric ' s degree of experience .

title: Prime Material Plane
description: Prime Material Plane The Prime Material Plane is the plane in which Toril and the surrounding cosmos exists . The phrase " Prime Material Plane , " or simply the " Prime , " is generally used by beings from other planes in the Forgotten Realms cosmology ( notably Sigil ) , and " prime " is used by the same beings to refer to the inhabitants of Toril . There is supposedly an infinite number of material planes , among them the Prime Material Plane , the Abeiran material plane , Oerth ' s material plane , ' s material plane , and the universe in which Earth is located .

title: Primordial
description: Primordial The primordials , or Dawn Titans , were god - like beings made of manifest entropy and elemental energy whose domains were the Elemental Chaos and Abeir , unlike the gods ( Estelar ) , whose domains were the Astral Sea and Toril . History . Ao created the multiverse from the raw material of the Phlogiston , and within the sphere several worlds drifted upon the Sea of Night .

title: Primus
description: Primus Primus , The One and the Prime was the immortal ruler of Mechanus and the modron s . He was godlike in power while in his realm . Abilities .

title: Prince Livid
description: Prince Livid Prince Livid was a massive gray ooze follower of the Pudding King in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . The Pudding King , an insane deep gnome fascinated by ooze s , subjugated a black pudding he called Princess Ebonmire and a gray ooze he called Prince Livid .

title: Prince of Jhothûn
description: Prince of Jhothûn The last Prince of Jhothûn was a qorrashi who was the last living resident of the city of Jhothûn . Whatever name the Prince once had was now forgotten . Description .

title: Princes of Murghôm
description: Princes of Murghôm The Princes of Murghôm were the ruling council who ruled the nation of Murghôm since 1409 DR . The princes were members of all the races of dragonkind . Each dragon prince ruled its own settlement and the region around it .

title: Princes of the Apocalypse
description: Princes of the Apocalypse Princes of the Apocalypse is a 2015 " Forgotten Realms " adventure module for the 5th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " , designed by Sasquatch Game Studio . The module was part of the Elder Evil storyline , and revolved around stopping four destructive cults devoted to the Elder Elemental Eye .

title: Princess Ebonmire
description: Princess Ebonmire Princess Ebonmire was a sentient black pudding follower of the Pudding King in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . At an unknown time , the black pudding devoured two spellbooks written by svirfneblin archmage Lesla Carrowil .

title: Princess of Doegan
description: Princess of Doegan The princess of the realm of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . tried to free it from its invaders . History .

title: Printing press
description: Printing press A printing press was a mechanical device for applying ink to a surface such as paper . History . The technology remained crude and experimental in the early 1360s DR , producing poor - quality texts .

title: Priscilla Auck
description: Priscilla Auck Priscilla Auck was the sister of Feringal , lord of Auckney . Description . Priscilla was domineering and controlling over her younger brother ' s actions , in part because of her desire to rule Auckney herself .

title: Prism of Kushk
description: Prism of Kushk The Prism of Kushk was a magic item that could be found in the city of Kushk in the Hordelands . Description . The Prism of Kushk was actually a large triangular diamond that measured one foot ( 30 cm ) on each side .

title: Prismal the Outrageous
description: Prismal the Outrageous Prismal the Outrageous was a human male wizard and cleric of Azuth . He owned and ran Chemcheaux , the most eclectic magic shop of the Realms , located in Raven ' s Bluff in the Vast . History .

title: Prismatic ice
description: Prismatic ice Prismatic ice was a mysterious magical substance thought to exhibit intense cold . The legendary " Calimemnon Crystal " emanated great cold , so some theorized it was incased in or formed of some form of ice , such as exceptionally cold water ice or frozen air . However , the wildest theory put forward was that it might be composed of prismatic ice .

title: Prismatic ray
description: Prismatic ray The prismatic ray spell is that which a single beam of brilliantly colored light shoots from the outstretched hand of the caster for over 100 feet . The color of the beam determines the effect of the spell . Occasionally , two effects may also occur simultaneously .

title: Prismatic sphere
description: Prismatic sphere Prismatic sphere is an abjuration spell that creates a prismatic barrier surrounding the caster on all sides . Effects . This spell functions in the same manner as " prismatic wall " , except you conjure up an immobile , opaque globe of shimmering , multicolored light that surrounds you and protects you from all forms of attack .

title: Procampur
description: Procampur Procampur , formerly known as Proeskampalar , was a city - state in the Vast , lying on the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars and the eastern shore of the Dragon Reach , situated at the western end of the North Road after Maerstar , and on the High Trail from High Haspur . It was an old and established independent city , and the richest on the north coast of the Inner Sea and in the Vast . Proud , well - mannered , and orderly , Procampur was famed for its jewelers and metal - smiths , and for its most unusual feature , the districts that divided the city by function and occupation , each with their own distinct roof color .

title: Proctiv ' s breach crystal sphere
description: Proctiv ' s breach crystal sphere Proctiv ' s seal crystal sphere was a powerful arcanist spell that permanently shut off a whole crystal sphere against access by spelljamming ships . It was actually the reverse version of the name - giving spell Proctiv ' s breach crystal sphere , which removed an earlier - cast " seal crystal sphere " , thus opening up portals through that crystal sphere again . Components .

title: Proctiv ' s move mountain
description: Proctiv ' s move mountain Proctiv ' s move mountain shears off a mountaintop and inverts and levitates it . The material components for this spell were a mythallar ( which needed to be placed in the new city within two weeks ) , a magical device that allowed flying or levitation , and a crystal ball . Without this spell the construction of enclave s would have been near - impossible .

title: Produce flame
description: Produce flame Produce flame was an evocation spell used by druid s and cleric s that created flames in the caster ' s hands . An arcane version of the spell existed , but it was only accessible to fire elementalist s and witch es , and required much more magical power . Effect .

title: Project image
description: Project image Project image was an illusion spell that created an illusory double that could talk and cast spells . Effects . The caster created a shadow duplicate of their self .

title: Promenade of the Dark Maiden
description: Promenade of the Dark Maiden The Promenade of the Dark Maiden was the most sacred temple to Eilistraee . It lay beneath Waterdeep , northeast of Skullport in Undermountain . Geography .

title: Promise of the Witch - King
description: Promise of the Witch - King Promise of the Witch - King is the second book of The Sellswords trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Pronouncement of Two Skies
description: Pronouncement of Two Skies The Pronouncement of Two Skies was when the gith race fractured into the githyanki and the githzerai . After the gith destroyed the illithid empire , Gith , a warrior - queen and leader of the rebellion , declared that the People would not rest until they had discovered and destroyed all remaining illithids in the multiverse ; then , the People would be free to conquer all of the planes of existence and bring war to all other races . Many of the People ’ s hearts shared this goal .

title: Proof from teleportation
description: Proof from teleportation Proof from teleportation , also called proof against teleportation , was an abjuration spell that created a barrier to teleportation and dimensional travel . Effects . The area protected by this spell was a sphere of radius 10 yd ( 9 .

title: Prophecy of Zhudun
description: Prophecy of Zhudun Prophecy of Zhudun is an invocation used by warlock s , particularly star pact warlocks . " Prophecy of Zhudun " , which draws upon the power of the dead star Zhudun , allows warlocks a glimpse into the maddening truths of the Far Realm , which he or she can then bestow upon a creature of their choosing . These nightmarish visions cause the creature to temporarily lose their sanity , becoming dazed if their willpower lacks the strength to resist the warlock ' s spell , which is enhanced by the warlock ' s charisma .

title: Prophet of Moonshae
description: Prophet of Moonshae Prophet of Moonshae , by Douglas Niles , is the first book in the Druidhome trilogy , which follows the events of the Moonshae trilogy . Characters . Alicia Kendrick • Keane • Tavish • Deirdre Kendrick • Tristan Kendrick • Robyn Kendrick • Newt • Earl Blackstone • Currag Blackstone • Gwyeth Blackstone • Hanrald Blackstone • Gotha • Brandon Olafsson • Sythissal • Nuva • Svenyird Olafsson • Sigurd • The Prophet • Talos • Kaffa • Larth • Wultha • Malawar / Coss - Axell - Sinioth • Knaff • Danrak • Yak • Loinwrap • Meghan • Mikal • Petite Isolde • Kile • Beaknod • Dagus • Backar • Warlock ( dog ) • Pryat Wentfeld

title: Proskler
description: Proskler Proskler was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , while posing as a strange adept of Talos , Proskler helped the relatives of Maude Kron to devise a plot against Cloak Nelvon deJuan by kidnapping his younger brother , Larch deJuan .

title: Proskur
description: Proskur Proskur was a city just outside of Cormyr . It was notorious for its open thieves guilds . Geography .

title: Protanther
description: Protanther Protanther was a gold dragon who gathered metallic dragon s to discuss the menace of the Cult of the Dragon and Tiamat during the time of the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Protanther was once the King of Justice , king of all gold dragons , but at one point he resigned from his post in favor of Lareth .

title: Protection candle
description: Protection candle A protection candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It either conferred " protection from evil , 10 ' radius " or " protection from good , 10 ' radius " on those within its area of effect . Description .

title: Protection from arrows
description: Protection from arrows Protection from arrows , also known as protection from normal missiles and originally called M ' dhal ' s missile shield , was a simple abjuration spell that defended against ranged weapon attacks . Effects . Upon casting the spell and touching another creature , the caster bestowed a protective shield upon the recipient .

title: Protection from birds
description: Protection from birds Protection from birds was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell protected the caster from birds , or creatures that had feathers .

title: Protection from chaos
description: Protection from chaos Protection from chaos was an abjuration spell that created an aura around the target that shielded against mental and physical attacks by chaotic creatures . This spell was not reversible , but a counterpart called " protection from law " was known . Effects .

title: Protection from energy
description: Protection from energy Protection from energy , also known as protection from elements , was the successor to the protection from fire spell . It was an abjuration spell that absorbed damage from either acid , cold , electricity , fire , or sound ( sonic damage ) , at the choice of the caster . Effects .

title: Protection from evil
description: Protection from evil Protection from evil was an abjuration spell that created an aura around the target that shielded against mental and physical attacks by evil creatures . The reverse of this spell , protection from good , had identical effects on good creatures . Effects .

title: Protection from good
description: Protection from good Protection from good was an abjuration spell that created an aura around the target that shielded against mental and physical attacks by good creatures . The reverse of this spell , protection from evil , had identical effects on evil creatures . Effects .

title: Protection from law
description: Protection from law Protection from law was an abjuration spell that created an aura around the target that shielded against mental and physical attacks by lawful creatures . Effects . This spell functioned exactly like " protection from evil " except the bonuses and benefits applied to attacks from lawful creatures .

title: Protection from lightning
description: Protection from lightning Protection from lightning was an abjuration spell that absorbed damage due to lightning and other electrical shocks . Effects . This spell was almost identical to " protection from fire " except it absorbed damage due to electricity and electrical effects instead of heat and fire .

title: Protection from lycanthropy
description: Protection from lycanthropy Protection from lycanthropy is a sorcerer / wizard spell that grants the target a greater chance to resist contracting lycanthropy when struck by a lycanthrope . If already infected , the target has a chance to resist a shapechange . The spell ' s material component is lycanthrope blood and the chance of this protection increases if the blood is from the same type of lycanthrope as the attacker , and increases yet further if the blood is from the attacker itself .

title: Protection from spells
description: Protection from spells Protection from spells was an abjuration spell that granted resistance to hostile spells . Effects . Subjects benefit from a much greater chance to resist spells and spell - like abilities ( but not supernatural and extraordinary abilities ) .

title: Protection from the elements
description: Protection from the elements Protection from the elements was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . This spell was used primarily by genie s upon their servants .

title: Protection sphere
description: Protection sphere The Protection sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , shaman s and , to a lesser degree , crusader s Beneficial auras and magical shields were the main focus of this sphere . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Protection Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Proto - dragon
description: Proto - dragon Proto - dragons were prehistoric lizard - like creatures from whom many scholars believed all species of dragonkind evolved . History . It was believed by scholars from Candlekeep that proto - dragons were related to the prehistoric dinosaur s , and it was speculated that maybe they were a divergent offshoot .

title: Proxy
description: Proxy Proxies were divine servitors of a deity . " Divine " in this case had two meanings . First , all proxies served a deity of at least demigod status .

title: Pryderi mac Dylan
description: Pryderi mac Dylan Pryderi mac Dylan was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark History . Pryderi was the son of Dylan . In the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR , Pryderi was one of the 2000 Earthfast dwarves led by Ironlord Torg mac Cei who joined the Army of the Alliance against the Tuigan Horde .

title: Prying eyes
description: Prying eyes Prying eyes is a divination spell that summons floating eyes to scout for the caster . Effect . You create ten or more semitangible , visible magical orbs ( called " eyes " ) that move out , scout around , and return as you direct them when casting the spell .

title: Pryntaler Obarskyr
description: Pryntaler Obarskyr Pryntaler Obarskyr was King of Cormyr and son of Palaghard I and Enchara . He was coronated in 1187 DR . Appearance .

title: Psaedros
description: Psaedros Psaedros , also known as , was a decorative hardstone mostly used for carving . Description . Psaedros was a soft rock that occurred in colors ranging from pink to mauve to lilac .

title: Psaltery
description: Psaltery A psaltery was a string musical instrument , similar to a plucked dulcimer . Description . Psalteries were popular in Interior and Northeast Faerûn , among both peasants and nobility .

title: Pseudodragon
description: Pseudodragon A pseudodragon was a small dragon - kin known to be playful but shy . Pseudodragons were not true dragons , but were highly valued for their use as wizard ' s familiars . Description .

title: Psionicist
description: Psionicist A psionicist is a person who uses the power of the mind , or psionics to influence objects , rather than magic . Often colloquially referred to as " mind mage s , " they draw their powers from their own consciousness using methods that must be replenished , or can be innate , as in illithid and drow practitioners . Although it is not fully known , this gift is an inherited trait and is subsequently genetic .

title: Psionics
description: Psionics Psionics , known in Faerûn as the Invisible Art and sometimes ki , and colloquially known also as mind magic was practiced by psionicist s . Nature of Psionics . Use of psionic power did not require spell components .

title: Ptah
description: Ptah Ptah was a master of planar travel and could teleport anywhere in the multiverse with accuracy . Ptah was summoned by Lord Ao and asked to carry a message to the deities on the home world of the Mulan , inviting them to create powerful avatars that could accompany Ptah to Realmspace where their people had been taken , bypassing the barriers put up by the Imaskari . Most of them agreed to make the sacrifice and the journey , so Ptah lead the way using an artifact known as the Beacon of Light .

title: Pterafolk
description: Pterafolk Pterafolk ( also called " pteramen " or " ptera - men " ) were a race of shape - shifting pteranodon - like humanoid s nearly unique to the jungles of Chult . Description . At first glance , pterafolk in their natural forms looked like tail - less lizardfolk or saurial s , but they were much taller and leaner and had elongated cranial crests like pteranodon s .

title: Pteranodon
description: Pteranodon Pteranodons were ranked among the dinosaur s . They were large behemoth s encountered in the wild and even occasionally trained for use as flying mounts , much like dragon s albeit with less intelligence . Description .

title: Ptola
description: Ptola Ptola was a doppelganger and a senior member of the Unseen in Waterdeep in 1370 . and 1372 . Ptola ' s area of activity was primarily Undermountain .

title: Public Gardens of Huzuz
description: Public Gardens of Huzuz The Public Gardens of Huzuz , or the Fourth Court , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . A splendid variety of trees and flowers filled the gardens with color throughout the year .

title: Pudding King
description: Pudding King The Pudding King was an insane deep gnome cultist of Juiblex in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The deep gnome known as the Pudding King possessed an innate power over oozes , able to communicate with them , playing with them like children .

title: Pulkka
description: Pulkka A pulkka was a kind of sled pulled by six reindeer . During coming - of - age ceremonies and other occasions in the kingdom of Hartsvale , it was a sign of honor to be carried behind a hunting party in a specially decorated " pulkka " .

title: Pullog
description: Pullog Pullog was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . Pullog ruled over a village far to the south .

title: Pumkato
description: Pumkato Pumkato was a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone . Description . The deep gnome had gray eyes .

title: Punakha Dzong
description: Punakha Dzong Punakha Dzong was a fortified monastery located in the Growing Mountains on the Katakoro Plateau in the Hordelands . Structure . Punakha Dzong was built atop a large column of rock .

title: Purang
description: Purang Purang was a land that lay between the jungle lands of Laothan and the Kuong Kingdom , and the border of T ' u Lung . Climate . The climate in Purang was more temperate than in the mountains of Kuong and jungles of Laothan .

title: Pureheartman
description: Pureheartman Pureheatman was the shaman of the Great Raven tribe of the Uthgardt . He was described as being of noble bearing , tall , slender , and usually dressed in a cape of flowing black feathers . He was secretly a member of the Host Tower of the Arcane and did what he could to oppose the plots of Dendybar and Eldeluc , and others of dubious nature .

title: Purification candle
description: Purification candle A purification candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It could cure all manner of illness and disease , or remove a curse , or banish an extraplanar creature . Description .

title: Purify food and drink
description: Purify food and drink Purify food and drink was a transmutation or alteration spell that make food edible and water potable . The alteration version could be reversed , creating putrefy food and drink , which spoiled food and fouled water . Effects .

title: Purlakhonthiis
description: Purlakhonthiis Purlakhonthiis was the pseudodragon familiar of Lhaeo , Elminster Aumar ' s sage who would become king of Tethyr . She was a platinum - colored pseudodragon with unique abilities . Description .

title: Purple Dragon knight
description: Purple Dragon knight Purple Dragon knights were the officers and warrior elite of the Cormyr ian army , the bulk of which was known as the Purple Dragons . The Purple Dragons and the knights within distinguished themselves with courage and honor several times in the past and being awarded knighthood within the Purple Dragons was a great honor for anyone from the Forest Country . On the battlefield they worked with the War Wizard s in order to overcome the enemy .

title: Purple Dragons
description: Purple Dragons The Purple Dragons were the famous military of Cormyr that were renowned for their discipline , skill , and loyalty . The Purple Dragons were considered to be one of the strongest armies in the Realms , and were well renowned for their heroism and acts of valor in the field of combat . They ranged from young nobles who joined as officers to farmers who joined as Blades .

title: Purple Hills
description: Purple Hills The Purple Hills were a range of hills on the coast of Tethyr , lying in County Vintor in the duchy of the Purple Marches . The town of Vineshade was located there . Inhabitants .

title: Purple Hills Cider
description: Purple Hills Cider Purple Hills Cider was an alcoholic cider made from a combination of apples , cherries , , plums , , and other fruits from the Purple Hills region . It had the kick of a strong wine with a fruity flavor . Purple Hills Cider was produced by the Kraljaom Distillery in Myratma .

title: Purple Marches
description: Purple Marches The Purple Marches was a of western Tethyr known for the quality of its wines . Geography . The Purple Marches were located on the coast between the Sulduskoon River and the River Ith and included the counties of Vintor , Bardshyr , and Elemetar .

title: Purple Rocks
description: Purple Rocks The Purple Rocks were an archipelago in the Trackless Sea located west of Gundarlin beyond the warm water of The River . They appeared as rocky outcroppings , but verdant valleys were sheltered from the storms behind their sparse forested peaks . The dragon Galadaeros considered the Purple Rocks its territory , and it is believed that Flamehome Isle , as he called its lair , was actually one of these two islands .

title: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern
description: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern The Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern was a very famous inn and tavern in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . Compared to the Elfsong Tavern , the tavern was frequented more by merchants , employers and adventurers .

title: Purple dragon ring
description: Purple dragon ring A purple dragon ring is a brass ring inscribed with the purple dragon symbol of the Obarskyr royal family , and they are usually worn by the Purple Dragon Knights to protect the royal family from harm . By 1372 DR it has been reported that over 4000 of these rings had been made . If this ring is worn on the same hand as a commander ' s ring , they are treated as one ring .

title: Purple worm
description: Purple worm The purple worm is akin to an enormous ( 5 feet wide and tall and 80 feet long ) and bizarre earthworm . Appearance . As its name implies , it is a deep purple color , with a pale yellow underbelly .

title: Purung
description: Purung Purung was a chieftain in Bawa in 1357 DR . History . Purung was the chieftain of the Kabuaya tribe , one of the most civilized Bawani tribes .

title: Pusavril
description: Pusavril Pusavril was one of the many merfolk refugee in Myth Nantar in 1370 DR . History . Pusavril was a weaver and netmaker .

title: Pusriver
description: Pusriver Pusriver was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Pusriver was the kindest of her coven , with the job of attracting people .

title: Puttak
description: Puttak Puttuk was an Iulutiun village in the southern region of Alpuk known for its domesticated kupuk . Geography . Puttuk was located on the Utaak Stream , northeast of Taak Lake , about 40 miles ( 64 kilometers ) from the Lugsaas Chain and 50 miles ( 80 kilometers ) from the Surykyk Range .

title: Pvelnqa Tsunglyl
description: Pvelnqa Tsunglyl Pvelnqua Tsunglyl was a member of the derro Council of Savants of Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Pvelnqua was a traditionalist who openly called for a Uniting War against an enemy like Blingdenstone or Menzoberranzan .

title: Pynroth
description: Pynroth Pynroth was a tiefling youth in the Moonsea . History . Pynroth lived with nine other non - human children in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children in Hillsfar until First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - humans .

title: Pyong Do
description: Pyong Do Pyong Do was a city in the realm of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was formerly part of the kingdom of Koguryo . Geography .

title: Pypyap
description: Pypyap Pypyap was an imp familiar of Halvin Graingle in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Pypyap was a very friendly devil albeit ill - willed .

title: Pyras Autorian
description: Pyras Autorian Pyras Autorian was the tharchion of Thaymount of Thay . Activities . Pyras had no real talent and was an open puppet of Szass Tam .

title: Pyratar
description: Pyratar Pyratar was the capital of Var the Golden in 1367 DR . Description . Pyratar was located on a bay named the Throat within the western regions of the Golden Water .

title: Pyrolisk
description: Pyrolisk The pyrolisk was a magical beast that was very similar in appearance and physical strength to the cockatrice . Their differences lay in the pyrolisk ' s red tail feathers and special abilities . Abilities .

title: Pyrotechnics
