description: Pyrotechnics Pyrotechnics was a spell from the transmutation school or the alteration school that operated on a normal fire to produce either bright , blinding fireworks or billowing clouds of thick , choking smoke . Casters . In the time of Netheril , " Primidon ' s pyrotechnics " could be cast by arcanist s of the Inventive specialization .

title: Q ' Xorlarrin
description: Q ' Xorlarrin Q ' Xorlarrin was a drow settlement founded around the forge of the ruined dwarven city of Gauntlgrym . Q ' Xorlarrin was the sister city of Menzoberranzan . Description .

title: Q ' arlynd Melarn
description: Q ' arlynd Melarn Q ' arlynd Melarn was a drow wizard . Originally from Ched Nasad , he was a capable battle mage and the only surviving male member of Ched Nasad . Description .

title: Qadib
description: Qadib The Free City of Qadib , also known as the City of Wands , was located along the Al - Haul River . Qadib housed more magic users than any other place in northern Zakhara , topped only by Huzuz and Rog ' osto in all the Land of Fate . Trade .

title: Qadim Hills
description: Qadim Hills The Qadim Hills were a grouping of hills in the Troll Mountains of Amn . Geography . These were the western hills of the Troll Mountains , beginning north of Trollford and running until the Green Fields .

title: Qaland T ' akk
description: Qaland T ' akk Qaland T ' akk was a barbarian chieftain inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Qaland was the chieftain of the Igidujin tribe and the ruler of Quaraqand and a descendant of the feared Qaland Shurijah .

title: Qallit
description: Qallit Qallit was a sahuagin malenti living in the Great Sea near a zaratan around the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Activities . Qallit guarded the island formed by the zaratan ' s shell from intruders , questioning any who approached .

title: Qanun
description: Qanun A qanun ( qah - NOON ) was a Zakharan stringed instrument similar to the zither found elsewhere on al - Toril . Description . A " qanun " was a trapezoidal box consisting of 24 - 36 courses .

title: Qanun of the spirits
description: Qanun of the spirits The qanun of the spirits was a beautiful magical musical instrument that was presented to the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , so there were multiple " qanun s of the spirits " scattered throughout the Land of Fate . Description .

title: Qar Jysstev
description: Qar Jysstev Qar Jysstev was Namarch on the Council of Six in Amn . Description . He was a skinny man who tried to hide his bald spot with expensive wigs of yoxen hair .

title: Qara
description: Qara Qara was a sorceress from Neverwinter who once attended the Neverwinter Academy , where she received some small amount of wizard training that she ultimately disregarded . She was best known for her travels with the Kalach - Cha . Appearance .

title: Qaraqib
description: Qaraqib The qaraqib ( kah - rah - KEEB ) was a set of clackers used by Zakharan dancers . Description . A dancer would hold two sets of " qaraqib " in each hand and manipulate them while moving about .

title: Qarbo
description: Qarbo Qarbo was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Qarbo was cruel and more than a little manic in his demeanor .

title: Qas ' ah baladi
description: Qas ' ah baladi The qas ' ah baladi ( KAh - sah bah - LAH - dee ) was a large Zakharan kettle drum . Description . These drums were crafted from fire - hardened clay .

title: Qaxdivak
description: Qaxdivak Qaxdivak was a mutant ixzan cleric and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren , as well as a priest of Ilxendren in 1370 DR . Personality . Although small in size , Qaxvidak made up for it by being highly cunning .

title: Qaynat
description: Qaynat The Qaynat was a group of beautiful and talented women gathered by the fourth Grand Caliph of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . History . Obsessed with beauty , the fourth Grand Caliph filled his harim with physically dazzling women who were also skilled musicians and behaved in a proper courtly manner .

title: Qerria
description: Qerria Qerria was the leader of the Order of the Gilded Eye in Helm ' s Hold sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Qerria ruled Helm ' s Hold and the Gilded Eye .

title: Qiltox
description: Qiltox Qiltox was a beholder involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Qiltox was a beholder allied to the Zhentarim ; he lived in the ruin of Myth Drannor until he was forced to flee at the start of the Cormanthor War ; The Zhent relocated him to their new drow allies of House Dhuurniv to help and control the drow .

title: Qilué Veladorn
description: Qilué Veladorn Qilué Veladorn was the youngest of the Seven Sisters , the Chosen family of Mystra , goddess of magic , and was a drow cleric of Eilistraee as of 1372 DR . . Description .

title: Qinnaz
description: Qinnaz Qinnaz was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Qinnaz was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Qirmiz min Hudid
description: Qirmiz min Hudid Qirmiz min Hudid was a beautiful but deadly agent of the Brotherhood of the True Flame inhabiting Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Violent outbursts and mood swings were commonplace when dealing with Qirmiz , causing many individuals who challenged her to experience the full wrath of her blazing power .

title: Qoha ' dar
description: Qoha ' dar Qoha ' dar was a human sha ' ir who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Qoha ' dar spent a great deal of time making sure she was always presentable for someone of her lofty station .

title: Qorrashi
description: Qorrashi Qorrash ( singular qorrashi ) were genie s of cold and ice . Description . Qorrash were elemental creature s native to the Plane of Air .

title: Qos
description: Qos Qos was the most powerful of the dukar in Myth Nantar . Activities . Qos was one of the greatest mysteries of Serôs .

title: Qotal
description: Qotal Qotal , the feathered dragon , also known as the Plumed One , was the lawful good god of healing , feathers and creation in Maztica . He was often portrayed as a huge golden dragon who had golden colored feathers instead of scales . From his neck erupted a lush mane of many colored feathers .

title: Qu ' ellarz ' orl
description: Qu ' ellarz ' orl Qu ' ellarz ' orl was a high plateau and district in the drow city of Menzoberranzan . It was home to some of the most powerful drow houses in the city , including House Baenre , the most powerful house . Qu ' ellarz ' orl and Tier Breche combined were considered the " two heads " ( most important unifying parts ) of Menzoberranzan .

title: Qu ' encesta
description: Qu ' encesta The Qu ' encesta were a far - ranging tribe of Nar found in Narfell known for their savage nature . There were 2 , 700 Qu ' encesta in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Qu ' ima
description: Qu ' ima The Qu ' ima were a moderately sized tribe of Nar found in Narfell who always weighed their options before acting . There were 1 , 900 Qu ' ima in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Quabah
description: Quabah Quabah was a small village that lay south of the Pit of the Ghuls within the High Desert of Zakhara . History . The village was originally founded by nomads hailing from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue as a religious retreat .

title: Quaervarr
description: Quaervarr Quaervarr ( also spelled Quaervaar ) was a small woodland town in the Silver Marches located in the southern part of the Moonwood near Herald ' s Holdfast . History . Quaervarr started out as a logging camp , but grew to be a small town that both tended and logged the trees of the Moonwood with great care .

title: Quaervaxthanus
description: Quaervaxthanus Quaervaxthanus was a beholder mage that became Magister . Personality . Quaervaxthanus had a natural talent in creating and modifying spell s .

title: Quaggoth
description: Quaggoth A quaggoth was a bear - like inhabitant of the Underdark . History . Originally believed to have been bred by drow magicians as a slave race , the quaggoth escaped and filled their own niche in the Underdark .

title: Quail
description: Quail Quails were common in the " Forgotten Realms " . Species . Sand hen .

title: Qualith
description: Qualith Qualith was the written language of illithid s . It took the form of four parallel lines that had texture that conveyed meaning when read by an illithid scanning its four tentacles along the lines simultaneously . It could be written on parchment , in books , or carved into surfaces .

title: Quallem
description: Quallem The Quallem family was a noble family of Dordrien in the area that later became Daggerdale . Organization . The head of the family was recognized to be Lady Quallem .

title: Quang Muku Forest
description: Quang Muku Forest The Quang Muku Forest or simply Quang Muku was a forest in the kingdom of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . It lay east of the Vorkani Mountains . Description .

title: Quaraband
description: Quaraband Quaraband was the capital city of Yamun Khahan ' s empire . Geography . Quaraband was a tent city that did not have permanent structures .

title: Quarrel
description: Quarrel Quarrel was a half - orc assassin in the service of Tyranthraxus . Description . Quarrel was a slender and powerful female humanoid with black hair , jet colored eyes , and a nose .

title: Quarren Urmbrusk
description: Quarren Urmbrusk Quarren Urmbrusk was the lord of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep until 1476 DR . Activities . Quarren was the lord of Urmbrusk , a house known for providing moneylending and land - buying services to many merchants and temples .

title: Quarters of the Unclean
description: Quarters of the Unclean The Quarters of the Unclean was the name of the poor sector of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . This quarter lay outside of the protective walls of the city .

title: Quarterstaff
description: Quarterstaff A quarterstaff ( plural quarterstaves ) is a simple , two - handed melee weapon that may be used as a double weapon . Description . Six to eight feet ( 1 .

title: Quarterstaff of Battle
description: Quarterstaff of Battle A Quarterstaff of Battle is a improved magic + 3 Quarterstaff of Speed . It is immune to all slashing and piercing damage and gives the wielder a great bonus to his or her ability to disarm opponents , as though he or she had the " Improved Disarm " feat . The staff can be used up to three times per day to deflect medium - sized or smaller projectiles for twelve seconds , including ranged attacks from spells of level 2 or lower , provided they are aimed within five feet ( 1 .

title: Quasimagical item
description: Quasimagical item A quasimagical item was an item that acted as a permanently activated magical item , provided that it remained within range of a " mythallar " . History . The great Netherese arcanist Ioulaum created the first quasimagical item in −3011 DR .

title: Quasit
description: Quasit Quasits are chaotic evil outsiders . Standing about 1 . 5 - 2 feet in size and weighing about 8 pounds , they resemble tiny humanoids with spiky horns and bat wings .

title: Quavylene Oblodra
description: Quavylene Oblodra Quavylene Oblodra was the First Priestess of House Oblodra and daughter of matron mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Quavylene was the chosen victim of her mother ' s psychic tortures because she could not measure up to K ' yorl ' s extreme expectations .

title: Quayle
description: Quayle Quayle is a whiny , foul - tempered , arrogant gnome with a nasal voice who believes that he is a genius and that all those around him are idiots who should acknowledge his super - intelligence . He appears in both the Baldur ' s Gate computer game and novelization . The Games .

title: Qudra
description: Qudra Qudra , or the City of Power , was a major power in the northern reaches of Zakhara . Description . Qudra was a model of duty and organization .

title: Queen ' s Fury
description: Queen ' s Fury The Queen ' s Fury was the pirate vessel of Catharyn of Dambrath . Description . The flag of Queen ' s Fury was a dolphin jumping over a ship .

title: Queen ' s Market
description: Queen ' s Market The Queen ' s Market was one of two major marketplaces in the city of Darromar , the capital of Tethyr . It was located west of Star Street in the Royal Quarter in the northern half of the city , northeast of Ithal Crag and the palace of Faerntarn . The Sea Lions ' Pride , an historic festhall within the city , was located just off the Queen ' s Market .

title: Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades
description: Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades Queen Filfaeril ' s Blades was a secret society of spies and assassins working to maintain order within the kingdom of Cormyr . Activities . Under Toraunt Hawkgar , the Blades did their best to keep a low profile , as rumours of their activities made it more likely that their identities would be revealed by the War Wizards , whose attentions they avoided to the utmost .

title: Queen of Chaos
description: Queen of Chaos The Queen of Chaos is a demon lord of obyrith origins . She became listed as an obyrith in the third edition supplement " " . Description .

title: Queenspire
description: Queenspire The Queenspire was a temple of Umberlee within Deepwater Harbor in Waterdeep . Location . The building was located on a large rocky outcropping of a sandbar south of the city off the South Ward .

title: Quelaerel
description: Quelaerel Quelaeral ( pronounced " kwel - " air " - ell " ) was a spicy brown sauce made by boiling leech es found in the Abyssal layers of Shedaklah and the Slugbed . This delicacy was prized by Calishite gourmands and was used in other cuisines of Southern Faerûn .

title: Quelamia
description: Quelamia Quelamia was an Eladrin mage and the most powerful wizard in the employ of House Serrat of Delzimmer . She was so important to the family ' s business that she was given a percentage of profits , something no other employee received . Description .

title: Quell
description: Quell Quell are ghostly undead creatures that despise the concept of life and the connection the living have to the gods . In essence , they hate the act of worship and the very presence of a quell can isolate a worshiper from the touch of their god . This power is called " intercession " .

title: Quelsandas
description: Quelsandas Quelsandas was a mature adult bronze dragon allied with Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel Taegan Nightwind , Queen Sambryl of Impiltur agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout .

title: Quelzarn
description: Quelzarn A quelzarn was a giant , eel - like water snake that was able to dwell in most kinds of large bodies of water . Description . Quelzarn looked like eels and had slimy green or brown skin .

title: Quelzur Naismen
description: Quelzur Naismen Quelzur Naisen was a Red Wizards of Thay pirate in 1359 DR . History . Quelzur was a talented wizard but frequently went in contrast with his superiors and was no prone to make friends .

title: Quenthel Baenre
description: Quenthel Baenre Quenthel Baenre was a drow priestess , and the third daughter of Yvonnel Baenre . She was the Mistress of Arach - Tinilith , the clerical school of Menzoberranzan , and later Matron Mother of First House Baenre . She first appeared as a minor , supporting character in the final three books in the Legacy of the Drow series before rising to prominence in the War of the Spider Queen series which further expanded on her character .

title: Quentin Bodeau
description: Quentin Bodeau Pasha Quentin Bodeau was the most recent leader of House Pook , a thieves guild in Calimport . He started as a thief and became master of the house after the death of Pook and the disappearance of Regis . The house ' s wizard , LaValle , considered him a good man and a competent master .

title: Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar
description: Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , also known as the " Golden Grove of Hidden Knowledge " , are five sets of 10 Nether Scrolls each , changed into the form of a tree . The empire of Netheril had acquired a set of the Nether Scrolls , explaining their rapid rise and their mastery of magic . The elves arranged for the scrolls theft from the Netherese , and secreted them away in Windsong Tower , in the city of Myth Drannor .

title: Quessahn Uthraebor
description: Quessahn Uthraebor Quessahn Uthraebor is a warlock living in Waterdeep . Hundreds of years ago , she lived in the High Forest and was married to a deva named Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn but he was killed soon after their marriage . Quess studied at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep and also received tutlage from the Avolakia Briarbones .

title: Quesseer
description: Quesseer Quesseer was a Netherese settlement founded in - 2368 DR by Arthindol the Terraseer , just to the north of the Sword Mountains . During its lifetime , the town became a trading center for the towns of Illusk and Waterdeep , as well as for the elves of the forests of Illefarn . It was eventually abandoned in - 2095 DR due to the destruction of Illusk by an orcish horde from the North and the threat of destruction as well .

title: Quest
description: Quest Quest was an enchantment spell that commanded a subject to undertake a task and return with proof the task had been completed . Effects . This divine version of the old " geas " spell could be used to coerce a creature to perform a significant task but unwilling subjects had a chance to resist , especially if the quest was unjust or undeserved .

title: Questele
description: Questele Questele was a moon elf mage and member of Moonstars . History . In 1486 DR Questele ' s duty was to protect the young Chosen of Lathander , Stedd Whitehorn .

title: Quickling
description: Quickling Quicklings were a rare breed of brownie that were once like any other brownies , but they sought out dark and powerful magic . It was unknown whether they sought the power for altruistic purposes or not , but it was known that the power corrupted them entirely . They became savage hunters who were particularly cruel in their methods of killing .

title: Quickstrike
description: Quickstrike Quickstrike was possibly the last specimen of slug - like creatures called gravecrawler or ancestor worm s . Description . Quickstrike had a gray , plump , segmented body with a hairless and eyeless man - like head .

title: Quiet Multitude
description: Quiet Multitude The Quiet Multitude was a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Selan , the Zakharan goddess of beauty . The Quiet Multitude did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities .

title: Quil ' bryn
description: Quil ' bryn Quil ' bryn was a mad drow in Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Quil ' bryn was a member of the Drow Resistance against the invading fire giant s .

title: Quildan Oussgyhm
description: Quildan Oussgyhm Quildan Oussghym was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) and the patron father of the Jaezred Chaulssin in Karsoluthiyl in 1374 DR . History . Quildan was the patron father responsible for the Jaezred Chaulssin ' s activities in Karsoluthiyl , namely marginalizing the matriarchy and thus the influence of Lolth ' s dogma while tilting the balance of power towards merchants who funded more of the Jaezred Chaulssin ' s actions during the Silence of Lolth .

title: Quillan
description: Quillan Quillan was the sage of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Quillan was focused on local flora , always trying to respond to questions with something related to flowers or plants .

title: Quimby
description: Quimby Quimby was a mage of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived some time prior to 882 DR . Quimby was a devoted gourmand but an impatient cook . For aid in meal preparation , Quimby modified the " unseen servant " spell to create " Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet " .

title: Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet
description: Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet Quimby ' s enchanting gourmet was an arcane conjuration spell dedicated to cooking and cleaning up a kitchen afterwards . Effect . It was a specialized version of the " unseen servant " spell , capable only of activities related to cooking and other kitchen tasks .

title: Quimby ( Easthaven )
description: Quimby ( Easthaven ) Quimby was the owner of the Snowdrift Inn in Easthaven within the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Description . He was a large man who wore a brown outfit .

title: Quinan Varnaed
description: Quinan Varnaed Quinan Varnaed was a slaver of Skullport and one of the founders of the Iron Ring . Personality . Quinan was a cruel and sadistic man but respected by all in the slave market of Skullport .

title: Quinix
description: Quinix Quinix was a glabrezu living in the ruins of the Gate of Iron Fangs on the southwestern tip of the Forest of Amtar . Activities . He traveled through a portal into the Forest of Amtar .

title: Quinn Nardrosz
description: Quinn Nardrosz Quinn Nardrosz was a retired ranger in Jalanthar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Quinn was the head of the council that ruled the village .

title: Quiral
description: Quiral Quiral was a human blacksmith and ex - adventurer who lived in Espar , Cormyr as of 1368 DR . Activities . The blacksmith was known for creating high quality sword s , although his methods were slow and careful .

title: Quirish
description: Quirish The Quirish were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Quirish lived in the central region of the Hordelands .

title: Quirish language
description: Quirish language Quirish was a tribal language of the Hordelands . Description . The grammar of Quirish had a subject – object – verb order .

title: Quiver of Anariel
description: Quiver of Anariel The quiver of Anariel was a magical arrow quiver which automatically replenished its ammunition . Description . The quiver of Anariel looked like any other ordinary arrow quiver , holding twenty arrows .

title: Quiver of plenty
description: Quiver of plenty The Quiver of Plenty was a magic al quiver capable of producing an unlimited number of magical arrow s . History . The history of the quiver of plenty was unknown , apparently forgotten by 1368 DR .

title: Quivering Forest
description: Quivering Forest The Quivering Forest was a forest stretching from the foothills of the Dragonspine Mountains in the north to within a mile of Phlan in the south . It acted as a barrier to the great gray waste of Thar to the east . The Quivering Forest lay mainly on the east bank of the River Stojanow .

title: Quivering palm
description: Quivering palm The Quivering Palm is a spell or incantation used by Kane for dominating enemies . The spell is enhanced by a magical item , such as a ring , and activated through meditative incantation . A spectral hand will appear next to the subject , lightly brushing him or her .

title: Quon Tok
description: Quon Tok Quon Tok was a bushi in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Quon Tok picked fights for a living .

title: Quorl Vemmil
description: Quorl Vemmil Quorl Vemmil was the first Tessarch on the Council of Six , the ruling council of Amn , and Lord of House Vemmil . He was cruel man who used his family business of alchemy , wine , and ale supply to conceal an underground trade in narcotic s to the south and east . Quorl died in 1345 DR after he plotted to frame the Meisarch Thayze Selemchant by unleashing a plague in Keczulla .

title: Quorlinn
description: Quorlinn Quorlinn ( also spelled Quorlin ) was a lesser deity who was the god of the kenku race . History . A number of obscure myths told of the creation of Quorlinn and the kenku .

title: Qurth Forest
description: Qurth Forest The Qurth Forest was located along the southern coast of the Lake of Steam and just west of the city of Derlusk . Various towns and ruins bordered the forest with the Barony of the Great Oak on the southwest side . The River Scelptar flowed southwest from its source in the Qurth Forest into the Inner Sea .

title: Quth - maren
description: Quth - maren Quth - maren were undead creatures created from flayed corpses by cleric s of Kiaransalee . Description . With every scrap of skin flayed from their bodies and their exposed muscles incessantly oozing acidic blood , the quth - maren were hideous creatures .

title: Quthnorak
description: Quthnorak Quthnorak was a male mind flayer sorcerer who laired in Vournoth ' s Mire . Personality . Contemplative and inquisitive , especially concerning the Weave , Quthnorak was willing to collaborate with even non - illithids when it came to arcane matters .

title: Quwen
description: Quwen Lord Quwen was the ruler of Ormath in the Shining Plains in 1370 DR . Activities . Quwen often led the city ' s patrols outside the walls of the city in order to clear the road of bandits .

title: Quysszt
description: Quysszt Quysszt was a Zhentarim beholder . Activities . Usually Quysszt floated in the Zhentarim ' s headquarters , protected by an " invisibility " spell , spying upon the councilors under orders of Manshoon .

title: Qwo
description: Qwo Qwo was an old servant in Shou Lung . History . Qwo was the old family servant of Lady Wu , the wife of General Batu Min Ho .

title: Qysari Rings
description: Qysari Rings Qysari Rings was the title given to the various magical rings made especially for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . The name comes from " qysar " , an ancient term for " emperor " that Amahl Shoon III , the first in a long line of imperial rulers , adopted for his title . The rings were a subset of the " shoonring s " , a more general term for magic rings made in the Shoon Imperium during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) , which had unique and distinguishing elements in their construction and enchantment .

title: Qysarus Secretus
description: Qysarus Secretus Qysarus Secretus was one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made for the the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It protected the wearer from all forms of magical and psionic detection and scrying . Description .

title: Qyxas
description: Qyxas Qyxas was a rogue vampiric ixitxachitl . . History .

title: Qyzal
description: Qyzal Qyzal was a rare female morkoth fighter member of the Arcanium of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR . Personality . Qyzal was a good strategist but her habit of toying with her victims often caused delays or worse effects .

title: R . A . Salvatore
description: R . A . Salvatore Born in 1959 , Robert Anthony Salvatore was born in Massachusetts and resides there with his wife Diane , and their three children , Bryan , Geno , and Caitlin .

title: Ra ' id bint Kawthar
description: Ra ' id bint Kawthar Ra ' id bint Kawthar was a sea elf living in Chaos Bay near Hawa in 1367 DR . Personality . Ra ' id was friendly and highly intelligent .

title: Ra ' koo
description: Ra ' koo Ra ' koo was a village in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It lay north of the city of Koje . Folk there discovered and disturbed a burial site of the ancient Han people , and brought a curse upon themselves .

title: Ra - Khati
description: Ra - Khati Ra - Khati was a country of the Hordelands . The country was found deep in the heart of Katakoro Shan . History .

title: Ra - Khati language
description: Ra - Khati language Ra - Khati , or Ra - Khatian , was the language spoken by the people of Ra - Khati in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group , being related to the Kao te Shou and Khazari language s . The languages were mutually intelligible , similar enough for a speaker of one to understand the other , yet different enough to count as separate languages .

title: Raanaghaun Cormrael
description: Raanaghaun Cormrael Raanaghaun Cormrael ( named for a famous Netherese priest of Shar ) was a Dark Diviner of Windsong Tower . After the theft of the " Leaves of One Night " , he left the tower and returned to the Fane of Shadows to attempt to rewrite portions of the Dark Diviners ' stolen tome . He never returned .

title: Raash
description: Raash Raash was a sage in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was in zoology and ecology and he was considered by most the best expert on dragon s outside Elminster Aumar . Raash had two sages that worked under him .

title: Raashub
description: Raashub Raashub was an uridezu and captain of a ship of chaos . History . Raashub was the captain of a ship of chaos that crashed into the Lake of Shadows in the Underdark and was trapped in time in a whirlwind .

title: Rababah
description: Rababah A rababah ( rah - BAH - bah ) was a strange stringed Zakharan instrument . Description . The " rababah " was a single - stringed instrument that consisted of a rectangular soundbox from which rose a thin neck .

title: Rababah of the dao
description: Rababah of the dao The rababah of the dao was a wondrous musical instrument created by dao craftsmen for the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " rababah of the dao " in existence throughout Zakhara . Description .

title: Rabbit
description: Rabbit Rabbits were common animals throughout the Realms . It was not uncommon to find them cooked and served in taverns and the like , such as at the Elfstone Tavern in Waterdeep . Species .

title: Race
description: Race The Race was a small tract of water located off the southern edge of the Tethyr Peninsula in West Faerûn . Geography . The sea was named for the frequent sight of ships fleeing the pirate bands that prowled Asavir ' s Channel .

title: Radatha
description: Radatha Radatha was the leader of the Fire Knives cell in Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . Radatha led a group of Fire Knives that escaped to Tilverton .

title: Radborne Wynn
description: Radborne Wynn Radborne Wynn was earl of the Storming Gorge in Hartsvale in the late 14 century DR . Description . Rayborne Wynn was a stout man who bore himself impressively yet had a wild look .

title: Radecere Perethun
description: Radecere Perethun Radecere Perethun was a traveler on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Radecere was usually a loner , but he never refused the opportunity to gamble in a good game , and he was quite good at it .

title: Radiant Heart Auxiliary
description: Radiant Heart Auxiliary The Radiant Heart Auxiliary is the junior wing of the Order of the Radiant Heart , and comprises of knights who are not yet old enough or highly regarded enough to gain membership to the senior branch of the Order . Most of the Paladins of the Radiant Heart Auxiliary pledge themselves to goodly deities ; followers of Torm and Helm are particularly common among their ranks . The Auxiliary branch of the Order ' s motto is : " A loyal heart and a faithful spirit .

title: Radiant fog
description: Radiant fog Radiant fog is a conjuration spell that summons a fog of celestial light . Effect . This spell works like " solid fog " , but the cloud of fog shimmers with brilliant celestial radiance .

title: Radiant shield
description: Radiant shield Radiant shield is an evocation spell that shocks attackers and protects against electricity . Effect . A scintillating aura of white radiance wreathes you and causes damage to each creature that attacks you in melee .

title: Radoc
description: Radoc Radoc , also known as " The One " and Doc , was a powerful archmage dwelling in the Star Mounts in the High Forest around 1358 DR . The mysterious charismatic figure known as Radoc gave the appearance of a peaceful yet powerful healer , seldom seen traveling yet known to give aid to those in need , such as to the folk of Loudwater . What wasn ' t known was that Radoc was had been exiled from another Prime Material Plane .

title: Radom
description: Radom Radom was the last member of the dukar Order of Jhimari in Myth Nantar in 1370 DR . History . Radom was a ancient Jhimari dukar at time of the fall of Nantarum in - 220 DR ; somehow he ended as a coral statue inside the city ' s Coliseum .

title: Radu Malveen
description: Radu Malveen Radu Malveen was a fighter in Selgaunt . Relationships . Radu was a member of the Malveen house .

title: Raedlar Belorgan
description: Raedlar Belorgan Raedlar Belorgan was one of five young men who attempted to assassinate Princess Tanalasta during the Abraxus affair in 1369 DR . He was killed in the attempt . Raedlar was rumored to be a titled Baron of Forgemarket ( a market crossroads in the Wyvernshores countryside ) .

title: Raedra Obarskyr
description: Raedra Obarskyr Raedra Obarskyr was the daughter of Irvel Obarskyr and the granddaughter of King Foril I of Cormyr . In 1486 DR , she served as regent for her wounded brother Baerovus and aided him after his recovery and coronation . During the siege of Suzail , she killed a large wyvern disguised as Thauglorimorgorus and fought the army of Thultanthar .

title: Raegar Stoneblade
description: Raegar Stoneblade Raegar Stoneblade was a rogue . Appearance . Raegar was trim and muscular with a tattoo on his left shoulder .

title: Raelaryn Xorlarrin
description: Raelaryn Xorlarrin Raelaryn Xorlarrin was an elder of the Council of Spiders . He sought to gain the support of a high - ranking wizard in Menzoberranzan and believed that Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre would soon back the Council . History .

title: Raelis Shai
description: Raelis Shai Raelis Shai was a tiefling wizard who was the leader of an actor ' s troupe based in Sigil that performed in Athkatla , Amn , for a time . History . When Raelis found that one of her actors , Haer ' Dalis , had vanished she enlisted the help of Gorion ' s Ward to find him .

title: Raella Hiess
description: Raella Hiess Raella Hiess was a female human wizard living in Skullport in the 1360s and 1370s DR . She was the true proprietor of The Deepfires inn and collected information for the Lords of Waterdeep . Activities .

title: Raerboth Obarskyr
description: Raerboth Obarskyr Raerboth Obarskyr was a king of Cormyr . He was the only legitimate son of King Ulbaeram Obarskyr . Like so many of his kin , he was killed by his aunt Gorauna .

title: Raerdrimne
description: Raerdrimne House Raerdrimne is a sun elf house known for producing fine ceramics , jewelry , paintings and statues . Only twenty of its members made it to Evermeet during the Retreat . As of 1368 DR , no children have been born to members of the house in centuries .

title: Raerlin
description: Raerlin Raerlin was a Calishite human and briefly , apprentice to Elminster , until he stole a key to a container of old spellbooks in Elminster ' s tower . Later , he became a lich , but Elminster assumed that he had been eaten by a dragon . Background .

title: Rafi al Shuree
description: Rafi al Shuree Rafi al Shuree was the Grand Yrshelem of Caravans of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Rafi was the daughter of a merchant of Calimshan , but for her not - so - beautiful appearance and her meager dowry she was unable to find a husband .

title: Ragarra
description: Ragarra Ragarra was a Zakhara n goddess who represented the jungle and its violent nature . She wanted to destroy any civilization that wanted to tame the wilderness around it and was therefore considered a savage goddess , " i . e .

title: Rage of Demons
description: Rage of Demons The Rage of Demons was a Dungeons & Dragons storyline that began in September 2015 and runs through March 2016 . The storyline was primarily set on the Sword Coast and in the Moonsea region . Description .

title: Rage of Dragons
description: Rage of Dragons A Rage of Dragons , or Dracorage , was a Realms - wide event that occurred when many dragon s went on a collective , senseless rampage , destroying everything in their path . This periodic madness seemed to be tied to the appearance of the King - Killer Star , and lasted for a tenday . In the event of a localized Rage of Dragons , the more common label was a " Flight of Dragons .

title: Ragged Dain
description: Ragged Dain Ragged Dain was the Captain of the Guard in Citadel Felbarr in 1479 DR . History . He was a friend of his colleague , Reginald Roundshield Sr .

title: Raggnar Redtooth
description: Raggnar Redtooth Raggnar Redtooth was a tavern owner in the Cult of the Dragon – controlled village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains . History . Raggnar managed the tavern the Golden Tankard in Parnast .

title: Ragheb
description: Ragheb Ragheb was an oasis town located in the southern region of Raurin desert . In the late 15th century DR the town was ruled by the tiefling Alzubra . Description .

title: Raging Bull
description: Raging Bull The " Raging Bull " was a name given to a captive minotaur in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport in Undermountain , held in a cage suspended from the cavern ceiling , high above the street just outside the doors of The Deepfires inn . History . Sometime in the 1340s DR , an unknown slaver imprisoned the minotaur in the almost unbreakable cage and abandoned him there .

title: Ragnor
description: Ragnor Ragnor was an ogrillon fighter and one of the three leaders of the military contingent of Castle Trinity . History . Ragnor , with the support of the wizard Dorigen Kel Lamond , guided the Trinity ' s invasion of Shilmista , causing great damage to the elves there .

title: Ragnor ( tribe )
description: Ragnor ( tribe ) The Ragnor were a dangerous tribe of Nar found in eastern Narfell . There were 1 , 900 Ragnor in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Rah Kigi Lo
description: Rah Kigi Lo Rah Kigi Lo was the secret concubine of the emperor of T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Rah Kigi Lo lived in Y ' cho Kang , the T ' u Lung royal summer house .

title: Rahalat
description: Rahalat Rahalat was a Place Spirit who was once a Bedine sorceress in Anauroch . Description . When Rahalat manifested herself , she appeared as a silent , transparent , and floating veiled woman , young and strong but with a heartbroken look on her face .

title: Rahimat el Taisar
description: Rahimat el Taisar Rahimat yn Fahd el Taisar yi Almraiven was a Calishite tailor and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Rahimat was a tailor and a silk merchant in Almraiven .

title: Rahishu
description: Rahishu Rahishu was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Rahishu was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Rahmah al - Zahir
description: Rahmah al - Zahir Sitt Rahmah al - Zahir was the Grand Caliph ' s favorite maternal aunt in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Rahmah was a member of the Magical Legion but spent too much time in politics to fully develop her power .

title: Rahmani
description: Rahmani A rahmani was a Zakharan captain ' s book of naval charts . Uses . Nearly as priceless as a daftar , this notebook contained maps , ocean charts , and landmarks useful for sailing the seas surrounding the Land of Fate .

title: Rahvin
description: Rahvin Rahvin was an assassin of some repute sent by Iron Throne leaders to kill Sarevok Anchev . History . While searching for Sarevok in Baldur ' s Gate ' s Undercity , Rahvin met Gorion ' s Ward and tried to kill him for the bounty on his head .

title: Rai - guy Bondalek
description: Rai - guy Bondalek Rai - guy ( in earlier publications spelled Rai ' gy ) was a drow high priest of Lolth and a wizard . He was a lieutenant of Bregan D ' aerthe . History .

title: Raiann
description: Raiann Raiann was a dragonborn member of the Platinum Cadre . History . Before she joined the Platinum Cadre , Raiann was a glassblower .

title: Raidon Kane
description: Raidon Kane Raidon Kane was a half - star elf , half - Shou monk and Keeper of the Cerulean Sign . He is one of the main characters in the " Stardeep " novel and the " Abolethic Sovereignty " series . History .

title: Rain of blood
description: Rain of blood Rain of blood was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was favored by the Red Eyes sorcerous society . Effects .

title: Rainbow Falls
description: Rainbow Falls The Rainbow Falls were located in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . The mighty chasm of the Rainbow Falls was located where the Akundi River plummeted over a thousand feet into the Gogrus River within the Katakoro Shan mountains .

title: Rainbow Gorge
description: Rainbow Gorge Rainbow Gorge was a cleft in the Rauvin Mountains that was generally believed to be the beginning of the River Rauvin . It made up the southern exit from Dead Orc Pass . Geography .

title: Rainbow Monastery
description: Rainbow Monastery The Rainbow Monastery was located next to the Rainbow Falls in the Katakoro Shan mountain range in Ra - Khati . Description . Six colored structures spread along the Rainbow Trail comprised the Rainbow Monastery .

title: Rainbow Trail
description: Rainbow Trail The Rainbow Trail was located in Ra - Khati . Geopgraphy . The trail was found at the junction of the Gogrus and Akundi rivers met at the Rainbow Falls .

title: Rainbow obsidian
description: Rainbow obsidian Rainbow obsidian was an obsidian variety with bands of color . It could be used just like black obsidian to make arrowheads and weapons . Description .

title: Raindrop
description: Raindrop Raindrop is the name given to the purest form of , specifically to flawless , colorless crystals or colorless areas inside larger , dark brown cassiterite crystals . Description . These stones , in their most prized form , were clear , hard , and durable , suitable for small faceted gems or they took a velvety smooth polish .

title: Raise dead
description: Raise dead Raise dead was a conjuration or necromancy spell that restored life to one dead creature . Earlier versions of this spell were reversible , resulting in the spell " slay living " which was very similar to the newer " finger of death " spell . Effects .

title: Rakshasa
description: Rakshasa Rakshasas were a type of evil outsider from the lawful evil regions of the Outer Planes , though most lived on the Material Plane . They were powerful sorcerer s and , although they disdained physical fighting as ignoble , could be dangerous in close combat as well . Description .

title: Ralan el Pesarkhal
description: Ralan el Pesarkhal Ralan el Pesarkhal is syl - pasha ( ruler ) of Calimshan . He appears as a dark - haired , lean and imposing figure that seems younger than his years , with only a small patches of grey along the temples as any indication that he is anywhere close to being more than sixty years old . Personality .

title: Ralayan
description: Ralayan Ralayan , also known as Ralayn the Occultacle , was an alhoon member of the Twisted Rune . Relationships . The alhoon was the right - hand man of Priamon " Frostrune " Rakesk and helped his master in his plots in order to attain for himself the place of Runemaster .

title: Rallio deVore
description: Rallio deVore Rallio deVore was a tiefling in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . History . Rallio entered into an infernal pact but regretting the decision he went to Spellgard in search of Lady Saharel ' s counsel in 1478 DR .

title: Rallogar Hardware
description: Rallogar Hardware Rallogar Hardware , or Rallogar ' s Hardware , was a hardware store located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Zendaros Rallogar . Location .

title: Ralma Damond
description: Ralma Damond Ralma Damond was a former member of the Company of Eight in Tethyr in 1358 DR . History . Ralma was one of the original members of the Company in 1344 DR .

title: Ramael ' s cyclical light
description: Ramael ' s cyclical light Ramael ' s cyclical light was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell was similar to the " continual light " spell , but it faded and glowed with exterior light .

title: Ramael the Reader
description: Ramael the Reader Ramael the Reader was a native from Halruaa who lived in the Dalelands in 1367 DR . Description . One of Ramael eyes was lost during his escape from Halruaa .

title: Ramas al - Rashid
description: Ramas al - Rashid Ramas al - Rashid was a holy slayer who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Ramas and his brothers were members of a merchant house in Liham .

title: Ramenos
description: Ramenos Ramenos is the bullywug deity of somnolence , intoxication , and decay . He is said to be sleeping deep within the Abyss where demons feed sacrifices into his gaping maw . Ramenos is completely uninterested in its worshippers and priests , and is concerned only with feeding and sleep .

title: Raml al - Nau
description: Raml al - Nau Raml al - Nau , also known as the Sandstorm , was an elite group of jann soldiers in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Organization . Raml al - Nau served as an army under the direct command of the Grand Caliph .

title: Ramman
description: Ramman Ramman was an ancient Untheric war deity . History . Ramman led Unther to its first victories as a strong and fair champion .

title: Rammaq
description: Rammaq Rammaq was an ancient titan , originally living during the Age of Giants , hence his large size as a demilich . History . He had been an undead mage for a very long time , and repeatedly sought to become a demigod , to no avail .

title: Ramos
description: Ramos Ramos was the paramount of the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain in 1366 DR . Description . Ramos had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .

title: Rampage Stunk
description: Rampage Stunk Rampage Stunk was a wealthy Waterdavian merchant with a bad reputation . Most of his hirelings were thugs and he even employed a werewolf in his service . Stunk made much of his money by lending to old noblemen and then foreclosing on their mansions when they couldn ' t repay him .

title: Ramparts of Dambrath
description: Ramparts of Dambrath The Ramparts of Dambrath were a series of fortified locations along the sharp cliffs of the Hethar Peninsula in southern Dambrath . Description . The Ramparts had two prominent strips .

title: Ramtharage Druin
description: Ramtharage Druin Ramtharage Druin was a priest of Eldath in the Misty Forest in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , just after the start of the Time of Troubles , Ramthar had imprisoned a group of ranger s of Mielikki , accusing them of desecrating the shrine to Eldath .

title: Ranauroch
description: Ranauroch Ranauroch was a site mentioned in the " Saga of the Dragon Queller " , a giant ballad . In it , the giant hero Hjurgen was known as the " leveler of Ranauroch " . Ranauroch was believed to be a prehistoric kingdom or citadel but no evidence of its existence was found .

title: Randal Morn
description: Randal Morn Randal Morn was the rightful heir of Daggerdale and had ruled as its Lord since 1369 DR when he reclaimed it from Zhentarim control . As the last surviving member of the Morn family , he lived in exile as a vigilante for over thirty years before his return . Description .

title: Randal Sweetgrove
description: Randal Sweetgrove Randal Sweetgrove was the leader of Amaunator ' s faith in Westgate during the Second Sundering . History . Randal led the temple to Amaunator in the city .

title: Randalla Brasshorn
description: Randalla Brasshorn Randalla Brasshorn was a merchant of Baldur ' s Gate who served the Harpers in the mid – 14th century DR . She temporarily became a lieutenant of Xanhast , the general of Mordoc SeLanmere , during the time of Mordoc ' s Gate . History .

title: Randers
description: Randers Randers was a mighty human paladin . Description . Randers was a tan , brown - haired man with narrow features and a prominent forehead .

title: Randil Moorwatch
description: Randil Moorwatch Randil Moorwatch was a mercenary in the 1370s DR . History . In 1374 DR , Randil and his Blue Griffon Company were hired by the Sembia n lord Borstag Duncastle to participate in the Cormanthor War .

title: Randolph dul Umast
description: Randolph dul Umast Randolph dul Umast was a Human male priest of Tymora , and the high priest at The Lady ' s Favor temple in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . When the temple of The Lady ' s Favor was built in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , Randolph dul Umast was appointed its first high priest by his superiors at the Lady ' s Happy Hall in Procampur .

title: Random Riellor
description: Random Riellor Random Riellor , or Random the Mad , was a necromancer who wandered the entire breadth of Faerûn . Personality . Brilliant and capable , Random was an accomplished spellcaster whose personality seemed to vary on a daily basis .

title: Random action
description: Random action Random action is an enchantment spell that causes one creature to act randomly for one round . Effect . The enchanted creature is compelled to act randomly for 1 round .

title: Randulaith
description: Randulaith Randulaith was an Illuskan human male wizard and a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Description . Randulaith favored plain clothes of tunic and breeches , but was elegant in dress .

title: Raneger
description: Raneger Raneger was a watersoul genasi crime lord whose base of operations was the Den of Games in Airspur . He was widely considered to be the most powerful criminal in the city . He was grossly obese and spent most of his time soaking his bulk in a pool .

title: Range of the Marching Camels
description: Range of the Marching Camels The Range of the Marching Camels in west Zakhara separated the High Desert in the north from the Pearl Cities region to the south . Geography . The Range of the Marching Camels ran east to west for hundreds of miles , stretching from Tajar and the Golden Gulf all the way to Akota on the coast of the Great Sea .

title: Ranger
description: Ranger Rangers were warriors who excelled at exploring the fringes of civilization and hunting down deadly monsters . Hunters , scouts , trappers , and assassins , rangers could be found wherever civilization bordered the wilderness . To aid them in their outback treks , rangers were trained in a number of combat techniques , survival skills , and even magic .

title: Rangewatchers
description: Rangewatchers The Rangewatchers were an adventuring company . History . In 1335 DR , the Rangewatchers battled a red dragon that was marauding against villages in the area .

title: Rangrim
description: Rangrim Rangrim was a paladin of Ilmater and a member of the Council of Lords of Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , following the suggestion of the avariel Taegan Nightwind , Queen Sambryl agreed to send a small contingent to the Gray Forest to destroy a Cult of the Dragon hideout .

title: Ranna Keeneyes
description: Ranna Keeneyes Countess - Consort Ranna Keeneyes was the wife of Count Oxsal Keeneyes of Monteshi , Tethyr . She was a tiny halfling lady with great practical sense . As her husband spent most of his time in defense of Tethyr at Fort Teqlar , she was given his responsibilities of guild chancellorship .

title: Rannek
description: Rannek Rannek was a human fighter from Nesmé who was a member of the Riders of Nesmé . History . Rannek was the only survivor left in the ruins of the town when it was destroyed by Proffit and his band of troll s .

title: Rannigan
description: Rannigan Rannigar was an investigator in Neverwinter in 1480 DR . He recruit tiefling adventurers to do in the Blacklake District some missions to contrast the Ashmadai . Appendix .

title: Ranseur
description: Ranseur A ranseur is a two - handed , martial melee reach weapon in the pole arm family . Description . Using Gary Gygax ' s classification system described in pole arm s , a ranseur is a specialized spear with some added capabilities .

title: Ranthor
description: Ranthor Ranthor was a human wizard and master of Shal Bal who lived in Cormyr . Description . Being a wizard , Ranthor liked to dress in fine clothes and keep his appearance in good order ; many of his robes were blue , which was his signature color .

title: Rantoon Gwa
description: Rantoon Gwa Rantoon Gwa was a ninja and pirate active in Koryo around 1357 DR . He was an infamous murderer who served as second - in - command of notorious pirate Crow Dz Pong , commanding a Koryoan warship . Both were based out of a secret fortress south of Mo ' ki Bay .

title: Rapid reflexive response
description: Rapid reflexive response Rapid reflexive response was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . Ramael the Reader created this spell , but many Halruaan s credited Mycontil .

title: Rapier
description: Rapier A rapier is a one - handed , martial melee weapon in the sword family . Description . The rapier is a slender , sharply pointed sword often with a complex hilt designed to protect the wielding hand .

title: Raptoran
description: Raptoran Raptorans are a freedom - loving race of humanoid avians . Description . Raptorans are slightly taller than human s with longer arms and legs although they tend to be slightly thinner .

title: Rarnok Jadronson
description: Rarnok Jadronson Rarnok Jadronson was a ogre mercenary in the year 1375 DR . Description . Rarnok was a foot taller than normal ogres ; he always had the hilt of his greataxe covered by the teeth of his past victims .

title: Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer
description: Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer Rary ' s mnemonic enhancer was a transmutation spell that was only usable by wizard s and cleric s commanding the spell domain . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as mnemonic enhancer , and counted among the spells of the universal province . It allowed one to prepare extra spells or retain one that was just cast , and was presumably developed by Rary .

title: Rary ' s telepathic bond
description: Rary ' s telepathic bond Rary ' s telepathic bond is a divination spell that forms a telepathic link to let allies communicate . It was presumably developed by Rary . Effect .

title: Raryn Snowstealer
description: Raryn Snowstealer Raryn Snowstealer was an arctic dwarf and a companion of Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Raryn lived with his people , the Inugaakalakurit , on the Great Glacier until he decided to go out and see the world .

title: Ras Nsi
description: Ras Nsi Ras ( or " Duke " ) Nsi was one of the seven " bara e " , the Chosen of Ubtao . He was infamous for seeking bloody and violent revenge against the Eshowe tribe of Chult and for the creation of the majority of the undead that roam that land . Description .

title: Rasaad yn Bashir
description: Rasaad yn Bashir Rasaad yn Bashir was a Calishite monk who wandered the Sword Coast in search of enlightenment after a disastrous mission to a monastery in Athkatla . History . As children , the orphaned brothers Rasaad and Gamaz survived in Calimport by begging and stealing .

title: Rashad al - Klemari
description: Rashad al - Klemari Rashad al - Klemari was an elven merchant who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . He was not a member of the House of Al - Klemari merchant family . Activities .

title: Rashara
description: Rashara Rashara was a cambion servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt exiled Gattash and Rashara for some failures , sending them to the Waydown area .

title: Rasharoo
description: Rasharoo Rasharoo was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . Rasharoo was the leader of the small Circle of Explorers in Neverlight Grove , exploring the Underdark more often than its fellow .

title: Rashemen
description: Rashemen Rashemen was a magocratic in the far northeast Faerûn . Geography . The people of Rashemen are called Rashemi .

title: Rashemi
description: Rashemi The Rashemi are a human ethnic group native to Rashemen . Appearance . Most are short ( about 5 1 / 2 feet tall on average ) and muscular , with a hardy physique .

title: Rashemi dictionary
description: Rashemi dictionary A list of words and terms in the Rashemi language . B . Bannik - spirit of health ; often provides divination in a bathhouse .

title: Rashemi language
description: Rashemi language Rashemi , also known as Rasallesian , was the language of the people of Rashemen . Speakers . In addition to Rashemen , Rashemi was spoken by inhabitants of Altumbel , the Great Dale , the Hordelands , Narfell , the Ride , Thay , Thesk , and the Vast .

title: Rashid al - Niran
description: Rashid al - Niran Rashid al - Niran was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Rashid served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .

title: Rashturiver
description: Rashturiver The Rashturiver was a river in Amn that fed Lake Weng . Geography . This river began in the Cloud Peaks northeast of Lake Weng and due west of Citadel Rashturl .

title: Rasid Nadepa ' an
description: Rasid Nadepa ' an Rasid Nadepa ' an was the crown prince of the kingdom of Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Rasid did not truly care about matters of state .

title: Rasping sand
description: Rasping sand Rasping sand was a deadly magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that tore away at any surface . . Powers .

title: Rassalantar
description: Rassalantar Rassalantar was a hamlet and caravan stop on the Long Road , just north of Waterdeep in the Sword Coast North region . Geography . The small community consisted of six walled farms .

title: Rassalantar ' s Keep
description: Rassalantar ' s Keep Rassalantar ' s Keep was a fortress built by the warrior Rassalantar . Geography . The keep was not far from the Sleeping Dragon , which was east of the hamlet of Rassalantar .

title: Rassendyll Uoumdolphin
description: Rassendyll Uoumdolphin Rassendyll Uoumdolphin was the High Blade of Mulmaster , ruling the city with cunning schemes . Relationships . Rassendyll was the twin brother of Selfaril .

title: Rassiter
description: Rassiter Rassiter was a wererat soldier and the leader of the wererats of Calimport . History . While Artemis Entreri was away searching for Regis , Pasha Pook allied with Rassiter and used him and his men as enforcers .

title: Rastafan Dimetar
description: Rastafan Dimetar Rastafan Dimetar was a courtier of Cormyr in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , news arrived in Suzail that runaway princess Alusair Obarskyr was seen near Tilverton .

title: Rat
description: Rat A rat was a long - tailed rodent , a species of animal . Ecology . Rats thrived in urban environments where they could easily feed off the leftover food and waste of the community .

title: Rat ' s Bastard
description: Rat ' s Bastard For the past month , orc s have been turning up murdered along with messages that read " The only good orc is a . . .

title: Rat Hills
description: Rat Hills The Rat Hills was the name given to a stretch of coastline a short distance to the south of Waterdeep , often used as a dump by the city . History . When Waterdeep was still young , it was a simple , barren pebble beach that was a favorite spot for ships to land for repairs or take on cargoes like lumber , since even a mile out to sea the water wasn ' t any deeper than five feet .

title: Rat Hills Conflagration
description: Rat Hills Conflagration The Rat Hills Conflagration was a large fire in the Rat Hills garbage dump located south of the city of Waterdeep in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR . It was accidentally started by the Confluence in a failed attack against the Unseen . Waterdhavian guard patrols got involved when they spotted what they thought was a group of evil will - o ' - wisp s in the blaze .

title: Rath Modar
description: Rath Modar Rath Modar was a Red Wizard of Thay who had desires to become the next Zulkir of Illusion and even grander plans for himself . Personality . Rath was deceptive and obfuscating .

title: Rathan Thentraver
description: Rathan Thentraver Rathan Thentraver was a human cleric of Tymora and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He appreciated feasting and drinking very much , so he was overweight and suffered from hangovers from time to time , though he did not complain . His trust in his goddess Tymora , the Lady Luck , made him a fearless man who preferred to act instead of thinking it over .

title: Rathene Fel
description: Rathene Fel Rathene Fel was a bandit in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rathene believed that her comrades had abandoned her and for the right price she would betray them .

title: Rathgar the Raider
description: Rathgar the Raider Rathgar the Raider was a man who conquered and seized control of the kingdom of Doegan in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Rathgar the Raider led a band of warriors who overran Doegan and laid siege to the capital .

title: Rathgaunt Mote
description: Rathgaunt Mote Prior to the Spellplague in 1385 DR , Rathguant Mote was part of the Rathgaunt Hills and a gnomish abbey known as the Shield of the Rathgaunt Hills sat on the site . When the Spellplague created the Underchasm , the area surrounding the abbey broke off into a large earthmote . As of 1479 DR the mote was inhabited by only the former gnomish monk s who continued to exist as undead creatures .

title: Rathool ' s Pond
description: Rathool ' s Pond Rathool ' s Pond , also called Rathool ' s Pool , was a body of water located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Geography . A tributary of the Wyvernflow fed Rathool ' s Pond , though it lay within the city itself .

title: Rathrea
description: Rathrea The rathrea were a type of undead dragon from Returned Abeir . Dragonborn called them ghost dragons . Creation .

title: Raudor
description: Raudor Raudor was an ancient Imaskari city in the Hordelands . Description . Built during the Imaskari Empire , Raudor was a city nestled beneath a cliff of the Raurin Alta , in what was once a green vale .

title: Rauglothgor
description: Rauglothgor Rauglothgor was a red dragon who became one of the first dracolich s created by Sammaster . By 1357 DR , the Cult of the Dragon under Symgharyl Maruel provided a new lair for Rauglothgor in a tower belonging to the wizard Garthond , who had often fought the Cult . In a twist of fate , in 1357 DR , Symgharyl Maruel captured a strange girl , Shandril Shessair , the daughter of Garthond , and entrusted Rauglothgor with her custody .

title: Rauligus Helderstone
description: Rauligus Helderstone Rauligus Helderstone was a noble in Cormyr and lord of the Helderstone noble house . History . Rauligus made an agreement with Lord Traevyn Illance to give him much money and live outside Suzail .

title: Raumathar
description: Raumathar Raumathar was a great eastern empire that once included the lands that became Rashemen and Thay . Its people were known to be powerful battle - wizard s , and their art of fighting is still known by some . History .

title: Raumkreml
description: Raumkreml Raumkreml , also called Chern - kreml or the Black Citadel , was a tower located in the city of Almorel within the Hordelands . Location . Ruamkreml was located in the center of Almorel .

title: Raumtheran languages
description: Raumtheran languages The Raumtheran language group was a small branch of the Faerûnian languages family that included languages spoken in northeastern regions of Faerûn , such as Rashemen . Languages . The following languages were considered Raumtheran languages : Appendix .

title: Raumvira
description: Raumvira Raumvira was a language in the Imaskari languages group that was one of the predecessors to the Rashemi language of Rashemen . Description . Raumvira had round and broad vowel sounds .

title: Raumviran
description: Raumviran The Raumvirans were remnants of the people of the ancient empire of Raumathar . The Rashemi and Damaran ethnic groups descended from the Raumvirans . Description .

title: Rauntil Balarr
description: Rauntil Balarr Rauntil Balarr was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities . Rauntil was a kitchen drudge that carried water , stirred pots , turned spits , cut firewood , stoked fires , and cleaned and cut mounds of vegetables for his two old dwarven bosses , Bezoldur Thornhand and Thaunder Gallowglaive .

title: Rauragh
description: Rauragh Rauragh was an orc chieftain who , in 940 DR , attempted to lead his orc horde out of the Sword Mountains through the tunnels in the Underdark in an attempt to attack Waterdeep . His plot was uncovered by the gold dragon Palarandusk , who then prevented the invasion .

title: Rauric languages
description: Rauric languages The Rauric languages were a family of languages with an origin in the Old Empires and Zakhara . Language Groups . Scholars divided the family into two major branches , the Mulani and Untheric languages .

title: Raurin
description: Raurin Raurin , known as the Dust Desert and the Desert of Desolation , was once the center of the ancient empire of Imaskar , but it was transformed into a wasteland in - 2488 DR by the battles between the Imaskari and the avatar s of the Mulhorandi pantheon and Untheric pantheon . After the fall of Imaskar , the ancient city of Solon sought to carve itself a new empire from the desert wastes . It succeeded for a time , gaining control of most of the land south of the Raurin Alta .

title: Raurlor
description: Raurlor Raurlor was a human and became War Lord of Waterdeep in 1026 DR . He was previously the leader of the city ' s army . He aimed to use Waterdeep ' s wealth and power to create an empire in Northwest Faerûn .

title: Raurokhymdhar
description: Raurokhymdhar Raurokhymdhar , also known as The Golden , was the gold dragon ruler of the fortress - prison of Raurokh , located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Raurokhymdhar was the ruler of Raurokh , an ancient dragonborn prison .

title: Rauvin Vale
description: Rauvin Vale The Rauvin Vale was a valley dominated by the River Rauvin in Luruar . Geography . The Rauvin Vale was bordered by the Nether Mountains to the north , the High Forest ( Turlang ' s Wood ) to the south , Everlund Pass and the Silverwood to the west , and Moon Pass to the east .

title: Rauvincross
description: Rauvincross Rauvincross was a village standing at the northern entrance of the Moon Pass through the Nether Mountains just south of Sundabar . Geography . The community rested along the trail between Everlund and Sundabar which crossed the River Rauvin .

title: Rauvinheart caverns
description: Rauvinheart caverns The Rauvinheart caverns were an immense system of caverns and tunnels underneath the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . The Rauvinheart caverns were located underneath Dead Orc Pass and the mountains on either side of the pass .

title: Ravager
description: Ravager Ravagers are the pinnacles of battlerager training , savage warriors who fight with a rage and sense of bloodlust more typical of barbarian s . Stories are told of the terrifying fury unleashed by ravagers , who are said to chew on their shield ' s rim or weapon just to diffuse the excess rage caused by a battle too long delayed . Ravagers charge into combat with little care for their safety , leaving a trail of bloodshed and gore in their wake .

title: Ravager ( ship )
description: Ravager ( ship ) The Ravager was the caravel of the pirate Gonchklas . By 1372 DR , it was a wallowing wreck with tattered sails , and one of the most feared ghost ship s on the Sword Coast . The crew of zombie s and skeleton s attacked other ships on sight .

title: Ravel Xorlarrin
description: Ravel Xorlarrin Ravel Xorlarrin was a wizard of House Xorlarrin of Menzoberranzan and leader of the Xorlarrin expedition to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . He and Tiago Baenre were considered the most promising of Menzoberranzan ' s young males . Description .

title: Raven
description: Raven Ravens are black birds similar to crow s . They are opportunistic eaters , feeding on carrion , insects , grains , fruits , and small animals . These birds thrive in most northern climates and are very long - lived , making them ideal pets and companions .

title: Raven ' s Rack
description: Raven ' s Rack Raven ' s Rack was a shrine dedicated to Ilmater the Crying God , situated atop Tanarspear Hill , west of Hlondeth in the Vilhon Reach , and quite isolated . " Circa " 1342 DR , a young underpriest from the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum named Kortolt Rushtyn found the " Tome of Torment " , the most holy book of the faith of Ilmater . Kortolt took the " Tome " to Raven ' s Rack and used it to aid both believers and non - believers , and to preach about Ilmater .

title: Ravenar
description: Ravenar Ravenar , also called , was a variety of tourmaline mainly in demand in the North , and less so in other lands . Description . Ravenar occurred in long crystals like other varieties of tourmaline and was a solid gloss black .

title: Ravenloft
description: Ravenloft Ravenloft was a campaign setting released by TSR , Inc . It was a Gothic horror setting that took place in an extradimensional space known as the Demiplane of Dread . Ravenloft was linked to the Forgotten Realms by way of the Ethereal Plane , and several crossovers between the two settings have officially been noted .

title: Ravens Bluff
description: Ravens Bluff Ravens Bluff was a port city and home to many heroes and adventurers . It was built on a bluff , on the mouth of the Fire River , and the ruins of dwarven city Sarbreen lie directly underneath the city streets . This might have been a major reason why so many adventurers chose to come to Ravens Bluff , and there were routine expeditions into Sarbreen .

title: Ravia
description: Ravia Ravia was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Fire in the Moonsea . Personality . Ravia was a cruel and pernicious individual , and believed that she couldn ' t be stopped .

title: Ravilar ' s Cloak
description: Ravilar ' s Cloak Ravilar ' s Cloak , also known as The Cloak , was a mining town within the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The settlement was located in the foothills of the Orsraun Mountains in Turmish .

title: Ravos Calantar
description: Ravos Calantar Ravos Calantar was a member of the Calantar family , a noble house of Cormyr . History . Following the execution of his aunt and matriarch of his family , Lady Calantar , Ravos came to hate the Obarskyr s with a passion .

title: Ravvas Thurrpurtyn
description: Ravvas Thurrpurtyn During the late 1350 ' s DR , Ravvas Thurrpurtyn was the owner of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . Personality . Ravvas was a snobbish young son of a wealthy family who felt he was privileged over others .

title: Rawun
description: Rawun Rawuns ( formal plural rawunin ) were the bard s and storytellers of the desert in Zakhara . They used epic poems to spread the legends of their tribe . Rawunin sometimes grouped together to form a " takht " , allowing for a greater range of detailed performances .

title: Ray Muzyka
description: Ray Muzyka Ray Muzyka is one of the founders of BioWare . He left the company in 2012 after almost 20 years of working in the video game industry . Education .

title: Ray of enfeeblement
description: Ray of enfeeblement Ray of enfeeblement was a necromantic spell learned by some inexperienced wizard s , particularly those curious as to the power of necromancy and shadow magic . When " ray of enfeeblement " was cast , a stream of green mist sprayed from the wizard ' s curled finger or implement towards a creature within fifty feet , sapping away their strength in a direct attack upon the creature ' s soul . The spell drained the mental faculties of a wizard somewhat and the wizard required a short rest before they could cast the spell again .

title: Ray of frost
description: Ray of frost Ray of frost is a spell cast by wizard s , formerly a cantrip cast by both wizards and sorcerer s , that is filled with cold energy . When cast , the spell conjure s a frigid blast of cold , freezing white or blue air which then streaks towards its intended target , over a distance of no more than fifty feet , slowing their movements down for a brief moment . A " ray of frost " is more powerful if its caster is of an archmage ' s equivalent in arcane skill , dealing twice as much damage .

title: Rayad al - Farif
description: Rayad al - Farif Rayad al - Farif was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Rayad owned a small shop called " Appointments with the Mighty " where he claimed to be able to arrange meetings between his customers and various elite members of Huzuz ' s society , including the leaders of the great mosques and even the Grand Caliph .

title: Rayanna
description: Rayanna Rayanna the Rose was the leader of the Red Ravens in 1374 DR . History . Rayanna led an adventuring party that was composed of one hundred members .

title: Raymond Swanland
description: Raymond Swanland Raymond Swanland is a science - fiction and fantasy artist who has illustrated the covers of several Forgotten Realms novels . Career . Swanland began his artistic career as a graphic designer for the video game company and worked on all four of that companies games .

title: Razak Irdi
description: Razak Irdi Razak Irdi was a barbarian nomad in the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . As a member of the Kashghun tribe , Irdi lived in Chegoyui until around 1350 DR when he stole one of the qaghan ' s prized huluk and headed north .

title: Razfallow
description: Razfallow Razfallow was a half - orc assassin from Calimshan . In 1346 DR , he was hired by the evil wizard Cyndre in his attempt to take over the Moonshae Islands after joining the king ' s council of sorcerers . He slew many members of the royal houses and druid s of the Isles .

title: Razim
description: Razim Razim , also called Razim the Incandescent was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Razim served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .

title: Raziz
description: Raziz Raziz was a small village located between the Range of the Marching Camels and the Mountains of Forgotten Dreams in the High Desert region of Zakhara . Description . Raziz was described as being " dropped from a height pelted with refuse , and left to fester in the sun .

title: Razor grass
description: Razor grass Razor grass was a special type of grass that could be found in small scattered areas throughout Pelleor ' s Prairie surrounding the Hill of Lost Souls . As the name implied , razor grass was incredibly sharp , and could easily cut passing animals or unarmored humanoid s . The only distinguishable feature of this grass was that its blades appeared slightly silver compared to regular green grass .

title: Razor of truth
description: Razor of truth The razor of truth was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This blade appeared like a regular razor used by barber s in the bazaar .

title: Re
description: Re Re was the former head of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Re died due to injuries he recieved during the Battle of the Gods by the orc deity Gruumsh during the Orcgate Wars . As Re died he transfered his power to Horus who was from then , known as Horus - Re .

title: Reaching Woods
description: Reaching Woods The Reaching Woods was a large forest in Elturgard . In 1459 DR the High Overseer of Torm , ruler of Elturgard , learned that shrines to unapproved god s existed in the forest and declared that no one could enter or exit the woods . By 1479 DR the gnoll s of the forest had exterminated all other humanoids .

title: Read magic
description: Read magic Read magic was a widespread universal spell that let one read scrolls and spellbooks . Effect . By means of " read magic " , the caster could read magical inscriptions on objects such as books , scrolls , weapons , and the like , that would otherwise be unintelligible .

title: Read southern magic
description: Read southern magic Read southern magic was a divination spell that allowed wizards to read spells written in the Thoth mage - script of southern magic . Two versions of this spell existed : The one had been employed by arcane spellcasters in the Old Empires of Mulhorand , Unther and Chessenta as essential to practice their separate system of magic introduced after the secession of Thay ( though some of them also knew the northern counter - part , " read magic " , giving access to spells from outside their domain ) . The second and much younger version was a rare spell created by Random Riellor from Halruaa around 1347 DR and allowed wizards from outside the closed ranks of southern magicians to read their encoded arcane writings .

title: Readers
description: Readers The Readers were a religious organization in Zakhara whose members followed the teachings of Zann , the Zakharan god of learning and intelligence . The Readers did not have a favored weapon or symbol . Activities .

title: Reading Room
description: Reading Room The Reading Room was a fortified temple of Deneir in the Earthfast Mountains between Impiltur and the Vast in north Faerûn . It was located far to the south of the main temple of the Master ' s Library on Iron Dragon Mountain . Activities .

title: Realms Master
description: Realms Master The Realms Master was a caravel piloted by the Halruaan wizard , Dwalimar Omen . The ship had the standard capabilities of a sea - going vessel , but also had the magical ability of flight and teleportation . The " Realms Master " had as a figurehead the image of Azuth , god of mages and consort of Mystra .

title: Realms of Infamy
description: Realms of Infamy Realms of Infamy , edited by James Lowder , is the second anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . " So High A Price " . By Ed Greenwood " Date : " 1334 DR Summary .

title: Realms of Magic
description: Realms of Magic Realms of Magic , edited by Brian Thomsen and J . Robert King , is the third anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . Contents .

title: Realms of Mystery
description: Realms of Mystery Realms of Mystery , edited by Philip Athans , is the sixth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . An excerpt from The Silent Blade by R . A .

title: Realms of Shadow
description: Realms of Shadow Realms of Shadow , edited by Lizz Baldwin , is the eighth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . The stories follow the Return of the Archwizards trilogy and many are about the lost nation of Netheril . Contents .

title: Realms of Valor
description: Realms of Valor Realms of Valor , edited by James Lowder , was the first anthology of short stories from the " Forgotten Realms " . The Lord of Lowhill . By Douglas Niles Date : before 1365 DR Summary .

title: Realms of War
description: Realms of War Contents . Continuum . By Paul S .

title: Realms of the Arcane
description: Realms of the Arcane Realms of the Arcane , edited by Brian M . Thomsen , is the fifth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . Contents .

title: Realms of the Dead
