description: Realms of the Dead Realms of the Dead is an anthology of short stories from the " Forgotten Realms " , and the last published anthology of original tales to date . It accompanied the " The Haunted Lands " trilogy by Richard Lee Byers , and had stories spanning both sides of the setting - changing Spellplague . Contents .

title: Realms of the Deep
description: Realms of the Deep Realms of the Deep , edited by Philip Athans , is the seventh anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . The stories involve The Threat from the Sea trilogy . Contents .

title: Realms of the Dragons
description: Realms of the Dragons Realms of the Dragons , edited by Philip Athans , is the ninth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . All the short stories relate in some way to the horrific Year of Rogue Dragons . Contents .

title: Realms of the Dragons II
description: Realms of the Dragons II Realms of the Dragons II , edited by Philip Athans , is the tenth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . All the short stories relate in some way to the horrific Year of Rogue Dragons . Contents .

title: Realms of the Elves
description: Realms of the Elves Realms of the Elves , edited by Philip Athans , is the eleventh anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . It serves as an anthology to " The Last Mythal " trilogy . Contents .

title: Realms of the Underdark
description: Realms of the Underdark Realms of the Underdark , edited by J . Robert King , is the fourth anthology of stories from the Forgotten Realms . Contents .

title: Realmspace
description: Realmspace Realmspace was the term used to describe the Torilian system and its surrounding environs . To those on the surface of Toril , Realmspace was called the Sea of Night . Contained within a crystal sphere , Realmspace consisted of wildspace ( empty vacuum ) , a sun , eight planetoids , and their satellites .

title: Reaper ' s stance
description: Reaper ' s stance Reaper ' s stance was an exploit that allowed a fighter to hit all opponents within reach and with an improved chance for critical hits . Effects . Once per day , a fighter who learned this exploit could take the " reaper ' s stance " and hit all adjacent enemies with a melee weapon which caused bleeding wounds that continued to drain their health for as long as the fighter had the opportunity to attack .

title: Reaper ( Ito - Jo )
description: Reaper ( Ito - Jo ) Reaper was a cursed kensai in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . The Reaper was a kensai retainer of the Ito family who died in their castle ' s burning in 647 DR .

title: Reaper ( Neverwinter Nights )
description: Reaper ( Neverwinter Nights ) The Reaper is a pivotal character in " . " His realm is accessible to the player via the Relic of the Reaper , which is described as having come into the player ' s hands while they were in the Plane of Shadow after the fall of Undrentide in the second game . During the first half of the game , he serves the same purpose as the Stone of Recall in the original campaign , drawing the player into his realm if he or she dies and reviving them as long as they have a Rogue Stone .

title: Reaver ( ship )
description: Reaver ( ship ) The Reaver was a feared pirate vessel active in Suq Bay along Dihl al - Suq in 1367 DR . The " Reaver " flew a standard of flying crossed cutlass es . Description .

title: Rebec
description: Rebec A rebec was a string instrument considered a precursor to the violin . Description . Rebecs were favored among peasants and made for very lively music .

title: Rebekkah Darklyte
description: Rebekkah Darklyte Rebekkah Darklyte was a female drow priestess of Eilistraee in Ravens Bluff around 1370 DR . She was the acting high priestess of The Dark Dancer , a controversial and troubled shrine to the goddess in that city . History .

title: Rebrum
description: Rebrum Rebrum was a travelling merchant from Sheirtalar in Lapaliiya . Around 1210 DR , Rebrum wrote the " Life of Rebrum " , a bawdy autobiography that was frequently copied . In it , among other things , Rebrum wrote of the " Aleave " trade - fair in Vaerndoun in the Underdark .

title: Recitation
description: Recitation Recitation was an abjuration / evocation spell that invoked a deity ' s blessing on a battle ; aiding the caster and any allies while hindering any enemies in the area of effect . Effects . This spell was cast by reading out loud a passage or declaration of a sacred text related to the caster ' s religion .

title: Reckoning of Hell
description: Reckoning of Hell The Reckoning of Hell was an event which turned the Nine Hells of Baator into its current state . The archdevils split into two factions . The first was led by Mephistopheles who was followed by Mammon , Dispater and Geryon .

title: Reclaiming Blingdenstone
description: Reclaiming Blingdenstone Reclaiming Blingdenstone was an adventure module included with the second D & D Next playtester packet . Plot Summary . A concerted effort is being made to reclaim the ruins of Blingdenstone for the svirfneblin .

title: Reconnect
description: Reconnect Reconnect was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was a closely guarded secret weapon used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Effects .

title: Reconstruction
description: Reconstruction Reconstruction was an arcane alteration spell that restored a broken object back to its original condition for a short time . Effects . Using this spell , a wizard could touch a piece of a broken object and restore it to the whole object in its original form .

title: Red Brigade
description: Red Brigade The Red Brigade was a mercenary company active in the 1360s DR . History . Cedric Ravajar joined the Red Brigade and after four years of service he rose to lead it as captain , due to his combat ability and charisma .

title: Red Dragon ( Herald )
description: Red Dragon ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn organization , the office of Red Dragon was one of the High Heralds . The sign of this office was a rampant metallic - red dragon with wings unfurled and mouth open with teeth bared . Traditionally , this office was given to a young Herald Pursuivant who was a bit more radical and had fresh ideas for the future .

title: Red Dragon Trading Post
description: Red Dragon Trading Post The Red Dragon Trading Post , also known as the Red Dragon Trading Lodge , was Luskan ' s most successful overland trading company . Location . The post was located in the North Bank of Luskan near the Throat water tower in the Mirabar District .

title: Red Flayers
description: Red Flayers The Red Flayers were a tribe of hobgoblin mercenaries from the High Moor that served the blue dragon Kizilpazar of the Morueme . History . The Red Flayers originally occupied territory on the southern High Moor , until they were recruited as guardians by the blue dragon Kizilpazar of the Morueme clan in 1026 DR .

title: Red Goat
description: Red Goat The Red Goat was a central province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . Save for a relatively small stretch of mountainous terrain on its southern edge , the Red Goat province was completely enclosed by other provinces of the Yikarian Empire , making it relatively secure .

title: Red Knight
description: Red Knight The Red Knight , or the Lady of Strategy , was the Faerûnian deity of strategy and battle tactics and an exarch of Tempus . Her dogma dictated the use of careful tactics in battle to achieve victory , under the belief that sound strategy was the best way to win a battle with the most favorable outcome . Her symbol was a red knight - errant chess piece with stars for eyes .

title: Red Larch
description: Red Larch The town of Red Larch is a waystop on the Long Road seven days north of Waterdeep , and is located at the intersection of three trails . One trail leads to the Bargewright Inn , another to Kheldell , and the third runs into the hills to derelict , monster - infested keeps . The town was named for a stand of red larch trees that were chopped down about the time of the town ' s founding .

title: Red Larch Rambler
description: Red Larch Rambler The Red Larch Rambler was a tavern in the town of Red Larch . Interior . The tavern was a large , well - known , and well - lit tavern .

title: Red Magic
description: Red Magic Red Magic , by Jean Rabe , is the third book of the loosely - related The Harpers series . Summary . Thay is ruled by a council of eight specialized archmages ( Zulkirs ) , one for each school .

title: Red Mazzie
description: Red Mazzie Red Mazzie was the most talented wizard of all Damara in the 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , in order to gain the favor of King Yarin Frostmantle of the Bloodstone Lands , Red Mazzie captured the copper dragon sisters Tazmikella and Ilnezhara .

title: Red Orchid
description: Red Orchid The Red Orchid was a ship sunk in the Sea of Fallen Stars by the exiled eladrin Caelynna . The ship was touched by the Spellplague and made sentient . For over eighty years , she remained in Cealynna ' s domain , unable to move , until Kwan Shang - Li ' s crew found the ship and removed the figurehead and attached it to their own ship .

title: Red Pillar Halls
description: Red Pillar Halls The Red Pillar Halls was an important bureaucratic location in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Red Pillar Halls were found within the Furnace ward of the city . Activities .

title: Red Plumes
description: Red Plumes The Red Plumes is a mercenary army of warrior s that operates directly under the will of First Lord Maalthiir . They enforce his will within the walls of Hillsfar , even going so far as to harass its inhabitants , while regularly extorting them , in order to maintain a fear of his authority . They understand their limits however , never going as far as would warrant complaints or pleas too loud as to be heard by the First Lord .

title: Red Prow
description: Red Prow The Red Prow was a slave ship out of Calimport in Calimshan . It sank under the weight of gold and gem s in its hold , then rose again as a ghost ship . By 1372 DR , it was home to wraith s and " weirder things " that rode people as if they were horse s .

title: Red Ravens
description: Red Ravens The Red Ravens were a Cormyr - based mercenary company formed by several people who fought together in the Horde War s , headquartered in Arabel , and led by Rayanna the Rose . Its symbol was a red raven amulet . It was tasked ( by the crown ) with clearing the Stonelands to the north of Cormyr .

title: Red River
description: Red River The Red River was a tributary of the River Ith in Tethyr . This creek flowed from the Purple Hills to Myratma and was often flanked by lavenders , hence its former name , Lavender Creek . It received its newer name because its waters flowed red with blood from the First Siege of Myratma during the Reclamation Wars .

title: Red Rock
description: Red Rock The Red Rock was a stone and wood inn located in Dagger Falls ran by the half - elven ex - minstrel known as Kessla . Structure . The taproom of the Red Rock was illuminated by magical globes of light rather than candles , curtesy of Kessla ' s magic .

title: Red Rysal
description: Red Rysal The Red Rysal , or Red Captain , was an outlaw in Teshburl , Calimshan , who had acquired legendary status . History . For many decades , the Red Rysal , clad in red leather , had defended the common folk of Teshburl against abuses of power among the rich and corrupt merchants , guildmasters , and government officials .

title: Red Sashes
description: Red Sashes The Red Sashes were a vigilante group that was based in Waterdeep . Organization . The individual cells of the Sashes , one for each ward of the city , each answered to an authority only known as " The One " .

title: Red Sisters
description: Red Sisters The Red Sisters were an elite band of assassin s that the Valsharess formed to help her with her plans for taking over the surface , starting with Waterdeep in the early 1370s DR . The Red Sisters assassinated a lot of important people in Waterdeep who were seen as a threat to the Valsharess . In the end , Mephistopheles , the ruler of Cania , killed the last of the Red Sisters .

title: Red Thunder Mercenary Corps
description: Red Thunder Mercenary Corps The Red Thunder Mercenary Corps was a centaur mercenary company based in the Hordelands . History . The Red Thunder Mercenary Corps was formed by the centaurs from the Chondalwood after they participated in the Battle of Five Crowns in the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .

title: Red Tiger Tribe
description: Red Tiger Tribe The Red Tiger Tribe was an Uthgardt barbarian tribe active in the Silver Marches of Faerûn . Organization . They were more traditional than the other Uthgardt tribes .

title: Red Tower of Dayya
description: Red Tower of Dayya The Red Tower of Dayya was located in the Lost City of Ubar in 1367 DR . Description . The Red Tower rose from the center of the city .

title: Red Wizard
description: Red Wizard Red Wizard is a special prestige class in Thay whose members belong to the Red Wizards of Thay . Would - be Red wizards tend to focus on one school of magic . Very few sorcerer s and bard s decide to become Red wizards ; those that do are considered misfits .

title: Red Wizards of Thay
description: Red Wizards of Thay The Red Wizards , formerly known as the Red Wizards of Thay before a coup led by Szass Tam , are an organization of wizards in Faerûn . During their height of power , the Red Wizards were the notorious and nefarious spellcasting ruling class of the inhospitable but well - inhabited country of Thay . Slavers , demonologists , and magical experimenters , the Red Wizards were much feared by most of Faerûn .

title: Red Worm
description: Red Worm The Red Worm was a half - red dragon half - remorhaz of enormous size who had been chosen to be a guardian of the portal in Choshein . Description . The Red Worm had streaks of red running along his otherwise white body , indicative of his draconic heritage .

title: Red dragon
description: Red dragon Red dragons are covetous , evil creatures , interested only in their own well - being , vanity and the extension of their treasure hoards . They are supremely confident of their own abilities and are prone to making snap decisions without any forethought . The most powerful of the chromatic dragon s , red dragons breathe a cone of fire .

title: Red leafhopper
description: Red leafhopper The red leafhopper was a type of insect found in Faerûn , such as in the rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor . Lyra Sunrose once rode through the rimwood of Cormanthor and found what she thought was an apple tree , but which turned out to be a pine with clusters of red leafhopper larvae hanging from its branches .

title: Red slaad
description: Red slaad Red slaadi were a type of slaad . Description . Red slaadi had long claws .

title: Red tear
description: Red tear Red Tears , also known as Tempus ' weeping or Tempus ' s weeping , were gemstones found only in the Realms in deep mines or anywhere old stone had been exposed by erosion , mining , or rockfall . Description . Red tears were teardrop - shaped crystals with a glossy surface , vividly colored fiery orange , cherry red , or blood crimson .

title: Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping
description: Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping Redbeard Rental Storage and Shipping was a business located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It rented out storage space for cargo and was owned by Lord Sarp Redbeard , ruler of the town . History .

title: Redbrands
description: Redbrands The Redbrands were a group of bandits and brigands that , in approximately 1480 DR , had settled in the resettled frontier town of Phandalin near the Triboar Trail and the Sword Mountains . Activities . With no local lord or powerful authority within the small town , the Redbrands were able to harass the farmers and prospectors for two months .

title: Redcap
description: Redcap Redcaps were evil murderous fey with an insatiable bloodlust . They appeared in the Feywild , or at places where creatures acted on a deep desire for bloodshed . Redcaps needed to kill constantly in order to continue existing .

title: Reddansyr
description: Reddansyr Reddansyr was a small settlement on the road from Westgate to Starmantle . It had a well - earned reputation as an adventurers ' town because it was a good source of information for such people . Oddly enough , the local temple of Oghma was not responsible for this ; they apparently resented the free flow of information at the Giant ' s Folly , the local festhall .

title: Redfang
description: Redfang Redfang the Reaper was the insidious monstrous ruler of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . History . Developing a taste for human flesh , Redfang instituted a reign of terror upon neighboring Vanesci Hamlet .

title: Redfires Inn
description: Redfires Inn Redfires Inn was an inn in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . Redfires Inn was a big place , high quality , and popular with patrons of many different races , though it was costly . It featured room service , and offered boar pie , wine s from all over Calaunt , and pleasure - girls .

title: Redinald Rascalin
description: Redinald Rascalin Redinald Rascalin was a human paladin of Torm and the baron of the city of Suormpar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Relations . Redinald was the grandson of Maelin Rascalin , a notorious bandit turned general and defender of the realm , who was rewarded with the barony .

title: Reduce animal
description: Reduce animal Reduce animal was a transmutation spell used by druid s and ranger s to shrink one animal to half its size . The animal had to acquiesce for the transformation to work . Components .

title: Redwaters
description: Redwaters Redwaters , also known as Dellon - lune , was a lake in the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale , fished for its Knucklehead scrimshaw . History . The lake ' s original name was Dellon - lune , but it was renamed after a fight between rival fishing boats left bloody corpses in the water , hence ' Redwaters .

title: Reef giant
description: Reef giant Reef giants were loners who lived among the tropical reefs that surrounded Zakhara . Description . Reef giants had white hair and coppery skin .

title: Reema Stonefist
description: Reema Stonefist Reema Stonefist was an Order of the Gauntlet fighter in 1489 DR . History . Reema led an adventuring party for the Order of the Gauntlet .

title: Reeve Sar Testain
description: Reeve Sar Testain Reeve Sar Testain was a pirate captain in the Moonsea region around 1429 DR , commanding the ship " Audacity " . History . One day in 1429 DR , he and his crew sacked the merchant ship " Abundant Serendipity " after a fierce fight .

title: Reforged Ring
description: Reforged Ring The Reforged Ring was , as of 1479 DR , a relatively new criminal gang in the town of Skullport . Organization . Members of the gang were initiated with a painful rite that involved branding the ring finger with a set of red - hot tongs .

title: Refuge
description: Refuge Refuge , also known as succor , is a conjuration spell that alters an item to transport its possessor to the caster . Effects . You create powerful magic in some specially prepared object - a statuette , a jeweled rod , a gem , etc .

title: Regbald Stonethrower
description: Regbald Stonethrower Regbald Stonethrower was a dwarven warrior of the Frozenfar around 1369 DR . History . In Tarsakh , 1369 DR , while traveling through the Spine of the World pass into Icewind Dale Regbald was killed fighting hobgoblin raiders and their goblin scouts who ambushed a merchant caravans .

title: Regenerate
description: Regenerate Regenerate was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could reattach or regrow severed body parts . The reverse of this spell , wither , shriveled a body part to dust . Effect .

title: Regent of City Works
description: Regent of City Works The Regent of City Works was a civic official position of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . It was subordinate to the Lord Chancellor . Duties .

title: Reghed Glacier
description: Reghed Glacier The Reghed Glacier was a glacial wasteland north of the Spine of the World . Geography . The Reghed Glacier formed the eastern boundary of Icewind Dale and was bordered by the Spine of the World to the south .

title: Reghedmen
description: Reghedmen The Reghedmen were the barbarian tribes of Icewind Dale , also known as the men of the tundra . They eked out a harsh and bitter life between the Reghed Glacier and the Sea of Moving Ice . The Reghedman were tall - taller than most southerners by a head .

title: Reginald
description: Reginald Reginald was a corrupt sergeant of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes . Personality . Reginald on the surface was polite , courteous , and professional but inside he was moved only by greed and ambition .

title: Reginald Roundshield
description: Reginald Roundshield Reginald Roundshield , nicknamed " Little Arr Arr " , was the son of Citadel Felbarr ' s Captain of the Guard Reginald Roundshield Sr . He was in fact the re - incarnation of Bruenor Battlehammer of the Companions of the Hall . Description .

title: Regis
description: Regis Regis ( jokingly called Rumblebelly by Bruenor Battlehammer ) was the halfling member of the adventuring group known as the Companions of the Hall . He was reincarnated in 1463 DR as Spider Parrafin . Physical description .

title: Regweld Harpell
description: Regweld Harpell Regweld Harpell was a member of the Harpell family which lived in Longsaddle in the Savage Frontier . Description . Regweld was very fat .

title: Reincarnate
description: Reincarnate Reincarnate was a transmutation or necromantic spell that returned a dead creature ' s soul to a new body . The arcane version of this spell was called reincarnation but was similar in most respects . Effects .

title: Reiner Trall
description: Reiner Trall Reiner Trall was a male human ranger of Daggerdale and a captain of the Freedom Riders in the 1360s DR . History . In 1367 DR , Captain Reiner Trall led a patrol of men searching for Zhent ish agents in Daggerdale and trying to prevent a Zhent caravan from reaching Dagger Falls .

title: Reinhar I
description: Reinhar I Reinhar I was an arkaiun warchief who rose to prominence in 545 DR in Dambrath . Activities . Reinhar consolidated the might of the various tribes of arkaiun inhabiting the barbarian kingdom of Dambrath .

title: Reinhar II
description: Reinhar II Reinhar II was an arkaiun warchief from Dambrath . Activities . After the death and defeat of Reinhar I at the hands of Mycontil in Halruaa , Reinhar II assumed command of the remaining forces of invading arkaiun .

title: Reinhar IX
description: Reinhar IX Reinhar IX , also known as Reinhar the Foolish , was the king of the arkaiun in Dambrath in 802 DR . Activities . Expansion .

title: Reitheillaethor
description: Reitheillaethor Reitheillaethor or Rheitheillaethor ( " rye " - thigh - " way " - eh - thor ) was a wood elf village of 640 in the High Forest , on the banks of the Heartblood River . History . In 1374 DR it was ruled by Lady Morgwais .

title: Rekx Tihler
description: Rekx Tihler Rekx Tihler was the Silhouette of Bounty Hunters for the Shadow Thieves in Riatavin around 1370 DR . Activities . In his role as Silhouette , Rekx was one of the guildmasters under Cloakmaster Kiirma Blackmane .

title: Reland Tymin
description: Reland Tymin Reland Tymin was a lord in the Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Reland ruled the city of Timindar .

title: Reldyk Applecrown
description: Reldyk Applecrown Reldyk Applecrown was a minor War Wizard of Cormyr . History . Often he acted as bodyguard for the old Lady Darlethra Greatgaunt , who always requested a young handsome man for her protection in Suzail .

title: Relgadrar Loroun
description: Relgadrar Loroun Relgadrar Loroun was an old noble in Cormyr and lord of the Loroun noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon tried to enslave his mind and , despite Relgadrar having powerful magic in his defense , Manshoon managed at last to enslave him .

title: Reliath Crescentia
description: Reliath Crescentia Reliath Crescentia was a female wood elf lurk and a young member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . In the mid - 1370s DR , Reliath robbed the Hall of the Kaliesh ' erai of a number of powerful psionic item s . The theft triggered huge debates among the remaining members , which came to focus on the future of the Kaliesh ' erai and led to a schism between older conservative and younger expansionist elements .

title: Relics of the Righteous
description: Relics of the Righteous Relics of the Righteous was a book written by Thontoros the Learned , the Sage of the Just Gods . Amongst other things , it detailed the enchantment of the magical sword " Dornavver " at Allyn ' s Anvil in Year of the Wrath Sword , 275 DR .

title: Relirva Indagley ' Belash
description: Relirva Indagley ' Belash Relirva Indagley ' Belash was a scout and retainer of House Teh ' kinrellz of Ched Nasad in the year 1370 DR . History . Relirva was a commoner and retainer of House Teh ' kinrellz , trained as a scout .

title: Relkath of the Infinite Branches
description: Relkath of the Infinite Branches Relkath of the Infinite Branches was a giant treant deity in the Yuir elven pantheon who was chaotic and unpredictable . Forests were said to sprout wherever he touched the ground . Whilst he was known to defend the Yuir elves , he also took action against some of them , turning priests into trees and villages into forests .

title: Relmaur
description: Relmaur Relmaur , also known as the Barrier Realm , was a small kingdom of dragonborn located in the southern region of the Howling Mountains in Returned Abeir . Relmaur was located between Melabrauth and Skelkor , and somehow served as a buffer between the two dragon empires . Government .

title: Reluhantis
description: Reluhantis Reluhantis was a marilith who was a personal attendant to the demon lord Graz ' zt . Personality . She was a cruel creature who ruled Graz ' zt ' s Argent Palace when he was away with an iron hand , along with her cohort , Unhath .

title: Reluraun ' s Tomb
description: Reluraun ' s Tomb Reluraun ' s Tomb was a tomb in the Ardeep Forest as of 1370 DR . It was the final resting place of Reluraun , an elven warrior who was a hero to the elves . Reluraun ' s body was said to be clad in magic chain mail and lying with a magical " dragon slayer " sword .

title: Remallia Haventree
description: Remallia Haventree Remallia Haventree was the Harper leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . She was also married to the Lords of Waterdeep Arthagast Ulbrinter . History .

title: Remarkus
description: Remarkus Remarkus was an insane lich in Myth Drannor in 1357 DR . Activities . Remarkus haunted a kind of war room with a map of Myth Drannor around 757 DR with pins indicating all the undead he controlled .

title: Remnis
description: Remnis Remnis was the god of giant eagle s , a free lord of the sky who willingly rendered his service as a mount and helper to like - minded deities . He untiringly flew across the planes , observing everything with his keen vision , in search of secrets and prey worthy of his attention . He shared his knowledge and wisdom with the deserving .

title: Remorhaz
description: Remorhaz A remorhaz , also known as a polar worm , was a monstrous beast resembling a cross between a worm and a centipede . A remorhaz was a creature that thrived in cold environments , particularly arctic regions . Description .

title: Remove affliction
description: Remove affliction Remove affliction , also called remove curse , allowed the caster to remove most curse s from objects or creatures . It could allow a creature to drop a magically cursed item , but would not remove a magically cursed weapon or piece of armor . The more powerful a caster became , the more types of curses could be removed by casting this spell .

title: Remove blindness or deafness
description: Remove blindness or deafness Remove blindness or deafness was a conjuration spell similar to older cure blindness and cure blindness or deafness which were abjuration spells that could restore sight or hearing in some cases . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell .

title: Remove curse
description: Remove curse Remove curse was an abjuration spell that could permanently eliminate all curses on an object or a creature , or in some instances , banish an evil presence . The reverse of this spell was " bestow curse " . Effects .

title: Remove disease
description: Remove disease Remove disease was a conjuration spell that , on touch , magically removed any diseases and killed any parasites from which the subject is suffering . An older abjuration version called cure disease took longer to work . Effects .

title: Remove fear
description: Remove fear Remove fear was an abjuration spell that increased the subject ' s courage and morale in the face of " fear " effects . The reverse of this spell , " cause fear " , could make one or more creatures flee in panic . Effects .

title: Remove paralysis
description: Remove paralysis Remove paralysis was a conjuration or abjuration spell that could free a small number of creatures from a paralyzing effect . Effects . Paralyzing effects that could be removed by this spell included " slow " or " hold " spells , and ghoul touch .

title: Ren
description: Ren Ren was a male human soldier of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR and the personal assassin of Commander Tyzack . History . Ren was a member of the Company of Scorpions and also Tyzack ' s personal assassin .

title: Ren Ferkins
description: Ren Ferkins Ren Ferkins was the mayor of Dagger Falls around 1479 DR . Personality . Ren was a very patriotic man .

title: Ren o ' the Blade
description: Ren o ' the Blade Ren o ' the Blade was a human ranger \ thief who worked at the Laughing Goblin Inn . History . Ren began his career as a ranger until he met the female thief Tempest in Waterdeep .

title: Renaer Neverember
description: Renaer Neverember Renaer Neverember was a noble and son of the Open Lord of Waterdeep , Dagult Neverember . History . Renaer was born to Dagult Neverember , who served as the Open Lord of Waterdeep .

title: Renal Bloodscalp
description: Renal Bloodscalp Renal Bloodscalp was the Silhouette of Burglars in Athkatla in 1370 . Description . Renal was a shady character who crouched more than he stood .

title: Rendaril
description: Rendaril Rendaril was a shopkeeper in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Rendaril managed the Rendaril Emporium , the largest trade house of the city .

title: Render
description: Render A render is an unholy creature created by combining a summoned tanar ' ri with a human prisoner . The process was an accident ; while permitting the demon to kill the human for pleasure , the wizard miscast a spell from an unknown scroll , causing the creatures to fuse . The wizard creator died , and hundreds of others died as well before the beast escaped .

title: Rendeth of the Royal Blood
description: Rendeth of the Royal Blood Rendeth of the Royal Blood , or Rendath , was a human male of the Vast , and the Thultyrl , or ruler , of the city of Procampur . Description . Rendeth had the distinctive family resemblance of copper - colored hair , gray - green eyes , and a sharp chin .

title: Rending
description: Rending Rending was a divine spell specifically meant to destroy any kind of manufactured item or creature owned as property . It was granted by the Zakhara n goddess of the untamed wild , Ragarra . Effects .

title: Rendril ' s Forge
description: Rendril ' s Forge Rendril ' s Forge was a metalworking smithy in the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was on Shards Street in the Adventurers ' District . Staff .

title: Renegades
description: Renegades The Renegades were a mercenary company based in Chessenta . Organization . The company included 70 cavalry , 20 infantry , and 90 archers .

title: Renfod
description: Renfod Renfod was a cleric and a Loremaster Accordant of the Order of Blue Flame . Appearance . He had short , graying black hair and dark ebony skin .

title: Renin
description: Renin Renin was a drow from Szith Morcane . History . During the Rage of Demons , Renin was one of the drow that needed to meet the smuggler Arrizz in order to receive the shipment of supplies procured by Arrizz .

title: Renn min Zann
description: Renn min Zann Imam Renn min Zann was the highest representative of the assembled Enlightened faiths throughout all of Zakhara . His official title was " Keeper of the Mosques , " and he worked in golden Huzuz , the City of Delights . Description .

title: Rensha
description: Rensha The Rensha family were a Calishite mercantile group that famously conquered much of the Delimbiyr Vale . History . Ibun Rensha led his family out of Calimshan at the head of a mercenary army to take over Loudwater in 1150 DR .

title: Rensharra Ironstave
description: Rensharra Ironstave Rensharra Ironstave was an official of Cormyr . Activities . Rensharra ' s duty was to collect income tax .

title: Renwick Caradoon
description: Renwick Caradoon Renwick " Snowcloak " Caradoon was the eldest of the three brothers whose exploits led to the creation of the Knights of Samular ( along with Samular Caradoon and Amphail the Just ) . Renwick eventually died in the last battle of the Second Troll War , only to return as an archlich . Life after undeath .

title: Repair injury
description: Repair injury Repair injury was an improved version of " cure moderate wounds " that also alleviated one specific debilitating injury . Effects . The caster had to touch the subject of this spell in order to apply the healing energies .

title: Repel metal or stone
description: Repel metal or stone Repel metal or stone is an abjuration spell that pushes away stone and metal . Effect . Like " repel wood " , this spell creates waves of invisible and intangible energy that roll forth from you .

title: Repel undead
description: Repel undead Repel undead was a necromantic abjuration spell used to drive undead creatures away from the caster . Effects . This spell created a powerful compulsion within undead creatures , prompting them to avoid the caster .

title: Repel vermin
description: Repel vermin Repel vermin , and another version called repel insects , were abjuration spells that created an invisible barrier to keep out unwanted pests . Effects . The area of effect for these spells was a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius around the spellcaster .

title: Repel wood
description: Repel wood Repel wood , also known as turn wood was a transmutation or alteration spell that pushed wooden objects in a given direction . Effects . This spell caused waves of wood - repelling force to emanate from the spot where the spell was cast , in the direction the caster was facing .

title: Repo La
description: Repo La Repo La , or Broken Wall Pass , was a mountain pass located in eastern Khazari . Geography . Repo La was the only accessible route passing through eastern Khazari and the end of the Katakoro Shan range .

title: Repose domain
description: Repose domain The Repose domain was a deity domain similar to the Death domain . It existed for those good - aligned deities who could not give their cleric s access to evil spells . Once a day , the spellcaster could kill a target instantly with but a touch , though the difficulty was affected by both the skill of the user and the strength of the target .

title: Reptilla Half - elven
description: Reptilla Half - elven Reptilla Half - elven was a half - elf woman who dwelt in the Dragonspine Mountains in the early 1360s DR . Skills . She was a highly dexterous mage , and skilled in making poisons .

title: Repulsion
description: Repulsion Repulsion is an abjuration spell that prevents creatures from approaching the caster . It is a common spell in the Realms . Effects .

title: Rerk
description: Rerk Rerk was a farmer in the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , he and five other men went inside the forest to recover Halvin Graingle before he disturbed the fey s .

title: Resar
description: Resar Resar was a wizard from Halruaa who traveled to Baldur ' s Gate to find and recover a crashed Halruaan Skyship . For this objective , he recruited Gorion ' s Ward , but when Gorion ' s Ward finished the task , Resar tried to kill him to silence all witnesses of Halruaan secrets .

title: Resist acid and corrosion
description: Resist acid and corrosion Resist acid and corrosion was an abjuration spell that improved the subject ' s defense against caustic substances for a few minutes . Effects . The caster had to touch the subject in order to bestow this protection .

title: Resist energy
description: Resist energy Resist energy was an abjuration spell that absorbed a small amount of damage from one energy type ( acid , cold , electricity , fire , or sonic ) at the choice of the caster . Effects . The caster could protect one creature from one type of damage ( either natural or magical in nature ) per casting of this spell .

title: Resist fire or cold
description: Resist fire or cold Resist fire / resist cold was an alteration spell that granted immunity from normal heat and cold to the subject and improved defenses against intense or magical heat and cold . This spell was the combination of the older resist cold and resist fire spells , allowing the caster to choose the form of protection at the time of casting . Effects .

title: Respected Mamluk Society
description: Respected Mamluk Society The Respected Mamluk Society , also known as the Respected , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This large mamluk organization had a long and proud history of serving Muluk , the City of Kings .

title: Ressa
description: Ressa Ressa was Hagen ' s daughter in Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Ressa was a merchant and Hagen ' s daughter .

title: Resting Place of the Whip
description: Resting Place of the Whip The Resting Place of the Whip was the local temple of Loviatar in Melvaunt . The temple had seventeen priest s , led by High Whipmistress Suzildara Sharranen . The temple was not particularly popular as worship of Loviatar decreased significantly as of recent times .

title: Restoration
description: Restoration Restoration was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could restore a lost life energy level to a creature , remove fatigue , and remove temporary ability handicaps . The older necromantic versions of this spell could restore a lost level , cure insanity and were reversible , resulting in the spell energy drain which siphoned off one life energy level from a creature . Effects .

title: Restorers
description: Restorers The Restorers were an organization of desert giant s dedicated to reclaiming the city of Ubar , or Dayya from the terrible jann who occupied it . Activities . The Restorers did what they could to hamper the way of life for the jann inhabiting Ubar .

title: Resurrection ( novel )
description: Resurrection ( novel ) Resurrection by Paul S . Kemp is the sixth and final book in the War of the Spider Queen series . Summary .

title: Resurrection ( spell )
description: Resurrection ( spell ) Resurrection was a conjuration or necromancy spell that could restore life and full vigorous health to one dead creature . Earlier versions of this spell were reversible , called destruction , and could turn a victim to dust . Effects .

title: Rethnor
description: Rethnor Rethnor was the leader of Ship Rethnor and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . Along with the others he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate . Rethnor ' s lead ship was the " Cutlass .

title: Retreat
description: Retreat The Retreat was the name given to the mass migration of elves from Faerûn to Evermeet . It was instigated by the Elven Court in 1344 DR . During the Retreat , over ninety percent of the elves in the forest of Cormanthor migrated to Evermeet or Evereska .

title: Retriever
description: Retriever A retriever is a mindless construct created by foul sorcery to be warriors and servants for more powerful demons of the Abyss . They specialize in retrieving lost or desired objects , runaway slaves , and enemies and bringing them back to its master . Appearance .

title: Retta Starling
description: Retta Starling Retta Starling was a female human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . She attended the Tourney of Talent during the Harvest Fair .

title: Return of the Archwizards
description: Return of the Archwizards The Return of the Archwizards is a trilogy of novels by Troy Denning centered around the elf Galaeron Nihmedu , an Evereskan Tomb Guard . The Summoning . Time Frame : 1371 DR - 1372 DR The floating city of Shade escaped the fall of the mighty Empire of Netheril .

title: Return to sand
description: Return to sand Return to sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused items made from metal , stone , or earth to crumple into sand .

title: Returned Abeir
description: Returned Abeir Returned Abeir was the name the natives of Toril gave the large , horseshoe - shaped landmass , known to its inhabitants as Laerakond ( pronounced " L - AIR - ah - KON - d " ) , that appeared during the Spellplague . Located west of the Trackless Sea , replacing Maztica from its known spot . Geography .

title: Returning
description: Returning Returning was a quality that could be applied to weapons that could be thrown . A weapons with this property would return to the one who ' d thrown it . Creation .

title: Reulek
description: Reulek Reulek was a duergar ghost at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationship . In life , Reulek had a partnership of convenience with an oni called Obratu .

title: Reveal invisible
description: Reveal invisible Reveal invisibile was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an invisible sphere that revealed any invisible creatures and objects located within its range .

title: Reveal magic
description: Reveal magic Reveal magic makes the hidden auras of magic visible , much like the spell " detect magic " . Unlike " detect magic " , this spell causes all magic in the effected area to glow for all to see , not just the caster . Reveal magic is an uncommon spell in the Realms .

title: Revelations of the Icedawn
description: Revelations of the Icedawn Revelations of the Icedawn was a holy book of Auril containing some of the most prized prayers of the Frostmaiden ' s faith . Description . The book had pages that looked and felt as if they were made of blue ice .

title: Revenance
description: Revenance Revenance was a necromancy spell that boosted the fortitude of one or more undead creatures , making them immune to one successful " turning " . An older version of this spell granted immunity for as many turning attempts as the caster had levels . Effects .

title: Revenant
description: Revenant Revenants were undead creatures that would rise from the dead to hunt down and slay their killers with an unwavering zeal . Description . Appearing as decayed and emaciated versions of their once - living selves , revenants typically had open festering wounds and drawn , clammy skin covering their flesh .

title: Reverie
description: Reverie Reverie was the elven state of meditation , which had certain sleep - like effects . During the meditation , sometimes referred to as a " trance , " the elf conducted a series of mental exercises that refreshed the elf ' s body and mind . During this meditation an elf was fully aware of the outside world , though breaking meditation in response to external events had an effect on the elf similar to disturbing the sleep of any other humanoid .

title: Revil Slombarr
description: Revil Slombarr Revil Slombarr was a heavyset young mage and a member of the Harpers in Loudwater sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Revil lived in the Smiling Satyr tavern , run by a Harper sympathizer .

title: Revjak
description: Revjak Revjak was a barbarian king of the Tribe of the Elk in Icewind Dale . Personality . Revjak was always in control of his emotions .

title: Revlopar
description: Revlopar Revlopar was a young mutant ixzan prodigy and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Revlopar secretly wanted to explore the Realms Above in hopes of learning new spells and magic , but until then he waited while his power grew .

title: Rewcol
description: Rewcol Rewcol was a wizard and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Eshpurta around 1370 DR . Personality . The shadow thief was a sort of misanthrope .

title: Reyill Werned
description: Reyill Werned Reyill Werned was a greengrocer in Hillsfar . Activities . Reyill went to farms outside the city to bought foods and repackaging sold them inside Hillsfar .

title: Reynald de Chatillon
description: Reynald de Chatillon Reynald de Chatillon was a fallen paladin in Athkatla in Amn . History . Reynald was a paladin and a member of the Order of the Radiant Heart , but at some point he fell from grace and started living as an outcast .

title: Rezim
description: Rezim Rezim was the vizier of Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Rezim was a member of the House of Helcaliant and one of the most powerful men of Mulhorand .

title: Rezlus
description: Rezlus Rezlus was a Zhentarim cleric who was in service to Bane . Rezlus , with his fellow Zhentarim agents planned to seize control of Daggerdale . Description .

title: Rezmir
description: Rezmir Rezmir , or Rezmir the Black , was a half – black dragon human woman who was the Black Dragon Wyrmspeaker of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . She descended from House Orogoth . History .

title: Rhalaglingalade
description: Rhalaglingalade Rhalaglingalade was a wizard in Neverwinter . History . In 1370 DR , Rhalaglingalade settled in Neverwinter and announced the creation of a new spell : the " sphere of summer " .

title: Rhammas Thann
description: Rhammas Thann Rhammas Thann was the husband of Cassandra Thann and thus the patriarch of Thann family , although in his later years , he retired from an active role in family affairs . Personality . He was a hardworking and honorable man who was overshadowed by his wife , Cassandra .

title: Rhangaun
description: Rhangaun Rhangaun was a male lich and a senior member of the Twisted Rune . Description . Dead for more than a thousand years , he was little more than a skeleton with glowing eyes .

title: Rhaugilath
description: Rhaugilath Rhaugilath , called " the Ageless " , was a male human and an archlich . He was the former Sorcerer - King of the enclave of Orbedal in ancient Netheril and later one of the servitor lich es of Larloch the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt . History .

title: Rhaunaguth
description: Rhaunaguth Rhaunaguth was a mercenary in Skullport . Personality . Rhaunaguth was the opposite of his greatest rival , Dalagor .

title: Rhauntides
description: Rhauntides Rhauntides was a human wizard living in Highmoon in Deepingdale . He was a cultured man who was devoted to the study of human and elven magic — specifically the history of their use and users up to the present . History .

title: Rhauron
description: Rhauron " Rhauron " was mysterious and notorious individual who lived on Tarsith , in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir , in the decade of the 1480s DR . Background . Nobody knew nothing concrete about this individual .

title: Rhavauz
description: Rhavauz Rhavauz was a female drow guard officer in Szith Morcane who fled from Maerimydra after the invasion of Kurgoth Hellspawn . Description . During her duties as an officer of Szith Morcane , Rhavauz wore a over her breastplate with the emblem of House T ' sarran on it , a leering black skull upon a white background .

title: Rhaymon
description: Rhaymon Rhaymon was a male human cleric of Lathander in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Rhaymon was a young cleric of the god Lathander in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles .

title: Rhazbos Redbridle
description: Rhazbos Redbridle Rhazbos Redbridle was a stout and jolly ex - adventurer who operated a stable within Waterdeep . He was also a former mercenary and caravan leader . Personality .

title: Rhazzad
description: Rhazzad Rhazzad was a moon elf wizard living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . He started studying the Spellplague and the Chasm .

title: Rhazzt ' s Dilemma
description: Rhazzt ' s Dilemma Rhazzt ' s Dilemma was a cavern in the Northdark that served as an outpost for the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . Rhazzt ' s Dilemma was located between Gracklstugh and Menzoberranzan , about 30 miles south of the drow city .

title: Rheax Bormul
description: Rheax Bormul Rheax Bormul was a male rogue and one of the members of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Rheax was the son of a ruined noble family and he enjoyed causing the decline of members of his former class . His job was to control the guild ' s operations in Amn .

title: Rhetegast Hawkwinter
description: Rhetegast Hawkwinter Rhetegast Hawkwinter , who went by Rhett , was a young Waterdavian noble and half - elf paladin of Torm . History . Luskan .

title: Rhetsim
description: Rhetsim Rhetsim was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Rhetsim was an alchemist running an alchemist shop in Waterdeep ; her role in the Guild was gave to the Slaver division of the Guild the potions they need in their abduction expedition . for this often Ahmaergo or Avaereene went to the Rhestim ' s shop .

title: Rhiazzshar
description: Rhiazzshar Rhiazzshar was a wood elf druid of Silvanus and a member of a tribe in Wildhome . Appearance . Rhiazzshar had amber - colored eyes and mahogany skin .

title: Rhigaerd Obarskyr II
description: Rhigaerd Obarskyr II Rhigaerd Obarskyr II was the king of Cormyr . Relatives . Rhigaerd II was the father of Azoun IV and had a daughter named Sulesta .

title: Rhiiman Obarskyr
description: Rhiiman Obarskyr Rhiiman Obarskyr was the brother of the first king of Cormyr , Faerlthann Obarskyr . Relatives . Rhiiman ' s father was Ondeth Obarskyr and his mother was Suzara Obarskyr .

title: Rhiiman Obarskyr the Glorious
description: Rhiiman Obarskyr the Glorious Rhiiman the Glorious ( real name Rhiiman Obarskyr ) was the fifth king of Cormyr . He reigned from 66 DR until his death in 79 DR . He was the first to push back the borders of the forest , and killed the last great dragon of the Wyvernwater .

title: Rhindaun Dynasty
description: Rhindaun Dynasty Rhindaun Dynasty was one of the ruling dynasties of Tethyr , founded by the adventuress Zaranda Star Rhindaun . Etymology . The dynasty took its name from King - Consort Haedrak ' s mother , Rhinda , second wife of Alemander V .

title: Rhinnom Dannihyr
description: Rhinnom Dannihyr Rhimmom Dannihyr was a male human rogue who was the leader of the Shadow Council of the Shadow Thieves . Rhimmon arrived at this position because he was at the same time the iltarch of the Council of Six from 1362 DR . In truth , the founder of the Council of Six , Thayze Selemchant , made a deal with the Shadow Thieves for use of them as intelligence agents for Amn in exchange for protection against the guild ' s enemies .

title: Rhinoceros
description: Rhinoceros A rhinoceros was a natural herbivorous animal found in warm plains . Description . They had big , barreled chests with stout legs and thick - skin , which was usually gray in color .

title: Rhinzen Halnian
description: Rhinzen Halnian Rhinzen Halnian was a powerful Elf Wizard and the Master of the House of Wonder mage academy in Waterdeep . He spent most of his time tutoring the children of weathly Waterdavian families , a task he seemed to find excrutiatingly boring . Rhinzen got his kicks by indulging in the narcotic haepthum .

title: Rhodea Firehair
description: Rhodea Firehair Rhodea Firehair was a powerful invoker living in Aluarim in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Personality . Rhodea ' s personality matched her surname .

title: Rhodochrosite
description: Rhodochrosite Rhodochrosite , also known as rosenstone , was most often used in rings and pendants . Description . These ornamental stones were various shades of pink and translucent with a glassy sheen .

title: Rhovann Disarnnyl
description: Rhovann Disarnnyl Rhovann Disarnnyl was a powerful moon elf mage formerly of Myth Drannor . History . He fought and lost a duel with Geran Hulmaster over a moon elf maiden and lost a hand in the battle .

title: Rhundorth
description: Rhundorth Rhundorth was a master blacksmith in Mirabar who became a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Rhundorth was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation .

title: Rhyem Maraphiir
description: Rhyem Maraphiir Rhyem Maraphiir was a moon elf and the father of the wizard Ashemmi . Relatives . Rhyem had two children with the sun elf Chelryn Sarynnryllar : Ashemmi ( born Shemithil Maraphiir ) and Malphys Maraphiir .

title: Rhykdeq
description: Rhykdeq Rhykdeq was an enterprising ixzan merchant in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . Activities . Rhykdeq regularly ferried goods up and down the Deepdrain .

title: Rhymanthiin
description: Rhymanthiin Rhymanthiin ( also called the Hidden City of Hope ) , was created in 1374 DR through a High Magic Ritual of Myriad and manipulation of the Killing Storms through Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun , Tsarra Chaadren , and Danthra the Dreamer , all of whose souls were within the body of Tsarra Chaadren , and over ninety wielders of the Art , including five Chosen of Mystra , all by the design of the Pentad ( the five gods Corellon Larethian , Sehanine Moonbow , Dumathoin , Mystra , and Oghma ) . It is a reconstruction of the ancient Miyeritar i city of Faer ' tel ' miir , the Library City . Location .

title: Rhynn Lanthorn
description: Rhynn Lanthorn The Rhynn Lanthorn was a magical lantern held by the elves of Suldanessellar . It had the power to reveal things behind even the most powerful illusions . When Irenicus was attacking Suldanessellar , he hid its entrance with illusions to prevent Elhan and his troops from entering .

title: Rhys Ravenwind
description: Rhys Ravenwind Rhys Ravenwind was a renowned bard and member of the Harpers . Personality . Despite being a bard , Rhys was quite shy .

title: Rhyxali
description: Rhyxali Rhyxali , the Queen of Shadows , is the demon princess daughter of Pale Night ( the Mother of Demons ) . This in turn made her the sister of Graz ' zt ( the Dark Prince ) , Vucarik ( Consort of Chains ) , and Zivorgian , the Lady of Ripe Carrion . Rhyxali was a long - standing ally of Graz ' zt .

title: Ri ' ola ' con
description: Ri ' ola ' con Ri ' ola ' con was the eadar of As ' arem and a member of the Nantarn Council . Activities . Ri ' ola ' con was the highest - ranking member of the council acting as mediator and facilitator despite his old age .

title: Ri ' ola ' kirk
description: Ri ' ola ' kirk Ri ' ola ' kirk was the eadar of As ' arem ' s protege . History . As the only heir of the eadar Ri ' ola ' con after the Twelfth Serôs War Ri ' ola ' kirk must abandoned his life as ranger in order to be instructed by the old shalarin .

title: Rian Nightshade
description: Rian Nightshade Rian Nightshade was the Zhentarim envoy to the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Rian acted under two principles : logic and greed .

title: Riasa Yegorovna
description: Riasa Yegorovna Riasa Yegorovna ( pronounced REE - suh YAY - gore - OVE - nuh ) was a girl in Mulmaster . Personality . Riasa was an easily excitable , but a little unfocused girl .

title: Riatavin
description: Riatavin Riatavin was a city in Amn and later Tethyr in west Faerûn . History . Formerly a city of Amn , Riatavin seceded to become part of Tethyr in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR .

title: Ribsmasher
description: Ribsmasher Ribsmasher was an apparently mad human male who was locked up in the ogre Ghellu ' s Riverguard Keep . Upon being released by adventurers , Ribsmasher attacked his jailors with his bare fists . When he next appears Ribsmasher is again a captive , this time of a cult of Shar .

title: Rice Spirits
description: Rice Spirits The Rice Spirits were a group of Lesser Immortal s of the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant faith of Kara - Tur . They served Nung Chiang , the god of agriculture and fertility . The Rice Spirits governed the harvest and fertility , and were responsible for causing rice to grow tall and sturdy , animals to have their young , and men and women to bear babies .

title: Rice candies
description: Rice candies Rice candies were a type of chewy candy from Shou Lung . They were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Richard Baker
description: Richard Baker Richard Baker , full name : L . Richard Baker III , grew up on the Jersey shore before graduating from Virginia Tech University . At some point he joined the Navy and was stationed in Virginia , Rhode Island , and Louisiana .

title: Richard Whitters
description: Richard Whitters Richard Whitters is a concept artist who has worked for Wizards of the Coast . Education . Whitters received his education in New Brunswick , Canada , majoring in graphic design and illustration .

title: Rico Pengallen
description: Rico Pengallen Rico Pengallen was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description .

title: Ricven
description: Ricven Ricven was a powerful elf archmage living in Neverwinter before the Spellplague in 1385 DR . History . He died in the cataclysm that also destroyed his tower , later known as the Fallen Tower .

title: Riders of Blood
description: Riders of Blood The Riders of Blood were renegades from the House of Hanif who operated along Dihl al - Taif in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . Located somewhere within the Haunted Lands , the Riders of Blood struck with the speed and savage efficiency of a sandstorm .

title: Riders of Nesmé
description: Riders of Nesmé The Riders of Nesmé was a military mercenary organization that served Nesmé . History . In 1358 DR , the Riders of Nesmé sent a small score of soldiers to support the dwarves of Mithral Hall when Menzoberranzan ' s army were on the march to take over the ancient halls .

title: Riding lizard
description: Riding lizard Riding lizards were large , sleek reptiles used as mounts by drow in the Underdark as as a food source for other creatures in the Underdark . Description . Riding lizards were large lizards 20 - 22 feet long ( their tails making up about half their length ) .

title: Rieltar Anchev
description: Rieltar Anchev Rieltar Anchev ( sometimes spelled Reiltar ) was the regional leader of the Iron Throne in Baldur ' s Gate , and the foster father of Sarevok . He killed his wife in front of Sarevok when he was young . He was also a central figure in orchestrating the iron crisis to gain power to the Iron Throne , as well as the doppelganger infiltration of merchant rivals .

title: Rigar Trueblood
description: Rigar Trueblood Rigar Trueblood was a veteran warrior and hero . As he lay on his deathbed , Rigar Trueblood begged his companion , the mage Spectorial , to preserve his skill and fortitude in battle . Although reluctant , Spectorial acceded and extracted these qualities from Rigar ' s soul , placing them into the " pale green ioun stone " so that others might benefit from them .

title: Righteous brand
description: Righteous brand Righteous brand is a prayer cast by many cleric s , particularly those of the battle cleric tradition . When cast , " righteous brand " lights a cleric ' s weapon with the holy symbol of their deity , allowing the cleric to channel divine power through it . When a cleric strikes a foe with a weapon so enchanted they momentarily brand their enemy with the symbol and the release of divine magic allows them to enhance the martial skill of an ally within twenty - five feet to a degree dependent on the cleric ' s physical strength .

title: Righteous might
description: Righteous might Righteous might is a transmutation spell that enlarges and strengthens the user . Effects . You grow to double your height , and your gear grows proportionally .

title: Righteous rage of Tempus
description: Righteous rage of Tempus Righteous rage of Tempus was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Tempus that gave the caster a short window of time in which to hit with a weapon . If the attack was successful , this prayer made it a devastating blow .

title: Righteous wrath of the faithful
description: Righteous wrath of the faithful Righteous wrath of the faithful was an enchantment spell that inflamed the battle fury of the caster ' s allies , improving their abilities in combat and granting a temporary health boost . Effects . When this spell was cast , all friends and allies of the caster in a 60 ft ( 18 .

title: Rihuud
description: Rihuud Rihuud was a stone giant living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Rihuud was one of the apprentices of Stonespeaker Hgraam , leader of Clan Cairngorm .

title: Rikmo Naquander
description: Rikmo Naquander Rikmo Naquander was a Master Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Rikmo had great attention to detail .

title: Rilauven
description: Rilauven Rilauven was a drow city in the Underdark . Geography . The city was located under an area near the surface city of Neverwinter .

title: Rilimbrar
description: Rilimbrar Rilimbrar was a king of Impiltur . Relationships . Rilimbrar was the second son of King Lashilmbrar the Sly .

title: Rilimbraun
description: Rilimbraun Rilimbraun was a cleric of Tyr and one of leaders of the Knights of Imphras II in 1374 DR and an old member of the Council of Lords . After the crowning of Imbrar II Rilimbraun alongside Soargilm retired from public life , acting only as advisor of Sambryl .

title: Rilira
description: Rilira Rilira was a former drow noble in Szith Morcane . History . Rilira was the head of a noble house in Szith Morcane .

title: Rilitar Shadow - water
description: Rilitar Shadow - water Rilitar Shadow - water was an elven wizard in Thentia during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Rilitar was among a cabal of humanoid wizards in Thentia who studied the " Dracorage mythal " .

title: Riliyyn Scantshar
description: Riliyyn Scantshar Riliyyn Scantshar , or Riliyyr Scantshar , was a human woman of the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast and matriarch of the Scantshar family in the late 1360s DR . Description . Riliyyn was an elderly woman by 1367 DR .

title: Rillifane ' s Grove
description: Rillifane ' s Grove Rillifane ' s Grove was a grove of old oak trees . It was used by moon and sun elf priests to contact the Seldarine . It was also used for ceremonies , funerals and marriages by wood and wild elves who traveled to Leuthilspar .

title: Rillifane Rallathil
description: Rillifane Rallathil Rillifane Rallathil ( RILL - ih - fane RALL - uh - thihl ) is the elven god of protection of woodlands and the guardian of the harmony of nature . His priests liken him to a giant ethereal oak tree so huge that its roots mingle with every other plant , which stands in the heart of Arvandor . The great tree draws into itself all the ebb and flow of the season and the lives within the woodlands of the green elves .

title: Rillo Leadstopper
description: Rillo Leadstopper Rillo Leadstopper was a gnome tinkerer in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Rillo and his daughter Villonah were always at odds with each other .

title: Rilrae Zolond
description: Rilrae Zolond Rilrae Zolond was member of House Zolond and a novice priestess of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . History . In 1372 DR , Rilrae was a novice priestess at Arach - Tinilith .

title: Rilsa Rael
description: Rilsa Rael Rilsa Rael was a crime lord of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Rilsa thought that the Flaming Fists were unnecessarily cruel and uncaring of the poor of the city and believed that the nobles and rich were all to blame for the terrible conditions of the inhabitants of the Outer City district .

title: Riltana
description: Riltana Riltana was a windsoul genasi rogue who lived in Airspur . She posed as a messenger for the Airstepper ' s Guild but was in reality an accomplished rogue . Riltana was able to use the air to leap further than otherwise possible .

title: Rilyanna Saerfynn
description: Rilyanna Saerfynn Rilyanna Saerfynn was a young noblewoman and , with her brother Callak , was the last of her family . Rilyanna ' s parents died when she was young and she lived at the family manor with her brother . The dark angel Sathariel visited her when she was a child and she agreed to serve Asmodeus .

title: Rimaq al - Nimar
description: Rimaq al - Nimar Rimaq al - Nimar was a priest and of I ' tiraf in the Cities of the Pantheon . History . Around 1367 DR , Rimaq al - Nimar was the emir of I ' tiraf and the most influential leader in the League of the Pantheon .

title: Rimardo Domine
description: Rimardo Domine Rimardo Domine was a male human wizard , an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the South Tower . He was responsible for the Brotherhood ' s operations in the southern quadrant of Faerûn . Description .

title: Rimlost
description: Rimlost Rimlost was a tower located on the northern region of Fimbrul , that served as a temple for the followers of the primordial cults of Returned Abeir . Background . Rimlost was the most sacred place of worship in Returned Abeir .

title: Rimlost ( keep )
description: Rimlost ( keep ) Rimlost was a fortress located on the southern shore of Glaur Lake , on the kingdom of Gontal . Background . Rimlost was a small trading town and a popular stop for explorers and adventurers seeking a place to use as a base of operations while exploring the Glaur Barrens .

title: Rimmen
description: Rimmen Rimmen of the Scarlet Eye was a magelord who carried himself with the attitude of those who practiced the same magic in Athalantar , that is , one of supremacy through magical might . He particularly enjoyed showing off with his arcane skill to intimidate others . Possessins .

title: Rinda
description: Rinda Rinda was the author of the " Cyrinishad " and the " True Life of Cyric " . Personality . Rinda genuinely cared for people around her , especially those less fortunate .

title: Rindon Wasatho
description: Rindon Wasatho Rindon Wasatho is a guide for , as well as a member of , the organization known as the Fellowship of the Purple Staff . He often leads new members through the Gulthmere Forest or east to the region between Turmish and the Sea of Fallen Stars . Rindon is entirely loyal to the group and is perhaps the most trusted of their agents .

title: Ring of Myrkul
description: Ring of Myrkul A ring of Myrkul was a magical ring originally worn by a priest of Myrkul . Description . A " ring of Myrkul " was a relatively thick gold band painted black adorned with an image of a white flaming skull ( the symbol of Myrkul ) .

title: Ring of avian control
description: Ring of avian control A ring of avian control was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magic item was available in a wide variety of ring types .

title: Ring of burning
description: Ring of burning A ring of burning grants the wielder the same powers as a ring of spell storing , containing " Aganazzar ' s scorcher " , " beltyn ' s burning blood " , " fire gate " , " flamestrike " and " shroud of flame " . One of these rings is believed to be housed at the House of the Morning .

title: Ring of cloaked wizardry
description: Ring of cloaked wizardry Rings of cloaked wizardry were special rings found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , whose enchantments were difficult to detect by magical means . Powers . These rings were similar to any other magic ring found on Al - Toril save for the fact that casting " detect magic " did not reveal that the ring was in fact magical .

title: Ring of disintegration
description: Ring of disintegration Ring of disintegration was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell created a small bit of disintegrating matter .

title: Ring of dragons
description: Ring of dragons A ring of dragons was a magic ring that , as the name suggested , bestowed dragon - related powers . Description . It was a brass ring that resembled a dragon or serpent biting its own tail .

title: Ring of enduring arcana
description: Ring of enduring arcana Rings of enduring arcana render a spellcaster ' s spells more resistant to dispelling . Creation . To forge a " ring of enduring arcana " , a spellcaster must have " dispel magic " available .

title: Ring of feather falling
description: Ring of feather falling A ring of feather falling was a common magical ring that protected the wearer from injury or death from falling . Description . " Rings of feather falling " were crafted with an intricate feather pattern around the whole ring .

title: Ring of folly
description: Ring of folly Rings of folly were cursed magic items that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . " Rings of folly " could be found with a wide array of decorations and made from different metals .

title: Ring of frost
description: Ring of frost A ring of frost was a magical ring capable of producing frost . Powers . A " ring of frost " functioned like a " wand of frost " , though it had an unlimited number of charges .

title: Ring of gaki - protection
description: Ring of gaki - protection A ring of gaki - protection was a magic item that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . Description . This item was a plain silver ring .

title: Ring of genie summoning
description: Ring of genie summoning A ring of genie summoning was a magical ring that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . This magical ring was able to summon a particular genie from its elemental plane .

title: Ring of hands
description: Ring of hands Ring of hands was a cooperative abjuration spell that formed a circle that acted as a zone of " protection from evil " . The reverse , ring of woe , had the identical effect except it created a zone of " protection from good " . Effects .

title: Ring of lore
description: Ring of lore A ring of lore was a magical ring giving powers of knowledge . Powers . It granted the wearer the ability to cast " legend lore " and " stone tell " once each per tenday with the correct command word .

title: Ring of mind shielding
description: Ring of mind shielding A ring of mind shielding is a magical device that helps keep the one who wears it continually immune to the spells " detect thoughts " , " discern lies " , and any attempt to magically discern his or her alignment . It is worth 8 , 000 gp . Appearance .

title: Ring of negation
description: Ring of negation A Ring of Negation was a cursed ring useful for controlling captive mage s . The purpose of the ring was to prevent the wearer from casting spells . Whenever the mage wearing the ring attempted to use magic , searing pain shot up their arm .

title: Ring of nine lives
description: Ring of nine lives A ring of nine lives is an ivory ring with the face of a snarling cat . If the wearer falls unconscious or dies , one of the ring ' s " lives " will be used automatically to cast a " heal " spell on the wearer . Also , if the wearer needs extremely quick reflexes , strong willpower or extreme fortitude , he or she can use one of the " lives " for this purpose .

title: Ring of nondetection
description: Ring of nondetection A ring of nondetection makes it impossible to detect the whereabouts of a person wearing the ring . Appearance . A ring of nondetection is normally made of plain gold .

title: Ring of protection
description: Ring of protection A ring of protection was a magical device that helped keep the one who wore it from physical harm . The ring could deflect a small part of most attacks . Creation .

title: Ring of spell storing
description: Ring of spell storing A ring of spell storing was a magic ring that stored a number of spell s . Powers . As the name suggested , a " ring of spell storing " stored a spell for later use .

title: Ring of spellbattle
description: Ring of spellbattle A ring of spellbattle ( also spelled ring of spell - battle ) was a gold ring inset with silver spheres and communicated to its wearer any spellcasting that occured within 60 feet ( 20m ) . If the wearer knew spellcraft , it was possible that he or she could identify the spell , even if he or she could not see it at all , and once per day , the ring could be commanded to cast " dispel magic " as a counterspell or change the target of the spell , but only to new targets within 60 feet ( 20m ) . Otherwise the redirection failed .

title: Ring of sustenance
description: Ring of sustenance A ring of sustenance was a useful magical ring that provided the benefit of nourishment and restful effects while worn . Powers . Wearers did not require food or drink , and required much less in the way of actual sleep .

title: Ring of telekinesis
description: Ring of telekinesis A ring of telekinesis was a magical ring that allowed the bearer to use the spell " telekinesis " at will . Powers . As the name suggested , the ring gave the wearer the power of " telekinesis " , allowing them to move items and creatures weighing up to 225 lb ( 102 kg ) .

title: Ring of the Unquenchable
description: Ring of the Unquenchable The Ring of the Unquenchable was an efreeti military force located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Activities . Though they were a slave legion , the efreeti mamluk s of the Ring of the Unquenchable were favored by the Sultan .

title: Ring of the holy slayer
description: Ring of the holy slayer Rings of the holy slayer were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These special rings were only used by holy slayer s . Powers .

title: Ring of the vizier
description: Ring of the vizier The ring of the vizier was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This magic item was available in a wide variety of ring types .

title: Ring of youth
description: Ring of youth Rings of youth were magical rings that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . Any wearer of these rings only aged at one - third of the normal rate .

title: Ringed Nose
description: Ringed Nose The Ringed Nose was a tavern in East Sabban of Keltar that was a good place to discuss secrets . The tavern was one of the more " seedy " bars in East Sabban . It was situated amongst the slaughterhouses of that district , and thus the stench was usually terrible , no matter how good the food being served there might actually smell .

title: Ringreemeralxoth
description: Ringreemeralxoth Ringreemeralxoth was a young adult green dragon that , as of 1370 DR , lived in the Snakewood southwest of Brigand ' s Gorge and west of the Gulf of Storms . Personality . Ring was was not overly aggressive and tended to stay close to his lair .

title: Rings of arbitration
description: Rings of arbitration Rings of arbitration are a pair of rings crafted for lovers who are bound body and soul . They are both a blessing and a curse because through the power of the rings a burden , such as drain of life - force , is shared between the wearers . The rings were created long ago by magic long lost to the world and only a few pairs exist .

title: Riordan Parnell
description: Riordan Parnell Riordan Parnell was a human bard and a member of Spysong . Description . Riordan was lithe of build and was regarded as quite handsome .

title: Ripper
description: Ripper Ripper was a fiendish displacer beast who served the drow blackguard , Zedarr T ' sarran . Description . Much larger than most displacer beast s , Ripper was as big as a dire tiger .

title: Ripplebark
description: Ripplebark Ripplebark was a large subterranean fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was known to dwarves as " arantym " and was a major food source for orc s in the North . It grew in shelf - like formations that resembled masses of decaying flesh but had a nut - like flavor .

title: Riqq
description: Riqq A riqq ( REEK ) was a Zakharan tambourine . Description . " Riqqs " were essentially tiny drum fixed with chimes or bells into slots around the sides .

title: Riqq of the efreet
description: Riqq of the efreet The riqq of the efreet was an unbreakable magical musical instrument created by efreet craftsmen for the high chieftain of the jann of the High Desert on his ascension day . Since each new jann chieftain received a full set of magical instruments known collectively as the instruments of the jann , there were multiple " riqqs of the efreet " scattered throughout Zakhara . Description .

title: Rise of the King
description: Rise of the King Rise of the King is the second book of the Companions Codex series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Risen Sun heresy
description: Risen Sun heresy The Risen Sun heresy is the belief that the time of Lathander ' s transformation is nigh and Amaunator is about to return . The Brotherhood of the Glorious Sun has long existed within the church of Lathander , tolerated by other followers of the Morninglord and preaching that Lathander is the reincarnated form of Amaunator . Believers of the Risen Sun take this one step further into heresy .

title: Ristamar Rhaal
description: Ristamar Rhaal Ristamar Rhaal was a mercenary recruiter in Amn . Personality . Lord Rhaal was a very dignified man , but he still maintained a sense of humor .

title: Risuak Lake
description: Risuak Lake Risuak Lake was a small , fresh - water lake in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier , known for the quality of its fishing . Risuak Lake was located northwest of the Lugalpgotak Sea and was connected to that great body of water by a stream . The village of Vekkak was on its shores , and Gotokok was found along the stream to the south .

title: Rite of Blood
description: Rite of Blood Rite of Blood is a short story by Elaine Cunningham . Plot . Young Liriel Baenre , daughter of Gromph Baenre , has reached the age for her Blooding .

title: Rite of Rebirth
description: Rite of Rebirth The Rite of Rebirth was ritual created by the god Bahamut designed to transform good - aligned non - draconic humanoids into dragonborn of Bahamut . Background . The Platinum Dragon rejected the thought of breeding creatures to oppose the aberrant creations of Tiamat .

title: Rite of Unwinding
description: Rite of Unwinding The Rite of Unwinding was a Shar ran ritual designed to create an ever - expanding dead - magic zone by slowly suppressing the Weave ( as destroying it would also destroy the Shadow Weave ) . The disruption to the Weave caused by this ritual reacted violently to users of silver fire , causing them to be hurt badly every moment they spent within the ritual ' s radius .
