The closer one got to the source of the ritual , the worse its effects became , with the worst being a dead - magic zone that allowed the Shadow Weave to still function .

title: Ritual
description: Ritual A Ritual is a complex ceremony that create magical effects . History . Rituals are as old as magic use itself .

title: Ritual of Purification
description: Ritual of Purification “ " In ancient times the guardian was created to protect Illefarn . If the time has come to dismantle our great instrument , you will be an agent of its destruction " ” - Ritual Statue , Neverwinter Nights 2 History . The Ritual of Purification was presented in the game " Neverwinter Nights 2 " as a " safety ward " developed by the Illefarn Empire to destroy , or severely diminish its guardian , who became the evil King of Shadows .

title: Ritual of Return
description: Ritual of Return Little is known of this powerful arcane ritual but it is believed to be capable of freeing Calim and Memnon from their prison . The ritual requires two books , one of which is held by the efreet of the city of Memnon . The other book was in the possession of Corvus Nightfeather .

title: Ritual of the border
description: Ritual of the border The Ritual of the Border was a powerful spell devised by the elven mage Vraith . The spell could be used to enlarge the size of plagueland or it could be used to encapsulate rogue areas of spellplague . The ritual required volunteers , who often died horribly during the ritual .

title: Ritual of twin burnings
description: Ritual of twin burnings The ritual of twin burnings was a complex and extremely evil arcane evocation spell or binding ritual that obliterated the body and spirit of a sacrificial victim . Its sole purpose was to create runes of chaos around " Thakorsil ' s Seat " , in order to permanently bind a creature to that artifact and enslave them to the caster ' s will . Components .

title: Ritual strength
description: Ritual strength Ritual strength was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only used by sha ' ir s . Effects .

title: Riurmorn
description: Riurmorn Riurmorn was a businessman in Tasseldale in 1368 DR . Activities . Riurmorn , a man of unknown origin , owned Riurmorn ' s Silks and Linens , a textile business that imported Sembia n textiles and eastern silk .

title: Rivalen Tanthul
description: Rivalen Tanthul Rivalen Tanthul was one of the twelve Princes of Shade . Rivalen was an accomplished wizard but also The " Nightseer " , a high priest of Shar , the goddess of loss and night . This made him what the Netheril call a Theurge , blending the magic of the Art and the Power .

title: River Agis
description: River Agis The River Agis flowed from the east out of the Marching Mountains and into the Trackless Sea near the city of Memnon . The river was called the Memnon River in most of Tethyr . It served as the border between Calimshan and Tethyr ever since the Eye Tyrant Wars .

title: River Ardulith
description: River Ardulith The River Ardulith was a river on the island of Evermeet . It flowed into the sea at the island ' s capital , Leuthilspar , on the east coast . Although it was a large river , its flow was gentle .

title: River Ashaba
description: River Ashaba The River Ashaba was one of two major rivers running through Cormanthor ( the other was the Duathamper , or Elvenflow ) . Geography . The river cut the forest roughly in half from Shadowdale in the Dalelands to Semberholme .

title: River Caraguir
description: River Caraguir The River Caraguir was located in Dambrath . Geography . The River Caraguir originated in the Gnollwatch Mountains , flowing south across Dambrath before emptying into the Bay of Dancing Dolphins .

title: River Chionthar
description: River Chionthar The River Chionthar was a large river that ran through the Western Heartlands . The river started high up in the Far Hills and flowed west into the Trackless Sea on the Sword Coast . Trade .

title: River Dessarin
description: River Dessarin The River Dessarin was a major river that flowed through the Savage Frontier in Northwest Faerûn . Description . This river was the main route for trade and commerce of this region .

title: River Dolsel
description: River Dolsel The River Dolsel was a river in the Guthland on the Chultan Peninsula . Geography . The river started in the Dolsel Gap and drained into the Thingulph .

title: River Esmur
description: River Esmur The River Esmur flowed from the west out of the Elkannath Mountains and into the Dragon Sea , across the lands of the Dusk Ports . Background . The River Esmur was known for its rich banks of fishes , eels , and the coveted rock crab s .

title: River Heldar
description: River Heldar The River Heldar was a small river found in the middle of Durpar in the Shining Lands of the Shining South . Geography . The river originated within the Dustwall Mountains , flowing south on a brief course before meeting the Golden Water .

title: River Ith
description: River Ith The River Ith was the longest river in Tethyr . It began in the Snowflake Mountains and Omlarandin Mountains and flowed west across Tethyr , passing through the capital city of Darromar ( formerly Ithmong ) and into the sea at the Sword Coast a few miles west of Myratma . The river formed the southern border of the Purple Marches , Crown Lands , and Golden Marches and the northern border of Ankaram Duchy and Suretmarch .

title: River Lapendrar
description: River Lapendrar The River Lapendrar , also called the River of Sorrows , was a river that , as of 1357 DR , formed the western boundary of Thay , in east Faerûn . It was named " River of Sorrows " after the gold miners who died working its banks and the Aglarond an army that died there . The river originated in the Thaymount mountain range .

title: River Lesh
description: River Lesh The River Lesh was located in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . The River Lesh originated in the Dustwall Mountains of northeast Durpar .

title: River Madras
description: River Madras The River Madras was a small waterway found near the borders of Durpar and Var the Golden in the Shining Lands . Geography . The river flowed southeast from the Aerilpar Forest in Veldorn before joining the River Panka and heading due east to empty into the Golden Water .

title: River Mirar
description: River Mirar The River Mirar was a river in the North . The mouth of the river , on the Sword Coast North , split the city of Luskan in two . The ruins of Illusk sat on its southern bank .

title: River Orlaphar
description: River Orlaphar The River Orlaphar flowed from the north out of the Glaur Lake and into the Trackless Sea , across the lands of the kingdom of Gontal . Features . The valley surrounding River Orlaphar was wild and trackless , full of strange monsters that defied description such as the anaxim s .

title: River Rauthenflow
description: River Rauthenflow The River Rauthenflow was a waterway in northern Mulhorand known for possessing an exceptionally fast current . The Rauthenflow connected Gbor Nor in the Hordelands with the Alamber Sea . Geography .

title: River Rauvin
description: River Rauvin The River Rauvin flowed from the Rauvin Mountains into the River Surbrin and eventually drained into the Dessarin River and out to the Sea of Swords . Description . The Rauvin was often called the Road Through the Marches .

title: River Redrun
description: River Redrun The River Redrun was a river in Luruar . Geography . The River Redrun began in the Druarwood and flowed southeast past the Moonwood and the Night Trees through the Moonlands .

title: River Rimril
description: River Rimril The River Rimril was a river in eastern Amn that was a part of the Esmelflow . Description . The river began somewhere in the Troll Mountains .

title: River Rith
description: River Rith The River Rith was a river that flowed south from the northwest of the Border Kingdoms near the village of Arnglar to join the River Scelptar not far from the town of Manywaters . The river was bridged from Manywaters on the eastern bank , allowing a road west to Irl .

title: River Road
description: River Road The River Road was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This road encircled Huzuz from the north .

title: River Ruin
description: River Ruin The River Ruin was the largest river in the Land of the Yak - Men and northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The River Ruin flowed out of the peaks of the World Pillar Mountains within the Ghost Leopard province of the Yikarian Empire , cascading north and west into the Sun ' s Eye province before passing the Blackwash Fens and emptying into the Great Sea at Pearl Bay .

title: River Scelptar
description: River Scelptar The River Scelptar was a large river that flowed from the Qurth Forest in the northeast of the Border Kingdoms to the Shining Sea in the southwest , a distance of approximately 300 miles . The mouth of the river was called simply Scelptarmouth . The River Rith was a tributary from the north , connecting about 100 miles inland .

title: River Shaar
description: River Shaar The River Shaar was an important feature of the Shaar . Geography . The River Shaar originated from the Riftlake in Underhome .

title: River Shining Tavern
description: River Shining Tavern The River Shining Tavern was a tavern in Faerûn that bore the nickname of the Delimbiyr River . The proprietors of the building also used Delimbiyr as their family name . History .

title: River Soshenstar
description: River Soshenstar The River Soshenstar was one of the three great rivers of Chult . The river was in the north - central region of the jungle and flowed from the Swamp of Sorrows into the Bay of Chult . The town of Port Nyanzaru was located at its mouth .

title: River Surbrin
description: River Surbrin The River Surbrin was a river in the Silver Marches . It flowed from the Spine of the World , after which it was joined by the River Rauvin , and later the Goblintide River , the Laughingflow , and Horn Stream . The River Surbrin then fed into the River Dessarin .

title: River Talar
description: River Talar The River Talar flowed along the southern fringe of the Shaar plains , providing access to Sheirtalar on the Shining Sea . Geography . The River Talar was fed by both the Shaar and Channath rivers near Shaareach .

title: River Tamthew
description: River Tamthew The River Tamthew was a small river found in southern Luiren in the Shining South . Geography . The River Tamthew originated in the heart of the Southern Lluirwood .

title: River Tath
description: River Tath The River Tath was one of the three great rivers of Chult . The river was in the western region of the jungle and flowed from the Swamp of Sorrows into the Trackless Sea between the Kobold Mountains and the Mistcliffs . The aldani lived in this river , as in the other large rivers of Chult .

title: River Umber
description: River Umber The River Umber was a fast flowing river , full of cascades , that formed part of the natural border between Aglarond and Thesk . The river has its headwaters in the high glaciers of Thaymount and flowed west . At the town of Nethentir if flowed down the First Escarpment and into Lake Umber , and from there it flowed through the Dragonjaw Mountains into the Sea of Dlurg .

title: River Valashar
description: River Valashar The River Valashar was a river in Amn , in the region of the former kingdom of the same name . Geography . The river started in the lower peaks of the Snowflake Mountains in the east of Amn , within the forest of Shilmista .

title: River Vesper
description: River Vesper The River Vesper was a river in the Vast that ran from the Earthspur Mountains to the Dragon Reach . Geography . The River Vesper began in the Earthspur Mountains and descended through the High Country down a long series of heavy waterfalls and rocky cascades .

title: River Xon
description: River Xon The River Xon was a river that lay along the border between Durpar and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . To the folk of the Hordelands and followers of the Padhra , it was the Gaya , called the River of Life and the Sacred River . Geography .

title: River of Blood
description: River of Blood The River of Blood was a cross - planar feature in the World Tree cosmology of the plane s . It was a huge and stinking river that flowed through many of the fiendish planes , connecting them similarly to how the World Tree connected the celestial planes . The source of the River of Blood was thought to lie somewhere in the Abyss .

title: River of Gold
description: River of Gold The River of Gold was a beautiful waterway located on the Island of Gardens within the Corsair Domains off the coast of northwest Zakhara . Description . The river originated atop a high cliff on the island , splitting to the south into two majestic waterfalls .

title: River of Shadows
description: River of Shadows The River of Shadows is a rocky and treacherous waterway located in the nation of Mulhorand . Geography . The River of Shadows flows west from its origin near the Dragonsword Mountains .

title: River of Spears
description: River of Spears The River of Spears provides water to the majority of the farms located in the nation of Mulhorand . Geography . The River of Spears flows west from the Dragonsword Mountains , across the Great Vale , and eventually empties into the Alamber Sea at the city of Gheldaneth .

title: River of Swords
description: River of Swords The River of Swords served as the border between the lands of Mulhorand and Unther . This river is divided into upper and lower portions at the ruins of Sekras . Upper Sword .

title: River of sand
description: River of sand River of sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . The spell created a barreling river of sand that was 80 feet ( 24 .

title: River of the Dawn
description: River of the Dawn The River of the Dawn lay between the lands of Mulhorand and Thay . Both nations claimed this waterway as their own , and combat between the forces of both sides erupted on occasion . Geography .

title: Rivermoot
description: Rivermoot Rivermoot was a very small town in the Lower Rauvin Vale in the Silver Marches , nestled on the trail between the High Hold and Nesme . It sat between the northern bank of the River Rauvin and the River Surbrin , at the foot of the Frost Hills south of the Spine of the World mountains . It was protected by a sturdy palisade on its east side , and by the two rivers on its south and north - west sides , making it defensible .

title: Rivershire
description: Rivershire Rivershire was one of the counties of Tethyr and a major agricultural territory . In 1370 DR , it was the most stable of Tethyr ' s counties . Geography .

title: Riviar Darkwind
description: Riviar Darkwind Riviar Darkwind was the second - in - command of the Zhentarim military forces of Darkhold and the leader of the elite Storm Watch company in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Riviar disliked wizard s ( even Sememmon , though she kept this secret in her heart ) .

title: Riyas
description: Riyas Old Riyas lived atop the highest peaks on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Old Riyas was an aging great roc .

title: Rizzen Do ' Urden
description: Rizzen Do ' Urden Rizzen , later known as Rizzen Do ' Urden , was the patron of House Do ' Urden until his death . Description . Rizzen was described as " handsome but otherwise unremarkable .

title: Ro ' kolor
description: Ro ' kolor Ro ' kolor was a drow rogue of Menzoberranzan and a member of Bregan D ' aerthe in 1479 DR . Personality . Ro ' kolor could be influenced by those who showed to him how gain the biggest profit for himself and Bregan D ' aerthe .

title: Road of the Patriarch
description: Road of the Patriarch Road of the Patriarch is the third and final novel of The Sellswords trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Road to Enlightenment
description: Road to Enlightenment The Road to Enlightenment , or the Enlightened Way , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Road to Enlightenment was one of the largest streets in Golden Huzuz .

title: Roalgan
description: Roalgan Roalgan was the leader of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in 1370 DR . Description . Roalgan was a very large man with long red hair and a heavy beard .

title: Roaoum
description: Roaoum Roaoum was a subchief of the Tiger Coral tribe of locathah and a member of the Nantarn Council . Relashionship . Roaoum was the son of chief Cuvis and a long - time acquaintance of merfolk prince Mirol .

title: Roaring Griffon
description: Roaring Griffon The Roaring Griffon ( once The Drowning Fish ) was an inn in Marsember , Cormyr . Location . The inn stood in the south central portion of the westernmost islet , north of its docks .

title: Roaring Lion Inn
description: Roaring Lion Inn The Roaring Lion Inn was an inn found in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located just off Whistleturn Way , near the Market . It was known as the best inn in the city around 1358 DR , with excellent accommodations but a high price to match .

title: Roaringhorn ( Waterdeep )
description: Roaringhorn ( Waterdeep ) Roaringhorn was a noble house of Waterdeep . They bred horses in Amphail , where they owned an estate and personal guard . The head of the family had six nieces , all of whom were wizard s .

title: Rob Heinsoo
description: Rob Heinsoo Rob Heinsoo is a game developer for Wizards of the Coast . He helped write the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting " and is the designer of Three - Dragon Ante , a unique card game . Other Forgotten Realms works include the sourcebook " Monsters of Faerûn " .

title: Robe of gentle repose
description: Robe of gentle repose A robe of gentle repose was a garment that when worn would halt the decomposition process . This was especially valued by undead who wished to maintain the appearance of still being a living creature . Description .

title: Roben
description: Roben Roben was a kensai adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Roben born to a shipping merchant and lived a comfortable life indulging in harmless pleasures .

title: Robert J . Kuntz
description: Robert J . Kuntz Robert J . Kuntz is a game designer and one of the first people ever to play Gary Gygax ' Dungeons & Dragons .

title: Robert J . Schwalb
description: Robert J . Schwalb Robert J . Schwalb is a writer in the roleplaying game industry .

title: Robert Lazzaretti
description: Robert Lazzaretti Robert Lazzarettii ( also credited as Rob Lazzaretti ) is an American fantasy cartographer . He took up strategy gaming during high school , and attended Lincoln College and Illinois State University . He took up a path to Game Designers Workshop and took to map illustration mainly because nobody else in his department enjoyed the role .

title: Robert Wiese
description: Robert Wiese Robert Wiese is a biochemist and a former game designer for Wizards of the Coast . Career . Wiese was a long - time player in the RPGA who eventually worked for the RPGA for seven years .

title: Robillard
description: Robillard Robillard was a powerful wizard and close ally of Deudermont . He served as the second - in - command on Deudermont ' s vessel , the " Sea Sprite " and was a former member of the Arcane Brotherhood . He was a capable magic user and was even skilled in the art of healing , aiding Deudermont after an assassination attempt , an act which helped save the life of Wulfgar the barbarian ; had Deudermont not woken , Wulfgar would have been falsely executed for the alleged assassination attempt , a crime which Deudermont confirmed he did not commit .

title: Robyn Kendrick
description: Robyn Kendrick Robyn Kendrick was the ward of the king of Caer Corwell . Description . Robyn was a beautiful young lady with bright green eyes and thick black hair .

title: Roc
description: Roc Rocs were gargantuan eagle - like birds that inhabited the highest mountains in warm regions . As large as these great birds were , they paled in both size and ferocity to the mighty Zakharan roc s of the Land of Fate . Ecology .

title: Rock crab
description: Rock crab Rock crabs were a variety of crabs endemic to the River Esmur , in Returned Abeir . Because of this , rock crabs were coveted in many other regions of the continent , and the merchants and fishers of Tarsith made lots of money exporting the crabs to other regions . Rock crabs were prepared by rolling its flesh into balls and later baking them .

title: Rock crystal
description: Rock crystal Rock crystal was another name for colorless , transparent . Description . This clear semi - precious stone was considered lower grade if it was soft or brittle , but was frequently used to adorn furniture or decorative head gear .

title: Rock gnome
description: Rock gnome Rock gnomes are a curious , childlike race very much unlike their cousins , the " svirfneblin " or deep gnomes and the forest gnome s . When most people think of gnome s , they are thinking of the rock gnome . Rock gnomes embody the characteristics of their creator and patron deity , Garl Glittergold , choosing to spend their long lives by filling each day with as much fun and enjoyment as possible .

title: Rock of Bral
description: Rock of Bral The Rock of Bral was one of the asteroids making up the Tears of Selûne , which orbited the planet Toril behind its moon Selûne . Government . The Rock was ruled by Prince Andru , grandson of a bandit king named Cozar , but several other factions wielded power as well .

title: Rock of Fasting
description: Rock of Fasting The Rock of Fasting was located within the fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . This 600 ft .

title: Rockbottom
description: Rockbottom Rockbottom was a dwarf cleric . He was part of an expedition that accompanied the Companions of the Hall to Shallows in 1370 DR , only to be attacked by orc s and frost giant s , and did what he could to heal Withegroo Seian ' Doo and Bruenor Battlehammer .

title: Rocktappers
description: Rocktappers The Rocktappers of the Earthfasts were an association of people who worked and explored the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast and Impiltur . They consisted largely of lone prospectors , fur trappers , and other mountain folk , and were often hermits or outcasts of mainstream society . Their numbers were highly variable and difficult to estimate , and fluctuated as new people ventured into mountains , old members gave up and returned to civilization , and others died in the wilderness .

title: Rocnest
description: Rocnest Rocnest was a high , rocky outcrop and natural citadel in Evereska that had housed elven garrisons for nearly a thousand years since the Crown Wars . Though the fortress was abandoned after the fall of Aryvandaar , its location between Evereska and the Greycloak Hills meant that the elves of Evereska continued to maintain it as a watch post . History .

title: Rod
description: Rod A rod is a scepterlike magical device that have unique magical powers . Anyone can use a rod . Realmslore .

title: Rod of Four Moons
description: Rod of Four Moons The Rod of Four Moons was the favored weapon of the Faerûn ian moon goddess Selûne . Uses . The weapon was a " + 5 defending disruption holy heavy mace " .

title: Rod of cats
description: Rod of cats A rod of cats is a black wooden rod seven feet ( 2 . 1m ) in length , with a carved cat ' s head at one end . It is a magic + 1 quarterstaff and when held , it improves the wielder ' s ability to " climb " , " hide " , " move silently " and see in the dark or low light .

title: Rod of displacement
description: Rod of displacement The rod of displacement was invented when Myth Drannor was in its prime and it acts like a " minor globe of displacement " when held . It allows the wielder to use " jump " and " knock " twice per day . Once a day , the wielder can create a sphere five feet ( 1 .

title: Rod of divergence
description: Rod of divergence A rod of divergence is constructed to act against one type of energy , and provides " resist energy " for that type of energy . It can produce " faerie fire " at will , and once per day , the rod will automatically spell turn any incoming spell of the rod ' s energy type , provided it can be turned . The rod is worth around 33 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Rod of fury
description: Rod of fury Rods of fury were the creation of the wizard s of Mulhorand and usually have the end carved into the shape of a Mulhorandi deity . The rods give varying levels of protection between + 1 and + 5 , and once per day , the rod can use " Empower Spell " . Depending on the quality of the rod , it can be worth between 27 , 000 gold pieces and 96 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Rod of leadership
description: Rod of leadership The rod of leadership was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item appeared as a stout rod that could actually be used as a potent melee weapon .

title: Rod of mirrors
description: Rod of mirrors A rod of mirrors gives the holder the ability to make an insubstantial round mirror at its end , two feet ( 0 . 6m ) in diameter , which lasts for eleven minutes , and when the holder looks through the back , sees as the spell " true seeing " . The holder is also immune to all gaze attacks and illusion effects coming from the other side of the mirror .

title: Rod of rulership
description: Rod of rulership A rod of rulership enabled its wielder to impose his or her will to would - be subjects . They felt a wave of compulsion washing over them , a telepathic call to fall to their knees and obey the wielder . Persons of strong mind could withstand its effect though .

title: Rod of silence
description: Rod of silence A rod of silence was carved with symbols of cat s ' paws and owl s . Powers . It gave the holder the ability to cast " silence " once per day on himself or herself , although the silence affected nobody else .

title: Rod of smiting
description: Rod of smiting Rods of smiting were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Rods by the same name could be found elsewhere in Toril . Powers .

title: Rod of spheres
description: Rod of spheres A rod of spheres allows its wielder to create up to three spheres per day . These spheres are four feet ( 1 . 2m ) in diameter and float a few feet off the ground .

title: Rod of surprises
description: Rod of surprises A rod of surprises is a magic rod that can be extended up to 60 feet ( 20m ) and support up to 800 pounds ( 363kg ) . It is worth around 22 , 000 gold pieces . A rod of surprises can store a message up to 25 words , and works like the " magic mouth " spell .

title: Rod of the monolith
description: Rod of the monolith The rod of of the monolith was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item resembled a short staff .

title: Rod of the twisted Weave
description: Rod of the twisted Weave The rod of the twisted Weave was an item with properties similar to a " rod of absorption " except instead of storing spell energy it released it as a backlash of negative energy . Description . A " rod of the twisted Weave " was a long scepter that tapered to a point at one end made of a black - colored material .

title: Rod of tuning
description: Rod of tuning A rod of tuning can produce any tuning note , which is useful for bard s or clerics of Milil when tuning musical instruments , but it is also capable of creating other , magical notes , with powerful effects . Once per day it can create a note that acts as a " holy word " spell to any evil creatures within 30 feet ( 10m ) . Also , once per day it can create a note that acts as a " banishment " spell to outsider s within 30 feet .

title: Rod of viscid globs
description: Rod of viscid globs A rod of viscid globs was a silver rod that could fire up to five sticky spheres per day , up to 100 feet ( 30m ) . These spheres acted like tanglefoot bag s , and the spheres dissolved quickly in alcohol . The rod was worth around 6 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Rod of whips
description: Rod of whips A rod of whips was a magic rod that could be commanded to transform into a " + 1 dancing whip " by sprouting a tendril of force . It functioned three times per day , with each transformation lasting for an hour . This whip acted as a " spiritual weapon " against incorporeal creatures .

title: Roddy McGristle
description: Roddy McGristle Roddy McGristle was a human bounty hunter . He wielded an axe named Bleeder , and was usually accompanied by a pair of hunting dogs . After the deaths of the Thistledown farming family at the hands of the barghest whelp Ulgulu ( who was disguised as a drow during the act ) , a bounty was placed on the head of the Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: Roderick Tem
description: Roderick Tem Roderick Tem was a male human leader of the Fire Knives during the Time of Troubles . History . Roderick was the leader of the Fire Knives during the Time of Troubles in 1358 .

title: Roderik Hilltopple
description: Roderik Hilltopple Roderik Hilltopple was a strongheart halfling shepherd sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Roderik was captured by the hill giant s of Chief Guh and taken as a prisoner to Grudd Haug .

title: Roderin Obarskyr
description: Roderin Obarskyr King Roderin Obarskyr , or Roderin the Bastard , was crowned the king of Cormyr after the reign of Gantharla Obarskyr in 261 DR . He succeeded her despite his illegitimacy due to the support of the Silver families and Baerauble . Unfortunately , he did not have an heir when he died and was succeeded by his mother ' s cousin Thargreve .

title: Rodolfo
description: Rodolfo Rodolfo was the most veteran navigator of the Trackless Sea . History . Rodolfo was a sailor who knew the Trackless Sea very well .

title: Roe
description: Roe Roe was a male human Watch lieutenant of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Roe was the lieutenant of the Watch .

title: Roejan Benster
description: Roejan Benster Roejan Benster was a Veteran Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR . Personality . Roejan was a scheming man with an ugly appearance but an agreeable personality .

title: Rog ' osto
description: Rog ' osto Located about 250 miles up the Nogaro River from Dihliz , the Zakhara n city of Rog ' osto was famed for its strange and lofty towers of bright metal . It was believed that this was once the site of the capital of the now - fallen kingdom of Nog .

title: Roge Applewink
description: Roge Applewink Roge Applewink was a large halfling farmer in the Moonsea . Activities . Roge regularly sold his products to Reyill Werned .

title: Roger E . Moore
description: Roger E . Moore Roger E . Moore is a writer of roleplaying games best known for his long - running tenure as editor of Dragon magazine , and was the founding editor of Dungeon magazine .

title: Rogrotus
description: Rogrotus Rogrotus was a black dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Rogrotus was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Rogue
description: Rogue Rogues were versatile masters of stealth , combat , and various skillful tricks . Where other adventurers had the power to defeat their enemies , rogues used their wits and their natural resourcefulness to exploit their foes ' vulnerabilities as well as to lead their allies safely through dangerous environments , disarming traps and opening lock along the way . Several well - known rogues of Toril include Ravenscar of Baldur ' s Gate , Regis of the Companions of the Hall , and Mirt of Waterdeep .

title: Rogue stone
description: Rogue stone A rogue stone ( sometimes written roguestone ) was a small , extremely rare magical gemstone with a tendency to cause wild magic . Description . Rogue stones were filled with rainbow colors that flowed as if in liquid , slowly swirling iridescently , when exposed to sunlight .

title: Rohini
description: Rohini Rohini is a succubus currently living with the Abolethic Sovereignty in Neverwinter . In the late 1470s she was sent to Neverwinter on a mission by her master , the Erinyes Invadiah , to attempt to create conflict between the Sovereignty and the god Asmodeus . Rohini was able to seduce the head priest of Oghma ' s House of Knowledge in Neverwinter .

title: Roi Uxio
description: Roi Uxio Roi Uxio was a soldier of the Red Plumes in Yulash . Activities . Roi was stationed at the Red Plumes camp in Yulash .

title: Rokthorl
description: Rokthorl Rokthorl was a dragonborn settlement and the capital of Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . Rokthorl was a " mobile " city .

title: Roldilar
description: Roldilar Roldilar , or the Realm of Glimmering Swords , was a shield dwarf kingdom that occupied the lands later known as the Vast , between Cormanthyr and Impiltur in north Faerûn , both below and above ground . It was founded in 610 DR and fell in 649 DR . History .

title: Rolf Sunriver
description: Rolf Sunriver Rolf Sunriver was the Chief Constable of Ravens Bluff from 1352 DR - - ? Appearance . Rolf is 5 ' 9 " tall and weighs 180 pounds ; compact and muscular .

title: Rolf Trygveson
description: Rolf Trygveson Rolf Trygveson was a notable inhabitant of Hawa . Description . Tall and strong , Rolf had striking blond hair that stood out among the predominantly dark - haired Zakharans of the Corsair Domains .

title: Rolim Durothil
description: Rolim Durothil Rolim Durothil was the third son of the Durothil patriarch , so he could not inherit a position of power in ancient Aryvandaar . He was a warrior and survived the Crown Wars . His father send him with the expedition to Evermeet to colonize the island in name of all elves .

title: Rolivar Brimbruir
description: Rolivar Brimbruir Rolivar Brimbruir was a cleric of Chauntea with the rank of Trueseed that resided in the Bounty of the Goddess temple in Voonlar . Description . Rolivar was a burly man with bushy brown hair that was mostly concentrated on the sides of his face and mustache as he slowly went bald .

title: Rolk
description: Rolk Rolk was a dwarf merchant in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rolk was a gregarious individual who recently had a change of fortune .

title: Rollo
description: Rollo Rollo was a very young dwarf of Mithril Hall in the late 15th century DR . History . Rollo was born " circa " 1465 DR .

title: Rolo
description: Rolo Rolo was an agent of Thylius Caramitru in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Activities . In 1491 DR , Rolo and his brother Jott were the main agents of Thylius , running the Yellow Breath Chapter House for him .

title: Rom
description: Rom Rom were undead giant s that inhabited some underground areas of Zakhara . Description . Rom were only male .

title: Romsan Kal
description: Romsan Kal Romsan Kal was a scarred innkeeper in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Romsan was a jovial individual .

title: Ron Spencer
description: Ron Spencer Ron Spencer is an american illustrator who has done work for companies such as Wizards of the Coast , White Wolf , FASA , Pinnacle Entertainment , AEG , Iron Crown , Dragon Gate , Holistic Design , TSR Games , Privateer Press , Toy Vault , and others . He is most notably known for his work on the " Magic : The Gathering " card game .

title: Rondeval
description: Rondeval Rondeval was a legendary stage performer of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . Several centuries before the Spellplague , Rondeval was a stage performer renowned for his wit , charm , and womanizing ways .

title: Rondeval ( town )
description: Rondeval ( town ) Rondeval was the largest trade - moot in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Background . The town was named after Rondeval , a legendary stage performer .

title: Ronglath Knightsbridge
description: Ronglath Knightsbridge Ronglath Knightsbridge was a male human member of the Zhentarim and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Ronglath was a powerful warrior in service to the Zhentarim and Bane .

title: Ront
description: Ront Ront was an orc who was trapped in the Underdark during the late 1480s DR . History . Ront was an orc warrior of Iceshield tribe in the Dessarin Valley .

title: Rontal Qirattar
description: Rontal Qirattar Rontal Qirattar was a male human cleric of Deneir . He was the farsann of Lady Kyrin Hawkwinter , the countess of Calimmon County in Tethyr . Rontal was in charge of planning Lady Kyrin ' s wedding to Garron Ersemm in the beginning of the Year of the Unstrung Harp , 1371 DR .

title: Rook
description: Rook Rook was an allegedly female drow revenant who lived in Araumycos . She was one of the fabled Morndin of Clan Ironstar . " Rook " wasn ' t her true name , but a nickname Daffyd gave to her since he never asked her true name .

title: Rookery
description: Rookery The Rookery was located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . The Rookery was the most dangerous section of the City of Brass , causing even the Sultan ' s guards to avoid treading there .

title: Rool
description: Rool Rool was a sailor on the Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Rool was the first mate of the " Morkoth " ship and a Kraken Society assassin .

title: Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars
description: Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars The Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars was located within the Potala in Saikhoi , Ra - Khati . Description . The main chamber of the Room of a Hundred and Three Pillars was a giant work of art .

title: Roond Asmyrk
description: Roond Asmyrk Roond Asmyrk was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a priest of Sune and proprietor of the Silvery Sembian Snail tavern . History .

title: Rootweal
description: Rootweal Rootweal was a red wine that originated from the forests of the Yuirwood in Aglarond . Description . The beverage had the color of red silk and was a smooth , full - bodied wine .

title: Roouddan
description: Roouddan The roouddan was a red turnip - like vegetable . It was colloquially known as the " red turnip of Proskur " . It grew around the Sea of Fallen Stars , and was a staple food of peasants .

title: Rope trick
description: Rope trick Rope trick , originally called Undine ' s rope , was a transmutation spell that used a rope to create an extradimensional hiding place . It was a spell known to be favored by the avatar s of the kenku god Quorlinn — in the exceptionally rare case that it used avatars at all . Effects .

title: Roper
description: Roper Ropers are ambush hunters that evolved in the underworld . Description . They take the appearance of stalagmites and wait for a living creature to draw close .

title: Ropes for All Uses
description: Ropes for All Uses Ropes for All Uses was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Ropes for All Uses carried an assortment of standard ropes , both practical and ornamental .

title: Rorgak
description: Rorgak Rorgak was the chief commander under Kaanyr Vhok of the Scoured Legion in 1372 DR . Description . He was red - scaled .

title: Rorlyn Handmane
description: Rorlyn Handmane Lionar Rorlyn Handmane was a high - ranking officer of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Rorlyn was one of the kingdom ' s most experienced officers .

title: Rorn
description: Rorn Rorn , also known as Blazing Rorn the Fury or Rorn of the Rages , was one of the primordial s who fought against the god s before the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Appareance . Rorn was a gigantic humanoid with cooling lava - like skin and the head and tail of a dragon , capable of transforming into a blazing star of light brighter than the sun .

title: Roroaros
description: Roroaros Roroaros was an elder black dragon and one of the " overdragons " of Melabrauth in Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Personality . Roroaros was cruel and enjoyed killing those who had defied him .

title: Rorreth Monforoth
description: Rorreth Monforoth Rorreth Monforoth was an exiled Red Wizard of Thay sent to Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Rorreth was one of the many exiled Red Wizards .

title: Rorskryn Mreldrake
description: Rorskryn Mreldrake Rorskryn Mreldrake was a former War Wizard of Cormyr in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , he was held in thrall by Manshoon .

title: Rorstil Hallowdant
description: Rorstil Hallowdant Rorstil Hallowdant was the steward of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , his underling Corleth Fentable , under the orders of Manshoon , tried to delay the Council of the Dragon while , thanks to Manshoon ' s plots , Rorstil was ill .

title: Rosaline
description: Rosaline Rosaline , also known as unionite , , or , was found in large quantities of soft stone ( usually cut in 1 lb / 2 . 2 kg blocks for trading ) , or in small , hard crystals . Description .

title: Rose
description: Rose A rose was a flowering shrub of the Rosa genus , although the term was often used to describe the flower from this shrub . History . Furthinghome , around 1374 DR , was notable for its culture and export of roses , amongst other flowers .

title: Rose Garden
description: Rose Garden The Rose Garden was a large cluster of various species of roses that grew in the southeast corner of the Battle of Bones . Description . The Rose Garden was large , measuring approximately 140 feet ( 42 .

title: Rose Keep
description: Rose Keep Rose Keep is a trade enclave on the edge of Veltalar , in Aglarond . Appearance . The enclave is walled with scuffed , mortared stone walls .

title: Rosealine Culkin
description: Rosealine Culkin Zora Rosealine Culkin was a noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Rosealine was a typical Mulmaster noble .

title: Rosecork
description: Rosecork A rosecork was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Rosecork wood was durable and extremely resistant to fire . It absorbed such a great concentration of water that open flames could not ignite it , short of exposure to a very hot flame for some hours .

title: Rosemantle
description: Rosemantle Rosemantle was a divine magic spell available to priests of Lathander , the Morninglord . It increased a creature ' s resistance to adverse effects such as fear , nausea , pain , or sickness . Before the Spellplague , it was only available to cleric s of the Morninglord who had been initiated on a path to the faith ' s greatest secrets .

title: Roses of forgetfulness
description: Roses of forgetfulness Roses of forgetfulness were magical flowers that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These strange flowers caused forgetfulness to anyone or anything that inhaled their fragrance .

title: Rosestone Abbey
description: Rosestone Abbey Rosestone Abbey is a partially ruined abbey located in Eastern Thar dedicated to the worship of Amaunator . In 1480 DR Rosestone Abbey was the site of a battle between forces loyal to the rightful Harmach of Hulburg under the command of Kara Hulmaster and those of the shadow mage Rhovann and his puppet Maroth Marstel . The loyalist army won the battle after Geran Hulmaster destroyed a magical device that animated dozens of golem soldiers in Rhovann ' s army .

title: Rot grub
description: Rot grub A rot grub is a 1 inch long grub that eats rotting organic material . They are often found in the bark of treant s in the forest of Cormanthor where they help to combat the tube wilt by eating the rotten wood and the fungal infection that causes it . Outside of Cormanthor , they are most often found in piles of offal or dung , attracted by movement , they will burrow into the nearest moving object and eat whatever they can .

title: Rotface
description: Rotface Rotface was a green hag of the Bloodroot Coven in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Rotface was petty and had a bit of mean streak .

title: Rothé
description: Rothé Rothé were herd animals and one of the primary livestock of human s in Faerûn ' s northern areas and of the drow of the Underdark below . Description . These magical beasts resembled .

title: Rotten Root Tavern
description: Rotten Root Tavern The Rotten Root Tavern was a dive on Silverpiece Way in Westgate that , as of 1480 DR , had been in business for over 100 years . Activities . The establishment was best known for its bad food and drink and its sign depicting an evil - looking treant .

title: Roushoum
description: Roushoum Roushoum , also called Imaskari , was the ancient language of the Imaskari people . Speakers . Roushoum was still spoken deep in the Underdark by the survivors of the Imaskari Empire , the Deep Imaskari .

title: Roving Dragon
description: Roving Dragon The Roving Dragon was an inn and restaurant in Suzail , Cormyr and owned by Caladarea Ithbeck . Geography . The inn was located on the promenade above Braundlae ' s Best , a tavern run by Braundlae .

title: Rowaan Vrinn
description: Rowaan Vrinn Rowaan Vrinn was the drow high priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR . History . Daughter of Leliana Vrinn , Rowaan was chosen to be the high priestess of the Misty Forest .

title: Rowan Babar
description: Rowan Babar Rowan Babar was the founder of the Order of the Dawn and the cult master in 1479 DR . History . Rowan Babar founded the Order of the Dawn in the city of Mreyelundar a few years before 1479 DR .

title: Rowanmantle
description: Rowanmantle House Rowanmantle was a small noble house of Cormyr . The family was originally from the Tilverton area but moved its base to Suzail at some point . The family strongly supported the Obarskyr s and advised the crown during the rule of the Steel Regent .

title: Rowen Cormaeril
description: Rowen Cormaeril Rowen Cormaeril was a Purple Dragon until his cousin Gaspar and several other nobles betrayed the royal family of Cormyr and had their nobility removed by Azoun IV , whereupon he became a scout assigned to Alusair Obarskyr ' s party . He fell in love with princess Tanalasta Obarskyr and eventually married her in the eyes of Chauntea , albeit with no witnesses . He was then separated from her when Alusair ordered him to track down Vangerdahast while the rest of their party fled to safety .

title: Royal Constabulary
description: Royal Constabulary The Royal Constabulary was a law enforcement organization that operated in Tsurlagol in the Vast , in the 7th century DR . History . In the early 7th century DR , the Royal Constabulary discovered the infamous pirate Urthag the Knife boldly carousing in the Bloated Gargoyle Inn .

title: Royal Council of Aglarond
description: Royal Council of Aglarond The Royal Council of Aglarond was the council that advised the Simbul , ruler of Aglarond , during her reign between 1320 DR and 1425 DR . It met monthly , usually at full moon , at the Council Hall in Velprintalar . The council was made up of 30 members , of which 11 are from major cities and the others are from smaller villages in Aglarond .

title: Royal Gardens
description: Royal Gardens The Royal Gardens were gardens around the royal palace Castle Obarskyr . Geography . The gardens were located in Suzail , Cormyr , on the slope of a hill away from the city itself .

title: Royal Gate
description: Royal Gate The Royal Gate was the entrance to the Grand Caliph ' s private apartments within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Royal Gate was constructed of polished stone but , due to a powerful enchantment , could open like a curtain for approaching visitors .

title: Royal Harim of Huzuz
description: Royal Harim of Huzuz The Royal Harim of Huzuz , or simply the Royal Harim , was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The Royal Harim was one of the largest sections of the palace .

title: Royal Mint
description: Royal Mint The Royal Mint was the location where all production of Halruaa ' s currency occurred . Location . The Royal Mint was located in Aluarim in the center of Halruaa .

title: Royal Vagabonds
description: Royal Vagabonds The Royal Vagabonds was a secret Shou Lung spy agency . Description . The Royal Vagabonds were a secret clan in service to the Shou Emperor .

title: Rozsarran Dathan
description: Rozsarran Dathan Rozsarran Dathan was a male warrior who was one of the guards of the Twisted Tower in Shadowdale . History . In 1357 , Rozsarran Dathan was involved in the hunt for Shandril Shessair .

title: Ruatheene
description: Ruatheene Ruatheene was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . She led the Zhent contingent based in the valley of Arntethyl by the river Tesh . She was a favorite of Manshoon .

title: Ruathlek
description: Ruathlek Ruathlek was the " secret language " or magical script of illusionist s . Waterdeep was known to hold at least one library of books in this dweomer - guarded tongue . History .

title: Ruathym
description: Ruathym The island of Ruathym ( ROO - uh - Thim ) was one of the larger islands north of the Moonshae Isles in the Trackless Sea . Geography . Ruathym located more than 200 miles north of the Moonshae Isles .

title: Ruathym ( city )
description: Ruathym ( city ) Ruathym was the largest settlement on the island of Ruathym in the Trackless Sea . Geography . Ruathym was located to the south of Holgerstead , another settlement on the island , and close to the magical ruins of Inthar , where a drow banshee dwelt until 1361 DR .

title: Rubban
description: Rubban Rubban was the term used to describe the captain of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Sometimes , the " rubban " and " nakhuda " , or owner , were the same person .

title: Rubbaniyah
description: Rubbaniyah Rubbaniyah was the term used to describe an officer of a sailing vessel in Zakhara . Activities . Though not required , especially on smaller vessels , " rubbaniyah " were useful in delegating lesser duties to shipmates so the " rubban " and " nakhuda " could focus on other things .

title: Ruben Delgaug
description: Ruben Delgaug Ruben Delgaug was an artist . He was a master artist , a painter , who was long dead by the 1360s DR . Among his works was a set of four paintings of Waterdeep during each season , sized 8×10 inches ( 20×25 centimeters ) .

title: Ruby
description: Ruby Ruby was a variety of that was a popular and plentiful jewel and had many magical uses in addition to its appeal as a sparkling gemstone . Description . Rubies came in a variety of colors , from colorless through shades of red to deep crimson .

title: Ruby Rod of Asmodeus
description: Ruby Rod of Asmodeus The Ruby Rod of Asmodeus is a formidable weapon of evil possessed by the archdevil , Asmodeus . Description . The ruby rod glistens with an unimaginable , unearthly luster .

title: Ruby Way
description: Ruby Way Ruby Way was a reddish crystal road in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Structure . Despite its name , the road was not made from ruby .

title: Ruby blushrose
description: Ruby blushrose The ruby blushrose was a flowering plant that grew within the Rose Garden in the Battle of Bones and other areas of Toril . Description . The flower of this plant was bright red , larger than other roses , and lacked thorns .

title: Ruby pendant
description: Ruby pendant A ruby pendant of beguiling was a ruby pendant with the powers of a " rod of beguiling " . Notable examples . Pasha Pook once owned a " ruby pendant " , and it was a key to his move to the top of the Calimport criminal world .

title: Ruby ray of reversal
description: Ruby ray of reversal Ruby ray of reversal , also known as Nezram ' s ruby ray , was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that reversed , undid , negated , circumvented , or destroyed particular magical spells , mundane hazards , or adverse situations . Effects . When cast , a narrow lance of bright red light emitted from the caster ' s fingertips in the direction he or she pointed toward a single target .

title: Rucien - Xan
description: Rucien - Xan Rucien - Xan was a hidden elven realm allegedly located somewhere in the Chondalwood . Supposedly , it contained only one city , also called Rucien - Xan that served as the capital for both it and the nearby realm of Nikerymath . No explorer or adventurer has ever found Rucien - Xan , though stories exist mentioning it that date back to the time when Jhaamdath was founded .

title: Rudiments of the Shadow Weave
description: Rudiments of the Shadow Weave Rudiments of the Shadow Weave was a controversial book about Shar ran doctrine and the Shadow Weave , written by the wizard Vontallion Rose . Description . " Rudiments of the Shadow Weave " contained a series of prose essays about the wonders and doctrine of the Goddess of Darkness in addition to instructions on how to tap into the power of the Shadow Weave .

title: Ruduk
description: Ruduk Ruduk was a Red Wizard of Thay agent in Messemprar in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Ruduk was sent by the zulkir Lauzoril to destabilize the country in order that one day Thay could conquer it .

title: Rueldarr
description: Rueldarr Rueldarr was the innkeeper of the Flaming Griffon inn in Mordulkin in Chessenta in the early 1370s DR . History . In the winter of the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , Rueldarr rented rooms to Ythnel Duumin , Kestus Aentius , Muctos Dapritus , and Kohtakah , who ' d just escaped to Mordulkin from Luthcheq .

title: Ruen Morleth
description: Ruen Morleth Ruen was a trained monk and rogue who lived in the Mistshore section of Waterdeep harbor . He was a companion of the young wizard Icelin Tearn and the butcher Sull . He was an expert in weaponless combat and held the distinction of being the only person to " escape " from Waterdeep dungeon .

title: Ruexohn
description: Ruexohn Ruexohn was a incubus agent of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR Ruexohn killed and replaced Davon Malaeda , the closest advisor of First Lord Torin Nomerthal .

title: Ruggedo
description: Ruggedo Ruggedo was the deep gnome king of Deepearth in the Underdark in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . Ruggedo ruled Deepearth until the duergar led by the demon lord Orcus seized the city .

title: Ruha
description: Ruha Description . She is described as having sable hair , a proud nose , sultry eyes , and regal cheeks . Her cheeks are tattooed with crossed hash marks .

title: Ruhh Island
description: Ruhh Island Ruhh Island was located on Suq Bay near Hayyir . Geography . Given its position along the well - traveled Dihl al - Suq , Ruhh Island was a haven for pirates hoping to prey upon the richly - laden merchant vessels using the shipping lane .

title: Ruinspoke
description: Ruinspoke Ruinspoke was a frontier village located near the border of Tymanther and Mulhorand . Ruinspoke served as the base of operations for adventurers and official Tymantheran expeditions sent to explore the old ruins of Unther . Description .

title: Ruke Diggot
description: Ruke Diggot Ruke Diggot was a human male scholar from Mistledale . He was tall with curly red hair . During a trip to the forest of Cormanthor to study butterflies , he met the half - elf ranger Lyra Sunrose and they married a few months later , having eleven children together , all of whom still live in Cormanthor .

title: Rukhelmoth Glitterstone
description: Rukhelmoth Glitterstone Rukhelmoth Glitterstone , or simply Rukh was a deep gnome explorer who was held prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , while attempting to sneak into the Fane of the Eye , Rukh was captured by Black Earth cultists .

title: Rulasuu
description: Rulasuu Rulasuu was an island and naval base located off the coast of southwest Halruaa . Description . The island of Rulasuu served as one of two major bases for Halruaa ' s navy .

title: Rulathorn
description: Rulathorn Captain Rulathorn is the aged and distinguished commander of the city watch of Waterdeep . A fair , but tough man , Rulathorn is more than willing to arrest the same person time and again until they cease wrongdoings within the city . Rulathorn reports directly to Open Lord Piergeiron .

title: Ruldarr
description: Ruldarr Ruldarr , a man of grace and manners , was the owner of Ruldarr ' s Pipes , Locks , Tobacco and Fine Furniture in the tiny community of Bargewright Inn in the years after the Time of Troubles . He was also an experienced gardener , his plants taking up much of the room in his house and shop . Description .

title: Ruldorn
description: Ruldorn Ruldorn " the Storm Ranger " is a guide , a Harper and a community leader within the city of Everlund . Ruldorn ' s home is hidden a bit west of city , though he can usually be found frequenting the Battered Hat when not guiding others on various trails . Ruldorn has earned his nickname for his ability to navigate in even the worst of storms .

title: Rule - of - Three
description: Rule - of - Three Rule - of - Three was a cambion working with Graz ' zt in a plan to unite the baatezu , tanar ' ri , and yugoloth s . Rule - of - Three was just about the most knowledgeable source on the Abyss available . He dwelt on Azzagrat in the city of Zelatar or in Sigil .

title: Rule of Dragons
description: Rule of Dragons The Rule of Dragons was a period in Abeir ' s history when dragon s consolidated their rule in the continent of Laerakond . Description . After the War of Fang and Talon , a mighty dragon called Gorloun founded the first dragon empire , and soon rival draconic realms sprang up thereafter .

title: Ruler ' s Ridge
description: Ruler ' s Ridge Ruler ' s Ridge , or Calim ' s See , was a peak in the Marching Mountains . It was one of the locations where the bakkal s of Coramshan were buried and then the site of a great genie battle . Description .

title: Rulers ' Blade
description: Rulers ' Blade The Rulers ' Blade ( also known as the Great King ' s Sword , or Ar ' Cor ' Kerym in Elven , and sometimes referred to as the Crownblade ) , is one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . This particular blade is used to name the Coronal , monarchial ruler of the kingdom of Cormanthyr , leader of the elves . History .

title: Rulisqer
description: Rulisqer Rulisqer of Tyr was a human male paladin of Tyr , god of justice , who policed the town of Mossbridges in the Vast around 1370 DR . Rulisqer and his fourteen followers believed that public safety and lawful behavior would bring happiness and prosperity to all . Through diligent , expert policing , they broke up brawls in the streets and kept out thieves ' guilds .

title: Rumblebelly
description: Rumblebelly Rumblebelly was the horse and mount belonging to Regis of the Companions of the Hall . Description . Rumblebelly was a fat pinto pony .

title: Rumpadump
description: Rumpadump Rumpadump was a myconid sprout in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Rumpadump was very introverted , preferring to hang back and not use its rapport spores unless absolutely necessary .

title: Rundeen
description: Rundeen The Rundeen were a slaving and mercantile consortium that operated in the southern Sword Coast and the Chultan Peninsula . History . They were originally a Tashalaran merchant company that operated during the Shoon Imperium .

title: Rundeth Hobyltar
description: Rundeth Hobyltar Rundeth Hobyltar was the only tailor and dyer of High Dale . Personality . He was cynical and laconic .

title: Rune of chaos
description: Rune of chaos A rune of chaos was a magical symbol representing chaos . There were at least nine runes of chaos . The runes of chaos were a key part of the operation of the dread artifact " Thakorsil ' s Seat " .

title: Runecaster
description: Runecaster A runecaster was a prestige class of Faerûn . Divine spellcasters who knew of the particular advantages of rune magic , runecasters used magic and a special alphabet to create runes , which were symbols that possess magical effects that were both powerful and capable of being used multiple times . Although rune magic was originally created by the dwarves and giants millennia ago , its practice eventually became available to other races .

title: Runehammer
description: Runehammer A runehammer is a magic + 1 warhammer that is made from darksteel . It contains the ability to cast a spell once per day , but the spell is the same each time , stored in the head of the hammer in the shape of a rune , giving the item its name . There are three common types of runehammer : Alhalbrin ( " heat metal " ) , Faerindyl ( " burning hands " ) and Thundaril ( " polymorph other " into either snail or toad ) .

title: Runemeet
description: Runemeet Runemeet is a holy day of Uthgar on the autumn equinox when the Uthgardt tribes travel to their respective ancestor mounts ( or to Beorunna ' s Well , the holiest of all ) for rites , pacts , and communing with ancestors . This is when juveniles who seek recognition as full tribe members prove themselves by hunting their tribes ' ritual enemies . Although Uthgardt ceremonies can be performed anywhere , the Thunderbeast tribe believed it could not stay strong without an ancestor mound .

title: Runestone
description: Runestone Runestones are stone slabs , with messages carved into them . These messages could be warnings , instructions , stories and accounts of events . They vary in shape and size depending on the creator and time they were made .

title: Rupert Brock
description: Rupert Brock Rupert Brock was a sea captain in 1357 DR . His ship sailed to Kozakura sometimes . On land , he was good - mannered but on board his ship Rupert was a tyrant , leading his crew with a crop and not caring to have adequate supplies .

title: Ruqiah
description: Ruqiah Ruqiah was a member of the Desai tribe , part of the nomadic Bedine . She was the reincarnation of Catti - brie . Description .

title: Rusalka
description: Rusalka A rusalka was a female fey water spirit that lived in cold lakes , streams , and rivers . They were notorious for their song , which could lure mortals into their arms or into watery graves . Description .

title: Ruse
description: Ruse Ruse was a bandit berserker in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Ruse was one of the two lieutenants of the Gray Patriots bandit group under Sahnd Krulek .

title: Rushing Hills
description: Rushing Hills The Rushing Hills was a series of rocky outcroppings that lay southeast of the city of Lheshayl in the Shining Plains in the Vilhon Reach . Geography . The Rushing Hills were a rough and rocky range , consisting of natural outcroppings of rock .

title: Rusk
description: Rusk Huntmaster Rusk was a cleric of Malar . Relationships . Rusk once loved Maleva .

title: Russel Roland
description: Russel Roland Russell Roland held the title of Lord MacIntyre of Ravens Bluff from 1354 DR - - ? Appearance . Russel Roland is 5 ' 8 " tall and weighs 175 pounds .

title: Rust monster
description: Rust monster A rust monster was an aberration that corroded and ate metal . Physical description . A rust monster was the size of a small pony , with four insectlike legs and a squat , humped body .

title: Rusteen
description: Rusteen Rusteen was the Realms name for . Description . Rusteen occurred in shades of brown from pale to dark reddish brown .

title: Rusting grasp
description: Rusting grasp Rusting grasp is a transmutation spell that lets the caster corrode metals and alloys with a touch . Effects . You corrode iron and iron alloys at a touch .

title: Rutherford Urmbrusk
description: Rutherford Urmbrusk Rutherford Urmbrusk was the heir of House Urmbrusk in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1476 DR Rutherford ' s father , Quarren Urmbrusk abandoned his duty in order to went to adventure in Undermountain granting the control of the House to his sister Lestra Urmbrusk and also granted her the custody of Rutherford .

title: Ruthless punisher
description: Ruthless punisher Ruthless punishers are ranger s of a brutal and merciless temperament , known for their cruelty and terrifying reputation . Most ruthless punishers are hunters of a sort , though they prefer the challenge offered by sentient prey rather than the common beast s most hunters stalk . For good or evil , ruthless punishers are virtually unequaled in their skill at hunting down their foes .

title: Ruudi Stonekin
description: Ruudi Stonekin Ruudi Stonekin was a dwarf cartographer in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Ruudi sold her maps inside the Yawning Portal inn .

title: Rydah
description: Rydah Rydah the Storm Soother was the high priestess of Umberlee in Mulmaster . Personality . Rydah was a cunning and cool - headed individual .

title: Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma
description: Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma , also known as Rylatar , is a red dragon . Description . Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma is around 80 ft ( 24 m ) long .

title: Ryld Argith
description: Ryld Argith Ryld Argith was a drow master of Melee - Magthere in Menzoberranzan . Description . Ryld was unusual for a drow due to his large and burly build .

title: Rylla
description: Rylla Rylla was the Half - drow battlemistress of the Promenade of the Dark Maiden . History . Rylla was the main military leader of the Church of Eilistraee .

title: Rym Windwalker
description: Rym Windwalker Rym Windwalker was a half - elven wizard living in Halruaa in 1367 DR . Personality . Eager to prove himself as a young mage , Rym always looked for adventure .

title: Ryndala Merendil
description: Ryndala Merendil Lady Ryndala Merendil of House Merendil was a traitor to Cormyr . History . She attempted to trick Amedahast , the first apprentice royal magician , into aiding an assassination attempt on the young Azoun I .

title: Rysellan
description: Rysellan Rysellan the Dark was a wizard from Calimshan and the founder of the Twisted Rune . History . Rysellan the Dark was an aging wizard from Calimshan when he founded the Twisted Rune in 864 DR .

title: Rystia Zav
description: Rystia Zav Rystia Zav was a spy and a member of the Harpers during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Rytsia had gone mad from loneliness , fear , and demon lord s ' influence .

title: Rythan
description: Rythan Crown Prince Rythan of Tethyr was next in line to the throne of Tethyr . He destroyed the lich Jhaniloth Puiral of the Twisted Rune while she was in her lair . In retribution for this act , the Rune created Mulsparkh , and Rythan was killed in the Battle of Nightflames against its armies in 1334 DR .

title: Rythanko
description: Rythanko The Rythanko was a magical bracelet of unknown origin . It was carried by a Githyanki aboard a merchant ship on the Moonsea when the ship was captured by the Orcsblood in 1460 DR . A young pirate named Gareth Jadaren took the Rythanko from the Gith and carried it to Mulmaster after he deserted his ship .

title: Rythnax
description: Rythnax Rythnax was a black dragon wyrmling near Phlan in 1489 DR . He was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Personality .

title: Ryvvik Dlardrageth
description: Ryvvik Dlardrageth Ryvvik Dlardrageth was the third - in - command of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Ryvvik was the youngest and only surviving child of Sarya Dlardrageth .

title: Ryzliir Symryvvin
description: Ryzliir Symryvvin Ryzliir Symryvvin was a female drow elite warrior in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Possessions . Dressed in studded leather , Ryzliir fought with a shortsword and shield in battle .

title: S ' domo rhan
description: S ' domo rhan The s ' domo rhan was a giant beetle that was said to dwell on the Naktong Moors of Koryo . The s ' domo rhan had the power to transform into a beautiful woman , in which form it would lure men to their dooms .

title: S ' slaar
description: S ' slaar S ' slaar was a troglodyte chieftain during the Rage of Demons . History . S ' slaar led a troglodyte tribe in the Wormwrithings area .

title: Sa ' Sani
description: Sa ' Sani Sa ' Sani was a yuan - ti princess around 1374 DR . History . Sa ' Sani was the princess of the Sauringar tribe in the Chultan Peninsula and a priestess of Sseth .

title: Sa ' id Firdawsi
description: Sa ' id Firdawsi Sa ' id Firdawsi was a rich halfling cloth merchant in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Typical for many halflings , Sa ' id was cheerful and got along well with most people .

title: Sa ' luk
description: Sa ' luk Sa ' luks were scoundrels and free adventurers in Zakhara . Rogue s to their core , these men and women owed allegiance to none but themselves . Requirements .

title: Saablic Tan
description: Saablic Tan Saablic Tan was a clone of the drow wizard Malavon Despana . History . Tan escaped from his master ' s clutches when one of them " died " and then ran to Isair and Madae for help .

title: Saas
description: Saas The Saas , or " Shields " , were the collection of mountain ranges that surrounded the Great Glacier and isolated it from the rest of Toril . Geography . The icy mountains of the Saas towered over the lands of the Great Glacier .

title: Sabal Mizzrym
description: Sabal Mizzrym Sabal Mizzrym was a priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan and sister of Pharaun Mizzrym . History . Sabal was the youngest twin sister of Greyanna Mizzrym and the daughter of Matron Mother Miz ' ri Mizzrym .

title: Sabass
description: Sabass Sabass , also known as Sabass of Thay , was a high level wizard in the School of Conjuration and Summoning in the magocracy of Thay in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR . and the Zulkir of this school until the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR . Description .

title: Sabban
description: Sabban A sabban was a major subdivision of a Calishite town or city , akin to a district or ward . Description . A sabban was composed of between three and five drudach s , smaller subdivisions .

title: Sabinus
description: Sabinus Sabinus was a male human smuggler and crime lord in Tantras in the Vast before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Sabinus interacted with the mortal Kelemvor , who was in search of one of the Tablets of Fate , and smuggled inside Bane ' s agents , the then mortal Cyric and the assassin Durrock , into Tantras .

title: Sable
description: Sable Sable was the falcon companion of Keren Donnell . Description . Sable was a huge black falcon .

title: Sable Forest
description: Sable Forest The Sable Forest was located on the Elemental Plane of Fire near the City of Brass . Description . The Sable Forest was filled with large black trees called serpent trees .

title: Sabu lord
description: Sabu lord Sabu lords , or “ Lion Lords , ” were large cats that lived on the plains and savannahs of Zakhara . They were very territorial , harassing any who traveled through their lands without permission . Description .

title: Sabyna
description: Sabyna Sabyna was a ship ' s mage in 1370 DR . History . Sabyna lived all her life on the sea .

title: Sacred Oak
description: Sacred Oak The Sacred Oak was an oak tree in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Inhabitants . At night , the tree was frequented by lovers who make their vows in secrecy .

title: Sacred Seer
description: Sacred Seer The Sacred Seer was a mutated myconid ruler in Sporedome . History . During the Rage of Demons , the Sacred Seer , infected by the madness , decided to worship the demon lord Zuggtmoy together with all her colony , also gaining some derro and fomorians followers .

title: Sacred flame
description: Sacred flame Sacred flame is a prayer similar , but not identical , to " lance of faith " . It is cast by cleric s , primarily devoted cleric s . When " sacred flame " is cast the cleric invokes divine power , casting a beam of light from the heavens into the flesh of a creature within twenty - five feet , injuring them to a degree largely dependent on how focused and perceptive the cleric casting the prayer is .

title: Sacred guardian
description: Sacred guardian Sacred guardian was an enchantment spell that warned the caster whenever the target was in danger . Effects . The caster had to touch the recipient of this spell for it to work .

title: Sacred lizardfolk poison
description: Sacred lizardfolk poison This sacred poison was used by the lizardfolk of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr . Effect . When poisoning occurred , the victim suffered instant paralysis for two to twelve minutes unless they had the fortitude to resist it .

title: Sadalar
description: Sadalar Sadalar was a crinti warchief living in Dambrath during the 12th century DR . Relationships . Sadalar was the consort of queen Melanith .

title: Sadik Harama
description: Sadik Harama Sadik Harama was an old dwarf who ran a small shop within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Sadik was completely bald .

title: Sadimmin
description: Sadimmin El Sadimmin were the standard army of the country of Calimshan . Etymology . The term " sadimmin " was plural , and meant " powerful swords " .

title: Sadiq
description: Sadiq Sadiq , also called Sadiq the Smokey was an efreeti pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Sadiq served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .

title: Sadrach ’ s Splinter
description: Sadrach ’ s Splinter Sadrach ' s Splinter was a thin mesa in the Underchasm . It was connected to the Underchasm ' s east wall by a series of earthmotes and suspension bridges . A dark castle sat on top of the mote .

title: Saed
description: Saed Saed was a vampire and the preeminent beast chieftain of Veldorn . Personality . Saed was a melancholy character , always thinking about his lost fortune .

title: Saemon Havarian
description: Saemon Havarian Saemon Havarian appears in both the novel and the game versions of the Baldur ' s Gate II story . He ' s the character responsible for taking the protagonist to the island prison of Spellhold . The Novel .

title: Saerlar Stormwyvern
description: Saerlar Stormwyvern Saerlar Stormwyvern was a Moonstars spy inside Candlekeep . History . Saerlar went to infiltrate Candlekeep .

title: Saerlia Ashley
description: Saerlia Ashley Battle Chaplain Saerlia Ashley was a female human cleric of Tempus , god of battle . She tended the shrine of Tempus in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . She was a scarred woman who inspired attending adventurers and Purple Dragons soldiers with sermons of battle , blood , and fire .

title: Saerloon
description: Saerloon Saerloon was a Sembia n city known for its gothic architecture , peppered throughout with gargoyles and other embellishments , and for its mercantile activity , seasoned by thievery and intrigue . Goverment . Saerloon was nominally ruled by a merchant prince , who ultimately served the merchant council .

title: Saerloonian Glowfire
description: Saerloonian Glowfire Saerloonian Glowfire was a wine exported from Saerloon . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Saerloonian Special Vat
description: Saerloonian Special Vat Saerloonian Special Vat was a wine exported from Saerloon . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Saerloonian Topaz
description: Saerloonian Topaz Saerloonian Topaz was a wine exported from Saerloon . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Saerol Danonbryl
description: Saerol Danonbryl Saerol Danonbryl was a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Saerol was ordered by his master to kill the Lantan ese duelist Audrec SeTourne , who was extorting a noble of the city who was allied with the Zhentarim , during one of the gladiator matches in the Black Blade and Bloody Boar tavern .

title: Saesaan Aelorothi
description: Saesaan Aelorothi Saesaan Aelorothi was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Saesaan was the wife of Pharnth Aelorothi .

title: Saestra Karanok
description: Saestra Karanok Saestra Karanok was the vampire daughter of the ruler of Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . History . During a very bad joke by her brother Naeros Karanok she was locked in a crypt for nine days ; when Saestra exited she was a vampire .

title: Saeval Calaudra
description: Saeval Calaudra Saeval Calaudra was a moon elf rogue and assassin and , as of 1374 DR , was a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma . He offered support and expertise to Eldreth Veluuthra cells across Faerûn and introduced people to the Vel ' Nikeryma . As of 1374 DR he was the youngest member of the organization .

title: Safana
description: Safana History . In " Baldur ' s Gate " she is first encountered as an joinable NPC in the Seawatcher ruins area looking for buried pirate treasure . In " " she can be found at the North Forest Area near the log cabin with her companion Coran .

title: Safe fall
description: Safe fall Safe fall was a basic alteration spell similar to the " feather fall " spell , but with more versatility . This spell was created by the famed wizard Darsson Spellmaker . Effects .

title: Safia al - Gurab Sakir
description: Safia al - Gurab Sakir Safia al - Gurab Sakir was a member of the Unclean in 1367 DR . Personality . Safia was demure and loyally obeyed every command of her master .

title: Safiya
description: Safiya Safiya is a Red Wizard of Thay , and one of the companions of the Kalach - Cha during the events of " " . Personality . Safiya was an instructor at the Academy of Shapers and Binders .

title: Safsaf
description: Safsaf Safsaf was a vishap living in the Furrowed Mountains in 1367 DR . Personality . Safsaf was a coward , preferring to observe travelers in her land well in advance of encountering them .

title: Saga of the Dragon Queller
description: Saga of the Dragon Queller The Saga of the Dragon Queller ( Sal Hotun Wyrmrever in its original language ) was an ancient giant ballad about the hero Hjurnur Wyrmrever . Description . This epic poem was composed by Hrotun , the first skald , and told the tale of his nephew , the hero Hjurnur , during the great war between the giants and the dragon s .

title: Saganite
description: Saganite Saganite , also known as " needle stone " , " love stone " , or " hairstone " , was a variety of chalcedony that encased many needlelike inclusions . Description . Saganite was usually a bone white to yellow stone with contrasting brown or greenish - black needles .

title: Sage of Shadowdale
description: Sage of Shadowdale The Sage of Shadowdale is a series by Ed Greenwood that follows the adventures of Elminster Aumar in the post - Spellplague era of the Realms . The Hooded one , Ed Greenwood ' s spokesperson in the Candlekeep Forums , has mentioned there will be additional novels in the series , but they are as yet unnamed .

title: Saghirah
description: Saghirah Saghirah was a vizier ' s turban living in Simbaya in north Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . When not in the form of a turban , Saghirah appeared to be a snake - like creature .

title: Sagrast Dracohorn
description: Sagrast Dracohorn Sagrast Dracohorn was a member of the Dracohorn noble house of Cormyr , and steward of the Royal House of Obarskyr . Background .
