In 245 DR , Sagrast arranged to meet the High Wizard Baerauble Etharr in private at The Ram and Duck to discuss his plans for removing Iltharl Obarskyr from the throne .

title: Saharel
description: Saharel Lady Saharel was formerly an archmage of ancient Netheril and later ruler of Saharelgard , better known as Spellgard , a ruined castle complex on the eastern edges of the former Anauroch desert . History . At some point , presumably after the fall of Netheril ( - 339 DR ) , Lady Saharel became an archlich .

title: Sahbuti Shanardanda
description: Sahbuti Shanardanda Sahbuti Shanardanda is a member of the Dark Moon , a Shar ran order of monk s who are the elite of Shar ' s followers . He was born and raised in Amn and taught of the worship of Shar while still very young . Sahbuti now travels the Sword Coast from Waterdeep to Calimshan , doing the work of his goddess which usually involves escorting Dark Moon officials , guarding valuable shipments for the church and occasionally assassinating Shar ' s enemies .

title: Sahlah
description: Sahlah Sahlah was a holy slayer living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Against her will , Sahlah served as an assassin of the Dark Wave for the Cult of Istishia .

title: Sahnd Krulek
description: Sahnd Krulek Sahnd Krulek was a bandit leader in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Sahnd was a Knight of the Black Fist in Phlan .

title: Sahu
description: Sahu Sahu was a large island in the Crowded Sea to the southwest of Afyal . Geography . Like in other places in the Ruined Kingdoms area of Zakhara , ancient ruins dotted the jungles and mountains , which were left here by two fallen empires : the worshipers of Thasmudyan of old and , following it , the New Dynasty of the Necromancer Kings .

title: Sahuagin
description: Sahuagin Sahuagin ( pronounced sah - HWAH - gin ) were a fish - like monstrous humanoid species that lived in oceans , seas , underground lakes , and underwater caves . Sahuagin spoke the Sahuagin language , though some were known to also speak Common and Aquan . Physical description .

title: Sahvin Sel ' rue
description: Sahvin Sel ' rue Sahvin Sel ' rue was a drow scout of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Sahvin was one of the top scouts of her city .

title: Sai
description: Sai A sai is an exotic light melee weapon used mainly by monk s . Description . The sai is a dagger - shaped metal baton or wand with two side prongs curving up and out from the place where the grip meets the base of the baton .

title: Saibhon el Bhiras
description: Saibhon el Bhiras Saibhon el Bhiras was the Grand Yrshelem of Slaves of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Saibhon was born the son of the leader of the Ice Chain slaver company in Calimshan , and his father taught the young Saibhon about the family business .

title: Saikhoi
description: Saikhoi Saikhoi was the capital city of Ra - Khati . Geography . Nestled deep within the Katakoro Shan range , Saikhoi sat between the two sacred lakes of Norasil and Manasowar .

title: Sailors of the Crimson Sea
description: Sailors of the Crimson Sea The Sailors of the Crimson Sea were a mercenary company based in Chessenta and active in Chondath around 1358 DR . Organization . They were divided into infantry , cavalry , and archers .

title: Saint Dionysus
description: Saint Dionysus St . Dionysus , or St . Dionysius , was a saint of the god Ilmater and patron saint of wine and other alcohol ic spirits .

title: Saint Fanal
description: Saint Fanal Saint Fanal was a priest and saint of Ilmater and the founder of the Monastery of St . Fanal in the Alimir Mountains . Personality .

title: Saint Sollars
description: Saint Sollars Saint Sollars , called the Twice Martyred , was a saint of the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . He was the patron saint of Bloodstone Pass . Worshipers .

title: Sairché
description: Sairché Sairché was a female cambion and the heiress of the succubus Invadiah . Relationships . Sairché was the sister of Lorcan and the only cambion daughter of Invadiah .

title: Saisho
description: Saisho Saisho was a wu jen / ninja adventurer in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Saisho was born in Miyama and as a child met and befriend Etsu - no - kami Makoto .

title: Saishu
description: Saishu Saishu was an island off the coast of the Koryo Peninsula and part of the land of Koryo ( formerly Choson ) in northeast Kara - Tur . Geography . Saishu lay in the Yellow Sea and was separated from the mainland by the Straits of Koryo , which were famed for their huge tidal range and speed .

title: Saj Amog
description: Saj Amog Saj Amog was a lich and the Zulkir of Conjuration in Thay in the late 15th century DR . Relationships . As a zulkir , Amog was a member of the ruling council of Thay .

title: Sajat
description: Sajat Sajats ( sah - JAHT ) were tiny tambourines used by dancers in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . A " sajat " was small enough to be held by the fingers .

title: Sakai Kazuhiko
description: Sakai Kazuhiko Sakai Kazuhiko was a samurai proprietor of a shoen in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Sakai owned a shoen near the village of Itsuki .

title: Sakigahara
description: Sakigahara Sakigahara was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . Sakigahara was a lieutenant of Ogaki , the second - in - command of Lord Korimori . History .

title: Sakina
description: Sakina Sakina were air sprites from Zakhara . Friendly by nature , these creatures roamed the sky in search of unique scents and adventure . Description .

title: Sakkors
description: Sakkors Sakkors was an ancient Netherese city built on an inverted mountain top . Because of Karsus ' s Folly , it plunged into the Sea of Fallen Stars . Before the fall of Netheril , one of the High Arcanists , Xolund " the Maker " , infused the mythallar of his own city with a rudimentary sentience , which called itself the Source .

title: Sakkratar ' s triple strike
description: Sakkratar ' s triple strike Sakkratar ' s triple strike was a transmutation spell that gave the target increased speed in combat allowing extra attacks . The spell also gave the target ' s weapon a special property Keen and caused it to be covered in pure white flame . History .

title: Sakrattars Irithyl
description: Sakrattars Irithyl Sakrattars Irithyl was second Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 2900 DR to - 1950 DR , the youngest great - grandson of Kahvoerm Irithyl , first Coronal . He became the ruler of the empire after his father ' s death and the unsuccessful blade draw of Divisav Irithyl , Kahvoerm ' s first son . His reign ended with his death as he sacrificed himself to create a blood dragon that slew a horde of drow that had occupied the former realm of Uvaeren and the Twisted Tower .

title: Sala Nidris
description: Sala Nidris Sala Nidris was a Calishite merchant in Neverwinter . History . Sala migrated from Calimshan to live in Neverwinter with her son Zan Nidris .

title: Salabak
description: Salabak Salabak was a human gladiator of the Arena of Blood in Manshaka of the mid – 14th century DR . History . Salabak hailed from a certain tribe in the Great Gray Land of Thar .

title: Salamander
description: Salamander Salamanders were large elemental , reptilian humanoid s . Personality . Salamanders tended to be greedy and cruel .

title: Salbread
description: Salbread Salbread was a popular type of bread baked by the creative halfling s of Luiren . Description . Because it lasted for weeks before spoiling , and contained much more flavor than standard breads , salbread was made for sailors and other travelers .

title: Saldashune ' s Mirror
description: Saldashune ' s Mirror Saldashune ' s Mirror was a divination ritual created by Saldashune . It was created to help remember specific details of memories , regardless of whether the person was able to fully recall them or not . Procedure .

title: Saleem
description: Saleem Saleem was an eccentric human architect who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Though an accomplished builder in his own right , Saleem was both modest and calm when he went about his work .

title: Saleem ibn Ahogar
description: Saleem ibn Ahogar Saleem ibn Ahogar was an inhabitant within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Saleem was a representative of the jann of the High Desert and the leader of the jann in Huzuz . Personality .

title: Salember Obarskyr
description: Salember Obarskyr Salember Obarskyr was the regent of Cormyr . Relatives . Salember had a single brother , Azoun III .

title: Salen
description: Salen Salen was the leader of a group of mercenaries who drank at the Laughing Goblin Inn . Description . Salen was a very beautiful salt - and - pepper - haired woman who was an experienced dagger thrower .

title: Saleska Mintharl
description: Saleska Mintharl Saleska Mintharl was a human woman and a priestess of Tempus . She held the title " Shield of Tempus " and was a Merchant Duke of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . History .

title: Salid Dhuzma
description: Salid Dhuzma Salid Dhuzma , or the Grand Verser of the South , was a famous bard who lived in Khalab during the mid 14h century DR . Activities . Students from all over East Faerûn and the Hordelands would travel to the small fishing village of Khalab with the hopes of becoming Salid ' s next pupil .

title: Sallissi
description: Sallissi Sallissi was a morkoth living in an underground cavern near Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Sallissi lived as a hermit in an underground lake near Dragonspear Castle .

title: Salman bin Salman
description: Salman bin Salman Salman bin Salman was a cleric of Hajama living in the small town of Ganam in 1367 DR . Activities . Salman served as head priest for the entire village .

title: Salt Jungle
description: Salt Jungle The Salt Jungle was a sprawling woodland region found in East Zakhara . Geography . The Salt Jungle was roughly nestled between Al - Iltifat river to the west and Al - Zilla River to the east , with some overlap on either side .

title: Salt bond
description: Salt bond A salt bond was a formal sign of hospitality offered by a host to a guest and was prevalent in Zakhara n culture . As the name suggested , salt bonds became a formal bond when the guest consumed salt from the host ' s table . Salt bonds typically lasted for three days , during which the host assumed full responsibility for the guest ' s welfare .

title: Saluqi
description: Saluqi Saluqi greyhounds were unique canines found within the Haunted Lands where the jann used them for hunting , particularly the jann of Amir Heidar Qan . Description . Saluqi had black hides that covered their sleek bodies .

title: Saluuknir
description: Saluuknir Saluuknir was an old male blue dragon imprisoned in the " Urn of the Blue Vishap " . History . Originally at home in the Raurin Desert , Saluuknir was bound to the magical " Urn " when its former inmate , the evil marid Merifa of the Pearl Lagoons , tricked the dragon into exchanging places .

title: Salvanas
description: Salvanas Salvanas was a male elf who liked to hang out in the Copper Coronet . Personality . Salvanas accosted many women who frequented the tavern with flattery and seduction .

title: Salvar Brix
description: Salvar Brix Salvar Brix was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Salvar was a charismatic individual , and always learned what he needed to motivate others to do his will .

title: Salvarad
description: Salvarad Salvarad was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was a member of ruling council and a supposed cleric of Talos . In truth , both Shar and Cyric granted him the spells thanks to a peculiar and unique relationship that Salvarad had with these two deities .

title: Sam Wood
description: Sam Wood Sam E . Wood is a prolific fantasy illustrator whose art fills many Dungeons & Dragons sourcebooks . Education .

title: Samakay
description: Samakay Samakay the Wry was the king of Golconda in the Turmish in 1358 DR . Activities . Samakay ruled the small kingdom of Golconda .

title: Samarach
description: Samarach Samarach was a country on the Chultan Peninsula . Geography . The country was virtually unexplored by people from the civilized lands as it was incredibly difficult to get to .

title: Samardag
description: Samardag Samardag the Hoper was a merchant on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Samardag , loyal to his moniker , always saw the good side of each situation .

title: Samark Dhanzscul
description: Samark Dhanzscul Samark Dhanzscul was the sixth Blackstaff . Description . Samark had three parallel scars on his face from his right cheekbone to his jaw .

title: Samarskite
description: Samarskite Samarskite was a semi - precious gem used for mourning jewelry or to adorn black ceremonial dress . Description . Samarskite was a rare - earth mineral , hard and dense , with a velvet - black metallic luster , usually cut .

title: Samas Kul
description: Samas Kul Samas Kul was the Zulkir of Transmutation since his predecessor ' s death in 1375 DR within the ranks of the Red wizard s of Thay and ally of Szass Tam . He was also the master of Thay ' s Guild of Foreign Trade . Description .

title: Samayan
description: Samayan Samayan was a boy Chosen of Chauntea . Activities . Samayan was one of the children in a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen .

title: Sambar ( priest )
description: Sambar ( priest ) Father Sambar was a priest of Shar posing a priest of Mystra at the false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr , in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Father Sambar was the first to pass through the Shadow Gate , a " portal " to the Plane of Shadow intended to provide a shortcut for the Sharrans ' operations . However , the " portal " was a failure : all Sambar ' s clothing , skin , and flesh simply misted away as shadow .

title: Sambryl
description: Sambryl Sambryl was the regent queen of Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . Description . Sambryl was a skilled wizard , who was often likened to her great - great - great - grandmother , Queen Sambral .

title: Sambuk
description: Sambuk A sambuk was a sailing ship with a single , triangular sail . It was a type of dhow . Description .

title: Samdralyrion
description: Samdralyrion Samdralyrion was an old brass dragon during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Samdralyrion was among the metallic dragon s who wanted to find a cure for the Rage .

title: Samia al - Giss
description: Samia al - Giss Samia al - Giss was an inhabitant of the Furrowed Mountians in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was a member of the Dervish faction of holy slayers .

title: Samia al - Kasir
description: Samia al - Kasir Samia al - Kasir was an elven wind mage within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was a former apprentice of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi , and served as her assistant .

title: Samia al - Risik
description: Samia al - Risik Imam Samia al - Risik was a High Priest of the Mosque of Zann the Wise in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Samia was the second of Imam Renn min Zann , leading services in the mosque since his duties kept him at the Golden Mosque much of the time .

title: Samirson Yarth
description: Samirson Yarth Samirson Yarth was one of the best assassins during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Samirson was a very efficient killer living in the city of Urmlaspyr in Sembia .

title: Sammafar
description: Sammafar " Sammafar " was an official title in the Kingdom of Tethyr . A sammafar was the head manager of a noble ' s estate , ensuring the maintenance of the physical location and the direction of its personnel . While unable to command troops , sammafars often provided advice on matters of estate security .

title: Sammaster
description: Sammaster Sammaster was an immensely powerful human mage and a former Chosen of Mystra . Sammaster was known for discovering the process which turns a dragon into a dracolich . After being killed in a great battle , he returned several hundred years later as a lich , but has since been destroyed once more .

title: Sammereza Sulphontis
description: Sammereza Sulphontis Sammereza " Sammer " Sulphontis was a traveling merchant and a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Sammer had brown skin and purple eyes .

title: Samoth Dier
description: Samoth Dier Samoth Dier was a Boar ' s Head , one of the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , mercenary recruitment company in Amn . Description . Samoth was strong and tall and had a dark complexion .

title: Sampranasz
description: Sampranasz The small town of Sampranasz served as the center for the Cult of Set in Mulhorand . History . Sampranasz had a violent history , and was destroyed three times : once during the Orcgate Wars and twice by natural disaster .

title: Sams Bandar
description: Sams Bandar Sams Bandar was the largest settlement located on Jazirat al - Qraidis within Jazayir al - Sartan . Defenses . Sams Bandar could summon a militia force of 15 armed men during a crisis .

title: Samsi Farlak
description: Samsi Farlak Samsi Farlak was a dwarven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Samsi hated the sea , but he did enjoy telling stories relating to it .

title: Samuel
description: Samuel Samuel was a former member of the Flaming Fist in the Gibberling Mountains . History . Samuel was a member of the Flaming Fist but he was convinced to desert by his friend Lena ; however , he was injured in the escape .

title: Samular Caradoon
description: Samular Caradoon Samular was a human knight of Tyr and the founder of the Holy Order of Samular . Relationships . Samular was the youngest of three brothers .

title: Sanctify
description: Sanctify Sanctify was a conjuration spell that allowed one or more priests to temporarily dedicate an area to their deity , creating a zone beneficial to followers of that deity and those of the same alignment , and detrimental to undead . The reverse of this spell , defile , did the same for evil priests but made it more difficult to turn undead . Effects .

title: Sanctify sacred site
description: Sanctify sacred site Sanctify sacred site was a divine magic spell available to priests of Chauntea that could restore a holy site that had been defiled . It was the only known remedy for a moonwell that had been corrupted by a " moonveil " spell . It was a ritual that took all day to cast , required material components that were difficult to procure , but could be assisted by as many followers of Chauntea as practical .

title: Sanctuary
description: Sanctuary Sanctuary was an abjuration spell that could prevent enemies from attacking the subject for a few minutes on the condition that the subject does not take direct offensive action . Effects . This spell protected the touched individual from any targeted attack , either melee , ranged weapon , or spell , unless the attacker was able to overcome the " sanctuary " by force of will .

title: Sand
description: Sand Sand was a moon elf wizard of both Luskan and Neverwinter , known for his potion s shop as well as , later on , his aid rendered to the Kalach - Cha during the Shadow War . Description . Short of height , even for a moon elf , Sand was a physically unremarkable character with long black hair , sky blue eyes , and typical elven ears .

title: Sand ( province )
description: Sand ( province ) The province of sand in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of earth , taking its name from one of its most common forms in the desert lands of the Land of Fate . Many of its spells contained and used sand as an essential part . The four elemental provinces played a very similar role for Zakharan magic - users as the eight ( or nine ) schools of magic did for Faerûn ian ones .

title: Sand cage
description: Sand cage A sand cage was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown at a target , this sand created a whirlwind cage shaped like an inverted cone .

title: Sand form
description: Sand form Sand form was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell any recipient whom the caster touched , including the caster , was able to animate and control a body made of sand while their real body was up to 100 miles ( 161 km ) away .

title: Sand giant
description: Sand giant Sand giants were disciplined , honorable desert dwellers who lived in stable communities which were often isolated . Although their villages tended to be remote , they did trade with other races and were not isolationists . Sand giant society was highly structured , with each clan ruled by a hereditary monarch .

title: Sand jambiya
description: Sand jambiya Sand jambiya was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Sand of mirages
description: Sand of mirages Sand of mirages was a useful magical sand found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that created a deceptive image . Powers . This sand created an illusion of whatever the user wanted barring creatures .

title: Sand of obscurement
description: Sand of obscurement Sand of obscurement was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . When thrown , " sand of obscurement " created an instantaneious mini sandstorm , effectively blinding anything within the storm .

title: Sand of restoration
description: Sand of restoration Sand of restoration was a magical sand from Zakhara that temporarily repaired buildings and other structures . Powers . If sprinkled on the damaged stones and framework of a building or other man - made structure , " sand of restoration " would temporarily repair all cracks , gaps , etc .

title: Sand of scintillation
description: Sand of scintillation Sand of scintillation was a useful magical sand from Zakhara that was beneficial to those who found themselves in a tight situation . Powers . When thrown into the air , this sand caused a blinding explosion of hypnotic light .

title: Sand of sinking
description: Sand of sinking Sand of sinking was a magical sand that turned other sand , earth , or stone into quicksand . This sand originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers .

title: Sand of truth
description: Sand of truth Sand of truth was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .

title: Sand quiet
description: Sand quiet Sand quiet was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Sand seal
description: Sand seal Sand seal was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell a wizard was able to create a solid barrier of sand capable of barring a doorway .

title: Sand shadow
description: Sand shadow Sand shadow was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell could conceal a target as long as they were mostly within a shadow .

title: Sand shroud
description: Sand shroud Sand shroud was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster could open up an area of sand directly beneath a target and swallow them whole .

title: Sand slumber
description: Sand slumber Sand slumber was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Sand sword
description: Sand sword Sand sword was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Similar to the " sand jambiya " spell , this spell created a sharp blade out of sand .

title: Sand tools
description: Sand tools Sand tools was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was primarily used by mechanician s . Effects .

title: Sand worm
description: Sand worm Sand worm was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned the recipient into a sand worm ; a man - sized worm that no longer needed to eat , drink , or breathe .

title: Sandara al - Sahil
description: Sandara al - Sahil Sandara al - Sahil was a tasked administrator genie who was in charge of supervising the North Center of Huzuz . Description . Sandara was a lovely genie who weighed well over 500 pounds ( over 227 kg ) .

title: Sandcone
description: Sandcone Sandcone was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was used to excavate a cone - sized area of sand where the caster desired .

title: Sandesyl Morgia
description: Sandesyl Morgia Sandesyl Morgia was a female vampire and member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1484 DR . At that time , a new Cult faction led by the mage Severin emerged , switching their adoration from dracolich es to living dragon s . Sandesyl considered this a blasphemy against the teachings of Sammaster so she went to stop Severin ' s plan to resurrect Tiamat .

title: Sandman
description: Sandman Sandmen were rare creatures found in Zakhara . Originally from the Elemental Plane of Earth , these creatures were used by the dao to capture slaves on Toril . They were favored by the dao for this task because of their ability to capture targets without damaging them .

title: Sandrew
description: Sandrew Savant Sandrew , usually know as Sandrew the Wise , was the leading cleric of Oghma in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Sandrew hailed from the Silver Marches but settled in Waterdeep circa 1362 DR with the objective of building a temple and a library worthy of his god and the City of Splendors .

title: Sandspray
description: Sandspray Sandspray was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster caused pillar of sand to explode upward beneath a target .

title: Sandstorm ( novel )
description: Sandstorm ( novel ) Sandstorm is a stand - alone novel by Christopher Rowe . Summary . In the time period after the Spellplague in 1385 DR , the lands of Calimshan were ripped asunder by an event known as the Second Era of Skyfire .

title: Sandyse Thunderquill
description: Sandyse Thunderquill Sandyse Thunderquill was a confident but socially awkward mage and a member of the Harpers in Neverwinter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Sandyse was in training to infiltrate the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Sanfin Lotte
description: Sanfin Lotte Sanfin Lotte was a gossip writer in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Sanfin spent all his time inside the Yawning Portal inn .

title: Sangalor
description: Sangalor Sangalor , also known as Sangalor of the Secrets , was a mind flayer outcast who became a cleric of Oghma in 1370 DR . Activities . In time , Sangalor became a fervent devotee of the God of Knowledge but was basically still an illithid : his usual trade was to find secrets by request or interrogating evil prisoners by eating their brains .

title: Sanidine
description: Sanidine Sanidine was an ornamental stone found on the surface of sand dunes and gravel screes . Sanidine was favored by the nomadic , desert - dwelling Bedine and to ring - stone size or smaller . Description .

title: Sansuri
description: Sansuri Countess Sansuri was the ruler of the cloud giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Sansuri was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Santir
description: Santir Santir was a monk of elven ancestry at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Personality . Santir loved to talk and to gossip , and he was always interested in a good story .

title: Santrin
description: Santrin Santrin " the Skilled " was a gnome man living in Calaunt in the Vast . Around 1358 DR , he was a noted carver of amber , ivory , jade , obsidian , and fine wood , producing extremely fine and beautiful inlays . Though very expensive , his work was famous around the Dragon Reach , and he had a very long backlog of orders .

title: Santur
description: Santur A santur ( SAHN - toor ) was a Zakharan instrument similar to the hammered dulcimer . Description . The " santur " was similar in appearance to the " qanun " , being a trapezoidal stringed instrument .

title: Sap
description: Sap A sap , also known as a " slapper " , " slap jack " , or " beavertail sap " , is a light , martial melee weapon that does non - lethal damage . Description . A sap is a lead rod or disk hammered somewhat flat and wrapped in leather , then fitted to a spring handle .

title: Sapphiraktar
description: Sapphiraktar Sapphiraktar was an ancient male blue dracolich and a member of the Twisted Rune . Description . Out of vanity , the dracolich maintained his dragon appearance through magic .

title: Sapphire
description: Sapphire Sapphire was a rare variety of that occured in the Realms . Description . Sapphire was found in shades of pale blue to a deep azure .

title: Sapphire dragon
description: Sapphire dragon Sapphire dragons tended to be territorial and antisocial although they loved to discuss military matters and strategy . They preferred to lair in deep , rocky caves and often kept large spiders in their home as a food source . Combat .

title: Saprach
description: Saprach Saprach was a thief who lived in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Saprach was the proprietor of Saprach ' s Fine Wines , but also had a side - line in thieving and fencing of stolen goods , and specialized in the discreet disposal of dead bodies .

title: Saprach ' s Fine Wines
description: Saprach ' s Fine Wines The Saprach ' s Fine Wines was a shop in the city of Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR , dedicated to selling wine . Location . The store was located in the east side of the city , on Whistleturn Way near the Market .

title: Saqr
description: Saqr The Saqr was a small tribe of genasi who lived on an island in the Poison Sea of Relmaur , Returned Abeir . History . The Saqr established their home on a crystal island in the center of the Poison Sea , near a crystal they believed was the heart of a dead god , in hopes of using the dormant power of this item to elevate one of them to godhood .

title: Sar
description: Sar Sar , also called Vengeance , was a giant two - headed roc who was stabled at Sarahin , the great fortress of the Everlasting . Activites . Sar was used by the holy slayer s on major raids against caravans travelling either between Halwa and the coast , or between Qudra and the south .

title: Sar ' Rukoth
description: Sar ' Rukoth Sar ' Rukoth was an island in Okoth containing a number of crumbling ruins and new , unlit domes . Each dome contained one of 18 sterile sarrukh and all of that sarrukh ' s servants , protectors , advisers , and entertainers , most of them being yuan - ti . They were connected by a system of tunnels that passed through various salt lakes , caves , and sarrukh tombs .

title: Saradreza Oussmtor
description: Saradreza Oussmtor Saradreza Oussmtor was a high priestess of Eilistraee . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Saradreza led a group of Sword Dancers , seeing the liberation of Maerimydra as a chance to rally drow with no interest in remaining under the shackles of Lolth ' s tyranny .

title: Saradush
description: Saradush Saradush was a metropolis within the land of Tethyr . History . Once a great bureaucratic center for the city ' s royal dynasty , Saradush became a producer of agricultural products for trade .

title: Sarahin
description: Sarahin Sarahin , translated as the " Wolves ' Den " , was a unique fortress located deep within the Haunted Lands in Zakhara . The actual fortress complex was located on a mountain named Jabal Sarahin . Location .

title: Sarbossa
description: Sarbossa Sarbossa , also known as , lintonite , comptonite , ozakite , eye stone , or fire rock , occurred in small nodules up to 1 in ( 2 . 5 cm ) in diameter left behind in cavities formed by volcanic activity . Description .

title: Sarbreen
description: Sarbreen Sarbreen , called the City of the Hammer , was a dwarven city built in 616 DR . For a short time in Faerûn ' s history , it was a great thriving city that shone for a brief moment as the richest of all dwarven holds . Led by master crafters known as Master Mason s — armorers , weaponsmiths , jewelers , miners , woodcarvers , glassblowers and others — Sarbreen flourished .

title: Sarbreenar
description: Sarbreenar Sarbreenar was a hamlet in the Vast , lying high in the western Earthfast Mountains , on the High Trail between High Haspur and Elvenblood Pass before Ravens Bluff . History . Sarbreenar was originally built by the forces of Roldilar , a dwarven kingdom that once dominated the surface lands in the early 7th century DR .

title: Sardasper Halaunt
description: Sardasper Halaunt Sardasper Halaunt was a noble of Cormyr in 1487 DR . Activities . Sardasper was a noble and a businessman .

title: Sardi al - Danafi
description: Sardi al - Danafi Sardi al - Danafi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Sardi was a fair man , though the occasional bribe padded his pockets .

title: Sardior
description: Sardior Sardior ( pronounced " SAR - dee - or " ) was the dragon god of night , psionics , and secrets , and he was also the Master of gem dragon s . Description . Sardior was said to be a unique ruby dragon .

title: Sardonyx
description: Sardonyx Sardonyx was a variety of banded onyx . Description . Sardonyx was characterized by alternating stripes of carnelian ( also known as ) and white onyx .

title: Sardrant
description: Sardrant The sardrant was an animal found in warm climates in Calimshan and Tashalar . Description . The sardrant appeared much like an , with natural plating covering much of its body .

title: Sarevok Anchev
description: Sarevok Anchev Sarevok Anchev was a powerful Bhaalspawn , a mortal offspring of Bhaal , who planned to ascend to divinity , following in the dead god ' s footsteps as the Lord of Murder . To this end , he concocted a plan to use the Iron Throne as his pawn to drive Baldur ' s Gate and Amn into war , believing that the initial slaughter would cause his ascension . He also sought to eliminate competition from other Bhaalspawn , which proved to be his downfall ; his attempt to destroy one of his half - siblings living in Candlekeep failed but left that Bhaalspawn to seek revenge .

title: Sargasso
description: Sargasso Sargasso was an arcane alteration spell that temporarily created a patch of dense seaweed near the surface of a body of water that could impede the movement of ships and swimming creatures . Effects . This spell could be cast at least 90 yd ( 82 m ) away , covered an area of at least 90 ft ( 8 .

title: Sargauth Enclave
description: Sargauth Enclave The Sargauth Enclave is the name some use for the Netherese outpost on the third level of the Undermountain , but the actual name of this place has been lost over time . It was created c . - 800 DR by an order of powerful wizards from Netheril to serve as a safe haven for conducting magical experiments , but after a decade it had grown into a city of about one square mile ( 2 .

title: Sargh ' elgg
description: Sargh ' elgg Sargh ' elgg , meaning " valor in slaying " , was a fighting style taught among poor drow . It made use of their natural agility and was used in conjunction with light weapons . Description .

title: Sarghathuld
description: Sarghathuld Sarghathuld , or " Orcbane " , was a legendary magical sword forged by dwarves to slay orc s , before becoming a sword of a king ' s royal guard , then finally a prize to a dragon , adventurers , and knights . Description . " Sarghathuld " was a short sword forged of " orcslayer " metal , which was of dull gray hue .

title: Sarhthor
description: Sarhthor Sarhthor was a wizard and a member of the Zhentarim during the hunt for Shandril Shessair . History . At first , Sarhthor appeared to be a member of the Zhentarim and one of the most favored assistants of Manshoon in the hunt for the " spellfire " of Shandril Shessair .

title: Saribel Xorlarrin
description: Saribel Xorlarrin Saribel Xorlarrin , later Saribel Baenre , was the the " youngest and weakest " of the priestesses of House Xorlarrin . She was the last living daughter of Matron Mother Zeerith History . Saribel accompanied the expedition led by Ravel Xorlarrin to Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR .

title: Sarifal
description: Sarifal Sarifal was a fey kingdom located on Gwynneth Isle in the Moonshaes . As of 1479 DR the kingdom was ruled from the city of Karador by High Lady Ordalf . History .

title: Sarissa Duncastle
description: Sarissa Duncastle Sarissa Duncastle was a female human wererat from the Moonwood and was a rogue for the tribe of the People of the Black Blood living there . Description . Sarissa was the best scout of her tribe .

title: Sarith Kzekarit
description: Sarith Kzekarit Sarith Kzekarit was a drow warrior who was infected by demonic madness during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Sarith had a fatalistic approach to problems .

title: Sark Axebarrel
description: Sark Axebarrel Sark Axebarrel was a deep gnome guard in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the cynical Sark commanded a patrol at the entrance of the closed Rockblight section of the city .

title: Sark Toliver
description: Sark Toliver Sark Toliver was an officer of the secret police called Hawks in Mulmaster . Personality . Sark Tolliver usually spoke with a customarily soft voice , even when threatening someone .

title: Sarkalla
description: Sarkalla Sarkalla was a crazy Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Sarkalla , in a word , was mad .

title: Sarkenaegal
description: Sarkenaegal The Sarkenaegal , also known as The Secrets of the Shadewrights , was a spell tome of shadow magic written by the mage Sarkon . The Sarkenaegal contained dozens of shadow magic spells of varying levels . The book was considered especially dangerous because it contained the spell " Sarkon ' s Umbra Simulacrum " , which allowed a shadow mage to create a shadow doppelganger of himself .

title: Sarkon ' s umbra simulacrum
description: Sarkon ' s umbra simulacrum Sarkon ' s Umbra Simulacrum was a Shadow magic spell that allowed a shadow mage to create an exact duplicate of himself . The only known source of the spell was the Sarkenaegal , a tome of shadow magic written by Sarkon . The book was highly sought after and was recovered twice for large rewards by the rogue Jack Ravenwild .

title: Sarliman Eurdoe
description: Sarliman Eurdoe Sarliman Eurdoe was an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a local entrepreneur . As a " hothands " , or entrepreneur , Sarliman imported the rosecork tree from Prespur to his native land for its fire - resistant properties and value in building . The trees went on to flourish by the southern tributaries of the Wyvernflow .

title: Sarp Redbeard
description: Sarp Redbeard Sarp Redbeard was a Chondathan man and the lord of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr in the mid - 14th century DR . Personality . Sarp Redbeard was famously the most headstrong of the local lords of Cormyr .

title: Sarphil
description: Sarphil Sarphil was one of the lost realms of the shield dwarves . Geography . Sarphil encompassed most of the mountain ranges of the eastern Moonsea , but the realm had no clearly defined borders .

title: Sarrak
description: Sarrak Sarrak of Westgate was a wizard in Cormyr . History . Sarrak hailed from Westgate but moved to Suzail , where he became a wizard bodyguard of Lord Harkuldragon .

title: Sarrukh
description: Sarrukh The sarrukh are a race of reptilian humanoids . They are one of the five progenitor , or Creator Races , of Faerûn . Eons ago , they built and maintained empires across most of the continent .

title: Sarshel ( Person )
description: Sarshel ( Person ) Sarshel was an apprentice at Blackstaff Tower . On 28 Uktar 1374 DR , Sarshel was involved in the defence of the tower against Kemarn Darkthrush , casting a wall of ice to prevent his summoned nishruu from entering a hole in the tower ' s wall .

title: Sarsor yi Tashluta
description: Sarsor yi Tashluta Sarsor yi Tashluta was an enforcer in the service of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . Activities . Sarsor was a yuan - ti pureblood of the Se ' Sehen tribe in Tashalar .

title: Sartani
description: Sartani Sartani were monstrous creatures that were a combination of giant and crab . Description . These creatures had the legs and torso of a giant humanoid , but their head and claws were those of a crab .

title: Sarth
description: Sarth Sarth was an elder malaugrym , ( a . k . a .

title: Sarth Khul Riizar
description: Sarth Khul Riizar Sarth Khul Riizar is a powerful tiefling sorcerer and is the Master Mage of Hulburg . He is close friends with Geran Hulmaster and has saved Geran ' s life on numerous occasions . Sarth is several generations removed from his fiendish ancestors .

title: Sarula Iliene
description: Sarula Iliene Sarula Iliene was a lesser water - based nature deity who attached herself to the Seldarine . History . When the first primitive elves left Faerie in the time before the Seldarine existed , they served the fey and worshiped their gods .

title: Sarya Dlardrageth
description: Sarya Dlardrageth Countess Sarya Dlardrageth was a half sun elf , half - fiend sorceress , leader of the daemonfey and a princess of House Dlardrageth . She was over five thousand years old as of 1374 DR . Description .

title: Sarya el Thamal
description: Sarya el Thamal Sarya yr Kadila yr Pesarkhal el Thamal was the granddaughter of Syl - Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal of Calimshan through his daughter Kadila el Pesarkhal . She was born in 1370 DR . When el Pesarkhal heard the news of the birth of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III ' s triplets two months prior , el Pesarkhal proposed a marriage between his new granddaughter and their son , Prince Coram Rhindaun : The results of this proposal are not recorded in history .

title: Sash of fire resistance
description: Sash of fire resistance Sashes of fire resistance were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items often appeared as red silk sashes with extravagant platinum thread brocade .

title: Sash of heat endurance
description: Sash of heat endurance Sashes of heat endurance were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items were red silk sashes , brocaded with gold thread depicting writhing flames .

title: Sashen
description: Sashen Sashen was a Zhentarim wizard and apprentice of Ashemmi in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Sashen was the junior - most of the Ashemmi ' s pupils and had few ambitions .

title: Sashesh
description: Sashesh Lady Sashesh was the rappresentative of Sembia in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Sashesh was a merchant and trade liaison that was the principal agent of a cabal of wealthy merchants that wanted made Scardale part of Sembia .

title: Satama
description: Satama Satama was a trader and later a wise man in Durpar . He founded the cult of Adama . Satama developed the concept that everything in the world was interconnected , including the deities , making them all part of the same thing .

title: Satarin
description: Satarin Brother Satarin was a dwarf priest in Helm ' s Hold near Neverwinter in 1479 DR . Activities . Satarin took care of the crazed inmates of the Cathedral .

title: Satcheera Moonfist
description: Satcheera Moonfist Satcheera " Silvereyes " Moonfist was a female bard and a member of the Turning Key adventuring company . History . Like the rest of the Turning Key , Satcheera lived at the House of the Key in Tavilar in the Vast .

title: Sathariel
description: Sathariel Sathariel was a dark angel in the service of the evil deity Asmodeus . His exact nature is unknown and , although he was described as a dark angel , he may in fact have been a devil . Alternatively , he could have been a fallen angel .

title: Satin spar
description: Satin spar Satin spar , also known as feather gypsum , was a variety of that had a sparkling sheen . It was mainly used in carvings . Description .

title: Sato Kitashi
description: Sato Kitashi Sato Kitashi was a female samurai in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Kitashi born from Sato Mikio , the shugo - daimyo of the Hoichi Province .

title: Sato Masako
description: Sato Masako Sato Masako was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and jito of Tosa in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Sato went to a small village led by Gobo to stop some bandit sohei in answer to a letter sent by Gobo .

title: Satomi
description: Satomi Satomi was a noble in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . She hate Benju for took away her loved daughter .

title: Satyr
description: Satyr Satyrs , also called fauns , were fey creatures that delighted in singing , dancing , feasting , and debauchery . They appeared to be men with sylvan features from the waist up and possessed goat legs from the waist down . Personality .

title: Saul
description: Saul Saul was a halfling in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . The halfling was an inquisitive , talkative , and knowledgeable individual .

title: Saurglyce
description: Saurglyce Saurglyce was a female white dragon dracolich and a partner of Pox in Yartar in 1369 DR . Personality . Saurglyce had a very close bond with her humanoid partner .

title: Saurial
description: Saurial Saurials are a rare breed of Scalykind - specifically a Sauroid race descended from dinosaur - like creatures - not native to Toril . Several sub - races exist , though only four can be found on Toril itself . Unlike reptiles , Saurials are not cold - blooded .

title: Saurosphinx
description: Saurosphinx Among sphinx es , saurosphinxes are the most civilized . Combat . Saurosphinxes avoid combat , but when given no other choice they try to limit an opponent ’ s ability to attack at range .

title: Sauruki
description: Sauruki Sauruki was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Scarlet Moon Hall . Possessions . In battle , Sauruki dressed in a chain shirt and fought with quarterstaff .

title: Sava
description: Sava Sava is a game created by the drow . Resembling chess , it involves the moving and capture of pieces that represent soldiers on a battlefield . While the gameplay itself is merely hinted at in the several books it is mentioned in , again , a chess - like game can be inferred .

title: Savage Frontier
description: Savage Frontier The Savage Frontier is a region in the subcontinent of Faerûn that includes the lands north of the Delimbiyr river that are not strictly part of the High Forest , the Silver Marches , the Sword Coast or Waterdeep . It is located between the Silver Marches and the Sword Coast , where the cities of Neverwinter and Luskan lie . Contrary to its name , much of the area is really no more a savage frontier than other parts of the Realms and is quite civilized ( Ed Greenwood once compared this to similar naming for cities in the US West ) .

title: Savahn
description: Savahn Savahn was a high - ranking monk of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the Bloodstone Lands in 1484 DR . History . Savahn assisted Perrywinkle Shin .

title: Savanfast
description: Savanfast Savanfast was a ruined dwarven fortress located in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Description . Savanfast was built within the hollow of a natural stone dome , and had windows that were non - existent in the outside carved in the sides of the natural formation , allowing the dwarves to watch the surrounding terrain without the risk of being spotted by potential intruders .

title: Savengriff
description: Savengriff Savengriff ( pronounced SAY - ven - griff ) was an apprentice wizard of Khelben Arunsun before he helped to refound the Covenant . Description . Savengriff was described as a gaunt man with pale skin and an unremarkable face .

title: Savra Belabranta
description: Savra Belabranta Savra Belabranta was a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Savra was totally brainwashed by the cult and fully believed everything .

title: Savras
description: Savras Savras ( pronounced " SAV - ras " ) was a god of mages and wizards in the service of Mystra , goddess of magic . Some say he was once a mortal , one of the mighty mages who constructed the portals beneath the city of Raven ' s Bluff . He is portrayed as a man with a crystalline face , clear to all who see him .

title: Sawaka
description: Sawaka Sawaka was a pan lung member of the Celestial Bureaucracy . Activities . Sawaka was one of the officers of the Qui sub - committee that governed the affairs of the animal population of the Fochu Peninsula under orders of the Ministry of Animal Affairs of the Celestial Bureaucracy .

title: Sayeed
description: Sayeed Sayeed was a spellscar ed agent of Mephistopheles in Faerûn . History . Zeehad and Sayeed fought in The Twilight War in 1374 DR , where they were killed by Abelar Corrinthal ' s troops .

title: Sayida ibn Afa
description: Sayida ibn Afa Sayida ibn Afa was a rawun who lived within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Contrary to those with whom she lived , Sayida despised killing .

title: Scale armor
description: Scale armor Scale armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Plate mail consisted of a leather coat , leggings and sometimes skirt which was covered in small plates of overlapping scales .

title: Scalesneer
description: Scalesneer Scalesneer was a lizardfolk shaman of the Muckmarsh tribe in Twilight Marsh near Phlan . History . In 1489 DR , Scalesneer saved his chieftain Bogclaw , curing his wounds .

title: Scalykind domain
description: Scalykind domain The Scalykind domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters scalykind spell powers . They gained the ability to rebuke and command reptile s much as an evil cleric rebuked undead . Deities with the Scalykind domain .

title: Scantshar
description: Scantshar Scantshar was the name of a prominent human family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Activities . The Scantshar family was distrusted and treated with slight suspicion by other village folk .

title: Scapra
description: Scapra Scapra was the term for gem quality stones . Description . Usually rough crystal scapras were found in pale to medium yellow hues .

title: Scar Pilgrimage
description: Scar Pilgrimage A Scar Pilgrimage was a journey to plagueland s in order to gain a Spellscar , such as those made by the Order of Blue Flame . The city of Ormpetarr on the edge of the Plaguewrought Land was one of the favored destinations of scar pilgrims . Sadly , rather than obtaining the spellscar they desired , most pilgrims died horribly .

title: Scardale
description: Scardale Scardale one of the regions that makes up the Dalelands . It has longed survived where other dales have fallen , such as Teshendale , despite wars , occupation by enemy states and a horrible plague . History .

title: Scare
description: Scare Scare , which was originally called Hamring ' s scare , was an arcane necromancy spell used induce fear in several creatures . Cleric s of Bane , Ghaunadaur , Gruumsh , Set , and Urdlen were also granted the ability to cast this spell . Effects .

title: Scarlet Mummers
description: Scarlet Mummers The Scarlet Mummers were an order of Lliira - worshipers formed to avenge the murder of Lliira ' s High Revelmistress in Selgaunt . Their duties included protecting Lliiran temples and battling with Loviata ns . Their battle prowess caused their fellows in the church to both fear and respect them .

title: Scarlet Sheath
description: Scarlet Sheath The Scarlet Sheath was a tavern located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Anthara Shalymarr . History .

title: Scarlet heart mushroom
description: Scarlet heart mushroom A scarlet heart mushroom was a large black mushroom that was covered with heart - shaped red spots . When a living creature approached , its heat caused the mushroom ' s red spots to burst , giving off a cloud of spores that caused blindness that could last for 2 - 8 days ( or until cured with " remove blindness " or similar ) . Although they were immune to fire and sonic damage , acid or cold would destroy the mushrooms , while electricity caused them to become dormant for days at a time .

title: Scathebeast
description: Scathebeast Scathebeasts were large herd animals endemic to the world of Abeir . In Toril , they were found in Returned Abeir , more commonly in Skelkor , and in displaced Abeiran lands in Faerûn , usually in Tymanther . Description .

title: Scatterspray
description: Scatterspray Scatterspray was an alteration spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused a small group of items to fly about in random directions within the radius of the spell effect .

title: Scent of danger
description: Scent of danger The scent of danger ritual was used by sha ' ir s to charge their gen ' s sense of smell with supernatural ability . Preparation . A concoction of rare herbs costing 600 dinar s was needed to complete scent - related rituals .

title: Scepter of Savras
description: Scepter of Savras The Scepter of Savras was an incredibly powerful artifact capable of containing the entire essence of a god . Created by the god Azuth and used to contain the deity of divination whose name it came to bear , it was lost for centuries in the Realms . Description .

title: Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye
description: Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye The Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye was a minor artifact of Bane created by Teldorn Darkhope and Fzoul Chembryl . Description . The scepter was equivalent to a " + 3 heavy mace " and was sentient .

title: Schonert
description: Schonert Schonert was a priest of Ilmater in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . Around 1479 DR , Schonert noticed that many residents of Downshadow had disappeared while rumors had spread of a treasure in the area .

title: School of song
description: School of song The school of song was a group of arcane spell s that used the voice , speaking or singing , as its central element . It was considered a school of thaumaturgy , a system of grouping spells not by the philosophies of the traditional schools of magic , but by the method that was used to access magical energy . The school of song was in opposition to the schools of necromancy , divination , and invocation / evocation .

title: School of the Mage of Shadowdale
description: School of the Mage of Shadowdale The School of the Mage of Shadowdale was a small school in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Students accepted by Elfinster could learn magical spell s , or , if they lacked magical ability , they could learn to recognize a specific spell being cast based upon the caster ' s gestures and speech .

title: School of the Penitents
description: School of the Penitents The School of the Penitents was an order devoted to the god Ilmater , the One Who Endures , and was dedicated to spreading his faith in the Underdark . It consisted of nine separate groups , each with only four or five members . They kept a number of small enclaves in unexplored locations throughout the Upperdark level of the Underdark .

title: School of the Shadow Weave
description: School of the Shadow Weave The School of the Shadow Weave was a magic school in Sshamath . Description . The city was unique among drow cities in that it wasn ' t ruled by a clergy but by mages .

title: Schuyler
description: Schuyler Schuyler was a food critic in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Schuyler went to the Madame Freona ' s Tea Kettle in order to test their food .

title: Scimitar
description: Scimitar The scimitar was a one - handed , martial melee weapon of the sword family . Description . The scimitar was similar to the falchion in that it was a " backsword " , sharpened on one edge and the other edge was thicker to give it strength .

title: Scimitar of shame
description: Scimitar of shame The scimitar of shame was a magic weapon that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons were available in a wide variety of scimitar s .

title: Scintillating sphere
description: Scintillating sphere Scintillating sphere was a spell unique to Halruaa . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to summon a small grape - sized ball of energy that traveled in a straight line where directed .

title: Scions of Amber
description: Scions of Amber The Scions of Amber was a freedom - fighting organization that operated in the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . Activities . The Scions of Amber ' s main goal was to end the dragon s ' rule in the Dusk Ports , and eventually in all Returned Abeir .

title: Scirkhel Wands
description: Scirkhel Wands Scirkhel Wands was a ranger and bard of the Wands family in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . History . Scirkhel was born in 1319 DR .

title: Scorching burst
description: Scorching burst A scorching burst is an evocation spell cast by many wizard s inflamed with the power of fire . When a wizard chooses to cast this spell , which he can do at any time , he creates a pillar of golden flame at the spot of his target , trapping his target and any others very close within its grasp . The burst must be cast within fifty feet of the wizard and disappears in an instant , but can be recast at any time .

title: Scoril Cimber
description: Scoril Cimber Scoril Cimber , also known as Shadowhawk , was the father of Artus Cimber and a renown highwayman within the King ' s Forest of Cormyr . Description . Scoril was a gruff hooked - nose man with dark green eyes .

title: Scorlworyx
description: Scorlworyx Scorlworyx was a red dragon in the Dragonspire Mountains in 1489 DR . History . One day , she heard that the neighboring Circle of the Scales had claimed that , thanks to a scale of Tiamat herself , they could dominate all dragons .

title: Scornubel
description: Scornubel Scornubel , also known as the Caravan City , was a major tradestop for caravans . It lay on the northern bank of the River Chionthar , where the Trade Way reached the river . Population .

title: Scornubrian sandglass
description: Scornubrian sandglass A Scornubrian sandglass was a miniature hourglass made in Scornubel that took two minutes and two seconds to empty its contents . It was often used to time moves in games or could be used to limit the time taken to make a decision or to choose a partner during certain festivals .

title: Scothgar
description: Scothgar Scothgar was a Northlander human man and a prince of Rogarsheim on the island of Norland in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR . In the Year of Nineteen Swords , 621 DR , he was due to marry the Ffolk Princess Bridget of Callidyrr , but she and her whole royal entourage vanished on the voyage to Norland . Ffolk and Northmen each blamed the other for the disappearance , which worsened relations between them .

title: Scott Haring
description: Scott Haring Scott Haring is a game designer who has worked for . He has contributed to Dungeons & Dragons material with gaming material in some of the comic books published by TSR , Inc . and was the author of the " Empires of the Sands " sourcebook .

title: Scour
description: Scour Scour was a Voidharrow demon who entered Toril through a gate from another universe with his " sibling " Murmur hundreds of years before the Spellplague . Scour ' s consciousness was scattered into many pieces but Murmur was apparently able to revive much of Scour ' s mind . By 1480 DR , Scour was in Luskan , manifesting as a swarm of mutated vermin .

title: Scoured Legion
description: Scoured Legion The Scoured Legion ( also known as the Scourged Legion ) of Hellgate Keep was a strong company of tanarukk s . Leadership . The Scoured Legion was led by Kaanyr Vhok , a cambion who proclaimed himself " the Sceptered One and Master of the Scoured Legions .

title: Scourge of fangs
description: Scourge of fangs A scourge of fangs , also known as a whip of fangs or a viper whip , was a snake - headed whip used by many drow cleric s of Lolth . Description . A " scourge of fangs " usually had an adamantine handle and a number of serpentine constructs ( snake heads ) as lashes .

title: Scourge of the Sword Coast
description: Scourge of the Sword Coast Summary . Recent events caused the brief reactivation of the " portal " to Avernus in Dragonspear Castle . During that window of opportunity , the shade of the pit fiend Baazka reentered Faerûn .

title: Scout
description: Scout A scout is a class similar to a rogue or ranger , preferring to stay hidden and attack from a distance rather then up close and personal . They have varying roles , from leading an army through unknown terrain to working as a missionary going solo to learn terrain for the payer . Usually they wear leather armor , as they rely more on speed and agility to out maneuver an opponent .

title: Scrag
description: Scrag Scrags ( also known as marine trolls , aquatic trolls , sea scrags , and sea trolls ) were an aquatic version of troll . There were two varieties : freshwater trolls and saltwater trolls . Nomenclature .

title: Scramsax
description: Scramsax Scramsax was an innkeeper in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Scramsax , a retired sellsword , managed the Northlook inn , a well - known place among adventurers and mercenaries of the North .

title: Screaming
description: Screaming Screaming is a quality that can be applied to weapons . If it is applied to ranged weapons , the effects apply to their ammunition . The weapon makes a low humming noise which changes to a painful screaming when it strikes a target , inflicting sonic damage , even within the area of a " silence " spell .

title: Screeching Wing
description: Screeching Wing The Screeching Wing was a small band of kir - lanan that laired at the Wailing Cliff , in the Deep Wastes . They were led by a powerful kir - lanan half - dragon called Phaikkul . Organization .

title: Screen
description: Screen Screen is an illusion spell that hides an area from vision and scrying . Effects . This spell combines several elements to create a powerful protection from scrying and direct observation .

title: Scriveners of Doom
description: Scriveners of Doom The Scriveners of Doom were the priesthood of Jergal , the Lord of the End of Everything . Priests of Jergal served as scribes , funerary workers , and morticians . The task of recording the fates and affairs of short - lived mortals of the land rested with the Scriveners of Doom .

title: Scroll
description: Scroll A scroll is a rolled or folded document . Unlike a tome , a scroll is usually a single piece of parchment . Magical scrolls contain the words of a spell that is released when the caster reads the words on the page .

title: Scrying
description: Scrying Scrying was the magical ability to use one ' s senses to experience events far away . Magical sensor . Many divination spells of the scrying subschool created a magical sensor that sent the caster information .

title: Scrying ( spell )
description: Scrying ( spell ) Scrying was both an arcane and divine magic spell that allowed the caster to view a subject at great distance and possibly across the planes of existence . The effect was very similar to using a " crystal ball " but with differences in scope , duration , and components . Newer versions of this spell allowed the caster to hear as well as see the subject .

title: Sculptures for the Elite
description: Sculptures for the Elite Sculptures for the Elite was a shop located in the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . This shop was located on the south side of the bazaar .

title: Scupperden
description: Scupperden Scupperden was an eatery located in the Dredge , the lowest level of Skullport . The establishment was known primarily for its stew made of fish , mushrooms and vegetable scraps which sold for 1 cp per bowl . The stew was described as somewhat alarming but unlikely to kill the eater .

title: Scurrd
description: Scurrd Describe by the Bloodsailor pirate Jalek in Neverwinter Nights as " The Meanest . . .

title: Scyllua Darkhope
description: Scyllua Darkhope Scyllua Darkhope was the Castellan of Zhentil Keep and High Captain of its armies . A fallen paladin of Tyr , she became a champion and blackguard of Bane . Under her leadership the Zhents were able to recover after the near complete destruction of their city by the humanoid army sent by Cyric in 1368 DR .

title: Scythe
description: Scythe A scythe is a farm implement that can be used as a two - handed , martial melee weapon . Description . A scythe is a long , curved , sharp - pointed , one - sided blade mounted at 90° on a shaped haft and is normally used for harvesting wheat or corn .

title: Sea ( province )
description: Sea ( province ) The province of sea in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of water . Dominated by deserts as the Land of Fate was , the magical province took its name from the one place where water was abundant : the seas surrounding the continent , so important for trade and travel . Many of its spells were related to sea - faring .

title: Sea Sprite
description: Sea Sprite The Sea Sprite was a large pirate hunting ship that was under the command of Captain Deudermont . The ship was commissioned by the Lords of Waterdeep , who recognised Deudermont ' s talents as a capable sailor and pirate hunter . Second in command on the Sea Sprite was Robillard , a capable wizard , albeit eternally grumpy , and friend to Deudermont .

title: Sea Tower
description: Sea Tower The Sea Tower was a fortress in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was the base of the Guard of Tantras . Location .

title: Sea Ward of Waterdeep
description: Sea Ward of Waterdeep The Sea Ward of Waterdeep was the wealthiest ward in Waterdeep and located in the northwest of the city . Geography . The ward contained the Field of Triumph , Heroes ' Garden and the Sea ' s Edge Beach .

title: Sea cat
description: Sea cat A sea cat , also known as a sea lion , was a magical beast that combined the features of a lion and a fish . It was a ferocious predator of the seas . Description .

title: Sea domain
description: Sea domain Umberlee and her alone holds the domain of the untamed sea , to any and all who wants to enter her domain must pay a trubiute to or linking or draw her terrible wrath , The Queen of the depths will strike quick and swift against those who anger her . Power of sea domain . Any divine caster who worships a god of the sea domain may use it to channel the power of the deity .

title: Sea hag
description: Sea hag Sea hags were wicked , cruel fey creatures . As their name implied , they were found in and along the shores of the sea . Description .

title: Sea legs
description: Sea legs Sea legs was a divine magic spell that could give a creature the ability to keep its balance and maneuver on board a vessel being tossed by waves . The reverse of this spell , called land legs , removed this ability , making it difficult and possibly dangerous to attempt any action on a heaving deck . As a healing effect , " sea legs " also prevented sea sickness .

title: Sea mother whip
description: Sea mother whip A Sea Mother Whip is a special prestige class of the kuo - toa . Those who pick this class seek a closer communion with their goddess , Blibdoolpoolp . In return for the dedication and desire to be close with her goddess , a Sea Mother Whip is given abilities to aid her in the goals that she has been given to her by her church .

title: Sea of Caravans
description: Sea of Caravans The Sea of Caravans , also called Bahr al - Dahil , was an inland sea nestled between north , west , and Interior Zakhara in 1367 DR . Geography . The Sea of Caravans was an important body of water connecting trade and commerce between Qudra and the Free Cities of Zakhara in the north with the Cities of the Heart in the southeast .

title: Sea of Fallen Stars
description: Sea of Fallen Stars The Sea of Fallen Stars , also known as the Inner Sea , was the largest inland body of water in Faerûn . Its major areas included the Dragonmere ( Lake of Dragons ) on the west , the Dragon and Easting Reaches on the north , the Alamber Sea on the east and the Vilhon Reach on the south . The sea floor was covered with hundreds of shipwrecks .

title: Sea of Moving Ice
description: Sea of Moving Ice The Sea of Moving Ice is the northernmost place in known Faerûn . Almost completely uncharted , it is filled with icebergs and isles of ice , set wide enough apart for a ship to pass . The ice of the sea changes so that all but the most experienced seafarers can be caught off guard , proof of such are a collection of ancient ice - locked ships .

title: Sea of Swords
description: Sea of Swords The Sea of Swords separates the western coast of Faerûn from the Nelanther Isles , the Moonshaes , Evermeet , Lantan and the further off areas of Abeir - Toril such as Maztica . History . The famed explorer Balduran was the first noted Faerûnian to explore the sea extensively , returning with wealth enough to build a huge city , a fine ship , and with enough left over to retire comfortably .

title: Sea of Swords ( novel )
description: Sea of Swords ( novel ) Sea of Swords is the fourth book in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Sea sight
description: Sea sight Sea sight was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Sea spawn
description: Sea spawn Sea spawn were humanoids that were transformed into hybrid marine creatures by making a pact with a powerful marine entity , such as a dragon turtle , a kraken , a marid , a morkoth , a sea hag or a storm giant or by suffering a curse from one such entity . Once transformed , the sea spawn became a minion of one such creature and could never stay away from the sea for too long . History .

title: Sea wyrm
description: Sea wyrm Sea wyrms were legless and wingless dragon s that inhabited the oceans and seas surrounding Zakhara . Description . Sea wyrms did not have legs or wings on their elongated bodies .

title: Seal of fate
description: Seal of fate The Seal of fate was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item appeared as a seal with letters carved deeply into its surface .

title: Sean K . Reynolds
description: Sean K . Reynolds Sean K . Reynolds is a professional game designer who has worked on and co - written a number of Dungeons & Dragons supplements for Wizards of the Coast , as well as material for other companies .

title: Search for the Diamond Staff
description: Search for the Diamond Staff Search for the Diamond Staff was an adventure module for the D & D Encounters program in 2013 , for the 4th edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Plot Synopsis . Following on from the events of Vault of the Dracolich , the sage Imani organises an expedition to one of Uvaeren ' s library - vaults .

title: Seatower of Balduran
description: Seatower of Balduran The massive Seatower of Balduran rested on a rocky island in the bay of Baldur ' s Gate . History . Named after Balduran , the tower could be reached by a bridge from the western shore linking it to the mainland .

title: Seawind Alley
description: Seawind Alley Seawind Alley was an alley in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep notable for the ghostly voices that could be heard within the alley . Inhabitants . The voices were harmless and usually spoke nothing but nonsensical phrases .

title: Sebastian Stoe
description: Sebastian Stoe Sebastian Stoe was a boy in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Relationships . Sebastian was the son of Blazen Stoe .

title: Sebastion
description: Sebastion Sebastion was a storm giant from the storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain . Description . Sebastion had pale violet skin and blue - black hair that was very long and unkempt .

title: Sebek
description: Sebek Sebek ( pronounced " seh " - beck ) is a jealous , vain , and evil member of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Know as Sebethant in Thay and by the name Sebakar in Unther , he delights in devouring humans . History .

title: Secomber
description: Secomber Secomber was a small , peaceful town that acted as the " de facto " border town between the relatively peaceful Western Heartlands and the more savage North along the Sword Coast . The town contained a number of colorful gardens . Geography .

title: Second Sundering
description: Second Sundering The Second Sundering ( sometimes called the Sundering of Toril and Abeir ) was a catastrophic event in the history of Toril . Events . Overview .

title: Second battle of Shadowdale
description: Second battle of Shadowdale The second battle of Shadowdale ( often referred to as simply the battle of Shadowdale ) was a battle fought in Shadowdale within the Dalelands in 1358 DR , between the defending forces of the Dalelands , and troops from Zhentil Keep , led by Bane .

title: Second inter - dale war
description: Second inter - dale war The second inter - dale war occurred in 1356 DR when Lord Lashan Aumersair of Scardale invaded a number of other dales . His forces quickly overcame Battledale , Featherdale and Harrowdale , and soon began invading Deepingdale and Mistledale . However , Cormyr , Hillsfar , Sembia and Zhentil Keep were displeased by Lord Lashan Aumersair ' s intentions , and an alliance was formed , which saw his defeat and the collapse of his " empire " .

title: Secret of Phantoms ' Cloister
description: Secret of Phantoms ' Cloister In the last adventure , the party entered the Mind of Karsus , where an unspoiled version of Phantom ' s Cloister , called the Monastery of the Fallen One , exists . It is populated by the shades of monks who worshiped the momentary god but now desire only release from their extraplanar prison . Along the way , the party can rescue a relative of the High Lord of Loudwater , Nardine Twohands .

title: Secret of the Silver Blades
description: Secret of the Silver Blades Secret of the Silver Blades is the third title in the four - game " Forgotten Realms " series of computer role - playing games developed and published by Strategic Simulations , Inc . It is the sequel to " Curse of the Azure Bonds " . Story .

title: Secrets of the Sages
description: Secrets of the Sages Secrets of the Sages was the first — and only — issue of the Forgotten Realms newsletter . It was promised to buyers of the original edition of the " Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting " , if they joined the " Order of Heroes " via the enclosed customer response card . It was dated Summer 1988 and contained : This was the only issue of the newsletter actually published .

title: Secure
description: Secure Secure was an arcane alteration spell that protected a door , portal , or chest from being opened or passed through , although it could eventually be physically destroyed . Effects . This spell prevented even the caster from opening a chest or passing through a door or portal that had been " secured " .

title: Sedge
description: Sedge Sedge was a halfling bard in Neverwinter . Activities . Around 1479 DR , Sedge made his living as a fireside companion for hire , bodyguard , and teller of tales .

title: Sedina Wolfpaw
description: Sedina Wolfpaw Sedina Wolpaw was a scout in the Dessarin Valley during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . Sedina hailed from Triboar .

title: Sedji al - Sanje
description: Sedji al - Sanje Sedji al - Sanje was a mamluk of the Valiant who served within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sedji was the commander of the guards stationed at the Grand Gate of Delights , protecting the main entrance to the palace .

title: See invisibility
description: See invisibility See invisibility , or detect invisibility , was a divination spell that allowed the caster to see invisible or ethereal creatures and objects . Some creatures had the magical ability to always see invisibility , such as helmed horror s , jade spider s , marid s , and other creatures . Effects .

title: Seeing Stones
description: Seeing Stones The Seeing Stones were a magical set of stones used for communication . Abilities . The Seeing Stones allowed communication between two individuals regardless of the distance .

title: Seeking
description: Seeking Seeking was a weapon quality that could only be applied to ranged weapons . When fired at a target , the ammunition of these weapons would veer toward the target , moving around anything concealing or obscuring it . However , it would not seek out enemies if their whereabouts were not known to the wielder .

title: Seerah
description: Seerah Seerah was a ranger and a member of the Order of Blue Flame . Description . She had pale skin and blonde hair .

title: Seerat
description: Seerat Seerat the Green was an Emerald Enclave druid in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . History . When the black dragon Throstulgrael arrived in the area , Seerat was captured by the dragon ' s kobold minions .

title: Sefer al - Raq
description: Sefer al - Raq Sefer al - Raq was an inhabitant of the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activities . As a priest of Kossuth and staunch member of the Brotherhood of the True Flame , Sefer was tasked with recruiting potential members for the Brotherhood from the efreeti city .

title: Segojan Earthcaller
description: Segojan Earthcaller Segojan Earthcaller was the neutral good gnome deity of earth and nature . Unlike his ally Baervan Wildwanderer , who was a god of the plants and forests of the surface world , Segojan ' s area of concern was the deep earth and the life within it . Segojan was also seen as the gnomish god of the dead , for the forgotten folk interred their fallen kin into his domain .

title: Sehanine Moonbow
description: Sehanine Moonbow Sehanine Moonbow ( pronounced " seh " - ha - neen " moon " - boe ) is the fey aspect of Selûne , god dess of the moon . She is one of the more powerful members of the Seldarine . The Lady of Dreams actively opposes the nefarious schemes of the Spider Queen and the other drow powers .

title: Sehlmari Ssemm
description: Sehlmari Ssemm Sehlmari Ssemm was a mercenary recruiter in Westgate . Activities . Sehlmari was the morale officer and quartermaster of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .

title: Sei
description: Sei Sei was a helpful spirit in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Sei was the spirit of a cherry blossom living near the cursed Ito - Jo .

title: Seila Norwood
description: Seila Norwood Seila Norwood was a young noblewoman of House Norwood in Ravens Bluff . She was the quintessential damsel in distress and was best known for her romantic attachment to Jack Ravenwild . Description .

title: Seiveril Miritar
description: Seiveril Miritar Lord Seiveril Miritar ( also Councilor Seiveril Miritar and Lord of Elion ) of the Miritar clan was a sun elf high priest of Corellon Larethian and a councilor of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower . He lived at Seamist , the Miritar palace . He was over four hundred years old .

title: Sekrr
description: Sekrr Sekrr was a male beholder who laired in Vournoth ' s Mire . Description . Sekrr looked much like most beholders with ten writhing eye stalks atop his orb - like body .

title: Sela Kitar
