description: Sela Kitar Sela Kitar was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sela had the immense responsibility of coordinating all of the activity within the warehouses of the House of Al - Danafi .

title: Selan
description: Selan Selan was the goddess of beauty of Zakhara . She was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and stood for the beauty that lay in everything . Selan ' s symbol was a moon within a ring .

title: Selanith L ' baros
description: Selanith L ' baros Selanith L ' baros was a female Crinti half - drow ( though 1 / 32 drow ) and the baroness of Herath , a city in Dambrath in the Shining South . Personality . Selanith was a cruel woman who greatly enjoyed contests and games that ended in the death of the loser .

title: Selantha
description: Selantha Selantha was a shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . Selantha managed a stone - and - wood shop alone from 1364 DR , when her husband disappeared on a trading mission .

title: Seldarine
description: Seldarine The Seldarine ( Elvish for " fellowship of brothers and sisters of the wood " ) was the elven pantheon of gods that resided on the astral dominion of Arvandor under the leadership of Corellon Larethian . Pre - Spellplague . Before the Spellplague , the Seldarine consisted of : Post - Spellplague .

title: Seldig
description: Seldig Seldig was a deep gnome fighter / illusionist from Blingdenstone . History . Around 1357 DR , Seldig ’ s svirfneblin patrol encountered Catti - brie disguised as a drow female , with the help of Agatha ' s mask .

title: Seldinor Stormcloak
description: Seldinor Stormcloak Seldinor Stormcloak was a male magelord who was one of the most powerful magelords of Athalantar . Description . As a tall man , Seldinor was attractive and extremely charismatic .

title: Seldra Tylmarande
description: Seldra Tylmarande Seldra Tylmarande was a half - elf woman who attempted to claim the throne of Neverwinter in 1478 DR using some clever ruses . Appearance . Seldra was described as an attractive brunette half - elf of about thirty years .

title: Seldszar Elpragh
description: Seldszar Elpragh Seldszar Elpragh was the head of the College of Divination and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . Seldszar became the Master of his college around 1177 DR , learning the secret about Sshamath ' s " faerzress " : it was cast by the first Master of Divination Chal ' dzar and the powerful conjurer Ythzin .

title: Selfaril Uoumdolphin
description: Selfaril Uoumdolphin Selfaril Uomodolphin was the High Blade of Mulmaster until 1375 DR . History . Selfaril become the High Blade in 1348 DR after killing his predecessor .

title: Selgard ' s Smithy
description: Selgard ' s Smithy Selgard ' s Smithy was a metalworking smithy in Shadowdale , originally owned and operated by Bronn Selgard . Location . Selgard ' s Smithy lay in central Shadowdale along the North Ride between Tethgar ' s House and the Stone House .

title: Selgaunt
description: Selgaunt Formerly known as Chancelgaunt , Selgaunt was a large merchant port on the Sea of Fallen Stars , the capital of the nation of Sembia . History . As of 1372 DR , Selgaunt was the wealthiest of Sembian cities and was ruled by merchant families .

title: Selger
description: Selger Selger was the Northman king of Trisk in Purple Rocks in 1370 DR but also an agent of the Kraken Society . Relationships . The Krakenar had control over Selger and Trisk for many decades .

title: Selin Ramur
description: Selin Ramur Selin Ramur was the marchion of Mirabar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Selin was the nominal ruler of Mirabar and a key member of the Lords ' Alliance .

title: Selinor
description: Selinor Selinor was a sage in Ordulin . History . Around 1358 DR , Selinor ' s area of expertise was the Elven Court .

title: Selpir
description: Selpir The Selpir was a slow and quiet creek that forked from the Ardeep River and the South Ardeep River . Geography . From source to mouth , the Selpir was surrounded by a marshy region known as the Selpir Marsh , which extended all the way to the coast .

title: Selsharra Durothil
description: Selsharra Durothil Selsharra Durothil was a sun elf , matron of the powerful Durothil clan , and a member of the Council of Evermeet . During the daemonfey assault on elven settlements in Faerûn in 1374 DR , she and Ammisyll Veldann threatened to withdraw the support of the houses of Durothil and Veldann if Amlaruil Moonflower sent forces from Evermeet to aid the Faerûnian elves .

title: Selu ' kiira
description: Selu ' kiira A selu ' kiira ( or high loregem ) was an intelligent gemstone that stored knowledge and could teach this knowledge to a viewer . It could also harm the viewer if it choose not to part with its knowledge . A " selu ' kiira " was a much more complicated form of a " tel ' kiira " .

title: Selvetargtlin
description: Selvetargtlin The Selvetargtlin were the followers of Selvetarm , Lolth ' s champion . Their ranks were largely made up of males , finding comfort in a male god while still paying homage to Lolth . The Selvetargtlin were known for wearing blood red robes , often over a coat of chain mail .

title: Selvetarm
description: Selvetarm Selvetarm , known also as The Spider that Waits , ( self - appointed ) Champion of Lolth or , despite being Vhaeraun ' s son and thus her grandson , Son of Lolth was the drow demigod of warriors and battle prowes . His church basically consisted of a military sub - division of Lolth ' s church , and was practically forgotten outside of his cult in Eryndlyn . In fact , the name assoicated with those followers of the Spider that Waits - - Selvetargtlin - - could be applied without problems to his entire clergy .

title: Selwyn Anderil
description: Selwyn Anderil Selwyn Anderil was a farmer during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activitivies . Selwyn managed a farm in the valley .

title: Selydra
description: Selydra Selydra , or the Pale Sybil , was an undead wizard living in Lorosfyr in the 1370s DR . She was a kind of vampire that consumed souls and magic . History .

title: Selûnarra
description: Selûnarra Selûnarra was also known as Opus , and was a surviving Netherese city whose patron was Selûne . The city survived the phaerimm s ' magical assaults by being transported to the Gates of the Moon , Selûne ' s realm in the Astral Sea , in the Year of the Sundered Webs ( - 339 DR ) . Opus stood in stark contrast to the other enclaves of Netheril .

title: Selûne
description: Selûne Selûne ( pronounced " seh - LOON - ay " ) , also known as Our Lady of Silver and the Moonmaiden , was the goddess of the moon . She was also venerated in Faerûn as a goddess of light , stars , navigation , navigators , wanderers , questers , and goodly lycanthropes . History .

title: Selûne ' s Eye
description: Selûne ' s Eye Selûne ' s Eye was an artifact associated with the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . History . " Selûne ' s Eye " was a matter of legend , set down in the Song of Selûne .

title: Selûne ' s Smile
description: Selûne ' s Smile Selûne ' s Smile , also known as the Inn of the Crescent Moon , was a tavern devoted to Selûne in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . Services . The Church of Selûne in Waterdeep used the Smile as a base of operations .

title: Selûne ( moon )
description: Selûne ( moon ) Selûne was the name of Toril and Abeir ' s moon . Description . Selûne was about 2 , 000 miles ( 3 , 200 km ) across and was located some 20 , 000 miles ( 32 , 000 km ) away from Toril .

title: Semberflow
description: Semberflow The Semberflow was a river in the Cormanthor forest . Geography . The stream flowed from Lake Sember to the River Verire .

title: Semberholme
description: Semberholme Semberholme was a range of wooded hills that were once home to a cavern - dwelling community of elves . It was one of the four old communities of Cormanthyr ( the others were the Elven Court , Myth Drannor , and the Tangled Trees ) . It lay on the banks of Lake Sember , in the south and west of Cormanthor Environs .

title: Sembia
description: Sembia Although once a wealthy , independent collection of city - states , Sembia was , as of 1479 DR , a vassal state of the Netherese Empire . Only the cities of Urmlaspyr and Daerlun remained independent . Prior to the Spellplague , Sembia was a young country of considerable wealth and prosperity governed by its merchants .

title: Sembia : Gateway to the Realms
description: Sembia : Gateway to the Realms Sembia : Gateway to the Realms is a seven part series focusing on the residents of Stormweather Towers in Selgaunt . It was originally titled the Sembia series . The first novel , " The Halls of Stormweather " , is an anthology , and multiple authors wrote the rest of installments .

title: Sememmon
description: Sememmon Sememmon ( born Malathar Wingstarl ) was a Chondathan human of the Wingstarl family , former student of Manshoon and former Lord of Darkhold but went on the run with his consort Ashemmi . His body is a clone ( his 6th ) that was created for him by Manshoon during his time with the Zhentarim . Description .

title: Seminarcane
description: Seminarcane The Seminarcane was a six - building complex in Keltar dedicated to magical education . Description . The outer walls were composed of simple brickwork , but the interiors of most of the buildings were decorated by elaborate mosaics .

title: Semkhrun
description: Semkhrun Semkhrun was founded in - 1124 DR by the ruler of Mulhorand . All that remains today are a few crumbling obelisks on the surface and many subterranean chambers . Circa 1360 DR , the ruins had been rediscovered by adventurers , and it was considered a dangerous ( but potentially lucrative ) site .

title: Semlithol
description: Semlithol Semlithol was a city in Semphar . Description . Located on the coast of the Gbor Nor , Semlithol was a small town in Semphar noted for its orchards , pleasant breezes , and fresh water .

title: Semmonemily
description: Semmonemily Semmonemily was a doppelganger working for the Kraken Society . Activities . As a member of the Kraken Society , Semmonemily would gather the latest rumors and information from numerous Underdark sources and unusual informers .

title: Semorav
description: Semorav Semorav , formally known as Semorav of the Cobra ' s Hood , was a necromancer and an agent of the Coiled Cabal in the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in Hlondeth as of the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . Semorav was a bipedal yuan - ti pureblood but had very distinctive snake - like features .

title: Sempadan Forest
description: Sempadan Forest The Sempadan Forest was a vast forest lying on the eastern side of the wide isthmus joining the continents of Faerûn and Kara - Tur with Zakhara . It was known as Herne ' s Wood to the people of the Utter East , on the western side of the isthmus , and as the Jungle of Monsters to Zakharans to the southwest . Geography .

title: Semphar
description: Semphar Semphar was the mightiest nation in the Hordelands . It was a of the Tuigan Khahan . Semphar strove to be independent but was subjugated by four different realms in its history , specifically the Imaskari , Mulhorand , the Shou Lung and most recently the Tuigan .

title: Semuanya
description: Semuanya Semuanya was the lizardfolk deity of survival and propagation . Description . Semuanya appeared as an outsized lizard man , strong and agile in both body and mind .

title: Sendai Argrims
description: Sendai Argrims Sendai Argrims was the heiress of the Amn ian noble merchant house of the Argrims . History . She was hunting in the Fire Leaf Forest with her companions Aleksander and Delgod when they came upon Gorion ' s Ward .

title: Sendever ' s Stables
description: Sendever ' s Stables Sendever ' s Stables was a stables located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Illumor Sendever . Location & Description .

title: Sending
description: Sending Sending is an evocation spell that delivers a short message anywhere , instantly . Effect . You contact a particular creature with whom you are familiar and send a short message of twenty - five words or less to the subject .

title: Sendrin
description: Sendrin Sendrin was a village in the Vast , standing on the junction of the Long Reach trail from Bambryn to King ' s Reach and Blaern ' s Trail from Thindilar to Fallentree . History . A temple to Savras was founded in Sendrin around the time when human s first dominated the Vast .

title: Senityili
description: Senityili Senityili was a sahuagin priestess of Sekolah in the Sea of Swords . History . Senityili lived in the City of Caverns .

title: Senni Diggermattock
description: Senni Diggermattock Senni Diggermattock was , along with her husband Dorbo Diggermattock , one of the informal rulers of the settlers in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Senni ' s main task was to find homes for all the new settlers .

title: Sensei
description: Sensei Sensei was the leader of the Hijo ninja clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . The Sensei always had his face covered in public .

title: Sentinelspire ( mountain )
description: Sentinelspire ( mountain ) The Sentinelspire was a mountain in the Hordelands . Description . Located east of the Khopet - Dag , the Sentinelspire was a lone volcanic mountain in the Hordelands .

title: Seppremis
description: Seppremis Seppremis was a high elf farmhand in the Moonsea . Activities . Seppremis worked as a farmhand on the Allano rothé farm .

title: Sepulcher
description: Sepulcher Brother Sepulcher was a priest of Jergal in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . As a priest of Jergal , Sepulcher was stationed at the Yawning Portal , keeping notes of the names and descriptions of any adventurers that entered Undermountain , sometimes questioning them about relatives , spiritual inclinations , and intended Undermountain destinations .

title: Ser ' ryu
description: Ser ' ryu Ser ' ryu was a queen of blue dragon s . Personality . Ser ' ryu took part in Akachi ' s Crusade on the Fugue Plane .

title: Serag Kull
description: Serag Kull Serag Kull was one of the captains of the military force known as the Red Plumes . Description . Serag stood around 6 ft ( 1 .

title: Seranolla
description: Seranolla Seranolla the Whisperer was an agent of the Emerald Enclave in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . Seranolla was possibly involved in the case of dracolich es and ghost ship roaming the Moonsea .

title: Serelis Greenleaf
description: Serelis Greenleaf Serelis Greenleaf was a ranger in the Quivering Forest near Phlan in 1489 DR . Activities . Serelis usually acted as a mediator between the Kabel ' s Hill ' s community and the elves of the forest .

title: Seren Juramot
description: Seren Juramot Seren Juramot was a mercenary war wizard of the ship the Green Siren . History . Seren was once one of the Red Wizards of Thay and worked with the Thayan enclaves in Raven ' s Bluff and in Silverymoon .

title: Serge Affapanov
description: Serge Affapanov Lord Serge Affapanov was a noble in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Relationships . Serge was the father of Ayre Affapanov .

title: Sergen Hulmaster
description: Sergen Hulmaster Step brother of Kara Hulmaster , Sergen was adopted into the family when his father Kamoth Kastelmar married Terena Hulmaster . The Hulmasters allowed Sergen to remain a member of the family even after Kamoth ' s attempt to seize control of Hulburg in 1466 DR . Sergen teamed up with his father ( Kamoth ) in an attempt to capture Hulburg in 1479 DR but was killed by Geran Hulmaster .

title: Sergor
description: Sergor Sergor was a warrior of Damara . History . Sergor was a sergeant in Damara ' s army , stationed at a small garrison in the Tomrav village , near the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .

title: Serinia
description: Serinia Serinia was a priestess of Mielikki and a member of the Emerald Enclave in Elventree . Activities . Serinia took care of the Hall of the Unicorn , the local temple to Mielikki .

title: Serissa
description: Serissa Serissa was the storm giant heiress sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . When Serissa was very youth she went with her mother into Sword Coast and Moonshae Isles meeting friendly small folks .

title: Serpent ' s Cowl
description: Serpent ' s Cowl Serpent ' s Cowl is a small village upstream of Boareskyr Bridge on east bank of the Winding Water . It is very close to the Forest of Wyrms . Located nearby is the estate of Heartwing own by Aluena Halacanter .

title: Serpent Hills
description: Serpent Hills The Serpent Hills were a range of rocky hills in the Western Heartlands of Faerûn , bordered on the north , west , and south by the High Moor and on the north , east , and south by the Serpent ' s Tail stream . Geography . The peaks of the western Serpent Hills broaden out and eventually level out to become the High Moor .

title: Serpent Valley
description: Serpent Valley The Serpent Valley was a river valley lying east of Doegan in the Utter East . Description . A tortuously winding river snaked through the Serpent Valley , deep amidst the untamed hills .

title: Serpent lord
description: Serpent lord Serpent lords were reptiles that lived in the hills and ancient ruins of Zakhara . Description . These creatures resembled giant white cobras with human faces that smiled frequently .

title: Serpentine
description: Serpentine Serpentine was the name given to a family of related materials which included williamsite , ricolite , , picrolite , taxoite , , and sometimes referred to as poor man ' s jade . Top quality samples of williamsite were classified as semi - precious stones and all other varieties were treated as hardstones sold under the name serpentine stone . Description .

title: Serpentine stone
description: Serpentine stone Serpentine stone was the name given to a wide variety of minerals including williamsite , ricolite , picrolite , taxoite , and bowenite . It was used for carving , furniture inlays , and building facing . Outside the Realms it was known as .

title: Serusan
description: Serusan Serusan ( or Serosian common ) was a shorthand language used as a common trade language by shallow - water races . It was a distinctly an undersea tongue , and contained dolphins ' clicks and whistles , words from the sahuagin language language , the aquatic elvish tongue , and the kuo - toan language , it also included some parts from the aquan language , which was used by locathah , merfolk , and shalarin . All these races could speak and understand Serusan , but unless fluent in it as a separate language , they could only grasp the most basic meanings .

title: Servan Llarabbar
description: Servan Llarabbar Servan Llarabbar was a drow mage in Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , after the demise of Ilvara Mizzrym , Servan was chosen as the next leader of Velkynvelve , but he and most of his minions had become afflicted by the demon lord – spread madness .

title: Servant of the Shard
description: Servant of the Shard Servant of the Shard is the first book of The Sellswords trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Servants of Mammon
description: Servants of Mammon The Servants of Mammon was Mammon ' s personal army , based in Minauros in the Nine Hells . It was comprised mostly of hamatula s and osyluth s and was commanded by gelugon s . Mammon had a pack of thirteen large hell hound s ( with which he hunted , himself assuming the form of a pit fiend ) and a nightmare .

title: Servants of the Royal Egg
description: Servants of the Royal Egg The Servants of the Royal Egg was a mercenary company based in the Great Swamp of Rethild comprised entirely of lizardfolk . Activites . This company hired - out their soldiers to anyone willing to pay .

title: Sespechian
description: Sespechian Sespechian was a language spoken by the inhabitants of Sespech and the Shining Plains . Speakers . Sespechian was spoken from Nathlekh in the north to Nagarr in the south and from the Snowflake Mountains in the west to Elbulder in the east .

title: Sess ' innek
description: Sess ' innek Sess ' innek is a tanar ' ri lord worshiped by the lizardfolk as a deity of civilization and dominion . His symbol is a green , clawed , reptilian hand . Description .

title: Sessrendale
description: Sessrendale Sessrendale , or " the Dead Dale " , was founded in 880 DR and destroyed by army from Archendale in the Sessrendale War , ( 1232 DR ) who then salted the earth to prevent resettlement . Some of the families , following the destruction of Sessrendale , fled to Battledale and Deepingdale . Others were driven west into Cormyr .

title: Set
description: Set Set ( pronounced " set " ) was the greatest evil power of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Known as Typhon in the lands of Thay and Unther , he was a jealous and loathsome being that did all he can to meddle in the plans of his fellow deities . He was also known as Zehir to the yuan - ti race .

title: Setana
description: Setana Setana was a watchghost barmaid in Skullport . Activities . Around 1370 DR , Setana worked as a barmaid for Gallowshawk , earning some notoriety for the inn .

title: Setara bint Aasim
description: Setara bint Aasim Setara bint Aasim was a money - changer living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Description . Setara was an attractive woman and she would openly flirt with men to gain information .

title: Setara bint Farid
description: Setara bint Farid Setara bint Farid was the human female captain of the ship " Spray " , operating in the Crowded Sea around 1367 DR . Description . Setara was a muscular , brown - haired woman , who wore padded armor .

title: Setara min Jisan
description: Setara min Jisan Setara min Jisan was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . As the Keeper of the Ceremonies , Setara was responsible for all of the services held within the Golden Mosque .

title: Setsu Iki
description: Setsu Iki Setsu Iki was a powerful wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Setsu Iki was a powerful wu jen , last member of the Order of the Mouse , who lived as farmer on a small estate near the village of Kawasa .

title: Settlestone
description: Settlestone Settlestone , also known as Dwarvendarrow and The Ruin was a village outside of Mithral Hall . It was first inhabited by dwarves , fell into ruins , then was resettled in 1358 DR by the barbarians of Icewind Dale under the leadership of Berkthgar in alliance with Mithral Hall . Geography .

title: Sevan
description: Sevan Sevan was a wealthy merchant from Amnwater in Amn . After the sinking of " Valashar ' s Bane " in 389 DR , a pair of fishermen from Teziir recovered the Cormyr ean sword of state " Ilbratha " and sold it to Sevan . Sevan took the sword with him on a trade caravan to Scornubel , via Trader ' s Road and the Chionthar river .

title: Seven
description: Seven The Seven were Halaster Blackcloak ' s seven apprentices . Members . The other apprentices were Arcturia , Jhesiyra Kestellharp , Nester , Marambra Nyghtsteel , and Rantantar .

title: Seven - Pillared Hall
description: Seven - Pillared Hall The Seven - Pillared Hall , originally called Saruun Khel , was an underground city located beneath Thunderspire Mountain , on the eastern border of Cormyr . Description . The Seven - Pillared Hall was once the market square and meeting place of the original minotaur city .

title: Seven Citadels ' War
description: Seven Citadels ' War The Seven Citadels ' War was a set of skirmishes between the elite forces of Siluvanede and the fledgling forces of Eaerlann . They are sometimes collectively referred to as the Sixth Crown War . It began when the High Mage s of Arcorar tracked down House Dlardrageth to Ascal ' s Horn in - 4500 DR .

title: Seven Heavens
description: Seven Heavens The plane of Seven Heavens ( also called the Seven Mountains of Goodness and Law or Mount Celestia ) was the pinnacle of lawful good ness in the Great Wheel cosmology . The Seven Heavens were dedicated to goodness shaped by law and justice tempered with mercy . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Green Fields and the House of the Triad when that cosmology became popular .

title: Seven Lost Gods
description: Seven Lost Gods The Seven Lost Gods is a term used to describe various groups of powerful entities at different times . Some of these entities might have been primordial s , and candidates include Dendar the Night Serpent , Kezef the Chaos Hound , and Borem of the Boiling Mud . The " Adventure Book " that accompanied the " Pool of Radiance " computer game identified the following entities as " those who fell down and became servants of the great lord Bane " : Maram of the Great Spear ; Haask , Voice of Hargut ; Tyranthraxus the Flamed One ; Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud ; and Camnod the Unseen .

title: Seven Sages
description: Seven Sages The Seven Sages were the appointed governors of the eight provinces of the Yikarian Empire in the World Pillar Mountains of northeast Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . These " sons and daughters " of the Faceless God were appointed by their deity .

title: Seven Sails Inn
description: Seven Sails Inn The Seven Sails Inn , also known as Safesails , was the only inn in Luskan as of 1370 DR with a strong Arcane Brotherhood presence . Geography . The inn stood on the south side of Setting Sun Street east of the Needle , the local water tower .

title: Seven Sisters
description: Seven Sisters The Seven Sisters are seven immortal women , all Chosen of Mystra and daughters of the goddess Mystra . They are all spellcasters born to the ranger Dornal Silverhand and his wife Elué , whom Mystra possessed to give birth to the children . After Elué died in 767 DR , Dornal abandoned his daughters and they were cared for by various foster parents .

title: Seven Snakes
description: Seven Snakes The Seven Snakes were a mercenary and bandit group based out of Daggerford who predominantly did " dirty works " for the Zhentarim . Their primary contact was Nelkin Danniker . History .

title: Seven Suns Trading Coster
description: Seven Suns Trading Coster The Seven Suns Trading Coster was a merchant organization operating in Faerûn in the 14th century DR . History . The coster was formed by seven partners of widely separated origins : Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Shield of Everlund , Pomphur of Almraiven , Chond of Calaunt , Alvund of Ormpetarr , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , and Nammna of Milvarune .

title: Seven Swords clan
description: Seven Swords clan The Ito family , more colloquially known as Seven Swords clan , was a noble family in Maeshi Province in Kozakura until 647 DR . History . The ito family started with Ito no Juro that around 24 DR led a wing of army of prince Miki in Maeshi battling the local Korobokuru .

title: Seven Wanderers
description: Seven Wanderers The Seven Wanderers were a special type of undead that roamed the High Desert of Zakhara . Created from hideous water deprivation experiments by the House of Dhi ' b , the wanderers were terrible abominations . Description .

title: Sevenecho
description: Sevenecho Sevenecho was the name of a prominent family in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . The hamlet of Sevenecho was named for the Sevenecho family .

title: Sevenecho ( hamlet )
description: Sevenecho ( hamlet ) Sevenecho , also called Sevone , was a small hamlet in the Vast , situated at the point where the Stormcrest Trail from Tsurlagol met the North Road between Maerstar and Glorming Pass . It lay south of the Brynwood and the Adhe Wood . It was home to The Worried Wyvern , thought to be one of the finest inns in the Vast and all Faerûn .

title: Sevenfold Mazework
description: Sevenfold Mazework The Sevenfold Mazework was the center of all major dao activity within the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth . It served as both a trading center and court for the dao , in addition to housing the palace of the Great Khan of the Dao . Geography .

title: Sevenhaunt
description: Sevenhaunt Sevenhaunt was the Rengarth father of Sunbright Steelshanks . Personality . The shaman was a powerful leader of the Raven Tribe .

title: Seventy - Two Society
description: Seventy - Two Society The Seventy - Two Society was a secret society in Shou Lung . Description . The Seventy - Two Society ( its name chosen only for feng - shui reasons ) was officially a merchant club in Wa K ' an .

title: Severed Hand
description: Severed Hand The Severed Hand , formerly Hand of the Seldarine , is an elven fortress , located in a canyon at the base of The Spine of the World across from the Fields of Slaughter , built in the early 900s as a place from which they could rule the surrounding lands . It was originally known as the Hand of the Seldarine by the elves but the locals always knew it as the Severed Hand due to the five towers arranged like a humanoid hand reaching towards the sky . It was due in large part to the elves presence there that the local orc population was restrained from successfully forming a horde and sweeping into the lands south of the mountain range .

title: Severin
description: Severin Severin was a priest of Kelemvor in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . He was part of the contingent under doom guide Volahk . Severin and some acolytes entered city ' s graveyard and disappeared ; in truth they were ambushed and sieged by many undead guided by a Red Wizard .

title: Severin Silrajin
description: Severin Silrajin Severin Silrajin , usually known simply as Severin , was the Red Dragon Wyrmspeaker and the main leader of the reformed Cult of the Dragon . Personality . Severin was a true visionary , bringing new life and power to the Cult .

title: Sewyrm
description: Sewyrm Sewyrm was the name for a type of lizard that dwelt in large numbers in Waterdeep ' s sewers . Description . Sewyrms were a mottled " lettuce green " color .

title: Seyll Auzkovyn
description: Seyll Auzkovyn Seyll Auzkovyn was a drow high priestess of Eilistraee and advisor to Lord Dessaer of Elventree in Cormanthor . Description . Seyll was young , less than 100 years old in 1372 DR .

title: Sezibul
description: Sezibul Sezibul was an orc shaman around 1485 DR . History . Sezibul was the shaman of the Fanged Moon tribe until 1485 , when a pale orc gathered the Fanged Moon , Gory Maul , and Jagged Scythe tribes under his command .

title: Sezilinta
description: Sezilinta Sezilinta was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . This city was located on the northern coast of the Golden Water about halfway between Adama ' s Tooth and the eastern edge of the Giant ' s Belt Mountains .

title: Sezz ' ia
description: Sezz ' ia Sezz ' ia was an outpost of Menzoberranzan ' s House Shobalar where they conducted arcane researches . History . When around 1379 DR House Shobalar was destructed the tunnel leading to it were sealed .

title: Sfena
description: Sfena Sfena was a powerful tiefling and the founder and leader of the Iron Throne but also the daughter of Glasya . History . Sfena was a unique baatezu born from Glasya and a unknown father , and so the granddaughter of Asmodeus ; Sfena was trained as assassin in Baator , working for her mother who kept a tight rein on her movements and prevented her from advancing in the baatezu hierarchy .

title: Sha ' ir
description: Sha ' ir Sha ' irs were unique Zakhara n wizards who communicated with the spirits of the elements — the genie s . Some Zakharans even believed traces of genie blood were spread across all races populating the Land of Fate and that this genie ancestry manifested itself the most within a sha ' ir . Requirements .

title: Shaalabhak
description: Shaalabhak Shaalabhak was a illithid in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Shaalabhak was a mind flayer that out of nowhere appeared in Vast Swamp offering its service to Despayr in his plot .

title: Shaan
description: Shaan Shaan the Serpent Queen was a nefarious archmage . History . Shaan was a mysterious wizard woman with scales who once ruled a snake cult in Tashalar .

title: Shaani
description: Shaani Shaani was the second empress and the second - to - last ruler of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shaani was described as a spectacularly beautiful woman , but that was her only redeeming quality .

title: Shaar
description: Shaar The Shaar was a stretch of grassy plains and gently rolling hills that measured more than 1 , 500 miles from east to west , and about 250 miles from north to south . By 1479 DR , due to the Spellplague , the Shaar had become a vast desert wasteland known as the Shaar Desolation . In the center of the Shaar Desolation lay an enormous area called the Underchasm where huge swathes of land around the Great Rift collapsed into the Underdark .

title: Shaaran
description: Shaaran Shaarans are a nomadic human ethnic group living in Southern Faerûn , primarily in the Shaar region , although some live in Halruaa , Dambrath , Unther or Mulhorand . Shaaran society is built around extended family units known as clans . Several clans form a tribe which is governed by a chieftain and a council of wise elders .

title: Shaaran language
description: Shaaran language Shaaran , also called Shaartan , was a regional language of Southern Faerûn , and the dominant language of the Shaaran people . Speakers . Besides the Shaar , other places where Shaaran was commonly spoken among human s included : Amn , Calimshan , the Chondalwood , Chult , Dambrath , the Golden Water , Halruaa , the Lake of Steam , Lantan , Lapaliiya , the Nelanther Isles , Sembia , Sespech , Tashalar , Tethyr , Turmish , Unther , and the Vilhon Reach .

title: Shackles of the Past
description: Shackles of the Past " Shackles of the Past " is the 13th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .

title: Shadar - kai
description: Shadar - kai Shadar - kai , also known as shadow fey , were a race of shadow - like humanoid s connected to the Plane of Shadow . Description . Shadar - kai were humanoid and usually slightly taller than average human s .

title: Shaddara
description: Shaddara Shaddara the Fair was the most famous queen of Anauria . Shaddara was a child queen and became a legend , growing up to become a great hunter who often killed monsters in the Hunters ' Hills . Mount Shaddath , later known as Rausrawna , was named after her , as were the Shaddan Hills .

title: Shade
description: Shade Shades were humanoids who had merged with the essence of shadowstuff . They grew more powerful in areas of darkness or shadows , including gaining the ability to leap from shadow to shadow , to create shadowy duplicates of themselves , and even to become entirely invisible . They could also decrease the amount of light in an area and could see through darkness , even of the magical variety .

title: Shade hunter
description: Shade hunter The Shade Hunter is a prestige class of Faerûn . Shade Hunters are opportunistic treasure hunters and adventurers who specialize in the procurement of Netherese artifacts . This is only a portion of the Shade Hunter ' s focus .

title: Shadha
description: Shadha Shadha was a holy slayer living in Hawa in 1367 DR . Activities . Against her will , Shadha served as an assassin of the Dark Wave for the Cult of Istishia .

title: Shadovar
description: Shadovar The Shadovar were the inhabitants of Thultanthar , the Shade enclave . During the course of the people ' s 1700 year exile from Toril , they battled the Malaugrym and other shadowy horrors of the realm , becoming more attuned to the Plane of Shadow with each generation and later Shadowfell for a short time , and were thus known as Shadovar . Etymology .

title: Shadow
description: Shadow Shadows were a type of incorporeal undead that resembled nothing more than their namesake . These wraith - like creatures existed to slay living beings , which they hated and desired to feed upon . When a shadow touched a living creature , it sapped the being ' s strength .

title: Shadow Epoch
description: Shadow Epoch The Shadow Epoch stemmed from the fall of the Blue Age , when Dendar the Night Serpent devoured the sun . With most life on Abeir - Toril dead from the loss of heat and light , there was less for the god s and primordial s to fight over in their constant battle for the system , but the fighting raged on regardless . According to Sarrukh legend , the World Serpent , Ouroboros , led the gods in a stalemate of epic battles against their enemies until Ubtao , in exchange for a portion of the land they fought over , aided the gods in killing or imprisoning his former allies .

title: Shadow Fringe
description: Shadow Fringe The Shadow Fringe , also called simply the Fringe , referred to the intersection of the Prime Material Plane and the Plane of Shadow . Description . In locations located in the Shadow Fringe , tendrils of shadowstuff " ebbed and flowed " like tides .

title: Shadow Ridge
description: Shadow Ridge Shadow Ridge was a rise of ground on the west side of the Ashaba in Shadowdale . Geography . The ridge was north of the Shrine to Mystra and east of Luth Mlennon ' s farm .

title: Shadow Sea
description: Shadow Sea The Shadow Sea was a body of water in Netheril west of the Scimitar Spires . History . Back when this region was known as the Anauroch desert , the Shadow Sea was known as the Shoal of Thirst .

title: Shadow Thieves
description: Shadow Thieves The Shadow Thieves was a thieves ' guild based in Athkatla , a large port city in Amn . They were formerly the most prominent thieves ' guild in Waterdeep , but have since been all but routed from the city by the Lords of Waterdeep . It is alleged they had some arrangement with the Council of Six , as the merchants of Waterdeep are the main trading enemies of Amn .

title: Shadow Weave
description: Shadow Weave The Shadow Weave is a force of magic similar to the Weave . The Shadow Weave originates from Shar rather than from Mystra . Shar studied the Weave long ago , and created a dark distorted version of it , and it is said to lie in between the strands of the Weave .

title: Shadow adept
description: Shadow adept A shadow adept was a prestige class of Faerûn . Shadow adepts were spellcasters who fearlessly reached out to the Shadow Weave and grabbed for power and knowledge that took others years longer to achieve . Each and every shadow adept was solely concerned with becoming more powerful , which meant those of the good alignments , who singularly refused to be under the control of the goddess Shar , were absent from the ranks of these dark individuals .

title: Shadow assassin
description: Shadow assassin The path of the shadow assassin is one embarked upon by rogue s who seek to become the deadliest warriors there are . Shadow assassins strike from darkness , dealing death and slinking back into the shadows before retaliation can commence . The goal of a shadow assassin is to fell their enemy as quickly as possible , leaving little , if any , chance for their own death .

title: Shadow canopy
description: Shadow canopy Shadow canopy was an evocation spell of darkness used by the Shadovar to protect excavation sites . Effects . The spell created a flat dome of shadowstuff 25 feet ( eight meters ) above the ground and with a radius of at least 325 feet ( 99 meters ) , depending on the power of the caster .

title: Shadow conjuration
description: Shadow conjuration Shadow conjuration , also known as shadow monsters , was an illusion spell that created semi - real duplicates of lesser conjuration spells . Effect . The spell drew energy from the Plane of Shadow in order to create a semi - real duplicate of any conjuration spell of lesser power from the subschools of summoning or creation .

title: Shadow creature
description: Shadow creature Shadow creatures were creatures with ties to the Plane of Shadow . This connection gave them some special abilities . Ecology .

title: Shadow demon
description: Shadow demon A shadow demon was the essence of a demon imprisoned in the form of a shadow . Description . Shadow demons resembled wraith s or shadow s but were in fact entirely different creatures .

title: Shadow dragon
description: Shadow dragon Shadow dragons were evil true dragons that were either native to the Shadowfell , or transformed by years spent there . Description . Physically seeming insubstantial , shadow dragons had dark and translucent scales which helped them camouflage into the darkness around them .

title: Shadow evocation
description: Shadow evocation Shadow evocation , formerly known as shadow magic ( but not to be confused with the general field of shadow magic ) , was an illusion spell that drew energy from the Plane of Shadow in order to create a semi - real duplicate of any evocation spell of lesser power . If the victim recognized the illusion , the shadow energy was a lot less effective than the duplicated spell . Components .

title: Shadow magic
description: Shadow magic Shadow magic , also called Talfirian magic , was a type of Weave - based arcane magic that channeled power from the Plane of Shadow . Nature of shadow magic . Shadow magic was but one of many ways of accessing and controlling the natural energies of the Weave , and was strongly tied to it .

title: Shadow mask
description: Shadow mask Shadow mask was a shadow spell used by arcane spellcasters in the Realms . It was one of the spells commonly employed by Harper agent s who could cast spells . Effects .

title: Shadow mastiff
description: Shadow mastiff Shadow mastiffs was a massive shadow dog . Description . Shadow mastiffs were all black , making it very easy for them to blend in with shadows .

title: Shadow of Ao
description: Shadow of Ao The Shadow of Ao was a powerful artifact said to have been lost after the sundering of Abeir - Toril . Abilities . Legend had that the Shadow of Ao had the power to split the world in two .

title: Shadow snake
description: Shadow snake Shadow snakes were large , venomous snakes that lived in the jungles of southern Faerûn . They may have had some connection to the Shadowfell . Yuan - ti were said to keep shadow snakes as pets .

title: Shadow veil
description: Shadow veil Shadow veil , sometimes known as darkness , was an invocation used by some warlock s , particularly inexperienced ones , that allowed them to cloak themselves in magical darkness for a brief moment . This made the warlock more difficult to detect , allowing them to hide or vanish from sight . The spell was relatively easy to use and warlocks required only a short rest between castings in order to regain the power necessary to cast it .

title: Shadow veil ( Universal )
description: Shadow veil ( Universal ) Shadow veil was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Shadow walk
description: Shadow walk Shadow walk was an illusion spell that helped people traveling long distances . Description . The spell enabled one to travel to the border between the Material Plane and the Plane of Shadow , and then physically wander along this zone to the desired destination , taking advantage of an effect that caused one to move much faster here than on the material plane .

title: Shadowbane ( novel )
description: Shadowbane ( novel ) Shadowbane is the second in the Shadowbane series of standalone novels by Erik Scott de Bie that follow the adventures of Kalen Dren . It is also the last in the line of novels ( both D & D and Forgotten Realms ) associated with the worlds - spanning Abyssal Plague event . Summary .

title: Shadowbred
description: Shadowbred Shadowbred is the first book in the The Twilight War trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Erevis Cale , struggling to preserve his humanity from a transformation into a shade , struggles alongside Drasek Riven to find and free their friend , Mags , from Sakkors .

title: Shadowcaster
description: Shadowcaster Shadowcasters are magic users who concentrate on studying shadow magic . This involves a significantly different path of study than learning most arcane magic , and requires a dedicated mind . Its secrets are closely guarded , so book learning is often not possible — shadowcasters are often chosen very selectively and then taught everything they know on the subject .

title: Shadowcloak ( cloak )
description: Shadowcloak ( cloak ) A shadowcloak was a magic al cloak used by the Shadowcloaks thieves guild of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . The guild was named for these cloaks . Description .

title: Shadowcloaks
description: Shadowcloaks The Shadowcloaks were a thieves ' guild located in the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Organization . The Shadowcloaks were a rather large organization , but largely comprised of minor and unremarkable thieves and spies .

title: Shadowdale
description: Shadowdale Shadowdale was a farming community in the Dalelands , in north Faerûn . It was the home of the archmage Elminster Aumar and was the home of two of the Seven Sisters , Storm Silverhand and Syluné . Through its history , Shadowdale battled both Zhentarim and drow invasions .

title: Shadowdale ( novel )
description: Shadowdale ( novel ) Shadowdale , by Scott Ciencin , is the first book of the Avatar series . Summary . In the first part of the book , the adventurers Kelemvor Lyonsbane , Midnight , Cyric , and Adon are presented as they join in a party to rescue a lady , who actually is the goddess Mystra , held captive by the avatar of Bane .

title: Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land
description: Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land Shadowdale : The Scouring of the Land , designed by Richard Baker , Eric L . Boyd and Thomas M . Reid , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 .

title: Shadowdale Trail
description: Shadowdale Trail The Shadowdale Trail was a road in the Dalelands that ran north and south out of Shadowdale . Followed north out of Shadowdale it dwindled away to open country and became little more than a trail when followed south from Shadowdale along the River Ashaba to Mistledale . Shadowdale Trail intersected with the North Ride in the heart of Shadowdale village .

title: Shadowdancer
description: Shadowdancer Shadowdancers were those who used innate ability rather than arcane magic to harness the power of shadow magic . Always existing in the place where light and darkness met , shadowdancers were enigmatic and dangerous . Despite the connotations between darkness and evil , many shadowdancers used their abilities for good .

title: Shadowdark
description: Shadowdark The Shadowdark was an underground domain of the Underdark situated in the Deep Wastes just beneath Shadowdale . Geography . Covering a 120 - mile area of the Upperdark , the Shadowdark was largely centered around the village of Shadowdale .

title: Shadowdark ale
description: Shadowdark ale Shadowdark ale was an ale brewed in Shadowdale with a dark brown cloudy bubbling appearance and a yellow foamy head . Description . It had a light , bitter taste .

title: Shadoweirs
description: Shadoweirs The Shadoweirs ( pronounced SHA - doh - weerz ) were a religious knighthood of the High Forest . Its members , who were ranger s and druid s , were activists of their faith who fought for their beloved forests . They worked for the regrowth of forested areas and strove to halt the assault of civilization on their homeland .

title: Shadowfang
description: Shadowfang Shadowfang was a shadowslain fang dragon involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Shadowfang approached the church of Shar in the hopes of using Shadow Weave magic to avoid the Rage of Dragons .

title: Shadowfell
description: Shadowfell The Shadowfell , sometimes simply called Shadow , was a parallel plane from which necrotic energies and shadow magic stemmed . It existed as sort of a counterpart to the Feywild in the sense that it was a reflection or " echo " of the Prime Material Plane except that it was a bleak , desolate place full of decay and death . History .

title: Shadowfell Keep
description: Shadowfell Keep Shadowfell Keep , originally called Keegan ' s Keep , was one of many fortresses built by Cormyr along its frontier , located in the middle of the Thunder Peaks just northeast of Winterhaven . History . When Cormyr began to create a series of fortresses along its frontier in 236 DR , the shadow dragon Shadraxil took this as an affront to his lands and began attacking the outposts .

title: Shadowgloom
description: Shadowgloom Shadowgloom was an illusion spell that could be employed in two different ways . Description . The two usages were called " gloomcloud " and " quickshadow " .

title: Shadowkind
description: Shadowkind The Shadowkind were an assassins guild based in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the 1360s DR . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Calispar Delgorth , a Talona n priest and member of the Vipers bandits , contacted the Shadowkind and offered them his magic - resistant poison .

title: Shadowkiss
description: Shadowkiss The Shadowkiss was a criminal organization that operated across the Dragon Sea . Their base of operations was the city of Lylorn , in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir . Activities .

title: Shadowmasters of Telflamm
description: Shadowmasters of Telflamm " This page is about the thieves ' guild of Telflamm . For information about the shapeshifters from the Shadowfell sometimes referred to as shadowmasters , see Malaugrym . " The Shadowmasters of Telflamm were a thieves ' guild that operates throughout the east of Faerûn .

title: Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality
description: Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality Shadows : The Palpable Cohesion of Formless Corporeality was the second major work of Telamont Tanthul , under the pseudonym " Shadow " . Description . " Shadows " was a tome describing the Plane of Shadow , based on investigations by Telamont himself and a group of other researchers .

title: Shadows of the Vampire
description: Shadows of the Vampire Shadows of the Vampire is a series of " Dungeons & Dragons " comic books published by as a tie - in to the adventure " Curse of Strahd " . It is a continuation of the series " Legends of Baldur ' s Gate " , and is itself continued in " Frost Giant ' s Fury " . Although the series itself is set on the Demiplane of Dread , technically part of the Ravenloft setting , it features a group of " Forgotten Realms " characters who find themselves transported to said Demiplane .

title: Shadows of the Vampire part 1
description: Shadows of the Vampire part 1 Shadows of the Vampire # 1 is a comic published by set primarily in the Demiplane of Dread . It is written by Jim Zub , and drawn by Nelson Dunbar . Product Description .

title: Shadowslain
description: Shadowslain A shadowslain was a unique type of undead monster created from the use of the " shadow shard " , a Shadow Weave artifact . Creation . A shadowslain was born when a creature was exposed to the necromantic magic of the " shadow shard " .

title: Shadowstone
description: Shadowstone The Shadowstone was a powerful Shadow Weave heavy mace created by the goddess Shar . Description . The mace weighed 8 lb ( 3 .

title: Shadowstorm ( novel )
description: Shadowstorm ( novel ) Shadowstorm is the second book in the The Twilight War trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Summary .

title: Shadowstrike
description: Shadowstrike Shadowstrike was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizards used this spell to attack a target through the target ' s shadow .

title: Shadowstuff
description: Shadowstuff Shadowstuff , or shadow substance , was a shadowy form of matter integral to the Plane of Shadow . It was found in items and phenomena there and in the bodies of creatures of darkness , and it was employed in some forms of illusion magic and shadow magic . It could also be crafted as weaponry , building materials , and other items , but such things were hazy , insubstantial , and all too impermanent .

title: Shadowtop
description: Shadowtop Shadowtop was a type of common tree that grew throughout Faerûn . Description . Shadowtops could grow to be 90 feet tall , growing at a rate of two feet a year .

title: Shadowtop Glade
description: Shadowtop Glade The Shadowtop Glade was a shrine to Eilistraee in the northern part of Velarswood , near Harrowdale . Geography . The shrine consisted of two series of caverns located on both sides of a steep - sided gully .

title: Shadowy Eye
description: Shadowy Eye The Shadowy Eye was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Shadowy Eye was made - up of 900 dark creeper mercenaries .

title: Shadraxil
description: Shadraxil Shadraxil was already a great wyrm when the nation of Cormyr was founded in 26 DR and had sired many other Shadow dragon s , including Shhuusshuru . He laired in the Thunder Peaks where his granddaughter Aurgloroasa presently resides . When Cormyr absorbed the nations of Esparin and Orva at its founding , it built several fortresses in the Thunder Peaks to guard its eastern border .

title: Shadrun of the Snows
description: Shadrun of the Snows Shadrun of the Snows is a monastary at a hot spring near the borders of Erlkazar . The monastary was founded centuries ago by a holy man named Vashtun who built a small shrine . People would come to visit and leave offerings .

title: Shael
description: Shael Shael was an elf who operated a clothing shop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Activities . Shael created cloak s , glove s , hat s , shoe s and tunic s which he charged very little , but usually dealt with wealthy clients .

title: Shaeradim
description: Shaeradim The Shaeradim are the twelve hills surrounding the elven settlement of Evereska . They are almost six thousand feet high and are surrounded for fifteen miles by lesser hills and narrow vales . There is a large valley west of Evereska and inside the hills called the West Cwm .

title: Shaerl Amcathra
description: Shaerl Amcathra Shaerl Amcathra ( born Shaerl Rowanmantle ) was a female rogue and former diplomatic envoy for the nation of Cormyr . She was married to former Lord of Shadowdale , Mourngrym Amcathra . Background .

title: Shafiya
description: Shafiya Chief Shafiya was the leader of the Haifami tribe of Jazayir al - Alfar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Shafiya was a young man of incredible physical prowess and vigor .

title: Shahrokh
description: Shahrokh Shahrokh was an extremely powerful djinn lord and was the vizar to the pasha of Calimport . Abilities . Shahrokh was a powerful mage who was even able to penetrate Acham el Jhotos ' s wards to enter the city of Almraiven .

title: Shajar
description: Shajar Shajar was the savage god of the Nogaro River in Zakhara , depicted with the head of a hippopotamus , and was the consort of Ragarra . Largely forgotten after the fall of the ancient kingdom of Nog and the rise of Enlightenment , his worship was continued by secret cults scattered throughout the Cities of the Ancients area . As the embodiment of the great Nogaro , Shajar represented both its benevolent , life - giving qualities and the destructive character present during the river ' s recurring floods .

title: Shajar ( human )
description: Shajar ( human ) Shajar lived on the island of Kaff in the Djinni ' s Claws in 1367 DR . Description . Shajar possessed a rare combination of beauty that matched her wondrous spirit .

title: Shajji Ghoiji
description: Shajji Ghoiji Shajji Ghoiji was the leader , or " qaghan " , of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the early 14th century DR . Ghoiji ' s brother , Shajji Hoijarek , abandoned his life as a lama to serve under his brother as " apa qaghan " . However , Ghoiji ' s government was corrupt and fell into chaos and finally rebellion " circa " 1337 DR .

title: Shajji Hoijarek
description: Shajji Hoijarek Shajji Hoijarek was a human barbarian of the Tsu - tsu tribe of the Plain of Horses in the 13th and 14th centuries DR . A former lama , he became the " qaghan " or leader of the tribe . History .

title: Shakti Hunzrin
description: Shakti Hunzrin Shakti Hunzrin was a powerful Menzoberranyr traitor - priestess of Lolth and Vhaeraun . She hated Liriel Baenre , pursuing her across Faerun and trying to kill her several times , but she was not successful . Description .

title: Shal
description: Shal Shal was a succubus posing as the duergar consort of Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . History . Shal was a loyal servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt .

title: Shal Desanea
description: Shal Desanea Shal Desanea was a wizard who lived in Phlan , she was happily married to Tarl Desanea . She hailed from Cormyr . Description .

title: Shala Karanok
description: Shala Karanok Shala Karanok was the ruler of Chessenta until Tchazzar ' s return in 1479 DR , when she relinquished the throne and became a minor dignitary in Tchazzar ' s court . In order to divert suspicion from Jhesrhi Coldcreek , Shala took the blame for the sabotage of Tchazzar ' s supplies and he threw her in the dungeon . She was rescued by Chessentan nobles at the start of the Battle of Luthcheq and she returned to kill Tchazzar after he had been weakened by Jhesri ' s magic .

title: Shalaer
description: Shalaer Shalaer was once an able half - elf bard who became a spectral harpist and a caretaker for the Harpers in 1368 DR . Activities . Shalaer took care of the House of the Harp in Elventree .

title: Shalanar
description: Shalanar Shalanar was the central barony of Erlkazar and included the capital of the kingdom . Description . The king ' s lands were the primary agricultural lands .

title: Shalantha ' s delicate disc
description: Shalantha ' s delicate disc Shalantha ' s delicate disc was a conjuration spell that caused a small disk to appear that looked like it was made of rose colored eggshell . A second spell was then cast which the disk absorbed . This spell was released if the disk was ever broken .

title: Shalara Swordshigh
description: Shalara Swordshigh In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , Shalara Swordshigh was the High Herald Old Night , in charge of keeping the heraldry of the Realms in order and maintaining the huge library at Herald ' s Holdfast . Personality . Quiet - spoken , Old Night Shalara said almost nothing in Council of 12 Peers meetings , except to provide lore and information on current situations in the North .

title: Shalarin
description: Shalarin Shalarins were an undersea race of graceful humanoid swimmers . Description . These hairless waterborne humanoids usually have dark blue skin " ( though other hues are not uncommon ) " , large dark eyes , long spindly arms , webbed fingers and toes , and a dorsal fin that travels down from their head to the base of their spine and are as slender as elves .

title: Shaleen Oomreen
description: Shaleen Oomreen Shaleen " Talonkiss " Oomreen was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . She was a priestess of Loviatar . She was the High Priestess , or " Whipmistress " , of the House of Scarlet Hooks temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1370 DR .

title: Shalendra Floshin
description: Shalendra Floshin Shalendra Floshin was a sun elf in Daggerford in 1370 DR and circa 1486 DR . History . Shalendra was the sister of Darfin Floshin and daughter of Elorfindar Floshin .

title: Shaless
description: Shaless Shaless was a woman of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . She was an adventurer . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , she made a triumphant return to The Drunken Dragon , favorite tavern in Tsurlagol , and there displayed a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s .

title: Shalhoond
description: Shalhoond The Shalhoond , also called the Great Wild Wood , was a forest located in the Endless Wastes . Description . Located north of Semphar and Murghom , south of the Khopet - Dag , and east of the Mountains of Copper , the Shalhoond marked the border between the nations of the south and the lands of the nomadic tribes of the north .

title: Shaliana Ghend
description: Shaliana Ghend Shaliana Ghend was a merchant in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Shaliana managed the Scardale Provisioner .

title: Shaliim Wyrmslayer
description: Shaliim Wyrmslayer Shaliim Wyrmslayer was in 1373 DR the Overking of Lapaliiya ruling from Sheirtalar , the Lapaliiyan town holy to Waukeen and the most powerful city of the League . History . Around 1353 DR prince Shaliim went to adventures with a band of Waterdhavian wild blades , even planewaking .

title: Shalis Ptolexis
description: Shalis Ptolexis Shalis Ptolexis was a human woman of Mulhorandi descent who was married to the patriarch of House Darkdance of Westgate , Neveren Darkdance . She was also the mother of the powerful mage Myrin Darkdance . Shalis was a priestess of Sharess and wrote a book called " Wanderings in Love ' s Name " , which was published in 1354 DR .

title: Shallows
description: Shallows Shallows is a settlement on the River Surbrin near to the Spine of the World . Its leader is the wizard Withegroo Seian ' Doo , who has his own tower , a thirty foot ( 9 . 1m ) high stone cylindrical building , from which hangs a pennant depicting a pair of hands surrounded by golden stars , on a red background .

title: Shalok
description: Shalok Shalok was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . Shalok was a Red Wizard assigned to the secret complex of Doomvault located under Thaymount .

title: Shaloon Farain
description: Shaloon Farain Shaloon Farain was a cleric of Mask in Telflamm in 1370 DR and a Proven Sister of the Shadowmasters . Personality . Shaloon was an enthusiastic and sly young woman .

title: Shalush Myrkeer
description: Shalush Myrkeer Shalush Myrkeer was a prominent merchant in Westgate . History . Shalush emigrated from Amn in 1350 DR and wanted to start his merchant house in Westgate .

title: Shalvus Martholio
description: Shalvus Martholio Shalvus Martholio was was a Zhentarim spy inside Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR posing as a shepherd Shalvus infiltrated Goldenfields .

title: Shaman
description: Shaman A shaman , sometimes called a spirit shaman , is a powerful primal leader who calls upon nature spirit s for aid or guidance . Shamans , much like cleric s or warlord s , are often leaders or healers , though they lead most often by example and through wisdom than through inspiration or charisma . Shamans are also more durable than their divine or martial equivalents , gaining through their connection to the wild a powerful capacity for enduring pain .

title: Shambarin
description: Shambarin Shambarin , also known as the Shadowcloak , and formerly Keltie " Silkhips " Silmar , was a mage who lived in Berdusk . Description . She often appeared as a bearded recluse of a man .

title: Shambling mound
description: Shambling mound A shambling mound is a large , animate d plant with predatory tendencies . Description . They appear to be moving , vaguely man - shaped mounds of rotting vegetation .

title: Shambos
description: Shambos " Shambos " was the Realms name for a tropical sea turtle shell . An adult sea turtle carapace would yield thirty - seven plates if cut by a skilled craftsman who knew how to regulate the heat required to separate them without ruining the color . The thirteen inner plates , known as " blades " , were valued for artistic ornamentation .

title: Shamph
description: Shamph Shamph , also known as the Crossroads City , was a city in the nation of Chondath in the Vilhon Reach . Merchants from the south stopped at Shamph to sell their goods to avoid the war zone between the cities of Iijak and Hlath . Government .

title: Shan
description: Shan Shan is a halfling ranger and is the twin sister of Cynda . She is also an accomplished aerialist in the Circus of Wonders . Her voice was damaged in a fight with an undead creature and she lost her ability to speak .

title: Shan Karsha
description: Shan Karsha Shan Karsha was the dominant peak of the Teyla Shan mountain range . Geography . Shan Karsha stood on the eastern rim of the range near the midpoint of its north to south expanse approximately 150 miles ( 240 km ) southwest of Nanhu Oasis .

title: Shan Khantayan
description: Shan Khantayan Shan Khantayan was a chieftain in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . Personality . Shan was not a very able leader but luckily had good counsel from Ayana No - Shui , a fact that all his people knew and accepted .

title: Shan Nala
description: Shan Nala Shan Nala was the highest peak of the Raurin Alta mountains of the Raurin desert . Geography . Shan Nala stood on the far eastern end of the mountain range near Howling Gap and Solon .

title: Shan Nikkoleth
description: Shan Nikkoleth Shan Nikkoleth was a death knight commander of the varied armies of undead , cambion s , and demon s in Hellgate Keep . Activities . For his lord Grintharke , this powerful death knight led and directed many patrols .

title: Shan Pi
description: Shan Pi Shan Pi was a large peak of Katakoro Shan found in Ra - Khati . Geography . Shan Pi was found in the southeast corner of Ra - Khati .

title: Shan Skar
description: Shan Skar Shan Skar was a prominent peak of Katakoro Shan found in Khazari . Geography . The peak sat high in the northwestern corner of the country near Manass .

title: Shan Thar
description: Shan Thar Shan Thar was a male Tethyrian human cleric of Cyric . In 1374 DR , he purported to be a cleric of Mystra at a false temple to Mystra in Wheloon in Cormyr . History .

title: Shan Trango
description: Shan Trango Shan Trango , or the Mountain Guardian , was the highest peak of the various mountain ranges on the eastern rim of the Katakoro Plateau . Geography . Shan Trango was found on the far eastern ridge of an unnamed cluster of mountains southeast of the Hollow Crown Mountains .

title: Shanalar
description: Shanalar Shanalar was an human female inhabitant of Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR who was secretly opposed to the Zhentarim . Personality . Shanalar had a fierce temper .

title: Shanatar
description: Shanatar Shanatar or Deep Shanatar was the underground realm of the shield dwarves . It first came into being around - 10800 DR when Taark Shanat and his dwarves migrated west from Bhaerynden and defeated the inhabitants of the Rift of Dhalnadar in the Cloaker Wars to found Alatorin . After the Spawn Wars , the subterranean part of Shanatar consisting of the eight sub - kingdoms became known as " Deep Shanatar " whilst the part above ground became known as " High Shanatar " .

title: Shandagara
description: Shandagara Shandagara was a human woman and a pirate operating on the Sea of Fallen Stars in central Faerûn . History . In the Year of the Serpent , 1359 DR , Shandagara disappeared , leaving her treasure - laden ship abandoned in the Vilhon Reach .

title: Shandalar
description: Shandalar Shandalar was an eccentric and reportedly powerful mage who lived in a converted Halruaan skyship , east of Ulgoth ' s Beard . Shandalar was a skilled mechanic and he created several devices to harness the lightning from the coastal storms to power his various contraptions . It was also rumored that the old wizard was immune to all harm from lightning as he could be seen , drenched from the rain , dancing and singing among the bolts of terrible storms .

title: Shandie
description: Shandie Shandie was a halfling warrior with great skill at the shortbow and a dream to become a longbow archer . Personality . Shandie favored bluntness and getting quickly to the point .

title: Shandon
description: Shandon Shandon was the Realms name for . Description . This mineral was found in thin crystals that produced tiny faceted gems often used to adorn clothing .

title: Shandra ' s farm
description: Shandra ' s farm Shandra ' s farm was a house in the Mere of Dead Men . Location . Shandra ' s farm was located near Highcliff .

title: Shandra Jerro
description: Shandra Jerro Shandra Jerro was a human farmer and sometime fighter from the village of Highcliff along the Sword Coast North . During the Shadow War she travelled with the Kalach - Cha , helping them locate the haven of her grandfather , Ammon Jerro . Description .

title: Shandra Mystahr
description: Shandra Mystahr Shandra Mystahr was a mage and bloodforge commander in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Mystahr was a wary leader but obsessed with discovering the magical secrets rumored to be hidden within Old Stone Keep . Mystahr marched there at the head of a bloodforge troop .

title: Shandrath
description: Shandrath Shandrath , usually referred to as the Old Shandrath , was the most powerful wizard of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . In his youth , Shandrath killed or tamed many dragons , earning his moniker , " Wyrmhumbler " .

title: Shandril ' s Saga
description: Shandril ' s Saga The Shandril ' s Saga trilogy by Ed Greenwood covers the adventures of Shandril Shessair . The second book was originally part of the loosely - connected Harpers series , but as the story of Shandril Shessair became more fleshed out and the books became more popular they were joined together as a separate series .

title: Shandril Shessair
description: Shandril Shessair Shandril Shessair is the main character in the novel " Spellfire . " Shandril was the daughter of Garthond Shessair , a wizard who had often fought the Cult of the Dragon , and the Incantatrix Dammasae , an adventurer whom Garthond had rescued from the cult . Dammasae had the ability to use spellfire and passed on that power to her daughter .

title: Shangalar the Black
description: Shangalar the Black Shangalar the Black was a male tiefling lich wizard and a member of the Twisted Rune . Description . In life , Shangalar displayed little of his demon ic heritage , with only a pointed ears and bone spurs on his elbows and knees .

title: Shanna Northgate
description: Shanna Northgate Shanna " Blackbard " Northgate was a woman of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . She was a minstrel , former smuggler and fence , and later a boat builder and proprietress of The Blackbard boatyard . Activities .

title: Shant Duerna
description: Shant Duerna Shant Duerna was a duergar in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . At some point in the late 1480s DR , he was in the recently conquered deep gnome city of Zortagra , acting as a gate guardian .

title: Shantel Othreier
description: Shantel Othreier Shantel Othreier was a realm of moon elves during the First Flowering ( founded roughly −23 , 600 DR ) . Geography . Shantel Othreier covered the part of west Faerûn where the areas later known as the Greenfields lay .

title: Shao Mountains
description: Shao Mountains The Shao Mountains were a mountain range located in southern Kara - Tur . Geography . The Shao Mountains were connected to the Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains and the great Yehimal in the west , but separated by the Hanya Maut Wasteland and the Medan Perang Grasslands .

title: Shar
description: Shar Shar ( pronounced " SHAHR " ) , the Mistress of the Night , was the goddess of darkness and the caverns of Faerûn , as well as a neutral evil greater deity . Counterpart to her twin Selûne , she presided over caverns , darkness , dungeons , forgetfulness , loss , night , secrets , and the Underdark . Among her array of twisted powers was the ability to see everything that lay or happened in the dark .

title: Shar - Teel Dosan
description: Shar - Teel Dosan Shar - Teel was an amazonian warrior woman who enjoyed humiliating male adventurers by challenging them to duels and soundly thrashing them . If she was defeated in a duel by a male , she would be impressed and might grudgingly pledge to accompany her combatant . Personality .

title: Shar Cormrael
description: Shar Cormrael Shar Cormrael was a Dark Diviner of Windsong Tower . History . Named for the goddess Shar herself , she discovered information in the library of the tower that gave her insight into Augathra the Seer ' s last journey .

title: Shar Nadal
description: Shar Nadal Shar Nadal was a drow warrior of House Maevret in Menzoberranzan . History . Circa 1328 DR , Shar Nadal was a member of a drow patrol that traveled to the surface in a raid on the surface elves .

title: Sharaedim Vale
description: Sharaedim Vale The Sharaedim Vale was a verdant alpine valley about 18 miles ( 29 km ) long by 4 miles ( 6 . 4 km ) wide . It was encircled by twelve virtually impassible mountains , save for the narrow cleft to the west leading to the Halfway Inn and two well - hidden footpaths leading out to the northeast and southeast .

title: Sharaera Duthtue
description: Sharaera Duthtue Sharaera Duthtue was a moon elf member of the Company of the Cloak . She was enamored with the party ' s leader , as well as her magical teacher , Mhair Gulzrabban . Although Sharaera knew he was holding her back , Mhair reminded the elf of her deceased uncle Phondelarrus as they were both supreme actors and manipulators .

title: Sharandar
description: Sharandar The Sharandar was a ancient elven keep lost within the Neverwinter Wood near the village of Conyberry . Structure . There were rumors the Sharandar was hidden under living trees within the forest .

title: Sharantyr
description: Sharantyr Sharantyr was one of the Knights of Myth Drannor and one of the Rangers Three . History . Sharantyr was born in Baldur ' s Gate to the merchant Zunzyr Thalomm and his wife Nathla .

title: Shard
description: Shard A Shard was a planetar servant of Selûne . Description . Each shard was female , had long blue hair and shining , pearly white skin .

title: Shard ( organization )
description: Shard ( organization ) The Shard were a mercenary company based in Orsraun Mountains . History . In 1356 DR , some adventurers saw the bodies of three red dragon s and of a large number of ogre members of the Shard .

title: Sharess
description: Sharess Sharess ( pronounced " SHAH - ress " ) is the deity of hedonism , festhalls and sensual fulfillment . Sharess is oft depicted as a beautiful , voluptuous woman with the head of a cat ( especially in Mulhorand ) . She has the individualistic and hedonistic personality of a feline and she is constantly grooming herself to ensure her appearance is always up to standards .

title: Shargaas
description: Shargaas Shargaas was the orc deity of darkness , night , stealth , thieves , and the undead . His symbol was a skull on a red crescent moon . Realm .

title: Shargrailar
description: Shargrailar Shargrailar was a great wyrm red dragon whose lair was in the mountains near the headwaters of the Immerflow in the Thunder Peaks . He was the first successful dracolich created by Sammaster in the Year of the Queen ' s Tears , 902 DR . Shargrailar went on to become the most powerful dracolich in the Cult of the Dragon and a loyal ally of Sammaster .

title: Shargul
description: Shargul Shargul ( also known as the Runner of the Rocks ) was a notorious pirate , who had died as of 1370 DR . A legend told that his treasure , a hoard consisting of gem s , was concealed within the walls of the Seven Sails Inn in Luskan , protected from magical scrying , and guarded by animated skeletal hands .

title: Shari - souk
description: Shari - souk Shari - souk was the name of the market quarter of the city of Dhaztanar in Semphar . Description . The market sat outside of Madinat .

title: Sharia Oriest
description: Sharia Oriest Sharia Oriest was a shopkeeper of Rigor ' s Fabrics in Skullport . History . Rumors said that Sharia had once lived in Waterdeep , where she worked as a servant of a noblewoman , but she happened to see a murder and fled to Skullport to avoid the killer .

title: Sharindlar
description: Sharindlar Sharindlar , also known as the Lady of Life and Mercy , was the chaotic good dwarven deity of healing and mercy . Sharindlar represented an aspect of dwarven life rarely seen by others . Her command of fertility expanded her clergy ' s influence over animal husbandry along with developing new varieties of crops .

title: Shark
description: Shark Sharks were the perfect killing machines . These creatures had been swimming in the oceans for millions of years with little change in their appearance or methods . Sharks come in a variety of sizes and appearances , but their general shape is consistent .

title: Sharksbane Wall
description: Sharksbane Wall The Sharksbane Wall was a 135 mile ( 217 km . ) long barrier protecting Serôs . Construction on it began in - 9845 DR to connect the garrison towers among the Sharksteeth Mountains .

title: Sharkskin armor
description: Sharkskin armor Sharkskin armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Sharkskin armor was a type of armor made from the treated skin of shark s .

title: Sharlario Moonflower
description: Sharlario Moonflower Sharlario Moonflower was a flame - haired moon elf who lived more than 25 , 000 years before the Time of Troubles . He was one of the first moon elves who came to Faerûn . History .

title: Sharlarion
description: Sharlarion Sharlarion was one of the ancient elven cities founded long before the Crown Wars and even the First Sundering . History . One of its founders was the master dragonrider Sharlario Moonflower .

title: Sharlarra Vendreth
description: Sharlarra Vendreth Sharlarra Vendreth ( also spelled Vindreth ) was a star elven thief and adventuring companion of Liriel Baenre and Thorn . She was formerly an apprentice of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun at Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep , but left her position for more excitement . Description .

title: Sharlasta Stormsword
description: Sharlasta Stormsword Sharlasta stormsword was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Sharlasta was the captain of the " Ravenous " .

title: Sharlotta Vespers
description: Sharlotta Vespers Sharlotta Vespers was a former lieutenant in House Basadoni . Later , after Jarlaxle and his mercenary band , Bregan D ' aerthe , expanded their operations beyond the Underdark and took over House Basadoni , Sharlotta served as figurehead for the guild . She was killed by Rai - guy Bondalek , a drow wizard / cleric , who was plotting against Jarlaxle to take over Bregan D ' aerthe .

title: Sharn
description: Sharn The sharns were mysterious aberration s of transformed humanoid s . They were best known as those responsible for imprisoning the malevolent phaerimm under the sands of the Anauroch desert . The sharns were also called by these lesser known names : shiftshades , blackclaws , shimmershadows , skulkingdeaths , and fhaorn ’ quessir , which was Elvish for “ changed / altered / transformed people .

title: Sharn Wall
description: Sharn Wall The Sharn Wall , also seen as Sharnwall , was a shimmering , silver - colored magical barrier in the Anauroch created by the sharn to imprison the phaerimm . History .
