In 1371 DR , the Sharn Wall was punctured by an explosion caused when magical bolts fired by Galaeron Nihmedu , a Weave caster , and Melegaunt Tanthul , a Shadow Weave caster , collided .

title: Sharna ( human )
description: Sharna ( human ) Sharna was a paladin of Helm who was uncommonly strong for her size . Description . Sharna was a petite woman with symmetrical facial features , blue eyes , and long , brown hair .

title: Sharna ( merfolk )
description: Sharna ( merfolk ) Sharna was the oldest and preeminent of the Vhaemas the Bastard ' s children . History . Sharna was born in 1340 DR by Vhaemas and Eaja Kamaar .

title: Sharpshooter
description: Sharpshooter Sharpshooters are ranger s , often , due to their focus on ranged weapons , archer ranger s , but not necessarily , who excel in the field of ranged combat . Specifically , sharpshooters focus their training and skills on obtaining an unusually high degree of accuracy in their attacks . Skilled sharpshooters can become legendary , making history as , with one arrow , they slay kings or generals .

title: Sharpstone
description: Sharpstone Sharpstone , also known as , was a variety that occurred in various colors . Description . This stone was usually gritty and its major use was for sharpening .

title: Sharptooth
description: Sharptooth The Sharptooths ( also Sharp - tooths ) were a tribe of lizardfolk dwelling in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr . Base of Operations . The Sharptooths had territory around the northern part and source of the Darkflow River , in the center of the Vast Swamp .

title: Sharrak
description: Sharrak Sharrak was a winged kobold member of the Cult of the Dragon in Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Sharrak had two heads who had different personalities that always disagreed .

title: Shartana
description: Shartana Shartana was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the mid – 14th century DR and a member of the Shadowcloaks thieves guild . Description . Shartana was tall with green eyes and jet black hair .

title: Sharwomen
description: Sharwomen The Sharwomen were a thieves guild based in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast in the 1360s DR . Leadership . The Sharwomen were directly controlled by the Cult of the Shadow , the local temple and worshippers of Shar .

title: Sharwyn
description: Sharwyn Sharwyn is a female human bard originally from the city of Neverwinter . She has a relatively neutral outlook on the world and is fascinated with music and stories . She is available as a henchman in " Neverwinter Nights " and " .

title: Shasphur
description: Shasphur Shasphur was a dragonborn of Abeir , and the founder of Clan Kepeshkmolik . Description . Shasphur had emerald - green scales .

title: Shatil
description: Shatil Shatil was a young priest of Zaltec in Palul and the brother of Erixitl . History . Considering his sister and his father Lotil weak for their compassion , Shatil decided to join the clergy of Zaltec .

title: Shatjan
description: Shatjan Shatjan served as protectors of the frozen northern reaches of the Hordelands . They guarded the herds of reindeer found in the northern climates . Description .

title: Shatter
description: Shatter Shatter ( originally called Aksa ' s shatter ) was a sonic spell from the school of evocation , common among both arcane and divine spellcasting traditions . It was one of the spells infused within a " staff of open doors " . Effects .

title: Shattered Tower
description: Shattered Tower The Shattered Tower was the tower of the Archmage of Maerimydra . It was so named for it broken glass - like design . Location .

title: Shatterhull
description: Shatterhull Shatterhull was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell considerably weakened any structure submerged in water .

title: Shaun Taunador
description: Shaun Taunador Shaun Taunador was one of the primary mind flayer merchants of Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . History . Shaun originated when an illithid tadpole was implanted in the body of a quaggoth shaman ; this rare choice for a host stemmed from a time when there were lack of more suitable hosts .

title: Shaundakul
description: Shaundakul Shaundakul ( pronounced " SHAWN - da - kul " ) , the Rider of the Winds , is the Faerûn ian lesser deity of traveling and travelers , exploration , caravans , the wind as well as mining and miners . Recently , Lord Ao gifted him with the portfolio of portals and portal - walking . He manifests bodily as a bearded man who wears a traveler ' s cape and is armed with a greatsword called the Sword of Shadows .

title: Shaunil Tharm
description: Shaunil Tharm Shaunil Tharm is a mage of skill who lives with her husband Rhauntides in his tower in Highmoon . Description . Shaunil is impish , tall , and lithe .

title: Shawm
description: Shawm A shawm or shaum was a double - reed instrument similar to an . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Shaxan Kazraat
description: Shaxan Kazraat Shaxan Kazraat was a Netherese mummy in Anauroch . History . Shaxan was an ancient inhabitant of Netheril buried in a tomb in Anauroch .

title: Shaymius Sky
description: Shaymius Sky Shaymius Sky was an accomplished adventurer and later swordmaster to the noble Thann family of Waterdeep . Description . Shaymius was mostly blind by 1361 DR .

title: Shaynara Tullastar
description: Shaynara Tullastar Shaynara Tullastar was the Fourth Reader of Candlekeep and a member of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . She was fascinating by the knowledge she gained by the book that Khelben Arunsun permitted her to copy for the library .

title: Shazzellim
description: Shazzellim Shazzellim is a + 1 intelligent scimitar created by the Red Wizards of Thay with the express purpose of slaying Harper s . It has been cared for poorly , evidenced by chips , scratches and the like and it resents that fact . It also resents its own existence as a result it comes off as very mean .

title: She - Wolves
description: She - Wolves She - Wolves were a female mercenary company based in the Vilhon Reach around 1358 DR . Organization . The She - Wolves had two units of infantry , one of cavalry and one of archers , each of 50 members .

title: Shedrak
description: Shedrak Shedrak of the Eyes was an adventurer who became the favored servant of a beholder living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . History . Shedrak was an adventurer who went with an adventuring party to Wormwrithings in the Underdark .

title: Sheela Peryroyl
description: Sheela Peryroyl Sheela Peryroyl ( sometimes misspelled Peryroyal ) is the halfling goddess of nature , song , dance , agriculture , and romantic love . When Yondalla was revealed to be an aspect of Chauntea after the Spellplague , Sheela became the prominent halfling deity . The distant , somewhat aloof Sheela Peryroyl ( prounced shee - lah pair - re - roil ) plays an important role in the culture of ghostwise halfling s , representing balance between the tamed earth of agricultural civilization and the verdant growth of the wild .

title: Sheen
description: Sheen Sheen was a variety of obsidian with many tiny sparkles . If the spangles were gold in color it was known as gold sheen and was classified as a semi - precious stone with a higher base value . Description .

title: Sheenra Duth
description: Sheenra Duth Sheenra Duth was an Harper . Personality . Sheenra loved her life and had always an contagious smile on her face .

title: Sheffol
description: Sheffol Sheffol was the Silhouette of Fences , Smugglers , and Pirates of the Sea ' s Sect of the Shadow Thieves in Murann around 1370 DR . Personality . Sheffol was a happy man who did what he loved .

title: Sheh ' stek
description: Sheh ' stek Sheh ' stek was a lizardfolk from the Vast Swamp in Cormyr in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Sheh ' stek was one of the lizardfolk that came through a " portal " in the Vast Swamp and arrived in in Undermountain .

title: Sheila Kree
description: Sheila Kree Sheila Kree was a pirate and captain of the ship " Bloody Keel " . Her partners included Jule Pepper , Le ' lorinel , Bellany , and many others . She resided in the Golden Cove with her ogre allies .

title: Shelavassa
description: Shelavassa Shelavassa was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in the Moonsea . Personality . Shelavassa was a very pragmatic individual , willing to give up whatever she needed to in order to avoid bigger troubles .

title: Shell
description: Shell Shell in the " Forgotten Realms " is short for seashell but includes fresh water varieties and certain amphibian carapaces as well . Seashells are valued for their ability to be carved into cameos and jewelry . Shells are rarely used for currency because prices vary wildly with scarcity , fashion , and geographic location .

title: Shell Game
description: Shell Game " Shell Game " is the 14th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .

title: Sherincal
description: Sherincal Sherincal was a half - dragon ( blue dragon ) who hated her human side and was a powerful member of the Legion of the Chimera . History . In 1310 DR , Sherincal battled the heroes of Icewind Dale at the ice palace in the western pass where she was killed .

title: Sherlen Miller
description: Sherlen Miller Sherlen Miller was the commander of the militia and the constable in Daggerford around 1485 DR . Activities . Her dual role meant Sherlen had to use two different aspects of her personality : as a militia commander , she trained her fellow warriors ; as constable , she had to mediate disputes and take care of the duke ' s interests .

title: Sherlen Spearslayer
description: Sherlen Spearslayer Sherlen Spearslayer was the leader of Daggerford ' s militia around 1370 DR . History . Sherlen was an adventurer who settled down in Daggerford with her husband .

title: Shestandeliath Geshthax
description: Shestandeliath Geshthax Shestandeliath Geshthax was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Shestandeliath in 1486 DR . He was a direct descendant of Haizverad . Description .

title: Sheva Whitefeather
description: Sheva Whitefeather Sheva Whitefeather was the ranking witch of Mulsantir . She was one of the few " othlors " of that organization . Sheva gave an adventurer the chance to fight for their life against Okku instead of simply allowing them to be sacrificed to save the city , allowing them to recruit followers from the Mulsantir jail .

title: Shevarash
description: Shevarash Shevarash is the elven deity of revenge , loss and hatred of the Drow . He never displays any emotion aside from anger and the occasional exultation after the death of an enemy . The Black Archer is disdainful of moderation in the pursuit of revenge , and will often strike preemptively against his foes .

title: Shevaril Starcloak
description: Shevaril Starcloak Shevaril Starcloak was a female half - elf abjurer from Dagger Falls . She served as an advisor to Randal Morn on wizard ing matters . Abilities .

title: Shex
description: Shex Shex is an angel of decay , an undead monstrosity — an avatar , the very essence of rot . Appearance . Shex is as tall as an ogre and has wings and claws .

title: Shey Chorten
description: Shey Chorten Shey Chorten was the name given to a section of the Katakoro Plateau where a large collection of burial mounds could be found . Geography . Shey Chorten was located due west of the Glacier of the Lost King .

title: Shhuusshuru
description: Shhuusshuru Shhuusshuru , also known as Shadow Wing , was sired sometime before the founding of Cormyr in 26 DR by the shadow dragon Shadraxil . She gave birth to now - leader of the Cult of the Dragon , Aurgloroasa , before expelling her daughter from her realm after two centuries . She preceded the Sibilant Shade ' s ascension to dracolichdom with the help of a nascent cult cell in Berdusk .

title: Shi ' drin Philiom
description: Shi ' drin Philiom Shi ' drin Philiom was a fanatic priest of Ghaunadaur in Llurth Dreir . Activities . Shi ' drin was a member of House Philiom in Llurth Dreir and the second - in - command of Molvayas ' s group .

title: Shi Lin
description: Shi Lin Shi Lin was a wu jen in the town of H ' sin - to in T ' u Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , she became one of the three wu jen bought under the control of Dragon Claw .

title: Shi Lo
description: Shi Lo Shi Lo was a samurai participant at the Komite in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Born as the daughter of a noble of the Imperial Court , she studied calligraphy and poetry .

title: Shialaevar
description: Shialaevar Shialaevar is an elven wizard who lives in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet as of 1368 DR . She is a high mage of the city and frequently visited Queen Amlaruil Moonflower at Moonstone Palace . She lives in a home made from magically grown trees decorated by coloured flags which she changes on a daily basis .

title: Shiallia
description: Shiallia Shiallia ( pronounced " shee - AL - yuh " or " shee - AL - lee - ah " ) is a good exarch of Mielikki . She usually appears as a voluptuously beautiful female korred whose long blond hair is festooned with garlands of oak leaves and golden acorns . She is the patron and protector of pregnant forest creatures , a planter of trees and nurturer of seedlings .

title: Shiau Chen
description: Shiau Chen Shaiu Chen was the proprietor of the Lily Pad Inn in the Xiousing district of Marsember . Chen ran the inn with the help of his Cormyr ean wife Cornelia and his children . He was once a member of the xenophobic society known as The Chuen but was kicked out when he took a non - Shou wife .

title: Shield
description: Shield Shields were a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Shield were usually made from wood or metal and were used by combatants to gain extra protection .

title: Shield ( merchant )
description: Shield ( merchant ) Shield was a merchant from the city of Everlund in Silver Marches in the 14th century DR . Shield partnered with six other merchants — Alvund of Ormpetarr , Chond of Calaunt , Dzunn of Sheirtalar , Jhasso of Baldur ' s Gate , Nammna of Milvarune , and Pomphur of Almraiven — to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster . The " Seven Suns " referred to the seven merchants themselves .

title: Shield ( spell )
description: Shield ( spell ) Shield was a relatively simple abjuration spell used by wizard s or , in the past , sorcerer s . When cast , " shield " manifested a wall of magical force around the caster , deflecting away damage and enhancing their reflexes significantly . " Shield " was not a very complex spell , but it required enough power on the part of its caster that it could not be recast until he or she had taken a short rest of a few minutes or more .

title: Shield Belt of Storms
description: Shield Belt of Storms The Shield Belt of Storms was a magical golden chain mail belt , made from beljurel s , gold , platinum , and steel . It augmented physical armour with magical defences , and added lighting to a weapon wielded by the wearer . Appearance .

title: Shield Trading Company
description: Shield Trading Company The Shield Trading Company was a merchant house , headquartered in Voonlar , that did business throughout the Dalelands and Moonsea regions of north Faerûn . It was owned by Zaravron Rarthree , an elderly and somewhat reclusive cloth dealer , and was in business some years before the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , through at least the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities .

title: Shield adept
description: Shield adept Shield adepts were fighter s trained in the expert use of shield s . Culture . Throughout history , the shield was a staple of armies and soldiers around the world .

title: Shield dwarf
description: Shield dwarf Shield dwarves , also known as mountain dwarves , are among the most common of the dwarven peoples . Once the rulers of mighty kingdoms across Faerûn , the shield dwarves have since fallen by the wayside after centuries of warfare with their goblinoid enemies . Since then , shield dwarves have been less commonly seen throughout Faerûn , though during the Era of Upheaval the subrace , spurred on by the Thunder Blessing , began to retake an important role in local politics .

title: Shield guardian
description: Shield guardian A shield guardian was a powerful construct created to defend arcane spellcasters . Description . Shield guardians could be made with various sizes and strengths , but the simplest and cheapest to make stood about nine feet ( nearly three meters ) tall and weighed over 1 , 200 pounds ( 540 kilograms ) .

title: Shield of Innocence
description: Shield of Innocence Shield of Innocence was an orog who was also a paladin of Torm , which is an unlikely combination . He had faith placed in him by Queen Zaranda Star of Tethyr . On Mirtul 3 , 1367 DR , he saved the lives of Zaranda and Vander Stillhawk , the latter of whom he also resurrected , when he sacrificed his own life to destroy a lower - planar fiend while the group was putting the Days of Terror to an end .

title: Shield of Myth Drannor
description: Shield of Myth Drannor The Shield of Myth Drannor was a company from Myth Drannor appointed to the watchpost at Helmgrove in order to serve as an early threat to the invading demonic horde in the Fall of Myth Drannor . History . The entire company was destroyed by the horde .

title: Shield of faith
description: Shield of faith Shield of faith was a divine abjuration spell that granted greater ability to deflect blows . Effects . Around a touched creature appeared a shimmering , magical field that caused physical attacks to be averted .

title: Shield of law
description: Shield of law Shield of law is an abjuration spell that grants protection against chaotic opponents . It is the lawful counterpart to the chaotic spell " cloak of chaos " . Effects .

title: Shield of senses
description: Shield of senses A shield of senses was a magical shield that protected the bearer from fire and from blindness and deafness . Description . This item was a " + 1 animated fire resistance large steel shield " .

title: Shield of the City
description: Shield of the City The Shield of the City was a medal awarded to members of the city watch for outstanding acts of military service . Occasionally a noble who participated in a battle would receive the award . Description .

title: Shield of the Lady
description: Shield of the Lady The Shield of the Lady was a militant order of woman wizard s , cleric s , and priestesses devoted to Isis around 1370 DR . Their duty was to protect Mulhorand i heroes from evil and barbarism . These spellcasters joined and assisted adventuring companies operating within Mulhorand and the Old Empires and beyond , on missions that furthered the aims of the goddess .

title: Shield of the holy
description: Shield of the holy Shields of the holy were magical shields that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These items looked like medium - sized shields bearing the image of one of the eight enlightened gods of Zakhara .

title: Shield of vigilance
description: Shield of vigilance A shield of vigilance is a large magic steel shield with a symbol of Torm on it . These shields protect their wielders against bashing shock and are highly prized by followers of Torm . It can fetch around 9000 gold pieces .

title: Shield of winds
description: Shield of winds Shield of winds was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an invisible windy barrier by creating strands of chaotic gusts of wind , resulting in a nearly impenetrable wall .

title: Shield other
description: Shield other Shield other is an abjuration spell that summons a protective barrier around another creature . Effect . This spell wards the subject and creates a mystic connection between you and the subject so that some of the subject ' s wounds are transferred to you .

title: Shieldbreakers
description: Shieldbreakers The Shieldbreakers were an ogre mercenary company based in the Lands of Intrigue . Organization . These ogres were known for being unbiased and honorable .

title: Shieldmeet
description: Shieldmeet Shieldmeet was the equivalent of a leap year day in the Calendar of Harptos , occurring once every four years , adding a day after the festival of Midsummer and before Eleasis 1 . Traditionally the day was used for fairs , bazaars , musical and theatrical performances , and tournaments of skill and magical ability . Nobles usually held court to hear the petitions of their people and to make or renew trade pacts , alliances , and agreements .

title: Shields of the Highland
description: Shields of the Highland The Shields of the Highland were a mildly famous adventuring company working in the Upper Highlands in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Organization . The Shields of the Highlands were a group of six friends hailing from near the Forest of Mir .

title: Shifter
description: Shifter Shifters , also sometimes called the weretouched , are a race of humanoid s descended from interbreeding between lycanthropes and human s . Fierce and wild - spirited , shifters are feared by many as much as their shapeshifting brethren . Physical Characteristics .

title: Shig ' harakhi
description: Shig ' harakhi The shig ' harakhi , or the younger brothers , were promising flame mages who studied under Nar - Aidiya at the fortress of Krak al - Mazhar . These individuals were called " shig ' harak " . Activities .

title: Shigatse Glacier
description: Shigatse Glacier The Shigatse Glacier was a monstrous glacier that sat just south of Ra - Khati in the Katakoro Shan mountain range . Geography . The glacier measured 90 miles ( 145 km ) in length and was 30 miles ( 48 km ) at its widest point .

title: Shigeruchan
description: Shigeruchan Shigeruchan was a monk of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Shigeruchan was the spiritual leader of the village of Gugedo in Fochu Peninsula .

title: Shilarn
description: Shilarn Shilarn Silmaeril was a human and one of the original Lords of Waterdeep . Along with Baeron , she overthrew the Lords Magister Ehlemm Zoar and Lhorar Gildeggh to restore the government of Waterdeep . Relatives .

title: Shilku
description: Shilku Shilku was a coastal town in Chult , located in a bay south of the Kobold Mountains . It was less than 50 miles ( 80 km ) from Wyrmheart Mine in the north and about 100 miles ( 160 km ) from the Valley of Lost Honor .

title: Shillelagh
description: Shillelagh The shillelagh ( shuh - ley - lee ) spell enhanced a wooden weapon , such as a club or a staff to do more harm in combat . Effects . The weapon to be enchanted had to be non - magical , made of oak , and not shod with metal .

title: Shilmista
description: Shilmista Shilmista , also known as the Forest of Shadows , was a forest near the Snowflake Mountains . Geography . Lying west of the Snowflakes , the forest has been sometimes considered within the territory of Amn or Tethyr , depending on the state of those countries ' borders .

title: Shimmer script
description: Shimmer script " Shimmer script " was a name given to a cantrip that obscured magical writings . Effects . The shimmer script spell made magical writings impossible to clearly read using a " wizard eyes " spell or other form of scrying , for the purposes of casting , copying , or memorizing .

title: Shimmering sash
description: Shimmering sash Shimmering sashes were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only used by holy slayer s . Description .

title: Shimnus
description: Shimnus Shimnuses were dreadful denizens of the outer planes who found their way to the Hordelands . Description . These creatures resembled ogre - like crones .

title: Shinar
description: Shinar Shinar was an elder of the centaur s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Shinar and her fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .

title: Shindia Darkeyes
description: Shindia Darkeyes Shindia Darkeyes was a female half - drow in the service of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild . In truth , she was the favorite servant of the original Xanathar and when the Eye killed and impersonated the Xanathar she agreed to join the reformed organization , but in secret she plotted to destroy the Eye , with help from the mind flayer s of Ch ' Chitl . Unknown to her , the Eye knew all about her plots .

title: Shing Jaw - long
description: Shing Jaw - long Shing Jaw - long was the only outland member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Shing was a small , handsome man who had long black hair and dark brown eyes that sparkled with intensity .

title: Shingles McRuff
description: Shingles McRuff Shingles McRuff was a short , very stout dwarf . He was the patriarch of Clan McRuff in Mirabar . Appearance .

title: Shining Citadel
description: Shining Citadel The Shining Citadel was a fabled fortress on the Plane of Shadow . A legend told that the plane was once a normal demiplane but when an order who venerated the plane ' s creator built the Shining Citadel , they used the plane ' s light , color , and life to power it , and the Plane of Shadow was stripped of these things as a result . No being on the Material Plane is thought to have found the citadel , if it exists .

title: Shining Falls
description: Shining Falls Shining Falls is a beautiful 120 foot tall waterfall that forms part of the Delimbiyr and once marked the southernmost point of the elf realm of Eaerlann . For many years it was also surrounded by a village that shared its name . History .

title: Shining Hand
description: Shining Hand The Shining Hand was a monastic order based in Amn , dedicated to Azuth . Activities . The monk s of the Shining Hand mixed their monastic practices and their faith in Azuth with the study of magic , such that they could also be wizard s .

title: Shining Lands
description: Shining Lands The Shining Lands , or the Lands of the One , was the collective term used for three of the countries surrounding the Golden Water . These were : Durpar , Estagund , and Var the Golden . The term " Lands of the One " was derived from the fact that all three counties followed the belief in Adama .

title: Shining Plains
description: Shining Plains The Shining Plains was a portion of the Vilhon Reach , named after the visual effect of sunlight hitting the plains . The plains themselves were not held by any cohesive force , instead being composed of human - filled city - states , wemic and centaur tribes , and a powerful druidic organization called the Emerald Enclave .

title: Shining Sea
description: Shining Sea The Shining Sea was one of the great seas of Faerûn . Geography . The sea stretched from the coastline of Chult in the south , to the shoreline of Calimshan in the north .

title: Shining South ( region )
description: Shining South ( region ) The Shining South was a loosely defined " region " of the continent of Faerûn . It incorporated some of the lands from both South Faerûn and Southeast Faerûn . Lands .

title: Shining Steel Mercenary Company
description: Shining Steel Mercenary Company The Shining Steel Mercenary Company was a disbanded mercenary company around 1358 DR . History . The Shining Steel originated as an adventuring party in the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Shining Stream
description: Shining Stream The Shining Stream was a river in eastern Tethyr that was the primary tributary of the River Ith . Geography . The Shining Stream began in the Snowflake Mountains and poured into the River Ith .

title: Shining Temple of Bishamon
description: Shining Temple of Bishamon The Shining Temple of Bishamon was a temple to Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa . Description . Standing atop a high hill , the Shining Temple of Bishamon dominated the town .

title: Shining White
description: Shining White Shining White was a large cavern and tunnel complex located in the Spine of the World mountain range in northern Faerûn . Inhabitants . It was inhabited by frost giants , who were once united and ruled by Jarl Orel , an ancient frost giant who lay on his death bed .

title: Shinthala Deepcrest
description: Shinthala Deepcrest Shinthala Deepcrest was a druid of Silvanus and member of the Elder Circle of the Emerald Enclave during the 14th and 15th centuries . History . Shinthala represented human s among the three members of the Elder Circle .

title: Shinzi
description: Shinzi Shinzi was a half - drow in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . Shinzi was the daughter of a human slave and a drow merchant .

title: Ship Isle
description: Ship Isle Ship Isle , or the Island of Ships or the Isle of Ships , was a small island located in the Golden Water of the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Description . As the name implied , Ship Isle was used primarily for the construction of sailing vessels .

title: Ship Kurth
description: Ship Kurth Ship Kurth was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by High Captain Kurth . Activities .

title: Ship Rethnor
description: Ship Rethnor Ship Rethnor was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by High Captain Rethnor . Relationships .

title: Ship Suljack
description: Ship Suljack Ship Suljack was one of the five factions of Luskan ruled by a High Captain . It was named for and originally led by Suljack . Relationships .

title: Ship of chaos
description: Ship of chaos A ship of chaos was a vessel that could travel the plane s . It sailed between planes on winds of chaos and fed on souls . Description .

title: Ship of fools
description: Ship of fools Ship of fools was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell had similar effects of the " feeblemind " spell , but instead of targeting wizard s , this spell made an entire ship ' s crew lose their knowledge of the sea .

title: Ship of the Gods
description: Ship of the Gods The Ship of the Gods was a volcanic island on the Alamber Sea on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It had no ports . History .

title: Shipshock
description: Shipshock Shipshock was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell protected ships from underwater attacks .

title: Shivanni Gardpeck
description: Shivanni Gardpeck Shivanni Gardpeck was the proprietor of the Cutlass inn in Luskan . She was also an informant for the drow band Bregan D ' aerthe . Relationships .

title: Shiz - ti
description: Shiz - ti Shiz - ti was the greatest wu jen in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Shiz - ti like his father received an appointment as a minor advisor of the Tairo .

title: Shizadai
description: Shizadai Shizadai was a samurai retainer of the Michimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Shizadai was ordered , together with his older brother Shizuoka , to lead a company of bushi to assist an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords .

title: Shizuoka
description: Shizuoka Shizuoka was a samurai retainer of the Michimori clan in Maeshi Province in Kozakura in 1360 DR . History . Shizuoka was ordered , together with his younger brother Shizadai , to lead a company of bushi to assist an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords .

title: Shoalar Quanderil
description: Shoalar Quanderil Shoalar Quanderil was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Shoalar always appeared jovial , but with a biting sense of humor and tending to laugh at people rather than with them .

title: Shock
description: Shock Shock was a magical weapon ability . With a command , a shock weapon became sheathed in crackling electricity . Any creature hit by the weapon took damage from the electricity in addition to the damage the weapon did .

title: Shock sphere
description: Shock sphere Shock sphere is an evocation spell learned early in the training of several wizard s that calls upon the elemental power of storm for its energy . When a wizard casts " shock sphere " she or he creates a sphere of crackling lightning and hurls it straight towards a spot within fifty feet of him or her . When the " sphere " reaches its destination it explodes , much like the simpler " force orb " spell , in a surge of electrical power over an area of five feet in diameter .

title: Shocker lizard
description: Shocker lizard Shocker lizards are not animals but magical beasts . They possess the magical ability to produce electrical effects from their body . Shocker lizards tend to be small and blue in color .

title: Shocking burst
description: Shocking burst Shocking burst was a powerful magical ability that could be added to a weapon . When a weapon with this ability hit a foe in a vital area , it released a blast of electricity that harmed the creature . A shocking burst weapon also had the shock ability .

title: Shocking grasp
description: Shocking grasp Shocking grasp charged the caster ' s hand with electrical energy that damaged a touched foe . A foe with large amounts of metal would suffer a greater effect . " Shocking grasp " was a common spell in the Realms , though not a popular one .

title: Shoehorn of puissant castleblasting
description: Shoehorn of puissant castleblasting The shoehorn of puissant castleblasting was a magical item sold to an adventurer by a Sembia n merchant . Appearance . The shoehorn was approximately three finger - widths wide at the wide end , one finger - width wide at the narrow curved end and 2 feet long ( 60 .

title: Sholapur chaka
description: Sholapur chaka The Sholapur chaka was a prominent chaka within the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Organization . The Sholapurs owned most of Ship Isle off the coast of Var the Golden near Myrmyr .

title: Shondarl Stonegiant
description: Shondarl Stonegiant Shondarl Stonegiant was a merchant who lived in the Vast and worked as a locksmith and a supplier of trained dancers . Stonegiant maintained a country house in the town of Maerstar , and fled there following the chaos and disaster in his home city during the Time of Troubles , 1358 DR , along with a number of other merchants from Procampur and Tsurlagol . However , they were harassed by looting mobs of refugees from Tantras , Calaunt and even Mulmaster , who ' d also come through Maerstar .

title: Shontiq A ' Lavallier
description: Shontiq A ' Lavallier Shontiq A ' Lavallier was a drow wizard of Q ' Xorlarrin in 1484 DR . History . Shontiq studied magic under the tutelage of Ravel Xorlarrin whom he idolized .

title: Shoon I
description: Shoon I Shoon I was the second emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shoon I was a handsome man , but his eyes were guarded and he had a cruelty that was visible in his facial features .

title: Shoon II
description: Shoon II Shoon II was the third emperor of the Shoon Imperium . He was remembered as the Atheist Qysar for his hatred of religion . Activities .

title: Shoon III
description: Shoon III Shoon III was the fourth emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Activities . Shoon III moved the government of Calimshan and the Shoon Imperium back to Shoonach from Calimport , where it would remain until the end of the Imperium .

title: Shoon IV
description: Shoon IV Shoon IV was the first necromancer emperor of the Shoon Imperium and the second - most evil and infamous of all its emperors . He was the only non - elf to ever succeed in designing a " create mythal " spell . Personality .

title: Shoon Imperium
description: Shoon Imperium The Shoon Imperium was the dominant government of much of south and western Faerûn during the sixth age of Calimshan ( 27 – 450 DR ) . It was the most well - documented of all of Calimshan ' s royal dynasties . History .

title: Shoon V
description: Shoon V Shoon V was the first empress of the Shoon Imperium and the first woman to directly rule over either Calimshan or Tethyr . Description . Shoon V was a skilled and capable ruler , despite how the nobles looked down on her for being a woman .

title: Shoon VI
description: Shoon VI Shoon VI was a powerful wizard and an emperor of the Shoon Imperium . Description . Shoon VI was described as " catlike " in his bearing .

title: Shoon VII
description: Shoon VII Qysar Shoon VII was one of the most wicked rulers and one of the most powerful spellcasters to ever have lived in Faerûn . Thought to have died with the Shoon Imperium of Calimshan , in truth , Shoon VII had managed to preserve himself as a lich for a thousand years . Description .

title: Shoonach
description: Shoonach Shoonach was the former capital of the Shoon Imperium , located on the border of Calimshan and Tethyr , and claimed by both . History . Work on Shoonach started as a ploy by King Amahl I to re - garrison the Calishite troops sent to keep an eye on him by his grandfather Akkabar Shoon .

title: Shoonring
description: Shoonring Shoonrings were magical rings from the time of the Shoon Imperium , which were all made to certain standards . Description . A " shoonring " was always constructed from two different metals .

title: Shoonring of swimming
description: Shoonring of swimming The shoonring of swimming was possibly one of the twelve " Qysari Rings " made especially for the rulers of the Shoon Imperium . It kept the wearer afloat in all but extreme conditions and allowed quick movement through water , like any " ring of swimming " , but it was its little - known ability to prevent detection or dispelling of all magical " charm s " present upon the wearer that pointed toward this being one of the legendary " Qysari Rings " of old . Description .

title: Shoor Vandree
description: Shoor Vandree Shoor Vandree was a young drow warrior during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Shoor was young and quite arrogant .

title: Shoosuva
description: Shoosuva Shoosuvas were hyena - shaped demon s that were given to powerful gnoll s as gifts from Yeenoghu after victorious battles . Each shoosuva was bonded with its gnoll master , and warriors who possessed such companions ranked high in gnoll war bands , second only to flind s .

title: Shorg
description: Shorg Shorg was a hobgoblin living near Julkoun around 1485 DR . Possessions . Dressed in chainmail , Shorg fought with a scimitar , morning star , and javelin s .

title: Shornthal Imynster
description: Shornthal Imynster Shornthal Imynster held the title of Magister of Faerûn from 136 DR until 148 DR . Appearance . Historical accounts appeared to confirm that Shornthal had blond hair that he wore down to his ankles .

title: Short Ones
description: Short Ones The Short Ones were a clan of halfling s that lived in the eastern forested mountain foothills of Maztica in the Pasocada Basin . Description . These small humanoid s were extremely resistant to the native poisons of Maztica .

title: Short sword
description: Short sword A short sword , also known as a shortsword , is a light , piercing melee weapon . Description . In essence , this weapon is a smaller version of the longsword but longer than a dagger or dirk , having many of the same parts including a generally double - edged blade , cross - guard , grip , and pommel .

title: Shortbow
description: Shortbow A shortbow is a two - handed martial ranged weapon of the bow family . Description . The shortbow is a flexible shaft of wood ( or horn or bone ) about 3 to 4 feet ( 0 .

title: Shortspear
description: Shortspear A shortspear is a simple , one - handed melee or thrown weapon . Description . A shortspear is exactly what its name implies , a shorter version of the spear .

title: Shoshara
description: Shoshara Shoshara was a priestess of Eilistraee in Shilmista . History . In 1377 DR , she was arguing with Glorst , a former priest of Vhaeraun , about which of their gods had absorbed the other in their duel in 1375 DR , when they were approached by Halisstra Melarn .

title: Shothragot
description: Shothragot Shothragot is an immensely powerful elder evil in the service of Ghaunadaur . Shothragot is the principal instrument in Ghaunadaur ' s plans , and its mission is to slay the worshipers of other god s in order to weaken them . When they are weak enough , Ghaunadaur plans to defeat the other deities and steal their power for himself until he has enough power to challenge Ao .

title: Shou
description: Shou The Shou were human s originally from the Empire of Shou Lung in the eastern lands of Kara - Tur . By 1360 DR , many Shou migrated to Thesk and other lands of Faerûn . Many cities , such as Phsant , Telflamm , Marsember and Westgate , had " Shou Town " districts within their walls , and the Shou nation of Nathlan in the Dragon Coast was founded in the aftermath of the Spellplague .

title: Shou Chiang languages
description: Shou Chiang languages The Shou Chiang languages were a group of languages spoken by the various nations of Kara - Tur , namely Shou Lung , T ' u Lung , Khazari , and Ra - Khati . The Shou Chiang languages group comprised the Kao te Shou , T ' u Lung , Khazari , and Ra - Khati languages . Of them , Kao te Shou and T ' u Lung came from same root tongue .

title: Shou Lung
description: Shou Lung Shou Lung was a country in the continent of Kara - Tur , which was located to the east of Faerûn . People from Shou Lung were referred to as Shou . Description .

title: Shou Lung amethyst
description: Shou Lung amethyst Shou Lung amethyst was a mineral more similar to ruby and sapphire than to the amethyst s found in Faerûn . Kara - Tur was believed to be the source for these gem stones , where their properties were said to protect the nobility . Description .

title: Shou Lung emerald
description: Shou Lung emerald Shou Lung emeralds , known as the bureaucrat ' s stone in Kara - Tur , had a rich color and were highly valued in western Faerûn . A legend surrounding these stones held that there were only three of them in existence , but this was clearly a myth as there were at least a dozen known stockpiles of them in various locations around the West . Description .

title: Shou Lung topaz
description: Shou Lung topaz Shou Lung Topaz was found in Shou Lung and the other mysterious nations to the east of Faerûn . It was imported to western Faerûn by travelers from those lands . Description .

title: Shoudra Stargleam
description: Shoudra Stargleam Shoudra Stargleam was sceptrana of Mirabar in 1370 DR , a title that she claimed after assuming control of Mirabar from its previous Marchion . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities & Civilization - p28 " > < / ref > Activities . Her role got involved in signing trade agreements .

title: Shoun
description: Shoun Shoun was a settlement in the halfling realm of Luiren . Geography . Shoun was located on Luirenstrand on the coast of the Great Sea in eastern Luiren .

title: Shounra Shalassalar
description: Shounra Shalassalar Shounra Shalassalar was the " Night Fingers " , or ruler , of the thieves ' guild known as the Worms in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . All members of the Worms reported to Shounra in one way or another .

title: Shradin Mulophor
description: Shradin Mulophor Shradin Mulophor was a Netherese necromancer who somehow survived the fall of Netheril and a thousand years after when he arrived at Undermountain in 1148 DR . This was during a period of major construction and expansion of the dungeon by Halaster Blackcloak . Shradin had been drawn by the ruins of Sargauth Enclave and , with permission from Halaster , converted it into a trading post which later flourished as Skullport .

title: Shrieker
description: Shrieker A shrieker was a variant of the violet fungus known for the strange and loud noises it emitted to attract prey . Description . Shriekers were human - sized mushrooms .

title: Shrieking Chasm
description: Shrieking Chasm The Shrieking Chasm was a seemingly bottomless chasm located beneath the Howling Mountains in Relmaur , Returned Abeir . Background . The sounds that emerged from the chasm were so terrible that many believed the Shrieking Chasm was the prison of a mad primordial who betrayed its kin to the gods during the Dawn War .

title: Shrieking walls
description: Shrieking walls Shrieking walls was an enchantment that turned a room into a sonic trap . Effects . A room no larger than a 20 ft ( 6 .

title: Shrimp
description: Shrimp Shrimp were an aquatic creature found in many areas of Toril . Species . Deeping shrimp .

title: Shrine of Tempus ( Thunderstone )
description: Shrine of Tempus ( Thunderstone ) The shrine of Tempus in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , dedicated to Tempus , god of battle , was tended by Battle Chaplain Saerlia Ashley . She inspired attending adventurers and Purple Dragons soldiers with sermons of battle , blood , and fire . She offered her healing only to those wounded in battle , and would confirm the truth of a tale before she started .

title: Shrine of the Black Sword
description: Shrine of the Black Sword The Shrine of the Black Sword was a small crystal located south of Thaola ' s Wineshop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . As a symbol of remembrance of all slain elves , the pyramid was set in its own grounds and black marble columns lead up to it .

title: Shrine of the Bold
description: Shrine of the Bold The Shrine of the Bold was located in the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Shrine of the Bold was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .

title: Shrine of the Brave
description: Shrine of the Brave The Shrine of the Brave was a " haram " , or holy site , located on the Pilgrims ' Route in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . This small roofed shrine was dedicated to the memory of a hero from antiquity .

title: Shrine of the Claw
description: Shrine of the Claw The Shrine of the Claw was constructed by a sect of kuo - toa in the Lake of Shadows who revered the fiend ish kraken that laired there . Location . Located in the north - western end of the Lake of Shadows , the Shrine of the Claw stood upon a large rocky island .

title: Shrine of the Jade Monolith
description: Shrine of the Jade Monolith The Shrine of the Jade Monolith was a temple dedicated to the yikarian Faceless God in 1367 DR . Location . The temple was located in the city of Lipo along the coast of the Great Sea in the Sun ' s Eye province of the Yikarian Empire .

title: Shrine of the Scimitar
description: Shrine of the Scimitar The Shrine of the Scimitar was a mosque dedicated to Vataqatal in Liham , in 1367 DR . Location . The mosque was situated so that it overlooked the bazaar .

title: Shrine to Mystra ( Shadowdale )
description: Shrine to Mystra ( Shadowdale ) The Shrine to Mystra was a holy place devoted to the goddess Mystra in Shadowdale . Structure . The shrine was a low step pyramid of three wide steps .

title: Shrine to Tempus ( Shadowdale )
description: Shrine to Tempus ( Shadowdale ) In Shadowdale , the Shrine to Tempus is an altar of black basalt framed by two iron pillars . The front of the altar bears a golden symbol of Tempus . Flowers are often left here in remembrance of fallen warriors .

title: Shrine to Tsikapasmatra
description: Shrine to Tsikapasmatra The Shrine to Tsikapasmatra was a small temple dedicated to an ancient hero of Khazari , Tsikapasmatra . The shrine was located in the city of Manass . Inhabitants .

title: Shrink item
description: Shrink item Shrink item ( originally called Aksa ' s object and later simply item ) was a common transmutation spell used by arcane casters to shrink an object to tiny size . Effects . Upon casting the spell , the caster could touch a non - magical , non - living object and shrink it to as little as times its original volume and mass .

title: Shrymaun Beldaerth
description: Shrymaun Beldaerth Shrymaun Beldaerth was a priest of Ilmater and the leader of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum " circa " 1265 DR . He held the title " Exalted Sufferer " . Around 1265 DR , the House of Holy Suffering had come into possession of the " Tome of Torment " , considered the holiest book of the Church of Ilmater .

title: Shu
description: Shu Shu were a secretive , slender humanoid race of warriors almost identical in appearance to halfling s except that they didn ' t grow hair . Description . Shu were diminutive humanoids who weren ' t noted as growing any more than four feet ( 120 centimeters ) tall .

title: Shu ( deity )
description: Shu ( deity ) Shu was the deity of wind in the group of gods that eventually became the Mulhorandi pantheon . A fair and benevolent deity , he took his responsibilities seriously and ruled in Heliopolis whenever Ra was away . Description .

title: Shudu - Ab
description: Shudu - Ab Shudu - Ab was a cleric of Tiamat in Unther in 1357 DR and 1374 DR . History . Originally Shudu - Ab was the right hand of high priestess Tiglath but broke with her in search of power .

title: Shugenja
description: Shugenja Shugenja ( also spelled shukenja ) were wielders of divine magic who controlled elemental forces . In Shou Lung , shugenja were called dang - ki . Shugenja were the priests of their cultures .

title: Shulgi
description: Shulgi Shulgi was a vampire thief in Unther in 1357 DR . History . Shulgi was a thief in Cormyr until exploring a ruin met a vampire that turned shulgi also in a vampire .

title: Shur
description: Shur Shur was a powerful human mage who actively opposed violence against nature . Description . Shur had a stern and wrinkled face , framed by long locks of gray and white - streaked hair .

title: Shurdriira Helviiryn
description: Shurdriira Helviiryn Shurdriira Helviiryn was the head of the College of Alteration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1379 DR , Shurdriira agreed with the proposal of Master Guldor Zauviir to elevate T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl , Master of Bae ' qeshel Magic , to be a new member of the Conclave .

title: Shuriken
description: Shuriken A shuriken was a small bladed throwing weapon . Description . A piece of sharpened metal , there were many sizes and shapes in use , but there were three main kinds of shuriken : the spike , the small star , and the large star .

title: Shuruppak
description: Shuruppak Lord Shuruppak , or " the Reaper " , was the once - Chosen of Gilgeam and the deity ' s deadly right hand . After Gilgeam was slain , Shuruppak became a wandering murderer , killing many in the name of Unther . Description .

title: Shussel
description: Shussel Shussel is a small city on the Alamber Sea in Unther . In 1370 DR , in an event called " the Vanishing " , a mysterious fog descended upon the city and overnight , ninety percent of the city ' s inhabitants vanished . They have not been heard from since .

title: Shutep
description: Shutep Shutep of Jhalhoran was a resourceful thief in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Shutep thieved from the tombs of the god - kings .

title: Shuushar
description: Shuushar Shuushar the Awakaned was a kuo - toa hermit and mystic who was captured by the drow during the late 1480s DR . Personality . Shuushar was a calm and peaceful presence .

title: Shyarn Feng
description: Shyarn Feng Shyarn Feng was a sohei adventurer in Shou Lung in 1358 . History . Born in Wa K ' an province in Shou Lung , Shyarn Feng grew up at the Blue Stork monastery .

title: Shyntlara Auvryndar
description: Shyntlara Auvryndar Shyntlara Auvryndar was a drow vampire and matron mother of House Auvryndar . History . In 1370 DR , matron mother Shyntlara was a member of the city ' s ruling council .

title: Shyok Muren
description: Shyok Muren The Shyok Muren was a small river found in Khazari . Geography . The Shyok Muren originated within a branch of the Katakoro Shan mountains in southeastern Khazari .

title: Shyr
description: Shyr Shyr was a continent on the planet of Abeir . It was the equivalent in that world to the Toril ian continent of Faerûn . Geography .

title: Shyressa
description: Shyressa Shyressa was a female vampire and a member of the Twisted Rune . She slew the vampire that created her and began to study magic . She gained a Runemaster seat in the 1360s DR .

title: Shyuk Glacier
description: Shyuk Glacier The Shyuk Glacier was a large glacier nestled within the steep peaks of the Katakoro Shan mountain range in southern Ra - Khati . Geography . The glacier measured roughly 60 miles ( 96 km ) in length and 30 miles ( 48 km ) wide at its farthest points .

title: SiNafay Hun ' ett
description: SiNafay Hun ' ett SiNafay Hun ' ett was Matron of House Hun ' ett for many years . Thinking House Do ' Urden posed a threat , she attacked it with the help of Bregan D ' aerthe . With Jarlaxle ' s betrayal , her house was defeated and punished by the ruling council of Menzoberranzan .

title: Siamorphe
description: Siamorphe The current Siamorphe ( pronounced " SIGH - a - morf " or " SEE - a - morf " ) usually appears as an older lady of the nobility , her hair touched with grey but well kept , and her iron - gray eyes missing nothing . Her clothing shows the jeweled purple of the true nobility , with a silver chalice and adamantine scepter in her hands , and a tiara carved from a single diamond on her brow . Siamorphe is the vessel of a semi - divine power , which is passed down to a successor when the successor is dying .

title: Siangham
description: Siangham A siangham is an exotic light melee weapon used mainly by monk s . Description . The siangham looks like a heavy metal arrow with a hilt or handle where the feathers would be .

title: Sibyl
description: Sibyl Sibyl was a half - fiend yuan - ti abomination who was an avatar of Sseth during the Time of Troubles and who wanted to become a god . Sibyl had four arms and a set of wings , which was unusual for common yuan - ti . She was ink black with clawed hands .

title: Sickle
description: Sickle The sickle is a farm implement slightly modified and strengthened to make a simple , light melee weapon . Description . This weapon is like a farmer ' s sickle commonly used to harvest grains .

title: Siege of Darkness
description: Siege of Darkness Siege of Darkness is the third book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Siege of Menzoberranzan
description: Siege of Menzoberranzan The Siege of Menzoberranzan was a siege of the drow city of Menzoberranzan by the combined forces of Horgar Steelshadow of Gracklstugh and Kaanyr Vhok ' s Scoured Legion with the secret backing of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Background . Slave uprising .

title: Sigil
description: Sigil Sigil ( pronounced / ' sɪg . ɪl / ) , also frequently known as the Cage or the City of Doors , is a city - state and the supposed center of the multiverse which includes the Prime Material Plane and all other known plane s according to some forms of the Great Wheel cosmology . People coming to Sigil from the Prime Material Plane are often treated as clueless inferiors by the planar elitists who dwell there .

title: Sigil Fernel
description: Sigil Fernel Sigil Fernel was a necromancer inhabiting the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Personality . To say Sigil Fernel was cruel was putting things mildly .

title: Sign of the Shield
description: Sign of the Shield The Sign of the Shield was an inn in Voonlar that catered to travelers looking for luxurious accommodations . Location . The grand inn was on the south side of Shind Road , facing the Shield Trading Company across the street .

title: Sigurd
description: Sigurd Sigurd was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark . History . Sigurd was a warrior of Earthfast and an ally of the Harpers .

title: Sika al - Bana
description: Sika al - Bana Sika al - Bana was a halfling who worked and cared for Hama Sayif within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Sika played his pipes while Hama performed his splendid dances .

title: Sikak
description: Sikak Sikak was one of the rich Pearl Cities of Zakhara . History . The metropolis gained its wealth from its famous fishing industry generated from the coastal waters next to the city and nearby Maribar Island that teemed with all kinds of different fish .

title: Sil ' zet Tlabbar
description: Sil ' zet Tlabbar Sil ' zet Tlabbar was the favorite daughter of Ghenni Tlabbar , matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Sil ' zet was the oldest and favorite daughter of Ghenni .

title: Silakul
description: Silakul Silakul was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Cormanthor . Activities . Silakul was the leader of the Cult cell that assisted Dretchroyaster .

title: Silari Carver
description: Silari Carver Silari Carver was the mayor of the halfling city of Fasruil in Luiren in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the mayor of Fasruil , Silari was a wealthy farmer and landowner .

title: Silas Broon
description: Silas Broon Silas Broon was a tavern owner of the Flagon and the Dragon in Skullport . Relationship . In his early mercenary days , Silas befriended a pseudodragon called Weeshrike , who went on to save his life numerous times and even now patrolled his master ' s place for potential minions of Dalagor .

title: Silat
description: Silat Silats were shapeshifting hag s that roamed the wilderness of Zakhara . They would venture into the cities of the Land of Fate under magical disguise to search for food . Description .

title: Silaviul Mountains
description: Silaviul Mountains The Silaviul Mountains were a mountain range in southeast Faerûn , and were an arm of the great Yehimal mountains . They separated the kingdom of Ulgarth and the barbarian lands to the east from the Utter East proper in the south . A river ran through the plains along the northern flank , before turning south in the Stony Waste and crossing through the mountains at their western end .

title: Silbran Obarskyr
description: Silbran Obarskyr Silbran Obarskyr was a queen of Cormyr . She took the crown after the death of her husband , Ulbaeram Obarskyr , so that she could protect her son Raerboth from his wicked aunt Gorauna . When her son came of age , the crown passed to him .

title: Sildëyuir
description: Sildëyuir Sildëyuir is a region of the Feywild that is conterminous with the Yuirwood in Faerûn , perhaps two to three hundred miles from end to end . It is the home of the reclusive star , or mithral , elves , who constructed the realm nearly two thousand years ago by breaking it off from the Feywild and turning it into a demiplane of finite size . However , as a consequence of the Spellplague that erupted in 1385 DR , Sildëyuir has been rejoined with the Feywild .

title: Silence
description: Silence Silence is an illusion spell that creates an area where sound is negated . Effect . Upon the casting of this spell , complete silence prevails in the affected area .

title: Silence , 15 ' radius
description: Silence , 15 ' radius Silence , 15 ' Radius was an alteration spell that created a zone of complete silence in a sphere of radius 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) . Effects .

title: Silence of Lolth
description: Silence of Lolth The Silence of Lolth ( also know as the Wrath of Lolth ) was a period between 28 Eleasias 1372 DR and 28 Ches 1373 DR when Lolth stopped granting divine spells , would not respond to communions of any type , and stopped all physical planar travel to the Demonweb Pits in the Abyss . Description . In 1372 DR , the priestesses of Menzoberranzan discovered that the Spider Queen was no longer answering their calls .

title: Silent Rain
description: Silent Rain Silent Rain were an elven mercenary company based in Evereska . Tactics . The Silent Rain were a group of archers that destroyed all enemies with their arrows .

title: Silent Sail
description: Silent Sail The Silent Sail was a merchant guild operating in the Cormyrean city of Marsember . The group took its name from the Marsemban slang word for a ship whose ownership could not be traced . Membership consisted of eleven aging Marsemban merchants who made their fortunes in the shipping trade .

title: Silent Sword
description: Silent Sword The Silent Sword was an inn found in the port district of the city of Procampur in the Vast around 1358 DR . It was frequented by adventurers visiting the city . It was a much quieter place than the Happy Hippocampus .

title: Silent shoes
description: Silent shoes Silent shoes were special footwear used by some rogue s . Uses . Creaking shoes were a thieve ' s nightmare .

title: Silixia
description: Silixia Silixia was a young brass dragon in the Gray Vale sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s , DR Silixia noticed that the nearby stone giant s had become aggressive , so she started helping all the people to flee the vale .

title: Silk Road
description: Silk Road The Silk Road was the primary overland trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Description . Beginning in Dhaztanar in Semphar , and ending in Yenching in Shou Lung , the Silk Road was the major trade route that connected the eastern lands of Kara - Tur to the western lands of Faerun , and was where most of the goods that traveled between the two areas passed .

title: Silk bodysuit
description: Silk bodysuit Silk bodysuits were used by some rogue s to eliminate noise generated from armor and clothing . Uses . Silk bodysuits were typically black and made from a special fabric imported from Maztica .

title: Silke Rosena
description: Silke Rosena Silke Rosena was a talented musician and entertainer living in Beregost . History . Silke was a musician in Beregost but she usually used her talents to manipulate others into doing her will .

title: Silkroot
description: Silkroot Silkroot , also known as Knight ' s Veil or Styxroot , was a stimulant that improved the reflexes and caused temporary euphoria . Geography . The root was found growing wild in Akanûl .

title: Silkstone
description: Silkstone Silkstone was a fibrous variety of similar to tiger eye . Description . This ornamental stone was found in many colors , yellow being the most common , and was cut , tumbled , or used for engravings such as seals for merchants and nobles .

title: Silla
description: Silla Silla was a kingdom in the land of Choson and later a region of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . It was briefly known as the Sillan Empire , covering all Choson , under the king of Silla in the early to mid – 14th century DR . Geography .

title: Silly Satyr
description: Silly Satyr The Silly Satyr was a tavern in the city of Tantras in the Vast . It was located by the western gate out of the city , on the Street of Shadows . Around 1358 DR , the Silly Satyr was notorious as being very wild and had a bad reputation .

title: Silmarien Silverleaf
description: Silmarien Silverleaf Silmarien Silverleaf was a moon elf from the realm of Synnoria in the Moonshae Isles . Description . Silmarien dressed in a blue shirt , green pants , and tall , brown leather boots .

title: Silnia
description: Silnia Silnia was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Silnia and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Silvanus
description: Silvanus Silvanus ( pronounced " sihl - VANN - us " ) , the Forest Father , was the god of nature , though formerly considered only the god of wild nature and druids . Silvanus was one of the oldest and most prominent deities in Faerûn , and the wilder counterpart to Chauntea the Earthmother . His worshipers protected places of nature from the encroachment of civilization with vigor and were implacable foes of industrious peoples .

title: Silvarren Longshank
description: Silvarren Longshank Silvarren Longshank was a priest of Helm in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Silvarren was a priest of Helm in Neverwinter .

title: Silver
description: Silver Silver was a precious metal that was used all across Toril for a vast variety of purposes . Properties . ( most notably lycanthrope s ) were vulnerable to silver .

title: Silver ( half - elf house )
description: Silver ( half - elf house ) The Silver house of half - elves was a noble house descended from the Yuir elves of the Yuirwood . They kept peaceful relations with the human s during the conflicts of the era . Silverhall in Velprintalar was the traditional family home .

title: Silver Ravens
description: Silver Ravens The Silver Ravens are the personal army created and utilized by Miklos Selkirk . Among their goals are to gather information , attain magical items and generally improve the image of Sembia abroad . It is for this reason that when Silver Ravens are working abroad they hide the coat - of - arms typically worn only while in Sembian lands .

title: Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad
description: Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad The Silver Scimitar , as it was originally named , was commissioned by Amahl Shoon IV early in his reign as qysar of the Shoon Imperium . Sometime after his paranoia grew into insanity , it took on his appellation and became known as the Silver Scimitar of Amahl the Mad . It was made in conjunction with " Amahl ' s Mastering " , which allowed the wearer to command the " Silver Scimitar " to attack and defend without being held in the hand .

title: Silver Stag
description: Silver Stag The office of Silver Stag was one of the High Heralds of the Heralds of Faerûn . At its inception , Silver Stag was charged with supporting the practice of heraldry in the lands of Impiltur , Thesk , Damara , and the independent cities of northeast Faerûn . Silver Stag was also tasked with maintaining and administering heraldry in lands east of the Inner Sea .

title: Silver Stake
description: Silver Stake The Silver Stake is a lycanthrope - hunting organization based in a compound on the outskirts of Baldur ' s Gate . They number between twenty and thirty and attempt to capture and cure lycanthropes in the Western Heartlands . The organization is led by Karel Mahorne , an elderly priestess of Mielikki .

title: Silver Stake gas bombs
description: Silver Stake gas bombs A Silver Stake gas bomb is a unique invention used by the Silver Stake to subdue and capture lycanthropes . The creation was invented by the alchemist Dram Kallen of Baldur ' s Gate and the bombs are pressurized with a substance to which lycanthropes are allergic ( this varies with the type of lycanthrope although typically might be catnip or wolfsbane ) . When the bomb is thrown against a hard surface , it explodes and scatters the contents over a radius of around 15 ' ( 4 .

title: Silver Sword of Gith
description: Silver Sword of Gith The Silver Sword of Gith is an artifact sacred to the Githyanki . It was the first and most powerful of the githyanki silver sword s and belonged to the Githyanki hero Gith . When Gith left her people to seek an alliance with Tiamat and never returned , the sword was lost .

title: Silver Tear
description: Silver Tear Silver Tear was one of the weapons of Tymora , the Faerûn ian goddess of good fortune . It was a " + 5 luck blade longsword " . It was not , however , her favored weapon ; that honor went to the coins that she used as " + 5 distance speed shuriken s " .

title: Silver Turban Legion
description: Silver Turban Legion The Silver Turban Legion , or the Feathers , was a military organization operating out of the Citadel of Ice and Steel on the Elemental Plane of Air . Organization . 250 djinni riding griffon s comprised the Silver Turban Legion .

title: Silver dragon
description: Silver dragon Silver dragons ( aka " shield dragons " ) are the second most powerful of the metallic dragon s , and are true friends to all . The silver dragon enjoys the company of human s and elves so much that it will often take the form of a human or elf and live among them for the majority of its life . It should be noted that silvers , like all dragons , believe themselves the most superior creatures in the world .

title: Silver fire
description: Silver fire Silver fire is one of the special abilities the Chosen of Mystra are gifted with . Once per hour , a Chosen of Mystra can unleash from within his or her body a beam of magical whitish flame known as " silver fire " ( which is also used as a general name for the overall power invested in each of her Chosen by the goddess ) . This beam is 5 feet wide and can be made to extend as far as 70 feet if desired .

title: Silver spark
description: Silver spark Silver spark was a poison sometimes used by holy slayer assassin s of the Soft Whisper in Zakhara . Description . This poison was a radiant vapor .

title: Silverbark
description: Silverbark Silverbarks were a type of tree that grew in Faerûn . Descriptions . Silverbark trees were thin and rarely grew above 12 feet tall .

title: Silverhair Knights
description: Silverhair Knights The Silverhair Knights , also called sin eaters , were an order of priests of the goddess Eilistraee , completely dedicated to the redemption and subsequent protection of drow followers of Lolth , Vhaeraun , and other deities of the Dark Seldarine . They fully embraced the teaching of Eilistraee about showing mercy and compassion , and fought dark elves using only nonlethal means , hoping to make them understand the error of their ways and choose a different life . Beliefs .

title: Silverhall
description: Silverhall Silverhall was the traditional home of the Silver family of half - elves in Velprintalar ( now known as Old Velprintalar ) , Aglarond . Description . Silverhall was a low airy building and one of the oldest in the city .

title: Silverspear
description: Silverspear House Silverspear is a relatively small moon elf house . As of 1368 DR , its matriarch is Tyllaetha Silverspear . Many of its members become priest s or wizard s .

title: Silverwood
description: Silverwood The Silverwood was a forest on the eastern borders of the Evermoors and to the west of the Nether Mountains . Description . The Silverwood was once part of the High Forest , but after centuries of logging , the woodcutters took most of the trees on both sides of the Evermoor Way , inflicting a deep wound to the heart of the forest .

title: Silverwraith
description: Silverwraith Silverwraiths were incorporeal undead that could only be created in areas of particularly potent negative energy . Description . Appearing similar to ghost s , silverwraiths manifested as skeletal forms with hints of the clothing they wore in life .

title: Silvery Sembian Snail
description: Silvery Sembian Snail The Silvery Sembian Snail was a tavern and festhall located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Housemaster Roond Asmyrk . History .

title: Silvery She - Snail
description: Silvery She - Snail The " Silvery She - Snail " was the stage - name of a famous nightclub dancer of Sembia . History . Her act was quite successful , thanks in part to a number of flying illusion spells developed by an archmage .

title: Silverymoon
description: Silverymoon Silverymoon was the prime signatory state of the Confederation of the Silver Marches and therefore , viewed by many as the capital . It was ruled for centuries by High Lady Alustriel Silverhand , a powerful wizard and one of the Seven Sisters , some of the most powerful individuals on Faerûn and also Chosen of Mystra , the goddess of magic . In 1369 DR , Alustriel stepped down , paving the way for her trusted adviser Taern " Thunderspell " Hornblade to ascend to the city ' s supreme office .

title: Silverymoon Pass
description: Silverymoon Pass The Silverymoon Pass separated the two sections of the western end of the Nether Mountains . Geography . The road from Silverymoon to Sundabar passed through the Silverymoon Pass .

title: Silverymoon Pass road
description: Silverymoon Pass road The Silverymoon Pass road linked Silverymoon to Sundabar and was 165 miles long . Starting at Silverymoon the road passed by Khelb before entering Silverymoon Pass . The road exited Silverymoon Pass at Auvandell , and continued on to terminate at Sundabar .

title: Silverywing
description: Silverywing Silverywing was a young silver dragon . She lived in the Dawn Age and served the legendary gold elf Prince Durothil . She died at age 20 , in combat with the red dragon Mahatnartorian .

title: Silvo Carver
description: Silvo Carver Silvo Carver was the mayor of Crimel in 1367 DR . Activities . In addition to being the mayor , Silvo was also a wealthy merchant who owned a large number of cattle and sheep .

title: Simbarch of Aglarond
description: Simbarch of Aglarond The simbarchs of Aglarond are a loosely bound order of wizard s who take their inspiration and principal teachings from the Simbul , a powerful sorceress who for a time ruled over Aglarond before her disappearance during the Era of Upheaval . Though the Simbul is now gone her ideological descendants continue to hold a prominent place in Aglarond , effectivelly acting as the ruling class of the nation . Regardless of whether a simbarch is part of this cultured elite or not , all draw on the same spell s and arcane secrets that made the Simbul well - known throughout Faerûn .

title: Simberuel Astalmé
description: Simberuel Astalmé Simberuel Astalmé was one of the last princes of Ascalhorn . History . In 882 DR , Prince Simberuel Astalmé led a group of human refugees from the fallen kingdom of Ascalhorn .

title: Simbul
description: Simbul The Simbul , born Alassra Shentrantra Silverhand , and also known as the Witch - Queen of Aglarond , is one of the Seven Sisters , a Chosen of Mystra , and one of the most powerful spellcasters in Faerûn . Her character is that of a wild and powerful sorceress , highly unpredictable and prone to sudden outbursts of rage . She is queen of Aglarond , a nation in the east of Faerûn , but many of her subjects fear her as much as they respect her for her recklessness and apparent unstable nature .

title: Simov
description: Simov Simov , also known as Simov the Pious , was a cleric of Oghma in the Fallen Lands , and a regional agent of the Moonstars in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Personality . Simov preferred to stay alone in his tower .

title: Simulacrum
description: Simulacrum Simulacrum was an illusion spell . Description . The spell allowed the creation of a moving ice - statue look - alike of a person .

title: Simurgh
description: Simurgh Simurghs , or the “ King of Birds ” , were avian creatures of Zakhara known to protect good - hearted lawful beings . Description . Simurghs had a male or female human face with the body of a giant eagle .

title: Simyaz
description: Simyaz Simyaz was the leader of the githyanki party sent out after the blade of the sacred Silver Sword stolen by Irenicus . The blade was subsequently given to Saemon Havarian , who knew it could only bring trouble and was anxious to be rid of it . Simyaz ' s group went after him in a levitating ship , but it was somehow capsized , possibly by the same sahuagin who may have attacked Havarian ' s ship .

title: Sinaht Irithyl
description: Sinaht Irithyl Sinaht Irithyl was the chosen heir of Sakrattars Irithyl , and the third Coronal of Cormanthyr from - 1950 DR to his death in - 1338 DR . He became coronal upon drawing the Rulers ' Blade after the former coronal ' s death . His rysar was known for a successful campaign against the drow of the Twisted Tower and the former realm of Uvaeren in - 1354 DR , which utilized the combined forces of Cormanthyr and Rystall Wood to rout many of the dark elves from the woods .

title: Singdown
description: Singdown A huuk , or " singdown " , was a competition held by Iulutiun s to settle disagreements . Description . A huuk was a battle of wits ; it was essentially an exchange of sung insults between two parties .

title: Singing sword
description: Singing sword A singing sword was a magic + 1 greatsword made of silver . It sang constantly ( and loudly ) when it was drawn , and gave its wielder a morale bonus , and a larger morale bonus against spells or effects affecting the mind . It was worth around 25 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Singing tree
description: Singing tree Singing trees were bizarre plant - like sanguivores ( blood - feeders ) found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Singing trees looked like regular deciduous trees , but had unique leaves .

title: Singye
description: Singye Singye was a city in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Singye lay at the edge of the great Quang Muku Forest , by the sea .

title: Sinhalite
description: Sinhalite Sinhalite was a rare find in streambed gravel , both active streams and ancient , dried up riverbeds . When polished cabochon or cut , these fancy stones were called sinhalas . Description .

title: Sinklayr Greenstroke
description: Sinklayr Greenstroke Sinklayr Greenstroke was a Grand Druid of the North around the 1340s DR . History . Sinklayr was a servant of Silvanus , the main deity revered in the heart of the Tall Trees region , particularly in the Deep Glade .

title: Sinmon Thul
description: Sinmon Thul Sinmon Thul was one of the leaders of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruiting company in Amn . Description . Sinmon was a big man with brown hair and a bushy mustache .

title: Sinnafain
description: Sinnafain Sinnafain ( also spelled Sinnafein ) was an elf in the Moonwood who married the drow renegade Tos ' un Armgo . She was also the leader of the elves of the Moonwood . Personality .

title: Sinveri Trollkin
description: Sinveri Trollkin Sinveri Trollkin was a quarter - drow half - elf woman who served as the general of the armed forces of Ulgarth around 1367 DR . She hailed originally from the land of Dambrath , but had turned renegade . Sinveri was a capable leader and intelligent .

title: Sirac
description: Sirac Sirac of Suzail was an acolyte of Torm in Bryn Shander sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Sirac was the son of the famous adventurer Artus Cimber , but was given up as a baby .

title: Sirak Mazelor
description: Sirak Mazelor Sirak Mazelor was the main drow representative in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Sirak liked luxurious items made by the drow .

title: Siremun
description: Siremun Siremun was the last Dwarven kingdom to be founded in the Dwarven expansion at the height of their races power during the Age of the Proud Peoples . The Firepeaks were discovered by a band of dwarven adventurers in - 11900 DR who then decided to settle there as many of their kin had done . The last wave of the dwarven expansion followed them after many years .

title: Sirge Wintermelt
description: Sirge Wintermelt Sirge Wintermelt was a scout and member of the Harpers in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 , Sirge followed rumors of the Cult of the Dragon gathering orc s from the Thar .

title: Sirhan al - Din
description: Sirhan al - Din Sirhan al - Din was a janni and member of the Sword Dancers in 1367 DR . Description . Sirhan stood over 6 ft .

title: Sirhan min Hajama
description: Sirhan min Hajama Sirhan min Hajama was the Imam of the Midnight Mosque in Liham in 1367 DR . Personality . Sirhan was a cheerful individual .

title: Siri al - Klemin
