description: Siri al - Klemin Siri al - Klemin was a dao inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Siri ' s real name was Khorasan , though he would never share that information with mortals . Personality .

title: Sirine
description: Sirine Sirines are playful , fun - loving fey creatures who love to sing and dance . Physical description . Sirines look like normal human females although their skin may have a yellow or greenish tinge to it .

title: Sirius Rulak
description: Sirius Rulak Sirius Rulak was a Zhentarim mercenary commander in Daggerdale around 1479 DR . History . Rulak and his squad were paid by the Shadovar to expel a large band of gnoll s from Anauroch .

title: Sirocco
description: Sirocco The Sirocco were a mercenary company based in Anauroch around 1358 DR . Tactics . The Sirocco ' s simple tactics consisted of waving their scimitar s over their heads and shrieking out a ululant war cry and attacking .

title: Sirrus Melandor
description: Sirrus Melandor Sirrus Melandor was the Chief Prelate of Ravens Bluff from 1353 DR - - ? Appearance . Sirrus Melandor stands 5 ' 11 " tall and weighs 155 pounds .

title: Sirvinhandra
description: Sirvinhandra Sirvinhandra was a green dragon ( great wyrm ) who , on 22 Mirtul 1373 DR , emerged from a lair in the Dun Hills to attack the Abbey of the Just Hammer , causing devastation , before being killed by Lord High Justiciar High Avenger Deren Eriach .

title: Sirya Redlock
description: Sirya Redlock Sirya Redlock was a ranger in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . Activities . Sirya ' s mother was a shaman of the Issacort people and her father a ranger from Faerûn .

title: Sisterhood of Essembra
description: Sisterhood of Essembra The Sisterhood of Essembra was a small and isolated female - only organization who lived in the forest of Battledale . Most of its members were half - dragon descendants of the notorious song dragon Essembramaerytha . History .

title: Sisterhood of the Oaks
description: Sisterhood of the Oaks The Sisterhood of the Oaks were a mercenary company based in the Chondalwood around 1358 DR . History . They were a group of ranger s who fought during the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep .

title: Sisters of the Merciful Mother
description: Sisters of the Merciful Mother The Sisters of the Merciful Mother were a religious order devoted to the goddess Hathor . Membership . The members of this order were clergy of Hathor who took vows of pacifism .

title: Sithe
description: Sithe Sithe was a half - genasi , half - demon warrior who worked as an enforcer for the Dead Rats gang in Luskan . Although she was half - demon , she very much disliked being referred to as a demon . Description .

title: Sithierel
description: Sithierel Sithierel was a shadar - kai hexblade who sailed the " Necreme " in 1374 DR . History . Sithirel was a shadar - kai involved in Despayr ' s plot in 1374 DR .

title: Sitting bull
description: Sitting bull The sitting bull was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a bull . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .

title: Sitting dog
description: Sitting dog The sitting dog was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a dog . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .

title: Sitting monkey
description: Sitting monkey The sitting monkey was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a monkey . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .

title: Sittl
description: Sittl Sittl was a malenti spy of Ascarle . Personality . Sittl was a great actor , always with the facade of a happy and generous person .

title: Six Coffers Market Priakos
description: Six Coffers Market Priakos The Six Coffers Market Priakos was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . Originally founded by six merchants , only four of the remaining founders remained alive in 1367 DR .

title: Six Spiked Rings
description: Six Spiked Rings The Six Spiked Rings were an adventuring company from Turmish . History . In the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR , the Six Spiked Rings visited the town of Ylraphon in the Vast and explored the House of Moander temple of the god Moander .

title: Sixfold Symmetry
description: Sixfold Symmetry The Sixfold Symmetry was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Sixfold Symmetry was made - up of 500 crysmal mercenaries .

title: Skagi
description: Skagi Skagi was a Shadar - kai warrior living in the Shadowfell side of Ikemmu . He was Cree ' s brother and was a close friend of Ashok . In 1479 DR Skagi travelled with Cree , Ashok and Vedoran on a quest to rescue the witch Ilvani from a Shadar - kai enclave in the Shadowfell .

title: Skalnaedyr
description: Skalnaedyr Skalnaedyr , named for its dragon founder , was the largest city in Murghôm as of 1479 DR . The city grew rapidly from a village in the 15th century DR and the city ' s architecture was a jumble of buildings and streets . Government .

title: Skalnaedyr ( dragon )
description: Skalnaedyr ( dragon ) Skalnaedyr was an elder blue dragon and the ruler of the city in Murghôm that bore his name . He was one of the Princes of Murghôm , and also considered to be the strongest wyrm who lived in Murghôm as of 1479 DR . History .

title: Skarn Stonegrinder
description: Skarn Stonegrinder Skarn Stonegrinder was a dwarf sage in 1358 DR . His expertise was in geology , mining , and metal smithing . Nobody knew why he lived among the men of Impiltur .

title: Skarou
description: Skarou Skarou was the capital city of the nation of Khazari . Description . Sitting where the Jumpa and Shyok Muren rivers met , the city of Skarou was well fortified due to the divided nature of the nation ' s politics .

title: Skaug
description: Skaug Skaug was a pirate captain and the founder of the Port of Skaug on the Isle of Skaug in the Nelanther Isles . Description . The pirate had a hook - like nose .

title: Skeletal Finger
description: Skeletal Finger The Skeletal Finger thieves guild were a notorious band of ambitious and powerful rogues active from the waning years of the 11th century DR to the mid 12th century . Wherein they caused widespread chaos , political upheaval and the loss of at least one sacred relic . Operating out of a nigh - impregnable hideout in the Small Teeth , the first act definately attributed to the guild was the assassination of Imnel IV in 1094 DR which would spell the end of the Torlath royal family of Amn a year later .

title: Skeleton
description: Skeleton Skeletons are undead animated corpses similar to zombie s , but are completely devoid of flesh and do not feed on the living . They can be made from virtually any solid creature , and as such their size and power varies widely . In addition to the basic humanoid skeleton , there are also skeletons created from wolves , trolls , ettin s and even giants .

title: Skelkor
description: Skelkor Skelkor was the most powerful dragon empire of Returned Abeir as of 1479 DR . Many people considered it to be " the " evil empire of the continent . Inhabitants .

title: Skerrit
description: Skerrit Skerrit is the neutral good god of the centaurs . He is known as the Forest Walker , the hunter and protector of the sylvan lands . He watches over the centaur communities and always aspires to maintain the natural balance .

title: Skie
description: Skie Skie was a young barmaid in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Activities . Skie worked at the Blue Badger Inn , a tavern situated in Toralth , a village in northeastern Tethyr .

title: Skie ( currency )
description: Skie ( currency ) Skie was the most common form of currency in Halruaa . Description . These coins were made from electrum at the Royal Mint in Aluarim in the center of Halruaa .

title: Skie Silvershield
description: Skie Silvershield Skie Silvershield was the innocent and extremely naive daughter of Grand Duke Entar Silvershield . She reputably enjoyed sneaking out of the safety of her father ’ s well - guarded estate and held unrealistic dreams of a life of adventure . She reportedly awaited " rescue " by Eldoth , her lover .

title: Skield
description: Skield Skield was a drow living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . Skield was the consort of the Duchess of the North , Tralia Falrith .

title: Skiff
description: Skiff A skiff was a small open boat . Marsember . Skiffs were used extensively in Marsember , Cormyr for personal transportation .

title: Skill domain
description: Skill domain The domain of skill has three deities and of them there are Corellon and oghma whom are patrons of artistic skill . The creator of elfs suports primarily visual art , arts created with magic , and all the arts of the eladrin , while the binder of what is known inspires skill in the ways of music and invention . Sune s power can aid in any skill that lends itself to more beauty .

title: Skin dancer
description: Skin dancer Skin dancers were creatures that wore the flesh of human beings in an attempt to appear human . Abilities . If a skindancer stole another person ' s skin , their victim became a skin dancer .

title: Skin kite
description: Skin kite A skin kite is an animated slice of skin that is constantly in danger of rotting away . Physical description . No two skin kites look identical , as their bodies are made of the skin type and color of their recent prey .

title: Skip Williams
description: Skip Williams Ralph Williams , almost always referred to as Skip Williams , is an American game designer . He is probably best known today as co - creator of Dungeons & Dragons 3rd Edition and as the longtime author of Dragon Magazine ' s column " Sage Advice , " a position he recently vacated ( now writes the column ) . Williams ' professional involvement in the industry goes back to the first edition AD & D game and even beyond ; Williams is credited in the preface to the 1978 Advanced Dungeons & Dragons Player ' s Handbook among many other works .

title: Skixtalq
description: Skixtalq Skixtalq , also known as Skixtalq the Obscurant , was one of the most powerful elder orb s in Faerûn . Activities . The beholder was the Chosen of Gzemnid , who was said to have send visions to it .

title: Skoraeus
description: Skoraeus Skoraeus Stonebones was a titan worshiped as a god by the stone giant s . His holy symbol was a stalactite . Unlike other titans , he had no realm of his own and wandered the mountain regions of the Elemental Chaos .

title: Skortchclaw
description: Skortchclaw Skortchclaw was a large tribe of orc s located in the Spine of the World . Activities . In 1370 DR , the clan leader , King Ugra Ngarl , was forcing goblin slaves to mine mithral from beneath Fortress Eyegad .

title: Skouloun
description: Skouloun Skouloun was one of the Nimbral Lords . He was a sharp - witted and sharp - tongued figure and one of the leading Elders . History .

title: Skovac
description: Skovac Skovac was a wight in the Dragonspire Mountains in 1489 DR . Personality . Skovac ' s only objective was to protect the temple ' s relic .

title: Skred
description: Skred Skred was a male troglodyte barbarian who roamed the Deep Wastes on raids for his tribe . Description . Skred wore studded leather armor and gauntlets on his raids .

title: Skriaxit
description: Skriaxit Skriaxits ( also known as blackstorms and living sandstorms were malevolent air elemental s . They were retributive spirits summoned from the Elemental Plane of Air millennia ago by ancient gods . Skriaxits could whip up powerful sandstorms that can ripped the flesh from their victims within minutes .

title: Skuerren Skargettian
description: Skuerren Skargettian Skuerren Skargettian was a duergar tavern owner in Skullport . History . Skuerren managed the Thrown Gauntlet , a tavern known for offering violent spectacles of armed and unarmed combat at least once a tenday .

title: Skuld
description: Skuld Skuld was located on the coast of the Alamber Sea . Prior to the Spellplague , Skuld was the capital city of the nation of Mulhorand . The City of Eternity , as it was also known , was claimed to be the oldest inhabited settlement in Faerûn , and , before its destruction , was certainly the largest .

title: Skulk
description: Skulk Skulks were a subrace of human kind , known to be stealthy cave - dwellers . History . Skulks originally descended from a tribe of nomadic human s who had wandered Calimshan after the defeat of the Djen .

title: Skulker ' s venom
description: Skulker ' s venom Skulker ’ s venom was the most basic of all abilities used by a skulker of Vhaeraun . Effect . A skulker of Vhaeraun used " skulker ' s venom " by invoking Vhaeraun ' s name and then striking his intended target with the poisoned weapon .

title: Skulker of Vhaeraun
description: Skulker of Vhaeraun A skulker of Vhaeraun was a catch - all term for followers of Vhaeraun in the post - Spellplague era . History . During the course of the War of the Spider Queen , Vhaeraun died but his church didn ' t collapse , at least not completely .

title: Skull Crag
description: Skull Crag Skull Crag was a human hamlet in the Storm Horns to the northwest of Cormyr . It was a mining community with a population of 270 around 1372 DR . The settlement was overshadowed by a large rock that had been made into a shrine to Kelemvor .

title: Skull Staff
description: Skull Staff The Skull Staff was a landmark and territorial marker on the western fringe of the Vast Swamp in Cormyr . Description . It was a massive broken log , up to 15 feet ( 4 .

title: Skull eyes
description: Skull eyes Skull eyes was a transmutation spell available only to cleric s of Cyric , the Prince of Lies . It was similar to the " eyebite " spell except it " charmed " or " confused " its targets . Effects .

title: Skull of secrets
description: Skull of secrets Skull of secrets was a divine magic available to priests of Cyric , the Black Sun . It created the image of a floating skull that could recite a message and shoot a tongue of flame . Effects .

title: Skull watch
description: Skull watch Skull watch was a necromancy spell that created a watchful guardian that sounded an alarm when a living creature was detected . An older version of this spell had a much shorter duration but was otherwise practically identical in effect . Effects .

title: Skullbreaker
description: Skullbreaker Skullbreaker , also known as Skullcrusher , was a mace belonging to the dwarven cleric Ambergris . Description . Skullbreaker was nearly 4 ft ( 1 .

title: Skullport
description: Skullport Skullport , also known as the Port of Shadows , was a teeming hive of evil lying deep beneath Waterdeep on the third underground level of Undermountain . Geographical features . Sargauth , Portals , and Port .

title: Skulls of Skullport
description: Skulls of Skullport In the chaotic underground of Skullport , a city of thieves , murderers and slave traders , the Skulls imposed some semblance of order when things get out of hand . They are magically powerful floating skulls believed to be the spiritual embodiment of the arcanists who created the Mythallar . The Mythallar or mantle is a sentient and powerful arcane relic capable of generating nearly limitless power .

title: Skullsmashers
description: Skullsmashers The Skullsmashers were a tribe of unusually strong and fierce ogre s , led by Guld , who made their base in Fangjaws Hold in Thar . They enslaved " lesser " neighbors such as goblin s and even human s and dwarves , working them hard , usually to death in just a few months .

title: Skultan
description: Skultan Skultan was a village near Daerlun in Sembia . As of 1368 DR , it was known as a place where goods could be fenced , currency could be exchanged between Cormyr eans and Sembia ns , and things could be repaired . The Tumbling Goblets and The Winking Wemic , two gnome - run festhall s , were staffed by attractive human females , and were sites of underhand dealings .

title: Skulto Mreth
description: Skulto Mreth Skulto Mreth was a wizard and a member of the slavery and crime syndicate known as the Tarntar . His specialty was illusion spells . Description .

title: Skum Lord
description: Skum Lord The Skum Lord was an aboleth prominent in Skullport in 1370 DR . Activities . The Skum Lord was the primary agent of the Kraken Society in Skullport .

title: Skurge
description: Skurge Skurge was an ancient female black dragon who laired in the Marsh of Tun . Personality . She was especially intelligent for her kind , knowing not to despoil the area she lived in , but otherwise shared the traits common to other black dragons , being petty , cruel and aggressive .

title: Skuthosiin
description: Skuthosiin Skuthosiin " the Venomous " was a fiend ish green dragon and one of Tiamat ' s chosen . History . He was invested with a third of Tiamat ' s divine power during the Time of Troubles but was devoured , along with Gestaniius , by the bearer of another third , Tchazzar .

title: Sky Home
description: Sky Home Sky Home was a plane in the Elemental Chaos and was home to the primordial Akadi . The plane was a broad expanse of sky , clouds and storms . In some places the winds coalesced to form structures which the planes inhabitants resided in .

title: Skydrop
description: Skydrop Skydrop was the common name given to material ; fragments of glass of meteoric origin found beneath the shifting dunes of Anauroch and other deserts . Description . Skydrop stones were usually clear to lightly shaded with a glassy luster .

title: Skykillers
description: Skykillers The Skykillers were a disbanded mercenary company based in Chondath around 1358 DR . History . They fought during the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep at the yugoloth ' s side .

title: Slaad
description: Slaad Slaadi were bipedal , frog - like creatures native to Limbo and to the Supreme Throne . Description . Their base form was that of a large bipedal frog , though some of the more powerful slaadi had polymorph self or shapechange abilities and sometimes appeared as humanoid s .

title: Sladis Vadir
description: Sladis Vadir Sladis Vadir was a druid and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Sladis was always fascinated by the Underdark , but the madness spread by the demon lord s broke his sanity .

title: Slan Thurbel
description: Slan Thurbel Slan Thurbel was the leader of the mercenaries and enforcers of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Activities . Slan commanded all the fighter s of the guild , including the punitive squads incaricated to kill those that cross the ways of the guild .

title: Slanya
description: Slanya Slanya was a monk of Kelemvor living at the monastery in the city of Ormpetarr . Appearance . Slanya was tall and lithe .

title: Slarkrethel
description: Slarkrethel Slarkrethel was a huge kraken wizard and Chosen of Umberlee , who also founded the Kraken Society . History . Born in the Year of the Kraken , 151 DR , it wasn ' t until Slarkrethel found the submerged ruins of Ascarle in 244 DR that he began building his undersea empire .

title: Slater
description: Slater Slater was a female human soldier of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Slater was one of the first to befriend Cyric when he decided to join the Scorpions . She helped and followed him loyally .

title: Slaughtertusk
description: Slaughtertusk Slaughtertusk was a nalfeshnee agent of Baphomet in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Slaughtertusk was a bully at heart , pleading for its life against enemies stronger than it .

title: Slavery
description: Slavery Slavery was a practice among certain cultures that forced a sentient creature to serve another , often against their will . Slavery differed from other forms of service such as indentured servitude or apprenticeship in that slavery was of an indefinite duration and the slave rarely had any choice in the arrangement . Slavery in the Realms .

title: Slavin ' krath ' magaal
description: Slavin ' krath ' magaal Slavin ' krath ' magaal , also known as Slavin , was a young brown dragon living in Unther . History . Slavin was a young brown dragon part of a dragon generation with good dealing with Tiamat ; for this she agreed to collaborate with the cleric of Tiamat Malise in exchange for rituals that improve her power .

title: Slay living
description: Slay living Slay living was a necromancy spell that could kill a single creature . The older versions of this spell were also reversible , known as " raise dead " . Effects .

title: Slayer genie
description: Slayer genie Slayer genies were tasked genie s who served to commit murder as often as possible . All tasked genies ran the risk of eventually becoming slayers if they were not able to retain their sanity while repeatedly performing their given tasks . Slayer genies were initially used by powerful genie lords to intimidate their enemies and rivals , but were later used by noble genie s to eliminate targets .

title: Sleep
description: Sleep Sleep was a spell of the enchantment school used by wizard s , bard s and sorcerer s , as well as warlock s with Archfey patron s . Effects . " Sleep " , as the name of the spell implies , placed its targets into a light slumber when cast successfully , overcoming the creatures ' willpower .

title: Sleep - smoke
description: Sleep - smoke Sleep - smoke was a dark - gray , smoky gas that caused those who inhaled it to fall unconscious for up to 4 minutes . When released into the air , it quickly dissipated , and affected an area 20 feet ( 6 m ) in diameter . It was known to be used primarily by members of Xanathar Thieves ' Guild , specifically when they attempted to capture or kidnap a target .

title: Sleeping Cat
description: Sleeping Cat The Sleeping Cat was a tavern and restaurant located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Whelgar Taerncole . History .

title: Sleeping Dragon
description: Sleeping Dragon The Sleeping Dragon was an inn near Rassalantar on the Long Road north of Waterdeep . Structure . The inn was equipped with stables and privies , and both the east and west walls of the main building had chimneys .

title: Sleeping gas
description: Sleeping gas Sleeping gas was a tool used by some rogue s to deal with pesky guards . Uses . Sleeping gas was stored in easily breakable flasks that would put most guards to sleep as soon as they smelled it .

title: Sleeping poison
description: Sleeping poison Sleeping poison was an extremely potent poison that put the victim to sleep . The drow were renowned for their sleeping poison , also known as drow knockout poison or simply drow poison . It was hard to find outside of drow areas .

title: Sleeping potion
description: Sleeping potion Sleeping potions were magical potion s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .

title: Sleet storm
description: Sleet storm Sleet storm is a conjuration spell that summons a rain of partially frozen water to hamper vision and movement . Effects . Driving sleet blocks all sight ( even darkvision ) within it and causes the ground in the area to be icy , slowing movement to one - half normal .

title: Slim
description: Slim Slim was a wererat of Ship Rethnor in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . History . Slim was a wererat fighter member of Ship Rethnor in Luskan .

title: Slime Clan
description: Slime Clan The Slime Clan were a tribe of derro living in the Underdark near Delzimmer in southern Faerûn . The tribe lived in a huge cave and had crude stone huts as dwellings . The only building of substance was a large stone building in which their leader lived and in which the derro performed bizarre experiments .

title: Slime domain
description: Slime domain The Slime domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters spell s related to slime . They also gained the ability to rebuke and command ooze s much as an evil cleric could rebuke and command undead . Slime domain spells .

title: Sling
description: Sling A sling is a missile weapon consisting of a cord with a pouch to hold a stone ( called a bullet ) . The cord may be made of leather or cloth . The user swings the sling in a circle and then releases the stone which flies at a high speed at his opponent .

title: Slink Monteskor
description: Slink Monteskor Slink Monteskor was the main spymaster of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild of Skullport . Slink was a potbellied fellow with an eidetic memory , allowing him to remember all that he read . The Xanathar used him as bookkeeper and information storehouse .

title: Sloopdilmonpolop
description: Sloopdilmonpolop Sloopdilmonpolop was a minor Underdark city of the kuo - toa . The city was home to the Sacred Pool of the Sea Mother , a square , subterranean lake occupying a cavern nearly 1 , 000 feet long and wide . It was dedicated to the worship of Blibdoolpoolp .

title: Sloth strike
description: Sloth strike Sloth strike is a transmutation spell used by several swordmage s of relatively low experience and power . When " sloth strike " is cast it infuses the flesh of a creature struck by a swordmage ' s weapon in melee with icy power , partially freezing their muscles and blood . In addition to causing the target great pain , this slows their movements for a brief moment .

title: Slow
description: Slow Slow ( originally Quantoul ' s slowmorph ) was a transmutation spell used by arcane spellcasters that caused one or more targets to move more slowly . Some creatures , such as stone golem s and mindwitness es , had innate magical abilities that mimicked this spell . Ocular adept s , humanoid servants of the Great Mother , the beholder goddess , also had the power of " slow " .

title: Slow Spout
description: Slow Spout Slow Spout was a Duergan ale that was thick and bitter . It was so named because it tended to swirl around in one ' s insides until it was " spouted " back up . Availability .

title: Slow boon
description: Slow boon Slow boon was a divine necromancy spell that slowly healed injuries that the subject had suffered . Effect . The " slow boon " spell simply applied a slow rate of healing to the subject until the spell expired .

title: Slow rot
description: Slow rot Slow rot was an abjuration spell that prevented spoilage of fruits , vegetables , and grains for a few weeks . Effects . Up to 100 ft ( 2 .

title: Slow sand
description: Slow sand Slow sand was a powerful magical sand from Zakhara that literally had the power to stop time . Powers . When thrown , this sand could affect up to three man - sized creatures so long as they stood within 10 feet ( 3 m ) of each other , freezing each of them for up to 5 minutes similar to a " hold person " spell .

title: Slowtooth Weaponry
description: Slowtooth Weaponry Slowtooth Weaponry was a weapon shop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Nym " Slowtooth " Nindar . Location .

title: Slub
description: Slub Slub was a hill giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Slub was one of the minions of Chief Guh in Grudd Haug .

title: Sluuguth
description: Sluuguth Sluuguth was a roaming illithid who in 1372 DR tried to take advantage of the Siege of Menzoberranzan by duergar s and tanarukk . He discovered in Lake Donigarten the Archmage of Menzoberranzan , Gromph Baenre , imprisoned in a magical sphere after his defeat in a battle with Lichdrow Lord Dyrr . Sluuguth was convinced by Gromph to free him from the sphere using his psionic powers in exchange for great recompense .

title: Small Teeth
description: Small Teeth The Small Teeth were a small mountain range that made up the border between Amn to the north and Muranndin to the south . Geography . The Small Teeth were a relatively small cluster of mountains .

title: Smallfry
description: Smallfry Smallfry was a tavern owner in Skullport . Personality . Smallfry was an irritable , short - tempered , and pushy individual .

title: Smelting
description: Smelting Smelting was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Smile
description: Smile Smile was a female halfling rogue in Wheloon in 1374 DR . Description . She wore a black hood .

title: Smiling Satyr
description: Smiling Satyr The Smiling Satyr was a rather good quality tavern just outside of the city of Loudwater . Geography . It was located eight farms southwest of Loudwater on the top of a hill with oaks and beeches .

title: Smiling Siren
description: Smiling Siren The Smiling Siren was a bawdy tavern / nightclub and theater in Waterdeep that later became a festhall run by the church of Sune . Description . Tavern / theater .

title: Smoke ( ninja )
description: Smoke ( ninja ) Smoke was one of the three ninja in the service of Daisake Mayazato in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Smoke trained in the ninja arts in the Warazama clan together with Moonlight and Snake , until that clan was destroyed by internal dissent .

title: Smoke Wyrm
description: Smoke Wyrm The Smoke Wyrm was a tavern in Ravens Bluff run by the dwarf Tharzon Brewhammer and his son . The tavern was best known for its excellent stout known as Old Smokey , which was shipped all over the Vast . Structure .

title: Smoke bridge
description: Smoke bridge Smoke bridge was a clerical spell from the elemental fire sphere . Effects . With this spell a priest or cleric shaped smoke into a desired form up to a maximum length of 300 yards ( 275 m ) .

title: Smoke drake
description: Smoke drake A Smoke drake ( also known as a fumarandi ) is a careful , sly predator that hunts its prey for miles before attacking with surprise . Physical description . A smoke drake ' s polished , overlapping scales are charcoal gray mixed with the occasional highlight of dark red and a dorsal ridge of ebony .

title: Smokepowder
description: Smokepowder Smokepowder was the " Realms " magical alchemical equivalent of black powder . History . The difference was in the composition of the powder .

title: Smokespire
description: Smokespire The Smokespire was an extinct volcano in the Troll Mountains of Amn famed for being the home of the great dragon Balagos . It was the westernmost mountain in the range . History .

title: Smoking Hammer Shrine
description: Smoking Hammer Shrine The Smoking Hammer Shrine was a temple located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . Description . Though scant information was available on the Smoking Hammer Shrine , it was said to be quite ugly and strange .

title: Smoking Mountains
description: Smoking Mountains The Smoking Mountains were a range of mountains with active volcanoes at its western end . They were located in the Old Empires area of Faerûn , between the nations of Unther and Tymanther . < ref name = " TDYK / Hardcover - p185 " > < / ref > The equivalent region of the Smoking Mountains in the world of Abeir were the Dead Stone Mountains .

title: Smoky quartz
description: Smoky quartz Smoky Quartz , also known as cairngorm or moorland topaz , was a variety of that was often found in massive deposits . The black variety of this stone was called morion and was used in necromancy . Description .

title: Smylla Nathos
description: Smylla Nathos Smylla Nathos was a human sorceress , psionicist , and broker of knowledge in the Braeryn in Menzoberranzan . History . Smylla came to Menzoberranzan from the surface and dwelt for a time with House Faen Tlabbar , until they grew tired of her novelty .

title: Snail - and - eel soup
description: Snail - and - eel soup Snail - and - eel soup was a dish made by the lizardfolk of the Vast Swamp of Cormyr , made from snails and eel s . In the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR , the Sharptooth tribe brewed snail - and - eel soup in a hot spring at their encampment in the swamp . The chieftain Kessessek offered this concoction to adventurers investigating Shar ran activities there as they parlayed .

title: Snake
description: Snake Snakes were natural reptiles that had no legs . They slithered along the ground or in trees in search of food , which consisted of small mammals , insects , and birds . In many parts of the world , snakes were seen as helpful creatures , due to their feeding on unwanted vermin .

title: Snake ( ninja )
description: Snake ( ninja ) Snake was one of the three ninja in the service of Daisake Mayazato in the town of Aru in Wa . History . Snake trained in ninja arts inside the Warazama clan together with Moonlight and Smoke , until that clan was destroyed by internal dissent .

title: Snake - dog
description: Snake - dog A snake - dog was a cross - breed of a venomous snake and a dog domesticated by the yuan - ti that lived in the jungles of Chult . Description . Snake - dogs were around 2 ft ( 0 .

title: Snake Road
description: Snake Road The Snake Road was a road in the Dragon Coast . The snake road ran from Elversult south across the Horse Prairie to the town of Wyrm ' s Hamlet on the Lake of the Snake . Blacknight Manor and the Ginger Palace were both on the Snake Road .

title: Snakewood
description: Snakewood The Snakewood was a relatively small forest located in eastern Amn . Etymology . It was given the name " Snakewood " because of the great number of black and green snakes that lived there .

title: Snapjaw
description: Snapjaw Snapjaw was a lizardfolk of the Scaly Death tribe in the Mere of Dead Men during the Tyranny of the Dragons . Snapjaw was a proud lizardfolk warrior . However , like the other members of his tribe , he was recruited to work as a labourer and hunter for the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Snare
description: Snare Snare was a transmutation or enchantment spell that created a magical booby trap . Effects . A loop at the end of some strong , supple material ( rope , cord , a vine , a leather thong , etc .

title: Snilloc
description: Snilloc Snilloc was an adventuring wizard who lived some time in the 13th century by Dalereckoning . Biography . Snilloc traveled with a party of adventurers , allegedly fighting beholder s , dinosaur s , pirates , spirits , and vampire s .

title: Snilloc ' s major missile
description: Snilloc ' s major missile Snilloc ' s major missile was an arcane evocation spell that improved upon the " magic missile " spell by increasing the possible damage for high - level casters . Effects . This spell produced a single missile and could only be aimed at one target within 60 yd ( 55 m ) plus 10 yd ( 9 .

title: Snilloc ' s snowball
description: Snilloc ' s snowball Snilloc ' s snowball was an evocation spell in general use throughout the Realms . Effects . This spell caused one ball of magical snow to instantly appear in the caster ' s hand which could then be thrown at any creature or object within the range of the spell ' s effect .

title: Snilloc ' s snowball swarm
description: Snilloc ' s snowball swarm Snilloc ' s snowball swarm , also just snowball swarm , was a spell that generated an explosion of snowballs that covered a 10 ft ( 3 m ) radius area . An older version of this spell covered a 30 ft ( 9 m ) radius but did less damage . Effect .

title: Snowdown
description: Snowdown Snowdown was an island of the Moonshae Isles . It lay to the east of Gwynneth . Inhabitants .

title: Snowdrift Inn
description: Snowdrift Inn The Snowdrift Inn was an inn in Easthaven within the Ten - Towns of Icewind Dale . Structure . Located near Pomab ' s Emporium in the eastern part of Easthaven , the wooden building looked inviting to many a cold traveler .

title: Snowflake Mountains
description: Snowflake Mountains The Snowflake Mountains were a range of mountains in West Faerûn , forming the borders between Tethyr , Amn , and what was once the barony of Impresk within Erlkazar . They included some of the tallest mountains in Faerûn . Geography .

title: Snowflake obsidian
description: Snowflake obsidian Snowflake Obsidian was a variety of obsidian found in large deposits of volcanic origin . Description . This ornamental stone was black volcanic glass with grayish splashes in the matrix that often exhibited snowflake - like symmetry if cut correctly .

title: Snowflower
description: Snowflower The snowflower was a plant that grew in cold climates . Description . Like an arctic version of tumbleweed , snowflowers tumbled across the ice in the wind .

title: Snowhair the Sorceress
description: Snowhair the Sorceress Snowhair the Sorceress was a character appearing in a ballad about the rumored Bryndar of Brynwood in the Vast . According to one tale about the Bryndar , they were real human women who adopted animal forms to discourage anyone who ventured into their forest . A certain minstrel wrote a ballad about one of these women , whom he named " Snowhair the Sorceress " .

title: Snowshoes
description: Snowshoes Snowshoes was a divine magic spell available to priests and ranger s of Auril , the Frostmaiden . It allowed one creature to walk over snow and ice at the same rate as if it were normal ground . Effects .

title: Snùt
description: Snùt Snùt was a goblin messenger in Northdark . Personality . Snùt was easily terrified and betrayed his clients if his life was in danger .

title: So - Kehur
description: So - Kehur So - Kehur is a Red Wizard of Necromancy and follower of the lich Szass Tam . Appearance . So - Kehur is quite corpulent for a Mulan .

title: So Golin - po
description: So Golin - po So Golin - po , nicknamed the Hojyko Yada ( meaning " mountain badger " ) , was a human yakuza who was head of the Bakshi yakuza clan and through them the " de facto " ruler of the city of Ojy - do in Koryo around 1357 DR . Activities . As the clanhead of the Bakshi , So Golin - po was the mastermind behind their rise to power over Ojy - do and the true ruler of the city .

title: Soapstone
description: Soapstone Soapstone , also known as steatite , was a soft and brittle but easily worked hardstone . Description . This harder version of was found in colors ranging from white to green and was often dyed other colors .

title: Soares
description: Soares Soares was a thug in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Soares was a charming and sure - of - himself individual .

title: Soargar
description: Soargar Soargar was one of the founders of the new Impiltur . History . Soargar was the archmage of the Elethlim dynasty and in his role he witnessed the plague that in 922 DR killed most of the family , the disappearance at sea of Princess Aliia in 924 DR , and finally the fragmentation of the kingdom in 926 DR .

title: Soargyl
description: Soargyl The Soargyl family is a noble house of Sembia . It is seated in the city of Selgaunt , and a sworn enemy of the House Uskevren . Their family badge is silver swans on a backdrop of green , and their motto is " Always even in the end .

title: Soarimbrar the Younger
description: Soarimbrar the Younger Soarimbrar Heltharn the Younger was a boy king of Impiltur who never ruled . Relationships . Soarimbrar was the son of Prince Verimlaun .

title: Society of Brilliance
description: Society of Brilliance The Society of Brilliance was a neutral society consisting of a few scholars represented by various races in the Underdark . Dogma . Their goal was to study the Underdark , hoping to gain a better understanding about the terrain where they lived .

title: Society of the Jade Empress
description: Society of the Jade Empress The Society of the Jade Empress was a secret society in Shou Lung . Description . The Society of the Jade Empress planned to reestablish the Hai dynasty on throne .

title: Society of the Kuo - Tan
description: Society of the Kuo - Tan The Society of the Kuo - Tan was a secret society secretly helping Shou Lung . Description . The Society of the Kuo - Tan was a vigilante organization .

title: Society of the Sword
description: Society of the Sword The Society of the Sword was the largest and oldest mercenary company in Chessenta and also active in the Vilhon Reach around 1358 DR . Organization . Contracts .

title: Society of the Verdant Arrow
description: Society of the Verdant Arrow The Society of the Verdant Arrow is an anti - human organization that met at Mytela Halvasyn ' s house around 1368 DR . The organization was made up of the half - elf descendants of Lady Mytela Halvasyn , who advocated the banishment of human s from Aglarond , thereby returning it to the way things were during the days of the Yuir elves . The members were particularly frustrated by the often - absent human ruler of Aglarond , the Simbul , and strongly opposed the Sons of Hoar .

title: Sofir Naj - kri
description: Sofir Naj - kri Sofir Naj - kri was an elven inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . As the head of the College of Alchemy , Sofir possessed a natural love of chemicals .

title: Soft Whisper
description: Soft Whisper The Soft Whisper was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Hakiyah , the Zakharan goddess of truth and honesty . The symbol of the Soft Whisper was a jade jambiya . Activities .

title: Soften earth and stone
description: Soften earth and stone Soften earth and stone is a transmutation spell turns stone to clay or dirt to sand and mud . Effect . When this spell is cast , all natural , undressed earth or stone in the spell ' s area is softened .

title: Sohang Gitse
description: Sohang Gitse Sohang Gitse was a gambler yakuza in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , at the komite in Suijeng , Sohang Gitse took bets on any and all contests in the tournament .

title: Sohei
description: Sohei Sohei were special warrior - priests that could be found in Kara - Tur and the Hordelands . In Shou Lung , they were called no - sheng . Role .

title: Sojourn
description: Sojourn Sojourn is the third book in the Dark Elf trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Sokol Keep
description: Sokol Keep Sokol Keep was located on Thorn Island near Phlan . Structure . It was an ancient fortress with stone walls charred , grayed , and desolated from dragon fire .

title: Solar
description: Solar Solars are the most powerful of all the angel s . A solar has a deep and commanding voice , and stands about 9 feet tall . It weighs about 500 pounds .

title: Solara
description: Solara Solara was a mercenary leader in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Solara led the Company of the Singing Dawn .

title: Solaufein
description: Solaufein Solaufein was a drow male living in Ust Natha and secretly a worshiper of Eilistraee . He grudgingly worked for the city ' s houses while at the same time not believing in the justification of the viciousness with which they dealt with other races and each other . He also had a particularly bitter relationship with Phaere , with whom he ' d had an actual romantic relationship in the past .

title: Soldim Jedea
description: Soldim Jedea Soldim Jedea was a member of the Jedea family and the first ruler of the city of Mordulkin in Chessenta following its revolt from Unther in the Year of Flashing Eyes , 929 DR . Soldim was the most powerful mage of the Jedea family , and it became standard practice for the family ' s best mages to rule the city . Soldim later founded the Jedea Academy , a school for magic .

title: Solid fog
description: Solid fog Solid fog , formerly known as Veridon ' s solidifier , was a conjuration or alteration spell that created a tangible fog . Users . " Solid fog " could be cast by sorcerer s and wizard s .

title: Solid sand
description: Solid sand Solid sand was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . This useful sand could be tossed upon any soft surface such as snow , mud , regular sand , and even quicksand , where it would instantly harden into a shell that could be walked upon .

title: Solom Ned ' razak
description: Solom Ned ' razak Solom Ned ' razak was a male drow wizard who was the Archmage of Szith Morcane and head of the Inverted Tower . Description . Solom was a middle - aged drow with a fine fashion sense and an air of hedonism .

title: Solon
description: Solon Solon was a city in the Raurin desert . History . Solon was an Imaskar i city that was founded in - 6422 DR and became the capital city of Lower Imaskar during the Middle Kingdoms period of the empire .

title: Solonor Thelandira
description: Solonor Thelandira Solonor Thelandira ( pronounced soe " - loe - nohr theh - " lan " - dih - ruh " ) was the elven god of hunting , archery , and survival in wild and harsh places . He taught his followers the arts of hunting ; including archery , moving unseen and hiding in the wild places . He watched over the borders of wilderness and farmed land and sought to maintain the balance between them .

title: Soman Galt
description: Soman Galt Soman Galt was a former adventurer and Dagult Neverember ' s lacky . History . Around 1479 DR , Galt was mayor of Neverwinter .

title: Somatic component
description: Somatic component The somatic component was a basic part of spellcasting . Many spells required the caster to make a motion to cast the spell . If the caster was unable to make the correct motion , the spell could not be cast .

title: Somidorr Danthan
description: Somidorr Danthan Somidorr Danthan was a half - elf man and smuggler of the city of Tantras in the Vast . Somidorr made a number of shrewd decisions in his illicit trade , and by 1358 had become very rich and dangerous . He desired to increase his own power with the acquisition of magical item s , and didn ' t care who he took them from or how .

title: Somraggah
description: Somraggah Somraggah was a large town in Murghôm . Description . Somraggah was a large town in the nation of Murghôm that sat along the Road of the Dawn , and bordered the Plains of Purple Dust .

title: Son - liin
description: Son - liin Son - liin was a stormsoul genasi who grew up with her father in the wilds of Akanûl . History . In 1479 DR she was very young , just barely a teenager .

title: Song
description: Song A song was a unit of time lasting a minute or two . It was the length of time it takes to sing a song . The school of song was a school of thaumaturgy , a group of spells that used songs and the voice as its central element .

title: Song dragon
description: Song dragon Song dragons were a type of dragon . They lived among human ity in the guise of human women . Physical description .

title: Song of Selûne
description: Song of Selûne The Song of Selûne was a legend about the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . The story . The story began with Selûne as a youthful and beautiful goddess , residing in a mystic realm populated by deities .

title: Songfarla
description: Songfarla Songfarla was an ancient and hidden rock gnome realm located in the eastern spur of the Sunrise Mountains . Geography . Songfarla was located in the eastern Sunrise Mountains at the source of the most northwestern tributary of the River Murghol , which was approximately equidistant from the ruins of Delhumide and the Lake of Mists .

title: Songhorn
description: Songhorn A songhorn was a wind musical instrument , similar to a longhorn . Description . Songhorns were simple recorders made of wood .

title: Songs and Swords series
description: Songs and Swords series The Songs and Swords series by Elaine Cunningham covers the adventures of Arilyn Moonblade and Danilo Thann . Several of the books were originally part of the loosely - connected Harpers series , but as the story of Arilyn Moonblade became more fleshed out and the books became more popular , they were joined together as their own series .

title: Sono
description: Sono Sono was a servant in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Sono was totally loyal to his daimyo but also in love with Buntaro Ostato .

title: Sons of Alagondar
description: Sons of Alagondar The Sons of Alagondar were a nationalist rebel group operating in the city of Neverwinter . Almost all of the Sons of Alagondar were descendants of those who served Lord Nasher Alagondar . They refused to leave Neverwinter even as Mount Hotenow erupted and actively opposed the city ' s new self - imposed leader Lord Protector Dagult Neverember , wishing to return Neverwinter to the way it was before the cataclysm rather than creating the ' New Neverwinter ' that Neverember endorsed .

title: Sons of Gruumsh
description: Sons of Gruumsh Appendix . Trivia . The original cover of " Sons of Gruumsh " incorrectly showed the author as Will Littrell .

title: Soolabax
description: Soolabax Soolabax was a walled town in Chessenta near the border with Threskel . The town was overcrowded and there was no room inside the walls for new construction . The town ' s nominal ruler was Baron Hasos Thora , though he was a vassal of Tchazzar .

title: Soot
description: Soot Captain Soot was a traveler of Zakhara and the Elemental planes in 1367 DR . Description . Captain Soot had jet - black skin and curly white hair .

title: Sophraea Carver
description: Sophraea Carver Sophraea Carver was the youngest member of the Carver family , who were renowned as the keepers of Waterdeep ' s City of the Dead . She was somewhat unique as a heroine of the Realms in that she had no special abilities or adventuring profession . Although she was never touched directly by the Spellplague , some of the blue fire seeped into her and she gained a sixth sense while within the walls of the City of the Dead .

title: Soqaxu
description: Soqaxu Soqaxu was a lizardman warrior of a tribe in the Flooded Forest . Personality . Soqaxu was a smart and experienced warrior .

title: Soram Battlebellow
description: Soram Battlebellow Soram Battlebellow was a dwarf fighter in Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Personality . Soram was a pragmatic and bullheaded individual , seeing everywhere insults against him .

title: Soravian Talebringers
description: Soravian Talebringers The Soravian Talebringers was an organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Talebringers were a group of rangers and clerics of Ilmater focusing on helping the people of Soravia and keeping the various local communities in touch .

title: Sorcere
description: Sorcere Sorcere was one of the three schools at the Tier Breche academy in Menzoberranzan . It was within Sorcere that drow mages and wizards were trained . It was nicknamed " the Tower .

title: Sorcerer
description: Sorcerer A sorcerer , sometimes known as a sorceress if female , is a wielder of arcane magic bound only by their own willpower . Unlike most other arcane spellcasters , particularly the wizards they are often compared with , sorcerers have innate magical ability and are noted for their lack of study in obtaining such power . And while a wizard focuses on isolating their foes and diminishing their ability to fight , a sorcerer prefers to unleash his or her full power , without restraint , blasting their enemies into oblivion .

title: Sorcerer ' s Moon
description: Sorcerer ' s Moon " Sorcerer ' s Moon " is the fourth issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics . It was written by Michael Fleisher and Jan Duursema , drawn by Duursema , and edited by Barbara Kesel . It ended the story arc begun in " The Gathering " and continued in " The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka " and " The Secret of Selûne ' s Eye " .

title: Sorcerer ( kit )
description: Sorcerer ( kit ) Sorcerers were the most common form of mage found in Zakhara . It should be noted that Zakharan sorcerers were completely different than their Faerûnian counterparts who went by the same name . Requirements .

title: Sorcerous duel
description: Sorcerous duel A sorcerous duel often occurred between two sorcerers who were unable to resolve their differences peacefully . These duels were respected and honored throughout the Land of Fate . All sorcerers in Zakhara abided by the rules of the sorcerous duel or faced harsh consequences from their superiors .

title: Sorelisa Zandra
description: Sorelisa Zandra Sorelisa Zandra , was a Zhentarim bounty hunter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , posing as officers of Mirabar , Sorelisa and her partner Naeremos were sent to find the notorious dwarf criminal Worvil Forkbeard by offering protection and a recruitment offer .

title: Soren Whitespear
description: Soren Whitespear Soren Whitespear was a human man . He was a mercenary in the Red Brigade and later a bandit with the Vipers . History .

title: Sorenth Gorender
description: Sorenth Gorender Sorenth Gorender , nicknamed Happy , was a vampire and a lower - ranked member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . He was also owner and bartender of the Purple Lady festhall . Description .

title: Sorgar Illance
description: Sorgar Illance Sorgar Illance was the head of the Illance noble house of Cormyr . He was an ex - adventurer who was both bald and bitter . He was a thief and cruelly enjoyed brawling , especially to the death .

title: Sorlan
description: Sorlan Sorlan was a ghost in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Sorlan hated the Red Wizard s but had become crazy .

title: Sorn
description: Sorn Sorn was a fighter in Thay and an agent of the zulkir Lauzoril in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , under Lauzoril ' s orders , Sorn posed as a trader and went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose a new king .

title: Sornafein Melarn
description: Sornafein Melarn Sornafein Melarn was the house patron of House Melarn in 1479 DR . Personality . The drow was intelligent and handsome , with great charm .

title: Soronil Noonshadow
description: Soronil Noonshadow Soronil Noonshadow was a moon elf diviner and information broker from Luskan . History . His past life was a mystery , and his ability to survive in Luskan despite the enemies his profession made him was also a mystery .

title: Sorrowsworn demon
description: Sorrowsworn demon A sorrowsworn demon was a breed of tanar ' ri demon that preyed upon feelings of grief and loss . Description . A sorrowsworn demon was a gaunt humanoid standing some 12 – 15 feet ( 3 .

title: Sorvic
description: Sorvic Sorvic was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Possessions . When working , Sorvic usually kept around 20 gp on his person .

title: Sos ' Umptu Baenre
description: Sos ' Umptu Baenre Sos ' Umptu Baenre was a daughter of Yvonnel Baenre and a cleric of Lolth . Description . Sos ' Umptu was about the height of Quenthel Baenre .

title: Sosdrielle Vandree
description: Sosdrielle Vandree Sosdrielle Vandree was a drow and the mistress of Gromph Baenre in Menzoberranzan . She bore Liriel Baenre and raised her for the first five years of her life . Although Sosdrielle was beautiful , she lacked ambition and magical talent , so she was not successful .

title: Sossal
description: Sossal The nation of Sossal was located in the Cold Lands of northeast Faerûn . Geography . This chilling place was locked between Pelvuria and Yal Tengri .

title: Sot
description: Sot Sot was the not so famous innkeeper of the Laughing Goblin Inn though his pork and cabbage soup was renowned throughout Phlan . History . Around 1290 DR , Sot ' s grandfather was a cleric of Tyr and guardsman at Sokol Keep on Thorn Island .

title: Sothillis
description: Sothillis Sothillis , or Sythillis , was an ogre mage who attacked the southern cities of Amn in West Faerûn . History . In 1370 DR , Sythillis along with Cyrvisnea , led an army of goblin s , kobold s , ogre s , hill giant s and worshipers of Cyric in attacks upon southern Amn .

title: Sothillisian War
description: Sothillisian War The Sothillisian War was a war that lasted over 4 years between the nation of Amn and the Sothillisian Empire with the goal of recovering the lost Armory of Nedeheim . The ogre mage Sothillis and his mate Cyrvisnea began this war by leading their army of kobold s , goblin s , hill giant s and ogre s , supported by Cyricists in an attack on Fort Ishla and Esmereltan . Both attacks were resounding victories , due in no small part to their superior numbers and the defenders distracted by the secession of Riatavin to Tethyr .

title: Soubar
description: Soubar Soubar was a small village on the Trade Way , south of the Boareskyr Bridge . Government . The population was highly variable , shrinking to an armed camp in the winter with the decline of caravan traffic .

title: Soul charge
description: Soul charge Soul charge was a necromancy spell contained in the " Obsul Ssussun " . Description . As the name suggested , the spell charged a gem with a portion of a soul stolen from a subject for an entire day , the subject could die from it .

title: Soultheft
description: Soultheft Soultheft was a spell used by priests of Vhaeraun . As the name suggested , it took a person ' s soul for later use of its energy . Effects .

title: Sound burst
description: Sound burst Sound burst was an evocation spell that blasted subjects with damaging sound waves . Effects . The caster blasted an area with a tremendous cacophony .

title: Sounds of the gentle zephyr
description: Sounds of the gentle zephyr The sounds of the gentle zephyr was a ritual used by sha ' ir s to greatly enhance their gen ' s natural hearing ability . Preparation . All rituals that enhanced a gen ' s hearing required a set of earrings studded with valuable gems worth at least 500 dinar s .

title: Sourdough
description: Sourdough Sourdough was a type of bread from the Pirate Isles . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: South Center
description: South Center The South Center was a ward of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . The South Center was part of the Affluent District .

title: South District
description: South District The South District was a district of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The South District was found in the People ' s Quarter and covered much of the southern portion of Huzuz .

title: South Faerûn
description: South Faerûn South Faerûn lay to the south of the regions around the Sea of Fallen Stars , being somewhat isolated by the Lake of Steam in the west , and the vast length of the Shaar . It was bordered along the south by the Great Sea ; to the west by the Chult an peninsula region , and in the east by Luiren . Regions .

title: South Gate ( Luskan )
description: South Gate ( Luskan ) The South Gate of the city of Luskan was the means of entry to the city from the southern bank . Structure . Flanked by two formidable towers known as the Twin Teeth , the towers were two of more than a dozen along the southern wall , and , around 1370 DR , it was customary to decorate them with body parts of those killed or executed by the Luskan militia .

title: South Road ( Zakhara )
description: South Road ( Zakhara ) The South Road was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The South Road encircled the City of Delights from the south , providing access to all of the major gates before connecting with the River Road on the north side of the city .

title: South Ward of Waterdeep
description: South Ward of Waterdeep South Ward , more properly called Southern Ward , though native Waterdhavians did not call it such , was the smallest of the seven Wards of the city of Waterdeep , though curiously , not the south - most ; this distinction went to Dock Ward , which bordered Southern Ward in the west and the south across the Way of the Dragon . Geography . The northern boundary with Trades Ward lay across Telshambra ' s Street and Caravan Court .

title: South Zakhara
description: South Zakhara South Zakhara comprised the central part of the Crowded Sea with myriad islands , most of them within three large archipelagoes where civilization gave way more and more to the untamed wild and its mysteries : Nada al - Hazan , the Steaming Isles , and the Islands of the Utter South . Geographic limits . Away to the north , on both sides of the Golden Gulf , lay south Zakhara ' s most important trading partners in the Cities of the Pantheon and especially the Pearl Cities .

title: Southeast Faerûn
description: Southeast Faerûn Southeast Faerûn lies to the south and east of the grassy plains known as the Shaar , along the shores of the Great Sea opposite the land of Zakhara . At the edge of this region lie in the east the Five Kingdoms of the Utter East and further to the south , and thus beyond Faerûn , the giant peninsula of Zakhara . Regions .

title: Southeast Zakhara
description: Southeast Zakhara The area of southeast Zakhara was also the eastern portion of the Crowded Sea . It contained a number of small islands , but was dominated by the two large isles of Harab and Bariya . Both of them featured a number of mountain chains , while much of their lowlands were covered in jungle .

title: Southeastern Sea Route
description: Southeastern Sea Route The Southeastern Sea Route was a trade route located in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . The Southeastern Sea Route exited Huzuz along Al - Sarif River and travelled south through Suq Bay , entering the Golden Gulf before turning southeast toward the Cities of the Pantheon .

title: Southern Imaskari languages
description: Southern Imaskari languages The Southern Imaskari languages were a group derived from Imaskari and spoken by the tribes of the southern parts of the Hordelands . Description . The Southern Imaskari languages had hard , almost biting , consonants .

title: Southern Lluirwood
description: Southern Lluirwood The Southern Lluirwood , or the Granuin Forest , was a forest in Luiren and Dambrath . Geography . The Southern Lluirwood was located south of the Lluirwood and made up the eastern border of Luiren and the western border of Dambrath .

title: Southern magic
description: Southern magic Southern magic was a term used to describe spell s written in a different magical language . While many spells common in the rest of Faerûn were also employed by mages in the south using this language , they also created a number of unique ones unknown outside their ranks . The term also applied to certain spellcasting techniques that blurred the line between arcane and divine .

title: Southwest Faerûn
description: Southwest Faerûn Southwest Faerûn lies along the great Chultan Peninsula that juts out toward the west . The waters to the north are named the Shining Sea , a body bounded by Calimshan to the north and joined to the Lake of Steam through the " Straits of Storm " . To the south of the land is the Great Sea .

title: Southwest Zakhara
description: Southwest Zakhara Wild southwest Zakhara comprised a number of uncivilized islands in the western part of the Crowded Sea . Most of them were part of one of the two archipelagoes of Jazayir al - Sartan and the Djinni ' s Claws . Geographic limits .

title: Southwood
description: Southwood The Southwood was a forest just south of Loudwater in the Gray Vale in the North . It was bordered to the north by the Gray Vale and to the south by Highstar Lake . It is part of the Triangle of Trees .

title: Sozarro
description: Sozarro Sozarro was a former member of the Golden Legion in 1362 DR . History . Sozarro was one of the legionaries who first came to Maztica with Cordell .

title: Speak with avians
description: Speak with avians Speak with avians was a divine spell that could be prayed for by followers of Aerdrie Faenya , the Winged Mother . It allowed the caster to briefly converse with a normal bird or a natural giant variety of avian . Effects .

title: Speak with dead
description: Speak with dead Speak with dead , also seen as speak with the dead , was a necromancy spell or exploration ritual that allowed the caster to ask a corpse questions and receive answers . Effects . The corpse being subjected to this " reading " had to be intact enough to speak and the questions asked had to be in a language that the deceased understood .

title: Speak with monsters
description: Speak with monsters Speak with monsters was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to communicate with any creature that had some mode of communication . Effects . For two minutes per level of experience the caster could speak any creature ' s language through whatever medium ( audio , tactile , pheromones , sign language , dance , empathy , telepathy , etc .

title: Speak with plants
description: Speak with plants Speak with plants was a divination or alteration spell that allowed the caster to converse in very simple terms with vegetative and fungoid life forms . Effects . This spell worked on all sorts of plants and plant creatures .

title: Speak with the drowned dead
description: Speak with the drowned dead Speak with the drowned dead was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Queen of the Deeps . It allowed a person to ask the spirit of someone who died by drowning two questions . Effects .

title: Speak with undead
description: Speak with undead Speak with undead , a skill specifically taught to adept ' s of the Doom Guide , allowing the user to commune with the recently departed by calling upon their spirit from the plane it has receded to after death . A Doom Guide at times uses this ability to console the family of the recently deceased , usually to convey the deceased last wishes , or provide information for those in the material plane . The drawback of using this technique is that upon attempting to contact the deceased , the deceased must choose to answer the summons to the material plane .

title: Spear
description: Spear A spear is a simple two - handed melee weapon in the pole arm family . Description . A spear can be made of any rigid material but is typically a straight shaft made of wood .

title: Spear of Lurue
description: Spear of Lurue Spear of Lurue was a transmutation spell that turned a non - magical weapon into a silvered spear . Effects . The caster had to be holding the drawn weapon to cast this spell .

title: Spear of the Wandering Legion
description: Spear of the Wandering Legion The Spear of the Wandering Legion was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This spear had an intricately etched shaft of slim silver .

title: Speck
description: Speck Speck was a half - orc Chosen . Activities . Speck and his fellow Hamdir acted as guards for Oota in a secret shadovar village for captured Chosen .

title: Spectator
description: Spectator A spectator was an extraplanar form of beholderkin with four eyestalks . Somewhat mild and even - tempered , they had even been known to form friendships with other creatures , a trait that no other beholderkin or true beholder ever displayed . Abilities .

title: Specter
description: Specter Specters ( also spelled spectres ) were undead , incorporeal creatures that resembled ghost s . Description . A specter appeared as a humanoid , with a mostly transparent and faintly luminous form .

title: Spectorial
description: Spectorial Spectorial was a mage and a friend of the warrior hero Rigar Trueblood . As he lay on his deathbed , Rigar Trueblood begged Spectorial to preserve his skill and fortitude in battle . Although reluctant , Spectorial acceded and extracted these qualities from Rigar ' s soul , placing them into the " pale green ioun stone " so that others might benefit from them .

title: Spectral claw
description: Spectral claw Spectral claw was an arcane magic spell used by sorcerer s to create a claw of force that could immobilize and harm an opponent . Effects . This spell brought forth a claw made of pure force , similar to the various " Bigby ' s hand " spells , and could be described as a combination of " Bigby ' s grasping hand " and " Bigby ' s crushing hand " .

title: Spectral dagger
description: Spectral dagger A spectral dagger was a magical dagger . The hilt was carved from a bone of a creature that had died violently . When it was wielded , a blade made from light protruded from the bone hilt .

title: Spectral guard
description: Spectral guard Spectral guard was an arcane evocation and necromancy spell that set a silent , invisible protector at a location , activated by specific conditions . Effects . This spell could be cast on any visible location within 60 yd ( 55 m ) of the caster .

title: Spectral harpist
description: Spectral harpist A spectral harpist was a type of ghost . They were created when the spirits of Master Harper s died whilst leaving Harper business unfinished . Spectral harpists were intelligent undead that resemble ghosts or wraith s , appearing as translucent , shadowy forms that floated or flew around .

title: Spectral wings
description: Spectral wings Spectral wings was an arcane evocation spell that created a flying steed . Effects . This spell created a magical force in the shape of a pair of wings that seemed to be made out of fog .

title: Spell ( disambiguation )
description: Spell ( disambiguation ) Spell is a non - definite term that can mean different things depending on the context , though indefinitely it refers to a power or ability fueled by some form of magic . Spell can mean : A similar term also used is exploit , which refers to spell - like abilities used by martial classes such as rogue s or ranger s .

title: Spell component pouch
description: Spell component pouch A " spell component pouch " was a pouch in which spellcaster s kept their commonly used material component s and spell focus es for easy access . These pouches were usually made of leather and were watertight . They often had separate compartments so that a spellcaster could find the item he or she needed in a matter of seconds .

title: Spell domain
description: Spell domain The Spell domain , not to be confused with the Magic domain , was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters arcane spell powers . Deities with the spell domain . Four gods offered the spell domain , all of them associated with magic in some respect .

title: Spell engine
description: Spell engine Spell engine was an arcane abjuration or alteration spell that created a magical device that absorbed virtually all spells cast in the surrounding area and produced a light that was conducive to magical study . Effects . There were at least three slightly different versions of this spell .

title: Spell immunity
description: Spell immunity Spell immunity was an abjuration spell that made the recipient completely resistant to one or more particular spells of 4th level or below . Effects . The caster was required to touch the recipient in order to successfully cast this spell .

title: Spell invulnerability
description: Spell invulnerability Spell invulnerability , also known as invulnerability to spells , was an arcane abjuration spell that rendered the recipient completely immune to one spell , spell - like ability , or magic item for a short time . Effects . This spell took ten minutes to cast and worked against only one spell , spell - like ability , or magic item that was specified as part of the casting .

title: Spell resistance
description: Spell resistance Spell resistance is an abjuration spell that grants resistance to incoming spells . Effect . The creature gains SR equal to 12 + caster level .

title: Spell turning
description: Spell turning When spell turning is cast , spells and spell - like effects targeted on you are turned back upon the original caster . The abjuration turns only spells that have you as a target . Effect and area spells are not affected .

title: Spellbane
description: Spellbane Spellbane was a type of plant often used as a herb for its magic - nullification properties , Ecology . The spellbane plant was only known to grow in Cormyr . It clung to rocks in areas of deep shade , such as in clefts , in piles of stones in forests , and in the mouths of caves .

title: Spellbattle ring
description: Spellbattle ring A spellbattle ring is a magic ring that gives its wearer the ability to dispel certain spells . Its wearer immediately becomes aware of any use of , and the nature of , magical spells , powers or psionics within 40m ( 120ft ) . He or she can then choose to dispel it or change its target .

title: Spellblade
description: Spellblade Spellblade was a magical quality that could be applied to weapons It made the wielder immune to a single spell of the creator ' s choice , but only if it was directly targeted at the wielder , not those that affected a large area . The spell was absorbed by the weapon and the wielder could then choose to redirect the spell at a target of their choosing , or let it drain away . Creation of a " spellblade " weapon required a " spell turning " spell .

title: Spellbook
description: Spellbook A spellbook was a type of book that wizard s and other arcane spellcasters used to record their known spell s . Description . The complex notation of a spell took up several full pages of a spellbook : the more powerful the spell , the more pages it took up .

title: Spellfilcher
description: Spellfilcher Spellfilchers were a special kind of elven mage - thief who specialized in stealing from other mages . Culture . Spellfilchers were always part of a so - called spellfilcher guild .

title: Spellfire
description: Spellfire Spellfire was a rare magical power highly coveted by many in Faerûn , as it allowed the user to absorb spells cast at them , internally convert it to raw magical energy , and then use it in myriad ways . Spellfire energies could be used to heal , to project destructive bursts of flame from the eyes , for flight , and in rare cases , for a powerful ability known as the Crown of Fire . Known Spellfire wielders include : And a wizard hidden in the Border Kingdoms and a cruel noble of Chessenta .

title: Spellfire ( novel )
description: Spellfire ( novel ) Spellfire is the first book in Shandril ' s Saga by Ed Greenwood . Characters . Aghazstamn • Amarune • Mourngrym Amcathra • Architrave • Arkuel • Ashemmi • Elminster Aumar • Baerth • Marsh Belwintle • Berost • Naergoth Bladelord • Burlane • Casildar • Fzoul Chembryl • Chess • Commarth • Crimmon • Culthar • Dargoth • Rozsarran Dathan • Illistyl Elventree • Eressea • Florin Falconhand • Ferostil • Ghondarrath • Gorstag • Delg Hammerhand • Malark Himbruel • Ilthond • Imraea • Kalthas • Kelan • Korvan • Kuldus • Laelar • Lhaeo • Lhaera • Lureene • Lynxal • Magusta • Manshoon • Manxam • Marimmar • Symgharyl Maruel • Naera • Orlgaun • Pardus • Raeth • Rauglothgor • Rold • Shaerl Rowanmantle • Ruld • Rymel • Salvarad • Sarhthor • Bronn Selgard • Sememmon • Sharantyr • Shargrailar • Shandril Shessair • Shield ( horse ) • Alassra Silverhand • Storm Silverhand • Syluné Silverhand • Jhaele Silvermane • Jhessail Silvertree • Sintre • Lanseril Snowmantle • Snuggleguts • Stralane • Merith Strongbow • Suld • Narm Tamaraith • Tezza • Thail • Theln • Rathan Thentraver • Thiszult • Thurbal • Torm • Ulsinar • Warrior ( horse ) • Yantra • Yarkul • Zhessae • Zilvreen d Wyvernspur ] ] • Giogioni Wyvernspur Locations .

title: Spellgard
description: Spellgard Spellgard ( formerly known as Saharelgard ) was the ruin of an ancient castle complex dating from the Netherese Empire located on a rocky ridge , northeast of Llorkh , where the southern edge of the Fallen Lands meets the eastern edge of the former Anauroch desert . Spellgard was once ruled by Lady Saharel , a high mage of ancient Netheril . At its apogee , Saharelgard was a rich storehouse of wealth , mighty magic , as well as luxurious dress , decoration , furnishings , and food .

title: Spellguard
description: Spellguard The Spellguard was an organization of powerful mage s in Silverymoon . Most of them were high - ranking politicians within Luruar . History .

title: Spellhold
description: Spellhold Spellhold was an insane asylum located on the island of Brynnlaw , one of the Nelanther Isles , off the western coast of Amn , under the command of the Cowled Wizards of Amn . They used the asylum to house the " deviants " they found in Amn who were caught practicing magic without an official license . There was a portal to the Underdark in a secret room on the main floor of the building .

title: Spelljammer
description: Spelljammer A spelljammer was a type of magically powered vessel that could travel great distances , even into the Sea of Night . Each ship had a magical helm or " captains - chair " that allowed a suitably powerful mage to pilot the ship . Many of these vessels ( and vessels like them ) still existed on Faerûn .

title: Spelljammer in the Realms
description: Spelljammer in the Realms Spelljammer is a D & D campaign setting that mixes fantasy elements ( elves , dwarves , ships , catapults , magic , and the like ) in a space setting . Officially cancelled in 1993 , some material for 3rd Edition was created at the Spelljammer web page . Geography .

title: Spellplague
description: Spellplague The Spellplague , called the Blue Breath of Change by the inhabitants of Returned Abeir , was a disaster that struck Realmspace , the world of Abeir , and even the planes themselves on Tarsakh 29 of the Year of Blue Fire , 1385 DR , and was caused by Mystra ' s assassination at the hands of Cyric and Shar . It continued for a decade , leading to the Wailing Years , during which arcane magic ceased to function and the planet of Toril was transformed . The diviner Yaphyll had a vision of the event : In her vision , Yaphyll referred to Mystra as the white queen and to Shar , goddess of the night , as the black queen .

title: Spellscar
description: Spellscar Creatures that ventured close to Plagueland s could gain Spellscar s . The Order of Blue Flame often sought out Plagueland s in what were referred to as Scar Pilgrimage s . A spellscar might leave no visible mark , or it could leave a marking in blue flame on the skin ( or perhaps worse ) .

title: Spellshire
description: Spellshire Spellshire was a minor county of Tethyr ruled by the famous wizard Gamalon Idogyr . Geography . County Spellshire was located north of the Sulduskoon River .

title: Spellsinger
description: Spellsinger Spellsingers ( also known as song mages or , in the case of cleric / bard spellsingers , circle dancers ) were rare practitioners of an ancient elven bardic tradition . Description . Spellsingers were almost always bards ( or multi - classed bards , particularly wizard / bard ) .

title: Spellslayer
description: Spellslayer Spellslayers were feared wizard s in Zakhara who specialized in directly attacking the connection between another wizard and their magic , affecting or utterly eliminating their ability to harness their powers . Requirements . The very nature of the skills and actions practiced by spellslayers only attracted chaotic - minded individuals who possessed dark hearts .

title: Spellslayer wine
description: Spellslayer wine Spellslayer wine was an alchemical concoction that temporarily disabled arcane casters ' ability to use magic . It was discovered by an herbalist in Daerlun named Janesse Wyndsur . The potion was discovered accidentally by Janesse while she was experimenting with painkilling potions .

title: Spellsong
