description: Spellsong Spellsong was the ability to invoke various magical effects through song and music . Casters . Practitioners of the Spellsong were known as Spellsinger s and were individuals who had the innate ability of using their voice to produce melodies with magical properties .

title: Spellstorm mage
description: Spellstorm mage Spellstorm mages are wizard s who see more clearly the nature of the arcane than most mortals . To a spellstorm mage , magic does not flow gently through the world in currents . Rather , it is a tempest to be calmed and unleashed at one ’ s beckoning .

title: Spellstrike
description: Spellstrike Spellstrike was an arcane alteration spell that could cancel another spell , even retroactively . Effects . This spell could be cast instantly at any spell or spell - like ability that the caster could sense was happening within range .

title: Spelltrap
description: Spelltrap Spelltrap was an arcane alteration and abjuration spell that could absorb spells cast upon the caster of " spelltrap " and then release them later at targets of the caster ' s choosing . Ironically , mages that specialized in transmutation or abjuration could not cast this spell . Effects .

title: Spendelard ' s chaser
description: Spendelard ' s chaser Spendelard ' s chaser was an arcane necromancy spell that alleviated pain and the undesirable side effects of drugs and alcohol , and provided significant protection against poison s . Effects . This spell could be used on one creature no bigger than an ogre , and maintained its efficacy for 10 minutes per level of the caster .

title: Spernik
description: Spernik Spernik was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Spernik suffered from chronic nervousness .

title: Sphene
description: Sphene Sphene was a precious stone that came in many colors and , like scapra , was easily worked by unskilled cutters . Description . Sphene was a soft , brittle gemstone that came in shades of yellow to deep green with a fine emerald green as the most prized hue .

title: Sphere
description: Sphere Sphere was a term that was short for " sphere of influence " in second edition D & D ( also known as AD & D ) . Each deity had a set of spheres of influence in which they were interested and which they embodied . Priests of a deity had access to the spells in that deity ' s spheres .

title: Sphere of annihilation
description: Sphere of annihilation A sphere of annihilation was a globe of absolute blackness , a ball of nothingness 2 feet in diameter . Description . The object was actually a hole in the continuity of the multiverse .

title: Sphere of ultimate destruction
description: Sphere of ultimate destruction Sphere of ultimate destruction is a very powerful sorcerer and wizard spell that conjures a featureless black sphere of nothingness that destroys everything in its path . Effects . Creatures who are struck by the sphere have a slim chance of surviving , but will most likely be disintegrated , along with any non - living matter .

title: Sphinx
description: Sphinx Sphinxes are a race of intelligent , immortal magical beasts . It is said that they once held a vast kingdom given to them by the gods in an effort to teach mortals the way of truth . The sphinxes had their own methods , however , by teaching mortals to think for themselves with riddles and parables .

title: Spice Road
description: Spice Road The Spice Road was a major trade route between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Description . Less used than its southern counterpart , the Silk Road , the Spice Road was a long and dangerous route through the steppes of the Endless Wastes .

title: Spice jar
description: Spice jar A spice jar was a magical item highly valued among travelers in the Realms for its ability to produce any desired spice . Powers . A magic " spice jar " could produce whatever spice — rare or otherwise — that the possessor wanted .

title: Spiced wine
description: Spiced wine Spiced wine was wine with added herbs produced in Calimshan and Tethyr . A variety was available for sale through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Spider
description: Spider A spider is an air - breathing chelicerate arthropod . Spiders are found all over Faerûn . They are arachnids that come in a variety of shapes , sizes , and coloration .

title: Spider ' s Bane
description: Spider ' s Bane Spider ' s Bane was an enchanted greatsword originally forged by dwarves of the Orothiar tribe in Cloakwood as a present to the Grand Dukes of Baldur ' s Gate . It was helpful in battle against spiders in that when wielded , it granted immunity to movement - restricting effects , such as webs . It was lost to the Grand Dukes a century later , but rediscovered by two young brothers .

title: Spider ' s kiss ( drow )
description: Spider ' s kiss ( drow ) The spider ' s kiss was a " game " played among the female members of drow society . It consisted of a female killing her male partner after mating . It was named so for the black widow spider " who mates and kills " .

title: Spider ( individual )
description: Spider ( individual ) Spider was a delivery boy in Skullport . Personality . Spider was overconfident , brash , and arrogant .

title: Spider Parrafin
description: Spider Parrafin Spider ( who sometimes went by Spider Parrafin after his father or Spider Pericolo Topolino after his mentor ) was the only son of Eiverbreen , a poor halfling from Delthuntle . He was the reincarnation of Regis , one of the Companions of the Hall . He inherited watersoul genasi blood from his mother .

title: Spider curse
description: Spider curse Spider curse is a transmutation spell unique to cleric s with the spider domain . It transforms the target into a drider like creature . Effect .

title: Spider domain
description: Spider domain The Spider domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters spider - themed spell s and powers . They gained the ability to rebuke and command spiders much as an evil cleric rebuked and commanded undead . Deities with the Spider domain .

title: Spider fang ( weapon )
description: Spider fang ( weapon ) A spider fang is a magic + 1 dagger , black or dark purple in color . It has the ability to cut through webs without getting stuck , and once per day it can either weave a web , or a curtain made of cobwebs , suitable for hiding or concealment . If a curtain is created and a creature touches it , it collapses and causes the creature acid damage .

title: Spider mask
description: Spider mask A spider mask was a drow item that allowed wearers to transverse any web safely . Description . A spider mask was a black velvet mask with four jointed wire legs protruding from each side of it .

title: Spider rod
description: Spider rod A spider rod can be used up to three times a day to shoot a strand of spider ' s silk up to 100 feet ( 30m ) . If the strand strikes a creature , there is a chance that it will entangle the creature for up to a minute . The silk is highly flammable , but burning it is likely to cause injury to the entangled creature as well .

title: Spider scuttle
description: Spider scuttle Sometimes known as " spiderwalk " or " spider climb " , Spider scuttle was an invocation used by some warlock s , particularly those of the dark pact . Effects . When cast , " spider scuttle " , allowed its caster to walk along the walls of a cavern like a spider , giving them shadowy legs that allowed them to move with unnatural ease and speed .

title: Spider shapes
description: Spider shapes Spider shapes is a transmutation spell unique to cleric s who worship deities of the spider domain that transforms its subjects into spiders . Effect . When cast , this spell functions much in the same manner as spells like " polymorph other " .

title: Spider that Waits
description: Spider that Waits The Spider that Waits was a demon that had been bound by the wizard s of Almraiven in the Plain of Stone Spiders since the Time of Troubles . The Spider was previously banished to the Abyss for one thousand years by an Almraiven wizard . The demon constantly strained to break its bonds but was unable to do so .

title: Spiderbait
description: Spiderbait Spiderbait was a goblin living in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . He was a thrill - seeking individual .

title: Spiderhaunt Wood
description: Spiderhaunt Wood Spiderhaunt Wood was a forest on the southwestern edge of Shadowdale in the Dalelands . The Northride ran just south of the woods , and the Tethyamar Trail ran the whole eastern border of the wood . A single trail , the Arachnid Pathway , led from the Tethyamar Trail into the heart of the wood .

title: Spiderkind
description: Spiderkind Spiderkind was a grouping of all spider s and creatures that resembled spiders ( arachnoid creature s ) . Spiderkind were revered by Lolth - worshiping drow . Arachnomancer s could communicate with all spiderkind .

title: Spidersilk armor
description: Spidersilk armor Spidersilk armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Spidersilk armor was crafted from treated aranea or drider silk .

title: Spiderstone golem
description: Spiderstone golem Spiderstone golems were construct s crafted by the drow and imbued with the martial skill of a trained drow warrior . Ecology . Physical Characteristics .

title: Spiel
description: Spiel Spiel was a Netherese enclave and a center of learning . History . Founded in - 2510 DR ( 1349 NY ) , it grew to house many universities and other institutions of learning , so much so that ten years after its founding there were more schools than taverns or festhalls .

title: Spike growth
description: Spike growth Spike growth was a transmutation or alteration / enchantment spell that caused the vegetation in an area of ground to become needle sharp without changing its appearance . Effects . This spell could work outdoors on any ground that could support plant life .

title: Spiked chain
description: Spiked chain The spiked chain is a two - handed , exotic , melee reach weapon . Description . A spiked chain is a length of metal chain whose last few links on each end are enlarged and enhanced with spikes .

title: Spinagon
description: Spinagon Spinagons , or spined devils , were porcupine - like fiend s . Description . Spined devils weighed 150 – 250 pounds and stood up to 30 inches tall .

title: Spine of the Dog
description: Spine of the Dog The Spine of the Dog was a long , thin stretch of mountains that formed much of the border with West Zakhara and the shores of Suq Bay and the Golden Gulf . Geography . The Spine of the Dog appeared to break from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue near the Sea of Caravans , running east along Al - Tariq Channel and turning south along both quarters of Suq Bay before turning back west toward the High Desert as it entered the territory of the Pearl Cities .

title: Spine of the World
description: Spine of the World The Spine of the World was a mountain range stretching from the westernmost part of Faerûn south of Icewind Dale to the eastern edge of the Cold Wood where it joined up with the Ice Mountains , which stretched all the way to the Anauroch . Folks all across the lands of the Savage Frontier and the Silver Marches , but especially those in Scornubel referred to the Spine as ' the Wall ' , typically because it was simply an endless , nearly impassable range of high , jagged , perpetually ice - covered mountains , but also because on the winter days when the white snow covered faces of the peaks meet the iron - grey of the sunless winter sky , it appeared as though it was holding up sky . While the western - most edge of the Spine was penetrated by a circuitous , always dangerous trade route to Icewind Dale , the rest of the range was not even approached by those without a stout heart .

title: Spinel
description: Spinel The precious stone spinel was not native to North Faerûn . Spinels came to the region from traders with the Southwest and from visitors to Kara - Tur . Description .

title: Spinning Keep of Siri ' wadjen
description: Spinning Keep of Siri ' wadjen The Spinning Keep of Siri ' wadjen was the magical structure surrounding the " Calimemnon Crystal " in which the genie s Calim and Memnon were entrapped in the Calim Desert . Location . The Spinning Keep magically hovered and rotated exactly 44 feet ( 13 .

title: Spirali
description: Spirali Spirali was a Maztican drow . He was one of the Ancient Ones . History .

title: Spire of Kor
description: Spire of Kor The Spire of Kor towered over the High Desert of Zakhara about 10 miles ( 16 . 1 km ) west of the village of Raziz . Description .

title: Spires of Mir
description: Spires of Mir The Spires of Mir were a wasteland of strange stone spires located in southern Tethyr , just north of the Marching Mountains . Geography . Prior to the Spellplague , the spires were part of the Forest of Mir , but the plague changed the trees into huge stone spires .

title: Spires of the Morning
description: Spires of the Morning The Spires of the Morning was a temple to Lathander in the Castle Ward at the northern spur of Mount Waterdeep in Waterdeep . Structure . Built of pink marble , this three - story cathedral was capped by seven spires of copper , gold , and silver that gleamed with the reflected glory of dawn ' s first light .

title: Spirit Lodge
description: Spirit Lodge Spirit Lodge was a temporary lodging for green elves in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description . The lodge was a long building surrounded by trees .

title: Spirit Soaring
description: Spirit Soaring Location . Cadderly Bonaduce built the temple to Deneir high in the Snowflake Mountains , it cost him a lot as the magics used drained him and aged him remarkably , but once it was finished , though he thought he might die in doing so , Deneir reversed the aging process so that he would go back to his natural age over time . The closest city to the temple is that of Carradoon , with a large lake and a fair sized fishing fleet .

title: Spirit Warriors
description: Spirit Warriors The Spirit Warriors were a group of Lesser Immortal s of the Celestial Bureaucracy , the dominant faith of Kara - Tur . They served Chan Cheng , the god of war . The Spirit Warriors had the duties of creating courage and resolve in those who wavered , and leading armies of phantoms , the manifestation of which could swing a battle .

title: Spirit World
description: Spirit World The Spirit World was one of the planes of existence in the World Tree cosmology . It was home to the Celestial Empire and its Bureaucracy , the overarching pantheon of Kara - Tur . Cosmology .

title: Spirit annihilation
description: Spirit annihilation Spirit annihilation was a divine magic spell available to priests of Bane , the Black Hand . It completely destroyed the spirit of a dying or recently dead creature so it could never return or reveal information via " speak with dead " . After Bane ' s supposed death in the Year of Shadows , 1358 DR , Cyric granted spells to Banite priests for a decade , so it was possible this spell could be found within the church of Cyric .

title: Spirit folk
description: Spirit folk Spirit folk were mystical descendants of human s and natural spirits . These creatures were uncommon all over Faerûn but were most likely to be found in Rashemen . They are loving and peaceful creatures , in tune with the natural world around them .

title: Spirit moss
description: Spirit moss Spirit moss is a pale white moss that grows on dead trees in swampy environments . When living creatures approach , it thrashes violently , causing creatures to become entangled . The moss implants spores into snared creatures that can cause complete immobilisation , the victim simply moaning gently , which whittles down the creature over a period of days , finally resulting in death .

title: Spirit naga
description: Spirit naga Spirit nagas are the most powerful type of naga . They have a human female head on a snake body and are akin to witches , among the naga races . They are even more mysterious and enigmatic than the others of their kind , seeking lost magic to a fanatical extent .

title: Spirit tempest
description: Spirit tempest Spirits move through the world . The Spirit tempest uses this constant moving to attack foes and send his companions over the battlefield . Abilities .

title: Spiritual guardian
description: Spiritual guardian Spiritual guardian is a spell that creates a translucent knight made of pure force within 5 ' ( 1 . 5m ) of the caster . The holy warrior appears clad in heavy plate mail with the holy symbol of the caster ' s deity embossed on its tunic and shield .

title: Spiritual weapon
description: Spiritual weapon Spiritual weapon , also called spiritual hammer in some circles , was an evocation spell that conjured a magical weapon which attacked chosen targets . Effects . This spell was used to call upon the caster ' s patron deity to bring forth a weapon made of pure force .

title: Spiritual wrath
description: Spiritual wrath Spiritual wrath was a cooperative evocation spell that brought down a mighty blow able to smash objects , creatures , and buildings alike . Effects . Between six and twelve priests were required to cast this spell and it cost them sorely to do so .

title: Spiteful glamor
description: Spiteful glamor Spiteful glamor is an invocation used by dark pact warlock s . " Spiteful glamor " , when cast , tears into the mind of any creature of the warlock ' s choosing within fifty feet , causing them great pain . The spell is even deadlier when used against creatures who haven ' t yet been injured .

title: Spitter
description: Spitter Spitters were small elemental vermin native to the Elemental Plane of Water that could also be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Spitters possessed a lizard ' s body with the head , eyes , hands and feet of a frog .

title: Splendarrllur
description: Splendarrllur The river Splendarrllur ( also known as the Shining River by the shield dwarves ) was one of the three greatest rivers of Amn . Description . The Splendarrllur had cold and swift water , but it was still an important route for the barge traffic from the northeast to Lake Esmel .

title: Splint mail
description: Splint mail Splint mail ( or simply splint ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Splint mail was made up of several vertical strips of ( known as splints ) that were riveted to a backing of leather .

title: Splitter
description: Splitter Splitter was a greatsword wielded by Ryld Argith , a drow master of Melee - Magthere in Menzoberranzan . " Splitter " could cut through nearly anything . It also dispelled magic with a successful hit .

title: Spodumene
description: Spodumene Spodumene was also known as or , depending on the color . Description . Spodumene came in two distinct color families each with their own name .

title: Spontaer
description: Spontaer The " Spontaer " was the title of the senior Sage - Priest , the official historian , of the Church of Ilmater " circa " 1265 DR . He was based at the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum . History .

title: Spriggan
description: Spriggan Spriggans were created by Netherese slavers in - 3649 DR . Inspired by the god Urdlen , they warped gnome slaves with their magic , making their skin yellow and warty , their hair red , their arms long and gangly , and they were gifted with strange powers like the ability to swell to giant size . Behind the Scenes .

title: Spring mastery
description: Spring mastery Spring mastery was a divine magic spell available to cleric s and druid s of Eldath , the Mother of the Waters . It could be used to create a spring , purify a spring , or teleport to another spring . Effects .

title: Springs of D ' onto Yeudo
description: Springs of D ' onto Yeudo The springs of D ' onto Yeudo was a mythical location said to lie on the island of Saishu , off the coast of Koryo in northeast Kara - Tur . The springs of D ' onto Yeudo were one of the local legends that Dan Zor , the former king and governor of Saishu , wished to investigate . By 1357 DR , he sought adventurers who could find the mythical springs for him .

title: Sprite ( classification )
description: Sprite ( classification ) Sprites were a grouping of fey races , consisting of grig s , nixie s and pixie s . Though sprites were generally reclusive , they were ready to combat ugliness and evil and defend their homes . In battle , they favored ambushes and tricks , and fought with their magic and their tiny weapons .

title: Sprite ( creature )
description: Sprite ( creature ) Sprites were the warrior relatives of pixie s . They were fierce defenders of good wherever they dwelt , and were also firm judges of other creatures ' hearts and intentions . Personality .

title: Spruce beer
description: Spruce beer Spruce beer was an alcohol ic beverage made from the spruce tree . Orlenstar Thirlthorn , a druid of Silvanus and caretaker of the God ' s Grove shrine in Wheloon , Cormyr , brewed his own spruce beer by 1358 DR . This was one of a number of factors that made the grove a popular spot for locals .

title: Spysong
description: Spysong Spysong was a scouting organization that collected information about threats to the kingdom of Damara for King Gareth Dragonsbane . Spysong operated in the Bloodstone Lands . Their primary mission was finding the location and the defenses of the Citadel of Assassins .

title: Squallocks
description: Squallocks Squallocks was a vrock advisor of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Maerimydra . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Squallocks was at the Undying Temple assisting Graz ' zt and the queen of Maerimydra Hledh Hellspawn in the ritual to permit Graz ' zt to resist to Vizeran DeVir ' s spell .

title: Squaring the circle
description: Squaring the circle Squaring the circle was an alteration spell that allowed a wizard to modify the shape of the effective area of other spells . Square or cubic areas could be changed to circular or spherical or vice - versa ; a square into a rectangle ; or a circle or sphere into an oval or egg shape . History .

title: Squatting toad
description: Squatting toad The squatting toad was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a toad . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .

title: Squch
description: Squch Squch was a scaladar and self - proclaimed leader of the mechanical entities that populate Trobriand ' s Graveyard . He was created by Trobriand as one of his " most intellectually stimulating experiments in this century " ( century not known ) . He aimed to break free from the graveyard and control the city of Waterdeep for himself .

title: Squeaking floors
description: Squeaking floors Squeaking floors was an evocation spell that caused a solid surface to emit loud squeaks whenever touched or tread upon . Effects . This spell could be cast on any flat surface .

title: Squealer
description: Squealer A squealer was a carnivorous creature with three arms that dwelled in forests and jungles . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Salabak created the illusion of a squealer to scary away the beggars of Memnon who were hanging around him , Vajra , and Conner .

title: Sree
description: Sree Sree was a Rashmeni Wychlaran who adopted the young daughter of Yaraella , a Witch believed to have committed suicide to end the troubling visions she received from the spirt world . In reality , Sree killed Yarealla because she refused to join the Wychlaren and so Sree could raise the young girl to become a powerful witch . Sree was killed by vengeful water spirits in 1480 DR during a Wychlaran circle ritual .

title: Srindin
description: Srindin Srindin was once an elven explorer in Anauroch . After a life of exploration and adventure across all the Realms , Srindin retired in the Anauroch , where he discovered a hidden fertile valley . He built a small castle where he lived as a hermit .

title: Srinshee
description: Srinshee The Srinshee ( born Oluevaera Estelda ) was one of the most famous baelnorn of all time . In her time she was many things : the Senior Cor ' Selu ' Taar ( Grand Mage of the High Mages of Cormanthor ) , leader of the Srinshinnar ( and thus her commonly known title ) , Wardnorn of the Vault of Ages , the Lorenorn for the armathors and was also High Court Mage of Myth Drannor for a time . She aided three Cormanthyran Coronals : Miirphys , Tannivh , and Eltargrim .

title: Srinshee ' s spell shift
description: Srinshee ' s spell shift Srinshee ' s spell shift was a mighty abjuration spell that let one manipulate a spell cast by another creature . Effects . This spell caused the caster to be able to perceive the Weave which allowed the caster to swiftly recognize and either counterspell or manipulate the spell being cast by another spellcaster .

title: Srivven
description: Srivven Srivven is a mage and along with Iraun , they are the self - proclaimed kings of Adaerglast . They originally came from easternmost Murghôm after a battle broke out in their school of magic between students and their masters . Before arriving in Adaerglast , Srivven and Iraun travelled Faerûn plundering mages ' tombs and seizing spells from living wizards .

title: Srossar
description: Srossar Srossar was a bronze dragon possessed by Tyranthraxus . History . Srossar was an ancient dragon .

title: Ss ' khanaja
description: Ss ' khanaja Ss ' khanaja was a city inhabited mainly by high - class naga and their staff , with some yuan - ti and lizardfolk making their homes in the Underdark passage that the city was built around . It was located in the Serpent Hills of Najara , in the west .

title: Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun
description: Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun Ss ' thar ' tiss ' ssun , or the City of Fountains , was once the capital city of the ancient serpent empire known as Najara . It was raised some 30 , 000 years before modern times by a powerful creator race called the Sarrukh . By the 14th century DR , however , the secretive empire of Najara or the Kingdom of Snakes was governed from Ss ' khanaja .

title: Sschindylryn
description: Sschindylryn Sschindylryn was situated miles below the King ’ s Forest of Cormyr . This drow city was a strong trading power in the Underdark but a minor military one , at best . History .

title: Sschindylryn ' s Gate
description: Sschindylryn ' s Gate Sschindylryn ' s Gate was a Toril - Oerth portal leading to Erelhei - Cinlu in Underdark . History . The portal was discovered by scouts from the city of Sschindylryn , a drow city under Cormyr known for its use of portals to explore and conquer other parts of the Underdark .

title: Sseelrigoth
description: Sseelrigoth Sseelrigoth was a blight wyrm from the Shadowfell . When Tchazzar was wounded by the spellplague and travelled through a rift between the Prime Material Plane and the Shadowfell , Sseelrigoth subdued and imprisoned him . Sseelrigoth fed from Tchazzar ' s essence for nearly 100 years until Jhesrhi Coldcreek rescued him from his imprisonment .

title: Ssendam
description: Ssendam Ssendam is the Slaad Lord of Madness . Description . Ssendam appears as a gigantic golden amoeba with a humanoid brain as a nucleus .

title: Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa
description: Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa Ssentenna Di ' Nastassa was a beautiful yuan - ti cleric of Sseth in Samarach in 1372 DR . Activities . Ssentenna was a yuan - ti from the Sauringar tribe who , under orders of the powerful undead jahi , managed the secret cabal of the Harim of the Jahi .

title: Ssessibil Istahvar
description: Ssessibil Istahvar Sssessibil Istahvar was a non - human archmage in the Savage Frontier . Activities . Ssessibil was an archmage not native to Toril living with a small entourage in the Lonely Tower .

title: Sseth
description: Sseth Sseth ( also known as Merrshaulk ) was the chief god of the reptilian yuan - ti , a chaotic evil mastermind of traps , poison , and murder . His clerics were known as " vrael olo " . His symbol was a flying snake with bared fangs .

title: Sshamath
description: Sshamath Sshamath or the City of Dark Weavings is a Drow city located in the Gauth Grottoes below the Far Hills . It has contacts in the Zhentarim citadel of Darkhold . History .

title: Sshumath Daerindra
description: Sshumath Daerindra Sshumath Daerindra was a drow half - deep dragon that roamed the Deep Wastes in the Underdark . Description . As a half - deep dragon , Sshumath ' s features were a distinctly draconic compared to other drow ; he had clawed hands and vicious fangs .

title: Ssibalentanamas
description: Ssibalentanamas Ssibalentanamas was the priest in charge of the yuan - ti breeding program that took place in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Emerald Scales in the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . He was also the First Consort of the ruler of Hlondeth , Dediana Extaminos . Activities .

title: Ssipriina Zauvirr
description: Ssipriina Zauvirr Ssipriina Zauvirr was the matron mother of House Zauvirr in Ched Nasad . History . In 1372 DR , Ssipriina led House Zauvirr in an attempt to defeat House Melarn .

title: Sssartisss
description: Sssartisss Sssartisss was a mixed poison distilled by the yuan - ti . Description . Sssartisss was a sticky , transparent liquid .

title: St . Amahl
description: St . Amahl St . Amahl was a saint of the god Ilmater .

title: St . Faelar ' s Cloisters
description: St . Faelar ' s Cloisters St . Faelar ' s Cloisters was a monastery of Ilmater in Calimshan , dedicated to St .

title: St . Liwan
description: St . Liwan St . Liwan was a saint of the Church of Ilmater and the patron of the House of St .

title: Staephon Gylesman
description: Staephon Gylesman Staephon Gylesman was a human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of the Lantern Inn and Boathouse by 1358 DR and still held the position in 1369 DR . Though he managed the inn , his more profitable service was , in fact , renting small boats and barges to patrons .

title: Staff
description: Staff A staff ( or stave ) is a pole - shaped implement used by various races as a walking stick or weapon and often has magical properties or abilities . The height of a staff is roughly the same as the height of the intended user and the diameter is such that it can be grasped comfortably in the hand . Some staves are tapered , becoming slightly narrower at the top .

title: Staff of devotion
description: Staff of devotion The staff of devotion was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .

title: Staff of entrapment
description: Staff of entrapment A staff of entrapment was a type of short brass staff originally made in Netheril and containing the " dimensional anchor " and " Otiluke ' s resilient sphere " spells . It was worth around 37 , 000 gold pieces if fully charged , but most were missing their charges when found .

title: Staff of eyes
description: Staff of eyes A staff of eyes was a spiralling staff with a large piece of amber at the top , and inlaid with silver . It contained the " arcane eye " , " remove blindness " and " see invisibility " spells . It was worth around 35 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of fiendish darkness
description: Staff of fiendish darkness A staff of fiendish darkness is a bone or ebony staff with a metal claw at one or both ends . They were used by the human s and drow serving demon s and devil s , and contain the " darkness " spell , and two each of the " animate dead " , " dispel magic " and " summon monster IX " spells . The last of these can only summon nightmare s .

title: Staff of flames
description: Staff of flames The staff of flames was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .

title: Staff of miracles
description: Staff of miracles A staff of miracles is made from white wood and adorned with the various deities worshipped in Myth Drannor . It contains the " heal " spell , and two each of the " holy aura " and " rosemantle " spells . It is worth around 77 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of night
description: Staff of night A staff of night is made from a dark wood covered in carvings of runes meaning stars , darkness and night . The wielder is granted immunity against the umber hulk ' s confusing gaze power . The staff contains the " darkness " , " darkvision " and " low - light vision " spells .

title: Staff of open doors
description: Staff of open doors A staff of open doors is a wooden staff covered in carvings of doors , some of which have decorative keyholes and some with iron bindings . The staff contains the " knock " , " open / close " , " password " and " shatter " spells . It is worth around 42 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of peace
description: Staff of peace A staff of peace is most often made from yew and contains the " calm emotions " , " hold person " , and " sanctuary " spells , all heightened to 6th level , and two of the " greater command " spell . If the wielder ' s patron is Eldath , he or she becomes quite the diplomat . The staff is worth around 175 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of power
description: Staff of power A staff of power was a powerful magical staff . Description . A " staff of power " was usually straight with a precious gem on top .

title: Staff of scrivening
description: Staff of scrivening The staff of scrivening originated in Myth Drannor and it is covered with symbols of quills and runes in many languages . It contains the " amanuensis " , " comprehend languages " , " erase " , and " read magic " spells , and two of the " suppress glyph " spell . It is worth around 54 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of skulls
description: Staff of skulls A staff of skulls was usually made from ebony with a carving of a skull at one end , but could also be made from a giant thigh bone with a real skull at the end . It contained the " animate dead " , " cure light wounds " and " inflict light wounds " spells , and two of the " circle of doom " spell . It was worth around 39 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of the Woodlands
description: Staff of the Woodlands The Staff of the Woodlands was a powerful , enchanted staff . History . It was once used by a man only known as the " Wild Man of the Wood " .

title: Staff of the World Pillars
description: Staff of the World Pillars The Staff of the World Pillars was a powerful magical staff carried by the Forgotten God . Powers . This staff combined all of the effects of a " ring of regeneration " , a " staff of withering " , and " chimes of interruption " .

title: Staff of the hulk
description: Staff of the hulk The staff of the hulk was a magical staff once possessed by Aumry , Lord of Shadowdale . It was made from twisted iron and a violet geode lay at the top , held by a claw . The staff can be used once per day to summon an umber hulk to do its wielder ' s bidding .

title: Staff of the magi
description: Staff of the magi The staff of the magi was a powerful magical artifact . Description . Generally , a " staff of the magi " was a long wooden staff encased in iron and inscribed with magical sigils and runes .

title: Staff of the sands
description: Staff of the sands The staff of the sands was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .

title: Staff of the sea
description: Staff of the sea Staves of the sea were magical staves that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These staves allowed a wizard to use the following powers : " cool strength " , " depth warning " , " converse with sea creatures " , " water blast " , and " waterbane " .

title: Staff of the winds
description: Staff of the winds The staff of the winds was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These magical items were available in a wide variety .

title: Staff of transportation
description: Staff of transportation A staff of transportation is a hollow wire staff with a mottled brown uncut gem at each end . It was originally made by a wizard named Whisper , and contains the " blink " and " dimension door " spells , and two of the " teleport " spell . It is worth around 68 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of vision
description: Staff of vision A staff of vision contained the " darkvision " , " remove blindness " and " see invisibility " spells , and two copies of the " true seeing " spell . Each time one of these was used , there was a chance that the caster would become mentally fatigued . It was worth around 43 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Staff of withering
description: Staff of withering A staff of withering was a magic al staff that could wither and age those it struck . Description . Imgig Zu ' s " staff of withering " was an 8 - foot - long ( 2 .

title: Stag - Horned Flagon
description: Stag - Horned Flagon The Stag - Horned Flagon tavern , the only only one located in Amphail , is run by Krivvin Shamblestar . The wood and stone bar is rather dark and cozy , whose clientele claims a wealth of Waterdhavian nobles . It is so named for the drinking cup , an unknown warrior ' s helmet with two antlers , which hangs over the bar .

title: Stag King
description: Stag King The Stag King was a dark fey lord who ruled part of Ashenwood forest in Rashemen . The Stag King was thousands of years old . Many centuries ago he agreed to aid a tribe of elves in exchange for the right to mate with three elven maidens .

title: Stag Skull Bridge
description: Stag Skull Bridge The Stag Skull Bridge was a bridge spanning the Thunder River in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . It led the way north out of town into the Hullack Forest . Defenses .

title: Stag at Bay
description: Stag at Bay The Stag at Bay was a tavern located near the Silver Moon Gate within Everlund . Patronage . The Stag tended to the needs of hunters and travelers of the region , as it provided them with a meeting area where they could boast about their adventures in the Savage Frontier .

title: Stagsmere
description: Stagsmere Stagsmere was a manor house near Waterdeep , located nine miles east of Rassalantar . By 1374 DR , the manor was ruined . Structure .

title: Stagwick
description: Stagwick Stagwick was a village in Hartsvale , notable for being the home of Tavis Burdun . Description . Stagwick was a small settlement with narrow streets and huts .

title: Stained glass golem
description: Stained glass golem The stained glass windows of a temple or stronghold does not only show of the wealth and grandeur of the group who lives there it might also be the hiding place of its hidden guardians . There constructed to blend in with the decor of the structure and most importantly to hide them from the eyes of unwanted visitors . Appearance .

title: Stamkk
description: Stamkk Stamkk was a male bugbear who ran the kitchen in the Coliseum of Maerimydra for Kurgoth Hellspawn . Description . A bugbear of some stature , Stamkk was armed with an array of cleavers and kitchen knives .

title: Standing bear
description: Standing bear The standing bear was a magical chalice carved in the shape of a bear . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Powers .

title: Standing deer
description: Standing deer The standing deer was a magical chalice . It was one of the Wo - ha Ui - jung , a collection of magical vessels created by the Han people of Koryo in ancient times . Description .

title: Stannis Malveen
description: Stannis Malveen Stannis Malveen was an aquatic vampire in Selgaunt . Relationships . Stannis was the heir of the Malveen house .

title: Stannoc
description: Stannoc Old Stannoc was a halfling in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Stannoc spent all his time inside the Yawning Portal inn .

title: Stannor Thistlehair
description: Stannor Thistlehair Stannor Thistlehair was a lightfoot halfling carpenter in Red Larch during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Stannor worked as a carpenter at Waelvur ' s Wagonworks .

title: Star Meadow Hall
description: Star Meadow Hall Star Meadow Hall is a tall white marble tower in the midst of the Star Meadow in Evereska , and is home of the Nihmedu family . Inside is airy and light , filled with smooth curves and softly glowing walls . A staircase swirls down from the upper floors into the foyer and leads into the lower house .

title: Star Mounts
description: Star Mounts The Star Mounts are an impressive and forbidding range of peaks , located in the center of the High Forest . Description . Some rumors told that , during the peaceful nights among the Star Mounts , strange flashing lights took place which would attract or send away dragon s and other flying creatures .

title: Star Protective Services
description: Star Protective Services The Star Protective Services , formerly known as the Company of the Star , was a band of adventurers that was led by Zaranda Star before she became queen of Tethyr . The band gained notoriety for their combat teachings . History .

title: Star Worm
description: Star Worm The Star Worm , also known as H ' Calos , is a unique creature that fell to Maztica in the city of Ixtzul in approximately 350 DR . The creature was originally encased in a metorite and was believed to be associated with the planet H ' Catha . Although the residents of Ixtzul claimed the Star Worm was their protector in order to intimidate other cities , in reality the worm was placed into a magical slumber to prevent it from devouring the city and the rest of Payit .

title: Star diopside
description: Star diopside Star diopside was the form of , a durable gemstone . Description . Diopside was a hard , durable gemstone that was usually found in unattractive colors , such as very dark green or brown .

title: Star elf
description: Star elf Star elves , or mithral elves or Ruar - tel - quessir as they used to be known , like sun elves have only recently ventured back into Faerûnian life . Long ago they retreated to the demiplanar realm of Sildëyuir , where they are currently under attack by an extraplanar threat . As a result , some are now returning to the Yuirwood .

title: Star metal
description: Star metal Star metal was the name in the Realms for a metallic . Description . Star metal was the leftover material from the impact of an object fallen from space .

title: Star of Ojy - do
description: Star of Ojy - do A star of Ojy - do was a magical shuriken forged by Ojy of Golden in Koryo in Kara - Tur . Description . Two distinct versions of the " stars of Ojy - do " were recorded ; one three hooked blades around a circular center and the other had four blades joined at the center .

title: Star rose quartz
description: Star rose quartz Star rose quartz was a smoky pink quartz which had an . Description . When cut cabochon , star rose quartz reflected or transmitted light in a star - like pattern .

title: Star ruby
description: Star ruby Star Ruby was a rare form of red corundum that exhibited . Description . Star rubies were more opaque than regular gem - quality rubies and had a reflective optical effect that highlighted a white six - pointed star on the surface of cabochon - cut stones .

title: Star sapphire
description: Star sapphire Star Sapphire was a very rare form of sapphire that exhibited . Description . Asterism is a reflective optical effect that highlights a white six - pointed star on the surface of cabochon - cut stones .

title: Stardeep
description: Stardeep Stardeep was a small dungeon complex sited in a small demiplane in the Ethereal Plane in a tenuous pocket near Sildëyuir . Stardeep was linked to Faerûn by a portal called the Causeway , appearing as a stone bridge over the Mere river , a tributary of the Chubala River . History .

title: Stargazer
description: Stargazer The Stargazer refers to a female elf who , thousands of years ago , picked up One Thousand Broken Dreams after the death of Datharian Mistwatcher and used it to slay hundreds of drow . Her true identity is not known . She died of grief over the death of her sister , after the Battle of Nine Arrows .

title: Starleaf
description: Starleaf Starleaf was a Wild elf and High Mage of enormous power . She served as center in a high magic ritual , known as the First Sundering . Her role was revealed to the elves by a gathering of elven priests , who got her role revealed from the Seldarine .

title: Starless Night
description: Starless Night Starless Night is the second book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Starling house
description: Starling house Starling house was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It was inhabited by the Starling family . Location .

title: Starmantle
description: Starmantle Starmantle was a small city located on the Dragon Coast . It was one of Westgate ' s main rivals for trade across the Sea of Fallen Stars . History .

title: Starry Gnosis
description: Starry Gnosis The Starry Gnosis was a minor artifact of Shadow Weave magic imbued by the goddess Shar with powers of mental domination . Purported to be a relic of the goddess Mystra instead , it was used to abduct petitioners at the false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Description .

title: Starspire
description: Starspire The Starspire was a large peak in northern Melabrauth . Background . The Starspire was so large that its peak reached the sky .

title: Starspire Mountains
description: Starspire Mountains The Starspire Mountains were a range of low mountains in Tethyr . Geography . The Starspires began gradually in the highlands of eastern Tethyr and ran from east to west .

title: Starspur
description: Starspur Starspur was the county of Tethyr encompassing the Starspire Peninsula . It was known for the city of Zazesspur , the sometime capital of that kingdom . Description .

title: Starwater River
description: Starwater River The Starwater River was a river in Cormyr . It flowed south from the Storm Horns mountain range , through the King ' s Forest , to the Dragonmere . The city of Marsember was situated on the western bank of the mouth of the river .

title: Starym
description: Starym House Starym was an ultraconservative and powerful elven noble family that once inhabited the city of Cormanthor ( later Myth Drannor ) in the elven empire of Cormanthyr . Comprised chiefly of Gold elves but with some Moon elves as well , they became discontent when Coronal Eltargrim Irithyl allowed races such as gnomes , halflings and dwarves to inhabit the city . Their reputation as a trusted influential house was destroyed after they attacked the Elven Court , subsequently most of the gold elves emigrated from Myth Drannor .

title: Stasis sphere
description: Stasis sphere The stasis sphere was a magical item . When touched by its owner and commanded , one nearby creature could be placed in " temporal stasis " and confined inside the sphere , similar to the " imprisonment " spell . Description .

title: Statue
description: Statue Statue was an arcane alteration spell that changed the recipient together with anything worn to stone , but kept their faculties and senses intact . In older versions the magical transformation carried a certain risk of immediate death , but if successfull , all versions allowed the affected person or creature to hide in plains sight as a statue , with all the resiliency of stone . The recipient could turn back to their normal form at will .

title: Statue of Mystra
description: Statue of Mystra The statue of Mystra was a magical statue of the goddess Mystra standing in the Stoneyard of the false Temple of Mystra in Wheloon in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . History . To aid in their deception , the false priests of the temple bought up a large quantity of religious paraphernalia , but chose to destroy much of what they did not need or found to be against the faith of Shar .

title: Status
description: Status Status is a divination spell that allows one to monitor the position and condition of one ' s allies . Effect . When a cleric needs to keep track of comrades that may get separated , " status " allows him to mentally monitor their relative position and general condition .

title: Staunt Pools
description: Staunt Pools The Staunt Pools referred to a succession of deep holes located in the River Rauvin to the west of Jalanthar . Description . The pools were the lair of a freshwater giant squid .

title: Steaming Isles
description: Steaming Isles The Steaming Isles , located in the southeast of Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea , were very unusual . Unexplored by denizens of the mainland , these islands , shrouded in mist and covered in sub - tropical forest , were inhabited and ruled by intelligent , talking animals . Geography .

title: Stedd Whitehorn
description: Stedd Whitehorn Stedd Whitehorn was a young boy Chosen and prophet of Lathander during the Second Sundering . History . Stedd was chosen by the god Lathander to announce his return to the people of the Realms .

title: Steel dragon
description: Steel dragon Steel dragons , sometimes known as Waterdeep dragons , were metallic dragon s who were rarely seen in their natural form , instead living clandestine lives in human cities , observing art , culture , history , and politics . Description . Steel dragons in their natural forms were especially feline in their movements and stature .

title: Steeping Falls
description: Steeping Falls Steeping Falls was an ancient barony that encompassed the lands surrounding modern - day Daggerford . History . Founded by the Shoon outlaw , Artor Morlin in 133 DR , the barony was located just to the west of Athalantar but between the Realm of the Stag and Halangorn Forest on the north bank of the Delimbiyr .

title: Steersissk
description: Steersissk Steersissk was a lizardfolk in the Vast Swamp in 1374 DR . History . Stersissk was a warrior of the Sharptooth tribe .

title: Stegosaurus
description: Stegosaurus A stegosaurus was a gargantuan , herbivorous , herd dinosaur found in Chult . Description . These dinosaurs were immense and had many defenses to protect them from their many predators .

title: Stellaga Brightstar
description: Stellaga Brightstar Mornmaster Stellaga Brightstar is the soft - spoken and diplomatic high priestess of the Morning temple in Archenbridge . Dedicated to her work , Stellaga encourages growth among the Arkhenfolk while taking little time to indulge in her more secret indulgences . These include dancing , adventuring and becoming romantic with people from far away .

title: Stellephosa
description: Stellephosa Lady Stellephosa was a paladin of Kelemvor in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , she went into Undermountain after hearing rumors of undead activities there .

title: Stelwyn Russlewood
description: Stelwyn Russlewood Stelwyn Russlewood was a female human cleric of Iyachtu Xvim and an agent of Zhentil Keep based in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Personality . Stelwyn was forthright in speech and tended to be destructive .

title: Stephan
description: Stephan Stephan was the innkeeper of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR . Activities . Stephan managed the Inn of the Clowns with his barmaids , Racquel and Carlotta .

title: Steploe Nestletoe
description: Steploe Nestletoe Steploe Nestletoe was a halfling member of the Cellarers ' & Plumbers ' Guild in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , he was with his crew in the city ' s sewers when their lights suddenly went dark and he was struck on the head .

title: Steps of Istishia
description: Steps of Istishia The Steps of Istishia was the most impressive structure within the city of Keltar . This monolithic shrine to the Water Lord was built thousands of years before the 14th century DR . Water from the Calim River was diverted by sluice gate and pumped to the top of the structure by hidden screw pumps .

title: Steve Kurtz
description: Steve Kurtz Steve Kurtz is an author and game designer who has written for TSR , Inc . , with several works published in the Al - Qadim setting . Background .

title: Steve Miller
description: Steve Miller Steve Miller is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . Education .

title: Steve Winter
description: Steve Winter Steve Winter is a game designer who has worked for TSR , Inc . and Wizards of the Coast . Education .

title: Steven E . Schend
description: Steven E . Schend Steven E . Schend is a fantasy writer and game designer .

title: Sticks to snakes
description: Sticks to snakes Sticks to snakes was an alteration spell that turned appropriate non - magical wooden items into snakes for a few minutes . The reverse of this spell , snakes to sticks countered " sticks to snakes " or turned ordinary - sized snakes temporarily into sticks . Effects .

title: Stig
description: Stig Stig was a male human fighter and a bouncer at the tavern called The Furniture ' s Fate in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . He was very strong . When brawls broken out , Boffo the tavern owner often had Stig lift him up and hurl the gnome into the fray .

title: Stiletto
description: Stiletto A stiletto , also known as a stylet is a slender dagger used for piercing leather and plated armor , and mail such as chain mail . Description . The slim blade of a stiletto is triangle or square in shape and ends in a sharp point .

title: Still Waters
description: Still Waters Still Waters was an inn located in the eastern part of the village of Elmwood on the southern side of the Moonsea . Structure . It was a two - story building run by master brewer , Enrad Daleborn , a friendly man whose was sought after in the area and a favorite of the River Lis ferry crewmen .

title: Stilmus
description: Stilmus Stilmus was a mercenary in Chessenta and the leader of the Society of the Sword . Personality . Stilmus was obsessed with honor and he never broke his word .

title: Stinking cloud
description: Stinking cloud Stinking cloud , originally called Tolodine ' s stinking cloud , was a conjuration spell that created a cloud bank of nauseating vapors . Moon - horse s of Evermeet often used this spell . Effects .

title: Stirge
description: Stirge A stirge is a tiny magical beast that feeds on the blood of other creatures . A group of stirges is known as a " thirst " . Stirges have been known to be used as familiar s .

title: Stival Chergoba
description: Stival Chergoba Stival Chergoba was a warrior of Sossal during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Stival was a commander in the contingent led by Madislak Pemsk during the war against the Ice Witch Iyraclea and the white dragon dracolich Zethrindor .

title: Stojanow
description: Stojanow The Stojanow river began high in the Dragonspine Mountains and flowed south into the Moonsea . There was fertile ground along this river allowing for farming of some grains and hardy vegetables . To the west of the river was the Grass Sea .

title: Stokely Silverstream
description: Stokely Silverstream Stokely Silverstream was the leader of the dwarven Clan Battlehammer that dwelt in Kelvin ' s Cairn in Icewind Dale . History . In his position as leader of the Clan Battlehammer dwarves , Stokely sometimes met with various humans , including Darby Snide , at a tavern in Bremen .

title: Stolvor
description: Stolvor Stolvor was a fire giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Stolvor with his hell hound went in search of pieces of the Vonindod near the Stone Bridge ; however , secretly he was simply in search of a good fight .

title: Stone Bridge
description: Stone Bridge Stone Bridge was a bridge located along the River Dessarin , connecting the Red Larch and the Long Road to the High Forest . The bridge , which was also a temple to Moradin , was a single arch , 3 . 2km ( two miles ) in length and 122m ( 400ft ) high , made of granite , roughly six paces wide , with no railings or barriers .

title: Stone Guard
description: Stone Guard The Stone Guard was a military corp in Gracklstugh . They served Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V as bodyguards , elite troops , and secret police . History .

title: Stone Stand
description: Stone Stand The Stone Stand was a stone circle in the High Forest in the Silver Marches . It contained a large oak tree , grown from a cutting from the Grandfather Tree . The site was sacred to the Tree Ghost tribe .

title: Stone flyer
description: Stone flyer Stone flyers were magical beast s which hunted prey deep in the Underdark . Description . These creatures looked like wolves with large wings .

title: Stone fountain
description: Stone fountain Stone fountain was a powerful arcane spell that could not just knock over stone towers and walls , but also lift and hurl them too . Effects . " Stone fountain " was a variant spell of " towerfall " , which quite simply lifted and knocked over huge stone structures , like castle towers , bridges , and city walls .

title: Stone giant
description: Stone giant A stone giant was a type of giant . Description . Adult stone giants averaged about 18 feet in height and weighed 1 , 700 pounds .

title: Stone golem
description: Stone golem Stone golems were constructed from either a single piece of carefully - chiseled stone or from a collection of specially - fitted stone blocks . The most elegant stone golems were used as both guardians and art pieces in a magical building . They appeared to be beautiful statues until commanded by their master to move and act .

title: Stone hull
description: Stone hull Stone hull was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell strengthened a ship ' s hull with a magical aura , helping it withstand attacks from sea monsters , hidden reefs , or bombardment .

title: Stone maiden
description: Stone maiden Stone maidens were beautiful damsels who dwelt in standing stones , rock formations , and secluded cavern walls in Zakhara . Description . These women appeared to be elven or human and wore simple , loose - fitting clothing .

title: Stone of Tymora
description: Stone of Tymora The Stone of Tymora was an artifact sacred to the goddess of good fortune , Tymora . The stone bound itself to the soul of a creature of its own choosing , usually someone who was already naturally lucky . When the stone was in close proximity to the one it had chosen , that mortal could perform feats of extraordinary luck , such as taking a leap off of a tall building in a city , only to hit every piece of laundry out to dry on the way down , and then conveniently to land on something reasonably soft , thereby turning a certainly lethal fall into a mildly painful bump .

title: Stone of Tymora ( omnibus )
description: Stone of Tymora ( omnibus ) Stone of Tymora was the published omnibus of the Stone of Tymora trilogy by Geno Salvatore and R . A . Salvatore .

title: Stone of Tymora trilogy
description: Stone of Tymora trilogy The Stone of Tymora trilogy is a trilogy of novels by R . A . Salvatore and his son Geno Salvatore intended for younger readers and published by Mirrorstone .

title: Stone shape
description: Stone shape Stone shape was a transmutation spell or alteration spell that reshaped stone objects . Effects . Fine detail was not possible , but natural or worked stone could be manipulated by means of this spell to form most any shape the caster desired — an arch , a statue , a door , or a wall with a hole in it , for example .

title: Stone sphere
description: Stone sphere Stone sphere is an evocation spell that conjures a spherical stone that can crush enemies . Effect . You create a smoothly polished , 5 - foot - diameter sphere of stone that moves under your control at a speed of 30 feet .

title: Stone spiders
description: Stone spiders Stone spiders was a transmutation spell unique to cleric s who commanded the Spider domain . It turned pebbles into enormous spider s , or gave insectoid vermin carapaces of stone . Effect .

title: Stone sword
description: Stone sword The stone sword was a unique weapon that could be found within the Rainbow Monastery in the Hordelands . History . The stone sword was ancient , forged long ago during a period of conflict in Solon ' s history .

title: Stone tell
description: Stone tell Stone tell was a divination spell that allowed the caster to speak with stones . Effects . This spell operated on any type of stone or rock , natural or worked .

title: Stone walk
description: Stone walk Stone walk is a transmutation spell unique to Banite cleric s . It creates what is effectively a portal between one stone area and another . Effect .

title: Stonecliff
description: Stonecliff The Stonecliff was a perilous , rocky , craggy limestone escarpment that formed a natural wall along the north side of The High Road . The Eveningstar Gorge or Starwater Gorge along the Starwater River was the only route that mount s and livestock couldn take up or down the Stonecliff . Rumors .

title: Stonefire
description: Stonefire Stonefire was a liquid material that could burn nearly any material , including stone . Stonefire bombs , called firepots , could be lobbed at structures and enemies to cause great damage . History .

title: Stonekiller
description: Stonekiller Stonekiller was a dwarf adventurer in Maztica . History . Stonekiller was going about his business when he was snatched by a cadre of riders and dragged back to Ulatos .

title: Stonelands
description: Stonelands The Stonelands was a rocky and hilly region of terrain north of the Storm Horns mountain range , to the north of Cormyr . Politics . Although Cormyr claimed this land as part of its territory , it could not control it beyond where its soldiers marched .

title: Stoneplague
description: Stoneplague The Stoneplague was a disease that began afflicting dwarves in the East Rift region of Faerûn in 1480 DR . History . At first , it was feared the disease was spread person - to - person .

title: Stoner ' s Needle
description: Stoner ' s Needle Stoner ' s Needle , also called Needle Rock , was a rocky spire in the Sword Coast lands . History . The extraplanar monster Imgig Zu placed a Lockstone with a frozen greater basilisk as guardian on the summit of Stoner ' s Needle .

title: Stoneskin
description: Stoneskin Stoneskin was an abjuration spell that turned a subject ' s skin stony in order to block blows , cuts , stabs , and slashes . Effects . The target creature felt a brief tingling sensation before their skin , clothes , and hair took on a gray , stone - like appearance .

title: Stonesmith Hammerhand
description: Stonesmith Hammerhand Stonesmith Hammerhand was a dwarf noble and commander of the city guard of the city of Orvyltar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR . Stonesmith was one of the few dwarven nobles in the kingdom . Stonesmith commanded 500 men - at - arms and three cavalry troops , as well as the city ' s defenses .

title: Stonesulder wine
description: Stonesulder wine Stonesulder wine took its name from the merchant Arlast Stonesulder who popularized its use . This wine was produced by crushing berries and vines found in the Abyss . It was yellow in color and had a sharp flavor .

title: Stool
description: Stool Stool was a myconid sprout living in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Stool lived in Neverlight Grove with all its people .

title: Storm ' s Front Tavern
description: Storm ' s Front Tavern The Storm ' s Front Tavern was a tavern in Waterdeep ' s Sea Ward . Structure . The tavern was decorated with a nautical theme so it looked like a faux Dock Ward tavern .

title: Storm Horns
description: Storm Horns The Storm Horns was the name given to the mountains that marked the western and northern frontier of Cormyr . They were wild and untamed , the cliffs and crags teeming with monsters . Geography .

title: Storm King
description: Storm King The Storm King was the most valuable warlord of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR , and served as the Lotus Emperor ' s right hand . Activities . The Storm King acted as the Emperor ' s adviser , general , and executioner , and was even a potential successor to the throne .

title: Storm King ' s Thunder
description: Storm King ' s Thunder Storm King ' s Thunder is a 5th - edition Dungeons & Dragons adventure set in the Savage Frontier region of the Forgotten Realms . It takes four to six characters from levels 1 – 5 up through level 10 . This adventure takes place after the events described in " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " and " The Rise of Tiamat " , but does not directly depend on them .

title: Storm Rune
description: Storm Rune The Storm Rune was a merchant cabal that operated in the city of Stormhelm in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . Members of the Storm Rune , merchants and landlords who met in secret and kept their identities hidden from the lower - ranking members , worked together to increase their wealth and status in Eskornar society , by manipulating the knights of Eskorn , making king ' s edicts or the knights seem tyrannical to the common people , and by slowly shaping popular beliefs .

title: Storm Silverhand
description: Storm Silverhand Storm Silverhand , called " The Bard of Shadowdale " , was one of the Seven Sisters and a Chosen of Mystra . Appearance . Storm was 6 feet , 2 inches tall and kept the silver hair she shared with her sisters so long that it came down to her knees .

title: Storm Which Destroys
description: Storm Which Destroys The Storm Which Destroys was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara comprised mostly of fanatical moralist s . The symbol of the Storm Which Destroys was an obsidian blade . Activities .

title: Storm armor of the earth ' s children
description: Storm armor of the earth ' s children Storm armor of the earth ' s children is a suit of magic full plate armor and grants the wearer resistance against cold , electricity and fire . Although magic armor usually broadly resizes to fit its wearer , this armor will only resize to fit dwarves , gnome s or halfling s . It will fetch in excess of 110 , 000 gold pieces .

title: Storm bell
description: Storm bell Storm bells , also called storm gongs , were easily the largest musical instruments throughout Zakhara . Description . These massive metal cylinders and plates were struck with large pieces of wood wrapped in protective cloth .

title: Storm dragon
description: Storm dragon Storm dragons were a type of dragon . Description . Storm dragons had snake - like bodies with deep purple scales and broad wings .

title: Storm giant
description: Storm giant Storm giants were extremely intelligent giant s who lived on cloud islands . Their vision was adapted to underwater conditions , where they saw equally as well as they did in the air . They spoke Jotunuvar and Jotun .

title: Storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain
description: Storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain The storm giant aerie of Lake Woe mountain was the home of a small tribe of storm giant s who played a significant role in the War of the Hart . Description . The aerie was located at the summit of Lake Woe mountain , which itself grew out of the center of Lake Woe .

title: Storm of the Dead
description: Storm of the Dead Storm of the Dead is the second book in the Lady Penitent trilogy by Lisa Smedman . Summary . Storm of the Dead follows up the events of the " Sacrifice of the Widow " , with the diffusion of Vhaeraun ' s cleric s with Eilistraee ’ s priestesses due to the death of Vhaeraun at the hands of Eilistraee .

title: Storm of vengeance
description: Storm of vengeance Storm of vengeance is a conjuration spell that calls a vicious thunderstorm that rains acid , thunder , and hail . Effect . This spell creates an enormous black storm cloud .

title: Storm rider ' s pearl
description: Storm rider ' s pearl The storm rider ' s pearl was a marid item used by the Great Padisha of the Marid . Storm Rider ' s Pearl . The " storm rider ' s pearl " was similar to the " traveler ' s pearl s " but also allowed the Padisha to alter wind , summon storms , and to change the tides .

title: Storm shield
description: Storm shield Storm shield was an abjuration spell that absorbed electric effects that passed close by . Effects . This spell created an amber colored ball of glowing light at target chosen by the caster .

title: Storm star
description: Storm star A storm star is a magical morning star of ancient design , thought to have originally been devised in Netheril . Many variants of the weapon exist , with most being cast in electrum - plated steel . They are among the longest and heaviest of morning stars .

title: Storm walk
description: Storm walk Storm walk is a spell of the evocation school used by sorcerer s , most often those with a taste for the entropic forces of wild magic . " Storm walk " , when cast , makes each step of the sorcerer for a brief , momentary stride of five feet impact the ground with a thunderous clap , injuring a creature of the sorcerer ' s choice fifty feet or less away from their original location . The spell ' s power is determined by the sorcerer ' s charisma , as well as the sorcerer ' s degree of experience .

title: Stormazîn
description: Stormazîn The stormazîn was the high priest of Annam All - Father for all giant tribes , acting as a spiritual father for all giant priests of all giant deities . Selection . A " stormazîn " was the Great Priest of Annam for life ; a new " stormazîn " was elected by all of the giant tribes upon the death of the previous holder of the title .

title: Stormblades
description: Stormblades The Stormblades were an adventuring company from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . History . The Stormblades were based in the city of Tsurlagol , but had come to Harrowdale in the Dalelands by 1370 DR .

title: Stormcloak
description: Stormcloak Stormcloak was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Sea Queen . It protected an individual from death by storm at sea when activated . Effects .

title: Stormgale
description: Stormgale Stormgale was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . In 1491 DR , Stormgale led two plots to access the elemental node under the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .

title: Stormhelm
description: Stormhelm Stormhelm was the capital and the only proper city of the kingdom of Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Government . As of 1479 DR , Stormhelm was ruled by King Ornan Roaryl .

title: Stormkeep
description: Stormkeep Stormkeep was a tower located in the Fallen Lands in the Savage Frontier . Description . The tower had the shape of a sharp fang .

title: Stormsoul genasi
description: Stormsoul genasi Stormsoul genasi , were one of five common subraces or " manifestations " within the genasi race . Like all genasi manifestations , they could be manifested by experienced genasi who had a different primary manifestation but had trained themselves otherwise , or have acquired the manifestation as a result of hidden ancestry or environmental conditions . Description .

title: Stormwarden
description: Stormwarden Stormwardens are two - blade ranger s trained in an ancient fey tradition . Stormwardens are charged with the defense of the natural world , whether it be the Feywild or the Prime , twirling their dual weapons into a tempestuous assault that threatens to slay all who bring harm to the wild . Abilities .

title: Storvald
description: Storvald Jarl Storvald was the ruler of the frost giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Storvald was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Straits of Koryo
description: Straits of Koryo The Straits of Koryo were the channels of water lying between the Koryo Peninsula and the island of Saishu and the other small islands between them . Tides . The Straits of Koryo were famed for their huge tidal ranges and speeds : the water could rise a distance of 30 feet ( 9 .

title: Strange Bedfellows
description: Strange Bedfellows The Zhentarim are indeed about to attack Loudwater . They have allied with a group of devil s and a surviving member of the Calishite Rensha family who used to rule over Loudwater . Otar , the Green Regent is leading an expedition to Silverymoon to see if he can gather allies to help defend against the upcoming attack .

title: Strasus Thingoleir
description: Strasus Thingoleir Strasus Thingoleir , nicknamed the " Bold " , was a talented archmage and adventurer living in Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Personality . Strasus was a dour old man with a bushy beard .

title: Strategic charge
description: Strategic charge Strategic charge was an abjuration spell that let one dodge blows better while armored . Originally , it was unique to blackguard s and paladin s of the Red Knight , but other lawful orders eventually adopted this spell . Effects .

title: Streams of Silver
description: Streams of Silver Streams of Silver is the second book in the Icewind Dale trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Street of Lances
description: Street of Lances The Street of Lances was a street in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Geography . The road was located at the very north of the ward just south of the Trolltower and intersected with the Street of the Singing Dolphin .

title: Street of Ser - Ukcal
description: Street of Ser - Ukcal The Street of Ser - Ukcal was a road in Myth Nantar leading south from the Fire Fountain at the city ' s centre , to the South Gate at its edge , and was the usual point of entry to the city for most visitors . It was paved with white stones , and had many arches overhead , which , as of 1369 DR , made it tricky to negotiate .

title: Street of Steel
description: Street of Steel The Street of Steel was a prominent avenue located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . This street was found within Keffinspires . Activity .

title: Street of Stelae
description: Street of Stelae The Street of Stelae was a prominent avenue located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire in 1367 DR . Activity . This street was one of the main avenues of the city , running west from the Charcoal Palace in the Pyraculum to the harbors .

title: Street of the Ajami
description: Street of the Ajami The Street of the Ajami , or Ajami Street , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Street of the Ajami was adjacent to the Caravan Boulevard , branching off to head northwest to exit Huzuz near the Caliph ' s Harbor where it met the River Road .

title: Street of the Inns
description: Street of the Inns The Street of the Inns was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . The Street of the Inns branched off of the Pilgrims ' Route to head directly north into the vast courtyard that housed the Golden Mosque and the Palace of the Enlightened Throne .

title: Street of the Last Houses
description: Street of the Last Houses The Street of the Last Houses , also referred to as the Boneyard by the lower classes , was a necropolis located in the City of Brass in 1367 DR . The Street of the Last Houses was found in the Plume ward of the city . Activities .

title: Street of the Learned
description: Street of the Learned The Street of the Learned , or the University Road , was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . This street was so named because it provided the most direct route for students commuting to the ferries that crossed Al - Sarif River to the great university , Al - Bidir Sallah .

title: Strengthen water creature
description: Strengthen water creature Strengthen water creature was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell increased the physical capabilities of creatures that lived in water , breathed water , or were from the Elemental Plane of Water .

title: Stretch spell
description: Stretch spell Stretch spell was a spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training . " Stretch spell " allowed sorcerers to bend the fabric of space to extend the reach of their spells , for a moment , by a number of feet dependent upon their natural agility and reflexes . " Stretch spell " was somewhat easy to cast , taking only an instant to use , and could be cast again after a rest of a few minutes .

title: Striders
description: Striders The Striders , also called the Newts , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Striders were a well - disciplined cavalry consisting of firenewt s .

title: Striding Giant Rapids
description: Striding Giant Rapids The Striding Giant Rapids was the name for a sections of rapids located around a petrified giant in the middle of the River Rauvin , just downriver from Everlund . Geography . Striding Giant Rapids was located just out of sight and to the west of Everlund in the Rauvin Vale .

title: Strife domain
description: Strife domain The Strife domain was a deity domain that granted strife - related powers to divine spellcasters . They could inflict more damage on a foe in a group when using certain powers , or sow doubt in two enemies , hindering their combat ability . Deities with the Strife domain .

title: Striking wave
description: Striking wave Striking wave was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Bitch Queen . It created a large wave in a body of water that could be directed by the caster and heavily damage or destroy creatures , objects , vessels , and structures . Effects .

title: Strog Thunderblade
description: Strog Thunderblade Strog Thunderblade was the military leader of Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Strog was the leader of the military force of Goldenfields .

title: Strogue Sstar
description: Strogue Sstar Strogue Sstar was a dwarf ruler in the Frozenfar . Personality . Unlike most dwarves , Strogue had no fear of magic .

title: Strohm I
description: Strohm I King Strohm I was the first king of Tethyr after the fall of the Shoon Imperium , having slain the Imperium ' s last emperor Amahl Shoon VII . Description . Strohm I was born with only a single arm , but this did not stop him from becoming a powerful warrior .

title: Strohm II
description: Strohm II King Strohm II was a half - elven ruler of Tethyr , the second king of the Strohm Dynasty . He was also the founder of the town of Mosstone . Description .

title: Strohm III
description: Strohm III King Strohm III was a king of Tethyr . He was perhaps most famous for an epic battle he waged against the drow in the Marching Mountains . Description .

title: Strohm IV
description: Strohm IV King Strohm IV was a king of Tethyr . He was famous for winning the Battle of Brinniq Dell . Description .

title: Strongheart halfling
description: Strongheart halfling The strongheart halflings were , like the ghostwise and lightfoot hin , native to Luiren . They traced their ancestry back to the same long - lost days as the other subraces , but unlike their cousins , the stronghearts elected to remain in their homeland following the events of the Hin Ghostwar .
