The legacy of Chand , the strong - heart war chieftain who galvanized his tribe against the threat of the feral ghostwise , lived on in a nation that both reinforced and defied many of the expectations non - halflings had of this race .

title: Stronghold of the Nine
description: Stronghold of the Nine The Stronghold of the Nine was an underground cavern complex on the banks of the Unicorn Run . History . Originally a dwarven hold , it was abandoned and fell into ruin until The Nine rediscovered and renovated it .

title: Stronk
description: Stronk Stronk was a fomorian living in the Wormwrithings during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Stronk somehow formed a bond with the purple worm s .

title: Stronmaus
description: Stronmaus Stronmaus ( " strawn " - mawz ) is the giant deity of the Sun , Sky , Weather , Seas , and Joy . His symbol is a forked lightning bolt descending from a cloud that partly obscures the sun . Description .

title: Studded leather
description: Studded leather Studded leather armor ( also known as brigandine ) was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Studded leather was made from tough but flexible leather .

title: Student of the Seven
description: Student of the Seven A student of the Seven is a bard who has learned to embrace the versatility of his or her training , extending it further to a point where the bard is less a specialized arcane spellcaster and more a jack - of - all - trades . Students of the Seven , who take their inspiration from a semi - mythical band of seven known for their variety and lack of a confirmed identity , learn from all venues of life and consider no knowledge beyond them . In increasing their own versatility , a student of the Seven often learn to make others better at what they do as well .

title: Studious Mamluk Society
description: Studious Mamluk Society The Studious Mamluk Society , also known as the Studious , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . Contrary to most of the mamluk organizations in Zakhara , the Studious focused on espionage and communication .

title: Stump Bog
description: Stump Bog The Stump Bog was a swamp to the east of the hamlet of Rassalantar . Geography . The foul swamp was located just south of Goldenfields , and its waters were fed from the River Dessarin .

title: Stumpet Rakingclaw
description: Stumpet Rakingclaw Stumpet Rakingclaw was a dwarven cleric from Mithral Hall . Description . She was a fiery dwarf with a short red beard .

title: Stun dart
description: Stun dart A stun dart is a hollow dart that contains poison . When it impacts , it pierces and also releases a puff of poison gas that can stun an opponent for up to five minutes . Stun darts cost 40 gp each and weigh around 1 lb ( 450 g ) .

title: Stuyles
description: Stuyles Stuyles was a farmer who owned land near Luskan . However , he was driven off of his land by the policies of the High Captains of Luskan . Thus Stuyles and many of his fellows became bandits assaulting the caravans of Luskan .

title: Styx
description: Styx The river Styx ( frequently River Styx ) linked the topmost layers of the Lower Planes . The Styx did not extend into the Astral Plane but portals existed along its banks . The seven lower planes , as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model , were Acheron , the Nine Hells , Gehenna , Hades , Tarterus , the Abyss , and Pandemonium .

title: Su ' un
description: Su ' un Su ' un was an island south of the large island of Saishu , off the coast of the Koryo Peninsula in northeast Kara - Tur . Description . It was a desert island , a bleak place of sand and jagged rocks with constant wind .

title: Su - monster
description: Su - monster Su - monsters were evil primate - like creatures with innate psionic abilities . They could be found in the Snowflake Mountains as of 1361 DR , and were prevalent on the Yadd al - Djinni islands of Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea in the same period . Description .

title: Su - to
description: Su - to Su - to was a samurai ghost actor in the Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Around 1148 DR , Su - to was the greatest noh actor and dramatist of Wa .

title: Su Po
description: Su Po Su Po was a member of the Society of the Purple Lotus in Shou Lung . History . As with all members of the Society of the Purple Lotus , Su Po wished to destroy the Mandarinate that ruled Shou Lung .

title: Substitution level
description: Substitution level Substitution levels are unusual talents developed by some people in Realmspace . Each is specific to a given character class . Often they are linked to a specific race , or a particular personal background .

title: Succubus
description: Succubus Of the many demons that exist in the universe , Succubi are most often encountered in the mortal world . This is due to their extraordinary beauty and carnal desires ; traits that attract mortal spellcasters to summon the demoness forth to use for their own debased desire . Succubi delight in causing suffering by manipulating the desires of mortals and tempting them into depraved acts that they would normally avoid .

title: Sudai Calin
description: Sudai Calin Sudai Calin lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Sudai was a dwarven sha ' ir and instructor for Adnan al - Raqi ' s students .

title: Suelivain
description: Suelivain Suelivain was a male shade from Thultanthar . He was the leader of Demarch ' s Folly , an organization dedicated to learning shadow magic . Abilities .

title: Suggestion
description: Suggestion Suggestion was an enchantment spell used to compel a subject to follow the caster ' s orders , but only if they could understand the caster ' s spoken language . Effects . With this spell the caster influenced the subject through verbal suggestions .

title: Suha
description: Suha Suha was a noble dao and slave of the Unspeakable in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Suha remained at the Unspeakable ' s side at all times under a guise of " invisibility " while the yikarian was in control of Mu ' izzi al - Kamar ' s body .

title: Suhail
description: Suhail Suhail was a female marid who served the notorious sha ' ir Adnan al - Raqi in 1367 DR . Activities . Suhail was tied to a " ring of genie summoning " owned by Adnan .

title: Suhailah al - Hawai
description: Suhailah al - Hawai Suhailah al - Hawai was a minor member of the Corsair Council of Hawa . Description . Suhailah was sturdy like most dwarves and possessed blue eyes and brown hair .

title: Sulabra
description: Sulabra Sulabra was the Realms name for . Description . Sulabra was a soft , gray stone somewhere in between slate and shale in color and hardness .

title: Sulasspryn
description: Sulasspryn Sulasspryn was a Moonsea city . History . In 974 DR ( Year of the Haunting Harpy ) , the Moonsea settlement that was built around the stronghold of retired half - elf adventurer Sulass Drowsbane is incorporated as the city of Sulasspryn .

title: Sulbain
description: Sulbain Sulbain , also called Steeleye , was a pegasus who was stabled at Sarahin , the great fortress of the Everlasting . Activites . The Grandfather of the Everlasting trained Sulbain since birth , relying on harsh methods to bend the magical creature to his will .

title: Suld
description: Suld Suld was a member of the Cult of the Dragon . History . In the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , Suld and Arkuel were servants of the Cult ' s archmage , Malark Himbruel , on a mission to capture Shandril Shessair inside the Twisted Tower of Ashaba .

title: Suldanessellar
description: Suldanessellar Suldanessellar was an elven city in the Forest of Tethir . It was ruled by Queen Ellesime and housed the Tree of Life . The city was a meeting place for elves and their tribes ; a location all elves of the forest called home at one time or another .

title: Suldax Tampcoin
description: Suldax Tampcoin Suldax Tampcoin was a member of the Shadow Council of Shadow Thieves and the Shade of the Caravan Sect around 1370 DR . History . Suldax started his career in the Shadow Thieves as a thief and moneylender .

title: Sulduskoon River
description: Sulduskoon River The Sulduskoon River was a major river in the kingdom of Tethyr . This spring - fed river flowed west from the highlands all the way into the ocean at the Bay of Bormul in Zazesspur . Etymology .

title: Sulesdeg
description: Sulesdeg Sulesdeg the Pole was a very tall guard working on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Sulesdeg did not talk much , but when he did , people listened .

title: Suliyar
description: Suliyar Suliyar was a rakshasa rajah in service of Set in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . Activities . Suliyar was a member of The Fangs of Set .

title: Suljack
description: Suljack Suljack was the leader of Ship Suljack and one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan . Along with the others he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate . Suljack was killed by Athrogate in " The Pirate King " for siding with Deudermont over Kensidan ; it was not clear what happened to his territory .

title: Sull ( the butcher )
description: Sull ( the butcher ) Sull is a semi - skilled fighter who works as a butcher in the South Ward of Waterdeep . After Icelin Tearn ' s great - uncle was killed by Cerest Elenithil ' s men , Sull agreed to take Icelin to Mistshore to hide from Cerest and the City Watch . He protected Icelin from Cerest and was seriously wounded in a battle with Cerest ' s henchmen .

title: Sultan ' s Own
description: Sultan ' s Own The Sultan ' s Own , or the Jackals , were located in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . This light infantry unit was comprised of 4 , 000 salamander s .

title: Suluq
description: Suluq Suluq was an enslaved efreeti in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Suluq was trapped within a ring of genie summoning and did his master ' s bidding whenever he was called .

title: Sumber Hills
description: Sumber Hills The Sumber Hills were a range of hills in the middle of the Dessarin Valley . The River Dessarin flowed through the hills , providing a source of water travel between Yartar and downstream communities such as Beliard , Bargewright Inn , and Womford . The Larch Path and the Dessarin Road provided passage through the hills .

title: Sumcha
description: Sumcha Sumcha was a human thief who claimed to be a merchant prince when he moved to Velprintalar in Aglarond around 1358 DR . His real occupation was as a burglar in Sembia , but he was forced to flee to Aglarond after stealing goods belonging to Zhentil Keep . He adopted Velprintalar as his new home , building and living in Sumcha ' s Tower with his family and servants .

title: Sumcha ' s Tower
description: Sumcha ' s Tower Sumcha ' s Tower was a tower in Velprintalar , Aglarond . It was built around 1358 DR by Sumcha , who claimed to be a merchant prince who moved to the city from Sembia . He lived in the tower with his family and servants .

title: Sumi - ko
description: Sumi - ko Sumi - ko was the younger daughter of Funada Toyoo in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Sumi - ko was promised in marriage by her father to the son of a daimyo of a far place but this son died and from then she was free from arranged marriage until her father not found an other good candidate .

title: Sumitomo Toyo
description: Sumitomo Toyo Sumitomo Toyo was the heir and chef of Doi No Fugu in 1360 DR . History . Toyo was the younger son of Sumitomo Koji , master of the Doi No Fugu , and the second male .

title: Sumitomo Yoichi
description: Sumitomo Yoichi Sumitomo Yoichi was the former heir of Doi No Fugu and a ninja in 1360 DR . History . Yoichi was the older son of Sumitomo Koji , master of the Doi No Fugu , destined to inherit the inn and the position of chef .

title: Summer Palace
description: Summer Palace The Summer Palace is the second home of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower of Evermeet and lies in the centre of the Lake of Dreams . The palace itself rivals the Moonstone Palace for beauty and is an enchanted structure of alabaster , marble , crystal and gems resting on four pyramids , 200 ' ( 60m ) above the lake . The queen uses this location to consider important issues with her Council of Matrons .

title: Summer in the City
description: Summer in the City " Summer in the City " is the 33rd issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Kim Yale . Appendix .

title: Summer rhymer
description: Summer rhymer Summer rhymers are cunning bard s who seek to evoke the power of the Feywild and the Summer Queen ' s lively spirit . Summer rhymers claim a deep connection to the power of the mystical Plane of Faerie , seeking to earn the blessing of the Summer Fey , reflecting the power of the fey in their own training , be it through teleportation or the life - enhancing powers of the Feywild . Culture .

title: Summon fire dragons
description: Summon fire dragons Summon fire dragons was a spell used commonly in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Summon monster
description: Summon monster Summon monster , or monster summoning , ( originally called Lucke ' s monster summons ) was a series of increasingly more powerful summoning spell s commonly in use by both arcane and divine spellcasters . Effects . A " summon monster " spell conjured one or more creatures from another plane and made them appear within close range of the caster .

title: Summon monster I
description: Summon monster I Summon monster I , or monster summoning I , ( originally called Lucke ' s 1 monster summons ) was one of the series of " summon monster " spells available to spellcasters . Cleric s whose gods had an interest in portal s , such as Eilistraee and Shaundakul , often prayed for this spell . Effects .

title: Summon monster II
description: Summon monster II Summon monster II , or monster summoning II , ( originally called Lucke ' s 2nd monster summons ) was one of the series of " summon monster " spells available to spellcasters . Effects . This spell functions just as all " summon monster " spells .

title: Summon monster III
description: Summon monster III Summon monster III , or monster summoning III , ( originally called Lucke ' s 3rd monster summons ) was one of the series of " summon monster " spells available to spellcasters . Effects . This spell functioned just as all " summon monster " spells .

title: Summon monster IX
description: Summon monster IX Summon monster IX is a conjuration spell that calls ( an ) outsider ( s ) to fight for the caster . Effect . This spell functions the same as " summon monster I " , except the caster can summon one very powerful creature , one or more creatures of slightly lesser power , or more creatures of lesser power still .

title: Summon monster VI
description: Summon monster VI Summon monster VI , also known as monster summoning VI , is a conjuration spell that calls an outsider to fight for the caster . Effects . This spell functions in the same manner as " summon monster I " , except you can summon one creature from the 6th - level list , 1d3 creatures of the same type from the 5th - level list , or 1d4 + 1 creatures of the same type from a lower - level list .

title: Summon sha ' ir
description: Summon sha ' ir Summon sha ' ir was a conjuration spell used by genie wizard s to compel service from an abusive sha ' ir . This spell was useless when cast upon any target who was not a sha ' ir . Typically genies would only use this spell against sha ' irs who abused their gen , created too many magical items , bound an excessive number of genies within genie prison s , or if the sha ' ir displayed similar malcontent toward geniekind .

title: Summon swarm
description: Summon swarm Summon swarm is a conjuration spell that conjures a swarm of small crawling or flying creatures . It requires as a material component a square of red cloth . Effect .

title: Summon undead
description: Summon undead Summon undead was a series of increasingly more powerful , evil summoning spell s commonly in use by sorcerer s and wizard s of the Realms . Effects . Like other summoning spells , a " summon undead " spell conjured one or more undead creatures from another place and made them appear within close range of the caster .

title: Summon undead I
description: Summon undead I Summon undead I was the weakest of the series of " summon undead " spells available to arcane casters in the Realms . This spell could summon a medium - sized skeleton or small zombie . Usually , the skeleton of a human warrior or a kobold zombie were chosen .

title: Summon undead II
description: Summon undead II Summon undead II was one of the series of " summon undead " spells available to arcane casters in the Realms . This spell could summon a large skeleton or medium - sized zombie , or it could summon one to three medium - sized skeletons or the same number of small zombies , provided they were within 30 feet of each other . Usually , the skeleton of an owlbear or a bugbear zombie were chosen .

title: Summon undead III
description: Summon undead III Summon undead III was one of the series of " summon undead " spells available to arcane casters in the Realms . This spell could summon a huge skeleton , a large zombie , or a ghoul . Usually , the skeleton of an troll or an ogre zombie were chosen .

title: Summon undead IV
description: Summon undead IV Summon undead IV was one of the series of " summon undead " spells available to arcane casters in the Realms . This spell could summon an allip , a ghast , or a huge zombie , which was usually the remains of a wyvern . As an alternative , the spell could summon one to three ghouls , one to three huge skeleton s , one to three large zombies , two to five large or medium - sized skeletons , or two to five medium - sized or small zombies — provided they were all within 30 feet of each other .

title: Summon undead V
description: Summon undead V Summon undead V was the most powerful of the series of " summon undead " spells available to arcane casters in the Realms . This spell could summon a mummy , a shadow , a vampire spawn or a wight . As an alternative , the spell could summon one to three allip s or ghast s , two to five ghouls , two to five huge , large , or medium - sized skeleton s , or two to five large , medium - sized , or small zombie s — provided they were all within 30 feet of each other .

title: Summon wind dragons
description: Summon wind dragons Summon wind dragons was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created 1 - 10 small wind vortices called wind dragons .

title: Summoning sphere
description: Summoning sphere The Summoning sphere was a group of spells granted to cleric s , mystic s and shaman s . These spells could bring aid in the form of creatures from distant places and planes , or transport the caster to safety . Spells in normal text were listed in the " Tome of Magic 2nd edition " .

title: Sun ' s Eye
description: Sun ' s Eye The Sun ' s Eye was the northern most province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This province was unique among others of the Empire in that most of its terrain was not dominated by the sprawling World Pillar Mountains .

title: Sun Canyon
description: Sun Canyon Sun Canyon is a canyon in the Pasocada Basin that runs southwest from the Dunobo Springs into the Pasocada River . The canyon is filled and carved out by the Danozi Wash , which is the floodwater coming from the mountains every spring . It is the spiritual centrepoint of the Azuposi civilization and the City of Gold , Michaca , is located here .

title: Sun Ya Sen
description: Sun Ya Sen Sun Ya Sen was the Chancellor of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Sun Ya Sen was appointed Chancellor in 1348 DR and from then on she always commanded respect from all the bureaucracy .

title: Sun domain
description: Sun domain The Sun domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters sun spell powers . Once per day , the user can perform a " greater turning " against undead in place of a normal turn / rebuke , which destroys undead that it would normally have turned / rebuked . Deities with the Sun domain .

title: Sun elf
description: Sun elf The sun elves , also sometimes known as gold elves , sometimes as high elves due to their stereotypically elitist ways , and Ar - tel - quessir in their own language are a subrace of eladrin historically rare in Faerûn due to the Retreat , in which the majority abandoned the continent for Evermeet , although during the Era of Upheaval they began return to the mainland . Haughty and arrogant , sun elves typically feel themselves superior to most other races , including other Tel - quessir . Ecology .

title: Sun scepter
description: Sun scepter Sun scepter was a conjuration spell that created a magical scepter of light . Effects . When cast , this spell created a scepter made from light that had a mace - like shape .

title: Sun sphere
description: Sun sphere The Sun sphere was a group of spells granted to druid s . These spells focus light and heat for comfort or for destruction . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Sun stone
description: Sun stone Sun stone was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned a small stone into a magical incendiary missile .

title: Sunbeam
description: Sunbeam Sunbeam , also known as sunray , was an evocation spell that allowed the caster to repeatedly fire destructive beams of sunlight . Effect . There were two known versions of this spell .

title: Sunbright Steelshanks
description: Sunbright Steelshanks Sunbright Steelshanks was a Rengarth barbarian who caught the eye of the Netherese wizard s Candlemas and Sysquemalyn . Description . The blond haired barbarian was slender and quick with corded muscles .

title: Sunburst
description: Sunburst Sunburst was an arcane evocation and divine spell that blinded and damaged nearby enemies . Effects . There were a few different versions of this spell that developed over time .

title: Sunburst ( prayer )
description: Sunburst ( prayer ) Sunburst was a cleric prayer in the post - Spellplague era that simultaneously burned enemies and healed allies . Effects . This prayer could be invoked at a distance of up to 50 ft ( 15 m ) away and created a 25 ft ( 7 .

title: Sundabar
description: Sundabar Sundabar is a defensible , dwarven - built fortress that became a refuge for Prince Simberuel Astalmé of Ascalhorn and his collected survivors . As the years rolled on , the human s grew in number until emerging as the dominant race of a bastion city against the dangers of the North . Geography .

title: Sundazzle
description: Sundazzle Sundazzle was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . If cast in full sunlight , or in the presence of spells that mimicked full sunlight , this spell caused small spheres of multicolored light to strike the target ' s eyes and blind them .

title: Sune
description: Sune Sune ( pronounced " SOO - nee " ) , also known as Lady Firehair , was the deity of beauty , with governance also over love . Her dogma primarily concerned love based on outward beauty , with primary importance placed upon loving people who responded to the Sunite ' s appearance . Her symbol was that of a beautiful woman with red hair .

title: Sune ' s caress
description: Sune ' s caress Named for Lady Firehair , Sune ' s caress is an enchantment spell that fills a subject with intense feelings of love , which evildoers can ' t quite process . Effect . A caster ' s gentle touch fills the target with tremendous feelings of love and compassion , and has the power to unnerve and debilitate evil creatures .

title: Sunfire
description: Sunfire Sunfire was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell harnessed the power of the sun to create an explosive ball of flame .

title: Sung
description: Sung Sung was a Prince of Shou Lung who earned the disfavor of the Emperor . History . Prince Sung was banished to the Valley of Exiles when he attempted to elope with one of the Emperor ' s concubines .

title: Sunil al - Sahil
description: Sunil al - Sahil Sunil al - Sahil was a tasked administrator genie who inhabited Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . Sunil was prized by the Grand Caliph for her devotion to duty .

title: Sunlight after storm
description: Sunlight after storm Sunlight After Storm was a sutra that cleared illusion s from one ' s mind , enabling them to see things as they truly were . It could be activated with a sprinkle of kumiss . Realmslore .

title: Sunmaster
description: Sunmaster Sunmaster was a prestige class on Faerûn whose members were those faithful of Lathander who believed he is the reincarnation of the deity Amaunator . Although they worshiped the Morninglord ( while referring to him as Amaunator ) with the rest of his clergy , their heretical belief that Amaunator ' s re - ascension was close , caused a rift in the church of Lathander . Like the Morninglords of Lathander , Sunmasters represented the elite clergy , albeit on opposite sides of the disagreement .

title: Sunrise
description: Sunrise Sunrise was a pegasus who lived in the Moonwood with her twin brother Sunset . The pair were rescued from giant s by the moon elf Tarathiel a few years prior to 1370 DR , and after this , they served as winged mounts for him and his partner , Innovindil . Sunrise was so named because her mane was highlighted with a yellowish pink color .

title: Sunrise Mountains
description: Sunrise Mountains The Sunrise Mountains was the name of a mountain range in Thay that formed much of that country ' s eastern border . Geography . The mountains marked the edge of Faerûn .

title: Sunscorch ( Wizard version )
description: Sunscorch ( Wizard version ) Sunscorch was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused an intense blast of heat to emanate from the caster ' s hand .

title: Sunset
description: Sunset Sunset was a pegasus who lived in the Moonwood with his twin sister Sunrise . Physical description . Sunset was so named because his mane had reddish tinges down the length of his body .

title: Sunset Mountains
description: Sunset Mountains The Sunset Mountains were a pair of mountain ranges separated by the Far Hills . Together with the Far Hills , they formed a high , almost impenetrable barrier between the Eastern and Western Heartlands , as well as forming the eastern edge of Sunset Vale . Inhabitants .

title: Sunset rose
description: Sunset rose The sunset rose was a flowering plant that grew in the Rose Garden of the Battle of Bones . Description . As the name implied , this plant ' s flowers were yellow , orange , and red .

title: Sunsho Daji
description: Sunsho Daji Sunsho Daji was a samurai in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Daji was the youngest son of honorable Sunsho Anteki .

title: Sunstone ( gem )
description: Sunstone ( gem ) Sunstone , also known as , was a gem closely related to moonstone . Description . The most common variety of this ornamental stone was soft and only able to be cut , but it did occur in a colorless or slightly greenish variety that was grade .

title: Sunstone ( lake )
description: Sunstone ( lake ) The Sunstone is a circular lake of liquid silver located in the Chical Hills in the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . The lake has mystical properties and can grant visions of the future to anyone who sits on the valley ' s rim at sunrise and stares into the lake .

title: Sunstone Commons
description: Sunstone Commons Sunstone Commons was a star - shaped open area in the city of Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . It was used as a meeting place , a place to deliver speeches , and a day and night market , particularly for trading in wine and food . A large statue of Corellon Larethian was located in the central area .

title: Sunthrun Blackshoulder
description: Sunthrun Blackshoulder Sunthrun Blackshoulder was a high - ranking Zhentilar warrior in High Dale , known for his cruelty and his habit of butchering women and younglings if possible . History . In 1358 DR , Sunthrun was the second - in - command of Constable Heladar Longspear in the secret Zhent occupation army in High Dale .

title: Suntunavick
description: Suntunavick Golden Gorger Suntunavick was a deep gnome cleric from Blingdenstone . He was head priest at the Ruby of the Rough temple to Segojan Earthcaller and was charged with the care of a number of cave badgers . History .

title: Sunwarp
description: Sunwarp Sunwarp was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This was an impressive illusion spell that multiplied an image selected by the caster and filled an area with it .

title: Sunwyrm
description: Sunwyrm A sunwyrm was a dangerous draconic predator that hunted from the skies above deserts and savannas . Description . A sunwyrm looked like a dragon with shining scales that visibly radiated heat , and wings that glowed with a brilliant light .

title: Suormpar
description: Suormpar Suormpar was the northernmost city in Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Description . Suormpar lay in the shadow of the Dustwall Mountains , on the eastern shore of Xontuil Bay and the Golden Water .

title: Supernal
description: Supernal Supernal was the language of the god s . It was a universal language , understandable by any sentient mind ( which heard the words as if they were spoken in its own languages ) . The gods shared their language with their servants , the angel s , and devil s spoke a version of it as well .

title: Supreme Throne
description: Supreme Throne The Supreme Throne is the realm in which Cyric , the Prince of Lies , holds dominion . After the murder of the Goddess of Magic , Mystra , fellow gods Lathander , Tyr , and Sune imprisoned Cyric in this realm for 1000 years . Before Cyric took control of the Supreme Throne , it was a realm in the plane of Limbo .

title: Suq Bay
description: Suq Bay Suq Bay was a vital body of water located in the heart of Zakhara . Geography . The bay was literally found in the center of the continent of Zakhara .

title: Surbar
description: Surbar Surbar was a coastal city of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . Geography . Surbar was sheltered safely within the bay of the Golden Water .

title: Surbrin Valley
description: Surbrin Valley The Surbrin Valley is the rocky vale formed by the River Surbrin in the Interior of Northwest Faerûn in the Savage Frontier . It extends from the Spine of the World to the north , the Evermoors to the south ; and between the Moonwood to the east and the Frost Hills to the west . History .

title: Surefeet Trademasters
description: Surefeet Trademasters The Surefeet Trademasters was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . A council of merchants ran the operations of this merchant company .

title: Surelife
description: Surelife Surelife was a rare abjuration spell unique to those who worshiped deities within the repose domain . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to protect himself against a deadly condition .

title: Suretmarch
description: Suretmarch The Duchy of Suretmarch was a region of southeast Tethyr bordering Calimshan . Geography . This contained a large portion of the Forest of Mir in its southern portions .

title: Surface rothé
description: Surface rothé Surface rothé , also known as high rothé or brown rothé , were a variety of rothé that lived in surface lands . Description . Surface rothé had shaggy brown fur , cloven hooves , and two curving horns .

title: Surgol Velard
description: Surgol Velard Surgol Velard was a War Wizard of Cormyr from Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Surgol was sent to the troops that had just overrun the Stormserpent Towers .

title: Surkazar
description: Surkazar Surkazar was a county in Tethyr located on the western foothills of the Omlarandin Mountains . Description . County Surkazar was known for its beautiful , pastoral landscapes as much as for its danger from monsters from the mountains .

title: Surkh
description: Surkh Surkh was a small city on the north shore of the Deepwash in the shadow of the Deepwing Mountains in the Vilhon Reach . The lizardfolk here keep to themselves , though they had good relations with the Emerald Enclave , Lachom , Nimpeth and Lheshayl . Government .

title: Surruk
description: Surruk Surruk was an wild elven woodsman in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . Possessions . When adventuring , Surruk wore dirty leather armor and fought with a purple - hued Morcant Burl longbow .

title: Surthay
description: Surthay Surthay is the name of a region , or tharch , of Thay and the name this region ' s capital city . Surthay . The capital lies outside of the enchantments that manage the climate in central Thay so the weather is colder and rainier than in the central regions of Thay .

title: Surtr
description: Surtr Surtr , also seen as Surtur , was the lord of the fire giants . His animal was the hell hound . His symbol was a flaming sword .

title: Susariel
description: Susariel Susariel was a cambion member of the Cult of the Dragon during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , during the Cult ' s coup in Phlan , Susariel was tasked with the command of the secret Black Fist prison inside Stojanow Gate , where Ector Brahms was imprisoned .

title: Suspended animation
description: Suspended animation Suspended animation was a necromancy spell that allowed one willing creature to enter a sleep - like state where bodily functions were so slow they became undetectable for extended periods of time . However , one or more priests of the same alignment had to maintain the spell , forgoing casting of all other spells and temporarily sapping their vitality . Effects .

title: Suspension
description: Suspension Suspension was a stronger version of the " levitate " spell . It was believed to be involved in the unique magic that kept skyships afloat . This spell was jealously guarded by native wizard s of Halruaa .

title: Susurrus
description: Susurrus The Susurrus was a monstrous spider of enormous proportions that ravaged Shadowdale ' s geographical backroads for millennia . Its maddening whispers and diseased bite turned all fey who encountered it into cannibalistic wendigo s . Appearance .

title: Susztam Mar - Shinn
description: Susztam Mar - Shinn Susztam Mar - Shinn was a male drow illusionist and shadow adept . He was the Head Student of the Inverted Tower and a user of the Shadow Weave in Szith Morcane in the 14th century . Description .

title: Suth
description: Suth Suth , also called suthwood , was a type of tree found in the south of Faerûn . The name " suth " was thought to be a corruption of " south " . Description .

title: Suzail
description: Suzail - - Olaurae , sage of Myth Drannor ( 855 DR ) Suzail was the capital of Cormyr and the seat of power . It was named after Suzara Obarskyr , the mother of the first king . It was originally the farm of Ondeth Obarskyr , the father of the first king .

title: Suzale
description: Suzale Suzale , also known as Purple Dragon ale , was a fine - quality nutty ale . History . The ale was first brewed for King Azoun IV of Cormyr but over time it became sold across Faerûn .

title: Suzara Obarskyr
description: Suzara Obarskyr Suzara Obarskyr was the wife of Ondeth Obarskyr and moved with him to the Forest Country to create a new life , and what would later become the nation of Cormyr . Its capital , Suzail , was named after her . Relatives .

title: Suzildara Sharranen
description: Suzildara Sharranen Suzildara Sharranen was the High Whipmistress at the Resting Place of the Whip in Melvaunt . Activities . She watched over sixteen other priests and oversaw all the rituals of the temple .

title: Swagdar
description: Swagdar The Swagdar , or the Outlaw Waste , was a large stretch of land located just northwest of Dambrath . Geography . This rolling grassland was filled with hidden valleys .

title: Swamp cave ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Swamp cave ( Mere of Dead Men ) The swamp cave was one of the caves in the Mere of Dead Men . Geography . The cave was located near West Harbor .

title: Swamp circle
description: Swamp circle The swamp circle was a druid circle associated with the fens , marshes , and wetlands filled with abundant life . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Swamp ruins ( Mere of Dead Men )
description: Swamp ruins ( Mere of Dead Men ) The swamp ruins were part of the ruins of Illefarn in the Mere of Dead Men . Geography . The ruins were located near West Harbor .

title: Swamplight lynx
description: Swamplight lynx A swamplight lynx was a magical cat found in swampy or marshy terrain . Description . Swamplight lynxes were between nine and ten feet long with large paws and short tails .

title: Swift Elyan
description: Swift Elyan Swift Elyan was a halfling adventurer in the Dalelands . History . Swift was an expert in traps and locks .

title: Swimstar Creek
description: Swimstar Creek Swimstar Creek was a tributary of the Shining Stream , which in turn was a tributary of Tethyr ' s River Ith . It began in the Kuldin Peaks and divided County Morninggold in half . It was fast - moving but shallow and contained a breed of luminescent fish .

title: Swipe
description: Swipe Swipe was the nickname of the rat - faced head of the Rogue ' s Guild in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . He and his guild acted as personal spies in the city for Lord Maalthiir but working too close with the Red Plumes prevented Swipe and his men from uncovering the true menace .

title: Swirling leaves of steel
description: Swirling leaves of steel Swirling leaves of steel was an exploit that allowed a ranger wielding two melee weapons to attack all adjacent enemies in a spinning dance of blades . Effects . Once per day , a ranger who learned this exploit could spin like a top with blades held out and strike all adjacent enemies that he or she could see in the immediate surrounding circle .

title: Sword
description: Sword A sword is a melee weapon that in its simplest form consists of a blade and a hilt . This definition includes those weapons that fit the archetype of blade with the additional restriction of a minimum size . For game purposes , weapons are divided into three size / weight classes : light , one - handed , and two - handed .

title: Sword Coast
description: Sword Coast The Sword Coast , not to be confused with the Sword Coast North , stretched along the Sea of Swords from Waterdeep down to the River Chionthar at Baldur ' s Gate in the south . The Sword Coast took its name from the white cliffs that rose up sharply for hundreds of miles along the coastline , from Baldur ' s Gate to the south and up to the River Dessarin in the north . Officially , the coast line north of Waterdeep up to Icewind Dale was not part of the Sword Coast , though most folk simply used the term Sword Coast for this otherwise unnamed stretch of coast line .

title: Sword Coast Legends
description: Sword Coast Legends Sword Coast Legends is a role - playing video game developed by and , released on October 20th , 2015 . The game features tactical , party - based combat , as well as a " Dungeon Master " mode that emulates the group dynamic of tabletop Dungeons & Dragons . The game ' s main storyline is set in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn , around the time of Rage of Demons .

title: Sword Coast North
description: Sword Coast North The Sword Coast North was a region on the northwestern coast of Faerûn . Geography . The region stretched from Waterdeep in the south to the Spine of the World in the north , and from the Sword Coast in the west to the Long Road in the east .

title: Sword Dancer of Eilistraee
description: Sword Dancer of Eilistraee The Sword Dancers of Eilistraee were the speciality priests of the Dark Maiden . Organization . Only females elves , drow , half - drow and half elves could become Sword Dancers .

title: Sword Dancers
description: Sword Dancers The Sword Dancers were a faction within the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Sword Dancers were based in the fortress of Sarahin located deep within the Haunted Lands .

title: Sword Heralds
description: Sword Heralds The Sword Heralds were a group of mages that arrived unheralded in Cormyr several centuries prior to the 14th century . Before their abrupt departure , the Sword Heralds worked on a variety of projects that improved Cormyr , the most notable being the construction of extra - dimensional refuges ( otherwise known as hideaways ) that protected against the threat of foul weather , roaming brigands and monsters .

title: Sword Lands
description: Sword Lands The Sword Lands were a confederation of small , independent human counties located in eastern Returned Abeir . Background . The land was known as the " boast realms " because the counties that composed the Sword Lands were small , and usually poor and lawless .

title: Sword Mountains
description: Sword Mountains The Sword Mountains are mountains in a range located on the Sword Coast North , forming a boomerang shape , northwest of Waterdeep and east of the Mere of Dead Men . Their western slopes lead to the Trackless Sea in rolling foothills . History .

title: Sword burst
description: Sword burst Sword burst is a very basic swordmage spell , used frequently by assault swordmage s as well as those of other styles . When a swordmage casts " sword burst " he or she causes a burst of invisible force with a blast area of five feet in diameter to surge outwards from his or her blade , sweeping through the mage ' s enemies with deadly force . The strength of this attack , which is in part dependent upon the swordmage ' s intellect , grows as the swordmage becomes more experienced and worldly .

title: Sword marshal
description: Sword marshal The path of a sword marshal is one taken by warlord s trained extensively in the use of a heavy blade , such as a longsword or scimitar . Through their skill and commanding power , the blade of a sword marshal becomes as much a symbol of leadership and courage as it does a weapon , aiding the wielder in their command over others and helping them bring hope to weakened allies . Abilities .

title: Sword of Anauroch
description: Sword of Anauroch The Sword of Anauroch was an area of the desert of Anauroch near Thultanthar . At the heart of this area is Elah ' zad , the House of the Moon , which lies in the Hills of Scent . In this location , in 464 DR , Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun came across his father , Arun Maerdrym who had been escorting some Evereskan elves ( his then wife and children ) westwards .

title: Sword of Selvetarm
description: Sword of Selvetarm The Sword of Selvetarm was an intelligent holy sword of Selvetarm ' s church . Properties . The sword ' s properties changed depending on who wielded it .

title: Sword of Souls
description: Sword of Souls The Sword of Souls was the + 3 scimitar wielded by Iyachtu Xvim . Properties . It had immense power including acid damage , paralyzing power , and more .

title: Sword of righteousness
description: Sword of righteousness Among warriors of every stripe there are hold themselves to a higher ideal than their colleagues . Even among paladin s there are those viewed as a paragon of righteousness and purity , truly exalted above their peers . These elite are called swords of righteousness , and though they are few , they make mighty opponents of evil that even the strongest blackguard s are hard - pressed to defeat .

title: Sword of the Soulless
description: Sword of the Soulless The Sword of the Soulless was a replica of Iyachtu Xvim ' s " Sword of Souls " . History . It was forged by Saablic Tan and Isair , who was its wielder , in the Severed Hand , The Legion of the Chimera ' s headquarters .

title: Sword of the believer
description: Sword of the believer The sword of the believer was a magical weapon that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These weapons were available in any type of sword .

title: Sword spider
description: Sword spider Sword spiders were a variety of subterranean spider . Description . Sword spiders were about twelve feet in diameter .

title: Swordball
description: Swordball A " swordball " was an arcane spell that caused rusty fragments of old weapons to explode outwards in all directions . It worked exactly the same way as a " fireball " exploded with flames . History .

title: Swordmage
description: Swordmage Swordmages are powerful arcane spellcasters who blend martial combat with magic , often but not always elemental in nature . Ancient traditions of swordmages are common throughout Abeir and parts of Toril , such as Netheril or Evermeet , and are particularly common amongst eladrin , genasi , or githyanki . Wielding swords enchanted with spell s , swordmages are powerful foes to cross , hardened through years of training in the melding of spell and blade .

title: Swordmage ( novel )
description: Swordmage ( novel ) Swordmage by Richard Baker is the first novel in the Blades of the Moonsea trilogy . It follows the story of Geran Hulmaster and his ghostwise halfling companion Hamil Alderheart as they return to Geran ' s home town to find things have changed more than expected . Summary .

title: Swordmaster
description: Swordmaster A swordmaster is a highly trained fighter particularly skilled in wielding non - polearm blade s of any type . Abilities . Swordmasters use to wield their blade in defense as well as offense , gaining considerable skill in deflecting or parrying enemy attacks so as to seem nigh untouchable .

title: Swords Meet
description: Swords Meet The Swords Meet was an inn located in Voonlar that catered mainly to the Zhentarim and their allies , affiliates , and sympathizers . Location . The Swords Meet faced a northerly direction across Shind Road .

title: Swords Pool ( pool )
description: Swords Pool ( pool ) Swords Pool was a pond in the village of Swords Pool in the Vast . It gave its name to the village . Description .

title: Swords Pool ( village )
description: Swords Pool ( village ) Swords Pool was a village in the Vast , lying on the North Road between Dead Tree Hollow and King ' s Reach . Description . The village lay in a wooded dell on the North Road .

title: Swords of Eveningstar
description: Swords of Eveningstar Swords of Eveningstar , by Ed Greenwood , is the first book of The Knights of Myth Drannor trilogy . Notes . The Swords of Eveningstar , the titular group that evolved into the Knights of Myth Drannor , were named after a party created by players of Ed Greenwood ' s home campaign .

title: Swords of the Lady
description: Swords of the Lady The Swords of the Lady , commonly called the Lunatics , were a fanatical order devoted to the goddess Selûne the Moonmaiden . Membership . The order was led by a handful of crusader s , mystic s , and silverstar s .

title: Syal Amandon
description: Syal Amandon Syal Amandol was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . History . Syal was the youngest Lord on the Council .

title: Syan al Derak
description: Syan al Derak Pasha Syan al Derak , whose full name was Syan yn Asraf al Derak yi Volothamp , was the leader of both the Guild of Gemcutters and the Guild of Whitesmiths in Teshburl . Secretly , Syan was a notable member of the Knights of the Shield , being the seventh member of his family in that clandestine organization . He fled from his native city of Volothamp during the Darkstalker Wars , when seven of his relatives were killed in a single night .

title: Sybille Rhindaun
description: Sybille Rhindaun Her Royal Highness Sybille Zaranda Rhinda Chenowyn Alisande Rhindaun was Princess of the Corsairs ' Sea and later the second queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty of Tethyr . Relationships . Sybille ' s regent until she came of age was her father , King Haedrak Rhindaun III , who ruled over the Principality in her stead .

title: Sydney
description: Sydney Sydney was a female wizard and a member of the Arcane Brotherhood and apprentice of Dendybar . She was ordered by her master to kill the Companions of the Hall with the help of the Luskan guard Jierdan and the flesh golem Bok . They also partnered with assassin Artemis Entreri for a time , but in the end Sydney was killed .

title: Syl - pasha
description: Syl - pasha " Syl - pasha " was an Alzhedo term most often used to refer to the caleph , or king , of Calimshan . Etymology . " Syl " was an older Alzhedo term for a tribal chief that later was used as a prefix .

title: Sylara
description: Sylara Sylara was an adventurer operating in Cormyr in the 1350s DR . She was a member of the Moon ' s Twelve company . History .

title: Syllia Adarbrent
description: Syllia Adarbrent Syllia Adarbrent was a female Illuskan human fighter of the noble house of Adarbrent in Waterdeep . Syllia was the captain of the " Hippocampus " , the flagship of the Horizon Armada , a noble - owned fleet headed by her family , the Adarbrents . She was also a member of the Harpers .

title: Sylora Salm
description: Sylora Salm Sylora Salm was a sorceress of Thay who followed the Archlich of Thay . Relationships . Salm was Dahlia Sin ' felle ' s rival .

title: Sylph
description: Sylph Sylphs were small outsiders who often inhabited the Elemental Plane of Air and the Material Plane . They often appeared as small , beautiful women with translucent , brightly colored wings . They often preferred filmy - seeming , silky , or loose clothing , and brightly colored jewelry .

title: Syluné ' s Hut
description: Syluné ' s Hut Syluné ' s Hut was once the home of Syluné , the Witch of Shadowdale . After her destruction , Syluné ' s Hut became little more than an empty , roofless house . History .

title: Sylvan archer
description: Sylvan archer Sylvan archers are elven ranger s trained in expert use of a bow or similarly ranged weapon . Archer ranger s tend towards this path more than other ranger traditions but previous specialization as an archer is not required . Sylvan archers are well - known for their almost artistic dedication to archery and though other rangers may be similarly skilled in the use of a bow few are as graceful and beautiful in their use of it as a sylvan archer .

title: Sylvanus Moondrop
description: Sylvanus Moondrop Lord Sylvanus Moondrop was Count of Uluran , Magistrates ' Chancellor of Tethyr , and a former member of the Company of Eight . Description . Sylvanus was an average - looking wood elf , tall and thin , with coppery skin and hair and green eyes .

title: Sylvia
description: Sylvia Sylvia was the baroness of Ostel in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Sylvia lived in luxury and normally executed her political opponents .

title: Symbaern
description: Symbaern House Symbaern was a sun elf house on Evermeet that survived the fall of Myth Drannor . Leadership . As of 1368 DR it was led by Yalathanil Symbaern , a reclusive wizard of more than a thousand years .

title: Symbol
description: Symbol Symbol was a conjuration spell that was similar to " glyph of warding " , creating a rune that had a variety of possible devastating effects when triggered . Effects . There was both a divine and an arcane version of this spell .

title: Symbol of pain
description: Symbol of pain Symbol of pain was a necromancy spell that created a powerful rune that tortured one or more creatures when triggered . Effects . This spell functioned similar to " symbol of death " except all creatures in the area of effect were wracked with pain that made performing any skill , using any ability , or engaging in combat very difficult .

title: Symgharyl Maruel
description: Symgharyl Maruel Symgharyl Maruel , also known as the Shadowsil , was a powerful wizard affiliated with the Cult of the Dragon and the Zhentarim . History . Elminster was her tutor in the Art .

title: Sympathy
description: Sympathy Sympathy was an enchantment spell that compelled a creature to approach another . Effects . The spell caused a specified creature within 60 feet ( 18 meters ) to feel an intense urge to be near the target .

title: Symrustar Auglamyr
description: Symrustar Auglamyr Symrustar Auglamyr was a Chosen of Mystra . History . Auglamyr was a noble and very beautiful elf living in Myth Drannor before the rising of the Mythal .

title: Symylazarr
description: Symylazarr Symylazarr ( the Fount of Honor ) was an ancient rune - engraved blade with a pommel in the shape of a dragon ' s head . History . The sword was used ceremonially around 376 DR by leaders of noble houses to swear allegiance to the king of Cormyr .

title: Syndra Wands
description: Syndra Wands Syndra Wands was a human spellcaster and member of the Wands noble house of Waterdeep . She lived in Syndra Wands ' Tower in the Castle Ward of the city . Relatives .

title: Syndra Wands ' Tower
description: Syndra Wands ' Tower Syndra Wands ' Tower ( also known as the Eightower ) was the tower of Syndra Wands in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . Structure . It was a four - storey tower , consisting of a two - storey octagonal base .

title: Synilla
description: Synilla Synilla was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Personality . Synilla had a great anger inside her .

title: Synnoria
description: Synnoria Geography . Synnoria was an ancient elven kingdom hidden in the mountains bordering the Myrloch Vale on Gwynneth , one of the Moonshae Isles . It was covered in a powerful mass " illusion " spell so that , if viewed from above , it simply looked like a continuation of the surrounding mountains .

title: Synod
description: Synod Synod was a Netherese floating citadel . It was an ecclesiastical enclave ruled by a pious archwizard . The city was home to some of Netheril ' s finest cathedrals .

title: Synostodweomer
description: Synostodweomer Synostodweomer , also known as Simbul ' s synostodweomer , was an arcane transmutation and necromancy spell that converted other spells into healing magic , or granted another creature some of the caster ' s healing ability . Effects . Before the Spellplague , wizards and sorcerers could use this spell to transform one of their other spells into positive energy that could be used as healing magic .

title: Syr ' daun Hunzrin
description: Syr ' daun Hunzrin Syr ' daun Hunzrin was a member of House Hunzrin and master of Melee - Magthere in 1479 DR . Personality . Syr ' daun knew that many despised him for his origins , supposedly coming from a house of farmers .

title: Syranna
description: Syranna Syranna was a rebel Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Syranna was honest and forthright but also cynical .

title: Syrzan
description: Syrzan Syrzan was a powerful alhoon living in the Underdark , who led a revolt in an attempt to take control of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . History . Syrzan was originally an illithid mage from the Underdark illithid city of Oryndoll .

title: Sysalok
description: Sysalok Sysalok was a yuan - ti abomination and a servant of Kharantes in 1375 DR . History . In 1375 DR , Sysalok commanded a patrol of asabi who surveyed the sands of Anauroch .

title: Sysquemalyn
description: Sysquemalyn Sysquemalyn was the chamberlain of Lady Polaris of Delia in the Netherese Empire . She was a villainess who landed herself and any nearby into more trouble than she could handle . Description .

title: Syòrpiir
description: Syòrpiir Syòrpiir was an ancient kingdom of moon elves and sun elves created during the First Flowering in - 23100 DR . History . Syòrpiir was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Thearnytaar and Eiellûr by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR .

title: Szant
description: Szant Szant was a port town of the kingdom of Gontal . Government . As of 1479 DR , the Docklord Maerigo Rustal administered the town on behalf of Queen Imreera Hethkantan .

title: Szarkai
description: Szarkai Szarkai ( pronounced " " zahrk " - eye " ) , meaning " ghost spiders " , were albino drow . Although extremely rare and a subject of mystery , they could easily pass as normal elves , making them ideal spies for the drow noble houses , able to operate freely in the surface world . Description .

title: Szass Tam
description: Szass Tam Szass Tam was a powerful lich and member of a group of eight Zulkirs who ruled the country of Thay . He was the Zulkir of Necromancy and commanded the Legion of Bone , a huge legion of undead soldiers , led by his vampire and lich generals . Szass Tam was the ruler of Thaymount .

title: Szith Morcane
description: Szith Morcane Szith Morcane was an outpost of the drow city of Maerimydra . Geography . Built into the side of a yawning chasm in the Upperdark of the Deep Wastes , Szith Morcane is connected not by streets and caverns but by a vast spider ' s web that covers the wall .

title: Szorak Auzkovyn
description: Szorak Auzkovyn Szorak Auzkovyn was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Szorak was a priest from Clan Auzkovyn who joined Malvag ' s plot .

title: Szuma Li
description: Szuma Li Szuma Li was a bushido warrior in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Szuma Li joined the army of Khan Kertep in 1354 DR because the khan appeared to be chosen by the god because all his predictions were proved true .

title: Szwentil Illeon
description: Szwentil Illeon Szwentil Illeon was the wealthiest man in Marsember , Cormyr around 1367 DR . Activities . He was one of the six founders of the Six Coffers Market Priakos , owner of The Roaring Griffon , and was rumored to be worth over six million gold piece s .

title: T ' Kalah
description: T ' Kalah T ' Kalah , known by mostly as Black Claws , was a sahuagin prince after the Twelfth Serôs War . History . T ' Kalah was born in 941 DR as a mutant with four arms .

title: T ' an - zao
description: T ' an - zao T ' an - zao the Gajin was a bandit leader in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . T ' an - zao led a bandit gang with around 400 members , of all kinds of origin , with a group of lieutenants and a mainland wu jen in his service .

title: T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl
description: T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl T ' lar Mizz ' rynturl was a drow assassin member of the Velkyn Velve . History . T ' lar was once a noble of House Mizz ' rynturl of the city of Guallidurth until she joined the Velkyn Velve , the assassin branch of the new Temple of the Black Mother , renouncing all her bond to better honor Lolth .

title: T ' lindhet
description: T ' lindhet T ' lindhet was a drow city 3 mi ( 4 . 83 km ) beneath the Gnollwatch Mountains which sat on top of a huge plateau in a large cavern . An underground river split as it approached the plateau , and rejoined itself on the other side .

title: T ' o Fang Jio
description: T ' o Fang Jio T ' o Fang Jio was a shukenja adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Jio was truly devoted to the Way , often unable to stop himself from lecturing followers of other religions about their wrong choice .

title: T ' o na ' Chee
description: T ' o na ' Chee T ' o na ' Chee was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying north of the Vorkani Mountains . The mountains separated T ' o Na ' chee from the rest of Koryo . Around 1357 DR , the town was the base of the powerful yakuza clan known as the Yio Dufong , or " the bears " .

title: T ' risstree T ' orgh
description: T ' risstree T ' orgh T ' risstree T ' orgh was a commoner - born instructor of Arach - Tinilith in 1372 DR . Abilities . She was a good warrior , always wielding a falchion .

title: T ' u Lung
description: T ' u Lung T ' u Lung was an oppressive and politically unstable country in Kara - Tur . After splitting from Shou Lung after a rebellion , the two states were at war for almost 250 years . History .

title: T ' u Lung language
description: T ' u Lung language T ' u Lung was a language spoken by the inhabitants of T ' u Lung in Kara - Tur . It was of the Shou Chiang languages group . It came from the same root tongue as Kao te Shou , the language of Shou Lung .

title: TSR , Inc .
description: TSR , Inc . TSR , Inc . was the American game publishing company that published " Dungeons & Dragons " .

title: Taak Lake
description: Taak Lake Taak Lake was a small , fresh - water lake in Alpuk , on the Great Glacier . Taak Lake was located off of the Utaak Stream , at the base of the Lugsaas Chain near the gap in those mountains that led to the village of Ishe . It was southwest of the Iulutiun village of Puttak .

title: Taalmuth Chaadren
description: Taalmuth Chaadren Taalmuth Chaadren was a human ranger from Amphail , and the father of Tsarra Chaadren . Relationships . Taalmuth married Malruthiia , who was an exiled bastard child of the Ilbaereth house of elves .

title: Taark Shanat
description: Taark Shanat Taark Shanat ( the Crusader ) and his eight sons led a great exodus of dwarves out of Bhaerynden around - 11000 DR to a new kingdom in the west . These emigrants eventually become known as shield dwarves and established the great empire of Shanatar beneath the lands of Amn , Tethyr , Calimshan and the Lake of Steam . Background .

title: Tabasheer
description: Tabasheer Tabasheer was an opal - like silica found in the joints of certain types of bamboo . Description . Tabasheer was found in irregular nuggets that were usually tumbled smooth and then polished to velvety sheen .

title: Tabaxi
description: Tabaxi Tabaxi ( also known as jaguar people or cat - men ) were a race of feline humanoids native to the jungles of Maztica . Description . Tabaxi were taller than most human s at six to seven feet .

title: Tabaxi ( tribe )
description: Tabaxi ( tribe ) The Tabaxi were the largest tribe of human s in Chult at the end of the 14th century DR . When most people referred to Chultans , they were speaking of members of this tribe , as the Tabaxi had absorbed most of the other Chultan tribes . History .

title: Tabl
description: Tabl The tabl ( TAB - leh ) was a double - sided Zakharan drum . Pearl divers from the Pearl Cities referred to these drums as " mirwas " . Description .

title: Table dice
description: Table dice Table dice , or backgammon , was a board game played with dice . Description . The sets sold through Aurora ' s Emporium used polished stone markers , ivory dice , and a leather dice cup .

title: Tablets of Fate
description: Tablets of Fate The Tablets of Fate were stone slabs on which the official portfolios of every one of the deities of Abeir - Toril were written . Bane and Myrkul stole the tablets from Ao and hid them in Faerûn , suspecting that some of the Overgod ' s power was derived from these tablets . When Ao discovered the Tablets of Fate were missing he summoned all the deities and asked for those guilty to hand them over .

title: Tablets of Pharyssolnyth
description: Tablets of Pharyssolnyth The Tablets of Pharyssolnyth , or the Pharyssolnyth Tablets , were a collection of writings by the silver dragon Pharyssolnyth . They detailed the secrets of dragon magic . Description .

title: Tabot
description: Tabot Tabot was a mountainous state founded by monks and barbarians . The monks fled from oppression of Shou Lung to this mountainous terrain , which contained barbarians , monsters and merciless cold winds . The people of Tabot created their own special culture and customs , and many wise men spent their whole lives in the mountains to learn the truth .

title: Tabotan
description: Tabotan The Tabotans were an ethnicity of human s from the Kara - Tur an country of Tabot . Description . Tabotans were shorter than Shou and had coarse hair but shared the same yellow skin tones and flat features .

title: Tabotan language
description: Tabotan language Tabotan was a language spoken by the Tabotan people of Tabot in Kara - Tur . Description . There was a common Tabotan tongue that held the nation together , but local accents were thick .

title: Tabra
description: Tabra Tabra was the proprietor of a festhall in Bargewright Inn . Powers . Despite keeping her skill with magic a secret , Tabra always had a full complement of spell s available , most notably , the incredibly powerful Netherese spell " dragonshape " .

title: Tacal
description: Tacal Tacal was an Itza prince of history . History . During the Payit golden age , Tacal was a prince of Tulom - Itzi .

title: Tace Blueshield
description: Tace Blueshield Tace Blueshield was a shield dwarf paladin of Ilmater at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR . Personality . Tace was grim and disciplined and had a drill - sergeant attitude towards both her men and to the monks .

title: Tad Staslep
description: Tad Staslep Tad Staslep was a grocer in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Tad was a portly man with a big appetite .

title: Tadaz
description: Tadaz Tadaz was an inhabitant of the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Tadaz was a muscular man .

title: Tae kwon do
description: Tae kwon do Tae kwon do , also known as Foot and Fist , was a martial art developed in the land of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Reputation . This martial art was widely practiced in Koryo in the 14th century DR .

title: Taegan Nightwind
description: Taegan Nightwind Taegan Nightwind is an avariel , an elven subrace noted for their wings and the fact that they are nowadays extremely rare in Faerûn . Description . Taegan is a warrior , and more specifically a duelist and bladesinger , relying on his lightning reflexes , fencing skills , and arcane abilities rather than brute strength to win a fight .

title: Taern Hornblade
description: Taern Hornblade Taern " Thunderspells " Hornblade was the High Mage of the city of Silverymoon < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p51 " > < / ref > , having succeeded Alustriel when she took the office of High Lady , and member of the Council of the Marches . < ref name = " N : GSF / Cities - p55 " > < / ref > Description . Taern was tall and gray - bearded , appearing grave and thoughtful most of the time .

title: Taerom Fuiruim
description: Taerom Fuiruim Taerom " Thunderhammer " Fuiruim is a renowned master armor er and weaponsmith , owning and running Thunderhammer Smithy in Beregost . Work . Taerom Fuiruim is considered one of the best smiths in Faerûn and has extensive knowledge of the use of rare and exotic ore s and magic in metalcrafting .

title: Taerymdoom
description: Taerymdoom Taerymdoom was a network of natural caves located in the southern borders of the Far Forest in the Savage Frontier . Description . Those who ventured into these caves said they stretched for several miles underground and were guarded by vargouille s .

title: Tagar Lusos
description: Tagar Lusos Tagar Lusos was an aquatic elf dukar of the Order of Numos and a member of the Nantarn Council . Activities . Despite his irrational hatred of Morgan Ildacer , Tagar was an effective councilor and normally spoke in defense of the people of eastern Serôs ( locathah , shalarin , and Qatoris morkoth included ) .

title: Taglath
description: Taglath Taglath was a bizarre ghost in Skullport . History . In life , Taglath was a poet , explorer , and a romantic .

title: Tagreth Cormaeril
description: Tagreth Cormaeril Lord Tagreth Cormaeril was the Grandfather of Assassins of the Fire Knives and tolerated no dissent within his organization . Description . Appearing as a frail and elderly man , Tagreth had unnatural vigor that came from magical sources .

title: Taharak
description: Taharak Taharak was once a powerful warrior among the drow of Maerimydra in life , before rising as a ghost after his death . Description . Taharak cut an impressive figure in his full plate armor , even more so when wearing his leering skull helm and astride his nightmare steed .

title: Tahlshara
description: Tahlshara Tahlshara is a magic two - handed sword sometimes considered to be the greatest elven weapon ever made . It drastically improves its wielder ' s armour and can only be wielded by elves ( except drow ) – death often being the result of a non - elf handling it . It has leaves and vines carved into its surface with knotwork on the hilt .

title: Tai Chai Ming
description: Tai Chai Ming Tai Chai Ming was the Minister of Magic of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Tai Chai Ming was a talented wu jen .

title: Taichi
description: Taichi Taichi was the magical advisor of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Taichi lived in the mountains surrounding Nakamaru and went to the city only if called by his lord , Funada Mitsuhide .

title: Taiku
description: Taiku Taiku was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Taiku lay on the northern coast of the western peninsula , south of the Straits of Koryo .

title: Tainted one
description: Tainted one Tainted ones were humans who had been turned into yuan - ti servitors by drinking a distillation of yuan - ti venom mixed with specific roots and herbs . Activities . Tainted ones primarily served as spies in human cities .

title: Tajar
description: Tajar Tajar was the most northerly of Zakhara ' s Pearl Cities . Geography . The city was located near the Golden Gulf on the banks of the Al - Adib River , at the nexus of different trade routes , making it the most important place to exchange all kinds goods in the whole Land of Fate apart from Golden Huzuz itself .

title: Tak
description: Tak Tak was a female doppelganger in the Moonsea . Activities . Posing as Doctor Jubal , she managed the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities .

title: Takabbar
description: Takabbar Takabbar was a small town on the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar within the Nada al - Hazan archipelago . Rumors and Legends . It was rumored that the only way to get off of the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar was through the Tower of the Test , located in Takabbar .

title: Takae Suju
description: Takae Suju Takae Suju was a monk in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Suju was the military instructor at Uwaji and a close collaborator of Baiyosho Degi .

title: Takahashi Yamaguchi
description: Takahashi Yamaguchi Takahashi Yamaguchi was the leader of the ninja Yamaguchi clan in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Takahashi was a man of honor , never brooking an agreement .

title: Takako Shimizu
description: Takako Shimizu Takako Shimizu was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Takako was a model of a perfect female samurai , attractive and vivacious .

title: Takamal
description: Takamal Takamal was the ruler of Kultaka in 1361 DR . History . Takamal originally was a great warrior that save Kultaka from the Nexalan armies led by Chalco , the nexalan ruler predecessor of Axalt , the father of Naltecona , around 1295 .

title: Takari Moonsnow
description: Takari Moonsnow Takari Moonsnow was an Evereska n wood elf who served under Galaeron Nihmedu for many years as a desert border guard . Activities . She was estranged from Galaeron for a while and , during the later part of the Evereska – phaerimm war , she decided to bed Kuhl in order to get pregnant and thus be able to wield his family blade .

title: Takegai Yodori
description: Takegai Yodori Takegai Yodori was a wandering shugenja in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yodori acted as a courier for Takegai Uezami , the head of the council of state and a high - ranking member of the noble Takegai clan .

title: Takenaka Okawa
description: Takenaka Okawa Takenaka Okawa was the shikken of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Okawa became shikken in 1349 DR after the conclusion of the Hojo War , where the Takenaka clan gained supremacy over the Hojo clan , putting a puppet shogun on the throne .

title: Takenaka Sugawara
description: Takenaka Sugawara Takenaka Sugawara was the hero of the Hojo War of Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Sugawara led the Takenaka clan armies to victory in the Hojo War but after the end of the war in 1349 DR , he was unable to ascend to the position of shikken because of his lack of blood ties to the shogun , a trait possessed instead by his half - brother , Takenaka Okawa .

title: Takht of the jann
description: Takht of the jann The takht of the jann was the collective term used when the five instruments of the jann were played together . Description . The " takht " consisted of a " qanun of the spirits " , a " riqq of the efreet " , a " rababah of the dao " , an " ' ud of the marids " , and a " nay of the djinn " .

title: Tako
description: Tako Tako were a race of intelligence octopi . They lived mostly in temperate and tropical aquatic terrains and usually traveled in war parties of two to seven , or tribes of eight to twenty . They were usually neutral towards other races .

title: Takshang
description: Takshang Takshang was a small hermitage located at the foot of Ghalyi Shan in the Hordelands . Description . The hermitage was located halfway up a cliff , tucked away in a cleft in the great mountain .

title: Takt Muren
description: Takt Muren The Takt Muren was a small river found in both the Hordelands and Shou Lung . Geography . The Takt Muren flowed slightly northeast from Nor Takt for several hundred miles within the far northern reaches of the Katakoro Plateau .

title: Tal Sey Lo
description: Tal Sey Lo Tal Sey Lo was a member of the Black Leopard Cult in 1358 DR . History . Tal Sey Lo was a Black Leopard merchant in the city of Pe Nok in T ' u Lung .

title: Tala al - Sunim
description: Tala al - Sunim Tala al - Sunim was a tax collector who worked at the Gulf Gate in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Though passed 60 years of age , Tala was as sharp as she was in her youth .

title: Tala bint Tufala
description: Tala bint Tufala Tala bint Tufala was a concubine of the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in 1367 DR . Description . Tala was beautiful , but where her appearance excelled her intelligence was lacking .

title: Talab
description: Talab The City of the Pantheon Talab lay on the source of the river Al - Muti . Situated at the crossroads between the League of the Pantheon , the Ruined Kingdoms and the Haunted Lands , visitors from very different cultures stopped here , while the inhabitants kept mainly to themselves . The so - called City of Questing was both home to a strong slave - trade and an important university specializing in Pantheist religion and medicine .

title: Talabrina Duskryn
description: Talabrina Duskryn Talabrina Duskryn was the main enemy of the deep gnome s re - settling Blingdenstone . Personality . Talabrina greatly hated the deep gnomes .

title: Talamic
description: Talamic Talamic was a bard of the 1360s DR . Talamic sang at the Griffin ' s Claw in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR . One of Talamic ' s songs was the " Lay of the Purple Dragons " .

title: Talana Taenfeather
description: Talana Taenfeather Talana Taenfeather was a member of the Waterdeep Guard , an elite unit of the city watch . She was a close friend of Araezra Hondyl , her commander . Talana was considered the fastest member of the guard and is usually the one who chased down suspects who fled .

title: Talane
description: Talane Talane was a beholder - kin accomplice of Manshoon in Suzail . History . Manshoon polymorph ed Talane into a human and she posed as Lady Deleira of the Truesilver noble house , acting to advance Manshoon ' s goals among Cormyr ' s nobles .

title: Talantra Bowgentle
description: Talantra Bowgentle Talantra Bowgentle was a bard based in Silverymoon and an active Harper . Description . Talantra stood 5 ft 6 in ( 168 cm ) , weighed 122 lb ( 55 kg ) , and had auburn hair and green eyes .

title: Talbot Uskevren
description: Talbot Uskevren Talbot Uskevren was the youngest of three children from the noble Uskevren family of Selgaunt and an actor in Mistress Quickly ' s theater acts in the Wide Realms . A warrior of moderate skill , he preferred to play the swashbuckling type in his plays , using flashy and fancy acrobatic moves . History .

title: Taleb Abd al - Jari
description: Taleb Abd al - Jari Taleb Abd al - Jari was a dwarven sergeant stationed in the armory of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Activities . Taleb rotated his guard duty with two other dwarven farisan .

title: Taleisin Starym
description: Taleisin Starym Taleisin Starym was a clan elder and Lord Protector of the Starym elven clan , uncle by marriage of Ysmyrl ' da Starym . He was a bladesinger and former member of the Akh ' Velahr as an " arykérym " cavalry . Taleisin , along with the clan heir Josidiah Starym were elves of great honour , and after the clan broke ties with the Coronal and most abandoned Myth Drannor , these two rebuilt the reputation of the family .

title: Talendar
description: Talendar The Talendars are the oldest , proudest noble family in Sembia . Among their enemies are the Uskevren family . Their family home , Old High Hall , is the biggest merchant - noble residence in Selgaunt .

title: Talfir
description: Talfir The Talfir were an extinct race of human s who once dwelt in the lands that later became known as the Western Heartlands . They were known as practitioners of shadow magic . Description .

title: Tali al - Jasmini
description: Tali al - Jasmini Tali al - Jasmini was a janni inhabiting the Lost City of Ubar within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Even among the widely attractive jann , Tali was considered to be quite beautiful .

title: Talia
description: Talia Talia was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Talia was an older monk in the Monastery of the Yellow Rose .

title: Talindra Amalith
description: Talindra Amalith Talindra Amalith was a wild elf and , as of 1374 DR , a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma , the guiding council of the Eldreth Veluuthra , who lived in the Methwood . She suffered due to the human adventurers in the area and led a cell of the Eldreth Veluuthra . She also recruited wild elves into the cell from the Chondalwood .

title: Talis
description: Talis Talis was a card game popular in Faerûn , being considered " one of the four universal games " along with draughts , chess , and dice . Description . It involved a deck of 78 cards , including four regular ( " planar " ) suits ( flames , stones , waves , and winds ) and one trump suit of 22 cards , called the major arcana .

title: Talis Kasterel
description: Talis Kasterel Talis Kasterel was a high - ranking member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Talis was raised by Galvan .

title: Talking bird
description: Talking bird Talking birds were fascinating creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These long - lived birds were highly intelligent , spending their years collecting information about their surroundings . They were even known to impart advice and wisdom to honorable people .

title: Tall Trees
description: Tall Trees Tall Trees was a northeastern section of the High Forest in northwest Faerûn . It was believed to contain the oldest trees in the High Forest . The Tall Trees area was a remnant of the long - ago elven realm of Eaerlann , which fell when the elves retreated to Evermeet .

title: Tall mouther
