description: Tall mouther Tall mouthers were aberration s found in the vicinity of halfling s . The halfling slang " They got mouthed " was a common way for halflings to explain that someone was killed by a tall mouther . Description .

title: Tallus
description: Tallus Tallus was an archmage at the House of Wonder in Waterdeep . He was in service to the dark god Asmodeus and the evil angel Sathariel . He hoped to achieve immortality by helping Sathariel complete the ritual of the First Flensing which would open the gates of Hell in Waterdeep .

title: Talmost
description: Talmost Talmost was a Waterdhavian house that was known as one of the city ' s foremost clothiers and furriers . They managed widespread trapping and fur - trading operations in the North and operated prosperous silk trading and crafting businesses in Calimshan . They had close ties to the League of Skinners and Tanners and the Solemn Order of Recognized Furriers and Woolmen .

title: Talon Everhale
description: Talon Everhale Talon Everhale was a young ranger in Icewind Dale , and a member of the Emerald Enclave during the Tyranny of Dragons of 1489 . History . Talon Everhale ' s mother died giving birth to her .

title: Talona
description: Talona Talona ( pronounced " tah - LOW - nah " ) , called the Lady of Poison , Mistress of Disease , and Mother of All Plagues , was the goddess of poison and disease . Talona was depicted as an old crone who brought misfortune and death . On the other hand , she could also be depicted as a beautiful and innocent woman .

title: Talons of Justice
description: Talons of Justice The Talons of Justice were an order of silver dragon paladin s dedicated to Xymor and who followed the " Ptarian Code " . Dogma . The " Ptarian Code " was originally an oath taken only by those who served the King of Justice , but eventually it was adopted by members of the gold and silver dragon species .

title: Talor Vurtalis
description: Talor Vurtalis Talor Vurtalis was one of the new aquatic elf high mages in Myth Nantar . History . In 1341 DR Talor was accepted as new student by the High Mages Taranath Reefglamor and Yrlimn Tidark together with Jhanra Merlistar and Keryth Adofaer .

title: Talos
description: Talos Talos ( pronounced " TAAHL - ose " ) , also known as The Storm Lord ( and long ago as Kozah ) , was the Faerûnian greater deity of storms and destruction . His dogma was self - serving , demanding utter obedience from his priests and instructing them to spread destruction where they might . His followers were known as Talassans .

title: Talryn
description: Talryn Talryn Heltharn was a prince of Impiltur . Relationships . Prince Talryn was the first son of King Imphras II and Lasheela of Dilpur .

title: Taluth
description: Taluth Taluth was a younger malaugrym , ( a . k . a .

title: Talya Floshin
description: Talya Floshin Talya Floshin was one of the leaders of the daemonfey in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Talya was the consort of Faersynd Floshin .

title: Talzir
description: Talzir Talzir was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Talzir was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee .

title: Tam Zawad
description: Tam Zawad Tam Zawad is a Harper and priest of Selûne living in the Sword Coast region of Faerûn . Description . Tam is described as a tall , thin middle aged man with brown skin and curly dark hair with some grey in it .

title: Tamal
description: Tamal Tamal was the young prince of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Tamal was still immature .

title: Tamalin Zoar
description: Tamalin Zoar Tamalin Zoar was a member of the Zoar family and the ruler of Calling Horns sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Tamalin bought the Calling Horn inn and retired to live there .

title: Tamalynda
description: Tamalynda Tamalynda , or the Whisperer , was a High Lady of the marrash in 1367 DR . Personality . Tamalynda was a prideful marrashi who was not quick to trust others .

title: Tamanokuni
description: Tamanokuni Tamanokuni was the largest city and the capital of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . In that year , there lived in the city more than 10 , 000 people divided into eight wards . Tamanokuni housed the residence of Niwa Hirotada and the most important shrines of Miyama .

title: Tamara
description: Tamara Tamara ( pronounced " Tuh - MAH - ruh " ) was the neutral good dragon goddess of life , light , mercy , and forgiveness . She was the consort of Lendys , and was commonly worshiped alongside him and Bahamut , who in some traditions was considered to be their son . Description .

title: Tamarand
description: Tamarand Tamarand was a gold great wyrm who was the King of Justice as of 1479 DR . Before that , he served as the second - in - comand to the former king , the gold dragon Lareth . Tamarand was also a chosen of Bahamut and a recurrent ally of the Talons of Justice .

title: Tamer Creed
description: Tamer Creed The Tamer Creed was one of the major illithid Creeds in the Realms . They were highly militaristic , and favored the use of martial might against other races . Oryndoll .

title: Tamiel
description: Tamiel Tamiel was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Tamiel and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Tammar
description: Tammar Tammar was a large town in Thesk . As of 1372 DR , it had a population of 3 , 594 . It was razed by the Tuigan Horde and subsequently besieged by bandits who took heavy tolls from passing caravans .

title: Tammas Forkbeard
description: Tammas Forkbeard Tammas Forkbeard was a dwarf and the daughter of King Daurvos Frostbeard of the Ironstar clan . Relatives . Tammas ' s father was Daurvos Frostbeard , king of the Ironstar clan .

title: Tammith Iltazyarra
description: Tammith Iltazyarra Tammith Iltazyarra was a vampire and lover of the bard Bareris Anskuld . Tammith the human . Until 1375 DR , Tammith was a beautiful young woman and from the Rashemi underclass of Bezantur .

title: Tamnaeuth
description: Tamnaeuth Tamnaeuth is an elf armourer who lives in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet where he operates an armoury . He creates sword s and mail and plate armour . Most of his pieces are enchanted .

title: Tamoko
description: Tamoko Tamoko was Sarevok ' s lover who did not wish for him to attempt to ascend to godhood , and for that reason ended up being abandoned by him in favor of Cythandria . Description . Tamoko was under 5 feet ( 1 .

title: Tamood al - Kasif
description: Tamood al - Kasif Tamood al - Kasif lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tamood was a learned sha ' ir and instructor who worked with Adnan al - Raqi , learning the advanced skills of his order .

title: Tamper Tencoin
description: Tamper Tencoin Tamper Tencoin was a wayward Harper . Activities . Tamper was a wily adventurer who sometimes acted as a joker and other times patiently waited in order to enact vengeance .

title: Tamr na - Fia
description: Tamr na - Fia Tamr na - Fia lived in the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Relationships . Tamr was the favorite student of Adnan al - Raqi , who looked upon her as his own granddaughter .

title: Tamura Tenryu
description: Tamura Tenryu Tamura Tenryu was a samurai of Fochu Peninsula in Wa around 1358 DR . Activities . Tamura Tenryu was the shoya of the village of Ayoi in Fochu Peninsula .

title: Tamura Umakai
description: Tamura Umakai Tamura Umakai was a wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Tamura Umakai was the shoya of the village of Ikizawa in Fochu Peninsula .

title: Tanagyr ' s Stout
description: Tanagyr ' s Stout Tanagyr ' s Stout was a stout beer brewed in the Moonsea region . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Tanalasta Obarskyr
description: Tanalasta Obarskyr Tanalasta Obarskyr ( known informally as Tanny or Tana ) was the eldest daughter of King Azoun IV and Filfaeril Obarskyr . She was the heir of the throne of Cormyr until her death in 1371 . It was rumored that she was having a secret romance with Aunadar Bleth .

title: Tanar ' ri
description: Tanar ' ri The tanar ' ri were the dominant subcategory of demon s . Originally created by the obyrith s as slaves , they eventually revolted against their masters , killing most of them and taking over as the dominant race of demons in the Abyss . Most known demon lord s were tanar ' ri .

title: Tanaroo Quinson
description: Tanaroo Quinson Tanaroo Quinson was a gnome illusionist in the Bloodstone Lands around 1357 DR and 1359 DR . Activities . Tanaroo was the assistant of Doctor Trundles in managing the Circus of Doctor Trundles , a collection of monsters .

title: Tanarukk
description: Tanarukk Tanarukks were orc s whose blood had been tainted by an evil outsider , in many cases a tanar ' ri demon . Physical Description . They appeared as short , stocky orcs with bristly hair , horns , or ridges along the sides of their heads .

title: Tanataskar Moonwind
description: Tanataskar Moonwind Tanataskar Moonwind was a curse d tavern owner in Yartar in 1370 DR . History . Once Tanataksar was an adventurer devotee of Tempus but offended the god for his pride and Tempus cursed him : whenever he draw blood in a fight he went berseker , also during this time a continuous rain of broken weapons pours from Tanataskar ' s body but with no consequence for him .

title: Tanathras
description: Tanathras Tanathras was a Netherese flying enclave . It was destroyed in −647 when the city ' s " mythallar " was disintegrate d by double agents working against Tanathras ' s ruler . Geography .

title: Tanetal
description: Tanetal Tanetal was a pit fiend and servant of Bane . History . Servant of the wizard .

title: Tangled Trees
description: Tangled Trees The Tangled Trees was one of the four old elven communities of Cormanthyr ( the others were the Elven Court , Myth Drannor , and Semberholme ) in the great forest of Cormanthor . Hundreds of elves still occupied the area in the 14th century DR , but they were extremely hostile to outsiders and were likely to attack on sight . The elves of the Tangled Trees typically worshiped Rillifane Rallathil .

title: Tangled Webs
description: Tangled Webs Tangled Webs is the second book in the Starlight and Shadows trilogy by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The novel opens with Liriel Baenre rescuing Hrolf the Unruly from prison in Skullport to his ship , the " Elfmaid " .

title: Tanglehair
description: Tanglehair Tanglehair was a deep gnome in Zortagra during the late 1480s DR . History . She was captured with her fellows by duergar in the mid - 1480s DR and put to work in the recently conquered city of Zortagra .

title: Tanis Keltronn
description: Tanis Keltronn Tanis Keltronn was a human male and the head of the Keltronn mercantile family in Eshpurta , which gave him a seat on the Shield Council as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . He was a distant cousin of the powerful Argrim family of Athkatla who made his reputation in the food and wine markets through ruthless negotiation .

title: Tanistan
description: Tanistan Tanistan Barony was a part of the monarchy of Erlkazar encompassing the Plains of Pehrrifaal . Description . This barony was responsible for the defense of the country ' s southern borders .

title: Tanjus
description: Tanjus Tanjus was a sea hag in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . She wanted to expand the territory that she controlled by any means , even if it meant helping adventurers .

title: Tann
description: Tann Commander Tann was a human commander of Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . Tann was the commander of Fort Locke until he vanished on a patrol .

title: Tannin
description: Tannin Tannin was a human bard and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . History . In 1364 DR , Tannin was killed by the red dragon Rylatar ' ralah ' tyma when she attacked the caravan he was with just outside of Hill ' s Edge .

title: Tannivh Irithyl
description: Tannivh Irithyl Tannivh Irithyl was fifth Coronal of Cormanthyr , ruling from - 791 DR to - 223 DR . He is known for having successfully routed the drow form the Twisted Tower in - 331 DR , passing control of the tower to followers of Eilistraee . In gratitude to the reformed and surface - acclimatized drow who helped in the downfall of the tower , he granted them rights to settle remote woods east of Cormanthor .

title: Tannous al - Assad
description: Tannous al - Assad Prince Tannous was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Tannous was lean from frequent exercise and appeared younger than he really was .

title: Tannuth Ormbyr
description: Tannuth Ormbyr Tannuth Ormbyr is the owner of The Net of Pearls , a curios store in Marsember , Cormyr . He has visible scars , and can find adventurers or mercenaries for a fee , or offer his services to retrieve people or items imprisoned or confiscated by the Crown . He knows a lot about Marsember , but will only talk about its history , refusing to talk about the present - day city .

title: Tanova
description: Tanova Tanova was transformed into a vampire by Bodhi , after Jon Irenicus met her in Baldur ' s Gate . Gorion ' s Ward fought her in the torture chamber in Bodhi ' s lair and defeated her . However , she was not fully slain .

title: Tanshiver Brynleaf
description: Tanshiver Brynleaf Tanshiver " the Bard " Brynleaf " was a human man living in Calaunt in the Vast around 1358 DR . Despite the nickname , Tanshiver was actually a sage who specialized in folklore of human cultures and music from around the Dragon Reach . He worked from his office , known as Tanshiver ' s Corner , on Turncobble Street .

title: Tanta Hagara
description: Tanta Hagara Tanta Hagara was an evil annis who worked her way into the Blue Bear tribe of the Uthgardt . A servant of Hellgate Keep and Grintharke , she corrupted the tribe with base rituals while posing as their shaman , to such an extant that the tribe were shunned by the rest of the Uthgardt . She sought the Grandfather Tree , an ancient embodiment of the forest , reputed to hold the Hall of Mists , a temple dating back to the creator races .

title: Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters
description: Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters The Tantran Guild of Merchant Masters was a guild in the city of Tantras in the Vast , located in the north - east corner and active around 1358 DR . The guild was a private club for Tantran citizens who owned and operated merchant fleets , though anyone could become a member . The membership fees were 200 gp per year .

title: Tantran finefish
description: Tantran finefish Tantran finefish was a type of fish prepared in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Those who didn ' t enjoy it disparaged it as silvermuck . The fish were caught locally , then spiced and pickled .

title: Tantras
description: Tantras Tantras was a city on the east coast of the Dragon Reach between Calaunt and Ravens Bluff . Etymology & Language . People and things from Tantras were called " Tantran " or " Tantrasan " .

title: Tantras Trail
description: Tantras Trail The Tantras Trail , also called the Lion ' s Walk , was a trail that ran through the Vast , connecting the city of Tantras and the village of Highbank Forest . From west to east , it began at Tantras , ran through Orlimmin , and ended at Highbank Forest . On the way , it linked with the Cross Road , Coast Road , the Long Reach , and Feldar ' s Trail .

title: Tantuss Shieldsun
description: Tantuss Shieldsun Tantuss Shieldsun was an adventurer and guide who operated in the North . Description . Tantuss was a notably tall man , his face framed with black hair and a bushy beard .

title: Tanya bint Perijan
description: Tanya bint Perijan Tanya bint Perijan was one of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s favorite wives . Her dowry for her engagement to the Grand Caliph was a staggering 500 , 000 " dinar s " , instantly propelling her family to prominent status among the elite of Huzuz . Description .

title: Tanyl Evanara
description: Tanyl Evanara Tanyl Evanara was an elven chief war wizard of the Tower of the Sun on Evermeet . Description . Tanyl was tall and thin even by elven standards .

title: Tapann
description: Tapann Tapann was the patron deity of korred s . His symbol was a laughing mouth . Description .

title: Tapestry of folded existence
description: Tapestry of folded existence Tapestries of folded existence were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .

title: Tapeyzin
description: Tapeyzin Chief Tapeyzin was the founder of the Maztica n city of Michaca . He recognized that the abundance of gold in the area was causing men to become greedy and try to obtain personal wealth , and instead decided to use the gold to build a city that would serve as a tribute to the .

title: Tappeng
description: Tappeng Tappeng was a chieftain in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Tappeng was the chieftain of the Kabundusil tribe , one of the most savage Bawani tribes .

title: Tappy Foamstrap
description: Tappy Foamstrap Tappy Foamstrap was an innkeeper in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Tappy was very bored because nothing ever seemed to happen in his inn .

title: Tar ' Ael Veluuthra
description: Tar ' Ael Veluuthra Tar ’ Ael Veluuthra , or Whetstone of the Blade or Whetstone of the Victorious Blade , was a spellbook containing some spell s designed for members of the Eldreth Veluuthra and also allowed crafting " humanbane " arrows for those with normally insufficient skill . Description . The entire book had a bend that looked as though it could and was carried around in a scroll tube .

title: Tar Hurara
description: Tar Hurara Tar Hurara was a human fighter and the leader of the town of Priapurl on the Dragon Coast in 1372 DR . History . Hurara was descended from bandits but she sought to reach true nobility .

title: Tara ' a
description: Tara ' a Tara ' a was a tasked artist genie working within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tara ' s artistic specialization revolved around cooking .

title: Tara el Viilam
description: Tara el Viilam Tara yr Meriel el Viilam , who became known as Tara of the Burning Mists , was the creator of the Bottlemist Plague , which killed thousands of people in Almraiven in the Year of the Tankard ( 1370 DR ) . Several other acts of terrorism were afterward attributed to her as well . Relationships .

title: Taradril Aumraven
description: Taradril Aumraven Taradril Aumraven was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR and a former Lord of Zhentil Keep . Personality . Taradril had a mercantile view of the Zhentarim and for this he supported Sememmon as the main Zhentarim leader .

title: Tarag
description: Tarag Tarag was a merrow chieftain of Serôs in the 6th century DR . History . Tarag somehow came into the possession of the sword " Ilbratha " , the legendary lost sword of King Azoun I of Cormyr .

title: Taragarth
description: Taragarth Taragarth , nicknamed the Bloodbrand , was a unique magic bastard sword or short sword . Description . The blade of " Taragarth " appeared as if it had been tarnished by fire , save for along its edges , which gleamed .

title: Taraj Hurlymm
description: Taraj Hurlymm Taraj Hurlymm was a male wizard who was one of the magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . Activities . Taraj ' s hobby was taking beast - shape and stalking men and women as if they were prey .

title: Tarana Lyr
description: Tarana Lyr Tarana Lyr was a female human sorceress and a worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . History . Tarana was a crazy sorceress in the service of Bane during the god ' s assault on Tantras .

title: Tarandor Delhame
description: Tarandor Delhame Tarandor Delhame was a powerful mage living in Iriaebor as of 1479 DR . He was the former apprentice of the apprentice of the arch mage Merithius who trapped Jack Ravenwild in the mythal beneath Ravens Bluff in 1367 DR . In 1479 DR the High House of Magic learned that Jack had escaped his confinement in the mythal and notified Tarandor who was obligated to his master to recapture Jack .

title: Tarangu
description: Tarangu The Tarangu was a tribe of halfling s who inhabited an area of Jazayir al - Sartan in southwest Zakhara . Organization . The Tarangu did not build permanent structures on the ground .

title: Tarask
description: Tarask Tarask was a fighter in Phlan in 1340 DR . History . Tarask had been in the service of Cadorna House since his youth .

title: Tarathiel
description: Tarathiel Tarathiel was a moon elf from Moonvines in the Moonwood . Physical description . Tarathiel was not tall , and had an angular face with rich blue eyes and very pale skin .

title: Taraz
description: Taraz Taraz the Fair was an efreeti trapped in Xonthal ' s Tower by the wizard Xonthal circa 1380 DR . History . Xonthal disappeared and Taraz remained trapped in the tower .

title: Tarbaw Nighthill
description: Tarbaw Nighthill Tarbaw Nighthill was a human and the governor of the small town of Greenest , located in the Western Heartlands of west Faerûn . Description . Tarbaw was a noble , some sixty - odd winters old who usually dressed in a blue tunic .

title: Tarchamus ' volcano
description: Tarchamus ' volcano Tarchamus ' volcano was an extremely powerful spell created by the legendary Netherese arcanist Tarchamus . The spell harnessed the power of Phlegethos to create a volcano capable of destroying cities . In approximately - 3500 DR , Tarchamus used the spell to destroy the floating Netherese city of Tenish .

title: Tarchamus the Unyielding
description: Tarchamus the Unyielding Tarchamus the Unyielding was a legendary Netherese arcanist who lived approximately 5 , 000 years before 1478 DR . Tarchamus was so powerful he was able to directly harness the power of other planes to rain destruction on his enemies . History .

title: Tardeth Llanistaph
description: Tardeth Llanistaph Lord Tardeth Llanistaph was Duke of Suretmarch , just chancellor of Tethyr , and one of the original members and a leader of the Company of Eight . He was greatly respected as a national hero across most of Tethyr . Description .

title: Tareen Kafour
description: Tareen Kafour Tareen Kafour ( pronounced " tuh - REEN KAY - fur " ) was a barkeeper in Mulmaster . History . Originally from Phlan , Tareen was forced to escape to Mulmaster after Vorgansharax ' s coup .

title: Tarek Wingspur
description: Tarek Wingspur Tarek is a wizard currently living in Zhentil Keep ( 1374 ) . He is a known shadow weave user . History .

title: Targ Keifer
description: Targ Keifer Targ Keifer was the chieftain of the Griffon Tribe in the 15th century DR . History . In 1484 DR , Targ discussed an alliance with Giselle Malcomb of Nesme , sensing the coming of the War of the Silver Marches .

title: Targaraene
description: Targaraene Targaraene is Scyllua Darkhope ' s nightmare , a fiendish servant that serves as her mount . Appearance . Targaraene looks like a large , powerful horse with a pale white coat .

title: Targos
description: Targos Targos was the second - largest city of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale . Geography . The city sits on the southernmost shore of the Maer Dualdon along a series of high cliff walls that shelter its port from the savage winter winds .

title: Targrael
description: Targrael Targrael was a former High Knight of Cormyr who later became a death knight . In 1479 DR , Manshoon dominated her mind and compelled her to place the kingdom ' s two highest ranking war wizards into magical stasis and hide them in a crypt beneath the palace . She broke free of Manshoon ' s mind control and set about to protect Cormyr according to her own warped code of honor .

title: Tarik al Farid al Fuqani
description: Tarik al Farid al Fuqani Tarik al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyr ian human from Myratma . Appearance . Tarik had dusky skin and straight jet - black hair in a short pony tail .

title: Tarkas Thallavv
description: Tarkas Thallavv Tarkas Thallavv was the Gemayor of Keczulla in Amn in 1362 DR and secretly a Cowled Wizard . History . Tarkas once was an administrator for the Vinson family , but while their influence dwindled , Tarkas ' s powers grew .

title: Tarkhaldale
description: Tarkhaldale Tarkhaldale was considered one of the dales in the Dalelands , despite being located between Anauroch and the Dalelands . It was generally unmarked on maps , but was located west of Shadowdale . History .

title: Tarkos Ree
description: Tarkos Ree Tarkos Ree was a crime lord in Damara in 1359 DR . Activities . Tarkos was the head of the Tightpurse thieves guild , being probably the most powerful being in Heliogabalus .

title: Tarl Desanea
description: Tarl Desanea Tarl Desanea was a blind , retired adventurer who lived in the city of Phlan with his wife Shal Desanea . History . Tarl was a cleric of Tyr from Vaasa who began his training in his order when he and his fellow brethren were tasked with transporting the Hammer of Tyr .

title: Tarmalune
description: Tarmalune The largest of the Windrise Ports , Tarmalune was a huge , cosmopolitan port city located in the southeastern shores of Returned Abeir , considered by its inhabitants to be the rival of Faerûn ian Waterdeep in wealth , tolerant outlook , entrepreneurial spirit , the ambition of its residents , and the sheer number of constantly unfolding opportunities that presented to the inhabitants of the city . The city bustled with activity and its streets were crowded day and night with merchants , traders , adventurers , nobles and commoners alike . History .

title: Tarman
description: Tarman Tarman the Old was the Emir of Phannaskul during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Sadly , Tarman spent most of his time reliving his glory days as a warrior instead of actually administering the city .

title: Tarmas
description: Tarmas Tarmas was a male human wizard of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Desciption . Tarmas was balding and generally adopted a sour expression .

title: Tarmas ' home
description: Tarmas ' home Tarmas ' home was one of the houses in the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North . It belonged to Tarmas . Location .

title: Tarmel Drouth
description: Tarmel Drouth Tarmel Drouth was the bastard second son of Rancelair Illance of House Illance of Cormyr . His mother , Asla Drouth was a barmaid in the dockside district of Suzail . Personality .

title: Tarna Calfi
description: Tarna Calfi Tarna Calfi was an inhabitant of Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Tarna was the harbormaster of the Caliph ' s Harbor in Huzuz .

title: Tarnheel Embuirhan
description: Tarnheel Embuirhan Tarnheel Embuirhan was the tyrant of Mintarn and was reputed to be one of the best swordsmen of the Realms . History . Tarnheel was intrigued when the " Sea Sprite " of Captain Deudermont arrived in Mintarn in search of information about the mythical isle of Caerwich because he knew that Drizzt Do ' Urden was onboard .

title: Tarnmark Lionmantle
description: Tarnmark Lionmantle Tarnmark Lionmantle was a War Wizard of Cormyr in 1487 DR . History . Tarnmark ' s mission involved spying on Lord Sardasper Halaunt .

title: Tarntar
description: Tarntar The Tarntar were a group of wealthy wizard s and merchants from Sembia that formed an illicit trading association that dabbled in slavery , smuggling , warehouse heists , and kidnapping of noble Sembian children and youths . It is unknown when this highly secretive cabal was formed , but it was known to be operating during the 1360s DR at least . History .

title: Tarntassa
description: Tarntassa Tarntassa was a human woman of the city of Tantras in the Vast . She was a mage and adventurer . Home .

title: Tarntassa ' s Tower
description: Tarntassa ' s Tower Tarntassa ' s Tower was a mage ' s tower in the city of Tantras in the Vast , standing off Sandril ' s Lane in the western side of the city . It was the home the adventurer - mage Tarntassa . Tarntassa was a friend to the Harpers .

title: Taroo
description: Taroo Taroo the Farmhand was a farmer in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Taroo was an honest man .

title: Tarr Burnig
description: Tarr Burnig Lord Tarr Burnig was a member of the Burnig Cormyr ean noble family . Description . Tarr was a large , musclebound man with a bushy red beard .

title: Tarrasque
description: Tarrasque The tarrasque was the most terrible creature known to inhabit the Prime Material Plane . A full fifty feet tall and seventy feet long quadruped with a long tail , reflective carapace , and two large horns on its head , the tarrasque was created by the primordial s as a weapon of destruction during the Dawn War , with the purpose of undoing the stability instilled in the world by the god s so that the primordials could remake it . Fortunately , the primordials created only one tarrasque , which slumbered within the world ' s core .

title: Tarsith
description: Tarsith Tarsith was a port city and a member of the confederation of the Dusk Ports in Returned Abeir . It was also one of the most important fishing cities in the region . Geography .

title: Tart
description: Tart Tarts were palm - sized pastry shells that were baked in Waterdeep . They were available for sale through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Tarterus
description: Tarterus Tarterus , also known as Carceri , was an Outer Plane in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between chaotic evil and neutral evil . Situated between Hades and the Abyss , Tarterus was a plane of contention between the warring demon s and daemon s but few of those interlopers would challenge the native demodand s . The Companions of the Hall entered Tarterus by means of the Taros Hoop in " The Halfling ' s Gem " .

title: Tartha
description: Tartha Tartha was a fire giant duchess sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Tartha was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Tarul Var
description: Tarul Var Tarul Var was a lich necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Daggerford in 1486 DR . History . Tarul was tasked with recreating the elemental portal nexus in Daggerford .

title: Tash ' kla
description: Tash ' kla Tash ' kla was a priestess of Eilistraee . History . Tash ' kla was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden .

title: Tasha ( monk )
description: Tasha ( monk ) Tasha was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Tasha was a thief in her youth , but in time she redeemed herself , becoming a monk at the monastery .

title: Tashalan
description: Tashalan The Tashalans were a native human race of the Chultan Peninsula and the primary inhabitants of " the Tashalar " . Description . The Tashalans were generally considered a beautiful race by other human cultures .

title: Tashalan language
description: Tashalan language The Tashalan language , called Akûrian , was a human language spoken in Tashalar and other parts of the Chultan Peninsula . Speakers . The Tashalan tongue was spoken in a region from Samarach in the west to the Mhair Jungle s in the east and from Narubel in the north to Mhairhetel in the south .

title: Tashalar
description: Tashalar Tashalar was a small , exotic country located on a strip of coast along the southern Shining Sea . It lay just east of the Chult peninsula , and west of the magic realm of Halruaa . It was famous for beautiful weather , beautiful people , excellent crossbows , and the richest wine - producing region in the world .

title: Task
description: Task Task ( pronounced " TASK " ) was the chaotic evil dragon god of greed and selfishness . Description . Task usually manifested as a huge dragon whose hide was so studded with coins and gem s from snout to tail that it was impossible to determine the color of his scales .

title: Taska Sonadora
description: Taska Sonadora Taska Sonadora was a sea captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Taska was an insane noble who wanted to use all her wealth on bold and foolish adventures .

title: Tasked genie
description: Tasked genie Many tasked genies were once members of the four elemental realms . Over time they changed in appearance and form as a result of performing the specific tasks for which they were used . Tasked genies removed from their work suffered adverse effects including weakness , insanity , and even death .

title: Taskerleigh
description: Taskerleigh Taskerleigh was a village located not far from Waterdeep . Geography . Taskerleigh was located on the northern side of the convergence of the Unicorn Run and the River Delimbiyr .

title: Tasloi
description: Tasloi Tasloi are humanoid jungle - dwellers whose race is thought to be thousands of years old . While very quick and nimble between the trees , tasloi are easily dazzled in bright sunlight , preferring to stay below the jungle canopy . Despite this , tasloi do possess low - light vision .

title: Taslythor Rocktapper
description: Taslythor Rocktapper Taslythor Rocktapper , who also went by the name Paerro , was a pickpocket and burglar within the city of Waterdeep in 1372 . Quickly falling into the life of a thief through necessity , Paerro eventually became quite skilled under the tutelage of Thear Chessar . It had been so long since he had been caught by the City Watch that they believed Paerro had left the City of Splendors .

title: Tasseldale
description: Tasseldale Tasseldale was one of the dales in the Dalelands . Its capital was Tegal ' s Mark . In the 15th century DR the dale was controlled by Sembia .

title: Tatak
description: Tatak Tatak was a desert dwarf from the House of Tezca desert in Maztica . History . After the Night of Wailing in 1361 DR , Tatak and his chieftain Luskag were checking a new water source when they were attacked by a Viperhands ogre .

title: Tatalla
description: Tatalla Tatallas , meaning “ the eye ” , were tiny sinister creatures found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . These creatures often found roles as spies or assassins . Description .

title: Tatigan Carrlock
description: Tatigan Carrlock Tatigan Carrlock was a human merchant living in the Shadowfell section of Ikemmu , a shadar - kai city . Activities . He specialized in providing the shadar - kai with exotic goods that stimulated their senses .

title: Tattoo of power
description: Tattoo of power Tattoo of power was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . Wizard s used this spell to store spells within special tattoos .

title: Tau
description: Tau Tau was a member of the Cult of the Black Earth sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Tau and his fellow Shardra mounting two bulette went to One Stone spirit mound wanting claim the relic in the name of Ogrémoch .

title: Tauk Kodagai
description: Tauk Kodagai Tauk Kodagai was a korobokuru bushi adventurer in Shou Lung . Personality . Tauk liked wilderness , not being comfortable in huge cities and with more cultured people around her .

title: Taulmaril
description: Taulmaril Taulmaril , also known as the Heartseeker , was Catti - brie ' s magic bow , which passed on to Drizzt after her death ( and remained with him even after her rebirth ) . Description . Longbow .

title: Taunissik
description: Taunissik Taunissik was a small kuo - toa colony of Olleth located in Serôs . Geography . Taunissik was a deep atoll , with massive coral growths on a submerged mountain .

title: Tauran
description: Tauran Tauran was an astral deva in service to Tyr until his faith was shaken in the events leading up to the death of Mystra . He was the mentor of the half - drow knight Kael . History .

title: Taurgosz Khosann
description: Taurgosz Khosann Taurgosz Khosann was the leader of the Blacktalons , a mercenary company based in Iriaebor . Description . He stood over 7 ft ( 2 .

title: Tavaray
description: Tavaray Tavaray ( or the Free City of Tavaray ) was a human settlement on the later site of the Lizard Marsh at the mouth of the River Delimbiyr . It was established in - 50 DR by settlers from Ruathym . This sparked a wave of settlement along the Sword Coast North .

title: Tavern
description: Tavern A place where people go to eat and drink , some couple as inns as well . Usually there is one per town and there are many in large cities . Often in a city there are low - end taverns and high - end taverns , depending on where the tavern is located .

title: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon
description: Tavern of the Flagon Dragon The Tavern of the Flagon Dragon was a tavern in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep , not far from Blackstaff Tower . Location . The two story tavern was located in the northern section of the Castle Ward on Darselune Street about a block from the Sleepy Slyph .

title: Tavilar
description: Tavilar Tavilar was a village in the Vast , located on the Hunt Trail between Ylraphon and Kurth , south of the Flooded Forest . The Pass Trail led to Blanaer . History .

title: Tawar Kroul
description: Tawar Kroul Tawar Kroul was the main representative of surface - dwellers in Mantol - Derith in 1479 DR . Activities . Tawar usually sold alcohol in exchange for art objects , poisons , and obsidian daggers .

title: Taxatl
description: Taxatl Taxatl was an exotic Maztican concubine of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz in 1367 DR . History . Taxatl was originally a plumaweaver from distant Maztica .

title: Tayanulchi
description: Tayanulchi The Tayanulchi , also spelled Tayanuchi , were a tribe of human s living in the Ama Basin in the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . They split from the Issacortae and disappeared into the Land of the Snow Demons centuries before the 14th century DR . Society .

title: Tayrom Onetry
description: Tayrom Onetry Tayrom Onetry was a human man who lived in the town of Elmwood in the Moonsea in the mid – 14th century . He was proprietor of the Grange trading emporium . History .

title: Tazlan Rilzeer
description: Tazlan Rilzeer Tazlan Rilzeer was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zaldar was the captain of the " Coin Toss " , of propriety of the noble Arilosa Adarbrent , a financier of the Order of the Gauntlet .

title: Tazmikella
description: Tazmikella Tazmikella was a copper dragon who lived in the Bloodstone Lands . Appearance . Her human form was that of a rather ordinary looking , middle - aged woman with once - strawberry - blond , mostly soft - gray hair , dressed in simple clothes .

title: Tazok
description: Tazok Tazok was a half - ogre bandit leader and an important follower of Sarevok . History . Tazok was already the leader of a band of brigands .

title: Tazu - ei
description: Tazu - ei Tazu - ei was a barbarian in Machukara around 1357 DR . History . Tazu - ei born from a noble family in Nakamaru on isle of Tsukishima .

title: Tchandrae Euinwood
description: Tchandrae Euinwood Tchandrae Euinwood was a girl with strange powers in Kheldell in 1370 DR . She possessed unusual powers : simply by touching an item , Tchandarae would know things about it , similarly to the " legend lore " spell . She was examined by Elminster Aumar in person , who said her powers had no clear origin but he was sure she was blessed by Mystra .

title: Tchazar
description: Tchazar Tchazar was the " Realms " name for which occurred in long , prism - shaped crystals that were straw - yellow and very fragile . Description . A of great skill was required to cut gems from this semi - precious stone .

title: Tchazzar
description: Tchazzar Tchazzar ( pronounced cha - zar ) was a red dragon mythic sovereign who posed as a human warlord and eventually became a god for a time . Appearance . Despite his age , Tchazzar had the vigor of a red dragon in its prime .

title: Tea
description: Tea Tea was a traditional beverage from Shou Lung . Two varieties were available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Tear of Selûne
description: Tear of Selûne The Tear of Selûne was a major artifact of both great value and power that naturally made any magic in its vicinity more intense and dangerous . When combined with three other magical items , it could also be used to bring about great destructive force against evildoers . Description .

title: Teardrops
description: Teardrops The Teardrops was the name given to a series of small lakes found within the eastern half of Narfell as well as the western borderlands of Rashemen . Geography . The lakes of the Teardrops were strewn in a roughly linear pattern found due east of Hark ' s Finger .

title: Tearfall
description: Tearfall The Tearfall , also known as ileleste ( falling rain , in Elven ) , the changing of the stars , the seven - turn winter , or the month of mist , was a planet - wide disaster that struck Abeir - Toril in the final millennium of the Days of Thunder . It was widely believed dragonkind was created as a consequence of the Tearfall . History .

title: Tears of Selûne
description: Tears of Selûne The Tears of Selûne is an asteroid cluster , visible from the surface of Abeir - Toril that follows the moon Selûne in its orbit around the planet . Description . From Toril , although Selûne appears to be about the size of a human fist an arm ' s length away , the Tears of Selûne span almost three handspans wide and three fingers deep at the same distance .

title: Tears of fire
description: Tears of fire Tears of fire was a flame evocation spell used by members of the Brotherhood of the True Flame in Zakhara . Effects . This spell created 2 - 5 spheres of fire .

title: Tebryn Dhialael
description: Tebryn Dhialael Tebryn Dhialael , also known as Dalael ) or the Shadowstalker , was a vampire and member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . Tebryn ' s skin was not as dark as a normal drow ' s but enough to betray his origin , as did his white hair .

title: Teelah
description: Teelah Teelah was a dancer at the Moonstone Mask . Biography . She had aspirations to study dance at the conservatory in Waterdeep , but lacked the money to pay for it .

title: Teeth
description: Teeth Teeth were an ogre mercenary company based in Stonelands . Organization . The Teeth were organized in units of 19 warriors and a sergeant , all reporting to Jadron , that decided if merge the units or no .

title: Teeth of the Wind
description: Teeth of the Wind The Teeth of the Wind was an armed militia from the djinn freehold s and the Citadel of Ice and Steel . Organization . The exact numbers of the Teeth of the Wind was unknown , though it was believed to be in the tens of thousands .

title: Tegan
description: Tegan Tegan was an escaped slave in the Deep Wastes . History . Tegan and her brother Drystan were two farmers in the Dalelands until , five years before the Rage of Demons , they were captured in an orc raid .

title: Tehrinna
description: Tehrinna Tehrinna was a human female and the proprietor of The Lake Spirits , a bathhouse and inn in Amnwater , Amn , circa 1368 DR . She had a sweet nature and flame red hair , and was only 1 . 37m ( 4 ' 6 " ) tall , but she was muscular and was able to eject most troublemakers .

title: Teirflin Armgo
description: Teirflin Armgo Teirflin Armgo was the son of Sinnafain and Tos ' un Armgo . Description . Teirflin kept his head shaved .

title: Tekinjo Gasahan
description: Tekinjo Gasahan Tekinjo Gasahan was the daimyo of Kurahito around 1357 DR . History . Tekinjo was the daimyo of the coastal Kurahito province and as the brother - in - law of the shogun one of the Three House daimyos .

title: Tekinjo Yojairo
description: Tekinjo Yojairo Tekinjo Yojairo was a samurai in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Yojairo was the son of Tekinjo Gasahan , one of the Three House daimyos , and for this , from around 1347 DR , he was appointed as military governor of the imperial residence at Rukimbaru , acting as liaison between the emperor and the shogun .

title: Tekir
description: Tekir Tekir was a sahuagin malenti living in the Great Sea near a zaratan around the Corsair Domains in 1367 DR . Activities . Tekir guarded the island formed by the zaratan ' s shell from intruders , questioning any who approached .

title: Tekthyrios
description: Tekthyrios Tekthyrios was a storm dragon living in a temple on Celestia . History . A portal was located in Tekthyrios ' s belly that was connected to the inside of a giant snake in the City of Brass in the Elemental Plane of Fire .

title: Tel ' kiira
description: Tel ' kiira A tel ' kiira ( also telkiira , plural tel ' kiira or telkiira ) is a small gemstone that can be used to magically store the thoughts or memories of an individual , or arcane lore or knowledge . Usually one merely needs to touch the stone to reveal its contents , but it is also possible to guard the contents against casual access . Some elven wizard s use these stones as spellbooks .

title: Tel - quessir
description: Tel - quessir Tel - quessir ( also Tel ' Quessir or Tel ' Quess ) are a number of closely related , long - lived fey races commonly known as elves , though this term is now acknowledged to be technically inaccurate . Nonetheless , the name is common and many of the Tel - quessir consider themselves as one larger culture , an attitude not unjustified given that nearly all Tel - quessir speak Elven and share a common history together . Perhaps more importantly , the Tel - quessir were once one race , generally assumed to have been the eladrin or “ high elves .

title: Telamont Tanthul
description: Telamont Tanthul Telamont Tanthul the Most High was the ruler of Thultanthar , also known as Shade Enclave . He was a powerful Shade Archmage and Netherese Arcanist of the Shadow Weave . Description .

title: Telantiwar
description: Telantiwar Telantiwar was an ancient drow city . History . When the drow first descended into the Underdark , they invaded and conquered the Dwarven city of Bhaerynden and renamed it Telantiwar .

title: Telbran Nelarn
description: Telbran Nelarn Telbran Nelarn was a sorcerer in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Telbran was a quiet man .

title: Teldar
description: Teldar Teldar was an old pirate in 1359 DR . History . Teldar was a pirate officer under Laershala , the last pirate lord of Earthspur .

title: Teldartham
description: Teldartham Teldartham was the new captain of the guard of Skuld in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 the clerics of Horus - Re managed to appoint Teldartham , a champion of Horus - Re , as captain of the guard of Skuld despite was a position usually covered by worshipers of Anhur .

title: Teldorn Darkhope
description: Teldorn Darkhope Teldorn Darkhope was the ruler of the city of Mintar , having conquered it with a Zhentarim - sponsored army of Iyachtu Xvim . After the conquest on Mintar , Teldorn , and Fzoul Chembryl forged the artifact known as the Scepter of the Tyrant ' s Eye .

title: Telekinesis
description: Telekinesis Telekinesis was an arcane transmutation spell that allowed a caster to telekinetically move , manipulate , or forcefully hurl objects or creatures . Effects . The spell gave the caster the power of telekinesis , allowing them to move an object or creature in a variety of possible ways , as they wished .

title: Telepathic broadcast
description: Telepathic broadcast Telepathic broadcast was a divine magic alteration spell that was available to priests of the Red Knight . It allowed the caster to telepathically convey verbal information to all allies within range . Effects .

title: Telepathy
description: Telepathy Telepathy was a psionic mental ability that enabled one intelligent creature to send and receive thoughts to another intelligent creature and communicate without words or a shared language . A creature must know a language to use telepathy . The use of magic was a common way to use telepathy .

title: Telepathy candle
description: Telepathy candle A telepathy candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It allowed a mystic to read thoughts and communicate mind to mind with those under its influence . Description .

title: Teleport
description: Teleport Teleport was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster to transit instantly between two points . Effect . This spell instantly transported the caster to a designated destination .

title: Teleport dead
description: Teleport dead Teleport dead was an alteration and necromancy spell that could instantly transport a single dead or undead body to anywhere on the plane of the caster . Effects . The oldest version of this spell was easier to learn and only worked on the undead .

title: Teleport without error
description: Teleport without error Teleport without error , or greater teleport , is a transmutation spell that lets one instantly transit from one location to another . Effects . This spell is like " teleport " , except there is no chance you arrive off target .

title: Teleportation circle
description: Teleportation circle Teleportation circle was a conjuration spell that created a circle that teleported any creature inside to a designated spot . Effects . The teleportation circles appeard on the floor or other horizontal surface .

title: Telescope of fantastic vision
description: Telescope of fantastic vision A telescope of fantastic vision was a bizarre magical spyglass that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These spyglasses were cylindrical and often made of precious metal such as gold .

title: Telescope of true vision
description: Telescope of true vision Telescopes of true vision were incredibly useful magic spyglasses that originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . These spyglasses were cylindrical and often made of precious metal such as gold .

title: Telflamm
description: Telflamm Telflamm was usually considered to be the biggest and most important city in Thesk ; however , Telflamm was actually an independent city - state but wielded so much power and influence over the country that it might as well have been the capital . Telflamm was officially founded in 926 DR by Windyn Balindre , who moved his base of operations from Impiltur to this newly - built settlement and declared himself ' Merchant Prince ' , a hereditary title . Situated at the start the incredibly profitable Golden Way trading route , Telflamm quickly became the biggest trading station in the region , with most trade concerning the products of Kara - Tur which was in wide demand across Faerûn .

title: Telkoun ' s Tower
description: Telkoun ' s Tower Telkoun ' s Tower was a wizard stronghold located in High Thorog in the Nether Mountains . Description . The stronghold consisted of one building with two double towers .

title: Telkoun Adranther
description: Telkoun Adranther Telkoun Adranther was an evil sorcerer who constantly sought magical power . Relationships . His parents were an evil sorceress and a powerful demon .

title: Tellectus
description: Tellectus Tellectus was a city founded by the Ariser Creed of Oryndoll in the Upperdark near Beregost . Long before the mid - 14th century DR , a band of adventurers launched a devastating raid on the city . They discovered the sword " Taragarth " , which had been being studied there .

title: Tellik Melarn
description: Tellik Melarn Tellik Melarn was the brother of Q ' arlynd Melarn . He was also a Nightshadow , a term to describe a cleric of Vhaeraun . Relationship .

title: Telmyz
description: Telmyz Telmyz was a priest of Vhaeraun . History . In 1377 DR , Telmyz was one of the six nightshadow s chosen for an assault led by Kâras on the main temple of Kiaransalee .

title: Telnarquel
description: Telnarquel Telnarquel was an Underdark city , called The Hidden City . It was so well concealed that some drow explorers refused to believe that it actually existed . In truth , it did indeed exist but was abandoned for an unknown reason at some point in the 14th century DR .

title: Telornym
description: Telornym Telornym was a human male cleric of Mystra and the Lord of Mystery at the Tower of Mysteries in Saerloon , Sembia . He was the second - in - command of the Tower of Mysteries , assisting the Mage Arcane Tanthala . He was also a senior member of the Moonstars in 1370 DR .

title: Telos
description: Telos The Master of the Iron Sky , known as Telos in most tongues , was a primordial who fell to the tundra of Vaasa during the Spellplague . He remained there , comatose , while the Warlock Knights mined what they called ironfell or " the iron " from his body . This material , which regenerated quickly , was used by the Knights to fashion items and construct s they called shardsoul s .

title: Telos ( city )
description: Telos ( city ) Telos was located in the crater created when the primordial Telos , whom the city takes its name from , fell to Vaasa . The city was fortress - like and the Ironfell Council ruled from the Citadel of the Iron Sky in the center of the city . There were no houses of worship in Telos but some sects worshiped in secret .

title: Telpi
description: Telpi Telpi was a language spoken by the inhabitants of the Dragon Coast and the Pirate Isles , from Proskur in the north to Nathlekh in the south , and from Iriaebor in the west to the Pirate and Whamite Isles in the east . Telpi was the only East Thorass language , but it included three dialects — Dragonsmere , Pirate / , and Whamite . The dialect of the pirates of the Sea of Fallen Stars was strongly influenced by other languages of the region .

title: Telshazz
description: Telshazz Telshazz was a demon in the balor Errtu ' s service . Personality . The small demon was obedient and very submissive to its masters .

title: Telthukiilir
description: Telthukiilir A telthukiilir ( or " high seeing orb " ) was an extremely powerful version of a crystal ball . It was lit faintly from within , emanating emerald - colored light . By speaking a command , the large orb could show the whereabouts of any individual .

title: Telvannah
description: Telvannah Telvannah was the White Worm high shaman in Vaasa in 1479 DR . Powers . Telvannah could summon the Spirit of the Remorhaz , gaining great control over heat and fire .

title: Temerity
description: Temerity Temerity was a tiefling descendant of the Toril thirteen . Activities . Temerity ran a shop in Proskur .

title: Temigast
description: Temigast Temigast was the steward of Auckney , serving under the Lord of Auckney since 1339 DR , the Year of the Weeping Moon . Description . Temigast essentially ran Auckney from beside the scene , advising Lord Feringal Auck in all important matters of state .

title: Temmenische
description: Temmenische Temmenische was a monk and a member of the Disciples of St . Sollars the Twice - Martyred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the 13th and 14th centuries DR . History .

title: Temmi Dharimm
description: Temmi Dharimm Temmi Dharimm ( pronounced " TEHM - ee DARR - imm " or " TEH - mee DAH - rimm " ) , known simply as " Temmi the Slaver " , was a human man from Tsurlagol in the Vast . He was a bandit and slaver . History .

title: Tempest
description: Tempest Tempest was the murdered lover of Ren o ' the Blade . Description . Tempest was a very beautiful and muscular woman with fiery red hair .

title: Tempest breath
description: Tempest breath Tempest breath , also known as Mestil ' s acid breath was a spell of the conjuration school used by some sorcerer s , particularly dragon sorcerers . When a sorcerer cast " tempest breath " he or she exhaled a green mist of acidic vapors that burned and disoriented any creatures within a nearby zone 15 ft ( 4 . 6 m ) in diameter .

title: Tempest domain
description: Tempest domain The Tempest domain was a set of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the destructive power of nature . Clerics who chose this domain were granted free access to these spells ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Temple Hill
description: Temple Hill Temple Hill was a rocky hill rising from the center of the city of Elversult . Description . Crowded on top of the hill was a temple to Waukeen and a temple to Lathander .

title: Temple of Corellon Larethian
description: Temple of Corellon Larethian The Temple of Corellon Larethian was a temple in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Structure . The temple was dedicated to the worship of Corellon Larethian , head of the Seldarine .

title: Temple of Deneir ( Procampur )
description: Temple of Deneir ( Procampur ) A temple of Deneir lay in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . Structure & Interior . The temple structure included a main hall .

title: Temple of Lolth ( Cathtyr )
description: Temple of Lolth ( Cathtyr ) The Temple of Lolth was the second largest temple in the metropolis of Cathtyr in Dambrath . Description . The temple sat on one side of the queen ' s palace .

title: Temple of Mystra ( Wheloon )
description: Temple of Mystra ( Wheloon ) The Temple of Mystra was a false temple in the town of Wheloon in Cormyr . Constructed in 1374 DR on the ruins of an old citadel on the edge of town , it was dedicated to Mystra , goddess of magic , but was in fact a front for worshipers of Shar , goddess of shadows , and Cyric , god of lies . Under the guise of a holy ritual , they kidnapped , murdered , and sacrificed true followers of Mystra , wielders of magic , and ordinary people who ' d become caught up in the snare .

title: Temple of Ten Thousand Gods
description: Temple of Ten Thousand Gods The Temple of Ten Thousand Gods was an unusual faith in Zakhara . Its adherents believed in the enlightened gods , but held the opinion that they , and each deity represented there , were only facets of one supreme divine being . The credo of the Ten Thousand also included that there was a divine spark in every creature , and that the variety of mortals also reflected the theme of diversity in unity .

title: Temple of Tyr ( Dagger Falls )
description: Temple of Tyr ( Dagger Falls ) A temple of Tyr lay in Dagger Falls and was occasionally known to lend its services to adventurers who aided Randal Morn . Location . It was situated in Dagger Falls , in northern Daggerdale .

title: Temple of Wisdom
description: Temple of Wisdom The Temple of Wisdom was a house of worship dedicated to the gnomish god Garl Glittergold at the Friendly Arm Inn on the Sword Coast . Structure . It was a low building with its interior walls decorated with gems and gold nuggets .

title: Temple of the Faceless God
description: Temple of the Faceless God The Temple of the Faceless God was dedicated to the Faceless God of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Location . The temple was located in the yikarian capital of Nathong in the heart of the Land of the Yak - Men .

title: Temple of the Lady of Mercy
description: Temple of the Lady of Mercy The Temple of the Lady of Mercy was a temple located in Hammergate dedicated to the dwarven goddess Sharindlar . The temple had a tall statue of the goddess carved from a single huge fire opal as well as a ritual cleansing pool . During the stoneplague in 1480 DR , the temple inadvertently spread the plague by accepting offerings of tainted gold from worshipers .

title: Temple of the Nine Travelers
description: Temple of the Nine Travelers The Temple of the Nine Travelers was one of the newer buildings in Manass in 1367 DR . It was a temple devoted to the Faith of the Nine Travelers , in particular to the Giants in Gray . Faith .

title: Temple of the Red Mountain
description: Temple of the Red Mountain The Temple of the Red Mountain was a rundown building in Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The Temple of the Red Mountain was a small structure in need of repair because of an assortment of attacks from rivals .

title: Temple of the Seldarine
description: Temple of the Seldarine The Temple of the Seldarine was a large temple complex located in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Description . Its main building was topped by a dome and was split into areas dedicated to the worship of the individual gods of the Seldarine , as well as a central chamber .

title: Temple of the Small Axe
description: Temple of the Small Axe The Temple of the Small Axe was a mosque dedicated to Kor in Liham , in 1367 DR . Description . The temple had a golden dome that dominated the city - scape of Liham .

title: Temple of the Yellow Mountain
description: Temple of the Yellow Mountain The Temple of the Yellow Mountain was the seat of power for the Yellow Mountain Sect of Manass in Khazari in 1367 DR . Description . The temple was one of the larger structures found in Manass .

title: Tempskya
description: Tempskya Tempskya is what was called in the Realms . Description . Specimens came in many colors , from black and white to red , yellow , brown , and sometimes pink .

title: Tempus
description: Tempus Tempus ( pronounced " TEM - pus " ) , also known as the Lord of Battles , was the god of war . His dogma was primarily concerned with honorable battle , forbidding cowardice and encouraging the use of force of arms to settle disputes . History .

title: Tempus ' s Tears
description: Tempus ' s Tears Tempus ' s Tears sits at the intersection of the Skuldask Road and The Thundar ' s Ride at the heart of the Fields of the Dead . There is a large standing stone setup at the intersection with an inscription : The dwarf and gnome villagers live in burrow homes as the area of the village is covered in stone ruins . The villages say the stones are under the protections of Amaeraszantha , an Amethyst Dragon .

title: Tempus Blackthorne
description: Tempus Blackthorne Tempus Blackthorne was a male human wizard worshiper of Bane before and during the Time of Troubles . History . Tempus was a powerful wizard of Zhentil Keep and a member of the church of Bane .

title: Ten Towns
description: Ten Towns The Ten Towns were a loose confederation of localized fishing villages in Icewind Dale , bordered individually by the lakes Lac Dinneshere , Maer Dualdon and Redwaters , and the mountain Kelvin ' s Cairn . Government . Official decisions for the towns were made by a council consisting of one influential member from each town .

title: Tenblades
description: Tenblades The Tenblades was a small group of adventures active in Vaasa before much of the region had been explored or settled . History . The Tenblades used their own wealth to fund the construction of the fortress of Darmshall .

title: Tenday
description: Tenday A tenday was a Faerûn ian unit of time . The Calendar of Harptos divided the thirty - day months into three blocks of ten days each , or simply put , " tendays " . The word was used interchangeably with the Earthly term " week " .

title: Tengu
description: Tengu The tengu was a winged avian humanoid creature found in Kara - Tur . There were two kinds of tengu : the crow tengu with a crow head and more avian characteristics ; and the humanoid tengu , with more humanoid characteristics . Description .

title: Tenison
description: Tenison Tenison was a wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Tenison had always been fascinated by fire , ever since he was a child .

title: Tennora Hedare
description: Tennora Hedare Tennora Hedare is a young apprentice Wizard and a member of one of Waterdeep ' s minor noble houses . She currently works as a spy for Nazra Mrays , a masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description .

title: Tenosh
description: Tenosh Tenosh was the Cloakmaster of Baldur ' s Gate for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . Tenosh was a cruel woman .

title: Tenrax
description: Tenrax Tenrax was the seldom - seen leader of the Nugha tribes in T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . Activities . Tenrax was the kio ton mu ( witchdoctor ) leader of the horsemen of E ' sang Yi in the hill country south of Chunming in Ausa province .

title: Tenser ' s transformation
description: Tenser ' s transformation Tenser ' s transformation was a spell that made the caster a virtual fighting machine — improving the caster ' s strength , dexterity , and physical constitution , as well as increasing the natural thickness of his or her skin . While granting those physical advantages , it prevented spellcasting and the ability to use any magical devices . To Zakhara n mages , always reluctant to acknowledge ajami names and accomplishments , the spell was known simply as transformation , and counted among the spells of the universal province .

title: Tentacle walls
description: Tentacle walls Tentacle walls was an enchantment spell that turned a room into a trap . Effects . The area of effect was a single room no bigger than a 50 ft ( 15 .

title: Tephanis
description: Tephanis Tephanis is a quickling who has served many masters ; Ulgulu being one of them . Chance encounter . When a group of their gnoll s sent to retrieve a pair of farmers , the father and eldest son , from the Thistledown farm never returned , he and his brother sent Nathak to scout out what happened , he returned and told both Kempfana and Ulgulu that their raiding party of five gnoll s were dead .

title: Ter - soth
description: Ter - soth Ter - soth was a balor commander in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR . Activities . Ter - soth led a regiment of 100 glabrezu s guarding the conduit to the palace of Orcus .

title: Teraff
description: Teraff Teraff was a young Star elf firebrand of an orator who , in the early days of the creation of Sildëyuir preached against peaceful relations with any other nation , even with other elves . She led a group of renegade star elves on raids against coastal camps of human settlers who she suspected of spying on Yuireshanyaar . Her fears proved true when she and her group were captured by some of those coastal settlers .

title: Terazul
description: Terazul Terazul was a flowering plant found only in a few locations in the jungles south of Delzimmer . It was also the name of a somewhat addictive drug made from the leaves of the plant . Ecology .

title: Teremon
description: Teremon Teremon was the king of the pixie s of Panjuis until his death in the early 14th century DR . Personality . Teremon was a disciplined ruler who maintained order within his special fortress .

title: Teresiel
description: Teresiel Teresiel was a prisoner at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Teresiel was chosen among many others to be part of a diplomatic delegation to Mirabar .

title: Termalaine
description: Termalaine Termalaine was the second - northernmost settlement of Ten Towns , and the third largest in the region . Geography . Termalaine was located on the eastern shore of Maer Dualdon , due north of Bryn Shander .

title: Terondarg Del ' Armgo
description: Terondarg Del ' Armgo Terondarg Del ' Armgo was one of the most able scouts of House Barrison Del ' Armgo in 1486 DR . History . Terondarg was one of the best scouts of Menzoberranzan in 1486 .

title: Terpenzi
description: Terpenzi Terpenzi was a ha - naga and the first ruler of Najara , taking this position in −361 DR . In 89 DR , Terpenzi foresaw its own death and ordered its servants to search for Netherese artifacts . In the meantime , it searched for a mate .

title: Terran
description: Terran Terran was the language of creatures from the Elemental Plane of Earth or those otherwise related to the earth in some way . Many earthsoul genasi learned the language as well . When written , it used the Dethek script .

title: Terrien Doucard
description: Terrien Doucard Terrien Doucard was a half - elven soldier of the Knights in Silver who replaced Besnell as leader during the Battle of Keeper ' s Dale . Description . Terrien had shining brown hair which shimmered even after the knight fought and killed on the battlefield .

title: Terxyx
description: Terxyx Terxyx was a tome archon in service to Saint Sollars in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Terxyx led a company of sword archon s in the Astral Plane to save Gareth Dragonsbane and his party from pursuing demon s and to accompany them to meet his master Saint Sollars .

title: Teryani Ealoeth
description: Teryani Ealoeth Teryani Ealoeth was a female fey ' ri ranger and a daughter of Xhalth . She was the chief scout for the daemonfey . History .

title: Teshaurus
description: Teshaurus Teshaurus was a skull lord who was a member of the Dominion of Bone in 1479 DR . History . Teshaurus acted as the " ambassador " of Prince Nathur Hethkantan in Glaur , dealing with the genasi of the Dominion of the Burned , or with adventurers or treasure hunters who were exploring the fortress .

title: Teshburl
description: Teshburl Teshburl was the most isolated town of Calimshan . It was the secondary shipbuilding site for the Nallojal ; everything in the town revolved around the navy , and Teshburl served as the nation ' s headquarters and primary port for it . Geography and Layout .

title: Teshendale
description: Teshendale Situated along the valley of the River Tesh , Teshendale was a lost dale once occupied the territory spanning from Zhentil Keep to the Desertsmouth Mountains . Now , the area is covered in ruins , as in 1316 DR it was invaded by Zhent forces and orc s working for them ; the people were slain , ensalved or driven away , the valley was quarried and the granite used to build vast sections of the walls that protected Zhentil Keep . Although no longer part of the Dalelands , the cities of Teshwave and Snowmantle remained under control of Zhentil Keep until its destruction ; Teshwave , once the largest trading community in Teshendale , was a staging area for Zhent nonhuman troups and mercenaries .

title: Teshford Arms
description: Teshford Arms The Teshford Arms was run by Olavia Tsardruyn and was the only real inn in Dagger Falls . Rumors . The inn suffered from the fact that Olavia ' s mint wine was the only thing to recommend it .

title: Teshwave
description: Teshwave Teshwave was a small town in Teshendale in the Dalelands . Geography . The community was built along the River Tesh just south of the Dragonspine Mountains .

title: Teshyll
description: Teshyll The ancient city of Teshyll was a center for trade in the old Calim Empire . It was best known for the famous Harem Palace of Calim . Geography .

title: Teshyllal Wastes
description: Teshyllal Wastes The Teshyllal Wastes were the desert wastelands surrounding the ruins of the ancient city of Teshyll . Geography . The Teshyllal Wastes were the central region of the Calim Desert .

title: Teskulladar
description: Teskulladar Teskulladar , also known as Manytalons , was a silver dragon . History . In 947 DR , Teskulladar killed the white dragon Cortulorrulagalargath in a battle above the realm of Calandor , indirectly causing the deaths of the Duke of Calandor and his retinue when the defeated Cortulorrulagalargath fell upon Delimbiyran .

title: Tessaernil Deirr
description: Tessaernil Deirr Tessaernil Deirr was the star elf lord of House Deirr in the 1370s DR in Sildëyuir . History . In 1374 DR , Lord Tessaernil welcomed back his nephew Nesterin Deirr , who was accompanied by Jorin Kell Harthan and Araevin Teshurr ' s party .

title: Tessalar Hulicorm
description: Tessalar Hulicorm Tessalar Hulicorm was an enterprising wizard in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Tessalar was a vain man , with a liking for elaborate dress .

title: Tessaril Winter
description: Tessaril Winter Tessaril Winter , formerly known as Tessar the Mage , was a female human fighter and wizard . Previously an adventurer , she became the lord of the town of Eveningstar in Cormyr . She was beloved as an easy - going and attentive ruler , who used her magic to keep the peace .

title: Tessarin Alaurun
description: Tessarin Alaurun Tessarin " Longtresses " Alaurun was the witty and beautiful First Speaker of the council and ruler of the beleagured town of Nesmé . Among other things , she was renowned for her collection of magical items . Background .

title: Tethgard
description: Tethgard Tethgard was an ancient , ruined city located in Hullack Forest . Description . The city was overgrown and mostly composed of isolated pillars , arches , half - arches , and stairs .

title: Tethir
description: Tethir Tethir the Dragonslayer was an elven hero and the first elven dragonslayer . Relationships . Tethir was related to the elven hero Keltormir .

title: Tethtoril
description: Tethtoril Tethtoril was the First Reader of Candlekeep around 1367 DR . He is known to be wise and soft spoken . This tall , impressive , wise , and soft - spoken man is often mistaken for the Keeper of Tomes of Candlekeep .

title: Tethyamar
description: Tethyamar The mines of Tethyamar were once home to one of the greatest dwarven communities in the North . Geography . The mines of Tethyamar were very deep , following the long vertical veins of ore that lay beneath the Desertsmouth Mountains .

title: Tethyamar Trail
description: Tethyamar Trail The Tethyamar Trail was a trade road that ran the length of Daggerdale . Geography . The Tethyamar Trail started a few miles east of the southern point of Spiderhaunt Wood at the Northride .

title: Tethyr
description: Tethyr Tethyr recently emerged from a decades - long civil war ( 1347 - 1369 DR ) with two new monarchs . The strong rule of Queen - Monarch Zaranda Star Rhindaun and King Haedrak III ( who formerly served the great Elminster of Shadowdale as a scribe under the name of " Lhaeo " ) began to restore hope to a cynical , suspicious , war - torn land . Tethyr was a growing nation , establishing ties with hesitant neighbors , and driving monsters from its lands .

title: Tethyr Mills
description: Tethyr Mills The Tethyr Mills , located just outside the walls of Myratma along the River Ith , was one of the largest textile mills in all of Faerûn . It produced some of the best silks outside of Kara - Tur as well as popular waterproof canvases for tents and sails . The silks were the first choice for fine clothiers in Calimshan and Amn .

title: Tethyrian Interregnum
description: Tethyrian Interregnum The Interregnum was a pivotal time in Tethyr ian history , when plots and assassinations and riots destabilized the entire country . History . A number of wizard s and their mercenary armies invaded Tethyr in 1333 DR attempting to create a new nation , which they would call Mulsparkh .

title: Teuveamanthaar
description: Teuveamanthaar Teuveamanthaar was the capital of Eaerlann . History . It was founded in −4550 DR among the ruins of Aryvandaar in the northern and eastern sections of the High Forest .

title: Tevish Malacont
description: Tevish Malacont Tevish Malacont was a member of Cult of the Dragon in the Vast before 1489 DR . Personality . Tevish believed that Throstulgrael had killed him and he was being punished for his life of evil .

title: Tewacha
description: Tewacha Tewacha was the fabled city of the gods located in the southern House of Tezca desert in Maztica . In approximately 350 DR , the gods desired a location for a battle they intended to fight so they commanded their human subjects to construct a great pyramid . The pyramid was over six hundred feet high and even in 1361 DR it remained in pristine condition .

title: Texter
description: Texter Texter the Paladin was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep . Description . Texter had a powerful build , ruddy face , and a thick brown mustache .

title: Teyla Shan
description: Teyla Shan Teyla Shan , or the Godswatch Mountains , formed much of the border of eastern Semphar , essentially separating the country from the vast plains of the Hordelands . Geography . Teyla Shan ran roughly north to south from the River Estan in the north to the pass of Howling Gap in the south .

title: Tezca
description: Tezca Tezca was the chaotic evil god of the sun and fire in Maztica . He was the live - giving force of heat and sunlight . Description .

title: Teziir
description: Teziir Teziir is the largest free city on the coast of the Dragonmere . Teziir is an independent trade city , attempting to displace Westgate as the principal trade city for goods traveling from the Sword Coast to the Inner Sea . The city is still considered a frontier town by most people .

title: Thaalis
description: Thaalis Thaalis was a lizardfolk cleric of Semuanya . She resided in the mines below Baeniff Tor in the Evermoors where she sacrificed victims to a giant crocodile , Kheshebik , who she and the Khoroshen tribe of lizardfolk believed to be an avatar of the deity Semuanya . Appearance .

title: Thabort
description: Thabort Thabort ( THAH - bort ) was a dice game popular in the Dragon Reach region of Faerûn . It was a quick game that only required two six - sided dice and whatever coins players cared to wager . It was favored by guards and those in similar situations where there was not much to do until something happened that required immediate attention .

title: Thaeron
description: Thaeron Thaeron ( also known later as Durthar Morgath ) was a swordmaster who was employed by Lord Elmaer Oraun of Harrowdale during his reign for around five years between 1175 and 1185 DR ( sources are not precise with dates ) . He died in the second inter - dale war in 1356 DR . History .

title: Thaerun Blackryn
description: Thaerun Blackryn Thaerun Blackryn was a member of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Thaerun look more like Lord Chess ; he was a cunning man but short - sight in his decisions , always fearing retribution from more ambitious and powerful Lords .

title: Thagdal
description: Thagdal Thagdal was non - member of the Zhentarim who operated a small and local wizard ' s guild within the Tower of the Art in Zhentil Keep . He was a mousy , easily flustered individual who possessed a sharp mind and was always interested about the goings - on within the city . Despite this , he and his colleges within the wizard ' s guild tried to maintain a low profile , although Fzoul Chembryl always kept a close eye on them .

title: Thaglar Xundorn
description: Thaglar Xundorn Thaglar Xundorn was a duergar smith in Skullport and Laird of Sargauthan Hold . Personality . Thaglar ' s title , bestowed on his father by the Deep King of Gracklstugh , granted him the loyalty of most of Skullport ' s duergar , especially those of Clan Xundorn .

title: Thakorsil
description: Thakorsil Thakorsil was an archmage who seized power in the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia , which was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . History . Yhalvia had been ruled by the baatezu devil lord Orlex , and his reign was naturally cruel , depraved , and wicked .

title: Thakorsil ' s Seat
description: Thakorsil ' s Seat Thakorsil ' s Seat was a powerful minor artifact that had the power to completely bind and enslave those who sat upon it .
