Constructed in the ancient kingdom of Yhalvia in Narfell to yoke a devil lord , it found its way into the possession of Larloch , the Shadow King of Warlock ' s Crypt . He gave it to Szass Tam , Zulkir of Necromancy , for his plot to control the demon lord Eltab and take over Thay .

title: Thalaman Harthgroth
description: Thalaman Harthgroth Thalaman Harthgroth was the grizzled leader of the nomadic Harthgroth tribe and head of the tribal council that ruled over the land of Narfell . He viewed outsiders amiably , preferring to trade with them rather than pursuing endless fights . As such , his influence led the Harthgroth tribe to be far less hostile then the neighboring tribes .

title: Thalantyr
description: Thalantyr Thalantyr was a wizard , specialized in conjuration , and a former adventurer who lived in his house called High Hedge , northwest of Beregost . Personality . Later retired , Thalantyr was more at home helping others through magic or advice for a fee .

title: Thalart
description: Thalart Thalart was a malaugrym in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Thalart was plotting to usurp the position of the Shadowmaster Supreme Dhalgrave .

title: Thalder
description: Thalder Thalder was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . Thalder was a Cult member of the traditionalist faction .

title: Thaleste
description: Thaleste Thaleste was a female drow novice priestess of Eilistraee . History . Thaleste was born in Menzoberranzan as a member of a noble house .

title: Thalia
description: Thalia Thalia was a member of the Rogues of Tilverton in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , the Guildmaster Artur Grossman ordered Thalia , disguised as a servant , to escort out of the Rogues ' hideout an adventuring party possessing the Azure Bonds .

title: Thallastam
description: Thallastam Thallastam was a Chondathan human man of the Vast of the 6th century DR . He was a famous expert in magical swords , a practitioner of the Sublime Way , and a Jade Phoenix mage . History .

title: Thallos el Bhirax
description: Thallos el Bhirax Thallos yn Sarsor el Bhilax yi Almraiven was a Calishite weaponsmaster and a member of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Thallos inherited his position in the Knights from his grandfather , Tahir el Bhirax .

title: Thalto Bresmer
description: Thalto Bresmer Thalto Bresmer was a traveling merchant based in Telflamm , Thesk . He covered in the Dragon Reach area , including the Moonsea and the Dalelands . Abilities .

title: Thalynsar
description: Thalynsar Thalynsar was an illithilich wizard and was once a leader of the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark . History . Thalynsar was an ulitharid in Ch ' Chitl in the mid – 13th century DR when a raiding party of githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain .

title: Thamilas
description: Thamilas Throughout the High Desert of Zakhara , particularly north of the Range of the Marching Camels , travelers could encounter depressions in the sand called thamilas . These depressions often held yellowish water that was perfectly safe to drink despite its appearance . Boiling the water was recommended as per drinking any water found in the wild .

title: Thammar Saddusk
description: Thammar Saddusk Thammar Saddusk was a very friendly wine merchant in High Dale . History . When in 1358 DR a secret Zhent occupation army occupied the dale , Saddusk was a member of the Council of the High Dale .

title: Thamphrol Sarlar
description: Thamphrol Sarlar Thamphrol Sarlar was an assistant in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar , " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Activities . The cookhouse at the Whistling Wizard was a raucous place where Thamphrol and the other kitchen drudges bickered with each other and the two dwarven cooks , Bezoldur Thornhand and Thaunder Gallowglaive , nonstop while carrying water , tending fires , turning spits , stirring cauldrons , and cleaning and slicing vegetables .

title: Thanatos
description: Thanatos Thanatos was a banshee in Myth Drannor in 1357 DR . History . Thanatos was once an elf in Myth Drannor .

title: Thanderahast
description: Thanderahast Thanderahast was a High Wizard of Cormyr and nephew of Royal Wizard Amedahast . Before becoming High Wizard , he was a War Wizard of Cormyr . Possessions .

title: Thane
description: Thane Thane of Westgate was an employee of Aurora ' s Emporium in 1370 DR . History . Thane joined the Emporium ' s staff in 1365 DR as a master of the central warehouse , a role that suited him perfectly thanks to his eye for detail .

title: Thantan Rhyrdyl
description: Thantan Rhyrdyl Thantan Rhyrdyl was one of the leaders ( a Boar ' s Head ) of the Order of the Blue Boar , a mercenary recruitment company in Amn . Description . Thantan was charismatic to the point of seeming arrogant .

title: Thanterim
description: Thanterim The Thanterim family were an Urmlaspyran merchant family that were closely aligned with the Church of Tymora . The Thanterims were quite successful , owning deeds , shares and loans in companies . However this all ended when Urmlaspyr rebelled against the Shadovar in 1409 DR for banning all religions except Shar .

title: Thaola ' s Wineshop
description: Thaola ' s Wineshop Thaola ' s Wineshop was a wine shop in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Geography . Thaola ' s shop was located east of Dhoelath ' s Tower and north of the Shrine of the Black Sword .

title: Thar
description: Thar Thar , also known as the Great Gray Land , was a rocky , broken moor stretching for hundreds of miles with a harsh climate north of the Moonsea . It was inhabited by wild tribes of humanoid s such as orc s who were constantly at war with one another . Raids .

title: Thar Greenbough
description: Thar Greenbough Thar Greenbough was a ranger living in the Rothé Valley near Neverwinter . History . Thar was the local agent of the Emerald Enclave in the Rothé Valley during the Tyranny of Dragons ; he directed adventurers against the Cult of the Dragon in the area , including the blue dragon Venfithar .

title: Tharas ' kalagram
description: Tharas ' kalagram Tharas ' kalagram , also known as Kalag was a red dragon that lived in the Forest of Wyrms . Description . The dragon was about 80 ft long .

title: Tharbas
description: Tharbas Tharbas was a golem assigned to guard the lake surrounding Khalusk . Personality . Tharbas was loyal to Khalusk and took his role seriously .

title: Tharcereli
description: Tharcereli Tharcereli was the ulitharid Creedmaster of the Loretakers Creed of Oryndoll in 1370 DR and 1372 DR . Personality . Tharcereli had an abiding hunger for knowledge but never shared this knowledge with non - illithids .

title: Thard ( barbarian )
description: Thard ( barbarian ) Thard was an human barbarian of the Sky Pony ( tribe ) and a member of the adventuring group , the Moor Runners . Description . Thard was a hulking man who wore leather armor and wielded a greataxe .

title: Thard Harr
description: Thard Harr Thard Harr " ( thard harr ) , " the dwarven god of jungle survival and hunting , is the patron of the wild dwarves ; he watches over them and works to ensure their continued survival . His followers revere the jungles they live in and do their best to live in harmony with and to protect the jungles ( and themselves ) from outsiders who would do either of them harm . His followers tend to be suspicious and isolationist , and they rarely willingly interact with outsiders .

title: Thardregh Droon
description: Thardregh Droon Thardregh Droon was a traveling merchant that dealt in gem s , jewelry , ornamental chains , lockets , and other fine metalwork such as cutlery , plates , and coffers with ornate silver detailing . He also sold security hardware such as bolts , hasps , and hinges . Description .

title: Thardresk Crypt
description: Thardresk Crypt Thardresk Crypt , the resting place of King Thausimbel Thardresk of Anauria , resided in the Serpent Hills and was as heavily guarded as the other tombs in the area , with magical traps and tricks , along with undead , ready to attack adventurers . Rumors held that it was actually a false crypt , disguising the existence of a number of tombs for the royalty of Anauria .

title: Thargreve Obarskyr the Lesser
description: Thargreve Obarskyr the Lesser Thargreve the Lesser ( real name Thargreve Obarskyr ) was the king of Cormyr after Roderin the Bastard . Baerauble had to fetch him from where he was living in Westgate . He ruled for less than a year before he died .

title: Tharian
description: Tharian Tharian was a collection of human dialects spoken in the region of the Thar . Speakers . Tharian was spoken by the inhabitants of the north and west Moonsea , from Glister in the north to Hillsfar in the south , and from Snowmantle in the west to Sulasspryn in the east .

title: Tharizdun
description: Tharizdun Tharizdun was a long - forgotten interloper god originating from Oerth who sought to destroy all that is . During the Dawn War , he created the Abyss , an act for which he was imprisoned by the gods . His followers hoped to set him free .

title: Tharmakkas IV
description: Tharmakkas IV Tharmakkas IV was the king of Murghôm in 1359 DR . Personality . Tharmakkas was a senile old man .

title: Tharman
description: Tharman Tharman was a human man from the village of Pengallen in the Silver Marches . He was a farmer . Description & Personality .

title: Tharra
description: Tharra Tharra was a Harper spy . History . Tharra Hailed from Mistledale but her job with Harpers made her travel a lot .

title: Tharsult
description: Tharsult Tharsult was an island in the Shining Sea . Its capital was Urbeth , and it was known for its unscrupulous traders . History .

title: Tharyann Obarskyr
description: Tharyann Obarskyr Tharyann " the Elder " was a king of Cormyr . Relatives . Tharyann was the tenth child and third son of King Irbruin Obarskyr .

title: Tharzon Brewhammer
description: Tharzon Brewhammer Tharzon Brewhammer was a retired adventurer and the owner of the Smoke Wyrm tavern in Ravens Bluff which he ran with his son Kurzen Brewhammer . Prior to the spellplague , Tharzon was an acquaintance of Jack Ravenwild and he was shocked when Jack turned up at his tavern in 1479 DR after escaping his one hundred year imprisonment in the mythal beneath the city . Although he was too old to help Jack with his scheme to recover the Sarkenaegal from Sarbreen , he offered Jack advice and even managed to negotiate a cut of the profits from the venture .

title: Thasmudyan
description: Thasmudyan Thasmudyan was an evil god of the undead and undeath , and a baatezu lord , worshiped since time immemorial on the Zakhara n island of Sahu . Cult of Worms . Thasmudyan ' s followers called themselves the Cult of Worms and were led by his Chosen and high priestess , the lich Vermissa , from her long - time magical prison on Sahu .

title: Thauglorimorgorus
description: Thauglorimorgorus Thauglorimorgorus ( also known as Thauglor , Black Doom , and King of the Forest Country ) was a black dragon and ruler of the old area known as the Forest Country , southeast of the Stormhorns , in what was later Cormyr . He took payments from wyvern s who inhabited the lake at its center , in exchange for allowing them to stay . Description .

title: Thaumaturgist
description: Thaumaturgist The thaumaturgist is a prestige class for cleric s and cleric / mage s who are interested in pacts with beings from other planes of existence . Depending on the alignment and intent of the thaumaturgist , the beings which the thaumaturgist summons may be demon s , devil s , angel s , or eladrin . The nature of the relationship between thaumaturgist and planar creature may also vary depending on the duties the thaumaturgist wishes the planar creature to perform , which may range between a long term quest down to assisting in a particularly difficult fight .

title: Thaun Khelbor
description: Thaun Khelbor Loremaster Thaun Khelbor was a cleric of Deneir in the service of the royalty of Cormyr . Appearance . Thaun was balding with patches of grey hair above his ears .

title: Thauna Maskalar
description: Thauna Maskalar High Priestess Thauna Maskalar was a female Chondathan and the head of the House of Firehair , a cathedral of Sune , within the city of Daerlun . History . Between 1358 DR and 1374 DR , at least , Thauna Maskalar led 48 human and half - elven cleric s in the worship of Lady Firehair .

title: Thaunder Gallowglaive
description: Thaunder Gallowglaive Thaunder Galowglaive was an elderly dwarven cook that worked in the cookhouse of the Whistling Wizard inn located in Voonlar . He was one of the very few non - humans that resided in Voonlar " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description .

title: Thausimbel Thardresk
description: Thausimbel Thardresk Thausimbel Thardresk was the greatest king of Anauria . thank to some Elven ancestry and his magic he ruled for 366 years , making durable alliances with Elves , Dwarves of Oghrann and Humans of Dragon Reach . He was known as " The Wise " , " the Greybeard " and " The Long - Lived " .

title: Thava
description: Thava Thava was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut . Description . Thava had golden eyes and ocher scales dulled in gold .

title: Thaxalia
description: Thaxalia Thaxalia was a beholder in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thaxalia was furious with the Red Wizards of Thay for imprisoning and maiming it .

title: Thaxll ' ssillyia
description: Thaxll ' ssillyia Thaxll ' ssillyia was a shadow dragon brought from the Plane of Shadow by the Shade Lord during his attempt to extend his influence onto the Material Plane . Thaxll ' ssillyia was left to guard the entrance into the Shade Lord ' s inner lair in the old temple to Amaunator near the Umar Hills . Gorion ' s Ward and party had to pass the dragon in order to complete their quest in the Umar Hills , but could , instead of fighting , use a wardstone that made their party undetectable to the dragon .

title: Thay
description: Thay Thay was a nation in east Faerûn . Geography . It was a dark and forbidding land of windswept mountains and badlands .

title: Thayan Quarter
description: Thayan Quarter The Thayan Quarter was a Thayan enclave in the city of Procampur in the Vast , and the first in the Realms . History . Samas Kul , Thay ' s Master of the Guild of Foreign Trade , organized the concession of a Thayan Quarter in Procampur in the Year of Moonfall , 1344 DR .

title: Thayan Resurrection
description: Thayan Resurrection The Thayan Resurrection was a secret rebel organization born among the Red Wizards of Thay . Activities . Composed of wizards of all schools of magic except necromancy , the Thayan Resurrection ' s goal was the overthrow of Szass Tam and the necromancers from their rule of Thay .

title: Thayan gladiator
description: Thayan gladiator The Thayan Gladiator is a special prestige class of Thay . Thayan Gladiators are in heavy demand from the elite upper class of Thay , serving as a distraction from the day to day hardship and torment that arises from living in the realm of the Red Wizards . This demand for excellence and amusement has given the Thayan Gladiators a tradition that makes them the very best of their kind within the Realms .

title: Thayan knight
description: Thayan knight Thayan knights were the generals of the Thayan armies , and protectors of The Red Wizards of Thay . Culture . These soldiers acted as defenders of thayan enclaves all over Faerûn , and personal bodyguards to Red Wizards .

title: Thayan orc
description: Thayan orc The two breeds of Thayan orc are magical hybrids of ordinary gray orcs , orogs , and other creatures , including possibly ogres and gnolls . Tall and muscular , with large hooded eyes , tough leathery skin , and snouted bestial faces , Thayan orcs seem to embody all the worse aspects of the creatures that went into their creation . Both Thayan black and red orcs are warrior creatures , loyal and skillful , who live for battle .

title: Thaymount
description: Thaymount The Thaymount is a chain of volcanic mountains at the heart of Thay . Geography . Some of these volcanos are still active and access to the region is restricted to only the Red Wizards .

title: Thayze Selemchant
description: Thayze Selemchant Thayze Selemchant was the first Meisarch of Amn and Lord of House Selemchant . He founded the Council of Six in 1333 DR , but then became petty and jaded . He was also secretly a high - ranked member of the Cowled Wizards .

title: Thazalhar
description: Thazalhar Thazalhar was a region of Thay , ruled by tharchion Milsantos Daramos until his death in 1382 DR . It was small and sparsely populated compared to other tharchs in Thay . History .

title: The Arming
description: The Arming The Arming was a celebration of local militias and battle readiness in the land of the Vast , occurring on the 4th Tarsakh . The Arming commemorated a time when the farmers and merchants of the Vast worked together and stood against orc raids out of the Earthfast Mountains and along the North Road and against bandit and pirate attacks all around the Vast . Every year on this day , communities mustered and inspected their local militias .

title: The Barghest
description: The Barghest The Barghest was a former bandit of Dragonspear Castle around 1368 DR . Activities . He was one of the most infamous residents of Dragonspear around 1358 DR and he slaughtered many good men during the second Dragonspear War .

title: The Beached Leviathan
description: The Beached Leviathan The Beached Leviathan was a three - decked tavern located in Neverwinter , that catered to sailors , smugglers , slavers , merchants , and others arriving by sea . It was built in and around the refurbished wreckage of the ship with the same name . Appendix .

title: The Bear ' s Den
description: The Bear ' s Den The Bear ' s Den was an inn in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , run by Derdek Deepingdell . It was a large and comfortable establishment , where noise was frowned upon . Rooms in the Bear ' s Den cost 7 gp a night , while a meal and drink were 3 gp .

title: The Best of the Realms
description: The Best of the Realms " Empty Joys " . By R . A .

title: The Best of the Realms III
description: The Best of the Realms III " Answered Prayers " . Liriel Baenre , Sharlarra Vendreth , and Thorn stop for a bite to eat at a tavern in Hlammach , Impiltur , and find more than food awaits them . A hunter seeking wolf pelts recognized Thorn as lythari and she challenges him to a duel .

title: The Blackbard
description: The Blackbard The Blackbard was a boatyard and warehouse located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Shanna " Blackbard " Northgate . The facility was formerly a warehouse and wharf converted into a combination boat - building and rental storage business .

title: The Bloodstone Wars
description: The Bloodstone Wars The Bloodstone Wars is a adventure . It was published in 1987 , the same year the Forgotten Realms became an official campaign setting , and was one of the first Forgotten Realms adventures . Like the previous titles in the Bloodstone Pass series , " The Bloodstone Wars " features the tabletop rules .

title: The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka
description: The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka " The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka " is the second issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics . It was written by Michael Fleisher and Jan Duursema , drawn by Duursema , and edited by Barbara Kesel . It continued the story begun in " The Gathering " .

title: The Brigadier
description: The Brigadier The Brigadier was a giff shopkeeper in Skullport in 1370 DR . History . The Brigadier arrived on Toril with his spelljammer ship in 1365 .

title: The Bright Sleeve
description: The Bright Sleeve The Bright Sleeve was an award bestowed by the city of Waterdeep on individuals for acts of bravery above the call of duty . Description . The award was a sleeve made out of cloth of gold embroidered with the name of the recipient .

title: The Cabal of the Crown
description: The Cabal of the Crown The Cabal of the Crown was an adventuring company based in Procampur in the Vast . History . " Circa " 1364 DR , The Cabal of the Crown visited the village of Orlimmin to explore the local gravel pits , which were rumored to conceal buried treasures .

title: The Choir
description: The Choir The Choir was a cult of aberrations based in Akanûl who worshiped a plaguechanged sirine they called the Blue Lady . Members . Members of the Choir had the ability to influence others through their strange songs .

title: The Chuen
description: The Chuen The Chuen were a small , traditionalist Shou society based in the Xiousing district of Marsember . Their name literally meant " The Pure " . Beliefs .

title: The Cities series
description: The Cities series The Cities series is a series of four books published between 2000 and 2005 and written by Richard Baker , Drew Karpyshyn , Mel Odom , Ed Greenwood , and Elaine Cunningham . The books are all stand - alones , the first following a man named Jack , the next following Corin , the next following a druid and the final installment , a mage of Waterdeep . They all include much action .

title: The Cloaked
description: The Cloaked The Cloaked was the only known resident wizard in Blackhold , Fimbrul , as of 1479 DR . Appareance . The Cloaked wore a hooded black cloak , hence its name .

title: The Codicil of White
description: The Codicil of White The Codicil of White was a magical book containing basic rites , rituals , services , and major ceremonies of Auril ' s faith . The book also had several pages devoted to the goddess ' favorite arcane magic . Description .

title: The Collected Stories : The Legend of Drizzt Anthology
description: The Collected Stories : The Legend of Drizzt Anthology The Collected Stories : The Legend of Drizzt Anthology is a collection of short stories written by R . A . Salvatore and set in the Forgotten Realms D & D setting .

title: The Companions
description: The Companions The Companions by R . A . Salvatore is the first book in The Sundering series .

title: The Coral Kingdom
description: The Coral Kingdom The Coral Kingdom , by Douglas Niles , is the second book in the Druidhome trilogy . Summary . The King Tristan Kendrick is captured by minions of Talos and held in the the Coral Kingdom .

title: The Covenant
description: The Covenant The Covenant was an alliance of mage s whose goal was to promote peace between the northern realms of Faerûn and to prepare these kingdoms for potentials conflicts with the orc s of The North . History . Four Founders .

title: The Crystal Mountain
description: The Crystal Mountain The Crystal Mountain is the third and final book in The Empyrean Odyssey trilogy by Thomas M . Reid . Summary .

title: The Crystal Shard
description: The Crystal Shard The Crystal Shard is the first book in the Icewind Dale trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Dark Dancer
description: The Dark Dancer The Dark Dancer was a shrine dedicated to the drow goddess Eilistraee , called the Dark Dancer , located in the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast . It had a troubled and controversial history . Location .

title: The Dark Elf Trilogy
description: The Dark Elf Trilogy The Dark Elf Trilogy is the second series of books about Drizzt Do ' Urden written by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Deepfires
description: The Deepfires The Deepfires was an inn in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain in the mid – 14th century DR . Location . The Deepfires was situated in the Lower Heart ward of Skullport .

title: The Dragon ' s Bestiary
description: The Dragon ' s Bestiary The Dragon ' s Bestiary was a long - running column in Dragon magazine which introduced new monsters within specific themes . Note that only articles relating to ( relating to the " Forgotten Realms " or Core D & D ) appear here .

title: The Dragons ' Den
description: The Dragons ' Den The Dragons ' Den was a tavern in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , owned by Oleg One - Ear . The tavern was taken over by the rowdy Purple Dragons garrison in town , quite against Oleg ' s original wishes , but he knew to mind his own business . It became the soldiers ' own hangout , and catered exclusively to them .

title: The Dream of the Dragon
description: The Dream of the Dragon The Dream of the Dragon was a chapbook written by the bard Elender Stormfall of Suzail in Cormyr . It was published late in the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . In the book , Elender discussed the spirit , doubts , and moods of the people of Cormyr around the time of the death of King Azoun IV and the rise of the Regent Alusair in 1371 DR , and of the years after once her rule was in place .

title: The Druid Queen
description: The Druid Queen The Druid Queen , by Douglas Niles , is the third book in the Druidhome trilogy . Characters . Alicia Kendrick • Keane • Tavish • Deirdre Kendrick • Tristan Kendrick • Robyn Kendrick • Talos • Miles • Bakar Dalsoritan • Thurgol • Baatlrap • Garisa • Harmanius • Parell Hyath

title: The Drunken Dragon
description: The Drunken Dragon The Drunken Dragon was a tavern found in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The tavern was a favorite of Shaless of Tsurlagol , an adventurer . In Nightal of the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , she returned to The Drunken Dragon and there displayed a selection of curious harp s and beautiful , magic al blade s that she claimed to have found in Myth Drannor .

title: The Empires trilogy
description: The Empires trilogy The Empires Trilogy is a group of novels each written by a different author . Publications are by TSR , Inc . from 1990 - 1991 .

title: The Empyrean Odyssey ( omnibus )
description: The Empyrean Odyssey ( omnibus ) The Empyrean Odyssey is an omnibus of The Empyrean Odyssey trilogy written by Thomas M . Reid . The novels included in this book are " The Gossamer Plain " , " The Fractured Sky " , and " The Crystal Mountain " .

title: The Erevis Cale Trilogy
description: The Erevis Cale Trilogy The Erevis Cale trilogy is a series of books set in the Forgotten Realms . The trilogy was written by Paul S . Kemp and released from 2003 to 2005 with cover art by Terese Nielsen .

title: The Faceless God
description: The Faceless God The Forgotten God or the Faceless God was the mysterious savage deity that watched over the empire of the evil yak - men in the World Pillar Mountains in Zakhara ' s northeast . Its name was known by his followers only . It was called " the Forgotten God " or " the Faceless God " by outsiders , because it appeared like a giant yak - man in flowing robes , but without a face .

title: The Fallen Tower
description: The Fallen Tower The Fallen Tower was one of the most popular taverns in Neverwinter . History . The tower was once the home of a local wizard , Llomnauvel " Firehands " Oloadhin .

title: The False
description: The False The False were the souls of those individuals who intentionally betrayed their deities after making a commitment to them during their lifetimes . If judged and found guilty by Kelemvor , they were punished for all eternity . The punishment varried depending on the severity of the crime .

title: The Fangs
description: The Fangs The Fangs were a pair of extremely steep mountains between which — at Fang Pass — the Trade Way led on the way through the Cloud Peaks of Amn . Description . These two crags were not among the tallest in the range , yet they were the most difficult mountains to climb in the Cloud Peaks because of their treacherously steep slopes and the cover of ice .

title: The Fangs of Set
description: The Fangs of Set The Fangs of Set was an organization that tried to rule Mulhorand from the shadows , leading the nation along a path of Set ' s design . They were an adventuring party gathered in 1357 DR by Seti , the living incarnation of Set . It was composed by four members , Hodkamset , Nekiset , Hamsetis and Suliyar , each one commanded a variable numbers of minions .

title: The Finder ' s Stone trilogy
description: The Finder ' s Stone trilogy The Finder ' s Stone trilogy covers the adventures of Alias , Dragonbait , Olive Ruskettle , and Finder Wyvernspur as they travel the Dalelands . The books were written by Jeff Grubb and Kate Novak . Related novels include " Masquerades " , " Finder ' s Bane " , and " Tymora ' s Luck " .

title: The Fine Gold Chain
description: The Fine Gold Chain The Fine Gold Chain was a popular adventurers ' club in Memnon . Location . This club was located in the northwestern drudach of the south - central sabban of Memnon .

title: The First Notch
description: The First Notch The First Notch was the first short story ever written by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Fish House
description: The Fish House The Fish House was a shop located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr , on the southern end of the city and the western bank of the Wyvernflow . It sold fish and ice and was owned by Ascalan , a retired wizard and fishmonger , " circa " 1369 DR . Description .

title: The Founding Time
description: The Founding Time The Founding Time or Age of the Proud Peoples was the period just after the end of the Crown Wars , when the elves and the dwarves dominated Faerûn . During this time , the humanoid races began their expansionist efforts . Elves , dwarves , and the first human tribes founded several realms such as Evereska , High Shanatar , and Imaskar .

title: The Fractured Sky
description: The Fractured Sky The Fractured Sky is the second book in The Empyrean Odyssey trilogy by Thomas M . Reid . Summary .

title: The Furniture ' s Fate
description: The Furniture ' s Fate The Furniture ' s Fate was a tavern in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , owned by Boffo Arglebargle Cosgrove Bullwubble II . The tavern was popular with adventurers operating out of Thunderstone , and thus it was a good spot to hear their stories . As the name suggested , brawls were common , especially those that resulted in broken furniture .

title: The Gambling Ghost
description: The Gambling Ghost The Gambling Ghost was a famous inn in Myratma popularized by its card - playing ghost . Location . The inn was located in the center of the city , bordering a large park or plaza .

title: The Gathering
description: The Gathering " The Gathering " is the first issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Michael Fleisher and Jan Duursema , drawn by Duursema , and edited by Barbara Kesel . It introduced the heroes of the series : Cybriana of Shadowdale , Onyx the Invincible , Timoth Eyesbright , and Vajra Valmeyjar , as well as Priam Agrivar , who would later be a hero of the related " Forgotten Realms " comics series .

title: The Ghost King
description: The Ghost King The Ghost King is the third and final novel in the " Transitions " trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Ghost Ray
description: The Ghost Ray The Ghost Ray was the most mysterious ixzan on Malydren in 1370 DR . History . During the Time of Troubles , a young ixzan living in one of Malydren ' s outlying settlements was blessed by the avatar of Ilxendren with the gift of transformation into a greater vampire , the first after Zekaqux and Phiaqiv .

title: The Glaendra
description: The Glaendra The Glaendra was a lamia noble who led a community of her fellows in the Lion ' s Eye Oasis . Description . The Glaendra was extremely beautiful and very tall , reaching nine feet .

title: The God Catcher
description: The God Catcher The God Catcher by Erin M . Evans is the fifth novel in the Waterdeep series . Erin introduces a few new characters to the Realms including Tennora Hedare and Nestrix .

title: The Godborn
description: The Godborn The Godborn by Paul S . Kemp is the second novel in The Sundering series . It follows The Twilight War Trilogy .

title: The Gossamer Plain
description: The Gossamer Plain The Gossamer Plain is the first novel of The Empyrean Odyssey trilogy by Thomas M . Reid . Summary .

title: The Halfling ' s Gem
description: The Halfling ' s Gem The Halfling ' s Gem is the third book in the Icewind Dale trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Hand ( organization )
description: The Hand ( organization ) The Hand was an evil adventuring group based in Voonlar . They had at least one encounter with the Knights of Myth Drannor during the latter part of Doust Sulwood ' s time as the Lord of Shadowdale ( 1350 DR – 1353 DR ) .

title: The Hand Behind the Mirror
description: The Hand Behind the Mirror The Hand Behind the Mirror was a mercenary company based in Athkatla in Amn . The Hand Behind the Mirror was composed of shadowcasters . They used their shadow magic to swiftly transport warriors to other destinations via the Plane of Shadow .

title: The Hermit
description: The Hermit The Hermit was a corpse tearer linnorm sage living in Narfell during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . The Hermit was a dragon - like creature living in the hills of Narfell with some undead servants .

title: The Hooded One
description: The Hooded One The Hooded One is one of Ed Greenwood ' s gaming group and his official spokesperson on the Candlekeep . com forums . THO ( as she is commonly referred to online ) has worked as an editor for several publishers but does not give out her real name since she also works in national security .

title: The Horn and Hoof
description: The Horn and Hoof The Horn and Hoof is a noisy tavern in Longsaddle , with a great assortment of drinks served at incredibly high prices . It is run by an retired warrior named Malavos Drunn , who keeps order with the threat of force . Violence is still common however , with the dead or beaten bodies simply being tossed outside .

title: The Howling of a Mighty Storm
description: The Howling of a Mighty Storm The druid circle responsible for determining the next Green Regent has been the victim of several kidnappings . Only one is left free and has fled to Loudwater . Unfortunately , in her haste she left behind the chalice needed to complete the ceremony and worries for its safety .

title: The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy
description: The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy is the fifth series of novels about Drizzt Do ' Urden written by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy Collector ' s Edition
description: The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy Collector ' s Edition The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus of The Hunter ' s Blades trilogy , R . A . Salvatore ' s fifth novel trilogy about the drow hero Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: The Icewind Dale Trilogy
description: The Icewind Dale Trilogy The Icewind Dale Trilogy was the first series of books featuring Drizzt Do ' Urden by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Icewind Dale Trilogy Collector ' s Edition
description: The Icewind Dale Trilogy Collector ' s Edition The Icewind Dale Trilogy Collector ' s Edition is an omnibus containing the three novels in The Icewind Dale Trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Inner Planes
description: The Inner Planes Beyond the Prime ' s infinite crystal spheres , beyond the endless realms of the Outer Planes , lies the absolute reality of the Inner Planes . The cornerstone planes of Air , Earth , Fire , and Water are the most well - known Inner Planes , but they ' re only the beginning . From the deadly purity of the Positive and Negative Energy Plane s to the unbearable filth of the plane of Ooze to the eternal storm of the plane of Lightning , the Elemental Planes are the substance of existence itself .

title: The Jaded Unicorn
description: The Jaded Unicorn The Jaded Unicorn was a ramshackle former warehouse in Scornubel was turned into an inn and tavern . It featured a life - sized purple unicorn statue that was wearing makeup . The rooms were of very poor quality and had a bad smell .

title: The Keeper
description: The Keeper The Keeper was a banelar naga involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . The Keeper was a banelar evoked by clerics of Bane in order to act as prison warden of the Twisted Tower of Ashaba .

title: The Knights of Dragon Down
description: The Knights of Dragon Down The Knights of Dragon Down is the favorite Bardic ballad that is also a drinking song of the patrons of A Pair of Black Antlers tavern in Elturel . Notes . The final verse has been outlawed in Elturel because a evil archmage made it a spell that brought undead to those that sang it .

title: The Lady ' s Favor
description: The Lady ' s Favor The Lady ' s Favor was a temple of Tymora in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . History . The temple was built in the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , becoming the first real temple in Sevenecho .

title: The Lady Penitent
description: The Lady Penitent The Lady Penitent trilogy is a Forgotten Realms series by Lisa Smedman that takes place after the events of War of the Spider Queen . Several fairly large realm - changing events take place during this series , ranging from the use of Elven High Magic on the drow race to the death of several deities . It ranges from the year 1372 DR to 1379 DR .

title: The Last Betrayal
description: The Last Betrayal " The Last Betrayal " is the 16th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .

title: The Last Threshold
description: The Last Threshold The Last Threshold is the fourth and final novel of The Neverwinter Saga by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Laughing Lass
description: The Laughing Lass The Laughing Lass was a tavern in Suzail , Cormyr that transformed into a festhall on warm evenings . Inhabitants . The Lass was frequented by the High Wizard Vangerdahast , although he was careful to disguise his identity .

title: The Legacy
description: The Legacy The Legacy is the first book in the Legacy of the Drow series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Legend of Drizzt ( graphic novels )
description: The Legend of Drizzt ( graphic novels ) The Legend of Drizzt is a series of graphic novel versions of the Legend of Drizzt novel series . Of that series , the first two trilogies and two of the later novels have been made into graphic novels . Additionally , several comics not present in novel form are included in the series .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : Exile ( graphic novel )
description: The Legend of Drizzt : Exile ( graphic novel ) The Legend of Drizzt : Exile ( original title : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 2 : Exile ; reissued title : Dungeons & Dragons : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 2 : Exile ) is the graphic novel version of R . A . Salvatore ' s novel " Exile " .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : Homeland ( graphic novel )
description: The Legend of Drizzt : Homeland ( graphic novel ) The Legend of Drizzt : Homeland ( original title : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 1 : Homeland ; reissued title : Dungeons & Dragons : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 1 : Homeland ) is the graphic novel version of R . A . Salvatore ' s novel " Homeland " .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : Sojourn ( graphic novel )
description: The Legend of Drizzt : Sojourn ( graphic novel ) The Legend of Drizzt : Sojourn ( original title : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 3 : Sojourn ; reissued title : Dungeons & Dragons : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 3 : Sojourn ) is the graphic novel version of R . A . Salvatore ' s novel " Sojourn " .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : Streams of Silver ( graphic novel )
description: The Legend of Drizzt : Streams of Silver ( graphic novel ) The Legend of Drizzt : Streams of Silver ( original title : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 5 : Streams of Silver ) is the graphic novel version of R . A . Salvatore ' s novel " Streams of Silver " .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : The Collected Stories
description: The Legend of Drizzt : The Collected Stories The Legend of Drizzt : The Collected Stories is an audiobook of short stories written by R . A . Salvatore , read by a number of notable actors and musicians .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : The Crystal Shard ( graphic novel )
description: The Legend of Drizzt : The Crystal Shard ( graphic novel ) The Legend of Drizzt : The Crystal Shard ( original title : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 4 : The Crystal Shard ) is the graphic novel version of R . A . Salvatore ' s novel " The Crystal Shard " .

title: The Legend of Drizzt : The Halfling ' s Gem ( graphic novel )
description: The Legend of Drizzt : The Halfling ' s Gem ( graphic novel ) The Legend of Drizzt : The Halfling ' s Gem ( original title : Forgotten Realms : The Legend of Drizzt , Volume 6 : The Halfling ' s Gem ) is the graphic novel version of R . A . Salvatore ' s novel " The Halfling ' s Gem " .

title: The Living Jungle
description: The Living Jungle The Living Jungle was an RPGA campaign set in the rainforests of the Malatran Plateau . It was a spin - off of The Living City campaign and was coordinated by Kevin Melka and Dave Gross . The campaign was later taken over by Tom Prusa , who was joined by Steve Jay , who went on to become Story Arc Coordinator .

title: The Lone Drow
description: The Lone Drow The Lone Drow is the second book in The Hunter ' s Blade Trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Lost Gods
description: The Lost Gods The Lost Gods is a gathering of three novels from across the planes . The first and third are by Kate Novak and Jeff Grubb and are based in the Forgotten Realms while the second is from the DragonLance universe by Douglas Niles . Novels .

title: The Lost One
description: The Lost One The Lost One was a deity worshiped on the island of Afyal in Zakhara ' s Crowded Sea before the coming of the enlightened gods . Rumor had it that the Lost One fled Afyal before the advance of the followers of Selan to some place in the Crowded Sea , shedding his name in the process , but idols of his elephant - headed humanoid form could still be found in many remote places of the Isle of the Elephant . Secret of the Lost One .

title: The Magister ( sourcebook )
description: The Magister ( sourcebook ) Notes . This accessory contains a table listing all the new spells described in this publication and the Forgotten Realms Campaign Set " DM ' s Sourcebook of the Realms " with page numbers for reference . The inside front cover has an expanded Magic Items table ( table III from the Dungeon Master ' s Guide 1st edition , page 121 , or the Unearthed Arcana 1st edition , page 84 ) for integrating Forgotten Realms - specific items into the random treasure determination system .

title: The Masked One
description: The Masked One The Masked One was a female human sorceress and rogue adventurer , and an apprentice of the Simbul in 1374 DR . By 1368 DR , she had retired from adventuring to live in Ingdal ' s Arm in Aglarond , where she lived in a house guarded by a tribe of sprite s . It was rumored that when an individual attempted to remove her hood , The Masked One turned that person into a teapot .

title: The Mermaid ' s Purse
description: The Mermaid ' s Purse The Mermaid ' s Purse was an inn in Corth , Aglarond , around 1368 DR , operated by the ex - fisherman Droze . Structure . It is constructed in the typical Aglarondan architectural style , made from weathered wood with a steep roof and dormers .

title: The Moon and Stars
description: The Moon and Stars The Moon and Stars was , according to Volo , one of the greatest taverns in all of the Realms . Geography . Located relatively close to Suzail , it was accessible enough to be convenient yet far enough to avoid frightening the capital ' s meeker inhabitants .

title: The Moonsea War
description: The Moonsea War The Moonsea War was a conflict between the allied forces of Phlan , Hillsfar , Sembia , Melvaunt and Zhentil Keep against the increasingly imperialistic Mulmaster . Mulmaster was blockading the River Lis , an important trade river that connected the Moonsea to the Dragon Reach and Sea of Fallen Stars . The allied armies attacked in 1306 DR .

title: The Morning Watchtower
description: The Morning Watchtower The Morning Watchtower was a watchtower and temple to Lathander in Deadsnows , led by Morninglord Ashnar the Humble . A banner flew from its topmost turret depicting the golden sunrise of Lathander the Morninglord . Inhabitants .

title: The Net of Pearls
description: The Net of Pearls The Net of Pearls was a curios store in Marsember , Cormyr . Atmosphere . It was owned and operated by Tannuth Ormbyr .

title: The Neverwinter Saga
description: The Neverwinter Saga The Neverwinter Saga is a tetralogy of novels written by R . A . Salvatore that feature Drizzt Do ' Urden as the main protagonist .

title: The Nine
description: The Nine The Nine was a powerful , long - lasting band of adventurers that wandered the Realms for over thirty winters . The band maintained a subterranean stronghold , the Stronghold of the Nine , in the High Forest , on the banks of the Unicorn Run . Before they disbanded , they had links to the Harpers and the Lords of Waterdeep .

title: The Occupation of Szith Morcane
description: The Occupation of Szith Morcane The Occupation of Szith Morcane , designed by Cindy Moore , is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th - edition ruleset . It focuses on the village of Elventree , drow , and the Szith Morcane . Summary .

title: The Old Oak
description: The Old Oak The Old Oak is an inn and tavern in Marsember , Cormyr . Previously it had been a noble house but is now somewhat run - down , with rotten wood and patches of mold . It is fairly inexpensive and the cost of a room includes stables .

title: The Orc King
description: The Orc King The Orc King is the first novel of the Transitions series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Orc Marches
description: The Orc Marches The Orc Marches was the name given to one of the biggest orc incursions into the Savage Frontier . In - 111 DR , several massive orc hordes came south from their homes in the Spine of the World and Ice Mountains to devastate the civilizations of the Northlands . The orcs nearly crippled the dwarven realm of Delzoun and destroyed the cities of Illusk and Gauntlgrym before they were turned back by the elves of Iliyanbruen , with help from Rilithar , Siluvanede and Earlann before they could reach the High Forest and Dessarin Valley .

title: The Ostus Legacy
description: The Ostus Legacy " The Ostus Legacy " is the 17th issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by . It was written by Dan Mishkin , drawn by Jan Duursema , and edited by Elliot S . Maggin .

title: The Pack ( fiends )
description: The Pack ( fiends ) The Pack are a group of powerful fiend ish creatures who hunt tanar ' ri in the Abyss . They are led by a great leucrotta named Toknana . Toknana leads Hruba the Chimera , Ylarria the red dragon , Voal the hydra and numerous leucrotta petitioners who were allowed to join the pack as a reward for being dangerous & resourceful during their lives .

title: The Paladin Inn
description: The Paladin Inn The Paladin Inn was an inn in Velprintalar , Aglarond , in 1368 DR . Its patrons were the wealthier nobles and merchants visiting the city , including visiting dignitaries . A room with a breakfast of fruit and ale was five gold piece s , while a supper of fish or fowl with Aglarondan wine was five silver piece s .

title: The Passing of Power
description: The Passing of Power The Passing of Power took place in - 205 DR when the elf Iliphar Nelnueve challenged the black dragon Thauglor to a Feint of Honor . Although a Feint of Honor typically took place between two dragons , Iliphar had cause to challenge Thauglor to put a stop to the fighting between the two races . The dragons contested the elves had invaded their long - established territory , while the elves maintained the dragons did not need to prey upon them .

title: The Paws of the Cheetah
description: The Paws of the Cheetah The Paws of the Cheetah were a pair of Boots of Speed that , slightly differently from others of their sort , doubled their wearer ' s speed of movement on foot at all times . As such , they were used by a deadly assassin who would chase down his prey . The name of this assassin was not known , but at least in 1368 DR the boots were in the possession of Drasus , who might have acquired them from him , or have been that assassin himself .

title: The Phantom Knights
description: The Phantom Knights " The Phantom Knights " was a name given to a group of ghost s that haunted the Glorming Pass through the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast . Their origins and identity were unknown . They were a force of warriors in full plate armor and closed helms bearing lance s and mounted upon horse s .

title: The Phoenix Prophecies
description: The Phoenix Prophecies The Phoenix Prophecies was a collection of prophecies from the great Nar ' ysr of Calimshan , composed by the Herald Swordswreath . Description . " The Phoenix Prophecies " was a seven - volume collection of over 8 , 000 prophecies .

title: The Pirate King
description: The Pirate King The Pirate King is the second book in the Transitions series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Plowing
description: The Plowing The Plowing was the traditional time for breaking ground in readiness for planting throughout the land of the Vast . It began on the 6th Mirtul . On this day , the people in each community formed teams and worked together to plow each other ' s fields for free , going on until every farmer in the area had at least one field ready to sow .

title: The Rage
description: The Rage The Rage is the first book in The Year of Rogue Dragons trilogy by Richard Lee Byers . Summary . The story of this first book is that all dragons of the world , good and evil , are succumbing to the Rage , a curse put on all the dragons that makes them insane and bloodthirsty every century .

title: The Raging Lion
description: The Raging Lion The Raging Lion is a large inn and tavern on the east side of the Trade Way in the north of Scornubel . It is well guarded and has secure stables . It is generally unclean throughout , and a dirty gilded lion stands outside .

title: The Ram and Duck
description: The Ram and Duck The Ram and Duck was a rough inn in Suzail , Cormyr . It had exposed timbers . Most of its furniture was old enough to have been broken and repaired several times .

title: The Ravager ( halberd )
description: The Ravager ( halberd ) The Ravager is a halberd found in " " in Yaga - Shura ' s fortress in the Marching Mountains , wielded by a prince of elemental fire . Already powerful then , it can be greatly enhanced by having Cespenar combine it with the Serpent Staff , making it arguably the most powerful weapon in an expansion full of artifacts of legendary might . The Ravager has a singular appearance for a halberd , looking more like a trident at a first glance .

title: The Ravencoat
description: The Ravencoat The Ravencoat was a local office of the Heralds of Faerûn , based in the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast and performing Herald duties there . This heraldic office was folded into the civic official position of the Regent of City Works . As a herald , The Ravencoat was entitled to a maroon - and - gold adorned with black wings , as well as a trumpet .

title: The Reaver ( novel )
description: The Reaver ( novel ) The Reaver by Richard Lee Byers is the fourth novel of The Sundering ( series ) . Summary . In 1486 DR , endless and torrential rain afflicted the Sea of Fallen Stars , also known as the Inner Sea , and the coastal regions surrounding it .

title: The Ride
description: The Ride The Ride was an open steppe land situated between the Dragonspine Mountains , the Border Forest and the Gray Land of Thar . It was a land of cold plains . The forces of Melvaunt and Zhentil Keep controlled lucrative mines that honeycombed the mountainsides north of the Ride .

title: The Ridge
description: The Ridge The Ridge was a long stretch of cliffs found in the eastern Cloud Peaks . Description . The Ridge was an exposed stretch of fault line nearly 280 feet tall at its center point and extending for more than 50 miles from the Cloud Peaks .

title: The Rise of Tiamat
description: The Rise of Tiamat The Rise of Tiamat , designed by Kobold Press and the Wizards RPG Team , is an adventure module set in the Forgotten Realms using the " Dungeons & Dragons " 5th edition ruleset . It focuses on the Cult of the Dragon ' s efforts to resurrect Tiamat , the goddess of chromatic dragon s . " The Rise of Tiamat " is a principal work in the Tyranny of Dragons storyline , and serves as a direct sequel to the adventure module " Hoard of the Dragon Queen " .

title: The Rising Moon
description: The Rising Moon The Rising Moon was a temple of Selûne in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , the temple was led by High Priest Orlathon Lunemast , who was still in charge by 1370 DR . Beneath him were nine sub - priests of differing ranks .

title: The Roots of the Earth
description: The Roots of the Earth The Roots of the Earth was an unusual combination tavern and shrine to Grumbar , the Earthlord , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Owned , operated , and attended by retired miner Torgan Minerson , he became a convert of Grumbar after surviving entrapment by a cave - in and having visions during his traumatic experience . The Roots was located in the mining district on the east edge of town and catered to the rough and tumble miners with cheap food and drink .

title: The Roving Rune
description: The Roving Rune The Roving Rune was a well - known inn , tavern , and brewery in Teshburl . Structure . The inn was located in an old , a former wizard ' s tower with four levels .

title: The Ruins of Karse
description: The Ruins of Karse Otar has recovered from his coma and returned to Loudwater with an artifact formed from Karsus ' final breath , the " coalescence of scorn " . With it , he plans on foiling the plans of the evil Green King but to succeed , he needs the help of two parties of adventurers . One to help him stop the Green King and another to prevent the Green King ' s minions from stopping them .

title: The Ruins of Undermountain
description: The Ruins of Undermountain The Ruins of Undermountain is a boxed set written by Ed Greenwood and released by TSR in 1991 . The material describes Undermountain , the infamous " über " - dungeon of the Forgotten Realms . It later became the first in a series of supplements about Undermountain .

title: The Ruins of Undermountain II : The Deep Levels
description: The Ruins of Undermountain II : The Deep Levels The Ruins of Undermountain II : The Deep Levels , a box set by Jean Rabe and Norm Ritchie , is the sequel to " The Ruins of Undermountain " . It is the second supplement about the infamous " über " - dungeon , Undermountain , and is followed by three adventure modules and another sourcebook .

title: The Sailor ' s Home
description: The Sailor ' s Home The Sailor ' s Home was a modest inn in Velprintalar , Aglarond , in 1368 DR , kept by Mharus . Its patrons were seafarers and the less wealthy merchants . A room was two silver pieces per night , while a supper of fish , beef or poultry was one copper piece .

title: The Secret of Selûne ' s Eye
description: The Secret of Selûne ' s Eye " The Secret of Selûne ' s Eye " is the third issue of the " Advanced Dungeons & Dragons " comics series set in the " Forgotten Realms " and published by DC Comics . It was written by Michael Fleisher and Jan Duursema , drawn by Duursema , and edited by Barbara Kesel . It continued the story begun in " The Gathering " and " The Bounty Seekers Of Manshaka " .

title: The Sentinel
description: The Sentinel The Sentinel by Troy Denning is the fifth book of The Sundering ( series ) . Summary . In the later months of 1486 DR , Marsember , a major port city in the kingdom of Cormyr , faced several different threats .

title: The Sentinels
description: The Sentinels The Sentinels was the final novel of the Stone of Tymora trilogy by Geno Salvatore and R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Serpent
description: The Serpent The Serpent was the leader of the Phoenix clan ninja in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . The Serpent was a very mysterious clan leader .

title: The Shadow of the Avatar Trilogy
description: The Shadow of the Avatar Trilogy The Shadow of the Avatar Trilogy ' s author , Ed Greenwood , is the creator of the Forgotten Realms . The trilogy is set during the same time frame as The Avatar Series , which describe the events during the Time of Troubles .

title: The Shadowmask
description: The Shadowmask The Shadowmask is the second novel in the Stone of Tymora trilogy by Geno Salvatore and R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Shifter
description: The Shifter The Shifter was a female shifter shadovar wizard and member of the Bounty Hirelings of Cavus Dun . History . The Shifter was the wizard of the Cavus Dun squad tasked by Effron to find Dahlia Sin ' felle and Drizzt Do ' Urden .

title: The Siege
description: The Siege The Siege by Troy Denning is the second novel in the Return of the Archwizards trilogy . Summary . Evereska defends itself against the overwhelming phaerimm in a losing battle for survival , the Chosen of Mystra fight for their goddess against the enigmatic Shadovar who wield the powers of the Shadow Weave and the long - exiled Netherese archwizards try to consolidate their foothold in the Prime Material plane , reclaiming what they see as rightfully theirs .

title: The Sign of Thunder
description: The Sign of Thunder The Sign of Thunder was an inn in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR , run by Boris Elberwelter and Tasha . It was the biggest inn in Thunderstone at the time , and it hosted countless adventuring companies . They used the inn as a base for their activities , and to share information about good places to explore and those to avoid .

title: The Silent Blade
description: The Silent Blade The Silent Blade is the first book in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Silent Room
description: The Silent Room The Silent Room was a temple in Suzail dedicated to the worship of the god of knowledge , Oghma . In the late 15th century DR , the temple was run by High Namer Wyndel Sedranis , a member of the Emmarask noble house . The temple housed a half - dozen priest s and about one hundred laymen .

title: The Sorcerer
description: The Sorcerer The Sorcerer by Troy Denning is the third novel in the Return of the Archwizards trilogy . Summary . Tilverton has been laid to waste by the Shadovar forces , but the Shadovar paid a steep price for their victory , as the Cormyrian war wizards obliterated many of their numbers .

title: The Spine of the World
description: The Spine of the World The Spine of the World is the second book in the Paths of Darkness series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Spirit of Myrrth
description: The Spirit of Myrrth Background . This issue Jeff Grubb provides the character sheet for Onyx the Invincible . There is also a brief article about the clerics of Waterdeep .

title: The Steel Princess ' s Field Guide
description: The Steel Princess ' s Field Guide The Steel Princess ' s Field Guide was a book on military matters written by Her Royal Highness Princess Alusair of Cormyr in the 1360s DR . A copy could be found in the War Library of the Abbey of the Sword , a temple to Tempus in Battledale , around 1372 DR .

title: The Stirge
description: The Stirge The Stirge is an NPC from the game , Neverwinter Nights . He is a murderer of infants , and was imprisoned in the jail at Waterdeep . At the time the PC encounters the Stirge , he has escaped the prison along with four accomplices , and has a bounty on his head .

title: The Stowaway
description: The Stowaway The Stowaway by Geno Salvatore and R . A . Salvatore was the first novel of the Stone of Tymora trilogy .

title: The Summoning
description: The Summoning The Summoning by Troy Denning is the first novel in the Return of the Archwizards trilogy . Summary . " The Summoning " focuses on the elf Galaeron Nihmedu , an Evereskan Tomb Guard , as he patrols the desert border south , coming across a band of tomb robbers his patrol intervenes and inadvertently releases a great evil imprisoned below the desert .

title: The Sundering ( series )
description: The Sundering ( series ) The Sundering is a series of stand alone novels explaining the events of the Second Sundering , during the Era of Upheaval . Novel releases beginning in August 2013 : Dust Jacket Inner Cover : Novels in Series . The Companions .

title: The Swinging Sword
description: The Swinging Sword The Swinging Sword is an inn owned and operated by two elderly sisters Jhandlatha Taskloath and Peieyrie Taskaloath in the town of Red Larch . Appearance . The Swinging Sword is a two - story building of stone and timber with a covered porch that runs parallel to the Long Road .

title: The Sword
description: The Sword The Sword was one of the three major regions of Anauroch . It was the hot , sandy region most thought of when someone mentioned the Great Desert . Etymology .

title: The Swordbelt
description: The Swordbelt The Swordbelt is the name given to the land in central Amn . The northern most part is the foothills of the Small Teeth mountains and the southernmost part is The Wealdath . The easternmost part is the Sword Coast and the easternmost point is the town of Brost .

title: The Tankard of Eels
description: The Tankard of Eels The Tankard of Eels was a tavern in Marsember , Cormyr , operating around 1367 DR . It took its name from a half - ogre patron who once drank a tankard of eel s as a bet . The beverage was later removed from the menu .

title: The Tarnished Trumpet
description: The Tarnished Trumpet The Tarnished Trumpet was a tavern that faced the Mayor ' s Tower in Hill ' s Edge in the Western Heartlands . It was alleged to be the best drinking location in Hill ' s Edge . It was a noisy , raucous tavern with tapestries and battered weapons on the walls .

title: The Teeth of Calaunt
description: The Teeth of Calaunt The Teeth of Calaunt , or simply The Teeth , were the standing army of the city - state of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR . Organization . The Teeth numbered six thousand soldiers , twenty battle - mages , and twenty warcaptains .

title: The Temptation of Elminster
description: The Temptation of Elminster The Temptation of Elminster by Ed Greenwood is the third book in the open - ended Elminster series . Summary . The first section ( 759 DR ) deals with Elminster emerging from a tomb ( after being freed by adventurers ) where he has been trapped in stasis for a number of years .

title: The Thousand Orcs
description: The Thousand Orcs The Thousand Orcs is first book of The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Three
description: The Three The Three was a collective term for the deities worshiped in the land of Rashemen . Originally these were Bhalla ( Chauntea ) , the Hidden One ( Mystra ) and Khelliara ( Mielikki ) . Sometime after Mystra ' s " death " and the resulting Spellplague she was replaced by Selûne in the Rashemi pantheon .

title: The Throne of Bloodstone
description: The Throne of Bloodstone The Throne of Bloodstone is the ultimate adventure in the Bloodstone Pass series and the highest level adventure in Dungeons & Dragons history . Designed for characters up to 100th ( ! ) level , it pulls out all the stops , with battles against great wyrm s and balor demons that are nothing more than lead - ins to the " really " powerful villains .

title: The Triad
description: The Triad The Triad was an alliance of three good - aligned deities : Tyr the Maimed God , god of justice ; Ilmater the Broken God , god of suffering ; and Torm the True , god of duty . They were a particularly powerful alliance that was one of the major forces behind the founding of the Triadic church , and their splinter group , the Triadic Knight s . Several crusades were launched over the course of history in their name .

title: The Truth of Hearts
description: The Truth of Hearts The first of a four - module series called the Tides of War . A spy who had been collecting information on the defences of Loudwater for the last two years has left town . He needs to be captured before he can inform the city ' s enemies .

title: The Tumbling Goblets
description: The Tumbling Goblets The Tumbling Goblets was a gnome - run festhall in Skultan , Sembia , that was in existence in 1368 DR . It was staffed by attractive human females , and was home to underhand dealings . A rumor existed that Purple Dragon s would permit these dealings to continue , accepting bribes in the form of discounted " services " .

title: The Twilight Giants
description: The Twilight Giants The Twilight Giants series is a group of three novels written by Troy Denning and Published by TSR , Inc . from 1994 – 1995 and then reprinted in 2005 by Wizards of the Coast . The novels take place in a little known part of the North called Hartsvale .

title: The Twilight Tomb
description: The Twilight Tomb The Twilight Tomb is an adventure module set in the " Forgotten Realms " for the 3 . 5 edition of " Dungeons & Dragons " . It was designed by Greg A .

title: The Two Swords
description: The Two Swords The Two Swords is the last book in The Hunter ' s Blades Trilogy by R . A . Salvatore .

title: The Vast
description: The Vast The Vast was a region in north Faerûn that rested along the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars , bounded by the Dragon Reach and River Lis in the west ; the Earthspur Mountains , the Gray Forest , and Impiltur in the east ; and the Moonsea and Damara in the north . It lay on both sides of the Earthfast Mountains that ran through it . Over its long history , it was home to the orc nation of Vastar for which it was named ; the ancient elf city of Ylraphon , an outpost of Cormanthyr ; the brief dwarf kingdom of Roldilar , the Realm of Glimmering Swords ; and a variety of human city - states — historic Procampur and Tsurlagol , and the newcomers Calaunt , Tantras , and Ravens Bluff , the Living City — some of which gathered into the nation of Vesperin .

title: The Wanderer
description: The Wanderer The Wanderer was an amnesiac kensai of Kozakura in 1358 DR . History . The Wanderer was at the Battle of Kiroshima .

title: The Warlock King
description: The Warlock King " The Warlock King " was a ballad known in Faerûn , about a warlock king . A few minstrels mistakenly called the ancient lich wizard Larloch " the Warlock " or " the Warlock King " , after the Warlock ' s Crypt where he dwelled , but Larloch apparently took umbrage at being called a warlock . Composers of ballads naming him as such were supposedly kidnapped by creatures in the night and carried away to be tortured and turned into some undead thing by Larloch .

title: The Way
description: The Way The Way was a faith dominant in Shou Lung , T ' u Lung , and other lands of Kara - Tur . It espoused a philosophy that there were no separate forces of good , evil , chaos , and law , but only interconnected and interrelated forces that followers of the Way could shape . Its followers were divided into a Dark Way and a Light Way .

title: The Way Inn
description: The Way Inn The Way Inn was a famous landmark on the Trade Way . It stood roughly 100 miles northwest of Dragonspear Castle . Ownership .

title: The Widower
description: The Widower The Widower was a drow wizard who led a group belonging to Clan Auzkovyn . History . Nothing , including his name , was actually known about the Widower .

title: The Wight on a Waterdragon
description: The Wight on a Waterdragon The Wight on a Waterdragon was a restaurant in Marsember , Cormyr . It took its name from the sculpture on the roof , shaped into a wight riding a creature like a blue dragon but with fins instead of legs . It was carved in Marsember itself by Jathoom Berl .

title: The Winking Wemic
description: The Winking Wemic The Winking Wemic was a gnome - run festhall in Skultan , Sembia , that was in existence in 1368 DR . It was staffed by attractive human females , and was home to underhanded dealings . A rumor existed that Purple Dragon s would permit these dealings to continue , accepting bribes in the form of discounted " services " .

title: The Worried Wyvern
description: The Worried Wyvern The Worried Wyvern , also known as the Worried Wyvern Inn or simply the Wyvern , and formerly known as The Wandering Wyvern , was a famous , high - quality inn found in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast . Reputation . The Worried Wyvern was widely considered to be one of the finest inns in the Vast , ranked just behind The Wizard ' s Hand in Maskyr ' s Eye and competing with The Elf in Armor in High Haspur , and was among the best in all Faerûn .

title: The Year of Rogue Dragons trilogy
description: The Year of Rogue Dragons trilogy The Year of Rogue Dragons is a trilogy by Richard Lee Byers . It covers the calamitous events of 1373 DR , the " Year of Rogue Dragons " . The Rage The Year of Rogue Dragons .

title: The diary of Sarevok
description: The diary of Sarevok The diary of Sarevok told the story of Sarevok Anchev and the events he was involved in before the Iron Throne set the Iron crisis on the Sword Coast in motion and during the iron crisis itself until Gorion ' s Ward stopped the Iron Throne operations in the Cloakwood . The diary was in the possession of Cythandria in the Iron Throne headquarters in Baldur ' s Gate .

title: The fist
description: The fist The fist is a magic + 1 chainmail gauntlet made from adamantine , created by dwarves . Description . It is covered with spikes and protects the wearer from " chill metal " and " heat metal " .

title: The flaming seas
description: The flaming seas Ganra ye - do , or " the flaming seas " was an area of sea lying south of the southwestern tip of the Koryo Peninsula in Koryo , Kara - Tur . The Muradi Lighthouse at the end of the peninsula was maintained to warn of ganra ye - do .

title: The man in green
description: The man in green The man in green was a male human who visited the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The man in green was part of Knaves ' Challenge .

title: The sun
description: The sun The sun of Realmspace , rarely also called Sol , was an enormous sphere of fire at the center of that crystal sphere , and the source of light and heat of the eight planets circling around it . In fact , the sun was so hot that any closer inspection was impossible for creatures not naturally immune to fire , even if magic al aid was employed . Features .

title: Thear Chessar
description: Thear Chessar Thear Chessar was a female shield dwarf rogue in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Thear was very clever , using her image as a dwarf to avoid suspicion .

title: Theara Gravelthumb
description: Theara Gravelthumb Theara Gravelthumb was a duergar in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Theara was traveling through the myconid settlement of Sporedome when she was attacked and captured by a group of githyanki servants of the rogue mind flayer warlock Xicvizt .

title: Thearnytaar
description: Thearnytaar Thearnytaar was an ancient kingdom of green elves created during the First Flowering in - 21400 DR . History . Thearnytaar was drawn into the War of Three Leaves against Syòrpiir and Eiellûr by the actions of assassins and spies from Ilythiir in - 17100 DR .

title: Theebles Royuset
description: Theebles Royuset Theebles Royuset was a former merchant and a lieutenant of the Basadoni Cabal , a thieves ' guild in Calimport . He was also the mentor to the young Artemis Entreri until his untimely death . Royuset had bought his position in the thieves ' guild sheerly through money .

title: Thegger Grynn
description: Thegger Grynn Thegger Grynn was one of the Red Wizards of Thay at Bloodgate Keep around 1485 DR . History . In 1485 DR , Thegger decided to take control of the Phylund Lodge , with the aid of a tribe of gnoll s and the possessing pit fiend Baazka .

title: Thelarr
description: Thelarr A thelarr was a simple wind instrument cut from a reed . It was considered a rustic longhorn . Description .

title: Theldir Whitemoon
description: Theldir Whitemoon Theldir Whitemoon was a male sun elf psion shaper and an older member of the Kaliesh ' erai , an association of psionic elves in Evereska . Around 1374 DR , Theldir Whitemoon had emerged as the leader of a conservative contingent within the Kaliesh ' erai , older members who preferred seclusion and separation from the outer , non - elven world .

title: Theleda Rost
description: Theleda Rost Theleda Rost was a human and was a former member of the Company of the White Star . When the company disbanded , she settled in Waterdeep and used her treasures to run her own tavern , and provision caravans and merchant ships . She was an expert with traps and locks .

title: Thelgaar Ironhand
description: Thelgaar Ironhand Thelgaar Ironhand was the king of Oman ' s Isle , in the center of the Moonshae Isles . History . In 1345 DR , Grunnarch the Red brought his host of longship s to Thelgaar Ironhand ' s Iron Keep on Oman ' s Isle to prepare an attack on the southern Moonshae Isles .

title: Thelia Ondertos
description: Thelia Ondertos Thelia Ondertos was a human woman who owned the Leaping Hart Tavern as of 1479 DR . She lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . History .

title: Thelorn
description: Thelorn Thelorn was a human man and the proprietor of Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys in Red Larch . Thelorn was a former mercenary who became a skilled wheelwright . He had money invested in not only his business in Red Larch , but also in real estate in Waterdeep .

title: Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys
description: Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys is a wagonworks shop owned by the ex - mercenary , Thelorn , in the town of Red Larch . Thelorn ' s Safe Journeys usually has at least a dozen high quality wagons in stock which cost about 150 gold pieces . These ready - made wagons are stored out of the weather under a large shed .

title: Thelossa
description: Thelossa Thelossa was a drow werebat who contracted the disease in 1352 DR . She left her home in Maerimydra and since then wandered the Underdark with her two dire bat animal companions . It is thought that she foolishly attacked the party of adventurers who went on to defeat Irae T ' sarran and paid for that foolishness with her life .

title: Thelve Baruinheld
description: Thelve Baruinheld Thelve Baruinheld was a merchant and member of the Six Coffers Market Priakos . Activities . Thelve was one of the original six founders of the merchant company .

title: Themberchaud
description: Themberchaud Themberchaud was a red dragon allied with the duergar of Gracklstugh in the Northdark of the Underdark in 1370 DR . Personality . Like most of his kind , Themberchaud was vain and proud .

title: Thendara Spearsinger
description: Thendara Spearsinger Thendara Spearsinger was a shield dwarf of the dwarven city of Earthfast in the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn in the 14th century DR . She was a captain in the hearth guard , and said to be a fierce fighter . Thendara was the mate of Olam Chistlesmith and the mother of the bard Morgalla the Mirthful .

title: Thendarion
description: Thendarion Thendarion , also called the Wizard of the Boot , was a man from the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . He was a wizard trapped in the form of a boot . History .

title: Thendric
description: Thendric Thendric was a male human fighter and a temple guard at the new Temple of Mystra in Wheloon , Cormyr . Activities . Thendric stood guard in the outer courtyard of the temple , and had a bunk in the guard post outside .

title: Theod
description: Theod Theod was a female troglodyte barbarian who roamed the Deep Wastes on raids for her tribe . Description . Theod wore studded leather armor and gauntlets on her raids .

title: Theoderus
description: Theoderus Theoderus was an eccentric and reclusive dwarven wizard who lived in a small , subterranean sanctum just outside the city of Melvaunt . He spent most of his time fashioning enchantments for items that are brought to him from various clientele . Background .

title: Theodo Greataxe
description: Theodo Greataxe Theodo Greataxe was a dwarf and commander of a small group of other dwarves who made a valiant final stand upon Dead Dwarf Bridge . Activities . In order to give Almorel time to prepare against an invasion from Narfell , Theodo and seven other dwarves blocked their passage across Clearflow Bridge .

title: Theodoric
description: Theodoric Theodoric was a cleric of Tempus in the Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Theodoric was the patriarch of Tempus in Chondath and a scholar of the old Chessentan Empire .

title: Theorists
description: Theorists The Theorists was an intellectual group in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . The Theorists were a group of friends who indulged in arguing about philosophy , literature , art , and politics .

title: Thepurl ' s Diamond
description: Thepurl ' s Diamond Thepurl ' s Diamond was a sailing ship on the Sea of Fallen Stars owned by the lich Ebonsoul . History . The ship was attacked and sunk by pirates around the time of the Spellplague .

title: Theras
description: Theras Theras was a half - elf druid and the bastard child of a prince . Description . Clad in brown robes and a green cloak , Theras had lengthy brown hair , partially worked into a braid over his right ear .

title: Theremen Ulath
description: Theremen Ulath Theremen Ulath was the lord of Deepingdale in 1374 DR . Activities . Responsible for the Dale ' s defense , enforcing laws , and handling diplomatic matters , Theremen always used only the minimum authority necessary .

title: Therescales
description: Therescales Therescales was the best wizard - hunter in Luthcheq in Chessenta in 1357 DR . Activities . Therescales was an agent of Jaerios Karanok .

title: Theriheb
description: Theriheb Theriheb was a paladin of Osiris in Mulhorand in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Theriheb went to participate in the tournament held in Mourktar in Threskel to choose the new king .

title: Therin
description: Therin Therin was the strongman of Pinch ' s thieves guild . Personality . Therin was ambitious and had tried unsuccessfully to become the boss of the gang instead of Pinch .

title: Therion Gers
description: Therion Gers Therion Gers ( later Therion the First of Gers ) was the human friend of Nether the Younger , one of the earliest rulers of Netheril . When the humans of Netheril began trading with the Earlanni elves , Therion became the first to learn the ways of magic , and after around a year of training , was able to cast the magic necessary to start a fire .
