Two years later , he had risen to the third most important position in Netheril , after Nether the Younger and the shaman Spiritsummoner .

title: Theris
description: Theris Theris was the dying king of Mourktar in Threskel in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 , Theris was on the verge of dying without an heir .

title: Theron
description: Theron Theron was a cook in Neverwinter . Personality . Theron did not like human s because he thought they smelled .

title: Therus
description: Therus Therus was a leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . History . Therus established a small chapter of the cult inside a former Zhent watchtower near Mulmaster .

title: Therzt
description: Therzt Therzt , known simply as the Chosen of Ghaunadaur , was a male drow Chosen of Ghaunadaur in Neverwinter . History . In 1484 DR , he was responsible for the transformation of the Blacklake into sludge .

title: Thesk
description: Thesk The nation of Thesk was an oligarchy of around 850 , 000 people , inhabited by human s , gnome s , and orc s . The majority of its inhabitants were either merchants or farmers . The Golden Way , the main trade route to Kara - Tur , ran through Thesk , exposing it to a wide variety of cultures and making its people more tolerant than most Faerûnians .

title: Thesk Mountains
description: Thesk Mountains The Thesk Mountains were bare , inhospitable mountains in Thesk that reached as high as 7 , 000 feet ( 2 , 100 meters ) . They featured extremely difficult terrain , and offered a limited amount of iron ore which was enough to supply the nation and provide extra for export .

title: Theskyn
description: Theskyn Theskyn was the court mage of Athalantar and an old friend and trusted servant of the Stag King Uthgrael Aumar . He tutored prince Cauln Aumar and many magelings sent to Hastarl by the outlying knights of the realm . He died soon after Uthgrael in 217 DR , poisoned by Belaur Aumar ' s agents .

title: Theskyn ' s hearty heave
description: Theskyn ' s hearty heave Theskyn ' s hearty heave was an evocation spell that created a blast of force . Effects . Casting this spell caused a blast of force to project from the caster , pushing away creatures that may have surrounded them .

title: Thesophul Wugg
description: Thesophul Wugg Thesophul Wugg was a shopkeeper and transmuter in Skullport . Activities . Thesophul managed a shop that provided adventurers who wanted to explore Undermountain with all they needed .

title: Thessaloni Canos
description: Thessaloni Canos Thessaloni Canos was the tharchion of the island tharch of Aloar in Thay . Description . Thessaloni was a tall woman even by Mulan standards .

title: Thessaly
description: Thessaly Thessaly was a succubus agent of the demon lord Graz ' zt in Hillsfar in 1491 DR . History . During the Rage of Demons in 1491 DR , Thessaly posed as the recently arrived sister of Davon Malaeda , the closest advisor of First Lord Torin Nomerthal ( in truth , Davon had been replaced by the incubus Ruexohn ) .

title: Thessar
description: Thessar Thessar the Warrior was a famous former mercenary in 1370 . History . Thessar worked as a mercenary for a long time on the Dragon Coast , having many adventures .

title: Thestryl Mellardin
description: Thestryl Mellardin Thestryl Mellardin was a pale girl mage and a member of the Harpers in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Thestryl lived inside the City of the Dead cemetery .

title: Thezz Tlabbar
description: Thezz Tlabbar Thezz tlabbar was a drow warrior of House Faen Tlabbar in Menzoberranzan . Description . Thezz had a good look .

title: Thibbledorf Pwent
description: Thibbledorf Pwent Thibbledorf Pwent was the dwarf leader of the Gutbusters of Mithral Hall . Description . Pwent was known for wearing vicious - looking spiked armor .

title: Thief ' s lament
description: Thief ' s lament Thief ' s lament was an alteration spell that protected an area by making it difficult for thieves to practice their trade . Effects . Unless a thief was able to resist " theif ' s lament " , most of the abilities thieves were known for were made much more difficult by this spell .

title: Thieraven
description: Thieraven Thieraven was a shadar - kai commander in the Lost Refuge in 1374 DR . History . Thieraven was sent by Esvele Greycastle to help Despayr organize his plot .

title: Thieves ' Patrol
description: Thieves ' Patrol The Thieves ' Patrol was the name given to the group of wandering ghost s that could be spotted in the Battle of Bones . Activities . The ghosts emerged from their resting place on the night of each new moon , only to be trampled again before dawn by the ghosts of those who acidentally killed them centuries ago .

title: Thieves ' cant
description: Thieves ' cant Thieves ' cant was the secret language of rogue s . Uses . This hidden language consisted more of and innuendos more than an actual language .

title: Thieves ' guild
description: Thieves ' guild A thieves ' guild was a guild of organized thieves and rogue s . Most major cities in Faerûn , and some smaller ones , had one or more thieves ' guilds . Some were powerful enough to hold significant political power , which they often obtained through bribery and intimidation .

title: Thieves ' tools
description: Thieves ' tools Thieves ' tools encompassed a wide array of equipment that aided a prospective rogue during their illicit activities . Many of these items were hand - crafted by the individual who intended to use them , but some were available through local guilds or even from Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Thieves Guild of Waterdeep
description: Thieves Guild of Waterdeep Several organizations attempted to claim this title over the many years Waterdeep existed . From 1255 DR , until it ' s near destruction and exile in 1298 DR , the Shadow Thieves were the closest claimant to the title . After 1298 DR , no organization could claim the title and the rise of the Red Sashes in 1311 DR put further pressure on stopping any would be claimant .

title: Thieving helmet
description: Thieving helmet Thieving helmets were special helmets worn by some rogues . Uses . One of the most important senses to a thief is his sense of hearing .

title: Thilren Sohj
description: Thilren Sohj Thilren Sohj was a Zhentarim spy inside the Cult of the Dragon in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , Thilren managed to infiltrate the Cult under the orders of his Zhent masters .

title: Thimblewine
description: Thimblewine Thimblewine was the most notorious fence in Skullport . Activities . Thimblewine was famous for always identifying the real value of items people sold to him and paying only 10 % of it .

title: Thindilar
description: Thindilar Thindilar was a town in the Vast in north Faerûn , located on the Cross Road between Blanaer and Hlintar , and on Blaern ' s Trail between Calaunt and Sendrin . History . Early in the Vast ' s history , before human rule and Thindilar , a flying cloud castle home to cloud giant s was defeated in some magical battle .

title: Thindol
description: Thindol Thindol was a little - known country on the southern coast of the Chultan Peninsula . It was full of grasslands and inhabited by Tashalan s and Chultans of the Thingugh tribe , known for their swift running . Gold dwarves , kuo - toa , and yuan - ti also inhabited the region .

title: Thiotar Umbarton
description: Thiotar Umbarton Thiotar Umbarton was a male human cleric of Tempus , the Lord of Battle , in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR . Thiotar was High Battlemaster of the House of Glory temple to Tempus at the time . He led sixteen priests and twenty - two lay - followers .

title: Thirsty sand
description: Thirsty sand Thirsty sand was a magical sand originating in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , that possessed magical properties similar to " dust of dryness " . Powers . " Thirsty sand " drained water from nearby living creatures .

title: Thlorrog
description: Thlorrog Thlorrog was a mind flayer living in Gauntlgrym in the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Thlorrog was the leader of a illithid sept that kidnapped many being in order to use as guinea - pigs for their experiment until the Underdark explorer Soren Ravaris send an adventurer to defeat them an to kill Thlorrog .

title: Thogaf
description: Thogaf Thogaf was a human wizard who found himself imprisoned in the Fortress of the Five Vultures in Calaunt . Description . Thogaf was a tan - skinned man with long , brown hair , dressed in a green shirt .

title: Thogonia Grim
description: Thogonia Grim Thogonia Grim was a human woman and a priestess of Umberlee in the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . By 1367 DR , Thogonia Grim was high priestess of Battering Wave temple of Umberlee in Tsurlagol , where she was served by six priests of fanatical beliefs . She was still in charge by 1370 DR .

title: Thok Lian
description: Thok Lian Thok Lian was the monarch of Laothan in Malatra . Personality . Thok was more prone to speach than to action .

title: Thokkor
description: Thokkor Thokkor of the Furrowed Mountains was in charge of Huzuz ' s mercenary units . Personality . Thokkor ' s strong sense of discipline snapped the unruly mercenaries serving Huzuz into shape after he assumed command .

title: Tholtz Daggerdark
description: Tholtz Daggerdark Tholtz Daggerdark was a sea - captain in Trackless Sea sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Tholtz was one of the mad devotee thralls of Slarkrethel .

title: Thom Reaverson
description: Thom Reaverson Thom Reaverson was a bard and historian of the 1360s DR . Reaverson was the author of " History of the Crusade " in the early 1360s DR , which gave a complete , accurate , and unbiased account of King Azoun IV ' s crusade against the Tuigan Horde in the Year of the Turret , 1360 DR . He also aided the lama Koja on his " Life among the Tuigan " , providing translation and guidance .

title: Thomas M . Costa
description: Thomas M . Costa Thomas M . Costa is a senior analyst with the Government Accountability Office , but in his spare time has written and contributed towards various written works for Wizards of the Coast , including " Demihuman Deities " and " Races of Faerûn " .

title: Thomas Raphiel
description: Thomas Raphiel Thomas Raphiel was the Lord Regent of Ravens Bluff from 1345 DR - - ? Appearance . Thomas Raphiel stands 6 ' 2 " and weighs 195 pounds .

title: Thomdor Ammaeth
description: Thomdor Ammaeth Baron Thomdor Ammaeth was the cousin of Azoun IV and Warden of the Eastern Marches of Cormyr . He lived in Arabel . Appearance .

title: Thommar
description: Thommar Thommar was a location lying somewhere near Durpar , south of the Dustwall Mountains in southeast Faerûn . It lay south of Bralizzar , a town nestled in the Dustwall . The mountains shielded Thommar from the Raurin desert .

title: Thondar
description: Thondar Thondar was an inhabitant of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr and a member of the Purple Dragons . History . Thondar held the position of Roadcaptain in the Purple Dragons and led road patrols around Wheloon in the 1350s DR .

title: Thongi SamBhota
description: Thongi SamBhota Thongi SamBhota was the abbot of Lagiluri during the mid – 14th century DR . Appearance . Thongi wore an orange wool robe and a leopard pendant .

title: Thontoros
description: Thontoros Thontoros the Learned , also called the Sage of the Just Gods , was a sage . Thontoros made a study of the clergy , relics , and deeds of the followers of the deities of justice : Helm , Ilmater , Torm , and Tyr . Thontoros once wrote about how the Twelve Champions of Torm defended the citadel of Lothtia on the Shining Plains against orc s in the Year of the Blood Tusk Charge , 1158 .

title: Thoon
description: Thoon Thoon was perhaps a deity or some other entity which was venerated by a specific group of mind flayer s , or it could have been a guiding philosophy just as well . Worshipers . The mind flayers traveled the Underdark , where they spread the philosophy of Thoon .

title: Thoqqua
description: Thoqqua Thoqqua , also called rock worms , were worm - like elemental s native to the Elemental Plane of Fire . Description . A thoqqua ' s long body was hot enough to melt rock .

title: Thoran
description: Thoran Thoran was a shadar - kai warrior in the ruin of Spellgard . History . Thoran was once the apprentice of a cabal of Shadowfell sages until he was exiled for stealing forbidden tomes .

title: Thorass alphabet
description: Thorass alphabet Thorass was the name of the alphabet used by the large majority of human languages on Faerûn , including Common . The alphabet was first developed for use with the Thorass language by a scribe whose name has been lost to history and was spurred by interactions between the kingdoms of Jhaamdath and Calimshan . It was influenced by the runes of the Untheric language .

title: Thorass language
description: Thorass language Thorass , or Old ( Auld ) Common , was an old human language , the original trade language of Faerûn and the direct ancestor of Common . Description . Thorass was similar enough to modern Common that it could be directly translated into the latter language , though it would have an jarring form and archaic vocabulary .

title: Thorass languages
description: Thorass languages The Thorass languages composed a large linguistic grouping of languages spoken throughout Faerûn , including Thorass , Chondathan , and Common . Subgroups . The Thorass language group was broken down by scholars into five subgroups : Script .

title: Thorlor ' s Well
description: Thorlor ' s Well Thorlor ' s Well was a well and campsite situated north of the western side of Ankhwood north of the Lake of Steam . History . At Thorlor ' s Well , " circa " 1342 DR , Sir Guth of Ormpetarr , a knight of Ilmater , confronted the mad Ilmatari priest Bloirt Waelarn over his crimes and challenged him to single combat .

title: Thorm
description: Thorm Thorm was a dwarven merchant who partnered with Tatigan Carrlock and another merchant in 1480 DR to form a caravan that journeyed to Rashemen . Unknown to Tatigan , Thorm was secretly working with bandits who attacked the caravan along the Golden Way . Throm was killed in a battle with his former comrades when the witch Ilvani and Daruk the bard used illusion magic to hide a crevasse into which Thorm fell .

title: Thorm Sureblade
description: Thorm Sureblade Thorm Sureblade was the Guildmaster of the Independent Fighters ' Guild of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance .

title: Thorn
description: Thorn Thorn was a lythari fighter and adventuring companion of Liriel Baenre and Sharlarra Vendreth . She was a champion of Eilistraee and a Moonhunter , able to travel through moonbeams . Description .

title: Thorn ( fey )
description: Thorn ( fey ) Thorns were small fey warriors who acted as guardians of other fey creatures . They took their name from the longswords they carried , which were constructed from thorny plants . Most thorns in Faerûn lived in the Dalelands or Cormanthor .

title: Thorn Island
description: Thorn Island Thorn Island was located in the Moonsea , south of the civilized portion of the city of Phlan out in the Bay of Phlan . Geography . The island was shaped like a tear with Sokol Keep sitting on the western portion .

title: Thorn Tlassalune
description: Thorn Tlassalune Thorn Tlassalune was an innkeeper in Amphail . Activities . Thorn owned the Stone Stallion .

title: Thorn Tree
description: Thorn Tree Thorn Tree was a local office of the Heralds of Faerûn , based in the city of Riatavin in Tethyr and performing Herald duties there . History . In the late 1360s DR , the office of Thorn Tree was occupied by a half - elf male .

title: Thorndathus Ardenthyn
description: Thorndathus Ardenthyn Thorndathus Ardenthyn , better known as Father Thorn , was one of the founders of the Scions of Amber , and its leader in 1479 DR . Description . Father Thorn was a hulking dragonborn who wore a black patch over one eye at all times .

title: Thornhold
description: Thornhold Thornhold was a fortress located off the southern edge of the Mere of Dead Men . Location . A short way from the top of a hill whose west side dropped off into a seaside cliff .

title: Thornwood
description: Thornwood The Thornwood was a forest by the Lake of Steam . Geography . The River Minta flowed through it from Erlkazar to the Lake of Steam and out to the Shining Sea .

title: Thoth
description: Thoth Thoth ( pronounced " thoth " ) is the scribe and historian of the Mulhorandi pantheon . Also known by the names Tholaunt in Thay and Thalatos in Unther , Thoth is an intellectual deity known for academic debate and innovation . History .

title: Thought sphere
description: Thought sphere The Thought sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s that followed deities of knowledge and learning . These spells treated thoughts as objects to be discovered and manipulated , even altering reality . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Thousand Maws
description: Thousand Maws The Thousand Maws were a group of one hundred caves located in the Nether Mountains and were the homes of the Thousand Fists orc tribe . Structure . Many of the caverns were huge , such as Arraggar , the home of around 60 orcs , and Oltho , where roughly 70 orcs lived .

title: Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya
description: Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya The Thousand Sacred Sources of the Gaya was a collection of hundreds of rivers in the Hordelands and southeast Faerûn that fed the Gaya , also known as the River Xon , which flowed between Durpar and Ulgarth and Xontuil Bay and the Golden Water . Fed by the great Jumpa River , its many tributaries and sources lay throughout the Katakoro Shan and the A - Ling Shan ranges of the Yehimal and the facing plains . These rivers were considered sacred in the Padhran religion and were a path of pilgrimage for the faithful .

title: Thousand Year War
description: Thousand Year War The Thousand Year War was a conflict between dragonkind and the giant nation of Ostoria . It began in the Time of Dragons , c . - 26000 DR , and lasted until c .

title: Thousandheads Trading Coster
description: Thousandheads Trading Coster The Thousandheads Trading Coster was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . Bharavan Bhaerkantos , a former adventurer , founded this merchant company .

title: Thovantareth
description: Thovantareth Thovantareth , also known as the Finder of Lost Hoards , was a brown dragon who lived in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . History . In 1479 DR , Thovantareth was seeking lost treasures in the ruins of Firetrees when he met the adventuress Jada Marlserpent , who rightly claimed to be one of the fabled dragonheir s .

title: Thoyana Jorgadaul
description: Thoyana Jorgadaul Thoyana Jorgadaul was the constable and served as village ruler of the town of Elmwood . Description . Thoyana was a calm dwarf woman with a gray braided beard who tolerated no troublemakers in her village .

title: Thradulf ' s Camp
description: Thradulf ' s Camp Thradulf ' s Camp was located in the southwestern region of the Cold Wood and was ruled by the cruel Thradulf Longfang , of the Red Tiger Tribe . History . Thradulf became leader of the Red Tiger tribe in 1368 DR succeeding Adalwulf Longfang , a wise leader who ruled his tribe long and well .

title: Thraxata
description: Thraxata Thraxata is a red dragon . On Elesias 7 1373 DR , Thraxata set many fires in Battledale , consuming a large part of the woodland there . In 1370 DR , Thraxata was desribed as a " young red dragon " and was known to lair on Bloodhorn .

title: Thraxxia
description: Thraxxia Thraxxia is a half - fiendish daughter of the demon lord Graz ' zt . Description . Though she has no known succubus blood , Thraxxia physically resembles an alu - fiend , with an attractive , feminine human form , upsloping eyebrows and small , batlike wings .

title: Three - Faced Sun heresy
description: Three - Faced Sun heresy The Three - Faced Sun heresey states that the sun is a tripartite overdeity , with aspects of dawn , highsun ( solar noon ) , and dusk . Like a spinning prism viewed from the side , believers in this heresy teach that only two of the three aspects can be " seen " at any time . ( There are said to be brief instants in deific time when only one aspect is manifest .

title: Three Elves
description: Three Elves The Three Elves was an inn located in Voonlar , known throughout the Moonsea for its homey atmosphere and good , cheap food . Location . The inn sat on the north side of Shind Road at the intersection with Dump Road .

title: Three Gates Reef
description: Three Gates Reef Three Gates Reef was a large tiger coral reef bordering and forming part of the ecosystem of the underwater city of Myth Nantar . It was 30 m ( 100 ft ) tall and several kilometers wide , and encircled three sides of the city , providing three arches ( gates ) through which access to the city could be gained . Over the years , the reef was carved with scenes depicting battles and myths .

title: Three Old Kegs
description: Three Old Kegs The Three Old Kegs is a well - known inn in the city of Baldur ' s Gate . It is widely regarded as one of the best inns in all of Faerûn , and is known for its comfortable furnishings and its generally somnific atmosphere . The establishment is located along the east wall of the Ducal Palace .

title: Three Roldons
description: Three Roldons The Three Roldons was an exclusive , expensive , and opulent tavern in Eshpurta in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . The proprietor was a halfling with impeccable taste who provided a quiet place for couples and small groups to gather and partake of good quality fare . The booths had heavy curtains and there were private rooms available for the utmost in discretion .

title: Three Sisters
description: Three Sisters The Three Sisters were a series of volcanoes in the Ice Spires South . Description . The Three Sisters were semi - active volcanoes .

title: Three Towers
description: Three Towers The Three Towers is a performance club in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep . It is known for hosting traveling minstrels , singers and storytellers , including Rymrick the Bawd , Dulchaesen and The Bell - Dwarves Three . On a night when no guest performer is available , a " Round of Ballades " is held by the staff , which is led by " Waterfall " Baerle Waszunn .

title: Three Trees Pass
description: Three Trees Pass Three Trees Pass was a major pass between the Troll Mountains and the Giantspike Mountains in the Vast . The North Road ran through it to connect Kurth and King ' s Reach . Description .

title: Threldryn Imbranneth
description: Threldryn Imbranneth Threldryn Imbranneth was a knight and a noble of Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . History . In the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , Alusair and her knights were operating in the Stonelands , pursuing a bold orc band that had raided a caravan east of Eveningstar ; in six days of pursuit , they ' d killed a hydra , a " fire lizard " , and three chimera s .

title: Thri - kreen
description: Thri - kreen The thri - kreen were an insectoid monstrous humanoid race that primarily lived in the Shaar . The thri - kreen were a race of nomads and hunters . They were also known as mantis warriors and sometimes called " tri - kreen " .

title: Throat
description: Throat The Throat was a water tower in Luskan . Location . The tower was located in the North Bank of Luskan near the Red Dragon Trading Post .

title: Throleatha
description: Throleatha Throleatha is a sun elf sorceress and the proprietor of Throleatha ' s Public House in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet as of 1368 DR . She is sometimes called into the service of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower as a messenger between nobles or to agents in Faerûn .

title: Throleatha ' s Public House
description: Throleatha ' s Public House Throleatha ' s Public House is a quiet public house in Leuthilspar on the island of Evermeet . Its proprietor is Throleatha , an elven sorcerer . Most of its clientele are sun elves .

title: Throstulgrael
description: Throstulgrael Throstulgrael , or " Velvet " , was a young male black dragon who laired in the Flooded Forest in the lands of the Moonsea and the Vast in north Faerûn . History . By 1369 DR , Velvet was waging a feud with the much older green dragon Malachite , who lived in the forests south of Mulmaster .

title: Throwing
description: Throwing Throwing is a quality that can be applied to any melee weapon . A weapon with this property gains a range increment of 10 feet and can be thrown at enemies if the wielding creature is proficient with it . Creation .

title: Throwing axe
description: Throwing axe A throwing axe is a light , martial melee weapon of the axe family that can be used as a ranged weapon . Description . A throwing axe is similar to a handaxe but lighter and balanced for throwing .

title: Thrym
description: Thrym Thrym was a titan , worshiped by the frost giant s as the giant god of cold and ice . He was the " de facto " leader of the frost giants as well . Thrym ruled the realm of Fimbulwinter in the Elemental Chaos , described as a large , desolate tundra accented by sparkling frozen waterfalls .

title: Thulbanian Games
description: Thulbanian Games The Thulbanian Games was a grand athletic competition that took place in Chessenta . Organization . They were held every two years on the Fields of Pryollus at the foot of Mount Thulbane in Threskel .

title: Thulk
description: Thulk Thulk was a male bugbear barbarian slave from Szith Morcane . He ruled the slaves of Szith Morcane with an iron fist under the approval of his drow masters . Description .

title: Thullen
description: Thullen Thullen was the benevolent brother of the cloud giant countess Sansuri sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR He lived in Lyn Armaal with Sansuri ' s family .

title: Thultanthar
description: Thultanthar Thultanthar ( " Shade " in the Loross language ) , also known as the Shade Enclave and the City of Shade , was a Netherese flying city situated in the middle of the Anauroch desert . Geography . On Toril , Thultanthar was located in the middle of the Anauroch desert among Bedine tribes along the Black Road trade route connecting the Silver Marches with Cormanthor .

title: Thultyrl
description: Thultyrl Thultyrl was the name of the ruling family of the city of Procampur in the Vast . It was also the title that its rulers adopted . The Thultyrls served as hereditary overlords of the city .

title: Thuluna Maah
description: Thuluna Maah Thuluna Maah was a sea hag and a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave at the Temple of the Crushing Wave in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Thuluna Maah was the second - in - command of the temple , answering only to Gar Shatterkeel .

title: Thunder Blessing
description: Thunder Blessing The Thunder Blessing , also known as the Thundering , occurred in the Year of Thunder , 1306 DR , and was the dwarven god Moradin ' s gift to his people which dramatically increased the reproductive rate of dwarves . Moradin called a council of the dwarven pantheon to find a way to increase the number of dwarves . The council decided to split each existing soul into two when they were reincarnated .

title: Thunder Peaks
description: Thunder Peaks The Thunder Peaks were a range of mountains that ran in a north – south line , marking the eastern edge of Cormyr . The entire range was subject to extremely severe and sudden storms all year round . They were home to tribes of orc s and goblin s that launched raids in nearby Cormyr , Sembia , and the Dalelands , and were also home to the dracolich Aurgloroasa , the Sibilant Shade .

title: Thunder slam
description: Thunder slam Thunder slam is a spell of the evocation school used by some sorcerer s early in their training . When cast , " thunder slam " causes a burst of sonic energy to burst from the sorcerer ' s implement , blowing a creature within fifty feet a distance of fifteen . " Thunder slam " is somewhat complex for its level of power and as such requires a rest of a few minutes before being cast again .

title: Thunderbeast Tribe
description: Thunderbeast Tribe The Thunderbeast tribe was a group of Uthgardt . History . In 1370 DR , their chief was the charismatic Gundar Brontoskin , but he was replaced around 1372 DR by Sungar Wolfkiller .

title: Thunderbelly
description: Thunderbelly Thunderbelly , the Iron Arm of Dardath was a dwarf soldier who participated in the last Illefarn battle against the King of Shadows . Before the battle , he swore an oath to not rest before the King was dead , and so awoke to find himself trapped in the gem mines in the ruined city of Arvahn along with other spirits connected to the King . His spirit helped an adventurer uncover one of the statues needed for the Ritual of Purification , designed to weaken the King of Shadows .

title: Thunderhide armor
description: Thunderhide armor Thunderhide armor was a type of armor used on Toril . Description . Thunderhide armor was made from layers of treated hides of dinosaur s ( called " thunderers " ) , or other large reptiles .

title: Thunderholme
description: Thunderholme Thunderholme was a dwarven kingdom in the region known as the Thunder Peaks . Dwarven legends spoke of the city as favored by Dumathoin , the Keeper of Secrets Under the Mountain , and that it was home to the noblest miners and finest metalsmiths in the Realms . It was also said that its vaults were emptied in a day , when Dumathoin swept his chosen away to live in paradise with him .

title: Thundering
description: Thundering Thundering was a magical weapon quality . When a weapon of this type hit a creature in a vital area , it produced a loud sound like thunder . This sound was powerful enough to damage the creature hit , and that creature could be permanently deafened by the noise .

title: Thunderlance
description: Thunderlance Thunderlance was an arcane evocation spell that created a spear of force that could be used as a weapon and had the ability to dispel some defensive magics . One version also absorbed certain magic projectiles and added their damage to its own . Effects .

title: Thunderspire Labyrinth
description: Thunderspire Labyrinth Thunderspire Labyrinth is an adventure module for the core setting of the 4th - edition ruleset of " Dungeons & Dragons " . Behind the scenes . While " Thunderspire Labyrinth " was designed initially for the " points of light " core setting of 4th edition , alterations to the adventure made in an article of " Dungeon " magazine made it possible to use it as a dungeon for characters in the " Forgotten Realms " .

title: Thunderspire Mountain
description: Thunderspire Mountain Thunderspire Mountain was a mountain located in the Thunder Peaks , near Arabel and Winterhaven in Cormyr , and Highmoon in the Dalelands . Description . Thunderspire Mountain was one of the tallest mountains in the Thunder Peaks .

title: Thunderstone
description: Thunderstone Thunderstone was a village or small town in northeastern Cormyr . It lay along the southern bank of the Thunder River , close to the southern side of Hullack Forest , north of the Vast Swamp , and near to the western slopes of the Thunder Peaks . The Thunderway began at Thunderstone , before running through High Dale and ending at Saerb in Sembia .

title: Thundertree
description: Thundertree Thundertree was a small village in the plains east of Neverwinter , in the time of 1365 DR . It was destroyed in 1451 DR . It was a source of wood and Zalantar .

title: Thunderwave
description: Thunderwave Thunderwave is a spell of low complexity learned by many wizard s . An evocation spell , " thunderwave " creates a blast of sonic energy that can cause bodily harm to any enemies within an area of fifteen feet of the spell , in addition to pushing them backwards , away from the blast zone . The distance a creature caught in the blast is pushed depends upon the caster ' s degree of self - control and perception .

title: Thundrazi
description: Thundrazi Thundrazi was a Red Wizard of Thay and a Harper spy in Mulmaster . Personality . Thundrazi usually spoke only in brief and curt sentences .

title: Thungor Triblane
description: Thungor Triblane Thungor Triblane was an innkeeper in Tilverton in 1357 DR . Activities . Thungor , a former illusionist , managed The Windlord ' s Rest , an inn of good quality in the town .

title: Thunkers
description: Thunkers The Thunkers was a bandit organization in Damara in 1359 DR . History . The Thunkers originated in 1357 DR after the first defeat of the bandit army of the Grandfather of Assassins against Gareth Dragonsbane .

title: Thunkers of the Thunkers
description: Thunkers of the Thunkers The Thunkers of the Thunkers was an adventuring party in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Thunkers of the Thunkers were three ranger s and a pair of twin brother dwarves who specialized in hunting giant s .

title: Thunsroon Frostbryn
description: Thunsroon Frostbryn Thunsroon " Thunderhand " Frostbryn was a human wizard of Elversult on the Dragon Coast . Description . Thunsroon was a powerful and brash man .

title: Thuparlial
description: Thuparlial Thuparlial , also known as , was found in hardened lava as a lining to gas cavities in the rock , but rarely was this lining thick enough or an attractive color to warrant cutting it into gemstones . Description . Thuparlial was hard , resilient , and translucent gemstone which varied in color from deep green through pale greenish yellow and from yellow to brown .

title: Thurauvyn Nathalanorn
description: Thurauvyn Nathalanorn Thuvauvyn Nathalanorn was a baelnorn lich in Myth Drannor . Activities . Thuvauvyn was the guardian of House Nathalanorn ' s crypt .

title: Thurbal
description: Thurbal Thurbal was a male human commander of the Twisted Tower ' s guards in Shadowdale before and during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . Thurbal in his role of leader of the guards of the Twisted Tower briefly met the young Shandril Shessair , the bearer of the " spellfire " , when she stayed in Shadowdale for a time .

title: Thurghom
description: Thurghom Thurghom was an outcast orc druid who guarded an ancient portal on the Sea of Moving Ice . Description . Thurghom dressed in magic rhino hide and carried a large magic shield of wood .

title: Thurgur
description: Thurgur Thurgurs were efreet military zones within the Elemental Plane of Fire . Geography . These zones were located all across the Elemental Plane of Fire , protecting the City of Brass and routing slaves back to the efreet capital .

title: Thuria
description: Thuria Thuria was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thuria was a coward , not wanting to risk his life for the Red Wizards .

title: Thuriya al - Kadari
description: Thuriya al - Kadari Thuriya al - Kadari was an orc concubine of the Grand Caliph of Huzuz , Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in 1367 DR . Description . Thuriya was not attractive by common standards but did offer Khalil genuine companionship .

title: Thurl Merosska
description: Thurl Merosska Thurl Merosska was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred and leader of Feathergale Knights during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Thurl ' s main motivation and goal was power .

title: Thurn Blackskull
description: Thurn Blackskull Thurn Blackskull was a male duergar fighter / psion or psychic warrior who worked as a fence in the subterranean city of Skullport in Undermountain around 1370 DR . Description . Thurn was an aged gray dwarf .

title: Thurndan Tallwand
description: Thurndan Tallwand Thurndan Tallwand was one of the most powerful wizard s in Mulmaster and the leader of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in 1373 and 1491 DR . Activities . As the head of this magic - oriented organization in 1373 DR , it was Thurndan ' s responsibility to ensure the safety of High Blade Rassendyll Uoumdolphin .

title: Thurr Gargengrim
description: Thurr Gargengrim Thurr Gargengrim was a dwarf businessman in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . Activities . The Gargengrim clan supplied the Monastery with all they needed in exchange for a percentage of the profits from distributing the monastery ' s whiskey .

title: Thurrak
description: Thurrak Thurrak was a male stone giant sorcerer and an elder of his tribe who resided on the shores of the Lake of Shadows . Personality . Thurrak was slightly less reticent than others of his kind when dealing with others .

title: Thutai
description: Thutai Thutai was a Red Wizard of Thay overseer in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Thutai cared little for his underlings .

title: Thylius Caramitru
description: Thylius Caramitru Thylius Caramitru was a minor noble in Mulmaster . Personality . Thylius was extremely charismatic .

title: Thymari
description: Thymari Thymari , known to common people as Tymantherans , were the dragonborn ethnicity that made up the vast majority of the population of Tymanther . Description . Thymari dragonborn used piercings to shown their clan allegiances .

title: Thyriellentha Snome
description: Thyriellentha Snome Thyriellentha Snome was the commander of the watch - wizard corps of the City Watch in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Thyriellentha was a capable and friendly woman , but power - hungry , though only with legal methods and becoming petty and grasping .

title: Tiago Baenre
description: Tiago Baenre Tiago Baenre was the grandson of Dantrag Baenre and a noble of House Baenre in Menzoberranzan . Tiago and Ravel Xorlarrin were considered the most promising of Menzoberranzan ' s young males . Description .

title: Tiamat
description: Tiamat Tiamat ( pronounced " TEE - a - maht " ) , was the lawful evil dragon goddess of greed , queen of evil dragon s and , for a time , a reluctant servant of the greater gods Bane and later Asmodeus . Before entering the Faerûnian pantheon , she was a member of the Draconic pantheon , and for some time she was also a member of the Untheric pantheon . Tiamat was also the eternal rival of her brother Bahamut , ruler of the good metallic dragon s .

title: Tianna Skyflower
description: Tianna Skyflower Tianna Skyflower was a half - elf who led a band of raiders known only as the Half - Elven Renegades on the southern edge of the High Forest . History . She moved her home and raiding base from the Dire Wood to near the Shining Falls .

title: Tiatha Hawksong
description: Tiatha Hawksong Tiatha Hawksong was the leader of the moon elf house Hawksong . History . Tiatha disappeared around 1357 DR , but members of her house believed her to be alive in 1367 DR .

title: Tiax
description: Tiax Tiax was a wandering cleric of Cyric . Not nearly as mad as his god , but insane nonetheless , Tiax claims that Cyric has granted him visions of world domination and he has made it his life ' s mission to fulfill those visions , attempting to create a worldwide theocracy in Cyric ' s name . He was not very successful in this endeavour , but it did not stop him from reminding everyone who he met of his goal .

title: Tibeem
description: Tibeem Tibeem was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Tibeem and his fellow Spernik infiltrated Mantor ' s Library in Phlan in order to steal some books containing draconic lore .

title: Tidal wave
description: Tidal wave Tidal wave was an arcane alteration spell that created a huge destructive wave in a large body of water . In terms of damage and scope , it was one of the most powerful spells known in the Realms since Mystra ' s Ban in the Year of Sundered Webs , −339 DR . Effects .

title: Tiefling
description: Tiefling Tieflings were human - based planetouched , native outsider s that were infused with the touch of the fiendish plane s , most often through descent from fiend s — demon s , Yugoloths , devil s , evil deities , and others who had bred with humans . Tieflings were known for their cunning and personal allure , which made them excellent deceivers as well as inspiring leaders when prejudices were laid aside . Although their evil ancestors could be many generations removed , the taint lingered .

title: Tiefling warfiend
description: Tiefling warfiend Tiefling warfiends are tiefling fighter s who use their fiend ish blood as a force for power . While many tiefling view their ancestry as a curse , tiefling warfiends learn to turn this dark " taint " into a source of brutal power , either for good or evil . These powerful warriors are deadly adversaries , consuming the energy of their foes and immersing their weapons in flame .

title: Tiega Gos
description: Tiega Gos Zora Tiega Gos ( pronounced ( ZORE - uh TEE - egg - uh GOSS ) was a noble in Mulmaster of the Gos family . History . In 1491 DR , for her birthday , Faltyn commissioned his nephew Andrik Gos to create a painting of her and hired Marim Tem as a musician , and hosted a party at the popular dance hall the Wave and Wink .

title: Tier Breche
description: Tier Breche Tier Breche was a cavern housing the Academy of Menzoberranzan , which consisted of Arach - Tinilith ( the clerical school ) , Sorcere ( the wizarding school ) , and Melee - Magthere ( the fighters ' school ) . Tier Breche was technically the name of the cavern where the Academy was located , but in common usage " Tier Breche " often referred to the Academy itself . Structure .

title: Tierak Morcane
description: Tierak Morcane Tierak Morcane was a female drow priestess of Lolth and perhaps the sole surviving priestess from House Morcane after the Silence of Lolth . Description . Ever - scowling , Tierak Morcane was nevertheless a striking female and like many priestesses of Lolth , she had an almost palpable aura of authority about her .

title: Tiger
description: Tiger Tigers were natural jungle cats that were native to both warm and cold forests of the world . They were distinguished from other great cats by their orange fur and black stripes . Also , unlike other great cats , tigers loved the water .

title: Tiger ' s Nest
description: Tiger ' s Nest The Tiger ' s Nest was an ancient monastery located in the Hordelands . History . Built in the age of the Imaskari Empire , the Tiger ' s Nest was originally an independent monastery of monks who fought against the evils of that empire , aiding the peasants of Imaskar against their rulers with powerful cleric spells .

title: Tiger ' s claws
description: Tiger ' s claws Tiger ' s claws were special weapon s in Zakhara . Description . Also called " bagh nakh " , these small weapons looked like brass knuckles that had spikes added so they stood out when the wearer made a fist .

title: Tiger eye agate
description: Tiger eye agate Tiger eye agate , also known as tiger ' s eye , was a member of the agate family . Description . This agate was a golden hue with dark brown stripes that exhibited a silky luster called .

title: Tigerworm
description: Tigerworm A tigerworm was a type of sea slug found in Kara - Tur . They were carnivorous and had black and orange stripes like the tiger , hence their name . By 1357 DR , tigerworms had infested E ' Tyon Bay north of Singye in Koryo .

title: Tiglath
description: Tiglath Tiglath was the high priestess of Tiamat in Unther in 1357 DR and again in 1374 DR . History . Once Tiglath was a member of the Gilgeam ' s harem .

title: Tilverton
description: Tilverton Tilverton was located on the Moonsea Ride in the Stonelands in Cormyr . Geography . Located at the strategic mouth of Tilver ' s Gap , between the Thunder Peaks and the Desertsmouth Mountains , Tilverton stood at the " T " intersection where the North Ride met the Moonsea Ride .

title: Tilverton Scar
description: Tilverton Scar The Tilverton Scar is all that is left after the town of Tilverton was attacked by the forces of Thultanthar on Mirtul 27 1372 DR . As of 1479 DR , the Tilverton Scar is the only known area of plagueland in Cormyr . Surrounding Land .

title: Time conduit
description: Time conduit Time conduit is an incredibly rare , powerful spell that allows the creation of a very short - lived portal backwards through time . It causes items that are anachronisms in the destination time to be removed , only restored into existence on the bearer ' s return to his or her own time . Pages from spellbooks or scrolls that refer to spells not yet in existence become blank , only being restored if the bearer travels forward in time again .

title: Time gate
description: Time gate A time gate was a permanent physical portal through time . There were only a handful on Faerûn and their locations were unknown to all except certain elven High Mage s . The gates ' exact ages were unknown , but they predated even the coming of the dwarves .

title: Time of Dragons
description: Time of Dragons The Time of Dragons was a period in Faerûn ' s history that coincided with the Dawn Age , between - 30000 DR to - 24000 DR . The Time of Dragons began in - 30000 DR when the dragon s of Faerûn launched devastating attacks against the dominant Aearee Empires throughout the land , air , and underground , creating the first Flight of Dragons , destroying those nations completely . They also battled against giants over territory , forcing giantkind to yield their lands and flee to the north .

title: Time of Troubles
description: Time of Troubles The Time of Troubles , also known as the Arrival , the Godswar and the Avatar Crisis , was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Faerûn . Taking place during 1358 DR , the Year of Shadows , the Time of Troubles was a period during which the deities of Faerûn were forced to walk the earth in their mortal avatar forms . Several major deities died during the Time of Troubles ( see Deaths , Ascensions , and Resurrections ) and a handful of mortals rose to divinity .

title: Time sphere
description: Time sphere The Time sphere was a group of spells granted to monk s that allowed manipulation of the flow of time and the effects of time . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Time Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Timmask
description: Timmask Timmask was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It was known colloquially as " the devil ' s mushroom " . Description .

title: Timor
description: Timor Timor " the Scar " was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Timor wore a sparse black beard .

title: Timoshenko
description: Timoshenko Timoshenko , as of 1372 DR , is the Grandfather of Assassins , the leader of the Citadel of Assassins in Damara . He rose to power after Kane defeated the last Grandfather . Backed by the archmage Knellict , Timoshenko surpassed Banak in power , a once mighty priest of Orcus , who was the other candidate for leader of the Citadel .

title: Timoth Eyesbright
description: Timoth Eyesbright Timoth Eyesbright was a male centaur adventurer who was known as a friend of Vajra Valmeyjar and Onyx the Invincible and as a hero of the Reclamation Wars . Personality . Timoth was quite loquacious .

title: Timothy J . Kask
description: Timothy J . Kask Timothy J . Kask was a game designer for TSR , Inc .

title: Ting Mei Wan
description: Ting Mei Wan Ting Mei Wan was the Minister of State Security of Shou Lung . Personality . Ting Mei Wan was a ruthless and ambitious woman who possessed great charm .

title: Tintageer
description: Tintageer Tintageer was the capital of an ancient gold elven realm in the Faerie . It was an island that boasted one of the most wondrous and populous civilizations in all of Faerie . After some kind of war it was threatened by a tremendous flood created by magical powers .

title: Tirichik
description: Tirichik The tirichik was one of the most feared monsters of the Great Glacier , second only to white dragon s . Description . Tirichik were strange creatures that some described as a cross between a dragon and a centipede , but they had no true relation to either .

title: Titan
description: Titan Titans are the largest of the giant race , standing even taller than cloud or storm giant s . Perchance they interact with other giants , they are ranked highest on the Ordning , above all other giants , giant - kin , and ogre s . They should not be mistaken with the Dawn Titans , or primordial s ( although the punishment for arrogance that lead to the creation of the Sea of Fallen Stars may very well be a confusion between the titans and the Dawn Titans ) .

title: Tithlin
description: Tithlin The Tithlin family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Tithlins were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Laranadda , and Vandover families .

title: Tiztor
description: Tiztor Tiztor the Great was a male human wizard from Mulmaster in the Moonsea area in the 14th century DR . Activities . Tiztor was obsessed with discovering the secret of the Thunder Stone , a monolith that stood at the center of the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr .

title: Tleobar T ' Enorgh
description: Tleobar T ' Enorgh Tleobar T ' Enorgh was a former drow adventuress from the Forest of Mir , the chosen guardian of the drow settlement of Dallnothax , and an agent of the Twisted Rune . Relationships . Tleobar was married to Raaghar T ' Enorgh , the ruler of Dallnothax and a priest of Vhaeraun .

title: Tlossarylathaunglar
description: Tlossarylathaunglar Tlossarylathaunglar was a dracolich in the Underdark . History . Tlossarylathaunglar was one of the oldest and most fell creations of the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Tluth Melarn
description: Tluth Melarn Tluth Melarn was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Tluth joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt .

title: To ' Zon
description: To ' Zon To ' Zon was a korobokuru wu jen inhabiting the Rainbow Monastery in Ra - Khati during the mid 14th century DR . Appearance . To ' Zon stood 4 ft .

title: To Sever the Snake ' s Head
description: To Sever the Snake ' s Head With a massive attack against the city of Loudwater expected to come within a week and allies from Silverymoon being sparse , the party are asked to slip past enemy lines and kill the leaders of the Zhentarim and devil ish army . Loudwater ' s leaders hope that if the party cause enough deaths in the higher ranks of the coming force that they will be easier to defeat or , even better , the enemy will abandon the attack altogether . This was the final Tides of War adventure and also the final Legacy of the Green Regent module to be published before the campaign was abandoned .

title: Toad
description: Toad A toad ( or frog — the terms were more or less interchangeable ) was any of a number of species of amphibians characterized by dry , leathery skin ( usually pink and orange - colored ) , short legs , and snout - like parotoid glands . Locations . Toads were found in the Calim Desert , the Great Swamp of Rethild , and at Toad Knoll in Shadowdale .

title: Toad ( demon )
description: Toad ( demon ) Toad was a hezrou servant of the demon lord Graz ' zt . History . During the Rage of Demons , Graz ' zt sent Toad to serve the cambion siblings Gattash and Rashara , who had gained control of a kuo - toa tribe .

title: Toad Knoll
description: Toad Knoll Toad Knoll was found just north of the North Ride , less than a mile west of the bridge over the Ashaba in Shadowdale . Toad Knoll took its name from the bumper crop of frogs and toads that occurred in the spring months , living and breeding in the marshy ground at base of Toad Knoll , caused by the the upwelling of an intermittent natural spring .

title: Toadsquat Mountains
description: Toadsquat Mountains The Toadsquat Mountains , or the Little Mountains , formed the northern border of Luiren in the Shining South in 1367 DR . Inhabitants . This mountain range was infested with ogres .

title: Toal
description: Toal A toal was a Waterdhavian coin worth two gold pieces in the city , but outside Waterdeep , these coins were practically worthless . Description . The toal was a square brass coin with a hole in the center to allow it to be strung on a string .

title: Tobin
description: Tobin Tobin , also known as Tobin Tok Tor , was a goliath warrior and a member of Corvus Nightfeather ' s Circus of Wonders . Description . Like most goliaths , Tobin was much taller and heavier than a human .

title: Tocka
description: Tocka Tocka was a gnome holy slayer and member of the Gilded Palm in Zakhara in 1367 DR . History . Tocka once served as the personal attendant of the Sultana of Hiyal , Alurah bint Asrah .

title: Todd Gamble
description: Todd Gamble Todd Alan Gamble is an artist , illustrator , and cartographer , focusing on fantasy illustration . He has worked for Wizards of the Coast and several other gaming companies . He lives in .

title: Todd Lockwood
description: Todd Lockwood Todd Lockwood was born in Boulder , Colorado and went on to graduate from the Colorado Institute of Art . He did freelance advertising work for fifteen years , managing to win several awards whilst also spending his free time playing " Dungeons & Dragons " . Inspired by artists such as Brom , Todd began doing artwork for sci - fi / fantasy magazines before going to work for Chaosium and Phil Foglio .

title: Togar Ironseth
description: Togar Ironseth Togar Ironseth was a human blacksmith in Amnwater , Amn , around 1368 DR , and a member of the Ironseth family , owners of about half of the land around Amnwater . Description . The large dark skinned smith learned his trade from a dwarven blacksmith .

title: Tohkkal Burrwarden
description: Tohkkal Burrwarden Tohkkal Burrwarden was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Tohkkal , along with her twin brother Tykkyl Burrwarden , managed the shop Clockwork Wonders .

title: Tohrepur
description: Tohrepur Tohrepur was a ruined city in the Mere - That - Was region of Akanûl . The city formerly sat on the shores of the Akanamere but when the Spellplague dried up the lake , the waters receded and the city was left beyond the waters reach . The Abolethic Sovereignty destroyed Tohrepur in 1473 DR and turned its residents into aberrations .

title: Toipeye
description: Toipeye Toipeye was a korobokuru bushi adventurer in Kozakura . History . Toipeye was aways be an outcast even among his tribe for his unattractive aspect and a bad temperament .

title: Tokan
description: Tokan Tokan was the chieftain of the dwarven Orothiar Clan in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . Tokan normally spoke of ancient events like they happened yesterday .

title: Tokol
description: Tokol Tokol was a leader of Kultaka in 1361 DR . History . Tokol was one of the four sons of Takamal .

title: Tola Vrass
description: Tola Vrass Tola Vrass was the beautiful and charasmatic leader of the Thay an enclave within Hillsfar . She served under the Zulkir of illusion , Mythrellan . Tola was involved in a bit of a courtship with Maalthiir , as the two were mutually attracted to one another both realized the power and benefits a successful alliance would garner for their power structures .

title: Tolgar Anuvien
description: Tolgar Anuvien Tolgar Anuvien is the impressive and veteran member of the Company of Crazed Venturers along with being the founder of the Goldenfields . It is in this latter endeavor that he believes he is truly doing the work of Chauntea , the goddess whom he venerates . Becoming a very wealthy man after his many years of adventuring , Tolgar has gained great amounts of wealth which he has stored at his house in Waterdeep , the Dripping Dagger inn and with several friends including the palace of Piergeiron .

title: Tollar Kieres
description: Tollar Kieres Tollar Kieres was a sailor of Baldur ' s Gate and a member of Merchant League . History . While searching for the sea charts needed by Mendas , Gorion ' s Ward met Tollar .

title: Tolmara Hysstryn
description: Tolmara Hysstryn Tolmara Hysstryn was a deranged inhabitant of Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Tolmara managed the Six Windows rooming house .

title: Tolodine ' s killing wind
description: Tolodine ' s killing wind Tolodine ' s killing wind was a spell of epic magic . History . This spell , was invented by the Netherese arcanist Tolodine in 1500 NY ( −2359 DR ) , one year before his death , as his crowning achievment .

title: Tom Baxa
description: Tom Baxa Tom Baxa is an artist who has illustrated various role - playing games . Education . Baxa was educated at , where he was taught by Mark Nelson , another artist who has illustrated Dungeons & Dragons material .

title: Tomar
description: Tomar Tomar , or Tomar of the Winds , was an elven inhabitant of the Pilgrims ' District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Tomar ran a small school where he educated priests represented by every Zakharan god , though Tomar worshiped Haku .

title: Tomas Siohcen
description: Tomas Siohcen Tomas Siohcen was a cleric of Cyric who joined the Unseen in Waterdeep by the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Personality . Tomas was a loyal devotee of Cyric .

title: Tomb jade
description: Tomb jade Tomb Jade was the name for jade that had been buried for centuries and turned from green to red or brown . Description . Tomb jade was rare and commanded a high price in the Realms .

title: Tomb of Chonis
description: Tomb of Chonis The Tomb of Chonis was the name given to a mysterious tomb in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . Location . It was located north of the Way of the Manticore and west of the Vast Swamp .

title: Tomb of the Betrayers
description: Tomb of the Betrayers Tomb of the Betrayers was a crypt in Neverwinter on the Sword Coast . Location . The tomb was located in Neverwinter , near the Church of Tyr .

title: Tomb tapper
description: Tomb tapper Thaalud , more commonly known as tomb tappers , were fifteen - foot tall intelligent construct s designed by the ancient Netherese empire to defend it against the depredations of the phaerimm . Their existence can be traced back to the very beginning of the Shadowed Age of Netheril ' s history , when a group of arcanist s created them to seek out the source of the magical drain that was beginning to reach across Netheril . Description .

title: Tombs of Deckon Thar
description: Tombs of Deckon Thar The Tombs of Deckon Thar were seven cairns loaded with bandit treasure within the Nether Mountains . Geography . The tombs were located on the western slope of the Nether Mountains in a secret canyon north of Silverymoon Pass .

title: Tome of Battle
description: Tome of Battle Tome of Battle The Book of the Nine Swords is an optional rulebook designed for " Dungeons & Dragons " 3 . 5 edition , written by Richard Baker . Description .

title: Tome of Suelivain
description: Tome of Suelivain The tome of Suelivain was a book written by Suelivain , a shade of Thultanthar . In it he included his notes of shadow magic . History .

title: Tome of Torment
description: Tome of Torment The Tome of Torment was the most holy book of the Church of Ilmater , reputedly granted by the One Who Endures himself . It had a long and troubled history , being stolen and recovered numerous times and once the center of a holy war between rival temples to the Broken God , and ironically the focus of much suffering . Value .

title: Tome of Universal Harmony
description: Tome of Universal Harmony The Tome of Universal Harmony is the most holy book of the god Deneir , studied and memorized by his disciples . A large tome in thick black bindings , containing nearly two thousand pages . The book is worth to be read more than once during one ' s life because as the perceptions of the world change while the words in the book remain the same , the meaning of those words will change as well .

title: Tome of mystical equations
description: Tome of mystical equations A tome of mystical equations is a magical tome that contains charts and equations that relate to the numbers sphere of magic , and can be used as the material component for the following spells , halving their casting time and making them harder to save against :

title: Tome of the Unicorn
description: Tome of the Unicorn The Tome of the Unicorn is a large book . It is 2 feet broad , 3 feet high and more than 4 inches thick . The pages of the Tome are polished plates of electrum and a casual observer might think that they are blank .

title: Tomi Sabero
description: Tomi Sabero Tomi Saburo was an explorer from the city of Shou ' Kuan in Ch ' ing Tung province in Shou Lung . History . In 1358 DR , he went to explore Chu ' Yuan province .

title: Tomi Undergallows
description: Tomi Undergallows Tomi Undergallows , or " Grin , " as he was often known , was a male halfling rogue from the land of Calimshan . An escaped prisoner from the Neverwinter Peninusula District Prison , he was wanted for a number of crimes , including " deflowering " a pasha ' s daughter and pickpocketing . Carefree and mischievous , Tomi rarely seemed to take things seriously .

title: Tomphael Arkenrret
description: Tomphael Arkenrret Tomphael Arkenrret was a mature adult drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekyl " ) , who held the tile of Patron Father of Eryndlyn among the Jaezred Chaulssin . After the Silence of Lolth , he became the direct superior of Nimor Imphraezl . Description .

title: Tomyris
description: Tomyris Tomyris , the Meeting Ground , was one of the most important places for the Issacortae tribe . This was a high bald hill circled by monoliths and surrounded by many tribal dwellings . Usually , the high king or queen lived far from Tomyris with their people , but the great shaman lived there all year and looked after the site .

title: Tongue of madness
description: Tongue of madness Tongue of madness was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . When mature , it resembled a large human tongue and was edible but somewhat poisonous . When consumed , any creature with the power of speech who did not have sufficient constitution to resist the mind - altering effects was compelled to speak his or her every thought for the next hour .

title: Tongues
description: Tongues Tongues was a divination or alteration spell that allowed the caster or a touched creature to speak and understand additional languages . The alteration version was reversible , called babble , and could confuse all verbal communication in an area . Effects .

title: Tonorak Winthrax
description: Tonorak Winthrax Tonorak Winthrax was a high priest of Helm in the Vilhon Reach in 1370 DR . History . Tonorak gained renown when , around 1361 DR , he spoke against sending missionaries to Maztica , saying the duty of true followers of Helm was to guard and protect , no to go and fight in far lands .

title: Tooktook
description: Tooktook Tooktook was a duergar living in Mithral Hall during the reign of Haerinvureem . Relationships . While Mithral Hall was controlled by Clan Bukbukken , Tooktook was from Clan Trilk .

title: Tooman Thendrik
description: Tooman Thendrik Tooman Thendrik was a male drow cleric of Ghaunadaur from Szith Morcane that secretly led a cult of Ghaunadar worshipers . Description . Tooman maintained an unassuming appearance to hide his true allegiance .

title: Toothed tentacle
description: Toothed tentacle Toothed tentacle was an evocation spell that caused a shadowy tentacle of energy to spring from your hand . Effects . This spell created a tentacle of energy , starting at your hand and extending outward before splitting into three slimmer tentacles tipped by toothed gaping mouths .

title: Toover Unn
description: Toover Unn Toover Unn was a wererat and a member of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter . History . Toover was a wererat merchant of the Dead Rats , living in the sewers of the Protector ' s Enclave .

title: Topaz
description: Topaz Topaz was a precious stone that occurred in granite deposits , sometimes yielding large , gem - quality crystals . Description . Topaz was a very hard , clear gemstone that was usually golden yellow but could be found in shades from yellow to brown .

title: Topaz dragon
description: Topaz dragon Topaz dragons were selfish and had an erratic personality which made them dangerous to deal with . Topaz dragons were most commonly found in the Elemental Chaos but sometimes live in lairs on secluded beaches on the Prime Material Plane . Combat .

title: Topiary guardian
description: Topiary guardian A Topiary guardian is a plant that has been sculpted into the shape of a creature and then animated with magic . Even though they are the same dimensions as the creature they resemble , they weigh much less because they ' re constructed from twigs and branches . Topiary guardians often guard druid rings or shrines to druidic deities such as Mielikki or Chauntea .

title: Topsy
description: Topsy Topsy was a deep gnome wererat living in the Underdark with his twin Turvy during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was very close to his twin Turvy .

title: Tor Millows
description: Tor Millows Tor Millows was a male human on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . He was a priest of Ilmater . History .

title: Toragawa
description: Toragawa Toragawa was a head sohei in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Toragawa was the head sohei at the Kanchai Temple of Miyama and also the overseer of the local shoen .

title: Toram Gyvvalstorm
description: Toram Gyvvalstorm Toram Gyvvalstorm was a paladin of Helm who led the Tethyrian Helmite knightly order of the Champions Vigilant , which during the Tethyrian Interregnum defended many poor people from the bandits and corrupt barons . Toram led them as late as 1374 DR , from Chevangard in Survale Ford .

title: Toranu Ganppo
description: Toranu Ganppo Toranu Ganppo , also transliterated as Toranu Gang - po , was a fortress in Koryo . Its location was lost by the 14th century DR . The fortress was said to hold many treasures , among them the magical chalice called the " dancing hart " .

title: Torchstalk
description: Torchstalk Torchstalk was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . Description . The torchstalk mushroom grew to a height of one to two feet ( 30 to 60 centimeters ) and had a flammable cap .

title: Tordon Sureblade
description: Tordon Sureblade Tordon Sureblade was the Lord Chancellor of Ravens Bluff from ? - - ? Appearance .

title: Toren
description: Toren Toren was a half - orc fighter and a member of the Zhentarim . He was a high - ranking member of the Zhent occupation army in Daggerdale in 1369 DR . History .

title: Torg mac Cei
description: Torg mac Cei Torg mac Cei was a shield dwarf man of the dwarven city of Earthfast of the Earthfast Mountains of north Faerûn , in the Earthroot region of the Underdark He was the Ironlord or King of Earthfast . History . Torg was the son of Cei and the hereditary ruler of Earthfast , succeeding to the position of ironlord .

title: Torgan Minerson
description: Torgan Minerson Torgan Minerson was a human male , and the proprietor of The Roots of the Earth tavern in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Torgan was once trapped in a mine cave - in and claimed he saw visions during the traumatic experience . He subsequently retired from mining and opened his tavern , which also housed a shrine to Grumbar , the King of the Land Below the Roots .

title: Torgar Hammerstriker
description: Torgar Hammerstriker Torgar Delzoun Hammerstriker is a tough - looking dwarf with many scars and a long black beard . He is the commander of the Axe of Mirabar , the militia of Mirabar . He has served the marchion of Mirabar for as long as anyone can remember , claiming it to be three hundred years .

title: Torgoja P ' a
description: Torgoja P ' a Torgoja P ' a was a high lama on the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . History . Torgoja ' s early life was shrouded in mystery .

title: Torgrave Needlebaum
description: Torgrave Needlebaum Torgrave Needlebaum was the seneschal of Hillsfar in 1491 DR . Activities . Torgrave was the city ' s seneschal and Head of Household .

title: Torhild Flametongue
description: Torhild Flametongue Torhild Flametongue was a dwarf who founded the realm of Besilmer in −4420 DR . Background . Torhild believed that the dwarven race would remain in a beleaguered state if they continued to live underground in mines , so he set out to create an overground farming realm , where dwarves could act as builders , inventors , and repairers .

title: Toril
description: Toril Toril , occasionally known as Abeir - Toril was the name of a planet in Realmspace . The name " Abeir - Toril " was archaic , meaning " cradle of life " in an extinct and forgotten language . It consisted of various continents and islands , including Faerûn , Kara - Tur , and Zakhara in the central super - continent and , throughout most of its history , Anchorome , Maztica , and Katashaka in the western super - continent .

title: Toril thirteen
description: Toril thirteen A Toril thirteen was a set of thirteen warlock s who descended from the original thirteen tiefling warlocks who made pacts with Asmodeus . Some devil s collected sets of warlocks , and a Toril thirteen was considered one of the most difficult collections to acquire because one of the warlocks named Bryseis Kakistos had very few living heirs . Original Thirteen .

title: Torin Nomerthal
description: Torin Nomerthal Torin Nomerthal , a First Lord of Hillsfar , was a human who reasserted the Great Laws of Trade and Humanity in Hillsfar in 1487 DR . He was head of a powerful family , known to be outwardly friendly , but secretly shrewd and cunning . Relationships .

title: Torio Claven
description: Torio Claven Torio Claven was Luskan ' s ambassador to Neverwinter and an agent of Black Garius during the Shadow War . History . Torio was born in Luskan and wandered the streets of the city earning coppers singing and performing in Luskan alehouses until Black Garius noted her and her talents .

title: Torixileos
description: Torixileos Torixileos was a white dragon apparently living with its treasure inside a glacier near Silverymoon Pass . The dragon abducted Lynaelle Dawnmantle as Lynaelle traversed the pass during a blizzard . Taken back to the dragon ' s lair , Lynaelle was frightened into assisting Torixileos in plundering a young silver dragon named Starglimmer ' s hoard .

title: Torlin Silvershield
description: Torlin Silvershield Torlin Silvershield was one of Grand Duke s of Baldur ' s Gate in 1479 DR . Personality . Torlin was a consummate actor with a great control over his voice .

title: Torlyn Wands
description: Torlyn Wands Torlyn Wands was a human noble and book collector in Waterdeep . Description . Torlyn was young ( 1479 DR ) and had mahogany hair and a full beard , as well as a hairy chest .

title: Torm
description: Torm Torm ( pronounced " TORM " ) , known as The True and The Loyal Fury , was the god whose portfolio consisted of duty , loyalty , and righteousness . His symbol was a right - hand gauntlet held upright with palm forward . History .

title: Torm ( adventurer )
description: Torm ( adventurer ) Torm was a human rogue and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor . He born in Westgate from prostitute Netha and a unknown man , heavily presumed be Dathguld , most powerful lord of the city . For this lineage he was targeted by Night Masks ( guild ) Description .

title: Torment domain
description: Torment domain The once whom hold domain over the tainted domain of torment are the lord of nessus Asmodeus and the whiling whip Loviatar . The Supreme ruler of the nine hells torments the damned in his hells , with torture he breaks adversaries and impose his will upon them , or as a punishment for enemies whom are captured by his minions . The twisted torment met at the hands of the maiden of pain and followers carers with it a small sliver of kindness or tricks of desire .

title: Torment toadstool
description: Torment toadstool Torment toadstools are blue mushrooms found in swamps that release spores when stepped on . The spores can cause nausea and vomiting , although a spore cloud released from a torment toadstool will only last around a minute before dissipation . The toadstools have been known to be used in making ale .

title: Tormstar
description: Tormstar Tormstar the Scarred was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR and a deep - cover Harper spy . History . Tormstar was a ranger living peacefully in Battledale , in the Dalelands , with his wife until a werewolf started terrorizing the dale .

title: Tornskulls
description: Tornskulls The Tornskulls were an orc tribe lead , in 1372 DR , by the trio of Koront , Naurorin and Baerzel . Its territory was located in the Dead Orc Pass . Description .

title: Toroth
description: Toroth Toroth was a noble family in Zhentil Keep . Around 1258 DR , Manshoon requested the help of this family in order to avenge the death of Harlshoon , his father . This resulted in the destruction of a Toroth villa , although Manshoon was pulled from the rubble and saved by his soon - to - be apprentice Sememmon ( known as Malatar Wingstarl at that time ) .

title: Torque of faith
description: Torque of faith The torque of faith was a magical item holy to the church of Tymora . History . Around Kythorn of the Year of the Gauntlet , 1369 DR , the " torque of faith " was to be transported to The Lady ' s Favor , a newly built temple of Tymora in the hamlet of Sevenecho in the Vast .

title: Torrin Ironstar
description: Torrin Ironstar Torrin Ironstar , or Daffyd Raltin , was a male human rogue and member of the Order of Delvers from Eartheart . History . Early Life .

title: Torst Evenhand
description: Torst Evenhand Torst Evenhand ( 244 – 286 DR ) was a human from Westgate and a member of the Evenhand family . He married Besmra Obarskyr who would later become Queen of Cormyr , and was therefore ennobled within Cormyr . Relatives .

title: Torstan Holbrar
description: Torstan Holbrar Torstan Holbrar was a wheelwright from the hamlet of Sarbreenar in the Vast , in business around 1370 DR . Torstan worked at the Sarbreenar wagonworks , and made top - quality wheels , among the best around the Inner Sea . Torstan also kept a large stock of spares available to wagon - drivers who ' d suffered breakdowns on the rough High Trail , though at exorbitant prices .

title: Torstan Ulzimmer
description: Torstan Ulzimmer Torstan Ulzimmer was a human man of the city of Procampur in the Vast , who lived " circa " 1358 DR . He owned a fleet of merchant ships that operated on the Inner Sea , and paid highly for the best crews and equipment . His ships were sleek and fast , and the best manned and equipped around .

title: Tortilla
description: Tortilla Tortilla was a flat bread made of coarse - grained mayz . It was traditionally baked in Maztica and was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Tortoise shield
description: Tortoise shield Tortoise shields were magical shields that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Tortoise shields were small buckler - style shields known as daraq s in Zakhara .

title: Tortured Land
description: Tortured Land The Tortured Land was an area of land in the Moonsea region which was formed by ancient lava flows that were then carved by flowing ice . Giant stone pillars , like teeth , smoothed by the wind jutted out from the landscape . Strange monsters chased small animals but the only other inhabitants seemed to be the bats that laired in the few caves of the area .

title: Torynnar Rhaevaern
description: Torynnar Rhaevaern Torynnar Rhaevaern was a sun elf baelnorn and one of the founders of the Eldreth Veluuthra . As of 1374 DR , he was still amongst its ranks , as a member of the Vel ' Nikeryma , and a source of great wisdom . He suspected that the organization was suffering from an outside influence in Cormanthor , and he last felt an influence of this power during the Fall of Myth Drannor .

title: Tos ' un Armgo
description: Tos ' un Armgo Tos ' un Armgo was the son of Mez ' Barris Armgo and later part of a band of four renegade drow that advised Obould Many - Arrows . Personality . Tos ' un was somewhat uncomfortable with violence .

title: Toshikazu Wada
description: Toshikazu Wada Toshikazu Wada was a samurai commander in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Toshikazu was a easy - going individual , always friendly and outgoing .

title: Tosker Nightsword
description: Tosker Nightsword Tosker Nightsword was the owner and proprietor of the Calling Horns inn . The inn was given to him by an adventuring group known as the Bored Swords . As a retired guide and hunter , Tosker was as familiar with the Evermoors and the western region of the High Forest as well as anyone else in Faerûn .

title: Toss the Dagger
description: Toss the Dagger Toss the Dagger was a betting game played in Cormyr . Set - Up . The game was played indoors over a " throwing area " of moist sand .

title: Tosvin
description: Tosvin The ice devil Tosvin was one of the Icy Claws of Iyraclea and the guardian of the portal to Jhothûn within the ruins of Gharreil . Description . Tosvin looked something akin to tall , humanoid insect .

title: Totem
description: Totem Totems are small animal carvings made of great wood that are given to children of a primal tribe at birth to determine their future personality . For example , Bear means affectionate , caring but is quick tempered and can turn into a savage beast when angered . Lion means courageous and strong , also working especially well in a group .

title: Touch of Blibdoolpoolp
description: Touch of Blibdoolpoolp Touch of Blibdoolpoolp is a cleric and druid spell in the transmutation school . It is granted to the faithful of the kuo - toa n deity Blibdoolpoolp . The hand of the caster of the spell turns into a large claw , resembling a lobster .

title: Touch of Opening
description: Touch of Opening The Touch of Opening was a ritual used by sha ' ir s on their gen to grant their familiar s the ability to open any item locked by mundane means . Preparation . In order for this ritual to succeed the sha ' ir needed to acquire a set of pure golden lockpicks worth at least 2 , 000 dinar s .

title: Touchsickle
description: Touchsickle Touchsickle was a divine magic spell available to druid s , specialty priest s , and allies of Eldath , the Green Goddess . It transformed the caster ' s hand into a magical sickle . Effects .

title: Tour of Duty
description: Tour of Duty As Waterdeep ' s city guard is crippled by illness , volunteers are needed to relieve a northern outpost . At the same time , ranger s from the same outpost discover a dragon ' s hoard and help themselves to some choice items , much to the anger of the dragon .

title: Tourmaline
description: Tourmaline Tourmaline was a long - crystalled mineral that came in many colors and was considered a fancy stone . Description . Tourmaline could be found in a wide variety of colors , the more common being pale shades of blue , brown , gold , green , pink , red , and silver pearl .

title: Tower Chûmavhraele
