description: Tower Chûmavhraele Tower Chûmahraele was a drow - controlled castle located in the Underdark approximately 2 , 500 feet ( 760 meters ) beneath the city of Ravens Bluff . The castle was home to the drow clan House Chûmavh , ruled by the Marquise Dresimil Chûmavh . The castle was constructed some time between 1367 DR and 1479 DR .

title: Tower Reilloch
description: Tower Reilloch Tower Reilloch was a tower on the northern coast of the island of Evermeet and home to Araevin Teshurr and the Circle of Reilloch Domayr . Defenses . It was guarded by the Queen ' s Guards since the attack on the island in 1371 DR .

title: Tower Tranquil
description: Tower Tranquil Tower Tranquil stood just north of Oversember Vale . Location . The Tower Tranquil stood atop the gateway to the cavern of the dracolich Rauglothgor .

title: Tower of Adnan al - Raqi
description: Tower of Adnan al - Raqi The Tower of Adnan al - Raqi was located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Tower of Adnan al - Raqi could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Tower of Al - Kalb
description: Tower of Al - Kalb The Tower of Al - Kalb , or Tower of the Dog , was located within the great fortress of Sarahin in the Haunted Lands . Description . Grey stucco covered the outside of the tower .

title: Tower of Harmony
description: Tower of Harmony The Tower of Harmony was located atop Mount Kus in the Hordelands near Kushk . Description . The Tower was constructed on the site where the six roads leading up from the Holy Mountain of Kus converged .

title: Tower of Martyrs
description: Tower of Martyrs The Tower of Martyrs was an outpost of the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Tower of Martyrs was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara .

title: Tower of Mystery
description: Tower of Mystery The Tower of Mystery or Tower of Mysteries was a temple to Mystra , the Lady of Mysteries , in Saerloon in Sembia . Leadership . Around 1370 DR , the temple was led by Mage Arcane Tanthala , who was assisted by Lord of Mystery Telornym .

title: Tower of Pain Exalted
description: Tower of Pain Exalted The Tower of Pain Exalted was found in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . This temple was dedicated to the worship of Loviatar , the Maiden of Pain . Inhabitants .

title: Tower of Stars
description: Tower of Stars The Tower of Stars was a wizard ' s tower on Traitor ' s Isle on the Sea of Fallen Stars . History . It was constructed and used by Jorunhast , a former Royal Wizard of Cormyr .

title: Tower of Twilight
description: Tower of Twilight The Tower of Twilight was home to Malchor Harpell and was located on the eastern edge of the Neverwinter Wood , a day ' s ride west of Longsaddle . Structure . Exterior .

title: Tower of the Dawn
description: Tower of the Dawn The Tower of the Dawn was an important religious site for the great fortress of Sarahin . Location . The Tower of Martyrs was located deep within the Haunted Lands of Zakhara in Sarahin .

title: Tower of the Eye
description: Tower of the Eye The Tower of the Eye was a temple of Helm in the Temple District of the city of Procampur in the Vast . By 1357 DR until 1367 DR and after , it was led by High Guardian Endra " Watchever " Mathlyn , with 18 subordinate priests and 24 lay - followers . History .

title: Tower of the Faceless God
description: Tower of the Faceless God The Tower of the Faceless God was a large structure within the Yikarian Empire dedicated to the Faceless God in 1367 DR . Location . The Tower was found in the capital city of Nathong , specifically within the Emperor ' s Quarters .

title: Tower of the Masked Mage
description: Tower of the Masked Mage The Tower of the Masked Mage was a temple to Vhaeraun in Sshamath . Description . Sshamath was a drow city in an Underdark cavern , with the temple hanging from the cavern ' s roof .

title: Tower of the Talon
description: Tower of the Talon The Tower of the Talon was a fortress inhabited by a cell of the Cult of the Dragon and named in honor of Anabraxis the Black Talon . The tower was shaped to look like a huge dragon fang with two tips . There were numerous balconies in the tower for the convenience of dragons .

title: Tower of the Test
description: Tower of the Test The Tower of the Test was a structure located on the island of Jazirat al - Gawwar in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Location . The tower could be found in the town of Takabbar .

title: Towerfall
description: Towerfall Towerfall was a powerful arcane spell that could knock over stone towers and walls . Effects . " Towerfall " , quite simply , lifted and knocked over huge stone structures , like castle towers , bridges , and city walls .

title: Towers of Good Fortune
description: Towers of Good Fortune The Towers of Good Fortune was a large and extremely wealthy temple in Suzail dedicated to the goddess of luck Tymora . The temple was considered the most prominent in Suzail and was home to over a dozen priest s who were assisted by several hundred laymen . Description .

title: Towers of Willful Suffering
description: Towers of Willful Suffering The Towers of Willful Suffering was a temple and abbey complex located in Eshpurta , Amn . In the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR , it was a quiet , contemplative place with a staff of 16 priests and a community of 48 followers , led by the Revered Mother of the House Heldatha Dhussta . The grounds and architecture were understated and plain , but its mere presence in Amn made it stand out more than opulence and grandeur ever could .

title: Towers of the Vengeful Hand
description: Towers of the Vengeful Hand The Towers of the Vengeful Hand was a temple complex devoted to Tempus and located in the center of Eshpurta in the Year of the Shield , 1367 DR through at least early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . As of 1367 DR , there were 10 underpriests serving about 150 adherents and a large number of worshipers among the 28 , 000 garrisoned troops , instructors , trainees , and support personnel . As of 1370 DR , Jak Errins was getting on in years and two of his underpriests , Peris Whallnsor , and Niskam Tresdaap , were vying for the powerful leadership position .

title: Toyo Otomoto
description: Toyo Otomoto Toyo Otomoto was a sea captain in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . Otomoto was a very experienced captain in service of Shou Ko clan for a long time commanding the " Joyful Spring " ship .

title: Toyo Shidiro
description: Toyo Shidiro Toyo Shidiro was a sailor in 1358 DR . Activities . Toyo Shidiro was a Kozakuran sailor in service to the mercantile Ko clan , acting as second - in - command of the " Victorious Morning " ship under Captain Hu .

title: Toyoaki
description: Toyoaki Toyoaki was a monk in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . Activities . Toyoaki was a monk devoted to Nung Chiang , one of the Nine Immortals of the Celestial Empire , and to the Way .

title: Toytere
description: Toytere Toytere was a halfling man and the leader of the Dead Rats gang of Luskan and the biological twin brother of Kalen Dren ' s adopted sister Cellica . Like many of the Rats , Toytere had some wererat blood although he never demonstrated any ability to shape shift until his death when his body took the form of a wererat . Description .

title: Traceless travel
description: Traceless travel Traceless travel was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Tracker scent
description: Tracker scent The tracker scent ritual was used by sha ' ir s to enhance the sense of smell of their gen . Preparation . A concoction of rare herbs costing 600 dinar s was needed to complete the tracker scent ritual .

title: Trackless Sea
description: Trackless Sea The Trackless Sea was the name of the ocean due west of the continent of Faerûn . Geography . The Trackless Sea ran from the Sea of Swords in the west to Maztica , where it was known as Taylola , the Eastern Ocean , and Anchorome in the east .

title: Trade Harbor
description: Trade Harbor The Trade Harbor was located in Huzuz , the City of Delights , along the banks of Al - Sarif River . Description . This large harbor had enough docks to support 40 galley s or dromond s with an additional 75 cog s .

title: Trade Tongue
description: Trade Tongue Trade Tongue was the name given to the common trade language amongst the inhabitants of Kara - Tur . Due to its purpose , it had only a limited vocabulary , consisting largely of terms for the exchange of goods and currency . It was therefore mostly used by merchants and traders , as well as sailors .

title: Trade Way
description: Trade Way The Trade Way was a long , well traveled trade road along the west coast of Faerûn . Geography . The Trade Way started at Calimport in the south and traveled along the coast line all the way north to Waterdeep .

title: Trade bar
description: Trade bar Trade bars are a form of hard currency made of various precious metals that are accepted as currency throughout virtually all of Faerûn . They are typically marked with the seal or symbol of the mercantile group or nation that minted them . Merchants , trade costers and anyone else who is trading in large quantities typically prefer to use trade bars for their wide acceptance and ease - of - use .

title: Trademeet
description: Trademeet Trademeet , also known as the City of Merchant ' s Peace , was a settlement in Amn and the smallest of the region ' s caravan stops . Due to the Merchant ' s Peace , all commerce in Trademeet was bound to be carried out honestly and fairly . Geography .

title: Trader ' s Road
description: Trader ' s Road The Trader ' s Road was a road traveling from the Sunset Vale through the Dragon Coast . Geography . The road ran from the town of Easting in the Sunset Vale , across the Dragon Reach through Elversult , across the Horse Prairie , to the town of Teziir , then turns south and goes through the town of Smuggler ' s Bank and Reddansyr , then crosses the river Reddan and ends at the city of Starmantle on the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Trader Bob
description: Trader Bob Trader Bob was a human adventurer - turned - merchant . His shops were notable for being more expensive than the norm . Description .

title: Trades Ward of Waterdeep
description: Trades Ward of Waterdeep Trades Ward was one of the seven wards of the city of Waterdeep . Geography . The ward was bounded in the south by South Ward , in the west by Castle Ward , in the north by North Ward and the City of the Dead and in the east by the Trollwall .

title: Traevyn Illance
description: Traevyn Illance Traevyn Illance was an old noble in Cormyr and lord of the Illance noble house . History . Around 1479 DR , Traevyn visited Broryn Windstag and his friend to check on their situation and to try to recruit all the gathered nobles to his cabal .

title: Trahern
description: Trahern Trahern of Oakvale was an old druid in charge of the Oakvale , a small forest in the Myrloch Vale . Personality . He was proud of his caretaker - ship of the Oakvale .

title: Trail Lords
description: Trail Lords The Trail Lords was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This mysterious merchant group was known to hire half - orcs , and other unsavory races , as caravan guards .

title: Trail between Everlund and Sundabar
description: Trail between Everlund and Sundabar The Everlund to Sundabar trail was a pathway within the Silver Marches . Geography . The trail began in Everlund at the Upriver Gate and followed the north bank of the River Rauvin to Lhuvenhead .

title: Trailsend
description: Trailsend Trailsend was a large city in Damara . A large center of trade for the surrounding region , the city appealed to adventuring parties who often went to explore the ruins of Rawlinswood or the Giantspire Mountains . The city was often used by travelers on the long road to Rashemen .

title: Traitor ' s Heads
description: Traitor ' s Heads Traitor ' s Heads was a betting dice game played in Cormyr . Set - Up . The game required a large cloak or velvet cloth ; a set of five six - sided dice ; and two skulls , one of which had had the top sawed off .

title: Traitor ' s Isle
description: Traitor ' s Isle Traitor ' s Isle was an unoccupied island that formed one of the two islands of Prespur in the Sea of Fallen Stars . The only site of interest was the Tower of Stars , created and used by Jorunhast , former Royal Wizard of Cormyr . The island ' s coastline was jagged and rocky , making travel there by boat extremely difficult and hazardous .

title: Traj
description: Traj Traj was a desert dwarf chieftain in Maztica . History . Traj ruled over a village near Sunhome .

title: Tralia Falrith
description: Tralia Falrith Tralia Falrith was a crinti living in Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the 14th century DR . Relationships . She was a third cousin of Queen Yenandra .

title: Tranph
description: Tranph Sergeant - Major Tranph was an officer in the Golden Legion . History . Tranph was a veteran of the Legion .

title: Transitions
description: Transitions Transitions is a series by R . A . Salvatore that follows The Hunter ' s Blades trilogy .

title: Transitive Planes
description: Transitive Planes Transitive Planes is a collective term used to describe those planes of existence that connected other planes together , or could be used as a means of travel between points on a single plane . The various cosmology models each described them differently and ascribed them slightly different traits , but all were accessed by either magic spells , spell - like abilities , or portals . The known Transitive Planes were : Each had their own unique structure and means of travel , and each connected a different set of planes together .

title: Transmutation
description: Transmutation The transmutation school of magic consisted of spell s that changed the physical properties of some creature , thing , or condition . The school was previously known as alteration . A wizard who specialized in transmutation was known as a transmuter .

title: Transmute metal to wood
description: Transmute metal to wood Transmute metal to wood was a transmutation spell that permanently transformed any metal within a 40 foot ( 12 m ) radius into wood . Older versions of this spell only operated on a single object . Effects .

title: Transmute rock to mud
description: Transmute rock to mud Transmute rock to mud was a transmutation or alteration spell that transformed natural stone into an equivalent volume of viscous mud . The reverse of this spell , " transmute mud to rock " , caused normal mud or quicksand to become a solid but brittle quantity of stone ( like alabaster , pipestone , or sandstone ) of equal volume . Effects .

title: Transport via plants
description: Transport via plants Transport via plants was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to enter any sufficiently large plant and jump any distance to another plant of the same species . Effects . The plants in question had to be alive and Medium sized or larger to accommodate the caster and any baggage ( up to the caster ' s carrying capacity ) .

title: Transposing lunge
description: Transposing lunge Transposing lunge is a spell used by several swordmage s , particularly those of the shielding style . When " transposing lunge " is cast it allows a swordmage to teleport a creature struck their weapon in melee combat to a nearby location . Shielding swordmages have the added capacity to teleport in such a way creatures who would normally beyond the reach of the spell , so long as they are also currently under the affect of the " aegis of shielding " spell .

title: Transtra
description: Transtra Transtra was one of the leaders of the Iron Ring and a slaver of Skullport around 1370 DR . History . Transtra was a powerful crime lord and slaver in Skullport who associated herself with the Iron Ring Consortium .

title: Tranth
description: Tranth Tranth was the baron of the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . History . Tranth inherited the barony from his father around 1332 DR , just before the kingdom started to fall .

title: Trap the soul
description: Trap the soul Trap the soul is a sorcerer and wizard spell that allows the caster to trap the life force and material body ( if any ) of a creature inside a gem . The creature can only be released if the gem is broken . The caster can complete the spell normally , or by creating a trigger object .

title: Traskar Selarn
description: Traskar Selarn Traskar Selarn , the Lord of Secomber , is a tall , regal and good - natured man . He has agreed to keep watch over the city for the Lords ' Alliance by intervening in it ' s affairs when necessary , but otherwise leaving it ' s inhabitants to themselves . He often sends adventurers to ruins he knows holds promise in that they have not yet been looted .

title: Travel domain
description: Travel domain The Travel domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters traveling spell powers . They gain the ability to move freely for brief periods regardless of magical effects impeding their movement . The ability is automatic and lasts until it runs out or is no longer needed .

title: Traveler ' s Cloak Inn
description: Traveler ' s Cloak Inn Traveler ' s Cloak Inn was an inn in Mulmaster on the Moonsea . Structure . The inn was a welcoming establishment where each room had a fireplace .

title: Traveler ' s dust
description: Traveler ' s dust Traveler ' s dust was a deadly , addictive drug . Those that used traveler ' s dust were said to be " walking the crimson road " . Appearance .

title: Traveler ' s pearl
description: Traveler ' s pearl Traveler ' s pearls were magic item s created by marid and given to mortals . Description . This item appeared as a large pearl with rosy coloration .

title: Traven Blackdagger
description: Traven Blackdagger Traven Blackdagger was the older and more powerful of the Blackdagger Bandits who , together with his brother Malus Blackdagger , raided the High Road . History . Malus and Traven were two penniless brothers from Luskan .

title: Treahugh Greiko
description: Treahugh Greiko Treahugh Greiko was an ex - ranger in the village of Conyberry around 1370 DR . History . Treahugh was a famed ranger expert in tracking large monsters .

title: Treant
description: Treant A treant was a huge intelligent plant . Biology . Although a treant ' s wood appeared to be solid like stone , it was filled with tubes that carried water from its roots to the areas where it was needed .

title: Treatise Against Blood - Metal
description: Treatise Against Blood - Metal Treatise Against Blood - Metal was a book written by the sage Fairin Icemantle in the 7th century DR . In this treatise , Fairin expressed his reservations about orcslayer blades whose steel was poisonous to orc s . He feared that they would lead to the development of other alloys toxic to many races , and spread death and destruction .

title: Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants
description: Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants The Treatise Historical of the Dragon Tyrants was an ancient text penned by Reverent Dreamer Rhistel Laelithar . It was recovered from the ruins of Myth Drannor in 1374 DR . The book discussed the history of the Time of Dragons , including the creation of the kobold , urd , and gnome races , and the origin of the deities Kurtulmak and Kuraulyek .

title: Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge
description: Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge The Treaty of Garumn ' s Gorge was a treaty signed in 1372 DR by both Bruenor Battlehammer and Obould Many - Arrows . It ended the fierce war between the newly recovered dwarvern kingdom and the beginnings of the orc realm known as the Kingdom of Many - Arrows . As of 1409 the two kingdoms are still at peace , although Bruenor has expressed sincere regret on numerous occasions .

title: Trebbe
description: Trebbe Trebbe was an archwizard and one of the most prolific spell creators in Netheril . Abilities . He was a specialist in magic that protected arcanists , enabling spell duels to last much longer .

title: Tred McKnuckles
description: Tred McKnuckles Tred McKnuckles was a stout dwarf with a yellow beard . He wore a throwing hammer on the back of each shoulder . He was a skilled blacksmith and farrier , and was often called upon by King Emerus Warcrown to shoe horses .

title: Tree - Gem of Bloodstone
description: Tree - Gem of Bloodstone The Tree - Gem of Bloodstone was a 30 ft tall white tree with golden leaves growing in the courtyard of Palace Dragonsbane in Bloodstone Village . History . In 1359 DR , Gareth Dragonsbane and his companions traveled to the Abyss and stole the Wand of Orcus using advice from Saint Sollars .

title: Tree Ghost Tribe
description: Tree Ghost Tribe The Tree Ghost Tribe were a Uthgardt barbarian band that seperated from the Blue Bear tribe in 1313 DR . History . In 1372 DR , the Tree Ghost ancestral mound was the Grandfather Tree .

title: Tree of Souls
description: Tree of Souls The Tree of Souls was a sapling planted on the newly formed Evermeet by the elven gods Angharradh and Corellon Larethian and given into the protection of the high mage Starleaf after the completion of the magic which created Evermeet in the First Sundering . History . The Tree of Souls remained in Evermeet and in the protection of the elves there but , after the failed conquest by Kymil Nimesin , the Queen , Amlaruil Moonflower , gave her son , Lamruil Moonflower , a bud of the tree .

title: Tree python
description: Tree python Often mistaken for normal , non - magical , tree - hunting constrictor snakes , tree pythons are found native to the Serpent Hills . Physical description . The tree python is an intelligent creature , that lies patiently in wait for its prey safely tangled up on a branch from a tree .

title: Tree seat
description: Tree seat Tree seats were handy items used by ranger s and others who spent time travelling through the wilds of Faerûn . Uses . With a tree seat , a ranger could turn any sturdy tree into his own fortress or watchtower .

title: Tree shape
description: Tree shape Tree shape , also called just tree , was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed the caster to take the form of a large tree or shrub for a few hours . Effects . When cast , the caster and all the caster ' s clothing and accouterments changed into a live tree or shrub , or a dead trunk with only a few dead limbs .

title: Tree steed
description: Tree steed Tree steed was an alteration / enchantment spell that changed a piece of wood into a walking ( I won ' t say lumbering ) beast of burden . Effects . Any kind of wood could be used for a " tree steed " as long as it was at least 3 in ( 7 .

title: Tree stride
description: Tree stride Tree stride , also known as pass plant , was a conjuration or alteration spell that allowed the caster to enter a tree and then teleport to a distant tree of the same type , and repeat for the duration of the spell . Effects . This spell was an improvement on the " plant door " spell , allowing the caster to not only step inside a tree , but also jump to other similar trees within range .

title: Trek bell
description: Trek bell A " Trek Bell " is a magical item of transportation . Description . A trek bell is an immense dull iron sphere , large enough to hold four or five people .

title: Tremair
description: Tremair Tremair , also known as hexagonite or pink tremolite , was a very small but valuable fancy stone . Description . In raw ore , tremair was found as small , pink , clear to translucent crystals .

title: Tren Noemfor
description: Tren Noemfor Tren Noemfor was a fighter and the Zhent - appointed constable of Dagger Falls from 1353 DR until around 1368 DR . History . Tren was an ex - adventurer of Daggerdale whom the Zhentarim appointed as constable of Dagger Falls in order to maintain the facade of a free and legitimate government in the dale .

title: Tren Saykatt
description: Tren Saykatt Tren Saykatt was the Cloakmaster of Murann for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR . Personality . The crime lord was totally devoted to the Shadow Thieves , whom she rightly saw as saving her from retaliation for the actions of her crazed goddess .

title: Trent Oster
description: Trent Oster Trent Oster is one of the founders of BioWare and the founder of , a downloading service , and IdeaSpark Labs . Education and Career . Oster studied computer science at the University of Saskatchewan before co - founding Bioware in 1995 .

title: Trent Vendall
description: Trent Vendall Trent Vendall was a visitor of Neverwinter in the 1370s DR . History . Trent came from Cormyr and went to Neverwinter , despite bandits attacking the caravans .

title: Trenton Bartlowes
description: Trenton Bartlowes Trenton Bartlowes was a businessmanin Skullport . History . Trenton was a rich man of Arabel that decided to settle in Skullport .

title: Tresendar
description: Tresendar The Tresendar Family was a royal family that used to live in a manor in Phandalin before the orc raids of Uruth Ukrypt wiped out the town and laid waste to the settlement in 951 DR . The manor , along with the whole town was abandoned during that time . Most of the members of the Tresendar Family were buried in the crypt below the manor .

title: Tresk Mulander
description: Tresk Mulander Tresk Mulander was a necromantic Red Wizard and a member of the Researcher faction who was imprisoned , brought to Mantol - Derith in the Underdark by Hadrogh Prohl , and sold to Xandra Shobalar in 1348 where he was kept by her in captivity in Menzoberranzan for two years . During his time in captivity , he learned a great deal about the magic of the Underdark . Appearance .

title: Trespin
description: Trespin Trespin was a four - armed troll , a demon - worshiper , and a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Trespin acted as one of the lead custodians of the Cult ' s hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains .

title: Tressym
description: Tressym A tressym was a magical beast resembling a small winged cat . They could be found across the warm and temperate lands of Faerûn , and were most common in northern Cormyr , particularly in the village of Eveningstar where they were seen as good luck charms and mascots and praised for keeping down rodents . They were also popular as familiars for good wizard s .

title: Trett
description: Trett Trett was a merchant during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Trett , during one of his travels in 1489 DR , acquired a necklace made from a blue dragon tooth .

title: Triadic knight
description: Triadic knight Triadic Knight is a prestige class whose members worship the Triad , the union of Ilmater , Torm and Tyr . They believe that to fully embody the virtues of a paladin , they must draw on the strengths of all three of these deities . Through courage and perseverance , Triadic knights seek justice for all .

title: Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale )
description: Tribe of the Elk ( Icewind Dale ) The Tribe of the Elk was a nomadic group of Reghedman barbarians living in the tundra that comprised Icewind Dale . History . After the Battle of Icewind Dale in 1351 DR , few tribe members were left , forcing women to scavenge for food on the tundra .

title: Triboar
description: Triboar Triboar is on the junction of the Long Road and Evermoor Way , due west of Yartar , its traditional rival . It is a large town with a population of around 2500 . Over the centuries it has been the assembly point for human armies in response to the orc hordes from the mountains in the north along the Surbrin .

title: Triboar Trail ( region )
description: Triboar Trail ( region ) The Triboar Trail was a stretch of foothills and rolling , sparsely wooded plains extending between the Sword Mountains to the south and the Neverwinter Wood s to the north . The area got its name from the trail of the same name . The Triboar Trail was also sometimes referred to as the Triboar Cutoff or named after the town of Conyberry as the Cony Gap .

title: Triceratops
description: Triceratops A triceratops ( ytepka in the Chultan language ) was a gargantuan , herbivorous , herd dinosaur . Description . These massive dinosaurs had a bony plate on their six - foot - long skull for defense , with two long horns on the top and a shorter horn at the nose .

title: Triceratops Society
description: Triceratops Society The Triceratops Society ( or Ytepka , Chultan for " triceratops " ) was a secret society dedicated to the protection of Chult from foreigners . Organization . There were 99 degrees of membership in the society .

title: Trickery domain
description: Trickery domain The Trickery domain was a suite of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolios included pranks , deception , and larceny . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . Trickery Domain Spells .

title: Trident
description: Trident A trident was a three - pronged martial piercing weapon . Usage . A trident could be thrown , but it was not as well - balanced as a spear .

title: Triel
description: Triel Triel was a small village in the Fields of the Dead located at the intersection of the Trade Way and the Dusk Road , south of Boareskyr Bridge . The city of Elturel was located to the southeast and the Trielta Hills were located to the northeast . The original ruler of Triel was Elvar the Grainlord .

title: Triel Baenre
description: Triel Baenre Triel Baenre was a drow priestess and the matron mother of House Baenre , first house of Menzoberranzan until 1383 DR . As the matron mother of the first house , Triel was the most influential drow in the city , and as such could be seen as the unofficial leader of Menzoberranzan ; however , due to the nature of the drow , no other matron mother would ever willingly accept her dominance publicly - - they were a far too envious and power hungry of a race to concede power to a single figurehead . As a powerful matron mother , Triel was addressed by a number of titles .

title: Trielta Hills
description: Trielta Hills The Trielta Hills lay to the north - east of Triel and north - west of Hardbuckler in the Western Heartlands . They were home to many communities of gnome s and a few halfling s . Periodically , miners found silver and gold deposits in the hills .

title: Trifin Creek
description: Trifin Creek Trifin Creek was a swiftly flowing small river with steep banks . Its source was near the Snakewood , and it flowed mainly southward until it merged with the River Rimril and then joined the Amstel River past Eshpurta . There were a few places where the current slowed enough to allow fishing .

title: Trill
description: Trill Trill was the pet wyvern of Mattias Farseer . Mattias found Trill as a fledgling after he had killed her mother . He adopted the little wyvern and the two travelled together for many years .

title: Trillimac
description: Trillimac Trillimac was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . Description . Trillimac stalks reached a height of 4 – 5 ft ( 1 .

title: Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts
description: Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts Trimia ' s catalogue of Outer Plane artifacts is an unmarked large book bound in heavy wood . The title of the book and a list of contents can be found on the first page . Operation .

title: Trio Nefarious
description: Trio Nefarious The Trio Nefarious or Khov ' Anilessa in elven , were three greater Nycaloth s summoned by the netherese archwizard Aldlas Sodhese who had heard that the Nether Scrolls lay somewhere in Cormanthor . His plan was to use the Yugoloths to wreak havoc among the elves as a distraction while searching for the scrolls . History .

title: Trip
description: Trip Trip was an enchantment spell that caused an object placed on the ground to rise up and attempt to make anyone crossing over it stumble and fall . Effects . Typically a long , thin object like a rope , vine , rod , stick , board , or staff was the target of this spell .

title: Triple Legion
description: Triple Legion The Triple Legion was a mercenary organization within the Sevenfold Mazework of the Great Dismal Delve . Organization . The Triple Legion was made - up of 800 xorn mercenaries .

title: Trishina
description: Trishina Trishina was the goddess of the dolphins and consort of Deep Sashelas . She was the reason why aquatic elves had such a bond with dolphins . Her clergy were pacifists but devoted themselves utterly to protecting the young of any race they encountered and saving as many lives as they could .

title: Tristan Kendrick
description: Tristan Kendrick Tristan Kendrick was a member of the Kendrick family and the prince of Corwell . Description . Tristan was a dashing man with a thick beard and dark brown hair .

title: Tristopher Chettlebell
description: Tristopher Chettlebell Tristopher Chettlebell was a historian of Neverwinter in around 1480 DR . History . As a sage , Tristopher tried to record the history of Neverwinter .

title: Triton
description: Triton Tritons originate from the Elemental Plane of Water , but have migrated to the Material Plane for some unknown purpose . They are sea dwellers , preferring warm waters but able to tolerate colder depths . Physical description .

title: Triumvirate
description: Triumvirate The Triumvirate were a group of three phaerimm who managed to escape Anauroch through a breach in the Sharn Wall . They conquered the beholder city of Ooltul in the Northdark . Activities .

title: Trobriand
description: Trobriand Trobriand was a wizard and former student of Halaster who lived in Undermountain . He specialized in magical metal creations , and whenever one of his creations failed , he used " Trobriand ' s wand of rejection " to send it to Trobriand ' s Graveyard . He thought of his creations as being superior to other creatures .

title: Trobriand ' s Graveyard
description: Trobriand ' s Graveyard Trobriand ' s Graveyard was an area of Undermountain used as a scrap heap by the mage Trobriand . History . Each time he needed to dispose of a failed creation , Trobriand used his " wand of rejecting " to send it to the graveyard .

title: Troglodyte
description: Troglodyte Troglodytes were reptilian humanoids , shorter than a human , with spindly but muscular arms and squat legs . They also had long , slender tails . The stench of an angry or frightened troglodyte was so foul that it sickened all living creatures nearby , even after the troglodyte died .

title: Troken ' ther Vandree
description: Troken ' ther Vandree Troken ' ther Vandree was the matron mother of House Vandree in Menzoberranzan around 1358 DR . Personality . The drow elf matron was known for being inefficient in challenging other houses , such as House Barrison Del ' Armgo .

title: Troll
description: Troll Trolls are massive , predatory species of giant - kin , they are considered " stupid bastards " by other species of giants except for ogre s , who are treated the same way . The most distinctive feature of trolls is their ability to regenerate . If any part of a troll ' s body is cut off , it will grow back after a while and the felled limb has a chance to evolve into an entirely new troll .

title: Troll Hills
description: Troll Hills The Troll Hills are a series of hills found along the coastal area of the Western Heartlands . . Features .

title: Troll Mountains ( Amn )
description: Troll Mountains ( Amn ) The Troll Mountains were a range of low mountains in Amn , so named for the rather intelligent troll s that inhabited their peaks . They were considered the " gateway to the northeast " . Geography .

title: Troll Mountains ( the Vast )
description: Troll Mountains ( the Vast ) The Troll Mountains , also called the Trollcrag Mountains , was a small mountain range in the Vast in north Faerûn , running north of the River Vesper from the Dragon Reach in the west to the Earthspur Mountains in the east . Geographical features . The Troll Mountains were an arm of the greater Earthspur Mountains .

title: Trollblood ioun stone
description: Trollblood ioun stone The Trollblood ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " giving martial prowess against troll s and the ability to regenerate wounds . Description . The stone was a gleaming dark green , resembling a sphere of hardened troll blood , bearing deep cracks .

title: Trollbridge
description: Trollbridge Trollbridge was a small village near the High Forest . North of it lay the Evermoor Way and the Dessarin with the Dead Horse Ford . Less than two days ' march from it lay the Drygully Tunnel , an entrance to the Underdark .

title: Trollclaw Ford
description: Trollclaw Ford The Trollclaw Ford is ruined hamlet located on the Winding Water , and is part of the Coast Way , connecting Baldur ' s Gate to Waterdeep . It would appear to be named after the Troll Claw , a group of hills to the immediate east of the ford .

title: Trollstooth Run
description: Trollstooth Run Trollstooth Run was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Description . This stream was named for the large amount of teeth and bones from troll s and other creatures that are found within its waters , resulting from many battles that took place in the area .

title: Trolltide
description: Trolltide Trolltide was a lesser Waterdhavian feast day celebrated mostly by children at the start of Kythorn . It commemorated the end of the Second Trollwar . Children ran through the city acting like troll s , banging on doors and growling , from highsun till dusk .

title: Trollwars
description: Trollwars The Trollwars were two wars fought between the human s of Waterdeep and the troll s of the nearby Trollmoors . First Trollwar . The First Trollwar occurred in 932 DR , when a large population of trolls had been displaced from the Sword Mountains by orc s after they were united under the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge .

title: Trommen
description: Trommen Trommen was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Although extremely lazy , Trommen was an adventurer with 32 years of adventuring experience .

title: Trout
description: Trout The trout was a common fish of Faerûn . Species . Szorp .

title: Troy Denning
description: Troy Denning Troy Denning ( b . 1958 ) is a fantasy and science fiction author of the New York Times bestselling novel Waterdeep ( 1989 ) , which he wrote with Scott Ciencin under the pseudonym Richard Awlinson . Other notable works are " Dragonwall " , " Pages of Pain " , and " The Parched Sea " .

title: True Ghost Knight Faithful
description: True Ghost Knight Faithful The True Ghost Knight Faithful was a cult that venerated the Ghost Knight of Galardoun as an incarnation of the dead god Helm . The group met in the upstairs rooms of the Ten Trolls Fallen tavern in Waterdeep ' s Trade Ward . The cult often quested to find the apparition which wandered the Heartlands .

title: True bearing
description: True bearing True bearing was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell was a favorite of mariners who used it to determine the direction of a landmark .

title: True name
description: True name A creature ' s true name is its hidden name that , rather just acting as a label , metaphysically truly belongs to that creature . All beings have true names , though most of these are unknown , especially to mere mortals . Knowing a creature ' s true name can grant power over it .

title: True seeing
description: True seeing True seeing , also known as true sight , was a divination spell that allowed the subject see things in their true form or location . A divine version of this spell was reversible , called false seeing , and masked the true form of things , generally making them appear the opposite of their true nature . Effects .

title: True strike
description: True strike True strike was a divination spell that allowed the caster to look a few seconds into the future and gain a great advantage to hit a target . Effects . This spell allowed the caster to look one move ahead and strike at the right place at the right time , with almost guaranteed success .

title: Trueblades
description: Trueblades The Trueblades were an order of crusader s devoted to the god Torm the True , based in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Base . They were based in a sword - temple in the city of Tantras .

title: Truent Tyranon
description: Truent Tyranon Truent Tyranon was a seasoned Cormyr ian warrior in Scardale in 1368 DR . Activities . Truent led the Cormyrean garrison in the city .

title: Trueshield Trading Priakos
description: Trueshield Trading Priakos The Trueshield Trading Priakos was a merchant company in Faerûn . History . This merchant group built its own wagons and even trained and equipped their guards .

title: Truesilver
description: Truesilver House Truesilver was a noble house of Cormyr , whose estate was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail . The family was known for its militarism and pushed to expand the Imperial Navy ' s influence in the late 15th century DR . The Truesilvers and Dauntinghorn s shared similar views on Cormyr ' s military might .

title: Trumpet archon
description: Trumpet archon Trumpet archons were a celestial beings that lived primarily on the slopes of Celestia . Physical description . A trumpet archon appeared as a beautiful humanoid being with pale skin , white hair and feathered wings , with eyes the color of gleaming pearls .

title: Trunalor
description: Trunalor The Trunalor , or star people , were a tribe of wild elves who lived within the Forest of Amtar in northern Dambrath . History . The star people despised the drow and crinti who dominated the country of Dambrath .

title: Trundles
description: Trundles LL . McV . Trundles or Doctor Trundles was a businessman in the Bloodstone Lands around 1357 DR and 1359 DR .

title: Truth candle
description: Truth candle A truth candle was a special magic item made by mystic s in the Realms . It caused individuals to enter a state of torpor and forced them to answer questions truthfully . Description .

title: Trythos
description: Trythos Trythos was one of the leaders of New Waterdeep in 1370 DR . History . Trythos simply went to Maztica in order to find a new land .

title: Tsabanor Oblodra
description: Tsabanor Oblodra Tsabanor Oblodra was the house patron of House Oblodra and the mate of Matron Mother K ' yorl Odran circa 1358 DR . Personality . Tsabanor was a pathetic figure in his house , and lived only with K ' yorl ' s permission .

title: Tsabrak
description: Tsabrak Tsabrak was a drider and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 . History . Tsabrak was part of a drider colony living in tunnels near Menzoberranzan .

title: Tsabrak Xorlarrin
description: Tsabrak Xorlarrin Tsabrak Xorlarrin was the Archmage of Q ' Xorlarrin . History . Tsabrak served as master of Sorcere academy of Menzoberranzan .

title: Tsabrak of the Blood
description: Tsabrak of the Blood Tsabrak of the Blood was the head of the College of Necromancy and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that everyone knew that Master Tsabrak was a vampire .

title: Tsagoth
description: Tsagoth Tsagoth is an undead creature , a blood fiend . Appearance . Tsagoth is huge with a purple - black scaly hide .

title: Tsampo
description: Tsampo Tsampo was a staple food stuff of Khazari , made from roasted flour . It could be prepared as a . History .

title: Tsao Ho
description: Tsao Ho Tsao Ho was a sohei adventurer in Shou Lung . History . Tsao Ho born as son of a noble of the Sheng Ti province of Shou Lung and made a quickly career in the army , leading many bushi .

title: Tsaparang Fortress
description: Tsaparang Fortress Tsaparang Fortress , or Tsa Parang , was an ancient fortress located in the Endless Wastes . History . Tsaparang Fortress was an old fortress built sometime during the age of the Kingdom of Guge by a race of half - elves known as the Maviddi in order to combat the growing power of that kingdom .

title: Tsarra Chaadren
description: Tsarra Chaadren Tsarra Chaadren ( known by the alias Autumnfire ) was a half - elf sorceress and the second Blackstaff of Waterdeep . Appearance . Tsarra had long , curly auburn hair Her eyes were hazel .

title: Tsathree ' s Comforts
description: Tsathree ' s Comforts Tsathree ' s Comforts was a boutique owned by Jhamanthra Tsathree . Location . Tsathree ' s Comforts was located on Golden Serpent Street in the North Ward of Waterdeep circa the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR .

title: Tsenya Bhrokiti
description: Tsenya Bhrokiti Princess Tsenya Bhrokiti was the royal heir of Ra - Khati during the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Many believed that Tsenya had many qualities that were ill - suited to a future ruler .

title: Tsenya Garbo
description: Tsenya Garbo Tsenya Garbo was the Holy Leader of Ra - Khati , also called the Dalai Lama , during the mid – 14th century DR . Appearance . Though he was well over one hundred years old , Tsenya appeared to be in his 50 ' s .

title: Tsien Chiang
description: Tsien Chiang Tsien Chiang was a wu jen sorceress who formerly lived in Kara - Tur and later became the Lord of I ' Cath in the Demiplane of Dread . History . Tsien was born as the daughter of one of the princes of I ' Cath .

title: Tsu - tsu
description: Tsu - tsu The Tsu - tsu ( or " Tsu - Tsu " ) were a tribe of the Plain of Horses in the Hordelands . They were one of the three major tribes of the plain , alongside the Fankiang and the Kashghun . Language .

title: Tsu Gonsuke
description: Tsu Gonsuke Tsu Gonsuke was the head of the noble Tsu family and the provincial governor of Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . History . The retired emperor Gokammu gave the governorship of Miyama to the Tsu family , one of the noble families that supported him , and Gonsuke , as head of the house , was chosen as governor .

title: Tsu family
description: Tsu family The Tsu family was a declining noble house related to the Igi clan in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . They still controlled the kokushu position but little more than that . In the past , the Igi were considered vassals of the Tsu but around 1357 DR , the Igi dominated the Tsu .

title: Tsuga Mosuke
description: Tsuga Mosuke Tsuga Mosuke was a Hengeyokai retainer of the Funada clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . He had several little birdlike mannerisms that marked his heritage .

title: Tsukishima
description: Tsukishima Tsukishima was the main isle of Wa . It was the largest and most densely populated . The terrain was composed by many extinct volcanoes bordered by fertile lowlands .

title: Tsukku
description: Tsukku Tsukku was a young samurai retainer of Benju Matsumoto in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Tsukku was a young but proud and loyal samurai .

title: Tsurlagol
description: Tsurlagol Tsurlagol , formerly known as Chessagol , was the southernmost city - state of the Vast , lying at the end of Stormcrest Trail from Sevenecho , on the north coast of the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was a prosperous port city , the last on the Inner Sea before Impiltur . To merchants , it was " The Gateway to the Unapproachable East " ; to pirates it was " Pirate ' s Haven " .

title: Tsurlanej
description: Tsurlanej Tsurlanej was an illithilich sorcerer and the first elder of the Concord of Elders that governed the illithid city of Ch ' Chitl in the Northdark of the Underdark in the mid – 14th century DR . History . In the mid – 13th century DR , the githyanki assaulted the city and mortally wounded the elder brain .

title: Tsushima
description: Tsushima Tsushima was a samurai retainer of the Korimori clan in Maeshi Province in 1360 DR . History . Tsushima was ordered to lead a cavalry squadron to stop by any means an adventuring party hired by Michimori Uemon to retrieve the Seven Swords for Uemon .

title: Tu ' ara ' thal
description: Tu ' ara ' thal Tu ' ara ' thal was a shalarin cleric of Oghma in Myth Nantar . History . Born into the shalarin ' s Seeker Caste , Tu ' ara ' thal followed the call of Oghma and joined the Faiths Caste .

title: Tu ' ola ' sara
description: Tu ' ola ' sara Tu ' ola ' sara was a dukar of the Order of Maliirn and a member of the Nantarn Council . History . Hailing from Ys ' bhol Tu ' ola ' sara was a shalarin of Wandered Caste .

title: Tu ' uua ' col
description: Tu ' uua ' col Tu ' uua ' col was a dukar of the Order of Kupav . History . Born in 1313 DR Tu ' uua ' col was trained as dukar by Qos and others in Qatoris and sent as secret agent in merfolk territories .

title: Tu - shun
description: Tu - shun Tu - shun was a sohei and also a zussho in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Tu - shun administrated a shoen of the Konjo school near the Itsuki village .

title: Tualo
description: Tualo Tualo , usually known as Tualo the Bright , was a wizard living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . He was interested in studying the effects of the Spellplague . Tualo met and befriended an elven wizard , Rhazzad , who had the same interest .

title: Tube wilt
description: Tube wilt Tube wilt was a disease affecting treant s . It was carried by tiny spores in the soil that could get into the trunk . Once inside the treant , they grew into a fungus that fed on the heartwood , the most tube - rich area of the treant , and caused rotting to occur .

title: Tuern
description: Tuern Tuern ( pronounced " TOORN " ) was an island in the Frozenfar in the Trackless Sea , far to the west of Faerûn . It was a rocky island of black beaches and fuming volcanoes , but was very fertile . Climate .

title: Tufala min - Jarmik
description: Tufala min - Jarmik Tufala min - Jarmik was a half - elven ethoist priest of Jarmik in 1367 DR . Activities . Tufala supervised the ten priests of the Mosque of the Thirsty Jann along the Pilgrims ' Route .

title: Tufenk
description: Tufenk Tufenks were special weapons originating in Zakhara . Description . These weapons looked like elongated blowpipe s .

title: Tuigan
description: Tuigan The Tuigan were humans from Taan , also known as the Endless Wastes , the vast steppes that stretched between Faerûn and Kara - Tur . Territory . The original tribal lands of the Tuigan were in the central Wastes .

title: Tuigan language
description: Tuigan language Tuigan was the language of the Tuigan tribe of the Hordelands . Description . Tuigan had harsh consonant sounds , and the sound of L was heavily aspirated .

title: Tuir Stonebeard
description: Tuir Stonebeard Tuir " Stonebeard " , Blood of Helban was a dwarf man and Deep King of the dwarven kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . History . Tuir was a descendent of Helban , whom he honored in his name .

title: Tukan
description: Tukan Tukan was a relatively new city in Maztica that sat on a peninsula . It was constructed by refugees from Nexal and was inhabited by human s of different origins . Most of them were Nexalans , others from Azatl or Tezat .

title: Tukulti
description: Tukulti Tukulti was the ruler of Firetrees in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Tukulti was a supporter of Gilgeam .

title: Tula Duadil
description: Tula Duadil Tula Duadil was an aquatic elf thief in Myth Nantar . History . Tula , a cousin of the ruler of Naramyr , went to the city in order to become a dukar but was rejected for her power - hungry attitude .

title: Tulmene
description: Tulmene Tulmene was a small settlement on the south coast of the Tethyr Peninsula . Tulmene was known for being the largest fishing village in the region . The village also occasionally traded goods with merchants .

title: Tulmon
description: Tulmon Tulmon is a settlement in the Lake of Steam area . In 1372 DR , its population was around 25 , 000 and was ruled by the sorcerer Arkanuirr Tchallem . Most of the buildings in the city were constructed of stone .

title: Tulom - Itzi
description: Tulom - Itzi Tulom - Itzi was a city in Far Payit in Maztica . The city was once a thriving metropolis but by the mid – 14th century was inhabited by only a fraction of the people who once lived there . The inhabitants , the Itza s , lived in wooden huts and had allowed the jungle to reclaim many of the great stone buildings .

title: Tulrun
description: Tulrun Tulrun of the Tent ( pronounced " TULL - run " ) was an uthgardt weretiger archmage who was , for a time , cursed into the form of a tiefling . Description . When Tulrun was a weretiger , he was tall and powerfully built , with pale skin that was covered in fine red and white hairs , striped like a tiger ' s .

title: Tulrun ' s Tent
description: Tulrun ' s Tent Tulrun ' s Tent was a magical dwelling found in the Cold Wood . Structure . From the outside , it looked like a colorful silk tent perched on top a plain wooden platform held on five thin wooden legs about 30 ft ( 9 .

title: Tumblestone River
description: Tumblestone River The Tumblestone River was a narrow river that originated in the hills north of the village of Arnglar in the Border Kingdoms and flowed roughly northeast through the realms of Middle Mukshar and Nether Mukshar until it reached the shores of the Lake of Steam , a total course of approximately 60 miles .

title: Tumen River
description: Tumen River The Tumen River was a river in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Geography . Beginning with two tributaries in the Vorkani Mountains , the Tumen River ran between the mountains and the Naktong Moors , and flowing into the Sea of Kozakura near Konang Pen .

title: Tun Hayal
description: Tun Hayal Tun Hayal was the owner of the Merchant ' s Home in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Though he owned the most splendid in all of the City of Delights , Tun was rarely found within his establishment .

title: Tun Marshes
description: Tun Marshes The Tun Marshes , also called the Marsh of Tun , was a swamp lying in the Tunlands between the Sunset Mountains and the Stormhorns east of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . Geography . Originating in the Farsea Marshes , the Tun River flowed south with few bends .

title: Tunaster Dranik
description: Tunaster Dranik Tunaster Dranik was a male Chondathan human cleric of Mystra who wandered Cormyr in 1374 DR . History . Tunaster was an itinerant cleric of Mystra who journeyed in search of old magic .

title: Tunfer
description: Tunfer Tunfer the Stout was a male human cleric who resided in Dagger Falls and advised Lord Randal Morn . Abilities . As an experienced cleric , Tunfer could pray for spell s capable of raising the dead , if needed .

title: Tunlands
description: Tunlands The Tunlands was an appellation given by many Cormytes to the area between the Storm Horns and the Sunset Mountains . Claimed as part of Cormyr due to its proximity to that nation , the region was more accurately owned by various tribes of human s and humanoid s . Dominated by the Farsea Marshes and the Tun Marshes , the Tunlands were wet and humid with very few settlements of any significant size .

title: Tural
description: Tural Tural was a young inhabitant of the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Tural looked almost exactly like a younger version of his father Tadaz .

title: Turam min Kor
description: Turam min Kor Turam min Kor was a priest of the Golden Mosque in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Though Imam Renn min Zann held the title of Keeper of the Mosques , Turam shared much of the workload .

title: Turami
description: Turami The Turami were an ethnic group of humans who made up the primary population of Turmish . Description . Turami had flat faces with mahogany skin tones .

title: Turbaern
description: Turbaern Turbaern was one of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . Turbaern was a priest of Clangeddin Silverbeard , holding the highest position of the faith , High Old One , and the personal title " Blood Axe of Clangeddin " . In the early 7th century , Turbaern enchanted over a thousand weapons forged from orcslayer metal by Master Smith Fyrfar Smokebeard over several years at the order of Deep King Tuir Stonebeard , in their mission to destroy the orc realm of Vastar .

title: Turban of multiplication
description: Turban of multiplication Turbans of multiplication were magical items that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only carried or used by holy slayer s . Description .

title: Turban of silence
description: Turban of silence Turbans of silence were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . They were only used by holy slayer s . Powers .

title: Turcassan
description: Turcassan Turcassan was a former noble house of Cormyr . It was situated beyond the Royal Gardens in Suzail , Cormyr . The house betrayed the Crown when Melineth Turcassan , in the king ' s absence , sold the city of Suzail to pirate s , although Jotor Turcassan remained loyal to the crown .

title: Turelve
description: Turelve Turelve was a large city in Durpar in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Situated at the mouth of the River Ssarren on the west end of the Golden Water , Turelve was a major launching point for caravans heading north or west out of Durpar .

title: Turg Zhuroth
description: Turg Zhuroth Turg Zhuroth was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Turg was a member of a party of Hands that wandered Waterdeep in search of possible slaves to kidnap .

title: Turik Dumark
description: Turik Dumark Turik Dumark was a mage and bloodforge commander in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . A dangerous mage , Turik Dumark attempted to ambush the Legendary Campaign forces on the road by Old Stone Keep . However , one of Dumark ' s scouts was captured , and the trap was revealed .

title: Turlang
description: Turlang Turlang was a treant in the High Forest . With his companions , he oversaw the security of the ruins of Hellgate Keep by refusing to let anyone in or out , but he was aware that evil was still present , sealed beneath the ruins , and was wary of its escape .

title: Turmic
description: Turmic Turmish was the language of the Turami people and the official tongue of Turmish . Speakers . Besides in the nation of Turmish , Turmic was spoken by folk living in Chessenta , Cormyr , Impiltur , Sembia , Thesk , the Vast , the Vilhon Reach , the Western Heartlands , and along the Dragon Coast .

title: Turmish
description: Turmish Turmish is a republic with the capital of Alaghôn , and is located in the north of the Vilhon Reach . The approximately 1 , 700 , 000 inhabitants are mainly humans , most of whom are Turami , but dwarves are common as well , along side minorities of halflings , elves , gnomes , half - elves and half - orcs . Turmish is known throughout the Sea of Fallen Stars as the " heartland of the Reach " due to its peaceful nature and concentration on commerce over warfare .

title: Turmish Brick
description: Turmish Brick Turmish Brick was a cheese crafted in Turmish . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Turn bin Trevor
description: Turn bin Trevor Turn bin Trevor , formerly known as Turon Daysender was a male human fighter from Waterdeep who came to Zakhara . He was Jayani al - Jasir ' s consort as of 1367 DR . Description .

title: Turn undead
description: Turn undead Turn undead is a " channel divinity " prayer cast by nearly all cleric s . When a cleric casts " turn undead " he or she pushes any undead within a nearby area of five feet in radius back at least fifteen feet , perhaps further depending on the cleric ' s strength of personality . Undead caught in the blast are momentarily paralyzed or , at the very least , seared by the severe light of the prayer .

title: Turning Key
description: Turning Key The Turning Key was an adventuring company . Description . The Turning Key consisted entirely of female thieves and bard s .

title: Turnshadow
description: Turnshadow Turnshadow was an arcane abjuration spell that could cause fear in illusory shadow monsters . It could also be used to take control of one such creature away from its summoner . Effects .

title: Turnstone Pass
description: Turnstone Pass Turnstone Pass was a valley in the Nether Mountains . Description . The region had a bad reputation .

title: Turquoise
description: Turquoise Turquoise was generally found in the more arid locations around Toril . Description . This ornamental stone was an opaque blue to greenish - blue , and usually occurred with blotches of darker hues in the mix .

title: Turritella
description: Turritella Turritella was an agate made up of many small fossilized shell s . Description . The shells were spiral and cone - shaped , less than an inch ( two and a half centimeters ) long .

title: Turvy
description: Turvy Turvy was a deep gnome wererat living in the Underdark with his twin Topsy during the Rage of Demons . Personality . The gnome was very close to his twin Topsy .

title: Tusk
description: Tusk Tusk was a fiendish elephant and the favorite pet of Kurgoth Hellspawn during the invasion of Maerimydra in 1372 DR . Description . Typically outfitted in chainmail barding and metal blades along its tusks , it was an enormous war elephant .

title: Tuth
description: Tuth Tuth was a member of the Shield Council of the Knights of the Shield in 1370 DR . History . Tuth in his early days was an adventurer on the Sword Coast , sacking temples at the bidding of enemy churches .

title: Tutugnik
description: Tutugnik Tutugnik was a bugbear king living in Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR . History . Tutugnik was the king of a tribe of bugbears , orc s , and goblin s living in Gauntlgrym in 1463 DR when an army of House Xorlarrin arrived .

title: Twelfth Serôs War
description: Twelfth Serôs War The Twelfth Serôs War was the major event in the Sea of Fallen Stars of the 1 , 439 year of Timesong ( 1369 DR ) . It involved the destruction brought by Iakhovas the Ravager , a great shark . History .

title: Twelvefold
description: Twelvefold The Twelvefold were a coalition of noble families who had great renown and influence in Gontal . The common folk considered the families of the Twelvefold to be the true rulers of Gontal , although this wasn ' t actually true . Background .

title: Twice as Nice
description: Twice as Nice Twice as Nice was a shop in the Sea Ward of Waterdeep . Structure . Located off the Street of Lances , the building was in a constant state of disrepair .

title: Twilight Falling
description: Twilight Falling Twilight Falling is the first book in the The Erevis Cale Trilogy by Paul S . Kemp . Erevis Cale Origins .

title: Twilight Knight
description: Twilight Knight The Twilight Knight was a vampire and the most mysterious member of the Night Masters , the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks . Description . The Twilight Knight always wore a mask modeled after a skull and no one except for Orbakh knew his true appearance .

title: Twilight Riders
description: Twilight Riders The Twilight Riders were a recently formed vigilante organization in Damara in 1359 DR . Organization . The Riders were a group of heroes gathered by the wizard Emelyn the Gray .

title: Twilight Traders
description: Twilight Traders The Twilight Traders were a coalition of merchants who did business with the people of the Underdark . Their business was secretive and membership was closely guarded , there being only six members . New members were approved by the existing members and also the denizens of the Underdark .

title: Twilight Vale
description: Twilight Vale The Twilight Vale was a mystical valley far to the north of Faerûn that only existed when the shadow of Othea Tor fell upon it . It was the location of the citadel of Voninheim , one of the last strongholds of the great Ostoria n Empire . Description .

title: Twin Paradises
description: Twin Paradises The Twin Paradises of Bytopia were two layers that formed one of the Outer Planes in the Great Wheel cosmology model representing alignments between lawful good and neutral good . Some characteristics of this plane were ascribed to the World Tree cosmology planes of Golden Hills and the House of the Triad when that cosmology became popular . The Golden Hills became part of Arvandor after the Spellplague and the House of the Triad became known as Celestia as described by the World Axis cosmology .

title: Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse
description: Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse The Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse were a pair of towers hidden high in the Small Teeth mountains , one on each side of the Trade Way . Location . The towers were about 5 mi ( 8 km ) apart , deep in the highest peaks of the Small Teeth Mountains between Amn and Muranndin .

title: Twin Visages
description: Twin Visages The Twin Visages are a site at the northern coast of Payit and a landmark for the people from Faerûn which shows them that they will soon arrive at the safe harbor of Helmsport . It consists of two faces looking to the east and cut into a high cliff . One shows a woman , the other a man and it is said that they were built to look for the return of the god Qotal who left the True World for the east a long time ago .

title: Twinkle
description: Twinkle Twinkle was Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s left - handed defensive scimitar forged by the elves of old . Description . Like all magical weapons , this " + 2 defending scimitar " had an enchantment that made the blade sharper and the weapon more likely to strike true .

title: Twisted Rune
description: Twisted Rune The Twisted Rune was a highly secret cabal of lich es and other powerful undead spellcasters . The inner circle was highly secretive , and employed agents to do their bidding , most of whom were unaware that they worked for the Rune . By 1018 DR ( the Year of the Dracorage ) , the Rune had become the most powerful organization in southwestern Faerûn , with agents in every country south of the High Moor and west of the Storm Horn Mountains .

title: Twisted Tower of Ashaba
description: Twisted Tower of Ashaba The Twisted Tower of Ashaba was the home and seat of power of the lord and lady of Shadowdale . The tower , originally known simply as the Twisted Tower , took its name from the first human lord of the dale , the water wizard Ashaba . History .

title: Two - Form Glacier
description: Two - Form Glacier The Two - Form Glacier was a large glacier locked within the peaks of an unknown mountain range near the monastery of Fatula Chupa in what was once the Kingdom of Guge . Geography . The glacier covered roughly 900 square miles ( 1450 sq .

title: Two - bladed sword
description: Two - bladed sword A two - bladed sword , or double - sword , was an exotic , two - handed melee weapon that could be used as a double weapon . Description . The two - bladed sword was approximately the same length as a greatsword or a quarterstaff but had two short sword - sized blades at each end .

title: Two Rocks
description: Two Rocks Two Rocks was a small rocky island in the harbor of Harrowdale Town ( later New Velar ) . As of 1368 DR , it was believed to be the location of hidden treasure , stored by pirates such as Urthag the Knife and the Masked Marquis , although up until that time , no treasure had been found there . As of 1368 DR , the Council of Seven Burghers , the ruling council of Harrowdale , were considering building a sea tower on the island to provide further defenses for the port , against the " one or two privateer night raids per season " that were endured at that time .

title: Tyaa Tymmyr
description: Tyaa Tymmyr Tyaa Tymmyr was an assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Tyaa was born in Daerlun as a scion of a merchant family and lived in wealth and privilege until a business partner of her father slaughtered all her family .

title: Tyar - Besil
description: Tyar - Besil Tyar - Besil was the ancient fortress - city of the shield dwarf kingdom of Besilmer , built under the Sumber Hills in the Dessarin Valley . It was eventually overrun by hordes of orc s , troll s , and giant s . The fortress - city was later used as a base for the Cult of Elemental Evil in 1491 DR .

title: Tyche
description: Tyche Tyche ( pronounced " TIE - key " ) was the original goddess of fortune . An ancient goddess , she was split into Tymora ( goddess of good luck ) and Beshaba ( goddess of misfortune ) before the rising of the Standing Stone ( 1 DR ) .

title: Tyche ' s touch
description: Tyche ' s touch Named for the ancient goddess of luck who was split into Tymora and Beshaba , Tyche ' s touch was a divine abjuration spell that granted either a protection or a curse to the target . Effects . The protection or curse from this spell lasted a day and either aided or harmed the target of the spell as circumstances affected them .

title: Tying Place
description: Tying Place The Tying Place was the name of a courtyard in Manass primarily used to stable horses and other pack animals . Uses . This courtyard was surrounded by stables and corrals .

title: Tyjit Skesh
description: Tyjit Skesh Tyjit Skesh was a guard on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Tyjit was quick to anger and quicker to use her two blades , but was also honest to a fault .

title: Tykkyl Burrwarden
description: Tykkyl Burrwarden Tykkyl Burrwarden was a shopkeeper in Skullport . Activities . Tykkyl , with his twin sister Tohkkal Burrwarden , managed the shop Clockwork Wonders .

title: Tyllaetha Silverspear
description: Tyllaetha Silverspear Tyllaetha Silverspear is a moon elf warrior and wizard , and as of 1368 DR , the matriarch of House Silverspear . Tyllaetha was an adventurer , and possesses the moonblade Thoerl , considered a symbol of the house . Tyllaetha keeps the heads of certain creatures she has slain in her study in the house ' s estate in Leuthilspar .

title: Tym Waterdeep Limited
description: Tym Waterdeep Limited Tym Waterdeep Limited was a large publishing business located in the city of Waterdeep . Structure . The publishing company was a large , converted warehouse .

title: Tymanchebar
description: Tymanchebar Tymanchebar was once a province ruled by rebel dragonborn in Abeir . It was destroyed during the Spellplague . History .

title: Tymanther
description: Tymanther Tymanther was a displaced section of the Abeir an , militaristic dragonborn - ruled state of Tymanchebar . Tymanther was located in the " Old Empires " region that was once southern Unther . The bulk of the dragonborn population resided in its capital , the citadel - city of Djerad Thymar .

title: Tymantheran ( dialect )
description: Tymantheran ( dialect ) Tymantheran was a regional Draconic dialect spoken by the dragonborn of Tymanther . Tymantheran words sounded softer than normal Draconic , a little more nasal and with words that had elongated syllables . Tymantheran dialect was based on the Draconic language from Abeir rather than from its Toril ian variant .

title: Tymofarrar
description: Tymofarrar Tymofarrar was a young white dragon who led the kobold tribes in the Nether Mountains . He sent the kobolds to attack Drogan Droganson and his pupils in 1372 DR . He held a mask artifact and wanted Drogan ' s apprentice to kill J ' Nah , who commanded the gnoll s in the High Forest .

title: Tymora
description: Tymora Tymora ( pronounced " tie - MORE - ah " ) , or more commonly Lady Luck , was the goddess of good fortune . She shone upon those who took risks and blessed those who dealt harshly with the followers of Beshaba . Should someone flee from her sisters ' mischievous followers or defile the dead , their fate would be decided with a roll of Tymora ' s dice .

title: Tymora ' s Fancy
description: Tymora ' s Fancy Tymora ' s Fancy was a high coin gambling establishment in the North Ward of the city of Waterdeep . Activities . The gambling den offered a fair and level field of play : no spell s , no magic items , no exceptions .

title: Tymora ' s coin
description: Tymora ' s coin Tymora ' s coin was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Tymora that , after an incident of extreme luck ( either good or bad ) granted the caster a double chance at an attack or to avoid harm within a brief window of time .

title: Tyr
description: Tyr Tyr ( pronounced " TEER " ) , also known as The Maimed God , was a lawful good greater deity of law and justice and part of The Triad . His dogma was primarily concerned with the punishment of wrong - doers , and the general furthering of law and good in the world . Not coincidentally , these values are among those held by most paladin s , many of whom were more than likely to follow The Triad , as the patron of paladins Torm is one - third of the coalition .

title: Tyra
description: Tyra Tyra was a female young adult black dragon who dwelled in the Vast Swamp in the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships . Tyra was the spawn of Skurge , the great dragon of the Tun Marshes , and the clutchmate of Despayr .

title: Tyran
description: Tyran Tyran the Outlaw was a bandit leader in Teshendale in 1368 DR . History . Tyran was a descendant of an old Teshwave family .

title: Tyrangal
description: Tyrangal Tyrangal was a copper dragon who lived in a large , heavily warded mansion in an abandoned section of Ormpetarr , in the guise of a human female . Tyrangal was the friend and mentor of the rogue Duvan . History .

title: Tyranny
description: Tyranny High Lord Kalahar Twohands orders the party to immediately return to the Fortress of the Eternal Despot from which they have only recently arrived back . New research suggests that a powerful artifact of evil lies underneath the structure and must be retrieved before Bane ' s clergy gets their hands on it .

title: Tyranny of Dragons
description: Tyranny of Dragons The Tyranny of Dragons was a Dungeons & Dragons storyline that began in August 2014 . A number of Dungeons & Dragons adventures were published under the Tyranny of Dragons storyline . The storyline also extended to the fourth and fifth Neverwinter modules , Tyranny of Dragons and Rise of Tiamat .

title: Tyranny of Dragons ( comic )
description: Tyranny of Dragons ( comic ) Tyranny of Dragons was a 10 - paneled comic released online to coincide with the Tyranny of Dragons event . Summary . The people of Icewind Dale are being besieged by dragon s , which are protecting a group of the Cult of the Dragon as they search for powerful Dragon Mask s .

title: Tyrantfog
description: Tyrantfog The Tyrantfog was a magical ritual , empowered by Iyachtu Xvim , that Fzoul Chembryl devised to save his own life . The ritual ' s effects affected much of the Western Heartlands , western Sea of Fallen Stars and south - eastern Tethyr . History .

title: Tyranthraxus
description: Tyranthraxus Tyranthraxus , also called the " Possessing Spirit " and the " Flamed One " , was a malign entity who stole control over the bodies of others to further its wicked goals . He was said to have been one of the Seven Lost Gods forced long ago to bow before Bane . Some sages have identified him as a type of yugoloth , though spells normally effective against such fiends have been shown to have no effect on him .

title: Tyrda Q ' Helvor
description: Tyrda Q ' Helvor Tyrda Q ' Helvor was Pommarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1362 DR , the Lady of House Q ' Helvor from 1359 DR , and the first woman on the council . History . She was only the head of a moderately successful family of pottery merchants from Esmeltaran before being chosen by the Iltarch for an empty position in the council .

title: Tyrluk
description: Tyrluk Tyrluk was a small village at the base of the Storm Horn Mountains in Cormyr . History . In 1368 DR , Tyrluk , along with Espar , Eveningstar , and Waymoot , was plagued by rogue dragon s .

title: Tystarn Dauntinghorn
description: Tystarn Dauntinghorn Tystarn Dauntinghorn was an unwitting spy for the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Tystarn was an expatriate Cormyrean noble who closely resembled Manshoon .

title: Tyvollus Aluviirsan
description: Tyvollus Aluviirsan Tyvollus Aluviirsan was a elf High Mage who was born during the time of the height of Cormanthyr . He transformed the stolen sets of the " Nether Scrolls " into the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , the " Golden Grove of Hidden Knowledge " . It was said that , for centuries after , he still watched over the Quess ' Ar ' Teranthvar , his body in stasis and his mind locked in " reverie " .

title: Tyzack
description: Tyzack Tyzack was a male human commander of the Zhentilar Company of the Scorpions during the Time of Troubles . History . When he was young , Tyzack tried to rebel against the Zhentarim and killed a young cleric of Bane in a little temple north of Zhentil Keep .

title: Tzakand
description: Tzakand Tzakand were the result of illithid tadpoles being inserted into lizardfolk . The tzakandi were used as personal guards and slave laborers . They were a race specific to the city of Oryndoll and were all made from the lizardfolk of Surkh by the Nourisher Creed .

title: Tzar - Su
description: Tzar - Su Tzar - Su was a malicious spirit in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Tzar - Su unleashed a gorgon he had created from the Qui Ren family ' s plowing ox inside the House of Qui Ren .

title: Tzindylspar
description: Tzindylspar Tzindylspar , the City of Rubies , was founded in - 1715 DR by dwarves of Delzoun and human s of Netheril . Geography . The mountain that marked the location of the city was unremarkable , one of many in the western Nether Mountains northeast of Silverymoon .

title: Tzirik Jaelre
description: Tzirik Jaelre Tzirik Jaelre was a high priest of Vhaeraun and member of House Jaelre . Description . He was short , stocky , and - - unusual for a drow - - bald .

title: Ualair
description: Ualair Ualair the Silent was the last High Mage of Myth Drannor . History . Ualair , in the last years of Myth Drannor , was the High Mage of the city and also the Master of the N ' Vaelahr , the shadow army of Myth Drannor .

title: Ubar
description: Ubar Ubar , also called the Lost City of Ubar , was a unique city found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . Ubar was the given name of the city in Jannti , the common genie tongue , but the desert giant s referred to the location as Dayya in their own language . Geography .

title: Ubriien Orlyn
description: Ubriien Orlyn Ubriien Orlyn was one of the most powerful magelord s of the kingdom of Athalantar . History . Ubriien was the first leader of the magelords , before Neldryn Hawklyn , and the first Royal Mage of Belaur Aumar , as which he dominated the nation .

title: Ubtao
description: Ubtao Ubtao ( pronounced " oob - TAY - oh " ) is the patron deity of Chult . He is also known as The Father of the Dinosaurs , Creator of Chult , Founder of Mezro , and The Deceiver . He stays distant from both mortals and other deities , and he seems to be above the daily doings of the world and his followers .

title: Udhask
description: Udhask Udhask was a deep gnome ghost in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . When the drow attacked Blingdenstone in 1371 DR , he tried to reach for his loot when he died of a heart attack .

title: Udi
