description: Udi Udi was a wandering wu jen in Bawa in 1357 DR . Activities . Udi wandered the wilderness of Bawa , trying to help the local tribes .

title: Ueda Teishi
description: Ueda Teishi Ueda Teishi was a retainer of the Goshukara clan in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Teishi was a supporter of Goshukara with a bad fortune .

title: Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin
description: Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin Uhlsrysn Xorlarrin was a member of House Xorlarrin and a master of Sorcere in 1479 DR . Personality . The drow had a prickly pride , always feeling himself inferior to his brother and he was easily provoked .

title: Uhndek
description: Uhndek Uhndek was the lizardfolk leader of the Khoroshen tribe , based in the marshland of the Evermoors . Uhndek had a crocodile companion named Dross . Appearance .

title: Uiss
description: Uiss Uiss was the leader of the Order of the Snake in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Around 1158 DR , the yuan - ti infiltrated the Order of the Snake .

title: Ukharim Grimshackle
description: Ukharim Grimshackle Ukharim Grimshackle was a halfling jailer at Grimshackle Jail in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Ukharim and his brother were only interested in money .

title: Ukolo
description: Ukolo Ukolo was a hamlet of Azuposi humans in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . It was the center of the Azuposi ' s turquoise - mining operation . Raw turquoise was exported from Ukolo to other settlements such as Michaca or Opallinoc , where it was refined into jewellery and other valuable items .

title: Ukulsid
description: Ukulsid Ukulsid was an undead male gnoll and the military commander of the city of Surcross in Thay in 1480 DR . He received his orders from Szass Tam himself . Ukulsid permitted Valindra Shadowmantle to use his city as her headquarters but only because this was the will of his master and Szass usually paid no attention to the elven lich .

title: Ulala
description: Ulala Ulala was a dustdigger and pet of the famed smith Jogaoh , protecting his home in the Sword Coast lands . When Vajra Valmeyjar , Cybriana , Timoth Eyesbright , Onyx the Invincible , and Priam Agrivar sought out the smith in the Year of the Prince , 1357 DR , they sighted a pool of sparkling fresh water and rushed into it . They were soon ensnared by the dustdigger , which dropped the illusion and tried to devour them .

title: Ulamyth Quantor
description: Ulamyth Quantor Ulamyth Quantor served as the High Priest , or High Torturelord , of Loviatar within the Tower of Pain Exalted in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Activities . High Torturelord Quantor supervised 14 fellow priests of the Maiden of Pain .

title: Ulark
description: Ulark Ulark was one of the river ports along the coast of the Sword River in the Sword Lands , Returned Abeir . Background . As of 1479 DR , the town was renowned as the merriest place in the Sword Lands , as well as for its brothels and swindlers .

title: Ulatha Mesavir
description: Ulatha Mesavir Ulatha Mesavir was an aquatic elf prince in the Moonsea in 1491 DR . History . Ulatha was captured by the marel Shelavassa of the Cult of the Crushing Wave , who planned to use him as a sacrifice .

title: Ulatos
description: Ulatos Ulatos was the only city of any size in Payit on the continent of Maztica . History . It was conquered by Cordell and the Golden Legion in 1361 DR .

title: Ulblyn Blackalbuck
description: Ulblyn Blackalbuck Ulblyn Blackalbuck was the proprietor of Blackalbuck ' s Swap Shop within the city of Melvaunt . Activities . Along with trading equipment and goods , Ulblyn was always looking for information and tips for which to trade .

title: Ulbrec Dinnesmore
description: Ulbrec Dinnesmore Lord Ulbrec Dinnesmore was a man from Neverwinter who became the lord of Targos in Icewind Dale . Personality . Ulbrec is known for his short temper .

title: Ulbror
description: Ulbror Ulbror was an orc chieftain of the orc kingdom of Vastar in the 6th century DR . In the Year of the Wyvernfall , 512 DR , Ulbror led an orcish horde out of Vastar and marched them east through many small passes over the Earthspur Mountains . They invaded the uplands of Impiltur , where they were met by a small army led by King Sharaun Mirandor .

title: Ulburto
description: Ulburto Ulburto was a man who lived in a small village on an isle near Phlan in the Moonsea region in 1489 DR . Activities . He ran the village ' s smokehouse .

title: Ulcaster
description: Ulcaster Ulcaster was a conjurer of note , who founded a school of wizardry in the small farming village of Beregost in the mid – 11th century DR . Roughly eighty years after the school was founded , Calishite mages came to fear the school ' s power and popularity . The school was destroyed in a massive spell battle and Ulcaster disappeared and was not seen since .

title: Ulder Ravengard
description: Ulder Ravengard Ulder Ravengard was the marshal of the Flaming Fists and the Baldur ' s Gate leading delegate at the Council of Waterdeep during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Ulder was a fighter , rising the ranks of the Faming Fists with the might of his blade and the sharpness of his wits .

title: Uldreiyn Starym
description: Uldreiyn Starym Uldreiyn Starym was a male elf and a former archmage of the Starym House of Cormanthyr who attempted to corrupt the raising of the " mythal " in 261 DR . He also slew Aulathar Orbryn in the rebellion . History .

title: Ulf
description: Ulf Ulf was a shaman of Ruathym in 1361 DR . Activities . Ulf was a shaman and religious leader of the Northlander s .

title: Ulgar
description: Ulgar Ulgar the Undying was a vampire who lived on Ulgar ' s Isle in the Pirate Isles . He became a vampire in Unther over 2 , 000 years ago ( as of 1370 DR ) , was banished to the island , and was later released by pirates . A lack of blood turned him insane .

title: Ulgar ' s Isle
description: Ulgar ' s Isle Ulgar ' s Isle , or Ulgar Isle , was an island in the Pirate Isles in the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was inhabited by the Chessenta n vampire Ulgar and his undead minions . History .

title: Ulgarth
description: Ulgarth Ulgarth was a feudal kingdom located in southeast Faerûn , east of Durpar and the Golden Water . Environment & Geography . Ulgarth occupied an area along the eastern shore of the Golden Water and north of the Great Sea , just before the barbarian - inhabited plains of the Utter East began .

title: Ulgoth ' s Beard
description: Ulgoth ' s Beard Ulgoth ' s Beard was a hamlet on the north bank of the river Chionthar , within sight of the Sea of Swords . It was home mostly to poor shepherds and fishermen . The purpose of the settlement was to warn Baldur ' s Gate of pending attacks or pirate raids .

title: Ulgrym
description: Ulgrym Lord General Ulgrym was the commander - in - chief of the Zhentilar and a member of the Zhentarim in 1370 DR . Relationships . Ulgrym was a member of the Council of lords of Zhentil Keep and the leader of the Zhentilar .

title: Ulgulu
description: Ulgulu Ulgulu was a barghest whelp from the planes of Gehenna . Description . Ulgulu was a huge purple - skinned goblin - like creature with glowing orange eyes .

title: Ulhro Luruth
description: Ulhro Luruth Ulhro Luruth was a shopkeeper in Red Larch and a member of the Believers during the Elemental Evil crisis in 1491 DR . Personality . Ulhro knew that he was prohibited to talk about the Believers to strangers , but he could be easily tricked .

title: Uligker Oloskar
description: Uligker Oloskar Uligker Oloskar was a merchant who dwelled in the city of Procampur in the Vast . Oloskar maintained a country house in the nearby town of Maerstar , and fled there following the chaos and disaster in Procampur during the Time of Troubles , 1358 DR , along with number of other merchants . However , they were harassed by looting mobs of refugees from Tantras , Calaunt and even Mulmaster , who ' d also come through Maerstar .

title: Ulin
description: Ulin Ulin was a priest and philosopher . Ulin studied and presented a theory that stated that things and people that one did not observe did not actually exist . In the Year of the Helm , 1362 DR , at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast , Koja fancied that if he ignored his secretary Foxe then he would disappear , in accordance with Brother Ulin ' s theory .

title: Uliset Faelgren
description: Uliset Faelgren Uliset Faelgren was a Harper wizard in 1489 DR . History . Uliset was crossing the Twilight Marsh near Phlan with a caravan when they were all killed by the black dragon Throstulgrael .

title: Ulitharid
description: Ulitharid The nobles of the Illithid society , the ulitharid possessed extraordinary gifts of strength , and a vile , malicious intellect and were treated as minor godly beings by their normal mind flayer brethren . The tadpoles that became ulitharid appeared normal , but were changed by some unknown force . The unique nature of the altered tadpole was not apparent until it underwent the process of Ceremorphosis , where the usual procedures of morphological alteration to the host body were altered and the resulting mind flayer displayed a pair of unusually long mouth tentacles not seen in other illithid .

title: Ulliam
description: Ulliam Ulliam was a cleric of Tempus in the village of Hlath in Chondath in 1358 DR . Activities . Ulliam took care of the Tempus ' s temple in Hlath together with acolyte Elspeth .

title: Ulmrin
description: Ulmrin Ulmrin was a rare half - orc fighter from Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Personality . Ulmrin loved to fight .

title: Ulnder Huntcrown
description: Ulnder Huntcrown Ulnder Huntcrown was a knight and a member of the Huntcrown noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr . She considered him a " young hotspur " . History .

title: Ulnorn
description: Ulnorn Ulnorn , blood of Jalabar was one of the dwarves who would found the kingdom of Roldilar in the Vast in north Faerûn in the 7th century DR . He was a warrior and a descendent of Jalabar . History .

title: Ulondarr
description: Ulondarr House Ulondarr Considered the founders of Semberholme , members of the Ulondarr clan have devoted their lives to maintaining Semberholme , following the appearance of the avatar of Corellon to their ancestors thousands of years ago . While some Ulondarr families can be found in Myth Drannor and Old Elven Court , the majority of them call Semberholme their home . Vesperr Ulondarr , a kind and benevolent elf who loves elven children more than anything else on Faerûn has led the clan for centuries .

title: Ulou languages
description: Ulou languages The Ulou languages was a grouping of related Faerûnian languages spoken in diverse regions of Faerûn , the most famous of which were probably Damaran and Netherese . The secret language of illusionist s , Ruathlek , was also a member of this language group . Languages .

title: Ulquar
description: Ulquar Ulquar was a jackalwere priest of Malar in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Ulquar heard about a room sacred to Selûne inside Undermountain where the lycanthropy curse was suppressed .

title: Ulraunt
description: Ulraunt Ulraunt was the Keeper of the Tomes of Candlekeep as of 1372 DR . He was known to be a proud and haughty wizard . Possessions .

title: Ulrich Eberhard
description: Ulrich Eberhard Ulrich Eberhard was the head of the Council of Ten in Phlan until 1340 DR . Activities . Ulrich handled most of the monetary negotiations of the Council and was a very hard bargainer .

title: Ultas Maernos
description: Ultas Maernos Lord Ultas Maernos was a human fighter and , in 1370 DR , head of the Maernos noble family in Waterdeep . Background . In his youth , Ultas was a mercenary and committed numerous atrocities against southern villages in order to make money for his family .

title: Ulthar
description: Ulthar Ulthar was the most patient of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ulthar was always busy sorting and filing ancient texts , maintaining the immeasurably vast catalog that organized them .

title: Ultoksamrin
description: Ultoksamrin Ultoksamrin was one of the subkingdoms of Deep Shanatar . After the dwarven kingdom fell , it was taken over by non - dwarves . Geography .

title: Ultroloth
description: Ultroloth Ulthroloths were the strange , enigmatic rulers of the yugoloths . These creatures held sway over their underlings by the force of their will and their reputation for cruelty . These ruling yugoloths appeared as faceless humanoids with large eyes that resembled fire opal s .

title: Uluik
description: Uluik Uluik was the language of the Ice Hunters of the Sea of Moving Ice . Speakers . Properly , Uluik was the High Ulutim language spoken by the westernmost ethnic subgroup of Ulutiun s residing on the Sea of Moving Ice , the Ice Peak , and the Cold Run .

title: Uluran
description: Uluran Uluran was a mountainous county in Kamlann in Tethyr . Description . Uluran also went by the names Shepherd ' s County , since most of its inhabitants were shepherds , and the Tomb Hills , since most of the royalty of Tethyr were buried somewhere underneath its mountains .

title: Uluruela Drael Tuabbar
description: Uluruela Drael Tuabbar Uluruela Drael Tuabbar was a businesswoman in Menzoberranzan and an agent of the Sept of Ill ' Ghact in 1479 DR . Personality . Uluruela was mentally controlled by the illithid s in order to guarantee that she never told anyone her true allegiance .

title: Ulutiu
description: Ulutiu Ulutiu ( pronounced " oo - LOO - tee - oo " ) , also known as The Lord in the Ice or The Eternal Sleeper , was the lawful neutral father of the giant - kin races and the god of glaciers , polar environments , and arctic dwellers . His domains consisted of animals , cold , law , ocean and protection . Ulutiu ' s symbol was a necklace of blue and white ice crystals and his divine realm was where he slept in the Astral Plane .

title: Ulutiun
description: Ulutiun The Ulutiuns were a grouping of related races of human s who inhabited the far polar regions of Faerûn . Description . Ulutiuns had dark , light brown , or yellow skin , dark hair , and dark brown eyes .

title: Ulutiun language
description: Ulutiun language Ulutiun was a language spoken by the Ulutiun people of the Great Glacier . Speakers . Ulutiun was spoken by the easternmost branch of Ulutiun s who lived on the Great Glacier .

title: Uluu Thalongh
description: Uluu Thalongh The Uluu Thalongh was a terrifying monster of Chult an jungle legend . Description . The Uluu Thalongh was an ancient , massive , intelligent , and baleful monster .

title: Uluvin
description: Uluvin Uluvin is a cross - roads for several trails , including The Iron Road , Secomber Trail , a track into the High Forest and a trail to the Stronghold of the Nine . In 1373 DR , under the effects of the Dracorage mythal , the drow - dragon Nurvureem unleashed her fury on this sleepy village of 600 or so farmers and cattle ranchers . The village is now a graveyard , home only to the risen dead .

title: Uluyara
description: Uluyara Uluyara was a drow high priestess of Eilistraee in Velarswood . Description . Uluyara wore mail and a green tunic .

title: Ulvaen
description: Ulvaen Ulvaen , also called amblygonite , was a soft but shatter - resistant fancy stone that was prized in the Realms . Description . This gem occurred in pale to deep yellow hues and was easily worked , even by the unskilled , into large cabochons or faceted gems that were popular in jewelry .

title: Umaerh
description: Umaerh Umaerh was a male drow lich sorcerer and an arcane devotee of Kiaransalee . During the Silence of Lolth , he was a resident of the Undying Temple in Maerimydra . Description .

title: Umar
description: Umar Umar , also called Umar the Patrician , was the governor and commander of the military forces of Port Ghaast in 1359 DR . Personality . Umar was a competent and intelligent commander .

title: Umar Hills
description: Umar Hills The Umar Hills were the foothills of the Small Teeth mountains on the north and south sides . Description . The Imnescourse Trail crossed through the hills , which were used for shepherding .

title: Umar al - Fennec
description: Umar al - Fennec Umar al - Fennec was an orphan and street urchin who lived in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Umar survived by stealing what he needed .

title: Umar al - Hadra al - Bazan
description: Umar al - Hadra al - Bazan Umar al - Hadra al - Bazan was an efreeti who lived within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire around 1367 DR . Activities . Umar was the leader of the Illuminated .

title: Umar al - Kushya
description: Umar al - Kushya Umar al - Kushya was an efreet pasha who lived in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Umar served in Zakhara as a representative of the Sultan of the Efreet , Marrake al - Sidan al - Hariq ben Lazan .

title: Umara
description: Umara The beautiful coastal city of Umara , or the " City of Knights , " lay at the mouth of Al - Yatir River , about a hundred and seventy miles northeast of Liham . Its appearance was marked by its distinctive blue tilework and textiles . In 1367 DR the outwardly peaceful situation was still stabilizing after a bloody palace coup by barbarian troops enlisted for a campaign against Muluk by the old caliph .

title: Umbarl Darlhoun
description: Umbarl Darlhoun Umbarl Darlhoun was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . In 1480 DR , Darlhoun was on duty in High Horn ' s garrison .

title: Umber hulk
description: Umber hulk Umber hulks look somewhat like a cross between a gorilla and a beetle . Their most prominent feature is probably the huge pair of mandibles , each roughly as tall as a halfling . Four eyes , one pair multifaceted , the other seemingly normal allow it to both see in the darkness in which it lives and somehow befuddle their enemies with merely a look .

title: Umberlee
description: Umberlee Umberlee ( pronounced " uhm - ber - LEE " ) , also referred to as The Bitch Queen , was the evil sea goddess in the Faerûnian pantheon . She was most often worshiped by sailors or people traveling by sea , out of fear of her destructive powers . She controlled the harshness of the sea while reveling in her own power and was not hesitant to drown people , if she so pleased .

title: Umbra
description: Umbra Umbra was the leader of the Dragonbloods , a Luskan gang . He was rumored to be a dragon but he was actually some sort of doppelganger . Umbra ' s face constantly shifted and his true form was unknown .

title: Umel Shorntooth
description: Umel Shorntooth Umel Shorntooth was a retired adventurer who lived in the " Royal Keep " of Mistshaws in Eskorn , Returned Abeir . Activities . In 1479 DR , Umel was searching for adventurers to accompany him , despite his advanced age , in an expedition to the ruins of Savanfast , which he had visited when he was young .

title: Umoja
description: Umoja Umoja was a druid devoted to Ubtao . Personality . Umoja viewed life as a maze , constantly looking for the best path through it .

title: Umpold Steinrut
description: Umpold Steinrut Umpold Steinrut , mostly known as Grumpold , was a dwarf in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . Activities . Grumpold was a regular customer at the Yawning Portal together with his brother Angus Steinrut , where they ate and drank .

title: Una el Shoon
description: Una el Shoon Una el Shoon was a Calishite woman who was the mother of Akkabar Shoon the Younger , Queen Arhymeria Ithal of Tethyr , and Amahl Shoon I . She was the daughter - in - law of Akkabar Shoon the Elder , being married to his oldest son .

title: Unaligned
description: Unaligned In 4th edition , an unaligned individual is one who is not taking a stand for either good or evil . It indicates someone who is not making an effort to be good , evil or neutral ; someone who is simply benign . Some unaligned people choose not to choose , because they see the benefits of both sides , but most them are undecided about alignment .

title: Unapproachable East
description: Unapproachable East The Unapproachable East is a border region between the northeast Faerûn and east Faerûn . The bounderies are usually defined as Easting Reach ( to the west ) , Sunrise Mountains ( to the east ) , Wizards ' Reach ( to the south ) and the Icerim Mountains ( to the north ) , right up to the Great Glacier . The region sports great adversity ; from the scheming Red Wizards of Thay to the boisterous barbarians of Rashemen , it is a place rife with conflict .

title: Unbroken Chain
description: Unbroken Chain Unbroken Chain is a standalone novel by Jaleigh Johnson set in the " Forgotten Realms " . The novel tells the story of Ashok , a wild shadar - kai of the Shadowfell who discovers Ikemmu , a city at the crossroads of the planes and the heart of his own struggle between life and oblivion .

title: Unburn
description: Unburn Unburn was an arcane abjuration / alteration spell that reversed the burning of an item . It was developed by Daltim Flamefist of Halruaa . Effects .

title: Unceasing vigilance of the holy sentinel
description: Unceasing vigilance of the holy sentinel Unceasing vigilance of the holy sentinel was an alteration spell that made a particular place easier to guard . Effects . This spell altered a spherical area 10 ft ( 3 .

title: Unclean
description: Unclean Unclean is the first novel of The Haunted Lands trilogy by Richard Lee Byers . Summary . In the country of Thay in 1375 DR , Druxus Rhym , the zulkir ( mage - lord ) of the Order of Transmutation , was assassinated in his home in Eltabbar , the capital city , by an unknown assailant .

title: Unclean ( Zakhara )
description: Unclean ( Zakhara ) The Unclean was a faction within the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Unclean were based in the fortress of Sarahin located deep within the Haunted Lands .

title: Undarl
description: Undarl Undarl was a male malaugrym wizard who posed as one of the most powerful magelord s of Athalantar and was killed by Elminster Aumar . History . In 224 DR , in the kingdom of Athalantar , Undarl killed Elthryn Aumar , the lord of the village of Heldon and a prince of Athalantar , and his wife Amrythale , but missed the Elthryn ' son Elminster .

title: Undead
description: Undead Undead is a term that collectively refers to once - living creatures which have been animated by spiritual or supernatural forces . All undead have darkvision out to 18m ( 60 feet ) . Undead have a wide array of immunities , including being immune to : all mind - affecting effects , poison , sleep effects , paralysis , stunning , disease , and death effects .

title: Undead ( novel )
description: Undead ( novel ) Undead is the second novel of The Haunted Lands trilogy by Richard Lee Byers . Summary . In the country of Thay in 1385 DR , the lich Szass Tam , the zulkir ( mage - lord ) of the Order of Necromancy and the self - proclaimed regent of Thay , met with his prisoner , Yaphyll , the zulkir of the Order of Divination , to discuss the War of the Zulkirs .

title: Undead bloodrose
description: Undead bloodrose The undead bloodrose was a rare flower that only grew within the inner portions of the Rose Garden located in the Battle of Bones . Description . As the name implied , undead bloodroses had petals the color of fresh blood .

title: Undead mount
description: Undead mount Undead mount was a necromancy spell that animated a corpse or the bones of an animal big enough to carry the caster . Effects . Possible mounts were dead horse s , mule s , camel s , oxen , griffon s , hippogriff s , hippocampi , and other beasts of burden .

title: Undead ward
description: Undead ward Undead ward was a necromantic abjuration spell that created a barrier that turned undead like the cleric ability . Effects . Undead entering the area of effect were subjected to " turning " as if by a cleric two ranks lower than the caster of this spell .

title: Undeath after death
description: Undeath after death Undeath after death was a divine magic spell available to priests of Bane , the Black Lord . It brought back a dying or recently dead creature as an intelligent undead with memories and personality intact . This spell was a jealously guarded secret in the upper echelons of the church of Bane and was only used on Banite faithful .

title: Undeath domain
description: Undeath domain The undeath domain is a deity domain that grants divine spellcasters undeath spell powers . They can turn / rebuke undead additional times per day . Deities with the Undeath domain .

title: Undeath to death
description: Undeath to death Undeath to death is a necromancy spell that destroys undead . Effects . The spell snuffs out the life forces of undead creatures , killing them instantly .

title: Underchasm
description: Underchasm The Underchasm was a huge canyon created by the spellplague in 1385 DR that ran roughly north to south from Akanûl to the borders of Halruaa . The chasm extended all the way to the Underdark . The upper Underchasm was home to many flying monsters such as dragon s .

title: Undercity
description: Undercity The Undercity or Eldercity was a ruined , underground city under Baldur ' s Gate , the remains of an older city that once stood there . It could be accessed through a trap - filled , monster - ridden maze beneath the city ' s thieves ' guild . Located in a vast cavern , the Undercity consisted mostly of broken - down shells of buildings haunted by undead .

title: Undercommon
description: Undercommon Undercommon was a trade language spoken by the majority of intelligent races native to the Underdark . Speakers of Undercommon included the aboleth , choker , chuul , cloaker , delver , drider , drow , duergar , dwarf , githyanki , githzerai , grimlock , kobold , kuo - toa , orc , rakshasa , roper , svirfneblin , and mind flayer races . Undercommon was written using the Espruar alphabet .

title: Underdark
description: Underdark The Underdark was the vast network of underground caverns and tunnels underneath the surface of Abeir - Toril . It was home to a host of evil beings driven deep into the caverns at the end of the age of demon s . Geography .

title: Underdark circle
description: Underdark circle The Underdark circle was a druid circle associated with life underground in the vast caverns and passages of the Underdark . Druids who took up the cause of nature in such a region had an affinity for this circle and the suite of spells that came to them without cost ( they could cast them at any time without having to prepare them in advance ) .

title: Undermountain
description: Undermountain Overview . This ancient dungeon started as a mine and dwelling of dwarves belonging to the Melairkyn clan . In the centuries since the dwarves were driven out it has been the home of drow , duergar , powerful wizards , criminal groups , and convicted felons .

title: Undermountain ( LGR )
description: Undermountain ( LGR ) A legendary manifestation known in the Delimbiyr Vale is heard singing inside the Yawning Portal of how Otar the Green Regent , whom the party has been tasked to find , is trapped in Undermountain by cyricists . Since Otar is the reason the party is in Waterdeep , they descend into the massive dungeon to find and rescue him .

title: Undermountain : Maddgoth ' s Castle
description: Undermountain : Maddgoth ' s Castle Undermountain : Maddgoth ' s Castle , written by Steven E . Schend , was released by TSR , Inc . in 1996 .

title: Undermountain : Stardock
description: Undermountain : Stardock Undermountain : Stardock , written by Steven E . Schend , was released by TSR , Inc . in 1996 .

title: Undermountain : The Lost Level
description: Undermountain : The Lost Level Undermountain : The Lost Level , written by Steven E . Schend , was released by TSR in 1996 . It is the first of three Dungeon Crawl adventures set in the largest , most dangerous dungeon in the Forgotten Realms , Undermountain .

title: Undermountain Alurlyath
description: Undermountain Alurlyath Undermountain Alurlyath was a wine crafted somewhere in Undermountain and sold through contacts in Skullport . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Underworld
description: Underworld The Underworld was a realm in the Spirit World , a land of unworthy dead and evil spirits punished by the Celestial Bureaucracy of Kara - Tur . Description . The Underworld was a realm of hells , filled with dark caverns that echoed with the anguished wails of the spirits bound there , out of sight of mortal eyes .

title: Undetectable alignment
description: Undetectable alignment Undetectable alignment was an abjuration spell that shielded the subject ' s alignment from detection . It was also the name of the reverse of the divination spell know alignment . Effects .

title: Undil Latheen
description: Undil Latheen Undil Latheen was a human male priest of Waukeen in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . He served as High Priest of the Hall of Success temple of Waukeen in Procampur ' s Temple District .

title: Undrek ' Thoz
description: Undrek ' Thoz Undrek ' Thoz was a confederation of drow cities , called segments , beneath Thay . The ten cities that comprised Undrek ' Thok were spread across the Middledark , each connected to the others by way of Portals . The Matron mother s that ruled were kept in check by a monastic order known as the Blackened Fist .

title: Undrentide
description: Undrentide Undrentide was a Netherese flying city that floated in the south east of their territory , near the western border of what was then the Eastern Forest . It crashed to the earth when Karsus cast the spell that momentarily made him the god of magic . It was buried under the sands of Anauroch and forgotten , until the medusa sorceress Heurodis discovered a powerful artifact that allowed her to reawaken the " mythallar " that powered the city , gaining its powers for herself but also becoming a lich in the process .

title: Undumor
description: Undumor Undumor ( previously known as Emmech ) is a fortress in Aglarond . It was built by King Brindor Olósynne and aided in the defence of Aglarond against invaders from Thesk . The fortress is situated at the mouth of the River Umber .

title: Undying Temple
description: Undying Temple The Undying Temple was a living temple dedicated to Kiaransalee in Castle Maerimydra . It was summoned by Irae T ' sarran during the Silence of Lolth . Location .

title: Undying patron
description: Undying patron An Undying patron was one possible sponsor for a warlock . If a bargain was made between a warlock and a mortal being who had conquered death in some fashion , the warlock ' s patron gave them access to certain powers , including a suite of spells that expanded the choices to fill their spell slots . Starting at 1st level , you learn the " spare the dying " cantrip , which counts as a warlock cantrip for you .

title: Undylyl Tessran
description: Undylyl Tessran Undylyl Tessran was a human woman of the city of Procampur in the Vast . She was a wizard and an ambitious young adventuress . Around 1358 DR , she was looking for adventuring bands to join or hire her .

title: Unearthly choir
description: Unearthly choir Unearthly choir was an evocation spell cast cooperatively by three or more priests in which they sing a dissonant chord for possibly devastating effect . Effects . Three or more priests were required to cast this spell simultaneously and they had to be within 10 ft ( 3 m ) of each other at the time of casting .

title: Unfailing endurance
description: Unfailing endurance Unfailing endurance was a necromancy spell that granted one or more creatures almost complete immunity from fatigue . Effects . The caster could bestow this boon on as many creatures as he or she had experience levels , but was required to touch them during the casting .

title: Unferth
description: Unferth Unferth was a member of the Kraken Society during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . The priest and his partner Ghald were the Kraken Society ' s top operatives in this part of the North , specialized in advancing the agenda of the society through theft , intimidation , and assassination .

title: Unger Farshal
description: Unger Farshal Unger Farshal was the proprietor of the Grinning Lion tavern in the North Ward of Waterdeep . He secretly worked for the Two - Cities Consortium , operating the drug markets weekly between Waterdeep and Skullport . He had been known to obtain bloodroot for Orlpar Husteem , a Waterdhavian noble .

title: Ungo - Ti
description: Ungo - Ti Ungo - Ti was a member of the Order of the Snake in Fochu Peninsula in Wa . Activities . Ungo - Ti wandered the peninsula searching for clues about a reemergence of the Order of the Mouse and promising candidates to join the Snakes .

title: Ungu Yakana
description: Ungu Yakana Ungu Yakana was an evil Wu jen in Ito - Jo in 1360 DR . History . Yakana entered in service of Ito family but secretly he worked for clan ' s enemies that payed him well .

title: Unholy aura
description: Unholy aura Unholy aura is an abjuration spell that grants protection against . It is the counterpart to the good spell " holy aura " . Effect .

title: Unholy blight
description: Unholy blight Unholy blight was a divine evocation spell unique to the evil domain that damaged good - aligned creatures . Effects . Upon casting , a cloying miasma of cold and greasy darkness spread around a point determined by the caster in a radius of 20 feet ( 6 .

title: Unicorn
description: Unicorn A unicorn was a mysterious and majestic magical beast resembling a horse with a horn protruding from its forehead . Description . A unicorn resembled a horse with a white coat , mane , and tail .

title: Unicorn ' s Bane
description: Unicorn ' s Bane Unicorn ' s Bane was the name eventually given to one of the " Qysari Rings " belonging to the wicked Shoon VII of the Shoon Imperium . It allowed the wearer to short - range " teleport " to within a few yards ( meters ) of a named individual , a member of a chosen race , or a specimen of a selected species . Description .

title: Unicorn ( Herald )
description: Unicorn ( Herald ) In the Heralds of Faerûn , the office of Unicorn was one of the High Heralds and the oldest and most revered . The holder of this office could set policy and his or her judgement took precedence in debates over Herald business , which could only be overruled by a unanimous vote from a quorum of the other High Heralds . By tradition , Unicorn had the first right to cry and judge all contests of honor , whether ceremonial , ritual , or personal single combat , except for those involving great cats or horses , mules and other creatures related to horses .

title: Unicorn Run
description: Unicorn Run The Unicorn Run was a river that started somewhere in the Star Mounts and joined the river Delimbiyr near Secomber . Bard s and sages passed down the tale that the headwaters of the Unicorn Run were , in truth , the Font of Life , and a cradle of fecundity . Each natural race was said to have emerged from the womb of Chauntea onto Toril at the river ' s source , and then traveled down the Unicorn Run to the outside world .

title: Unicorn pendant
description: Unicorn pendant Unicorn pendants were magical amulets embossed with the holy symbol of the deity Lurue . Description . Bearing the head of unicorn , a " unicorn pendant " could be made of silver or sculpted of marble with a gold horn .

title: Unidentified duergar fiddler
description: Unidentified duergar fiddler An unidentified duergar fiddler of Zortagra was in Elventree during the late 1480s DR . History . A duergar fiddler was afflicted by the demon lord ' s madness in the late 1480s DR .

title: Universal ( province )
description: Universal ( province ) In the Zakhara n view of magic , the universal province encompassed a number of spells that were not specific to the four elemental provinces of sand , sea , wind , and flame . Universal spells could be learned by all Zakharan sorcerers and elemental mage s , no matter their specialization . The universal province is not to be confused with the much narrower range of universal spell s that were not considered part of any of the nine ( or eight ) schools of magic distinguished by Faerûn ian magic - users .

title: Universal spell
description: Universal spell Universal spells were spells not associated with any school , though they were sometimes collectively called the school of universal magic . Only a small number of spells fit this description , including " permanency " , " prestidigitation " , and " wish " . They could be learned by all wizards , no matter their specialization .

title: Unknown Shrine
description: Unknown Shrine The Unknown Shrine was the name given to a ruined structure in the Eastern Plains of Cormyr . Location . The Unknown Shrine stood atop a steep - sided hill situated some 10 miles ( 16 kilometers ) east of the city of Wheloon and a few miles to the north of the Way of the Manticore .

title: Unleash monolith
description: Unleash monolith Unleash monolith was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This was an elemental summoning spell that brought an elemental creature to the Prime Material Plane .

title: Unluck
description: Unluck Unluck was a wild magic spell that allowed the caster to affect the forces of chance around the target , giving it a stroke of bad luck for the duration of the spell . Components . Proper casting of this spell required verbal and somatic component s and the shard of a broken mirror , which was tossed in the direction of the target and vanished .

title: Unnamed Dungeons & Dragons movie
description: Unnamed Dungeons & Dragons movie An unnamed " Dungeons & Dragons " movie is currently in planning and expected to be set in the " Forgotten Realms " . It is rumored to be titled Dungeons & Dragons : The Hand of Chaos . Production .

title: Unnamed Grandfather of Assassins
description: Unnamed Grandfather of Assassins A unnamed old man was the leader of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas until 1357 DR . History . The Grandfather allied with the lich - King of Vaasa Zhengyi and conspired with him to kill King Virdin of Damara .

title: Unnamed bandit leader
description: Unnamed bandit leader This unnamed bandit leader was a human bandit in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . When the Kalach - Cha came to the bandit leader , the leader was calm , as his plans had been foiled and had no power to resist .

title: Unnamed bandit sergeant
description: Unnamed bandit sergeant This unnamed bandit sergeant was a half - orc ish bandit in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North in 1374 DR . History . When the Kalach - Cha came to the building in the bandit camp , the Kalach - Cha could ' ve encountered this sergeant , who was not pleased and attacked .

title: Unnamed craftmaster
description: Unnamed craftmaster This unnamed craftmaster was a human in Fort Locke near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . In 1374 DR , the craftmaster was able to give the Kalach - Cha the many wonders and secrets of weapons , traps , alchemy , armor , and magical item crafting .

title: Unnamed lizardling shaman
description: Unnamed lizardling shaman This unnamed lizardling shaman was an inhabitant near the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The lizardling shaman was preaching to the followers of the Stone God when the Kalach - Cha and Bevil Starling entered the room .

title: Unnamed minstrels ( NWN2 )
description: Unnamed minstrels ( NWN2 ) These unnamed minstrels were human s who visited West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . The minstrels came to West Harbor to entertain people .

title: Unnamed refugee leader
description: Unnamed refugee leader This refugee leader was a human captive in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . The refugee leader was one of the bandits ' captives , who were held for ransom .

title: Unnamed shadow priest
description: Unnamed shadow priest This unnamed shadow priest was an antagonist of the unnamed graveyard near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . This shadow priest was located in the unnamed graveyard .

title: Unnamed wizard ( Bandit camp )
description: Unnamed wizard ( Bandit camp ) These unnamed wizards were human spellcasters in the bandit camp near the Mere of Dead Men on the Sword Coast North . History . These wizards were employed by the bandit leader .

title: Unquenchable
description: Unquenchable The Unquenchable , or abd Multahib , was an efreet organization within the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The Unquenchable were composed of 3 , 000 efreet who were fanatically loyal to their Sultan .

title: Unseen
description: Unseen The Unseen were a group of shapechangers , illusionists , assassins , thieves and evil creatures based out of Waterdeep . They were led by a greater doppelganger known as Hlaavin , who masqueraded as the Masked Lord , Nindil Jalbuck . History .

title: Unseen ( Zakhara )
description: Unseen ( Zakhara ) The Unseen referred to any elemental mage in Zakhara who wished to conceal the true nature of his or her power . The common factor driving most elemental mages to choose this way of life was the desire to remain hidden , and safe , from the Brotherhood of the True Flame . Activities .

title: Unseen aid
description: Unseen aid Unseen aid is a spell used by many sorcerer s early in their training . Using " unseen aid " grants arcane assistance to the caster , allowing them to perform a number of tasks with greater proficiency than they would otherwise be able to . " Unseen aid " is not particularly difficult to cast , taking only an instant to use and a rest of a few minutes or more to recharge .

title: Unseen servant
description: Unseen servant An unseen servant was a conjuration spell that performed simple tasks at its user ' s orders . History . This spell was created by the Arcanist Carbury in - 880 DR .

title: Unspeakable
description: Unspeakable The Unspeakable , or He Whose Name Must Not Be Spoken , was a yak - man who possessed the body of Mu ' izzi al - Kamar , in 1367 DR . Other yikarians referred to him as " Revered Master , " which is their term for a High Priest . Activities .

title: Unstrarr Troon
description: Unstrarr Troon Unstrarr Troon was a veteran member of the Purple Dragons in Suzail , Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Troon and other five Dragons acted as an escort for the War Wizard of Cormyr Ellard Gauntur in his pursuit of the renegade Rorskryn Mreldrake to Marsember .

title: Unther
description: Unther Unther was one of the Old Empires in eastern Faerûn . The Untherite were brought to Toril from Earth by the Imaskar Empire looking for some manpower . After countless praises , the gods of the Untheric pantheon were able to manifest into Toril by sending physical avatars .

title: Untheric languages
description: Untheric languages The Untheric languages group was one of the two major branches of the Rauric languages family and included languages spoken in both Faerûn and Zakhara . Subgroups . The Untheric languages included the Untheric language spoken in Unther and also those of the two language subgroups of the Midani and Alzho languages .

title: Untheric pantheon
description: Untheric pantheon The Untheric pantheon , originally housed on the plane of Zigguraxus . Brought over from another world by slaves imported into Faerûn by Imaskar . Like the Mulhorandi pantheon , the Untheric gods were initially barred from contact with their followers by a planar barrier erected by the Imaskari , however also like the Mulhorandi gods , they bypassed this problem by sending physical manifestations of themselves to Toril via the Astral Plane .

title: Unworthy of Ilsensine
description: Unworthy of Ilsensine The Unworthy of Ilsensine is a new organization , based underneath the Giant ' s Run mountains on the Dragon Coast . It is a cult dedicated to the worship of Ilsensine and is led by an Illithid cleric named Qooql . History .

title: Uplift
description: Uplift Uplift was a cooperative spell that allowed one priest to boost the spellcasting ability of another , temporarily granting higher level spells . Effects . Both priests had to be able to cast this spell , which took 12 hours to complete .

title: Upper planes
description: Upper planes The upper planes ( sometimes Upper Planes ) is a collective term used in the Great Wheel cosmology model to represent the Outer planes of Good alignment , located across the top of the Great Wheel . These are Arcadia , the Seven Heavens , the Twin Paradises , Elysium , Happy Hunting Grounds / Beastlands , Olympus / Arvandor , and Gladsheim . The World Tree cosmology model rearranged , renamed , and reorganized the upper planes into the Celestial planes but some people still use the older term to describe the good - aligned planes .

title: Upsen Downs
description: Upsen Downs Upsen Downs was a dwarven song and the name of the subject of the song : a mythical dwarven utopian town in a deep mine . Once the many formal verses had been sung , it was customary to improvise further verses , where each singer would take a turn to state their own wants from the imaginary town .

title: Upsetting onslaught
description: Upsetting onslaught Upsetting onslaught , also sometimes known as binding blast , is a spell used by some warlock s , particularly those of the dark pact . When " upsetting onslaught " is cast , the warlock casts a bolt of pure arcane power at a target of his or her choice within fifty feet . If the target fails to resist the bolt ' s effects upon their minds , they dazed into a stupor for a brief moment or take even greater injury .

title: Upstream Span
description: Upstream Span The Upstream Span was a bridge across the River Mirar in the city of Luskan . History . As of 1370 DR , Baliver ' s House of Horses was situated at the south end of this bridge , and at the north end was the North Gate , the northern entrance to the walled city .

title: Upvale
description: Upvale Upvale is the name of the area between Tall Trees and the Far Forest . This region , along the Delimbiyr ( River Shining ) , used to be an area with many farms and pastures settled by humans , but subject to frequent raids by orcs . It eventually fell under the control of Hellgate Keep until that location was laid to ruins .

title: Ur - priest
description: Ur - priest While the vast majority of divine spellcasters gain their powers from a deity , there are some who despise the gods . The ur - priests have learned to siphon off the divine or unholy energies granted by gods to their divine spellcasters , using it for their own needs without giving even lip - service to any god . Background .

title: Urathyl
description: Urathyl Urathyl was the Councilor of Zhentil Keep ' s Council of Lords in 1368 DR . Personality . Urathyl was loyal to Manshoon and the Zhent but if he can support also the Church of Bane .

title: Urbone
description: Urbone Urbone was a lizardfolk chieftain in Cormanthor . Activities . Urbone was the leader of a lizardfolk tribe that venerated Dretchroyaster .

title: Urd
description: Urd Urds were distant relatives of kobold s , with the power of flight , due to a pair of bat - like wings . They were frail , around 3 ' ( 90 cm ) tall with yellow to red scales and a pair of horns . Although they could live over a hundred years , life expectancy was only around fifty .

title: Urdlen
description: Urdlen Urdlen , also known as the Crawler Below , was a chaotic evil gnome deity . It took the form of a white mole , blind , hairless , sexless , but with claws of steel . A mindless force of evil and destruction , Urdlen was the only evil gnome deity .

title: Urdogen
description: Urdogen Urdogen was a pirate lord of history residing in Ravenloft . History . Urdogen was the successor of Immurk as lord of the Pirate Isles in 1204 DR .

title: Urdun Brizik
description: Urdun Brizik Urdun Brizik was a half - elf businessman and dancer in Mulmaster . Personality . The half - elf considered himself very lucky that Mulmaster ' s current situation permitted him to join his two interests into a profitable venture .

title: Urdunnir
description: Urdunnir The Urdunnirin ( singular : urdunnir ) were a long - forgotten offshoot of the dwarves . Their name meant " orecutter " in the urdunnir dialect of Dwarvish . History .

title: Urduthar
description: Urduthar Urduthar was a shadowslain cleric of Shar involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Urduthar was a cleric of Shar that chose to become undead to rise in rank within the Church of Shar ; and so he become the second - in - command of Esvele Greycastle .

title: Urgala Meltimer
description: Urgala Meltimer Urgala Meltimer was an innkeeper in Triboar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Urgala was a female human of Turami descent , with dark brown skin and black hair .

title: Urgrosh
description: Urgrosh An urgrosh , also known as a spear - axe , was an exotic two - handed melee weapon . Description . The urgrosh was much like the dwarven waraxe but with a longer haft , longer even than a greataxe but not so long as to be considered a pole arm .

title: Urgutha Forka
description: Urgutha Forka Urgutha Forka was a vicious demon that once spread a virulent plague in ancient times before the ancestors of the drow fled to the Underdark . The surface elves denied the existence of Urgutha Forka , preferring to blame the drow . The drow , when realizing they were immune to the lethal plague , enlisted Urgutha as an ally .

title: Urhur Hahpet
description: Urhur Hahpet Urhur Hahpet was a Red Wizard practitioner of necromancy and a follower of the lich Szass Tam . History . Urhur was one of the necromancers tasked by Tam with creating and commanding the marauding undead who had attacked eastern Thay in order to create fear .

title: Uridezu
description: Uridezu A uridezu was a craven , intelligent demon of the Abyss . Appearance . It appeared as a hairless rat - like fiend that walked upright with a long flexible tail and feral claws .

title: Urkamond Thond
description: Urkamond Thond Urkamond Thond was a wealthy aristocrat from Saerloon , Sembia , who made his fortune in the textile trade . Abilities . Urkamond was a sharp - witted fellow that made shrewd business deals in textiles .

title: Url
description: Url Url was a dwarven blacksmith and merchant in Mantol - Derith . Activities . Url usually sold weapons .

title: Urlgen Threefist
description: Urlgen Threefist Urlgen Threefist is a male orc and son of King Obould Many - Arrows . Background . Urlgen led some of his fathers forces agains the Shallows , which was ultimately levelled by the attack .

title: Urlingwood
description: Urlingwood The Urlingwood was a wood in north Rashemen . Inhabitants . The forest was the meeting place of the Witches of Rashemen .

title: Urlryn
description: Urlryn Urlryn was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . Urlryn once trained at Melee - Magthere under Ryld Argith and was proficient enough that Ryld remembered his name many years later .

title: Urlryn Khalazza
description: Urlryn Khalazza Urlryn Khalazza was the head of the College of Conjuration and one of the members of the Conclave of Sshamath in the city of Sshamath in the year 1372 DR . History . In 1377 DR , Q ' arlynd Melarn told the priestess of Eilistraee Miverra that Urlryn had risen through the ranks by poisoning all his rivals .

title: Urmas
description: Urmas Urmas was the busiest of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Urmas regularly kept in touch with all giant s community in Underdark using a vast network of magically augmented subterranean beasts used as messengers .

title: Urml
description: Urml Urml was a community of grippli at the far eastern end of the Wetwoods in the Shining Plains . Government . Urml ' s leader was the tribe mother Oluusious , a grippli aged nearly four hundred years old .

title: Urmlaspyr
description: Urmlaspyr Urmlaspyr was a city in southern Sembia that was notable mostly for its poor treatment at the hands of the shadovar . The city was supported by Cormyr and a significant amount of trade from that country flowed through its port . Urmlaspyr was blanketed by a layer of dark magical clouds conjured by a Netherese arch mage that was impossible to dispel .

title: Urn of the Blue Vishap
description: Urn of the Blue Vishap The Urn of the Blue Vishap was a unique Zakhara n magical item commanding a powerful creature . Description . This item was aptly named , being an urn richly adorned in gold and blue with themes from the sea with a vishap ' s head decorating its lid .

title: Urnalithorgathla
description: Urnalithorgathla Urnalithorgathla was a female wyrm green dragon that once laired in Spiderhaunt Wood in the Dalelands . History . Around the 1270s DR , Urnalithorgathla slew the Grimblades adventuring company in her lair , and left their bones amidst her treasure .

title: Urogalan
description: Urogalan Urogalan was the halfling deity of earth and death . His symbol was the silhouette of a dog ' s head . Urogalan was a gentle deity for a god of death , respected and revered by his chosen race but never feared .

title: Urophion
description: Urophion An urophion was created by inserting an illithid tadpole into a roper , resulting in these miserable creatures . They were used as guards and sentries . Description .

title: Urthag
description: Urthag Urthag the Knife was a infamous pirate who preyed on the Dragon Reach in north Faerûn around the early 7th century DR . History . Urthag somehow got his hands on Galathos , a magic sword forged during the ancient empire of Raumathar and lost many centuries before .

title: Uruma
description: Uruma Uruma was the oyabun of the Worthless Flower yakuza gang in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . Activities . Uruma directed all the operations of his gang from his veranda .

title: Uruth Ukrypt
description: Uruth Ukrypt Uruth Ukrypt was the king of the orc s of the Sword Mountains and led the orc invasion of Nimoar ' s Hold ( which later became Waterdeep ) in the Orcfastings War in 936 DR . Appearance . Uruth was a massive tusker .

title: Uruthkurt
description: Uruthkurt The Uruthkurt family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Uruthkurts were allied with the Aldimer and Mathlin families .

title: Uryuga
description: Uryuga Uryuga was an orc shaman in the Kingdom of Many - Arrows in 1484 DR . History . Uryuga was the high shaman of Gruumsh among the Many - Arrows orcs .

title: Urz Jaelre
description: Urz Jaelre Urz Jaerle was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Urz was a priest from House Jaelre who joined Malvag ' s plot .

title: Usamah
description: Usamah Usamah was a human corsair living on the various lands of the Great Sea in 1367 DR . Activities . Usamah was both the nakhuda and rubban of his sailing vessel .

title: Usilie Rostik
description: Usilie Rostik Usilie Rostik was a shopkeeper in Mulmaster in 1491 DR . Personality . Usilie was a very greedy person , always looking for some way to make a profit .

title: Uskevren
description: Uskevren The Uskevren ( meaning " too bold to hide " in some forgotten tongue ) were a noble family of Selgaunt who lived primarily in Stormweather Towers . Their house badge was a gold horse - head - and - fouled - anchor . Their money originally stockpiled through piracy , the family was nearly destroyed in the 1330s DR by rival families who discovered their illicit means of money - making .

title: Ust Natha
description: Ust Natha Ust Natha is a drow city in the Underdark under northwestern Tethyr in Old Shanatar . It is maintained by the drow as a symbol , marking the location of a nearby temple on the surface where the first drow descended underground ; its name means " the first " . The temple and city are fought over regularly by the drow and surface elves ( including at least those from Suldanessellar ) , though the silver dragon Adalon guards the area and tries to govern the hostilities , often succesfully .

title: Ust sreen
description: Ust sreen Ust sreen , meaning " first danger " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It put importance on fast reactions when danger was first sighted . Description .

title: Ustann
description: Ustann Ustaan was a small fishing village on the edge of Gbor Nor in Murghom . Description . Sitting on the coast of Gbor Nor , the small fishing village of Ustann was most famous for the Myrthard Clan of fishermen who lived there .

title: Ustilagor
description: Ustilagor Ustilagors were the larval stage of the development of intellect devourer s . They were considered a delicacy by the mind flayer s of Oryndoll . The Thrall Market sold ustilagors to visitors for high prices in several varieties such as raw , pickled or seasoned with fungi .

title: Ustova
description: Ustova Ustova was the most reserved of the librarians living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ustova spent all her time in meditation , sensing visions of the future that she transcribed on stone tablets .

title: Ususi Manaallin
description: Ususi Manaallin Empress Ususi Manaallin was an Imaskari human wizard and the ruler of High Imaskar in 1479 DR . Appearance . As of 1479 DR , Empress Ususi was a frail and weak old woman .

title: Utaqa
description: Utaqa Utaqa , located at the mouth of Al - Zulma River , was the northernmost of Zakhara ' s Free Cities . Laying almost 200 miles ( 322 km ) from its nearest neighbor , Hafayah , Utaqa ' s citizens felt on the edge of civilization , and took pride in their independence from authority .

title: Uth I
description: Uth I King Uth I ( full name Uth Myrmoran ) was a human who constructed Uthtower and became self - proclaimed king of a small port settlement on the Sword Coast North that would later become Myrmoran . Relatives . Uth ' s eldest son was Ornoth Myrmoran .

title: Uthagrimnoshaarl
description: Uthagrimnoshaarl Uthagrimnoshaarl , also known as the Dire Dragon , was an shadow dracolich who acted as the guardian of the Well of Dragons in Skull Gorge . Description . Uthagrimnoshaarl was a special kind of undead , a dracolich .

title: Uthalion
description: Uthalion Uthalion was a human fighter and former mercenary who lived in the Spur Forest with his killoren friend Vaasurri . Uth was something of a naturalist and enjoyed sketching plants in a notebook . He was best known for destroying The Choir cult .

title: Uthegentel Del ' Armgo
description: Uthegentel Del ' Armgo Uthegentel Del ' Armgo was the drow house weapons master of Barrison Del ' Armgo . Description . It was often said Uthegentel was the largest drow ever since he stood at over 6 ft ( 1 .

title: Uther
description: Uther Uther was a dye found in the city of Qadib in Zakhara . Uses . The city of Qadib was well known for its dyemakers .

title: Uther ( individual )
description: Uther ( individual ) Uther was the butler of the Society of Stalwart Adventurers in Suzail in the 1360s DR . Thanks to an irreversible spell cast by Danilo Thann , Uther looked like an Abyss al denizen . The Thann family payed him a large amount of money for the damage .

title: Uthgang Jyarl
description: Uthgang Jyarl Uthgang Jyarl was the head of the Tall Trees druidic order and the reputed Great Druid of the North . Not much was known of the goals of the druidic other than their desire to protect that portion of the woods that was once part of Earlann . Very few were allowed access to the Tall Trees enclave save a few allied Harpers , and notable figures of good , with whom they had some mutual alliance .

title: Uthgar
description: Uthgar Uthgar ( pronounced " UHTH - gar " ) , the Battle Father , is the god of the Uthgardt and physical strength as well as , by 1479 DR , an exarch of Tempus . Worshipers . Uthgar ' s followers consist of many human tribes collectively termed as the Uthgardt barbarians .

title: Uthgardt
description: Uthgardt The Uthgardt is a collective term used to refer to various human barbarian tribes who worship the deity Uthgar . Each tribe is named after a beast totem of Uthgar who mediates between the deity and his people . The Uthgardt are humans , often with black hair and blue eyes .

title: Uthgrael Aumar
description: Uthgrael Aumar Uthgrael Aumar , also known as the Stag King , was the founder and ruler of the kingdom of Athalantar until his death in 216 DR . Relationships . He was married to Niluembra and fathered seven sons , who became known as " the warring princes " , and was the grandfather of Elminster Aumar .

title: Uthor
description: Uthor Uthor was very high - ranking storm giant sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Uthor was the brother of king Hekaton at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Uthorn
description: Uthorn Uthorn was a doppelganger and a baron of the city of Calaunt in the Vast in 1358 DR . Activities . Together with Wenszrin , a fellow baron and doppelganger , Uthorn commanded the city ' s standing army , The Teeth of Calaunt , with all warcaptains reporting to the two barons .

title: Uthraki
description: Uthraki Uthraki were malevolent forest spirits in Rashemen . Description . The natural form of an uthraki was apelike , hairy , and gray - white .

title: Utter East
description: Utter East The Utter East was a land in the extreme southeast of Faerûn , bordering the continents of both Kara - Tur and Zakhara . It was home to the Five Kingdoms . Geography .

title: Utterdark
description: Utterdark Utterdark was a wine made and sold in the town of Bogbrook in Cormyr in the 14th century DR . Description . It was black and had a salty taste .

title: Utterdark ( wine )
description: Utterdark ( wine ) Utterdark was a wine made in the town of Bogbrook in Cormyr . Utterdark , or " black Bogbrook water " as it was known colloquially , was described as a black wine rather than a red due to its incredibly dark colouration . Made using a secret process , it tasted salty with a fiery undertone .

title: Utu
description: Utu Utu was the Untheric god of the sun . His manifestation on Toril was killed during the Orcgate Wars . His symbol was a sun disc .

title: Uwaji
description: Uwaji Uwaji was the shogunate capital of Wa , where the shogun lived and meet . It was one of the most largest and important cities of Kara - Tur . It was in Tsukishima , bordered on the west by the Ikuyu Mountains .

title: Uwan
description: Uwan Uwan has served as the leader of the Shadar - kai city of Ikemmu in the Shadowfell for twenty years . He is a mighty warrior and strong leader . Uwan has an extremely strong sense of justice and adheres rigorously to the law of Ikemmu .

title: Uxma
description: Uxma Uxma the Sorcerer was a wise elder in Maztica in 1362 DR . Activities . Uxma was a sage specializing in the fields of Maztican art and architecture , astronomy , Maztican history and folklore , and music .

title: Uyun al - Sartan
description: Uyun al - Sartan Uyun al - Sartan , also known as the Eyes of the Crab , was an island in Jazayir al - Sartan . Geography . The island served as a hatchery for giant crab s infesting the lagoon .

title: Uzbeg
description: Uzbeg Uzbeg was a village near the Lake of Mists in the Hordelands between Kara - Tur and Faerûn . Geography . The village was located along the Golden Way which connected the continents of Kara - Tur and Faerûn .

title: Uzurr
description: Uzurr Uzurr , also called the The City of Toiling Monks , was a city in Lapaliiya , which lay sprawling across three hilltops west of the Lapal Way , between Abreon and Lhazantal . Uzurr was a member of the Lapal League and one of the Cities of the Seabreeze . It was devoted to Ilmater , the Crying God .

title: V ' elddrinnsshar
description: V ' elddrinnsshar V ' elddrinnsshar was a drow city located on a mile wide island in the centre of the Moondeep Sea . The city ' s name seems to be composed of two drow words that have been given translation ( Veldrin and shar meaning concealment and mind respectively ) and thus the name could mean Concealed Mind or some variation there upon . Like most drow cities , it was dominated by the clergy of Lolth , but even her divine magic couldn ' t protect her subjects from the Ascomoid Plague .

title: Vaal
description: Vaal Vaal was a cloud giant count sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Vaal was one of the giant lords at the time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Vaalrik Redreef
description: Vaalrik Redreef Vaalrik Redreef was a sea captain in Luskan sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vaalrik a captain in the employ of the High Captains of Luskan .

title: Vaasa
description: Vaasa Vaasa was an untamed wasteland of frozen moors and tundra located in the Cold Lands of northeast Faerûn . Geography . It was a relatively empty land with sporadic farms and the occasional wandering monster .

title: Vaasurri
description: Vaasurri Vaasurri was a killoren who lived with his human friend Uthalion in a secluded grove in the Spur Forest . Like most killoren , he was highly attuned to the natural world . In 1479 DR , one of Uthalion ' s old friends , who was on a mission to rescue a young genasi from a cult , sought their aid as guides to the ruined city of Tohrepur .

title: Vadalma Tlabbar
description: Vadalma Tlabbar Vadalma Tlabbar was the drow matron mother of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR and and 1484 DR . Personality . During the Rage of Demons , she was fanatically devoted to Lolth .

title: Vaelis
description: Vaelis Vaelis was a young human paladin and Kalen Dren ' s first apprentice . History . At some point in 1479 DR , Kalen took Vaelis on as his apprentice with the intent of training him to be the heir to the Shadowbane title .

title: Vaelish Gant
description: Vaelish Gant Vaelish Gant was a wizard of the Arcane Brotherhood in Icewind Dale in 1485 DR . Personality . With his plot , Vaelish hoped to elevate his master Jendrick to the position of Archmage Arcane so he could replace him as Master of the North Tower .

title: Vaeren Dragonskorn
description: Vaeren Dragonskorn Vaeren Dragonskorn was a sky pirate . Activities . Vaeren had managed to repair an old Halruaan skyship that he used for his business .

title: Vaeril Rhuidhen
description: Vaeril Rhuidhen Vaeril Rhuidhen was a sun elf and a member of the Council of Elders in Everlund as of 1372 DR and also sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vaeril acted as voice of moderation and reason inside the council .

title: Vaerluth
description: Vaerluth Vaerluth was the easternmost goblin realm in the Rauvin Mountains in Luruar . Geography . Malauth was located in the caverns and foothills of the eastern Rauvin Mountains .

title: Vaerndoun
description: Vaerndoun Vaerndoun was a network of interconnected caves in the Underdark . Geography . Vaerndoun stretched for over 100 miles ( 160 kilometers ) northeast to southwest with the center point directly under the city of Torsch in southeastern Sespech .

title: Vahn
description: Vahn Vahn was a human arcane archer and one of a trio of adventurer s who arrived in Baldur ' s Gate as the Dark Alliance was rising to threaten the city . Abilities . As an arcane archer , Vahn combined the arts of archery and arcane magic .

title: Vahtov
description: Vahtov Vahtov was once one of the greatest cities of the High Desert of Zakhara . Inhabitant . During the mid 900s DR a motley group composed of dwarf nomads from the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue and human refugees from the House of Nasr joined together to excavate rumored gem and gold deposits beneath the Pit of the Ghuls .

title: Vainrence
description: Vainrence Vainrence was the second - in - command of the War Wizards of Cormyr in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Vainrence , together with the Royal Mage Ganrahast Aeiulvana , was imprisoned by one of Manshoon ' s servants in magical stasis in a crypt beneath the Royal Palace in Suzail .

title: Vairshekellabex
description: Vairshekellabex Vairshekellabex was a gray dragon who lived on an earthmote above Old Man ' s Head mountain in the Akanapeaks . He was allied with Tchazzar and with the help of Tiamat ' s clergy , he made it appear that dragonborn were attacking villages and caravans in Akanûl . This was part of Tchazzar ' s plot to convince Akanûl to join him in an invasion of Tymanther .

title: Vajal
description: Vajal Vajal the Dark was a member of the Shields of the Highland adventuring company in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Vajal was a Calishite man with dark , long hair and a well - trimmed bear .

title: Vajra Safahr
description: Vajra Safahr Vajra Safahr was the seventh Blackstaff of Waterdeep , a title she ascended to in 1479 DR when her mentor and lover , Samark Dhanzscul , was killed . Description . Vajra was diminutive , with olive skin , and short black hair , and indigo blue eyes .

title: Vajra Valmeyjar
description: Vajra Valmeyjar Vajra Valmeyjar was a female human fighter and a slave - warrior of the Arena of Blood in Manshaka in the 1350s DR . She famously escaped and went on to become an adventuress in Waterdeep and later even a duchess of the Kingdom of Tethyr . Description .

title: Valan Jaelre
description: Valan Jaelre Valan Jaelre was a leader of House Jaelre and the Jaezred Chaulssin . Physical Description . Valan wore fine robes and a house insignia of a sunburst with two dagger s pointing downward from it .

title: Valantha Moonbreeze
description: Valantha Moonbreeze Valantha Moonbreeze was a merchant in Elventree during the late 1480s DR . History . Valantha sold finger foods at a celebration for Mielikki at the Hall of the Unicorn in Elventree .

title: Valas Belaem del Pharm
description: Valas Belaem del Pharm Valas Belaem Del Pharm ( Valas , slave of Pharm ) the Black Raven was a half - drow slave of house Leun in Rilauven , he was lost in a bet to house Pharm who kept him despite the slave ' s considerable strength just to spite Leun . Pharm made Valas fight in the city arenas , where the latter developed his fighting style and became the city ' s greatest arena champion . Valas freed himself and fought his way through the Underdark with only his bare hands and the chains holding them .

title: Valas Hune
description: Valas Hune Valas Hune was a pragmatic drow scout and member of Bregan D ' aerthe . He was an accomplished guide of the Underdark . He became involved in a quest to solve the mystery of the Silence of Lolth .

title: Valas Jaelre
description: Valas Jaelre Valas Jaelre was a drow wizard who held the position of senior mage in an outpost of House Jaelre in Cormanthor . Duties . Valas was the senior mage in an outpost of House Jaelre , which served as a launching point for attacks against the Dalelands and followers of Lolth .

title: Valashar ' s Bane
description: Valashar ' s Bane Valashar ' s Bane was a ship in Cormyr ' s navy in the 4th century DR , sailing on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It was the flagship of the fleet and carried Crown Prince Azoun I , until it was wrecked and a sunk in a storm in 389 DR , taking with it many great treasures . Description .

title: Valashar ( county )
description: Valashar ( county ) County Valashar , or Lathmarch , was known as the " Gate to the Highlands " of Tethyr . Located roughly in the southern reaches of the historic kingdom of the same name , Valashar had a large population of monsters . Geography .

title: Valashar ( kingdom )
description: Valashar ( kingdom ) Valashar was a short - lived kingdom within the Shoon Empire . Geography . At its founding , Valashar extended from the highlands near the start of the Sulduskoon River north to the headwaters of the Amstel River .

title: Valdar Jaelre
description: Valdar Jaelre Valdar Jaelre was a drow priest of Vhaeraun in 1375 DR . History . Valdar was a priest from House Jaelre born when his house was still in Menzoberranzan .

title: Valdenar Octi
description: Valdenar Octi Valdenar Octi was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut and a platinum knight . Description . Valdenar had gold scales .

title: Vale of Lost Voices
description: Vale of Lost Voices The Vale of Lost Voices is a sacred burial place for honored elf warriors . Created on the spot where Venom ambushed and killed those who had killed his mate , the Vale of Lost Voices is now guarded by baelnorn s from the sylvan elf clan Audark . Over time this place has been used by other elves to bury their honored dead .

title: Vale of Shadows
description: Vale of Shadows The Vale of Shadows was a valley in Icewind Dale , lying a few hours ' journey northeast of Kuldahar . History . Tombs were built in the Vale of Shadows by the barbarian king Kresselack , the Black Wolf .

title: Valen
description: Valen Valen was a vampire and a mistress of Bodhi . She and two other vampires attacked Gorion ' s Ward just as they arrived in Brynnlaw , but were defeated . Not fully slain , however , she again fought Gorion ' s Ward in Bodhi ' s lair and was ultimately destroyed .

title: Valen Shadowbreath
description: Valen Shadowbreath Valen Shadowbreath was a tiefling fighter and weapon master . He was in the rebel drow encampment of Lith My ' athar in 1372 DR . Although distrustful of others , Valen made his services available to an adventurer .

title: Valerios Theokillos
description: Valerios Theokillos Valerios Theokillos was the Tharchion of Pyarados in Thay and a retired adventurer in 1357 DR . History . Valerios was a success adventurer in his youth ; it ' s said that he slew also an avatar of one of the Mulhorand god - king ; now Valerios was retired and appointed tharchion .

title: Valero Brokengulf
description: Valero Brokengulf Valero Brokengulf was a member of House Brokengulf in 1489 DR . Personality . Valero had a deeply hatred of Claugiyliamatar .

title: Valiant Mamluk Society
description: Valiant Mamluk Society The Valiant Mamluk Society , also known as the Valiant , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This mamluk organization specialized in engaging enemies with quick lightning strikes .

title: Valin Geldencross
description: Valin Geldencross Valin Geldencross was a diviner from Bryn Shander . Activities . Valin was hired by Elytharra Dinnesmore of Targos to locate a goblin headquarters when The Legion of the Chimera attacked in 1312 DR .

title: Valindra Shadowmantle
description: Valindra Shadowmantle Valindra Shadowmantle was an Overwizard of the Host Tower of the Arcane and Master of the North Tower responsible for the Brotherhoods operations in the northern quadrant of Faerûn . Later , she became an important player in the politics of rebuilt Neverwinter . Personality .

title: Valkur
description: Valkur Valkur ( pronounced " val - KURR " ) , the Captain of the Waves , was an exarch of Tempus , patron of sailors , ships , favorable winds , and naval combat . Worshipers . Clergy .

title: Valley of Dog - Men
description: Valley of Dog - Men The Valley of Dog - Men was nestled deep within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Inhabitants . A large colony of gnolls claimed this valley .

title: Valley of Exiles
description: Valley of Exiles The Valley of Exiles was nestled within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Compared to the other hidden valleys of the Kun - Yen Shan range , the Valley of Exiles is relatively easy to locate , though its exact location was kept secret .

title: Valley of Khedrun
description: Valley of Khedrun The Valley of Khedrun was a valley through which the River Mirar flowed from east to west , joined by the River Khedrun from the north , with the Spine of the World to the north and the Lurkwood to the south . It was filled with tall grass and dandelion s . Its eastern edge was about a hundred miles east of Mirabar .

title: Valley of Nanayok
description: Valley of Nanayok The Valley of Nanayok was a valley in the eastern end of the Koryaz Mountains of the Northern Wastes of Kara - Tur . By 1357 DR , the valley was filled with ruins , though mostly no more than heaps of crumbling stones shrouded in vegetation . It was believed to have been a center of Maraloi culture and politics .

title: Valley of Nexal
description: Valley of Nexal The Valley of Nexal was once the center of the mighty maztican empire and more than one million humans inhabited the cities and the center city Nexal on the island of the central lake itself . After the Night of Wailing the valley became a wasteland full with monsters and evil humans . The mount Zatal still errupted smoke and ash which coated the valley and made it impossible to farm the land .

title: Valley of the Dogs
description: Valley of the Dogs The Valley of the Dogs is a forested valley between Harkwood and Weathercote Wood , in the Fallen Lands , inhabited by two hobgoblin tribes called the Spittlemaws and Fistclenches . The two tribes are in a perpetual war over the area , though neither side can explain or remember why the valley is so important to them .

title: Valley of the Shan Sao
description: Valley of the Shan Sao The Valley of the Shan Sao was isolated deep within the Kun - Yen Shan mountain range in the Hordelands . Description . Heavy forests permeated this small valley .

title: Valls
description: Valls Valls was a town in Damara and the capital of the duchy of Arcata . It was situated in the southern part of the duchy at a tributary to the Beaumaris River at the north end of the King ' s Road . History .

title: Valmiki
description: Valmiki Valmiki was a poet in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Valmiki was a mediocre poet , that usually copied her poems from more famous artists .

title: Valon
description: Valon Valon was the commander of the centaur s in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . History . In 1357 DR , Valon and his fellows met Gareth Dragonsbane ' s party .

title: Valostar
description: Valostar The Valostar was an award bestowed by the city of Waterdeep for acts of service to the city . It was more of a lifetime achievement award rather than one given for single acts of service . The award was never given to members of the clergy as they were expected to serve without the expectation of reward .

title: Valsharess
description: Valsharess " For the word as a generic term , see Drow dictionary . " The Valsharess ( meaning " queen " or " empress " ) was the name adopted by a female drow who gained great power and influence after the binding of Mephistopheles , one of the Archdukes of Hell , and using the devil in her service . She was originally just another matron mother , and it is not known how she managed to bind Mephistopheles .

title: Valygar Corthala
description: Valygar Corthala Valygar Corthala was a specialised ranger ( stalker ) living in Amn with a particular dislike for magic . His parents had come to a tragic end after being corrupted by the power of magic , and his whole line family was cursed because of his infamous ancestor Lavok .
