Determined to leave no heir and to have nothing to do with arcane magic , Valygar was nevertheless forced to face both in 1369 DR when Lavok returned from the Planes to Toril in search of his last descendant .

title: Vamar Isahn
description: Vamar Isahn Vamar Isahn was a lich living in Serôs in Vamar ' s Tower . History . Born in 1247 DR , Vamar was a wizard in Starmantle .

title: Vampire
description: Vampire Vampires were one of the most feared and powerful undead creatures in Toril . Description . A vampire is an undead creature .

title: Vampire spawn
description: Vampire spawn Vampire spawn were undead created by vampire s . Description . Vampire spawn appeared as they did in life , though their features were hardened and appeared predatory .

title: Vampiric ( weapon quality )
description: Vampiric ( weapon quality ) Vampiric was a quality that could be applied to weapons . When the weapon struck an opponent , there was a chance that some of the opponent ' s life energy was drained and transferred to the wielder . The effects on the wielder disappeared after about an hour .

title: Vampiric dragon
description: Vampiric dragon A vampiric dragon was a type of undead dragon with vampirism . It was created when another vampiric dragon fully drained the life energy from a living dragon . They desired only evil and death , and were fond of spreading tales of their treasure to lure unwitting adventurers to feed upon .

title: Vampiric embrace
description: Vampiric embrace Vampiric embrace is a simple but deadly spell used most often by infernal pact warlock s , though other warlocks may also learn it . When cast " vampiric embrace " allows its caster to extend a strand of necrotic energy into the life force of a creature within twenty - five feet , sapping its vitality to temporarily fuel the warlock ' s own . The potency of the spell is largely determined by the warlock ' s regular health , and those of the infernal pact use an even deadlier version of the spell .

title: Vandathra Paleme
description: Vandathra Paleme Vandathra Paleme was a cleric from Neverwinter . History . Vandathra originated from a Neverwintan family with elven blood .

title: Vander
description: Vander Vander was a firbolg , once an assassin of the Night Masks and later a companion of Cadderly Bonaduce and his friends . Description . Vander had red hair and beard , was about twelve feet tall and weighed over 800 pounds , being thick - muscled and bearing scars of many battles .

title: Vander Stillhawk
description: Vander Stillhawk Vander Stillhawk is a human ranger and a major character in the realm of Tethyr . He was a companion to Queen Zaranda Star before her ascension to the crown . Vander is tall and spare with long muscles that seem to have been carved of oak and then weathered dark .

title: Vandover
description: Vandover The Vandover family was a noble merchant family of the city of Tantras in the Vast . The head of the family sat on the High Council that governed Tantras . In 1358 DR , shortly after the Time of Troubles , the Vandovers were allied with the Channath , Elovear , Laranadda , and Tithlin families .

title: Vane
description: Vane Vane was a member in the Golden Legion and a companion of the officer Alvarro . History . Vane took part in the Maztica n expedition as one of the cavalry .

title: Vanesci Hamlet
description: Vanesci Hamlet Vanesci Hamlet , or simply Vanesci , was a town in Konigheim in the Utter East of southeast Faerûn . It lay outside the Phantom Pass , which connected it to the Kingdom of Nix on the Forbidden Plateau . Description .

title: Vangerdahast Aeiulvana
description: Vangerdahast Aeiulvana Vangerdahast Aeiulvana was the former Royal Court Wizard of Cormyr who was responsible for the awakening of Nalavarauthatoryl and the returning of the goblin s of Grodd . Vangerdahast was perhaps the greatest mage to have ever taken up the mantle of Mage Royal . For decades he controlled the Kingdom of Cormyr , in fact if not in title .

title: Vanifer
description: Vanifer Vanifer is the Prophet of Fire and leader of the Cult of the Eternal Flame . She is extremely manipulative , gathering allies as she needs them and discarding them as soon as they lose their usefulness . Though she puts on the airs of a rich noble , she she despises those born into wealth .

title: Vanilla
description: Vanilla Vanilla was a delicate spice from Maztica . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Vanish
description: Vanish Vanish is a wizard spell that causes an object to vanish and optionally reappear in another location . It cannot be used on creatures or magical forces . The more powerful the caster , the larger and heavier an object can be made to vanish , but if the caster attempts an object beyond his or her power , the spell fails .

title: Vankila Slab
description: Vankila Slab The Vankila Slab is prison in the sky . Built by a joint effort of the Houses of Amn , it had been constructed on a barren mote , a massive slab of earth floating above Murandinn . The ogres who were charged with running the prison were given enough gold and slave labor to construct four sky - scraping round towers connected by raised walkways .

title: Vannak
description: Vannak Vannak ran a camp near Spellgard . History . Vannak was a dragonborn of a prominent clan .

title: Vanquisher
description: Vanquisher Vanquisher was a title used by a dragonborn ruler of Tymanther , equivalent to both a monarch and a general . The Vanquisher were also the leaders of the Adjudicators . < ref name = " AotT / Hardcover - p61 , 145 " > < / ref > A Vanquisher governed for a period of ten years , after which a new Vanquisher was elected .

title: Vanquo
description: Vanquo Vanquo was a mind flayer in the Vast region . Personality . Its main goal was to acquire artifacts from the Elemental Plane of Earth .

title: Vansi Bloodscar
description: Vansi Bloodscar Vansi Bloodscar was the female leader of the Many - Arrows contingent in Neverwinter . History . Vansi , a powerful spellscar red orc warrior , was chosen by King Obould XVII to guide the Many - Arrows contingent in Neverwinter following the rebuilding of the city after the Spellplague .

title: Vaprak
description: Vaprak Vaprak was a lesser deity and the patron deity of ogre s . Othea , mother of giant s , had an affair with him , which led to the birth of the ogre race . Vaprak was located in the Abyss on the layer of Shatterstone .

title: Var ( tribe )
description: Var ( tribe ) The Var were a strong dangerous tribe of Nar found in western Narfell and Damara . They measured 2 , 400 strong in 1357 DR . Activities .

title: Var the Drowned
description: Var the Drowned Var the Drowned was an area once known as Var the Golden . This land was drowned in 1385 DR . Geography .

title: Var the Golden
description: Var the Golden Var the Golden , or simply Var , was a peninsula in the far south - eastern region of Faerûn . In front of it sat Ulgarth . Its name came from huge quantities of wheat fields found throughout the land .

title: Varden
description: Varden Varden was a male human thief living in Scardale during the Time of Troubles . History . Varden was a successful thief in Scardale Town until in 1358 the god Bane , after the Battle of Shadowdale , ordered the Zhentilar armies to conquer Scardale in order to then threaten Tantras .

title: Varen Malavhan
description: Varen Malavhan Varen Malavhan was a mercenary recruiter in Westgate . Activities . Varen was the chief recruiting and propaganda officer and treasurer of the Mercenaries ' Guild of Westgate .

title: Vargo Kent
description: Vargo Kent Vargo Kent was a member of the Cult of the Dragon who had devoted his life to dragon s , specifically black dragon s . History . He was tasked with the construction of their citadel at the Well of Dragons .

title: Vargouille
description: Vargouille Vargouilles were denizens of the lower planes , some of which were trapped in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Lands . Summoned to Zakhara during ages past for an unknown purpose , these creatures were usually found within the Haunted Lands or Ruined Kingdoms .

title: Variance Amatick
description: Variance Amatick Variance Amatick was a shade cleric of Shar at the Fane of Shar in Thultanthar . Description . She had gray black skin and black hair .

title: Variath
description: Variath Variath was a powerful druid in the Chondalwood in 1358 DR . Activities . Variath governed a section of Chondalwood .

title: Variscite
description: Variscite Variscite , also known as lucinite and peganite , was an ornamental stone found in nodules or in rock seams . Description . This stone was translucent and came in deep to pale shades of yellowish green .

title: Varorn Irrymgalis
description: Varorn Irrymgalis Varorn Irrymgalis was an elf steward in Myth Drannor . Activities . Varorn was the Steward of the Southern Gate of the city .

title: Varramzord
description: Varramzord Varramzord , also known as Varram the White , was a male gold dwarf and the White Dragon Wrymspeaker in the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . Personality . Owing to his past experience , Varram hated the Red Wizards of Thay and despised the fact that Severin had allied with them .

title: Varrdig
description: Varrdig Varrdigs , or fluid brutes , were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Water . Description . These creatures assumed multiple forms depending on the situation .

title: Varriel
description: Varriel Varriel was a Red Wizard of Thay in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Varriel discovered notes about a necromancer ' s laboratory inside Undermountain .

title: Varscona
description: Varscona Varscona was an enchanted longsword . It was of a type of sword used by Sharran priests during the sacrificial rites conducted during Feast of the Moon ceremonies . Accoriding to legend , this sword was placed within the chest of its ritually mummified owner , who was to be exhumed and born again in some new form .

title: Vartain
description: Vartain Vartain was a widely traveled riddlemaster originally from Calimport . Description . Vartain was bald .

title: Vartha Do ' Urden
description: Vartha Do ' Urden Vartha Do ' Urden was the mother and predecessor of Malice Do ' Urden , matron mother of House Do ' Urden . History . Vartha Do ' Urden was the matron mother of House Do ' Urden when she suffered a sudden death in the tenth century DR .

title: Varyth
description: Varyth County Varyth was a region of lush farmland in Tethyr but also struggled with an elevated monster population . Geography . Varyth was a member of the Crown Lands .

title: Varytha Gheldieg
description: Varytha Gheldieg Varytha Gheldieg was a member of the Gheldieg family and lived on an estate in Eshpurta as of early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . . She was also a necromancer and a member of the Cowled Wizards .

title: Vasen Cale
description: Vasen Cale Vasen Cale was the son of Erevis Cale and Varra . History . Vasen Cale was conceived in 1374 DR , to Varra and the shade assassin , Erevis Cale .

title: Vast Swamp
description: Vast Swamp The Vast Swamp was an area of swampland in interior Faerûn that lay between Cormyr to its west and Sembia to its east . It was widely thought of as the most dangerous stretch of wilderness in the land . Ignored by surrounding nations , it had no proper name ; " vast swamp " appears to be a nickname that stuck .

title: Vast Swamp geyser
description: Vast Swamp geyser There was an unnamed geyser in the Vast Swamp of Cormyr where the Sharptooth lizardfolk tribe made their encampment . Geography . The geyser lay in a somewhat drier part of the western swamp , where the marshy ground gave way to an area of wet gravel , mud , and even bare rock .

title: Vastar
description: Vastar Vastar was an orc kingdom that occupied the lands later known as the Vast , between Cormanthyr and Impiltur in north Faerûn . It was founded " circa " −700 DR and fell in 610 DR . History .

title: Vataqatal
description: Vataqatal Vataqatal was the Zakhara n war god . He wanted his followers to grow by testing their strength of body and will and preached the importance of duty . He was a local god worshiped mainly in the northern parts of the Land of Fate that bordered on foreign lands .

title: Vattick Tanthul
description: Vattick Tanthul Prince Vattick Tanthul was a male shade human of Thultanthar , the City of Shade . Relationships . He was the twin brother of Prince Mattick Tanthul .

title: Vault of Cloaked Midnight
description: Vault of Cloaked Midnight The Vault of Cloaked Midnight was a temple of Vhaeraun in Ultoksamrin around which a settlement of followers of the same deity did grow . It was led by Vokkrzyr Rualfren , a cleric of Vhaeraun . Structure .

title: Vault of the Word of the Loregiver
description: Vault of the Word of the Loregiver The Vault of the Word of the Loregiver was part of the complex of the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Contained within this vault was the oldest known recorded copy of the Word of the Loregiver , created by the first Grand Caliph .

title: Vaustal Urle
description: Vaustal Urle Vaustal Urle was a female human cleric of Helm who resided in Hillsfar and would occasionally help adventurers . Abilities . As a highly experienced cleric of Helm , Vaustal could request some of the most powerful divine spell s from her deity .

title: Vaxall
description: Vaxall Vaxall , also known as Vaxall of the Dying Gaze and as Xavlal to the Zhentarim , was one of the oldest beholder s in Faerûn . Relationships . Vaxall was a lesser agent of the Twisted Rune .

title: Vedoran
description: Vedoran Vedoran was an accomplished Shadar - kai warrior from Ikemmu in the Shadowfell . Although most inhabitants of Ikemmu worhip Tempus , Vedoran didn ' t have strong faith in any god . He utilized Beshaba ' s temple for healing and schemed with Traedis , Beshaba ' s priest , to start an uprising in the city .

title: Veera Wavecrest
description: Veera Wavecrest Veera Wavecrest was a female Chondathan human rogue sorceress and a pirate from the Vilhon Reach in the 14th century DR . History . Veera was a pirate captain of the Vilhon Reach who venerated both Umberlee and Mystra , thanks to her sorcerous powers .

title: Vees
description: Vees Vees was a firesoul genasi guard in Neverwinter . History . Vees was always in the employ of Sala Nidris and followed her and her son Zan Nidris to Neverwinter .

title: Veesh Restoon
description: Veesh Restoon Veesh Restoon was a member of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Waterdeep around 1370 DR . Activities . Veesh ' s role on her team was as sneak attack specialist .

title: Vegepygmy
description: Vegepygmy Vegepygmies , also known as moldies , mold folk or mold men , were fungus creatures that lived in dark forests or underground , hunting for sustenance and spreading the spores from which they reproduced . They were spawned from dead humanoid s or giant s that were killed by a type of mold commonly known as russet mold . Society .

title: Vehlarr
description: Vehlarr Vehlarr was a natural werewolf and accomplished sorcerer who was favoured by Malar and Sehanine . With their help , he organized the packs of werewolves in the Wood of Sharp Teeth and formed the city of Vehlarr within the forest . Myth Lharast .

title: Vehlarr ( city )
description: Vehlarr ( city ) Vehlarr was a city named after its creator , the werewolf Vehlarr , who united the werewolf packs of the Wood of Sharp Teeth into a single nation . The city was the site of the Circle of Vehlarr , a magic portal into the city of Myth Lharast , until the deity Selûne destroyed both cities in 720 DR , after being angered by the warfare between them . Rumours .

title: Vekkak
description: Vekkak Vekkak was an Iulutiun village on the shore of Lake Risuak . Its claim to fame was that its " iquemelum " ( council of elders ) was particularly adept at predicting the weather . Geography .

title: Vel ' Nikeryma
description: Vel ' Nikeryma The Vel ' Nikeryma ( or Blade Lords ) was the organization that acted as the guiding council for the Eldreth Veluuthra . Its purpose was to gather information from across Faerûn in order to dictate the direction of the Eldreth Veluuthra but , in general , they avoided intervention in individual cells ' matters . Organization .

title: Veladar ' s vambrace
description: Veladar ' s vambrace Veladar ' s vambrace was an alteration spell that repaired , preserved , and strengthened inorganic materials . Effects . One item no bigger than the caster ' s body could be enchanted by this spell .

title: Velandilmur
description: Velandilmur Velandilmur was a port town of the kingdom of Gontal . Government . As of 1479 DR , the Docklord Lantra Orhond administered the town on behalf of Queen Imreera Hethkantan .

title: Velantha Waerdar
description: Velantha Waerdar Velantha Waerdar was a cleric of Tymora in Yartar in 1370 DR . Activities . Velantha was the high priestess of the temple of Tymora in the city .

title: Velarswood
description: Velarswood Velarswood ( also known as Velarwood ) was a wood near the centre of Harrowdale . Geography . The north of the wood contained a temple to Eilistraee , which was guarded by a number of drow .

title: Velartree
description: Velartree Velartree was a hamlet in Harrowdale , and marked the start of the Halfaxe Trail to the north west , and the Harrow Ride to the south east . As of 1374 DR , it consisted of a market paddock , an inn - and - tavern , a mill , a smith , and a small number of residences , including boarding for seasonal farm hands .

title: Velasta T ' sarran
description: Velasta T ' sarran Velasta T ' sarran was a female drow cleric of Kiaransalee and one of the twin nieces of Dorina T ' sarran . Description . A strongly built female drow , Velasta had a rounder face than most other drow .

title: Velathalar Muirdraevrel
description: Velathalar Muirdraevrel Velathalar Muirdraevrel was an elf warrior in Myth Drannor . History . In 1487 DR , during heavy fighting against Sembia n mercenaries , Velathalar met again Storm Silverhand , together with Arclath Delcastle and Amarune Whitewave .

title: Velcuthimmorhar
description: Velcuthimmorhar Velcuthimmorhar ( also known as Hephaestus ) was a red wyrm living in the mountains west of Mirabar , where he has resided for longer than even the dwarves can remember . The name " Hephaestus " was given to the dragon in reference to some obscure god of blacksmiths . He earned his considerable pay by melting ores for merchants .

title: Veldyskar
description: Veldyskar Veldyskar was an intelligent basilisk living in Gravenhollow during the Rage of Demons . History . A stone giant visitor to Gravenhollow donated Veldyskar to the keepers of the library to act as a guardian and general - purpose helper untold years before .

title: Velen
description: Velen Velen was a coastal city near Tethyr . It was a naval outpost , protecting against the Nelanther pirates . In addition , owing to its coastal location , it was also home to a large seafaring and fishing community .

title: Velgor Zolond
description: Velgor Zolond Velgor Zolond was a drow mage in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , Velgor was the second - in - command of Ryzliir Symryvvin in leading a drow battalion to intercept an expedition led by some adventurers hired by Bruenor Battlehammer to investigate the threat of a demon lord , but she and her troops were defeated .

title: Velina T ' sarran
description: Velina T ' sarran Velina T ' sarran was a female drow cleric of Kiaransalee and one of the twin nieces of Dorina T ' sarran . Description . A strongly built female drow , Velina had a rounder face than most other drow .

title: Velkryst
description: Velkryst Velkryst was the house patron of House Baenre and the mate of matron mother Quenthel Baenre circa 1484 DR . History . The drow wizard was a former member of House Xorlarrin .

title: Velkynvelve
description: Velkynvelve Velkynvelve ( drow for " unseen knife " ) was a small drow outpost of the great city of Menzoberranzan , specifically used to collect slaves captured in various raids before taking them to the city as workers or sacrifices to Lolth . History . During the Rage of Demons , the commander of the outpost was Ilvara Mizzrym of House Mizzrym and her senior officials were Shoor Vandree and Asha Vandree of House Vandree and Jorlan Duskryn of House Duskryn .

title: Velsharoon
description: Velsharoon Velsharoon ( pronounced " VEL - shah - roon " ) , the Archmage of Necromancy , was a god of necromancy . History . Velsharoon was once a lich wizard who , with the sponsorship of the deity Talos , managed to ascend to godhood .

title: Veltalar
description: Veltalar Veltalar ( formerly Velprintalar ) was a settlement in Aglarond and the nation ' s primary port in 1479 DR , with a population of around seventy thousand . It was founded by human colonists from Chessenta in 756 DR . The population of Veltalar rose from around 35 , 000 in 1368 DR , to around 66 , 000 in 1374 DR , then around 70 , 000 by 1479 DR .

title: Velvet Hands
description: Velvet Hands The Velvet Hands were a thieves ' guild in Hastarl in the ancient kingdom of Athalantar , formed by the thief Farl and his best friend , the young Elminster Aumar . History . In the years between 224 DR and 229 DR , Elminster , under the alias " Eladar the Dark " , and Farl were two of the most notorious thieves of Hastarl .

title: Ven
description: Ven The Ven was the title of the ruler of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The Ven was elected by the members of the Council , consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords , from among their number . Each Ven served for a 10 - year term , in which their word was law , though unpopular Ven tended to die prematurely .

title: Ven ' s Voice
description: Ven ' s Voice The Ven ' s Voice was the title of the chief advisor and spokesperson of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast . The Ven ' s Voice was elected by the members of the Council , consisting of Tsurlagol ' s highest noble s and leading merchant lords , from among their number . The Voice served as a spokesperson both for the Council and for the Ven , the secret ruler of the city .

title: Venali Starym
description: Venali Starym Lord Venali Starym was clan heir of the Starym clan , holding the post while the proper heir , Josidiah Starym had left on a quest to find the lost Warblade of Cormanthyr ( Josidiah was gone from 500 DR until 674 DR ) . He later served on the Council of Twelve as a House Lord of the clan . Venali was the first son of Illitran Starym , who made a pact with Moander in order to fool the family Moonblade in 523 DR .

title: Vendariiq Memtyn
description: Vendariiq Memtyn Vendariiq Memtyn was a leading member of the derro Council of Savants and the " high priest " of Diirinka in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Despite his role as the main caretaker of the worship of Diirinka , Vendariiq had little interest in preaching .

title: Vendes Baenre
description: Vendes Baenre Vendes Baenre , also named Duk - Tak , a name meaning " Unholy Executioner " , was one of Yvonnel Baenre ' s daughters and also a priestess of Lolth . She was master tormentress of the Baenre compound ; her nickname was because of this " job " . History .

title: Venerator Creed
description: Venerator Creed The Venerator Creed was one of the major illithid Creed s in the Realms . They were the priests of Ilsensine . Bases .

title: Vengeance domain
description: Vengeance domain The Fiery force that is vengeance fuels a lot different individuals , and the deities of the vengeance domain both love to use it . vengeance is worthwhile if it is given in equal or greater suffering in reciprocation and it should be the only response according to Loviatar . Even the slightest insult against the spiteful queen of dragons Tiamat , her vain and pride will bring down the fury and wrath of her devoted worshipers .

title: Vengeance knight
description: Vengeance knight The Vengeance Knights are an elite group of fighters who have pledged to serve the Knights of the Shield , a group of politicians and merchants with considerable influence in many governments along the Sword Coast . The Knight ' s purpose is to force the organizations enemies into compliance . Vengeance Knights prefer to wear heavy plated armor .

title: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf
description: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf is the third and final book of the Companions Codex series by R . A . Salvatore .

title: Ventriloquism
description: Ventriloquism Ventriloquism ( originally called Dace ' s ventriloquism ) was an illusion spell from the subschool that allowed one to throw his or her voice . Some creatures , such as slayer genie s and dazzles could innately create this magical effect . Effects .

title: Venzentilax
description: Venzentilax Venzentilax was a blue dragon living in Threskel . She was a loyal servant of Alasklerbanbastos . Description .

title: Veperyd
description: Veperyd Veperyd was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn , who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons , Veperyd was in charge of the security of Coliseum with four bar - lgura guards until an adventuring party hired by Solom Ned ' razak to collect samples of fiendish fire giant bloods confronted and defeated him and his minions .

title: Verbal component
description: Verbal component The verbal component was a basic part of spellcasting . Most spells required the caster to complete a spoken incantation in a clear , powerful voice . Being gagged or magically silence d prevent one from casting such a spell .

title: Verbeeg
description: Verbeeg Verbeegs were giant - kin and were also sometimes known as human behemoths because they resembled human s more than any other giant race . Verbeeg were accomplished spear fighters . Personality .

title: Verblen
description: Verblen Verblen was the Slave Lord of Zhentil Keep and an important member of the Zhentarim . History . Verblen grew up on the streets of Zhentil Keep , always in fear of the slavers that wandered the keep at nights .

title: Verdant lord
description: Verdant lord Verdant Lord is a special class on Faerûn . Its members are people who have dedicated their lives to the understanding and well - being of all plant life . Being skilled in herbalism and wilderness lore , most verdant lords live apart from civilization , often within very lush groves .

title: Veren Drakewell
description: Veren Drakewell Veren Drakewell was a member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster and secretly a member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . Activities . Veren was a low - ranking Cloak who also ran a shop in the city .

title: Vergadain
description: Vergadain Vergadain , also known as The Laughing Dwarf by non - dwarves , is the neutral dwarven deity of luck , trickery , negotiation and wealth and an exarch of Moradin . While it seems that Vergadain represents the dwarves ' well - known dedication to the mercantile art of bargaining , those who know better are aware that he has an aspect that fills even the more legal - minded dwarves with pride . As such Vergadain also watches over those dwarves who use less - than - legal means to gain wealth .

title: Veridon
description: Veridon Veridon was a Netherese man and an arcanist . He was the ruler of the enclave of Lathery . History .

title: Verik
description: Verik Verik was a member of the Cult of the Dragon in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Verik was a very good liar and spy .

title: Veris
description: Veris Veris was a Cyric - worshiping pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR . Description . Veris was a one - eyed , bald , and scarred man .

title: Vermin keeper
description: Vermin keeper A Vermin Keeper is a prestige class of the Underdark . Whether formerly from the Realms of Above ( as the lands of Faerûn are called in the Underdark ) or life long denizens of the dark places , Vermin Keepers have mastered the control of vermin creatures . Insects , spiders , scorpions , worms all are subject to the orders of the Vermin Keeper .

title: Verner
description: Verner Verner was a halfling youth from the Moonsea . History . Verner lived with nine other non - human children in Madame Delilah ' s Home for Orphaned Children in Hillsfar until First Lord Torin Nomerthal proclaimed again the Great Law of Humanity , expelling all non - humans .

title: Veron Angalen
description: Veron Angalen Veron Angalen is a half - orc bounty hunter , originally from Silverymoon . Unlike many half - orcs who are the result of a non - consensual union between a human female and a male orc , Veron ' s orcish mother and human father were married and loved each other . In 1478 DR , Veron accepted a commision to track down a supposedly mad woman named Clytemorrenestrix ( Nestrix ) who had killed a wizard in Cormyr .

title: Verthandantalynx
description: Verthandantalynx Verthandantalynx was a green dragon living in the forest of Cormanthor , to the west of the ruins of Myth Drannor . Also called Verdant Cloud , this green wyrm lived 80 miles due west of Myth Drannor , and was worshipped by the population of Trenahess , a nearby village of human s on the east bank of the River Ashaba . The villagers offered up visitors and valuables to " Little Verthie " , who defended them from monsters and other communities .

title: Verthisathurgiesh Anala
description: Verthisathurgiesh Anala Verthisathurgiesh Anala was the dragonborn matriarch of Clan Verthisathurgiesh in 1486 DR . Description . Anala was lithe and loose - limbed , with damp brick - colored scales and black plumes hanging neatly to her shoulders .

title: Vesarius
description: Vesarius Vesarius was a cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . In the past , Vesarius made a bargain with the ancient black dragon Maelestor Rex .

title: Vescaras Ammakyl
description: Vescaras Ammakyl Vescaras Ammakyl was a half - elf Harper agent . Activities . Vescaras was a noble of Waterdeep .

title: Veserab
description: Veserab A veserab was a large , worm - like creature with bat wings and a large leech - like maw lined with teeth . Combat . They could also and spew a highly corrosive acid in battle .

title: Vesilde Gaerth
description: Vesilde Gaerth Vesilde Gaerth is a sun elf Knight - Commander of the Golden Star . He personally led over 500 elves in aid of Seiveril Miritar ' s cause against the daemonfey threat to the elves of Faerûn in early 1374 DR . Description .

title: Vesperin
description: Vesperin Vesperin was a human country in the land of the Vast in the 15th century , comprising the cities of Calaunt , Ravens Bluff , and Tantras . History . In 1370 DR , Ravens Bluff proposed the formation of a regional government in the Vast .

title: Vesryn Aelorothi
description: Vesryn Aelorothi Vesryn Aelorothi was a male fey ' ri sorcerer of House Aelorothi and a member of the daemonfey . Equipment . Vesryn carried a magical " + 1 longsword " , " + 1 elven chain " , 2 " potion s of cure moderate wounds " , a " potion of neutralize poison " , a " scroll of flashburst " , a " scroll of lesser ironguard " , a " ring of counterspells " ( " magic missile " ) , a " wand of Melf ' s acid arrow " , 2 waterstar s ( 500 gp each ) , and a leather scroll case containing a hand - drawn map of the North .

title: Vestress
description: Vestress Vestress was a rogue illithid serving as the Regent of Ascarle in 1361 DR . Description . Vestress dressed elegantly , with amethyst rings , lavender robes , and a silver circlet on her head .

title: Vesvur Alder
description: Vesvur Alder Vesvur Alder was an agent of the Harpers who operated out of Mulmaster . Activities . The bard frequently reported his findings within the city to Chesslyn Onaubra Relationships .

title: Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff
description: Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff The Veteran Guild of Ravens Bluff was a mercenary company based in Ravens Bluff and also active in the Sea of Fallen Stars and the Vast around 1358 DR . Organization . As well as infantry , cavalry , archers , and wizards , they also had a unit of priests and even a musical unit composed of ten bards to improve morale .

title: Vhaemas
description: Vhaemas Vhaemas was the merfolk king of Eadraal in Myth Nantar . History . Born in 1302 DR , Vhaemas ruled for 35 years of peace until the start of the Twelfth Serôs War when Prince Vhaemas the Bastard allied with Iakhovas .

title: Vhaemas the Bastard
description: Vhaemas the Bastard Vhaemas the Bastard was a renegade merfolk king during the Twelfth Serôs War . History . Vhaemas was born in 1320 DR to King Vhaemas and a merwoman of the outcast Kamaar clan .

title: Vhaerath
description: Vhaerath A vhaerath was a creature created by Vhaeraun from one of his petitioners . They were used by the deity as servants on Toril . Description .

title: Vhaeraun
description: Vhaeraun Vhaeraun ( Vay - " rawn " ) , also called the Masked Lord , the Masked God of Night , The Shadow , less frequently , the Masked Mage and the Lord of Shadow was the drow god of drow males , thievery , territory , shadow magic , spellfilcher s and evil activities on the surface , aimed to further drow goals , interests and power there . Vhaeraun was the son of Araushnee and Corellon Larethian . He held the unique view among drow that males and females were equally valuable , and was primarily prayed to by those drow males who sought a better life than slavery under Lolth ’ s matriarchy , and that opposed it .

title: Vhaeraun ' s nightshield
description: Vhaeraun ' s nightshield Vhaeraun ' s nightshield was an abjuration spell contained in the " Obsul Ssussun " and associated with the drow god Vhaeraun . Effects . The spell created a protective aura that enhanced the physical resilience , reflexes , and willpower of the caster , and protected them from the " magic missile " spell in a manner similar to a " brooch of shielding ] " .

title: Vhaidra Uoswiir
description: Vhaidra Uoswiir Vhaidra was a drow monk who excelled in both armed and unarmed combat . History . Vhaidra is the first in line to the noble Uoswiir household .

title: Vharem Kuthcutter
description: Vharem Kuthcutter Vharem Kuthcutter was a friend of Renaer Neverember . Description . Vharem had an unkempt blond beard .

title: Vhissilka
description: Vhissilka Vhissilka was a marilith commander serving the balor lord Axithar . Description . Vhissilka wore her hair in dull gray - brown braids .

title: Vhondryl
description: Vhondryl Vhondryl was a female human psion living in Skullport in the 1360s and 1370s DR . One of the most powerful psionicist s in the city , she was also one of the top two dealers in poisons and potions , the alleged proprietor of The Deepfires inn , and leader of the Hall of Mental Splendor group of mercenary psychic spies . Description .

title: Vhostym
description: Vhostym Vhostym , also called the Sojourner , is a member of the sparsely populated but powerful offshoots of the Gith sundering , the Githvyrik . Vhostym is an ancient and extremely powerful being who has both arcane and psionic powers to call upon . Vhostym worships no god or goddess , as he sees the gods as nothing compared to the utter randomness and enormity of the universe .

title: Vhyridaan the Mad
description: Vhyridaan the Mad Vhyridaan the Mad was a male half - elf mage who had his soul trapped inside a stone . History . Exiled from Myth Drannor , Vhyridaan was self - taught in the ways of High Magic .

title: Vi ' oontu
description: Vi ' oontu The Vi ' oontu were a ninja clan based in the town of Manchar in Koryo . Their name meant " evening swallow that calls death " . Around 1357 DR , the Vi ' oontu waged an ongoing war with the Panthers of Xi , who dominated the Vorkani Mountains to the north .

title: Vial
description: Vial Vials were small glass containers that were used to hold liquids and powders . They could be used in laboratories to conduct experiments or to transport these substances . Description .

title: Vichorn Vrockwing
description: Vichorn Vrockwing Vichorn Vrockwing was a tiefling who frequented the Driftwood Tavern in Neverwinter around 1484 DR . Activities . Vichorn wanted to recruit a tiefling adventurer , claiming there was a bargain between his master and the adventurer ' s ancestors , to sabotage the Ashmadai .

title: Viconia DeVir
description: Viconia DeVir History . Viconia left her house and trappings as a priestess of Lolth after she failed to slay a baby in Lolth ' s name . A rival killed the child in her stead and House DeVir fell out of favour with the Drow ' s fell deity .

title: Victor Dhostar
description: Victor Dhostar Victor Dhostar was the second Faceless of the Night Mask until 1367 DR . Description . Victor was a tall and handsome man with brown hair and blue eyes .

title: Vidrinath
description: Vidrinath Vidrinath ( or Lullaby ) was a sword belonging to Tiago Baenre . Description . Like " Orbbcress " , the sword was made of translucent glassteel imbued with diamond s .

title: Vierna Do ' Urden
description: Vierna Do ' Urden Vierna Do ' Urden was a drow priestess of Lolth of House Do ' Urden in Menzoberranzan . She raised her younger brother , Drizzt Do ' Urden , in his early years . Personality .

title: Vigdas Miller
description: Vigdas Miller Vigdas Miller was a widow miller living near Hillsfar . History . Vigdas lived with her husband , a miller , until he died two years before the Rage .

title: Vigilent Order
description: Vigilent Order The Vigilent Order was a loosely organized society in Waterdeep dedicated to furthering the ends of the evil god Asmodeus . In the years prior to 1480 DR , the Vigilent Order was nearly destroyed by the deva Jinnaoth Ir ' Gadohn who ruthlessly hunted down members of the Order . Until the late 15th century DR , most members of the Order were poor , desperate people who hoped to improve their situation through Asmodeus ' power .

title: Viis Dyrr
description: Viis Dyrr Viis Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1373 DR . History . Viis graduated from Sorcere at unknown time .

title: Vikos
description: Vikos Vikos was one of the centaur s in the Barony of Bloodstone in 1357 DR . Activities . Vikos was a historian and a good writer .

title: Vil ' Kenna
description: Vil ' Kenna Vil ' Kenna was a female barbarian from the Sky Pony tribe of Uthgardt barbarians . In 1374 DR she travelled to Nesmé on the edge of the Evermoors to join others from her tribe who had been hired by First Speaker Tessarin Alaurin to defend the city against troll and giant attack .

title: Vilcuum
description: Vilcuum Vilcuum was a mind flayer in Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Vilcuum was one of the mind flayers that joined the allied attack on Maerimydra .

title: Vilheim
description: Vilheim Vilheim Baltson was a native of Chessenta . He was a paladin of Torm when during the Time of Troubles he lost sign of his god ( when he was killed by Bane in Tantras . Feeling abandoned he retreated in the Great Glacier living as hermit .

title: Vilhiard
description: Vilhiard Vilhiard was a human man from the city of Procampur in the Vast . He was a renowned scholar and monk of Deneir , famous for his book " A Discovery of the World " . History .

title: Vilhon Cider
description: Vilhon Cider Vilhon Cider was a cider crafted in Nimpeth . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Vilhon Mercenary Corps
description: Vilhon Mercenary Corps The Vilhon Mercenary Corps were a renowned group that traveled around the " Forgotten Realms " completing various contracts for noble lords and city - states . History . In 1479 DR , it was rumored Lord Caleb Randol of Kovel Mansion commissioned the group to undermine Black Fist operations north of Phlan .

title: Vilhon Reach
description: Vilhon Reach The Vilhon Reach was a region named after a body of water called the Vilhon Reach , a part of the Sea of Fallen Stars . Geography . Through its many port cities , the Vilhon Reach was established as an essential trade center between the cities of the southern bodies of water , the Lake of Steam , the Shining Sea , and the many kingdoms and city - states around the inner sea of the continent , the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Vilhon blanc
description: Vilhon blanc Vilhon Blanc was a cheese from Sembia . Geography . The cheese was rarely found outside the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Vilirij
description: Vilirij A vilirij was a bizarre parasite found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Vilirij were small , flat creatures that looked exactly like a patch of human or demihuman skin .

title: Vilksmaarg
description: Vilksmaarg Vilksmaarg was an herbed goat cheese made in Vilkstead . Description . Vilksmaarg was pungent and salty , and was popular in taverns along the Sword Coast .

title: Villonah Leadstopper
description: Villonah Leadstopper Villonah Leadstopper was a gnome in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Villonah from a young age had trouble with the law , usually being saved by her father Rillo Leadstopper , who paid for the damage she did .

title: Villynaty
description: Villynaty Villynaty was a sahuagin prince in the Sea of Swords . History . Villynaty lived in the City of Caverns .

title: Viln Tirin
description: Viln Tirin Viln Tirin was a gang leader and cultist in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . Activities . The elf led the Bandersnatches , a gang of young demon - worshiping drow in West Wall district .

title: Vimal Craumerdaun
description: Vimal Craumerdaun Vimal Craumerdaun was a human male and the head accountant for the Craumerdaun family in Eshpurta , Amn , in early 1370 DR , the Year of the Tankard . Due to the treatment of arcane spellcaster s in Amn , Vimal kept his wizard ly skills a closely guarded secret .

title: Vindala Chalanther
description: Vindala Chalanther Vindala Chalanther was a retired adventurer and illusionist who lived in Marsember , Cormyr . She tutored apprentice magicians but would accept hire as a spellcaster , and enjoyed relaxing at the Drowning Flagon inn . She was petite with black hair and dark eyes , although she often disguised herself .

title: Vindicator
description: Vindicator Vindicator was Helm ' s bastard sword . Description . The sword glowed with silver y flame and had the symbol of Helm on its hilt .

title: Vine Vale
description: Vine Vale The Vine Vale is an area surrounding Evereska dedicated to agriculture for orchards and vineyards . It is a vast staircase of lush vineyards and black soiled winter fields , descending toward Evereska ' s walls in a series of smokethorn tree and spiny soapleaf covered terraces .

title: Vineshade
description: Vineshade The town of Vineshade was the largest settlement in the Purple Hills in Tethyr and thought by most to be the wine capital of the entire Sword Coast . It was primarily a halfling town . Geography and Layout .

title: Vintor
description: Vintor Vintor was a county on the western coast of Tethyr famous for its wines . Geography . Vintor was one of the counties of the Purple Marches .

title: Viol
description: Viol A viol was a six - string instrument similar to a violin . Description . Viols had a deeply resonant sound that conveyed melancholy themes very well .

title: Violet fungus
description: Violet fungus A violet fungus was a type of subterranean fungus creature that could be dangerous to adventurers . Description . Violet fungi were human - sized mushrooms supported by a mass of root - like feelers that allowed them to move slowly to more favorable feeding spots .

title: Violet slime
description: Violet slime Violet slime was a slime found on the surface of standing water in swampy environments . It clung to creatures and caused acid burns , although these did not affect metals . It could be washed off with water , or burned with fire or bright light .

title: Violin
description: Violin Violins were musical instruments greatly favored by elves . Description . Music from violins was mellow and their sound was particularly loved by elves .

title: Violine
description: Violine Violine gems were purple and volcanic in nature . Description . Found in deposits mixed with other minerals and occasionally of exceptional ( up to human fist ) size , this ornamental stone was usually cut and polished , or baguette style .

title: Viper ' s Kiss
description: Viper ' s Kiss Viper ' s Kiss by Lisa Smedman is the second book in the House of Serpents Trilogy . Summary . This novel explores the political intrigues of the yuan - ti race , the details of which have been little explored in previous Forgotten Realms products .

title: Viper tree
description: Viper tree Viper trees were a strange mixture of demon , plant and reptile found in the Lower Planes . As of 1370 DR there were reports that several Red Wizard zulkir s had brought specimens from the Abyss and planted them in Thay . Description .

title: Vipers
description: Vipers The Vipers were a bandit company active in the Vast in the 1360s DR . They were based out of the Vipers ' Nest in Brynwood . History .

title: Vipers ' Nest
description: Vipers ' Nest The Vipers ' Nest was a secret base of the Vipers bandits , located in the Brynwood forest in the Vast . History . In the Year of the Banner , 1368 DR , two Red Brigade scouts reported a dead - magic zone in Brynwood in the Vast to their captain , Cedric Ravajar .

title: Viperstongue Ford
description: Viperstongue Ford Viperstongue Ford was a ford where the Cross Road , between Thindilar and Blanaer , went over the River Vesper in the Vast . It coincided with the valley of Viperstongue , a low saddle in the Troll Mountains that served as a major pass through the range . History .

title: Virdin
description: Virdin King Virdin was the king of Damara in 1357 DR . History . King Virdin led the Damaran armies against those of Zhengyi the Witch - King , but was defeated at the Ford of Goliad when he was tricked into believing that a magic wand would enable his army to cross the Goliad River .

title: Virus charm
description: Virus charm Virus charm was an arcane enchantment spell , similar to " mass charm " , that could spread from a single creature to other individuals by touch . Effects . When casting this spell , it was important that the first target be a creature less robust than the caster for the virus to take hold — a child or a commoner , for example .

title: Viryn
description: Viryn Viryn was a solar in service to Tyr in 1385 DR . History . Viryn was a solar in service to Tyr in Mount Celestia .

title: Vishap
description: Vishap Vishap were flightless dragon s that lived in Zakhara . Compared to other dragons they were cowardly , choosing to prey on the weak . Stealth and deceit were their chosen methods of attack .

title: Vishap ' s Teeth
description: Vishap ' s Teeth The Vishap ' s Teeth was a landmark located in the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . It was surely a striking feature .

title: Vishnan VII
description: Vishnan VII Vishnan VII was the priest - king of Kuong Kingdom in Malatra around 1357 DR . Personality . Vishnan was a strong leader with a regal authority .

title: Vishva
description: Vishva Vishva was a dragonborn member of the Platinum Cadre , who became the leader of the order after the death of Patrin in 1479 DR . Due to her faith in a dragon god , Vishva was a " thrikominaki " ( clanless dragonborn ) . Description .

title: Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer
description: Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer Visil ' Taphenos Meadswimmer was a renegade aboleth savant from Llurth Dreir living in Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR . History . Born in Llurth Dreir , Visil ' Taphenos descended from a line of aboleths specializing in dwarven lore .

title: Vision
description: Vision Vision was a divination spell that granted the caster knowledge of tales about a given person , place , or thing . Effects . This spell worked in the same manner as " legend lore " , except that " vision " worked more quickly and produced greater strain on the caster .

title: Viticun
description: Viticun Viticun was a sage and Red Wizard in Eltabbar in 1358 DR . His area of expertise was the understanding of magic and its relationship to the Inner Planes and Outer Planes and nobody knew more than him about this . He worked only for fellow Red Wizards .

title: Viv
description: Viv Viv was a halfling trickster in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR , Viv joined Enda Yate in her treasure hunt into Undermountain .

title: Vix ' thra
description: Vix ' thra Vix ' thra was a dracolich who allied with the Valsharess during her campaign to conquer the Underdark . Vix ' thra established a cult devoted to his worship , under the leadership of a vampire priest named Sodalis . This cult was based in an Underdark village called Drearing ' s Deep , where freed slaves came to seek refuge .

title: Vizeran DeVir
description: Vizeran DeVir Vizeran DeVir was an exiled drow archmage during the Rage of Demons . History . A scion of House DeVir , Vizeran studied the arcane arts at the same time as Gromph Baenre .

title: Vizier ' s turban
description: Vizier ' s turban Vizier ' s turbans were symbiotic creatures in Zakhara that attached themselves to wizard s . Abilities . Bonded to a wizard , they would greatly increase any wizard ' s ability to cast spells in exchange for a small portion of the wizard ' s life force .

title: Vlaakith CLVII
description: Vlaakith CLVII Vlaakith CLVII , also known as the Lich Queen , is the current ruler of the githyanki race . Vlaakith is the name of several rulers of the githyanki race after the disappearance of Gith , the rebel leader that united them against the illithid . The original holder , Vlaakith I helped seal the pact between the red dragons and the githyanki .

title: Vlashiri
description: Vlashiri Vlashiri was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest . History . Vlashiri was one of the priestesses in the Misty Forest .

title: Vlotho
description: Vlotho Vlotho the Blue was a half - elf gambler who lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir , as of 1479 DR . Background . Vlotho was a known gambler and gossiper in Harglast , and he usually dealt with more obscure information as well .

title: Voadkyn
description: Voadkyn The voadkyn were a kind of giant - kin sometimes also known as wood giants . A large population lived with the wood elves and the treant s in the Cold Wood . Abilities .

title: Voaraghamanthar
description: Voaraghamanthar Voaraghamanthar , known as the Black Death , was one of the most famous black dragon s . Personality . Voaraghamanthar shared an unusually powerful empathic link with his twin Waervaerendor .

title: Vocalize
description: Vocalize Vocalize was an alteration spell that allowed a spell - caster to cast spells without uttering a sound . Effects . For five minutes , this spell granted the ability to cast spells silently .

title: Vodos
description: Vodos Vodos was the great triton architect who planned the Sharksbane Wall . History . Vodos was a very ancient triton born possibly in - 11000 DR .

title: Voice of the great lion
description: Voice of the great lion The Voice of the Great Lion was a magical item that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . This item looked like a crinkled old scroll bound with a faded golden cord .

title: Voice of thunder
description: Voice of thunder A voice of thunder is a variety of bard trained to enhance their voice with arcane magic through ancient traditions . To the properly trained voice of thunder , the sound of their voice is a weapon in of itself , a source of power that can harm and heal alike . From the sound of music to the rumbling roll of thunder , a voice of thunder ' s vocal range is impressive and filled with deadly power , with even its echoes full of supernatural qualities .

title: Voidstone
description: Voidstone Voidstone was a solid substance that originated on the Negative Energy Plane and destroyed anything it touched . Properties . Completely black and featureless , voidstone was nearly unmeasurable by any known means .

title: Vok Dorrg
description: Vok Dorrg Vok Dorrg was the vendicative reigning king of Ruathym sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Vok ruled from the Hall of the Black Waves .

title: Vokkrzyr Rualfren
description: Vokkrzyr Rualfren Vokkrzyr Rualfren was a cleric of Vhaeraun . Activities . He was the leader of the drow settlement in Ultoksamrin , which made him the leader of the Vault of Cloaked Midnight .

title: Volahk
description: Volahk Volahk was a senior priest in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . Relationships . As a member of the Eternal Order of Kelemvor , his mission was the clean the city ' s graveyard of undead .

title: Volar
description: Volar Volar was a storm giant hero of history in Serôs . History . Born in 780 DR , Volar emerged as a great storm giant chieftain living among the mountains that were renamed in his honor , and all people in Seros knew about his battles against the sahuagin king Kromes and Xisar the Blue Kraken .

title: Volkumburgh
description: Volkumburgh Volkumburgh is a tiny village nestled in the foothills of the Thunder Peaks , south of Thunder Gap . The village was originally a noble ' s villa , but strangely , the location of the village only appears on maps of Cormyr dated from before 1160 DR . King Proster ordered the College of Shaping Magics located in Volkumburgh to build something known as an awtawmatawn but this information can only be found in a single obscure government document in Suzail .

title: Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical ( in - universe )
description: Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical ( in - universe ) Volo ' s Guide to All Things Magical was a vellum pamphlet written by Volothamp Geddarm in late 1359 DR and published by Tym Waterdeep Limited Description . The guide was full of long - forgotten spells and a grab bag full of odds and ends about magic . History .

title: Volo ' s Guide to Monsters
description: Volo ' s Guide to Monsters Volo ' s Guide to Monsters is a 5th - edition Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook that describes monster lore and lairs , playing monster character races , and gives the stat blocks of many monsters old and new . Monsters . Abjurer • Alhoon • Annis hag • Apprentice wizard • Archdruid • Archer • Aurochs • Babau • Banderhobb • Bard • Barghest • Bheur hag • Blackguard • Bodak • Boggle • Brontosaurus • Catoblepas • Cave fisher • Champion • Chitine • Choldrith • Cloud giant smiling one • Conjurer • Cow • Cranium rat • Darkling • Darkling elder • Death kiss • Deep scion • Deinonychus • Devourer • Dimetrodon • Diviner • Dolphin • Draegloth • Elder brain • Enchanter • Evoker • Fire giant dreadnought • Firenewt • Firenewt warlock of Imix • Flail snail • Flind • Froghemoth • Frost giant everlasting one • Gauth • Gazer • Giant strider • Girallon • Gnoll flesh gnawer • Gnoll hunter • Gnoll witherling • Grung • Grung elite warrior • Grung wildling • Guard drake • Hadrosaurus • Hobgoblin devastator • Hobgoblin Iron Shadow • Illusionist • Ki - rin • Kobold dragonshield • Kobold inventor • Kobold scale sorcerer • Korred • Kraken priest • Leucrotta • Martial arts adept • Master thief • Maw demon • Meenlock • Mind flayer lich • Mindwitness • Morkoth • Mouth of Grolantor • Necromancer • Neogi • Neogi hatchling • Neogi master • Neothelid • Nilbog • Orc Blade of Ilneval • Orc Claw of Luthic • Orc Hand of Yurtrus • Orc Nurtured One of Yurtrus • Orc Red Fang of Shargaas • Ox • Quetzalcoatlus • Quickling • Redcap • Rothé • Sea spawn • Shadow mastiff • Shoosuva • Slithering tracker • Spawn of Kyuss • Stegosaurus • Stench kow • Stone giant dreamwalker • Stone giant quintessent • Swarm of cranium rats • Swarm of rot grubs • Swashbuckler • Tanarukk • Thorny • Tlincalli • Transmuter • Trapper • Ulitharid • Vargouille • Vegepygmy • Vegepygmy chief • Velociraptor • War priest • Warlock of the archfey • Warlock of the fiend • Warlock of the Great Old One • Warlord • Wood woad • Xvart • Xvart warlock of Raxivort • Yeth hound • Yuan - ti anathema • Yuan - ti broodguard • Yuan - ti mind whisperer • Yuan - ti nightmare speaker • Yuan - ti pit master

title: Volo ' s Guide to the Sword Coast
description: Volo ' s Guide to the Sword Coast This book is the third in the celebrated series of travel guides by Volothamp Geddarm . This book details settlements and attractions large and small , up and down the sword coast . It is written in Volo ' s trademark colorful and ( unintentionally ) humorous style .

title: Volo ' s rating system
description: Volo ' s rating system Volo ' s Ratings System was the means by which Volothamp Geddarm ranked taverns , inns , shops , alleyways , and so forth in his well - known guidebooks . The categories were as follows : Pipes . Used to rate the quality of inns , which were defined as any establishment that rented beds to travelers .

title: Volo ( familiar )
description: Volo ( familiar ) Volo was a bat living in West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Volo was Amie ' s familiar .

title: Volodni
description: Volodni Volodni were sentient plant creature s native to the cold forests of Northeast Faerûn . History . Circa - 150 DR , a group of Nar refugees fled from the effects of the Great Conflagration into a nearby ancient forest .

title: Volothamp Geddarm
description: Volothamp Geddarm Volothamp Geddarm , or Volo for short , was a legendary traveler and storyteller , and was most famous for his guidebook published by Tym Waterdeep Limited . Personality . He was oft portrayed as the quintessential " go - to guy " of the Realms even if his information was , at best , half - accurate .

title: Volshur
description: Volshur Volshur the Crooked was a priest of Ilmater , of the 3rd century DR , who held the title " Exalted Servant " and helped create the legendary sword " Dornavver " , the " Demonbane " . History . To counter the growing spread of evil under the Shoon Imperium and a plethora of evil artifacts fashioned at the time , the Church of Ilmater sought a weapon to combat such evil .

title: Volzakaris
description: Volzakaris Volzakaris was a green dragon living near the Well of Dragons . History . When the Cult of the Dragon attempted to summon Tiamat into the world at the Well of Dragons , Volzakaris was one of the chromatic dragon heralds sent to ensure the coming of the Dragon Queen .

title: Vongoethe
description: Vongoethe Vongoethe was a lich from Calimshan encountered in Amkethran in " " . He had come to the town in pursuit of a man called Marlowe and set up a lair in the cave used as a graveyard for the town . The player is likely to first hear about Vongoethe from Marlowe , who asks for their help and will tell that the lich was after his daughter Malla and has now stolen her soul .

title: Voninheim
description: Voninheim Voninheim , ( which means " Titanhome " in Jotun , ) known also as the Bleak Palace , was a citadel in the Ice Spires . History . It was built by Lanaxis and formed the capital of the giant kingdom of Ostoria for over a thousand years .

title: Vooka
description: Vooka Vooka was the most intelligent cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Vooka led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Blood Guard , a group composed of 300 orc s and 200 hobgoblin s .

title: Voonlar
description: Voonlar Voonlar was a small farming town located between the Dalelands and the Moonsea . It was more urbanized than most farming communities because it was located at an intersection of trade routes . The town was Shadowdale ' s main rival in many ways .

title: Voor
description: Voor Ecology . Voors have ravenous appetites for flesh and even greater appetites for blood ; the legacy of cruelty and murder they leave behind makes this obvious to those who have witnessed their rampages . Periodically a voor may spawn broods : it takes five years for a juvenile voor to reach maturity , after which it is ready for guard duty .

title: Vorasaegha
description: Vorasaegha Vorasaegha was an ancient guardian dragon living in Gray Forest in Impiltur during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Vorasaegha was a female bronze dragon in past ages prior to her death .

title: Vorbyx
description: Vorbyx Vorbyx is said , by the orc s and ogre s of Thar , to have been the " First King of Thar " . By 1373 DR no one remembers who Vorbyx was , or even what race Vorbyx was . What is known is Vorbyx united the orc and ogre tribes of Thar .

title: Vordrorn Forest
description: Vordrorn Forest The Vordrorn Forest was a small forest at the base of the Ice Mountains , north of the fork . It was sometimes referred to as the Ghostwood , owing to the large number of incorporeal undead that seemed bound to it . Nearby areas of interest included Adbar Road , Ascore , and Fork Road .

title: Vorgansharax
description: Vorgansharax Vorgansharax was an adult green dragon during the time of Tyranny of Dragons . Description . Vorgansharax was a massive dragon whose ego surpassed his size .

title: Vorja
description: Vorja Vorja was a Red Wizard of Thay in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . Personality . Vorja had very little loyalty to the Red Wizards .

title: Vorkani Mountains
description: Vorkani Mountains The Vorkani Mountains were a mountain range that arced across the land of Koryo in northeastern Kara - Tur , lying at the end of the great Koryo Peninsula . They were also known as the Sillan Mountains . Geography .

title: Voronica Whitney - Robinson
description: Voronica Whitney - Robinson Voronica Whitney - Robinson is the author of several " Forgotten Realms " works , including two novels . She has also written novels in the " Ravenloft " and " Star Wars " settings . She resides in Seattle , USA , and works as a marine biologist .

title: Vorpal
description: Vorpal Vorpal was a magical enhancement for slashing weapons that increased the chance of the weapon severing an opponent ' s head . Creation . A powerful spellcaster needed the spells " keen edge " and " circle of death " to add this magic quality to a weapon .

title: Vosh
description: Vosh Vosh the White was a miller in the village of Toralth in Tethyr in 1370 DR . Description . Very few in Toralth knew that Vosh was a half - orc , thanks to his long beard .

title: Vourdakeq
description: Vourdakeq Vourdakeq was an ixzan teacher and a member of the Xendreth , the ruling council of of Malydren in 1370 DR . Personality . Vourdakeq was a severe disciplinarian .

title: Vournoth
description: Vournoth Vournoth was a lich that laired in a stagnant intersection in the Deep Wastes that became known as Vournoth ' s Mire . Personality . Vournoth had become well - known enough in the vicinity of Maerimydra that the lich ' s name was attributed to the mire it resided in .

title: Vournoth ' s Mire
description: Vournoth ' s Mire Vournoth ' s Mire was an area in the Deep Wastes between Szith Morcane and Maerimydra that had been the lair for numerous creatures over the years . Geography . Situated along the natural tunnels that connect the city of Maerimydra with the outpost of Szith Morcane , it was 40 miles north from Maerimydra itself and 50 miles from the Wailing Cliff .

title: Vrag
description: Vrag Vrag was a cornugon lieutenant in Dragonspear Castle circa 1363 DR . History . Vrag led one of the Hordes of Dragonspear , specifically the Marauders , a group composed of one unit of 500 kobold s and one unit of 500 goblin s led by the able chieftain Pruj .

title: Vragni Moonsmith
description: Vragni Moonsmith Vragni Moonsmith was a dwarf mummy in the Deep Wastes . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Vragni and his retinue were ambushed and killed by drow from Szith Morcane .

title: Vraith
description: Vraith Vraith was a wood elf female and a commander in the Order of Blue Flame located in the city of Ormpetarr . She held the rank of Accordant . She possessed a spellscar .

title: Vrakk
description: Vrakk Vrakk was a Zhentilar general , and noted war hero in Zhentil Keep . He was bodyguard and co - conspirator with Fzoul Chembryl in the creation of " The True Life of Cyric " in 1368 DR History . In 1360 Vrakk led the orc army that the Zhent send to joined the allied armies led by Azoun Obarskyr IV in fighting against the Grand Army of the Tuigan in Thesk .

title: Vreesar
description: Vreesar Vreesar was an ice devil who tried to conquer Faerûn . Description . Vreesar was a large , insectoid creature as were all gelugons .

title: Vremyonni
description: Vremyonni The vremyonni or " Old Ones " were an arcane brotherhood in Rashemen . Organization . Men that were arcane spellcasters in Rashemen had two choices , exile or to join the vremyonni .

title: Vriild Denvenar
description: Vriild Denvenar Vriild Denvenar was a leading member of the derro Council of Savants in Gracklstugh in 1370 DR . Personality . Vriild ' s main concern was the new nation of Luruar , which Vriild saw as a successor of Ascalhorn , Myth Drannor , and Phalorm , and a menace to the derros ' ambitions on the surface .

title: Vrock
description: Vrock Vrocks , also known as Type I demons , were minor tanar ' ri demon s . Description . Vrocks appeared as a large cross between a vulture and a human .

title: Vrr ' maal
description: Vrr ' maal Vrr ' maal was a balor prince who dwelled in the Infinite Layers of the Abyss . He was known for keeping a great forge . One proposed method for destroying the dread artifact known as " Thakorsil ' s Seat " was to take it to the Abyss and drop into Vrr ' maal ' s forge .

title: Vryloka
description: Vryloka Vryloka were a race of vampire - like nobles . History . The elders of their race made a deal with an entity known as the Red Witch .

title: Vualdia
description: Vualdia Vualdia was a dukar of the Order of Maliirn and the morkoth member of the Nantarn Council . Personality . Vualdia was a strict conservative individual , believing that her opinion being facts .

title: Vuddar
description: Vuddar Vuddor ( singular vuddar ) were the specialty priest s of Thard Harr , the patron of the wild dwarves . Etymology . The word " vuddar " means " of the jungle " in the Authalan dialect .

title: Vudlur
description: Vudlur The Vudlur was one of the watercourses of the Esmelflow in Amn . Geography . This creek began at a spring in the western Snakewood .

title: Vuhm Yestral
description: Vuhm Yestral Vuhm Yestral was a commander of Hillsfar ' s Red Plumes . Personality . Vuhm , despite being loud and opinionated , was kind and very devoted to the citizens of Hillsfar .

title: Vulpomyscan
description: Vulpomyscan Vulpomyscan was a brown dragon who dwelt in the Citadel of Black Ash in Unther . History . Around −3000 DR , a clan of dwarves from the Brightstar Lake region began digging into the cliffs along the edge of the Black Ash Plain when they awakened Vulpomyscan , who ate their leaders and enslaved the remaining dwarves .

title: Vulture drake
description: Vulture drake A vulture drake , also known as a deathwing , was a type of drake that had been corrupted by the Shadowfell . Description . The drakes were large , menacing reptiles that could be used as mounts .

title: Vurgrom
description: Vurgrom Vurgrom the Mighty was an evil pirate in 1359 DR . History . Vurgrom rose the rank killing his captain .

title: Vuzlyn Freth
description: Vuzlyn Freth Vuzlyn Freth was a drow and one of Houndaer Tuin ' Tarl and Syrzan ' s group in Menzoberranzan in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth , Vuzlyn joined Houndaer ' s group in order to start a slave revolt .

title: Vyaalis
description: Vyaalis Vyaalis was from the Coral Kingdom , a sea elven kingdom in the Trackless Sea near Evermeet . History . For a time , he lived in Memnon , learning the art of longsword fighting from Shieldlord Hastor el Khafar .

title: Vyqinak
description: Vyqinak Vyqinak was an ixitxachitl vampire known as the Count of the Depths in the court of the Night King in Westgate as of the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Activities . As Count of the Depths , Vyqinak was the junior Night Master in charge of all smuggling in the Westgate harbor .

title: Vyrlo Trath
description: Vyrlo Trath Vyrlo Trath was a member of the Cult of the Crushing Wave in Mulmaster . Relationships . Trath was a warrior affiliated with the Cult of the Crushing Wave .

title: Vyzzstek Nhynssoth
description: Vyzzstek Nhynssoth Vyzzstek Nhynssoth was the Arcane Brotherhood representative in Skullport . History . Around 1370 DR , Vyzzstek posed as a loyal lieutenant of Zstulkk Ssarmn but in truth was the eyes and ears of the Arcane Brotherhood under his master , the South Overwizard Deltagar Zelhund .

title: Wa
description: Wa Wa is an island nation made up of several islands . Geography . The largest island and most populated island of Wa is known as Tsukishima composed of towering but extinct volcanoes and fertile lowlands .

title: Wa - an
description: Wa - an Wa - an , or the Wa language , was a language spoken by the Wanese , inhabitants of Wa in Kara - Tur . Wa - an descended from the ancient Han language , as did Koryo and Kozakuran , and possibly others . Wa - an and Kozakuran were closely related ; some considered them only different dialects of the same language .

title: Wadi ' a bint Sali
description: Wadi ' a bint Sali Wadi ' a bint Sali was an gnome sha ' ir within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Wadi ' a was an assistant of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi .

title: Wadsworth
description: Wadsworth Wadsworth was a Helm ite priest in Maztica in 1362 DR . Activities . Together with his fellows Delian and Elkhound , Wadsorth was a missionary in the village of Maju on the plains between the Chuapli Forest and the Narabatun Jungle .

title: Waelan
description: Waelan Waelan was the native language of the Ffolk . Speakers . Waelan was spoken by the Ffolk of the southern Moonshaes , although by 1372 DR the majority of Ffolk in the Isles spoke the Illuskan language of the Northlander s who had invaded their native home .

title: Waerva Baenre
description: Waerva Baenre Waerva Baenre was a drow priestess of Lolth in Menzoberranzan and a member of House Baenre in 1372 DR . History . During the Silence of Lolth in 1372 DR , Waerva sought to increase her power by framing the ambassador of Ched Nasad , Faeryl Zauvirr , with plotting against Matron Mother Triel Baenre .

title: Waervaerendor
description: Waervaerendor Waervaerendor , nicknamed by himself the Rapacious Raider , was the shadow of one of the most famous black dragon s in Faerûn . Personality . Waervaerendor shared an unusually powerful empathic link with his twin Voaraghamanthar .

title: Wah - ree
description: Wah - ree Wah - ree was an ancient abstract strategy board game in Faerûn , popular among giant s and played even by some of the gods . History . Legends stated that the game of " wah - ree " was invented by the gods themselves .

title: Wai Chi
description: Wai Chi Wai Chi was a Shou scribe on Akari in 1357 DR . History . Wai Chi was the scribe of Governor Ko Lei Kho .

title: Wai Gada Shinzu
description: Wai Gada Shinzu Wai Gada Shinzu was the emperor of T ' u Lung in 1357 DR . History . Wai Gada Shinzu ascended to become the Eighth Emperor of the Lui Dynasty in 1308 DR and soon after his cousin and regent Wai Yeh Yin disappeared .

title: Wai Locunni Eio
description: Wai Locunni Eio Wai Locunni Eio was the mother of the emperor of T ' u Lung . Personality . At 72 years of age , Wai Locunni had iron gray hair yet still had a straight back .

title: Wail of the banshee
description: Wail of the banshee Wail of the banshee was a necromancy spell that killed several creatures . Effects . The caster emitted a terrible scream that killed creatures who heard it , except for the caster .

title: Wailing Cliff
description: Wailing Cliff The Wailing Cliff was a 300 - ft - high ( 91 . 4 m ) cliff in the Deep Wastes that interrupted the tunnel between the Lake of Shadows and Maerimydra . Geography .

title: Wailing Death
description: Wailing Death The Wailing Death was a magical disease that ravaged the city of Neverwinter in Tarsakh and Mirtul of 1372 DR . Most of the citizens of the city were dead or dying within a tenday of the first reported case . Neverwinter did not fully recover from the effects of the disease for an entire decade and it left the city vulnerable to Netherese infiltration .

title: Wailing Dwarf
description: Wailing Dwarf The Wailing Dwarf was a 4 , 000 ft ( 1 , 220 m ) stone sculpture of a dwarf named for the sound made by wind passing over and through the cavernous ears , eyes , and mouth . Geography . The Wailing Dwarf was located in the Troll Mountains of western Amn , carved from the easternmost peak , Mount Batyr .

title: Wailing Years
description: Wailing Years The Wailing Years , also known as the Plague Years , was a cataclysmic time period in the chronology of Toril and Abeir . Taking place between 1385 DR , the Year of Blue Fire , and 1395 DR , the Year of Silent Death , the Wailing Years was a period of ten years during which the effects of the Spellplague were at their worst . Summary .

title: Wailing wind
description: Wailing wind Wailing wind was a divine magic spell available to druid s of Eldath , the Mother Guardian of Groves . It warned the caster of any intrusion on a designated space and carried the sound of the intruder to the caster . Effects .

title: Wak Rathar
description: Wak Rathar Wak Rathar was a wizard living in Hillsfar in 1367 DR . As an old friend of Lord Maalthiir , he was permitted to do all he wished . Personality .

title: Walaxyrvaan
description: Walaxyrvaan Walaxyrvaan ( preferred name Lynx ) was an elf from the Elmanesse tribe in the Wealdath who earned an apprenticeship at Blackstaff Tower . The name translates as Lynx of the Approaching Dusk . Appearance .

title: Waleed ibn - Keram
description: Waleed ibn - Keram Waleed ibn - Keram was a gnome tax collector who worked at the Gate of the Ghost in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Waleed had an impeccable eye for spotting smugglers .

title: Walharrow
description: Walharrow Captain Walharrow was a minotaur pirate and inmate of Grimshackle Jail in Phlan . History . Walharrow was a feared pirate captain .

title: Walking Statue
description: Walking Statue The Walking Statue was a 90 ft ( 27 m ) stone golem positioned on Gull Leap at the western end of Julthoon Street in Waterdeep by Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun to help defend the city . It was one of a set of eight such golems .

title: Walking Statue of Waterdeep
description: Walking Statue of Waterdeep Walking statues were mighty construct s built for the defense of holy temples , ancient vaults and the most important cities , castles and fortresses of Waterdeep . They often served as ethereal guardians that could attack other ethereal creatures approaching its guarded area . They were unswervingly loyal to their instructions or orders , carrying them out to the best of their abilities .

title: Wall against noise
description: Wall against noise Wall against noise was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a wall of air that prevented sound from passing through .

title: Wall of fire
description: Wall of fire Wall of fire was an evocation or conjuration spell that raised a one - sided opaque curtain of flames in the form of a segmented wall or a circle . After the Spellplague , the wall was two - sided . Effects .

title: Wall of force
description: Wall of force Wall of force ( originally called Shan ' s forcewall ) was an evocation spell used by arcane casters to create and invisible force field . Some cleric s of were also granted this spell . Oathbinder genie s , a type of tasked genie , could create a wall of force effect innately .

title: Wall of ice
description: Wall of ice Wall of ice , formerly known as Veridon ' s ice wall , was an evocation spell that created a thick , opaque , sheet or dome of ice . After the Spellplague , only the wall form was available . " Wall of ice " could be cast by sorcerer s , wizard s , and cleric s who commanded the cold or ocean domain s .

title: Wall of iron
description: Wall of iron Wall of iron is a conjuration spell that creates a dense iron barrier . Effect . You cause a flat , vertical iron wall to spring into being .

title: Wall of sand
description: Wall of sand Wall of sand was an arcane evocation spell that created a temporary wall made of spinning sand . Effects . This spell could create a wall up to 12 ft ( 3 .

title: Wall of stone
description: Wall of stone Wall of stone is a conjuration or evocation spell that summons a mutable stone wall . Effect . This spell creates a wall of rock that merges into adjoining rock surfaces .

title: Wall of the Faithless
description: Wall of the Faithless The Wall of the Faithless is the wall surrounding the City of Judgment on the Fugue Plane . It was erected by Myrkul to punish the souls of beings who claimed no patron god . When a faithful mortal dies , it can then petition their respective gods for entry to their plane of influence .

title: Wall of thorns
description: Wall of thorns Wall of thorns was a conjuration spell that called a dense , thorny thicket into existence . Effects . A tangled mass of wiry scrub with needle - like thorns as long as a human finger was temporarily created by this spell .

title: Walls of Halruaa
description: Walls of Halruaa The Walls were a crescent - shaped mountain range that towered up to 20 , 000 feet ( 6 , 100 meters ) over Halruaa , surrounding the country on three sides . Geography . Prior to the Spellplague the mountains formed a natural defense for the realm .

title: Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih
description: Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih Wan - yen Ch ' eng - shih was the Shou magistrate of Kwachow in 1359 DR . Personality . Wan - yen was a lazy ruler who was disinterested in his post .

title: Wan Tu Ma
description: Wan Tu Ma Wan Tu Ma was a barbarian in Shou Lung . History . Hailing from Ma ' Yuan , Wan worked as a weapon - smith , horseman , and bodyguard for his sometime romantic interest Mei Li Mao .

title: Wanang Sun
description: Wanang Sun Wanang Sun was a male human samurai and the warlord and king of Koryo in Kara - Tur , ruling from the capital city of Xi Hulang . He was the first of the Wanang dynasty . History .

title: Wand
description: Wand Wands are spell - casting implement s commonly used by artificer s , bard s , warlock s , and wizard s alike . Constructed from wood most commonly wands typically have arcane energies of their own . Sometimes this energy allows the caster to simply empower their spell s , while other wands possess the ability to cast their own .

title: Wand of Orcus
description: Wand of Orcus The Wand of Orcus was the primary weapon of the demon lord Orcus . Description . The wand was a black obsidian and iron rod topped with the skull of a human hero once slain by Orcus .

title: Wand of power
description: Wand of power The wand of power was a potent magical item belonging to a god . This god was said to be the father of the goddess Selûne in the legend called the Song of Selûne . History .

title: Wand of the sun
