description: Wand of the sun Wands of the sun were magical item s that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . These wand s discharged a golden ray that was up to 30 yards long .

title: Wanderer ' s Rest
description: Wanderer ' s Rest The Wanderer ' s Rest was a boarding house located in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Location . The Wanderer ' s Rest could be found in the Pilgrims ' District of the City of Delights .

title: Wanderers Mamluk Society
description: Wanderers Mamluk Society The Wanderers Mamluk Society , also known as the Wanderers , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . The Wanderers were the only naval mamluk organization in Zakhara .

title: Wandering Legion
description: Wandering Legion The Wandering Legion was a military organization in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . History . During the reign of the First Caliph , the Wandering Legion rose to oppose the Exalted One and his spreading of the Word of the Loregiver .

title: Wandering Stones
description: Wandering Stones Wandering Stones was a small village located in southern Skelkor , Returned Abeir . Background . The village was named after the remains of the primordial Arambar , a group of massive stones that moved on their own accord every night , creating strange patterns that never took the same shape twice .

title: Wangle ' s Livery
description: Wangle ' s Livery Wangle ' s Livery was a stables in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . It was managed by Wangle Towerstruck . The livery traded in all kinds of livestock , especially horse s , which could be of top - quality .

title: Wangle Towerstruck
description: Wangle Towerstruck Wangle Towerstruck was a male human ranger , an agent of the crown of Cormyr and a member of the Harpers . He managed Wangle ' s Livery in the town of Thunderstone in Cormyr in the late 1360s DR . Activities .

title: War Twins
description: War Twins The War Twins were gods of the Azuposi civilization in Maztica . Matsailema . Matsailema was one of the War Twins .

title: War Wizard of Cormyr
description: War Wizard of Cormyr War Wizard of Cormyr is a prestige class ( in 3rd edition ) and a paragon path ( in 4th edition ) whose members are the elite battle - mage s of Cormyr in the organization of the same name . The War Wizards are among the most respected spellcasters throughout all of Faerûn . Most war wizards serve Cormyr directly , which allows for little time to explore and adventure though some members are allowed to work in a more extended capacity .

title: War Wizards
description: War Wizards The War Wizards were a group of battle - mage s and sorcerer s loyal to the Crown of Cormyr . They were led by the Royal Mage of Cormyr . Around a third of the War Wizards were either killed or driven mad around 1385 DR due to the Spellplague .

title: War chanter
description: War chanter War chanters are virtuous bard s who , more than other bards , choose to emulate rather than to merely sing of the ancient heroes of old . War chanters seek to inspire others to action , while taking it themselves , rousing others to bravery with their own acts of heroism . War chanters do not abandon their bardic roots , however , instead using their music and training to help carry others through battle , preserving their morale , becoming inspiring leaders who fight beside the men and women they lead .

title: War domain
description: War domain The War domain was a suite of spells that were granted by deities whose portfolio included the concepts of honor and chivalry , pillage and destruction , and domination and conquest . Priests who worshiped one of these deities could choose which aspects of their god or goddess they wished to focus on , and if they chose this domain , their repertoire of spells was expanded to include the ones listed below . War Domain Spells .

title: War of Fang and Talon
description: War of Fang and Talon The War of Fang and Talon was a conflict between the dragon s and Primordial s of Abeir . History . The war began some time after the Primordials were granted the world of Abeir by Lord Ao .

title: War of Gold and Gloom
description: War of Gold and Gloom The War of Gold and Gloom was a ongoing war between the gold dwarves from the Great Rift and the gray dwarves from the Underspires over the lost shield dwarf kingdom of Deep Shanatar . History . The war began when the gold dwarves of the Great Rift sent the Army of Gold into the caverns of Taark Shanat .

title: War of the Hart
description: War of the Hart The War of the Hart was a battle that took place between Hartkiller ' s human and giant - kin armies , and the giant s . It took place many thousands of years before the 14th century DR . Hartkiller eventually forced the giants to leave the valley of Hartsvale , but he was killed by a storm giant at the end of the war .

title: War of the Purple Dragon
description: War of the Purple Dragon The War of the Purple Dragon was a brief conflict that occurred in the Hordelands . Events . The Battle .

title: War of the Regency
description: War of the Regency The War of the Regency spanned the years of 1260 DR and 1261 DR in Cormyr . It was a bloody civil war between the rightful king Rhigaerd II against the regent Salember Obarskyr . At the Battle of Hilp , three thousand men died , and a plague ravaged the countryside .

title: War of the Silver Marches
description: War of the Silver Marches The War of the Silver Marches was a conflict against orc s that took place in the Silver Marches in the Year of the Iron Dwarf ' s Vengeance . History . The drow wizard Tsabrak Xorlarrin channeled the Darkening upon the Silver Marches under the orders of Lolth in order to prepare for the war .

title: War of the Spider Queen
description: War of the Spider Queen War of the Spider Queen is a " New York Times " best - selling series of novels set in the " Forgotten Realms " universe published by Wizards of the Coast . The series contains six books focused on the drow and their principle deity Lolth . Each of the six novels in the series is written by a different author with veteran Forgotten Realms author R .

title: War of the Zulkirs
description: War of the Zulkirs The War of the Zulkirs took place in 1375 - 1478 DR between the self - proclaimed regent of Thay , the lich Szass Tam , and the combined forces of the other zulkirs Lallara Mediocros , Nevron , Yaphyll , Lauzoril , Kumed Hahpret , Mythrellan and Samas Kul under the guidance of Dmitra Flass . The war took place at various locations in Thay . Participants .

title: War sphere
description: War sphere The War sphere was a group of spells granted to crusader s . These spells focused on giving advantage in large - scale conflicts , such as those governed by BATTLESYSTEM™ rules , rather than individual or small party confrontations . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition .

title: Warblade ( weapon )
description: Warblade ( weapon ) The Warblade ( also known as the Noble Warrior ' s Blade , or Ary ' Velahr ' Kerym in Elven ) , was one of three Elfblade s created in ancient Cormanthyr to help the elves establish a ruling family . The Warblade was used to name the Arms - Major , the Defender by Arm , as the wielder is called . The barer of the Warblade was responsible for the primary armed forces of the realm at large , known as the Akh ' Velahr .

title: Ward Mossfeld
description: Ward Mossfeld Ward Mossfeld was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Ward , like his brothers , was the member of West Harbor militia .

title: Ward against undead
description: Ward against undead Ward against undead was an abjuration and / or necromancy spell that protected an area against entry by the undead . Effects . There were at least two versions of this spell : an older one that could be cast at a distance , and a newer one that was centered on the spell caster at the time of casting .

title: Warden
description: Warden Wardens are mighty and powerful defenders of the natural world , fighting to preserve the untamed wilderness . Wardens , like fighter s , paladin s , and swordmage s hold the line for their allies , protecting them from harm . In order to fulfill their sworn duties to the spirits of the natural world , wardens train themselves in the use of simple weapons as well as light armor and shield s .

title: Warders
description: Warders The warders were a loose military order based in or around the halfling cities of Luiren . Organization . A particularly large troop of warders found in Beluir was composed of 400 halflings who were all elite specialists with the sling .

title: Wards of Silverymoon
description: Wards of Silverymoon The wards of Silverymoon are a pair of magical protections that utilize a mythal which protect Silverymoon from all sorts of threats . The first ward encompasses an area that surrounds the city as well as 1000 feet beyond the city wall , while the second works in concert with the first and provides further protections to the palace . Full details of the mythal ' s effects , including the effects of the second ward are known to only two people , the High Mage and the ruler of the city , but a few others are trusted enough to be allowed to attune themselves to the wards and be able to control most of their powers .

title: Wards sphere
description: Wards sphere The Wards sphere was a group of spells granted to crusader s and shaman s to help protect items and geographical areas from harm or encroachment . Spells in normal text were listed in the Tome of Magic 2nd edition . Spells in italics were added to the Wards Sphere in the sourcebook .

title: Warehouse District of Huzuz
description: Warehouse District of Huzuz The Warehouse District of Huzuz was the center for the storage of goods for many merchants in 1367 DR . Description . Found within the North Quarter in the northern section of the city , this part of the City of Delights was dominated by large warehouses .

title: Warforged
description: Warforged Warforged are a rare race of humanoid construct s constructed through powerful ritual s . Warforged average between 6 ' and 6 ' 6 " and are made up of bulky ( albeit resilient ) metallic or stone bodies that weigh roughly 270 - 300 lbs . Extremely powerful and durable , warforged are able fighter s .

title: Warhammer
description: Warhammer A warhammer is a one - handed melee weapon . Description . Resembling a large , heavy sledge hammer ( striking surfaces on either side of the head ) , the warhammer was originally adapted from the tools of laborers and craftsmen but is no longer suitable for anything but combat .

title: Warlock
description: Warlock A warlock is an arcane spellcaster who gains power through pacts with powerful entities , most commonly devil s , elder evil s of the Far Realm , fey , or demon s . These pacts allow warlocks to channel powerful abilities of arcane might that would otherwise be closed to them . Davoren Hellsheart and Ammon Jerro are some of Faerûn ' s best known warlocks .

title: Warlock ' s Crypt
description: Warlock ' s Crypt Warlock ' s Crypt or Warlock ' s Keep lay in the Troll Hills on the Sword Coast in west Faerûn . It was home to the ancient lich wizard Larloch the Shadow King , a survivor of the fallen empire of Netheril . The name itself was a corruption of " Larloch ' s Crypt " or " Larloch ' s Keep " .

title: Warlock ( moorhound )
description: Warlock ( moorhound ) Warlock was a large , strong moorhound owned by Earl Blackstone . In 1365 DR , Currag Blackstone set Warlock and the pack of moorhounds on an old man who had approached the gate of the manor . With a spoken command , the man was able to stop the pack of moorhounds and with another , they fled , inexplicably jumping a 20 ' ( 6 .

title: Warlock Knights
description: Warlock Knights The Warlock Knights were the lords of Vaasa in the 15th century DR . Organization . The knights were ruled by the leader of the Ironfell Council , the Voice of Telos .

title: Warlord
description: Warlord Warlords are trained warriors who excel at leading others into combat . Trained in tactics and generally charismatic , warlords direct allies in battle and use words of encouragement to keep them fighting when injured or demoralized . With the proper skill , warlords can direct flanking maneuvers , feints , and other clever tactics in order to overcome the power of their foes .

title: Warmage
description: Warmage Among every class there are individuals who care only for battle . Warmages are arcane spellcasters who live for the din of combat , clashing blades , screams of pain , and , especially , the epic destruction wrought by war . The more utilitarian spells of wizard s , sorcerer s , and bard s have little importance to a warmage ; they favor function over form and are drilled only in spells most useful for smiting foes , sowing confusion , and screening allies .

title: Warmonger genie
description: Warmonger genie Warmonger genies were special tasked genie s who served as strategists and advisors to generals and lords . They were found leading soldiers or mercenaries . If there was not a war to be found then they would usually start one .

title: Warp wood
description: Warp wood Warp wood was a transmutation or alteration spell that could twist and bend wooden objects to degrade their strength or ruin their function . The reverse of this spell , straighten wood , could improve bent or crooked wooden objects , or reverse the effects of " warp wood " . Effects .

title: Warrens
description: Warrens The Warrens are tunnels underneath Dock Ward and Castle Ward in Waterdeep . The Warrens have existed for hundreds of years and are inhabited primarily by gnome s and halfling s . The existence of the tunnels was unknown to most Waterdavians until the gnomes told the halfings about the tunnels and the halflings told everyone else .

title: Warrenwood
description: Warrenwood Warrenwood was a small but densely overgrown forest found near the middle of Bloodstone Barony . The forest ' s name was derived from the Warren fortress found under the ground . Geography .

title: Warrior
description: Warrior Warriors were akin to fighter s although they received less training . Culture . These soldiers were common throughout the " Realms " , either self - taught or trained en - masse as part of an army or other military force .

title: Warrior ' s Rest
description: Warrior ' s Rest Warrior ' s Rest is a neutral inner plane in the cosmology of Toril . With perhaps the most misleading title in the whole cosmology , the theme of the Warrior ' s Rest is battle , and each petitioner has no constant loyalty to a deity . When a petitioner is slain in combat during one of the endless chaotic battles , he rises again on the team that brought him down .

title: Warsh
description: Warsh Warsh was a boatman in the Moonsea region in 1489 DR . Personality . Warsh was a greedy , foul - tempered old man .

title: Wartle
description: Wartle Wartle was a slaad lord and a rival of Ygorl . History . Ygorl defeated him and imprisoned him in the form of a meteor , casting the meteor toward Celestia in the hope that this would destroy him .

title: Wartsnak
description: Wartsnak Wartsnak was an orc wight warlord around 1485 DR . History . Wartsnak was somehow possessed by the pit fiend Baazka and thanks to him he slaughtered the leaders of the Fanged Moon , Gory Maul , and Jagged Scythe tribes and took control of a large orc horde .

title: Wasat
description: Wasat Wasat , or the Middle City , was located in Zakhara on the eastern shore of Suq Bay . Geography . Wasat lay on the major trade route between Huzuz and Hiyal , at the narrow middle of Suq Bay .

title: Wasp
description: Wasp A wasp is a breed of flying , stinging insect . Wasps prey on other insects as a means of keeping their populations in check . Background .

title: Wassen
description: Wassen Wassen was a small farming town nestled along the Goliad River in the Barony of Morov in Damara . Activities . Travelers who preferred quieter surroundings often stopped in Wassen as opposed to nearby Morovar found just downstream .

title: Wastirek
description: Wastirek Wastirek was a black wyrm whose lair was in the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . He was the grandson of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the mate of the black wyrm Vilholin , and the father of the black dragons Woklef , Cheleen , Aswidorg and Kasidikal .

title: Watanabe Kanzo
description: Watanabe Kanzo Watanabe Kanzo was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan who ran a posthouse in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . In a posthouse in the center of an imperial shoen , he led a company of twenty samurai and one hundred bushi .

title: Watanabe Okaji
description: Watanabe Okaji Watanabe Okaji was one of the best actors in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Watanabe was the star of the Imperial Noh Troupe of Fukama , the best noh troupe based in Fukama .

title: Watch - blades
description: Watch - blades The Watch - blades were the city guard of Yhaunn in 1358 DR . Activities . The Watch - blades patrolled the streets of Yhaunn and maintained the general order of the city .

title: Watcher
description: Watcher The Watcher , or He Who Watches and Waits , was a yikarian inhabiting the body of Makin al - Mutrattab in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Personality . The Watcher was extremely patient and cautious , making him the perfect fit for a spy within the Court of Enlightenment .

title: Watcher ' s Keep
description: Watcher ' s Keep Watcher ' s Keep was an ancient castle located south of Amn . Description . It bore its age very well , and all in all , the keep was still in good shape by the 14th century DR .

title: Watcher ' s Knoll
description: Watcher ' s Knoll Watcher ' s Knoll is a good sized hill with a clearing at the top located in Shadowdale . Watcher ' s Knoll can be found northeast of the village of Shadowdale , in the forest . Features .

title: Watcher ' s Mound
description: Watcher ' s Mound A Watcher ' s Mound was a type of campsite found in the Earthspur Mountains of north Faerûn . The Watcher ' s Mounds were constructed and maintained by the monks of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , particularly by their Watchers . They lay throughout the mountains south of the monastery , situated along the trails running down from it .

title: Watchfire Legions
description: Watchfire Legions The Watchfire Legions , also called the Orphans , were part of the standing army of the efreet in the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire . Organization . The 40 , 000 efreet soldiers of the Watchfire Legions were irregulars who received military training .

title: Watchful Eye ( Espar )
description: Watchful Eye ( Espar ) The Watchful Eye was the only inn in Espar , Cormyr . Structure . The building ' s name came from the sign outside which showed the symbol for the god Helm .

title: Watchful Eye ( Essembra )
description: Watchful Eye ( Essembra ) The Watchful Eye was an inn in Essembra around 1368 DR . Structure . The building was a huge and half - timbered converted manor house .

title: Watchful Eye ( Hluthvar )
description: Watchful Eye ( Hluthvar ) The Watchful Eye was the only inn in Hluthvar around 1368 DR . Structure . The building had a roof , shutters , and not much else .

title: Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors
description: Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors While technically one of Waterdeep ' s many guild s , the Watchful Order functions primarily as a mage academy . The Watchful Order polices the use of magic within Waterdeep , encouraging wizards to use magic wisely . The Order provides many services to its members including a venue for trading spell components and magic items .

title: Watchwall
description: Watchwall The Watchwall was a massive , magically engineered length of stone wall , stretching from the fortress city of Glarondar to the slopes of Umbergoth , thus extending the defensive barrier of the Dragonjaw Mountains another fifteen miles , up to a rock - like fortification containing one - third of Aglarond ' s armed forces . It was constructed by the galeb duhr living in Tannath and Undergoth in 1085 DR .

title: Watchware
description: Watchware Watchware was an arcane evocation spell that placed a mental alarm on an inanimate object . Effects . In order to cast this spell , the caster had to touch the object being alarmed .

title: Water
description: Water The element of water was one of the four fundamental building blocks of matter and the source of all fluidity , essential for life , liable to transformations but cyclically reverting to its basic liquid nature . Cosmology . Water manifested its position in the cosmos as the Elemental Plane of Water , one of the Inner Planes .

title: Water Queen ' s House
description: Water Queen ' s House The Water Queen ' s House was a temple of Umberlee in Baldur ' s Gate . Inhabitants . The human , Jalantha Mistmyr , was the lead Storm Priestess of this temple to the Bitch Queen and she was aided by eight cleric s and sixteen followers .

title: Water blast
description: Water blast Water blast was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell turned a regular bottle , or vial , of water into a deadly weapon .

title: Water breathing
description: Water breathing Water breathing was a transmutation or alteration spell that let one or more living , air - breathing creatures breathe water temporarily . The reverse of the spell , air breathing likewise allowed water - breathing creatures to survive out of water . Effects .

title: Water elemental
description: Water elemental Water elementals were elemental creatures of water who were unable to move more than 180 feet ( 55 meters ) from the body of water from which they were conjured . They spoke Aquan although they rarely chose to speak . Combat .

title: Water form
description: Water form Water form was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell transformed the caster or recipient into a creature made from elemental water .

title: Water naga
description: Water naga Water nagas lived within oceans and rivers , protecting hidden treasures claimed by these waterways . They preferred solitude and isolation . Appearance .

title: Water of Eldath
description: Water of Eldath Water of Eldath was a divine magic spell available to priests of Eldath , the Goddess of Singing Waters . It created three flasks of a potion that had many curative and purification abilities . Effects .

title: Water opal
description: Water opal Water opal was a rare and valuable gem stone . Description . Water opal was a clear to translucent gemstone with small flashes of color .

title: Water walk
description: Water walk Water walk was a transmutation or alteration spell that allowed one or more creatures to stride upon liquids or semi - liquids such as water ( flowing or still ) , oil , snow , mud , or quicksand . Effects . While walking on a liquid , the subject ' s feet did not touch the surface but floated one or two inches ( 2 .

title: Waterbane
description: Waterbane Waterbane was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Waterclock Guild
description: Waterclock Guild The Waterclock Guild was a guild founded in Neverwinter by the wizard Lucan Greenharrow and the clockmaker Saborn Rendel . Using the former ' s magic and the latter ' s clockmaking skill , the guild produced clocks that were both accurate and beautiful . Over time , Lucan built the crypts beneath the guild , expanding them using the magic he had learned during his time at the Hosttower of the Arcane in Luskan .

title: Waterdeep
description: Waterdeep Waterdeep , also known as the City of Splendors or the Crown of the North , was the most important and influential city in the North and perhaps in all Faerûn . For this reason it was considered part of the Western Heartlands of the Realms , even though it lay 150 miles north of Daggerford on the shores of the Sword Coast . The city sat " slightly above the 45 degree north latitude line on Toril .

title: Waterdeep ( series )
description: Waterdeep ( series ) Waterdeep ( or Ed Greenwood Presents Waterdeep ) is a series of six stand - alone novels , each written by a different author , that takes place in the city of Waterdeep in 1479 DR , the year in which the fourth edition of the Forgotten Realms takes place . Forgotten Realms creator Ed Greenwood oversaw the project .

title: Waterdhavian ( cheese )
description: Waterdhavian ( cheese ) Waterdhavian cheese was pale with holes and came from Waterdeep . Geography . The cheese was available in most bars in the city and was commonly eaten by the nobility also .

title: Waterfall Kiss
description: Waterfall Kiss Waterfall Kiss was a scented facial wash invented by Jhamanthra Tsathree around the Year of Lightning Storms , 1374 DR . Description . Waterfall Kiss was a secret blend of herbs brewed with water that was clear with a slightly oily feel and a strong scent .

title: Watermaster
description: Watermaster The Watermaster was a hobgoblin sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , the Watermaster was one of the minions of the hill giant Chief Guh in Grudd Haug .

title: Waterorb
description: Waterorb Waterorb was a fungus that grew in the Underdark in shallow water . When mature , it was bulbous in shape and bigger than a human head . If squeezed and wrung out , it yielded about a gallon ( almost four liters ) of potable water .

title: Waters of devotion
description: Waters of devotion Waters of devotion was a potion that could be found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers . The imbiber of this potion was placed under the control of the person who gave it to them .

title: Watersoul genasi
description: Watersoul genasi Watersoul genasi , also known as water genasi , are one of five most common subraces or " manifestations " within the genasi race . Like all genasi manifestations they can be manifested by experienced genasi who have a different primary manifestation but have trained themselves otherwise or have acquired the manifestation as a result of hidden ancestry or environmental conditions . Ecology .

title: Waterspout
description: Waterspout Waterspout was a divine magic spell available to priests of Umberlee , the Bitch Queen , and cleric s of other deities that claimed the ocean as their domain . It created a towering column of water that could pick up objects and creatures , pummel them mercilessly , and then eject them high above the water level . A rare arcane conjuration / summoning version of this spell also existed , mainly used by water elementalist s .

title: Waterstar
description: Waterstar Waterstar , also called achroite or colorless tourmaline , was a rare fancy stone . Description . Waterstar was a colorless and transparent gemstone .

title: Watery death domain
description: Watery death domain Watery Death was a prestige domain granted to certain high - level divine spellcasters , such as kuo - toa n sea mother whip s of Blibdoolpoolp . It bestowed the power to " smite " any non - aquatic creature once a day , and a range of killing water - themed spells . Deities with the Watery Death domain .

title: Watery form
description: Watery form Watery form was an arcane alteration spell that transformed the caster and anything being worn into a quantity of water . Effects . For 50 minutes ( or longer , for higher level casters ) , the caster of " watery form " became essentially a sentient , mobile , puddle of water .

title: Watson Nettlebee
description: Watson Nettlebee Watson Nettlebee was the oldest son and heir of Bertram Nettlebee during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Watson was brave , honest , and forthright .

title: Waukeen
description: Waukeen Waukeen ( pronounced wau - KEEN or wah - KEEN ) was a lesser deity of the Faerûnian pantheon known as the Merchant ' s Friend , Liberty ' s Maiden , and the Golden Lady . Her portfolio included everything related to commerce and the accumulation of wealth through free and fair trade , as well as the beneficial use of wealth to improve civilization . Those that venerated and appeased her included merchants from lowly peddlers to the wealthy owners of trading companies , investors , accountants , entrepreneurs , caravan guides , warehouse owners , philanthropists , deal - makers , moneylenders , and so on .

title: Waukeen ' s Promenade
description: Waukeen ' s Promenade Waukeen ' s Promenade is one of the most impressive structures in Athkatla . It is a huge marketplace , twice the size of Waterdeep ' s market and built as an oval stadium surrounded by terraced 50 - foot walls . The Promenade has 75 - foot - wide levels for consumer and mercantile traffic .

title: Waukeen ' s silver tongue
description: Waukeen ' s silver tongue Waukeen ' s silver tongue was a divine spell , or Channel Divinity prayer , given to worshipers of Waukeen that granted them a second chance at a more favorable outcome in situations requiring diplomacy or when attempting to bluff or intimidate . Better or worse , the second outcome was final .

title: Wave Echo Cave
description: Wave Echo Cave Wave Echo Cave was a great cavern complex within the Sword Mountains . The cavern was known for its mineral wealth as well as its magical properties . Wave Echo Cave was connected to an underground hot spring that continuously boiled near the cavern .

title: Wavecrest
description: Wavecrest Wavecrest is one of two islands that make up the Eyes of Silvanus on the Sea of Fallen Stars . It is situated close to the mouth of the Vilhon Reach . It benefits from the protection of reefs and also the magic of the Emerald Enclave .

title: Waves of sand
description: Waves of sand Waves of sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . With this spell the caster caused the sand surrounding a wagon , or similar vehicle , to undulate like water .

title: Waves of weariness
description: Waves of weariness Waves of weariness was an enchantment spell that could cause a person or creature to either pause in their attack or fall to the ground completely , depending on the target ' s wisdom or intellect . Effects . This spell could affect one creature up to 40 yd ( 36 .

title: Way of Lost Power
description: Way of Lost Power The Way of Lost Power was a small twenty - two page hand written chapbook which contained cryptic hints to guide the reader to sites containing lost magic . Description . The original book was a rather ordinary looking , slim chapbook with the title on the cover .

title: Way of the Manticore
description: Way of the Manticore The Way of the Manticore was a long road that connected the nations of Cormyr and Sembia . The westernmost point of the Way of the Manticore was located at the town of Hilp , where it met Calantar ' s Way . The easternmost part of the Way of the Manticore was the city of Selgaunt in Sembia .

title: Way of the Powrie
description: Way of the Powrie The Way of the Powrie was a road in the Moonsea North . Starting at a bridge crossing the Telstang Brook , north of the village of Ilinvur , it stretched over 100 miles further north , skirting the eastern edge of the Ride before crossing into the Tortured Land s then ending at a bridge over the River Pelauvir near Frozen Flindyke .

title: Wayfork Village
description: Wayfork Village A growing village that is located just North of Trollbark Forest . Its fate is unknown as it either was destroyed by the Spellplague , or like the rest of the civilizations around its area , it was relatively untouched . It is likely still growing into a larger city .

title: Waymoot
description: Waymoot Waymoot was a small town in the King ' s Forest in Cormyr . Locations . It the location of The Moon and Stars , which was , according to Volo , one of the greatest taverns in all of the Realms .

title: Wayrock
description: Wayrock Wayrock is both an island and an 11 , 000 ft . ( 3 , 400 m ) mountain in the Sea of Fallen Stars . It is visible from up to 100 miles ( 161km ) away .

title: Wean mother
description: Wean mother The task of being a Wean mother is delegated to a noble daughter of a noble drow house . Their job is to tend to the needs of a drow infant for 10 years , teaching it language ( low drow , High Drow , Drow Sign Language and undercommon ) , how to manifest it ' s spell - like abilities , and above all to teach it it ' s place in drow society .

title: Weapon - black
description: Weapon - black Weapon - black was a useful substance used by some rogue s and other nocturnal adventurers . Uses . When smeared on metal this substance eliminated the chance of light reflecting off of a blade and alerting guards .

title: Weapon master
description: Weapon master For a weapon master , perfection is found in the mastery of a single melee weapon . A weapon master seeks to unite this weapon of choice with the body to make them one and to use the weapon as naturally and without thought as any other limb . Source of Power .

title: Weapon of concealed wizardry
description: Weapon of concealed wizardry A weapon of concealed wizardry referred to any type of magic weapon where the enchantments were undetectable by magical means . These weapons originated in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Powers .

title: Weather sphere
description: Weather sphere The Weather sphere was a group of spells granted to druid s . These spells could temporarily alter the weather or local conditions for good or ill . Appendix .

title: Weather stasis
description: Weather stasis Weather stasis was an abjuration spell that preserved the weather conditions in a given area for a few hours . Effects . The area of effect for this spell was a cube whose sides were of length 10 ft ( 3 .

title: Weathercote Wood
description: Weathercote Wood Weathercote Woods is a woodland located just west of Anauroch , north of the Lonely Moor , east of the Graypeak Mountains and south of the Fallen Lands in the Savage Frontier . Blue mists and strange lights are often see in the woods . History .

title: Weathertell
description: Weathertell Weathertell was an arcane divination spell that allowed the caster to foresee natural weather conditions a few hours ahead . Effects . This spell had to be cast outdoors where the caster was able to see and hear the current weather conditions .

title: Weave
description: Weave The Weave , controlled by Mystryl or one of her successors , was a way through which raw magic was accessed , tapped into and used by casters of magic . The Weave was the way in which magic presented itself to beings for their use , and it flowed throughout the world , touching almost every corner of existence , with exception of dead - magic zone s . The Weave coexisted with the Shadow Weave .

title: Web
description: Web Web , formerly known as Shan ' s web , was a spell that filled an area with sticky spider - webs that ensnared those caught in the area . Users . The " web " spell could be learned and cast by wizard s and sorcerer s with access to the conjuration school of magic .

title: Web - of - bells
description: Web - of - bells A web - of - bells was a costume originating from Thay typically worn by dancers . History . When Volothamp Geddarm visited Elgath ' s Provisions in Archenbridge in Archendale , in the Dalelands , he tested proprietor Elgath ' s claim that he could locate any desired item for sale within a day by requesting a Thayan web - of - bells dancer ' s costume .

title: Webb Mossfeld
description: Webb Mossfeld Webb Mossfeld was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Webb , like his brothers , was the member of West Harbor militia .

title: Webstone
description: Webstone Webstone was the " Realms " name for spiderweb obsidian . Description . This ornamental stone was an obsidian variety formed by small pieces of the stone cemented together by heat and pressure in a globular mass , the joints showing as wispy , web - like lines .

title: Weeping Desert
description: Weeping Desert The Weeping Desert was a desert located in the Haunted Lands of interior Zakhara . It was a sandy expanse running from limestone hills at the base of the Furrowed Mountains to massive dunes separating it from the Burning Land . By 1367 DR , the Weeping Desert earned its name from the prevalence of undead spirits , such as ghost s , ghost horses , and the undead giant s known as rom .

title: Weeping Friars
description: Weeping Friars The Weeping Friars were an informal group of quasi - ascetics known throughout most of the Savage Frontier . They claimed to believe that there was only a finite amount of pain and suffering in the world , and the more suffering they took upon themselves , the less suffering others would have to endure . They would offer to undergo suffering on a person ' s behalf in exchange for money or items , usually taking the form of alcohol or trinkets .

title: Weeping Garden
description: Weeping Garden The Weeping Garden was a planar location in the House of the Triad , provided by the god Ilmater to provide relief and aid to his most dedicated followers . Access . Only the god Ilmater allowed entry to the Weeping Garden , and he allowed only a select and faithful few , those who demonstrated supreme dedication and selflessness in his name and were themselves in great need of relief .

title: Weeping Rock ( Ilmater )
description: Weeping Rock ( Ilmater ) Weeping Rock was a site related to the faith of Ilmater the Crying God . In the autumn of the Year of the Groaning Hart , 1267 DR , Weeping Rock was the site of a bloody battle between feuding factions of the church of Ilmater . The holy war had broken out around 1265 DR when Archsufferer Bloirt Waelarn of the House of the Broken God in Keltar had denounced his fellow Ilmatari priests of the House of Holy Suffering in Mussum for refusing to relinquish the " Tome of Torment " , the holiest book of the faith .

title: Weeping Unicorn
description: Weeping Unicorn The Weeping Unicorn was an inn and tavern in the city of Calaunt in the Vast , operating around 1358 DR . It was a quiet and comfortable place located by the docks , and of good quality for moderate prices . It was oft - used to do business by villainous sorts .

title: Weeping War
description: Weeping War The Weeping War was a battle that culminated on 15 Flamerule , 714 DR , in which the Akh ' Velahr ( the army of Cormanthor ) were defeated by the invading demonic forces named the Army of Darkness , leading to the fall of the elven city of Myth Drannor , the greatest and most powerful bastion of civilisation by far at the time . Origins . The exact power responsible for the original demonic summoning is unknown , but it is believed to have been a flind or orc shaman , or a human archmage .

title: Weeping Willow Inn
description: Weeping Willow Inn Weeping Willow Inn was an inn in the Mere of Dead Men . It was the only inn for miles around , so was a frequent stop for travellers of that part of the High Road . Location .

title: Weeping Wyvern
description: Weeping Wyvern The Weeping Wyvern was an inn in the city of Tantras in the Vast . Location . The Weeping Wyvern lay close by the eastern wall of Tantras , at the end of Stumble Street .

title: Weet Greenspen
description: Weet Greenspen Weet Greenspen was an alchemist in the Moonsea . History . During of the Rage of Demons , the doppelganger Tak , posing as the Doctor Jubal of the wandering Doctor Jubal ' s Carnival of Curiosities , kidnapped Weet and forced her to brew alchemical items .

title: Wei Do Peak
description: Wei Do Peak Wei Do Peak was a mountain in the eastern Vorkani Mountains in the realm of Koryo in Kara - Tur . Each year after he took the throne in the 1350s DR , a three - day - long ceremony was held on Wei Do Peak to honor King Wanang Sun and his new dynasty . Many monk s and shukenja attended the festival , and bestowed blessings on the king and his court .

title: Weighed in the balance
description: Weighed in the balance Weighed in the balance is a necromancy spell unique to cleric s with the Balance domain . It harms or heals creatures within 30 feet . Effect .

title: Weighty chest
description: Weighty chest Weighty chest was an alteration spell that made an object extremely difficult to move when touched by someone other than the caster . Effects . The caster had to touch the object to cast this spell .

title: Weir
description: Weir Weir trees , also known as weirwoods , were rare trees in Faerûn . Description . Weir trees resembled oak s and could grow huge in their later years .

title: Weird
description: Weird Weird , originally known as Trebbe ' s weird , was an illusion spell that created a deadly phantasm to kill or injure multiple victims . Effects . This spell functioned in the same manner as " phantasmal killer " , except that it could affect more than one target .

title: Weirdstone
description: Weirdstone Weirdstones were powerful magic al trinkets that impeded many spells and abilities which allowed extradimensional movement and scry ing . Description . Though made of cut glass , a " weirdstone " appeared to be a faceted diamond about the size of a humanoid ' s clenched fist .

title: Weldrarn Orblin
description: Weldrarn Orblin Weldrarn Orblin was a magister who held the title for less than a year in 242 DR . Personality . Weldrarn was an arrogant and brutal wizard .

title: Well of Dragons
description: Well of Dragons The Well of Dragons was a citadel operated by the Cult of the Dragon in the canyonlands near the Sunset Mountains . The site was a legendary graveyard of dragons and historically many dragons would travel to the Well of Dragons to die . Cultists freed the shadow dragon guardian of the site and built a citadel where they carried out their activities which mainly involved attempting to transform dragon s into dracoliches .

title: Well of Kashan
description: Well of Kashan The Well of Kashan was an enchanted oasis found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate , in 1367 DR . Geography . The Well of Kashan was found somewhere within the Genies ' Anvil of the High Desert near a stone called the Hand of Makti .

title: Well of the Cloven Rock
description: Well of the Cloven Rock The Well of the Cloven Rock was a popular well and oasis in Anauroch . Geography . The oasis was located in the Hills of Scent in the Sword , about 60 miles ( 97 kilometers ) east of Elah ' zad .

title: Wellspring Endless
description: Wellspring Endless The Wellspring Endless was a legendary pool said to exist somewhere in the Forest of Mir . By 1370 DR , it had still not been discovered , if it had ever existed at all . Description .

title: Welsea Parenthe
description: Welsea Parenthe Welsea Parenthe was a vampire sorcerer and Zhentarim agent in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Welsea normally stick to the shadows , but when forced by circumstances to go into the open , she tried to conceal her features .

title: Welwyn Tracegar
description: Welwyn Tracegar Welwyn Tracegar was a War Wizard of Cormyr . History . Around 1479 DR , Welwyn was among the many War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail .

title: Wemic
description: Wemic A wemic was a creature with the upper body of a humanoid and the lower body of a lion . Like centaur s , they were considered " taur ic " creatures . Wemics were found primarily in The Shaar , but also in many other lands of Faerûn .

title: Wenda Wildeye
description: Wenda Wildeye Wenda Wildeye was an infamous bandit and mage operating out of the Serpent Valley in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . Wenda Wildeye used the Serpent Valley as a hideout and mustering area . While preparing for another raid , the commander of the Legendary Campaign came to put an end to the banditry .

title: Wendonai
description: Wendonai Wendonai was a balor lord who in - 11500 DR was tasked by Lolth with seducing the Sethomiir clan , rulers of the Ilythiiri , into her worship and granting them evil magics . He succeeded and was probably the greatest ( but by no means the only ) influence on the fall of the dark elves . After the Descent , Wendonai continued his work , acting as an adviser , tutor , and sometimes consort to the most powerful drow Matron Mother s .

title: Wengwater
description: Wengwater The Wengwater was a tributary of Lake Weng in Amn . Description . The river was fast and had dangerous rapids .

title: Wenslan Amthur
description: Wenslan Amthur Wenslan Amthur was a priest of Deneir at the temple of Deneir in the city of Procampur in the Vast . History . By " circa " 1361 DR , Amthur was Prelate or Hierarch of the temple of Deneir in Procampur , where he had the title of High Scrivener .

title: Wenszrin
description: Wenszrin Wenszrin was a doppelganger and a baron of the city of Calaunt in the Vast in 1358 DR . Activities . Together with Uthorn , a fellow baron and doppelganger , Wenszrin commanded the city ' s standing army , The Teeth of Calaunt , with all warcaptains reporting to the two barons .

title: Werebear
description: Werebear A werebear is a shapeshifter able to transform into a bear . Most werebears are good - natured and desire to help others in their communities . They see themselves as the guardians standing between the natural world and civilization .

title: Wereboar
description: Wereboar A wereboar was a humanoid or giant lycanthrope that was bitten by another wereboar . Wereboars were often of neutral alignment but hunted anything for food . Any humanoid or giant that survived a wereboar ' s bite could be infected with the curse , thus becoming a wereboar themselves .

title: Werecrocodile
description: Werecrocodile Werecrocodiles were lycanthrope s whose animal form was that of a crocodile . They preferred to live in swamps or flooded plains and had a taste for human flesh . In human form , werecrocodiles often used a khopesh sword ; in crocodile form they preferred to grab their opponent and hold it underwater .

title: Werefox
description: Werefox Werefoxes a type of lycanthrope that are mostly female , thus they are often referred to as foxwomen . Description . In humanoid form , all foxwomen have lustrous silver hair sporting a widow ' s peak , appearing incredibly attractive .

title: Weregund
description: Weregund Weregund was a trader in who owned the General Store in the town of Shadowdale . Biography . Weregund was a longstanding plant of Zhentil Keep in the town .

title: Werehyena
description: Werehyena Werehyenas were humans in Zakhara who could transform into a hyena - like form . Description . Most werehyenas were male and usually had long shaggy hair .

title: Werelion
description: Werelion Werelions were human s in Zakhara who could assume a lion form . Description . Werelions were usually thin and sinewy while in human form .

title: Wererat
description: Wererat Wererats ( alternately known as ratmen ) are lycanthrope s common in urban areas . Wererats could transform into dire rat s . Physical Description .

title: Weretiger
description: Weretiger Weretigers were usually female . They tended to hide from civilized society , assuming the role of witches or hermits in the wild . Many weretigers took the time to learn magical arts to enhance this façade .

title: Werewolf
description: Werewolf Werewolves are a type of shape - changing monster in Faerûn that are vulnerable to silver or enchanted weapons and can regenerate most wounds . Infected werewolves transform during the full moon involuntarily . Members of their race that are born with the curse can infect others and can control their shifting .

title: Werond Torophar
description: Werond Torophar Werond Torophar was a teamster on the Sword Coast just before the Tyranny of Dragons . Personality . Werond was a quiet but romantic woman .

title: Werz Saltbaron
description: Werz Saltbaron Werz Saltbaron was a duergar merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Werz was a merchant with dealings with some corrupt officials like Gorglak .

title: Wesclodat
description: Wesclodat Wesclodat the Aged was a human Deneir an priest of unknown origins . Description . In his old age , Wesclodat retained only thin whisps of long , white hair , and a similar beard .

title: Wessalen Arturia
description: Wessalen Arturia Wessalen Arturia was a human paladin of Lathander from Cimbar , Chessenta . He sailed the Pirate Isles in 1359 DR . Activities .

title: Wessic
description: Wessic Wessic the Wizened was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon under Severin Silrajin . History . Wessic was an old cultist and , alongside Sorvic and Maelgot , was one of the bodyguards of Talis Kasterel in the Cult ' s occupied hunting lodge in the Greypeak Mountains .

title: West Center
description: West Center The West Center was a ward of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Found in the Central District , this ward controlled all activity through the Suq Gate , Harbor Gate , and the Grand Bazaar .

title: West Cwm
description: West Cwm The West Cwm was a large high valley in the Shaeradim , the hills surrounding Evereska . In the south , there was a large deep lake of very cold water , and to the east lay the Vine Vale , through the Sunset Gate . It was the site of the Battle of the Cwm between the daemonfey army and the defending elves of Evereska and Evermeet .

title: West Faerûn
description: West Faerûn The western part of Faerûn includes the nations south of Waterdeep and north of the Shining Sea , that border along the Sea of Swords . It also includes the multitude of islands that lie to the west in the vast ocean called the Trackless Sea . The closely - linked nations of Amn , Tethyr , and Calimshan have been collectively termed the " Lands of Intrigue " .

title: West Harbor
description: West Harbor West Harbor was a small village near the southern end of the Mere of Dead Men along the Sword Coast . Geography . West Harbor is located in Mere of Dead Men , south of Highcliff .

title: West Wall
description: West Wall West Wall was a district of the drow city of Menzoberranzan . Geography . West Wall encompassed the area next to the entire western wall of the cavern where Menzoberranzan was located , from Tier Breche in the north to Narbondellyn in the south .

title: West Zakhara
description: West Zakhara West Zakhara was a giant peninsula that contained the arid plateau of the High Desert , populated by nomadic tribes , in the north , and the wealthy Pearl Cities , centers of trade , in the south . Geography . The only land connection to the rest of the Land of Fate lay towards the north , where the edge of the Mountains of the Lizard ' s Tongue met the area around Qudra .

title: Westbridge
description: Westbridge Westbridge was a village along the Long Road . It stood at the intersection of the Long Road and the trail to the Stone Bridge . As of 1368 DR , all the major industries in Westbridge , including the market , stockyard and grain warehouses , were owned by a halfling named Ghaliver Longstocking .

title: Western Heartlands
description: Western Heartlands The Western Heartlands is a region located in West Faerûn . The Western Heartlands stretch west from Cormyr and the Dragon Coast to the east , and slowly blend into the coastal Sword Coast region at the Sea of Swords . The city of Baldur ' s Gate is the strongest city in the Western Heartlands and also Faerûn ' s most powerful , along with Evereska ; due to a massive influx of refugees created by the Spellplague , the city has swelled and grown as big as half of Elturgard .

title: Westgate
description: Westgate Westgate was a seedy and squalid metropolis — with a history in piracy , powerful crime syndicates , and nameless vampiric crime - lords . Westgate thrived on blackmarket trade and corruption , and was perhaps one of the most sordid cities in all of Faerûn . The legacy of scoundrels and spies was found in every alley , and danger lurked for the unprepared in every corner .

title: Westgate Ruby
description: Westgate Ruby Westgate Ruby was a wine exported from Westgate . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Westways
description: Westways The Westways were a series of tunnels and roads that led west from the drow city of Menzoberranzan to Blingdenstone and Mithral Hall , as well as to Mantol - Derith and Phanlinksal . Description . The Westways tunnels were heavily patrolled by drow forces near Menzoberranzan .

title: Westwood
description: Westwood Westwood was a forest on the Sword Coast North on the eastern edge of the Sword Mountains . Geography . The closest settlement to Westwood was Kheldell which sat on the north western edge of the wood at the bottom of the Sword Mountains .

title: Wetwoods
description: Wetwoods The Wetwoods was an area of wooded and grazing land south of the Wet River in the Vilhon Reach area . Geography . Two - thirds of the southern area of the Wetwoods was a misty bog with fungus - coated trees .

title: Whale
description: Whale Whales were the largest mammals in the world . They were gentle sea - dwelling creatures that migrate from place to place in the oceans . While peaceful , whales are known to only attack ships and other sea creatures when provoked .

title: Whamite Isles
description: Whamite Isles The Whamite Isles consisted of a number of islands in the Sea of Fallen Stars . History . During the Twelfth Serôs War , Iakhovas reintroduced the kelpie species of sentient seaweed , long extinct in the Realms , back to the sea .

title: Wheel of bones
description: Wheel of bones Wheel of bones was a divine magic spell available to specialty priest s and other followers of Eldath , the Green Goddess . It created a whirling weapon of bone fragments around one appendage of the caster that could be used as both a melee weapon and a ranged weapon . Effects .

title: Whelgar Taerncole
description: Whelgar Taerncole Whelgar Taerncole was a human man of the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was a former adventurer and proprietor of the Sleeping Cat restaurant . Whelgar was once an adventurer and a member of the Easy Blades Adventuring Band , a group often suspected of smuggling .

title: Wheloon
description: Wheloon Wheloon , sometimes nicknamed the " Jade Towers " , was a town and later small city in the kingdom of Cormyr in interior Faerûn . It lay at the junction of the Wyvernflow River and the Way of the Manticore and at the end of the Hullack Trail in southeastern Cormyr . Language .

title: Wheloon Moothouse
description: Wheloon Moothouse The Wheloon Moothouse was a meeting hall located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It stood on Wheloon Way , opposite Oldstone Hall . The moothouse served as Wheloon ' s courthouse and a hall for meetings .

title: Wheloon Tack & Leather
description: Wheloon Tack & Leather Wheloon Tack & Leather was a store located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr that sold leather goods . Its proprietor was Landon Bhentyl . The store sold leather products of all kinds .

title: Wheloon Watch
description: Wheloon Watch The Wheloon Watch was a militia and law - enforcement organization that operated in Wheloon in Cormyr , in the 14th century DR . Organization . The Wheloon Watch was a militia force of volunteers , all merchants and tradesmen by day , with basic fighting ability .

title: Wheloon Watch House
description: Wheloon Watch House The Wheloon Watch House was a watch house located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It stood at the intersection of Wheloon Way and the Way of the Manticore . The watch house was a base for the Wheloon Watch and also served as a barracks for the local Purple Dragons .

title: Whip
description: Whip A whip ( the common name for what we call a bullwhip ) is an exotic , one - handed melee reach weapon that only does non - lethal damage . Description . The whip is a long , flexible , braided leather cord which tapers gradually from the handle to the tip .

title: Whip sash
description: Whip sash Whip sashes were special weapons used by Holy slayer assassin s in Zakhara . Description . Outwardly , these weapons appeared as regular silk sashes .

title: Whiptail
description: Whiptail Whiptail was a lizardfolk member of the Muckmarsh tribe in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Whiptail was very resolute but believed heavily in superstitions .

title: Whirlchain
description: Whirlchain Whirlchain was a divine evocation spell that created a chain that battered one ' s foe . Effect . The spell conjured a chain around the target creature in a helix fashion , that then whipped and battered the victim before disappearing .

title: Whirling blade
description: Whirling blade Whirling blade is a relatively powerful spell learned by some swordmage s early in their training . When a swordmage casts " whirling blade " he or she first throws a melee weapon of their choice at a target within twenty - five , using the power of the spell to keep the weapon aloft in the air , striking the creature with deadly force . If they miss the first target , a swordmage may spend their weapon twirling towards another creature within ten feet of the first .

title: Whirling scimitar
description: Whirling scimitar The whirling scimitar was a Zakhara n magic al weapon that could bestow the ability to fly . Description . This item usually appeared as a scimitar , but versions in the form of a broadsword or two - handed sword also existed .

title: Whirlpool
description: Whirlpool Whirlpool was an arcane alteration spell that created a large swirling vortex in a body of water that could pull creatures and ships down into the depths . Effects . This spell took ten minutes to cast and could be directed at a point up to 420 ft ( 128 m ) away .

title: Whirlwind
description: Whirlwind Whirlwind was an evocation spell that created a small but powerful tornado that could be directed along the ground or over a body of water . The goddesses Akadi and Aerdrie Faenya granted their own version of this spell . Effects .

title: Whirlwind ( Akadi )
description: Whirlwind ( Akadi ) This whirlwind spell was an extremely powerful version of the " whirlwind " spell that was only given to priests of Akadi , the Queen of Air , and Aerdrie Faenya , the Winged Mother . It created a towering rotational vortex on land or sea that destroyed most everything in its path . Effects .

title: Whirlwind ( horse )
description: Whirlwind ( horse ) The Whirlwind was a legendary horse living in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Personality . The Whirlwind had a vicious temperament and actually appeared to enjoy fighting .

title: Whisper
description: Whisper Whisper was a cruel and calculating mage with great ambition , but he angered the wrong group of adventurers . Working as an agent of the Zhentarim in northern Cormyr , he spied on trade routes and troop movements , organizing raids and ambushes . His ambition was to rise in the ranks of the Zhentarim and also head up his own secret society .

title: Whisper ( Luskan )
description: Whisper ( Luskan ) Whisper was a vicious criminal in Luskan . Activities . Whisper was a criminal with a vile reputation .

title: Whispering Children
description: Whispering Children The Whispering Children were twenty - two powerful artifact s in the form of portraits . In reality , they were the transformed demi - power children of the god Oghma . The paintings were referred to as Whispering Children because they whispered secrets to those nearby .

title: Whispering Serpent
description: Whispering Serpent The Whispering Serpent was the main advisor of the rulers of Sammaresh in Lapaliiya . Believed to be the ghost of a couatl , in truth he was a living couatl using " ethereal jaunt " . He advised Lady Ilnara Mremman around 1373 DR .

title: Whispering of the wind
description: Whispering of the wind The whispering of the wind was a special ritual used by sha ' ir s to enhance their gen ' s hearing ability . Preparation . All rituals that enhanced a gen ' s hearing required a set of earrings studded with valuable gems worth at least 500 dinar s .

title: Whispering sand
description: Whispering sand Whispering sand was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell imbued a handful of sand with a message from the caster .

title: Whistler
description: Whistler Whistlers were special halfling bard s found commonly in Luiren in the Shining South . Requirements . Only halfling bards could be whistlers .

title: Whistling Wizard
description: Whistling Wizard The Whistling Wizard was an inn in Voonlar that catered to adventurers and had a shady reputation around the Moonsea region . It was also famous for a cistern in its basement , called the Wizard Well , that would talk to people and give advice . Location .

title: Whitchthorn
description: Whitchthorn Whitchthorn was a powerful archfey of Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . Activities . Whitchthorn was the ruler of all the fey living in Kryptgarden .

title: White Agate ' s Tower
description: White Agate ' s Tower The White Agate ' s Tower was located within the Court District of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . The mansion was situated around the base of the tower .

title: White Lady
description: White Lady The White Lady was a amnesiac elf lady in Waterdeep in 1479 DR . History . One day in 1479 a elderly lady in white dress arrived in Yawning Portal tavern .

title: White Maw
description: White Maw White Maw was a massive intelligent gray ooze in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR . History . White Maw was the result of one of the experiments of the transmuter Sarkalla to create a sentient ooze beside the Ooze Master .

title: White Worm
description: White Worm The Tribe of the White Worm , or simply White Worm , were a barbarian tribe dwelling in northern Vaasa , beside the Great Glacier , and in the Earthspur Mountains around the Glacier of the White Worm , in north Faerûn . They saw the white worm — an albino remorhaz — as their totem beast and were notoriously unwelcoming of strangers . Infamously , they fought for Zhengyi , the Witch - King , but did turn away from his evil .

title: White copper ring of fire
description: White copper ring of fire The white copper ring of fire was a unique magical ring that was forged by the djinn to aid them against the efreet . Description . This ring was made from white copper .

title: White dragon
description: White dragon White dragons ( also known as ice dragons or glacial wyrms ) were the weakest and most feral of the classic chromatic dragon s . Description . White dragons were physically the smallest of the chromatic dragons , even smaller than black dragon s .

title: Whitey
description: Whitey Whitey was a promising young assassin of the Night Masks in 1370 DR . History . Whitey was born in the Shore area of Westgate in the Year of the Morningstar , 1350 DR .

title: Whyllwyst
description: Whyllwyst Whyllwyst was a gray and the familiar of Araevin Teshurr . It died over eight years ago , based on the current year being 1374 DR . Discrepancy .

title: Wibisono
description: Wibisono Wibisono was a pirate leader in Panjardu . History . Wibisono was born in Nahdatul on the isle of Bawa in the merchant caste , but soon he went ro Djagong , where he joined the yakuza .

title: Widowmaker
description: Widowmaker Widowmaker was the moniker of a powerful great scimitar wielded by a tasked slayer genie called the Head Taker . " Widowmaker " was one of two dangerous swords wielded by the Head Taker , with the other being " Firefiend " . Powers .

title: Wiggan Nettlebee
description: Wiggan Nettlebee Wiggan Nettlebee was the patriarch of the halfling Nettlebee in the Dessarin Valley clan during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Wiggan disliked outsiders , believing all of them to be evildoers who would steal from him if they could .

title: Wigglefingers
description: Wigglefingers Wigglefingers was a mage and captain of Morada Topolino , the assassin / thieves ' guild run by Pericolo Topolino in Delthuntle . Description . Wigglefingers wore a mustache .

title: Wight
description: Wight A wight was an undead creature given a semblance of life through sheer violence and hatred . They could drain the life energy out of victims by touch , turning them into new wights upon death . Wights appeared as a weird and twisted reflections of the forms they had in life .

title: Wigluf
description: Wigluf Wigluf was a stone giant who helped Blagothkus in managing the flying Skyreach Castle . Personality . Wigluf was very concerned about Blagothkus ' plan to ally with dragon s and the Cult of the Dragon .

title: Wild Yak Meadows
description: Wild Yak Meadows The Wild Yak Meadows formed a large portion of the Katakoro Plateau in the Hordelands . Geopgraphy . The Wild Yak Meadows were surrounded by Nor Tso on the east , the Hungste River to the south , the Muren Tso to the north , and the mountains of Katakoro Shan to the west .

title: Wild dog
description: Wild dog Wild dogs roam throughout Faerûn . They do not usually approach humanoids unless they are starving or they have been provoked . Species .

title: Wild dwarf
description: Wild dwarf Wild dwarves , also know as jungle dwarves and dur Authalar ( " the People " ) , were primitive dwarves who inhabited the Jungles of Chult and the Mhair and Black Jungle s . Description . This dwarven subrace was little - known except by those familiar with the jungles of South Faerûn .

title: Wild elf
description: Wild elf Wild elves or green elves , also known as Sy - tel - quessir , are a feral , stealthy subrace of the elven species that have become more and more reclusive over the years . As of 1374 DR , they are an extremely insular race who remain close to nature and are rarely seen by other races . They have a heavier build and darker skin than other elf subraces despite having a similar average height .

title: Wild halfling
description: Wild halfling Wild halflings were halfling s native to Far Payit and other jungles in Maztica . Society . They were extremely primitive and wore no clothing but painted their bodies with red and black paint .

title: Wild mage
description: Wild mage Wild mages are powerful sorcerer s or specialist wizard s who have chosen to master the unpredictable art of casting wild magic , a form of arcane magic noted for its erratic behavior and random effects . Devastatingly powerful , wild mages believe the attempts of others to codify and define magic is a useless pursuit that can end only in failure . Instead , wild mages seek out what they consider magic in its purest form , accepting the risks that come along with wild magic in exchange for the chance to realize even more power in the random chance of a single spell .

title: Wild magic
description: Wild magic Wild magic zones were areas where the Weave was damaged or distorted . In such areas , a spell could backfire upon its caster , target the wrong location , be dramatically increased in power , or indeed , anything could occur . These areas were thought to have been caused by the titanic battles of the god s during the Time of Troubles .

title: Wildcat stalker
description: Wildcat stalker Wildcat stalkers are beastmaster ranger s who have a special bond with feline s such as panther s or wildcat s . Less social than other animals , felines are nonetheless valuable as beast companions for their stealth and swiftness and wildcat stalkers seek to evoke these qualities within themselves by taking on a feline as their friend and ally . Wildcat stalkers learn to mimic the behavior of felines , darting in silently only to retreat as swiftly as they come .

title: Wilddwarf Brigade
description: Wilddwarf Brigade The Wilddwarf Brigade ( also known as the Wilddwarves ) was a dwarven battlerager squad in Citadel Adbar . History . In 1484 DR , the Wilddwarves were led by a dwarf simply known as Crunch .

title: Wilderness domain
description: Wilderness domain The forests and plains , deserts and mountains and all the places untouched by the hand of civilization have a connection with the deities of the wilderness domain . Corellon , the protector , is one of these deities , as seen by a lot of the forests in the reaches of the feywild has had there lush beauty shaped by him . And the beauty of the archetypal forest homes that the eladrin reside in are one of the many lush examples of his contributions to nature .

title: Wildfire
description: Wildfire Wildfire was a peculiar phenomenon observed once or twice a year in the city of Raven ' s Bluff and was defined as the ability to use magic when placed in dangerous situations , albeit haphazardly and in a chaotic fashion . It manifested itself in a small portion of the residents , and people who exhibited signs of wildfire were always native residents of Raven ' s Bluff who had no formal training in the arcane arts . The Warlord Myrkyssa Jelan discovered the reason for this : a wild mythal , built by the Dark Elves .

title: Wildhound Court
description: Wildhound Court Wildhound Court was a courtyard in the Mountainside neighborhood of Waterdeep . It ' s name was derived from the strange effect it had on stray dogs who seem to be attracted to the courtyard by an old curse . Dogs who entered the courtyard often turned savage and formed a pack even if they were normally docile .

title: Wildwoods
description: Wildwoods Wildwoods was a mansion located in the King ' s Forest near Waymoot in Cormyr . Inhabitants . The original owner of the mansion was a wizard named Orthaerus Manycloaks .

title: Wilfred
description: Wilfred Private Wilfred was a male human living in Neverwinter in 1484 DR , serving as soldier in the army of Lord Dagult Neverember . Under orders from Sergeant Knox , he fought against an undead horde commanded by Valindra Shadowmantle . He was the first to meet a new adventurer arriving in the city .

title: Will - o ' - wisp
description: Will - o ' - wisp Will - o ' - wisps , also called will - o ' - the - wisps , are malicious fey creatures often seen floating over lakes or within swamps . They enjoy leading lone travelers off the beaten path at night . As the traveler follows the ghost ly light into a dangerous swamp , the will - o ' - wisp then extinguishes its light , leaving the traveler lost within a dark swamp where it is easy pray for the wisp or any other malicious creatures .

title: Will Turnstone
description: Will Turnstone Will Turnstone was a halfling scout and a companion of Dorn Graybrook during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Will was a halfing scout .

title: William
description: William William was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . William was a villager , who got tired of his life , since he had take care of his child with Juni every day ( which made him look much older ) .

title: William ( halfling )
description: William ( halfling ) William was the mayor of the halfling town of Waukeshire in Bloodstone Barony in 1357 DR . Activities . William liked to make long , formal speeches .

title: William Horgath
description: William Horgath Duke William Horgath , most commonly know as William the Lazy , was the eight duke of Arcata in Damara in 1357 DR and 1359 DR . History . In 1357 William the Lazy , in league with the Grandfather of Assassins , gathered an army to conquer the Barony of Bloodstone .

title: William O ' Connor
description: William O ' Connor William O ' Connor is an award - winning fantasy illustrator who has contributed to many role - playing games . He is the author and illustrator of the Dracopedia trilogy . Education .

title: Willing Smile
description: Willing Smile The Willing Smile was a brothel in Suzail with a reputation as a seedy establishment that employed workers too young or too old for mainstream clients . In reality , it was a clean and quiet , if somewhat rundown house of pleasure . Inhabitants .

title: Willow
description: Willow The willow was a type of tree found in Faerûn . Locations . Willow trees with droopy branches grew on hillsides in the Rimwood area of the forest of Cormanthor .

title: Wilton Mortaire
description: Wilton Mortaire Wilton Mortaire was a sergeant in the Zhent army that occupied Daggerdale in 1369 DR but was also an honorable man . History . Wilton Mortaire was a member of the Zhentarim and became a sergeant in the Zhent army that occupied Daggerdale in 1369 DR .

title: Wind ( province )
description: Wind ( province ) The province of wind in the Zakhara n view of magic was a group of spells related to the element of air , felt most clearly in the free - roaming winds in the Land of Fate . The four elemental provinces played a very similar role for Zakharan magic - users as the eight ( or nine ) schools of magic did for Faerûn ian ones . Elemental mage s in Zakhara specialized exclusively in one province , like wind , while sorcerers took spells from two provinces , shunning the other two .

title: Wind blade
description: Wind blade Wind blade was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created a wind - made invisible sword that the caster could instantly extend and retract from his hand .

title: Wind blast
description: Wind blast Wind blast was a divine magic spell given to priests of Aerdrie Faenya . It created a powerful gust of wind that struck all in the area of effect with blunt force . Effects .

title: Wind burial
description: Wind burial A wind burial was a common type of burial used by the Tuigan . The bodies of commoners were placed on simple wooden frames . Offerings were placed around the body , and it was left exposed to the elements until the remains and structure crumbled into dust .

title: Wind carpet
description: Wind carpet Wind carpet was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell allowed the caster , or someone they touched , to command a flying carpet created from a glowing magical force .

title: Wind compass
description: Wind compass Wind compass was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . This spell was only usable by wizard s . Effects .

title: Wind of Fate
description: Wind of Fate The Wind of Fate was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Haku , the Zakharan god of freedom and personal independence . The symbol of the Wind of Fate was a blowgun . Activities .

title: Wind of Quick Death
description: Wind of Quick Death The Wind of Quick Death was a pirate who sailed the Golden Gulf in 1367 DR . Activities . The Wind of Quick Death attacked merchant ships traveling along the Southeastern Sea Route until he was successfully defeated by the Admirality of Huzuz .

title: Wind servant
description: Wind servant Wind servant was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster to summon and control a weak air elemental to manipulate air currents and winds . There was a divine and an arcane version of this spell that differed mainly in duration and scope . Effects .

title: Wind shadow
description: Wind shadow Wind shadow was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell caused the target to assume a nearly weightless , translucent form that was capable of gliding on a breeze .

title: Wind walker
description: Wind walker Wind walkers , or maswat - rih , were rare creatures from the Elemental Plane of Air where they served the djinn . They could be found in Zakhara high in the mountains or in caves located deep underground . A distinct whistling or roaring sound preceded the approach of a group of wind walkers .

title: Wind wall
description: Wind wall Wind wall is an evocation spell that deflects arrows , smaller creatures , and gases . Effect . An invisible vertical curtain of wind appears .

title: Windharrow
description: Windharrow Windharrow was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Howling Hatred at the Temple of Howling Hatred in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . He was at heart an opportunist .

title: Winding Water
description: Winding Water The Winding Water was a river located along the Sword Coast , roughly 250 miles north of Baldur ' s Gate and the River Chionthar . It flowed from several tributaries , some as far away as the Marsh of Chelimber , and eventually flowed into the Sea of Swords south of the Troll Hills . Notable locations along the river were Boareskyr Bridge , Trollclaw Ford , and Serpent ' s Cowl .

title: Winding Way
description: Winding Way The Winding Way was a tavern located in the center of Soubar in the Western Heartlands . History . The tavern was also the home of Mag , a mysterious woman who owned the bar around 1367 DR .

title: Windle
description: Windle Windle was a member of the Harpers in 1489 DR . Personality . Windle was a sly but dutiful individual .

title: Windon Lumbus
description: Windon Lumbus Windon Lumbus was a halfling boy in the Moonsea . Activities . Windon lived with his family at the Lumbus farm , near the village of The Stop .

title: Windriders
description: Windriders The Windriders were an all - but - retired mercenary company based in Chondath . History . They fought during the war against the arcanaloth Yrkhetep and were decisive in defeating the yugoloth ' s army in Hades .

title: Windrise Ports
description: Windrise Ports The Windrise Ports were a loose confederation of independent , free port cities on the southeastern shores of the Dragon Sea . Those ports served as bastions of trade and civilization in Returned Abeir . Geography .

title: Windsong Tower
description: Windsong Tower Windsong Tower was the physical location of a school of magic in the elven city of Myth Drannor . After Myth Drannor ' s fall , the central tower was all but razed but other portions of the school survived . As of 1376 DR , many ruins of the school still existed .

title: Windsoul genasi
description: Windsoul genasi Windsoul genasi , also known as air genasi , are one of the five main " manifestations " or subraces of the genasi race . The name " windsoul genasi " usually refers to genasi for whom the manifestation is their primary one , though like all of the genasi manifestations it is possible for genasi of another subrace to learn how to manifest it . Ecology .

title: Windtomb
description: Windtomb Windtomb was a spell unique to Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Effects . This spell created an impenetrable tomb of wind that surrounded the target .

title: Windvane
description: Windvane Windvane was a spear forged by the drow wizard Vizeran DeVir , and wielded by Aerisi Kalinoth during her time as the leader of the Cult of the Howling Hatred . History . Vizeran DeVir , a drow worshiper of the Elder Elemental Eye , forged the spear " Windvane " using part of the essence of Yan - C - Bin , Prince of Evil Air , in a temple known as the Fane of the Eye .

title: Windwalker ( artifact )
description: Windwalker ( artifact ) The Windwalker was a magical artifact of the ancient Rus , who brought it to the eastern parts of Faerun , where their descendants , the Rashemi , continued to use it . Description . The artifact itself was an amulet resembling a small , golden dagger , 3 inches long , encased in a rune - carved sheath hung from a chain ( also of gold ) .

title: Windwalker ( novel )
