description: Windwalker ( novel ) Windwalker is the third and final book in the Starlight and Shadows trilogy by Elaine Cunningham . Summary . The novel opens with the Battle of Immil Dale ( 1360 DR ) , in which the Tuigan Horde has engaged the berserkers of Rashemen in a dead - magic zone .

title: Wine
description: Wine Wine was an alcoholic beverage popular throughout the Realms . Most wines were poured into wooden casks for transport . The casks were then tapped by innkeepers or other consumers .

title: Winefiddle
description: Winefiddle Winefiddle was once a member of the group known as the King ' s Men . Physical Description . He is a rotund man with thinning brown hair and puffy red cheeks .

title: Winemaker genie
description: Winemaker genie Winemaker genies were unique tasked genie s dedicated to making the best possible wines in Zakhara . They were believed to have originally been created from marid and therefore considered by some to be the greatest of all tasked genies . Some hakima s and seers believed that winemaker genies were exiled noble marid s who were punished for transgressions within the marid court .

title: Wing - ta
description: Wing - ta The Wing - ta was a monastic order based in the town of Goisho in Koryo . For many years , the Wing - ta monks tended a shrine outside Goisho , the centerpiece of which was the Hu ' i Wing , a massive magical brazier that revealed the future and was one of the most valued relics of Koryo . However , some ten generations before 1357 DR , Kozakura n forces stole the Hu ' i Wing and carried it off to Karak , and they built it into their fortress there .

title: Winged Bulls
description: Winged Bulls The Winged Bulls were a faction within the Everlasting in 1367 DR . Base of Operations . The Winged Bulls were based in the fortress of Sarahin located deep within the Haunted Lands .

title: Winged serpent
description: Winged serpent Winged serpents , also called “ spark snakes , ” were reptiles that lived in the jungles and forests of Zakhara . Description . These snakes appeared with a variety of colors including sky blue , emerald , and raspberry red .

title: Wingham
description: Wingham Wingham , often callen Weird Wingham is an old half - orc of the region of Damara . Appearance . Wingham is old , his stature bent by age , bald and limping , but with a sparkle in his bright eyes locking the stares of any young woman .

title: Wingle Spewgold
description: Wingle Spewgold Wingle Spewgold was a male gnome illusionist and thief and a spy of Glinda Scatterstar in the Rogue ' s Guild of Hillsfar in 1367 DR . Description . He used his illusions to pass as an ordinary human thief .

title: Wingstarl
description: Wingstarl The Wingstarl family was a human family of merchants in Zhentil Keep who plied their trades around the Moonsea area . The family made its fortunes by building fine temples in the Dalelands and the Moonsea in the 13th century DR . The wizard Sememmon was originally Malathar Wingstarl , a member of this family .

title: Winking Eyes of Rhauron
description: Winking Eyes of Rhauron The Winking Eyes of Rhauron were numerous magically enchanted gemstones which , when touched bare - handed , would melt into the handler ' s hand and compel the person to attempt to assassinate a target . Description . All the gems were approximately the size of a large man ' s thumb and could be sapphire s , emerald s , diamond s , or rubies .

title: Winko Battleblade
description: Winko Battleblade Winko Battleblade was a dwarf of Mithril Hall in the late 15th century DR . History . During the late stages of the War of the Silver Marches in 1485 DR , Winko and his young cousin Rollo were among the dwarves that marched from Mithril Hall to battle against the orc s and drow .

title: Winlof
description: Winlof Winlof was one of the many Doomguide s who were part of the contingent in Neverdeath Graveyard in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . She and some of her fellows became lost in the graveyard after an assault by undead .

title: Winski Perorate
description: Winski Perorate Winski Perorate was Sarevok ' s mentor . Relations . He taught Sarevok " in the darkest of rituals " and helped orchestrate his intended rise to power as the new Lord of Murder .

title: Winter ' s Cradle Tavern
description: Winter ' s Cradle Tavern The Winter ' s Cradle Tavern was a tavern in Easthaven within the Ten - Towns of Icewind Dale . Structure . Located in the northern part of Easthaven , the wooden building looked ramshackle on the outside .

title: Winter Edge
description: Winter Edge Winter Edge was a hamlet in the Silver Marches of Northwest Faerûn . Geography . West of the Moonwood , the hamlet was east of River Surbrin and near Mithral Hall located in the Frost Hills .

title: Winter Wine
description: Winter Wine Winter Wine was a wine crafted in the North . It was also sold through Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue . Description .

title: Winter Zulth
description: Winter Zulth Winter Zulth was a half - elf living in Waterdeep and the regional agent of the Moonstars for non - Faerûn ian locations in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Winter was raised in Waterdeep and worked at the Horizon ' s Sails as a map - maker .

title: Winter wolf
description: Winter wolf A winter wolf was more akin to a worg than an actual wolf , being of wicked intelligence and cunning . Description . It grew to about 8 ft ( 2 .

title: Wintercloak River
description: Wintercloak River The Wintercloak River connected the Deepwash with the Nagawater . Description . The river was swift but still navigable , even going upstream if the wind was right and the rowers were strong enough .

title: Winterhaven
description: Winterhaven The town of Winterhaven was located on the East Way , between the nations of Sembia and Cormyr . It was situated on the road between Arabel and Highmoon . Due to its location in the middle of the Thunder Peaks , it was not uncommon for the inhabitants to be attacked by monstrous races such as kobolds and goblins .

title: Winterkeep
description: Winterkeep Winterkeep was a ruin located on the southern tip of the Yal Tengri . East of Winterkeep were the Glittering Spires . Description .

title: Wintersun
description: Wintersun Wintersun was a noble house of Cormyr . Their holdings were mostly in Cormyr ' s back country and they were considered backwater hicks by most other noble families . After the Abraxus affair in 1369 DR the family began buying properties in Suzail in an effort to seem more cosmopolitan and by the late 15th century DR was the largest landlord in the city .

title: Winterwood
description: Winterwood Winterwood was a vast woodland filled with pine s and oak s and was the darkest forest in the region . The thick foliage from these tall tress blocked out the sunlight and a cool , light , white mist was commonly seen floating along the ground . The white mist was so dense it looks like newly fallen snow , especially on the edges of the forest when the morning light struck the it ; hence its name : Winterwood .

title: Winthrop
description: Winthrop Winthrop was the innkeep of the Candlekeep Inn in the 1350s DR . He was known for his good - humored nature and frequent jests . Appearance .

title: Wired cane
description: Wired cane A wired cane was a tool used by some rogue s when pickpocketing . Uses . Wired canes were attached to a rogue ' s hand by a thin wire .

title: Wiri Fleagol
description: Wiri Fleagol Wiri Fleagol was a slave of the fire giant s in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Wiri was captured by fire giants and taken to Ironslag where she worked as a miner together with many other gnome s and dwarves , overseen by salamander guards .

title: Wish
description: Wish Wish was arguably the most powerful spell that a sorcerer or wizard could hope to learn . It allowed its caster to accomplish multiple , various effects ranging from duplicating other spell effects to altering reality to suit the caster ' s wish , hence its name . History .

title: Wispling
description: Wispling Wisplings were planetouched , native outsider s descended from the breeding of halfling s and demons . Description . Wisplings descended from demons and halflings ; however , they lacked the " traditional " fiendish traits , instead having light brown skin and bright red hair .

title: Witches of Rashemen
description: Witches of Rashemen The Witches of Rashemen , also known as Wychlaran , meaning " wise old women " in the ancient language of Halardrim , were the spiritual leaders of Rashemen , communing with the spirits and guiding the souls of the Rashemi people . History . The Witches of Rashemen were formed in - 160 DR to preserve the lore and magic of Raumathar at the beginning of their final conflict with Narfell .

title: Witchfire
description: Witchfire Witchfire was a mildly complex invocation wielded by several warlock s . When " witchfire " was cast , it summoned from the Feywild a hot , white flame into a target of the warlock ' s choosing within fifty feet ( fifteen meters ) . If set inside a living creature , the flame caused the creature immense pain , sending streams of enchanted fire through the creature ' s orifices with such pain as to distract them from all other things , making them less effective combatants .

title: Withdraw
description: Withdraw Withdraw was an alteration spell that allowed the caster to slow time as he or she experienced it in order to contemplate a problem or cast a personal spell . Effects . This spell bent time around the caster so that a few minutes ( based on the caster ' s level ) passed for the caster while only one minute passed for everyone else .

title: Withegroo Seian ' Doo
description: Withegroo Seian ' Doo Withegroo Seian ' Doo is a wizard who lives in Shallows where he has his own tower . He founded , and leads the hamlet . Appearance .

title: Witherite
description: Witherite Witherite was a yellow to white semi - precious gemstone . Description . Witherite was found in large , fibrous deposits containing zones of translucent gem - quality material .

title: Wittel
description: Wittel Wittel was a teamster in Hillsfar in the Moonsea . Activities . Wittel was a teamster who worked transferring goods from the farms around Hillsfar to the city .

title: Wizard
description: Wizard Wizards are a form of spellcaster who learn the art of arcane magic through research and learning . What wizards lack in combat prowess and armor they make up with a broad range of magical spell s and abilities learned through years of practice and training . Through their spellcasting ability powerful wizards can control the battlefield , using spells that affect wide areas , often hindering enemies , while also learning to use powerful ritual s of arcane power .

title: Wizard ' s Quaff
description: Wizard ' s Quaff Wizard ' s Quaff was an ale brewed in Voonlar specifically for the Whistling Wizard inn " circa " the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR . Description . More accurately described as a small beer , the Wizard ' s Quaff was a locally brewed , low - quality drink .

title: Wizard Well
description: Wizard Well The Wizard Well was a cistern that filled with water from an underground well . It was located in a room in the basement of the Whistling Wizard inn in Voonlar , on the southwestern edge of the Moonsea region . During the latter half of the , it was famous throughout the surrounding area because it would talk to individuals who respectfully entered the room one at a time .

title: Wizard eye
description: Wizard eye Wizard eye is a wizard spell that creates an invisible " eye " about 1 in ( 2 . 5 cm ) in diameter that can provide the caster with visual information . The eye can see up to 10 ft ( 3 m ) with infravision and otherwise can see normally .

title: Wizard lice
description: Wizard lice Wizard lice were tiny parasitic insects found in Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . A wizard louse usually measured 1 / 16th of an inch in length , making them very difficult to spot .

title: Wizard of the Spiral Tower
description: Wizard of the Spiral Tower The wizards of the Spiral Tower are a group of wizard s trained in ancient methods of the Feywild , as part of a tradition initiated at Corellon ’ s own behest . Practicing ancient lessons passed down by Corellon ’ s most devoted followers , wizards of the Spiral Tower are deadly arcane spellcaster s who have learned to use Corellon ’ s favored weapon , the longsword , as an implement in a manner similar to swordmage s , using their blade as both a weapon and an implement . With time , a wizard of the Spiral Tower ’ s longsword becomes fused with the power of the Feywild itself .

title: Wizard slayer
description: Wizard slayer Wizard slayers were barbarian s and fighter s who specialized in defeating spellcasters , particularly wizard s . Culture . Wizard slayers from the barbarian tradition were typically born into tribes where magic was reserved for a select few elders .

title: Wizardgout Water
description: Wizardgout Water Wizardgout Water was a fountain located in High Dale . It was the source of a stream that flowed down to Saerb . The fountain was actually a petrified wizard named Yalumvrael of Athkatla whose body was turned to stone and enspelled to produce an endless flow of water .

title: Wizards ' Reach
description: Wizards ' Reach The Wizards ' Reach was a broad plain on the Aglarondan peninsula that stretched between the Sea of Fallen Stars and the Yuirwood . The coast was full of extensive tidal marshes and barrier islands . The Wizards ' Reach was not a part of the nation of Aglarond .

title: Wizards of the Coast
description: Wizards of the Coast Wizards of the Coast ( often referred to as WotC or simply Wizards ) is an American publisher of games , primarily based on fantasy and science fiction themes and the current license holder of " Dungeons & Dragons " and its Forgotten Realms campaign setting . Originally a basement - run role - playing game publisher , they popularized the collectible card game genre with " " in the mid - 1990s . Today they publish board games , collectible card games and role - playing games .

title: Wizshade
description: Wizshade A wizshade or spellshade was an incorporeal creature created when a spellcaster was caught in their own magical backlash . Description . They appeared first as а swirling vortex of mаny colors about 8 feet in diameter .

title: Wo
description: Wo Wo was the owner of the House of Wo in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Wo oversaw all food preparation for his .

title: Wo - ha Ui - jung
description: Wo - ha Ui - jung The Wo - ha Ui - jung were ten magical chalices of Koryo in ancient times . Description . Forged with arcane magic , each of the Wo - ha Ui - jung was carved to resemble a different beast .

title: Woklef
description: Woklef Woklef was an adult black dragon whose lair was in the ruins of Orogoth in High Moor of the Western Heartlands . He was the great - grandson of the black wyrm dracolich Calathanorgoth the Old One , the daughter of the black wyrms Vilholin and Wastirek , and the brother of the black dragons Aswidorg , Cheleen and Kasidikal .

title: Wolf ' s Pelt Inn
description: Wolf ' s Pelt Inn The Wolf ' s Pelt Inn was an inn located in Targos one of the Ten Towns . Structure . The building faced Maer Dualdon so fishermen could see the front door from the lake .

title: Wolf Woods
description: Wolf Woods The Wolf Woods was an area of forest near the site of Suzail in Cormyr , part of what was once the Forest Country and part of the forest the elves called Cormanthir . Notably , it was settled in 6 DR by Ondeth Obarskyr and his immediate family , before which time it had been hunting grounds for the elves .

title: Wolfgang Baur
description: Wolfgang Baur Wolfgang Baur grew up near Chicago and later began working with Dungeon magazine in a low - level position but worked his way up to become editor of Dragon magazine though he eventually left to work for Wizards of the Coast . He edited a lot of books and designed the Dark * Matter campaign before leaving Wizards for HR reasons . In 2006 he pioneered Open Design .

title: Wolfwere
description: Wolfwere The Wolfwere is the offspring of werewolves and natural wolves . Inhabiting out of the way places , the hated and feared wolfwere is the bane of human s and demihuman s alike , for it is able to take the form of a human male or female of considerable charisma . Shapeshifting .

title: Wolmad ' s Camp
description: Wolmad ' s Camp Wolmad ' s Camp was an Uthgardt thorp located in the Silver Marches . Geography . The Camp was located in a vale of the northern flanks of the Nether Mountains not far from Citadel Felbarr .

title: Woman Warrior
description: Woman Warrior The Woman Warrior was a constellation resembling a female warrior with a sword . Observation . It could be observed over the Sword Coast North in summer .

title: Womford
description: Womford Womford was a tiny village on the banks of the River Dessarin . History . The settlement of Womford , according to local legend , was to have originally been called " Ironford " .

title: Won Kwang
description: Won Kwang Won Kwang , known commonly as the Master , was a noted monk , scholar , and philosopher of Koryo . In 925 DR , Won established a school for martial arts and other skills in the city of Pyong Do in the then kingdom of Koguryo . Won set down its daily routine and defined five rules for the basis of its teachings and the good behavior of its students : Won also built a shrine there .

title: Wondermen
description: Wondermen The Wondermen were mages who experimented with magic and extraplanar travel . Their crypt was situated beneath Nightshade nightclub in Scornubel . It was said that several members were turned into lich es and that they kept guard of the crypt , hunting down anyone who stole from it .

title: Wonderstone
description: Wonderstone Wonderstone was a variety of displaying bands of red , brown , tan , or purple . Description . These ornamental stones were found in large deposits , and could be cut into blocks of almost a cubic foot ( 27 , 000 cubic centimeters ) in size when quarried .

title: Wondrous Mamluk Society
description: Wondrous Mamluk Society The Wondrous Mamluk Society , also known as the Wondrous , was a military organization in Zakhara . Activities . This wealthy group of mamluk s served the Padisha of Afyal .

title: Wong Fei ' s ioun stone
description: Wong Fei ' s ioun stone Wong Fei ' s ioun stone was a unique " ioun stone " that protected and increased the resilience of their bearer . Description . It was a pale green ovoid stone .

title: Wong Fei Hung
description: Wong Fei Hung Wong Fei Hung was a Shou - ling monk of the Path of Enlightenment in Kara - Tur . It was said that Chan Cheng , a god of war in Kara - Tur , one of the Nine Immortals , once descended to earth in the form of a dragon and challenged Wong Fei . The two battled each other for three days and three nights , and in the end Chan Cheng was so impressed by Wong Fei ' s skill that he gave him a special " ioun stone " .

title: Wood elf
description: Wood elf Wood elves , also known as copper elves , or Or - tel - quessir were the most populous of the elven races . Wood elves saw themselves as guardians of the Tel - quessir forest homes that were largely abandoned after the Crown Wars and before the Retreat , but unlike most elves they did not view themselves as a people apart from the rest of Faerûn . Description .

title: Wood of Sharp Teeth
description: Wood of Sharp Teeth The Wood of Sharp Teeth , formerly called the Glimmerwood , was a dense forest south of the Chionthar , southeast of Baldur ' s Gate and southwest of Scornubel . It was a wilderness except for Durlag ' s Tower on the forest ' s southern edge . Uldoon Trail was the nearest route to the forest .

title: Wood shape
description: Wood shape Wood shape is a transmutation spell that reshapes wooden objects . Effect . " Wood shape " enables you to form one existing piece of wood into any shape that suits your purpose .

title: Wood woad
description: Wood woad Wood woads were powerful humanoid - shaped guardian plants . Each wood woad contained the soul of a creature that ( willingly or otherwise ) gave up its life in order to eternally perform a given duty . Description .

title: Woodtine
description: Woodtine Woodtine was a variety of . Description . This brownish and fibrous ornamental stone was found in large nodules and was cut .

title: Word of chaos
description: Word of chaos Word of chaos is an evocation spell that kills , confuses , stuns , or deafens nonchaotic subjects . Effect . Uttering " word of chaos " creates two effects : On the caster ' s home plane , non - chaotic extraplanar creatures within the area are instantly banished back to their home planes .

title: Word of recall
description: Word of recall Word of recall was a conjuration or alteration spell that teleported the caster and possibly other goods or creatures back to a designated place . Effects . In preparing this spell the caster had to designate a sanctuary about which the caster had extensive first - hand knowledge , and a clear area no larger than 10 ft ( 3 m ) square in which to appear .

title: Words of Creation
description: Words of Creation The Words of Creation were fragments of the precursor of the Celestial language . This precursor language , known as Supernal , was said to be the tongue of the gods themselves . A very few celestial s remembered some of these words , whose power was said to be so great that no mortal mind could comprehend more than three or four of these Words of Creation in their true form .

title: Worg
description: Worg A worg was a type of magical beast that resembled a normal wolf but was larger , intelligent , and had a fiendish countenance and glowing eyes . Description . A worg resembled a typical wolf , though much larger and bearing an intelligent , wicked gleam in its eyes .

title: Worghest
description: Worghest Worghests were planetouched , native outsider s descended from the breeding of goblin s and barghest s . Ecology . Worghests often lived as feared and respected warriors in orc and goblin tribes , disdaining positions of power in favor of the freedom of the hunt .

title: World Axis cosmology
description: World Axis cosmology The World Axis was a cosmological model used prior to the Second Sundering . This structure , which resembled a sphere split into two axes , hence the name , resulted from the Spellplague and its effects upon the local multiverse , which included the untethering of the astral dominion s and the creation ( or possible return ) of the Elemental Chaos . As a result of the changes wrought by the disaster , the formerly prominent World Tree model was abandoned in favor of the World Axis , which most scholars believed more accurately reflected the current structure of the multiverse .

title: World Pillar Mountains
description: World Pillar Mountains The World Pillar Mountains , called Jibal al - Akbas in Midani , were the southernmost range of the mighty Yehimal and the greatest mountain range in Zakhara . The World Pillars contained the center of power and the majority of the Land of the Yak - Men . Geography .

title: World Serpent Inn
description: World Serpent Inn The World Serpent Inn was an establishment in Arabel that actually displayed a sign outside calling it The Wild Goose . Description . The building structure was shabby and in need of repair .

title: World Tree
description: World Tree The World Tree was a sentient tree - like cosmic structure in the World Tree cosmology model that connected all of the Celestial plane s to each other , from its roots in Dwarfhome and Arvandor , its lower branches in Greenfields , the House of the Triad and Dweomerheart , its main trunk along the House of Knowledge , Golden Hills and Brightwater , and at the top was the Gates of the Moon . Normal planar travel used the Astral plane to pass from the Prime Material Plane to one of the other Outer planes and all inter - planar journeys had to pass through the Prime Material nexus . Angel ic servants of the good deities used the tree as a kind of " celestial ladder " to avoid having to go through the Prime Material plane , although the tree did not enjoy being used as such .

title: World Tree cosmology
description: World Tree cosmology The World Tree cosmology model was outlined in the Year of Wild Magic , 1372 DR , and quickly became the most widely accepted model during those tumultuous times , supplanting the Great Wheel cosmology . The name came from the discovery of a sentient being that manifested itself as a brobdingnagian tree that connected various planes of existence , much like the river Styx . The World Tree cosmological model was invalidated by the Spellplague in 1385 DR and the decade that followed , during which the Elemental Planes collapsed into the Elemental Chaos , the Ethereal Plane and World Tree were destroyed , and the Outer Planes that survived became drifting dominions in the Astral Sea as described by the World Tree model ' s successor , the World Axis cosmology model .

title: Worldfire
description: Worldfire Worldfire was an extremely dangerous magic al ability that allowed a spellcaster to drain energy from another world or plane to empower its spellcasting abilities . Using this ability not only drained the life force of a world or plane , it also damaged the Weave . Background .

title: Worldwalk
description: Worldwalk Worldwalk was an arcane alteration spell that could connect the plane of the caster to another plane or dimension , allowing two - way travel between them . Effects . This spell could be cast into an open area or against a wall up to 90 ft ( 27 m ) away , as long as the space was not occupied .

title: Wormblod
description: Wormblod Wormblod was the chieftain of the Great Worm Tribe sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Wormblod led a group of his berserkers plus an enslaved white dragon and a shaman to try to break inside the Eye of the All - Father temple with the objective of find a missing member of the tribe , Noori .

title: Wormhole
description: Wormhole The Wormhole was a secret location within the City of Brass in 1367 DR . Activities . By an incredible stroke of luck , or genius , the salamander population of the City of Brass was able to keep the location of this hideout a secret from the efreet for ages .

title: Wormwrithings
description: Wormwrithings The Wormwrithings are a series of twisting tunnels located to the north and west of Blingdenstone . Believed to have been created by a colony of purple worm s , it is now the home of many small tribes of kobold s who are beset by many larger predators . Before the drow attack on their city , the svirfneblin of Blingdenstone used to track the purple worms still living in the area as their excretions often contained precious metals and stones .

title: Worthless Flower
description: Worthless Flower The Worthless Flower gang was a yakuza group in Nakamaru in Wa around 1357 DR . The Worthless flower ' s main business was gambling . They tried to control all gambling operations in city and surrounding but their games were not overtly dishonest , also in honest gambling games in the end won the gambler .

title: Worvil Forkbeard
description: Worvil Forkbeard Worvil Forkbeard , mostly knew only as the Weevil , was a notorious criminal in Ten Towns sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR Worvil led a bandit group that raided caravans went to south and mines properties of Mirabar .

title: Woto Jubojiro
description: Woto Jubojiro Woto Jubojiro was an old bushi in Wa around 1357 DR . History . Jubojiro was a soldier in the army of Matasuuri Nagahide .

title: Woumar ' s Wheloon Mill
description: Woumar ' s Wheloon Mill Woumar ' s Wheloon Mill was a mill located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . Its proprietor was Leahon Woumar . Description .

title: Wraith
description: Wraith A wraith was an undead creature born of evil and darkness , despising light and all living things . They could drain the life from living creatures , turning them into new wraiths upon death . Wraiths were powerless in natural sunlight , appearing as a sinister , spectral figure robed in darkness .

title: Wraith of the Inner Sea
description: Wraith of the Inner Sea The Wraith of the Inner Sea were a mercenary company based in the Sea of Fallen Stars . Organization . The Wraith had three ships the " Sea Queen " , the " Sea Horse " , and the " Sea Quest " .

title: Wraith spider
description: Wraith spider A wraith spiders was a type of undead giant spider . Description . Appearing much like the monstrous spiders that they were in life , wraith spiders differed in a few noticeable ways .

title: Wrath domain
description: Wrath domain The Wrath domain was a deity domain that granted divine spellcasters powers of righteous fury to smite their enemies . It originated in the Book of Exalted Deeds , and was added to the Forgotten Realms setting by the Player ' s Guide to Faerûn . Wrath Domain Powers .

title: Wrath of the Old
description: Wrath of the Old The Wrath of the Old was a holy slayer organization in Zakhara who followed the teachings of Kor , the Zakharan god of wisdom . The symbol of the Wrath of the Old was a dagger emblazoned with the sunburst of Kor . Activities .

title: Wren
description: Wren A wren is a passerine bird . Species . Needle .

title: Wruz Olg ' lmar
description: Wruz Olg ' lmar Wruz Olg ' lmar was a drow in Gauntlgrym in the Underdark in 1484 DR . History . Wruz was a drow who was captured by a mind flayer sect led by Thlorrog .

title: Wu - haltai
description: Wu - haltai The Wu - haltai were a collection of human tribes living mainly in the eastern part of the Ama Basin in Kara - Tur . Society . The Wu - haltai lived in small villages , hunting , fishing , and growing some crops .

title: Wu - haltai language
description: Wu - haltai language Wu - haltai was a language spoken by the Wu - haltai people of the Ama Basin . It was one of the chief languages of the region . Related languages .

title: Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains
description: Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains The Wu Pi Te Shao Mountains were a series of mountain ranges in southwestern Kara - Tur . They were called the Peerless Mountains ( or " Wu Pi Te Shan Mo " ) and also spelled the Wu Pi Te Shar Mountains ( or simply " Wu Pi Te Shar " ) . They were the southern part of the great Yehimal range that dominated the continent .

title: Wu jen
description: Wu jen Wu jen ( also called wu - jen ) were wielders of mysterious powers , similar to sorcerers . Culture . They used the spirit forces , elements , and the powers of nature .

title: Wudei ' a bint Samia
description: Wudei ' a bint Samia Wudei ' a bint Samia lived within the Tower of Adnan al - Raqi in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Wudei ' a was one of Adnan al - Raqi instructors .

title: Wulfgang Warts
description: Wulfgang Warts Wulfgang Warts was a person in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . He was reputedly a skilled commander of bloodforge armies , but had a debilitating fear of such places as the Phantom Pass . Learning of Wulfgang ' s phobia , the commander of the Legendary Campaign planned a ruse to lure him there .

title: Wulfgar
description: Wulfgar Wulfgar , son of Beornegar , was the barbarian hero of Icewind Dale , and one of the Companions of the Hall along with Drizzt Do ' Urden , Cattie - brie , Regis , and Bruenor Battlehammer . He worshipped Tempus , the god of battle . He was reborn , along with the rest of the deceased Companions , through the power of the goddess Mielikki , and he rejoined his friends in 1484 DR .

title: Wulgreda
description: Wulgreda Wulgreda was a prisoner of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Wulgreda was prospecting the hills near the Sacred Stone Monastery when she was captured by Black Earth cultists .

title: Wulgreth ( Ascalhorn )
description: Wulgreth ( Ascalhorn ) Wulgreth was an Ascalhi wizard , consorted with baatezu in defiance of the ancient pact his ancestors had made with the Eaerlanni elves to abandon the dark arts of the Netherese . Wulgreth of Ascalhorn bested his rivals for six decades because of the help of his baatezu . In turn , his rivals summoned the aid of tanar ' ri for their own defense , which killed the baatezu , conquered all of Ascalhorn ( which then became known as Hellgate Keep ) , and overran the elven kingdom of Eaerlann and the dwarven kingdom of Ammarindar , destroying them both .

title: Wulgreth ( Netheril )
description: Wulgreth ( Netheril ) Wulgreth was an individual from Netheril who was accidentally exposed to heavy magic by Karsus and transformed into a lich . After the Fall of Netheril , he came to the city of Karse and exacted his revenge by creating divisions within the Cult of Karsus , which eventually tore the city apart a little more than a decade after its founding . After the cult disintegrated in the Year of Foul Awakenings , −286 DR , Wulgreth moved into the temple to ensure that no one would ever rebuild the city .

title: Wulver Xornnag
description: Wulver Xornnag Wulver Xornnag was Pommarch on the Council of Six in Amn from 1345 DR to 1362 DR being previously Dahaunarch from 1342 DR to 1345 , the Lord of House Xornnag from 1337 DR . He was always a step ahead of his opponents and a master in framing others for his failures . In 1362 after was made public the Golden Legion ' s report about Maztica Amn was plagued by a campaign of assassinations among high - ranking merchants .

title: Wund
description: Wund Wund was an orc shaman from the tribes of the Sword Mountains in Northwest Faerûn . He was the founder of the Brotherhood of the Scarlet Scourge . Background .

title: Wunturn Radest
description: Wunturn Radest Wunturn Radest was the high priest of the temple of Tempus within the city of Mulmaster . Relationships . Radest and the rest of the clergy served the army of Mulmaster as the majority of its forces shared in the worship of the Lord of Battles .

title: Wurlitzer
description: Wurlitzer Wurlitzer was a tavern owner and cook in Skullport . Relationship . Wurlitzer hated the halfling Smallfry .

title: Wurt Dumire
description: Wurt Dumire Wurt Dumire was a tyrant ruling the goblin realm of the Kingdom of Nix in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars ( 648 – 657 DR ) . In the aftermath of Redfang the Reaper ' s reign , Wurt Dumire came to enslave the goblins of Nix , putting them to work in a far - off mine . The commander of the Legendary Campaign felt unexpected sympathy for the goblins ' plight and was compelled to try to bring an end to Wurt ' s operation in a bloodforge battle in Nix itself .

title: Wydda
description: Wydda Wydda was the monk sacristan of the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . History . Wydda was a monk of vaguely elven ancestry from Aglarond who went to the Monastery of the Yellow Rose , where she became the high cleric .

title: Wykarr
description: Wykarr Wykarr was a fence and a member of the Shadow Thieves in Port Kir around 1370 DR . Personality . Wykarr had a keen eye for details .

title: Wyl Mossfeld
description: Wyl Mossfeld Wyl Mossfeld was a male human of the village of West Harbor on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . Activities . Wyl , like his brothers , was the member of West Harbor militia .

title: Wylan Burral
description: Wylan Burral Wylan Burral was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth in Mulmaster . Personality . On the surface , Wylan was a jovial and friendly individual , wanting to enjoy the finer things in life .

title: Wyllowwood
description: Wyllowwood Wyllowwood is an area of Undermountain . Access . There are numerous ways to enter Wyllowwood , although none are immediately apparent .

title: Wyn Ashgrove
description: Wyn Ashgrove Wyn Ashgrove was an elven bard and spellsinger . Description . Wyn was graceful , with golden skin , short curly black hair , and green eyes .

title: Wyndra Syrylstone
description: Wyndra Syrylstone Wyndra Syrylstone was a human woman of the city of Calaunt in the Vast . She was a priestess of Selûne . She was the High Priestess , or " Moon Mistress " , of the Moonsilver House temple by 1358 DR , a position which she still held by 1370 DR .

title: Wynn Castle
description: Wynn Castle Wynn Castle was the keep of Earl Radborne Wynn of Hartsvale . Location . Wynn Castle was located east of the Clear Whirl River , south of where its tributary , the Wyrm River , joined it .

title: Wynne Cromm
description: Wynne Cromm Wynne Cromm was a commander in the Lizard Marsh sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Wynne ruled over Cromm Hold , a keep that watched over the Marsh in order to detect all signs of lizardfolk activities .

title: Wynter
description: Wynter Wynter was a centaur and an agent of the Harpers . Personality . Wynter was a kind of pacifist , fighting only if he really had no other options .

title: Wyrekka Kusell
description: Wyrekka Kusell Wyrekka Kusell was a bard famous in the eastern Sea of Fallen Stars and the regional agent of the Moonstars for Thesk , Impiltur , Narfell and Great Dale in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . History . Wyrekka made her home in Telflamm when she wasn ' t wandering Thesk , Impiltur , and the Great Dale .

title: Wyrm River
description: Wyrm River Wyrm River in Hartsvale was a tributary of the Clear Whirl River . Description . Wyrm River froze solid in the winter months .

title: Wyrmcrown
description: Wyrmcrown The Wyrmcrown was a powerful dragon artifact . Abilities . The Wyrmcrown allowed its bearer to magically poison any dragon who was blood - related to it , or a dragon whose blood the bearer had tasted .

title: Wyrmheart Mine
description: Wyrmheart Mine Wyrmheart Mine was a dwarven mine in the Kobold Mountains , renowned in Chult for its vast collection of diamonds and emeralds . The clan leader , Kyer Wyrmheart , was an old and hateful dwarf . He placed ballista e and dimetrodon s at the entrance to the mine to defend against raiders .

title: Wyrmskull Throne
description: Wyrmskull Throne Wyrmskull Throne is a throne made from the skulls of four blue dragons slain by Taark Shanat around - 12 , 000 DR to bring the Cloaker Wars to a victorious end for his dwarves . It is believed that the throne was forged by Dumathoin ' s hand . History .

title: Wyrran Alastrarra
description: Wyrran Alastrarra Wyrran Alastrarra was the mate of Countess Sarya Dlardrageth in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Wyrran was the most recent mate of Sarya .

title: Wyrruth
description: Wyrruth Wyrruth was a male human shade and an enchanter who operated as an ambassador between the city of Shade and Maerimydra . Description . A dark grey complexion complemented his equally dark eyes and his black hair was kept pulled back in a long ponytail .

title: Wyvern
description: Wyvern A wyvern was a large winged lizard with a stinging tail and sharp teeth . They had dark brown or grey bodies , around 15 ' ( 4 . 6 m ) in length , weighing around a ton .

title: Wyvern Ferry Route
description: Wyvern Ferry Route The Wyvern Ferry Route , or simply the Wyvern Ferry , was a ferry across the Wyvernflow River in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It linked the Way of the Manticore over the river . 1374 DR Wheloon was originally a small thorp that lived off the trade of river crossings on the Wyvern Ferry .

title: Wyvern Tor
description: Wyvern Tor Wyvern Tor was a crag in the hills northeast of the Sword Mountains , and was easily seen by any on the Triboar Trail near the vicinity of Conyberry . History . Wyvern Tor was formerly inhabited by a vicious nest of wyverns , but they were slain by bold adventurers .

title: Wyvern Watch Inn
description: Wyvern Watch Inn The Wyvern Watch Inn was an inn located in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . It was owned by the Mhaerkoon family : Buldegas Mhaerkoon and later his daughters Asanta & Baerill . History .

title: Wyvern watch
description: Wyvern watch Wyvern watch was an evocation spell of the guardian sphere that created a field of temporary paralysis to guard an area against intrusion . Effects . This spell lasted for eight hours or until it was triggered , which ever came first .

title: Wyvernstones of Hullack
description: Wyvernstones of Hullack The Wyvernstones of Hullack are a sacred site of Eldath and a legend of the Hullack Forest in northeastern Cormyr . Each menhir is twelve feet high and six wide and the twelve of them create a circle some 60 feet in diameter . The north , east , and west facing stones are crossed by a table stone forming an arch over each pair with the south arch , lying cracked and broken at the base of the menhirs .

title: Wyverntongue Chalice
description: Wyverntongue Chalice The Wyverntongue Chalice was one of the relics of The Nine . It contained the spirit of Treth Halonter who could be called forth by the chalice ' s owner . Treth ' s spirit was forced to obey the commands of the owner .

title: Wyvernwater
description: Wyvernwater The Wyvernwater was a star - shaped freshwater lake more or less centrally positioned in Cormyr . It had abundant crab , eel , and fish stocks . Each morning , the lake was covered in a thick mist , and those who fished it early in the morning were therefore known as " mistfishers " .

title: Xai Chung
description: Xai Chung Xai Chung was a settlement in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . Geography . It lay on the western side of Kang Bay near the foot of the Vorkani Mountains , which one could view from a balcony in Xai Chung .

title: Xalith Masq ' il ' yr
description: Xalith Masq ' il ' yr Xalith Masq ' il ' yr was a drow trader living in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Xalith was a trader in Gracklstugh and an ally of House Mizzrym of Menzoberranzan .

title: Xalliana
description: Xalliana Xalliana was a tiefling member of the Harpers who infiltrated the Blackdagger Bandits . History . Xalliana was a Harper agent who infiltrated the Blackdagger Bandits as a spy .

title: Xalyth
description: Xalyth Xalyth , also known as Nal , was a female drow trader and fencer of gems and spell components in Menzoberranzan in 1370 DR . History . Her fortune came from her relations with nine suppliers , from Ammryyr of Skullport , a male drow worshiper of Vhaeraun , to Ubelein Shubelith , a duergar of Underspires nicknamed " Fatreek " .

title: Xamlyn Margaster
description: Xamlyn Margaster Xamlyn Margaster was a wizard of the Margaster family in Silverymoon sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Xamlyn resided in a tower in Silverymoon .

title: Xamus
description: Xamus Xamus was an efreeti inhabiting Rog ' osto in east Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Xamus served the sha ' ir Othmar bin Kaloth as his loyal genie companion .

title: Xan
description: Xan Xan was an elf who appeared in both the Baldur ' s Gate computer game and novelization . The Novel . Xan was an elf with a sense of humor as well as a good streak of luck who befriended Abdel Adrian , Khalid , and Jaheira .

title: Xanathar
description: Xanathar The Xanathar was one of most infamous beholder s of the Realms and the crime lord of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport . History . The Eye , as he was originally known , was an ancient , wrinkled , and paranoid beholder of the Graypeaks Hive .

title: Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild
description: Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild Xanathar ' s Thieves ' Guild was run by a paranoid elder beholder . Geography . This slaver network was the most powerful on the Sword Coast and often acted as a buffer against other evil organizations unintentionally .

title: Xanathar ( original )
description: Xanathar ( original ) Xanathar was one of most infamous beholder s of the Realms and the crime lord of the Xanathar Thieves ' Guild in Skullport . History . Xanathar was originally a follower of Xantriph of Zhentil Keep .

title: Xandra Shobalar
description: Xandra Shobalar Xandra Shobalar was a drow of House Shobalar and the third daughter of Hinkutes ' nat Alar Shobalar . She was the house ' s Mistress of Magic , tasked with training others in the house about wizardry . She trained the young Liriel Baenre .

title: Xanos Messarmos
description: Xanos Messarmos Xanos Messarmos was a half - orc sorcerer and barbarian , and a former student of Drogan Droganson . Description . A large half - orc man with black hair and mustache .

title: Xantam
description: Xantam Xantam was the guild master of Xantam ' s Thieves Guild , an emergent criminal organization in Baldur ' s Gate , with the secret backing of Eldrith . His primary agent was Karne , in truth a Zhentarim agent . His guild was destroyed and Xantam was killed by the heroes Vahn , Adrianna , and Kromlech Bruenghor .

title: Xanther Srildar
description: Xanther Srildar Xanther Srildar was a saturnine merchant in High Dale . History . Xanther was a merchant of Sembia n rarities and collectibles in High Dale .

title: Xanthon Cormaeril
description: Xanthon Cormaeril Xanthon Cormaeril was a member of the Cormaeril noble family . His traitorous cousin , Gaspar Cormaeril , was the cause of their noble house being stripped of land and title . Xanthon then somehow turned into a ghazneth , unleashing the buried scourges to destroy Cormyr .

title: Xantriph
description: Xantriph Xantriph was a beholder member of the Zhentarim and one of the closest ally of Manshoon . History . Xantriph was a beholder living in the Temple in the Sky , a strange flying hollow rock over Teshendale .

title: Xaos
description: Xaos The Xaos was a chaos beast lurking at Telkoun ' s Tower in High Thorog in the Silver Marches . It was twice the normal size of a chaos beast . History .

title: Xara Tantlor
description: Xara Tantlor Xara Tantlor was a wizard and shopkeeper in Silverymoon in 1370 DR . Activities . Xara worked as a wizard - for - hire but also managed a potion shop .

title: Xarlandralath
description: Xarlandralath Xarlandralath , spawn of Xorlughra , was one of the beholder s in the service of Manshoon in Suzail . History . Around 1479 DR , Manshoon sent Xarlandralath and many other beholders to the house of Larak Dardulkyn to ensure the death of Elminster Aumar .

title: Xaros Tenseal
description: Xaros Tenseal Xaros Tenseal , known as the " Amlak Arcane " , was an elf who actually held a position of respect in the city of Keltar . He was the commander of the " amlakkar " , the city guard in Keltar , as well as a competent mage . He actually cared about upholding the law and protecting the citizens and refused to except bribes from the powerful cattle lords in the city .

title: Xatli
description: Xatli Xatli was a priest of Qotal in Nexal . History . In 1361 DR , he was one of the survivors after the Night of Wailing .

title: Xavarathimius
description: Xavarathimius Xavarathimius , also known as the Everlasting Wyrm , was a male great wyrm green dragon dracolich bound by the witches of Rashemen to guard the demon lord Eltab ' s prison in the Sharawood . History . Even after Eltab was gone , the Everlasting Wyrm remained .

title: Xaven Tanor ' this
description: Xaven Tanor ' this Xaven Tanor ' this was an alchemist of Szith Morcane . History . Xaven was an alchemist in Maerimydra ' s Shattered Tower and later in Szith Morcane .

title: Xax Chung
description: Xax Chung Xax Chung was a male hengeyokai ( hare ) bushi and the defender of the city of Koje in Koryo in the mid – 14th century DR . History . Xax was found wounded in the form of a hare by a wandering shukenja .

title: Xaxan Thavish
description: Xaxan Thavish Xaxan Thavish was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster . Personality . The priest was a vain and fastidious sociopath .

title: Xazax
description: Xazax Xazax the Eyemonger was a beholder in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Xazax was an unusual beholder who , with the help of his servant and surgeon Peebles the deep gnome , grafted onto himself the eyestalks of other beholders after killing them .

title: Xehil Yldin
description: Xehil Yldin Xehil Yldin was a lich inhabiting the Battle of Bones in 1367 DR . Personality . Xehil possessed an uncanny ability to work with others to further his own goals .

title: Xendreth
description: Xendreth The Xendreth was the ruling council of Malydren , composed of both the preeminent wizards and clerics of the ixzan city . Unlike most ixzan communities , mutant ixzan were allowed to join the clergy and become wizards , so they could also join the council . For many centuries , the council was in fact strongly influenced by the two vampiric ixzan Zekaqux and Phiaqiv .

title: Xenix
description: Xenix Xenix the Occluded was an elderly beholder eye tyrant of Ooltul and an innkeeper in 1370 DR . Personality . Xenix , like its fellow beholders , hated non - beholder strangers .

title: Xeno Mirrormane
description: Xeno Mirrormane Xeno Mirrormane was a cleric of Cyric . Appearance . Xeno ' s face was covered with wrinkles and he had curly silver - white hair .

title: Xephras
description: Xephras Xephras ( pronounced " ZEF - frus " ) was the " stormazîn " of the " Jotunbrud " in 1366 DR . Description . Xephras was a short cloud giant .

title: Xern
description: Xern Xern was a monk at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose . Activities . Xern was a member of the Order of the Chisel of the Disciples of St .

title: Xetzirbor
description: Xetzirbor Xetzirbor was a mind flayer during or after the Rage of Demons . History . During the Rage of Demons , the elder brain of Cyrog , also named Cyrog , died and was raised as an undead creature by the demon lord Orcus .

title: Xhalph Dlardrageth
description: Xhalph Dlardrageth Xhalph Dlardrageth was a daemonfey and the son of Sarya Dlardrageth . Appearance . Xhalph inherited the four arms of his father , and stands taller with a stronger build than any human .

title: Xhalth
description: Xhalth Baron Xhalth was a half - fiend member of the daemonfey and the nephew of Sarya Dlardrageth . Appeareance . Xhalth was physically the most fearsome of the tanar ' ri half - breeds .

title: Xharva Deem
description: Xharva Deem Xharva Deem was a dao in service to the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . History . In 1491 DR , Marlos Urnrayle made a pact with Xharva Deem in order to use the dao ' s abilities to manage the forge for the Black Earth .

title: Xi
description: Xi Xi was a town in the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur , lying in the northern Vorkani Mountains . The mountains separated Xi from the rest of Koryo . Around 1357 DR , the town was the base of the ninja clan known as the Panthers of Xi .

title: Xi - Chu
description: Xi - Chu Xi - Chu was a vampire who ruled over the Taring village of Gigit in Kutuk Valley in Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . In 1358 DR , Xi - Chu was attacked in the jungle by some hunters from the village of Tebing , who struck him with a wooden stake and then threw the body into the Ular River .

title: Xi Hulang
description: Xi Hulang Xi Hulang was the capital city of the kingdom of Koryo in Kara - Tur around 1357 DR . It lay at the mouth of the Hoparatu River on Kang Bay . The city was the home of King Wanang Sun , ruler of Koryo .

title: Xiang Do
description: Xiang Do Xiang Do is the art of fighting without fighting . Only few truly know it , but those that do are some of the best martial artists in the realms . Although the origin of this fighting style is unknown , there are rumors that suggest the creator of this art was a Shou monk .

title: Xiang Temple
description: Xiang Temple Xiang Temple was a monastery for monk s in the city of Telflamm in the nation of Thesk . Appearance . The Xiang Temple was brightly painted on the outside , while the inside was covered with incense smoke .

title: Xicvizt
description: Xicvizt Xicvizt was a rogue mind flayer from Ryxyg . History . During the Rage of Demons of 1491 DR , Xicvizt sensed a strange presence in the Underdark .

title: Xinaya
description: Xinaya Xinaya was a drow scout of Velkynvelve during the Rage of Demons . History . Xinaya was a young scout and acolyte of Lolth in Velkynvelve .

title: Xingax
description: Xingax Xingax was a mighty , undead creature from the Abyss . Appearance . Xingax looked like an oversized , freakishly deformed stillborn or aborted fetus - the pure ugliness with asymmetrical features .

title: Xinlenal
description: Xinlenal Xinlenal was the first of the flying Netherese enclaves . History . It was created in - 2954 DR by the archwizard Ioulaum , sixty years after he had invented the mythallar .

title: Xinlenal Enclave
description: Xinlenal Enclave Xinlenal Enclave was the first floating city of Netheril ( known then as Ioulaum ) . The city was established in - 2954 DR as a magrocacy ruled by Ioulaum until - 1205 DR when day - to - day control over the city itself was given to a variety of archwizards who resided in Ioulaum ' s city . The First Floating City .

title: Xiousing
description: Xiousing Xiousing ( pronounced " yow - sing " ) was a small , cramped district in northern Marsember in Cormyr inhabited primarily by Shou . History . Xiousing was built on land exposed after the level of the Sea of Fallen Stars dropped in the years following the Spellplague .

title: Xisar
description: Xisar Xisar , or simply the Blue Kraken , was a powerful kraken of history in Serôs . History . A very unusual sapphire - blue - tinged kraken Xisar attacked multiple times Es ' purr and the Hills of Eralis , trying to enslave the eastern locathah tribes .

title: Xivros
description: Xivros Emissary Xivros was one of the many Red Wizards of Thay serving under Valindra Shadowmantle in Neverwinter in 1484 DR . History . The emissary Xivros decided to raise the powerful ancient ogre warrior Arleon the Unforgiven as an undead to guide Valindra ' s undead army in the conquest of the city .

title: Xol
description: Xol Xol was a flumph living in the Underdark beneath the Earthspur Mountains near Mulmaster . Personality . Xol greatly disliked evil and did all in his ability to stop it .

title: Xolkin Alassandar
description: Xolkin Alassandar Xolkin Alassandar was the leader of the Seven Snakes sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Xolkin and his six men usually did " dirty works " for the Zhentarim , in particular Nelkin Danniker .

title: Xonthal ' s Tower
description: Xonthal ' s Tower Xonthal ' s Tower was a tower in the Western Heartlands that housed the wizard Xonthal after 1361 DR . History . The tower became famous in the Realms for its unusual magical defenses , including the magical hedge maze that surrounded it .

title: Xontuil Bay
description: Xontuil Bay Xontuil Bay was a bay in the Golden Water , lying between Durpar and Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn . It was fed by the river Xon . It was also known as Xonaluir Bay and the Narrow Seas .

title: Xoraulkyr
description: Xoraulkyr Xoraulkyr was a beholder in Waterdeep . Personality . The beholder believed himself above all other minds until Elminster defeated and froze Xoraulkyr in a Waterdeep prison .

title: Xorhun
description: Xorhun Xorhun , also known as Corellon ' s Cradle and Lifeblood Falls , is a special city in the Turmish area , on the edge of the Halondar Valley . Xorhun serves primarily as a stopping point along the Halondar , the road that connects Hlondeth to the south and Alaghôn to the north . It is populated primarily by craftsmen and merchants .

title: Xorla Djannas
description: Xorla Djannas Xorla Djannas was fervent champion of the deity Cyric who resided in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Biography . A native of the southern region of Tethyr , Xorla moved to Waterdeep with her master Selphar Thynn .

title: Xorn
description: Xorn Xorns ( alternative plural " xorn " ) were strange elemental creatures from the Plane of Earth . Reputation . Grumbar , the lord of elemental earth , naturally favored xorns .

title: Xorthaul Barriath
description: Xorthaul Barriath Xorthaul Barriath was a drow - dragon who held the position of the Patron Father of Jhachalkhyn . Description . Xorthaul Barriath was a drow - dragon cleric of Vhaeraun .

title: Xorvintaal
description: Xorvintaal Xorvintaal , sometimes referred to as " The Great Game " or just " The Game " , was a game dragon s used as a proxy for open warfare . Rules . Dragons who played " xorvintaal " were called " taaldarax " .

title: Xothaerin
description: Xothaerin Xothaerin was a subkingdom of Deep Shanatar with Sharindlar as its patron deity . Geography . It was located below western Amn and known as the Adamant Kingdom .

title: Xualahuu
description: Xualahuu Xualahuu was a Zhentarim beholder in Anauroch . History . By 1358 DR , it had been seriously injured and lost the use of some of its eyestalks .

title: Xulla
description: Xulla Xulla was a beholder member of the Zhentarim . Relationships . Xulla was the longest and most loyal beholder ally of Fzoul Chembryl .

title: Xullrae Dhuurniv
description: Xullrae Dhuurniv Xullrae Dhuurniv was the youngest of the Matron Sisters of House Dhuurniv involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in the Year of Risen Elfkin , 1375 DR . History . Although Xullrae allied together with her sisters with the Zhentarim the Matron Sisters had plots in minds different from the objective of the Zhent and the Shar rans ; the true plan of Xullrae was recreate a swarm of spiderfire , an ancient kind of spider , and unleash them in the Cormanthor forest to burn it down .

title: Xvart
description: Xvart Xvarts ( also known as Xivorts or Svarts ) were a race of small blue humanoid s . Description . Xvarts were relatively small , standing at around 3 feet ( 0 .

title: Xxiphu
description: Xxiphu Xxiphu , also known as the Soaring City , was an ancient mobile aboleth city from the Far Realm that had existed on Abeir - Toril since prehistoric times . Description . Xxiphu was a glyph - scribed obelisk with tentacles sprawling from its walls , wrapped in an eternal storm that soared over the surface of the world .

title: Xylopal
description: Xylopal Xylopal was a form of petrified wood with a more lustrous beauty . Description . Xylopal was similar to tempskya ( petrified wood ) except the wood fiber was replaced by opal instead of .

title: Xynicynct
description: Xynicynct Xynicynct was the jailor of Vorgansharax in 1489 DR . History . After Vorgansharax ' s coup Xynicynct lead a squad of Tears of Virulence in trying to stop the escape from the city of Madame Freona , the Lord Sage of Phlan and Jhessail Greycastle but was killed by a adventuring party hired by the resistance

title: Xzar
description: Xzar Xzar was an insane wizard and a member of the Zhentarim . He was quite unbalanced and would randomly spout gibberish at unpredictable moments . He was sent to the Baldur ' s Gate area during the iron crisis with his " colleague " Montaron .

title: Xzorsh
description: Xzorsh Xzorsh ( pronounced with a click followed by " zzorshhh " ) was a sea elf ranger dwelling in the Trackless Sea . Personality . Xzorsh was a ranger who was quite curious and relatively open - minded .

title: Xûl - Jarak
description: Xûl - Jarak Xûl - Jarak , also called The Gray Citadel because of its gray ashen walls , is a fortress that has long been in disrepair . It is situated two days ride north of Melvaunt along the road to Glister , in the realm of Thar . It sits atop a 20ft ( 7 .

title: Y ' chak
description: Y ' chak Y ' chak , " " The Violet Flame " " , is an Elder Evil who is actively interested in the destruction of life and an inspiration for all that is destructive and ruinous within civilizations . The Aboleth s believe that the gods of evil came to be as a result of Y ' chak ' s whisperings and Y ' chak encourages the worship of those deities . Y ' chak appears to those it contacts as a member of the same race , but its true form is said to be a brilliant pillar of violet flames that conceal an inner form which is to horrifying to see .

title: Y ' lara
description: Y ' lara " Y ' lara " was a yochlol trapped in Menzoberranzan during the Rage of Demons . History . A yochlol was sent by Lolth to help Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre in a demon lord summoning ritual in late 1486 DR .

title: Yaaz Gut - Breaker
description: Yaaz Gut - Breaker Yaaz Gut - Breaker was an ogre mage living on Jazirat al - Sadaf in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . He ruled a mixed tribe of ogres and ogre magi called the Gurum . Description .

title: Yadd al - Djinni
description: Yadd al - Djinni Yadd al - Djinni , or the Hand of the Djinni , were rocky jungle islands of the Djinni ' s Claws southwest of mainland Zakhara . Geography . The islands of Yadd al - Djinni were very slender and covered with dense jungle .

title: Yaemon
description: Yaemon Yaemon was a monk of Bishamon at the Shining Temple of Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Yaemon was a good man but too often jumped too quickly to conclusions and reacted violently .

title: Yaereene Ilbaereth
description: Yaereene Ilbaereth Yaereene Ilbaereth was an elf of House Ilbaereth and the proprietor of the Elfstone Tavern , a tavern aimed at elves and half - elves in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep . She usually had a blue - green faerie dragon familiar named Pyrith on her shoulder . Appearance .

title: Yaga - Shura
description: Yaga - Shura Yaga - Shura was a fire giant Bhaalspawn and one of the Five . He commanded an army of fire giants and humans in an attempt to destroy other Bhaalspawn , advancing greatly in that objective when he laid siege to and finally sacked Saradush . He had acquired invulnerability to all attacks by having his heart removed and keeping it burning with magical fire .

title: Yaghi - Siyan
description: Yaghi - Siyan Emir Yaghi - Siyan was the ruler of Delbyl during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . The position of Emir of Delbyl was typically given to incompetent individuals , or as punishment from the bey .

title: Yagoth
description: Yagoth Yagoth was an ogre chieftain of Thar during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . Yagoth was both chieftain of his tribe and a shaman of the god Vaprak .

title: Yak ' s Horn
description: Yak ' s Horn The Yak ' s Horn was a southwestern province of the Yikarian Empire in 1367 DR . Geography . This province was split into equal parts of rocky terrain from the World Pillar Mountains on the northeastern side , and a portion of the desert wasteland known as the Haunted Lands in the southwest .

title: Yak butter
description: Yak butter Yak butter was a soft cream cheese made from the of a yak . It was made in the Spine of the World , Khazari , the Hordelands and the Land of the Yak - Men . Description .

title: Yak folk
description: Yak folk Yak - folk were a race inhabiting the remote mountains of northern Zakhara . They referred to themselves as the yikaria , which translated as " Lucky Chosen " in their language . Yak - men was another common name for them among the natives of the Land of Fate .

title: Yal Tengri
description: Yal Tengri Yal Tengri , also known as the Great Ice Sea , was an arm of the ocean that covered the north pole of Toril . All sorts of cold - loving creatures were found in its waters . The sea was open for about six months of the year .

title: Yalathanil Symbaern
description: Yalathanil Symbaern Yalathanil Symbaern was a reclusive sun elf wizard . Activities . As of 1368 DR , he was the patriarch of House Symbaern and was at least 1000 years old .

title: Yalek Snurd
description: Yalek Snurd Yalek Snurd was a spy of the Zhentarim in 1489 DR . History . Yalek infiltrated the new faction of the Cult of the Dragon led by Severin Silrajin .

title: Yamun Khahan
description: Yamun Khahan Yamun Khahan lived in the Hordelands during the mid – 14th century DR . Personality . Though he came from humble beginnings , Yamun Khahan was a natural leader who possessed both charisma and strong ambition .

title: Yan - C - Bin
description: Yan - C - Bin Yan - C - Bin , also known as the Prince of Evil Air , was a powerful archomental from the Elemental Plane of Air . Description . Yan - C - Bin commonly appeared to his followers as a tall , thin , elderly humanoid with long hair flowing in the wind .

title: Yanitsava
description: Yanitsava The Yanitsava was a holy book within the Red Mountain Sect of the Path of Enlightenment . In it , it was said that all things had their balance . The lama Koja of Khazari used this to explain to Foxe that kumiss warmed the blood , despite the taste , and that Faerûn ian roast meats unbalanced the weak and strong animus — meaning that Foxe was overweight .

title: Yanna Hammerbound
description: Yanna Hammerbound Yanna Hammerbound was a dwarf and a high - ranking member of the Ironhanded in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . Yanna worked as high - ranking member of Phlan ' s Ironworkers ' Guild .

title: Yannik Johastra
description: Yannik Johastra Yannik Johastra was a minor noble in the Monastery of the Precipice in 1479 DR . Activities . Yannik traveled to Spellgard in 1478 DR seeking Lady Saharel ' s counsel regarding a feud between his sons .

title: Yanseldara
description: Yanseldara Lady Yanseldara is the , human , ruler of the city of Elversult . She killed the black dragon Cypress . When he was resurrected as a dracolich by the Cult of the Dragon , he became fixated on her believing himself to be in love with his killer .

title: Yantha Coaxrock
description: Yantha Coaxrock Yantha Coaxrock was the leader of of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone during the Rage of Demons . History . Yantha was a young wizard who became the leader of the Stoneheart Enclave in Blingdenstone .

title: Yaphyll
description: Yaphyll Yaphyll was the Zulkir of divination in the Red Wizards of Thay who was a strong supporter of Druxus Rhym and Szass Tam . She often used her magic to keep an eye on the other Zulkirs and various Thay an enclaves throughout Faerûn . History .

title: Yapoza
description: Yapoza Yapoza was an Azuposi human settlement of 1 , 200 people on the banks of the Pasocada River in Maztica . History . A myth surrounded the city ' s history .

title: Yaraella
description: Yaraella Yarealla was a powerful Rashemi witch who had an extremely strong connection to the spirit world . In 1480 DR she was driven mad and apparently committed suicide , leaving her young daughter behind . In reality , Yarealla was murdered by the Wychlaren Sree because of Yarealla ' s refusal to join the Wychlaren and because Sree wanted to raise Yarealla ' s child as a Wychlaren .

title: Yarash
description: Yarash Yarash was a wizard living near Phlan in 1340 DR . Activities . Yarash was a wizard and alchemist who busied himself with creating new species in his pyramid near Phlan in order to dominate the Moonsea .

title: Yarbro
description: Yarbro Yarbro was a male human soldier living in Shadowdale during the Time of Troubles of 1358 DR . History . He was guarding the gates of the city when the company of Midnight and Kelemvor Lyonsbane arrived before Bane ' s assault .

title: Yarin Frostmantle
description: Yarin Frostmantle Yarin Frostmantle was the king of the Bloodstone Lands . History . Yarin Frostmantle was born a noble in the Bloodstone Lands .

title: Yarjack Blamreld
description: Yarjack Blamreld Yarjack Blamreld was a veteran War Wizard of Cormyr in Arabel . History . Around 1479 DR , Blamreld was one of the leading War Wizards sent to besiege the Stormserpent Towers near Suzail .

title: Yarkul
description: Yarkul Yarkul was a member of the Zhentarim in Darkhold in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Description . Yarkul was a black - haired female wizard .

title: Yarlhang La
description: Yarlhang La Yarlhang La , or the Trying Pass , was a prominent mountain pass located the Hordelands . Based upon maps of the region , Yarlhang La was the general location where the A - Ling Shan and Katakoro Shan mountain ranges converged . Geography .

title: Yarno
description: Yarno Yarno was a young werewolf living in Velarswood . Description . He had dark hair and was dirty .

title: Yarrat
description: Yarrat Yarrat was a small dwarven village within the High Desert of Zakhara . Description . Yarrat was located near the southern tip of the Genies ' Anvil .

title: Yarsha
description: Yarsha Yarsha was a high - ranking member of the Cult of the Black Earth at the Temple of the Black Earth in Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Yarsha was a murderous individual , plotting to kill and replace Miraj Vizann .

title: Yartar
description: Yartar Yartar was a fortified city standing on the east bank of the River Dessarin . It was connected by a fortified bridge to a citadel on the west bank where the Evermoor Way ( linking Triboar and Silverymoon crossed the Dessarin . It was a crossroads trading town , so it was always bustling with caravans entering and leaving its walls .

title: Yarth
description: Yarth Yarth of Berun was a gnome businessman in Daggerford around 1370 DR . Activities . Yarth managed a series of vaults , considered the safest places to store items in all the North .

title: Yarting
description: Yarting A yarting was a stringed instrument , similar to a , common to Amn and Calimshan . Description . Yartings were widespread among bard s across Faerûn and many variations of the instrument existed .

title: Yashar
description: Yashar Yashar was a male medusa that guarded the Undying Temple during the Silence of Lolth . Description . He was only 5 ft ( 1 .

title: Yasir
description: Yasir Yasir was a bandit and member of the Desert Wind during the mid – 14th century DR . Activities . Yasir served as one of Sheik Ar - Rabi ' s lieutenants .

title: Yasmi al - Datma
description: Yasmi al - Datma Yasmi al - Datma was one of many wives of the Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir in Huzuz . Description . Yasmi was a slim , elven woman with wide , sky blue eyes .

title: Yasraena Dyrr
description: Yasraena Dyrr Yasraena Dyrr was the matron mother of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan until 1373 DR . History . Yasraena was the granddaughter of the Lichdrow and sister of Auro ' pol Dyrr , who was matron mother until 1358 DR .

title: Yastera Menano
description: Yastera Menano Yastera " Blackhands " Menano was a Proven Thief of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm in 1370 DR with a unique power . Description . Yastera was slender and fairly short , with wispy red hair and freckles on her nose .

title: Yataghan
description: Yataghan The yataghan was a type of one - handed sword , closely related to the sabre . Description . It featured a broad blade with one edge , slightly curved inward .

title: Yathaghera
description: Yathaghera Yathaghera , the Winged Queen , is a pegasus demigoddess bound to Toril and the Prime Material Plane . She dwells on the Island of Evermeet . Appearance .

title: Yathchol webrider
description: Yathchol webrider A Yathchol webrider was a prestige class of the Underdark . Yathchol webriders were generally members of the chitine race of spiderkind , though anyone who possessed the capacity to create a web through natural or magical means might elect to become a webrider . A stealthy disposition meant that rogues were a natural fit for this class .

title: Yather Indaglol
description: Yather Indaglol Yather Indaglol was the proprietor of the Helm at Highsun in Red Larch . Personality . Yather Indaglol was a reclusive mage who stays in a locked , warded room in the back of his tavern .

title: Yathla Oloryn
description: Yathla Oloryn Yathla " Shimmerstar " Oloryn " was a human woman living in Calaunt in the Vast around 1358 DR . She was an expert make - up artist and cosmetic surgeon , skilled with all kinds of human disguises . She was also a talented actor .

title: Yathrinshee
description: Yathrinshee Mistresses of undead , the yathrinshee used arcane magic along with their clerical powers to further the aims of Kiaransalee . Culture . Yathrinshees were leaders among the church of Kiaransalee and were often the instigators of many of the church ' s plots .

title: Yaulazna
description: Yaulazna Yaulazna was an earthmote used as a fortress by the Five Companies . History . Yaulazna was originally a pirate enclave on Halruaa ' s coast .

title: Yauln
description: Yauln Yauln was the leader of a stone giant clan in the ancient past . History . Yauln led his clan until the duergar of Gracklstugh offered an alliance .

title: Yavendel
description: Yavendel Yavendel was a druid of the Emerald Enclave in Mulmaster . History . In 1491 DR , Yavendel found some of her burrowing mammal friends acting strange .

title: Yawning Portal
description: Yawning Portal The Yawning Portal inn , built in 1306 DR by the later Lord of Waterdeep Durnan on the ruins of Halaster Blackcloak ' s old tower , gained most of its renown for being the primary open route to the Undermountain . A well within its walls led down into the first dungeon of Undermountain . Location .

title: Yder Tanthul
description: Yder Tanthul Prince Yder Tanthul was a male shade and the right hand of his older brother Prince Rivalen Tanthul , whilst being respected and feared as a warrior . Personality . Unlike his elder brother , Rivalen , Yder has no quarrel with Telamont ' s hand , Hadrhune .

title: Yeenoghu
description: Yeenoghu Yeenoghu was the demon prince and lord of savagery , and the chief being worshiped by gnoll s . Relationships . Yeenoghu was the patron of all gnolls and commanded the servitude of ghoul s through the subjugation of the demonic King of Ghouls , Doresain , a former ally of Orcus , who failed to strike back at Yeenoghu for the acquisition of one of his subjects .

title: Yegar
description: Yegar Lord Yegar was the ruler of Citadel Rashemar during the mid 14th century DR . Activities . Lord Yegar dispatched patrols to monitor the Sunrise Mountains .

title: Yegor
description: Yegor Yegor was the leader of a cell of the Cult of the Black Earth in the Moonsea . History . Yegor led an earth cultist cell in the Moonsea ; they acted as minor pirates until 1491 DR .

title: Yehimal Mountains
description: Yehimal Mountains The Yehimal , a name meaning " Rock - Snow " , or the Mountains of Snow , and sometimes called the Yehimal Mountains or simply the Yehimals , was an immense mountain range that formed the primary barrier between the three continents of Zakhara , Faerûn , and Kara - Tur , and between them the Hordelands . They were famed as the largest , highest , most extensive , and indeed greatest mountain range in all the known lands of Toril . Geography .

title: Yellow Sea
description: Yellow Sea The Yellow Sea washed the northern shores of Kara - Tur and the haunted island of Talmaruk , as well as the west coast of Koryo . Geography . Some in Shou Lung considered the Yellow Sea to be the same as the Celestial Sea , which lay in the south .

title: Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs
description: Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs The Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs was a long stretch of sheer rock that served as a natural boundary between part of the eastern Hordelands and western Shou Lung , specifically the provinces of Mai Yuan and Ch ' ing Tung . Geography . The cliffs ran for hundreds of miles from the northernmost region of the Yehimal mountains near Nas Trango Shan to the peak of Shan Trango in the south .

title: Yellow Thunder Falls
description: Yellow Thunder Falls The Yellow Thunder Falls were a large series of waterfalls in the Endless Wastes region . Description . Falling over the Yellow Serpent Border Cliffs in the Katakoro Plateau , the Takt Muren river dropped over 2 , 000 feet ( 610 meters ) to form this large waterfall .

title: Yemere
description: Yemere Yemere was a steel dragon who lived in the disguise of a young windsoul genasi in Akanûl . He was a participant in the draconic game of Xorvintaal and was allied with the gray dragon Vairshekellabex . Yemere travelled with Aoth Fezim ' s expedition into the Akanapeaks to kill Vairshekellabex .

title: Yenandra
description: Yenandra Yenandra , the Pirate Queen , was a Queen of Dambrath from the latter 13th century to the mid – 14th century DR . Relationships . Yenandra was the daughter of Queen Ausitil .

title: Yench ' eng Tzu Yu
description: Yench ' eng Tzu Yu Yench ' eng Tzu Yu was a wu jen member of the Many - Hued Peacock Society in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . Yench ' eng Tzu Yu may have an ulterior motive behind his affiliation with the Many - Hued Peacock .

title: Yenisha
description: Yenisha Yenisha was a clown in the Pasocada Basin in Maztica . History . Yenisha was always a troublemaker , having become disenchanted with her people .

title: Yeoman ' s fiddle
description: Yeoman ' s fiddle A yeoman ' s fiddle was a mechanical musical instrument invented by the gnome artist Nadul DaRoni . It was available for purchase through " Aurora ' s Whole Realms Catalogue " . Description .

title: Yerrininae
description: Yerrininae Yerrininae was the leader of the drider s in service to the drow House Xorlarrin . History . In Menzoberranzan , Yerrininae served Gromph Baenre , who frequently ordered him to guard Ravel Xorlarrin while the younger drow collected spell components .

title: Yeshpek
description: Yeshpek Yeshpek is a large fortified city in the Lake of Steam area of Faerûn . As of 1372 DR , its population was around 23 , 000 . Its inhabitants are known for becoming mercenaries , often reckless ones who oppose authority , and for being critical of others , despite displaying pride over their own goods .

title: Yeslick Orothiar
description: Yeslick Orothiar Yeslick Orothiar is a laid - back , good - natured dwarven cleric of Moradin and Clangeddin Silverbeard . He was once a blacksmith of the Iron Throne , but was betrayed when he casually mentioned the location of his clan ' s long abandoned ore mine to them . Now he is one of the Iron Throne ' s prisoners / slave laborers held in the Cloak Wood mines .

title: Yestabrod
description: Yestabrod Yestabrod was an aberrant myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . History . In Neverlight Grove , Yestabrod was created as the leader of the new Circle of Masters , formed by Phylo only from myconids corrupted by Zuggtmoy .

title: Yeth hound
description: Yeth hound A yeth hound was an intelligent outsider that hunted during night . Description . A yeth hound looked like a big grey hound with glowing cherry - red eyes .

title: Yeti
description: Yeti Yeti , also known as tundra yeti , were large , white - furred creatures that could be found in arctic climates . They were the cold - climate version of the dire ape . Description .

title: Yeva
description: Yeva Appearance . Yeva ' s skin is the color of desert sand with dark mottling . Her hair is long and brown colored , layered into braids .

title: Yezeed
description: Yezeed Qadi Yezeed was a dwarf priest living in Sams Bandar on Jazirat al - Qraidis in the Crowded Sea in 1367 DR . Description . Yezeed spoke so slowly that it often infuriated others .

title: Yggdrasil
