description: Yggdrasil Yggdrasil , also known as the World Ash , was a cosmic plane - spanning tree that linked the Prime Material Plane through the Astral Plane to the Outer Planes that were important to the Norse mythos . The tree ' s roots were in Niflheim ( the second layer of Hades ) , and its crown was in Asgard ( the first layer of Gladsheim ) as described by the Great Wheel cosmology model . Other roots and branches penetrated the Prime planes where the Norse pantheon was recognized , allowing travelers to climb the tree until they reached a " color pool " and step through to their destination .

title: Yggdrasil ' s Child
description: Yggdrasil ' s Child Yggdrasil ' s Child was a tree of great power grown from a seed of the World Ash Yggdrasil . The tree stood in a remote grove on the island of Ruathym north of the Moonshae Isles . Before the destruction of the World Tree in the Spellplague Yggdrasil ' s Child could be used as a portal .

title: Ygorl
description: Ygorl Ygorl was the slaad Lord of Entropy . He was the second - oldest slaad lord , after Ssendam , and was considered the " de facto " ruler of the Outer Plane of Limbo . He was said to have created the Spawning Stone that was the focus of the slaad race , forcing them to take frog - like forms rather than their original , purely chaotic shapes .

title: Yhalvia
description: Yhalvia Yhalvia was an ancient kingdom that was part of the empire of Narfell ( −946 DR to −150 DR ) . History . The baatezu devil lord Orlex ruled Yhalvia with an iron fist .

title: Yharaskrik
description: Yharaskrik Yharaskrik was an illithid . Description . As an illithid , Yharaskrik had a truly horrible appearance .

title: Yhaunn
description: Yhaunn Yhaunn was a coastal city of Sembia built on an old quarry site . History . The city was built on the site of an ancient quarry .

title: Yhekal
description: Yhekal Yhekal was a Zhent wizard in Anauroch . History . Yhekal was a Zhentarim wizard who in 1360 DR plotted an attack in order to enslave the Bedine .

title: Yhliivast
description: Yhliivast The Yhliivast family was a human family residing in Amnwater , Amn around 1368 DR . It was a family of horse breeders and trainers , wheel wrights , and various other caravan trades . As of 1368 DR the head of the family was Lord Jhanos Yhliivast .

title: Yi Woo
description: Yi Woo Yi Woo was a Shou healer who operated a clinic in the Xiousing district of Marsember . In his youth , he studied the arcane as well as the martial arts . Later in life he moved to Xiousing and opened a healing clinic that served both Shou and native Marsembens .

title: Yi Wu ' s Clinic
description: Yi Wu ' s Clinic Yi Wu ' s Clinic was a healing center located in the Xiousing district in Marsember . It was run by the Shou healer known as Yi Wu . The clinic would treat anyone , Shou or Cormyrean , regardless of ability to pay .

title: Yiccardaria
description: Yiccardaria Yiccardaria is one of many handmaidens of Lloth . This type of creature is principally a mediate , a messenger between the priestesses of Menzoberranzan ( more commonly Matron Mothers ) and Lloth . In this case , Yiccardaria seems to be appointed to the reborn Yvonnel the Eternal because she is now the Chosen of Lloth .

title: Yikarian ( language )
description: Yikarian ( language ) Yikarian was the native tongue of the mysterious yak folk of Northeast Zakhara . Given their horrific reputation and their distrust of outsiders , little was known about the language outside of the Yikarian Empire . Yikarian dictionary .

title: Yikarian Empire
description: Yikarian Empire The Yikarian Empire was an ancient empire in the northern corner of Zakhara that was home to the malicious yak - folk . The terrain covered by the Yikarian Empire was known as the Land of the Yak - Men . Geography .

title: Yin - kung T ' o
description: Yin - kung T ' o Yin - kung T ' o was the cell leader of the Royal Vagabonds in Nakamaru around 1357 DR . History . At the celebration of the birth of Goshukara Sadamoto ' s third son , the Gorath disguised himself as Yin - king T ' o to impress Lui - hsia Chih .

title: Yio Dufong
description: Yio Dufong The Yio Dufong , nicknamed " bears " , were a powerful yakuza clan based in the town of T ' o na ' Chee in Koryo . For many years , the Yio Dufong possessed the " standing bear " , a potent magical chalice that granted those who drank from it the strength of a bear . All the Yio Dufong would imbibe before a fight , and for this reason they were called the " bears " .

title: Yip
description: Yip Yip was a madman in Phlan in 1489 DR . History . Yip used to live in a village near Phlan .

title: Yipyak
description: Yipyak Yipyak was the language spoken by kobold s . It was a variation of the Draconic language that sounded like the yapping of a dog . Origins .

title: Yitriq Rukku
description: Yitriq Rukku Yitriq Rukku was a barbarian ruler inhabiting the Plain of Horses in 1357 DR . Activities . Yririq was the Fankiang ruler of Haxkhun and a notorious coward .

title: Yklwa
description: Yklwa An yklwa was a Chult an short spear . Description . A typical yklwa was four feet long , with about 40 % of the length taken up by its sword - like , bladed point .

title: Ylarell
description: Ylarell Ylarell was a member of the City Guard of Waterdeep during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR . Activities . He collaborated with Khelben Arunsun .

title: Yllivia
description: Yllivia Yllivia was a scout and member of the Order of the Gauntlet in Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons . History . In 1489 DR , Yllivia asked for the help of her fellow Villonah Leadstopper to find a map showing a secret white dragon lair .

title: Ylraphon
description: Ylraphon Ylraphon , also known as Yrlaphon , was a town in the Vast , lying on the eastern shore of the northern end of the Dragon Reach , at the eastern end of the Hunt Trail . Etymology . The name " Ylraphon " was variously pronounced as either " Ee - ul - RAFF - on " , " Ee - IL - ra - FON " or " Ee - yil - ra - fon " .

title: Ylsa Henstak
description: Ylsa Henstak Ylsa Henstak was a duergar merchant in Gracklstugh during the Rage of Demons . Activities . Ylsa was a rich merchant in Gracklstugh , notorious for leading caravans that always arrived on schedule .

title: Ylveraasahlisar
description: Ylveraasahlisar Ylveraasahlisar , also known as the Rose Dragon , was an infamous red dragon that ruled Calimshan for more than a century . History . Ylveraasahlisar was a great wyrm that laired somewhere in or near Calimshan in past ages .

title: Ymmeline
description: Ymmeline Ymmeline was a Zhentarim agent in the Moonsea . Activities . Ymmeline resided at the inn and tavern called the Plodding Plow , in the village of The Stop .

title: Yngukulub
description: Yngukulub Yngukulub the Devourer was an aboleth ally of Gar Shatterkeel at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Personality . Yngukulub obeyed Gar because it believed that in the new era of Olhydra the aboleth would rule the world .

title: Yntar Shieldblazon
description: Yntar Shieldblazon Yntar Shieldblazon was a bard . History . Around 1370 DR , Yntar was a local member of the Heralds of Faerûn , holding the title of Flailchains .

title: Yochlol
description: Yochlol A yochlol was a type of lesser tanar ' ri demon that served as " handmaidens " to Lolth , the drow goddess of chaos . Description . Yochlols had four forms available to them : humanoid , spider , ooze , and gaseous .

title: Yola
description: Yola Imam Yola min Zann was a gnome " qadi " living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Yola was the " qadi " for the entire Grand Bazaar and surrounding area , which also happened to be the part of Huzuz with the greatest amount of crime .

title: Yolanda Shamat
description: Yolanda Shamat Yolanda Shamat was a cleric of Loviatar in Waterdeep in 1372 DR . Description . Yolanda always stood rigidly erect and had an icy stare .

title: Yondalla
description: Yondalla Yondalla ( pronounced yon - " dah " - lah ) was the creator of the halfling race and matriarch of not only the halfling pantheon , but the whole race itself . With her charming personality and friendly demeanor she was an example to all halflings ; who almost all shared her curiosity , loyalty and sense of mischief . Yondalla was not , in fact , a true goddess but rather a divine aspect of the goddess Chauntea .

title: Yondalla ' s Children
description: Yondalla ' s Children Yondalla ' s Children was the collective name for the halfling pantheon , which was led by the greater deity Yondalla , known as the Protector and Provider , the Nurturing Matriarch , and the Blessed One . The members of the pantheon were : According to the Great Wheel cosmology model , Yondalla ' s Children resided in Venya , the third layer of the Seven Heavens , which they named the Green Fields . When the World Tree cosmology model became popular , Green Fields became its own plane connected to the World Tree .

title: Yondral Horn
description: Yondral Horn Yondarl Horn was an innkeeper in Rassalantar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Yondarl managed the Sleeping Dragon inn .

title: Yonin
description: Yonin Yonin was a head ninja and also a zussho in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yonin led the ninja village of Susa .

title: Yorel
description: Yorel Yorel was a veteran Zhentilar commander in Zhentil Keep in 1358 DR . Personality . Yorel was a cautious individual well - suited to his job .

title: Yosh al - Nasr
description: Yosh al - Nasr Yosh al - Nasr , or the Eagle , was a Maztican Eagle Knight living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . His real name was Yax Cautli . History .

title: Yoshiie
description: Yoshiie Yoshiie was a bandit leader in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yoshiie led a bandit gang with more than 200 members , including korobokuru , with a kensai second - in - command and sometimes a wu jen in his service .

title: Yoshimo
description: Yoshimo Yoshimo was a rogueish male human from Kara - Tur . He died in Faerûn during Jon Irenicus ' attempt to destroy Suldanessellar with the help of the hidden divine power he brought forth from the souls of Imoen and another Bhaalspawn . The Game .

title: Yosten
description: Yosten Yosten was a sage from the city of Procampur in the Vast . Yosten made a study of the mysterious gigantic stone carvings on the island of Paldir in the Sea of Fallen Stars . As they showed no hand - or foot - holds for their construction , Yosten speculated that the workers began at the top and worked their way down , carving away signs of their work as they went .

title: Yostur Ulhmond
description: Yostur Ulhmond Yostur Ulhmond was a fighter from the villages of the Snow People of Thar in the 1350s DR . In the Year of the Worm , 1356 DR , Yostur was a member of a band of adventurers that rediscovered the fabled Barroch ' s Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm . However , they soon ran into a number of strange creatures , and were separated or killed .

title: Youmans
description: Youmans Youmans was an ex - adventurer in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Youmans had a tragic story : she was once part of an adventuring party who fought some rust monster s and a tribe of orc / gnoll hybrids , and all save Youmans and one other died .

title: Your delicious weakness
description: Your delicious weakness Your delicious weakness , is a spell used by some warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with demon ic powers of the Abyss . When " your delicious weakness " is cast , the warlock strikes into the mind of a creature within fifty feet , uncovering their weaknesses and using those weaknesses against them . The spell is normally charged by a warlock ' s strength of personality but warlocks of the dark pact are able to enhance the deadliness of the spell through concentrating their intellect .

title: Your glorious sacrifice
description: Your glorious sacrifice Your glorious sacrifice is a moderately powerful warlock invocation learned by young or inexperienced warlock s , particularly those who forge pacts with the powers of the Abyss . " Your glorious sacrifice " is , in many ways , a relatively weak spell , injuring a creature within fifty feet through necrotic power enhanced by the warlock ' s strength of personality . However , if the warlock chooses , he may target a nearby ally as well with the power , dealing damage to them as well to increase their chances of successfully attacking their primary target .

title: Yovir Glandon
description: Yovir Glandon Yovir Glandon was the high priest of Kelemvor in Phlan in 1489 DR . Personality . Yovir was a reserved man , speaking as little as possible .

title: Yozumian Dudui Yinochek
description: Yozumian Dudui Yinochek Yozumian Dudui Yinochek was the high priest of the Protector ' s House , a Selûnian temple in Memnon . Activities . On the surface Yozumian ' s clerics helped the poor people of Memnon , but in truth the high members of the church , starting with Yozumian , were corrupt , living in very comfortable room with precious goods and indulging in the company of women .

title: Yrberop
description: Yrberop Yrberop was a myconid leader of a Circle in Neverlight Grove during the Rage of Demons . Personality . Yrberop always listened to a music that only it could hear , but because of Zuggtmoy , people could hear a faint echo of its internal cacophony .

title: Yrjixtilex Kallan
description: Yrjixtilex Kallan Yrjixtilex Kallan was a dragonborn mercenary member of Clan Yrjixtilex , and the interim Vanquisher of Tymanther in 1487 DR . Description . Kallan was a handsome dragonborn , even by human standards , with dark - gray scales and silver eyes .

title: Yrlamar
description: Yrlamar Yrlamar was a wizard who , in his old age , found himself imprisoned in the dungeons underneath the Fortress of the Five Vultures in Calaunt . Deprived of his spellbook , he was unable to escape . Yrlamar was chained next to the wizard Thogaf , and spent a lot of time training his much younger colleague in the art of magic .

title: Yrudis Gregan
description: Yrudis Gregan Yrudis Gregan was a wealthy businessman in Sundabar in 1373 DR . Description . Yrudis was an obese man .

title: Ysele
description: Ysele Ysele the Cat was a businesswoman and wizard in Skullport . Personality . Ysele was a persuasive and manipulative woman .

title: Ysgarda
description: Ysgarda Ysgarda was a page of Candlemas , the of Delia , in the Netherese Empire . Description . The girl had deep blue eyes and short black hair .

title: Yshiggol
description: Yshiggol Yshiggol was a mind flayer elder brain living in the Dread Vault in Gauntlgrym . In the past , Yshiggol was responsible for the corruption of the dwarven Clan Duergar into the subrace of duergar . When the duergar rose against their masters , Yshiggol was thought by all to have been killed by the rebellious slaves .

title: Ysmyrl ' da Starym
description: Ysmyrl ' da Starym Ysmyrl ' da Starym was a clan archmage of the elven Starym clan , one of the twelve founding houses of Cormanthyr , and mother of the house ' s famous missing heir , Josidiah Starym . She was niece by marriage to Taleisin Starym , one of the clan elders . She was a moon elf , a minority in the clan .

title: Ysolde Veladorn
description: Ysolde Veladorn Ysolde Veladorn was the daughter of Qilué Veladorn . History . Ysolde was born to the Chosen of Eilistraee Qilué Veladorn and her companion Elkantar Iluim in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden in Skullport .

title: Ysuran Auondril
description: Ysuran Auondril Ysuran Auondril is a moon elf necromancer and one of five starting playable characters in . He has access to more magical specializations than the other characters and he carries a black tome at all times during the game . Biography .

title: Ysval
description: Ysval Ysval was a nighthaunt ; a sentient undead being from the Plane of Shadow - an avatar of darkness . Appearance . Ysval somewhat resembled a gargoyle with bat wings , talons , curling horns and a whipping serpentine tail .

title: Ythazz Buvaar
description: Ythazz Buvaar Ythazz Buvaar was a Red Wizard of Thay demilich in 1368 DR and one of the fonder of modern Thay . History . Ythazz was one of the members of the original group of Red Wizard when Thay was still a province of the empire of Mulhorand .

title: Yuan - ti
description: Yuan - ti Yuan - ti are a species of monstrous humanoid snake - men and are usually of an evil alignment . Yuan - ti have their own language , and they can also speak Common , Draconic , and Abyssal . Society .

title: Yuan - ti abomination
description: Yuan - ti abomination Yuan - ti abominations were monstrous serpent - like creatures , almost completely snakelike except for a roughly humanoid torso . They formed the highest caste of yuan - ti society . Description .

title: Yuan - ti anathema
description: Yuan - ti anathema Yuan - ti anathemas were the result of a ritual that transformed a yuan - ti abomination into a larger , more powerful and more aggressive creature . They were considered by their followers to be the pinnacle of the yuan - ti race . Description .

title: Yuan - ti halfblood
description: Yuan - ti halfblood < / ref > Halfbloods , also known as malisons , were a subrace of the yuan - ti , a psionic race of serpent - men . Halfblood was not a precise category but generally referred to a yuan - ti with half human - like and half snake - like features , which shared certain common abilities . Description .

title: Yuan - ti pit master
description: Yuan - ti pit master Yuan - ti pit masters were the most conservative of yuan - ti malison priests . They had a pact with the god Merrshaulk and pledged to sacrifice humanoids to him in order to raise him . Advocates of caution and always opposed to reckless behavior , pit masters were the most deeply concerned with the yuan - ti ' s plans of world domination .

title: Yuan - ti pureblood
description: Yuan - ti pureblood Purebloods were the most human - seeming of all true yuan - ti and one of three main breeds — the other two being the halfbloods and the abominations . Description . Purebloods were described as human - like but with minor reptilian features , such as snake - like eyes , a forked tongue , and patches of scales on their skin .

title: Yuchimo Ein
description: Yuchimo Ein Yuchimo Ein was a monk of Bishamon at the Shining Temple of Bishamon in the town of Aru in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . He was a high - ranking monk of Bishamon , based permanently at the Shining Temple .

title: Yuf Bawrax
description: Yuf Bawrax Yuf Bawrax was a man living in the settlement of Bejung in Koryo around 1358 DR , described as an " old northern barbarian " . He could often be found at The Sharpening House , a local tavern . Yuf had discovered an entrance into the ruins of the city of Old Bejung .

title: Yugoloth
description: Yugoloth Yugoloths ( also often called daemons or nicknamed loths ) are neutral evil fiend ish natives of the Blood Rift who are neutral to the affairs of the other fiendish races , interfering only when they see a situation that may be profitable or a potential for the advancement of their own schemes . The yugoloths are manipulative , secretive , and mercenary by nature , often acting as soldiers for in their own private wars , or even at times aiding both sides of the Blood War . Physical description .

title: Yui Min Li
description: Yui Min Li Yui Min Li was the Minister of Faith of Shou Lung in 1358 DR . History . Yui Min Li was originally a sohei of the Dragon Order but also an Imperial Guard .

title: Yuir
description: Yuir The Yuir elves were a proud race of wild elves who inhabited the Yuirwood in what is now known as Aglarond . They possessed powerful magic and held ceremonies in circles of stone menhirs . The Yuir fell into decline , pressured by outside forces such as a human presence , and eventually ceased to exist , although their ancestry remains in some of the half - elves of modern Aglarond .

title: Yuir pantheon
description: Yuir pantheon The Yuir pantheon was the pantheon of ten deities once worshiped by the primitive tribes of indigenous human s living in the forests of what became Aglarond , the Great Dale , Impiltur and Narfell . These humans eventually moved on , with the last cohesive remnants of their tribes becoming the Nar s , who turned from the pantheon in favour of Abyssal powers . These gods came to be associated with the Yuir elves when they established homes within those woodlands after the Crown Wars in - 9800 DR .

title: Yuirwood
description: Yuirwood Once home to a powerful nation of elves , in 1372 DR , the Yuirwood is the site of ancient ruins of unknown power and origin . It is located in the center of the nation of Aglarond , and is populated by elves and half elves . Sildëyuir is a plane of finite size that is conterminous with the Yuirwood in Faerûn , perhaps two to three hundred miles from end to end , and is home to the Star Elves , a subrace of elves that left Faerûn in antiquity .

title: Yuji Takaesu
description: Yuji Takaesu Yuji Takaesu was a samurai in the town of Aru in Wa . Personality . Yuji was totally loyal to his daimyo .

title: Yuk Yuk
description: Yuk Yuk Yuk Yuk was a goblin living in the Silken Paths during the Rage of Demons . Personality . He was a thrill - seeking individual .

title: Yukio
description: Yukio Yukio the Rice Merchant was one of the most powerful merchant in Miyama Province in Kozakura in 1357 DR . Activities . Yukio operated by a large fortified house with all confort in the Castle District of Tamanokuni .

title: Yulis
description: Yulis Yulis the Fortune Teller was a human woman who had the ability to divine the future . As of 1479 DR , she lived in the city of Harglast , in the Windrise Ports of Returned Abeir . Abilities .

title: Yumbu Shan
description: Yumbu Shan Yumbu Shan was a large mountain peak found in the nation of Khazari in the Hordelands . Geography . Yumbu Shan was found in the southwest corner of Khazari where an arm of Katakoro Shan encircled the country from the south .

title: Yuminoi Bowida
description: Yuminoi Bowida Yuminoi Bowida was a Roju representative in Fochu in Wa around 1357 DR . Activities . Yuminoi was sent from Uwaji by the Roju in Fochu to survey possible activity of followers of Chauntea in the area since daimyo Bokika Hokio was known to sympathized for them .

title: Yunik al - Zanil
description: Yunik al - Zanil Yunik al - Zanil ran a small shop specializing in flying tours within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR . Activities . Yunik ’ s rates were pricey , but worth it .

title: Yurian
description: Yurian The yurians , also known as crabmen , aldani , or lobster men , were a race of crustacean beings that inhabited the seas and rivers of Faerûn . Description . An aldani resembled a the size of a human being , walking on two humanoid legs but they could swim like lobsters .

title: Yurtrus
description: Yurtrus Yurtrus was an orc god of death and disease . Where Shargaas symbolized the fear of what lurked in the bowels of the earth , Yurtrus embodied the constant threat of death and plagues with which the orc s lived every day . Description .

title: Yusendre
description: Yusendre Yusendre was one of the Nimbral Lords . She was an impish fun - loving figure and one of the leading Elders . History .

title: Yusten Karas
description: Yusten Karas Yusten Karas was a drow assassin and sword master in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . History . At one point , he was captured in Phlan and put in prison .

title: Yusuf bin Ayyub
description: Yusuf bin Ayyub Yusuf bin Ayyub was the leader of the Loyalists within the fortress of Sarahin in 1367 DR . Personality . Paranoid that everyone was jealous of his position within Sarahin , Yusuf was accompanied by three werelion bodyguards at all times .

title: Yusuke T ' ing
description: Yusuke T ' ing Yusuke T ' ing was an inhabitant of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Yusuke lived in the village of Sokijan in Fochu Peninsula .

title: Yuvaraj
description: Yuvaraj Yuvaraj was the last " Lord Artificer " ( Emperor ) of Imaskar . He fell in battle with the deity Horus at the palace of Inupras in - 2488 DR . The battle , in which he rode his copper dragon mount and wore the " First Imaskarcana " , was the final confrontation between the Imaskari and the Mulan and their deities .

title: Yvonnel Baenre
description: Yvonnel Baenre Yvonnel Baenre , often known only as Matron Baenre or simply Baenre , was the matron mother of House Baenre in the city of Menzoberranzan . She led her house and the city itself with an uncanny strength bred from deceitful ambition . Description .

title: Yxunomei
description: Yxunomei Yxunomei was a marilith demon who threatened Icewind Dale . History . Yxunomei wished to precipitate an ages - old vendetta against the baatezu Belhifet while also returning Icewind Dale to its ancient jungle - like state , wherein her serpentine followers could thrive .

title: Yûlash
description: Yûlash Yûlash was a fortress town positioned between the two cities of Zhentil Keep and Hillsfar . The ongoing conflict between these two cities meant that Yûlash spent much of its history in ruin and occupied by soldiers . Geography .

title: Z ' har thalack
description: Z ' har thalack Z ' har thalack , meaning " riding war " , was a fighting style taught among drow for those who fought on mounts . Description . As the name " riding war " suggested , users fought while riding , and the style addressed the benefits and drawbacks of this as for any mounted warrior .

title: Z ' ress a ' thalak
description: Z ' ress a ' thalak Z ' ress athalak , meaning " force of war " , was a fighting style taught among drow . It was unusual for drow as it revolved around the users ' physical strength . Description .

title: Za - Jikku
description: Za - Jikku Za - Jikku was a powerful wu jen of Fochu Peninsula in Wa . History . Originally Za - Jikku was a pan lung member of the Celestial Bureaucracy .

title: Zabbas Thuul
description: Zabbas Thuul Zabbas Thuul was a rogue and all - around ne ' er - do - well who operated out of Waterdeep and Skullport . He made his living either as a thief , using his magical powers to augment his chances of success , or as an agent for several devious organizations who operated out of the Port of Shadows . Among those he worked for were the Iron Ring slavers and the Red Wizards of Thay through Consul Orgin Ulmokina in their enclave in Skullport .

title: Zachan
description: Zachan Zachan was a villager of Highcliff on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Zachan was in Weeping Willow Inn when he was attacked by bladeling s and duergar .

title: Zagum
description: Zagum Zagum was a vassal of Asmodeus . Personality . He was noted for cold - blooded ambition .

title: Zahara ' s Krakens
description: Zahara ' s Krakens Zahara ' s Krakens were a mercenary company based in the Sword Coast around 1358 DR . They had a lucrative business of protecting shipping . Tactics .

title: Zaheb al - Zidq
description: Zaheb al - Zidq Zaheb al - Zidq was a noble dao inhabiting Ajayib in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Activities . Despite being a mighty noble among the dao , Zaheb was madly in love with the Calipha of Ajayib , Halima al - Wahsi .

title: Zaid bin Ziyad
description: Zaid bin Ziyad Zaid bin Ziyad was a cook in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Zaid was a large man .

title: Zairtail
description: Zairtail Zairtails are small aggressive lizards found across Returned Abeir . Description . These reptile s have bodies around the size of a human hand and tails which are about twice this length .

title: Zakhara
description: Zakhara Zakhara , also known as the Land of Fate , was a giant peninsula of the same super - continent that hosted Faerûn and Kara - Tur on the planet Abeir - Toril . The land was located south and east of Faerûn , beyond the region of the Utter East , with the closest Faerûnian lands to Zakhara being Dambrath and Var the Golden ( by sea ) and Ulgarth or arguably Konigheim ( by land ) . Zakhara was mostly isolated from the rest of the world , as the peninsula was separated from the main mass by the treacherous World Pillar Mountains .

title: Zakharan ( ethnicity )
description: Zakharan ( ethnicity ) Zakharans were the human ethnicity that made up the vast majority of the population of Zakhara , the Land of Fate . Description . Zakharans tended to be shorter than those of other human groups on average .

title: Zakharan Calendar Months
description: Zakharan Calendar Months According to Zakhara n sage s , the planet Al - Toril had 360 days in its year plus 5 holy days . Each year had twelve 30 - day months which roughly matched the orbit of Al - Toril ' s single moon . The months of the year for Zakhara were broken down as follows :

title: Zakharan Holidays
description: Zakharan Holidays The people of Zakhara celebrated a wide range of holidays , holy days , and festivals throughout the year . High Holy Days . The five High Holy Days — Ahad , Atnen , Salas , Arba , and Yasad — occurred between the months of Qawafil and Safa .

title: Zakharan ogre
description: Zakharan ogre Zakharan ogre s were found throughout the Land of Fate . Personality . In Zakhara , these ogres interacted with the world in many of the same ways that human s , elves , or dwarves did , though they did not have superior crafting skills .

title: Zakharan pantheon
description: Zakharan pantheon The Zakharan pantheon greatly influenced the culture on the continent of Zakhara , which was shaped by the Law of the Loregiver — a set of common values including honor , hospitality and the importance of one ' s family that date back to the teachings of a person called the Loregiver . Altogether this is called Enlightenment . Accordingly the commonly worshiped deities of Zakhara were seen as enlightened and differed from other deities worshiped on Al - Toril because they did not have a precise portfolio .

title: Zakharan roc
description: Zakharan roc Zakharan rocs were monstrous raptors found in the Land of Fate . They were even larger versions of their northern cousins . Three variations of Zakharan rocs existed : the common roc , great roc , and two - headed roc .

title: Zakharan seas
description: Zakharan seas The continent of Zakhara was renowned for its burning deserts and lush jungles , but the seas surrounding its varied coastlines allowed much travel and trade hindered by its harsh interior . Surrounding seas . The Land of Fate was surrounded by three major seas : < br > Together , these interior bodies of water separated the west of Zakhara almost completely from its central and eastern portion , with only a relatively narrow strip of land between Qudra and Liham connecting the regions of the High Desert and the Haunted Lands .

title: Zaknafein Do ' Urden
description: Zaknafein Do ' Urden Zaknafein Do ' Urden was the famed weapons master of House Daermon N ' a ' shezbaernon more commonly known as House Do ' Urden . He was also Drizzt Do ' Urden ' s father , his mentor and his dearest friend . It was he who gave Drizzt the courage to leave Menzoberranzan and trained him to become an excellent warrior .

title: Zal ' therra Baenre
description: Zal ' therra Baenre Zal ' therra Baenre was a cousin of Triel Baenre and commander of the rearguard of the Army of the Black Spider in 1372 DR . She was the most promising of Triel ' s cousins . Description .

title: Zalantar
description: Zalantar Zalantar , also called blackwood or darkwood , was a subtropical tree that was usually found in southern Faerûn . Description . Zalantars grew oddly in the sense that one plant was composed of several tree trunks that stemmed from a central root system .

title: Zalaren
description: Zalaren Zalaren was a priest of Waukeen and an agent of the Lords ' Alliance in 1489 DR . Personality . Zalaren was a dour individual .

title: Zalarth Bloodbrow
description: Zalarth Bloodbrow Zalarth Bloodbrow was a Zhentarim wizard and a trusted agent of Manshoon . History . In 1358 DR , after Elminster Aumar had foiled a Zhentarim plot to conquer High Dale , Manshoon decided to send the young Avaerl to track and kill the Old Mage .

title: Zalathorm Kirkson
description: Zalathorm Kirkson Zalathorm Kirkson was the Netyarch ( wizard - king ) of the nation of Halruaa . Activities . As of 1367 DR , Zalathorm served as the leader of Halruaa and head of the Council of Elders .

title: Zalaznar Crinios
description: Zalaznar Crinios Zalaznar Crinios was the ruler of Cedarsproke in the Gulthmere Forest in 1370 DR . Activities . Zalaznar was a totally independent leader , not affiliated with the Emerald Enclave .

title: Zalazuu
description: Zalazuu Zalazuu ( also seen as Zalasuu ) was a city located in southeast Halruaa nestled in the Bay of Azuth . Description . Zalasuu was a small city with a population of 5 , 000 .

title: Zaldar Floshin
description: Zaldar Floshin Zaldar Floshin was a sea - captain in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zaldar was the captain of the " Kelpie ' s Kiss " .

title: Zallanora Argentresses
description: Zallanora Argentresses Zallanora Argentresses was a young elf and only 105 years old , when she met the demilich , known as Shoon VII . She appeared to be still a young , short elf woman with bobbed silver and curly hair . Her coppery skin and hazel eyes showed her sylvan - elf heritage .

title: Zallara
description: Zallara Zallara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee . Description . Zallara had black skin and very long , flowing white hair .

title: Zaltec
description: Zaltec Zaltec was the chaotic evil god of war in Maztica . He was also known as Bringer of War and the Eater of Hearts . The latter title says what he demanded of his followers .

title: Zaltember
description: Zaltember Zaltember was a fire giant and the sadistic son of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . In the late 1480s or early 1490s DR , Zaltember was overseeing four ogre s in the upper level of Ironslag ' s foundry .

title: Zalto
description: Zalto Duke Zalto was the ruler of the fire giant s sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Zalto was one of the giant lords at time of the shattering of the ordning .

title: Zaltys Serrat
description: Zaltys Serrat Zaltys Serrat was a yuan - ti pureblood ranger and the adopted daughter of Alaia Serrat , one of the three leaders of the merchant clan House Serrat . Until she was seventeen , she believed she was human . Zaltys spent much of her time with the Travelers of House Serrat who harvested terazul in the jungles south of Delzimmer .

title: Zaluski
description: Zaluski Zaluski was a fishmonger in Daggerford around 1370 DR . History . Zaluski was a fishmonger west of Mirabar but was forced to abandon the area because of the growing pressure from Luskan .

title: Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn
description: Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn Zamanyeh bint Salman al - Kahn was a mamluk who lived in Liham in 1367 DR . Activities . Captain Zamanyeh was in charge of guarding from Liham .

title: Zammzt Everharn
description: Zammzt Everharn Zammzt Everharn was a drow - dragon ( " draa ' zekylyn " ) and one of the eight patron fathers of the Jaezred Chaulssin . Specifically , he was the Patron Father of Ched Nasad . Description .

title: Zamogedi
description: Zamogedi The Zamogedi were a tribe of nomadic human s living in the Hordelands . Territory . The Zamogedi lived in the eastern Hordelands near Shou Lung , near the Tuigan tribe .

title: Zamogedi language
description: Zamogedi language Zamogedi was a tribal tongue of the Hordelands bordering Shou Lung . Description . Zamogedi was an nasal language , with long I and E vowels drawn out .

title: Zan - akar Zeraez
description: Zan - akar Zeraez Zan - akar Zeraez was a stormsoul genasi who served as the ambassador of Akanûl . Description . Zan - akar had long and slender silver spikes projecting from his scalp , and his skin color was like the duskiest grapes .

title: Zanda Tholing
description: Zanda Tholing Zanda Tholing , also called the Place of Kings or the Resting Place of Kings , was an important ritual site for the royalty of Khazari . Description . Located far outside the borders of Khazari , Zanda Tholing was an important pilgrimage site for the royal family , and was treated as a site of supreme holiness , dedicated to the Enlightened One .

title: Zandess Danthiir
description: Zandess Danthiir Zandess Danthiir ( pronounced " ZAHN - dess DAN - theer " ) , titled the " Strong Arm of Tyr " , was a human paladin from Tethyr in the 14th century DR and a senior member of the Moonstars . Personality . As a paladin , Zandess was supremely zealous in her faith and highly principled .

title: Zandever Eyredanus
description: Zandever Eyredanus Zandever " Nighteyes " Eyredanus is a guide in the town of Triboar . He earned his reputation for guiding parties through the woods during the night , in order to strike against the orc s . He often deals with wealthy Waterdhavians .

title: Zandilar the Dancer
description: Zandilar the Dancer Zandilar the Dancer was a female deity in the Yuir elven pantheon . Her avatar appeared as a blue - skinned elf . Her portfolio was similar to that of Hanali Celanil and Sune , but it was focused on intense passionate love that burned quickly and died out .

title: Zanhoriloch
description: Zanhoriloch Zanhoriloch was a dwarven city located on an island in Lake Thoroot . An aboleth colony in the lake was also known by this name . The dwarves often called their city Mhorilot , meaning " dark surface .

title: Zann
description: Zann Zann was the scholarly deity of learning and intelligence of Zakhara . He was one of the eight Great Gods of the Land of Fate and preached the value of studying and understanding , of seeking new and preserving old knowledge . Zann ' s symbol was a fountain ' s jet .

title: Zaor Moonflower
description: Zaor Moonflower Zaor Moonflower was the husband of Queen Amlaruil Moonflower and king of Evermeet . Description . Zaor had blue hair .

title: Zar ' ithra
description: Zar ' ithra A zar ' ithra ( plural " zar ' ithra ' rin " ) or shadow draconic drow was a member of an offshoot of the drow race primarily found in the city of Chaulssin . They were the non - first - generation drow offspring of the shadow dragon s of Clan Jaezred and thus were not half - dragon s . Abilities .

title: Zar - Dandan
description: Zar - Dandan Zar - Dandan , who was also called the Wanderer or Gold - Teeth , was a half - elven traveler in the Hordelands in 1367 DR . Description . Zar - Dandan earned his nickname of Gold - Teeth for the many gold - capped teeth lining his mouth .

title: Zara Dalkor
description: Zara Dalkor Zara Dalkor was a knight of Helm in Helm ' s Hold sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . History . Zara was a member of the Order of the Gilded Eye .

title: Zarad Duskmarrow
description: Zarad Duskmarrow Zarad Duskmarrow was a wizard who dwelled in a great clock tower hidden in the depths of the Cloak Wood . According to rumor , he studied necromancy and other strange arts . Ysuran Auondril served him as an apprentice , and wrote his black tome under his tutelage .

title: Zaralda
description: Zaralda Zaralda was a necromancer and Red Wizard of Thay in Kryptgarden Forest in 1489 DR . History . In 1489 DR , she went to Kryptgarden where , in order to broker an alliance with the old or new factions of the Cult of the Dragon , she helped Claugiyliamatar to corrupt the forest .

title: Zaranda Rhindaun II
description: Zaranda Rhindaun II Zaranda Rhindaun II was the third queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty and the second queen of Tethyr by that name . Relationships . Zaranda was the granddaughter of Zaranda Star , the famous adventuress and first queen of the Rhindaun Dynasty , through her mother Queen Sybille .

title: Zaranda Star
description: Zaranda Star Zaranda Star Rhindaun was a former human adventuress , countess , and then Queen of Tethyr . Description . Zaranda was very tall , standing at six feet , one inch , and had an athletic build .

title: Zaratan
description: Zaratan The zaratan ( " pl " zaratani ) was a huge that lived in the seas surrounding Zakhara . A zaratan ' s shell could easily measure hundreds of feet in diameter . Combat .

title: Zarbrina
description: Zarbrina Zarbrina was the name given in the " Realms " to , an extremely soft lead - like mineral , colorless and easily cut into brilliant gems . Description . Due to its softness , this ornamental stone was often used in ceremonial or little - used jewelry , or set in small protective metal claw mounts on sleeves or collar - hems of gowns .

title: Zardazik
description: Zardazik Zardazik was a soft metal used to create alloyed weapons that were undetectable and could be easily hidden inside a person . Appearance . In its raw state , zardazik was an amber to red color , similar to raw iron in some respects .

title: Zarell Tahaladar
description: Zarell Tahaladar Zarell Tahaladar was a drow scroll merchant in Mantol - Derith . Personality . Zarell was an elegant drow with a passion for books .

title: Zargon
description: Zargon Zargon the Returner was an elder evil abomination who hungered to drown the world in its slime . Legends indicate that Zargon may have been the first master of the Nine Hells . Other stories say he was a Demon Prince that was thrown out of the Abyss .

title: Zariel
description: Zariel Zariel is an archdevil of the Nine Hells , Lord of Avernus . Background . Once favored by Asmodeus , Zariel sided against him in the Reckoning of Hell .

title: Zarif
description: Zarif Zarif was a small town located on Dihl al - Taif in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Zarif was surrounded in every direction by hundreds of miles of scorching desert .

title: Zarifar
description: Zarifar Zarifar was a drow wizard from Sshamath . Personality . Zarifar was a very talented geometer wizard , with his mind always full of geometric designs .

title: Zarifrax
description: Zarifrax Zarifrax was a lich in the Neverdeath Graveyard of Neverwinter . History . Zarifrax was a very powerful lich but at one time his mortal body was destroyed and only his phylactery remained .

title: Zarod
description: Zarod Zarod was a fallen angel in the Labyrinth during the Rage of Demons . History . The gods condemned Zarod and seven other fallen angels to remain as stone statues in the depths of the Labyrinth for unknown crimes .

title: Zarr
description: Zarr Zarr was a mad half - elf mercenary in Undermountain in 1479 DR . History . In 1479 DR he during a work in Dalelands saw a strange glyph .

title: Zarracee Ambroanye
description: Zarracee Ambroanye Zarracee Ambroanye was a spectral harpist that haunted the Whistling Wizard inn and specifically the Wizard Well located in the basement of that establishment . People throughout the Moonsea region thought of her and the water - filled cistern as a single entity , usually referred to as " the Well " . Activities .

title: Zarrick
description: Zarrick Zarrick the Sorcerer was an evil magic - user member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR . History . Zarrick originally served in Vaasa ' s army .

title: Zarwu Koi
description: Zarwu Koi Zarwu Koi was a stocky bushi in Shou Lung . History . Zarwu was an experienced soldier acting as a guard for caravans along the Ningtang Road in order to eliminate the growing menace of bandits in the hills of Ching Ring in 1358 DR .

title: Zasheena Drethyl
description: Zasheena Drethyl Zasheena Drethyl was one of the leaders of the Shadowkiss , a criminal organization that operated in the Dusk Ports of Returned Abeir . Description . Zasheena was beautiful by dragonborn standards , though she was also big and had an imposing figure .

title: Zasian Menz
description: Zasian Menz Zasian Menz was a priest of Cyric , who posed as a Banite in order to enter Dweomerheart and steal Azuth ' s staff , enabling Cyric to kill Mystra . Description . Zasian was described as young and handsome .

title: Zayir
description: Zayir Zayir was a small town located on the Pilgrims ' Route in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Description . Nestled between the Golden Gulf to the south and the Al - Akara Mountains to the north , Zayir was one of the few stops along the Pilgrim ' s Route heading south into the Cities of the Pantheon .

title: Zaynal
description: Zaynal Zaynal was a half - elven sorcerer and scribe living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Zaynal was a bit of a cheat and liar .

title: Zaynal ibn Sabur
description: Zaynal ibn Sabur Zaynal ibn Sabur was one of Grand Caliph Khalil al - Assad al - Zahir ' s wives in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Zaynal was a dark and passionate beauty and one of Khalil ' s favorite wives .

title: Zazspar Bronzefire
description: Zazspar Bronzefire Zazspar Bronzefire was a shield dwarf mage and a member of the Harpers in Mirabar sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zazspar posed as a stablehand .

title: Zbavra
description: Zbavra Zbavra the Witch - Queen was a human cleric , sorcerer and Disciple of Mammon who served in the Servants of Mammon and had joined Mammon ' s court in his palace in Minauros , in the Nine Hells . Background . Zbavra was originally a cleric of Hextor and chose to move to the Nine Hells to serve him , but decided that she wanted more power and joined forces with Mammon instead .

title: Zeboaster
description: Zeboaster Zeboaster the Blunt was a sage who lived in Ordulin in Sembia in the 1350s DR . Zeboaster named the god of suffering Ilmater " the Stupid God " , and called the zulkir s of Thay the " Dumb Wizards of Thay " after they failed to conquer Rashemen . Zeboaster disappeared in 1358 DR .

title: Zedarr T ' sarran
description: Zedarr T ' sarran Zedarr T ' sarran was a male drow from Maerimydra , the son of Irae T ' sarran and an unholy champion of Kiaransalee . Description . Although Zedarr was of average height for a male drow , he was an imposing figure in his black full plate armor .

title: Zeeahd
description: Zeeahd Zeeahd was a spellscar ed diviner agent of Mephistopheles in Faerûn . History . Zeehad and Sayeed fought in the Twilight War of 1374 DR , where they were killed by Abelar Corrinthal ' s troops .

title: Zeearie
description: Zeearie Zeearie was a female githyanki operating on the Sword Coast North in the 1370s DR . History . Zeearie was one of the Sword Stalker knights serving the Lich Queen , Vlaakith , on the Astral Plane .

title: Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin
description: Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin Zeerith Q ' Xorlarrin was the matron mother of House Xorlarrin of Menzoberranzan . She was matron mother in 1361 DR and still remained in that position in 1484 DR , when House Xorlarrin moved to the city of Q ' Xorlarrin . Personality .

title: Zegdar
description: Zegdar Zegdar was a minotaur chieftain and an ally of the Cult of the Eternal Flame at the Fane of the Eye under Tyar - Besil during the Elemental Evil crisis . Relationships . Zegdar led the Emberhorn tribe .

title: Zehir
description: Zehir Zehir was an apparent interloper deity who came to Toril around the time of the Spellplague and took up residence in the Sea of Poison near Talona ' s realm in the Towers of Night . Personality . His methods were aggressive , yet subtle .

title: Zekaqux
description: Zekaqux Zekaqux was one of the leading ixzan members of the Xendreth , ruling council of Malydren in 1370 DR , as well as the city ' s high priest of Ilxendren . History . Zekaqux born in the year of Malydren ' s founding , 602 DR , and together with Phiaqiv was transformed into a greater vampire by an avatar of Ilxendren .

title: Zekyl
description: Zekyl The zekyl ( plural " zekylyn " ; feminine " zebeyl " , plural " zebylyn " ) or half – shadow dragon drow , were an offshoot of the drow race . Abilities . A " zekyl " had the abilities of a drow and that of a half - dragon of shadow dragon patronage .

title: Zel Tregarthen
description: Zel Tregarthen Zel Tregarthen was a high - ranking member of the Brotherhood of the Cloak in Mulmaster . Relationships . Tregarthen was an internal investigator for the Cloaks , tasked with rooting out corruption .

title: Zelatar
description: Zelatar Zelatar was the capital and political hub of the Abyssal realm of Azzagrat . Geography . Zelatar occupied a place on all three Abyssal planes that made up Azzagrat .

title: Zelbross
description: Zelbross Zelbross was a hamlet lying on the Delimbiyr Route , halfway between Loudwater and Secomber . In the 1360s DR , it was home to about 120 people . Zelbross was famous for its clay smoking pipes .

title: Zeld Mizzrym
description: Zeld Mizzrym Zeld Mizzrym was a drow priestess of House Mizzrym in Menzoberranzan . History . Around 1361 DR , Zeld was a Mizzrym priestess and an instructor at Arach - Tinilith .

title: Zelia
description: Zelia Zelia was a powerful yuan - ti psionicist who planted mental seeds in people all over Toril , who were taken over and became her agents with their own psionic powers , albeit lesser than hers . She used them in a plot of world domination . Her demise started when she became interested in the young psion Arvin , who had powers similar to hers .

title: Zellix
description: Zellix Zellix was a mind flayer who founded and managed an asylum in the Underdark during the Rage of Demons . History . Zellix discovered that brains of people infected by the demon lord s ' madness were more succulent and tasty than others .

title: Zelphar Arunsun
description: Zelphar Arunsun Zelphar Arunsun was a powerful human wizard , originally from Neverwinter . He was the son of Khelben " Blackstaff " Arunsun and married Lhestyn . His son is Khelben Arunsun the Younger , who is often confused with the Blackstaff .

title: Zelphar Thann
description: Zelphar Thann Zelphar Thann was the fourth son of Rhammas and Cassandra Thann of Waterdeep and an older brother of Danilo Thann . He served as Tethyr ' s Count of Rivershire and Estate Chancellor . He was in charge of public works and maintained the siegeworks in the Reclamation Army .

title: Zelpir
description: Zelpir Zelpir was a small city in Var the Golden in the Shining Lands in 1367 DR . Geography . Zelpir sat on the southwest shore of the Golden Water near Pyratar .

title: Zelraun Roaringhorn
description: Zelraun Roaringhorn Zelraun Roaringhorn was a wizard member of the Harper s during the Rage of Demons . History . Zelraun hailed from the noble Roaringhorn family .

title: Zendalure
description: Zendalure Zendalure was a gemstone with remarkable preservative properties , unique to the Realms . Description . Zendalure crystals could be found in places where lava had cooled and become solid .

title: Zendaros Rallogar
description: Zendaros Rallogar Zendaros Rallogar was a Tethyrian human man living in the city of Wheloon in Cormyr . He was the proprietor of Rallogar Hardware . Zendaros was in business with Rallogar Hardware by 1358 DR .

title: Zenobia
description: Zenobia Zenobia was a dwarf fighter from the world of Oerth who , along with her companions , was sent to Toril after angering an evil mage . Description . Zenobia had long , braided blonde hair , and a substantial blonde beard .

title: Zephyros
description: Zephyros Zephyros was an eccentric cloud giant wizard sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Zephyros lived in his floating Tower of Zephyros .

title: Zerath
description: Zerath Zerath was a dragonborn of Abeir , and one of the ancestors of Clan Kepeshkmolik . History . Zerath was one of the seven wise elders who raised Shasphur .

title: Zerbin Gethrik
description: Zerbin Gethrik Zerbin Gethrik was a cleric of Tempus in Chondath in 1358 DR . History . Once Zerbin was a murderer on the Sword Coast until he escaped to Chondath to flee justice .

title: Zern Xerkstil
description: Zern Xerkstil Zern Xerkstil was an agent of the Order of the Gauntlet in the Moonsea in 1489 DR . Personality . Zern was a brash and headstrong warrior .

title: Zerth
description: Zerth Within githzerai culture , zerths are those who mix arcane arts with other skills and powers — particularly martial or psionic ones . These githzerai follow the example of Zerthimon , even if they do so unintentionally . Any githzerai who multiclass es or hybrids an arcane class with a non - arcane class can claim the honorific " zerth .

title: Zespara Alather
description: Zespara Alather Zespara Alather is a talented swordsmith who runs the House of the Bright Blade in Mirabar . Occasionally one to partake in adventuring , Zespara has powerful friends , notably , several anonymous mage s . Also a members of the Harpers , she also sometimes operates as an agent of the Lords ' Alliance ; as such , Zespara Alather has slain many dangerous members of evil organizations such as the Zhentarim , the Red Wizards and the Arcane Brotherhood .

title: Zesstra Aleanrahel
description: Zesstra Aleanrahel Zesstra Aleanrahel was a member of House Aleanrahel and a secret cleric of Shar in Ched Nasad in the year 1370 DR . and 1372 History . Zesstra was the third daughter of Matron Mother Jyslin Aleanrahel .

title: Zet
description: Zet Zet was an efreeti who lived in the Pantheist League in Zakhara in 1367 DR . Relationships . Zet was the genie servant and bodyguard of the sha ' ir Othmar bin Jaqal .

title: Zetharmas
description: Zetharmas Zetharmas was a tiefling warlock in the Plane of Shadow in 1374 DR . History . Zetharmas was rumored to be the scion of a powerful demon lord , but nobody knew if this was true .

title: Zethrindor
description: Zethrindor Zethrindor was an ancient white dragon dracolich who allied with Sammaster during the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR . History . In 1373 DR , Sammaster realized that the reemergence of metallic dragon s threatened his plan , so he allied with the Ice Witch Iyraclea and sent Zethrindor and a host of dragons to her .

title: Zezania Tarth - Kelet
description: Zezania Tarth - Kelet Zezania Tarth - Kelet was a Chultan human woman from Tashalar . She was a priestess of Shar and a member of Demarch ' s Folly , an organization dedicated to learning shadow magic . Abilities .

title: Zezen Washio
description: Zezen Washio Zezen Washio was a samurai adventurer in Kozakura . History . Washio hailed from the illustrious and noble Zezen clan and he was the eldest son of an eldest son .

title: Zhai
description: Zhai Zhai was a half - drow , half - wood elf rogue of the 14th century DR . Abilities . She was able to use twin dagger s and had skill at hiding herself .

title: Zhengyi
description: Zhengyi Zhengyi the Witch - King was once a Red Wizard of Thay , but later became an enormously powerful lich and servant of the demon prince Orcus . In the far north of Vaasa in northeast Faerûn , Zhengyi created Castle Perilous in just one night in 1347 DR , and summoned the various goblin s , giant s and orc s of the lands to him . History .

title: Zhentarim
description: Zhentarim The Zhentarim were a mercenary company who , over their 200 years of existence , experienced several leaps and bounds in terms of successes , but also several major defeats . As of 1479 DR they were a shadow of their former glory , but still an organization of great power and influence . Hierarchy .

title: Zhentil Keep
description: Zhentil Keep Zhentil Keep ( also called Thargate Keep ) was once the most powerful city in the Moonsea region as well as the main base of operation for the Zhentarim . Along with the Citadel of the Raven , Zhentil Keep was destroyed by the Shadovar in 1383 DR after it was discovered that the Zhentarim had forged an alliance with the phaerimm . History .

title: Zhentilar
description: Zhentilar The Zhentilar were the standing army of Zhentil Keep . History . The Zhentilar were formed sometime after the death of Zhentar in 753 DR as a group loyal to his vision .

title: Zhessae
description: Zhessae Zhessae was a member of the Zhentarim in Mulmaster in the Year of the Tankard , 1370 DR . Relationships . Zhessae was a follower of Fzoul Chembryl .

title: Zhindia Melarn
description: Zhindia Melarn Zhindia Melarn was the first matron mother of House Melarn in Menzoberranzan . Personality . Zhindia was known for being extremely fanatical to Lolth , and because of that and her status as the youngest matron on the Ruling Council , she was rarely taken seriously by other matron mothers .

title: Zhjaeve
description: Zhjaeve Zhjaeve was a githzerai planewalker who famously traveled to the Prime Material Plane to do battle with the King of Shadows at the Kalach - Cha ' s side . Physical description . Like other githzerai , Zhjaeve exhibited several seemingly alien features , in spite of her human ancestry .

title: Zhora Hallen
description: Zhora Hallen Zhora Hallen was a drow explorer and hunter during the Rage of Demons . Relationship . Zhora was very close to her daughter Hanne .

title: Zhundult Ulblesk
description: Zhundult Ulblesk Zhundult " Stormhand " Ulblesk was a male human wizard who made his home in Tantras in 1358 DR . He was one of the more notable mages of the city at the time . He was a dangerous and quite possibly insane mage who aggressively defended his privacy .

title: Zi Liang
description: Zi Liang Zi Liang was was an acolyte of Chauntea in Goldenfields sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Activities . Often Zi Liang tried to convince Father Ellardin Darovik to no affide the defense of the place to incompetent military leaders .

title: Zikthann
description: Zikthann Zikthann of the Six Scepters was a human lich living in Sshamath in the year 1370 DR . History . Zikthann was a wizard from Illusk .

title: Zilchyn Q ' Leptin
description: Zilchyn Q ' Leptin Zilchyn Q ' Leptin , or simply Zilch , was a drow wizard in Mantol - Derith during the Rage of Demons . . Personality .

title: Zillak
description: Zillak Zillak was a member of House Baenre and an assassin in the service of the Archmage of Menzoberranzan Gromph Baenre in 1373 DR . History . Zillak was one of Gromph ' s most trusted agents .

title: Zilvreen
description: Zilvreen Zilvreen was one of the Wearers of Purple in the Cult of the Dragon . He was the master thief of the cult and a member of the Wearers of Purple council . He usually resided in Saerloon .

title: Zilzmaer
description: Zilzmaer Zilzmaer was a drow warrior of House Faen Tlabbar , the fourth house of Menzoberranzan until the Silence of Lolth . History . Zilzmaer was one of the guards of Faen Tlabbar ' s complex .

title: Zima al - Hatik
description: Zima al - Hatik Zima al - Hatik was a sage who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR . Description . Zima was a cranky old man .

title: Zimrilim
description: Zimrilim Zimrilim was the ruler of Unthalass in Unther in 1357 DR . Activities . Zimrilim was the right hand of Gilgeam .

title: Zin
description: Zin Zin were spirit snakes that inhabited rivers and lake beds of Zakhara . They could shapeshift at will and enjoyed a good prank . Their bard ic nature meant they enjoyed spreading song and merriment , along with mischief , to those who traveled near their habitat .

title: Zin - carla
description: Zin - carla Zin - carla , " spirit - wraith " in the Drow language , was a special type of undead created through a ritual performed by arachne . Lolth only granted the zin - carla ritual for specific tasks , which may never be purely to work revenge or bring harm on other drow . Failure brought the disfavor of Lolth .

title: Zin - carla ( spell )
description: Zin - carla ( spell ) Zin - carla was a practice of the drow , given only to those who have most pleased Lolth the Spider Queen . Zin - carla was a spell that could give a corpse a semblance of life . It was a more advanced form of reanimation where the reanimated corpse was not simply a mindless zombie , but retained all the capabilities it had while it was alive .

title: Zindalankh
description: Zindalankh Zindalankh was a coastal city of Murghôm . Location . Zindalankh sat on the western rim of the Semphar Water within the southern portion of Gbor Nor .

title: Zindira
description: Zindira Zindira was a priestess of Eilistraee . Activities . Zindira was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden .

title: Zinjir al - Muqi
description: Zinjir al - Muqi Zinjir al - Muqi , also known as the Twelvefold Master or the Shackle - breaker , was a wizard from Hiyal in 1367 DR . Activities . Zinjir was able to overcome the powerful magic used upon holy slayer s designed to keep them from breaking their oaths of silence .

title: Zinnirit Yauntyrr
description: Zinnirit Yauntyrr Zinnirit Yauntyrr was the former house wizard of House Yauntyrr of Eryndlyn . Description . Zinnirit was aged .

title: Zinzerena
description: Zinzerena Zinzerena was the drow goddess of chaos and assassins until Lolth killed her and took her portfolio . Her symbol is a shortsword draped in a black cloak , symbolizing her hidden menace . Zinzerena was a female drow illusionist and assassin of supreme skill .

title: Ziose
description: Ziose Ziose was the name given by sages to a particularly transparent variety of rosaline . Description . Ziose was a rare mineral that yielded facet - grade stones that flashed three different colors depending on how the light refracted through them or at what angle they were viewed — purple , blue , and red , or purple , green , and red ( see Gallery ) .

title: Ziran
description: Ziran Ziran or bloodfast was a magical drug made from a number of subterranean fungi . The drow were the first to produce it . Description .

title: Zircon
description: Zircon Zircon was a mineral that could be cut into faceted gem s . Description . Zircon was volcanic in origin , found in igneous rock formations .

title: Ziss al - Waran
description: Ziss al - Waran Ziss al - Waran , or Ziss the Lizard , was a lizardfolk merchant living in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Description . Green scales covered Ziss ' skin .

title: Zither
description: Zither The zither was a stringed instrument with a flat box as its resonating body . It was played by plucking its strings , usually on a table . Description .

title: Zitli
description: Zitli Zitli was the high priest of Zaltec in Palul . History . In 1361 DR , his prime assistant was Shatil , brother of Erixitl .

title: Ziyero Ridge
description: Ziyero Ridge Ziyero Ridge , also called Zigero Range , was a mountain range running through Koguryo in Koryo . Locations . The vast Dang Caverns lay beneath the range ' s northern tip .

title: Zo
description: Zo Zo was the proprietor of the Lord Cyric ' s Bane tavern in Priapurl on the Dragon Coast in 1372 DR . Personality . Formerly a priest of Bane , Zo claimed he became disinterested in the politics of the Zhentarim and vowed to become an honest citizen instead .

title: Zoartik
description: Zoartik Zoartik was one of the most violent mind flayer s of Ch ' Chitl in 1370 DR . Personality . Zoartik suffered from a mental problem : he could not completely sublimate the mind of his original drow host .

title: Zobeida bint Maneira
description: Zobeida bint Maneira Zobeida bint Maneira was a sorcerer within the Palace of the Enlightened Throne in Huzuz , the City of Delights , in 1367 DR . Activities . Zobeida served as an assistant of the Grand Vizier , Alyana al - Azzazi .

title: Zochimaloc
description: Zochimaloc Zochimaloc was the ruler of Tulom - Itzi in 1361 DR . Personality . He was very wise and knew much concerning the coming of the Golden Legion in Maztica , but was very enigmatic in speaking about it .

title: Zofia
description: Zofia Zofia ( often named with her title as Zofia Othlor , which meant " elder among witches " ) was one of the Witches of Rashemen and an oracle and elder of the witches in her community in Dernovia , Rashemen . Description . Zofia was old and plump and had blue eyes .

title: Zokan Thunderer
description: Zokan Thunderer Zokan Thunderer was the chieftain of the Elk Tribe of the Uthgardt Personality . Zokan was well known for his barbaric exaggeration . He was regarded as possibly the ugliest , rudest , richest , wiliest , and the most feared and hated bandit leader in the North .

title: Zola Sethrakt
description: Zola Sethrakt Zola Sethrakt was a necromancer and a member of the council of zulkirs during the war of Thay . Appearance . Zola was a youthful - looking woman , appearing quite comely .

title: Zombie
description: Zombie A zombie is an undead creature usually created by the re - animation of a corpse . Unlike animated skeletons , zombies still retain some flesh on their bodies , and give off a horrid , rank smell . They are almost mindless , but can be given simple commands , such as " kill anyone who opens the treasure chest .

title: Zomir
description: Zomir Zomir was a Calishite human bounty hunter active in 1357 DR . He was one of a trio of bounty hunters hired by Baron Abon Duum of Manshaka to recover or slay the escaped slave - gladiator Vajra Valmeyjar . In 1357 DR , they went to the Selûne ' s Smile in Waterdeep and used a poison dart and a club to subdue Vajra and kidnap her , though even beaten and drugged she put up a fight .

title: Zomith
description: Zomith Zomith was a half - orc caravan guard during the Elemental Evil crisis . Activities . Zomith worked as a caravan guard .

title: Zone of sweet air
description: Zone of sweet air Zone of sweet air was an abjuration spell that protected a large area from unhealthy vapors . Effects . All natural and magical ( e .

title: Zone of truth
description: Zone of truth Zone of truth was an enchantment spell that prevented lies from being spoken within the area of effect . Effects . For a few minutes , an area designated by the caster became a no - lie zone .

title: Zook
description: Zook Zook was a yellow faerie dragon in Cormanthor . Activities . The goddess Mielikki herself tasked Zook with a mission to protect the Cormanthor forest .

title: Zoran Baenre
description: Zoran Baenre Zoran Baenre was a member of House Baenre who was a second - year apprentice at Sorcere " circa " 1373 DR . Gromph considered him annoying . History .

title: Zorkh
description: Zorkh Zorkh was a stone giant hermit sometime after the War of the Silver Marches . Description . Zorkh was mute ; he could understand the Giant language but could not speak .

title: Zormarq
description: Zormarq Zormarq the Phantyrant was the last beholder hive mother of Ooltul , who survived as an undead doomsphere in 1370 DR . History . Zormarq was the last beholder hive mother to claim the title of ocularch .

title: Zorquan
description: Zorquan Zorquan ( pronounced " ZORE - kwon " ) was the neutral dragon god of dragon kind and " dragonness " , that is , the essence of what it was to be a dragon . Zorquan was supposed to encompass all alignments dragonkind could have , but was often regarded as neutral . Description .

title: Zosker Anthalar
description: Zosker Anthalar Zosker Anthalar was a sage in Escalant , Thay . Personality . Anthalar believed there was a great need for strong and brave companions to fight evil during the Year of the Shadows .

title: Zotha
description: Zotha Zotha was a godlike being who , according to the " Book of the World " , created a Crystal Sun at the beginning of time , while the god Asgorath created Toril . Asgorath casted Zotha down from the heavens , and Zotha was not mentioned again . Historically , Asgorath actually casted down an " ice moon , " to the surface of Abeir - Toril in an event known as the Tearfall , wiping out the Batrachi civilization and creating the Sea of Fallen Stars .

title: Zrie Prakis
description: Zrie Prakis Zrie Prakis was a lich . History . Zrie Prakis lived several centuries before the 14th century DR .

title: Zrintor
description: Zrintor Zrintor , also known as the Viper Forest , was a region on the 45th layer of the Abyss that was populated by viper tree s . Geography . Located somewhere along the banks of the River of Salt , Zrintor was a salty marsh pockmarked by pits of " quicksalt " .

title: Zstulkk Ssarmn
description: Zstulkk Ssarmn Zstulkk Ssarmn was a slaver of Skullport and one of the founders of the Iron Ring . Description . Zstulkk Ssarmn ' s head closely resembled a human , but the rest of his body was that of a large snake with no arms or legs .

title: Zthyz al - Zin
description: Zthyz al - Zin Zthyz al - Zin was a zin living among the waters of the River of Gold on the Island of Gardens in 1367 DR . Personality . Zthyz enjoyed playing tricks and pranks on any visitors to the River of Gold .

title: Zuggtmoy
description: Zuggtmoy Zuggtmoy , also know as the Demon Queen of Fungi , and the Lady of Rot and Decay , was a demon lord . Activities . Her only desire was to infect living creatures with her spores , making them her mindless slaves and , eventually , into rotting and decomposing hosts for mushrooms , moulds and spores that she spawned .

title: Zukimoto Chikitada
description: Zukimoto Chikitada Zukimoto Chikitada was a samurai in Wa . Personality . Zukimoto was deeply loyal to his master but never admitted it to anyone .

title: Zulifein T ' orgh
description: Zulifein T ' orgh Zulifein T ' orgh held the position of secondwizard of a group belonging to Clan Auzkovyn in 1372 DR . History . Zulifein T ' orgh was born in Sshamath and enjoyed a privileged life as a wizard .

title: Zulkir
description: Zulkir Zulkir was a title of power among the Red Wizards of Thay . There were eight zulkirs , one for each School of Magic ; together they ruled the Red Wizards and , by extension , Thay itself . They did not directly control the country , as the day - to - day governing was left to the tharchion s .

title: Zulkoon
description: Zulkoon A zulkoon was a wind musical instrument that functioned like a portable pump organ . Description . A zulkoon player pumped air into the instrument and through its organ pipes using a foot pump .

title: Zundaerazylym
description: Zundaerazylym Zundaerazylym , or Amundra Nelaerdra , was an ancient steel dragon in Neverwinter in 1374 DR . History . Zundaerazylym came to believe that the two greatest menaces to the North were the harsh climate and orc hordes .

title: Zundbridge
description: Zundbridge Zundbridge was a massive , squat bridge located about 10 miles southeast of Waterdeep , where the Trade Way crossed the Dessarin River . The bridge was named after the wizard Zund , who created it . As of 1370 DR , the bridge had held firm without repairs for more than 90 winters .

title: Zuras el Ireen
description: Zuras el Ireen Zuras el Ireen was the Grand Yrshelem of Ships of the Rundeen in 1370 DR . History . Zuras started as a pirate in service to the Rundeen .

title: Zurkhwood
description: Zurkhwood Zurkhwood was a fungus that grew in the Underdark . It had edible spores and the tree - like stems could be used as a building material . Description .

title: Zvopua
description: Zvopua Zvopua was a foulwing involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR . History . Zvopua was the loyal mount of the high ranking member of Zhentarim Eregul the Freestave ; like his master Zvopua was part of the Zhentarim Occupation Army in Shadowdale in 1375 .

title: Zwei
description: Zwei Zwei was the first Netherese arcanist to be credited with the creation of new spells . The variator introduced the three successively more powerful " extension " spells in the years 1280 to 1300 NY of Netheril ' s Silver Age . All other facts about Zwei ' s life ( including his or her gender ) were lost to history .

title: Zyl
description: Zyl Zyl was a fire spirit in the service of the Stag King , a dark fey lord who lived in Ashenwood forest . He was sent by the Stag King to spy on a stronghold in the Feywild that belonged to a tribe of cyclops and their fomorian queen . Zyl had shapechanged into the form of a giant rat but was captured by the cyclops ' goblin servants who were about to prepare him to eat .

title: Zz ' Pzora
description: Zz ' Pzora Zz ' Pzora was a mutated deep dragon . Description . Zz ' Pzora had two heads with different personalities .

title: Zzar
description: Zzar Zzar was a fortified sherry wine popular in Waterdeep . Description . Zzar had an orange color and an almondy scent ( and flavor ) .
